name: aeval_idempotentLiftPow
statement:
theorem aeval_idempotentLiftPow (n : ℕ) (x : R) :
    aeval x (idempotentLiftPow n (X : ℤ[X])) = idempotentLiftPow n x
proof:
:= by
  simp [idempotentLiftPow]

name: map_idempotentLiftPow
statement:
theorem map_idempotentLiftPow {S F : Type*} [Ring S] [FunLike F R S] [RingHomClass F R S] (g : F)
    (n : ℕ) (x : R) : g (idempotentLiftPow n x) = idempotentLiftPow n (g x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [idempotentLiftPow]

name: X_sub_X_sq_dvd_idempotentLiftPow_sub
statement:
theorem X_sub_X_sq_dvd_idempotentLiftPow_sub {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (X - X ^ 2 : ℤ[X]) ∣ idempotentLiftPow n X - X
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (X : ℤ[X]) ∣ idempotentLiftPow n X - X := by
    rw [X_dvd_iff, coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
    simp [idempotentLiftPow, zero_pow hn]
  have h1 : (X - C 1 : ℤ[X]) ∣ idempotentLiftPow n X - X := by
    rw [dvd_iff_isRoot]
    simp [idempotentLiftPow, zero_pow hn]
  have hc : IsCoprime (X : ℤ[X]) (X - C 1) := ⟨1, -1, by simp⟩
  have h := hc.mul_dvd h0 h1
  have he : (X - X ^ 2 : ℤ[X]) = -(X * (X - C 1)) := by simp; ring
  rw [he, neg_dvd]
  exact h

name: X_dvd_idempotentLiftPow
statement: theorem X_dvd_idempotentLiftPow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (X : ℤ[X]) ∣ idempotentLiftPow n X
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_dvd_iff, coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
  simp [idempotentLiftPow, zero_pow hn]

name: isIdempotentElem_idempotentLiftPow
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_idempotentLiftPow {x : R} {n : ℕ} (h : (x - x ^ 2) ^ n = 0) :
    IsIdempotentElem (idempotentLiftPow n x)
proof:
:=
  isIdempotentElem_one_sub_one_sub_pow_pow x n h

name: idempotentLiftPow_eq_idempotentLiftPow
statement:
theorem idempotentLiftPow_eq_idempotentLiftPow {x : R} {k n m : ℕ} (hk : (x - x ^ 2) ^ k = 0)
    (hn : k ≤ n) (hm : k ≤ m) : idempotentLiftPow n x = idempotentLiftPow m x
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk0
  · have : Subsingleton R := subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one (by simpa using hk.symm)
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := X_sub_X_sq_dvd_idempotentLiftPow_sub (n := n) hn0
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := X_sub_X_sq_dvd_idempotentLiftPow_sub (n := m) hm0
  have hcomm : ∀ p q : ℤ[X], Commute (aeval x p) (aeval x q) := fun p q ↦ by
    change _ * _ = _ * _
    rw [← map_mul, mul_comm, map_mul]
  refine eq_of_isNilpotent_sub_of_isIdempotentElem_of_commute
    (isIdempotentElem_idempotentLiftPow (pow_eq_zero_of_le hn hk))
    (isIdempotentElem_idempotentLiftPow (pow_eq_zero_of_le hm hk)) ?_ ?_
  · have he : idempotentLiftPow n x - idempotentLiftPow m x =
        aeval x (X - X ^ 2 : ℤ[X]) * aeval x (a - b) := by
      rw [← aeval_idempotentLiftPow n x, ← aeval_idempotentLiftPow m x, ← map_mul, mul_sub, ← ha,
        ← hb]
      simp
    rw [he]
    refine Commute.isNilpotent_mul_right (hcomm (X - X ^ 2) (a - b)) ⟨k, ?_⟩
    simpa using hk
  · rw [← aeval_idempotentLiftPow n x, ← aeval_idempotentLiftPow m x]
    exact hcomm _ _

name: nilpotencyClass_le_of_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nilpotencyClass_le_of_pow_eq_zero {x : R} {k : ℕ} (hk : x ^ k = 0) :
    nilpotencyClass x ≤ k
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_le hk

name: idempotentLift_eq
statement:
theorem idempotentLift_eq {x : R} {n : ℕ} (h : (x - x ^ 2) ^ n = 0) :
    idempotentLift x = idempotentLiftPow n x
proof:
:=
  idempotentLiftPow_eq_idempotentLiftPow (k := nilpotencyClass (x - x ^ 2))
    (pow_nilpotencyClass ⟨n, h⟩) le_rfl (nilpotencyClass_le_of_pow_eq_zero h)

name: isIdempotentElem_idempotentLift
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_idempotentLift {x : R} (h : IsNilpotent (x - x ^ 2)) :
    IsIdempotentElem (idempotentLift x)
proof:
:=
  isIdempotentElem_idempotentLiftPow (pow_nilpotencyClass h)

name: IsIdempotentElem.idempotentLift_eq
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.idempotentLift_eq {e : R} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    idempotentLift e = e
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : e - e ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [sq, he.eq, sub_self]
  rw [_root_.idempotentLift_eq (n := 1) (by rw [pow_one, h0])]
  simp [idempotentLiftPow]

name: idempotentLiftPow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem idempotentLiftPow_mul_eq {x e : R} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hx : x * e = x) :
    idempotentLiftPow n x * e = idempotentLiftPow n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := X_dvd_idempotentLiftPow hn
  have hcomm : Commute (aeval x a) x := by
    change _ * _ = _ * _
    nth_rw 2 [← aeval_X (R := ℤ) x]
    nth_rw 3 [← aeval_X (R := ℤ) x]
    rw [← map_mul, mul_comm, map_mul]
  rw [← aeval_idempotentLiftPow n x, ha, map_mul, aeval_X, ← hcomm.eq, mul_assoc, hx]

name: mul_idempotentLiftPow_eq
statement:
theorem mul_idempotentLiftPow_eq {x e : R} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hx : e * x = x) :
    e * idempotentLiftPow n x = idempotentLiftPow n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := X_dvd_idempotentLiftPow hn
  rw [← aeval_idempotentLiftPow n x, ha, map_mul, aeval_X, ← mul_assoc, hx]

name: LinearMap.comp_pow_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem comp_pow_of_comp_eq {f : M →ₗ[S] N} {u : Module.End S M} {v : Module.End S N}
    (h : f ∘ₗ u = v ∘ₗ f) (k : ℕ) : f ∘ₗ (u ^ k) = (v ^ k) ∘ₗ f
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, ← comp_assoc, ih,
      comp_assoc, h, comp_assoc]

name: LinearMap.comp_one_sub_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem comp_one_sub_of_comp_eq {f : M →ₗ[S] N} {u : Module.End S M} {v : Module.End S N}
    (h : f ∘ₗ u = v ∘ₗ f) : f ∘ₗ (1 - u) = (1 - v) ∘ₗ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_sub, sub_comp, h]
  rfl

name: LinearMap.comp_idempotentLiftPow
proof:
:=
  comp_one_sub_of_comp_eq (comp_pow_of_comp_eq (comp_one_sub_of_comp_eq
    (comp_pow_of_comp_eq h n)) n)

name: LinearMap.comp_idempotentLift
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hv
  rw [_root_.idempotentLift_eq (pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_left a b) ha),
    _root_.idempotentLift_eq (pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_right a b) hb)]
  exact comp_idempotentLiftPow h _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BarTwist.ofU_symm_ofU
statement: @[simp] lemma ofU_symm_ofU (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) : (ofU R).symm (ofU R x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BarTwist.smul_ofU
statement: lemma smul_ofU (c : 𝕂) (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) : c • ofU R x = ofU R (RatFunc.bar c • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BarTwist.qSerre_ofU
statement:
lemma qSerre_ofU (d n : ℕ) (a b : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    qSerre (𝕧 ^ d) n (ofU R a) (ofU R b) = ofU R (qSerre (𝕧 ^ d) n a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold qSerre
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, smul_ofU]
  congr 2
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, bar_qBinomial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_zpow_X
statement: lemma bar_zpow_X (n : ℤ) : RatFunc.bar (𝕧 ^ n) = 𝕧 ^ (-n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zpow₀, RatFunc.bar_X, inv_zpow']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_relations
statement:
lemma bar_relations : Relations R 𝕧 (fun i ↦ ofU R (E R 𝕧 i)) (fun i ↦ ofU R (F R 𝕧 i))
    (barK R) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    simp only [barK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, smul_ofU, ← map_mul,
      bar_zpow_X]
    rw [K_mul_E, map_neg]
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    simp only [barK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, smul_ofU, ← map_mul,
      bar_zpow_X]
    rw [K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg]
  E_mul_F i j := by
    simp only [barK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, ← map_mul, ← map_sub]
    rw [E_mul_F_sub]
    split_ifs
    · rw [smul_ofU]
      congr 1
      rw [map_inv₀, map_sub, map_inv₀, map_pow, RatFunc.bar_X, inv_pow, inv_inv,
        ← neg_sub (𝕧 ^ D.d i), inv_neg, neg_smul, ← smul_neg, neg_sub, Kt, neg_neg]
    · simp
  serre_E i j hij := by
    rw [qSerre_ofU, serre_E R 𝕧 hij, map_zero]
  serre_F i j hij := by
    rw [qSerre_ofU, serre_F R 𝕧 hij, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_E
statement: @[simp] theorem barHom_E (i : I) : barHom R (E R 𝕧 i) = E R 𝕧 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [barHom, barAlgHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_F
statement: @[simp] theorem barHom_F (i : I) : barHom R (F R 𝕧 i) = F R 𝕧 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [barHom, barAlgHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_K
statement: @[simp] theorem barHom_K (μ : Y) : barHom R (K R 𝕧 μ) = K R 𝕧 (-μ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [barHom, barAlgHom, barK]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_smul
statement:
theorem barHom_smul (c : 𝕂) (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    barHom R (c • x) = RatFunc.bar c • barHom R x
proof:
:= by
  change (ofU R).symm (barAlgHom R (c • x)) = _
  rw [map_smul]
  change (ofU R).symm (c • ofU R ((ofU R).symm (barAlgHom R x))) = _
  rw [smul_ofU]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem barHom_algebraMap (c : 𝕂) :
    barHom R (algebraMap 𝕂 _ c) = algebraMap 𝕂 _ (RatFunc.bar c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, barHom_smul, map_one, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_barHom
statement: @[simp] theorem barHom_barHom (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) : barHom R (barHom R x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : barSq R = AlgHom.id 𝕂 _ := by
    ext <;> simp [barSq]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_minusHom
statement:
theorem barHom_minusHom (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    barHom R (minusHom R 𝕧 x) = minusHom R 𝕧 (LusztigF.bar x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, barHom_algebraMap, LusztigF.bar_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes]
  | grade1 i =>
    have := LusztigF.bar_θ (K := ℚ) i
    simp only [LusztigF.θ] at this
    rw [this]
    simp [minusHom]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_plusHom
statement:
theorem barHom_plusHom (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    barHom R (plusHom R 𝕧 x) = plusHom R 𝕧 (LusztigF.bar x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, barHom_algebraMap, LusztigF.bar_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes]
  | grade1 i =>
    have := LusztigF.bar_θ (K := ℚ) i
    simp only [LusztigF.θ] at this
    rw [this]
    simp [plusHom]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.exists_le_freeCoroot
statement:
lemma exists_le_freeCoroot (R : D.RootDatum Y) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ Λ : Y × (I →₀ ℤ) →+ ℤ, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ (R.freeCoroot.coroot i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(N : ℤ) • (Finsupp.liftAddHom fun _ ↦ AddMonoidHom.id ℤ).comp (AddMonoidHom.snd _ _),
    fun i ↦ by simp [freeCoroot]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Hom.map_ktilde
statement: lemma Hom.map_ktilde (φ : R.Hom R') (i : I) : φ.toHom (ktilde R i) = ktilde R' i
proof:
:= by
  simp [ktilde, map_nsmul, φ.map_coroot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Hom.map_reflY
statement:
lemma Hom.map_reflY (φ : R.Hom R') (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    φ.toHom (reflY R i μ) = reflY R' i (φ.toHom μ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [reflY_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, φ.map_coroot, φ.root_map]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_relations
statement:
theorem mapHom_relations (φ : R.Hom R') :
    Relations R v (E R' v) (F R' v) ((KHom R' v).comp φ.toHom.toMultiplicative) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    change K R' v (φ.toHom μ) * E R' v i = _
    rw [K_mul_E, φ.root_map]
    rfl
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    change K R' v (φ.toHom μ) * F R' v i = _
    rw [K_mul_F, φ.root_map]
    rfl
  E_mul_F i j := by
    rw [E_mul_F_sub]
    split_ifs
    · change _ = _ • (K R' v (φ.toHom (ktilde R i)) - K R' v (φ.toHom (-ktilde R i)))
      rw [map_neg, Hom.map_ktilde]
    · rfl
  serre_E _ _ h := serre_E R' v h
  serre_F _ _ h := serre_F R' v h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_E
statement: @[simp] lemma mapHom_E (φ : R.Hom R') (i : I) : mapHom v φ (E R v i) = E R' v i
proof: := lift_E _ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_F
statement: @[simp] lemma mapHom_F (φ : R.Hom R') (i : I) : mapHom v φ (F R v i) = F R' v i
proof: := lift_F _ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_K
statement: @[simp] lemma mapHom_K (φ : R.Hom R') (μ : Y) : mapHom v φ (K R v μ) = K R' v (φ.toHom μ)
proof:
:=
  lift_K _ μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_surjective
statement:
lemma mapHom_surjective (φ : R.Hom R') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ.toHom) :
    Function.Surjective (mapHom v φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : ∀ u : QuantumGroup R' v, u ∈ (mapHom v φ).range := by
    intro u
    refine induction_on R' v u (fun c ↦ (mapHom v φ).range.algebraMap_mem c)
      (fun i ↦ ⟨E R v i, mapHom_E φ i⟩) (fun i ↦ ⟨F R v i, mapHom_F φ i⟩) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
      (fun x y hx hy ↦ add_mem hx hy) (fun x y hx hy ↦ mul_mem hx hy)
    obtain ⟨μ, rfl⟩ := hφ μ
    exact ⟨K R v μ, mapHom_K φ μ⟩
  exact fun u ↦ hrange u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_comp_of_hasBraidGeneratorImages
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, mapHom_E, H.map_E, H'.map_E]
    split_ifs
    · simp [braidEi, Kt, Hom.map_ktilde]
    · simp [braidEj, serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow]
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, mapHom_F, H.map_F, H'.map_F]
    split_ifs
    · simp [braidFi, Hom.map_ktilde]
    · simp [braidFj, serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow]
  · simp [H.map_K, H'.map_K, Hom.map_reflY]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diag_relations
statement:
theorem diag_relations (c : I → kˣ) :
    Relations R v (fun i ↦ (c i : k) • E R v i) (fun i ↦ (c i : k)⁻¹ • F R v i)
      (KHom R v) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    change K R v μ * ((c i : k) • E R v i) = v ^ R.root i μ • (((c i : k) • E R v i) * K R v μ)
    rw [mul_smul_comm, K_mul_E, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm]
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    change K R v μ * ((c i : k)⁻¹ • F R v i) =
      v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (((c i : k)⁻¹ • F R v i) * K R v μ)
    rw [mul_smul_comm, K_mul_F, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm]
  E_mul_F i j := by
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_comm ((c j : k)⁻¹), ← smul_sub, E_mul_F_sub]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero _), one_smul]
      rfl
    · rw [smul_zero]
  serre_E i j h := by rw [qSerre_smul_smul, serre_E R v h, smul_zero]
  serre_F i j h := by rw [qSerre_smul_smul, serre_F R v h, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_E
statement:
@[simp] lemma diagHom_E (c : I → kˣ) (i : I) :
    diagHom R v c (E R v i) = (c i : k) • E R v i
proof: := lift_E _ i

statement:
@[simp] lemma diagHom_F (c : I → kˣ) (i : I) :
    diagHom R v c (F R v i) = (c i : k)⁻¹ • F R v i
proof: := lift_F _ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_K
statement: @[simp] lemma diagHom_K (c : I → kˣ) (μ : Y) : diagHom R v c (K R v μ) = K R v μ
proof: := lift_K _ μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_comp_diagHom
statement:
lemma diagHom_comp_diagHom (c c' : I → kˣ) :
    (diagHom R v c).comp (diagHom R v c') = diagHom R v (c * c')
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · simp [smul_smul, mul_comm]
  · simp [smul_smul, mul_comm]
  · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_one
statement: lemma diagHom_one : diagHom R v 1 = AlgHom.id k (QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_) <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_smul_smul'
statement:
lemma serreAux_smul_smul' {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (c x : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : B)
    (α β : k) : serreAux c x m (α • a) (β • b) = (α ^ m * β) • serreAux c x m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [serreAux, Finset.smul_sum, smul_pow, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  simp only [mem_range] at hr
  congr 1
  have : α ^ m = α ^ (m - r) * α ^ r := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
  rw [this]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_comp_comp_diagHom
statement:
theorem chevalley_comp_comp_diagHom [NeZero v] {i : I}
    {T : QuantumGroup R v →ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R v} (H : HasBraidGeneratorImages i T) :
    (chevalley R v).comp (T.comp ((chevalley R v).comp (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v)))) =
      (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v)).comp T
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, diagHom_E, map_smul, chevalley_E, H.map_F, H.map_E]
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst hl
      simp only [↓reduceIte, braidFi, braidEi, map_neg, map_mul, chevalley_K, chevalley_E,
        diagHom_F, diagHom_K, Kt, smul_neg, neg_inj, smul_mul_assoc]
      rw [show K R v (-(-ktilde R l)) * F R v l = (v ^ D.d l) ^ (-2 : ℤ) • (F R v l * Kt R v l) by
        rw [neg_neg, K_mul_F, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self]
        congr 1
        rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
        ring_nf]
      rw [smul_smul]
      congr 1
      simp only [chevalleyScalar, Units.val_mk0]
      field_simp
    · simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte, braidFj, braidEj, map_smul, smul_smul]
      rw [show chevalley R v (serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l) (F R v i)
          (F R v l)) = serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l) (E R v i) (E R v l) by
        simp [serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow],
        show diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v) (serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l)
          (E R v i) (E R v l)) = serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l)
            ((chevalleyScalar D v i : k) • E R v i) ((chevalleyScalar D v l : k) • E R v l) by
        simp [serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow],
        serreAux_smul_smul', smul_smul]
      congr 1
      simp only [chevalleyScalar, Units.val_mk0]
      rw [neg_pow (v ^ D.d i)]
      ring
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, diagHom_F, map_smul, chevalley_F, H.map_F, H.map_E]
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst hl
      simp only [↓reduceIte, braidFi, braidEi, map_neg, map_mul, chevalley_K, chevalley_F,
        diagHom_E, diagHom_K, Kt, smul_neg, neg_inj, mul_smul_comm]
      rw [show K R v (-ktilde R l) * E R v l = (v ^ D.d l) ^ (-2 : ℤ) • (E R v l *
          K R v (-ktilde R l)) by
        rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self]
        congr 1
        rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
        ring_nf]
      rw [smul_smul]
      congr 1
      simp only [chevalleyScalar, Units.val_mk0]
      field_simp
    · simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte, braidFj, braidEj, map_smul, smul_smul]
      rw [show chevalley R v (serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l) (E R v i)
          (E R v l)) = serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l) (F R v i) (F R v l) by
        simp [serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow],
        show diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v) (serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l)
          (F R v i) (F R v l)) = serreAux (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (negA D i l)
            ((chevalleyScalar D v i : k)⁻¹ • F R v i) ((chevalleyScalar D v l : k)⁻¹ • F R v l) by
        simp [serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow],
        serreAux_smul_smul', smul_smul]
      congr 1
      simp only [chevalleyScalar, Units.val_mk0]
      rw [inv_pow, neg_pow (v ^ D.d i)]
      field_simp
  · simp [H.map_K, map_neg, reflY]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootSum_ktilde
statement:
lemma rootSum_ktilde (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) :
    R.rootSum ν (ktilde R i) = D.weightDot (Finsupp.single i 1) ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot, Finsupp.sum_single_index (by simp)]
  simp only [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum, Finsupp.sum, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, root_ktilde_eq_dot, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapF_apply
statement:
lemma shapF_apply (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapF R hv' Λ x y = shapForm Λ hv' (toVerma R v Λ x) (toVerma R v Λ y)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapF_one_left
statement: lemma shapF_one_left (y : LusztigF k I) : shapF R hv' Λ 1 y = LusztigF.counit y
proof:
:= by
  rw [shapF_apply, toVerma_one, ← one_smul (QuantumGroup R v) (hwv R v Λ), shapForm_smul_hwv,
    rho_one, one_smul, hwCoord_toVerma]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.K_neg_ktilde_smul_toVerma
statement:
lemma K_neg_ktilde_smul_toVerma (i : I) (z : LusztigF k I) :
    K R v (-ktilde R i) • toVerma R v Λ z =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-Λ (R.coroot i)) • toVerma R v Λ (twist D v i z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, smul_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul c a ha => rw [map_smul, smul_comm, ha, map_smul, map_smul, smul_comm]
  | word w =>
    have hw : wordBasis k I w ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k (wordWeight w) :=
      wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w
    have h1 := (toVerma_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ) hw) (-ktilde R i)
    rw [h1, twist_of_mem (NeZero.ne v) i hw, map_smul, smul_smul, ← rootSum_ktilde (R := R)]
    congr 1
    rw [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, map_neg, map_neg, ktilde, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
    congr 1
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.twist_twist_inv
statement: lemma twist_twist_inv (i : I) (z : LusztigF k I) : twist D v i (twist D v⁻¹ i z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have : (twist D v i).comp (twist D v⁻¹ i) = AlgHom.id k (LusztigF k I) := by
    refine FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun j ↦ ?_)
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
    rw [twist_θ, map_smul, twist_θ, smul_smul, inv_zpow', ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v),
      neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f z) this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.thetaNorm_eq
statement:
lemma thetaNorm_eq (i : I) :
    thetaNorm D v i = v ^ D.d i * (LusztigF.qDenom D v i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  unfold thetaNorm LusztigF.qDenom
  rw [← inv_inv (v ^ D.d i * _), mul_inv, inv_inv]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapF_θ_mul
statement:
theorem shapF_θ_mul [CharZero k] (i : I) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapF R hv' Λ (θ k i * x) y =
      shapF R hv' Λ x (Lop D v i y - zcoef R v Λ i • Rop D v i y)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : LusztigF.qDenom D v i ≠ 0 := LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDenom_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v) hv' i
  have h0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  rw [shapF_apply, shapF_apply, toVerma_ι_mul, isContravariant_shapForm hv', rho_F, rhoF,
    smul_assoc, mul_smul, E_smul_toVerma hv']
  have hE : vermaOp i (qCoeff R v Λ i) = vermaOpQ D v (fun j ↦ Λ (R.coroot j)) i :=
    (vermaOpQ_eq_vermaOp D (NeZero.ne v) _ hq).symm
  rw [hE, K_neg_ktilde_smul_toVerma, smul_smul, ← map_smul]
  congr 2
  rw [vermaOpQ_apply, map_smul, map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, twist_twist_inv, Lop, Rop, zcoef,
    thetaNorm_eq]
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, smul_sub,
    smul_smul]
  have hn : (v ^ D.d i) ^ Λ (R.coroot i) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ h0
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    rw [zpow_neg]; field_simp
  · congr 1
    rw [show -2 * Λ (R.coroot i) = -Λ (R.coroot i) + -Λ (R.coroot i) by ring, zpow_add₀ h0,
      zpow_neg]
    field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_one
statement: lemma shapZ_one (z : I → k) (y : LusztigF k I) : shapZ D v z 1 y = LusztigF.counit y
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapZ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_θ_mul
statement:
lemma shapZ_θ_mul (z : I → k) (i : I) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z (θ k i * x) y = shapZ D v z x (Lop D v i y - z i • Rop D v i y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapZ, opZ, θ, map_mul, MulOpposite.unop_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_add_left
statement:
lemma shapZ_add_left (z : I → k) (x x' y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z (x + x') y = shapZ D v z x y + shapZ D v z x' y
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapZ, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_smul_left
statement:
lemma shapZ_smul_left (z : I → k) (c : k) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z (c • x) y = c * shapZ D v z x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapZ, map_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_add_right
statement:
lemma shapZ_add_right (z : I → k) (x y y' : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z x (y + y') = shapZ D v z x y + shapZ D v z x y'
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapZ, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_smul_right
statement:
lemma shapZ_smul_right (z : I → k) (c : k) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z x (c • y) = c * shapZ D v z x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapZ, map_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapF_eq_shapZ
statement:
theorem shapF_eq_shapZ [CharZero k] (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapF R hv' Λ x y = shapZ D v (zcoef R v Λ) x y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_wordBasis generalizing y with
  | zero => simp [shapZ]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, shapZ_add_left]
  | smul c a ha => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha, shapZ_smul_left, smul_eq_mul]
  | word w =>
    induction w generalizing y with
    | nil => rw [wordBasis_nil, shapF_one_left, shapZ_one]
    | cons j w ih => rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, ← θ, shapF_θ_mul, ih, shapZ_θ_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.form_eq_shapZ_zero
statement: theorem form_eq_shapZ_zero (x y : LusztigF k I) : LusztigF.form D v x y = shapZ D v 0 x y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_wordBasis generalizing y with
  | zero => simp [shapZ]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, shapZ_add_left]
  | smul c a ha => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha, shapZ_smul_left, smul_eq_mul]
  | word w =>
    induction w generalizing y with
    | nil => rw [wordBasis_nil, form_one_left, shapZ_one]
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, ← θ, form_θ_mul, shapZ_θ_mul, Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, sub_zero,
        Lop, LinearMap.smul_apply, ← ih, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.wordBasis_mem_fLe
statement: lemma wordBasis_mem_fLe {N : ℕ} {w : List I} (hw : w.length ≤ N) : wordBasis k I w ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.fLe_mono
statement: lemma fLe_mono {N N' : ℕ} (h : N ≤ N') : fLe k I N ≤ fLe k I N'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun _ hw ↦ le_trans hw h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.twist_wordBasis_mem
statement:
lemma twist_wordBasis_mem (i : I) (hv : v ≠ 0) {N : ℕ} {w : List I} (hw : w.length ≤ N) :
    twist D v i (wordBasis k I w) ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_of_mem hv i (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w)]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (wordBasis_mem_fLe hw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.θ_mul_mem_fLe
statement:
lemma θ_mul_mem_fLe (j : I) {N : ℕ} {z : LusztigF k I} (hz : z ∈ fLe k I N) :
    θ k j * z ∈ fLe k I (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [θ, ι_mul_wordBasis]
    exact wordBasis_mem_fLe (by simp at hu ⊢; omega)
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.lDeriv_wordBasis_mem
statement:
lemma lDeriv_wordBasis_mem (i : I) (w : List I) {N : ℕ} (hw : w.length ≤ N) :
    lDeriv D v i (wordBasis k I w) ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing N with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hw
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, ← θ, lDeriv_θ_mul]
    refine add_mem ?_ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_)
    · split_ifs
      · exact wordBasis_mem_fLe (by omega)
      · exact zero_mem _
    · have h := θ_mul_mem_fLe j (ih (N := N - 1) (by omega))
      rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.rDeriv_wordBasis_mem
statement:
lemma rDeriv_wordBasis_mem (i : I) (hv : v ≠ 0) (w : List I) {N : ℕ} (hw : w.length ≤ N) :
    rDeriv D v i (wordBasis k I w) ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing N with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hw
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, ← θ, rDeriv_θ_mul]
    refine add_mem ?_ ?_
    · have h := θ_mul_mem_fLe j (ih (N := N - 1) (by omega))
      rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)] at h
    · split_ifs
      · exact twist_wordBasis_mem i hv (by omega)
      · exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.map_fLe
statement:
lemma map_fLe {T : Module.End k (LusztigF k I)} (hT : ∀ (w : List I) (N : ℕ), w.length ≤ N →
      T (wordBasis k I w) ∈ fLe k I N) {N : ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ fLe k I N) :
    T y ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz => obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hz; exact hT u N hu
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.Lop_mem_fLe
statement:
lemma Lop_mem_fLe (i : I) {N : ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ fLe k I N) :
    Lop D v i y ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:=
  map_fLe (fun w _ hw ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (lDeriv_wordBasis_mem i w hw)) hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.Rop_mem_fLe
statement:
lemma Rop_mem_fLe (i : I) {N : ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ fLe k I N) :
    Rop D v i y ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:= by
  refine map_fLe (fun w _ hw ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_) hy
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  exact map_fLe (T := (twist D v i).toLinearMap)
    (fun u _ hu ↦ twist_wordBasis_mem i (NeZero.ne v) hu)
    (rDeriv_wordBasis_mem i (NeZero.ne v) w hw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.span_latN
statement: lemma span_latN (N : ℕ) : Submodule.span k (latN k I A N : Set (LusztigF k I)) = fLe k I N
proof:
:= by
  rw [latN, Submodule.span_span_of_tower]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.latN_fg
statement: lemma latN_fg [Finite I] (N : ℕ) : (latN k I A N).FG
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨((List.finite_length_le I N).image (wordBasis k I)).toFinset, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.counit_mem_range
statement:
lemma counit_mem_range {N : ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ latN k I A N) :
    LusztigF.counit y ∈ (algebraMap A k).range
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, -, rfl⟩ := hy
    rcases w with _ | ⟨j, w⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ha; obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨x + y, by rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]⟩
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨c * x, by rw [← algebraMap_smul k c a, map_smul, ← hx, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_smul_left_A
statement:
lemma shapZ_smul_left_A (z : I → k) (c : A) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z (c • x) y = algebraMap A k c * shapZ D v z x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul k c x, shapZ_smul_left]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_smul_right_A
statement:
lemma shapZ_smul_right_A (z : I → k) (c : A) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z x (c • y) = algebraMap A k c * shapZ D v z x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul k c y, shapZ_smul_right]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.exists_shapZ_sub_mem
statement:
theorem exists_shapZ_sub_mem [Finite I] {ϖ : A}
    (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (z : I → k) (m : ℕ), (∀ i, ∃ a : A, z i = algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m * a)) →
      ∀ x ∈ latN k I A N, ∀ y ∈ latN k I A N, ∃ a : A,
        algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ C) * (shapZ D v z x y - shapZ D v 0 x y) =
          algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m * a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hbd : ∀ T : Module.End k (LusztigF k I), (∀ y, y ∈ fLe k I N → T y ∈ fLe k I N) →
      ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ latN k I A N, ϖ ^ c • T y ∈ latN k I A N := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := DualLattice.exists_pow_smul_le hk (Λ := latN k I A N)
      (N := (latN k I A N).map (T.restrictScalars A)) ((latN_fg A N).map _)
      (fun x hx ↦ by
        obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [span_latN]
        exact hT y (by rw [← span_latN A]; exact Submodule.subset_span hy))
    exact ⟨c, fun y hy ↦ hc _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩
  choose cL hcL using fun i ↦ hbd (Lop D v i) fun y hy ↦ Lop_mem_fLe i hy
  choose cR hcR using fun i ↦ hbd (Rop D v i) fun y hy ↦ Rop_mem_fLe i hy
  set C₀ := Finset.univ.sup cL ⊔ Finset.univ.sup cR
  have hmono : ∀ (c : ℕ) (T : Module.End k (LusztigF k I)), c ≤ C₀ →
      (∀ y ∈ latN k I A N, ϖ ^ c • T y ∈ latN k I A N) →
      ∀ y ∈ latN k I A N, ϖ ^ C₀ • T y ∈ latN k I A N := by
    intro c T hc hT y hy
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hc
    rw [hd, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hT y hy)
  have hL : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ latN k I A N, ϖ ^ C₀ • Lop D v i y ∈ latN k I A N := fun i ↦
    hmono _ _ ((Finset.le_sup (f := cL) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans le_sup_left) (hcL i)
  have hR : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ latN k I A N, ϖ ^ C₀ • Rop D v i y ∈ latN k I A N := fun i ↦
    hmono _ _ ((Finset.le_sup (f := cR) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans le_sup_right) (hcR i)
  refine ⟨N * C₀, fun z m hz ↦ ?_⟩
  choose b hb using hz
  have hzA : ∀ i, z i = algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m * b i) := hb
  
  have key : ∀ w : List I, w.length ≤ N → ∀ y ∈ latN k I A N,
      (∃ a : A, (algebraMap A k) (ϖ ^ (w.length * C₀)) * shapZ D v z (wordBasis k I w) y =
        (algebraMap A k) a) ∧
      (∃ a : A, (algebraMap A k) (ϖ ^ (w.length * C₀)) * shapZ D v 0 (wordBasis k I w) y =
        (algebraMap A k) a) ∧
      (∃ a : A, (algebraMap A k) (ϖ ^ (w.length * C₀)) *
        (shapZ D v z (wordBasis k I w) y - shapZ D v 0 (wordBasis k I w) y) =
          (algebraMap A k) (ϖ ^ m * a)) := by
    intro w
    induction w with
    | nil =>
      intro _ y hy
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := counit_mem_range A hy
      refine ⟨⟨a, ?_⟩, ⟨a, ?_⟩, ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩ <;> simp [shapZ_one, ha]
    | cons j w ih =>
      intro hw y hy
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hw
      have hy₁ := hL j y hy
      have hy₂ := hR j y hy
      obtain ⟨⟨a₁, ha₁⟩, ⟨a₁', ha₁'⟩, ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩⟩ := ih (by omega) _ hy₁
      obtain ⟨⟨a₂, ha₂⟩, ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩, ⟨d₂, hd₂⟩⟩ := ih (by omega) _ hy₂
      simp only [shapZ_smul_right_A] at ha₁ ha₁' ha₂ ha₂' hd₁
      have e : ((w.length + 1) * C₀) = w.length * C₀ + C₀ := by ring
      have hlin : ∀ (z' : I → k) (c : k) (x : LusztigF k I),
          shapZ D v z' x (Lop D v j y - c • Rop D v j y) =
            shapZ D v z' x (Lop D v j y) - c * shapZ D v z' x (Rop D v j y) := by
        intro z' c x; simp [shapZ, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, ← θ, shapZ_θ_mul, shapZ_θ_mul, hlin, hlin, Pi.zero_apply,
        List.length_cons, e, pow_add, map_mul, hzA j]
      simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, sub_zero]
      refine ⟨⟨a₁ - ϖ ^ m * b j * a₂, ?_⟩, ⟨a₁', ?_⟩, ⟨d₁ - b j * a₂, ?_⟩⟩
      · simp only [map_sub, map_mul]
        linear_combination ha₁ - (algebraMap A k) (ϖ ^ m) * (algebraMap A k) (b j) * ha₂
      · linear_combination ha₁'
      · simp only [map_sub, map_mul] at hd₁ ⊢
        linear_combination hd₁ - (algebraMap A k) (ϖ ^ m) * (algebraMap A k) (b j) * ha₂
  
  intro x hx y hy
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨-, -, ⟨a, ha⟩⟩ := key w hw y hy
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_right C₀ (show w.length ≤ N from hw))
    refine ⟨ϖ ^ d * a, ?_⟩
    rw [hd, pow_add]
    simp only [map_mul] at ha ⊢
    linear_combination (algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ d)) * ha
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp [shapZ]⟩
  | add x x' _ _ hx hx' =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hx'
    refine ⟨a + a', ?_⟩
    rw [shapZ_add_left, shapZ_add_left]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul] at ha ha' ⊢
    linear_combination ha + ha'
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨c * a, ?_⟩
    rw [shapZ_smul_left_A, shapZ_smul_left_A]
    simp only [map_mul] at ha ⊢
    linear_combination (algebraMap A k) c * ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.zcoef_eq_algebraMap_pow
statement:
lemma zcoef_eq_algebraMap_pow {ϖ : A} (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I)
    (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    zcoef R v Λ i = algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ (2 * D.d i * (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hΛ
  rw [zcoef, hn, Int.toNat_natCast, map_pow, hϖv, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast,
    inv_zpow', ← zpow_mul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.exists_mem_fLe
statement: lemma exists_mem_fLe (x : LusztigF k I) : ∃ N : ℕ, x ∈ fLe k I N
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨N ⊔ N', add_mem (fLe_mono le_sup_left hN) (fLe_mono le_sup_right hN')⟩
  | smul c a ha =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨N, Submodule.smul_mem _ c hN⟩
  | word w => exact ⟨w.length, wordBasis_mem_fLe le_rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.form_minusHom_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma form_minusHom_smul_hwv (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    IrreducibleModule.form Λ hR hv' (minusHom R v x • IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ)
        (minusHom R v y • IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ) = VermaModule.shapF R hv' Λ x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [IrreducibleModule.hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
    IrreducibleModule.form_mk, VermaModule.shapF_apply, VermaModule.toVerma_apply,
    VermaModule.toVerma_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.exists_form_minusHom_sub_mem
statement:
theorem exists_form_minusHom_sub_mem [CharZero k] [Finite I] {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra A k] {ϖ : A}
    (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) (x y : LusztigF k I) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℤ, ∀ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, (∀ i, M ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) → ∃ a : A,
      IrreducibleModule.form Λ hR hv' (minusHom R v x • IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ)
          (minusHom R v y • IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ) - LusztigF.form D v x y =
        algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨Nx, hNx⟩ := VermaModule.exists_mem_fLe x
  obtain ⟨Ny, hNy⟩ := VermaModule.exists_mem_fLe y
  set N := Nx ⊔ Ny
  have hspan : ∀ z ∈ VermaModule.fLe k I N,
      z ∈ Submodule.span k (VermaModule.latN k I A N : Set (LusztigF k I)) := by
    intro z hz; rwa [VermaModule.span_latN]
  obtain ⟨cx, hcx⟩ := DualLattice.exists_pow_smul_mem hk
    (hspan x (VermaModule.fLe_mono le_sup_left hNx))
  obtain ⟨cy, hcy⟩ := DualLattice.exists_pow_smul_mem hk
    (hspan y (VermaModule.fLe_mono le_sup_right hNy))
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := VermaModule.exists_shapZ_sub_mem (D := D) (v := v) A hk N
  set m' := m + C + cx + cy
  refine ⟨m', fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hz : ∀ i, ∃ a : A, VermaModule.zcoef R v Λ i = algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m' * a) := by
    intro i
    have h0 : 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i) := le_trans (by positivity) (hΛ i)
    rw [VermaModule.zcoef_eq_algebraMap_pow (R := R) (A := A) hϖv Λ i h0]
    have hle : m' ≤ 2 * D.d i * (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat := by
      have := hΛ i
      have := D.d_pos i
      have : (m' : ℤ) ≤ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat : ℤ) := by omega
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
    exact ⟨ϖ ^ t, by rw [ht, pow_add]⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hC _ m' hz _ hcx _ hcy
  rw [VermaModule.shapZ_smul_left_A, VermaModule.shapZ_smul_right_A,
    VermaModule.shapZ_smul_left_A, VermaModule.shapZ_smul_right_A] at ha
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [form_minusHom_smul_hwv, VermaModule.shapF_eq_shapZ, VermaModule.form_eq_shapZ_zero]
  have hpow : algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ (C + cx + cy)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_pow]; exact pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hpow
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow] at ha ⊢
  rw [show m' = m + (C + cx + cy) by omega, pow_add] at ha
  linear_combination ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.isCategoryOInt
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.isCategoryOInt (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    IsCategoryOInt R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have hle := weightSpace_quotient_le_map hv' (VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top (Λ := Λ))
    (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R v Λ)
  have hbot : ∀ Λ', (∀ ν, Λ' ≠ Λ - R.rootSum ν) →
      weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ) Λ' = ⊥ := fun Λ' h ↦ by
    have := hle Λ'
    rwa [VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot hv' h, Submodule.map_bot, le_bot_iff] at this
  refine ⟨IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable hR hv' hΛ, fun Λ' ↦ ?_, ⟨{Λ}, fun Λ' h ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · by_cases hν : ∃ ν, Λ' = Λ - R.rootSum ν
    · obtain ⟨ν, rfl⟩ := hν
      have := VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace (Λ := Λ) hv' hR ν
      exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (hle _)
    · rw [hbot Λ' fun ν h ↦ hν ⟨ν, h⟩]
      infer_instance
  · by_contra! hν
    exact h (hbot Λ' fun ν ↦ hν Λ (Finset.mem_singleton_self Λ) ν)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.tmul_mem_weightPiece
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨x, hx⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.weightPiece_le
statement:
lemma weightPiece_le (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ Λ₁ Λ₂ ≤ weightSpace R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) (Λ₁ + Λ₂)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y => exact tmul_mem_weightSpace x.2 y.2
  | add t t' h h' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.weightPiece_eq_bot_of_left
statement:
lemma weightPiece_eq_bot_of_left {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Y →+ ℤ} (h : weightSpace R v M₁ Λ₁ = ⊥) :
    weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ Λ₁ Λ₂ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    have hx : (x : M₁) = 0 := (Submodule.mem_bot k).1 (h ▸ x.2)
    simp [hx]
  | add t t' h h' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.weightPiece_eq_bot_of_right
statement:
lemma weightPiece_eq_bot_of_right {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Y →+ ℤ} (h : weightSpace R v M₂ Λ₂ = ⊥) :
    weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ Λ₁ Λ₂ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    have hy : (y : M₂) = 0 := (Submodule.mem_bot k).1 (h ▸ y.2)
    simp [hy]
  | add t t' h h' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.weightSpace_le_iSup_weightPiece
statement:
theorem weightSpace_le_iSup_weightPiece (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (h₁ : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M₁ Λ = ⊤) (h₂ : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M₂ Λ = ⊤) (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    weightSpace R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) Λ ≤
      ⨆ (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = Λ), weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  set P := ⨆ (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (_ : p.1 + p.2 = Λ), weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ p.1 p.2
  set Q := ⨆ (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (_ : μ ≠ Λ), weightSpace R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) μ
  have hP : P ≤ weightSpace R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) Λ :=
    iSup₂_le fun p hp ↦ by rw [← hp]; exact weightPiece_le p.1 p.2
  intro z hz
  have htop : ⊤ ≤ P ⊔ Q := by
    rw [← span_tmul_weight h₁ h₂, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨Λ₁, Λ₂, x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
    by_cases h : Λ₁ + Λ₂ = Λ
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left
        (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (Λ₁, Λ₂) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem h
          (tmul_mem_weightPiece hx hy)))
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right
        (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem h
          (tmul_mem_weightSpace hx hy)))
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (htop (Submodule.mem_top (x := z)))
  have hb' : b ∈ weightSpace R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) Λ := by
    have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hz (hP ha)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
  have hb0 : b = 0 := (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_weightSpace hv' Λ)) b hb' hb
  rw [hb0, add_zero]
  exact ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.isCategoryOInt
statement:
theorem isCategoryOInt (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (h₁ : IsCategoryOInt R v M₁) (h₂ : IsCategoryOInt R v M₂) :
    IsCategoryOInt R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective R.rootSum := fun ν ν' h ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR hne
    exact hμ (by rw [h])
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ := h₁.exists_finset
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂⟩ := h₂.exists_finset
  have hle := weightSpace_le_iSup_weightPiece (M₁ := M₁) (M₂ := M₂) hv'
    h₁.isIntegrable.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top h₂.isIntegrable.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
  
  let S : (Y →+ ℤ) → Set ((Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) := fun Λ ↦
    {p | p.1 + p.2 = Λ ∧ weightSpace R v M₁ p.1 ≠ ⊥ ∧ weightSpace R v M₂ p.2 ≠ ⊥}
  have hle' : ∀ Λ, weightSpace R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) Λ ≤
      ⨆ p ∈ S Λ, weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ p.1 p.2 := fun Λ ↦ (hle Λ).trans <|
    iSup₂_le fun p hp ↦ by
      by_cases h1 : weightSpace R v M₁ p.1 = ⊥
      · rw [weightPiece_eq_bot_of_left h1]; exact bot_le
      by_cases h2 : weightSpace R v M₂ p.2 = ⊥
      · rw [weightPiece_eq_bot_of_right h2]; exact bot_le
      exact le_iSup₂_of_le p ⟨hp, h1, h2⟩ le_rfl
  have hfin : ∀ Λ, (S Λ).Finite := fun Λ ↦ by
    let T : Set ((Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) :=
      ⋃ μ ∈ ((s₁ ×ˢ s₂ : Finset ((Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ))) : Set ((Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ))),
        ⋃ ν ∈ {ν : I →₀ ℕ | R.rootSum ν = μ.1 + μ.2 - Λ},
          (fun q : (I →₀ ℕ) × (I →₀ ℕ) ↦ (μ.1 - R.rootSum q.1, μ.2 - R.rootSum q.2)) ''
            (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν : Set ((I →₀ ℕ) × (I →₀ ℕ)))
    refine Set.Finite.subset ?_ (show S Λ ⊆ T from ?_)
    · refine Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun μ _ ↦
        Set.Finite.biUnion ?_ fun ν _ ↦ (Finset.finite_toSet _).image _
      exact Set.Subsingleton.finite fun ν hν ν' hν' ↦ hinj (hν.trans hν'.symm)
    rintro ⟨Λ₁, Λ₂⟩ ⟨hΛ, hn₁, hn₂⟩
    obtain ⟨μ₁, hμ₁, ν₁, rfl⟩ := hs₁ _ hn₁
    obtain ⟨μ₂, hμ₂, ν₂, rfl⟩ := hs₂ _ hn₂
    refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := (μ₁, μ₂)) (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hμ₁, hμ₂⟩)) ?_
    refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := ν₁ + ν₂) ?_
      ⟨(ν₁, ν₂), Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.2 rfl), rfl⟩
    change R.rootSum (ν₁ + ν₂) = μ₁ + μ₂ - Λ
    rw [R.rootSum_add, ← hΛ]
    ext y
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply]
    ring
  refine ⟨isIntegrable h₁.isIntegrable h₂.isIntegrable, fun Λ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := (hfin Λ).to_subtype
    have : ∀ p : S Λ, FiniteDimensional k (weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ p.1.1 p.1.2) := fun p ↦ by
      have := h₁.finiteDimensional_weightSpace p.1.1
      have := h₂.finiteDimensional_weightSpace p.1.2
      exact LinearMap.finiteDimensional_range _
    have hsup : weightSpace R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) Λ ≤
        ⨆ p : S Λ, weightPiece R v M₁ M₂ p.1.1 p.1.2 :=
      (hle' Λ).trans (iSup₂_le fun p hp ↦ le_iSup_of_le (⟨p, hp⟩ : S Λ) le_rfl)
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le hsup
  · refine ⟨Finset.image₂ (· + ·) s₁ s₂, fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨Λ₁, Λ₂⟩, ⟨rfl, hn₁, hn₂⟩⟩ : (S Λ).Nonempty := by
      by_contra h
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
      refine hΛ (le_bot_iff.1 ((hle' Λ).trans ?_))
      simp [h]
    obtain ⟨μ₁, hμ₁, ν₁, rfl⟩ := hs₁ _ hn₁
    obtain ⟨μ₂, hμ₂, ν₂, rfl⟩ := hs₂ _ hn₂
    refine ⟨μ₁ + μ₂, Finset.mem_image₂_of_mem hμ₁ hμ₂, ν₁ + ν₂, ?_⟩
    rw [R.rootSum_add]
    ext y
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_serreElement
statement:
theorem plusHom_serreElement {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfact : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ≠ 0) :
    plusHom R v (serreElement D v i j) = 0

    (hfact : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ≠ 0) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreIdeal_le_ker_plusHom
statement:
theorem serreIdeal_le_ker_plusHom (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    serreIdeal D v ≤ TwoSidedIdeal.ker (plusHom R v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
