    (plusHom_serreElement hij (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv hv' i _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreIdeal_le_ker_minusHom
statement:
theorem serreIdeal_le_ker_minusHom (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    serreIdeal D v ≤ TwoSidedIdeal.ker (minusHom R v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
  exact (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).2
    (minusHom_serreElement hij (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv hv' i _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PreRelations.kt_mul_lift
statement:
lemma PreRelations.kt_mul_lift (h : PreRelations R v e f κ) (l : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    κ (.ofAdd (ktilde R l)) * FreeAlgebra.lift k e x =
      FreeAlgebra.lift k e (twist D v l x) * κ (.ofAdd (ktilde R l))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp [Algebra.commutes]
  | grade1 j =>
    rw [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, h.K_mul_E, twist_θ, map_smul, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply,
      root_ktilde_eq_dot, smul_mul_assoc]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc, ha, mul_assoc, hb, ← mul_assoc, map_mul, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, mul_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, add_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PreRelations.lift_mul_kt_neg
statement:
lemma PreRelations.lift_mul_kt_neg (h : PreRelations R v e f κ) (hv : v ≠ 0) (l : I)
    (x : LusztigF k I) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift k e x * κ (.ofAdd (-ktilde R l)) =
      κ (.ofAdd (-ktilde R l)) * FreeAlgebra.lift k e (twist D v l x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp [Algebra.commutes]
  | grade1 j =>
    rw [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, twist_θ, map_smul, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, mul_smul_comm,
      h.K_mul_E, smul_smul, map_neg (R.root j), root_ktilde_eq_dot, ← zpow_add₀ hv, add_neg_cancel,
      zpow_zero, one_smul]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, mul_assoc, hb, ← mul_assoc, ha, mul_assoc, map_mul, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_mul, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, mul_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PreRelations.lift_mul_sub
statement:
theorem PreRelations.lift_mul_sub (h : PreRelations R v e f κ) (hv : v ≠ 0) (l : I)
    (x : LusztigF k I) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift k e x * f l - f l * FreeAlgebra.lift k e x =
      (v ^ D.d l - (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        (FreeAlgebra.lift k e (rDeriv D v l x) * κ (.ofAdd (ktilde R l)) -
          κ (.ofAdd (-ktilde R l)) * FreeAlgebra.lift k e (lDeriv D v l x))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp [Algebra.commutes]
  | grade1 j =>
    rw [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, h.E_mul_F, rDeriv_θ, lDeriv_θ]
    by_cases hjl : j = l
    · subst hjl; simp
    · simp [hjl, Ne.symm hjl]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    have e1 : FreeAlgebra.lift k e a * FreeAlgebra.lift k e b * f l -
        f l * (FreeAlgebra.lift k e a * FreeAlgebra.lift k e b) =
        FreeAlgebra.lift k e a * (FreeAlgebra.lift k e b * f l - f l * FreeAlgebra.lift k e b) +
          (FreeAlgebra.lift k e a * f l - f l * FreeAlgebra.lift k e a) *
            FreeAlgebra.lift k e b := by
      noncomm_ring
    rw [map_mul, e1, ha, hb, rDeriv_mul, lDeriv_mul, map_add, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul,
      map_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← smul_add]
    congr 1
    set A := FreeAlgebra.lift k e a
    set B := FreeAlgebra.lift k e b
    have h1 : A * κ (.ofAdd (-ktilde R l)) =
        κ (.ofAdd (-ktilde R l)) * FreeAlgebra.lift k e (twist D v l a) :=
      h.lift_mul_kt_neg hv l a
    have h2 : κ (.ofAdd (ktilde R l)) * B =
        FreeAlgebra.lift k e (twist D v l b) * κ (.ofAdd (ktilde R l)) :=
      h.kt_mul_lift l b
    calc _ = A * FreeAlgebra.lift k e (rDeriv D v l b) * κ (.ofAdd (ktilde R l)) -
          (A * κ (.ofAdd (-ktilde R l))) * FreeAlgebra.lift k e (lDeriv D v l b) +
          FreeAlgebra.lift k e (rDeriv D v l a) * (κ (.ofAdd (ktilde R l)) * B) -
          κ (.ofAdd (-ktilde R l)) * FreeAlgebra.lift k e (lDeriv D v l a) * B := by noncomm_ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h1, h2]; noncomm_ring
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, add_mul, mul_add, add_sub_add_comm, ha, hb, ← smul_add, map_add, map_add,
      map_add, map_add, add_mul, mul_add]
    congr 1
    abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_mul_minusHom_monomial
statement:
lemma K_mul_minusHom_monomial (μ : Y) (w : List I) :
    K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w) =
      (w.map fun j ↦ v ^ (-R.root j μ)).prod • (minusHom R v (monomial k w) * K R v μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, minusHom_θ, ← mul_assoc, K_mul_F, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ih,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_triangularSpan
statement:
lemma mem_triangularSpan (w : List I) (μ : Y) (w' : List I) :
    minusHom R v (monomial k w) * K R v μ * plusHom R v (monomial k w') ∈
      triangularSpan R v
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_mul_mem_triangularSpan
statement:
lemma F_mul_mem_triangularSpan (i : I) {s : QuantumGroup R v} (hs : s ∈ triangularSpan R v) :
    F R v i * s ∈ triangularSpan R v
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← minusHom_θ R v (k := k) i, ← map_mul, ← monomial_cons]
    exact mem_triangularSpan _ _ _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_mul_mem_triangularSpan
statement:
lemma K_mul_mem_triangularSpan (ν : Y) {s : QuantumGroup R v} (hs : s ∈ triangularSpan R v) :
    K R v ν * s ∈ triangularSpan R v
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, K_mul_minusHom_monomial, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc,
      mul_assoc (minusHom R v _), K_add]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mem_triangularSpan _ _ _)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_mem_triangularSpan
statement:
lemma E_mul_mem_triangularSpan (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) (w : List I) (μ : Y) (w' : List I) :
    E R v i * (minusHom R v (monomial k w) * K R v μ * plusHom R v (monomial k w')) ∈
      triangularSpan R v
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing μ w' with
  | nil =>
    have hEK : E R v i * K R v μ = v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (K R v μ * E R v i) := by
      rw [K_mul_E, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ hv, neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]
    rw [monomial_nil, map_one, one_mul, ← mul_assoc, hEK, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
      ← plusHom_θ R v (k := k) i, ← map_mul, ← monomial_cons, ← one_mul (K R v μ),
      ← map_one (minusHom R v), ← monomial_nil]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mem_triangularSpan _ _ _)
  | cons j w ih =>
    have h := E_mul_F_sub R v i j
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h
    set X := minusHom R v (monomial k w) * K R v μ * plusHom R v (monomial k w')
    have hX : E R v i * (minusHom R v (monomial k (j :: w)) * K R v μ *
        plusHom R v (monomial k w')) = F R v j * (E R v i * X) +
          (if i = j then (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i))
            else 0) * X := by
      calc E R v i * (minusHom R v (monomial k (j :: w)) * K R v μ *
            plusHom R v (monomial k w')) = (E R v i * F R v j) * X := by
            simp only [X, monomial_cons, map_mul, minusHom_θ, mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [h, add_mul, add_comm, mul_assoc]
    rw [hX]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ (F_mul_mem_triangularSpan j (ih μ w')) ?_
    split_ifs
    · rw [smul_mul_assoc, sub_mul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sub_mem _
        (K_mul_mem_triangularSpan _ (mem_triangularSpan _ _ _))
        (K_mul_mem_triangularSpan _ (mem_triangularSpan _ _ _)))
    · rw [zero_mul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_triangular
statement: theorem span_triangular (hv : v ≠ 0) : triangularSpan R v = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ u : QuantumGroup R v, ∀ s ∈ triangularSpan R v, u * s ∈ triangularSpan R v := by
    intro u
    induction u using induction_on with
    | algebraMap c =>
      intro s hs; rw [← Algebra.smul_def]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hs
    | E i =>
      intro s hs
      induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hx
        exact E_mul_mem_triangularSpan hv i w μ w'
      | zero => simp
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
      | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
    | F i => exact fun s hs ↦ F_mul_mem_triangularSpan i hs
    | K μ => exact fun s hs ↦ K_mul_mem_triangularSpan μ hs
    | add x y hx hy => intro s hs; rw [add_mul]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ (hx s hs) (hy s hs)
    | mul x y hx hy => intro s hs; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hy s hs)
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun u _ ↦ ?_
  have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ triangularSpan R v := by
    simpa using mem_triangularSpan (R := R) (v := v) [] 0 []
  simpa using key u 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toralPlusHom_theta
statement:
@[simp] theorem toralPlusHom_theta (i : I) :
    toralPlusHom R v (θ k i) = Kt R v i ⊗ₜ E R v i
proof:
:= by
  simp [toralPlusHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveTensorComparison_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveTensorComparison_tmul (a b : LusztigF k I) :
    positiveTensorComparison R v (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      (plusHom R v a ⊗ₜ (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) * toralPlusHom R v b
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveTensorComparison]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveTensorComparison_left
statement:
theorem positiveTensorComparison_left (i : I) (z : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    positiveTensorComparison R v ((LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ z) =
      (E R v i ⊗ₜ (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) * positiveTensorComparison R v z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul a b => simp [← mul_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb, mul_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveTensorComparison_right
statement:
theorem positiveTensorComparison_right (i : I) (z : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    positiveTensorComparison R v
      (TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)) z) =
      (Kt R v i ⊗ₜ E R v i) * positiveTensorComparison R v z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul a b =>
    have h : Kt R v i * plusHom R v a = plusHom R v (twist D v i a) * Kt R v i :=
      (relations R v).toPreRelations.kt_mul_lift i a
    simp only [map_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
      positiveTensorComparison_tmul, map_mul, toralPlusHom_theta, ← mul_assoc,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul, mul_one, h]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb, mul_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveToralWeight_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem positiveToralWeight_zero : positiveToralWeight R 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveToralWeight]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveToralWeight_add
statement:
theorem positiveToralWeight_add (ν μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    positiveToralWeight R (ν + μ) = positiveToralWeight R ν + positiveToralWeight R μ
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_nsmul _ _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveToralWeight_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveToralWeight_single (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    positiveToralWeight R (Finsupp.single i n) = n • ktilde R i
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveToralWeight]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toralPlusHom_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem b hb =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hb
    induction w with
    | nil => simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
    | cons i w ih =>
      simp only [monomial_cons, map_mul, toralPlusHom_theta, ih,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, K_add, wordWeight_cons,
        positiveToralWeight_add, positiveToralWeight_single, one_nsmul, plusHom_θ]
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => simp [ha, hb, tmul_add]
  | smul c b _ hb => simp [hb, tmul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem positiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem (a : LusztigF k I)
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : LusztigF k I} (hb : b ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν) :
    positiveTensorComparison R v (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      (plusHom R v a * K R v (positiveToralWeight R ν)) ⊗ₜ plusHom R v b
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveTensorComparison_tmul, toralPlusHom_of_mem R v hb,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_plusHom
statement:
theorem comul_plusHom (x : LusztigF k I) :
    comul R v (plusHom R v x) = positiveTensorComparison R v (LusztigF.comul D v x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using LusztigF.induction_left with
  | algebraMap c => simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  | smul c x hx => simp [hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | θ_mul i x hx =>
    rw [map_mul, plusHom_θ, map_mul, comul_E, add_mul, hx, LusztigF.comul_θ_mul,
      map_add, positiveTensorComparison_left, positiveTensorComparison_right]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_plusHom_of_finite
statement:
theorem comul_plusHom_of_finite {A : Type*} (s : Finset A) (x : LusztigF k I)
    (a b : A → LusztigF k I) (ν : A → I →₀ ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j ∈ s, b j ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k (ν j))
    (hx : LusztigF.comul D v x = ∑ j ∈ s, a j ⊗ₜ b j) :
    comul R v (plusHom R v x) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, (plusHom R v (a j) * K R v (positiveToralWeight R (ν j))) ⊗ₜ
        plusHom R v (b j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_plusHom, hx, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ positiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem R v _ (hb j hj)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toralPlusHom_radical
statement:
theorem toralPlusHom_radical {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ radical D 𝕧) :
    toralPlusHom R 𝕧 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_serreIdeal_ratFunc] at hx
  rw [← sum_coeff_gradingHom x, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro ν hν
  have hm := LusztigF.weightProj_mem ν x
  have hz : plusHom R 𝕧 (LusztigF.weightProj ν x) = 0 :=
    (plusHom_eq_zero_iff R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root _).mpr
      (weightProj_mem_serreIdeal hx ν)
  change toralPlusHom R 𝕧 (LusztigF.weightProj ν x) = 0
  rw [toralPlusHom_of_mem R 𝕧 hm, hz, tmul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientToralPlus_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientToralPlus_toQuotient (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientToralPlus R (toQuotient D 𝕧 x) = toralPlusHom R 𝕧 x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul (a b : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientPositiveTensorComparison R (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      (quotientPlus R a ⊗ₜ (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) * quotientToralPlus R b
proof:
:= by
  simp [quotientPositiveTensorComparison]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPositiveTensorComparison_toQuotient
statement:
theorem quotientPositiveTensorComparison_toQuotient
    (z : LusztigF 𝕂 I ⊗[𝕂] LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientPositiveTensorComparison R (quotientTensorMap D z) =
      positiveTensorComparison R 𝕧 z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul a b => simp [quotientTensorMap]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_quotientPlus
statement:
theorem comul_quotientPlus (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    comul R 𝕧 (quotientPlus R x) =
      quotientPositiveTensorComparison R (quotientComul D x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  rw [quotientPlus_toQuotient, quotientComul_toQuotient,
    quotientPositiveTensorComparison_toQuotient, comul_plusHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem (a : Quotient D 𝕧)
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ (LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν).map (toQuotient D 𝕧).toLinearMap) :
    quotientPositiveTensorComparison R (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      (quotientPlus R a * K R 𝕧 (positiveToralWeight R ν)) ⊗ₜ quotientPlus R b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hb
  simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  rw [quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul, quotientToralPlus_toQuotient,
    toralPlusHom_of_mem R 𝕧 hb, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_quotientPlus_of_finite
statement:
theorem comul_quotientPlus_of_finite {A : Type*} (s : Finset A) (x : Quotient D 𝕧)
    (a b : A → Quotient D 𝕧) (ν : A → I →₀ ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j ∈ s, b j ∈ (LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (ν j)).map (toQuotient D 𝕧).toLinearMap)
    (hx : quotientComul D x = ∑ j ∈ s, a j ⊗ₜ b j) :
    comul R 𝕧 (quotientPlus R x) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, (quotientPlus R (a j) * K R 𝕧 (positiveToralWeight R (ν j))) ⊗ₜ
        quotientPlus R (b j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_quotientPlus, hx, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦
    quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem R _ (hb j hj)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPositiveTensorComparison_string
statement:
theorem quotientPositiveTensorComparison_string (a : Quotient D 𝕧) (i : I) (n : ℕ)
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hb : b ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν) :
    quotientPositiveTensorComparison R
      (a ⊗ₜ toQuotient D 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i) * b)) =
      (quotientPlus R a * K R 𝕧 (n • ktilde R i + positiveToralWeight R ν)) ⊗ₜ
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * plusHom R 𝕧 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul, quotientToralPlus_toQuotient, map_mul,
    toralPlusHom_of_mem R 𝕧 hb]
  simp only [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, toralPlusHom_theta,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    Kt, K_pow, K_add]
  rw [mul_smul_comm, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul,
    ← tmul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_quotientPlus_of_finite_strings
statement:
theorem comul_quotientPlus_of_finite_strings {A : Type*} (s : Finset A)
    (x : Quotient D 𝕧) (i : I) (a : A → Quotient D 𝕧) (b : A → LusztigF 𝕂 I)
    (n : A → ℕ) (ν : A → I →₀ ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j ∈ s, b j ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (ν j))
    (hx : quotientComul D x = ∑ j ∈ s,
      a j ⊗ₜ toQuotient D 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n j) (θ 𝕂 i) * b j)) :
    comul R 𝕧 (quotientPlus R x) = ∑ j ∈ s,
      (quotientPlus R (a j) * K R 𝕧 (n j • ktilde R i + positiveToralWeight R (ν j))) ⊗ₜ
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n j) (E R 𝕧 i) * plusHom R 𝕧 (b j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_quotientPlus, hx, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦
    quotientPositiveTensorComparison_string R _ _ _ (hb j hj)

name: LusztigF.weightProj_apply
statement:
lemma weightProj_apply (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    weightProj ν y = (gradingHom k I y).coeff ν
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.sum_coeff_gradingHom
statement: lemma sum_coeff_gradingHom (y : LusztigF k I) : (gradingHom k I y).coeff.sum (fun _ a ↦ a) = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace k (I := I) μ := by rw [iSup_weightSpace]; trivial
  induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ y hy => rw [gradingHom_of_mem hy, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
      Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    rw [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ ↦ rfl)
      (fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl), hy, hz]

name: LusztigF.weightProj_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem weightProj_mem_serreIdeal {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : weightProj ν x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction generalizing ν with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hmem : serreElement D v i j ∈ weightSpace k
        ((1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat • Finsupp.single i 1 + Finsupp.single j 1) := by
      have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, θ k i ^ n ∈ weightSpace k (n • Finsupp.single i 1) := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => simpa using one_mem_weightSpace (k := k) (I := I)
        | succ n ih =>
          rw [pow_succ, succ_nsmul]
          exact mul_mem_weightSpace ih (θ_mem_weightSpace i)
      have hdiv : ∀ n : ℕ, QuantumGroup.qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (θ k i) ∈
          weightSpace k (n • Finsupp.single i 1) := fun n ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hpow n)
      rw [serreElement, QuantumGroup.qSerreDiv]
      refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r hr ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      simp only [mem_range] at hr
      have h1 := mul_mem_weightSpace (mul_mem_weightSpace
        (hdiv ((1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat - r)) (θ_mem_weightSpace j)) (hdiv r)
      convert h1 using 2
      rw [add_right_comm, ← add_nsmul, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
    rw [weightProj_of_mem hmem]
    split_ifs
    · exact TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem (hy ν) (hz ν)
  | neg y _ hy => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem (hy ν)
  | left_absorb a y _ hy =>
    rw [weightProj_apply, map_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul]
    refine sum_mem fun p _ ↦ sum_mem fun q _ ↦ ?_
    dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact (serreIdeal D v).mul_mem_left _ _ (hy q)
    · exact zero_mem _
  | right_absorb a y _ hy =>
    rw [weightProj_apply, map_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul]
    refine sum_mem fun p _ ↦ sum_mem fun q _ ↦ ?_
    dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact (serreIdeal D v).mul_mem_right _ _ (hy p)
    · exact zero_mem _

name: LusztigF.mem_serreIdeal_of_weightProj
statement:
lemma mem_serreIdeal_of_weightProj {y : LusztigF k I}
    (h : ∀ ν, weightProj ν y ∈ serreIdeal D v) : y ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_coeff_gradingHom y]
  exact sum_mem fun ν _ ↦ h ν

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.mem_highSpan_of_mem
proof:
:= fun μ hμ ↦ by
  classical
  rw [weightProj_of_mem hy] at hμ
  split_ifs at hμ with h
  · exact ⟨i, h ▸ hi⟩
  · exact (hμ rfl).elim

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.fPowSubmodule_le_map_toVerma
statement:
theorem fPowSubmodule_le_map_toVerma {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    (fPowSubmodule R v Λ).restrictScalars k ≤ (highSpan R Λ).map (toVerma R v Λ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ (i : I) (u : QuantumGroup R v),
      u • (F R v i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) • hwv R v Λ) ∈
        (highSpan R Λ).map (toVerma R v Λ) := by
    intro i u
    set n := (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat
    have hw := F_pow_smul_mem_weightSpace (hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ)) i
      (n + 1)
    have hE : ∀ j, E R v j • (F R v i ^ (n + 1) • hwv R v Λ) = 0 :=
      E_smul_F_pow_smul_eq_zero (NeZero.ne v) hwv_mem_weightSpace (fun j ↦ E_smul_hwv j)
        (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hΛ i)).symm
    induction mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem u hu =>
      obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
      rw [mul_smul, mul_smul, plusHom_smul_of_E_smul_eq_zero hE, smul_comm (K R v μ),
        hw μ, smul_comm (minusHom R v _), smul_comm (minusHom R v _)]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ⟨monomial k w * θ k i ^ (n + 1),
        ?_, ?_⟩)
      · have hpow : θ k i ^ (n + 1) ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ((n + 1) • Finsupp.single i 1) := by
          induction (n + 1) with
          | zero => simpa using one_mem_weightSpace (k := k) (I := I)
          | succ m ih =>
            rw [pow_succ, succ_nsmul]
            exact mul_mem_weightSpace ih (θ_mem_weightSpace i)
        refine mem_highSpan_of_mem (i := i)
          (mul_mem_weightSpace (monomial_mem_weightSpace w) hpow) ?_
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul,
          mul_one]
        omega
      · simp only [toVerma_apply, map_mul, map_pow, minusHom_θ, mul_smul]
    | zero => rw [zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x x' _ _ hx hx' => rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem hx hx'
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
  intro m hm
  change m ∈ Submodule.span _ (Set.range fun i ↦ F R v i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) •
    hwv R v Λ) at hm
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.1 hm
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ key i (c i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.mem_serreIdeal_of_toVerma_mem_fPowSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := fPowSubmodule_le_map_toVerma hΛ h
  have hsub : y - z ∈ serreIdeal D v := by
    rw [← toVerma_eq_zero_iff (R := R) (Λ := Λ) hv', map_sub, hzy, sub_self]
  refine LusztigF.mem_serreIdeal_of_weightProj fun ν ↦ ?_
  have h1 := LusztigF.weightProj_mem_serreIdeal hsub ν
  by_cases hν : weightProj ν y = 0
  · rw [hν]; exact zero_mem _
  · have hz0 : weightProj ν z = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hz ν hne
      have := hy ν hν i
      omega
    rwa [map_sub, hz0, sub_zero] at h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem minusHom_eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero
    (hcor : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) (y : LusztigF k I)
    (h : ∀ (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (m : FPowQuotient R v Λ), minusHom R v y • m = 0) :
    minusHom R v y = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set N := ∑ ν ∈ (gradingHom k I y).coeff.support, ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := hcor N
  rw [minusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv']
  refine mem_serreIdeal_of_toVerma_mem_fPowSubmodule hv' (Λ := Λ) (fun i ↦ (hΛ i).trans' (by
    positivity)) (fun ν hν i ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have hνs : ν ∈ (gradingHom k I y).coeff.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hν
    have h1 : ν i ≤ ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i := by
      by_cases hi : i ∈ ν.support
      · exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hi
      · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi]; exact Nat.zero_le _
    have h2 : ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i ≤ N :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ν : I →₀ ℕ ↦ ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i)
        (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hνs
    have := hΛ i
    omega
  · have := h Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (hwv R v Λ))
    rwa [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_comp_plusHom
statement: lemma chevalley_comp_plusHom : (chevalley R v).comp (plusHom R v) = minusHom R v
proof:
:=
  FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun i ↦ by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply]
    exact (congrArg (chevalley R v) (plusHom_θ R v i)).trans ((chevalley_E R v i).trans
      (minusHom_θ R v i).symm))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist
statement:
lemma smul_toTwist (u : QuantumGroup R v) (m : M) :
    u • toTwist R v M m = toTwist R v M (chevalley R v u • m)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ChevalleyTwist.isIntegrable
statement:
theorem isIntegrable (hM : IsIntegrable R v M) : IsIntegrable R v (ChevalleyTwist R v M) where
  iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
proof:
:= by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro m -
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (toTwist R v M).surjective m
    have hm : m ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ := by rw [hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
    induction hm using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem Λ m hm =>
      refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (-Λ) fun μ ↦ ?_
      rw [smul_toTwist, chevalley_K, hm (-μ), map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]
      rfl
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add m m' _ _ hm hm' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hm hm'
  exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i m := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (toTwist R v M).surjective m
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM.exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i m
    exact ⟨n, by rw [smul_toTwist, map_pow, chevalley_E, hn, map_zero]⟩
  exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i m := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (toTwist R v M).surjective m
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i m
    exact ⟨n, by rw [smul_toTwist, map_pow, chevalley_F, hn, map_zero]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem plusHom_eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero
    (hcor : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) (x : LusztigF k I)
    (h : ∀ (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (m : ChevalleyTwist R v (FPowQuotient R v Λ)), plusHom R v x • m = 0) :
    plusHom R v x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : minusHom R v x = 0 := by
    refine minusHom_eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero hv' hcor x fun Λ m ↦ ?_
    have := h Λ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _ m)
    rwa [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, chevalley_comp_plusHom,
      LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at this
  rwa [plusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv', ← minusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.exists_maximal
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.exists_maximal (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M)
    {Λ₀ : Y →+ ℤ} (h0 : weightSpace R v M Λ₀ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ i, weightSpace R v M (Λ + R.root i) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
  have hinj : Function.Injective R.rootSum := fun ν ν' h ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR hne
    exact hμ (by rw [h])
  set S : Set ℕ :=
    {n | ∃ ν : I →₀ ℕ, weightSpace R v M (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν) ≠ ⊥ ∧ ν.degree = n}
  have hbdd : BddAbove S := by
    refine ⟨∑ μ ∈ s, (if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ then h.choose.degree else 0), ?_⟩
    rintro n ⟨ν, hν, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨μ, hμs, ν', hν'⟩ := hs _ hν
    have hρ : R.rootSum (ν + ν') = μ - Λ₀ := by
      calc R.rootSum (ν + ν') = (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν) + R.rootSum ν' - Λ₀ := by
            rw [R.rootSum_add]; abel
        _ = μ - Λ₀ := by rw [hν']; abel
    have hex : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ := ⟨_, hρ⟩
    have hch : hex.choose = ν + ν' := hinj (hex.choose_spec.trans hρ.symm)
    calc ν.degree ≤ (ν + ν').degree := by rw [map_add]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
      _ = (if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ then h.choose.degree else 0) := by
            simp only [hex, ↓reduceDIte, hch]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun μ ↦ if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ then h.choose.degree else 0)
            (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hμs
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, 0, by simpa using h0, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hdeg⟩ := Nat.sSup_mem hne hbdd
  refine ⟨Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν, hν, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hi
  have hmem : (ν + Finsupp.single i 1).degree ∈ S :=
    ⟨_, by rwa [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, ← add_assoc], rfl⟩
  have := le_csSup hbdd hmem
  rw [map_add, hdeg, Finsupp.degree_single] at this
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dominant_of_primitive
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hw0 (IntegrableSl2.eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg (V := nodeSl2 R v M hv' hM i)
    (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) (mem_nodeWt_of_mem hw) (hE i) (by omega))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nonempty_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_span
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_span (hM : IsIntegrable R v M) {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {w : M}
    (hw : w ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) (hE : ∀ i, E R v i • w = 0)
    (hspan : Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w} = ⊤) :
    (∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) ∧
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule R v Λ ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ := dominant_of_primitive hv' hM hw hw0 hE
  refine ⟨hΛ, ⟨LinearEquiv.ofBijective (IrreducibleModule.lift hvt hR hv' hΛ hM w hw hE)
    ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · have := IrreducibleModule.isSimpleModule hR hv' Λ
    rcases IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top
      (LinearMap.ker (IrreducibleModule.lift hvt hR hv' hΛ hM w hw hE)) with h | h
    · exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.1 h
    · exfalso
      have : IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ ∈
          LinearMap.ker (IrreducibleModule.lift hvt hR hv' hΛ hM w hw hE) := h ▸ trivial
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, IrreducibleModule.lift_hwv] at this
      exact hw0 this
  · rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← hspan, Submodule.span_le,
      Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨_, IrreducibleModule.lift_hwv hvt hR hv' hΛ hM w hw hE⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.exists_nonempty_equiv_of_isSimpleModule
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.exists_nonempty_equiv_of_isSimpleModule (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M)
    [IsSimpleModule (QuantumGroup R v) M] :
    ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) ∧
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule R v Λ ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
proof:
:= by
  have hnt : Nontrivial M := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial (QuantumGroup R v) M
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, h0⟩ : ∃ Λ₀, weightSpace R v M Λ₀ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra! h
    have htop := hM.isIntegrable.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
    simp only [h, iSup_bot] at htop
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
    exact hx ((Submodule.mem_bot k).1 (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top))
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hmax⟩ := hM.exists_maximal hR h0
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw0⟩ := Submodule.ne_bot_iff _ |>.1 hΛ
  have hE : ∀ i, E R v i • w = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    have := E_smul_mem_weightSpace hw i
    rwa [hmax i, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  have hspan : Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w} = ⊤ := by
    rcases IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top (Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w}) with h | h
    · exact absurd (Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.1 h) hw0
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨hdom, he⟩ :=
    nonempty_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_span hv' hvt hR hM.isIntegrable hw hw0 hE hspan
  exact ⟨Λ, hdom, he⟩

name: Submodule.mem_endStab
statement: lemma mem_endStab {X : Module.End k M} : X ∈ W.endStab ↔ ∀ w ∈ W, X w ∈ W

name: Submodule.endDescend_mk
