name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PreRelations.map
statement:
lemma PreRelations.map (h : PreRelations R v e f κ) (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) :
    PreRelations R v (φ ∘ e) (φ ∘ f) (φ.toMonoidHom.comp κ) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by simpa [map_mul, map_smul] using congr_arg φ (h.K_mul_E μ i)
  K_mul_F μ i := by simpa [map_mul, map_smul] using congr_arg φ (h.K_mul_F μ i)
  E_mul_F i j := by
    have := congr_arg φ (h.E_mul_F i j)
    split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> simpa [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Relations.map
statement:
lemma Relations.map (h : Relations R v e f κ) (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) :
    Relations R v (φ ∘ e) (φ ∘ f) (φ.toMonoidHom.comp κ)
proof:
:=
  { h.toPreRelations.map φ with
    serre_E := fun i j hij ↦ by simpa [map_qSerre] using congr_arg φ (h.serre_E i j hij)
    serre_F := fun i j hij ↦ by simpa [map_qSerre] using congr_arg φ (h.serre_F i j hij) }

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PreRelations.of_injective
statement:
lemma PreRelations.of_injective (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (hφ : Function.Injective φ)
    (h : PreRelations R v (φ ∘ e) (φ ∘ f) (φ.toMonoidHom.comp κ)) : PreRelations R v e f κ where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= hφ (by simpa [map_mul, map_smul] using h.K_mul_E μ i)
  K_mul_F μ i := hφ (by simpa [map_mul, map_smul] using h.K_mul_F μ i)
  E_mul_F i j := hφ (by
    have := h.E_mul_F i j
    split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> simpa [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul] using this)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_endDescend_mk
statement:
lemma lift_endDescend_mk {e : I → Module.End k M} (he : ∀ i, e i ∈ W.endStab)
    (x : LusztigF k I) (z : M) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift k (fun i ↦ W.endDescend ⟨e i, he i⟩) x (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (FreeAlgebra.lift k e x z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing z with
  | grade0 c => simp [Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
  | grade1 i => simp
  | mul a b ha hb => simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, ha]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PreRelations.descend
statement:
theorem PreRelations.descend (h : PreRelations R v e f κ) (he : ∀ i, e i ∈ W.endStab)
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ W.endStab) (hκ : ∀ μ, κ μ ∈ W.endStab) :
    PreRelations R v (fun i ↦ W.endDescend ⟨e i, he i⟩) (fun i ↦ W.endDescend ⟨f i, hf i⟩)
      (descendHom W κ hκ) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    ext x
    simpa [descendHom] using congr_arg (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := W))
      (LinearMap.congr_fun (h.K_mul_E μ i) x)
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    ext x
    simpa [descendHom] using congr_arg (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := W))
      (LinearMap.congr_fun (h.K_mul_F μ i) x)
  E_mul_F i j := by
    have := h.E_mul_F i j
    ext x
    split_ifs at this ⊢ <;>
    simpa [descendHom] using congr_arg (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := W))
      (LinearMap.congr_fun this x)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Relations.descend
statement:
theorem Relations.descend (h : PreRelations R v e f κ) (he : ∀ i, e i ∈ W.endStab)
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ W.endStab) (hκ : ∀ μ, κ μ ∈ W.endStab)
    (hsE : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ z,
      qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (e i) (e j) z ∈ W)
    (hsF : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ z,
      qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (f i) (f j) z ∈ W) :
    Relations R v (fun i ↦ W.endDescend ⟨e i, he i⟩) (fun i ↦ W.endDescend ⟨f i, hf i⟩)
      (descendHom W κ hκ)
proof:
:=
  { h.descend he hf hκ with
    serre_E := fun i j hij ↦ by
      rw [← map_qSerre]
      refine W.endDescend_eq_zero fun z ↦ ?_
      have h1 : ((qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ⟨e i, he i⟩ ⟨e j, he j⟩ :
          W.endStab) : Module.End k M) =
          qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (e i) (e j) :=
        map_qSerre W.endStab.val _ _ _
      rw [h1]
      exact hsE i j hij z
    serre_F := fun i j hij ↦ by
      rw [← map_qSerre]
      refine W.endDescend_eq_zero fun z ↦ ?_
      have h1 : ((qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ⟨f i, hf i⟩ ⟨f j, hf j⟩ :
          W.endStab) : Module.End k M) =
          qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (f i) (f j) :=
        map_qSerre W.endStab.val _ _ _
      rw [h1]
      exact hsF i j hij z }

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ serreIdeal D v)
    (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x) ∈ serreTriSubmodule Y D v
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, g, x, rfl, Or.inl hy⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_right
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_right (y : LusztigF k I) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y)
    {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x) ∈ serreTriSubmodule Y D v
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, g, x, rfl, Or.inr hx⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left'
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left' {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ serreIdeal D v)
    (w : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) : y ⊗ₜ w ∈ serreTriSubmodule Y D v
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul g x => exact tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left hy g x
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [tmul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hw hw'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_mem_endStab
statement:
lemma tri_mem_endStab {a c : Module.End k (LusztigF k I)} (b : Module.End k (AddMonoidAlgebra k Y))
    (ha : ∀ y ∈ serreIdeal D v, a y ∈ serreIdeal D v)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ serreIdeal D v, c x ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    tri a b c ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_endStab]
  intro w hw
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨y, g, x, rfl, h⟩ := hz
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left (ha y h) _ _
    · exact tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_right _ _ (hc x h)
  | zero => simp
  | add z z' _ _ hz hz' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz hz'
  | smul c z _ hz => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opF_mem_endStab
statement: lemma opF_mem_endStab (i : I) : opF (k := k) (Y := Y) i ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab
proof:
:=
  tri_mem_endStab _ (fun _ hy ↦ TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hy) (fun _ hx ↦ hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opK_mem_endStab
statement: lemma opK_mem_endStab (ν : Y) : opK R v ν ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab
proof:
:=
  tri_mem_endStab _ (fun _ hy ↦ diagTwist_mem_serreIdeal _ hy) (fun _ hx ↦ hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opE_mem_endStab
statement:
lemma opE_mem_endStab (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) :
    opE R v i ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : opE0 R v i ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab :=
    tri_mem_endStab _ (fun _ hy ↦ hy) (fun _ hx ↦ TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx)
  have hp : opEp R v i ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab :=
    tri_mem_endStab _ (fun _ hy ↦ diagTwist_mem_serreIdeal _
      (lDeriv_mem_serreIdeal (NeZero.ne v) hv' i hy)) (fun _ hx ↦ hx)
  have hm : opEm R v i ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab :=
    tri_mem_endStab _ (fun _ hy ↦ rDeriv_mem_serreIdeal (NeZero.ne v) hv' i hy) (fun _ hx ↦ hx)
  exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ (Subalgebra.add_mem _ h0 (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hp _))
    (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hm _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_opF_tmul
statement:
lemma lift_opF_tmul (y z : LusztigF k I) (w : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift k (opF (k := k) (Y := Y)) y (z ⊗ₜ w) = (y * z) ⊗ₜ w
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing z with
  | grade0 c =>
    simp [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, Algebra.smul_def, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  | grade1 l => simp [opF, tri, TensorProduct.map_one]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, ha, mul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, add_mul, add_tmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_opF_mem_endStab
statement:
lemma lift_opF_mem_endStab (y : LusztigF k I) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift k (opF (k := k) (Y := Y)) y ∈ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endStab
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes]; exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c
  | grade1 l => rw [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]; exact opF_mem_endStab v l
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul]; exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_opF_mem
statement:
lemma qSerre_opF_mem (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (z : TriSpace k I Y) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (opF i) (opF j) z ∈
      serreTriSubmodule Y D v
proof:
:= by
  have hS := qSerre_mem_serreIdeal (D := D) (v := v) (k := k) hij
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i _)
  have h1 : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (opF (k := k) (Y := Y) i) (opF j) =
      FreeAlgebra.lift k opF
        (qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j)) := by
    have := map_qSerre (FreeAlgebra.lift k (opF (k := k) (Y := Y))) (v := v ^ D.d i)
      (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j)
    rw [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  rw [h1]
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul y w =>
    rw [lift_opF_tmul]
    exact tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left' (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ y hS) w
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz hz'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_opE_one_tmul
statement:
lemma lift_opE_one_tmul (z : LusztigF k I) (μ : Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift k (opE R v) z (1 ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1 ⊗ₜ x)) =
      1 ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1 ⊗ₜ (tau R v μ z * x))
proof:
:= by
  induction z using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing x with
  | grade0 c =>
    simp only [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
    rw [← Algebra.smul_def, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  | grade1 i =>
    simp [opE, opE0, opEp, opEm, tri, chi_single, tau_apply_θ, TensorProduct.smul_tmul',
      TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, ha, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, map_add, add_mul, tmul_add,
      tmul_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_opE_mem
statement:
lemma qSerre_opE_mem (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (z : TriSpace k I Y) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (opE R v i) (opE R v j) z ∈
      serreTriSubmodule Y D v
proof:
:= by
  set S := qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j) with hS_def
  have hS : S ∈ serreIdeal D v := qSerre_mem_serreIdeal hij
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i _)
  set T := FreeAlgebra.lift k (opE R v) S with hT_def
  have h1 : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (opE R v i) (opE R v j) = T := by
    have := map_qSerre (FreeAlgebra.lift k (opE R v)) (v := v ^ D.d i)
      (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j)
    rw [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  
  have hTF : ∀ l, T * opF l = opF l * T := fun l ↦ by
    have := (preRelations_op R v).lift_mul_sub (NeZero.ne v) l S
    have h0 : FreeAlgebra.lift k (opE R v) (rDeriv D v l S) = 0 := by
      rw [rDeriv_qSerre (NeZero.ne v) hij]; exact map_zero _
    have h0' : FreeAlgebra.lift k (opE R v) (lDeriv D v l S) = 0 := by
      rw [lDeriv_qSerre (NeZero.ne v) hij]; exact map_zero _
    rw [h0, h0', zero_mul, mul_zero] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (this.trans (by module))
  have hTy : ∀ y : LusztigF k I, T * FreeAlgebra.lift k opF y = FreeAlgebra.lift k opF y * T := by
    intro y
    induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.commutes]
    | grade1 l => rw [FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, hTF]
    | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc, ha, mul_assoc, hb, mul_assoc]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, mul_add, add_mul, ha, hb]
  rw [h1]
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul y w =>
    have hyw : y ⊗ₜ[k] w = FreeAlgebra.lift k opF y ((1 : LusztigF k I) ⊗ₜ[k] w) := by
      rw [lift_opF_tmul, mul_one]
    rw [hyw, ← Module.End.mul_apply, hTy, Module.End.mul_apply]
    refine (Submodule.mem_endStab _).1 (lift_opF_mem_endStab v y) _ ?_
    clear hyw
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul g x =>
      induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
      | of μ =>
        change T (1 ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1 ⊗ₜ x)) ∈ _
        rw [hT_def, lift_opE_one_tmul]
        have hτ : tau R v μ S ∈ serreIdeal D v := diagTwist_mem_serreIdeal _ hS
        exact tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_right _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ hτ)
      | add g g' hg hg' => rw [add_tmul, tmul_add, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hg hg'
      | smul c g hg =>
        rw [← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hg
    | add w w' hw hw' => rw [tmul_add, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hw hw'
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz hz'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.relations_triQuot
statement:
theorem relations_triQuot (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    Relations R v
      (fun i ↦ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endDescend ⟨opE R v i, opE_mem_endStab R v hv' i⟩)
      (fun i ↦ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endDescend ⟨opF i, opF_mem_endStab v i⟩)
      (descendHom _ (opKHom R v) fun μ ↦ opK_mem_endStab R v μ.toAdd)
proof:
:=
  Relations.descend (preRelations_op R v) _ _ _ (fun _ _ hij z ↦ qSerre_opE_mem R v hv' hij z)
    (fun _ _ hij z ↦ qSerre_opF_mem v hv' hij z)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triRep_plusHom_mk
statement:
lemma triRep_plusHom_mk (x : LusztigF k I) (z : TriSpace k I Y) :
    triRep R v hv' (plusHom R v x) (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (FreeAlgebra.lift k (opE R v) x z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (triRep R v hv').comp (plusHom R v) = FreeAlgebra.lift k
      (fun i ↦ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endDescend ⟨opE R v i, opE_mem_endStab R v hv' i⟩) :=
    FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun i ↦ by simp [triRep])
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, h, lift_endDescend_mk]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triRep_minusHom_mk
statement:
lemma triRep_minusHom_mk (y : LusztigF k I) (z : TriSpace k I Y) :
    triRep R v hv' (minusHom R v y) (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (FreeAlgebra.lift k opF y z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (triRep R v hv').comp (minusHom R v) = FreeAlgebra.lift k
      (fun i ↦ (serreTriSubmodule Y D v).endDescend ⟨opF i, opF_mem_endStab v i⟩) :=
    FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun i ↦ by simp [triRep])
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, h, lift_endDescend_mk]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triRep_zeroHom_mk
statement:
lemma triRep_zeroHom_mk (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    triRep R v hv' (zeroHom R v g) (Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ x))) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x))
proof:
:= by
  induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of μ =>
    change triRep R v hv' (zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1)) _ =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1 ⊗ₜ x))
    simp [triRep, descendHom, opKHom_apply, opK, shift]
  | add g g' hg hg' =>
    have key : ∀ (A B : Module.End k (TriSpace k I Y ⧸ serreTriSubmodule Y D v)) q,
        (A + B) q = A q + B q := fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
    rw [map_add, map_add, key, hg, hg', add_tmul, tmul_add, Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]
  | smul c g hg =>
    have key : ∀ (A : Module.End k (TriSpace k I Y ⧸ serreTriSubmodule Y D v)) q,
        (c • A) q = c • A q := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, key, hg, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← smul_tmul', tmul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma triMap_tmul (y : LusztigF k I) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    triMap (R := R) (v := v) (y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x)) = minusHom R v y * (zeroHom R v g * plusHom R v x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreTriSubmodule_le_ker
statement:
lemma serreTriSubmodule_le_ker (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker (triMap (R := R) (v := v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨y, g, x, rfl, h | h⟩
  · have := (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).1 (serreIdeal_le_ker_minusHom (R := R) hv hv' h)
    simp [this]
  · have := (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).1 (serreIdeal_le_ker_plusHom (R := R) hv hv' h)
    simp [this]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triQuotMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma triQuotMap_mk (z : TriSpace k I Y) :
    triQuotMap R v hv' (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) = triMap z
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triRep_triMap
statement:
lemma triRep_triMap (z : TriSpace k I Y) :
    triRep R v hv' (triMap z) (Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ 1))) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul y w =>
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul g x =>
      have hx : FreeAlgebra.lift k (opE R v) x (1 ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ 1)) =
          (1 : LusztigF k I) ⊗ₜ ((1 : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) ⊗ₜ x) := by
        rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, lift_opE_one_tmul, mul_one]
        congr 3
        exact LinearMap.congr_fun (tau_zero (R := R) (v := v)) x
      rw [triMap_tmul, map_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
        triRep_plusHom_mk, hx, triRep_zeroHom_mk, triRep_minusHom_mk, lift_opF_tmul, mul_one]
    | add w w' hw hw' => rw [tmul_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hw, hw',
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hz, hz',
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triRep_triQuotMap
statement:
lemma triRep_triQuotMap (q : TriSpace k I Y ⧸ serreTriSubmodule Y D v) :
    triRep R v hv' (triQuotMap R v hv' q) (Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ 1))) = q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H z => exact triRep_triMap R v hv' z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triQuotMap_injective
statement: lemma triQuotMap_injective : Function.Injective (triQuotMap R v hv')
proof:
:= fun a b h ↦ by
  rw [← triRep_triQuotMap R v hv' a, ← triRep_triQuotMap R v hv' b, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triQuotMap_surjective
statement: lemma triQuotMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (triQuotMap R v hv')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← span_triangular (R := R) (NeZero.ne v),
    triangularSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk (monomial k w ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1 ⊗ₜ monomial k w')),
    ?_⟩
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triangularEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem triangularEquiv_mk (y : LusztigF k I) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y)
    (x : LusztigF k I) :
    triangularEquiv R v hv' (Submodule.Quotient.mk (y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x))) =
      minusHom R v y * zeroHom R v g * plusHom R v x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc]; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_serreTriSubmodule_of_triMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mem_serreTriSubmodule_of_triMap_eq_zero {z : TriSpace k I Y}
    (hz : triMap (R := R) (v := v) z = 0) : z ∈ serreTriSubmodule Y D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact triQuotMap_injective R v hv' (by rw [triQuotMap_mk, hz, map_zero])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.augmentation_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma augmentation_single (μ : Y) (c : k) :
    augmentation Y (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ c) = c
proof:
:= by
  simp [augmentation, AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_serreSubmodule
statement: lemma mem_serreSubmodule {x : LusztigF k I} : x ∈ serreSubmodule D v ↔ x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:=
  TwoSidedIdeal.mem_asIdeal

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem plusHom_eq_zero_iff (x : LusztigF k I) : plusHom R v x = 0 ↔ x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun hx ↦ (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).1
    (serreIdeal_le_ker_plusHom (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) hv' hx)⟩
  have hz : (1 : LusztigF k I) ⊗ₜ ((1 : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) ⊗ₜ x) ∈ serreTriSubmodule Y D v :=
    mem_serreTriSubmodule_of_triMap_eq_zero R v hv' (by simp [hx])
  let π : TriSpace k I Y →ₗ[k] LusztigF k I ⧸ serreSubmodule D v :=
    (TensorProduct.lid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map counit.toLinearMap
      ((TensorProduct.lid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (augmentation Y).toLinearMap (serreSubmodule D v).mkQ)
  have hπ : ∀ y g x', π (y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x')) =
      counit y • augmentation Y g • Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) x' :=
    fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
  have hW : serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker π := by
    rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨y, g, x', rfl, h | h⟩
    · simp [hπ, counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal h]
    · have : Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) x' = 0 :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (mem_serreSubmodule.2 h)
      simp [hπ, this]
  have := hW hz
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hπ, map_one, map_one, one_smul, one_smul,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
  exact mem_serreSubmodule.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem minusHom_eq_zero_iff (y : LusztigF k I) : minusHom R v y = 0 ↔ y ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hy ↦ ?_, fun hy ↦ (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).1
    (serreIdeal_le_ker_minusHom (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) hv' hy)⟩
  have hz : y ⊗ₜ ((1 : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) ⊗ₜ (1 : LusztigF k I)) ∈ serreTriSubmodule Y D v :=
    mem_serreTriSubmodule_of_triMap_eq_zero R v hv' (by simp [hy])
  let π : TriSpace k I Y →ₗ[k] LusztigF k I ⧸ serreSubmodule D v :=
    (TensorProduct.rid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (serreSubmodule D v).mkQ
      ((TensorProduct.lid k k).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (augmentation Y).toLinearMap counit.toLinearMap)
  have hπ : ∀ y' g x, π (y' ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x)) =
      (augmentation Y g • counit x) • Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) y' :=
    fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
  have hW : serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker π := by
    rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨y', g, x, rfl, h | h⟩
    · have : Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) y' = 0 :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (mem_serreSubmodule.2 h)
      simp [hπ, this]
    · simp [hπ, counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal h]
  have := hW hz
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hπ, map_one, map_one, one_smul, one_smul,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
  exact mem_serreSubmodule.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zeroHom_injective
statement: theorem zeroHom_injective : Function.Injective (zeroHom R v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro g hg
  have hz : (1 : LusztigF k I) ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ (1 : LusztigF k I)) ∈ serreTriSubmodule Y D v :=
    mem_serreTriSubmodule_of_triMap_eq_zero R v hv' (by simp [hg])
  let π : TriSpace k I Y →ₗ[k] AddMonoidAlgebra k Y :=
    (TensorProduct.lid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map counit.toLinearMap
      ((TensorProduct.rid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id counit.toLinearMap)
  have hπ : ∀ y g' x, π (y ⊗ₜ (g' ⊗ₜ x)) = counit y • counit x • g' := fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
  have hW : serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker π := by
    rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨y, g', x, rfl, h | h⟩
    · simp [hπ, counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal h]
    · simp [hπ, counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal h]
  have := hW hz
  rwa [LinearMap.mem_ker, hπ, map_one, one_smul, one_smul] at this

name: LusztigF.exists_linearIndependent_fin
statement:
theorem exists_linearIndependent_fin {K M ι : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    (f : ι → M) [FiniteDimensional K (Submodule.span K (Set.range f))] :
    ∃ a : Fin (finrank K (Submodule.span K (Set.range f))) → ι, LinearIndependent K (f ∘ a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨κ, a, -, hsp, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' K f
  set S := Submodule.span K (Set.range f)
  have hmem : ∀ x, f (a x) ∈ S := fun x ↦ Submodule.subset_span ⟨a x, rfl⟩
  have hli' : LinearIndependent K (fun x ↦ (⟨f (a x), hmem x⟩ : S)) :=
    LinearIndependent.of_comp S.subtype hli
  have := hli'.finite_of_isNoetherian
  have := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have hcard : Fintype.card κ = finrank K S := by
    rw [← hsp]; exact linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span.1 hli
  refine ⟨a ∘ (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard).symm, ?_⟩
  exact hli.comp _ (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard).symm.injective

name: LusztigF.card_le_finrank_of_linearIndependent
proof:
:= by
  have h := linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span.1 hf
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  rw [h]
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono (Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hS))

name: LusztigF.weightSpace_eq_span
statement:
lemma weightSpace_eq_span (K : Type*) [Field K] (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    weightSpace K ν = Submodule.span K (Set.range fun w : Words ν ↦ wordBasis K I w.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [monomial, Words]

name: LusztigF.finrank_weightSpace
statement:
lemma finrank_weightSpace (K : Type*) [Field K] (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank K (weightSpace K ν) = Fintype.card (Words ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace_eq_span]
  exact (finrank_span_eq_card
    ((wordBasis K I).linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective))

name: LusztigF.wordCoord_apply
statement:
lemma wordCoord_apply (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (x : FreeAlgebra R I) (w : Words ν) :
    wordCoord R ν x w = (wordBasis R I).repr x w.1
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.repr_eq_zero_of_mem_wordSpan
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hx using wordSpan_induction with
  | word u hu =>
    rw [Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right_iff]
    rintro rfl; exact absurd hu hw
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
  | smul c y _ hy => simp [hy]

name: LusztigF.eq_zero_of_wordCoord_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_wordCoord_eq_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : FreeAlgebra R I}
    (hx : x ∈ wordSpan R ν) (h : wordCoord R ν x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (wordBasis R I).repr.injective ?_
  ext w
  rw [map_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  by_cases hw : wordWeight w = ν
  · exact congr_fun h ⟨w, hw⟩
  · exact repr_eq_zero_of_mem_wordSpan hx hw

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_qSerreU
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_qSerreU {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [Field K] (φ : R →+* K) (q : Rˣ) (m : ℕ)
    (a b : FreeAlgebra R I) :
    mapCoeffs φ (qSerreU q m a b) = qSerre (φ q) m (mapCoeffs φ a) (mapCoeffs φ b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerreU, qSerre, map_sum, mapCoeffs_smul, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one,
    map_qBinomialU]

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_serreProductL
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_serreProductL {K : Type*} [Field K] (φ : LaurentPolynomial ℚ →+* K)
    (g : List I × I × I × List I) :
    mapCoeffs φ (serreProductL D g) =
      serreProduct D (fun i ↦ φ ((laurentT ^ D.d i : (LaurentPolynomial ℚ)ˣ) : _)) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreProductL, map_mul, map_mul, mapCoeffs_qSerreU, mapCoeffs_wordBasis, mapCoeffs_wordBasis,
    mapCoeffs_ι, mapCoeffs_ι]
  rfl

name: LusztigF.ne_zero_of_transcendental
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_transcendental (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) : v ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  Polynomial.X_ne_zero ((transcendental_iff.1 hv) Polynomial.X (by simp [h]))

name: LusztigF.pow_ne_one_of_transcendental
statement: lemma pow_ne_one_of_transcendental (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : v ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hn (1 : ℚ)
    ((transcendental_iff.1 hv) _ (by simp [h]))

name: LusztigF.serreProduct_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma serreProduct_mem_serreIdeal (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {g : List I × I × I × List I} (hg : g.2.1 ≠ g.2.2.1) :
    serreProduct D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) g ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ ?_)
  exact qSerre_mem_serreIdeal hg (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv0 hv _ _)

name: LusztigF.serreSpan_le_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma serreSpan_le_serreIdeal (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {ν : I →₀ ℕ}
    {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν) : y ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨hg, -⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact serreProduct_mem_serreIdeal D hv0 hv hg
  | zero => exact (serreIdeal D v).zero_mem
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => exact smul_mem_serreIdeal c hy

name: LusztigF.stdWeight_coroot
statement:
lemma stdWeight_coroot [DecidableEq I] (n : I → ℕ) (i : I) :
    stdWeight D n ((Matrix.Realization.std D.cartanMatrix ℚ).coroot i) = n i
proof:
:= by
  simp [stdWeight, Matrix.Realization.std, Pi.single_apply]

name: LusztigF.mem_serreSpan_of_mem_radical_and_finrank_serreSpan
statement:
theorem mem_serreSpan_of_mem_radical_and_finrank_serreSpan [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (∀ x : LusztigF k I, x ∈ radical D v → x ∈ weightSpace k ν →
      x ∈ serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν) ∧
    finrank k (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν) =
      finrank ℚ (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) ν)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hv0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hv
  have hvn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1 := fun n hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn
  have hv' : ∀ i, (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 ≠ 1 := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← pow_mul]; exact hvn _ (by have := D.d_pos i; omega)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (evalAt v hv0) :=
    LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_injective_of_transcendental hv hv0
  set n : I → ℕ := fun i ↦ ν i with hn_def
  set cL : I → (I →₀ ℕ) → LaurentPolynomial ℚ := fun i μ ↦ vermaCoeff D (fun i ↦ (n i : ℤ)) i μ
  have hc₀ : (fun i ↦ (evalAt (1 : ℚ) one_ne_zero) ∘ cL i) = classicalCoeff ℚ D n := by
    funext i μ
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, cL, evalAt_one_vermaCoeff, classicalCoeff]
  
  let Φ : LusztigF k I →ₗ[k] (Words ν → k) :=
    LinearMap.pi fun w ↦ vermaForm (fun i ↦ (evalAt v hv0) ∘ cL i) w.1
  let Φ₀ : LusztigF ℚ I →ₗ[ℚ] (Words ν → ℚ) :=
    LinearMap.pi fun w ↦ vermaForm (classicalCoeff ℚ D n) w.1
  have hspecQ : ∀ (u : List I) (w : Words ν),
      evalAt v hv0 (vermaForm cL w.1 (wordBasis _ I u)) = Φ (wordBasis k I u) w := by
    intro u w
    rw [map_vermaForm, mapCoeffs_wordBasis]
    rfl
  have hspec₀ : ∀ (u : List I) (w : Words ν),
      evalAt (1 : ℚ) one_ne_zero (vermaForm cL w.1 (wordBasis _ I u)) = Φ₀ (wordBasis ℚ I u) w := by
    intro u w
    rw [map_vermaForm, mapCoeffs_wordBasis, hc₀]
    rfl
  set V := weightSpace k ν
  set V₀ := weightSpace ℚ ν
  set Z := serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) ν
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ Z := Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν)
  
  have hker₀ : finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (Φ₀.domRestrict V₀)) ≤ finrank ℚ Z := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
    refine Submodule.finrank_mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hy' : Φ₀ (y : LusztigF ℚ I) = 0 := hy
    change (y : LusztigF ℚ I) ∈ Z
    refine mem_serreSpan_of_vermaForm_eq_zero D (Matrix.Realization.std D.cartanMatrix ℚ)
      (stdWeight_coroot D n) (fun _ ↦ le_rfl) y.2 fun w hw ↦ ?_
    exact congr_fun hy' ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hrange₀ : LinearMap.range (Φ₀.domRestrict V₀) =
      Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range fun w : Words ν ↦ Φ₀ (wordBasis ℚ I w.1)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, show V₀ = _ from weightSpace_eq_span ℚ ν, Submodule.map_span,
      ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  have hrank₀ := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Φ₀.domRestrict V₀)
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_linearIndependent_fin (K := ℚ) fun w : Words ν ↦ Φ₀ (wordBasis ℚ I w.1)
  have hq : LinearIndependent k fun t ↦ Φ (wordBasis k I (a t).1) := by
    have h := LinearIndependent.of_comp_ratHom (evalAt (1 : ℚ) one_ne_zero) (evalAt v hv0) hinj
      (fun t (w : Words ν) ↦ vermaForm cL w.1 (wordBasis _ I (a t).1)) (by
        convert ha using 1
        funext t w
        exact hspec₀ _ w)
    convert h using 1
    funext t w
    exact (hspecQ _ w).symm
  have hr := card_le_finrank_of_linearIndependent hq (S := LinearMap.range (Φ.domRestrict V))
    fun t ↦ ⟨⟨_, wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq (a t).2⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [← hrange₀] at hr
  have hrank := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Φ.domRestrict V)
  have hVV₀ : finrank k V = finrank ℚ V₀ := by rw [finrank_weightSpace, finrank_weightSpace]
  have hker : finrank k (LinearMap.ker (Φ.domRestrict V)) ≤ finrank ℚ Z := by omega
  
  have hZ : Z = Submodule.span ℚ
      (Set.range fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦ serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g.1) := by
    rw [show Z = serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) ν from rfl, serreSpan, Set.image_eq_range]
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ
      (Set.range fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦ serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g.1)) := hZ ▸ this
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_linearIndependent_fin (K := ℚ)
    fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦ serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g.1
  have hm : finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ
      (Set.range fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦ serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g.1)) =
      finrank ℚ Z := by rw [hZ]
  have hb' : LinearIndependent ℚ fun t ↦
      wordCoord ℚ ν (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) (b t).1) := by
    refine hb.map (f := wordCoord ℚ ν) ?_
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro y hy hy0
    refine eq_zero_of_wordCoord_eq_zero ?_ hy0
    have hle : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range
        ((fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦ serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g.1) ∘ b)) ≤
        wordSpan ℚ ν := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(b t).1, (b t).2, rfl⟩)
    exact hle hy
  have hqS : LinearIndependent k fun t ↦ serreProduct D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) (b t).1 := by
    have h := LinearIndependent.of_comp_ratHom (evalAt (1 : ℚ) one_ne_zero) (evalAt v hv0) hinj
      (fun t (w : Words ν) ↦ (wordBasis _ I).repr (serreProductL D (b t).1) w.1) (by
        convert hb' using 1
        funext t w
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, wordCoord_apply, ← wordBasis_repr_mapCoeffs,
          mapCoeffs_serreProductL, evalAt_laurentT_pow, one_pow])
    refine LinearIndependent.of_comp (wordCoord k ν) ?_
    convert h using 1
    funext t w
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, wordCoord_apply, ← wordBasis_repr_mapCoeffs,
      mapCoeffs_serreProductL, evalAt_laurentT_pow]
  have : FiniteDimensional k (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν)
  have hm' := card_le_finrank_of_linearIndependent hqS
    (S := serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν) fun t ↦
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨(b t).1, (b t).2, rfl⟩
  
  let RadV : Submodule k V := (radicalSubmodule D v).comap V.subtype
  let SerV : Submodule k V := (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν).comap V.subtype
  have hSerRad : SerV ≤ RadV := fun y hy ↦
    serreIdeal_le_radical hv0 hvn (serreSpan_le_serreIdeal D hv0 hvn hy)
  have hRadKer : RadV ≤ LinearMap.ker (Φ.domRestrict V) := fun y hy ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    funext w
    exact vermaForm_eq_zero_of_mem_radical D hv0 hv' _ w.1 hy
  have hSerV : finrank k SerV = finrank k (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
      inf_eq_right.2 (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν)]
  have hEq : SerV = RadV := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hSerRad (by
    have := Submodule.finrank_mono hRadKer
    omega)
  refine ⟨fun x hx hxν ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hxV : (⟨x, hxν⟩ : V) ∈ SerV := hEq ▸ hx
    exact hxV
  · have := Submodule.finrank_mono hRadKer
    rw [← hEq] at this
    rw [hm] at hm'
    omega

name: LusztigF.radical_inf_weightSpace_le_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem radical_inf_weightSpace_le_serreIdeal [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ radical D v) (hxν : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) :
    x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:=
  serreSpan_le_serreIdeal D (ne_zero_of_transcendental hv)
    (fun _ hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn)
    ((mem_serreSpan_of_mem_radical_and_finrank_serreSpan D hv ν).1 x hx hxν)

name: LusztigF.form_weightProj
statement:
lemma form_weightProj (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (y x : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v (weightProj k ν y) x = form D v y (weightProj k ν x)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hy, hy']
  | smul c y hy => simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hy]
  | word w =>
    induction x using induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hx']
    | smul c x hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hx]
    | word u =>
      rw [weightProj_wordBasis, weightProj_wordBasis]
      by_cases hwu : wordWeight w = wordWeight u
      · rw [hwu]; split_ifs <;> simp
      · have h0 := form_eq_zero_of_ne D v hwu (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan (R := k) w)
          (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan (R := k) u)
        split_ifs <;> simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, h0]

name: LusztigF.weightProj_mem_radical
statement:
lemma weightProj_mem_radical (ν : I →₀ ℕ) {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ radical D v) :
    weightProj k ν x ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_radical_iff']
  intro y
  rw [← form_weightProj, (mem_radical_iff' D v).1 hx]

name: LusztigF.sum_weightProj
statement:
lemma sum_weightProj (x : LusztigF k I) :
    ∑ ν ∈ ((wordBasis k I).repr x).support.image wordWeight, weightProj k ν x = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set c := (wordBasis k I).repr x
  have hx : x = ∑ w ∈ c.support, c w • wordBasis k I w := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (wordBasis k I).linearCombination_repr x]
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [hx]
  conv_lhs => rw [hx]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, weightProj_wordBasis, smul_ite, smul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  simp [Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hw]

name: LusztigF.radical_eq_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem radical_eq_serreIdeal [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) :
    radical D v = serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    (serreIdeal_le_radical (ne_zero_of_transcendental hv)
      fun _ hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn)
  rw [← sum_weightProj x]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ (· ∈ serreIdeal D v) (fun a b ha hb ↦ TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ ha hb)
    (serreIdeal D v).zero_mem fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  exact radical_inf_weightSpace_le_serreIdeal D hv ν (weightProj_mem_radical D ν hx)
    (weightProj_mem ν x)

name: LusztigF.forall_form_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem forall_form_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v)
    {x : LusztigF k I} : (∀ y, form D v x y = 0) ↔ x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_radical_iff, radical_eq_serreIdeal D hv]

name: LusztigF.toQuotient_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem toQuotient_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v)
    {x : LusztigF k I} : toQuotient D v x = 0 ↔ x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [toQuotient_eq_zero_iff, radical_eq_serreIdeal D hv]

name: LusztigF.transcendental_ratFunc_X
statement: lemma transcendental_ratFunc_X : Transcendental ℚ (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  convert RatFunc.transcendental_X (K := ℚ)
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: LusztigF.radical_eq_serreIdeal_ratFunc
statement:
theorem radical_eq_serreIdeal_ratFunc :
    radical D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) = serreIdeal D RatFunc.X
proof:
:=
  radical_eq_serreIdeal D transcendental_ratFunc_X

name: LusztigF.forall_form_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal_ratFunc
statement:
theorem forall_form_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal_ratFunc {x : FreeAlgebra (RatFunc ℚ) I} :
    (∀ y, form D RatFunc.X x y = 0) ↔ x ∈ serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
proof:
:=
  forall_form_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal D transcendental_ratFunc_X

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chi_single
statement:
lemma chi_single (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    chi R v i (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1) =
      v ^ (-R.root i μ) • AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [chi, AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tau_apply_θ
statement: lemma tau_apply_θ (ν : Y) (j : I) : tau R v ν (θ k j) = v ^ (-R.root j ν) • θ k j
proof:
:= by
  simp [tau]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tau_mul_tau
statement:
lemma tau_mul_tau (ν ν' : Y) :
    (tau R v ν).toLinearMap * (tau R v ν').toLinearMap = (tau R v (ν + ν')).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, tau, diagTwist_diagTwist]
  rw [show ((fun j ↦ v ^ (-R.root j ν)) * fun j ↦ v ^ (-R.root j ν')) =
    fun j ↦ v ^ (-R.root j (ν + ν')) from funext fun j ↦ by
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply, map_add, neg_add, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tau_zero
statement: lemma tau_zero : (tau R v 0).toLinearMap = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [tau]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tau_comm
statement:
lemma tau_comm (ν ν' : Y) :
    (tau R v ν).toLinearMap * (tau R v ν').toLinearMap =
      (tau R v ν').toLinearMap * (tau R v ν).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [tau, diagTwist_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tau_mul_mulLeft
statement:
lemma tau_mul_mulLeft (ν : Y) (j : I) :
    (tau R v ν).toLinearMap * LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j) =
      v ^ (-R.root j ν) • (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j) * (tau R v ν).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [tau]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lDeriv_mul_tau
statement:
lemma lDeriv_mul_tau (i : I) (ν : Y) :
    (lDeriv D v i : Module.End k (LusztigF k I)) * (tau R v ν).toLinearMap =
      v ^ (-R.root i ν) • ((tau R v ν).toLinearMap * lDeriv D v i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [tau, lDeriv_diagTwist]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_mul_tau
statement:
lemma rDeriv_mul_tau (i : I) (ν : Y) :
    (rDeriv D v i : Module.End k (LusztigF k I)) * (tau R v ν).toLinearMap =
      v ^ (-R.root i ν) • ((tau R v ν).toLinearMap * rDeriv D v i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [tau, rDeriv_diagTwist]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lDeriv_mul_mulLeft
statement:
lemma lDeriv_mul_mulLeft (i j : I) :
    (lDeriv D v i : Module.End k (LusztigF k I)) * LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j) =
      (if i = j then 1 else 0) + v ^ D.dot i j • (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j) * lDeriv D v i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, lDeriv_θ_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_mul_mulLeft
statement:
lemma rDeriv_mul_mulLeft (i j : I) :
    (rDeriv D v i : Module.End k (LusztigF k I)) * LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j) =
      LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j) * rDeriv D v i +
        (if i = j then (twist D v i).toLinearMap else 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, rDeriv_θ_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tau_neg_ktilde
statement: lemma tau_neg_ktilde (i : I) : tau R v (-ktilde R i) = twist D v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [tau, twist_eq_diagTwist]
  congr 1
  funext j
  rw [map_neg, neg_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shift_mul_shift
statement:
lemma shift_mul_shift (ν ν' : Y) :
    shift (k := k) ν * shift ν' = shift (ν + ν')
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun g ↦ ?_
  simp only [shift, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, ← mul_assoc,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shift_zero
statement: lemma shift_zero : shift (k := k) (0 : Y) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun g ↦ ?_
  simp [shift, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shift_comm
statement: lemma shift_comm (ν ν' : Y) : shift (k := k) ν * shift ν' = shift ν' * shift ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [shift_mul_shift, shift_mul_shift, add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chi_mul_shift
statement:
lemma chi_mul_shift (i : I) (ν : Y) :
    (chi R v i).toLinearMap * shift ν =
      v ^ (-R.root i ν) • (shift ν * (chi R v i).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun g ↦ ?_
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, shift, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_mul, chi_single, smul_mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chi_comm
statement:
lemma chi_comm (i j : I) :
    (chi R v i).toLinearMap * (chi R v j).toLinearMap =
      (chi R v j).toLinearMap * (chi R v i).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun g ↦ ?_
  induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of μ =>
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
    rw [show AddMonoidAlgebra.of k Y (Multiplicative.ofAdd μ) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1
      from rfl, chi_single, map_smul, chi_single, map_smul, chi_single, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      mul_comm]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul c x hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hx]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_mul
statement:
lemma tri_mul (a a' b b' c c') :
    tri (k := k) (I := I) (Y := Y) a b c * tri a' b' c' = tri (a * a') (b * b') (c * c')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tri, TensorProduct.map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_one
statement: lemma tri_one : tri (k := k) (I := I) (Y := Y) 1 1 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [tri]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_smul_left
statement:
lemma tri_smul_left (s : k) (a b c) :
    tri (k := k) (I := I) (Y := Y) (s • a) b c = s • tri a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [tri, TensorProduct.map_smul_left]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_smul_mid
statement:
lemma tri_smul_mid (s : k) (a b c) :
    tri (k := k) (I := I) (Y := Y) a (s • b) c = s • tri a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [tri, TensorProduct.map_smul_left, TensorProduct.map_smul_right]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_add_left
statement:
lemma tri_add_left (a a' b c) :
    tri (k := k) (I := I) (Y := Y) (a + a') b c = tri a b c + tri a' b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [tri, TensorProduct.map_add_left]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_zero_left
statement: lemma tri_zero_left (b c) : tri (k := k) (I := I) (Y := Y) 0 b c = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tri]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tri_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma tri_tmul (a b c) (y : LusztigF k I) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    tri a b c (y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x)) = a y ⊗ₜ (b g ⊗ₜ c x)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opKHom_apply
statement: lemma opKHom_apply (μ : Multiplicative Y) : opKHom R v μ = opK R v μ.toAdd
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opK_mul_opE0
statement:
lemma opK_mul_opE0 (ν : Y) (i : I) :
    opK R v ν * opE0 R v i = v ^ R.root i ν • (opE0 R v i * opK R v ν)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [opE0, opK, tri_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [chi_mul_shift, tri_smul_mid, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), add_neg_cancel,
    zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opK_mul_opEp
statement:
lemma opK_mul_opEp (ν : Y) (i : I) :
    opK R v ν * opEp R v i = v ^ R.root i ν • (opEp R v i * opK R v ν)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [opEp, opK, tri_mul, mul_one]
  rw [mul_assoc, lDeriv_mul_tau, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, tau_comm, shift_comm,
    tri_smul_left, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opK_mul_opEm
statement:
lemma opK_mul_opEm (ν : Y) (i : I) :
    opK R v ν * opEm R v i = v ^ R.root i ν • (opEm R v i * opK R v ν)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [opEm, opK, tri_mul, mul_one]
  rw [rDeriv_mul_tau, shift_comm, tri_smul_left, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v),
    add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opK_mul_opE
statement:
lemma opK_mul_opE (ν : Y) (i : I) :
    opK R v ν * opE R v i = v ^ R.root i ν • (opE R v i * opK R v ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [opE, mul_add, mul_add, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, opK_mul_opE0, opK_mul_opEp,
    opK_mul_opEm, add_mul, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add, smul_add,
    smul_comm (cst v D i), smul_comm (-cst v D i)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opK_mul_opF
statement:
lemma opK_mul_opF (ν : Y) (i : I) :
    opK R v ν * opF i = v ^ (-R.root i ν) • (opF i * opK R v ν)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [opF, opK, tri_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [tau_mul_mulLeft, tri_smul_left]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opE0_mul_opF
statement: lemma opE0_mul_opF (i j : I) : opE0 R v i * opF j = opF j * opE0 R v i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [opE0, opF, tri_mul, mul_one, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opEp_mul_opF
statement:
lemma opEp_mul_opF (i j : I) :
    opEp R v i * opF j = opF j * opEp R v i + if i = j then opK R v (ktilde R i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [opEp, opF, opK, tri_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [mul_assoc, lDeriv_mul_mulLeft, mul_add, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, tau_mul_mulLeft,
    smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, root_ktilde_eq_dot, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), add_neg_cancel,
    zpow_zero, one_smul, tri_add_left, add_comm, mul_assoc]
  split_ifs <;> simp [tri_zero_left]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opEm_mul_opF
statement:
lemma opEm_mul_opF (i j : I) :
    opEm R v i * opF j = opF j * opEm R v i + if i = j then opK R v (-ktilde R i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [opEm, opF, opK, tri_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [rDeriv_mul_mulLeft, tri_add_left, tau_neg_ktilde]
  split_ifs <;> simp [tri_zero_left]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.opE_mul_opF
statement:
lemma opE_mul_opF (i j : I) :
    opE R v i * opF j = opF j * opE R v i + if i = j then
      cst v D i • opK R v (ktilde R i) + (-cst v D i) • opK R v (-ktilde R i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [opE, add_mul, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, opE0_mul_opF, opEp_mul_opF,
    opEm_mul_opF, mul_add, mul_add, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]
  split_ifs
  · simp only [smul_add]; abel
  · simp only [add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.preRelations_op
statement:
theorem preRelations_op : PreRelations R v (opE R v) (opF (k := k) (Y := Y)) (opKHom R v) where
  K_mul_E ν i
proof:
:= opK_mul_opE ν i
  K_mul_F ν i := opK_mul_opF ν i
  E_mul_F i j := by
    rw [opE_mul_opF]
    split_ifs
    · rw [opKHom_apply, opKHom_apply, toAdd_ofAdd, toAdd_ofAdd]
      module
    · module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_apply
statement: lemma reflY_apply (i : I) (μ : Y) : reflY R i μ = μ - R.root i μ • R.coroot i
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.root_reflY
statement:
lemma root_reflY (i j : I) (μ : Y) :
    R.root j (reflY R i μ) = R.root j μ - R.root i μ * D.cartanMatrix i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflY_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, R.root_coroot, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.root_reflY_self
statement: @[simp] lemma root_reflY_self (i : I) (μ : Y) : R.root i (reflY R i μ) = -R.root i μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [root_reflY, D.cartanMatrix_self]; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_reflY
statement: @[simp] lemma reflY_reflY (i : I) (μ : Y) : reflY R i (reflY R i μ) = μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflY_apply (μ := reflY R i μ), root_reflY_self, reflY_apply, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add,
    sub_add_cancel]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_ktilde
statement: @[simp] lemma reflY_ktilde (i : I) : reflY R i (ktilde R i) = -ktilde R i
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflY_apply, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self, ktilde, ← natCast_zsmul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_neg_ktilde
statement: @[simp] lemma reflY_neg_ktilde (i : I) : reflY R i (-ktilde R i) = ktilde R i
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_neg, reflY_ktilde, neg_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidK_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma braidK_apply (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_root_neg_ktilde_self
statement:
lemma zpow_root_neg_ktilde_self (i : I) :
    v ^ R.root i (-ktilde R i) = ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_neg, zpow_neg, zpow_root_ktilde_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Kt_mul_E
statement: lemma Kt_mul_E (i : I) : Kt R v i * E R v i = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 • (E R v i * Kt R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kt, K_mul_E, zpow_root_ktilde_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_ktilde_mul_E
statement:
lemma K_neg_ktilde_mul_E (i : I) :
    K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i = ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2)⁻¹ • (E R v i * K R v (-ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [K_mul_E, zpow_root_neg_ktilde_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Kt_mul_K_neg
statement: lemma Kt_mul_K_neg (i : I) : Kt R v i * K R v (-ktilde R i) = 1
proof: := K_mul_K_neg R v _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_mul_Kt
statement: lemma K_neg_mul_Kt (i : I) : K R v (-ktilde R i) * Kt R v i = 1
proof: := K_neg_mul_K R v _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_mul_E_mul_F_mul_Kt
statement:
lemma K_neg_mul_E_mul_F_mul_Kt (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) :
    K R v (-ktilde R i) * (E R v i * F R v i) * Kt R v i = E R v i * F R v i
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)
  rw [← mul_assoc, K_neg_ktilde_mul_E, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_neg_ktilde_mul_F,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_smul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
    K_neg_mul_Kt, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_mul_F_mul_E_mul_Kt
statement:
lemma K_neg_mul_F_mul_E_mul_Kt (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) :
    K R v (-ktilde R i) * (F R v i * E R v i) * Kt R v i = F R v i * E R v i
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 :=
    mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv))
  rw [← mul_assoc, K_neg_ktilde_mul_F, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_neg_ktilde_mul_E,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, hq, one_smul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_neg_mul_Kt, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidK_mul_braidEi
statement:
theorem braidK_mul_braidEi (μ : Y) :
    braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ) * braidEi R i =
      v ^ R.root i μ • (braidEi R i * braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidK_apply, mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, K_mul_F, root_reflY_self, neg_neg, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc, K_comm, ← mul_assoc, neg_mul, smul_neg, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidK_mul_braidFi
statement:
theorem braidK_mul_braidFi (μ : Y) :
    braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ) * braidFi R i =
      v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (braidFi R i * braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidK_apply, mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, K_comm, mul_assoc, K_mul_E, root_reflY_self,
    mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, neg_mul, smul_neg, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidK_mul_braidInvEi
statement:
theorem braidK_mul_braidInvEi (μ : Y) :
    braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ) * braidInvEi R i =
      v ^ R.root i μ • (braidInvEi R i * braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidK_apply, mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, K_comm, mul_assoc, K_mul_F, root_reflY_self, neg_neg,
    mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, neg_mul, smul_neg, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidK_mul_braidInvFi
statement:
theorem braidK_mul_braidInvFi (μ : Y) :
    braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ) * braidInvFi R i =
      v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (braidInvFi R i * braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidK_apply, mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, K_mul_E, root_reflY_self, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc, K_comm, ← mul_assoc, neg_mul, smul_neg, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEi_mul_braidFi_sub
statement:
theorem braidEi_mul_braidFi_sub :
    braidEi R i * braidFi R i - braidFi R i * braidEi R i =
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        (braidK R v i (.ofAdd (ktilde R i)) - braidK R v i (.ofAdd (-ktilde R i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have h1 : braidEi R i * braidFi R i = F R v i * E R v i := by
    rw [neg_mul_neg, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (Kt R v i), Kt_mul_K_neg, one_mul]
  have h2 : braidFi R i * braidEi R i = E R v i * F R v i := by
    rw [neg_mul_neg, ← K_neg_mul_E_mul_F_mul_Kt hv i]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have h := E_mul_F_sub R v i i
  simp only [↓reduceIte] at h
  rw [h1, h2, braidK_apply, braidK_apply, reflY_ktilde, reflY_neg_ktilde, ← neg_sub, h,
    ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidInvEi_mul_braidInvFi_sub
statement:
theorem braidInvEi_mul_braidInvFi_sub :
    braidInvEi R i * braidInvFi R i - braidInvFi R i * braidInvEi R i =
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        (braidK R v i (.ofAdd (ktilde R i)) - braidK R v i (.ofAdd (-ktilde R i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have h1 : braidInvEi R i * braidInvFi R i = F R v i * E R v i := by
    rw [neg_mul_neg, ← K_neg_mul_F_mul_E_mul_Kt hv i]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have h2 : braidInvFi R i * braidInvEi R i = E R v i * F R v i := by
    rw [neg_mul_neg, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (Kt R v i), Kt_mul_K_neg, one_mul]
  have h := E_mul_F_sub R v i i
  simp only [↓reduceIte] at h
  rw [h1, h2, braidK_apply, braidK_apply, reflY_ktilde, reflY_neg_ktilde, ← neg_sub, h,
    ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankOneBraid_relations
statement:
theorem rankOneBraid_relations :
    Relations R₁ v (fun _ ↦ braidEi R₁ ()) (fun _ ↦ braidFi R₁ ()) (braidK R₁ v ()) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i (); exact braidK_mul_braidEi (R := R₁) () μ
  K_mul_F μ i := by obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i (); exact braidK_mul_braidFi (R := R₁) () μ
  E_mul_F i j := by
    obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i ()
    obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim j ()
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    exact braidEi_mul_braidFi_sub (R := R₁) ()
  serre_E i j h := absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) h
  serre_F i j h := absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.hasFiniteWeightsAbove
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.hasFiniteWeightsAbove (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M) :
    HasFiniteWeightsAbove R v M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
  have hinj : Function.Injective R.rootSum := fun ν ν' h ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR hne
    exact hμ (by rw [h])
  intro μ
  refine ((s : Set (Y →+ ℤ)).toFinite.biUnion fun μ' _ ↦
    ((antidiagonal (if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ' - μ then h.choose else 0)).image
      Prod.fst).finite_toSet).subset ?_
  intro ν hν
  obtain ⟨μ', hμ', ρ, hρ⟩ := hs _ hν
  have hσ : R.rootSum (ν + ρ) = μ' - μ := by
    rw [R.rootSum_add]
    calc R.rootSum ν + R.rootSum ρ = (μ + R.rootSum ν) + R.rootSum ρ - μ := by abel
      _ = μ' - μ := by rw [hρ]; abel
  have hex : ∃ σ, R.rootSum σ = μ' - μ := ⟨_, hσ⟩
  refine Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_coe.2 hμ') ?_
  refine Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(ν, ρ), mem_antidiagonal.2 ?_, rfl⟩)
  simp only [hex, ↓reduceDIte]
  exact (hinj (hex.choose_spec.trans hσ.symm)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isCategoryOInt_of_le_span
statement:
theorem isCategoryOInt_of_le_span {Λ₀ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ₀)
    {N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M} (hN : N ≤ Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {x}) :
    IsCategoryOInt R v N where
  isIntegrable
proof:
:= hM.submodule hv' N
  finiteDimensional_weightSpace Λ := by
    have := hfd Λ
    let f : weightSpace R v N Λ →ₗ[k] weightSpace R v M Λ :=
      { toFun := fun y ↦ ⟨y.1, mem_weightSpace_submodule.1 y.2⟩
        map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
        map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
    exact Module.Finite.of_injective f fun y z h ↦
      Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun w : weightSpace R v M Λ ↦ (w : M)) h))
  exists_finset := by
    classical
    set W : Submodule k M := ⨆ ν : I →₀ ℕ, weightSpace R v M (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν)
    have hE : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W, E R v i • y ∈ W := by
      intro i
      suffices W ≤ W.comap (Algebra.lsmul k k M (E R v i)) from fun y hy ↦ this hy
      refine iSup_le fun ν y hy ↦ ?_
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
      refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (ν + Finsupp.single i 1) ?_
      have := E_smul_mem_weightSpace hy i
      rwa [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, ← add_assoc]
    have hW : W ≤ ⨆ μ, W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ := iSup_le fun ν ↦
      le_iSup_of_le (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν)
        (le_inf (le_iSup (fun ν ↦ weightSpace R v M (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν)) ν) le_rfl)
    have hxW : x ∈ W := Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (by rwa [R.rootSum_zero, add_zero])
    have hWμ : ∀ μ, W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ ≠ ⊥ →
        ∃ ν ∈ (hab Λ₀).toFinset, μ = Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν := by
      intro μ hμ
      by_contra! hne
      refine hμ (eq_bot_iff.2 fun y hy ↦ ?_)
      have hle : W ≤ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ μ), weightSpace R v M j := iSup_le fun ν ↦ by
        by_cases h : weightSpace R v M (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν) = ⊥
        · rw [h]
          exact bot_le
        · exact le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun j (_ : j ≠ μ) ↦ weightSpace R v M j) _
            (fun h' ↦ hne ν ((hab Λ₀).mem_toFinset.2 h) h'.symm) le_rfl
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot k).2
        (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_weightSpace hv' μ) y hy.2 (hle hy.1))
    refine ⟨(hab Λ₀).toFinset.image fun ν ↦ Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν, fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hΛ
    by_contra! hne
    refine hy0 (Subtype.ext (eq_zero_of_mem_span_of_mem_weightSpace hv' hE hW ?_
      (Submodule.span_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hxW) (hN y.2))
      (mem_weightSpace_submodule.1 hy)))
    intro μ hμ ν he
    obtain ⟨ν', hν', rfl⟩ := hWμ μ hμ
    exact hne _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hν') ν he.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isSemisimpleModule_of_hasFiniteWeightsAbove
statement: theorem isSemisimpleModule_of_hasFiniteWeightsAbove : IsSemisimpleModule (QuantumGroup R v) M
proof:
:= by
  refine isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule'
    (p := fun x : Σ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ ↦ Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {(x.2 : M)})
    (fun x ↦ (isCategoryOInt_of_le_span hv' hM hfd hab x.2.2 le_rfl).isSemisimpleModule hv' hvt hR)
    ?_
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro m _
  have hm : m ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ := hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  have hle : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ ≤ (⨆ x : Σ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ,
      Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {(x.2 : M)}).restrictScalars k :=
    iSup_le fun Λ y hy ↦
      Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ⟨Λ, ⟨y, hy⟩⟩ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self y)
  exact hle hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp_of_hasFiniteWeightsAbove
statement:
theorem exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp_of_hasFiniteWeightsAbove :
    ∃ (s : Set (Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M)) (Λ : s → Y →+ ℤ),
      (∀ j i, 0 ≤ Λ j (R.coroot i)) ∧
        Nonempty ((Π₀ j : s, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j)) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
proof:
:= by
  have := isSemisimpleModule_of_hasFiniteWeightsAbove hv' hM hfd hab hvt hR
  obtain ⟨s, e, -, hsimple⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp (QuantumGroup R v) M
  have key : ∀ m : s, ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) ∧
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule R v Λ ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] m.1) := fun m ↦ by
    have hs := hsimple m
    have hint := hM.submodule hv' m.1
    have hnt := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial (QuantumGroup R v) m.1
    obtain ⟨Λ₀, y, hy, hy0⟩ : ∃ Λ₀, ∃ y ∈ weightSpace R v m.1 Λ₀, y ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : m.1)
      have hz' : z ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v m.1 Λ :=
        hint.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top ▸ Submodule.mem_top
      have hbot : ∀ Λ, weightSpace R v m.1 Λ = ⊥ := fun Λ ↦
        eq_bot_iff.2 fun y hy ↦ (Submodule.mem_bot k).2 (h Λ y hy)
      simp only [hbot, iSup_bot] at hz'
      exact hz ((Submodule.mem_bot k).1 hz')
    have hle : Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {(y : M)} ≤ m.1 :=
      (Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).2 y.2
    have heq := ((isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.1 hs).le_iff.1 hle).resolve_left fun h ↦
      hy0 (Subtype.ext ((Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot).1 h))
    exact (isCategoryOInt_of_le_span hv' hM hfd hab (mem_weightSpace_submodule.1 hy)
      heq.ge).exists_nonempty_equiv_of_isSimpleModule hv' hvt hR
  choose Λ hΛ he using key
  exact ⟨s, Λ, hΛ, ⟨(DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun m ↦ (he m).some).trans e.symm⟩⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.root_ktilde

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.KHom_apply

proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.KHom_apply'
statement: lemma KHom_apply' (μ : Multiplicative Y) : KHom R v μ = mkAlgHom R v (genK k μ.toAdd)
proof: := rfl
