statement: @[simp] theorem K_zero : K R v 0 = 1
proof: := map_one (KHom R v)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_add
statement: theorem K_add (μ ν : Y) : K R v μ * K R v ν = K R v (μ + ν)
proof:
:=
  (map_mul (KHom R v) (.ofAdd μ) (.ofAdd ν)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_mul_K_neg
statement: theorem K_mul_K_neg (μ : Y) : K R v μ * K R v (-μ) = 1
proof: := by rw [K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_mul_K
statement: theorem K_neg_mul_K (μ : Y) : K R v (-μ) * K R v μ = 1
proof: := by rw [K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_comm
statement: theorem K_comm (μ ν : Y) : K R v μ * K R v ν = K R v ν * K R v μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [K_add, K_add, add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_mul_E
statement: theorem K_mul_E (μ : Y) (i : I) : K R v μ * E R v i = v ^ R.root i μ • (E R v i * K R v μ)
proof:
:= by
  change mkAlgHom R v (genK k μ) * mkAlgHom R v (genE k i) =
    v ^ R.root i μ • (mkAlgHom R v (genE k i) * mkAlgHom R v (genK k μ))
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_smul]
  exact RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel k (Rel.K_E μ i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_mul_F
statement:
theorem K_mul_F (μ : Y) (i : I) :
    K R v μ * F R v i = v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (F R v i * K R v μ)
proof:
:= by
  change mkAlgHom R v (genK k μ) * mkAlgHom R v (genF k i) =
    v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (mkAlgHom R v (genF k i) * mkAlgHom R v (genK k μ))
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_smul]
  exact RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel k (Rel.K_F μ i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_F_sub
statement:
theorem E_mul_F_sub (i j : I) : E R v i * F R v j - F R v j * E R v i = if i = j then
    (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel k (Rel.E_F (R := R) (v := v) i j)
  change mkAlgHom R v (genE k i) * mkAlgHom R v (genF k j) -
    mkAlgHom R v (genF k j) * mkAlgHom R v (genE k i) = if i = j then
    (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
      (mkAlgHom R v (genK k (ktilde R i)) - mkAlgHom R v (genK k (-ktilde R i))) else 0
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_sub]
  split_ifs at this ⊢
  · rw [← map_sub, ← map_smul]; exact this
  · rw [← map_zero (mkAlgHom R v)]; exact this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serre_E
statement:
theorem serre_E {i j : I} (h : i ≠ j) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (E R v i) (E R v j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change qSerre _ _ (mkAlgHom R v (genE k i)) (mkAlgHom R v (genE k j)) = 0
  rw [← map_qSerre, ← map_zero (mkAlgHom R v)]
  exact RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel k (Rel.serre_E i j h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serre_F
statement:
theorem serre_F {i j : I} (h : i ≠ j) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (F R v i) (F R v j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change qSerre _ _ (mkAlgHom R v (genF k i)) (mkAlgHom R v (genF k j)) = 0
  rw [← map_qSerre, ← map_zero (mkAlgHom R v)]
  exact RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel k (Rel.serre_F i j h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.relations
statement:
theorem relations : Relations R v (E R v) (F R v) (KHom R v) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= K_mul_E R v μ i
  K_mul_F μ i := K_mul_F R v μ i
  E_mul_F i j := E_mul_F_sub R v i j
  serre_E _ _ h := serre_E R v h
  serre_F _ _ h := serre_F R v h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {P : QuantumGroup R v → Prop} (x : QuantumGroup R v)
    (algebraMap : ∀ c, P (algebraMap k _ c)) (E : ∀ i, P (E R v i)) (F : ∀ i, P (F R v i))
    (K : ∀ μ, P (K R v μ)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (mul : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x * y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_surjective k (Rel R v) x
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes]; exact algebraMap c
  | grade1 g =>
    cases g with
    | E i => exact E i
    | F i => exact F i
    | K μ => exact K μ
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul]; exact mul _ _ ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_mkAlgHom
statement:
lemma lift_mkAlgHom (x : FreeAlgebra k (Generator I Y)) :
    lift h (mkAlgHom R v x) = freeLift e f κ x
proof:
:=
  RingQuot.liftAlgHom_mkAlgHom_apply k _ _ x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_E
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_E (i : I) : lift h (E R v i) = e i
proof:
:= by
  rw [E, lift_mkAlgHom]; simp [freeLift]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_F
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_F (i : I) : lift h (F R v i) = f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [F, lift_mkAlgHom]; simp [freeLift]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lift_K
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_K (μ : Y) : lift h (K R v μ) = κ (.ofAdd μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K, KHom_apply']; rw [lift_mkAlgHom]; simp [freeLift]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : QuantumGroup R v →ₐ[k] A} (hE : ∀ i, φ (E R v i) = ψ (E R v i))
    (hF : ∀ i, φ (F R v i) = ψ (F R v i)) (hK : ∀ μ, φ (K R v μ) = ψ (K R v μ)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine RingQuot.ringQuot_ext' k φ ψ (FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun g ↦ ?_))
  cases g with
  | E i => exact hE i
  | F i => exact hF i
  | K μ => exact hK μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_dot_mul
statement: lemma zpow_dot_mul (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) : (v ^ D.d i) * (v ^ D.d i) * v ^ (-D.dot i i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((D.d i + D.d i : ℕ) : ℤ) + -(2 * (D.d i : ℤ)) = 0 := by push_cast; ring
  rw [← D.two_mul_d i, ← pow_add, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ hv, h, zpow_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoE_mul_K
statement:
lemma rhoE_mul_K (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    rhoE R v i * K R v μ = v ^ R.root i μ • (K R v μ * rhoE R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoE, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, F_mul_K (NeZero.ne v), mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    K_comm, mul_assoc, smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoF_mul_K
statement:
lemma rhoF_mul_K (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    rhoF R v i * K R v μ = v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (K R v μ * rhoF R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoF, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, E_mul_K (NeZero.ne v), mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    K_comm, mul_assoc, smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoF_mul_rhoE_sub
statement:
lemma rhoF_mul_rhoE_sub (i j : I) :
    rhoF R v j * rhoE R v i - rhoE R v i * rhoF R v j = if i = j then
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have e1 : rhoF R v j * rhoE R v i = ((v ^ D.d j * v ^ D.d i) * v ^ (-D.dot i j)) •
      (K R v (-ktilde R j) * Kt R v i * (E R v j * F R v i)) := by
    rw [rhoF, rhoE, smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (E R v j), E_mul_K hv,
      root_ktilde_eq_dot]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  have e2 : rhoE R v i * rhoF R v j = ((v ^ D.d j * v ^ D.d i) * v ^ (-D.dot i j)) •
      (K R v (-ktilde R j) * Kt R v i * (F R v i * E R v j)) := by
    rw [rhoE, rhoF, smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (F R v i), F_mul_K hv,
      map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot, D.dot_comm j i]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    · ring
    · rw [← mul_assoc, K_comm, mul_assoc]
  rw [e1, e2, ← smul_sub, ← mul_sub, E_mul_F_sub]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    simp only [ite_true]
    rw [mul_smul_comm, K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero, one_mul, zpow_dot_mul hv, one_smul]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h), ite_eq_right h, mul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_relations
statement:
theorem rho_relations :
    Relations R v (fun i ↦ op (rhoE R v i)) (fun i ↦ op (rhoF R v i)) (rhoK R v) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [rhoK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, unop_mul, unop_op,
      unop_smul]
    exact rhoE_mul_K i μ
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [rhoK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, unop_mul, unop_op,
      unop_smul]
    exact rhoF_mul_K i μ
  E_mul_F i j := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [unop_sub, unop_mul, unop_op]
    rw [rhoF_mul_rhoE_sub]
    split_ifs
    · simp [rhoK, Kt]
    · simp
  serre_E i j hij := by
    have hv := NeZero.ne v
    rw [qSerre_op, rhoE, rhoE, qSerre_smul_smul,
      qSerre_mul_mul (t := v ^ (-R.root i (ktilde R i))) (s := v ^ R.root i (ktilde R j))
        (zpow_ne_zero _ hv) (K_mul_F R v _ i) (F_mul_K hv _ i)
        (by rw [F_mul_K hv, root_ktilde_eq_dot, root_ktilde_eq_dot, D.dot_comm]) (K_comm R v _ _),
      serre_F R v hij]
    simp
  serre_F i j hij := by
    have hv := NeZero.ne v
    rw [qSerre_op, rhoF, rhoF, qSerre_smul_smul,
      qSerre_mul_mul (t := v ^ R.root i (-ktilde R i)) (s := v ^ (-R.root i (-ktilde R j)))
        (zpow_ne_zero _ hv) (K_mul_E R v _ i) (E_mul_K hv _ i)
        (by rw [E_mul_K hv, map_neg, map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot, root_ktilde_eq_dot,
          D.dot_comm]) (K_comm R v _ _),
      serre_E R v hij]
    simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_E
statement: @[simp] lemma rho_E (i : I) : rho R v (E R v i) = rhoE R v i
proof: := by simp [rho, rhoOp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_F
statement: @[simp] lemma rho_F (i : I) : rho R v (F R v i) = rhoF R v i
proof: := by simp [rho, rhoOp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_K
statement: @[simp] lemma rho_K (μ : Y) : rho R v (K R v μ) = K R v μ
proof: := by simp [rho, rhoOp, rhoK]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] lemma rho_algebraMap (c : k) : rho R v (algebraMap k _ c) = algebraMap k _ c
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_mul
statement: theorem rho_mul (x y : QuantumGroup R v) : rho R v (x * y) = rho R v y * rho R v x
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_one
statement: @[simp] lemma rho_one : rho R v 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [rho]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_rhoE
statement: lemma rho_rhoE (i : I) : rho R v (rhoE R v i) = E R v i
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  rw [rhoE, map_smul, rho_mul, rho_F, rho_K, rhoF, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, E_mul_K hv,
    root_ktilde_eq_dot, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero, one_mul,
    smul_smul, smul_smul, zpow_dot_mul hv, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_rhoF
statement: lemma rho_rhoF (i : I) : rho R v (rhoF R v i) = F R v i
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  rw [rhoF, map_smul, rho_mul, rho_E, rho_K, rhoE, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, F_mul_K hv,
    map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero,
    one_mul, smul_smul, smul_smul, zpow_dot_mul hv, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_rho
statement: theorem rho_rho (x : QuantumGroup R v) : rho R v (rho R v x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | E i => rw [rho_E, rho_rhoE]
  | F i => rw [rho_F, rho_rhoF]
  | K μ => rw [rho_K, rho_K]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [rho_mul, rho_mul, hx, hy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isContravariant_of_generators
statement:
theorem isContravariant_of_generators {B : LinearMap.BilinForm k M}
    (hE : ∀ i x y, B (E R v i • x) y = B x (rhoE R v i • y))
    (hF : ∀ i x y, B (F R v i • x) y = B x (rhoF R v i • y))
    (hK : ∀ μ x y, B (K R v μ • x) y = B x (K R v μ • y)) : IsContravariant R v B
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => intro x y; simp [algebraMap_smul]
  | E i => intro x y; rw [rho_E]; exact hE i x y
  | F i => intro x y; rw [rho_F]; exact hF i x y
  | K μ => intro x y; rw [rho_K]; exact hK μ x y
  | add a b ha hb => intro x y; rw [add_smul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, map_add,
      add_smul, map_add]
  | mul a b ha hb => intro x y; rw [mul_smul, ha, hb, rho_mul, mul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsContravariant.eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem IsContravariant.eq_zero_of_ne {B : LinearMap.BilinForm k M} (hB : IsContravariant R v B)
    {Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : Λ ≠ Λ') {x y : M} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ)
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ') (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) : B x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := DFunLike.ne_iff.1 h
  have e := hB (K R v μ) x y
  rw [rho_K, hx μ, hy μ, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul] at e
  have hne : v ^ Λ μ ≠ v ^ Λ' μ := by
    intro he
    refine zpow_ne_one_of_not_root hv' (sub_ne_zero.2 hμ) ?_
    rw [zpow_sub₀ (NeZero.ne v), he, div_self (zpow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))]
  have : (v ^ Λ μ - v ^ Λ' μ) * B x y = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, e, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.2 hne)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapAux_apply
statement:
lemma shapAux_apply (u : QuantumGroup R v) (m : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    shapAux Λ hv' u m = hwCoord Λ hv' (rho R v u • m)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwCoord_F_smul
statement: lemma hwCoord_F_smul (i : I) (m : VermaModule R v Λ) : hwCoord Λ hv' (F R v i • m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minusHom_θ (R := R) (v := v) (k := k), hwCoord_minusHom_smul, LusztigF.counit_θ,
    zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwCoord_rhoE_smul
statement:
lemma hwCoord_rhoE_smul (i : I) (m : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    hwCoord Λ hv' (rhoE R v i • m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoE, smul_assoc, mul_smul, map_smul, hwCoord_K_smul, hwCoord_F_smul, mul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapAux_mul
statement:
lemma shapAux_mul (a b : QuantumGroup R v) (m : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    shapAux Λ hv' (a * b) m = shapAux Λ hv' b (rho R v a • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shapAux_apply, shapAux_apply, rho_mul, mul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapAux_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma shapAux_eq_zero_of_mem {z : QuantumGroup R v} (hz : z ∈ vermaIdeal R v Λ) :
    shapAux Λ hv' z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    rcases hz with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, rfl⟩
    · rw [shapAux_apply, rho_E, hwCoord_rhoE_smul, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    · rw [shapAux_apply, (rho R v).map_sub, rho_K, rho_algebraMap, sub_smul, algebraMap_smul,
        (hwCoord Λ hv').map_sub, hwCoord_K_smul, (hwCoord Λ hv').map_smul, smul_eq_mul, sub_self,
        LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul, shapAux_mul, hx, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapForm_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma shapForm_smul_hwv (u : QuantumGroup R v) (m : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    shapForm Λ hv' (u • hwv R v Λ) m = hwCoord Λ hv' (rho R v u • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_smul_hwv]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.isContravariant_shapForm
statement:
theorem isContravariant_shapForm :
    IsContravariant (M := VermaModule R v Λ) R v (shapForm Λ hv')
proof:
:= by
  intro u x y
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [mk_eq_smul_hwv, ← mul_smul, shapForm_smul_hwv, shapForm_smul_hwv, rho_mul, mul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.rho_minusHom_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma rho_minusHom_smul_hwv (y : LusztigF k I) :
    rho R v (minusHom R v y) • hwv R v Λ = LusztigF.counit y • hwv R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, rho_algebraMap, algebraMap_smul, LusztigF.counit_algebraMap]
  | grade1 i =>
    rw [minusHom_θ, rho_F, LusztigF.counit_θ, zero_smul, rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul,
      E_smul_hwv, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, rho_mul, mul_smul, ha, smul_comm, hb, smul_smul, map_mul, mul_comm]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, add_smul, ha, hb, map_add, add_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwCoord_rho_plusHom_smul
statement:
lemma hwCoord_rho_plusHom_smul (x : LusztigF k I) (m : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    hwCoord Λ hv' (rho R v (plusHom R v x) • m) = LusztigF.counit x * hwCoord Λ hv' m
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing m with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, rho_algebraMap, algebraMap_smul, map_smul, LusztigF.counit_algebraMap,
      smul_eq_mul]
  | grade1 i => rw [plusHom_θ, rho_E, hwCoord_rhoE_smul, LusztigF.counit_θ, zero_mul]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, rho_mul, mul_smul, hb, ha, map_mul]; ring
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, add_smul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, add_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwCoord_rho_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma hwCoord_rho_smul_hwv (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    hwCoord Λ hv' (rho R v u • hwv R v Λ) = hwCoord Λ hv' (u • hwv R v Λ)
proof:
:= by
  induction mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
    set y := LusztigF.monomial k w
    set x := LusztigF.monomial k w'
    have h1 : rho R v (minusHom R v y * K R v μ * plusHom R v x) • hwv R v Λ =
        rho R v (plusHom R v x) • ((LusztigF.counit y * v ^ Λ μ) • hwv R v Λ) := by
      rw [rho_mul, rho_mul, rho_K, mul_smul, mul_smul, rho_minusHom_smul_hwv,
        smul_comm (K R v μ) (LusztigF.counit y), K_smul_hwv, smul_smul]
    have h2 : (minusHom R v y * K R v μ * plusHom R v x) • hwv R v Λ =
        minusHom R v y • ((LusztigF.counit x * v ^ Λ μ) • hwv R v Λ) := by
      rw [mul_smul, mul_smul, plusHom_smul_hwv, smul_comm (K R v μ) (LusztigF.counit x),
        K_smul_hwv, smul_smul]
    rw [h1, h2, hwCoord_rho_plusHom_smul, hwCoord_minusHom_smul, (hwCoord Λ hv').map_smul,
      (hwCoord Λ hv').map_smul, hwCoord_hwv]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    rw [(rho R v).map_add, add_smul, (hwCoord Λ hv').map_add, hx, hy, add_smul,
      (hwCoord Λ hv').map_add]
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [(rho R v).map_smul, smul_assoc, (hwCoord Λ hv').map_smul, hx, smul_assoc,
      (hwCoord Λ hv').map_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapForm_comm
statement: theorem shapForm_comm (x y : VermaModule R v Λ) : shapForm Λ hv' x y = shapForm Λ hv' y x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  rw [mk_eq_smul_hwv, mk_eq_smul_hwv, shapForm_smul_hwv, shapForm_smul_hwv, ← mul_smul,
    ← mul_smul, ← hwCoord_rho_smul_hwv hv' (rho R v b * a), rho_mul, rho_rho]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapForm_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma shapForm_hwv : shapForm Λ hv' (hwv R v Λ) (hwv R v Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := shapForm_smul_hwv hv' (1 : QuantumGroup R v) (hwv R v Λ)
  rwa [one_smul, rho_one, one_smul, hwCoord_hwv] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapForm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem shapForm_eq_zero_iff (hR : R.IsXRegular) (x : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    (∀ y, shapForm Λ hv' x y = 0) ↔ x ∈ maxSubmodule R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_maxSubmodule_iff hR hv']
  refine ⟨fun h u ↦ ?_, fun h y ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := h (rho R v u • hwv R v Λ)
    rwa [shapForm_comm, shapForm_smul_hwv, rho_rho] at this
  · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
    rw [shapForm_comm, mk_eq_smul_hwv, shapForm_smul_hwv, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.eq_hwCoord_mul_of_isContravariant
proof:
:= by
  induction mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
    set y := LusztigF.monomial k w
    set x := LusztigF.monomial k w'
    have h2 : (minusHom R v y * K R v μ * plusHom R v x) • hwv R v Λ =
        minusHom R v y • ((LusztigF.counit x * v ^ Λ μ) • hwv R v Λ) := by
      rw [mul_smul, mul_smul, plusHom_smul_hwv, smul_comm (K R v μ) (LusztigF.counit x),
        K_smul_hwv, smul_smul]
    rw [h2, hB, rho_minusHom_smul_hwv]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hwCoord_minusHom_smul, hwCoord_hwv]
    ring
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    rw [add_smul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, (hwCoord Λ hv').map_add, add_mul]
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    rw [smul_assoc, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha, (hwCoord Λ hv').map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.eq_smul_shapForm_of_isContravariant
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  rw [mk_eq_smul_hwv, mk_eq_smul_hwv, hB, ← mul_smul, shapForm_smul_hwv, ← mul_smul]
  have : B (hwv R v Λ) ((rho R v a * b) • hwv R v Λ) =
      B ((rho R v (rho R v a * b)) • hwv R v Λ) (hwv R v Λ) := by
    rw [hB, rho_rho]
  rw [this, eq_hwCoord_mul_of_isContravariant hv' hB, hwCoord_rho_smul_hwv, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.shapForm_left_eq_zero
statement:
lemma shapForm_left_eq_zero {x : VermaModule R v Λ} (hx : x ∈ maxSubmodule R v Λ)
    (y : VermaModule R v Λ) : shapForm Λ hv' x y = 0
proof:
:=
  (shapForm_eq_zero_iff hv' hR x).2 hx y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.shapForm_right_eq_zero
statement:
lemma shapForm_right_eq_zero (x : VermaModule R v Λ) {y : VermaModule R v Λ}
    (hy : y ∈ maxSubmodule R v Λ) : shapForm Λ hv' x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [shapForm_comm]; exact shapForm_left_eq_zero hR hv' hy x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.form_mk
statement:
lemma form_mk (x y : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    form Λ hR hv' (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = shapForm Λ hv' x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [form]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form
statement: theorem isContravariant_form : IsContravariant R v (form Λ hR hv')
proof:
:= by
  intro u x y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, form_mk, form_mk,
    isContravariant_shapForm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.form_comm
statement: theorem form_comm (x y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ) : form Λ hR hv' x y = form Λ hR hv' y x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  rw [form_mk, form_mk, shapForm_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.form_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma form_hwv : form Λ hR hv' (hwv R v Λ) (hwv R v Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_mk, shapForm_hwv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.eq_zero_of_form_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_form_eq_zero {x : IrreducibleModule R v Λ}
    (h : ∀ y, form Λ hR hv' x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← shapForm_eq_zero_iff hv' hR]
  intro y
  rw [← form_mk hR hv']
  exact h _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.eq_smul_form_of_isContravariant
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  set π := (Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv k (maxSubmodule R v Λ)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    ((maxSubmodule R v Λ).restrictScalars k).mkQ
  have hπ : ∀ z, π z = Submodule.Quotient.mk z := fun z ↦ rfl
  have hB' : IsContravariant R v (B.compl₁₂ π π) := by
    intro u a b
    simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, hπ, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
    exact hB u _ _
  have := VermaModule.eq_smul_shapForm_of_isContravariant hv' hB' x y
  simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, hπ] at this
  rw [this, form_mk]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.form_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma form_tmul (B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm k M₁) (B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm k M₂)
    (x x' : M₁) (y y' : M₂) :
    form B₁ B₂ (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ y)) (mk M₁ M₂ (x' ⊗ₜ y')) = B₁ x x' * B₂ y y'
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib k k (B₁ ⊗ₜ B₂) (x ⊗ₜ y) (x' ⊗ₜ y') = _
  rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.form_comm
proof:
:= by
  have := LinearMap.IsSymm.tmul (B₁ := B₁) (B₂ := B₂) ⟨fun x x' ↦ h₁ x x'⟩ ⟨fun y y' ↦ h₂ y y'⟩
  exact this.eq z z'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.form_smul_eq_of_tmul
statement:
lemma form_smul_eq_of_tmul {B : LinearMap.BilinForm k (TensorModule k M₁ M₂)}
    (u u' : QuantumGroup R v)
    (h : ∀ x y x' y', B (u • mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ y)) (mk M₁ M₂ (x' ⊗ₜ y')) =
      B (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ y)) (u' • mk M₁ M₂ (x' ⊗ₜ y'))) (z z' : TensorModule k M₁ M₂) :
    B (u • z) z' = B z (u' • z')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (mk M₁ M₂).surjective z
  obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := (mk M₁ M₂).surjective z'
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, smul_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, map_add,
      LinearMap.add_apply]
  | tmul x y =>
    induction z' using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, smul_add, map_add]
    | tmul x' y' => exact h x y x' y'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.isContravariant_form
proof:
:= by
  refine isContravariant_of_generators (fun i ↦ form_smul_eq_of_tmul _ _ fun x y x' y' ↦ ?_)
    (fun i ↦ form_smul_eq_of_tmul _ _ fun x y x' y' ↦ ?_)
    (fun μ ↦ form_smul_eq_of_tmul _ _ fun x y x' y' ↦ ?_)
  · simp only [rhoE, smul_assoc, mul_smul, E_smul_tmul, F_smul_tmul, K_smul_tmul, map_add,
      smul_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, form_tmul, smul_eq_mul,
      h₁ (E R v i), h₂ (E R v i), h₁ (Kt R v i), rho_E, rho_K]
    rw [← mul_smul (Kt R v i) (K R v (-ktilde R i)), K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_smul]
    ring
  · simp only [rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul, E_smul_tmul, F_smul_tmul, K_smul_tmul, map_add,
      smul_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, form_tmul, smul_eq_mul,
      h₁ (F R v i), h₂ (F R v i), h₂ (K R v (-ktilde R i)), rho_F, rho_K]
    rw [← mul_smul (K R v (-ktilde R i)) (Kt R v i), K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero, one_smul]
    ring
  · simp only [K_smul_tmul, form_tmul, h₁ (K R v μ), h₂ (K R v μ), rho_K]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_tmul_left
statement:
lemma qSerre_tmul_left (ν : k) (M : ℕ) {g h : A} (hgh : Commute g h) (a b : B) :
    qSerre ν M (g ⊗ₜ[k] a) (h ⊗ₜ[k] b) = (g ^ M * h) ⊗ₜ qSerre ν M a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    TensorProduct.tmul_sum, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ M := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  rw [mul_assoc, ← (hgh.pow_left r).eq, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_tmul_right
statement:
lemma qSerre_tmul_right (ν : k) (M : ℕ) {g h : B} (hgh : Commute g h) (a b : A) :
    qSerre ν M (a ⊗ₜ[k] g) (b ⊗ₜ[k] h) = qSerre ν M a b ⊗ₜ (g ^ M * h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    TensorProduct.sum_tmul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ M := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  rw [mul_assoc (g ^ (M - r)), ← (hgh.pow_left r).eq, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_K
statement:
lemma E_mul_K (hv : v ≠ 0) (μ : Y) (i : I) :
    E R v i * K R v μ = v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (K R v μ * E R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K_mul_E, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ hv, neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_mul_K
statement:
lemma F_mul_K (hv : v ≠ 0) (μ : Y) (i : I) :
    F R v i * K R v μ = v ^ R.root i μ • (K R v μ * F R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K_mul_F, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ hv, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_root_ktilde_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hA := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix).offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have ha : D.cartanMatrix i j = -(m : ℤ) := by omega
  have := hv
  rw [root_ktilde, ha, show (D.d i : ℤ) * -(m : ℤ) = -((D.d i * m : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
    zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, pow_mul, inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_root_ktilde_self
statement: lemma zpow_root_ktilde_self (i : I) : v ^ R.root i (ktilde R i) = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self, show (D.d i : ℤ) * 2 = ((D.d i * 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) by
    push_cast; ring, zpow_natCast, pow_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_relations
statement:
theorem comul_relations (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Relations R v (comulE R v) (comulF R v) (KHom₂ R v) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    simp only [KHom₂, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, comulE, mul_add, add_mul,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, K_mul_E, smul_add]
    rw [K_comm, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    simp only [KHom₂, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, comulF, mul_add, add_mul,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul, mul_one, K_mul_F, smul_add]
    rw [K_comm R v μ (-ktilde R i), TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  E_mul_F i j := by
    have hcross : (Kt R v i * F R v j) ⊗ₜ (E R v i * K R v (-ktilde R j)) =
        (F R v j * Kt R v i) ⊗ₜ[k] (K R v (-ktilde R j) * E R v i) := by
      rw [K_mul_F, E_mul_K hv, ← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ hv, map_neg,
        neg_neg, root_ktilde_comm R i j, neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]
    have hdiff : comulE R v i * comulF R v j - comulF R v j * comulE R v i =
        (E R v i * F R v j - F R v j * E R v i) ⊗ₜ K R v (-ktilde R j) +
          Kt R v i ⊗ₜ (E R v i * F R v j - F R v j * E R v i) := by
      simp only [comulE, comulF, mul_add, add_mul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one,
        one_mul, sub_tmul, tmul_sub, hcross]
      abel
    rw [hdiff, E_mul_F_sub]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      rw [← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, ← smul_add]
      congr 1
      simp only [KHom₂, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, Kt, sub_tmul, tmul_sub]
      abel
    · simp
  serre_E i j hij := by
    have hA := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix).offDiag_nonpos i j hij
    set m := (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat
    have hM : (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = m + 1 := by omega
    have hν : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
    rw [hM]
    have hwu : Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i * E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) =
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 • (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) * Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) := by
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, Kt, K_mul_E,
        zpow_root_ktilde_self, smul_tmul']
    have hb : Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i * E R v j ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) =
        (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m • (E R v j ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) * Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) := by
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, Kt, K_mul_E,
        zpow_root_ktilde_eq hv hij hM, smul_tmul']
    have hb' : E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) * Kt R v j ⊗ₜ[k] E R v j =
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ m • (Kt R v j ⊗ₜ[k] E R v j * E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) := by
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, Kt, K_mul_E,
        root_ktilde_comm R j i, zpow_root_ktilde_eq hv hij hM, smul_tmul', smul_smul, ← mul_pow,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hν, one_pow, one_smul]
    rw [comulE, comulE, qSerre_add hν hwu hb hb', qSerre_tmul_right _ _ (Commute.one_left 1),
      qSerre_tmul_left _ _ (K_comm R v _ _), ← hM, serre_E R v hij, zero_tmul, tmul_zero,
      add_zero]
  serre_F i j hij := by
    have hA := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix).offDiag_nonpos i j hij
    set m := (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat
    have hM : (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = m + 1 := by omega
    have hν : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
    rw [hM]
    have hwu : F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R i) * (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v i =
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 •
          ((1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v i * F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, K_mul_F, map_neg,
        neg_neg, zpow_root_ktilde_self, tmul_smul]
    have hb : F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R i) * (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v j =
        (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m •
          ((1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v j * F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, K_mul_F, map_neg,
        neg_neg, zpow_root_ktilde_eq hv hij hM, tmul_smul]
    have hb' : (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v i * F R v j ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R j) =
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ m •
          (F R v j ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R j) * (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v i) := by
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, K_mul_F, map_neg,
        neg_neg, root_ktilde_comm R j i, zpow_root_ktilde_eq hv hij hM, tmul_smul, smul_smul,
        ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hν, one_pow, one_smul]
    rw [comulF, comulF, add_comm (F R v i ⊗ₜ _), add_comm (F R v j ⊗ₜ _),
      qSerre_add hν hwu hb hb', qSerre_tmul_left _ _ (Commute.one_left 1),
      qSerre_tmul_right _ _ (K_comm R v _ _), ← hM, serre_F R v hij, zero_tmul, tmul_zero,
      add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_E
statement: @[simp] theorem comul_E (i : I) : comul R v (E R v i) = E R v i ⊗ₜ 1 + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ E R v i
proof:
:= by
  simp [comul, comulE]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_F
statement:
@[simp] theorem comul_F (i : I) :
    comul R v (F R v i) = F R v i ⊗ₜ K R v (-ktilde R i) + 1 ⊗ₜ F R v i
proof:
:= by
  simp [comul, comulF]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_K
statement: @[simp] theorem comul_K (μ : Y) : comul R v (K R v μ) = K R v μ ⊗ₜ K R v μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [comul, KHom₂]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_relations
statement:
theorem counit_relations :
    Relations R v (0 : I → k) (0 : I → k) (1 : Multiplicative Y →* k) where
  K_mul_E _ _
proof:
:= by simp
  K_mul_F _ _ := by simp
  E_mul_F i j := by split_ifs <;> simp
  serre_E _ _ _ := by simp
  serre_F _ _ _ := by simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_E
statement: @[simp] theorem counit_E (i : I) : counit R v (E R v i) = 0
proof: := by simp [counit]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_F
statement: @[simp] theorem counit_F (i : I) : counit R v (F R v i) = 0
proof: := by simp [counit]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_K
statement: @[simp] theorem counit_K (μ : Y) : counit R v (K R v μ) = 1
proof: := by simp [counit]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_coassoc
statement:
theorem comul_coassoc :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc k k k (QuantumGroup R v) (QuantumGroup R v)
      (QuantumGroup R v)).toAlgHom.comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (comul R v) (.id k _)).comp (comul R v)) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id k _) (comul R v)).comp (comul R v)
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> simp [add_tmul, tmul_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, add_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_rTensor_comul
statement:
theorem counit_rTensor_comul :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (counit R v) (.id k _)).comp (comul R v) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid k (QuantumGroup R v)).symm
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_lTensor_comul
statement:
theorem counit_lTensor_comul :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id k _) (counit R v)).comp (comul R v) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k (QuantumGroup R v)).symm
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_relations
statement:
theorem antipode_relations (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Relations R v (fun i ↦ op (-(K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i)))
      (fun i ↦ op (-(F R v i * Kt R v i))) (antipodeK R v) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [antipodeK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, unop_mul, unop_op,
      unop_smul, neg_mul, mul_neg, smul_neg, neg_inj]
    rw [mul_assoc, E_mul_K hv, map_neg, neg_neg, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
      K_comm]
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [antipodeK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, unop_mul, unop_op,
      unop_smul, neg_mul, mul_neg, smul_neg, neg_inj]
    rw [← mul_assoc, K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ hv,
      neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_comm]
  E_mul_F i j := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [antipodeK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, unop_mul, unop_op,
      unop_sub, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg]
    
    have hEF := E_mul_F_sub R v i j
    have h1 : F R v j * Kt R v j * (K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i) =
        v ^ (R.root i (ktilde R j) - R.root i (ktilde R i)) •
          (F R v j * E R v i * K R v (ktilde R j - ktilde R i)) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (Kt R v j), K_add, K_mul_E, map_add, map_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg,
        ← sub_eq_add_neg, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
    have h2 : K R v (-ktilde R i) * (F R v j * E R v i) * Kt R v j =
        v ^ (R.root i (ktilde R j) - R.root i (ktilde R i)) •
          (F R v j * E R v i * K R v (ktilde R j - ktilde R i)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, K_mul_F, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_mul_E, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul,
        smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_add, map_neg, map_neg, neg_neg, ← mul_assoc,
        ← zpow_add₀ hv, root_ktilde_comm R i j, sub_eq_add_neg (ktilde R j), add_comm (-ktilde R i),
        ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    have h3 : K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i * (F R v j * Kt R v j) =
        K R v (-ktilde R i) * (F R v j * E R v i) * Kt R v j +
          K R v (-ktilde R i) * (E R v i * F R v j - F R v j * E R v i) * Kt R v j := by
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc]; abel
    rw [h3, h1, h2, hEF, sub_add_cancel_left]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      have e1 : K R v (-ktilde R i) * Kt R v i * Kt R v i = Kt R v i := by
        rw [K_add, K_add]; congr 1; abel
      have e2 : K R v (-ktilde R i) * K R v (-ktilde R i) * Kt R v i = K R v (-ktilde R i) := by
        rw [K_add, K_add]; congr 1; abel
      simp only [unop_smul, unop_sub, unop_op]
      rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, sub_mul, e1, e2, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]
    · simp
  serre_E i j hij := by
    rw [qSerre_op, ← neg_mul, ← neg_mul]
    rw [qSerre_mul_mul (t := v ^ R.root i (-ktilde R i)) (s := v ^ R.root i (ktilde R j))
      (zpow_ne_zero _ hv), serre_E R v hij, mul_zero, smul_zero, op_zero, smul_zero]
    · rw [neg_mul, mul_neg, K_mul_E, smul_neg]
    · rw [neg_mul, mul_neg, E_mul_K hv, smul_neg, map_neg, neg_neg]
    · rw [neg_mul, mul_neg, E_mul_K hv, smul_neg, map_neg, neg_neg, root_ktilde_comm R i j]
    · rw [neg_mul_neg, neg_mul_neg, K_comm]
  serre_F i j hij := by
    have hop : ∀ l, op (-(F R v l * Kt R v l)) = op (-Kt R v l) * op (F R v l) := fun l ↦ by
      rw [← op_mul, mul_neg]
    rw [hop, hop, qSerre_mul_mul (t := v ^ R.root i (ktilde R i))
      (s := v ^ (-R.root i (ktilde R j))) (zpow_ne_zero _ hv), qSerre_op, serre_F R v hij,
      op_zero, smul_zero, mul_zero, smul_zero]
    · apply unop_injective
      simp only [unop_mul, unop_op, unop_smul, neg_mul, mul_neg, smul_neg, neg_inj]
      rw [F_mul_K hv]
    · apply unop_injective
      simp only [unop_mul, unop_op, unop_smul, neg_mul, mul_neg, smul_neg, neg_inj]
      rw [K_mul_F]
    · apply unop_injective
      simp only [unop_mul, unop_op, unop_smul, neg_mul, mul_neg, smul_neg, neg_inj]
      rw [K_mul_F, root_ktilde_comm R j i]
    · rw [← op_mul, ← op_mul, neg_mul_neg, neg_mul_neg, K_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_apply
statement: lemma antipode_apply (x : QuantumGroup R v) : antipode R v x = unop (antipodeOp R v x)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_E
statement:
@[simp] theorem antipode_E (i : I) :
    antipode R v (E R v i) = -(K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [antipode_apply, antipodeOp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_F
statement: @[simp] theorem antipode_F (i : I) : antipode R v (F R v i) = -(F R v i * Kt R v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [antipode_apply, antipodeOp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_K
statement: @[simp] theorem antipode_K (μ : Y) : antipode R v (K R v μ) = K R v (-μ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [antipode_apply, antipodeOp, antipodeK]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_one
statement: @[simp] theorem antipode_one : antipode R v 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [antipode_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem antipode_algebraMap (c : k) :
    antipode R v (algebraMap k _ c) = algebraMap k _ c
proof:
:= by
  simp [antipode_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipode_mul
statement:
theorem antipode_mul (x y : QuantumGroup R v) :
    antipode R v (x * y) = antipode R v y * antipode R v x
proof:
:= by
  simp [antipode_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul'_rTensor_antipode_mul
statement:
lemma mul'_rTensor_antipode_mul (X Y : QuantumGroup R v ⊗[k] QuantumGroup R v) :
    LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).rTensor _ (X * Y)) =
      antipodeConjLeft R v Y (LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).rTensor _ X))
proof:
:= by
  induction X with
  | tmul x x' =>
    induction Y with
    | tmul y y' =>
      simp [antipodeConjLeft, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, antipode_mul, mul_assoc]
    | add Y Y' hY hY' => simp only [mul_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hY, hY']
  | add X X' hX hX' => simp only [add_mul, map_add, hX, hX']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul'_lTensor_antipode_mul
statement:
lemma mul'_lTensor_antipode_mul (X Y : QuantumGroup R v ⊗[k] QuantumGroup R v) :
    LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).lTensor _ (X * Y)) =
      antipodeConjRight R v X (LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).lTensor _ Y))
proof:
:= by
  induction X with
  | tmul x x' =>
    induction Y with
    | tmul y y' =>
      simp [antipodeConjRight, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, antipode_mul, mul_assoc]
    | add Y Y' hY hY' => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hY, hY']
  | add X X' hX hX' => simp only [add_mul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hX, hX']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipodeConjLeft_one
statement:
lemma antipodeConjLeft_one (Y : QuantumGroup R v ⊗[k] QuantumGroup R v) :
    antipodeConjLeft R v Y 1 = LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).rTensor _ Y)
proof:
:= by
  induction Y with
  | tmul y y' => simp [antipodeConjLeft]
  | add Y Y' hY hY' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hY, hY']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.antipodeConjRight_one
statement:
lemma antipodeConjRight_one (X : QuantumGroup R v ⊗[k] QuantumGroup R v) :
    antipodeConjRight R v X 1 = LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).lTensor _ X)
proof:
:= by
  induction X with
  | tmul x x' => simp [antipodeConjRight]
  | add X X' hX hX' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hX, hX']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul'_rTensor_antipode_comul
statement:
theorem mul'_rTensor_antipode_comul (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).rTensor _ (comul R v x)) =
      algebraMap k _ (counit R v x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | algebraMap c =>
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  | E i => simp [neg_add_cancel]
  | F i =>
    simp only [comul_F, map_add, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, antipode_F, antipode_one,
      LinearMap.mul'_apply, counit_F, map_zero, one_mul]
    rw [neg_mul, mul_assoc, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, mul_one, neg_add_cancel]
  | K μ => simp [K_add]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_mul, mul'_rTensor_antipode_mul, hx, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul,
      antipodeConjLeft_one, hy, map_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul'_lTensor_antipode_comul
statement:
theorem mul'_lTensor_antipode_comul (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    LinearMap.mul' k _ ((antipode R v).lTensor _ (comul R v x)) =
      algebraMap k _ (counit R v x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | algebraMap c =>
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  | E i =>
    simp only [comul_E, map_add, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, antipode_E, antipode_one,
      LinearMap.mul'_apply, counit_E, map_zero, mul_one]
    rw [mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul, add_neg_cancel]
  | F i => simp
  | K μ => simp [K_add]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_mul, mul'_lTensor_antipode_mul, hy, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul,
      antipodeConjRight_one, hx, map_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Kt_mul_F
statement:
lemma Kt_mul_F (i : I) :
    Kt R v i * F R v i = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (F R v i * Kt R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kt, K_mul_F, zpow_neg, zpow_root_ktilde_self, inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_ktilde_mul_F
statement:
lemma K_neg_ktilde_mul_F (i : I) :
    K R v (-ktilde R i) * F R v i = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 • (F R v i * K R v (-ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg, zpow_root_ktilde_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_F_of_ne
statement: lemma E_mul_F_of_ne {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) : E R v i * F R v j = F R v j * E R v i
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hij, sub_eq_zero] using E_mul_F_sub R v i j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_aux_inv
statement:
lemma qInt_aux_inv {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (c : k) (n : ℕ) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * c * q⁻¹ ^ n * q⁻¹ ^ 2 + c = qInt q (n + 1 + 1) * c * q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (n + 1) = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
  rw [qInt_succ (v := q) (n + 1)]
  linear_combination (-c) * h3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_aux
statement:
lemma qInt_aux {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (c : k) (n : ℕ) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * c * q ^ n * q ^ 2 + c = qInt q (n + 1 + 1) * c * q ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (n + 1) = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
  have h2 := qInt_mul_sub (v := q) (n + 1)
  rw [qInt_succ (v := q) (n + 1)]
  linear_combination (c * q ^ (n + 1)) * h2 - c * h3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_F_pow_sub
statement:
theorem E_mul_F_pow_sub (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    E R v i * F R v i ^ (n + 1) - F R v i ^ (n + 1) * E R v i =
      (qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹) •
        (F R v i ^ n * ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ n • Kt R v i - (v ^ D.d i) ^ n •
          K R v (-ktilde R i)))
proof:
:= by
  set q := v ^ D.d i with hq
  set c := (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hEF : E R v i * F R v i - F R v i * E R v i = c • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    simp only [E_mul_F_sub, ↓reduceIte]; rfl
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hEF, qInt]
  | succ n ih =>
    set Kp := Kt R v i
    set Km := K R v (-ktilde R i)
    set Fi := F R v i
    have e1 : E R v i * Fi ^ (n + 1 + 1) - Fi ^ (n + 1 + 1) * E R v i =
        (E R v i * Fi ^ (n + 1) - Fi ^ (n + 1) * E R v i) * Fi +
          Fi ^ (n + 1) * (E R v i * Fi - Fi * E R v i) := by
      rw [pow_succ Fi (n + 1)]; noncomm_ring
    have hp : Fi ^ n * Kp * Fi = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (Fi ^ (n + 1) * Kp) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, Kt_mul_F, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
    have hm : Fi ^ n * Km * Fi = q ^ 2 • (Fi ^ (n + 1) * Km) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, K_neg_ktilde_mul_F, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
    have lhs : E R v i * Fi ^ (n + 1 + 1) - Fi ^ (n + 1 + 1) * E R v i =
        (qInt q (n + 1) * c * q⁻¹ ^ n * q⁻¹ ^ 2 + c) • (Fi ^ (n + 1) * Kp) -
          (qInt q (n + 1) * c * q ^ n * q ^ 2 + c) • (Fi ^ (n + 1) * Km) := by
      rw [e1, ih, hEF]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub]
      rw [hp, hm]
      module
    rw [lhs, qInt_aux_inv hq0, qInt_aux hq0]
    simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub
statement:
theorem E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) (n : ℕ) (hn : qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) ≠ 0) :
    E R v i * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) (F R v i) -
        qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) (F R v i) * E R v i =
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i) *
        ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ n • Kt R v i - (v ^ D.d i) ^ n • K R v (-ktilde R i)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qDivPow, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← smul_sub]
  rw [E_mul_F_pow_sub hv, smul_smul, smul_smul, qFactorial_succ, mul_inv]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_F_pow_smul
statement:
theorem E_smul_F_pow_smul (hv : v ≠ 0) {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ)
    {i : I} (hE : E R v i • m = 0) (s : ℕ) :
    E R v i • (F R v i ^ (s + 1) • m) =
      (qInt (v ^ D.d i) (s + 1) * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ *
        ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ s * (v ^ D.d i) ^ Λ (R.coroot i) -
          (v ^ D.d i) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-Λ (R.coroot i)))) • (F R v i ^ s • m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := E_mul_F_pow_sub (R := R) hv i s
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h
  have hK : ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ s • Kt R v i - (v ^ D.d i) ^ s • K R v (-ktilde R i)) • m =
      ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ s * (v ^ D.d i) ^ Λ (R.coroot i) -
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-Λ (R.coroot i))) • m := by
    rw [sub_smul, smul_assoc, smul_assoc, Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hm,
      K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hm, smul_smul, smul_smul, sub_smul]
  rw [← mul_smul, h, add_smul, mul_smul (F R v i ^ (s + 1)), hE, smul_zero, add_zero,
    smul_assoc, mul_smul (F R v i ^ s), hK, smul_comm (F R v i ^ s), smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_F_pow_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · subst hij
    rw [E_smul_F_pow_smul hv hm (hE j), hn]
    have hq : v ^ D.d j ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
    have : (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ^ n * (v ^ D.d j) ^ (n : ℤ) -
        (v ^ D.d j) ^ n * (v ^ D.d j) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) = 0 := by
      rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_pow]; field_simp; ring
    rw [this, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  · rw [← mul_smul, ((Commute.pow_right (E_mul_F_of_ne hij) (n + 1))).eq, mul_smul, hE,
      smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dE_eq_zero_of_E_dE
statement:
theorem dE_eq_zero_of_E_dE {n : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ V.wt n) {b : ℕ} (hnb : n + b < 0)
    (hE : V.E (V.dE b x) = 0) : V.dE b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, η, hη, hη0, hN, rfl⟩ := exists_sum_dF hq0 hq hx
  
  have key : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ θ : M, θ ∈ V.prim (n + 2 * b + 2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
      V.dE b (V.dF (b + 1 + j) (η (b + 1 + j))) = V.dF (j + 1) θ := by
    intro j
    by_cases h0 : η (b + 1 + j) = 0
    · exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, by simp [h0]⟩
    have hnj := hη0 _ h0
    push_cast at hnj
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) = n + 2 * ((b + 1 + j : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
      ⟨_, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by push_cast; omega)⟩
    have hηp : η (b + 1 + j) ∈ V.prim p := by rw [hp]; exact hη _
    refine ⟨qBinomial q (p - (b + 1 + j) + b) b • η (b + 1 + j), ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      convert hη (b + 1 + j) using 2
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hηp.1 hηp.2 (by omega) (by push_cast at hp; omega),
        map_smul, show b + 1 + j - b = j + 1 by omega]
  choose θ hθ hθe using key
  have hsplit : ∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF j (η j) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (b + 1), V.dF j (η j) + ∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF (b + 1 + j) (η (b + 1 + j)) := by
    rw [← sum_range_add]
    refine sum_subset (fun j hj ↦ mem_range.2 (by have := mem_range.1 hj; omega))
      fun j _ hj ↦ ?_
    rw [hN j (by simpa using hj), map_zero]
  have hlow : ∑ j ∈ range (b + 1), V.dF j (η j) = 0 := by
    refine sum_eq_zero fun j hj ↦ ?_
    by_cases h0 : η j = 0
    · rw [h0, map_zero]
    · have := hη0 j h0
      have := mem_range.1 hj
      omega
  set y := V.dE b (∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF j (η j))
  have hy : y = ∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF (j + 1) (θ j) := by
    rw [show y = V.dE b (∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF j (η j)) from rfl, hsplit, hlow, zero_add, map_sum]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ hθe j
  set η' : ℕ → M := fun j ↦ Nat.casesOn j (-y) θ
  have hη' : ∀ j : ℕ, η' j ∈ V.prim (n + 2 * b + 2 * j) := by
    rintro (_ | j)
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
        exact neg_mem (dE_mem hx b)
      · change V.E (-y) = 0
        rw [map_neg, hE, neg_zero]
    · exact hθ j
  have hsum : ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1), V.dF j (η' j) = 0 := by
    rw [sum_range_succ']
    change ∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF (j + 1) (θ j) + V.dF 0 (-y) = 0
    rw [← hy, dF_zero, add_neg_cancel]
  have := dF_eq_zero_of_sum_range_eq_zero hq0 hq (N + 1) (n + 2 * b) η' hη' hsum 0
    (Nat.succ_pos N)
  have h0 : V.dF 0 (-y) = 0 := this
  rw [dF_zero, neg_eq_zero] at h0
  exact h0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.RhoDual.toDual_smul
statement:
lemma toDual_smul (u : QuantumGroup R v) (f : RhoDual R v M) (m : M) :
    toDual (u • f) m = toDual f (rho R v u • m)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.RhoDual.ext
statement: lemma ext {f g : RhoDual R v M} (h : ∀ m, toDual f m = toDual g m) : f = g
proof:
:=
  toDual.injective (LinearMap.ext h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_rhoF_pow_smul
statement:
lemma exists_rhoF_pow_smul {μ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M μ) (i : I)
    (n : ℕ) : ∃ c : k, rhoF R v i ^ n • m = c • (E R v i ^ n • m)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing μ m with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih (E_smul_mem_weightSpace hm i)
    have h1 : rhoF R v i • m =
        (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-((μ + R.root i) (R.coroot i)))) • E R v i • m := by
      rw [rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul,
        K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace (E_smul_mem_weightSpace hm i), smul_smul]
    refine ⟨(v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-((μ + R.root i) (R.coroot i)))) * c, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul, h1, smul_comm (rhoF R v i ^ n), hc, ← mul_smul (E R v i ^ n),
      ← pow_succ, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSpaceFunctional_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightSpaceFunctional_of_mem {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) :
    RhoDual.toDual (weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g) m = g ⟨m, hm⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightSpaceFunctional, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (weightSetProj_singleton_of_mem hv' hM hm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSpaceFunctional_of_ne
statement:
lemma weightSpaceFunctional_of_ne {Λ' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : Λ' ≠ Λ) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ') : RhoDual.toDual (weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [weightSpaceFunctional, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have : (weightSetProj hv' hM {Λ}).codRestrict _ (weightSetProj_singleton_mem hv' hM Λ) m =
      0 := Subtype.ext (by simp [weightSetProj_of_mem hv' hM _ hm, h])
  rw [this, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_smul_weightSpaceFunctional
statement:
lemma K_smul_weightSpaceFunctional (μ : Y) :
    K R v μ • weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g = v ^ Λ μ • weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g
proof:
:= by
  have := ext_weightSpace hM (f := RhoDual.toDual (K R v μ • weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g))
    (g := RhoDual.toDual (v ^ Λ μ • weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g)) fun Λ' m hm ↦ by
      rw [RhoDual.toDual_smul, rho_K, hm μ, map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
      by_cases h : Λ' = Λ
      · subst h; rfl
      · rw [weightSpaceFunctional_of_ne hv' hM g h hm, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  exact RhoDual.toDual.injective this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_weightSpaceFunctional
statement: lemma E_smul_weightSpaceFunctional (i : I) : E R v i • weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine RhoDual.toDual.injective (ext_weightSpace hM fun Λ' m hm ↦ ?_)
  rw [RhoDual.toDual_smul, rho_E, rhoE, smul_assoc, mul_smul, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hF := F_smul_mem_weightSpace hm i
  by_cases h : Λ' - R.root i = Λ
  · have : m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ + R.root i) := by rw [← h, sub_add_cancel]; exact hm
    rw [hmax i, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    simp [this]
  · rw [map_smul, Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hF, map_smul,
      weightSpaceFunctional_of_ne hv' hM g h hF, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_pow_smul_weightSpaceFunctional
statement:
lemma F_pow_smul_weightSpaceFunctional (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) (i : I) :
    F R v i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) • weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g = 0
proof:
:= by
  set b := (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1
  have rho_pow : ∀ (x : QuantumGroup R v) (n : ℕ), rho R v (x ^ n) = rho R v x ^ n := by
    intro x n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, rho_mul, ih, pow_succ']
  refine RhoDual.toDual.injective (ext_weightSpace hM fun Λ' m hm ↦ ?_)
  rw [RhoDual.toDual_smul, rho_pow, rho_F, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_rhoF_pow_smul hm i b
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv' hM i
  have hEb : E R v i ^ b • m = qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) b • V.dE b m := by
    rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_apply, smul_smul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) b),
      one_smul, nodeSl2_E, ← map_pow, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
  have hmem := nodeSl2_dE_mem_weightSpace hv' hM i hm b
  rw [hc, hEb, map_smul, map_smul]
  by_cases h : Λ' + (b : ℤ) • R.root i = Λ
  · have hroot : R.root i (R.coroot i) = 2 := by rw [R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self]
    have h0 : V.dE b m = 0 := by
      refine IntegrableSl2.dE_eq_zero_of_E_dE (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i)
        (mem_nodeWt_of_mem hm) (b := b) ?_ ?_
      · have := congrArg (fun μ : Y →+ ℤ ↦ μ (R.coroot i)) h
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, hroot, smul_eq_mul] at this
        have hb : (b : ℤ) = Λ (R.coroot i) + 1 := by
          simp only [b]; push_cast; rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hΛ i)]
        omega
      · rw [h] at hmem
        have := E_smul_mem_weightSpace hmem i
        rw [hmax i, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
        rw [nodeSl2_E]
        exact this
    rw [h0, map_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  · rw [weightSpaceFunctional_of_ne hv' hM g h hmem, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dualEmb_hwv
statement:
lemma dualEmb_hwv :
    dualEmb hv' hvt hR hM hΛ g hmax (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ) =
      weightSpaceFunctional hv' hM g
proof:
:=
  IrreducibleModule.liftOfFPow_hwv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isContravariantPairing_dualPairing
statement:
lemma isContravariantPairing_dualPairing :
    IsContravariantPairing R v (dualPairing hv' hvt hR hM hΛ g hmax)
proof:
:= fun u m x ↦ by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_dualProj
statement:
lemma form_dualProj (m : M) (x : IrreducibleModule R v Λ) :
    IrreducibleModule.form Λ hR hv' (dualProj hv' hvt hR hM hΛ g hmax m) x =

:=
