name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_map_eq_hwv_of_maximal
statement:
theorem exists_map_eq_hwv_of_maximal {w : M} (hw : w ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) ∧ ∃ π : M →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] IrreducibleModule R v Λ,
      π w = IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ∀ i, E R v i • w = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    have := E_smul_mem_weightSpace hw i
    rwa [hmax i, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  have hΛ := dominant_of_primitive hv' hM hw hw0 hE
  refine ⟨hΛ, ?_⟩
  have := IrreducibleModule.isSimpleModule hR hv' Λ
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one k (x := (⟨w, hw⟩ : weightSpace R v M Λ))
    (by simpa using hw0)
  set j := IrreducibleModule.lift hvt hR hv' hΛ hM w hw hE
  set P := dualProj hv' hvt hR hM hΛ g hmax
  have h1 : IrreducibleModule.form Λ hR hv' (P w) (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ) = 1 := by
    rw [form_dualProj, dualEmb_hwv, weightSpaceFunctional_of_mem hv' hM g hw, hg]
  have hne : P ∘ₗ j ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by
    have e := LinearMap.congr_fun h (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ)
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, IrreducibleModule.lift_hwv, LinearMap.zero_apply] at e
    rw [e, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1
  set e := LinearEquiv.ofBijective (P ∘ₗ j) (LinearMap.bijective_of_ne_zero hne)
  refine ⟨e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ P, ?_⟩
  have hjw : w = j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ) := (IrreducibleModule.lift_hwv ..).symm
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hjw]
  exact e.symm_apply_apply _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_isCompl_span_of_maximal
statement:
theorem exists_isCompl_span_of_maximal {w : M} (hw : w ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) ∧
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule R v Λ ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]
        Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w}) ∧
      ∃ N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M, IsCompl (Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w}) N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hΛ, π, hπ⟩ := exists_map_eq_hwv_of_maximal hv' hvt hR hM hmax hw hw0
  have hE : ∀ i, E R v i • w = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    have := E_smul_mem_weightSpace hw i
    rwa [hmax i, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  have := IrreducibleModule.isSimpleModule hR hv' Λ
  set j := IrreducibleModule.lift hvt hR hv' hΛ hM w hw hE
  have hjw : j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ) = w := IrreducibleModule.lift_hwv ..
  
  have htop : Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ} = ⊤ := by
    refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top _).resolve_left fun h ↦ hw0 ?_
    rw [Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.1 h, map_zero] at hjw
    exact hjw.symm
  have hπj : ∀ x, π (j x) = x := by
    have h : π ∘ₗ j = LinearMap.id := LinearMap.ext_on htop (by
      rintro _ rfl
      simp [hjw, hπ])
    exact fun x ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  have hrange : LinearMap.range j = Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w} := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← htop, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hjw]
  have hinj : Function.Injective j := fun x y h ↦ by rw [← hπj x, h, hπj]
  refine ⟨hΛ, ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofInjective j hinj).trans (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hrange)⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨LinearMap.ker (j.rangeRestrict ∘ₗ π), ?_⟩
  rw [← hrange]
  refine LinearMap.isCompl_of_proj fun ⟨x, y, hy⟩ ↦ ?_
  subst hy
  exact Subtype.ext (by simp [hπj])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_charHom_eq_one_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_charHom_eq_one_forall_eq_zero {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {t : Finset (Y →+ ℤ)} (hΛ : Λ ∉ t) :
    ∃ g, charHom v Λ g = 1 ∧ ∀ Λ' ∈ t, charHom v Λ' g = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1, map_one _, by simp⟩
  | insert a t _ ih =>
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, not_or] at hΛ
    obtain ⟨g, hg1, hg⟩ := ih hΛ.2
    obtain ⟨g', hg'1, hg'⟩ := exists_charHom_eq_one_eq_zero hv' hΛ.1
    refine ⟨g * g', by rw [map_mul, hg1, hg'1, one_mul], fun Λ' hΛ' ↦ ?_⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hΛ' with rfl | h
    · rw [map_mul, hg', mul_zero]
    · rw [map_mul, hg Λ' h, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zeroHom_smul_mem
statement:
lemma zeroHom_smul_mem {W : Submodule k M} (hW : ∀ μ, ∀ x ∈ W, K R v μ • x ∈ W)
    (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ W) : zeroHom R v g • x ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of μ =>
    change zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1) • x ∈ W
    rw [zeroHom_single]
    exact hW μ x hx
  | add f g hf hg => rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact W.add_mem hf hg
  | smul c f hf => rw [map_smul, smul_assoc]; exact W.smul_mem c hf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_zeroHom_smul_eq_weightSetProj
statement:
lemma exists_zeroHom_smul_eq_weightSetProj (x : M) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    ∃ g, zeroHom R v g • x = weightSetProj hv' hM {μ} x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ := hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset.1 hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg1, hg0⟩ := exists_charHom_eq_one_forall_eq_zero hv' (Finset.notMem_erase μ s)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have key : ⨆ Λ ∈ s, weightSpace R v M Λ ≤ LinearMap.eqLocus
      (Algebra.lsmul k k M (zeroHom R v g)) (weightSetProj hv' hM {μ}) := by
    refine iSup₂_le fun Λ hΛ m hm ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.mem_eqLocus, Algebra.lsmul_apply, zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hm,
      weightSetProj_of_mem hv' hM _ hm]
    by_cases h : Λ = μ
    · subst h
      simp [hg1]
    · rw [hg0 Λ (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨h, hΛ⟩), zero_smul]
      simp [h]
  exact key hs

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_iSup_inf_weightSpace
statement:
theorem mem_iSup_inf_weightSpace {W : Submodule k M} (hW : ∀ μ, ∀ x ∈ W, K R v μ • x ∈ W)
    {x : M} (hx : x ∈ W) : x ∈ ⨆ μ, W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ := hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset.1 hx'
  have key : ⨆ Λ ∈ s, weightSpace R v M Λ ≤
      LinearMap.eqLocus (∑ μ ∈ s, weightSetProj hv' hM {μ}) LinearMap.id := by
    refine iSup₂_le fun Λ hΛ m hm ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.mem_eqLocus, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    simp [weightSetProj_of_mem hv' hM _ hm, hΛ]
  have hsum := key hs
  rw [LinearMap.mem_eqLocus, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hsum
  rw [← hsum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun μ _ ↦ Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ
    ⟨?_, weightSetProj_singleton_mem hv' hM μ x⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_zeroHom_smul_eq_weightSetProj hv' hM x μ
  rw [← hg]
  exact zeroHom_smul_mem hW g hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_weightSpace_submodule
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpace_submodule {N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M} {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : N} :
    x ∈ weightSpace R v N Λ ↔ (x : M) ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_weightSpace, Subtype.ext_iff, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntegrable.submodule
statement:
theorem IsIntegrable.submodule (N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M) : IsIntegrable R v N where
  iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
proof:
:= by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    have hx := mem_iSup_inf_weightSpace hv' hM (W := N.restrictScalars k)
      (fun μ y hy ↦ N.smul_mem _ hy) x.2
    have hle : ⨆ μ, N.restrictScalars k ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ ≤
        (⨆ μ, weightSpace R v N μ).map (N.subtype.restrictScalars k) := by
      rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
      exact iSup_mono fun μ y hy ↦ ⟨⟨y, hy.1⟩, mem_weightSpace_submodule.2 hy.2, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := hle hx
    rwa [show z = x from Subtype.ext hzx] at hz
  exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i x
    exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext hn⟩
  exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM.exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i x
    exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext hn⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.submodule
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.submodule (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M)
    (N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M) : IsCategoryOInt R v N where
  isIntegrable
proof:
:= hM.isIntegrable.submodule hv' N
  finiteDimensional_weightSpace Λ := by
    have := hM.finiteDimensional_weightSpace Λ
    let f : weightSpace R v N Λ →ₗ[k] weightSpace R v M Λ :=
      { toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, mem_weightSpace_submodule.1 x.2⟩
        map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
        map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
    exact Module.Finite.of_injective f fun x y h ↦
      Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : weightSpace R v M Λ ↦ (z : M)) h))
  exists_finset := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
    refine ⟨s, fun Λ hΛ ↦ hs Λ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hΛ
    exact (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).2
      ⟨x, mem_weightSpace_submodule.1 hx, fun h ↦ hx0 (Subtype.ext h)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.exists_maximal_of_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
  have hinj : Function.Injective R.rootSum := fun ν ν' h ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR hne
    exact hμ (by rw [h])
  set S : Set ℕ := {n | ∃ ν : I →₀ ℕ, P (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν) ∧ ν.degree = n}
  have hbdd : BddAbove S := by
    refine ⟨∑ μ ∈ s, (if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ then h.choose.degree else 0), ?_⟩
    rintro n ⟨ν, hν, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨μ, hμs, ν', hν'⟩ := hs _ (hP _ hν)
    have hρ : R.rootSum (ν + ν') = μ - Λ₀ := by
      calc R.rootSum (ν + ν') = (Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν) + R.rootSum ν' - Λ₀ := by
            rw [R.rootSum_add]; abel
        _ = μ - Λ₀ := by rw [hν']; abel
    have hex : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ := ⟨_, hρ⟩
    have hch : hex.choose = ν + ν' := hinj (hex.choose_spec.trans hρ.symm)
    calc ν.degree ≤ (ν + ν').degree := by rw [map_add]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
      _ = (if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ then h.choose.degree else 0) := by
            simp only [hex, ↓reduceDIte, hch]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun μ ↦ if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ - Λ₀ then h.choose.degree else 0)
            (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hμs
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, 0, by simpa using h0, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hdeg⟩ := Nat.sSup_mem hne hbdd
  refine ⟨Λ₀ + R.rootSum ν, hν, fun ν' hν' hP' ↦ ?_⟩
  have hmem : (ν + ν').degree ∈ S := ⟨_, by rwa [R.rootSum_add, ← add_assoc], rfl⟩
  have hle := le_csSup hbdd hmem
  rw [map_add, hdeg] at hle
  have : ν'.degree ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hν' ((Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff ν').1 h)
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_le_iSup_weightSpace
statement:
theorem span_le_iSup_weightSpace (hE : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ W, E R v i • x ∈ W)
    (hW : W ≤ ⨆ μ, W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W : Set M)) :
    m ∈ ⨆ (μ) (_ : W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ ≠ ⊥) (ν : I →₀ ℕ),
      weightSpace R v M (μ - R.rootSum ν)
proof:
:= by
  set P : Submodule k M := ⨆ (μ) (_ : W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ ≠ ⊥) (ν : I →₀ ℕ),
    weightSpace R v M (μ - R.rootSum ν) with hPdef
  have hPF : ∀ i, ∀ m ∈ P, F R v i • m ∈ P := by
    intro i
    suffices P ≤ P.comap (Algebra.lsmul k k M (F R v i)) from fun m hm ↦ this hm
    refine iSup_le fun μ ↦ iSup_le fun hμ ↦ iSup_le fun ν m hm ↦ ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμ
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (ν + Finsupp.single i 1) ?_))
    have := F_smul_mem_weightSpace hm i
    rwa [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, ← sub_sub]
  have hPK : ∀ μ', ∀ m ∈ P, K R v μ' • m ∈ P := by
    intro μ'
    suffices P ≤ P.comap (Algebra.lsmul k k M (K R v μ')) from fun m hm ↦ this hm
    refine iSup_le fun μ ↦ iSup_le fun hμ ↦ iSup_le fun ν m hm ↦ ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμ
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν (K_smul_mem_weightSpace hm μ')))
  have hWP : W ≤ P := hW.trans (iSup_le fun μ ↦ by
    by_cases hμ : W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ = ⊥
    · rw [hμ]; exact bot_le
    · intro m hm
      refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμ
        (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 ?_))
      rw [R.rootSum_zero, sub_zero]
      exact hm.2)
  have hplus : ∀ x : LusztigF k I, ∀ m ∈ W, plusHom R v x • m ∈ W := by
    intro x
    induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c => intro m hm; rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul]; exact W.smul_mem c hm
    | grade1 i => intro m hm; rw [plusHom_θ]; exact hE i m hm
    | mul a b ha hb => intro m hm; rw [map_mul, mul_smul]; exact ha _ (hb m hm)
    | add a b ha hb => intro m hm; rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact W.add_mem (ha m hm) (hb m hm)
  have hminus : ∀ y : LusztigF k I, ∀ m ∈ P, minusHom R v y • m ∈ P := by
    intro y
    induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c => intro m hm; rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul]; exact P.smul_mem c hm
    | grade1 i => intro m hm; rw [minusHom_θ]; exact hPF i m hm
    | mul a b ha hb => intro m hm; rw [map_mul, mul_smul]; exact ha _ (hb m hm)
    | add a b ha hb => intro m hm; rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact P.add_mem (ha m hm) (hb m hm)
  have hU : ∀ u : QuantumGroup R v, ∀ m ∈ W, u • m ∈ P := by
    intro u m hm
    have hu : u ∈ Submodule.span k (triangularSet R v) := by
      change u ∈ triangularSpan R v
      rw [span_triangular (NeZero.ne v)]
      trivial
    induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem u hu =>
      obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
      rw [mul_smul, mul_smul]
      exact hminus _ _ (hPK μ _ (hWP (hplus _ m hm)))
    | zero => rw [zero_smul]; exact P.zero_mem
    | add u u' _ _ h h' => rw [add_smul]; exact P.add_mem h h'
    | smul c u _ h => rw [smul_assoc]; exact P.smul_mem c h
  let Q : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M :=
    { carrier := {m | ∀ u : QuantumGroup R v, u • m ∈ P}
      add_mem' := fun ha hb u ↦ by rw [smul_add]; exact P.add_mem (ha u) (hb u)
      zero_mem' := fun u ↦ by rw [smul_zero]; exact P.zero_mem
      smul_mem' := fun c m hm u ↦ by rw [smul_smul]; exact hm _ }
  have hWQ : Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W : Set M) ≤ Q :=
    Submodule.span_le.2 fun m hm u ↦ hU u m hm
  simpa using (hWQ hm : ∀ u : QuantumGroup R v, u • m ∈ P) 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_mem_span_of_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := span_le_iSup_weightSpace hE hW hm
  have h2 : (⨆ (μ) (_ : W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ ≠ ⊥) (ν : I →₀ ℕ),
      weightSpace R v M (μ - R.rootSum ν)) ≤ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ Λ), weightSpace R v M j :=
    iSup_le fun μ ↦ iSup_le fun hμ ↦ iSup_le fun ν ↦
      le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun j (_ : j ≠ Λ) ↦ weightSpace R v M j) _ (hΛ μ hμ ν) le_rfl
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_weightSpace hv' Λ) m hmΛ (h2 h1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.exists_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.exists_finiteDimensional (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M)
    (x : M) : ∃ W : Submodule k M, x ∈ W ∧ FiniteDimensional k W ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W, E R v i • y ∈ W) ∧ ∀ μ, ∀ y ∈ W, K R v μ • y ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
  have hinj : Function.Injective R.rootSum := fun ν ν' h ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR hne
    exact hμ (by rw [h])
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ :=
    hM.isIntegrable.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset.1 hx
  have hfin : ∀ μ : Y →+ ℤ, {ν : I →₀ ℕ | weightSpace R v M (μ + R.rootSum ν) ≠ ⊥}.Finite := by
    intro μ
    refine ((s : Set (Y →+ ℤ)).toFinite.biUnion fun μ' _ ↦
      ((antidiagonal (if h : ∃ ρ, R.rootSum ρ = μ' - μ then h.choose else 0)).image
        Prod.fst).finite_toSet).subset ?_
    intro ν hν
    obtain ⟨μ', hμ', ρ, hρ⟩ := hs _ hν
    have hσ : R.rootSum (ν + ρ) = μ' - μ := by
      rw [R.rootSum_add]
      calc R.rootSum ν + R.rootSum ρ = (μ + R.rootSum ν) + R.rootSum ρ - μ := by abel
        _ = μ' - μ := by rw [hρ]; abel
    have hex : ∃ σ, R.rootSum σ = μ' - μ := ⟨_, hσ⟩
    refine Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_coe.2 hμ') ?_
    refine Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(ν, ρ), mem_antidiagonal.2 ?_, rfl⟩)
    simp only [hex, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact (hinj (hex.choose_spec.trans hσ.symm)).symm
  have hfd : ∀ Λ, FiniteDimensional k (weightSpace R v M Λ) := hM.finiteDimensional_weightSpace
  set W : Submodule k M := ⨆ μ ∈ t, ⨆ ν : I →₀ ℕ, weightSpace R v M (μ + R.rootSum ν)
  refine ⟨W, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : ⨆ μ ∈ t, weightSpace R v M μ ≤ W := iSup₂_mono fun μ _ ↦ by
      refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup _ (0 : I →₀ ℕ))
      rw [R.rootSum_zero, add_zero]
    exact hle ht
  · have hle : W ≤ ⨆ (μ : t) (ν : (hfin μ).toFinset), weightSpace R v M (μ + R.rootSum ν) := by
      refine iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ iSup_le fun ν ↦ ?_
      by_cases h : weightSpace R v M (μ + R.rootSum ν) = ⊥
      · rw [h]; exact bot_le
      · exact le_iSup_of_le ⟨μ, hμ⟩ (le_iSup_of_le ⟨ν, (hfin μ).mem_toFinset.2 h⟩ le_rfl)
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le hle
  · intro i
    suffices W ≤ W.comap (Algebra.lsmul k k M (E R v i)) from fun y hy ↦ this hy
    refine iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ iSup_le fun ν y hy ↦ ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμ
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (ν + Finsupp.single i 1) ?_))
    have := E_smul_mem_weightSpace hy i
    rwa [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, ← add_assoc]
  · intro μ'
    suffices W ≤ W.comap (Algebra.lsmul k k M (K R v μ')) from fun y hy ↦ this hy
    refine iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ iSup_le fun ν y hy ↦ ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμ
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν (K_smul_mem_weightSpace hy μ')))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.isSemisimpleModule_span
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.isSemisimpleModule_span (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ W : Submodule k M, Module.finrank k W = n → FiniteDimensional k W →
      (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W, E R v i • y ∈ W) → (∀ μ, ∀ y ∈ W, K R v μ • y ∈ W) →
      IsSemisimpleModule (QuantumGroup R v) (Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W : Set M))
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro W hWn hWfd hE hK
  by_cases hW0 : W = ⊥
  · subst hW0
    have h : Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) ((⊥ : Submodule k M) : Set M) = ⊥ := by simp
    rw [h]
    exact IsSemisimpleModule.of_sSup_simples_eq_top (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  have hgr : W ≤ ⨆ μ, W ⊓ weightSpace R v M μ := fun y hy ↦
    mem_iSup_inf_weightSpace hv' hM.isIntegrable hK hy
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, hΛ₀⟩ : ∃ Λ₀, W ⊓ weightSpace R v M Λ₀ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra! h
    simp only [h, iSup_bot, le_bot_iff] at hgr
    exact hW0 hgr
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hmax⟩ := hM.exists_maximal_of_le hR
    (P := fun Λ ↦ W ⊓ weightSpace R v M Λ ≠ ⊥) (fun Λ h h' ↦ h (by rw [h', inf_bot_eq])) hΛ₀
  obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hw0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hΛ
  have hwW : w ∈ W := hwmem.1
  set S := Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W : Set M) with hS
  have hSint : IsIntegrable R v S := hM.isIntegrable.submodule hv' S
  have hSmax : ∀ i, weightSpace R v S (Λ + R.root i) = ⊥ := by
    intro i
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro y hy
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
    refine Subtype.ext (eq_zero_of_mem_span_of_mem_weightSpace hv' hE hgr ?_ y.2
      (mem_weightSpace_submodule.1 hy))
    intro μ hμ ν he
    have hν : ν + Finsupp.single i 1 ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by
      have := congrArg (fun f : I →₀ ℕ ↦ f i) h
      simp at this
    refine hmax _ hν ?_
    have : Λ + R.rootSum (ν + Finsupp.single i 1) = μ := by
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at he
      rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, he]
      abel
    rwa [this]
  set w' : S := ⟨w, Submodule.subset_span hwW⟩
  have hw' : w' ∈ weightSpace R v S Λ := mem_weightSpace_submodule.2 hwmem.2
  have hw'0 : w' ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hw0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨e⟩, N, hc⟩ := exists_isCompl_span_of_maximal hv' hvt hR hSint hSmax hw' hw'0
  have hL : IsSemisimpleModule (QuantumGroup R v) (Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w'}) := by
    have := IrreducibleModule.isSimpleModule hR hv' Λ
    exact IsSemisimpleModule.congr e.symm
  let p := Submodule.projectionOnto N (Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) {w'}) hc.symm
  let ψ : S →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M := S.subtype ∘ₗ N.subtype ∘ₗ p
  have hψN : ∀ y : N, ψ y = ((y : S) : M) := fun y ↦ by
    simp [ψ, p, Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_left]
  have hψw : ψ w' = 0 := by
    have : p w' = 0 :=
      Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_right hc.symm ⟨w', Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self w'⟩
    simp [ψ, this]
  let ι : W →ₗ[k] S :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ ⟨y, Submodule.subset_span y.2⟩
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  let g : W →ₗ[k] M := ψ.restrictScalars k ∘ₗ ι
  set W' := LinearMap.range g
  have hW'lt : Module.finrank k W' < n := by
    have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g
    have h2 : Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker g) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Submodule.finrank_eq_zero]
      intro h
      have hker : (⟨w, hwW⟩ : W) ∈ LinearMap.ker g := by
        rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
        exact hψw
      rw [h, Submodule.mem_bot] at hker
      exact hw0 (congrArg Subtype.val hker)
    change Module.finrank k W' + _ = _ at h1
    omega
  have hE' : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W', E R v i • y ∈ W' := by
    rintro i _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨E R v i • (y : M), hE i y y.2⟩, ?_⟩
    change ψ (ι _) = E R v i • ψ (ι y)
    rw [← map_smul]
    exact congrArg ψ (Subtype.ext rfl)
  have hK' : ∀ μ, ∀ y ∈ W', K R v μ • y ∈ W' := by
    rintro μ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨K R v μ • (y : M), hK μ y y.2⟩, ?_⟩
    change ψ (ι _) = K R v μ • ψ (ι y)
    rw [← map_smul]
    exact congrArg ψ (Subtype.ext rfl)
  have hIH := ih _ hW'lt W' rfl inferInstance hE' hK'
  have hrange : ∀ m : S, ψ m ∈ Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W' : Set M) := by
    intro m
    have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (((↑) : S → M) ⁻¹' (W : Set M)) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_span_coe_preimage]
      trivial
    induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem m hm => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul u a _ ha => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ u ha
  let χ : N →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W' : Set M) :=
    (ψ ∘ₗ N.subtype).codRestrict _ fun y ↦ hrange y
  have hχ : Function.Injective χ := by
    intro a b hab
    have h : ψ a = ψ b := by
      have := congrArg (fun z : Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W' : Set M) ↦ (z : M)) hab
      exact this
    rw [hψN, hψN] at h
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h)
  have hN : IsSemisimpleModule (QuantumGroup R v) N := .of_injective χ hχ
  have hsup := IsSemisimpleModule.sup hL hN
  rw [hc.sup_eq_top] at hsup
  exact IsSemisimpleModule.congr Submodule.topEquiv.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.isSemisimpleModule
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.isSemisimpleModule (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M) :
    IsSemisimpleModule (QuantumGroup R v) M
proof:
:= by
  choose W hxW hfd hE hK using hM.exists_finiteDimensional hR
  refine isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule'
    (p := fun x ↦ Submodule.span (QuantumGroup R v) (W x : Set M))
    (fun x ↦ hM.isSemisimpleModule_span hv' hvt hR _ (W x) rfl (hfd x) (hE x) (hK x)) ?_
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem x (Submodule.subset_span (hxW x))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCategoryOInt.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem IsCategoryOInt.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp (hM : IsCategoryOInt R v M) :
    ∃ (s : Set (Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M)) (Λ : s → Y →+ ℤ),
      (∀ j i, 0 ≤ Λ j (R.coroot i)) ∧
        Nonempty ((Π₀ j : s, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j)) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
proof:
:= by
  have := hM.isSemisimpleModule hv' hvt hR
  obtain ⟨s, e, -, hsimple⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp (QuantumGroup R v) M
  have key : ∀ m : s, ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) ∧
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule R v Λ ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] m.1) := fun m ↦ by
    have := hsimple m
    exact (hM.submodule hv' m.1).exists_nonempty_equiv_of_isSimpleModule hv' hvt hR
  choose Λ hΛ he using key
  exact ⟨s, Λ, hΛ, ⟨(DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun m ↦ (he m).some).trans e.symm⟩⟩

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_zero : R.rootSum 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [rootSum]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_add
statement: lemma rootSum_add (ν ν' : I →₀ ℕ) : R.rootSum (ν + ν') = R.rootSum ν + R.rootSum ν'
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _)

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_single
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_single (i : I) (n : ℕ) : R.rootSum (Finsupp.single i n) = n • R.root i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootSum]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.exists_rootSum_ne
statement:
theorem exists_rootSum_ne (hR : R.IsXRegular) {ν ν' : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ ν') :
    ∃ μ, R.rootSum ν μ ≠ R.rootSum ν' μ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have h0 : R.rootSum ν - R.rootSum ν' = 0 := AddMonoidHom.ext fun μ ↦ by simp [h μ]
  have key : ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ R.root
      (ν.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp)) = R.rootSum ν := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (by simp)]
    simp only [rootSum, natCast_zsmul]
  have h2 := linearIndependent_iff.1 hR (ν.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp) -
    ν'.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp)) (by rw [map_sub, key, key, h0])
  apply hν
  ext i
  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using congr($h2 i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ ↔ ∀ μ, K R v μ • m = v ^ Λ μ • m
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem E_smul_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (i : I) :
    E R v i • m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ + R.root i)
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  rw [← mul_smul, K_mul_E, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hm μ, smul_comm (E R v i), smul_smul,
    AddMonoidHom.add_apply, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_smul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem F_smul_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (i : I) :
    F R v i • m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ - R.root i)
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  rw [← mul_smul, K_mul_F, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hm μ, smul_comm (F R v i), smul_smul,
    AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_eq_add_neg, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_smul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem K_smul_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (ν : Y) :
    K R v ν • m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hm ν]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.charHom_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma charHom_single (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) (c : k) :
    charHom v Λ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ c) = c * v ^ Λ μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [charHom, AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ)
    (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) : zeroHom R v g • m = charHom v Λ g • m
proof:
:= by
  induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of μ =>
    change zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1) • m = _
    rw [zeroHom_single, hm, AddMonoidAlgebra.of_apply, charHom_single, one_mul]; rfl
  | add f g hf hg => rw [map_add, add_smul, hf, hg, map_add, add_smul]
  | smul c f hf => rw [map_smul, smul_assoc, hf, map_smul, smul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (i : I) :
    Kt R v i • m = (v ^ D.d i) ^ Λ (R.coroot i) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kt, hm, ktilde, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [hm, map_neg, ktilde, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, neg_mul_eq_mul_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_ne_one_of_not_root
statement:
lemma zpow_ne_one_of_not_root (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    v ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq n with h | h
  · rw [h, zpow_natCast]; exact hv' _ (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hn)
  · rw [h, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_ne_one]; exact hv' _ (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hn)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_charHom_eq_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_charHom_eq_one_eq_zero (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (h : Λ₁ ≠ Λ₂) : ∃ g, charHom v Λ₁ g = 1 ∧ charHom v Λ₂ g = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := DFunLike.ne_iff.1 h
  have hv0 := NeZero.ne v
  have hab : v ^ Λ₁ μ - v ^ Λ₂ μ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]
    intro hab
    refine zpow_ne_one_of_not_root hv' (sub_ne_zero.2 hμ) ?_
    rw [zpow_sub₀ hv0, hab, div_self (zpow_ne_zero _ hv0)]
  refine ⟨(v ^ Λ₁ μ - v ^ Λ₂ μ)⁻¹ • (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1 -
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (v ^ Λ₂ μ)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [map_smul, map_sub, charHom_single, one_mul, AddMonoidHom.map_zero, zpow_zero,
      mul_one, smul_eq_mul]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hab
  · simp [charHom_single]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.iSupIndep_weightSpace
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_weightSpace (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    iSupIndep (weightSpace R v M)
proof:
:= by
  intro Λ
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hx hx'
  have comb : ∀ y z : M, (∃ g, charHom v Λ g = 1 ∧ zeroHom R v g • y = 0) →
      (∃ g, charHom v Λ g = 1 ∧ zeroHom R v g • z = 0) →
      ∃ g, charHom v Λ g = 1 ∧ zeroHom R v g • (y + z) = 0 := by
    rintro y z ⟨g₁, hg₁, hy⟩ ⟨g₂, hg₂, hz⟩
    refine ⟨g₁ * g₂, by rw [map_mul, hg₁, hg₂, one_mul], ?_⟩
    have e1 : zeroHom R v (g₁ * g₂) • y = zeroHom R v g₂ • zeroHom R v g₁ • y := by
      rw [← mul_smul, ← map_mul, mul_comm]
    have e2 : zeroHom R v (g₁ * g₂) • z = zeroHom R v g₁ • zeroHom R v g₂ • z := by
      rw [← mul_smul, ← map_mul]
    rw [smul_add, e1, e2, hy, hz, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  
  have key : ∀ y ∈ ⨆ Λ', ⨆ (_ : Λ' ≠ Λ), weightSpace R v M Λ',
      ∃ g, charHom v Λ g = 1 ∧ zeroHom R v g • y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem Λ' y hy =>
      induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem hΛ' y hy =>
        obtain ⟨g, hg1, hg2⟩ := exists_charHom_eq_one_eq_zero hv' (Ne.symm hΛ')
        exact ⟨g, hg1, by rw [zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hy, hg2, zero_smul]⟩
      | zero => exact ⟨1, map_one _, smul_zero _⟩
      | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact comb y z hy hz
    | zero => exact ⟨1, map_one _, smul_zero _⟩
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact comb y z hy hz
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgx⟩ := key x hx'
  rwa [zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hx, hg, one_smul] at hgx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qInt_zero : qInt v 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [qInt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qFactorial_zero : qFactorial v 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_succ
statement: lemma qFactorial_succ (n : ℕ) : qFactorial v (n + 1) = qInt v (n + 1) * qFactorial v n
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomial_zero_right (n : ℕ) : qBinomial v n 0 = 1
proof: := by cases n <;> rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_zero_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomial_zero_succ (j : ℕ) : qBinomial v 0 (j + 1) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_succ_succ
statement:
lemma qBinomial_succ_succ (n j : ℕ) : qBinomial v (n + 1) (j + 1) =
    v⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) * qBinomial v n (j + 1) + v ^ (n - j) * qBinomial v n j
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: lemma qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt {n j : ℕ} (h : n < j) : qBinomial v n j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero h.ne'; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : j ≠ 0)
    rw [qBinomial_succ_succ, ih (by omega), ih (by omega)]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_succ_self
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomial_succ_self (n : ℕ) : qBinomial v n (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt v (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_self
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomial_self (n : ℕ) : qBinomial v n n = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [qBinomial_succ_succ, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_one
statement: theorem qBinomial_one (n j : ℕ) : qBinomial (1 : k) n j = n.choose j
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => cases j <;> simp
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j => simp [qBinomial_succ_succ, ih, Nat.choose_succ_succ', add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_add
statement:
lemma qInt_add (a b : ℕ) :
    qInt v (a + b) = v⁻¹ ^ b * qInt v a + v ^ a * qInt v b
proof:
:= by
  rw [qInt, add_comm a b, Finset.sum_range_add, add_comm, qInt, qInt, Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    have hs := Finset.mem_range.1 hs
    rw [show b + a - 1 - (b + s) = a - 1 - s by omega, pow_add]
    ring
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    have hs := Finset.mem_range.1 hs
    rw [show b + a - 1 - s = a + (b - 1 - s) by omega, pow_add]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_succ
statement: lemma qInt_succ (n : ℕ) : qInt v (n + 1) = v⁻¹ * qInt v n + v ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [qInt_add]; simp [qInt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_mul_sub
statement: lemma qInt_mul_sub (n : ℕ) : (v - v⁻¹) * qInt v n = v ^ n - v⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [qInt_succ, mul_add, mul_left_comm, ih]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_ne_zero
statement: theorem qInt_ne_zero (hv : v ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (h : v ^ (2 * n) ≠ 1) : qInt v n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have := qInt_mul_sub (v := v) n
  rw [h0, mul_zero, eq_comm, sub_eq_zero] at this
  apply h
  rw [two_mul, pow_add]
  nth_rewrite 2 [this]
  rw [inv_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem qFactorial_ne_zero (hv : v ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ m, 0 < m → m ≤ n → v ^ (2 * m) ≠ 1) :
    qFactorial v n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [qFactorial_succ]
    exact mul_ne_zero (qInt_ne_zero hv (h _ n.succ_pos le_rfl))
      (ih fun m hm hmn ↦ h m hm (hmn.trans n.le_succ))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial
statement:
theorem qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    qBinomial v n j * qFactorial v j * qFactorial v (n - j) = qFactorial v n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
            simp
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j =>
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hj with h | h
      · obtain rfl : j = n := by omega
        simp
      · have h1 := ih (j := j + 1) (by omega)
        have h2 := ih (j := j) (by omega)
        rw [show n + 1 - (j + 1) = n - j by omega, qBinomial_succ_succ]
        rw [show n - j = (n - (j + 1)) + 1 by omega] at h2 ⊢
        have key : qInt v (n + 1) = v⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) * qInt v (n - (j + 1) + 1) +
            v ^ (n - (j + 1) + 1) * qInt v (j + 1) := by
          rw [← qInt_add, show n - (j + 1) + 1 + (j + 1) = n + 1 by omega]
        rw [qFactorial_succ v j] at h1
        rw [qFactorial_succ v (n - (j + 1))] at h2
        rw [qFactorial_succ v (n - (j + 1)), qFactorial_succ v j, qFactorial_succ v n]
        linear_combination (-qFactorial v n) * key +
          (v⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) * qInt v (n - (j + 1) + 1)) * h1 +
          (v ^ (n - (j + 1) + 1) * qInt v (j + 1)) * h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_one_right
statement: lemma qBinomial_one_right (n : ℕ) : qBinomial v n 1 = qInt v n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [qBinomial_succ_succ, ih, qInt_succ]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_mul_sub
statement:
theorem qBinomial_mul_sub (n k : ℕ) :
    (v ^ (n - k) - v⁻¹ ^ (n - k)) * qBinomial v n k =
      (v ^ (k + 1) - v⁻¹ ^ (k + 1)) * qBinomial v n (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => cases k <;> simp
  | succ n ih =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [qBinomial_one_right, qInt_mul_sub]
    | succ k =>
      rcases le_or_gt n k with hnk | hnk
      · rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt v (by omega : n + 1 < k + 1 + 1),
          show n + 1 - (k + 1) = 0 by omega]
        simp
      · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p, n - k = p + 1 := ⟨n - k - 1, by omega⟩
        have h1 := ih k
        have h2 := ih (k + 1)
        rw [hp] at h1
        rw [show n - (k + 1) = p by omega] at h2
        rw [show n + 1 - (k + 1) = p + 1 by omega, qBinomial_succ_succ, qBinomial_succ_succ, hp,
          show n - (k + 1) = p by omega]
        linear_combination (v ^ (p + 1)) * h1 + (v⁻¹ ^ (k + 2)) * h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_symm
statement: theorem qBinomial_symm {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) : qBinomial v n (n - k) = qBinomial v n k
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
            simp
  | succ n ih =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k =>
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hk with h | h
      · obtain rfl : k = n := by omega
        simp
      · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p, n - k = p + 1 := ⟨n - k - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [show n + 1 - (k + 1) = p + 1 by omega, qBinomial_succ_succ, qBinomial_succ_succ,
          show n - p = k + 1 by omega, hp]
        have e1 : qBinomial v n (p + 1) = qBinomial v n k := by rw [← hp]; exact ih (by omega)
        have e2 : qBinomial v n p = qBinomial v n (k + 1) := by
          rw [show p = n - (k + 1) by omega]; exact ih (by omega)
        have h1 := qBinomial_mul_sub v n k
        rw [hp] at h1
        rw [e1, e2]
        linear_combination -h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_inv
statement: theorem qBinomial_inv (n k : ℕ) : qBinomial v⁻¹ n k = qBinomial v n k
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => cases k <;> simp
  | succ n ih =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k =>
      rw [qBinomial_succ_succ, qBinomial_succ_succ, ih, ih, inv_inv]
      linear_combination -qBinomial_mul_sub v n k

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerreDiv_eq
statement:
theorem qSerreDiv_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : qFactorial v m ≠ 0) (a b : B) :
    qSerreDiv v m a b = (qFactorial v m)⁻¹ • qSerre v m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerreDiv, qSerre, qDivPow, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_smul_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  have h := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := v) hr
  have h1 : qFactorial v r ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hm (by rw [← h, h0]; ring)
  have h2 : qFactorial v (m - r) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hm (by rw [← h, h0]; ring)
  have h3 : qBinomial v m r ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hm (by rw [← h, h0]; ring)
  congr 1
  rw [← h]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_one
statement: lemma serreAux_one (m : ℕ) (a b : B) : serreAux v 1 m a b = qSerre v m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [serreAux, qSerre]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qSerre_zero (a b : B) : qSerre v 0 a b = b
proof: := by simp [qSerre]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_serreAux
statement:
lemma map_serreAux {B' : Type*} [Ring B'] [Algebra k B'] (f : B →ₐ[k] B') (c : k) (m : ℕ)
    (a b : B) : f (serreAux v c m a b) = serreAux v c m (f a) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_qSerre
statement:
lemma map_qSerre {B' : Type*} [Ring B'] [Algebra k B'] (f : B →ₐ[k] B') (m : ℕ)
    (a b : B) : f (qSerre v m a b) = qSerre v m (f a) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [← serreAux_one, map_serreAux]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_sub_smul
statement:
lemma serreAux_sub_smul (c : k) (m : ℕ) (a x y : B) (μ : k) :
    serreAux v c m a (x - μ • y) = serreAux v c m a x - μ • serreAux v c m a y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [serreAux, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.smul_sum,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ smul_comm _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_mul_left
statement:
lemma serreAux_mul_left (c : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : B) :
    serreAux v c m a (a * b) = a * serreAux v c m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [serreAux, Finset.mul_sum, mul_smul_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  congr 1
  simp only [mul_assoc]
  rw [← mul_assoc a (a ^ (m - r)), (Commute.self_pow a _).eq, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_mul_right
statement:
lemma serreAux_mul_right (c : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : B) :
    serreAux v c m a (b * a) = serreAux v c m a b * a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [serreAux, Finset.sum_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  congr 1
  simp only [mul_assoc]
  rw [(Commute.self_pow a _).eq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_succ
statement:
theorem serreAux_succ (hv : v ≠ 0) (c : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : B) :
    serreAux v c (m + 1) a b = serreAux v (c * v⁻¹) m a (a * b - (c * v ^ m) • (b * a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreAux_sub_smul]
  simp only [serreAux]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (m + 1)]
  simp only [qBinomial_succ_succ, pow_zero, mul_one, qBinomial_zero_right, one_smul,
    Nat.sub_zero, add_mul, mul_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  
  have h1 : ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), ((-1) ^ (r + 1) * (v⁻¹ ^ (r + 1) * qBinomial v m (r + 1)) *
        c ^ (r + 1)) • (a ^ (m + 1 - (r + 1)) * b * a ^ (r + 1)) + a ^ (m + 1) * b =
      ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), ((-1) ^ r * qBinomial v m r * (c * v⁻¹) ^ r) •
        (a ^ (m - r) * (a * b) * a ^ r) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, qBinomial_succ_self]
    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_smul, add_zero, pow_zero, qBinomial_zero_right,
      mul_one, one_smul, Nat.sub_zero]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
      have hr := Finset.mem_range.1 hr
      rw [show m + 1 - (r + 1) = m - (r + 1) + 1 by omega]
      congr 1
      · rw [mul_pow]; ring
      · rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc (a ^ (m - (r + 1))) a b]
    · rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
  
  have h2 : ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), ((-1) ^ (r + 1) * (v ^ (m - r) * qBinomial v m r) *
        c ^ (r + 1)) • (a ^ (m + 1 - (r + 1)) * b * a ^ (r + 1)) =
      -∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), (c * v ^ m * ((-1) ^ r * qBinomial v m r * (c * v⁻¹) ^ r)) •
        (a ^ (m - r) * (b * a) * a ^ r) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
    have hr := Finset.mem_range.1 hr
    rw [← neg_smul]
    congr 1
    · have hvm : v ^ m = v ^ (m - r) * v ^ r := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
      have hvr : v ^ r * v⁻¹ ^ r = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hv, one_pow]
      rw [hvm, mul_pow]
      linear_combination ((-1) ^ r * c ^ (r + 1) * v ^ (m - r) * qBinomial v m r) * hvr
    · simp only [Nat.add_sub_add_right, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
  rw [add_right_comm, h1, h2, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_succ'
statement:
theorem serreAux_succ' (hv : v ≠ 0) (c : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : B) :
    serreAux v c (m + 1) a b = a * serreAux v (c * v⁻¹) m a b -
      (c * v ^ m) • (serreAux v (c * v⁻¹) m a b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreAux_succ hv, serreAux_sub_smul, serreAux_mul_left, serreAux_mul_right]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul
statement:
lemma mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul {w a : B} {t : k} (h : w * a = t • (a * w)) (n : ℕ) :
    w * a ^ n = t ^ n • (a ^ n * w)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, h, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul,
      ← mul_assoc, pow_succ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_serreAux_of_mul_eq_smul
statement:
lemma mul_serreAux_of_mul_eq_smul {w a b : B} {t μ : k} (ha : w * a = t • (a * w))
    (hb : w * b = μ • (b * w)) (c : k) (m : ℕ) :
    w * serreAux v c m a b = (μ * t ^ m) • (serreAux v c m a b * w)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ p r, w * (a ^ p * b * a ^ r) = (μ * t ^ (p + r)) • (a ^ p * b * a ^ r * w) := by
    intro p r
    calc w * (a ^ p * b * a ^ r) = (w * a ^ p) * b * a ^ r := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = t ^ p • (a ^ p * (w * b) * a ^ r) := by
      rw [mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul ha]; simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    _ = (t ^ p * μ) • (a ^ p * b * (w * a ^ r)) := by
      rw [hb]; simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
    _ = (t ^ p * μ * t ^ r) • (a ^ p * b * a ^ r * w) := by
      rw [mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul ha]
      simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by congr 1; rw [pow_add]; ring
  simp only [serreAux, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.smul_sum, mul_smul_comm,
    smul_mul_assoc]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [key, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hr), smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_add_left
statement:
theorem serreAux_add_left (hv : v ≠ 0) {u w : B} (hwu : w * u = v⁻¹ ^ 2 • (u * w)) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ (c : k) (b : B), w * b = (c * v ^ m) • (b * w) →
      serreAux v c (m + 1) (u + w) b = serreAux v c (m + 1) u b
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro c b hb
    simp [serreAux, Finset.sum_range_succ, hb, add_mul, mul_add]
    abel
  | succ m ih =>
    intro c b hb
    have key : (u + w) * b - (c * v ^ (m + 1)) • (b * (u + w)) =
        u * b - (c * v ^ (m + 1)) • (b * u) := by
      rw [add_mul, mul_add, hb, smul_add]; abel
    rw [serreAux_succ hv, serreAux_succ hv c (m + 1) u b, key]
    apply ih
    set l := c * v ^ (m + 1)
    have e1 : w * (u * b) = (v⁻¹ ^ 2 * l) • (u * b * w) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, hwu, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hb, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
    have e2 : w * (b * u) = (l * v⁻¹ ^ 2) • (b * u * w) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, hb, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hwu, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, ← mul_assoc]
    have hvv : v⁻¹ * v = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hv
    rw [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, e1, e2, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 2
    · simp only [l]; linear_combination (c * v⁻¹ * v ^ m) * hvv
    · simp only [l]; linear_combination (c * c * v ^ (2 * m + 1) * v⁻¹) * hvv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_add_right
statement:
theorem serreAux_add_right (hv : v ≠ 0) {u w : B} (hwu : w * u = v ^ 2 • (u * w)) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ (c : k) (b : B), w * b = (c * v⁻¹ ^ m) • (b * w) →
      serreAux v c (m + 1) (u + w) b = serreAux v c (m + 1) u b
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro c b hb
    simp [serreAux, Finset.sum_range_succ, hb, add_mul, mul_add]
    abel
  | succ m ih =>
    intro c b hb
    have hb' : w * b = (c * v⁻¹ * v⁻¹ ^ m) • (b * w) := by rw [hb, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
    rw [serreAux_succ' hv, serreAux_succ' hv c (m + 1) u b, ih _ _ hb']
    have hX := mul_serreAux_of_mul_eq_smul (v := v) hwu hb' (c * v⁻¹) (m + 1)
    rw [add_mul, mul_add, hX, smul_add]
    have : c * v⁻¹ * v⁻¹ ^ m * (v ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) = c * v ^ (m + 1) := by
      have hvv : v⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * v ^ (m + 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv, one_pow]
      linear_combination (c * v ^ (m + 1)) * hvv
    rw [this]
    abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_add
statement:
theorem qSerre_add (hv : v ≠ 0) {u w b b' : B} {m : ℕ} (hwu : w * u = v ^ 2 • (u * w))
    (hb : w * b = v⁻¹ ^ m • (b * w)) (hb' : u * b' = v ^ m • (b' * u)) :
    qSerre v (m + 1) (u + w) (b + b') = qSerre v (m + 1) u b + qSerre v (m + 1) w b'
proof:
:= by
  have huw : u * w = v⁻¹ ^ 2 • (w * u) := by
    rw [hwu, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv, one_pow, one_smul]
  have hadd : ∀ x y : B, qSerre v (m + 1) (u + w) (x + y) =
      qSerre v (m + 1) (u + w) x + qSerre v (m + 1) (u + w) y := by
    intro x y
    simp only [qSerre, mul_add, add_mul, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [hadd, ← serreAux_one, ← serreAux_one, serreAux_add_right hv hwu m 1 b (by simpa using hb),
    add_comm u w, serreAux_add_left hv huw m 1 b' (by simpa using hb'), serreAux_one,
    serreAux_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma qSerre_zero_right (m : ℕ) (a : B) : qSerre v m a 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [qSerre]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_add_right
statement:
lemma qSerre_add_right (m : ℕ) (a b b' : B) :
    qSerre v m a (b + b') = qSerre v m a b + qSerre v m a b'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, mul_add, add_mul, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomial_mul_inv_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomial_mul_inv_pow_eq_zero (hv : v ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ r ∈ range (m + 2), (-1) ^ r * qBinomial v (m + 1) r * (v⁻¹ ^ m) ^ r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := serreAux_succ (B := k) hv (v⁻¹ ^ m) m 1 1
  have h1 : v⁻¹ ^ m * v ^ m = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv, one_pow]
  rw [h1, one_smul, mul_one, sub_self] at h
  simpa [serreAux] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem qSerre_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_smul (hv : v ≠ 0) {m : ℕ} {a b : B}
    (h : b * a = v⁻¹ ^ m • (a * b)) : qSerre v (m + 1) a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ r ≤ m + 1, a ^ (m + 1 - r) * b * a ^ r = (v⁻¹ ^ m) ^ r • (a ^ (m + 1) * b) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul h, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]
  calc qSerre v (m + 1) a b
      = ∑ r ∈ range (m + 2), ((-1) ^ r * qBinomial v (m + 1) r * (v⁻¹ ^ m) ^ r) •
          (a ^ (m + 1) * b) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
        rw [key r (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)), smul_smul]
    _ = 0 := by rw [← Finset.sum_smul, sum_qBinomial_mul_inv_pow_eq_zero hv, zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_op
statement:
theorem qSerre_op (m : ℕ) (a b : B) : qSerre v m (MulOpposite.op a) (MulOpposite.op b) =
    (-1 : k) ^ m • MulOpposite.op (qSerre v m a b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, ← MulOpposite.op_pow, ← MulOpposite.op_mul, Finset.op_sum,
    MulOpposite.op_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  rw [show m + 1 - 1 - r = m - r by omega, show m - (m - r) = r by omega, qBinomial_symm v hr]
  rw [← mul_assoc (a ^ (m - r))]
  congr 1
  have h1 : (-1 : k) ^ m = (-1) ^ (m - r) * (-1) ^ r := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]
  have h2 : (-1 : k) ^ r * (-1) ^ r = 1 := by rw [← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]; simp
  rw [h1]
  linear_combination (-((-1) ^ (m - r) * qBinomial v m r)) * h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul
statement:
lemma pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul {w a : B} {t : k} (h : w * a = t • (a * w)) (m n : ℕ) :
    w ^ m * a ^ n = t ^ (m * n) • (a ^ n * w ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul h, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ih,
      smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, ← pow_add, Nat.succ_mul, add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_pow_eq_smul
statement:
lemma mul_pow_eq_smul {g e : B} {t : k} (ht : t ≠ 0) (h : g * e = t • (e * g)) (n : ℕ) :
    (g * e) ^ n = t⁻¹ ^ n.choose 2 • (g ^ n * e ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have heg : e * g = t⁻¹ • (g * e) := by rw [h, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht, one_smul]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hen : e ^ n * g = t⁻¹ ^ n • (g * e ^ n) := by
      simpa using pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul heg n 1
    calc (g * e) ^ (n + 1) = (g * e) ^ n * (g * e) := pow_succ _ _
      _ = t⁻¹ ^ n.choose 2 • (g ^ n * (e ^ n * g) * e) := by
        rw [ih]; simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = (t⁻¹ ^ n.choose 2 * t⁻¹ ^ n) • (g ^ n * g * (e ^ n * e)) := by
        rw [hen]; simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← pow_succ, ← pow_succ, Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.choose_one_right,
          mul_comm (t⁻¹ ^ n.choose 2), ← pow_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.choose_two_add
statement: private lemma choose_two_add (a b : ℕ) : (a + b).choose 2 = a.choose 2 + b.choose 2 + a * b
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.choose_one_right, ih, Nat.choose_succ_succ',
      Nat.choose_one_right]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_mul_mul
statement:
theorem qSerre_mul_mul {t s : k} (ht : t ≠ 0) {g e h f : B} (hge : g * e = t • (e * g))
    (heh : e * h = s • (h * e)) (hfg : f * g = s • (g * f)) (hgh : g * h = h * g) (M : ℕ) :
    qSerre v M (g * e) (h * f) = (t⁻¹ ^ M.choose 2 * s ^ M) • (g ^ M * h * qSerre v M e f)
proof:
:= by
  have heg : e * g = t⁻¹ • (g * e) := by rw [hge, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht, one_smul]
  simp only [qSerre, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ M := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  have key : (g * e) ^ (M - r) * (h * f) * (g * e) ^ r =
      (t⁻¹ ^ M.choose 2 * s ^ M) • (g ^ M * h * (e ^ (M - r) * f * e ^ r)) := by
    rw [mul_pow_eq_smul ht hge, mul_pow_eq_smul ht hge]
    have e1 : e ^ (M - r) * h = s ^ (M - r) • (h * e ^ (M - r)) := by
      simpa using pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul heh (M - r) 1
    have e2 : f * g ^ r = s ^ r • (g ^ r * f) := by
      simpa using pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul hfg 1 r
    have e3 : e ^ (M - r) * g ^ r = t⁻¹ ^ ((M - r) * r) • (g ^ r * e ^ (M - r)) :=
      pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul heg (M - r) r
    have e4 : g ^ (M - r) * h * g ^ r = g ^ M * h := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← ((Commute.pow_left hgh r).eq), ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
        Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]
    calc t⁻¹ ^ (M - r).choose 2 • (g ^ (M - r) * e ^ (M - r)) * (h * f) *
          t⁻¹ ^ r.choose 2 • (g ^ r * e ^ r)
        = (t⁻¹ ^ (M - r).choose 2 * t⁻¹ ^ r.choose 2) •
            (g ^ (M - r) * (e ^ (M - r) * h) * (f * g ^ r) * e ^ r) := by
          simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
          congr 1; ring
      _ = (t⁻¹ ^ (M - r).choose 2 * t⁻¹ ^ r.choose 2 * s ^ (M - r) * s ^ r) •
            (g ^ (M - r) * h * (e ^ (M - r) * g ^ r) * f * e ^ r) := by
          rw [e1, e2]
          simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
          congr 1; ring
      _ = (t⁻¹ ^ (M - r).choose 2 * t⁻¹ ^ r.choose 2 * s ^ (M - r) * s ^ r *
            t⁻¹ ^ ((M - r) * r)) • (g ^ (M - r) * h * g ^ r * e ^ (M - r) * f * e ^ r) := by
          rw [e3]
          simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by
          rw [e4]
          congr 1
          · have hM : M.choose 2 = (M - r).choose 2 + r.choose 2 + (M - r) * r := by
              rw [← choose_two_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]
            have hs : s ^ M = s ^ (M - r) * s ^ r := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]
            rw [hM, hs, pow_add, pow_add]
            ring
          · simp only [mul_assoc]
  rw [key, smul_smul, mul_comm ((-1) ^ r * qBinomial v M r)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_inv
statement: lemma qSerre_inv (m : ℕ) (a b : B) : qSerre v⁻¹ m a b = qSerre v m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [qSerre, qBinomial_inv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_smul_smul
statement:
lemma qSerre_smul_smul (m : ℕ) (a b : B) (c d : k) :
    qSerre v m (c • a) (d • b) = (c ^ m * d) • qSerre v m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, Finset.smul_sum, smul_pow, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  congr 1
  rw [show c ^ m = c ^ (m - r) * c ^ r by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_qSerreDiv
statement:
lemma map_qSerreDiv {B' : Type*} [Ring B'] [Algebra k B'] (f : B →ₐ[k] B') (m : ℕ)
    (a b : B) : f (qSerreDiv v m a b) = qSerreDiv v m (f a) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qSerreDiv, qDivPow, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerreDiv_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma qSerreDiv_zero_right (m : ℕ) (a : B) : qSerreDiv v m a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [qSerreDiv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerreDiv_smul_smul
statement:
lemma qSerreDiv_smul_smul (m : ℕ) (a b : B) (c d : k) :
    qSerreDiv v m (c • a) (d • b) = (c ^ m * d) • qSerreDiv v m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerreDiv, qDivPow, Finset.smul_sum, smul_pow, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
    smul_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  congr 1
  rw [show c ^ m = c ^ (m - r) * c ^ r by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_units_val_pow_inv
statement:
lemma map_units_val_pow_inv (a b : ℕ) :
    φ ((q ^ a * q⁻¹ ^ b : Rˣ) : R) = φ q ^ a * (φ q)⁻¹ ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.val_mul, map_mul, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, map_pow,
    map_pow, map_units_inv φ q]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_qNatU
statement: lemma map_qNatU (n : ℕ) : φ (qNatU q n) = qInt (φ q) n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qNatU, map_sum, map_units_val_pow_inv, qInt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_qBinomialU
statement: lemma map_qBinomialU (n j : ℕ) : φ (qBinomialU q n j) = qBinomial (φ q) n j
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => cases j <;> simp [qBinomialU, qBinomial]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp [qBinomialU]
    | succ j =>
      rw [qBinomialU, qBinomial_succ_succ, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, ih, ih,
        Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, map_pow, map_pow, map_units_inv φ q]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sub_mul_map_qIntU
statement:
lemma sub_mul_map_qIntU (n : ℤ) :
    (φ q - (φ q)⁻¹) * φ (qIntU q n) = φ q ^ n - φ q ^ (-n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n =>
    rw [qIntU, map_qNatU, qInt_mul_sub]
    simp [zpow_neg]
  | negSucc n =>
    rw [qIntU, map_neg, map_qNatU, mul_neg, qInt_mul_sub, Int.neg_negSucc, zpow_natCast,
      zpow_negSucc, inv_pow]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_qIntU_of_eq_one
statement: lemma map_qIntU_of_eq_one (hφ : φ q = 1) (n : ℤ) : φ (qIntU q n) = n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n => simp [qIntU, map_qNatU, hφ, qInt]
  | negSucc n =>
    rw [qIntU, map_neg, map_qNatU, hφ]
    simp [qInt, Int.negSucc_eq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBarE_mul_K
statement:
lemma rhoBarE_mul_K (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    rhoBarE R v i * K R v μ = v ^ R.root i μ • (K R v μ * rhoBarE R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoBarE, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, F_mul_K (NeZero.ne v), mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    K_comm, mul_assoc, smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBarF_mul_K
statement:
lemma rhoBarF_mul_K (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    rhoBarF R v i * K R v μ = v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (K R v μ * rhoBarF R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoBarF, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, E_mul_K (NeZero.ne v), mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    K_comm, mul_assoc, smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inv_zpow_dot_mul
statement:
lemma inv_zpow_dot_mul (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) :
    (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * v ^ D.dot i i = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := zpow_dot_mul (D := D) hv i
  rw [zpow_neg] at h
  rw [← inv_inv (v ^ D.dot i i), ← mul_inv, ← mul_inv, h, inv_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBarF_mul_rhoBarE_sub
statement:
lemma rhoBarF_mul_rhoBarE_sub (i j : I) :
    rhoBarF R v j * rhoBarE R v i - rhoBarE R v i * rhoBarF R v j = if i = j then
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have e1 : rhoBarF R v j * rhoBarE R v i = (((v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) * v ^ D.dot i j) •
      (Kt R v j * K R v (-ktilde R i) * (E R v j * F R v i)) := by
    rw [rhoBarF, rhoBarE, smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (E R v j), E_mul_K hv,
      map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot, neg_neg]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  have e2 : rhoBarE R v i * rhoBarF R v j = (((v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) * v ^ D.dot i j) •
      (Kt R v j * K R v (-ktilde R i) * (F R v i * E R v j)) := by
    rw [rhoBarE, rhoBarF, smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (F R v i), F_mul_K hv,
      root_ktilde_eq_dot, D.dot_comm j i]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    · ring
    · rw [← mul_assoc, K_comm, mul_assoc]
  rw [e1, e2, ← smul_sub, ← mul_sub, E_mul_F_sub]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    simp only [ite_true]
    rw [mul_smul_comm, Kt, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul, inv_zpow_dot_mul hv,
      one_smul]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h), ite_eq_right h, mul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBar_relations
statement:
theorem rhoBar_relations :
    Relations R v (fun i ↦ op (rhoBarE R v i)) (fun i ↦ op (rhoBarF R v i)) (rhoK R v) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [rhoK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, unop_mul, unop_op,
      unop_smul]
    exact rhoBarE_mul_K i μ
  K_mul_F μ i := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [rhoK, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, toAdd_ofAdd, unop_mul, unop_op,
      unop_smul]
    exact rhoBarF_mul_K i μ
  E_mul_F i j := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [unop_sub, unop_mul, unop_op]
    rw [rhoBarF_mul_rhoBarE_sub]
    split_ifs
    · simp [rhoK, Kt]
    · simp
  serre_E i j hij := by
    have hv := NeZero.ne v
    rw [qSerre_op, rhoBarE, rhoBarE, qSerre_smul_smul,
      qSerre_mul_mul (t := v ^ (-R.root i (-ktilde R i))) (s := v ^ R.root i (-ktilde R j))
        (zpow_ne_zero _ hv) (K_mul_F R v _ i) (F_mul_K hv _ i)
        (by rw [F_mul_K hv, map_neg, map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot, root_ktilde_eq_dot,
          D.dot_comm]) (K_comm R v _ _),
      serre_F R v hij]
    simp
  serre_F i j hij := by
    have hv := NeZero.ne v
    rw [qSerre_op, rhoBarF, rhoBarF, qSerre_smul_smul,
      qSerre_mul_mul (t := v ^ R.root i (ktilde R i)) (s := v ^ (-R.root i (ktilde R j)))
        (zpow_ne_zero _ hv) (K_mul_E R v _ i) (E_mul_K hv _ i)
        (by rw [E_mul_K hv, root_ktilde_eq_dot, root_ktilde_eq_dot, D.dot_comm])
        (K_comm R v _ _),
      serre_E R v hij]
    simp

proof: := by simp [rhoBar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBar_rhoBarE
statement: lemma rhoBar_rhoBarE (i : I) : rhoBar R v (rhoBarE R v i) = E R v i
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  rw [rhoBarE, map_smul, rhoBar_mul, rhoBar_F, rhoBar_K, rhoBarF, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
    E_mul_K hv, map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot, neg_neg, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, Kt, K_add,
    add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul, smul_smul, smul_smul, inv_zpow_dot_mul hv, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBar_rhoBarF
statement: lemma rhoBar_rhoBarF (i : I) : rhoBar R v (rhoBarF R v i) = F R v i
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  rw [rhoBarF, map_smul, rhoBar_mul, rhoBar_E, rhoBar_K, rhoBarE, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
    F_mul_K hv, root_ktilde_eq_dot, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero,
    one_mul, smul_smul, smul_smul, inv_zpow_dot_mul hv, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBar_rhoBar
statement: theorem rhoBar_rhoBar (x : QuantumGroup R v) : rhoBar R v (rhoBar R v x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | E i => rw [rhoBar_E, rhoBar_rhoBarE]
  | F i => rw [rhoBar_F, rhoBar_rhoBarF]
  | K μ => rw [rhoBar_K, rhoBar_K]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [rhoBar_mul, rhoBar_mul, hx, hy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_qBinomialSeries
