  coeff_mk _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_qBinomialInvSeries
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_qBinomialInvSeries (h n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (qBinomialInvSeries q h) = (-1) ^ n * qBinomial q (h + n - 1) n
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_zero_one_add_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_zero_one_add_mul (c : k) (φ : PowerSeries k) :
    coeff 0 ((1 + C c * X) * φ) = coeff 0 φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_mul, one_mul, map_add, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, coeff_zero_X_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_succ_one_add_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_succ_one_add_mul (c : k) (φ : PowerSeries k) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff (n + 1) ((1 + C c * X) * φ) = coeff (n + 1) φ + c * coeff n φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_mul, one_mul, map_add, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_X_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialSeries_succ
statement:
theorem qBinomialSeries_succ (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : ℕ) :
    qBinomialSeries q (h + 1) = (1 + C (q ^ h) * X) * rescale q⁻¹ (qBinomialSeries q h)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rw [coeff_zero_one_add_mul, coeff_rescale]; simp
  | succ n =>
    rw [coeff_succ_one_add_mul, coeff_qBinomialSeries, coeff_rescale, coeff_rescale,
      coeff_qBinomialSeries, coeff_qBinomialSeries, qBinomial_succ_succ]
    congr 1
    rcases le_or_gt n h with hn | hn
    · rw [← mul_assoc, inv_pow, pow_sub₀ q hq hn]
    · rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q hn]
      ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialInvSeries_succ_mul
statement:
theorem qBinomialInvSeries_succ_mul (h : ℕ) :
    qBinomialInvSeries q (h + 1) * (1 + C (q ^ h) * X) = rescale q⁻¹ (qBinomialInvSeries q h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rw [coeff_zero_one_add_mul, coeff_rescale]; simp
  | succ n =>
    rw [coeff_succ_one_add_mul, coeff_qBinomialInvSeries, coeff_qBinomialInvSeries, coeff_rescale,
      coeff_qBinomialInvSeries, show h + 1 + (n + 1) - 1 = (h + n) + 1 by omega,
      show h + 1 + n - 1 = h + n by omega, show h + (n + 1) - 1 = h + n by omega,
      qBinomial_succ_succ, show h + n - n = h by omega]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialSeries_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomialSeries_zero : qBinomialSeries q 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialInvSeries_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomialInvSeries_zero : qBinomialInvSeries q 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n => simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialSeries_mul_qBinomialInvSeries
statement:
theorem qBinomialSeries_mul_qBinomialInvSeries (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : ℕ) :
    qBinomialSeries q h * qBinomialInvSeries q h = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero => simp
  | succ h ih =>
    rw [qBinomialSeries_succ hq, show ∀ a b c : PowerSeries k, a * b * c = b * (c * a) from
      fun a b c ↦ by ring, qBinomialInvSeries_succ_mul, ← map_mul, ih, map_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialPhi_one
statement: lemma qBinomialPhi_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : ℕ) : qBinomialPhi q h 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomialPhi, pow_one, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, rescale_one, RingHom.id_apply, mul_comm,
    qBinomialSeries_mul_qBinomialInvSeries hq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialPhi_succ
statement:
lemma qBinomialPhi_succ (hq : q ≠ 0) (h a : ℕ) :
    qBinomialPhi q h (a + 1) = (1 + C (q ^ (h + a)) * X) * rescale q⁻¹ (qBinomialPhi q h a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomialPhi, qBinomialPhi, ← add_assoc, qBinomialSeries_succ hq, map_mul,
    rescale_rescale, pow_succ, ← mul_assoc]
  ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_qBinomialPhi
statement:
lemma coeff_qBinomialPhi (h a j : ℕ) :
    coeff j (qBinomialPhi q h a) = ∑ c ∈ range (j + 1),
      (-1) ^ c * (q * q⁻¹ ^ a) ^ c * qBinomial q (h + c) c * qBinomial q (h + a) (j - c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomialPhi, coeff_mul, Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun c _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [coeff_rescale, coeff_qBinomialInvSeries, coeff_qBinomialSeries,
    show h + 1 + c - 1 = h + c by omega]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_qBinomialPhi_eq_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_qBinomialPhi_eq_zero (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : ℕ) {a j : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hj : a ≤ j) :
    coeff j (qBinomialPhi q h a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction a, ha using Nat.le_induction generalizing j with
  | base =>
    rw [qBinomialPhi_one hq]
    simp [coeff_one, show j ≠ 0 by omega]
  | succ a ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [qBinomialPhi_succ hq, coeff_succ_one_add_mul, coeff_rescale, coeff_rescale,
      ih (by omega), ih (by omega)]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_qBinomialPhi_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_qBinomialPhi_zero (hq : q ≠ 0) (h j : ℕ) :
    coeff j (qBinomialPhi q h 0) = (-q ^ (h + 1)) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ n, coeff (n + 1) (qBinomialPhi q h 0) + q ^ (h + 1) *
      coeff n (qBinomialPhi q h 0) = 0 := by
    intro n
    have e := congrArg (coeff (n + 1)) (qBinomialPhi_succ hq h 0)
    rw [zero_add, qBinomialPhi_one hq, coeff_succ_one_add_mul, coeff_rescale, coeff_rescale]
      at e
    simp only [coeff_one, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte] at e
    have hq' : q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hq)
    refine (mul_eq_zero.1 ?_).resolve_left hq'
    have hh : q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (h + 1) = q ^ h * q⁻¹ ^ n := by
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      field_simp
    linear_combination -e + coeff n (qBinomialPhi q h 0) * hh
  have h0 : coeff 0 (qBinomialPhi q h 0) = 1 := by
    rw [coeff_qBinomialPhi]
    simp
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa using h0
  | succ n ih => linear_combination key n - q ^ (h + 1) * ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq_zero (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : ℕ) {a j : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (hj : a ≤ j) : ∑ c ∈ range (j + 1),
      (-1) ^ c * (q * q⁻¹ ^ a) ^ c * qBinomial q (h + c) c * qBinomial q (h + a) (j - c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_qBinomialPhi, coeff_qBinomialPhi_eq_zero hq h ha hj]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_zero
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_zero (hq : q ≠ 0) (h j : ℕ) : ∑ c ∈ range (j + 1),
    (-1) ^ c * q ^ c * qBinomial q (h + c) c * qBinomial q h (j - c) = (-q ^ (h + 1)) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_qBinomialPhi_zero hq h j, coeff_qBinomialPhi]
  simp

name: LusztigCartanDatum.two_mul_d
statement: lemma two_mul_d (i : I) : 2 * (D.d i : ℤ) = D.dot i i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := D.even_dot_self i
  have := D.dot_self_pos i
  simp only [d, hm]
  omega

name: LusztigCartanDatum.d_pos
statement: lemma d_pos (i : I) : 0 < D.d i
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := D.two_mul_d i
  have h2 := D.dot_self_pos i
  omega

name: LusztigCartanDatum.d_mul_cartanMatrix
statement: lemma d_mul_cartanMatrix (i j : I) : (D.d i : ℤ) * D.cartanMatrix i j = D.dot i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := D.dot_self_dvd i j
  have hpos := D.dot_self_pos i
  have h2 := D.two_mul_d i
  simp only [cartanMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, hc, Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ hpos.ne']
  have : 2 * ((D.d i : ℤ) * c) = 2 * D.dot i j := by rw [hc, ← h2]; ring
  omega

name: LusztigCartanDatum.cartanMatrix_self
statement: lemma cartanMatrix_self (i : I) : D.cartanMatrix i i = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [cartanMatrix, Int.mul_ediv_cancel _ (D.dot_self_pos i).ne']

name: LusztigCartanDatum.cartanMatrix_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma cartanMatrix_eq_zero_iff (i j : I) : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0 ↔ D.dot i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix]
  have := D.d_pos i
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [h, mul_zero]
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with h | h
    · omega
    · exact h

name: LusztigCartanDatum.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
statement:
theorem isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix : D.cartanMatrix.IsGeneralizedCartan where
  diag
proof:
:= D.cartanMatrix_self
  offDiag_nonpos i j hij := by
    have h1 := D.d_mul_cartanMatrix i j
    have h2 := D.dot_nonpos i j hij
    have h3 := D.d_pos i
    by_contra h
    have : 0 < (D.d i : ℤ) * D.cartanMatrix i j := mul_pos (by omega) (not_le.1 h)
    omega
  zero_comm i j := by
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_eq_zero_iff, D.cartanMatrix_eq_zero_iff, D.dot_comm]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm
statement:
lemma d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm (i j : I) :
    (D.d i : ℤ) * D.cartanMatrix i j = D.d j * D.cartanMatrix j i
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.d_mul_cartanMatrix, D.d_mul_cartanMatrix, D.dot_comm]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma weightDot_zero_left (μ : I →₀ ℕ) : D.weightDot 0 μ = 0
proof: := by simp [weightDot]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma weightDot_zero_right (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : D.weightDot ν 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [weightDot]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot_add_left
statement:
lemma weightDot_add_left (ν ν' μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    D.weightDot (ν + ν') μ = D.weightDot ν μ + D.weightDot ν' μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightDot
  rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index']
  · intro i; simp
  · intro i a b; simp [add_mul, Finsupp.sum_add]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot_add_right
statement:
lemma weightDot_add_right (ν μ μ' : I →₀ ℕ) :
    D.weightDot ν (μ + μ') = D.weightDot ν μ + D.weightDot ν μ'
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightDot
  rw [← Finsupp.sum_add]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index']
  · intro j; simp
  · intro j a b; push_cast; ring

name: LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot_single_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma weightDot_single_single (i j : I) :
    D.weightDot (Finsupp.single i 1) (Finsupp.single j 1) = D.dot i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [weightDot]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot_comm
statement: lemma weightDot_comm (ν μ : I →₀ ℕ) : D.weightDot ν μ = D.weightDot μ ν
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightDot
  rw [Finsupp.sum_comm]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun i _ ↦ Finsupp.sum_congr fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [D.dot_comm]; ring

name: LusztigCartanDatum.symmetrizerOf_pos
statement: lemma symmetrizerOf_pos (S : A.Symmetrization) (i : I) : 0 < symmetrizerOf S i
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast (S.ε i).den_pos)
    (prod_pos fun k _ ↦ Rat.num_pos.2 (S.ε_pos k))

name: LusztigCartanDatum.symmetrizerOf_mul_ε
statement:
lemma symmetrizerOf_mul_ε (S : A.Symmetrization) (i : I) :
    (symmetrizerOf S i : ℚ) * S.ε i = ∏ k, ((S.ε k).num : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_prod_erase univ (fun k ↦ ((S.ε k).num : ℚ)) (mem_univ i), symmetrizerOf]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (∏ k ∈ univ.erase i, ((S.ε k).num : ℚ)) * Rat.mul_den_eq_num (S.ε i)

name: LusztigCartanDatum.symmetrizerOf_mul_comm
statement:
lemma symmetrizerOf_mul_comm (S : A.Symmetrization) (i j : I) :
    symmetrizerOf S i * A i j = symmetrizerOf S j * A j i
proof:
:= by
  have hi := symmetrizerOf_mul_ε S i
  have hj := symmetrizerOf_mul_ε S j
  have h := S.ε_mul_comm i j
  have hεi := S.ε_ne_zero i
  have hεj := S.ε_ne_zero j
  have : ((symmetrizerOf S i * A i j : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((symmetrizerOf S j * A j i : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    push_cast
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hεi hεj)
    calc (symmetrizerOf S i : ℚ) * A i j * (S.ε i * S.ε j)
        = ((symmetrizerOf S i : ℚ) * S.ε i) * (S.ε j * A i j) := by ring
      _ = ((symmetrizerOf S j : ℚ) * S.ε j) * (S.ε i * A j i) := by rw [hi, hj, h]
      _ = _ := by ring
  exact_mod_cast this

name: LusztigCartanDatum.cartanMatrix_ofSymmetrization
statement:
theorem cartanMatrix_ofSymmetrization (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (S : A.Symmetrization) :
    (ofSymmetrization hA S).cartanMatrix = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [cartanMatrix, ofSymmetrization, Matrix.of_apply, hA.diag]
  rw [show 2 * (symmetrizerOf S i * A i j) = (symmetrizerOf S i * 2) * A i j by ring,
    Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (mul_pos (symmetrizerOf_pos S i) two_pos).ne']

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.exists_coroot_eq_of_isYRegular
statement:
theorem exists_coroot_eq_of_isYRegular [Finite I] [Module.Free ℤ Y] [Module.Finite ℤ Y]
    (hR : R.IsYRegular) : ∃ d : ℤ, 1 ≤ d ∧ ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, ∀ i, Λ (R.coroot i) = d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let κ := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ Y
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ Y
  
  let e : Y →ₗ[ℤ] (κ → ℚ) :=
    (LinearMap.funLeft ℤ ℚ id ∘ₗ (Finsupp.lcoeFun ∘ₗ
      Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (Int.castAddHom ℚ).toIntLinearMap)) ∘ₗ b.repr.toLinearMap
  have he : ∀ y j, e y j = (b.repr y j : ℚ) := fun y j ↦ rfl
  have he_inj : Function.Injective e := by
    intro y y' h
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext j
    have := congr_fun h j
    rw [he, he] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hZ : LinearIndependent ℤ (e ∘ R.coroot) := hR.map' e (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.2 he_inj)
  have hQ : LinearIndependent ℚ (e ∘ R.coroot) := (LinearIndependent.iff_fractionRing ℤ ℚ).1 hZ
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := LinearMap.exists_extend
    ((Module.Basis.span hQ).constr ℚ fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ) : _ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
  have hg1 : ∀ i, g (e (R.coroot i)) = 1 := fun i ↦ by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hg (Module.Basis.span hQ i)
    rw [Module.Basis.constr_basis, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      Module.Basis.span_apply] at this
    exact this
  
  let c : κ → ℚ := fun j ↦ g (Pi.single j 1)
  let d : ℕ := ∏ j, (c j).den
  have hd : (d : ℤ) ≥ 1 := by
    have : 0 < d := Finset.prod_pos fun j _ ↦ (c j).den_pos
    omega
  have hint : ∀ j, ∃ a : ℤ, (a : ℚ) = d * c j := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : (c j).den ∣ d := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)
    refine ⟨(c j).num * m, ?_⟩
    rw [hm, Nat.cast_mul, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, mul_comm ((c j).den : ℚ),
      mul_assoc, Rat.den_mul_eq_num, mul_comm]
  choose a ha using hint
  let Λ : Y →+ ℤ :=
    (∑ j, a j • (b.coord j : Y →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ)).toAddMonoidHom
  have hΛ : ∀ y, (Λ y : ℚ) = d * g (e y) := fun y ↦ by
    have hy : e y = ∑ j, (b.repr y j : ℚ) • Pi.single j 1 := by
      ext j'; simp [he, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [hy, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [Λ, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_smul]
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [ha]
    simp only [c]
    ring
  refine ⟨d, hd, Λ, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have := hΛ (R.coroot i)
  rw [hg1, mul_one] at this
  exact_mod_cast this

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.exists_le_coroot_of_isYRegular
statement:
theorem exists_le_coroot_of_isYRegular [Finite I] [Module.Free ℤ Y] [Module.Finite ℤ Y]
    (hR : R.IsYRegular) (N : ℕ) : ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, Λ, hΛ⟩ := exists_coroot_eq_of_isYRegular hR
  refine ⟨(N : ℤ) • Λ, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, hΛ, smul_eq_mul]
  nlinarith

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.smul_mk
statement:
lemma smul_mk (u : QuantumGroup R v) (z : M₁ ⊗[k] M₂) :
    u • mk M₁ M₂ z = mk M₁ M₂ (act R v M₁ M₂ u z)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.act_tmul
statement:
lemma act_tmul (a b : QuantumGroup R v) (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    actPair R v M₁ M₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] b) (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = (a • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (b • y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [actPair, Module.endTensorEndAlgHom_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.E_smul_tmul
statement:
lemma E_smul_tmul (i : I) (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    E R v i • mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
      mk M₁ M₂ ((E R v i • x) ⊗ₜ[k] y + (Kt R v i • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i • y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mk, act, AlgHom.comp_apply, comul_E, map_add, map_add,
    LinearMap.add_apply, act_tmul, act_tmul, one_smul, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.F_smul_tmul
statement:
lemma F_smul_tmul (i : I) (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    F R v i • mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
      mk M₁ M₂ ((F R v i • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (K R v (-ktilde R i) • y) + x ⊗ₜ[k] (F R v i • y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mk, act, AlgHom.comp_apply, comul_F, map_add, map_add,
    LinearMap.add_apply, act_tmul, act_tmul, one_smul, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.K_smul_tmul
statement:
lemma K_smul_tmul (μ : Y) (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    K R v μ • mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = mk M₁ M₂ ((K R v μ • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (K R v μ • y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mk, act, AlgHom.comp_apply, comul_K, act_tmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.tmul_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  rw [K_smul_tmul, hx μ, hy μ, smul_tmul_smul, ← map_smul, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
    zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.span_tmul_weight
statement:
theorem span_tmul_weight (h₁ : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M₁ Λ = ⊤)
    (h₂ : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M₂ Λ = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span k {z : TensorModule k M₁ M₂ | ∃ Λ Λ' x y, x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ Λ ∧
      y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ Λ' ∧ z = mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set S := Submodule.span k {z : TensorModule k M₁ M₂ | ∃ Λ Λ' x y,
    x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ Λ ∧ y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ Λ' ∧ z = mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)}
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro z -
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (mk M₁ M₂).surjective z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add z z' h h' => rw [map_add]; exact S.add_mem h h'
  | tmul x y =>
    have hx : x ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M₁ Λ := h₁ ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hx using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem Λ x hx =>
      have hy : y ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M₂ Λ := h₂ ▸ Submodule.mem_top
      induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem Λ' y hy => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨Λ, Λ', x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
      | zero => simp
      | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [tmul_add, map_add]; exact S.add_mem h h'
    | zero => simp
    | add x x' _ _ h h' => rw [add_tmul, map_add]; exact S.add_mem h h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.E_pow_smul_tmul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma E_pow_smul_tmul_eq_zero (i : I) (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (x : M₁) (y : M₂) (a b : ℕ), x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ Λ →
      y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ Λ' → E R v i ^ a • x = 0 → E R v i ^ b • y = 0 → a + b ≤ N →
      E R v i ^ N • mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro Λ Λ' x y a b _ _ ha _ hab
    obtain rfl : a = 0 := by omega
    rw [pow_zero, one_smul] at ha
    simp [ha]
  | succ N ih =>
    intro Λ Λ' x y a b hx hy ha hb hab
    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul, E_smul_tmul, map_add, smul_add]
    rcases a with _ | a
    · rw [pow_zero, one_smul] at ha
      simp [ha]
    rcases b with _ | b
    · rw [pow_zero, one_smul] at hb
      simp [hb]
    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul] at ha hb
    rw [Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hx,
      ← smul_tmul' ((v ^ D.d i) ^ Λ (R.coroot i)) x (E R v i • y), (mk M₁ M₂).map_smul,
      smul_comm (E R v i ^ N) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ Λ (R.coroot i)),
      ih _ _ _ _ a (b + 1) (E_smul_mem_weightSpace hx i) hy ha (by rwa [pow_succ, mul_smul])
        (by omega),
      ih _ _ _ _ (a + 1) b hx (E_smul_mem_weightSpace hy i) (by rwa [pow_succ, mul_smul]) hb
        (by omega), smul_zero, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.F_pow_smul_tmul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma F_pow_smul_tmul_eq_zero (i : I) (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (x : M₁) (y : M₂) (a b : ℕ), x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ Λ →
      y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ Λ' → F R v i ^ a • x = 0 → F R v i ^ b • y = 0 → a + b ≤ N →
      F R v i ^ N • mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro Λ Λ' x y a b _ _ ha _ hab
    obtain rfl : a = 0 := by omega
    rw [pow_zero, one_smul] at ha
    simp [ha]
  | succ N ih =>
    intro Λ Λ' x y a b hx hy ha hb hab
    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul, F_smul_tmul, map_add, smul_add]
    rcases a with _ | a
    · rw [pow_zero, one_smul] at ha
      simp [ha]
    rcases b with _ | b
    · rw [pow_zero, one_smul] at hb
      simp [hb]
    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul] at ha hb
    rw [K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hy,
      tmul_smul ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (-Λ' (R.coroot i))) (F R v i • x) y, (mk M₁ M₂).map_smul,
      smul_comm (F R v i ^ N) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (-Λ' (R.coroot i))),
      ih _ _ _ _ a (b + 1) (F_smul_mem_weightSpace hx i) hy ha (by rwa [pow_succ, mul_smul])
        (by omega),
      ih _ _ _ _ (a + 1) b hx (F_smul_mem_weightSpace hy i) (by rwa [pow_succ, mul_smul]) hb
        (by omega), smul_zero, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.isIntegrable
statement:
theorem isIntegrable (h₁ : IsIntegrable R v M₁) (h₂ : IsIntegrable R v M₂) :
    IsIntegrable R v (TensorModule k M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hspan := span_tmul_weight h₁.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top h₂.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
  refine ⟨?_, fun i z ↦ ?_, fun i z ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [eq_top_iff, ← hspan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨Λ, Λ', x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (tmul_mem_weightSpace hx hy)
  · have hz : z ∈ Submodule.span k _ := hspan ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨Λ, Λ', x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₁.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i x
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h₂.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i y
      exact ⟨a + b, E_pow_smul_tmul_eq_zero i _ Λ Λ' x y a b hx hy ha hb le_rfl⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨0, smul_zero _⟩
    | add z z' _ _ h h' =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := h'
      refine ⟨n + n', ?_⟩
      have e1 : E R v i ^ (n + n') • z = 0 := by rw [add_comm, pow_add, mul_smul, hn, smul_zero]
      have e2 : E R v i ^ (n + n') • z' = 0 := by rw [pow_add, mul_smul, hn', smul_zero]
      rw [smul_add, e1, e2, add_zero]
    | smul c z _ h =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
      exact ⟨n, by rw [smul_comm, hn, smul_zero]⟩
  · have hz : z ∈ Submodule.span k _ := hspan ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨Λ, Λ', x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₁.exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i x
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h₂.exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i y
      exact ⟨a + b, F_pow_smul_tmul_eq_zero i _ Λ Λ' x y a b hx hy ha hb le_rfl⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨0, smul_zero _⟩
    | add z z' _ _ h h' =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := h'
      refine ⟨n + n', ?_⟩
      have e1 : F R v i ^ (n + n') • z = 0 := by rw [add_comm, pow_add, mul_smul, hn, smul_zero]
      have e2 : F R v i ^ (n + n') • z' = 0 := by rw [pow_add, mul_smul, hn', smul_zero]
      rw [smul_add, e1, e2, add_zero]
    | smul c z _ h =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
      exact ⟨n, by rw [smul_comm, hn, smul_zero]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ktilde_comap

proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.levi_relations
statement:
theorem levi_relations :
    Relations (R.comap e) v (fun j ↦ E R v (e j)) (fun j ↦ F R v (e j)) (KHom R v) where
  K_mul_E μ j
proof:
:= K_mul_E R v μ (e j)
  K_mul_F μ j := K_mul_F R v μ (e j)
  E_mul_F j j' := by
    change E R v (e j) * F R v (e j') - F R v (e j') * E R v (e j) = _
    rw [E_mul_F_sub]
    simp only [e.injective.eq_iff]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      rfl
    · rfl
  serre_E _ _ h := serre_E R v (e.injective.ne h)
  serre_F _ _ h := serre_F R v (e.injective.ne h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.leviHom_E
statement: @[simp] lemma leviHom_E (j : J) : leviHom R v e (E (R.comap e) v j) = E R v (e j)
proof:
:=
  lift_E (levi_relations R v e) j

  lift_F (levi_relations R v e) j

proof:

  lift_K (levi_relations R v e) μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.leviRestrict_smul

lemma leviRestrict_smul (u : QuantumGroup (R.comap e) v) (m : LeviRestrict R v e M) :
    u • m = (leviHom R v e u • (m : M) : M)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_leviRestrict
statement:
lemma E_smul_leviRestrict (j : J) (m : LeviRestrict R v e M) :
    E (R.comap e) v j • m = (E R v (e j) • (m : M) : M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviRestrict_smul, leviHom_E]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_smul_leviRestrict

proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSpace_leviRestrict
statement:
theorem weightSpace_leviRestrict (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    weightSpace (R.comap e) v (LeviRestrict R v e M) Λ = weightSpace R v M Λ
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  change (∀ μ, K (R.comap e) v μ • m = v ^ Λ μ • m) ↔ ∀ μ, K R v μ • (m : M) = v ^ Λ μ • (m : M)
  exact forall_congr' fun μ ↦ by rw [K_smul_leviRestrict]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntegrable.leviRestrict
statement:
theorem IsIntegrable.leviRestrict (hM : IsIntegrable R v M) :
    IsIntegrable (R.comap e) v (LeviRestrict R v e M) where
  iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
proof:
:= by
    simp only [weightSpace_leviRestrict]
    exact hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
  exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero j m := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero (e j) (m : M)
    exact ⟨n, by rw [leviRestrict_smul, map_pow, leviHom_E]; exact hn⟩
  exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero j m := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM.exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero (e j) (m : M)
    exact ⟨n, by rw [leviRestrict_smul, map_pow, leviHom_F]; exact hn⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeWt_leviRestrict
statement:
lemma nodeWt_leviRestrict (j : J) (n : ℤ) :
    nodeWt (R.comap e) v (LeviRestrict R v e M) j n = nodeWt R v M (e j) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold nodeWt
  exact iSup_congr fun Λ ↦ iSup_congr fun _ ↦ weightSpace_leviRestrict Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.eq_of
statement:
lemma IntegrableSl2.eq_of {q : k} {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    {V W : IntegrableSl2 q N} (hE : V.E = W.E) (hF : V.F = W.F) (hwt : V.wt = W.wt) : V = W
proof:
:= by
  cases V
  cases W
  cases hE
  cases hF
  cases hwt
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_leviRestrict
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_leviRestrict (j : J) :
    (nodeSl2 (R.comap e) v (LeviRestrict R v e M) hv hM.leviRestrict j :
      IntegrableSl2 (v ^ D.d (e j)) M) = nodeSl2 R v M hv hM (e j)
proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableSl2.eq_of ?_ ?_ ?_
  · ext m
    exact E_smul_leviRestrict j m
  · ext m
    exact F_smul_leviRestrict j m
  · funext n
    exact nodeWt_leviRestrict j n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_map
statement:
theorem qBinomial_map (φ : k →+* L) (w : k) (n j : ℕ) :
    qBinomial (φ w) n j = φ (qBinomial w n j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => cases j <;> simp [qBinomial]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j => simp [qBinomial, ih, map_inv₀]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_algebraMap
statement:
theorem qSerre_algebraMap (w : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : B) :
    qSerre (algebraMap k L w) m a b = qSerre w m a b
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [qBinomial_map, show (-1 : L) ^ r * algebraMap k L (qBinomial w m r) =
    algebraMap k L ((-1) ^ r * qBinomial w m r) by simp, algebraMap_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.relations_algebraMap_iff
statement:
theorem relations_algebraMap_iff :
    Relations R (algebraMap k L v) e f κ ↔ Relations R v e f κ
proof:
:= by
  have hz (n : ℤ) (x : B) : algebraMap k L v ^ n • x = v ^ n • x := by
    rw [← map_zpow₀, algebraMap_smul]
  have hc (d : ℕ) (x : B) :
      (algebraMap k L v ^ d - (algebraMap k L v ^ d)⁻¹)⁻¹ • x = (v ^ d - (v ^ d)⁻¹)⁻¹ • x := by
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_inv₀, ← map_sub, ← map_inv₀, algebraMap_smul]
  have hs (d m : ℕ) (a b : B) : qSerre (algebraMap k L v ^ d) m a b = qSerre (v ^ d) m a b := by
    rw [← map_pow, qSerre_algebraMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, h4, h5⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun μ i ↦ by rw [h1, hz], fun μ i ↦ by rw [h2, hz], fun i j ↦ by rw [h3, hc]⟩,
      fun i j h ↦ by rw [← hs, h4 i j h], fun i j h ↦ by rw [← hs, h5 i j h]⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, h4, h5⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun μ i ↦ by rw [h1, hz], fun μ i ↦ by rw [h2, hz], fun i j ↦ by rw [h3, hc]⟩,
      fun i j h ↦ by rw [hs, h4 i j h], fun i j h ↦ by rw [hs, h5 i j h]⟩

:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toBaseChange_minusHom
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_minusHom (x : LusztigF k I) :
    toBaseChange (L := L) R v (minusHom R v x) =
      minusHom R (algebraMap k L v) (FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs (algebraMap k L) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 i => simp [minusHom]
  | mul a b ha hb => simp only [map_mul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

statement:

  | grade0 c => simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toBaseChange_rho
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_rho [NeZero v] (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    toBaseChange (L := L) R v (rho R v x) = rho R (algebraMap k L v) (toBaseChange R v x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | E i => simp [rhoE, Kt, toBaseChange_smul]
  | F i => simp [rhoF, toBaseChange_smul]
  | K μ => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy => simp only [rho_mul, map_mul, hx, hy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toBaseChange_mem_adWeightSpace
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have := congr_arg (toBaseChange (L := L) R v) (hx μ)
  rwa [map_mul, toBaseChange_smul, map_mul, toBaseChange_K, map_zpow₀] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_mul_mem_span_of_qSerre
statement:
theorem pow_mul_mem_span_of_qSerre {q : k} {m : ℕ} {a b : B} (h : qSerre q m a b = 0) (N : ℕ) :
    a ^ N * b ∈ Submodule.span k {x | ∃ p < m, p ≤ N ∧ x = a ^ p * b * a ^ (N - p)}
proof:
:= by
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ N ih =>
  by_cases hN : N < m
  · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨N, hN, le_rfl, by simp⟩
  push Not at hN
  
  have hs := h
  rw [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ'] at hs
  simp only [pow_zero, qBinomial_zero_right, mul_one, one_smul, Nat.sub_zero] at hs
  have hab : a ^ m * b = -∑ r ∈ Finset.range m, ((-1) ^ (r + 1) * qBinomial q m (r + 1)) •
      (a ^ (m - (r + 1)) * b * a ^ (r + 1)) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hs
  have e : a ^ N * b = a ^ (N - m) * (a ^ m * b) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hN]
  rw [e, hab, mul_neg, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r hr ↦ ?_)
  have hr := Finset.mem_range.1 hr
  rw [mul_smul_comm]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  have e' : a ^ (N - m) * (a ^ (m - (r + 1)) * b * a ^ (r + 1)) =
      a ^ (N - (r + 1)) * b * a ^ (r + 1) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show N - m + (m - (r + 1)) = N - (r + 1) by omega]
  rw [e']
  have ih' := ih (N - (r + 1)) (by omega)
  have hle : Submodule.span k {x | ∃ p < m, p ≤ N - (r + 1) ∧ x = a ^ p * b * a ^ (N - (r + 1) - p)}
      ≤ (Submodule.span k {x | ∃ p < m, p ≤ N ∧ x = a ^ p * b * a ^ (N - p)}).comap
        (LinearMap.mulRight k (a ^ (r + 1))) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨p, hp, hpN, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨p, hp, by omega, ?_⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.mulRight_apply, mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    congr 3
    omega
  exact hle ih'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.smul_eq_zero_of_mem_span
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem s hs => exact hS s hs
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_smul, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_assoc, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_pow_smul_F_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_smul]
  refine smul_eq_zero_of_mem_span ?_ (pow_mul_mem_span_of_qSerre (serre_F R v hij) _)
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, -, rfl⟩
  rw [mul_smul, hm _ (by omega), smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.iSup_weightSpace_quotient
statement:
lemma iSup_weightSpace_quotient (h : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ = ⊤)
    (N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M) : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v (M ⧸ N) Λ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  have hm : m ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ := by rw [h]; trivial
  induction hm using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem Λ m hm =>
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem Λ fun μ ↦ ?_
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, hm μ, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add m m' _ _ hm hm' => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hm hm'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_pow_smul_mk_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, by rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, hn, Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_smul_of_E_smul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma plusHom_smul_of_E_smul_eq_zero {m : M} (hm : ∀ j, E R v j • m = 0)
    (x : LusztigF k I) : plusHom R v x • m = LusztigF.counit x • m
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul, LusztigF.counit_algebraMap]
  | grade1 i => rw [plusHom_θ, hm, LusztigF.counit_θ, zero_smul]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, mul_smul, hb, smul_comm, ha, smul_smul, map_mul, mul_comm]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_smul, ha, hb, map_add, add_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntegrable.quotient
statement:
theorem IsIntegrable.quotient (hM : IsIntegrable R v M) (N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M) :
    IsIntegrable R v (M ⧸ N) where
  iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
proof:
:= iSup_weightSpace_quotient hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top N
  exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    exact exists_pow_smul_mk_eq_zero (hM.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i m)
  exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    exact exists_pow_smul_mk_eq_zero (hM.exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i m)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.lowerSpan_mono
statement:
lemma lowerSpan_mono (i : I) {n n' : ℕ} (h : n ≤ n') :
    lowerSpan R v Λ i n ≤ lowerSpan R v Λ i n'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono fun _ ⟨w, hw, e⟩ ↦ ⟨w, by omega, e⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_monomial_mem_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma toVerma_monomial_mem_lowerSpan (i : I) (w : List I) :
    toVerma R v Λ (monomial k w) ∈ lowerSpan R v Λ i (wordWeight w i + 1)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, by omega, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.F_smul_mem_lowerSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem m hm =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hm
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨j :: w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; simp only [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
        simp; omega
      · simp only [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.add_apply]
        simp [hij]; omega
    · rw [monomial_cons, toVerma_apply, toVerma_apply, map_mul, mul_smul, minusHom_θ]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.E_smul_toVerma_monomial_mem
statement:
lemma E_smul_toVerma_monomial_mem (i : I) (w : List I) :
    E R v i • toVerma R v Λ (monomial k w) ∈ lowerSpan R v Λ i (wordWeight w i)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [monomial, toVerma_one]
  | cons j w ih =>
    have ht : toVerma R v Λ (monomial k (j :: w)) = F R v j • toVerma R v Λ (monomial k w) := by
      rw [monomial_cons, toVerma_apply, toVerma_apply, map_mul, mul_smul, minusHom_θ]
    set t := toVerma R v Λ (monomial k w)
    have h := E_mul_F_sub R v i j
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h
    have hcount : wordWeight (j :: w) i = wordWeight w i + if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; simp [wordWeight_cons]; omega
      · simp [wordWeight_cons, hij]
    rw [ht, ← mul_smul, h, add_smul, mul_smul, hcount]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ (F_smul_mem_lowerSpan i j ih)
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij
      have hw := toVerma_mem_weightSpace (Λ := Λ) (R := R) (v := v)
        (monomial_mem_weightSpace (k := k) w)
      rw [smul_assoc, sub_smul, Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hw,
        K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hw, ← sub_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (toVerma_monomial_mem_lowerSpan i w))
    · rw [zero_smul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.E_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_mem_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma E_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_mem_lowerSpan (i : I) (n : ℕ) {m : VermaModule R v Λ}
    (hm : m ∈ lowerSpan R v Λ i n) : E R v i ^ n • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem m hm => obtain ⟨w, hw, -⟩ := hm; omega
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm, hx, smul_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul]
    refine ih ?_
    induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem m hm =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hm
      exact lowerSpan_mono i (by omega) (E_smul_toVerma_monomial_mem i w)
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero (i : I) (m : VermaModule R v Λ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, E R v i ^ n • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : m ∈ LinearMap.range (toVerma R v Λ) := by rw [range_toVerma]; trivial
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (monomial k (I := I))) := by
    rw [span_monomial]; trivial
  suffices ∃ n, toVerma R v Λ y ∈ lowerSpan R v Λ i n from
    this.imp fun n hn ↦ E_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_mem_lowerSpan i n hn
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨_, toVerma_monomial_mem_lowerSpan i w⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨max n n', by
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (lowerSpan_mono i (le_max_left _ _) hn)
        (lowerSpan_mono i (le_max_right _ _) hn')⟩
  | smul c x _ hx => exact hx.imp fun n hn ↦ by rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.isIntegrable_quotient
proof:
:= iSup_weightSpace_quotient iSup_weightSpace_eq_top N
  exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    exact exists_pow_smul_mk_eq_zero (exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i m)
  exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i x := by
    have h1 : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (hwv R v Λ) : VermaModule R v Λ ⧸ N) ∈
        fLocNilSubmodule R v (VermaModule R v Λ ⧸ N) i := by
      refine ⟨(Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact hN (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
    have := Submodule.smul_mem _ u h1
    rwa [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← mk_eq_smul_hwv] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.F_pow_smul_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, succ_nsmul, ← sub_sub]
    exact F_smul_mem_weightSpace ih i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_mem_maxSubmodule
statement:
theorem toVerma_mem_maxSubmodule (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : LusztigF.counit y = 0) {Λ' : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hw : toVerma R v Λ y ∈ weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) Λ')
    (hE : ∀ j, E R v j • toVerma R v Λ y = 0) : toVerma R v Λ y ∈ maxSubmodule R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_maxSubmodule_iff hR hv']
  intro u
  have e : ∀ x, minusHom R v x • toVerma R v Λ y = toVerma R v Λ (x * y) := fun x ↦ by
    rw [toVerma_apply, toVerma_apply, map_mul, mul_smul]
  induction mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
    rw [mul_smul, mul_smul, plusHom_smul_of_E_smul_eq_zero hE, smul_comm (K R v μ), hw μ,
      smul_comm (minusHom R v _), smul_comm (minusHom R v _), e, map_smul, map_smul,
      hwCoord_toVerma, map_mul, hy, mul_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  | zero => rw [zero_smul, map_zero]
  | add x x' _ _ hx hx' => rw [add_smul, map_add, hx, hx', add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_assoc, map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule
statement:
theorem fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) : fPowSubmodule R v Λ ≤ maxSubmodule R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [fPowSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have e : F R v i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) • hwv R v Λ =
      toVerma R v Λ (θ k i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1)) := by
    rw [toVerma_apply, map_pow, minusHom_θ]
  have hw := F_pow_smul_mem_weightSpace (hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ)) i
    ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1)
  change F R v i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) • hwv R v Λ ∈ maxSubmodule R v Λ
  rw [e] at hw ⊢
  refine toVerma_mem_maxSubmodule hR hv' (by simp) hw fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [← e]
  exact E_smul_F_pow_smul_eq_zero (NeZero.ne v) hwv_mem_weightSpace (fun j ↦ E_smul_hwv j)
    (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hΛ i)).symm j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable [NeZero v] (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    IsIntegrable R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ)
proof:
:=
  VermaModule.isIntegrable_quotient (VermaModule.fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule hR hv' hΛ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.FPowQuotient.isIntegrable
statement:
theorem FPowQuotient.isIntegrable [NeZero v] (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    IsIntegrable R v (FPowQuotient R v Λ)

:=
  VermaModule.isIntegrable_quotient le_rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule_surjective
statement:
theorem FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule_surjective [NeZero v] (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    Function.Surjective (FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule hR hv' hΛ)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.factor_surjective (VermaModule.fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule hR hv' hΛ)

name: LusztigF.span_mapCoeffs_tildeFamily
statement:
lemma span_mapCoeffs_tildeFamily {F : Type*} [Field F] (φ : LaurentPolynomial ℚ →+* F)
    (n : I → ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Submodule.span F (Set.range fun t ↦ mapCoeffs φ (tildeFamily D n ν t)) =
      tildeSpan D (fun i ↦ φ ((laurentT ^ D.d i : (LaurentPolynomial ℚ)ˣ) : _)) n ν
proof:
:= by
  have e : (fun t ↦ mapCoeffs φ (tildeFamily D n ν t)) = Sum.elim
      (fun t : serreIndices D ν ↦
        serreProduct D (fun i ↦ φ ((laurentT ^ D.d i : (LaurentPolynomial ℚ)ˣ) : _)) t.1)
      (fun t : powIndices n ν ↦ wordBasis F I (powWord n t.1)) := by
    funext t
    cases t with
    | inl t => exact mapCoeffs_serreProductL D φ t.1
    | inr t => exact mapCoeffs_wordBasis φ _
  rw [e, Set.Sum.elim_range, Submodule.span_union, tildeSpan, serreSpan, powSpan,
    Set.image_eq_range, Set.image_eq_range]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapovalov_comparison
statement:
theorem shapovalov_comparison [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (∀ y ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν, shapovalovMap (qCoeff R v Λ) ν y = 0 →
      y ∈ tildeSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) (fun i ↦ (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat) ν) ∧
    shapovalovRank (qCoeff R v Λ) ν =
      shapovalovRank (classicalCoeff ℚ D fun i ↦ (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := NeZero.ne v
  have hvn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1 := fun n hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn
  have hinj : Function.Injective (evalAt v hv0) :=
    LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_injective_of_transcendental hv hv0
  set n : I → ℕ := fun i ↦ (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat with hn_def
  have hnZ : ∀ i, ((n i : ℕ) : ℤ) = Λ (R.coroot i) := fun i ↦ Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hΛ i)
  set cL : I → (I →₀ ℕ) → LaurentPolynomial ℚ :=
    fun i μ ↦ vermaCoeff D (fun i ↦ Λ (R.coroot i)) i μ
  have hc₀ : (fun i ↦ (evalAt (1 : ℚ) one_ne_zero) ∘ cL i) = classicalCoeff ℚ D n := by
    funext i μ
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, cL, evalAt_one_vermaCoeff, classicalCoeff, hnZ]
  have hcq : (fun i ↦ (evalAt v hv0) ∘ cL i) = qCoeff R v Λ := rfl
  set Φ := shapovalovMap (qCoeff R v Λ) ν
  set Φ₀ := shapovalovMap (classicalCoeff ℚ D n) ν
  set V := LusztigF.weightSpace k ν
  set V₀ := LusztigF.weightSpace ℚ ν
  set Z := tildeSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) n ν
  set Z₀ := tildeSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) n ν
  
  set p : Words ν → Words ν → LaurentPolynomial ℚ :=
    fun u w ↦ vermaForm cL w.1 (wordBasis _ I u.1)
  have e₀ : (fun u : Words ν ↦ Φ₀ (wordBasis ℚ I u.1)) = fun u ↦ evalAt 1 one_ne_zero ∘ p u := by
    funext u w
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, p, map_vermaForm, mapCoeffs_wordBasis, hc₀]
    rfl
  have eq : (fun u : Words ν ↦ Φ (wordBasis k I u.1)) = fun u ↦ evalAt v hv0 ∘ p u := by
    funext u w
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, p, map_vermaForm, mapCoeffs_wordBasis, hcq]
    rfl
  have hrank : shapovalovRank (classicalCoeff ℚ D n) ν ≤ shapovalovRank (qCoeff R v Λ) ν := by
    rw [shapovalovRank, shapovalovRank, range_shapovalovMap, range_shapovalovMap]
    change finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range fun u : Words ν ↦ Φ₀ (wordBasis ℚ I u.1))) ≤
      finrank k (Submodule.span k (Set.range fun u : Words ν ↦ Φ (wordBasis k I u.1)))
    rw [e₀, eq]
    exact Submodule.finrank_span_le_of_comp_ratHom _ _ hinj p
  
  have hZker : Z ≤ (LinearMap.ker (Φ.domRestrict V)).map V.subtype := by
    intro y hy
    have hyV : y ∈ V := tildeSpan_le_weightSpace D _ n ν hy
    refine ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.domRestrict_apply,
      shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff _ hyV, ← toVerma_mem_maxSubmodule_iff hvn hR]
    exact fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule hR hvn hΛ (toVerma_mem_fPowSubmodule hvn hy)
  
  have hZZ : finrank ℚ Z₀ ≤ finrank k Z := by
    set g := tildeFamily D n ν
    have hZ₀ : Z₀ =
        Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range fun t ↦ mapCoeffs (evalAt 1 one_ne_zero) (g t)) := by
      rw [span_mapCoeffs_tildeFamily]
      simp only [evalAt_laurentT_pow, one_pow, Z₀]
    have hZ : Z = Submodule.span k (Set.range fun t ↦ mapCoeffs (evalAt v hv0) (g t)) := by
      rw [span_mapCoeffs_tildeFamily]
      simp only [evalAt_laurentT_pow, Z]
    rw [hZ₀, hZ]
    refine finrank_span_mapCoeffs_le _ _ hinj ν g (fun t ↦ ?_) (fun t ↦ ?_)
    · refine tildeSpan_le_weightSpace D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) n ν ?_
      rw [← show Z₀ = tildeSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) n ν from rfl, hZ₀]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨t, rfl⟩
    · refine tildeSpan_le_weightSpace D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) n ν ?_
      rw [← show Z = tildeSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) n ν from rfl, hZ]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨t, rfl⟩
  
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ Z₀ :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (tildeSpan_le_weightSpace D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) n ν)
  have : FiniteDimensional k Z :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (tildeSpan_le_weightSpace D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) n ν)
  have hker₀ : finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (Φ₀.domRestrict V₀)) ≤ finrank ℚ Z₀ := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
    refine Submodule.finrank_mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact mem_tildeSpan_of_shapovalovMap_eq_zero D n y.2 hy
  
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Φ.domRestrict V)
  have h2 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Φ₀.domRestrict V₀)
  have hVV₀ : finrank k V = finrank ℚ V₀ := by rw [finrank_weightSpace, finrank_weightSpace]
  have hZk : finrank k Z ≤ finrank k (LinearMap.ker (Φ.domRestrict V)) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]; exact Submodule.finrank_mono hZker
  change finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (Φ₀.domRestrict V₀)) ≤
    finrank k (LinearMap.range (Φ.domRestrict V)) at hrank
  refine ⟨fun y hy hΦ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  swap
  · change finrank k (LinearMap.range (Φ.domRestrict V)) =
      finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (Φ₀.domRestrict V₀))
    omega
  have hEq : Z = (LinearMap.ker (Φ.domRestrict V)).map V.subtype :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hZker (by rw [Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]; omega)
  rw [hEq]
  exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hΦ, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff_mem_tildeSpan
statement:
theorem shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff_mem_tildeSpan [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v)
    (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν) :
    shapovalovMap (qCoeff R v Λ) ν y = 0 ↔
      y ∈ tildeSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) (fun i ↦ (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hvn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1 := fun n hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn
  refine ⟨(shapovalov_comparison hv hR hΛ ν).1 y hy, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff _ hy, ← toVerma_mem_maxSubmodule_iff hvn hR]
  exact fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule hR hvn hΛ (toVerma_mem_fPowSubmodule hvn h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapovalovRank_qCoeff
statement:
theorem shapovalovRank_qCoeff [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    shapovalovRank (qCoeff R v Λ) ν =
      shapovalovRank (classicalCoeff ℚ D fun i ↦ (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat) ν
proof:
:=
  (shapovalov_comparison hv hR hΛ ν).2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule
statement:
theorem maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) : maxSubmodule R v Λ = fPowSubmodule R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hvn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1 := fun n hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn
  refine le_antisymm (fun m hm ↦ ?_) (fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule hR hvn hΛ)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toVerma_surjective hvn m
  rw [toVerma_mem_maxSubmodule_iff hvn hR] at hm
  rw [← sum_weightProj y, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun ν _ ↦ toVerma_mem_fPowSubmodule hvn
    ((shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff_mem_tildeSpan hv hR hΛ (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν y)).1 ?_)
  rw [shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff _ (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν y)]
  intro w
  rw [vermaForm_weightProj, hm w, ite_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule_injective
statement:
theorem FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule_injective [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v)
    (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    Function.Injective (FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule hR hv' hΛ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule, ← Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.factor_mk,
    Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero,
    VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule hv hR hΛ] at hx
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_eq
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_eq [Fintype I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v)
    (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) {K H : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [AddCommGroup H] [Module K H] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    (P : Matrix.Realization D.cartanMatrix K H) {Λ' : Module.Dual K H}
    (hΛ' : ∀ i, Λ' (P.coroot i) = Λ (R.coroot i)) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank k (weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ) (Λ - R.rootSum ν)) =
      finrank K (LieModule.weightSpaceOfMap
        (Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule P Λ')
        (Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.h P) (Λ' - P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hvn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1 := fun n hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn
  have hn : ∀ i, Λ' (P.coroot i) = ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat : K) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [hΛ', ← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hΛ i)]
  rw [VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_irreducibleModule hvn hR,
    LusztigF.finrank_weightSpace_irreducibleModule D P hn, shapovalovRank_classicalCoeff,
    VermaModule.shapovalovRank_qCoeff hv hR hΛ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule_ratFunc
statement:
theorem VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule_ratFunc [Finite I] (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    maxSubmodule R (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) Λ = fPowSubmodule R RatFunc.X Λ
proof:
:=
  haveI : NeZero (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) := ⟨RatFunc.X_ne_zero⟩
  maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule transcendental_ratFunc_X hR hΛ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_eq_ratFunc
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_eq_ratFunc [Fintype I] (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) {K H : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] [AddCommGroup H]
    [Module K H] [FiniteDimensional K H] (P : Matrix.Realization D.cartanMatrix K H)
    {Λ' : Module.Dual K H} (hΛ' : ∀ i, Λ' (P.coroot i) = Λ (R.coroot i)) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank (RatFunc ℚ)
        (weightSpace R (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) (IrreducibleModule R (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) Λ)
          (Λ - R.rootSum ν)) =
      finrank K (LieModule.weightSpaceOfMap
        (Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule P Λ')
        (Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.h P) (Λ' - P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ)))
proof:
:=
  haveI : NeZero (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) := ⟨RatFunc.X_ne_zero⟩
  finrank_weightSpace_eq transcendental_ratFunc_X hR hΛ P hΛ' ν

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_primitive
statement:
theorem F_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_primitive (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (hN : IsIntegrable R v N) {w : N} (hw : w ∈ weightSpace R v N Λ)
    (hE : ∀ i, E R v i • w = 0) (i : I) : F R v i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) • w = 0
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v N hv' hN i
  have hwt : w ∈ V.wt (Λ (R.coroot i)) := mem_nodeWt_of_mem hw
  by_cases hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)
  · have h0 := IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive (V := V) (pow_d_ne_zero i)
      (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) hwt (hE i) (b := (Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1)
      (by push_cast; omega)
    rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_apply, smul_eq_zero] at h0
    rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd h0 (inv_ne_zero (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one
        (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) _))
    · have : ∀ n : ℕ, (V.F ^ n) w = F R v i ^ n • w := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, nodeSl2_F,
            Algebra.lsmul_apply, ← mul_smul, ← pow_succ']
      rw [← this]; exact h0
  · have h0 := IntegrableSl2.eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg (V := V) (pow_d_ne_zero i)
      (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) hwt (hE i) (by omega)
    rw [h0, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.liftOfFPow_hwv

@[simp] lemma liftOfFPow_hwv (hF : ∀ i, F R v i ^ ((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) • w = 0) :
    liftOfFPow hvt hR hv' hΛ w hw hE hF (hwv R v Λ) = w
proof:

      Submodule.Quotient.mk (VermaModule.hwv R v Λ) := by

  simp [liftOfFPow, this]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsContravariantPairing.eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := DFunLike.ne_iff.1 h
  have e := hP (K R v μ) n m
  rw [rho_K, hn μ, hm μ, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul] at e
  have hne : v ^ Λ μ ≠ v ^ Λ' μ := by
    intro he
    refine zpow_ne_one_of_not_root hv' (sub_ne_zero.2 hμ) ?_
    rw [zpow_sub₀ (NeZero.ne v), he, div_self (zpow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))]
  have : (v ^ Λ μ - v ^ Λ' μ) * P n m = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, e, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.2 hne)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsContravariant.isContravariantPairing_compl₂
proof:
:= fun u n m ↦ by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsGoodForm.nondegenerate_restrict
statement:
lemma IsGoodForm.nondegenerate_restrict (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    (BM.restrict (weightSpace R v M Λ)).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x : weightSpace R v M Λ, (∀ y : weightSpace R v M Λ, BM x y = 0) → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subtype.ext (hB.nondegenerate _ fun m' ↦ ?_)
    have hm' : m' ∈ ⨆ Λ', weightSpace R v M Λ' := by
      rw [hB.isIntegrable.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
    induction hm' using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem Λ' m' hm' =>
      by_cases h : Λ = Λ'
      · subst h; exact hx ⟨m', hm'⟩
      · exact hB.isContravariant.eq_zero_of_ne h x.2 hm' hv'
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  exact ⟨fun x hx ↦ key x hx, fun y hy ↦ key y fun x ↦ by rw [hB.symm]; exact hy x⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjointWeight_mem
statement:
lemma adjointWeight_mem (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (n : weightSpace R v N Λ) :
    adjointWeight hv' hB P Λ n ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ
proof:
:= by
  simp [adjointWeight]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_adjointWeight
statement:
lemma form_adjointWeight (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (n : weightSpace R v N Λ) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) : BM (adjointWeight hv' hB P Λ n) m = P n m
proof:
:= by
  have := hB.finiteDimensional Λ
  have := LinearMap.BilinForm.apply_toDual_symm_apply
    (hB := hB.nondegenerate_restrict (hv' := hv') Λ)
    ((P.compl₂ (weightSpace R v M Λ).subtype) n) ⟨m, hm⟩
  simpa [adjointWeight] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoint_of_mem
statement:
lemma adjoint_of_mem {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ weightSpace R v N Λ) :
    adjoint hv' hB hN P n = adjointWeight hv' hB P Λ ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (weightSpace R v N))
      (isInternal_weightSpace hv' hN)).symm n =
      DirectSum.of (fun Λ ↦ weightSpace R v N Λ) Λ ⟨n, hn⟩ := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    exact (DirectSum.coeLinearMap_of (A := weightSpace R v N) Λ ⟨n, hn⟩).symm
  simp only [adjoint, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, h]
  exact DirectSum.toModule_lof k Λ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_adjoint
statement: theorem form_adjoint (n : N) (m : M) : BM (adjoint hv' hB hN P n) m = P n m
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v N Λ := by rw [hN.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
  induction hn using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem Λ n hn =>
    have hm : m ∈ ⨆ Λ', weightSpace R v M Λ' := by
      rw [hB.isIntegrable.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
    induction hm using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem Λ' m hm =>
      rw [adjoint_of_mem hB hN hn]
      by_cases h : Λ = Λ'
      · subst h; exact form_adjointWeight hB Λ _ hm
      · rw [hB.isContravariant.eq_zero_of_ne h (adjointWeight_mem hB Λ _) hm hv',
          hP.eq_zero_of_ne hv' h hn hm]
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, map_add,
      LinearMap.add_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoint_smul
statement:
theorem adjoint_smul (u : QuantumGroup R v) (n : N) :
    adjoint hv' hB hN P (u • n) = u • adjoint hv' hB hN P n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine hB.nondegenerate _ fun m ↦ ?_
  rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, form_adjoint hB hN hP, hP, hB.isContravariant,
    form_adjoint hB hN hP, sub_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjointHom_apply

@[simp] lemma adjointHom_apply (n : N) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSpace_quotient_le_map
statement:
theorem weightSpace_quotient_le_map (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (hM : ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ = ⊤) (P : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M) (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    weightSpace R v (M ⧸ P) Λ ≤ (weightSpace R v M Λ).map (P.mkQ.restrictScalars k)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  have hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ ⊔ ⨆ (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (_ : μ ≠ Λ), weightSpace R v M μ := by
    have : ⊤ ≤ weightSpace R v M Λ ⊔ ⨆ (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (_ : μ ≠ Λ), weightSpace R v M μ := by
      rw [← hM]
      refine iSup_le fun μ ↦ ?_
      by_cases h : μ = Λ
      · subst h; exact le_sup_left
      · exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup₂_of_le μ h le_rfl)
    exact this Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hm
  have hb' : (Submodule.Quotient.mk b : M ⧸ P) ∈
      ⨆ (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (_ : μ ≠ Λ), weightSpace R v (M ⧸ P) μ := by
    clear hx ha hm
    induction hb using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem μ b hb =>
      induction hb using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem hμ b hb =>
        refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμ fun ν ↦ ?_)
        rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, hb ν, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
      | zero => simp
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  have ha' : (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : M ⧸ P) ∈ weightSpace R v (M ⧸ P) Λ := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ha ν, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
  have hb0 : (Submodule.Quotient.mk b : M ⧸ P) = 0 := by
    have hbΛ : (Submodule.Quotient.mk b : M ⧸ P) ∈ weightSpace R v (M ⧸ P) Λ := by
      have := sub_mem hx ha'
      rwa [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_weightSpace hv' Λ)) _ hbΛ hb'
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk a = _
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, hb0, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_weightSpace (Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) :
    FiniteDimensional k (weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ) Λ')
proof:
:= by
  have hle := weightSpace_quotient_le_map hv' VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
    (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R v Λ) Λ'
  by_cases h : ∃ ν, Λ' = Λ - R.rootSum ν
  · obtain ⟨ν, rfl⟩ := h
    have := VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace (Λ := Λ) hv' hR ν
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le hle
  · push Not at h
    rw [VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot hv' h, Submodule.map_bot] at hle
    rw [le_bot_iff.1 hle]
    infer_instance

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.isGoodForm_form
statement:
theorem isGoodForm_form (hΛ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) :
    IsGoodForm (R := R) (v := v) (form Λ hR hv') where
  isIntegrable
proof:
:= IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable hR hv' hΛ
  finiteDimensional := finiteDimensional_weightSpace hR hv'
  isContravariant := isContravariant_form hR hv'
  symm := form_comm hR hv'
