name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorForm_tensorEmb
statement:
theorem tensorForm_tensorEmb (x y : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) :
    tensorForm hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ x) (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ y) =
      IrreducibleModule.form (Λ₁ + Λ₂) hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hB : IsContravariant R v ((tensorForm hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂).compl₁₂
      ((tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂).restrictScalars k)
      ((tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂).restrictScalars k)) := by
    intro u a b
    simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, map_smul]
    exact isContravariant_tensorForm hvt hR u _ _
  have := IrreducibleModule.eq_smul_form_of_isContravariant hR
    (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hB x y
  simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, tensorEmb_hwv,
    TensorModule.form_tmul, IrreducibleModule.form_hwv, mul_one, one_mul] at this
  exact this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_tensorProj
statement:
theorem form_tensorProj (z : TensorModule k (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁) (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₂))
    (x : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) :
    IrreducibleModule.form (Λ₁ + Λ₂) hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
      (tensorProj hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ z) x = tensorForm hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ z (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ x)
proof:
:=
  form_adjoint (IrreducibleModule.isGoodForm_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
      (fun i ↦ by rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply]; exact add_nonneg (hΛ₁ i) (hΛ₂ i)))
    (TensorModule.isIntegrable
      (IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hΛ₁)
      (IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hΛ₂))
    ((isContravariant_tensorForm hvt hR).isContravariantPairing_compl₂
      (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂)) z x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorProj_tensorEmb
statement:
theorem tensorProj_tensorEmb (x : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) :
    tensorProj hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine IrreducibleModule.eq_zero_of_form_eq_zero hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
    fun y ↦ ?_
  rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, form_tensorProj, tensorForm_tensorEmb, sub_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoF_smul_hwv
statement: lemma rhoF_smul_hwv (i : I) : rhoF R v i • IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul, IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.form_hwv_F_smul
statement:
lemma IrreducibleModule.form_hwv_F_smul (i : I) (x : IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁) :
    IrreducibleModule.form Λ₁ hR hv' (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁) (F R v i • x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IrreducibleModule.form_comm, IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form, rho_F,
    rhoF_smul_hwv, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorHead_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorHead_tmul (x : IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁) (y : M) :
    tensorHead hR hv' Λ₁ (TensorModule.mk _ _ (x ⊗ₜ y)) =
      IrreducibleModule.form Λ₁ hR hv' (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁) x • y
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorHead]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorHead_F_smul
statement:
theorem tensorHead_F_smul (i : I) (z : TensorModule k (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁) M) :
    tensorHead hR hv' Λ₁ (F R v i • z) = F R v i • tensorHead hR hv' Λ₁ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (TensorModule.mk (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁) M).surjective z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, map_add, map_add, tensorHead_tmul, tensorHead_tmul,
      tensorHead_tmul, IrreducibleModule.form_hwv_F_smul, zero_smul, zero_add, smul_comm]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, smul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorHead_tensorEmb_hwv
statement:
lemma tensorHead_tensorEmb_hwv :
    tensorHead hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) Λ₁
      (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂))) =
      IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEmb_hwv, tensorHead_tmul, IrreducibleModule.form_hwv, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorHead_tensorEmb_F_smul
statement:
lemma tensorHead_tensorEmb_F_smul (i : I) (x : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) :
    tensorHead hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) Λ₁ (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ (F R v i • x)) =
      F R v i • tensorHead hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) Λ₁
        (tensorEmb hvt hR hΛ₁ hΛ₂ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul, tensorHead_F_smul]

name: LusztigF.weightProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightProj_of_mem [DecidableEq (I →₀ ℕ)] {ν ν₀ : I →₀ ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k ν) : weightProj ν₀ y = if ν = ν₀ then y else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightProj, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, gradingHom_of_mem hy]
  by_cases h : ν = ν₀
  · simp [h, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single]
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single]

name: LusztigF.weightProj_mem
statement: lemma weightProj_mem (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (y : LusztigF k I) : weightProj ν y ∈ weightSpace k ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace k (I := I) μ := by rw [iSup_weightSpace]; trivial
  induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ y hy =>
    rw [weightProj_of_mem hy]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact h ▸ hy
    · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz

name: LusztigF.eq_algebraMap_of_mem_weightSpace_zero
statement:
lemma eq_algebraMap_of_mem_weightSpace_zero {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k 0) :
    y = algebraMap k _ (counit y)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    cases w with
    | nil => simp [monomial]
    | cons l w =>
      exfalso
      have := congr($hw l)
      simp at this
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, ← hy, ← hz]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul counit, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ← hy, Algebra.smul_def]

name: LusztigF.counit_weightProj_zero
statement: lemma counit_weightProj_zero (y : LusztigF k I) : counit (weightProj 0 y) = counit y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace k (I := I) μ := by rw [iSup_weightSpace]; trivial
  induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ y hy =>
    rw [weightProj_of_mem hy]
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · rw [counit_eq_zero_of_mem h hy, map_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.mk_eq_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma mk_eq_smul_hwv (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk u : VermaModule R v Λ) = u • hwv R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.E_smul_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma E_smul_hwv (i : I) : E R v i • hwv R v Λ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.K_smul_hwv
statement: lemma K_smul_hwv (μ : Y) : K R v μ • hwv R v Λ = v ^ Λ μ • hwv R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← algebraMap_smul (QuantumGroup R v), ← sub_smul, ← mk_eq_smul_hwv,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma hwv_mem_weightSpace : hwv R v Λ ∈ weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) Λ
proof: := K_smul_hwv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.plusHom_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma plusHom_smul_hwv (x : LusztigF k I) :
    plusHom R v x • hwv R v Λ = LusztigF.counit x • hwv R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul, LusztigF.counit_algebraMap]
  | grade1 i => rw [plusHom_θ, E_smul_hwv, LusztigF.counit_θ, zero_smul]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, mul_smul, hb, smul_comm, ha, smul_smul, map_mul, mul_comm]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_smul, ha, hb, map_add, add_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_apply
statement: lemma toVerma_apply (y : LusztigF k I) : toVerma R v Λ y = minusHom R v y • hwv R v Λ
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_one
statement: @[simp] lemma toVerma_one : toVerma R v Λ 1 = hwv R v Λ
proof: := by simp [toVerma_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_algebraMap
statement: lemma toVerma_algebraMap (c : k) : toVerma R v Λ (algebraMap k _ c) = c • hwv R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVerma_apply, AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    induction w with
    | nil => simpa [monomial] using hwv_mem_weightSpace
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [monomial_cons, toVerma_apply, map_mul, mul_smul, minusHom_θ, ← toVerma_apply,
        wordWeight_cons, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, add_comm, ← sub_sub]
      exact F_smul_mem_weightSpace ih j
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.iSup_map_toVerma
statement:
theorem iSup_map_toVerma :
    ⨆ ν, (LusztigF.weightSpace k (I := I) ν).map (toVerma R v Λ) =
    LinearMap.range (toVerma R v Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, LusztigF.iSup_weightSpace, Submodule.map_top]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.exists_zeroHom_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_zeroHom_smul_eq (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (ν₀ : I →₀ ℕ) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    ∃ g, charHom v (Λ - R.rootSum ν₀) g = 1 ∧
      zeroHom R v g • toVerma R v Λ y = toVerma R v Λ (weightProj ν₀ y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ μ, LusztigF.weightSpace k (I := I) μ := by rw [LusztigF.iSup_weightSpace]; trivial
  induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν y hy =>
    rw [weightProj_of_mem hy]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact ⟨1, map_one _, by rw [map_one, one_smul]⟩
    · have hne : Λ - R.rootSum ν₀ ≠ Λ - R.rootSum ν := fun e ↦ by
        obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR h
        have := congr($e μ)
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply] at this
        omega
      obtain ⟨g, hg1, hg2⟩ := exists_charHom_eq_one_eq_zero hv' hne
      exact ⟨g, hg1, by rw [zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace (toVerma_mem_weightSpace hy), hg2,
        zero_smul, map_zero]⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨1, map_one _, by simp⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, hy⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, hz⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨g₁ * g₂, by rw [map_mul, hg₁, hg₂, one_mul], ?_⟩
    have h₁ := zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace (M := VermaModule R v Λ)
      (toVerma_mem_weightSpace (Λ := Λ) (weightProj_mem ν₀ y))
    have h₂ := zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace (M := VermaModule R v Λ)
      (toVerma_mem_weightSpace (Λ := Λ) (weightProj_mem ν₀ z))
    have e1 : zeroHom R v (g₁ * g₂) • toVerma R v Λ y =
        zeroHom R v g₂ • zeroHom R v g₁ • toVerma R v Λ y := by
      rw [← mul_smul, ← map_mul, mul_comm]
    have e2 : zeroHom R v (g₁ * g₂) • toVerma R v Λ z =
        zeroHom R v g₁ • zeroHom R v g₂ • toVerma R v Λ z := by
      rw [← mul_smul, ← map_mul]
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, smul_add, e1, e2, hy, hz, h₁, h₂, hg₁, hg₂, one_smul,
      one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.serreSubmodule_le_ker_toVerma
statement:
lemma serreSubmodule_le_ker_toVerma :
    serreSubmodule D v ≤ LinearMap.ker (toVerma R v Λ)
proof:
:= fun y hy ↦ by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, toVerma_apply, (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).1
    (serreIdeal_le_ker_minusHom (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) hv' (mem_serreSubmodule.1 hy)), zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.triCoord_tmul
statement:
lemma triCoord_tmul (y : LusztigF k I) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    triCoord D v Λ (y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x)) =
      (charHom v Λ g * LusztigF.counit x) • Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) y
proof:
:= by
  simp [triCoord]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.serreTriSubmodule_le_ker_triCoord
statement:
lemma serreTriSubmodule_le_ker_triCoord :
    serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker (triCoord D v Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨y, g, x, rfl, h | h⟩
  · simp [triCoord_tmul, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (mem_serreSubmodule.2 h)]
  · simp [triCoord_tmul, counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.coordAux_triangular
statement:
lemma coordAux_triangular (y : LusztigF k I) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    coordAux Λ hv' (minusHom R v y * zeroHom R v g * plusHom R v x) =
      (charHom v Λ g * LusztigF.counit x) • Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← triangularEquiv_mk R v hv', coordAux, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Submodule.liftQ_apply, triCoord_tmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.coordAux_triangular'
statement:
lemma coordAux_triangular' (y : LusztigF k I) (μ : Y) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    coordAux Λ hv' (minusHom R v y * K R v μ * plusHom R v x) =
      (v ^ Λ μ * LusztigF.counit x) • Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeroHom_single, coordAux_triangular, charHom_single, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.mem_triangularSpan_of
statement: lemma mem_triangularSpan_of (u : QuantumGroup R v) (hv : v ≠ 0) : u ∈ triangularSpan R v
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_triangular (R := R) hv]; trivial

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.range_toVerma
statement: theorem range_toVerma : LinearMap.range (toVerma R v Λ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro m -
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  induction mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
    refine ⟨(v ^ Λ μ * LusztigF.counit (monomial k w')) • monomial k w, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, toVerma_apply, mk_eq_smul_hwv, mul_smul, mul_smul, plusHom_smul_hwv]
    rw [mul_smul, smul_comm (K R v μ), K_smul_hwv, smul_comm (minusHom R v _),
      smul_comm (minusHom R v _), smul_comm (v ^ Λ μ)]
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.coordAux_mul_E
statement: lemma coordAux_mul_E (u : QuantumGroup R v) (i : I) : coordAux Λ hv' (u * E R v i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
    rw [mul_assoc, ← plusHom_θ R v (k := k) i, ← map_mul, coordAux_triangular', map_mul,
      LusztigF.counit_θ, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.plusHom_mul_K
statement:
lemma plusHom_mul_K (x : LusztigF k I) (ν : Y) :
    plusHom R v x * K R v ν = K R v ν * plusHom R v (tau R v ν x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp [Algebra.commutes]
  | grade1 j =>
    rw [tau_apply_θ, map_smul, plusHom_θ, E_mul_K (NeZero.ne v), mul_smul_comm]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, mul_assoc, hb, ← mul_assoc, ha, mul_assoc, map_mul, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_mul, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, mul_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.coordAux_mul_K
statement:
lemma coordAux_mul_K (u : QuantumGroup R v) (ν : Y) :
    coordAux Λ hv' (u * K R v ν) = v ^ Λ ν • coordAux Λ hv' u
proof:
:= by
  induction mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
    rw [mul_assoc, plusHom_mul_K, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc (minusHom R v _), K_add,
      coordAux_triangular', coordAux_triangular', tau, LusztigF.counit_diagTwist, smul_smul,
      map_add, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
    ring_nf
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hx, map_smul, smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.coordAux_mul_of_mem
statement:
lemma coordAux_mul_of_mem {z : QuantumGroup R v} (hz : z ∈ vermaIdeal R v Λ)
    (u : QuantumGroup R v) : coordAux Λ hv' (u * z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction generalizing u with
  | mem z hz =>
    rcases hz with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, rfl⟩
    · exact coordAux_mul_E hv' u i
    · rw [mul_sub, map_sub, coordAux_mul_K, ← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul,
        sub_self]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, hx]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.ofVerma_mk
statement:
lemma ofVerma_mk (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    ofVerma Λ hv' (Submodule.Quotient.mk u) = coordAux Λ hv' u
proof:
:= by
  simp [ofVerma]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.equivSerreQuotient_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivSerreQuotient_mk (y : LusztigF k I) :
    equivSerreQuotient Λ hv' (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = minusHom R v y • hwv R v Λ
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem toVerma_eq_zero_iff (y : LusztigF k I) :
    toVerma R v Λ y = 0 ↔ y ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_serreSubmodule, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero,
    ← (equivSerreQuotient Λ hv').map_eq_zero_iff, equivSerreQuotient_mk, toVerma_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.toVerma_surjective
statement: theorem toVerma_surjective : Function.Surjective (toVerma R v Λ)
proof:
:= fun m ↦ by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := (equivSerreQuotient Λ hv').surjective m
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
  exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_map
statement:
theorem weightSpace_eq_map (hR : R.IsXRegular) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    QuantumGroup.weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) (Λ - R.rootSum ν) =
      (LusztigF.weightSpace k ν).map (toVerma R v Λ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun m hm ↦ ?_) ?_
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toVerma_surjective hv' m
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgy⟩ := exists_zeroHom_smul_eq hR hv' ν y
    rw [zeroHom_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hm, hg, one_smul] at hgy
    exact ⟨_, weightProj_mem ν y, hgy.symm⟩
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact fun y hy ↦ toVerma_mem_weightSpace hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_weightSpace_eq_top :
    ⨆ Λ', QuantumGroup.weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) Λ' = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← range_toVerma, ← iSup_map_toVerma]
  exact iSup_le fun ν ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun y hy ↦
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (toVerma_mem_weightSpace hy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.counitQ_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma counitQ_mk (y : LusztigF k I) :
    counitQ D v (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = LusztigF.counit y
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_eq_bot {Λ' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : ∀ ν, Λ' ≠ Λ - R.rootSum ν) :
    QuantumGroup.weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) Λ' = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have htop : ⨆ ν : I →₀ ℕ, QuantumGroup.weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ)
      (Λ - R.rootSum ν) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← range_toVerma, ← iSup_map_toVerma]
    exact iSup_mono fun ν ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun y hy ↦ toVerma_mem_weightSpace hy
  have hle : ⨆ ν : I →₀ ℕ, QuantumGroup.weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) (Λ - R.rootSum ν) ≤
      ⨆ Λ'' , ⨆ (_ : Λ'' ≠ Λ'), QuantumGroup.weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) Λ'' :=
    iSup_le fun ν ↦ le_iSup₂_of_le (Λ - R.rootSum ν) (Ne.symm (h ν)) le_rfl
  have := (iSupIndep_weightSpace (M := VermaModule R v Λ) hv' Λ').mono_right
    (htop.symm.le.trans hle)
  exact disjoint_top.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_weightSpace (hR : R.IsXRegular) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional k
      (QuantumGroup.weightSpace R v (VermaModule R v Λ) (Λ - R.rootSum ν))
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace_eq_map hv' hR]
  infer_instance

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwCoord_toVerma
statement:
@[simp] theorem hwCoord_toVerma (y : LusztigF k I) :
    hwCoord Λ hv' (toVerma R v Λ y) = LusztigF.counit y
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwCoord, LinearMap.comp_apply, toVerma_apply, ← equivSerreQuotient_mk hv',
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, counitQ_mk]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwCoord_hwv
statement: @[simp] theorem hwCoord_hwv : hwCoord Λ hv' (hwv R v Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toVerma_one, hwCoord_toVerma, map_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.eq_top_of_hwCoord_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toVerma_surjective hv' m
  obtain ⟨g, -, hgy⟩ := exists_zeroHom_smul_eq hR hv' 0 y
  have e : toVerma R v Λ (weightProj 0 y) = LusztigF.counit y • hwv R v Λ := by
    rw [eq_algebraMap_of_mem_weightSpace_zero (weightProj_mem 0 y), toVerma_algebraMap,
      counit_weightProj_zero]
  rw [e] at hgy
  rw [hwCoord_toVerma] at hc
  have hw : hwv R v Λ ∈ N := by
    have := N.smul_of_tower_mem (LusztigF.counit y)⁻¹ (N.smul_mem (zeroHom R v g) hm)
    rwa [hgy, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul] at this
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro m _
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  rw [mk_eq_smul_hwv]
  exact N.smul_mem u hw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.le_maxSubmodule
statement:
theorem le_maxSubmodule {N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) (VermaModule R v Λ)} (hN : N ≠ ⊤) :
    N ≤ maxSubmodule R v Λ
proof:
:=
  le_sSup hN

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.mem_maxSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maxSubmodule_iff {m : VermaModule R v Λ} :
    m ∈ maxSubmodule R v Λ ↔ ∀ u : QuantumGroup R v, hwCoord Λ hv' (u • m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let M' : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) (VermaModule R v Λ) :=
    { carrier := {m | ∀ u : QuantumGroup R v, hwCoord Λ hv' (u • m) = 0}
      add_mem' := fun ha hb u ↦ by rw [smul_add, map_add, ha u, hb u, add_zero]
      zero_mem' := fun u ↦ by rw [smul_zero, map_zero]
      smul_mem' := fun a m hm u ↦ by rw [smul_smul]; exact hm _ }
  have hM' : M' ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ by
    have : hwv R v Λ ∈ M' := by rw [h]; trivial
    simpa using this 1
  have h1 : maxSubmodule R v Λ ≤ M' := sSup_le fun N hN m hm u ↦ by
    by_contra hc
    exact hN (eq_top_of_hwCoord_ne_zero hv' hR (N.smul_mem u hm) hc)
  exact ⟨fun hm ↦ h1 hm, fun hm ↦ le_maxSubmodule hM' hm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule
statement: theorem hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule : hwv R v Λ ∉ maxSubmodule R v Λ
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  simpa using (mem_maxSubmodule_iff hR hv').1 h 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_ne_top
statement: theorem maxSubmodule_ne_top : maxSubmodule R v Λ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule hR hv' (by rw [h]; trivial)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.isCoatom_maxSubmodule
statement: theorem isCoatom_maxSubmodule : IsCoatom (maxSubmodule R v Λ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨maxSubmodule_ne_top hR hv', fun _ hN ↦ by
    by_contra h
    exact hN.not_ge (le_maxSubmodule h)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.eq_maxSubmodule_of_isCoatom
statement:
theorem eq_maxSubmodule_of_isCoatom {N : Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) (VermaModule R v Λ)}
    (hN : IsCoatom N) : N = maxSubmodule R v Λ
proof:
:=
  ((hN.le_iff_eq (maxSubmodule_ne_top hR hv')).1 (le_maxSubmodule hN.1)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.isSimpleModule
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.isSimpleModule (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) : IsSimpleModule (QuantumGroup R v) (IrreducibleModule R v Λ)
proof:
:=
  isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.2 (VermaModule.isCoatom_maxSubmodule hR hv')

name: LieAlgebra.adProd_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma adProd_nil (x : L) : adProd [] x = x
proof: := rfl

name: LieAlgebra.adProd_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma adProd_cons (y : L) (l : List L) (x : L) :
    adProd (y :: l) x = ⁅y, adProd l x⁆
proof: := rfl

name: LieSubalgebra.subset_adProdSet
statement: lemma subset_adProdSet (s : Set L) : s ⊆ adProdSet s
proof:
:=
  fun x hx ↦ ⟨[], by simp, x, hx, rfl⟩

name: LieSubalgebra.lie_mem_span_adProdSet
statement:
lemma lie_mem_span_adProdSet {s : Set L} {y : L} (hy : y ∈ s) {z : L}
    (hz : z ∈ Submodule.span R (adProdSet s)) : ⁅y, z⁆ ∈ Submodule.span R (adProdSet s)
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, hl, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨y :: l, ?_, x, hx, rfl⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hw
    exacts [hy, hl w hw]
  | zero => simp
  | add z₁ z₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [lie_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | smul c z _ h => rw [lie_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c h

name: LieSubalgebra.lie_mem_span_adProdSet_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction generalizing w with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, hl, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
    induction l generalizing w with
    | nil => exact lie_mem_span_adProdSet hx hw
    | cons y l ih =>
      have hy : y ∈ s := hl y (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      have hl' : ∀ u ∈ l, u ∈ s := fun u hu ↦ hl u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu)
      rw [adProd_cons, lie_lie]
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (lie_mem_span_adProdSet hy (ih hw hl'))
        (ih (lie_mem_span_adProdSet hy hw) hl')
  | zero => simp
  | add z₁ z₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [add_lie]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ (h₁ hw) (h₂ hw)
  | smul c z _ h => rw [smul_lie]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (h hw)

name: LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_toSubmodule_eq_span_adProd
statement:
theorem lieSpan_toSubmodule_eq_span_adProd (s : Set L) :
    (lieSpan R L s).toSubmodule = Submodule.span R (adProdSet s)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · let S : LieSubalgebra R L :=
      { Submodule.span R (adProdSet s) with
        lie_mem' := fun hz hw ↦ lie_mem_span_adProdSet_of_mem hz hw }
    have : lieSpan R L s ≤ S :=
      lieSpan_le.mpr fun x hx ↦ Submodule.subset_span (subset_adProdSet s hx)
    exact this
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨l, hl, x, hx, rfl⟩
    induction l with
    | nil => exact subset_lieSpan hx
    | cons y l ih =>
      exact (lieSpan R L s).lie_mem (subset_lieSpan (hl y (List.mem_cons_self ..)))
        (ih fun u hu ↦ hl u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu))

name: LieSubalgebra.engel_eq_top_of_lieSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem engel_eq_top_of_lieSpan_eq_top {s : Set L} (hs : lieSpan R L s = ⊤) (x : L)
    (hx : ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ n : ℕ, (ad R L x ^ n) y = 0) : engel R x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← hs, lieSpan_le]
  intro y hy
  exact (mem_engel_iff R x y).mpr (hx y hy)

name: LieSubalgebra.exists_ad_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_ad_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan_eq_top {s : Set L} (hs : lieSpan R L s = ⊤) (x : L)
    (hx : ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ n : ℕ, (ad R L x ^ n) y = 0) (y : L) : ∃ n : ℕ, (ad R L x ^ n) y = 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_engel_iff R x y).mp (engel_eq_top_of_lieSpan_eq_top hs x hx ▸ mem_top y)

name: LieSubalgebra.map_engel_le
statement: lemma map_engel_le (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') (x : L) : (engel R x).map f ≤ engel R (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (mem_engel_iff R x y).mp hy
  refine (mem_engel_iff R (f x) (f y)).mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : L), f ((ad R L x ^ k) z) = (ad R L' (f x) ^ k) (f z) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro z
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, LieHom.map_lie, ih, pow_succ',
        Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
  rw [← key, hn, map_zero]

name: LieSubalgebra.engel_eq_top_of_surjective
statement:
lemma engel_eq_top_of_surjective {f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L'} (hf : Function.Surjective f) {x : L}
    (hx : engel R x = ⊤) : engel R (f x) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro _ -
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf ‹L'›
  exact map_engel_le f x ⟨y, hx ▸ mem_top y, rfl⟩

name: IsSl2Triple.HasPrimitiveVectorWith.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero [IsDomain R] [CharZero R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M]
    (P : t.HasPrimitiveVectorWith m μ) (hm : ∃ n : ℕ, ((toEnd R L M f) ^ n) m = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, μ = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn₁, hn₂⟩ := Nat.exists_not_and_succ_of_not_zero_of_exists (by simpa using P.ne_zero)
    hm
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  have := P.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f n
  rw [hn₂, lie_zero, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero_iff_left hn₁, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this.resolve_left <| Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero n

name: LieModule.extCocycles.map_add'
statement: theorem map_add' (c : extCocycles φ M N) (x y : L) : c.1 (x + y) = c.1 x + c.1 y

name: LieModule.extCocycles.map_smul'
statement: theorem map_smul' (c : extCocycles φ M N) (t : K) (x : L) : c.1 (t • x) = t • c.1 x

name: LieModule.extCocycles.map_apply_eq_zero
statement: theorem map_apply_eq_zero (c : extCocycles φ M N) (a : H) : c.1 (φ a) = 0

name: LieModule.extCocycles.map_zero'
statement: theorem map_zero' (c : extCocycles φ M N) : c.1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using extCocycles.map_smul' c 0 0

name: LieModule.extCocycles.apply_lie_apply
statement:
theorem apply_lie_apply (c : extCocycles φ M N) (x y : L) (m : M) :
    c.1 ⁅x, y⁆ m = ⁅x, c.1 y m⁆ - c.1 y ⁅x, m⁆ - (⁅y, c.1 x m⁆ - c.1 x ⁅y, m⁆)
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.2.2.2.2 x y, LinearMap.sub_apply, LieHom.lie_apply, LieHom.lie_apply]

name: LieModule.ExtOne.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk : extCocycles φ M N → ExtOne φ M N)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _

name: LieModule.ExtOne.mk_eq_zero_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff_exists (c : extCocycles φ M N) :
    mk c = 0 ↔ ∃ f : M →ₗ[K] N, f ∈ relHom φ M N ∧ ∀ x m, c.1 x m = ⁅x, f m⁆ - f ⁅x, m⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, LinearMap.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f, f.2, fun x m ↦ LieHom.lie_apply _ _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, h⟩
    refine ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, Subtype.ext (funext fun x ↦ LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)⟩
    exact (LieHom.lie_apply _ _ _).trans (h x m).symm

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.equiv_lie
statement:
theorem equiv_lie (x : L) (v : Extension c) :
    equiv c ⁅x, v⁆ = (⁅x, (equiv c v).1⁆ + c.1 x (equiv c v).2, ⁅x, (equiv c v).2⁆)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.ext_iff'
statement:
theorem ext_iff' {v w : Extension c} :
    v = w ↔ (equiv c v).1 = (equiv c w).1 ∧ (equiv c v).2 = (equiv c w).2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Prod.ext_iff, (equiv c).injective.eq_iff]

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.fst_lie
statement:
theorem fst_lie (x : L) (v : Extension c) :
    (equiv c ⁅x, v⁆).1 = ⁅x, (equiv c v).1⁆ + c.1 x (equiv c v).2
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.snd_lie'
statement: theorem snd_lie' (x : L) (v : Extension c) : (equiv c ⁅x, v⁆).2 = ⁅x, (equiv c v).2⁆
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.equiv_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_inl (n : N) : equiv c (inl c n) = (n, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.snd_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem snd_apply (v : Extension c) : snd c v = (equiv c v).2
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.injective_inl
statement: theorem injective_inl : Function.Injective (inl c)
proof:
:= fun n n' h ↦ by
  simpa using congrArg (fun v ↦ (equiv c v).1) h

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.surjective_snd
statement: theorem surjective_snd : Function.Surjective (snd c)
proof:
:= fun m ↦
  ⟨(equiv c).symm (0, m), rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.exists_inl_eq_of_snd_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_inl_eq_of_snd_eq_zero {v : Extension c} (hv : snd c v = 0) :
    ∃ n, inl c n = v
proof:
:=
  ⟨(equiv c v).1, (ext_iff' c).mpr ⟨rfl, by rw [equiv_inl]; exact hv.symm⟩⟩

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff (μ : Dual K H) (v : Extension c) :
    v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (Extension c) φ μ ↔
      (equiv c v).1 ∈ weightSpaceOfMap N φ μ ∧ (equiv c v).2 ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_weightSpaceOfMap, ext_iff', fst_lie, snd_lie', extCocycles.map_apply_eq_zero c,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero, map_smul, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun a ↦ (h a).1, fun a ↦ (h a).2⟩, fun h a ↦ ⟨h.1 a, h.2 a⟩⟩

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.symm_zero_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
proof:
:=
  (mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff c μ _).mpr ⟨Submodule.zero_mem _, hm⟩

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top (hN : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap N φ μ = ⊤)
    (hM : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ = ⊤) :
    ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (Extension c) φ μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hinl : ∀ n : N, inl c n ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (Extension c) φ μ := by
    intro n
    have hn : n ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap N φ μ := hN ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hn using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem μ n hn =>
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ ((mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff c μ _).mpr
        ⟨hn, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩)
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add n n' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'
  have hsnd : ∀ m : M, (equiv c).symm (0, m) ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (Extension c) φ μ := by
    intro m
    have hm : m ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ := hM ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hm using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem μ m hm => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (symm_zero_mem_weightSpaceOfMap c hm)
    | zero =>
      rw [show ((0 : N), (0 : M)) = 0 from rfl, map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add m m' _ _ h h' =>
      have : ((equiv c).symm (0, m + m') : Extension c) =
          (equiv c).symm (0, m) + (equiv c).symm (0, m') := by
        rw [← map_add, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero]
      rw [this]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro v -
  have hv : v = inl c (equiv c v).1 + (equiv c).symm (0, (equiv c v).2) := by
    rw [ext_iff']
    exact ⟨(add_zero _).symm, (zero_add _).symm⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (hinl _) (hsnd _)

name: LieModule.ExtOne.Extension.injective_weightSpaceMap
statement: theorem injective_weightSpaceMap (μ : Dual K H) : Function.Injective (weightSpaceMap c μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun p ↦ (p.1 : N)) h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun p ↦ (p.2 : M)) h
  exact Subtype.ext ((ext_iff' c).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩)

name: LieModule.ExtOne.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff (c : extCocycles φ M N) :
    mk c = 0 ↔ ∃ σ : M →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ Extension c, ∀ m, Extension.snd c (σ m) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_zero_iff_exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, -, hf⟩
    refine ⟨{ toLinearMap := (Extension.equiv c).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.prod (-f)
                LinearMap.id
              map_lie' := fun {x m} ↦ ?_ }, fun m ↦ rfl⟩
    rw [Extension.ext_iff']
    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
    change -f ⁅x, m⁆ = ⁅x, -f m⁆ + c.1 x m
    rw [hf, lie_neg]
    abel
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    let f : M →ₗ[K] N := -(LinearMap.fst K N M ∘ₗ (Extension.equiv c).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      (σ : M →ₗ[K] Extension c))
    have hf : ∀ m, f m = -(Extension.equiv c (σ m)).1 := fun m ↦ rfl
    have hσ2 : ∀ m, (Extension.equiv c (σ m)).2 = m := hσ
    have key : ∀ x m, (Extension.equiv c (σ ⁅x, m⁆)).1 =
        ⁅x, (Extension.equiv c (σ m)).1⁆ + c.1 x m := by
      intro x m
      rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, Extension.fst_lie, hσ2]
    refine ⟨f, fun a m ↦ ?_, fun x m ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [hf, hf, key, extCocycles.map_apply_eq_zero c, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero, lie_neg]
    · rw [hf, hf, key, lie_neg]
      abel

name: LieModule.ExtOne.comap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem comap_mk (g : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ M) (c : extCocycles φ M N) :
    comap g (mk c) = mk (cocycleComap φ g c)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.p_i
statement: theorem p_i (a : A) : p (i a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := S.i_r_add_s_p (i a)
  rw [S.r_i, add_eq_left] at h
  simpa [S.p_s] using congrArg p h

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.r_s
statement: theorem r_s (c : C) : S.r (S.s c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := S.i_r_add_s_p (S.s c)
  rw [S.p_s, add_eq_right] at h
  have := congrArg S.r h
  rwa [S.r_i, map_zero] at this

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.i_r_of_p_eq_zero
statement: theorem i_r_of_p_eq_zero {b : B} (hb : p b = 0) : i (S.r b) = b
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hb] using S.i_r_add_s_p b

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.p_lie_s_sub
statement: theorem p_lie_s_sub (x : L) (c : C) : p (⁅x, S.s c⁆ - S.s ⁅x, c⁆) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [S.p_s]

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.lie_r_of_p_eq_zero
statement: theorem lie_r_of_p_eq_zero (z : L) {b : B} (hb : p b = 0) : ⁅z, S.r b⁆ = S.r ⁅z, b⁆
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : i ⁅z, S.r b⁆ = ⁅z, b⁆ := by rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, S.i_r_of_p_eq_zero hb]
  rw [← h1, S.r_i]

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.cocycle_apply
statement:
theorem cocycle_apply (x : L) (c : C) :
    S.cocycle.1 x c = S.r (⁅x, S.s c⁆ - S.s ⁅x, c⁆)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.i_cocycle_apply
statement:
theorem i_cocycle_apply (x : L) (c : C) :
    i (S.cocycle.1 x c) = ⁅x, S.s c⁆ - S.s ⁅x, c⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [cocycle_apply, S.i_r_of_p_eq_zero (S.p_lie_s_sub x c)]

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.pushCocycle_apply
statement:
theorem pushCocycle_apply (f : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N) (x : L) (c : C) :
    (S.pushCocycle f).1 x c = f (S.cocycle.1 x c)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.connecting_apply
statement:
theorem connecting_apply (f : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N) :
    S.connecting f = ExtOne.mk (S.pushCocycle f)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.connecting_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem connecting_eq_zero_iff (f : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N) :
    S.connecting f = 0 ↔ ∃ g : B →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N, g.comp i = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [connecting_apply, mk_eq_zero_iff_exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, -, hfe⟩
    
    let g₀ : B →ₗ[K] N := (f : A →ₗ[K] N) ∘ₗ S.r + e ∘ₗ (p : B →ₗ[K] C)
    have hg₀i : ∀ a, g₀ (i a) = f a := fun a ↦ by
      simp [g₀, S.r_i, S.p_i]
    have hg₀s : ∀ c, g₀ (S.s c) = e c := fun c ↦ by
      simp [g₀, S.r_s, S.p_s]
    have hlie : ∀ (x : L) b, g₀ ⁅x, b⁆ = ⁅x, g₀ b⁆ := by
      intro x b
      rw [← S.i_r_add_s_p b, lie_add, map_add, map_add, lie_add, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, hg₀i,
        hg₀i, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
      congr 1
      have h2 : ⁅x, S.s (p b)⁆ = i (S.cocycle.1 x (p b)) + S.s ⁅x, p b⁆ := by
        rw [S.i_cocycle_apply]; abel
      rw [h2, map_add, hg₀i, hg₀s, hg₀s, ← pushCocycle_apply, hfe]
      abel
    refine ⟨{ toLinearMap := g₀, map_lie' := fun {x b} ↦ hlie x b }, ?_⟩
    ext a
    exact hg₀i a
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(g : B →ₗ[K] N) ∘ₗ S.s, fun a c ↦ ?_, fun x c ↦ ?_⟩
    · simp [S.s_mem a c]
    · rw [pushCocycle_apply]
      simp only [LieModuleHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, S.i_cocycle_apply, map_sub,
        LieModuleHom.map_lie, LinearMap.coe_comp, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap]

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.connecting_id_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem connecting_id_eq_zero_iff :
    S.connecting (LieModuleHom.id : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ A) = 0 ↔
      ∃ g : B →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ A, ∀ a, g (i a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [connecting_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨g, hg⟩ ↦ ⟨g, fun a ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun hg a⟩,
    fun ⟨g, hg⟩ ↦ ⟨g, LieModuleHom.ext hg⟩⟩

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.exists_connecting_eq
statement:
theorem exists_connecting_eq {y : ExtOne φ C N} (hy : comap p y = 0) :
    ∃ f : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N, S.connecting f = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective y
  rw [comap_mk, mk_eq_zero_iff_exists] at hy
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgc⟩ := hy
  have hgc' : ∀ x b, c.1 x (p b) = ⁅x, g b⁆ - g ⁅x, b⁆ := hgc
  
  have hgi : ∀ (x : L) a, g (i ⁅x, a⁆) = ⁅x, g (i a)⁆ := by
    intro x a
    have := hgc' x (i a)
    rw [S.p_i, map_zero, eq_comm, sub_eq_zero, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie] at this
    exact this.symm
  let f : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N :=
    { toLinearMap := -(g ∘ₗ (i : A →ₗ[K] B))
      map_lie' := fun {x a} ↦ by
        change -(g (i ⁅x, a⁆)) = ⁅x, -(g (i a))⁆
        rw [hgi, lie_neg] }
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  rw [connecting_apply, ← sub_eq_zero, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, mk_eq_zero_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨-(g ∘ₗ S.s), fun a c' ↦ ?_, fun x c' ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp [hg a, S.s_mem a c']
  · change (S.pushCocycle f).1 x c' - c.1 x c' = _
    have h1 : c.1 x c' = ⁅x, g (S.s c')⁆ - g ⁅x, S.s c'⁆ := by
      rw [← hgc', S.p_s]
    have h2 : (S.pushCocycle f).1 x c' = -(g (⁅x, S.s c'⁆ - S.s ⁅x, c'⁆)) := by
      change -(g (i _)) = _
      rw [S.i_cocycle_apply]
    rw [h1, h2, map_sub]
    simp only [LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, lie_neg]
    abel

name: LieModule.ExtOne.SplitData.connectingEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem connectingEquiv_apply (hHom : ∀ g : B →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N, g = 0)
    (hExt : ∀ y : ExtOne φ B N, y = 0) (f : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N) :
    S.connectingEquiv hHom hExt f = S.connecting f
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ExtOne.exists_splitData_of_section
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpi : ∀ a, p (i a) = 0 := fun a ↦ (hexact (i a)).mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have hmem : ∀ b, b - s (p b) ∈ LinearMap.range (i : A →ₗ[K] B) := fun b ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hexact (b - s (p b))).mp (by simp [hps])
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  let e := LinearEquiv.ofInjective (i : A →ₗ[K] B) hi
  let r : B →ₗ[K] A := e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    ((LinearMap.id - s ∘ₗ (p : B →ₗ[K] C)).codRestrict _ hmem)
  have hir : ∀ b, i (r b) = b - s (p b) := fun b ↦ by
    have := LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply (f := (i : A →ₗ[K] B)) (h := hi)
      ⟨b - s (p b), hmem b⟩
    exact this
  have hri : ∀ a, r (i a) = a := fun a ↦ hi (by rw [hir, hpi, map_zero, sub_zero])
  exact ⟨{
    s := s
    r := r
    p_s := hps
    r_i := hri
    i_r_add_s_p := fun b ↦ by rw [hir]; abel
    s_mem := hs
    r_mem := fun a b ↦ hi (by
      rw [hir, LieModuleHom.map_lie i, hir, LieModuleHom.map_lie p, hs a, lie_sub]) }⟩

name: LieModule.ExtOne.map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
theorem map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (g : B →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ C) {μ : Dual K H} {b : B}
    (hb : b ∈ weightSpaceOfMap B φ μ) : g b ∈ weightSpaceOfMap C φ μ
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, hb a, map_smul]

name: LieModule.ExtOne.exists_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ ν, (weightSpaceOfMap B φ ν).map (g : B →ₗ[K] C) ≤ weightSpaceOfMap C φ ν :=
    fun ν ↦ by
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap φ g hv
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩ := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le φ _ hle hc (by
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hB, Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hg]
    trivial)
  exact ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩

name: LieModule.ExtOne.exists_relHom_section
statement:
theorem exists_relHom_section (hB : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap B φ μ = ⊤)
    (hC : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap C φ μ = ⊤) {p : B →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ C} (hp : Function.Surjective p) :
    ∃ s : C →ₗ[K] B, (∀ c, p (s c) = c) ∧ s ∈ relHom φ C B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hint : DirectSum.IsInternal (fun μ ↦ weightSpaceOfMap C φ μ) :=
    DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
      (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap φ) hC
  let bC := hint.collectedBasis fun μ ↦ Basis.ofVectorSpace K (weightSpaceOfMap C φ μ)
  have hbC : ∀ j, bC j ∈ weightSpaceOfMap C φ j.1 := fun j ↦ hint.collectedBasis_mem _ j
  have hpre : ∀ j, ∃ b ∈ weightSpaceOfMap B φ j.1, p b = bC j := fun j ↦
    exists_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_surjective φ hB hp (hbC j)
  choose pre hpreW hpreP using hpre
  let s : C →ₗ[K] B := bC.constr K pre
  have hs : ∀ j, s (bC j) = pre j := fun j ↦ bC.constr_basis K pre j
  refine ⟨s, fun c ↦ ?_, fun a c ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := bC.ext (f₁ := (p : B →ₗ[K] C) ∘ₗ s) (f₂ := LinearMap.id) fun j ↦ by
      simp [hs, hpreP]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun this c
  · have := bC.ext (f₁ := s ∘ₗ (toEnd K L C (φ a) : C →ₗ[K] C))
      (f₂ := (toEnd K L B (φ a) : B →ₗ[K] B) ∘ₗ s) fun j ↦ by
        simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, hbC j a,
          map_smul, hs, hpreW j a]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun this c

name: LieModule.ExtOne.exists_splitData
statement:
theorem exists_splitData (hB : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap B φ μ = ⊤)
    (hC : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap C φ μ = ⊤) {i : A →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ B} {p : B →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ C}
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (hexact : ∀ b, p b = 0 ↔ ∃ a, i a = b) : Nonempty (SplitData φ i p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hps, hs⟩ := exists_relHom_section φ hB hC hp
  exact exists_splitData_of_section φ hi hexact s hps hs

name: LieIdeal.mkHom_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma mkHom_apply (x : L) : mkHom I x = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk x
proof: := rfl

name: LieIdeal.mkHom_surjective
statement: lemma mkHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkHom I)
proof: := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' I

name: LieIdeal.mkHom_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma mkHom_eq_zero_iff {x : L} : mkHom I x = 0 ↔ x ∈ I
proof: := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'

name: LieIdeal.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') (hf : I ≤ f.ker) (x : L) :
    lift I f hf (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: LieIdeal.lift_mkHom
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mkHom (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') (hf : I ≤ f.ker) (x : L) :
    lift I f hf (mkHom I x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: LieIdeal.lift_comp_mkHom

@[simp] lemma lift_comp_mkHom (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') (hf : I ≤ f.ker) :

proof: := rfl

name: LieIdeal.lieHom_ext
statement:
lemma lieHom_ext {g₁ g₂ : L ⧸ I →ₗ⁅R⁆ L'}
    (h : ∀ x, g₁ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk x) = g₂ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk x)) : g₁ = g₂
proof:

name: LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (φ : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M') (hφ : N ≤ φ.ker) (m : M) :
    lift N φ hφ (mk' N m) = φ m
proof: := rfl

name: LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_surjective
statement:
lemma lift_surjective (φ : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M') (hφ : N ≤ φ.ker) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Function.Surjective (lift N φ hφ)
proof:
:= fun m' ↦ by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hs m'

name: LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofBijective_apply (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (hf : Function.Bijective f) (m : M) :
    ofBijective f hf m = f m
proof:
:=
