name: Module.End.aeval_apply_mem
statement:
lemma aeval_apply_mem (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P) (q : K[X]) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ P) :
    aeval T q x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem hp hq
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [aeval_monomial, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
    refine P.smul_mem a ?_
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using hx
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; exact hP _ ih

name: Module.End.pow_apply_mem
statement: lemma pow_apply_mem (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P) (n : ℕ) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ P) : (T ^ n) x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  simpa using aeval_apply_mem hP (X ^ n) hx

name: Module.End.aeval_add_mul_apply_mem
statement:
lemma aeval_add_mul_apply_mem (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P) (c d : K[X]) {a b : K[X]} {x : M}
    (ha : aeval T a x ∈ P) (hb : aeval T b x ∈ P) : aeval T (c * a + d * b) x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
  exact add_mem (aeval_apply_mem hP c ha) (aeval_apply_mem hP d hb)

name: Module.End.commute_aeval_left
statement:
lemma commute_aeval_left {S : Module.End K M} (hTS : Commute T S) (q : K[X]) :
    Commute (aeval T q) S
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact hp.add_left hq
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [aeval_monomial]
    exact (Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left a S).mul_left (hTS.pow_left n)

name: Module.End.aeval_X_sub_C_apply_mem
statement:
lemma aeval_X_sub_C_apply_mem [CharZero K] (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P) {x : M} {N m r : ℕ}
    {w : K[X]} (hw : IsCoprime (∏ k ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase m, (X - C (k : K))) w)
    (hp : aeval T (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C (k : K))) x ∈ P)
    (hg : aeval T ((X - C (m : K)) ^ r * w) x ∈ P) : aeval T (X - C (m : K)) x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsCoprime (∏ k ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase m, (X - C (k : K)))
      ((X - C (m : K)) ^ r) := IsCoprime.pow_right
    (IsCoprime.prod_left fun k hk ↦ isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hk)).isUnit)
  generalize hu_def : ∏ k ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase m, (X - C (k : K)) = u at hu hw
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hu.mul_right hw
  have hdvd : (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C (k : K))) ∣ (X - C (m : K)) * u := by
    by_cases hm : m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1)
    · rw [← hu_def, Finset.mul_prod_erase _ (fun k : ℕ ↦ X - C (k : K)) hm]
    · rw [← hu_def, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hm]
      exact dvd_mul_left _ _
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hdvd
  have h1 : aeval T ((X - C (m : K)) * u) x ∈ P := by
    rw [hz, mul_comm, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact aeval_apply_mem hP z hp
  have heq : X - C (m : K) = a * ((X - C (m : K)) * u) + b * (X - C (m : K)) *
      ((X - C (m : K)) ^ r * w) := by
    linear_combination (-(X - C (m : K))) * hab
  rw [heq]
  exact aeval_add_mul_apply_mem hP a (b * (X - C (m : K))) h1 hg

name: Module.End.ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup
statement:
lemma ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup {ι : Type*} (T : Module.End K M) (s : Finset ι)
    (g : ι → K[X]) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) :
    LinearMap.ker (aeval T (∏ i ∈ s, g i)) ≤ ⨆ i ∈ s, LinearMap.ker (aeval T (g i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    have hcop : IsCoprime (g a) (∏ i ∈ s, g i) := IsCoprime.prod_right fun i hi ↦
      hg a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) (by rintro rfl; exact ha hi)
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, ← sup_ker_aeval_eq_ker_aeval_mul_of_coprime T hcop]
    refine sup_le (le_biSup (fun i ↦ LinearMap.ker (aeval T (g i))) (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
      ((ih fun i hi j hj ↦ hg i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)).trans
        (biSup_mono fun i hi ↦ Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: IsSl2Triple.casimir_apply
statement:
lemma casimir_apply (v : M) :
    casimir K M h e f v = ⁅h, ⁅h, v⁆⁆ + (2 : K) • ⁅h, v⁆ + (4 : K) • ⁅f, ⁅e, v⁆⁆
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsSl2Triple.prod_comp_eq
statement:
lemma prod_comp_eq (N : ℕ) :
    (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C ((k : K) * (k + 2)))).comp (X ^ 2 + 2 * X) =
      (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C (k : K))) *
        ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X + C ((k : K) + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_comp, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, C_ofNat]
  ring

name: IsSl2Triple.pow_comp_eq
statement:
lemma pow_comp_eq (m : K) (r : ℕ) :
    ((X - C (m * (m + 2))) ^ r).comp (X ^ 2 + 2 * X) = (X - C m) ^ r * (X + C (m + 2)) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_comp, ← mul_pow]
  congr 1
  simp only [sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, C_ofNat]
  ring

name: IsSl2Triple.commute_casimir_e
statement: lemma commute_casimir_e : Commute (casimir K M h e f) (toEnd K L M e)
proof:
:= by
  have A1 : ∀ x : M, ⁅h, ⁅e, x⁆⁆ = ⁅e, ⁅h, x⁆⁆ + (2 : K) • ⁅e, x⁆ := fun x ↦ by
    rw [leibniz_lie h e x, t.lie_h_e_smul K, smul_lie, add_comm]
  have A2 : ∀ x : M, ⁅e, ⁅f, x⁆⁆ = ⁅f, ⁅e, x⁆⁆ + ⁅h, x⁆ := fun x ↦ by
    rw [leibniz_lie e f x, t.lie_e_f, add_comm]
  ext v
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, casimir_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, lie_add, lie_smul, A1, A2]
  module

name: IsSl2Triple.toEnd_h_mul_e
statement:
lemma toEnd_h_mul_e : toEnd K L M h * toEnd K L M e =
    toEnd K L M e * toEnd K L M h + (2 : K) • toEnd K L M e
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    leibniz_lie h e m, t.lie_h_e_smul K, smul_lie]
  abel

name: IsSl2Triple.toEnd_h_mul_f
statement:
lemma toEnd_h_mul_f : toEnd K L M h * toEnd K L M f =
    toEnd K L M f * toEnd K L M h - (2 : K) • toEnd K L M f
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    leibniz_lie h f m, t.lie_lie_smul_f K, smul_lie, neg_lie]
  abel

name: IsSl2Triple.toEnd_e_mul_f
statement:
lemma toEnd_e_mul_f : toEnd K L M e * toEnd K L M f =
    toEnd K L M f * toEnd K L M e + toEnd K L M h
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
    leibniz_lie e f m, t.lie_e_f]
  abel

name: IsSl2Triple.toEnd_h_mul_e_pow
statement:
lemma toEnd_h_mul_e_pow (n : ℕ) : toEnd K L M h * toEnd K L M e ^ n =
    toEnd K L M e ^ n * toEnd K L M h + (2 * n : K) • toEnd K L M e ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, add_mul, mul_assoc, t.toEnd_h_mul_e, mul_add, ← mul_assoc,
      smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, add_assoc, ← add_smul]
    push_cast; ring_nf

name: IsSl2Triple.toEnd_h_mul_f_pow
statement:
lemma toEnd_h_mul_f_pow (n : ℕ) : toEnd K L M h * toEnd K L M f ^ n =
    toEnd K L M f ^ n * toEnd K L M h - (2 * n : K) • toEnd K L M f ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, sub_mul, mul_assoc, t.toEnd_h_mul_f, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc,
      smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, sub_sub, ← add_smul]
    push_cast; ring_nf

name: IsSl2Triple.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq
statement:
lemma lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq {c : K} {w : M} (hw : ⁅h, w⁆ = c • w) (j : ℕ) :
    ⁅h, (toEnd K L M f ^ j) w⁆ = (c - 2 * j) • (toEnd K L M f ^ j) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toEnd_apply_apply (R := K), ← Module.End.mul_apply, t.toEnd_h_mul_f_pow,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, hw, map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, sub_smul]

name: IsSl2Triple.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f
statement:
lemma lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f (n : ℕ) (v : M) :
    ⁅e, (toEnd K L M f ^ (n + 1)) v⁆ = (toEnd K L M f ^ (n + 1)) ⁅e, v⁆ +
      (n + 1 : K) • (toEnd K L M f ^ n) (⁅h, v⁆ - (n : K) • v)
proof:
:= by
  have base : ∀ v : M, ⁅e, ⁅f, v⁆⁆ = ⁅f, ⁅e, v⁆⁆ + ⁅h, v⁆ := fun v ↦ by
    rw [leibniz_lie, t.lie_e_f, add_comm]
  have hf : ∀ v : M, ⁅h, ⁅f, v⁆⁆ = ⁅f, ⁅h, v⁆⁆ - (2 : K) • ⁅f, v⁆ := fun v ↦ by
    rw [leibniz_lie, t.lie_lie_smul_f K, neg_lie, smul_lie]; abel
  have e1 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : M), (toEnd K L M f ^ (n + 1)) w = (toEnd K L M f ^ n) ⁅f, w⁆ := by
    intro n w; rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero => simp [base v]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [e1 (n + 1) v, ih, base v, hf v, e1 (n + 1) ⁅e, v⁆]
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, ← e1 n]
    push_cast
    module

name: IsSl2Triple.lie_e_lie_h
statement: lemma lie_e_lie_h (w : M) : ⁅e, ⁅h, w⁆⁆ = ⁅h, ⁅e, w⁆⁆ - (2 : K) • ⁅e, w⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [leibniz_lie h e w, t.lie_h_e_smul K, smul_lie]
  abel

name: IsSl2Triple.comap_e_stable
statement:
lemma comap_e_stable : ∀ w ∈ P.comap (toEnd K L M e),
    toEnd K L M h w ∈ P.comap (toEnd K L M e)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, toEnd_apply_apply] at hw ⊢
  rw [t.lie_e_lie_h (K := K)]
  exact sub_mem (hPh _ hw) (P.smul_mem _ hw)

name: IsSl2Triple.aeval_casimir_sub_mem
statement:
lemma aeval_casimir_sub_mem {v : M} (hv : ⁅e, v⁆ ∈ P) (q : K[X]) :
    aeval (casimir K M h e f) q v - aeval (toEnd K L M h) (q.comp (X ^ 2 + 2 * X)) v ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  set Ω := casimir K M h e f
  set D := aeval (toEnd K L M h) (X ^ 2 + 2 * X : K[X])
  have hW := t.comap_e_stable hPh
  have hDW : ∀ w ∈ P.comap (toEnd K L M e), D w ∈ P.comap (toEnd K L M e) :=
    fun w hw ↦ Module.End.aeval_apply_mem hW _ hw
  have hΩP : ∀ x ∈ P, Ω x ∈ P := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [casimir_apply]
    exact add_mem (add_mem (hPh _ (hPh _ hx)) (P.smul_mem _ (hPh _ hx)))
      (P.smul_mem _ (hPf _ (hPe _ hx)))
  have hΩD : ∀ w ∈ P.comap (toEnd K L M e), Ω w - D w ∈ P := fun w hw ↦ by
    have : Ω w - D w = (4 : K) • ⁅f, ⁅e, w⁆⁆ := by
      simp only [Ω, D, casimir_apply, map_add, map_mul, aeval_X, LinearMap.add_apply,
        Module.End.mul_apply, sq, toEnd_apply_apply]
      rw [show (2 : K[X]) = C 2 from rfl, aeval_C, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
      abel
    rw [this]
    exact P.smul_mem _ (hPf _ hw)
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, (Ω ^ n) v - (D ^ n) v ∈ P := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      have hDn : (D ^ n) v ∈ P.comap (toEnd K L M e) := Module.End.pow_apply_mem hDW n hv
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
        show Ω ((Ω ^ n) v) - D ((D ^ n) v) =
          Ω ((Ω ^ n) v - (D ^ n) v) + (Ω ((D ^ n) v) - D ((D ^ n) v)) by
          rw [map_sub]; abel]
      exact add_mem (hΩP _ ih) (hΩD _ hDn)
  induction q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [add_comp, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
      add_sub_add_comm]
    exact add_mem hp hq
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [monomial_comp, aeval_monomial, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_C]
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, ← smul_sub]
    exact P.smul_mem a (hpow n)

name: IsSl2Triple.aeval_prod_apply_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hW := t.comap_e_stable hPh
  have hPf' : ∀ x ∈ P, toEnd K L M f x ∈ P := hPf
  have key : ∀ d j, j + d = N + 1 → ∀ w, ⁅e, w⁆ ∈ P → (toEnd K L M f ^ j)
      (aeval (toEnd K L M h) (∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico j (N + 1), (X - C (k : K))) w) ∈ P := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro j hj w _
      rw [add_zero] at hj
      subst hj
      rw [hN, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      exact zero_mem P
    | succ d ih =>
      intro j hj w hw
      set u := aeval (toEnd K L M h) (∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico (j + 1) (N + 1), (X - C (k : K))) w
      have hu : ⁅e, u⁆ ∈ P := Module.End.aeval_apply_mem hW _ (x := w) hw
      have h2 := hPe _ (ih (j + 1) (by omega) w hw)
      rw [t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f] at h2
      have h3 := sub_mem h2 (Module.End.pow_apply_mem hPf' (j + 1) hu)
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at h3
      have h4 := P.smul_mem (j + 1 : K)⁻¹ h3
      rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero j), one_smul] at h4
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_prod_Ico_succ_bot (by omega : j < N + 1), map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
      convert h4 using 2
      simp [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  have := key (N + 1) 0 (by simp) v hv
  rwa [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range] at this

name: IsSl2Triple.pow_apply_mem_primitiveSpan
statement:
lemma pow_apply_mem_primitiveSpan (j : ℕ) {w : M} (hwe : ⁅e, w⁆ = 0) (hwh : ⁅h, w⁆ = m • w) :
    (toEnd K L M f ^ j) w ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem
    ⟨LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hwe, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hwh⟩)

name: IsSl2Triple.primitiveSpan_le_comap
statement:
lemma primitiveSpan_le_comap {T : Module.End K M}
    (hT : ∀ (j : ℕ) (w : M), ⁅e, w⁆ = 0 → ⁅h, w⁆ = m • w →
      T ((toEnd K L M f ^ j) w) ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m) :
    ∀ x ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m, T x ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m
proof:
:= by
  refine fun x hx ↦ (iSup_le fun j ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr ?_ :
    primitiveSpan K M h e f m ≤ (primitiveSpan K M h e f m).comap T) hx
  rintro w ⟨hwe, hwh⟩
  exact hT j w (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hwe) (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hwh)

name: IsSl2Triple.primitiveSpan_f
statement: lemma primitiveSpan_f : ∀ x ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m, ⁅f, x⁆ ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m
proof:
:=
  primitiveSpan_le_comap m (T := toEnd K L M f) fun j w hwe hwh ↦ by
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']
    exact pow_apply_mem_primitiveSpan m (j + 1) hwe hwh

name: IsSl2Triple.primitiveSpan_h
statement: lemma primitiveSpan_h : ∀ x ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m, ⁅h, x⁆ ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m
proof:
:=
  primitiveSpan_le_comap m (T := toEnd K L M h) fun j w hwe hwh ↦ by
    rw [toEnd_apply_apply, t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq hwh]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_apply_mem_primitiveSpan m j hwe hwh)

name: IsSl2Triple.primitiveSpan_e
statement: lemma primitiveSpan_e : ∀ x ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m, ⁅e, x⁆ ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f m
proof:
:=
  primitiveSpan_le_comap m (T := toEnd K L M e) fun j w hwe hwh ↦ by
    rw [toEnd_apply_apply]
    rcases j with _ | j
    · rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, hwe]
      exact zero_mem _
    · rw [t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f, hwe, map_zero, zero_add, hwh, ← sub_smul, map_smul,
        smul_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_apply_mem_primitiveSpan m j hwe hwh)

name: IsSl2Triple.primitiveSpan_le_iSup_eigenspace
statement:
lemma primitiveSpan_le_iSup_eigenspace (m : ℕ) :
    primitiveSpan K M h e f (m : K) ≤ ⨆ k : ℤ, (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace (k : K)
proof:
:= by
  refine iSup_le fun j ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr ?_
  rintro w ⟨hwe, hwh⟩
  refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ((m : ℤ) - 2 * j) (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr ?_)
  rw [toEnd_apply_apply, t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hwh)]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: IsSl2Triple.aeval_prod_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_primitiveSpan
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ((iSup_le fun j ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr ?_ :
    primitiveSpan K M h e f m ≤ (LinearMap.ker _).comap (LinearMap.id)) hx)
  rintro w ⟨hwe, hwh⟩
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  by_cases hj : j ≤ N
  · rw [Module.End.aeval_apply_of_mem_apply_eq_smul (by
      rw [toEnd_apply_apply]
      exact t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hwh) j),
      eval_prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := j) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) (by simp),
      zero_smul]
  · rw [show j = (j - (N + 1)) + (N + 1) by omega, pow_add, hN, mul_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      map_zero]

name: IsSl2Triple.aeval_casimir_pow_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem aeval_casimir_pow_apply_eq_zero {N : ℕ} (hN : toEnd K L M f ^ (N + 1) = 0) (d : ℕ)
    {v : M} (hv : (toEnd K L M e ^ d) v = 0) :
    (aeval (casimir K M h e f) (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C ((k : K) * (k + 2)))) ^ d)
      v = 0
proof:
:= by
  set Q := aeval (casimir K M h e f) (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C ((k : K) * (k + 2))))
  induction d generalizing v with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ d ih =>
    have hQe : Commute Q (toEnd K L M e) :=
      Module.End.commute_aeval_left t.commute_casimir_e _
    have hw : ⁅e, (Q ^ d) v⁆ = 0 := by
      rw [← toEnd_apply_apply (R := K), ← Module.End.mul_apply, ((hQe.pow_left d).eq).symm,
        Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]
      exact ih (by rwa [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] at hv)
    have hw' : ⁅e, (Q ^ d) v⁆ ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K M) := by rw [hw]; exact zero_mem _
    have hb : ∀ x : L, ∀ y ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K M), ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K M) := by simp
    have h1 := t.aeval_casimir_sub_mem (hb e) (hb f) (hb h) hw'
      (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C ((k : K) * (k + 2))))
    have h2 := t.aeval_prod_apply_mem (hb e) (hb f) (hb h) hN hw'
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at h1
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at h2
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, h1, prod_comp_eq, mul_comm, map_mul,
      Module.End.mul_apply, h2, map_zero]

name: IsSl2Triple.mem_primitiveSpan
statement:
theorem mem_primitiveSpan {N : ℕ} (hN : toEnd K L M f ^ (N + 1) = 0) (m r d : ℕ) {v : M}
    (hd : (toEnd K L M e ^ d) v = 0)
    (hv : aeval (casimir K M h e f) ((X - C ((m : K) * (m + 2))) ^ r) v = 0) :
    v ∈ primitiveSpan K M h e f (m : K)
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing v with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hd; rw [hd]; exact zero_mem _
  | succ d ih =>
  set P := primitiveSpan K M h e f (m : K)
  have hPe := t.primitiveSpan_e (M := M) (m : K)
  have hPf := primitiveSpan_f (K := K) (M := M) (h := h) (e := e) (f := f) (m : K)
  have hPh := t.primitiveSpan_h (M := M) (m : K)
  have hEv : ⁅e, v⁆ ∈ P := by
    refine ih (by rwa [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] at hd) ?_
    have hc := Module.End.commute_aeval_left (t.commute_casimir_e (K := K) (M := M))
      ((X - C ((m : K) * (m + 2))) ^ r)
    rw [← toEnd_apply_apply (R := K), ← Module.End.mul_apply, hc.eq, Module.End.mul_apply,
      hv, map_zero]
  set T := toEnd K L M h
  have hTP : ∀ x ∈ P, T x ∈ P := hPh
  
  have hp := t.aeval_prod_apply_mem hPe hPf hPh hN hEv
  have hg : aeval T ((X - C (m : K)) ^ r * (X + C ((m : K) + 2)) ^ r) v ∈ P := by
    have := t.aeval_casimir_sub_mem hPe hPf hPh hEv ((X - C ((m : K) * (m + 2))) ^ r)
    rwa [hv, zero_sub, neg_mem_iff, pow_comp_eq] at this
  have hcopw : IsCoprime (∏ k ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase m, (X - C (k : K)))
      ((X + C ((m : K) + 2)) ^ r) := by
    refine IsCoprime.pow_right (IsCoprime.prod_left fun k _ ↦ ?_)
    rw [show X + C ((m : K) + 2) = X - C (-((m : K) + 2)) by rw [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]]
    refine isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (sub_ne_zero.mpr fun hk ↦ ?_).isUnit
    have : ((k + m + 2 : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by push_cast; linear_combination hk
    exact absurd (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp this) (by omega)
  have hm : aeval T (X - C (m : K)) v ∈ P := Module.End.aeval_X_sub_C_apply_mem hTP hcopw hp hg
  
  set s := ∏ j ∈ Finset.range N, (X - C ((m : K) - 2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : K)))
  have hprod : (X - C (m : K)) * s =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C ((m : K) - 2 * (j : K))) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ', mul_comm]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hkill : ∀ x ∈ P, aeval T ((X - C (m : K)) * s) x = 0 := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [hprod]; exact t.aeval_prod_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_primitiveSpan (m : K) hN hx
  have hs0 : s.eval (m : K) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eval_prod]
    refine Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, sub_sub_cancel]
    exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero j))
  set v' := (s.eval (m : K))⁻¹ • aeval T s v
  have hvv' : v - v' ∈ P := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := X_sub_C_dvd_sub_C_eval (p := s) (a := (m : K))
    have h1 : aeval T (s - C (s.eval (m : K))) v ∈ P := by
      rw [hz, mul_comm, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
      exact Module.End.aeval_apply_mem hTP z hm
    rw [map_sub, aeval_C, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply] at h1
    have h2 := P.smul_mem (-(s.eval (m : K))⁻¹) h1
    have e : v - v' = (-(s.eval (m : K))⁻¹) • (aeval T s v - s.eval (m : K) • v) := by
      simp only [v', smul_sub, smul_smul, neg_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs0, neg_smul, one_smul]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact h2
  have hv'2 : aeval T ((X - C (m : K)) ^ 2) v' = 0 := by
    rw [map_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul,
      show (X - C (m : K)) ^ 2 * s = ((X - C (m : K)) * s) * (X - C (m : K)) by ring, map_mul,
      Module.End.mul_apply, hkill _ hm, smul_zero]
  
  have hEv'P : ⁅e, v'⁆ ∈ P := by
    have := sub_mem hEv (hPe _ hvv')
    rwa [lie_sub, sub_sub_cancel] at this
  have hshift : ∀ (a : K) (x : M), aeval T (X - C (a + 2)) ⁅e, x⁆ = ⁅e, aeval T (X - C a) x⁆ := by
    intro a x
    simp only [T, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply,
      toEnd_apply_apply, lie_sub, lie_smul, t.lie_e_lie_h (K := K)]
    module
  have hEv'2 : aeval T ((X - C ((m : K) + 2)) ^ 2) ⁅e, v'⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [sq, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hshift, hshift, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul,
      ← sq, hv'2, lie_zero]
  have hEv'0 : ⁅e, v'⁆ = 0 := by
    have hcop : IsCoprime ((X - C (m : K)) * s) ((X - C ((m : K) + 2)) ^ 2) := by
      refine IsCoprime.pow_right (IsCoprime.mul_left ?_ (IsCoprime.prod_left fun j _ ↦ ?_))
      · refine isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h2 ↦ ?_).isUnit
        have : (2 : K) = 0 := by linear_combination -h2
        exact two_ne_zero this
      · refine isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h2 ↦ ?_).isUnit
        have : ((2 * j + 4 : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by push_cast at h2 ⊢; linear_combination -h2
        exact absurd (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp this) (by omega)
    exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (Polynomial.disjoint_ker_aeval_of_isCoprime T hcop)) _
      (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hkill _ hEv'P)) (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hEv'2)
  
  have hb : ∀ x : L, ∀ y ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K M), ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K M) := by simp
  have hp' := t.aeval_prod_apply_mem (hb e) (hb f) (hb h) hN
    (by rw [hEv'0]; exact zero_mem (⊥ : Submodule K M))
  have hm' : aeval T (X - C (m : K)) v' ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K M) :=
    Module.End.aeval_X_sub_C_apply_mem (fun x hx ↦ by simp_all) (w := 1) (r := 2)
      isCoprime_one_right hp' (by rw [mul_one, hv'2]; exact zero_mem _)
  have hv'P : v' ∈ P := by
    have := pow_apply_mem_primitiveSpan (K := K) (M := M) (h := h) (e := e) (f := f) (m : K) 0
      hEv'0 (by
        rw [Submodule.mem_bot, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, LinearMap.sub_apply,
          Module.algebraMap_end_apply, sub_eq_zero] at hm'
        exact hm')
    rwa [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at this
  have := add_mem hvv' hv'P
  rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this

name: IsSl2Triple.isNilpotent_toEnd_e
statement: theorem isNilpotent_toEnd_e : IsNilpotent (toEnd K L M e)
proof:
:= by
  set E := toEnd K L M e
  set H := toEnd K L M h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsArtinian.monotone_stabilizes E.iterateRange
  have hR : LinearMap.range (E ^ (n + 1)) = LinearMap.range (E ^ n) := (hn (n + 1) (by omega)).symm
  set R := LinearMap.range (E ^ n)
  have hER : ∀ x ∈ R, E x ∈ R := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [← hR]
    exact ⟨y, by rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]⟩
  have hHR : ∀ x ∈ R, H x ∈ R := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, t.toEnd_h_mul_e_pow, LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply]
    exact add_mem ⟨_, rfl⟩ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  let E' := E.restrict hER
  let H' := H.restrict hHR
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective E' := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [← hR] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨⟨(E ^ n) y, ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩, Subtype.ext (by
      simp [E', LinearMap.restrict_apply, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply])⟩
  have hunit : IsUnit E' := (LinearMap.isUnit_iff_range_eq_top E').mpr
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hunit
  have hrel : H' * E' = E' * H' + (2 : K) • E' := by
    ext x
    simp only [H', E', Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      LinearMap.restrict_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul]
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, t.toEnd_h_mul_e]
    rfl
  have hH : H' = E' * (H' * ↑u⁻¹) + (2 : K) • 1 := by
    have := congrArg (· * (↑u⁻¹ : Module.End K R)) hrel
    simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc] at this
    rw [← hu, u.mul_inv, mul_one] at this
    rw [← hu]; exact this
  have htr := congrArg (LinearMap.trace K R) hH
  rw [map_add, LinearMap.trace_mul_comm, mul_assoc, ← hu, u.inv_mul, mul_one, map_smul,
    LinearMap.trace_one, left_eq_add, smul_eq_mul, mul_eq_zero] at htr
  have h0 : finrank K R = 0 := by exact_mod_cast htr.resolve_left two_ne_zero
  refine ⟨n, LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp ?_⟩
  exact Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp h0

name: IsSl2Triple.isNilpotent_toEnd_f
statement: theorem isNilpotent_toEnd_f : IsNilpotent (toEnd K L M f)
proof:
:=
  t.symm.isNilpotent_toEnd_e

name: IsSl2Triple.iSup_eigenspace_toEnd_h_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_eigenspace_toEnd_h_eq_top :
    ⨆ k : ℤ, (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace (k : K) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := t.isNilpotent_toEnd_e (K := K) (M := M)
  obtain ⟨N, hN'⟩ := t.symm.isNilpotent_toEnd_e (K := K) (M := M)
  have hN : toEnd K L M f ^ (N + 1) = 0 := by rw [pow_succ, hN', zero_mul]
  set c : ℕ → K := fun m ↦ (m : K) * (m + 2)
  have hQ : aeval (casimir K M h e f) (∏ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C (c m)) ^ n) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.prod_pow, map_pow]
    ext v
    exact t.aeval_casimir_pow_apply_eq_zero hN n (by rw [hn, LinearMap.zero_apply])
  have hcop : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), i ≠ j →
      IsCoprime ((X - C (c i)) ^ n) ((X - C (c j)) ^ n) := by
    intro i _ j _ hij
    refine (isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (sub_ne_zero.mpr fun hc ↦ hij ?_).isUnit).pow
    have : ((i * (i + 2) : ℕ) : K) = ((j * (j + 2) : ℕ) : K) := by push_cast; exact hc
    have hij' := Nat.cast_injective this
    rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
    · exact absurd hij' (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' h (by omega)).ne
    · exact h
    · exact absurd hij' (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' h (by omega)).ne'
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro v _
  have hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (aeval (casimir K M h e f)
      (∏ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (X - C (c m)) ^ n)) := by
    rw [hQ, LinearMap.ker_zero]; trivial
  refine (iSup₂_le fun m _ ↦ ?_ : _ ≤ ⨆ k : ℤ, (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace (k : K))
    (Module.End.ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup _ _ _ hcop hv)
  intro x hx
  exact t.primitiveSpan_le_iSup_eigenspace m
    (t.mem_primitiveSpan hN m n n (by rw [hn, LinearMap.zero_apply]) hx)

name: DirectSum.toLieModule_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLieModule_of (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (i : ι) (m : M i) :
    toLieModule φ (DirectSum.of M i m) = φ i m
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toModule_lof (M := M) R i m

name: DirectSum.range_toLieModule
statement:
theorem range_toLieModule (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) :
    (toLieModule φ).range = ⨆ i, (φ i).range
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    induction m using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | of i m =>
      rw [toLieModule_of]
      exact LieSubmodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i ⟨m, rfl⟩
    | add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hm hm'
  · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨DirectSum.of M i m, toLieModule_of φ i m⟩

name: LieModuleHom.mul_def
statement: lemma mul_def (f g : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) : f * g = f.comp g
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.mul_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma mul_apply (f g : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) (m : M) : (f * g) m = f (g m)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.coe_pow
statement:
lemma coe_pow (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) (n : ℕ) :
    ((f ^ n : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) : M →ₗ[R] M) = (f : M →ₗ[R] M) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change ((npowRec n f * f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) : M →ₗ[R] M) = _
    rw [pow_succ, ← ih]
    rfl

name: LieModuleHom.one_apply'
statement: @[simp] lemma one_apply' (m : M) : (1 : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) m = m
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.op_smul_def
statement: lemma op_smul_def (a : (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ) (φ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) : a • φ = φ.comp a.unop
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.op_smul_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma op_smul_apply (a : (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ) (φ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) (q : Q) :
    (a • φ) q = φ (a.unop q)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.homMap_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma homMap_apply (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (φ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) : homMap Q f φ = f.comp φ
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.homMapₗ_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma homMapₗ_apply (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) : homMapₗ Q M N f = homMap Q f
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.finsetSum_apply
statement:
lemma finsetSum_apply {α X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [LieRingModule L X]
    (s : Finset α) (f : α → X →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (x : X) : (∑ a ∈ s, f a) x = ∑ a ∈ s, f a x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, _root_.add_apply, ih]

name: LieModuleHom.sum_comp_component
statement:
lemma sum_comp_component {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [LieRingModule L X]
    [LieModule R L X] (ψ : X →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q) :
    ∑ j, (lieModuleOf R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j).comp
      ((lieModuleComponent R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j).comp ψ) = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [finsetSum_apply]
  conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_univ_of (ψ x)]
  rfl

name: LieModuleHom.toLieModule_comp
statement:
lemma toLieModule_comp {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [LieRingModule L X]
    [LieModule R L X] (φ : ι → (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N)) (ψ : X →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q) :
    (toLieModule φ).comp ψ =
      ∑ j, (φ j).comp ((lieModuleComponent R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j).comp ψ)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← sum_comp_component ψ]
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  simp only [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, finsetSum_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  exact toLieModule_of φ j _

name: LieModuleHom.comp_eq_sum_smul
statement:
lemma comp_eq_sum_smul (π : (⨁ _ : ι, Q) →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) (ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q) :
    π.comp ψ = ∑ j, op ((lieModuleComponent R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j).comp ψ) •
      π.comp (lieModuleOf R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← sum_comp_component ψ]
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  simp only [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, finsetSum_apply, map_sum,
    op_smul_apply, unop_op]

name: LieModuleHom.liftOfSurjective_comp
statement:
lemma liftOfSurjective_comp {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [LieRingModule L X]
    [LieModule R L X] (π : X →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (h : X →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N)
    (hle : π.ker ≤ h.ker) : (liftOfSurjective π hπ h hle).comp π = h
proof:
:= by
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  change h (hπ (π x)).choose = h x
  have : (hπ (π x)).choose - x ∈ π.ker := by
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, map_sub, (hπ (π x)).choose_spec, sub_self]
  have := LieModuleHom.mem_ker.1 (hle this)
  rwa [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this

name: LieModuleHom.homMap_injective
statement:
theorem homMap_injective (hπ : Function.Surjective π) :
    Function.Injective (homMap (R := R) (L := L) (M := M) (N := N) Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro f g hfg
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hπ m
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | of j q =>
    exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun
      (LinearMap.congr_fun hfg (π.comp (lieModuleOf R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j))) q
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: LieModuleHom.homMap_surjective
statement:
theorem homMap_surjective (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hlift : ∀ φ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M, ∃ ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q, π.comp ψ = φ)
    (hker : π.ker ≤ ⨆ (ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q) (_ : π.comp ψ = 0), ψ.range) :
    Function.Surjective (homMap (R := R) (L := L) (M := M) (N := N) Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  intro g
  set h := toLieModule fun j ↦ g (π.comp (lieModuleOf R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j))
  have hcomp : ∀ ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q, h.comp ψ = g (π.comp ψ) := by
    intro ψ
    rw [toLieModule_comp, comp_eq_sum_smul π ψ, map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ (g.map_smul _ _).symm
  have hle : π.ker ≤ h.ker := hker.trans (iSup₂_le fun ψ hψ ↦ by
    rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hcomp, hψ, map_zero]
    rfl)
  refine ⟨liftOfSurjective π hπ h hle, LinearMap.ext fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ψ, rfl⟩ := hlift φ
  change ((liftOfSurjective π hπ h hle).comp π).comp ψ = g (π.comp ψ)
  rw [liftOfSurjective_comp, hcomp]

name: LieModuleHom.homMap_bijective
statement:
theorem homMap_bijective (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hlift : ∀ φ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M, ∃ ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q, π.comp ψ = φ)
    (hker : π.ker ≤ ⨆ (ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q) (_ : π.comp ψ = 0), ψ.range) :
    Function.Bijective (homMap (R := R) (L := L) (M := M) (N := N) Q)
proof:
:=
  ⟨homMap_injective π hπ, homMap_surjective π hπ hlift hker⟩

name: LieModuleHom.homDirectSumToModule_lieModuleOf
statement:
lemma homDirectSumToModule_lieModuleOf [DecidableEq ι] (x : ι → X) (j : ι) :
    homDirectSumToModule Q x (lieModuleOf R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j) = x j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homDirectSumToModule, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · have h1 : (lieModuleComponent R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j).comp (lieModuleOf R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j) =
        1 := LieModuleHom.ext fun q ↦ DirectSum.of_eq_same _ _
    rw [h1, op_one, one_smul]
  · intro l _ hl
    have : (lieModuleComponent R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) l).comp (lieModuleOf R ι L (fun _ ↦ Q) j) = 0 :=
      LieModuleHom.ext fun q ↦ DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hl
    rw [this, op_zero, zero_smul]
  · simp

name: LieModuleHom.surjective_homDirectSumToModule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← hx, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, homDirectSumToModule_lieModuleOf x j⟩

name: LieModuleHom.range_homMap_toLieModule
statement:
lemma range_homMap_toLieModule (y : κ → (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q)) :
    LinearMap.range (homMap Q (toLieModule y)) =
      Submodule.span (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range y)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
    rw [homMap_apply, toLieModule_comp]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _
      (op ((lieModuleComponent R κ L (fun _ ↦ Q) k).comp ψ)) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨lieModuleOf R κ L (fun _ ↦ Q) k, LieModuleHom.ext fun q ↦ toLieModule_of y k q⟩

name: LieModuleHom.nonempty_linearEquiv_homMap
statement:
theorem nonempty_linearEquiv_homMap (x : ι → X)
    (hx : Submodule.span (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    (y : κ → (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q))
    (hy : Submodule.span (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range y) =
      LinearMap.ker (homDirectSumToModule Q x))
    (hliftM : ∀ φ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ (⨁ _ : ι, Q) ⧸ (toLieModule y).range,
      ∃ ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : ι, Q,
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (toLieModule y).range).comp ψ = φ)
    (hliftα : ∀ φ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ (toLieModule y).range,
      ∃ ψ : Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ ⨁ _ : κ, Q, (LieModuleHom.codRestrict (toLieModule y).range (toLieModule y)
        fun m ↦ ⟨m, rfl⟩).comp ψ = φ) :
    Nonempty (X ≃ₗ[(Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ]
      (Q →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ (⨁ _ : ι, Q) ⧸ (toLieModule y).range))
proof:
:= by
  set α := toLieModule y
  set mk := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' α.range
  set Φ := homMap Q mk
  have hΦ : Function.Surjective Φ := fun φ ↦ hliftM φ
  have hker : LinearMap.ker Φ = LinearMap.ker (homDirectSumToModule Q x) := by
    rw [← hy, ← range_homMap_toLieModule]
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro φ hφ
      have hle : ∀ q, φ q ∈ α.range := fun q ↦ by
        have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun (LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hφ) q
        rwa [homMap_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, _root_.zero_apply,
          LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'] at this
      obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hliftα (LieModuleHom.codRestrict α.range φ hle)
      refine ⟨ψ, LieModuleHom.ext fun q ↦ ?_⟩
      have := congrArg Subtype.val (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ q)
      exact this
    · rintro _ ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
      refine LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (LieModuleHom.ext fun q ↦ ?_)
      rw [homMap_apply, homMap_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, _root_.zero_apply,
        LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero']
      exact ⟨ψ q, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨((homDirectSumToModule Q x).quotKerEquivOfSurjective
    (surjective_homDirectSumToModule hx)).symm.trans
      ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker.symm).trans (Φ.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hΦ))⟩

name: FreeLieAlgebra.lieSpan_range_of
statement:
theorem lieSpan_range_of :
    LieSubalgebra.lieSpan R (FreeLieAlgebra R X) (Set.range (of R)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set S := LieSubalgebra.lieSpan R (FreeLieAlgebra R X) (Set.range (of R))
  let g : FreeLieAlgebra R X →ₗ⁅R⁆ S :=
    lift R fun x ↦ ⟨of R x, LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Set.mem_range_self x)⟩
  have hg : S.incl.comp g = LieHom.id := by ext x; simp [g]
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro y _
  have : S.incl (g y) = y := by rw [← LieHom.comp_apply, hg, LieHom.id_apply]
  rw [← this]
  exact (g y).2

name: FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {p : FreeLieAlgebra R X → Prop} (y : FreeLieAlgebra R X)
    (of : ∀ x, p (of R x)) (zero : p 0) (add : ∀ y z, p y → p z → p (y + z))
    (smul : ∀ (a : R) y, p y → p (a • y)) (lie : ∀ y z, p y → p z → p ⁅y, z⁆) : p y
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ LieSubalgebra.lieSpan R (FreeLieAlgebra R X) (Set.range (FreeLieAlgebra.of R)) :=
    by rw [lieSpan_range_of]; trivial
  induction hy using LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_induction with
  | mem x hx => obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx; exact of x
  | zero => exact zero
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add y z hy hz
  | smul a y _ hy => exact smul a y hy
  | lie y z _ _ hy hz => exact lie y z hy hz

name: FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra_of
statement: @[simp] lemma toFreeAlgebra_of (x : X) : toFreeAlgebra R X (of R x) = FreeAlgebra.ι R x
proof:
:= by
  simp [toFreeAlgebra]

name: FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra_eq
statement:
lemma toFreeAlgebra_eq :
    toFreeAlgebra R X = ((universalEnvelopingEquivFreeAlgebra R X).toAlgHom :
      UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R (FreeLieAlgebra R X) →ₗ⁅R⁆ FreeAlgebra R X).comp
      (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [toFreeAlgebra]

name: FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra_injective
statement:
theorem toFreeAlgebra_injective (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    Function.Injective (toFreeAlgebra K X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFreeAlgebra_eq, LieHom.coe_comp]
  exact (universalEnvelopingEquivFreeAlgebra K X).injective.comp
    (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_injective K _)

name: LieModule.mem_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpaceOfMap {μ : Dual K H} {m : M} :
    m ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ ↔ ∀ a, ⁅φ a, m⁆ = μ a • m
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieModule.weightSpaceOfMap_eq_weightSpaceOf
statement:
theorem weightSpaceOfMap_eq_weightSpaceOf (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ =
      Module.End.weightSpaceOf ((toEnd K L M : L →ₗ[K] Module.End K M) ∘ₗ φ) μ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieModule.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_sum_mem
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_sum_mem (N : Submodule K M) (hN : ∀ a, ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅φ a, m⁆ ∈ N)
    (s : Finset (Dual K H)) (x : Dual K H → M) (hx : ∀ μ ∈ s, x μ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ)
    (hsum : ∑ μ ∈ s, x μ ∈ N) : ∀ μ ∈ s, x μ ∈ N
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_of_sum_mem ((toEnd K L M : L →ₗ[K] Module.End K M) ∘ₗ φ) N hN s x hx hsum

name: LieModule.inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le
statement:
theorem inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (N : Submodule K M) (hN : ∀ a, ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅φ a, m⁆ ∈ N)
    (S : Set (Dual K H)) :
    N ⊓ ⨆ μ ∈ S, weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ S, (N ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨hmN, hm⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.mp hm
  rw [← iSup_subtype'', Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset] at hm
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hm
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum] at hs
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hs
  let s' : Finset (Dual K H) := s.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _)
  let x' : Dual K H → M := fun μ ↦ if h : μ ∈ S then (x ⟨μ, h⟩ : M) else 0
  have hx' : ∀ μ ∈ s', x' μ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M φ μ := by
    intro μ hμ
    obtain ⟨⟨μ, hμS⟩, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hμ
    simp [x', hμS]
  have hsum : ∑ μ ∈ s', x' μ = ∑ i ∈ s, (x i : M) := by
    simp [s', x']
  have hmem := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_sum_mem φ N hN s' x' hx' (hsum ▸ hmN)
  rw [← hsum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun μ hμ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨μ, hμS⟩, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hμ
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμS ⟨hmem _ hμ, hx' _ hμ⟩)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.isZero_weightComplex_homology_succ
statement:
theorem isZero_weightComplex_homology_succ {μ : Dual K H} {k : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ f ∈ ρ.cochainWeightSpace (k + 1) μ, δ K L N (k + 1) f = 0 →
      ∃ g ∈ ρ.cochainWeightSpace k μ, δ K L N k g = f) :
    IsZero ((ρ.weightComplex μ).homology (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.isZero_homology ?_
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ k (k + 1) (k + 1 + 1) (by simp) (by simp),
    ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
  intro f₀ hf
  let f : ρ.cochainWeightSpace (k + 1) μ := f₀
  have h1 : ρ.δWeight (k + 1) μ f = 0 := by
    have h := hf
    simp only [HomologicalComplex.sc', HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor'_obj_g,
      ρ.weightComplex_d] at h
    exact h
  have hf' : δ K L N (k + 1) (f : Cochains K L N (k + 1)) = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h1
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩ := h f f.2 hf'
  refine ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, ?_⟩
  have h2 : ρ.δWeight k μ ⟨g, hg⟩ = f := Subtype.ext hgf
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.sc', HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor'_obj_f,
    ρ.weightComplex_d]
  exact h2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpaceOfMap_le_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist
statement:
lemma weightSpaceOfMap_le_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist (ν : Dual K H) :
    (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν).map (OmegaTwist.of P V).toLinearMap ≤
      Module.End.weightSpaceOf (nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).φ (-ν)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ a
  rw [nPosDerivAction_φ_apply]
  change OmegaTwist.of P V ⁅chevalleyInvolution P (h P a), v⁆ = _
  rw [chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_lie, hv a]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.iSup_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist
statement:
lemma iSup_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν = ⊤) :
    ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf (nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).φ ν = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun m _ ↦ ?_
  have hm : (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm m ∈ ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν := hV ▸ trivial
  have : m ∈ (⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν).map (OmegaTwist.of P V).toLinearMap :=
    ⟨_, hm, (OmegaTwist.of P V).apply_symm_apply m⟩
  rw [Submodule.map_iSup] at this
  exact (iSup_mono fun ν ↦ weightSpaceOfMap_le_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist P ν).trans
    (iSup_le fun ν ↦ le_iSup (fun ν ↦ Module.End.weightSpaceOf
      (nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).φ ν) (-ν)) this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_range_dualPairing
proof:
:= by
  let φ : TwistedDual P V := (TwistedDual.toDual P V).symm (ψ ∘ₗ (OmegaTwist.of P V).toLinearMap)
  have hφ : φ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) (-γ) := fun a ↦ by
    refine TwistedDual.ext fun v ↦ ?_
    have h1 := hψ a (OmegaTwist.of P V v)
    rw [nPosDerivAction_φ_apply, OmegaTwist.lie_of, chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_lie, map_neg,
      map_neg] at h1
    rw [TwistedDual.lie_apply, transpose_h]
    simp only [φ, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp h1]
    simp
  exact ⟨⟨φ, (mem_restrictedDual P).mpr (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ hφ)⟩, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_δ_eq_dualVerma
statement:
theorem exists_δ_eq_dualVerma {k : ℕ} {μ : Dual K H}
    {f : Cochains K (nPos P) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ)) (k + 1)}
    (hf : f ∈ (nPosDerivAction P (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ))).cochainWeightSpace
      (k + 1) μ)
    (hδ : δ K (nPos P) _ (k + 1) f = 0) :
    ∃ g ∈ (nPosDerivAction P (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ))).cochainWeightSpace k μ,
      δ K (nPos P) _ k g = f
proof:
:=
  (nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P (VermaModule P Λ))).exists_δ_eq_of_subsingleton_homology
    (ρN := nPosDerivAction P (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ))) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun x φ m ↦ dualPairing_lie P (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) φ m)
    (fun a φ m ↦ dualPairing_lie P (h P a) φ m) (dualPairing_injective P)
    (fun _ _ hψ ↦ mem_range_dualPairing P hψ) (iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNPos P)
    (iSup_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist P
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top)
    (subsingleton_homology_omegaTwist_verma P Λ (k + 1) k.succ_pos) hf hδ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isZero_nPosCohomology_dualVerma

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right_of_hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₃, rfl⟩ := covariant_sequence_exact₁ X hS x (h₂ _) (zero_add 1)

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.exists_comp_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem exists_comp_of_shortExact {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) {X : C}
    (h₁ : ∀ x : Ext.{w} X S.X₁ 1, x = 0) (f : X ⟶ S.X₃) : ∃ g : X ⟶ S.X₂, g ≫ S.g = f
proof:

  refine ⟨homEquiv₀ x₂, (mk₀_bijective X S.X₃).1 ?_⟩
