name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.lieModuleHom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.lieModuleHom_eq_zero (hQ : IsCategoryO P Q)
    [WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q)]
    (h : ∀ ν, hQ.multiplicity ν ≠ 0 →
      ∀ ψ : Y →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν, ψ = 0)
    (φ : Y →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ Q) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hφ
  have hr : φ.range ≠ ⊥ := fun h0 ↦ hφ (by
    ext y
    have hy : φ y ∈ φ.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ (φ y)).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hy
    exact hy)
  obtain ⟨M', -, ν, hν, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hQ.exists_subquotient_equiv_of_ne_bot hr
  let q : Y →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν :=
    ψ.toLieModuleHom.comp ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (M'.comap φ.range.incl)).comp
      (φ.codRestrict φ.range fun y ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ (φ y)).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩))
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (M'.comap φ.range.incl) (ψ.symm z)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ w).mp w.2
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    have hyw : φ.codRestrict φ.range (fun y ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ (φ y)).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩) y =
        w := Subtype.ext hy
    change ψ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _ (φ.codRestrict φ.range _ y)) = z
    rw [hyw, hw, LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : IrreducibleModule P ν)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hq z
  exact hz (LieModuleHom.congr_fun (h ν hν q) y)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hom_eq_zero_of_lie
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_lie {Y Z : CategoryO.{u} P} (h : ∀ φ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z.obj, φ = 0)
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun (h (toLieModuleHom f.hom)) y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_right
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_right {Y Z Z' : CategoryO.{u} P} (e : Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z'.obj) {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y Z n, x = 0) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y Z' n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : Z ⟶ Z' := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e.toLieModuleHom)
  let g : Z' ⟶ Z := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e.symm.toLieModuleHom)
  have hgf : g ≫ f = 𝟙 Z' := by
    ext z
    exact e.apply_symm_apply z
  have hx : x = (x.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g) (add_zero n)).comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f)
      (add_zero n) := by
    rw [Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, hgf,
      Abelian.Ext.comp_mk₀_id]
  rw [hx, h (x.comp _ _)]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_ofSub_top_right
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_ofSub_top_right (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X (ofSub Y ⊤) n, x = 0) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y n) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_right ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y.obj)).symm.trans
    (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y.obj).incl
      ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun y ↦ ⟨⟨y, LieSubmodule.mem_top y⟩, rfl⟩⟩)) h x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity (X W : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ ν, W.property.1.multiplicity ν ≠ 0 → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν) → ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Z n, x = 0)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X W n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := W.property.2
  have := W.property.1.wellFoundedLT_lieSubmodule P (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan) hS
  have := W.property.1.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan) hS
  refine ext_eq_zero_of_ofSub_top_right X W (WellFoundedLT.induction
    (motive := fun M ↦ ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X (ofSub W M) n, x = 0) ⊤ fun M ih ↦ ?_) x
  by_cases hM : M = ⊥
  · subst hM
    exact Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right (isZero_ofSub_bot W)
  obtain ⟨M', hM'M, ν, hν, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := W.property.1.exists_subquotient_equiv_of_ne_bot hM
  have hS := shortExact_subComplex W hM'M.le (ofSubquotient W M' M) (toSubquotient W M' M)
    (fun y hy ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff W M' M ⟨y, hM'M.le hy⟩).mpr hy)
    (surjective_toSubquotient W M' M) fun y hy ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff W M' M y).mp hy
  exact Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right hS (ih M' hM'M)
    (h ν hν _ ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (M'.Subquotient M)).symm.trans ψ))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_quotientMap
statement:
theorem surjective_quotientMap (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj) :
    Function.Surjective (quotientMap X N)
proof:
:=
  (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (X.obj ⧸ N)).surjective.comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.toQuotient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem toQuotient_eq_zero_iff (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj) (x : X.obj) :
    toQuotient X N x = 0 ↔ x ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  change (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N x : X.obj ⧸ N) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_toQuotient
statement:
theorem surjective_toQuotient (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj) :
    Function.Surjective (toQuotient X N)
proof:
:=
  surjective_quotientMap X N

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.injective_simpleToDualVerma
statement:
theorem injective_simpleToDualVerma (μ : Dual K H) :
    Function.Injective (simpleToDualVerma (P := P) μ)
proof:
:=
  (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ))).injective.comp
    (IrreducibleModule.toRestrictedDual_injective P μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_one_simple_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_one_simple_eq_zero (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (μ : Dual K H)
    (hdual : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y (dualVerma P μ) 1, x = 0)
    (hhom : ∀ ν ∈ cone P μ, ν ≠ μ → ∀ ψ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν, ψ = 0)
    (Z : CategoryO.{u} P) (e : Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y Z 1) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let D := dualVerma P μ
  let ι := simpleToDualVerma (P := P) μ
  let Q := ofQuotient D ι.range
  let φ := toQuotient D ι.range
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := surjective_toQuotient D ι.range
  have hker (y : D.obj) : y ∈ φ.ker ↔ ∃ m, ι m = y := by
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, toQuotient_eq_zero_iff, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  
  let eK : IrreducibleModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ φ.ker := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective
    (ι.codRestrict φ.ker fun m ↦ (hker (ι m)).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩)
    ⟨fun a b hab ↦ injective_simpleToDualVerma μ (congrArg Subtype.val hab), fun y ↦ by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (hker y).mp y.2
      exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩⟩
  have hS := shortExact_kerComplex D Q φ hφ
  refine ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_right (Z := ofSub D φ.ker)
    ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) φ.ker).symm.trans (eK.symm.trans e.symm)) ?_ x
  refine Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right_of_hom hS hdual fun f ↦ ?_
  
  have hD := D.property.1
  have hQ := Q.property.1
  have hmult (ν : Dual K H) : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity ν =
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity ν + hQ.multiplicity ν := by
    rw [← multiplicity_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)) hD
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ))),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hD.lieSubmodule φ.ker) hD hQ φ.ker.incl φ
        Subtype.val_injective φ.ker.range_incl.symm hφ,
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (hD.lieSubmodule φ.ker) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ)
        eK.symm]
  obtain ⟨S, hS'⟩ := Q.property.2
  have := hQ.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan) hS'
  refine hom_eq_zero_of_lie (fun ψ ↦ hQ.lieModuleHom_eq_zero (fun ν hν ↦ ?_) ψ) f
  have h := hmult ν
  rw [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq] at h
  refine hhom ν (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (by omega)) ?_
  rintro rfl
  rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self] at h
  simp at h
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_lift_verma
statement:
theorem exists_lift_verma (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (lam : Dual K H)
    (hext : ∀ ν ∈ cone P lam, ν ≠ lam → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν) → ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y Z 1, x = 0)
    (φ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) :
    ∃ ψ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam,
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P lam)).comp ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  let eL := (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P lam)).symm
  let π := toSimple P lam (simple P lam) eL
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := surjective_toSimple lam (simple P lam) eL
  let N := ofSub (verma P lam) π.ker
  have hV := (verma P lam).property.1
  have hS := shortExact_kerComplex (verma P lam) (simple P lam) π hπ
  
  have hmult (ν : Dual K H) : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν =
      N.property.1.multiplicity ν + (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν := by
    rw [IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam) hV
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hV.lieSubmodule π.ker) hV (simple P lam).property.1
        π.ker.incl π Subtype.val_injective π.ker.range_incl.symm hπ,
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (hV.lieSubmodule π.ker) N.property.1
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) π.ker),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (simple P lam).property.1
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam) eL]
  have hN1 : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y N 1, x = 0 := by
    refine ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity Y N 1 fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    have h := hmult ν
    refine hext ν (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (by omega)) ?_
    rintro rfl
    rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self, IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq] at h
    simp at h
    omega
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Abelian.Ext.exists_comp_of_shortExact hS hN1
    ((IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom (eL.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp φ)))
  refine ⟨(ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm.toLieModuleHom.comp
    (toLieModuleHom g.hom), LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ eL.symm.injective ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun k : Y ⟶ simple P lam ↦ k.hom.hom y) hg

name: Module.finrank_add_finrank_of_exact_four
statement:
theorem Module.finrank_add_finrank_of_exact_four [FiniteDimensional K B] [FiniteDimensional K C]
    (f : A →ₗ[K] B) (g : B →ₗ[K] C) (k : C →ₗ[K] D) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hfg : Function.Exact f g) (hgk : Function.Exact g k) (hk : Function.Surjective k) :
    finrank K A + finrank K C = finrank K B + finrank K D
proof:
:= by
  have hg := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g
  have hk' := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker k
  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hfg, LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hf] at hg
  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hgk, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hk, finrank_top] at hk'
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction
statement:
theorem isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) :
    DerivAction.IsEquivariant (nPosDerivAction P V) (nPosDerivAction P W)
      (g.restrictLie (nPos P)) where
  D_eq
proof:
:= rfl
  map_φ a v := g.map_lie (h P a) v

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nPosWeightComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem nPosWeightComplex_shortExact (hinj : Function.Injective g₁) (hex : Function.Exact g₁ g₂)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective g₂) (hV₂ : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V₂ (h P) ν = ⊤)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (DerivAction.weightComplexMap (isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction P g₁) μ)
      (DerivAction.weightComplexMap (isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction P g₂) μ) (by
        ext k f : 3
        exact Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _))).ShortExact
proof:
:=
  DerivAction.weightComplex_shortExact (bL := nPosBasis P) (γ := fun x ↦ x.root)
    (isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction P g₁) (isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction P g₂)
    (fun x ↦ nPosBasis_mem_weightSpaceOf P V₁ x) hinj hex
    (fun _ _ hx ↦ ExtOne.exists_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_surjective (h P) hV₂ hsurj hx) μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.injective_mk
statement:
theorem injective_mk (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hS : ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hinj : IsInjectiveO.{u} P M) : Injective (mk M hM hS) where
  factors {X Y} g f _
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hinj X.property.1 Y.property.1 (toLieModuleHom f.hom) (injective_of_mono f)
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) M).symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (toLieModuleHom g.hom))
    refine ⟨(IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) M).toLieModuleHom.comp ψ)), ?_⟩
    ext m
    exact (congrArg (ofLieEquiv (P := P) M) (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ m)).trans
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) M).apply_symm_apply _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_shortExact_injective
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_injective (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) :
    ∃ (J Z : CategoryO.{u} P) (f : Y ⟶ J) (g : J ⟶ Z) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact ∧ Injective J ∧
      (∀ (μ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → IsZero (nPosCohomology P J.obj μ n)) ∧
      ∃ (g₁ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ J.obj) (g₂ : J.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z.obj), Function.Injective g₁ ∧
        Function.Exact g₁ g₂ ∧ Function.Surjective g₂
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsFiniteCartan := Fact.out
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := Y.property.2
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, hIO, hIinj, hIfg, e, he⟩ :=
    exists_isInjectiveO_injective.{u, u} P hA Y.property.1 hS
  let I := restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))
  let J := mk I hIO hIfg
  let e' : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ J.obj := (ofLieEquiv (P := P) I).toLieModuleHom.comp e
  have he' : Function.Injective e' := (ofLieEquiv (P := P) I).injective.comp he
  let N := e'.range
  have hex : Function.Exact e' (toQuotient J N) := fun x ↦
    (toQuotient_eq_zero_iff J N x).trans (e'.mem_range x)
  let f : Y ⟶ J := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e')
  let g : J ⟶ ofQuotient J N := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom (toQuotient J N))
  have w : f ≫ g = 0 := by
    ext y
    exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero y
  have hQ : IsCategoryO P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) :=
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun j ↦ isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA _ _
  refine ⟨J, ofQuotient J N, f, g, w, shortExact_of_lie he' (surjective_toQuotient J N)
    (fun y hy ↦ (hex y).mp hy), injective_mk I hIO hIfg hIinj, fun μ n hn ↦ ?_,
    e', toQuotient J N, he', hex, surjective_toQuotient J N⟩
  
  have hI := isZero_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual_directSum P
    (fun j ↦ τ j + (projectiveCoverShift P hA (τ j) : K) • P.rho)
    (fun j ↦ Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ((projectiveCoverShift P hA (τ j) : K) • P.rho)))
    hQ.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top μ hn
  have hI' : IsZero (nPosCohomology P (restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦
      VermaModule P (τ j + (projectiveCoverShift P hA (τ j) : K) • P.rho) ⊗[K]
        Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ((projectiveCoverShift P hA (τ j) : K) • P.rho))))
      μ n) := hI
  exact (show IsZero (nPosCohomology P I μ n) from hI').of_iso
    (nPosCohomologyCongr P (ofLieEquiv (P := P) I) μ n).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finiteDimensional_nPosCohomology_and_finrank_eq
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_nPosCohomology_and_finrank_eq (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ Y : CategoryO.{u} P, FiniteDimensional K (nPosCohomology P Y.obj μ n) ∧
      finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y n) = finrank K (nPosCohomology P Y.obj μ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro Y
    exact ⟨LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (extZeroEquivNPosCohomology μ Y),
      (extZeroEquivNPosCohomology μ Y).finrank_eq⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro Y
    obtain ⟨J, Z, f, g, w, hS, hJ, hJ0, g₁, g₂, hg₁, hex, hg₂⟩ := exists_shortExact_injective P Y
    have hT := nPosWeightComplex_shortExact P hg₁ hex hg₂
      J.property.1.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top μ
    have hrel : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel n (n + 1) := rfl
    let δ := (hT.δ n (n + 1) hrel).hom
    have := hJ
    have hJext : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) J (m + 1)), x = 0 :=
      fun m x ↦ Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_injective x
    
    have hδ : Function.Surjective δ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp
      (hT.epi_δ n (n + 1) hrel (hJ0 μ (n + 1) n.succ_pos))
    have hfd : FiniteDimensional K (nPosCohomology P Y.obj μ (n + 1)) :=
      have := (ih Z).1
      Module.Finite.of_surjective δ hδ
    refine ⟨hfd, ?_⟩
    
    have hc : Function.Surjective (connectingLinear (verma P μ) hS n) := fun x ↦
      (exact_connectingLinear_postcompLinear (verma P μ) hS n x).mp (hJext n _)
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      
      have hE := Module.finrank_add_finrank_of_exact_four (postcompLinear (verma P μ) f 0)
        (postcompLinear (verma P μ) g 0) (connectingLinear (verma P μ) hS 0)
        (injective_postcompLinear_zero (verma P μ) hS) (exact_postcompLinear (verma P μ) hS 0)
        (exact_connectingLinear (verma P μ) hS 0) hc
      
      have hmono : Mono (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (DerivAction.weightComplexMap (isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction P g₁) μ) 0) := by
        have := hT.mono_f
        have h := CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀_inv_naturality
          (DerivAction.weightComplexMap (isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction P g₁) μ)
        have : Mono (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (DerivAction.weightComplexMap (isEquivariant_nPosDerivAction P g₁) μ) 0 ≫
              (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ _).inv) := by
          rw [h]
          infer_instance
        exact mono_of_mono _ (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ _).inv
      have := (ih J).1
      have := (ih Z).1
      have hH := Module.finrank_add_finrank_of_exact_four (nPosCohomologyMap μ g₁ 0)
        (nPosCohomologyMap μ g₂ 0) δ ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp hmono)
        (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr ((ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker _).mp
          (hT.homology_exact₂ 0)).symm)
        (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr ((ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker _).mp
          (hT.homology_exact₃ 0 1 hrel)).symm) hδ
      change _ + finrank K (nPosCohomology P Z.obj μ 0) =
        _ + finrank K (nPosCohomology P Y.obj μ (0 + 1)) at hH
      rw [(ih Y).2, (ih J).2, (ih Z).2] at hE
      change _ = _ + finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y (0 + 1)) at hE
      omega
    | succ n =>
      
      have hci : Function.Injective (connectingLinear (verma P μ) hS (n + 1)) := by
        rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.exact_iff.mp (exact_connectingLinear _ hS _)]
        exact eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ by
          rw [← hy, hJext n y, map_zero]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      have := hT.isIso_δ (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) hrel (hJ0 μ (n + 1) n.succ_pos)
        (hJ0 μ (n + 1 + 1) (n + 1).succ_pos)
      rw [← (LinearEquiv.ofBijective _ ⟨hci, hc⟩).finrank_eq, (ih Z).2,
        (asIso (hT.δ (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) hrel)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finrank_ext_verma_eq_finrank_nPosCohomology
statement:
theorem finrank_ext_verma_eq_finrank_nPosCohomology (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ) :
    finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y n) = finrank K (nPosCohomology P Y.obj μ n)
proof:
:=
  (finiteDimensional_nPosCohomology_and_finrank_eq μ n Y).2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.nonempty_ext_verma_linearEquiv_nPosCohomology
statement:
theorem nonempty_ext_verma_linearEquiv_nPosCohomology (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y n ≃ₗ[K] nPosCohomology P Y.obj μ n)
proof:
:=
  have := (finiteDimensional_nPosCohomology_and_finrank_eq μ n Y).1
  ⟨LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ (finrank_ext_verma_eq_finrank_nPosCohomology μ Y n)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.nonempty_ext_verma_mk_linearEquiv_nPosCohomology
statement:
theorem nonempty_ext_verma_mk_linearEquiv_nPosCohomology (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module K N] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N] [LieModule K 𝔤 N] (hN : IsCategoryO P N)
    (hS : ∃ S : Finset N, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set N) = ⊤) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (mk N hN hS) n ≃ₗ[K] nPosCohomology P N μ n)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_ext_verma_linearEquiv_nPosCohomology μ (mk N hN hS) n
  ⟨e.trans (nPosCohomologyCongr P (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N).symm μ n).toLinearEquiv⟩

name: StrictMonoOn.inf_add_sup
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  have hfx : x ⊓ a ∈ Set.Iic a := inf_le_right
  have hfy : y ⊓ a ∈ Set.Iic a := inf_le_right
  have hgx : x ⊔ a ∈ Set.Icc a b := ⟨le_sup_right, sup_le hx hab⟩
  have hgy : y ⊔ a ∈ Set.Icc a b := ⟨le_sup_right, sup_le hy hab⟩
  have h2 := hg.monotoneOn hgx hgy (sup_le_sup_right hxy.le a)
  change f (x ⊓ a) + g (x ⊔ a) < f (y ⊓ a) + g (y ⊔ a)
  by_cases he : x ⊓ a = y ⊓ a
  · have := hg hgx hgy (sup_lt_sup_of_lt_of_inf_le_inf hxy he.ge)
    rw [he]
    omega
  · have := hf hfx hfy (lt_of_le_of_ne (inf_le_inf_right a hxy.le) he)
    omega

name: StrictMonoOn.comp_inf_Icc_sup
statement:
theorem StrictMonoOn.comp_inf_Icc_sup {a b : α} {g : α → ℕ} (hg : StrictMonoOn g (Set.Iic b)) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun x ↦ g (x ⊓ b)) (Set.Icc a (a ⊔ b))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  refine hg inf_le_right inf_le_right (lt_of_le_of_ne (inf_le_inf_right b hxy.le) fun he ↦
    hxy.ne ?_)
  calc x = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ x := (inf_eq_right.mpr hx.2).symm
    _ = a ⊔ b ⊓ x := sup_inf_assoc_of_le b hx.1
    _ = a ⊔ b ⊓ y := by rw [inf_comm b x, he, inf_comm]
    _ = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ y := (sup_inf_assoc_of_le b hy.1).symm
    _ = y := inf_eq_right.mpr hy.2

name: StrictMonoOn.exists_Iic_sup
statement:
theorem StrictMonoOn.exists_Iic_sup {a b : α} {f g : α → ℕ} (hf : StrictMonoOn f (Set.Iic a))
    (hg : StrictMonoOn g (Set.Iic b)) : ∃ F : α → ℕ, StrictMonoOn F (Set.Iic (a ⊔ b))
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, hf.inf_add_sup le_sup_left hg.comp_inf_Icc_sup⟩

name: LieSubmodule.strictMonoOn_comap
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_comap {f : LieSubmodule R L M → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f)
    (φ : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) {Q : LieSubmodule R L N} (hQ : Q ≤ φ.range) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun Q' ↦ f (Q'.comap φ)) (Set.Iic Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q₁ h₁ Q₂ h₂ hlt
  refine hf (lt_of_le_of_ne (fun _ hx ↦ hlt.le hx) fun he ↦ hlt.ne ?_)
  rw [← map_comap_eq _ _ ((Set.mem_Iic.mp h₁).trans hQ),
    ← map_comap_eq _ _ ((Set.mem_Iic.mp h₂).trans hQ), he]

name: LieSubmodule.strictMonoOn_map_mk'
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_map_mk' (N : LieSubmodule R L M) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun Q ↦ Q.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) (Set.Ici N)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q₁ h₁ Q₂ h₂ hlt
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (map_mono hlt.le) fun he ↦ hlt.ne (le_antisymm hlt.le fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  have he' : Q₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) = Q₂.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) := he
  have hx' : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N x ∈ Q₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) := by
    rw [he']
    exact mem_map_of_mem hx
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqx⟩ := (mem_map _).mp hx'
  have hxq : x - q ∈ N := by
    rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := N), map_sub, hqx, sub_self]
  have := Q₁.add_mem hq (h₁ hxq)
  rwa [add_sub_cancel] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finiteDimensional_vermaLinkedSpan
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_vermaLinkedSpan (Λ : Dual K H) :
    FiniteDimensional K (vermaLinkedSpan P hA Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  have := fun w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan ↦
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap
      ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)
  exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_iSup _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_mem_vermaLinkedSpan_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Q := N₂.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₁)
  have hV := VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ
  have hQ : IsCategoryO P Q := (hV.quotient N₁).lieSubmodule Q
  obtain ⟨m, hm₂, hm₁⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hlt
  have hq0 : (⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₁ m, LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hm₂⟩ : Q) ≠ 0 :=
    fun h ↦ hm₁ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := N₁)).mp (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀⟩ : ∃ μ, weightSpace P Q μ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have htop : (⊤ : Submodule K Q) = ⊥ := by
      rw [← hQ.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]
      exact iSup_eq_bot.mpr hcon
    exact hq0 ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top))
  have hW : aboveSpan P Q {μ₀} ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hb
    apply hμ₀
    rw [eq_bot_iff, ← hb]
    exact le_iSup_of_le ⟨μ₀, Finset.mem_singleton_self μ₀⟩
      (le_iSup₂_of_le (0 : ι → ℤ) le_rfl (by simp))
  obtain ⟨ν, v, hv, hv0, -⟩ := hQ.exists_primitive_mem_aboveSpan P {μ₀} hW
  have hcb : (v : VermaModule P Λ ⧸ N₁) ∈
      centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λ ⧸ N₁) (centralCharacter P Λ) := by
    obtain ⟨m', -, hm'v⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp v.2
    rw [← hm'v]
    refine map_mem_centralBlock P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₁) _ ?_
    rw [mem_centralBlock]
    intro z
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    have := rep_center_map P Λ LieModuleHom.id z m'
    rw [LieModuleHom.id_apply] at this
    rw [pow_one, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, this, sub_self]
  have hcb' : v ∈ centralBlock P Q (centralCharacter P Λ) :=
    mem_centralBlock_of_injective P Q.incl (LieSubmodule.injective_incl Q) _ hcb
  have hχ := centralCharacter_eq_of_mem_centralBlock P hv hv0 hcb'
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwν⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA Λ ν).mp hχ.symm
  have hN₂ : IsCategoryO P N₂ := hV.lieSubmodule N₂
  let φ : N₂ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q := ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₁).comp N₂.incl).codRestrict Q
    fun x ↦ LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem x.2
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨m', hm', rfl⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hq
    exact ⟨⟨m', hm'⟩, rfl⟩
  have hvW : v ∈ weightSpace P Q ν := (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hv).1
  rw [weightSpace, ← map_weightSpace_of_surjective P hN₂.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top φ hφ ν]
    at hvW
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := hvW
  refine ⟨y.1, y.2, fun hy₁ ↦ hv0 ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hyv]
    exact Subtype.ext ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := N₁)).mpr hy₁)
  · have hy' : y.1 ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P Λ) (h P) ν :=
      map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P N₂.incl hy
    refine (le_iSup_of_le (⟨w, hw⟩ : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) ?_ :
      _ ≤ vermaLinkedSpan P hA Λ) hy'
    rw [show ((⟨w, hw⟩ : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) = w
      from rfl, hwν, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule
statement:
theorem VermaModule.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P Λ) → ℕ, StrictMono f
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional_vermaLinkedSpan P hA Λ
  refine ⟨fun N ↦ finrank K (N.toSubmodule.comap (vermaLinkedSpan P hA Λ).subtype),
    fun N₁ N₂ hlt ↦ Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx₂, hx₁, hxV⟩ := exists_mem_vermaLinkedSpan_of_lt P hA hlt
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (fun y hy ↦ hlt.le hy) fun he ↦ hx₁ ?_
  have hx : (⟨x, hxV⟩ : vermaLinkedSpan P hA Λ) ∈
      N₂.toSubmodule.comap (vermaLinkedSpan P hA Λ).subtype := hx₂
  rw [← he] at hx
  exact hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.exists_strictMonoOn
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.exists_strictMonoOn {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} {s : Multiset (Dual K H)}
    (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s) : ∃ f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X → ℕ, StrictMonoOn f (Set.Iic N)
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => exact ⟨fun _ ↦ 0, fun _ _ _ hy hxy ↦ absurd (hxy.trans_le hy) not_lt_bot⟩
  | @step N N' s μ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := VermaModule.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA μ
    set R := N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)
    let ψ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X ⧸ N := R.incl.comp e.toLieModuleHom
    have hR : R ≤ ψ.range := fun x hx ↦
      (LieModuleHom.mem_range ψ x).mpr ⟨e.symm ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp [ψ]⟩
    have hg' : StrictMonoOn (fun Q ↦ g ((Q.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)).comap ψ))
        (Set.Icc N N') := fun Q₁ h₁ Q₂ h₂ hlt ↦
      LieSubmodule.strictMonoOn_comap hg ψ hR (LieSubmodule.map_mono h₁.2)
        (LieSubmodule.map_mono h₂.2) (LieSubmodule.strictMonoOn_map_mk' N h₁.1 h₂.1 hlt)
    exact ⟨_, hf.inf_add_sup hle hg'⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, π, hπ⟩ := hM.isCovered P hA hS
  have hj : ∀ j, ∃ f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) → ℕ,
      StrictMono f := by
    intro j
    set n := projectiveCoverShift P hA (τ j)
    have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P n)
    obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma P
      (isCategoryO_dual_irreducible_nsmul_rho P hA n).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      (τ j + (n : K) • P.rho)
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hs.exists_strictMonoOn P hA
    exact ⟨f, fun a b hab ↦ hf (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_top) (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_top) hab⟩
  choose f hf using hj
  let R : κ → LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M := fun j ↦
    (π.comp (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ 𝔤 (fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) j)).range
  have hR : ∀ s : Finset κ, ∃ F : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M → ℕ, StrictMonoOn F (Set.Iic (s.sup R)) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨fun _ ↦ 0, fun _ _ _ hy hxy ↦ absurd (hxy.trans_le hy) not_lt_bot⟩
    | insert j s _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := ih
      rw [Finset.sup_insert]
      exact (LieSubmodule.strictMonoOn_comap (hf j) _ le_rfl).exists_Iic_sup hF
  have htop : Finset.univ.sup R = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hπ x
    induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | of j q =>
      exact (Finset.le_sup (f := R) (Finset.mem_univ j))
        ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨q, rfl⟩)
    | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hR Finset.univ
  rw [htop] at hF
  exact ⟨F, fun a b hab ↦ hF (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_top) (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_top) hab⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.wellFoundedLT_lieSubmodule
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.wellFoundedLT_lieSubmodule (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {S : Finset M}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) : WellFoundedLT (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hM.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  exact hf.wellFoundedLT

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {S : Finset M}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) : WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hM.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  refine StrictAnti.wellFoundedGT (f := fun N ↦ f ⊤ - f N) fun a b hab ↦ ?_
  have h1 := hf hab
  have h2 := hf.monotone (le_top : b ≤ ⊤)
  change f ⊤ - f b < f ⊤ - f a
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finiteDimensional_hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hspan⟩ := hM.exists_finset_lieSpan_weightSpace_eq_top P hS
  have := hM.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap
  have := hN.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap
  let Φ : (M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) →ₗ[K] ((μ : F) → weightSpace P M μ →ₗ[K] weightSpace P N μ) :=
    { toFun := fun φ μ ↦ ((φ : M →ₗ[K] N).comp (weightSpace P M μ).subtype).codRestrict
        (weightSpace P N μ) fun x ↦ map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ x.2
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  refine Module.Finite.of_injective Φ ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero Φ).mpr fun φ hφ ↦ ?_)
  have hker : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P M μ : Set M)) ≤ φ.ker := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe] at hx
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hx⟩ := hx
    have := congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.congr_fun (congrFun hφ ⟨μ, hμ⟩) ⟨x, hx⟩)
    exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr this
  rw [hspan] at hker
  ext m
  exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp (hker (LieSubmodule.mem_top m))

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_isZero_right {X Y : C} (hY : IsZero Y) {n : ℕ} (x : Ext.{w} X Y n) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_mk₀_id x, hY.eq_of_src (𝟙 Y) 0, mk₀_zero]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₁, rfl⟩ := covariant_sequence_exact₂ X hS x (h₃ _)
  rw [h₁ x₁]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right_succ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₂, rfl⟩ := covariant_sequence_exact₃ X hS x rfl (h₁ _)
  rw [h₂ x₂]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_eq_bot_of_equiv
statement:
theorem weightSpace_eq_bot_of_equiv {M M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [AddCommGroup M']
    [Module K M'] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M'] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M']
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ M') {ρ : Dual K H} (h : weightSpace P M ρ = ⊥) :
    weightSpace P M' ρ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro v hv
  have hv' : e.symm v ∈ weightSpace P M ρ := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P e.symm.toLieModuleHom hv
  rw [h, Submodule.mem_bot] at hv'
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot, ← e.apply_symm_apply v]
  change e (e.symm v) = 0
  rw [hv', map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_subquotientMap
statement:
theorem surjective_subquotientMap (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (N N' : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj) :
    Function.Surjective (subquotientMap X N N')
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (N.comap N'.incl)
    ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (N.Subquotient N')).symm z)
  exact ⟨ofLieEquiv (P := P) N' y,
    (congrArg (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (N.Subquotient N')) hy).trans
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (N.Subquotient N')).apply_symm_apply z)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (N N' : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj)
    (y : N') : toSubquotient X N N' y = 0 ↔ (y : X.obj) ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  change (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N.comap N'.incl) y : N.Subquotient N') = 0 ↔ _
  rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_toSubquotient
statement:
theorem surjective_toSubquotient (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (N N' : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj) :
    Function.Surjective (toSubquotient X N N')
proof:
:=
  (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (N.Subquotient N')).surjective.comp
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_toSimple
statement:
theorem surjective_toSimple (lam : Dual K H) (Z : CategoryO.{u} P)
    (e : Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) : Function.Surjective (toSimple P lam Z e)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P lam) (e z)
  refine ⟨ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam) m, ?_⟩
  change e.symm (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P lam) m) = z
  rw [hm, LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_isLocalCompositionSeries
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_isLocalCompositionSeries (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (μ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ)
    {N M : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y.obj} {l : List (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y.obj × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P μ N l M)
    (hN : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (ofSub Y N) n, x = 0)
    (hfac : ∀ κ ∈ factorWeights l, ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P, (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P κ) →
      ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Z n, x = 0) :
    ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (ofSub Y M) n, x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing N with
  | nil =>
    rw [← IsLocalCompositionSeries.nil_iff.mp hl]
    exact hN
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨hle, hf, hl'⟩ := IsLocalCompositionSeries.cons_iff.mp hl
    refine ih hl' ?_ fun κ hκ ↦ hfac κ (by cases o <;> simp [hκ])
    have hS := shortExact_subComplex Y hle (ofSubquotient Y N N') (toSubquotient Y N N')
      (fun x hx ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff Y N N' ⟨x, hle hx⟩).mpr hx)
      (surjective_toSubquotient Y N N') fun y hy ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff Y N N' y).mp hy
    refine Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right hS hN ?_
    cases o with
    | none =>
      refine ext_verma_eq_zero_of_weightSpace _ n μ fun ρ hρ ↦ ?_
      exact weightSpace_eq_bot_of_equiv (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (N.Subquotient N'))
        ((hf : ∀ ρ, μ ∈ cone P ρ → weightSpace P (N.Subquotient N') ρ = ⊥) ρ hρ)
    | some κ =>
      obtain ⟨-, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hf
      exact hfac κ (by simp) _ ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (N.Subquotient N')).symm.trans ψ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_simple_eq_zero_aux
statement:
theorem ext_simple_eq_zero_aux (μ : Dual K H) (d : ℕ) : ∀ (lam : Dual K H) (k : ι → ℤ),
    0 ≤ k → μ = lam - P.rootOf k → ∑ i, k i ≤ d →
    ¬ (P.IsStronglyLinked (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan μ lam ∧ μ ≠ lam) →
    ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P, (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Z (n + 1)), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsFiniteCartan := Fact.out
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ d ih =>
  intro lam k hk hμk hkd hμ Z e n
  let φ := toSimple P lam Z e
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := surjective_toSimple lam Z e
  let Y := ofSub (verma P lam) φ.ker
  have hV := (verma P lam).property.1
  have hY := Y.property.1
  
  have hmult (κ : Dual K H) : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity κ =
      hY.multiplicity κ + (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity κ := by
    rw [IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam) hV
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hV.lieSubmodule φ.ker) hV Z.property.1
        φ.ker.incl φ Subtype.val_injective φ.ker.range_incl.symm hφ,
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (hV.lieSubmodule φ.ker) hY (ofLieEquiv (P := P) φ.ker),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr Z.property.1 (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam) e]
  have hker (κ : Dual K H) (hκ : hY.multiplicity κ ≠ 0) :
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity κ ≠ 0 ∧ κ ≠ lam := by
    refine ⟨by rw [hmult]; omega, ?_⟩
    rintro rfl
    have h1 : (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P κ).multiplicity κ = 1 := by
      rw [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq]
      simp
    have h := hmult κ
    rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self, h1] at h
    omega
  refine Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right_succ (shortExact_kerComplex (verma P lam) Z φ hφ)
    (ext_verma_eq_zero hμ (Nat.succ_pos n)) ?_
  
  let z : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (ofSub Y ⊥).obj := 0
  have hz : Function.Surjective z := fun _ ↦ ⟨0, (ofLieEquiv (P := P)
    (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y.obj)).symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  have hz0 : z.ker = ⊤ := eq_top_iff.mpr fun y _ ↦ LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr rfl
  suffices h : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (ofSub Y z.ker) (n + 1 + 1), x = 0 from
    Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_right (shortExact_kerComplex Y (ofSub Y ⊥) z hz) h
      (Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right (isZero_ofSub_bot Y))
  rw [hz0]
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hY.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ
  refine ext_eq_zero_of_isLocalCompositionSeries Y μ _ hl
    (Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right (isZero_ofSub_bot Y)) fun κ hκ Z' e' x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨k', hk', hμk'⟩ := hl.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights hκ
  obtain ⟨hκV, hκne⟩ := hker κ ((hY.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff ⟨k', hk', hμk'⟩ hl).mpr hκ)
  have hκl := VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hκV
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hκj⟩ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hκV
  
  have hkj : k = j + k' := P.rootOf_injective (by
    have e1 : P.rootOf k = lam - μ := by rw [hμk]; abel
    have e2 : P.rootOf j = lam - κ := by rw [hκj]; abel
    have e3 : P.rootOf k' = κ - μ := by rw [hμk']; abel
    rw [map_add, e1, e2, e3]
    abel)
  have hj0 : j ∈ posCone ι := ⟨hj, fun h0 ↦ hκne (by rw [hκj, h0, map_zero, sub_zero])⟩
  have h1 := one_le_sum_of_mem_posCone hj0
  have h2 : ∑ i, k i = ∑ i, j i + ∑ i, k' i := by
    rw [hkj, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  have h3 : ((∑ i, k' i).toNat : ℤ) = ∑ i, k' i :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hk' i)
  have hlt : (∑ i, k' i).toNat < d := by omega
  
  have hnot : ¬ (P.IsStronglyLinked hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ κ ∧ μ ≠ κ) := by
    rintro ⟨hμκ, hμκne⟩
    have hμl : μ = lam := by
      by_contra h
      exact hμ ⟨Relation.ReflTransGen.trans hκl hμκ, h⟩
    exact hμκne (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone ⟨k', hk', hμk'⟩ (by rw [hμl]; exact ⟨j, hj, hκj⟩))
  exact ih _ hlt κ k' hk' hμk' h3.ge hnot Z' e' (n + 1) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_simple_eq_zero_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  by_cases hc : μ ∈ cone P lam
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hμk⟩ := hc
    exact ext_simple_eq_zero_aux μ _ lam k hk hμk (Int.self_le_toNat _) hμ Z e m x
  · refine ext_verma_eq_zero_of_weightSpace Z _ μ (fun ρ hρ ↦ ?_) x
    by_contra hne
    exact hc (mem_cone_trans hρ (IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot
      fun h ↦ hne (weightSpace_eq_bot_of_equiv e.symm h)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_simple_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_simple_eq_zero {μ lam : Dual K H}
    (hμ : ¬ (P.IsStronglyLinked (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan μ lam ∧
      μ ≠ lam)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (simple P lam) n) :
    x = 0
proof:
:=
  ext_simple_eq_zero_of_equiv hμ _ (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P lam)).symm hn x

name: TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie_symm_apply_apply
statement:
theorem TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie_symm_apply_apply (g : M ⊗[R] N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q) (m : M)
    (n : N) : (TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie R L M N Q).symm g m n = g (m ⊗ₜ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := (TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie R L M N Q).surjective g
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_tensor_eq_top
statement:
theorem Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_tensor_eq_top
    [FiniteDimensional K W] {S : Finset V} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L (S : Set V) = ⊤) :
    ∃ T : Finset (V ⊗[K] W), LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L (T : Set (V ⊗[K] W)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis K W
  refine ⟨(S ×ˢ Finset.univ).image fun p ↦ p.1 ⊗ₜ[K] b p.2, ?_⟩
  set N := LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L
    (((S ×ˢ Finset.univ).image fun p ↦ p.1 ⊗ₜ[K] b p.2 : Finset (V ⊗[K] W)) : Set (V ⊗[K] W))
  have hvN : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ l : W, v ⊗ₜ[K] l ∈ N := by
    intro v hv l
    rw [← b.sum_repr l, tmul_sum]
    refine N.sum_mem fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [tmul_smul]
    refine N.smul_mem _ (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ?_)
    simp only [Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product,
      Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Prod.exists]
    exact ⟨v, i, hv, rfl⟩
  let S' : LieSubmodule K L V :=
    { carrier := {x | ∀ l : W, x ⊗ₜ[K] l ∈ N}
      add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy l ↦ by
        rw [add_tmul]
        exact N.add_mem (hx l) (hy l)
      zero_mem' := fun l ↦ by
        rw [zero_tmul]
        exact N.zero_mem
      smul_mem' := fun c x hx l ↦ by
        rw [← smul_tmul']
        exact N.smul_mem c (hx l)
      lie_mem := fun {y x} hx l ↦ by
        have h := N.sub_mem (N.lie_mem (x := y) (hx l)) (hx ⁅y, l⁆)
        rwa [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, add_sub_cancel_right] at h }
  have hS' : S' = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← hS, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    exact fun v hv ↦ hvN v hv
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro z -
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x l =>
    have hx : x ∈ S' := hS' ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x
    exact hx l
  | add x y hx hy => exact N.add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralTranslationMap_add
statement:
theorem centralTranslationMap_add (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (f g : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    centralTranslationMap P L χ₁ χ₂ (f + g) =
      centralTranslationMap P L χ₁ χ₂ f + centralTranslationMap P L χ₁ χ₂ g
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨t, ht⟩
  change TensorProduct.map _ _ t = TensorProduct.map _ _ t + TensorProduct.map _ _ t
  clear ht
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul v z =>
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, ← add_tmul]
    rfl
  | add s t hs ht =>
    simp only [map_add, hs, ht]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralTranslationMap_smul
statement:
theorem centralTranslationMap_smul (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (c : K) (f : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    centralTranslationMap P L χ₁ χ₂ (c • f) = c • centralTranslationMap P L χ₁ χ₂ f
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨t, ht⟩
  change TensorProduct.map _ _ t = c • TensorProduct.map _ _ t
  clear ht
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul v z =>
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, smul_tmul']
    rfl
  | add s t hs ht => simp only [map_add, hs, ht, smul_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction_apply
statement:
theorem tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction_apply (g : M ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) (m : M) :
    tensorDualEquivHom P N L (tensorHomAdjunction P g m) =
      (TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie K 𝔤 M L N).symm g m
proof:
:=
  (tensorDualEquivHom P N L).apply_symm_apply _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorHomAdjunction_comp_left
statement:
theorem tensorHomAdjunction_comp_left (f : M' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M) (g : M ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    tensorHomAdjunction P
        (g.comp (TensorProduct.LieModule.map f (LieModuleHom.id : L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L))) =
      (tensorHomAdjunction P g).comp f
proof:
:= by
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ (tensorDualEquivHom P N L).injective ?_
  rw [tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply,
    tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction_apply]
  ext l
  simp only [TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie_symm_apply_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply,
    TensorProduct.LieModule.map_tmul, LieModuleHom.id_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorHomAdjunction_comp_right
statement:
theorem tensorHomAdjunction_comp_right (k : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') (g : M ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    tensorHomAdjunction P (k.comp g) =
      (TensorProduct.LieModule.map k (LieModuleHom.id : Module.Dual K L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ _)).comp
        (tensorHomAdjunction P g)
proof:
:= by
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ (tensorDualEquivHom P N' L).injective ?_
  rw [tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply,
    tensorDualEquivHom_map, tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction_apply]
  ext l
  simp only [TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie_symm_apply_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_centralBlock_centralBlock
statement:
theorem mem_centralBlock_centralBlock (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (y : centralBlock P N χ) :

proof:
:= by
