name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_left
statement:
theorem homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_left (hM' : IsCentralLocallyFinite P M')
    (hM : IsCentralLocallyFinite P M) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (f : M' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M)
    (g : centralBlock P M χ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    homCentralBlockEquiv P hM' χ (g.comp (centralBlockMap P f χ)) =
      (homCentralBlockEquiv P hM χ g).comp f
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun y ↦ (g y : N))
    (Subtype.ext (LieModuleHom.congr_fun (centralBlockProjection_natural P hM' hM f χ) m)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_right
statement:
theorem homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_right (hM : IsCentralLocallyFinite P M) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (k : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') (g : centralBlock P M χ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    homCentralBlockEquiv P hM χ (k.comp g) =
      (centralBlockMap P k χ).comp (homCentralBlockEquiv P hM χ g)
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top_of_fg
statement:
theorem exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top_of_fg (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (hL : IsCategoryO P L) {S : Finset M}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) :
    ∃ T : Finset (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M),
      LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (T : Set (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr₁ : Function.Surjective (blockRetr P hM χ₁) := fun y ↦ ⟨(y : M), blockRetr_incl P hM χ₁ y⟩
  have hS₁ := lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective (blockRetr P hM χ₁) hr₁ hS
  rw [← Finset.coe_image] at hS₁
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_tensor_eq_top (L := 𝔤) (W := L) hS₁
  have hXO : IsCategoryO P (centralBlock P M χ₁ ⊗[K] L) := (hM.centralBlock P χ₁).tensorProduct hL
  have hr₂ : Function.Surjective (blockRetr P hXO χ₂) :=
    fun y ↦ ⟨(y : centralBlock P M χ₁ ⊗[K] L), blockRetr_incl P hXO χ₂ y⟩
  have hT₂ := lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective (blockRetr P hXO χ₂) hr₂ hT
  rw [← Finset.coe_image] at hT₂
  exact ⟨_, hT₂⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.homTranslationEquiv_comp_left
statement:
theorem homTranslationEquiv_comp_left (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (hM' : IsCategoryO P M')
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (hL : IsCategoryO P L) (f : M' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M)
    (g : centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    homTranslationEquiv P χ₁ χ₂ hM' hL (g.comp (centralTranslationMap P L χ₁ χ₂ f)) =
      (homTranslationEquiv P χ₁ χ₂ hM hL g).comp f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homTranslationEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, centralTranslationMap]
  rw [homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_left P _
      (((hM.centralBlock P χ₁).tensorProduct hL).isCentralLocallyFinite P),
    tensorHomAdjunction_comp_left,
    homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_left P (hM'.isCentralLocallyFinite P) (hM.isCentralLocallyFinite P)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.homTranslationEquiv_comp_right
statement:
theorem homTranslationEquiv_comp_right (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hL : IsCategoryO P L)
    (g : centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) (k : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') :
    homTranslationEquiv P χ₁ χ₂ hM hL (k.comp g) =
      (centralTranslationMap P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ k).comp
        (homTranslationEquiv P χ₁ χ₂ hM hL g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homTranslationEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, centralTranslationMap]
  rw [homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_right, tensorHomAdjunction_comp_right,
    homCentralBlockEquiv_comp_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.lie_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem lie_of_shortExact {S : ShortComplex (CategoryO.{u} P)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    Function.Injective S.f.hom.hom ∧ Function.Exact S.f.hom.hom S.g.hom.hom ∧
      Function.Surjective S.g.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  have : PreservesFiniteLimits (IsObj.{u} P).ι :=
    ((Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_tfae (IsObj.{u} P).ι).out 3 4).mp
      (IsObj.{u} P).preservesKernels_ι
  have : PreservesFiniteColimits (IsObj.{u} P).ι :=
    ((Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_tfae (IsObj.{u} P).ι).out 3 4).mp
      (IsObj.{u} P).preservesCokernels_ι
  have h := hS.map_of_exact (IsObj.{u} P).ι
  exact ⟨h.moduleCat_injective_f,
    (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp h.exact,
    h.moduleCat_surjective_g⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional'
statement: theorem isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional' : IsCategoryO P L
proof:
:=
  isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (V := L) Fact.out

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.translationFunctor_shortExact
statement:
theorem translationFunctor_shortExact {S : ShortComplex (CategoryO.{u} P)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hf, hex, hg⟩ := lie_of_shortExact hS
  obtain ⟨hf', hex', hg'⟩ := centralTranslationMap_shortExact P L S.X₂.property.1
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional' L) (toLieModuleHom S.f.hom) (toLieModuleHom S.g.hom) hf
    ((exact_iff_ker_eq_range P _ _).mp hex) hg χ₁ χ₂
  exact shortExact_of_lie hf' hg' fun y hy ↦ ((exact_iff_ker_eq_range P _ _).mpr hex' y).mp hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.translationFunctor_preservesFinite
statement:
theorem translationFunctor_preservesFinite :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂) ∧
      PreservesFiniteColimits (translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂)
proof:
:=
  ((Functor.exact_tfae (translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂)).out 1 4 rfl rfl).mp
    fun _ hS ↦ translationFunctor_shortExact L χ₁ χ₂ hS

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.translationHomEquiv_comp_left
statement:
theorem translationHomEquiv_comp_left {X' X Y : CategoryO.{u} P} (f : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : (translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂).obj X ⟶ Y) :
    translationHomEquiv L χ₁ χ₂ X' Y ((translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂).map f ≫ h) =
      f ≫ translationHomEquiv L χ₁ χ₂ X Y h
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun (homTranslationEquiv_comp_left P χ₁ χ₂ X'.property.1
    X.property.1 (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional' L) (toLieModuleHom f.hom)
    ((toLieModuleHom h.hom).comp
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ X.obj)).toLieModuleHom)) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.translationHomEquiv_comp_right
statement:
theorem translationHomEquiv_comp_right {X Y Y' : CategoryO.{u} P}
    (h : (translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂).obj X ⟶ Y) (k : Y ⟶ Y') :
    translationHomEquiv L χ₁ χ₂ X Y' (h ≫ k) =
      translationHomEquiv L χ₁ χ₂ X Y h ≫ (translationFunctor (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁).map k
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun (homTranslationEquiv_comp_right P χ₁ χ₂ X.property.1
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional' L)
    ((toLieModuleHom h.hom).comp
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ X.obj)).toLieModuleHom)
    (toLieModuleHom k.hom)) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sub_sub_mem_cone
statement:
lemma sub_sub_mem_cone {y ν ν' η ξ : Dual K H} (h₁ : y - ν' ∈ cone P η) (h₂ : η - ν ∈ cone P ξ) :
    y - ν - ν' ∈ cone P ξ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨k', hk', hke'⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨k + k', add_nonneg hk hk', ?_⟩
  rw [map_add]
  have : y - ν - ν' = (y - ν') - ν := by abel
  rw [this, hke, sub_sub, add_comm (P.rootOf k), ← sub_sub, hke', sub_sub, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_sum_of_character_eq_sum
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_sum_of_character_eq_sum (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (T : Finset (Dual K H))
    (h : hX.character = ∑ y ∈ T, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y).character) (η : Dual K H) :
    hX.multiplicity η = ∑ y ∈ T, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y).multiplicity η
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsCategoryO.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, ← map_sum] at h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.coeffAt η) (sumIrreducibleCharacter_injective h)
  simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities] at h1
  rw [CharacterRing.coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_sum] at h1
  simp only [← CharacterRing.coeffAt.eq_1, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities] at h1
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_nsmul_of_multiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.character_eq_nsmul_of_multiplicity_eq (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ y, hX.multiplicity y = n * hV.multiplicity y) :
    hX.character = n • hV.character
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCategoryO.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter,
    IsCategoryO.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, ← map_nsmul]
  congr 1
  ext y
  simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities, CharacterRing.coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_nsmul,
    Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [h, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_finsetSum
statement:
theorem multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_finsetSum (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {ν y : Dual K H}
    (hZν : ∀ ν', weightSpace P Z ν' ≠ ⊥ → ν' ∈ cone P ν) (s : Finset (Dual K H))
    (hs : ∀ η, y - ν ∈ cone P η → hV.multiplicity η ≠ 0 → η ∈ s) :
    (hV.centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y =
      ∑ η ∈ s, hV.multiplicity η *
        ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries (y - ν)
  rw [multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_sum P hV hZ χ₁ χ₂ hZν hl, Finset.sum_list_map_count]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_subset (fun η hη ↦ ?_) (fun η _ hηl ↦ ?_) |>.symm.trans
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun η hη ↦ ?_)
  · have hη' := List.mem_toFinset.mp hη
    have hc := hl.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights hη'
    exact hs η hc ((hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff hc hl).mpr hη')
  · by_cases hc : y - ν ∈ cone P η
    · have : hV.multiplicity η = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hηl (List.mem_toFinset.mpr ((hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff hc hl).mp h))
      rw [this, zero_mul]
    · rw [IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot
        ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂) ?_, mul_zero]
      refine weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η) hZ χ₁ χ₂
        hZν fun μ hμ ↦ weightSpace_lieSubmodule_eq_bot _ ?_
      by_contra hne
      exact hc (mem_cone_trans hμ (IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hne))
  · have hc := hl.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights (List.mem_toFinset.mp hη)
    rw [smul_eq_mul, hV.count_factorWeights_eq_multiplicity hc hl]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_cone_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {ν ξ η : Dual K H}
    (hZν : ∀ ν', weightSpace P Z ν' ≠ ⊥ → ν' ∈ cone P ν)
    (h : ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity η ≠ 0) :
    η - ν ∈ cone P ξ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  refine h (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot _ ?_)
  refine weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ) hZ χ₁ χ₂
    hZν fun μ hμ ↦ weightSpace_lieSubmodule_eq_bot _ ?_
  by_contra hne
  exact hc (mem_cone_trans hμ (IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hne))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_centralTranslation_of_equiv_eq_sum
statement:
theorem multiplicity_centralTranslation_of_equiv_eq_sum (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hX : IsCategoryO P X) (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (hZ' : IsCategoryO P Z')
    (χ₁ χ₂ χ₃ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V) {ν ν' y : Dual K H}
    (hZν : ∀ ν'', weightSpace P Z ν'' ≠ ⊥ → ν'' ∈ cone P ν)
    (hZν' : ∀ ν'', weightSpace P Z' ν'' ≠ ⊥ → ν'' ∈ cone P ν') (s : Finset (Dual K H))
    (hs : ∀ ξ, y - ν - ν' ∈ cone P ξ → hV.multiplicity ξ ≠ 0 → ξ ∈ s) :
    (hX.centralTranslation P hZ' χ₂ χ₃).multiplicity y =
      ∑ ξ ∈ s, hV.multiplicity ξ * ∑ᶠ η,
        ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity η *
          ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hZ' χ₂ χ₃).multiplicity y
proof:
:= by
  let a : Dual K H → Dual K H → ℕ := fun ξ η ↦
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity η
  let b : Dual K H → ℕ := fun η ↦
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hZ' χ₂ χ₃).multiplicity y
  have hfin := hX.finite_setOf_mem_cone (y - ν')
  have hmemH : ∀ η, y - ν' ∈ cone P η → hX.multiplicity η ≠ 0 → η ∈ hfin.toFinset :=
    fun η hc hη ↦ (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr
      ⟨hc, hX.weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hη⟩
  have hHs : ∀ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, y - ν' ∈ cone P η := fun η hη ↦
    ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hη).1
  
  have hXη : ∀ η, y - ν' ∈ cone P η → hX.multiplicity η = ∑ ξ ∈ s, hV.multiplicity ξ * a ξ η :=
    fun η hc ↦ (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr hX (hV.centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂) eX η).trans
      (multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_finsetSum P hV hZ χ₁ χ₂ hZν s
        fun ξ hξ hm ↦ hs ξ (sub_sub_mem_cone hc hξ) hm)
  have h1 : (hX.centralTranslation P hZ' χ₂ χ₃).multiplicity y =
      ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, hX.multiplicity η * b η :=
    multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_finsetSum P hX hZ' χ₂ χ₃ hZν' hfin.toFinset hmemH
  have hF : ∀ ξ ∈ s, hV.multiplicity ξ ≠ 0 →
      ∑ᶠ η, a ξ η * b η = ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, a ξ η * b η := by
    intro ξ _ hξ
    refine finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun η hη ↦ ?_
    have hne : a ξ η * b η ≠ 0 := Function.mem_support.mp hη
    have ha : a ξ η ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    have hc : y - ν' ∈ cone P η :=
      mem_cone_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero P hZ' χ₂ χ₃ hZν'
        (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
    refine Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hmemH η hc fun h0 ↦ ?_)
    have := hXη η hc
    rw [h0] at this
    have hterm := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp this.symm) ξ (hs ξ (sub_sub_mem_cone hc
      (mem_cone_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero P hZ χ₁ χ₂ hZν ha)) hξ)
    exact (mul_ne_zero hξ ha) hterm
  calc (hX.centralTranslation P hZ' χ₂ χ₃).multiplicity y
      = ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, hX.multiplicity η * b η := h1
    _ = ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, ∑ ξ ∈ s, hV.multiplicity ξ * a ξ η * b η :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun η hη ↦ by rw [hXη η (hHs η hη), Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ ξ ∈ s, ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, hV.multiplicity ξ * a ξ η * b η := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ ξ ∈ s, hV.multiplicity ξ * ∑ᶠ η, a ξ η * b η := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ξ hξs ↦ by
        by_cases hξ : hV.multiplicity ξ = 0
        · simp only [hξ, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        · rw [hF ξ hξs hξ, Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun η _ ↦ by ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_of_equiv (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (e : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V) (y : Dual K H) :
    (hV.centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y = hX.multiplicity y
proof:
:=
  (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr hX (hV.centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂) e y).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries y
  have hy := (hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff (mem_cone_self y) hl).mp h
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, -, h12, -, -, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hl.exists_of_mem_factorWeights hy
  by_contra hne
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (M₁.comap M₂.incl)
    (e.symm (IrreducibleModule.hwv P y))
  have hm : (q : V) ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock P V χ := by rw [hχ]; trivial
  have hq' : q ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock P M₂ χ :=
    mem_centralBlock_of_injective P M₂.incl (fun a b h ↦ Subtype.ext h) χ hm
  have h1 := map_mem_centralBlock P (e.toLieModuleHom.comp
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (M₁.comap M₂.incl))) χ hq'
  have h2 : (e.toLieModuleHom.comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (M₁.comap M₂.incl))) q =
      IrreducibleModule.hwv P y := by
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hq]
    exact e.apply_symm_apply _
  rw [h2, centralBlock_irreducible_eq_bot P y χ hne] at h1
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P y ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp h1)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero {V Z : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) →ₐ[K] K)
    {y : Dual K H} (h : (hV.centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y ≠ 0) :
    centralCharacter P y = χ₂
proof:
:=
  IsCategoryO.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P _
    (centralBlock_centralBlock_eq_top P _) h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.card_eq_stabilizerIndex
statement:
theorem card_eq_stabilizerIndex (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (lam μ : Dual K H)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) (T : Finset (Dual K H))
    (hT : (T : Set (Dual K H)) = {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA,
      P.weylDot hA w' μ = μ ∧ y = P.weylDot hA (w * w') lam}) :
    T.card = stabilizerIndex P hA lam μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stabilizerIndex, ← Nat.card_eq_finsetCard, ← Finset.coe_sort_coe, hT]
  refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective (fun y ↦ ⟨P.weylDot hA w⁻¹ y.1, ?_⟩) ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
  · obtain ⟨w', hw', hy⟩ := y.2
    refine ⟨w', hw', ?_⟩
    rw [hy]
    simp only [weylDot, sub_add_cancel, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, inv_mul_cancel]
    rfl
  · intro a b hab
    have := congrArg (fun y : {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA, P.weylDot hA w' μ = μ ∧
      y = P.weylDot hA w' lam} ↦ P.weylDot hA w y.1) hab
    simp only [weylDot, sub_add_cancel] at this
    rw [← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, mul_inv_cancel]
      at this
    exact Subtype.ext (by simpa using this)
  · rintro ⟨y, w', hw', rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨P.weylDot hA (w * w') lam, w', hw', rfl⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    simp only [weylDot, sub_add_cancel]
    rw [← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_translation_translation_verma
statement:
theorem multiplicity_translation_translation_verma {lam μ ν ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (μ - lam) = ν')
    (x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ)))
    (y : Dual K H) :
    (hX.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y =
      stabilizerIndex P hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam μ *
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ)).multiplicity y
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' x μ)) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' x.property μ) ▸
      centralBlock_verma P (P.weylDot hA' x μ)
  
  have hch0 := character_translation_verma_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hν hz hzν x
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hch⟩ := hch0
  let eTB := centralBlockEquiv P (rTensorEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hMχ)) (centralCharacter P lam)
  have hchX : hX.character = ∑ y' ∈ T, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y').character :=
    (IsCategoryO.character_congr hX _ (eX.trans eTB)).trans hch
  have hmX := hX.multiplicity_eq_sum_of_character_eq_sum P T hchX
  have hZν' : ∀ ν'', weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν') ν'' ≠ ⊥ → ν'' ∈ cone P ν' :=
    fun _ h ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot h
  have hfin := hX.finite_setOf_mem_cone (y - ν')
  have hmemH : ∀ η, y - ν' ∈ cone P η → hX.multiplicity η ≠ 0 → η ∈ hfin.toFinset :=
    fun η hc hη ↦ (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr
      ⟨hc, hX.weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hη⟩
  let b : Dual K H → ℕ := fun η ↦
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y
  let m : Dual K H → Dual K H → ℕ := fun y' η ↦ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y').multiplicity η
  have h1 : (hX.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν')
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y =
      ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, hX.multiplicity η * b η :=
    multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_finsetSum P hX (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν')
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) hZν' hfin.toFinset hmemH
  
  have hstep : ∀ y' ∈ T, ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, m y' η * b η =
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' x μ)).multiplicity y := by
    intro y' hy'
    have hy'' : y' ∈ (T : Set (Dual K H)) := hy'
    rw [hT] at hy''
    obtain ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩ := hy''
    have hA1 := multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_finsetSum P (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _)
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
      hZν' hfin.toFinset fun η hc hη ↦ hmemH η hc fun h0 ↦ hη
        ((Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp ((hmX η).symm.trans h0)) _ hy')
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hz' hzν'
      (x * w')
    have hxw : P.weylDot hA' (x * w') μ = P.weylDot hA' x μ := by
      have h1 : (w' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) = μ + P.rho := by
        have := congrArg (· + P.rho) hw'
        simpa [weylDot] using this
      simp only [weylDot, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, h1]
    have h2 := multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_of_equiv P
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' (x * w') lam))
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' (x * w') μ)) e y
    exact hA1.symm.trans (h2.trans (by rw [hxw]))
  calc _ = ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, hX.multiplicity η * b η := h1
    _ = ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, ∑ y' ∈ T, m y' η * b η :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun η _ ↦ by rw [hmX η, Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ y' ∈ T, ∑ η ∈ hfin.toFinset, m y' η * b η := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ y' ∈ T, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' x μ)).multiplicity y :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl hstep
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, card_eq_stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ x T hT]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_translation_translation_irreducible
statement:
theorem multiplicity_translation_translation_irreducible {lam μ ν ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (μ - lam) = ν')
    (x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (y : Dual K H) :
    ∑ᶠ η, ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ)).centralTranslation P
          (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
            (centralCharacter P lam)).multiplicity η *
        ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
          (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
            (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y =
      if P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ = y then
        stabilizerIndex P hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam μ else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hA') := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hZν : ∀ ν'', weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν'' ≠ ⊥ → ν'' ∈ cone P ν :=
    fun _ h ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot h
  have hZν' : ∀ ν'', weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν') ν'' ≠ ⊥ → ν'' ∈ cone P ν' :=
    fun _ h ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot h
  
  let a : Dual K H → Dual K H → ℕ := fun ξ η ↦
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam)).multiplicity η
  let b : Dual K H → Dual K H → ℕ := fun η y ↦
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y
  let G : Dual K H → Dual K H → ℕ := fun ξ y ↦ ∑ᶠ η, a ξ η * b η y
  let m : Dual K H → Dual K H → ℕ := fun ξ ξ' ↦ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ξ).multiplicity ξ'
  
  have hGη : ∀ ξ y, G ξ y ≠ 0 → ∃ η, a ξ η ≠ 0 ∧ b η y ≠ 0 := by
    intro ξ y hG
    by_contra hne
    push Not at hne
    exact hG (finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun η ↦ by
      by_cases ha : a ξ η = 0
      · rw [ha, zero_mul]
      · rw [hne η ha, mul_zero])
  have hGc : ∀ ξ y, G ξ y ≠ 0 → y - ν - ν' ∈ cone P ξ := by
    intro ξ y hG
    obtain ⟨η, ha, hb⟩ := hGη ξ y hG
    exact sub_sub_mem_cone
      (mem_cone_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν')
        _ _ hZν' hb)
      (mem_cone_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν)
        _ _ hZν ha)
  
  let S : Finset (Dual K H) := Finset.univ.image fun w : P.weylGroup hA' ↦ P.weylDot hA' w μ
  have hS : ∀ ξ, centralCharacter P ξ = centralCharacter P μ → ξ ∈ S := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA μ ξ).mp hξ.symm
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, by
      rw [weylDot, hwe, add_sub_cancel_right]⟩
  have hwS : ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA', P.weylDot hA' w μ ∈ S := fun w ↦
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  have hGS : ∀ ξ y, G ξ y ≠ 0 → y ∈ S := by
    intro ξ y hG
    obtain ⟨η, -, hb⟩ := hGη ξ y hG
    exact hS y (centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_centralTranslation_ne_zero P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') _ _ hb)
  
  have hverma : ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA', ∀ y, stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ *
      m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) y = ∑ ξ' ∈ S, m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * G ξ' y := by
    intro w y
    have hξV := VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
    have hX := hξV.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
    have hfin := hξV.finite_setOf_mem_cone (y - ν - ν')
    have hs : ∀ ξ', y - ν - ν' ∈ cone P ξ' → hξV.multiplicity ξ' ≠ 0 → ξ' ∈ hfin.toFinset :=
      fun ξ' hc h ↦ (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr
        ⟨hc, hξV.weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero h⟩
    have hB := multiplicity_translation_translation_verma P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν hν' hz'
      hzν' w hX LieModuleEquiv.refl y
    have hA2 := multiplicity_centralTranslation_of_equiv_eq_sum P hξV hX
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν')
      (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) LieModuleEquiv.refl
      hZν hZν' hfin.toFinset hs
    have hBA : stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ * m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) y =
        ∑ ξ' ∈ hfin.toFinset, m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * G ξ' y := hB.symm.trans hA2
    have hblock : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
      (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸
        centralBlock_verma P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
    have e1 : ∑ ξ' ∈ hfin.toFinset, m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * G ξ' y =
        ∑ ξ' ∈ hfin.toFinset ∪ S, m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * G ξ' y :=
      Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left fun ξ' _ hξ' ↦ by
        by_cases hc : y - ν - ν' ∈ cone P ξ'
        · by_cases hm : m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' = 0
          · rw [hm, zero_mul]
          · exact absurd (hs ξ' hc hm) hξ'
        · by_cases hG : G ξ' y = 0
          · rw [hG, mul_zero]
          · exact absurd (hGc ξ' y hG) hc
    have e2 : ∑ ξ' ∈ S, m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * G ξ' y =
        ∑ ξ' ∈ hfin.toFinset ∪ S, m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * G ξ' y :=
      Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right fun ξ' _ hξ' ↦ by
        by_cases hm : m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' = 0
        · rw [hm, zero_mul]
        · exact absurd (hS ξ' (hξV.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hblock hm)) hξ'
    exact hBA.trans (e1.trans e2.symm)
  
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA',
      (S.filter (· ∈ cone P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))).card ≤ N →
      ∀ y, y ∈ S → G (P.weylDot hA' w μ) y =
        if P.weylDot hA' w μ = y then stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ else 0 := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero =>
      intro w hw
      exfalso
      have : P.weylDot hA' w μ ∈ S.filter (· ∈ cone P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)) :=
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hwS w, mem_cone_self _⟩
      exact absurd (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨_, this⟩) (by omega)
    | succ N ih =>
      intro w hw y hy
      have hv := hverma w y
      have hself : m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) (P.weylDot hA' w μ) = 1 :=
        VermaModule.multiplicity_self (P := P) _
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase S _ (hwS w), hself, one_mul] at hv
      
      have hlow : ∀ ξ' ∈ S.erase (P.weylDot hA' w μ), m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * G ξ' y =
          m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' * (if ξ' = y then stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ else 0) := by
        intro ξ' hξ'
        obtain ⟨hne, hξ'S⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hξ'
        by_cases hm : m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ξ' = 0
        · rw [hm, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        obtain ⟨w', -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hξ'S
        have hlt := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (P := P) hm
        refine congrArg _ (ih w' ?_ y hy)
        refine Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.card_lt_card ?_) hw)
        refine ⟨fun a ha ↦ ?_, fun hsub ↦ ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨haS, hac⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨haS, mem_cone_trans hac hlt⟩
        · have hξmem : P.weylDot hA' w μ ∈ S.filter (· ∈ cone P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)) :=
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hwS w, mem_cone_self _⟩
          exact hne (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hlt (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub hξmem)).2)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hlow] at hv
      by_cases hξy : P.weylDot hA' w μ = y
      · subst hξy
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ξ' hξ' ↦ by
          rw [ite_eq_right (Finset.mem_erase.mp hξ').1, mul_zero], add_zero, hself, mul_one] at hv
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
        exact hv.symm
      · rw [ite_eq_right hξy]
        have hyS : y ∈ S.erase (P.weylDot hA' w μ) := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hξy, hy⟩
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hyS, ite_eq_left rfl,
          Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ξ' hξ' ↦ by
            rw [ite_eq_right (Finset.mem_erase.mp hξ').1, mul_zero], add_zero] at hv
        have hc := mul_comm (stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ) (m (P.weylDot hA' w μ) y)
        omega
  
  change G (P.weylDot hA' x μ) y = _
  by_cases hy : y ∈ S
  · exact key _ x le_rfl y hy
  · rw [ite_eq_right fun (h : P.weylDot hA' x μ = y) ↦ hy (h ▸ hwS x)]
    by_contra hG
    exact hy (hGS _ y hG)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.character_translation_translation
statement:
theorem character_translation_translation {lam μ ν ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (μ - lam) = ν')
    {V X : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hVμ : centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤)
    (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) V) :
    (hX.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)).character =
      stabilizerIndex P hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam μ • hV.character
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hZν : ∀ ν'', weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν'' ≠ ⊥ → ν'' ∈ cone P ν :=
    fun _ h ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot h
  have hZν' : ∀ ν'', weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν') ν'' ≠ ⊥ → ν'' ∈ cone P ν' :=
    fun _ h ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot h
  let G : Dual K H → Dual K H → ℕ := fun ξ y ↦ ∑ᶠ η,
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam)).multiplicity η *
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y
  
  have hG : ∀ ξ y, hV.multiplicity ξ ≠ 0 →
      G ξ y = if ξ = y then stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ else 0 := by
    intro ξ y hξ
    have hχ := hV.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hVμ hξ
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA μ ξ).mp hχ.symm
    have hξ' : ξ = P.weylDot hA' ⟨w, hw⟩ μ := by rw [weylDot, hwe, add_sub_cancel_right]
    subst hξ'
    exact multiplicity_translation_translation_irreducible P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν hν' hz'
      hzν' _ y
  have hmult : ∀ y, (hX.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν')
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y =
      stabilizerIndex P hA' lam μ * hV.multiplicity y := by
    intro y
    have hfin := hV.finite_setOf_mem_cone (y - ν - ν')
    have hs : ∀ ξ, y - ν - ν' ∈ cone P ξ → hV.multiplicity ξ ≠ 0 →
        ξ ∈ insert y hfin.toFinset := fun ξ hc h ↦ Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr ⟨hc, hV.weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero h⟩)
    have h1 : (hX.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν')
        (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y =
        ∑ ξ ∈ insert y hfin.toFinset, hV.multiplicity ξ * G ξ y :=
      multiplicity_centralTranslation_of_equiv_eq_sum P hV hX
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') _ _ _ eX hZν
        hZν' _ hs
    refine h1.trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem y (Finset.mem_insert_self y _) fun ξ _ hξy ↦ ?_]
    · by_cases hy : hV.multiplicity y = 0
      · rw [hy, zero_mul, mul_zero]
      · rw [hG y y hy, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_comm]
    · by_cases hξ : hV.multiplicity ξ = 0
      · rw [hξ, zero_mul]
      · rw [hG ξ y hξ, ite_eq_right hξy, mul_zero]
  exact IsCategoryO.character_eq_nsmul_of_multiplicity_eq P _ hV _ hmult

name: LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis K W
  let t : Finset (V ⊗[K] W) := (s ×ˢ Finset.univ).image fun p ↦ p.1 ⊗ₜ b p.2
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  set N := lieSpan K L (t : Set (V ⊗[K] W))
  
  have hs' : ∀ m ∈ s, ∀ w, m ⊗ₜ[K] w ∈ N := by
    intro m hm w
    rw [← b.sum_repr w, tmul_sum]
    refine N.sum_mem fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [tmul_smul]
    exact N.smul_mem _ (subset_lieSpan (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨(m, i), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hm, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, rfl⟩)))
  
  let S : LieSubmodule K L V :=
    { carrier := {m | ∀ w, m ⊗ₜ[K] w ∈ N}
      add_mem' := fun ha hb w ↦ by rw [add_tmul]; exact N.add_mem (ha w) (hb w)
      zero_mem' := fun w ↦ by rw [zero_tmul]; exact N.zero_mem
      smul_mem' := fun c m hm w ↦ by rw [← smul_tmul']; exact N.smul_mem c (hm w)
      lie_mem := fun {x m} hm w ↦ by
        have h : ⁅x, m ⊗ₜ[K] w⁆ = ⁅x, m⁆ ⊗ₜ[K] w + m ⊗ₜ[K] ⁅x, w⁆ :=
          TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right x m w
        have h' : ⁅x, m⁆ ⊗ₜ[K] w = ⁅x, m ⊗ₜ[K] w⁆ - m ⊗ₜ[K] ⁅x, w⁆ := by
          rw [h, add_sub_cancel_right]
        rw [h']
        exact N.sub_mem (N.lie_mem (hm w)) (hm _) }
  have hS : lieSpan K L (s : Set V) ≤ S := by
    rw [lieSpan_le]
    exact fun m hm ↦ hs' m hm
  rw [hs] at hS
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro y -
  induction y with
  | add a b ha hb => exact N.add_mem ha hb
  | tmul m w => exact hS (mem_top m) w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translationIdem_idempotent
statement:
theorem translationIdem_idempotent (hL : IsCategoryO P L) (hL' : IsCategoryO P L')
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (t : M ⊗[K] (L ⊗[K] L')) :
    translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ M hM (translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ M hM t) =
      translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ M hM t
proof:
:= by
  set hML := hM.tensorProduct hL
  set hMLL := hML.tensorProduct hL'
  set p₁ := TensorProduct.LieModule.map (hML.centralBlockProjection P χ₁)
    (LieModuleHom.id : L' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L')
  set p₂ := hMLL.centralBlockProjection P χ₂
  have h₁ : ∀ y, p₁ (p₁ y) = p₁ y := by
    intro y
    induction y with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
    | tmul m l =>
      change hML.centralBlockProjection P χ₁ (hML.centralBlockProjection P χ₁ m) ⊗ₜ l =
        hML.centralBlockProjection P χ₁ m ⊗ₜ l
      exact congrArg (· ⊗ₜ l)
        (centralBlockProjection_self P _ χ₁ (centralBlockProjection_mem P _ χ₁ m))
  have h₂ : ∀ y, p₂ (p₂ y) = p₂ y := fun y ↦
    centralBlockProjection_self P _ χ₂ (centralBlockProjection_mem P _ χ₂ y)
  have h₁₂ : ∀ y, p₁ (p₂ y) = p₂ (p₁ y) := fun y ↦
    DFunLike.congr_fun (IsCategoryO.centralBlockProjection_natural P hMLL hMLL p₁ χ₂) y
  change LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (p₂ (p₁ ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L').symm
      (LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (p₂ (p₁ _)))))) =
    LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (p₂ (p₁ _))
  rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_apply, h₁₂, h₁, h₂]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ofCentral_comp_rTensor_app_eq_translationIdem
statement:
theorem ofCentral_comp_rTensor_app_eq_translationIdem (hL : IsCategoryO P L)
    (hL' : IsCategoryO P L') (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (z₁ z₂ : 𝓩) (M : Type w₀) [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (h₁ : ∀ v, rep P (M ⊗[K] L) (z₁ : 𝓤) v =
      (hM.tensorProduct hL).centralBlockProjection P χ₁ v)
    (h₂ : ∀ v, rep P ((M ⊗[K] L) ⊗[K] L') (z₂ : 𝓤) v =
      ((hM.tensorProduct hL).tensorProduct hL').centralBlockProjection P χ₂ v) :
    ((TensorNatTrans.ofCentral.{_, _, w₀} (L ⊗[K] L') (z₂ : 𝓤) z₂.property).comp
      (TensorNatTrans.rTensor L' (TensorNatTrans.ofCentral L (z₁ : 𝓤) z₁.property))).app M =
        translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ M hM
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  set e := LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L'
  have hmap : ∀ y : M ⊗[K] L ⊗[K] L', TensorProduct.LieModule.map
      ((TensorNatTrans.ofCentral L (z₁ : 𝓤) z₁.property).app M)
      (LieModuleHom.id : L' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L') y =
      TensorProduct.LieModule.map ((hM.tensorProduct hL).centralBlockProjection P χ₁)
      (LieModuleHom.id : L' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L') y := by
    intro y
    induction y with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
    | tmul m l => exact congrArg (· ⊗ₜ l) (h₁ m)
  have hassoc := LieModuleHom.map_actionHom e.toLieModuleHom (z₂ : 𝓤)
    (TensorProduct.LieModule.map ((TensorNatTrans.ofCentral L (z₁ : 𝓤) z₁.property).app M)
      (LieModuleHom.id : L' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L') (e.symm x))
  refine hassoc.symm.trans ?_
  change e (rep P _ (z₂ : 𝓤) _) = e _
  rw [h₂, hmap]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_tensorNatTrans_app_eq_translationIdem
statement:
theorem exists_tensorNatTrans_app_eq_translationIdem [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L'] (hL : IsCategoryO P L) (hL' : IsCategoryO P L') (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    {M N : Type w₀} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N] [LieModule K 𝔤 N]
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {s : Finset M} (hs : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hN : IsCategoryO P N) {t : Finset N} (ht : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (t : Set N) = ⊤) :
    ∃ e : TensorNatTrans.{_, _, w₀} K 𝔤 (L ⊗[K] L') (L ⊗[K] L'),
      e.app M = translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ M hM ∧
        e.app N = translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ N hN
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ := LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top (W := L) hs
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top (W := L) ht
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂⟩ := LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top (W := L') hs₁
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top (W := L') ht₁
  obtain ⟨z₁, hzM₁, hzN₁⟩ := exists_rep_eq_centralBlockProjection₂ P
    ((hM.tensorProduct hL).isCentralLocallyFinite P) hs₁
    ((hN.tensorProduct hL).isCentralLocallyFinite P) ht₁ χ₁
  obtain ⟨z₂, hzM₂, hzN₂⟩ := exists_rep_eq_centralBlockProjection₂ P
    (((hM.tensorProduct hL).tensorProduct hL').isCentralLocallyFinite P) hs₂
    (((hN.tensorProduct hL).tensorProduct hL').isCentralLocallyFinite P) ht₂ χ₂
  exact ⟨_, ofCentral_comp_rTensor_app_eq_translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ z₁ z₂ M hM hzM₁ hzM₂,
    ofCentral_comp_rTensor_app_eq_translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ z₁ z₂ N hN hzN₁ hzN₂⟩

name: LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorAssoc_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (q : Q) :
    tensorAssoc R L M N Q ((m ⊗ₜ[R] n) ⊗ₜ[R] q) = m ⊗ₜ[R] (n ⊗ₜ[R] q)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_tensor_verma_tensor_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_tensor_verma_tensor_of_isDominant {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) {L L' : Type*} [AddCommGroup L] [Module K L]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 L] [LieModule K 𝔤 L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [AddCommGroup L']
    [Module K L'] [LieRingModule 𝔤 L'] [LieModule K 𝔤 L'] [FiniteDimensional K L']
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P μ ⊗[K] L') =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (L ⊗[K] Module.Dual K L') (h P) (μ - Λ))
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ := lieModuleHomCongr P (LieModuleEquiv.refl (M := VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L))
    (LieModuleEquiv.tensorCongr (LieModuleEquiv.refl (M := VermaModule P μ))
      (evalEquiv (L := 𝔤) (M := L')))
  have e₂ := (tensorHomAdjunction P (M := VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L) (N := VermaModule P μ)
    (L := Module.Dual K L')).symm
  have e₃ := lieModuleHomCongr P
    (LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 (VermaModule P Λ) L (Module.Dual K L'))
    (LieModuleEquiv.refl (M := VermaModule P μ))
  rw [(e₁.trans (e₂.trans e₃)).finrank_eq]
  exact finrank_hom_tensor_verma_of_isDominant P hA hΛ μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_tensor_verma_tensor_self_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_tensor_verma_tensor_self_of_isDominant {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) {L L' : Type*} [AddCommGroup L] [Module K L]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 L] [LieModule K 𝔤 L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [AddCommGroup L']
    [Module K L'] [LieRingModule 𝔤 L'] [LieModule K 𝔤 L'] [FiniteDimensional K L'] :
    finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L') =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (L ⊗[K] Module.Dual K L') (h P) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_hom_tensor_verma_tensor_of_isDominant P hA hΛ, sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.ext
statement:
@[ext] lemma ext {φ ψ : TwistedDual P V} (hφψ : ∀ v, toDual P V φ v = toDual P V ψ v) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  (toDual P V).injective (LinearMap.ext hφψ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.ext_tmul
statement:
lemma ext_tmul {φ ψ : TwistedDual P (V ⊗[K] W)}
    (hφψ : ∀ v w, toDual P _ φ (v ⊗ₜ w) = toDual P _ ψ (v ⊗ₜ w)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  (toDual P _).injective (TensorProduct.ext' hφψ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.toDual_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma toDual_map (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (φ : TwistedDual P W) (v : V) :
    toDual P V (map P f φ) v = toDual P W φ (f v)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.toDual_rep
statement:
theorem toDual_rep (u : 𝓤) (φ : TwistedDual P V) :
    toDual P V (rep P (TwistedDual P V) u φ) =
      toDual P V φ ∘ₗ rep P V (envTranspose P u).unop
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing φ with
  | algebraMap c =>
    ext v
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | ι x =>
    ext v
    rw [rep_ι, lie_apply, envTranspose_ι, MulOpposite.unop_op, LinearMap.comp_apply, rep_ι]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    ext v
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, LinearMap.comp_apply, hb, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      unop_envTranspose_mul, map_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    ext v
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, LinearMap.comp_apply, MulOpposite.unop_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff {μ : Dual K H} {φ : TwistedDual P V} :
    φ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) μ ↔
      ∀ a v, toDual P V φ ⁅h P a, v⁆ = μ a * toDual P V φ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_weightSpaceOfMap]
  constructor
  · intro hφ a v
    have := congrArg (fun ψ ↦ toDual P V ψ v) (hφ a)
    simpa only [lie_apply, transpose_h, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  · intro hφ a
    ext v
    rw [lie_apply, transpose_h, hφ, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.apply_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, μ a ≠ ν a := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hne (LinearMap.ext hc)
  have h1 := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff.mp hφ a v
  rw [hv a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h2 : (μ a - ν a) * toDual P V φ v = 0 := by linear_combination -h1
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_mem_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
lemma map_mem_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) : f v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ v hv => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hv)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tmul_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, hv a, hw a]
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul, tmul_smul, smul_tmul']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tmul_mem_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ v hv =>
    induction hw using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem ν w hw => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (tmul_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P hv hw)
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [tmul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_tmul]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_restrictedDual
statement:
lemma mem_restrictedDual {φ : TwistedDual P V} :
    φ ∈ restrictedDual P V ↔ φ ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) μ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDual_ext
statement:
lemma restrictedDual_ext {φ ψ : restrictedDual P V}
    (hφψ : ∀ v, toDual P V φ.val v = toDual P V ψ.val v) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (TwistedDual.ext hφψ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_restrictedDualMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma toDual_restrictedDualMap (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (φ : restrictedDual P W) (v : V) :
    toDual P V (restrictedDualMap P f φ).val v = toDual P W φ.val (f v)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_tensorDualLin_tmul
statement:
lemma toDual_tensorDualLin_tmul (φ : TwistedDual P V) (l : L) (v : V) (l' : L) :
    toDual P _ (tensorDualLin P B (φ ⊗ₜ l)) (v ⊗ₜ l') = toDual P V φ v * B l l'
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_tensorDualHom_tmul
statement:
lemma toDual_tensorDualHom_tmul (φ : TwistedDual P V) (l : L) (v : V) (l' : L) :
    toDual P _ (tensorDualHom P B hB (φ ⊗ₜ l)) (v ⊗ₜ l') = toDual P V φ v * B l l'
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_sliceDual
statement:
@[simp] lemma toDual_sliceDual (l : L) (Ψ : TwistedDual P (V ⊗[K] L)) (v : V) :
    toDual P V (sliceDual P l Ψ) v = toDual P _ Ψ (v ⊗ₜ l)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sliceDual_add
statement:
lemma sliceDual_add (l l' : L) (Ψ : TwistedDual P (V ⊗[K] L)) :
    sliceDual P (l + l') Ψ = sliceDual P l Ψ + sliceDual P l' Ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [toDual_sliceDual, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, toDual_sliceDual, toDual_sliceDual,
    tmul_add, map_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sliceDual_zero
statement: lemma sliceDual_zero (Ψ : TwistedDual P (V ⊗[K] L)) : sliceDual P (0 : L) Ψ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [toDual_sliceDual, tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sliceDual_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff] at hΨ ⊢
  intro a v
  have h1 := hΨ a (v ⊗ₜ l)
  rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, map_add, hl a, tmul_smul, map_smul,
    smul_eq_mul] at h1
  rw [toDual_sliceDual, toDual_sliceDual, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_mul]
  linear_combination h1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sliceDual_mem_restrictedDual
statement:
lemma sliceDual_mem_restrictedDual (hL : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap L (h P) μ = ⊤) (l : L)
    (Ψ : restrictedDual P (V ⊗[K] L)) : sliceDual P l Ψ.val ∈ restrictedDual P V
proof:
:= by
  have hl : l ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap L (h P) μ := hL ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ := Ψ
  change Ψ ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap _ (h P) μ at hΨ
  induction hΨ using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem κ Ψ hΨ =>
    induction hl using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem ν l hl => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (sliceDual_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P hΨ hl)
    | zero => rw [sliceDual_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add l l' _ _ hl hl' => rw [sliceDual_add]; exact add_mem hl hl'
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add Ψ Ψ' _ _ hΨ hΨ' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hΨ hΨ'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_apply_dualBasis_smul
statement:
lemma sum_apply_dualBasis_smul {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (hBn : B.Nondegenerate)
    (b : Basis ι' K L) (l : L) : ∑ i, B l (b i) • B.dualBasis hBn b i = l
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← (B.dualBasis hBn b).sum_repr l]
  simp only [LinearMap.BilinForm.dualBasis_repr_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_dualBasis_apply_smul
statement:
lemma sum_dualBasis_apply_smul {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (hBn : B.Nondegenerate)
    (hBs : B.IsSymm) (b : Basis ι' K L) (l : L) : ∑ i, B (B.dualBasis hBn b i) l • b i = l
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← (B.dualBasis hBn (B.dualBasis hBn b)).sum_repr l]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.dualBasis_repr_apply, hBs.eq,
    LinearMap.BilinForm.dualBasis_dualBasis hBn hBs b]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weightSpace_pseudoInverse
statement:
lemma exists_weightSpace_pseudoInverse (g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (κ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ t : weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) κ →ₗ[K] weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ,
      ∀ v (hv : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ),
        g (t ⟨g v, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hv⟩ : V) = g v
proof:
:= by
  let gκ : weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ →ₗ[K] weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) κ :=
    ((g : V →ₗ[K] W).comp (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ).subtype).codRestrict _
      fun x ↦ map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g x.2
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := LinearMap.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective gκ.rangeRestrict
    (LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict gκ)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (LinearMap.range gκ).subtype
    (Submodule.ker_subtype _)
  refine ⟨s ∘ₗ r, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 : r ⟨g v, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hv⟩ = gκ.rangeRestrict ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun hr (gκ.rangeRestrict ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have h2 : gκ (s (gκ.rangeRestrict ⟨v, hv⟩)) = gκ ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.congr_fun hs (gκ.rangeRestrict ⟨v, hv⟩))
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, h1]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_restrictedDualMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_restrictedDualMap_eq (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (hW : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ = ⊤) (g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (φ : restrictedDual P V)
    (hφ : ∀ v, g v = 0 → TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 v = 0) :
    ∃ ψ : restrictedDual P W, restrictedDualMap P g ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  choose t ht using exists_weightSpace_pseudoInverse P g
  
  have key : ∀ θ ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) μ,
      ∃ ψ : restrictedDual P W, ∀ κ v (hv : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ),
        TwistedDual.toDual P W ψ.1 (g v) =
          TwistedDual.toDual P V θ (t κ ⟨g v, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hv⟩ : V) := by
    intro θ hθ
    induction hθ using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem μ θ hθ =>
      let γ : Module.Dual K (weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ) :=
        TwistedDual.toDual P V θ ∘ₗ (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ).subtype ∘ₗ t μ
      refine ⟨⟨(TwistedDual.toDual P W).symm (γ ∘ₗ weightProj P hW μ),
        Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp hW μ γ)⟩,
        fun κ v hv ↦ ?_⟩
      change γ (weightProj P hW μ (g v)) = _
      by_cases hκ : κ = μ
      · subst hκ
        rw [weightProj_of_mem hW (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hv)]
        rfl
      · rw [weightProj_of_mem_ne hW (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hv) hκ, map_zero,
          TwistedDual.apply_eq_zero_of_ne hθ (t κ _).2 (Ne.symm hκ)]
    | zero => exact ⟨0, fun κ v hv ↦ by simp⟩
    | add θ₁ θ₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
      obtain ⟨ψ₁, e₁⟩ := h₁
      obtain ⟨ψ₂, e₂⟩ := h₂
      exact ⟨ψ₁ + ψ₂, fun κ v hv ↦ by
        simp only [LieSubmodule.coe_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, e₁ κ v hv, e₂ κ v hv]⟩
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := key φ.1 φ.2
  refine ⟨ψ, restrictedDual_ext P fun v ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [toDual_restrictedDualMap]
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem κ v hv =>
    rw [hψ κ v hv, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub]
    exact hφ _ (by rw [map_sub, ht κ v hv, sub_self])
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.injective_restrictedDualMap
statement:
theorem injective_restrictedDualMap (g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Injective (restrictedDualMap P g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro ψ hψ
  refine restrictedDual_ext P fun w ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hg w
  have := congrArg (fun φ : restrictedDual P V ↦ TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 v)
    ((LieModuleHom.mem_ker).mp hψ)
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exact_restrictedDualMap
statement:
theorem exact_restrictedDualMap (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (hW : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ = ⊤) {f : U →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V} {g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W}
    (hfg : Function.Exact f g) :
    Function.Exact (restrictedDualMap P g) (restrictedDualMap P f)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  constructor
  · intro hφ
    refine exists_restrictedDualMap_eq P hV hW g φ fun v hv ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (hfg v).mp hv
    have := congrArg (fun χ : restrictedDual P U ↦ TwistedDual.toDual P U χ.1 u) hφ
    simpa using this
  · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
    refine restrictedDual_ext P fun u ↦ ?_
    simp only [toDual_restrictedDualMap, (hfg (f u)).mpr ⟨u, rfl⟩, map_zero]
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_restrictedDoubleDualLin
statement:
@[simp] lemma toDual_restrictedDoubleDualLin (v : V) (φ : restrictedDual P V) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P (restrictedDual P V) (restrictedDoubleDualLin v) φ =
      TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDoubleDualLin_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [TwistedDual.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff]
  intro a φ
  rw [toDual_restrictedDoubleDualLin, toDual_restrictedDoubleDualLin, LieSubmodule.coe_bracket,
    lie_apply, transpose_h, hv a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_restrictedDoubleDual
statement:
@[simp] lemma toDual_restrictedDoubleDual (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) (v : V)
    (φ : restrictedDual P V) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P (restrictedDual P V) (restrictedDoubleDual hV v).1 φ =
      TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDualMap_restrictedDualMap_comp
statement:
theorem restrictedDualMap_restrictedDualMap_comp (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (hW : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ = ⊤) (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) :
    (restrictedDualMap P (restrictedDualMap P f)).comp (restrictedDoubleDual hV) =
      (restrictedDoubleDual hW).comp f
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ restrictedDual_ext P fun _ ↦ rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_forall_weightProj_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_forall_weightProj_eq_zero (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) {v : V}
    (hv : ∀ κ, weightProj P hV κ v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset.mp hmem
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum] at hs
  obtain ⟨μ, rfl⟩ := hs
  have hμ : ∀ κ ∈ s, (μ κ : V) = 0 := by
    intro κ hκ
    have h1 := congrArg Subtype.val (hv κ)
    rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem κ hκ fun ν _ hν ↦ weightProj_of_mem_ne hV
      (μ ν).2 hν, weightProj_of_mem hV (μ κ).2] at h1
    simpa using h1
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.injective_restrictedDoubleDual
statement:
theorem injective_restrictedDoubleDual (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) :
    Function.Injective (restrictedDoubleDual (P := P) hV)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro v hv
  refine eq_zero_of_forall_weightProj_eq_zero hV fun κ ↦ ?_
  refine (Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K _).mp fun γ ↦ ?_
  have := congrArg (fun Ψ : restrictedDual P (restrictedDual P V) ↦
    TwistedDual.toDual P (restrictedDual P V) Ψ.1
      ⟨(TwistedDual.toDual P V).symm (γ ∘ₗ weightProj P hV κ),
      Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem κ (mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp hV κ γ)⟩)
    ((LieModuleHom.mem_ker).mp hv)
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_restrictedDoubleDual
statement:
theorem surjective_restrictedDoubleDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    Function.Surjective (restrictedDoubleDual (P := P) hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  have hd' := (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  rintro ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩
  suffices H : ∀ Ψ ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P (restrictedDual P V)) (h P) μ,
      ∃ v, (restrictedDoubleDual hd v).1 = Ψ by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := H Ψ hΨ
    exact ⟨v, Subtype.ext hv⟩
  intro Ψ hΨ
  induction hΨ using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ Ψ hΨ =>
    have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    
    let ι : Module.Dual K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) →ₗ[K] restrictedDual P V :=
      { toFun γ := ⟨(TwistedDual.toDual P V).symm (γ ∘ₗ weightProj P hd μ),
          Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp hd μ γ)⟩
        map_add' _ _ := rfl
        map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
    set v := (Module.evalEquiv K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ)).symm
      (TwistedDual.toDual P (restrictedDual P V) Ψ ∘ₗ ι)
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    refine eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_twistedDual hd'
      (Submodule.sub_mem _ (restrictedDoubleDualLin_mem_weightSpace v.2) hΨ) fun φ hφ ↦ ?_
    
    have hφ' := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hφ
    have hι : ι (TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 ∘ₗ (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ).subtype) = φ := by
      have e := (weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ).symm_apply_apply ⟨φ.1, hφ'⟩
      have e' : ((weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ).symm
          ((weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ) ⟨φ.1, hφ'⟩)).1 = φ.1 :=
        congrArg Subtype.val e
      exact Subtype.ext e'
    have := Module.apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply
      (f := TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 ∘ₗ (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ).subtype)
      (g := TwistedDual.toDual P (restrictedDual P V) Ψ ∘ₗ ι)
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hι] at this
    rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    exact this
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add Ψ₁ Ψ₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨v₁, e₁⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨v₂, e₂⟩ := h₂
    exact ⟨v₁ + v₂, by rw [map_add, LieSubmodule.coe_add, e₁, e₂]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDoubleDualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrictedDoubleDualEquiv_apply (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (v : V) :
    restrictedDoubleDualEquiv hV v = restrictedDoubleDual hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negSpan_le
statement: lemma negSpan_le (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) : negSpan P N.toSubmodule ≤ N.toSubmodule
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun i ↦ by
    rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    exact N.lie_mem hn

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negSpan_mono
statement: lemma negSpan_mono {N N' : Submodule K X} (h : N ≤ N') : negSpan P N ≤ negSpan P N'
proof:
:=
  iSup_mono fun _ ↦ Submodule.map_mono h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toEnd_f_mem_negSpan
statement:
lemma toEnd_f_mem_negSpan {N : Submodule K X} (i : ι) {n : X} (hn : n ∈ N) :
    ⁅f P i, n⁆ ∈ negSpan P N
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negSpan_induction
statement:
lemma negSpan_induction {N : Submodule K X} {p : X → Prop} (mem : ∀ i, ∀ n ∈ N, p ⁅f P i, n⁆)
    (zero : p 0) (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ negSpan P N) : p x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem i x hx =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact mem i n hn
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker
statement:
lemma finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker {Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]
    (g : X →ₗ[K] Z) (S : Submodule K X) [FiniteDimensional K S] :
    finrank K (S.map g) + finrank K ↥(S ⊓ LinearMap.ker g) = finrank K S
proof:
:= by
  have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (g.domRestrict S)
  rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, LinearMap.ker_domRestrict] at this
  rw [← this, ← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq S ((LinearMap.ker g).comap S.subtype),
    Submodule.map_comap_subtype]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_injective
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_injective (g : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) (hg : Function.Injective g) {ν : Dual K H}
    {x : X} (hx : g x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) ν) : x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  apply hg
  rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, map_smul]
  exact hx a

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_mem
statement: lemma rep_mem (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) (u : 𝓤) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ N) : rep P X u x ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing x with
  | algebraMap r => rw [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]; exact N.smul_mem r hx
  | ι y => rw [rep_ι]; exact N.lie_mem hx
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]; exact ha (hb hx)
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact N.add_mem (ha hx) (hb hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace_wordWt
statement:
lemma rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace_wordWt {μ : Dual K H} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) μ)
    (w : List ι) : rep P X (fWord P w) x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) (μ - wt w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using hx
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [fWord_cons, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, rep_ι, AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons,
      show μ - (P.root j + wt w) = μ - wt w - P.root j by abel]
    exact toEnd_f_mem_weightSpace j ih

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_section
statement:
theorem exists_section (hX : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν = ⊤) (hNN' : N ≤ N')
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) :
    ∃ σ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ[K] X,
      (∀ m, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (σ m) = (e m : X ⧸ N)) ∧ (∀ m, σ m ∈ N') ∧
      (∀ i m, σ ⁅f P i, m⁆ = ⁅f P i, σ m⁆) ∧
      (∀ ν m, m ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν →
        σ m ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν)
proof:
:= by
  set ι' : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X ⧸ N := (N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)).incl.comp
    e.toLieModuleHom
  set y : X ⧸ N := ι' (hwv P μ)
  have hyw : y ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (X ⧸ N) (h P) μ :=
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P ι' (hwv_mem_weightSpace P μ)
  obtain ⟨x, hxw, hxy⟩ := (map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P N hX μ).ge hyw
  change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N x = y at hxy
  have hxN' : x ∈ N' := by
    obtain ⟨x', hx', hx'y⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (e (hwv P μ)).2
    have : x - x' ∈ N := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub]
      change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N x - LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N x' = 0
      rw [hxy, hx'y]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr rfl
    simpa using N'.add_mem (hNN' this) hx'
  set E := equivEnvNNeg P μ
  set σ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ[K] X :=
    (LinearMap.applyₗ x ∘ₗ (rep P X).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (mapN).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ E.symm.toLinearMap
  have hσ (m : VermaModule P μ) : σ m = rep P X (mapN (E.symm m)) x := rfl
  have hE (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P)) : E u = mapN u • hwv P μ :=
    equivEnvNNeg_apply P μ u
  refine ⟨σ, fun m ↦ ?_, fun m ↦ ?_, fun i m ↦ ?_, fun ν m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := E.surjective m
    rw [hσ, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_rep, hxy, hE]
    change _ = ι' (mapN u • hwv P μ)
    rw [map_smul_eq_rep]
  · exact rep_mem P N' _ hxN'
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := E.surjective m
    have h1 : ⁅f P i, E u⁆ = E (fWordNeg P [i] * u) := by
      rw [equivEnvNNeg_mul, map_fWordNeg, hE, fWord_cons, fWord_nil, mul_one,
        VermaModule.lie_eq_smul P μ]
    rw [h1, hσ, hσ, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_mul,
      map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, map_fWordNeg, fWord_cons, fWord_nil, mul_one, rep_ι]
  · have hm' := weightSpace_le_wordSpan P μ ν hm
    rw [wordSpan] at hm'
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun m _ ↦ σ m ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) ?_
      (by simp) (fun _ _ _ _ h1 h2 ↦ by rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h1 h2)
      (fun c _ _ h1 ↦ by rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c h1) hm'
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    rw [hσ]
    dsimp only
    rw [← equivEnvNNeg_fWordNeg, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_fWordNeg, ← hw]
    exact rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace_wordWt P hxw w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negSpan_inf_le
statement:
theorem negSpan_inf_le (hX : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν = ⊤) (hNN' : N ≤ N')
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) :
    negSpan P N'.toSubmodule ⊓ N.toSubmodule ≤ negSpan P N.toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσmk, -, hσf, -⟩ := exists_section P hX hNN' e
  have key : ∀ y ∈ negSpan P N'.toSubmodule, ∃ m, y - σ m ∈ negSpan P N.toSubmodule ∧
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N y = (e m : X ⧸ N) := by
    intro y hy
    refine negSpan_induction P (p := fun y ↦ ∃ m, y - σ m ∈ negSpan P N.toSubmodule ∧
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N y = (e m : X ⧸ N)) (fun i n hn ↦ ?_) ⟨0, by simp, by simp⟩
      (fun y z ⟨m, hm, hmy⟩ ⟨m', hm', hmz⟩ ↦ ⟨m + m', ?_, ?_⟩) hy
    · have hmem : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N n ∈ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) :=
        LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hn
      set m₀ := e.symm ⟨_, hmem⟩
      have hm₀ : (e m₀ : X ⧸ N) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N n := by simp [m₀]
      refine ⟨⁅f P i, m₀⁆, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hσf, ← lie_sub]
        refine toEnd_f_mem_negSpan P i ?_
        rw [LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, ← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero']
        change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (n - σ m₀) = 0
        rw [map_sub, hσmk, hm₀, sub_self]
      · have := e.toLieModuleHom.map_lie (f P i) m₀
        simp only [LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom] at this
        rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, ← hm₀, this, LieSubmodule.coe_bracket]
    · rw [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]; exact add_mem hm hm'
    · rw [map_add, map_add, hmy, hmz, LieSubmodule.coe_add]
  rintro y ⟨hy, hyN⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmy⟩ := key y hy
  have hem : e m = 0 := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [← hmy, LieSubmodule.coe_zero, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]; exact hyN)
  have hm0 : m = 0 := (e.toLinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff).mp hem
  simpa [hm0] using hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coinvDim_step
statement:
theorem coinvDim_step (hX : IsCategoryO P X) (hNN' : N ≤ N')
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) (ν : Dual K H) :
    coinvDim P N' ν = coinvDim P N ν + coinvDim P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hXd := hX.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  obtain ⟨σ, hσmk, hσN', hσf, hσw⟩ := exists_section P hXd hNN' e
  set ι' : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X ⧸ N := (N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)).incl.comp
    e.toLieModuleHom
  have hι' : Function.Injective ι' := fun a b hab ↦ e.injective (Subtype.ext hab)
  have hι'σ (m : VermaModule P μ) : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (σ m) = ι' m := hσmk m
  set q : X →ₗ[K] X ⧸ N := (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N).toLinearMap
  have hker : LinearMap.ker q = N.toSubmodule := by
    ext x
    simp [q]
  have hrange (y : X ⧸ N) (hy : y ∈ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) :
      ∃ m, ι' m = y := ⟨e.symm ⟨y, hy⟩, by simp [ι']⟩
  have := hX.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap ν
  have hfin (S : Submodule K X) : FiniteDimensional K ↥(S ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_right
  have := VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace P μ ν
  have hfinM (S : Submodule K (VermaModule P μ)) :
      FiniteDimensional K ↥(S ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_right
  have hmapfin (T : Submodule K (VermaModule P μ)) :
      finrank K (T.map (ι' : VermaModule P μ →ₗ[K] X ⧸ N)) = finrank K T :=
    (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ hι' T).finrank_eq.symm
  
  have h1 : finrank K ↥(N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) =
      finrank K ↥(N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) +
        finrank K ↥((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
          weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) := by
    have hrn := finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker q (N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν)
    have hmap : (N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν).map q =
        ((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
          weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν).map (ι' : VermaModule P μ →ₗ[K] X ⧸ N) := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxN', hxw⟩, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hrange (q x) (LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hxN')
        refine ⟨m, ⟨trivial, mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_injective P ι' hι' ?_⟩, hm⟩
        rw [hm]; exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) hxw
      · rintro ⟨m, ⟨-, hmw⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨σ m, ⟨hσN' m, hσw ν m hmw⟩, hι'σ m⟩
    have hinf : (N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) ⊓ LinearMap.ker q =
        N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν := by
      rw [hker, inf_right_comm, inf_eq_right.mpr (show N.toSubmodule ≤ N'.toSubmodule from hNN')]
    rw [hmap, hmapfin, hinf] at hrn
    omega
  
  have h2 : finrank K ↥(negSpan P N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) =
      finrank K ↥(negSpan P N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) +
        finrank K ↥(negSpan P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
          weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) := by
    have hrn := finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker q
      (negSpan P N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν)
    have hneg : ∀ x ∈ negSpan P N'.toSubmodule, ∃ m ∈ negSpan P
        (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule, ι' m = q x := by
      intro x hx
      refine negSpan_induction P (p := fun x ↦ ∃ m ∈ negSpan P
        (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule, ι' m = q x)
        (fun i n hn ↦ ?_) ⟨0, zero_mem _, by simp⟩
        (fun x y ⟨m, hm, hmx⟩ ⟨m', hm', hmy⟩ ↦ ⟨m + m', add_mem hm hm', by
          rw [map_add, map_add, hmx, hmy]⟩) hx
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hrange (q n) (LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hn)
      refine ⟨⁅f P i, m⁆, toEnd_f_mem_negSpan P i trivial, ?_⟩
      rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, hm]
      exact (LieModuleHom.map_lie (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) (f P i) n).symm
    have hσneg : ∀ m ∈ negSpan P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule,
        σ m ∈ negSpan P N'.toSubmodule := by
      intro m hm
      refine negSpan_induction P (p := fun m ↦ σ m ∈ negSpan P N'.toSubmodule)
        (fun i n _ ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun x y hx hy ↦ by rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy) hm
      rw [hσf]
      exact toEnd_f_mem_negSpan P i (hσN' n)
    have hmap : (negSpan P N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν).map q =
        (negSpan P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
          weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν).map (ι' : VermaModule P μ →ₗ[K] X ⧸ N) := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxn, hxw⟩, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m, hm, hmx⟩ := hneg x hxn
        refine ⟨m, ⟨hm, mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_injective P ι' hι' ?_⟩, hmx⟩
        change ι' m ∈ _
        rw [hmx]; exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) hxw
      · rintro ⟨m, ⟨hmn, hmw⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨σ m, ⟨hσneg m hmn, hσw ν m hmw⟩, hι'σ m⟩
    have hinf : (negSpan P N'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) ⊓ LinearMap.ker q =
        negSpan P N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν := by
      rw [hker, inf_right_comm]
      refine le_antisymm (inf_le_inf_right _ (negSpan_inf_le P hXd hNN' e)) ?_
      exact inf_le_inf_right _ (le_inf (negSpan_mono P hNN') (negSpan_le P N))
    rw [hmap, hmapfin, hinf] at hrn
    omega
  have hle (N₀ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) :
      finrank K ↥(negSpan P N₀.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) ≤
        finrank K ↥(N₀.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (inf_le_inf_right _ (negSpan_le P N₀))
  have hleM : finrank K ↥(negSpan P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
        weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) ≤
      finrank K ↥((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
        weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (inf_le_inf_right _ (negSpan_le P _))
  have := hle N
  unfold coinvDim
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.negSpan_le_lowerPart
statement:
theorem VermaModule.negSpan_le_lowerPart :
    negSpan P (⊤ : Submodule K (VermaModule P μ)) ≤ lowerPart P μ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine negSpan_induction P (p := fun x ↦ x ∈ lowerPart P μ) (fun i n hn0 ↦ ?_) (zero_mem _)
    (fun x y hx hy ↦ add_mem hx hy) hx
  clear hn0 hx
  have hn : n ∈ ⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), VermaModule.weightSpace P μ (μ - P.rootOf k) := by
    rw [iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
  induction hn using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem k n hn =>
    induction hn using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem hk n hn =>
      have hne : μ - P.rootOf k - P.root i ≠ μ := by
        intro h0
        have h1 : P.rootOf (k + Pi.single i 1) = P.rootOf 0 := by
          rw [map_add, rootOf_single, map_zero]
          rw [sub_sub, sub_eq_self] at h0
          exact h0
        have h2 := congrFun (P.rootOf_injective h1) i
        have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k i := hk i
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply] at h2
        omega
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hne
        (toEnd_f_mem_weightSpace i hn))
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [lie_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [lie_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.coinvDim_top
statement:
theorem VermaModule.coinvDim_top [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (ν : Dual K H) :
    coinvDim P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)) ν = if ν = μ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace P μ ν
  have htop : finrank K ↥((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
      weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (by simp)).finrank_eq
  unfold coinvDim
  rw [htop]
  split_ifs with hν
  · subst hν
    have hbot : negSpan P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P ν)).toSubmodule ⊓
        weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P ν) (h P) ν = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]
      rintro x ⟨hxn, hxw⟩
      have hx : x ∈ K ∙ hwv P ν := by rw [← weightSpace_self]; exact hxw
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
      by_cases hc : c = 0
      · simp [hc]
      · exfalso
        apply hwv_notMem_lowerPart P ν
        have := Submodule.smul_mem (lowerPart P ν) c⁻¹
          (negSpan_le_lowerPart P ν (by simpa using hxn))
        rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul] at this
    rw [(LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hbot).finrank_eq, finrank_bot,
      VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_self]
  · have hle : weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν ≤
        negSpan P (⊤ : Submodule K (VermaModule P μ)) := by
      intro m hm
      have hm' := weightSpace_le_wordSpan P μ ν hm
      rw [wordSpan] at hm'
      refine Submodule.span_induction
        (p := fun m _ ↦ m ∈ negSpan P (⊤ : Submodule K (VermaModule P μ))) ?_ (zero_mem _)
        (fun _ _ _ _ h1 h2 ↦ add_mem h1 h2) (fun c _ _ h1 ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ c h1) hm'
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      cases w with
      | nil => exact (hν (by simpa using hw.symm)).elim
      | cons j w =>
        dsimp only
        rw [fWord_smul_cons]
        exact toEnd_f_mem_negSpan P j trivial
    have heq : negSpan P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ)).toSubmodule ⊓
        weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν = weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν :=
      inf_eq_right.mpr (by simpa using hle)
    rw [(LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ heq).finrank_eq, Nat.sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.count_eq_coinvDim
statement:
