theorem IsStdFiltered.count_eq_coinvDim [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X}
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s) (ν : Dual K H) :
    s.count ν = coinvDim P N ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot =>
    have h0 : finrank K ↥((⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) = 0 :=
      Nat.le_zero.mp ((Submodule.finrank_mono (inf_le_left.trans (by simp))).trans
        (finrank_bot K X).le)
    unfold coinvDim
    rw [h0, Nat.zero_sub, Multiset.count_zero]
  | step _ hNN' he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    rw [coinvDim_step P hX hNN' e, ← ih, VermaModule.coinvDim_top, Multiset.count_cons]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isStdFiltered_of_fin
statement:
theorem isStdFiltered_of_fin {n : ℕ} (F : Fin (n + 1) → LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X)
    (wt' : Fin n → Dual K H) (hF : Monotone F) (h0 : F 0 = ⊥)
    (hstep : ∀ j, Nonempty (VermaModule P (wt' j) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)))) :
    IsStdFiltered P (F (Fin.last n)) (Finset.univ.val.map wt')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ k (hk : k ≤ n), IsStdFiltered P (F ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩)
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin n ↦ j.val < k).val.map wt') := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      have : (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin n ↦ j.val < 0) = ∅ := by
        ext j; simp
      rw [this]
      simpa [h0] using IsStdFiltered.bot (P := P) (X := X)
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      set j : Fin n := ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hfilt : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n ↦ i.val < k + 1) =
          Finset.cons j (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n ↦ i.val < k) (by simp [j]) := by
        ext i
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_cons, j]
        constructor
        · intro h
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp h with h | h
          · exact Or.inr h
          · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext h)
        · rintro (rfl | h)
          · exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
          · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt h
      rw [hfilt, Finset.cons_val, Multiset.map_cons]
      have h1 := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hk)
      exact IsStdFiltered.step h1 (hF (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (Nat.le_succ k))) (hstep j)
  have := key n le_rfl
  have hfull : (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin n ↦ j.val < n) = Finset.univ := by
    ext j; simp
  rwa [hfull] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma {Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z] [FiniteDimensional K Z]
    [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P Z) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ s : Multiset (Dual K H),
      IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z)) (s.map (Λ + ·)) ∧
      ∀ μ : Dual K H, s.count μ = finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap Z (h P) μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, wt', hmono, hN0, hNlast, hstep, hcount⟩ :=
    exists_tensorVermaStandardFiltration P hZ Λ
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.val.map wt', ?_, fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := isStdFiltered_of_fin P N (fun j ↦ Λ + wt' j) hmono.monotone hN0 hstep
    rw [hNlast] at this
    rwa [Multiset.map_map]
  · classical
    rw [← hcount μ, Multiset.count_map, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]
    congr 1
    ext j
    simp [eq_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.coeffAt_weylAltSum
statement:
lemma coeffAt_weylAltSum {μ₀ : Dual K H} (hμ₀ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, μ₀ (P.coroot i) = n)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    (weylAltSum P hA hμ₀).coeffAt μ = ∑ᶠ w : P.weylGroup hA,
      if (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ₀ = μ then (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone
statement:
lemma eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone {β Λ : Dual K H} (h₁ : β ∈ cone P Λ) (h₂ : Λ ∈ cone P β) :
    β = Λ
proof:
:=
  (toWeightOrd P).injective (le_antisymm
    ((toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr h₂)
    ((toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr h₁))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_self
statement:
theorem coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_self (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character).coeffAt Λ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hM := VermaModule.denominator_mul_character P Λ
  rw [coeffAt_denominator_mul_eq (g := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).character), hM,
    coeff_exp_self]
  intro β hβ
  rw [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character]
  by_cases hβΛ : β = Λ
  · subst hβΛ
    exact_mod_cast (finrank_weightSpace_self P β).trans
      (VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P β).symm
  · have h1 : finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) β) = 0 := by
      by_contra h0
      exact hβΛ (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone (mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero h0) hβ)
    have h2 : finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P Λ) (h P) β) = 0 := by
      by_contra h0
      have hne : weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P Λ) (h P) β ≠ ⊥ := fun hbot ↦
        h0 (by rw [hbot, finrank_bot])
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
      exact hβΛ (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone
        (VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id
          hx hx0) hβ)
    rw [h1, h2]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isDominantIntegral_add_rho
statement:
lemma isDominantIntegral_add_rho {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n
proof:
:= fun i ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
  exact ⟨n + 1, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]; push_cast; rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isDominantIntegral_zero
statement: lemma isDominantIntegral_zero : P.IsDominantIntegral 0
proof: := fun _ ↦ ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isDominantIntegral_rho
statement: lemma isDominantIntegral_rho : P.IsDominantIntegral P.rho
proof: := fun i ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.lie_hwv_zero
statement: lemma lie_hwv_zero (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) : ⁅x, hwv P (0 : Dual K H)⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on P x (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun a ↦ ?_) (zero_lie _)
    (fun y z hy hz ↦ by rw [add_lie, hy, hz, add_zero])
    (fun c y hy ↦ by rw [smul_lie, hy, smul_zero])
    (fun y z hy hz ↦ by rw [lie_lie, hy, hz, lie_zero, lie_zero, sub_zero])
  · rw [hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero]
  · rw [hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie]
    have hmem := VermaModule.fPowHwv_mem_maxSubmodule P (0 : Dual K H) hA
      (i := i) (n := 0) (by simp)
    rw [VermaModule.fPowHwv, zero_add, pow_one, toEnd_apply_apply] at hmem
    exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'.mpr hmem
  · rw [hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_h_hwv, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul,
      map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.lie_eq_zero_of_zero
statement:
theorem lie_eq_zero_of_zero (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (m : IrreducibleModule P (0 : Dual K H)) :
    ⁅x, m⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have htop := VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P (0 : Dual K H)))
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)
  have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      {LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P (0 : Dual K H))
        (VermaModule.hwv P 0)} ≤
      maxTrivSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (IrreducibleModule P (0 : Dual K H)) := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact fun y ↦ lie_hwv_zero hA y
  rw [htop] at hle
  exact hle (LieSubmodule.mem_top m) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.character_zero
statement: theorem character_zero : (isCategoryO P (0 : Dual K H)).character = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext ν
  rw [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, ← exp_zero (P := P) (R := ℤ), coeff_exp]
  split_ifs with hν
  · subst hν
    exact_mod_cast finrank_weightSpace_self P (0 : Dual K H)
  · have hbot : weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P (0 : Dual K H)) (h P) ν = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, ν a ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra! h0
        exact hν (LinearMap.ext h0)
      have hxa : ⁅h P a, x⁆ = ν a • x := hx a
      rw [lie_eq_zero_of_zero hA] at hxa
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr ((smul_eq_zero.mp hxa.symm).resolve_left ha)
    rw [hbot, finrank_bot, Nat.cast_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character
statement:
theorem coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character (μ : Dual K H) :
    (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character).coeffAt μ =
      ∑ᶠ w : P.weylGroup hA, if (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) = μ then
        (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hS
  have hcoeff : ∀ ν, (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character).coeffAt ν =
      (denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character).coeffAt (ν - P.rho) := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [mul_assoc, coeff_exp_mul]
  refine coeffAt_eq_finsum_of_isWeylAntiInvariant S
    (IsCategoryO.isWeylAntiInvariant_exp_rho_mul_character hA _
      ((isIntegrable_iff P hA).mpr hΛ)) (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_ (fun ν hν ↦ ?_) μ
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
    exact ⟨n, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]⟩
  · rw [hcoeff, add_sub_cancel_right, coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_self]
  · rw [hcoeff] at hν
    obtain ⟨⟨k, hk, hνk⟩, hform⟩ := coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_ne_zero S hA
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) _ hν
    refine ⟨⟨k, hk, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hνk
      rw [hνk]
      abel
    · have := (dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho_eq_iff S Λ (ν - P.rho)).mpr hform
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
      exact this.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character_apply
statement:
theorem coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character_apply (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character).coeffAt
      ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho)) = (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hreg : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n + 1 := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
    exact ⟨n, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]⟩
  rw [coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA hS hΛ,
    finsum_eq_single _ w fun w' hw' ↦ ite_eq_right fun h ↦ hw'
      (P.apply_injective_of_regular hA hreg h)]
  exact ite_eq_left rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA hS hΛ]
  exact finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun w ↦ ite_eq_right (hμ w)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character
statement:
theorem exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character :
    exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character =
      weylAltSum P hA (isDominantIntegral_add_rho hΛ)
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  rw [coeffAt_weylAltSum, coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA hS hΛ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem exp_rho_mul_denominator :
    exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P = weylAltSum P hA (isDominantIntegral_rho (P := P))
proof:
:= by
  have h := exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA hS (isDominantIntegral_zero (P := P))
  rw [character_zero hA, mul_one] at h
  ext μ
  rw [h]
  simp only [coeffAt_weylAltSum, zero_add]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lieSubmoduleQuotientMap_surjective
statement:
theorem lieSubmoduleQuotientMap_surjective (N N' : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) :
    Function.Surjective (lieSubmoduleQuotientMap N N')
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hy
  exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_lieSubmoduleQuotientMap
statement:
theorem ker_lieSubmoduleQuotientMap {N N' : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X} (hle : N ≤ N') :
    (lieSubmoduleQuotientMap N N').ker = (LieSubmodule.inclusion hle).range
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (x : X) = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hx
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx'
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx'⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (y : X) = 0
    exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := N)).mpr y.2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_lieSubmodule_eq_add
statement:
theorem multiplicity_lieSubmodule_eq_add (hX : IsCategoryO P X) (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    {N N' : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X} (hle : N ≤ N')
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) (χ : Dual K H) :
    (hX.lieSubmodule N').multiplicity χ =
      (hX.lieSubmodule N).multiplicity χ + hM.multiplicity χ
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hX.lieSubmodule N) (hX.lieSubmodule N') hM
    (LieSubmodule.inclusion hle) (e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (lieSubmoduleQuotientMap N N'))
    (LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective hle)
    (by
      rw [← ker_lieSubmoduleQuotientMap hle]
      ext x
      simp only [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
      exact e.symm.toLinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff)
    (e.symm.surjective.comp (lieSubmoduleQuotientMap_surjective N N')) χ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_zero_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (χ : Dual K H) : hM.multiplicity χ = 0
proof:
:=
  hM.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.multiplicity_eq_sum
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.multiplicity_eq_sum (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X}
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s) (χ : Dual K H) :
    (hX.lieSubmodule N).multiplicity χ =
      (s.map fun ν ↦ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν).multiplicity χ).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot =>
    rw [Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.sum_zero]
    exact (hX.lieSubmodule ⊥).multiplicity_eq_zero_of_subsingleton χ
  | @step N N' s μ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    rw [hX.multiplicity_lieSubmodule_eq_add (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) hle e, ih,
      Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsInBlock.of_multiplicity_le
statement:
theorem of_multiplicity_le (hX : IsInBlock P hA lam X) (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hfg : ∃ s : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤)
    (h : ∀ χ, hM.multiplicity χ ≤ hX.isCategoryO.multiplicity χ) : IsInBlock P hA lam M where
  isCategoryO
proof:
:= hM
  exists_finset := hfg
  multiplicity_ne_zero χ hχ := hX.multiplicity_ne_zero χ fun h0 ↦ hχ (by
    have := h χ
    omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsInBlock.lieSubmodule
statement:
theorem lieSubmodule (hX : IsInBlock P hA lam X) (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) :
    IsInBlock P hA lam N
proof:
:= by
  have := hX.isCategoryO.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P hA hX.exists_finset.choose_spec
  have : WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 N) :=
    (LieSubmodule.mapOrderEmbedding (f := N.incl) Subtype.val_injective).strictMono.wellFoundedGT
  have hfg : ∃ T : Finset N, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (T : Set N) = ⊤ :=
    LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top
  refine of_multiplicity_le (M := N) hX (hX.isCategoryO.lieSubmodule N) hfg ?_
  intro χ
  have := hX.isCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add N χ
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsInBlock.of_equiv_map
statement:
theorem of_equiv_map (hX : IsInBlock P hA lam X) (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hfg : ∃ s : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤)
    {N N' : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} (hle : N ≤ N')
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) : IsInBlock P hA lam M
proof:
:=
  hX.of_multiplicity_le hM hfg fun χ ↦ by
    have h₁ := hX.isCategoryO.multiplicity_lieSubmodule_eq_add hM hle e χ
    have h₂ := hX.isCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add N' χ
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.rTensor_mem_range
statement:
theorem rTensor_mem_range (hA' : IsInBlock P hA lam A') (hB : IsInBlock P hA lam B)
    (f : A' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B) (x : A' ⊗[K] V) (hx : x ∈ (F.idem A').range) :
    (f : A' →ₗ[K] B).rTensor V x ∈ (F.idem B).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hx
  rw [F.naturality hA' hB f y]
  exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.coe_map_apply
statement:
theorem coe_map_apply (hA' : IsInBlock P hA lam A') (hB : IsInBlock P hA lam B)
    (f : A' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B) (x : (F.idem A').range) :
    (F.map hA' hB f x : B ⊗[K] V) = (f : A' →ₗ[K] B).rTensor V x
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.map_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective (hA' : IsInBlock P hA lam A') (hB : IsInBlock P hA lam B)
    {f : A' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B} (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective (F.map hA' hB f)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hxy ↦ Subtype.ext (Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
    (M := V) (f : A' →ₗ[K] B) hf (congrArg Subtype.val hxy))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective (hB : IsInBlock P hA lam B) (hC : IsInBlock P hA lam C)
    {g : B →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ C} (hg : Function.Surjective g) : Function.Surjective (F.map hB hC g)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.rTensor_surjective V (g := (g : B →ₗ[K] C)) hg z
  refine ⟨⟨F.idem B x, (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [coe_map_apply, F.naturality hB hC g x]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.ker_map_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_map_eq_range (hA' : IsInBlock P hA lam A') (hB : IsInBlock P hA lam B)
    (hC : IsInBlock P hA lam C) {f : A' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B} {g : B →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ C} (hex : g.ker = f.range)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g) : (F.map hB hC g).ker = (F.map hA' hB f).range
proof:
:= by
  have hexact : Function.Exact (f : A' →ₗ[K] B) (g : B →ₗ[K] C) := fun y ↦ by
    have := congrArg (y ∈ ·) hex
    simp only [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range] at this
    simpa [Set.mem_range] using this
  have hT := rTensor_exact V hexact hg
  ext ⟨y, hy⟩
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    have h0' : (g : B →ₗ[K] C).rTensor V y = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h0
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hT y).mp h0'
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hy
    refine ⟨⟨F.idem A' x, (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [coe_map_apply, F.naturality hA' hB f x, hx, F.idem_idem B hB z]
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [← hx]
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, coe_map_apply, coe_map_apply]
    exact (hT _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isCategoryO_range
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_range {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M) :
    IsCategoryO P (F.idem M).range
proof:
:=
  (hM.tensorProduct (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V)).lieSubmodule _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hA' : IsInBlock P hA lam A') (hB : IsInBlock P hA lam B)
    (hC : IsInBlock P hA lam C) {f : A' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B} {g : B →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ C}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hex : g.ker = f.range) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (χ : Dual K H) :
    (F.isCategoryO_range hB.isCategoryO).multiplicity χ =
      (F.isCategoryO_range hA'.isCategoryO).multiplicity χ +
        (F.isCategoryO_range hC.isCategoryO).multiplicity χ
proof:
:=
  IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact _ _ _ (F.map hA' hB f) (F.map hB hC g)
    (F.map_injective hA' hB hf) (F.ker_map_eq_range hA' hB hC hex hg)
    (F.map_surjective hB hC hg) χ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.multiplicity_eq_sum_of_isStdFiltered
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_sum_of_isStdFiltered {X : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup X]
    [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X] (hX : IsInBlock P hA lam X)
    {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s)
    (χ : Dual K H) :
    (F.isCategoryO_range (hX.isCategoryO.lieSubmodule N)).multiplicity χ =
      (s.map fun Λ ↦ (F.isCategoryO_range (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ)).multiplicity χ).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot =>
    rw [Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.sum_zero]
    have : Subsingleton (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) :=
      ⟨fun a b ↦ Subtype.ext ((a.2.trans b.2.symm : (a : X) = b))⟩
    have : Subsingleton ((⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) ⊗[K] V) := by
      refine ⟨fun a b ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [Subsingleton.elim a 0, Subsingleton.elim b 0]
    have : Subsingleton (F.idem (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X)).range :=
      ⟨fun a b ↦ Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
    exact IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_subsingleton _ χ
  | @step N N' s Λ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    have hN := hX.lieSubmodule N
    have hN' := hX.lieSubmodule N'
    have hΛ := hX.of_equiv_map (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ)
      (isInBlock_verma P hA Λ).exists_finset hle e
    rw [F.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact hN hN' hΛ (f := LieSubmodule.inclusion hle)
      (g := (e.symm : N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P Λ).comp
        (lieSubmoduleQuotientMap N N')) (LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective hle)
      (by
        rw [← ker_lieSubmoduleQuotientMap hle]
        ext x
        rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply]
        exact e.symm.toLinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff)
      (e.symm.surjective.comp (lieSubmoduleQuotientMap_surjective N N')) χ,
      ih, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.injective_of_isIrreducible_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem injective_of_isIrreducible_of_ne_zero {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 N] [LieModule.IsIrreducible K 𝔤 M] (f : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  rcases IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top f.ker with h' | h'
  · exact (LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot f).mp h'
  · exact (hf (LieModuleHom.ext fun a ↦
      (LieModuleHom.mem_ker).mp (h' ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top a))).elim

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.multiplicity_le_of_surjective
statement:
theorem multiplicity_le_of_surjective {X Y : CategoryO.{u} P} (φ : X.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    Y.property.1.multiplicity ν ≤ X.property.1.multiplicity ν
proof:
:= by
  have := IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (X.property.1.lieSubmodule φ.ker)
    X.property.1 Y.property.1 φ.ker.incl φ Subtype.val_injective φ.ker.range_incl.symm hφ ν
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_translationFunctor_map
statement:
theorem surjective_translationFunctor_map (L : Type u) [AddCommGroup L] [Module K L]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 L] [LieModule K 𝔤 L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (χ₁ χ₂ : Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤) →ₐ[K] K)
    {X Y : CategoryO.{u} P} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom.hom) :
    Function.Surjective ((translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂).map f).hom.hom
proof:
:=
  (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ Y.obj)).surjective.comp
    ((centralTranslationMap_surjective P X.property.1
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional' L) χ₁ χ₂ (toLieModuleHom f.hom) hf).comp
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ X.obj)).symm.surjective)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_injective_translation_translation
statement:
theorem exists_injective_translation_translation (L L' : Type u) [AddCommGroup L] [Module K L]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 L] [LieModule K 𝔤 L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [AddCommGroup L']
    [Module K L'] [LieRingModule 𝔤 L'] [LieModule K 𝔤 L'] [FiniteDimensional K L']
    (eD : Module.Dual K L ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L')
    (χ₁ χ₂ : Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤) →ₐ[K] K)
    (X : CategoryO.{u} P) {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 M] [LieModule.IsIrreducible K 𝔤 M] (e : X.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M)
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (hX : centralBlock P M χ₁ = ⊤)
    [Nontrivial (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M)] :
    ∃ φ : X.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        ((translationFunctor L' χ₂ χ₁).obj ((translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂).obj X)).obj,
      Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  let N := centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M
  have adj := translationAdjunction P hM (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional' L) hX
    (centralBlock_centralTranslation_eq_top P (L := L) (M := M) χ₁ χ₂)
  let η₀ := adj (LieModuleHom.id : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N)
  have hη₀ : η₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h0' : (LieModuleHom.id : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) = 0 := (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff adj).mp h0
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_ne (0 : N)
    exact hb (LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0' b)
  let E := ((centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P N χ₂ χ₁ eD).trans
    (centralTranslationEquiv P L' χ₂ χ₁ ((centralTranslationEquiv P L χ₁ χ₂ e.symm).trans
      (translationObjEquiv L χ₁ χ₂ X)))).trans
    (translationObjEquiv L' χ₂ χ₁ ((translationFunctor L χ₁ χ₂).obj X))
  exact ⟨E.toLieModuleHom.comp (η₀.comp e.toLieModuleHom),
    E.injective.comp ((injective_of_isIrreducible_of_ne_zero η₀ hη₀).comp e.injective)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_ext_quotient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ext_quotient_ne_zero {X Y : CategoryO.{u} P} (φ : X.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) {T : CategoryO.{u} P} {n : ℕ}
    (hY : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y T n, x = 0) (hX : ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X T n, x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ W : CategoryO.{u} P, (∀ κ, W.property.1.multiplicity κ ≤ Y.property.1.multiplicity κ) ∧
      ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} W T (n + 1), x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := hX
  let F : X ⟶ Y := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom φ)
  let G : Y ⟶ ofQuotient Y φ.range :=
    (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom (toQuotient Y φ.range))
  have hFG : F ≫ G = 0 := by
    ext a
    exact (toQuotient_eq_zero_iff Y φ.range _).mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩
  let S := ShortComplex.mk F G hFG
  have hS : S.ShortExact := shortExact_of_lie (fun a b hab ↦ hφ hab)
    (fun b ↦ surjective_toQuotient Y φ.range b)
    (fun b hb ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ b).mp ((toQuotient_eq_zero_iff Y φ.range b).mp hb))
  exact ⟨ofQuotient Y φ.range, fun κ ↦ multiplicity_le_of_surjective (toQuotient Y φ.range)
    (surjective_toQuotient _ _) κ, _, Abelian.Ext.extClass_comp_ne_zero hS hY hx₁⟩

name: Nat.ne_zero_or_ne_zero_of_le_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Nat.ne_zero_or_ne_zero_of_le_add {a b c : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : a ≤ b + c) :
    b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_translation_wall_simple_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_translation_wall_simple_eq_zero {y : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hy : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      ¬P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (y * v) i) (i : ι)
    [FiniteDimensional K (IrreducibleModule P (Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i))]
    (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} ((translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P (Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i))
      (centralCharacter P ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho))
      (centralCharacter P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ))).obj X) (simple P Λ) n) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  let s := (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i
  let lam := P.weylDot hA' y Λ
  let μ := (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho
  let ν := Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i
  let v₀ := y * s
  have hlam := isAntidominant_weylDot hA hy hΛ
  have hμ := isAntidominant_wall hA hy i
  have hfacet : ∀ v j, P.IsPosRoot hA' v j → P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v j = 0 →
      P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v j = 0 := fun v j hv h0 ↦ by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg hA hy hΛ hv
    rw [hm] at h0
    exact (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero m (neg_eq_zero.mp h0)).elim
  have hν := isDominantIntegral_sub_wallWeight hΛ i
  have hzν : ((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam - μ) = ν :=
    inv_apply_weylDot_sub_wall (hF := hA) (y := y) i
  have hμα := corootPairing_wall_mul_simple (hF := hA) (y := y) i
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hΛ i
  let chiL := centralCharacter P lam
  let chiM := centralCharacter P μ
  obtain ⟨z'', hz'', hdom, ⟨eD⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual (P := P) hA hν
  have hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, lam (P.coroot j) = z := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg hA hy hΛ (isPosRoot_one hA' j)
    rw [corootPairing_one, LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hk
    exact ⟨-(k + 2 : ℤ), by push_cast; linear_combination hk⟩
  have hsimp : (⟨P.reflection hA' i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i⟩ :
      P.weylGroup hA') = s := Subtype.ext (coxeterSystem_simple P hA' i).symm
  have hC : ¬P.UpperClosureCondition hA'
      (((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho))
      (((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho)) := by
    have key := not_upperClosureCondition_of_wall (P := P) hA (a := lam + P.rho) (b := μ + P.rho)
      (v := v₀) (w := s * y⁻¹) (i := i) hμα (n := -((m : ℤ) + 1)) (by omega) (by
        rw [corootPairing_weylDot_mul_simple (hF := hA) (y := y) (Λ := Λ) i, hm]; push_cast; ring)
      (by
        rw [show s * y⁻¹ * v₀ = 1 by simp [v₀, s, mul_assoc]]
        exact isPosRoot_one hA' i)
    rwa [show s * y⁻¹ * P.reflectionOf hA' v₀ i = y⁻¹ by
      simp [reflectionOf, hsimp, v₀, s, mul_assoc]] at key
  have hsub := translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA
    hlam hμ hfacet hdom (z := z'' * ((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H))
    (mul_mem hz'' (y⁻¹).2) (by
      rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, show μ - lam = -(lam - μ) by abel, map_neg, hzν])
    y⁻¹ (by rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_top hA' hint]; trivial) hC
  have hΛ' : P.weylDot hA' y⁻¹ lam = Λ := by
    rw [← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one]
  rw [hΛ'] at hsub
  let T' := (translationFunctor (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) chiL chiM).obj
    (simple P Λ)
  have : Subsingleton T'.obj := (((ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.trans
    ((centralTranslationEquiv P _ chiL chiM
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).symm).trans
      (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) chiL chiM eD))).toEquiv
    ).subsingleton
  have hz := Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right (isZero_of_subsingleton T')
    (extTranslationEquiv (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL X (simple P Λ) n x)
  exact (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp hz

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_le_verma
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_le_verma {u v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hlen : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length v + 1 =
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length u) {n : ℕ}
    (hvan : ∀ z : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length u ≤
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length z → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan z Λ)) →
      ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Z (simple P Λ) (n + 1), x = 0)
    (hv : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (simple P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v Λ)) (simple P Λ)
      (n + 1), x = 0)
    (W : CategoryO.{u} P)
    (hW : ∀ κ, W.property.1.multiplicity κ ≤
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v Λ)).multiplicity κ +
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan u Λ)).multiplicity κ)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} W (simple P Λ) (n + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_left W _ (n + 1) (fun κ hκ Z eZ e₀ ↦ ?_) x
  rcases Nat.ne_zero_or_ne_zero_of_le_add hκ (hW κ) with hk | hk
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_bruhatLE_weylDot P hA hΛ
      (VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hk)
    rcases hz.eq_or_length_lt with rfl | hlt
    · exact ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_left ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.trans eZ.symm) hv e₀
    · exact hvan z (hlen.symm.trans_le hlt) Z eZ e₀
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_bruhatLE_weylDot P hA hΛ
      (VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hk)
    rcases hz.eq_or_length_lt with rfl | hlt
    · exact hvan u le_rfl Z eZ e₀
    · exact hvan z hlt.le Z eZ e₀

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_ext_simple_ne_zero_succ
statement:
theorem exists_ext_simple_ne_zero_succ (i : ι) {u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hu : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (u * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i) {n : ℕ}
    (hvan : ∀ z : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length u ≤
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length z → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan z Λ)) →
      ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Z (simple P Λ) (n + 1), x = 0)
    (h : ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (simple P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan u Λ)) (simple P Λ) n,
      x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (simple P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (u * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) Λ)) (simple P Λ) (n + 1),
      x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hlen : (P.coxeterSystem hA').length (u * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i) + 1 =
      (P.coxeterSystem hA').length u := by
    have hnd := hu
    rw [isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent, (P.coxeterSystem hA').isRightDescent_iff,
      (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at hnd
    rcases (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_mul_simple u i with h' | h' <;> omega
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_forall_not_isPosRoot_mul (P := P) hA
  let s := (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i
  let lam := P.weylDot hA' y Λ
  let μ := (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho
  let ν := Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i
  let ν' := μ - lam
  let v₀ := y * s
  let w := u * y⁻¹
  have hlen' : (P.coxeterSystem hA').length (u * s) + 1 = (P.coxeterSystem hA').length u := hlen
  have hlam := isAntidominant_weylDot hA hy hΛ
  have hμ := isAntidominant_wall hA hy i
  have hfacet : ∀ v j, P.IsPosRoot hA' v j → P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v j = 0 →
      P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v j = 0 := fun v j hv h0 ↦ by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg hA hy hΛ hv
    rw [hm] at h0
    exact (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero m (neg_eq_zero.mp h0)).elim
  have hν := isDominantIntegral_sub_wallWeight hΛ i
  have hν' := isDominantIntegral_wall_sub_weylDot hA hy hΛ i
  have hzν : ((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam - μ) = ν :=
    inv_apply_weylDot_sub_wall (hF := hA) (y := y) i
  have hv₀ : P.IsPosRoot hA' v₀ i := isPosRoot_mul_simple hA hy i
  have hμα := corootPairing_wall_mul_simple (hF := hA) (y := y) i
  have hwall := fun v' i' (h0 : P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0) ↦
    apply_root_eq_or_of_corootPairing_wall hA i h0
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hΛ i
  have hlamα : P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v₀ i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [corootPairing_weylDot_mul_simple (hF := hA) (y := y) (Λ := Λ) i, hm]
    intro h0
    exact Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero m (neg_eq_zero.mp h0)
  have hw : P.IsPosRoot hA' (w * v₀) i := by
    rwa [show w * v₀ = u * s by simp only [w, v₀]; group]
  have hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, lam (P.coroot j) = z := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg hA hy hΛ (isPosRoot_one hA' j)
    rw [corootPairing_one, LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hk
    exact ⟨-(k + 2 : ℤ), by push_cast; linear_combination hk⟩
  have hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_top hA' hint]; trivial
  let chiL := centralCharacter P lam
  let chiM := centralCharacter P μ
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν'
  have h1 : P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v₀ i) lam = P.weylDot hA' (u * s) Λ := by
    have hsimp : (⟨P.reflection hA' i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i⟩ :
        P.weylGroup hA') = s := Subtype.ext (coxeterSystem_simple P hA' i).symm
    rw [← weylDot_mul]
    congr 1
    simp [reflectionOf, hsimp, w, v₀, s, mul_assoc]
  have h3 : P.weylDot hA' w lam = P.weylDot hA' u Λ := by
    rw [← weylDot_mul]
    simp [w]
  let x₀ := P.weylDot hA' w lam
  
  let Xv := (translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM).obj (verma P x₀)
  let eXv : Xv.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM
      (VermaModule P x₀) :=
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM
      (verma P x₀).obj)).symm.trans
      (centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P x₀)).symm)
  obtain ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hfg⟩ := wallCrossing_verma_shortExact P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν
    (y⁻¹).2 hzν hν' (1 : P.weylGroup hA').2 rfl hv₀ hμα hwall hlamα hw eXv
  let Θv := (translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL).obj Xv
  let CTv := centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL Xv.obj
  have hexact : LieModuleHom.ker (g.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) CTv).symm.toLieModuleHom) =
      LieModuleHom.range ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) CTv).toLieModuleHom.comp f) :=
    LieSubmodule.ext _ _ fun b ↦ (hfg _).trans
      (exists_congr fun a ↦ (ofLieEquiv (P := P) CTv).toEquiv.eq_symm_apply)
  have hmultv₀ : ∀ κ, Θv.property.1.multiplicity κ =
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v₀ i) lam)).multiplicity κ +
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P x₀).multiplicity κ := fun κ ↦
    IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) Θv.property.1
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) CTv).toLieModuleHom.comp f)
      (g.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) CTv).symm.toLieModuleHom)
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) CTv).injective.comp hf) hexact
      (hg.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) CTv).symm.surjective) κ
  have hmultv : ∀ κ, Θv.property.1.multiplicity κ =
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' (u * s) Λ)).multiplicity κ +
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' u Λ)).multiplicity κ := by
    have hv : ∀ a b, a = b → ∀ κ, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P a).multiplicity κ =
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P b).multiplicity κ := by
      rintro a b rfl κ; rfl
    exact fun κ ↦ (hmultv₀ κ).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hv _ _ h1 κ) (hv _ _ h3 κ))
  
  let π : verma P x₀ ⟶ simple P x₀ := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom
    (toSimple P x₀ (simple P x₀) (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P x₀)).symm))
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π.hom.hom := fun z ↦
    surjective_toSimple x₀ (simple P x₀) (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P x₀)).symm z
  let Xo := (translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM).obj (simple P x₀)
  let Θo := (translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL).obj Xo
  have hmultΘ : ∀ κ, Θo.property.1.multiplicity κ ≤ Θv.property.1.multiplicity κ :=
    multiplicity_le_of_surjective (toLieModuleHom ((translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      chiM chiL).map ((translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM).map π)).hom)
      (surjective_translationFunctor_map _ _ _ _
        (surjective_translationFunctor_map _ _ _ _ hπ))
  
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  obtain ⟨eW⟩ := (translation_irreducible_wall P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' (1 : P.weylGroup hA').2
    rfl hv₀ hμα hwall hlamα hw hwint w).1 rfl
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
  have : Nontrivial (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM
      (IrreducibleModule P x₀)) := eW.symm.toEquiv.nontrivial
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P x₀
  obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hdom₁, ⟨eD⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual (P := P) hA hν'
  have hyν : (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν = -ν' := by
    rw [← hzν, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Subgroup.coe_one]
    change lam - μ = -(μ - lam)
    abel
  have hz₁ν : z₁ (-ν') = ν := by
    rw [← hyν, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    exact P.apply_eq_self_of_dominant hA' hν (mul_mem hz₁ y.2)
      (by rwa [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hyν])
  rw [hz₁ν] at eD
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_injective_translation_translation (IrreducibleModule P ν')
    (IrreducibleModule P ν) eD chiL chiM (simple P x₀)
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P x₀)).symm (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P x₀) hMχ
  have h₂ : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Θo (simple P Λ) n, x = 0 :=
    fun x ↦ ext_translation_wall_simple_eq_zero hA hΛ hy i Xo n x
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ : ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (simple P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)) (simple P Λ) n,
      x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [h3]; exact h
  
  obtain ⟨W, hW, xq, hne⟩ := exists_ext_quotient_ne_zero φ hφ h₂ ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  refine hne (ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_le_verma hA hΛ hlen' hvan hcon W (fun κ ↦ ?_) _)
  have hle₁ : W.property.1.multiplicity κ ≤ Θo.property.1.multiplicity κ := hW κ
  have hle₂ : Θo.property.1.multiplicity κ ≤ Θv.property.1.multiplicity κ := hmultΘ κ
  have hle₃ := (hmultv κ).le
  have hle₄ := hle₂.trans hle₃
  exact hle₁.trans hle₄

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_ext_simple_weylDot_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ext_simple_weylDot_ne_zero : ∀ (d : ℕ) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan),
    (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement -
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w = d →
    ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (simple P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) (simple P Λ)
      (2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
          (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement -
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w), x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro w hw
    have hwm := (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_le_length_longestElement w
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_forall_not_isPosRoot_mul (P := P) hA
    have hyw : y = w := by
      have hy₀ : y = (P.coxeterSystem hA').longestElement :=
        (P.coxeterSystem hA').eq_longestElement_iff_forall_isRightDescent.mpr fun j ↦ by
          have := hy 1 j (isPosRoot_one hA' j)
          rwa [mul_one, isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent, not_not] at this
      have hw₀ : w = (P.coxeterSystem hA').longestElement :=
        (P.coxeterSystem hA').eq_longestElement_of_forall_length_le fun v ↦ by
          have := (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_le_length_longestElement v
          omega
      rw [hy₀, hw₀]
    subst hyw
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ext_verma_weylDot_simple_ne_zero hA hΛ _ y rfl
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := VermaModule.nonempty_equiv_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA
      (isAntidominant_weylDot hA hy hΛ)
    rw [show 2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA').length (P.coxeterSystem hA').longestElement -
      (P.coxeterSystem hA').length y = (P.coxeterSystem hA').length y by omega]
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    exact hx (ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_left ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.trans
      (e.symm.trans (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _))) hcon x)
  | succ d ih =>
    intro w hw
    have hwm := (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_le_length_longestElement w
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA').IsRightDescent w i := by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      rw [(P.coxeterSystem hA').eq_longestElement_iff_forall_isRightDescent.mpr hc] at hw
      omega
    have hl : (P.coxeterSystem hA').length (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i) =
        (P.coxeterSystem hA').length w + 1 := by
      rw [(P.coxeterSystem hA').isRightDescent_iff] at hi
      rcases (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_mul_simple w i with h' | h' <;> omega
    have hum := (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_le_length_longestElement
      (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ih (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i) (by omega)
    have hws : w * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i = w :=
      (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple_mul_simple_cancel_right i
    have hu : P.IsPosRoot hA' (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i *
        (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i) i := by
      rwa [hws, isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent]
    have key := exists_ext_simple_ne_zero_succ hA hΛ i hu (fun z hz Z e x ↦
      ext_simple_weylDot_eq_zero hA hΛ _ z rfl Z e _ (by
        have := (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_le_length_longestElement z
        omega) (simple P Λ) x) ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [hws] at key
    rwa [show 2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA').length (P.coxeterSystem hA').longestElement -
      (P.coxeterSystem hA').length w = 2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA').length
        (P.coxeterSystem hA').longestElement - (P.coxeterSystem hA').length
          (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i) + 1 by omega]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.projectiveDimension_simple_weylDot
statement:
theorem projectiveDimension_simple_weylDot (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    projectiveDimension (simple.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) =
      ((2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
          (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement -
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · exact (projectiveDimension_le_iff _ _).mpr (hasProjectiveDimensionLT_simple_weylDot hA hΛ w)
  · rw [projectiveDimension_ge_iff]
    intro h
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ext_simple_weylDot_ne_zero hA hΛ _ w rfl
    exact hx (x.eq_zero_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLT _ le_rfl)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.projectiveDimension_simple
statement:
theorem projectiveDimension_simple :
    projectiveDimension (simple.{u} P Λ) =
      ((2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have h := projectiveDimension_simple_weylDot hA hΛ 1
  rwa [weylDot_one, (P.coxeterSystem _).length_one, Nat.sub_zero] at h

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left_succ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₂, rfl⟩ := contravariant_sequence_exact₁ hS Y x rfl (h₃ _)
  rw [h₂ x₂]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_left
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_left {Y Y' Z : CategoryO.{u} P} (e : Y.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y'.obj) {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y Z n, x = 0) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y' Z n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : Y ⟶ Y' := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e.toLieModuleHom)
  let g : Y' ⟶ Y := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e.symm.toLieModuleHom)
  have hgf : g ≫ f = 𝟙 Y' := by
    ext y
    exact e.apply_symm_apply y
  have hx : x = (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g).comp ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp x (zero_add n))
      (zero_add n) := by
    rw [Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc, hgf, Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp]
  rw [hx, h ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp x _)]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_minimal_hom_simple
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_hom_simple (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (hY : ¬ Subsingleton Y.obj) :
    ∃ lam : Dual K H, ∃ φ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam, φ ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ ν ∈ cone P lam, ν ≠ lam → ∀ ψ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν, ψ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsFiniteCartan := Fact.out
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := Y.property.2
  have := Y.property.1.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Y.property.1.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  let T : Set (Dual K H) := {ν | ∃ ψ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν, ψ ≠ 0}
  have hT : T.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hT
    refine hY ⟨fun a b ↦ ?_⟩
    have hid := Y.property.1.lieModuleHom_eq_zero (fun ν _ ψ ↦ by
      by_contra hψ
      exact hT ⟨ν, ψ, hψ⟩) (LieModuleHom.id : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj)
    have ha : a = 0 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hid a
    have hb : b = 0 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hid b
    rw [ha, hb]
  obtain ⟨lam, ⟨φ, hφ⟩, hmin⟩ := Y.property.1.exists_minimal_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hf
    (S := T) (fun ν ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ ↦ Y.property.1.multiplicity_ne_zero_of_lieModuleHom ψ hψ) hT
  refine ⟨lam, φ, hφ, fun ν hν hne ψ ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hψ
  exact hne (hmin ν ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ hν)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isStdFiltered_of_ext_one
statement:
theorem isStdFiltered_of_ext_one (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj)
    (hN : ∀ (lam : Dual K H) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub X N) (dualVerma P lam) 1), x = 0) :
    ∃ s, IsStdFiltered P N s
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsFiniteCartan := Fact.out
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := X.property.2
  have := X.property.1.wellFoundedLT_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  revert hN
  induction N using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | ind N ih =>
  intro hN
  by_cases h0 : N = ⊥
  · subst h0
    exact ⟨0, IsStdFiltered.bot⟩
  let Y := ofSub X N
  have hY : ¬ Subsingleton Y.obj := by
    intro hsub
    refine h0 (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    have h1 : ofLieEquiv (P := P) N ⟨x, hx⟩ = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ hsub _ _
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) N).injective
      (h1.trans (map_zero (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N)).symm))
  
  obtain ⟨lam, φ, hφ, hbelow⟩ := exists_minimal_hom_simple Y hY
  
  have hext : ∀ μ ∈ cone P lam, μ ≠ lam → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) → ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Y Z 1, x = 0 :=
    fun μ hμ hne Z e ↦ ext_one_simple_eq_zero Y μ (hN μ) (fun ν hν hνne ↦
      hbelow ν (mem_cone_trans hν hμ) fun h ↦ hne (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hμ (h ▸ hν))) Z e
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_lift_verma Y lam hext φ
  have hψs : Function.Surjective ψ := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    by_contra hr
    refine hφ ?_
    rw [← hψ]
    ext y
    exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := VermaModule.maxSubmodule P lam)).mpr
      ((VermaModule.le_maxSubmodule_iff P lam _).mpr hr
        ((LieModuleHom.mem_range ψ (ψ y)).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩))
  let g : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam := ψ.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N).toLieModuleHom
  have hgs : Function.Surjective g := hψs.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N).surjective
  
  let N₀ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj := g.ker.map N.incl
  have hmem (y : N) : (y : X.obj) ∈ N₀ ↔ g y = 0 := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_map]
    refine ⟨fun ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ ↦ ?_, fun hy ↦ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [← LieModuleHom.mem_ker, ← Subtype.ext hzy]
    exact hz
  have hle : N₀ ≤ N := fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map x).mp hx
    exact z.2
  have hlt : N₀ < N := lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun heq ↦ by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hgs (VermaModule.hwv P lam)
    have hy0 : g y = 0 := (hmem y).mp (by rw [heq]; exact y.2)
    exact VermaModule.hwv_ne_zero P lam (hy.symm.trans hy0)
  let g' : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (verma P lam).obj :=
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).toLieModuleHom.comp g
  have hS' := shortExact_subComplex X hle (verma P lam) g'
    (fun x hx ↦ by
      change ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam) (g ⟨x, hle hx⟩) = 0
      rw [(hmem ⟨x, hle hx⟩).mp hx, map_zero])
    ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).surjective.comp hgs)
    fun y hy ↦ (hmem y).mpr ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).injective
      (hy.trans (map_zero (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam))).symm))
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ih N₀ hlt fun μ ↦ Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left_succ hS' (hN μ)
    (ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero lam μ (by norm_num))
  
  have hker : g.ker = N₀.comap N.incl := by
    ext y
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieSubmodule.mem_comap]
    exact (hmem y).symm
  obtain ⟨e₁⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective _ g hgs hker
  obtain ⟨e₂⟩ := LieSubmodule.nonempty_subquotientEquivMap N₀ N
  exact ⟨lam ::ₘ s, hs.step hle ⟨e₁.symm.trans e₂⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.tfae_isStdFiltered
statement:
theorem tfae_isStdFiltered (X : CategoryO.{u} P) :
    List.TFAE [∃ s, IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj) s,
      ∀ (lam : Dual K H) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X (dualVerma P lam) n, x = 0,
      ∀ (lam : Dual K H) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X (dualVerma P lam) 1), x = 0]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun ⟨s, hs⟩ lam n hn x ↦ ext_dualVerma_eq_zero_of_isStdFiltered X hs lam hn x
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := fun h lam x ↦ h lam 1 Nat.one_pos x
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := fun h ↦ isStdFiltered_of_ext_one X ⊤ fun lam ↦
    ext_eq_zero_of_equiv_left (Y := X) ((LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective
      (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj).incl
      ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun y ↦ ⟨⟨y, LieSubmodule.mem_top y⟩, rfl⟩⟩).symm.trans
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj))) (h lam)
  tfae_finish

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk R A)
proof: := LieIdeal.mkHom_surjective _

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.mk_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma mk_eq_zero_of_mem {x : FreeLieAlgebra R (Generators ι)} (hx : x ∈ Relations.toSet R A) :
    mk R A x = 0
proof:
:=
  (LieIdeal.mkHom_eq_zero_iff _).mpr (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan hx)

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lie_h_h
statement: lemma lie_h_h (i j : ι) : ⁅h R A i, h R A j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem (R := R) (A := A)
    (Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inl ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  rwa [Relations.HH, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lie_e_f
statement: lemma lie_e_f (i j : ι) : ⁅e R A i, f R A j⁆ = if i = j then h R A i else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem (R := R) (A := A)
    (Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  rw [Relations.EF, Function.uncurry_apply_pair] at this
  split_ifs at this ⊢ with hij
  · subst hij
    rwa [map_sub, LieHom.map_lie, sub_eq_zero] at this
  · rwa [LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lie_h_e
statement: lemma lie_h_e (i j : ι) : ⁅h R A i, e R A j⁆ = A i j • e R A j
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem (R := R) (A := A) (Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  rwa [Relations.HE, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, map_sub, LieHom.map_lie, map_zsmul,
    sub_eq_zero] at this

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lie_h_f
statement: lemma lie_h_f (i j : ι) : ⁅h R A i, f R A j⁆ = -(A i j • f R A j)
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem (R := R) (A := A) (Or.inl <| Or.inl <| Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  rwa [Relations.HF, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, map_add, LieHom.map_lie, map_zsmul,
    add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at this

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.map_ad_pow
statement:
private lemma map_ad_pow {L L' : Type*} [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [LieRing L']
    [LieAlgebra R L'] (φ : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') (x y : L) (n : ℕ) :
    φ ((ad R L x ^ n) y) = (ad R L' (φ x) ^ n) (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, LieHom.map_lie, ih, pow_succ',
      Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.serre_e
statement:
lemma serre_e (i j : ι) :
    (ad R _ (e R A i) ^ (-A i j).toNat) ⁅e R A i, e R A j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem (R := R) (A := A) (Or.inl <| Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  rwa [Relations.adE, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.serre_f
statement:
lemma serre_f (i j : ι) :
    (ad R _ (f R A i) ^ (-A i j).toNat) ⁅f R A i, f R A j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem (R := R) (A := A) (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  rwa [Relations.adF, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.LiftData.le_ker
statement:
lemma LiftData.le_ker (D : LiftData R A L) :
    Relations.toIdeal R A ≤ (FreeLieAlgebra.lift R D.gen).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [Relations.toIdeal, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro x (((((⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩) | ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩) | ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩) |
    ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩) | ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩)
  · simp [Relations.HH, LiftData.gen, D.lie_h_h]
  · simp only [Relations.EF, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker]
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij; simp [LiftData.gen, D.lie_e_f]
    · simp [LiftData.gen, D.lie_e_f, hij]
  · simp [Relations.HE, LiftData.gen, D.lie_h_e]
  · simp [Relations.HF, LiftData.gen, D.lie_h_f]
  · simp only [Relations.adE, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker,
      map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie, Function.comp_apply, lift_of_apply, LiftData.gen]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp
    · exact D.serre_e i j hij
  · simp only [Relations.adF, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker,
      map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie, Function.comp_apply, lift_of_apply, LiftData.gen]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp
    · exact D.serre_f i j hij

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lift_h
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_h (D : LiftData R A L) (i : ι) : lift D (h R A i) = D.h i
proof:
:=
  lift_of_apply (R := R) D.gen (Generators.H i)

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lift_e
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_e (D : LiftData R A L) (i : ι) : lift D (e R A i) = D.e i
proof:
:=
  lift_of_apply (R := R) D.gen (Generators.E i)

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lift_f
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_f (D : LiftData R A L) (i : ι) : lift D (f R A i) = D.f i
proof:
:=
  lift_of_apply (R := R) D.gen (Generators.F i)

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma hom_ext {g₁ g₂ : Matrix.ToLieAlgebra R A →ₗ⁅R⁆ L} (hh : ∀ i, g₁ (h R A i) = g₂ (h R A i))
    (he : ∀ i, g₁ (e R A i) = g₂ (e R A i)) (hf : ∀ i, g₁ (f R A i) = g₂ (f R A i)) :
    g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  have : g₁.comp (mk R A) = g₂.comp (mk R A) := by
    ext (x | x | x)
    · exact hh x
    · exact he x
    · exact hf x
  exact LieIdeal.lieHom_ext _ fun x ↦ LieHom.congr_fun this x

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lieSpan_generators
statement:
lemma lieSpan_generators :
    LieSubalgebra.lieSpan R (Matrix.ToLieAlgebra R A)
      (Set.range (h R A) ∪ Set.range (e R A) ∪ Set.range (f R A)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro y -
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective R A y
  induction x using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of g =>
    apply LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan
    rcases g with i | i | i
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => simpa using LieSubalgebra.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul a y hy => simpa using LieSubalgebra.smul_mem _ a hy
  | lie y z hy hz => simpa using LieSubalgebra.lie_mem _ hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  have : g₁.comp (π P) = g₂.comp (π P) := AuxLieAlgebra.hom_ext he hf hh
  exact LieIdeal.lieHom_ext _ fun x ↦ LieHom.congr_fun this x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ofToLieAlgebra_h
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofToLieAlgebra_h (i : ι) :
    ofToLieAlgebra P hA (Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.h K A i) = h P (P.coroot i)
proof:
:=
  Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lift_h _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ofToLieAlgebra_e
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofToLieAlgebra_e (i : ι) :
    ofToLieAlgebra P hA (Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.e K A i) = e P i
proof:
:=
  Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lift_e _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ofToLieAlgebra_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofToLieAlgebra_f (i : ι) :
    ofToLieAlgebra P hA (Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.f K A i) = f P i
proof:
:=
  Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lift_f _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_ofToLieAlgebra
statement:
theorem range_ofToLieAlgebra :
    (ofToLieAlgebra P hA).range =
      LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P))
proof:
:= by
  have he : ofToLieAlgebra P hA ∘ Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.e K A = e P :=
    funext (ofToLieAlgebra_e P hA)
  have hf : ofToLieAlgebra P hA ∘ Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.f K A = f P :=
    funext (ofToLieAlgebra_f P hA)
  rw [LieHom.range_eq_map, ← Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lieSpan_generators, LieSubalgebra.map_lieSpan,
    Set.image_union, Set.image_union, ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp, he,
    hf]
  refine le_antisymm (LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_le.mpr ?_)
    (LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_mono (Set.union_subset_union_left _ Set.subset_union_right))
  rintro _ ((⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, ofToLieAlgebra_h, ← lie_e_f_self]
    exact LieSubalgebra.lie_mem _
      (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))
      (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  · exact LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · exact LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_mem_lieSpan_e_f
proof:
:= by
  set S := LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P))
  induction hx using LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rw [lie_h_e]
      exact S.smul_mem _ (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))
    · rw [lie_h_f]
      exact S.neg_mem (S.smul_mem _ (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [lie_add]; exact S.add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [lie_smul]; exact S.smul_mem c hx
  | lie x y hx' hy' hx hy =>
    rw [leibniz_lie]
    exact S.add_mem (S.lie_mem hx hy') (S.lie_mem hx' hy)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f
proof:
:= by
  set S := LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P))
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  induction x using AuxLieAlgebra.induction_on generalizing y with
  | he i => exact S.lie_mem (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)) hy
  | hf i => exact S.lie_mem (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)) hy
  | hh a => exact lie_h_mem_lieSpan_e_f P a hy
  | zero => simp
  | add x z hx hz => rw [map_add, add_lie]; exact S.add_mem (hx hy) (hz hy)
  | smul c x hx => rw [map_smul, smul_lie]; exact S.smul_mem c (hx hy)
  | lie x z hx hz => rw [LieHom.map_lie, lie_lie]; exact S.sub_mem (hx (hz hy)) (hz (hx hy))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f_of_mem_left
statement:
lemma lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f_of_mem_left {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P)))
    (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lie_skew]
  exact neg_mem (lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f P y hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f'
statement:
lemma lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f' (x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P))
proof:
:= by
  set S := LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P))
  have hh (a : H) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) : ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ S := by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
    induction x using AuxLieAlgebra.induction_on with
    | he i => exact lie_h_mem_lieSpan_e_f P a (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))
    | hf i => exact lie_h_mem_lieSpan_e_f P a (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))
    | hh b => rw [π_h, lie_h_h]; exact S.zero_mem
    | zero => simp
    | add x z hx hz => rw [map_add, lie_add]; exact S.add_mem hx hz
    | smul c x hx => rw [map_smul, lie_smul]; exact S.smul_mem c hx
    | lie x z hx hz =>
      rw [LieHom.map_lie, leibniz_lie]
      exact S.add_mem (lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f_of_mem_left P hx _) (lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f P _ hz)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P y
  induction y using AuxLieAlgebra.induction_on generalizing x with
  | he i => exact lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f P x (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  | hf i => exact lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f P x (LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  | hh a => rw [π_h, ← lie_skew]; exact neg_mem (hh a x)
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, lie_add]; exact S.add_mem (hy x) (hz x)
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul, lie_smul]; exact S.smul_mem c (hy x)
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    rw [LieHom.map_lie, leibniz_lie]
    exact S.add_mem (hz _) (lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f P _ (hz x))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lieSpan_e_f_eq_derivedSeries
statement:
theorem lieSpan_e_f_eq_derivedSeries :
    LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P)) =
      (derivedSeries K P.KacMoodyAlgebra 1 : LieSubalgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : derivedSeries K P.KacMoodyAlgebra 1 = ⁅(⊤ : LieIdeal K P.KacMoodyAlgebra), ⊤⁆ := by
    rw [derivedSeries_def, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero]
  have ha (i : ι) : ∃ a : H, P.root i a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! H
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i (LinearMap.ext H)
  refine le_antisymm (LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_le.mpr ?_) fun x hx ↦ ?_
  · rintro _ (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) <;> obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ha i
    · have : e P i = (P.root i a)⁻¹ • ⁅h P a, e P i⁆ := by
        rw [lie_h_e, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieIdeal.mem_toLieSubalgebra, hD, this]
      exact SMulMemClass.smul_mem _ (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie trivial trivial)
    · have : f P i = -(P.root i a)⁻¹ • ⁅h P a, f P i⁆ := by
        rw [lie_h_f, smul_neg, smul_smul, neg_mul, neg_smul, neg_neg, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieIdeal.mem_toLieSubalgebra, hD, this]
      exact SMulMemClass.smul_mem _ (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie trivial trivial)
  · rw [LieIdeal.mem_toLieSubalgebra, hD] at hx
    let S' : LieIdeal K P.KacMoodyAlgebra :=
      { (LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
          (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P))).toSubmodule with
        lie_mem := fun {y} {_} hz ↦ lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f P y hz }
    have : ⁅(⊤ : LieIdeal K P.KacMoodyAlgebra), ⊤⁆ ≤ S' :=
      (LieSubmodule.lie_le_iff _ _ _).mpr fun y _ z _ ↦ lie_mem_lieSpan_e_f' P y z
    exact this hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_ofToLieAlgebra_eq_derivedSeries
statement:
theorem range_ofToLieAlgebra_eq_derivedSeries :
    (ofToLieAlgebra P hA).range =
      (derivedSeries K P.KacMoodyAlgebra 1 : LieSubalgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_ofToLieAlgebra, lieSpan_e_f_eq_derivedSeries P]

name: Matrix.Realization.span_coroot_eq_top_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem span_coroot_eq_top_of_det_ne_zero [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) : Submodule.span K (Set.range P.coroot) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → K)) := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    have := (Int.castRingHom K).map_det A
    rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, eq_intCast, Int.coe_castRingHom] at this
    rw [← this]
    exact_mod_cast hdet
  have hrank := Matrix.rank_of_isUnit _ hunit
  have hfin := P.finrank_add_rank
  refine P.linearIndependent_coroot.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' ?_
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.corootBasis_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma corootBasis_apply (i : ι) : corootBasis hspan i = P.coroot i
proof:
:= by
  simp [corootBasis]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.induction_coroot
statement:
lemma induction_coroot {p : H → Prop} (a : H) (hc : ∀ i, p (P.coroot i)) (h0 : p 0)
    (hadd : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a + b)) (hsmul : ∀ (c : K) a, p a → p (c • a)) : p a
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range P.coroot) := hspan ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hc i
  | zero => exact h0
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => exact hadd a b ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => exact hsmul c a ha

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toLieAlgebraH_coroot
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLieAlgebraH_coroot (i : ι) :
    toLieAlgebraH hspan (P.coroot i) = Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.h K A i
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLieAlgebraH, ← corootBasis_apply hspan, Basis.constr_basis]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.auxLift_h
statement:
@[simp] lemma auxLift_h (a : H) :
    AuxLieAlgebra.lift (auxLiftData P hspan) (AuxLieAlgebra.h P a) = toLieAlgebraH hspan a
proof:
:=
  AuxLieAlgebra.lift_h _ a

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.maxIdeal_le_ker_auxLift
statement:
lemma maxIdeal_le_ker_auxLift :
    AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P ≤ (AuxLieAlgebra.lift (auxLiftData P hspan)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal P hA hS, AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal,
    LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro x ⟨i, j, -, rfl | rfl⟩
  · simp [AuxLieAlgebra.serreE, LieHom.map_ad_pow, auxLiftData, Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.serre_e]
  · simp [AuxLieAlgebra.serreF, LieHom.map_ad_pow, auxLiftData, Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.serre_f]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toToLieAlgebra_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma toToLieAlgebra_π (x : P.AuxLieAlgebra) :
    toToLieAlgebra hA hS hspan (π P x) = AuxLieAlgebra.lift (auxLiftData P hspan) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toToLieAlgebra_e
statement:
@[simp] lemma toToLieAlgebra_e (i : ι) :
    toToLieAlgebra hA hS hspan (e P i) = Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.e K A i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_e, toToLieAlgebra_π, AuxLieAlgebra.lift_e]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toToLieAlgebra_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma toToLieAlgebra_f (i : ι) :
    toToLieAlgebra hA hS hspan (f P i) = Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.f K A i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_f, toToLieAlgebra_π, AuxLieAlgebra.lift_f]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toToLieAlgebra_h
statement:
@[simp] lemma toToLieAlgebra_h (a : H) :
    toToLieAlgebra hA hS hspan (h P a) = toLieAlgebraH hspan a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_h, toToLieAlgebra_π, auxLift_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toToLieAlgebra_comp_ofToLieAlgebra
statement:
lemma toToLieAlgebra_comp_ofToLieAlgebra :
    (toToLieAlgebra hA hS hspan).comp (ofToLieAlgebra P hA) = LieHom.id
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ofToLieAlgebra_comp_toToLieAlgebra
statement:
lemma ofToLieAlgebra_comp_toToLieAlgebra :
    (ofToLieAlgebra P hA).comp (toToLieAlgebra hA hS hspan) = LieHom.id
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun i ↦ by simp) (fun i ↦ by simp) fun a ↦ ?_
  induction a using induction_coroot hspan with
  | hc i => simp
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd a b ha hb => simp_all
  | hsmul c a ha => simp_all

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toLieAlgebraEquivOfSpan_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLieAlgebraEquivOfSpan_apply (x : Matrix.ToLieAlgebra K A) :
    toLieAlgebraEquivOfSpan hA hS hspan x = ofToLieAlgebra P hA x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toLieAlgebraEquivOfSpan_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLieAlgebraEquivOfSpan_symm_apply (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    (toLieAlgebraEquivOfSpan hA hS hspan).symm x = toToLieAlgebra hA hS hspan x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toLieAlgebraEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLieAlgebraEquiv_apply [FiniteDimensional K H] (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (x : Matrix.ToLieAlgebra K A) :
    toLieAlgebraEquiv P hA hS hdet x = ofToLieAlgebra P hA x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra_tprod
statement:
@[simp] theorem toSymmetricAlgebra_tprod (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → M) :
    toSymmetricAlgebra n (tprod K v) = ∏ i, SymmetricAlgebra.ι K M (v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [toSymmetricAlgebra]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ofFn_prod_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem ofFn_prod_mem_filtration (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → L) :
    (List.ofFn (fun i => ι K (v i))).prod ∈ filtration K L n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [List.map_ofFn, List.length_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using
    (list_prod_mem_filtration (R := K) (List.ofFn v))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetrizationPower_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem symmetrizationPower_mem_filtration (n : ℕ) (s : SymmetricPower K (Fin n) L) :
    symmetrizationPower n s ∈ filtration K L n
proof:
:= by
  have hs : s ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (SymmetricPower.tprod K)) := by
    rw [SymmetricPower.span_tprod_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [symmetrizationPower_tprod]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun e _ =>
      ofFn_prod_mem_filtration n (v ∘ e))
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (filtration K L n).zero_mem
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using (filtration K L n).add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using (filtration K L n).smul_mem a hx

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ofFn_prod_toGr
statement:
theorem ofFn_prod_toGr (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → L) :
    toGr K L n ⟨_, ofFn_prod_mem_filtration n v⟩ =
      symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded K L (∏ i, SymmetricAlgebra.ι K L (v i))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using (toGr_zero_one (R := K) (L := L))
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, map_mul, symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_ι, ← ih,
      toGr_mul]
    apply toGr_congr (by omega)
    simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetrizationPower_toGr_of_factorial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem symmetrizationPower_toGr_of_factorial_ne_zero (n : ℕ)
    (hn : (n.factorial : K) ≠ 0) (s : SymmetricPower K (Fin n) L) :
    toGr K L n (symmetrizationPowerFiltered n s) =
      symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded K L (SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra n s)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (toGr K L n).comp (symmetrizationPowerFiltered n) =
      (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded K L).toLinearMap.comp
        (SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra n) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext_on (SymmetricPower.span_tprod_eq_top K (Fin n) L)
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra_tprod]
    have he : symmetrizationPowerFiltered n (SymmetricPower.tprod K v) =
        (n.factorial : K)⁻¹ • ∑ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
          (⟨_, ofFn_prod_mem_filtration n (v ∘ e)⟩ : filtration K L n) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [symmetrizationPowerFiltered, symmetrizationPower_tprod]
    have hp (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
        (∏ i, SymmetricAlgebra.ι K L (v (e i))) = ∏ i, SymmetricAlgebra.ι K L (v i) :=
      Equiv.prod_comp e (fun i => SymmetricAlgebra.ι K L (v i))
    rw [he, map_smul, map_sum]
    simp only [ofFn_prod_toGr, Function.comp_apply, hp,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hm s

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetrizationPower_toGr
statement:
theorem symmetrizationPower_toGr [CharZero K] (n : ℕ)
    (s : SymmetricPower K (Fin n) L) :
    toGr K L n (symmetrizationPowerFiltered n s) =
      symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded K L (SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra n s)
proof:
:= by
  apply symmetrizationPower_toGr_of_factorial_ne_zero
  exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetrizationPowerToCenter_toGr
statement:
theorem symmetrizationPowerToCenter_toGr [CharZero K] (n : ℕ)
    (s : invariantSymmetricPower (K := K) (L := L) n) :
    toGr K L n
      ⟨(symmetrizationPowerToCenter n s : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L),
        symmetrizationPower_mem_filtration n s.val⟩ =
      symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded K L
        (SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra n s.val)
proof:
:=
  symmetrizationPower_toGr n s.val

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetrizationPower_mem_filtration_iff
statement:
theorem symmetrizationPower_mem_filtration_iff [CharZero K] (n : ℕ)
    (s : SymmetricPower K (Fin (n + 1)) L) :
    symmetrizationPower (n + 1) s ∈ filtration K L n ↔
      SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra (n + 1) s = 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((symmetrizationPowerFiltered (n + 1) s : filtration K L (n + 1)) :
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L) ∈ filtration K L n ↔ _
  rw [← toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff (symmetrizationPowerFiltered (n + 1) s),
    symmetrizationPower_toGr]
  exact (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_bijective K L).injective.eq_iff' (map_zero _)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.mem_iSup_rootSpace
statement: lemma mem_iSup_rootSpace (x : P.AuxLieAlgebra) : x ∈ ⨆ μ, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ allWeights P, rootSpace P μ := by
    rw [iSup_rootSpace_eq_top]; trivial
  exact (iSup₂_le fun μ _ ↦ le_iSup (fun μ ↦ rootSpace P μ) μ) hx

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.induction_on_rootSpace
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma induction_on_rootSpace {p : P.AuxLieAlgebra → Prop} (x : P.AuxLieAlgebra)
    (mem : ∀ μ, ∀ x ∈ rootSpace P μ, p x) (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) : p x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction (fun μ ↦ rootSpace P μ) (motive := p) (mem_iSup_rootSpace P x) mem
    (mem 0 0 (Submodule.zero_mem _)) add

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_eq_bot
statement: lemma rootSpace_eq_bot {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∉ allWeights P) : rootSpace P μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨆ ν, ⨆ (_ : ν ∈ allWeights P), rootSpace P ν := by
    have : x ∈ ⨆ ν ∈ allWeights P, rootSpace P ν := by rw [iSup_rootSpace_eq_top]; trivial
    exact this
  have := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) (fun ν ↦ ⨆ (_ : ν ∈ allWeights P), rootSpace P ν)
    (fun ν ↦ iSup_le fun _ ↦ le_rfl) hx hx'
  simpa [hμ] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.mem_negWeights_iff
statement: lemma mem_negWeights_iff {μ : Dual K H} : μ ∈ P.negWeights ↔ -μ ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, hk, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, hμ⟩
    exact ⟨k, hk, show -P.rootOf k = μ by rw [hμ, neg_neg]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ μ P.rhoCheck = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨hk0, hk⟩, rfl⟩ := hμ
  have hpos : 0 < height k := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk
    exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ ↦ hk0 j) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_ne (hk0 i)
      (Ne.symm hi)⟩
  refine ⟨(height k).toNat, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [rootOf_rhoCheck, ← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hpos.le]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero
statement:
lemma apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ allWeights P) (hμ0 : μ ≠ 0) :
    μ P.rhoCheck ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hμ with (hμ | hμ) | hμ
  · obtain ⟨n, hn, hμn⟩ := exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights P ((mem_negWeights_iff P).mp hμ)
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg] at hμn
    rw [hμn, neg_ne_zero]
    exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  · exact absurd hμ hμ0
  · obtain ⟨n, hn, hμn⟩ := exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights P hμ
    rw [hμn]
    exact_mod_cast hn.ne'

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) : μ P.rhoCheck ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμw : μ ∈ allWeights P
  · exact apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero P hμw hμ
  · rw [rootSpace_eq_bot P hμw] at hx
    exact absurd ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hx) hx0

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.hComp_triangular
statement:
