      have hh := P.apply_mem_realRoots hA (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i) hr
      rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, P.reflection_reflection hA] at hh
      exact ih.2.2 hh
  exact hall.2.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_rho_rootOf
statement:
lemma transpose_rho_rootOf (k : ι → ℤ) :
    P.transpose.rho (P.rootOf k) = (height k : K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr (j : ι) : P.transpose.rho (P.root j) = 1 := P.transpose.rho_coroot j
  simp [rootOf_apply, hr, height]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_apply_root_eq_zero
statement:
lemma sum_apply_root_eq_zero [Fintype (P.weylGroup hA)]
    (φ : Dual K (Dual K H)) (i : ι) :
    ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA, φ (w.1 (P.root i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let r : P.weylGroup hA := ⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩
  have heq : (∑ w : P.weylGroup hA, φ (w.1 (P.root i))) =
      ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA, -φ (w.1 (P.root i)) := by
    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulRight r) _ _ fun w ↦ ?_
    change φ (w.1 (P.root i)) = -φ (w.1 (P.reflection hA i (P.root i)))
    simp
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at heq
  exact CharZero.eq_neg_self_iff.mp heq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.roots_eq_realRoots_of_finite_weylGroup
statement:
theorem roots_eq_realRoots_of_finite_weylGroup [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)] :
    roots P = P.realRoots hA
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite (P.weylGroup hA)
  have hpositive {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ roots P) (hp : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
      μ ∈ P.realRoots hA := by
    by_contra hn
    choose k hk hkw using fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦
      apply_mem_posWeights_of_not_mem_realRoots P hA hμ hp hn w.2
    have hpos : 0 < ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA, height (k w) := by
      apply Finset.sum_pos _ Finset.univ_nonempty
      intro w _
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp (hk w).2
      exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ ↦ (hk w).1 j)
        ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_ne ((hk w).1 i) (Ne.symm hi)⟩
    have hcast : (∑ w : P.weylGroup hA, height (k w) : ℤ) = 0 ↔
        (∑ w : P.weylGroup hA, P.transpose.rho (w.1 μ)) = 0 := by
      simp_rw [← hkw, transpose_rho_rootOf, ← Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_eq_zero]
    have hne := (ne_of_gt hpos)
    obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := hp
    have hzero : ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA, P.transpose.rho (w.1 (P.rootOf k)) = 0 := by
      simp only [rootOf_apply, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_apply_root_eq_zero P hA, mul_zero]
      simp
    exact hne (hcast.mpr hzero)
  refine subset_antisymm (fun μ hμ ↦ ?_) (realRoots_subset_roots P hA)
  rcases mem_posWeights_or_mem_negWeights P hμ with hp | ⟨k, hk, hkμ⟩
  · exact hpositive hμ hp
  · have hneg : -μ ∈ P.posWeights := ⟨k, hk, by simp [← hkμ]⟩
    simpa using P.neg_mem_realRoots hA (hpositive (neg_mem_roots P hμ) hneg)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_roots_of_finite_weylGroup
statement:
theorem finite_roots_of_finite_weylGroup [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)] :
    (roots P).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [roots_eq_realRoots_of_finite_weylGroup P hA]
  refine (Set.finite_range (fun p : P.weylGroup hA × ι ↦ p.1.1 (P.root p.2))).subset ?_
  rintro μ ⟨w, hw, i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨(⟨w, hw⟩, i), rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_roots_iff_finite_weylGroup
statement:
theorem finite_roots_iff_finite_weylGroup :
    (roots P).Finite ↔ Finite (P.weylGroup hA)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact P.finite_weylGroup_of_finite_roots hA
  · intro h
    let _ := h
    exact finite_roots_of_finite_weylGroup P hA

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_roots_iff_titsCone_eq_univ
statement:
theorem finite_roots_iff_titsCone_eq_univ :
    (roots P).Finite ↔ P.titsCone hA = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  (finite_roots_iff_finite_weylGroup P hA).trans
    (P.finite_weylGroup_iff_titsCone_eq_univ hA)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_injective_weylDot_self
statement:
lemma exists_injective_weylDot_self (w : W) :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ,
      Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  have := exists_injective_of_bruhatLE hA hΛ ((cs).one_bruhatLE w)
  rwa [weylDot_one] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggEmb_injective
statement: lemma bggEmb_injective (w : W) : Function.Injective (bggEmb P hA hΛ w)
proof:
:=
  (exists_injective_weylDot_self P hA hΛ w).choose_spec

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggEmb_mem_range
statement:
lemma bggEmb_mem_range {w w' : W} (h : (cs).BruhatLE w w') (m : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ)) :
    bggEmb P hA hΛ w' m ∈ (bggEmb P hA hΛ w).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_injective_of_bruhatLE hA hΛ h
  have hne : bggEmb P hA hΛ w' ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hwv_ne_zero P _
    (bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ w' (by rw [h0, map_zero, _root_.zero_apply]))
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' _ hne).mp
    (finrank_hom_weylDot_self hA hΛ w') ((bggEmb P hA hΛ w).comp ψ)
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at hc
    exact hwv_ne_zero P _ (hψ (bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ w (by
      rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ← hc, map_zero, _root_.zero_apply, map_zero])))
  refine ⟨c⁻¹ • ψ m, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ← hc, _root_.smul_apply, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggEmb_comp_bggMap
statement:
lemma bggEmb_comp_bggMap {w w' : W} (h : (cs).BruhatLE w w') :
    (bggEmb P hA hΛ w).comp (bggMap P hA hΛ w' w) = bggEmb P hA hΛ w'
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext P _ ?_
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, bggMap, dite_eq_left h, ← homEquiv_apply,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (bggEmb_mem_range P hA hΛ h (hwv P _)).choose_spec

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggMap_injective
statement:
lemma bggMap_injective {w w' : W} (h : (cs).BruhatLE w w') :
    Function.Injective (bggMap P hA hΛ w' w)
proof:
:= by
  intro m m' hm
  apply bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ w'
  rw [← bggEmb_comp_bggMap P hA hΛ h, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggMap_comp
statement:
theorem bggMap_comp {w b w' : W} (h₁ : (cs).BruhatLE w b) (h₂ : (cs).BruhatLE b w') :
    (bggMap P hA hΛ b w).comp (bggMap P hA hΛ w' b) = bggMap P hA hΛ w' w
proof:
:= by
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ w ?_
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply (bggEmb P hA hΛ w),
    bggEmb_comp_bggMap P hA hΛ h₁, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply (bggEmb P hA hΛ b),
    bggEmb_comp_bggMap P hA hΛ h₂, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply (bggEmb P hA hΛ w),
    bggEmb_comp_bggMap P hA hΛ (h₁.trans h₂)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_bggBoundary
statement:
lemma mem_bggBoundary {w' : W} {k : ℕ} {w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}} :
    w ∈ bggBoundary P hA w' k ↔ (cs).BruhatCovBy w w'
proof:
:= by
  rw [bggBoundary, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]

name: LieModuleHom.finset_sum_apply
statement:
lemma _root_.LieModuleHom.finset_sum_apply {R L M N κ : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L]
    [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] (s : Finset κ) (φ : κ → M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (x : M) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, φ i) x = ∑ i ∈ s, φ i x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, _root_.add_apply, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggDiff_of
statement:
lemma bggDiff_of (k : ℕ) (w' : {w : W // (cs).length w = k + 1})
    (x : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ)) :
    bggDiff P hA hΛ k (DirectSum.of _ w' x) = ∑ w ∈ bggBoundary P hA w' k,
      bggSign P hA w w' • DirectSum.of (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k} ↦
        VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) w (bggMap P hA hΛ w' w x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bggDiff, DirectSum.toLieModule_of, LieModuleHom.finset_sum_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_bggSign_mul_bggSign
statement:
lemma sum_bggSign_mul_bggSign {k : ℕ} (w'' : {w : W // (cs).length w = k + 2})
    (w₀ : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}) :
    ∑ b ∈ (bggBoundary P hA w'' (k + 1)).filter
      (fun b : {w : W // (cs).length w = k + 1} ↦ w₀ ∈ bggBoundary P hA b k),
      bggSign P hA b w'' * bggSign P hA w₀ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  generalize hTdef : (bggBoundary P hA w'' (k + 1)).filter
    (fun b : {w : W // (cs).length w = k + 1} ↦ w₀ ∈ bggBoundary P hA b k) = T
  have hT : ∀ b ∈ T, (cs).BruhatCovBy w₀ b ∧ (cs).BruhatCovBy b w'' := fun b hb ↦ by
    rw [← hTdef, Finset.mem_filter, mem_bggBoundary, mem_bggBoundary] at hb
    exact ⟨hb.2, hb.1⟩
  rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hTe | ⟨b, hb⟩
  · rw [hTe, Finset.sum_empty]
  obtain ⟨hb₁, hb₂⟩ := hT b hb
  obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, hc, hmid⟩ := (cs).exists_middle_pair (hb₁.1.trans hb₂.1)
    (by rw [hb₂.2, hb₁.2])
  have hl : ∀ c, (c = c₁ ∨ c = c₂) → (cs).length c = k + 1 := fun c hc' ↦ by
    rw [((hmid c).mpr hc').1.2, w₀.2]
  have hTeq : T = {⟨c₁, hl c₁ (.inl rfl)⟩, ⟨c₂, hl c₂ (.inr rfl)⟩} := by
    ext b'
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, Subtype.ext_iff (a1 := b'),
      Subtype.ext_iff (a1 := b')]
    constructor
    · intro hb'
      exact (hmid b').mp (hT b' hb')
    · intro hb'
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := (hmid b').mpr hb'
      rw [← hTdef, Finset.mem_filter, mem_bggBoundary, mem_bggBoundary]
      exact ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
  rw [hTeq, Finset.sum_pair (fun h ↦ hc (congrArg Subtype.val h))]
  have hsq := (cs).neg_one_pow_bruhatSign_square (R := K) ((hmid c₁).mpr (.inl rfl)).1
    ((hmid c₁).mpr (.inl rfl)).2 ((hmid c₂).mpr (.inr rfl)).1 ((hmid c₂).mpr (.inr rfl)).2 hc
  simp only [bggSign]
  rw [mul_comm, mul_comm ((-1 : K) ^ ((cs).bruhatSign c₂ w'').val), hsq]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggDiff_comp_bggDiff
statement:
theorem bggDiff_comp_bggDiff (k : ℕ) :
    (bggDiff P hA hΛ k).comp (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext1 m
  induction m using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', map_add]
  | of w'' x =>
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, bggDiff_of, map_sum, _root_.zero_apply]
  simp_rw [map_smul, bggDiff_of, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  
  have hcomp : ∀ b ∈ bggBoundary P hA w'' (k + 1), ∀ w ∈ bggBoundary P hA b k,
      bggMap P hA hΛ b w (bggMap P hA hΛ w'' b x) = bggMap P hA hΛ w'' w x := by
    intro b hb w hw
    rw [mem_bggBoundary] at hb hw
    rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, bggMap_comp P hA hΛ hw.1 hb.1]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ by rw [hcomp b hb w hw]]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_comm' (t' := (bggBoundary P hA w'' (k + 1)).biUnion
      fun b : {w : W // (cs).length w = k + 1} ↦ bggBoundary P hA b k)
    (s' := fun w ↦ (bggBoundary P hA w'' (k + 1)).filter
      fun b : {w : W // (cs).length w = k + 1} ↦ w ∈ bggBoundary P hA b k)
    (fun b w ↦ by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨hb, hw⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨hb, hw⟩, b, hb, hw⟩, fun ⟨⟨hb, hw⟩, _⟩ ↦ ⟨hb, hw⟩⟩)]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun w₀ _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [sum_bggSign_mul_bggSign P hA w'' w₀]
  exact zero_smul K _

name: LieModuleHom.range_smul_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma _root_.LieModuleHom.range_smul_of_ne_zero {L M N : Type*} [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module K N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule K L N] (φ : M →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (c • φ).range = φ.range
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [LieModuleHom.mem_range, _root_.smul_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c • m, map_smul φ c m⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨c⁻¹ • m, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul φ c⁻¹ m, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_eq_of_finrank_hom_eq_one
statement:
lemma range_eq_of_finrank_hom_eq_one {μ μ' ν : Dual K H} (e : μ = μ')
    (hd : finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P ν) = 1)
    {φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P ν}
    {ψ : VermaModule P μ' →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P ν} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) (hψ : ψ ≠ 0) :
    φ.range = ψ.range
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' _ hφ).mp hd ψ
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hψ (by rw [← hc, zero_smul])
  rw [← hc, LieModuleHom.range_smul_of_ne_zero _ hc0]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_bggOne
statement:
lemma eq_of_bggOne (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ 0) :
    x = DirectSum.of (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = 0} ↦ VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ))
      (bggOne P hA) (x (bggOne P hA))
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim j (bggOne P hA)
  rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggEmbZero_of
statement:
lemma bggEmbZero_of (w : {w : W // (cs).length w = 0}) (x : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) :
    bggEmbZero P hA hΛ (DirectSum.of _ w x) = bggEmb P hA hΛ w x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toLieModule_of _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggEmbZero_injective
statement: lemma bggEmbZero_injective : Function.Injective (bggEmbZero P hA hΛ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rw [eq_of_bggOne P hA x, eq_of_bggOne P hA y, bggEmbZero_of, bggEmbZero_of] at hxy
  rw [eq_of_bggOne P hA x, eq_of_bggOne P hA y, bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ _ hxy]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_bggEmb_bggOne
statement: lemma range_bggEmb_bggOne : (bggEmb P hA hΛ (bggOne P hA)).range = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : P.weylDot hA (bggOne P hA : W) Λ = Λ := weylDot_one P hA Λ
  refine (range_eq_of_finrank_hom_eq_one P h1 (finrank_hom_weylDot_self hA hΛ _)
    (φ := bggEmb P hA hΛ (bggOne P hA)) (ψ := LieModuleHom.id) ?_ ?_).trans
    ((LieModuleHom.range_eq_top _).mpr Function.surjective_id)
  · exact fun h ↦ hwv_ne_zero P _ (bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ _ (by
      rw [h, _root_.zero_apply, map_zero]))
  · exact fun h ↦ hwv_ne_zero P Λ (by
      rw [← LieModuleHom.id_apply (R := K) (L := P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (hwv P Λ), h,
        _root_.zero_apply])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggEmbZero_surjective
statement: lemma bggEmbZero_surjective : Function.Surjective (bggEmbZero P hA hΛ)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ m).mp
    ((range_bggEmb_bggOne P hA hΛ).symm ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top m)
  exact ⟨DirectSum.of _ _ x, by rw [bggEmbZero_of, hx]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggAugmentation_surjective
statement: theorem bggAugmentation_surjective : Function.Surjective (bggAugmentation P hA hΛ)
proof:
:=
  (bggAug_surjective P).comp (bggEmbZero_surjective P hA hΛ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggEmbZero_bggDiff_of
statement:
lemma bggEmbZero_bggDiff_of (w' : {w : W // (cs).length w = 0 + 1})
    (x : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ)) :
    bggEmbZero P hA hΛ (bggDiff P hA hΛ 0 (DirectSum.of _ w' x)) =
      bggSign P hA (bggOne P hA : W) w' • bggEmb P hA hΛ w' x
proof:
:= by
  have hb : bggBoundary P hA w' 0 = {bggOne P hA} := by
    refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨?_, fun w _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
    rw [mem_bggBoundary, CoxeterSystem.BruhatCovBy]
    exact ⟨(cs).one_bruhatLE _, by rw [w'.2, bggOne, (cs).length_one]⟩
  rw [bggDiff_of, hb, Finset.sum_singleton, map_smul, bggEmbZero_of,
    ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply,
    bggEmb_comp_bggMap P hA hΛ (w := (bggOne P hA : W)) ((cs).one_bruhatLE _)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggSign_ne_zero
statement: lemma bggSign_ne_zero (w w' : W) : bggSign P hA w w' ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weylDot_simple
statement:
lemma weylDot_simple (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.weylDot hA ((cs).simple i) μ = P.reflection hA i (μ + P.rho) - P.rho
proof:
:= by
  have := weylDot_simple_mul P hA i 1 μ
  rwa [mul_one, weylDot_one] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_bggEmb_simple
statement:
lemma range_bggEmb_simple {w : W} {i : ι} (hi : w = (cs).simple i) :
    (bggEmb P hA hΛ w).range =
      (reflectionHom hA (Nat.succ_pos _) (add_rho_coroot_eq P hΛ i)).range
proof:
:=
  range_eq_of_finrank_hom_eq_one P (by rw [hi, weylDot_simple])
    (finrank_hom_weylDot_self hA hΛ w)
    (fun h ↦ hwv_ne_zero P _ (bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ _ (by
      rw [h, _root_.zero_apply, map_zero])))
    (reflectionHom_ne_zero hA (Nat.succ_pos _) (add_rho_coroot_eq P hΛ i))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_bggEmbZero_comp_bggDiff
statement:
lemma range_bggEmbZero_comp_bggDiff :
    ((bggEmbZero P hA hΛ).comp (bggDiff P hA hΛ 0)).range = maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_bggAug, ← range_bggDiffOne P hA hΛ hS, bggDiffOne, DirectSum.range_toLieModule]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
    | of w' x =>
      rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, bggEmbZero_bggDiff_of]
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (cs).length_eq_one_iff.mp w'.2
      refine SMulMemClass.smul_mem _ (LieSubmodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i ?_)
      rw [← range_bggEmb_simple P hA hΛ hi]
      exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
  · refine iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_
    let w' : {w : W // (cs).length w = 0 + 1} := ⟨(cs).simple i, (cs).length_simple i⟩
    rw [← range_bggEmb_simple P hA hΛ (w := w') rfl]
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨DirectSum.of _ w' ((bggSign P hA (bggOne P hA : W) w')⁻¹ • x), ?_⟩
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, bggEmbZero_bggDiff_of, map_smul, smul_smul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (bggSign_ne_zero P hA _ _), one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_bggAugmentation
statement: theorem ker_bggAugmentation : (bggAugmentation P hA hΛ).ker = (bggDiff P hA hΛ 0).range
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range, bggAugmentation, LieModuleHom.comp_apply,
    ← LieModuleHom.mem_ker, ker_bggAug, ← range_bggEmbZero_comp_bggDiff P hA hΛ hS,
    LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨y, bggEmbZero_injective P hA hΛ hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggAugmentation_comp_bggDiff
statement:
theorem bggAugmentation_comp_bggDiff :
    (bggAugmentation P hA hΛ).comp (bggDiff P hA hΛ 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, _root_.zero_apply, ← LieModuleHom.mem_ker,
    ker_bggAugmentation P hA hΛ hS]
  exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.isWeylAntiInvariant_of_reflection
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w using (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple_induction_left with
  | one => intro μ; simp
  | mul_simple_left w i ih =>
    intro μ
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple, hc, ih]
    rcases (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_simple_mul w i with h | h
    · rw [h, pow_succ]; ring
    · rw [← h, pow_succ]; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.IsWeylAntiInvariant.mul
statement:
theorem IsWeylAntiInvariant.mul {c d : P.CharacterRing R} (hc : c.IsWeylAntiInvariant P hA)
    (hd : d.IsWeylInvariant P hA) : (c * d).IsWeylAntiInvariant P hA
proof:
:= by
  intro w μ
  set w' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H := (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
  rw [coeff_mul, coeff_mul, ← finsum_comp_equiv w'.toEquiv]
  have h : ∀ ν, c.coeffAt (w'.toEquiv ν) * d.coeffAt (w' μ - w'.toEquiv ν) =
      (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w * (c.coeffAt ν * d.coeffAt (μ - ν)) := by
    intro ν
    rw [LinearEquiv.coe_toEquiv, hc w ν, ← map_sub, hd w' w.2 (μ - ν)]
    ring
  simp_rw [h]
  rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or R ((P.coxeterSystem hA).length w) with h1 | h1
  · simp [h1]
  · simp [h1, finsum_neg_distrib]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_denominator
statement:
lemma coeffAt_denominator (μ : Dual K H) :
    (denominator P).coeffAt μ =
      ∑ᶠ S : Finset (NegRootIndex P), if -finsetWt P S = μ then (-1) ^ S.card else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeffAt, denominator, SummableFamily.coeff_hsum]
  refine finsum_congr fun S ↦ ?_
  simp only [denominatorFamily, SummableFamily.coe_mk, coeff_single]
  exact if_congr ⟨fun h ↦ ((toWeightOrd P).injective h).symm, fun h ↦ by rw [h]⟩ rfl rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.NegRootIndex.root_mem_posWeights
statement: lemma NegRootIndex.root_mem_posWeights (x : NegRootIndex P) : x.root ∈ P.posWeights

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.NegRootIndex.root_mem_roots
statement: lemma NegRootIndex.root_mem_roots (x : NegRootIndex P) : x.root ∈ roots P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ P.zero_notMem_posWeights (h0 ▸ x.root_mem_posWeights), fun hbot ↦ ?_⟩
  have hj : x.2.val < finrank K (rootSpace P x.root) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_eq x.2.isLt (finrank_rootSpace_neg_eq P x.root_mem_posWeights)
  rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hj
  exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ hj

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.NegRootIndex.ext
statement:
lemma NegRootIndex.ext {x y : NegRootIndex P} (h : x.root = y.root) (hj : x.2.val = y.2.val) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨α, hα⟩, j⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨⟨β, hβ⟩, k⟩ := y
  change α = β at h
  subst h
  exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (Fin.ext hj))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.root_simpleIndex
statement: @[simp] lemma root_simpleIndex (i : ι) : (simpleIndex P i).root = P.root i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_simpleIndex
statement:
lemma eq_simpleIndex {x : NegRootIndex P} {i : ι} (hx : x.root = P.root i) :
    x = simpleIndex P i
proof:
:= by
  have hj : x.2.val < 1 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_eq x.2.isLt (by rw [← finrank_rootSpace_neg_root P i, ← hx]; rfl)
  exact NegRootIndex.ext hx (by change x.2.val = 0; omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.root_eq_iff_eq_simpleIndex
statement:
lemma root_eq_iff_eq_simpleIndex {x : NegRootIndex P} {i : ι} :
    x.root = P.root i ↔ x = simpleIndex P i
proof:
:=
  ⟨eq_simpleIndex, fun h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflection_ne_root
statement:
lemma reflection_ne_root (i : ι) {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    P.reflection hA i μ ≠ P.root i
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : μ = -P.root i := by rw [← P.reflection_reflection hA i μ, h, reflection_root_self]
  rw [this] at hμ
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp P.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights hμ
    ((neg_mem_negWeights_iff P).mpr (P.root_mem_posWeights i))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflection_root_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma reflection_root_mem_posWeights (i : ι) (x : NegRootIndex P) (hx : ¬x.root = P.root i) :
    P.reflection hA i x.root ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:=
  reflection_mem_posWeights P hA x.root_mem_roots x.root_mem_posWeights hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_rootSpace_neg_reflection
statement:
lemma finrank_rootSpace_neg_reflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (rootSpace P (-P.reflection hA i μ)) = finrank K (rootSpace P (-μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_neg]
  simp only [Module.finrank]
  rw [rank_rootSpace_weylGroup P hA (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.root_reflectIndex
statement:
lemma root_reflectIndex (i : ι) (x : {x : NegRootIndex P // ¬x.root = P.root i}) :
    (reflectIndex hA i x).1.root = P.reflection hA i x.1.root
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.val_reflectIndex
statement:
lemma val_reflectIndex (i : ι) (x : {x : NegRootIndex P // ¬x.root = P.root i}) :
    (reflectIndex hA i x).1.2.val = x.1.2.val
proof:
:=
  Fin.val_cast (finrank_rootSpace_neg_reflection hA i x.1.root).symm x.1.2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflectIndex_reflectIndex
statement:
lemma reflectIndex_reflectIndex (i : ι) (x : {x : NegRootIndex P // ¬x.root = P.root i}) :
    reflectIndex hA i (reflectIndex hA i x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (NegRootIndex.ext ?_ ?_)
  · rw [root_reflectIndex, root_reflectIndex, reflection_reflection]
  · rw [val_reflectIndex, val_reflectIndex]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflectPerm_simpleIndex
statement: lemma reflectPerm_simpleIndex (i : ι) : reflectPerm hA i (simpleIndex P i) = simpleIndex P i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [reflectPerm,
    Equiv.Perm.subtypeCongr.left_apply (a := simpleIndex P i) _ _ (root_simpleIndex i)]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.root_reflectPerm
statement:
lemma root_reflectPerm (i : ι) (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    (reflectPerm hA i x).root = P.reflection hA i x.root +
      if x = simpleIndex P i then (2 : ℕ) • P.root i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  split_ifs with hx
  · rw [hx, reflectPerm_simpleIndex, root_simpleIndex, reflection_root_self]
    simp only [two_nsmul]
    abel
  · rw [add_zero, ← root_eq_iff_eq_simpleIndex] at *
    rw [reflectPerm, Equiv.Perm.subtypeCongr.right_apply (a := x) _ _ hx]
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.symmDiff_singleton_eq
statement:
lemma symmDiff_singleton_eq (T : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    symmDiff T {x} = if x ∈ T then T.erase x else insert x T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y
  split_ifs with hx
  · simp only [Finset.mem_symmDiff, Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_erase]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨hy, hyx⟩ | ⟨rfl, hy⟩)
      · exact ⟨hyx, hy⟩
      · exact absurd hx hy
    · rintro ⟨hyx, hy⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hyx⟩
  · simp only [Finset.mem_symmDiff, Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_insert]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨hy, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩)
      · exact Or.inr hy
      · exact Or.inl rfl
    · rintro (rfl | hy)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, hx⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, fun h ↦ hx (h ▸ hy)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetWt_symmDiff_singleton
statement:
lemma finsetWt_symmDiff_singleton (T : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    finsetWt P (symmDiff T {x}) =
      if x ∈ T then finsetWt P T - x.root else finsetWt P T + x.root
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [symmDiff_singleton_eq]
  split_ifs with hx
  · rw [finsetWt, finsetWt, Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub hx]
  · rw [finsetWt, finsetWt, Finset.sum_insert hx, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.neg_one_pow_card_symmDiff_singleton
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_card_symmDiff_singleton (T : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (symmDiff T {x}).card = -(-1) ^ T.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [symmDiff_singleton_eq]
  split_ifs with hx
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, T.card = n + 1 :=
      ⟨T.card - 1, (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hx⟩)).symm⟩
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hx, hn, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
    ring
  · rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hx, pow_succ]
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflectFinset_apply
statement:
lemma reflectFinset_apply (i : ι) (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    reflectFinset hA i S = symmDiff (S.map (reflectPerm hA i).toEmbedding) {simpleIndex P i}
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.simpleIndex_mem_map_iff
statement:
lemma simpleIndex_mem_map_iff (i : ι) (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    simpleIndex P i ∈ S.map (reflectPerm hA i).toEmbedding ↔ simpleIndex P i ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← reflectPerm_simpleIndex hA i]
  exact Finset.mem_map' _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetWt_map_reflectPerm
statement:
lemma finsetWt_map_reflectPerm (i : ι) (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    finsetWt P (S.map (reflectPerm hA i).toEmbedding) = P.reflection hA i (finsetWt P S) +
      if simpleIndex P i ∈ S then (2 : ℕ) • P.root i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finsetWt, Finset.sum_map, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, root_reflectPerm,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, map_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetWt_reflectFinset
statement:
lemma finsetWt_reflectFinset (i : ι) (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    finsetWt P (reflectFinset hA i S) = P.reflection hA i (finsetWt P S) + P.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectFinset_apply, finsetWt_symmDiff_singleton, finsetWt_map_reflectPerm,
    root_simpleIndex]
  by_cases h : simpleIndex P i ∈ S
  · rw [ite_eq_left ((simpleIndex_mem_map_iff hA i S).mpr h), ite_eq_left h]
    simp only [two_nsmul]
    abel
  · rw [ite_eq_right (mt (simpleIndex_mem_map_iff hA i S).mp h), ite_eq_right h, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.neg_one_pow_card_reflectFinset
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_card_reflectFinset (i : ι) (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (reflectFinset hA i S).card = -(-1) ^ S.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectFinset_apply, neg_one_pow_card_symmDiff_singleton, Finset.card_map]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_denominator_reflection
statement:
theorem coeffAt_denominator_reflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (denominator P).coeffAt (P.reflection hA i μ - P.root i) = -(denominator P).coeffAt μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeffAt_denominator, coeffAt_denominator, ← finsum_comp_equiv (reflectFinset hA i),
    ← finsum_neg_distrib]
  refine finsum_congr fun S ↦ ?_
  rw [finsetWt_reflectFinset, neg_one_pow_card_reflectFinset]
  have : -(P.reflection hA i (finsetWt P S) + P.root i) = P.reflection hA i μ - P.root i ↔
      -finsetWt P S = μ := by
    rw [neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_left_inj, ← map_neg, (P.reflection hA i).injective.eq_iff]
  rw [if_congr this rfl rfl]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_reflection
statement:
theorem coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_reflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P).coeffAt (P.reflection hA i μ) =
      -(exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P).coeffAt μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_exp_mul, coeff_exp_mul, ← coeffAt_denominator_reflection hA i (μ - P.rho)]
  congr 1
  rw [map_sub, reflection_apply P hA i P.rho, rho_coroot, one_smul]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isWeylAntiInvariant_exp_rho_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem isWeylAntiInvariant_exp_rho_mul_denominator :
    (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P).IsWeylAntiInvariant P hA
proof:
:=
  isWeylAntiInvariant_of_reflection (coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_reflection hA)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.isWeylAntiInvariant_exp_rho_mul_character
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.isWeylAntiInvariant_exp_rho_mul_character {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hI : IsIntegrable P V) :
    (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P * hV.character).IsWeylAntiInvariant P hA
proof:
:=
  (isWeylAntiInvariant_exp_rho_mul_denominator hA).mul (hV.isWeylInvariant_character hA hI)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_nNeg
statement: lemma mem_nNeg {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} : x ∈ nNeg P ↔ ∃ y, fHom P y = x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_nPos
statement: lemma mem_nPos {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} : x ∈ nPos P ↔ ∃ z, eHom P z = x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.f_mem_nNeg
statement: lemma f_mem_nNeg (i : ι) : f P i ∈ nNeg P
proof: := ⟨FreeLieAlgebra.of K i, fHom_of P i⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.e_mem_nPos
statement: lemma e_mem_nPos (i : ι) : e P i ∈ nPos P
proof: := ⟨FreeLieAlgebra.of K i, eHom_of P i⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_mem_nNeg
statement: lemma lie_h_mem_nNeg (a : H) {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nNeg P) : ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ nNeg P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_fHom P a y
  exact ⟨y', show π P _ = ⁅h P a, π P _⁆ by
    rw [← π_h, ← LieHom.map_lie]; exact congrArg (π P) hy'.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_mem_nPos
statement: lemma lie_h_mem_nPos (a : H) {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nPos P) : ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ nPos P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_eHom P a z
  exact ⟨z', show π P _ = ⁅h P a, π P _⁆ by
    rw [← π_h, ← LieHom.map_lie]; exact congrArg (π P) hz'.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_cartan
statement: lemma mem_cartan {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} : x ∈ cartan P ↔ ∃ a, h P a = x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartan_toSubmodule
statement: @[simp] lemma cartan_toSubmodule : (cartan P).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range (h P)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_nPos_of_mem_sup
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, n, hn, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, n', hn', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy
  rw [add_lie, lie_add, lie_add, lie_h_h, zero_add, ← lie_skew n (h P b)]
  exact add_mem (lie_h_mem_nPos P a hn') (add_mem (neg_mem (lie_h_mem_nPos P b hn))
    ((nPos P).lie_mem hn hn'))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.borel_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] lemma borel_toSubmodule :
    (borel P).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range (h P) ⊔ (nPos P).toSubmodule
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_borel
statement:
lemma mem_borel {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} :
    x ∈ borel P ↔ ∃ a, ∃ n ∈ nPos P, h P a + n = x
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ LinearMap.range (h P) ⊔ (nPos P).toSubmodule ↔ _
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup]
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_range, exists_exists_eq_and]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.h_mem_borel
statement: lemma h_mem_borel (a : H) : h P a ∈ borel P
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_sup_left (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ a)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nPos_le_borel
statement: lemma nPos_le_borel : nPos P ≤ borel P
proof: := fun _ hx ↦ Submodule.mem_sup_right hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartan_le_borel
statement: lemma cartan_le_borel : cartan P ≤ borel P
proof: := fun _ hx ↦ Submodule.mem_sup_left hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.e_mem_borel
statement: lemma e_mem_borel (i : ι) : e P i ∈ borel P
proof: := nPos_le_borel P (e_mem_nPos P i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_nPos_of_mem_borel
statement:
lemma lie_mem_nPos_of_mem_borel {x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ borel P)
    (hy : y ∈ borel P) : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ nPos P
proof:
:=
  lie_mem_nPos_of_mem_sup P hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCompl_nNeg_borel
statement: theorem isCompl_nNeg_borel : IsCompl (nNeg P).toSubmodule (borel P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr fun x hx hx' ↦ ?_,
    Submodule.codisjoint_iff_exists_add_eq.mpr fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨a, _, ⟨z, rfl⟩, hyz⟩ := (mem_borel P).mp hx'
    change h P a + eHom P z = fHom P y at hyz
    have := triangular_eq_zero P (y := y) (a := -a) (z := -z) (by
      rw [map_neg, map_neg, ← hyz]; abel)
    exact this.1
  · obtain ⟨y, a, z, rfl⟩ := exists_triangular P x
    exact ⟨fHom P y, h P a + eHom P z, ⟨y, rfl⟩, (mem_borel P).mpr ⟨a, _, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
      (add_assoc _ _ _).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCompl_range_h_nNeg_sup_nPos
statement:
theorem isCompl_range_h_nNeg_sup_nPos :
    IsCompl (LinearMap.range (h P)) ((nNeg P).toSubmodule ⊔ (nPos P).toSubmodule)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr fun x hx hx' ↦ ?_,
    Submodule.codisjoint_iff_exists_add_eq.mpr fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, _, ⟨z, rfl⟩, hyz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx'
    change fHom P y + eHom P z = h P a at hyz
    have := triangular_eq_zero P (y := y) (a := -a) (z := z) (by
      rw [map_neg, add_right_comm, hyz, add_neg_cancel])
    rw [neg_eq_zero.mp this.2.1, map_zero]
  · obtain ⟨y, a, z, rfl⟩ := exists_triangular P x
    exact ⟨h P a, fHom P y + eHom P z, ⟨a, rfl⟩,
      Submodule.add_mem_sup ⟨y, rfl⟩ ⟨z, rfl⟩, by abel⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartanProj_h
statement: @[simp] lemma cartanProj_h (a : H) : cartanProj P (h P a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartanProj, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_left _
    (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ a), LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartanProj_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cartanProj_eq_zero {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ (nNeg P).toSubmodule ⊔ (nPos P).toSubmodule) : cartanProj P x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartanProj, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_right _ hx,
    map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartanProj_of_mem_nNeg
statement: lemma cartanProj_of_mem_nNeg {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nNeg P) : cartanProj P x = 0
proof:
:=
  cartanProj_eq_zero P (Submodule.mem_sup_left hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartanProj_of_mem_nPos
statement: lemma cartanProj_of_mem_nPos {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nPos P) : cartanProj P x = 0
proof:
:=
  cartanProj_eq_zero P (Submodule.mem_sup_right hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nPos_toSubmodule_eq
statement: theorem nPos_toSubmodule_eq : (nPos P).toSubmodule = ⨆ μ ∈ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (π P).toLinearMap) (AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_mem P z)
    simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, ← rootSpace_eq_map] at this
    exact this
  · rw [rootSpace_eq_map]
    refine (Submodule.map_mono (AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_pos_le P hμ)).trans ?_
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNeg_toSubmodule_eq
statement: theorem nNeg_toSubmodule_eq : (nNeg P).toSubmodule = ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (π P).toLinearMap) (AuxLieAlgebra.fHom_mem P y)
    simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, ← rootSpace_eq_map] at this
    exact this
  · rw [rootSpace_eq_map]
    refine (Submodule.map_mono (AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_le P hμ)).trans ?_
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_add_iff
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.character_eq_add_iff (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hV' : IsCategoryO P V')
    (hV'' : IsCategoryO P V'') :
    hV.character = hV'.character + hV''.character ↔
      ∀ μ, hV.multiplicity μ = hV'.multiplicity μ + hV''.multiplicity μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hV.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, hV'.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter,
    hV''.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, ← map_add,
    sumIrreducibleCharacter_injective.eq_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h μ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ CharacterRing.ext fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.coeffAt μ) h
    simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities, CharacterRing.coeffAt,
      HahnSeries.coeff_add] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  · simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities, CharacterRing.coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_add]
    exact_mod_cast h μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.denominator_mul_character_tensorProduct_verma
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.denominator_mul_character_tensorProduct_verma (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (Λ : Dual K H) :
    denominator P * (hZ.tensorProduct (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ)).character =
      CharacterRing.exp P ℤ Λ * hZ.character
proof:
:= by
  rw [hZ.character_tensorProduct (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ), mul_left_comm,
    VermaModule.denominator_mul_character, mul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.character_casimirBlock_eq_add
statement:
theorem character_casimirBlock_eq_add (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hV' : IsCategoryO P V')
    (hV'' : IsCategoryO P V'') (h : hV.character = hV'.character + hV''.character) (c : K) :
    (hV.lieSubmodule (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c)).character =
      (hV'.lieSubmodule (hB.casimirBlock hA hV'.isPosFinite c)).character +
        (hV''.lieSubmodule (hB.casimirBlock hA hV''.isPosFinite c)).character
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [IsCategoryO.character_eq_add_iff] at h ⊢
  intro μ
  rw [hB.multiplicity_casimirBlock hA hV, hB.multiplicity_casimirBlock hA hV',
    hB.multiplicity_casimirBlock hA hV'']
  split_ifs
  · exact h μ
  · rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.isCategoryO_translation
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_translation (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (c c' : K) :
    IsCategoryO P (hB.translation hA hZ hV c c')
proof:
:=
  (hZ.tensorProduct (hV.lieSubmodule _)).lieSubmodule _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.character_translation_eq_add
statement:
theorem character_translation_eq_add (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hV' : IsCategoryO P V') (hV'' : IsCategoryO P V'')
    (h : hV.character = hV'.character + hV''.character) (c c' : K) :
    (hB.isCategoryO_translation hA hZ hV c c').character =
      (hB.isCategoryO_translation hA hZ hV' c c').character +
        (hB.isCategoryO_translation hA hZ hV'' c c').character
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hB.character_casimirBlock_eq_add hA hV hV' hV'' h c
  have h2 : (hZ.tensorProduct (hV.lieSubmodule (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c))).character =
      (hZ.tensorProduct (hV'.lieSubmodule (hB.casimirBlock hA hV'.isPosFinite c))).character +
        (hZ.tensorProduct
          (hV''.lieSubmodule (hB.casimirBlock hA hV''.isPosFinite c))).character := by
    rw [hZ.character_tensorProduct (hV.lieSubmodule _),
      hZ.character_tensorProduct (hV'.lieSubmodule _),
      hZ.character_tensorProduct (hV''.lieSubmodule _), h1, mul_add]
  exact hB.character_casimirBlock_eq_add hA (hZ.tensorProduct (hV.lieSubmodule _))
    (hZ.tensorProduct (hV'.lieSubmodule _)) (hZ.tensorProduct (hV''.lieSubmodule _)) h2 c'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.character_translation_eq_add_quotient
statement:
theorem character_translation_eq_add_quotient (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) (c c' : K) :
    (hB.isCategoryO_translation hA hZ hV c c').character =
      (hB.isCategoryO_translation hA hZ (hV.lieSubmodule N) c c').character +
        (hB.isCategoryO_translation hA hZ (hV.quotient N) c c').character
proof:
:=
  hB.character_translation_eq_add hA hZ hV _ _ (hV.character_eq_add N _ _) c c'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCompl_nSum_range_h
statement: lemma isCompl_nSum_range_h : IsCompl (nSum P) (LinearMap.range (h P))
proof:
:=
  (isCompl_range_h_nNeg_sup_nPos P).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nSumProj_apply_coe
statement: lemma nSumProj_apply_coe (x : nSum P) : nSumProj P x = x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_left _ x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nSumProj_of_mem
statement: lemma nSumProj_of_mem {x : 𝔤} (hx : x ∈ nSum P) : (nSumProj P x : 𝔤) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [nSumProj, Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_left _ hx]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_mem_nSum
statement: lemma lie_h_mem_nSum (a : H) {x : 𝔤} (hx : x ∈ nSum P) : ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ nSum P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
  rw [lie_add]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (lie_h_mem_nNeg P a hy) (lie_h_mem_nPos P a hz)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nSumVec_inl
statement: lemma nSumVec_inl (i : NegRootIndex P) : nSumVec P (Sum.inl i) = nNegBasis P i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nSumVec_inr
statement:
lemma nSumVec_inr (i : NegRootIndex P) :
    nSumVec P (Sum.inr i) = chevalleyInvolution P (nNegBasis P i)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.span_nNegBasis
statement:
lemma span_nNegBasis :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ (nNegBasis P i : 𝔤)) = (nNeg P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Submodule.map (nNeg P).toSubmodule.subtype) (nNegBasis P).span_eq
  rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype] at h
  exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.linearIndependent_nSumVec
statement: lemma linearIndependent_nSumVec : LinearIndependent K (nSumVec P)
proof:
:= by
  have hNeg : LinearIndependent K fun i ↦ (nNegBasis P i : 𝔤) :=
    (nNegBasis P).linearIndependent.map' (nNeg P).toSubmodule.subtype
      (Submodule.ker_subtype _)
  have hPos : LinearIndependent K fun i ↦ chevalleyInvolution P (nNegBasis P i) :=
    hNeg.map' (chevalleyInvolution P).toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr
      (Function.LeftInverse.injective (chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution P)))
  refine LinearIndependent.sum_type hNeg hPos ?_
  refine ((isCompl_nNeg_borel P).disjoint.mono_right fun x hx ↦ nPos_le_borel P hx).mono ?_ ?_
  · exact (span_nNegBasis P).le
  · exact Submodule.span_le.mpr (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun i ↦
      chevalleyInvolution_mem_nPos P (nNegBasis P i).2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.span_nSumVec
statement: lemma span_nSumVec : Submodule.span K (Set.range (nSumVec P)) = nSum P
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.mpr (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun j ↦ ?_))
    (sup_le ?_ fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · rcases j with i | i
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (nNegBasis P i).2
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (chevalleyInvolution_mem_nPos P (nNegBasis P i).2)
  · rw [← span_nNegBasis]
    exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩)
  · have hω : chevalleyInvolution P x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ (nNegBasis P i : 𝔤)) :=
      (span_nNegBasis P).ge (chevalleyInvolution_mem_nNeg P hx)
    have hx' : x ∈ Submodule.span K
        (Set.range fun i ↦ chevalleyInvolution P (nNegBasis P i : 𝔤)) := by
      have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (chevalleyInvolution P).toLinearMap) hω
      rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at this
      simpa [Function.comp_def, chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution] using this
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ hx'
    exact Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inr i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coe_nSumBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_nSumBasis (j : NegRootIndex P ⊕ NegRootIndex P) :
    (nSumBasis P j : 𝔤) = nSumVec P j
proof:
:= by
  simp [nSumBasis, Basis.span_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_nSumVec
statement:
lemma lie_h_nSumVec (a : H) (j : NegRootIndex P ⊕ NegRootIndex P) :
    ⁅h P a, nSumVec P j⁆ = nSumWt P j a • nSumVec P j
proof:
:= by
  rcases j with i | i
  · simpa [nSumVec_inl, nSumWt] using nNegBasis_mem P i a
  · have h1 : ⁅h P a, (nNegBasis P i : 𝔤)⁆ = (-i.root) a • (nNegBasis P i : 𝔤) :=
      nNegBasis_mem P i a
    rw [nSumVec_inr, ← chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution P (h P a), ← LieHom.map_lie,
      chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_lie, h1, map_neg, map_smul]
    simp [nSumWt]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isRelData_relAction
statement:
lemma isRelData_relAction : RelativeKoszul.IsRelData (h P) (relAction P Λ μ) (nSumProj P) where
  D_eq _
proof:
:= rfl
  φ_eq _ _ := rfl
  lie_eta := lie_h_h P
  map_eta a :=
    Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_right (isCompl_nSum_range_h P)
      ⟨h P a, LinearMap.mem_range_self _ a⟩
  sub_mem y := by
    have : y - (nSumProj P y : 𝔤) ∈ LinearMap.range (h P) := by
      rw [← Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_eq_zero_iff (isCompl_nSum_range_h P)]
      change nSumProj P (y - (nSumProj P y : 𝔤)) = 0
      rw [map_sub, nSumProj_apply_coe, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this
    exact ⟨a, ha.symm⟩
  map_ad a y := by
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ : ∃ a', y - (nSumProj P y : 𝔤) = h P a' := by
      have : y - (nSumProj P y : 𝔤) ∈ LinearMap.range (h P) := by
        rw [← Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_eq_zero_iff (isCompl_nSum_range_h P)]
        change nSumProj P (y - (nSumProj P y : 𝔤)) = 0
        rw [map_sub, nSumProj_apply_coe, sub_self]
      obtain ⟨a', h'⟩ := this
      exact ⟨a', h'.symm⟩
    have hy : y = (nSumProj P y : 𝔤) + h P a' := by rw [← ha', add_sub_cancel]
    have hmem := lie_h_mem_nSum P a (nSumProj P y).2
    conv_lhs => rw [hy, lie_add, lie_h_h, add_zero]
    exact nSumProj_of_mem P hmem

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.omegaCoord_lie
statement:
lemma omegaCoord_lie (x : 𝔤) (q : MvPolynomial (NegRootIndex P) K) :
    omegaCoord P μ ⁅x, (omegaCoord P μ).symm q⁆ =
      VermaModule.vermaCoord P μ ⁅chevalleyInvolution P x, (VermaModule.vermaCoord P μ).symm q⁆
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isLeading_relCoord
statement: lemma isLeading_relCoord : RelativeKoszul.IsLeading (relCoord P Λ μ) (nSumBasis P)
proof:
:= by
  refine RelativeKoszul.isLeading_tensorCoord _ _ _ (fun j n q hq ↦ ?_) (fun j n q hq ↦ ?_)
    (fun j n q hq ↦ ?_) (fun j n q hq ↦ ?_)
  · rw [coe_nSumBasis, nSumVec_inl]
    exact VermaModule.vermaCoord_lie_nNegBasis_sub_mem P Λ j n hq
  · rw [coe_nSumBasis, nSumVec_inl, omegaCoord_lie]
    exact VermaModule.vermaCoord_lie_mem_of_mem_borel P μ
      (nPos_le_borel P (chevalleyInvolution_mem_nPos P (nNegBasis P j).2)) hq
  · rw [coe_nSumBasis, nSumVec_inr]
    exact VermaModule.vermaCoord_lie_mem_of_mem_borel P Λ
      (nPos_le_borel P (chevalleyInvolution_mem_nPos P (nNegBasis P j).2)) hq
  · rw [coe_nSumBasis, nSumVec_inr, omegaCoord_lie, chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution]
    exact VermaModule.vermaCoord_lie_nNegBasis_sub_mem P μ j n hq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.monoWt_nSumWt_inl
statement:
lemma monoWt_nSumWt_inl (m : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    RelativeKoszul.monoWt (nSumWt P ∘ Sum.inl) m = -negRootWt P m
proof:
:= by
  simp [RelativeKoszul.monoWt, negRootWt, nSumWt, Finsupp.sum]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.monoWt_nSumWt_inr
statement:
lemma monoWt_nSumWt_inr (m : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    RelativeKoszul.monoWt (nSumWt P ∘ Sum.inr) m = negRootWt P m
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isWeightCoord_relCoord
statement:
lemma isWeightCoord_relCoord :
    RelativeKoszul.IsWeightCoord (nSumBasis P) (nSumWt P) (relAction P Λ μ) (relCoord P Λ μ)
      (Λ + -μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine RelativeKoszul.isWeightCoord_tensorCoord _ _ _ (fun a j ↦ ?_) (fun a m ↦ ?_)
    (fun a m ↦ ?_)
  · rw [coe_nSumBasis]
    exact lie_h_nSumVec P a j
  · rw [monoWt_nSumWt_inl, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact VermaModule.vermaCoord_symm_monomial_mem_weightSpace P Λ m a
  · rw [monoWt_nSumWt_inr]
    change OmegaTwist.of P _ ⁅chevalleyInvolution P (h P a),
      (VermaModule.vermaCoord P μ).symm (monomial m 1)⁆ = _
    rw [chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_lie,
      VermaModule.vermaCoord_symm_monomial_mem_weightSpace P μ m a, map_neg, map_smul]
    change -(((μ - negRootWt P m) a) • _) = ((-μ + negRootWt P m) a) • _
    rw [← neg_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply]
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relPairing_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma relPairing_tmul (n : RelN P Λ μ) (m : VermaModule P Λ)
    (y : OmegaTwist P (VermaModule P μ)) :
    relPairing P Λ μ n (m ⊗ₜ y) = dualPairing P _ (n m) y
proof:
:= by
  simp [relPairing]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relPairing_lie
statement:
lemma relPairing_lie (x : 𝔤) (n : RelN P Λ μ) (z : RelX P Λ μ) :
    relPairing P Λ μ ⁅x, n⁆ z = -relPairing P Λ μ n ⁅x, z⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul m y =>
    rw [relPairing_tmul, LieHom.lie_apply, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, dualPairing_lie,
      TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, map_add, relPairing_tmul, relPairing_tmul]
    ring
  | add z z' h h' => rw [map_add, h, h', lie_add, map_add, neg_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relPairing_injective
statement: lemma relPairing_injective : Function.Injective (relPairing P Λ μ)
proof:
:= fun n n' hnn' ↦
  LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ dualPairing_injective P (LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ by
    simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun hnn' (m ⊗ₜ y))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_range_relPairing
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ s, ∃ d, dualPairing P (VermaModule P μ) d =
      ψ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ _ (VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma P Λ s) := fun s ↦ by
    refine mem_range_dualPairing P (γ := γ - (Λ - negRootWt P s)) fun a y ↦ ?_
    have h1 := hψ a (VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma P Λ s ⊗ₜ y)
    rw [DerivAction.ofMap_φ, TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right,
      VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace P Λ s a, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_add,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h1
    simp only [nPosDerivAction_φ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply,
      LinearMap.sub_apply]
    linear_combination h1
  choose d hd using hs
  refine ⟨(VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma P Λ).constr K d,
    TensorProduct.ext ((VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma P Λ).ext fun s ↦ LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ ?_)⟩
  simpa [Basis.constr_basis] using LinearMap.congr_fun (hd s) y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_δ_eq_relVerma
proof:
:= by
  have hr := isRelData_relAction P Λ μ
  have hw := isWeightCoord_relCoord P Λ μ
  have hL := RelativeKoszul.iSup_weightSpaceOf_D hr hw
  have hX := RelativeKoszul.iSup_weightSpaceOf_φ hw
  have hT := (relAction P Λ μ).iSup_chainWeightSpace hL hX
  exact DerivAction.exists_δ_eq_of_relExact (ρ := relAction P Λ μ)
    (ρN := DerivAction.ofMap (RelN P Λ μ) (h P)) (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
    (lie_h_h P) (relPairing_lie P Λ μ) (fun a n z ↦ relPairing_lie P Λ μ (h P a) n z)
    (relPairing_injective P Λ μ) (fun _ _ hψ ↦ mem_range_relPairing P Λ μ hψ) hL hX
    (fun t ht hdt ↦ RelativeKoszul.relExact (hp := nSumProj_apply_coe P) (hT := hT)
      (isLeading_relCoord P Λ μ) hr hw t ht hdt) hf hδ

name: SymmetricAlgebra.eval_affineLine
statement:
theorem eval_affineLine (Λ μ : Dual K H) (t : K) (p : SymmetricAlgebra K H) :
    Polynomial.eval t (affineLine Λ μ p) = lift (Λ + t • μ) p
proof:
:= by
  have he : (Polynomial.aeval t).comp (affineLine Λ μ) = lift (Λ + t • μ) := by
    apply algHom_ext
    ext h
    simpa [affineLine] using mul_comm (μ h) t
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he p

name: SymmetricAlgebra.lift_affine_eq_of_nat
statement:
theorem lift_affine_eq_of_nat [CharZero K] (p q : SymmetricAlgebra K H)
    (Λ μ Λ' μ' : Dual K H)
    (hn : ∀ n : ℕ, lift (Λ + (n : K) • μ) p = lift (Λ' + (n : K) • μ') q)
    (t : K) : lift (Λ + t • μ) p = lift (Λ' + t • μ') q
proof:
:= by
  have he : affineLine Λ μ p = affineLine Λ' μ' q := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
    apply (Set.infinite_range_of_injective (Nat.cast_injective (R := K))).mono
    rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩
    simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, eval_affineLine] using hn n
  simpa only [eval_affineLine] using congrArg (Polynomial.eval t) he

name: SymmetricAlgebra.lift_affinePullback
statement:
theorem lift_affinePullback (f : H →ₗ[K] H) (δ Λ : Dual K H)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra K H) :
    lift Λ (affinePullback f δ p) = lift (Λ.comp f + δ) p
proof:
:= by
  have he : (lift Λ).comp (affinePullback f δ) = lift (Λ.comp f + δ) := by
    apply algHom_ext
    ext h
    simp [affinePullback]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he p

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_harishChandra_reflection
statement:
theorem eval_harishChandra_reflection (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    (i : ι) (Λ : Dual K H) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)
      (harishChandra P z) = SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (harishChandra P z)
proof:
:= by
  let a : K := (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i)
  let ν : Dual K H := Λ - a • P.rho
  have hn : ∀ n : ℕ,
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift
        ((P.reflection hA i (ν + P.rho) - P.rho) +
          (n : K) • P.reflection hA i P.rho) (harishChandra P z) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (ν + (n : K) • P.rho) (harishChandra P z) := by
    intro n
    have hi : ((ν + (n : K) • P.rho) + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = (n : ℤ) := by
      simp only [ν, a, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        P.rho_coroot, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Int.cast_natCast]
      ring
    have hc := VermaModule.centralCharacter_reflection_of_integral P hA
      (Λ := ν + (n : K) • P.rho) i ⟨(n : ℤ), hi⟩
    have hw : P.reflection hA i (ν + (n : K) • P.rho + P.rho) - P.rho =
        (P.reflection hA i (ν + P.rho) - P.rho) +
          (n : K) • P.reflection hA i P.rho := by
      rw [map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_add]
      abel
    rw [← hw]
    exact (eval_harishChandraProjection_center P _ z).trans
      ((DFunLike.congr_fun hc z).trans (eval_harishChandraProjection_center P _ z).symm)
  have he := SymmetricAlgebra.lift_affine_eq_of_nat (harishChandra P z)
    (harishChandra P z) (P.reflection hA i (ν + P.rho) - P.rho)
    (P.reflection hA i P.rho) ν P.rho hn a
  have hr : ν + a • P.rho = Λ := sub_add_cancel Λ (a • P.rho)
  have hl : (P.reflection hA i (ν + P.rho) - P.rho) +
      a • P.reflection hA i P.rho = P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho := by
    rw [← hr]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul]
    abel
  rwa [hr, hl] at he

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_reflection
statement:
theorem VermaModule.centralCharacter_reflection (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    (i : ι) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    VermaModule.centralCharacter P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) =
      VermaModule.centralCharacter P Λ
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  exact (eval_harishChandraProjection_center P _ z).symm.trans
    ((eval_harishChandra_reflection P hA i Λ z).trans
      (eval_harishChandraProjection_center P _ z))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl
statement:
theorem VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    VermaModule.centralCharacter P (w (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) =
      VermaModule.centralCharacter P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA (p := fun w ↦
    VermaModule.centralCharacter P (w (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) =
      VermaModule.centralCharacter P Λ) (by simp) (fun i w ih ↦ ?_) hw
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
  have he := VermaModule.centralCharacter_reflection P hA i (w (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using he.trans ih

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_harishChandra_weyl
statement:
theorem eval_harishChandra_weyl (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (Λ : Dual K H) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (w (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) (harishChandra P z) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (harishChandra P z)
proof:
:=
  (eval_harishChandraProjection_center P _ z).trans
    ((DFunLike.congr_fun (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA hw Λ) z).trans
      (eval_harishChandraProjection_center P _ z).symm)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandra_dot_reflection
statement:
theorem harishChandra_dot_reflection (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    (i : ι) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap
      (P.rho.comp (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap - P.rho) (harishChandra P z) =
        harishChandra P z
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.eq_of_lift_eq
  intro Λ
  rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_affinePullback]
  have hw : Λ.comp (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap +
      (P.rho.comp (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap - P.rho) =
      P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho := by
    ext h
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe, P.reflection_apply_apply]
    ring
  rw [hw]
  exact eval_harishChandra_reflection P hA i Λ z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_shiftedHarishChandra
statement:
theorem eval_shiftedHarishChandra (μ : Dual K H) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift μ (shiftedHarishChandra P z) =
      VermaModule.centralCharacter P (μ - P.rho) z
proof:
:= by
  change SymmetricAlgebra.lift μ
    (SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback LinearMap.id (-P.rho) (harishChandra P z)) = _
  rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_affinePullback, LinearMap.comp_id, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact eval_harishChandraProjection_center P _ z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_shiftedHarishChandra_weyl
statement:
theorem eval_shiftedHarishChandra_weyl (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (μ : Dual K H) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (w μ) (shiftedHarishChandra P z) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift μ (shiftedHarishChandra P z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_shiftedHarishChandra, eval_shiftedHarishChandra]
  have he := DFunLike.congr_fun (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA hw (μ - P.rho)) z
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using he

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.shiftedHarishChandra_reflection
statement:
theorem shiftedHarishChandra_reflection (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    (i : ι) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap 0
      (shiftedHarishChandra P z) = shiftedHarishChandra P z
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.eq_of_lift_eq
  intro μ
  rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_affinePullback, add_zero]
  have he : μ.comp (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap = P.reflection hA i μ := by
    ext h
    exact (P.reflection_apply_apply hA i μ h).symm
  rw [he]
  exact eval_shiftedHarishChandra_weyl P hA (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i) μ z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isStdFiltered_of_equiv
statement:
theorem isStdFiltered_of_equiv {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} {μ : Dual K H}
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) : IsStdFiltered P N {μ}
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X)) :=
    (LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot _).mp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker ⊥)
  exact IsStdFiltered.step IsStdFiltered.bot bot_le
    ⟨e.trans (LieSubmodule.equivMapOfInjective N hinj)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isStdFiltered_range_of_injective
statement:
theorem isStdFiltered_range_of_injective {μ : Dual K H} (φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) : IsStdFiltered P φ.range {μ}
proof:
:=
  isStdFiltered_of_equiv P (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective
    (LieModuleHom.codRestrict φ.range φ fun m ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ _).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩)
    ⟨fun a b hab ↦ hφ (congrArg Subtype.val hab), fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ by
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ y).mp hy
      exact ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.eq_bot_of_zero
statement:
lemma IsStdFiltered.eq_bot_of_zero {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N 0) :
    N = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  generalize hs : (0 : Multiset (Dual K H)) = s at hN
  cases hN with
  | bot => rfl
  | step _ _ _ => exact absurd hs.symm (Multiset.cons_ne_zero)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.map_of_injOn
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => simpa using IsStdFiltered.bot (P := P) (X := Y)
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ μ hN₀ h01 he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    refine IsStdFiltered.step (ih (h01.trans hNB)) (LieSubmodule.map_mono h01) ⟨e.trans ?_⟩
    have hker : N₀ ≤ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N₀.map g)).comp g).ker := fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hx
    set ψ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift N₀ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N₀.map g)).comp g) hker
    have hψmk (x : X) : ψ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀ x) =
        LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N₀.map g) (g x) := rfl
    have hmap : (N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)).map ψ =
        (N₁.map g).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N₀.map g)) := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.map_comp, ← LieSubmodule.map_comp]
      rfl
    refine (equivMapOfInjOn ψ _ fun y hy hψy ↦ ?_).trans (equivLieSubmoduleOfEq hmap)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hy
    rw [hψmk, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hψy
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hgx₀⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hψy
    have hsub : x₀ - x = 0 :=
      hg _ (B.sub_mem (hNB (h01 hx₀)) (hNB hx)) (by rw [map_sub, hgx₀, sub_self])
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    rwa [sub_eq_zero.mp hsub] at hx₀

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.comap_mk
proof:
:= by
  induction hT with
  | bot =>
    have : (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (X ⧸ R)).comap (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) = R := by
      ext x
      simp
    simpa [this] using hR
  | @step T₀ T₁ t₀ μ hT₀ h01 he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    rw [Multiset.cons_add]
    refine IsStdFiltered.step ih (fun x hx ↦ h01 hx) ⟨e.trans ?_⟩
    set C₀ := T₀.comap (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R)
    have hker : C₀ ≤ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' T₀).comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R)).ker :=
      fun x hx ↦ by
        rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
        exact hx
    set χ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift C₀
      ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' T₀).comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R)) hker
    have hχ : Function.Injective χ := by
      rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' C₀ y
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker] at hy
      change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' T₀ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R x) = 0 at hy
      rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hy
      rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact hy
    have hmap : ((T₁.comap (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R)).map
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' C₀)).map χ = T₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' T₀) := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.map_comp]
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R x, hx, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' R z
        exact ⟨x, hz, rfl⟩
    exact ((LieSubmodule.equivMapOfInjective _ hχ).trans (equivLieSubmoduleOfEq hmap)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.exists_mem_cone
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => exact absurd ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot x).mp hxN) hx0
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ μ hN₀ h01 he ih =>
    by_cases hx₀ : x ∈ N₀
    · obtain ⟨ν, hν, hκ⟩ := ih hx₀
      exact ⟨ν, Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν, hκ⟩
    · obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
      refine ⟨μ, Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _, ?_⟩
      set ι' : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X ⧸ N₀ :=
        (N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)).incl.comp e.toLieModuleHom
      have hι' : Function.Injective ι' := fun a b hab ↦ e.injective (Subtype.ext hab)
      have hmem : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀ x ∈ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀) :=
        LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hxN
      set m := e.symm ⟨_, hmem⟩
      have hιm : ι' m = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀ x := by simp [ι', m]
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx₀
        rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← hιm, h0, map_zero]
      have hmw : m ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) κ :=
        mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_injective P ι' hι' (by
          rw [hιm]; exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀) hxw)
      by_contra hκ
      have hbot := weightSpace_eq_bot P μ (μ := κ) fun k hk h ↦ hκ ⟨k, hk, h⟩
      exact hm0 ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp (hbot ▸ hmw))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.lie_e_eq_zero_of_maximal
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hcone⟩ := hN.exists_mem_cone P (N.lie_mem hvN) (toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace i hvw)
    hne
  have h1 : Λ ∈ cone P (Λ + P.root i) := ⟨Pi.single i 1, Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one,
    by rw [rootOf_single]; abel⟩
  have hΛμ := hmax μ hμ (mem_cone_trans h1 hcone)
  subst hΛμ
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkΛ⟩ := hcone
  have h2 : P.rootOf (k + Pi.single i 1) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [map_add, rootOf_single, map_zero]
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_assoc, add_eq_left] at hkΛ
    rw [add_comm]; exact hkΛ
  have h3 := congrFun (P.rootOf_injective h2) i
  have h4 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k i := hk i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply] at h3
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.verma_of_maximal
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.verma_of_maximal [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X}
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hmax : ∀ μ ∈ s, Λ ∈ cone P μ → Λ = μ) {v : X} (hv : v ∈ primitiveVectors P X Λ)
    (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hvN : v ∈ N) :
    Λ ∈ s ∧ Function.Injective ((homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨v, hv⟩) ∧
      ((homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨v, hv⟩).range ≤ N ∧
      IsStdFiltered P (N.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' ((homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨v, hv⟩).range))
        (s.erase Λ)
proof:
:= by
  set φ := (homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hφv : φ (hwv P Λ) = v := congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P X Λ).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  set R := φ.range
  have hRle {M : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} (hvM : v ∈ M) : R ≤ M := by
    change φ.range ≤ M
    rw [VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan, hφv, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact hvM
  have hvw : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ := (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hv).1
  induction hN with
  | bot => exact absurd ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot v).mp hvN) hv0
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ μ hN₀ h01 he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    by_cases hvN₀ : v ∈ N₀
    · obtain ⟨hΛ, hinj, -, hfilt⟩ :=
        ih (fun μ' hμ' ↦ hmax μ' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hμ')) hvN₀
      have hRN₀ := hRle hvN₀
      refine ⟨Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hΛ, hinj, hRle hvN, ?_⟩
      have hs : (μ ::ₘ s₀).erase Λ = μ ::ₘ s₀.erase Λ := by
        by_cases hμΛ : μ = Λ
        · subst hμΛ; rw [Multiset.erase_cons_head, Multiset.cons_erase hΛ]
        · exact Multiset.erase_cons_tail s₀ hμΛ
      rw [hs]
      refine IsStdFiltered.step hfilt (LieSubmodule.map_mono h01) ⟨e.trans ?_⟩
      have hker : N₀ ≤ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N₀.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R))).comp
          (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R)).ker := fun x hx ↦ by
        rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
        exact LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hx
      set ψ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift N₀ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'
        (N₀.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R))).comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R)) hker
      have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := by
        rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
        intro y hy
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N₀ y
        rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker] at hy
        change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N₀.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R))
          (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R x) = 0 at hy
        rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hy
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hxx₀⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hy
        have hd : x₀ - x ∈ R := by
          rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub, hxx₀, sub_self]
        rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
        simpa using N₀.sub_mem hx₀ (hRN₀ hd)
      have hmap : (N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)).map ψ =
          (N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R)).map
            (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N₀.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R))) := by
        rw [← LieSubmodule.map_comp, ← LieSubmodule.map_comp]
        rfl
      exact (LieSubmodule.equivMapOfInjective _ hψ).trans (equivLieSubmoduleOfEq hmap)
    · set ι' : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X ⧸ N₀ :=
        (N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)).incl.comp e.toLieModuleHom
      have hι' : Function.Injective ι' := fun a b hab ↦ e.injective (Subtype.ext hab)
      have hrange (y : X ⧸ N₀) (hy : y ∈ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)) :
          ∃ m, ι' m = y := ⟨e.symm ⟨y, hy⟩, by simp [ι']⟩
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hrange _ (LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hvN)
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        rw [map_zero, eq_comm, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hm
        exact hvN₀ hm
      have hmw : m ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) Λ :=
        mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_injective P ι' hι' (by
          rw [hm]; exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀) hvw)
      have hΛμ : Λ = μ := by
        refine hmax μ (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _) ?_
        by_contra hκ
        have hbot := weightSpace_eq_bot P μ (μ := Λ) fun k hk h ↦ hκ ⟨k, hk, h⟩
        exact hm0 ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp (hbot ▸ hmw))
      subst hΛμ
      have hm' : m ∈ K ∙ hwv P Λ := by rw [← weightSpace_self]; exact hmw
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hm'
      have hc : c ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hm0 (zero_smul K _)
      have hcomp : (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀).comp φ = c • ι' := by
        refine hom_ext P Λ ?_
        rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hφv]
        change _ = c • ι' (hwv P Λ)
        rw [← map_smul, hm]
      have hφι (a : VermaModule P Λ) : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀ (φ a) = c • ι' a :=
        LieModuleHom.congr_fun hcomp a
      have hinj : Function.Injective φ := fun a b hab ↦ by
        have := hφι a
        rw [hab, hφι b] at this
        exact hι' (smul_right_injective _ hc this.symm)
      refine ⟨Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _, hinj, hRle hvN, ?_⟩
      rw [Multiset.erase_cons_head]
      
      have hN₁ : N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) = N₀.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) := by
        refine le_antisymm ?_ (LieSubmodule.map_mono h01)
        rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := hrange _ (LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hn)
        have hmem : n - φ (c⁻¹ • m') ∈ N₀ := by
          rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub, hφι, map_smul, smul_smul,
            mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul, hm', sub_self]
        refine ⟨n - φ (c⁻¹ • m'), hmem, ?_⟩
        have h0 : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R (φ (c⁻¹ • m')) = 0 :=
          (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero R).mpr ((LieModuleHom.mem_range φ _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩)
        change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R (n - φ (c⁻¹ • m')) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R n
        rw [map_sub, h0, sub_zero]
      rw [hN₁]
      refine hN₀.map_of_injOn P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) (B := N₀) (fun x hx hx0 ↦ ?_) le_rfl
      rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx0
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ x).mp hx0
      have h0 : c • ι' a = 0 := by
        rw [← hφι, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]; exact hx
      have ha : a = 0 := hι' (by rw [map_zero]; exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left hc)
      rw [ha, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_maximal_mem
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_mem {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Λ ∈ s, ∀ μ ∈ s, Λ ∈ cone P μ → Λ = μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ := (s.toFinset.image (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P)).exists_minimal
    (by simpa [Finset.image_nonempty, Multiset.toFinset_nonempty] using hs)
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
  refine ⟨Λ, Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hΛ, fun μ hμ hΛμ ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 : WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P μ ≤ WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P Λ :=
    (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr hΛμ
  have h2 := hmin (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hμ)) h1
  exact eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hΛμ
    ((WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mp h2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.exists_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 := hs.count_eq_coinvDim P hX Λ
  have h2 : 0 < s.count Λ := Multiset.count_pos.mpr hΛ
  rw [h1, coinvDim] at h2
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hbot : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ = ⊥ := by
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    rintro v ⟨-, hv⟩
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr (hcon v hv)
  rw [(LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hbot).finrank_eq, finrank_bot] at h2
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isStdFiltered_range
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_range (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {X : Type u} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
      [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X], IsCategoryO P X → ∀ s : Multiset (Dual K H),
      Multiset.card s = n → IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) s →
      ∀ p : X →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X, p.comp p = p → ∃ t, IsStdFiltered P p.range t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro X _ _ _ _ hX s hsn hs p hp
  have hpp (x : X) : p (p x) = p x := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hp x
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · subst hs0
    have htop := hs.eq_bot_of_zero
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    have : p.range = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) := trivial
      rw [htop, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hx
      simp [hx]
    rw [this]
    exact IsStdFiltered.bot
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛs, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_mem P hs0
  obtain ⟨v, hvw, hv0⟩ := hs.exists_ne_zero P hX hΛs
  have hcard : Multiset.card (s.erase Λ) < n := by
    have : 0 < Multiset.card s := Multiset.card_pos.mpr hs0
    rw [Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hΛs, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
    omega
  have hprim (w : X) (hw : w ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ) : w ∈ primitiveVectors P X Λ :=
    mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hw, fun i ↦ hs.lie_e_eq_zero_of_maximal P hmax trivial hw i⟩
  
  have key (w : X) (hw : w ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ) (hw0 : w ≠ 0)
      (hpR : ∀ x ∈ ((homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨w, hprim w hw⟩).range,
        LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' ((homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨w, hprim w hw⟩).range (p x) = 0) :
      ∃ t, IsStdFiltered P (p.range.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'
        ((homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨w, hprim w hw⟩).range)) t := by
    set φ := (homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨w, hprim w hw⟩
    set R := φ.range
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hfilt⟩ := hs.verma_of_maximal P hmax (hprim w hw) hw0 trivial
    have hfilt' : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X ⧸ R)) (s.erase Λ) := by
      have : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) = ⊤ := by
        rw [LieModuleHom.map_top, LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
        exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' R
      rwa [this] at hfilt
    set q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift R ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R).comp p) fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply]; exact hpR x hx
    have hq (x : X) : q (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R x) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R (p x) := rfl
    have hqq : q.comp q = q := by
      ext y
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' R y
      rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hq, hq, hpp]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih _ hcard (hX.quotient R) (s.erase Λ) rfl hfilt' q hqq
    have hrange : q.range = p.range.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' R z
        exact ⟨p x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, (hq x).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R x, hq x⟩
    exact ⟨t, hrange ▸ ht⟩
  by_cases hpv : p v = 0
  · 
    set φ := (homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨v, hprim v hvw⟩
    have hφv : φ (hwv P Λ) = v :=
      congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P X Λ).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hprim v hvw⟩)
    have hRker : φ.range ≤ p.ker := by
      rw [VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan, hφv, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hpv
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := key v hvw hv0 fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp (hRker hx), map_zero]
    set g := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift φ.range p hRker
    have hg (x : X) : g (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range x) = p x := rfl
    have hmap : (p.range.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range)).map g = p.range := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.map_comp]
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨p x, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨p x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hpp x⟩
    refine ⟨t, hmap ▸ ht.map_of_injOn P g (B := p.range.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range))
      (fun y hy hgy ↦ ?_) le_rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    change p (p x) = 0 at hgy
    rw [hpp] at hgy
    change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range (p x) = 0
    rw [hgy, map_zero]
  · 
    have hpvw : p v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P p hvw
    set φ := (homEquiv P X Λ).symm ⟨p v, hprim (p v) hpvw⟩
    have hφv : φ (hwv P Λ) = p v :=
      congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P X Λ).apply_symm_apply ⟨p v, hprim (p v) hpvw⟩)
    have hRp : φ.range ≤ p.range := by
      rw [VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan, hφv, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
    have hpR : ∀ x ∈ φ.range, p x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hRp hx
      exact hpp y
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := key (p v) hpvw hpv fun x hx ↦ by
