      rw [hpR x hx, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]; exact hx
    obtain ⟨hΛ, hinj, -, -⟩ := hs.verma_of_maximal P hmax (hprim (p v) hpvw) hpv trivial
    have hext := (isStdFiltered_range_of_injective P φ hinj).comap_mk P ht
    have hcomap : (p.range.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range)).comap
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range) = p.range := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
        have hyx' : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range y = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range x :=
          hyx
        have hd : y - x ∈ φ.range := by
          rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub, hyx', sub_self]
        simpa using p.range.sub_mem hy (hRp hd)
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, hcomap ▸ hext⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isStdFiltered_range_add
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_range_add {X : Type u} [AddCommGroup X]
    [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    (hX : IsCategoryO P X) {s : Multiset (Dual K H)}
    (hs : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) s)
    (p : X →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X) (hp : p.comp p = p) :
    ∃ t t', IsStdFiltered P p.range t ∧ IsStdFiltered P p.ker t' ∧ s = t + t'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpp (x : X) : p (p x) = p x := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hp x
  set q : X →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X := LieModuleHom.id - p
  have hq (x : X) : q x = x - p x := rfl
  have hqq : q.comp q = q := by
    ext x
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hq, hq, map_sub, hpp, sub_self, sub_zero]
  have hqker : q.range = p.ker := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, hq, map_sub, hpp, sub_self]
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨x, by rw [hq, LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp hx, sub_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range P _ hX s rfl hs p hp
  obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range P _ hX s rfl hs q hqq
  rw [hqker] at ht'
  refine ⟨t, t', ht, ht', ?_⟩
  have hinj : ∀ x ∈ p.ker, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' p.range x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx hx0
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx0
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx0
    have := LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp hx
    rwa [hpp] at this
  have hT := ht'.map_of_injOn P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' p.range) hinj le_rfl
  have hext := ht.comap_mk P hT
  have htop : (p.ker.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' p.range)).comap
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' p.range) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    refine ⟨x - p x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change p (x - p x) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hpp, sub_self]
    · change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' p.range (x - p x) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' p.range x
      have : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' p.range (p x) = 0 :=
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rw [map_sub, this, sub_zero]
  rw [htop] at hext
  ext μ
  rw [hs.count_eq_coinvDim P hX, ← hext.count_eq_coinvDim P hX, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_congr_left
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_congr_left {M M' D : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] [AddCommGroup M'] [Module K M'] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M']
    [LieModule K 𝔤 M'] [AddCommGroup D] [Module K D] [LieRingModule 𝔤 D] [LieModule K 𝔤 D]
    (E : M ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M') : finrank K (M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ D) = finrank K (M' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ D)
proof:
:=
  (lieModuleHomCongr P E LieModuleEquiv.refl).finrank_eq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_range_eq_add
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_range_eq_add {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y] [LieModule K 𝔤 Y] (hY : IsCategoryO P Y)
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hs : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y) s)
    {e e₁ : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y} (he : e.comp e = e) (he₁ : e₁.comp e₁ = e₁) (hee₁ : e.comp e₁ = e₁)
    (he₁e : e₁.comp e = e₁) (ν : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν)) =
      finrank K (e₁.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν)) +
        finrank K ((e - e₁).range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hee (y : Y) : e (e y) = e y := LieModuleHom.congr_fun he y
  have hee₁' (y : Y) : e (e₁ y) = e₁ y := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hee₁ y
  have he₁e' (y : Y) : e₁ (e y) = e₁ y := LieModuleHom.congr_fun he₁e y
  have he₁e₁ (y : Y) : e₁ (e₁ y) = e₁ y := LieModuleHom.congr_fun he₁ y
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range P _ hY s rfl hs e he
  have hX : IsCategoryO P e.range := hY.lieSubmodule _
  have htX := isStdFiltered_top_range P he ht
  have hmem (y : e.range) : e₁ y ∈ e.range :=
    (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨e₁ y, hee₁' y⟩
  set p : e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ e.range := LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ (e₁.comp e.range.incl) hmem
  have hp (y : e.range) : (p y : Y) = e₁ y := rfl
  have hpp : p.comp p = p := LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ Subtype.ext <| by
    change e₁ (e₁ y) = e₁ y
    exact he₁e₁ y
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range_add P hX htX p hpp
  set q : e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ e.range := LieModuleHom.id - p
  have hq (y : e.range) : (q y : Y) = y - e₁ y := rfl
  have hqq : q.comp q = q := LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ Subtype.ext <| by
    change (q y : Y) - e₁ (q y) = q y
    rw [hq, map_sub, he₁e₁, sub_self, sub_zero]
  have hqk : q.range = p.ker := by
    ext x
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_range, LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change e₁ (q y : Y) = 0
      rw [hq, map_sub, he₁e₁, sub_self]
    · intro h
      refine ⟨x, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      rw [hq, ← hp, h]
      exact sub_zero _
  rw [← hqk] at hb
  have hinj : Function.Injective e.range.incl := Subtype.val_injective
  have hmap₁ : p.range.map e.range.incl = e₁.range := by
    ext y
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_map, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨p ⟨e z, (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩,
        (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change e₁ (e z) = e₁ z
      exact he₁e' z
  have hmap₂ : q.range.map e.range.incl = (e - e₁).range := by
    ext y
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_map, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨_, ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
      change e z - e₁ z = e z - e₁ (e z)
      rw [he₁e']
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨q ⟨e z, (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩,
        (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change e z - e₁ (e z) = e z - e₁ z
      rw [he₁e']
  have h0 := htX.count_eq_finrank_hom hX ν
  have h1 := ha.count_range_eq_finrank_hom P hpp (hX.lieSubmodule _) ν
  have h2 := hb.count_range_eq_finrank_hom P hqq (hX.lieSubmodule _) ν
  rw [finrank_hom_congr_left P (p.range.equivMapOfInjective hinj), hmap₁] at h1
  rw [finrank_hom_congr_left P (q.range.equivMapOfInjective hinj), hmap₂] at h2
  rw [← h0, ← h1, ← h2, hab, Multiset.count_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mul_list_sum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mul_list_sum_eq_zero {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y] [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 Y] (a : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) (l : List (Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y))
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ l, a * e = 0 ∧ e * a = 0) : a * l.sum = 0 ∧ l.sum * a = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b t ih =>
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ih fun e he ↦ hl e (List.mem_cons_of_mem b he)
    rw [List.sum_cons, mul_add, add_mul, (hl b List.mem_cons_self).1,
      (hl b List.mem_cons_self).2, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.list_sum_mul_self
statement:
theorem list_sum_mul_self {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y] [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 Y] (l : List (Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y)) (hl : ∀ e ∈ l, e * e = e)
    (hp : l.Pairwise fun e e' ↦ e * e' = 0 ∧ e' * e = 0) : l.sum * l.sum = l.sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hp
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := mul_list_sum_eq_zero P a t hp.1
    rw [List.sum_cons, add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, h₁, h₂, hl a List.mem_cons_self,
      ih (fun e he ↦ hl e (List.mem_cons_of_mem a he)) hp.2, add_zero, zero_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_range_list_sum
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_range_list_sum {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y] [LieModule K 𝔤 Y] (hY : IsCategoryO P Y)
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hs : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y) s) (ν : Dual K H)
    (l : List (Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y)) (hl : ∀ e ∈ l, e * e = e)
    (hp : l.Pairwise fun e e' ↦ e * e' = 0 ∧ e' * e = 0) :
    finrank K (l.sum.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν)) =
      (l.map fun e ↦ finrank K (e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν))).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.sum_nil, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
    have : Subsingleton ((0 : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y).range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν)) := ⟨fun f g ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩ := x
      have : (⟨(0 : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) y, ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩ : (0 : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y).range) = 0 := rfl
      rw [this, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  | cons a t ih =>
    have hp' := hp
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hp'
    have hl' : ∀ e ∈ t, e * e = e := fun e he ↦ hl e (List.mem_cons_of_mem a he)
    obtain ⟨h₂, h₁⟩ := mul_list_sum_eq_zero P a t hp'.1
    have ha : a * a = a := hl a List.mem_cons_self
    have h := finrank_hom_range_eq_add P hY hs (list_sum_mul_self P (a :: t) hl hp) ha
      (show (a + t.sum) * a = a by rw [add_mul, ha, h₁, add_zero])
      (show a * (a + t.sum) = a by rw [mul_add, ha, h₂, add_zero]) ν
    rw [List.sum_cons, add_sub_cancel_left] at h
    rw [List.sum_cons, h, ih hl' hp'.2, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_linkedAbove
statement:
theorem finite_linkedAbove (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) (ψ : Dual K H) :
    (linkedAbove P ψ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  refine (Set.finite_range fun w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan ↦
    P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ψ).subset fun ξ hξ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwξ⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA ψ ξ).mp hξ.1.symm
  refine ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
  change w (ψ + P.rho) - P.rho = ξ
  rw [hwξ, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ncard_linkedAbove_lt
statement:
theorem ncard_linkedAbove_lt (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {ψ μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : μ ∈ linkedAbove P ψ) : (linkedAbove P μ).ncard < (linkedAbove P ψ).ncard
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ncard_lt_ncard ⟨fun ξ hξ ↦ ⟨hξ.1.trans hμ.1, mem_cone_trans hμ.2.1 hξ.2.1,
    fun h ↦ hμ.2.2 ?_⟩, fun h ↦ (h hμ).2.2 rfl⟩ (finite_linkedAbove P hA ψ)
  subst h
  exact eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hξ.2.1 hμ.2.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem vermaMult_eq_of_equiv {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] (G : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam W)
    {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    (E : (F.idem M).range ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (G.idem M).range) (ν : Dual K H) :
    F.vermaMult M ν = G.vermaMult M ν
proof:
:=
  finrank_hom_congr_left P E

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_eq_of_bijOn
statement:
theorem vermaMult_eq_of_bijOn {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] (G : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam W)
    (φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W)
    {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    (hb : Set.BijOn (fun x ↦ G.idem M (φ.app M x)) (Set.range (F.idem M))
      (Set.range (G.idem M))) (ν : Dual K H) :
    F.vermaMult M ν = G.vermaMult M ν
proof:
:= by
  have hmem (x : (F.idem M).range) : ((G.idem M).comp (φ.app M)) x ∈ (G.idem M).range :=
    (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩
  set f : (F.idem M).range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (G.idem M).range :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ (((G.idem M).comp (φ.app M)).comp (F.idem M).range.incl) hmem
  have hf (x : (F.idem M).range) : (f x : M ⊗[K] W) = G.idem M (φ.app M x) := rfl
  have hrange (x : (F.idem M).range) : (x : M ⊗[K] V) ∈ Set.range (F.idem M) := by
    obtain ⟨_, y, rfl⟩ := x
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  refine F.vermaMult_eq_of_equiv G (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun x y hxy ↦ ?_, ?_⟩) ν
  · exact Subtype.ext (hb.injOn (hrange x) (hrange y) (by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      rwa [hf, hf] at this))
  · rintro ⟨_, z, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := hb.surjOn ⟨z, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨⟨F.idem M y, y, rfl⟩, Subtype.ext hxz⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isInBlock_verma_weylDot
statement:
theorem isInBlock_verma_weylDot {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam) :
    IsInBlock P hA lam (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) where
  isCategoryO
proof:
:= VermaModule.isCategoryO P _
  exists_finset := (isInBlock_verma P hA _).exists_finset
  multiplicity_ne_zero μ hμ := by
    obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := (isInBlock_verma P hA _).multiplicity_ne_zero μ hμ
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hμ
    refine ⟨x * w, ?_, by rw [weylDot_mul, hx]⟩
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot] at hw ⊢
    have h : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * w) lam - lam =
        -P.rootOf k + (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam) := by
      rw [weylDot_mul, ← hx, hk]
      abel
    change P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * w) lam - lam ∈ P.rootLattice
    rw [h]
    exact add_mem (neg_mem (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k)) hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.CommutesWithWeyl.of_bijOn
statement:
theorem CommutesWithWeyl.of_bijOn {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] {G : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam W}
    (hG : G.CommutesWithWeyl) (φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W)
    (hb : ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
      [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsInBlock P hA lam M →
      Set.BijOn (fun x ↦ G.idem M (φ.app M x)) (Set.range (F.idem M))
        (Set.range (G.idem M))) :
    F.CommutesWithWeyl
proof:
:= fun w hw ν ↦ by
  rw [F.vermaMult_eq_of_bijOn G φ (hb _ (isInBlock_verma_weylDot hw)),
    F.vermaMult_eq_of_bijOn G φ (hb _ (isInBlock_verma P hA lam)), hG w hw ν]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_eq_sum
statement:
theorem vermaMult_eq_sum [FiniteDimensional K V] (l : List (BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam V))
    (hp : l.Pairwise (fun G G' ↦ ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
      [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsInBlock P hA lam M →
        G.idem M * G'.idem M = 0 ∧ G'.idem M * G.idem M = 0))
    (hsum : ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
      [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsInBlock P hA lam M → (l.map fun G ↦ G.idem M).sum = F.idem M)
    {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : IsInBlock P hA lam (VermaModule P Λ)) (ν : Dual K H) :
    F.vermaMult (VermaModule P Λ) ν = (l.map fun G ↦ G.vermaMult (VermaModule P Λ) ν).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma P
    (isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional (V := V) hA) Λ
  have hY := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V)
  have h := finrank_hom_range_list_sum P hY hs ν (l.map fun G ↦ G.idem (VermaModule P Λ))
    (fun e he ↦ by
      obtain ⟨G, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
      exact G.idem_mul_idem hΛ)
    (List.pairwise_map.mpr (hp.imp fun h ↦ h _ hΛ))
  rw [hsum _ hΛ, List.map_map] at h
  exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_verma_eq_multiplicity
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaMult, ← finrank_hom_congr_left P E,
    ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (P := P) (hA := hA) (Λ := μ)
      (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν)),
    multiplicity_restrictedDual]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.commutesWithWeyl_of_ncard
statement:
private theorem commutesWithWeyl_of_ncard (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ψ : Dual K H), (linkedAbove P ψ).ncard = n →
      (∀ ξ, centralCharacter P ξ = centralCharacter P ψ → ξ - ψ ∈ P.rootLattice →
        P.IsDominantIntegral (lam - ξ)) →
      ∀ (V₁ : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup V₁] [Module K V₁] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V₁]
        [LieModule K 𝔤 V₁] [FiniteDimensional K V₁] (F₁ : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam V₁),
        Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA ψ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F₁.vermaValue) → F₁.CommutesWithWeyl
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro ψ hn hD V₁ _ _ _ _ _ F₁ ⟨E₁⟩
  have hν : P.IsDominantIntegral (lam - ψ) := hD ψ rfl (by rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _)
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional hA hν
  set L := IrreducibleModule P (lam - ψ)
  have hLO := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) L
  have hLO' := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) (Module.Dual K L)
  set G := tensorBlock P hA lam (Module.Dual K L) (centralCharacter P ψ)
  have hGv (ξ : Dual K H) : G.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ξ =
      if centralCharacter P ξ = centralCharacter P ψ then
        finrank K (weightSpace P L (lam - ξ)) else 0 := by
    rw [vermaMult_tensorBlock]
    split_ifs
    · rw [weightSpace, finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual P hLO.1 hLO'.1, neg_sub]
    · rfl
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hp, hsum⟩ := G.exists_decomposition hlam hM₀ hI
  have hμ : ∀ G' ∈ l, ∃ μ, Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ G'.vermaValue) :=
    fun G' hG' ↦ G'.exists_nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover hlam hM₀ hI hK (hl G' hG').1
  have hdec (ξ : Dual K H) : G.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ξ =
      (l.map fun G' ↦ G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ξ).sum :=
    G.vermaMult_eq_sum l hp hsum (isInBlock_verma P hA lam) ξ
  
  have hcone : ∀ G' ∈ l, ∀ μ, Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ G'.vermaValue) →
      centralCharacter P μ = centralCharacter P ψ ∧ ψ ∈ cone P μ := by
    rintro G' hG' μ ⟨E⟩
    have h1 : G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) μ = 1 := by
      rw [G'.vermaMult_verma_eq_multiplicity E μ, VermaModule.multiplicity_self]
    have h2 : 1 ≤ G.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) μ := by
      rw [hdec, ← h1]
      exact List.le_sum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem hG')
    rw [hGv] at h2
    split_ifs at h2 with hc
    · refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
      have hne : weightSpace P L (lam - μ) ≠ ⊥ := fun h ↦ by
        rw [h, finrank_bot] at h2
        omega
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
      obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P (lam - ψ)
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P (lam - ψ)))
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) hx hx0
      refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
      calc ψ = lam - (lam - ψ - P.rootOf k) - P.rootOf k := by abel
        _ = lam - (lam - μ) - P.rootOf k := by rw [h]
        _ = μ - P.rootOf k := by abel
    · omega
  have hval : ∀ G' ∈ l, ∀ μ, Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ G'.vermaValue) →
      G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ψ = if μ = ψ then 1 else 0 := by
    rintro G' hG' μ ⟨E⟩
    rw [G'.vermaMult_verma_eq_multiplicity E ψ]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      exact VermaModule.multiplicity_self _
    · by_contra hne
      exact h (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hne)
        (hcone G' hG' μ ⟨E⟩).2)
  have hsumψ := hdec ψ
  rw [hGv, ite_eq_left rfl, IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P (lam - ψ)] at hsumψ
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := List.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero (by
    rw [← hsumψ]; exact one_ne_zero)
  obtain ⟨Gk, hGk, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  obtain ⟨μk, ⟨Ek⟩⟩ := hμ Gk hGk
  have hμk : μk = ψ := by
    rw [hval Gk hGk μk ⟨Ek⟩] at hx0
    by_contra h
    exact hx0 (ite_eq_right h)
  rw [hμk] at Ek
  have hGkψ : Gk.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ψ = 1 := by
    rw [hval Gk hGk ψ ⟨Ek⟩, ite_eq_left rfl]
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := List.append_of_mem hGk
  
  have hrest : ∀ G' ∈ s ++ t, G'.CommutesWithWeyl := by
    intro G' hG'
    have hG'l : G' ∈ l := by
      rw [hst]
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hG' with h | h
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ h
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    obtain ⟨μ', ⟨E'⟩⟩ := hμ G' hG'l
    have h0 : G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ψ = 0 := by
      have h := hsumψ
      rw [hst, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_append, List.sum_cons, hGkψ] at h
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hG' with h' | h'
      · have := List.le_sum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem
          (f := fun G' ↦ G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ψ) h')
        omega
      · have := List.le_sum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem
          (f := fun G' ↦ G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ψ) h')
        omega
    have hne : μ' ≠ ψ := fun h ↦ by
      rw [hval G' hG'l μ' ⟨E'⟩, ite_eq_left h] at h0
      exact one_ne_zero h0
    obtain ⟨hc, hc'⟩ := hcone G' hG'l μ' ⟨E'⟩
    have hmem : μ' ∈ linkedAbove P ψ := ⟨hc, hc', hne⟩
    refine ih _ (hn ▸ ncard_linkedAbove_lt P hA hmem) μ' rfl (fun ξ hξ hξ' ↦ hD ξ (hξ.trans hc)
      ?_) (Module.Dual K L) G' ⟨E'⟩
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := hc'
    rw [show ξ - ψ = (ξ - μ') + (μ' - ψ) by abel, hk, sub_sub_cancel]
    exact add_mem hξ' (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k)
  
  have hGkc : Gk.CommutesWithWeyl := by
    intro w hw ξ
    have hG := commutesWithWeyl_tensorBlock (P := P) (hA := hA) (lam := lam)
      (V := Module.Dual K L) (centralCharacter P ψ) w hw ξ
    have h1 := G.vermaMult_eq_sum l hp hsum (isInBlock_verma_weylDot hw)
      (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ξ)
    have h2 := hdec ξ
    rw [hst, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_append, List.sum_cons] at h1 h2
    have hs : (s.map fun G' ↦ G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ξ)).sum =
        (s.map fun G' ↦ G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ξ).sum :=
      congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left fun G' hG' ↦
        hrest G' (List.mem_append_left _ hG') w hw ξ)
    have ht : (t.map fun G' ↦ G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ξ)).sum =
        (t.map fun G' ↦ G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ξ).sum :=
      congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left fun G' hG' ↦
        hrest G' (List.mem_append_right _ hG') w hw ξ)
    change G.vermaMult _ _ = G.vermaMult _ _ at hG
    omega
  obtain ⟨φ, hb⟩ := F₁.exists_bijOn_of_equiv_verma Gk hlam hM₀ hI hK (E₁.symm.trans Ek)
  exact CommutesWithWeyl.of_bijOn F₁ hGkc φ hb

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.commutesWithWeyl_of_equiv_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem commutesWithWeyl_of_equiv_projectiveCover [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) {ψ : Dual K H}
    (hD : ∀ ξ, centralCharacter P ξ = centralCharacter P ψ → ξ - ψ ∈ P.rootLattice →
      P.IsDominantIntegral (lam - ξ))
    (E : ProjectiveCover P hA ψ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F.vermaValue) : F.CommutesWithWeyl
proof:
:=
  commutesWithWeyl_of_ncard hlam hM₀ hI hK _ ψ rfl hD V F ⟨E⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isInBlock_verma
statement:
theorem isInBlock_verma (lam : Dual K H) : IsInBlock P hA lam (VermaModule P lam) where
  isCategoryO
proof:
:= VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam
  exists_finset := ⟨{VermaModule.hwv P lam}, by
    rw [Finset.coe_singleton]
    exact VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id⟩
  multiplicity_ne_zero μ hμ := by
    obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hposDef⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
    have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
      simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hposDef.isHermitian
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := VermaModule.exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA
      (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm) hμ
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hμ
    refine ⟨w, ?_, hw⟩
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot]
    have h : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam = -P.rootOf k := by
      rw [← hw, hk]
      abel
    change P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam ∈ P.rootLattice
    rw [h]
    exact neg_mem (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.idem_mul_idem
statement:
theorem idem_mul_idem {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M) : F.idem M * F.idem M = F.idem M
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.ext (F.idem_idem M hM)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.naturality
statement:
theorem naturality {M N : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N] [LieModule K 𝔤 N]
    (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M) (hN : IsInBlock P hA lam N) (f : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N)
    (x : M ⊗[K] V) :
    (f : M →ₗ[K] N).rTensor V (F.idem M x) = F.idem N ((f : M →ₗ[K] N).rTensor V x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htM, htN⟩ := F.exists_tensorNatTrans M N hM hN
  rw [← htM, ← htN]
  exact t.naturality M N f x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.sub_idem
statement:
@[simp] theorem sub_idem (F₁ : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam V) (h : F₁.IsSummand F)
    (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]

proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.sub_isSummand
statement:
theorem sub_isSummand (F₁ : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam V) (h : F₁.IsSummand F) :
    (F.sub F₁ h).IsSummand F
proof:
:= fun M _ _ _ _ hM ↦ by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h M hM
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [sub_idem, mul_sub, F.idem_mul_idem hM, h₁]
  · rw [sub_idem, sub_mul, F.idem_mul_idem hM, h₂]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.idem_eq_zero_of_idem_verma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem idem_eq_zero_of_idem_verma_eq_zero (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (h : F.idem (VermaModule P lam) = 0) {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M) : F.idem M = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htM, htV⟩ := F.exists_tensorNatTrans M (VermaModule P lam) hM
    (isInBlock_verma P hA lam)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, -⟩ := exists_inverse_of_block P hA hlam hM₀ hI t
    (TensorNatTrans.zero K 𝔤 V V) (TensorNatTrans.zero K 𝔤 V V) (TensorNatTrans.zero K 𝔤 V V)
    (by rw [htV, h]; exact LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl) (LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl)
    hM.isCategoryO hs hM.multiplicity_ne_zero (fun x ↦ by rw [htM]; exact F.idem_idem M hM x)
    (fun _ ↦ by simp) (fun _ ↦ by simp) (fun _ ↦ by simp)
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  calc F.idem M x = t.app M x := by rw [htM]
    _ = ψ ((TensorNatTrans.zero K 𝔤 V V).app M x) := (LinearMap.congr_fun hψ x).symm
    _ = 0 := map_zero ψ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isNilpotent_idem_mul_mul_idem
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_idem_mul_mul_idem (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V V)
    (hφ : IsIdempotentElem (F.idem (VermaModule P lam) * φ.app _ * F.idem (VermaModule P lam)))
    {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M) :
    IsNilpotent (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M - (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htM, htV⟩ := F.exists_tensorNatTrans M (VermaModule P lam) hM
    (isInBlock_verma P hA lam)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_isKilledByPow_of_block P hA hlam hM₀ hM.isCategoryO hs
    hM.multiplicity_ne_zero
  set b := (t.comp φ).comp t with hb
  have hbM : b.app M = F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M := by
    rw [hb, TensorNatTrans.comp_app, TensorNatTrans.comp_app, htM]
    rfl
  have hbV : (b.app (VermaModule P lam)).comp (b.app _) = b.app (VermaModule P lam) := by
    have hbV' : b.app (VermaModule P lam) =
        F.idem (VermaModule P lam) * φ.app _ * F.idem (VermaModule P lam) := by
      rw [hb, TensorNatTrans.comp_app, TensorNatTrans.comp_app, htV]
      rfl
    rw [hbV']
    exact hφ.eq
  have h := TensorNatTrans.isNilpotent_comp_sub b b b hM₀ hI hbV
    (hasKilledFiltration_of_isKilledByPow hn)
  rw [← IsNilpotent.map_iff LieModuleHom.toEndRingHom_injective]
  have he : LieModuleHom.toEndRingHom (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M -
      (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M) ^ 2) =
      -(((b.comp b).app M : M ⊗[K] V →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] V) -
        (b.app M : M ⊗[K] V →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] V)) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_pow, ← hbM, sq, neg_sub]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  exact h.neg

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.exists_isSummand_idem_verma
statement:
theorem exists_isSummand_idem_verma [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I))
    (q : VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] V) (hq : IsIdempotentElem q)
    (hqF : F.idem (VermaModule P lam) * q = q) (hFq : q * F.idem (VermaModule P lam) = q) :
    ∃ F₁ : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam V,
      F₁.idem (VermaModule P lam) = q ∧ F₁.IsSummand F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_tensorNatTrans_app_verma P hA hlam hM₀ hI hK q
  have hqV : F.idem (VermaModule P lam) * φ.app _ * F.idem (VermaModule P lam) = q := by
    rw [hφ, hqF, hFq]
  have hnil : ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
      [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsInBlock P hA lam M →
      IsNilpotent (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M - (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M) ^ 2) :=
    fun M _ _ _ _ hM ↦ F.isNilpotent_idem_mul_mul_idem hlam hM₀ hI φ (by rw [hqV]; exact hq) hM
  let F₁ : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam V :=
    { idem := fun M _ _ _ _ ↦ idempotentLift (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M)
      idem_idem := fun M _ _ _ _ hM x ↦
        DFunLike.congr_fun (isIdempotentElem_idempotentLift (hnil M hM)).eq x
      exists_tensorNatTrans := fun M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hM hN ↦ by
        obtain ⟨t, htM, htN⟩ := F.exists_tensorNatTrans M N hM hN
        obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := hnil M hM
        obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := hnil N hN
        refine ⟨((t.comp φ).comp t).idempotentLiftPow (max k₁ k₂), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [idempotentLift_eq (pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_left _ _) hk₁),
            TensorNatTrans.idempotentLiftPow_app, TensorNatTrans.comp_app,
            TensorNatTrans.comp_app, htM]
          rfl
        · rw [idempotentLift_eq (pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_right _ _) hk₂),
            TensorNatTrans.idempotentLiftPow_app, TensorNatTrans.comp_app,
            TensorNatTrans.comp_app, htN]
          rfl }
  refine ⟨F₁, ?_, fun M _ _ _ _ hM ↦ ?_⟩
  · change idempotentLift (F.idem (VermaModule P lam) * φ.app _ * F.idem (VermaModule P lam)) = q
    rw [hqV]
    exact hq.idempotentLift_eq
  · change F.idem M * idempotentLift (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M) =
        idempotentLift (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M) ∧
      idempotentLift (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M) * F.idem M =
        idempotentLift (F.idem M * φ.app M * F.idem M)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hnil M hM
    have he := F.idem_mul_idem hM
    rw [idempotentLift_eq (pow_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_succ k) hk)]
    refine ⟨mul_idempotentLiftPow_eq (Nat.succ_ne_zero k) ?_,
      idempotentLiftPow_mul_eq (Nat.succ_ne_zero k) ?_⟩
    · rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, he]
    · rw [mul_assoc _ (F.idem M), he]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_primitiveVectors
statement:
lemma mem_primitiveVectors {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} :
    v ∈ primitiveVectors P V μ ↔ v ∈ weightSpace P V μ ∧ ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [primitiveVectors, Submodule.mem_iInf]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_mem_primitiveVectors
statement:
lemma hwv_mem_primitiveVectors (Λ : Dual K H) :
    hwv P Λ ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) Λ
proof:
:=
  mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ, lie_e_hwv P Λ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors
proof:
:=
  mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ (hwv_mem_weightSpace P μ),
    fun i ↦ by rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, lie_e_hwv, map_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.homEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homEquiv_apply (μ : Dual K H) (φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) :
    (homEquiv P V μ φ : V) = φ (hwv P μ)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma eq_zero_iff {μ : Dual K H} (φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) :
    φ = 0 ↔ φ (hwv P μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homEquiv_apply, ← ZeroMemClass.coe_zero (primitiveVectors P V μ), Subtype.coe_inj,
    LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_iff (μ : Dual K H) :
    (∃ φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V, φ ≠ 0) ↔
      ∃ v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨φ (hwv P μ), (mem_primitiveVectors.mp (map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P φ)).1,
      fun h ↦ hφ ((eq_zero_iff P φ).mpr h),
      (mem_primitiveVectors.mp (map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P φ)).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hv0, he⟩
    refine ⟨(homEquiv P V μ).symm ⟨v, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hv, he⟩⟩, fun h ↦ hv0 ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (homEquiv P V μ φ : V)) h
    simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom
statement:
theorem finrank_hom (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) =
      finrank K (primitiveVectors P V μ)
proof:
:=
  (homEquiv P V μ).finrank_eq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.rep_apply
statement:
lemma rep_apply (Λ : Dual K H) (u : 𝓤) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    rep P (VermaModule P Λ) u m = u • m
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing m with
  | algebraMap r => rw [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, algebraMap_smul]
  | ι x => rw [rep_ι, lie_eq_smul]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, ha, mul_smul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, add_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_smul_eq_smul
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul_eq_rep, rep_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.injective_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hw : φ (hwv P μ) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hφ ((eq_zero_iff P φ).mpr h)
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective (φ (hwv P μ))
  have hu₀0 : u₀ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [map_zero] at hu₀; exact hw hu₀.symm
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P μ).surjective m
  rw [equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_smul_eq_smul, ← hu₀, ← equivEnvNNeg_mul,
    LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hm
  rw [(mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_right hu₀0, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_iff
statement:
theorem exists_injective_iff (Λ μ : Dual K H) :
    (∃ φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ, Function.Injective φ) ↔
      ∃ v ∈ weightSpace P Λ μ, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Iff.trans ?_ (exists_ne_zero_iff P μ)
  refine ⟨fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ ↦ ⟨φ, fun h ↦ ?_⟩, fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ ↦ ⟨φ, injective_of_ne_zero P hφ⟩⟩
  exact hwv_ne_zero P μ (hφ (by rw [h, _root_.zero_apply, map_zero]))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.toEnd_pow_apply
statement:
lemma toEnd_pow_apply {Λ : Dual K H} (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (n : ℕ) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) x ^ n) m = (ιᵤ x) ^ n • m
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, toEnd_apply_apply, lie_eq_smul, pow_succ',
      mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.toEnd_f_pow_hwv_ne_zero
statement:
theorem toEnd_f_pow_hwv_ne_zero (Λ : Dual K H) (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (hwv P Λ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (⟨f P i, f_mem_nNeg P i⟩ : nNeg P) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    f_ne_zero P i (congrArg Subtype.val
      (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_injective (R := K) (L := nNeg P)
        (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)))
  have : (ιᵤ (f P i)) ^ n =
      mapN ((UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (⟨f P i, f_mem_nNeg P i⟩ : nNeg P)) ^ n) := by
    rw [map_pow, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]
    rfl
  rw [toEnd_pow_apply, this, ← equivEnvNNeg_apply, ne_eq, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff]
  exact pow_ne_zero _ hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWord_replicate
statement: lemma fWord_replicate (i : ι) (n : ℕ) : fWord P (List.replicate n i) = (ιᵤ (f P i)) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [fWord]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_sub_nsmul_root
statement:
theorem weightSpace_sub_nsmul_root (Λ : Dual K H) (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    weightSpace P Λ (Λ - n • P.root i) =
      K ∙ (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (hwv P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr
    (toEnd_f_pow_mem_weightSpace i (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ) n))
  rw [weightSpace_eq_wordSpan, wordSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  have hc : AuxLieAlgebra.counts w = n • Pi.single i 1 := by
    refine P.rootOf_injective ?_
    rw [← AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf, map_nsmul, rootOf_single]
    exact sub_right_injective hw
  have hw' : w = List.replicate n i := by
    cases w with
    | nil =>
      have := congrFun hc i
      simp only [AuxLieAlgebra.counts_nil, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same,
        nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
      rw [show n = 0 by exact_mod_cast this.symm, List.replicate_zero]
    | cons j l =>
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.eq_replicate_of_counts_eq hc
      have := congrFun hc j
      simp only [AuxLieAlgebra.counts, List.count_cons_self, List.count_replicate_self,
        Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
      rw [← List.replicate_succ]
      congr 1
      omega
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hw']
  dsimp only
  rw [fWord_replicate, ← toEnd_pow_apply]
  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho
statement:
lemma _root_.Matrix.Realization.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {Λ : Dual K H} {i : ι} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho = Λ - n • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply, hn, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors
statement:
theorem toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors {Λ : Dual K H} {i : ι} {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (hwv P Λ) ∈
      primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hm : Λ (P.coroot i) = m := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot, Nat.cast_succ] at hn
    exact add_right_cancel hn
  rw [P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn]
  exact mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨toEnd_f_pow_mem_weightSpace i (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ) _,
    lie_e_fPowHwv P Λ hA hm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_reflection
statement:
theorem exists_injective_reflection {Λ : Dual K H} {i : ι} {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P Λ, Function.Injective φ ∧
      φ (hwv P _) = (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (hwv P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  set φ := (homEquiv P (VermaModule P Λ) _).symm
    ⟨_, toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P hA hn0 hn⟩
  have hφ : φ (hwv P _) = (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n)
      (hwv P Λ) := by
    rw [← homEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine ⟨φ, injective_of_ne_zero P fun h ↦ toEnd_f_pow_hwv_ne_zero P Λ i n ?_, hφ⟩
  rw [← hφ, h, _root_.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_reflection
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_reflection {Λ : Dual K H} {i : ι} {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_hom]
  have hmem := toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P hA hn0 hn
  have heq : primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) =
      K ∙ (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (hwv P Λ) := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr hmem)
    rw [← weightSpace_sub_nsmul_root, ← P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn]
    exact inf_le_left
  rw [heq, finrank_span_singleton (toEnd_f_pow_hwv_ne_zero P Λ i n)]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.derivation_ext
statement:
theorem derivation_ext {D₁ D₂ : Derivation K (SymmetricAlgebra K M) (SymmetricAlgebra K M)}
    (h : ∀ x, D₁ (ι K M x) = D₂ (ι K M x)) : D₁ = D₂
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap c => simp only [Derivation.map_algebraMap]
  | ι x => exact h x
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [Derivation.leibniz, hp, hq]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_derivation
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_derivation {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M) (D : M →ₗ[K] M)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra K M) :
    equivMvPolynomial b (derivation D p) =
      MvPolynomial.mkDerivation K (fun i => equivMvPolynomial b (ι K M (D (b i))))
        (equivMvPolynomial b p)
proof:
:= by
  have h : derivation D = derivationOfBasis b D :=
    derivation_ext fun x => by rw [derivation_ι, derivationOfBasis_ι]
  rw [h]
  exact (equivMvPolynomial b).apply_symm_apply _

name: SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_dualBasis_ι
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_dualBasis_ι {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (b : Basis κ K M) (φ : Dual K M) :
    equivMvPolynomial b.dualBasis (ι K (Dual K M) φ) = ∑ u, φ (b u) • MvPolynomial.X u
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← b.dualBasis.sum_repr φ]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply, Basis.dualBasis_repr]

name: LieAlgebra.eq_zero_of_invariant_of_restrict_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_invariant_of_restrict_eq_zero (j : H →ₗ[K] L) (b : Basis ν K L)
    (μ : ν → Dual K H) (hμ : ∀ u a, ⁅j a, b u⁆ = μ u a • b u)
    (hspan : Submodule.span K (b '' {u | μ u = 0}) = LinearMap.range j)
    (F : SymmetricAlgebra K (Dual K L))
    (hF : ∀ x : L, SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieModule.toEnd K L (Dual K L) x) F = 0)
    (hres : SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp j.dualMap) F = 0) :
    F = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ν
  set e := SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b.dualBasis with he_def
  let w : ν → ℕ := fun u => if μ u = 0 then 0 else 1
  have hw : ∀ u, w u ≤ 1 := fun u => by simp only [w]; split_ifs <;> omega
  have hw0 : ∀ u, w u = 0 ↔ μ u = 0 := fun u => by simp only [w]; split_ifs <;> simp_all
  
  have hC : ∀ u, ∃ a : H, μ u = 0 → j a = b u := fun u => by
    by_cases hu : μ u = 0
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : b u ∈ LinearMap.range j :=
        hspan ▸ Submodule.subset_span ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a, fun _ => ha⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hu⟩
  choose a ha using hC
  
  have h₀ : weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 (e F) = 0 := by
    let T : Dual K H →ₗ[K] MvPolynomial ν K :=
      ∑ u ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun u => μ u = 0),
        (Module.Dual.eval K H (a u)).smulRight (X u)
    let τ := SymmetricAlgebra.lift T
    let R := SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp j.dualMap)
    have hζ : τ.comp (R.comp e.symm.toAlgHom) =
        aeval (fun u => if w u = 0 then X u else 0) := by
      apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
      intro u
      have h1 : e.symm (X u) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K L) (b.dualBasis u) :=
        SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_symm_X _ u
      have h2 : ∀ ψ : Dual K H, τ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) ψ) =
          ∑ u' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun u => μ u = 0), ψ (a u') • X u' := fun ψ => by
        simp [τ, T, LinearMap.sum_apply]
      change τ (R (e.symm (X u))) = aeval (fun u => if w u = 0 then X u else 0) (X u)
      rw [h1, aeval_X]
      simp only [R, SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, h2,
        LinearMap.dualMap_apply]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun u' => if u' = u then X u' else 0)]
      · rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
        simp [hw0]
      · intro u' hu'
        rw [ha u' (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu').2, Basis.dualBasis_apply_self]
        split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [← aeval_weight_zero_eq_weightedHomogeneousComponent, ← hζ]
    change τ (R (e.symm (e F))) = 0
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change τ (SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp j.dualMap) F) = 0
    rw [hres, map_zero]
  
  have hDx : ∀ x : L, MvPolynomial.mkDerivation K
      (fun i => e (SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K L) ⁅x, b.dualBasis i⁆)) (e F) = 0 := by
    intro x
    have h := SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_derivation b.dualBasis
      (LieModule.toEnd K L (Dual K L) x) F
    rw [hF x, map_zero] at h
    simpa only [LieModule.toEnd_apply_apply] using h.symm
  have hcomp : ∀ u i, weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0
      (e (SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K L) ⁅b u, b.dualBasis i⁆)) =
      ∑ u', if w u' = 0 then (μ u (a u') * (if u = i then 1 else 0)) • X u' else 0 := by
    intro u i
    rw [he_def, SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_dualBasis_ι, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u' _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul]
    have hX := isWeightedHomogeneous_X K w u'
    by_cases hu' : w u' = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left hu']
      rw [hu'] at hX
      rw [hX.weightedHomogeneousComponent_same, Module.Dual.lie_apply,
        ← ha u' ((hw0 u').mp hu'), ← lie_skew, hμ, map_neg, neg_neg, map_smul,
        Basis.dualBasis_apply_self, smul_eq_mul]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hu', hX.weightedHomogeneousComponent_ne 0 (Ne.symm hu'), smul_zero]
  have hD : ∀ u, w u = 1 → ∃ D : Derivation K (MvPolynomial ν K) (MvPolynomial ν K),
      D (e F) = 0 ∧ weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 (D (X u)) ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ i, i ≠ u → w i = 1 → weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 (D (X i)) = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    refine ⟨_, hDx (b u), ?_, fun i hi _ => ?_⟩
    · rw [mkDerivation_X, hcomp]
      intro h0
      have hc : ∀ u', μ u' = 0 → μ u (a u') = 0 := by
        intro u' hu'
        simp only [ite_true, mul_one] at h0
        have := congrArg (fun q => q.coeff (Finsupp.single u' 1)) h0
        rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single u'] at this
        · simpa [(hw0 u').mpr hu', coeff_X] using this
        · intro c _ hc
          split_ifs <;> simp [coeff_X, Finsupp.single_left_inj, hc]
        · simp
      have hμu : μ u = 0 := by
        ext x
        have hx : j x ∈ Submodule.span K (b '' {u | μ u = 0}) := hspan ▸ ⟨x, rfl⟩
        have hle : Submodule.span K (b '' {u | μ u = 0}) ≤ LinearMap.ker (ad K L (b u)) := by
          rw [Submodule.span_le]
          rintro _ ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩
          change ⁅b u, b u'⁆ = 0
          rw [← ha u' hu', ← lie_skew, hμ, hc u' hu', zero_smul, neg_zero]
        have h1 : ⁅b u, j x⁆ = 0 := hle hx
        rw [← lie_skew, hμ, neg_eq_zero, smul_eq_zero] at h1
        exact h1.resolve_right (b.ne_zero u)
      have : w u = 0 := (hw0 u).mpr hμu
      omega
    · rw [mkDerivation_X, hcomp]
      simp [Ne.symm hi]
  
  have hp := eq_zero_of_derivation_lowestWeight w hw h₀ hD
  exact (map_eq_zero_iff e e.injective).mp hp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.span_diagWeightBasis_zero
statement:
theorem span_diagWeightBasis_zero :
    Submodule.span K (diagWeightBasis (isHDiagonalizable_adjoint P) ''
      {u | u.1 = 0}) = LinearMap.range (h P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set hV := isHDiagonalizable_adjoint P
  rw [← rootSpace_zero]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hm := diagWeightBasis_mem hV u
    rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq.mp hu] at hm
    exact hm
  · intro x hx
    let B₀ := Basis.ofVectorSpace K (weightSpace P 𝔤 0)
    have hx' : x ∈ Submodule.span K (Subtype.val '' Set.range B₀) := by
      have hm := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (weightSpace P 𝔤 0).subtype)
        (B₀.mem_span ⟨x, hx⟩)
      rw [Submodule.map_span] at hm
      exact hm
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ hx'
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨k, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨0, k⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    simp [diagWeightBasis, IsHDiagonalizable.weightBasis, DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedBasis_coe,
      B₀]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_invariant_of_coordinateCartanRestriction_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_invariant_of_coordinateCartanRestriction_eq_zero
    (F : SymmetricAlgebra K (Dual K 𝔤))
    (hF : ∀ x : 𝔤, SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieModule.toEnd K 𝔤 (Dual K 𝔤) x) F = 0)
    (h₀ : coordinateCartanRestriction P F = 0) : F = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := finiteDimensional P hA
  set hV := isHDiagonalizable_adjoint P
  have : Finite (DiagWeightBasisIndex P 𝔤) := Module.Finite.finite_basis (diagWeightBasis hV)
  exact LieAlgebra.eq_zero_of_invariant_of_restrict_eq_zero (h P) (diagWeightBasis hV)
    (fun u => u.1) (fun u a => diagWeightBasis_mem hV u a) (span_diagWeightBasis_zero P) F hF h₀

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyRestriction_injective
statement: theorem chevalleyRestriction_injective : Function.Injective (chevalleyRestriction P hA)
proof:
:= by
  intro F G hFG
  have he : coordinateCartanRestriction P F.val = coordinateCartanRestriction P G.val :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hFG
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  apply eq_zero_of_invariant_of_coordinateCartanRestriction_eq_zero P hA
  · intro x
    rw [map_sub, F.property x, G.property x, sub_zero]
  · rw [map_sub, he, sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyRestriction_bijective
statement: theorem chevalleyRestriction_bijective : Function.Bijective (chevalleyRestriction P hA)
proof:
:=
  ⟨chevalleyRestriction_injective P hA, chevalleyRestriction_surjective P hA⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyRestrictionEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chevalleyRestrictionEquiv_apply (F) :
    (chevalleyRestrictionEquiv P hA F).val = coordinateCartanRestriction P F.val
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.upperClosureCondition_of_wall
statement:
theorem upperClosureCondition_of_wall {a b : Dual K H}
    {v w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι}
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan b v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) (ha : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n)
    (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i) :
    P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val a) (w.val b)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu j hpos hb0
  set u' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan := ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hpos' : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan u' j := isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights.mpr hpos
  have hb0' : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan b (w⁻¹ * u') j = 0 := by
    rw [← corootPairing_apply]
    exact hb0
  have hroot : (u' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) =
      ((w * v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
    rcases hwall _ _ hb0' with h | h
    · have := congrArg (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) h
      rwa [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, apply_inv_apply] at this
    · exfalso
      have h' : ((w * v * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i :
          P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) =
          (u' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) := by
        rw [mul_simple_apply_root]
        have := congrArg (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) h
        rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, apply_inv_apply, map_neg] at this
        rw [this, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := hpos'
      exact not_isPosRoot_and hw ⟨k, hk, h'.trans hk'⟩
  have hc : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val a) u' j = n := by
    rw [corootPairing_eq_of_apply_root_eq hA hroot]
    rw [corootPairing_apply, inv_mul_cancel_left, ha]
  refine ⟨(-n).toNat, ?_⟩
  change P.corootPairing _ (w.val a) u' j = _
  rw [hc]
  have : (((-n).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = -n := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
  have : (((-n).toNat : ℕ) : K) = ((-n : ℤ) : K) := by exact_mod_cast this
  rw [this]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.not_upperClosureCondition_of_wall
statement:
theorem not_upperClosureCondition_of_wall {a b : Dual K H}
    {v w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι}
    (hb : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0)
    {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) (ha : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n)
    (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i) :
    ¬P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      ((w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i).val a)
      ((w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i).val b)
proof:
:= by
  intro hU
  have hsv : (w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)⁻¹ * (w * v) =
      v * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i := by
    have hs : (⟨P.reflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i,
          P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan i⟩ :
        P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)⁻¹ =
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i := by
      rw [← CoxeterSystem.inv_simple]
      congr 1
    rw [← hs, reflectionOf]
    group
  have hpair : ∀ x : Dual K H, P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      ((w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i).val x) (w * v) i =
        -P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan x v i := by
    intro x
    rw [corootPairing_apply, hsv, corootPairing_mul_simple]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hU _ (w * v).2 i (isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights.mp hw)
    (by change P.corootPairing _ _ (w * v) i = 0; rw [hpair, hb, neg_zero])
  change P.corootPairing _ _ (w * v) i = _ at hm
  rw [hpair, ha] at hm
  have : ((-n : ℤ) : K) = ((-(m : ℤ)) : ℤ) := by push_cast; rw [← hm]
  have := Int.cast_injective (α := K) this
  omega

name: LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma _root_.LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff {R L M N M' : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L]
    [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] [LieRingModule L M'] [LieModule R L M']
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (g : M' →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) : e.toLieModuleHom.comp g = 0 ↔ g = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext u
    have h1 : e (g u) = 0 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h u
    simpa using h1
  · rintro rfl
    ext u
    simp

name: LieModuleEquiv.comp_toLieModuleHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma _root_.LieModuleEquiv.comp_toLieModuleHom_eq_zero_iff {R L M N M' : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M]
    [LieModule R L M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] [LieRingModule L M'] [LieModule R L M']
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (g : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M') : g.comp e.toLieModuleHom = 0 ↔ g = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext u
    have h1 : g (e (e.symm u)) = 0 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h (e.symm u)
    simpa using h1
  · rintro rfl
    ext u
    simp

name: LieModuleEquiv.eq_zero_of_toLieModuleHom_eq_zero
statement:
lemma _root_.LieModuleEquiv.eq_zero_of_toLieModuleHom_eq_zero {R L M N : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M]
    [LieModule R L M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (h : e.toLieModuleHom = 0) (m : M) : m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : e m = 0 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h m
  simpa using h1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_of_hom_irreducible_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hv : g (VermaModule.hwv P a) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hg ((VermaModule.eq_zero_iff P g).mpr h)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective g := by
    have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P b
    rcases IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top g.range with h | h
    · refine absurd (LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ ?_) hg
      have hm : g m ∈ g.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩
      rw [h] at hm
      exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp hm
    · exact (LieModuleHom.range_eq_top g).mp h
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hab⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P b
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)
    (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P a)) hv
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hba⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P a g hsurj
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P b) (IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P b)
  have h1 : P.rootOf k = b - a := by rw [hab]; abel
  have h2 : P.rootOf l = a - b := by rw [hba]; abel
  have hkl : k + l = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_add, h1, h2, map_zero]; abel)
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    ext i
    have := congrFun hkl i
    have := hk i
    have := hl i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at *
    omega
  rw [hab, hk0, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.eq_of_hom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.eq_of_hom_ne_zero {a b : Dual K H}
    {g : IrreducibleModule P a →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P b} (hg : g ≠ 0) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  refine VermaModule.eq_of_hom_irreducible_ne_zero P
    (g := g.comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P a))) fun h ↦ hg ?_
  ext u
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ u
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun h m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.mk'_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.mk'_ne_zero (a : Dual K H) :
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P a) :
      VermaModule P a →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P a (LieModuleHom.congr_fun h (VermaModule.hwv P a))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.id_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.id_ne_zero (a : Dual K H) :
    (LieModuleHom.id : IrreducibleModule P a →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P a (LieModuleHom.congr_fun h (IrreducibleModule.hwv P a))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_wall
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_wall {lam μ ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (μ - lam) = ν')
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam →
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
          (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam)))) ∧
    (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam ≠ P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam →
      Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
          (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam))) ∨
        ∃ y ≠ P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ, Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P y ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
          centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
            (centralCharacter P μ)
              (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set s := P.reflectionOf hA' v i with hs
  
  have hint := sub_rho_integral P hA hν' hz' hzν'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hint v i).mpr ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hμα⟩
  change P.corootPairing _ (lam + P.rho) v i = n at hn
  have hn0 : n < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hlam v i hv n hn)
    (by rintro rfl; exact hlamα (by simp [hn]))
  have hU : ∀ x' : P.weylGroup hA',
      (P.MemUpperClosure hA' (P.weylDot hA' x' lam) (P.weylDot hA' x' μ) ↔
        P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (x'.val (lam + P.rho)) (x'.val (μ + P.rho))) :=
    fun x' ↦ memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hint hfacet x'
  have hsint : s ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' (μ' := lam + P.rho) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩]
    exact (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff _ v i).mpr ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨fun hxw ↦ ?_, fun hxw ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    have h1 : (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) =
        (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) := by
      have := congrArg (· + P.rho) hxw
      simpa [weylDot] using this
    have hfixl : ((w⁻¹ * x : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) =
        lam + P.rho := by
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, h1, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply,
        ← Subgroup.coe_mul, inv_mul_cancel]
      rfl
    have hfixm : ((w⁻¹ * x : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) =
        μ + P.rho := by
      refine (apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf hA (μ + P.rho) _).mpr
        (Subgroup.closure_mono ?_ ((apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf hA
          (lam + P.rho) _).mp hfixl))
      rintro _ ⟨v', i', h0, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨v', i', ?_, rfl⟩
      rcases isPosRoot_or v' i' with hp | hp
      · exact hfacet v' i' hp h0
      · have := hfacet _ _ hp (by rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, h0, neg_zero])
        rwa [corootPairing_mul_simple, neg_eq_zero] at this
    have hxμ : P.weylDot hA' x μ = P.weylDot hA' w μ := by
      simp only [weylDot]
      congr 1
      rw [← mul_inv_cancel_left w x, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hfixm]
    have hmem : P.MemUpperClosure hA' (P.weylDot hA' x lam) (P.weylDot hA' x μ) := by
      rw [hxw, hxμ]
      exact (hU w).mpr (upperClosureCondition_of_wall hA hwall hn0 hn hw)
    have he := translation_irreducible_of_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet
      hν' hz' hzν' x hmem
    rwa [hxμ] at he
  · obtain hsub | he :=
      translation_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hz' hzν' x
    · exact Or.inl hsub
    by_cases hxμ : P.weylDot hA' x μ = P.weylDot hA' w μ
    · 
      have hfix : P.weylDot hA' (w⁻¹ * x) μ = μ := by
        have h1 := congrArg (· + P.rho) hxμ
        simp only [weylDot, sub_add_cancel] at h1 ⊢
        rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, h1, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply,
          ← Subgroup.coe_mul, inv_mul_cancel]
        simp
      rcases eq_one_or_eq_of_weylDot_eq hA
          (fun v' i' h0 ↦ reflectionOf_eq_of_apply_root_eq hA (hwall v' i' h0)) hfix with h | h
      · exact absurd (by rw [← mul_inv_cancel_left w x, h, mul_one]) hxw
      · have hx : x = w * s := by rw [← mul_inv_cancel_left w x, h]
        subst hx
        exact Or.inl (translation_irreducible_of_not_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam
          hμ hfacet hν' hz' hzν' (w * s) (mul_mem hwint hsint)
          (fun hmem ↦ not_upperClosureCondition_of_wall hA hμα hn0 hn hw ((hU _).mp hmem)))
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, hxμ, he⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_hom_translation_verma_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem exists_hom_translation_verma_ne_zero_iff {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (∃ f : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
          IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam), f ≠ 0) ↔
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  have key := translation_irreducible_wall P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hzz hzν' hv hμα hwall hlamα hw
    hwint x
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  have hNχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' x.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  let adj := translationAdjunction P (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) hMχ hNχ
  let E := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
    (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) eν
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    have hg : E.toLieModuleHom.comp (adj f) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hf ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff adj).mp
      ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff E (adj f)).mp h))
    by_contra hxw
    rcases key.2 hxw with hsub | ⟨y, hy, ⟨e⟩⟩
    · exact hg (LieModuleHom.ext fun u ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    · exact hy (VermaModule.eq_of_hom_irreducible_ne_zero P
        (g := e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (E.toLieModuleHom.comp (adj f))) fun h ↦ hg
          ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff e.symm _).mp h)).symm
  · intro hxw
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := key.1 hxw
    let g := E.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (e.toLieModuleHom.comp
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))))
    refine ⟨adj.symm g, fun h ↦ IrreducibleModule.mk'_ne_zero P (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ?_⟩
    exact (LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff e _).mp ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff E.symm _).mp
      ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff adj.symm).mp h))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_hom_translation_irreducible_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem exists_hom_translation_irreducible_ne_zero_iff {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (∃ f : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ))
          →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam), f ≠ 0) ↔
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  have key := translation_irreducible_wall P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hzz hzν' hv hμα hwall hlamα hw
    hwint x
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))
      (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  have hNχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' x.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  let adj := translationAdjunction P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) hMχ hNχ
  let E := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
    (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) eν
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    have hg : E.toLieModuleHom.comp (adj f) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hf ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff adj).mp
      ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff E (adj f)).mp h))
    by_contra hxw
    rcases key.2 hxw with hsub | ⟨y, hy, ⟨e⟩⟩
    · exact hg (LieModuleHom.ext fun u ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    · exact hy (IrreducibleModule.eq_of_hom_ne_zero P
        (g := e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (E.toLieModuleHom.comp (adj f))) fun h ↦ hg
          ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff e.symm _).mp h)).symm
  · intro hxw
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := key.1 hxw
    let g := E.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp e.toLieModuleHom
    refine ⟨adj.symm g, fun h ↦ IrreducibleModule.id_ne_zero P (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ?_⟩
    have h0 : E.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (e.toLieModuleHom.comp LieModuleHom.id) = 0 :=
      (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff adj.symm).mp h
    exact (LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff e _).mp ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff E.symm _).mp
      h0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_hom_irreducible_translation_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem exists_hom_irreducible_translation_ne_zero_iff {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (∃ f : IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)),
          f ≠ 0) ↔
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν'
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  have key := translation_irreducible_wall P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hzz hzν' hv hμα hwall hlamα hw
    hwint x
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' x.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  have hNχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))
      (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  
  let adj := translationAdjunction P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (z' (-ν))) hMχ hNχ
  let eD : Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P (z' (-ν))) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν :=
    (dualEquiv eν).trans evalEquiv.symm
  let E := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) eD
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    
    let g := adj.symm (E.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp f)
    have hg : g ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hf ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff E.symm f).mp
      ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff adj.symm).mp h))
    by_contra hxw
    rcases key.2 hxw with hsub | ⟨y, hy, ⟨e⟩⟩
    · exact hg (LieModuleHom.ext fun u ↦ by rw [Subsingleton.elim u 0, map_zero]; rfl)
    · exact hy (IrreducibleModule.eq_of_hom_ne_zero P (g := g.comp e.toLieModuleHom) fun h ↦
        hg ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_toLieModuleHom_eq_zero_iff e g).mp h))
  · intro hxw
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := key.1 hxw
    let g : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P (z' (-ν))) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam)) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
          IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ) := e.symm.toLieModuleHom
    have hg : g ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
      ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff e.toLinearEquiv).mp
        (LieModuleEquiv.eq_zero_of_toLieModuleHom_eq_zero e.symm h _))
    refine ⟨E.toLieModuleHom.comp (adj g), fun h ↦ hg ?_⟩
    exact (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff adj).mp ((LieModuleEquiv.comp_eq_zero_iff E _).mp h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_sub_root_add_root
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [weightSpace_eq_wordSpan, wordSpan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have hc : AuxLieAlgebra.counts w = AuxLieAlgebra.counts [i, j] := by
      apply P.rootOf_injective
      rw [← AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf, ← AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf]
      apply sub_right_injective (b := Λ)
      simpa [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons] using hw
    have hp : w.Perm [i, j] := List.perm_iff_count.mpr fun a ↦ by
      have := congrFun hc a
      dsimp [AuxLieAlgebra.counts] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    rcases List.perm_pair.mp hp with rfl | rfl
    · exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · simpa [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons] using fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ [i, j]
    · rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx with rfl
      simpa [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons, add_comm] using
        fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ [j, i]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_sub_root_add_root_le_two
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_sub_root_add_root_le_two :
    finrank K (weightSpace P Λ (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j))) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weightSpace_sub_root_add_root]
  exact (finrank_span_le_card _).trans (by
    simp only [Set.toFinset_insert, Set.toFinset_singleton]
    exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_fWord_pair_sub
statement:
theorem lie_e_fWord_pair_sub (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ⁅e P i, fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ - fWord P [j, i] • hwv P Λ⁆ =
      -(A i j : K) • ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fWord_smul_cons, fWord_nil, one_smul, lie_sub]
  have heij : ⁅e P i, f P j⁆ = 0 := by simp [lie_e_f, hij]
  have heii : ⁅e P i, f P i⁆ = h P (P.coroot i) := by simp
  have h1 : ⁅e P i, ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [leibniz_lie, heij, zero_lie, lie_e_hwv, lie_zero, add_zero]
  have h2 : ⁅e P i, ⁅f P i, hwv P Λ⁆⁆ = Λ (P.coroot i) • hwv P Λ := by
