    rw [leibniz_lie, heii, lie_h_hwv, lie_e_hwv, lie_zero, add_zero]
  have h3 : ⁅h P (P.coroot i), ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆⁆ =
      (Λ (P.coroot i) - (A i j : K)) • ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆ := by
    have hwt := fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ [j] (P.coroot i)
    simpa [fWord_smul_cons, AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons, P.root_coroot] using hwt
  rw [leibniz_lie, heii, h1, lie_zero, add_zero, h3,
    leibniz_lie, heij, zero_lie, zero_add, h2, lie_smul]
  module

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_le_one
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_le_one (hij : i ≠ j) (hAij : A i j ≠ 0) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j)) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P Λ) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_hom]
  have := finiteDimensional_weightSpace P Λ (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j))
  have hlt : primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j)) <
      weightSpace P Λ (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j)) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne inf_le_left ?_
    intro heq
    have hm : fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ - fWord P [j, i] • hwv P Λ ∈
        weightSpace P Λ (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j)) := by
      rw [weightSpace_sub_root_add_root]
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _))
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
    rw [← heq] at hm
    have hz := (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hm).2 i
    rw [lie_e_fWord_pair_sub P Λ hij] at hz
    have hf : ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆ ≠ 0 := by
      simpa using toEnd_f_pow_hwv_ne_zero P Λ j 1
    exact hf ((smul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (neg_ne_zero.mpr
      (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hAij)))
  have hdim := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt
  have htwo := finrank_weightSpace_sub_root_add_root_le_two P Λ (i := i) (j := j)
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_fWord_pair_left
statement:
theorem lie_e_fWord_pair_left (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ⁅e P i, fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ⁆ =
      (Λ (P.coroot i) - (A i j : K)) • ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fWord_smul_cons, fWord_nil, one_smul]
  have heij : ⁅e P i, f P j⁆ = 0 := by simp [lie_e_f, hij]
  have heii : ⁅e P i, f P i⁆ = h P (P.coroot i) := by simp
  have h1 : ⁅e P i, ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [leibniz_lie, heij, zero_lie, lie_e_hwv, lie_zero, add_zero]
  rw [leibniz_lie, heii, h1, lie_zero, add_zero]
  have hwt := fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ [j] (P.coroot i)
  simpa [fWord_smul_cons, AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons, P.root_coroot] using hwt

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_fWord_pair_right
statement:
theorem lie_e_fWord_pair_right (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ⁅e P i, fWord P [j, i] • hwv P Λ⁆ =
      Λ (P.coroot i) • ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fWord_smul_cons, fWord_nil, one_smul]
  have heij : ⁅e P i, f P j⁆ = 0 := by simp [lie_e_f, hij]
  have heii : ⁅e P i, f P i⁆ = h P (P.coroot i) := by simp
  have h2 : ⁅e P i, ⁅f P i, hwv P Λ⁆⁆ = Λ (P.coroot i) • hwv P Λ := by
    rw [leibniz_lie, heii, lie_h_hwv, lie_e_hwv, lie_zero, add_zero]
  rw [leibniz_lie, heij, zero_lie, zero_add, h2, lie_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_fWord_pair_other
statement:
theorem lie_e_fWord_pair_other {k : ι} (hki : k ≠ i) (hkj : k ≠ j) :
    ⁅e P k, fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fWord_smul_cons, fWord_nil, one_smul]
  have hei : ⁅e P k, f P i⁆ = 0 := by simp [lie_e_f, hki]
  have hej : ⁅e P k, f P j⁆ = 0 := by simp [lie_e_f, hkj]
  have hj : ⁅e P k, ⁅f P j, hwv P Λ⁆⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [leibniz_lie, hej, zero_lie, lie_e_hwv, lie_zero, add_zero]
  rw [leibniz_lie, hei, zero_lie, zero_add, hj, lie_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWord_pair_add_ne_zero
statement:
theorem fWord_pair_add_ne_zero (hij : i ≠ j) (hAij : A i j ≠ 0) :
    fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ + fWord P [j, i] • hwv P Λ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let u (k : ι) : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P) :=
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K ⟨f P k, f_mem_nNeg P k⟩
  have heq (ν : Dual K H) :
      equivEnvNNeg P ν (u i * u j + u j * u i) =
        fWord P [i, j] • hwv P ν + fWord P [j, i] • hwv P ν := by
    simp only [equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_add, map_mul, u, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]
    simp [fWord, mul_smul]
  intro hz
  have hu : u i * u j + u j * u i = 0 :=
    (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).injective (by simpa only [heq, map_zero] using hz)
  have hzero : fWord P [i, j] • hwv P 0 + fWord P [j, i] • hwv P 0 = 0 := by
    rw [← heq, hu, map_zero]
  have hh := congrArg (fun x : VermaModule P 0 ↦ ⁅e P i, x⁆) hzero
  rw [lie_add, lie_e_fWord_pair_left P 0 hij, lie_e_fWord_pair_right P 0 hij] at hh
  simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_sub, zero_smul, add_zero, lie_zero] at hh
  have hf : ⁅f P j, hwv P 0⁆ ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using toEnd_f_pow_hwv_ne_zero P 0 j 1
  exact hf ((smul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left
    (neg_ne_zero.mpr (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hAij)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWord_pair_add_mem_primitiveVectors
statement:
theorem fWord_pair_add_mem_primitiveVectors (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hAij : A i j = -1) (hAji : A j i = -1)
    (hΛi : Λ (P.coroot i) = -(2 : K)⁻¹) (hΛj : Λ (P.coroot j) = -(2 : K)⁻¹) :
    fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ + fWord P [j, i] • hwv P Λ ∈
      primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j))
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨?_, fun k ↦ ?_⟩
  · change _ ∈ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j))
    rw [weightSpace_sub_root_add_root]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  · rw [lie_add]
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      rw [lie_e_fWord_pair_left P Λ hij, lie_e_fWord_pair_right P Λ hij,
        hΛi, hAij, ← add_smul]
      norm_num
    · by_cases hkj : k = j
      · subst k
        rw [lie_e_fWord_pair_right P Λ hij.symm, lie_e_fWord_pair_left P Λ hij.symm,
          hΛj, hAji, ← add_smul]
        norm_num
      · rw [lie_e_fWord_pair_other P Λ hki hkj,
          lie_e_fWord_pair_other P Λ hkj hki, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_eq_one_half
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_eq_one_half (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hAij : A i j = -1) (hAji : A j i = -1)
    (hΛi : Λ (P.coroot i) = -(2 : K)⁻¹) (hΛj : Λ (P.coroot j) = -(2 : K)⁻¹) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j)) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hne : A i j ≠ 0 := by omega
  refine le_antisymm (finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_le_one P Λ hij hne) ?_
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := (exists_ne_zero_iff P (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j))).mpr
    ⟨_, (mem_primitiveVectors.mp
      (fWord_pair_add_mem_primitiveVectors P Λ hij hAij hAji hΛi hΛj)).1,
      fWord_pair_add_ne_zero P Λ hij hne, (mem_primitiveVectors.mp
        (fWord_pair_add_mem_primitiveVectors P Λ hij hAij hAji hΛi hΛj)).2⟩
  exact Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨φ, hφ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_neg_half_rho
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_neg_half_rho (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hAij : A i j = -1) (hAji : A j i = -1) :
    finrank K
      (VermaModule P (-(2 : K)⁻¹ • P.rho - (P.root i + P.root j)) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P (-(2 : K)⁻¹ • P.rho)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_eq_one_half P _ hij hAij hAji
  all_goals simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_sub_root_add_root_half
statement:
theorem exists_injective_sub_root_add_root_half (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hAij : A i j = -1) (hAji : A j i = -1)
    (hΛi : Λ (P.coroot i) = -(2 : K)⁻¹) (hΛj : Λ (P.coroot j) = -(2 : K)⁻¹) :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (Λ - (P.root i + P.root j)) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P Λ, Function.Injective φ ∧
      φ (hwv P _) = fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ + fWord P [j, i] • hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  let φ := (homEquiv P (VermaModule P Λ) _).symm
    ⟨_, fWord_pair_add_mem_primitiveVectors P Λ hij hAij hAji hΛi hΛj⟩
  have hφ : φ (hwv P _) = fWord P [i, j] • hwv P Λ + fWord P [j, i] • hwv P Λ := by
    rw [← homEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine ⟨φ, injective_of_ne_zero P ?_, hφ⟩
  intro hz
  apply fWord_pair_add_ne_zero P Λ hij (by omega)
  rw [← hφ, hz, _root_.zero_apply]

name: vermaHomNext_A2_rational
statement:
theorem vermaHomNext_A2_rational :
    let P := Matrix.Realization.std (!![2, -1; -1, 2] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) ℚ
    finrank ℚ
      (Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule P
        (-(2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • P.rho - (P.root 0 + P.root 1)) →ₗ⁅ℚ,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule P (-(2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • P.rho)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  apply Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_sub_root_add_root_neg_half_rho
  all_goals decide

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.exists_surjective_verma
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.exists_surjective_verma {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (μ : Dual K H) (q : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P μ), Function.Surjective q
proof:
:= by
  cases hN with
  | bot => exact absurd rfl hs
  | @step N₀ _ _ μ _ h01 he =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    refine ⟨μ, e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (LieModuleHom.codRestrict _
      ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀).comp N.incl) fun y ↦ LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem y.2), ?_⟩
    intro m
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (e m).2
    refine ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom, LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    exact Subtype.ext hyx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_hom
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_hom {V : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (hVO : IsCategoryO P V) (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) {s : Multiset (Dual K H)}
    (hs : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V) s) {x : Dual K H}
    (φ : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P x) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hdim : ∀ f g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P x, f ≠ 0 → ∃ c : K, g = c • f)
    (huniq : ∀ (η : Dual K H) (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η), f ≠ 0 → η = x) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA x ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s', r, hrs⟩ := (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveCover P x hA).exists_retract
    (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA x) hproj hVO φ hφ
  have hrs' (y : ProjectiveCover P hA x) : r (s' y) = y := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hrs y
  let p := s'.comp r
  have hp : p.comp p = p := by
    ext y
    change s' (r (s' (r y))) = s' (r y)
    rw [hrs']
  obtain ⟨t, t', -, ht', -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range_add P hVO hs p hp
  have ht'0 : t' = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨μ, q, hq⟩ := ht'.exists_surjective_verma P hne
    let k : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ p.ker := LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ (LieModuleHom.id - p) fun y ↦ by
      change p (y - p y) = 0
      rw [map_sub, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply p p, hp, sub_self]
    let f := (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P μ)).comp (q.comp k)
    have hk (y : p.ker) : k y = y := by
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      change (y : V) - p y = y
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp y.2, sub_zero]
    have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hq (hwv P μ)
      apply IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P μ
      have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 (y : V)
      change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P μ) (q (k y)) = 0 at this
      rw [hk, hy] at this
      exact this
    have hfs : f.comp s' = 0 := by
      ext y
      change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P μ) (q (k (s' y))) = 0
      have : k (s' y) = 0 := Subtype.ext (by
        change s' y - s' (r (s' y)) = 0
        rw [hrs', sub_self])
      rw [this, map_zero, map_zero]
    have hμ := huniq μ f hf0
    subst hμ
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdim f ((ProjectiveCover.π P hA μ).comp r) hf0
    apply (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveCover P μ hA).π_ne_zero
    ext y
    have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hc (s' y)
    change ProjectiveCover.π P hA μ (r (s' y)) = c • f (s' y) at this
    rw [hrs', show f (s' y) = 0 from LieModuleHom.congr_fun hfs y, smul_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hker := IsStdFiltered.eq_bot_of_zero P (ht'0 ▸ ht')
  refine ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective s' ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ⟨r y, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · rw [← hrs' a, ← hrs' b, hab]
  · have hmem : y - s' (r y) ∈ p.ker := by
      change s' (r (y - s' (r y))) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hrs', sub_self, map_zero]
    rw [hker, LieSubmodule.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at hmem
    exact hmem.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isProjectiveCover
statement:
theorem VermaModule.isProjectiveCover (Λ : Dual K H) :
    IsProjectiveCover P (VermaModule P Λ) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P Λ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ, LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _, fun N hN ↦ by
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker] at hN
    by_contra hne
    exact hN ((le_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ N).mpr hne)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.blockRetr_incl
statement:
lemma blockRetr_incl (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (y : centralBlock P V χ) :
    blockRetr P hV χ y = y
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (centralBlockProjection_self P (hV.isCentralLocallyFinite P) χ y.2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isProjectiveO_centralBlock
statement:
theorem isProjectiveO_centralBlock {hV : IsCategoryO P V} (hVp : IsProjectiveO.{w} P V)
    (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) : IsProjectiveO.{w} P (centralBlock P V χ)
proof:
:=
  hVp.of_retract (centralBlock P V χ).incl (blockRetr P hV χ)
    (LieModuleHom.ext (blockRetr_incl P hV χ))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isStdFiltered_of_fin_of_zero
statement:
theorem isStdFiltered_of_fin_of_zero {n : ℕ} (F : Fin (n + 1) → LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X)
    (wt' : Fin n → Dual K H) (S : Set (Fin n)) [DecidablePred (· ∈ S)] (hF : Monotone F)
    (h0 : F 0 = ⊥)
    (hstep : ∀ j ∈ S, Nonempty (VermaModule P (wt' j) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc))))
    (hzero : ∀ j ∉ S, (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥) :
    IsStdFiltered P (F (Fin.last n)) ((Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ S)).val.map wt')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ k (hk : k ≤ n), IsStdFiltered P (F ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩)
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin n ↦ j ∈ S ∧ j.val < k).val.map wt') := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      have : (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin n ↦ j ∈ S ∧ j.val < 0) = ∅ := by
        ext j; simp
      rw [this]
      simpa [h0] using IsStdFiltered.bot (P := P) (X := X)
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      set j : Fin n := ⟨k, hk⟩
      have h1 := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hk)
      have hle : F j.castSucc ≤ F j.succ := hF (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (Nat.le_succ k))
      by_cases hj : j ∈ S
      · have hfilt : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n ↦ i ∈ S ∧ i.val < k + 1) =
            Finset.cons j (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n ↦ i ∈ S ∧ i.val < k) (by simp [j]) := by
          ext i
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_cons, j]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hiS, hi⟩
            rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with hi | hi
            · exact Or.inr ⟨hiS, hi⟩
            · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext hi)
          · rintro (rfl | ⟨hiS, hi⟩)
            · exact ⟨hj, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
            · exact ⟨hiS, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi⟩
        rw [hfilt, Finset.cons_val, Multiset.map_cons]
        exact IsStdFiltered.step h1 hle (hstep j hj)
      · have hfilt : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n ↦ i ∈ S ∧ i.val < k + 1) =
            (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n ↦ i ∈ S ∧ i.val < k) := by
          ext i
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hiS, hi⟩
            refine ⟨hiS, lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi) fun he ↦ hj ?_⟩
            have : i = j := Fin.ext he
            exact this ▸ hiS
          · rintro ⟨hiS, hi⟩
            exact ⟨hiS, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi⟩
        have heq : F j.succ = F j.castSucc := by
          refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) hle
          have := hzero j hj
          have hmem : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc) x ∈
              (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) :=
            LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hx
          rw [this, LieSubmodule.mem_bot, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hmem
          exact hmem
        rw [hfilt]
        change IsStdFiltered P (F j.succ) _
        rw [heq]
        exact h1
  have := key n le_rfl
  have hfull : (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin n ↦ j ∈ S ∧ j.val < n) =
      Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ S) := by
    ext j; simp
  rwa [hfull] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isStdFiltered_translation_verma
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_translation_verma {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    ∃ s, IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)))) s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set Λw := P.weylDot hA' w μ
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λw) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  have hLO := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hXO := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λw).tensorProduct hLO
  obtain ⟨n, F, x, S, hmono, h0, hlast, hstep, hzero, -⟩ :=
    exists_translation_verma_filtration_of_isAntidominant (P := P) hA hlam hμ hν hz hzν w
  have h1 := isStdFiltered_of_fin_of_zero P F x S hmono h0 hstep hzero
  rw [hlast] at h1
  
  have h2 := h1.map_of_injOn P (blockRetr P hXO (centralCharacter P lam))
    (B := centralBlock P _ (centralCharacter P lam)) (fun y hy hy0 ↦ by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hy0
      rwa [show (blockRetr P hXO (centralCharacter P lam) y : _) = y from
        congrArg Subtype.val (blockRetr_incl P hXO _ ⟨y, hy⟩)] at this) le_rfl
  have hmap : (centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λw ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam)).map (blockRetr P hXO (centralCharacter P lam)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    exact ⟨y.1, y.2, blockRetr_incl P hXO _ y⟩
  rw [hmap] at h2
  
  let e := centralBlockEquiv P (rTensorEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
    (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hMχ).symm) (centralCharacter P lam)
  have h3 := h2.map_of_injOn P e.toLieModuleHom (B := ⊤)
    (fun y _ hy0 ↦ (e.toLinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff).mp hy0) le_rfl
  have hmap' : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λw ⊗[K]
      IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam))).map e.toLieModuleHom = ⊤ := by
    rw [LieModuleHom.map_top, LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    exact e.surjective
  rw [hmap'] at h3
  exact ⟨_, h3⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_verma
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_verma {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hmax : ∀ w' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, ∀ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k →
      w' (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ + P.rho) =
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ + P.rho + P.rootOf k → k = 0) :
    ∃ x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ ∧
      P.MemUpperClosure hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam)
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ) ∧
      Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set Λw := P.weylDot hA' w μ with hΛw
  
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  have hint := sub_rho_integral P hA hν' hzz hzν'
  have ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i = n →
      n ≤ 0 := hlam
  
  have hWl : P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam = P.integralWeylGroup hA' (lam + P.rho) :=
    P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩
  have hWm : P.integralWeylGroup hA' (lam + P.rho) = P.integralWeylGroup hA' (μ + P.rho) :=
    P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' hint
  have hwb : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' (μ + P.rho) := hWm ▸ hWl ▸ hwint
  
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λw) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  have hLO := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hL'O : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm
  have hMO := VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λw
  have hP'O := hMO.centralTranslation P hLO (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
  have hMp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (VermaModule P Λw) :=
    VermaModule.isProjectiveO_of_forall P hA hmax
  have hP'p : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P Λw)) :=
    isProjectiveO_centralBlock P (hV := (hMO.centralBlock P _).tensorProduct hLO)
      ((hMp.of_equiv (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hMχ).symm).tensorProduct P hL'O) _
  
  let mult : Dual K H → ℕ := fun η ↦ ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (z' (-ν))) (centralCharacter P lam)
    (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity Λw
  
  have hHom : ∀ η, centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P η) (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ →
      FiniteDimensional K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η) ∧
      finrank K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η) = mult η := by
    intro η hNχ
    let adj := translationAdjunction P hMO hLO hMχ hNχ
    let E := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P η)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) eν
    have hT'O := (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hL'O
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
    have hcov := VermaModule.isProjectiveCover P Λw
    have := hcov.finiteDimensional_hom hT'O
    refine ⟨LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional adj.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [adj.finrank_eq, hcov.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity hMp hT'O]
    exact IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr hT'O _ E Λw
  
  have hblock : ∀ η, centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P η) (centralCharacter P lam) ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ f : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η, f = 0 := by
    intro η hη f
    have hne : centralCharacter P η ≠ centralCharacter P lam := fun h ↦
      hη (h ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P η)
    have hbot := centralBlock_irreducible_eq_bot P η _ hne
    ext y
    have hy : y ∈ centralBlock P _ (centralCharacter P lam) := by
      rw [centralBlock_centralBlock_eq_top]; trivial
    have := map_mem_centralBlock P f _ hy
    rw [hbot, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact this
  have hmult1 : ∀ w' : P.weylGroup hA',
      P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w'.val (lam + P.rho)) (w'.val (μ + P.rho)) →
      P.weylDot hA' w' μ = Λw → mult (P.weylDot hA' w' lam) = 1 := by
    intro w' hC hw'μ
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ
      hfacet hν' hzz hzν' w' hC
    exact (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P
      (P.weylDot hA' w' lam)).centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (z' (-ν)))
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _)
      e.symm Λw).trans (by simp [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, hw'μ])
  
  have hK1 : ∀ η, mult η ≠ 0 → ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA', η = P.weylDot hA' w' lam ∧
      P.weylDot hA' w' μ = Λw ∧
      P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w'.val (lam + P.rho)) (w'.val (μ + P.rho)) ∧ mult η = 1 := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨w', rfl, hw'μ, hns⟩ :=
      exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν'
        hzz hzν' hη
    have hw'b : w'.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho) := by
      have := congrArg (· + P.rho) hw'μ
      simpa [weylDot, hΛw] using this
    have hw'int : w' ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam := by
      rw [hWl, hWm, mem_integralWeylGroup, hw'b]
      exact hwb
    have hC : P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w'.val (lam + P.rho)) (w'.val (μ + P.rho)) := by
      by_contra hC
      exact hns (translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam
        hμ hfacet hν' hzz hzν' w' hw'int hC)
    exact ⟨w', rfl, hw'μ, hC, hmult1 w' hC hw'μ⟩
  
  obtain ⟨x, hxint, hxb, hxC, -⟩ := exists_upperClosureCondition_of_integral (P := P) hA hint ha
    (hWl ▸ hwint)
  rw [← hxb] at hxC
  have hxμ : P.weylDot hA' x μ = Λw := by
    simp only [hΛw, weylDot, hxb]
  have hxmult : mult (P.weylDot hA' x lam) = 1 := hmult1 x hxC hxμ
  
  have hK4 : ∀ w' : P.weylGroup hA', P.weylDot hA' w' μ = Λw →
      P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w'.val (lam + P.rho)) (w'.val (μ + P.rho)) →
      P.weylDot hA' w' lam = P.weylDot hA' x lam := by
    intro w' hw'μ hC
    have hb : w'.val (μ + P.rho) = x.val (μ + P.rho) := by
      have h1 := congrArg (· + P.rho) hw'μ
      have h2 := congrArg (· + P.rho) hxμ
      simp only [weylDot, sub_add_cancel] at h1 h2
      rw [h1, h2]
    obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, h₁⟩ := exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
      (P := P) hA hint ha hxC hb
    obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, h₂⟩ := exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
      (P := P) hA hint ha hC hb.symm
    have h0 : P.rootOf (c₁ + c₂) = P.rootOf 0 := by
      rw [map_add, ← h₁, ← h₂, map_zero]; abel
    have hc0 : c₁ = 0 := by
      have := P.rootOf_injective h0
      ext j
      have h1 := congrFun this j
      have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c₁ j := hc₁ j
      have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c₂ j := hc₂ j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 ⊢
      omega
    rw [hc0, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h₁
    simp only [weylDot, h₁]
  
  have hxblock : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' x.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  obtain ⟨hfdx, hdimx⟩ := hHom _ hxblock
  rw [hxmult] at hdimx
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ0⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp (hdimx ▸ Nat.one_pos)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P (P.weylDot hA' x lam)
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top φ.range).resolve_left fun h0 ↦ hφ0 ?_
    ext y
    have : φ y ∈ φ.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_translation_verma P hA hlam hμ hν hz hzν w
  refine ⟨x, hxμ, (memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hint hfacet x).mpr hxC,
    nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_hom P hA hP'O hP'p hs φ hφ (fun f g hf ↦ ?_)
      (fun η f hf ↦ ?_)⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' f hf).mp hdimx g
    exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩
  · by_cases hηb : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P η) (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤
    · obtain ⟨hfd, hdim⟩ := hHom η hηb
      have hpos : mult η ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hdim]
        exact (Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨f, hf⟩).ne'
      obtain ⟨w', rfl, hw'μ, hC, -⟩ := hK1 η hpos
      exact hK4 w' hw'μ hC
    · exact absurd (hblock η hηb f) hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOne_eq_zero_of_isProjectiveO
statement:
theorem extOne_eq_zero_of_isProjectiveO {X N : Type w} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 N] (hX : IsCategoryO P X) (hN : IsCategoryO P N)
    (hXp : IsProjectiveO.{w} P X) (y : ExtOne (h P) X N) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ExtOne.mk_surjective y
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hXp (hN.extension P hX c) hX (ExtOne.Extension.snd c)
    (ExtOne.Extension.surjective_snd c) LieModuleHom.id
  exact (ExtOne.mk_eq_zero_iff c).mpr ⟨σ, fun m ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun hσ m⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOneEquivQuotient_symm_mk
statement:
theorem extOneEquivQuotient_symm_mk {B C N' : Type w} [AddCommGroup B] [Module K B]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 B] [LieModule K 𝔤 B] [AddCommGroup C] [Module K C] [LieRingModule 𝔤 C]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 C] [AddCommGroup N'] [Module K N'] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N'] [LieModule K 𝔤 N']
    (hB : IsCategoryO P B) (hN : IsCategoryO P N') (hBp : IsProjectiveO.{w} P B)
    {i : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B} {p : B →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ C} (S : ExtOne.SplitData (h P) i p)
    (f : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') :
    (extOneEquivQuotient P hB hN hBp S).symm (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) = S.connecting f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_extOne_equiv_quotient_ker
statement:
theorem nonempty_extOne_equiv_quotient_ker {B C N' : Type w} [AddCommGroup B] [Module K B]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 B] [LieModule K 𝔤 B] [AddCommGroup C] [Module K C] [LieRingModule 𝔤 C]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 C] [AddCommGroup N'] [Module K N'] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N'] [LieModule K 𝔤 N']
    (hB : IsCategoryO P B) (hC : IsCategoryO P C) (hN : IsCategoryO P N')
    (hBp : IsProjectiveO.{w} P B) {p : B →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ C} (hp : Function.Surjective p) :
    Nonempty (ExtOne (h P) C N' ≃ₗ[K]
      (p.ker →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') ⧸ LinearMap.range (precompHom P N' p.ker.incl))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := ExtOne.exists_splitData (h P) hB.1 hC.1 (i := p.ker.incl) (p := p)
    Subtype.val_injective hp fun b ↦ ⟨fun hb ↦ ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, rfl⟩, fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ by
      rw [← ha]; exact a.2⟩
  exact ⟨extOneEquivQuotient P hB hN hBp S⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_one
statement: lemma equivEnvNNeg_one (Λ : Dual K H) : equivEnvNNeg P Λ 1 = hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_ι_mul
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_ι_mul (Λ : Dual K H) (y : nNeg P) (u : 𝓤₋) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ (ιₙ y * u) = ⁅(y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivEnvNNeg_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, lie_eq_smul]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie (Λ : Dual K H) (y : nNeg P) (u : 𝓤₋) :
    (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm ⁅(y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆ = ιₙ y * u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equivEnvNNeg_ι_mul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_affine_lie
statement:
theorem exists_affine_lie (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (u : 𝓤₋) :
    ∃ (a : 𝓤₋) (ℓ : Dual K H →ₗ[K] 𝓤₋), ∀ Λ,
      (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm ⁅x, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆ = a + ℓ Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.induction_left generalizing x with
  | hone =>
    have hx : x ∈ (nNeg P).toSubmodule ⊔ (borel P).toSubmodule := by
      rw [(isCompl_nNeg_borel P).sup_eq_top]; trivial
    obtain ⟨y, hy, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hb
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (mem_cartan P).mp hc
    refine ⟨ιₙ ⟨y, hy⟩, (LinearMap.applyₗ a).smulRight 1, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    have hy' := equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie P Λ ⟨y, hy⟩ 1
    simp only [mul_one] at hy'
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_one, add_lie, add_lie, lie_h_hwv, lie_hwv_of_mem_nPos P Λ hz, add_zero,
      map_add, ← equivEnvNNeg_one, hy', map_smul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  | hadd u u' hu hu' =>
    obtain ⟨a, ℓ, h⟩ := hu x
    obtain ⟨a', ℓ', h'⟩ := hu' x
    refine ⟨a + a', ℓ + ℓ', fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, lie_add, map_add, h, h', LinearMap.add_apply]
    abel
  | hsmul r u hu =>
    obtain ⟨a, ℓ, h⟩ := hu x
    refine ⟨r • a, r • ℓ, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, lie_smul, map_smul, h, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add]
  | hι y u hu =>
    obtain ⟨a, ℓ, h⟩ := hu x
    obtain ⟨a₁, ℓ₁, h₁⟩ := hu ⁅x, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆
    refine ⟨a₁ + ιₙ y * a, ℓ₁ + LinearMap.mulLeft K (ιₙ y) ∘ₗ ℓ, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_ι_mul, leibniz_lie, map_add, h₁,
      ← LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (equivEnvNNeg P Λ) ⁅x, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆,
      equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie, h, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_add]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_lie_h
statement:
theorem exists_lie_h (a : H) (u : 𝓤₋) :
    ∃ c : 𝓤₋, ∀ Λ, (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm ⁅h P a, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆ = c + Λ a • u
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.induction_left with
  | hone =>
    refine ⟨0, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_one, lie_h_hwv, ← equivEnvNNeg_one, ← map_smul,
      LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, zero_add]
  | hadd u u' hu hu' =>
    obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨c', h'⟩ := hu'
    refine ⟨c + c', fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, lie_add, map_add, h, h', smul_add]
    abel
  | hsmul r u hu =>
    obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hu
    refine ⟨r • c, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, lie_smul, map_smul, h, smul_add, smul_comm]
  | hι y u hu =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hu
    have hy : ⁅h P a, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ ∈ nNeg P := lie_h_mem_nNeg P a y.2
    refine ⟨ιₙ ⟨_, hy⟩ * u + ιₙ y * c, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    have hy' := equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie P Λ ⟨_, hy⟩ u
    simp only at hy'
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_ι_mul, leibniz_lie, map_add, hy',
      ← LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (equivEnvNNeg P Λ) ⁅h P a, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆,
      equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie, hc, mul_add, mul_smul_comm]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace_iff
statement:
theorem equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace_iff (Λ ν : Dual K H) (u : 𝓤₋) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ u ∈ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - ν) ↔ u ∈ negWeightSpace P ν
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ Λ', equivEnvNNeg P Λ' u ∈ weightSpace P Λ' (Λ' - ν) ↔
      ∀ a, ∀ c : 𝓤₋, (∀ Λ, (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm ⁅h P a, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆ =
        c + Λ a • u) → c = -ν a • u := by
    intro Λ'
    refine ⟨fun hu a c hc ↦ ?_, fun H a ↦ ?_⟩
    · have := hc Λ'
      rw [hu a, map_smul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_smul] at this
      rw [neg_smul]
      linear_combination (norm := module) -this
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_lie_h P a u
      have hc' := H a c hc
      apply (equivEnvNNeg P Λ').symm.injective
      rw [hc Λ', map_smul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hc', LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_smul,
        neg_smul]
      abel
  rw [key, negWeightSpace, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    show (-ν) = (0 : Dual K H) - ν by simp, key]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.primMap_apply
statement:
lemma primMap_apply (Λ ν : Dual K H) (u : negWeightSpace P ν) (j : ι) :
    primMap P Λ ν u j = (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm ⁅e P j, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_iff_not_injective_primMap
statement:
theorem exists_injective_iff_not_injective_primMap (Λ ν : Dual K H) :
    (∃ φ : VermaModule P (Λ - ν) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ,
      Function.Injective φ) ↔ ¬Function.Injective (primMap P Λ ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exists_injective_iff, injective_iff_map_eq_zero, not_forall]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hv0, he⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective v
    have hu := (equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace_iff P Λ ν u).mp hv
    refine ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [not_imp]
    refine ⟨funext fun j ↦ ?_, fun h0 ↦ hv0 ?_⟩
    · rw [primMap_apply, he, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    · rw [show u = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val h0, map_zero]
  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    rw [not_imp] at hu
    refine ⟨equivEnvNNeg P Λ u, (equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace_iff P Λ ν u).mpr u.2,
      fun h0 ↦ hu.2 (Subtype.ext ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)), fun j ↦ ?_⟩
    have := congrFun hu.1 j
    rw [primMap_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    simpa using congrArg (equivEnvNNeg P Λ) this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_primMap_eq_add
statement:
theorem exists_primMap_eq_add (ν : Dual K H) (u : negWeightSpace P ν) :
    ∃ ℓ : Dual K H →ₗ[K] (ι → 𝓤₋), ∀ Λ, primMap P Λ ν u = primMap P 0 ν u + ℓ Λ
proof:
:= by
  choose a ℓ h using fun j ↦ exists_affine_lie P (e P j) (u : 𝓤₋)
  refine ⟨LinearMap.pi ℓ, fun Λ ↦ funext fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Pi.add_apply, primMap_apply, primMap_apply, h, h, LinearMap.pi_apply, map_zero, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.primMap_add_sum_smul
statement:
theorem primMap_add_sum_smul (ν μ₀ : Dual K H) (μ : ι → Dual K H) (y : ι → K) :
    primMap P (∑ j, y j • μ j + μ₀) ν =
      primMap P μ₀ ν + ∑ j, y j • (primMap P (μ j) ν - primMap P 0 ν)
proof:
:= by
  ext u : 1
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ := exists_primMap_eq_add P ν u
  have hj : ∀ j, (primMap P (μ j) ν - primMap P 0 ν) u = ℓ (μ j) := fun j ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, hℓ (μ j), add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, hℓ, hℓ μ₀]
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, hj, map_add, map_sum, map_smul]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.corootPairing_ne_zero_of_regular
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isPosRoot_or u j with hu | hu
  · have hu' : ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsLeftDescent u⁻¹ j := by
      rw [CoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_inv_iff]
      exact isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent.mp hu
    obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent hA hx hu'
    rw [corootPairing, hm]
    exact_mod_cast hm0.ne'
  · have hu' : ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsLeftDescent (u * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j)⁻¹ j := by
      rw [CoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_inv_iff]
      exact isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent.mp hu
    obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent hA hx hu'
    have h := corootPairing_mul_simple (P := P) (hA := hA) x u j
    rw [corootPairing, hm] at h
    intro h0
    rw [h0, neg_zero] at h
    exact hm0.ne' (by exact_mod_cast h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.reflectionOf_mul_self_eq
statement:
lemma reflectionOf_mul_self_eq (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (u : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.reflectionOf hA u i * u = u * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ : P.weylGroup hA) =
      (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i := Subtype.ext (P.coxeterSystem_simple hA i).symm
  rw [reflectionOf, hs]
  group

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.reflectionOf_mul
statement:
lemma reflectionOf_mul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (v w : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.reflectionOf hA v i * w = w * P.reflectionOf hA (w⁻¹ * v) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reflectionOf]
  group

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_reflectionOf_of_regular
statement:
theorem exists_injective_reflectionOf_of_regular (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)] {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = z)
    (hreg : ∀ u j, P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) u j ≠ 0)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = n) :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (Λ - n • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) →ₗ⁅K,
      P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ, Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA hint
  set Λ₀ := w₀.val (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho with hΛ₀def
  have hΛ₀ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ₀ := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hw₀ j
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      apply hreg w₀⁻¹ j
      rw [corootPairing, inv_inv]
      exact_mod_cast hm
    refine ⟨m - 1, ?_⟩
    rw [hΛ₀def, LinearMap.sub_apply, hm, rho_coroot,
      Nat.cast_sub (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm0), Nat.cast_one]
  set w := w₀⁻¹
  have hΛw : P.weylDot hA w Λ₀ = Λ := by
    rw [weylDot, hΛ₀def, sub_add_cancel, inv_apply_apply, add_sub_cancel_right]
  set u := w⁻¹ * v
  have hpair : ∀ y : P.weylGroup hA, P.corootPairing hA (w₀.val (Λ + P.rho)) (w₀ * y) i =
      P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) y i := fun y ↦ by
    rw [corootPairing_apply, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
  have hu : P.IsPosRoot hA u i := by
    refine (isPosRoot_or u i).resolve_right fun hneg ↦ ?_
    have hneg' : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent (u * cs.simple i)⁻¹ i := by
      rw [CoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_inv_iff]
      exact isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent.mp hneg
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_nat_of_not_isLeftDescent hA hw₀ hneg'
    have h1 : P.corootPairing hA (w₀.val (Λ + P.rho)) (u * cs.simple i) i = m := hm
    rw [show u = w₀ * v by simp [u, w], mul_assoc, hpair, corootPairing_mul_simple, hn] at h1
    have h2 : (n : K) = 0 := by
      have : ((n + m : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by push_cast; linear_combination -h1
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_eq_zero_iff.mp (by exact_mod_cast this)).1
    exact hreg v i (by rw [hn, h2])
  have hwu : w * u = v := by simp [u]
  have hlen : cs.length w < cs.length (w * P.reflectionOf hA u i) := by
    have hneg : ¬P.IsPosRoot hA (w * P.reflectionOf hA u i * u) i := by
      rw [mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self_eq, ← mul_assoc, hwu]
      exact fun h ↦ not_isPosRoot_and hv h
    have := length_mul_reflectionOf_lt hu hneg
    rwa [mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self, mul_one] at this
  have hbr : cs.BruhatLE w (w * P.reflectionOf hA u i) := by
    refine CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.bruhatLE ⟨?_, hlen⟩
    have hs : (⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ : P.weylGroup hA) =
        cs.simple i := Subtype.ext (P.coxeterSystem_simple hA i).symm
    exact ⟨u, i, by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul, reflectionOf, hs]⟩
  have hdot : P.weylDot hA (w * P.reflectionOf hA u i) Λ₀ =
      Λ - n • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
    rw [show u = w⁻¹ * v from rfl, ← reflectionOf_mul, weylDot_mul, hΛw, weylDot,
      reflectionOf_apply', hn, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K]
    abel
  have := exists_injective_of_bruhatLE hA hΛ₀ hbr
  rwa [hdot, hΛw] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_reflectionOf_of_finrank
statement:
theorem exists_injective_reflectionOf_of_finrank (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)] [FiniteDimensional K H] (hH : finrank K H = Fintype.card ι)
    {Λ : Dual K H} {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = n) :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (Λ - n • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) →ₗ⁅K,
      P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ, Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hA) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn0
  · rw [zero_smul, sub_zero]
    exact ⟨LieModuleHom.id, Function.injective_id⟩
  set ν := n • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
  let b : Basis ι K H := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' P.coroot
    P.linearIndependent_coroot hH.symm
  have hb : ∀ j, b j = P.coroot j := fun j ↦ by simp [b]
  have hϖ : ∀ j k, b.dualBasis j (P.coroot k) = if k = j then 1 else 0 := fun j k ↦ by
    rw [← hb, Basis.dualBasis_apply_self]
  
  let x : (ι → K) → Dual K H := fun y ↦
    (n : K) • b.dualBasis i + ∑ j, (if j = i then 0 else y j) • b.dualBasis j
  have hx : ∀ y k, x y (P.coroot k) = if k = i then (n : K) else y k := fun y k ↦ by
    simp only [x, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, hϖ,
      smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hk : k = i <;> simp [hk]
  let μ : ι → Dual K H := fun j ↦ if j = i then 0 else (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b.dualBasis j)
  let μ₀ : Dual K H := (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ((n : K) • b.dualBasis i) - P.rho
  have hfam : ∀ y, ∑ j, y j • μ j + μ₀ + P.rho = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (x y) := by
    intro y
    have hj : ∀ j, y j • μ j =
        (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ((if j = i then 0 else y j) • b.dualBasis j) := by
      intro j
      by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [μ, h]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ hj j, ← map_sum]
    simp only [μ₀, x, map_add]
    abel
  have hpair : ∀ y, P.corootPairing hA ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (x y)) v i = n := by
    intro y
    rw [corootPairing, inv_apply_apply, hx, ite_eq_left rfl]
  have hint : ∀ y : ι → ℤ, ∀ k, ∃ z : ℤ,
      (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (x fun j ↦ (y j : K)) (P.coroot k) = z := by
    intro y k
    have hxint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, x (fun j ↦ (y j : K)) (P.coroot j) = z := fun j ↦
      ⟨if j = i then n else y j, by rw [hx]; split_ifs <;> simp⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice
      (P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hA v.2 hxint) k
    obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hxint k
    refine ⟨z + z', ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, hz'] at hz
    push_cast
    linear_combination hz
  
  let L : P.weylGroup hA → ι → MvPolynomial ι K := fun u j ↦
    MvPolynomial.C (P.corootPairing hA (μ₀ + P.rho) u j) +
      ∑ l, MvPolynomial.X l * MvPolynomial.C (P.corootPairing hA (μ l) u j)
  let D : MvPolynomial ι K := ∏ u, ∏ j, L u j
  have hL : ∀ y u j, MvPolynomial.eval y (L u j) =
      P.corootPairing hA ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (x y)) u j := by
    intro y u j
    rw [← hfam]
    simp only [L, corootPairing, map_add, map_sum, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_C,
      MvPolynomial.eval_X, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) h0
    simp only [D, map_prod, hL, map_zero, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] at h1
    obtain ⟨u, j, hj⟩ := h1
    rw [corootPairing_apply] at hj
    refine corootPairing_ne_zero_of_regular P hA (fun k ↦ ?_) _ j hj
    refine ⟨if k = i then n - 1 else 0, ?_⟩
    rw [hx]
    split_ifs
    · rw [Nat.cast_sub hn0, Nat.cast_one, sub_add_cancel]
    · simp
  have hnot : ∀ y : ι → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j ↦ (y j : K)) D ≠ 0 →
      ¬Function.Injective (primMap P μ₀ ν +
        ∑ j, (y j : K) • (primMap P (μ j) ν - primMap P 0 ν)) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [← primMap_add_sum_smul, ← exists_injective_iff_not_injective_primMap]
    have hΛy := hfam fun j ↦ (y j : K)
    simp only [D, map_prod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, forall_const] at hy
    refine exists_injective_reflectionOf_of_regular P hA ?_ ?_ hv ?_
    · intro k
      rw [hΛy]
      exact hint y k
    · intro u j
      rw [hΛy, ← hL]
      exact hy u j
    · rw [hΛy, hpair]
  let ystar : ι → K := fun j ↦
    ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot j)
  have hxs : x ystar = ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) := by
    refine b.ext fun k ↦ ?_
    rw [hb, hx]
    split_ifs with hk
    · subst hk
      rw [← hn]
      rfl
    · rfl
  have hstar : ∑ j, ystar j • μ j + μ₀ = Λ := by
    have h1 := hfam ystar
    rw [hxs, apply_inv_apply] at h1
    exact add_right_cancel h1
  have key := LinearMap.not_injective_add_sum_smul_of_forall_int _ _ hD hnot ystar
  rw [← primMap_add_sum_smul, hstar] at key
  exact (exists_injective_iff_not_injective_primMap P Λ ν).mpr key

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_reflectionOf
proof:
:=
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  exists_injective_reflectionOf_of_finrank P hA.isGeneralizedCartan
    (P.finrank_eq_card_of_isFiniteCartan hA) hv hn

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.injective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.injective_of_surjective (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (a : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (ha : Function.Surjective a) : Function.Injective a
proof:
:= by
  have hO := isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV
  obtain ⟨-, hsurj⟩ := IsCategoryO.bijective_of_injective_of_character_eq P hO hO
    (restrictedDualMap P a) (injective_restrictedDualMap P a ha) rfl
  intro x y hxy
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine hV.eq_zero_of_forall_restrictedDual P fun φ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨ψ, rfl⟩ := hsurj φ
  rw [toDual_restrictedDualMap, map_sub, hxy, sub_self, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.exists_retract_of_comp_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_retract_of_comp_ne_zero (hπ : IsProjectiveCover P V π)
    (hVp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) (hXproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P X)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (j : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) (f : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam)
    (hf : f.comp j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (s : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z) (r : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V), r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  have hLO := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hVp hZ hLO (f.comp j) (surjective_of_ne_zero_irreducibleModule P hf) π
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hXproj hπ.isCategoryO hLO π hπ.surjective f
  set a := (p.comp j).comp q with ha
  have hπa : π.comp a = π := by
    refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    have h1 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hp (j (q x))
    have h2 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hq x
    simp only [ha, LieModuleHom.comp_apply] at h1 h2 ⊢
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective a := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    refine hπ.eq_top_of_not_le_ker _ fun hle ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hπ.surjective (IrreducibleModule.hwv P lam)
    have h0 : a x ∈ π.ker := hle ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hπa, hx] at h0
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P lam h0
  let e := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective a
    ⟨IsCategoryO.injective_of_surjective P hπ.isCategoryO a hsurj, hsurj⟩
  refine ⟨q, (e.symm : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V).comp (p.comp j), LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  change e.symm (p (j (q x))) = x
  exact e.symm_apply_apply x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_selfDual
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_selfDual (hπ : IsProjectiveCover P V π)
    (hVp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) (hXproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P X)
    (hX : IsCategoryO P X) {S : Finset X} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set X) = ⊤)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (eZ : Z ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P Z) (j : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (f : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) (hf : f.comp j ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (V ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hVO := hπ.isCategoryO
  have hDO := isCategoryO_restrictedDual hVO
  obtain ⟨s, r, hrs⟩ := hπ.exists_retract_of_comp_ne_zero P hVp hXproj hZ j f hf
  
  obtain ⟨b, c, hbc⟩ : ∃ (b : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P V) (c : restrictedDual P V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z),
      b.comp c = LieModuleHom.id := by
    refine ⟨(restrictedDualMap P s).comp (eZ : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P Z),
      (eZ.symm : restrictedDual P Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z).comp (restrictedDualMap P r),
      LieModuleHom.ext fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
    have h1 : eZ (eZ.symm (restrictedDualMap P r φ)) = restrictedDualMap P r φ :=
      eZ.apply_symm_apply _
    have h2 : restrictedDualMap P s (restrictedDualMap P r φ) = φ :=
      LieModuleHom.congr_fun (congrArg (restrictedDualMap P) hrs) φ
    exact (congrArg (restrictedDualMap P s) h1).trans h2
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hVp.isInjectiveO_restrictedDual P hVO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
    (M := Z) (N := X) hZ hX j hj b
  have hψc : ψ.comp (j.comp c) = LieModuleHom.id := by
    refine LieModuleHom.ext fun φ ↦ ?_
    exact (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ (c φ)).trans (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hbc φ)
  have hDp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (restrictedDual P V) :=
    hXproj.of_retract (j.comp c) ψ hψc
  
  have hDS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (↑(S.image ψ) : Set (restrictedDual P V)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro φ _
    have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set X) ≤
        (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (↑(S.image ψ) : Set (restrictedDual P V))).comap ψ := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
      intro x hx
      exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (by simpa using ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    have hx := hle (hS ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top (j (c φ)))
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_comap] at hx
    have hφ : ψ (j (c φ)) = φ := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψc φ
    rwa [hφ] at hx
  obtain ⟨x₀, -, -, hx₀⟩ := hπ.exists_generator
  have hch : hVO.character = hDO.character := by
    rw [IsCategoryO.character_eq_iff]
    exact fun μ ↦ (multiplicity_restrictedDual hVO μ).symm
  exact IsProjectiveO.nonempty_equiv_of_character_eq P hA hVp hVO (S := {x₀})
    (by simpa using hx₀) hDp hDO hDS hch

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_selfDual
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_selfDual {lam : Dual K H}
    {X Z : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z]
    (hXproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P X)
    (hX : IsCategoryO P X) {S : Finset X} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set X) = ⊤)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (eZ : Z ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P Z) (j : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (f : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) (hf : f.comp j ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (ProjectiveCover P hA lam))
proof:
:=
  (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveCover P lam hA).nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_selfDual P hA
    (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA lam) hXproj hX hS hZ eZ j hj f hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.top_le_iSup_span_of_basis
statement:
lemma top_le_iSup_span_of_basis :
    ⊤ ≤ ⨆ η, Submodule.span K (b '' {k | wt k = η})
proof:
:= by
  rw [← b.span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (wt k) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis
statement:
theorem weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis (ξ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P M ξ = Submodule.span K (b '' {k | wt k = ξ})
proof:
:= by
  have hle (η : Dual K H) : Submodule.span K (b '' {k | wt k = η}) ≤ weightSpace P M η := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact hb k
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (hle ξ)
  exact mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) _ hle hx (top_le_iSup_span_of_basis (b := b) (wt := wt) trivial)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isHDiagonalizable_of_basis
statement: theorem isHDiagonalizable_of_basis : IsHDiagonalizable P M
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr ((top_le_iSup_span_of_basis (b := b) (wt := wt)).trans
    (iSup_mono fun η ↦ ?_))
  rw [weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis hb]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpace_of_basis
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_of_basis (ξ : Dual K H) (hfin : {k | wt k = ξ}.Finite) :
    finrank K (weightSpace P M ξ) = hfin.toFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : b '' {k | wt k = ξ} =
      Set.range (b ∘ (Subtype.val : ↥(hfin.toFinset : Set κ) → κ)) := by
    rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, Set.image_eq_range]
    rfl
  rw [weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis hb, hrange,
    finrank_span_eq_card (b.linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective)]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tmul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_weightSpace {μ ν : Dual K H} {v : V} {w : W} (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P V μ)
    (hw : w ∈ weightSpace P W ν) : v ⊗ₜ[K] w ∈ weightSpace P (V ⊗[K] W) (μ + ν)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [LieModule.lie_tmul_right, hv a, hw a, LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul, smul_tmul',
    tmul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorWeightBasis_mem
statement:
lemma tensorWeightBasis_mem (p : DiagWeightBasisIndex P V × DiagWeightBasisIndex P W) :
    tensorWeightBasis hV hW p ∈ weightSpace P (V ⊗[K] W) (p.1.1 + p.2.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Basis.tensorProduct_apply']
  exact tmul_mem_weightSpace (diagWeightBasis_mem hV p.1) (diagWeightBasis_mem hW p.2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsHDiagonalizable.tensorProduct
statement: theorem IsHDiagonalizable.tensorProduct : IsHDiagonalizable P (V ⊗[K] W)
proof:
:=
  isHDiagonalizable_of_basis (tensorWeightBasis_mem hV hW)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem weightSpace_tensorProduct (ξ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P (V ⊗[K] W) ξ = ⨆ μ, LinearMap.range
      (TensorProduct.map (weightSpace P V μ).subtype (weightSpace P W (ξ - μ)).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup_le fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · rw [weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis (tensorWeightBasis_mem hV hW), Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem p.1.1 ⟨⟨diagWeightBasis hV p.1, diagWeightBasis_mem hV p.1⟩ ⊗ₜ
      ⟨diagWeightBasis hW p.2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have := diagWeightBasis_mem hW p.2
      rwa [show p.2.1 = ξ - p.1.1 by rw [← hp]; abel] at this
    · rw [map_tmul, Basis.tensorProduct_apply']
      rfl
  · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    induction x with
    | tmul v w =>
      have := tmul_mem_weightSpace v.2 w.2
      rwa [add_sub_cancel] at this
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_hsum
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.character_eq_hsum (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {κ : Type*} {b : Basis κ K M}
    {wt : κ → Dual K H} (hb : ∀ k, b k ∈ weightSpace P M (wt k))
    (s : HahnSeries.SummableFamily P.WeightOrd ℤ κ)
    (hs : ∀ k, s k = CharacterRing.exp P ℤ (wt k)) :
    hM.character = s.hsum
proof:
:= by
  ext ξ
  have hset (k : κ) : CharacterRing.coeffAt (s k : P.CharacterRing ℤ) ξ ≠ 0 ↔ wt k = ξ := by
    classical
    rw [hs, CharacterRing.coeff_exp]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp [h, eq_comm]
  have hfin : {k | wt k = ξ}.Finite :=
    (s.finite_co_support (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P ξ)).subset fun k hk ↦ (hset k).mpr hk
  have hsum := HahnSeries.SummableFamily.coeff_hsum_eq_sum_of_subset (s := s)
    (g := WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P ξ) (t := hfin.toFinset)
    (fun k hk ↦ by simpa using (hset k).mp hk)
  rw [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, finrank_weightSpace_of_basis hb ξ hfin]
  change _ = HahnSeries.coeff s.hsum (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P ξ)
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦
    (?_ : CharacterRing.coeffAt (s k : P.CharacterRing ℤ) ξ = 1)]
  · simp
  · classical
    rw [hs, CharacterRing.coeff_exp]
    simp [((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hfin).mp hk).symm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_weightBasisIndex_ne_bot
statement:
lemma weightSpace_weightBasisIndex_ne_bot (hV : IsHDiagonalizable P V)
    (k : DiagWeightBasisIndex P V) :
    weightSpace P V k.1 ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= fun h0 ↦ (diagWeightBasis hV).ne_zero k (by
  have := diagWeightBasis_mem hV k
  rwa [h0, Submodule.mem_bot] at this)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.weightFamily_apply
statement:
lemma weightFamily_apply (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (k : DiagWeightBasisIndex P V) :
    hV.weightFamily k = CharacterRing.exp P ℤ k.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_hsum_weightFamily
statement:
theorem character_eq_hsum_weightFamily (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    hV.character = hV.weightFamily.hsum
proof:
:=
  hV.character_eq_hsum (diagWeightBasis_mem hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top) _
    hV.weightFamily_apply

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.tensorProduct
statement: theorem tensorProduct : IsCategoryO P (V ⊗[K] W)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := tensorWeightBasis_mem hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top hW.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  have hfin (ξ : Dual K H) : {p : DiagWeightBasisIndex P V × DiagWeightBasisIndex P W |
      p.1.1 + p.2.1 = ξ}.Finite := by
    refine ((hV.weightFamily.mul hW.weightFamily).finite_co_support
      (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P ξ)).subset fun p hp ↦ ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, HahnSeries.SummableFamily.mul_toFun, weightFamily_apply,
      ← CharacterRing.exp_add] at hp ⊢
    change CharacterRing.coeffAt (CharacterRing.exp P ℤ (p.1.1 + p.2.1)) ξ ≠ 0
    rw [hp, CharacterRing.coeff_exp_self]
    exact one_ne_zero
  refine ⟨IsHDiagonalizable.tensorProduct hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
    hW.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top, fun ξ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · change FiniteDimensional K (weightSpace P _ ξ)
    rw [weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis hb]
    exact FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite K ((hfin ξ).image _)
  · classical
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hV.exists_finset
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hW.exists_finset
    refine ⟨(s ×ˢ t).image fun x ↦ x.1 + x.2, fun ξ hξ ↦ ?_⟩
    change weightSpace P _ ξ ≠ ⊥ at hξ
    rw [weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis hb] at hξ
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : DiagWeightBasisIndex P V × DiagWeightBasisIndex P W,
        p.1.1 + p.2.1 = ξ := by
      by_contra! h
      apply hξ
      rw [Submodule.span_eq_bot]
      rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      exact absurd hq (h q)
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, c, hc, hμ⟩ :=
      hs p.1.1 (weightSpace_weightBasisIndex_ne_bot hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top p.1)
    obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', c', hc', hν⟩ :=
      ht p.2.1 (weightSpace_weightBasisIndex_ne_bot hW.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top p.2)
    refine ⟨Λ + Λ', Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(Λ, Λ'), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hΛ, hΛ'⟩, rfl⟩,
      c + c', add_nonneg hc hc', ?_⟩
    rw [← hp, hμ, hν, map_add]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem character_tensorProduct :
    (hV.tensorProduct hW).character = hV.character * hW.character
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hV.tensorProduct hW).character_eq_hsum
      (tensorWeightBasis_mem hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top hW.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top)
      (hV.weightFamily.mul hW.weightFamily) fun p ↦ by
        rw [HahnSeries.SummableFamily.mul_toFun, weightFamily_apply, weightFamily_apply,
          CharacterRing.exp_add],
    HahnSeries.SummableFamily.hsum_mul, ← character_eq_hsum_weightFamily,
    ← character_eq_hsum_weightFamily]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.sumIrreducibleCharacter_multiplicities_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem sumIrreducibleCharacter_multiplicities_tensorProduct :
    sumIrreducibleCharacter P (hV.tensorProduct hW).multiplicities =
      hV.character * hW.character
proof:
:= by
  rw [← character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, character_tensorProduct]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_pow_toEnd_tensorProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_toEnd_tensorProduct_eq_zero (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (hV : ∀ v : V, ∃ n : ℕ, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V x ^ n) v = 0)
    (hW : ∀ w : W, ∃ n : ℕ, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W x ^ n) w = 0) (t : V ⊗[K] W) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (V ⊗[K] W) x ^ n) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  set X := toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V x
  set Y := toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W x
  set T := toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (V ⊗[K] W) x
  have hT : T = X.rTensor W + Y.lTensor V := LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hcomm : Commute (X.rTensor W) (Y.lTensor V) := by
    change _ * _ = _ * _
    rw [Module.End.mul_eq_comp, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor,
      LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor]
  have hpow {Z : Module.End K V} {v : V} {a n : ℕ} (ha : (Z ^ a) v = 0) (h : a ≤ n) :
      (Z ^ n) v = 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, map_zero]
  have hpow' {Z : Module.End K W} {w : W} {a n : ℕ} (ha : (Z ^ a) w = 0) (h : a ≤ n) :
      (Z ^ n) w = 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, map_zero]
  suffices t ∈ T.maxGenEigenspace 0 by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace _ _ _).mp this
    exact ⟨k, by simpa using hk⟩
  induction t with
  | tmul v w =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hV v
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hW w
    refine (Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace _ _ _).mpr ⟨a + b, ?_⟩
    rw [zero_smul, sub_zero, hT, hcomm.add_pow', LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m hm ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hm
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_pow, LinearMap.lTensor_pow,
      LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul]
    rcases le_or_gt a m.1 with h | h
    · rw [hpow ha h, zero_tmul, smul_zero]
    · rw [hpow' hb (by omega), tmul_zero, smul_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsIntegrable.tensorProduct
statement:
theorem IsIntegrable.tensorProduct (hV : IsIntegrable P V) (hW : IsIntegrable P W) :
    IsIntegrable P (V ⊗[K] W) where
  isHDiagonalizable
proof:
:= hV.isHDiagonalizable.tensorProduct hW.isHDiagonalizable
  exists_pow_e_eq_zero i :=
    exists_pow_toEnd_tensorProduct_eq_zero _ (hV.exists_pow_e_eq_zero i) (hW.exists_pow_e_eq_zero i)
  exists_pow_f_eq_zero i :=
    exists_pow_toEnd_tensorProduct_eq_zero _ (hV.exists_pow_f_eq_zero i) (hW.exists_pow_f_eq_zero i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exists_isInternal_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.exists_isInternal_tensorProduct [FiniteDimensional K H]
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hS : A.IsSymmetrizable) {Λ Λ' : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) (hΛ' : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ') :
    ∃ s : Set (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
        (IrreducibleModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P Λ')),
      DirectSum.IsInternal (fun N : s ↦
        (N : Submodule K (IrreducibleModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P Λ'))) ∧
      ∀ N ∈ s, ∃ Λ'', P.IsDominantIntegral Λ'' ∧
        Nonempty (N ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ'')
proof:
:=
  IsCategoryO.exists_isInternal_irreducibleModule hA hS
    ((isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct (isCategoryO P Λ'))
    (((isIntegrable_iff P hA).mpr hΛ).tensorProduct ((isIntegrable_iff P hA).mpr hΛ'))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_ne {μ ν : Dual K H}
    {u w : IrreducibleModule P Λ} (hu : u ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) μ)
    (hw : w ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) ν) (hne : μ ≠ ν) :
    IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm P Λ u w = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, μ a ≠ ν a := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hne (LinearMap.ext hc)
  have h1 := IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_lie_left P Λ (h P a) u w
  rw [transpose_h, hu a, hw a, map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h2 : (μ a - ν a) * IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm P Λ u w = 0 := by
    linear_combination h1
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.toDual_toRestrictedDualSelf
statement:
@[simp] lemma IrreducibleModule.toDual_toRestrictedDualSelf (u w : IrreducibleModule P Λ) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P _ (IrreducibleModule.toRestrictedDualSelf P Λ u).val w =
      IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm P Λ u w
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_centralTranslation {ν : Dual K H}
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    Nonempty (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂ (IrreducibleModule P Λ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      restrictedDual P (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂
        (IrreducibleModule P Λ)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨((restrictedDualCentralTranslationEquiv P hA hν (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ) χ₁
    χ₂).trans (centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂
      (IrreducibleModule.equivRestrictedDual P Λ).symm)).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_coroot_nat_of_not_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem exists_apply_coroot_nat_of_not_isLeftDescent
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : P.IsDominantIntegral μ)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι}
    (hw : ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsLeftDescent w i) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, w.val μ (P.coroot i) = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA w.2 (μ := μ) fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hμ j
    exact ⟨n, by rw [hn]; norm_cast⟩
  obtain ⟨nᵢ, hnᵢ⟩ := hμ i
  set z : ℤ := nᵢ + (A *ᵥ k) i
  have hc : w.val μ (P.coroot i) = z := by
    rw [hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hnᵢ, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast [z]
    rfl
  have hw' : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w⁻¹ i := by rwa [cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff]
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hw'
  set v := w⁻¹ * cs.simple i * w
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hvm⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA hμ v
  have hv : v.val μ = μ - (z : K) • P.rootOf l := by
    simp only [v, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple, cs]
    rw [reflection_apply, hc, map_sub, map_smul, hwl]
    congr 1
    exact w.val.symm_apply_apply μ
  have h2 : P.rootOf (z • l) = (z : K) • P.rootOf l := by
    rw [map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
  rw [hv, sub_sub_cancel, ← h2] at hvm
  have hml : z • l = m := P.rootOf_injective hvm
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hwl
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hwl
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, l j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hl0 (funext h)
  have hlj : 0 < l j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hl j) (Ne.symm hj)
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := by
    have h1 := congrFun hml j
    have h2 := hm j
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨z.toNat, hc.trans ?_⟩
  exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz0).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_dotDominantIntegral_weylDot
statement:
theorem exists_dotDominantIntegral_weylDot
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)]
    {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = z) :
    ∃ Λ', P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ' + P.rho) ∧
      ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, Λ = P.weylDot hA w Λ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA hΛ
  refine ⟨w.val (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho, ?_, w⁻¹, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hw
  · simp [weylDot]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_weylDot_of_dotDominant
statement:
theorem exists_injective_weylDot_of_dotDominant
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ + P.rho)) (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ,
      Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  induction hl : cs.length w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ l ih =>
    subst hl
    by_cases hw1 : w = 1
    · subst hw1
      rw [weylDot_one]
      exact ⟨LieModuleHom.id, Function.injective_id⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw1
    have hsl := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hs
    set w' := cs.simple s * w
    have hww' : w = cs.simple s * w' := (cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left s).symm
    have hw' : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent w' s := by
      rwa [← cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul]
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := ih _ (by omega) w' rfl
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_nat_of_not_isLeftDescent hA hΛ hw'
    have hn' : (P.weylDot hA w' Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot s) = n := by
      rwa [weylDot_add_rho]
    rw [hww', weylDot_simple_mul]
    by_cases hn0 : n = 0
    · have heq : P.reflection hA s (P.weylDot hA w' Λ + P.rho) - P.rho =
          P.weylDot hA w' Λ := by
        rw [P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn', hn0, zero_nsmul, sub_zero]
      rw [heq]
      exact ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    · obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, -⟩ := exists_injective_reflection P hA (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) hn'
      exact ⟨φ.comp ψ, hφ.comp hψ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weylDot_mem_cone_of_dotDominant
statement:
theorem weylDot_mem_cone_of_dotDominant
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ + P.rho)) (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    P.weylDot hA w Λ ∈ cone P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA hΛ w
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  rw [← hwk, weylDot]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.multiplicity_weylDot_ne_zero_of_dotDominant
statement:
theorem multiplicity_weylDot_ne_zero_of_dotDominant
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ + P.rho)) (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    (isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity (P.weylDot hA w Λ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_injective_weylDot_of_dotDominant P hA hΛ w
  refine multiplicity_ne_zero_of_hom_ne_zero P (φ := φ) fun h ↦ hwv_ne_zero P _ (hφ ?_)
  rw [h, map_zero, _root_.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_dotDominant_of_integral
statement:
theorem exists_injective_dotDominant_of_integral
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)]
    (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = z) :
    ∃ Λ', P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ' + P.rho) ∧
      (∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, Λ = P.weylDot hA w Λ') ∧
      ∃ φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ',
        Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', w, hw⟩ := P.exists_dotDominantIntegral_weylDot hA hΛ
  refine ⟨Λ', hΛ', ⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [hw]
  exact exists_injective_weylDot_of_dotDominant P hA hΛ' w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_le_of_injective
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_le_of_injective {Λ Λ' : Dual K H} (μ : Dual K H)
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ')
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) ≤
      finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ')
proof:
:= by
  let Φ : (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) →ₗ[K]
      (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ') :=
    { toFun := fun ψ ↦ φ.comp ψ
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ map_add φ _ _
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ map_smul φ _ _ }
  exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective
    (show Function.Injective Φ from fun ψ ψ' h ↦
      LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ hφ (LieModuleHom.congr_fun h m))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_dotDominant_hom_bound_of_finite_type_integral
statement:
theorem exists_dotDominant_hom_bound_of_finite_type_integral
    (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) (Λ : Dual K H)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = z) :
    ∃ Λ', P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ' + P.rho) ∧
      (∃ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
        Λ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ') ∧
      ∀ μ : Dual K H,
        finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) ≤
          finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ')
proof:
:= by
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', hw, φ, hφ⟩ :=
    exists_injective_dotDominant_of_integral P hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ hΛ
  exact ⟨Λ', hΛ', hw, fun μ ↦ finrank_hom_le_of_injective P μ φ hφ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace
statement:
theorem hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace (F : Submodule K Z) {z : Z} (hz : z ∈ F) :
    hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ F
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm 1 ⊗ₜ[K]
    (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) F).symm ⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [tensorSubspaceMap, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, TensorProduct.LieModule.map_tmul]
  exact tensorEquivLeftRegular_one P Λ z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorSubspace_le
statement:
theorem tensorSubspace_le (F : Submodule K Z)
    (N : LieSubmodule K (nNeg P) (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z))
    (hN : ∀ z ∈ F, hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z ∈ N) : tensorSubspace P Λ F ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  rintro t ⟨s, rfl⟩
  suffices h : ∀ (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P))
      (z : TrivialLieModule K (nNeg P) F),
      tensorSubspaceMap P Λ F ((LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm u ⊗ₜ[K] z) ∈ N by
    induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul u z => simpa using h (LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P) u) z
    | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add]; exact N.add_mem hs ht
  intro u
  induction u using TensorIdentity.induction_left with
  | hone =>
    intro z
    simp only [tensorSubspaceMap, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, TensorProduct.LieModule.map_tmul]
    change tensorEquivLeftRegular P Λ
      ((LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm 1 ⊗ₜ[K]
        (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) Z).symm
          (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) F z).val) ∈ N
    rw [tensorEquivLeftRegular_one]
    exact hN _ (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) F z).property
  | hadd a b ha hb => intro z; simp only [map_add, add_tmul]; exact N.add_mem (ha z) (hb z)
  | hsmul r a ha =>
    intro z
    simp only [map_smul, ← smul_tmul']
    exact N.smul_mem r (ha z)
  | hι x a ha =>
    intro z
    have heq : (LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K x * a)
        ⊗ₜ[K] z = ⁅x, (LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm a ⊗ₜ[K] z⁆ := by
      simp only [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, trivial_lie_zero, tmul_zero,
        add_zero]
      rfl
    rw [heq, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
    exact N.lie_mem (ha z)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace
statement:
theorem lie_hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace (F : LieSubmodule K (borel P) Z)
    (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) {z : Z} (hz : z ∈ F) :
    ⁅x, hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z⁆ ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, a, w, rfl⟩ := exists_triangular P x
  rw [add_lie, add_lie]
  refine (tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule).add_mem
    ((tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule).add_mem ?_ ?_) ?_
  · exact (tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule).lie_mem
      (x := ⟨fHom P y, ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩) (hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ _ hz)
  · rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, lie_h_hwv, ← smul_tmul']
    exact (tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule).add_mem
      ((tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule).smul_mem _
        (hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ _ hz))
      (hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ _
        (F.lie_mem (x := ⟨h P a, h_mem_borel P a⟩) hz))
  · rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right,
      lie_hwv_of_mem_nPos P Λ (show eHom P w ∈ nPos P from ⟨w, rfl⟩),
      zero_tmul, zero_add]
    exact hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ _
      (F.lie_mem (x := ⟨eHom P w, nPos_le_borel P ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩) hz)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_mem_tensorSubspace
statement:
theorem lie_mem_tensorSubspace (F : LieSubmodule K (borel P) Z)
    (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) {t : VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z}
    (ht : t ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule) :
    ⁅x, t⁆ ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
