  let N := tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule
  let D : LieSubmodule K (nNeg P) (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z) :=
    { carrier := {t | ∀ x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra, ⁅x, t⁆ ∈ N}
      zero_mem' := by intro x; rw [lie_zero]; exact N.zero_mem
      add_mem' := by
        intro s t hs ht x
        rw [lie_add]
        exact N.add_mem (hs x) (ht x)
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c t ht x
        rw [lie_smul]
        exact N.smul_mem c (ht x)
      lie_mem := by
        intro y t ht x
        change ⁅x, ⁅(y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), t⁆⁆ ∈ N
        rw [leibniz_lie]
        exact N.add_mem (ht ⁅x, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆) (N.lie_mem (ht x)) }
  have hD : tensorSubspace P Λ F.toSubmodule ≤ D :=
    tensorSubspace_le P Λ _ D (fun z hz x => lie_hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ F x hz)
  exact hD ht x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_mem_tensorSubspace_of_generators
statement:
theorem lie_mem_tensorSubspace_of_generators (F : Submodule K Z)
    (he : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ F, ⁅e P i, z⁆ ∈ F)
    (hh : ∀ a, ∀ z ∈ F, ⁅h P a, z⁆ ∈ F)
    (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) {t : VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z}
    (ht : t ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ F) : ⁅x, t⁆ ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ F
proof:
:=
  lie_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ (borelSubmoduleOfGenerators P F he hh) x ht

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorBorelSubmodule_mono
statement: theorem tensorBorelSubmodule_mono : Monotone (tensorBorelSubmodule (Z := Z) P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro F G hFG
  exact tensorSubspace_mono P Λ hFG

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorBorelSubmodule_top
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorBorelSubmodule_top : tensorBorelSubmodule (Z := Z) P Λ ⊤ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  change t ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ (⊤ : Submodule K Z) ↔ _
  rw [tensorSubspace_top]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorSubspace_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorSubspace_bot : tensorSubspace (Z := Z) P Λ ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  apply tensorSubspace_le
  intro z hz
  have hz0 : z = 0 := hz
  rw [hz0, tmul_zero]
  exact LieSubmodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorBorelSubmodule_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorBorelSubmodule_bot : tensorBorelSubmodule (Z := Z) P Λ ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  change t ∈ tensorSubspace P Λ (⊥ : Submodule K Z) ↔ _
  rw [tensorSubspace_bot]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hom_ext_nNeg
statement:
theorem hom_ext_nNeg {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule (nNeg P) V] [LieModule K (nNeg P) V]
    {f g : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,nNeg P⁆ V} (hfg : f (hwv P Λ) = g (hwv P Λ)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective m
  induction u using TensorIdentity.induction_left with
  | hone => simpa using hfg
  | hadd u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, hu, hv]
  | hsmul c u hu => simp only [map_smul, hu]
  | hι x u hu =>
    have heq : equivEnvNNeg P Λ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K x * u) =
        ⁅x, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆ :=
      (equivLeftRegular P Λ).map_lie x ((LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm u)
    rw [heq, f.map_lie, g.map_lie, hu]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorCoefficientProbe_seed
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorCoefficientProbe_seed (ℓ : Z →ₗ[K] K) (z : Z) :
    tensorCoefficientProbe P Λ ℓ (hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z) =
      ℓ z • (LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorCoefficientProbe
  simp only [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom]
  rw [← tensorEquivLeftRegular_one P Λ z, LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorSubspace_le_ker_probe
statement:
theorem tensorSubspace_le_ker_probe (F : Submodule K Z) (ℓ : Z →ₗ[K] K)
    (hℓ : F ≤ LinearMap.ker ℓ) : tensorSubspace P Λ F ≤ (tensorCoefficientProbe P Λ ℓ).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply tensorSubspace_le
  intro z hz
  change tensorCoefficientProbe P Λ ℓ (hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z) = 0
  rw [tensorCoefficientProbe_seed, show ℓ z = 0 from hℓ hz, zero_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_hwv
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_hwv (F : LieSubmodule K (borel P) Z)
    (μ : Module.Dual K H) (z : Z)
    (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, z⁆ ∈ F) (hh : ∀ a, ⁅h P a, z⁆ - μ a • z ∈ F) :
    shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient P Λ F μ z he hh (hwv P (Λ + μ)) =
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (tensorBorelSubmodule P Λ F) (hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient
  rw [lift_hwv]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_injective
statement:
theorem shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_injective (F : LieSubmodule K (borel P) Z)
    (μ : Module.Dual K H) (z : Z) (hz : z ∉ F)
    (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, z⁆ ∈ F) (hh : ∀ a, ⁅h P a, z⁆ - μ a • z ∈ F) :
    Function.Injective (shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient P Λ F μ z he hh)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓz, hℓ⟩ := F.toSubmodule.exists_le_ker_of_notMem hz
  let φ := shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient P Λ F μ z he hh
  have hcomp : (quotientCoefficientProbe P Λ F ℓ hℓ).comp (φ.restrictLie (nNeg P)) =
      ℓ z • (equivLeftRegular P (Λ + μ)).symm.toLieModuleHom := by
    apply hom_ext_nNeg
    change quotientCoefficientProbe P Λ F ℓ hℓ
      (shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient P Λ F μ z he hh (hwv P (Λ + μ))) = _
    rw [shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_hwv]
    change tensorCoefficientProbe P Λ ℓ (hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z) = _
    rw [tensorCoefficientProbe_seed]
    congr 1
    apply (equivLeftRegular P (Λ + μ)).injective
    simp [equivLeftRegular]
  intro u v huv
  have heq := congrArg (quotientCoefficientProbe P Λ F ℓ hℓ) huv
  change ((quotientCoefficientProbe P Λ F ℓ hℓ).comp (φ.restrictLie (nNeg P))) u =
    ((quotientCoefficientProbe P Λ F ℓ hℓ).comp (φ.restrictLie (nNeg P))) v at heq
  rw [hcomp] at heq
  exact (equivLeftRegular P (Λ + μ)).symm.injective ((smul_right_injective _ hℓz) heq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.range_shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient
statement:
theorem range_shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient (F G : LieSubmodule K (borel P) Z)
    (μ : Module.Dual K H) (z : Z) (hzG : z ∈ G)
    (hG : ∀ w ∈ G, ∃ f ∈ F, ∃ c : K, w = f + c • z)
    (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, z⁆ ∈ F) (hh : ∀ a, ⁅h P a, z⁆ - μ a • z ∈ F) :
    (shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient P Λ F μ z he hh).range = tensorBorelStep P Λ F G
proof:
:= by
  let φ := shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient P Λ F μ z he hh
  let q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (tensorBorelSubmodule P Λ F)
  apply le_antisymm
  · have htop : (tensorBorelStep P Λ F G).comap φ = ⊤ := by
      apply eq_top_of_hwv_mem
      change φ (hwv P (Λ + μ)) ∈ tensorBorelStep P Λ F G
      rw [shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_hwv]
      exact ⟨hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z, hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ _ hzG, rfl⟩
    rintro t ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact show m ∈ (tensorBorelStep P Λ F G).comap φ from htop ▸ trivial
  · have hle : tensorSubspace P Λ G.toSubmodule ≤
        (φ.range.comap q).restr (nNeg P) := by
      apply tensorSubspace_le
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨f, hf, c, rfl⟩ := hG w hw
      change q (hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] (f + c • z)) ∈ φ.range
      rw [tmul_add, tmul_smul, map_add, map_smul]
      have hf0 : q (hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] f) = 0 :=
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ _ hf)
      rw [hf0, zero_add]
      exact φ.range.smul_mem c ⟨hwv P (Λ + μ), shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_hwv P Λ F μ z he hh⟩
    rintro t ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact hle hs

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_directSum_eq_top
statement:
theorem centralBlock_directSum_eq_top {κ : Type*} {Q : κ → Type*} [∀ j, AddCommGroup (Q j)]
    [∀ j, Module K (Q j)] [∀ j, LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Q j)]
    [∀ j, LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Q j)] (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (h : ∀ j, centralBlock P (Q j) χ = ⊤) : centralBlock P (⨁ j, Q j) χ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | of j q =>
    exact map_mem_centralBlock P (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q j) χ
      (by rw [h j]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top q)
  | add x y hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveGeneratorO.exists_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_surjective (hQ : IsProjectiveGeneratorO P Q χ) {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    {S : Finset M} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hMχ : centralBlock P M χ = ⊤) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ π : (⨁ _ : Fin n, Q) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M, Function.Surjective π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M := ⨆ φ : Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M, φ.range with hNdef
  have hN : N = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hne)
    have : Nontrivial (M ⧸ N) := ⟨⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N x, 0, fun h ↦ hx (by
      rwa [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'] at h)⟩⟩
    have hMN : IsCategoryO P (M ⧸ N) := hM.quotient N
    have hSN := lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N) hS
    rw [← Finset.coe_image] at hSN
    obtain ⟨μ, p, hp⟩ := hMN.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA hSN
    set q := p.comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)
    have hq : Function.Surjective q := hp.comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N)
    have hμ : centralCharacter P μ = χ := by
      by_contra hne'
      have h1 : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P μ) χ = ⊤ := eq_top_iff.2 fun y _ ↦ by
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hq y
        exact map_mem_centralBlock P q χ (by rw [hMχ]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top m)
      rw [centralBlock_eq_bot_of_ne P hne' (centralBlock_irreducible P μ)] at h1
      have : IrreducibleModule.hwv P μ ∈ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (IrreducibleModule P μ)) :=
        h1 ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _
      exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P μ ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).1 this)
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hQ.exists_ne_zero μ hμ
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hQ.isFGProjectiveO.isProjectiveO hM (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ) q
      hq f
    apply hf
    rw [← hφ]
    refine LieModuleHom.ext fun v ↦ ?_
    have hv : φ v ∈ N := (le_iSup (fun φ : Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M ↦ φ.range) φ) ⟨v, rfl⟩
    change p (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (φ v)) = 0
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'.2 hv, map_zero]
  have := hM.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := WellFoundedGT.isSupFiniteCompact
    (Set.range fun φ : Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M ↦ φ.range)
  choose φ hφ using fun a : t ↦ ht a.2
  let e := t.equivFin
  refine ⟨t.card, toLieModule fun i ↦ φ (e.symm i), ?_⟩
  rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top, range_toLieModule, e.symm.iSup_comp (g := fun a ↦ (φ a).range)]
  simp_rw [hφ]
  have ht' : (⨆ y : t, (y : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M)) = t.sup _root_.id := by
    rw [Finset.sup_id_eq_sSup, sSup_eq_iSup']
    rfl
  rw [ht', ← hts, sSup_range, ← hNdef, hN]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveGeneratorO.homMap_bijective
statement:
theorem homMap_bijective (hQ : IsProjectiveGeneratorO P Q χ) {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    {S : Finset M} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hMχ : centralBlock P M χ = ⊤) (N : Type*) [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 N] [LieModule K 𝔤 N] :
    Function.Bijective (homMap (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (M := M) (N := N) Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, π, hπ⟩ := hQ.exists_surjective hA hM hS hMχ
  have hQn : IsCategoryO P (⨁ _ : Fin n, Q) :=
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun _ ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.isCategoryO
  have hQnχ : centralBlock P (⨁ _ : Fin n, Q) χ = ⊤ :=
    centralBlock_directSum_eq_top P χ fun _ ↦ hQ.centralBlock_eq_top
  refine LieModuleHom.homMap_bijective π hπ
    (fun φ ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.isProjectiveO hQn hM π hπ φ) ?_
  obtain ⟨Sn, hSn⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top
    fun _ : Fin n ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.fg
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hQn.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hSn
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top_of_strictMono
    (π.ker.strictMono_map_incl hf)
  have hKχ : centralBlock P π.ker χ = ⊤ := eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦
    mem_centralBlock_of_injective P π.ker.incl Subtype.val_injective χ
      (by rw [hQnχ]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top _)
  obtain ⟨m, σ, hσ⟩ := hQ.exists_surjective hA (hQn.lieSubmodule π.ker) hT hKχ
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hσ ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hx' : x = π.ker.incl (σ y) := by rw [hy]; rfl
  rw [hx', ← DirectSum.sum_univ_of y, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine sum_mem fun j _ ↦ ?_
  set ψ := π.ker.incl.comp (σ.comp (lieModuleOf K (Fin m) 𝔤 (fun _ ↦ Q) j))
  have hψ : π.comp ψ = 0 := LieModuleHom.ext fun q ↦ (σ _).2
  exact LieSubmodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ψ (LieSubmodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hψ ⟨y j, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveGeneratorO.homMapEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem homMapEquiv_apply (hQ : IsProjectiveGeneratorO P Q χ) {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    {S : Finset M} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hMχ : centralBlock P M χ = ⊤) {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 N] [LieModule K 𝔤 N] (f : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    hQ.homMapEquiv hA hM hS hMχ N f = homMap Q f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveGeneratorO.exists_linearEquiv_homMap
statement:
theorem exists_linearEquiv_homMap (hQ : IsProjectiveGeneratorO P Q χ) (X : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ X] [Module K X]
    [IsScalarTower K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ X] [FiniteDimensional K X] :
    ∃ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) (_ : AddCommGroup M) (_ : Module K M) (_ : LieRingModule 𝔤 M)
      (_ : LieModule K 𝔤 M), IsCategoryO P M ∧
      (∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) ∧ centralBlock P M χ = ⊤ ∧
      Nonempty (X ≃ₗ[(Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ] (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let n := finrank K X
  let bX : Basis (Fin n) K X := Module.finBasis K X
  have hx : Submodule.span (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range bX) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro v _
    have hv : v ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range bX) := by rw [bX.span_eq]; trivial
    exact Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ _ hv
  have hQn : IsCategoryO P (⨁ _ : Fin n, Q) :=
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun _ ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.isCategoryO
  have : FiniteDimensional K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ⨁ _ : Fin n, Q) :=
    hQ.isFGProjectiveO.finiteDimensional_hom hQn
  set F := homDirectSumToModule (R := K) (L := 𝔤) Q bX
  set Kr := (LinearMap.ker F).restrictScalars K
  let bK := Module.finBasis K Kr
  let y : Fin (finrank K Kr) → (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ⨁ _ : Fin n, Q) := fun i ↦ (bK i : _)
  have hy : Submodule.span (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range y) = LinearMap.ker F := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact (bK i).2
    · intro v hv
      have h1 : (⟨v, hv⟩ : Kr) ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range bK) := by rw [bK.span_eq]; trivial
      have h2 := Submodule.apply_mem_span_image_of_mem_span Kr.subtype h1
      have hr : Kr.subtype '' Set.range bK = Set.range y := by rw [← Set.range_comp]; rfl
      rw [hr] at h2
      exact Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)ᵐᵒᵖ _ h2
  set α := toLieModule y
  have hQm : IsCategoryO P (⨁ _ : Fin (finrank K Kr), Q) :=
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun _ ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.isCategoryO
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_linearEquiv_homMap bX hx y hy
    (fun φ ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.isProjectiveO hQn (hQn.quotient α.range)
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' α.range) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' α.range) φ)
    (fun φ ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.isProjectiveO hQm (hQn.lieSubmodule α.range) _
      (by rintro ⟨_, z, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩) φ)
  obtain ⟨Sn, hSn⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top
    fun _ : Fin n ↦ hQ.isFGProjectiveO.fg
  have hQnχ : centralBlock P (⨁ _ : Fin n, Q) χ = ⊤ :=
    centralBlock_directSum_eq_top P χ fun _ ↦ hQ.centralBlock_eq_top
  refine ⟨_, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, hQn.quotient α.range,
    ⟨Sn.image (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' α.range), ?_⟩, ?_, ⟨e⟩⟩
  · rw [Finset.coe_image]
    exact lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective _ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) hSn
  · refine eq_top_iff.2 fun z _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' α.range z
    exact map_mem_centralBlock P _ χ (by rw [hQnχ]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top v)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isProjectiveGeneratorO_directSum
statement:
theorem isProjectiveGeneratorO_directSum {κ : Type u₂} [Finite κ] (μ : κ → Dual K H)
    {χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hμ : ∀ i, centralCharacter P (μ i) = χ)
    (hsurj : ∀ ν, centralCharacter P ν = χ → ∃ i, μ i = ν) :
    IsProjectiveGeneratorO P (⨁ i, ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (⨁ i, ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) :=
    IsProjectiveO.directSum fun i ↦ ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA (μ i)
  have h2 : IsCategoryO P (⨁ i, ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) :=
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun i ↦ ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA (μ i)
  have h3 : ∃ S : Finset (⨁ i, ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)),
      LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set (⨁ i, ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i))) = ⊤ :=
    exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top fun i ↦ (ProjectiveCover.isFGProjectiveO P hA (μ i)).fg
  have h4 : centralBlock P (⨁ i, ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) χ = ⊤ :=
    centralBlock_directSum_eq_top P χ fun i ↦ by
      rw [← hμ i]; exact ProjectiveCover.centralBlock_eq_top P hA (μ i)
  have h5 : IsFGProjectiveO P (⨁ i, ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) := ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  refine ⟨h5, h4, fun ν hν ↦ ?_⟩
  clear h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hsurj ν hν
  refine ⟨(ProjectiveCover.π P hA (μ i)).comp
    (lieModuleComponent K κ 𝔤 (fun i ↦ ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) i), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ProjectiveCover.surjective_π P hA (μ i) (IrreducibleModule.hwv P (μ i))
  apply IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P (μ i)
  have hc : lieModuleComponent K κ 𝔤 (fun i ↦ ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) i
      (DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ ProjectiveCover P hA (μ i)) i x) = x := by
    simp [lieModuleComponent, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of K]
  rw [← hx]
  exact (congrArg (ProjectiveCover.π P hA (μ i)) hc.symm).trans
    ((LieModuleHom.congr_fun h _).trans (_root_.zero_apply _))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isProjectiveGeneratorO_weylDot
statement:
theorem isProjectiveGeneratorO_weylDot (Λ : Dual K H) :
    IsProjectiveGeneratorO P
      (⨁ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
        ProjectiveCover P hA (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ))
      (centralCharacter P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  refine isProjectiveGeneratorO_directSum P hA _ (fun w ↦ ?_) fun ν hν ↦ ?_
  · exact ((VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA _ _).2
      ⟨w, w.2, (P.weylDot_add_rho _ w Λ).symm⟩).symm
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwν⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA _ _).1 hν.symm
    exact ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, add_right_cancel ((P.weylDot_add_rho _ _ Λ).trans hwν)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.f_mem_rootSpace
statement: lemma f_mem_rootSpace (i : ι) : f P i ∈ rootSpace P (-P.root i)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [lie_h_f, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma fWord_nil : fWord P [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWord_cons
statement: lemma fWord_cons (j : ι) (w : List ι) : fWord P (j :: w) = ιᵤ (f P j) * fWord P w
proof:
:= by
  simp [fWord]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma hwv_mem_weightSpace : hwv P Λ ∈ weightSpace P Λ Λ
proof: := fun a ↦ lie_h_hwv P Λ a

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWord_smul_cons
statement:
lemma fWord_smul_cons (j : ι) (w : List ι) :
    fWord P (j :: w) • hwv P Λ = ⁅f P j, fWord P w • hwv P Λ⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [fWord_cons, mul_smul, lie_eq_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace (w : List ι) :
    fWord P w • hwv P Λ ∈ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - wt w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [fWord_smul_cons]
    convert lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (f_mem_rootSpace P j) ih using 2
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.wordSpan_le_weightSpace
statement: lemma wordSpan_le_weightSpace (μ : Dual K H) : wordSpan P Λ μ ≤ weightSpace P Λ μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_mem_span_of_forall
statement:
lemma lie_mem_span_of_forall {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] {s : Set M}
    {y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hs : ∀ m ∈ s, ⁅y, m⁆ ∈ Submodule.span K s) :
    ∀ m ∈ Submodule.span K s, ⁅y, m⁆ ∈ Submodule.span K s
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem m hm => exact hs m hm
  | zero => simp
  | add m n _ _ hm hn => rw [lie_add]; exact add_mem hm hn
  | smul c m _ hm => rw [lie_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_h_mem_fWordSpan
statement:
lemma lie_h_mem_fWordSpan (a : H) :
    ∀ m ∈ fWordSpan P Λ, ⁅h P a, m⁆ ∈ fWordSpan P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine lie_mem_span_of_forall P ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ w a]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_f_mem_fWordSpan
statement:
lemma lie_f_mem_fWordSpan (i : ι) :
    ∀ m ∈ fWordSpan P Λ, ⁅f P i, m⁆ ∈ fWordSpan P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine lie_mem_span_of_forall P ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [← fWord_smul_cons]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i :: w, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_mem_fWordSpan
statement:
lemma lie_e_mem_fWordSpan (i : ι) :
    ∀ m ∈ fWordSpan P Λ, ⁅e P i, m⁆ ∈ fWordSpan P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine lie_mem_span_of_forall P ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    dsimp only at ih ⊢
    rw [fWord_smul_cons, leibniz_lie, lie_e_f]
    refine add_mem ?_ (lie_f_mem_fWordSpan P Λ j _ ih)
    split_ifs
    · exact lie_h_mem_fWordSpan P Λ _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl⟩)
    · rw [zero_lie]; exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.span_fWord_smul_eq_top
statement: theorem span_fWord_smul_eq_top : fWordSpan P Λ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) :=
    { fWordSpan P Λ with
      lie_mem := fun {x m} hm ↦ lie_mem_of_generators P (fWordSpan P Λ)
        (lie_e_mem_fWordSpan P Λ) (lie_f_mem_fWordSpan P Λ) (lie_h_mem_fWordSpan P Λ) x m hm }
  have hN : N = ⊤ := eq_top_of_hwv_mem P Λ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], by simp⟩)
  exact congrArg LieSubmodule.toSubmodule hN

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fWordSpan_le_iSup_wordSpan
statement: lemma fWordSpan_le_iSup_wordSpan : fWordSpan P Λ ≤ ⨆ μ, wordSpan P Λ μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (Λ - wt w) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_le_wordSpan
statement: theorem weightSpace_le_wordSpan (μ : Dual K H) : weightSpace P Λ μ ≤ wordSpan P Λ μ
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  refine mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) (wordSpan P Λ) (wordSpan_le_weightSpace P Λ) hm ?_
  exact fWordSpan_le_iSup_wordSpan P Λ (by rw [span_fWord_smul_eq_top]; trivial)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_wordSpan
statement: theorem weightSpace_eq_wordSpan (μ : Dual K H) : weightSpace P Λ μ = wordSpan P Λ μ
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (weightSpace_le_wordSpan P Λ μ) (wordSpan_le_weightSpace P Λ μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.counts_nonneg
statement: lemma counts_nonneg (w : List ι) : 0 ≤ AuxLieAlgebra.counts w
proof: := fun _ ↦ Int.natCast_nonneg _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_weightSpace_eq_top :
    ⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf k) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_fWord_smul_eq_top, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have := fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ w
  rw [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf] at this
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (counts_nonneg w) this)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_eq_bot {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : ∀ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k → μ ≠ Λ - P.rootOf k) :
    weightSpace P Λ μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace_eq_wordSpan, wordSpan, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  refine absurd ?_ (hμ (AuxLieAlgebra.counts w) (counts_nonneg w))
  rw [← hw, AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finite_setOf_wordWt_eq
statement: lemma finite_setOf_wordWt_eq (ν : Dual K H) : {w : List ι | wt w = ν}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hν : ∃ w₀, wt w₀ = ν
  · obtain ⟨w₀, rfl⟩ := hν
    refine (List.finite_length_eq ι w₀.length).subset fun w hw ↦ ?_
    have hw' : AuxLieAlgebra.counts w = AuxLieAlgebra.counts w₀ := by
      apply P.rootOf_injective
      rw [← AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf, ← AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf]
      exact hw
    have h1 := AuxLieAlgebra.sum_counts w
    rw [hw', AuxLieAlgebra.sum_counts] at h1
    change w.length = w₀.length
    exact_mod_cast h1.symm
  · convert Set.finite_empty
    ext w
    simpa using fun h ↦ hν ⟨w, h⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_weightSpace (μ : Dual K H) :
    FiniteDimensional K (weightSpace P Λ μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (wordSpan P Λ μ).FG := by
    refine Submodule.fg_def.mpr ⟨_, Set.Finite.image _ ?_, rfl⟩
    refine (finite_setOf_wordWt_eq P (Λ - μ)).subset fun w hw ↦ ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hw ⊢
    rw [← hw, sub_sub_cancel]
  have : FiniteDimensional K (wordSpan P Λ μ) := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hfin
  exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (weightSpace_le_wordSpan P Λ μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_self
statement: theorem weightSpace_self : weightSpace P Λ Λ = K ∙ hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr
    (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ))
  rw [weightSpace_eq_wordSpan, wordSpan]
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  have hw' : P.rootOf (AuxLieAlgebra.counts w) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [← AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf, map_zero]
    simpa using hw
  have h1 := AuxLieAlgebra.sum_counts w
  rw [P.rootOf_injective hw'] at h1
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero] at h1
  obtain rfl : w = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by exact_mod_cast h1.symm)
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.counts_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma counts_nil : counts ([] : List ι) = 0
proof: := by ext; simp [counts]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.counts_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma counts_cons (j : ι) (w : List ι) : counts (j :: w) = Pi.single j 1 + counts w
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [counts, List.count_cons, Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_apply, beq_iff_eq]
  split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> simp_all; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf
statement: lemma wordWt_eq_rootOf (w : List ι) : wordWt P w = P.rootOf (counts w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih => simp [ih, map_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.sum_counts
statement: lemma sum_counts (w : List ι) [Fintype ι] : ∑ i, counts w i = w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih => simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ih, Pi.single_apply]; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.adProd_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma adProd_mem_rootSpace (j : ι) (l : List ι) :
    adProd (l.map (e P)) (e P j) ∈ rootSpace P (wordWt P (j :: l))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa using e_mem_rootSpace P j
  | cons i l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, adProd_cons]
    have := lie_mem_rootSpace P (e_mem_rootSpace P i) ih
    convert this using 2
    simp only [wordWt_cons]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.posSpan_le
statement: lemma posSpan_le (μ : Dual K H) : posSpan P μ ≤ rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [posSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, l, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact adProd_mem_rootSpace P j l

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_mem_lieSpan
statement:
lemma eHom_mem_lieSpan (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    eHom P z ∈ LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.AuxLieAlgebra (Set.range (e P))
proof:
:= by
  induction z using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i => exact LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, (eHom_of P i).symm⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul]; exact LieSubalgebra.smul_mem _ c hy
  | lie y z hy hz => rw [LieHom.map_lie]; exact LieSubalgebra.lie_mem _ hy hz

name: List.exists_map_eq_of_forall_mem_range
statement:
lemma _root_.List.exists_map_eq_of_forall_mem_range {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {l : List β}
    (hl : ∀ y ∈ l, y ∈ Set.range f) : ∃ l' : List α, l'.map f = l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons y l ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hl y (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ := ih fun z hz ↦ hl z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)
    exact ⟨a :: l', rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_mem_iSup_posSpan
statement: lemma eHom_mem_iSup_posSpan (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : eHom P z ∈ ⨆ μ, posSpan P μ
proof:
:= by
  have hz : eHom P z ∈ (LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.AuxLieAlgebra (Set.range (e P))).toSubmodule :=
    eHom_mem_lieSpan P z
  rw [LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_toSubmodule_eq_span_adProd] at hz
  refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) hz
  rintro _ ⟨l, hl, _, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ := List.exists_map_eq_of_forall_mem_range hl
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (wordWt P (j :: l'))
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, l', rfl, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_le_posSpan
statement:
theorem rootSpace_le_posSpan {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    rootSpace P μ ≤ posSpan P μ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : ∃ z, eHom P z = x := rootSpace_pos_le P hμ hx
  exact mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) (posSpan P) (posSpan_le P) hx (eHom_mem_iSup_posSpan P z)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.finite_setOf_wordWt_eq
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_wordWt_eq (k : ι → ℤ) :
    {w : ι × List ι | wordWt P (w.1 :: w.2) = P.rootOf k}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Set.finite_univ.prod (List.finite_length_eq ι ((∑ i, k i).toNat - 1))).subset ?_
  rintro ⟨j, l⟩ hw
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, wordWt_eq_rootOf, P.rootOf_injective.eq_iff] at hw
  have := sum_counts (j :: l)
  rw [hw] at this
  simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, true_and]
  simp only [List.length_cons] at this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.finiteDimensional_rootSpace
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_rootSpace {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    FiniteDimensional K (rootSpace P μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hμ
  have hfin : (posSpan P (P.rootOf k) : Submodule K P.AuxLieAlgebra).FG := by
    rw [posSpan]
    refine Submodule.fg_def.mpr ⟨_, ((finite_setOf_wordWt_eq P k).image
      fun w ↦ adProd (w.2.map (e P)) (e P w.1)), ?_⟩
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Prod.exists]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, l, h, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, l, h, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, l, h, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, l, h, rfl⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional K (posSpan P (P.rootOf k)) :=
    Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hfin
  exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (rootSpace_le_posSpan P ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.adProd_replicate_self
statement:
lemma adProd_replicate_self {L : Type*} [LieRing L] (x : L) (m : ℕ) :
    adProd (List.replicate (m + 1) x) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih => rw [List.replicate_succ, adProd_cons, ih, lie_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eq_replicate_of_counts_eq
statement:
lemma eq_replicate_of_counts_eq {j : ι} {l : List ι} {i : ι} {n : ℕ}
    (h : counts (j :: l) = n • Pi.single i 1) : j = i ∧ l = List.replicate (n - 1) i
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ b ∈ j :: l, b = i := by
    intro b hb
    by_contra hbi
    have := congr_fun h b
    simp only [counts, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_apply, hbi, ite_false, smul_zero,
      Nat.cast_eq_zero, List.count_eq_zero] at this
    exact this hb
  have hlen := congr_fun h i
  simp only [counts, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hlen
  rw [List.count_eq_length.mpr fun b hb ↦ (hmem b hb).symm] at hlen
  refine ⟨hmem j (List.mem_cons_self ..), List.eq_replicate_iff.mpr ⟨?_, fun b hb ↦
    hmem b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)⟩⟩
  simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot
statement:
theorem rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot (i : ι) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    rootSpace P (n • P.root i) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hw : n • P.root i = P.rootOf (n • Pi.single i 1) := by rw [map_nsmul, rootOf_single]
  have hpos : n • P.root i ∈ P.posWeights := by
    refine ⟨n • Pi.single i 1, ⟨fun m ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩, hw.symm⟩
    · by_cases hm : m = i
      · subst hm; simp
      · simp [hm]
    · have := congr_fun h i; simp at this; omega
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr ((rootSpace_le_posSpan P hpos).trans ?_)
  rw [posSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, l, hjl, rfl⟩
  rw [hw, wordWt_eq_rootOf, P.rootOf_injective.eq_iff] at hjl
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_replicate_of_counts_eq hjl
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, n - 1 = m + 1 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
  rw [hm, List.map_replicate, adProd_replicate_self]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.e_ne_zero
statement: lemma e_ne_zero (i : ι) : e P i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra K ι (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i) = 0 := by
    rw [← tensorRep_fHom_one P 0, fHom_of]
    have hω := congr_arg (chevalleyInvolution P) h
    rw [chevalleyInvolution_e, map_zero, neg_eq_zero] at hω
    simp [hω]
  simp only [FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra_of] at this
  exact FreeAlgebra.ι_ne_zero i this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_root
statement: theorem rootSpace_root (i : ι) : rootSpace P (P.root i) = K ∙ e P i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr (e_mem_rootSpace P i))
  have hw : P.root i = P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1) := by simp
  have hpos : P.root i ∈ P.posWeights := P.root_mem_posWeights i
  refine (rootSpace_le_posSpan P hpos).trans ?_
  rw [posSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, l, hjl, rfl⟩
  rw [hw, wordWt_eq_rootOf, P.rootOf_injective.eq_iff, ← one_nsmul (Pi.single i 1)] at hjl
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_replicate_of_counts_eq hjl
  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) : chevalleyInvolution P x ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have := congr_arg (chevalleyInvolution P) (hx (-a))
  simp only [LieHom.map_lie, map_neg, chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_neg, map_smul] at this
  rw [this, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_eq_map
statement:
lemma rootSpace_neg_eq_map (μ : Dual K H) :
    rootSpace P (-μ) = (rootSpace P μ).map (chevalleyInvolution P).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · refine ⟨chevalleyInvolution P x, ?_, by simp⟩
    simpa using chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace P hx
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace P hx

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.finiteDimensional_rootSpace_neg
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_rootSpace_neg {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    FiniteDimensional K (rootSpace P (-μ))
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional_rootSpace P hμ
  rw [rootSpace_neg_eq_map]
  infer_instance

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_nsmul_root_eq_bot
statement:
theorem rootSpace_neg_nsmul_root_eq_bot (i : ι) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    rootSpace P (-(n • P.root i)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_neg_eq_map, rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot P i hn, Submodule.map_bot]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_root
statement: theorem rootSpace_neg_root (i : ι) : rootSpace P (-P.root i) = K ∙ f P i
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_neg_eq_map, rootSpace_root, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, chevalleyInvolution_e, ← Set.neg_singleton, Submodule.span_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_lie_e_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_lie_e_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_ne_bot (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {μ₀ : Dual K H}
    (hμ₀ : weightSpace P V μ₀ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ l : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ l ∧ ∃ v ∈ weightSpace P V (μ₀ + P.rootOf l), v ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hV.exists_finset
  set T : Set (ι → ℤ) := {l | 0 ≤ l ∧ weightSpace P V (μ₀ + P.rootOf l) ≠ ⊥} with hT
  let c : Dual K H → ι → ℤ := fun Λ ↦
    if h : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - μ₀ then h.choose else 0
  have hTfin : T.Finite := by
    refine (s.finite_toSet.biUnion fun Λ _ ↦
      (Set.Finite.pi (t := fun i ↦ Set.Icc 0 (c Λ i)) fun i ↦ Set.finite_Icc _ _)).subset ?_
    rintro l ⟨hl0, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛs, k, hk, heq⟩ := hs _ hl
    have hlk : P.rootOf (l + k) = Λ - μ₀ := by
      rw [map_add, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm, ← add_assoc, heq, sub_add_cancel]
    have hex : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - μ₀ := ⟨l + k, hlk⟩
    have hc : c Λ = l + k := by
      refine P.rootOf_injective ?_
      simp only [c, hex, ↓reduceDIte]
      rw [hex.choose_spec, hlk]
    refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := Λ) hΛs fun i _ ↦ ⟨hl0 i, ?_⟩
    rw [hc, Pi.add_apply, le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
    exact hk i
  have hTne : T.Nonempty := ⟨0, le_rfl, by rwa [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨l, ⟨hl0, hl⟩, hmax⟩ := hTfin.exists_maximal hTne
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hl
  refine ⟨l, hl0, v, hv, hv0, fun i ↦ by_contra fun hne ↦ ?_⟩
  have hmem : l + Pi.single i 1 ∈ T := by
    refine ⟨add_nonneg hl0 (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one), fun hbot ↦ hne ?_⟩
    have := toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace i hv
    rw [add_assoc, ← rootOf_single P i, ← map_add, hbot] at this
    exact this
  have := hmax hmem (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one)) i
  simp at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_lie_e_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_lie_e_eq_zero [Nontrivial V] (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    ∃ μ, ∃ v ∈ weightSpace P V μ, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀⟩ : ∃ μ₀, weightSpace P V μ₀ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra! h
    have := hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
    simp only [h, iSup_bot] at this
    exact bot_ne_top this
  obtain ⟨l, -, v, hv, hv0, he⟩ := exists_lie_e_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hV hμ₀
  exact ⟨_, v, hv, hv0, he⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_lieModuleHom_verma
statement:
theorem exists_lieModuleHom_verma [Nontrivial V] (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    ∃ (μ : Dual K H) (φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V),
      φ (VermaModule.hwv P μ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, v, hv, hv0, he⟩ := hV.exists_lie_e_eq_zero
  exact ⟨μ, VermaModule.lift P v (fun _ hx ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos he hx) (fun a ↦ hv a),
    by rwa [VermaModule.lift_hwv]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_lieModuleHom_verma_of_isIntegrable
statement:
theorem exists_lieModuleHom_verma_of_isIntegrable [Nontrivial V] (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hV' : IsIntegrable P V) :
    ∃ (μ : Dual K H), P.IsDominantIntegral μ ∧
      ∃ φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V, φ (VermaModule.hwv P μ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, v, hv, hv0, he⟩ := hV.exists_lie_e_eq_zero
  exact ⟨μ, isDominantIntegral_of_isIntegrable hA hV' hv he hv0,
    VermaModule.lift P v (fun _ hx ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos he hx) (fun a ↦ hv a),
    by rwa [VermaModule.lift_hwv]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_translation_verma_back
statement:
theorem exists_translation_verma_back {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet' : ∀ i, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    ∃ ν' : Dual K H, ∃ z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      P.IsDominantIntegral ν' ∧ z' (lam - μ) = ν' ∧
      Nonempty (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν') ∧
      Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P μ)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (lam - μ) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (lam - μ)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  exact ⟨z' (-ν), z' * z, hzz, hν', hzν', ⟨eν⟩,
    translation_verma_equiv P hA hμ hlam hfacet' hν' hzz hzν' w⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ i, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨ν', -, -, hν', -, ⟨eν⟩, ⟨eV⟩⟩ :=
    exists_translation_verma_back P hA hlam hμ hfacet' hν hz hzν w
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν'
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  set x := P.weylDot hA' w lam
  set y := P.weylDot hA' w μ
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P y) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_verma P y
  have hNχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P x) (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P x
  let adj := translationAdjunction P (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y)
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') hMχ hNχ
  let π : VermaModule P x →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P x := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _
  let f₀ := π.comp eV.symm.toLieModuleHom
  have hf₀ : f₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h (eV (hwv P x))
    change π (eV.symm (eV (hwv P x))) = 0 at h1
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h1
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P x h1
  have hg : adj f₀ ≠ 0 := (LinearEquiv.map_ne_zero_iff adj).mpr hf₀
  let eD : Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν') ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν :=
    (dualEquiv eν).trans evalEquiv.symm
  let E := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P x) (centralCharacter P lam)
    (centralCharacter P μ) eD
  have hnt : ¬ Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P x)) := by
    intro hs
    exact hg (LieModuleHom.ext fun u ↦ E.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
  rcases translation_irreducible P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w with h | h
  · exact absurd h hnt
  · exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_translation_verma_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem translation_translation_verma_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ i, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))))
proof:
:= by
  have h := exists_translation_verma_back P hA hlam hμ hfacet' hν hz hzν w
  obtain ⟨ν', h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨z', h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hz', h⟩ := h
  have eν := h.2.2.1.some
  have eV := h.2.2.2.some
  have e₁ := (translation_verma_equiv P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w).some
  have E₂ := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ))
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) eν.symm
  have E₃ := centralTranslationEquiv P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν))
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) e₁
  have E := (eV.trans E₂).trans E₃
  exact ⟨E⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem translation_translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ i, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))))
proof:
:= by
  have h := exists_translation_verma_back P hA hlam hμ hfacet' hν hz hzν w
  obtain ⟨ν', h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨z', h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hz', h⟩ := h
  have eν := h.2.2.1.some
  have e₁ := (translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet P hA hlam hμ hfacet hfacet' hν hz hzν w).some
  have e₂ := (translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet P hA hμ hlam hfacet' hfacet h.1 hz' h.2.1
    w).some
  have E₂ := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P
    (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ))
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) eν.symm
  have E₃ := centralTranslationEquiv P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν))
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) e₁
  have E := (e₂.trans E₂).trans E₃
  exact ⟨E⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.RelAcyclic.congr
statement:
theorem RelAcyclic.congr {M' N' : Type u} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module K M']
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M'] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M'] [AddCommGroup N']
    [Module K N'] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra N'] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra N']
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ M') (e' : N ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N')
    (hMN : RelAcyclic P M N) : RelAcyclic P M' N'
proof:
:=
  fun n ↦ (hMN n).of_iso
    (relCohomologyCongr (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homCongr e e') (n + 1)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relAcyclic_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem relAcyclic_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton (M →ₗ[K] N)] : RelAcyclic P M N
proof:
:= fun _ ↦
  isZero_relCohomology_succ fun _ _ _ ↦ ⟨0, zero_mem _, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relAcyclic_verma_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem relAcyclic_verma_restrictedDual [Finite (NegRootIndex P)] (Λ μ : Dual K H) :
    RelAcyclic P (VermaModule P Λ) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ))
proof:
:= fun _ ↦
  isZero_relCohomology_succ fun _ hf hδ ↦ exists_δ_eq_relVerma P Λ μ hf hδ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exact_inclusion_stdStepMap
statement:
theorem exact_inclusion_stdStepMap {N₀ N₁ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X} {μ : Dual K H}
    (hle : N₀ ≤ N₁)
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)) :
    Function.Exact (LieSubmodule.inclusion hle) (stdStepMap hle e)
proof:
:= fun y ↦ by
  rw [stdStepMap_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ⟨fun hy ↦ ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩, by rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact x.2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.RelAcyclic.of_isStdFiltered_left
statement:
theorem RelAcyclic.of_isStdFiltered_left (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X}
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s)
    (hs : ∀ μ ∈ s, RelAcyclic P (VermaModule P μ) M) : RelAcyclic P N M
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot =>
    have : Subsingleton (↥(⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) →ₗ[K] M) :=
      ⟨fun f g ↦ LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ by
        rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    exact relAcyclic_of_subsingleton
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ μ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    refine fun n ↦ isZero_relCohomology_hom_of_shortExact_left (h P)
      (iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule hX N₁)
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      (LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective hle) (exact_inclusion_stdStepMap hle e)
      (surjective_stdStepMap hle e)
      (ih (fun ν hν ↦ hs ν (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν)) n)
      (hs μ (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _) n)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.RelAcyclic.of_isStdFiltered_right
statement:
theorem RelAcyclic.of_isStdFiltered_right (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X}
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s)
    (hs : ∀ μ ∈ s, RelAcyclic P M (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ))) :
    RelAcyclic P M (restrictedDual P N)
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot =>
    have : Subsingleton (restrictedDual P (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X)) :=
      ⟨fun φ ψ ↦ restrictedDual_ext P fun x ↦ by
        rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    have : Subsingleton (M →ₗ[K] restrictedDual P (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X)) :=
      ⟨fun f g ↦ LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
    exact relAcyclic_of_subsingleton
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ μ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    have h₀ := iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule hX N₀
    have h₁ := iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule hX N₁
    have hV := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
    refine fun n ↦ isZero_relCohomology_hom_of_shortExact_right (h P)
      (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (hX.lieSubmodule N₁)).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (hX.lieSubmodule N₀)).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      (injective_restrictedDualMap P _ (surjective_stdStepMap hle e))
      (exact_restrictedDualMap P h₁ hV (exact_inclusion_stdStepMap hle e))
      (surjective_restrictedDualMap P h₀ h₁ _ (LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective hle))
      (hs μ (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _) n)
      (ih (fun ν hν ↦ hs ν (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν)) n)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relAcyclic_restrictedDual_of_isStdFiltered
proof:
:=
  RelAcyclic.of_isStdFiltered_left hX hN fun Λ _ ↦
    RelAcyclic.of_isStdFiltered_right hY hN' fun μ _ ↦
      relAcyclic_verma_restrictedDual P Λ μ

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left_X₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₁, rfl⟩ := contravariant_sequence_exact₃ hS Y x (h₂ _) (n₀ := n) (by omega)
  rw [h₁ x₁]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.StrongLinkStep.exists_weylDot_eq
statement:
theorem StrongLinkStep.exists_weylDot_eq {lam μ : Dual K H} (h : P.StrongLinkStep hA lam μ) :
    ∃ s : P.weylGroup hA, lam = P.weylDot hA s μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, i, n, -, -, hn, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨P.reflectionOf hA v i, ?_⟩
  have hs : P.weylDot hA (P.reflectionOf hA v i) lam =
      lam - n • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
    rw [weylDot, reflectionOf_apply', hn, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K]
    abel
  rw [← hs, ← weylDot_mul, reflectionOf_mul_self, weylDot_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.IsStronglyLinked.exists_weylDot_eq
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsStronglyLinked at h
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl => exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
  | head hstep _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hstep.exists_weylDot_eq P hA
    exact ⟨s * x, by rw [hs, weylDot_mul]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_left
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_left (W Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ ν, W.property.1.multiplicity ν ≠ 0 → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν) → ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Z Y n, x = 0)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} W Y n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := W.property.2
  have := W.property.1.wellFoundedLT_lieSubmodule P (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan) hS
  have := W.property.1.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan) hS
  refine ext_eq_zero_of_ofSub_top W Y (WellFoundedLT.induction
    (motive := fun M ↦ ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub W M) Y n, x = 0) ⊤ fun M ih ↦ ?_) x
  by_cases hM : M = ⊥
  · subst hM
    exact Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_left (isZero_ofSub_bot W)
  obtain ⟨M', hM'M, ν, hν, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := W.property.1.exists_subquotient_equiv_of_ne_bot hM
  have hS := shortExact_subComplex W hM'M.le (ofSubquotient W M' M) (toSubquotient W M' M)
    (fun y hy ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff W M' M ⟨y, hM'M.le hy⟩).mpr hy)
    (surjective_toSubquotient W M' M) fun y hy ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff W M' M y).mp hy
  exact Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left hS (ih M' hM'M)
    (h ν hν _ ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (M'.Subquotient M)).symm.trans ψ))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero : ∀ (l : ℕ) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan),
    (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w = l → ∀ n, l < n → ∀ (Y : CategoryO.{u} P)
      (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) Y n), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ l ih =>
  intro w hw n hn Y x
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ext_succ_verma_eq_zero Y _ n (fun κ hκ hne z ↦ ?_) x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_weylDot_eq P hA.isGeneralizedCartan
    (VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hκ)
  have hyw := (VermaModule.multiplicity_weylDot_ne_zero_iff_of_isDominantIntegral P hA hΛ).mp hκ
  have hlt := hyw.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
  exact ih _ (by omega) y rfl n (by omega) Y z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_verma_weylDot
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_verma_weylDot (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT (verma.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ))
      ((P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w + 1)
proof:
:=
  HasProjectiveDimensionLT.mk fun i hi ⦃Y⦄ x ↦
    ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero hA hΛ _ w rfl i (by omega) Y x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_simple_weylDot_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_simple_weylDot_eq_zero : ∀ (d : ℕ) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan),
    (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement -
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w = d → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
    (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) → ∀ n,
    2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement -
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w < n →
    ∀ (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} Z Y n), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ d ih =>
  intro w hw Z e n hn Y x
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hwm := (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_le_length_longestElement w
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  let lam := P.weylDot hA' w Λ
  let φ := toSimple P lam Z e
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := surjective_toSimple lam Z e
  let N := ofSub (verma P lam) φ.ker
  have hV := (verma P lam).property.1
  
  have hmult (ν : Dual K H) : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν =
      N.property.1.multiplicity ν + (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν := by
    rw [IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam) hV
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hV.lieSubmodule φ.ker) hV Z.property.1
        φ.ker.incl φ Subtype.val_injective φ.ker.range_incl.symm hφ,
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (hV.lieSubmodule φ.ker) N.property.1
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) φ.ker),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr Z.property.1 (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam) e]
  refine Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left_X₃
    (shortExact_kerComplex (verma P lam) Z φ hφ) ?_
    (ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero hA hΛ _ w rfl _ (by omega) Y) x
  refine ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_left N Y n fun ν hν Z' e' x' ↦ ?_
  have h := hmult ν
  have hνV : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hνne : ν ≠ lam := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self, IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq] at h
    simp at h
    omega
  obtain ⟨y, hwy, rfl⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_bruhatLE_weylDot P hA hΛ
    (VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hνV)
  have hlt := hwy.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left fun h ↦ hνne (by subst h; rfl)
  have hym := (P.coxeterSystem hA').length_le_length_longestElement y
  exact ih _ (by omega) y rfl Z' e' n (by omega) Y x'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_simple_weylDot
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_simple_weylDot (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT (simple.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ))
      (2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
          (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement -
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w + 1)
proof:
:=
  HasProjectiveDimensionLT.mk fun i hi ⦃Y⦄ x ↦
    ext_simple_weylDot_eq_zero hA hΛ _ w rfl _
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P _)).symm i (by omega) Y x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_multiplicity
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_multiplicity (X : CategoryO.{u} P)
    (hX : ∀ ν, X.property.1.multiplicity ν ≠ 0 →
      ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, ν = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT X
      (2 * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).longestElement + 1)
proof:
:=
  HasProjectiveDimensionLT.mk fun i hi ⦃Y⦄ x ↦
    ext_eq_zero_of_multiplicity_left X Y i (fun ν hν Z e ↦ by
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hX ν hν
      exact ext_simple_weylDot_eq_zero hA hΛ _ w rfl Z e i (by omega) Y) x

name: Derivation.matrix_map_mul
statement:
theorem matrix_map_mul (D : Derivation K R R) (M N : Matrix κ κ R) :
    (M * N).map D = M.map D * N + M * N.map D
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.add_apply, map_sum,
    Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: Derivation.matrix_map_pow_of_commutator
statement:
theorem matrix_map_pow_of_commutator (D : Derivation K R R) (M C : Matrix κ κ R)
    (hM : M.map D = M * C - C * M) (n : ℕ) :
    (M ^ n).map D = M ^ n * C - C * M ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, apply_ite D]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, matrix_map_mul, ih, hM]
    noncomm_ring

name: Derivation.trace_pow_eq_zero_of_commutator
statement:
theorem trace_pow_eq_zero_of_commutator (D : Derivation K R R) (M C : Matrix κ κ R)
    (hM : M.map D = M * C - C * M) (n : ℕ) : D (Matrix.trace (M ^ n)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddMonoidHom.map_trace, matrix_map_pow_of_commutator D M C hM,
    Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_mul_comm, sub_self]

name: LieModule.coordinateMatrix_derivation
statement:
theorem coordinateMatrix_derivation (b : Basis κ K V) (x : L) :
    (coordinateMatrix (L := L) b).map
      (SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (toEnd K L (Dual K L) x)) =
    coordinateMatrix (L := L) b *
      (LinearMap.toMatrix b b (toEnd K L V x)).map (algebraMap K _) -
      (LinearMap.toMatrix b b (toEnd K L V x)).map (algebraMap K _) *
      coordinateMatrix (L := L) b
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hc : toEnd K L (Dual K L) x (matrixCoefficient b i j) =
      (∑ k, (LinearMap.toMatrix b b (toEnd K L V x) k j) • matrixCoefficient b i k) -
      ∑ k, (LinearMap.toMatrix b b (toEnd K L V x) i k) • matrixCoefficient b k j := by
    ext y
    simp only [toEnd_apply_apply, Module.Dual.lie_apply, matrixCoefficient,
      LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [LieHom.map_lie, Ring.lie_def, map_sub, LinearMap.toMatrix_mul,
      LinearMap.toMatrix_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
    rw [neg_sub]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    exact mul_comm _ _
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, coordinateMatrix, SymmetricAlgebra.derivation_ι, hc,
    map_sub, map_sum, map_smul, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Algebra.smul_def]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: LieModule.tracePowerPolynomial_invariant
statement:
theorem tracePowerPolynomial_invariant (b : Basis κ K V) (n : ℕ) (x : L) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (toEnd K L (Dual K L) x)
      (tracePowerPolynomial b n) = 0
proof:
:=
  Derivation.trace_pow_eq_zero_of_commutator _ _ _ (coordinateMatrix_derivation b x) n

name: LieModule.eval_tracePowerPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_tracePowerPolynomial (b : Basis κ K V) (n : ℕ) (x : L) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval K L x) (tracePowerPolynomial b n) =
    LinearMap.trace K V (toEnd K L V x ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  let ev := SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval K L x)
  change ev (Matrix.trace (coordinateMatrix b ^ n)) = _
  rw [AddMonoidHom.map_trace]
  change Matrix.trace ((coordinateMatrix (L := L) b ^ n).map ev.toRingHom) = _
  rw [Matrix.map_pow]
  have he : (coordinateMatrix (L := L) b).map ev.toRingHom =
      LinearMap.toMatrix b b (toEnd K L V x) := by
    ext i j
    simp [coordinateMatrix, matrixCoefficient, ev]
  rw [he, LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K b]
  congr 1
  exact (map_pow (LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv b) _ n).symm

name: LieModule.tracePowerPolynomial_homogeneous
statement:
theorem tracePowerPolynomial_homogeneous (b : Basis κ K V) (n : ℕ) :
    tracePowerPolynomial (L := L) b n ∈
      SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp (m : ℕ) (i j : κ) : (coordinateMatrix (L := L) b ^ m) i j ∈
      SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule m := by
    induction m generalizing i j with
    | zero =>
      simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_apply]
      split_ifs
      · simp [SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule]
      · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro k _
      change _ ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K L)) ^ (m + 1)
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (ih i k) (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _)
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => hp n i i

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coordinateMatrix_cartanRestriction
statement:
theorem coordinateMatrix_cartanRestriction (b : Basis κ K V) (wt : κ → Dual K H)
    (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ weightSpace P V (wt j)) :
    (coordinateMatrix (L := P.KacMoodyAlgebra) b).map (coordinateCartanRestriction P) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j => SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) (wt j))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have he : (h P).dualMap (matrixCoefficient b i j) =
      if i = j then wt j else 0 := by
    ext a
    simp only [LinearMap.dualMap_apply, matrixCoefficient, LinearMap.coe_mk,
      AddHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]
    rw [hb j a]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp
    · simp [hij]
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, coordinateMatrix, coordinateCartanRestriction,
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, he, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial
statement:
theorem coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial (b : Basis κ K V)
    (wt : κ → Dual K H) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ weightSpace P V (wt j)) (n : ℕ) :
    coordinateCartanRestriction P (tracePowerPolynomial b n) =
      ∑ j, SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) (wt j) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tracePowerPolynomial, AddMonoidHom.map_trace]
  change Matrix.trace ((coordinateMatrix b ^ n).map
    (coordinateCartanRestriction P).toRingHom) = _
  rw [Matrix.map_pow]
  have he := coordinateMatrix_cartanRestriction P b wt hb
  change (coordinateMatrix b).map (coordinateCartanRestriction P).toRingHom = _ at he
  rw [he, Matrix.diagonal_pow, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial_multiplicity
statement:
theorem coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial_multiplicity
    (b : Basis κ K V) (wt : κ → Dual K H)
    (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ weightSpace P V (wt j)) (n : ℕ) :
    coordinateCartanRestriction P (tracePowerPolynomial b n) =
      ∑ μ ∈ Finset.univ.image wt,
        (finrank K (weightSpace P V μ) : K) •
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) μ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial P b wt hb]
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to' (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) =>
    Finset.mem_image_of_mem wt (Finset.mem_univ j))
    (fun μ => SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) μ ^ n)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro μ _
  have hm := finrank_weightSpace_of_basis hb μ (Set.toFinite {j | wt j = μ})
  have hs : (Set.toFinite {j | wt j = μ}).toFinset =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun j => wt j = μ) := by ext j; simp
  rw [hs] at hm
  simp [hm, Algebra.smul_def]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial_finsum
statement:
theorem coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial_finsum
    (b : Basis κ K V) (wt : κ → Dual K H)
    (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ weightSpace P V (wt j)) (n : ℕ) :
    coordinateCartanRestriction P (tracePowerPolynomial b n) =
      ∑ᶠ μ : Dual K H, (finrank K (weightSpace P V μ) : K) •
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) μ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial_multiplicity P b wt hb]
  symm
  apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
  intro μ hμ
  by_contra hn
  have hz : (Set.toFinite {j | wt j = μ}).toFinset = ∅ := by
    ext j
    simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false]
    intro hj
    exact hn (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hj⟩)
  have hm := finrank_weightSpace_of_basis hb μ (Set.toFinite {j | wt j = μ})
  rw [hz, Finset.card_empty] at hm
  simp [Function.mem_support, hm] at hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_invariant_tracePower_extension
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_tracePower_extension [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ F : SymmetricAlgebra K (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra),
      F ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n ∧
      (∀ x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra,
        SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
          (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) x) F = 0) ∧
      (∀ x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra,
        SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval K P.KacMoodyAlgebra x) F =
          LinearMap.trace K V (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V x ^ n)) ∧
      coordinateCartanRestriction P F =
        ∑ᶠ μ : Dual K H, (finrank K (weightSpace P V μ) : K) •
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) μ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hV : IsCategoryO P V := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA
  let b := hV.weightBasis
  let := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b
  refine ⟨tracePowerPolynomial b n, tracePowerPolynomial_homogeneous b n,
    tracePowerPolynomial_invariant b n, eval_tracePowerPolynomial b n, ?_⟩
  exact coordinateCartanRestriction_tracePowerPolynomial_finsum P b Sigma.fst
    hV.weightBasis_mem n

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_dominant_tracePower_extension
statement:
theorem exists_dominant_tracePower_extension [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ F : SymmetricAlgebra K (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra),
      F ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n ∧
      (∀ x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra,
        SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
          (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) x) F = 0) ∧
      coordinateCartanRestriction P F =
        ∑ᶠ μ : Dual K H, (finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ) : K) •
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) μ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hΛ
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hi, _, hr⟩ :=
    exists_invariant_tracePower_extension P (V := IrreducibleModule P Λ) hA n
  exact ⟨F, hF, hi, hr⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.weylDot_add_eq_weylDot_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem weylDot_add_eq_weylDot_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    {ν' : Dual K H} (hν' : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν' ≠ ⊥)
    {w x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (h : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam + ν' = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ) :
    P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam + ν' = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  have hνint : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, ν (P.coroot i) = n := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν i; exact ⟨n, by rw [hn, Int.cast_natCast]⟩
  
  have hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((μ + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA' (inv_mem hz) hνint
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hνint j
    have e : (μ + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho) = z⁻¹ ν := by
      rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← hzν]
      exact (z.symm_apply_apply _).symm
    refine ⟨n + (A *ᵥ k) j, ?_⟩
    rw [e, hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  set ν₁ := (w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val ν' with hν₁def
  have hν₁ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν₁ ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hν (w⁻¹).property hν'
  have hν₁int : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, ν₁ (P.coroot i) = n := by
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν₁
    intro i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν i
    refine ⟨n - (A *ᵥ k) i, ?_⟩
    rw [hk, LinearMap.sub_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA' hν₁int
  have hν₂ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (u'.val ν₁) ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hν u'.property hν₁
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hck⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν₂
  have hνc : z ((μ + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho)) - u'.val ν₁ = P.rootOf c := by
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hzν, hck]
    abel
  have hu : (u'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val (u'.val ν₁) = ν₁ := by
    change u'.val.symm (u'.val ν₁) = ν₁
    exact u'.val.symm_apply_apply ν₁
  
  have hwx : x.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (lam + P.rho) + ν' := by
    have h' := h
    simp only [weylDot] at h'
    rw [sub_add_eq_add_sub, sub_left_inj] at h'
    exact h'.symm
  have hy : (lam + P.rho) + (u'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val (u'.val ν₁) =
      (w⁻¹ * x : P.weylGroup hA').val (μ + P.rho) := by
    rw [hu, hν₁def]
    change lam + P.rho + w.val.symm ν' = w.val.symm (x.val (μ + P.rho))
    rw [hwx, map_add, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  
  have hyW : w⁻¹ * x ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' (μ + P.rho) := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, ← hy]
    have h1 : ν₁ - ν ∈ P.rootLattice := by
      obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν₁
      rw [hk, sub_sub_cancel_left]
      exact neg_mem (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k)
    have h2 : ν - ((μ + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho)) ∈ P.rootLattice := by
      rw [← hzν, ← add_sub_add_right_eq_sub μ lam P.rho]
      exact P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hA' hz hab
    have e : lam + P.rho + (u'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val (u'.val ν₁) - (μ + P.rho) =
        (ν₁ - ν) + (ν - ((μ + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho))) := by
      rw [hu]; abel
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem h1 h2
  have hfix := P.apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply_integralWeylGroup hA hab hlam hμ hfacet
    (z := ⟨z, hz⟩) (u := u'⁻¹) (by rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hzν]; exact hν) hu' hc hνc hyW hy
  have hxw : x.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho) := by
    have := congrArg w.val hfix
    change w.val (w.val.symm (x.val (μ + P.rho))) = _ at this
    rwa [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
  rw [h]
  simp only [weylDot, hxw]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_verma_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_verma_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ⊗[K]
        IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set Λ := P.weylDot hA' w lam with hΛdef
  set ν₀ := P.weylDot hA' w μ - Λ with hν₀def
  have : FiniteDimensional K (IrreducibleModule P ν) :=
    IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P (IrreducibleModule P ν) :=
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  obtain ⟨N, wt, -, -, -, -, hcount, hFmono, hF0, hFlast, -, hFstep, hret⟩ :=
    exists_centralTensorVermaFiltration P hZ Λ (centralCharacter P μ)
  set C := centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
  set F := fun k => N k ⊓ C with hFdef
  have hwμ : Λ + ν₀ = P.weylDot hA' w μ := by rw [hν₀def]; abel
  have hχ₀ : centralCharacter P (Λ + ν₀) = centralCharacter P μ := by
    rw [hwμ]
    exact centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ
  have hν₀ : ν₀ = (w.val * z⁻¹) ν := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    change _ = w.val (z.symm ν)
    rw [← hzν, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hν₀def, hΛdef]
    simp only [weylDot, map_sub, map_add]
    abel
  have hmult : finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν₀) = 1 := by
    have hV := (IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable_iff P hA').mpr hν
    have hr := rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA' hV (mul_mem w.property (inv_mem hz)) ν
    rw [hν₀]
    unfold Module.finrank
    rw [hr]
    exact IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P ν
  have hone := hret ν₀
  rw [ite_eq_left hχ₀, hmult] at hone
  obtain ⟨hsub, ⟨j₀, hj₀wt, hj₀χ⟩⟩ := Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hone
  have hretained (j) (hj : centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) = centralCharacter P μ) :
      wt j = ν₀ := by
    have hwtj : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (wt j) ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro hbot
      have hc := hcount (wt j)
      rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hc
      have : Nonempty {j' // wt j' = wt j} := ⟨⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
      exact (Nat.card_pos (α := {j' // wt j' = wt j})).ne' hc
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA μ (Λ + wt j)).mp hj.symm
    have h : P.weylDot hA' w lam + wt j = P.weylDot hA' ⟨x, hx⟩ μ := by
      simp only [weylDot]
      rw [hxe, hΛdef]
      simp only [weylDot]
      abel
    have := IrreducibleModule.weylDot_add_eq_weylDot_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz
      hzν hwtj h
    rw [hν₀def, ← this, hΛdef]
    abel
  have hstep_ne (j) (hj : j ≠ j₀) :
      (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥ := by
    apply (hFstep j).2
    intro hχ
    apply hj
    have := hsub.elim ⟨j, hretained j hχ, hχ⟩ ⟨j₀, hj₀wt, hj₀χ⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val this
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := LieSubmodule.eq_bot_and_eq_last_of_single_step F hFmono hF0 j₀ hstep_ne
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := (hFstep j₀).1 hj₀χ
  have h2' : F j₀.succ = C := h2.trans hFlast
  rw [hj₀wt, hwμ] at e
  change VermaModule P _ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (F j₀.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j₀.castSucc))
    at e
  rw [h1, h2'] at e
  exact ⟨e.trans (LieSubmodule.mapMkBotEquiv C).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,KacMoodyAlgebra P⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  have hχ : centralCharacter P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) =
      centralCharacter P lam := centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.property lam
