  have htop : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ := hχ ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  exact ⟨e.trans (centralBlockEquiv P (rTensorEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
    (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P htop)).symm (centralCharacter P μ))⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_dualVerma_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_dualVerma_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ))
      ≃ₗ⁅K,KacMoodyAlgebra P⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  exact ⟨(restrictedDualEquiv P e).symm.trans
    (restrictedDualCentralTranslationEquiv P hA hν (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) _ _)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))) ∨
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,KacMoodyAlgebra P⁆
        centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
          (centralCharacter P μ)
          (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  set x := P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
  obtain ⟨e₁⟩ := translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  obtain ⟨e₂⟩ := translation_dualVerma_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  let π : VermaModule P x →ₗ⁅K,KacMoodyAlgebra P⁆ IrreducibleModule P x :=
    LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P x)
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _
  have hTπ : Function.Surjective (centralTranslationMap P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) π) := centralTranslationMap_surjective P
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P x) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _ π hπ
  have hTι : Function.Injective (centralTranslationMap P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule.toRestrictedDual P x)) :=
    centralTranslationMap_injective P _ _ _ (IrreducibleModule.toRestrictedDual_injective P x)
  exact subsingleton_or_nonempty_equiv_irreducible P
    ((centralTranslationMap P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ) π).comp e₁.toLieModuleHom) (hTπ.comp e₁.surjective)
    (e₂.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (centralTranslationMap P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule.toRestrictedDual P x)))
    (e₂.symm.injective.comp hTι)

name: Module.End.exists_pow_apply_eq_zero_of_fg
statement:
theorem Module.End.exists_pow_apply_eq_zero_of_fg {K M : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module K M] {T : Module.End K M} {S : Submodule K M} (hS : S.FG)
    (h : ∀ v ∈ S, ∃ m : ℕ, (T ^ m) v = 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ v ∈ S, (T ^ n) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hS
  choose! m hm using fun v (hv : v ∈ (s : Set M)) ↦ h v (Submodule.subset_span hv)
  refine ⟨∑ v ∈ s, m v, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  have hle : Submodule.span K (s : Set M) ≤ LinearMap.ker (T ^ ∑ v ∈ s, m v) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro v hv
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker,
      ← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hv), pow_add,
      Module.End.mul_apply, hm v hv, map_zero]
  exact hle hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.unop_envTranspose_mem_center
statement: theorem unop_envTranspose_mem_center (z : 𝓩) : (envTranspose P (z : 𝓤)).unop ∈ 𝓩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff]
  intro u
  have hz := Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp z.property (envTranspose P u).unop
  have := congrArg (fun a ↦ (envTranspose P a).unop) hz
  simp only [unop_envTranspose_mul, unop_envTranspose_unop_envTranspose] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralCharacter_centerTranspose
statement:
theorem centralCharacter_centerTranspose (Λ : Dual K H) (z : 𝓩) :
    centralCharacter P Λ (centerTranspose P z) = centralCharacter P Λ z
proof:
:= by
  have h := contravariantForm_smul_left P Λ (z : 𝓤) (hwv P Λ) (hwv P Λ)
  have h1 : (z : 𝓤) • hwv P Λ = centralCharacter P Λ z • hwv P Λ :=
    centralCharacter_smul P Λ z _
  have h2 : (envTranspose P (z : 𝓤)).unop • hwv P Λ =
      centralCharacter P Λ (centerTranspose P z) • hwv P Λ :=
    centralCharacter_smul P Λ (centerTranspose P z) _
  rw [h1, h2, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, contravariantForm_hwv_hwv] at h
  simpa using h.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_center_sub_pow_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      Module.End.one_apply]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (rep_center_mem_weightSpace P z μ ih) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ih)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_centralBlock_eq_top
statement:
theorem centralBlock_centralBlock_eq_top (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    centralBlock P (centralBlock P V χ) χ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro v -
  exact mem_centralBlock_of_injective P (centralBlock P V χ).incl Subtype.val_injective χ
    v.property

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.unop_envTranspose_center
statement: theorem unop_envTranspose_center (z : 𝓩) : (envTranspose P (z : 𝓤)).unop = z
proof:
:= by
  have := harishChandra_injective P hA (a₁ := centerTranspose P z) (a₂ := z)
    (SymmetricAlgebra.eq_of_lift_eq fun Λ ↦ by
      change SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (harishChandraProjection P
          ((centerTranspose P z : 𝓩) : 𝓤)) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (harishChandraProjection P (z : 𝓤))
      rw [eval_harishChandraProjection_center, eval_harishChandraProjection_center,
        centralCharacter_centerTranspose])
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_rep_center_sub_pow
statement:
theorem toDual_rep_center_sub_pow (z : 𝓩) (c : K) (n : ℕ) (φ : TwistedDual P V) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P V (((rep P (TwistedDual P V) (z : 𝓤) - c • 1) ^ n) φ) =
      TwistedDual.toDual P V φ ∘ₗ (rep P V (z : 𝓤) - c • 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hz := unop_envTranspose_center P hA z
  induction n generalizing φ with
  | zero => ext v; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    ext v
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_sub,
      map_smul, toDual_rep, hz, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_centralBlock_twistedDual
statement:
theorem mem_centralBlock_twistedDual (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (hfin : ∀ μ, FiniteDimensional K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ)) {χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K}
    (hχ : centralBlock P V χ = ⊤) {φ : TwistedDual P V} (hφ : φ ∈ restrictedDual P V) :
    φ ∈ centralBlock P (TwistedDual P V) χ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_restrictedDual] at hφ
  induction hφ using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ φ hφ =>
    rw [mem_centralBlock]
    intro z
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Module.End.exists_pow_apply_eq_zero_of_fg
      (T := rep P V (z : 𝓤) - χ z • 1) ((Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mpr (hfin μ))
      (fun v _ ↦ (mem_centralBlock P χ v).mp (hχ ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top v) z)
    refine ⟨n, TwistedDual.ext fun v ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [toDual_rep_center_sub_pow P hA, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hv : v ∈ ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem ν v hv =>
      by_cases hνμ : μ = ν
      · subst hνμ
        rw [hn v hv, map_zero]
      · exact apply_eq_zero_of_ne hφ (rep_center_sub_pow_mem_weightSpace P z _ n hv) hνμ
    | zero => simp
    | add v w _ _ hv hw => rw [map_add, map_add, hv, hw, add_zero]
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add φ ψ _ _ hφ hψ => exact add_mem hφ hψ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_restrictedDual_eq_top
statement:
theorem centralBlock_restrictedDual_eq_top (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K}
    (hχ : centralBlock P V χ = ⊤) : centralBlock P (restrictedDual P V) χ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro φ -
  exact mem_centralBlock_of_injective P (restrictedDual P V).incl Subtype.val_injective χ
    (mem_centralBlock_twistedDual P hA hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap hχ φ.property)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDual_apply_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  let r := restrictedDualMap P (centralBlock P V θ).incl
  have h1 : r ψ ∈ centralBlock P _ χ := map_mem_centralBlock P r χ hψ
  have h2 : r ψ ∈ centralBlock P _ θ :=
    (centralBlock_restrictedDual_eq_top P hA (hV.centralBlock P θ)
      (centralBlock_centralBlock_eq_top P θ)) ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _
  have h3 : r ψ = 0 := (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp
    ((disjoint_centralBlock P hne.symm).le_bot ((LieSubmodule.mem_inf _ _ _).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩))
  have := congrArg (fun φ : restrictedDual P (centralBlock P V θ) ↦
    TwistedDual.toDual P _ φ.val ⟨v, hv⟩) h3
  simpa [r] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_dualVerma
statement:
theorem translation_dualVerma {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ))
      ≃ₗ⁅K,KacMoodyAlgebra P⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma_equiv P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  exact ⟨(restrictedDualEquiv P e).symm.trans
    (restrictedDualCentralTranslationEquiv P hA hν (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) _ _)⟩

name: LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top_of_strictMono {f : LieSubmodule R L M → ℕ}
    (hf : StrictMono f) : ∃ S : Finset M, lieSpan R L (S : Set M) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule R L M) := by
    refine StrictAnti.wellFoundedGT (f := fun N ↦ f ⊤ - f N) fun a b hab ↦ ?_
    have h1 := hf hab
    have h2 := hf.monotone (le_top : b ≤ ⊤)
    change f ⊤ - f b < f ⊤ - f a
    omega
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨S, rfl⟩, hmax⟩ := (wellFounded_gt (α := LieSubmodule R L M)).has_min
    (Set.range fun S : Finset M ↦ lieSpan R L (S : Set M)) ⟨_, ⟨∅, rfl⟩⟩
  refine ⟨S, eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hx
  refine hmax _ ⟨insert x S, rfl⟩ (lt_of_le_of_ne (lieSpan_mono ?_) fun he ↦ hx ?_)
  · rw [Finset.coe_insert]
    exact Set.subset_insert _ _
  · have he' : lieSpan R L (S : Set M) = lieSpan R L ((insert x S : Finset M) : Set M) := he
    rw [he']
    exact subset_lieSpan (by simp)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_restrictedDualMap
statement:
theorem surjective_restrictedDualMap (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (hW : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ = ⊤) (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Surjective (restrictedDualMap P f)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
  suffices H : ∀ φ ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) μ,
      ∃ ψ : restrictedDual P W, (restrictedDualMap P f ψ).1 = φ by
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := H φ hφ
    exact ⟨ψ, Subtype.ext hψ⟩
  intro φ hφ
  induction hφ using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem κ φ hφ =>
    let fκ : weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ →ₗ[K] weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) κ :=
      ((f : V →ₗ[K] W).comp (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ).subtype).codRestrict _
        fun x ↦ map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f x.2
    have hfκ : LinearMap.ker fκ = ⊥ := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr fun x y hxy ↦
      Subtype.ext (hf (congrArg Subtype.val hxy))
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective fκ hfκ
    let g : Module.Dual K (weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) κ) :=
      ((TwistedDual.toDual P V φ).comp (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ).subtype).comp r
    refine ⟨⟨(TwistedDual.toDual P W).symm (g ∘ₗ weightProj P hW κ),
      Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem κ (mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp hW κ g)⟩, ?_⟩
    apply TwistedDual.ext
    intro v
    rw [toDual_restrictedDualMap, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem ν v hv =>
      by_cases hν : ν = κ
      · subst hν
        rw [weightProj_of_mem hW (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hv)]
        have hfv : (⟨f v, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hv⟩ : weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) ν) =
            fκ ⟨v, hv⟩ := rfl
        have hrv : r (fκ ⟨v, hv⟩) = ⟨v, hv⟩ := LinearMap.congr_fun hr ⟨v, hv⟩
        simp only [g, LinearMap.comp_apply]
        rw [hfv, hrv]
        rfl
      · rw [weightProj_of_mem_ne hW (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hv) hν, map_zero,
          TwistedDual.apply_eq_zero_of_ne hφ hv (Ne.symm hν)]
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      simp only [map_add]
      rw [hx, hy]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero]; rfl⟩
  | add φ₁ φ₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨ψ₁, e₁⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨ψ₂, e₂⟩ := h₂
    exact ⟨ψ₁ + ψ₂, by rw [map_add]; exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) e₁ e₂⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveO.isInjectiveO_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem IsProjectiveO.isInjectiveO_restrictedDual {Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module K Q]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 Q] [LieModule K 𝔤 Q] (hQ : IsProjectiveO.{w} P Q)
    (hQw : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap Q (h P) μ = ⊤) : IsInjectiveO.{w} P (restrictedDual P Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hM hN f hf φ
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hQ (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hN) (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hM)
    (restrictedDualMap P f) (surjective_restrictedDualMap P hM.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      hN.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top f hf) (dualSwap hQw φ)
  refine ⟨dualSwap hN.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top g,
    LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ restrictedDual_ext P fun q ↦ ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun F : restrictedDual P M ↦ TwistedDual.toDual P M F.1 m)
    (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hg q)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator
statement:
lemma mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator {S : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (restrictedDual P V)} {v : V} :
    v ∈ restrictedDualAnnihilator P V S ↔ ∀ φ ∈ S, TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 v = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDualAnnihilator_strictAnti
statement:
theorem restrictedDualAnnihilator_strictAnti (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    StrictAnti (restrictedDualAnnihilator P V)
proof:
:= by
  intro S₁ S₂ hlt
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (fun v hv ↦ mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator P |>.mpr fun φ hφ ↦
    (mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator P).mp hv φ (hlt.le hφ)) fun he ↦ ?_
  have hR := isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV
  have hdec : ∀ S : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (restrictedDual P V),
      S.toSubmodule ≤ ⨆ μ, S.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ := by
    intro S φ hφ
    have hmem : φ ∈ S.toSubmodule ⊓
        ⨆ μ ∈ Set.univ, weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ := by
      refine ⟨hφ, ?_⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_univ, iSup_pos]
      rw [hR.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]
      trivial
    have := inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (h P) S.toSubmodule (fun a m hm ↦ S.lie_mem hm)
      Set.univ hmem
    simpa only [Set.mem_univ, iSup_pos] using this
  obtain ⟨κ, φ, hφ₂, hφκ, hφ₁⟩ : ∃ κ, ∃ φ ∈ S₂,
      φ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) κ ∧ φ ∉ S₁ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    refine hlt.not_ge fun φ hφ ↦ ?_
    refine (iSup_le fun μ ↦ ?_ : ⨆ μ, S₂.toSubmodule ⊓
      weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ ≤ S₁.toSubmodule) (hdec S₂ hφ)
    rintro ψ ⟨hψ₂, hψμ⟩
    exact hcon μ ψ hψ₂ hψμ
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap κ
  let ρ : restrictedDual P V →ₗ[K] Module.Dual K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ) :=
    { toFun := fun ψ ↦
        (TwistedDual.toDual P V ψ.1).comp (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ).subtype
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hρ : ∀ μ, μ ≠ κ → ∀ ψ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ, ρ ψ = 0 := by
    intro μ hμ ψ hψ
    exact LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ TwistedDual.apply_eq_zero_of_ne
      (mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hψ) x.2 hμ
  set W₁ := S₁.toSubmodule.map ρ
  have hW₁ : W₁ ≤ (S₁.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) κ).map ρ := by
    rintro _ ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩
    refine (iSup_le fun μ ↦ ?_ : ⨆ μ, S₁.toSubmodule ⊓
      weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ ≤
        ((S₁.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) κ).map ρ).comap ρ)
      (hdec S₁ hψ)
    by_cases hμ : μ = κ
    · subst hμ
      exact Submodule.le_comap_map _ _
    · rintro ψ' ⟨-, hψ'⟩
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, hρ μ hμ ψ' hψ']
      exact zero_mem _
  have hφW : ρ φ ∉ W₁ := by
    intro hφ'
    obtain ⟨ψ, ⟨hψ₁, hψκ⟩, hψφ⟩ := hW₁ hφ'
    apply hφ₁
    have h0 := eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_twistedDual hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      (κ := κ) (φ := (φ - ψ).1)
      (mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp (sub_mem hφκ hψκ)) fun v hv ↦ by
        have := LinearMap.congr_fun hψφ ⟨v, hv⟩
        change TwistedDual.toDual P V ψ.1 v = TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 v at this
        change TwistedDual.toDual P V (φ.1 - ψ.1) v = 0
        rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, this, sub_self]
    have hφψ : φ = ψ := sub_eq_zero.mp (Subtype.ext h0)
    rw [hφψ]
    exact hψ₁
  rw [← Subspace.dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq (W := W₁), Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
    at hφW
  push Not at hφW
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hφu⟩ := hφW
  have hu₁ : (u : V) ∈ restrictedDualAnnihilator P V S₁ :=
    (mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator P).mpr fun ψ hψ ↦
      ((Submodule.mem_dualCoannihilator _).mp hu) (ρ ψ) ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩
  rw [← he] at hu₁
  exact hφu ((mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator P).mp hu₁ φ hφ₂)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_strictMono_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.exists_strictMono_restrictedDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    {f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    ∃ F : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (restrictedDual P V) → ℕ, StrictMono F
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun S ↦ f ⊤ - f (restrictedDualAnnihilator P V S), fun S₁ S₂ hlt ↦ by
    have h1 := hf (restrictedDualAnnihilator_strictAnti P hV hlt)
    have h2 := hf.monotone (le_top : restrictedDualAnnihilator P V S₁ ≤ ⊤)
    change f ⊤ - f _ < f ⊤ - f _
    omega⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.eq_zero_of_forall_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.eq_zero_of_forall_restrictedDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {v : V}
    (hv : ∀ φ : restrictedDual P V, TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1 v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  set N := restrictedDualAnnihilator P V ⊤
  have hvN : v ∈ N := (mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator P).mpr fun φ _ ↦ hv φ
  suffices hN : N = ⊥ by
    rw [hN] at hvN
    exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot v).mp hvN
  by_contra hN
  have hNO := hV.lieSubmodule N
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff N.toSubmodule).mp
    fun h ↦ hN ((LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_eq_bot N).mp h)
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ, weightSpaceOfMap N (h P) κ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have htop : (⊤ : Submodule K N) = ⊥ := by
      rw [← hNO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]
      exact iSup_eq_bot.mpr hcon
    have : (⟨x, hx⟩ : N) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K N) := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact hx0 (congrArg Subtype.val ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp this))
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hκ
  have hyV : (y : V) ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hy
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Module.Dual K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ), g ⟨y, hyV⟩ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have h := (Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K
      (⟨y, hyV⟩ : weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ)).mp hcon
    exact hy0 (Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h : (y : V) = 0))
  have h0 := (mem_restrictedDualAnnihilator P).mp y.2
    ⟨(TwistedDual.toDual P V).symm (g ∘ₗ weightProj P hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top κ),
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem κ
      (mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top κ g)⟩
    (LieSubmodule.mem_top _)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    weightProj_of_mem hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top hyV] at h0
  exact hg h0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isInjectiveO_injective
statement:
theorem exists_isInjectiveO_injective (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {S : Finset M}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) :
    ∃ (κ : Type) (_ : Fintype κ) (_ : DecidableEq κ) (τ : κ → Dual K H),
      IsCategoryO P (restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))) ∧
      IsInjectiveO.{w'} P
        (restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))) ∧
      (∃ T : Finset (restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))),
        LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (T : Set (restrictedDual P
          (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)))) = ⊤) ∧
      ∃ e : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)),
        Function.Injective e
proof:
:= by
  have hMd := isCategoryO_restrictedDual hM
  have h1 := IsCategoryO.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hM hS
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h1
  have h2 := hM.exists_strictMono_restrictedDual P hf
  obtain ⟨Fd, hFd⟩ := h2
  have h3 := LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top_of_strictMono hFd
  obtain ⟨Sd, hSd⟩ := h3
  have h4 := hMd.isCovered P hA hSd
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, π, hπ⟩ := h4
  have hQO : IsCategoryO P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) :=
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun j ↦ isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA _ _
  have hQproj : IsProjectiveO.{w'} P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) :=
    IsProjectiveO.directSum fun j ↦ isProjectiveO_projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA _
  have h5 := exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top fun j ↦
    exists_finset_lieSpan_projectiveCoverAmbient'_eq_top P hA (τ j)
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := h5
  have h6 := hQO.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hT
  obtain ⟨fQ, hfQ⟩ := h6
  have h7 := hQO.exists_strictMono_restrictedDual P hfQ
  obtain ⟨FQ, hFQ⟩ := h7
  refine ⟨κ, inferInstance, inferInstance, τ, isCategoryO_restrictedDual hQO,
    hQproj.isInjectiveO_restrictedDual P hQO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top,
    LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top_of_strictMono hFQ,
    dualSwap hM.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top π, ?_⟩
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro m hm
  refine hM.eq_zero_of_forall_restrictedDual P fun φ ↦ ?_
  have h8 := hπ φ
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := h8
  have h0 : TwistedDual.toDual P _ (dualSwap hM.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top π m).1 q = 0 := by
    rw [hm]
    rfl
  exact h0

name: LieSubmodule.map_mk'_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem map_mk'_eq_bot_iff (N M : LieSubmodule K L V) :
    M.map (Quotient.mk' N) = ⊥ ↔ M ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h m hm
    have : Quotient.mk' N m ∈ M.map (Quotient.mk' N) := (mem_map _).mpr ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    rw [h, mem_bot] at this
    exact (Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mp this
  · intro h
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    rintro _ hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := (mem_map _).mp hx
    exact (Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mpr (h hm)

name: LieSubmodule.eq_bot_and_eq_last_of_single_step
statement:
theorem eq_bot_and_eq_last_of_single_step {n : ℕ} (F : Fin (n + 1) → LieSubmodule K L V)
    (hF : Monotone F) (h0 : F 0 = ⊥) (j₀ : Fin n)
    (hstep : ∀ j, j ≠ j₀ → (F j.succ).map (Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥) :
    F j₀.castSucc = ⊥ ∧ F j₀.succ = F (Fin.last n)
proof:
:= by
  have hle (j : Fin n) (hj : j ≠ j₀) : F j.succ = F j.castSucc :=
    le_antisymm ((map_mk'_eq_bot_iff _ _).mp (hstep j hj))
      (hF (Fin.castSucc_le_succ j))
  constructor
  · have key : ∀ m (hm : m ≤ j₀.val), F ⟨m, by omega⟩ = ⊥ := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro _; exact h0
      | succ m ih =>
        intro hm
        have hj : (⟨m, by omega⟩ : Fin n) ≠ j₀ := by
          intro h; rw [← h] at hm; simp at hm
        have := hle ⟨m, by omega⟩ hj
        simp only [Fin.succ_mk, Fin.castSucc_mk] at this
        rw [this]
        exact ih (by omega)
    exact key j₀.val le_rfl
  · have key : ∀ d (k : Fin (n + 1)), k.val + d = n → j₀.val + 1 ≤ k.val →
        F k = F (Fin.last n) := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero =>
        intro k hk _
        congr 1
        ext
        simp [← hk]
      | succ d ih =>
        intro k hk hk₀
        have hj : (⟨k.val, by omega⟩ : Fin n) ≠ j₀ := by
          intro h; rw [← h] at hk₀; simp at hk₀
        have := hle ⟨k.val, by omega⟩ hj
        simp only [Fin.succ_mk, Fin.castSucc_mk] at this
        rw [← ih ⟨k.val + 1, by omega⟩ (by simp only; omega)
          (by simp only; omega), this]
    exact key (n - (j₀.val + 1)) j₀.succ (by simp only [Fin.val_succ]; omega)
      (by simp only [Fin.val_succ]; omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_verma
statement:
theorem translation_verma {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ⊗[K]
        IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set Λ := P.weylDot hA' w lam with hΛdef
  set ν₀ := P.weylDot hA' w μ - Λ with hν₀def
  have : FiniteDimensional K (IrreducibleModule P ν) :=
    IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P (IrreducibleModule P ν) :=
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  obtain ⟨N, wt, -, -, -, -, hcount, hFmono, hF0, hFlast, -, hFstep, hret⟩ :=
    exists_centralTensorVermaFiltration P hZ Λ (centralCharacter P μ)
  set C := centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
  set F := fun k => N k ⊓ C with hFdef
  have hwμ : Λ + ν₀ = P.weylDot hA' w μ := by rw [hν₀def]; abel
  
  have hχ₀ : centralCharacter P (Λ + ν₀) = centralCharacter P μ := by
    rw [hwμ]
    exact centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ
  have hν₀ : ν₀ = (w.val * z⁻¹) ν := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    change _ = w.val (z.symm ν)
    rw [← hzν, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hν₀def, hΛdef]
    simp only [weylDot, map_sub, map_add]
    abel
  have hmult : finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν₀) = 1 := by
    have hV := (IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable_iff P hA').mpr hν
    have hr := rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA' hV (mul_mem w.property (inv_mem hz)) ν
    rw [hν₀]
    unfold Module.finrank
    rw [hr]
    exact IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P ν
  have hone := hret ν₀
  rw [ite_eq_left hχ₀, hmult] at hone
  obtain ⟨hsub, ⟨j₀, hj₀wt, hj₀χ⟩⟩ := Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hone
  
  have hretained (j) (hj : centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) = centralCharacter P μ) :
      wt j = ν₀ := by
    have hwtj : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (wt j) ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro hbot
      have hc := hcount (wt j)
      rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hc
      have : Nonempty {j' // wt j' = wt j} := ⟨⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
      exact (Nat.card_pos (α := {j' // wt j' = wt j})).ne' hc
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA μ (Λ + wt j)).mp hj.symm
    have h : P.weylDot hA' w lam + wt j = P.weylDot hA' ⟨x, hx⟩ μ := by
      simp only [weylDot]
      rw [hxe, hΛdef]
      simp only [weylDot]
      abel
    have := IrreducibleModule.weylDot_add_eq_weylDot hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν hwtj h
    rw [hν₀def, ← this, hΛdef]
    abel
  have hstep_ne (j) (hj : j ≠ j₀) :
      (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥ := by
    apply (hFstep j).2
    intro hχ
    apply hj
    have := hsub.elim ⟨j, hretained j hχ, hχ⟩ ⟨j₀, hj₀wt, hj₀χ⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val this
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := LieSubmodule.eq_bot_and_eq_last_of_single_step F hFmono hF0 j₀ hstep_ne
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := (hFstep j₀).1 hj₀χ
  have h2' : F j₀.succ = C := h2.trans hFlast
  rw [hj₀wt, hwμ] at e
  change VermaModule P _ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (F j₀.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j₀.castSucc))
    at e
  rw [h1, h2'] at e
  exact ⟨e.trans (LieSubmodule.mapMkBotEquiv C).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply
statement:
theorem apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {a b : Dual K H}
    (ha : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, a (P.coroot i) = -n) (hb : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, b (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, a (P.coroot i) = 0 → b (P.coroot i) = 0)
    {z u y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hu : u ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hy : y ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral (z (b - a)))
    {ν₂ : Dual K H} (hν₂ : P.IsDominantIntegral ν₂) {c : ι → ℤ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hνc : z (b - a) - ν₂ = P.rootOf c) (h : a + u ν₂ = y b) : y b = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  have hB (k : ι → ℤ) (x : Dual K H) := P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm k x
  have hW {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA') (x x' : Dual K H) :
      B (w x) (w x') = B x x' := P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA' S hw x x'
  have hBsymm (x x' : Dual K H) : B x x' = B x' x := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq x x'
  
  obtain ⟨e, he, hye⟩ : ∃ e : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ e ∧ y b - b = P.rootOf e := by
    obtain ⟨e, he, hee⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA' (μ := -b)
      (fun i => by obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hb i; exact ⟨n, by simp [hn]⟩) ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨e, he, ?_⟩
    rw [← hee, map_neg]
    abel
  choose na hna using ha
  choose nb hnb using hb
  choose n2 hn2 using hν₂
  choose nν hnν using hν
  
  set R₁ : ℤ := ∑ i, c i * d i * ((nν i : ℤ) + n2 i) with hR₁
  have hR₁nonneg : 0 ≤ R₁ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hc i) (hdpos i).le) (by positivity)
  have hR₁eq : B (z (b - a)) (z (b - a)) - B ν₂ ν₂ = R₁ := by
    have hsplit : z (b - a) = ν₂ + P.rootOf c := by rw [← hνc]; abel
    calc B (z (b - a)) (z (b - a)) - B ν₂ ν₂ = B (P.rootOf c) (z (b - a) + ν₂) := by
          rw [hsplit]
          simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
          rw [hBsymm ν₂ (P.rootOf c)]
          ring
      _ = R₁ := by
          rw [hB, hR₁]
          push_cast
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hnν, hn2]
  
  set R₂ : ℤ := ∑ i, 2 * (e i * d i * (-(na i : ℤ))) with hR₂
  have hR₂nonpos : R₂ ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun i _ => by
    have := mul_nonneg (he i) (hdpos i).le
    have : (0 : ℤ) ≤ na i := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hR₂eq : B (b - a) (b - a) - B (y b - a) (y b - a) = R₂ := by
    have h1 : B (y b) (y b) = B b b := hW hy _ _
    have hyb : y b = b + P.rootOf e := by rw [← hye]; abel
    have hBea : 2 * B (P.rootOf e) a = R₂ := by
      rw [hB, hR₂]
      push_cast
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [hna]
    rw [hyb] at h1 ⊢
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h1 ⊢
    rw [hBsymm b a, hBsymm b (P.rootOf e), hBsymm a (P.rootOf e)] at *
    linear_combination (-1 : K) * h1 + hBea
  have hR : R₁ = R₂ := by
    have h1 : B (z (b - a)) (z (b - a)) = B (b - a) (b - a) := hW hz _ _
    have h2 : B (u ν₂) (u ν₂) = B ν₂ ν₂ := hW hu _ _
    have h3 : y b - a = u ν₂ := by rw [← h]; abel
    have : (R₁ : K) = R₂ := by rw [← hR₁eq, ← hR₂eq, h1, h3, h2]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hR₂0 : R₂ = 0 := le_antisymm hR₂nonpos (hR ▸ hR₁nonneg)
  
  have hsupp (i : ι) : e i = 0 ∨ nb i = 0 := by
    have hterms := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos fun j _ => by
      have := mul_nonneg (he j) (hdpos j).le
      have : (0 : ℤ) ≤ na j := by positivity
      nlinarith).mp hR₂0 i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hd : d i ≠ 0 := (hdpos i).ne'
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hterms with h2 | h2
    · norm_num at h2
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h3 | h3
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h3 with h4 | h4
      · exact Or.inl h4
      · exact absurd h4 hd
    · right
      have h4 : na i = 0 := by omega
      have hna0 : a (P.coroot i) = 0 := by rw [hna i, h4]; simp
      have := hfacet i hna0
      rw [hnb i] at this
      exact_mod_cast neg_eq_zero.mp this
  have hBeb : B (P.rootOf e) b = 0 := by
    rw [hB]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    rcases hsupp i with h0 | h0
    · simp [h0]
    · simp [hnb i, h0]
  
  have hee : B (P.rootOf e) (P.rootOf e) = 0 := by
    have h1 : B (y b) (y b) = B b b := hW hy _ _
    have hyb : y b = b + P.rootOf e := by rw [← hye]; abel
    rw [hyb] at h1
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at h1
    rw [hBsymm b (P.rootOf e), hBeb] at h1
    linear_combination h1
  have he0 : e = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hq := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    rw [hB] at hee
    have hcast : ((e ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ e : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← hee, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct]
      simp only [mulVec_diagonal]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
      ring
    simp only [star_trivial] at hq
    exact hq.ne' (by exact_mod_cast hcast)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, hye, he0, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.weightSpace_apply_ne_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_apply_ne_bot (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {ν : Dual K H}
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {ν' : Dual K H} (hν' : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν' ≠ ⊥) :
    weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (w ν') ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hV := (isIntegrable_iff P hA).mpr hν
  have := rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA hV hw ν'
  rw [Ne, ← Submodule.rank_eq_zero, this, Submodule.rank_eq_zero]
  exact hν'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.weightSpace_self_ne_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_self_ne_bot (ν : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := finrank_weightSpace_self P ν
  rw [h, finrank_bot] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.weylDot_add_eq_weylDot
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  
  set ν₁ := (w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val ν' with hν₁def
  have hν₁ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν₁ ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hν (w⁻¹).property hν'
  have hν₁int : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, ν₁ (P.coroot i) = n := by
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν₁
    intro i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν i
    refine ⟨n - (A *ᵥ k) i, ?_⟩
    rw [hk, LinearMap.sub_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA' hν₁int
  have hν₂ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (u'.val ν₁) ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hν u'.property hν₁
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hck⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν₂
  have hνc : z ((μ + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho)) - u'.val ν₁ = P.rootOf c := by
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hzν, hck]
    abel
  have hu : (u'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val (u'.val ν₁) = ν₁ := by
    change u'.val.symm (u'.val ν₁) = ν₁
    exact u'.val.symm_apply_apply ν₁
  
  have hwx : x.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (lam + P.rho) + ν' := by
    have h' := h
    simp only [weylDot] at h'
    rw [sub_add_eq_add_sub, sub_left_inj] at h'
    exact h'.symm
  have hy : (lam + P.rho) + (u'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val (u'.val ν₁) =
      (w⁻¹ * x : P.weylGroup hA').val (μ + P.rho) := by
    rw [hu, hν₁def]
    change lam + P.rho + w.val.symm ν' = w.val.symm (x.val (μ + P.rho))
    rw [hwx, map_add, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hfix := P.apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply hA hlam hμ hfacet hz (u'⁻¹).property
    (w⁻¹ * x).property (by rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hzν]; exact hν) hu' hc hνc hy
  have hxw : x.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho) := by
    have := congrArg w.val hfix
    change w.val (w.val.symm (x.val (μ + P.rho))) = _ at this
    rwa [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
  rw [h]
  simp only [weylDot, hxw]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.weightSpace_weylDot_sub_ne_bot
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have he : P.weylDot hA' w μ - P.weylDot hA' w lam = (w.val * z.symm) ν := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← hzν, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    simp only [weylDot, map_sub, map_add]
    abel
  rw [he]
  exact weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hν (mul_mem w.property (inv_mem hz))
    (weightSpace_self_ne_bot ν)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_nPosIncl
statement: lemma range_nPosIncl : LinearMap.range (nPosIncl P) = (nPos P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ hy ▸ y.2, fun hx ↦ ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nPosIncl_injective
statement: lemma nPosIncl_injective : Function.Injective (nPosIncl P)
proof: := Subtype.val_injective

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_le_nPos
statement:
lemma rootSpace_le_nPos {α : Dual K H} (hα : α ∈ P.posWeights) :
    rootSpace P α ≤ (nPos P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [nPos_toSubmodule_eq]
  exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun μ (_ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) ↦ rootSpace P μ) _ hα

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_nPosRootSpace
statement:
lemma map_nPosRootSpace (α : P.posWeights) :
    (nPosRootSpace P α).map (nPosIncl P) = rootSpace P (α : Dual K H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nPosRootSpace, Submodule.map_comap_eq, range_nPosIncl]
  exact inf_eq_right.mpr (rootSpace_le_nPos P α.2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isInternal_nPosRootSpace
statement: theorem isInternal_nPosRootSpace : DirectSum.IsInternal (nPosRootSpace P)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top ?_ ?_
  · refine iSupIndep.of_map (nPosIncl_injective P) ?_
    simp_rw [map_nPosRootSpace]
    exact (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (h P)).comp
      (f := fun α : P.posWeights ↦ (α : Dual K H)) fun α β hαβ ↦ Subtype.ext hαβ
  · apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (nPosIncl_injective P)
    rw [Submodule.map_iSup, Submodule.map_top, range_nPosIncl, nPos_toSubmodule_eq]
    simp_rw [map_nPosRootSpace]
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun α ↦ ?_) (iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ ?_)
    · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun μ (_ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) ↦ rootSpace P μ) _ α.2
    · exact le_iSup (fun α : P.posWeights ↦ rootSpace P (α : Dual K H)) ⟨μ, hμ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_nPosRootSpace
statement:
lemma finrank_nPosRootSpace (α : P.posWeights) :
    finrank K (nPosRootSpace P α) = finrank K (rootSpace P (α : Dual K H))
proof:
:= by

    (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ (nPosIncl_injective P) (nPosRootSpace P α))]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nPosBasis_mem

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coe_adNPos_apply

name: Matrix.Realization.finiteDimensional_of_nonempty
statement: lemma finiteDimensional_of_nonempty [Nonempty ι] : FiniteDimensional K H
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.finite_of_finrank_pos
  have h1 := P.finrank_add_rank
  have h2 := (A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → K)).rank_le_card_width

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_rootOf_right
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_rootOf_right (μ : Dual K H) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    P.dualBilinForm S μ (P.rootOf k) = ∑ i, (k i : K) * (μ (P.coroot i) / S.ε i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rootOf_apply, map_sum, map_smul, dualBilinForm_root_right, smul_eq_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_neg_rootOf_add_two_rho_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_neg_rootOf_add_two_rho_ne_zero {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hle : ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j * k j ≤ 0) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (-P.rootOf k + 2 • P.rho) (-P.rootOf k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set q : ℚ := ∑ i, (k i : ℚ) * ((2 - ((∑ j, A i j * k j : ℤ) : ℚ)) / S.ε i) with hq
  have key : P.dualBilinForm S (-P.rootOf k + 2 • P.rho) (-P.rootOf k) = ((-q : ℚ) : K) := by
    rw [map_neg, dualBilinForm_rootOf_right, hq]
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      rootOf_apply_coroot, mulVec, dotProduct, rho_coroot]
    push_cast
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [two_nsmul]
    ring
  have hpos : 0 < q := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk.2
    have hki : 0 < k i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hk.1 i) (Ne.symm hi)
    refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ ↦ ?_) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ k j := by exact_mod_cast hk.1 j
      have h2 : ((∑ l, A j l * k l : ℤ) : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hle j
      exact mul_nonneg h1 (div_nonneg (by linarith) (S.ε_pos j).le)
    · have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < k i := by exact_mod_cast hki
      have h2 : ((∑ l, A i l * k l : ℤ) : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hle i
      exact mul_pos h1 (div_pos (by linarith) (S.ε_pos i))
  rw [key, Rat.cast_ne_zero, neg_ne_zero]
  exact hpos.ne'

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_neg_root_add_two_rho
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_neg_root_add_two_rho (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (-P.root i + 2 • P.rho) (-P.root i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := two_mul_dualBilinForm_rho_root (P := P) S hA i
  simp only [map_neg, map_add, map_nsmul, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  linear_combination -this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.directSum
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.directSum (hM : ∀ i, IsCategoryO P (M i)) :
    IsCategoryO P (DirectSum κ M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have hof : ∀ i μ (m : M i), m ∈ weightSpace P (M i) μ →
      DirectSum.of M i m ∈ weightSpace P (DirectSum κ M) μ := fun i _ _ hm ↦
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ P.KacMoodyAlgebra M i) hm
  have hcomp : ∀ i μ (v : DirectSum κ M), v ∈ weightSpace P (DirectSum κ M) μ →
      v i ∈ weightSpace P (M i) μ := fun i _ _ hv ↦
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K κ P.KacMoodyAlgebra M i) hv
  have hle : ∀ μ, weightSpace P (DirectSum κ M) μ ≤
      ⨆ i, (weightSpace P (M i) μ).map (DirectSum.lof K κ M i) := by
    intro μ v hv
    rw [← DirectSum.sum_univ_of v]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i ⟨v i, hcomp i μ v hv, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨?_, fun μ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro v -
    rw [← DirectSum.sum_univ_of v]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
    have hv : v i ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace P (M i) μ := by
      rw [(hM i).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]; trivial
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction _
      (motive := fun m ↦ DirectSum.of M i m ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace P (DirectSum κ M) μ) hv
      (fun μ m hm ↦ Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (hof i μ m hm)) (by simp) ?_
    intro m m' hm hm'
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem hm hm'
  · have : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (weightSpace P (M i) μ) := fun i ↦
      (hM i).finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (hle μ)
  · choose s hs using fun i ↦ (hM i).exists_finset
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion s, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h0
      exact hv0 (DFinsupp.ext h0)
    have hne : weightSpace P (M i) μ ≠ ⊥ := fun hbot ↦ by
      have := hcomp i μ v hv
      rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
      exact hi this
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hμΛ⟩ := hs i μ hne
    exact ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hΛ⟩, hμΛ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCategoryO_vermaSum
statement: theorem isCategoryO_vermaSum : IsCategoryO P (VermaSum P)
proof:
:=
  IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun _ ↦ VermaModule.isCategoryO P _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_vermaSum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsStandardForm.casimir_vermaSum_eq_zero (hB : IsStandardForm P S B)
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (v : VermaSum P) :
    hB.casimir (VermaSum P) (isCategoryO_vermaSum P).isPosFinite v = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | of i m =>
    have := hB.map_casimir
      (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K ι P.KacMoodyAlgebra (fun i ↦ VermaModule P (-P.root i)) i)
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _).isPosFinite (isCategoryO_vermaSum P).isPosFinite m
    rw [← show DirectSum.lieModuleOf K ι P.KacMoodyAlgebra (fun i ↦ VermaModule P (-P.root i)) i
      m = DirectSum.of _ i m from rfl, ← this,
      hB.casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective hA _ LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id,
      dualBilinForm_neg_root_add_two_rho P S hA, zero_smul, map_zero]
  | add v w hv hw => rw [map_add, hv, hw, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalNeg_inf_rootSpace_eq_bot_of_minimal
statement:
theorem radicalNeg_inf_rootSpace_eq_bot_of_minimal (S : A.Symmetrization) {k : ι → ℤ}
    (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf l) = ⊥) :
    (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf k) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty ι := by
    obtain ⟨i, -⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk.2
    exact ⟨i⟩
  have := P.finiteDimensional_of_nonempty
  rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  rintro x ⟨hx, hxk⟩
  by_contra hx0
  obtain ⟨s, -, hsw, hsT, he⟩ := exists_syzygy P hA hk hmin hx hxk hx0
  have hB := KacMoodyAlgebra.isStandardForm_invForm P S
  have h1 := hB.casimir_sub_smul_mem (KacMoodyAlgebra.isCategoryO_vermaSum P)
    (KacMoodyAlgebra.lowerSyzygies P k) hsw he
  rw [hB.casimir_vermaSum_eq_zero hA, zero_sub, neg_mem_iff] at h1
  have hc := P.dualBilinForm_neg_rootOf_add_two_rho_ne_zero S hk
    (sum_mul_le_zero_of_minimal P hA hk hmin hx hxk hx0)
  have h2 := (KacMoodyAlgebra.lowerSyzygies P k).toSubmodule.smul_mem
    (P.dualBilinForm S (-P.rootOf k + 2 • P.rho) (-P.rootOf k))⁻¹ h1
  rw [inv_smul_smul₀ hc] at h2
  exact hsT h2

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalNeg_eq_bot
statement: theorem radicalNeg_eq_bot (hS : A.IsSymmetrizable) : radicalNeg P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hS
  have hind : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k ∈ posCone ι, height k < n →
      (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf k) = ⊥ := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk hkn
      have : 0 ≤ height k := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hk.1 i
      omega
    | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk hkn
      exact radicalNeg_inf_rootSpace_eq_bot_of_minimal P hA S hk fun l hl hlk ↦
        ih l hl (by omega)
  have hbot : ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, ((radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P μ) = ⊥ := by
    refine iSup₂_eq_bot.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    exact hind ((height k).toNat + 1) k hk (by omega)
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule := hx
  have hmem : x ∈ (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ := by
    refine ⟨hx', ?_⟩
    rw [radicalNeg_toSubmodule P hA] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx'.2
    exact fHom_mem P y
  have := inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (h P) _ (fun _ _ hm ↦ (radicalNeg P).lie_mem hm) _ hmem
  rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  rw [this]
  exact LieSubmodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal :
    AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P = AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal P
proof:
:=
  (SerrePresentedAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal_iff P hA).mpr
    ((SerrePresentedAlgebra.radical_eq_bot_iff P hA).mpr
      (SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalNeg_eq_bot P hA hS))

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.toKacMoody_injective
statement: theorem toKacMoody_injective : Function.Injective (toKacMoody P hA)
proof:
:=
  (radical_eq_bot_iff_injective P hA).mp
    ((radical_eq_bot_iff P hA).mpr (radicalNeg_eq_bot P hA hS))

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.toKacMoody_bijective
statement: theorem toKacMoody_bijective : Function.Bijective (toKacMoody P hA)
proof:
:=
  ⟨toKacMoody_injective P hA hS, toKacMoody_surjective P hA⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.equivKacMoody_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma equivKacMoody_apply (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) :
    equivKacMoody P hA hS x = toKacMoody P hA x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.maxIdeal_le_ker_flip
statement:
lemma maxIdeal_le_ker_flip :
    (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker (invFormAux P S).flip
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  ext x
  change invFormAux P S x r = 0
  rw [(isSymm_invFormAux P S).eq]
  exact invFormAux_eq_zero_of_mem_maxIdeal P S hr x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.maxIdeal_le_ker_liftQ_flip
statement:
lemma maxIdeal_le_ker_liftQ_flip :
    (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule ≤ LinearMap.ker
      ((maxIdeal P).toSubmodule.liftQ (invFormAux P S).flip (maxIdeal_le_ker_flip P S)).flip
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  ext y
  exact invFormAux_eq_zero_of_mem_maxIdeal P S hr y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.invForm_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma invForm_π (x y : P.AuxLieAlgebra) :
    invForm P S (π P x) (π P y) = AuxLieAlgebra.invFormAux P S x y
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isSymm_invForm
statement: theorem isSymm_invForm : (invForm P S).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_def.mpr fun x y ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P y
  simp only [invForm_π]
  exact (AuxLieAlgebra.isSymm_invFormAux P S).eq x y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.invForm_lie
statement:
theorem invForm_lie (x y z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    invForm P S ⁅x, y⁆ z = invForm P S x ⁅y, z⁆
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P z
  rw [← LieHom.map_lie, ← LieHom.map_lie, invForm_π, invForm_π, AuxLieAlgebra.invFormAux_lie]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lieInvariant_invForm
statement: theorem lieInvariant_invForm : (invForm P S).lieInvariant P.KacMoodyAlgebra
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z
  rw [← lie_skew, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, invForm_lie]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nondegenerate_invForm
statement: theorem nondegenerate_invForm : (invForm P S).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  refine (LinearMap.IsRefl.nondegenerate_iff_separatingLeft
    (isSymm_invForm P S).isRefl).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  rw [π_eq_zero_iff]
  refine (AuxLieAlgebra.invFormAux_eq_zero_iff_mem_maxIdeal P S).mp fun y ↦ ?_
  rw [← invForm_π]
  exact hx _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.invForm_h_h
statement: @[simp] theorem invForm_h_h (a b : H) : invForm P S (h P a) (h P b) = P.bilinForm S a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_h, ← π_h, invForm_π, AuxLieAlgebra.invFormAux_h_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.invForm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem invForm_eq_zero {μ ν : Dual K H} {x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P ν) (hμν : μ + ν ≠ 0) : invForm P S x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact AuxLieAlgebra.invFormAux_eq_zero P S hx hy hμν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_eq_invForm_smul
statement:
theorem lie_eq_invForm_smul {μ : Dual K H} {x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)) : ⁅x, y⁆ = invForm P S x y • h P ((P.toDual S).symm μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hy
  change ⁅π P x, π P y⁆ = invForm P S (π P x) (π P y) • h P _
  rw [← LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lie_eq_invFormAux_smul P S μ x hx y hy, map_smul, π_h,
    invForm_π]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.invForm_e_f
statement:
theorem invForm_e_f (i j : ι) :
    invForm P S (e P i) (f P j) = if i = j then (S.ε i : K) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_e, ← π_f, invForm_π, AuxLieAlgebra.invFormAux_e_f]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_invForm_rootSpace_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_invForm_rootSpace_eq_zero {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) (hx0 : ∀ y ∈ rootSpace P (-μ), invForm P S x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (nondegenerate_invForm P S).1 x fun y ↦ ?_
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ ν, rootSpace P ν := by
    have : y ∈ ⨆ ν ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, rootSpace P ν := by
      rw [iSup_rootSpace_eq_top]; trivial
    exact (iSup₂_le fun ν _ ↦ le_iSup (fun ν ↦ rootSpace P ν) ν) this
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun y ↦ invForm P S x y = 0) hy (fun ν y hy ↦ ?_)
    (by simp) fun y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [map_add, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
  by_cases hμν : μ + ν = 0
  · obtain rfl : ν = -μ := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hμν
    exact hx0 y hy
  · exact invForm_eq_zero P S hx hy hμν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpacePairing_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma rootSpacePairing_apply (μ : Dual K H) (y : rootSpace P (-μ)) (x : rootSpace P μ) :
    rootSpacePairing P S μ y x = invForm P S x y
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpacePairing_injective
statement: lemma rootSpacePairing_injective (μ : Dual K H) : Function.Injective (rootSpacePairing P S μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro y hy
  ext
  refine eq_zero_of_invForm_rootSpace_eq_zero P S y.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rw [neg_neg] at hx
  rw [(isSymm_invForm P S).eq]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hy ⟨x, hx⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) : chevalleyInvolution P x ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have := congr_arg (chevalleyInvolution P) (hx (-a))
  simp only [LieHom.map_lie, map_neg, chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_neg, map_smul] at this
  rw [this, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_rootSpace_neg_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_rootSpace_neg_eq {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    finrank K (rootSpace P (-μ)) = finrank K (rootSpace P μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin := finiteDimensional_rootSpace P hμ
  have := finiteDimensional_rootSpace_neg P hμ
  have : FiniteDimensional K (rootSpace P (-(-μ))) := by rwa [neg_neg]
  have hinj : ∀ ν : Dual K H, Function.Injective ((chevalleyInvolution P).toLinearMap.restrict
      (p := rootSpace P ν) (q := rootSpace P (-ν))
      fun _ hx ↦ chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace P hx) := fun ν x y hxy ↦ by
    ext
    simpa using congr_arg (fun z : rootSpace P (-ν) ↦ chevalleyInvolution P z) hxy
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (hinj μ)
  have h2 := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (hinj (-μ))
  rw [neg_neg] at h2
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpacePairingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma rootSpacePairingEquiv_apply {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights)
    (y : rootSpace P (-μ)) (x : rootSpace P μ) :
    rootSpacePairingEquiv P S hμ y x = invForm P S x y
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.compLeftₗ_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma compLeftₗ_apply (f g : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) : compLeftₗ f g = f.comp g
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.compLeftₗ_pow_apply
statement:
lemma compLeftₗ_pow_apply (f g : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) (m : ℕ) (v : V) :
    ((compLeftₗ f ^ m) g) v = (⇑f)^[m] (g v)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing g with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, compLeftₗ_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ih,
      Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.compLeftₗ_pow_comp
statement:
lemma compLeftₗ_pow_comp (f g g' : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) (m : ℕ) :
    (compLeftₗ f ^ m) (g.comp g') = ((compLeftₗ f ^ m) g).comp g'
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [compLeftₗ_pow_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, compLeftₗ_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_fitting
statement:
theorem exists_fitting [FiniteDimensional K (V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V)] (f : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) :
    Function.Surjective f ∨ (∃ m : ℕ, ∀ v, (⇑f)^[m] v = 0) ∨
      ∃ a : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V, a.comp a = a ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  set F := compLeftₗ f
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (LinearMap.eventually_isCompl_ker_pow_range_pow F).exists_forall_of_atTop
  set m := max n 1
  have hc := hn m (le_max_left _ _)
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := le_max_right _ _
  have hid : (LieModuleHom.id : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) ∈ LinearMap.ker (F ^ m) ⊔ LinearMap.range (F ^ m) :=
    by rw [hc.sup_eq_top]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hid
  
  have hker (x y : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (F ^ m)) :
      x.comp y ∈ LinearMap.ker (F ^ m) := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
    rw [compLeftₗ_pow_comp, hx]; rfl
  have hrange (x y : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range (F ^ m)) :
      x.comp y ∈ LinearMap.range (F ^ m) := by
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨c.comp y, compLeftₗ_pow_comp f c y m⟩
  
  have haa : a.comp a = a := by
    have h1 : a.comp a + b.comp a = a := by
      ext v
      have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hab (a v)
      simpa using this
    have h2 : a.comp a - a = -(b.comp a) := by
      rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, sub_add_eq_add_sub, h1, sub_self]
    have hmem1 : a.comp a - a ∈ LinearMap.ker (F ^ m) := Submodule.sub_mem _ (hker a a ha) ha
    have hmem2 : a.comp a - a ∈ LinearMap.range (F ^ m) := by
      rw [h2]; exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (hrange b a hb)
    have := hc.disjoint.eq_bot ▸ Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hmem1, hmem2⟩
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp this)
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · 
    left
    subst ha0
    rw [zero_add] at hab
    subst hab
    obtain ⟨c, hc'⟩ := hb
    intro v
    refine ⟨(⇑f)^[m - 1] (c v), ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (fun g : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V ↦ g v) hc'
    change ((compLeftₗ f ^ m) c) v = v at this
    rw [compLeftₗ_pow_apply] at this
    rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply' f, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm1]
    exact this
  · by_cases hb0 : b = 0
    · 
      right; left
      subst hb0
      rw [add_zero] at hab
      subst hab
      refine ⟨m, fun v ↦ ?_⟩
      have := congrArg (fun g : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V ↦ g v) (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ha)
      change ((compLeftₗ f ^ m) LieModuleHom.id) v = (0 : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ V) v at this
      rw [compLeftₗ_pow_apply] at this
      simpa using this
    · right; right
      refine ⟨a, haa, ha0, fun ha1 ↦ hb0 ?_⟩
      rw [ha1] at hab
      exact add_eq_left.mp hab

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.incl_rangeRetr
statement: lemma incl_rangeRetr (x : Q) : e.range.incl (rangeRetr e x) = e x
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rangeRetr_incl
statement: lemma rangeRetr_incl (he : e.comp e = e) (y : e.range) : rangeRetr e (e.range.incl y) = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, x, rfl⟩ := y
  exact Subtype.ext (LieModuleHom.congr_fun he x)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.apply_incl
statement: lemma apply_incl (he : e.comp e = e) (y : e.range) : e (e.range.incl y) = e.range.incl y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← incl_rangeRetr, rangeRetr_incl he]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rangeRetr_apply
statement: lemma rangeRetr_apply (he : e.comp e = e) (x : Q) : rangeRetr e (e x) = rangeRetr e x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← incl_rangeRetr, rangeRetr_incl he]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rangeRetr_comp_incl
statement:
lemma rangeRetr_comp_incl (he : e.comp e = e) :
    (rangeRetr e).comp e.range.incl = LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.ext (rangeRetr_incl he)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_rangeRetr
statement: lemma surjective_rangeRetr (he : e.comp e = e) : Function.Surjective (rangeRetr e)
proof:
:=
  fun y ↦ ⟨_, rangeRetr_incl he y⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.idemRank_lt
statement:
theorem idemRank_lt [FiniteDimensional K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)] (he : e.comp e = e)
    {a : e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ e.range} (ha : a.comp a = a) (ha1 : a ≠ LieModuleHom.id) :
    idemRank (e.range.incl.comp (a.comp (rangeRetr e))) < idemRank e
proof:
:= by
  let e' := e.range.incl.comp (a.comp (rangeRetr e))
  have he₀e' : e.comp e' = e' := by
    ext x
    exact apply_incl he _
  have he'e₀ : e'.comp e = e' := by
    ext x
    change e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e (e x))) = e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e x))
    rw [rangeRetr_apply he]
  have he'e' : e'.comp e' = e' := by
    ext x
    change e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e (e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e x))))) =
      e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e x))
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply a a, ha]
  have hle : LinearMap.range (compLeftₗ e') ≤ LinearMap.range (compLeftₗ e) := by
    rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨e'.comp g, ?_⟩
    ext x
    exact apply_incl he _
  have hne : e ∉ LinearMap.range (compLeftₗ e') := by
    rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    simp only [compLeftₗ_apply] at hg
    have h1 : e' = e := by
      rw [← he'e₀, ← hg]
      ext x
      exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun he'e' (g x)
    apply ha1
    ext y
    have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h1 (e.range.incl y)
    change e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e (e.range.incl y))) = e (e.range.incl y) at this
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he, apply_incl he] at this
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (Subtype.ext this)
  have h₀ : e ∈ LinearMap.range (compLeftₗ e) := ⟨e, he⟩
  exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h ↦ hne (h ▸ h₀))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.false_of_idempotent
statement:
theorem false_of_idempotent [FiniteDimensional K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)] (he : e.comp e = e)
    {ψ : Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L}
    (hmin : ∀ e' : Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q, e'.comp e' = e' → ψ.comp e' ≠ 0 → idemRank e ≤ idemRank e')
    {c : e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ e.range} (hc : c.comp c = c) (hc1 : c ≠ LieModuleHom.id)
    (hπc : (ψ.comp e.range.incl).comp c ≠ 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  refine absurd (hmin _ ?_ ?_) (not_le.mpr (idemRank_lt he hc hc1))
  · ext x
    change e.range.incl (c (rangeRetr e (e.range.incl (c (rangeRetr e x))))) =
      e.range.incl (c (rangeRetr e x))
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply c c, hc]
  · intro h0
    apply hπc
    ext y
    have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 (e.range.incl y)
    change ψ (e.range.incl (c (rangeRetr e (e.range.incl y)))) = 0 at this
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he] at this
    exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_top_of_minimal
statement:
theorem eq_top_of_minimal [FiniteDimensional K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q)]
    [FiniteDimensional K (e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ e.range)] (he : e.comp e = e) {ψ : Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L}
    (hmin : ∀ e' : Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q, e'.comp e' = e' → ψ.comp e' ≠ 0 → idemRank e ≤ idemRank e')
    (hψ : ψ.comp e.range.incl ≠ 0) (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 e.range)
    (hlift : ∀ φ : e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L, ∃ g : e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N,
      ((ψ.comp e.range.incl).comp N.incl).comp g = φ) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let π := ψ.comp e.range.incl
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hlift π
  let f := N.incl.comp g
  have hπf : π.comp f = π := by
    ext y
    exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun hg y
  rcases exists_fitting f with hsurj | ⟨m, hm⟩ | ⟨a, haa, ha0, ha1⟩
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hsurj y
    exact (g x).2
  · exfalso
    apply hψ
    ext y
    have key : ∀ k, π ((⇑f)^[k] y) = π y := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply π f, hπf, ih]
    have := key m
    rw [hm, map_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  · exfalso
    by_cases hπa : π.comp a = 0
    · refine false_of_idempotent he hmin (c := LieModuleHom.id - a) ?_ ?_ ?_
      · ext y
        have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun haa y
        simp only [LieModuleHom.comp_apply] at this
        simp [this]
      · intro h
        apply ha0
        ext y
        have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h y
        simpa using this
      · intro h
        apply hψ
        ext y
        have h2 : ψ (e.range.incl (a y)) = 0 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hπa y
        have h1 : ψ (e.range.incl y) - ψ (e.range.incl (a y)) = 0 := by
          simpa using LieModuleHom.congr_fun h y
        rw [h2, sub_zero] at h1
        simpa using h1
    · exact false_of_idempotent he hmin haa ha1 hπa

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finiteDimensional_hom_projectiveCoverAmbient
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom_projectiveCoverAmbient (Λ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) {X : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X) :
    FiniteDimensional K (projectiveCoverAmbient P Λ n →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X)
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P n)
  have hL : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (Module.Dual K
      (IrreducibleModule P ((n : K) • P.rho)))) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) LieModule.evalEquiv
  have hT := hX.tensorProduct hL
  have := hT.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap (Λ + (n : K) • P.rho)
  have : FiniteDimensional K (primitiveVectors P (X ⊗[K] Module.Dual K (Module.Dual K
      (IrreducibleModule P ((n : K) • P.rho)))) (Λ + (n : K) • P.rho)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional ((tensorHomAdjunction P).trans (homEquiv P _ _)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isProjectiveO_projectiveCoverAmbient'
statement:
theorem isProjectiveO_projectiveCoverAmbient' (Λ : Dual K H) :
    IsProjectiveO.{w} P (projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA
    (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P (projectiveCoverShift P hA Λ))
  exact IsProjectiveO.tensorProduct P (VermaModule.isProjectiveO_of_forall P hA
    (exists_forall_add_nsmul_rho P hA Λ).choose_spec)
    (IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) LieModule.evalEquiv)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finiteDimensional_end_projectiveCoverAmbient'
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_end_projectiveCoverAmbient' (Λ : Dual K H) :
    FiniteDimensional K (projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ)
proof:
:=
  finiteDimensional_hom_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ _
    (isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_projectiveCoverAmbientMap
statement:
theorem surjective_projectiveCoverAmbientMap (Λ : Dual K H) :
    Function.Surjective (projectiveCoverAmbientMap P hA Λ)
proof:
:=
  (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _).comp
    (exists_surjective_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ (projectiveCoverShift P hA Λ)).choose_spec

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_idemRank
statement:
theorem exists_idemRank (Λ : Dual K H) : ∃ k, ∃ e : projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
    projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ, e.comp e = e ∧ (projectiveCoverAmbientMap P hA Λ).comp e ≠ 0 ∧
      idemRank e = k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨_, LieModuleHom.id, rfl, fun h0 ↦ ?_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := surjective_projectiveCoverAmbientMap P hA Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
  apply IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ
  rw [← hx]
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.projectiveCoverIdem_idem
statement:
theorem projectiveCoverIdem_idem (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ).comp (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ) = projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ
proof:
:=
  by classical exact (Nat.find_spec (exists_idemRank P hA Λ)).choose_spec.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.projectiveCoverIdem_ne_zero
statement:
theorem projectiveCoverIdem_ne_zero (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (projectiveCoverAmbientMap P hA Λ).comp (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  by classical exact (Nat.find_spec (exists_idemRank P hA Λ)).choose_spec.2.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.idemRank_projectiveCoverIdem_le
statement:
theorem idemRank_projectiveCoverIdem_le (Λ : Dual K H)
    (e : projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ) (he : e.comp e = e)
    (hψ : (projectiveCoverAmbientMap P hA Λ).comp e ≠ 0) :
    idemRank (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ) ≤ idemRank e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show idemRank (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ) = Nat.find (exists_idemRank P hA Λ) from
    (Nat.find_spec (exists_idemRank P hA Λ)).choose_spec.2.2]
  exact Nat.find_min' _ ⟨e, he, hψ, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO
statement: theorem isCategoryO : IsCategoryO P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)
proof:
:=
  (isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ _).lieSubmodule _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO
statement: theorem isProjectiveO : IsProjectiveO.{w} P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)
proof:
:=
  (isProjectiveO_projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ).of_retract (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ).range.incl
    (rangeRetr _) (rangeRetr_comp_incl (projectiveCoverIdem_idem P hA Λ))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.π_ne_zero
statement: theorem π_ne_zero : π P hA Λ ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h0 ↦ projectiveCoverIdem_ne_zero P hA Λ (by
  ext x
  have h := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 (rangeRetr _ x)
  change projectiveCoverAmbientMap P hA Λ ((projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ).range.incl
    (rangeRetr _ x)) = 0 at h
  rw [incl_rangeRetr] at h
  exact h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.surjective_π
statement: theorem surjective_π : Function.Surjective (π P hA Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P Λ
  rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
  refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top (π P hA Λ).range).resolve_left fun h0 ↦ π_ne_zero P hA Λ ?_
  ext y
  have : π P hA Λ y ∈ (π P hA Λ).range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X) :
    FiniteDimensional K (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X)
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional_hom_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ (projectiveCoverShift P hA Λ) hX
  let φ : (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) →ₗ[K] (projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) :=
    { toFun f := f.comp (rangeRetr _)
      map_add' _ _ := rfl
      map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
  refine Module.Finite.of_injective φ fun f g hfg ↦ ?_
  ext y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := surjective_rangeRetr (projectiveCoverIdem_idem P hA Λ) y
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun hfg x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.eq_top_of_not_le_ker
statement:
theorem eq_top_of_not_le_ker (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ))
    (hN : ¬ N ≤ (π P hA Λ).ker) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hO := isCategoryO P hA Λ
  have := finiteDimensional_hom P hA Λ hO
  have := finiteDimensional_end_projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ
  refine eq_top_of_minimal (projectiveCoverIdem_idem P hA Λ)
    (fun e' he' hψ ↦ idemRank_projectiveCoverIdem_le P hA Λ e' he' hψ) (π_ne_zero P hA Λ) N
    fun φ ↦ ?_
  have hπN : Function.Surjective ((π P hA Λ).comp N.incl) := by
    have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P Λ
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top ((π P hA Λ).comp N.incl).range).resolve_left
      fun h0 ↦ hN fun y hy ↦ ?_
    have : ((π P hA Λ).comp N.incl) ⟨y, hy⟩ ∈ ((π P hA Λ).comp N.incl).range :=
      (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact this
  exact isProjectiveO P hA Λ (hO.lieSubmodule N) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ)
    ((π P hA Λ).comp N.incl) hπN φ

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk P)
proof: := LieIdeal.mkHom_surjective _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.mk_eq_zero_of_mem
statement: lemma mk_eq_zero_of_mem {x} (hx : x ∈ P.auxRels) : mk P x = 0
proof:
:=
  (LieIdeal.mkHom_eq_zero_iff _).mpr (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_h
statement: lemma lie_h_h (a b : H) : ⁅h P a, h P b⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem P (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a, b, rfl⟩)))
  rwa [LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_e_f
statement: lemma lie_e_f (i j : ι) : ⁅e P i, f P j⁆ = if i = j then h P (P.coroot i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem P (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨i, j, rfl⟩))))
  rw [map_sub, LieHom.map_lie, sub_eq_zero] at this
  rw [e, f, this]
  split_ifs <;> simp [h]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_e_f_self
statement: @[simp] lemma lie_e_f_self (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, f P i⁆ = h P (P.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lie_e_f]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_e_f_of_ne
statement: lemma lie_e_f_of_ne {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : ⁅e P i, f P j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lie_e_f, hij]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_e
statement: lemma lie_h_e (a : H) (i : ι) : ⁅h P a, e P i⁆ = P.root i a • e P i
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem P (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a, i, rfl⟩)))))
  rw [map_sub, LieHom.map_lie, map_smul, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_f
statement: lemma lie_h_f (a : H) (i : ι) : ⁅h P a, f P i⁆ = -(P.root i a • f P i)
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_eq_zero_of_mem P (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, i, rfl⟩)))))
  rw [map_add, LieHom.map_lie, map_smul, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.LiftData.le_ker
statement:
lemma LiftData.le_ker (D : LiftData P L) :
    P.auxIdeal ≤ (FreeLieAlgebra.lift K D.gen).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [auxIdeal, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  intro x hx
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker]
  rcases hx with ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, a, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, j, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, i, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, i, rfl⟩
  · simp [LiftData.gen]
  · simp [LiftData.gen]
  · simp [LiftData.gen, D.lie_h_h]
  · simp only [map_sub, LieHom.map_lie, lift_of_apply, LiftData.gen, D.lie_e_f]
    split_ifs <;> simp [LiftData.gen]
  · simp [LiftData.gen, D.lie_h_e]
  · simp [LiftData.gen, D.lie_h_f]

statement: @[simp] lemma lift_e (D : LiftData P L) (i : ι) : lift D (e P i) = D.e i

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma hom_ext {g₁ g₂ : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ⁅K⁆ L} (he : ∀ i, g₁ (e P i) = g₂ (e P i))
    (hf : ∀ i, g₁ (f P i) = g₂ (f P i)) (hh : ∀ a, g₁ (h P a) = g₂ (h P a)) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  have : g₁.comp (mk P) = g₂.comp (mk P) := by
    ext (x | x | x)
    · exact he x
    · exact hf x
    · exact hh x
  exact LieIdeal.lieHom_ext _ fun x ↦ LieHom.congr_fun this x

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lieSpan_generators
statement:
lemma lieSpan_generators :
    LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.AuxLieAlgebra
      (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P) ∪ Set.range (h P)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro y -
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P y
  induction x using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of g =>
    apply LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan
    rcases g with i | i | a
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨a, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => simpa using LieSubalgebra.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul a y hy => simpa using LieSubalgebra.smul_mem _ a hy
  | lie y z hy hz => simpa using LieSubalgebra.lie_mem _ hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma induction_on {p : P.AuxLieAlgebra → Prop} (y : P.AuxLieAlgebra)
    (he : ∀ i, p (e P i)) (hf : ∀ i, p (f P i)) (hh : ∀ a, p (h P a)) (zero : p 0)
    (add : ∀ y z, p y → p z → p (y + z)) (smul : ∀ (a : K) y, p y → p (a • y))
    (lie : ∀ y z, p y → p z → p ⁅y, z⁆) : p y
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.AuxLieAlgebra
      (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P) ∪ Set.range (h P)) := by
    rw [lieSpan_generators]; trivial
  induction hy using LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) | ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exacts [he i, hf i, hh a]
  | zero => exact zero
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add y z hy hz
  | smul a y _ hy => exact smul a y hy
  | lie y z _ _ hy hz => exact lie y z hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_mem_of_generators
statement:
lemma lie_mem_of_generators (S : Submodule K P.AuxLieAlgebra)
    (he : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ S, ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ S) (hf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ S, ⁅f P i, x⁆ ∈ S)
    (hh : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ S, ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ S) (y : P.AuxLieAlgebra) : ∀ x ∈ S, ⁅y, x⁆ ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | he i => exact he i
  | hf i => exact hf i
  | hh a => exact hh a
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => intro x hx; rw [add_lie]; exact S.add_mem (hy x hx) (hz x hx)
  | smul a y hy => intro x hx; rw [smul_lie]; exact S.smul_mem a (hy x hx)
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    intro x hx
    rw [lie_lie]
    exact S.sub_mem (hy _ (hz x hx)) (hz _ (hy x hx))

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.idealOfGenerators_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] lemma idealOfGenerators_toSubmodule (S : Submodule K P.AuxLieAlgebra) (he hf hh) :
    (idealOfGenerators S he hf hh).toSubmodule = S
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eq_top_of_generators
statement:
lemma eq_top_of_generators (S : Submodule K P.AuxLieAlgebra)
    (hse : ∀ i, e P i ∈ S) (hsf : ∀ i, f P i ∈ S) (hsh : ∀ a, h P a ∈ S)
    (he : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ S, ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ S) (hf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ S, ⁅f P i, x⁆ ∈ S)
    (hh : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ S, ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ S) : S = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro y -
  induction y using induction_on with
  | he i => exact hse i
  | hf i => exact hsf i
  | hh a => exact hsh a
  | zero => exact S.zero_mem
  | add y z hy hz => exact S.add_mem hy hz
  | smul a y hy => exact S.smul_mem a hy
  | lie y z _ hz => exact lie_mem_of_generators S he hf hh y z hz

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution
