name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.kacKazhdanStep_of_wallStep
statement:
theorem kacKazhdanStep_of_wallStep (S : A.Symmetrization) (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {η ξ ξ' : Dual K H} (h : P.WallStep hA η ξ ξ') :
    KacKazhdanStep P S (ξ - P.rho) (ξ' - P.rho)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, i, n, hpos, hn0, -, hn, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨v (P.root i), hpos, (realRoots_subset_roots P hA ⟨v, hv, i, rfl⟩).2, n, hn0,
    by abel, ?_⟩
  have h1 : P.dualBilinForm S ξ (v (P.root i)) = (n : K) / S.ε i := by
    have := P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S hv (v.symm ξ) (P.root i)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    rw [this, P.dualBilinForm_root_right, hn]
  have h2 : P.dualBilinForm S (v (P.root i)) (v (P.root i)) = 2 / S.ε i := by
    rw [P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S hv, P.dualBilinForm_root_right, P.root_coroot_self hA]
  rw [sub_add_cancel, h1, h2]
  ring

name: List.add_le_sum_map_of_mem_of_ne
statement:
theorem _root_.List.add_le_sum_map_of_mem_of_ne {α : Type*} {l : List α} {a b : α}
    (ha : a ∈ l) (hb : b ∈ l) (hab : a ≠ b) (f : α → ℕ) : f a + f b ≤ (l.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 := (List.perm_cons_erase ha).map f
  have h2 := (List.perm_cons_erase ((List.mem_erase_of_ne hab.symm).mpr hb)).map f
  rw [h1.sum_eq, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, h2.sum_eq, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
  omega

name: List.exists_mem_of_sum_map_eq_one
statement:
theorem _root_.List.exists_mem_of_sum_map_eq_one {α : Type*} {l : List α} {f : α → ℕ}
    (h : (l.map f).sum = 1) : ∃ a ∈ l, f a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  rw [List.sum_eq_zero fun n hn ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hn
    exact hcon a ha] at h
  exact zero_ne_one h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weylDot_sub_mem_cone_weylDot
statement:
theorem weylDot_sub_mem_cone_weylDot {lam μ ν : Dual K H} (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν)
    {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν) (w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ - ν ∈
      cone P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' lam)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ := IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot
    (IrreducibleModule.weightSpace_weylDot_sub_ne_bot hA hν hz hzν w')
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add] at hke ⊢
  rw [hke, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν) {η y : Dual K H}
    (h : ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, η = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' lam ∧
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = y ∧
      ¬Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P η))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hns : ¬Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P η)) := fun hs ↦
    h (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot _
      (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun v _ ↦ (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr (Subsingleton.elim v 0)))
  by_cases hχ : centralCharacter P η = centralCharacter P lam
  · obtain ⟨w', hw', hw'e⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA lam η).mp hχ.symm
    have hη : η = P.weylDot hA' ⟨w', hw'⟩ lam := by
      rw [weylDot, hw'e, add_sub_cancel_right]
    subst hη
    refine ⟨⟨w', hw'⟩, rfl, ?_, hns⟩
    rcases translation_irreducible P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν ⟨w', hw'⟩ with hs | he
    · exact absurd hs hns
    · obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
      rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e y,
        IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq] at h
      by_contra hne
      exact h (ite_eq_right fun hy ↦ hne hy.symm)
  · exfalso
    have hbot := centralBlock_irreducible_eq_bot P η (centralCharacter P lam) hχ
    refine h (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot _
      (weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η)
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _
        (fun _ hw ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hw) fun μ' _ ↦
          eq_bot_iff.mpr fun v _ ↦ ?_))
    have hv : (v : IrreducibleModule P η) ∈
        (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (IrreducibleModule P η)) := by
      rw [← hbot]
      exact v.2
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr (Subtype.ext ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp hv))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one
statement:
private theorem sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ - ν) ⊥ l ⊤) :
    ((factorWeights l).map fun η ↦
      ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity
          (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)).sum = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma_equiv P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  rw [← multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_sum P (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _)
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _
    (fun _ hw ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hw) hl,
    ← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e,
    VermaModule.multiplicity_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hC : P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val (lam + P.rho))
      (w.val (μ + P.rho))) :
    Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  rcases translation_irreducible P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w with hsub | hne
  swap
  · exact hne
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P
    (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).exists_isLocalCompositionSeries (P.weylDot hA' w μ - ν)
  have hsum := sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w hl
  
  obtain ⟨η, hηl, hη0⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_sum_map_eq_one hsum
  obtain ⟨w', rfl, hw'y, hns⟩ := exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero P hA hlam hμ
    hfacet hν hz hzν hη0
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
    (((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity_ne_zero_iff
      (hl.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights hηl) hl).mpr hηl)
  
  have hb' : w'.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho) := by
    rw [← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w' μ, ← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w μ, hw'y]
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hce⟩ := P.exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition hA hlam hμ hC hb'
  have h0 : P.rootOf (c + k) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, ← hce]
    simp only [weylDot] at hke
    linear_combination (norm := abel) hke
  have hck : c + k = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [h0, map_zero])
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    ext j
    have h1 := hc j
    have h2 := hk j
    have h3 := congrFun hck j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
    omega
  rw [hk0, map_zero, sub_zero] at hke
  have hxy : P.weylDot hA' w' lam = P.weylDot hA' w lam := by
    exact hke
  rw [hxy] at hns
  exact hns hsub

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hC : ¬P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val (lam + P.rho))
      (w.val (μ + P.rho))) :
    Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)
      (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  
  obtain ⟨w'', hw''b, hw''U, hchain⟩ := P.exists_upperClosureCondition hA'
    (a := lam + P.rho) (b := μ + P.rho) hlam w
  have hy : P.weylDot hA' w'' μ = P.weylDot hA' w μ := by
    simp only [weylDot, hw''b]
  have hne : P.weylDot hA' w lam ≠ P.weylDot hA' w'' lam := by
    intro h
    have h' : w''.val (lam + P.rho) = w.val (lam + P.rho) := by
      rw [← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w'' lam, ← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w lam, h]
    exact hC (h' ▸ hw''U)
  obtain ⟨e''⟩ := translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν
    w'' (by rw [hw''b]; exact hw''U)
  
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  have hKK : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity
      (P.weylDot hA' w'' lam) ≠ 0 :=
    (VermaModule.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff_reflTransGen P
      (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm) hA' _ _).mpr
      (Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (fun ξ ↦ ξ - P.rho)
        (fun _ _ h ↦ kacKazhdanStep_of_wallStep P _ hA' h) _ _ hchain)
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P
    (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).exists_isLocalCompositionSeries (P.weylDot hA' w μ - ν)
  have hsum := sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w hl
  have hx : P.weylDot hA' w lam ∈ factorWeights l :=
    ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity_ne_zero_iff
      (weylDot_sub_mem_cone_weylDot P hA hν hz hzν w) hl).mp (by
        rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self]
        exact one_ne_zero)
  have hx'' : P.weylDot hA' w'' lam ∈ factorWeights l :=
    ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity_ne_zero_iff
      (hy ▸ weylDot_sub_mem_cone_weylDot P hA hν hz hzν w'') hl).mp hKK
  have hle := List.add_le_sum_map_of_mem_of_ne hx hx'' hne fun η ↦
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
  rw [hsum, ← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e'',
    IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ite_eq_left hy.symm] at hle
  rcases translation_irreducible P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w with hsub | he
  · exact hsub
  · obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    exfalso
    rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e,
      IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ite_eq_left rfl] at hle
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_memUpperClosure
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_memUpperClosure {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)

    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)

      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:=
  translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
    ((P.memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff hA.isGeneralizedCartan hlam hμ hfacet w).mp hU)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_translation_irreducible_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_translation_irreducible_iff {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))) ↔
      P.MemUpperClosure hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ ?_,
    translation_irreducible_of_memUpperClosure P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w⟩
  by_contra hU
  have hs := translation_irreducible_of_not_memUpperClosure P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w hU
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P _ (e.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sub_rho_integral
statement:
theorem sub_rho_integral {lam μ ν : Dual K H} (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν)
    {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν) :
    ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  have hνint : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, ν (P.coroot i) = n := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν i; exact ⟨n, by rw [hn, Int.cast_natCast]⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan (inv_mem hz) hνint
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hνint j
  have e : (lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) = -(z⁻¹ ν) := by
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← hzν, ← neg_sub]
    congr 1
    exact (z.symm_apply_apply _).symm
  refine ⟨-(n + (A *ᵥ k) j), ?_⟩
  rw [e, hk, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν) {η y : Dual K H}
    (h : ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, η = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' lam ∧
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = y ∧
      ¬Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P η))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hns : ¬Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P η)) := fun hs ↦
    h (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot _
      (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun v _ ↦ (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr (Subsingleton.elim v 0)))
  by_cases hχ : centralCharacter P η = centralCharacter P lam
  · obtain ⟨w', hw', hw'e⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA lam η).mp hχ.symm
    have hη : η = P.weylDot hA' ⟨w', hw'⟩ lam := by
      rw [weylDot, hw'e, add_sub_cancel_right]
    subst hη
    refine ⟨⟨w', hw'⟩, rfl, ?_, hns⟩
    rcases translation_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν ⟨w', hw'⟩ with
        hs | he
    · exact absurd hs hns
    · obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
      rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e y,
        IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq] at h
      by_contra hne
      exact h (ite_eq_right fun hy ↦ hne hy.symm)
  · exfalso
    have hbot := centralBlock_irreducible_eq_bot P η (centralCharacter P lam) hχ
    refine h (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot _
      (weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η)
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _
        (fun _ hw ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hw) fun μ' _ ↦
          eq_bot_iff.mpr fun v _ ↦ ?_))
    have hv : (v : IrreducibleModule P η) ∈
        (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (IrreducibleModule P η)) := by
      rw [← hbot]
      exact v.2
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr (Subtype.ext ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp hv))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one_of_isAntidominant
statement:
private theorem sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ - ν) ⊥ l ⊤) :
    ((factorWeights l).map fun η ↦
      ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity
          (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)).sum = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  rw [← multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_sum P (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _)
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _
    (fun _ hw ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hw) hl,
    ← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e,
    VermaModule.multiplicity_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hC : P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val (lam + P.rho))
      (w.val (μ + P.rho))) :
    Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  rcases translation_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w with hsub | hne
  swap
  · exact hne
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P
    (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).exists_isLocalCompositionSeries (P.weylDot hA' w μ - ν)
  have hsum := sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν
      w hl
  
  obtain ⟨η, hηl, hη0⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_sum_map_eq_one hsum
  obtain ⟨w', rfl, hw'y, hns⟩ :=
      exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ
    hfacet hν hz hzν hη0
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
    (((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity_ne_zero_iff
      (hl.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights hηl) hl).mpr hηl)
  
  have hb' : w'.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho) := by
    rw [← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w' μ, ← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w μ, hw'y]
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hce⟩ := exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral hA
    (sub_rho_integral P hA hν hz hzν) hlam hC hb'
  have h0 : P.rootOf (c + k) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, ← hce]
    simp only [weylDot] at hke
    linear_combination (norm := abel) hke
  have hck : c + k = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [h0, map_zero])
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    ext j
    have h1 := hc j
    have h2 := hk j
    have h3 := congrFun hck j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
    omega
  rw [hk0, map_zero, sub_zero] at hke
  have hxy : P.weylDot hA' w' lam = P.weylDot hA' w lam := by
    exact hke
  rw [hxy] at hns
  exact hns hsub

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hC : ¬P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val (lam + P.rho))
      (w.val (μ + P.rho))) :
    Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)
      (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  
  have hwρ : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' (lam + P.rho) := by
    rwa [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' (μ' := lam) fun j ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩]
  obtain ⟨w'', -, hw''b, hw''U, hchain⟩ := exists_upperClosureCondition_of_integral hA
    (sub_rho_integral P hA hν hz hzν) hlam hwρ
  have hy : P.weylDot hA' w'' μ = P.weylDot hA' w μ := by
    simp only [weylDot, hw''b]
  have hne : P.weylDot hA' w lam ≠ P.weylDot hA' w'' lam := by
    intro h
    have h' : w''.val (lam + P.rho) = w.val (lam + P.rho) := by
      rw [← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w'' lam, ← P.weylDot_add_rho hA' w lam, h]
    exact hC (h' ▸ hw''U)
  obtain ⟨e''⟩ := translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ
      hfacet hν hz hzν
    w'' (by rw [hw''b]; exact hw''U)
  
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  have hKK : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity
      (P.weylDot hA' w'' lam) ≠ 0 :=
    (VermaModule.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff_reflTransGen P
      (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm) hA' _ _).mpr
      (Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (fun ξ ↦ ξ - P.rho)
        (fun _ _ h ↦ kacKazhdanStep_of_wallStep P _ hA' h) _ _ hchain)
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P
    (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).exists_isLocalCompositionSeries (P.weylDot hA' w μ - ν)
  have hsum := sum_multiplicity_translation_eq_one_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν
      w hl
  have hx : P.weylDot hA' w lam ∈ factorWeights l :=
    ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity_ne_zero_iff
      (weylDot_sub_mem_cone_weylDot P hA hν hz hzν w) hl).mp (by
        rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self]
        exact one_ne_zero)
  have hx'' : P.weylDot hA' w'' lam ∈ factorWeights l :=
    ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).multiplicity_ne_zero_iff
      (hy ▸ weylDot_sub_mem_cone_weylDot P hA hν hz hzν w'') hl).mp hKK
  have hle := List.add_le_sum_map_of_mem_of_ne hx hx'' hne fun η ↦
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
  rw [hsum, ← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e'',
    IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ite_eq_left hy.symm] at hle
  rcases translation_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w with hsub | he
  · exact hsub
  · obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    exfalso
    rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e,
      IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ite_eq_left rfl] at hle
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_not_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_not_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hU : ¬P.MemUpperClosure hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
      (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)) :
    Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)
      (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:=
  translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz
      hzν w hw
    fun hC ↦
    hU ((memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ
      (sub_rho_integral P hA hν hz hzν) hfacet w).mpr hC)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_translation_irreducible_iff_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_translation_irreducible_iff_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam) :
    Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))) ↔
      P.MemUpperClosure hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ ?_,
    translation_irreducible_of_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w⟩
  by_contra hU
  have hs := translation_irreducible_of_not_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet
      hν hz hzν w hw
    hU
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P _ (e.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.apply_eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_dual
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, κ a ≠ (-μ) a := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hκ (LinearMap.ext hc)
  have h1 := congrArg (fun g : Module.Dual K V ↦ g v) (hf a)
  simp only [Module.Dual.lie_apply, hv a, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h2 : (κ a - (-μ) a) * f v = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply]
    linear_combination -h1
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualWeightRestrict_injective
statement:
theorem dualWeightRestrict_injective (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (μ : Dual K H) : Function.Injective (dualWeightRestrict P (V := V) μ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩ ⟨g, hg⟩ hfg
  refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_)
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ κ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem κ v hv =>
    by_cases hκ : κ = -μ
    · subst hκ
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun hfg ⟨v, hv⟩
    · simp only
      rw [apply_eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_dual P hf hv hκ,
        apply_eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_dual P hg hv hκ]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add] at hx hy ⊢; rw [hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual_le
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual_le [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (Module.Dual K V) (h P) μ) ≤
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) (-μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]
  exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (dualWeightRestrict_injective P hV μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (hV' : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (Module.Dual K V) (h P) μ = ⊤) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (Module.Dual K V) (h P) μ) =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) (-μ))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual_le P hV μ) ?_
  have h1 := finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual_le P hV' (-μ)
  rwa [neg_neg, ← finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv P
    (LieModule.evalEquiv (L := P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (M := V)) (-μ)] at h1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.LieSubmodule.nonempty_subquotientEquivMap
statement:
theorem LieSubmodule.nonempty_subquotientEquivMap (N N' : LieSubmodule R L M) :
    Nonempty (N.Subquotient N' ≃ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N))
proof:
:= by
  let θ : N' →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) :=
    ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N).comp N'.incl).codRestrict _ fun x ↦ ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩
  have hθ : Function.Surjective θ := by
    rintro ⟨_, x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  refine LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective _ θ hθ ?_
  ext x
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieSubmodule.mem_comap]
  change (⟨_, _⟩ : N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff]
  exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.multiplicity_of_isDominant
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hξ
  · subst hξ
    exact multiplicity_self ξ
  · by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
    have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
      simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA
      (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm) hne
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkΛ⟩ := mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hne
    have hwk : ((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
        (Λ + P.rho) = Λ + P.rho + P.rootOf k := by
      have h1 := P.weylDot_add_rho hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ξ
      rw [← hw] at h1
      rw [h1, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Subgroup.coe_one,
        LinearEquiv.coe_one, id, ← h1, hkΛ]
      abel
    have hk0 := hΛ.eq_zero_of_apply_eq P hA (w⁻¹).2 hk hwk
    apply hξ
    rw [hkΛ, hk0, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.finrank_hom_verma_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.finrank_hom_verma_of_isDominant [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) {X : Type w} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) = s.count Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := VermaModule.isProjectiveCover P Λ
  induction hN with
  | bot =>
    have : Subsingleton (VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X)) :=
      ⟨fun f g ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ Subtype.ext
        (((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (f x).2).trans ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (g x).2).symm)⟩
    simp [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
  | @step N N' s μ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    obtain ⟨e'⟩ := LieSubmodule.nonempty_subquotientEquivMap N N'
    rw [hπ.finrank_hom_eq_add (VermaModule.isProjectiveO.{w} P hA hΛ) hX hle, ih,
      (lieModuleHomCongr P LieModuleEquiv.refl (e'.trans e.symm)).finrank_eq,
      hπ.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (VermaModule.isProjectiveO P hA hΛ) (isCategoryO P μ),
      VermaModule.multiplicity_of_isDominant P hA hΛ, Multiset.count_cons]
    by_cases hμ : μ = Λ
    · simp [hμ]
    · simp [hμ, Ne.symm hμ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_tensor_verma_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_tensor_verma_of_isDominant {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) {L : Type*} [AddCommGroup L] [Module K L]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 L] [LieModule K 𝔤 L] [FiniteDimensional K L] (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P μ) =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap L (h P) (μ - Λ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hL : IsCategoryO P L := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA
  have hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K L) := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcount⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma P hL'.1 μ
  have hX := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).tensorProduct hL'
  have etop : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (VermaModule P μ ⊗[K] Module.Dual K L)) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      VermaModule P μ ⊗[K] Module.Dual K L :=
    LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 _).incl
      ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun x ↦ ⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  have hc : (s.map (μ + ·)).count Λ = s.count (Λ - μ) := by
    rw [show Λ = μ + (Λ - μ) by abel, Multiset.count_map_eq_count' _ _ (add_right_injective μ),
      add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [(tensorHomAdjunction P).finrank_eq,
    ← (lieModuleHomCongr P LieModuleEquiv.refl etop).finrank_eq,
    hs.finrank_hom_verma_of_isDominant P hA hΛ hX, hc, hcount,
    finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual P hL.1 hL'.1, neg_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.two_mul_dualBilinForm_eq_corootPairing_mul
statement:
theorem two_mul_dualBilinForm_eq_corootPairing_mul (S : A.Symmetrization) (x : Dual K H)
    (v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    2 * P.dualBilinForm S x ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan x v i * P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan S v.2
    (((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x) (P.root i)
  have hx : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x) = x := by
    rw [← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Subgroup.coe_one,
      LinearEquiv.coe_one, id]
  rw [hx] at h₁
  rw [h₁]
  exact (VermaModule.two_mul_dualBilinForm_root_eq_iff P hA.isGeneralizedCartan S _ i _).mpr rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.KacKazhdanStep.exists_isPosRoot
statement:
theorem KacKazhdanStep.exists_isPosRoot (S : A.Symmetrization) {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (hstep : KacKazhdanStep P S Λ μ) :
    ∃ (v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι), P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ μ = Λ - n • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∧
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (Λ + P.rho) v i = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, hα, hroot, n, hn, rfl, hKK⟩ := hstep
  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ P.zero_notMem_posWeights (h0 ▸ hα)
  have hreal : α ∈ P.realRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan := by
    rw [← roots_eq_realRoots P hA]
    exact ⟨hα0, hroot⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu, i, rfl⟩ := hreal
  refine ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, i, ?_, n, hn, rfl, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hkα⟩ := hα
    exact ⟨k, hk.1, hkα.symm⟩
  · have h := two_mul_dualBilinForm_eq_corootPairing_mul P hA S (Λ + P.rho) ⟨u, hu⟩ i
    have h₂ := P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan S hu (P.root i) (P.root i)
    change 2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (u (P.root i)) = _ at h
    rw [hKK, h₂] at h
    have hne : P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [dualBilinForm_root_self S hA.isGeneralizedCartan]
      have := S.ε_pos i
      exact_mod_cast (by positivity : (2 / S.ε i : ℚ) ≠ 0)
    exact (mul_right_cancel₀ hne h).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_irreducibleModule_eq_bot_of_kacKazhdanStep
statement:
theorem weightSpace_irreducibleModule_eq_bot_of_kacKazhdanStep {Λ μ Λ' ν : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) (hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, (μ - Λ) (P.coroot j) = z)
    (hc : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (Λ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
      ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hνw : ν = w (μ - Λ)) (S : A.Symmetrization)
    (hstep : KacKazhdanStep P S μ Λ') :
    weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (Λ' - Λ) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hx
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  obtain ⟨v, i, hv, n, hn, rfl, hpair⟩ := hstep.exists_isPosRoot P hA S
  set S' := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hd hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S'
  set β := (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
  obtain ⟨c, hcγ⟩ := exists_int_corootPairing_of_integral P hA' hint v i
  have hΛc : P.corootPairing hA' (Λ + P.rho) v i = ((n - c : ℤ) : K) := by
    have h := corootPairing_sub (P := P) (hA := hA') (μ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) v i
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hcγ, hpair] at h
    push_cast
    linear_combination h
  have h0 : 0 ≤ (n : ℤ) - c := hΛ v i hv _ hΛc
  have h1 : (n : ℤ) - c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h1
    have := hc v i hv (by rw [hΛc, h1, Int.cast_zero]) n (by rw [hpair]; push_cast; rfl)
    omega
  obtain ⟨m, hm, -⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_norm_eq_add P hA hd hsymm hpos hν hx
  have hνν : B ν ν = B (μ - Λ) (μ - Λ) := by
    rw [hνw]
    exact P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA' S' hw (μ - Λ) (μ - Λ)
  have hββ : B β β = B (P.root i) (P.root i) :=
    P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA' S' v.2 (P.root i) (P.root i)
  have hγβ : 2 * B (μ - Λ) β = (c : K) * B (P.root i) (P.root i) := by
    have := two_mul_dualBilinForm_eq_corootPairing_mul P hA S' (μ - Λ) v i
    rwa [hcγ] at this
  have key : ∀ x y : Dual K H,
      B (x - (n : K) • y) (x - (n : K) • y) = B x x - 2 * n * B x y + n ^ 2 * B y y := by
    intro x y
    have hs : B y x = B x y := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S').eq y x
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs]
    ring
  have hx' : μ - n • β - Λ = (μ - Λ) - (n : K) • β := by
    rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    abel
  rw [hx', hνν, key, hββ, dualBilinForm_root_self S' hA'] at hm
  rw [dualBilinForm_root_self S' hA'] at hγβ
  have hε := S'.ε_pos i
  have hq : ((((n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) - c) * (2 / S'.ε i) + m : ℚ)) : K) = 0 := by
    push_cast at hm hγβ ⊢
    linear_combination -hm + (n : K) * hγβ
  have hq' : ((n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) - c) * (2 / S'.ε i) + m : ℚ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hnc : (0 : ℚ) < (n : ℚ) - c := by
    have : (0 : ℤ) < n - c := lt_of_le_of_ne h0 (Ne.symm h1)
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hnpos : (0 : ℚ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have : (0 : ℚ) < (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) - c) * (2 / S'.ε i) + m := by positivity
  linarith

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpace_irreducibleModule_of_apply_eq
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional hA hν
  have h := rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan
    (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional hA (V := IrreducibleModule P ν)) hw x
  rw [hx] at h
  rw [← IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P ν]
  exact congrArg Cardinal.toNat h.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isFGProjectiveO_tensor_verma
statement:
theorem isFGProjectiveO_tensor_verma {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ)
    {L : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup L] [Module K L] [LieRingModule 𝔤 L] [LieModule K 𝔤 L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] : IsFGProjectiveO P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L) where
  isProjectiveO
proof:
:= IsProjectiveO.tensorProduct P (VermaModule.isProjectiveO P hA hΛ)
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA)
  isCategoryO := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA)
  fg := exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top
    (VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top (P := P) (Λ := Λ) LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_irreducibleModule_of_ne_zero {V Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y] [LieModule K 𝔤 Y] {S : Finset V}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set V) = ⊤) (hY : IsCategoryO P Y)
    {g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ξ : Dual K H, ∃ φ : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ξ, Function.Surjective φ ∧
      hY.multiplicity ξ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let g' : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ g.range :=
    g.codRestrict g.range fun m ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩
  have hg' : Function.Surjective g' := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hy
    exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
  have : Nontrivial g.range := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, g v ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hg (LieModuleHom.ext h)
    exact ⟨⟨g' v, 0, fun h ↦ hv (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩⟩
  have hSR : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 ((S.image g' : Finset g.range) : Set g.range) = ⊤ := by
    have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set V) ≤
        (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 ((S.image g' : Finset g.range) : Set g.range)).comap g' :=
      LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr fun s hs ↦ LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan
        (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image_of_mem g' (Finset.mem_coe.mp hs)))
    rw [hS] at hle
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro y -
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hg' y
    exact hle (LieSubmodule.mem_top v)
  obtain ⟨ξ, φ, hφ⟩ := (hY.lieSubmodule g.range).exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA hSR
  refine ⟨ξ, φ.comp g', hφ.comp hg', ?_⟩
  have h1 := hY.multiplicity_eq_add g.range ξ
  have h2 := IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact ((hY.lieSubmodule g.range).lieSubmodule φ.ker)
    (hY.lieSubmodule g.range) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ) φ.ker.incl φ
    Subtype.val_injective (LieSubmodule.range_incl _).symm hφ ξ
  simp only [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ↓reduceIte] at h2
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.finrank_hom_ne_zero_of_multiplicity
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, r, hrs⟩ := hV.exists_retract hA φ hφ
  rw [hV.finrank_hom_eq_add hA hrs hY, ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity P ξ hA hY]
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_tensor_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_tensor_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_one {Λ μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) (hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, (μ - Λ) (P.coroot j) = z)
    (hc : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (Λ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
      ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hνw : ν = w (μ - Λ)) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) =
      1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional hA hν
  have hV := isFGProjectiveO_tensor_verma P hA hΛ (L := IrreducibleModule P ν)
  have h1 : finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P μ) =
      1 := by
    rw [finrank_hom_tensor_verma_of_isDominant P hA hΛ μ]
    exact finrank_weightSpace_irreducibleModule_of_apply_eq P hA hν hw hνw.symm
  let π : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ :=
    LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ)
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective
      (π.homCompLeftₗ (Q := VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν)) := fun φ ↦
    hV.isProjectiveO (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ) π hπ φ
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_hom (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_hom (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ)
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le
    (π.homCompLeftₗ (Q := VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν))
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top, h1] at hle
  have hne : finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      IrreducibleModule P μ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hsub := Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp h0
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp (h1 ▸ Nat.one_pos)
    obtain ⟨ξ, φ, hφ, hξ⟩ := exists_surjective_irreducibleModule_of_ne_zero P hA
      hV.fg.choose_spec (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) hg
    have hξμ : ξ ≠ μ := by
      rintro rfl
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hφ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P ξ)
      rw [Subsingleton.elim φ 0, _root_.zero_apply] at hx
      exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P ξ hx.symm
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
    have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
      simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
    obtain ⟨Λ', hstep, hΛ'⟩ := VermaModule.exists_kacKazhdanStep_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P
      (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hd hsymm) hA.isGeneralizedCartan hξμ hξ
    have h2 := hV.finrank_hom_ne_zero_of_multiplicity P hA hφ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ') hΛ'
    rw [finrank_hom_tensor_verma_of_isDominant P hA hΛ Λ'] at h2
    apply h2
    rw [show weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P ν) (h P) (Λ' - Λ) = ⊥ from
      weightSpace_irreducibleModule_eq_bot_of_kacKazhdanStep P hA hΛ hint hc hν hw hνw _ hstep]
    exact finrank_bot K _
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.hom_tensor_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hom_tensor_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_zero {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) {L : Type*} [AddCommGroup L] [Module K L]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 L] [LieModule K 𝔤 L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hΛ0 : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (Λ + P.rho) v i = 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hμn : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = n)
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set α := (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
  have hL : IsCategoryO P L := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA
  have hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K L) := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA
  have hVp := IsProjectiveO.tensorProduct.{max u₁ u₂} P (VermaModule.isProjectiveO P hA hΛ) hL'
  have hVO : IsCategoryO P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L) :=
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct hL
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top (W := L)
    (VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top (P := P) (Λ := Λ) LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := VermaModule.exists_injective_reflectionOf P hA hv hμn
  
  have hpair : P.corootPairing hA' (μ - Λ) v i = n := by
    have h := corootPairing_sub (P := P) (hA := hA') (μ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) v i
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hμn, hΛ0, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hrefl : ((P.reflectionOf hA' v i : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ - Λ) =
      μ - n • α - Λ := by
    rw [reflectionOf_apply', hpair, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    abel
  have hdim : finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P (μ - n • α)) =
      finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P μ) := by
    rw [finrank_hom_tensor_verma_of_isDominant P hA hΛ, finrank_hom_tensor_verma_of_isDominant P hA
      hΛ, ← hrefl]
    exact congrArg Cardinal.toNat (rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA'
      (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional hA (V := L)) (P.reflectionOf hA' v i).2 (μ - Λ))
  have := hVO.finiteDimensional_hom P hS (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)
  have := hVO.finiteDimensional_hom P hS (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (μ - n • α))
  have hinj : Function.Injective (ψ.homCompLeftₗ (Q := VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L)) :=
    fun g g' hgg ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ hψ (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hgg x)
  have hbij := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mp hinj
  
  have hne : ψ.range ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    let e := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective ψ ⟨hψ, (LieModuleHom.range_eq_top _).mp htop⟩
    have hm := IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (μ - n • α))
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) e μ
    rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self] at hm
    have hc1 : μ ∈ cone P (μ - n • α) :=
      VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (by rw [hm]; exact one_ne_zero)
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, hαk⟩ := hv
    have hc2 : μ - n • α ∈ cone P μ := ⟨n • k₀, nsmul_nonneg hk₀ n, by rw [map_nsmul, ← hαk]⟩
    have h0 : n • α = 0 := by
      have := eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hc2 hc1
      rwa [sub_eq_self] at this
    rw [smul_eq_zero] at h0
    rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    · omega
    · exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i
        ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)
  have hrange : ψ.range ≤ VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ :=
    (VermaModule.le_maxSubmodule_iff P μ _).mpr hne
  let π : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ :=
    LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ)
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hVp (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ) π
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) φ
  obtain ⟨g', rfl⟩ := hbij g
  ext x
  change π (ψ (g' x)) = 0
  exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'.mpr
    (hrange ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨g' x, rfl⟩))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tfae_projectiveCover_tensor_verma
statement:
theorem tfae_projectiveCover_tensor_verma {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) (hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, (μ - Λ) (P.coroot j) = z) :
    List.TFAE [
      ∃ (L : Type (max u₁ u₂)) (_ : AddCommGroup L) (_ : Module K L) (_ : LieRingModule 𝔤 L)
        (_ : LieModule K 𝔤 L) (_ : FiniteDimensional K L)
        (s : ProjectiveCover P hA μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L)
        (r : VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA μ), r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id,
      ∃ (L : Type (max u₁ u₂)) (_ : AddCommGroup L) (_ : Module K L) (_ : LieRingModule 𝔤 L)
        (_ : LieModule K 𝔤 L) (_ : FiniteDimensional K L)
        (φ : VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ), φ ≠ 0,
      ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (Λ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = n → n ≤ 0]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := by
    rintro ⟨L, _, _, _, _, _, s, r, hrs⟩
    refine ⟨L, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
      (ProjectiveCover.π P hA μ).comp r, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ProjectiveCover.surjective_π P hA μ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P μ)
    have h := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 (s x)
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply r s, hrs, LieModuleHom.id_apply, hx,
      _root_.zero_apply] at h
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P μ h
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := by
    rintro ⟨L, _, _, _, _, _, φ, hφ⟩ v i hv hΛ0 n hn
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    refine hφ (hom_tensor_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_zero P hA hΛ hv hΛ0 (n := n.toNat)
      (by omega) ?_ φ)
    rw [hn, ← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hlt.le]
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := by
    intro hc
    have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup P hA.isGeneralizedCartan hint
    have h1 := finrank_hom_tensor_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_one P hA hΛ hint hc hw w.2 rfl
    have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional hA hw
    have hV := isFGProjectiveO_tensor_verma P hA hΛ (L := IrreducibleModule P (w.val (μ - Λ)))
    have := hV.finiteDimensional_hom (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ)
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp (h1 ▸ Nat.one_pos)
    obtain ⟨s, r, hrs⟩ := hV.exists_retract hA φ
      (surjective_of_ne_zero_irreducibleModule P hφ)
    exact ⟨IrreducibleModule P (w.val (μ - Λ)), inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
      inferInstance, inferInstance, s, r, hrs⟩
  tfae_finish

name: Matrix.Realization.weylDot_eq_of_upperClosureCondition
statement:
theorem weylDot_eq_of_upperClosureCondition [FiniteDimensional K H] {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n)
    {w w' : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hC : P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val (lam + P.rho))
      (w.val (μ + P.rho)))
    (hC' : P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w'.val (lam + P.rho))
      (w'.val (μ + P.rho)))
    (hb : w'.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho)) :
    P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan w' lam = P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n → n ≤ 0 := hlam
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, h₁⟩ := exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
    (P := P) hF hint ha hC hb
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, h₂⟩ := exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
    (P := P) hF hint ha hC' hb.symm
  have h0 : P.rootOf (c₁ + c₂) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [map_add, ← h₁, ← h₂, map_zero]; abel
  have hc0 : c₁ = 0 := by
    have := P.rootOf_injective h0
    ext j
    have h1 := congrFun this j
    have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c₁ j := hc₁ j
    have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c₂ j := hc₂ j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 ⊢
    omega
  rw [hc0, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h₁
  simp only [weylDot, h₁]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective
statement:
theorem lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective {R L M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [LieRingModule L N] (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) {s : Set M}
    (hs : LieSubmodule.lieSpan R L s = ⊤) : LieSubmodule.lieSpan R L (f '' s) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro y -
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf y
  have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan R L s ≤ (LieSubmodule.lieSpan R L (f '' s)).comap f := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    intro a ha
    exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (Set.mem_image_of_mem f ha)
  exact hle (hs ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top {V Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 Z] [LieModule K 𝔤 Z] [FiniteDimensional K Z] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) {χ₁ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (hVχ : centralBlock P V χ₁ = ⊤)
    {x : V} (hx : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {x} = ⊤) :
    ∃ T : Finset (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V),
      LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (T : Set (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hVχ
  have hx' : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {e.symm x} = ⊤ := by
    have := lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective e.symm.toLieModuleHom e.symm.surjective hx
    rwa [Set.image_singleton] at this
  have hS0 := exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top (L := 𝔤) (W := Z) hx'
  have hXO : IsCategoryO P (centralBlock P V χ₁ ⊗[K] Z) :=
    (hV.centralBlock P χ₁).tensorProduct hZ
  let r : (centralBlock P V χ₁ ⊗[K] Z) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V :=
    blockRetr P hXO χ₂
  have hr : Function.Surjective r := fun y ↦ ⟨y, blockRetr_incl P hXO χ₂ y⟩
  refine ⟨hS0.choose.image r, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.coe_image]
  exact lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective r hr hS0.choose_spec

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_centralBlock_eq_top_of_ne
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_centralBlock_eq_top_of_ne {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] {χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hV : centralBlock P V χ = ⊤)
    {η : Dual K H} (hne : centralCharacter P η ≠ χ) (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  have := map_mem_centralBlock P f χ (hV ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top y)
  rwa [centralBlock_irreducible_eq_bot P η χ hne, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.exists_lieSpan_singleton_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_lieSpan_singleton_eq_top (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ x : ProjectiveCover P hA Λ, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {x} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := surjective_π P hA Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
  refine ⟨x, eq_top_of_not_le_ker P hA Λ _ fun hle ↦ IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ ?_⟩
  rw [← hx]
  exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp (hle (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (Set.mem_singleton x)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.centralBlock_eq_top
statement:
theorem centralBlock_eq_top (Λ : Dual K H) :
    centralBlock P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) (centralCharacter P Λ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hO := (isCategoryO P hA Λ).isCentralLocallyFinite P
  have hL := (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).isCentralLocallyFinite P
  refine eq_top_of_not_le_ker P hA Λ _ fun hle ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := surjective_π P hA Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
  have h0 := LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp
    (hle (centralBlockProjection_mem P hO (centralCharacter P Λ) x))
  have hnat := LieModuleHom.congr_fun
    (centralBlockProjection_natural P hO hL (π P hA Λ) (centralCharacter P Λ)) x
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hx, centralBlockProjection_self P hL _
    (by rw [centralBlock_irreducible]; trivial)] at hnat
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ (hnat.symm.trans h0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.isFGProjectiveO
statement: theorem isFGProjectiveO (Λ : Dual K H) : IsFGProjectiveO P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_lieSpan_singleton_eq_top P hA Λ
  exact ⟨isProjectiveO P hA Λ, isCategoryO P hA Λ, ⟨{x}, by simpa using hx⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isFGProjectiveO_centralTranslation_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem isFGProjectiveO_centralTranslation_projectiveCover {Λ ν : Dual K H}
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {χ₁ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (hMχ : centralBlock P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) χ₁ = ⊤) :
    IsFGProjectiveO P
      (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂ (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hLO := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hL'O : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) hd.choose_spec.2.2.some.symm
  have hMO := ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA Λ
  have hMp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) :=
    ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA Λ
  have hx₀ := ProjectiveCover.exists_lieSpan_singleton_eq_top P hA Λ
  have hT := exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top P hMO hLO χ₂ hMχ hx₀.choose_spec
  exact ⟨isProjectiveO_centralBlock P (hV := (hMO.centralBlock P _).tensorProduct hLO)
      ((hMp.of_equiv (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hMχ).symm).tensorProduct P hL'O) _,
    hMO.centralTranslation P hLO χ₁ χ₂, ⟨hT.choose, hT.choose_spec⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_centralTranslation_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_centralTranslation_projectiveCover {Λ ν ν' η : Dual K H}
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν)
    (eν : Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν')
    {χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hMχ : centralBlock P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) χ₁ = ⊤)
    (hNχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P η) χ₂ = ⊤) :
    finrank K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂ (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)
      →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η) =
      ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') χ₂ χ₁).multiplicity Λ
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hLO := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hL'O : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm
  have hMO := ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA Λ
  have hT'O := (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hL'O χ₂ χ₁
  rw [(translationAdjunction P hMO hLO hMχ hNχ).finrank_eq,
    ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity P Λ hA hT'O]
  exact IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr hT'O _
    (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P η) χ₂ χ₁ eν) Λ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_projectiveCover {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hup : P.MemUpperClosure hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
      (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam)
        (ProjectiveCover P hA (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  let Λw := P.weylDot hA' w μ
  have hΛw : Λw = P.weylDot hA' w μ := rfl
  
  have hd := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  let z' := hd.choose
  have hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := hd.choose_spec.1
  have hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral (z' (-ν)) := hd.choose_spec.2.1
  let eν := hd.choose_spec.2.2.some
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  have hint := sub_rho_integral P hA hν' hzz hzν'
  have hC : P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w.val (lam + P.rho)) (w.val (μ + P.rho)) :=
    (memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hint hfacet w).mp hup
  
  have hWl : P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam = P.integralWeylGroup hA' (lam + P.rho) :=
    P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩
  have hWm : P.integralWeylGroup hA' (lam + P.rho) = P.integralWeylGroup hA' (μ + P.rho) :=
    P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' hint
  have hwb : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' (μ + P.rho) := hWm ▸ hWl ▸ hwint
  
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸
      ProjectiveCover.centralBlock_eq_top P hA Λw
  have hV := isFGProjectiveO_centralTranslation_projectiveCover P hA hν
    (centralCharacter P lam) hMχ
  
  let mult : Dual K H → ℕ := fun η ↦ ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (z' (-ν))) (centralCharacter P lam)
    (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity Λw
  
  have hHom : ∀ η, centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P η) (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ →
      finrank K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η) =
        mult η := by
    intro η hNχ
    exact finrank_hom_centralTranslation_projectiveCover P hA hν eν hMχ hNχ
  
  have hTop : centralBlock P (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw)) (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    centralBlock_centralBlock_eq_top P _
  have hblock : ∀ η, centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P η) (centralCharacter P lam) ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ f : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η,
        f = 0 := by
    intro η hη f
    exact eq_zero_of_centralBlock_eq_top_of_ne P hTop (fun h ↦
      hη (h ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P η)) f
  have hmult1 : ∀ w' : P.weylGroup hA',
      P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w'.val (lam + P.rho)) (w'.val (μ + P.rho)) →
      P.weylDot hA' w' μ = Λw → mult (P.weylDot hA' w' lam) = 1 := by
    intro w' hC' hw'μ
    let e := (translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ
      hfacet hν' hzz hzν' w' hC').some
    exact (IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P
      (P.weylDot hA' w' lam)).centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (z' (-ν)))
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _)
      e.symm Λw).trans (by simp [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, hw'μ])
  
  have hK : ∀ η, mult η ≠ 0 → η = P.weylDot hA' w lam := by
    intro η hη
    have hex := exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_translation_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ
      hfacet hν' hzz hzν' hη
    let w' := hex.choose
    have hηw : η = P.weylDot hA' w' lam := hex.choose_spec.1
    have hw'μ : P.weylDot hA' w' μ = Λw := hex.choose_spec.2.1
    have hns := hex.choose_spec.2.2
    rw [hηw] at hns
    have hw'b : w'.val (μ + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho) := by
      have := congrArg (· + P.rho) hw'μ
      simpa [weylDot, hΛw] using this
    have hw'int : w' ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam := by
      rw [hWl, hWm, mem_integralWeylGroup, hw'b]
      exact hwb
    have hC' : P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w'.val (lam + P.rho)) (w'.val (μ + P.rho)) := by
      by_contra hC'
      exact hns (translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P
        hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hzz hzν' w' hw'int hC')
    rw [hηw]
    exact weylDot_eq_of_upperClosureCondition hA hlam hint hC hC' hw'b
  have hwblock : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  have hdim1 : finrank K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)) = 1 := by
    rw [hHom _ hwblock]
    exact hmult1 w hC rfl
  have hdim0 : ∀ η, η ≠ P.weylDot hA' w lam → finrank K (centralTranslation P
      (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η) = 0 := by
    intro η hη
    by_cases hηb : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P η) (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤
    · rw [hHom η hηb]
      by_contra h
      exact hη (hK η h)
    · have : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P η) :=
        ⟨fun f g ↦ (hblock η hηb f).trans (hblock η hηb g).symm⟩
      exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  have key : ∀ η, finrank K (ProjectiveCover P hA (P.weylDot hA' w lam) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      IrreducibleModule P η) = finrank K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) (ProjectiveCover P hA Λw) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        IrreducibleModule P η) := by
    intro η
    refine (ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_irreducible (P := P) (hA := hA)
      (Λ := P.weylDot hA' w lam) η).trans ?_
    split_ifs with hη
    · subst hη
      exact hdim1.symm
    · exact (hdim0 η hη).symm
  exact (ProjectiveCover.isFGProjectiveO P hA _).nonempty_equiv_of_finrank_hom_eq P hA hV key

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_left
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_isZero_left {X Y : C} (hX : IsZero X) {n : ℕ} (x : Ext.{w} X Y n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk₀_id_comp x, hX.eq_of_src (𝟙 X) 0, mk₀_zero]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₃, rfl⟩ := contravariant_sequence_exact₂ hS Y x (h₁ _)
  rw [h₃ x₃]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_of_projective
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_shortExact_of_projective {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [Projective S.X₂] {Y : C} {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ x : Ext.{w} S.X₁ Y n, x = 0)
    (z : Ext.{w} S.X₃ Y (n + 1)) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₁, rfl⟩ := contravariant_sequence_exact₃ hS Y z (eq_zero_of_projective _)
    (n₀ := n) (by omega)
  rw [h x₁]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_stdStepMap
statement:
theorem surjective_stdStepMap (hle : N₀ ≤ N₁)
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)) :
    Function.Surjective (stdStepMap hle e)
proof:
:= fun m ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (e m).2
  refine ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ?_⟩
  change e.symm ⟨_, _⟩ = m
  rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact Subtype.ext hyz

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.stdStepMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem stdStepMap_eq_zero_iff (hle : N₀ ≤ N₁)
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)) (y : N₁) :
    stdStepMap hle e y = 0 ↔ (y : X) ∈ N₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  change e.symm _ = 0 ↔ _
  rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_eq, map_zero]
  exact Subtype.ext_iff

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isZero_ofSub_bot
statement: theorem isZero_ofSub_bot (X : CategoryO.{u} P) : IsZero (ofSub X ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton ((IsObj.{u} P).ι.obj (ofSub X ⊥)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj))
  exact IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero (IsObj.{u} P).ι _
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.shortExact_subComplex
statement:
theorem shortExact_subComplex (X : CategoryO.{u} P) {N N' : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj}
    (hle : N ≤ N') (Z : CategoryO.{u} P) (g : N' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z.obj)
    (hg : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ N), g ⟨x, hle hx⟩ = 0) (hgs : Function.Surjective g)
    (hker : ∀ y : N', g y = 0 → (y : X.obj) ∈ N) : (subComplex X hle Z g hg).ShortExact
proof:
:=
  shortExact_of_lie
    (fun a b hab ↦ (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N).symm.injective (Subtype.ext
      (congrArg (fun y : N' ↦ (y : X.obj)) ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) N').injective hab))))
    (fun z ↦ by
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hgs z
      exact ⟨ofLieEquiv (P := P) N' y, rfl⟩)
    (fun y hy ↦ ⟨ofLieEquiv (P := P) N ⟨_, hker _ hy⟩, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.shortExact_kerComplex
statement:
theorem shortExact_kerComplex (X Z : CategoryO.{u} P) (φ : X.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z.obj)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : (kerComplex X Z φ).ShortExact
proof:
:=
  shortExact_of_lie
    (fun _ _ hab ↦ (ofLieEquiv (P := P) φ.ker).symm.injective (Subtype.ext hab)) hφ
    (fun y hy ↦ ⟨ofLieEquiv (P := P) φ.ker ⟨y, LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr hy⟩, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.stdStepMapO_apply
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.stdStepMapO_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h : stdStepMap hle e y = stdStepMap hle e 0 := by
    rw [map_zero]
    exact (stdStepMap_eq_zero_iff hle e y).mpr hy
  rw [← map_zero (stdStepMapO X hle e), stdStepMapO_apply, stdStepMapO_apply, h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.stdStepMapO_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem stdStepMapO_eq_zero_iff (X : CategoryO.{u} P) {N₀ N₁ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj}
    {μ : Dual K H} (hle : N₀ ≤ N₁)
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)) (y : N₁) :
    stdStepMapO X hle e y = 0 ↔ (y : X.obj) ∈ N₀
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, stdStepMapO_eq_zero X hle e⟩
  rw [← map_zero (stdStepMapO X hle e), stdStepMapO_apply, stdStepMapO_apply] at h
  have h' := (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P μ)).injective h
  rw [map_zero] at h'
  exact (stdStepMap_eq_zero_iff hle e y).mp h'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_step
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_step (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) {n : ℕ} {N₀ N₁ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj}
    {μ : Dual K H} (hle : N₀ ≤ N₁)
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀))
    (h₀ : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub X N₀) Y n, x = 0)
    (hμ : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y n, x = 0) :
    ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub X N₁) Y n, x = 0
proof:
:=
  Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left
    (shortExact_subComplex X hle (verma P μ) (stdStepMapO X hle e)
      (fun _ hx ↦ stdStepMapO_eq_zero X hle e hx)
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P μ)).surjective.comp (surjective_stdStepMap hle e))
      (fun y hy ↦ (stdStepMapO_eq_zero_iff X hle e y).mp hy)) h₀ hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_isStdFiltered
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_isStdFiltered (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) {n : ℕ}
    {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj} {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s)
    (hY : ∀ μ ∈ s, ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y n, x = 0) :
    ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub X N) Y n, x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => exact Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_left (isZero_ofSub_bot X)
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ μ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    exact ext_eq_zero_of_step X Y hle e (ih fun ν hν ↦ hY ν (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν))
      (hY μ (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_of_ne_zero_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  subst hκ
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_section_of_comp_ne_zero P (q := g) (g := LieModuleHom.id)
    (fun h ↦ hg (by ext m; exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun h m))
  exact fun m ↦ ⟨σ m, hσ m⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_inf_ker_eq_zero_aux
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot =>
    exact Or.inl ⟨fun x hx ↦ by rw [(LieSubmodule.mem_bot x).mp hx, map_zero],
      fun _ ↦ Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_left (isZero_ofSub_bot X)⟩
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ κ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    have hcount₀ : s₀.count ν ≤ 1 :=
      (Multiset.count_le_of_le ν (Multiset.le_cons_self s₀ κ)).trans hcount
    have hκmem : κ ∈ κ ::ₘ s₀ := Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _
    
    have hstep0 : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ N₀), stdStepMap hle e ⟨x, hle hx⟩ = 0 := fun x hx ↦
      (stdStepMap_eq_zero_iff hle e _).mpr hx
    rcases ih hcount₀ (fun κ' h ↦ hhom κ' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h))
        (fun κ' h ↦ hY κ' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)) with ⟨h0, hext⟩ | ⟨hsurj, hν, hext⟩
    · 
      have hker₀ : N₀ ≤ φ.ker := fun x hx ↦ LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr (h0 x hx)
      let g : VermaModule P κ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P ν :=
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift N₀ φ hker₀).comp
          ((N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)).incl.comp e.toLieModuleHom)
      have hφg : ∀ y : N₁, φ y = g (stdStepMap hle e y) := fun y ↦ by
        simp only [g, stdStepMap, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
          LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LieSubmodule.incl_apply]
        rfl
      by_cases hg : g = 0
      · refine Or.inl ⟨fun x hx ↦ by rw [hφg ⟨x, hx⟩, hg, _root_.zero_apply], fun hν ↦ ?_⟩
        have hκν : κ ≠ ν := fun h ↦ hν (h ▸ hκmem)
        exact ext_eq_zero_of_step X Y hle e (hext fun h ↦ hν (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h))
          (hY κ hκmem hκν)
      · have hκν := hhom κ hκmem g hg
        have hgs := surjective_of_ne_zero_of_eq hg hκν
        have hgi := VermaModule.injective_of_ne_zero P hg
        have hν₀ : ν ∉ s₀ := by
          rw [← hκν, Multiset.count_cons_self] at hcount
          rw [← hκν]
          exact Multiset.count_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
        refine Or.inr ⟨fun v ↦ ?_, hκν ▸ hκmem, ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hgs v
          obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := surjective_stdStepMap hle e m
          exact ⟨y, y.2, by rw [hφg y, hy]⟩
        · have hN : N₁ ⊓ φ.ker = N₀ := by
            refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (le_inf hle hker₀)
            have h1 : g (stdStepMap hle e ⟨x, hx.1⟩) = 0 := by
              rw [← hφg]
              exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp hx.2
            exact (stdStepMap_eq_zero_iff hle e _).mp (hgi (h1.trans (map_zero g).symm))
          rw [hN]
          exact hext hν₀
    · 
      have hκν : κ ≠ ν := by
        rintro rfl
        rw [Multiset.count_cons_self] at hcount
        have := Multiset.count_pos.mpr hν
        omega
      refine Or.inr ⟨fun v ↦ ?_, Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν, ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hsurj v
        exact ⟨x, hle hx, rfl⟩
      · have hle' : N₀ ⊓ φ.ker ≤ N₁ ⊓ φ.ker := inf_le_inf_right _ hle
        let g' : (N₁ ⊓ φ.ker : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (verma P κ).obj :=
          (stdStepMapO X hle e).comp (LieSubmodule.inclusion inf_le_left)
        refine Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left
          (shortExact_subComplex X hle' (verma P κ) g' (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun m ↦ ?_)
            (fun y hy ↦ ?_)) hext (hY κ hκmem hκν)
        · exact stdStepMapO_eq_zero X hle e hx.1
        · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := surjective_stdStepMap hle e
            ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P κ)).symm m)
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hφx⟩ := hsurj (φ y)
          have hmem : (y : X.obj) - x ∈ N₁ ⊓ φ.ker :=
