            ⟨sub_mem y.2 (hle hx), LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr (by rw [map_sub, hφx, sub_self])⟩
          refine ⟨⟨_, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
          have hsub : stdStepMap hle e ⟨(y : X.obj) - x, hmem.1⟩ =
              stdStepMap hle e y - stdStepMap hle e ⟨x, hle hx⟩ := by
            rw [← map_sub]
            rfl
          change stdStepMapO X hle e ⟨(y : X.obj) - x, hmem.1⟩ = m
          rw [stdStepMapO_apply, hsub, hstep0 x hx, sub_zero, hy]
          exact (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P κ)).apply_symm_apply m
        · exact ⟨(stdStepMapO_eq_zero_iff X hle e (LieSubmodule.inclusion inf_le_left y)).mp hy,
            y.2.2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_succ_verma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_succ_verma_eq_zero (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (μ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ)
    (hY : ∀ κ, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P κ).multiplicity μ ≠ 0 → κ ≠ μ →
      ∀ z : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P κ) Y n, z = 0)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y (n + 1)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsFiniteCartan := Fact.out
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcount, -⟩ := ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered P μ hA
  
  have hmult : ∀ κ ∈ t, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P κ).multiplicity μ ≠ 0 := fun κ hκ ↦ by
    rw [← ProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity P μ hA ht κ]
    exact (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hκ).ne'
  
  obtain ⟨p, -, -, hp⟩ := (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveCover P μ hA).exists_generator
  let Q := mk (ProjectiveCover P hA μ) (ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA μ)
    ⟨{p}, by rw [Finset.coe_singleton]; exact hp⟩
  have hQ : Projective Q := projective_mk _ _ _ (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA μ)
  let eQ := ofLieEquiv (P := P) (ProjectiveCover P hA μ)
  
  obtain ⟨φ₀, hφ₀⟩ := ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA μ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ))
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) (ProjectiveCover.π P hA μ)
  have hφ₀s : Function.Surjective φ₀ := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    by_contra hne
    have hle := (VermaModule.le_maxSubmodule_iff P μ φ₀.range).mpr hne
    apply ProjectiveCover.π_ne_zero P hA μ
    rw [← hφ₀]
    ext y
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, _root_.zero_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact hle ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  let φ : Q.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P μ := φ₀.comp eQ.symm.toLieModuleHom
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := hφ₀s.comp eQ.symm.surjective
  
  have htop : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (ProjectiveCover P hA μ)).map eQ.toLieModuleHom = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    exact (LieSubmodule.mem_map y).mpr ⟨eQ.symm y, trivial, eQ.apply_symm_apply y⟩
  have ht' : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Q.obj) t := by
    have h := ht.map_of_injOn P eQ.toLieModuleHom (B := ⊤)
      (fun y _ hy ↦ eQ.injective (hy.trans (map_zero eQ.toLieModuleHom).symm)) le_rfl
    rw [htop] at h
    exact h
  rcases ext_inf_ker_eq_zero_aux Q Y φ ht' hcount.le
      (fun κ hκ g hg ↦ eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
        (VermaModule.multiplicity_ne_zero_of_hom_ne_zero P (φ := g) hg))
        (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (hmult κ hκ)))
      (fun κ hκ hne ↦ hY κ (hmult κ hκ) hne) with
    ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, -, hext⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hφ (VermaModule.hwv P μ)
    exact absurd (hy.symm.trans (h0 y (LieSubmodule.mem_top y))) (VermaModule.hwv_ne_zero P μ)
  · rw [top_inf_eq] at hext
    let eV := ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P μ)
    let ψ : Q.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (verma P μ).obj := eV.toLieModuleHom.comp φ
    have hkerψ : ψ.ker = φ.ker := by
      ext y
      simp only [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ eV.injective (h.trans (map_zero eV.toLieModuleHom).symm),
        fun h ↦ (congrArg eV h).trans (map_zero eV.toLieModuleHom)⟩
    have : Projective (kerComplex Q (verma P μ) ψ).X₂ := hQ
    have hker : ∀ z : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub Q ψ.ker) Y n, z = 0 := by
      rw [hkerψ]
      exact hext
    exact Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_of_projective
      (shortExact_kerComplex Q (verma P μ) ψ (eV.surjective.comp hφ)) hker x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_eq_zero_aux
statement:
theorem ext_verma_eq_zero_aux (lam : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) : ∀ μ : Dual K H,
    ¬ (P.IsStronglyLinked (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan μ lam ∧ μ ≠ lam) →
      ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (verma P lam) (n + 1), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsFiniteCartan := Fact.out
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro μ hμ x
    refine ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_of_equiv _ _ (VermaModule P μ) (VermaModule P lam)
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _) (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _)
      (fun y ↦ ?_) x
    by_contra hy
    exact hμ (VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_extOne_ne_zero P hA hy)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro μ hμ x
    refine ext_succ_verma_eq_zero _ μ (n + 1) (fun κ hκ _ ↦ ih κ fun ⟨hκl, hκne⟩ ↦ ?_) x
    have hμκ := VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hκ
    have hμe : μ = lam := by
      by_contra h
      exact hμ ⟨Relation.ReflTransGen.trans hκl hμκ, h⟩
    have h1 : κ ∈ cone P μ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
      (VermaModule.multiplicity_ne_zero_of_isStronglyLinked P hA (by rw [hμe]; exact hκl))
    exact hκne ((eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone h1
      (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hκ)).trans hμe)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_verma_eq_zero {μ lam : Dual K H}
    (hμ : ¬ (P.IsStronglyLinked (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan μ lam ∧
      μ ≠ lam)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (verma P lam) n) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  exact ext_verma_eq_zero_aux lam m μ hμ x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_eq_zero_of_weightSpace
statement:
theorem ext_verma_eq_zero_of_weightSpace (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ) : ∀ μ : Dual K H,
    (∀ ρ, μ ∈ cone P ρ → weightSpace P Y.obj ρ = ⊥) →
      ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y n, x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro μ hμ x
    let eV := ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P μ)
    let ψ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj :=
      (toLieModuleHom (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ x).hom).comp eV.toLieModuleHom
    have hmem : ψ (VermaModule.hwv P μ) ∈ weightSpace P Y.obj μ :=
      map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P ψ (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P μ)
    rw [hμ μ (mem_cone_self μ)] at hmem
    have hψ : ψ = 0 := (VermaModule.eq_zero_iff P ψ).mpr hmem
    have h0 : Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ x = 0 := by
      ext m
      exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ (eV.symm m)
    rw [← Abelian.Ext.mk₀_homEquiv₀_apply x, h0, Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro μ hμ x
    exact ext_succ_verma_eq_zero Y μ n (fun κ hκ _ ↦ ih κ fun ρ hρ ↦
      hμ ρ (mem_cone_trans (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hκ) hρ)) x

name: FreeAlgebra.basisFreeMonoid_apply
statement:
lemma basisFreeMonoid_apply (w : FreeMonoid X) :
    basisFreeMonoid R X w = FreeMonoid.lift (ι R) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [basisFreeMonoid, Module.Basis.map_apply, Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne]
  change equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid.symm (MonoidAlgebra.single w 1) = _
  simp [equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid]

name: FreeAlgebra.basisFreeMonoid_one
statement: lemma basisFreeMonoid_one : basisFreeMonoid R X 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [basisFreeMonoid_apply]

name: FreeAlgebra.basisFreeMonoid_of_mul
statement:
lemma basisFreeMonoid_of_mul (x : X) (w : FreeMonoid X) :
    basisFreeMonoid R X (FreeMonoid.of x * w) = ι R x * basisFreeMonoid R X w
proof:
:= by
  simp [basisFreeMonoid_apply]

name: FreeAlgebra.word_nil
statement: lemma word_nil : word (R := R) ([] : List X) = 1
proof: := basisFreeMonoid_one R X

name: FreeAlgebra.word_cons
statement: lemma word_cons (j : X) (w : List X) : word (R := R) (j :: w) = ι R j * word w
proof:
:= by
  rw [word, FreeMonoid.ofList_cons, basisFreeMonoid_of_mul]

name: FreeAlgebra.onWords_word
statement:
@[simp] lemma onWords_word {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (g : List X → M)
    (w : List X) : onWords g (word (R := R) w) = g w
proof:
:= by
  simp [onWords, word]

name: FreeAlgebra.endo_ext
statement:
lemma endo_ext {φ ψ : Module.End R (FreeAlgebra R X)} (h : ∀ w, φ (word w) = ψ (word w)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  (basisFreeMonoid R X).ext fun w ↦ by simpa [word] using h (FreeMonoid.toList w)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordWt_nil : wordWt P [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma wordWt_cons (j : ι) (w : List ι) : wordWt P (j :: w) = P.root j + wordWt P w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordWt]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.repH_word
statement:
@[simp] lemma repH_word (a : H) (w : List ι) :
    repH P Λ a (word w) = (Λ a - wordWt P w a) • word w
proof:
:= by
  simp [repH]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.repF_word
statement: @[simp] lemma repF_word (i : ι) (w : List ι) : repF (K := K) i (word w) = word (i :: w)
proof:
:= by
  simp [repF, word_cons]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.repE_word
statement: @[simp] lemma repE_word (i : ι) (w : List ι) : repE P Λ i (word w) = eWord P Λ i w
proof:
:= by
  simp [repE]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.repH_mulLeft
statement:
lemma repH_mulLeft (a : H) (j : ι) (x : T) :
    repH P Λ a (FreeAlgebra.ι K j * x) =
      FreeAlgebra.ι K j * repH P Λ a x - P.root j a • (FreeAlgebra.ι K j * x)
proof:
:= by
  have : repH P Λ a ∘ₗ repF j = repF j ∘ₗ repH P Λ a - P.root j a • repF j := by
    refine endo_ext fun w ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, repF_word, repH_word, wordWt_cons, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
    module
  simpa [repF] using LinearMap.congr_fun this x

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.repH_eWord
statement:
lemma repH_eWord (a : H) (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    repH P Λ a (eWord P Λ i w) =
      (Λ a - wordWt P w a + P.root i a) • eWord P Λ i w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [eWord]
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [eWord, map_add, repH_mulLeft, ih, wordWt_cons, LinearMap.add_apply]
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij
      simp only [map_smul, repH_word, smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
      module
    · simp only [add_zero, mul_smul_comm, map_zero]
      module

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.tensorRep_e
statement: @[simp] lemma tensorRep_e (i : ι) : tensorRep P Λ (e P i) = repE P Λ i
proof: := lift_e _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.tensorRep_f
statement: @[simp] lemma tensorRep_f (i : ι) : tensorRep P Λ (f P i) = repF i
proof: := lift_f _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.tensorRep_h
statement: @[simp] lemma tensorRep_h (a : H) : tensorRep P Λ (h P a) = repH P Λ a
proof: := lift_h _ a

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.repH_one
statement: @[simp] lemma repH_one (a : H) : repH P Λ a 1 = Λ a • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← word_nil, repH_word]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.tensorRep_h_one
statement: lemma tensorRep_h_one (a : H) : tensorRep P Λ (h P a) 1 = Λ a • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorRep_h, ← word_nil, repH_word]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.fHom_of
statement: @[simp] lemma fHom_of (i : ι) : fHom P (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i) = f P i
proof: := by simp [fHom]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_of
statement: @[simp] lemma eHom_of (i : ι) : eHom P (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i) = e P i
proof: := by simp [eHom]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.tensorRep_fHom_one
statement:
lemma tensorRep_fHom_one (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    tensorRep P Λ (fHom P y) 1 = FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra K ι y
proof:
:= by
  have : (tensorRep P Λ).comp (fHom P) =
      ((Algebra.lmul K T).toLieHom : T →ₗ⁅K⁆ Module.End K T).comp
        (FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra K ι) := by
    ext i
    simp [repF]
  have := LieHom.congr_fun this y
  simp only [LieHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at this
  rw [this]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.tensorRep_eHom_one
statement: lemma tensorRep_eHom_one (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : tensorRep P Λ (eHom P z) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction z using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i => rw [eHom_of, tensorRep_e, ← word_nil, repE_word]; rfl
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
  | smul a y hy => simp [hy]
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    simp [LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, hy, hz]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.h_injective
statement: theorem h_injective : Function.Injective (h P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro a ha
  refine (forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K a).mp fun Λ ↦ ?_
  have := tensorRep_h_one P Λ a
  rw [ha, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero] at this
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.fHom_injective
statement: theorem fHom_injective : Function.Injective (fHom P)
proof:
:= by
  intro y z hyz
  apply FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra_injective ι K
  rw [← tensorRep_fHom_one P 0, ← tensorRep_fHom_one P 0, hyz]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.negGen_negGen
statement: lemma negGen_negGen (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : negGen (negGen y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have : (negGen (K := K) (ι := ι)).comp negGen = LieHom.id := by ext; simp [negGen]
  exact LieHom.congr_fun this y

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_eq
statement: lemma eHom_eq : eHom P = (chevalleyInvolution P).comp ((fHom P).comp negGen)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [negGen]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_injective
statement: theorem eHom_injective : Function.Injective (eHom P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eHom_eq, LieHom.coe_comp, LieHom.coe_comp]
  refine Function.Injective.comp ?_ (Function.Injective.comp (fHom_injective P) ?_)
  · exact Function.LeftInverse.injective (chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution P)
  · exact Function.LeftInverse.injective negGen_negGen

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.triangularMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangularMap_apply (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) (a : H) (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    triangularMap P (y, a, z) = fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z
proof:
:= by
  simp [triangularMap, add_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.triangularMap_injective
statement: lemma triangularMap_injective : Function.Injective (triangularMap P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  rintro ⟨y, a, z⟩ hyaz
  rw [triangularMap_apply] at hyaz
  have key : ∀ Λ : Dual K H,
      FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra K ι y + Λ a • (1 : FreeAlgebra K ι) = 0 := by
    intro Λ
    have := congr_arg (fun x ↦ tensorRep P Λ x 1) hyaz
    simpa [tensorRep_fHom_one, tensorRep_h_one, tensorRep_eHom_one] using this
  
  have hconst : FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv (FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra K ι y) = 0 := by
    have : (FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv : FreeAlgebra K ι →ₐ[K] K).toLieHom.comp
        (FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra K ι) = 0 := by
      ext i
      simp [FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv]
    simpa using LieHom.congr_fun this y
  have ha : a = 0 := by
    refine (forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K a).mp fun Λ ↦ ?_
    have := congr_arg FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv (key Λ)
    simpa [hconst, Algebra.smul_def] using this
  subst ha
  have hy : y = 0 := by
    apply FreeLieAlgebra.toFreeAlgebra_injective ι K
    simpa using key 0
  subst hy
  have hz : z = 0 := by
    apply eHom_injective P
    simpa using hyaz
  simp [hz]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_fHom
statement: lemma lie_h_fHom (a : H) (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : ∃ y', ⁅h P a, fHom P y⁆ = fHom P y'
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i => exact ⟨-(P.root i a • FreeLieAlgebra.of K i), by simp [lie_h_f]⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add y z hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy⟩ := hy; obtain ⟨z', hz⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨y' + z', by simp [hy, hz]⟩
  | smul c y hy => obtain ⟨y', hy⟩ := hy; exact ⟨c • y', by simp [hy]⟩
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy⟩ := hy; obtain ⟨z', hz⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨⁅y', z⁆ + ⁅y, z'⁆, by simp [leibniz_lie, hy, hz]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_e_fHom
statement:
lemma lie_e_fHom (i : ι) (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    ∃ y' b, ⁅e P i, fHom P y⁆ = fHom P y' + h P b
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of j =>
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; exact ⟨0, P.coroot i, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, 0, by simp [lie_e_f_of_ne P hij]⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
  | add y z hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨y', b, hy⟩ := hy; obtain ⟨z', c, hz⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨y' + z', b + c, by simp [hy, hz]; abel⟩
  | smul c y hy => obtain ⟨y', b, hy⟩ := hy; exact ⟨c • y', c • b, by simp [hy]⟩
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨y', b, hy⟩ := hy; obtain ⟨z', c, hz⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := lie_h_fHom P b z
    obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := lie_h_fHom P c y
    refine ⟨⁅y', z⁆ + w + ⁅y, z'⁆ - w', 0, ?_⟩
    rw [LieHom.map_lie, leibniz_lie, hy, hz, add_lie, lie_add, hw, ← lie_skew (fHom P y) (h P c),
      hw']
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, LieHom.map_lie, map_zero, add_zero]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_fHom
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_fHom (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    chevalleyInvolution P (fHom P y) = eHom P (negGen y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eHom_eq, LieHom.comp_apply, LieHom.comp_apply, negGen_negGen]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_eHom
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_eHom (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    chevalleyInvolution P (eHom P z) = fHom P (negGen z)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← negGen_negGen z, ← chevalleyInvolution_fHom]
  rw [chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_eHom
statement: lemma lie_h_eHom (a : H) (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : ∃ z', ⁅h P a, eHom P z⁆ = eHom P z'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := lie_h_fHom P (-a) (negGen z)
  refine ⟨negGen w, ?_⟩
  rw [← chevalleyInvolution_fHom, ← hw, LieHom.map_lie, chevalleyInvolution_h,
    chevalleyInvolution_fHom, negGen_negGen, map_neg, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_f_eHom
statement:
lemma lie_f_eHom (i : ι) (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    ∃ z' b, ⁅f P i, eHom P z⁆ = eHom P z' + h P b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y', b, hy⟩ := lie_e_fHom P i (negGen z)
  refine ⟨-negGen y', b, ?_⟩
  have := congr_arg (chevalleyInvolution P) hy
  rw [LieHom.map_lie, chevalleyInvolution_e, chevalleyInvolution_fHom, negGen_negGen, map_add,
    chevalleyInvolution_fHom, chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_lie] at this
  rw [map_neg, ← neg_neg (⁅f P i, eHom P z⁆), this]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.triangularMap_surjective
statement: lemma triangularMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (triangularMap P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top]
  set S := LinearMap.range (triangularMap P)
  have hf : ∀ y, fHom P y ∈ S := fun y ↦ ⟨(y, 0, 0), by simp⟩
  have hh : ∀ a, h P a ∈ S := fun a ↦ ⟨(0, a, 0), by simp⟩
  have he : ∀ z, eHom P z ∈ S := fun z ↦ ⟨(0, 0, z), by simp⟩
  have hS : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ y a z, x = fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z := by
    rintro x ⟨⟨y, a, z⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, a, z, by simp⟩
  refine eq_top_of_generators S (fun i ↦ by simpa using he (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i))
    (fun i ↦ by simpa using hf (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i)) hh ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i x hx
    obtain ⟨y, a, z, rfl⟩ := hS x hx
    obtain ⟨y', b, hy⟩ := lie_e_fHom P i y
    have h1 : ⁅e P i, fHom P y⁆ ∈ S := hy ▸ S.add_mem (hf _) (hh _)
    have h2 : ⁅e P i, h P a⁆ ∈ S := by
      rw [← lie_skew, lie_h_e, ← eHom_of]; exact S.neg_mem (S.smul_mem _ (he _))
    have h3 : ⁅e P i, eHom P z⁆ ∈ S := by rw [← eHom_of, ← LieHom.map_lie]; exact he _
    rw [lie_add, lie_add]; exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem h1 h2) h3
  · intro i x hx
    obtain ⟨y, a, z, rfl⟩ := hS x hx
    obtain ⟨z', b, hz⟩ := lie_f_eHom P i z
    have h1 : ⁅f P i, fHom P y⁆ ∈ S := by rw [← fHom_of, ← LieHom.map_lie]; exact hf _
    have h2 : ⁅f P i, h P a⁆ ∈ S := by
      rw [← lie_skew, lie_h_f, neg_neg, ← fHom_of]; exact S.smul_mem _ (hf _)
    have h3 : ⁅f P i, eHom P z⁆ ∈ S := hz ▸ S.add_mem (he _) (hh _)
    rw [lie_add, lie_add]; exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem h1 h2) h3
  · intro a x hx
    obtain ⟨y, b, z, rfl⟩ := hS x hx
    obtain ⟨y', hy⟩ := lie_h_fHom P a y
    obtain ⟨z', hz⟩ := lie_h_eHom P a z
    rw [lie_add, lie_add, hy, hz, lie_h_h, add_zero]
    exact S.add_mem (hf _) (he _)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.triangularEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangularEquiv_apply (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) (a : H) (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :
    triangularEquiv P (y, a, z) = fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z
proof:
:=
  triangularMap_apply P y a z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.eq_one_of_isIdempotentElem_of_not_range_le_ker
proof:
:= by
  have htop := eq_top_of_not_le_ker P hA μ b.range h
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ ?_
  have hy : y ∈ b.range := htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hy
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hb.eq x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_isIdempotentElem
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a.range ≤ (π P hA μ).ker
  · left
    have h1 : 1 - a = 1 := by
      refine eq_one_of_isIdempotentElem_of_not_range_le_ker P hA ha.one_sub fun h' ↦
        π_ne_zero P hA μ (LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
      have h₁ : π P hA μ ((1 - a) x) = 0 :=
        LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp (h' ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩))
      have h₂ : π P hA μ (a x) = 0 :=
        LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp (h ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩))
      rw [_root_.sub_apply, map_sub, h₂, sub_zero] at h₁
      exact h₁
    rwa [sub_eq_self] at h1
  · exact Or.inr (eq_one_of_isIdempotentElem_of_not_range_le_ker P hA ha h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.exists_bijOn_of_equiv_verma
statement:
theorem exists_bijOn_of_equiv_verma [FiniteDimensional K V] {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (G : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam W) (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I))
    (E : (F.idem (VermaModule P lam)).range ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (G.idem (VermaModule P lam)).range) :
    ∃ φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W,
      ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
        [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsInBlock P hA lam M →
        Set.BijOn (fun x ↦ G.idem M (φ.app M x)) (Set.range (F.idem M))
          (Set.range (G.idem M))
proof:
:= by
  have hb := isInBlock_verma P hA lam
  obtain ⟨φ, φ', h₁, h₂⟩ := exists_tensorNatTrans_of_equiv_verma P hA hlam hM₀ hI hK
    (F.idem (VermaModule P lam)) (G.idem _) (F.idem_idem _ hb) (G.idem_idem _ hb) E
  refine ⟨φ, fun M _ _ _ _ hM ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, htM, htV⟩ := F.exists_tensorNatTrans M (VermaModule P lam) hM hb
  obtain ⟨t', ht'M, ht'V⟩ := G.exists_tensorNatTrans M (VermaModule P lam) hM hb
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
  have h := bijOn_range_of_block P hA hlam hM₀ hI t t' φ φ' (by rw [htV, ht'V]; exact h₁)
    (by rw [htV, ht'V]; exact h₂) hM.isCategoryO hs hM.multiplicity_ne_zero
    (by rw [htM]; exact F.idem_idem M hM) (by rw [ht'M]; exact G.idem_idem M hM)
  rwa [htM, ht'M] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.idem_comp_idem_verma
statement:
theorem idem_comp_idem_verma :
    (F.idem (VermaModule P lam)).comp (F.idem (VermaModule P lam)) = F.idem _
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.ext (F.idem_idem _ (isInBlock_verma P hA lam))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.nontrivial_vermaValue
statement:
theorem nontrivial_vermaValue (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hF : ¬ F.IsZero) : Nontrivial F.vermaValue
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hn
  refine hF fun M _ _ _ _ hM ↦ F.idem_eq_zero_of_idem_verma_eq_zero hlam hM₀ hI ?_ hM
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  have h : rangeRetr (F.idem (VermaModule P lam)) x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.eq_zero_or_eq_id_of_isIndecomposable
statement:
theorem eq_zero_or_eq_id_of_isIndecomposable [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) (hF : F.IsIndecomposable)
    (a : F.vermaValue →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F.vermaValue) (ha : a.comp a = a) :
    a = 0 ∨ a = LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  have hb := isInBlock_verma P hA lam
  have he := F.idem_comp_idem_verma
  set e := F.idem (VermaModule P lam) with he_def
  set q := e.range.incl.comp (a.comp (rangeRetr e)) with hq
  have hqq : IsIdempotentElem q := LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by
    change e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e (e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e x))))) =
      e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e x))
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply a a, ha]
  have heq : e * q = q := LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ apply_incl he _
  have hqe : q * e = q := LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by
    change e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e (e x))) = e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e x))
    rw [rangeRetr_apply he]
  obtain ⟨F₁, hF₁, hs⟩ := F.exists_isSummand_idem_verma hlam hM₀ hI hK q hqq heq hqe
  rcases hF.2 F₁ hs with h0 | h0
  · refine Or.inl (LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ Subtype.ext ?_)
    have h := LieModuleHom.congr_fun (h0 _ hb) (e.range.incl y)
    rw [hF₁] at h
    change e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e (e.range.incl y))) = 0 at h
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he] at h
    exact h
  · refine Or.inr (LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ Subtype.ext ?_)
    have h := LieModuleHom.congr_fun (h0 _ hb) (e.range.incl y)
    rw [sub_idem, _root_.sub_apply, _root_.zero_apply, hF₁, sub_eq_zero,
      apply_incl he] at h
    change _ = e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e (e.range.incl y))) at h
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he] at h
    exact h.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isCategoryO_vermaValue
statement: theorem isCategoryO_vermaValue [FiniteDimensional K V] : IsCategoryO P F.vermaValue
proof:
:=
  ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).tensorProduct
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (V := V) hA)).lieSubmodule _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isProjectiveO_vermaValue
statement:
theorem isProjectiveO_vermaValue [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam) :
    IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P F.vermaValue
proof:
:=
  ((VermaModule.isProjectiveO P hA hlam).tensorProduct P
      (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (V := Module.Dual K V) hA)).of_retract
    (F.idem _).range.incl (rangeRetr _) (rangeRetr_comp_incl F.idem_comp_idem_verma)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.exists_finset_lieSpan_vermaValue
statement:
theorem exists_finset_lieSpan_vermaValue [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    ∃ S : Finset F.vermaValue, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set F.vermaValue) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_tensor_eq_top (W := V)
    (S := {VermaModule.hwv P lam}) (by
      rw [Finset.coe_singleton]
      exact VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id)
  classical
  refine ⟨T.image (rangeRetr (F.idem _)), ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.coe_image]
  exact lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective _ (surjective_rangeRetr F.idem_comp_idem_verma) hT

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.exists_nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) (hF : F.IsIndecomposable) :
    ∃ μ : Dual K H, Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F.vermaValue)
proof:
:= by
  have := F.nontrivial_vermaValue hlam hM₀ hI hF.1
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := F.exists_finset_lieSpan_vermaValue
  exact ProjectiveCover.exists_nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable P hA
    (F.isProjectiveO_vermaValue hlam) F.isCategoryO_vermaValue hS
    (F.eq_zero_or_eq_id_of_isIndecomposable hlam hM₀ hI hK hF)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isIndecomposable_of_equiv_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem isIndecomposable_of_equiv_projectiveCover
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I) {μ : Dual K H}
    (E : ProjectiveCover P hA μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F.vermaValue) : F.IsIndecomposable
proof:
:= by
  have hb := isInBlock_verma P hA lam
  have he := F.idem_comp_idem_verma
  set e := F.idem (VermaModule P lam) with he_def
  refine ⟨fun hz ↦ ProjectiveCover.π_ne_zero P hA μ (LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_),
    fun F₁ hs ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hz0 : e = 0 := hz _ hb
    have h0 : E x = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp (E x).2
      rw [← hy, ← he_def, hz0]
      rfl
    have hx : x = 0 := E.injective (h0.trans (map_zero E).symm)
    rw [hx, map_zero]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨heq, hqe⟩ := hs _ hb
  set q := F₁.idem (VermaModule P lam) with hq_def
  have hqq : ∀ x, q (q x) = q x := F₁.idem_idem _ hb
  have heq' : ∀ x, e (q x) = q x := fun x ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun heq x
  have hqe' : ∀ x, q (e x) = q x := fun x ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun hqe x
  set a : F.vermaValue →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F.vermaValue := (rangeRetr e).comp (q.comp e.range.incl)
  have key : ∀ x, e.range.incl (a (rangeRetr e x)) = q x := fun x ↦ by
    change e (q (e x)) = q x
    rw [hqe', heq']
  have ha : a.comp a = a := LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ Subtype.ext <| by
    change e (q (e (q (e.range.incl y)))) = e (q (e.range.incl y))
    rw [heq', hqe', hqq, heq']
  set b : ProjectiveCover P hA μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA μ :=
    (E.symm : F.vermaValue →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA μ).comp
      (a.comp (E : ProjectiveCover P hA μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F.vermaValue))
  have hbb : IsIdempotentElem b := LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by
    change E.symm (a (E (E.symm (a (E x))))) = E.symm (a (E x))
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact congrArg E.symm (LieModuleHom.congr_fun ha (E x))
  have hab : ∀ y, a y = E (b (E.symm y)) := fun y ↦ by
    change a y = E (E.symm (a (E (E.symm y))))
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rcases ProjectiveCover.eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_isIdempotentElem P hA hbb with h0 | h1
  · left
    have hq0 : q = 0 := LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by
      rw [← key, hab, h0]
      change e.range.incl (E 0) = 0
      rw [map_zero, map_zero]
    exact fun M _ _ _ _ hM ↦ F₁.idem_eq_zero_of_idem_verma_eq_zero hlam hM₀ hI hq0 hM
  · right
    have hqe0 : (F.sub F₁ hs).idem (VermaModule P lam) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_idem]
      refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
      rw [_root_.sub_apply, ← key, hab, h1]
      change e x - e.range.incl (E (E.symm (rangeRetr e x))) = 0
      rw [LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, incl_rangeRetr, sub_self]
    exact fun M _ _ _ _ hM ↦
      (F.sub F₁ hs).idem_eq_zero_of_idem_verma_eq_zero hlam hM₀ hI hqe0 hM

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isIndecomposable_iff_exists_equiv_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem isIndecomposable_iff_exists_equiv_projectiveCover [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) :
    F.IsIndecomposable ↔
      ∃ μ : Dual K H, Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA μ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F.vermaValue)
proof:
:=
  ⟨F.exists_nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover hlam hM₀ hI hK, fun ⟨_, ⟨E⟩⟩ ↦
    F.isIndecomposable_of_equiv_projectiveCover hlam hM₀ hI E⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.exists_bijOn_of_character_eq
statement:
theorem exists_bijOn_of_character_eq [FiniteDimensional K V] {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (G : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam W) (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I))
    (hch : ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
      [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsInBlock P hA lam M → ∀ (hF : IsCategoryO P (F.idem M).range)
      (hG : IsCategoryO P (G.idem M).range), hF.character = hG.character) :
    ∃ φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W,
      ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
        [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsInBlock P hA lam M →
        Set.BijOn (fun x ↦ G.idem M (φ.app M x)) (Set.range (F.idem M))
          (Set.range (G.idem M))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := F.exists_finset_lieSpan_vermaValue
  obtain ⟨S', hS'⟩ := G.exists_finset_lieSpan_vermaValue
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := IsProjectiveO.nonempty_equiv_of_character_eq P hA
    (F.isProjectiveO_vermaValue hlam) F.isCategoryO_vermaValue hS
    (G.isProjectiveO_vermaValue hlam) G.isCategoryO_vermaValue hS'
    (hch _ (isInBlock_verma P hA lam) _ _)
  exact F.exists_bijOn_of_equiv_verma G hlam hM₀ hI hK E

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_rep
statement:
lemma VermaModule.map_rep (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W)
    (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (v : V) :
    f (VermaModule.rep P V u v) = VermaModule.rep P W u (f v)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing v with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | ι x => rw [VermaModule.rep_ι, VermaModule.rep_ι, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, ha, hb, map_add,
      LinearMap.add_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.rep_eq_smul
statement:
lemma VermaModule.rep_eq_smul (Λ : Dual K H) (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)
    (m : VermaModule P Λ) : VermaModule.rep P (VermaModule P Λ) u m = u • m
proof:
:=
  (VermaModule.map_smul_eq_rep P Λ LieModuleHom.id u m).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_zero_or_ker_le
statement:
theorem VermaModule.eq_zero_or_ker_le {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] {ξ lam : Dual K H}
    (f : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P ξ) (g : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam) (hfg : f.ker ≤ g.ker) :
    g = 0 ∨ g.ker ≤ f.ker
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional P hA
  by_contra! h
  obtain ⟨h0, hle⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, g q ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hq
    exact h0 (LieModuleHom.ext hq)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ : ∃ p, g p = 0 ∧ f p ≠ 0 := by
    rw [SetLike.not_le_iff_exists] at hle
    obtain ⟨p, hpg, hpf⟩ := hle
    exact ⟨p, hpg, hpf⟩
  have hfq : f q ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hq (hfg h)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P ξ).surjective (f q)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P ξ).surjective (f p)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P lam).surjective (g q)
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hfq (by rw [← ha, map_zero])
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hfp (by rw [← hb, map_zero])
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hq (by rw [← hc, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu⟩ := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_common_left_multiple a b ha0 hb0
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hu (zero_mul a)
  have hmem : VermaModule.rep P X (mapN u) q - VermaModule.rep P X (mapN v) p ∈ f.ker := by
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, map_sub, VermaModule.map_rep, VermaModule.map_rep,
      VermaModule.rep_eq_smul, VermaModule.rep_eq_smul, ← ha, ← hb, ← equivEnvNNeg_mul,
      ← equivEnvNNeg_mul, huv, sub_self]
  have key := hfg hmem
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, map_sub, VermaModule.map_rep, VermaModule.map_rep, hp, map_zero,
    sub_zero, ← hc, VermaModule.rep_eq_smul, ← equivEnvNNeg_mul] at key
  exact mul_ne_zero hu0 hc0 ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp key)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_zero_or_injective
proof:
:= by
  have hker : N.incl.ker ≤ φ.ker := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.ker_incl]
    exact bot_le
  refine (VermaModule.eq_zero_or_ker_le P hA N.incl φ hker).imp_right fun h ↦ ?_
  rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff, ← LieSubmodule.ker_incl]
  exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.borelChar_apply
statement: lemma borelChar_apply (x : borel P) : borelChar P Λ x = Λ (cartanProj P x)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.ι_sub_mem_vermaIdeal
statement:
lemma ι_sub_mem_vermaIdeal {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ borel P) :
    ιᵤ x - algebraMap K 𝓤 (Λ (cartanProj P x)) ∈ vermaIdeal P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, n, hn, rfl⟩ := (mem_borel P).mp hx
  rw [(cartanProj P).map_add, cartanProj_h, cartanProj_of_mem_nPos P hn, add_zero, map_add,
    add_sub_right_comm]
  exact add_mem (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨a, rfl⟩))
    (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_sub_mem_vermaIdeal
statement:
lemma map_sub_mem_vermaIdeal (b : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (borel P)) :
    mapB b - algebraMap K 𝓤 (envBorelChar P Λ b) ∈ vermaIdeal P Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction b using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | ι x =>
    rw [map_ι, lift_ι_apply]
    exact ι_sub_mem_vermaIdeal P Λ x.2
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    have : mapB (a * b) - algebraMap K 𝓤 (envBorelChar P Λ (a * b)) =
        mapB a • (mapB b - algebraMap K 𝓤 (envBorelChar P Λ b)) +
          envBorelChar P Λ b • (mapB a - algebraMap K 𝓤 (envBorelChar P Λ a)) := by
      simp only [map_mul]
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Algebra.smul_def, mul_sub, mul_sub,
        Algebra.commutes (envBorelChar P Λ b) (mapB a),
        Algebra.commutes (envBorelChar P Λ b) (algebraMap K 𝓤 (envBorelChar P Λ a))]
      abel
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hb) (Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ ha)
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact add_mem ha hb

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mk_map_borel
statement:
lemma mk_map_borel (b : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (borel P)) :
    mk P Λ (mapB b) = envBorelChar P Λ b • hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← algebraMap_smul 𝓤, ← mk_eq_smul, ← map_sub, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  exact map_sub_mem_vermaIdeal P Λ b

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.proj_mul
statement:
lemma proj_mul (n : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P))
    (b : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (borel P)) :
    proj P Λ (mapN n * mapB b) = envBorelChar P Λ b • n
proof:
:= by
  have : (mulEquiv P).symm (mapN n * mapB b) = n ⊗ₜ b := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul]
  simp only [proj, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, this,
    LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, TensorProduct.rid_tmul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.proj_map
statement: lemma proj_map (n : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P)) : proj P Λ (mapN n) = n
proof:
:= by
  have := proj_mul P Λ n 1
  rwa [map_one, mul_one, map_one, one_smul] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.proj_mul_map_eq_zero
statement:
lemma proj_mul_map_eq_zero {b : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (borel P)}
    (hb : envBorelChar P Λ b = 0) (u : 𝓤) : proj P Λ (u * mapB b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (mulEquiv P).surjective u
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul n b' =>
    rw [tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul, mul_assoc, ← map_mul, proj_mul, map_mul, hb, mul_zero,
      zero_smul]
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, add_mul, map_add, ht, ht', add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.vermaIdeal_le_projKer
statement: lemma vermaIdeal_le_projKer : vermaIdeal P Λ ≤ projKer P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaIdeal, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ (⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
  · intro u
    have := proj_mul_map_eq_zero P Λ (b := ιᵤ ⟨x, nPos_le_borel P hx⟩) (by
      rw [lift_ι_apply, borelChar_apply]
      simp [cartanProj_of_mem_nPos P hx]) u
    rwa [map_ι] at this
  · intro u
    have := proj_mul_map_eq_zero P Λ
      (b := ιᵤ ⟨h P a, h_mem_borel P a⟩ - algebraMap K _ (Λ a)) (by
        rw [map_sub, lift_ι_apply, borelChar_apply, AlgHom.commutes]
        simp) u
    rwa [map_sub, map_ι, AlgHom.commutes] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.proj_eq_zero_of_mem
statement: lemma proj_eq_zero_of_mem {x : 𝓤} (hx : x ∈ vermaIdeal P Λ) : proj P Λ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using vermaIdeal_le_projKer P Λ hx 1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.envNNegToVerma_apply
statement:
lemma envNNegToVerma_apply (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P)) :
    envNNegToVerma P Λ u = mapN u • hwv P Λ
proof:
:=
  mk_eq_smul P Λ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.envNNegToVerma_injective
statement: lemma envNNegToVerma_injective : Function.Injective (envNNegToVerma P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro u hu
  rw [envNNegToVerma_apply, ← mk_eq_smul] at hu
  have := proj_eq_zero_of_mem P Λ ((mk_eq_zero_iff P Λ).mp hu)
  rwa [proj_map] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.envNNegToVerma_surjective
statement: lemma envNNegToVerma_surjective : Function.Surjective (envNNegToVerma P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P Λ m
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (mulEquiv P).surjective x
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul n b =>
    refine ⟨envBorelChar P Λ b • n, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.map_smul, envNNegToVerma_apply, tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul, mk_eq_smul,
      mul_smul, ← mk_eq_smul P Λ (mapB b), mk_map_borel, smul_comm]
  | add t t' ht ht' =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ht
    obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := ht'
    exact ⟨u + u', by rw [map_add, hu, hu', map_add, map_add]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma equivEnvNNeg_apply (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P)) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ u = mapN u • hwv P Λ
proof:
:=
  envNNegToVerma_apply P Λ u

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_mul
statement:
theorem equivEnvNNeg_mul (u u' : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P)) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ (u * u') = mapN u • equivEnvNNeg P Λ u'
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_ne_zero
statement: theorem hwv_ne_zero : hwv P Λ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : equivEnvNNeg P Λ 1 = hwv P Λ := by simp
  rw [← this, ne_eq, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_self
statement: theorem finrank_weightSpace_self : finrank K (weightSpace P Λ Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace_self, finrank_span_singleton (hwv_ne_zero P Λ)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDualMapLin_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrictedDualMapLin_apply (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) :
    restrictedDualMapLin P f = restrictedDualMap P f
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDualMap_comp
statement:
lemma restrictedDualMap_comp {U : Type*} [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [LieRingModule 𝔤 U]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 U] (g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (f : U →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) :
    restrictedDualMap P (g.comp f) = (restrictedDualMap P f).comp (restrictedDualMap P g)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDualMap_id
statement:
lemma restrictedDualMap_id : restrictedDualMap P (LieModuleHom.id : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) =
    LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.injective_restrictedDualMapLin
statement:
theorem injective_restrictedDualMapLin (hW : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ = ⊤) :
    Function.Injective (restrictedDualMapLin (V := V) (W := W) P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro f hf
  refine LieModuleHom.ext fun v ↦ injective_restrictedDoubleDual hW ?_
  rw [_root_.zero_apply, map_zero]
  refine restrictedDual_ext P fun α ↦ ?_
  have := congrArg (fun F : restrictedDual P V ↦ TwistedDual.toDual P V F.1 v)
    (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hf α)
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_restrictedDualMapLin
statement:
theorem surjective_restrictedDualMapLin (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hW : IsCategoryO P W) :
    Function.Surjective (restrictedDualMapLin (V := V) (W := W) P)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  let a : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W := (restrictedDoubleDualEquiv hW).symm.toLieModuleHom.comp
    ((restrictedDualMap P b).comp (restrictedDoubleDualEquiv hV).toLieModuleHom)
  refine ⟨a, LieModuleHom.ext fun α ↦ restrictedDual_ext P fun v ↦ ?_⟩
  have ha : restrictedDoubleDual hW.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top (a v) =
      restrictedDualMap P b (restrictedDoubleDual hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top v) := by
    rw [← restrictedDoubleDualEquiv_apply hW]
    exact (restrictedDoubleDualEquiv hW).apply_symm_apply _
  have := congrArg (fun Ψ : restrictedDual P (restrictedDual P W) ↦
    TwistedDual.toDual P (restrictedDual P W) Ψ.1 α) ha
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDualHomEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrictedDualHomEquiv_apply (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) : restrictedDualHomEquiv P hV hW f = restrictedDualMap P f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.indecomposable_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.indecomposable_restrictedDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V) [Nontrivial V]
    (hind : ∀ a : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V, a.comp a = a → a = 0 ∨ a = LieModuleHom.id) :
    Nontrivial (restrictedDual P V) ∧
      ∀ e : restrictedDual P V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P V, e.comp e = e →
        e = 0 ∨ e = LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  have hd := hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  refine ⟨?_, fun e he ↦ ?_⟩
  · by_contra hn
    rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hn
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_ne (0 : V)
    refine hv (injective_restrictedDoubleDual hd ?_)
    rw [map_zero]
    exact restrictedDual_ext P fun α ↦ by rw [Subsingleton.elim α 0]; simp
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := surjective_restrictedDualMapLin P hV hV e
  rw [restrictedDualMapLin_apply] at he ⊢
  have haa : a.comp a = a := injective_restrictedDualMapLin P hd (by
    rw [restrictedDualMapLin_apply, restrictedDualMapLin_apply, restrictedDualMap_comp]
    exact he)
  rcases hind a haa with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl (LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ restrictedDual_ext P fun _ ↦ by simp)
  · exact Or.inr rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lieModuleHom_sum_apply
statement:
lemma lieModuleHom_sum_apply {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X]
    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y] [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y] (f : κ → X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) (x : X) :
    (∑ i, f i) x = ∑ i, f i x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset κ) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, _root_.add_apply, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.restrictedDualDirectSumHom_apply
statement:
lemma restrictedDualDirectSumHom_apply (φ : restrictedDual P (⨁ i, M i)) (i : κ) :
    restrictedDualDirectSumHom P M φ i = restrictedDualMap P (lieModuleOf K κ 𝔤 M i) φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictedDualDirectSumHom, lieModuleHom_sum_apply, DirectSum.sum_apply,
    Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · exact DirectSum.of_eq_same _ _
  · intro j _ hj
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hj.symm
  · simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_restrictedDualDirectSumInv
statement:
lemma toDual_restrictedDualDirectSumInv (ψ : ⨁ i, restrictedDual P (M i)) (m : ⨁ i, M i) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P _ (restrictedDualDirectSumInv P M ψ).1 m =
      ∑ i, TwistedDual.toDual P (M i) (ψ i).1 (m i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictedDualDirectSumInv, lieModuleHom_sum_apply]
  have : ((∑ i, ((restrictedDualMap P (lieModuleComponent K κ 𝔤 M i)).comp
      (lieModuleComponent K κ 𝔤 (fun i ↦ restrictedDual P (M i)) i)) ψ :
        restrictedDual P (⨁ i, M i)) : TwistedDual P (⨁ i, M i)) =
      ∑ i, (((restrictedDualMap P (lieModuleComponent K κ 𝔤 M i)).comp
        (lieModuleComponent K κ 𝔤 (fun i ↦ restrictedDual P (M i)) i)) ψ :
          TwistedDual P (⨁ i, M i)) :=
    map_sum (restrictedDual P (⨁ i, M i)).incl _ _
  rw [this, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.exists_injective_of_isAtom
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => exact absurd (le_bot_iff.mp hSN) hS.1
  | @step N N' s μ _ hle he ih =>
    by_cases h : S ≤ N
    · obtain ⟨μ', hμ', f, hf⟩ := ih h
      exact ⟨μ', Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hμ', f, hf⟩
    · have hinf : S ⊓ N = ⊥ := by
        rcases hS.le_iff.mp (inf_le_left : S ⊓ N ≤ S) with h' | h'
        · exact h'
        · exact absurd (h' ▸ inf_le_right) h
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
      let g : S →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N'.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) :=
        ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N).comp S.incl).codRestrict _ fun x ↦
          LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem (hSN x.2)
      have hg : Function.Injective g := by
        rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
        intro x hx
        have hx0 : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (x : X) = 0 :=
          congrArg Subtype.val (LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp hx)
        have hxN : (x : X) ∈ N := by
          rwa [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx0
        have hxSN : (x : X) ∈ S ⊓ N := ⟨x.2, hxN⟩
        rw [hinf, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hxSN
        exact Subtype.ext hxSN
      exact ⟨μ, Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _, e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp g,
        fun a b hab ↦ hg (e.symm.injective hab)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isAntidominant_of_isAtom_of_injective
statement:
theorem exists_isAntidominant_of_isAtom_of_injective (hQ : IsCategoryO P Q)
    {S : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q} (hS : IsAtom S) {μ : Dual K H}
    {f : S →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ∃ ξ, P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan ξ ∧
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity ξ ≠ 0 ∧
        Nonempty (S ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P ξ)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial S := (LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _).mpr hS.1
  obtain ⟨ξ, ψ, hψ⟩ := (hQ.lieSubmodule S).exists_lieModuleHom_verma
  have hφ0 : f.comp ψ (hwv P ξ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    hψ (hf (by rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply] at h0; rw [h0, map_zero]))
  have hφ : f.comp ψ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hφ0 (by rw [h, _root_.zero_apply])
  have hψinj : Function.Injective ψ := fun a b hab ↦
    injective_of_ne_zero P hφ (by simp only [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hab])
  have hψsurj : Function.Surjective ψ := by
    have hle : (S.incl.comp ψ).range ≤ S := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hx
      exact (ψ m).2
    have hrange : (S.incl.comp ψ).range = S := by
      rcases hS.le_iff.mp hle with h | h
      · exact absurd (Subtype.ext ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (h ▸
          (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨hwv P ξ, rfl⟩))) hψ
      · exact h
    intro s
    have hs : (s : Q) ∈ (S.incl.comp ψ).range := by rw [hrange]; exact s.2
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hs
    exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩
  let e := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective ψ ⟨hψinj, hψsurj⟩
  have hmax : maxSubmodule P ξ = ⊥ := by
    let T : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q := (maxSubmodule P ξ).map (S.incl.comp ψ)
    have hT : T ≤ S := by
      rintro _ ⟨m, -, rfl⟩
      exact (ψ m).2
    rcases hS.le_iff.mp hT with h | h
    · rw [LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
      intro m hm
      have hmT : (S.incl.comp ψ) m ∈ T := LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hm
      rw [h, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hmT
      exact hψinj (Subtype.ext (by rw [map_zero]; exact hmT))
    · exfalso
      have hv : (ψ (hwv P ξ) : Q) ∈ T := by rw [h]; exact (ψ (hwv P ξ)).2
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hme⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hv
      have : m = hwv P ξ := hψinj (Subtype.ext hme)
      exact hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule P ξ (by rwa [← this])
  have hξ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan ξ :=
    (maxSubmodule_eq_bot_iff_isAntidominant P hA).mp hmax
  obtain ⟨e'⟩ := VermaModule.nonempty_equiv_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hξ
  exact ⟨ξ, hξ, multiplicity_ne_zero_of_hom_ne_zero P hφ, ⟨e.symm.trans e'⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant {lam ξ μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hξ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan ξ) {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hmξ : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity ξ ≠ 0)
    (hmwl : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity
      (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≠ 0) :
    ξ = lam
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hposDef⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hposDef.isHermitian
  set Sym := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA Sym hmξ
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_weylDot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA Sym hmwl
  obtain ⟨k₁, -, hk₁⟩ := mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hmξ
  obtain ⟨k₂, -, hk₂⟩ := mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hmwl
  have hμ : μ = P.weylDot hA' y⁻¹ (P.weylDot hA' w lam) := by
    rw [hy, ← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one]
  set z := x * y⁻¹ * w
  have hzξ : ξ = P.weylDot hA' z lam := by
    rw [hx, hμ, ← weylDot_mul, ← weylDot_mul]
  have hz : z ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot]
    have hwQ := (mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot P hA').mp hw
    have h1 : (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - P.rho = μ - P.rootOf k₁ := by
      rw [← hk₁, hzξ]; rfl
    have h2 : (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - P.rho = μ - P.rootOf k₂ := by
      rw [← hk₂]; rfl
    have e1 : (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - P.rho - lam =
        -P.rootOf k₁ + P.rootOf k₂ +
          ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - P.rho - lam) := by
      rw [h1, h2]
      abel
    rw [e1]
    exact add_mem (add_mem (neg_mem (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k₁)) (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k₂))
      hwQ
  have hzfix := hlam.eq_of_weylDot_eq hA hz (by rw [← weylDot, ← hzξ]; exact hξ)
  rw [hzξ, weylDot, hzfix, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_isAtom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -, -⟩ :=
    ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) hA
  obtain ⟨μ, hμt, f, hf⟩ := ht.exists_injective_of_isAtom P hS le_top
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hmξ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_isAntidominant_of_isAtom_of_injective P hA
    (ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA _) hS hf
  have hmwl : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity
      (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← ProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity P _ hA ht μ]
    exact (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hμt).ne'
  obtain rfl := eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hξ hw hmξ hmwl
  exact ⟨e⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.omegaTwistTensorLinearEquiv_lie
statement:
lemma omegaTwistTensorLinearEquiv_lie (x : nPos P) (t : V ⊗[K] W) :
    omegaTwistTensorLinearEquiv P V W ⁅x, OmegaTwist.of P _ t⁆ =
      ⁅x, omegaTwistTensorLinearEquiv P V W (OmegaTwist.of P _ t)⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul v w =>
    change TensorProduct.congr (OmegaTwist.of P V) (OmegaTwist.of P W)
      ⁅chevalleyInvolution P x, v ⊗ₜ[K] w⁆ = _
    rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right]
    simp only [omegaTwistTensorLinearEquiv, map_add, TensorProduct.congr_tmul,
      LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  | add t s ht hs =>
    rw [map_add, lie_add, map_add, ht, hs, map_add, lie_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.subsingleton_homology_omegaTwist_verma_tensor
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_omegaTwist_verma_tensor (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Subsingleton (homology K (nPos P) (OmegaTwist P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] F)) q)
proof:
:=
  (homologyEquiv (omegaTwistVermaTensorEquiv P Λ F) q).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr
    (subsingleton_homology_tensor_trivial K (nPos P) _ _ q
      (subsingleton_homology_leftRegular q hq))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.subsingleton_homology_omegaTwist_directSum
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_omegaTwist_directSum (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Subsingleton (homology K (nPos P)
      (OmegaTwist P (⨁ j, VermaModule P (lam j) ⊗[K] F j)) q)
proof:
:=
  (homologyEquiv (omegaTwistDirectSumEquiv P fun j ↦ VermaModule P (lam j) ⊗[K] F j)
    q).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr
    (subsingleton_homology_directSum _ q fun j ↦
      subsingleton_homology_omegaTwist_verma_tensor P (lam j) (F j) q hq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_δ_eq_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem exists_δ_eq_restrictedDual (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν = ⊤)
    (hacyc : ∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (homology K (nPos P) (OmegaTwist P V) q)) {k : ℕ}
    {μ : Dual K H} {f : Cochains K (nPos P) (restrictedDual P V) (k + 1)}
    (hf : f ∈ (nPosDerivAction P (restrictedDual P V)).cochainWeightSpace (k + 1) μ)
    (hδ : δ K (nPos P) _ (k + 1) f = 0) :
    ∃ g ∈ (nPosDerivAction P (restrictedDual P V)).cochainWeightSpace k μ,
      δ K (nPos P) _ k g = f
proof:
:=
  (nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).exists_δ_eq_of_subsingleton_homology
    (ρN := nPosDerivAction P (restrictedDual P V)) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun x φ m ↦ dualPairing_lie P (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) φ m)
    (fun a φ m ↦ dualPairing_lie P (h P a) φ m) (dualPairing_injective P)
    (fun _ _ hψ ↦ mem_range_dualPairing P hψ) (iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNPos P)
    (iSup_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist P hV) (hacyc (k + 1) k.succ_pos) hf hδ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isZero_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem isZero_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν = ⊤)
    (hacyc : ∀ q, 0 < q → Subsingleton (homology K (nPos P) (OmegaTwist P V) q))
    (μ : Dual K H) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsZero (nPosCohomology P (restrictedDual P V) μ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hn
  rw [zero_add]
  exact (nPosDerivAction P _).isZero_weightComplex_homology_succ fun f hf hδ ↦
    exists_δ_eq_restrictedDual P hV hacyc hf hδ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isZero_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual_directSum
statement:
theorem isZero_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual_directSum
    (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap (⨁ j, VermaModule P (lam j) ⊗[K] F j) (h P) ν = ⊤)
    (μ : Dual K H) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsZero (nPosCohomology P (restrictedDual P (⨁ j, VermaModule P (lam j) ⊗[K] F j)) μ n)
proof:
:=
  isZero_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual P hV
    (fun q hq ↦ subsingleton_homology_omegaTwist_directSum P lam F q hq) μ hn

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOne_verma_eq_zero_of_mem_cone
statement:
theorem extOne_verma_eq_zero_of_mem_cone {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (hM : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap M (h P) ν = ⊤)
    (hwt : ∀ ν (x : M), x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M (h P) ν → x ≠ 0 → ν ∈ cone P μ)
    (hΛμ : ¬ (Λ ∈ cone P μ ∧ Λ ≠ μ)) (y : ExtOne (h P) (VermaModule P Λ) M) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ExtOne.mk_surjective y
  set E := ExtOne.Extension c
  have hE : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap E (h P) ν = ⊤ :=
    ExtOne.Extension.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top c hM (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).1
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvv⟩ := ExtOne.exists_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_surjective (h P) hE
    (ExtOne.Extension.surjective_snd c) (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ)
  
  have he (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0 := by
    have hsnd : ExtOne.Extension.snd c ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0 := by
      rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, hvv]
      exact lie_e_hwv P Λ i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ExtOne.Extension.exists_inl_eq_of_snd_eq_zero c hsnd
    have hvi : ⁅e P i, v⁆ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap E (h P) (Λ + P.root i) :=
      toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace (P := P) i hv
    have hnw : n ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M (h P) (Λ + P.root i) := by
      rw [← hn, ExtOne.Extension.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff] at hvi
      exact hvi.1
    by_contra hne
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [← hn, h0, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkμ⟩ := hwt _ n hnw hn0
    refine hΛμ ⟨⟨k + Pi.single i 1, add_nonneg hk (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one), ?_⟩,
      fun hΛ ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [map_add, rootOf_single, sub_add_eq_sub_sub, ← hkμ]
      abel
    · have h0 : P.rootOf (k + Pi.single i 1) = P.rootOf 0 := by
        rw [map_add, rootOf_single, map_zero]
        calc P.rootOf k + P.root i = (μ + P.root i) - (μ - P.rootOf k) := by abel
          _ = 0 := by rw [← hkμ, hΛ, sub_self]
      have := congrFun (P.rootOf_injective h0) i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      have := hk i
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at this
      omega
  set σ := VermaModule.lift P v (fun _ hx ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos he hx) (fun a ↦ hv a)
  refine (ExtOne.mk_eq_zero_iff c).mpr ⟨σ, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  have : (ExtOne.Extension.snd c).comp σ = LieModuleHom.id :=
    VermaModule.hom_ext P Λ (by rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, VermaModule.lift_hwv, hvv]; rfl)
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun this m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOne_verma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem extOne_verma_eq_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hΛμ : ¬ (Λ ∈ cone P μ ∧ Λ ≠ μ)) (y : ExtOne (h P) (VermaModule P Λ) M) : y = 0
proof:
:=
  extOne_verma_eq_zero_of_mem_cone P (IsCategoryO.of_surjective φ hφ).1
    (fun _ _ hx hx0 ↦ VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P μ φ hφ hx hx0) hΛμ y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOne_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_zero
statement:
theorem extOne_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_zero {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hμΛ : μ ∈ cone P Λ)
    (y : ExtOne (h P) (VermaModule P Λ) (IrreducibleModule P μ)) : y = 0
proof:
:=
  extOne_verma_eq_zero P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P μ))
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)
    (fun h ↦ h.2 (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone h.1 hμΛ)) y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_splitData_maxSubmodule
statement:
theorem nonempty_splitData_maxSubmodule (Λ : Dual K H) :
    Nonempty (ExtOne.SplitData (h P) (maxSubmodule P Λ).incl
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P Λ)))
proof:
:=
  ExtOne.exists_splitData (h P) (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).1
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).1 Subtype.val_injective
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) fun b ↦ by
      rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact ⟨fun hb ↦ ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, rfl⟩, fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ha ▸ a.2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_hom_maxSubmodule_equiv_extOne
statement:
theorem nonempty_hom_maxSubmodule_equiv_extOne {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hμΛ : μ ∈ cone P Λ)
    (hne : μ ≠ Λ) :
    Nonempty ((maxSubmodule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) ≃ₗ[K]
      ExtOne (h P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (IrreducibleModule P μ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := nonempty_splitData_maxSubmodule P Λ
  refine ⟨D.connectingEquiv (fun g ↦ ?_) (extOne_verma_irreducibleModule_eq_zero P hμΛ)⟩
  
  by_contra hg
  have hg0 : g (hwv P Λ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hg (VermaModule.hom_ext P Λ (by rw [h0]; rfl))
  have hw : g (hwv P Λ) ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P μ) (h P) Λ :=
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkΛ⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P μ
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P μ)) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) hw hg0
  exact hne (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hμΛ ⟨k, hk, hkΛ⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOne_irreducibleModule_self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem extOne_irreducibleModule_self_eq_zero (Λ : Dual K H)
    (y : ExtOne (h P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (IrreducibleModule P Λ)) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := nonempty_splitData_maxSubmodule P Λ
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := D.exists_connecting_eq (y := y)
    (extOne_verma_eq_zero P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P Λ))
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl) _)
  
  suffices hf : f = 0 by rw [hf, map_zero]
  by_contra hf
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P Λ
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top f.range).resolve_left fun h0 ↦ hf ?_
    ext y
    have : f y ∈ f.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact this
  have hN : IsCategoryO P (maxSubmodule P Λ) :=
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).lieSubmodule (maxSubmodule P Λ)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hnf⟩ := ExtOne.exists_mem_weightSpaceOfMap_of_surjective (h P) hN.1 hsurj
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ)
  have hn0 : (n : VermaModule P Λ) ∈ (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓
      weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P Λ) (h P) Λ :=
    ⟨n.2, mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hn⟩
  rw [inf_weightSpace_self_eq_bot P Λ (hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule P Λ), Submodule.mem_bot] at hn0
  have : n = 0 := Subtype.ext hn0
  rw [this, map_zero] at hnf
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ hnf.symm

name: LieSubmodule.infQuotientImageMap_injective
statement:
theorem infQuotientImageMap_injective (N M C : LieSubmodule K L V) :
    Function.Injective (infQuotientImageMap N M C)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr
  rintro ⟨y, x, hx, rfl⟩ hy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N ⊓ C)).mpr
  exact ⟨(Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mp (congrArg Subtype.val hy), hx.2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsHDiagonalizable.isCategoryO_of_finite
statement:
theorem IsHDiagonalizable.isCategoryO_of_finite [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hV : IsHDiagonalizable P V) : IsCategoryO P V where
  iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
proof:
:= hV
  finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap _ := inferInstance
  exists_finset := by
    classical
    have hind := iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := V) (h P)
    have := hind.fintypeNeBotOfFiniteDimensional
    have hfin : {μ | weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
      Set.finite_coe_iff.mp (inferInstance : Finite {μ // weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ ≠ ⊥})
    exact ⟨hfin.toFinset, fun μ hμ =>
      ⟨μ, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hμ, 0, le_rfl, by simp⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_centralBlockProjection_eq_inf
statement:
theorem map_centralBlockProjection_eq_inf (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    N.map (centralBlockProjection P (hV.isCentralLocallyFinite P) χ) =
      N ⊓ centralBlock P V χ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, centralBlockProjection_mem P _ χ v⟩
    have hn := congrArg (fun f => f (⟨v, hv⟩ : N))
      (centralBlockProjection_natural P ((hV.lieSubmodule N).isCentralLocallyFinite P)
        (hV.isCentralLocallyFinite P) N.incl χ)
    exact hn ▸ (centralBlockProjection P ((hV.lieSubmodule N).isCentralLocallyFinite P)
      χ (⟨v, hv⟩ : N)).property
  · intro v hv
    exact ⟨v, hv.1, centralBlockProjection_self P _ χ hv.2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlockStepEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
theorem centralBlockStepEquiv_apply_mk (N M : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ M ⊓ centralBlock P V χ) :
    ((centralBlockStepEquiv P N M hM χ
      ⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _ v, v, hv, rfl⟩).val : V ⧸ N) =
        LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlockStep_eq_bot
statement:
theorem centralBlockStep_eq_bot (N M : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (μ : Dual K H)
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ M.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N))
    (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (hχ : centralCharacter P μ ≠ χ) :
    (M ⊓ centralBlock P V χ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N ⊓ centralBlock P V χ)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have ht := centralBlock_eq_bot_of_ne P hχ
    (centralBlock_eq_top_of_verma_surjective P μ e.toLieModuleHom e.surjective)
  let g := centralBlockStepEquiv P N M hM χ
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro v hv
  have hz : g ⟨v, hv⟩ = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [ht, LieSubmodule.mem_bot, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] using (g ⟨v, hv⟩).property
  have hv0 := g.injective (hz.trans (map_zero g).symm)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hv0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlockStep_ne_bot_iff
statement:
theorem centralBlockStep_ne_bot_iff (N M : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (μ : Dual K H)
    (e : VermaModule P μ ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ M.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N))
    (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    (M ⊓ centralBlock P V χ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N ⊓ centralBlock P V χ)) ≠ ⊥ ↔
      centralCharacter P μ = χ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hn
    by_contra hχ
    exact hn (centralBlockStep_eq_bot P N M hM μ e χ hχ)
  · intro hχ hz
    let g := centralBlockStepVermaEquiv P N M hM μ e χ hχ
    have hg : g (hwv P μ) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa only [hz, LieSubmodule.mem_bot, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] using (g (hwv P μ)).property
    exact hwv_ne_zero P μ (g.injective (hg.trans (map_zero g).symm))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCategoryO_tensorVerma_of_finite
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_tensorVerma_of_finite (hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P Z) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    IsCategoryO P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z)
proof:
:=
  (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct (hZ.isCategoryO_of_finite P)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.retained_tensorVerma_weight_count
statement:
theorem retained_tensorVerma_weight_count {n : ℕ} (wt : Fin n → Dual K H)
    (hc : ∀ μ, Nat.card {j // wt j = μ} = finrank K (weightSpace P Z μ))
    (Λ μ : Dual K H) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Nat.card {j : Fin n // wt j = μ ∧ centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) = χ} =
      if centralCharacter P (Λ + μ) = χ then finrank K (weightSpace P Z μ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : centralCharacter P (Λ + μ) = χ
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, ← hc μ]
    apply Nat.card_congr
    exact Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun j => ⟨fun hj => hj.1, fun hj => ⟨hj, hj ▸ h⟩⟩)
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]
    have he : IsEmpty {j : Fin n // wt j = μ ∧ centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) = χ} :=
      ⟨fun j => h (j.property.1 ▸ j.property.2)⟩
    exact Nat.card_of_isEmpty

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_centralTensorVermaFiltration
statement:
theorem exists_centralTensorVermaFiltration (hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P Z) (Λ : Dual K H)
    (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    ∃ (N : Fin (finrank K Z + 1) →
        LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z))
      (wt : Fin (finrank K Z) → Dual K H),
      StrictMono N ∧ N 0 = ⊥ ∧ N (Fin.last (finrank K Z)) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ j, Nonempty (VermaModule P (Λ + wt j) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        (N j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N j.castSucc)))) ∧
      (∀ μ, Nat.card {j // wt j = μ} = finrank K (weightSpace P Z μ)) ∧
      let F := fun k => N k ⊓ centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z) χ
      Monotone F ∧ F 0 = ⊥ ∧
      F (Fin.last (finrank K Z)) = centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z) χ ∧
      (∀ k, F k = (N k).map (centralBlockProjection P
        ((isCategoryO_tensorVerma_of_finite P hZ Λ).isCentralLocallyFinite P) χ)) ∧
      (∀ j, (centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) = χ →
        Nonempty (VermaModule P (Λ + wt j) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
          (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)))) ∧
        (centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) ≠ χ →
          (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥)) ∧
      ∀ μ, Nat.card {j // wt j = μ ∧ centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) = χ} =
        if centralCharacter P (Λ + μ) = χ then finrank K (weightSpace P Z μ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, wt, hmono, hzero, hlast, hstep, hcount⟩ :=
    exists_tensorVermaStandardFiltration P hZ Λ
  have hV := isCategoryO_tensorVerma_of_finite P hZ Λ
  refine ⟨N, wt, hmono, hzero, hlast, hstep, hcount, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun i j hij => inf_le_inf_right _ (hmono.monotone hij),
    by simp [hzero], by simp [hlast], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    exact (map_centralBlockProjection_eq_inf P hV (N k) χ).symm
  · intro j
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hstep j
    exact ⟨fun hχ => ⟨centralBlockStepVermaEquiv P _ _ (hV.lieSubmodule _) _ e χ hχ⟩,
      fun hχ => centralBlockStep_eq_bot P _ _ (hV.lieSubmodule _) _ e χ hχ⟩
  · exact fun μ => retained_tensorVerma_weight_count P wt hcount Λ μ χ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.count_range_eq_finrank_hom
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.count_range_eq_finrank_hom [CharZero K] [DecidableEq (Dual K H)]
    {e : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X} (he : e.comp e = e) (hX : IsCategoryO P e.range)
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hs : IsStdFiltered P e.range s) (ν : Dual K H) :
    s.count ν = finrank K (e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν))
proof:
:=
  (isStdFiltered_top_range P he hs).count_eq_finrank_hom hX ν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.count_eq_vermaMult
statement:
theorem count_eq_vermaMult [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M)
    (hFM : IsCategoryO P (F.idem M).range) {s : Multiset (Dual K H)}
    (hs : IsStdFiltered P (F.idem M).range s) (ν : Dual K H) :
    s.count ν = F.vermaMult M ν
proof:
:=
  hs.count_range_eq_finrank_hom P (LieModuleHom.ext (F.idem_idem M hM)) hFM ν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [FiniteDimensional K V] : IsCategoryO P V
proof:
:=
  IsHDiagonalizable.isCategoryO_of_finite P (isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional hA)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.tensorBlock_idem
statement:
theorem tensorBlock_idem [FiniteDimensional K V] (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M) :
    (tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).idem M =
      (hM.tensorProduct
        (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V)).centralBlockProjection P χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [tensorBlock, hM, ↓reduceDIte]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.range_tensorBlock_idem
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorBlock_idem χ hM, ← LieModuleHom.map_top, IsCategoryO.centralBlockProjection,
    map_centralBlockProjection_eq_inf P
      (hM.tensorProduct (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V)), top_inf_eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.exists_isStdFiltered_tensorBlock_verma
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_tensorBlock_verma [FiniteDimensional K V] (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ s, IsStdFiltered P ((tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).idem (VermaModule P Λ)).range s ∧
      ∀ ξ, s.count ξ = if centralCharacter P ξ = χ then finrank K (weightSpace P V (ξ - Λ))
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, wt, -, -, -, -, -, hmono, h0, hlast, -, hstep, hcount⟩ :=
    exists_centralTensorVermaFiltration P (isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional (V := V) hA)
      Λ χ
  set S : Set (Fin (finrank K V)) := {j | centralCharacter P (Λ + wt j) = χ}
  have h1 := isStdFiltered_of_fin_of_zero P _ (fun j ↦ Λ + wt j) S hmono h0
    (fun j hj ↦ (hstep j).1 hj) (fun j hj ↦ (hstep j).2 hj)
  refine ⟨(Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ S)).val.map (fun j ↦ Λ + wt j), ?_, fun ξ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [range_tensorBlock_idem χ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ)]
    exact hlast ▸ h1
  · have hc := hcount (ξ - Λ)
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at hc
    rw [← hc, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, Multiset.count_map,
      ← Finset.filter_val, Finset.filter_filter, Finset.card_val]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.filter_congr fun j _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [S, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨by rw [h2]; abel, h1⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨h2, by rw [h1]; abel⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_tensorBlock
statement:
theorem vermaMult_tensorBlock [FiniteDimensional K V] (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (Λ ξ : Dual K H) :
    (tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).vermaMult (VermaModule P Λ) ξ =
      if centralCharacter P ξ = χ then finrank K (weightSpace P V (ξ - Λ)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hVO := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V
  have hO := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct hVO
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcount⟩ :=
    exists_isStdFiltered_tensorBlock_verma (P := P) (hA := hA) (lam := lam) (V := V) χ Λ
  have he : ((tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).idem (VermaModule P Λ)).comp
      ((tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).idem (VermaModule P Λ)) =
      (tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).idem (VermaModule P Λ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [LieModuleHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      tensorBlock_idem χ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ), IsCategoryO.centralBlockProjection]
    exact centralBlockProjection_self P _ χ (centralBlockProjection_mem P _ χ x)
  have hX : IsCategoryO P ((tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).idem (VermaModule P Λ)).range :=
    hO.lieSubmodule _
  rw [vermaMult, ← hs.count_range_eq_finrank_hom P he hX ξ, hcount ξ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.commutesWithWeyl_tensorBlock
statement:
theorem commutesWithWeyl_tensorBlock [FiniteDimensional K V] (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    (tensorBlock P hA lam V χ).CommutesWithWeyl
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro w _ ν
  rw [vermaMult_tensorBlock, vermaMult_tensorBlock]
  have hc : centralCharacter P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ν) = centralCharacter P ν :=
    VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.property ν
  have hsub : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ν - P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam =
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (ν - lam) := by
    simp only [weylDot, map_sub, map_add]
    abel
  rw [hc, hsub, ((nonempty_weightSpace_weylGroup_equiv hA.isGeneralizedCartan
    (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional hA (V := V)) w.property (ν - lam)).some.finrank_eq)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.exists_generator
statement:
theorem exists_generator : ∃ p ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) Λ,
    π p = IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ ∧ LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {p} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ
  rw [← map_weightSpace_of_surjective P hπ.isCategoryO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top _
    hπ.surjective] at hmem
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hπp⟩ := hmem
