  refine ⟨p, hp, hπp, hπ.eq_top_of_not_le_ker _ fun hle ↦ ?_⟩
  have : p ∈ π.ker := hle (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan rfl)
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker] at this
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ (hπp.symm.trans this)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.eq_zero_of_apply_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {p} ≤ f.ker := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact hf
  ext y
  have hy : y ∈ f.ker := hle (hp ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top y)
  exact hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_le
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_le {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [FiniteDimensional K (weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ)] :
    finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) ≤ finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpw, -, hp⟩ := hπ.exists_generator
  let φ : (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) →ₗ[K] weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ :=
    { toFun f := ⟨f p, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hpw⟩
      map_add' _ _ := rfl
      map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
  refine LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (f := φ) fun f g hfg ↦ ?_
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_apply_eq_zero hp ?_
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hfg
  simpa [φ, sub_eq_zero] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.π_ne_zero
statement: theorem π_ne_zero : π ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h0 ↦ by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hπ.surjective (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
  rw [h0] at hx
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ hx.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.hom_irreducible_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hom_irreducible_eq_zero {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ Λ)
    (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hf0
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P μ
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top f.range).resolve_left fun h0 ↦ hf0 ?_
    ext y
    have : f y ∈ f.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact this
  have hker : f.ker ≤ π.ker := by
    by_contra hle
    have := hπ.eq_top_of_not_le_ker f.ker hle
    exact hf0 (by ext y; exact (this ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top y : y ∈ f.ker))
  let ℓ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift f.ker f le_rfl
  have hℓ : Function.Bijective ℓ := by
    refine ⟨fun x y hxy ↦ ?_, LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_surjective f.ker f le_rfl hf⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' f.ker x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' f.ker y
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_mk, LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_mk] at hxy
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, LieModuleHom.mem_ker,
      map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  let e := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective ℓ hℓ
  let g := (LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift f.ker π hker).comp e.symm.toLieModuleHom
  have hg (y : V) : g (f y) = π y := by
    change LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift f.ker π hker (e.symm (f y)) = _
    have : e.symm (f y) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' f.ker y := by
      rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    rfl
  have hgs : Function.Surjective g := fun z ↦ by
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hπ.surjective z
    exact ⟨f y, hg y⟩
  have hgi : Function.Injective g := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot]
    refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top g.ker).resolve_right fun htop ↦ ?_
    apply hπ.π_ne_zero
    ext y
    rw [← hg]
    exact (htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top (f y) : f y ∈ g.ker)
  exact hμ (IrreducibleModule.eq_of_equiv P (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective g ⟨hgi, hgs⟩))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_irreducible_self
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_irreducible_self
    [FiniteDimensional K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)] :
    finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : FiniteDimensional K (weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) Λ) :=
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap Λ
  have hle := hπ.finrank_hom_le (X := IrreducibleModule P Λ)
  rw [show finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) Λ) = 1 from
    IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P Λ] at hle
  have hpos : 0 < finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) :=
    Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨π, hπ.π_ne_zero⟩
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X) :
    FiniteDimensional K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X)
proof:
:= by
  have := hX.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap Λ
  obtain ⟨p, hpw, -, hp⟩ := hπ.exists_generator
  let φ : (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) →ₗ[K] weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) Λ :=
    { toFun f := ⟨f p, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hpw⟩
      map_add' _ _ := rfl
      map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
  refine Module.Finite.of_injective φ fun f g hfg ↦ ?_
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_apply_eq_zero hp ?_
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hfg
  simpa [φ, sub_eq_zero] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_add
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_eq_add (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{w} P V) {X : Type w}
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    {A B : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B) = finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ A) +
      finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ A.Subquotient B)
proof:
:= by
  set S := A.comap B.incl
  let Φ : (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B) →ₗ[K] (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ A.Subquotient B) :=
    { toFun g := (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S).comp g
      map_add' _ _ := by ext; simp
      map_smul' _ _ := by ext; simp }
  let Ψ : (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ A) →ₗ[K] (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ B) :=
    { toFun g := (LieSubmodule.inclusion hAB).comp g
      map_add' _ _ := by ext; simp
      map_smul' _ _ := by ext; simp }
  have hBO : IsCategoryO P B := hX.lieSubmodule B
  have := hπ.finiteDimensional_hom hBO
  have := hπ.finiteDimensional_hom (hBO.quotient S)
  have hΦ : Function.Surjective Φ := fun φ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hproj hBO (hBO.quotient S) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S)
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' S) φ
    exact ⟨g, hg⟩
  have hΨ : Function.Injective Ψ := fun g g' hgg' ↦ by
    ext y
    have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hgg' y
    simpa [Ψ] using congrArg Subtype.val this
  have hker : LinearMap.ker Φ = LinearMap.range Ψ := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · intro hg
      have hmem (y : V) : ((g y : B) : X) ∈ A := by
        have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hg) y
        change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S (g y) = 0 at this
        rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
        exact this
      refine ⟨LieModuleHom.codRestrict A (B.incl.comp g) hmem, ?_⟩
      ext y
      rfl
    · rintro ⟨g', rfl⟩
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      ext y
      change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S (LieSubmodule.inclusion hAB (g' y)) = 0
      rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact (g' y).2
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker Φ
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hΦ, finrank_top, hker,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hΨ] at h1
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_eq_zero {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y]
    (hY : weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) Λ = ⊥) : finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K (weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) Λ) := by
    rw [hY]; infer_instance
  have h1 := hπ.finrank_hom_le (X := Y)
  have h2 : finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) Λ) = 0 :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hY).finrank_eq.trans (finrank_bot K Y)
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_irreducible
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_irreducible [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) = if μ = Λ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hμ
  · subst hμ
    have := hπ.finiteDimensional_hom (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ)
    exact hπ.finrank_hom_irreducible_self
  · have : Subsingleton (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) :=
      ⟨fun f g ↦ (hπ.hom_irreducible_eq_zero hμ f).trans (hπ.hom_irreducible_eq_zero hμ g).symm⟩
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{w} P V) {X : Type w}
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X) :
    finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) = hX.multiplicity Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hX.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries Λ
  rw [← hX.count_factorWeights_eq_multiplicity (mem_cone_self Λ) hl]
  have key : ∀ (l : List (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X × Option (Dual K H)))
      (N M : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X), IsLocalCompositionSeries P Λ N l M →
      finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M) = finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) + (factorWeights l).count Λ := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro N M h
      rw [IsLocalCompositionSeries.nil_iff] at h
      subst h
      simp
    | cons a l ih =>
      obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
      intro N M h
      obtain ⟨hNN', hfac, hrest⟩ := h
      rw [ih N' M hrest, hπ.finrank_hom_eq_add hproj hX hNN']
      cases o with
      | none =>
        rw [hπ.finrank_hom_eq_zero (hfac Λ (mem_cone_self Λ)), factorWeights_cons_none]
        ring
      | some μ =>
        obtain ⟨-, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hfac
        rw [(lieModuleHomCongr P LieModuleEquiv.refl e).finrank_eq,
          hπ.finrank_hom_irreducible μ, factorWeights_cons_some, List.count_cons]
        by_cases hμ : μ = Λ
        · subst hμ
          simp only [ite_true, beq_self_eq_true]
          omega
        · simp [hμ]
  have h := key l ⊥ ⊤ hl
  have hbot : finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X)) = 0 := by
    have : Subsingleton (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X)) :=
      ⟨fun f g ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ Subtype.ext
        (((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (f x).2).trans ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (g x).2).symm)⟩
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  have etop : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X :=
    LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X).incl
      ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun x ↦ ⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [hbot, zero_add, (lieModuleHomCongr P LieModuleEquiv.refl etop).finrank_eq] at h
  exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.exists_retract
statement:
theorem exists_retract {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) (hWproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P W)
    (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (φ : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    ∃ (s : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (r : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V), r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hWproj hπ.isCategoryO (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ) π hπ.surjective φ
  have hrs : Function.Surjective r := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    refine hπ.eq_top_of_not_le_ker _ fun hle ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hφ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
    have : r x ∈ π.ker := hle ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hr, hx] at this
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ this
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hproj hW hπ.isCategoryO r hrs LieModuleHom.id
  exact ⟨s, r, hs⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) (hWproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P W)
    (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (hind : ∀ a : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W, a.comp a = a → a = 0 ∨ a = LieModuleHom.id)
    (φ : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Nonempty (V ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, r, hrs⟩ := hπ.exists_retract hproj hWproj hW φ hφ
  have hidem : (s.comp r).comp (s.comp r) = s.comp r := by
    ext x
    change s (r (s (r x))) = s (r x)
    rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply r s, hrs]
    rfl
  rcases hind _ hidem with h0 | h1
  · exfalso
    apply hπ.π_ne_zero
    ext v
    have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 (s v)
    change s (r (s v)) = 0 at this
    rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply r s, hrs] at this
    change s v = 0 at this
    have hv : v = r (s v) := by rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hrs]; rfl
    rw [hv, this, map_zero, map_zero]
    rfl
  · refine ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective s ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ?_, fun w ↦ ⟨r w, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    · have := congrArg r hab
      rwa [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply r s, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply r s, hrs] at this
    · exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun h1 w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveCover
statement: theorem isProjectiveCover : IsProjectiveCover P (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) (π P hA Λ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isCategoryO P hA Λ, surjective_π P hA Λ, eq_top_of_not_le_ker P hA Λ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X) :
    finrank K (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) = hX.multiplicity Λ
proof:
:=
  (isProjectiveCover P Λ hA).finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (isProjectiveO P hA Λ) hX

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_irreducible
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_irreducible [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) = if μ = Λ then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  (isProjectiveCover P Λ hA).finrank_hom_irreducible μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    (hWproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P W) (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (hind : ∀ a : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W, a.comp a = a → a = 0 ∨ a = LieModuleHom.id)
    (φ : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
proof:
:=
  (isProjectiveCover P Λ hA).nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable (isProjectiveO P hA Λ) hWproj hW
    hind φ hφ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.postcompLinear_comp
statement:
theorem postcompLinear_comp (X : CategoryO.{u} P) {Y Y' Y'' : CategoryO.{u} P} (f : Y ⟶ Y')
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y'') (n : ℕ) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y n) :
    postcompLinear X g n (postcompLinear X f n x) = postcompLinear X (f ≫ g) n x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [postcompLinear, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  rw [Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.postcompLinear_id
statement:
theorem postcompLinear_id (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y n) :
    postcompLinear X (𝟙 Y) n x = x
proof:
:=
  Abelian.Ext.comp_mk₀_id x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finrank_ext_congr
proof:
:= by
  let f : Z ⟶ Z' := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e.toLieModuleHom)
  let g : Z' ⟶ Z := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e.symm.toLieModuleHom)
  have hfg : f ≫ g = 𝟙 Z := by
    ext z
    exact e.symm_apply_apply z
  have hgf : g ≫ f = 𝟙 Z' := by
    ext z
    exact e.apply_symm_apply z
  exact LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    { postcompLinear X f n with
      invFun := postcompLinear X g n
      left_inv := fun x ↦ by
        change postcompLinear X g n (postcompLinear X f n x) = x
        rw [postcompLinear_comp, hfg, postcompLinear_id]
      right_inv := fun x ↦ by
        change postcompLinear X f n (postcompLinear X g n x) = x
        rw [postcompLinear_comp, hgf, postcompLinear_id] }

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.eulerChar_congr
statement:
theorem eulerChar_congr (μ : Dual K H) {Z Z' : CategoryO.{u} P} (e : Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z'.obj) :
    eulerChar hA μ Z = eulerChar hA μ Z'
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ by rw [finrank_ext_congr (verma P μ) e n]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.multiplicity_kerComplex
statement:
theorem multiplicity_kerComplex (X Z : CategoryO.{u} P) (φ : X.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z.obj)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    X.property.1.multiplicity ν =
      (ofSub X φ.ker).property.1.multiplicity ν + Z.property.1.multiplicity ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (X.property.1.lieSubmodule φ.ker) X.property.1
      Z.property.1 φ.ker.incl φ Subtype.val_injective φ.ker.range_incl.symm hφ,
    IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (X.property.1.lieSubmodule φ.ker) (ofSub X φ.ker).property.1
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) φ.ker)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.multiplicity_subComplex
statement:
theorem multiplicity_subComplex (X : CategoryO.{u} P) {N N' : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj}
    (hle : N ≤ N') (Z : CategoryO.{u} P) (g : N' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z.obj)
    (hg : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ N), g ⟨x, hle hx⟩ = 0) (hgs : Function.Surjective g)
    (hker : ∀ y : N', g y = 0 → (y : X.obj) ∈ N) (ν : Dual K H) :
    (ofSub X N').property.1.multiplicity ν =
      (ofSub X N).property.1.multiplicity ν + Z.property.1.multiplicity ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (X.property.1.lieSubmodule N') (ofSub X N').property.1
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N'),
    ← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (X.property.1.lieSubmodule N) (ofSub X N).property.1
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N),
    IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (X.property.1.lieSubmodule N)
      (X.property.1.lieSubmodule N') Z.property.1 (LieSubmodule.inclusion hle) g
      (LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective hle) ?_ hgs]
  ext y
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨⟨y, hker y hy⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hg x.1 x.2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.delormeSum_eq_of_subset
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_subset hTT' fun μ _ hμ ↦ by rw [hT μ hμ, zero_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.delormeSum_eq_add
statement:
theorem delormeSum_eq_add {S : ShortComplex (CategoryO.{u} P)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (T : Finset (Dual K H)) (ν : Dual K H) :
    delormeSum hA S.X₂ T ν = delormeSum hA S.X₁ T ν + delormeSum hA S.X₃ T ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [delormeSum, delormeSum, delormeSum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ by rw [eulerChar_eq_add hA μ hS, add_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasDelormeFormula_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem hasDelormeFormula_of_shortExact {S : ShortComplex (CategoryO.{u} P)}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (hm : ∀ ν, S.X₂.property.1.multiplicity ν =
      S.X₁.property.1.multiplicity ν + S.X₃.property.1.multiplicity ν) :
    (HasDelormeFormula hA S.X₁ → HasDelormeFormula hA S.X₃ → HasDelormeFormula hA S.X₂) ∧
      (HasDelormeFormula hA S.X₂ → HasDelormeFormula hA S.X₃ → HasDelormeFormula hA S.X₁)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T₁, hT₁, h₁⟩ ⟨T₃, hT₃, h₃⟩
    refine ⟨T₁ ∪ T₃, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_, fun ν ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hμ
      rw [eulerChar_eq_add hA μ hS, hT₁ μ hμ.1, hT₃ μ hμ.2, add_zero]
    · rw [hm ν, Nat.cast_add, h₁ ν, h₃ ν,
        delormeSum_eq_of_subset hA Finset.subset_union_left hT₁,
        delormeSum_eq_of_subset hA Finset.subset_union_right hT₃, delormeSum_eq_add hA hS]
  · rintro ⟨T₂, hT₂, h₂⟩ ⟨T₃, hT₃, h₃⟩
    refine ⟨T₂ ∪ T₃, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_, fun ν ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hμ
      have := eulerChar_eq_add hA μ hS
      rw [hT₂ μ hμ.1, hT₃ μ hμ.2] at this
      linarith
    · have h := delormeSum_eq_add hA hS (T₂ ∪ T₃) ν
      rw [← delormeSum_eq_of_subset hA Finset.subset_union_left hT₂,
        ← delormeSum_eq_of_subset hA Finset.subset_union_right hT₃, ← h₂ ν, ← h₃ ν, hm ν,
        Nat.cast_add] at h
      linarith

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.HasDelormeFormula.of_equiv
statement:
theorem HasDelormeFormula.of_equiv {N N' : CategoryO.{u} P} (e : N.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N'.obj)
    (h : HasDelormeFormula hA N) : HasDelormeFormula hA N'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hN⟩ := h
  refine ⟨T, fun μ hμ ↦ by rw [← eulerChar_congr hA μ e, hT μ hμ], fun ν ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr N.property.1 N'.property.1 e ν, hN ν]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ by rw [eulerChar_congr hA μ e]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.eulerChar_ofSub_bot
statement:
theorem eulerChar_ofSub_bot (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (μ : Dual K H) :
    eulerChar hA μ (ofSub X ⊥) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n _ ↦ ?_
  have : Subsingleton (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (ofSub X ⊥) n) :=
    ⟨fun x y ↦ (Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right (isZero_ofSub_bot X) x).trans
      (Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right (isZero_ofSub_bot X) y).symm⟩
  rw [finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.multiplicity_ofSub_bot
statement:
theorem multiplicity_ofSub_bot (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (ν : Dual K H) :
    (ofSub X ⊥).property.1.multiplicity ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (ofSub X ⊥).obj :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj))
  have h := IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (ofSub X ⊥).property.1
    (ofSub X ⊥).property.1 (ofSub X ⊥).property.1 0 0 (fun a b _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim a b) ?_
    (fun a ↦ ⟨a, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩) ν
  · omega
  · ext y
    rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0]
    exact iff_of_true (zero_mem _) (zero_mem _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasDelormeFormula_ofSub_bot
statement: theorem hasDelormeFormula_ofSub_bot (X : CategoryO.{u} P) : HasDelormeFormula hA (ofSub X ⊥)
proof:
:=
  ⟨∅, fun μ _ ↦ eulerChar_ofSub_bot hA X μ, fun ν ↦ by
    rw [multiplicity_ofSub_bot, delormeSum, Finset.sum_empty, Nat.cast_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.multiplicity_dualVerma
statement:
theorem multiplicity_dualVerma (lam ν : Dual K H) :
    (dualVerma P lam).property.1.multiplicity ν =
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [← multiplicity_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam) ν,
    IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam))
      (dualVerma P lam).property.1 (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P lam)))]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finrank_ext_zero_verma_dualVerma
statement:
theorem finrank_ext_zero_verma_dualVerma [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (μ lam : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (dualVerma P lam) 0) = if lam = μ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [((Abelian.Ext.linearEquiv₀ (R := K)).trans
    ((homEquivLie (verma P μ) (dualVerma P lam)).trans
      (lieModuleHomCongr P (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P μ)).symm
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P lam))).symm))).finrank_eq,
    finrank_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma P lam μ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.eulerChar_dualVerma
statement:
theorem eulerChar_dualVerma (μ lam : Dual K H) :
    eulerChar hA μ (dualVerma P lam) =
      finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (dualVerma P lam) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar, Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun n _ hn ↦ ?_)
    (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos _)) h)]
  · simp
  have : Subsingleton (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (dualVerma P lam) n) :=
    ⟨fun x y ↦ (ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero μ lam (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) x).trans
      (ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero μ lam (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) y).symm⟩
  rw [finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasDelormeFormula_dualVerma
statement:
theorem hasDelormeFormula_dualVerma (lam : Dual K H) :
    HasDelormeFormula hA (dualVerma P lam)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨{lam}, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_, fun ν ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [eulerChar_dualVerma, finrank_ext_zero_verma_dualVerma]
    simp [Ne.symm (Finset.notMem_singleton.mp hμ)]
  · rw [delormeSum, Finset.sum_singleton, eulerChar_dualVerma, finrank_ext_zero_verma_dualVerma,
      multiplicity_dualVerma]
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasDelormeFormula_of_multiplicity
statement:
theorem hasDelormeFormula_of_multiplicity (W : CategoryO.{u} P)
    (h : ∀ ν, W.property.1.multiplicity ν ≠ 0 → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν) → HasDelormeFormula hA Z) :
    HasDelormeFormula hA W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := W.property.2
  have := W.property.1.wellFoundedLT_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  have := W.property.1.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  refine HasDelormeFormula.of_equiv hA
    ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W.obj)).symm.trans
      (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W.obj).incl
        ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun y ↦ ⟨⟨y, LieSubmodule.mem_top y⟩, rfl⟩⟩))
    (WellFoundedLT.induction (motive := fun M ↦ HasDelormeFormula hA (ofSub W M)) ⊤
      fun M ih ↦ ?_)
  by_cases hM : M = ⊥
  · subst hM
    exact hasDelormeFormula_ofSub_bot hA W
  obtain ⟨M', hM'M, ν, hν, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := W.property.1.exists_subquotient_equiv_of_ne_bot hM
  have hg : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ M'), toSubquotient W M' M ⟨y, hM'M.le hy⟩ = 0 :=
    fun y hy ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff W M' M ⟨y, hM'M.le hy⟩).mpr hy
  have hker : ∀ y : M, toSubquotient W M' M y = 0 → (y : W.obj) ∈ M' :=
    fun y hy ↦ (toSubquotient_eq_zero_iff W M' M y).mp hy
  have hS := shortExact_subComplex W hM'M.le (ofSubquotient W M' M) (toSubquotient W M' M) hg
    (surjective_toSubquotient W M' M) hker
  exact (hasDelormeFormula_of_shortExact hA hS (multiplicity_subComplex W hM'M.le
    (ofSubquotient W M' M) (toSubquotient W M' M) hg (surjective_toSubquotient W M' M)
      hker)).1 (ih M' hM'M) (h ν hν _ ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (M'.Subquotient M)).symm.trans ψ))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finite_dotOrbitBelow
statement: theorem finite_dotOrbitBelow (μ : Dual K H) : (dotOrbitBelow P hA μ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  refine (Set.finite_range fun w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan ↦
    P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ).subset ?_
  rintro κ ⟨⟨w, rfl⟩, -⟩
  exact ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ncard_dotOrbitBelow_lt
statement:
theorem ncard_dotOrbitBelow_lt {μ κ : Dual K H} (hκ : κ ∈ dotOrbitBelow P hA μ) :
    (dotOrbitBelow P hA κ).ncard < (dotOrbitBelow P hA μ).ncard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hκμ, hne⟩ := hκ
  have hsub : dotOrbitBelow P hA κ ⊆ dotOrbitBelow P hA μ := by
    rintro ν ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩, hνκ, -⟩
    refine ⟨⟨y * x, by rw [hx, weylDot_mul]⟩, mem_cone_trans hνκ hκμ, fun h ↦ hne ?_⟩
    rw [h] at hνκ
    exact eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hκμ hνκ
  exact Set.ncard_lt_ncard ((Set.ssubset_iff_of_subset hsub).mpr
    ⟨κ, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hκμ, hne⟩, fun h ↦ h.2.2 rfl⟩) (finite_dotOrbitBelow hA μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.mem_dotOrbitBelow_of_multiplicity
proof:
:= by
  have hlink := VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA h
  rw [← weylDot_one P hA.isGeneralizedCartan ν] at hlink
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_weylDot_eq P hA.isGeneralizedCartan hlink
  refine ⟨⟨x⁻¹, ?_⟩, VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero h, hne⟩
  rw [hx, ← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasDelormeFormula_simple_aux
statement:
theorem hasDelormeFormula_simple_aux : ∀ (n : ℕ) (lam : Dual K H),
    (dotOrbitBelow P hA lam).ncard < n → ∀ Z : CategoryO.{u} P,
      (Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) → HasDelormeFormula hA Z
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro lam h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
  intro lam hlam Z e
  let D := dualVerma P lam
  let ι := simpleToDualVerma (P := P) lam
  let Q := ofQuotient D ι.range
  let φ := toQuotient D ι.range
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := surjective_toQuotient D ι.range
  have hker (y : D.obj) : y ∈ φ.ker ↔ ∃ m, ι m = y := by
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, toQuotient_eq_zero_iff, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  
  let eK : IrreducibleModule P lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ φ.ker := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective
    (ι.codRestrict φ.ker fun m ↦ (hker (ι m)).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩)
    ⟨fun a b hab ↦ injective_simpleToDualVerma lam (congrArg Subtype.val hab), fun y ↦ by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (hker y).mp y.2
      exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩⟩
  have hS := shortExact_kerComplex D Q φ hφ
  have hD := D.property.1
  have hQ := Q.property.1
  have hmult (ν : Dual K H) : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν =
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν + hQ.multiplicity ν := by
    rw [← multiplicity_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam))
        hD (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P lam))),
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hD.lieSubmodule φ.ker) hD hQ φ.ker.incl φ
        Subtype.val_injective φ.ker.range_incl.symm hφ,
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (hD.lieSubmodule φ.ker) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam)
        eK.symm]
  
  have hQD : HasDelormeFormula hA Q := by
    refine hasDelormeFormula_of_multiplicity hA Q fun ν hν Z' e' ↦ ?_
    have h := hmult ν
    rw [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq] at h
    have hne : ν ≠ lam := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self] at h
      simp at h
      omega
    simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte] at h
    have hmem := mem_dotOrbitBelow_of_multiplicity hA
      (by omega : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity ν ≠ 0) hne
    exact ih ν (by have := ncard_dotOrbitBelow_lt hA hmem; omega) Z' e'
  exact HasDelormeFormula.of_equiv hA ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) φ.ker).symm.trans
    (eK.symm.trans e.symm)) ((hasDelormeFormula_of_shortExact hA hS
      (multiplicity_kerComplex D Q φ hφ)).2 (hasDelormeFormula_dualVerma hA lam) hQD)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasDelormeFormula_of_equiv_simple
statement:
theorem hasDelormeFormula_of_equiv_simple (lam : Dual K H) (Z : CategoryO.{u} P)
    (e : Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) : HasDelormeFormula hA Z
proof:
:=
  hasDelormeFormula_simple_aux hA _ lam (Nat.lt_succ_self _) Z e

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasDelormeFormula
statement: theorem hasDelormeFormula (N : CategoryO.{u} P) : HasDelormeFormula hA N
proof:
:=
  hasDelormeFormula_of_multiplicity hA N fun ν _ Z e ↦ hasDelormeFormula_of_equiv_simple hA ν Z e

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.multiplicity_eq_sum_eulerChar
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_sum_eulerChar (N : CategoryO.{u} P) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Dual K H), (∀ μ ∉ T, eulerChar hA μ N = 0) ∧ ∀ ν,
      (N.property.1.multiplicity ν : ℤ) =
        ∑ μ ∈ T, eulerChar hA μ N * ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity ν : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  hasDelormeFormula hA N

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.character_eq_sum_eulerChar
statement:
theorem character_eq_sum_eulerChar (N : CategoryO.{u} P) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Dual K H), (∀ μ ∉ T, eulerChar hA μ N = 0) ∧
      N.property.1.character =
        ∑ μ ∈ T, eulerChar hA μ N • (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).character
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, h⟩ := hasDelormeFormula hA N
  refine ⟨T, hT, ?_⟩
  have hsum : ∑ μ ∈ T, eulerChar hA μ N • (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).character =
      sumIrreducibleCharacter P
        (∑ μ ∈ T, eulerChar hA μ N • (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicities) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_zsmul, ← (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter]
  rw [N.property.1.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, hsum]
  congr 1
  ext ν
  change (N.property.1.multiplicity ν : ℤ) = _
  rw [h ν, delormeSum]
  simp only [CharacterRing.coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_sum, HahnSeries.coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpaceBasis_mem
statement:
lemma rootSpaceBasis_mem (μ : Dual K H) (k : Fin (finrank K (rootSpace P μ))) :
    (rootSpaceBasis P μ k : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P μ
proof:
:=
  (rootSpaceBasis P μ k).2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.symm
statement: lemma symm (x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) : B x y = B y x
proof: := hB.isSymm.eq x y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_left
statement: lemma lie_left (x y z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) : B ⁅x, y⁆ z = B x ⁅y, z⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lie_skew, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, hB.lieInvariant y x z, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.eq_zero_of_forall
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (hx0 : ∀ y ∈ rootSpace P (-μ), B x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : rootSpace P μ = ⊥
  · rw [hμ] at hx; exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hx
  rcases mem_allWeights_of_rootSpace_ne_bot P hμ with (hneg | h0) | hpos
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hneg
    exact hB.eq_zero_of_neg ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ hx (by simpa using hx0)
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h0
    subst h0
    rw [rootSpace_zero] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    have ha : a = 0 := (P.nondegenerate_bilinForm S).1 a fun b ↦ by
      rw [← hB.h_h]
      exact hx0 _ (by rw [neg_zero, rootSpace_zero]; exact ⟨b, rfl⟩)
    rw [ha, map_zero]
  · exact hB.eq_zero_of_pos hpos hx hx0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_eq_smul
statement:
theorem lie_eq_smul {μ : Dual K H} {x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)) : ⁅x, y⁆ = B x y • h P ((P.toDual S).symm μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ rootSpace P 0 := by
    have := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hx hy
    rwa [add_neg_cancel] at this
  rw [rootSpace_zero] at hxy
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hxy
  rw [← hc, ← map_smul]
  congr 1
  apply (P.toDual S).injective
  rw [map_smul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  ext a
  rw [toDual_apply, ← hB.h_h, hc, hB.lie_left, ← lie_skew, hy a]
  simp only [map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.pairing_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma pairing_apply (μ : Dual K H) (y : rootSpace P (-μ)) (x : rootSpace P μ) :
    pairing B μ y x = B x y
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.pairing_injective
statement: lemma pairing_injective (μ : Dual K H) : Function.Injective (pairing B μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro y hy
  refine Submodule.coe_eq_zero.mp (hB.eq_zero_of_forall (μ := -μ) y.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  rw [hB.symm]
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun hy ⟨x, by rwa [neg_neg] at hx⟩
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finrank_rootSpace_le
statement:
lemma finrank_rootSpace_le (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (rootSpace P μ) ≤ finrank K (rootSpace P (-μ))
proof:
:= by
  have := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (hB.pairing_injective (-μ))
  rwa [Subspace.dual_finrank_eq, neg_neg] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finrank_rootSpace_neg
statement:
theorem finrank_rootSpace_neg (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (rootSpace P (-μ)) = finrank K (rootSpace P μ)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by have := hB.finrank_rootSpace_le (-μ); rwa [neg_neg] at this)
    (hB.finrank_rootSpace_le μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.dualBasis_mem
statement:
lemma dualBasis_mem (μ : Dual K H) (k : Fin (finrank K (rootSpace P μ))) :
    hB.dualBasis μ k ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.property _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.apply_dualBasis
statement:
lemma apply_dualBasis (μ : Dual K H) (x : rootSpace P μ) (k : Fin (finrank K (rootSpace P μ))) :
    B x (hB.dualBasis μ k) = (rootSpaceBasis P μ).coord k x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun ((hB.pairingEquiv μ).apply_symm_apply ((rootSpaceBasis P μ).coord k)) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.basis_dualBasis
statement:
lemma basis_dualBasis (μ : Dual K H) (j k : Fin (finrank K (rootSpace P μ))) :
    B (rootSpaceBasis P μ j) (hB.dualBasis μ k) = if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [apply_dualBasis, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.sum_smul_basis
statement:
theorem sum_smul_basis (μ : Dual K H) {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) :
    ∑ k, B x (hB.dualBasis μ k) • (rootSpaceBasis P μ k : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) = x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg Subtype.val ((rootSpaceBasis P μ).sum_repr ⟨x, hx⟩)
  rw [Submodule.coe_sum] at this
  change _ = x at this
  conv_rhs => rw [← this]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Submodule.coe_smul, ← Basis.coord_apply, ← hB.apply_dualBasis]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.sum_smul_dualBasis
statement:
theorem sum_smul_dualBasis (μ : Dual K H) {y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)) :
    ∑ k, B (rootSpaceBasis P μ k) y • hB.dualBasis μ k = y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑ k, B (rootSpaceBasis P μ k) y • (hB.pairingEquiv μ).symm
      ((rootSpaceBasis P μ).coord k) = (⟨y, hy⟩ : rootSpace P (-μ)) := by
    apply (hB.pairingEquiv μ).injective
    rw [map_sum]
    simp_rw [map_smul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact (rootSpaceBasis P μ).sum_dual_apply_smul_coord (pairing B μ ⟨y, hy⟩)
  have := congrArg Subtype.val h1
  rwa [Submodule.coe_sum] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_def
statement:
lemma casimirSum_def {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (Φ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra → P.KacMoodyAlgebra → M) (μ : Dual K H) :
    hB.casimirSum Φ μ = ∑ k, Φ (hB.dualBasis μ k) (rootSpaceBasis P μ k)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_eq_zero_of_eq_bot
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ x ∈ rootSpace P μ, x = 0 := by rw [hμ]; simp
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [h0 _ (rootSpaceBasis_mem P μ k), hΦ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    {Φ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra → P.KacMoodyAlgebra → M} {μ : Dual K H}
    (hΦ : hB.casimirSum Φ μ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ y ∈ rootSpace P (-μ), ∃ x ∈ rootSpace P μ, Φ y x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hΦ
  exact ⟨_, hB.dualBasis_mem μ k, _, rootSpaceBasis_mem P μ k, hk⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_lie_left
statement:
theorem casimirSum_lie_left {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    (Ψ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra →ₗ[K] P.KacMoodyAlgebra →ₗ[K] M) {γ : Dual K H}
    {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ Ψ ⁅y, z⁆ x) μ = hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ Ψ y ⁅z, x⁆) (μ - γ)
proof:
:= by
  set b := rootSpaceBasis P μ
  set b' := rootSpaceBasis P (μ - γ)
  have h1 (k) : ⁅hB.dualBasis μ k, z⁆ ∈ rootSpace P (-(μ - γ)) := by
    have := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (hB.dualBasis_mem μ k) hz
    rwa [show -μ + γ = -(μ - γ) by abel] at this
  have h2 (l) : ⁅z, (b' l : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ ∈ rootSpace P μ := by
    have := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hz (rootSpaceBasis_mem P (μ - γ) l)
    rwa [show γ + (μ - γ) = μ by abel] at this
  have hc (k l) : B (b' l) ⁅hB.dualBasis μ k, z⁆ = B ⁅z, b' l⁆ (hB.dualBasis μ k) := by
    rw [hB.lie_left, ← hB.lie_left, hB.symm]
  simp only [casimirSum_def]
  calc ∑ k, Ψ ⁅hB.dualBasis μ k, z⁆ (b k)
      = ∑ k, Ψ (∑ l, B (b' l) ⁅hB.dualBasis μ k, z⁆ • hB.dualBasis (μ - γ) l) (b k) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ by rw [hB.sum_smul_dualBasis (μ - γ) (h1 k)]
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ l, B ⁅z, b' l⁆ (hB.dualBasis μ k) • Ψ (hB.dualBasis (μ - γ) l) (b k) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hc]
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ k, B ⁅z, b' l⁆ (hB.dualBasis μ k) • Ψ (hB.dualBasis (μ - γ) l) (b k) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ l, Ψ (hB.dualBasis (μ - γ) l)
          (∑ k, B ⁅z, b' l⁆ (hB.dualBasis μ k) • (b k : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
    _ = ∑ l, Ψ (hB.dualBasis (μ - γ) l) ⁅z, b' l⁆ :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ by rw [hB.sum_smul_basis μ (h2 l)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_eq_of_basis
statement:
theorem casimirSum_eq_of_basis {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    (Ψ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra →ₗ[K] P.KacMoodyAlgebra →ₗ[K] M) {μ : Dual K H} {κ : Type*}
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (c : Basis κ K (rootSpace P μ)) (c' : κ → P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (hc' : ∀ k, c' k ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)) (hcc' : ∀ j k, B (c j) (c' k) = if j = k then 1 else 0) :
    ∑ k, Ψ (c' k) (c k) = hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ Ψ y x) μ
proof:
:= by
  
  have hx {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) :
      ∑ k, B x (c' k) • (c k : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) = x := by
    have hrepr := congrArg Subtype.val (c.sum_repr ⟨x, hx⟩)
    rw [Submodule.coe_sum] at hrepr
    change _ = x at hrepr
    have hcoef (k : κ) : B x (c' k) = c.repr ⟨x, hx⟩ k := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hrepr]
      simp only [Submodule.coe_smul, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply,
        LinearMap.smul_apply, hcc', smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ by rw [hcoef k, Submodule.coe_smul]).trans hrepr
  
  have hy {y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P (-μ)) :
      ∑ k, B (c k) y • c' k = y := by
    have hmem : ∑ k, B (c k) y • c' k ∈ rootSpace P (-μ) :=
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hc' k)
    have := hB.pairing_injective μ (a₁ := ⟨_, hmem⟩) (a₂ := ⟨y, hy⟩) (c.ext fun j ↦ ?_)
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val this
    simp only [pairing_apply, map_sum, map_smul, hcc', smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  simp only [casimirSum_def]
  calc ∑ k, Ψ (c' k) (c k)
      = ∑ k, Ψ (c' k)
          (∑ l, B (c k) (hB.dualBasis μ l) • (rootSpaceBasis P μ l : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ by rw [hB.sum_smul_basis μ (c k).2]
    _ = ∑ l, Ψ (∑ k, B (c k) (hB.dualBasis μ l) • c' k) (rootSpaceBasis P μ l) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ l, Ψ (hB.dualBasis μ l) (rootSpaceBasis P μ l) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ by rw [hy (hB.dualBasis_mem μ l)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isStandardForm_invForm
statement:
theorem isStandardForm_invForm (S : A.Symmetrization) :
    IsStandardForm P S (invForm P S) where
  isSymm
proof:
:= isSymm_invForm P S
  lieInvariant := lieInvariant_invForm P S
  h_h := invForm_h_h P S
  eq_zero := fun hx hy hμν ↦ invForm_eq_zero P S hx hy hμν
  eq_zero_of_pos := fun _ _ hx hx0 ↦ eq_zero_of_invForm_rootSpace_eq_zero P S hx hx0
  eq_zero_of_neg := fun _ _ hx hx0 ↦
    eq_zero_of_invForm_rootSpace_eq_zero P S hx fun y hy ↦ hx0 y (by rwa [neg_neg] at hy)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.π_surjective
statement: lemma π_surjective : Function.Surjective (π P)
proof: := LieIdeal.mkHom_surjective _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.π_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma π_eq_zero_iff {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra} : π P x = 0 ↔ x ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P
proof:
:=
  LieIdeal.mkHom_eq_zero_iff _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.π_e
statement: @[simp] lemma π_e (i : ι) : π P (AuxLieAlgebra.e P i) = e P i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.π_f
statement: @[simp] lemma π_f (i : ι) : π P (AuxLieAlgebra.f P i) = f P i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.π_h
statement: @[simp] lemma π_h (a : H) : π P (AuxLieAlgebra.h P a) = h P a
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_h
statement: lemma lie_h_h (a b : H) : ⁅h P a, h P b⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_h, ← π_h, ← LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_h, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_e_f
statement: lemma lie_e_f (i j : ι) : ⁅e P i, f P j⁆ = if i = j then h P (P.coroot i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_e, ← π_f, ← LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lie_e_f]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_e_f_self
statement: @[simp] lemma lie_e_f_self (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, f P i⁆ = h P (P.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lie_e_f]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_e_f_of_ne
statement: lemma lie_e_f_of_ne {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : ⁅e P i, f P j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lie_e_f, hij]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_e
statement: lemma lie_h_e (a : H) (i : ι) : ⁅h P a, e P i⁆ = P.root i a • e P i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_h, ← π_e, ← LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_e, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_f
statement: lemma lie_h_f (a : H) (i : ι) : ⁅h P a, f P i⁆ = -(P.root i a • f P i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_h, ← π_f, ← LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_f, map_neg, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.fHom_of
statement: @[simp] lemma fHom_of (i : ι) : fHom P (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i) = f P i
proof: := by simp [fHom]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eHom_of
statement: @[simp] lemma eHom_of (i : ι) : eHom P (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i) = e P i
proof: := by simp [eHom]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_triangular
statement:
lemma exists_triangular (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    ∃ y a z, x = fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  obtain ⟨⟨y, a, z⟩, rfl⟩ := (AuxLieAlgebra.triangularEquiv P).surjective x
  exact ⟨y, a, z, by simp [fHom, eHom, map_add]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.triangular_eq_zero
statement:
theorem triangular_eq_zero {y z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι} {a : H}
    (hyaz : fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z = 0) : fHom P y = 0 ∧ a = 0 ∧ eHom P z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y + AuxLieAlgebra.h P a + AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z ∈
      AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P := by
    rw [← π_eq_zero_iff]; simpa [fHom, eHom, map_add] using hyaz
  have hmem' : AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y + AuxLieAlgebra.h P a + AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z ∈
      (AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P).toSubmodule := hmem
  rw [AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq, Submodule.mem_sup] at hmem'
  obtain ⟨r₁, ⟨hr₁, y', rfl⟩, r₂, ⟨hr₂, z', rfl⟩, hr⟩ := hmem'
  have hr' : AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y' + AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z' =
      AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y + AuxLieAlgebra.h P a + AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z := hr
  have h0 : AuxLieAlgebra.triangularMap P (y - y', a, z - z') =
      AuxLieAlgebra.triangularMap P 0 := by
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.triangularMap_apply, map_zero, map_sub, map_sub]
    have : AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y - AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y' + AuxLieAlgebra.h P a +
        (AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z - AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z') =
        (AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y + AuxLieAlgebra.h P a + AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z) -
          (AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y' + AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z') := by abel
    rw [this, hr', sub_self]
  have hinj := AuxLieAlgebra.triangularMap_injective P h0
  simp only [Prod.mk_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hinj
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hinj
  refine ⟨(π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr hr₁, rfl, (π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr hr₂⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.h_injective
statement: theorem h_injective : Function.Injective (h P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro a ha
  have := triangular_eq_zero P (y := 0) (z := 0) (a := a) (by simp [ha])
  exact this.2.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.π_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma π_mem_rootSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P μ) : π P x ∈ rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  rw [← π_h, ← LieHom.map_lie, hx a, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_eq_map
statement:
theorem rootSpace_eq_map (μ : Dual K H) :
    rootSpace P μ = (AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P μ).map (π P).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
    have htop := AuxLieAlgebra.iSup_rootSpace_eq_top P
    have hx' : (π P).toLinearMap x ∈
        ⨆ ν, (AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P ν).map (π P).toLinearMap := by
      rw [← Submodule.map_iSup]
      refine Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_
      exact (iSup₂_le fun ν _ ↦ le_iSup (fun ν ↦ AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P ν) ν)
        (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
    refine mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P)
      (fun ν ↦ (AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P ν).map (π P).toLinearMap) ?_ hx hx'
    intro ν
    rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact fun y hy ↦ π_mem_rootSpace P hy
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact fun y hy ↦ π_mem_rootSpace P hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_zero
statement: theorem rootSpace_zero : rootSpace P 0 = LinearMap.range (h P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_zero, h, LinearMap.range_comp]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot
statement:
theorem rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot (i : ι) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    rootSpace P (n • P.root i) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot P i hn, Submodule.map_bot]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_root
statement: theorem rootSpace_root (i : ι) : rootSpace P (P.root i) = K ∙ e P i
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_root, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.e_ne_zero
statement: lemma e_ne_zero (i : ι) : e P i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have := lie_e_f_self P i
  rw [he, zero_lie, ← map_zero (h P)] at this
  exact P.linearIndependent_coroot.ne_zero i (h_injective P this).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_root
statement: theorem rootSpace_neg_root (i : ι) : rootSpace P (-P.root i) = K ∙ f P i
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_root, Submodule.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_nsmul_root_eq_bot
statement:
theorem rootSpace_neg_nsmul_root_eq_bot (i : ι) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    rootSpace P (-(n • P.root i)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_nsmul_root_eq_bot P i hn, Submodule.map_bot]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_rootSpace_root
statement: theorem finrank_rootSpace_root (i : ι) : finrank K (rootSpace P (P.root i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_root, finrank_span_singleton (e_ne_zero P i)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.f_ne_zero
statement: lemma f_ne_zero (i : ι) : f P i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hf
  have := lie_e_f_self P i
  rw [hf, lie_zero, ← map_zero (h P)] at this
  exact P.linearIndependent_coroot.ne_zero i (h_injective P this).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_rootSpace_neg_root
statement: theorem finrank_rootSpace_neg_root (i : ι) : finrank K (rootSpace P (-P.root i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_neg_root, finrank_span_singleton (f_ne_zero P i)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finiteDimensional_rootSpace
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_rootSpace {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    FiniteDimensional K (rootSpace P μ)
proof:
:= by
  have := AuxLieAlgebra.finiteDimensional_rootSpace P hμ
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map]
  infer_instance

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finiteDimensional_rootSpace_neg
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_rootSpace_neg {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    FiniteDimensional K (rootSpace P (-μ))
proof:
:= by
  have := AuxLieAlgebra.finiteDimensional_rootSpace_neg P hμ
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map]
  infer_instance

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.iSup_rootSpace_eq_top
statement: theorem iSup_rootSpace_eq_top : ⨆ μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, rootSpace P μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P μ := by
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.iSup_rootSpace_eq_top]; trivial
  have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (π P).toLinearMap) hx
  rw [Submodule.map_iSup] at this
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup] at this
  exact (iSup₂_mono fun μ _ ↦ (rootSpace_eq_map P μ).ge :
    (⨆ μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, (AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P μ).map (π P).toLinearMap) ≤
      ⨆ μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, rootSpace P μ) this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_π (x : P.AuxLieAlgebra) :
    chevalleyInvolution P (π P x) = π P (AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution P x)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_e
statement: @[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_e (i : ι) : chevalleyInvolution P (e P i) = -f P i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_e, chevalleyInvolution_π, AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_e, map_neg, π_f]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_f
statement: @[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_f (i : ι) : chevalleyInvolution P (f P i) = -e P i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_f, chevalleyInvolution_π, AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_f, map_neg, π_e]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_h
statement: @[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_h (a : H) : chevalleyInvolution P (h P a) = -h P a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← π_h, chevalleyInvolution_π, AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_h, map_neg, π_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution
statement:
@[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    chevalleyInvolution P (chevalleyInvolution P x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serre_e
statement:
theorem serre_e {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K _ (e P i) ^ (-A i j).toNat) ⁅e P i, e P j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr (AuxLieAlgebra.serreE_mem_maxIdeal P hA hij)
  rwa [AuxLieAlgebra.serreE, LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serre_f
statement:
theorem serre_f {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K _ (f P i) ^ (-A i j).toNat) ⁅f P i, f P j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr (AuxLieAlgebra.serreF_mem_maxIdeal P hA hij)
  rwa [AuxLieAlgebra.serreF, LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_bilinForm_eq_of_mem_integralPosRootCone
statement:
lemma exists_bilinForm_eq_of_mem_integralPosRootCone (S : A.Symmetrization) {a b : Dual K H}
    (hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (a - b) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (hb : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    {x : Dual K H} (hx : x ∈ P.integralPosRootCone hF.isGeneralizedCartan a) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, q ≤ 0 ∧ P.dualBilinForm S x b = q ∧
      (q = 0 → x ∈ P.orthPosRootCone hF.isGeneralizedCartan b)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨v, i, hv, hint, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab v i).mp hint
    change P.corootPairing _ b v i = n at hn
    have hform : ∀ y : Dual K H, P.dualBilinForm S y ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan y v i / S.ε i := by
      intro y
      rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan S (v⁻¹).2, inv_apply_apply,
        dualBilinForm_root_right]
      rfl
    refine ⟨n / S.ε i, div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hb v i hv n hn)
      (S.ε_pos i).le, ?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [(P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq, hform, hn]
      push_cast
      rfl
    · have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        rw [div_eq_zero_iff] at h0
        exact_mod_cast h0.resolve_right (S.ε_ne_zero i)
      exact AddSubmonoid.subset_closure ⟨v, i, ⟨hv, by rw [hn, hn0, Int.cast_zero]⟩, rfl⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp, fun _ ↦ zero_mem _⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨q₁ + q₂, add_nonpos hq₁ hq₂, ?_,
      fun h0 ↦ add_mem (hx₂ (by linarith)) (hy₂ (by linarith))⟩
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx₁, hy₁]
    push_cast
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply_of_antidominant
statement:
theorem exists_apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply_of_antidominant {a b : Dual K H}
    (hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (a - b) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    (hb : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    {z u x : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hν : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b) (P.coroot i) = n)
    {ν₂ : Dual K H} (hν₂ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, ν₂ (P.coroot i) = n) {c : ι → ℤ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hνc : (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b) - ν₂ = P.rootOf c)
    (h : b + (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν₂ = (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) :
    ∃ g : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan, (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b ∧
      (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a = (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  have hB (k : ι → ℤ) (y : Dual K H) := P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm k y
  have hW (w : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) (y y' : Dual K H) :
      B ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) y) ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) y') = B y y' :=
    P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan S w.2 y y'
  have hBsymm (y y' : Dual K H) : B y y' = B y' y := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq y y'
  have hν₂int : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ν₂ (P.coroot j) = n := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν₂ j
    exact ⟨n, by rw [hn, Int.cast_natCast]⟩
  
  have hstab : ∀ g : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan, (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b →
      g ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a := by
    intro g hg
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup]
    have e : (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a =
        (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b) - (a - b) := by
      rw [map_sub, hg]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hF.isGeneralizedCartan g.2 hab
  have hx : x ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, ← h]
    have e : b + (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν₂ - a =
        ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν₂ - ν₂) - P.rootOf c +
          ((z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b) - (a - b)) := by
      rw [← hνc]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (sub_mem (P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral _ u.2 hν₂int)
      (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice c)) (P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral _ z.2 hab)
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq, -⟩ := exists_bilinForm_eq_of_mem_integralPosRootCone hF S hab hb
    (apply_sub_mem_integralPosRootCone hF ha hx)
  
  choose n2 hn2 using hν₂
  choose nν hnν using hν
  set R₁ : ℤ := ∑ i, c i * d i * ((nν i : ℤ) + n2 i) with hR₁
  have hR₁nonneg : 0 ≤ R₁ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hc i) (hdpos i).le) (by positivity)
  have hR₁eq : B ((z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b)) ((z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b))
      - B ν₂ ν₂ = R₁ := by
    have hsplit : (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b) = ν₂ + P.rootOf c := by
      rw [← hνc]; abel
    calc _ = B (P.rootOf c) ((z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b) + ν₂) := by
          rw [hsplit]
          simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
          rw [hBsymm ν₂ (P.rootOf c)]
          ring
      _ = R₁ := by
          rw [hB, hR₁]
          push_cast
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hnν, hn2]
  have hR₂ : B (a - b) (a - b) - B ((x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - b)
      ((x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - b) = 2 * q := by
    have h1 : B ((x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) ((x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) = B a a :=
      hW x a a
    have h2 := hxq
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h2 ⊢
    rw [hBsymm b a, hBsymm b ((x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a)]
    linear_combination (-1 : K) * h1 + 2 * h2
  have hR : (R₁ : K) = 2 * q := by
    have h3 : (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - b = (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν₂ := by
      rw [← h]; abel
    rw [← hR₁eq, ← hR₂, hW z, h3, hW u]
  have hq0 : q = 0 := by
    have : ((R₁ : ℚ) : K) = ((2 * q : ℚ) : K) := by push_cast; exact hR
    have h' : (R₁ : ℚ) = 2 * q := by exact_mod_cast this
    have : (0 : ℚ) ≤ R₁ := by exact_mod_cast hR₁nonneg
    linarith
  have hBxb : B ((x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a) b = 0 := by
    rw [hxq, hq0, Rat.cast_zero]
  
  have hmem : ∀ g : {g : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan //
      (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b},
      g.1⁻¹ * x ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a :=
    fun g ↦ mul_mem (inv_mem (hstab g.1 g.2)) hx
  choose m hm hmeq using fun g ↦ exists_nonneg_apply_sub_eq_rootOf hF ha (hmem g)
  have : Nonempty {g : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan //
      (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b} := ⟨⟨1, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hgmin⟩ := Finite.exists_min (fun g : {g : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan //
      (g : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b} ↦ ∑ i, m g i)
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ : ∃ c', ((g.1⁻¹ * x : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) :
      Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a = c' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmg : c' - a = P.rootOf (m g) := hc' ▸ hmeq g
  
  have hga : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0 →
        ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧ P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan c' v i = n := by
    intro v i hv hb0
    obtain ⟨na, hna⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab v i).mpr ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hb0⟩
    change P.corootPairing _ a v i = na at hna
    obtain ⟨nd, hnd⟩ := exists_int_corootPairing_of_mem_rootLattice
      (hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan) (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice (m g)) v i
    have hc'pair : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan c' v i = ((na + nd : ℤ) : K) := by
      rw [show c' = a + P.rootOf (m g) by rw [← hmg]; abel, corootPairing_add, hna, hnd]
      push_cast
      rfl
    refine ⟨na + nd, ?_, hc'pair⟩
    by_contra hposn
    push Not at hposn
    set s := P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i with hs
    have hsb : (s : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b := by
      rw [hs, reflectionOf_apply', hb0, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    have hgs : ((g.1 * s : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b =
        b := by
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hsb, g.2]
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hvl⟩ := hv
    have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hvl
      exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hvl
    have hsinv : s⁻¹ = s := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left (reflectionOf_mul_self v i)
    have hcs : (((g.1 * s)⁻¹ * x : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a = (s : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) c' := by
      rw [_root_.mul_inv_rev, hsinv, mul_assoc, ← hc']
      rfl
    have h1 := hmeq ⟨g.1 * s, hgs⟩
    dsimp only at h1
    rw [hcs] at h1
    have hnew : P.rootOf (m ⟨g.1 * s, hgs⟩) = P.rootOf (m g - (na + nd) • l) := by
      rw [← h1, hs, reflectionOf_apply', hc'pair, map_sub, map_zsmul, ← hmg, ← hvl,
        ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
      abel
    have hmnew := P.rootOf_injective hnew
    have hsum : ∑ j, m ⟨g.1 * s, hgs⟩ j = ∑ j, m g j - (na + nd) * ∑ j, l j := by
      rw [hmnew]
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Finset.mul_sum]
    have hlpos : 0 < ∑ j, l j := by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hl0
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_le_of_ne (hl j) (Ne.symm hj))
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ ↦ hl k) (Finset.mem_univ j))
    have hlt := hgmin ⟨g.1 * s, hgs⟩
    have := mul_pos hposn hlpos
    linarith
  
  have hd : c' - a ∈ P.orthPosRootCone hF.isGeneralizedCartan b := by
    obtain ⟨q', -, hq', hq'0⟩ := exists_bilinForm_eq_of_mem_integralPosRootCone hF S hab hb
      (hc' ▸ apply_sub_mem_integralPosRootCone hF ha (hmem g))
    refine hq'0 ?_
    have e1 : B c' b = B ((x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) b := by
      rw [← hW g.1 c' b, g.2, ← hc', Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, apply_inv_apply]
    have e2 : B (c' - a) b = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, e1, ← LinearMap.sub_apply, ← map_sub, hBxb]
    have : ((q' : ℚ) : K) = 0 := hq'.symm.trans e2
    exact_mod_cast this
  
  have hG1 : ∀ v i, (P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0) → ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n ∧
          (n = 0 → P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = 0) := fun v i ⟨hv, hb0⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab v i).mpr ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hb0⟩
    change P.corootPairing _ a v i = n at hn
    exact ⟨n, ha v i hv n hn, hn, fun h0 ↦ by rw [hn, h0, Int.cast_zero]⟩
  have hG2 : ∀ v i, (P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0) → ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan c' v i = n ∧
          (n = 0 → P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan c' v i = 0) := fun v i ⟨hv, hb0⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := hga v i hv hb0
    exact ⟨n, hn, hn', fun h0 ↦ by rw [hn', h0, Int.cast_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, h₁, -⟩ := bilinForm_mem_closure_nonpos S hG1 hd
  obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂, h₂, -⟩ := bilinForm_mem_closure_nonpos S hG2 hd
  have hWc : B c' c' = B a a := by rw [← hc']; exact hW _ a a
  have hsum : ((q₁ + q₂ : ℚ) : K) = 0 := by
    push_cast
    rw [← h₁, ← h₂]
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    rw [hBsymm a c']
    linear_combination hWc
  have hq : q₁ + q₂ = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hq₁0 : q₁ = 0 := by linarith
  have hq₂0 : q₂ = 0 := by linarith
  have hxx : B (c' - a) (c' - a) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub (B (c' - a)), h₁, h₂, hq₁0, hq₂0]
    simp
  have hk0 : m g = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hqd := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    rw [hmg, hB] at hxx
    have hcast : ((m g ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ m g : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← hxx, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct]
      simp only [mulVec_diagonal]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
      ring
    simp only [star_trivial] at hqd
    exact hqd.ne' (by exact_mod_cast hcast)
  have hca : c' = a := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, hmg, hk0, map_zero]
  refine ⟨g.1, g.2, ?_⟩
  calc (g.1 : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a = (g.1 : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) c' := by rw [hca]
    _ = _ := by rw [← hc', Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, apply_inv_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exists_weylDot_eq_of_add_eq_weylDot_of_isAntidominant
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  have hνint : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, ν (P.coroot i) = n := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν i; exact ⟨n, by rw [hn, Int.cast_natCast]⟩
  
  have hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA' (inv_mem hz) hνint
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hνint j
    have e : (lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) = z⁻¹ ν := by
      rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← hzν]
      exact (z.symm_apply_apply _).symm
    refine ⟨n + (A *ᵥ k) j, ?_⟩
    rw [e, hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    ring
  set ν₁ := (w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val ν' with hν₁def
  have hν₁ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) ν₁ ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hν (w⁻¹).property hν'
  have hν₁int : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, ν₁ (P.coroot i) = n := by
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν₁
    intro i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν i
    refine ⟨n - (A *ᵥ k) i, ?_⟩
    rw [hk, LinearMap.sub_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA' hν₁int
  have hν₂ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (u'.val ν₁) ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hν u'.property hν₁
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hck⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν₂
  have hνc : z ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) - u'.val ν₁ = P.rootOf c := by
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hzν, hck]
    abel
  have hu : (u'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val (u'.val ν₁) = ν₁ := by
    change u'.val.symm (u'.val ν₁) = ν₁
    exact u'.val.symm_apply_apply ν₁
  have hwy : y.val (lam + P.rho) = w.val (μ + P.rho) + ν' := by
    have h' := h
    simp only [weylDot] at h'
    rw [sub_add_eq_add_sub, sub_left_inj] at h'
    exact h'.symm
  have hx : (μ + P.rho) + (u'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val (u'.val ν₁) =
      (w⁻¹ * y : P.weylGroup hA').val (lam + P.rho) := by
    rw [hu, hν₁def]
    change μ + P.rho + w.val.symm ν' = w.val.symm (y.val (lam + P.rho))
    rw [hwy, map_add, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  obtain ⟨g, hgb, hga⟩ := exists_apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply_of_antidominant hA hab hlam hμ
    (z := ⟨z, hz⟩) (u := u'⁻¹) (x := w⁻¹ * y)
    (by rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, hzν]; exact hν) hu' hc hνc hx
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [weylDot, hgb, add_sub_cancel_right]
  · simp only [weylDot]
    congr 1
    change y.val (lam + P.rho) = w.val (g.val (lam + P.rho))
    rw [hga]
    change y.val (lam + P.rho) = w.val (w.val.symm (y.val (lam + P.rho)))
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_translation_verma_filtration_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem exists_translation_verma_filtration_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : Fin (n + 1) → LieSubmodule K 𝔤
        (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν))
      (x : Fin n → Dual K H) (S : Set (Fin n)),
      Monotone F ∧ F 0 = ⊥ ∧
      F (Fin.last n) = centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ⊗[K]
        IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam) ∧
      (∀ j ∈ S, Nonempty (VermaModule P (x j) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)))) ∧
      (∀ j ∉ S, (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥) ∧
      Set.BijOn x S {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = μ ∧
          y = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * w') lam}
proof:
:=
  exists_translation_verma_filtration_of_forall hA hν hz hzν w fun _ hν' _ h ↦
    IrreducibleModule.exists_weylDot_eq_of_add_eq_weylDot_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hν hz hzν
      hν' h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.character_translation_verma_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem character_translation_verma_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Dual K H), (T : Set (Dual K H)) = {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = μ ∧
          y = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * w') lam} ∧
      (((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)).tensorProduct
          (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν)).lieSubmodule
          (centralBlock P _ (centralCharacter P lam))).character =
        ∑ y ∈ T, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y).character
proof:
:=
  character_translation_verma_of_forall hA hν hz hzν w fun _ hν' _ h ↦
    IrreducibleModule.exists_weylDot_eq_of_add_eq_weylDot_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hν hz hzν
      hν' h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem exists_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_tensorProduct (hV : IsHDiagonalizable P V)
    (hW : IsHDiagonalizable P W) {ξ : Dual K H} (h : weightSpace P (V ⊗[K] W) ξ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ a, weightSpace P V a ≠ ⊥ ∧ weightSpace P W (ξ - a) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  refine h ?_
  rw [weightSpace_tensorProduct hV hW ξ]
  refine iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun a ↦ LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mpr ?_
  by_cases ha : weightSpace P V a = ⊥
  · have : (weightSpace P V a).subtype = 0 := by
      ext x
      have hx : (x : V) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K V) := ha ▸ x.property
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hx
    rw [this, TensorProduct.map_zero_left]
  · have hb := hne a ha
    have : (weightSpace P W (ξ - a)).subtype = 0 := by
      ext x
      have hx : (x : W) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K W) := hb ▸ x.property
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hx
    rw [this, TensorProduct.map_zero_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsInBlock.sub_mem_rootLattice
statement:
theorem IsInBlock.sub_mem_rootLattice {lam : Dual K H} {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M)
    {a : Dual K H} (ha : weightSpace P M a ≠ ⊥) : a - lam ∈ P.rootLattice
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K (weightSpace P M a) :=
    hM.isCategoryO.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap a
  have hfr : finrank K (weightSpace P M a) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ ha (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp h0)
  rw [hM.isCategoryO.finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum a] at hfr
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ, hM.isCategoryO.multiplicity μ *
      finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) a) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h0
    push Not at h0
    exact hfr (finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero h0)
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hM.multiplicity_ne_zero μ (left_ne_zero_of_mul hμ)
  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero
    (right_ne_zero_of_mul hμ)
  rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot] at hw
  have e : a - lam = (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam) - P.rootOf k := by
    rw [hk]
    abel
  rw [e]
  exact sub_mem hw (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isInBlock_of_centralBlock_eq_top
statement:
theorem isInBlock_of_centralBlock_eq_top {lam : Dual K H} {X : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X] (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (hfg : ∃ s : Finset X, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set X) = ⊤)
    (hχ : centralBlock P X (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤)
    (hwt : ∀ a, weightSpace P X a ≠ ⊥ → a - lam ∈ P.rootLattice) : IsInBlock P hA lam X where
  isCategoryO
proof:
:= hX
  exists_finset := hfg
  multiplicity_ne_zero μ hμ := by
    have hc := hX.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hχ hμ
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwμ⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA lam μ).mp hc.symm
    refine ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot]
      change w (lam + P.rho) - P.rho - lam ∈ P.rootLattice
      rw [hwμ, add_sub_cancel_right]
      exact hwt μ (hX.weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hμ)
    · change μ = w (lam + P.rho) - P.rho
      rw [hwμ, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.nonempty_equiv_of_singleton
proof:
:= by
  generalize hs : ({μ} : Multiset (Dual K H)) = s at h
  cases h with
  | bot => exact absurd hs (Multiset.singleton_ne_zero μ)
  | step h₀ hle e =>
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := (Multiset.singleton_eq_cons_iff _).mp hs
    have hb := IsStdFiltered.eq_bot_of_zero P h₀
    subst hb
    have hinj : Function.Injective (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X)) :=
      (LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot _).mp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker ⊥)
    exact ⟨e.some.trans (LieSubmodule.equivMapOfInjective _ hinj).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpace_sub_weylDot
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_sub_weylDot {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [FiniteDimensional K V] {lam δ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hVc : ∀ b, weightSpace P V b ≠ ⊥ → -b ∈ cone P δ)
    (hδ : finrank K (weightSpace P V (-δ)) = 1) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (ξ : Dual K H) :
    (if centralCharacter P ξ = centralCharacter P lam then
        finrank K (weightSpace P V (ξ - P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w (lam + δ)))
      else 0) = if ξ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hVI := isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (V := V) hA
  have hinv : ∀ (u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) μ,
      finrank K (weightSpace P V ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ)) =
        finrank K (weightSpace P V μ) := fun u μ ↦
    congrArg Cardinal.toNat (rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan hVI u.property μ)
  by_cases hξ : ξ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
  · subst hξ
    have h1 : centralCharacter P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) =
        centralCharacter P lam := centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.property lam
    simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte]
    have e : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam -
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w (lam + δ) = (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (-δ) := by
      simp only [weylDot, map_add, map_neg]
      abel
    rw [e, hinv, hδ]
  simp only [hξ, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [ite_eq_right_iff]
  intro hc
  by_contra h0
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huξ⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA lam ξ).mp hc.symm
  set c := ((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
    (ξ - P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w (lam + δ)) with hcdef
  have hb : weightSpace P V c ≠ ⊥ := fun hbot ↦ h0 (by rw [← hinv w⁻¹, ← hcdef, hbot,
    finrank_bot])
  obtain ⟨k, hk0, hk⟩ := hVc c hb
  set v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan := w⁻¹ * ⟨u, hu⟩
  have e1 : ξ - P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w (lam + δ) =
      u (lam + P.rho) - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + δ + P.rho) := by
    rw [huξ, weylDot, add_right_comm]
    abel
  have hc' : c = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - (lam + δ + P.rho) := by
    rw [hcdef, e1, map_sub, inv_apply_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hc'] at hk
  have hv : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) = lam + P.rho + P.rootOf k := by
    calc (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho)
        = -(-((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - (lam + δ + P.rho))) +
          (lam + δ + P.rho) := by abel
      _ = -(δ - P.rootOf k) + (lam + δ + P.rho) := by rw [hk]
      _ = lam + P.rho + P.rootOf k := by abel
  have hvmem : v ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot, hv,
      show lam + P.rho + P.rootOf k - P.rho - lam = P.rootOf k by abel]
    exact P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k
  obtain ⟨k', hk'0, hk'⟩ := IsDominant.exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf P hA hlam hvmem
  have hvd : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v lam = lam + P.rootOf k := by
    rw [weylDot, hv]
    abel
  have heq : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v lam = lam :=
    eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone ⟨k', hk'0, by rw [← hk']; abel⟩
      ⟨k, hk0, by rw [hvd]; abel⟩
  have hvl : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) = lam + P.rho := by
