    rw [← weylDot_add_rho, heq]
  apply hξ
  rw [weylDot, ← hvl]
  change ξ = (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
    (((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (u (lam + P.rho))) -
      P.rho
  rw [apply_inv_apply, huξ, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsDominant.add_nsmul_rho
statement:
theorem IsDominant.add_nsmul_rho {lam : Dual K H} (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (n : ℕ) : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + (n : K) • P.rho)
proof:
:= by
  intro v i hv m hm
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_int_corootPairing_of_forall_int (hA := hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (c := P.rho) (fun t ↦ ⟨1, by rw [rho_coroot, Int.cast_one]⟩) v i
  have hr1 := one_le_of_corootPairing_rho_eq hA hv hr
  have hsplit : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i =
      ((m - n * r : ℤ) : K) := by
    rw [add_right_comm, corootPairing_add, corootPairing_smul, hr] at hm
    push_cast
    rw [← hm]
    ring
  have h0 := hlam v i hv _ hsplit
  have hnr : (0 : ℤ) ≤ n * r := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (by omega)
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.integralWeylGroup_add_nsmul_rho
statement:
theorem integralWeylGroup_add_nsmul_rho (lam : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) :
    P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + (n : K) • P.rho) =
      P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam
proof:
:=
  P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA.isGeneralizedCartan fun j ↦
    ⟨n, by simp [rho_coroot]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isDominantIntegral_add_nsmul_rho_sub
statement:
theorem exists_isDominantIntegral_add_nsmul_rho_sub (lam : Dual K H) (T : Finset (Dual K H))
    (hT : ∀ ξ ∈ T, ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (lam - ξ) (P.coroot i) = z) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ ξ ∈ T, P.IsDominantIntegral (lam + (n : K) • P.rho - ξ)
proof:
:= by
  choose! z hz using hT
  refine ⟨T.sup fun ξ ↦ ∑ i, (z ξ i).natAbs, fun n hn ξ hξ i ↦ ⟨(z ξ i + n).toNat, ?_⟩⟩
  have hle : (z ξ i).natAbs ≤ n :=
    ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans
      (Finset.le_sup (f := fun ξ ↦ ∑ i, (z ξ i).natAbs) hξ)).trans hn
  have hpos : 0 ≤ z ξ i + n := by omega
  have e : (lam + (n : K) • P.rho - ξ) (P.coroot i) = (lam - ξ) (P.coroot i) + n := by
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, rho_coroot,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  rw [e, hz ξ hξ i]
  have : ((z ξ i + n).toNat : K) = ((z ξ i + n : ℤ) : K) := by
    exact_mod_cast congrArg (Int.cast (R := K)) (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hpos)
  rw [this]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.mapsTo_tensorBlock
statement:
theorem mapsTo_tensorBlock {φ lam : Dual K H} {V : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hV : ∀ b, weightSpace P V b ≠ ⊥ → φ + b - lam ∈ P.rootLattice) :
    (tensorBlock P hA φ V (centralCharacter P lam)).MapsTo lam
proof:
:= by
  intro M _ _ _ _ hM
  have hVO := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V
  have hMV := hM.isCategoryO.tensorProduct hVO
  refine isInBlock_of_centralBlock_eq_top (hMV.lieSubmodule _) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM.exists_finset
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_tensor_eq_top (W := V) hs
    classical
    refine ⟨T.image (rangeRetr ((tensorBlock P hA φ V (centralCharacter P lam)).idem M)), ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.coe_image]
    exact lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective _
      (surjective_rangeRetr ((tensorBlock P hA φ V (centralCharacter P lam)).idem_mul_idem hM)) hT
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro v -
    have hv : (v : M ⊗[K] V) ∈ centralBlock P (M ⊗[K] V) (centralCharacter P lam) := by
      rw [← range_tensorBlock_idem _ hM.isCategoryO]
      exact v.property
    exact mem_centralBlock_of_injective P (LieSubmodule.incl _) Subtype.val_injective _ hv
  · intro a ha
    have ha' : weightSpace P (M ⊗[K] V) a ≠ ⊥ := fun h ↦ ha (weightSpace_lieSubmodule_eq_bot _ h)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hb⟩ := exists_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_tensorProduct
      hM.isCategoryO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top hVO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top ha'
    have := add_mem (hM.sub_mem_rootLattice hc) (hV _ hb)
    convert this using 1
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.nonempty_idem_range_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_idem_range_equiv {M N : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 N] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M) (hN : IsInBlock P hA lam N)
    (e : M ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) : Nonempty ((F.idem M).range ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (F.idem N).range)
proof:
:= by
  set E := LieModuleEquiv.tensorCongr e (LieModuleEquiv.refl (M := V))
  have hE : ∀ x, E x = (e.toLieModuleHom : M →ₗ[K] N).rTensor V x := fun x ↦ by
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul m v =>
      rw [LieModuleEquiv.tensorCongr_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul]
      rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  have hc : ∀ x, E (F.idem M x) = F.idem N (E x) := fun x ↦ by
    rw [hE, hE, F.naturality hM hN]
  have hmap : (F.idem M).range.map E.toLieModuleHom = (F.idem N).range := by
    ext y
    simp only [LieSubmodule.mem_map, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨E x, (hc x).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨F.idem M (E.symm x), ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change E (F.idem M (E.symm x)) = _
      rw [hc, E.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [← hmap]
  exact ⟨LieSubmodule.equivMapOfInjective _ E.injective⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.nonempty_tensorBlock_verma_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_tensorBlock_verma_equiv [FiniteDimensional K V] {μ₀ δ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hVc : ∀ b, weightSpace P V b ≠ ⊥ → -b ∈ cone P δ)
    (hδ : finrank K (weightSpace P V (-δ)) = 1) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      ((tensorBlock P hA μ₀ V (centralCharacter P lam)).idem
        (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w (lam + δ)))).range)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcount⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorBlock_verma (P := P) (hA := hA)
    (lam := μ₀) (V := V) (centralCharacter P lam) (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w (lam + δ))
  have hs1 : s = {P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam} := by
    ext ξ
    rw [hcount ξ, Multiset.count_singleton]
    convert finrank_weightSpace_sub_weylDot (hA := hA) hlam hVc hδ w ξ
  subst hs1
  exact hs.nonempty_equiv_of_singleton

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_verma_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcount⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma P
    (isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (V := V) hA) Λ
  have hY : IsCategoryO P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] V) :=
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P)
      (hA := hA) V)
  have h := finrank_hom_range_eq_add P hY hs (e := LieModuleHom.id)
    (e₁ := F.idem (VermaModule P Λ)) (by ext; rfl) (F.idem_mul_idem hΛ)
    (by ext; rfl) (by ext; rfl) ν
  have hcnt := hs.count_eq_finrank_hom hY ν
  have hmap := Multiset.count_map_eq_count' (Λ + ·) s (add_right_injective Λ) (ν - Λ)
  simp only [add_sub_cancel] at hmap
  rw [hmap, hcount] at hcnt
  have hE : (LieModuleHom.id : VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ _).range ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] V :=
    LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (LieSubmodule.incl _)
      ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun y ↦ ⟨⟨y, y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [finrank_hom_congr_left P hE] at h
  have hle : F.vermaMult (VermaModule P Λ) ν ≤
      finrank K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P ν)) := by
    rw [h]
    exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  exact hle.trans_eq hcnt.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.finite_setOf_vermaMult_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hind := iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := V) (h P)
  have := hind.fintypeNeBotOfFiniteDimensional
  have hfin : {μ | weightSpace P V μ ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    Set.finite_coe_iff.mp (inferInstance : Finite {μ // weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ ≠ ⊥})
  refine (hfin.image (Λ + ·)).subset fun ν hν ↦ ⟨ν - Λ, ?_, add_sub_cancel Λ ν⟩
  intro h0
  have := F.vermaMult_verma_le hΛ ν
  rw [h0, finrank_bot] at this
  exact hν (Nat.le_zero.mp this)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.mono_of_injective
statement:
theorem mono_of_injective {X Y : CategoryO.{u} P} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : Function.Injective f.hom.hom) :
    Mono f
proof:
:=
  have : Mono ((IsObj.{u} P).ι.map f) := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr hf
  (IsObj.{u} P).ι.mono_of_mono_map this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.mono_homMk_of_injective
statement:
theorem mono_homMk_of_injective {X Y : CategoryO.{u} P} (φ : X.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) : Mono ((IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom φ))
proof:
:=
  mono_of_injective _ hφ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isPreserving_id
statement: theorem isPreserving_id : IsPreserving P (𝟭 (CategoryO.{u} P))
proof:
:=
  ⟨inferInstance, fun _ h ↦ h, fun _ h ↦ h⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.IsPreserving.comp
statement:
theorem IsPreserving.comp {F G : CategoryO.{u} P ⥤ CategoryO.{u} P} (hF : IsPreserving P F)
    (hG : IsPreserving P G) : IsPreserving P (F ⋙ G)
proof:
:=
  have := hF.mono
  have := hG.mono
  ⟨inferInstance, fun X h ↦ hG.projective _ (hF.projective X h),
    fun X h ↦ hG.selfDual _ (hF.selfDual X h)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isPreserving_translationFunctor
statement:
theorem isPreserving_translationFunctor {ν : Dual K H} (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν)
    [FiniteDimensional K (IrreducibleModule P ν)]
    (χ₁ χ₂ : Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤) →ₐ[K] K) :
    IsPreserving P (translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂) where
  mono
proof:
:= inferInstance
  projective X hX := by
    have h₁ := isProjectiveO_centralBlock P (hV := X.property.1) hX χ₁
    have h₂ := h₁.tensorProduct P (L := IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional' (P := P) (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)))
    have h₃ := isProjectiveO_centralBlock P
      (hV := (X.property.1.centralBlock P χ₁).tensorProduct (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν))
      h₂ χ₂
    exact h₃.of_equiv (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _)
  selfDual X := by
    rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact ⟨(ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.trans <|
      (centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂ e).trans <|
      (restrictedDualCentralTranslationEquiv P Fact.out hν X.property.1 χ₁ χ₂).symm.trans
      (restrictedDualEquiv P (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_adjunction_mono_wallCrossing
statement:
theorem exists_adjunction_mono_wallCrossing {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hint : ∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, (μ - lam) (P.coroot t) = z)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (F G : CategoryO.{u} P ⥤ CategoryO.{u} P) (_ : F ⊣ G), IsPreserving P F ∧
      ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i →
        ∃ φ : verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
            (w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam) ⟶
          G.obj (verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)), Mono φ
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hint' : ∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, (lam - μ) (P.coroot t) = z := fun t ↦ by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hint t
    exact ⟨-z, by rw [show lam - μ = -(μ - lam) by abel, LinearMap.neg_apply, hz]; push_cast; rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hν⟩ := exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup (P := P) hA' hint'
  obtain ⟨z', hν'⟩ := exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup (P := P) hA' hint
  set ν := z.val (lam - μ)
  set ν' := z'.val (μ - lam)
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν'
  obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hν₁, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual (P := P) hA hν
  obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂, hν₂, ⟨e₂⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual (P := P) hA hν'
  set chiL := centralCharacter P lam
  set chiM := centralCharacter P μ
  let F := translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM ⋙
    translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL
  let G := translationFunctor (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) chiL chiM ⋙
    translationFunctor (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν')) chiM chiL
  have adj : F ⊣ G := (translationAdj (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM).comp
    (translationAdj (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL)
  refine ⟨F, G, adj, (isPreserving_translationFunctor hν' chiL chiM).comp
    (isPreserving_translationFunctor hν chiM chiL), fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
  
  let Xo := (translationFunctor (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) chiL chiM).obj
    (verma P (P.weylDot hA' w lam))
  let eX : Xo.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P (z₁ (-ν))) chiL chiM
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)) :=
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.trans <|
      (centralTranslationEquiv P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) chiL chiM
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam))).symm).trans
      (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)) chiL chiM e₁)
  have hzν₁ : (z₁ * z.val) (μ - lam) = z₁ (-ν) := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, show μ - lam = -(lam - μ) by abel, map_neg]
  have hzν₂ : (z₂ * z'.val) (lam - μ) = z₂ (-ν') := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, show lam - μ = -(μ - lam) by abel, map_neg]
  obtain ⟨f, -, hf, -, -⟩ := wallCrossing_verma_shortExact P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν₂
    (mul_mem hz₂ z'.2) hzν₂ hν₁ (mul_mem hz₁ z.2) hzν₁ hv hμα hwall hlamα hw eX
  let Yo := (translationFunctor (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν')) chiM chiL).obj Xo
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : (verma P (P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v i) lam)).obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      Yo.obj, Function.Injective φ :=
    ⟨(ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).toLieModuleHom.comp <|
      (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P Xo.obj chiM chiL e₂.symm).toLieModuleHom.comp <|
        f.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P _)).symm.toLieModuleHom,
      fun a b hab ↦ (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P _)).symm.injective <| hf <|
        (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P Xo.obj chiM chiL e₂.symm).injective <|
          (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).injective hab⟩
  let φo : verma P (P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v i) lam) ⟶ Yo :=
    (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom φ)
  have hφo : Mono φo :=
    mono_homMk_of_injective (X := verma P (P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v i) lam))
      (Y := Yo) φ hφ
  have hG : G.obj (verma P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)) = Yo := rfl
  rw [hG]
  exact ⟨φo, hφo⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_adjunction_mono_weylDot
statement:
theorem exists_adjunction_mono_weylDot {lam : Dual K H}
    (hreg : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n → n < 0)
    (hwalls : ∀ (u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (j : ι),
      P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan u j →
      P.IsIntegralRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) u j →
      (∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
        P.IsIntegralRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i →
        (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ≠ (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) →
          P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan u j * v) i) →
      ∃ c : Dual K H, (∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, c (P.coroot t) = z) ∧
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho + c) u j = 0 ∧
        ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ m : ℤ,
          P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho + c) v i = m →
          m < 0 ∨ (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) =
            (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j))
    {y : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hy : y ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho)) :
    ∃ (F G : CategoryO.{u} P ⥤ CategoryO.{u} P) (_ : F ⊣ G), IsPreserving P F ∧
      ∃ φ : verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y lam) ⟶ G.obj (verma P lam), Mono φ
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  induction hlen : (P.coxeterSystem hA').length y using Nat.strong_induction_on
    generalizing y with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hy1 : y = 1
  · subst hy1
    refine ⟨𝟭 _, 𝟭 _, Adjunction.id, isPreserving_id, ?_⟩
    rw [weylDot_one]
    exact ⟨𝟙 _, inferInstance⟩
  obtain ⟨u, j, hu, hux, hyu, hsimple⟩ := exists_isPosRoot_reflectionOf_mul hA hreg hy hy1
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcu, hcw⟩ := hwalls u j hu hux hsimple
  set s := P.reflectionOf hA' u j with hsdef
  have hs : s ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' (lam + P.rho) :=
    (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff _ u j).mpr hux
  obtain ⟨F', G', adj', hF', φ', hφ'⟩ :=
    ih _ (hlen ▸ length_mul_reflectionOf_lt hu hyu) (mul_mem hy hs) rfl
  set μ := lam + c with hμdef
  have hμρ : μ + P.rho = lam + P.rho + c := add_right_comm _ _ _
  have hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA' lam := fun v i hv n hn ↦ (hreg v i hv n hn).le
  have hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA' μ := fun v i hv n hn ↦ by
    rw [hμρ] at hn
    rcases hcw v i hv n hn with h | h
    · exact h.le
    rw [corootPairing_eq_of_apply_root_eq hA h, hcu] at hn
    have : (n : K) = 0 := hn.symm
    exact (Int.cast_eq_zero.mp this).le
  have hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
      P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 := fun v i hv h0 ↦ by
    have := hreg v i hv 0 (by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero])
    omega
  have hint : ∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, (μ - lam) (P.coroot t) = z := by
    rw [hμdef, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact hc
  have hμα : P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) u j = 0 := by rw [hμρ]; exact hcu
  have hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') =
          -(u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) := fun v' i' h0 ↦ by
    rw [hμρ] at h0
    rcases P.isPosRoot_or v' i' with hp | hn
    · rcases hcw v' i' hp 0 (by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero]) with h | h
      · omega
      · exact Or.inl h
    · have h0' : P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho + c)
          (v' * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i') i' = ((0 : ℤ) : K) := by
        rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, h0, Int.cast_zero, neg_zero]
      rcases hcw _ _ hn 0 h0' with h | h
      · omega
      · rw [mul_simple_apply_root] at h
        exact Or.inr (by rw [← h, neg_neg])
  have hlamα : P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) u j ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
    have := hreg u j hu 0 (by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero])
    omega
  obtain ⟨Fs, Gs, adjs, hFs, hmono⟩ :=
    exists_adjunction_mono_wallCrossing hA hlam hμ hfacet hint hu hμα hwall hlamα
  have hsimp : (⟨P.reflection hA' j, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' j⟩ :
      P.weylGroup hA') = (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple j :=
    Subtype.ext (by rw [coxeterSystem_simple])
  have hw : P.IsPosRoot hA' (y * s * u) j := by
    have : y * s * u = y * u * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple j := by
      rw [hsdef, reflectionOf, hsimp]
      group
    rw [this]
    exact (P.isPosRoot_or (y * u) j).resolve_left hyu
  have hmono' := hmono (y * s) hw
  rw [mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self, mul_one] at hmono'
  obtain ⟨φs, hφs⟩ := hmono'
  have := adjs.isRightAdjoint
  refine ⟨Fs ⋙ F', G' ⋙ Gs, adjs.comp adj', hFs.comp hF', φs ≫ Gs.map φ', ?_⟩
  exact mono_comp _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_walls
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_walls {lam : Dual K H}
    (hreg : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n → n < 0)
    (hwalls : ∀ (u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (j : ι),
      P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan u j →
      P.IsIntegralRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) u j →
      (∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
        P.IsIntegralRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i →
        (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ≠ (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) →
          P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan u j * v) i) →
      ∃ c : Dual K H, (∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, c (P.coroot t) = z) ∧
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho + c) u j = 0 ∧
        ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ m : ℤ,
          P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho + c) v i = m →
          m < 0 ∨ (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) =
            (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j))
    : Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (ProjectiveCover P hA lam))
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA' lam := fun v i hv n hn ↦ (hreg v i hv n hn).le
  have hreg' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0 :=
    fun v i hv h0 ↦ by
      have := hreg v i hv 0 (by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero])
      omega
  obtain ⟨wl, hwl⟩ := exists_isLongestIntegral hA hlam hreg'
  have hdom : P.IsDominant hA' (P.weylDot hA' wl lam) :=
    isDominant_weylDot_of_isLongestIntegral hA hlam (fun j ↦ ⟨0, by simp⟩) hwl
  have hwlρ : wl ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' (lam + P.rho) := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ (μ' := lam) fun j ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩]
    exact hwl.1
  have hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, (P.weylDot hA' wl lam - lam) (P.coroot j) = z := by
    have e : P.weylDot hA' wl lam - lam =
        (wl : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho) := by
      rw [weylDot]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice hwlρ
  have hinv : wl⁻¹ ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' (P.weylDot hA' wl lam) := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ hint]
    exact inv_mem hwl.1
  have e : P.weylDot hA' wl⁻¹ (P.weylDot hA' wl lam) = lam := by
    rw [← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one]
  have key := VermaModule.exists_injective_weylDot_of_isDominant P hA hdom hinv
  rw [e] at key
  obtain ⟨ι₀, hι₀⟩ := key
  have hex := exists_adjunction_mono_weylDot (P := P) hA hreg hwalls (y := wl) hwlρ
  obtain ⟨F, G, adj, hFp, φ, hφ⟩ := hex
  have heM := VermaModule.nonempty_equiv_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA (μ := lam) hlam
  let eM := heM.some
  let ιl : (verma P lam).obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam)).obj :=
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam))).toLieModuleHom.comp
      (ι₀.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm.toLieModuleHom)
  have hιl : Function.Injective ιl := fun a b hab ↦
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm.injective <| hι₀ <|
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam))).injective hab
  let ιo : verma P lam ⟶ verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam) := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom ιl)
  have hιo : Mono ιo :=
    mono_homMk_of_injective (X := verma P lam) (Y := verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam)) ιl hιl
  let g : F.obj (verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam)) ⟶ verma P lam := (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm φ
  have hg : F.map ιo ≫ g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [← adj.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm] at h0
    have h1 : ιo ≫ φ = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (adj.homEquiv _ _) h0
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
      rw [this, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
      have := adj.isRightAdjoint
      simp
    have hinj := injective_of_mono (ιo ≫ φ)
    rw [h1] at hinj
    have h2 := @hinj ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)) (VermaModule.hwv P lam)) 0
      rfl
    exact VermaModule.hwv_ne_zero P lam
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).injective (h2.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have := hFp.mono
  have hXproj : IsProjectiveO.{u} P (F.obj (verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam))).obj :=
    hFp.projective _ ((VermaModule.isProjectiveO P hA hdom).of_equiv (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _))
  have hS := (F.obj (verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam))).property.2.choose_spec
  have hsd : IsSelfDual P (verma P lam) :=
    ⟨(ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm.trans <| eM.trans <|
      (IrreducibleModule.equivRestrictedDual P lam).trans <| (restrictedDualEquiv P eM).trans
        (restrictedDualEquiv P (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm)⟩
  have heZ := hFp.selfDual _ hsd
  let eZ := heZ.some
  let j := toLieModuleHom (F.map ιo).hom
  have hj : Function.Injective j := injective_of_mono (F.map ιo)
  let f : (F.obj (verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam))).obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam :=
    eM.toLieModuleHom.comp
      ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (toLieModuleHom g.hom))
  have hf : f.comp j ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hg
    ext x
    have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 x
    have h3 : (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm
        (g.hom.hom ((F.map ιo).hom.hom x)) = 0 :=
      eM.injective (this.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    exact (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P lam)).symm.injective (h3.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  exact ProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_selfDual P hA hXproj
    (F.obj (verma P (P.weylDot hA' wl lam))).property.1 hS (F.obj _).property.1 eZ j hj f hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_deep
statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_deep :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 1 ≤ D ∧ ∀ lam : Dual K H,
      (∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n → n ≤ -D) →
      Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        restrictedDual P (ProjectiveCover P hA lam))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hA') := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hA') := Fintype.ofFinite _
  choose D _ hD using fun p : P.weylGroup hA' × ι ↦
    exists_wall_shift (P := P) hA (hA := hA') p.1 p.2
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup D + 1, by omega, fun lam hdeep ↦ ?_⟩
  refine nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_walls hA
    (fun v i hv n hn ↦ by have := hdeep v i hv n hn; omega) fun u j hu hux hsimple ↦ ?_
  refine hD (u, j) (lam + P.rho) (fun v i hv n hn ↦ ?_) hu hux hsimple
  have h1 := hdeep v i hv n hn
  have h2 : D (u, j) ≤ Finset.univ.sup D := Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ _)
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_translation
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_translation {lam lam' ν : Dual K H}
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν)
    (eP : ProjectiveCover P hA lam' ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (ProjectiveCover P hA lam'))
    (eL : IrreducibleModule P lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam') (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P lam')) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (ProjectiveCover P hA lam))
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hPO := ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA lam'
  have hfg := isFGProjectiveO_centralTranslation_projectiveCover P hA hν (centralCharacter P lam)
    (ProjectiveCover.centralBlock_eq_top P hA lam')
  have hS := hfg.fg.choose_spec
  let eZ := ((restrictedDualCentralTranslationEquiv P hA hν hPO (centralCharacter P lam')
      (centralCharacter P lam)).trans (centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P lam') (centralCharacter P lam) eP.symm)).symm
  let f := eL.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (centralTranslationMap P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
    (centralCharacter P lam') (centralCharacter P lam) (ProjectiveCover.π P hA lam'))
  have hfs : Function.Surjective f := eL.symm.surjective.comp
    (centralTranslationMap_surjective P hPO (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _ _
      (ProjectiveCover.surjective_π P hA lam'))
  have hf : f.comp LieModuleHom.id ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hfs (IrreducibleModule.hwv P lam)
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P lam (hx.symm.trans (LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 x))
  exact ProjectiveCover.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_selfDual P hA hfg.isProjectiveO
    hfg.isCategoryO hS hfg.isCategoryO eZ LieModuleHom.id Function.injective_id f hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.upperClosureCondition_sub_natCast_smul_rho
statement:
theorem upperClosureCondition_sub_natCast_smul_rho {lam lam' : Dual K H} {D : ℕ}
    (hlam' : lam' = lam - (D : K) • P.rho) :
    P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      ((1 : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan).val (lam' + P.rho))
      ((1 : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan).val (lam + P.rho))
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  intro v hv i hpos h0
  have hw : P.IsPosRoot hA' ⟨v, hv⟩ i := isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights.2 hpos
  have hmex := exists_int_corootPairing_of_forall_int (P := P) (hA := hA')
    (c := P.rho) (fun t ↦ ⟨1, by rw [rho_coroot, Int.cast_one]⟩) ⟨v, hv⟩ i
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hmex
  have hm1 := one_le_of_corootPairing_rho_eq hA hw hm
  have h0' : P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) ⟨v, hv⟩ i = 0 := h0
  have hp : P.corootPairing hA' (lam' + P.rho) ⟨v, hv⟩ i =
      P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) ⟨v, hv⟩ i - D * P.corootPairing hA' P.rho ⟨v, hv⟩ i := by
    simp only [corootPairing, hlam', map_add, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [h0', hm] at hp
  have hDm : (0 : ℤ) ≤ D * m := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by omega)
  refine ⟨(D * m).toNat, ?_⟩
  have e : (((D * m).toNat : ℕ) : K) = ((D * m : ℤ) : K) := by
    rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hDm]
  change P.corootPairing hA' (lam' + P.rho) ⟨v, hv⟩ i = _
  rw [hp, e]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_isAntidominant
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hex := exists_nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_deep (P := P) hA
  obtain ⟨D, hD1, hdeep⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨lam', hlam'⟩ : ∃ l : Dual K H, l = lam - (D : K) • P.rho := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hνex : ∃ l : Dual K H, l = (D : K) • P.rho := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hνdef⟩ := hνex
  have hpair : ∀ v i, P.corootPairing hA' (lam' + P.rho) v i =
      P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i - D * P.corootPairing hA' P.rho v i := by
    intro v i
    simp only [corootPairing, hlam', map_add, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hdeep' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA' (lam' + P.rho) v i = n → n ≤ -D := by
    intro v i hv n hn
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_int_corootPairing_of_forall_int (P := P) (hA := hA')
      (c := P.rho) (fun t ↦ ⟨1, by rw [rho_coroot, Int.cast_one]⟩) v i
    have hm1 := one_le_of_corootPairing_rho_eq hA hv hm
    have hl : P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i = ((n + D * m : ℤ) : K) := by
      rw [hpair, hm] at hn
      push_cast
      rw [← hn]
      ring
    have := hlam v i hv _ hl
    nlinarith
  have hlam'a : P.IsAntidominant hA' lam' := fun v i hv n hn ↦ by
    have := hdeep' v i hv n hn
    omega
  have heP := hdeep lam' hdeep'
  have eP := heP.some
  have hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν := fun i ↦ ⟨D, by
    rw [hνdef, LinearMap.smul_apply, rho_coroot, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]⟩
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hzν : (1 : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam - lam') = ν := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.coe_one, id, hlam', sub_sub_cancel, hνdef]
  have hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → P.corootPairing hA' (lam' + P.rho) v i = 0 →
      P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 := fun v i hv h0 ↦ by
    have := hdeep' v i hv 0 (by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero])
    omega
  have hC : P.UpperClosureCondition hA' ((1 : P.weylGroup hA').val (lam' + P.rho))
      ((1 : P.weylGroup hA').val (lam + P.rho)) :=
    upperClosureCondition_sub_natCast_smul_rho hA hlam'
  have hT := translation_irreducible_of_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam'a hlam
    hfacet hν (z := 1) (one_mem _) hzν (w := 1) hC
  have hT' : ∀ a b : Dual K H, a = lam → b = lam' →
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P a ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
        (centralCharacter P lam') (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P b)) →
      Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
        (centralCharacter P lam') (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P lam')) := by
    rintro a b rfl rfl h
    exact h
  have hT2 := hT' _ _ (by rw [weylDot_one]) (by rw [weylDot_one]) hT
  exact nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_translation hA hν heP.some hT2.some

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weylDot_eq_of_weylDot_eq
statement:
theorem weylDot_eq_of_weylDot_eq {a b : Dual K H}
    (hf : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (a + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (b + P.rho) v i = 0)
    {x w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (h : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x a = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w a) :
    P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x b = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w b
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a + P.rho) =
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a + P.rho) := sub_left_injective h
  set u := w⁻¹ * x
  have hwu : w * u = x := mul_inv_cancel_left w x
  have hu : (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a + P.rho) = a + P.rho := by
    rw [← hwu, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply] at h1
    exact (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).injective h1
  have hub : (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b + P.rho) = b + P.rho := by
    refine (apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf hA (b + P.rho) _).mpr
      (Subgroup.closure_mono ?_ ((apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf hA
        (a + P.rho) _).mp hu))
    rintro _ ⟨v', i', h0, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨v', i', ?_, rfl⟩
    rcases isPosRoot_or v' i' with hp | hp
    · exact hf v' i' hp h0
    · have := hf _ _ hp (by rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, h0, neg_zero])
      rwa [corootPairing_mul_simple, neg_eq_zero] at this
  simp only [weylDot]
  rw [← hwu, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hub]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_dotOrbit
statement:
theorem mem_dotOrbit {lam η : Dual K H} :
    η ∈ dotOrbit P hA lam ↔ ∃ x, P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = η
proof:
:= by
  simp [dotOrbit]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.facetShift_weylDot
statement:
theorem facetShift_weylDot {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    facetShift P hA lam μ (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) =
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ x, P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam :=
    ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [facetShift, dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true h)]
  exact weylDot_eq_of_weylDot_eq P hA hfacet h.choose_spec

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_translationClassMap
statement:
theorem coeffAt_translationClassMap (lam μ : Dual K H) (c : P.CharacterRing ℤ) (ξ : Dual K H) :
    (translationClassMap P hA lam μ c).coeffAt ξ = ∑ η ∈ dotOrbit P hA lam,
      c.coeffAt η * (CharacterRing.exp P ℤ (facetShift P hA lam μ η)).coeffAt ξ
proof:
:= by
  change HahnSeries.coeff (∑ η ∈ dotOrbit P hA lam, _) _ = _
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sum]
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_translationClassMap_weylDot
statement:
theorem coeffAt_translationClassMap_weylDot {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (c : P.CharacterRing ℤ) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (translationClassMap P hA lam μ c).coeffAt (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) =
      c.coeffAt (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
    w lam) ((mem_dotOrbit P hA).mpr ⟨w, rfl⟩)]
  · rw [facetShift_weylDot P hA hfacet, CharacterRing.coeff_exp_self, mul_one]
  · intro η hη hne
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (mem_dotOrbit P hA).mp hη
    rw [facetShift_weylDot P hA hfacet, CharacterRing.coeff_exp,
      ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _
        (eq_false fun h ↦ hne (weylDot_eq_of_weylDot_eq P hA hfacet' h.symm)),
      mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_translationClassMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeffAt_translationClassMap_eq_zero (lam μ : Dual K H) (c : P.CharacterRing ℤ)
    {ξ : Dual K H} (hξ : ∀ x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ ≠ ξ) :
    (translationClassMap P hA lam μ c).coeffAt ξ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun η hη ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (mem_dotOrbit P hA).mp hη
  rw [facetShift, dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true ⟨x, rfl⟩), CharacterRing.coeff_exp,
    ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (eq_false (hξ _).symm), mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translationClassMap_translationClassMap
statement:
theorem translationClassMap_translationClassMap {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    {c : P.CharacterRing ℤ}
    (hc : ∀ ξ, c.coeffAt ξ ≠ 0 → ∃ x, P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = ξ) :
    translationClassMap P hA μ lam (translationClassMap P hA lam μ c) = c
proof:
:= by
  ext ξ
  by_cases hξ : ∃ x, P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = ξ
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hξ
    rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap_weylDot P hA hfacet' hfacet,
      coeffAt_translationClassMap_weylDot P hA hfacet hfacet']
  · push Not at hξ
    rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap_eq_zero P hA μ lam _ hξ]
    by_contra h
    exact absurd (hc ξ (Ne.symm h)) (not_exists.mpr hξ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases translation_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w with h | h
  · exfalso
    have hχ : centralCharacter P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) =
        centralCharacter P lam := centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.property lam
    have hNχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
        (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ := hχ ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
    have := subsingleton_of_subsingleton_translation_of_sameFacet P hA hμ hlam hfacet' hfacet hν
      hz hzν (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) hNχ h
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  · exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_translation_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem multiplicity_translation_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hVlam : centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (hV.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicity (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) =
      hV.multiplicity (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : ∀ η, P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ - ν ∈ cone P η →
      hV.multiplicity η ≠ 0 → η ∈ dotOrbit P hA lam := by
    intro η _ hη
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA lam η).mp
      (hV.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hVlam hη).symm
    exact (mem_dotOrbit P hA).mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, by simp only [weylDot]; rw [hxe]; abel⟩
  rw [multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_finsetSum P hV (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _
    (fun _ hne ↦ IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hne) _ hs,
    Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
      ((mem_dotOrbit P hA).mpr ⟨w, rfl⟩)]
  · obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet
      hfacet' hν hz hzν w
    rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e,
      IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true rfl), mul_one]
  · intro η hη hne
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (mem_dotOrbit P hA).mp hη
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_irreducible_of_sameFacet_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet
      hfacet' hν hz hzν x
    rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e,
      IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _
        (eq_false fun h ↦ hne (weylDot_eq_of_weylDot_eq P hA hfacet' h.symm)), mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicities_translation_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem multiplicities_translation_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hVlam : centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤) :
    (hV.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)).multiplicities =
      translationClassMap P hA lam μ hV.multiplicities
proof:
:= by
  ext ξ
  by_cases hξ : ∃ x, P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ = ξ
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hξ
    rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap_weylDot P hA hfacet hfacet', IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities,
      IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities,
      multiplicity_translation_of_sameFacet P hA hlam hμ hfacet hfacet' hν hz hzν hV hVlam x]
  · push Not at hξ
    rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap_eq_zero P hA lam μ _ hξ, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities,
      Nat.cast_eq_zero]
    by_contra hne
    have hχ := IsCategoryO.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P _
      (centralBlock_centralTranslation_eq_top P (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)) hne
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA μ ξ).mp hχ.symm
    exact hξ ⟨x, hx⟩ (by simp only [weylDot]; rw [hxe]; abel)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translationClassMap_exp
statement:
theorem translationClassMap_exp {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    translationClassMap P hA lam μ
        (CharacterRing.exp P ℤ (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) =
      CharacterRing.exp P ℤ (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ξ
  by_cases hξ : ∃ x, P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x μ = ξ
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hξ
    rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap_weylDot P hA hfacet hfacet', CharacterRing.coeff_exp,
      CharacterRing.coeff_exp]
    by_cases h : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
    · rw [ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true h),
        ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true (weylDot_eq_of_weylDot_eq P hA hfacet h))]
    · rw [ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (eq_false h), ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _
        (eq_false fun h' ↦ h (weylDot_eq_of_weylDot_eq P hA hfacet' h'))]
  · push Not at hξ
    rw [coeffAt_translationClassMap_eq_zero P hA lam μ _ hξ, CharacterRing.coeff_exp,
      ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (eq_false (hξ w).symm)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translationClassMap_verma
statement:
theorem translationClassMap_verma {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    translationClassMap P hA lam μ (IsCategoryO.multiplicities (P := P)
        (V := VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _)) =
      IsCategoryO.multiplicities (P := P)
        (V := VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ))
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _)
proof:
:= by
  have hχ : centralCharacter P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) =
      centralCharacter P lam := centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.property lam
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ := hχ ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  rw [← multiplicities_translation_of_sameFacet P hA hlam hμ hfacet hfacet' hν hz hzν _ hMχ]
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  ext ξ
  rw [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities,
    IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) _ e]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.apply_dualTranspose
statement:
@[simp] theorem apply_dualTranspose (w : Dual K H →ₗ[K] Dual K H) (φ : Dual K H) (h : H) :
    φ (dualTranspose w h) = w φ h
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x : H, evalEquiv K H x φ = φ x := fun x => rfl
  rw [← key]
  change evalEquiv K H ((evalEquiv K H).symm (w.dualMap (evalEquiv K H h))) φ = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: SymmetricAlgebra.eq_of_forall_dual_apply_eq
statement: theorem eq_of_forall_dual_apply_eq {x y : H} (h : ∀ φ : Dual K H, φ x = φ y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine (forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K (x - y)).mp fun φ => ?_
  rw [map_sub, h, sub_self]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.dualTranspose_id
statement: @[simp] theorem dualTranspose_id : dualTranspose (K := K) (H := H) LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun h => eq_of_forall_dual_apply_eq (K := K) fun φ => by simp

name: SymmetricAlgebra.dualTranspose_comp
statement:
theorem dualTranspose_comp (v w : Dual K H →ₗ[K] Dual K H) :
    dualTranspose (w ∘ₗ v) = dualTranspose v ∘ₗ dualTranspose w
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  apply eq_of_forall_dual_apply_eq (K := K)
  intro φ
  simp

name: SymmetricAlgebra.lift_pullbackDual
statement:
theorem lift_pullbackDual (w : Dual K H →ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a : Dual K H)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra K H) : lift a (pullbackDual w p) = lift (w a) p
proof:
:= by
  have he : (lift a).comp (pullbackDual w) = lift (w a) := by
    apply algHom_ext
    ext h
    simp [pullbackDual]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he p

name: SymmetricAlgebra.pullbackDual_pullbackDual
statement:
theorem pullbackDual_pullbackDual (v w : Dual K H →ₗ[K] Dual K H) (p : SymmetricAlgebra K H) :
    pullbackDual v (pullbackDual w p) = pullbackDual (w ∘ₗ v) p
proof:
:= by
  have he : (pullbackDual v).comp (pullbackDual w) = pullbackDual (w ∘ₗ v) := by
    apply algHom_ext
    ext h
    simp [pullbackDual, dualTranspose_comp]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he p

name: SymmetricAlgebra.pullbackDual_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullbackDual_id (p : SymmetricAlgebra K H) :
    pullbackDual LinearMap.id p = p
proof:
:= by
  have he : pullbackDual (K := K) (H := H) LinearMap.id = AlgHom.id K _ := by
    apply algHom_ext
    ext h
    simp [pullbackDual]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he p

name: SymmetricAlgebra.exists_invariant_separating
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_separating [Infinite K] (G : Subgroup (Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H))
    [Finite G] {a b : Dual K H} (hab : ∀ w ∈ G, w a ≠ b) :
    ∃ f : SymmetricAlgebra K H, (∀ w ∈ G, pullbackDual (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).toLinearMap
      f = f) ∧ lift b f = 0 ∧ lift a f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite G
  
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : H, ∀ w : G, (w.val a - b) h ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hcov : ⋃ w : G, ((LinearMap.ker (w.val a - b) : Subspace K H) : Set H) = Set.univ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      exact hcon x
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Subspace.exists_eq_top_of_iUnion_eq_univ hcov
    apply hab w.val w.property
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    exact LinearMap.ker_eq_top.mp hw
  let g : SymmetricAlgebra K H := ι K H h - algebraMap K _ (b h)
  have hg : ∀ c : Dual K H, lift c g = c h - b h := fun c => by simp [g]
  refine ⟨∏ w : G, pullbackDual w.val.toLinearMap g, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    rw [map_prod]
    simp only [pullbackDual_pullbackDual]
    refine Fintype.prod_equiv (Equiv.mulRight ⟨v, hv⟩) _ _ fun w => ?_
    rfl
  · rw [map_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ 1)
    rw [lift_pullbackDual, hg]
    simp
  · rw [map_prod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
    intro w _
    rw [lift_pullbackDual, hg, ← LinearMap.sub_apply]
    exact hh w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualTranspose_reflection
statement:
theorem dualTranspose_reflection (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    dualTranspose (P.reflection hA i).toLinearMap = (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun h => eq_of_forall_dual_apply_eq (K := K) fun φ => by
    rw [apply_dualTranspose]
    exact P.reflection_apply_apply hA i φ h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.pullbackDual_reflection
statement:
theorem pullbackDual_reflection (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    pullbackDual (P.reflection hA i).toLinearMap =
      affinePullback (P.coreflection hA i).toLinearMap 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackDual, dualTranspose_reflection, affinePullback, LinearMap.comp_zero, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_coreflectionInvariants_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coreflectionInvariants_iff (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (f : SymmetricAlgebra K H) :
    f ∈ coreflectionInvariants P hA ↔
      ∀ w ∈ P.weylGroup hA, pullbackDual (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).toLinearMap f = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_coreflectionInvariants]
  constructor
  · intro hf w hw
    refine P.weylGroup_induction hA (p := fun w =>
      pullbackDual (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).toLinearMap f = f) (by simp) (fun i w ih => ?_) hw
    have he : ((P.reflection hA i * w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)).toLinearMap =
        (P.reflection hA i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ w.toLinearMap := rfl
    rw [he, ← pullbackDual_pullbackDual, pullbackDual_reflection, hf i, ih]
  · intro hf i
    rw [← pullbackDual_reflection]
    exact hf _ (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff
statement:
theorem VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff (Λ Λ' : Dual K H) :
    VermaModule.centralCharacter P Λ = VermaModule.centralCharacter P Λ' ↔
      ∃ w ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, w (Λ + P.rho) = Λ' + P.rho
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hχ
    by_contra hne
    push Not at hne
    have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
    obtain ⟨f, hfinv, hb, ha⟩ := exists_invariant_separating
      (P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) hne
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := exists_shiftedHarishChandra_eq P hA f
      ((mem_coreflectionInvariants P hA.isGeneralizedCartan).mp
        ((mem_coreflectionInvariants_iff P hA.isGeneralizedCartan f).mpr hfinv))
    rw [eval_shiftedHarishChandra, add_sub_cancel_right] at ha hb
    exact ha (by rw [hχ]; exact hb)
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, he⟩
    have h := VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan hw Λ
    rw [he, add_sub_cancel_right] at h
    exact h.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_weyl_of_hom_ne_zero
proof:
:=
  (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA Λ μ).mp
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_of_hom_ne_zero P φ hφ).symm

name: LieAlgebra.ad_neg_pow_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem ad_neg_pow_apply_eq_sum (x y : B) (n : ℕ) :
    (ad K B (-x) ^ n) y =
      ∑ r ∈ range (n + 1), ((-1 : K) ^ r * n.choose r) • (x ^ r * y * x ^ (n - r))
proof:
:= by
  have had : ad K B (-x) = -LinearMap.mulLeft K x + LinearMap.mulRight K x := by
    rw [ad_eq_lmul_left_sub_lmul_right]
    ext z
    simp
  have hc : Commute (-LinearMap.mulLeft K x) (LinearMap.mulRight K x) :=
    (LinearMap.commute_mulLeft_right x x).neg_left
  rw [had, hc.add_pow, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [neg_pow, LinearMap.pow_mulLeft, LinearMap.pow_mulRight, Module.End.mul_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    Module.End.natCast_apply, mul_smul]
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd r with hr | hr <;>
    simp [hr.neg_one_pow, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, mul_assoc, (Nat.cast_commute _ _).eq]

name: Matrix.ad_neg_pow_apply_aux
statement:
private lemma ad_neg_pow_apply_aux (x y : L) (n : ℕ) :
    (ad K L (-x) ^ n) y = (-1 : K) ^ n • (ad K L x ^ n) y
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have e1 : (ad K L (-x) ^ (n + 1)) y = ⁅-x, (ad K L (-x) ^ n) y⁆ := by
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
    have e2 : (ad K L x ^ (n + 1)) y = ⁅x, (ad K L x ^ n) y⁆ := by
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
    rw [e1, e2, ih, neg_lie, lie_smul, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul]

name: Matrix.map_ad_pow_aux
statement:
private lemma map_ad_pow_aux {L' : Type*} [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra K L'] (φ : L →ₗ⁅K⁆ L')
    (x y : L) (n : ℕ) : φ ((ad K L x ^ n) y) = (ad K L' (φ x) ^ n) (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, LieHom.map_lie, ih, pow_succ',
      Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]

name: Matrix.serreAssocElem_eq_ad_neg_pow
statement:
theorem serreAssocElem_eq_ad_neg_pow (i j : ι) :
    serreAssocElem K A i j =
      (ad K _ (-FreeAlgebra.ι K i) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1)) (FreeAlgebra.ι K j)
proof:
:=
  (ad_neg_pow_apply_eq_sum _ _ _).symm

name: Matrix.serreAssocElem_eq_neg_one_pow_smul_ad_pow
statement:
theorem serreAssocElem_eq_neg_one_pow_smul_ad_pow (i j : ι) :
    serreAssocElem K A i j = (-1 : K) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1) •
      (ad K _ (FreeAlgebra.ι K i) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1)) (FreeAlgebra.ι K j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreAssocElem_eq_ad_neg_pow, ad_neg_pow_apply_aux]

name: Matrix.map_serreAssocElem
statement:
theorem map_serreAssocElem {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra K B] (f : FreeAlgebra K ι →ₐ[K] B)
    (i j : ι) : f (serreAssocElem K A i j) =
      (ad K B (-f (FreeAlgebra.ι K i)) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1)) (f (FreeAlgebra.ι K j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ad_neg_pow_apply_eq_sum, serreAssocElem, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, map_mul, map_pow]

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_surjective
statement: lemma mkAlgHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkAlgHom K A)
proof:
:=
  RingQuot.mkAlgHom_surjective K _

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_ι
statement: @[simp] lemma mkAlgHom_ι (i : ι) : mkAlgHom K A (FreeAlgebra.ι K i) = θ K A i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_serreAssocElem
statement:
lemma mkAlgHom_serreAssocElem {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    mkAlgHom K A (serreAssocElem K A i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkAlgHom, RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel K (SerreAssocRel.serre hij), map_zero]

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.sum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_eq_zero {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∑ r ∈ range ((-A i j).toNat + 1 + 1), ((-1 : K) ^ r * ((-A i j).toNat + 1).choose r) •
      (θ K A i ^ r * θ K A j * θ K A i ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1 - r)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mkAlgHom_serreAssocElem hij, serreAssocElem, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, map_mul, map_pow, mkAlgHom_ι]

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.ad_pow_θ
statement:
theorem ad_pow_θ {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K _ (θ K A i) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1)) (θ K A j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mkAlgHom_serreAssocElem (K := K) (A := A) hij
  rw [map_serreAssocElem, mkAlgHom_ι, mkAlgHom_ι, ad_neg_pow_apply_aux] at h
  have := congrArg (fun x ↦ (-1 : K) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1) • x) h
  simpa [smul_smul, ← mul_pow] using this

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {f g : SerreAssocAlgebra K A →ₐ[K] B} (h : ∀ i, f (θ K A i) = g (θ K A i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  RingQuot.ringQuot_ext' K _ _ (FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext h))

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.lift_mkAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mkAlgHom_apply
    (f : {f : FreeAlgebra K ι →ₐ[K] B // ∀ i j, i ≠ j → f (serreAssocElem K A i j) = 0})
    (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) : lift f (mkAlgHom K A x) = f.1 x
proof:
:=
  RingQuot.liftAlgHom_mkAlgHom_apply _ _ _ _

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.lift_θ
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_θ
    (f : {f : FreeAlgebra K ι →ₐ[K] B // ∀ i j, i ≠ j → f (serreAssocElem K A i j) = 0})
    (i : ι) : lift f (θ K A i) = f.1 (FreeAlgebra.ι K i)
proof:
:=
  lift_mkAlgHom_apply f _

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.ker_mkAlgHom
statement: theorem ker_mkAlgHom : TwoSidedIdeal.ker (mkAlgHom K A) = serreAssocIdeal K A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · set J := serreAssocIdeal K A
    let q := RingCon.mkₐ K J.ringCon
    have hq : ∀ v, q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ J := fun v ↦ by
      rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_iff, ← RingCon.eq]
      rfl
    let g := lift ⟨q, fun i j hij ↦ (hq _).mpr (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩)⟩
    have hg : g (mkAlgHom K A x) = q x := lift_mkAlgHom_apply _ x
    rw [← hq, ← hg, (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).mp hx, map_zero]
  · rw [serreAssocIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker, mkAlgHom_serreAssocElem hij]

name: Matrix.SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma mkAlgHom_eq_zero_iff {x : FreeAlgebra K ι} :
    mkAlgHom K A x = 0 ↔ x ∈ serreAssocIdeal K A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_mkAlgHom, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker]

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.mkHom_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma mkHom_eq_zero_iff {x : FreeLieAlgebra K ι} : mkHom K A x = 0 ↔ x ∈ serreLieIdeal K A

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.mkHom_serreLieElem

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.ad_pow_θ
statement:
theorem ad_pow_θ {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K _ (θ K A i) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1)) (θ K A j) = 0

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.lift_mkHom

@[simp] lemma lift_mkHom (f : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ⁅K⁆ L')
    (hf : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → f (serreLieElem K A i j) = 0) (x : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) :

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.lift_θ

@[simp] lemma lift_θ (f : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ⁅K⁆ L')

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {f g : SerreLieAlgebra K A →ₗ⁅K⁆ L'} (h : ∀ i, f (θ K A i) = g (θ K A i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine LieIdeal.lieHom_ext _ fun x ↦ ?_
  have : f.comp (mkHom K A) = g.comp (mkHom K A) := FreeLieAlgebra.hom_ext h

statement:
@[simp] lemma toUniversalEnveloping_θ (i : ι) :
    toUniversalEnveloping K A (θ K A i) =
      UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (SerreLieAlgebra.θ K A i)
