name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dominant_mem_orbitLowerCone
statement:
theorem dominant_mem_orbitLowerCone {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    Λ ∈ orbitLowerCone P hA Λ
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan hΛ w
  exact ⟨k, hk, by rw [← he]; abel⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_orbitLowerCone
statement:
theorem finite_orbitLowerCone (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    (orbitLowerCone P hA Λ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  let : Fintype (P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have key : ∀ μ ∈ orbitLowerCone P hA Λ, ∃ k κ : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧
      k ≤ κ ∧ μ = Λ - P.rootOf k ∧
      P.rootOf κ = Fintype.card (P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) • Λ := by
    intro μ hμ
    choose k hk0 hk using hμ
    refine ⟨k 1, ∑ w, k w, hk0 1,
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun w _ ↦ hk0 w) (Finset.mem_univ 1),
      by simpa using hk 1, ?_⟩
    have hs : ∑ w, P.rootOf (k w) =
        ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, (Λ - w.val μ) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ ↦ by rw [hk w]; abel
    rw [map_sum, hs, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_weylGroup_apply_eq_zero hA,
      sub_zero, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ]
  obtain ⟨_, κ, _, _, _, hκ⟩ := key Λ (dominant_mem_orbitLowerCone P hA hΛ)
  have hf : (Set.univ.pi fun i ↦ Set.Icc (0 : ℤ) (κ i)).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.pi fun _ ↦ Set.finite_Icc _ _
  refine (hf.image fun k ↦ Λ - P.rootOf k).subset ?_
  intro μ hμ
  obtain ⟨k, κ', hk0, hkk, he, hκ'⟩ := key μ hμ
  have : κ' = κ := P.rootOf_injective (hκ'.trans hκ.symm)
  subst κ'
  exact ⟨k, Set.mem_univ_pi.mpr fun i ↦ ⟨hk0 i, hkk i⟩, he.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.orbitCharacter_weyl
statement:
theorem orbitCharacter_weyl {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (μ : Dual K H) :
    orbitCharacter P Λ (w.val μ) = orbitCharacter P Λ μ
proof:
:= by
  have he := IrreducibleModule.isWeylInvariant_character hA.isGeneralizedCartan hΛ
    w.val w.property μ
  simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, Nat.cast_inj] at he
  exact congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → K) he

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.orbitCharacter_mem_cone
statement:
theorem orbitCharacter_mem_cone {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hμ : orbitCharacter P Λ μ ≠ 0) :
    μ ∈ cone P Λ
proof:
:=
  IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero
    (by simpa only [orbitCharacter, Nat.cast_ne_zero] using hμ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.orbitCharacter_support
statement:
theorem orbitCharacter_support {Λ μ ν : Dual K H} (hμ : P.IsDominantIntegral μ)
    (hm : μ ∈ cone P Λ) (hν : orbitCharacter P μ ν ≠ 0) :
    ν ∈ orbitLowerCone P hA Λ
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  exact mem_cone_trans (orbitCharacter_mem_cone P
    (by rwa [orbitCharacter_weyl P hA hμ w])) hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.integral_of_mem_cone
statement:
theorem integral_of_mem_cone {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    (hμ : μ ∈ cone P Λ) : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, μ (P.coroot i) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := hμ
  intro i
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
  refine ⟨(n : ℤ) - (A *ᵥ k) i, ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, hn, P.rootOf_apply_coroot, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_natCast]

name: FiniteDominance.independent
statement:
theorem independent (m : J → J → K) (hd : ∀ i, m i i = 1)
    (ht : ∀ i j, m i j ≠ 0 → i ≤ j) : LinearIndependent K m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite J
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro c hc
  have hh : ∀ j, c j = 0 := by
    intro j
    induction j using (Finite.wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl
      (fun a b : J ↦ a < b)).induction with
    | h j ih =>
      have he := congrFun hc j
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at he
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j] at he
      · simpa only [hd, mul_one] using he
      · intro i _ hij
        by_cases hm : m i j = 0
        · simp [hm]
        · rw [ih i (lt_of_le_of_ne (ht i j hm) hij), zero_mul]
      · simp
  exact hh

name: FiniteDominance.exists_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_coefficients {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (m : J → J → R) (hd : ∀ i, m i i = 1)
    (ht : ∀ i j, m i j ≠ 0 → i ≤ j) (f : J → R) :
    ∃ c : J → R, ∀ j, f j = ∑ i, c i * m i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U := Submodule.span R (Set.range m)
  have hsingle : ∀ i, Pi.single i (1 : R) ∈ U := by
    intro i
    induction i using (Finite.wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl
      (fun a b : J ↦ b < a)).induction with
    | h i ih =>
      have he : Pi.single i (1 : R) = m i -
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, m i j • Pi.single j (1 : R) := by
        ext j
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst j
          rw [Pi.single_eq_same, hd]
          have hz : (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
              m i x * (Pi.single x (1 : R) : J → R) i) = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro x hx
            simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx).symm]
          simp only [smul_eq_mul, hz, sub_zero]
        · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
          · simp
          · intro x _ hxj
            simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hxj.symm]
          · simp [Ne.symm hij]
      rw [he]
      apply U.sub_mem (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i))
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro j hj
      by_cases hm : m i j = 0
      · simp [hm]
      · exact U.smul_mem _ (ih j (lt_of_le_of_ne (ht i j hm)
          (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm))
  have hf : f ∈ U := by
    have he : f = ∑ i, f i • Pi.single i (1 : R) := by
      ext j
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
    rw [he]
    exact U.sum_mem fun i _ ↦ U.smul_mem _ (hsingle i)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun R).mp hf
  exact ⟨c, fun j ↦ by simpa using (congrFun hc j).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_distinctWeylOrbit
statement:
theorem mem_distinctWeylOrbit (Λ ν : Dual K H) :
    ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ ↔
      ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, w.val Λ = ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [distinctWeylOrbit]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_distinctWeylOrbit_weyl
statement:
theorem mem_distinctWeylOrbit_weyl (Λ ν : Dual K H)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    w.val ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ ↔ ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_distinctWeylOrbit, mem_distinctWeylOrbit]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    exact ⟨w⁻¹ * v, by change w.val.symm (v.val Λ) = ν; rw [hv]; simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w * v, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.distinctWeylOrbit_subset
statement:
theorem distinctWeylOrbit_subset {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    ↑(distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ) ⊆ orbitLowerCone P hA Λ
proof:
:= by
  intro ν hν
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (mem_distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ ν).mp hν
  intro w
  exact dominant_mem_orbitLowerCone P hA hΛ (w * v)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_dominantBelow
statement:
theorem finite_dominantBelow (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    {μ | P.IsDominantIntegral μ ∧ μ ∈ cone P Λ}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (finite_orbitLowerCone P hA Λ hΛ).subset ?_
  intro μ hμ w
  exact mem_cone_trans (dominant_mem_orbitLowerCone P hA hμ.1 w) hμ.2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_dominant_mem_distinctWeylOrbit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (mem_distinctWeylOrbit P hA μ ν).mp hm
  exact P.apply_eq_self_of_dominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan hμ w.property hν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.character_eq_sum_distinctOrbit
statement:
theorem character_eq_sum_distinctOrbit (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    (ν : Dual K H) :
    orbitCharacter P Λ ν =
      ∑ μ ∈ (finite_dominantBelow P hA Λ hΛ).toFinset,
        orbitCharacter P Λ μ * (if ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA μ then (1 : K) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  by_cases hn : ν ∈ orbitLowerCone P hA Λ
  · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (integral_of_mem_cone P hΛ (by simpa using hn 1))
    have hm : w.val ν ∈ (finite_dominantBelow P hA Λ hΛ).toFinset := by
      simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      exact ⟨hw, hn w⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (w.val ν)]
    · have ho : ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA (w.val ν) :=
        (mem_distinctWeylOrbit P hA _ _).mpr ⟨w⁻¹, by simp⟩
      simp only [ho, ite_true, mul_one, orbitCharacter_weyl P hA hΛ w ν]
    · intro μ hμ hne
      have hμ' := (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hμ
      have ho : ν ∉ distinctWeylOrbit P hA μ := by
        intro ho
        have he := eq_of_dominant_mem_distinctWeylOrbit P hA hμ'.1 hw
          ((mem_distinctWeylOrbit_weyl P hA μ ν w).mpr ho)
        exact hne he.symm
      simp [ho]
    · exact fun hnot ↦ (hnot hm).elim
  · have hz : orbitCharacter P Λ ν = 0 := by
      by_contra hz
      exact hn (orbitCharacter_support P hA hΛ (mem_cone_self Λ) hz)
    rw [hz]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro μ hμ
    have hμ' := (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hμ
    have ho : ν ∉ distinctWeylOrbit P hA μ := by
      intro ho
      exact hn (fun w ↦ mem_cone_trans (distinctWeylOrbit_subset P hA hμ'.1 ho w) hμ'.2)
    simp [ho]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.orbitCharacter_self
statement: theorem orbitCharacter_self (Λ : Dual K H) : orbitCharacter P Λ Λ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [orbitCharacter, IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.orbitCharacter_strict
statement:
theorem orbitCharacter_strict {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hne : μ ≠ Λ)
    (hm : orbitCharacter P Λ μ ≠ 0) :
    WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P Λ < WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P μ
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne
  · exact (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
      (orbitCharacter_mem_cone P hm)
  · exact fun he ↦ hne ((WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P).injective he).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_distinctOrbit_character_inversion
statement:
theorem exists_distinctOrbit_character_inversion (Λ : Dual K H)
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Dual K H)) (c : Dual K H → ℤ),
      (∀ μ ∈ S, P.IsDominantIntegral μ ∧ μ ∈ cone P Λ) ∧
      ∀ ν, (if ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ then (1 : K) else 0) =
        ∑ μ ∈ S, (c μ : K) * orbitCharacter P μ ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  let D := {μ : Dual K H // P.IsDominantIntegral μ ∧ μ ∈ cone P Λ}
  have : Finite D := finite_dominantBelow P hA Λ hΛ
  let : Fintype D := Fintype.ofFinite D
  let : PartialOrder D := PartialOrder.lift
    (fun μ ↦ WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P μ.val)
    (fun _ _ he ↦ Subtype.ext ((WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P).injective he))
  obtain ⟨c, hcZ⟩ := FiniteDominance.exists_coefficients
    (fun μ ν : D ↦ (finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ.val) ν.val) : ℤ))
    (fun μ ↦ by simp [IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self])
    (fun μ ν hn ↦
      (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
        (IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hn)))
    (fun ν : D ↦ if ν.val ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
  have hc (ν : D) : (if ν.val ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ then (1 : K) else 0) =
      ∑ μ : D, (c μ : K) * orbitCharacter P μ.val ν.val := by
    have he := congrArg (Int.cast : ℤ → K) (hcZ ν)
    simpa only [Int.cast_ite, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_zero, Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_mul,
      Int.cast_natCast, orbitCharacter] using he
  let S := (finite_dominantBelow P hA Λ hΛ).toFinset
  let c' : Dual K H → ℤ := fun μ ↦ if hm : μ ∈ S then c ⟨μ, by simpa [S] using hm⟩ else 0
  have hs (ν : Dual K H) :
      (∑ μ ∈ S, (c' μ : K) * orbitCharacter P μ ν) =
        ∑ μ : D, (c μ : K) * orbitCharacter P μ.val ν := by
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_bij (fun μ _ ↦ μ.val)
    · intro μ _
      simp [S]
    · intro μ _ μ' _ he
      exact Subtype.ext he
    · intro μ hm
      exact ⟨⟨μ, by simpa [S] using hm⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    · intro μ _
      simp only [c', show μ.val ∈ S by simp [S], dite_true]
      rfl
  refine ⟨S, c', fun μ hm ↦ by simpa [S] using hm, fun ν ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hs]
  by_cases hn : ν ∈ orbitLowerCone P hA Λ
  · have hi : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, ν (P.coroot i) = z :=
      integral_of_mem_cone P hΛ (by simpa using hn 1)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan hi
    have he := hc ⟨w.val ν, hw, hn w⟩
    simp only [mem_distinctWeylOrbit_weyl P hA Λ ν w] at he
    exact he.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦
      congrArg ((c μ : K) * ·) (orbitCharacter_weyl P hA μ.property.1 w ν))
  · have ho : ν ∉ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ :=
      fun hv ↦ hn (distinctWeylOrbit_subset P hA hΛ hv)
    rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun hv ↦ (ho hv).elim]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro μ _
    have hz : orbitCharacter P μ.val ν = 0 := by
      by_contra hz
      exact hn (orbitCharacter_support P hA μ.property.1 μ.property.2 hz)
    rw [hz, mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_normalized_distinctOrbit_character_inversion
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_distinctOrbit_character_inversion (Λ : Dual K H)
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Dual K H)) (c : Dual K H → ℤ),
      Λ ∈ S ∧ c Λ = 1 ∧
      (∀ μ ∈ S, P.IsDominantIntegral μ ∧ μ ∈ cone P Λ) ∧
      (∀ μ ∈ S, μ ≠ Λ →
        WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P Λ < WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P μ) ∧
      ∀ ν, (if ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ then (1 : K) else 0) =
        ∑ μ ∈ S, (c μ : K) * orbitCharacter P μ ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, c, hS, hc⟩ := exists_distinctOrbit_character_inversion P hA Λ hΛ
  have hz (μ : Dual K H) (hm : μ ∈ S) (hne : μ ≠ Λ) :
      orbitCharacter P μ Λ = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hle := (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
      (hS μ hm).2
    have hle' := (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
      (orbitCharacter_mem_cone P hn)
    exact hne ((WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P).injective (le_antisymm hle' hle))
  have ho : Λ ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ :=
    (mem_distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ Λ).mpr ⟨1, rfl⟩
  have he := hc Λ
  simp only [ho, ite_true] at he
  have hmem : Λ ∈ S := by
    by_contra hn
    have hzero : (∑ μ ∈ S, (c μ : K) * orbitCharacter P μ Λ) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun μ hm ↦ by rw [hz μ hm (fun heq ↦ hn (heq ▸ hm)), mul_zero]
    exact one_ne_zero (he.trans hzero)
  have hcΛ : c Λ = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single Λ] at he
    · rw [orbitCharacter_self, mul_one] at he
      exact_mod_cast he.symm
    · intro μ hm hne
      rw [hz μ hm hne, mul_zero]
    · exact fun hn ↦ (hn hmem).elim
  refine ⟨S, c, hmem, hcΛ, hS, ?_, hc⟩
  intro μ hm hne
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne
  · exact (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr (hS μ hm).2
  · exact fun heq ↦ hne ((WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P).injective heq).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.characterPower_eq_sum
statement:
theorem characterPower_eq_sum {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    (hμ : P.IsDominantIntegral μ) (hm : μ ∈ cone P Λ) (n : ℕ) :
    characterPower P μ n = ∑ ν ∈ (finite_orbitLowerCone P hA Λ hΛ).toFinset,
      orbitCharacter P μ ν • SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) ν ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
  intro ν hν
  apply (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr
  apply orbitCharacter_support P hA hμ hm
  intro hz
  simp [Function.mem_support, hz] at hν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_distinctOrbitPower_inversion
statement:
theorem exists_distinctOrbitPower_inversion (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Dual K H)) (c : Dual K H → ℤ),
      (∀ μ ∈ S, P.IsDominantIntegral μ ∧ μ ∈ cone P Λ) ∧
      ∀ n, distinctOrbitPower P hA Λ n = ∑ μ ∈ S, (c μ : K) • characterPower P μ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, c, hS, hc⟩ := exists_distinctOrbit_character_inversion P hA Λ hΛ
  refine ⟨S, c, hS, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  let F := (finite_orbitLowerCone P hA Λ hΛ).toFinset
  have ho : distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ ⊆ F := fun ν hν ↦
    (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr (distinctWeylOrbit_subset P hA hΛ hν)
  have he : distinctOrbitPower P hA Λ n = ∑ ν ∈ F,
      (if ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ then (1 : K) else 0) •
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) ν ^ n := by
    rw [distinctOrbitPower]
    calc
      _ = ∑ ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ,
          (if ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ then (1 : K) else 0) •
            SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) ν ^ n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro ν hν
        simp [hν]
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_subset ho (fun ν _ hn ↦ by simp [hn])
  rw [he]
  simp_rw [hc, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro μ hm
  rw [characterPower_eq_sum P hA hΛ (hS μ hm).1 (hS μ hm).2, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ν _
  exact mul_smul _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_distinctOrbitPower_extension
statement:
theorem exists_distinctOrbitPower_extension (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ F : SymmetricAlgebra K (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra),
      F ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n ∧
      (∀ x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra,
        SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieModule.toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
          (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) x) F = 0) ∧
      coordinateCartanRestriction P F = distinctOrbitPower P hA Λ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, c, hS, hc⟩ := exists_distinctOrbitPower_inversion P hA Λ hΛ
  have he : ∀ μ : {μ // μ ∈ S},
      ∃ F : SymmetricAlgebra K (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra),
        F ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n ∧
        (∀ x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra,
          SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieModule.toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
            (Dual K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) x) F = 0) ∧
        coordinateCartanRestriction P F = characterPower P μ.val n := fun μ ↦
    exists_dominant_tracePower_extension P hA μ.val (hS μ.val μ.property).1 n
  choose F hF using he
  refine ⟨∑ μ : {μ // μ ∈ S}, (c μ.val : K) • F μ,
    Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun μ _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hF μ).1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    simp only [map_sum, Derivation.map_smul, (hF _).2.1 x, smul_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · simp only [map_sum, map_smul, (hF _).2.2]
    rw [hc n]
    exact Finset.sum_coe_sort S (fun μ ↦ (c μ : K) • characterPower P μ n)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.orbit_fiber_card
statement:
theorem orbit_fiber_card (Λ ν : Dual K H) (hν : ν ∈ distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ) :
    Nat.card {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan // w.val Λ = ν} =
      orbitStabilizerCard P hA Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (mem_distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ ν).mp hν
  apply Nat.card_congr
  refine
    { toFun := fun w ↦ ⟨v⁻¹ * w.val, ?_⟩
      invFun := fun w ↦ ⟨v * w.val, ?_⟩
      left_inv := fun w ↦ Subtype.ext (by simp)
      right_inv := fun w ↦ Subtype.ext (by simp) }
  · change v.val.symm (w.val.val Λ) = Λ
    rw [w.property]
    simp
  · change v.val (w.val.val Λ) = v.val Λ
    rw [w.property]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.fullWeylPower_eq_stabilizer_smul
statement:
theorem fullWeylPower_eq_stabilizer_smul
    [Fintype (P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)] (Λ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) (w.val Λ) ^ n) =
        (orbitStabilizerCard P hA Λ : K) • distinctOrbitPower P hA Λ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [distinctOrbitPower, Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to' (fun w (_ : w ∈ Finset.univ) ↦
    (mem_distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ _).mpr ⟨w, rfl⟩)
    (fun ν ↦ SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H) ν ^ n)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ν hν
  have hf : (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan ↦ w.val Λ = ν)).card =
      orbitStabilizerCard P hA Λ := by
    rw [← Fintype.card_subtype, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact orbit_fiber_card P hA Λ ν hν
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, hf, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.distinctOrbitPower_zero
statement:
theorem distinctOrbitPower_zero (Λ : Dual K H) :
    distinctOrbitPower P hA Λ 0 = (distinctWeylOrbit P hA Λ).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [distinctOrbitPower]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.distinctOrbitPower_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem distinctOrbitPower_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty ι] (Λ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) :
    distinctOrbitPower P hA Λ n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hspan := P.linearIndependent_coroot.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank'
    (P.finrank_eq_card_of_isFiniteCartan hA).symm
  have hΛ : Λ = 0 := LinearMap.ext_on_range hspan fun i ↦ isEmptyElim i
  subst Λ
  have ho : distinctWeylOrbit P hA (0 : Dual K H) = {0} := by
    ext ν
    rw [mem_distinctWeylOrbit]
    simp [eq_comm]
  simp [distinctOrbitPower, ho, zero_pow_eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.DvdXPow.zero
statement: lemma zero (i : ℕ) : DvdXPow K i (fun _ ↦ 0)
proof: := ⟨0, fun t ↦ by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.DvdXPow.add
statement: lemma add (hf : DvdXPow K i f) (hg : DvdXPow K i g) : DvdXPow K i (fun t ↦ f t + g t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨p + q, fun t ↦ by simp [hp, hq, mul_add]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.DvdXPow.const_mul
statement: lemma const_mul (c : K) (hf : DvdXPow K i f) : DvdXPow K i (fun t ↦ c * f t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨C c * p, fun t ↦ by simp [hp]; ring⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.DvdXPow.pow_mul
statement: lemma pow_mul (n : ℕ) (hf : DvdXPow K i f) : DvdXPow K i (fun t ↦ t ^ n * f t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨X ^ n * p, fun t ↦ by simp [hp]; ring⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.DvdXPow.of_succ
statement: lemma of_succ (hf : DvdXPow K (i + 1) f) : DvdXPow K i f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨X * p, fun t ↦ by simp [hp]; ring⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.DvdXPow.eval_zero
statement: lemma eval_zero (hf : DvdXPow K (i + 1) f) : f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  simp [hp]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.DvdXPow.sum
statement:
lemma sum {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) {f : κ → K → K} (hf : ∀ k ∈ s, DvdXPow K i (f k)) :
    DvdXPow K i (fun t ↦ ∑ k ∈ s, f k t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using zero (K := K) i
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add (ih fun k hk ↦ hf k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_eval_eq_evalPoly
statement:
lemma exists_eval_eq_evalPoly (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H) (p : MvPolynomial (PolyIdx K H) K) :
    ∃ q : K[X], ∀ t : K, q.eval t = evalPoly K H p (Λ₀ + t • δ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ C (Λ₀ (Module.Free.chooseBasis K H j)) +
    C (δ (Module.Free.chooseBasis K H j)) * X) p, fun t ↦ ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ p) (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval (R := K)
    (f := fun j ↦ C (Λ₀ (Module.Free.chooseBasis K H j)) +
      C (δ (Module.Free.chooseBasis K H j)) * X) (Polynomial.aeval t))
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply] at this
  rw [← coe_aeval_eq_eval, this, evalPoly_apply]
  refine congrArg (fun g ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval g p) (funext fun j ↦ ?_)
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply,
    LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_eval_eq_of_mem_polyFun
statement:
lemma exists_eval_eq_of_mem_polyFun (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H) {F : Dual K H → K}
    (hF : F ∈ polyFun K H) : ∃ q : K[X], ∀ t : K, q.eval t = F (Λ₀ + t • δ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hF
  exact exists_eval_eq_evalPoly Λ₀ δ p

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.zero_mem_lineFam
statement: lemma zero_mem_lineFam : (fun _ : K ↦ (0 : 𝒰⁻)) ∈ lineFam P
proof: := (lineFam P).zero_mem

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.add_mem_lineFam
statement:
lemma add_mem_lineFam {f g : K → 𝒰⁻} (hf : f ∈ lineFam P) (hg : g ∈ lineFam P) :
    (fun t ↦ f t + g t) ∈ lineFam P
proof: := (lineFam P).add_mem hf hg

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.const_smul_mem_lineFam
statement:
lemma const_smul_mem_lineFam (a : K) {f : K → 𝒰⁻} (hf : f ∈ lineFam P) :
    (fun t ↦ a • f t) ∈ lineFam P
proof: := (lineFam P).smul_mem a hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pow_smul_mem_lineFam
statement: lemma pow_smul_mem_lineFam (n : ℕ) (u : 𝒰⁻) : (fun t : K ↦ t ^ n • u) ∈ lineFam P
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨n, u, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.const_mem_lineFam
statement: lemma const_mem_lineFam (u : 𝒰⁻) : (fun _ : K ↦ u) ∈ lineFam P
proof:
:= by
  simpa using pow_smul_mem_lineFam (P := P) 0 u

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.polyEval_smul_mem_lineFam
statement:
lemma polyEval_smul_mem_lineFam (q : K[X]) (u : 𝒰⁻) :
    (fun t : K ↦ q.eval t • u) ∈ lineFam P
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun t : K ↦ q.eval t • u) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (q.natDegree + 1), q.coeff n • fun t : K ↦ t ^ n • u := by
    ext t
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_smul]
    rw [eval_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_smul_mem_lineFam n u)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lineFam_of_mem_polyFam
statement:
lemma lineFam_of_mem_polyFam (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H) {F : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (hF : F ∈ polyFam P) :
    (fun t : K ↦ F (Λ₀ + t • δ)) ∈ lineFam P
proof:
:= by
  induction hF using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem F hF =>
    obtain ⟨p, u, rfl⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_eval_eq_evalPoly Λ₀ δ p
    simp_rw [← hq]
    exact polyEval_smul_mem_lineFam q u
  | zero => exact (lineFam P).zero_mem
  | add F G _ _ hF hG => exact (lineFam P).add_mem hF hG
  | smul a F _ hF => exact (lineFam P).smul_mem a hF

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pow_smul_mem_lineFam'
statement:
lemma pow_smul_mem_lineFam' (n : ℕ) {f : K → 𝒰⁻} (hf : f ∈ lineFam P) :
    (fun t ↦ t ^ n • f t) ∈ lineFam P
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨k, u, rfl⟩ := hf
    simpa [smul_smul, ← pow_add] using pow_smul_mem_lineFam (P := P) (n + k) u
  | zero => simpa using zero_mem_lineFam
  | add f g _ _ hf hg => simpa [smul_add] using add_mem_lineFam hf hg
  | smul a f _ hf => simpa [smul_comm (_ ^ n) a] using const_smul_mem_lineFam a hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.actEnv_mem_lineFam
statement:
lemma actEnv_mem_lineFam (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) {f : K → 𝒰⁻}
    (hf : f ∈ lineFam P) : (fun t ↦ actEnv P (Λ₀ + t • δ) x (f t)) ∈ lineFam P
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨n, u, rfl⟩ := hf
    simp only [map_smul]
    exact pow_smul_mem_lineFam' n
      (lineFam_of_mem_polyFam Λ₀ δ (actEnv_mem_polyFam x (const_mem_polyFam u)))
  | zero => simpa using zero_mem_lineFam
  | add f g _ _ hf hg => simpa using add_mem_lineFam hf hg
  | smul a f _ hf => simpa using const_smul_mem_lineFam a hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_add_left
statement:
lemma pairAt_add_left (Λ : Dual K H) (u u' w : 𝒰⁻) :
    pairAt P Λ (u + u') w = pairAt P Λ u w + pairAt P Λ u' w
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairAt, add_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_smul_left
statement:
lemma pairAt_smul_left (Λ : Dual K H) (c : K) (u w : 𝒰⁻) :
    pairAt P Λ (c • u) w = c * pairAt P Λ u w
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairAt]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_add_right
statement:
lemma pairAt_add_right (Λ : Dual K H) (u w w' : 𝒰⁻) :
    pairAt P Λ u (w + w') = pairAt P Λ u w + pairAt P Λ u w'
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairAt, add_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_smul_right
statement:
lemma pairAt_smul_right (Λ : Dual K H) (c : K) (u w : 𝒰⁻) :
    pairAt P Λ u (c • w) = c * pairAt P Λ u w
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairAt]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_actEnv
statement:
lemma pairAt_actEnv (Λ : Dual K H) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (u w : 𝒰⁻) :
    pairAt P Λ (actEnv P Λ x u) w = pairAt P Λ u (actEnv P Λ (transpose P x) w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairAt, equivEnvNNeg_actEnv, contravariantForm_lie_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_eval_eq_pairAt
statement:
lemma exists_eval_eq_pairAt (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H) (u w : 𝒰⁻) :
    ∃ q : K[X], ∀ t : K, q.eval t = pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) u w
proof:
:=
  exists_eval_eq_of_mem_polyFun Λ₀ δ (pairBil_const_mem_polyFun P S u w)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.dvdXPow_zero_pairAt
statement:
lemma dvdXPow_zero_pairAt (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H) {f : K → 𝒰⁻} (hf : f ∈ lineFam P) (w : 𝒰⁻) :
    DvdXPow K 0 (fun t ↦ pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (f t) w)
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨n, u, rfl⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_eval_eq_pairAt S Λ₀ δ u w
    exact ⟨X ^ n * q, fun t ↦ by simp [pairAt_smul_left, hq]⟩
  | zero => simpa [pairAt] using DvdXPow.zero (K := K) 0
  | add f g _ _ hf hg =>
    simpa [pairAt_add_left] using hf.add hg
  | smul a f _ hf =>
    simpa [pairAt_smul_left] using hf.const_mul a

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_zero_smul
statement: lemma pairAt_zero_smul (u w : 𝒰⁻) : pairAt P (Λ₀ + (0 : K) • δ) u w = pairAt P Λ₀ u w
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.actEnv_zero_smul
statement:
lemma actEnv_zero_smul (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    actEnv P (Λ₀ + (0 : K) • δ) x = actEnv P Λ₀ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.actEnv_mem_jantzenEnv
statement:
lemma actEnv_mem_jantzenEnv {i : ℕ} (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) {u : 𝒰⁻}
    (hu : u ∈ jantzenEnv P Λ₀ δ i) : actEnv P Λ₀ x u ∈ jantzenEnv P Λ₀ δ i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl, hfw⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨fun t ↦ actEnv P (Λ₀ + t • δ) x (f t), actEnv_mem_lineFam Λ₀ δ x hf,
    by simp only [actEnv_zero_smul], fun w ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [pairAt_actEnv]
  
  have hg := actEnv_mem_lineFam Λ₀ δ (transpose P x) (const_mem_lineFam (P := P) w)
  
  suffices ∀ g ∈ lineFam P, DvdXPow K i (fun t ↦ pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (f t) (g t)) from
    this _ hg
  intro g hg
  induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
    obtain ⟨n, w', rfl⟩ := hg
    simpa [pairAt_smul_right] using (hfw w').pow_mul n
  | zero => simpa [pairAt] using DvdXPow.zero (K := K) i
  | add g g' _ _ hg hg' => simpa [pairAt_add_right] using hg.add hg'
  | smul a g _ hg => simpa [pairAt_smul_right] using hg.const_mul a

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_jantzen
statement:
lemma mem_jantzen {i : ℕ} {m : VermaModule P Λ₀} :
    m ∈ jantzen P Λ₀ δ i ↔ (equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m ∈ jantzenEnv P Λ₀ δ i
proof:
:= by
  change m ∈ (jantzenEnv P Λ₀ δ i).map (equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).toLinearMap ↔ _
  rw [Submodule.mem_map_equiv]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.jantzen_antitone
statement: theorem jantzen_antitone (i : ℕ) : jantzen P Λ₀ δ (i + 1) ≤ jantzen P Λ₀ δ i
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [mem_jantzen] at hm ⊢
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0, hfw⟩ := hm
  exact ⟨f, hf, hf0, fun w ↦ (hfw w).of_succ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.jantzen_zero
statement: theorem jantzen_zero : jantzen P Λ₀ δ 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun m _ ↦ (mem_jantzen P Λ₀ δ).mpr ?_
  exact ⟨_, const_mem_lineFam _, rfl, fun w ↦ dvdXPow_zero_pairAt S Λ₀ δ (const_mem_lineFam _) w⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.jantzen_one
statement: theorem jantzen_one : jantzen P Λ₀ δ 1 = maxSubmodule P Λ₀
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [mem_jantzen]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, -, hf0, hfw⟩
    rw [mem_maxSubmodule_iff]
    intro w
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).surjective w
    have h0 := (hfw w).eval_zero
    have : pairAt P Λ₀ (f 0) w = 0 := by
      have e : pairAt P (Λ₀ + (0 : K) • δ) (f 0) w = pairAt P Λ₀ (f 0) w := pairAt_zero_smul _ _
      exact e ▸ h0
    rw [hf0, pairAt, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    exact this
  · intro hm
    refine ⟨_, const_mem_lineFam ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m), rfl, fun w ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_eval_eq_pairAt S Λ₀ δ ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m) w
    have hq0 : q.eval 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hq, pairAt_zero_smul, pairAt, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact (mem_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ₀ m).mp hm _
    obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ : X ∣ q := by rwa [X_dvd_iff, coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
    exact ⟨q', fun t ↦ by beta_reduce; rw [← hq, hq']; simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.integral_sub_add_rho
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hint j
  refine ⟨m - 1, ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hm ⊢
  push_cast
  linear_combination hm

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_mul_eq_of_apply_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h := corootPairing_apply u (u * v) b i
  rwa [hu, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.integralWeylGroup_neg
statement:
lemma integralWeylGroup_neg (lam : Dual K H) :
    P.integralWeylGroup hA (-lam) = P.integralWeylGroup hA lam
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, mem_integralWeylGroup, map_neg,
    show -(w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) lam - -lam =
      -((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) lam - lam) by abel, neg_mem_iff]

name: Matrix.Realization.isDominant_weylDot_of_isLongestIntegral
proof:
:= by
  intro v i hv n hn
  rw [weylDot_add_rho, corootPairing_apply] at hn
  have hint' : P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam (wl⁻¹ * v) i := by
    rw [P.isIntegralRoot_congr hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' := μ + P.rho)
      (integral_sub_add_rho hint)]
    exact ⟨n, hn⟩
  rcases P.isPosRoot_or (wl⁻¹ * v) i with hpos | hneg
  · exact absurd (by rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]) (hwl.2 _ i hpos hint')
  · have := hμ _ i hneg (-n) (by rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, hn]; push_cast; ring)
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.upperClosureCondition_mul_of_isLongest
statement:
theorem upperClosureCondition_mul_of_isLongest {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n)
    {wl u : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hwl : P.IsLongestIntegral hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam wl)
    (hu : P.IsLongestStabilizer hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) u) :
    P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((wl * u).val (lam + P.rho))
      ((wl * u).val (μ + P.rho))
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  intro v' hv' i hpos h0
  set v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan := ⟨v', hv'⟩
  have hvpos : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i := isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights.mpr hpos
  rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing (v := v)] at h0 ⊢
  rw [show ((wl * u).val (μ + P.rho)) = ((wl * u : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) from rfl, corootPairing_apply] at h0
  rw [show ((wl * u).val (lam + P.rho)) = ((wl * u : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) from rfl, corootPairing_apply]
  set γ := (wl * u)⁻¹ * v with hγ
  
  have hcongr : ∀ x : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan,
      P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) x i →
        P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam x i := fun x hx ↦ by
    rwa [P.isIntegralRoot_congr hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' := μ + P.rho)
      (integral_sub_add_rho hint)]
  
  have hδ : u * γ = wl⁻¹ * v := by rw [hγ]; group
  have hδ0 : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) (u * γ) i = 0 := by
    rw [corootPairing_mul_eq_of_apply_eq hu.1]; exact h0
  have hδneg : ¬P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (u * γ) i := by
    intro hδpos
    refine hwl.2 _ i hδpos (hcongr _ ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hδ0⟩) ?_
    rwa [hδ, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
  
  have hγpos : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan γ i := by
    rcases P.isPosRoot_or γ i with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have hγ0 : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho)
          (γ * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i = 0 := by
        rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, ← corootPairing_mul_eq_of_apply_eq hu.1, hδ0, neg_zero]
      have := hu.2 _ i h hγ0
      rw [← mul_assoc] at this
      rcases P.isPosRoot_or (u * γ) i with h' | h'
      · exact hδneg h'
      · exact this h'
  
  have hγint := hcongr γ ⟨0, by
    rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact (corootPairing_mul_eq_of_apply_eq hu.1 γ i).symm.trans hδ0⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' := lam + P.rho)
    (fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩) γ i).mp hγint
  have hle := hlam γ i hγpos n hn
  have hn' : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) γ i = n := hn
  have hnat : (((-n).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = -n := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
  refine ⟨(-n).toNat, ?_⟩
  rw [hn', show (((-n).toNat : ℕ) : K) = ((((-n).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) : K) by norm_cast, hnat]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_isLongestIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_isLongestIntegral {lam : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hreg : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ wl, P.IsLongestIntegral hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam wl
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hanti⟩ := P.exists_isAntidominant_weylDot hF (-(lam + P.rho) - P.rho)
  have hW : P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan (-(lam + P.rho) - P.rho) =
      P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hF.isGeneralizedCartan
      (μ' := -(lam + P.rho)) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩, integralWeylGroup_neg,
      ← P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ := lam) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩]
  refine ⟨w⁻¹, inv_mem (hW ▸ hw), fun v i hv hint hpos ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' := lam + P.rho)
    (fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩) _ i).mp
    (P.isIntegralRoot_mul hF.isGeneralizedCartan
      (inv_mem (hW ▸ hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup _ lam)) hint)
  replace hn : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) (w⁻¹ * v) i = n := hn
  have hle := hlam _ i hpos n hn
  have hne : n ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hreg _ i hpos (by rw [hn, h, Int.cast_zero])
  have h2 := hanti v i hv (-n) (by
    rw [sub_add_cancel, sub_add_cancel, corootPairing_apply, corootPairing_neg, hn]; push_cast
    ring)
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_isLongestStabilizer
statement:
theorem exists_isLongestStabilizer [FiniteDimensional K H] {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hreg : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n)
    {wl : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hwl : P.IsLongestIntegral hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam wl) :
    ∃ u, P.IsLongestStabilizer hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) u
proof:
:= by
  have hwa : wl ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) := by
    rw [← P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ := lam)
      fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩]
    exact hwl.1
  obtain ⟨x, -, hxb, hxC, -⟩ := exists_upperClosureCondition_of_integral (P := P) hF hint hlam hwa
  refine ⟨wl⁻¹ * x, ?_, fun v i hv h0 hpos ↦ ?_⟩
  · change ((wl⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (x.val (μ + P.rho)) = μ + P.rho
    rw [hxb]
    exact inv_apply_apply wl (μ + P.rho)
  · 
    set δ := wl⁻¹ * x * v
    have hδ0 : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) δ i = 0 := by
      rw [corootPairing_mul_eq_of_apply_eq (u := wl⁻¹ * x) (by
        change ((wl⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
          (x.val (μ + P.rho)) = μ + P.rho
        rw [hxb]; exact inv_apply_apply wl (μ + P.rho))]
      exact h0
    have hδint : P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam δ i := by
      rw [P.isIntegralRoot_congr hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' := μ + P.rho)
      (integral_sub_add_rho hint)]
      exact ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hδ0⟩
    
    have hxneg := hwl.2 δ i hpos hδint
    have hxv : wl * δ = x * v := by simp only [δ]; group
    rw [hxv] at hxneg
    have hβ := (P.isPosRoot_or (x * v) i).resolve_left hxneg
    have hβ' : (((x * v * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i :
        P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) ∈
        P.posWeights := isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights.mp hβ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxC _ (x * v * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i).2 i hβ' (by
      rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing (v := x * v * _), ← hxb,
        show x.val (μ + P.rho) = (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) from rfl,
        corootPairing_apply, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul,
        corootPairing_mul_simple, h0, neg_zero])
    rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing (v := x * v * _),
      show x.val (lam + P.rho) = (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) from rfl,
      corootPairing_apply, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul,
      corootPairing_mul_simple, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, neg_neg] at hn
    
    have hle := hlam v i hv n (by rw [hn]; norm_cast)
    have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
    exact hreg v i hv (by rw [hn, hn0, Nat.cast_zero])

name: Matrix.Realization.weylDot_eq_of_memUpperClosure_of_isLongest
statement:
theorem weylDot_eq_of_memUpperClosure_of_isLongest [FiniteDimensional K H] {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    {wl u x : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hwl : P.IsLongestIntegral hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam wl)
    (hu : P.IsLongestStabilizer hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) u)
    (hxμ : P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan x μ = P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan wl μ)
    (hxup : P.MemUpperClosure hF.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan x lam)
      (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan x μ)) :
    P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan x lam = P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (wl * u) lam
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hxC := (memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant hF hlam hμ hint hfacet x).mp hxup
  have hC := upperClosureCondition_mul_of_isLongest hF hlam hint hwl hu
  have hb : (wl * u).val (μ + P.rho) = x.val (μ + P.rho) := by
    have h1 := congrArg (· + P.rho) hxμ
    simp only [weylDot, sub_add_cancel] at h1
    rw [h1]
    change (wl : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho)) = _
    rw [hu.1]
  have ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i = n →
      n ≤ 0 := hlam
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, h₁⟩ := exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
    (P := P) hF hint ha hC hb.symm
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, h₂⟩ := exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
    (P := P) hF hint ha hxC hb
  have h0 : P.rootOf (c₁ + c₂) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [map_add, ← h₁, ← h₂, map_zero]; abel
  have hc0 : c₁ = 0 := by
    have := P.rootOf_injective h0
    ext j
    have h1 := congrFun this j
    have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c₁ j := hc₁ j
    have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c₂ j := hc₂ j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 ⊢
    omega
  rw [hc0, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h₁
  simp only [weylDot, h₁]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_verma_longest
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_verma_longest {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {wl u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hwl : P.IsLongestIntegral hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam wl)
    (hu : P.IsLongestStabilizer hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) u) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (wl * u) lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan wl μ)))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := sub_rho_integral (lam := μ) (μ := lam) P hA hν hz hzν j
    refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
    rw [show (lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) = -((μ + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho)) by abel,
      LinearMap.neg_apply, hn, Int.cast_neg]
  
  have hdom := isDominant_weylDot_of_isLongestIntegral hA hμ hint hwl
  have h := nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_verma P hA hlam hμ
    hfacet hν hz hzν hwl.1 fun w' hw' k hk hwk ↦ hdom.eq_zero_of_apply_eq P hA hw' hk hwk
  rw [← weylDot_eq_of_memUpperClosure_of_isLongest hA hlam hμ hint hfacet hwl hu
    h.choose_spec.1 h.choose_spec.2.1]
  exact h.choose_spec.2.2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_isAtom_le
statement:
theorem exists_isAtom_le (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ S : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ),
      IsAtom S ∧ ∀ N, N ≠ ⊥ → S ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA Λ
  have : WellFoundedLT (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)) := hf.wellFoundedLT
  have htop : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)) ≠ ⊥ := fun h ↦
    hwv_ne_zero P Λ ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (h ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top (hwv P Λ)))
  obtain ⟨S, hS, -⟩ := (IsAtomic.eq_bot_or_exists_atom_le (⊤ : LieSubmodule K _ _)).resolve_left
    htop
  refine ⟨S, hS, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := inf_ne_bot_of_finite_type P hA Λ S N hS.1 hN
  rcases hS.le_iff.mp inf_le_left with h' | h'
  · exact absurd h' h
  · exact h' ▸ inf_le_right

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.existsUnique_isAtom
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isAtom (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃! S : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ), IsAtom S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hle⟩ := exists_isAtom_le P hA Λ
  exact ⟨S, hS, fun T hT ↦ ((hT.le_iff.mp (hle T hT.1)).resolve_left hS.1).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_nonempty_equiv_of_isAtom
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial S := (LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _).mpr hS.1
  obtain ⟨μ, ψ, hψ⟩ := ((isCategoryO P _).lieSubmodule S).exists_lieModuleHom_verma
  let φ := S.incl.comp ψ
  have hφ0 : φ (hwv P μ) ≠ 0 := fun hz ↦ hψ (Subtype.ext hz)
  have hφ : φ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hφ0 (by rw [h, _root_.zero_apply])
  have hinj : Function.Injective ψ := fun a b hab ↦
    injective_of_ne_zero P hφ (by simp only [φ, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hab])
  have hle : φ.range ≤ S := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hx
    exact (ψ m).2
  have hrange : φ.range = S := by
    rcases hS.le_iff.mp hle with h | h
    · exact absurd ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (h ▸ (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr
        ⟨hwv P μ, rfl⟩)) hφ0
    · exact h
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective ψ := fun s ↦ by
    have hs : (s : VermaModule P Λ) ∈ φ.range := by rw [hrange]; exact s.2
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hs
    exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩
  exact ⟨μ, ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective ψ ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_bot_iff_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem maxSubmodule_eq_bot_iff_isAntidominant {μ : Dual K H} :
    maxSubmodule P μ = ⊥ ↔ P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hbot v i hpos n hn ↦ ?_, maxSubmodule_eq_bot_of_isAntidominant P hA⟩
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  by_contra! hn0
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hposDef⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hposDef.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  have hwall : P.WallStep hA' 0 (μ + P.rho)
      (μ + P.rho - n.toNat • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) := by
    refine ⟨v.val, v.2, i, n.toNat, isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights.mp hpos, by omega, by simp, ?_,
      rfl⟩
    rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing, hn]
    exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn0.le).symm
  obtain ⟨α, hα, hαne, m, hm, -, hK⟩ := kacKazhdanStep_of_wallStep P S hA' hwall
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at hK
  exact (maxSubmodule_eq_bot_iff_kacKazhdan P S hA' μ).mp hbot α hα hαne m hm hK

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exact_postcompLinear
statement:
theorem exact_postcompLinear (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (postcompLinear X S.f n) (postcompLinear X S.g n)
proof:
:= by
