name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.injective_postcompLinear_zero
statement: theorem injective_postcompLinear_zero : Function.Injective (postcompLinear X S.f 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro x hx
  have := hS.mono_f
  rw [← Abelian.Ext.mk₀_homEquiv₀_apply x] at hx ⊢
  change (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ _).comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f) (add_zero 0) = 0 at hx
  rw [Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, Abelian.Ext.mk₀_eq_zero_iff] at hx
  rw [(cancel_mono S.f).mp (hx.trans zero_comp.symm), Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.sum_finrank_ext_eq_add
statement:
theorem sum_finrank_ext_eq_add (N : ℕ)
    (hN : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₁ (N + 1), x = 0) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₂ n) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₁ n) +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₃ n)
proof:
:= by
  let rf : ℕ → ℤ := fun n ↦ finrank K (LinearMap.range (postcompLinear X S.f n))
  let rg : ℕ → ℤ := fun n ↦ finrank K (LinearMap.range (postcompLinear X S.g n))
  let rd : ℕ → ℤ := fun n ↦ finrank K (LinearMap.range (connectingLinear X hS n))
  have hb (n : ℕ) : (finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₂ n) : ℤ) = rf n + rg n := by
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (postcompLinear X S.g n)
    rw [(LinearMap.exact_iff.mp (exact_postcompLinear X hS n))] at h
    simp only [rf, rg]
    omega
  have hc (n : ℕ) : (finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₃ n) : ℤ) = rg n + rd n := by
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (connectingLinear X hS n)
    rw [(LinearMap.exact_iff.mp (exact_connectingLinear X hS n))] at h
    simp only [rg, rd]
    omega
  have ha (n : ℕ) : (finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₁ (n + 1)) : ℤ) = rd n + rf (n + 1) := by
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (postcompLinear X S.f (n + 1))
    rw [(LinearMap.exact_iff.mp (exact_connectingLinear_postcompLinear X hS n))] at h
    simp only [rf, rd]
    omega
  have ha₀ : (finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₁ 0) : ℤ) = rf 0 := by
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (postcompLinear X S.f 0)
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (injective_postcompLinear_zero X hS), finrank_bot] at h
    simp only [rf]
    omega
  have hrd : rd N = 0 := by
    have : LinearMap.range (connectingLinear X hS N) = ⊥ :=
      eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x _ ↦ (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr (hN x)
    simp only [rd]
    rw [this, finrank_bot, Nat.cast_zero]
  
  have key (M : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ n *
      ((finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₂ n) : ℤ) - finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₁ n) -
        finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X S.X₃ n)) = (-1) ^ (M + 1) * rd M := by
    induction M with
    | zero =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_one, hb, hc, ha₀]
      ring
    | succ M ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, hb, hc, ha]
      ring
  have h := key N
  rw [hrd, mul_zero] at h
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at h
  linarith

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.eulerChar_eq_add
proof:
:=
  sum_finrank_ext_eq_add (verma P μ) hS _
    (ext_verma_eq_zero_of_ncard_lt hA _ μ (Nat.lt_succ_self _) S.X₁)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.eulerChar_eq_sum
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_sum (μ : Dual K H) (N : CategoryO.{u} P) {B : ℕ}
    (hB : (dotOrbitAbove P hA μ).ncard < B) :
    eulerChar hA μ N = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range B,
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) N n)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hB) fun n hn hn' ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn hn'
  have : Subsingleton (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) N n) :=
    ⟨fun x y ↦ (ext_verma_eq_zero_of_ncard_lt hA n μ (by omega) N x).trans
      (ext_verma_eq_zero_of_ncard_lt hA n μ (by omega) N y).symm⟩
  rw [finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.separatingLeft_tmul
statement:
theorem separatingLeft_tmul (h₁ : B₁.SeparatingLeft) (h₂ : B₂.SeparatingLeft) :
    (B₁.tmul B₂).SeparatingLeft
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro t ht
  let b := Basis.ofVectorSpace K V₁
  set f := equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b t with hf
  have ht' : t = f.sum fun i w ↦ b i ⊗ₜ w := by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft_symm b) f
    simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, hf, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Finsupp.lsum_apply] at this
    exact this
  suffices hf0 : f = 0 by rw [ht', hf0, Finsupp.sum_zero_index]
  by_contra hf0
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hf0
  rw [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hi₀
  have hmem : i₀ ∈ f.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hi₀
  
  let Ψ : V₁ →ₗ[K] (f.support → K) := LinearMap.pi fun i ↦ B₁ (b i)
  have hΨ : Function.Surjective Ψ := by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ0, hψ⟩ :=
      Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_lt_top (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne) inferInstance
    have hψv : ∀ v, ψ (Ψ v) = 0 := fun v ↦ by
      have : ψ (Ψ v) ∈ (LinearMap.range Ψ).map ψ := ⟨Ψ v, ⟨v, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rwa [hψ, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    have hψe : ∀ x : f.support → K, ψ x = ∑ i, x i * ψ (Pi.single i 1) := fun x ↦ by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single x]
      simp only [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul]
      congr 1
      ext j
      by_cases h : j = i
      · subst h
        simp
      · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne h]
    have hsum : (∑ i : f.support, ψ (Pi.single i 1) • b i) = 0 := by
      apply h₁
      intro v
      rw [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
      have := hψv v
      rw [hψe] at this
      rw [← this]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      rfl
    have hc := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp
      (b.linearIndependent.comp (fun i : f.support ↦ (i : _)) Subtype.val_injective) _ hsum
    apply hψ0
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    rw [hψe, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ by rw [hc i, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨v', hv'⟩ := hΨ (Pi.single ⟨i₀, hmem⟩ 1)
  have hv'i : ∀ i (hi : i ∈ f.support), B₁ (b i) v' = if i = i₀ then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have := congrArg (fun g ↦ g (⟨i, hi⟩ : f.support)) hv'
    change B₁ (b i) v' = _ at this
    rw [this]
    by_cases h : i = i₀
    · subst h
      simp
    · simp [Subtype.ext_iff, h]
  obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ : ∃ w', B₂ (f i₀) w' ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hi₀ (h₂ _ h)
  apply hw'
  have := ht (v' ⊗ₜ w')
  rw [ht', Finsupp.sum, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply] at this
  rw [← this, Finset.sum_eq_single i₀]
  · rw [tensorDistrib_tmul, hv'i i₀ hmem]
    simp
  · intro i hi hne
    rw [tensorDistrib_tmul, hv'i i hi]
    simp [hne]
  · intro h
    exact absurd hmem h

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.flip_tmul
statement:
lemma flip_tmul (B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm K V₁) (B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm K V₂) :
    (B₁.tmul B₂).flip = B₁.flip.tmul B₂.flip
proof:
:= by
  ext x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂
  rfl

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.Nondegenerate.tmul
statement:
theorem Nondegenerate.tmul (h₁ : B₁.Nondegenerate) (h₂ : B₂.Nondegenerate) :
    (B₁.tmul B₂).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨separatingLeft_tmul h₁.1 h₂.1, ?_⟩
  rw [← LinearMap.flip_separatingLeft, flip_tmul]
  exact separatingLeft_tmul (LinearMap.flip_separatingLeft.mpr h₁.2)
    (LinearMap.flip_separatingLeft.mpr h₂.2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.lie_right
statement:
lemma lie_right (hB : IsContravariantForm P B) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (u w : V) :
    B u ⁅x, w⁆ = B ⁅transpose P x, u⁆ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [hB.lie_left, transpose_transpose]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.apply_rep_left
statement:
theorem apply_rep_left (hB : IsContravariantForm P B) (a : 𝓤) (u w : V) :
    B (rep P V a u) w = B u (rep P V (envTranspose P a).unop w)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing u w with
  | algebraMap r => simp [Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
  | ι x => rw [rep_ι, envTranspose_ι, MulOpposite.unop_op, rep_ι, hB.lie_left]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb, unop_envTranspose_mul, map_mul,
      Module.End.mul_apply]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, MulOpposite.unop_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.apply_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, μ a ≠ ν a := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hne (LinearMap.ext hc)
  have h1 := hB.lie_left (h P a) u w
  rw [transpose_h, hu a, hw a, map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h2 : (μ a - ν a) * B u w = 0 := by linear_combination h1
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.compl₁₂_eq_smul_contravariantForm
statement:
theorem compl₁₂_eq_smul_contravariantForm (hB : IsContravariantForm P B) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) :
    B.compl₁₂ (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) =
      B (φ (hwv P Λ)) (φ (hwv P Λ)) • VermaModule.contravariantForm P Λ
proof:
:= by
  have := eq_smul_contravariantForm P Λ
    (B.compl₁₂ (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V)) fun x u w ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, LieModuleHom.map_lie,
        hB.lie_left]
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.eq_of_apply_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_apply_eq {B' : LinearMap.BilinForm K V} (hB : IsContravariantForm P B)
    (hB' : IsContravariantForm P B') {Λ : Dual K H} (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (h : B (φ (hwv P Λ)) (φ (hwv P Λ)) = B' (φ (hwv P Λ)) (φ (hwv P Λ))) :
    B = B'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hB.compl₁₂_eq_smul_contravariantForm φ
  have h2 := hB'.compl₁₂_eq_smul_contravariantForm φ
  rw [h, ← h2] at h1
  ext u w
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hφ u
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hφ w
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h1 u w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.apply_hwv_ne_zero
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  hB0 (hB.eq_of_apply_eq ⟨⟨fun _ _ ↦ by simp⟩, fun _ _ _ ↦ by simp⟩ φ hφ (by simpa using h))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.mem_orthogonal
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_orthogonal (hB : IsContravariantForm P B)
    (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) (v : V) :
    v ∈ hB.orthogonal N ↔ ∀ w ∈ N, B v w = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.tmul
statement:
theorem IsContravariantForm.tmul (h₁ : IsContravariantForm P B₁)
    (h₂ : IsContravariantForm P B₂) : IsContravariantForm P (B₁.tmul B₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mpr (LinearMap.IsSymm.tmul
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp h₁.isSymm) (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp h₂.isSymm)),
    fun x t t' ↦ ?_⟩
  induction t with
  | add t₁ t₂ ht₁ ht₂ => rw [lie_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
      ht₁, ht₂]
  | tmul v w =>
    induction t' with
    | add t₁ t₂ ht₁ ht₂ => rw [map_add, lie_add, map_add, ht₁, ht₂]
    | tmul v' w' =>
      simp only [LieModule.lie_tmul_right, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
        LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul, h₁.lie_left, h₂.lie_left, smul_eq_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.apply_eq_zero_of_centralBlock
statement:
theorem IsContravariantForm.apply_eq_zero_of_centralBlock {ι H : Type*} {K : Type} [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Field K] [CharZero K] [AddCommGroup H] [Module K H] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} {P : Realization A K H} (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    {B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V} (hB : IsContravariantForm P B)
    {χ₁ χ₂ : Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) →ₐ[K] K}
    (hχ : χ₁ ≠ χ₂) {u w : V} (hu : u ∈ centralBlock P V χ₁) (hw : w ∈ centralBlock P V χ₂) :
    B u w = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, χ₁ z ≠ χ₂ z := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hχ (AlgHom.ext hc)
  set c₁ := χ₁ z
  set c₂ := χ₂ z
  set T₁ := rep P V (z : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) - c₁ • 1
  set T₂ := rep P V (z : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) - c₂ • 1
  have hid : ∀ u w : V, B (T₁ u) w - B u (T₂ w) = (c₂ - c₁) * B u w := by
    intro u w
    have h := hB.apply_rep_left (z : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) u w
    rw [unop_envTranspose_center P hA z] at h
    simp only [T₁, T₂, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_sub,
      map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h]
    ring
  have key : ∀ n m (u w : V), (T₁ ^ n) u = 0 → (T₂ ^ m) w = 0 → B u w = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro m u w hu _
      rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hu
      rw [hu, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    | succ n ihn =>
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro u w _ hw
        rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hw
        rw [hw, map_zero]
      | succ m ihm =>
        intro u w hu hw
        rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] at hu hw
        have h1 : B (T₁ u) w = 0 :=
          ihn (m + 1) _ _ hu (by rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]; exact hw)
        have h2 : B u (T₂ w) = 0 := ihm u _ (by rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]; exact hu) hw
        have h3 := hid u w
        rw [h1, h2, sub_zero] at h3
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3.symm).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hz))
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (mem_centralBlock P χ₁ u).mp hu z
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (mem_centralBlock P χ₂ w).mp hw z
  exact key n m u w hn hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.mem_radical
statement:
lemma IsContravariantForm.mem_radical (hB : IsContravariantForm P B) (v : V) :
    v ∈ hB.radical ↔ ∀ w, B v w = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h w ↦ h w (LieSubmodule.mem_top w), fun h w _ ↦ h w⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_le_maxSubmodule
statement: lemma ker_le_maxSubmodule (h0 : φ (hwv P Λ) ≠ 0) : φ.ker ≤ maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:=
  (le_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ φ.ker).mpr fun h ↦ h0 <| by
    have : hwv P Λ ∈ φ.ker := by rw [h]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top _
    exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isContravariantForm_of_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_isContravariantForm_of_surjective (h0 : φ (hwv P Λ) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V, ∃ hB : IsContravariantForm P B,
      B (φ (hwv P Λ)) (φ (hwv P Λ)) = 1 ∧ hB.radical = (maxSubmodule P Λ).map φ
proof:
:= by
  set S := VermaModule.contravariantForm P Λ
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V).exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hφ)
  have hgφ : ∀ u, g (φ u) - u ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ := fun u ↦
    ker_le_maxSubmodule φ h0 (by
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, map_sub]
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hg (φ u)
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap] at this
      rw [this, sub_self])
  have hS : ∀ u u' w, u - u' ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ → S u w = S u' w := fun u u' w h ↦ by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_mem P Λ h) w
    rwa [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this
  let B := S.compl₁₂ g g
  have hBφ : ∀ u w, B (φ u) (φ w) = S u w := fun u w ↦ by
    change S (g (φ u)) (g (φ w)) = S u w
    rw [hS _ _ _ (hgφ u), (isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq, hS _ _ _ (hgφ w),
      (isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq]
  have hB : IsContravariantForm P B := by
    refine ⟨⟨fun v w ↦ ?_⟩, fun x v w ↦ ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hφ v
      obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := hφ w
      rw [hBφ, hBφ, (isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq]
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hφ v
      obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := hφ w
      rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, hBφ, hBφ, contravariantForm_lie_left]
  refine ⟨B, hB, by rw [hBφ, contravariantForm_hwv_hwv], ?_⟩
  ext v
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hφ v
  rw [hB.mem_radical, LieSubmodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨u, (mem_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ u).mpr fun w ↦ ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hBφ]
    exact h (φ w)
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, hmu⟩ w
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hφ w
    rw [hBφ]
    have hmu' : u - m ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ :=
      ker_le_maxSubmodule φ h0 (by rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hmu, sub_self])
    have := (maxSubmodule P Λ).add_mem hmu' hm
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
    exact (mem_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ u).mp this w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsContravariantForm.nondegenerate_iff_nonempty_equiv
statement:
theorem IsContravariantForm.nondegenerate_iff_nonempty_equiv (hB : IsContravariantForm P B)
    (hB0 : B (φ (hwv P Λ)) (φ (hwv P Λ)) ≠ 0) :
    B.Nondegenerate ↔ Nonempty (V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : φ (hwv P Λ) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hB0 (by simp [h])
  have hleft : B.Nondegenerate ↔ hB.radical = ⊥ := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
    refine ⟨fun h v hv ↦ h.1 v ((hB.mem_radical v).mp hv), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    have hsep : B.SeparatingLeft := fun v hv ↦ h v ((hB.mem_radical v).mpr hv)
    refine ⟨hsep, fun w hw ↦ hsep w fun v ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [hB.isSymm.eq]
    exact hw v
  rw [hleft]
  constructor
  · intro hrad
    have hpull := hB.compl₁₂_eq_smul_contravariantForm φ
    have hker : φ.ker = maxSubmodule P Λ := by
      refine le_antisymm (ker_le_maxSubmodule φ h0) fun m hm ↦ ?_
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
      have : φ m ∈ hB.radical := (hB.mem_radical _).mpr fun w ↦ by
        obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hφ w
        have := LinearMap.congr_fun₂ hpull m w
        simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap,
          LinearMap.smul_apply] at this
        rw [this, (mem_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ m).mp hm w, smul_zero]
      rw [hrad] at this
      exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp this
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective _ φ hφ hker
    exact ⟨e.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P Λ
    rcases IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top (hB.radical.map e.toLieModuleHom) with h | h
    · rw [LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
      intro v hv
      have : e v ∈ hB.radical.map e.toLieModuleHom := LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hv
      rw [h, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
      exact e.injective (by rw [this, map_zero])
    · exfalso
      have : e (φ (hwv P Λ)) ∈ hB.radical.map e.toLieModuleHom := h ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hev⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp this
      have hv' : v = φ (hwv P Λ) := e.injective hev
      exact hB0 ((hB.mem_radical _).mp (hv' ▸ hv) _)

name: LieSubmodule.eq_of_forall_step_eq_bot
statement:
theorem eq_of_forall_step_eq_bot {n : ℕ} (F : Fin (n + 1) → LieSubmodule K L V)
    (hF : Monotone F) {p q : ℕ} (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ n)
    (hstep : ∀ j : Fin n, p ≤ j.val → j.val < q →
      (F j.succ).map (Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥) :
    F ⟨p, by omega⟩ = F ⟨q, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction q, hpq using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ q hpq ih =>
    rw [ih (by omega) fun j hj hjq ↦ hstep j hj (by omega)]
    have h := hstep ⟨q, by omega⟩ hpq (by simp)
    exact (le_antisymm ((map_mk'_eq_bot_iff _ _).mp h)
      (hF (Fin.castSucc_le_succ _))).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_verma_lieSubmodule_of_extension
statement:
theorem exists_verma_lieSubmodule_of_extension
    (hX : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) μ = ⊤) {N T : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} (hNT : N ≤ T)
    {a b : Dual K H} (eN : VermaModule P a ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N)
    (eQ : VermaModule P b ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)) (hab : b ∉ cone P a) :
    ∃ S : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X, S ≤ T ∧ Nonempty (VermaModule P b ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ S) ∧
      Nonempty (VermaModule P a ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set y : X ⧸ N := (eQ (VermaModule.hwv P b) : X ⧸ N) with hy
  have hyw : y ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (X ⧸ N) (h P) b :=
    mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P
      eQ.toLieModuleHom (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P b))
  obtain ⟨x, hxw, hxy⟩ := (map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P N hX b).ge hyw
  change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N x = y at hxy
  have hxT : x ∈ T := by
    obtain ⟨t, htT, ht⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (eQ (VermaModule.hwv P b)).2
    have hxt : x - t ∈ N := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub, hxy, ht, sub_self]
    have := T.add_mem (hNT hxt) htT
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
  
  have hprim : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, x⁆ = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hey : ⁅e P i, eQ (VermaModule.hwv P b)⁆ = 0 := by
      have := eQ.toLieModuleHom.map_lie (e P i) (VermaModule.hwv P b)
      rw [VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero] at this
      exact this.symm
    have hmem : ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ N := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, LieModuleHom.map_lie, hxy, hy,
        ← LieSubmodule.coe_bracket, hey, LieSubmodule.coe_zero]
    have hw : ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) (b + P.root i) := by
      simpa using toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace (P := P) (V := X) i hxw
    set n : N := ⟨_, hmem⟩
    have hn : n ∈ weightSpaceOfMap N (h P) (b + P.root i) :=
      mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mpr hw
    have hn' := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P eN.symm.toLieModuleHom hn
    rw [show weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P a) (h P) (b + P.root i) = ⊥ from
      VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot P a fun k hk hbk ↦ hab ⟨k + Pi.single i 1,
        add_nonneg hk (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one), by
          rw [map_add, rootOf_single, ← sub_sub, ← hbk, add_sub_cancel_right]⟩] at hn'
    have h0 : n = 0 := by
      have := (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hn'
      simpa using this
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h0
  
  let xT : T := ⟨x, hxT⟩
  have hxTw : xT ∈ weightSpaceOfMap T (h P) b := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mpr hxw
  have hxTe : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, xT⁆ = 0 := fun i ↦ Subtype.ext (by
    rw [LieSubmodule.coe_bracket]; exact hprim i)
  let φ : VermaModule P b →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T := (VermaModule.homEquiv P T b).symm
    ⟨xT, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hxTw, hxTe⟩⟩
  have hφ : φ (VermaModule.hwv P b) = xT :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((VermaModule.homEquiv P T b).apply_symm_apply
      ⟨xT, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hxTw, hxTe⟩⟩)
  
  let π : T →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N).comp T.incl)
      (fun t ↦ (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mpr ⟨t, t.2, rfl⟩)
  have hπ : ∀ t : T, (π t : X ⧸ N) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (t : X) := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hπφ : π.comp φ = (eQ : VermaModule P b →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ _) := by
    refine VermaModule.hom_ext P b (Subtype.ext ?_)
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hπ, hφ]
    exact hxy
  have hπφ' : ∀ z, π (φ z) = eQ z := fun z ↦ by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hπφ]; rfl
  have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := fun z z' hzz' ↦ eQ.injective (by
    rw [← hπφ', ← hπφ', hzz'])
  
  let φX : VermaModule P b →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X := T.incl.comp φ
  have hφXinj : Function.Injective φX := fun z z' h ↦ hφinj (Subtype.ext h)
  refine ⟨φX.range, ?_, ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective
    (LieModuleHom.codRestrict φX.range φX fun z ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩)
    ⟨fun z z' h ↦ hφXinj (congrArg (fun q : φX.range ↦ (q : X)) h), ?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact (φ z).2
  · rintro ⟨_, z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  
  let θ : VermaModule P a →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φX.range) :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φX.range).comp
      (N.incl.comp (eN : VermaModule P a →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N)))
      (fun m ↦ (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mpr ⟨(eN m : X), hNT (eN m).2, rfl⟩)
  have hθ : ∀ m, (θ m : X ⧸ φX.range) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φX.range (eN m : X) :=
    fun _ ↦ rfl
  refine ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective θ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro m hm
    have h1 : ((θ m : X ⧸ φX.range)) = 0 := by rw [hm]; rfl
    rw [hθ, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h1
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp h1
    have hz0 : eQ z = 0 := by
      rw [← hπφ']
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [hπ]
      change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (φX z) = 0
      rw [hz, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact (eN m).2
    have hz' : z = 0 := by simpa using hz0
    have : (eN m : X) = 0 := by rw [← hz, hz', map_zero]
    have : eN m = 0 := Subtype.ext this
    simpa using this
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨t, htT, rfl⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hq
    set z := eQ.symm (π ⟨t, htT⟩)
    have hmem : t - φX z ∈ N := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub]
      have h1 : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N (φX z) = (eQ z : X ⧸ N) := by
        rw [← hπφ' z]; rfl
      rw [h1, show z = eQ.symm (π ⟨t, htT⟩) from rfl, LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hπ,
        sub_self]
    refine ⟨eN.symm ⟨_, hmem⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [hθ, LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φX.range (t - φX z) = _
    rw [map_sub, (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr
      ⟨z, rfl⟩), sub_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_of_two_steps
statement:
theorem exists_of_two_steps {n : ℕ} (F : Fin (n + 1) → LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) (hF : Monotone F)
    (hF0 : F 0 = ⊥) {j₁ j₂ : Fin n} (h12 : j₁ < j₂)
    (hzero : ∀ j, j ≠ j₁ → j ≠ j₂ →
      (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥) {a b : Dual K H}
    (e₁ : Nonempty (VermaModule P a ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      (F j₁.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j₁.castSucc))))
    (e₂ : Nonempty (VermaModule P b ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      (F j₂.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j₂.castSucc)))) :
    F j₁.succ ≤ F (Fin.last n) ∧ Nonempty (VermaModule P a ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ F j₁.succ) ∧
      Nonempty (VermaModule P b ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        (F (Fin.last n)).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j₁.succ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h12' : j₁.val < j₂.val := h12
  have hc1 : F j₁.castSucc = ⊥ := by
    rw [← hF0]
    exact (LieSubmodule.eq_of_forall_step_eq_bot F hF (Nat.zero_le j₁.val) (by omega)
      fun j _ hj ↦ hzero j (fun h ↦ by rw [h] at hj; omega)
        (fun h ↦ by rw [h] at hj; omega)).symm
  have hc2 : F j₂.castSucc = F j₁.succ := by
    exact (LieSubmodule.eq_of_forall_step_eq_bot F hF (p := j₁.val + 1) (q := j₂.val)
      (by omega) (by omega)
      fun j hj hj' ↦ hzero j (fun h ↦ by rw [h] at hj; omega)
        (fun h ↦ by rw [h] at hj'; omega)).symm
  have hc3 : F j₂.succ = F (Fin.last n) :=
    LieSubmodule.eq_of_forall_step_eq_bot F hF (p := j₂.val + 1) (q := n) (by omega) le_rfl
      fun j hj _ ↦ hzero j (fun h ↦ by rw [h] at hj; omega) (fun h ↦ by rw [h] at hj; omega)
  refine ⟨hc3 ▸ hc2 ▸ hF (Fin.castSucc_le_succ j₂), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hc1] at e₁
    obtain ⟨e₁⟩ := e₁
    exact ⟨e₁.trans (LieSubmodule.mapMkBotEquiv _).symm⟩
  · rwa [hc2, hc3] at e₂

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_eq_of_apply_root_eq
statement:
lemma _root_.Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_eq_of_apply_root_eq
    {v v' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i i' : ι}
    (h : (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (x : Dual K H) :
    P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan x v' i' =
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan x v i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (Matrix.diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  have hform : ∀ (u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (j : ι) (y : Dual K H),
      P.dualBilinForm S y ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)) =
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan y u j / S.ε j := by
    intro u j y
    rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan S (u⁻¹).2, inv_apply_apply,
      dualBilinForm_root_right]
    rfl
  have hself : ∀ (u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (j : ι),
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)) u j =
        2 := by
    intro u j
    rw [corootPairing, inv_apply_apply, P.root_coroot_self hA.isGeneralizedCartan]
  have hne : ∀ j, (S.ε j : K) ≠ 0 := fun j ↦ by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero j
  have hε : (S.ε i' : K) = S.ε i := by
    have h1 := hform v i ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    have h2 := hform v' i' ((v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i'))
    rw [hself] at h1 h2
    rw [h] at h2
    have e : (2 : K) / S.ε i' = 2 / S.ε i := h2.symm.trans h1
    field_simp [hne i, hne i'] at e
    exact e.symm
  have h1 := hform v i x
  have h2 := hform v' i' x
  rw [h] at h2
  rw [hε] at h2
  exact (div_left_inj' (hne i)).mp (h2.symm.trans h1)

name: Matrix.Realization.reflectionOf_eq_of_apply_root_eq
statement:
lemma _root_.Matrix.Realization.reflectionOf_eq_of_apply_root_eq
    {v v' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i i' : ι}
    (h : (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) :
    P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v' i' = P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · refine Subtype.ext (LinearEquiv.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
    rw [reflectionOf_apply', reflectionOf_apply', corootPairing_eq_of_apply_root_eq hA h, h]
  · have h' : ((v' * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i' :
        P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') =
        (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      rw [mul_simple_apply_root, h, neg_neg]
    refine Subtype.ext (LinearEquiv.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
    rw [reflectionOf_apply', reflectionOf_apply', ← corootPairing_eq_of_apply_root_eq hA h',
      corootPairing_mul_simple, h]
    module

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.integral_sub_of_apply_eq
statement:
lemma integral_sub_of_apply_eq {lam μ ν : Dual K H} (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν)
    {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν) :
    ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n
proof:
:= by
  have hνint : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, ν (P.coroot i) = n := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hν i; exact ⟨n, by rw [hn, Int.cast_natCast]⟩
  intro j
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan (inv_mem hz) hνint
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hνint j
  have e : (lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) = z⁻¹ ν := by
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← hzν]
    exact (z.symm_apply_apply _).symm
  refine ⟨n + (A *ᵥ k) j, ?_⟩
  rw [e, hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_one_or_eq_of_weylDot_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hfix : (w' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) = μ + P.rho := by
    have := congrArg (· + P.rho) hw'
    simpa [weylDot] using this
  have hmem := (apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf hA (μ + P.rho) w').mp hfix
  have hle : Subgroup.closure {s | ∃ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 ∧ P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v' i' = s} ≤
      Subgroup.closure {P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i} := by
    refine Subgroup.closure_mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨v', i', h0, rfl⟩
    exact hwall v' i' h0
  set s := P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i
  have hss : s * s = 1 := reflectionOf_mul_self v i
  have key : ∀ y ∈ Subgroup.closure {s}, y = 1 ∨ y = s := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact Or.inr hx
    | one => exact Or.inl rfl
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl (one_mul 1)
      · exact Or.inr (one_mul _)
      · exact Or.inr (mul_one _)
      · exact Or.inl hss
    | inv x _ hx =>
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl inv_one
      · exact Or.inr (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left hss)
  exact key _ (hle hmem)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weylDot_mul_reflectionOf_notMem_cone
statement:
lemma weylDot_mul_reflectionOf_notMem_cone {lam : Dual K H}
    {v w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0)
    (hpair : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n)
    (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i) :
    P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam ∉
      cone P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := hw
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hwl
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hwl
  have he : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
      lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - P.rootOf (n • l) := by
    simp only [weylDot]
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', hpair, map_sub, map_smul,
      ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, hwl, map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
    abel
  rintro ⟨k, hk, hke⟩
  rw [he, sub_right_inj] at hke
  have hkl := P.rootOf_injective hke
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hl0
  have h1 : 0 ≤ k j := hk j
  have h2 : (n • l) j = k j := congrFun hkl j
  have h3 : 0 < l j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hl j) (Ne.symm hj)
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h2
  have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hn h3
  linarith

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_verma_shortExact_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem translation_verma_shortExact_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i) :
    ∃ S : LieSubmodule K 𝔤
        (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν),
      S ≤ centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ⊗[K]
        IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam) ∧
      Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
        (w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ S) ∧
      Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        (centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ⊗[K]
          IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)).map
            (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s := P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i with hs
  set a := P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam with ha
  set b := P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * s) lam with hb
  
  have hint := integral_sub_of_apply_eq hA hν hz hzν
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hint v i).mpr ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hμα⟩
  change P.corootPairing _ (lam + P.rho) v i = n at hn
  have hn0 : n < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hlam v i hv n hn) (by rintro rfl; exact hlamα (by simp [hn]))
  have hab : b ∉ cone P a := weylDot_mul_reflectionOf_notMem_cone hA hn0 hn hw
  have hne : a ≠ b := fun h ↦ hab (h ▸ mem_cone_self a)
  
  obtain ⟨N, F, x, S, hmono, hF0, hFlast, hiso, hzero, hbij⟩ :=
    exists_translation_verma_filtration_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hν hz hzν w
  have hsμ : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan s μ = μ := by
    simp only [weylDot, hs, reflectionOf_apply', hμα, zero_smul, sub_zero, add_sub_cancel_right]
  obtain ⟨j₁, hj₁, hxa⟩ := hbij.surjOn ⟨1, by simp [weylDot], by rw [mul_one]⟩
  obtain ⟨j₂, hj₂, hxb⟩ := hbij.surjOn ⟨s, hsμ, rfl⟩
  have hS : ∀ j ∈ S, j = j₁ ∨ j = j₂ := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨w', hw', hxj⟩ := hbij.mapsTo hj
    rcases eq_one_or_eq_of_weylDot_eq hA
      (fun v' i' h0 ↦ reflectionOf_eq_of_apply_root_eq hA (hwall v' i' h0)) hw' with rfl | rfl
    · left
      exact hbij.injOn hj hj₁ (by rw [hxj, mul_one, hxa])
    · right
      exact hbij.injOn hj hj₂ (by rw [hxj, hxb])
  have h12 : j₁ ≠ j₂ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hne (hxa.symm.trans hxb)
  have hzero' : ∀ j, j ≠ j₁ → j ≠ j₂ →
      (F j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (F j.castSucc)) = ⊥ := fun j h1 h2 ↦
    hzero j fun hj ↦ (hS j hj).elim h1 h2
  have hX : ⨆ μ', weightSpaceOfMap
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν) (h P)
        μ' = ⊤ :=
    ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P _).tensorProduct
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν)).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h12 with hlt | hlt
  · 
    have e₁ := hiso j₁ hj₁
    have e₂ := hiso j₂ hj₂
    rw [hxa] at e₁
    rw [hxb] at e₂
    obtain ⟨hle, ⟨eN⟩, ⟨eQ⟩⟩ := exists_of_two_steps F hmono hF0 hlt hzero' e₁ e₂
    rw [hFlast] at hle eQ
    exact exists_verma_lieSubmodule_of_extension hX hle eN eQ hab
  · 
    have e₁ := hiso j₂ hj₂
    have e₂ := hiso j₁ hj₁
    rw [hxb] at e₁
    rw [hxa] at e₂
    obtain ⟨hle, eN, eQ⟩ := exists_of_two_steps F hmono hF0 hlt
      (fun j h1 h2 ↦ hzero' j h2 h1) e₁ e₂
    rw [hFlast] at hle eQ
    exact ⟨_, hle, eN, eQ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.of_surjective
statement:
theorem of_surjective (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : IsCategoryO P V
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : ∀ μ, (VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ μ).map (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) ≤
      weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := fun μ ↦ by
    rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ hm
  have htop : ⨆ μ, (VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ μ).map (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hφ x
    refine Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_
    have hm : m ∈ ⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf k) := by
      rw [VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
    exact (iSup₂_le fun k _ ↦ le_iSup (VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ) _ :
      _ ≤ ⨆ μ, VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ μ) hm
  have hle : ∀ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ ≤
      (VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ μ).map (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) := fun μ x hx ↦
    mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) _ hmap hx (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  refine ⟨eq_top_iff.mpr (htop ▸ iSup_mono hmap), fun μ ↦ ?_, ⟨{Λ}, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · have := VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace P Λ μ
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (hle μ)
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
    exact ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_singleton_self Λ,
      VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ φ hφ hx hx0⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isCategoryO
statement: theorem VermaModule.isCategoryO (Λ : Dual K H) : IsCategoryO P (VermaModule P Λ)
proof:
:=
  .of_surjective LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO
statement: theorem IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO (Λ : Dual K H) : IsCategoryO P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:=
  .of_surjective (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_corootPairing_mul_eq_sum
statement:
lemma exists_corootPairing_mul_eq_sum :
    ∃ d : ι → ℤ, (∀ i, 0 < d i) ∧ ∀ (x : Dual K H) (v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan)
      (i : ι) (k : ι → ℤ), (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf k →
        (d i : K) * P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan x v i =
          ∑ l, ((k l * d l : ℤ) : K) * x (P.coroot l)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  refine ⟨d, hdpos, fun x v i k hvk ↦ ?_⟩
  have hi : (d i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hdpos i).ne'
  have h : P.dualBilinForm S x ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
      d i * P.corootPairing hA x v i := by
    rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S (v⁻¹).2 x, P.inv_apply_apply v,
      dualBilinForm_root_right]
    simp only [S, Symmetrization.ofDiagonal, corootPairing]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [← h, hvk, (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq, P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_corootPairing_eq_sum
statement:
lemma exists_corootPairing_eq_sum {v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι}
    (hv : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℕ, k ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x : Dual K H,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan x v i = ∑ j, (k j : K) * x (P.coroot j)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hd⟩ := exists_corootPairing_mul_eq_sum (P := P) hF
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hvk⟩ := hv
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hvk
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hvk
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk0
  have hkj : 0 < k j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hk j) (Ne.symm hj)
  have hN : (0 : ℤ) < ∑ l, k l * d l :=
    Finset.sum_pos' (fun l _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hk l) (hdpos l).le)
      ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, mul_pos hkj (hdpos j)⟩
  have hρ : (d i : K) * P.corootPairing hA P.rho v i = ((∑ l, k l * d l : ℤ) : K) := by
    rw [hd P.rho v i k hvk]
    simp
  obtain ⟨k', hk', ε, hε, h⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_eq_sum hA (v⁻¹).2 i
  have hcp : ∀ x : Dual K H, P.corootPairing hA x v i = ε * ∑ l, (k' l : K) * x (P.coroot l) :=
    fun x ↦ h x
  have hM : 0 ≤ ∑ l, k' l := Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ ↦ hk' l
  have hint : d i * (ε * ∑ l, k' l) = ∑ l, k l * d l := by
    have := hcp P.rho
    simp only [rho_coroot, mul_one] at this
    rw [this] at hρ
    exact_mod_cast hρ
  have hε1 : ε = 1 := by
    rcases hε with rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · nlinarith [hdpos i]
  subst hε1
  refine ⟨fun l ↦ (k' l).toNat, ?_, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have : ∑ l, k' l = (0 : ℤ) := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ ↦ by
      have := congrFun h0 l
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, Int.toNat_eq_zero] at this
      exact le_antisymm this (hk' l)
    rw [this] at hint
    omega
  · rw [hcp x, Int.cast_one, one_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
    congr 1
    exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hk' l)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_nat_corootPairing
statement:
lemma exists_nat_corootPairing {x : Dual K H} (hx : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℕ, x (P.coroot j) = n)
    {v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι}
    (hv : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan x v i = n
proof:
:= by
  choose n hn using hx
  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := exists_corootPairing_eq_sum hF hv
  exact ⟨∑ j, k j * n j, by rw [hk x]; push_cast; simp [hn]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_nat_corootPairing_add_rho
statement:
lemma exists_nat_corootPairing_add_rho {x : Dual K H} (hx : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℕ, x (P.coroot j) = n)
    {v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι}
    (hv : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (x + P.rho) v i = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  choose n hn using hx
  obtain ⟨k, hk0, hk⟩ := exists_corootPairing_eq_sum hF hv
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk0
  have hs : 1 ≤ ∑ l, k l := le_trans (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj)
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (k l)) (Finset.mem_univ j))
  refine ⟨∑ l, k l * n l + (∑ l, k l - 1), ?_⟩
  rw [hk]
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot, hn]
  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hs]
  simp only [mul_add, mul_one, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.wallWeight_coroot
statement:
lemma wallWeight_coroot (i j : ι) :
    P.wallWeight i (P.coroot j) = if j = i then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst h; simp [wallWeight]
  · simp [wallWeight, h, Ne.symm h]

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_root_eq_of_corootPairing_wallWeight
statement:
lemma apply_root_eq_of_corootPairing_wallWeight {u : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    {i j : ι} (hu : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan u j)
    (h0 : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (P.wallWeight i) u j = 0) :
    (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) = P.root i
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := exists_corootPairing_eq_sum hF hu
  
  have hkl : ∀ l, l ≠ i → k l = 0 := by
    have hsum : ((∑ l, if l = i then 0 else k l : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← h0, hk]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
      rw [wallWeight_coroot]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hsum' : (∑ l, if l = i then 0 else k l) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hsum
    intro l hl
    have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp hsum') l (Finset.mem_univ l)
    simpa [hl] using this
  have hki : ∀ x : Dual K H, P.corootPairing hA x u j = (k i : K) * x (P.coroot i) := by
    intro x
    rw [hk, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun l _ hl ↦ by simp [hkl l hl]) (by simp)]
  obtain ⟨k'', hk''0, hk''⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hd⟩ := exists_corootPairing_mul_eq_sum (P := P) hF
  have hk''l : ∀ l, l ≠ i → k'' l = 0 := by
    intro l hl
    have h := hd (LinearMap.proj l ∘ₗ P.corootCoord) u j k'' hk''
    rw [hki] at h
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, corootCoord_coroot, LinearMap.coe_proj,
      Function.eval, Pi.single_apply, hl, ite_false, mul_zero, mul_ite, mul_one] at h
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true] at h
    have : k'' l * d l = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h.symm
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h' | h'
    · exact h'
    · exact absurd h' (hdpos l).ne'
  have hβ : P.rootOf k'' = (k'' i : K) • P.root i := by
    rw [rootOf_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun l _ hl ↦ by simp [hk''l l hl]) (by simp)]
  
  have h2 : P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)) u j = 2 := by
    rw [corootPairing, P.inv_apply_apply u]
    exact P.root_coroot_self hA j
  rw [hk'', hβ, hki] at h2
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, P.root_coroot_self hA, smul_eq_mul] at h2
  have h1 : (k i : ℤ) * k'' i = 1 := by
    have : ((k i : ℤ) * k'' i : K) * 2 = 1 * 2 := by
      push_cast; linear_combination h2
    exact_mod_cast mul_right_cancel₀ (two_ne_zero) this
  have hk''1 : k'' i = 1 := by
    have h0i : 0 ≤ k'' i := hk''0 i
    rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one' h1 with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
    · exact h
    · omega
  rw [hk'', hβ, hk''1, Int.cast_one, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_forall_not_isPosRoot_mul
statement:
lemma exists_forall_not_isPosRoot_mul :
    ∃ y : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan, ∀ v i,
      P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ¬P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (y * v) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := P.exists_isAntidominant_weylDot hF 0
  refine ⟨y⁻¹, fun v i hv hyv ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_corootPairing_add_rho (P := P) hF (x := 0)
    (fun j ↦ ⟨0, by simp⟩) hyv
  have h := hy v i hv (n + 1)
  rw [zero_add, sub_add_cancel, corootPairing_apply, ← zero_add P.rho, hn] at h
  exact absurd (h (by push_cast; ring)) (by omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_mul_of_not
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvs := (P.isPosRoot_or v i).resolve_left hv
  refine (P.isPosRoot_or (y * v) i).resolve_right fun h ↦ hy _ _ hvs ?_
  rwa [← mul_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg
statement:
lemma exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg {v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan} {j : ι}
    (hv : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v j) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan
      (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ + P.rho) v j = -(n + 1 : K)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hn : ¬P.IsPosRoot hA (y⁻¹ * v) j := fun h ↦ hy _ _ h (by rwa [← mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel, one_mul])
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_corootPairing_add_rho hF hΛ ((P.isPosRoot_or _ j).resolve_left hn)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [weylDot_add_rho, corootPairing_apply, ← neg_neg (P.corootPairing hA _ _ j),
    ← corootPairing_mul_simple, hn]

name: Matrix.Realization.isAntidominant_weylDot
statement:
lemma isAntidominant_weylDot : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan
    (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro v j hv m hm
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg hF hy hΛ hv
  rw [hn] at hm
  have : (m : K) = ((-(n + 1 : ℤ)) : ℤ) := by rw [← hm]; push_cast; ring
  have := Int.cast_injective this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.not_isPosRoot_inv_mul
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  hy _ _ h (by rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul])

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_one
statement: lemma isPosRoot_one (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) : P.IsPosRoot hA 1 i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ⟨Pi.single i 1, Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.not_isPosRoot_simple
statement:
lemma not_isPosRoot_simple (i : ι) : ¬P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan
    ((P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  P.not_isPosRoot_and (isPosRoot_one hF.isGeneralizedCartan i) (by rwa [one_mul])

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_mul_simple
statement:
lemma isPosRoot_mul_simple (i : ι) : P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan
    (y * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i
proof:
:=
  isPosRoot_mul_of_not hy (not_isPosRoot_simple hF i)

name: Matrix.Realization.isAntidominant_wall
statement:
lemma isAntidominant_wall (i : ι) : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan
    ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  intro v j hv m hm
  have hb : ∀ l, ∃ n : ℕ, P.wallWeight i (P.coroot l) = n := fun l ↦ by
    rw [wallWeight_coroot]; split_ifs
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_corootPairing hF hb
    ((P.isPosRoot_or _ j).resolve_left (not_isPosRoot_inv_mul hF hy hv))
  rw [sub_add_cancel, corootPairing_apply, ← neg_neg (P.corootPairing hA _ _ j),
    ← corootPairing_mul_simple, hn] at hm
  have : (m : K) = ((-(n : ℤ)) : ℤ) := by rw [← hm]; push_cast; ring
  have := Int.cast_injective this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_wall_mul_simple
statement:
lemma corootPairing_wall_mul_simple (i : ι) : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan
    ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho + P.rho)
      (y * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_add_cancel, corootPairing_apply, show y⁻¹ * (y *
    (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) =
      1 * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i by group,
    corootPairing_mul_simple, corootPairing_one, wallWeight_coroot,
    ite_eq_left_iff.mpr (fun h => absurd rfl h), neg_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_weylDot_mul_simple
statement:
lemma corootPairing_weylDot_mul_simple (i : ι) : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan
    (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ + P.rho)
      (y * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i = -(Λ (P.coroot i) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weylDot_add_rho, corootPairing_apply, show y⁻¹ * (y *
    (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) =
      1 * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i by group,
    corootPairing_mul_simple, corootPairing_one]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_root_eq_or_of_corootPairing_wall
statement:
lemma apply_root_eq_or_of_corootPairing_wall (i : ι) {v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    {j : ι} (h0 : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan
      ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho + P.rho) v j = 0) :
    (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) =
        ((y * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i :
          P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
      (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) =
        -((y * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i :
          P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  rw [sub_add_cancel, corootPairing_apply] at h0
  rw [mul_simple_apply_root, neg_neg]
  have hv : v = y * (y⁻¹ * v) := by group
  rcases P.isPosRoot_or (y⁻¹ * v) j with hu | hu
  · right
    rw [hv, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply,
      apply_root_eq_of_corootPairing_wallWeight hF hu h0]
  · left
    have h0' : P.corootPairing hA (P.wallWeight i) (y⁻¹ * v *
        (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j) j = 0 := by
      rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, h0, neg_zero]
    have h := apply_root_eq_of_corootPairing_wallWeight hF hu h0'
    rw [mul_simple_apply_root, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg] at h
    rw [hv, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, h, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.isDominantIntegral_sub_wallWeight
statement:
lemma isDominantIntegral_sub_wallWeight (i : ι) :
    P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro j
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ j
  refine ⟨n + if j = i then 1 else 0, ?_⟩
  rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot, wallWeight_coroot]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.inv_apply_weylDot_sub_wall
statement:
lemma inv_apply_weylDot_sub_wall (i : ι) :
    ((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ -
        ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho)) =
      Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i
proof:
:= by
  rw [weylDot, show ∀ a b c : Dual K H, a - c - (b - c) = a - b from fun a b c ↦ by abel,
    ← map_sub, P.inv_apply_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.isDominantIntegral_wall_sub_weylDot
statement:
lemma isDominantIntegral_wall_sub_weylDot (i : ι) :
    P.IsDominantIntegral ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho -
      P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  intro j
  have hn : ¬P.IsPosRoot hA y⁻¹ j := fun h ↦ hy _ _ h (by
    rw [mul_inv_cancel]; exact isPosRoot_one hA j)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_corootPairing hF (isDominantIntegral_sub_wallWeight hΛ i)
    ((P.isPosRoot_or _ j).resolve_left hn)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [show (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho -
      P.weylDot hA y Λ = -(y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i) by
    rw [weylDot, map_sub, map_add]; abel,
    LinearMap.neg_apply, apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing, ← neg_neg (P.corootPairing hA _ _ j),
    ← corootPairing_mul_simple, hn, neg_neg]

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.extClass_comp_ne_zero
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := contravariant_sequence_exact₁ hS Y x₁ (add_comm 1 n) h
  rw [h₂ x₂, comp_zero] at hx₂
  exact hx₁ hx₂.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isZero_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem isZero_of_subsingleton (X : CategoryO.{u} P) [Subsingleton X.obj] : Limits.IsZero X
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton ((IsObj.{u} P).ι.obj X) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton X.obj)
  exact Limits.IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero (IsObj.{u} P).ι _
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_ext_verma_simple_ne_zero_succ
statement:
theorem exists_ext_verma_simple_ne_zero_succ (i : ι) {u : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hu : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (u * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i)
    {n : ℕ} (h : ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (u * (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) Λ)) (simple P Λ) n, x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan u Λ)) (simple P Λ) (n + 1),
      x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_forall_not_isPosRoot_mul (P := P) hA
  set s := (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i
  set lam := P.weylDot hA' y Λ
  set μ := (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.wallWeight i) - P.rho
  set ν := Λ + P.rho - P.wallWeight i
  set ν' := μ - lam
  set v₀ := y * s
  set w := u * y⁻¹
  have hlam := isAntidominant_weylDot hA hy hΛ
  have hμ := isAntidominant_wall hA hy i
  have hfacet : ∀ v j, P.IsPosRoot hA' v j → P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v j = 0 →
      P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v j = 0 := fun v j hv h0 ↦ by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg hA hy hΛ hv
    rw [hm] at h0
    exact (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero m (neg_eq_zero.mp h0)).elim
  have hν := isDominantIntegral_sub_wallWeight hΛ i
  have hν' := isDominantIntegral_wall_sub_weylDot hA hy hΛ i
  have hzν : ((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam - μ) = ν :=
    inv_apply_weylDot_sub_wall (hF := hA) (y := y) i
  have hv₀ : P.IsPosRoot hA' v₀ i := isPosRoot_mul_simple hA hy i
  have hμα := corootPairing_wall_mul_simple (hF := hA) (y := y) i
  have hwall := fun v' i' (h0 : P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0) ↦
    apply_root_eq_or_of_corootPairing_wall hA i h0
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hΛ i
  have hlamα : P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v₀ i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [corootPairing_weylDot_mul_simple (hF := hA) (y := y) (Λ := Λ) i, hm]
    intro h0
    exact Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero m (neg_eq_zero.mp h0)
  have hw : P.IsPosRoot hA' (w * v₀) i := by
    rwa [show w * v₀ = u * s by simp only [w, v₀]; group]
  set chiL := centralCharacter P lam
  set chiM := centralCharacter P μ
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν'
  let Xo := (translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM).obj
    (verma P (P.weylDot hA' w lam))
  let eX : Xo.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)) :=
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM
      (verma P (P.weylDot hA' w lam)).obj)).symm.trans
      (centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν') chiL chiM
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w lam))).symm)
  obtain ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hfg⟩ := wallCrossing_verma_shortExact P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν
    (y⁻¹).2 hzν hν' (1 : P.weylGroup hA').2 rfl hv₀ hμα hwall hlamα hw eX
  let Θo := (translationFunctor (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL).obj Xo
  let F : verma P (P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v₀ i) lam) ⟶ Θo :=
    (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).toLieModuleHom.comp
      (f.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P _)).symm.toLieModuleHom)))
  let G : Θo ⟶ verma P (P.weylDot hA' w lam) :=
    (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom ((ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).toLieModuleHom.comp
      (g.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.toLieModuleHom)))
  have hFG : F ≫ G = 0 := by
    ext x
    exact (hfg _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩
  let S := ShortComplex.mk F G hFG
  have hS : S.ShortExact := shortExact_of_lie (fun a b hab ↦ hf hab) (fun b ↦ hg b)
    (fun b hb ↦ (hfg b).mp hb)
  have h₂ : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} S.X₂ (simple P Λ) n, x = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨z'', hz'', hdom, ⟨eD⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual (P := P) hA hν
    have hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, lam (P.coroot j) = z := fun j ↦ by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_corootPairing_weylDot_eq_neg hA hy hΛ (isPosRoot_one hA' j)
      rw [corootPairing_one, LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hk
      exact ⟨-(k + 2 : ℤ), by push_cast; linear_combination hk⟩
    have hsimp : (⟨P.reflection hA' i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i⟩ :
        P.weylGroup hA') = s := Subtype.ext (coxeterSystem_simple P hA' i).symm
    have hC : ¬P.UpperClosureCondition hA'
        (((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho))
        (((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho)) := by
      have key := not_upperClosureCondition_of_wall (P := P) hA (a := lam + P.rho) (b := μ + P.rho)
        (v := v₀) (w := s * y⁻¹) (i := i) hμα (n := -((m : ℤ) + 1)) (by omega) (by
          rw [corootPairing_weylDot_mul_simple (hF := hA) (y := y) (Λ := Λ) i, hm]; push_cast; ring)
        (by
          rw [show s * y⁻¹ * v₀ = 1 by simp [v₀, s, mul_assoc]]
          exact isPosRoot_one hA' i)
      rwa [show s * y⁻¹ * P.reflectionOf hA' v₀ i = y⁻¹ by
        simp [reflectionOf, hsimp, v₀, s, mul_assoc]] at key
    have hsub := translation_irreducible_of_not_upperClosureCondition_of_isAntidominant P hA
      hlam hμ hfacet hdom (z := z'' * ((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA') : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H))
      (mul_mem hz'' (y⁻¹).2) (by
        rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, show μ - lam = -(lam - μ) by abel, map_neg, hzν])
      y⁻¹ (by rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_top hA' hint]; trivial) hC
    have hΛ' : P.weylDot hA' y⁻¹ lam = Λ := by
      rw [← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one]
    rw [hΛ'] at hsub
    let T' := (translationFunctor (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) chiL chiM).obj
      (simple P Λ)
    have : Subsingleton T'.obj := (((ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.trans
      ((centralTranslationEquiv P _ chiL chiM
        (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).symm).trans
        (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) chiL chiM eD))).toEquiv
      ).subsingleton
    intro x
    have hz := Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_right (isZero_of_subsingleton T')
      (extTranslationEquiv (IrreducibleModule P ν) chiM chiL Xo (simple P Λ) n x)
    exact (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp hz
  have h1 : P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v₀ i) lam = P.weylDot hA' (u * s) Λ := by
    have hsimp : (⟨P.reflection hA' i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i⟩ :
        P.weylGroup hA') = s := Subtype.ext (coxeterSystem_simple P hA' i).symm
    rw [← weylDot_mul]
    congr 1
    simp [reflectionOf, hsimp, w, v₀, s, mul_assoc]
  have h3 : P.weylDot hA' w lam = P.weylDot hA' u Λ := by
    rw [← weylDot_mul]
    simp [w]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
  have hx' : ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P (P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v₀ i) lam))
      (simple P Λ) n, x ≠ 0 := by rw [h1]; exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := hx'
  rw [← h3]
  exact ⟨_, Abelian.Ext.extClass_comp_ne_zero hS h₂ (x₁ := x₁) hx₁⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_ext_verma_weylDot_simple_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ext_verma_weylDot_simple_ne_zero :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan),
    (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w = l →
    ∃ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) (simple P Λ) l,
      x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  intro l
  induction l with
  | zero =>
    intro w hw
    rw [(P.coxeterSystem hA').length_eq_zero_iff.mp hw, weylDot_one]
    have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P Λ
    have : Nontrivial (simple.{u} P Λ).obj :=
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
    refine ⟨Abelian.Ext.mk₀ ((IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom
      (toSimple P Λ (simple P Λ) (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).symm))), ?_⟩
    rw [Ne, Abelian.Ext.mk₀_eq_zero_iff]
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_ne (0 : (simple.{u} P Λ).obj)
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := surjective_toSimple Λ (simple P Λ)
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).symm a
    exact ha (congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom.hom b) h0)
  | succ l ih =>
    intro w hw
    have hw1 : w ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hw
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (P.coxeterSystem hA').exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw1
    have hl := (P.coxeterSystem hA').isRightDescent_iff.mp hi
    have hpos : P.IsPosRoot hA' (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i) i := by
      rw [isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent]
      exact (P.coxeterSystem hA').isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul.mp hi
    exact exists_ext_verma_simple_ne_zero_succ hA hΛ i hpos (ih _ (by omega))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.projectiveDimension_verma_weylDot
statement:
theorem projectiveDimension_verma_weylDot (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    projectiveDimension (verma.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) =
      ((P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · exact (projectiveDimension_le_iff _ _).mpr (hasProjectiveDimensionLT_verma_weylDot hA hΛ w)
  · rw [projectiveDimension_ge_iff]
    intro h
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ext_verma_weylDot_simple_ne_zero hA hΛ _ w rfl
    exact hx (x.eq_zero_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLT _ le_rfl)

proof:

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_nNegRootSpace
statement:
lemma map_nNegRootSpace (α : P.posWeights) :
    (nNegRootSpace P α).map (nNegIncl P) = rootSpace P (-(α : Dual K H))
proof:
:= by

  exact inf_eq_right.mpr (rootSpace_neg_le_nNeg P α.2)

name: iSupIndep.of_map
statement:
lemma _root_.iSupIndep.of_map {R M N κ : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {g : M →ₗ[R] N} (hg : Function.Injective g)
    {p : κ → Submodule R M} (hp : iSupIndep fun i ↦ (p i).map g) : iSupIndep p
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hx hx'
  have hx'' : g x ∈ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), (p j).map g := by
    simp only [← Submodule.map_iSup]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx'
  have := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (hp i) (g x) (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx) hx''
  exact hg (this.trans (map_zero g).symm)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isInternal_nNegRootSpace
statement: theorem isInternal_nNegRootSpace : DirectSum.IsInternal (nNegRootSpace P)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top ?_ ?_
  · refine iSupIndep.of_map (nNegIncl_injective P) ?_
    simp_rw [map_nNegRootSpace]
    exact (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (h P)).comp
      (f := fun α : P.posWeights ↦ -(α : Dual K H)) fun α β hαβ ↦
        Subtype.ext (neg_injective hαβ)
  · apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (nNegIncl_injective P)
    rw [Submodule.map_iSup, Submodule.map_top, range_nNegIncl, nNeg_toSubmodule_eq]
    simp_rw [map_nNegRootSpace]
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun α ↦ ?_) (iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ ?_)
    · exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun μ (_ : μ ∈ P.negWeights) ↦ rootSpace P μ) _
        (neg_mem_negWeights P α.2)
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hμ
      exact le_iSup (fun α : P.posWeights ↦ rootSpace P (-(α : Dual K H))) ⟨_, k, hk, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_nNegRootSpace
statement:
lemma finrank_nNegRootSpace (α : P.posWeights) :
    finrank K (nNegRootSpace P α) = finrank K (rootSpace P (-(α : Dual K H)))
proof:
:= by

    (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ (nNegIncl_injective P) (nNegRootSpace P α))]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegBasis_mem
statement:
lemma nNegBasis_mem (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    ((nNegBasis P x : nNeg P) : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-x.root)
proof:
:=
  (isInternal_nNegRootSpace P).collectedBasis_mem
    (fun α ↦ Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq K _ (finrank_nNegRootSpace P α)) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.listProd_smul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma listProd_smul_mem_weightSpace (l : List (NegRootIndex P)) {μ : Dual K H}
    {m : VermaModule P Λ} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace P Λ μ) :
    (l.map fun x ↦ ιᵤ ((nNegBasis P x : nNeg P) : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)).prod • m ∈
      weightSpace P Λ (μ - (l.map NegRootIndex.root).sum)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa using hm
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.sum_cons, mul_smul, ← lie_eq_smul]
    convert lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (nNegBasis_mem P a) ih using 2
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.sum_sort_toMultiset
statement:
lemma sum_sort_toMultiset (s : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    (((Finsupp.toMultiset s).sort (· ≤ ·)).map NegRootIndex.root).sum = negRootWt P s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.sum_coe, ← Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sort_eq, Finsupp.toMultiset_map,
    Finsupp.sum_toMultiset, negRootWt, Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (h := fun a n ↦ n • a)
      (fun _ ↦ zero_nsmul _) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_nsmul _ _ _)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace (s : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    pbwBasisVerma P Λ s ∈ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - negRootWt P s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pbwBasisVerma, Basis.map_apply, pbwBasis_apply, equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_pbwMonomial,
    pbwMonomial, ← sum_sort_toMultiset]
  exact listProd_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ _ (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_span
statement:
theorem weightSpace_eq_span (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P Λ μ =
      Submodule.span K (pbwBasisVerma P Λ '' {s | Λ - negRootWt P s = μ})
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ ν, Submodule.span K (pbwBasisVerma P Λ '' {s | Λ - negRootWt P s = ν}) ≤
      weightSpace P Λ ν := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace P Λ s
  refine le_antisymm (fun m hm ↦ mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) _ hle hm ?_) (hle μ)
  have htop : Submodule.span K (Set.range (pbwBasisVerma P Λ)) ≤
      ⨆ ν, Submodule.span K (pbwBasisVerma P Λ '' {s | Λ - negRootWt P s = ν}) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (Λ - negRootWt P s)
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩)
  exact htop (by rw [(pbwBasisVerma P Λ).span_eq]; trivial)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpace P Λ μ) = Nat.card {s | Λ - negRootWt P s = μ}
proof:
:= by
  set B := pbwBasisVerma P Λ
  have hli : LinearIndepOn K id (B '' {s | Λ - negRootWt P s = μ}) :=
    ((linearIndepOn_id_range_iff B.injective).mpr B.linearIndependent).mono
      (Set.image_subset_range _ _)
  rw [weightSpace_eq_span, finrank, rank_span_set hli, ← Nat.card.eq_1,
    Nat.card_image_of_injective B.injective]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_sub
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_sub (β : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpace P Λ (Λ - β)) = kostantPartition P β
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_weightSpace, kostantPartition]
  exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun s ↦ sub_right_inj)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.coeffAt_character
statement:
theorem coeffAt_character (β : Dual K H) :

proof:
:= by

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finite_dotOrbitAbove
statement: theorem finite_dotOrbitAbove (μ : Dual K H) : (dotOrbitAbove P hA μ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  refine (Set.finite_range fun w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan ↦
    P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ).subset ?_
  rintro κ ⟨⟨w, rfl⟩, -⟩
  exact ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ncard_dotOrbitAbove_lt
statement:
theorem ncard_dotOrbitAbove_lt {μ κ : Dual K H} (hκ : κ ∈ dotOrbitAbove P hA μ) :
    (dotOrbitAbove P hA κ).ncard < (dotOrbitAbove P hA μ).ncard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hμκ, hne⟩ := hκ
  have hsub : dotOrbitAbove P hA κ ⊆ dotOrbitAbove P hA μ := by
    rintro ν ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩, hκν, hne'⟩
    refine ⟨⟨y * x, by rw [hx, weylDot_mul]⟩, mem_cone_trans hμκ hκν, fun h ↦ hne' ?_⟩
    subst h
    exact eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hκν hμκ
  exact Set.ncard_lt_ncard ((Set.ssubset_iff_of_subset hsub).mpr
    ⟨κ, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hμκ, hne⟩, fun h ↦ h.2.2 rfl⟩) (finite_dotOrbitAbove hA μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_eq_zero_of_ncard_lt
statement:
theorem ext_verma_eq_zero_of_ncard_lt : ∀ (n : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H),
    (dotOrbitAbove P hA μ).ncard < n → ∀ (Y : CategoryO.{u} P)
      (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) Y n), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro μ h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
  intro μ hμ Y x
  refine ext_succ_verma_eq_zero Y μ n (fun κ hκ hne z ↦ ?_) x
  have hlink := VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hκ
  rw [← weylDot_one P hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ] at hlink
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_weylDot_eq P hA.isGeneralizedCartan hlink
  have hmem : κ ∈ dotOrbitAbove P hA μ :=
    ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hκ, fun h ↦ hne h.symm⟩
  exact ih κ (by have := ncard_dotOrbitAbove_lt hA hmem; omega) Y z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_verma
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_verma (μ : Dual K H) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT (verma.{u} P μ) ((dotOrbitAbove P hA μ).ncard + 1)
proof:
:=
  HasProjectiveDimensionLT.mk fun i hi ⦃Y⦄ x ↦
    ext_verma_eq_zero_of_ncard_lt hA i μ (by omega) Y x
