name: LieAlgebra.Basis.ad_e_pow_e_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ad_e_pow_e_eq_zero {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K L (B.e i) ^ ((-B.A j i).toNat + 1)) (B.e j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, -B.A j i = n :=
    ⟨_, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by linarith [hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm])).symm⟩
  rw [hn, Int.toNat_natCast]
  have hP : (B.sl2 i).symm.HasPrimitiveVectorWith (B.e j) (n : K) :=
    { ne_zero := (B.sl2 j).e_ne_zero
      lie_h := by
        rw [neg_lie, B.lie_h_e, ← neg_smul, hn, natCast_zsmul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
      lie_e := by rw [← lie_skew, B.lie_e_f_ne j i hij.symm, neg_zero] }
  exact hP.pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero_of_eq_nat rfl

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.ad_f_pow_f_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ad_f_pow_f_eq_zero {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K L (B.f i) ^ ((-B.A j i).toNat + 1)) (B.f j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, -B.A j i = n :=
    ⟨_, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by linarith [hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm])).symm⟩
  rw [hn, Int.toNat_natCast]
  have hP : (B.sl2 i).HasPrimitiveVectorWith (B.f j) (n : K) :=
    { ne_zero := (B.sl2 j).f_ne_zero
      lie_h := by
        rw [B.lie_h_f, hn, natCast_zsmul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
      lie_e := B.lie_e_f_ne i j hij }
  exact hP.pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero_of_eq_nat rfl

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.serreIdeal_le_ker_auxHom
statement: lemma serreIdeal_le_ker_auxHom : AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal Q ≤ (auxHom B Q hA).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl | rfl⟩
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker, AuxLieAlgebra.serreE_eq, LieHom.map_ad_pow, auxHom_e,
      auxHom_e]
    exact ad_e_pow_e_eq_zero B hA hij
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker, AuxLieAlgebra.serreF, ← ad_apply K, ← Module.End.mul_apply,
      ← pow_succ, LieHom.map_ad_pow, auxHom_f, auxHom_f]
    exact ad_f_pow_f_eq_zero B hA hij

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.maxIdeal_le_ker_auxHom
statement: lemma maxIdeal_le_ker_auxHom : AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal Q ≤ (auxHom B Q hA).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal Q hA.transpose.isGeneralizedCartan
    hA.transpose.isSymmetrizable]
  exact serreIdeal_le_ker_auxHom B Q hA

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyHom_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma kacMoodyHom_π (x : Q.AuxLieAlgebra) :
    kacMoodyHom B Q hA (KacMoodyAlgebra.π Q x) = auxHom B Q hA x
proof:
:=
  LieIdeal.lift_mkHom _ (auxHom B Q hA) _ x

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyHom_e
statement: @[simp] lemma kacMoodyHom_e (i : ι) : kacMoodyHom B Q hA (KacMoodyAlgebra.e Q i) = B.e i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← KacMoodyAlgebra.π_e, kacMoodyHom_π, auxHom_e]

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyHom_f
statement: @[simp] lemma kacMoodyHom_f (i : ι) : kacMoodyHom B Q hA (KacMoodyAlgebra.f Q i) = B.f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← KacMoodyAlgebra.π_f, kacMoodyHom_π, auxHom_f]

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyHom_h
statement:
lemma kacMoodyHom_h (a : H) :
    kacMoodyHom B Q hA (KacMoodyAlgebra.h Q a) = (corootBasis B Q hA).constr K B.h a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← KacMoodyAlgebra.π_h, kacMoodyHom_π, auxHom_h]

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyHom_h_coroot
statement:
@[simp] lemma kacMoodyHom_h_coroot (i : ι) :
    kacMoodyHom B Q hA (KacMoodyAlgebra.h Q (Q.coroot i)) = B.h i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← KacMoodyAlgebra.π_h, kacMoodyHom_π, auxHom_h_coroot]

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyHom_surjective
statement: theorem kacMoodyHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (kacMoodyHom B Q hA)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieHom.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← B.span_ef, LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_le]
  rintro _ (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · exact ⟨KacMoodyAlgebra.e Q i, kacMoodyHom_e B Q hA i⟩
  · exact ⟨KacMoodyAlgebra.f Q i, kacMoodyHom_f B Q hA i⟩

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyHom_injective
statement: theorem kacMoodyHom_injective : Function.Injective (kacMoodyHom B Q hA)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieHom.ker_eq_bot]
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha⟩ := KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_h_mem_of_ne_bot Q hne
  rw [LieHom.mem_ker, kacMoodyHom_h, Module.Basis.constr_apply_fintype] at ha
  have hc := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp B.linInd _ ha
  exact ha0 ((corootBasis B Q hA).equivFun.injective (funext fun i ↦ by simp [hc i]))

name: LieAlgebra.Basis.kacMoodyEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma kacMoodyEquiv_apply (x : Q.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    kacMoodyEquiv B Q hA x = kacMoodyHom B Q hA x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RootPairing.GeckConstruction.equivKacMoodyAlgebra_e
statement:
@[simp] lemma equivKacMoodyAlgebra_e (i : b.support) :
    equivKacMoodyAlgebra b Q (KacMoodyAlgebra.e Q i) = ⟨e i, e_mem_lieAlgebra i⟩
proof:
:=
  (basis b).kacMoodyHom_e Q _ i

name: RootPairing.GeckConstruction.equivKacMoodyAlgebra_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma equivKacMoodyAlgebra_f (i : b.support) :
    equivKacMoodyAlgebra b Q (KacMoodyAlgebra.f Q i) = ⟨f i, f_mem_lieAlgebra i⟩
proof:
:=
  (basis b).kacMoodyHom_f Q _ i

name: RootPairing.GeckConstruction.equivKacMoodyAlgebra_h_coroot
statement:
@[simp] lemma equivKacMoodyAlgebra_h_coroot (i : b.support) :
    equivKacMoodyAlgebra b Q (KacMoodyAlgebra.h Q (Q.coroot i)) = ⟨h i, h_mem_lieAlgebra i⟩
proof:
:=
  (basis b).kacMoodyHom_h_coroot Q _ i

name: LieAlgebra.lie_f_ad_e_pow_succ
statement:
lemma lie_f_ad_e_pow_succ {e f h v : L} {c : K} (hef : ⁅e, f⁆ = h) (hhe : ⁅h, e⁆ = (2 : K) • e)
    (hfv : ⁅f, v⁆ = 0) (hhv : ⁅h, v⁆ = c • v) (m : ℕ) :
    ⁅f, (ad K L e ^ (m + 1)) v⁆ = -(((m + 1 : K) * (c + m))) • (ad K L e ^ m) v
proof:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ n : ℕ, ⁅h, (ad K L e ^ n) v⁆ = (c + 2 * n) • (ad K L e ^ n) v := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using hhv
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, leibniz_lie, hhe, ih, smul_lie, lie_smul,
        ← add_smul]
      push_cast; congr 1; ring
  have hsucc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : L), ⁅e, (ad K L e ^ n) w⁆ = (ad K L e ^ (n + 1)) w := by
    intro n w; rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_add, pow_one, ad_apply, leibniz_lie, ← lie_skew f e, hef, hfv, lie_zero, add_zero,
      neg_lie, hhv]
    simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [← hsucc, leibniz_lie, ← lie_skew f e, hef, neg_lie, hh, ih, lie_smul, hsucc,
      ← neg_smul, ← add_smul]
    congr 1; push_cast; ring

name: LieHom.map_ad_pow
statement:
lemma _root_.LieHom.map_ad_pow {L' : Type*} [LieRing L']
    [LieAlgebra K L'] (φ : L →ₗ⁅K⁆ L') (x y : L) (n : ℕ) :
    φ ((ad K L x ^ n) y) = (ad K L' (φ x) ^ n) (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, LieHom.map_lie, ih, pow_succ',
      Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]

name: LieAlgebra.ad_neg_pow_apply
statement:
lemma ad_neg_pow_apply (x y : L) (n : ℕ) :
    (ad K L (-x) ^ n) y = (-1 : K) ^ n • (ad K L x ^ n) y
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have e1 : (ad K L (-x) ^ (n + 1)) y = ⁅-x, (ad K L (-x) ^ n) y⁆ := by
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
    have e2 : (ad K L x ^ (n + 1)) y = ⁅x, (ad K L x ^ n) y⁆ := by
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
    rw [e1, e2, ih, neg_lie, lie_smul, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.range_eHom_inf_range_h
statement:
lemma range_eHom_inf_range_h :
    LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P)
      = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ⟨a, ha⟩⟩ ↦ ?_
  have hz' : eHom P z = x := hz
  have h0 : triangularMap P (0, -a, z) = triangularMap P 0 := by
    rw [triangularMap_apply, map_neg, ha, hz', map_zero, zero_add, neg_add_cancel, map_zero]
  have := congr_arg (fun p ↦ p.2.2) (triangularMap_injective P h0)
  simp only [Prod.snd_zero] at this
  rw [← hz', this, map_zero]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_e_mem_eSpan
statement:
lemma lie_e_mem_eSpan (x : P.AuxLieAlgebra) (i : ι) :
    ∀ y ∈ eSpan P x, ⁅e P i, y⁆ ∈ eSpan P x
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i :: l, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [lie_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [lie_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.adProd_mem_rootSpace_of_mem
statement:
lemma adProd_mem_rootSpace_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (l : List ι) : adProd (l.map (e P)) x ∈ rootSpace P (wordWt P l + μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa using hx
  | cons i l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, adProd_cons, wordWt_cons, add_assoc]
    exact lie_mem_rootSpace P (e_mem_rootSpace P i) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_mem_eSpan
statement:
lemma lie_h_mem_eSpan {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) (a : H) :
    ∀ y ∈ eSpan P x, ⁅h P a, y⁆ ∈ eSpan P x
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [adProd_mem_rootSpace_of_mem P hx l a]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩)
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [lie_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [lie_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_f_mem_eSpan
statement:
lemma lie_f_mem_eSpan {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (hfx : ∀ k, ⁅f P k, x⁆ = 0) (j : ι) : ∀ y ∈ eSpan P x, ⁅f P j, y⁆ ∈ eSpan P x
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ l : List ι, ⁅f P j, adProd (l.map (e P)) x⁆ ∈ eSpan P x := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [hfx j]
    | cons i l ih =>
      rw [List.map_cons, adProd_cons, leibniz_lie, ← lie_skew (f P j) (e P i), lie_e_f, neg_lie]
      refine add_mem (neg_mem ?_) (lie_e_mem_eSpan P x i _ ih)
      split_ifs
      · exact lie_h_mem_eSpan P hx _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩)
      · simp
  intro y hy
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hy; exact key l
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [lie_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [lie_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eSpan_le_range_eHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [eSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
  induction l with
  | nil => exact hx
  | cons i l ih =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih
    have hz' : eHom P z = _ := hz
    exact ⟨⁅FreeLieAlgebra.of K i, z⁆, by simp [hz']⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreE_eq
statement: lemma serreE_eq (i j : ι) : serreE P i j = (ad K _ (e P i) ^ ((-A i j).toNat + 1)) (e P j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreE, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_f_ad_e_pow_of_lie_eq_zero
statement:
lemma lie_f_ad_e_pow_of_lie_eq_zero {k i : ι} (hki : ⁅f P k, e P i⁆ = 0) (n : ℕ)
    (y : P.AuxLieAlgebra) : ⁅f P k, (ad K _ (e P i) ^ n) y⁆ = (ad K _ (e P i) ^ n) ⁅f P k, y⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing y with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, ad_apply,
      leibniz_lie, hki, zero_lie, zero_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreE_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma serreE_mem_rootSpace (i j : ι) :
    serreE P i j ∈ rootSpace P (((-A i j).toNat + 1) • P.root i + P.root j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreE_eq]
  induction (-A i j).toNat + 1 with
  | zero => simpa using e_mem_rootSpace P j
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, succ_nsmul', add_assoc]
    exact lie_mem_rootSpace P (e_mem_rootSpace P i) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreE_mem_range_eHom
statement:
lemma serreE_mem_range_eHom (i j : ι) :
    serreE P i j ∈ LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreE_eq]
  induction (-A i j).toNat + 1 with
  | zero => exact ⟨FreeLieAlgebra.of K j, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih
    have hz' : eHom P z = _ := hz
    refine ⟨⁅FreeLieAlgebra.of K i, z⁆, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
    simp [hz']

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_serreE
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_serreE (i j : ι) :
    chevalleyInvolution P (serreE P i j) = (-1 : K) ^ (-A i j).toNat • serreF P i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreE, serreF, LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie, chevalleyInvolution_e,
    chevalleyInvolution_e, neg_lie, lie_neg, neg_neg, ad_neg_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.mem_maxIdeal_of_lie_f_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_maxIdeal_of_lie_f_eq_zero {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (hxe : x ∈ LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra))
    (hfx : ∀ k, ⁅f P k, x⁆ = 0) : x ∈ maxIdeal P
proof:
:= by
  let I := idealOfGenerators (eSpan P x) (lie_e_mem_eSpan P x) (lie_f_mem_eSpan P hx hfx)
    (lie_h_mem_eSpan P hx)
  have hI : I ≤ maxIdeal P := by
    rw [le_maxIdeal_iff, eq_bot_iff]
    refine le_trans (inf_le_inf_right _ (eSpan_le_range_eHom P hxe)) ?_
    rw [range_eHom_inf_range_h]
  exact hI (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_mem_maxIdeal {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ maxIdeal P) :
    chevalleyInvolution P x ∈ maxIdeal P
proof:
:= by
  have hle : LieIdeal.comap (chevalleyInvolution P) (maxIdeal P) ≤ maxIdeal P := by
    rw [le_maxIdeal_iff, eq_bot_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨hy, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
    have hy' : chevalleyInvolution P (h P a) ∈ maxIdeal P := hy
    rw [chevalleyInvolution_h, ← map_neg] at hy'
    have := (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (maxIdeal_inf_range_h P) _
      ⟨hy', LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _⟩
    rw [map_neg, neg_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  apply hle
  change chevalleyInvolution P (chevalleyInvolution P x) ∈ maxIdeal P
  rwa [chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_f_serreE
statement: lemma lie_f_serreE {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ι) : ⁅f P k, serreE P i j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreE_eq]
  set n := (-A i j).toNat
  have hn : (n : ℤ) = -A i j := hA.toNat_neg_eq hij
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst hki
    have hef : ⁅e P k, f P k⁆ = h P (P.coroot k) := lie_e_f_self P k
    have hhe : ⁅h P (P.coroot k), e P k⁆ = (2 : K) • e P k := by
      rw [lie_h_e, P.root_coroot, hA.diag]; simp
    have hfv : ⁅f P k, e P j⁆ = 0 := by rw [← lie_skew, lie_e_f_of_ne P (Ne.symm hij), neg_zero]
    have hhv : ⁅h P (P.coroot k), e P j⁆ = (A k j : K) • e P j := by
      rw [lie_h_e, P.root_coroot]
    rw [lie_f_ad_e_pow_succ hef hhe hfv hhv n]
    have : (A k j : K) + n = 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : (A k j : ℤ) + n = 0)
    simp [this]
  · by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst hkj
      have hki' : ⁅f P k, e P i⁆ = 0 := by rw [← lie_skew, lie_e_f_of_ne P (Ne.symm hki),
        neg_zero]
      have hfe : ⁅f P k, e P k⁆ = -(h P (P.coroot k)) := by rw [← lie_skew, lie_e_f_self]
      rw [lie_f_ad_e_pow_of_lie_eq_zero P hki', hfe, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply,
        lie_neg, ← lie_skew, neg_neg, lie_h_e, P.root_coroot, map_smul]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn0 | hn0
      · have hA0 : A i k = 0 := by omega
        rw [(hA.zero_comm i k).mp hA0]; simp
      · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [hm, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, lie_self, map_zero, smul_zero]
    · have hki' : ⁅f P k, e P i⁆ = 0 := by rw [← lie_skew, lie_e_f_of_ne P (Ne.symm hki),
        neg_zero]
      have hkj' : ⁅f P k, e P j⁆ = 0 := by rw [← lie_skew, lie_e_f_of_ne P (Ne.symm hkj),
        neg_zero]
      rw [lie_f_ad_e_pow_of_lie_eq_zero P hki', hkj', map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreE_mem_maxIdeal
statement: theorem serreE_mem_maxIdeal {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : serreE P i j ∈ maxIdeal P
proof:
:=
  mem_maxIdeal_of_lie_f_eq_zero P (serreE_mem_rootSpace P i j) (serreE_mem_range_eHom P i j)
    (lie_f_serreE P hA hij)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreF_mem_maxIdeal
statement: theorem serreF_mem_maxIdeal {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : serreF P i j ∈ maxIdeal P
proof:
:= by
  have h := chevalleyInvolution_mem_maxIdeal P (serreE_mem_maxIdeal P hA hij)
  rw [chevalleyInvolution_serreE] at h
  have := (maxIdeal P).smul_mem ((-1 : K) ^ (-A i j).toNat) h
  rwa [smul_smul, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_smul] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal
statement: theorem serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal : serreIdeal P ≤ maxIdeal P
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreIdeal, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl | rfl⟩
  exacts [serreE_mem_maxIdeal P hA hij, serreF_mem_maxIdeal P hA hij]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_int_corootPairing_of_integral
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h i
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice
    (P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hA (v⁻¹).2 h) i
  refine ⟨b + a, ?_⟩
  have e : P.corootPairing hA x v i =
      (((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x - x) (P.coroot i) +
        x (P.coroot i) := by
    simp [Matrix.Realization.corootPairing]
  rw [e, hb, ha]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_equiv (he : Nonempty (V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X))
    (f : X ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ restrictedDual P X) :
    Nonempty (V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ restrictedDual P V)
proof:
:=
  he.map fun e ↦ e.trans (f.trans (restrictedDualEquiv P e))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_bot_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_bot_of_isAntidominant {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ) : maxSubmodule P μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hM := VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ
  have key : ∀ y, hM.multiplicity y ≠ 0 → y = μ := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hy
    have hχ := hM.centralCharacter_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P (centralBlock_verma P μ) hy
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwy⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA μ _).mp hχ.symm
    have hwint : (⟨w, hw⟩ : P.weylGroup hA') ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' μ := by
      rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' (μ' := μ + P.rho) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩,
        mem_integralWeylGroup]
      change w (μ + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) ∈ P.rootLattice
      rw [hwy, mem_rootLattice]
      exact ⟨-c, by rw [map_neg]; abel⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := hμ.exists_weylDot_sub_eq_rootOf hA hwint
    change w (μ + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) = P.rootOf k at hwk
    rw [hwy] at hwk
    have h0 : P.rootOf (k + c) = P.rootOf 0 := by
      rw [map_add, map_zero, ← hwk]
      abel
    have hkc := P.rootOf_injective h0
    have hc0 : c = 0 := by
      ext j
      have h1 := congrFun hkc j
      have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k j := hk j
      have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c j := hc j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 ⊢
      omega
    rw [hc0, map_zero, sub_zero]
  have hsub : Subsingleton (maxSubmodule P μ) :=
    (hM.lieSubmodule _).subsingleton_of_multiplicity_eq_zero P fun y ↦ by
      have hadd := hM.multiplicity_eq_add (maxSubmodule P μ) y
      by_cases hy : hM.multiplicity y = 0
      · omega
      · obtain rfl := key y hy
        have h1 := VermaModule.multiplicity_self (P := P) y
        have h2 : (hM.quotient (maxSubmodule P y)).multiplicity y = 1 := by
          simpa using IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq (P := P) y y
        omega
  rw [LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro m hm
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (Subsingleton.elim (⟨m, hm⟩ : maxSubmodule P μ) 0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.nonempty_equiv_irreducible_of_isAntidominant
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P μ))
    ⟨?_, LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _⟩⟩
  rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker,
    maxSubmodule_eq_bot_of_isAntidominant P hA hμ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isDominant_and_isAntidominant_of_singular
statement:
theorem isDominant_and_isAntidominant_of_singular
    (hsing : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν) :
    P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ ∧ P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ ∧
      ∀ y ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y μ = μ
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hint := sub_rho_integral P hA hν hz hzν
  have hzero : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v i = n → n = 0 := by
    intro v i hv n hn
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_int_corootPairing_of_integral P hA' hint v i
    rw [corootPairing_sub, hn] at hm
    have h0 := hsing v i hv (n - m) (by push_cast; linear_combination -hm)
    rw [hn] at h0
    exact_mod_cast h0
  have hdom : P.IsDominant hA' μ := fun v i hv n hn ↦ (hzero v i hv n hn).ge
  have hanti : P.IsAntidominant hA' μ := fun v i hv n hn ↦ (hzero v i hv n hn).le
  refine ⟨hdom, hanti, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  have hWl : P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam = P.integralWeylGroup hA' μ := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' (μ' := lam + P.rho) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩,
      P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' (μ' := μ + P.rho) fun j ↦ by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hint j
        exact ⟨-n, by rw [← neg_sub, LinearMap.neg_apply, hn, Int.cast_neg]⟩,
      ← P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' (μ := μ) (μ' := μ + P.rho) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩]
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hyk⟩ := hanti.exists_weylDot_sub_eq_rootOf hA (hWl ▸ hy)
  have hk0 := hdom.eq_zero_of_apply_eq P hA y.2 hk (by rw [← hyk]; abel)
  rw [hk0, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hyk
  simp only [weylDot, hyk, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_translation_verma_of_singular
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_translation_verma_of_singular
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hsing : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν) {y : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hy : y ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam) :
    FiniteDimensional K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P μ) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
          VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y lam)) ∧
      finrank K (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P μ) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
          VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y lam)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨hdom, hanti, hfix⟩ := isDominant_and_isAntidominant_of_singular P hA hsing hν hz hzν
  have hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
      P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 := fun v i hv h0 ↦
    hsing v i hv 0 (by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero])
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P μ) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ := centralBlock_verma P μ
  have hNχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' y lam)) (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' y.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  have hLO := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hL'O : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm
  have hMO := VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ
  have hMp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (VermaModule P μ) := VermaModule.isProjectiveO P hA hdom
  let adj := translationAdjunction P hMO hLO hMχ hNχ
  let E := centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' y lam))
    (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) eν
  have hT'O := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' y lam)).centralTranslation P hL'O
    (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
  have hT''O := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' y lam)).centralTranslation P
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P (z' (-ν))) (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
  obtain ⟨eV⟩ := translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hanti hfacet hν' hzz hzν' y
  have hcov := VermaModule.isProjectiveCover P μ
  have := hcov.finiteDimensional_hom hT'O
  refine ⟨LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional adj.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [adj.finrank_eq, hcov.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity hMp hT'O,
    IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr hT'O hT''O E μ,
    ← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) hT''O eV μ, hfix y hy]
  exact VermaModule.multiplicity_self (P := P) μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_singular
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_singular
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hsing : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P μ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨hdom, hanti, -⟩ := isDominant_and_isAntidominant_of_singular P hA hsing hν hz hzν
  have hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA' v i → P.corootPairing hA' (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
      P.corootPairing hA' (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 := fun v i hv h0 ↦
    hsing v i hv 0 (by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero])
  obtain ⟨x, -, -, ⟨e⟩⟩ := nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_translation_verma P hA hlam hanti hfacet
    hν hz hzν (w := 1) (one_mem _) fun w' hw' k hk h ↦
      hdom.eq_zero_of_apply_eq P hA hw' hk (by simpa using h)
  rw [weylDot_one] at e
  
  obtain ⟨-, hdim⟩ := finrank_hom_translation_verma_of_singular P hA hlam hsing hν hz hzν
    (y := 1) (one_mem _)
  rw [weylDot_one] at hdim
  have hmult : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity (P.weylDot hA' x lam) ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 := ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (P := P) (hA := hA)
      (Λ := P.weylDot hA' x lam) (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam)
    rw [(lieModuleHomCongr P e (LieModuleEquiv.refl)).finrank_eq, hdim] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    exact one_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hxc⟩ := VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hmult
  
  have hxint : x ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA' lam := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA' (μ' := lam + P.rho) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩,
      mem_integralWeylGroup, mem_rootLattice]
    refine ⟨-c, ?_⟩
    have : (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) = P.weylDot hA' x lam + P.rho := by
      simp [weylDot]
    rw [this, hxc, map_neg]
    abel
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hxk⟩ := hlam.exists_weylDot_sub_eq_rootOf hA hxint
  have hxk' : (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho) = -P.rootOf c := by
    have : (x : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) = P.weylDot hA' x lam + P.rho := by
      simp [weylDot]
    rw [this, hxc]
    abel
  have h0 : P.rootOf (k + c) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [map_add, map_zero, ← hxk, hxk']
    abel
  have hkc := P.rootOf_injective h0
  have hc0 : c = 0 := by
    ext j
    have h1 := congrFun hkc j
    have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k j := hk j
    have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ c j := hc j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 ⊢
    omega
  rw [hc0, map_zero, sub_zero] at hxc
  rw [hxc] at e
  exact ⟨e⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_singular
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_singular
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hsing : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (ProjectiveCover P hA lam))
proof:
:= by
  have hanti := (isDominant_and_isAntidominant_of_singular P hA hsing hν hz hzν).2.1
  let eM := (VermaModule.nonempty_equiv_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hanti).some
  let eD : restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P μ :=
    (restrictedDualEquiv P eM).symm.trans
      ((IrreducibleModule.equivRestrictedDual P μ).symm.trans eM.symm)
  let f : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      restrictedDual P (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P μ)) :=
    (centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) eD).symm.trans (restrictedDualCentralTranslationEquiv P hA hν
        (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)).symm
  exact nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_of_equiv P
    (nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_singular P hA hlam hsing hν hz hzν) f

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isDominantIntegral_of_integral
statement:
theorem exists_isDominantIntegral_of_integral
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = n) :
    ∃ z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, P.IsDominantIntegral (z (lam + P.rho))
proof:
:= by
  have hν : P.IsDominantIntegral (-(lam + P.rho)) := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hint i
    have h1 : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan 1 i :=
      ⟨Pi.single i 1, fun l ↦ by by_cases h : l = i <;> simp [h], by simp⟩
    have hle := hlam 1 i h1 m (by rw [corootPairing_one, hm])
    refine ⟨(-m).toNat, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, hm]
    have : ((-m).toNat : ℤ) = -m := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    exact_mod_cast this.symm
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzν, -⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  exact ⟨z, hz, by rwa [neg_neg] at hzν⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_integral
statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_integral
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = n) :
    ∃ z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, ∃ _ : P.IsDominantIntegral (z (lam + P.rho)),
      Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P (z (lam + P.rho))) (centralCharacter P (-P.rho))
          (centralCharacter P lam) (VermaModule P (-P.rho)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hν⟩ := exists_isDominantIntegral_of_integral P hA hlam hint
  exact ⟨z, hz, hν, nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover_of_singular P hA hlam
    (fun v i _ _ _ ↦ by simp [Matrix.Realization.corootPairing]) hν hz (by rw [sub_neg_eq_add])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_integral
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_integral
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = n) :
    Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA lam ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (ProjectiveCover P hA lam))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hν⟩ := exists_isDominantIntegral_of_integral P hA hlam hint
  exact nonempty_equiv_restrictedDual_projectiveCover_of_singular P hA (μ := -P.rho) hlam
    (fun v i _ _ _ ↦ by simp [Matrix.Realization.corootPairing]) hν hz (by rw [sub_neg_eq_add])

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.range_fHom_inf_range_eHom
statement:
lemma range_fHom_inf_range_eHom :
    LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) ⊓
      LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩⟩ ↦ ?_
  have hy' : fHom P y = x := hy
  have hz' : eHom P z = x := hz
  have h0 : triangularMap P (y, 0, -z) = triangularMap P 0 := by
    rw [triangularMap_apply, map_neg, hy', hz', map_zero, add_zero, add_neg_cancel, map_zero]
  have := congr_arg Prod.fst (triangularMap_injective P h0)
  rw [← hy', show y = 0 from this, map_zero]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
lemma map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap {L' : Type*} [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra K L']
    (g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ⁅K⁆ L') {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) :
    g x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap L' ((g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ[K] L') ∘ₗ h P) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, ← LieHom.map_lie, hx a, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.weightSpaceOfMap_eq_map
statement:
theorem weightSpaceOfMap_eq_map {L' : Type*} [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra K L']
    (g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ⁅K⁆ L') (hg : Function.Surjective g) (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpaceOfMap L' ((g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ[K] L') ∘ₗ h P) μ =
      (rootSpace P μ).map (g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ[K] L')
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hg x
    have htop := iSup_rootSpace_eq_top P
    have hx' : (g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ[K] L') x ∈
        ⨆ ν, (rootSpace P ν).map (g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ[K] L') := by
      rw [← Submodule.map_iSup]
      refine Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_
      exact (iSup₂_le fun ν _ ↦ le_iSup (fun ν ↦ rootSpace P ν) ν)
        (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
    refine mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le _
      (fun ν ↦ (rootSpace P ν).map (g : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ[K] L')) ?_ hx hx'
    intro ν
    rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact fun y hy ↦ map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hy
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact fun y hy ↦ map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hy

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.toSubmodule_eq_inf_sup_inf
statement:
theorem toSubmodule_eq_inf_sup_inf {I : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hI : I ≤ maxIdeal P) :
    I.toSubmodule =
      I.toSubmodule ⊓ LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) ⊔
        I.toSubmodule ⊓ LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le inf_le_left inf_le_left)
  have hle := inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (h P) I.toSubmodule
    (lie_h_mem P _) (P.negWeights ∪ P.posWeights)
  have hI' : I.toSubmodule ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights ∪ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ :=
    le_trans (show I.toSubmodule ≤ (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule from fun _ hx ↦ hI hx)
      (maxIdeal_le P)
  rw [inf_eq_left.mpr hI'] at hle
  refine hle.trans (iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ ?_)
  rcases hμ with hμ | hμ
  · exact le_sup_of_le_left (inf_le_inf_left _ (rootSpace_neg_le P hμ))
  · exact le_sup_of_le_right (inf_le_inf_left _ (rootSpace_pos_le P hμ))

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.triangular_mem_of_le_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem triangular_mem_of_le_maxIdeal {I : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hI : I ≤ maxIdeal P)
    {y z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι} {a : H} (hyaz : fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z ∈ I) :
    fHom P y ∈ I ∧ a = 0 ∧ eHom P z ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have hmem' : fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z ∈ I.toSubmodule := hyaz
  rw [toSubmodule_eq_inf_sup_inf P hI, Submodule.mem_sup] at hmem'
  obtain ⟨r₁, ⟨hr₁, y', rfl⟩, r₂, ⟨hr₂, z', rfl⟩, hr⟩ := hmem'
  have hr' : fHom P y' + eHom P z' = fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z := hr
  have h0 : triangularMap P (y - y', a, z - z') = triangularMap P 0 := by
    rw [triangularMap_apply, map_zero, map_sub, map_sub]
    have : fHom P y - fHom P y' + h P a + (eHom P z - eHom P z') =
        (fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z) - (fHom P y' + eHom P z') := by abel
    rw [this, hr', sub_self]
  have hinj := triangularMap_injective P h0
  simp only [Prod.mk_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hinj
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hinj
  exact ⟨hr₁, rfl, hr₂⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.negPartIdeal_toSubmodule

@[simp] lemma negPartIdeal_toSubmodule {I : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hI : I ≤ maxIdeal P) :

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.posPartIdeal_toSubmodule

@[simp] lemma posPartIdeal_toSubmodule {I : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hI : I ≤ maxIdeal P) :
    (posPartIdeal hI).toSubmodule =

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_posPartIdeal_negPartIdeal
statement:
lemma lie_posPartIdeal_negPartIdeal {I J : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hI : I ≤ maxIdeal P)
    (hJ : J ≤ maxIdeal P) {x y : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ posPartIdeal hI)
    (hy : y ∈ negPartIdeal hJ) : ⁅x, y⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ (negPartIdeal hJ).toSubmodule := (negPartIdeal hJ).lie_mem hy
  have h2 : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ (posPartIdeal hI).toSubmodule := by
    rw [← lie_skew]; exact (posPartIdeal hI).toSubmodule.neg_mem ((posPartIdeal hI).lie_mem hx)
  have := (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (range_fHom_inf_range_eHom P) _ ⟨h1.2, h2.2⟩
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_serreF
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_serreF (i j : ι) :
    chevalleyInvolution P (serreF P i j) = (-1 : K) ^ (-A i j).toNat • serreE P i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreE, serreF, LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie, chevalleyInvolution_f,
    chevalleyInvolution_f, neg_lie, lie_neg, neg_neg, ad_neg_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_mem_serreIdeal {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal P) :
    chevalleyInvolution P x ∈ serreIdeal P
proof:
:= by
  have hle : serreIdeal P ≤ LieIdeal.comap (chevalleyInvolution P) (serreIdeal P) := by
    rw [serreIdeal, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl | rfl⟩
    · change chevalleyInvolution P (serreE P i j) ∈ serreIdeal P
      rw [chevalleyInvolution_serreE]
      exact (serreIdeal P).smul_mem _
        (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, j, hij, Or.inr rfl⟩)
    · change chevalleyInvolution P (serreF P i j) ∈ serreIdeal P
      rw [chevalleyInvolution_serreF]
      exact (serreIdeal P).smul_mem _
        (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, j, hij, Or.inl rfl⟩)
  exact hle hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_h_e
statement: lemma lie_h_e (a : H) (i : ι) : ⁅h P a, e P i⁆ = P.root i a • e P i

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_h_f

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.serre_e
statement:
theorem serre_e {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K _ (e P i) ^ (-A i j).toNat) ⁅e P i, e P j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, j, hij, Or.inl rfl⟩ :
    AuxLieAlgebra.serreE P i j ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal P)
  rwa [AuxLieAlgebra.serreE, LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.serre_f
statement:
theorem serre_f {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ad K _ (f P i) ^ (-A i j).toNat) ⁅f P i, f P j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, j, hij, Or.inr rfl⟩ :
    AuxLieAlgebra.serreF P i j ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal P)
  rwa [AuxLieAlgebra.serreF, LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_triangular
statement:
lemma exists_triangular (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) :
    ∃ y a z, x = fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  obtain ⟨⟨y, a, z⟩, rfl⟩ := (AuxLieAlgebra.triangularEquiv P).surjective x
  exact ⟨y, a, z, by simp [fHom, eHom, map_add]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lieSpan_generators
statement:
lemma lieSpan_generators :
    LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.SerrePresentedAlgebra
      (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P) ∪ Set.range (h P)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro y -
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P y
  have : (LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K P.SerrePresentedAlgebra
      (Set.range (e P) ∪ Set.range (f P) ∪ Set.range (h P))).comap (π P) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← AuxLieAlgebra.lieSpan_generators, LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ ((⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) | ⟨a, rfl⟩) <;> apply LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan
    exacts [Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩), Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩), Or.inr ⟨a, rfl⟩]
  exact (this ▸ LieSubalgebra.mem_top x : x ∈ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.π_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma π_mem_rootSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra}

proof:
:=
  AuxLieAlgebra.map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (π P) hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.rootSpace_eq_map
statement:
theorem rootSpace_eq_map (μ : Dual K H) :
    rootSpace P μ = (AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P μ).map (π P).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  AuxLieAlgebra.weightSpaceOfMap_eq_map P (π P) (π_surjective P) μ

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.e_mem_rootSpace
statement: lemma e_mem_rootSpace (i : ι) : e P i ∈ rootSpace P (P.root i)
proof:
:=

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.f_mem_rootSpace

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.h_mem_rootSpace

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma lie_mem_rootSpace {μ ν : Dual K H} {x y : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P ν) : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ rootSpace P (μ + ν)
proof:
:=
  lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.fHom_mem
statement: lemma fHom_mem (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : fHom P y ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (π P).toLinearMap) (AuxLieAlgebra.fHom_mem P y)
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, ← rootSpace_eq_map] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.eHom_mem
statement: lemma eHom_mem (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : eHom P z ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (π P).toLinearMap) (AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_mem P z)
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, ← rootSpace_eq_map] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.iSup_rootSpace_eq_top
statement: theorem iSup_rootSpace_eq_top : ⨆ μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, rootSpace P μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace P μ := by
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.iSup_rootSpace_eq_top]; trivial
  have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (π P).toLinearMap) hx
  simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup, ← rootSpace_eq_map] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_root
statement: theorem rootSpace_neg_root [CharZero K] (i : ι) : rootSpace P (-P.root i) = K ∙ f P i
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_root, Submodule.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.rootSpace_root
statement: theorem rootSpace_root [CharZero K] (i : ι) : rootSpace P (P.root i) = K ∙ e P i
proof:

  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_root, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_le
statement:
theorem rootSpace_neg_le [CharZero K] {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.negWeights) :
    rootSpace P μ ≤
      LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_le P hμ hx
  exact ⟨y, by rw [← (show AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y = x from hy)]; rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.rootSpace_pos_le
statement:
theorem rootSpace_pos_le [CharZero K] {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    rootSpace P μ ≤
      LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_pos_le P hμ hx
  exact ⟨z, by rw [← (show AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z = x from hz)]; rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_π

@[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_π (x : P.AuxLieAlgebra) :

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_e
statement: @[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_e (i : ι) : chevalleyInvolution P (e P i) = -f P i
proof:

  rw [← π_e, chevalleyInvolution_π, AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_e, map_neg, π_f]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution

@[simp] lemma chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) :

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_surjective
statement: lemma chevalleyInvolution_surjective : Function.Surjective (chevalleyInvolution P)
proof:

  fun x ↦ ⟨chevalleyInvolution P x, chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution P x⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero (i : ι) (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (ad K _ (e P i) ^ n) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine LieSubalgebra.exists_ad_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan_eq_top (lieSpan_generators P) _ ?_ x
  have hsucc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra),
      (ad K _ (e P i) ^ (n + 1)) y = (ad K _ (e P i) ^ n) ⁅e P i, y⁆ := by
    intro n y; rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
  have hhe : ∀ a, ⁅e P i, h P a⁆ = -(P.root i a • e P i) := fun a ↦ by
    rw [← lie_skew, lie_h_e]
  rintro _ ((⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩) | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
  · by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨(-A i j).toNat + 1, by rw [hsucc, serre_e P hij]⟩
  · by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
      rw [hsucc, hsucc, hsucc, lie_e_f_self, hhe, lie_neg, lie_smul, lie_self]
      simp
    · exact ⟨1, by rw [hsucc, lie_e_f_of_ne P hij]; simp⟩
  · exact ⟨2, by rw [hsucc, hsucc, hhe, lie_neg, lie_smul, lie_self]; simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero (i : ι) (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (ad K _ (f P i) ^ n) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have htop : LieSubalgebra.engel K (e P i) = ⊤ :=
    LieSubalgebra.engel_eq_top_of_lieSpan_eq_top (lieSpan_generators P) _
      fun y _ ↦ exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero P i y
  have := LieSubalgebra.engel_eq_top_of_surjective (chevalleyInvolution_surjective P) htop
  rw [chevalleyInvolution_e] at this
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (LieSubalgebra.mem_engel_iff K _ x).mp (this ▸ LieSubalgebra.mem_top x)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [ad_neg_pow_apply] at hn
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hn).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.toKacMoody_chevalleyInvolution
statement:
lemma toKacMoody_chevalleyInvolution (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) :
    toKacMoody P hA (chevalleyInvolution P x) =
      KacMoodyAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution P (toKacMoody P hA x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.h_injective
statement: theorem h_injective : Function.Injective (h P)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply KacMoodyAlgebra.h_injective P
  rw [← toKacMoody_h P hA, hab, toKacMoody_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.triangular_eq_zero
statement:
theorem triangular_eq_zero {y z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι} {a : H}
    (hyaz : fHom P y + h P a + eHom P z = 0) : fHom P y = 0 ∧ a = 0 ∧ eHom P z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y + AuxLieAlgebra.h P a + AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z ∈
      AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal P := by
    rw [← π_eq_zero_iff]; simpa [fHom, eHom, map_add] using hyaz
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.triangular_mem_of_le_maxIdeal P
    (AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal P hA) hmem
  exact ⟨(π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr h1, h2, (π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr h3⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.range_fHom_inf_range_eHom
statement:
lemma range_fHom_inf_range_eHom :
    LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) ⊓
      LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩⟩ ↦ ?_
  have hy' : fHom P y = x := hy
  have hz' : eHom P z = x := hz
  have := (triangular_eq_zero P hA (y := y) (z := -z) (a := 0)
    (by rw [map_neg, hy', hz', map_zero, add_zero, add_neg_cancel])).1
  rw [← hy', this]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.mem_radical_iff
statement:
lemma mem_radical_iff {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} :
    x ∈ radical P hA ↔ toKacMoody P hA x = 0
proof: := LieHom.mem_ker

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.π_mem_radical_iff
statement:
lemma π_mem_radical_iff {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra} :
    π P x ∈ radical P hA ↔ x ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_radical_iff, toKacMoody_π, KacMoodyAlgebra.π_eq_zero_iff]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radical_eq_map
statement: lemma radical_eq_map : radical P hA = (AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P).map (π P)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  have : π P x ∈ (AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P).map (π P) ↔
      π P x ∈ ((AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P).map (π P)).toSubmodule := Iff.rfl
  rw [π_mem_radical_iff, this, LieIdeal.coe_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P)]
  constructor
  · intro hx; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
    have : y - x ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal P := by
      rw [← π_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]; exact hyx
    have h' := (AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P).sub_mem hy
      (AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal P hA this)
    rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at h'

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal_iff :
    AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P = AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal P ↔ radical P hA = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
    rw [π_mem_radical_iff, heq, ← π_eq_zero_iff] at hx
    rw [hx]; exact LieSubmodule.zero_mem _
  · intro hbot
    refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal P hA)
    rw [← π_mem_radical_iff P hA, hbot, LieSubmodule.mem_bot, π_eq_zero_iff] at hx
    exact hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radical_eq_bot_iff_injective
statement: lemma radical_eq_bot_iff_injective : radical P hA = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective (toKacMoody P hA)
proof:
:=
  (toKacMoody P hA).ker_eq_bot

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalNeg_toSubmodule
statement:
theorem radicalNeg_toSubmodule : (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule = (radical P hA).toSubmodule ⊓
    LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [radicalNeg, LieIdeal.coe_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P)]
  ext x
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, AuxLieAlgebra.negPartIdeal_toSubmodule, Submodule.mem_inf,
    LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, LinearMap.mem_range, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hx, y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(π_mem_radical_iff P hA).mpr hx, y, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨(π_mem_radical_iff P hA).mp hx, y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalPos_toSubmodule
statement:
theorem radicalPos_toSubmodule : (radicalPos P).toSubmodule = (radical P hA).toSubmodule ⊓
    LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [radicalPos, LieIdeal.coe_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P)]
  ext x
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, AuxLieAlgebra.posPartIdeal_toSubmodule, Submodule.mem_inf,
    LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, LinearMap.mem_range, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hx, z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(π_mem_radical_iff P hA).mpr hx, z, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨(π_mem_radical_iff P hA).mp hx, z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalNeg_le_radical
statement: lemma radicalNeg_le_radical : radicalNeg P ≤ radical P hA
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  have : x ∈ (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule := hx
  rw [radicalNeg_toSubmodule P hA] at this
  exact this.1

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalPos_le_radical
statement: lemma radicalPos_le_radical : radicalPos P ≤ radical P hA
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  have : x ∈ (radicalPos P).toSubmodule := hx
  rw [radicalPos_toSubmodule P hA] at this
  exact this.1

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radical_toSubmodule_eq
statement:
theorem radical_toSubmodule_eq :
    (radical P hA).toSubmodule = (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊔ (radicalPos P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_map, LieIdeal.coe_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P),
    AuxLieAlgebra.toSubmodule_eq_inf_sup_inf P (le_refl _), Submodule.map_sup, radicalNeg,
    radicalPos, LieIdeal.coe_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P),
    LieIdeal.coe_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P)]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalNeg_inf_radicalPos
statement: theorem radicalNeg_inf_radicalPos : radicalNeg P ⊓ radicalPos P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  rintro x ⟨hx, hx'⟩
  have h1 : x ∈ (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule := hx
  have h2 : x ∈ (radicalPos P).toSubmodule := hx'
  rw [radicalNeg_toSubmodule P hA] at h1
  rw [radicalPos_toSubmodule P hA] at h2
  have := (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (range_fHom_inf_range_eHom P hA) x ⟨h1.2, h2.2⟩
  rw [this]; exact LieSubmodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_radicalPos_radicalNeg
statement:
theorem lie_radicalPos_radicalNeg {x y : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ radicalPos P)
    (hy : y ∈ radicalNeg P) : ⁅x, y⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x', hx'⟩, rfl⟩ := LieIdeal.mem_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P) hx
  obtain ⟨⟨y', hy'⟩, rfl⟩ := LieIdeal.mem_map_of_surjective (π_surjective P) hy
  rw [← LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lie_posPartIdeal_negPartIdeal _ _ hx' hy', map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_radicalPos_radicalNeg_eq_bot
statement: theorem lie_radicalPos_radicalNeg_eq_bot : ⁅radicalPos P, radicalNeg P⁆ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff, LieSubmodule.lie_le_iff]
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [lie_radicalPos_radicalNeg P hx hy]
  exact LieSubmodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_mem_radicalNeg
statement:
lemma chevalleyInvolution_mem_radicalNeg {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ radicalPos P) :
    chevalleyInvolution P x ∈ radicalNeg P
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : x ∈ (radicalPos P).toSubmodule := hx
  rw [radicalPos_toSubmodule P hA] at h1
  obtain ⟨hxr, z, rfl⟩ := h1
  change _ ∈ (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule
  rw [radicalNeg_toSubmodule P hA]
  refine ⟨?_, AuxLieAlgebra.negGen z, ?_⟩
  · change _ ∈ radical P hA
    rw [mem_radical_iff, toKacMoody_chevalleyInvolution, (mem_radical_iff P hA).mp hxr, map_zero]
  · exact congrArg (π P) (AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_eHom P z).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radical_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem radical_eq_bot_iff : radical P hA = ⊥ ↔ radicalNeg P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [eq_bot_iff, ← h]; exact radicalNeg_le_radical P hA
  · intro h
    have hpos : radicalPos P = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]
      intro x hx
      have := chevalleyInvolution_mem_radicalNeg P hA hx
      rw [h, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
      rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot, ← chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution P x, this, map_zero]
    rw [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_inj, radical_toSubmodule_eq P hA, h, hpos]
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.isSl2Triple
statement:
theorem isSl2Triple (i : ι) : IsSl2Triple (h P (P.coroot i)) (e P i) (f P i) where
  h_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
    rw [ne_eq, ← map_zero (h P), (h_injective P hA).eq_iff]
    exact P.linearIndependent_coroot.ne_zero i
  lie_e_f := lie_e_f_self P i
  lie_h_e_nsmul := by
    rw [lie_h_e, P.root_coroot, hA.diag, two_nsmul, Int.cast_ofNat, two_smul]
  lie_h_f_nsmul := by
    rw [lie_h_f, P.root_coroot, hA.diag, two_nsmul, Int.cast_ofNat, two_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_nat_of_lie_e_eq_zero
proof:
:=
  IsSl2Triple.HasPrimitiveVectorWith.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero
    (t := isSl2Triple P hA i) ⟨hx0, hx (P.coroot i), hex⟩ (exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero P i x)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_nat_of_lie_f_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsSl2Triple.HasPrimitiveVectorWith.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero
    (t := (isSl2Triple P hA i).symm) (μ := -μ (P.coroot i))
    ⟨hx0, by rw [neg_lie, hx (P.coroot i), neg_smul], hfx⟩ (exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero P i x)
  exact ⟨n, by rw [← hn, neg_neg]⟩

name: LieSubmodule.projOfIsCompl_apply_coe
statement:
theorem projOfIsCompl_apply_coe (h : IsCompl N N') (m : M) :
    (projOfIsCompl h m : M) =
      N.toSubmodule.projection N'.toSubmodule (isCompl_toSubmodule.mpr h) m
proof: := rfl

name: LieSubmodule.projOfIsCompl_apply_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem projOfIsCompl_apply_left (h : IsCompl N N') (n : N) :
    projOfIsCompl h n = n
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_left _ n

name: LieSubmodule.projOfIsCompl_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem projOfIsCompl_apply_right (h : IsCompl N N') (n : N') :
    projOfIsCompl h n = 0
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_right _ n

name: LieSubmodule.projOfIsCompl_add
statement:
theorem projOfIsCompl_add (h : IsCompl N N') (m : M) :
    (projOfIsCompl h m : M) + (projOfIsCompl h.symm m : M) = m
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projection_add_projection_eq_self _ m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_of_kostant
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_of_kostant {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 X] (hX : KostantMultiplicity P X) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (Y : Type u) [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y] [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y] [LieModule K 𝔤 Y]
      [FiniteDimensional K Y], finrank K Y = n →
      FiniteDimensional K (Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) ∧
        finrank K (Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) = finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro Y _ _ _ _ _ hn
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Y with hY | hY
  · have : Subsingleton (Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) :=
      ⟨fun f g ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun y ↦ by rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    have : Subsingleton (weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) 0) := inferInstance
    exact ⟨inferInstance, by rw [finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]⟩
  have : ComplementedLattice (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y) :=
    complementedLattice_of_finiteDimensional (V := Y) hA
  obtain ⟨N, hN, -⟩ := (eq_bot_or_exists_atom_le (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Y)).resolve_left
    (by simp)
  obtain ⟨N', hNN'⟩ := exists_isCompl N
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, ⟨e⟩⟩ := IsCategoryO.exists_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_isAtom
    hA.isGeneralizedCartan (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA)
    (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional hA) hN
  have hlt : finrank K N' < n := by
    have hadd := Submodule.finrank_add_eq_of_isCompl
      (LieSubmodule.isCompl_toSubmodule.mpr hNN')
    have hpos : 0 < finrank K N := by
      have : Nontrivial N := (LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot K _ Y).mpr hN.1
      exact finrank_pos
    change finrank K N.toSubmodule + finrank K N'.toSubmodule = finrank K Y at hadd
    change finrank K N'.toSubmodule < n
    change 0 < finrank K N.toSubmodule at hpos
    omega
  obtain ⟨hfin', hrk'⟩ := ih _ hlt N' rfl
  obtain ⟨hfin, hrk⟩ := hX ν hν
  have e₁ := LieSubmodule.homEquivProdOfIsCompl (X := X) hNN'
  have e₂ := lieModuleHomCongr P e (LieModuleEquiv.refl (M := X))
  have e₃ := LieModule.weightSpaceOfMapEquivProdOfIsCompl (h P) hNN' 0
  have e₄ := LieModule.weightSpaceOfMapCongr (h P) e 0
  have : FiniteDimensional K (N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) := LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional e₂.symm
  refine ⟨LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional e₁.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [e₁.finrank_eq, e₃.finrank_eq, finrank_prod, finrank_prod, e₂.finrank_eq, e₄.finrank_eq,
    hrk, hrk']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bijective_tensorNatLinear_verma
statement:
theorem bijective_tensorNatLinear_verma {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P Λ))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P Λ) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) (V W : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [FiniteDimensional K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] [FiniteDimensional K W] :
    Function.Bijective (tensorNatLinear (V := V) (W := W) hM)
proof:
:= by
  have e : (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ AdQuotient K 𝔤 I ⊗[K] W) ≃ₗ[K]
      (V ⊗[K] Module.Dual K W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ AdQuotient K 𝔤 I) :=
    (lieModuleHomCongr P (LieModuleEquiv.refl (M := V))
      (LieModuleEquiv.tensorCongr (LieModuleEquiv.refl (M := AdQuotient K 𝔤 I))
        (evalEquiv (L := 𝔤) (M := W)))).trans
      (tensorHomAdjunction P (M := V) (N := AdQuotient K 𝔤 I) (L := Module.Dual K W)).symm
  obtain ⟨hfin, hrk⟩ := finrank_hom_of_kostant P hA hK _ (V ⊗[K] Module.Dual K W) rfl
  have : FiniteDimensional K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ AdQuotient K 𝔤 I ⊗[K] W) :=
    LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional e.symm
  have hrkM := finrank_hom_tensor_verma_tensor_self_of_isDominant P hA hΛ (L := V) (L' := W)
  have : FiniteDimensional K (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] W) := by
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top (W := V)
      (VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top (P := P) (Λ := Λ) LieModuleHom.id
        Function.surjective_id)
    exact ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA)
      ).finiteDimensional_hom P hS
        ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA))
  exact tensorNatLinear_bijective hM hI (by rw [e.finrank_eq, hrk, hrkM])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.bijective_of_injective_of_character_eq
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.bijective_of_injective_of_character_eq (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hW : IsCategoryO P W) (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hch : hV.character = hW.character) : Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf, fun w ↦ ?_⟩
  have hw : w ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ := hW.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top ▸ trivial
  suffices hsub : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ ≤ LinearMap.range (f : V →ₗ[K] W) by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsub hw
    exact ⟨v, hv⟩
  refine iSup_le fun μ ↦ ?_
  intro y hy
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  have := hW.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  let g : weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ →ₗ[K] weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ :=
    (f : V →ₗ[K] W).restrict fun v hv ↦ map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hv
  have hg : Function.Injective g := fun a b hab ↦
    Subtype.ext (hf (congrArg Subtype.val hab))
  have hdim : finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) = finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ) := by
    have := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.coeffAt μ) hch
    simp only [coeffAt_character] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mp hg ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ⟨v, congrArg Subtype.val hv⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.subsingleton_of_character_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.subsingleton_of_character_eq_zero (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (h0 : hV.character = 0) : Subsingleton V
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : ∀ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊥ := fun μ ↦ by
    have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    have h1 : ((finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 := by
      rw [← IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character hV μ, h0]
      rfl
    exact Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp (by exact_mod_cast h1)
  have htop := hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  simp only [hμ, iSup_bot] at htop
  refine ⟨fun a b ↦ ?_⟩
  have ha : a ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K V) := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  have hb : b ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K V) := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at ha hb
  rw [ha, hb]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_zero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.character_eq_zero_of_subsingleton (hV : IsCategoryO P V) [Subsingleton V] :
    hV.character = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [coeffAt_character, HahnSeries.coeff_zero]
  exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.stabilizerIndex_eq_one
statement:
theorem stabilizerIndex_eq_one {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0) :
    stabilizerIndex P hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hset : {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA', P.weylDot hA' w' μ = μ ∧ y = P.weylDot hA' w' lam} =
      {lam} := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩
      have hfixm : (w' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) = μ + P.rho := by
        have := congrArg (· + P.rho) hw'
        simpa [weylDot] using this
      have hfixl : (w' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) = lam + P.rho := by
        refine (apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf hA (lam + P.rho) _).mpr
          (Subgroup.closure_mono ?_ ((apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf hA
            (μ + P.rho) _).mp hfixm))
        rintro _ ⟨v', i', h0, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨v', i', ?_, rfl⟩
        rcases isPosRoot_or v' i' with hp | hp
        · exact hfacet' v' i' hp h0
        · have := hfacet' _ _ hp (by rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, h0, neg_zero])
          rwa [corootPairing_mul_simple, neg_eq_zero] at this
      simp [weylDot, hfixl]
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨1, by simp [weylDot], by simp [weylDot]⟩
  rw [stabilizerIndex, hset]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.character_translation_translation_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem character_translation_translation_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {V X : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hVμ : centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤)
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) V)
    (hT : IsCategoryO P (centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν))
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) X)) :
    hT.character = hV.character
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  have hX : IsCategoryO P X :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (P := P) (hV.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν)
      _ _) eX.symm
  have h1 := character_translation_translation P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν hν' hzz hzν' hV hVμ
    hX eX
  rw [stabilizerIndex_eq_one P hA hfacet', one_smul] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  exact IsCategoryO.character_congr hT _ (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P X _ _ eν)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.subsingleton_of_subsingleton_translation_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_subsingleton_translation_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hVμ : centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) V)) : Subsingleton V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm
  have hT := (hV.centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
    (centralCharacter P lam)).centralTranslation P hL' (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ)
  have hc := character_translation_translation_of_sameFacet P hA hlam hμ hfacet hfacet' hν hz
    hzν hV hVμ LieModuleEquiv.refl hT
  have : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν))
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) (centralTranslation P
        (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) V)) :=
    subsingleton_centralTranslation P _ _
  exact hV.subsingleton_of_character_eq_zero P (hc ▸ hT.character_eq_zero_of_subsingleton P)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bijective_translationUnit_of_sameFacet
statement:
theorem bijective_translationUnit_of_sameFacet {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {V X : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hVμ : centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤)
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) V)
    (hXχ : centralBlock P X (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤)
    [FiniteDimensional K (IrreducibleModule P ν)] :
    Function.Bijective (translationUnit P hV (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) hVμ eX hXχ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have hL := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm
  have hX : IsCategoryO P X :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (P := P) (hV.centralTranslation P hL _ _) eX.symm
  have hT := hX.centralTranslation P hL' (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
  have hch := character_translation_translation_of_sameFacet P hA hlam hμ hfacet hfacet' hν hz
    hzν hV hVμ eX hT
  refine hV.bijective_of_injective_of_character_eq P hT _ ?_ hch.symm
  
  let Kk := (translationUnit P hV hL hVμ eX hXχ).ker
  have hK : IsCategoryO P Kk := hV.lieSubmodule Kk
  have hKμ : centralBlock P Kk (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    have hx : (x : V) ∈ centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P μ) := by
      rw [hVμ]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top _
    exact mem_centralBlock_of_injective P Kk.incl Subtype.val_injective _ hx
  
  have hnat := translationAdjunction_comp_left P hK hV hL hKμ hVμ hXχ Kk.incl
    eX.symm.toLieModuleHom
  have h0 : (translationAdjunction P hV hL hVμ hXχ eX.symm.toLieModuleHom).comp Kk.incl = 0 :=
    LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ x.2
  have hzero := (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp (hnat.symm.trans h0)
  have hinj := centralTranslationMap_injective P (Z := IrreducibleModule P ν)
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) Kk.incl Subtype.val_injective
  have hsubTK : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) Kk) := by
    refine ⟨fun a b ↦ hinj (eX.symm.injective ?_)⟩
    have ha := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hzero a
    have hb := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hzero b
    exact ha.trans hb.symm
  have hsubK : Subsingleton Kk := subsingleton_of_subsingleton_translation_of_sameFacet P hA hlam
    hμ hfacet hfacet' hν hz hzν hK hKμ hsubTK
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun v hv ↦ ?_
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (Subsingleton.elim (⟨v, hv⟩ : Kk) 0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [Nontrivial W]
    (hW : IsCategoryO P W) {S : Finset W} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set W) = ⊤) :
    ∃ μ : Dual K H, ∃ φ : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ, Function.Surjective φ
proof:
:= by
  have hwf := hW.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  have : IsCoatomic (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W) := inferInstance
  have hbot : (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne W
    have hx : x ∈ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W) := h ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x
    have hy : y ∈ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W) := h ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top y
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hx hy
    exact hxy (hx.trans hy.symm)
  obtain ⟨N, hN, -⟩ := (eq_top_or_exists_le_coatom (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W)).resolve_left hbot
  
  set q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N
  have hWN := hW.quotient N
  have hex : ∃ μ, weightSpace P (W ⧸ N) μ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : W, w ∉ N := by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      exact hN.1 (eq_top_iff.mpr fun w _ ↦ hc w)
    have htop := hWN.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
    simp_rw [show ∀ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (W ⧸ N) (h P) μ = ⊥ from hcon, iSup_bot] at htop
    have : q w ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K (W ⧸ N)) := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
    exact hw this
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hex
  have hab : aboveSpan P (W ⧸ N) {μ} ≠ ⊥ := by
    refine fun h0 ↦ hμ (eq_bot_iff.mpr ?_)
    rw [← h0]
    refine le_iSup_of_le (⟨μ, Finset.mem_singleton_self μ⟩ : ({μ} : Finset (Dual K H)))
      (le_iSup₂_of_le 0 le_rfl ?_)
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨ν, v, hv, hv0, -⟩ := hWN.exists_primitive_mem_aboveSpan P {μ} hab
  rw [mem_primitiveVectors] at hv
  have hmem : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (W ⧸ N) (h P) ν := hv.1
  rw [← map_weightSpace_of_surjective P hW.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top q hq] at hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hmem
  have hwN : w ∉ N := fun h ↦ hv0 (by
    change q w = 0
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact h)
  have he (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, w⁆ ∈ N := by
    have h0 := hv.2 i
    change ⁅e P i, q w⁆ = 0 at h0
    rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie] at h0
    rwa [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h0
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, hNM₁, hM₁₂, -, hwM₂, hwM₁, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    exists_subquotient_equiv_irreducibleModule (le_top : N ≤ ⊤) hw (LieSubmodule.mem_top w)
      hwN he
  have hM₂ : M₂ = ⊤ := by
    rcases hN.le_iff.mp (hNM₁.trans hM₁₂) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (h ▸ hwM₂) hwN
  let r : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M₂ :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict M₂ LieModuleHom.id fun x ↦ hM₂ ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x
  refine ⟨ν, e.toLieModuleHom.comp ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _).comp r), ?_⟩
  refine e.surjective.comp fun z ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ z
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.exists_nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable
statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    [Nontrivial W] (hWproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P W) (hW : IsCategoryO P W) {S : Finset W}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set W) = ⊤)
    (hind : ∀ a : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W, a.comp a = a → a = 0 ∨ a = LieModuleHom.id) :
    ∃ Λ : Dual K H, Nonempty (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Λ, φ, hφ⟩ := hW.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA hS
  exact ⟨Λ, nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable P Λ hA hWproj hW hind φ hφ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_irreducible_of_indecomposable
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_irreducible_of_indecomposable {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    [Nontrivial W] (hWproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P W) (hW : IsCategoryO P W) {S : Finset W}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set W) = ⊤)
    (hind : ∀ a : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W, a.comp a = a → a = 0 ∨ a = LieModuleHom.id) (Λ : Dual K H)
    [Decidable (Nonempty (W ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA Λ))] :
    finrank K (W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) =
      if Nonempty (W ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨μ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_nonempty_equiv_of_indecomposable P hA hWproj hW hS hind
  have hfin (ν : Dual K H) : finrank K (W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν) =
      if ν = μ then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [← (lieModuleHomCongr P e LieModuleEquiv.refl).finrank_eq]
    exact finrank_hom_irreducible P μ hA ν
  rw [hfin Λ]
  by_cases hΛ : Λ = μ
  · subst hΛ
    have hne : Nonempty (W ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) := ⟨e.symm⟩
    simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
  · have hne : ¬ Nonempty (W ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA Λ) := by
      rintro ⟨e'⟩
      have h1 := hfin Λ
      rw [← (lieModuleHomCongr P e'.symm LieModuleEquiv.refl).finrank_eq,
        finrank_hom_irreducible P Λ hA Λ] at h1
      simp [hΛ] at h1
    simp only [hΛ, hne, ↓reduceIte]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.card_filter_nonempty_equiv_eq_finrank_hom
statement:
theorem card_filter_nonempty_equiv_eq_finrank_hom {V : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (hVproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {S : Finset V}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set V) = ⊤)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] {Q : J → Type (max u₁ u₂)}
