    [∀ j, AddCommGroup (Q j)] [∀ j, Module K (Q j)] [∀ j, LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Q j)]
    [∀ j, LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Q j)] [∀ j, Nontrivial (Q j)]
    (hind : ∀ j, ∀ a : Q j →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q j, a.comp a = a → a = 0 ∨ a = LieModuleHom.id)
    (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ⨁ j, Q j) (Λ : Dual K H)
    [DecidablePred fun j ↦ Nonempty (Q j ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)] :
    #{j | Nonempty (Q j ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)} =
      finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let s (j : J) : Q j →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V :=
    e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K J 𝔤 Q j)
  let r (j : J) : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Q j :=
    (DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K J 𝔤 Q j).comp e.toLieModuleHom
  have hrs (j : J) : (r j).comp (s j) = LieModuleHom.id := by
    ext q
    simp [r, s, DirectSum.lieModuleComponent, DirectSum.lieModuleOf]
  have hr (j : J) : Function.Surjective (r j) := fun q ↦
    ⟨s j q, LieModuleHom.congr_fun (hrs j) q⟩
  have hproj (j : J) : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (Q j) := hVproj.of_retract (s j) (r j) (hrs j)
  have hO (j : J) : IsCategoryO P (Q j) := by
    obtain ⟨f⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective _ (r j) (hr j) rfl
    exact (hV.quotient _).of_equiv f
  have hfg (j : J) : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 ((S.image (r j) : Finset (Q j)) : Set (Q j)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro y -
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hr j y
    have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set V) ≤
        (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 ((S.image (r j) : Finset (Q j)) : Set (Q j))).comap (r j) := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
      intro x hx
      exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx))
    exact hle (hS ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x)
  
  have hfin (j : J) : FiniteDimensional K (Q j →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) :=
    (hO j).finiteDimensional_hom P (hfg j) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ)
  rw [(lieModuleHomCongr P e LieModuleEquiv.refl).finrank_eq,
    (DirectSum.lieModuleHomEquiv (R := K) (L := 𝔤)).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_pi_fintype,
    Finset.card_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  exact (finrank_hom_irreducible_of_indecomposable P hA (hproj j) (hO j) (hfg j) (hind j) Λ).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weightOrderedBasis
statement:
theorem exists_weightOrderedBasis [FiniteDimensional K Z] (hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P Z) :
    ∃ (b : Basis (Fin (finrank K Z)) K Z) (wt : Fin (finrank K Z) → Dual K H),
      (∀ j, b j ∈ weightSpace P Z (wt j)) ∧
      ∀ i j, WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P (wt i) < WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P (wt j) → i < j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let κ := DiagWeightBasisIndex P Z
  let b := diagWeightBasis hZ
  let : Fintype κ := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b
  let w : κ → P.WeightOrd := fun j => WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P j.1
  let o : PartialOrder κ :=
    { le := fun i j => i = j ∨ w i < w j
      le_refl := fun _ => Or.inl rfl
      le_trans := by
        rintro i j k (rfl | hij) (rfl | hjk)
        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · exact Or.inr hjk
        · exact Or.inr hij
        · exact Or.inr (lt_trans hij hjk)
      le_antisymm := by
        rintro i j (hij | hij) (hji | hji)
        · exact hij
        · exact hij
        · exact hji.symm
        · exact (lt_asymm hij hji).elim }
  let : Fintype (LinearExtension κ) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype κ)
  have hc : Fintype.card (LinearExtension κ) = finrank K Z :=
    (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b).symm
  let e := monoEquivOfFin (LinearExtension κ) hc
  let f : κ ≃ Fin (finrank K Z) :=
    (Equiv.refl κ).trans e.toEquiv.symm
  refine ⟨b.reindex f, fun i => (f.symm i).1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [Basis.reindex_apply] using diagWeightBasis_mem hZ (f.symm i)
  · intro i j hij
    apply e.lt_iff_lt.mp
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne
    · exact (@toLinearExtension κ o).monotone (Or.inr hij)
    · intro heq
      exact (ne_of_lt hij) (congrArg w heq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toWeightOrd_add_root_lt
statement:
theorem toWeightOrd_add_root_lt (μ : Dual K H) (i : ι) :
    WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P (μ + P.root i) < WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne
  · refine ⟨Pi.single i 1, Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one, ?_⟩
    simp only [WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd, add_sub_cancel_left, rootOf_single]
  · intro heq
    have hr : P.root i = 0 := by
      simpa only [WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd, add_eq_left] using
        congrArg (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P) heq
    have hs : (Pi.single i (1 : ℤ) : ι → ℤ) = 0 :=
      P.rootOf_injective (by rw [rootOf_single, hr, map_zero])
    have := congr_fun hs i
    simp at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_e_mem_weightBasis_flag
statement:
theorem lie_e_mem_weightBasis_flag (i : ι) (j : Fin n) :
    ⁅e P i, b j⁆ ∈ b.flag j.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  have hv := toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace i (hb j)
  rw [weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis hb] at hv
  apply Submodule.span_mono _ hv
  rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨k, ?_, rfl⟩
  change k < j
  apply ho
  rw [hk]
  exact toWeightOrd_add_root_lt P (wt j) i

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightBorelFlag_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightBorelFlag_toSubmodule (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (weightBorelFlag P b wt hb ho k).toSubmodule = b.flag k
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightBorelFlag_strictMono
statement: theorem weightBorelFlag_strictMono : StrictMono (weightBorelFlag P b wt hb ho)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact b.flag_strictMono hij

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightBorelFlag_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem weightBorelFlag_zero : weightBorelFlag P b wt hb ho 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_injective
  exact b.flag_zero

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightBorelFlag_last
statement: @[simp] theorem weightBorelFlag_last : weightBorelFlag P b wt hb ho (Fin.last n) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_injective
  exact b.flag_last

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightBorelFlag_step
proof:
:= by
  change z ∈ b.flag j.succ at hz
  rw [b.flag_succ] at hz
  obtain ⟨u, hu, f, hf, huf⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hu
  exact ⟨f, hf, c, by rw [← huf, add_comm]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightBasis_count
statement:
theorem weightBasis_count (μ : Dual K H) :
    Nat.card {j : Fin n // wt j = μ} = finrank K (weightSpace P Z μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finrank_weightSpace_of_basis hb μ (Set.toFinite _)]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Set.Finite.card_toFinset]
  exact Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.refl _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorWeightFlag_strictMono
statement:
theorem tensorWeightFlag_strictMono (Λ : Dual K H) :
    StrictMono (tensorWeightFlag P b wt hb ho Λ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
  intro j
  refine lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨VermaModule.tensorBorelSubmodule_mono P Λ
    ((weightBorelFlag_strictMono P b wt hb ho).monotone (Fin.castSucc_le_succ j)), ?_⟩
  intro hle
  let F := weightBorelFlag P b wt hb ho j.castSucc
  have he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, b j⁆ ∈ F := fun i =>
    lie_e_mem_weightBasis_flag P b wt hb ho i j
  have hh : ∀ a, ⁅h P a, b j⁆ - wt j a • b j ∈ F := by
    intro a
    rw [hb j a, sub_self]
    exact F.zero_mem
  let φ := VermaModule.shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient P Λ F (wt j) (b j) he hh
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ :=
    VermaModule.shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_injective P Λ F (wt j) (b j)
      (by change b j ∉ b.flag j.castSucc; simp) he hh
  have hzero : φ (VermaModule.hwv P (Λ + wt j)) = 0 := by
    rw [VermaModule.shiftedVermaToTensorQuotient_hwv]
    apply (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
    apply hle
    exact VermaModule.hwv_tmul_mem_tensorSubspace P Λ _
      (show b j ∈ b.flag j.succ by simp)
  exact VermaModule.hwv_ne_zero P (Λ + wt j) (hinj (hzero.trans (map_zero φ).symm))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorWeightFlag_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorWeightFlag_zero (Λ : Dual K H) :
    tensorWeightFlag P b wt hb ho Λ 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorWeightFlag]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorWeightFlag_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorWeightFlag_last (Λ : Dual K H) :
    tensorWeightFlag P b wt hb ho Λ (Fin.last n) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorWeightFlag]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weightBorelFlag
statement:
theorem exists_weightBorelFlag [FiniteDimensional K Z] (hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P Z) :
    ∃ (F : Fin (finrank K Z + 1) → LieSubmodule K (borel P) Z)
      (wt : Fin (finrank K Z) → Dual K H) (z : Fin (finrank K Z) → Z),
      StrictMono F ∧ F 0 = ⊥ ∧ F (Fin.last (finrank K Z)) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ j, z j ∉ F j.castSucc ∧ z j ∈ F j.succ ∧
        z j ∈ weightSpace P Z (wt j) ∧ (∀ i, ⁅e P i, z j⁆ ∈ F j.castSucc) ∧
        ∀ v ∈ F j.succ, ∃ f ∈ F j.castSucc, ∃ c : K, v = f + c • z j) ∧
      ∀ μ, Nat.card {j // wt j = μ} = finrank K (weightSpace P Z μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, wt, hb, ho⟩ := exists_weightOrderedBasis P hZ
  refine ⟨weightBorelFlag P b wt hb ho, wt, b,
    weightBorelFlag_strictMono P b wt hb ho, weightBorelFlag_zero P b wt hb ho,
    weightBorelFlag_last P b wt hb ho, ?_, weightBasis_count P b wt hb⟩
  intro j
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hb j, (fun i => lie_e_mem_weightBasis_flag P b wt hb ho i j),
    fun _ hz => weightBorelFlag_step P b wt hb ho j hz⟩
  · change b j ∉ b.flag j.castSucc
    simp
  · change b j ∈ b.flag j.succ
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_tensorVermaStandardFiltration
statement:
theorem exists_tensorVermaStandardFiltration [FiniteDimensional K Z]
    (hZ : IsHDiagonalizable P Z) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ (N : Fin (finrank K Z + 1) →
        LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z))
      (wt : Fin (finrank K Z) → Dual K H),
      StrictMono N ∧ N 0 = ⊥ ∧ N (Fin.last (finrank K Z)) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ j, Nonempty (VermaModule P (Λ + wt j) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        (N j.succ).map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N j.castSucc)))) ∧
      ∀ μ, Nat.card {j // wt j = μ} = finrank K (weightSpace P Z μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, wt, hb, ho⟩ := exists_weightOrderedBasis P hZ
  exact ⟨tensorWeightFlag P b wt hb ho Λ, wt,
    tensorWeightFlag_strictMono P b wt hb ho Λ, tensorWeightFlag_zero P b wt hb ho Λ,
    tensorWeightFlag_last P b wt hb ho Λ,
    fun j => ⟨weightBorelFlag_tensorStepEquiv P b wt hb ho Λ j⟩, weightBasis_count P b wt hb⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorNatTrans.lTensor_app_apply
statement:
theorem lTensor_app_apply (φ : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, w} K L W W') (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] (t : M ⊗[K] (V ⊗[K] W)) :
    (lTensor V φ).app M t = LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K L M V W'
      (φ.app (M ⊗[K] V) ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K L M V W).symm t))
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.nonempty_range_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_range_comp_equiv (e : X →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ X) (Φ : X →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ Y) (Ψ : Y →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ X)
    (h : ∀ x, Ψ (Φ x) = x) : Nonempty ((Φ.comp (e.comp Ψ)).range ≃ₗ⁅K,L⁆ e.range)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ y : e.range, Φ y ∈ (Φ.comp (e.comp Ψ)).range := by
    rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩
    exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨Φ x, by simp [h]⟩
  let g : e.range →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ (Φ.comp (e.comp Ψ)).range :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ (Φ.comp e.range.incl) hmem
  refine ⟨(LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective g ⟨fun y₁ y₂ hy ↦ ?_, ?_⟩).symm⟩
  · have hy' : Ψ ((g y₁ : _) : Y) = Ψ ((g y₂ : _) : Y) := by rw [hy]
    change Ψ (Φ (y₁ : X)) = Ψ (Φ (y₂ : X)) at hy'
    rw [h, h] at hy'
    exact Subtype.ext hy'
  · rintro ⟨_, y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨e (Ψ y), (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨Ψ y, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.character_eq_add
statement:
theorem character_eq_add (F₁ : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA lam V) (h : F₁.IsSummand F)
    {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M) (hF : IsCategoryO P (F.idem M).range)
    (hF₁ : IsCategoryO P (F₁.idem M).range) (hF₂ : IsCategoryO P ((F.sub F₁ h).idem M).range) :
    hF.character = hF₁.character + hF₂.character
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h M hM
  set e := F.idem M with he_def
  set e₁ := F₁.idem M with he₁_def
  have hee : ∀ x, e (e x) = e x := F.idem_idem M hM
  have he₁e₁ : ∀ x, e₁ (e₁ x) = e₁ x := F₁.idem_idem M hM
  have hee₁ : ∀ x, e (e₁ x) = e₁ x := fun x ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun h₁ x
  have he₁e : ∀ x, e₁ (e x) = e₁ x := fun x ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun h₂ x
  have hsub : (F.sub F₁ h).idem M = e - e₁ := rfl
  
  have hmem₂ : ∀ y : e.range, (e - e₁) y ∈ ((F.sub F₁ h).idem M).range := fun y ↦
    (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, by rw [hsub]⟩
  let g : e.range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ((F.sub F₁ h).idem M).range :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ ((e - e₁).comp e.range.incl) hmem₂
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := by
    rintro ⟨_, z, rfl⟩
    have hz : (e - e₁) z ∈ e.range :=
      (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨(e - e₁) z, by
        simp only [_root_.sub_apply, map_sub, hee, hee₁]⟩
    refine ⟨⟨(e - e₁) z, hz⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change (e - e₁) ((e - e₁) z) = ((F.sub F₁ h).idem M) z
    rw [hsub]
    simp only [_root_.sub_apply, map_sub, hee, hee₁, he₁e, he₁e₁, sub_self, sub_zero]
  
  have hker : ∀ y : e.range, g y = 0 → (y : M ⊗[K] V) = e₁ y := by
    rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩ hy
    have hy' : ((g ⟨_, (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩ : _) : M ⊗[K] V) = 0 := by
      rw [hy]; rfl
    change e (e x) - e₁ (e x) = 0 at hy'
    rw [hee, he₁e] at hy'
    change e x = e₁ (e x)
    rw [he₁e]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hy'
  have hmem₁ : ∀ y : g.ker, ((y : e.range) : M ⊗[K] V) ∈ e₁.range := fun y ↦
    (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, (hker y (LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp y.2)).symm⟩
  let k : g.ker →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ e₁.range :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ (e.range.incl.comp g.ker.incl) hmem₁
  have hk : Function.Bijective k := by
    refine ⟨fun y₁ y₂ hy ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hy' : ((k y₁ : _) : M ⊗[K] V) = ((k y₂ : _) : M ⊗[K] V) := by rw [hy]
      exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hy')
    rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩
    have hx : e₁ x ∈ e.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨e₁ x, hee₁ x⟩
    have hx' : (⟨e₁ x, hx⟩ : e.range) ∈ g.ker := by
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      change (e - e₁) (e₁ x) = 0
      rw [_root_.sub_apply, hee₁, he₁e₁, sub_self]
    exact ⟨⟨_, hx'⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective g.ker g hg rfl
  rw [hF.character_eq_add g.ker (hF.lieSubmodule g.ker) (hF.quotient g.ker),
    (hF.lieSubmodule g.ker).character_congr hF₁ (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective k hk),
    (hF.quotient g.ker).character_congr hF₂ q]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.compRetr_compIncl
statement:
theorem compRetr_compIncl {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M)
    (y : (F.idem M).range ⊗[K] W) : F.compRetr M (F.compIncl M y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have he : (F.idem M).comp (F.idem M) = F.idem M := F.idem_mul_idem hM
  change TensorProduct.LieModule.map (rangeRetr (F.idem M)) (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
    ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M V W).symm (LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M V W
      (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (F.idem M).range.incl (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) y))) = y
  rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  induction y with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul y w =>
    change rangeRetr (F.idem M) ((F.idem M).range.incl y) ⊗ₜ[K] w = y ⊗ₜ[K] w
    rw [rangeRetr_incl he]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.app_eq_compIdem
statement:
theorem app_eq_compIdem {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (t : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 W W)
    (ht : t.app (F.idem M).range = G.idem (F.idem M).range) (x : M ⊗[K] (V ⊗[K] W)) :
    LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M V W (t.app (M ⊗[K] V)
      (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (F.idem M) (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
        ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M V W).symm x))) = F.compIdem G M x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ y : (M ⊗[K] V) ⊗[K] W,
      TensorProduct.LieModule.map (F.idem M) (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) y =
        TensorProduct.LieModule.map (F.idem M).range.incl (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
          (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (rangeRetr (F.idem M)) (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
            y) := fun y ↦ by
    induction y with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
    | tmul a w => rfl
  have h2 := t.naturality _ (M ⊗[K] V) (F.idem M).range.incl
    (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (rangeRetr (F.idem M)) (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
      ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M V W).symm x))
  rw [h1]
  change _ = LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M V W
    (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (F.idem M).range.incl (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
      (G.idem (F.idem M).range (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (rangeRetr (F.idem M))
        (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M V W).symm x))))
  rw [← ht]
  exact congrArg _ h2.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.nonempty_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_comp_equiv (hF : F.MapsTo μ) (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M) :
    Nonempty (((F.comp G hF).idem M).range ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (G.idem (F.idem M).range).range)
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.nonempty_range_comp_equiv _ _ _ (F.compRetr_compIncl hM)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.character_comp
statement:
theorem character_comp (hF : F.MapsTo μ) {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsInBlock P hA lam M)
    (hGF : IsCategoryO P ((F.comp G hF).idem M).range)
    (hGFM : IsCategoryO P (G.idem (F.idem M).range).range) :
    hGF.character = hGFM.character
proof:
:=
  hGF.character_congr hGFM (F.nonempty_comp_equiv G hF M hM).some

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsIntegrable.lieSubmodule
statement:
theorem IsIntegrable.lieSubmodule (hI : IsIntegrable P V) (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) : IsIntegrable P N where
  isHDiagonalizable
proof:
:= (hV.lieSubmodule N).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  exists_pow_e_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hI.exists_pow_e_eq_zero i x
    exact ⟨n, N.injective_incl (by rw [← toEnd_pow_apply_map, map_zero]; exact hn)⟩
  exists_pow_f_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hI.exists_pow_f_eq_zero i x
    exact ⟨n, N.injective_incl (by rw [← toEnd_pow_apply_map, map_zero]; exact hn)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsIntegrable.quotient
statement:
theorem IsIntegrable.quotient (hV : IsIntegrable P V) : IsIntegrable P (V ⧸ N) where
  isHDiagonalizable
proof:
:= by
    have hV' : ⨆ μ, weightSpace P V μ = ⊤ := hV.isHDiagonalizable
    simp only [IsHDiagonalizable, ← map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P N hV']
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hV', Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N
  exists_pow_e_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N x
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hV.exists_pow_e_eq_zero i v
    exact ⟨n, by rw [toEnd_pow_apply_map, hn, map_zero]⟩
  exists_pow_f_eq_zero i x := by
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N x
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hV.exists_pow_f_eq_zero i v
    exact ⟨n, by rw [toEnd_pow_apply_map, hn, map_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_isAtom
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_isAtom (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hI : IsIntegrable P V)
    {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V} (hN : IsAtom N) :
    ∃ Λ, P.IsDominantIntegral Λ ∧
      Nonempty (N ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial N := (LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot K _ V).mpr hN.1
  obtain ⟨Λ, x, hx, hx0, hxe⟩ := (hV.lieSubmodule N).exists_lie_e_eq_zero
  set w : V := (x : V)
  have hw : w ∈ weightSpace P V Λ := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hx
  have hwe : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, w⁆ = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    simp only [w, ← LieSubmodule.coe_bracket, hxe i, LieSubmodule.coe_zero]
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hx0 (Subtype.ext h)
  refine ⟨Λ, isDominantIntegral_of_isIntegrable hA hI hw hwe hw0, ?_⟩
  let φ := VermaModule.lift P w (fun _ hy ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos hwe hy) (fun a ↦ hw a)
  have hφv : φ (VermaModule.hwv P Λ) = w := VermaModule.lift_hwv P w _ _
  have hrange : φ.range = N := by
    rw [VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan, hφv]
    refine (hN.le_iff.mp (LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr ?_)).resolve_left ?_
    · rintro _ rfl; exact x.2
    · rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_eq_bot_iff]
      exact fun h ↦ hw0 (h w rfl)
  have hker_le : φ.ker ≤ VermaModule.maxSubmodule P Λ :=
    (VermaModule.le_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ _).mpr fun htop ↦ hw0 (by
      rw [← hφv, ← LieModuleHom.mem_ker, htop]; trivial)
  have hle_ker : VermaModule.maxSubmodule P Λ ≤ φ.ker := by
    rw [LieModuleHom.le_ker_iff_map]
    have hle : (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P Λ).map φ ≤ N := by
      rw [← hrange, ← LieModuleHom.map_top]
      exact LieSubmodule.map_mono le_top
    refine (hN.le_iff.mp hle).resolve_right fun heq ↦ ?_
    have hwmem : w ∈ (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P Λ).map φ := heq ▸ x.2
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmw⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map w).mp hwmem
    apply VermaModule.hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule P Λ
    have hdiff : m - VermaModule.hwv P Λ ∈ VermaModule.maxSubmodule P Λ :=
      hker_le (by rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hmw, hφv, sub_self])
    simpa using sub_mem hm hdiff
  
  let ψ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift _ φ hle_ker
  have hψN : ∀ q, ψ q ∈ N := fun q ↦ by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ q
    rw [← hrange]
    exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ _).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩
  let ψ' := LieModuleHom.codRestrict N ψ hψN
  have hψ' : Function.Bijective ψ' := by
    refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero ψ').mpr fun q hq ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ q
      rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      refine hker_le ?_
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hq
    · have hy : (y : V) ∈ φ.range := by rw [hrange]; exact y.2
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ _).mp hy
      exact ⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _ m, Subtype.ext hm⟩
  exact ⟨(LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective ψ' hψ').symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.map_casimir
statement:
theorem map_casimir {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hV : IsPosFinite P V)
    (hW : IsPosFinite P W) (v : V) : f (hB.casimir V hV v) = hB.casimir W hW (f v)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (μ : Dual K H) : f (hB.casimirTerm V μ v) = hB.casimirTerm W μ (f v) := by
    simp only [casimirTerm_apply, casimirSum_def, map_sum, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
  rw [casimir_apply, casimir_apply, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, LieModuleHom.map_lie,
    hterm]
  congr 2
  have := (f : V →ₗ[K] W).toAddMonoidHom.map_finsum_mem' (hB.finite_casimirTerm hV v)
  simp only [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap] at this
  rw [this]
  exact finsum_mem_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ hterm μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma casimirHom_apply (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (v : V) :
    hB.casimirHom hA hV v = hB.casimir V hV v
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_sub_smul_mem
statement:
theorem casimir_sub_smul_mem (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P V μ) (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ ∈ N) :
    hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite v - P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ • v ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub, map_smul,
    hB.map_casimir _ hV.isPosFinite (hV.quotient N).isPosFinite,
    hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero _ (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P _ hv) fun i ↦ by
      rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (he i)],
    sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.eq_zero_of_pow_apply_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  set T : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V := hB.casimirHom hA hV.isPosFinite -
    P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ • LieModuleHom.id with hT
  induction n generalizing y with
  | zero => simpa using hn
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] at hn
    have hTy : T y = 0 := ih (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P T hy) hn
    by_contra hy0
    have hne : weightSpace P T.ker (μ + P.rootOf k) ≠ ⊥ := fun hbot ↦
      hy0 (congrArg Subtype.val ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hbot ⟨y, hTy⟩
        (mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mpr hy)))
    obtain ⟨l, hl, w, hw, hw0, hwe⟩ :=
      (hV.lieSubmodule T.ker).exists_lie_e_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hne
    have hw' := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hw
    have hwe' : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, (w : V)⁆ = 0 := fun i ↦ by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.coe_bracket, hwe i, LieSubmodule.coe_zero]
    have hw0' : (w : V) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hw0 (Subtype.ext h)
    have hdom := isDominantIntegral_of_isIntegrable hA hI hw' hwe' hw0'
    have h2 : hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite w - P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ • (w : V) = 0 :=
      w.2
    rw [hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero _ hw' hwe', ← sub_smul, smul_eq_zero] at h2
    refine dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_ne S hdom hμ (k := k + l) ⟨add_nonneg hk.1 hl,
      fun h0 ↦ hk.2 ?_⟩ ?_ (sub_eq_zero.mp (h2.resolve_right hw0'))
    · ext j
      have h1 := congrFun h0 j
      have h2 := hk.1 j
      have h3 := hl j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
      omega
    · rw [map_add, add_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.isAtom_lieSpan_singleton
statement:
theorem isAtom_lieSpan_singleton {Λ : Dual K H} {w : V} (hw : w ∈ weightSpace P V Λ)
    (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, w⁆ = 0) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) :
    IsAtom (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra {w})
proof:
:= by
  set U := LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra {w}
  let φ := VermaModule.lift P w (fun _ hy ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos he hy) (fun a ↦ hw a)
  have hrange : φ.range = U := by
    rw [VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan, VermaModule.lift_hwv]
  have hφU : ∀ m, φ m ∈ U := fun m ↦ by
    rw [← hrange]; exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ _).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩
  let φ' := LieModuleHom.codRestrict U φ hφU
  have hφ' : Function.Surjective φ' := fun y ↦ by
    have hy : (y : V) ∈ φ.range := by rw [hrange]; exact y.2
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ _).mp hy
    exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ hw0 (by rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_eq_bot_iff] at h; exact h w rfl),
    fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases hB.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_isIntegrable hA φ' hφ' (hI.lieSubmodule hV U)
    (N.comap U.incl) with h | h
  · rw [LieSubmodule.comap_incl_eq_bot] at h
    rw [eq_bot_iff, ← h]
    exact le_inf hN.le le_rfl
  · rw [LieSubmodule.comap_incl_eq_top] at h
    exact absurd h hN.not_ge

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lieSpan_primitive_eq_top
statement:
theorem lieSpan_primitive_eq_top :
    LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      {v : V | ∃ μ, v ∈ weightSpace P V μ ∧ ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set V' := LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      {v : V | ∃ μ, v ∈ weightSpace P V μ ∧ ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0} with hV'
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne)
  have : Nontrivial (V ⧸ V') := ⟨⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' V' x, 0, by
    rwa [Ne, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨μ, v', hv', hv'0, hv'e⟩ := (hV.quotient V').exists_lie_e_eq_zero
  have hμ := isDominantIntegral_of_isIntegrable hA (hI.quotient (N := V')) hv' hv'e hv'0
  change v' ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (V ⧸ V') (h P) μ at hv'
  rw [← map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P V' hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top] at hv'
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hv'
  simp only [LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap] at hv'0 hv'e
  have hve : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ ∈ V' := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
    exact hv'e i
  set T : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V := hB.casimirHom hA hV.isPosFinite -
    P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ • LieModuleHom.id with hT
  have hTv : T v ∈ V' := hB.casimir_sub_smul_mem hV V' hv hve
  
  have hTV' : ∀ y ∈ V', T y ∈ V' := by
    intro y hy
    have : V' ≤ V'.comap T := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
      rintro z ⟨ν, hz, hze⟩
      change hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite z - P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ • z ∈ V'
      rw [hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero _ hz hze, ← sub_smul]
      exact V'.smul_mem _ (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨ν, hz, hze⟩)
    exact this hy
  
  set W : Submodule K V := V'.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ with hW
  have hTW : ∀ y ∈ W, (T : Module.End K V) y ∈ W := fun y hy ↦
    ⟨hTV' y hy.1, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P T hy.2⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional K W := by
    have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_right
  have hpow : ∀ m (y : W), ((((T : Module.End K V).restrict hTW ^ m) y : W) : V) =
      ((T : Module.End K V) ^ m) y := fun m y ↦ by
    rw [Module.End.pow_restrict, LinearMap.coe_restrict_apply]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsArtinian.monotone_stabilizes ((T : Module.End K V).restrict hTW).iterateRange
  have hrange : LinearMap.range ((T : Module.End K V).restrict hTW ^ n) =
      LinearMap.range ((T : Module.End K V).restrict hTW ^ (n + 1)) := hn (n + 1) n.le_succ
  have hTvW : (T : Module.End K V) v ∈ W := ⟨hTv, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P T hv⟩
  have hmem : ((T : Module.End K V).restrict hTW ^ n) ⟨_, hTvW⟩ ∈
      LinearMap.range ((T : Module.End K V).restrict hTW ^ (n + 1)) := by
    rw [← hrange]; exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hmem
  have hw' : ((T : Module.End K V) ^ (n + 1)) (w : V) = ((T : Module.End K V) ^ (n + 1)) v := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hw
    rw [hpow, hpow] at this
    rw [this, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
  
  have hv₀μ : v - (w : V) ∈ weightSpace P V μ := sub_mem hv w.2.2
  have hv₀T : ((T : Module.End K V) ^ (n + 1)) (v - (w : V)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hw', sub_self]
  have hv₀e : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v - (w : V)⁆ = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hy : ⁅e P i, v - (w : V)⁆ ∈ weightSpace P V (μ + P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1)) := by
      rw [rootOf_single]
      exact toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace i hv₀μ
    refine hB.eq_zero_of_pow_apply_eq_zero hA hV hI hμ
      ⟨Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one, fun h ↦ by simpa using congrFun h i⟩ hy
      (n := n + 1) ?_
    have hcomm : Commute (T : Module.End K V) (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (e P i)) :=
      LinearMap.ext fun z ↦ T.map_lie (e P i) z
    rw [← toEnd_apply_apply (R := K), ← Module.End.mul_apply, (hcomm.pow_left (n + 1)).eq,
      Module.End.mul_apply, hv₀T, map_zero]
  apply hv'0
  rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  have := add_mem (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨μ, hv₀μ, hv₀e⟩ : v - (w : V) ∈ V') w.2.1
  rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.sSup_isAtom_eq_top
statement: theorem sSup_isAtom_eq_top : sSup {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V | IsAtom N} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hB := isStandardForm_invForm P (isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hS).some
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← hB.lieSpan_primitive_eq_top hA hV hI, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro w ⟨μ, hw, he⟩
  by_cases hw0 : w = 0
  · rw [hw0]; exact zero_mem _
  · exact (le_sSup (hB.isAtom_lieSpan_singleton hA hV hI hw he hw0) :
      _ ≤ sSup {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V | IsAtom N})
      (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan rfl)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.complementedLattice
statement: theorem complementedLattice : ComplementedLattice (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
proof:
:=
  complementedLattice_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top (sSup_isAtom_eq_top hA hS hV hI)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_sSupIndep_irreducibleModule
statement:
theorem exists_sSupIndep_irreducibleModule :
    ∃ s : Set (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V), sSupIndep s ∧ sSup s = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ N ∈ s, ∃ Λ, P.IsDominantIntegral Λ ∧
        Nonempty (N ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, htop, hatom⟩ :=
    exists_sSupIndep_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top (sSup_isAtom_eq_top hA hS hV hI)
  exact ⟨s, hs, htop, fun N hN ↦ exists_equiv_irreducibleModule_of_isAtom hA hV hI (hatom hN)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_isInternal_irreducibleModule
statement:
theorem exists_isInternal_irreducibleModule :
    ∃ s : Set (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V),
      DirectSum.IsInternal (fun N : s ↦ (N : Submodule K V)) ∧
      ∀ N ∈ s, ∃ Λ, P.IsDominantIntegral Λ ∧
        Nonempty (N ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, htop, hN⟩ := exists_sSupIndep_irreducibleModule hA hS hV hI
  refine ⟨s, DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (LieSubmodule.iSupIndep_toSubmodule.mpr ((sSupIndep_iff s).mp hs)) ?_, hN⟩
  rw [LieSubmodule.iSup_toSubmodule_eq_top, ← sSup_eq_iSup']
  exact htop

name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_forall_exists_comp
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_exists_comp {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) [Projective S.X₂]
    {Y : C} (h : ∀ a : S.X₁ ⟶ Y, ∃ b : S.X₂ ⟶ Y, S.f ≫ b = a) (z : Ext.{w} S.X₃ Y 1) :
    z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₁, rfl⟩ := contravariant_sequence_exact₃ hS Y z (eq_zero_of_projective _)
    (n₀ := 0) rfl
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h (homEquiv₀ x₁)
  rw [← mk₀_homEquiv₀_apply x₁, ← hb, ← mk₀_comp_mk₀]
  exact hS.extClass_comp_assoc _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.shortExact_of_lie
proof:
:=
  ShortExact.reflects_shortExact_of_faithful (CategoryO.IsObj.{u} P).ι
    { exact := (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff _).mpr hfg
      mono_f := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr hf
      epi_g := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr hg }

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_aux
statement:
theorem ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_aux (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hS : ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{u} P M) (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (π : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X.obj)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (MX MY : Type u) [AddCommGroup MX] [Module K MX]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 MX] [LieModule K 𝔤 MX] [AddCommGroup MY] [Module K MY]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 MY] [LieModule K 𝔤 MY] (hMX : IsCategoryO P MX)
    (eX : MX ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X.obj) (eY : MY ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj) (hXY : ∀ e : ExtOne (h P) MX MY, e = 0)
    (z : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y 1) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Q := mk M hM hS
  have hQ : Projective Q := projective_mk M hM hS hproj
  let eM := ofLieEquiv (P := P) M
  let πQ : Q.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X.obj := π.comp eM.symm.toLieModuleHom
  have hπQ : Function.Surjective πQ := fun x ↦ by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hπ x
    exact ⟨eM m, rfl⟩
  have hexact : ∀ b, πQ b = 0 ↔ ∃ a : πQ.ker, πQ.ker.incl a = b := fun b ↦
    ⟨fun hb ↦ ⟨⟨b, LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr hb⟩, rfl⟩, by
      rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp a.2⟩
  let eN := ofLieEquiv (P := P) πQ.ker
  let iL : ofLie P πQ.ker ⟶ Q.obj := ofLieModuleHom (πQ.ker.incl.comp eN.symm.toLieModuleHom)
  have hiL : Function.Injective iL.hom := fun a b hab ↦ eN.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hab)
  let Nobj : CategoryO.{u} P := ⟨ofLie P πQ.ker, isObj_of_injective iL hiL Q.property⟩
  let i : Nobj ⟶ Q := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk iL
  let p : Q ⟶ X := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom πQ)
  let S := ShortComplex.mk i p (by
    ext x
    exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp (eN.symm x).2)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := shortExact_of_lie hiL hπQ fun y hy ↦
    ⟨eN ⟨y, LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr hy⟩, rfl⟩
  have : Projective S.X₂ := hQ
  refine Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_forall_exists_comp hS (fun a ↦ ?_) z
  let pX : Q.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ MX := eX.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp πQ
  have hpX : Function.Surjective pX := eX.symm.surjective.comp hπQ
  have hexactX : ∀ b, pX b = 0 ↔ ∃ a : πQ.ker, πQ.ker.incl a = b := fun b ↦
    Iff.trans ⟨fun hb ↦ eX.symm.injective (hb.trans (map_zero eX.symm.toLieModuleHom).symm),
      fun hb ↦ (congrArg eX.symm hb).trans (map_zero eX.symm.toLieModuleHom)⟩ (hexact b)
  obtain ⟨SD⟩ := ExtOne.exists_splitData (h P) Q.property.1.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
    hMX.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top Subtype.val_injective hpX hexactX
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (SD.connecting_eq_zero_iff
    (eY.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp ((toLieModuleHom a.hom).comp eN.toLieModuleHom))).mp (hXY _)
  refine ⟨(IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom (eY.toLieModuleHom.comp g)), ?_⟩
  ext x
  exact (congrArg eY (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hg (eN.symm x))).trans (eY.apply_symm_apply _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_of_equiv
statement:
theorem ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_of_equiv (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (MX MY : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup MX] [Module K MX] [LieRingModule 𝔤 MX] [LieModule K 𝔤 MX] [AddCommGroup MY]
    [Module K MY] [LieRingModule 𝔤 MY] [LieModule K 𝔤 MY] (hMX : IsCategoryO P MX)
    (eX : MX ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X.obj) (eY : MY ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj) (hXY : ∀ e : ExtOne (h P) MX MY, e = 0)
    (z : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y 1) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := X.property.2
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, hD, hproj, hgen, π, hπ⟩ :=
    exists_isProjectiveO_surjective P (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan) X.property.1 hS
  exact ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_aux _ hD hgen hproj X Y π hπ MX MY hMX eX eY hXY z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne
statement:
theorem ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P)
    (hXY : ∀ e : ExtOne (h P) X.obj Y.obj, e = 0) (z : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y 1) : z = 0
proof:
:=
  ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_of_equiv X Y X.obj Y.obj X.property.1 (LieModuleEquiv.refl)
    (LieModuleEquiv.refl) hXY z

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.finite_degree_indices
statement:
private theorem finite_degree_indices {σ : Type*} [Finite σ] (n : ℕ) :
    Finite {s : σ →₀ ℕ // s.degree ≤ n}
proof:
:= by
  let f : {s : σ →₀ ℕ // s.degree ≤ n} → (σ → Fin (n + 1)) :=
    fun s i ↦ ⟨s.1 i, Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Finsupp.le_degree i s.1).trans s.2)⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f fun s t h ↦ Subtype.ext
    (Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ congrArg Fin.val (congrFun h i))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.finiteDimensional_filtration
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_filtration [FiniteDimensional K L] (n : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional K (filtration K L n)
proof:
:= by
  have := finite_degree_indices (σ := Fin (finrank K L)) n
  exact Module.Finite.of_basis (filtrationBasis (Module.finBasis K L) n)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.finrank_filtration_le
statement:
theorem finrank_filtration_le [FiniteDimensional K L] (n : ℕ) :
    finrank K (filtration K L n) ≤ (n + 1) ^ finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := finite_degree_indices (σ := Fin (finrank K L)) n
  let := Fintype.ofFinite {s : Fin (finrank K L) →₀ ℕ // s.degree ≤ n}
  rw [finrank_eq_card_basis (filtrationBasis (Module.finBasis K L) n)]
  let f : {s : Fin (finrank K L) →₀ ℕ // s.degree ≤ n} →
      (Fin (finrank K L) → Fin (n + 1)) :=
    fun s i ↦ ⟨s.1 i, Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Finsupp.le_degree i s.1).trans s.2)⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := fun s t h ↦ Subtype.ext
    (Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ congrArg Fin.val (congrFun h i))
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_polynomial_lt_two_pow
statement:
private theorem exists_polynomial_lt_two_pow (c r : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ c * n ^ r < 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hlim := (tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt r (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).const_mul
    (c : ℝ)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (c : ℝ) * (n ^ r / 2 ^ n) < 1 :=
    hlim.eventually_lt_const (by simp)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1 |>.and hsmall).exists
  refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n := by positivity
  have h' : (c : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ r < (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    apply (div_lt_one hp).mp
    simpa [mul_div_assoc] using h
  exact_mod_cast h'

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.not_doubling_of_polynomial_bound
proof:
:= by
  intro hdouble
  have hgrowth : ∀ n, 2 ^ n ≤ f (n * d) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hzero
    | succ n ih =>
      calc
        2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ n := pow_succ' _ _
        _ ≤ 2 * f (n * d) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ih
        _ ≤ f ((n + 1) * d) := by simpa [Nat.add_mul] using hdouble (n * d)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hlt⟩ := exists_polynomial_lt_two_pow ((d + 1) ^ r) r
  have hle : 2 ^ n ≤ (d + 1) ^ r * n ^ r := calc
    2 ^ n ≤ f (n * d) := hgrowth n
    _ ≤ (n * d + 1) ^ r := hbound _
    _ ≤ ((d + 1) * n) ^ r := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by nlinarith) r
    _ = (d + 1) ^ r * n ^ r := mul_pow _ _ _
  omega

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_common_left_multiple
statement:
theorem exists_common_left_multiple [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (a b : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ u v : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L, u * a = v * b ∧ u * a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hdisjoint
  obtain ⟨da, hda⟩ := exists_mem_filtration a
  obtain ⟨db, hdb⟩ := exists_mem_filtration b
  let d := max da db
  have hda' : a ∈ filtration K L d := filtration_mono (le_max_left _ _) hda
  have hdb' : b ∈ filtration K L d := filtration_mono (le_max_right _ _) hdb
  have hfinite : ∀ n, FiniteDimensional K (filtration K L n) :=
    finiteDimensional_filtration
  have hdouble : ∀ n, 2 * finrank K (filtration K L n) ≤
      finrank K (filtration K L (n + d)) := by
    intro n
    let T : (filtration K L n × filtration K L n) →ₗ[K] filtration K L (n + d) :=
      { toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x.1.1 * a + x.2.1 * b,
          add_mem (mul_mem_filtration x.1.2 hda') (mul_mem_filtration x.2.2 hdb')⟩
        map_add' := fun x y ↦ Subtype.ext (by dsimp; noncomm_ring)
        map_smul' := fun c x ↦ Subtype.ext (by dsimp; simp [smul_add]) }
    have hT : Function.Injective T := by
      apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
      apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
      rintro ⟨u, v⟩ h
      have heq : u.1 * a = (-v.1) * b := by
        have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
        change u.1 * a + v.1 * b = 0 at h'
        simpa using (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h')
      have hu : u.1 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp (hdisjoint u.1 (-v.1) heq)).resolve_right ha
      have hv : v.1 = 0 := by
        rw [hu, zero_mul, neg_mul, eq_comm, neg_eq_zero] at heq
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp heq).resolve_right hb
      exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hu) (Subtype.ext hv)
    have := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hT
    simpa [Module.finrank_prod, two_mul] using this
  have hzero : 0 < finrank K (filtration K L 0) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    exact ⟨⟨1, one_mem_filtration 0⟩, fun h ↦ one_ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  exact not_doubling_of_polynomial_bound (fun n ↦ finrank K (filtration K L n)) d
    (finrank K L) hzero finrank_filtration_le hdouble

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.nonempty_oreSet
statement:
theorem nonempty_oreSet [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Nonempty (OreLocalization.OreSet
      (nonZeroDivisors (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L)))
proof:
:= by
  apply OreLocalization.nonempty_oreSet_iff_of_noZeroDivisors.mpr
  intro r s
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · exact ⟨0, 1, by simp [hr]⟩
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu⟩ := exists_common_left_multiple r s.1 hr
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp s.2)
  refine ⟨v, ⟨u, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ?_⟩, huv⟩
  intro h
  exact hu (by rw [h, zero_mul])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_oreSet_envNNeg
statement:
theorem nonempty_oreSet_envNNeg :
    Nonempty (OreLocalization.OreSet (nonZeroDivisors
      (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P))))
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional P hA
  exact UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.nonempty_oreSet

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.inf_ne_bot_of_finite_type
statement:
theorem inf_ne_bot_of_finite_type (Λ : Dual K H)
    (N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ))
    (h₁ : N₁ ≠ ⊥) (h₂ : N₂ ≠ ⊥) : N₁ ⊓ N₂ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional P hA
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ : ∃ x ∈ N₁, x ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ne_eq, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff, not_forall, exists_prop] using h₁
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ : ∃ y ∈ N₂, y ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ne_eq, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff, not_forall, exists_prop] using h₂
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective y
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hx0 (by rw [h, map_zero])
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hy0 (by rw [h, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu⟩ := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_common_left_multiple a b ha hb
  rw [ne_eq, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
  push Not
  refine ⟨equivEnvNNeg P Λ (u * a), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [equivEnvNNeg_mul]
    exact smul_mem P Λ N₁ _ hx
  · rw [huv, equivEnvNNeg_mul]
    exact smul_mem P Λ N₂ _ hy
  · exact (LinearEquiv.map_ne_zero_iff _).mpr hu

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.vermaCoord_symm_apply
statement:
lemma vermaCoord_symm_apply (Λ : Dual K H) (q : MvPolynomial (NegRootIndex P) K) :
    (vermaCoord P Λ).symm q = equivEnvNNeg P Λ ((pbwEquiv (nNegBasis P)).symm q)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.vermaCoord_equivEnvNNeg
statement:
lemma vermaCoord_equivEnvNNeg (Λ : Dual K H) (u : 𝓤₋) :
    vermaCoord P Λ (equivEnvNNeg P Λ u) = pbwEquiv (nNegBasis P) u
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaCoord, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.vermaCoord_mem_iff
statement:
lemma vermaCoord_mem_iff (Λ : Dual K H) {n : ℕ} (u : 𝓤₋) :
    vermaCoord P Λ (equivEnvNNeg P Λ u) ∈ restrictTotalDegree (NegRootIndex P) K n ↔
      u ∈ filtration K (nNeg P) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaCoord_equivEnvNNeg, mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv (nNegBasis P)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.vermaCoord_lie_nNegBasis_sub_mem
statement:
theorem vermaCoord_lie_nNegBasis_sub_mem (Λ : Dual K H) (j : NegRootIndex P) (n : ℕ)
    {q : MvPolynomial (NegRootIndex P) K} (hq : q ∈ restrictTotalDegree (NegRootIndex P) K n) :
    vermaCoord P Λ ⁅(nNegBasis P j : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), (vermaCoord P Λ).symm q⁆ - X j * q ∈
      restrictTotalDegree (NegRootIndex P) K n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (pbwEquiv (nNegBasis P)).surjective q
  rw [vermaCoord_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, ← equivEnvNNeg_ι_mul,
    vermaCoord_equivEnvNNeg]
  exact pbwEquiv_ι_basis_mul_sub_mem (nNegBasis P) j n ((mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv _).mpr hq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_equivEnvNNeg_mem_of_mem_borel
statement:
lemma lie_equivEnvNNeg_mem_of_mem_borel (Λ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ u ∈ filtration K (nNeg P) n, ∀ x ∈ borel P,
      (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm ⁅x, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆ ∈ filtration K (nNeg P) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro u hu x hx
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := mem_filtration_zero.mp hu
    obtain ⟨a, y, hy, rfl⟩ := (mem_borel P).mp hx
    have h1 : equivEnvNNeg P Λ (algebraMap K 𝓤₋ r) = r • hwv P Λ := by
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, equivEnvNNeg_one]
    rw [h1, lie_smul, add_lie, lie_hwv_of_mem_nPos P Λ hy, add_zero, lie_h_hwv, smul_smul,
      ← equivEnvNNeg_one, ← map_smul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (one_mem_filtration 0)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro u hu x hx
    rw [filtration_succ] at hu
    induction hu using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
    | mem_mul_mem g hg w hw =>
      obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, _, ⟨y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hg
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hg₁
      rw [add_mul, map_add, lie_add, map_add, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul,
        map_smul, lie_smul, map_smul]
      refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (filtration_mono (Nat.le_succ n) (ih w hw x hx)))
        ?_
      simp only [LieHom.coe_toLinearMap]
      obtain ⟨y', a, z, hyz⟩ := exists_triangular P ⁅x, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆
      have hb : h P a + eHom P z ∈ borel P := (mem_borel P).mpr ⟨a, _, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [equivEnvNNeg_ι_mul, leibniz_lie, map_add, hyz, add_assoc, add_lie, map_add]
      refine add_mem (add_mem ?_ ?_) ?_
      · rw [show fHom P y' = ((⟨fHom P y', y', rfl⟩ : nNeg P) : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) from rfl,
          equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie, filtration_succ]
        exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨_, rfl⟩) hw
      · exact filtration_mono (Nat.le_succ n) (ih w hw _ hb)
      · have hw' := ih w hw x hx
        rw [← LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (equivEnvNNeg P Λ) ⁅x, equivEnvNNeg P Λ w⁆,
          equivEnvNNeg_symm_lie, filtration_succ]
        exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨_, rfl⟩) hw'
    | add w w' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add, lie_add, map_add]; exact add_mem h h'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.vermaCoord_lie_mem_of_mem_borel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (pbwEquiv (nNegBasis P)).surjective q
  rw [vermaCoord_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    ← LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (equivEnvNNeg P Λ) ⁅x, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆, vermaCoord_mem_iff]
  exact lie_equivEnvNNeg_mem_of_mem_borel P Λ n u ((mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv _).mpr hq) x hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.vermaCoord_symm_monomial_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem vermaCoord_symm_monomial_mem_weightSpace (Λ : Dual K H) (m : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    (vermaCoord P Λ).symm (monomial m 1) ∈ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - negRootWt P m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace P Λ m
  rwa [pbwBasisVerma, Basis.map_apply, pbwBasis_apply, ← pbwEquiv_symm_monomial]
    at h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.neg_mem_roots
statement: theorem neg_mem_roots {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ roots P) : -μ ∈ roots P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨neg_ne_zero.mpr hμ.1, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ.2
  refine Submodule.ne_bot_iff _ |>.mpr ⟨_, chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace P hx, fun h ↦ hx0 ?_⟩
  rw [← chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution P x, h, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootOf_mem_realRoots_of_height_lt
statement:
lemma rootOf_mem_realRoots_of_height_lt (n : ℕ) : ∀ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k → height k < n →
    P.rootOf k ∈ roots P → P.rootOf k ∈ P.realRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan
proof:
:= by
  set hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have hheight : ∀ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k → 0 ≤ height k := fun k hk ↦
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hk i
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro k hk hkn _
    have := hheight k hk
    omega
  | succ n ih =>
  intro k hk hkn hroot
  by_cases hsimple : ∃ i, P.rootOf k = P.root i
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hsimple
    rw [hi]
    exact P.root_mem_realRoots hA' i
  push Not at hsimple
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hroot.1 (by simp [h])
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, 0 < (A *ᵥ k) i := by
    by_contra! h
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
    have h1 := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hk0
    rw [star_trivial, ← mulVec_mulVec] at h1
    have h2 : k ⬝ᵥ diagonal d *ᵥ (A *ᵥ k) ≤ 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonpos fun j _ ↦ ?_
      rw [mulVec_diagonal]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hk j)
        (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hd j).le (h j))
    exact absurd h1 (not_lt.mpr h2)
  set k' := k - (A *ᵥ k) i • Pi.single i 1 with hk'def
  have hr : P.reflection hA' i (P.rootOf k) = P.rootOf k' := P.reflection_rootOf hA' i k
  have hroot' : P.rootOf k' ∈ roots P :=
    hr ▸ apply_mem_roots P hA' (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i) hroot
  obtain ⟨k'', ⟨hk''0, -⟩, hk''⟩ : P.rootOf k' ∈ P.posWeights :=
    hr ▸ reflection_mem_posWeights P hA' hroot ⟨k, ⟨hk, hk0⟩, rfl⟩ (hsimple i)
  obtain rfl : k'' = k' := P.rootOf_injective hk''
  have hh : height k' < n := by
    have : height k' = height k - (A *ᵥ k) i := by
      simp [hk'def, height, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Pi.single_apply]
    omega
  have hreal := ih k' hk''0 hh hroot'
  have : P.rootOf k = P.reflection hA' i (P.rootOf k') := by
    rw [← hr, reflection_reflection]
  rw [this]
  exact P.apply_mem_realRoots hA' (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i) hreal

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.roots_eq_realRoots
statement: theorem roots_eq_realRoots : roots P = P.realRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun μ hμ ↦ ?_) (realRoots_subset_roots P hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
  rcases mem_posWeights_or_mem_negWeights P hμ with ⟨k, ⟨hk, -⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, ⟨hk, -⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact rootOf_mem_realRoots_of_height_lt P hA ((height k).toNat + 1) k hk (by omega) hμ
  · have := rootOf_mem_realRoots_of_height_lt P hA ((height k).toNat + 1) k hk (by omega)
      (by simpa using neg_mem_roots P hμ)
    exact P.neg_mem_realRoots _ this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_roots
statement: theorem finite_roots : (roots P).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [roots_eq_realRoots P hA]
  exact P.finite_realRoots hA

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_rootSpace_of_mem_roots
statement:
theorem finrank_rootSpace_of_mem_roots {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ roots P) :
    finrank K (rootSpace P μ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [roots_eq_realRoots P hA] at hμ
  exact finrank_eq_of_rank_eq (rank_rootSpace_of_mem_realRoots P hA.isGeneralizedCartan hμ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finiteDimensional
statement: theorem finiteDimensional [FiniteDimensional K H] : FiniteDimensional K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
proof:
:= by
  set S := insert 0 (roots P)
  have hS : S.Finite := (finite_roots P hA).insert 0
  have hfg : (⨆ μ ∈ hS.toFinset, rootSpace P μ).FG := by
    refine Submodule.fg_biSup _ _ fun μ hμ ↦ ?_
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hμ
    rcases hμ with rfl | hμ
    · rw [rootSpace_zero, Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional]
      infer_instance
    · rw [Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional]
      exact Module.finite_of_finrank_eq_succ (finrank_rootSpace_of_mem_roots P hA hμ)
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ hS.toFinset, rootSpace P μ := by
    rw [← iSup_rootSpace_eq_top P]
    refine iSup₂_le fun μ _ ↦ ?_
    by_cases h0 : μ = 0
    · exact le_iSup₂_of_le μ (by simp [S, h0]) le_rfl
    by_cases hb : rootSpace P μ = ⊥
    · rw [hb]
      exact bot_le
    · exact le_iSup₂_of_le μ (by simp [S, roots, h0, hb]) le_rfl
  exact Module.finite_def.mpr (top_le_iff.mp htop ▸ hfg)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_h_mem_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_h_mem_of_ne_bot {J : LieIdeal K P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ a : H, a ≠ 0 ∧ h P a ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hJh
  refine hJ (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  have hle : J.comap (π P) ≤ AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P := by
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.le_maxIdeal_iff, eq_bot_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨hz, a, rfl⟩
    have ha : h P a ∈ J := by
      rw [← π_h]
      exact LieIdeal.mem_comap.mp hz
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · simp [ha0]
    · exact absurd ha (hJh a ha0)
  exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mpr ((π_eq_zero_iff P).mpr (hle (LieIdeal.mem_comap.mpr hx)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.not_isLieAbelian_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem not_isLieAbelian_of_ne_bot [FiniteDimensional K H] {J : LieIdeal K P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) : ¬IsLieAbelian J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha⟩ := exists_h_mem_of_ne_bot P hJ
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, P.root i a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    refine ha0 ((Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K a).mp fun φ ↦ ?_)
    have hφ : φ ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range P.root) := by
      rw [P.span_root_eq_top_of_isFiniteCartan hA]; trivial
    induction hφ using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hx; exact h j
    | zero => rfl
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy, add_zero]
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hx, smul_zero]
  rw [LieSubmodule.lie_abelian_iff_lie_self_eq_bot, LieSubmodule.lie_eq_bot_iff]
  intro hab
  have h1 : ⁅h P a, e P i⁆ ∈ J := lie_mem_left K _ J _ _ ha
  have h2 := hab _ ha _ h1
  rw [lie_h_e, lie_smul, lie_h_e, smul_smul, smul_eq_zero] at h2
  exact h2.elim (fun h ↦ hi (mul_self_eq_zero.mp h)) (e_ne_zero P i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isSemisimple
statement: theorem isSemisimple [FiniteDimensional K H] : IsSemisimple K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional P hA
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hA.isSymmetrizable
  exact InvariantForm.isSemisimple_of_nondegenerate (invForm P S) (nondegenerate_invForm P S)
    (lieInvariant_invForm P S) (isSymm_invForm P S).isRefl
    fun I hI ↦ not_isLieAbelian_of_ne_bot P hA hI.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero_of_hom
statement:
theorem ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero_of_hom (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (k : ℕ)
    (hY : ∀ y : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length y < k →
        ∀ φ : (verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ)).obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y.obj, φ = 0) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan),
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w' < n + k →
        ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' Λ)) Y n, x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro w' hw' x
    rw [← Abelian.Ext.mk₀_homEquiv₀_apply x,
      hom_eq_zero_of_lie (hY w' (by omega)) (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ x), Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro w' hw' x
    refine ext_succ_verma_eq_zero Y _ n (fun κ hκ hne z ↦ ?_) x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_weylDot_eq P hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA hκ)
    have hyw := (VermaModule.multiplicity_weylDot_ne_zero_iff_of_isDominantIntegral P hA hΛ).mp hκ
    have hlt := hyw.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
    exact ih y (by omega) z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_weylDot_verma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_verma_weylDot_verma_eq_zero (w w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w' <
      n + (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' Λ))
      (verma.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero_of_hom hA hΛ _ _ (fun y hy φ ↦ ?_) n w' hn x
  by_contra hφ
  let g : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ) :=
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).symm.toLieModuleHom.comp
      (φ.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).toLieModuleHom)
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hφ (LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 m)
  have hwy := (VermaModule.multiplicity_weylDot_ne_zero_iff_of_isDominantIntegral P hA hΛ).mp
    (VermaModule.multiplicity_ne_zero_of_hom_ne_zero P hg)
  have := hwy.length_le
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_weylDot_simple_eq_zero_of_equiv
statement:
theorem ext_verma_weylDot_simple_eq_zero_of_equiv (w w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (Z : CategoryO.{u} P)
    (e : Z.obj ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w' <
      n + (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' Λ)) Z n) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_verma_weylDot_eq_zero_of_hom hA hΛ _ _ (fun y hy φ ↦ ?_) n w' hn x
  by_contra hφ
  let g : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan y Λ) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ) :=
    e.toLieModuleHom.comp (φ.comp (ofLieEquiv (P := P) _).toLieModuleHom)
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hφ (LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦
    e.injective ((LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 m).trans (map_zero e).symm))
  have hyw := weylDot_injective P hA.isGeneralizedCartan hΛ
    (VermaModule.eq_of_hom_irreducible_ne_zero P hg)
  subst hyw
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_weylDot_simple_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_verma_weylDot_simple_eq_zero (w w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w' <
      n + (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' Λ))
      (simple.{u} P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ)) n) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  ext_verma_weylDot_simple_eq_zero_of_equiv hA hΛ w w' _
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule P _)).symm hn x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_irreducible_verma
statement:
theorem exists_injective_irreducible_verma [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) (S : A.Symmetrization) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ (μ : Dual K H) (φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ),
      Function.Injective φ ∧ IsIrreducible K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  let T : Set P.WeightOrd := {μ | ∃ φ :
    VermaModule P (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ, φ ≠ 0}
  have hTfin : T.Finite := by
    apply (Set.finite_range (fun w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan ↦
      WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ))).subset
    rintro μ ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_weylDot_of_hom_ne_zero P hA S hφ
    exact ⟨w, congrArg (WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P) hw.symm⟩
  have hTne : T.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P Λ, LieModuleHom.id, ?_⟩
    intro hid
    have := congrArg (fun f : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ ↦
      f (hwv P Λ)) hid
    exact hwv_ne_zero P Λ this
  obtain ⟨μ, ⟨φ, hφ⟩, hmax⟩ := hTfin.exists_maximal hTne
  refine ⟨WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ, φ, injective_of_ne_zero P hφ, ?_⟩
  apply IsIrreducible.mk
  intro N hN
  have : Nontrivial N :=
    (LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _).mpr hN
  obtain ⟨ν, ψ, hψ⟩ := ((isCategoryO P _).lieSubmodule N).exists_lieModuleHom_verma
  let g := N.incl.comp ψ
  have hg : g (hwv P ν) ≠ 0 := fun hz ↦ hψ (Subtype.ext hz)
  have hcomp : φ.comp g ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have he : φ (g (hwv P ν)) = φ 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun f : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ ↦
        f (hwv P ν)) hz
      simpa using this
    exact hg ((injective_of_ne_zero P hφ) he)
  have hνT : WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P ν ∈ T := ⟨φ.comp g, hcomp⟩
  have hμν : μ ≤ WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P ν := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P _
      LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id
      (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g (hwv_mem_weightSpace P ν)) hg
    refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    change WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ - ν = P.rootOf k
    rw [heq, sub_sub_cancel]
  have hνμ : ν = WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ :=
    congrArg (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P) (le_antisymm (hmax hνT hμν) hμν)
  have hw : g (hwv P ν) ∈ weightSpace P (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ)
      (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ) := by
    simpa only [hνμ] using map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g (hwv_mem_weightSpace P ν)
  rw [weightSpace_self] at hw
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hw
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hg (by rw [← hc, hz, zero_smul])
  apply eq_top_of_hwv_mem P _
  have hm : g (hwv P ν) ∈ N := (ψ (hwv P ν)).property
  have := N.smul_mem c⁻¹ hm
  rwa [← hc, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0, one_smul] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_smul_eq_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq_of_irreducible (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {Λ ν : Dual K H}
    [IsIrreducible K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P ν)]
    (φ ψ : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) (hψ : ψ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : K, c • ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hφ : φ = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hφ]⟩
  have hrφ : φ.range ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hz
    apply hφ
    apply (eq_zero_iff P φ).mpr
    exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (hz ▸ (show φ (hwv P ν) ∈ φ.range from ⟨_, rfl⟩))
  have hrψ : ψ.range ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hz
    apply hψ
    apply (eq_zero_iff P ψ).mpr
    exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (hz ▸ (show ψ (hwv P ν) ∈ ψ.range from ⟨_, rfl⟩))
  have hinter := inf_ne_bot_of_finite_type P hA Λ φ.range ψ.range hrφ hrψ
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ : ∃ x ∈ φ.range ⊓ ψ.range, x ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ne_eq, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff, not_forall, exists_prop] using hinter
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx.1
  have hpre : ψ.range.comap φ ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hz
    have hy0 : y = 0 := (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp
      (hz ▸ (show y ∈ ψ.range.comap φ from
        (show φ y ∈ ψ.range from hy.symm ▸ hx.2)))
    exact hx0 (by rw [← hy, hy0, map_zero])
  have htop : ψ.range.comap φ = ⊤ :=
    (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top _).resolve_left hpre
  have hmem : φ (hwv P ν) ∈ ψ.range :=
    show hwv P ν ∈ ψ.range.comap φ from htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hmem
  have hzw : z ∈ weightSpace P ν ν := by
    intro a
    apply injective_of_ne_zero P hψ
    rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, map_smul, hz]
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ (hwv_mem_weightSpace P ν) a
  rw [weightSpace_self] at hzw
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hzw
  refine ⟨c, hom_ext P ν ?_⟩
  change c • ψ (hwv P ν) = φ (hwv P ν)
  rw [← map_smul, hc, hz]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.precomp_injective
statement:
theorem precomp_injective {Λ μ ν : Dual K H}
    (j : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ) (hj : j ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (fun φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ ↦
      φ.comp j)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ ψ heq
  by_contra hne
  have hd : φ - ψ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  have hzero : (φ - ψ) (j (hwv P ν)) = 0 := by
    change φ (j (hwv P ν)) - ψ (j (hwv P ν)) = 0
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (LieModuleHom.congr_fun heq (hwv P ν))
  have hjzero : j (hwv P ν) = 0 :=
    injective_of_ne_zero P hd (hzero.trans (map_zero (φ - ψ)).symm)
  exact hj ((eq_zero_iff P j).mpr hjzero)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_le_one_of_finite_type
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_le_one_of_finite_type [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) (S : A.Symmetrization) (Λ μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hall : ∀ φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ, φ = 0
  · apply finrank_le_one_iff.mpr
    exact ⟨0, fun φ ↦ ⟨0, by rw [hall φ, zero_smul]⟩⟩
  push Not at hall
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hall
  obtain ⟨ν, j, hj, hirr⟩ := exists_injective_irreducible_verma P hA S μ
  have := hirr
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hwv_ne_zero P ν (hj (by rw [hz]; rfl))
  have hψj : ψ.comp j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hh : ψ.comp j = (0 :
        VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ).comp j := by
      exact hz.trans (LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl)
    exact hψ (precomp_injective P j hj0 hh)
  apply finrank_le_one_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨ψ, fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_irreducible P hA (φ.comp j) (ψ.comp j) hψj
  refine ⟨c, precomp_injective P j hj0 ?_⟩
  exact hc

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.algHom_pbwMonomial
statement:
theorem algHom_pbwMonomial (f : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L →ₐ[K] C)
    (v : σ → L) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    f (pbwMonomial K v s) = MvPolynomial.aeval (R := K) (fun i => f (ι K (v i)))
      (MvPolynomial.monomial s 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ m (s : σ →₀ ℕ), s.degree = m →
      f (pbwMonomial K v s) = MvPolynomial.aeval (R := K) (fun i => f (ι K (v i)))
        (MvPolynomial.monomial s 1) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro s hs
      rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff] at hs
      subst s
      simp
    | succ m ih =>
      intro s hs
      have hne : s.support.Nonempty := by
        rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, Finsupp.support_eq_empty]
        rintro rfl
        simp at hs
      have hts := PBW.sub_add_single_minIdx s hne
      have htdeg := PBW.degree_sub_single_minIdx s hne
      have e : MvPolynomial.monomial s (1 : K) =
          MvPolynomial.X (PBW.minIdx s hne) *
            MvPolynomial.monomial (s - Finsupp.single (PBW.minIdx s hne) 1) 1 := by
        rw [MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul,
          add_comm, hts]
      rw [e, map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, ← ih _ (by omega),
        ← map_mul, ← PBW.pbwMonomial_add_single (PBW.leAll_minIdx s hne), hts]
  exact h s.degree s rfl

name: SymmetricAlgebra.lift_comp_ι_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem lift_comp_ι_mem_homogeneous (f : M →ₗ[K] N) (n : ℕ)
    {p : SymmetricAlgebra K M} (hp : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule n) :
    lift ((ι K N).comp f) p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule n
proof:
:= by
  have h : (homogeneousSubmodule (K := K) (M := M) n).map
      (lift ((ι K N).comp f)).toLinearMap ≤ homogeneousSubmodule n := by
    unfold homogeneousSubmodule
    rw [Submodule.map_pow]
    apply pow_le_pow_left'
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f x, by simp⟩
  exact h ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

name: SymmetricAlgebra.lift_comp_equivMvPolynomial_symm
statement:
theorem lift_comp_equivMvPolynomial_symm (b : Basis σ K M)
    {C : Type*} [CommRing C] [Algebra K C] (f : M →ₗ[K] C) :
    (lift f).comp (equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toAlgHom =
      MvPolynomial.aeval (R := K) (fun i => f (b i))
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  simp

name: SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hh := (mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff (Module.Free.chooseBasis K M) n p).mp hp
  simp only [homogeneousComponent, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply,
    MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_of_mem hh]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_homogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_homogeneousComponent (b : Basis σ K M) (n : ℕ)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra K M) :
    equivMvPolynomial b (homogeneousComponent n p) =
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n (equivMvPolynomial b p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := (equivMvPolynomial b).symm.surjective p
  induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial s c =>
    have hp : (equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.monomial s c) ∈
        homogeneousSubmodule s.degree := by
      rw [mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff b]
      simp only [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl
    rw [homogeneousComponent_of_mem hp, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_of_mem (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl)]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback_id_degree_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem affinePullback_id_degree_of_homogeneous (b : Basis σ K M) (δ : Module.Dual K M)
    {n : ℕ} {p : SymmetricAlgebra K M} (hp : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule n) :
    (equivMvPolynomial b (affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p)).totalDegree ≤ n ∧
    (equivMvPolynomial b (affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p - p)).totalDegree ≤ n - 1 ∧
    (n = 0 → affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p - p = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let e := equivMvPolynomial b
  let f := affinePullback (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[K] M) δ
  have hf (x : M) : f (ι K M x) = ι K M x + algebraMap K (SymmetricAlgebra K M) (δ x) := by
    simp [f, affinePullback]
  change (e (f p)).totalDegree ≤ n ∧ (e (f p - p)).totalDegree ≤ n - 1 ∧
    (n = 0 → f p - p = 0)
  induction hp using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap c => simp [e, f]
  | add p q i _ _ hp hq =>
    simp only [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact ⟨(MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans (max_le hp.1 hq.1),
      (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans (max_le hp.2.1 hq.2.1),
      fun hi => by rw [hp.2.2 hi, hq.2.2 hi, zero_add]⟩
  | mem_mul g hg i p _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hg
    have hx : (e (ι K M x)).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
      apply MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.totalDegree_le
      apply (mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff b 1 _).mp
      exact (show ι K M x ∈ LinearMap.range (ι K M) ^ 1 by
        rw [pow_one]; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    have he : e (f (ι K M x)) = e (ι K M x) + MvPolynomial.C (δ x) := by
      simp [hf, e]
    have hfd : (e (f (ι K M x))).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
      rw [he]
      exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans
        (max_le hx (by simp))
    have hd : e (f (ι K M x * p) - ι K M x * p) =
        e (ι K M x) * e (f p - p) + MvPolynomial.C (δ x) * e (f p) := by
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, he, map_sub]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, by omega⟩
    · rw [map_mul, map_mul]
      exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (by omega)
    · rw [hd]
      apply (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans
      apply max_le
      · by_cases hi : i = 0
        · rw [ih.2.2 hi, map_zero, mul_zero, MvPolynomial.totalDegree_zero]
          omega
        · exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (by omega)
      · apply (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans
        rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C]
        omega

name: SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_affinePullback_id_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_affinePullback_id_of_homogeneous
    (δ : Module.Dual K M) {m n : ℕ} {p : SymmetricAlgebra K M}
    (hp : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule m) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    homogeneousComponent n (affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p) = homogeneousComponent n p
proof:
:= by
  have hd := affinePullback_id_degree_of_homogeneous (Free.chooseBasis K M) δ hp
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub]
  apply (equivMvPolynomial (Free.chooseBasis K M)).injective
  rw [equivMvPolynomial_homogeneousComponent, map_zero]
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · rw [hd.2.2 hm, map_zero, map_zero]
  · exact MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero _ _ (by omega)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback_id_degree_le
statement:
theorem affinePullback_id_degree_le (b : Basis σ K M) (δ : Module.Dual K M)
    (n : ℕ) {p : SymmetricAlgebra K M} (hp : (equivMvPolynomial b p).totalDegree ≤ n) :
    (equivMvPolynomial b (affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p)).totalDegree ≤ n ∧
    (equivMvPolynomial b (affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p - p)).totalDegree ≤ n - 1 ∧
    (n = 0 → affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p - p = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := (equivMvPolynomial b).symm.surjective p
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree] at hp
  rw [MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree, MvPolynomial.restrictSupport_eq_span] at hp
  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem q hq =>
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hq
    change s.degree ≤ n at hs
    have hh : (equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.monomial s 1) ∈
        homogeneousSubmodule s.degree := by
      rw [mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff b, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_monomial 1 rfl
    have hd := affinePullback_id_degree_of_homogeneous b δ hh
    exact ⟨hd.1.trans hs, hd.2.1.trans (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hs 1),
      fun hn => hd.2.2 (by omega)⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add q r _ _ hq hr =>
    simp only [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact ⟨(MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans (max_le hq.1 hr.1),
      (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans (max_le hq.2.1 hr.2.1),
      fun hn => by rw [hq.2.2 hn, hr.2.2 hn, zero_add]⟩
  | smul c q _ hq =>
    simp only [map_smul, ← smul_sub]
    exact ⟨(MvPolynomial.totalDegree_smul_le _ _).trans hq.1,
      (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_smul_le _ _).trans hq.2.1,
      fun hn => by rw [hq.2.2 hn, smul_zero]⟩

name: SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_affinePullback_id
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_affinePullback_id (b : Basis σ K M) (δ : Module.Dual K M)
    (n : ℕ) {p : SymmetricAlgebra K M} (hp : (equivMvPolynomial b p).totalDegree ≤ n) :
    homogeneousComponent n (affinePullback LinearMap.id δ p) = homogeneousComponent n p
proof:
:= by
  have hd := affinePullback_id_degree_le b δ n hp
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub]
  apply (equivMvPolynomial b).injective
  rw [equivMvPolynomial_homogeneousComponent, map_zero]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · rw [hd.2.2 hn, map_zero, map_zero]
  · exact MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero _ _ (by omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartanRestriction_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem cartanRestriction_ι (x : 𝔤) :

@[simp] theorem cartanRestriction_h (a : H) :

theorem cartanRestriction_of_mem_nNeg {x : 𝔤} (hx : x ∈ nNeg P) :

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartanRestriction_of_mem_nPos

theorem cartanRestriction_of_mem_nPos {x : 𝔤} (hx : x ∈ nPos P) :

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_cartanRestriction
statement:
theorem eval_cartanRestriction (Λ : Module.Dual K H) (p : SymmetricAlgebra K 𝔤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (cartanRestriction P p) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Λ.comp (cartanProj P)) p
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ).comp (cartanRestriction P) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Λ.comp (cartanProj P)) := by
    ext x
    simp
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hh p

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandraProjection_pbwMonomial
statement:
theorem harishChandraProjection_pbwMonomial
    {σ τ : Type*} [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ]
    (bN : Basis σ K (nNeg P)) (bB : Basis τ K (borel P))
    (s : σ ⊕ₗ τ →₀ ℕ) :
    harishChandraProjection P
      (pbwMonomial K (PBW.basisOfIsCompl (isCompl_nNeg_borel P) bN bB) s) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval (R := K)
        (fun i => SymmetricAlgebra.ι K H
          (cartanProj P (PBW.basisOfIsCompl (isCompl_nNeg_borel P) bN bB i)))
        (MvPolynomial.monomial s 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨sN, sB⟩, rfl⟩ := PBW.lexFinsuppEquiv.surjective s
  rw [← mulMap_pbwMonomial_tmul, mulMap_tmul, harishChandraProjection_mul,
    algHom_pbwMonomial, algHom_pbwMonomial, PBW.lexFinsuppEquiv_apply]
  rw [show MvPolynomial.monomial
      (sN.mapDomain (toLex ∘ Sum.inl) + sB.mapDomain (toLex ∘ Sum.inr)) (1 : K) =
      MvPolynomial.rename (toLex ∘ Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.monomial sN 1) *
        MvPolynomial.rename (toLex ∘ Sum.inr) (MvPolynomial.monomial sB 1) by
      simp [MvPolynomial.rename_monomial, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul_monomial]]
  rw [map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_rename, MvPolynomial.aeval_rename]
  have hn : (fun i => SymmetricAlgebra.ι K H
      (cartanProj P (PBW.basisOfIsCompl (isCompl_nNeg_borel P) bN bB
        ((toLex ∘ Sum.inl) i)))) = fun _ : σ => (0 : 𝓢) := by
    funext i
    simp [PBW.basisOfIsCompl_inl, cartanProj_of_mem_nNeg P (bN i).property]
  have hb : (fun i => SymmetricAlgebra.ι K H
      (cartanProj P (PBW.basisOfIsCompl (isCompl_nNeg_borel P) bN bB
        ((toLex ∘ Sum.inr) i)))) =
      fun i => envBorelCartanPolynomial P (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (bB i)) := by
    funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, PBW.basisOfIsCompl_inr,
      envBorelCartanPolynomial, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    rfl
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hn hb ⊢
  rw [hn, hb]
  simp [VermaModule.counitNNeg, Algebra.smul_def, MvPolynomial.aeval_def,
    map_finsuppProd]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.cartanRestriction_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem cartanRestriction_mem_homogeneous (n : ℕ)
    {p : SymmetricAlgebra K 𝔤} (hp : p ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n) :
    cartanRestriction P p ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_comp_ι_mem_homogeneous (cartanProj P) n hp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandraProjection_eq_cartanRestriction_pbw
statement:
theorem harishChandraProjection_eq_cartanRestriction_pbw
    {σ τ : Type*} [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ]
