lemma mem_cone_trans {μ₁ μ₂ μ₃ : Dual K H} (h₁₂ : μ₁ ∈ cone P μ₂) (h₂₃ : μ₂ ∈ cone P μ₃) :
    μ₁ ∈ cone P μ₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := h₁₂
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := h₂₃
  exact ⟨l + k, add_nonneg hl hk, by rw [map_add]; abel⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.factorWeights_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma factorWeights_nil :
    factorWeights ([] : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))) = []

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.factorWeights_cons_some

@[simp] lemma factorWeights_cons_some (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) (μ : Dual K H)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.nil_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma nil_iff {N M : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V} :
    IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν N [] M ↔ N = M
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.cons_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma cons_iff {N N' M : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V} {o : Option (Dual K H)}
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))} :
    IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν N ((N', o) :: l) M ↔
      N ≤ N' ∧ IsLocalFactor P ν N N' o ∧ IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν N' l M
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.le
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing N with
  | nil => exact (nil_iff.mp hl).le
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨h, -, hl⟩ := cons_iff.mp hl
    exact h.trans (ih hl)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.append
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing N₁ with
  | nil =>
    rw [nil_iff] at h₁
    rwa [List.nil_append, h₁]
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨h, hf, hl⟩ := cons_iff.mp h₁
    exact cons_iff.mpr ⟨h, hf, ih hl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.exists_of_mem_factorWeights
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing N with
  | nil => simp at hμ
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨h, hf, hl'⟩ := cons_iff.mp hl
    clear hl
    cases o with
    | none =>
      obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hf'⟩ := ih hl' (by simpa using hμ)
      exact ⟨M₁, M₂, h.trans h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hf'⟩
    | some μ' =>
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp (by simpa using hμ) with rfl | hμ
      · exact ⟨N, N', le_rfl, h, hl'.le, hf⟩
      · obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hf'⟩ := ih hl' hμ
        exact ⟨M₁, M₂, h.trans h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hf'⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hf⟩ := hl.exists_of_mem_factorWeights hμ
  exact hf.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finite_setOf_mem_cone
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.finite_setOf_mem_cone (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (ν : Dual K H) :
    {μ | ν ∈ cone P μ ∧ weightSpace P V μ ≠ ⊥}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (((hV.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_ne_bot ν).image (· + ν)).insert ν).subset ?_
  rintro μ ⟨⟨k, hk, hνμ⟩, hμ⟩
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · left
    rw [hνμ, hk0, map_zero, sub_zero]
  · right
    have hμ' : P.rootOf k + ν = μ := by rw [hνμ]; abel
    exact ⟨P.rootOf k, ⟨⟨k, ⟨hk, hk0⟩, rfl⟩, by rwa [hμ']⟩, hμ'⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule
statement:
lemma iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) :
    ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap N (h P) μ = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (hV.lieSubmodule N).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_subquotient_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem weightSpace_subquotient_eq_bot_iff (N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P (N₁.Subquotient N₂) μ = ⊥ ↔
      N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ ≤ N₁.toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace, ← map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P _
    (iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule hV N₂) μ, eq_bot_iff, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap,
    Submodule.comap_bot, ker_quotMk]
  constructor
  · rintro hle v ⟨hv₂, hv⟩
    exact hle ((mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff (m := (⟨v, hv₂⟩ : N₂))).mpr hv)
  · intro hle m hm
    exact hle ⟨m.2, mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_inf_weightSpace_eq_add
statement:
theorem finrank_inf_weightSpace_eq_add {N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V}
    (hN : N₁ ≤ N₂) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K ↥(N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ) =
      finrank K ↥(N₁.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ) +
        finrank K (weightSpace P (N₁.Subquotient N₂) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have := (hV.lieSubmodule N₂).finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  have hadd := finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_add P (N₁.comap N₂.incl)
    (iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule hV N₂) μ
  rw [finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule, finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule] at hadd
  have hmap : ((N₁.comap N₂.incl).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap N₂ (h P) μ).map
      (N₂.incl : N₂ →ₗ[K] V) = N₁.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ := by
    ext v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, ⟨hm₁, hm⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hm₁, mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hm⟩
    · rintro ⟨hv₁, hv⟩
      exact ⟨⟨v, hN hv₁⟩, ⟨hv₁, mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mpr hv⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hadd, (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective (N₂.incl : N₂ →ₗ[K] V) Subtype.val_injective
    _).finrank_eq, hmap]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finrankAbove_mono
statement:
lemma finrankAbove_mono {N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V} (h : N₁ ≤ N₂) :
    hV.finrankAbove ν N₁ ≤ hV.finrankAbove ν N₂
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun μ _ ↦ ?_
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  have : FiniteDimensional K ↥(N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_right
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono (inf_le_inf_right _ h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finrankAbove_lt
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun μ _ ↦ ?_) ⟨μ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    have : FiniteDimensional K ↥(N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ) :=
      Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_right
    exact Submodule.finrank_mono (inf_le_inf_right _ h)
  · rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    refine ⟨hνμ, fun hbot ↦ hw₁ ?_⟩
    rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hw
    rw [hw]
    exact N₁.zero_mem
  · have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    have : FiniteDimensional K ↥(N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ) :=
      Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_right
    refine Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne (inf_le_inf_right _ h) fun heq ↦ ?_)
    have : w ∈ N₁.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ := heq ▸ ⟨hw₂, hw⟩
    exact hw₁ this.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_subquotient_equiv_irreducibleModule
statement:
theorem exists_subquotient_equiv_irreducibleModule {N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V}
    (hN : N₁ ≤ N₂) {μ : Dual K H} {w : V} (hw : w ∈ weightSpace P V μ) (hw₂ : w ∈ N₂)
    (hw₁ : w ∉ N₁) (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, w⁆ ∈ N₁) :
    ∃ M₁ M₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V, N₁ ≤ M₁ ∧ M₁ ≤ M₂ ∧ M₂ ≤ N₂ ∧ w ∈ M₂ ∧
      w ∉ M₁ ∧ Nonempty (M₁.Subquotient M₂ ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ)
proof:
:= by
  set π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₁
  have hw' : π w ∈ weightSpace P (V ⧸ N₁) μ := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P π hw
  have he' (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, π w⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact he i
  set ψ := VermaModule.lift P (π w) (fun _ hx ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos he' hx) (fun a ↦ hw' a)
  have hψ : ψ (VermaModule.hwv P μ) = π w := VermaModule.lift_hwv P _ _ _
  set R := ψ.range
  set R' := (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ).map ψ
  have hker : ψ.ker ≤ VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ := by
    refine (VermaModule.le_maxSubmodule_iff P μ _).mpr fun htop ↦ hw₁ ?_
    have : VermaModule.hwv P μ ∈ ψ.ker := htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _
    rwa [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, hψ, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
  have hmem (m : VermaModule P μ) : ψ m ∈ R' ↔ m ∈ VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ := by
    refine ⟨fun hm ↦ ?_, fun hm ↦ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨m', hm', hmm'⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hm
    have : m - m' ∈ ψ.ker := by rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hmm', sub_self]
    simpa using add_mem (hker this) hm'
  have hRN₂ : R ≤ N₂.map π := by
    rw [show R = _ from VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan ψ, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le,
      Set.singleton_subset_iff, hψ]
    exact ⟨w, hw₂, rfl⟩
  
  have e₁ : Nonempty (R'.Subquotient R ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) := by
    let θ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ R'.Subquotient R :=
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _).comp (ψ.codRestrict R fun m ↦ ⟨m, rfl⟩)
    have hθ : Function.Surjective θ := by
      intro q
      obtain ⟨⟨_, m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ q
      exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
    have hker : θ.ker = VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ := by
      ext m
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, ← hmem]
      exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective _ θ hθ hker
    exact ⟨e.symm⟩
  
  have e₂ : Nonempty ((R'.comap π).Subquotient (R.comap π) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      R'.Subquotient R) := by
    let θ : R.comap π →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ R'.Subquotient R :=
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _).comp ((π.comp (R.comap π).incl).codRestrict R fun x ↦ x.2)
    have hθ : Function.Surjective θ := by
      intro q
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ q
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N₁ (r : V ⧸ N₁)
      exact ⟨⟨x, show π x ∈ R from hx ▸ r.2⟩,
        congrArg (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (R'.comap R.incl)) (Subtype.ext hx)⟩
    have hker : θ.ker = (R'.comap π).comap (R.comap π).incl := by
      ext x
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
      exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _
    exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective _ θ hθ hker
  obtain ⟨e₁⟩ := e₁
  obtain ⟨e₂⟩ := e₂
  refine ⟨R'.comap π, R.comap π, fun x hx ↦ ?_,
    fun x hx ↦ LieSubmodule.map_le_range (N := VermaModule.maxSubmodule P μ) ψ hx, fun x hx ↦ ?_,
    ?_, ?_, ⟨e₂.trans e₁⟩⟩
  · rw [LieSubmodule.mem_comap, (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hx]
    exact R'.zero_mem
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (hRN₂ (LieSubmodule.mem_comap.mp hx))
    have : x - y ∈ N₁ := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hyx.symm
    simpa using add_mem (hN this) hy
  · exact LieSubmodule.mem_comap.mpr ⟨VermaModule.hwv P μ, hψ⟩
  · intro hw
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_comap, ← hψ, hmem] at hw
    exact VermaModule.hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule P μ hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_isLocalFactor_some
statement:
theorem exists_isLocalFactor_some {N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V} (hN : N₁ ≤ N₂)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hνμ : ν ∈ cone P μ)
    (hμ : ¬ N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ ≤ N₁.toSubmodule) :
    ∃ (M₁ M₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) (μ' : Dual K H), N₁ ≤ M₁ ∧ M₁ ≤ M₂ ∧
      M₂ ≤ N₂ ∧ hV.finrankAbove ν M₁ < hV.finrankAbove ν M₂ ∧
        IsLocalFactor P ν M₁ M₂ (some μ')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set T : Set (ι → ℤ) :=
    {k | 0 ≤ k ∧ ¬ N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V (μ + P.rootOf k) ≤ N₁.toSubmodule}
  have hTfin : T.Finite := by
    refine ((hV.finite_setOf_mem_cone ν).preimage
      (f := fun k ↦ μ + P.rootOf k) (fun k _ l _ hkl ↦ P.rootOf_injective
        (add_left_cancel hkl))).subset ?_
    rintro k ⟨hk, hkN⟩
    refine ⟨mem_cone_trans hνμ ⟨k, hk, (add_sub_cancel_right μ (P.rootOf k)).symm⟩,
      fun hbot ↦ hkN ?_⟩
    simp only at hbot
    rw [hbot, inf_bot_eq]
    exact bot_le
  have hTne : T.Nonempty := ⟨0, le_rfl, by rwa [map_zero, add_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨hk, hkN⟩, hmax⟩ := hTfin.exists_maximal hTne
  obtain ⟨w, ⟨hw₂, hw⟩, hw₁⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp hkN
  have he (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, w⁆ ∈ N₁ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : k + Pi.single i 1 ∈ T := by
      refine ⟨add_nonneg hk (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one), fun hle ↦ hne (hle ⟨N₂.lie_mem hw₂,
        ?_⟩)⟩
      have := toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace i hw
      rwa [add_assoc, ← rootOf_single P i, ← map_add] at this
    have := hmax hmem (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one)) i
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hwM₂, hwM₁, he⟩ :=
    exists_subquotient_equiv_irreducibleModule hN hw hw₂ hw₁ he
  have hνμ' : ν ∈ cone P (μ + P.rootOf k) :=
    mem_cone_trans hνμ ⟨k, hk, (add_sub_cancel_right μ (P.rootOf k)).symm⟩
  exact ⟨M₁, M₂, μ + P.rootOf k, h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hV.finrankAbove_lt h₁₂ hνμ' hw hwM₂ hwM₁,
    hνμ', he⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_isLocalCompositionSeries_of_le (ν : Dual K H)
    {N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V} (h : N₁ ≤ N₂) :
    ∃ l, IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν N₁ l N₂
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ n, ∀ N₁ N₂ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V, N₁ ≤ N₂ →
      hV.finrankAbove ν N₂ - hV.finrankAbove ν N₁ = n →
        ∃ l, IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν N₁ l N₂ from H _ N₁ N₂ h rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro N₁ N₂ h hn
  by_cases hc : ∀ μ, ν ∈ cone P μ → N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ ≤ N₁.toSubmodule
  · exact ⟨[(N₂, none)], h,
      fun μ hμ ↦ (weightSpace_subquotient_eq_bot_iff hV N₁ N₂ μ).mpr (hc μ hμ), rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨μ, hνμ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ, ν ∈ cone P μ ∧
      ¬ N₂.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ ≤ N₁.toSubmodule := by
    simpa only [not_forall, exists_prop] using hc
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, μ', h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hlt, hf⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalFactor_some h hνμ hμ
  have hm₁ := hV.finrankAbove_mono (ν := ν) h₁
  have hm₂ := hV.finrankAbove_mono (ν := ν) h₂
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁⟩ := ih _ (by omega) N₁ M₁ h₁ rfl
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂⟩ := ih _ (by omega) M₂ N₂ h₂ rfl
  exact ⟨l₁ ++ (M₂, some μ') :: l₂, hl₁.append (IsLocalCompositionSeries.cons_iff.mpr
    ⟨h₁₂, hf, hl₂⟩)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries
statement:
theorem exists_isLocalCompositionSeries (ν : Dual K H) :
    ∃ l, IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) l ⊤
proof:
:=
  hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries_of_le ν bot_le

name: IsSl2Triple.lie_h_lie_f
statement: lemma lie_h_lie_f {c : K} {v : M} (hv : ⁅h, v⁆ = c • v) : ⁅h, ⁅f, v⁆⁆ = (c - 2) • ⁅f, v⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [leibniz_lie, t.lie_lie_smul_f K, hv, neg_lie, smul_lie, lie_smul, sub_smul]
  abel

name: IsSl2Triple.lie_h_lie_e
statement: lemma lie_h_lie_e {c : K} {v : M} (hv : ⁅h, v⁆ = c • v) : ⁅h, ⁅e, v⁆⁆ = (c + 2) • ⁅e, v⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [leibniz_lie, t.lie_h_e_smul K, hv, smul_lie, lie_smul, add_smul]
  abel

name: IsSl2Triple.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f_of_lie_h
statement:
lemma lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f_of_lie_h (m : ℕ) {c : K} {v : M} (hv : ⁅h, v⁆ = c • v) :
    ⁅e, (toEnd K L M f ^ (m + 1)) v⁆ =
      (toEnd K L M f ^ (m + 1)) ⁅e, v⁆ + ((m + 1 : K) * (c - m)) • (toEnd K L M f ^ m) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f, hv, ← sub_smul, map_smul, smul_smul]

name: IsSl2Triple.pow_toEnd_e_pow_toEnd_f
statement:
lemma pow_toEnd_e_pow_toEnd_f (m : ℕ) {c : K} {v : M} (hv : ⁅h, v⁆ = c • v) (he : ⁅e, v⁆ = 0) :
    (toEnd K L M e ^ m) ((toEnd K L M f ^ m) v) =
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, ((j + 1 : K) * (c - j))) • v
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f_of_lie_h m hv,
      he, map_zero, zero_add, map_smul, ih, smul_smul, Finset.prod_range_succ, mul_comm]

name: IsSl2Triple.eq_zero_of_pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero {k n : ℕ} {v : M} (hk : (toEnd K L M e ^ k) v = 0)
    (hv : ⁅h, v⁆ = (n : K) • v) (hf : (toEnd K L M f ^ n) v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing n v with
  | zero => simpa using hk
  | succ k ih =>
    
    have hev : ⁅e, v⁆ = 0 := by
      refine ih (n := n + 2) ?_ ?_ ?_
      · rwa [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply] at hk
      · rw [t.lie_h_lie_e hv]; push_cast; ring_nf
      · have h1 : (toEnd K L M f ^ (n + 1)) v = 0 := by
          rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, hf, map_zero]
        have h2 : (toEnd K L M f ^ (n + 2)) v = 0 := by
          rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, h1, map_zero]
        have := t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f_of_lie_h (n + 1) hv
        rwa [h2, h1, lie_zero, smul_zero, add_zero, eq_comm] at this
    
    have := t.pow_toEnd_e_pow_toEnd_f n hv hev
    rw [hf, map_zero, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero] at this
    refine this.resolve_left (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j hj ↦ mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_)
    · exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero j
    · rw [sub_ne_zero, Ne, Nat.cast_inj]
      exact (Finset.mem_range.mp hj).ne'

name: IsSl2Triple.exists_int_of_lie_h_eq_smul
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing c v with
  | zero => exact absurd (by simpa using hk) hv0
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hev : ⁅e, v⁆ = 0
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hf v
      have := t.pow_toEnd_e_pow_toEnd_f m hv hev
      rw [hm, map_zero, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at this
      obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := this.resolve_right hv0
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hj with hj | hj
      · exact absurd hj (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero j)
      · exact ⟨j, by rw [sub_eq_zero] at hj; exact_mod_cast hj⟩
    · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih (by rwa [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply] at hk)
        (t.lie_h_lie_e hv) hev
      exact ⟨z - 2, by push_cast; rw [← hz]; ring⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isSl2Triple
statement:
theorem isSl2Triple (i : ι) : IsSl2Triple (h P (P.coroot i)) (e P i) (f P i) where
  h_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
    rw [Ne, ← map_zero (h P), (h_injective P).eq_iff]
    exact P.linearIndependent_coroot.ne_zero i
  lie_e_f := lie_e_f_self P i
  lie_h_e_nsmul := by rw [lie_h_e, P.root_coroot_self hA, two_smul, two_smul]
  lie_h_f_nsmul := by rw [lie_h_f, P.root_coroot_self hA, two_smul, two_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_int_of_weightSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_int_of_weightSpace_ne_bot (hV : IsIntegrable P V) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : weightSpace P V μ ≠ ⊥) (i : ι) : ∃ z : ℤ, μ (P.coroot i) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hV.exists_pow_e_eq_zero i v
  exact (isSl2Triple P hA i).exists_int_of_lie_h_eq_smul (hV.exists_pow_f_eq_zero i) hk (hv _)
    hv0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rank_weightSpace_le_reflection
statement:
theorem rank_weightSpace_le_reflection (hV : IsIntegrable P V) (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Module.rank K (weightSpace P V μ) ≤
      Module.rank K (weightSpace P V (P.reflection hA i μ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : weightSpace P V μ = ⊥
  · rw [hμ, rank_bot]; exact zero_le
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_int_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hA hV hμ i
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg z
  · 
    have hr : P.reflection hA i μ = μ - n • P.root i := by
      rw [reflection_apply, hz, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    let φ : weightSpace P V μ →ₗ[K] weightSpace P V (P.reflection hA i μ) :=
      (toEnd K _ V (f P i) ^ n).restrict fun v hv ↦ hr ▸ toEnd_f_pow_mem_weightSpace i hv n
    refine LinearMap.rank_le_of_injective φ (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp ?_)
    refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr fun v hv ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hV.exists_pow_e_eq_zero i v
    refine t.eq_zero_of_pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero hk ?_ (congr_arg Subtype.val hv)
    rw [v.2 (P.coroot i), hz, Int.cast_natCast]
  · 
    have hr : P.reflection hA i μ = μ + n • P.root i := by
      rw [reflection_apply, hz, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K]
      module
    let φ : weightSpace P V μ →ₗ[K] weightSpace P V (P.reflection hA i μ) :=
      (toEnd K _ V (e P i) ^ n).restrict fun v hv ↦ hr ▸ toEnd_e_pow_mem_weightSpace i hv n
    refine LinearMap.rank_le_of_injective φ (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp ?_)
    refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr fun v hv ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hV.exists_pow_f_eq_zero i v
    refine t.symm.eq_zero_of_pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero hk ?_ (congr_arg Subtype.val hv)
    rw [neg_lie, v.2 (P.coroot i), hz, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, neg_smul, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rank_weightSpace_reflection
statement:
theorem rank_weightSpace_reflection (hV : IsIntegrable P V) (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Module.rank K (weightSpace P V (P.reflection hA i μ)) = Module.rank K (weightSpace P V μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (rank_weightSpace_le_reflection hA hV i μ)
  have := rank_weightSpace_le_reflection hA hV i (P.reflection hA i μ)
  rwa [reflection_reflection] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rank_weightSpace_weylGroup
proof:
:= by
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA
    (p := fun w ↦ ∀ μ, Module.rank K (weightSpace P V (w μ)) = Module.rank K (weightSpace P V μ))
    (fun μ ↦ rfl) (fun i w ih μ ↦ ?_) hw μ
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, rank_weightSpace_reflection hA hV, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_weightSpace_weylGroup_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_weightSpace_weylGroup_equiv (hV : IsIntegrable P V)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Nonempty (weightSpace P V (w μ) ≃ₗ[K] weightSpace P V μ)
proof:
:=
  Module.nonempty_linearEquiv_iff_rank_eq.mpr (rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA hV hw μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_weylGroup_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem weightSpace_weylGroup_eq_bot_iff (hV : IsIntegrable P V)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P V (w μ) = ⊥ ↔ weightSpace P V μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.rank_eq_zero, ← Submodule.rank_eq_zero, rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA hV hw]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rank_rootSpace_weylGroup
statement:
theorem rank_rootSpace_weylGroup {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (μ : Dual K H) : Module.rank K (rootSpace P (w μ)) = Module.rank K (rootSpace P μ)
proof:
:=
  rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA (isIntegrable_adjoint P hA) hw μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bijOn_range_of_block
statement:
theorem bijOn_range_of_block {lam : Dual K H} (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W]
    (e : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V V)
    (e' : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 W W)
    (φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W)
    (φ' : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 W V)
    (h₁ : ∀ x, e.app (VermaModule P lam) (φ'.app _ (e'.app _ (e'.app _ (φ.app _
      (e.app (VermaModule P lam) x))))) = e.app _ x)
    (h₂ : ∀ y, e'.app (VermaModule P lam) (φ.app _ (e.app _ (e.app _ (φ'.app _
      (e'.app (VermaModule P lam) y))))) = e'.app _ y)
    {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {s : Finset M} (hs : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hblock : ∀ μ, hM.multiplicity μ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
        μ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
    (he : ∀ x, e.app M (e.app M x) = e.app M x) (he' : ∀ y, e'.app M (e'.app M y) = e'.app M y) :
    Set.BijOn (fun x ↦ e'.app M (φ.app M x)) (Set.range (e.app M)) (Set.range (e'.app M))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ₁, hψ₂⟩ := exists_inverse_of_block P hA hlam hM₀ hI e e' ((e'.comp φ).comp e)
    ((e.comp φ').comp e') (LieModuleHom.ext h₁) (LieModuleHom.ext h₂) hM hs hblock he he'
    (fun x ↦ by simp only [TensorNatTrans.comp_app, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, he, he'])
    (fun y ↦ by simp only [TensorNatTrans.comp_app, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, he, he'])
  have hψ₁' : ∀ a, ψ (e'.app M (φ.app M (e.app M a))) = e.app M a := LinearMap.congr_fun hψ₁
  have hψ₂' : ∀ b, e'.app M (φ.app M (e.app M (ψ b))) = e'.app M b := LinearMap.congr_fun hψ₂
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, rfl⟩ hab
    have := congrArg ψ hab
    simp only at this
    rwa [hψ₁', hψ₁'] at this
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e.app M (ψ (e'.app M b)), ⟨_, rfl⟩, by simp only [hψ₂', he']⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_tensorNatTrans_of_equiv_verma
statement:
theorem exists_tensorNatTrans_of_equiv_verma {lam : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) {V W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [FiniteDimensional K V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (p : VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] V)
    (p' : VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] W)
    (hp : ∀ x, p (p x) = p x) (hp' : ∀ y, p' (p' y) = p' y) (E : p.range ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ p'.range) :
    ∃ (φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W)
      (φ' : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 W V),
      (∀ x, p (φ'.app _ (p' (p' (φ.app _ (p x))))) = p x) ∧
        ∀ y, p' (φ.app _ (p (p (φ'.app _ (p' y))))) = p' y
proof:
:= by
  let r : VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ p.range :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict p.range p fun x ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range p _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
  let r' : VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ p'.range :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict p'.range p' fun y ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range p' _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_tensorNatTrans_app_verma P hA hlam hM₀ hI hK
    (p'.range.incl.comp (E.toLieModuleHom.comp r))
  obtain ⟨φ', hφ'⟩ := exists_tensorNatTrans_app_verma P hA hlam hM₀ hI hK
    (p.range.incl.comp (E.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp r'))
  
  have hfix : ∀ x : p.range, p x = x := by
    rintro ⟨_, a, rfl⟩
    exact hp a
  have hfix' : ∀ y : p'.range, p' y = y := by
    rintro ⟨_, b, rfl⟩
    exact hp' b
  have hr : ∀ x : p.range, r x = x := fun x ↦ Subtype.ext (hfix x)
  have hr' : ∀ y : p'.range, r' y = y := fun y ↦ Subtype.ext (hfix' y)
  refine ⟨φ, φ', fun x ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [hφ, hφ']
    change p ((E.symm (r' (p' (p' (E (r (p x)) : _))))) : _) = p x
    rw [hfix' (E (r (p x))), hfix' (E (r (p x))), hr', E.symm_apply_apply]
    change p (p (p x)) = p x
    rw [hp, hp]
  · rw [hφ, hφ']
    change p' ((E (r (p (p (E.symm (r' (p' y)) : _))))) : _) = p' y
    rw [hfix (E.symm (r' (p' y))), hfix (E.symm (r' (p' y))), hr, E.apply_symm_apply]
    change p' (p' (p' y)) = p' y
    rw [hp', hp']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_bijOn_translationIdem
statement:
theorem exists_bijOn_translationIdem {lam : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I))
    {L₁ L₁' L₂ L₂' : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup L₁] [Module K L₁] [LieRingModule 𝔤 L₁]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 L₁] [FiniteDimensional K L₁] [AddCommGroup L₁'] [Module K L₁']
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 L₁'] [LieModule K 𝔤 L₁'] [FiniteDimensional K L₁'] [AddCommGroup L₂]
    [Module K L₂] [LieRingModule 𝔤 L₂] [LieModule K 𝔤 L₂] [FiniteDimensional K L₂]
    [AddCommGroup L₂'] [Module K L₂'] [LieRingModule 𝔤 L₂'] [LieModule K 𝔤 L₂']
    [FiniteDimensional K L₂'] (hL₁ : IsCategoryO P L₁) (hL₁' : IsCategoryO P L₁')
    (hL₂ : IsCategoryO P L₂) (hL₂' : IsCategoryO P L₂') (χ₁ χ₂ χ₁' χ₂' : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (hV : IsCategoryO P (VermaModule P lam))
    (E : (translationIdem P hL₁ hL₁' χ₁ χ₂ (VermaModule P lam) hV).range ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      (translationIdem P hL₂ hL₂' χ₁' χ₂' (VermaModule P lam) hV).range) :
    ∃ φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 (L₁ ⊗[K] L₁') (L₂ ⊗[K] L₂'),
      ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
        [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (s : Finset M),
        LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤ →
        (∀ μ, hM.multiplicity μ ≠ 0 → ∃ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
          μ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) →
        Set.BijOn (fun x ↦ translationIdem P hL₂ hL₂' χ₁' χ₂' M hM (φ.app M x))
          (Set.range (translationIdem P hL₁ hL₁' χ₁ χ₂ M hM))
          (Set.range (translationIdem P hL₂ hL₂' χ₁' χ₂' M hM))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, φ', h₁, h₂⟩ := exists_tensorNatTrans_of_equiv_verma P hA hlam hM₀ hI hK _ _
    (translationIdem_idempotent P hL₁ hL₁' χ₁ χ₂ _ hV)
    (translationIdem_idempotent P hL₂ hL₂' χ₁' χ₂' _ hV) E
  refine ⟨φ, fun M _ _ _ _ hM s hs hblock ↦ ?_⟩
  have hsV : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤
      (({VermaModule.hwv P lam} : Finset (VermaModule P lam)) : Set (VermaModule P lam)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [Finset.coe_singleton]
    exact VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id
  obtain ⟨e, heM, heV⟩ := exists_tensorNatTrans_app_eq_translationIdem P hL₁ hL₁' χ₁ χ₂ hM hs hV
    hsV
  obtain ⟨e', he'M, he'V⟩ := exists_tensorNatTrans_app_eq_translationIdem P hL₂ hL₂' χ₁' χ₂' hM
    hs hV hsV
  have key := bijOn_range_of_block P hA hlam hM₀ hI e e' φ φ' (by rw [heV, he'V]; exact h₁)
    (by rw [heV, he'V]; exact h₂) hM hs hblock
    (by rw [heM]; exact fun x ↦ translationIdem_idempotent ..)
    (by rw [he'M]; exact fun y ↦ translationIdem_idempotent ..)
  rwa [heM, he'M] at key

name: Module.finrank_add_finrank_le_of_comp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Module.finrank_add_finrank_le_of_comp_eq_zero [FiniteDimensional K B] (f : A →ₗ[K] B)
    (g : B →ₗ[K] C) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hfg : g ∘ₗ f = 0) :
    finrank K A + finrank K C ≤ finrank K B
proof:
:= by
  have hrk := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hg, finrank_top] at hrk
  have hle : LinearMap.range f ≤ LinearMap.ker g := fun _ ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ by
    rw [← ha, LinearMap.mem_ker, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, hfg, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hf] at this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_lieSubmodule_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_finset_lieSpan_lieSubmodule_eq_top {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    {S : Finset V} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (S : Set V) = ⊤)
    (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) :
    ∃ T : Finset N, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (T : Set N) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := hV.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P hA hS
  have : WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra N) :=
    (LieSubmodule.mapOrderEmbedding (f := N.incl) Subtype.val_injective).strictMono.wellFoundedGT
  exact LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relAcyclic_of_isInjectiveO
statement:
theorem relAcyclic_of_isInjectiveO {J : Type u} [AddCommGroup J] [Module K J]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra J] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra J]
    (hJinj : IsInjectiveO.{u} P J) (hJ : IsCategoryO P J)
    (hJS : ∃ S : Finset J, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (S : Set J) = ⊤)
    (hproj : ∀ (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
      [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V], IsProjectiveO.{u} P V → IsCategoryO P V →
      (∃ S : Finset V, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (S : Set V) = ⊤) →
      RelAcyclic P V J)
    (n : ℕ) (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hMS : ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (S : Set M) = ⊤) :
    IsZero (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing M with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hMS
    obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, hQO, hQproj, ⟨T, hT⟩, π, hπ⟩ :=
      exists_isProjectiveO_surjective.{u, u} P hA hM hS
    let Kr := π.ker
    have hKO : IsCategoryO P Kr := hQO.lieSubmodule Kr
    obtain ⟨TK, hTK⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_lieSubmodule_eq_top hA hQO hT Kr
    obtain ⟨SJ, hSJ⟩ := hJS
    have hex : Function.Exact Kr.incl π := fun y ↦
      ⟨fun hy ↦ ⟨⟨y, LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr hy⟩, rfl⟩,
        by rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp x.2⟩
    have hT' := homPrecomp_shortExact (N := J) (h P) hQO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      hM.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top Subtype.val_injective hex hπ
    have hrel : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel 0 1 := rfl
    let δ := (hT'.δ 0 1 hrel).hom
    have hδ : Function.Surjective δ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp
      (hT'.epi_δ 0 1 hrel (hproj _ hQproj hQO ⟨T, hT⟩ 0))
    
    have := hM.finiteDimensional_hom P hS hJ
    have := hQO.finiteDimensional_hom P hT hJ
    have := hKO.finiteDimensional_hom P hTK hJ
    have e₁ := relCohomologyZeroHomEquiv P M J
    have e₂ := relCohomologyZeroHomEquiv P
      (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) J
    have e₃ := relCohomologyZeroHomEquiv P Kr J
    have := e₁.symm.finiteDimensional
    have := e₂.symm.finiteDimensional
    have := e₃.symm.finiteDimensional
    have hfd : FiniteDimensional K
        (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) (0 + 1)) :=
      Module.Finite.of_surjective δ hδ
    
    let R : ((DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))
          →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J) →ₗ[K]
        (Kr →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J) :=
      { toFun := fun φ ↦ φ.comp Kr.incl
        map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
        map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
    have hR : Function.Surjective R := fun ψ ↦
      let ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hJinj hKO hQO Kr.incl Subtype.val_injective ψ
      ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    let I : (M →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J) →ₗ[K]
        ((DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J) :=
      { toFun := fun ψ ↦ ψ.comp π
        map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
        map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
    have hI : Function.Injective I := fun ψ ψ' hψ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ by
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hπ m
      exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ q
    have hRI : R ∘ₗ I = 0 := LinearMap.ext fun ψ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by
      change ψ (π x) = 0
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp x.2, map_zero]
    have hle := Module.finrank_add_finrank_le_of_comp_eq_zero I R hI hR hRI
    
    have hmono : Mono (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPrecomp J π)) 0) := by
      have := hT'.mono_f
      have hnat := CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀_inv_naturality
        (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPrecomp J π))
      have : Mono (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPrecomp J π)) 0 ≫
            (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ _).inv) := by
        rw [hnat]
        infer_instance
      exact mono_of_mono _ (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ _).inv
    have hH := Module.finrank_add_finrank_of_exact_four
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPrecomp J π)) 0).hom
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPrecomp J Kr.incl)) 0).hom
      δ ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp hmono)
      (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr ((ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker _).mp
        (hT'.homology_exact₂ 0)).symm)
      (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr ((ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker _).mp
        (hT'.homology_exact₃ 0 1 hrel)).symm) hδ
    have h₁ : finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) 0) =
        finrank K (M →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J) := e₁.finrank_eq
    have h₂ : finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
          ((DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) 0) =
        finrank K ((DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))
          →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J) :=
      e₂.finrank_eq
    have h₃ : finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Kr →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) 0) =
        finrank K (Kr →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J) := e₃.finrank_eq
    have hH' : finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) 0) +
        finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Kr →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) 0) =
        finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
          ((DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) 0) +
        finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) (0 + 1)) :=
      hH
    have h0 : finrank K
        (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) (0 + 1)) = 0 := by
      omega
    have : Subsingleton
        (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] J) (Set.range (h P)) (0 + 1)) :=
      Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp h0
    exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hMS
    obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, hQO, hQproj, ⟨T, hT⟩, π, hπ⟩ :=
      exists_isProjectiveO_surjective.{u, u} P hA hM hS
    let Kr := π.ker
    have hex : Function.Exact Kr.incl π := fun y ↦
      ⟨fun hy ↦ ⟨⟨y, LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr hy⟩, rfl⟩,
        by rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp x.2⟩
    have hT' := homPrecomp_shortExact (N := J) (h P) hQO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      hM.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top Subtype.val_injective hex hπ
    have hrel : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) := rfl
    have := hT'.epi_δ (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) hrel (hproj _ hQproj hQO ⟨T, hT⟩ (n + 1))
    exact IsZero.of_epi (hT'.δ (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) hrel)
      (ih Kr (hQO.lieSubmodule Kr) (exists_finset_lieSpan_lieSubmodule_eq_top hA hQO hT Kr))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.relAcyclic_restrictedDual_projectiveCoverAmbient
statement:
theorem relAcyclic_restrictedDual_projectiveCoverAmbient {κ : Type} [Finite κ]
    (τ : κ → Dual K H) (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hMS : ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (S : Set M) = ⊤) :
    RelAcyclic P M
      (restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have : Finite (NegRootIndex P) := Finite.of_equiv _ (negRootIndexEquiv P hA).symm
  have hQO : IsCategoryO P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) :=
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun j ↦ isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA _ _
  have hQproj : IsProjectiveO.{u} P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) :=
    IsProjectiveO.directSum fun j ↦ isProjectiveO_projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA _
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top fun j ↦
    exists_finset_lieSpan_projectiveCoverAmbient'_eq_top P hA (τ j)
  obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := IsProjectiveO.exists_isStdFiltered P hA hQproj hQO hT
  have hIO := isCategoryO_restrictedDual hQO
  have hIinj := hQproj.isInjectiveO_restrictedDual P hQO.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  obtain ⟨fQ, hfQ⟩ := hQO.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hT
  obtain ⟨FQ, hFQ⟩ := hQO.exists_strictMono_restrictedDual P hfQ
  have hIS := LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top_of_strictMono hFQ
  exact fun n ↦ relAcyclic_of_isInjectiveO hA hIinj hIO hIS
    (fun V _ _ _ _ hVproj hVO ⟨S, hS⟩ ↦
      let ⟨s, hs⟩ := IsProjectiveO.exists_isStdFiltered P hA hVproj hVO hS
      (relAcyclic_restrictedDual_of_isStdFiltered P hVO hQO hs hs').congr
        (topLieEquiv P V) (restrictedDualEquiv (P := P) (topLieEquiv P _).symm)) n M hM hMS

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_shortExact_injective_relAcyclic
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_injective_relAcyclic (Y : CategoryO.{u} P) :
    ∃ (J Z : CategoryO.{u} P) (f : Y ⟶ J) (g : J ⟶ Z) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact ∧ Injective J ∧
      (∀ X : CategoryO.{u} P, RelAcyclic P X.obj J.obj) ∧
      ∃ (g₁ : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J.obj) (g₂ : J.obj →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ Z.obj),
        Function.Injective g₁ ∧ Function.Exact g₁ g₂ ∧ Function.Surjective g₂
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsFiniteCartan := Fact.out
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := Y.property.2
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, hIO, hIinj, hIfg, e, he⟩ :=
    exists_isInjectiveO_injective.{u, u} P hA Y.property.1 hS
  let I := restrictedDual P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))
  let J := mk I hIO hIfg
  let e' : Y.obj →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ J.obj := (ofLieEquiv (P := P) I).toLieModuleHom.comp e
  have he' : Function.Injective e' := (ofLieEquiv (P := P) I).injective.comp he
  let N := e'.range
  have hex : Function.Exact e' (toQuotient J N) := fun x ↦
    (toQuotient_eq_zero_iff J N x).trans (e'.mem_range x)
  let f : Y ⟶ J := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom e')
  let g : J ⟶ ofQuotient J N := (IsObj.{u} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom (toQuotient J N))
  have w : f ≫ g = 0 := by
    ext y
    exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero y
  refine ⟨J, ofQuotient J N, f, g, w, shortExact_of_lie he' (surjective_toQuotient J N)
    (fun y hy ↦ (hex y).mp hy), injective_mk I hIO hIfg hIinj, fun X ↦ ?_,
    e', toQuotient J N, he', hex, surjective_toQuotient J N⟩
  exact (relAcyclic_restrictedDual_projectiveCoverAmbient hA τ X.obj X.property.1
    X.property.2).congr LieModuleEquiv.refl (ofLieEquiv (P := P) I)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finiteDimensional_relCohomology_and_finrank_eq
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_relCohomology_and_finrank_eq (X : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ Y : CategoryO.{u} P,
      FiniteDimensional K
        (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X.obj →ₗ[K] Y.obj) (Set.range (h P)) n) ∧
      finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y n) =
        finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X.obj →ₗ[K] Y.obj) (Set.range (h P)) n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro Y
    exact ⟨LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (extZeroEquivRelCohomology X Y),
      (extZeroEquivRelCohomology X Y).finrank_eq⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro Y
    obtain ⟨J, Z, f, g, w, hS, hJ, hJ0, g₁, g₂, hg₁, hex, hg₂⟩ :=
      exists_shortExact_injective_relAcyclic P Y
    have hT := homPostcomp_shortExact (M := X.obj) (h P)
      J.property.1.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top Z.property.1.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      hg₁ hex hg₂
    have hrel : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel n (n + 1) := rfl
    let δ := (hT.δ n (n + 1) hrel).hom
    have := hJ
    have hJext : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X J (m + 1)), x = 0 :=
      fun m x ↦ Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_injective x
    
    have hδ : Function.Surjective δ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp
      (hT.epi_δ n (n + 1) hrel (hJ0 X n))
    have hfd : FiniteDimensional K
        (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X.obj →ₗ[K] Y.obj) (Set.range (h P)) (n + 1)) :=
      have := (ih Z).1
      Module.Finite.of_surjective δ hδ
    refine ⟨hfd, ?_⟩
    
    have hc : Function.Surjective (connectingLinear X hS n) := fun x ↦
      (exact_connectingLinear_postcompLinear X hS n x).mp (hJext n _)
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      
      have hE := Module.finrank_add_finrank_of_exact_four (postcompLinear X f 0)
        (postcompLinear X g 0) (connectingLinear X hS 0)
        (injective_postcompLinear_zero X hS) (exact_postcompLinear X hS 0)
        (exact_connectingLinear X hS 0) hc
      
      have hmono : Mono (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPostcomp X.obj g₁)) 0) := by
        have := hT.mono_f
        have hnat := CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀_inv_naturality
          (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPostcomp X.obj g₁))
        have : Mono (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homPostcomp X.obj g₁)) 0 ≫
              (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ _).inv) := by
          rw [hnat]
          infer_instance
        exact mono_of_mono _ (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ _).inv
      have := (ih J).1
      have := (ih Z).1
      have hH := Module.finrank_add_finrank_of_exact_four (relCohomologyPostcomp X.obj g₁ 0)
        (relCohomologyPostcomp X.obj g₂ 0) δ ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp hmono)
        (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr ((ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker _).mp
          (hT.homology_exact₂ 0)).symm)
        (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr ((ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker _).mp
          (hT.homology_exact₃ 0 1 hrel)).symm) hδ
      change _ + finrank K
          (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X.obj →ₗ[K] Z.obj) (Set.range (h P)) 0) =
        _ + finrank K
          (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X.obj →ₗ[K] Y.obj) (Set.range (h P)) (0 + 1))
        at hH
      rw [(ih Y).2, (ih J).2, (ih Z).2] at hE
      change _ = _ + finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y (0 + 1)) at hE
      omega
    | succ n =>
      
      have hci : Function.Injective (connectingLinear X hS (n + 1)) := by
        rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.exact_iff.mp (exact_connectingLinear _ hS _)]
        exact eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ by
          rw [← hy, hJext n y, map_zero]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      have := hT.isIso_δ (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) hrel (hJ0 X n) (hJ0 X (n + 1))
      rw [← (LinearEquiv.ofBijective _ ⟨hci, hc⟩).finrank_eq, (ih Z).2,
        (asIso (hT.δ (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) hrel)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finrank_ext_eq_finrank_relCohomology
statement:
theorem finrank_ext_eq_finrank_relCohomology (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ) :
    finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y n) =
      finrank K (relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X.obj →ₗ[K] Y.obj) (Set.range (h P)) n)
proof:
:=
  (finiteDimensional_relCohomology_and_finrank_eq X n Y).2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.nonempty_ext_linearEquiv_relCohomology
statement:
theorem nonempty_ext_linearEquiv_relCohomology (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y n ≃ₗ[K]
      relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (X.obj →ₗ[K] Y.obj) (Set.range (h P)) n)
proof:
:=
  have := (finiteDimensional_relCohomology_and_finrank_eq X n Y).1
  ⟨LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ (finrank_ext_eq_finrank_relCohomology X Y n)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.nonempty_ext_mk_linearEquiv_relCohomology
statement:
theorem nonempty_ext_mk_linearEquiv_relCohomology (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module K N] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra N] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra N]
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hMS : ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hN : IsCategoryO P N)
    (hNS : ∃ S : Finset N, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (S : Set N) = ⊤) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Abelian.Ext.{u} (mk M hM hMS) (mk N hN hNS) n ≃ₗ[K]
      relCohomology K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M →ₗ[K] N) (Set.range (h P)) n)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_ext_linearEquiv_relCohomology (mk M hM hMS) (mk N hN hNS) n
  ⟨e.trans (relCohomologyCongr (Set.range (h P)) (LieModuleHom.homCongr
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) M).symm (ofLieEquiv (P := P) N).symm) n).toLinearEquiv⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_ne_bot
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_ne_bot [CharZero K] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (μ₀ : Dual K H) :
    {α | α ∈ P.posWeights ∧ weightSpace P V (α + μ₀) ≠ ⊥}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hV.exists_finset
  let c : Dual K H → ι → ℤ := fun Λ ↦
    if hc : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - μ₀ then hc.choose else 0
  refine (s.finite_toSet.biUnion fun Λ _ ↦ ((Set.Finite.pi (t := fun i ↦ Set.Icc 0 (c Λ i))
    fun i ↦ Set.finite_Icc _ _).image P.rootOf)).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨l, hl, rfl⟩, hne⟩
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, k, hk, heq⟩ := hs _ hne
  have hlk : P.rootOf (l + k) = Λ - μ₀ := by
    rw [map_add, ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_eq_zero.mpr heq]
    abel
  have hex : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - μ₀ := ⟨_, hlk⟩
  have hc : c Λ = l + k := P.rootOf_injective (by
    simp only [c, hex, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [hex.choose_spec, hlk])
  refine Set.mem_biUnion hΛ ⟨l, fun i _ ↦ ⟨hl.1 i, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hc, Pi.add_apply, le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
  exact hk i

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.isPosFinite
statement: theorem IsCategoryO.isPosFinite [CharZero K] (hV : IsCategoryO P V) : IsPosFinite P V
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace P V μ := by rw [hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]; trivial
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun v ↦
    {α | α ∈ P.posWeights ∧ ∃ x ∈ rootSpace P α, ⁅x, v⁆ ≠ 0}.Finite) hv ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro μ v hv
    refine (hV.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_ne_bot μ).subset ?_
    rintro α ⟨hα, x, hx, hxv⟩
    refine ⟨hα, fun hbot ↦ hxv ?_⟩
    have : ⁅x, v⁆ ∈ weightSpace P V (α + μ) := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hx hv
    rwa [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  · simp
  · intro v w hv hw
    refine (hv.union hw).subset ?_
    rintro α ⟨hα, x, hx, hxv⟩
    by_cases h1 : ⁅x, v⁆ = 0
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hα, x, hx, by rwa [lie_add, h1, zero_add] at hxv⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hα, x, hx, h1⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.one_le_sum_of_mem_posCone
statement: lemma one_le_sum_of_mem_posCone [Fintype ι] {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) : 1 ≤ ∑ j, k j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk.2
  have h0 := hk.1 j
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hj h0
  exact (show 1 ≤ k j by omega).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hk.1 j) (Finset.mem_univ j))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.add_root_notMem_posWeights
statement:
lemma add_root_notMem_posWeights [CharZero K] {β : Dual K H} (hβ : β ∈ P.negWeights) (i : ι) :
    β + P.root i ∉ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hβ
  simp only at hl'
  have heq : P.rootOf (l + k) = P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1) := by
    rw [map_add, rootOf_single, hl']
    abel
  have := congrArg (fun f : ι → ℤ ↦ ∑ j, f j) (P.rootOf_injective heq)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_pi_single', Finset.mem_univ,
    ite_true] at this
  have h1 := one_le_sum_of_mem_posCone hl
  have h2 := one_le_sum_of_mem_posCone hk
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root
statement:
theorem finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root [CharZero K] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    (F : Dual K H → M) (i : ι) (hF : ∀ μ, rootSpace P μ = ⊥ → F μ = 0)
    (hfin : (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support F).Finite) :
    ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F (μ - P.root i) = F 0 + ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F μ
proof:
:= by
  have hpt (β : Dual K H) : P.posWeights.indicator (fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i)) (β + P.root i) =
      (insert 0 P.posWeights).indicator F β := by
    by_cases hβ : β ∈ insert 0 P.posWeights
    · have : β + P.root i ∈ P.posWeights := by
        rcases hβ with rfl | hβ
        · simpa using P.root_mem_posWeights i
        · exact P.posWeights_add hβ (P.root_mem_posWeights i)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem this, Set.indicator_of_mem hβ, add_sub_cancel_right]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hβ]
      by_cases h' : β + P.root i ∈ P.posWeights
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h', add_sub_cancel_right]
        refine hF β (by_contra fun hne ↦ ?_)
        rcases mem_allWeights_of_rootSpace_ne_bot P hne with (hneg | h0) | hpos
        · exact add_root_notMem_posWeights P hneg i h'
        · exact hβ (Or.inl h0)
        · exact hβ (Or.inr hpos)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h']
  calc ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F (μ - P.root i)
      = ∑ᶠ μ, P.posWeights.indicator (fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i)) μ := finsum_mem_def _ _
    _ = ∑ᶠ β, P.posWeights.indicator (fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i))
          (Equiv.addRight (P.root i) β) := (finsum_comp_equiv _).symm
    _ = ∑ᶠ β, (insert 0 P.posWeights).indicator F β := finsum_congr hpt
    _ = ∑ᶠ β ∈ insert 0 P.posWeights, F β := (finsum_mem_def _ _).symm
    _ = F 0 + ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F μ := finsum_mem_insert' F P.zero_notMem_posWeights hfin

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root
statement:
lemma finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root [CharZero K] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    (F : Dual K H → M) (i : ι) (hF : ∀ μ, rootSpace P μ = ⊥ → F μ = 0)
    (hfin : (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support F).Finite) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((hfin.insert 0).preimage (f := fun μ ↦ μ - P.root i)
    (sub_left_injective.injOn)).subset ?_
  rintro μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_insert_iff]
  by_cases h0 : μ - P.root i = 0
  · exact Or.inl h0
  refine Or.inr ⟨?_, hne⟩
  have hne' : rootSpace P (μ - P.root i) ≠ ⊥ := fun hbot ↦ hne (hF _ hbot)
  rcases mem_allWeights_of_rootSpace_ne_bot P hne' with (hneg | h0') | hpos
  · exact absurd (by rwa [sub_add_cancel]) (add_root_notMem_posWeights P hneg i)
  · exact absurd h0' h0
  · exact hpos

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite
statement:
private lemma finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite {α M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] {s : Set α}
    {f g : α → M} (hf : (s ∩ Function.support f).Finite)
    (hg : (s ∩ Function.support g).Finite) :
    ∑ᶠ i ∈ s, (f i - g i) = ∑ᶠ i ∈ s, f i - ∑ᶠ i ∈ s, g i
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : (s ∩ Function.support fun i ↦ f i - g i).Finite :=
    (hf.union hg).subset fun i ⟨his, hi⟩ ↦ by
      rcases Function.support_sub f g hi with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨his, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨his, h⟩
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← finsum_mem_add_distrib' hfg hg]
  simp only [sub_add_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.root_toDual_symm_root
statement:
lemma root_toDual_symm_root [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K H] (S : A.Symmetrization)
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    P.root i ((P.toDual S).symm (P.root i)) = 2 * P.root i ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, ← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq _ P.rho,
    two_mul_dualBilinForm_rho_root S hA]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lieLieBilin_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma lieLieBilin_apply (v : V) (y x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    lieLieBilin V v y x = ⁅y, ⁅x, v⁆⁆
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirTerm_apply
statement:
lemma casimirTerm_apply (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    hB.casimirTerm V μ v = hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [casimirTerm, casimirSum_def, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.exists_of_casimirTerm_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exists_of_casimirTerm_ne_zero {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : hB.casimirTerm V μ v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ rootSpace P μ, ⁅x, v⁆ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [casimirTerm_apply] at hv
  obtain ⟨y, -, x, hx, hne⟩ := hB.exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hv
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, lie_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_casimirTerm
statement:
lemma finite_casimirTerm (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (v : V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦ hB.casimirTerm V μ v).Finite
proof:
:=
  (hV v).subset fun _ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hμ, hB.exists_of_casimirTerm_ne_zero hne⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_apply
statement:
lemma casimir_apply (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (v : V) :
    hB.casimir V hV v = (2 : K) • ⁅h P ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho), v⁆ + hB.casimirTerm V 0 v +
      (2 : K) • ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_of_mem_rootSpace_zero
statement:
lemma lie_of_mem_rootSpace_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M]
    {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P 0) {Λ : Dual K H}
    {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M (h P) Λ) :
    ⁅x, m⁆ = B (h P ((P.toDual S).symm Λ)) x • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootSpace_zero] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [hm a, hB.h_h, bilinForm_toDual_symm_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_casimirTerm
statement:
lemma lie_casimirTerm (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    ⁅z, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ = hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅z, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) μ +
      hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅z, x⁆, v⁆⁆) μ + hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅z, v⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp only [casimirTerm_apply, casimirSum_def, lie_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [leibniz_lie z (hB.dualBasis μ k), leibniz_lie z (rootSpaceBasis P μ k : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) v,
    lie_add]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_lie_left_lie
statement:
lemma casimirSum_lie_left_lie {γ : Dual K H} {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ)
    (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅z, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) μ =
      -hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅z, x⁆, v⁆⁆) (μ - γ)
proof:
:= by
  have := hB.casimirSum_lie_left (lieLieBilin V v) hz μ
  simp only [lieLieBilin_apply] at this
  rw [← this, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, casimirSum_def, casimirSum_def, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← add_lie, ← lie_skew z, neg_add_cancel, zero_lie]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_casimirTerm_sub
statement:
lemma lie_casimirTerm_sub {γ : Dual K H} {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ)
    (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    ⁅z, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ - hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅z, v⁆ =
      hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅z, x⁆, v⁆⁆) μ -
        hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅z, x⁆, v⁆⁆) (μ - γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lie_casimirTerm, hB.casimirSum_lie_left_lie V hz]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_casimirTerm_sub'
statement:
lemma lie_casimirTerm_sub' {γ : Dual K H} {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ)
    (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    ⁅z, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ - hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅z, v⁆ =
      hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅z, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) μ -
        hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅z, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) (μ + γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lie_casimirTerm, hB.casimirSum_lie_left_lie V hz (μ + γ), add_sub_cancel_right]
  abel_nf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_zero_left
statement:
lemma casimirSum_zero_left {γ : Dual K H} {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ)
    (v : V) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅z, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) 0 = -⁅z, ⁅h P ((P.toDual S).symm γ), v⁆⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hH : h P ((P.toDual S).symm γ) ∈ rootSpace P 0 := by
    rw [rootSpace_zero]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← hB.sum_smul_basis 0 hH]
  simp only [casimirSum_def, sum_lie, lie_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hk : hB.dualBasis 0 k ∈ rootSpace P 0 := by simpa using hB.dualBasis_mem 0 k
  rw [← lie_skew z, hB.lie_of_mem_rootSpace_zero hk hz, neg_lie, smul_lie, smul_lie, lie_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_zero_right
statement:
lemma casimirSum_zero_right {γ : Dual K H} {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ)
    (v : V) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅z, x⁆, v⁆⁆) 0 = -⁅h P ((P.toDual S).symm γ), ⁅z, v⁆⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hH : h P ((P.toDual S).symm γ) ∈ rootSpace P (-0) := by
    rw [neg_zero, rootSpace_zero]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← hB.sum_smul_dualBasis 0 hH]
  simp only [casimirSum_def, sum_lie, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← lie_skew z, hB.lie_of_mem_rootSpace_zero (rootSpaceBasis_mem P 0 k) hz, neg_lie,
    smul_lie, lie_neg, lie_smul, smul_lie, hB.symm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_lie_h_sub
statement:
lemma lie_lie_h_sub {γ : Dual K H} {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ) (a : H)
    (v : V) : ⁅z, ⁅h P a, v⁆⁆ - ⁅h P a, ⁅z, v⁆⁆ = -(γ a • ⁅z, v⁆)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lie_lie, ← lie_skew, hz a, neg_lie, smul_lie]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_zero_right_sub_left
statement:
lemma casimirSum_zero_right_sub_left {γ : Dual K H} {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ) (v : V) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅z, x⁆, v⁆⁆) 0 - hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅z, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) 0 =
      -(γ ((P.toDual S).symm γ) • ⁅z, v⁆)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hB.casimirSum_zero_right V hz, hB.casimirSum_zero_left V hz, ← lie_lie_h_sub V hz]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_casimirSum_left
statement:
lemma finite_casimirSum_left (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (v : V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦
      hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅z, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) μ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (hV v).subset fun μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hμ, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, -, x, hx, hne⟩ := hB.exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hne
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, lie_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_casimirSum_right
statement:
lemma finite_casimirSum_right (hV : IsPosFinite P V) {γ : Dual K H} (hγ : γ ∈ P.posWeights)
    {z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hz : z ∈ rootSpace P γ) (v : V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦
      hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅z, x⁆, v⁆⁆) μ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((hV v).preimage (f := fun μ ↦ γ + μ) (add_right_injective γ).injOn).subset
    fun μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨y, -, x, hx, hne⟩ := hB.exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hne
  exact ⟨P.posWeights_add hγ hμ, ⁅z, x⁆, lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hz hx,
    fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, lie_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_finsum_casimirTerm_sub
statement:
lemma lie_finsum_casimirTerm_sub (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (v : V) :
    ⁅z, ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ -
        ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅z, v⁆ =
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, (⁅z, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ - hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅z, v⁆)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V z).toAddMonoidHom.map_finsum_mem'
    (hB.finite_casimirTerm hV v)
  simp only [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, toEnd_apply_apply] at h1
  rw [h1, finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite _ (hB.finite_casimirTerm hV _)]
  refine (hB.finite_casimirTerm hV v).subset fun μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hμ, fun h0 ↦ hne ?_⟩
  simp only [h0, lie_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_lie_e
statement:
theorem casimir_lie_e (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (i : ι) (v : V) :
    hB.casimir V hV ⁅e P i, v⁆ = ⁅e P i, hB.casimir V hV v⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hz : e P i ∈ rootSpace P (P.root i) := fun a ↦ lie_h_e P a i
  have hfin := hB.finite_casimirSum_right hV (P.root_mem_posWeights i) hz v
  have hR0 : ∀ μ, rootSpace P μ = ⊥ → hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅e P i, x⁆, v⁆⁆) μ = 0 :=
    fun μ hμ ↦ hB.casimirSum_eq_zero_of_eq_bot (fun y ↦ by simp) hμ
  have hsum : ⁅e P i, ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ -
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅e P i, v⁆ =
      -hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅y, ⁅⁅e P i, x⁆, v⁆⁆) 0 := by
    rw [hB.lie_finsum_casimirTerm_sub hV,
      finsum_mem_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ hB.lie_casimirTerm_sub V hz μ v,
      finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite hfin
        (finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root P _ i hR0 hfin),
      finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root P _ i hR0 hfin]
    abel
  have h0 := hB.lie_casimirTerm_sub V hz 0 v
  have hL := hB.casimirSum_lie_left_lie V hz 0 v
  have hRL := hB.casimirSum_zero_right_sub_left V hz v
  have hρ := lie_lie_h_sub V hz ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) v
  rw [root_toDual_symm_root S hA] at hRL
  simp only [casimir_apply, lie_add, lie_smul]
  linear_combination (norm := module) -(2 : K) • hρ - h0 - (2 : K) • hsum + hL + hRL

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_lie_f
statement:
theorem casimir_lie_f (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (i : ι) (v : V) :
    hB.casimir V hV ⁅f P i, v⁆ = ⁅f P i, hB.casimir V hV v⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hz : f P i ∈ rootSpace P (-P.root i) := fun a ↦ by
    rw [lie_h_f, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul]
  have hfin := hB.finite_casimirSum_left hV (f P i) v
  have hL0 : ∀ μ, rootSpace P μ = ⊥ → hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅f P i, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) μ = 0 :=
    fun μ hμ ↦ hB.casimirSum_eq_zero_of_eq_bot (fun y ↦ by simp) hμ
  have hsum : ⁅f P i, ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ -
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅f P i, v⁆ =
      -hB.casimirSum (fun y x ↦ ⁅⁅f P i, y⁆, ⁅x, v⁆⁆) 0 := by
    rw [hB.lie_finsum_casimirTerm_sub hV,
      finsum_mem_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ by rw [hB.lie_casimirTerm_sub' V hz μ v, ← sub_eq_add_neg],
      finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite hfin
        (finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root P _ i hL0 hfin),
      finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root P _ i hL0 hfin]
    abel
  have h0 := hB.lie_casimirTerm_sub' V hz 0 v
  have hR := hB.casimirSum_lie_left_lie V hz (0 + -P.root i) v
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right] at hR
  have hRL := hB.casimirSum_zero_right_sub_left V hz v
  have hρ := lie_lie_h_sub V hz ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) v
  simp only [map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_neg, root_toDual_symm_root S hA] at hRL hρ
  simp only [casimir_apply, lie_add, lie_smul]
  linear_combination (norm := module) -(2 : K) • hρ - h0 - (2 : K) • hsum + hR - hRL

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.h_mem_rootSpace_zero
statement: lemma h_mem_rootSpace_zero (a : H) : h P a ∈ rootSpace P 0
proof:
:= fun b ↦ by
  rw [lie_h_h, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_lie_h
statement:
theorem casimir_lie_h (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (a : H) (v : V) :
    hB.casimir V hV ⁅h P a, v⁆ = ⁅h P a, hB.casimir V hV v⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hz := h_mem_rootSpace_zero (P := P) a
  have hsum : ⁅h P a, ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ v⁆ -
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ ⁅h P a, v⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [hB.lie_finsum_casimirTerm_sub hV]
    exact finsum_mem_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun μ _ ↦ by
      rw [hB.lie_casimirTerm_sub V hz μ v, sub_zero, sub_self]
  have h0 := hB.lie_casimirTerm_sub V hz 0 v
  rw [sub_zero, sub_self] at h0
  have hρ := lie_lie_h_sub V hz ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) v
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul, neg_zero] at hρ
  simp only [casimir_apply, lie_add, lie_smul]
  linear_combination (norm := module) -(2 : K) • hρ - h0 - (2 : K) • hsum

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_lie
statement:
theorem casimir_lie (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (v : V) : hB.casimir V hV ⁅x, v⁆ = ⁅x, hB.casimir V hV v⁆
proof:
:= by
  revert v
  refine induction_on P x (fun i ↦ hB.casimir_lie_e hA hV i) (fun i ↦ hB.casimir_lie_f hA hV i)
    (fun a ↦ hB.casimir_lie_h hV a) (by simp) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro y z hy hz v
    rw [add_lie, map_add, hy, hz, add_lie]
  · intro c y hy v
    rw [smul_lie, map_smul, hy, smul_lie]
  · intro y z hy hz v
    simp only [lie_lie, map_sub, hy, hz]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, hB.casimirTerm V μ v = 0 := by
    refine finsum_mem_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun μ hμ ↦ ?_
    rw [casimirTerm_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
    have hk : (rootSpaceBasis P μ k : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ (nPos P).toSubmodule := by
      rw [nPos_toSubmodule_eq]
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hμ (rootSpaceBasis_mem P μ k))
    simp only
    rw [lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos he hk, lie_zero]
  have h0 : hB.casimirTerm V 0 v = ⁅h P ((P.toDual S).symm Λ), v⁆ := by
    have hH : h P ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) ∈ rootSpace P (-0) := by
      rw [neg_zero, rootSpace_zero]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    conv_rhs => rw [← hB.sum_smul_dualBasis 0 hH]
    rw [casimirTerm_apply, casimirSum_def, sum_lie]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hB.lie_of_mem_rootSpace_zero (rootSpaceBasis_mem P 0 k) hv, lie_smul, smul_lie, hB.symm]
  have hsymm : P.rho ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) = Λ ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) := by
    rw [← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, ← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq]
  rw [casimir_apply, hpos, h0, hv, hv, dualBilinForm_apply_eq, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, hsymm]
  module

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective
statement:
theorem casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hV : IsPosFinite P V)
    {Λ : Dual K H} (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (v : V) : hB.casimir V hV v = P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ • v
proof:
:= by
  let N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V :=
    { carrier := {v | hB.casimir V hV v = P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ • v}
      add_mem' := fun {v w} (hv : _ = _) (hw : _ = _) ↦ show _ = _ by
        rw [map_add, hv, hw, smul_add]
      zero_mem' := show _ = _ by rw [map_zero, smul_zero]
      smul_mem' := fun c v (hv : _ = _) ↦ show _ = _ by rw [map_smul, hv, smul_comm]
      lie_mem := fun {x v} (hv : _ = _) ↦ show _ = _ by rw [hB.casimir_lie hA, hv, lie_smul] }
  have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra {φ (VermaModule.hwv P Λ)} ≤ N := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero hV
      (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ))
      fun i ↦ by rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero]
  rw [VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top φ hφ] at hle
  exact hle (LieSubmodule.mem_top v)

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_or_exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf
statement:
theorem eq_one_or_exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, μ (P.coroot i) = n + 1) (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    w = 1 ∨ ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ k ≠ 0 ∧
      μ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine P.weylGroup_induction_length hA (p := fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦ w = 1 ∨
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ k ≠ 0 ∧ μ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k)
    (Or.inl rfl) (fun w i hwi ih ↦ Or.inr ?_) w
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hwi
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hwl
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hwl
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hμ i
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ : ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧
      μ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k := by
    rcases ih with rfl | ⟨k, hk, -, hwk⟩
    · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩
  refine ⟨k + ((m : ℤ) + 1) • l, add_nonneg hk (smul_nonneg (by positivity) hl), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hl0
    have h1 := congrFun h0 j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at h1
    have h2 : 0 < l j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hl j) (Ne.symm hj)
    have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k j := hk j
    nlinarith
  · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply, map_sub,
      map_smul, hm, hwl, map_add, map_zsmul, ← hwk, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
    push_cast
    module

name: Matrix.Realization.IsDominant.eq_zero_of_apply_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (-(μ + P.rho)) v i = n → n ≤ 0 := by
    intro v i hv n hn
    rw [corootPairing_neg, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg] at hn
    have := hμ v i hv (-n) (by rw [hn]; push_cast; ring)
    omega
  have hwb : (⟨w, hw⟩ : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) ∈
      P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan (-(μ + P.rho)) := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup]
    change w (-(μ + P.rho)) - -(μ + P.rho) ∈ P.rootLattice
    rw [map_neg, hwk, show -(μ + P.rho + P.rootOf k) - -(μ + P.rho) = P.rootOf (-k) by
      rw [map_neg]; abel]
    exact P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice _
  obtain ⟨k', hk', hwk'⟩ := exists_nonneg_apply_sub_eq_rootOf (P := P) hF hb hwb
  change w (-(μ + P.rho)) - -(μ + P.rho) = P.rootOf k' at hwk'
  rw [map_neg, hwk, show -(μ + P.rho + P.rootOf k) - -(μ + P.rho) = P.rootOf (-k) by
    rw [map_neg]; abel] at hwk'
  have h := P.rootOf_injective hwk'
  ext j
  have h1 := congrFun h j
  have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k j := hk j
  have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k' j := hk' j
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply] at h1
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_forall_add_nsmul_rho
statement:
theorem exists_forall_add_nsmul_rho (μ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan, ∀ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k →
      w (μ + (n : K) • P.rho + P.rho) = μ + (n : K) • P.rho + P.rho + P.rootOf k → k = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA := hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  let _ : Fintype (P.weylGroup hA) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let c : P.weylGroup hA → ℕ := fun w ↦
    if h : ∃ k : ι → ℤ, P.rootOf k = (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)
    then ∑ j, (h.choose j).natAbs else 0
  refine ⟨∑ w, c w + 1, fun w hw k hk hwk ↦ ?_⟩
  set n := ∑ w, c w + 1 with hn
  rcases P.eq_one_or_exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA (μ := P.rho) (fun i ↦ ⟨0, by simp⟩)
    ⟨w, hw⟩ with h1 | ⟨m, hm, hm0, hwm⟩
  · have hw1 : w = 1 := congrArg Subtype.val h1
    subst hw1
    have : P.rootOf k = P.rootOf 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]; simpa using hwk.symm
    exact P.rootOf_injective this
  · change P.rho - w P.rho = P.rootOf m at hwm
    have hex : P.rootOf (k + (n : ℤ) • m) = w (μ + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) := by
      have e1 : w (μ + (n : K) • P.rho + P.rho) =
          w (μ + P.rho) + (n : K) • (P.rho - P.rootOf m) := by
        rw [← hwm, sub_sub_cancel, show μ + (n : K) • P.rho + P.rho = (μ + P.rho) + (n : K) • P.rho
          by abel, map_add, map_smul]
      rw [e1, smul_sub] at hwk
      rw [map_add, map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, Int.cast_natCast,
        eq_sub_of_add_eq hwk]
      abel
    have hc : c ⟨w, hw⟩ = ∑ j, (k j + (n : ℤ) * m j).natAbs := by
      have h : ∃ k' : ι → ℤ, P.rootOf k' = w (μ + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho) := ⟨_, hex⟩
      simp only [c, h, ↓reduceDIte]
      have := P.rootOf_injective (h.choose_spec.trans hex.symm)
      rw [this]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hm0
    have hmj : 1 ≤ m j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hm j) (Ne.symm hj)
    have hle : n ≤ c ⟨w, hw⟩ := by
      rw [hc]
      refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j))
      have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k j := hk j
      have : (n : ℤ) ≤ k j + (n : ℤ) * m j := by nlinarith
      omega
    have hlt : c ⟨w, hw⟩ < n := by
      rw [hn]
      exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ _))
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveO.of_retract
statement:
theorem of_retract (hV : IsProjectiveO.{w} P V) (s : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) (r : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W)
    (hrs : r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id) : IsProjectiveO.{w} P W
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hM hN π hπ φ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hV hM hN π hπ (φ.comp r)
  refine ⟨ψ.comp s, ?_⟩
  ext x
  have h1 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ (s x)
  have h2 := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hrs x
  simp only [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleHom.id_apply] at h1 h2 ⊢
  rw [h1, h2]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveO.of_equiv
statement: theorem of_equiv (hV : IsProjectiveO.{w} P V) (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) : IsProjectiveO.{w} P W
proof:
:=
  hV.of_retract e.symm.toLieModuleHom e.toLieModuleHom (by ext; simp)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_weightSpace_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_weightSpace_of_surjective (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ).map (f : V →ₗ[K] W) = weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ ν, (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν).map (f : V →ₗ[K] W) ≤
      weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) ν := fun ν ↦ by
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hv
  refine le_antisymm (hle μ) fun x hx ↦ mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) _ hle hx ?_
  rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hV, Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hf]
  trivial

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralCharacter_eq_of_mem_centralBlock
proof:
:= by
  set φ := (homEquiv P V ν).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hφ : φ (hwv P ν) = v := congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P V ν).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  ext z
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (mem_centralBlock P χ v).mp hχ z
  have hz : rep P V (z : 𝓤) v = centralCharacter P ν z • v := by
    rw [← hφ]; exact rep_center_map P ν φ z _
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, ((rep P V (z : 𝓤) - χ z • 1) ^ m) v =
      (centralCharacter P ν z - χ z) ^ m • v := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, hz,
        LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, ← sub_smul, smul_smul, pow_succ', mul_comm]
  rw [key, smul_eq_zero] at hn
  rcases hn with hn | hn
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero hn)
  · exact absurd hn hv0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isProjectiveO_of_forall
statement:
theorem VermaModule.isProjectiveO_of_forall {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : ∀ w ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, ∀ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k →
      w (Λ + P.rho) = Λ + P.rho + P.rootOf k → k = 0) :
    IsProjectiveO.{w} P (VermaModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hM hN π hπ φ
  set χ := centralCharacter P Λ
  have hB : IsCategoryO P (centralBlock P M χ) := hM.centralBlock P χ
  have hx : φ (hwv P Λ) ∈ centralBlock P N χ :=
    map_mem_centralBlock P φ χ (by rw [centralBlock_verma]; trivial)
  have hxw : φ (hwv P Λ) ∈ weightSpaceOfMap N (h P) Λ :=
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ)
  have hmem : (⟨_, hx⟩ : centralBlock P N χ) ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (centralBlock P N χ) (h P) Λ :=
    mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mpr hxw
  rw [← map_weightSpace_of_surjective P hB.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top _
    (hM.surjective_centralBlockMap P π hπ χ)] at hmem
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hmem
  have hyM : (y : M) ∈ weightSpaceOfMap M (h P) Λ := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hy
  have hprim : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, (y : M)⁆ = 0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra hne
    have hne' : toEnd K 𝔤 (centralBlock P M χ) (e P i) y ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
      hne (by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val h0)
    have hw : weightSpaceOfMap (centralBlock P M χ) (h P) (Λ + P.root i) ≠ ⊥ := fun hbot ↦
      hne' (by simpa [hbot] using toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace i hy)
    obtain ⟨l, hl, z, hz, hz0, hze⟩ := hB.exists_lie_e_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hw
    have hzp : (z : M) ∈ primitiveVectors P M (Λ + P.root i + P.rootOf l) :=
      mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hz,
        fun j ↦ by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val (hze j)⟩
    have hχ := centralCharacter_eq_of_mem_centralBlock P hzp
      (fun h0 ↦ hz0 (Subtype.ext h0)) z.2
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA Λ _).mp hχ.symm
    have hk := hΛ w hw (Pi.single i 1 + l)
      (add_nonneg (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one) hl)
      (by rw [hwe, map_add, rootOf_single]; abel)
    have := congrFun hk i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    have h0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ l i := hl i
    omega
  refine ⟨(homEquiv P M Λ).symm ⟨y, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hyM, hprim⟩⟩, hom_ext P Λ ?_⟩
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply]
  have h1 : ((homEquiv P M Λ).symm ⟨y, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hyM, hprim⟩⟩) (hwv P Λ) = y :=
