    congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P M Λ).apply_symm_apply _)
  rw [h1]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hyx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isProjectiveO
statement:
theorem VermaModule.isProjectiveO {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan Λ) :
    IsProjectiveO.{w} P (VermaModule P Λ)
proof:
:=
  isProjectiveO_of_forall P hA fun _ hw _ hk hwk ↦ hΛ.eq_zero_of_apply_eq P hA hw hk hwk

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction
statement:
theorem tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction (f : M ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) (m : M) (l : L) :
    tensorDualEquivHom P N L (tensorHomAdjunction P f m) l = f (m ⊗ₜ l)
proof:
:= by
  change tensorDualEquivHom P N L ((tensorDualEquivHom P N L).symm _) l = _
  rw [LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorHomAdjunction_comp
statement:
theorem tensorHomAdjunction_comp (q : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') (f : M ⊗[K] L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    tensorHomAdjunction P (q.comp f) =
      (TensorProduct.LieModule.map q LieModuleHom.id).comp (tensorHomAdjunction P f)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  apply (tensorDualEquivHom P N' L).injective
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, tensorDualEquivHom_map]
  ext l
  rw [tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveO.tensorProduct
statement:
theorem IsProjectiveO.tensorProduct (hV : IsProjectiveO.{max w u l} P V)
    (hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K L)) : IsProjectiveO.{w} P (V ⊗[K] L)
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hM hN π hπ φ
  set π' := TensorProduct.LieModule.map π (LieModuleHom.id : Module.Dual K L →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ _)
  have hπ' : Function.Surjective π' :=
    TensorProduct.map_surjective hπ Function.surjective_id
  obtain ⟨ψ', hψ'⟩ := hV (hM.tensorProduct hL') (hN.tensorProduct hL') π' hπ'
    (tensorHomAdjunction P φ)
  refine ⟨(tensorHomAdjunction P).symm ψ', (tensorHomAdjunction P).injective ?_⟩
  rw [tensorHomAdjunction_comp, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hψ']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorDualEquivHom_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorDualEquivHom_tmul (n : N) (f : Module.Dual K L) (l : L) :
    tensorDualEquivHom P N L (n ⊗ₜ f) l = f l • n
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorDualEquivHom]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho
statement: lemma isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho (n : ℕ) : P.IsDominantIntegral ((n : K) • P.rho)
proof:
:=
  fun i ↦ ⟨n, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCategoryO_dual_irreducible_nsmul_rho
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_dual_irreducible_nsmul_rho (n : ℕ) :
    IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ((n : K) • P.rho)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzν, ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA
    (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P n)
  exact IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient (Λ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) :
    IsCategoryO P (projectiveCoverAmbient P Λ n)
proof:
:=
  (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _).tensorProduct (isCategoryO_dual_irreducible_nsmul_rho P hA n)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_surjective_projectiveCoverAmbient
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_projectiveCoverAmbient (Λ : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ π : projectiveCoverAmbient P Λ n →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P Λ, Function.Surjective π
proof:
:= by
  set ν : Dual K H := (n : K) • P.rho
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P n)
  set L := IrreducibleModule P ν
  set ξ : Module.Dual K (Module.Dual K L) :=
    LieModule.evalEquiv (L := 𝔤) (IrreducibleModule.hwv P ν)
  have hξw : ξ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (Module.Dual K (Module.Dual K L)) (h P) ν :=
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieModule.evalEquiv (L := 𝔤) (M := L)).toLieModuleHom
      (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P ν)
  have hξe : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, ξ⁆ = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ⁅e P i, IrreducibleModule.hwv P ν⁆ = 0 := by
      rw [IrreducibleModule.hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero]
    have h2 := (LieModule.evalEquiv (K := K) (L := 𝔤) (M := L)).toLieModuleHom.map_lie (e P i)
      (IrreducibleModule.hwv P ν)
    rw [h1, map_zero] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  set x := VermaModule.hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] ξ
  have hx : x ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Module.Dual K (Module.Dual K L))
      (Λ + ν) := by
    refine mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨tmul_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P
      (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ) hξw, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, hξe, zero_tmul,
      tmul_zero, add_zero]
  set ψ := (homEquiv P _ (Λ + ν)).symm ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hψ : ψ (VermaModule.hwv P (Λ + ν)) = x :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P _ (Λ + ν)).apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)
  set φ := (tensorHomAdjunction P (M := VermaModule P (Λ + ν)) (L := Module.Dual K L)).symm ψ
  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one K (IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P ν)
  have hφ : φ (VermaModule.hwv P (Λ + ν) ⊗ₜ f) = VermaModule.hwv P Λ := by
    rw [← tensorDualEquivHom_tensorHomAdjunction, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hψ,
      tensorDualEquivHom_tmul]
    simp [ξ, hf]
  rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
  exact VermaModule.eq_top_of_hwv_mem P Λ ⟨_, hφ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isProjectiveO_surjective_verma
statement:
theorem exists_isProjectiveO_surjective_verma (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, IsCategoryO P (projectiveCoverAmbient P Λ n) ∧
      IsProjectiveO.{w} P (projectiveCoverAmbient P Λ n) ∧
      ∃ π : projectiveCoverAmbient P Λ n →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P Λ, Function.Surjective π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_forall_add_nsmul_rho P hA Λ
  refine ⟨n, isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ n, ?_,
    exists_surjective_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ n⟩
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P n)
  exact IsProjectiveO.tensorProduct P (VermaModule.isProjectiveO_of_forall P hA hn)
    (IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) LieModule.evalEquiv)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.isWeylInvariant_character
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.isWeylInvariant_character (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hI : IsIntegrable P V) :
    hV.character.IsWeylInvariant P hA
proof:
:= fun w hw μ ↦ by
  simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, finrank]
  rw [rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA hI hw μ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isWeylInvariant_character
proof:
:=
  IsCategoryO.isWeylInvariant_character hA _ ((IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable_iff P hA).mpr hΛ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos
statement:
lemma lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos {v : V} (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0) {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ nPos P) : ⁅x, v⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_nPos P).mp hx
  clear hx
  induction y using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i => rw [eHom_of]; exact he i
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, add_lie, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul a y hy => rw [map_smul, smul_lie, hy, smul_zero]
  | lie y z hy hz => rw [LieHom.map_lie, lie_lie, hy, hz, lie_zero, lie_zero, sub_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_toEnd_pow_of_lie_eq_zero
statement:
lemma lie_toEnd_pow_of_lie_eq_zero {x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hxy : ⁅x, y⁆ = 0) (m : ℕ) (v : V) :
    ⁅x, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V y ^ m) v⁆ = (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V y ^ m) ⁅x, v⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply,
      toEnd_apply_apply, leibniz_lie, hxy, zero_lie, zero_add, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr (by
    rintro _ rfl
    exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range φ _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩))
  have : (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra {φ (VermaModule.hwv P Λ)}).comap φ = ⊤ :=
    VermaModule.eq_top_of_hwv_mem P Λ (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan rfl)
  rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  have hm : m ∈ (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra {φ (VermaModule.hwv P Λ)}).comap φ :=
    this ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top m
  exact hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  rw [← VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan, LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
  exact hφ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isIntegrable_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isIntegrable_of_surjective {Λ : Dual K H} (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∃ m, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (f P i) ^ m) (φ (VermaModule.hwv P Λ)) = 0) :
    IsIntegrable P V where
  isHDiagonalizable
proof:
:= (IsCategoryO.of_surjective φ hφ).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  exists_pow_e_eq_zero i := exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan (exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero P hA i)
    (VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top φ hφ) (by
      rintro _ rfl
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_one, toEnd_apply_apply, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero])
  exists_pow_f_eq_zero i := exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan (exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero P hA i)
    (VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top φ hφ) (by rintro _ rfl; exact hf i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isDominantIntegral_of_isIntegrable

:= fun i ↦ by

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_maxSubmodule_of_lie_e_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  let φ := lift P w (fun _ hx ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos he hx) hw
  have hle : φ.range ≤ maxSubmodule P Λ := by
    rw [le_maxSubmodule_iff]
    intro htop
    rw [LieModuleHom.range_eq_top] at htop
    exact hμ (exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P μ φ htop (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ)
      (hwv_ne_zero P Λ))
  exact hle ((LieModuleHom.mem_range φ w).mpr ⟨hwv P μ, lift_hwv P w _ _⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fPowHwv_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fPowHwv_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_fPowHwv
statement:
theorem lie_e_fPowHwv {i : ι} {n : ℕ} (hn : Λ (P.coroot i) = n) (j : ι) :
    ⁅e P j, fPowHwv P Λ i n⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · subst hij
    rw [(isSl2Triple P hA j).lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f_of_lie_h n (lie_h_hwv P Λ _), lie_e_hwv,
      map_zero, zero_add, hn, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  · rw [lie_toEnd_pow_of_lie_eq_zero (lie_e_f_of_ne P hij), lie_e_hwv, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fPowHwv_mem_maxSubmodule
statement:
theorem fPowHwv_mem_maxSubmodule {i : ι} {n : ℕ} (hn : Λ (P.coroot i) = n) :
    fPowHwv P Λ i n ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_maxSubmodule_of_lie_e_eq_zero P Λ (fPowHwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ i n)
    (lie_e_fPowHwv P Λ hA hn) ?_
  rintro ⟨k, hk, hΛ⟩
  have h0 : P.rootOf ((n + 1 : ℕ) • Pi.single i 1 + k) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, map_nsmul, rootOf_single]
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hΛ
    rw [← sub_eq_zero] at hΛ
    rw [← hΛ]
    abel
  have h1 := congrFun (P.rootOf_injective (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)) i
  have h2 := hk i
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    Pi.zero_apply] at h1
  rw [Pi.zero_apply] at h2
  push_cast at h1
  linarith

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule
statement:
theorem fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule {n : ι → ℕ} (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i) :

:=

theorem isIntegrable_iff {Λ : Dual K H} :

proof:
:= by

    (fun i ↦ ?_) (hwv_ne_zero P Λ), fun hΛ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero]

      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) fun i ↦ ?_

    rw [toEnd_pow_apply_map, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]

name: IsSl2Triple.wall_cast_mul_ne
statement:
lemma wall_cast_mul_ne {n m j k : ℕ} (hj : j < k) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (-(m : K) + 2 * j) * (-(m : K) + 2 * j + 2) - n * (n + 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : ((-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j) * (-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j + 2) - n * (n + 2) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : (-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j + 1) - (n + 1) < 0 := by omega
    have h2 : 0 < (-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j + 1) + (n + 1) := by omega
    nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast this

name: IsSl2Triple.wall_eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Ω := casimir K M h e f
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := t.isNilpotent_toEnd_e (K := K) (M := M)
  obtain ⟨N, hN'⟩ := t.isNilpotent_toEnd_f (K := K) (M := M)
  have hN : toEnd K L M f ^ (N + 1) = 0 := by rw [pow_succ, hN', zero_mul]
  
  set c : ℕ → K := fun j ↦ -(m : K) + 2 * j
  set P₁ := ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (X - C (c j * (c j + 2)))
  have h₁ : aeval Ω P₁ x = 0 := by
    rw [← t.four_pow_smul_pow_f_pow_e hx k, hk, map_zero, smul_zero]
  
  set g : ℕ → K[X] := fun n ↦ (X - C ((n : K) * (n + 2))) ^ d
  set s := Finset.range (N + 1)
  have h₂ : aeval Ω (∏ n ∈ s, g n) x = 0 := by
    have := t.aeval_casimir_pow_apply_eq_zero hN d (v := x) (by rw [hd, LinearMap.zero_apply])
    rwa [← map_pow, ← Finset.prod_pow] at this
  
  set A := ∏ n ∈ s.filter (· < m), g n
  set B := ∏ n ∈ s.filter (fun n ↦ ¬ n < m), g n
  have hAB : ∏ n ∈ s, g n = A * B := (Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not s (· < m) g).symm
  have hcop : IsCoprime P₁ B := by
    refine IsCoprime.prod_right fun n hn ↦ IsCoprime.pow_right (IsCoprime.prod_left fun j hj ↦ ?_)
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, not_lt] at hn
    refine isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (Ne.isUnit ?_)
    exact wall_cast_mul_ne (Finset.mem_range.mp hj) hkm hn.2
  have hAx : aeval Ω A x = 0 := by
    have hker := Polynomial.disjoint_ker_aeval_of_isCoprime Ω hcop
    refine Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hker _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, mul_comm, map_mul,
        Module.End.mul_apply, h₁, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, mul_comm, ← hAB, h₂]
  
  set S := ⨆ (c : K) (_ : c ≠ -(m : K)), (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace c
  have hS : ∀ n < m, LinearMap.ker (aeval Ω (g n)) ≤ S := by
    intro n hn v hv
    have hvp := t.mem_primitiveSpan hN n d d (v := v) (by rw [hd, LinearMap.zero_apply]) hv
    refine (iSup_le fun j ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr ?_ :
      primitiveSpan K M h e f (n : K) ≤ S) hvp
    rintro w ⟨hwe, hwh⟩
    replace hwe : ⁅e, w⁆ = 0 := hwe
    replace hwh : ⁅h, w⁆ = (n : K) • w := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hwh
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
    by_cases hj : j ≤ n
    · refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ((n : K) - 2 * j) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ?_ ?_)
      · intro heq
        have : ((m + n : ℕ) : K) = ((2 * j : ℕ) : K) := by push_cast; linear_combination heq
        have := Nat.cast_injective this
        omega
      · rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, toEnd_apply_apply]
        exact t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq hwh j
    · rw [show j = (j - (n + 1)) + (n + 1) by omega, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply,
        t.pow_f_succ_eq_zero hwe hwh ⟨N + 1, by rw [hN, LinearMap.zero_apply]⟩, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
  have hxS : x ∈ S := by
    have hcopg : ∀ i ∈ s.filter (· < m), ∀ j ∈ s.filter (· < m), i ≠ j →
        IsCoprime (g i) (g j) := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      refine IsCoprime.pow (isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (Ne.isUnit fun hc ↦ hij ?_))
      have : ((i * (i + 2) : ℕ) : K) = ((j * (j + 2) : ℕ) : K) := by
        push_cast; linear_combination hc
      have h' := Nat.cast_injective this
      rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
      · exact absurd h' (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' h (by omega)).ne
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h' (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' h (by omega)).ne'
    have := Module.End.ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup Ω (s.filter (· < m)) g hcopg
      (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hAx)
    have hle : (⨆ n ∈ s.filter (· < m), LinearMap.ker (aeval Ω (g n))) ≤ S :=
      iSup₂_le fun n hn ↦ hS n (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    exact hle this
  have hxm : x ∈ (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace (-(m : K)) := by
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, toEnd_apply_apply, hx]
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.mp
    ((Module.End.eigenspaces_iSupIndep (toEnd K L M h)).disjoint_biSup
      (x := -(m : K)) (y := {c | c ≠ -(m : K)}) fun hc ↦ hc rfl) x hxm hxS

name: IsSl2Triple.wall_eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem wall_eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero
    (he : ∀ v : M, ∃ n, (toEnd K L M e ^ n) v = 0) (hf : ∀ v : M, ∃ n, (toEnd K L M f ^ n) v = 0)
    {x : M} {m k : ℕ} (hx : ⁅h, x⁆ = -(m : K) • x) (hkm : k ≤ m)
    (hk : (toEnd K L M e ^ k) x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := he x
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos B with rfl | hB0
  · simpa using hB
  choose A hA using fun b : ℕ ↦ hf ((toEnd K L M e ^ b) x)
  set A' := ∑ b ∈ Finset.range B, A b
  set E := toEnd K L M e
  set F := toEnd K L M f
  have hFA : ∀ b < B, ∀ a, A' ≤ a → (F ^ a) ((E ^ b) x) = 0 := by
    intro b hb a ha
    have : A b ≤ a := (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr hb)).trans ha
    rw [show a = (a - A b) + A b by omega, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hA b, map_zero]
  have hEB : ∀ b, B ≤ b → (E ^ b) x = 0 := fun b hb ↦ by
    rw [show b = (b - B) + B by omega, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hB, map_zero]
  set S : Finset M := ((Finset.range A') ×ˢ (Finset.range B)).image fun p ↦ (F ^ p.1) ((E ^ p.2) x)
  set W := Submodule.span K (S : Set M)
  have hmem : ∀ a b, (F ^ a) ((E ^ b) x) ∈ W := by
    intro a b
    by_cases hb : b < B
    · by_cases ha : a < A'
      · exact Submodule.subset_span (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr
          ⟨(a, b), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr ha, Finset.mem_range.mpr hb⟩,
            rfl⟩))
      · rw [hFA b hb a (by omega)]; exact zero_mem _
    · rw [hEB b (by omega), map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  have hwt : ∀ b : ℕ, ⁅h, (E ^ b) x⁆ = (-(m : K) + 2 * b) • (E ^ b) x := fun b ↦ by
    rw [← toEnd_apply_apply (R := K), ← Module.End.mul_apply, t.toEnd_h_mul_e_pow,
      LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, hx, map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, ← add_smul, add_comm]
  have hstab : ∀ T : Module.End K M, (∀ a b, T ((F ^ a) ((E ^ b) x)) ∈ W) → ∀ v ∈ W, T v ∈ W := by
    intro T hT v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem v hv =>
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hv)
      exact hT a b
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add v w _ _ hv hw => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hv hw
    | smul c v _ hv => rw [map_smul]; exact W.smul_mem c hv
  have hfW : ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅f, v⁆ ∈ W := hstab F fun a b ↦ by
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']; exact hmem _ _
  have hhW : ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅h, v⁆ ∈ W := hstab (toEnd K L M h) fun a b ↦ by
    rw [toEnd_apply_apply, t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq (hwt b)]; exact W.smul_mem _ (hmem _ _)
  have heW : ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅e, v⁆ ∈ W := hstab E fun a b ↦ by
    rcases a with _ | a
    · rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']
      simpa using hmem 0 (b + 1)
    · rw [toEnd_apply_apply, t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f, hwt b, ← sub_smul, map_smul]
      refine add_mem ?_ (W.smul_mem _ (W.smul_mem _ (hmem _ _)))
      have : ⁅e, (E ^ b) x⁆ = (E ^ (b + 1)) x := by rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl
      rw [this]
      exact hmem _ _
  
  set L' := LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K L {h, e, f}
  have hL' : ∀ z ∈ L', ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅z, v⁆ ∈ W := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hhW
      · exact heW
      · exact hfW
    | zero => intro v _; rw [zero_lie]; exact zero_mem _
    | add z z' _ _ hz hz' => intro v hv; rw [add_lie]; exact add_mem (hz v hv) (hz' v hv)
    | smul c z _ hz => intro v hv; rw [smul_lie]; exact W.smul_mem c (hz v hv)
    | lie z z' _ _ hz hz' =>
      intro v hv
      rw [lie_lie]
      exact sub_mem (hz _ (hz' v hv)) (hz' _ (hz v hv))
  let Y : LieSubmodule K L' M :=
    { W with lie_mem := fun {z v} hv ↦ hL' z z.2 v hv }
  have : FiniteDimensional K Y := FiniteDimensional.span_finset K S
  let h' : L' := ⟨h, LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (by simp)⟩
  let e' : L' := ⟨e, LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (by simp)⟩
  let f' : L' := ⟨f, LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (by simp)⟩
  have t' : IsSl2Triple h' e' f' :=
    { h_ne_zero := fun h0 ↦ t.h_ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h0)
      lie_e_f := Subtype.ext t.lie_e_f
      lie_h_e_nsmul := Subtype.ext t.lie_h_e_nsmul
      lie_h_f_nsmul := Subtype.ext t.lie_h_f_nsmul }
  have hxY : x ∈ Y := by
    change x ∈ W
    simpa using hmem 0 0
  have hpow : ∀ n (y : Y), ((toEnd K L' Y e' ^ n) y : M) = (E ^ n) (y : M) := by
    intro n y
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ← ih]
      rfl
  have := t'.wall_eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional (M := Y) (x := ⟨x, hxY⟩)
    (Subtype.ext hx) hkm (Subtype.ext (by rw [hpow]; exact hk))
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.wall_mem_range_toEnd_f
proof:
:= by
  set D := nilradDecomp P i Λ
  set g := D.symm y
  have hyg : D g = y := D.apply_symm_apply y
  have hH : opH i Λ g = (-((k : K) + 1)) • g := D.injective (by
    rw [← lie_h_nilradDecomp i Λ hA, hyg, hy, map_smul, hyg])
  have hE : opE i Λ g = 0 := D.injective (by rw [← lie_e_nilradDecomp i Λ hA, hyg, he, map_zero])
  have hHn : ∀ n : ℕ, adH P i (g n) = (-((k : K) + 1) - ((d : K) - 1) + 2 * n) • g n := fun n ↦ by
    have := congrArg (· n) hH
    simp only [opH_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, hd] at this
    rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq this]
    module
  have hEn : ∀ n : ℕ, adE P i (g n) = (-(((n : K) + 1) * ((n : K) + 1 - k))) • g (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    have := congrArg (· n) hE
    simp only [opE_apply, Finsupp.zero_apply, hd, hHn (n + 1)] at this
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← this]
    push_cast
    module
  
  have hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, (adE P i ^ j) (g 0) =
      (∏ n ∈ Finset.range j, (-(((n : K) + 1) * ((n : K) + 1 - k)))) • g j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_smul, hEn, smul_smul, Finset.prod_range_succ]
  have hk0 : (adE P i ^ k) (g 0) = 0 := by
    rw [hpow, Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := k - 1) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) (by
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hk]; ring), zero_smul]
  
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
    let _ := adLieRingModule P
    have _ := adLieModule P
    have hx := (isSl2Triple P hA i).wall_eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero (M := 𝓤)
      (exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_ad P (exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero P hA i))
      (exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_ad P (exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero P hA i))
      (x := envNilrad P i (g 0)) (m := k + d) (k := k)
      (by
        have := toEnd_envNilrad P i (h P (P.coroot i))
          (fun _ hy ↦ lie_h_mem_nilradNeg i _ hy) (g 0) 1
        rw [pow_one, pow_one, toEnd_apply_apply] at this
        rw [this, hHn 0]
        simp only [map_smul]
        push_cast
        ring_nf)
      (by omega)
      (by rw [toEnd_envNilrad P i (e P i) (fun _ hy ↦ lie_e_mem_nilradNeg i hy), hk0, map_zero])
    exact envNilrad_injective P i (by rw [hx, map_zero])
  
  refine ⟨D (Finsupp.comapDomain (· + 1) g (Set.injOn_of_injective (add_left_injective 1))), ?_⟩
  rw [lie_f_nilradDecomp, ← hyg]
  congr 1
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [hg0, shiftF, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range]
    simp
  · rw [shiftF, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply]
    exact (Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (f := (· + 1)) (add_left_injective 1) _ n).trans
      (Finsupp.comapDomain_apply _ _ _ n)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.wall_exists_eq_toEnd_f_pow
proof:
:= by
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  set F := toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i)
  suffices ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∃ x, (F ^ j) x = y from this k hk le_rfl
  intro j hj1 hjk
  induction j with
  | zero => omega
  | succ j ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj0
    · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := wall_mem_range_toEnd_f i Λ hA hd he hk hy
      exact ⟨z, by rw [pow_one]; exact hz⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ih hj0 (by omega)
    
    have hxh : ⁅h P (P.coroot i), x⁆ = (2 * (j : K) - k - 1) • x := by
      apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ j
      have := lie_h_toEnd_f_pow i Λ (P.coroot i) j x
      rw [hy, root_coroot_self P hA, eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at this
      rw [map_smul, ← this]
      module
    
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
    have hfe : ⁅f P i, ⁅e P i, x⁆⁆ = (((j' : K) + 1) * (k - j' - 1)) • x := by
      apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ j'
      have := t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f (K := K) j' x
      rw [he, hxh, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, ← sub_smul, map_smul,
        eq_comm, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at this
      rw [map_smul, this]
      push_cast
      module
    have hc : ((j' : K) + 1) * (k - j' - 1) ≠ 0 := by
      refine mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero j') ?_
      have : ((k : ℕ) : K) - j' - 1 = ((k - j' - 1 : ℕ) : K) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; push_cast; ring
      rw [this, Nat.cast_ne_zero]
      omega
    refine ⟨(((j' : K) + 1) * (k - j' - 1))⁻¹ • ⁅e P i, x⁆, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, map_smul, toEnd_apply_apply, hfe, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.wall_exists_mem_primitiveVectors_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  rw [mem_primitiveVectors] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := wall_exists_eq_toEnd_f_pow i Λ hA hd (hy.2 i) hk (by rw [hy.1, hν])
  have hxw : ∀ a, ⁅h P a, x⁆ = (ν + k • P.root i) a • x := fun a ↦ by
    apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ k
    have := lie_h_toEnd_f_pow i Λ a k x
    rw [hy.1 a] at this
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, add_smul]
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at this
    rw [← this, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨x, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hxw, fun l ↦ ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ k
  rw [map_zero]
  by_cases hl : l = i
  · subst hl
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have := t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f (K := K) k' x
    rw [hy.2 l, hxw, ← sub_smul, map_smul] at this
    have hz : ν (P.coroot l) + ((k' + 1) • P.root l) (P.coroot l) - k' = 0 := by
      rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hν, root_coroot_self P hA, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hz, zero_smul, smul_zero, add_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  · rw [← lie_toEnd_pow_of_lie_eq_zero (lie_e_f_of_ne P hl) k x, hy.2 l]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.wall_finrank_hom_reflection_source
statement:
theorem wall_finrank_hom_reflection_source {μ : Dual K H} {d n : ℕ}
    (hd : Λ (P.coroot i) = (d : K) - 1) (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (μ + P.rho) - P.rho) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P Λ) =
      finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have hμn : μ (P.coroot i) = (n : K) - 1 := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hn
    linear_combination hn
  rw [finrank_hom, finrank_hom, P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn]
  let T : primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) μ →ₗ[K]
      primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (μ - n • P.root i) :=
    ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n).restrict fun x hx ↦
      toEnd_f_pow_mem_primitiveVectors_of_mem i Λ (by rw [hμn]; ring) hx hA)
  have hT : Function.Bijective T := by
    refine ⟨fun x y hxy ↦ Subtype.ext (toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ n
      (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)), fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    have hν : (μ - n • P.root i) (P.coroot i) = -((n : K) + 1) := by
      rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, root_coroot_self P hA, hμn, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := wall_exists_mem_primitiveVectors_of_mem i Λ hA hd hn0 hν y.2
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at hx
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext hxy⟩
  exact (LinearEquiv.ofBijective T hT).finrank_eq.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.wall_finrank_hom_weylDot_self
statement:
theorem wall_finrank_hom_weylDot_self (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ + P.rho))
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  induction hl : cs.length w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ l ih =>
    subst hl
    by_cases hw1 : w = 1
    · subst hw1
      rw [weylDot_one, finrank_hom]
      have : primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) Λ = K ∙ hwv P Λ := by
        refine le_antisymm ?_ ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr
          (hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P Λ))
        rw [← weightSpace_self]
        exact inf_le_left
      rw [this, finrank_span_singleton (hwv_ne_zero P Λ)]
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw1
    have hsl := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hs
    set w' := cs.simple s * w
    have hww' : w = cs.simple s * w' := (cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left s).symm
    have hw' : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent w' s := by
      rwa [← cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul]
    have hind := ih _ (by omega) w' rfl
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_nat_of_not_isLeftDescent hA hΛ hw'
    have hn' : (P.weylDot hA w' Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot s) = n := by
      rwa [weylDot_add_rho]
    rw [hww', weylDot_simple_mul]
    by_cases hn0 : n = 0
    · rw [P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn', hn0, zero_nsmul, sub_zero]
      exact hind
    · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hΛ s
      have hd' : Λ (P.coroot s) = (d : K) - 1 := by
        rw [LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hd
        linear_combination hd
      rw [wall_finrank_hom_reflection_source s hA hd' (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) hn']
      exact hind

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.wall_finrank_hom_weylDot_le_one
statement:
theorem wall_finrank_hom_weylDot_le_one (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ + P.rho))
    (w w' : P.weylGroup hA) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_injective_weylDot_of_dotDominant P hA hΛ w
  exact (finrank_hom_le_of_injective P _ φ hφ).trans
    (wall_finrank_hom_weylDot_self hA hΛ w').le

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_le_one_of_dotDominant
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_le_one_of_dotDominant (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    (S : A.Symmetrization) (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral (Λ + P.rho)) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hzero : ∀ φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ, φ = 0
  · have : Subsingleton (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) :=
      ⟨fun φ ψ ↦ (hzero φ).trans (hzero ψ).symm⟩
    rw [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  push Not at hzero
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hzero
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := exists_weylDot_of_hom_ne_zero P hfin S hφ
  exact (wall_finrank_hom_weylDot_self hfin.isGeneralizedCartan hΛ w).le

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_le_one_of_finite_type_integral
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_le_one_of_finite_type_integral (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    (S : A.Symmetrization) (Λ μ : Dual K H)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = z) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', -, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_dotDominant_hom_bound_of_finite_type_integral P hfin Λ hΛ
  exact (hbound μ).trans (finrank_hom_le_one_of_dotDominant hfin S hΛ' μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsDominant.exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (-(lam + P.rho)) v i = n → n ≤ 0 := by
    intro v i hv n hn
    rw [corootPairing_neg, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg] at hn
    have := hlam v i hv (-n) (by rw [hn]; push_cast; ring)
    omega
  have hw' : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan (-(lam + P.rho)) := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' := lam + P.rho)
      fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩] at hw
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, map_neg, show -(w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) -
      -(lam + P.rho) = -((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (lam + P.rho) - (lam + P.rho)) by abel]
    exact neg_mem hw
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := exists_nonneg_apply_sub_eq_rootOf hA hb hw'
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  rw [← hwk, weylDot, map_neg]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_raise_of_not_isDominant
statement:
theorem exists_raise_of_not_isDominant {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : ¬P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ) :
    ∃ (v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) (l : ι → ℤ) (c : ℕ),
      0 ≤ l ∧ (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf l ∧ 0 < c ∧
      P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan
        (μ + c • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) + P.rho) v i = c ∧
      (P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) =
        μ + c • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) + P.rho
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsDominant, not_forall, not_le] at hμ
  obtain ⟨v, i, hv, m, hm, hm0⟩ := hμ
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hvl⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨v, i, l, (-m).toNat, hl, hvl, by omega, ⟨l, hl, hvl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcm : (((-m).toNat : ℕ) : K) = -(m : K) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), Int.cast_neg]
    have hββ : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan
        ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) v i = 2 := by
      rw [corootPairing, inv_apply_apply, P.root_coroot_self hA.isGeneralizedCartan]
    rw [add_right_comm, corootPairing_add, hm, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, corootPairing_smul,
      hββ, hcm]
    ring
  · rw [reflectionOf_apply', hm, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K]
    have hcm : (((-m).toNat : ℕ) : K) = -(m : K) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), Int.cast_neg]
    rw [hcm, neg_smul]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_weylDot_of_isDominant
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam → ∀ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k →
      lam - P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam = P.rootOf k → ∑ i, k i = n →
      ∃ φ : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam,
        Function.Injective φ by
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := IsDominant.exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf P hA hlam hw
    exact H (∑ i, k i).toNat w hw k hk hwk
      (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hk i)).symm
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro w hw k hk hwk hn
  by_cases hdom : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
  · 
    have hint : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ,
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam) (P.coroot j) = z := by
      have h := P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice (-k))
      rwa [map_neg, ← hwk, neg_sub] at h
    have hw' : w⁻¹ ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) := by
      rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA.isGeneralizedCartan hint]
      exact inv_mem hw
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := IsDominant.exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf P hA hdom hw'
    rw [← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one] at hwl
    have hkl : k + l = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_add, ← hwk, ← hwl, map_zero]; abel)
    have hk0 : k = 0 := by
      ext i
      have h1 := congr_fun hkl i
      have h2 := hk i
      have h3 := hl i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
      omega
    have heq : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam = lam := by
      rw [hk0, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hwk
      exact hwk.symm
    rw [heq]
    exact ⟨LieModuleHom.id, Function.injective_id⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨v, i, l, c, hl, hvl, hc, hv, hpair, hrefl⟩ :=
      exists_raise_of_not_isDominant P hA hdom
    
    have hw'μ : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i * w)
        lam = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam + P.rootOf (c • l) := by
      rw [weylDot_mul]
      change (P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam + P.rho) - P.rho = _
      rw [hrefl, add_sub_cancel_right, hvl, map_nsmul]
    have hw'mem : P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i * w ∈
        P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam := by
      rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot, ← weylDot, hw'μ, add_sub_right_comm, ← neg_sub, hwk,
        ← map_neg, ← map_add]
      exact P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice _
    obtain ⟨k', hk', hwk'⟩ := IsDominant.exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf P hA hlam hw'mem
    
    have hkk' : k = k' + c • l := by
      refine P.rootOf_injective ?_
      rw [map_add, ← hwk', hw'μ, ← hwk]
      abel
    have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      have h0 : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = 0 := by rw [hvl, map_zero]
      have h2 := P.root_coroot_self hA.isGeneralizedCartan i
      rw [LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      rw [h0, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h2
      exact two_ne_zero h2.symm
    have hlpos : 0 < ∑ j, l j := by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, l j ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h
        push Not at h
        exact hl0 (funext h)
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_le_of_ne (hl j) (Ne.symm hj))
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hl j) (Finset.mem_univ j))
    have hsum : ∑ j, k j = ∑ j, k' j + c * ∑ j, l j := by
      rw [hkk', Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hk'n : ∑ j, k' j = ((∑ j, k' j).toNat : ℤ) :=
      (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hk' j)).symm
    obtain ⟨φ₂, hφ₂⟩ := ih (∑ j, k' j).toNat (by
      have : (c : ℤ) * ∑ j, l j > 0 := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hc) hlpos
      omega) _ hw'mem k' hk' hwk' hk'n
    
    have h46 := VermaModule.exists_injective_reflectionOf P hA hv hpair
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, hvl, ← map_nsmul, ← hw'μ] at h46
    obtain ⟨φ₁, hφ₁⟩ := h46
    exact ⟨φ₂.comp φ₁, hφ₂.comp hφ₁⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.multiplicity_weylDot_ne_zero_of_isDominant
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := VermaModule.exists_injective_weylDot_of_isDominant P hA hlam hw
  refine multiplicity_ne_zero_of_hom_ne_zero P (φ := φ) fun h ↦ hwv_ne_zero P _ (hφ ?_)
  rw [h, map_zero, _root_.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsSerreClassO.irreducibleModule_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem irreducibleModule_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (hSM : S M)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : hM.multiplicity μ ≠ 0) : S (IrreducibleModule P μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hM.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ
  rw [hM.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff (mem_cone_self μ) hl] at hμ
  obtain ⟨N₁, N₂, -, h₁₂, -, -, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hl.exists_of_mem_factorWeights hμ
  have h₂ : S N₂ := ((hS.iff hM N₂).mp hSM).1
  have hq : S (N₁.Subquotient N₂) :=
    ((hS.iff (hM.lieSubmodule N₂) (N₁.comap N₂.incl)).mp h₂).2
  exact hS.of_equiv e hq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_equiv_of_isAtom
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.exists_equiv_of_isAtom {Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module K Q]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q] (hQ : IsCategoryO P Q)
    {B : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q} (hB : IsAtom B) :
    ∃ ξ : Dual K H, Nonempty (B ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P ξ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hb0⟩ : ∃ b ∈ B, b ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact hB.1 (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun b hb ↦ (LieSubmodule.mem_bot b).mpr (hc b hb))
  
  have hsub : ∀ T : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra B, T < ⊤ → T = ⊥ := by
    intro T hT
    have h := hB.2 _ (LieSubmodule.map_incl_lt_iff_lt_top.mpr hT)
    rw [← LieSubmodule.map_bot (f := B.incl)] at h
    exact LieSubmodule.map_injective_of_injective (LieSubmodule.injective_incl B) h
  have hspan : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      (({⟨b, hb⟩} : Finset B) : Set B) = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    have h := hsub _ (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne)
    have hmem : (⟨b, hb⟩ : B) ∈ LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
        (({⟨b, hb⟩} : Finset B) : Set B) :=
      LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (by simp)
    rw [h, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hmem
    exact hb0 (congrArg Subtype.val hmem)
  have : Nontrivial B := ⟨⟨⟨b, hb⟩, 0, fun h ↦ hb0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨ξ, φ, hφ⟩ := (hQ.lieSubmodule B).exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA hspan
  have hker : φ.ker = ⊥ := by
    refine hsub _ (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr fun htop ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hφ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P ξ)
    have : x ∈ φ.ker := htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, hx] at this
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P ξ this
  exact ⟨ξ, ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective φ ⟨(LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot φ).mp hker, hφ⟩⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsSerreClassO.of_forall_multiplicity
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hwf := hM.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P hA hs
  suffices H : ∀ N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M, S (M ⧸ N) by
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective ⊥
      (LieModuleHom.id : M →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ M) Function.surjective_id
      ((LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot _).mpr Function.injective_id)
    exact hS.of_equiv e (H ⊥)
  intro N
  induction N using WellFoundedGT.induction with
  | _ N ih =>
  set q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N
  have hQ : IsCategoryO P (M ⧸ N) := hM.quotient N
  by_cases hN : N = ⊤
  · have : Subsingleton (M ⧸ N) := ⟨fun x y ↦ by
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hq x
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hq y
      rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hN]
      exact LieSubmodule.mem_top _⟩
    exact hS.of_subsingleton _
  
  have hsQ : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      ((s.image q : Finset (M ⧸ N)) : Set (M ⧸ N)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro y -
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hq y
    have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (s : Set M) ≤
        LieSubmodule.comap q (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
          ((s.image q : Finset (M ⧸ N)) : Set (M ⧸ N))) := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
      intro x hx
      exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx))
    exact hle (hs ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x)
  have hwfQ := hQ.wellFoundedLT_lieSubmodule P hA hsQ
  have htop : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M ⧸ N)) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : M, x ∉ N := by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      exact hN (eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ ↦ hc x)
    have : q x ∈ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M ⧸ N)) :=
      h0 ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact hx ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp this)
  obtain ⟨B, hB, -⟩ := (IsAtomic.eq_bot_or_exists_atom_le
    (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (M ⧸ N))).resolve_left htop
  obtain ⟨ξ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hQ.exists_equiv_of_isAtom P hA hB
  
  set N' := B.comap q
  have hlt : N < N' := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (fun x hx ↦ ?_) fun hNN ↦ hB.1 (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun y hy ↦ ?_)
    · rw [LieSubmodule.mem_comap, (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hx]
      exact zero_mem B
    · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hq y
      have hx : x ∈ N' := hy
      rw [← hNN] at hx
      rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot]
      exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hx
  obtain ⟨e'⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective N'
    ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' B).comp q)
    ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' B).comp hq) (by
      ext x
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply]
      exact LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _)
  
  have hmult : hM.multiplicity ξ ≠ 0 := by
    have h₁ := hM.multiplicity_eq_add N ξ
    have h₂ := hQ.multiplicity_eq_add B ξ
    have h₃ := IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (hQ.lieSubmodule B)
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ξ) e ξ
    simp only [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq, ↓reduceIte] at h₃
    omega
  exact (hS.iff hQ B).mpr ⟨hS.of_equiv e.symm (h ξ hmult), hS.of_equiv e' (ih N' hlt)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsSerreClassO.of_verma_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem of_verma_of_isDominant {lam : Dual K H} (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hSV : S (VermaModule P lam)) (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {s : Finset M}
    (hs : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (s : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hblock : ∀ μ, hM.multiplicity μ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
        μ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) : S M
proof:
:=
  hS.of_forall_multiplicity hA hM hs fun μ hμ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hblock μ hμ
    exact hS.irreducibleModule_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (VermaModule.isCategoryO P lam) hSV
      (VermaModule.multiplicity_weylDot_ne_zero_of_isDominant P hA hlam hw)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isSerreClassO_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem isSerreClassO_centralTranslation (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra) →ₐ[K] K) :
    IsSerreClassO P fun M _ _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ M) where
  of_subsingleton M _ _ _ _ _
proof:
:= ⟨fun x y ↦ by
    have h0 : ∀ t : centralBlock P M χ₁ ⊗[K] Z, t = 0 := fun t ↦ by
      induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul a z =>
        rw [show a = 0 from Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _), TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
      | add a b ha hb => rw [ha, hb, add_zero]
    exact Subtype.ext ((h0 x.val).trans (h0 y.val).symm)⟩
  of_equiv {M N} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ e hM := ⟨fun x y ↦ by
    have hc : ∀ t, centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ e.toLieModuleHom
        (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ e.symm.toLieModuleHom t) = t := fun t ↦ by
      rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ← centralTranslationMap_comp]
      have : e.toLieModuleHom.comp e.symm.toLieModuleHom = LieModuleHom.id := by
        ext; simp
      rw [this, centralTranslationMap_id, LieModuleHom.id_apply]
    rw [← hc x, ← hc y]
    congr 1
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  iff {M} _ _ _ _ hM N := by
    obtain ⟨hf, hex, hg⟩ := centralTranslationMap_shortExact P Z hM hZ N.incl
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) (LieSubmodule.injective_incl N)
      (by rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker, LieSubmodule.range_incl])
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N) χ₁ χ₂
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨hf.subsingleton, hg.subsingleton⟩
    · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      refine ⟨fun x y ↦ ?_⟩
      have hx : x ∈ (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)).ker := by
        rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      have hy : y ∈ (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)).ker := by
        rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hex, LieModuleHom.mem_range] at hx hy
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [Subsingleton.elim a b]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
lemma map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    (φ : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) : φ v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, hv a, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_notMem_lowerPart
statement: lemma hwv_notMem_lowerPart : hwv P Λ ∉ lowerPart P Λ
proof:
:= fun hv ↦
  hwv_ne_zero P Λ (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp ((iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (h P)) Λ) _
    (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ) hv)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.inf_weightSpace_self_eq_bot
statement:
lemma inf_weightSpace_self_eq_bot {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)}
    (hN : hwv P Λ ∉ N) : N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ Λ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  rintro x ⟨hxN, hx⟩
  rw [weightSpace_self] at hx
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · simp [hc]
  · exact absurd (by simpa [hc] using N.smul_mem c⁻¹ hxN) hN

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_notMem_iff_le_lowerPart
statement:
theorem hwv_notMem_iff_le_lowerPart (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)) :
    hwv P Λ ∉ N ↔ N.toSubmodule ≤ lowerPart P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hN ↦ ?_, fun hN hv ↦ hwv_notMem_lowerPart P Λ (hN hv)⟩
  have hle := inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (h P) N.toSubmodule (fun a _ hm ↦ N.lie_mem hm)
    Set.univ
  have htop : ⨆ μ ∈ Set.univ, weightSpace P Λ μ = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← iSup_weightSpace_eq_top P Λ]
    exact iSup₂_le fun k _ ↦ le_biSup (fun μ ↦ weightSpace P Λ μ) (Set.mem_univ _)
  rw [htop, inf_top_eq] at hle
  refine hle.trans (iSup₂_le fun μ _ ↦ ?_)
  by_cases hμ : μ = Λ
  · subst hμ
    rw [inf_weightSpace_self_eq_bot P μ hN]
    exact bot_le
  · exact inf_le_right.trans (le_biSup (fun ν ↦ weightSpace P Λ ν) hμ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_notMem_iff_inf_weightSpace_eq_bot
statement:
theorem hwv_notMem_iff_inf_weightSpace_eq_bot
    (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)) :
    hwv P Λ ∉ N ↔ N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ Λ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inf_weightSpace_self_eq_bot P Λ, fun hN hv ↦ hwv_ne_zero P Λ ?_⟩
  rw [← Submodule.mem_bot K, ← hN]
  exact ⟨hv, hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_le_lowerPart
statement: lemma maxSubmodule_le_lowerPart : (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ≤ lowerPart P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxSubmodule, LieSubmodule.sSup_toSubmodule]
  refine sSup_le ?_
  rintro _ ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
  exact (hwv_notMem_iff_le_lowerPart P Λ N).mp hN

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule
statement: theorem hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule : hwv P Λ ∉ maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:=
  (hwv_notMem_iff_le_lowerPart P Λ _).mpr (maxSubmodule_le_lowerPart P Λ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_ne_top
statement: theorem maxSubmodule_ne_top : maxSubmodule P Λ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule P Λ (h ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.le_maxSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem le_maxSubmodule_iff (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)) :
    N ≤ maxSubmodule P Λ ↔ N ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hN h ↦ maxSubmodule_ne_top P Λ (eq_top_iff.mpr (h ▸ hN)), fun hN ↦ ?_⟩
  exact le_sSup fun hv ↦ hN (eq_top_of_hwv_mem P Λ hv)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isCoatom_maxSubmodule
statement: theorem isCoatom_maxSubmodule : IsCoatom (maxSubmodule P Λ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨maxSubmodule_ne_top P Λ, fun N hN ↦ by_contra fun h ↦
    hN.not_ge ((le_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ N).mpr h)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_maxSubmodule_of_isCoatom
statement:
theorem eq_maxSubmodule_of_isCoatom {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)}
    (hN : IsCoatom N) : N = maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:=
  ((hN.le_iff.mp ((le_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ N).mpr hN.1)).resolve_left
    (maxSubmodule_ne_top P Λ)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    {μ : Dual K H} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ μ = Λ - P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! hμ
  let S : Set (Dual K H) := {ν | ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ν = Λ - P.rootOf k}
  let N : Dual K H → Submodule K V := fun ν ↦ if ν ∈ S then weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν else ⊥
  have hN : ∀ ν, N ν ≤ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν := fun ν ↦ by
    simp only [N]; split_ifs <;> simp
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hφ x
  have hm : m ∈ ⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf k) := by
    rw [iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
  have hx' : φ m ∈ ⨆ ν, N ν := by
    have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V)) hm
    simp_rw [Submodule.map_iSup] at this
    refine (iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦ ?_ : _ ≤ ⨆ ν, N ν) this
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup N (Λ - P.rootOf k))
    simp only [N, show Λ - P.rootOf k ∈ S from ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, ite_true]
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ hy
  have := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) N hN hx hx'
  simp only [N, show μ ∉ S from fun ⟨k, hk, h⟩ ↦ hμ k hk h, ite_false,
    Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  exact hx0 this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero
statement: theorem hwv_ne_zero : hwv P Λ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ne_eq, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact VermaModule.hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule P Λ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma hwv_mem_weightSpace : hwv P Λ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) Λ
proof:
:=
  map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P _ (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible
statement: theorem isIrreducible : IsIrreducible K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsIrreducible.mk fun N hN ↦ ?_
  set π' := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P Λ)
  have hle : VermaModule.maxSubmodule P Λ ≤ N.comap π' := fun m hm ↦ by
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_comap, (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hm]
    exact N.zero_mem
  rcases (VermaModule.isCoatom_maxSubmodule P Λ).le_iff.mp hle with h | h
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro q _
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ q
    have : m ∈ N.comap π' := h ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top m
    exact this
  · refine absurd ?_ hN
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ q
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← h]
    exact hq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem eq_of_equiv {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (e : IrreducibleModule P Λ ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) : Λ = μ
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hΛ⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P μ
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)
    (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P e.toLieModuleHom (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ))
    (by simpa using hwv_ne_zero P Λ)
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hμ⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)
    (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P e.symm.toLieModuleHom (hwv_mem_weightSpace P μ))
    (by simpa using hwv_ne_zero P μ)
  have h1 : P.rootOf k = μ - Λ := by rw [hΛ]; abel
  have h2 : P.rootOf l = Λ - μ := by rw [hμ]; abel
  have hkl : k + l = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_add, h1, h2, map_zero]; abel)
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    ext i
    have := congrFun hkl i
    have := hk i
    have := hl i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at *
    omega
  rw [hΛ, hk0, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_comp_equiv
statement:
lemma ker_comp_equiv {X Y Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y] [LieRingModule 𝔤 Y] [LieModule K 𝔤 Y]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z] [LieRingModule 𝔤 Z] [LieModule K 𝔤 Z]
    (e : Y ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z) (π : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) :
    ((e : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z).comp π).ker = π.ker
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ e.injective ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h, map_zero]⟩
  rw [map_zero]
  exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.ker_π_le_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCover.ker_π_le_of_isAntidominant {lam ξ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (f : ProjectiveCover P hA lam →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P ξ) :
    (ProjectiveCover.π P hA lam).ker ≤ f.ker
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · intro x _
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, hf]
    rfl
  have h1 : f.ker ≤ (ProjectiveCover.π P hA lam).ker := by
    by_contra h
    refine hf (LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
    have hx : x ∈ f.ker := (ProjectiveCover.eq_top_of_not_le_ker P hA lam _ h) ▸ trivial
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := VermaModule.nonempty_equiv_irreducible_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam
  have hgker := ker_comp_equiv P e.symm (ProjectiveCover.π P hA lam)
  rcases VermaModule.eq_zero_or_ker_le P hA f _ (hgker ▸ h1) with h | h
  · exfalso
    refine ProjectiveCover.π_ne_zero P hA lam (LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
    have hx : ((e.symm : IrreducibleModule P lam →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam).comp
        (ProjectiveCover.π P hA lam)) x = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [LieModuleHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at hx
    exact e.symm.injective (hx.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  · exact hgker ▸ h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_verma_le_one_of_isAntidominant
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hposDef⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hposDef.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  have hπ := ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveCover P lam hA
  obtain ⟨p, hpw, hπp, hp⟩ := hπ.exists_generator
  rw [← ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity P lam hA (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ξ)]
  have hprim : ∀ f : ProjectiveCover P hA lam →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P ξ,
      f p ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P ξ) lam := fun f ↦ by
    refine mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f hpw, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie]
    refine ProjectiveCover.ker_π_le_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam f ?_
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.map_lie, hπp, IrreducibleModule.hwv,
      ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv,
      map_zero]
  let Φ : (ProjectiveCover P hA lam →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P ξ) →ₗ[K]
      primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P ξ) lam :=
    { toFun f := ⟨f p, hprim f⟩
      map_add' _ _ := rfl
      map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
  have : FiniteDimensional K (primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P ξ) lam) :=
    have := VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace P ξ lam
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  refine (LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (f := Φ) fun f g hfg ↦ ?_).trans ?_
  · rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    refine IsProjectiveCover.eq_zero_of_apply_eq_zero hp ?_
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hfg
    simpa [Φ, sub_eq_zero] using this
  · rw [← (homEquiv P (VermaModule P ξ) lam).finrank_eq]
    exact finrank_hom_le_one_of_finite_type P hA S ξ lam

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_verma_weylDot_of_isAntidominant
proof:
:= by
  set μ := P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam
  refine le_antisymm (multiplicity_verma_le_one_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam μ) ?_
  obtain ⟨S, hS, -⟩ := VermaModule.exists_isAtom_le P hA μ
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hmξ, -⟩ := exists_isAntidominant_of_isAtom_of_injective P hA
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) hS (f := S.incl) Subtype.val_injective
  have hmμ : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity μ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [VermaModule.multiplicity_self]
    exact one_ne_zero
  obtain rfl := eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hξ hw hmξ hmμ
  exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hmξ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.count_projectiveCover_of_isAntidominant
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity P lam hA ht]
  exact multiplicity_verma_weylDot_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_verma_weylDot_of_integral
statement:
theorem multiplicity_verma_weylDot_of_integral {lam : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hint : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = n) (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)).multiplicity lam = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine multiplicity_verma_weylDot_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam ?_
  rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' := lam + P.rho)
    fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩, mem_integralWeylGroup, mem_rootLattice]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.2 hint
  exact ⟨k, by rw [hk, add_sub_cancel_left]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.extension
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.extension (hN : IsCategoryO P N) (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (c : extCocycles (h P) M N) : IsCategoryO P (ExtOne.Extension c) where
  iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
proof:
:=
    ExtOne.Extension.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top c hN.1 hM.1
  finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ := by
    have := hN.2 μ
    have := hM.2 μ
    exact Module.Finite.of_injective _ (ExtOne.Extension.injective_weightSpaceMap c μ)
  exists_finset := by
    classical
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hN.3
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hM.3
    refine ⟨s ∪ t, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
    rw [ExtOne.Extension.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff] at hv
    by_cases h1 : (ExtOne.Extension.equiv c v).1 = 0
    · have h2 : (ExtOne.Extension.equiv c v).2 ≠ 0 := fun h2 ↦ hv0
        ((ExtOne.Extension.ext_iff' c).mpr ⟨by rw [h1, map_zero]; rfl, by rw [h2, map_zero]; rfl⟩)
      obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, h⟩ := ht μ fun hb ↦ h2 ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hb _ hv.2)
      exact ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_union_right _ hΛ, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, h⟩ := hs μ fun hb ↦ h1 ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp hb _ hv.1)
      exact ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_union_left _ hΛ, h⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_extension_eq_top
statement:
theorem centralBlock_extension_eq_top {χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hN : centralBlock P N χ = ⊤)
    (hM : centralBlock P M χ = ⊤) (c : extCocycles (h P) M N) :
    centralBlock P (ExtOne.Extension c) χ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro v -
  rw [mem_centralBlock]
  intro z
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (mem_centralBlock P χ _).mp
    (hM ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top (ExtOne.Extension.snd c v)) z
  have h1 : ExtOne.Extension.snd c
      (((rep P (ExtOne.Extension c) (z : 𝓤) - χ z • 1) ^ a) v) = 0 := by
    rw [map_rep_center_sub_pow]; exact ha
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ExtOne.Extension.exists_inl_eq_of_snd_eq_zero c h1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (mem_centralBlock P χ n).mp (hN ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top n) z
  refine ⟨b + a, ?_⟩
  rw [pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, ← hn, ← map_rep_center_sub_pow, hb, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.tensorDualEquivHom_map
statement:
theorem tensorDualEquivHom_map (q : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') (t : N ⊗[K] Module.Dual K L) :
    tensorDualEquivHom P N' L (TensorProduct.LieModule.map q LieModuleHom.id t) =
      (q : N →ₗ[K] N') ∘ₗ tensorDualEquivHom P N L t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | tmul n f =>
    ext l
    simp [tensorDualEquivHom]
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add, LinearMap.comp_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rTensorEquiv_apply_symm_apply
statement:
theorem rTensorEquiv_apply_symm_apply {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule 𝔤 W]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 W] (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (z : W ⊗[K] L) :
    rTensorEquiv P L e (rTensorEquiv P L e.symm z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul a b => change e (e.symm a) ⊗ₜ b = a ⊗ₜ b; rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rTensorEquiv_map_centralBlockMap
statement:
theorem rTensorEquiv_map_centralBlockMap {χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hN : centralBlock P N χ = ⊤)
    (hN' : centralBlock P N' χ = ⊤) (q : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N') (t : centralBlock P N χ ⊗[K] L) :
    rTensorEquiv P L (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hN')
      (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (centralBlockMap P q χ) LieModuleHom.id t) =
      TensorProduct.LieModule.map q LieModuleHom.id
        (rTensorEquiv P L (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hN) t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | tmul a b => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translationAdjunction_comp
statement:
theorem translationAdjunction_comp (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (hL : IsCategoryO P L)
    {χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hMχ : centralBlock P M χ₁ = ⊤) (hNχ : centralBlock P N χ₂ = ⊤)
    (hNχ' : centralBlock P N' χ₂ = ⊤) (q : N →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N')
    (f : centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) :
    translationAdjunction P hM hL hMχ hNχ' (q.comp f) =
      (centralTranslationMap P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ q).comp
        (translationAdjunction P hM hL hMχ hNχ f)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  apply (rTensorEquiv P (Module.Dual K L) (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hNχ')).injective
  apply (tensorDualEquivHom P N' L).injective
  change tensorDualEquivHom P N' L (rTensorEquiv P (Module.Dual K L)
      (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hNχ')
        (rTensorEquiv P (Module.Dual K L) (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hNχ').symm _)) =
    tensorDualEquivHom P N' L (rTensorEquiv P (Module.Dual K L) (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hNχ')
      (TensorProduct.LieModule.map (centralBlockMap P q χ₂) LieModuleHom.id
        (rTensorEquiv P (Module.Dual K L) (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hNχ).symm _)))
  rw [rTensorEquiv_apply_symm_apply, rTensorEquiv_map_centralBlockMap P hNχ hNχ',
    rTensorEquiv_apply_symm_apply, tensorDualEquivHom_map]
  change tensorDualEquivHom P N' L ((tensorDualEquivHom P N' L).symm _) =
    (q : N →ₗ[K] N') ∘ₗ tensorDualEquivHom P N L ((tensorDualEquivHom P N L).symm _)
  rw [LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  ext l
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_subsingleton_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_subsingleton_centralTranslation (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (hL : IsCategoryO P L)
    {χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hMχ : centralBlock P M χ₁ = ⊤) (hNχ : centralBlock P N χ₂ = ⊤)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ N))
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X]
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M) (g : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) : g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : translationAdjunction P hM hL hMχ hNχ (g.comp eX.symm.toLieModuleHom) = 0 :=
    LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have h1 := (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp this
  ext x
  simpa using LieModuleHom.congr_fun h1 (eX x)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOne_eq_zero_of_subsingleton_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem extOne_eq_zero_of_subsingleton_centralTranslation (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hL : IsCategoryO P L) (hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K L))
    {χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hMχ : centralBlock P M χ₁ = ⊤)
    (hN : IsCategoryO P N) (hNχ : centralBlock P N χ₂ = ⊤)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ N))
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X]
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M) (y : ExtOne (h P) X N) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ExtOne.mk_surjective y
  rw [ExtOne.mk_eq_zero_iff]
  have hTX : IsCategoryO P (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M) := hM.centralTranslation P hL χ₁ χ₂
  have hX : IsCategoryO P X := IsCategoryO.of_equiv (P := P) hTX eX.symm
  have hTXχ : centralBlock P (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M) χ₂ = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro v -
    exact mem_centralBlock_of_injective P (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M).incl
      Subtype.val_injective χ₂ v.property
  have hXχ : centralBlock P X χ₂ = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    have hx : eX x ∈ centralBlock P (centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M) χ₂ := by
      rw [hTXχ]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top _
    exact mem_centralBlock_of_injective P eX.toLieModuleHom eX.injective χ₂ hx
  have hE := IsCategoryO.extension P hN hX c
  have hEχ := centralBlock_extension_eq_top P hNχ hXχ c
  
  have hex : (ExtOne.Extension.snd c).ker = (ExtOne.Extension.inl c).range := by
    ext v
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
    exact ⟨fun hv ↦ ExtOne.Extension.exists_inl_eq_of_snd_eq_zero c hv,
      fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ hn ▸ rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hker, hsurj⟩ := centralTranslationMap_shortExact P (Module.Dual K L) hE hL'
    (ExtOne.Extension.inl c) (ExtOne.Extension.snd c) (ExtOne.Extension.injective_inl c) hex
    (ExtOne.Extension.surjective_snd c) χ₂ χ₁
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (centralTranslationMap P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ (ExtOne.Extension.snd c)) := by
    refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
    have hx' : x ∈ (centralTranslationMap P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁
        (ExtOne.Extension.snd c)).ker := hx
    rw [hker, LieModuleHom.mem_range] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx'
    rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨eT, heT⟩ : ∃ e : centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ (ExtOne.Extension c) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ X,
      ∀ y, e y = centralTranslationMap P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ (ExtOne.Extension.snd c) y :=
    ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective _ ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ X,
      η = (centralTranslationMap P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ eX.symm.toLieModuleHom).comp
        (translationAdjunction P hM hL hMχ hTXχ LieModuleHom.id) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨σ', hσ'⟩ : ∃ σ' : centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ExtOne.Extension c,
      translationAdjunction P hM hL hMχ hEχ σ' = eT.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp η :=
    ⟨(translationAdjunction P hM hL hMχ hEχ).symm _, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
  have key : (ExtOne.Extension.snd c).comp σ' = eX.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp LieModuleHom.id := by
    have h2 := translationAdjunction_comp P hM hL hMχ hTXχ hXχ eX.symm.toLieModuleHom
      LieModuleHom.id
    apply (translationAdjunction P hM hL hMχ hXχ).injective
    rw [h2, ← hη, translationAdjunction_comp P hM hL hMχ hEχ hXχ, hσ']
    refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    have h3 := heT (eT.symm (η x))
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h3
    exact h3.symm
  refine ⟨σ'.comp eX.toLieModuleHom, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun key (eX x)
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_hom_ker_equiv_extOne
statement:
theorem nonempty_hom_ker_equiv_extOne (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (hL : IsCategoryO P L)
    (hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K L)) {χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hMχ : centralBlock P M χ₁ = ⊤)
    (hN : IsCategoryO P N) (hNχ : centralBlock P N χ₂ = ⊤)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K L) χ₂ χ₁ N))
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X]
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P L χ₁ χ₂ M)
    {S : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S] [LieRingModule 𝔤 S] [LieModule K 𝔤 S]
    (hS : IsCategoryO P S) (p : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ S) (hp : Function.Surjective p) :
    Nonempty ((p.ker →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) ≃ₗ[K] ExtOne (h P) S N)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : IsCategoryO P X :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (P := P) (hM.centralTranslation P hL χ₁ χ₂) eX.symm
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := ExtOne.exists_splitData (h P) hX.1 hS.1 (i := p.ker.incl) (p := p)
    Subtype.val_injective hp fun b ↦ ⟨fun hb ↦ ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, rfl⟩, fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ha ▸ a.2⟩
  exact ⟨D.connectingEquiv
    (eq_zero_of_subsingleton_centralTranslation P hM hL hMχ hNχ h0 eX)
    (extOne_eq_zero_of_subsingleton_centralTranslation P hM hL hL' hMχ hN hNχ h0 eX)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.not_isPosRoot_of_weylDot_mul_reflectionOf_lt
statement:
theorem not_isPosRoot_of_weylDot_mul_reflectionOf_lt {lam : Dual K H}
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} {n : ℤ} (hn0 : n < 0)
    (hn : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = n)
    {x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hlt : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam ∈
        cone P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam) ∧
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam ≠
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam) :
    ¬P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * v) i
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, hk, hke⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨k', hk', he'⟩, hne⟩ := hlt
  have he : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam =
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam + P.rootOf ((-n) • k) := by
    simp only [weylDot]
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', hn, map_sub, map_smul,
      ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, hke, map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
    push_cast
    module
  rw [he] at he' hne
  have h0 : P.rootOf ((-n) • k + k') = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, ← sub_eq_zero.mpr he']
    abel
  have h1 : (-n) • k + k' = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    ext j
    have := congrFun h1 j
    have hj := hk j
    have hj' := hk' j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at this hj hj' ⊢
    nlinarith
  exact hne (by rw [hk0, smul_zero, map_zero, add_zero])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_hom_ker_equiv_extOne_wall
statement:
theorem nonempty_hom_ker_equiv_extOne_wall {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    {x : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hxint : x ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hlt : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam ∈
        cone P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam) ∧
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam ≠
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam)
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule 𝔤 X] [LieModule K 𝔤 X]
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)))
    (p : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
    (hp : Function.Surjective p) :
    Nonempty ((p.ker →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam))
      ≃ₗ[K] ExtOne (h P) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hν', ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have hzz : z' * z ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := mul_mem hz' hz
  have hzν' : (z' * z) (μ - lam) = z' (-ν) := by
    change z' (z (μ - lam)) = z' (-ν)
    rw [← hzν, ← map_neg, neg_sub]
  set s := P.reflectionOf hA' v i with hs
  have hint := sub_rho_integral P hA hν' hzz hzν'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hint v i).mpr ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hμα⟩
  change P.corootPairing _ (lam + P.rho) v i = n at hn
  have hn0 : n < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hlam v i hv n hn)
    (by rintro rfl; exact hlamα (by simp [hn]))
  have hx := not_isPosRoot_of_weylDot_mul_reflectionOf_lt P hA hn0 hn hlt
  
  have hss : s * s = 1 := reflectionOf_mul_self v i
  have hx' : P.IsPosRoot hA' ((x * s) * v) i := by
    have hsv : s * v = v * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i := by
      have hsimp : (⟨P.reflection hA' i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i⟩ : P.weylGroup hA') =
          (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i := by
        ext1
        simp
      rw [hs, reflectionOf, ← hsimp]
      group
    rw [mul_assoc, hsv, ← mul_assoc]
    exact (isPosRoot_or (x * v) i).resolve_left hx
  have hxx : (x * s) * s = x := by rw [mul_assoc, hss, mul_one]
  have hnotU := not_upperClosureCondition_of_wall hA hμα hn0 hn hx'
  rw [hxx] at hnotU
  have hsub := translation_irreducible_of_not_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ
    hfacet hν' hzz hzν' x hxint (fun hU ↦ hnotU ((memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant
      hA hlam hμ hint hfacet x).mp hU))
  
  have h0 : Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν))
      (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))) :=
    @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ (centralTranslationCoeffEquiv P
      (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam)) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) eν).toEquiv hsub
  have hL' : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (P := P) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ))
      (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  have hNχ : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA' x lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' x.property lam) ▸ centralBlock_irreducible P _
  exact nonempty_hom_ker_equiv_extOne P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _)
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) hL' hMχ (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) hNχ h0 eX
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) p hp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_surjective_translation_irreducible_wall
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_translation_irreducible_wall {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam) :
    ∃ p : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ))
          →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam),
      Function.Surjective p
proof:
:= by
