  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (exists_hom_translation_irreducible_ne_zero_iff P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν
    hv hμα hwall hlamα hw hwint w).mpr rfl
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  rcases IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top f.range with h | h
  · exact absurd (LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ by
      have : f m ∈ f.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range f _).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩
      rwa [h, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this) hf
  · exact (LieModuleHom.range_eq_top f).mp h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isStdFiltered_top_range
statement:
theorem isStdFiltered_top_range {e : Q →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ Q} (he : e.comp e = e)
    {t : Multiset (Dual K H)} (ht : IsStdFiltered P e.range t) :
    IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra e.range) t
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : e.range.map (rangeRetr e) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    exact ⟨y.1, y.2, rangeRetr_incl he y⟩
  rw [← hmap]
  refine ht.map_of_injOn P (rangeRetr e) (fun x hx hx0 ↦ ?_) le_rfl
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  have : e (e y) = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hx0
  rwa [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply e e, he] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem count_eq_multiplicity [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (hπ : IsProjectiveCover P V π)
    (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) {t : Multiset (Dual K H)}
    (ht : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) t) (μ : Dual K H) :
    t.count μ = (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).multiplicity Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ht.count_eq_finrank_hom hπ.isCategoryO μ,
    hπ.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity hproj (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)),
    multiplicity_restrictedDual]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered_range
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_range :
    ∃ t, IsStdFiltered P (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ).range t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set n := projectiveCoverShift P hA Λ
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P n)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma P
    (isCategoryO_dual_irreducible_nsmul_rho P hA n).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
    (Λ + (n : K) • P.rho)
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht, -, -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range_add P
    (isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA Λ n) hs (projectiveCoverIdem P hA Λ)
    (projectiveCoverIdem_idem P hA Λ)
  exact ⟨t, ht⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity
proof:
:=
  (isProjectiveCover P Λ hA).count_eq_multiplicity (isProjectiveO P hA Λ) ht μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] :
    ∃ t, IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)) t ∧
      t.count Λ = 1 ∧ ∀ μ ∈ t, Λ ∈ cone P μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range P Λ hA
  have ht' := isStdFiltered_top_range P (projectiveCoverIdem_idem P hA Λ) ht
  refine ⟨t, ht', ?_, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [count_eq_multiplicity P Λ hA ht' Λ, VermaModule.multiplicity_self]
  · have h := count_eq_multiplicity P Λ hA ht' μ
    have hpos : t.count μ ≠ 0 := (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hμ).ne'
    rw [h] at hpos
    exact VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hpos

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_eq_zero_of_ofSub_top
statement:
theorem ext_eq_zero_of_ofSub_top (X Y : CategoryO.{u} P) {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub X ⊤) Y n, x = 0) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} X Y n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let z : X.obj →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (ofSub X ⊥).obj := 0
  have hz : Function.Surjective z := fun _ ↦ ⟨0, (ofLieEquiv (P := P)
    (⊥ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X.obj)).symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  have hz0 : z.ker = ⊤ := eq_top_iff.mpr fun y _ ↦ LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr rfl
  have h' : ∀ x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ofSub X z.ker) Y n, x = 0 := by
    rw [hz0]
    exact h
  exact Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_shortExact_left (shortExact_kerComplex X (ofSub X ⊥) z hz) h'
    (Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_isZero_left (isZero_ofSub_bot X)) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero_aux
statement:
theorem ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero_aux (lam : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) : ∀ (μ : Dual K H)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (dualVerma P lam) (n + 1)), x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro μ x
    exact ext_one_eq_zero_of_extOne_of_equiv _ _ (VermaModule P μ)
      (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P lam)) (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (VermaModule P μ))
      (ofLieEquiv (P := P) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P lam)))
      (extOne_verma_restrictedDual_verma_eq_zero P lam μ) x
  | succ n ih =>
    intro μ x
    exact ext_succ_verma_eq_zero _ μ (n + 1) (fun κ _ _ ↦ ih κ) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero (μ lam : Dual K H) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (x : Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (dualVerma P lam) n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  exact ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero_aux lam m μ x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ext_dualVerma_eq_zero_of_isStdFiltered
proof:
:=
  ext_eq_zero_of_ofSub_top X _
    (ext_eq_zero_of_isStdFiltered X _ hX fun μ _ ↦ ext_verma_dualVerma_eq_zero μ lam hn) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.ofLieModuleHom_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofLieModuleHom_hom_apply {X Y : ModuleCat.{w} 𝓤} (φ : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) (m : X) :
    (ofLieModuleHom φ).hom m = φ m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.surjective_of_epi
statement:
theorem surjective_of_epi {X Y : CategoryO.{w} P} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Epi f] :
    Function.Surjective f.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  have := (IsObj.{w} P).preservesEpimorphisms_ι_of_isNormalMonoCategory
  exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective ((IsObj.{w} P).ι.map f)).mp inferInstance

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.projective_of_isProjectiveO
statement:
theorem projective_of_isProjectiveO (Q : CategoryO.{w} P) (hQ : IsProjectiveO.{w} P Q.obj) :
    Projective Q where
  factors {E X} g e _
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hQ E.property.1 X.property.1 (toLieModuleHom e.hom) (surjective_of_epi e)
      (toLieModuleHom g.hom)
    refine ⟨(IsObj.{w} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom ψ), ?_⟩
    ext m
    exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.projective_mk
statement:
theorem projective_mk (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
    [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hS : ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{w} P M) : Projective (mk M hM hS)
proof:
:=
  projective_of_isProjectiveO _ (hproj.of_retract (ofLieEquiv (P := P) M).symm.toLieModuleHom
    (ofLieEquiv (P := P) M).toLieModuleHom (by ext; rfl))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.nonempty_projectivePresentation
statement:
theorem nonempty_projectivePresentation (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (X : CategoryO.{w} P) (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (hS : ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hproj : IsProjectiveO.{w} P M) (π : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X.obj) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) :
    Nonempty (ProjectivePresentation X)
proof:
:= by
  let e := ofLieEquiv (P := P) M
  have := projective_mk M hM hS hproj
  let f : mk M hM hS ⟶ X := (IsObj.{w} P).homMk (ofLieModuleHom (π.comp e.symm.toLieModuleHom))
  have hf : Epi f := (IsObj.{w} P).ι.epi_of_epi_map
    ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr fun x ↦ by
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hπ x
      exact ⟨e d, rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨⟨mk M hM hS, f⟩⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.act_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem act_ι (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M]
    [LieModule R L M] (x : L) (m : M) : act M (ι R x) m = ⁅x, m⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, lift_ι_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.induction_left
statement:
theorem induction_left {C : U → Prop} (hone : C 1)
    (hadd : ∀ a b, C a → C b → C (a + b))
    (hsmul : ∀ (r : R) a, C a → C (r • a))
    (hι : ∀ (x : L) a, C a → C (ι R x * a)) (u : U) : C u
proof:
:= by
  have h (a : U) : ∀ b, C b → C (a * b) := by
    induction a using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction with
    | algebraMap r => intro b hb; rw [← Algebra.smul_def]; exact hsmul r b hb
    | ι x => exact hι x
    | mul a b ha hb => intro c hc; rw [mul_assoc]; exact ha _ (hb _ hc)
    | add a b ha hb => intro c hc; rw [add_mul]; exact hadd _ _ (ha _ hc) (hb _ hc)
  simpa using h u 1 hone

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.forward_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem forward_tmul (u : Reg) (z : Z₀) :
    forward (u ⊗ₜ[R] z) =
      act Diag (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) (seed (TrivialLieModule.equiv R L Z z))
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.backward_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_tmul (u : Reg) (z : Z) :
    backward (u ⊗ₜ[R] z) = act (Z →ₗ[R] Free) (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) freeSeed z
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.forward_lie
statement: theorem forward_lie (x : L) (t : Free) : forward ⁅x, t⁆ = ⁅x, forward t⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul u z =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, trivial_lie_zero, tmul_zero,
      add_zero, forward_tmul, LeftRegular.equiv_lie, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, act_ι]
  | add t s ht hs => simp only [lie_add, map_add, ht, hs]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.backward_lie_tmul
statement:
theorem backward_lie_tmul (x : L) (u : Reg) (z : Z) :
    backward (⁅x, u⁆ ⊗ₜ[R] z) =
      ⁅x, backward (u ⊗ₜ[R] z)⁆ - backward (u ⊗ₜ[R] ⁅x, z⁆)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [backward_tmul, LeftRegular.equiv_lie, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, act_ι,
    LieHom.lie_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.backward_lie
statement: theorem backward_lie (x : L) (t : Diag) : backward ⁅x, t⁆ = ⁅x, backward t⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul u z =>
    rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, map_add, backward_lie_tmul,
      sub_add_cancel]
  | add t s ht hs => simp only [lie_add, map_add, ht, hs]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.forward_freeSeed
statement:
@[simp] theorem forward_freeSeed (z : Z) :
    forward (freeSeed (R := R) (L := L) z) = seed z
proof:
:= by
  simp [freeSeed, forward_tmul]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.backward_seed
statement:
@[simp] theorem backward_seed (z : Z) :
    backward (seed (R := R) (L := L) z) = freeSeed z
proof:
:= by
  simp [seed, backward_tmul]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.backward_forward
statement: theorem backward_forward (t : Free) : backward (forward t) = t
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ (u : U) (z : Z₀),
      backward (forward ((LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm u ⊗ₜ[R] z)) =
        (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm u ⊗ₜ[R] z by
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul u z => simpa using h (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) z
    | add t s ht hs => simp only [map_add, ht, hs]
  intro u
  induction u using induction_left with
  | hone =>
    intro z
    change backward (forward (freeSeed (R := R) (L := L)
      (TrivialLieModule.equiv R L Z z))) = _
    rw [forward_freeSeed, backward_seed]
    rfl
  | hadd a b ha hb => intro z; simp only [map_add, add_tmul, ha, hb]
  | hsmul r a ha => intro z; simp only [map_smul, ← smul_tmul', ha]
  | hι x a ha =>
    intro z
    have e : (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm (ι R x * a) ⊗ₜ[R] z =
        ⁅x, (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm a ⊗ₜ[R] z⁆ := by
      simp only [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, trivial_lie_zero, tmul_zero,
        add_zero]
      rfl
    rw [e, forward_lie, backward_lie, ha]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorIdentity.forward_backward
statement: theorem forward_backward (t : Diag) : forward (backward t) = t
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ (u : U) (z : Z),
      forward (backward ((LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm u ⊗ₜ[R] z)) =
        (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm u ⊗ₜ[R] z by
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul u z => simpa using h (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) z
    | add t s ht hs => simp only [map_add, ht, hs]
  intro u
  induction u using induction_left with
  | hone =>
    intro z
    change forward (backward (seed (R := R) (L := L) z)) = _
    rw [backward_seed, forward_freeSeed]
    rfl
  | hadd a b ha hb => intro z; simp only [map_add, add_tmul, ha, hb]
  | hsmul r a ha => intro z; simp only [map_smul, ← smul_tmul', ha]
  | hι x a ha =>
    intro z
    change forward (backward (⁅x, (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm a⁆ ⊗ₜ[R] z)) = _
    rw [backward_lie_tmul, map_sub, forward_lie, ha, ha,
      TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, add_sub_cancel_right]
    rfl

name: LieModuleEquiv.tensorCongr_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorCongr_tmul (f : M ≃ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M') (g : N ≃ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorCongr f g (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = f m ⊗ₜ[R] g n
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.congr_tmul _ _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorEquivLeftRegular_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorEquivLeftRegular_one (z : Z) :
    tensorEquivLeftRegular P Λ
      ((LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm 1 ⊗ₜ[K]
        (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) Z).symm z) = hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z
proof:
:= by
  change (equivLeftRegular P Λ).tensorCongr LieModuleEquiv.refl
    (TensorIdentity.forward (TensorIdentity.freeSeed z)) = _
  rw [TensorIdentity.forward_freeSeed]
  rw [TensorIdentity.seed, TensorProduct.mk_apply, LieModuleEquiv.tensorCongr_tmul]
  change equivEnvNNeg P Λ 1 ⊗ₜ[K] z = _
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_top_of_hwv_tmul_mem
statement:
theorem eq_top_of_hwv_tmul_mem
    (N : LieSubmodule K (nNeg P) (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] Z))
    (hN : ∀ z : Z, hwv P Λ ⊗ₜ[K] z ∈ N) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_top_iff.mpr
  intro t ht
  clear ht
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := (tensorEquivLeftRegular P Λ).surjective t
  suffices h : ∀ (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P))
      (z : TrivialLieModule K (nNeg P) Z),
      tensorEquivLeftRegular P Λ ((LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm u ⊗ₜ[K] z) ∈ N by
    induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul u z => simpa using h (LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P) u) z
    | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add]; exact N.add_mem hs ht
  intro u
  induction u using TensorIdentity.induction_left with
  | hone =>
    intro z
    rw [← (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) Z).symm_apply_apply z,
      tensorEquivLeftRegular_one]
    exact hN _
  | hadd a b ha hb => intro z; simp only [map_add, add_tmul]; exact N.add_mem (ha z) (hb z)
  | hsmul r a ha =>
    intro z
    simp only [map_smul, ← smul_tmul']
    exact N.smul_mem r (ha z)
  | hι x a ha =>
    intro z
    have e : (LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K x * a)
        ⊗ₜ[K] z = ⁅x, (LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm a ⊗ₜ[K] z⁆ := by
      simp only [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, trivial_lie_zero, tmul_zero,
        add_zero]
      rfl
    rw [e]
    change (tensorEquivLeftRegular P Λ).toLieModuleHom ⁅x, _⁆ ∈ N
    rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie]
    exact N.lie_mem (ha z)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorSubspaceMap_injective
statement:
theorem tensorSubspaceMap_injective (F : Submodule K Z) :
    Function.Injective (tensorSubspaceMap P Λ F)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorEquivLeftRegular P Λ).injective.comp
  apply TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat
  · exact Function.injective_id
  · exact (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) Z).symm.injective.comp
      (F.subtype_injective.comp (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) F).injective)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorSubspace_mono
statement: theorem tensorSubspace_mono : Monotone (tensorSubspace (Z := Z) P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro F G h t ht
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := ht
  induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul u z =>
    refine ⟨u ⊗ₜ[K] (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) G).symm
      ⟨(TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) F z).val,
        h (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) F z).property⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [tensorSubspaceMap, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, TensorProduct.LieModule.map_tmul]
    rfl
  | add s t hs ht =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact (tensorSubspace P Λ G).add_mem hs ht

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.tensorSubspace_top
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorSubspace_top : tensorSubspace (Z := Z) P Λ ⊤ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_top_of_hwv_tmul_mem
  intro z
  refine ⟨(LeftRegular.equiv K (nNeg P)).symm 1 ⊗ₜ[K]
    (TrivialLieModule.equiv K (nNeg P) (⊤ : Submodule K Z)).symm ⟨z, trivial⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [tensorSubspaceMap, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, TensorProduct.LieModule.map_tmul]
  exact tensorEquivLeftRegular_one P Λ z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_shortExact_of_lieSubmodule
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_of_lieSubmodule {U U' : Type*} [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra U] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra U] [AddCommGroup U']
    [Module K U'] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra U'] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra U']
    {S T : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 W} (hS : S ≤ T) (eS : U ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ S)
    (eQ : U' ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S)) (e : Y ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T) :
    ∃ (f : U →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) (g : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ U'), Function.Injective f ∧ Function.Surjective g ∧
      ∀ y, g y = 0 ↔ ∃ u, f u = y
proof:
:= by
  let qT : T →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S) :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S).comp T.incl)
      (fun t ↦ (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mpr ⟨t, t.2, rfl⟩)
  let f : U →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y :=
    e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp ((LieSubmodule.inclusion hS).comp eS.toLieModuleHom)
  let g : Y →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ U' := eQ.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (qT.comp e.toLieModuleHom)
  refine ⟨f, g, fun u u' huu ↦ ?_, fun u' ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ⟨fun hy ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have h1 := congrArg e huu
    simp only [f, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
      LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h1
    exact eS.injective (LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective hS h1)
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hte⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (eQ u').2
    refine ⟨e.symm ⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [g, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
      LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    exact Subtype.ext hte
  · have h1 : qT (e y) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg eQ hy
      simp only [g, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
        LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] at this
      exact this
    have h2 : (e y).1 ∈ S := (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp (congrArg Subtype.val h1)
    refine ⟨eS.symm ⟨(e y).1, h2⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [f, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
      LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact e.symm_apply_eq.mpr (Subtype.ext rfl)
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    have h1 : qT (LieSubmodule.inclusion hS (eS u)) = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (eS u).2)
    simp only [g, f, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
      LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, h1, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.subsingleton_tensorProduct_left
statement: theorem subsingleton_tensorProduct_left [Subsingleton V] : Subsingleton (V ⊗[K] Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y ↦ ?_⟩
  have h0 : ∀ t : V ⊗[K] Z, t = 0 := fun t ↦ by
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a b => rw [Subsingleton.elim a 0, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [ha, hb, add_zero]
  rw [h0 x, h0 y]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.subsingleton_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem subsingleton_centralTranslation [Subsingleton V] (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Subsingleton (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V)
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (centralBlock P V χ₁) := inferInstance
  have : Subsingleton (centralBlock P V χ₁ ⊗[K] Z) := subsingleton_tensorProduct_left
  exact inferInstance

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.wallCrossing_verma_shortExact
statement:
theorem wallCrossing_verma_shortExact {lam μ ν ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (μ - lam) = ν')
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))) :
    ∃ (f : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
        (w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (centralCharacter P lam) X)
      (g : centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (centralCharacter P lam) X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
        VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)),
      Function.Injective f ∧ Function.Surjective g ∧ ∀ y, g y = 0 ↔ ∃ u, f u = y
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  
  obtain ⟨e₁⟩ := translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hz' hzν' w
  let eXM := eX.trans e₁.symm
  
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸
      centralBlock_verma P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
  let e := (centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
    (centralCharacter P lam) eXM).trans (centralBlockEquiv P (rTensorEquiv P
      (IrreducibleModule P ν) (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hMχ)) (centralCharacter P lam))
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS, ⟨eS⟩, ⟨eQ⟩⟩ := translation_verma_shortExact_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hν hz
    hzν hv hμα hwall hlamα hw
  exact exists_shortExact_of_lieSubmodule P hS eS eQ e

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.wallCrossing_irreducible_of_isPosRoot
statement:
theorem wallCrossing_irreducible_of_isPosRoot {lam μ ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (μ - lam) = ν')
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
    (ν : Dual K H) :
    Nonempty (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := (translation_irreducible_wall P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν' hz' hzν' hv hμα hwall hlamα
    hw hwint w).1 rfl
  exact ⟨centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν) _ _ (eX.trans e.symm)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.wallCrossing_irreducible_of_not_isPosRoot
statement:
theorem wallCrossing_irreducible_of_not_isPosRoot {lam μ ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (μ - lam) = ν')
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : ¬P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X]
    (eX : X ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (IrreducibleModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
    (ν : Dual K H) :
    Subsingleton (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) X)
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set s := P.reflectionOf hA' v i with hs
  have hint := sub_rho_integral P hA hν' hz' hzν'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hint v i).mpr ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hμα⟩
  change P.corootPairing _ (lam + P.rho) v i = n at hn
  have hn0 : n < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hlam v i hv n hn)
    (by rintro rfl; exact hlamα (by simp [hn]))
  
  have hss : s * s = 1 := reflectionOf_mul_self v i
  have hw' : P.IsPosRoot hA' ((w * s) * v) i := by
    have hsv : s * v = v * (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i := by
      have hsimp : (⟨P.reflection hA' i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i⟩ : P.weylGroup hA') =
          (P.coxeterSystem hA').simple i := by
        ext1
        simp
      rw [hs, reflectionOf, ← hsimp]
      group
    rw [mul_assoc, hsv, ← mul_assoc]
    exact (isPosRoot_or (w * v) i).resolve_left hw
  have hww : (w * s) * s = w := by rw [mul_assoc, hss, mul_one]
  have hnotU := not_upperClosureCondition_of_wall hA hμα hn0 hn hw'
  rw [hww] at hnotU
  have hsub := translation_irreducible_of_not_memUpperClosure_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ
    hfacet hν' hz' hzν' w hwint (fun hU ↦ hnotU ((memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant
      hA hlam hμ hint hfacet w).mp hU))
  have : Subsingleton X := @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ eX.toEquiv hsub
  exact subsingleton_centralTranslation P _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing
statement:
lemma symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (v : P.weylGroup hA)
    (x : Dual K H) (i : ι) :
    (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).symm x (P.coroot i) = P.corootPairing hA x v i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} :
    P.IsPosRoot hA v i ↔ (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent, P.apply_root_mem_posWeights_iff hA]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
statement:
theorem exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition_of_integral [FiniteDimensional K H]
    {a b : Dual K H} (hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (a - b) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    {w w' : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hU : P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val a) (w.val b))
    (hb' : w'.val b = w.val b) :
    ∃ c : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ c ∧ w'.val a - w.val a = P.rootOf c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hort : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0 →
        ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧ P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n := by
    intro v i hv hb0
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab v i).mpr
      ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hb0⟩
    exact ⟨n, ha v i hv n hn, hn⟩
  obtain ⟨w₁, u₁, rfl, hu₁b, hpos⟩ := exists_mul_eq_isPosRoot_of_orth (P := P) b w
  have hu₁a : (u₁ : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a = a := by
    refine apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_of_orth hF hab hort hu₁b fun v i hv hb0 ↦ ?_
    have hpw : ((w₁ * v : P.weylGroup _) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∈
        P.posWeights := isPosRoot_iff_mem_posWeights.mp (hpos v i hv hb0)
    have hwb : ((w₁ * v : P.weylGroup _) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).symm
        ((w₁ * u₁ : P.weylGroup _).val b) (P.coroot i) = 0 := by
      rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing]
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hu₁b, corootPairing_apply, ← mul_assoc,
        _root_.inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
      exact hb0
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hU _ (w₁ * v).2 i hpw hwb
    rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing] at hn
    change P.corootPairing _ (((w₁ * u₁ : P.weylGroup _) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) _ i = _
      at hn
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, corootPairing_apply, ← mul_assoc,
      _root_.inv_mul_cancel, one_mul] at hn
    exact ⟨-(n : ℤ), by omega, by rw [hn]; push_cast; ring⟩
  have hvb : ((w₁⁻¹ * w' : P.weylGroup _) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b := by
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    change ((w₁⁻¹ : P.weylGroup _) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (w'.val b) = b
    rw [hb', Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, inv_apply_apply, hu₁b]
  have hx := apply_sub_mem_orthPosRootCone hF hort hvb
  
  have hmap : ∀ x ∈ P.orthPosRootCone hF.isGeneralizedCartan b, ∃ c : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ c ∧
      (w₁ : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x = P.rootOf c := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨v, i, ⟨hv, hb0⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := hpos v i hv hb0
      exact ⟨k, hk, by rw [← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul]; exact hk'⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp⟩
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨c₁, h₁, e₁⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨c₂, h₂, e₂⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨c₁ + c₂, add_nonneg h₁ h₂, by rw [map_add, e₁, e₂, map_add]⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hce⟩ := hmap _ hx
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  rw [← hce]
  simp only [map_sub, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, apply_inv_apply, hu₁a]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_upperClosureCondition_of_integral
statement:
theorem exists_upperClosureCondition_of_integral {a b : Dual K H}
    (hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (a - b) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a) :
    ∃ w'' : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan,
      w'' ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a ∧ w''.val b = w.val b ∧
      P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w''.val a) (w.val b) ∧
      Relation.ReflTransGen (P.WallStep hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val b)) (w.val a)
        (w''.val a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices H : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a, ∀ c : ι → ℤ,
      0 ≤ c → (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a = P.rootOf c → (∑ j, c j).toNat = N →
      ∃ w'' : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan,
        w'' ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a ∧ w''.val b = w.val b ∧
        P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w''.val a) (w.val b) ∧
        Relation.ReflTransGen (P.WallStep hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val b)) (w.val a)
          (w''.val a) by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hce⟩ := exists_nonneg_apply_sub_eq_rootOf hF ha hw
    exact H _ w hw c hc hce rfl
  intro N
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ N ih =>
  intro w hw c hc hce hN
  by_cases hU : P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val a) (w.val b)
  · exact ⟨w, hw, rfl, hU, .refl⟩
  unfold UpperClosureCondition at hU
  push Not at hU
  obtain ⟨v, hv, i, hpos, hvb, hva⟩ := hU
  set u : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan := ⟨v, hv⟩ with hu
  
  have hint : ∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val a) u i = z := by
    have h1 : P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan b (w⁻¹ * u) i := ⟨0, by
      change P.corootPairing _ b (w⁻¹ * u) i = _
      rw [← corootPairing_apply, Int.cast_zero]
      exact hvb⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab _ i).mpr h1
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    rw [corootPairing_apply]
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hint
  have hz0 : 0 < z := by
    by_contra hle
    push Not at hle
    apply hva (-z).toNat
    rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing (v := u), hz]
    have h' : (((-z).toNat : ℕ) : K) = ((-z : ℤ) : K) := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ -z by omega)
    rw [h']
    push_cast
    ring
  set n := z.toNat with hn
  have hnz : (n : K) = z := by exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz0.le
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  set s := P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i
  have hsb : (s * w).val b = w.val b := by
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply',
      ← symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing (v := u)]
    change (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - v.symm (w.val b) (P.coroot i) • _ = _
    rw [hvb, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hsa : (s * w).val a = w.val a - n • v (P.root i) := by
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', hz, ← hnz,
      Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  have hstep : P.WallStep hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val b) (w.val a) ((s * w).val a) :=
    ⟨v, hv, i, n, hpos, hn0, hvb, by rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing (v := u), hz, ← hnz],
      hsa⟩
  
  have hWa : P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val a) =
      P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a := by
    refine P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ fun j ↦ ?_
    rw [show w.val a = (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a from rfl, hce]
    exact P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice c) j
  have hsw : s * w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan a := by
    refine mul_mem ?_ hw
    rw [← hWa]
    exact (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff _ u i).mpr ⟨z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨c', hc', hce'⟩ := exists_nonneg_apply_sub_eq_rootOf hF ha hsw
  obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁, hk₁e⟩ := hpos
  have hcc' : c' = c - n • k₁ := P.rootOf_injective (by
    rw [map_sub, map_nsmul, ← hce, ← hce']
    rw [show ((s * w : P.weylGroup _) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a = (s * w).val a from rfl, hsa,
      hk₁e]
    abel)
  have hlt : (∑ j, c' j).toNat < N := by
    have h1 := KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_pos_of_mem_posCone hk₁
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, c' j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hc' j
    have h3 : 0 < (n : ℤ) * ∑ j, k₁ j := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn0) h1
    have h4 : ∑ j, c' j = ∑ j, c j - (n : ℤ) * ∑ j, k₁ j := by
      rw [hcc', Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by simp
    omega
  obtain ⟨w'', hw'', hw''b, hw''U, hchain⟩ := ih _ hlt (s * w) hsw c' hc' hce' rfl
  rw [hsb] at hw''b hw''U hchain
  exact ⟨w'', hw'', hw''b, hw''U, .head hstep hchain⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.natCast_toNat'
statement: private lemma natCast_toNat' {z : ℤ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) : ((z.toNat : ℕ) : K) = (z : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_natCast (R := K), Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz]

name: Matrix.Realization.memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff_of_isAntidominant {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, ((lam + P.rho) - (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (w : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    P.MemUpperClosure hF.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
        (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ↔
      P.UpperClosureCondition hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val (lam + P.rho))
        (w.val (μ + P.rho))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set a := lam + P.rho
  set b := μ + P.rho
  
  have key : ∀ v ∈ P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan, ∀ i,
      ((¬∃ z : ℤ, v.symm (w.val a) (P.coroot i) = z) ∧
        (¬∃ z : ℤ, v.symm (w.val b) (P.coroot i) = z)) ∨
      ∃ sa sb : ℤ, 0 ≤ sa ∧ 0 ≤ sb ∧ (sa = 0 → sb = 0) ∧ ∃ ε : ℤ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧
        v.symm (w.val a) (P.coroot i) = ((-ε * sa : ℤ) : K) ∧
        v.symm (w.val b) (P.coroot i) = ((-ε * sb : ℤ) : K) := by
    intro v hv i
    set u : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan := w⁻¹ * ⟨v, hv⟩
    have hA' : ∀ x : Dual K H, v.symm (w.val x) (P.coroot i) =
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan x u i := fun x ↦ by
      rw [symm_apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing (v := ⟨v, hv⟩)]
      exact corootPairing_apply w _ x i
    simp only [hA']
    by_cases hbint : ∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b u i = z
    · obtain ⟨zb, hzb⟩ := hbint
      obtain ⟨za, hza⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab u i).mpr ⟨zb, hzb⟩
      change P.corootPairing _ a u i = _ at hza
      right
      rcases isPosRoot_or u i with hp | hp
      · have h1 := hlam u i hp za hza
        have h2 := hμ u i hp zb hzb
        have hfz : za = 0 → zb = 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
          have := hfacet u i hp (by rw [hza, h0, Int.cast_zero])
          rw [hzb] at this
          exact_mod_cast this
        refine ⟨-za, -zb, by omega, by omega, fun h0 ↦ by have := hfz (by omega); omega, 1,
          Or.inl rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hza]; push_cast; ring
        · rw [hzb]; push_cast; ring
      · have hma := corootPairing_mul_simple a u i
        have hmb := corootPairing_mul_simple b u i
        rw [hza] at hma
        rw [hzb] at hmb
        have h1 := hlam _ i hp (-za) (by rw [hma]; push_cast; ring)
        have h2 := hμ _ i hp (-zb) (by rw [hmb]; push_cast; ring)
        have hfz : za = 0 → zb = 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
          have := hfacet _ i hp (by rw [hma, h0]; push_cast; ring)
          rw [hmb] at this
          have h' : ((zb : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by linear_combination -this
          exact_mod_cast h'
        refine ⟨za, zb, by omega, by omega, hfz, -1, Or.inr rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hza]; push_cast; ring
        · rw [hzb]; push_cast; ring
    · left
      refine ⟨fun ⟨za, hza⟩ ↦ hbint ?_, hbint⟩
      have hab' : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (b - a) (P.coroot j) = n := fun j ↦ by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hab j
        exact ⟨-n, by rw [← neg_sub, LinearMap.neg_apply, hn, Int.cast_neg]⟩
      exact (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab' u i).mpr ⟨za, hza⟩
  simp only [MemUpperClosure, UpperClosureCondition, weylDot_add_rho]
  constructor
  · intro hU v hv i hpos hb0
    rcases key v hv i with ⟨-, hbn⟩ | ⟨sa, sb, hsa, hsb, hab0, ε, hε, h1, h2⟩
    · exact absurd ⟨0, by rw [hb0, Int.cast_zero]⟩ hbn
    obtain ⟨-, hU2, -⟩ := hU v hv i hpos
    rw [h2] at hb0
    have hb0' : -ε * sb = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb0
    rcases hε with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨sa.toNat, by rw [h1, natCast_toNat' hsa]; push_cast; ring⟩
    · by_cases hsa0 : sa = 0
      · exact ⟨0, by rw [h1, hsa0]; simp⟩
      · obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := hU2 ⟨sa.toNat, by omega, by
          rw [h1, natCast_toNat' hsa]; push_cast; ring⟩
        rw [h2] at hm'
        have : - -1 * sb = (m : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hm'
        exfalso
        omega
  · intro hC v hv i hpos
    rcases key v hv i with ⟨han, hbn⟩ | ⟨sa, sb, hsa, hsb, hab0, ε, hε, h1, h2⟩
    · refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ absurd ⟨0, by rw [h0, Int.cast_zero]⟩ han, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨n, -, hn⟩
        exact absurd ⟨n, by rw [hn, Int.cast_natCast]⟩ han
      · rintro ⟨n, -, hn⟩
        exact absurd ⟨-(n : ℤ), by rw [hn]; push_cast; ring⟩ han
    have hC' := hC v hv i hpos
    refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h1] at h0
      have h0' : -ε * sa = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h0
      have : sa = 0 := by rcases hε with rfl | rfl <;> omega
      rw [h2, hab0 this, mul_zero, Int.cast_zero]
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩
      rw [h1] at hn'
      have hn'' : -ε * sa = (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn'
      rcases hε with rfl | rfl
      · exfalso
        omega
      · have hsb0 : sb ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
          obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hC' (by rw [h2, h0, mul_zero, Int.cast_zero])
          rw [h1] at hq
          have : - -1 * sa = -(q : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
          omega
        exact ⟨sb.toNat, by omega, by rw [h2, natCast_toNat' hsb]; push_cast; ring⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩
      rw [h1] at hn'
      have hn'' : -ε * sa = -(n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn'
      rcases hε with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨sb.toNat, by rw [h2, natCast_toNat' hsb]; push_cast; ring⟩
      · exfalso
        omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_setOf_mem_cone_and_mem_cone
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_mem_cone_and_mem_cone (Λ ξ : Dual K H) :
    {μ | μ ∈ cone P Λ ∧ ξ ∈ cone P μ}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∃ c : ι → ℤ, P.rootOf c = Λ - ξ
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
    refine ((Set.Finite.pi (t := fun i ↦ Set.Icc 0 (c i)) fun i ↦ Set.finite_Icc _ _).image
      fun k ↦ Λ - P.rootOf k).subset ?_
    rintro μ ⟨⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, ⟨l, hl, hξ⟩⟩
    have hkl : k + l = c := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_add, hc, hξ]; abel)
    refine ⟨k, fun i _ ↦ ⟨hk i, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [← hkl, Pi.add_apply]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (hl i)
  · refine Set.finite_empty.subset ?_
    rintro μ ⟨⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, ⟨l, hl, hξ⟩⟩
    exact h ⟨k + l, by rw [map_add, hξ]; abel⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_sumIrreducibleCharacter
statement:
theorem coeffAt_sumIrreducibleCharacter (c : P.CharacterRing ℤ) (ξ : Dual K H) :
    (sumIrreducibleCharacter P c).coeffAt ξ =
      ∑ᶠ μ, c.coeffAt μ * finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sumIrreducibleCharacter, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, coeffAt,
    SummableFamily.coeff_hsum]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sumIrreducibleCharacter_exp
statement:
theorem sumIrreducibleCharacter_exp (μ : Dual K H) :
    sumIrreducibleCharacter P (exp P ℤ μ) = (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ).character
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ξ
  rw [coeffAt_sumIrreducibleCharacter, finsum_eq_single _ μ fun ν hν ↦ by
    simp [coeff_exp, hν], coeff_exp_self, one_mul, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sumIrreducibleCharacter_injective
statement:
theorem sumIrreducibleCharacter_injective :
    Function.Injective (sumIrreducibleCharacter P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro c hc
  by_contra hc0
  have hne : c.support.Nonempty := HahnSeries.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hc0
  obtain ⟨μ₀', -, hmin⟩ := c.isPWO_support.exists_le_minimal hne.some_mem
  set μ₀ := ofWeightOrd P μ₀' with hμ₀
  have h0 := congrArg (fun d ↦ d.coeffAt μ₀) hc
  simp only [coeffAt_sumIrreducibleCharacter, HahnSeries.coeff_zero] at h0
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ μ₀ fun μ hμ ↦ ?_] at h0
  · rw [IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at h0
    exact hmin.1 h0
  · by_contra hne0
    have h1 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne0
    have h2 := IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero
      (by exact_mod_cast right_ne_zero_of_mul hne0)
    have hle : toWeightOrd P μ ≤ μ₀' :=
      (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr h2
    exact hμ (congrArg (ofWeightOrd P) (le_antisymm hle (hmin.2 h1 hle)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.count_mul_finrank_eq
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ) = 0
  · rw [h, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  · rw [hV.count_factorWeights_eq_multiplicity
      (IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero h) hl]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finite_support_multiplicity_mul
statement:
lemma finite_support_multiplicity_mul (ξ : Dual K H) :
    (Function.support fun μ ↦
      hV.multiplicity μ * finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries ξ
  refine (factorWeights l).toFinset.finite_toSet.subset fun μ hμ ↦ ?_
  rw [Function.mem_support, ← hV.count_mul_finrank_eq hl] at hμ
  exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.count_pos_iff.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (left_ne_zero_of_mul hμ)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum (ξ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpace P V ξ) =
      ∑ᶠ μ, hV.multiplicity μ * finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries ξ
  rw [hl.finrank_weightSpace_eq hV (mem_cone_self ξ), Finset.sum_list_map_count,
    finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := (factorWeights l).toFinset) fun μ hμ ↦ ?_]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul, hV.count_mul_finrank_eq hl]
  · rw [Function.mem_support, ← hV.count_mul_finrank_eq hl] at hμ
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.count_pos_iff.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (left_ne_zero_of_mul hμ)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_le_finrank
statement:
theorem multiplicity_le_finrank (μ : Dual K H) :
    hV.multiplicity μ ≤ finrank K (weightSpace P V μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hV.finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum μ]
  refine le_trans ?_ (single_le_finsum μ (hV.finite_support_multiplicity_mul μ)
    fun _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
  rw [IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : hV.multiplicity μ ≠ 0) : weightSpace P V μ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := hV.multiplicity_le_finrank μ
  rw [h, finrank_bot] at this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeffAt_multiplicities (μ : Dual K H) :
    hV.multiplicities.coeffAt μ = hV.multiplicity μ
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter
statement:
theorem character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter :
    hV.character = sumIrreducibleCharacter P hV.multiplicities
proof:
:= by
  ext ξ
  rw [coeffAt_sumIrreducibleCharacter, coeffAt_character, finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum hV ξ]
  have := (Nat.castAddMonoidHom ℤ).map_finsum (hV.finite_support_multiplicity_mul ξ)
  simp only [Nat.coe_castAddMonoidHom, Nat.cast_mul] at this
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_iff
statement:
theorem character_eq_iff (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hW : IsCategoryO P W) :
    hV.character = hW.character ↔ ∀ μ, hV.multiplicity μ = hW.multiplicity μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter,
    sumIrreducibleCharacter_injective.eq_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h μ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ CharacterRing.ext fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.coeffAt μ) h
    simp only [coeffAt_multiplicities, Nat.cast_inj] at this
    exact this
  · simp [h μ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_add (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) (μ : Dual K H) :
    hV.multiplicity μ =
      (hV.lieSubmodule N).multiplicity μ + (hV.quotient N).multiplicity μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := hV.character_eq_add N (hV.lieSubmodule N) (hV.quotient N)
  rw [character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter,
    character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, ← map_add] at h
  have := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.coeffAt μ) (sumIrreducibleCharacter_injective h)
  simp only [coeffAt_multiplicities, coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_add] at this
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.multiplicities_eq
statement: theorem multiplicities_eq (Λ : Dual K H) : (isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicities = exp P ℤ Λ
proof:
:=
  sumIrreducibleCharacter_injective (by
    rw [← IsCategoryO.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter, sumIrreducibleCharacter_exp])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq (Λ μ : Dual K H) :
    (isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity μ = if μ = Λ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.coeffAt μ) (multiplicities_eq (P := P) Λ)
  simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities, coeff_exp] at this
  split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> exact_mod_cast this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (h : (isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity μ ≠ 0) : μ ∈ cone P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot
    ((isCategoryO P Λ).weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero h)
  exact exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id hx hx0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.multiplicity_self
statement: theorem multiplicity_self (Λ : Dual K H) : (isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity Λ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isCategoryO P Λ).finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum Λ
  rw [finrank_weightSpace_self, finsum_eq_single _ Λ fun μ hμ ↦ ?_,
    IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self, mul_one] at h
  · exact h.symm
  · by_contra hne
    have h1 := mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (left_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
    have h2 := IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero
      (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
    refine hμ (congrArg (ofWeightOrd P) (le_antisymm (a := toWeightOrd P μ)
      ((toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr h2)
      ((toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr h1)))

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd (μ : Dual K H) :
    ofWeightOrd P (toWeightOrd P μ) = μ
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_ofWeightOrd
statement:
@[simp] lemma toWeightOrd_ofWeightOrd (μ : P.WeightOrd) :
    toWeightOrd P (ofWeightOrd P μ) = μ
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma toWeightOrd_symm : (toWeightOrd P).symm = ofWeightOrd P
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma ofWeightOrd_symm : (ofWeightOrd P).symm = toWeightOrd P
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.le_iff
statement:
lemma le_iff {μ ν : P.WeightOrd} :
    μ ≤ ν ↔ ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ofWeightOrd P μ - ofWeightOrd P ν = P.rootOf k
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_iff
statement:
lemma toWeightOrd_le_iff {μ ν : Dual K H} :
    toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P ν ↔ ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ μ - ν = P.rootOf k
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub
statement:
lemma toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub {Λ μ : Dual K H} :
    toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ ↔ ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ μ = Λ - P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  rw [toWeightOrd_le_iff]
  refine exists_congr fun k ↦ and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ?_
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [← h]; abel
  · rw [h]; abel

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.isPWO_Ici
statement: theorem isPWO_Ici (Λ : P.WeightOrd) : (Set.Ici Λ).IsPWO
proof:
:= by
  let g : (ι → ℕ) → P.WeightOrd := fun k ↦ Λ - toWeightOrd P (P.rootOf fun i ↦ (k i : ℤ))
  have hg : Monotone g := by
    intro k l hkl
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ (l i : ℤ) - k i, fun i ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hkl i
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_nonneg]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · simp only [g, ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left, ← map_sub]
      congr 1
  have hpwo : (Set.univ : Set (ι → ℕ)).IsPWO := by
    rw [← Set.pi_univ]
    exact Set.IsPWO.pi fun _ ↦ Set.isPWO_of_wellQuasiOrderedLE _
  refine (hpwo.image_of_monotone hg).mono ?_
  rintro μ ⟨k, hk, hΛμ⟩
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ (k i).toNat, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  have hk' : (fun i ↦ ((k i).toNat : ℤ)) = k := funext fun i ↦ Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hk i)
  simp only [g, hk']
  apply (ofWeightOrd P).injective
  rw [map_sub, ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd, ← hΛμ, sub_sub_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.WeightOrd.isPWO_iff
statement:
theorem isPWO_iff {s : Set P.WeightOrd} :
    s.IsPWO ↔ ∃ t : Finset (Dual K H), ∀ μ ∈ s, ∃ Λ ∈ t,
      ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ofWeightOrd P μ = Λ - P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hs
    have hfin : {b | Minimal (· ∈ s) b}.Finite :=
      (setOfPred_minimal_antichain _).finite_of_partiallyWellOrderedOn
        (hs.mono fun _ hb ↦ hb.1)
    refine ⟨hfin.toFinset.image (ofWeightOrd P), fun μ hμ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hbμ, hb⟩ := hs.exists_le_minimal hμ
    refine ⟨ofWeightOrd P b, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hb), ?_⟩
    rw [← toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub]
    exact hbμ
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    refine ((Finset.isPWO_bUnion t (f := fun Λ ↦ Set.Ici (toWeightOrd P Λ))).mpr
      fun Λ _ ↦ isPWO_Ici P _).mono fun μ hμ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hμΛ⟩ := ht μ hμ
    exact Set.mem_biUnion hΛ ((toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr hμΛ)

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.exists_finset
statement:
lemma exists_finset [Zero R] (c : P.CharacterRing R) : ∃ t : Finset (Dual K H), ∀ μ,
    c.coeffAt μ ≠ 0 → ∃ Λ ∈ t, ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ μ = Λ - P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (isPWO_iff P).mp c.isPWO_support
  exact ⟨t, fun μ hμ ↦ ht (toWeightOrd P μ) hμ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext [Zero R] {c d : P.CharacterRing R} (h : ∀ μ, c.coeffAt μ = d.coeffAt μ) : c = d
proof:
:=
  HahnSeries.ext (funext fun μ ↦ h (ofWeightOrd P μ))

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.coeff_ofFun
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_ofFun [Zero R] (c : Dual K H → R) (hc) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (ofFun P c hc).coeffAt μ = c μ
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.coeff_exp
statement:
lemma coeff_exp [Zero R] [One R] (μ ν : Dual K H) :
    (exp P R μ).coeffAt ν = if ν = μ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeffAt, exp, HahnSeries.coeff_single]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.coeff_exp_self
statement: @[simp] lemma coeff_exp_self [Zero R] [One R] (μ : Dual K H) : (exp P R μ).coeffAt μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeffAt, exp]

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.exp_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_zero : exp P R 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [exp]

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.exp_add
statement: lemma exp_add (μ ν : Dual K H) : exp P R (μ + ν) = exp P R μ * exp P R ν
proof:
:= by
  simp [exp, HahnSeries.single_mul_single]

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.coeff_exp_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_exp_mul (Λ : Dual K H) (c : P.CharacterRing R) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (exp P R Λ * c).coeffAt μ = c.coeffAt (μ - Λ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeffAt, exp]
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, one_mul, map_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.coeff_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_mul (c d : P.CharacterRing R) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (c * d).coeffAt μ = ∑ᶠ ν, c.coeffAt ν * d.coeffAt (μ - ν)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s := Finset.antidiagonal c.isPWO_support d.isPWO_support (toWeightOrd P μ)
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := s.image fun x ↦ ofWeightOrd P x.1), coeffAt,
    HahnSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_image]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨-, -, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hx
    have : μ - ofWeightOrd P x.1 = ofWeightOrd P x.2 := by
      rw [← ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd P μ, ← hx, map_add, add_sub_cancel_left]
    simp only [coeffAt, this, toWeightOrd_ofWeightOrd]
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    obtain ⟨-, -, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hx
    obtain ⟨-, -, hy⟩ := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hy
    have h1 : x.1 = y.1 := hxy
    refine Prod.ext h1 ?_
    rw [← hy, h1] at hx
    exact add_left_cancel hx
  · intro ν hν
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hν
    refine Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(toWeightOrd P ν, toWeightOrd P (μ - ν)),
      Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr ⟨left_ne_zero_of_mul hν, right_ne_zero_of_mul hν, ?_⟩, rfl⟩)
    rw [← map_add, add_sub_cancel]

name: Multiset.eq_of_forall_sum_map_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_forall_sum_map_eq {α β : Type*} [PartialOrder β] {o : α → β}
    (ho : Function.Injective o) {w : α → α → ℕ} (hw₁ : ∀ a, w a a = 1)
    (hw : ∀ a b, w a b ≠ 0 → o b ≤ o a) (s s' : Multiset α)
    (h : ∀ b, (s.map (w · b)).sum = (s'.map (w · b)).sum) : s = s'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Multiset.strongInductionOn generalizing s' with
  | ih s ih =>
  by_cases h0 : s + s' = 0
  · rw [add_eq_zero] at h0
    rw [h0.1, h0.2]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (s + s').toFinset.exists_maximalFor o
    (Multiset.toFinset_nonempty.mpr h0)
  have ha' : a ∈ s + s' := Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp ha.1
  have hmax : ∀ x ∈ s + s', o a ≤ o x → x = a := fun x hx hle ↦
    ho (le_antisymm (ha.2 (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hx) hle) hle)
  have hsum : ∀ t, t ≤ s + s' → (t.map (w · a)).sum = t.count a := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Multiset.sum_map_eq_nsmul_single a fun x hxa hx ↦ ?_, hw₁, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    by_contra hne
    exact hxa (hmax x (Multiset.mem_of_le ht hx) (hw x a hne))
  have hc : s.count a = s'.count a := by
    rw [← hsum s (Multiset.le_add_right s s'), ← hsum s' (Multiset.le_add_left s' s), h a]
  have has : a ∈ s := by
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp ha' with h' | h'
    · exact h'
    · rw [← Multiset.count_pos, hc]
      exact Multiset.count_pos.mpr h'
  have has' : a ∈ s' := by
    rw [← Multiset.count_pos, ← hc]
    exact Multiset.count_pos.mpr has
  rw [← Multiset.cons_erase has, ← Multiset.cons_erase has',
    ih _ (Multiset.erase_lt.mpr has) (s'.erase a) fun b ↦ ?_]
  have hb := h b
  rw [← Multiset.cons_erase has, ← Multiset.cons_erase has', Multiset.map_cons,
    Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.sum_cons] at hb
  omega

name: LieModuleHom.coe_retractCompl_apply
statement:
lemma coe_retractCompl_apply (hrs : r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id) (v : V) :
    (retractCompl hrs v : V) = v - s (r v)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.retractCompl_apply_coe
statement:
lemma retractCompl_apply_coe (hrs : r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id) (c : r.ker) :
    retractCompl hrs (c : V) = c
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [coe_retractCompl_apply, LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp c.2, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: LieModuleHom.retractCompl_apply_apply
statement:
lemma retractCompl_apply_apply (hrs : r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id) (x : X) :
    retractCompl hrs (s x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [coe_retractCompl_apply, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply r s, hrs, LieModuleHom.id_apply,
    sub_self]
  rfl

name: LieModuleHom.apply_add_retractCompl
statement:
lemma apply_add_retractCompl (hrs : r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id) (v : V) :
    s (r v) + (retractCompl hrs v : V) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_retractCompl_apply, add_sub_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.finrank_inf_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.finrank_inf_weightSpaceOfMap (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X} {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s)
    (ν : Dual K H) :
    finrank K ↥(N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν) =
      (s.map fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => simp
  | @step N N' s μ _ hle he ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    rw [finrank_inf_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_add hX hle ν, ih, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons,
      ← finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule P, finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv P e.symm ν,
      add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.ker
statement:
theorem ker {X : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X] (hV : IsFGProjectiveO P V)
    {s : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V} {r : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X} (hrs : r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id) :
    IsFGProjectiveO P r.ker
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hq : (LieModuleHom.retractCompl hrs).comp r.ker.incl = LieModuleHom.id :=
    LieModuleHom.ext fun c ↦ LieModuleHom.retractCompl_apply_coe hrs c
  refine ⟨hV.isProjectiveO.of_retract _ _ hq, hV.isCategoryO.lieSubmodule _, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hV.fg
  refine ⟨S.image (LieModuleHom.retractCompl hrs), ?_⟩
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro c -
  have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set V) ≤ (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤
      ((S.image (LieModuleHom.retractCompl hrs) : Finset r.ker) : Set r.ker)).comap
        (LieModuleHom.retractCompl hrs) := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    intro x hx
    exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx))
  have := hle (hS ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top (c : V))
  rwa [LieSubmodule.mem_comap, LieModuleHom.retractCompl_apply_coe] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom (hV : IsFGProjectiveO P V) {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y] (hY : IsCategoryO P Y) :
    FiniteDimensional K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y)
proof:
:=
  hV.isCategoryO.finiteDimensional_hom P hV.fg.choose_spec hY

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.exists_retract
statement:
theorem exists_retract (hV : IsFGProjectiveO P V) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (φ : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    ∃ (s : ProjectiveCover P hA Λ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) (r : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ ProjectiveCover P hA Λ),
      r.comp s = LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:=
  (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveCover P Λ hA).exists_retract (ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA Λ)
    hV.isProjectiveO hV.isCategoryO φ hφ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.finrank_hom_eq_add
proof:
:= by
  have := ProjectiveCover.finiteDimensional_hom P hA Λ hY
  have := (hV.ker hrs).finiteDimensional_hom hY
  rw [(LieModuleHom.homRetractEquiv hrs).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.ker_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ProjectiveCover.surjective_π P hA Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
  have h0 : r (s x) = 0 := LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp (htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top (s x))
  rw [← LieModuleHom.comp_apply r s, hrs, LieModuleHom.id_apply] at h0
  rw [h0, map_zero] at hx
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ hx.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_of_ne_zero_irreducibleModule
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P Λ
  rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
  refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top f.range).resolve_left fun h0 ↦ hf0 ?_
  ext y
  have : f y ∈ f.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
  exact this

name: LieSubmodule.strictMono_map_incl
statement:
theorem _root_.LieSubmodule.strictMono_map_incl {R L M : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] (N : LieSubmodule R L M)
    {f : LieSubmodule R L M → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    StrictMono fun N' : LieSubmodule R L N ↦ f (N'.map N.incl)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  refine hf (lt_of_le_of_ne (LieSubmodule.map_mono hab.le) fun heq ↦ hab.ne ?_)
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (heq ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hx :
      (x : M) ∈ b.map N.incl)
    rwa [Subtype.val_injective hyx] at hy
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (heq.symm ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hx :
      (x : M) ∈ a.map N.incl)
    rwa [Subtype.val_injective hyx] at hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.nonempty_equiv_of_finrank_hom_eq
statement:
theorem IsFGProjectiveO.nonempty_equiv_of_finrank_hom_eq {V V' : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [AddCommGroup V'] [Module K V']
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V'] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V']
    (hV : IsFGProjectiveO P V) (hV' : IsFGProjectiveO P V')
    (h : ∀ Λ, finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) =
      finrank K (V' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)) :
    Nonempty (V ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hV.isCategoryO.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hV.fg.choose_spec
  suffices key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (V V' : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
      [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [AddCommGroup V']
      [Module K V'] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V'] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V'],
      IsFGProjectiveO P V → IsFGProjectiveO P V' →
      (∀ Λ, finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) =
        finrank K (V' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)) →
      ∀ f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V → ℕ, StrictMono f → f ⊤ < n → Nonempty (V ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V') from
    key _ V V' hV hV' h f hf (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hn; exact absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
  intro V V' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hV hV' h f hf hn
  by_cases hVt : Nontrivial V
  · obtain ⟨Λ, φ, hφ⟩ := hV.isCategoryO.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA
      hV.fg.choose_spec
    have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ (by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hφ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
      rw [← hx, h0]; rfl)
    have := hV.finiteDimensional_hom (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ)
    have := hV'.finiteDimensional_hom (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ)
    have hpos : 0 < finrank K (V' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) := by
      rw [← h Λ]
      exact Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨φ, hφ0⟩
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ0⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp hpos
    obtain ⟨s, r, hrs⟩ := hV.exists_retract hA φ hφ
    obtain ⟨s', r', hrs'⟩ := hV'.exists_retract hA ψ
      (surjective_of_ne_zero_irreducibleModule P hψ0)
    have hC : ∀ μ, finrank K (r.ker →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) =
        finrank K (r'.ker →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) := by
      intro μ
      have h1 := hV.finrank_hom_eq_add hA hrs (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ)
      have h2 := hV'.finrank_hom_eq_add hA hrs' (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ)
      have := h μ
      omega
    have hlt : f ((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 r.ker).map r.ker.incl) < n := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.map_incl_top]
      have := hf (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (IsFGProjectiveO.ker_ne_top hA hrs))
      omega
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := ih r.ker r'.ker (hV.ker hrs) (hV'.ker hrs') hC _
      (r.ker.strictMono_map_incl hf) hlt
    exact ⟨LieModuleHom.equivOfRetract hrs hrs' e⟩
  · rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hVt
    have hV't : Subsingleton V' := by
      by_contra hcon
      rw [not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial] at hcon
      obtain ⟨Λ, φ, hφ⟩ := hV'.isCategoryO.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA
        hV'.fg.choose_spec
      have := hV'.finiteDimensional_hom (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ)
      have hpos : 0 < finrank K (V' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) :=
        Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨φ, fun h0 ↦ IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ
          (by obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hφ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ); rw [← hx, h0]; rfl)⟩
      have : Subsingleton (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) :=
        ⟨fun a b ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
      rw [← h Λ, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton] at hpos
      exact Nat.lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    exact ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective 0 ⟨fun a b _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim a b,
      fun y ↦ ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.exists_multiset
statement:
theorem IsFGProjectiveO.exists_multiset [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] {V : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] (hV : IsFGProjectiveO P V)
    {t : Dual K H → Multiset (Dual K H)}
    (ht : ∀ Λ, IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (ProjectiveCover P hA Λ)) (t Λ)) :
    ∃ d : Multiset (Dual K H),
      (∀ Λ, finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) = d.count Λ) ∧
      ∀ μ, finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ)) = (d.bind t).count μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hV.isCategoryO.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hV.fg.choose_spec
  suffices key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (V : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
      [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V],
      IsFGProjectiveO P V → ∀ f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V → ℕ, StrictMono f → f ⊤ < n →
      ∃ d : Multiset (Dual K H),
        (∀ Λ, finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ) = d.count Λ) ∧
        ∀ μ, finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ)) = (d.bind t).count μ from
    key _ V hV f hf (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hn; exact absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
  intro V _ _ _ _ hV f hf hn
  by_cases hVt : Nontrivial V
  · obtain ⟨Λ, φ, hφ⟩ := hV.isCategoryO.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA
      hV.fg.choose_spec
    obtain ⟨s, r, hrs⟩ := hV.exists_retract hA φ hφ
    have hlt : f ((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 r.ker).map r.ker.incl) < n := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.map_incl_top]
      have := hf (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (IsFGProjectiveO.ker_ne_top hA hrs))
      omega
    obtain ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂⟩ := ih r.ker (hV.ker hrs) _ (r.ker.strictMono_map_incl hf) hlt
    refine ⟨Λ ::ₘ d, fun μ ↦ ?_, fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [hV.finrank_hom_eq_add hA hrs (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ),
        ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_irreducible P Λ hA μ, hd₁ μ, Multiset.count_cons]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · have hdual := isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)
      rw [hV.finrank_hom_eq_add hA hrs hdual, hd₂ μ, Multiset.cons_bind, Multiset.count_add,
        ← (ht Λ).count_eq_finrank_hom (ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA Λ) μ]
  · rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hVt
    have hzero {Y : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y]
        [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y] :
        finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) = 0 := by
      have : Subsingleton (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) :=
        ⟨fun a b ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
      exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
    exact ⟨0, fun Λ ↦ by rw [hzero, Multiset.count_zero],
      fun μ ↦ by rw [hzero, Multiset.zero_bind, Multiset.count_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveO.nonempty_equiv_of_character_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hW : IsFGProjectiveO P V := ⟨hVproj, hV, S, hS⟩
  have hW' : IsFGProjectiveO P V' := ⟨hV'proj, hV', S', hS'⟩
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hVproj.exists_isStdFiltered P hA hV hS
  obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := hV'proj.exists_isStdFiltered P hA hV' hS'
  have hss' : s = s' := by
    refine Multiset.eq_of_forall_sum_map_eq (o := fun μ ↦ OrderDual.toDual (toWeightOrd P μ))
      (fun a b hab ↦ (toWeightOrd P).injective (OrderDual.toDual.injective hab))
      (w := fun μ ν ↦ finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν))
      (fun μ ↦ VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P μ) (fun μ ν hne ↦ ?_) s s' fun ν ↦ ?_
    · change finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν) ≠ 0 at hne
      have hne' : weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) ν ≠ ⊥ := fun h0 ↦ hne (by
        rw [h0, finrank_bot])
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne'
      exact (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
        (VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P μ LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id
          hx hx0)
    · have h1 := hs.finrank_inf_weightSpaceOfMap P hV ν
      have h2 := hs'.finrank_inf_weightSpaceOfMap P hV' ν
      have h3 := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.coeffAt ν) hch
      simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, Nat.cast_inj] at h3
      simp only [LieSubmodule.top_toSubmodule] at h1 h2
      rw [← h1, ← h2]
      convert h3 using 3 <;> exact top_inf_eq _
  
  choose t ht using fun Λ ↦ ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered P Λ hA
  obtain ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂⟩ := hW.exists_multiset P hA fun Λ ↦ (ht Λ).1
  obtain ⟨d', hd'₁, hd'₂⟩ := hW'.exists_multiset P hA fun Λ ↦ (ht Λ).1
  have hbind : d.bind t = d'.bind t := by
    ext μ
    rw [← hd₂, ← hd'₂, ← hs.count_eq_finrank_hom hV, ← hs'.count_eq_finrank_hom hV', hss']
  have hdd' : d = d' := by
    refine Multiset.eq_of_forall_sum_map_eq (o := toWeightOrd P) (toWeightOrd P).injective
      (w := fun Λ ν ↦ (t Λ).count ν) (fun Λ ↦ (ht Λ).2.1) (fun Λ ν hne ↦ ?_) d d' fun ν ↦ ?_
    · exact (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
        ((ht Λ).2.2 ν (Multiset.count_ne_zero.mp hne))
    · rw [← Multiset.count_bind, ← Multiset.count_bind, hbind]
  exact hW.nonempty_equiv_of_finrank_hom_eq P hA hW' fun Λ ↦ by rw [hd₁, hd'₁, hdd']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralTranslationMap_comp_apply
statement:
theorem centralTranslationMap_comp_apply (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (f : U →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X) (x) :
    centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (g.comp f) x =
      centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ g (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centralTranslationMap_comp]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_centralTranslationMap_mk'
statement:
theorem ker_centralTranslationMap_mk' (hX : IsCategoryO P X) (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) :
    (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)).ker =
      (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N.incl).range
proof:
:=
  (centralTranslationMap_shortExact P Z hX hZ N.incl (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)
    (LieSubmodule.injective_incl _) (by rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker, LieSubmodule.range_incl])
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) χ₁ χ₂).2.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_map_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_map_centralTranslation (hX : IsCategoryO P X) (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {N₀ N₁ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X}
    (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)) :
    Nonempty (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N₁.incl).range.map
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N₀.incl).range))
proof:
:= by
  let π : X →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X ⧸ N₀ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀
  let R := (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N₀.incl).range
  
  have hkerπ : (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ π).ker = R :=
    ker_centralTranslationMap_mk' P hX hZ χ₁ χ₂ N₀
  have hsurjπ : Function.Surjective (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ π) :=
    centralTranslationMap_surjective P hX hZ χ₁ χ₂ π (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N₀)
  let κ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift R (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ π) hkerπ.ge
  have hκ : Function.Bijective κ := by
    constructor
    · rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' R y
      rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker] at hy
      rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← hkerπ]
      exact hy
    · intro q
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hsurjπ q
      exact ⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R x, rfl⟩
  let κe := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective κ hκ
  
  let g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X ⧸ N₀ :=
    (N₁.map π).incl.comp e.toLieModuleHom
  have hg : Function.Injective g := fun a b hab ↦ e.injective (Subtype.ext hab)
  let r₀ : N₁ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N₁.map π :=
    (π.comp N₁.incl).codRestrict _ fun x ↦ LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem x.2
  have hr₀ : Function.Surjective r₀ := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp hy
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  let r : N₁ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V := e.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp r₀
  have hr : Function.Surjective r := e.symm.surjective.comp hr₀
  have hgr : g.comp r = π.comp N₁.incl := by
    ext x
    change ((e (e.symm (r₀ x))) : X ⧸ N₀) = π x
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hTg := centralTranslationMap_injective P (Z := Z) χ₁ χ₂ g hg
  have hTr := centralTranslationMap_surjective P (hX.lieSubmodule N₁) hZ χ₁ χ₂ r hr
  
  let γ := κe.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ g)
  have hγ : ∀ a, γ (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ r a) =
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N₁.incl a) := by
    intro a
    have h₁ := centralTranslationMap_comp_apply P (Z := Z) χ₁ χ₂ r g a
    have h₂ := centralTranslationMap_comp_apply P (Z := Z) χ₁ χ₂ N₁.incl π a
    have h₃ := LieModuleHom.congr_fun (congrArg (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂) hgr) a
    have h₄ : κe (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N₁.incl a)) =
        centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ π (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N₁.incl a) :=
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ _ _
    refine κe.injective ((κe.apply_symm_apply _).trans ?_)
    exact h₁.symm.trans (h₃.trans (h₂.trans h₄.symm))
  have hmem : ∀ v, γ v ∈ (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N₁.incl).range.map
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hTr v
    rw [hγ]
    exact LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem ⟨a, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (γ.codRestrict _ hmem) ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := congrArg Subtype.val hab
    simp only [LieModuleHom.codRestrict_apply, γ, LieModuleHom.comp_apply,
      LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom] at this
    exact hTg (κe.symm.injective this)
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ r a,
      Subtype.ext ((hγ a).trans ((congrArg (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' R) ha).trans hxy))⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_centralTranslationMap_bot
statement:
theorem range_centralTranslationMap_bot (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X).incl).range =
      ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have hsub (u : centralBlock P (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) χ₁) : u = 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp u.1.2))
  have h0 : ∀ y : centralBlock P (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) χ₁ ⊗[K] Z, y = 0 := by
    intro y
    induction y with
    | tmul u z => rw [hsub u, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
    | add y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [h₁, h₂, add_zero]
