  have : a = 0 := Subtype.ext (h0 _)
  rw [this, map_zero]
  exact LieSubmodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.exists_isStdFiltered_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.exists_isStdFiltered_centralTranslation (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X}
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s)
    (hfac : ∀ ν ∈ s, ∃ ν', Nonempty (VermaModule P ν' ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ (VermaModule P ν))) :
    ∃ t, IsStdFiltered P (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ N.incl).range t
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => exact ⟨0, by rw [range_centralTranslationMap_bot]; exact IsStdFiltered.bot⟩
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ ν _ h01 he ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih fun ν' hν' ↦ hfac ν' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν')
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    obtain ⟨ν', ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hfac ν (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)
    obtain ⟨e''⟩ := nonempty_equiv_map_centralTranslation P hX hZ χ₁ χ₂ e
    refine ⟨ν' ::ₘ t, ht.step ?_ ⟨e'.trans e''⟩⟩
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (LieSubmodule.inclusion h01) a, ?_⟩
    rw [← centralTranslationMap_comp_apply]
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.centralCharacter_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => simp
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ ν _ _ he ih =>
    intro ν' hν'
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hν' with rfl | hν'
    · obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
      by_contra hne
      let f : VermaModule P ν' →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ X ⧸ N₀ :=
        (N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)).incl.comp e.toLieModuleHom
      have hf : Function.Injective f := fun a b hab ↦ e.injective (Subtype.ext hab)
      have hblk : f (hwv P ν') ∈ centralBlock P (X ⧸ N₀) χ := by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N₀ (f (hwv P ν'))
        rw [← hx]
        exact map_mem_centralBlock P _ χ (hX ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x)
      have h0 := mem_centralBlock_of_injective P f hf χ hblk
      rw [centralBlock_verma_eq_bot P ν' χ hne] at h0
      exact hwv_ne_zero P ν' ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp h0)
    · exact ih ν' hν'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isStdFiltered_translation_of_isAntidominant
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_translation_of_isAntidominant {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (hX : IsCategoryO P X) (hblock : centralBlock P X (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤)
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hs : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X) s) :
    ∃ t, IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) X)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hfac : ∀ ν' ∈ s, ∃ ν'', Nonempty (VermaModule P ν'' ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ) (VermaModule P ν')) := by
    intro ν' hν'
    have hχ := IsStdFiltered.centralCharacter_eq P hblock hs ν' hν'
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwe⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA lam ν').mp hχ.symm
    have hν'w : ν' = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan ⟨w, hw⟩ lam := by
      change ν' = w (lam + P.rho) - P.rho
      rw [hwe, add_sub_cancel_right]
    subst hν'w
    exact ⟨_, translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν ⟨w, hw⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hs.exists_isStdFiltered_centralTranslation P hX hZ _ _ hfac
  have htop : (centralTranslationMap P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam)
      (centralCharacter P μ) (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X).incl).range = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := centralTranslationMap_surjective P (hX.lieSubmodule ⊤) hZ _ _
      (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X).incl (fun x ↦ ⟨⟨x, LieSubmodule.mem_top x⟩, rfl⟩) y
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨t, htop ▸ ht⟩

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_homogeneousSubmodule
statement:
theorem map_homogeneousSubmodule {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M) (n : ℕ) :
    (homogeneousSubmodule (K := K) (M := M) n).map
      (equivMvPolynomial b).toAlgHom.toLinearMap = MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule κ K n
proof:
:= by
  have h : (LinearMap.range (ι K M)).map (equivMvPolynomial b).toAlgHom.toLinearMap =
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule κ K 1 := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_eq_span_X]
    rw [← Submodule.map_top (ι K M), ← b.span_eq, Submodule.map_span,
      Submodule.map_span]
    congr 1
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, (equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply b i).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ι K M (b i), ⟨b i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply b i⟩
  change ((LinearMap.range (ι K M)) ^ n).map
    (equivMvPolynomial b).toAlgHom.toLinearMap = _
  rw [Submodule.map_pow, h,
    MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_homogeneousSubmodule_iff {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M) (n : ℕ)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra K M) :
    p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (K := K) (M := M) n ↔
      (equivMvPolynomial b p).IsHomogeneous n
proof:
:= by
  change p ∈ _ ↔ equivMvPolynomial b p ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule κ K n
  rw [← map_homogeneousSubmodule b n]
  constructor
  · intro hp
    exact ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩
    have h : q = p := (equivMvPolynomial b).injective hqp
    exact h ▸ hq

name: SymmetricAlgebra.derivationOfBasis_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem derivationOfBasis_ι {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M)
    (D : M →ₗ[K] M) (x : M) : derivationOfBasis b D (ι K M x) = ι K M (D x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (derivationOfBasis b D).toLinearMap.comp (ι K M) = (ι K M).comp D := by
    apply b.ext
    intro i
    simp [derivationOfBasis]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: SymmetricAlgebra.derivation_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem derivation_ι (D : M →ₗ[K] M) (x : M) :
    derivation D (ι K M x) = ι K M (D x)
proof: := derivationOfBasis_ι _ D x

name: SymmetricAlgebra.derivation_prod_ι
statement:
theorem derivation_prod_ι (D : M →ₗ[K] M) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → M) :
    derivation D (∏ i, ι K M (v i)) =
      ∑ i, ∏ j, ι K M (Function.update v i (D (v i)) j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn (i : Fin n) : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ i.succ := (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
    simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Derivation.leibniz, derivation_ι, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
      Function.update_apply, Fin.succ_inj, Fin.succ_ne_zero, hn, ite_false, ite_true]
    have h := ih (fun i => v i.succ)
    simp only [Function.update_apply] at h
    rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, h, Finset.mul_sum]
    ac_rfl

name: SymmetricPower.range_toSymmetricAlgebra
statement:
theorem range_toSymmetricAlgebra (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (toSymmetricAlgebra (K := K) (M := M) n) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n
proof:
:= by
  rw [SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule, LinearMap.range_eq_map,
    ← span_tprod_eq_top K (Fin n) M, Submodule.map_span]
  rw [← Submodule.span_eq (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι K M)),
    Submodule.span_pow]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_range]
  rw [Set.mem_pow_iff_prod]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨v, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun i => SymmetricAlgebra.ι K M (v i), fun i => ⟨v i, rfl⟩,
      (toSymmetricAlgebra_tprod n v).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    choose v hv using hf
    exact ⟨tprod K v, ⟨v, rfl⟩, by rw [toSymmetricAlgebra_tprod]; simp only [hv]⟩

name: SymmetricPower.tprod_basis_eq_of_exponent_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc (a : κ) : Fintype.card {i // f i = a} = Fintype.card {i // g i = a} := by
    have ha := DFunLike.congr_fun h a
    simpa [tupleExponent, Finsupp.single_apply, Fintype.card_subtype, eq_comm] using ha
  let e (a : κ) : {i // f i = a} ≃ {i // g i = a} := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (hc a)
  have he (i : Fin n) : g (Equiv.ofFiberEquiv e i) = f i := Equiv.ofFiberEquiv_map e i
  calc
    tprod K (fun i => b (f i)) =
        tprod K (fun i => b (g (Equiv.ofFiberEquiv e i))) := by simp only [he]
    _ = tprod K (fun i => b (g i)) := tprod_equiv (Equiv.ofFiberEquiv e) (fun i => b (g i))

name: SymmetricPower.monomialPreimage_tupleExponent
statement:
theorem monomialPreimage_tupleExponent {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M) (n : ℕ)
    (f : Fin n → κ) :
    monomialPreimage b n (tupleExponent f) = tprod K (fun i => b (f i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold monomialPreimage
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact tprod_basis_eq_of_exponent_eq b _ f h.choose_spec
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (h ⟨f, rfl⟩)

name: SymmetricPower.polynomialPreimage_prod_X
statement:
theorem polynomialPreimage_prod_X {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M) (n : ℕ)
    (f : Fin n → κ) :
    polynomialPreimage b n (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X (f i)) =
      tprod K (fun i => b (f i))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∏ i, MvPolynomial.X (f i) : MvPolynomial κ K) =
      MvPolynomial.monomial (tupleExponent f) 1 := by
    rw [tupleExponent, MvPolynomial.monomial_sum_one]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  change polynomialPreimage b n (MvPolynomial.basisMonomials κ K (tupleExponent f)) = _
  rw [polynomialPreimage, Basis.constr_basis, monomialPreimage_tupleExponent]

name: SymmetricPower.polynomialPreimage_leftInverse
statement:
theorem polynomialPreimage_leftInverse {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.LeftInverse
      ((polynomialPreimage b n).comp (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).toLinearMap)
      (toSymmetricAlgebra (K := K) (M := M) n)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : ((polynomialPreimage b n).comp
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).toLinearMap).comp
      (toSymmetricAlgebra n) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext_on (span_tprod_eq_top K (Fin n) M)
    have ht : (((polynomialPreimage b n).comp
        (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).toLinearMap).comp
        (toSymmetricAlgebra n)).compMultilinearMap (tprod K) = tprod K := by
      apply Basis.ext_multilinear (fun _ => b)
      intro f
      simp only [LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        toSymmetricAlgebra_tprod, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply, map_prod,
        SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply, polynomialPreimage_prod_X]
    rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact MultilinearMap.congr_fun ht f
  intro s
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hm s

name: SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra_injective
statement:
theorem toSymmetricAlgebra_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (toSymmetricAlgebra (K := K) (M := M) n)
proof:
:=
  (polynomialPreimage_leftInverse (Module.Free.chooseBasis K M) n).injective

name: SymmetricPower.coe_homogeneousEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_homogeneousEquiv (n : ℕ) (s : SymmetricPower K (Fin n) M) :
    (homogeneousEquiv n s : SymmetricAlgebra K M) = toSymmetricAlgebra n s
proof: := rfl

name: SymmetricPower.homogeneousEquiv_symm_eq
statement:
theorem homogeneousEquiv_symm_eq {κ : Type*} (b : Basis κ K M) (n : ℕ)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule (K := K) (M := M) n) :
    (homogeneousEquiv n).symm p =
      polynomialPreimage b n (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b p.val)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := (homogeneousEquiv (K := K) (M := M) n).surjective p
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, coe_homogeneousEquiv,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply] using
    (polynomialPreimage_leftInverse b n s).symm

name: SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra_diagonal
statement:
theorem toSymmetricAlgebra_diagonal (n : ℕ) (D : M →ₗ[K] M)
    (s : SymmetricPower K (Fin n) M) :
    toSymmetricAlgebra n (diagonal D s) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.derivation D (toSymmetricAlgebra n s)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (toSymmetricAlgebra n).comp (diagonal D) =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.derivation D).toLinearMap.comp (toSymmetricAlgebra n) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext_on (span_tprod_eq_top K (Fin n) M)
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, diagonal_tprod, map_sum, toSymmetricAlgebra_tprod,
      Derivation.coeFn_coe, SymmetricAlgebra.derivation_prod_ι]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h s

name: SymmetricPower.homogeneousEquiv_symm_diagonal_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneousEquiv_symm_diagonal_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (D : M →ₗ[K] M)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule (K := K) (M := M) n) :
    diagonal D ((homogeneousEquiv n).symm p) = 0 ↔
      SymmetricAlgebra.derivation D p.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : toSymmetricAlgebra n ((homogeneousEquiv n).symm p) = p.val := by
    rw [← coe_homogeneousEquiv, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := toSymmetricAlgebra_diagonal n D ((homogeneousEquiv n).symm p)
    rw [h, map_zero, hp] at he
    exact he.symm
  · intro h
    apply toSymmetricAlgebra_injective n
    rw [map_zero, toSymmetricAlgebra_diagonal, hp, h]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_centralLift_of_invariant_homogeneous
statement:
theorem exists_centralLift_of_invariant_homogeneous (n : ℕ)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule (K := K) (M := L) n)
    (hp : ∀ x : L, SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieAlgebra.ad K L x) p.val = 0) :
    ∃ z : Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L),
      ∃ hz : z.val ∈ filtration K L n,
        toGr K L n ⟨z.val, hz⟩ = symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded K L p.val
proof:
:= by
  let s := (SymmetricPower.homogeneousEquiv (K := K) (M := L) n).symm p
  have hs (x : L) : SymmetricPower.diagonal (LieAlgebra.ad K L x) s = 0 :=
    (SymmetricPower.homogeneousEquiv_symm_diagonal_eq_zero_iff n _ p).mpr (hp x)
  refine ⟨⟨symmetrizationPower n s, symmetrizationPower_mem_center n s hs⟩,
    symmetrizationPower_mem_filtration n s, ?_⟩
  rw [show p.val = SymmetricPower.toSymmetricAlgebra n s by
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [← SymmetricPower.coe_homogeneousEquiv, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]]
  exact symmetrizationPower_toGr n s

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (Λ μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ)) =
      if Λ = μ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_hom_restrictedDual_verma (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ), VermaModule.coinvDim_top]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eq_of_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma_ne_zero {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    {f : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ)} (hf : f ≠ 0) : μ = Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  have h0 := finrank_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma P Λ μ
  simp only [Ne.symm hne, ↓reduceIte, Module.finrank_zero_iff] at h0
  exact hf (Subsingleton.elim f 0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.range_toRestrictedDual
statement:
lemma IrreducibleModule.range_toRestrictedDual (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (IrreducibleModule.toRestrictedDual P Λ).range = (VermaModule.toRestrictedDual P Λ).range
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (maxSubmodule P Λ) u
    exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P Λ) v, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := eq_of_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma_ne_zero P hf
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [IrreducibleModule.range_toRestrictedDual]
  have hφ := VermaModule.eq_smul_toTwistedDual P μ
    ((restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ)).incl.comp f)
  set c := TwistedDual.toDual P _ (((restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ)).incl.comp f)
    (VermaModule.hwv P μ)) (VermaModule.hwv P μ)
  have hfu : ∀ u, f u = c • VermaModule.toRestrictedDual P μ u := fun u ↦
    Subtype.ext (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hφ u)
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro hc
    exact hf (LieModuleHom.ext fun u ↦ by rw [hfu, hc, zero_smul, _root_.zero_apply])
  ext x
  simp only [LieModuleHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c • u, by rw [hfu, map_smul]⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c⁻¹ • u, by rw [hfu, map_smul, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.range_toRestrictedDual_le
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.range_toRestrictedDual_le (Λ : Dual K H)
    {N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ))} (hN : N ≠ ⊥) :
    (IrreducibleModule.toRestrictedDual P Λ).range ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  have hO := (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ)).lieSubmodule N
  have : Nontrivial N := (LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot K 𝔤 _).mpr hN
  obtain ⟨ν, φ, hφ⟩ := hO.exists_lieModuleHom_verma
  have hf : N.incl.comp φ ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hφ (Subtype.ext
    (by simpa using LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 (VermaModule.hwv P ν)))
  rw [← (range_hom_verma_restrictedDual_verma P _ hf).2]
  rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
  exact (φ u).2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_restrictedDual_verma_self
statement:
theorem multiplicity_restrictedDual_verma_self (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (isCategoryO_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ)).multiplicity Λ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ), VermaModule.multiplicity_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_restrictedDual_verma_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity_restrictedDual (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ)] at h
  exact VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_cone_of_mem_weightSpace_restrictedDual_verma
proof:
:= by
  have hV := VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap ν
  have := (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV).finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap ν
  have hpos : 0 < finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P Λ) (h P) ν) := by
    rw [← finrank_weightSpace_restrictedDual hV, Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero]
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, fun h0 ↦ hx0 (congrArg Subtype.val h0)⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy0⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp hpos
  exact VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id hy
    fun h0 ↦ hy0 (Subtype.ext h0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.extOne_verma_restrictedDual_verma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem extOne_verma_restrictedDual_verma_eq_zero (Λ μ : Dual K H)
    (y : ExtOne (h P) (VermaModule P μ) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ))) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hV := VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ
  have hW := VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ
  by_cases hc : μ ∈ cone P Λ ∧ μ ≠ Λ
  · 
    have hΛ : ¬ (Λ ∈ cone P μ ∧ Λ ≠ μ) := fun h' ↦ hc.2 (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hc.1 h'.1)
    have h0 : ExtOne.mapComap (h P) (LieModuleEquiv.refl).toLieModuleHom
        (restrictedDoubleDualEquiv hV).toLieModuleHom
        (extOneRestrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ) (restrictedDual P (VermaModule P Λ)) y) = 0 :=
      extOne_verma_eq_zero_of_mem_cone P (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hW).1
        (fun _ _ hx hx0 ↦ mem_cone_of_mem_weightSpace_restrictedDual_verma P hx hx0) hΛ _
    exact injective_extOneRestrictedDual hW (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV)
      ((ExtOne.injective_mapComap (h P) LieModuleEquiv.refl (restrictedDoubleDualEquiv hV)
        (h0.trans (LinearMap.map_zero _).symm)).trans (LinearMap.map_zero _).symm)
  · exact extOne_verma_eq_zero_of_mem_cone P (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV).1
      (fun _ _ hx hx0 ↦ mem_cone_of_mem_weightSpace_restrictedDual_verma P hx hx0) hc y

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.commutator_ι_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem commutator_ι_mem_filtration (x : L) {n : ℕ} {u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L}
    (hu : u ∈ filtration K L n) : ι K x * u - u * ι K x ∈ filtration K L n
proof:
:= by
  have := commutator_mem_filtration (ι_mem_filtration_one (R := K) x) hu
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at this

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_succ_generator_mul
statement:
theorem toGr_succ_generator_mul {i : ℕ} (r : K) (w : L) (a : filtration K L i)
    (h : (algebraMap K _ r + ι K w) * (a : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L) ∈
      filtration K L (i + 1)) :
    toGr K L (i + 1) ⟨_, h⟩ = toGr K L 1 ⟨ι K w, ι_mem_filtration_one w⟩ * toGr K L i a
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : algebraMap K _ r * (a : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L) ∈ filtration K L (i + 1) := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (filtration_mono (Nat.le_succ i) a.2)
  have h₂ : ι K w * (a : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L) ∈ filtration K L (i + 1) := by
    rw [add_comm]
    exact mul_mem_filtration (ι_mem_filtration_one w) a.2
  have e : (⟨_, h⟩ : filtration K L (i + 1)) = ⟨_, h₁⟩ + ⟨_, h₂⟩ := Subtype.ext (add_mul _ _ _)
  rw [e, map_add, (toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff _).mpr, zero_add, toGr_mul]
  · exact toGr_congr (add_comm i 1) rfl
  · dsimp only
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ a.2

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_commutator
statement:
theorem toGr_commutator (x : L) (n : ℕ) (u : filtration K L n) :
    toGr K L n ⟨ι K x * u - u * ι K x, commutator_ι_mem_filtration x u.2⟩ =
      symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded K L
        (SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)
          ((symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded K L).symm (toGr K L n u)))
proof:
:= by
  set e := symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded K L
  set D := SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)
  let Δ : AssociatedGraded K L → AssociatedGraded K L := fun t => e (D (e.symm t))
  have hΔmul : ∀ s t, Δ (s * t) = s * Δ t + t * Δ s := by
    intro s t
    simp only [Δ, map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, map_add, e.apply_symm_apply]
  have hΔadd : ∀ s t, Δ (s + t) = Δ s + Δ t := by
    intro s t
    simp only [Δ, map_add]
  have hΔι : ∀ w, Δ (toGr K L 1 ⟨ι K w, ι_mem_filtration_one w⟩) =
      toGr K L 1 ⟨ι K ⁅x, w⁆, ι_mem_filtration_one _⟩ := by
    intro w
    simp only [Δ]
    rw [← symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded_ι, e.symm_apply_apply,
      SymmetricAlgebra.derivation_ι, LieAlgebra.ad_apply, symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded_ι]
  change _ = Δ (toGr K L n u)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := u
  induction hu using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r =>
    have hr : toGr K L 0 ⟨algebraMap K _ r, algebraMap_mem_filtration r 0⟩ =
        algebraMap K _ r := by
      rw [toGr_apply, ← AlgHom.commutes (AssociatedGraded.mk (R := K) (L := L)) r]
      rfl
    calc _ = toGr K L 0 0 := congrArg _ (Subtype.ext (by simp [Algebra.commutes]))
      _ = Δ (toGr K L 0 ⟨algebraMap K _ r, algebraMap_mem_filtration r 0⟩) := by
        rw [hr, map_zero]
        simp only [Δ, AlgEquiv.commutes, Derivation.map_algebraMap, map_zero]
  | add a b i ha hb iha ihb =>
    calc _ = toGr K L i (⟨_, commutator_ι_mem_filtration x ha⟩ +
          ⟨_, commutator_ι_mem_filtration x hb⟩) :=
          congrArg _ (Subtype.ext (by simp only [Submodule.coe_add]; noncomm_ring))
      _ = Δ (toGr K L i (⟨a, ha⟩ + ⟨b, hb⟩)) := by rw [map_add, map_add, iha, ihb, hΔadd]
  | mem_mul g hg i a ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hg
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hy
    have ha' : a ∈ filtration K L i := ha
    have hra : algebraMap K _ r * a ∈ filtration K L i := by
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha'
    have hc := commutator_ι_mem_filtration x ha'
    have h₁ : ι K x * (algebraMap K _ r * a) - algebraMap K _ r * a * ι K x ∈
        filtration K L (i + 1) :=
      filtration_mono (Nat.le_succ i) (commutator_ι_mem_filtration x hra)
    have h₂ : ι K ⁅x, w⁆ * a ∈ filtration K L (i + 1) := by
      rw [add_comm]
      exact mul_mem_filtration (ι_mem_filtration_one _) ha'
    have h₃ : ι K w * (ι K x * a - a * ι K x) ∈ filtration K L (i + 1) := by
      rw [add_comm]
      exact mul_mem_filtration (ι_mem_filtration_one _) hc
    have hg : (algebraMap K _ r + ι K w) * a ∈ filtration K L (i + 1) := by
      rw [add_comm]
      exact mul_mem_filtration (add_mem (algebraMap_mem_filtration r 1)
        (ι_mem_filtration_one w)) ha'
    calc _ = toGr K L (i + 1) (⟨_, h₁⟩ + ⟨_, h₂⟩ + ⟨_, h₃⟩) := by
          apply congrArg
          apply Subtype.ext
          simp only [Submodule.coe_add, LieHom.map_lie, Ring.lie_def]
          change ι K x * ((algebraMap K _ r + ι K w) * a) -
            (algebraMap K _ r + ι K w) * a * ι K x = _
          noncomm_ring
      _ = toGr K L 1 ⟨ι K ⁅x, w⁆, ι_mem_filtration_one _⟩ * toGr K L i ⟨a, ha⟩ +
          toGr K L 1 ⟨ι K w, ι_mem_filtration_one w⟩ * Δ (toGr K L i ⟨a, ha⟩) := by
        rw [map_add, map_add, (toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff _).mpr (commutator_ι_mem_filtration x hra),
          zero_add, ← ih, toGr_mul, toGr_mul]
        congr 1
        · exact toGr_congr (add_comm i 1) rfl
        · exact toGr_congr (add_comm i 1) rfl
      _ = Δ (toGr K L (i + 1) ⟨_, hg⟩) := by
        rw [toGr_succ_generator_mul r w ⟨a, ha⟩ hg, hΔmul, hΔι]
        ring

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.derivation_symbol_eq_zero_of_mem_center
statement:
theorem derivation_symbol_eq_zero_of_mem_center {n : ℕ} {z : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L}
    (hz : z ∈ Subalgebra.center K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K L)) (hzn : z ∈ filtration K L n)
    (x : L) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)
      ((symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded K L).symm (toGr K L n ⟨z, hzn⟩)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := toGr_commutator x n ⟨z, hzn⟩
  have h0 : (⟨ι K x * z - z * ι K x, commutator_ι_mem_filtration x hzn⟩ :
      filtration K L n) = 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (by
      change ι K x * z - z * ι K x = 0
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp hz (ι K x), sub_self])
  rw [h0, map_zero, eq_comm, map_eq_zero_iff _ (AlgEquiv.injective _)] at h
  exact h

name: SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt {m : ℕ} (f : SymmetricAlgebra K M)
    (hf : (equivMvPolynomial (Free.chooseBasis K M) f).totalDegree < m) :
    homogeneousComponent m f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivMvPolynomial (Free.chooseBasis K M)).injective
  rw [equivMvPolynomial_homogeneousComponent, map_zero]
  exact MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero _ _ hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_invariant_of_cartanRestriction_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_invariant_of_cartanRestriction_eq_zero (p : SymmetricAlgebra K 𝔤)
    (hp : ∀ x : 𝔤, SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieAlgebra.ad K 𝔤 x) p = 0)
    (h₀ : cartanRestriction P p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := coordinateCartanRestriction_killingSymbolEquiv P hA p
  rw [h₀, map_zero] at he
  have hq := eq_zero_of_invariant_of_coordinateCartanRestriction_eq_zero P hA _
    ((killingSymbolEquiv_invariant_iff P hA p).mpr hp) he
  exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ (killingSymbolEquiv P hA).injective).mp hq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_homogeneousComponent_eq_cartanRestriction
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_homogeneousComponent_eq_cartanRestriction
    (φ : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤 →ₗ[K] SymmetricAlgebra K H)
    (hφ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) (hz : z.val ∈ filtration K 𝔤 n),
      SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent n (φ z) =
        cartanRestriction P ((symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded K 𝔤).symm
          (toGr K 𝔤 n ⟨z.val, hz⟩)))
    (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) (h₀ : φ z = 0) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_filtration (R := K) z.val
  induction n generalizing z with
  | zero =>
    have hs := hφ 0 z hn
    rw [h₀, map_zero, eq_comm] at hs
    have h := eq_zero_of_invariant_of_cartanRestriction_eq_zero P hA _
      (derivation_symbol_eq_zero_of_mem_center z.property hn) hs
    rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ (AlgEquiv.injective _), toGr_zero_eq_zero_iff] at h
    exact Subtype.ext (by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val h)
  | succ m ih =>
    have hs := hφ (m + 1) z hn
    rw [h₀, map_zero, eq_comm] at hs
    have h := eq_zero_of_invariant_of_cartanRestriction_eq_zero P hA _
      (derivation_symbol_eq_zero_of_mem_center z.property hn) hs
    rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ (AlgEquiv.injective _), toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff] at h
    exact ih z h₀ h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandra_injective
statement: theorem harishChandra_injective : Function.Injective (harishChandra P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  exact eq_zero_of_homogeneousComponent_eq_cartanRestriction P hA
    (harishChandra P).toLinearMap (fun n z hz => harishChandraProjection_homogeneousComponent
      P n ⟨z.val, hz⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.shiftedHarishChandra_injective
statement: theorem shiftedHarishChandra_injective : Function.Injective (shiftedHarishChandra P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  exact eq_zero_of_homogeneousComponent_eq_cartanRestriction P hA
    (shiftedHarishChandra P).toLinearMap (fun n z hz =>
      shiftedHarishChandra_homogeneousComponent P n z hz)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_invariant_cartanRestriction_eq
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_cartanRestriction_eq (n : ℕ) (f : SymmetricAlgebra K H)
    (hf : f ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n)
    (hinv : ∀ i, SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback
      (P.coreflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i).toLinearMap 0 f = f) :
    ∃ p ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule (K := K) (M := 𝔤) n,
      (∀ x : 𝔤, SymmetricAlgebra.derivation (LieAlgebra.ad K 𝔤 x) p = 0) ∧
        cartanRestriction P p = f
proof:
:= by
  set κH := SymmetricAlgebra.equivOfLinearEquiv (cartanKillingEquivDual P hA)
  have hq : κH f ∈ SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousSubmodule n :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift_comp_ι_mem_homogeneous _ n hf
  have hw : ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp w.val.toLinearMap)
        (κH f) = κH f := by
    intro w
    refine P.weylGroup_induction hA.isGeneralizedCartan (p := fun w =>
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp w.toLinearMap)
        (κH f) = κH f) (by simp) (fun i w ih => ?_) w.property
    have he : SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp
        (P.reflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i * w).toLinearMap) =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp
        (P.reflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i).toLinearMap)).comp
      (SymmetricAlgebra.lift ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι K (Dual K H)).comp w.toLinearMap)) := by
      apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
      ext a
      simp
    rw [he, AlgHom.comp_apply, ih, cartanKillingSymbolEquiv_reflection, hinv i]
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hiF, heF⟩ := exists_homogeneous_chevalley_extension P hA n (κH f) hq hw
  refine ⟨(killingSymbolEquiv P hA).symm F, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact SymmetricAlgebra.lift_comp_ι_mem_homogeneous _ n hF
  · apply (killingSymbolEquiv_invariant_iff P hA _).mp
    simpa only [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hiF
  · have he := coordinateCartanRestriction_killingSymbolEquiv P hA
      ((killingSymbolEquiv P hA).symm F)
    rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, heF] at he
    exact κH.injective he.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_shiftedHarishChandra_eq
statement:
theorem exists_shiftedHarishChandra_eq (f : SymmetricAlgebra K H)
    (hinv : ∀ i, SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback
      (P.coreflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i).toLinearMap 0 f = f) :
    ∃ z, shiftedHarishChandra P z = f
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n (f : SymmetricAlgebra K H), (∀ i, SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback
      (P.coreflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i).toLinearMap 0 f = f) →
      (∀ m, n ≤ m → SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent m f = 0) →
      ∃ z, shiftedHarishChandra P z = f := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f _ hf
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero]
      exact SymmetricAlgebra.eq_of_homogeneousComponent_eq _ _ fun m => by
        rw [map_zero, hf m (Nat.zero_le m)]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f hfinv hf
      have hcomp : ∀ i, SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback
          (P.coreflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i).toLinearMap 0
          (SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent n f) =
          SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent n f := by
        intro i
        have h := SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_lift_comp_ι
          (P.coreflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i).toLinearMap n f
        simp only [SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback, LinearMap.comp_zero, add_zero] at hfinv ⊢
        rw [← h, hfinv i]
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpinv, hpres⟩ := exists_invariant_cartanRestriction_eq P hA n _
        (SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_mem n f) hcomp
      obtain ⟨z, hz, -, htop⟩ := exists_centralLift_shiftedHarishChandra_top P n ⟨p, hp⟩ hpinv
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := ih (f - shiftedHarishChandra P z) (fun i => by
          rw [map_sub, hfinv i, shiftedHarishChandra_reflection P hA.isGeneralizedCartan i z])
        (fun m hm => by
          rw [map_sub]
          rcases hm.lt_or_eq with hlt | rfl
          · rw [hf m hlt, SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt _
              (lt_of_le_of_lt (shiftedHarishChandra_degree_le P (Free.chooseBasis K H) n z hz).1
                hlt), sub_zero]
          · rw [htop, hpres, sub_self])
      exact ⟨z + z', by rw [map_add, hz', add_sub_cancel]⟩
  refine key ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial (Free.chooseBasis K H) f).totalDegree + 1)
    f hinv fun m hm => SymmetricAlgebra.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt f ?_
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_coreflectionInvariants
statement:
theorem mem_coreflectionInvariants {f : SymmetricAlgebra K H} :
    f ∈ coreflectionInvariants P hA' ↔
      ∀ i, SymmetricAlgebra.affinePullback (P.coreflection hA' i).toLinearMap 0 f = f
proof:
:= by
  simp [coreflectionInvariants, Algebra.mem_iInf, AlgHom.mem_equalizer]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.shiftedHarishChandra_range
statement:
theorem shiftedHarishChandra_range :
    (shiftedHarishChandra P).range = coreflectionInvariants P hA.isGeneralizedCartan
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_coreflectionInvariants, AlgHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩ i
    exact shiftedHarishChandra_reflection P hA.isGeneralizedCartan i z
  · exact exists_shiftedHarishChandra_eq P hA f

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.shiftedHarishChandraEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftedHarishChandraEquiv_apply (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    (shiftedHarishChandraEquiv P hA z : SymmetricAlgebra K H) = shiftedHarishChandra P z
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_envBorelCartanPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_envBorelCartanPolynomial (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ).comp (envBorelCartanPolynomial P) =
      VermaModule.envBorelChar P Λ
proof:
:= by
  apply UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.hom_ext
  ext x
  change SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ
    (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift K (borelCartanPolynomial P)
      (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K x)) =
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift K (borelChar P Λ) (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K x)
  rw [UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
  exact SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply Λ (cartanProj P x)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandraProjection_mul
statement:
theorem harishChandraProjection_mul (n : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P))
    (b : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (borel P)) :
    harishChandraProjection P (mapN n * mapB b) =
      VermaModule.counitNNeg P n • envBorelCartanPolynomial P b
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (VermaModule.mulEquiv P).symm (mapN n * mapB b) = n ⊗ₜ b := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul]
  simp [harishChandraProjection, ht]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandraProjection_map_borel
statement:
theorem harishChandraProjection_map_borel (b : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (borel P)) :
    harishChandraProjection P (mapB b) = envBorelCartanPolynomial P b
proof:
:= by
  simpa using harishChandraProjection_mul P 1 b

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandraProjection_h
statement:
theorem harishChandraProjection_h (a : H) :
    harishChandraProjection P (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (h P a)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι K H a
proof:
:= by
  have ht := harishChandraProjection_map_borel P
    (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K ⟨h P a, h_mem_borel P a⟩)
  rw [UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι] at ht
  change harishChandraProjection P (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (h P a)) = _ at ht
  rw [ht]
  change UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift K (borelCartanPolynomial P)
    (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K ⟨h P a, h_mem_borel P a⟩) = _
  rw [UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
  change SymmetricAlgebra.ι K H (cartanProj P (h P a)) = _
  rw [cartanProj_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_harishChandraProjection
statement:
theorem eval_harishChandraProjection (Λ : Dual K H) (u : 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (harishChandraProjection P u) =
      VermaModule.hwCoord P Λ (VermaModule.mk P Λ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (VermaModule.mulEquiv P).surjective u
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul n b =>
    rw [UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul,
      harishChandraProjection_mul, map_smul]
    have he : SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (envBorelCartanPolynomial P b) =
        VermaModule.envBorelChar P Λ b :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun (eval_envBorelCartanPolynomial P Λ) b
    rw [he, VermaModule.mk_eq_smul, mul_smul, ← VermaModule.mk_eq_smul P Λ (mapB b),
      VermaModule.mk_map_borel, smul_comm,
      ← VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_smul]
    change VermaModule.counitNNeg P n * VermaModule.envBorelChar P Λ b =
      VermaModule.envBorelChar P Λ b * VermaModule.counitNNeg P
        ((VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm (VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P Λ n))
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, mul_comm]
  | add t s ht hs => simp only [map_add, ht, hs]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_harishChandraProjection_center
statement:
theorem eval_harishChandraProjection_center (Λ : Dual K H) (z : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ (harishChandraProjection P (z : 𝓤)) =
      VermaModule.centralCharacter P Λ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_harishChandraProjection, VermaModule.mk_eq_smul,
    VermaModule.centralCharacter_smul, map_smul, VermaModule.hwCoord_hwv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.eq_of_lift_eq
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis K H
  let e := equivMvPolynomial b
  apply e.injective
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro x
  have he : (lift (b.constr K x)).comp e.symm.toAlgHom = MvPolynomial.aeval x := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    simp [e]
  have hp := DFunLike.congr_fun he (e p)
  have hq := DFunLike.congr_fun he (e q)
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hp hq
  simpa only [MvPolynomial.aeval_eq_eval] using
    hp.symm.trans ((hpq (b.constr K x)).trans hq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.harishChandraProjection_center_mul
statement:
theorem harishChandraProjection_center_mul (z w : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) :
    harishChandraProjection P ((z * w : Subalgebra.center K 𝓤) : 𝓤) =
      harishChandraProjection P (z : 𝓤) * harishChandraProjection P (w : 𝓤)
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.eq_of_lift_eq
  intro Λ
  rw [map_mul, eval_harishChandraProjection_center, eval_harishChandraProjection_center,
    eval_harishChandraProjection_center, map_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eval_comp_harishChandra
statement:
theorem eval_comp_harishChandra (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (SymmetricAlgebra.lift Λ).comp (harishChandra P) =
      VermaModule.centralCharacter P Λ
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  exact eval_harishChandraProjection_center P Λ z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_allWeights_of_rootSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem mem_allWeights_of_rootSpace_ne_bot {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : rootSpace P μ ≠ ⊥) :
    μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hμ'
  refine hμ (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨆ ν ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, rootSpace P ν := by
    rw [iSup_rootSpace_eq_top]; trivial
  have := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P)
    (fun ν ↦ ⨆ (_ : ν ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P), rootSpace P ν)
    (fun ν ↦ iSup_le fun _ ↦ le_rfl) hx hx'
  rwa [iSup_neg hμ'] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_posWeights_or_mem_negWeights
statement:
theorem mem_posWeights_or_mem_negWeights {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ roots P) :
    μ ∈ P.posWeights ∨ μ ∈ P.negWeights
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_allWeights_of_rootSpace_ne_bot P hμ.2 with (h | h) | h
  · exact Or.inr h
  · exact absurd h hμ.1
  · exact Or.inl h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.root_mem_roots
statement: lemma root_mem_roots (i : ι) : P.root i ∈ roots P
proof:
:=
  ⟨P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i, by
    rw [rootSpace_root, Ne, Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact e_ne_zero P i⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_apply_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem rootSpace_apply_eq_bot_iff {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (μ : Dual K H) : rootSpace P (w μ) = ⊥ ↔ rootSpace P μ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  weightSpace_weylGroup_eq_bot_iff hA (isIntegrable_adjoint P hA) hw μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.apply_mem_roots
statement:
theorem apply_mem_roots {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ roots P) : w μ ∈ roots P
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [Ne, map_eq_zero_iff w w.injective]; exact hμ.1,
    by rw [Ne, rootSpace_apply_eq_bot_iff P hA hw]; exact hμ.2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflection_mem_posWeights
statement:
theorem reflection_mem_posWeights {i : ι} {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ roots P)
    (hμp : μ ∈ P.posWeights) (hne : μ ≠ P.root i) : P.reflection hA i μ ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  have hr := apply_mem_roots P hA (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i) hμ
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨hk0, hkne⟩, rfl⟩ := hμp
  rw [reflection_rootOf] at hr ⊢
  set k' := k - (A *ᵥ k) i • Pi.single i 1
  have hk' : ∀ j, j ≠ i → k' j = k j := fun j hj ↦ by simp [k', hj]
  rcases mem_posWeights_or_mem_negWeights P hr with h | ⟨l, ⟨hl0, -⟩, hl⟩
  · exact h
  exfalso
  
  have hkl : k' + l = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_add, ← hl, neg_add_cancel, map_zero])
  have hkj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → k j = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by
    have h1 := congr_fun hkl j
    have h2 := hk0 j
    have h3 := hl0 j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply, hk' j hj] at h1 h2 h3
    omega
  have hki : 0 ≤ k i := hk0 i
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, k i = n := ⟨(k i).toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hki).symm⟩
  have hμ' : P.rootOf k = n • P.root i := by
    rw [P.rootOf_eq_smul_root_of_eq_zero hkj, hn, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with hn2 | hn2
  · interval_cases n
    · exact hkne (funext fun j ↦ by
        by_cases hj : j = i
        · subst hj; simpa using hn
        · simpa using hkj j hj)
    · exact hne (by rw [hμ', one_smul])
  · exact hμ.2 (by rw [hμ']; exact rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot P i hn2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.realRoots_subset_roots
statement: theorem realRoots_subset_roots : P.realRoots hA ⊆ roots P
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, i, rfl⟩
  exact apply_mem_roots P hA hw (root_mem_roots P i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rank_rootSpace_of_mem_realRoots
statement:
theorem rank_rootSpace_of_mem_realRoots {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.realRoots hA) :
    Module.rank K (rootSpace P μ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, i, rfl⟩ := hμ
  rw [rank_rootSpace_weylGroup P hA hw, rootSpace_root, ← Module.finrank_eq_rank,
    finrank_span_singleton (e_ne_zero P i), Nat.cast_one]

name: Module.End.ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup_maxGenEigenspace
statement:
theorem ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup_maxGenEigenspace (f : End K M) (s : Finset K) (m : K → ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (aeval f (∏ c ∈ s, (X - C c) ^ m c)) ≤ ⨆ c ∈ s, f.maxGenEigenspace c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, ← sup_ker_aeval_eq_ker_aeval_mul_of_coprime]
    · refine sup_le ?_ (ih.trans (biSup_mono fun c hc ↦ Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hc))
      refine le_trans ?_ (le_biSup _ (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
      intro v hv
      rw [mem_maxGenEigenspace]
      refine ⟨m a, ?_⟩
      simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hv
    · refine IsCoprime.prod_right fun c hc ↦ ?_
      exact (isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h : a = c ↦ ha (h ▸ hc)).isUnit).pow

name: Module.End.mem_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_of_prod_apply_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : aeval f (∏ c ∈ l.toFinset, (X - C c) ^ l.count c) =
      (l.map fun c ↦ f - c • (1 : End K M)).prod := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_list_map_count, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
    congr 1
    refine List.map_congr_left fun c _ ↦ ?_
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  have := ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup_maxGenEigenspace f l.toFinset l.count
    (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (h ▸ hv))
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.map_pow_casimir_sub
statement:
lemma map_pow_casimir_sub (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hV : IsPosFinite P V)
    (hW : IsPosFinite P W) (c : K) (k : ℕ) (v : V) :
    f (((hB.casimir V hV - c • (1 : Module.End K V)) ^ k) v) =
      ((hB.casimir W hW - c • (1 : Module.End K W)) ^ k) (f v)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih]
    congr 1
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_sub,
      map_smul, hB.map_casimir f hV hW]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.prod_map_casimir_sub_mem
statement:
lemma prod_map_casimir_sub_mem (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (p : Submodule K V)
    (hp : ∀ v ∈ p, hB.casimir V hV v ∈ p) (l : List K) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ p) :
    (l.map fun c ↦ hB.casimir V hV - c • (1 : Module.End K V)).prod v ∈ p
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa using hv
  | cons c l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Module.End.mul_apply]
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply]
    exact sub_mem (hp _ ih) (p.smul_mem c ih)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_mem_lieSubmodule
statement:
lemma casimir_mem_lieSubmodule (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ N) : hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite v ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  have := hB.map_casimir N.incl (hV.lieSubmodule N).isPosFinite hV.isPosFinite ⟨v, hv⟩
  have h : hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite v =
      ((hB.casimir N (hV.lieSubmodule N).isPosFinite ⟨v, hv⟩ : N) : V) := this.symm
  rw [h]
  exact Subtype.prop _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.commute_casimir_toEnd
statement:
lemma commute_casimir_toEnd (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    Commute (hB.casimir V hV) (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V x)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ hB.casimir_lie hA hV x v

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma casimir_mem_weightSpace (hV : IsPosFinite P V) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P V μ) : hB.casimir V hV v ∈ weightSpace P V μ
proof:
:=
  map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (hB.casimirHom hA hV) hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirBlock_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] lemma casimirBlock_toSubmodule (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (c : K) :
    (hB.casimirBlock hA hV c).toSubmodule = (hB.casimir V hV).maxGenEigenspace c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.mem_casimirBlock
statement:
lemma mem_casimirBlock (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (c : K) {v : V} :
    v ∈ hB.casimirBlock hA hV c ↔
      ∃ k : ℕ, ((hB.casimir V hV - c • (1 : Module.End K V)) ^ k) v = 0
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.map_mem_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem map_mem_casimirBlock (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hV : IsPosFinite P V)
    (hW : IsPosFinite P W) {c : K} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ hB.casimirBlock hA hV c) :
    f v ∈ hB.casimirBlock hA hW c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV c).mp hv
  exact (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hW c).mpr
    ⟨k, by rw [← hB.map_pow_casimir_sub f hV hW, hk, map_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.iSupIndep_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_casimirBlock (hV : IsPosFinite P V) :
    iSupIndep fun c ↦ (hB.casimirBlock hA hV c).toSubmodule
proof:
:=
  Module.End.independent_maxGenEigenspace _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimir_sub_smul_mem_of_equiv
statement:
lemma casimir_sub_smul_mem_of_equiv (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    {N N' : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V} {μ : Dual K H}
    (ψ : N.Subquotient N' ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P μ) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ N') :
    hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite u - P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ • u ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  have hN' : IsCategoryO P N' := hV.lieSubmodule N'
  have hQ : IsCategoryO P (N.Subquotient N') := hN'.quotient _
  let φ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N.Subquotient N' :=
    (ψ.symm : IrreducibleModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N.Subquotient N').comp
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ :=
    ψ.symm.surjective.comp (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)
  set π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N.comap N'.incl)
  have h1 := hB.casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective hA hQ.isPosFinite φ hφ (π ⟨u, hu⟩)
  have h2 := hB.map_casimir π hN'.isPosFinite hQ.isPosFinite ⟨u, hu⟩
  have h3 := hB.map_casimir N'.incl hN'.isPosFinite hV.isPosFinite ⟨u, hu⟩
  have h4 : π (hB.casimir N' hN'.isPosFinite ⟨u, hu⟩ -
      P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ • ⟨u, hu⟩) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, h2, h1, sub_self]
  rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, LieSubmodule.mem_comap, map_sub, map_smul, h3] at h4
  exact h4

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.prod_apply_mem_of_isLocalCompositionSeries
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing N with
  | nil =>
    rw [IsLocalCompositionSeries.nil_iff.mp hl]
    simpa using hvM
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨-, hf, hl'⟩ := IsLocalCompositionSeries.cons_iff.mp hl
    have hu := ih hl'
    have huν : (((factorWeights l).map fun μ ↦ P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ).map
        fun c ↦ hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite - c • (1 : Module.End K V)).prod v ∈
          weightSpace P V ν :=
      hB.prod_map_casimir_sub_mem hV.isPosFinite (weightSpace P V ν)
        (fun _ ↦ hB.casimir_mem_weightSpace hA hV.isPosFinite) _ hv
    cases o with
    | none =>
      exact (weightSpace_subquotient_eq_bot_iff hV N N' ν).mp (hf ν (mem_cone_self ν)) ⟨hu, huν⟩
    | some μ =>
      simp only [factorWeights_cons_some, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Module.End.mul_apply,
        LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply]
      exact hB.casimir_sub_smul_mem_of_equiv hA hV hf.2.some hu

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.iSup_casimirBlock_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_casimirBlock_eq_top (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    ⨆ c, (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).toSubmodule = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]
  refine iSup_le fun ν v hv ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries ν
  have h0 := hB.prod_apply_mem_of_isLocalCompositionSeries hA hV hl (LieSubmodule.mem_top v) hv
  rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at h0
  exact (iSup₂_le fun c _ ↦ le_iSup (fun c ↦ (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).toSubmodule) c)
    (Module.End.mem_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_of_prod_apply_eq_zero _ _ h0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.isInternal_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem isInternal_casimirBlock (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun c ↦ (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).toSubmodule
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (hB.iSupIndep_casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite) (hB.iSup_casimirBlock_eq_top hA hV)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirBlock_le_map
statement:
theorem casimirBlock_le_map (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (c : K) :
    hB.casimirBlock hA hW.isPosFinite c ≤ (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).map f
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hf w
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ c, (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).toSubmodule := by
    rw [hB.iSup_casimirBlock_eq_top hA hV]; trivial
  have hmap : f v ∈ ⨆ c, ((hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).toSubmodule.map
      (f : V →ₗ[K] W)) := by
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup]; exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv
  have := (hB.iSupIndep_casimirBlock hA hW.isPosFinite).mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le
    (F := fun c ↦ (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).toSubmodule.map (f : V →ₗ[K] W))
    (fun c ↦ by
      rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact hB.map_mem_casimirBlock hA f hV.isPosFinite hW.isPosFinite hu) hw hmap
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hfu⟩ := this
  exact (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mpr ⟨u, hu, hfu⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.eq_of_mem_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_casimirBlock (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    {μ : Dual K H} {w : V} (hw : w ∈ weightSpace P V μ) (hwN : w ∉ N) (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, w⁆ ∈ N)
    {c : K} (hc : w ∈ hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ = c
proof:
:= by
  set Ω := hB.casimir V hV.isPosFinite
  set a := P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ
  have h1 : Ω w - a • w ∈ N := hB.casimir_sub_smul_mem hV N hw he
  have key (k : ℕ) : ((Ω - c • (1 : Module.End K V)) ^ k) w - (a - c) ^ k • w ∈ N := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      set u := ((Ω - c • (1 : Module.End K V)) ^ k) w
      have hT := sub_mem (hB.casimir_mem_lieSubmodule hV N ih) (N.smul_mem c ih)
      have e : ((Ω - c • (1 : Module.End K V)) ^ (k + 1)) w - (a - c) ^ (k + 1) • w =
          (a - c) ^ k • (Ω w - a • w) + (Ω (u - (a - c) ^ k • w) - c • (u - (a - c) ^ k • w)) := by
        rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
        simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_sub,
          map_smul, u]
        module
      rw [e]
      exact add_mem (N.smul_mem _ h1) hT
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).mp hc
  have := key k
  rw [hk, zero_sub, neg_mem_iff] at this
  by_contra hne
  have hne' : (a - c) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have := N.smul_mem ((a - c) ^ k)⁻¹ this
  rw [inv_smul_smul₀ hne'] at this
  exact hwN this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.eq_of_multiplicity_casimirBlock_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  set N := hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c
  have hN := hV.lieSubmodule N
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hN.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, -, -, -, -, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ :=
    hl.exists_of_mem_factorWeights ((hN.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff (mem_cone_self μ) hl).mp hμ)
  obtain ⟨w, hw, -, hw₁, he⟩ := hN.exists_lie_e_mem_of_equiv ψ
  refine hB.eq_of_mem_casimirBlock hA hN M₁ hw hw₁ he ?_
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).mp w.2
  refine (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hN.isPosFinite c).mpr ⟨k, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  have := hB.map_pow_casimir_sub N.incl hN.isPosFinite hV.isPosFinite c k w
  rw [LieSubmodule.incl_apply] at this
  rw [this]
  exact hk

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirBlock_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, -, -, -, -, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ :=
    hl.exists_of_mem_factorWeights ((hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff (mem_cone_self μ) hl).mp hμ)
  obtain ⟨w, hw, -, hw₁, he⟩ := hV.exists_lie_e_mem_of_equiv ψ
  set π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' M₁
  have hQ : IsCategoryO P (V ⧸ M₁) := hV.quotient M₁
  have hπw : π w ∈ hB.casimirBlock hA hQ.isPosFinite (P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ) := by
    refine (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hQ.isPosFinite _).mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_one, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
      hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero hQ.isPosFinite (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P π hw)
        fun i ↦ by rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]; exact he i,
      sub_self]
  intro hbot
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hπu⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp
    (hB.casimirBlock_le_map hA hV hQ π (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' M₁) _ hπw)
  rw [hbot, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hu
  rw [hu, map_zero, eq_comm, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hπu
  exact hw₁ hπu

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirBlock_quotient_eq_bot
statement:
lemma casimirBlock_quotient_eq_bot (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (c : K) :
    hB.casimirBlock hA (hV.quotient (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c)).isPosFinite c = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  set N := hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c
  have hQ := hV.quotient N
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N x
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hQ.isPosFinite c).mp hx
  rw [← hB.map_pow_casimir_sub _ hV.isPosFinite, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hk
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).mp hk
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add] at hm
  rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c).mpr ⟨_, hm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.multiplicity_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem multiplicity_casimirBlock (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (c : K) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (hV.lieSubmodule (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c)).multiplicity μ =
      if P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ = c then hV.multiplicity μ else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := hV.multiplicity_eq_add (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c) μ
  split_ifs with h
  · have h0 : (hV.quotient (hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c)).multiplicity μ = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have := hB.casimirBlock_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hA _ hne
      rw [h, hB.casimirBlock_quotient_eq_bot hA hV c] at this
      exact this rfl
    rw [hadd, h0, add_zero]
  · by_contra hne
    exact h (hB.eq_of_multiplicity_casimirBlock_ne_zero hA hV hne)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.exists_multiplicity_ne_zero_of_casimirBlock_ne_bot
proof:
:= by
  set N := hB.casimirBlock hA hV.isPosFinite c
  have hN := hV.lieSubmodule N
  have hne : hN.multiplicities ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hch := hN.character_eq_sumIrreducibleCharacter
    rw [h0, map_zero] at hch
    apply hc
    rw [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
    intro v hv
    have hv' : (⟨v, hv⟩ : N) ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace P N μ := by
      rw [hN.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]; trivial
    have hbot : ∀ μ, weightSpace P N μ = ⊥ := fun μ ↦ by
      have := hN.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
      have h' := congrArg (fun x ↦ x.coeffAt μ) hch
      simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, HahnSeries.coeff_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero,
        Submodule.finrank_eq_zero] at h'
      exact h'
    simp only [hbot, iSup_bot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hv'
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hv'
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ, hN.multiplicities.coeffAt μ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hne (CharacterRing.ext fun μ ↦ h μ)
  rw [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_multiplicities, Nat.cast_ne_zero] at hμ
  have hc' := hB.eq_of_multiplicity_casimirBlock_ne_zero hA hV hμ
  refine ⟨μ, ?_, hc'⟩
  simpa only [hB.multiplicity_casimirBlock hA hV c μ, hc', ↓reduceIte] using hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirBlock_eq_top_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro v _
  refine (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV _).mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rw [pow_one, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
    hB.casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective hA hV φ hφ, sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lieSpan_le_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem lieSpan_le_casimirBlock (hV : IsPosFinite P V) {Λ : Dual K H} {w : V}
    (hw : w ∈ weightSpace P V Λ) (he : ∀ i, ⁅e P i, w⁆ = 0) :
    LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra {w} ≤
      hB.casimirBlock hA hV (P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  refine (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV _).mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rw [pow_one, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
    hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero hV hw he, sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.isInternal_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem isInternal_casimirBlock :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun c ↦ (hV.casimirBlock S hA c).toSubmodule
proof:
:=
  (isStandardForm_invForm P S).isInternal_casimirBlock hA hV

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_casimirBlock
statement:
theorem multiplicity_casimirBlock (c : K) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (hV.lieSubmodule (hV.casimirBlock S hA c)).multiplicity μ =
      if P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ = c then hV.multiplicity μ else 0
proof:
:= by
  convert (isStandardForm_invForm P S).multiplicity_casimirBlock hA hV c μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.casimirBlock_eq_top_of_surjective
proof:
:=
  (isStandardForm_invForm P S).casimirBlock_eq_top_of_surjective hA hV.isPosFinite φ hφ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negRootWt_add
statement:
lemma negRootWt_add (s t : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    negRootWt P (s + t) = negRootWt P s + negRootWt P t
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (h := fun (x : NegRootIndex P) (n : ℕ) ↦ n • x.root)
    (fun _ ↦ zero_nsmul _)
    (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_nsmul _ _ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negRootWt_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma negRootWt_zero : negRootWt P 0 = 0
proof: := Finsupp.sum_zero_index

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negRootWt_single
statement:
lemma negRootWt_single (x : NegRootIndex P) (n : ℕ) :
    negRootWt P (Finsupp.single x n) = n • x.root
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_single_index (h := fun (x : NegRootIndex P) (n : ℕ) ↦ n • x.root) (zero_nsmul _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_negRootWt_eq_rootOf
statement:
lemma exists_negRootWt_eq_rootOf (s : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ negRootWt P s = P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp⟩
  | add s t hs ht =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hks⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hlt⟩ := ht
    exact ⟨k + l, add_nonneg hk hl, by rw [negRootWt_add, hks, hlt, map_add]⟩
  | single x n =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkx⟩ := x.1.2
    refine ⟨n • k, nsmul_nonneg hk.1 n, ?_⟩
    rw [negRootWt_single, map_nsmul, hkx]
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negRootWt_finsetToFinsupp
statement:
lemma negRootWt_finsetToFinsupp (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    negRootWt P (finsetToFinsupp P S) = finsetWt P S
proof:
:=
  map_sum (AddMonoidHom.mk' (negRootWt P) (negRootWt_add P)) _ S |>.trans
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ by simp [negRootWt_single])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetToFinsupp_apply
statement:
lemma finsetToFinsupp_apply (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    finsetToFinsupp P S x = if x ∈ S then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finsetToFinsupp, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetToFinsupp_injective
statement: lemma finsetToFinsupp_injective : Function.Injective (finsetToFinsupp P)
proof:
:= by
  intro S T h
  ext x
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  rw [finsetToFinsupp_apply, finsetToFinsupp_apply] at this
  split_ifs at this with h1 h2 h2 <;> simp_all

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finsetWt_eq_rootOf
statement:
lemma exists_finsetWt_eq_rootOf (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ finsetWt P S = P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← negRootWt_finsetToFinsupp]
  exact exists_negRootWt_eq_rootOf P _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_setOf_negRootWt_eq
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_negRootWt_eq (β : Dual K H) :
    {s : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ | negRootWt P s = β}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  set S := {s : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ | negRootWt P s = β}
  set B := VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma P 0
  let W := VermaModule.weightSpace P 0 (0 - β)
  have hmem : ∀ s : S, B s ∈ W := fun s ↦ by
    have := VermaModule.pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace P 0 s
    rwa [s.2] at this
  let f : S → W := fun s ↦ ⟨B s, hmem s⟩
  have hf : LinearIndependent K f := by
    refine LinearIndependent.of_comp W.subtype ?_
    exact B.linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective
  have := VermaModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace P 0 (0 - β)
  exact Set.finite_coe_iff.mp hf.finite

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_setOf_finsetWt_eq
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_finsetWt_eq (β : Dual K H) :
    {S : Finset (NegRootIndex P) | finsetWt P S = β}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((finite_setOf_negRootWt_eq P β).preimage
    (finsetToFinsupp_injective P).injOn).subset fun S hS ↦ ?_
  simpa [negRootWt_finsetToFinsupp] using hS

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_setOf_pairWeight_eq
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_pairWeight_eq (β : Dual K H) :
    {p : Finset (NegRootIndex P) × (NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) |
      Finsupp.PairInvolution.pairWeight NegRootIndex.root p = β}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := finite_setOf_negRootWt_eq P β
  refine (T.biUnion fun t _ ↦ ((t.support.powerset : Set (Finset (NegRootIndex P))).toFinite.prod
    (Set.finite_Icc 0 t))).subset fun p hp ↦ ?_
  refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := finsetToFinsupp P p.1 + p.2) ?_ ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change negRootWt P _ = β
    rw [negRootWt_add, negRootWt_finsetToFinsupp]
    exact hp
  · refine Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_powerset.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    simp [finsetToFinsupp_apply, hx]
  · exact ⟨zero_le, le_add_self⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isPWO_iUnion_support_single
statement:
lemma isPWO_iUnion_support_single {α : Type*} (f : α → Dual K H) (c : α → ℤ)
    (hf : ∀ a, ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ f a = P.rootOf k) :
    (⋃ a, (HahnSeries.single (toWeightOrd P (-f a)) (c a) : P.CharacterRing ℤ).support).IsPWO
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPWO_Ici P (toWeightOrd P 0)).mono (Set.iUnion_subset fun a μ hμ ↦ ?_)
  obtain rfl := support_single_subset hμ
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hfk⟩ := hf a
  exact ⟨k, hk, by simp [hfk]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_kostantSeries
statement:
theorem coeffAt_kostantSeries (β : Dual K H) :
    (kostantSeries P).coeffAt (-β) = kostantPartition P β
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin := finite_setOf_negRootWt_eq P β
  rw [coeffAt, kostantSeries, SummableFamily.coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _
    (s := hfin.toFinset), kostantPartition,
    show Nat.card {s // negRootWt P s = β} = Nat.card {s | negRootWt P s = β} from rfl,
    Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset hfin]
  · rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.cast_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hs
    simp [kostantFamily, (show negRootWt P s = β from hs).symm]
  · intro s hs
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hs
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    by_contra h
    refine hs (coeff_single_of_ne fun hg ↦ h ?_)
    simpa using hg.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator_mul_kostantSeries
statement: theorem denominator_mul_kostantSeries : denominator P * kostantSeries P = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [denominator, kostantSeries, ← SummableFamily.hsum_mul]
  refine HahnSeries.ext (funext fun g ↦ ?_)
  have hfin := finite_setOf_pairWeight_eq P (-ofWeightOrd P g)
  have hmul : ∀ p : Finset (NegRootIndex P) × (NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ),
      ((denominatorFamily P).mul (kostantFamily P) p).coeff g =
        if Finsupp.PairInvolution.pairWeight NegRootIndex.root p = -ofWeightOrd P g then
          (-1) ^ p.1.card else 0 := by
    intro p
    simp only [SummableFamily.mul_toFun, denominatorFamily, kostantFamily,
      SummableFamily.coe_mk, single_mul_single, mul_one, coeff_single]
    refine if_congr ?_ rfl rfl
    rw [← map_add, ← neg_add]
    change _ ↔ finsetWt P p.1 + negRootWt P p.2 = _
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      simp
    · intro h
      rw [h, neg_neg, toWeightOrd_ofWeightOrd]
  rw [SummableFamily.coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := hfin.toFinset)]
  · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦
      (hmul p).trans (ite_eq_left ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hp))]
    rw [Finsupp.PairInvolution.sum_neg_one_pow_card_eq_ite _ _ fun p ↦ Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _,
      coeff_one, neg_eq_zero]
    exact if_congr ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [← toWeightOrd_ofWeightOrd P g, h]; rfl,
      fun h ↦ by rw [h]; rfl⟩ rfl rfl
  · intro p hp
    rw [Function.mem_support, hmul] at hp
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    by_contra h
    exact hp (ite_eq_right h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.character_eq_exp_mul_kostantSeries
statement:
theorem character_eq_exp_mul_kostantSeries (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (isCategoryO P Λ).character = exp P ℤ Λ * kostantSeries P
proof:
:= by
  rw [character_eq]
  congr 1
  ext μ
  rw [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, ← neg_neg μ, coeffAt_kostantSeries,
    ← finrank_weightSpace_sub P 0 (-μ), zero_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.denominator_mul_character
statement:
theorem denominator_mul_character (Λ : Dual K H) :
    denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character = exp P ℤ Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [character_eq_exp_mul_kostantSeries, mul_left_comm, denominator_mul_kostantSeries, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_span_singleton_le_one
statement:
lemma finrank_span_singleton_le_one {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] (u : M) :
    finrank K (K ∙ u) ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (finrank_span_le_card ({u} : Set M)).trans (by simp)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_mem_weightSpace_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ ν, (weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) ν).map (g : X →ₗ[K] Y) ≤
      weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) ν := fun ν ↦ by
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hv
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) _ hle hy (by
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hX, Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hg]
    trivial)
  exact ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_weightSpace_of_injective
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpace_of_injective (f : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {μ : Dual K H} {x : X} (hx : f x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap Y (h P) μ) :
    x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) μ
proof:
:= fun a ↦ hf (by
  rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, hx a, map_smul])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_finrank_of_forall_mem_cone
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_finrank_of_forall_mem_cone (hY : IsCategoryO P Y)
    {b : Dual K H} (hmax : ∀ μ, weightSpace P Y μ ≠ ⊥ → μ ∈ cone P b) :
    hY.multiplicity b = finrank K (weightSpace P Y b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hY.finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum b, finsum_eq_single _ b fun μ hμ ↦ ?_,
    IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self, mul_one]
  by_contra hne
  have h1 := hmax μ (hY.weightSpace_ne_bot_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (left_ne_zero_of_mul hne))
  have h2 := IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
  exact hμ (eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone h1 h2)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_one_of_extension
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_one_of_extension (hX : IsCategoryO P X)
    (hY : IsCategoryO P Y) {a b : Dual K H} (hba : b ∉ cone P a) (hab : a ∈ cone P b)
    (f : VermaModule P b →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ X) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (g : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P a) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hker : ∀ x, g x = 0 → ∃ m, f m = x) (π : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hd : 1 < hY.multiplicity a) : hY.multiplicity b = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hXd := hX.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  have := hY.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap a
  have := hY.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap b
  have hvb : f (VermaModule.hwv P b) ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) b :=
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P f (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P b)
  
  have hXb : ∀ x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap X (h P) b, ∃ c : K, x = c • f (VermaModule.hwv P b) := by
    intro x hx
    have hgx : g x ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P a) (h P) b :=
      map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hx
    rw [show weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P a) (h P) b = ⊥ from
      VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot P a fun k hk hbk ↦ hba ⟨k, hk, hbk⟩] at hgx
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hker x ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hgx)
    have hm := mem_weightSpace_of_injective P f hf hx
    rw [show weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P b) (h P) b = K ∙ VermaModule.hwv P b from
      VermaModule.weightSpace_self P b] at hm
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hm
    exact ⟨c, by rw [map_smul]⟩
  
  have hmax : ∀ ξ, weightSpace P Y ξ ≠ ⊥ → ξ ∈ cone P b := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hξ
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := exists_mem_weightSpace_of_surjective P hXd π hπ hy
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hy0 (by rw [h0, map_zero])
    by_cases hgx : g x = 0
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hker x hgx
      have hm := mem_weightSpace_of_injective P f hf hx
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hx0 (by rw [h0, map_zero])
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P b LieModuleHom.id
        Function.surjective_id hm hm0
      exact ⟨k, hk, hke⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P a LieModuleHom.id
        Function.surjective_id (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hx) hgx
      exact mem_cone_trans ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ hab
  rw [hY.multiplicity_eq_finrank_of_forall_mem_cone P hmax]
  
  have hle : weightSpace P Y b ≤ K ∙ π (f (VermaModule.hwv P b)) := fun y hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := exists_mem_weightSpace_of_surjective P hXd π hπ hy
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hXb x hx
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  
  have hπv : π (f (VermaModule.hwv P b)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hπf : ∀ m, π (f m) = 0 := by
      have hφ : π.comp f = 0 := (VermaModule.eq_zero_iff P (π.comp f)).mpr h0
      exact fun m ↦ LieModuleHom.congr_fun hφ m
    obtain ⟨x₀, -, hgx₀⟩ := exists_mem_weightSpace_of_surjective P hXd g hg
      (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P a)
    have hYa : weightSpace P Y a ≤ K ∙ π x₀ := fun y hy ↦ by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := exists_mem_weightSpace_of_surjective P hXd π hπ hy
      have hgx : g x ∈ K ∙ VermaModule.hwv P a := by
        rw [← show weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P a) (h P) a = K ∙ VermaModule.hwv P a from
          VermaModule.weightSpace_self P a]
        exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P g hx
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hgx
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hker (x - c • x₀) (by rw [map_sub, map_smul, hgx₀, hc, sub_self])
      have : π x = c • π x₀ := by
        rw [← map_smul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← hm, hπf]
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have h1 := hY.multiplicity_le_finrank a
    have h2 : finrank K (weightSpace P Y a) ≤ 1 :=
      (Submodule.finrank_mono hYa).trans (finrank_span_singleton_le_one _)
    omega
  refine le_antisymm ((Submodule.finrank_mono hle).trans (finrank_span_singleton_le_one _)) ?_
  refine Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 ↦ hπv ?_
  have hmem : π (f (VermaModule.hwv P b)) ∈ weightSpace P Y b := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P π hvb
  rw [Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp h0] at hmem
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hmem

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_translation_irreducible_wall_reflection
statement:
theorem multiplicity_translation_irreducible_wall_reflection {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (lam - μ) = ν)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i)
    (hμα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hwall : ∀ v' i', P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v' i' = 0 →
      (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∨
        (v' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i') = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    (hlamα : P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i ≠ 0)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan} (hw : P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i)
    (hwint : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam) :
    ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ)).centralTranslation P
          (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
            (centralCharacter P lam)).multiplicity
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * P.reflectionOf hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i) lam) =
      1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set a := P.weylDot hA' w lam with ha
  set b := P.weylDot hA' (w * P.reflectionOf hA' v i) lam with hb
  
  have hint := integral_sub_of_apply_eq hA hν hz hzν
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hint v i).mpr ⟨0, by rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact hμα⟩
  change P.corootPairing _ (lam + P.rho) v i = n at hn
  have hn0 : n < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hlam v i hv n hn)
    (by rintro rfl; exact hlamα (by simp [hn]))
  have hba : b ∉ cone P a := weylDot_mul_reflectionOf_notMem_cone hA hn0 hn hw
  have hab : a ∈ cone P b := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := hw
    refine ⟨(-n) • l, smul_nonneg (by omega) hl, ?_⟩
    simp only [ha, hb, weylDot]
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', hn, map_sub, map_smul,
      ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, hwl, map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
    push_cast
    module
  
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸
      centralBlock_verma P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)
  obtain ⟨S, hS, ⟨eS⟩, ⟨eQ⟩⟩ := translation_verma_shortExact_of_isAntidominant hA hlam hμ hν hz
    hzν hv hμα hwall hlamα hw
  let T := centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ) ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν)
    (centralCharacter P lam)
  have hT := ((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)).tensorProduct
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν)).lieSubmodule T
  let f : VermaModule P b →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T := (LieSubmodule.inclusion hS).comp eS.toLieModuleHom
  let qT : T →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ T.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S) :=
    LieModuleHom.codRestrict _ ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' S).comp T.incl)
      (fun t ↦ (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mpr ⟨t, t.2, rfl⟩)
  let g : T →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P a := eQ.symm.toLieModuleHom.comp qT
  have hf : Function.Injective f := fun m m' hmm ↦
    eS.injective (LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective hS hmm)
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro y
