    obtain ⟨t, ht, hte⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp (eQ y).2
    refine ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [g, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom]
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    exact Subtype.ext hte
  have hker : ∀ x, g x = 0 → ∃ m, f m = x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : qT x = 0 := by
      have := congrArg eQ hx
      simp only [g, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
        LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] at this
      exact this
    have h2 : x.1 ∈ S := (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp (congrArg Subtype.val h1)
    exact ⟨eS.symm ⟨x.1, h2⟩, Subtype.ext (by simp [f])⟩
  
  let e := centralBlockEquiv P (rTensorEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
    (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hMχ)) (centralCharacter P lam)
  let π := (centralTranslationMap P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P μ)
    (centralCharacter P lam) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.maxSubmodule P
      (P.weylDot hA' w μ)))).comp e.symm.toLieModuleHom
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := (centralTranslationMap_surjective P
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _) (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) _ _ _
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)).comp e.symm.surjective
  have hd := multiplicity_translation_irreducible_wall P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν hv hμα hwall
    hlamα hw hwint
  exact IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_one_of_extension P hT _ hba hab f hf g hg hker π hπ
    (by rw [hd]; norm_num)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_section_of_comp_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : q (g (hwv P μ)) ∈ K ∙ hwv P μ := by
    rw [← weightSpace_self]
    exact ExtOne.map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (q.comp g) (hwv_mem_weightSpace P μ)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hg
    refine VermaModule.hom_ext P μ ?_
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ← hc, zero_smul, _root_.zero_apply]
  refine ⟨c⁻¹ • g, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  have : q.comp (c⁻¹ • g) = LieModuleHom.id := by
    refine VermaModule.hom_ext P μ ?_
    change q (c⁻¹ • g (hwv P μ)) = hwv P μ
    rw [map_smul, ← hc, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0, one_smul]
  exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun this m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.exists_section_or_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.exists_section_or_eq_zero {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra X}
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hN : IsStdFiltered P N s) {μ : Dual K H}
    (q : E →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ) (φ : X →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ E)
    (hker : ∀ ν ∈ s, ∀ g : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ E, q.comp g = 0 → g = 0)
    (heq : ∀ ν ∈ s, ∀ g : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ, g ≠ 0 →
      ν = μ) :
    (∃ σ : VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ E, ∀ m, q (σ m) = m) ∨
      ∀ x ∈ N, φ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hN with
  | bot => exact Or.inr fun x hx ↦ by rw [(LieSubmodule.mem_bot x).mp hx, map_zero]
  | @step N₀ N₁ s₀ ν _ hle he ih =>
    rcases ih (fun ν' hν' ↦ hker ν' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν'))
      (fun ν' hν' ↦ heq ν' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hν')) with hsec | h0
    · exact Or.inl hsec
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    have hker₀ : N₀ ≤ φ.ker := fun x hx ↦ LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mpr (h0 x hx)
    let φ' : (X ⧸ N₀) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ E := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift N₀ φ hker₀
    let g : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ E :=
      φ'.comp ((N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀)).incl.comp e.toLieModuleHom)
    by_cases hqg : q.comp g = 0
    · have hg0 := hker ν (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _) g hqg
      refine Or.inr fun x hx ↦ ?_
      have hmem : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀ x ∈ N₁.map (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N₀) :=
        LieSubmodule.mem_map_of_mem hx
      have hgx : g (e.symm ⟨_, hmem⟩) = φ x := by
        simp only [g, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom,
          LieModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LieSubmodule.incl_apply]
        rfl
      rw [← hgx, hg0, _root_.zero_apply]
    · have hν := heq ν (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _) (q.comp g) hqg
      subst hν
      exact Or.inl (exists_section_of_comp_ne_zero P hqg)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isStronglyLinked_of_extOne_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, fun hμ ↦ hy ?_⟩
  swap
  · subst hμ
    exact extOne_verma_eq_zero P LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id
      (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl) y
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ExtOne.mk_surjective y
  set q := ExtOne.Extension.snd c
  have hE : IsCategoryO P (ExtOne.Extension c) :=
    (isCategoryO P lam).extension P (isCategoryO P μ) c
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -, -⟩ := ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered P μ hA
  
  have hmult : ∀ ν ∈ t, (isCategoryO P ν).multiplicity μ ≠ 0 := fun ν hν ↦ by
    rw [← ProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity P μ hA ht ν]
    exact (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hν).ne'
  by_cases hhom : ∃ ν ∈ t, ∃ g : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P lam,
      g ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨ν, hν, g, hg⟩ := hhom
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.trans (isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA
      (multiplicity_ne_zero_of_hom_ne_zero P (φ := g) hg))
      (isStronglyLinked_of_multiplicity_ne_zero P hA (hmult ν hν))
  exfalso
  push Not at hhom
  
  have hker : ∀ ν ∈ t, ∀ g : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ ExtOne.Extension c,
      q.comp g = 0 → g = 0 := by
    intro ν hν g hg
    let i := ExtOne.Extension.inl c
    let r : i.range ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P lam :=
      (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (i.codRestrict i.range fun m ↦ ⟨m, rfl⟩)
        ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ExtOne.Extension.injective_inl c (congrArg Subtype.val hab),
          fun x ↦ by
            obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp x.2
            exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩⟩).symm
    have hmem : ∀ m, g m ∈ i.range := fun m ↦ by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ExtOne.Extension.exists_inl_eq_of_snd_eq_zero c
        (LieModuleHom.congr_fun hg m)
      exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨n, hn⟩
    have h0 := hhom ν hν (r.toLieModuleHom.comp (g.codRestrict i.range hmem))
    ext m
    have hm := LieModuleHom.congr_fun h0 m
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, _root_.zero_apply, LieModuleEquiv.coe_toLieModuleHom] at hm
    have hm' : g.codRestrict i.range hmem m = 0 := by
      simpa using congrArg r.symm hm
    rw [_root_.zero_apply]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hm'
  
  have heq : ∀ ν ∈ t, ∀ g : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ, g ≠ 0 →
      ν = μ := fun ν hν g hg ↦
    eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone (mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
      (multiplicity_ne_zero_of_hom_ne_zero P (φ := g) hg)) (mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
        (hmult ν hν))
  
  obtain ⟨φ₀, hφ₀⟩ := ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA μ (isCategoryO P μ)
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P μ))
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) (ProjectiveCover.π P hA μ)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := ProjectiveCover.isProjectiveO P hA μ hE (isCategoryO P μ) q
    (ExtOne.Extension.surjective_snd c) φ₀
  rcases IsStdFiltered.exists_section_or_eq_zero P ht q φ hker heq with ⟨σ, hσ⟩ | h0
  · exact hy ((ExtOne.mk_eq_zero_iff c).mpr ⟨σ, hσ⟩)
  · apply ProjectiveCover.π_ne_zero P hA μ
    rw [← hφ₀, ← hφ]
    ext x
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, h0 x (LieSubmodule.mem_top x),
      map_zero, map_zero, _root_.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.bruhatLT_of_extOne_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bruhatLT_of_extOne_ne_zero {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    {w w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    {y : ExtOne (h P) (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' Λ))
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w Λ))} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).BruhatLE w w' ∧ w ≠ w' ∧
      (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w <
        (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlink, hne⟩ := isStronglyLinked_of_extOne_ne_zero P hA hy
  obtain ⟨z, hwz, hz⟩ := IsStronglyLinked.exists_bruhatLE_weylDot P hA hΛ hlink
  rw [← weylDot_injective P hA.isGeneralizedCartan hΛ hz] at hwz
  have hww' : w ≠ w' := fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
  exact ⟨hwz, hww', hwz.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left hww'⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.posCone_add
statement:
lemma posCone_add {k l : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) (hl : l ∈ posCone ι) :
    k + l ∈ posCone ι
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨add_nonneg hk.1 hl.1, fun h ↦ hk.2 ?_⟩
  ext i
  have h1 := hk.1 i; have h2 := hl.1 i; have := congr_fun h i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 this ⊢
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.single_mem_posCone
statement: lemma single_mem_posCone [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) : Pi.single i 1 ∈ posCone ι
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by simpa using congr_fun h i⟩
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj; simp
  · simp [hj]

name: Matrix.Realization.posWeights_add
statement:
lemma posWeights_add {μ ν : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) (hν : ν ∈ P.posWeights) :
    μ + ν ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hμ; obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hν
  exact ⟨k + l, posCone_add hk hl, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.negWeights_add
statement:
lemma negWeights_add {μ ν : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.negWeights) (hν : ν ∈ P.negWeights) :
    μ + ν ∈ P.negWeights
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hμ; obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hν
  exact ⟨k + l, posCone_add hk hl, by simp only [map_add, neg_add]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.root_mem_posWeights
statement: lemma root_mem_posWeights (i : ι) : P.root i ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  classical exact ⟨Pi.single i 1, single_mem_posCone i, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.neg_root_mem_negWeights
statement: lemma neg_root_mem_negWeights (i : ι) : -P.root i ∈ P.negWeights
proof:
:= by
  classical exact ⟨Pi.single i 1, single_mem_posCone i, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.zero_notMem_posWeights
statement: lemma zero_notMem_posWeights : (0 : Dual K H) ∉ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, hk, h0⟩
  exact P.rootOf_ne_zero hk.2 h0

name: Matrix.Realization.zero_notMem_negWeights
statement: lemma zero_notMem_negWeights : (0 : Dual K H) ∉ P.negWeights
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, hk, h0⟩
  exact P.rootOf_ne_zero hk.2 (neg_eq_zero.mp h0)

name: Matrix.Realization.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights
statement: lemma disjoint_posWeights_negWeights : Disjoint P.posWeights P.negWeights
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ ⟨l, hl, hlk⟩
  have : P.rootOf (k + l) = 0 := by rw [map_add, ← hlk]; simp
  exact P.rootOf_ne_zero (posCone_add hk hl).2 this

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.e_mem_rootSpace
statement: lemma e_mem_rootSpace (i : ι) : e P i ∈ rootSpace P (P.root i)
proof: := fun a ↦ lie_h_e P a i

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.f_mem_rootSpace
statement: lemma f_mem_rootSpace (i : ι) : f P i ∈ rootSpace P (-P.root i)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  simp [lie_h_f]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.h_mem_rootSpace
statement: lemma h_mem_rootSpace (a : H) : h P a ∈ rootSpace P 0
proof: := fun b ↦ by simp [lie_h_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma lie_mem_rootSpace {μ ν : Dual K H} {x y : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ)
    (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P ν) : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ rootSpace P (μ + ν)
proof:
:=
  lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_mem_biSup
statement:
lemma lie_mem_biSup {S : Set (Dual K H)} (hS : ∀ μ ∈ S, ∀ ν ∈ S, μ + ν ∈ S)
    {x y : P.AuxLieAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ S, rootSpace P μ) (hy : y ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ S, rootSpace P μ) :
    ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ S, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_subtype''] at hx hy ⊢
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun x ↦ ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ _) hx (fun μ x hx ↦ ?_)
    (by simp) (fun x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [add_lie]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂)
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun y ↦ ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ _) hy (fun ν y hy ↦ ?_)
    (by simp) (fun y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [lie_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂)
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ⟨_, hS _ μ.2 _ ν.2⟩ (lie_mem_rootSpace P hx hy)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.fHom_mem
statement: lemma fHom_mem (y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : fHom P y ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i =>
    rw [fHom_of]
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (P.neg_root_mem_negWeights i)
      (f_mem_rootSpace P i))
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    rw [LieHom.map_lie]; exact lie_mem_biSup P (fun _ h₁ _ h₂ ↦ P.negWeights_add h₁ h₂) hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_mem
statement: lemma eHom_mem (z : FreeLieAlgebra K ι) : eHom P z ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  induction z using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i =>
    rw [eHom_of]
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (P.root_mem_posWeights i)
      (e_mem_rootSpace P i))
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    rw [LieHom.map_lie]; exact lie_mem_biSup P (fun _ h₁ _ h₂ ↦ P.posWeights_add h₁ h₂) hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.h_mem_biSup
statement: lemma h_mem_biSup (a : H) : h P a ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ ({0} : Set (Dual K H)), rootSpace P μ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem rfl (h_mem_rootSpace P a))

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.iSup_rootSpace_eq_top
statement: lemma iSup_rootSpace_eq_top : ⨆ μ ∈ allWeights P, rootSpace P μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  obtain ⟨⟨y, a, z⟩, rfl⟩ := (triangularEquiv P).surjective x
  rw [triangularEquiv_apply]
  have h1 : ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ allWeights P, rootSpace P μ :=
    biSup_mono fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl hμ)
  have h2 : ⨆ μ ∈ ({0} : Set (Dual K H)), rootSpace P μ ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ allWeights P, rootSpace P μ :=
    biSup_mono fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inl (Or.inr hμ)
  have h3 : ⨆ μ ∈ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ allWeights P, rootSpace P μ :=
    biSup_mono fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inr hμ
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (h1 (fHom_mem P y)) (h2 (h_mem_biSup P a)))
    (h3 (eHom_mem P z))

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.disjoint_biSup
statement:
lemma disjoint_biSup {S T : Set (Dual K H)} (hST : Disjoint S T) :
    Disjoint (⨆ μ ∈ S, rootSpace P μ) (⨆ μ ∈ T, rootSpace P μ)
proof:
:=
  (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (h P)).disjoint_biSup_biSup hST

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.mem_biSup_of_subset
statement:
lemma mem_biSup_of_subset {S T : Set (Dual K H)} (hST : ∀ μ ∈ S, μ ∈ T) {x : P.AuxLieAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ S, rootSpace P μ) : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ T, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:=
  (biSup_mono hST : (⨆ μ ∈ S, rootSpace P μ) ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ T, rootSpace P μ) hx

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_le_biSup
statement:
lemma rootSpace_le_biSup {μ : Dual K H} {S : Set (Dual K H)} (hμ : μ ∈ S) :
    rootSpace P μ ≤ ⨆ ν ∈ S, rootSpace P ν
proof:
:=
  le_biSup (fun ν ↦ rootSpace P ν) hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_zero
statement: theorem rootSpace_zero : rootSpace P 0 = LinearMap.range (h P)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · obtain ⟨⟨y, a, z⟩, rfl⟩ := (triangularEquiv P).surjective x
    rw [triangularEquiv_apply] at hx ⊢
    have hS : Disjoint ({0} : Set (Dual K H)) (P.negWeights ∪ P.posWeights) :=
      Set.disjoint_singleton_left.mpr fun h ↦
        h.elim P.zero_notMem_negWeights P.zero_notMem_posWeights
    have hmem : fHom P y + eHom P z ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights ∪ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ :=
      Submodule.add_mem _ (mem_biSup_of_subset P (fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inl hμ) (fHom_mem P y))
        (mem_biSup_of_subset P (fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inr hμ) (eHom_mem P z))
    have hmem0 : fHom P y + eHom P z ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ ({0} : Set (Dual K H)), rootSpace P μ := by
      have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hx (h_mem_rootSpace P a)
      rw [add_right_comm, add_sub_cancel_right] at this
      exact rootSpace_le_biSup P (Set.mem_singleton 0) this
    have h0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (disjoint_biSup P hS) _ hmem0 hmem
    rw [add_right_comm, add_comm, h0, add_zero]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact h_mem_rootSpace P a

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_pos_le
statement:
theorem rootSpace_pos_le {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    rootSpace P μ ≤ LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨y, a, z⟩, rfl⟩ := (triangularEquiv P).surjective x
  rw [triangularEquiv_apply] at hx ⊢
  have hS : Disjoint (P.negWeights ∪ {0}) (P.posWeights) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨P.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights.symm, by simp [P.zero_notMem_posWeights]⟩
  have hmem1 : fHom P y + h P a ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights ∪ {0}, rootSpace P μ :=
    Submodule.add_mem _ (mem_biSup_of_subset P (fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inl hμ) (fHom_mem P y))
      (mem_biSup_of_subset P (fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inr hμ) (h_mem_biSup P a))
  have hmem2 : fHom P y + h P a ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ := by
    have := Submodule.sub_mem _ (rootSpace_le_biSup P hμ hx) (eHom_mem P z)
    convert this using 1; abel
  have h0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (disjoint_biSup P hS) _ hmem1 hmem2
  rw [h0, zero_add]
  exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_le
statement:
theorem rootSpace_neg_le {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.negWeights) :
    rootSpace P μ ≤ LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨y, a, z⟩, rfl⟩ := (triangularEquiv P).surjective x
  rw [triangularEquiv_apply] at hx ⊢
  have hS : Disjoint ({0} ∪ P.posWeights) (P.negWeights) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by simp [zero_notMem_negWeights], P.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights⟩
  have hmem1 : h P a + eHom P z ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ {0} ∪ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ :=
    Submodule.add_mem _ (mem_biSup_of_subset P (fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inl hμ) (h_mem_biSup P a))
      (mem_biSup_of_subset P (fun μ hμ ↦ Or.inr hμ) (eHom_mem P z))
  have hmem2 : h P a + eHom P z ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ := by
    have := Submodule.sub_mem _ (rootSpace_le_biSup P hμ hx) (fHom_mem P y)
    convert this using 1; abel
  have h0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (disjoint_biSup P hS) _ hmem1 hmem2
  rw [add_assoc, h0, add_zero]
  exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_mem
statement:
lemma lie_h_mem (I : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra) (a : H) :
    ∀ x ∈ I.toSubmodule, ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ I.toSubmodule
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ I.lie_mem hx

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.le_of_inf_eq_bot
proof:
:= by
  have hle := inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (h P) I.toSubmodule
    (lie_h_mem P I) (allWeights P)
  rw [iSup_rootSpace_eq_top, inf_top_eq] at hle
  refine hle.trans (iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ ?_)
  rcases hμ with (hμ | hμ) | hμ
  · exact inf_le_right.trans (rootSpace_le_biSup P (Or.inl hμ))
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hμ]
    exact (inf_le_inf_left _ (rootSpace_zero P).le).trans (hI.le.trans bot_le)
  · exact inf_le_right.trans (rootSpace_le_biSup P (Or.inr hμ))

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_le
statement:
lemma maxIdeal_le : (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule ≤
    ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights ∪ P.posWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  change (sSup _ : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra).toSubmodule ≤ _
  rw [LieSubmodule.sSup_toSubmodule]
  refine sSup_le ?_
  rintro _ ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩
  exact le_of_inf_eq_bot P hI

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_inf_range_h
statement:
theorem maxIdeal_inf_range_h :
    (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rootSpace_zero]
  have hS : Disjoint (P.negWeights ∪ P.posWeights) ({0} : Set (Dual K H)) :=
    Set.disjoint_singleton_right.mpr fun h ↦
      h.elim P.zero_notMem_negWeights P.zero_notMem_posWeights
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x ⟨hx, hx0⟩ ↦ ?_
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (disjoint_biSup P hS) x (maxIdeal_le P hx)
    (rootSpace_le_biSup P (Set.mem_singleton 0) hx0)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.le_maxIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem le_maxIdeal_iff (I : LieIdeal K P.AuxLieAlgebra) :
    I ≤ maxIdeal P ↔ I.toSubmodule ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hI ↦ eq_bot_iff.mpr ?_, fun hI ↦ le_sSup hI⟩
  rw [← maxIdeal_inf_range_h P]
  exact inf_le_inf_right _ fun x hx ↦ hI hx

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem maxIdeal_eq : (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule =
    (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule ⊓
        LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) ⊔
      (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule ⊓
        LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le inf_le_left inf_le_left)
  have hle := inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (h P) (maxIdeal P).toSubmodule
    (lie_h_mem P _) (P.negWeights ∪ P.posWeights)
  rw [inf_eq_left.mpr (maxIdeal_le P)] at hle
  refine hle.trans (iSup₂_le fun μ hμ ↦ ?_)
  rcases hμ with hμ | hμ
  · exact le_sup_of_le_left (inf_le_inf_left _ (rootSpace_neg_le P hμ))
  · exact le_sup_of_le_right (inf_le_inf_left _ (rootSpace_pos_le P hμ))

name: LieModule.exists_toEnd_pow_lie_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_toEnd_pow_lie_eq_zero {x y : L} {m : M} (hy : ∃ n, (ad K L x ^ n) y = 0)
    (hm : ∃ n, (toEnd K L M x ^ n) m = 0) : ∃ n, (toEnd K L M x ^ n) ⁅y, m⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hm
  refine ⟨a + b, ?_⟩
  rw [toEnd_pow_lie]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ij hij ↦ ?_
  obtain (h | h) : a ≤ ij.1 ∨ b ≤ ij.2 := by rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hij; omega
  · rw [Module.End.pow_map_zero_of_le h ha, zero_lie, smul_zero]
  · rw [Module.End.pow_map_zero_of_le h hb, lie_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieModule.mem_locallyNilpotentSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_locallyNilpotentSubmodule {x : L} (hx : ∀ y : L, ∃ n, (ad K L x ^ n) y = 0)
    {m : M} : m ∈ locallyNilpotentSubmodule K L M x hx ↔ ∃ n, (toEnd K L M x ^ n) m = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: LieModule.exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan
statement:
theorem exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan {x : L} (hx : ∀ y : L, ∃ n, (ad K L x ^ n) y = 0)
    {S : Set M} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L S = ⊤)
    (hSx : ∀ m ∈ S, ∃ n, (toEnd K L M x ^ n) m = 0) (m : M) :
    ∃ n, (toEnd K L M x ^ n) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L S ≤ locallyNilpotentSubmodule K L M x hx :=
    LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr hSx
  rw [hS] at this
  exact this (LieSubmodule.mem_top m)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsHDiagonalizable.isInternal_weightSpace
statement:
theorem IsHDiagonalizable.isInternal_weightSpace (hV : IsHDiagonalizable P V) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (weightSpace P V)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := V) (h P)) hV

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P V μ) :
    toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (e P i) v ∈ weightSpace P V (μ + P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (fun a ↦ lie_h_e P a i) hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toEnd_f_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma toEnd_f_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P V μ) :
    toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (f P i) v ∈ weightSpace P V (μ - P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_neg_add]
  refine lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (fun a ↦ ?_) hv
  rw [lie_h_f, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toEnd_e_pow_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma toEnd_e_pow_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P V μ)
    (n : ℕ) : (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (e P i) ^ n) v ∈ weightSpace P V (μ + n • P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, succ_nsmul, ← add_assoc]
    exact toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace i ih

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toEnd_f_pow_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma toEnd_f_pow_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P V μ)
    (n : ℕ) : (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (f P i) ^ n) v ∈ weightSpace P V (μ - n • P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, succ_nsmul, ← sub_sub]
    exact toEnd_f_mem_weightSpace i ih

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma induction_on {p : P.KacMoodyAlgebra → Prop} (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (he : ∀ i, p (e P i)) (hf : ∀ i, p (f P i)) (hh : ∀ a, p (h P a)) (zero : p 0)
    (add : ∀ y z, p y → p z → p (y + z)) (smul : ∀ (a : K) y, p y → p (a • y))
    (lie : ∀ y z, p y → p z → p ⁅y, z⁆) : p y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P y
  induction x using AuxLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | he i => exact he i
  | hf i => exact hf i
  | hh a => exact hh a
  | zero => simpa using zero
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hy hz
  | smul a y hy => rw [map_smul]; exact smul a _ hy
  | lie y z hy hz => rw [LieHom.map_lie]; exact lie _ _ hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_ad_pow_add_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_ad_pow_add_eq_zero {x y z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hy : ∃ n, (ad K _ x ^ n) y = 0)
    (hz : ∃ n, (ad K _ x ^ n) z = 0) : ∃ n, (ad K _ x ^ n) (y + z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨a + b, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, Module.End.pow_map_zero_of_le (Nat.le_add_right a b) ha,
    Module.End.pow_map_zero_of_le (Nat.le_add_left b a) hb, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isHDiagonalizable_adjoint
statement: theorem isHDiagonalizable_adjoint : IsHDiagonalizable P P.KacMoodyAlgebra
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr ((iSup_rootSpace_eq_top P).symm.le.trans
    (iSup₂_le fun μ _ ↦ le_iSup (weightSpace P P.KacMoodyAlgebra) μ))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero (i : ι) (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    ∃ n, (ad K _ (e P i) ^ n) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | he j =>
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · refine ⟨(-A i j).toNat + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, serre_e P hA hij]
  | hf j =>
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      have h1 : ⁅e P i, h P (P.coroot i)⁆ = -((2 : K) • e P i) := by
        rw [← lie_skew, lie_h_e, P.root_coroot, hA.diag]
        norm_num
      refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
      simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, lie_e_f_self, h1,
        lie_neg, lie_smul, lie_self, smul_zero, neg_zero]
    · exact ⟨1, by simp [lie_e_f_of_ne P hij]⟩
  | hh a =>
    refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply]
    rw [← lie_skew (e P i) (h P a), lie_h_e, lie_neg, lie_smul, lie_self, smul_zero, neg_zero]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add y z hy hz => exact exists_ad_pow_add_eq_zero P hy hz
  | smul c y hy =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨n, by rw [map_smul, hn, smul_zero]⟩
  | lie y z hy hz => exact exists_toEnd_pow_lie_eq_zero hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero (i : ι) (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    ∃ n, (ad K _ (f P i) ^ n) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero P hA i (chevalleyInvolution P y)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  have := congr_arg (chevalleyInvolution P) hn
  rw [LieHom.map_ad_pow, chevalleyInvolution_e, chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution,
    map_zero, ad_neg_pow_apply] at this
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isIntegrable_adjoint
statement:
theorem isIntegrable_adjoint : IsIntegrable P P.KacMoodyAlgebra where
  isHDiagonalizable
proof:
:= isHDiagonalizable_adjoint P
  exists_pow_e_eq_zero := exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero P hA
  exists_pow_f_eq_zero := exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero P hA

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsFGProjectiveO.finrank_hom_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem IsFGProjectiveO.finrank_hom_restrictedDual {Q : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup Q]
    [Module K Q] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q]
    (hQ : IsFGProjectiveO P Q) {Y : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module K Y]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Y]
    (hY : IsCategoryO P Y) :
    finrank K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P Y) = finrank K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hQ.isCategoryO.exists_strictMono_lieSubmodule P hA hQ.fg.choose_spec
  suffices key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (Q : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module K Q]
      [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q],
      IsFGProjectiveO P Q → ∀ f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 Q → ℕ, StrictMono f → f ⊤ < n →
      finrank K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P Y) = finrank K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Y) from
    key _ Q hQ f hf (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hn; exact absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
  intro Q _ _ _ _ hQ f hf hn
  by_cases hQt : Nontrivial Q
  · obtain ⟨Λ, φ, hφ⟩ := hQ.isCategoryO.exists_surjective_irreducibleModule P hA
      hQ.fg.choose_spec
    obtain ⟨s, r, hrs⟩ := hQ.exists_retract hA φ hφ
    have hlt : f ((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 r.ker).map r.ker.incl) < n := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.map_incl_top]
      have := hf (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (IsFGProjectiveO.ker_ne_top hA hrs))
      omega
    have h1 := hQ.finrank_hom_eq_add hA hrs (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hY)
    have h2 := hQ.finrank_hom_eq_add hA hrs hY
    have h3 := ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (P := P) (hA := hA) (Λ := Λ)
      (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hY)
    have h4 := ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (P := P) (hA := hA) (Λ := Λ) hY
    have h5 := multiplicity_restrictedDual hY Λ
    have h6 := ih r.ker (hQ.ker hrs) _ (r.ker.strictMono_map_incl hf) hlt
    omega
  · rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hQt
    have hzero {Z : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]
        [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra Z] :
        finrank K (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z) = 0 := by
      have : Subsingleton (Q →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z) :=
        ⟨fun a b ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ by rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
      exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
    rw [hzero, hzero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_forall_sum_multiplicity_eq
proof:
:=
  Multiset.eq_of_forall_sum_map_eq (o := fun μ ↦ OrderDual.toDual (toWeightOrd P μ))
    (fun _ _ hab ↦ (toWeightOrd P).injective (OrderDual.toDual.injective hab))
    (w := fun Λ κ ↦ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity κ)
    (fun Λ ↦ VermaModule.multiplicity_self Λ)
    (fun _ _ hne ↦ OrderDual.toDual_le_toDual.mpr
      ((toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
        (VermaModule.mem_cone_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hne))) s s' h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_blockWeights
statement: theorem finite_blockWeights (lam : Dual K H) : (blockWeights P hA lam).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  exact (Set.finite_range fun w ↦ P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam).subset
    fun _ ⟨w, _, hχ⟩ ↦ ⟨w, hχ.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isInBlock_verma_of_mem
statement:
theorem isInBlock_verma_of_mem {lam Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : Λ ∈ blockWeights P hA lam) :
    IsInBlock P hA lam (VermaModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hΛ
  exact BlockProjectiveFunctor.isInBlock_verma_weylDot hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_blockWeights_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
proof:
:=
  (isInBlock_verma_of_mem hΛ).multiplicity_ne_zero χ h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_blockWeights_of_multiplicity_ne_zero'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hψ
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxΛ⟩ := (isInBlock_verma P hA Λ).multiplicity_ne_zero _ h
  refine ⟨x⁻¹ * w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot] at hw hx ⊢
    change P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam ∈ P.rootLattice at hw
    change P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x Λ - Λ ∈ P.rootLattice at hx
    change P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x⁻¹ * w) lam - lam ∈ P.rootLattice
    have h1 : P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (x⁻¹ * w) lam = Λ := by
      rw [weylDot_mul, hxΛ, ← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one]
    have h2 : Λ - lam = -(P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x Λ - Λ) +
        (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam) := by
      rw [← hxΛ]
      abel
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact add_mem (neg_mem hx) hw
  · rw [weylDot_mul, hxΛ, ← weylDot_mul, inv_mul_cancel, weylDot_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isInBlock_projectiveCover
statement:
theorem isInBlock_projectiveCover {lam ψ : Dual K H} (hψ : ψ ∈ blockWeights P hA lam) :
    IsInBlock P hA lam (ProjectiveCover P hA ψ) where
  isCategoryO
proof:
:= ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA ψ
  exists_finset := (ProjectiveCover.isFGProjectiveO P hA ψ).fg
  multiplicity_ne_zero κ hκ := by
    classical
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -, -⟩ := ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered P ψ hA
    have hX := ProjectiveCover.isCategoryO P hA ψ
    have hsum := IsStdFiltered.multiplicity_eq_sum hX ht κ
    have htop := IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (hX.lieSubmodule ⊤) hX (topEquiv P _) κ
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛt, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ ∈ t, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity κ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_not] at hcon
      refine hκ ?_
      change hX.multiplicity κ = 0
      rw [← htop, hsum]
      exact Multiset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx ↦ by
        obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
        exact hcon Λ hΛ
    have hΛψ : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity ψ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← ProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity P ψ hA ht Λ]
      exact Multiset.count_ne_zero.mpr hΛt
    exact mem_blockWeights_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
      (mem_blockWeights_of_multiplicity_ne_zero' hψ hΛψ) hΛ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.exists_isStdFiltered_verma
statement:
theorem exists_isStdFiltered_verma {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : IsInBlock P hA lam (VermaModule P Λ)) :
    ∃ s, IsStdFiltered P (F.idem (VermaModule P Λ)).range s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma P
    (isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional (V := V) hA) Λ
  have hY := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V)
  exact exists_isStdFiltered_range P _ hY _ rfl hs _ (F.idem_mul_idem hΛ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.isFGProjectiveO_range
statement:
theorem isFGProjectiveO_range {Q : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module K Q]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 Q] [LieModule K 𝔤 Q] (hQb : IsInBlock P hA lam Q)
    (hQ : IsFGProjectiveO P Q) : IsFGProjectiveO P (F.idem Q).range
proof:
:= by
  have he : (F.idem Q).comp (F.idem Q) = F.idem Q := F.idem_mul_idem hQb
  refine ⟨?_, F.isCategoryO_range hQ.isCategoryO, ?_⟩
  · exact (hQ.isProjectiveO.tensorProduct P
      (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) (Module.Dual K V))).of_retract
      (F.idem Q).range.incl (rangeRetr _) (rangeRetr_comp_incl he)
  · obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_tensor_eq_top (W := V) hQ.fg.choose_spec
    classical
    refine ⟨T.image (rangeRetr (F.idem Q)), ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.coe_image]
    exact lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective _ (surjective_rangeRetr he) hT

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_projectiveCover
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hQ := ProjectiveCover.isFGProjectiveO P hA ψ
  have hFQ := F.isFGProjectiveO_range hψ hQ
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hFQ.isProjectiveO.exists_isStdFiltered P hA hFQ.isCategoryO
    hFQ.fg.choose_spec
  let sF : Dual K H → Multiset (Dual K H) := fun Λ ↦
    if h : ∃ s, IsStdFiltered P (F.idem (VermaModule P Λ)).range s then h.choose else 0
  have hsF : ∀ Λ ∈ t, IsStdFiltered P (F.idem (VermaModule P Λ)).range (sF Λ) := fun Λ hΛ ↦ by
    have h := F.exists_isStdFiltered_verma (htb Λ hΛ)
    simp only [sF, h, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact h.choose_spec
  have hY : ∀ Λ, IsCategoryO P (VermaModule P Λ ⊗[K] V) := fun Λ ↦
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).tensorProduct
      (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) V)
  have hTop := hψ.lieSubmodule ⊤
  have huF : u = t.bind sF := by
    refine eq_of_forall_sum_multiplicity_eq P fun κ ↦ ?_
    rw [← IsStdFiltered.multiplicity_eq_sum hFQ.isCategoryO hu κ,
      IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr _ hFQ.isCategoryO (topEquiv P _) κ,
      ← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr (F.isCategoryO_range hTop.isCategoryO) hFQ.isCategoryO
        (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (F.map hTop hψ (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 _).incl)
          ⟨F.map_injective hTop hψ Subtype.val_injective,
            F.map_surjective hTop hψ fun x ↦ ⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, rfl⟩⟩) κ,
      F.multiplicity_eq_sum_of_isStdFiltered hψ ht κ, Multiset.map_bind, Multiset.sum_bind]
    refine congrArg Multiset.sum (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_)
    exact IsStdFiltered.multiplicity_eq_sum (hY Λ) (hsF Λ hΛ) κ
  rw [vermaMult, ← hu.count_eq_finrank_hom hFQ.isCategoryO ν, huF, Multiset.count_bind]
  refine congrArg Multiset.sum (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_)
  exact F.count_eq_vermaMult (htb Λ hΛ) (F.isCategoryO_range (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ))
    (hsF Λ hΛ) ν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.vermaMult_eq_vermaMult_of_adjoint
statement:
theorem vermaMult_eq_vermaMult_of_adjoint {μ : Dual K H} {W : Type (max u₁ u₂)}
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (G : BlockProjectiveFunctor P hA μ W) (hG : G.MapsTo lam)
    (hadj : ∀ (M N : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
      [LieModule K 𝔤 M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [LieRingModule 𝔤 N] [LieModule K 𝔤 N],
      IsInBlock P hA lam M → IsInBlock P hA μ N →
      Nonempty (((F.idem M).range →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) ≃ₗ[K] (M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ (G.idem N).range)))
    {χ ν : Dual K H} (hχ : χ ∈ blockWeights P hA lam) (hν : ν ∈ blockWeights P hA μ) :
    F.vermaMult (VermaModule P χ) ν = G.vermaMult (VermaModule P ν) χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hνb := isInBlock_verma_of_mem hν
  have hGM := hG _ hνb
  obtain ⟨sG, hsG⟩ := G.exists_isStdFiltered_verma hνb
  have hY : IsCategoryO P (VermaModule P ν ⊗[K] W) :=
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν).tensorProduct
      (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) W)
  set B := (finite_blockWeights P hA lam).toFinset
  set a : Dual K H → ℕ := fun Λ ↦ F.vermaMult (VermaModule P Λ) ν
  have key : sG = B.val.bind fun Λ ↦ Multiset.replicate (a Λ) Λ := by
    refine eq_of_forall_sum_multiplicity_eq P fun ψ ↦ ?_
    rw [← IsStdFiltered.multiplicity_eq_sum hY hsG ψ, Multiset.map_bind, Multiset.sum_bind]
    simp only [Multiset.map_replicate, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
    by_cases hψ : ψ ∈ blockWeights P hA lam
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, -, -⟩ := ProjectiveCover.exists_isStdFiltered P ψ hA
      have hcount := ProjectiveCover.count_eq_multiplicity P ψ hA ht
      have htb : ∀ Λ ∈ t, Λ ∈ blockWeights P hA lam := fun Λ hΛ ↦
        mem_blockWeights_of_multiplicity_ne_zero' hψ (by
          rw [← hcount Λ]
          exact Multiset.count_ne_zero.mpr hΛ)
      have hPb := isInBlock_projectiveCover hψ
      have hFQ := F.isFGProjectiveO_range hPb (ProjectiveCover.isFGProjectiveO P hA ψ)
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := hadj _ _ hPb hνb
      have h1 := ProjectiveCover.finrank_hom_eq_multiplicity (P := P) (hA := hA) (Λ := ψ)
        (G.isCategoryO_range (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν))
      have h2 := hFQ.finrank_hom_restrictedDual P hA (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν)
      have h3 := F.vermaMult_projectiveCover hPb ht (fun Λ hΛ ↦ isInBlock_verma_of_mem (htb Λ hΛ)) ν
      rw [vermaMult] at h3
      change (G.isCategoryO_range (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν)).multiplicity ψ = _
      rw [← h1, ← e.finrank_eq, ← h2, h3, Finset.sum_multiset_map_count]
      rw [Finset.sum_subset (s₂ := B) (fun Λ hΛ ↦ (finite_blockWeights P hA lam).mem_toFinset.mpr
        (htb Λ (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hΛ))) (fun Λ _ hΛ ↦ by
          rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr fun h ↦ hΛ (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr h), zero_smul])]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun Λ _ ↦ ?_
      rw [hcount Λ, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    · have h0 : (G.isCategoryO_range (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν)).multiplicity ψ = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hψ (hGM.multiplicity_ne_zero ψ h)
      change (G.isCategoryO_range (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν)).multiplicity ψ = _
      rw [h0]
      refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_).symm
      have hΛ' := (finite_blockWeights P hA lam).mem_toFinset.mp hΛ
      by_cases hm : (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).multiplicity ψ = 0
      · rw [hm, mul_zero]
      · exact absurd (mem_blockWeights_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hΛ' hm) hψ
  have hχB : χ ∈ B := (finite_blockWeights P hA lam).mem_toFinset.mpr hχ
  rw [← G.count_eq_vermaMult hνb (G.isCategoryO_range (VermaModule.isCategoryO P ν)) hsG χ, key,
    Multiset.count_bind, ← Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
  simp only [Multiset.count_replicate]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' B χ a]
  simp only [hχB, ↓reduceIte, a]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_span_map_hwv_of_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  have hmap (μ : Dual K H) : (VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ μ).map (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) ≤
      weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := by
    rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ hm
  have htop : w ∈ ⨆ μ, (VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ μ).map (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] V) := by
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup]
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hφ w
    refine Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ?_
    have hm : m ∈ ⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf k) := by
      rw [VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial
    exact (iSup₂_le fun k _ ↦ le_iSup (VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ) _ :
      _ ≤ ⨆ μ, VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ μ) hm
  have := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) _ hmap hw htop
  rwa [VermaModule.weightSpace_self, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_ne
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_ne [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K H] (S : A.Symmetrization)
    {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) (hμ : P.IsDominantIntegral μ) {k : ι → ℤ}
    (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) (hΛμ : Λ = μ + P.rootOf k) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ ≠ P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ
proof:
:= by
  choose n hn using hΛ
  choose m hm using hμ
  intro heq
  have hsymm := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq
  have h1 : P.dualBilinForm S (P.rootOf k) (Λ + μ + 2 • P.rho) = 0 := by
    rw [hΛμ] at heq ⊢
    simp only [two_nsmul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at heq ⊢
    rw [hsymm μ (P.rootOf k), hsymm P.rho (P.rootOf k)] at heq
    linear_combination heq
  have h2 : P.dualBilinForm S (P.rootOf k) (Λ + μ + 2 • P.rho) =
      ((∑ i, (k i : ℚ) * ((n i + m i + 2) / S.ε i) : ℚ) : K) := by
    rw [rootOf_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hsymm, dualBilinForm_root_right]
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hn, hm, rho_coroot, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hq : (0 : ℚ) < ∑ i, (k i : ℚ) * ((n i + m i + 2) / S.ε i) := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk.2
    refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ ↦ mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hk.1 i)
      (div_nonneg (by positivity) (S.ε_pos i).le)) ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, mul_pos ?_
      (div_pos (by positivity) (S.ε_pos j))⟩
    have := hk.1 j
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hj this
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm hj)
  rw [h2, Rat.cast_eq_zero] at h1
  exact hq.ne' h1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_isIntegrable
proof:
:= by
  refine or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr fun hN ↦ ?_
  have hO : IsCategoryO P V := .of_surjective φ hφ
  have : Nontrivial N := (LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V).mpr hN
  obtain ⟨μ, w, hw, hw0, he⟩ := (hO.lieSubmodule N).exists_lie_e_eq_zero
  have hw' : (w : V) ∈ weightSpace P V μ := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hw
  have he' (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, (w : V)⁆ = 0 := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val (he i)
    rwa [LieSubmodule.coe_bracket] at this
  have hw0' : (w : V) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hw0 (Subtype.ext h0)
  have hv0 : φ (VermaModule.hwv P Λ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hw0' (by
    have htop := VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top φ hφ
    rw [h0] at htop
    have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra ({0} : Set V) ≤ ⊥ :=
      LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr (by simp)
    exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp (hle (htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top (w : V))))
  have hΛ := isDominantIntegral_of_isIntegrable hA hV
    (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ))
    (fun i ↦ by rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero]) hv0
  have hμ := isDominantIntegral_of_isIntegrable hA hV hw' he' hw0'
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hμΛ⟩ := VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ φ hφ hw' hw0'
  have hPF := hO.isPosFinite
  have hΩ : P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ = P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ :=
    smul_left_injective K hw0' ((hB.casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective hA hPF φ hφ (w : V)).symm.trans
      (hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero hPF hw' he'))
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · rw [hk0, map_zero, sub_zero] at hμΛ
    rw [hμΛ] at hw'
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp (mem_span_map_hwv_of_mem_weightSpace φ hφ hw')
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [zero_smul] at hc
      exact hw0' hc.symm
    have hmem : φ (VermaModule.hwv P Λ) ∈ N := by
      have := N.smul_mem c⁻¹ w.2
      rwa [← hc, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0, one_smul] at this
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top φ hφ, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact hmem
  · exact absurd hΩ (dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_ne S hΛ hμ ⟨hk, hk0⟩ (by rw [hμΛ, sub_add_cancel]))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.isIrreducible_of_isIntegrable
proof:
:=
  IsIrreducible.mk fun N hN ↦ (hB.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_isIntegrable hA φ hφ hV N).resolve_left hN

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.toIrreducibleModule_injective
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieModuleHom.ker_eq_bot]
  refine (hB.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_isIntegrable hA (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _)
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) (FPowQuotient.isIntegrable P Λ n hA)
    _).resolve_right fun htop ↦ ?_
  have : FPowQuotient.hwv P Λ n ∈ (FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule P hA hn).ker :=
    htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top _
  rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule_hwv] at this
  exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ this

name: Matrix.Realization.natCast_toNat
statement: private lemma natCast_toNat {z : ℤ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) : ((z.toNat : ℕ) : K) = (z : K)
proof:

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_coroot_eq_sum
statement:
theorem exists_apply_coroot_eq_sum (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hu : u ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ∃ ε : ℤ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧
      ∀ ξ : Dual K H, u ξ (P.coroot i) = ε * ∑ j, (k j : K) * ξ (P.coroot j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u', hu', huu'⟩ := P.exists_coweylGroup_apply_apply hA hu
  rcases P.mem_posRealCoroots_or_neg_mem hA ⟨u', hu', i, rfl⟩ with
    ⟨-, k, hk, hkc⟩ | ⟨-, k, hk, hkc⟩
  · refine ⟨k, hk, 1, Or.inl rfl, fun ξ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [huu', ← hkc, P.apply_corootOf, Int.cast_one, one_mul]
  · refine ⟨k, hk, -1, Or.inr rfl, fun ξ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [huu', ← P.apply_corootOf, hkc, map_neg]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_antidominant
statement:
theorem exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_antidominant (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {a b : Dual K H}
    {na nb : ι → ℕ} (hna : ∀ i, a (P.coroot i) = -(na i : K))
    (hnb : ∀ i, b (P.coroot i) = -(nb i : K))
    {u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hu : u ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ∃ ε : ℤ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧
      u a (P.coroot i) = ((-ε * ∑ j, k j * (na j : ℤ) : ℤ) : K) ∧
      u b (P.coroot i) = ((-ε * ∑ j, k j * (nb j : ℤ) : ℤ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, ε, hε, h⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_eq_sum hA hu i
  refine ⟨k, hk, ε, hε, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h a]
    push_cast
    simp only [hna, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  · rw [h b]
    push_cast
    simp only [hnb, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff
statement:
theorem memUpperClosure_weylDot_iff (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {lam μ : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    P.MemUpperClosure hA (P.weylDot hA w lam) (P.weylDot hA w μ) ↔
      P.UpperClosureCondition hA (w.val (lam + P.rho)) (w.val (μ + P.rho))
proof:
:= by
  choose na hna using hlam
  choose nb hnb using hμ
  have hfacet' : ∀ j, na j = 0 → nb j = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by
    have h := hfacet j (by rw [hna j, hj, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero])
    rw [hnb j, neg_eq_zero] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  
  have key : ∀ v ∈ P.weylGroup hA, ∀ i, ∃ sa sb : ℤ, 0 ≤ sa ∧ 0 ≤ sb ∧ (sa = 0 → sb = 0) ∧
      ∃ ε : ℤ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧
        v.symm (w.val (lam + P.rho)) (P.coroot i) = ((-ε * sa : ℤ) : K) ∧
        v.symm (w.val (μ + P.rho)) (P.coroot i) = ((-ε * sb : ℤ) : K) := by
    intro v hv i
    have hu : v⁻¹ * w.val ∈ P.weylGroup hA := mul_mem (inv_mem hv) w.property
    obtain ⟨k, hk, ε, hε, h1, h2⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_antidominant hA hna hnb hu i
    refine ⟨∑ j, k j * (na j : ℤ), ∑ j, k j * (nb j : ℤ),
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hk j) (Int.natCast_nonneg _),
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hk j) (Int.natCast_nonneg _), fun h0 ↦ ?_,
      ε, hε, h1, h2⟩
    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ ↦
      mul_nonneg (hk j) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)).mp h0
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (hz j (Finset.mem_univ j)) with h | h
    · rw [h, zero_mul]
    · rw [hfacet' j (by exact_mod_cast h), Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
  simp only [MemUpperClosure, UpperClosureCondition, weylDot_add_rho]
  constructor
  · intro hU v hv i hpos hb0
    obtain ⟨sa, sb, hsa, hsb, hab, ε, hε, h1, h2⟩ := key v hv i
    obtain ⟨-, hU2, -⟩ := hU v hv i hpos
    rw [h2] at hb0
    have hb0' : -ε * sb = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb0
    rcases hε with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨sa.toNat, by rw [h1, natCast_toNat hsa]; push_cast; ring⟩
    · by_cases hsa0 : sa = 0
      · exact ⟨0, by rw [h1, hsa0]; simp⟩
      · obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := hU2 ⟨sa.toNat, by omega, by
          rw [h1, natCast_toNat hsa]; push_cast; ring⟩
        rw [h2] at hm'
        have : - -1 * sb = (m : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hm'
        exfalso
        omega
  · intro hC v hv i hpos
    obtain ⟨sa, sb, hsa, hsb, hab, ε, hε, h1, h2⟩ := key v hv i
    have hC' := hC v hv i hpos
    refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h1] at h0
      have h0' : -ε * sa = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h0
      have : sa = 0 := by rcases hε with rfl | rfl <;> omega
      rw [h2, hab this, mul_zero, Int.cast_zero]
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩
      rw [h1] at hn'
      have hn'' : -ε * sa = (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn'
      rcases hε with rfl | rfl
      · exfalso
        omega
      · have hsb0 : sb ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
          obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hC' (by rw [h2, h0, mul_zero, Int.cast_zero])
          rw [h1] at hq
          have : - -1 * sa = -(q : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
          omega
        exact ⟨sb.toNat, by omega, by rw [h2, natCast_toNat hsb]; push_cast; ring⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩
      rw [h1] at hn'
      have hn'' : -ε * sa = -(n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn'
      rcases hε with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨sb.toNat, by rw [h2, natCast_toNat hsb]; push_cast; ring⟩
      · exfalso
        omega

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_apply_eq
statement:
theorem exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_apply_eq (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {a b : Dual K H}
    (ha : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, a (P.coroot i) = -n) (hb : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, b (P.coroot i) = -n)
    {v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hv : v ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hvb : v b = b) :
    ∃ c : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ c ∧ v a - a = P.rootOf c ∧ ∀ i, c i ≠ 0 → b (P.coroot i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hce⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA' (μ := -a)
    (fun i => by obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ha i; exact ⟨n, by simp [hn]⟩) ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hva : v a - a = P.rootOf c := by
    rw [← hce, map_neg]
    abel
  refine ⟨c, hc, hva, ?_⟩
  choose nb hnb using hb
  have hB1 : B (v a) b = B a b := by
    have := P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA' S hv a b
    rwa [hvb] at this
  have h0 : B (P.rootOf c) b = 0 := by
    rw [← hva, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hB1, sub_self]
  rw [P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm] at h0
  have hcast : ((∑ i, c i * d i * (nb i : ℤ) : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by
    have h1 : ((∑ i, c i * d i * (nb i : ℤ) : ℤ) : K) =
        -∑ i, ((c i * d i : ℤ) : K) * b (P.coroot i) := by
      push_cast
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [hnb i]; ring
    rw [h1, h0, neg_zero]
  have hsum : ∑ i, c i * d i * (nb i : ℤ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hcast
  intro i hi
  have hterm := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ ↦
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hc j) (hdpos j).le) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)).mp hsum i
    (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h' : nb i = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hterm with h | h
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact absurd h hi
      · exact absurd h (hdpos i).ne'
    · exact_mod_cast h
  rw [hnb i, h', Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_of_nonpos (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {a b : Dual K H}
    (ha : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, a (P.coroot i) = -n) (hb : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, b (P.coroot i) = -n)
    {u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hu : u ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
    (hub : u b = b)
    (hua : ∀ i, b (P.coroot i) = 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, u a (P.coroot i) = -(n : K)) : u a = a
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hce, hcb⟩ := P.exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_apply_eq hA ha hb hu hub
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  have hB (k : ι → ℤ) (x : Dual K H) := P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm k x
  have hBsymm (x x' : Dual K H) : B x x' = B x' x := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq x x'
  choose na hna using ha
  have hm : ∀ i, ∃ m : ℕ, c i ≠ 0 → u a (P.coroot i) = -(m : K) := fun i ↦ by
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · exact ⟨0, fun h ↦ absurd hi h⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hua i (hcb i hi)
      exact ⟨m, fun _ ↦ hm⟩
  choose m hm using hm
  
  have h1 : B (P.rootOf c) (u a + a) = 0 := by
    have hW : B (u a) (u a) = B a a := P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA' S hu a a
    rw [← hce]
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    rw [hBsymm a (u a)]
    linear_combination hW
  have hsum : ∑ i, c i * d i * ((m i : ℤ) + na i) = 0 := by
    have hcast : ((∑ i, c i * d i * ((m i : ℤ) + na i) : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by
      have h2 : ((∑ i, c i * d i * ((m i : ℤ) + na i) : ℤ) : K) =
          -∑ i, ((c i * d i : ℤ) : K) * (u a + a) (P.coroot i) := by
        push_cast
        rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
        by_cases hi : c i = 0
        · simp [hi]
        · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hm i hi, hna i]
          ring
      rw [h2, ← hB, h1, neg_zero]
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  have hterm (i : ι) : c i = 0 ∨ (m i = 0 ∧ na i = 0) := by
    have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ ↦
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hc j) (hdpos j).le) (by positivity)).mp hsum i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact absurd h (hdpos i).ne'
    · right
      constructor <;> omega
  
  have h3 : B (P.rootOf c) (u a - a) = 0 := by
    rw [hB]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · simp [hi]
    · rcases hterm i with h | ⟨hm0, hn0⟩
      · exact absurd h hi
      · rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, hm i hi, hna i, hm0, hn0]
        simp
  rw [hce] at h3
  have hc0 : c = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hq := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    rw [hB] at h3
    have hcast : ((c ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ c : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← h3, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct]
      simp only [mulVec_diagonal]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
      ring
    simp only [star_trivial] at hq
    exact hq.ne' (by exact_mod_cast hcast)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, hce, hc0, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_mul_eq_of_apply_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_of_apply_eq (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (b : Dual K H)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    ∃ w₁ u₁ : P.weylGroup hA, w = w₁ * u₁ ∧ u₁.val b = b ∧
      ∀ i, b (P.coroot i) = 0 → w₁.val (P.root i) ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hn : (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases h : ∀ i, b (P.coroot i) = 0 → ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent w i
  · exact ⟨w, 1, (mul_one w).symm, rfl, fun i hi ↦
      (P.apply_root_mem_posWeights_iff hA).mpr (h i hi)⟩
  · push Not at h
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hdesc⟩ := h
    have hlt : (P.coxeterSystem hA).length (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) < n := by
      rw [← hn]
      exact hdesc
    obtain ⟨w₁, u₁, hw, hu, hpos⟩ := ih _ hlt (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) rfl
    refine ⟨w₁, u₁ * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i, ?_, ?_, hpos⟩
    · rw [← mul_assoc, ← hw, mul_assoc, (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple_mul_simple_self, mul_one]
    · change u₁.val (((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i).val b) = b
      rw [coxeterSystem_simple, reflection_apply, hi, zero_smul, sub_zero, hu]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition
statement:
theorem exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_upperClosureCondition (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    {a b : Dual K H} (ha : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, a (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hb : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, b (P.coroot i) = -n) {w w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hU : P.UpperClosureCondition hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w.val a) (w.val b))
    (hb' : w'.val b = w.val b) :
    ∃ c : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ c ∧ w'.val a - w.val a = P.rootOf c
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  obtain ⟨w₁, u₁, rfl, hu₁b, hpos⟩ := P.exists_mul_eq_of_apply_eq hA' b w
  have hmul (x : Dual K H) : (w₁ * u₁ : P.weylGroup hA').val x = w₁.val (u₁.val x) := rfl
  have hsymm (x : Dual K H) : w₁.val.symm (w₁.val x) = x := w₁.val.symm_apply_apply x
  
  have hu₁a : u₁.val a = a := by
    refine P.apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_of_nonpos hA ha hb u₁.property hu₁b fun i hi ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hU w₁.val w₁.property i (hpos i hi) (by rw [hmul, hsymm, hu₁b, hi])
    rw [hmul, hsymm] at hn
    exact ⟨n, hn⟩
  
  have hv'b : (w₁⁻¹ * w' : P.weylGroup hA').val b = b := by
    change w₁.val.symm (w'.val b) = b
    rw [hb', hmul, hsymm, hu₁b]
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hce, hcb⟩ := P.exists_apply_sub_eq_rootOf_of_apply_eq hA ha hb
    (w₁⁻¹ * w').property hv'b
  have hkey : w'.val a - (w₁ * u₁ : P.weylGroup hA').val a = w₁.val (P.rootOf c) := by
    rw [hmul, hu₁a, ← hce, map_sub]
    congr 1
    exact (w₁.val.apply_symm_apply (w'.val a)).symm
  have hk : ∀ i, ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ (c i ≠ 0 → w₁.val (P.root i) = P.rootOf k) := fun i ↦ by
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, fun h ↦ absurd hi h⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, ⟨hk, -⟩, hk'⟩ := hpos i (hcb i hi)
      exact ⟨k, hk, fun _ ↦ hk'.symm⟩
  choose kk hkk0 hkk using hk
  refine ⟨∑ i, c i • kk i, Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ smul_nonneg (hc i) (hkk0 i), ?_⟩
  rw [hkey, P.rootOf_apply c, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul, map_zsmul]
  by_cases hi : c i = 0
  · simp [hi]
  · rw [hkk i hi]
    exact Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K (c i) (P.rootOf (kk i))

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_upperClosureCondition
statement:
theorem exists_upperClosureCondition (hA' : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {a b : Dual K H} (ha : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, a (P.coroot i) = -n) (w : P.weylGroup hA') :
    ∃ w'' : P.weylGroup hA', w''.val b = w.val b ∧
      P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w''.val a) (w.val b) ∧
      Relation.ReflTransGen (P.WallStep hA' (w.val b)) (w.val a) (w''.val a)
proof:
:= by
  choose na hna using ha
  have hc : ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA', ∃ c : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ c ∧ w.val a - a = P.rootOf c := fun w ↦ by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hce⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA' (μ := -a)
      (fun i => ⟨na i, by simp [hna i]⟩) w
    exact ⟨c, hc, by rw [← hce, map_neg]; abel⟩
  choose cc hcc0 hcc using hc
  induction hN : (∑ j, cc w j).toNat using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ N ih =>
  by_cases hU : P.UpperClosureCondition hA' (w.val a) (w.val b)
  · exact ⟨w, rfl, hU, .refl⟩
  · unfold UpperClosureCondition at hU
    push Not at hU
    obtain ⟨v, hv, i, hpos, hvb, hva⟩ := hU
    
    obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ v.symm (w.val a) (P.coroot i) = n := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA' (mul_mem (inv_mem hv) w.property)
        (μ := a) fun j ↦ ⟨-(na j : ℤ), by simp [hna j]⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : ℤ, v.symm (w.val a) (P.coroot i) = z := by
        refine ⟨-(na i : ℤ) + (A *ᵥ k) i, ?_⟩
        change (v⁻¹ * w.val) a (P.coroot i) = _
        rw [hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hna i, rootOf_apply_coroot, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_neg,
          Int.cast_natCast]
      by_cases hz0 : 0 < z
      · exact ⟨z.toNat, by omega, by rw [hz, natCast_toNat hz0.le]⟩
      · refine absurd ?_ (hva (-z).toNat)
        rw [hz, natCast_toNat (by omega), Int.cast_neg, neg_neg]
    
    let s : P.weylGroup hA' := ⟨v * P.reflection hA' i * v⁻¹,
      mul_mem (mul_mem hv (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA' i)) (inv_mem hv)⟩
    have hs (x : Dual K H) : (s * w).val x =
        w.val x - v.symm (w.val x) (P.coroot i) • v (P.root i) := by
      change v (P.reflection hA' i (v.symm (w.val x))) = _
      rw [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hsb : (s * w).val b = w.val b := by rw [hs, hvb, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    have hsa : (s * w).val a = w.val a - n • v (P.root i) := by
      rw [hs, hn, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    have hstep : P.WallStep hA' (w.val b) (w.val a) ((s * w).val a) :=
      ⟨v, hv, i, n, hpos, hn0, hvb, hn, hsa⟩
    obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁, hk₁e⟩ := hpos
    have hcc' : cc (s * w) = cc w - n • k₁ := P.rootOf_injective (by
      rw [map_sub, map_nsmul, ← hcc, ← hcc, hsa, hk₁e]
      abel)
    have hlt : (∑ j, cc (s * w) j).toNat < N := by
      have h1 := KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_pos_of_mem_posCone hk₁
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, cc (s * w) j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hcc0 (s * w) j
      have h3 : 0 < (n : ℤ) * ∑ j, k₁ j := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn0) h1
      have h4 : ∑ j, cc (s * w) j = ∑ j, cc w j - (n : ℤ) * ∑ j, k₁ j := by
        rw [hcc', Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by simp
      omega
    obtain ⟨w'', hw''b, hw''U, hchain⟩ := ih _ hlt (s * w) rfl
    rw [hsb] at hw''b hw''U hchain
    exact ⟨w'', hw''b, hw''U, .head hstep hchain⟩

name: LieModule.dualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualEquiv_apply (e : M ≃ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (f : Module.Dual R N) (m : M) :
    dualEquiv e f m = f (e m)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.evalEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalEquiv_apply [FiniteDimensional K M] (m : M) (f : Module.Dual K M) :
    evalEquiv (L := L) m f = f m
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.isIrreducible_dual
statement:
theorem isIrreducible_dual [FiniteDimensional K M] [IsIrreducible K L M] :
    IsIrreducible K L (Module.Dual K M)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial M := nontrivial_of_isIrreducible K L M
  have : Nontrivial (Module.Dual K M) := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos
    (by rw [Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]; exact Module.finrank_pos)
  refine IsIrreducible.mk fun N hN ↦ ?_
  let C : LieSubmodule K L M :=
    { toSubmodule := N.toSubmodule.dualCoannihilator
      lie_mem := fun {x v} hv ↦ by
        change v ∈ N.toSubmodule.dualCoannihilator at hv
        change ⁅x, v⁆ ∈ N.toSubmodule.dualCoannihilator
        rw [Submodule.mem_dualCoannihilator] at hv ⊢
        intro f hf
        have := hv _ (N.lie_mem (x := x) hf)
        rwa [Module.Dual.lie_apply, neg_eq_zero] at this }
  rcases IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top C with hC | hC
  · have hC' : N.toSubmodule.dualCoannihilator = ⊥ := congrArg LieSubmodule.toSubmodule hC
    have := Subspace.dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq (W := N.toSubmodule)
    rw [hC', Submodule.dualAnnihilator_bot] at this
    exact LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_injective (by rw [← this]; rfl)
  · refine absurd ?_ hN
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro f hf
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot]
    ext v
    have hv : v ∈ C := hC ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top v
    exact (Submodule.mem_dualCoannihilator v).mp hv f hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpaceOfMap_ne_bot_of_equiv
statement:
theorem weightSpaceOfMap_ne_bot_of_equiv (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ ≠ ⊥) : weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
  refine fun hbot ↦ hx0 (e.injective ?_)
  have := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P e.toLieModuleHom hx
  rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  rw [map_zero]
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpaceOfMap_neg_ne_bot_of_dual
statement:
theorem weightSpaceOfMap_neg_ne_bot_of_dual (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : weightSpaceOfMap (Module.Dual K V) (h P) μ ≠ ⊥) :
    weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) (-μ) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
  intro hbot
  refine hf0 (LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_)
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ κ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem κ v hv =>
    by_cases hκ : κ = -μ
    · subst hκ
      rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hv
      simp [hv]
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, κ a ≠ (-μ) a := by
        by_contra hc
        push Not at hc
        exact hκ (LinearMap.ext hc)
      have h1 := congrArg (fun g : Module.Dual K V ↦ g v) (hf a)
      simp only [Module.Dual.lie_apply, hv a, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul] at h1
      have h2 : (κ a - (-μ) a) * f v = 0 := by
        rw [LinearMap.neg_apply]
        linear_combination -h1
      rw [LinearMap.zero_apply]
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exists_norm_eq_add
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.exists_norm_eq_add {d : ι → ℤ} (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm) (hpos : (diagonal d * A).PosDef) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, P.dualBilinForm (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hd hsymm) Λ Λ =
        P.dualBilinForm (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hd hsymm) μ μ + n ∧
      (n = 0 → ∃ w ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, μ = w Λ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hd hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  have hB (k : ι → ℤ) (x : Dual K H) := P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hd hsymm k x
  have hBsymm (x x' : Dual K H) : B x x' = B x' x := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq x x'
  have hμint : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, μ (P.coroot i) = n := by
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot (P := P) hμ
    intro i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
    refine ⟨n - (A *ᵥ k) i, ?_⟩
    rw [hk, LinearMap.sub_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := P.exists_dominantIntegral_weylGroup hA' hμint
  have hD : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (u.val μ) ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpace_apply_ne_bot hA' hΛ u.property hμ
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcD⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot (P := P) hD
  choose m hm using hu
  set Q : ℤ := c ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ c with hQdef
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by
    by_cases hc0 : c = 0
    · simp [hQdef, hc0]
    · have := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hc0
      simp only [star_trivial] at this
      exact this.le
  set N : ℤ := ∑ i, 2 * (c i * d i * m i) + Q with hNdef
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, 2 * (c i * d i * m i) := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ by
    have := mul_nonneg (hc i) (hd i).le
    positivity
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := add_nonneg hS0 hQ0
  have hBq : B (P.rootOf c) (P.rootOf c) = (Q : K) := by
    rw [hB, hQdef, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct]
    simp only [mulVec_diagonal]
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
    ring
  have hBD : B (P.rootOf c) (u.val μ) = ∑ i, ((c i * d i * m i : ℤ) : K) := by
    rw [hB]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [hm i]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hΛD : Λ = u.val μ + P.rootOf c := by rw [hcD]; abel
  have hnorm : B Λ Λ = B μ μ + (N : K) := by
    have hW : B (u.val μ) (u.val μ) = B μ μ :=
      P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA' S u.property μ μ
    rw [hΛD]
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
    rw [hBsymm (u.val μ) (P.rootOf c), hBD, hBq, hW, hNdef]
    push_cast
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    ring
  refine ⟨N.toNat, ?_, fun hn ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [hnorm]
    congr 1
    exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hN0).symm
  · have hN : N = 0 := by omega
    have hQ : Q = 0 := by
      have : ∑ i, 2 * (c i * d i * m i) + Q = 0 := hN
      omega
    have hc0 : c = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
      simp only [star_trivial] at this
      omega
    refine ⟨(u⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA').val, (u⁻¹).property, ?_⟩
    rw [hΛD, hc0, map_zero, add_zero]
    change μ = u.val.symm (u.val μ)
    exact (u.val.symm_apply_apply μ).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual {ν : Dual K H} (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) :
    ∃ z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, P.IsDominantIntegral (z (-ν)) ∧
      Nonempty (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        IrreducibleModule P (z (-ν)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P ν
  have hirr : IsIrreducible K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    isIrreducible_dual
  have : Nontrivial (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    nontrivial_of_isIrreducible K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsL⟩ := exists_isInternal_irreducibleModule_of_finiteDimensional (P := P)
    (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) hA
  obtain ⟨N, hNs, hN⟩ : ∃ N ∈ s, N ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    have htop := hs.submodule_iSup_eq_top
    have hbot : ⨆ N : s, (N : Submodule K (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν))) = ⊥ :=
      iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun N ↦ by rw [hc N N.property]; rfl
    rw [hbot] at htop
    exact bot_ne_top htop
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, ⟨e₀⟩⟩ := hsL N hNs
  have hNtop : N = ⊤ := (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top N).resolve_left hN
  let eN : N ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν) :=
    LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective N.incl
      ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun f ↦ ⟨⟨f, hNtop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top f⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  let e : Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ :=
    eN.symm.trans e₀
  
  have h1 : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (-Λ) ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpaceOfMap_neg_ne_bot_of_dual P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν).1
      (weightSpaceOfMap_ne_bot_of_equiv P e.symm (weightSpace_self_ne_bot (P := P) Λ))
  have h2 : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (-ν) ≠ ⊥ :=
    weightSpaceOfMap_neg_ne_bot_of_dual P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).1
      (weightSpaceOfMap_ne_bot_of_equiv P (evalEquiv.trans (dualEquiv e).symm)
        (weightSpace_self_ne_bot (P := P) ν))
  
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set B := P.dualBilinForm (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm)
  have hneg (x : Dual K H) : B (-x) (-x) = B x x := by simp
  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁, -⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_norm_eq_add P hA hdpos hsymm hpos hν h1
  obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂, hn₂0⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_norm_eq_add P hA hdpos hsymm hpos hΛ h2
  rw [hneg] at hn₁ hn₂
  have hsum : ((n₁ + n₂ : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by
    push_cast
    linear_combination -hn₁ - hn₂
  have hn : n₁ + n₂ = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwΛ⟩ := hn₂0 (by omega)
  have hz : w⁻¹ ∈ P.weylGroup hA' := inv_mem hw
  have hzν : w⁻¹ (-ν) = Λ := by
    rw [hwΛ]
    change w.symm (w Λ) = Λ
    exact w.symm_apply_apply Λ
  exact ⟨w⁻¹, hz, hzν ▸ hΛ, ⟨hzν ▸ e⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr
statement:
theorem multiplicity_congr (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (μ : Dual K H) :
    hV.multiplicity μ = hW.multiplicity μ
proof:
:=
  (character_eq_iff hV hW).mp (character_congr hV hW e) μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hU : IsCategoryO P U) (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hW : IsCategoryO P W) (f : U →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hex : g.ker = f.range) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (μ : Dual K H) : hV.multiplicity μ = hU.multiplicity μ + hW.multiplicity μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₂⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.nonempty_lieModuleEquiv_of_surjective f.range g hg hex
  let e₁ : U ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ f.range :=
    LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective
      (f.codRestrict f.range fun m ↦ by rw [LieModuleHom.mem_range]; exact ⟨m, rfl⟩)
      ⟨fun a b hab ↦ hf (congrArg Subtype.val hab), fun y ↦ by
        have hy := y.2
        rw [LieModuleHom.mem_range] at hy
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hy
        exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩⟩
  rw [hV.multiplicity_eq_add f.range μ]
  congr 1
  · exact (multiplicity_congr hU _ e₁ μ).symm
  · exact multiplicity_congr _ hW e₂ μ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : weightSpace P V μ = ⊥) : hV.multiplicity μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := hV.multiplicity_le_finrank μ
  rw [h, finrank_bot] at this
  exact Nat.le_zero.mp this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_lieSubmodule_eq_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_lieSubmodule_eq_bot (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : weightSpace P V μ = ⊥) : weightSpace P N μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro v hv
  have hv' : (v : V) ∈ weightSpace P V μ := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hv
  rw [h] at hv'
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr (Subtype.ext ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hv'))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.centralTranslation
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.centralTranslation (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) : IsCategoryO P (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V)
proof:
:=
  ((hV.centralBlock P χ₁).tensorProduct hZ).centralBlock P χ₂

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {ν y : Dual K H}
    (hZν : ∀ ν', weightSpace P Z ν' ≠ ⊥ → ν' ∈ cone P ν)
    (hQ : ∀ μ, y - ν ∈ cone P μ → weightSpace P (centralBlock P V χ₁) μ = ⊥) :
    weightSpace P (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ V) y = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hX : IsHDiagonalizable P (centralBlock P V χ₁) :=
    (hV.centralBlock P χ₁).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  have hZd : IsHDiagonalizable P Z := hZ.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  refine weightSpace_lieSubmodule_eq_bot _ ?_
  rw [weightSpace_tensorProduct hX hZd y]
  refine iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun μ ↦ LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mpr ?_
  by_cases hμ : weightSpace P (centralBlock P V χ₁) μ = ⊥
  · have h0 : (weightSpace P (centralBlock P V χ₁) μ).subtype = 0 := LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ by
      have hv : (v : centralBlock P V χ₁) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K (centralBlock P V χ₁)) := by
        rw [← hμ]
        exact v.2
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hv
    rw [h0, TensorProduct.map_zero_left]
  · have hZμ : weightSpace P Z (y - μ) = ⊥ := by
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hke⟩ := hZν _ hne
      refine hμ (hQ μ ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩)
      rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add] at hke ⊢
      rw [hke, add_comm]
    have h0 : (weightSpace P Z (y - μ)).subtype = 0 := LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ by
      have hv : (v : Z) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K Z) := by
        rw [← hZμ]
        exact v.2
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hv
    rw [h0, TensorProduct.map_zero_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_centralTranslation_subquotient
statement:
theorem multiplicity_centralTranslation_subquotient (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {N N' : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V}
    (h : N ≤ N') (y : Dual K H) :
    ((hV.lieSubmodule N').centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y =
      ((hV.lieSubmodule N).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y +
        (((hV.lieSubmodule N').quotient (N.comap N'.incl)).centralTranslation P hZ
          χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y
proof:
:= by
  let f : N →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N' := LieSubmodule.inclusion h
  let g : N' →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ N' ⧸ N.comap N'.incl :=
    LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (N.comap N'.incl)
  have hf : Function.Injective f := LieSubmodule.inclusion_injective h
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _
  have hex : g.ker = f.range := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker]
    ext x
    rw [LieSubmodule.mem_comap, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x.val, hx⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
      exact m.2
  obtain ⟨hTf, hTex, hTg⟩ := centralTranslationMap_shortExact P Z (hV.lieSubmodule N') hZ f g
    hf hex hg χ₁ χ₂
  exact IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact _ _ _ _ _ hTf hTex hTg y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_centralTranslation_of_isLocalCompositionSeries
statement:
theorem multiplicity_centralTranslation_of_isLocalCompositionSeries (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z) (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {ν y : Dual K H}
    (hZν : ∀ ν', weightSpace P Z ν' ≠ ⊥ → ν' ∈ cone P ν)
    {N M : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V}
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P (y - ν) N l M) :
    ((hV.lieSubmodule M).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y =
      ((hV.lieSubmodule N).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y +
        ((factorWeights l).map fun η ↦
