          ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity
            y).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing N with
  | nil =>
    obtain rfl := IsLocalCompositionSeries.nil_iff.mp hl
    simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨h, hfac, hl'⟩ := IsLocalCompositionSeries.cons_iff.mp hl
    rw [ih hl', multiplicity_centralTranslation_subquotient P hV hZ χ₁ χ₂ h y, add_assoc]
    congr 1
    cases o with
    | none =>
      rw [factorWeights_cons_none]
      have h0 : weightSpace P (centralTranslation P Z χ₁ χ₂ (N.Subquotient N')) y = ⊥ :=
        weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot P ((hV.lieSubmodule N').quotient _) hZ χ₁ χ₂ hZν
          fun μ hμ ↦ weightSpace_lieSubmodule_eq_bot _ (hfac μ hμ)
      rw [IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot _ h0, zero_add]
    | some η =>
      obtain ⟨-, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hfac
      rw [factorWeights_cons_some, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      congr 1
      exact IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr _ _ (centralTranslationEquiv P Z χ₁ χ₂ e) y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_sum
statement:
theorem multiplicity_centralTranslation_eq_sum (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {ν y : Dual K H}
    (hZν : ∀ ν', weightSpace P Z ν' ≠ ⊥ → ν' ∈ cone P ν)
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P (y - ν) (⊥ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) l ⊤) :
    (hV.centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y =
      ((factorWeights l).map fun η ↦
        ((IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity
          y).sum
proof:
:= by
  have h := multiplicity_centralTranslation_of_isLocalCompositionSeries P hV hZ χ₁ χ₂ hZν hl
  have hbot : ((hV.lieSubmodule ⊥).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂).multiplicity y = 0 :=
    IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_zero_of_weightSpace_eq_bot _
      (weightSpace_centralTranslation_eq_bot P (hV.lieSubmodule ⊥) hZ χ₁ χ₂ hZν fun μ _ ↦
        eq_bot_iff.mpr fun v _ ↦ (Submodule.mem_bot K).mpr
          (Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext ((LieSubmodule.mem_bot _).mp v.1.2))))
  let e : (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V :=
    LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (⊤ : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V).incl
      ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun v ↦ ⟨⟨v, LieSubmodule.mem_top v⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [← IsCategoryO.multiplicity_congr ((hV.lieSubmodule ⊤).centralTranslation P hZ χ₁ χ₂) _
    (centralTranslationEquiv P Z χ₁ χ₂ e) y, h, hbot, zero_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isSerreClassO_isKilledByPow
statement:
theorem isSerreClassO_isKilledByPow (I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)) :
    IsSerreClassO P fun M _ _ _ _ ↦ ∃ n, IsKilledByPow I n M where
  of_subsingleton _ _ _ _ _ _
proof:
:= ⟨0, fun _ _ _ ↦ LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  of_equiv {M N} _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ e := by
    rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, fun l hl hlI ↦ LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← e.apply_symm_apply y, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    change actionHom N l.prod ((e : M →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ N) (e.symm y)) = 0
    rw [← LieModuleHom.map_actionHom, hn l hl hlI, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
  iff {M} _ _ _ _ _ N := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      refine ⟨⟨n, fun l hl hlI ↦ LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ Subtype.ext ?_⟩,
        ⟨n, fun l hl hlI ↦ LinearMap.ext fun q ↦ ?_⟩⟩
      · change N.incl (actionHom N l.prod x) = 0
        rw [LieModuleHom.map_actionHom, hn l hl hlI, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      · induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
        | H m =>
          change actionHom _ l.prod (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N m) = 0
          rw [← LieModuleHom.map_actionHom, hn l hl hlI, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
      refine ⟨a + b, fun l hl hlI ↦ LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_⟩
      have hm : actionHom M (l.drop a).prod m ∈ N := by
        rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, LieModuleHom.map_actionHom,
          hb _ (by simp [hl]) fun x hx ↦ hlI x (List.mem_of_mem_drop hx),
          LinearMap.zero_apply]
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val
        (LinearMap.congr_fun (ha (l.take a) (by simp [hl]) fun x hx ↦ hlI x
          (List.mem_of_mem_take hx)) ⟨_, hm⟩)
      change N.incl (actionHom N (l.take a).prod ⟨_, hm⟩) = 0 at h
      rw [LieModuleHom.map_actionHom] at h
      rw [← List.take_append_drop a l, List.prod_append, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
      exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isKilledByPow_of_block
statement:
theorem exists_isKilledByPow_of_block {lam : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hI : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {s : Finset M}
    (hs : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hblock : ∀ μ, hM.multiplicity μ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
        μ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) :
    ∃ n, IsKilledByPow I n M
proof:
:=
  (isSerreClassO_isKilledByPow P I).of_verma_of_isDominant hA hlam
    ⟨1, fun l hl hlI ↦ by
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hl
      rw [List.prod_singleton]
      exact hI a (hlI a (List.mem_singleton_self a))⟩ hM hs hblock

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_tensorNatTrans_app_verma
statement:
theorem exists_tensorNatTrans_app_verma {lam : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) {V W : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [FiniteDimensional K V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (ψ : VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ VermaModule P lam ⊗[K] W) :
    ∃ φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W, φ.app (VermaModule P lam) = ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (bijective_tensorNatLinear_verma hA hlam hM hI hK V W).2 ψ
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := exists_tensorNatMap_eq P hA I g
  exact ⟨TensorNatTrans.ofTensorNatMap g', (hg' _ hM).trans hg⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_inverse_of_block
statement:
theorem exists_inverse_of_block {lam : Dual K H} (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)} (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P lam))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P lam) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule 𝔤 W] [LieModule K 𝔤 W]
    (e : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V V)
    (e' : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 W W)
    (φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 V W)
    (φ' : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤 W V)
    (h₁ : (φ'.app (VermaModule P lam)).comp (φ.app (VermaModule P lam)) = e.app _)
    (h₂ : (φ.app (VermaModule P lam)).comp (φ'.app (VermaModule P lam)) = e'.app _)
    {M : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M]
    (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {s : Finset M} (hs : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤)
    (hblock : ∀ μ, hM.multiplicity μ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
        μ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
    (he : ∀ x, e.app M (e.app M x) = e.app M x) (he' : ∀ y, e'.app M (e'.app M y) = e'.app M y)
    (hφ : ∀ x, e'.app M (φ.app M (e.app M x)) = φ.app M x)
    (hφ' : ∀ y, e.app M (φ'.app M (e'.app M y)) = φ'.app M y) :
    ∃ ψ : M ⊗[K] W →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] V, ψ ∘ₗ (φ.app M : M ⊗[K] V →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] W) = e.app M ∧
      (φ.app M : M ⊗[K] V →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] W) ∘ₗ ψ = e'.app M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_isKilledByPow_of_block P hA hlam hM₀ hM hs hblock
  exact TensorNatTrans.exists_inverse_of_hasKilledFiltration e e' φ φ' hM₀ hI h₁ h₂
    (hasKilledFiltration_of_isKilledByPow hn) he he' hφ hφ'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_apply
statement: lemma transpose_apply (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) : transpose P x = -chevalleyInvolution P x
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_e
statement: @[simp] lemma transpose_e (i : ι) : transpose P (e P i) = f P i
proof: := by simp [transpose_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_f
statement: @[simp] lemma transpose_f (i : ι) : transpose P (f P i) = e P i
proof: := by simp [transpose_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_h
statement: @[simp] lemma transpose_h (a : H) : transpose P (h P a) = h P a
proof: := by simp [transpose_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_transpose
statement: @[simp] lemma transpose_transpose (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) : transpose P (transpose P x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [transpose_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_lie
statement:
lemma transpose_lie (x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    transpose P ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅transpose P y, transpose P x⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_apply, transpose_apply, transpose_apply, LieHom.map_lie, neg_lie, lie_neg,
    neg_neg, ← lie_skew, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.transpose_mem_nNeg
statement: lemma transpose_mem_nNeg {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nPos P) : transpose P x ∈ nNeg P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨-AuxLieAlgebra.negGen z, ?_⟩
  change π P (AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P _) = -chevalleyInvolution P (π P (AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z))
  rw [chevalleyInvolution_π, AuxLieAlgebra.chevalleyInvolution_eHom, map_neg, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.envTranspose_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma envTranspose_ι (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) :
    envTranspose P (ιᵤ x) = MulOpposite.op (ιᵤ (transpose P x))
proof:
:=
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_ι_apply K _ x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.unop_envTranspose_mul
statement:
lemma unop_envTranspose_mul (a b : 𝓤) :
    (envTranspose P (a * b)).unop = (envTranspose P b).unop * (envTranspose P a).unop
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, MulOpposite.unop_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.unop_envTranspose_unop_envTranspose
statement:
@[simp] lemma unop_envTranspose_unop_envTranspose (a : 𝓤) :
    (envTranspose P (envTranspose P a).unop).unop = a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | ι x => rw [envTranspose_ι, MulOpposite.unop_op, envTranspose_ι, MulOpposite.unop_op,
      transpose_transpose]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [unop_envTranspose_mul, unop_envTranspose_mul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, MulOpposite.unop_add, ha, hb]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.lie_apply
statement:
lemma lie_apply (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (φ : TwistedDual P V) (v : V) :
    toDual P V ⁅x, φ⁆ v = toDual P V φ ⁅transpose P x, v⁆
proof:
:= by
  change -(toDual P V φ) ⁅chevalleyInvolution P x, v⁆ = _
  rw [transpose_apply, neg_lie, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.TwistedDual.toDual_homOfForm
statement:
@[simp] lemma toDual_homOfForm (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V)
    (hB : ∀ x u w, B ⁅x, u⁆ w = B u ⁅transpose P x, w⁆) (u : V) :
    toDual P V (homOfForm P V B hB u) = B u
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwCoord_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma hwCoord_hwv : hwCoord P Λ (hwv P Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).symm (hwv P Λ) = 1 := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_one, one_smul]
  simp [hwCoord, this]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg
statement:
lemma hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg {y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hy : y ∈ nNeg P) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    hwCoord P Λ ⁅y, m⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective m
  have : ⁅y, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆ =
      equivEnvNNeg P Λ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K ⟨y, hy⟩ * u) := by
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, lie_eq_smul]
    rfl
  rw [this]
  simp [hwCoord, -equivEnvNNeg_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_smul_hwCoord
statement:
theorem eq_smul_hwCoord (φ : Module.Dual K (VermaModule P Λ))
    (hφ : ∀ i m, φ ⁅f P i, m⁆ = 0) : φ = φ (hwv P Λ) • hwCoord P Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext_on_range (span_fWord_smul_eq_top P Λ) fun w ↦ ?_
  cases w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w =>
    rw [fWord_smul_cons, hφ, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P Λ (f_mem_nNeg P j), smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwCoord_lie_h
statement:
lemma hwCoord_lie_h (a : H) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    hwCoord P Λ ⁅h P a, m⁆ = Λ a * hwCoord P Λ m
proof:
:= by
  set ψ : Module.Dual K (VermaModule P Λ) :=
    hwCoord P Λ ∘ₗ (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (h P a)) - Λ a • hwCoord P Λ
  have hψ : ∀ m, ψ m = hwCoord P Λ ⁅h P a, m⁆ - Λ a * hwCoord P Λ m := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have := eq_smul_hwCoord P Λ ψ fun i m ↦ by
    rw [hψ, leibniz_lie, map_add,
      hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P Λ (lie_h_mem_nNeg P a (f_mem_nNeg P i)),
      hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P Λ (f_mem_nNeg P i), hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P Λ (f_mem_nNeg P i),
      zero_add, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have h0 := LinearMap.congr_fun this m
  rw [hψ, hψ, lie_h_hwv, map_smul, hwCoord_hwv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_self, zero_smul,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero] at h0
  exact h0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_hwCoordTw_of_mem_nPos
statement:
lemma lie_hwCoordTw_of_mem_nPos {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nPos P) :
    ⁅x, hwCoordTw P Λ⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (toDual P _).injective
  ext m
  rw [lie_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  exact hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P Λ (transpose_mem_nNeg P hx) m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_h_hwCoordTw
statement: lemma lie_h_hwCoordTw (a : H) : ⁅h P a, hwCoordTw P Λ⁆ = Λ a • hwCoordTw P Λ
proof:
:= by
  apply (toDual P _).injective
  ext m
  rw [lie_apply, transpose_h, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact hwCoord_lie_h P Λ a m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_apply
statement:
lemma contravariantForm_apply (u w : VermaModule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ u w = toDual P _ (toTwistedDual P Λ u) w
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_hwv_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma contravariantForm_hwv_left (w : VermaModule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ (hwv P Λ) w = hwCoord P Λ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [contravariantForm_apply, toTwistedDual, lift_hwv, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_hwv_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma contravariantForm_hwv_hwv : contravariantForm P Λ (hwv P Λ) (hwv P Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_lie_left
statement:
theorem contravariantForm_lie_left (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (u w : VermaModule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ ⁅x, u⁆ w = contravariantForm P Λ u ⁅transpose P x, w⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [contravariantForm_apply, LieModuleHom.map_lie, lie_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_smul_contravariantForm
statement:
theorem eq_smul_contravariantForm (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K (VermaModule P Λ))
    (hB : ∀ x u w, B ⁅x, u⁆ w = B u ⁅transpose P x, w⁆) :
    B = B (hwv P Λ) (hwv P Λ) • contravariantForm P Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hv : B (hwv P Λ) = B (hwv P Λ) (hwv P Λ) • hwCoord P Λ :=
    eq_smul_hwCoord P Λ _ fun i m ↦ by rw [← transpose_e, ← hB, lie_e_hwv, map_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have := hom_ext P Λ (φ := homOfForm P _ B hB)
    (ψ := B (hwv P Λ) (hwv P Λ) • toTwistedDual P Λ) (by
      apply (toDual P _).injective
      rw [toDual_homOfForm, _root_.smul_apply, map_smul, toTwistedDual, lift_hwv,
        LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hv)
  ext u w
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun (congr_arg (toDual P _) (LieModuleHom.congr_fun this u)) w
  rw [toDual_homOfForm] at this
  rw [this, _root_.smul_apply, map_smul]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isSymm_contravariantForm
statement: theorem isSymm_contravariantForm : (contravariantForm P Λ).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  have := eq_smul_contravariantForm P Λ (LinearMap.flip (contravariantForm P Λ)) fun x u w ↦ by
    simp only [LinearMap.flip_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [← transpose_transpose P x]
    rw [← contravariantForm_lie_left]
  rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, contravariantForm_hwv_hwv, one_smul] at this
  exact ⟨fun u w ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun₂ this w u⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.existsUnique_contravariantForm
statement:
theorem existsUnique_contravariantForm :
    ∃! B : LinearMap.BilinForm K (VermaModule P Λ),
      (∀ x u w, B ⁅x, u⁆ w = B u ⁅transpose P x, w⁆) ∧ B (hwv P Λ) (hwv P Λ) = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨contravariantForm P Λ, ⟨contravariantForm_lie_left P Λ, contravariantForm_hwv_hwv P Λ⟩,
    fun B ⟨hB, h1⟩ ↦ by rw [eq_smul_contravariantForm P Λ B hB, h1, one_smul]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_lie_right
statement:
lemma contravariantForm_lie_right (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (u w : VermaModule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ u ⁅x, w⁆ = contravariantForm P Λ ⁅transpose P x, u⁆ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [contravariantForm_lie_left, transpose_transpose]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_smul_left
statement:
theorem contravariantForm_smul_left (a : 𝓤) (u w : VermaModule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ (a • u) w = contravariantForm P Λ u ((envTranspose P a).unop • w)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing u w with
  | algebraMap r => simp [algebraMap_smul]
  | ι x => rw [← lie_eq_smul, envTranspose_ι, MulOpposite.unop_op, ← lie_eq_smul,
      contravariantForm_lie_left]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [mul_smul, ha, hb, unop_envTranspose_mul, mul_smul]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [add_smul, map_add, MulOpposite.unop_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
      ha, hb]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_smul_hwv
statement:
theorem contravariantForm_smul_hwv (a b : 𝓤) :
    contravariantForm P Λ (a • hwv P Λ) (b • hwv P Λ) =
      hwCoord P Λ (((envTranspose P a).unop * b) • hwv P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contravariantForm_smul_left, contravariantForm_hwv_left, mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, μ a ≠ ν a := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hμν (LinearMap.ext h)
  have := contravariantForm_lie_left P Λ (h P a) u w
  rw [transpose_h, hu a, hw a, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul] at this
  have h0 : (μ a - ν a) * contravariantForm P Λ u w = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, this, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hwCoord_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
lemma hwCoord_eq_zero_of_ne {μ : Dual K H} {w : VermaModule P Λ} (hw : w ∈ weightSpace P Λ μ)
    (hμ : μ ≠ Λ) : hwCoord P Λ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← contravariantForm_hwv_left]
  exact contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_ne P Λ (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ) hw (Ne.symm hμ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lowerPart_le_ker_hwCoord
statement: lemma lowerPart_le_ker_hwCoord : lowerPart P Λ ≤ LinearMap.ker (hwCoord P Λ)
proof:
:=
  iSup₂_le fun _ hμ _ hw ↦ hwCoord_eq_zero_of_ne P Λ hw hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_maxSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maxSubmodule_iff (u : VermaModule P Λ) :
    u ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ ↔ ∀ w, contravariantForm P Λ u w = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hu w
    have htop : orthMaxSubmodule P Λ = ⊤ := eq_top_of_hwv_mem P Λ fun u hu ↦ by
      rw [(isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq, contravariantForm_hwv_left]
      exact lowerPart_le_ker_hwCoord P Λ (maxSubmodule_le_lowerPart P Λ hu)
    exact (htop ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top w : w ∈ orthMaxSubmodule P Λ) u hu
  · intro hu
    have hker : hwv P Λ ∉ (toTwistedDual P Λ).ker := fun h ↦ by
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun (congr_arg (toDual P _) (LieModuleHom.mem_ker.mp h))
        (hwv P Λ)
      rw [← contravariantForm_apply, contravariantForm_hwv_hwv, map_zero,
        LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
      exact one_ne_zero this
    refine (le_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ (toTwistedDual P Λ).ker).mpr
      (fun h ↦ hker (by rw [h]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top _)) ?_
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
    apply (toDual P _).injective
    ext w
    exact hu w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_toSubmodule_eq_ker
statement:
theorem maxSubmodule_toSubmodule_eq_ker :
    (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule = LinearMap.ker (contravariantForm P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  rw [LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, mem_maxSubmodule_iff, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ LinearMap.ext h, fun h w ↦ by rw [h, LinearMap.zero_apply]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_mem {u : VermaModule P Λ} (hu : u ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ u = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext ((mem_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ u).mp hu)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_maxSubmodule_iff_of_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_maxSubmodule_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h w _ ↦ h w, fun h w ↦ ?_⟩
  have hle : ⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf k) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (contravariantForm P Λ u) := by
    refine iSup₂_le fun k _ w hw ↦ ?_
    by_cases hν : Λ - P.rootOf k = μ
    · rw [hν] at hw
      exact h w hw
    · exact contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_ne P Λ hu hw (Ne.symm hν)
  exact hle (by rw [iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]; trivial)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.maxSubmodule_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem maxSubmodule_eq_bot_iff : maxSubmodule P Λ = ⊥ ↔ (contravariantForm P Λ).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  have hsep : (contravariantForm P Λ).Nondegenerate ↔
      ∀ u, (∀ w, contravariantForm P Λ u w = 0) → u = 0 := by
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.1, fun h ↦ ⟨h, fun w hw ↦ h w fun u ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    rw [(isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq]
    exact hw u
  rw [hsep, LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff]
  simp_rw [mem_maxSubmodule_iff]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.nondegenerate_weightSpaceForm_iff
statement:
theorem nondegenerate_weightSpaceForm_iff (μ : Dual K H) :
    (weightSpaceForm P Λ μ).Nondegenerate ↔
      (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hsep : (weightSpaceForm P Λ μ).Nondegenerate ↔
      ∀ u, (∀ w, weightSpaceForm P Λ μ u w = 0) → u = 0 := by
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.1, fun h ↦ ⟨h, fun w hw ↦ h w fun u ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    change contravariantForm P Λ w u = 0
    rw [(isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq]
    exact hw u
  rw [hsep, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro h u ⟨hu, huμ⟩
    have := h ⟨u, huμ⟩ fun w ↦
      (mem_maxSubmodule_iff_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ huμ).mp hu w w.2
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val this
  · intro h u hu
    exact Subtype.ext (h u ⟨(mem_maxSubmodule_iff_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ u.2).mpr
      fun w hw ↦ hu ⟨w, hw⟩, u.2⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_ne_zero_iff {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ : Dual K H) (b : Basis n K (weightSpace P Λ μ)) :
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix b (weightSpaceForm P Λ μ)).det ≠ 0 ↔
      (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_iff_det_ne_zero, nondegenerate_weightSpaceForm_iff]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma contravariantForm_mk (u w : VermaModule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _ u) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _ w) =
      VermaModule.contravariantForm P Λ u w
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_hwv_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma contravariantForm_hwv_hwv : contravariantForm P Λ (hwv P Λ) (hwv P Λ) = 1
proof:
:=
  VermaModule.contravariantForm_hwv_hwv P Λ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_lie_left
statement:
theorem contravariantForm_lie_left (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (u w : IrreducibleModule P Λ) :
    contravariantForm P Λ ⁅x, u⁆ w = contravariantForm P Λ u ⁅transpose P x, w⁆
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ u
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ w
  rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, contravariantForm_mk, contravariantForm_mk,
    VermaModule.contravariantForm_lie_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isSymm_contravariantForm
statement: theorem isSymm_contravariantForm : (contravariantForm P Λ).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun u w ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ u
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ w
  rw [contravariantForm_mk, contravariantForm_mk, (VermaModule.isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.nondegenerate_contravariantForm
statement: theorem nondegenerate_contravariantForm : (contravariantForm P Λ).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  have hl : ∀ u : IrreducibleModule P Λ, (∀ w, contravariantForm P Λ u w = 0) → u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ u
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, mem_maxSubmodule_iff]
    exact fun w ↦ hu (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _ w)
  refine ⟨hl, fun w hw ↦ hl w fun u ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [(isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq]
  exact hw u

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule
statement:
lemma map_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule (μ : Dual K H) :
    (weightSpaceOfMap N (h P) μ).map N.toSubmodule.subtype =
      N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨n.2, fun a ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (hn a)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hvN, hv⟩
    exact ⟨⟨v, hvN⟩, fun a ↦ Subtype.ext (hv a), rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule
statement:
lemma finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap N (h P) μ) =
      finrank K ↥(N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule, Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_quotMk
statement: lemma ker_quotMk : LinearMap.ker (quotMk P N) = N.toSubmodule
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ker_mkQ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_quotMk
statement: lemma range_quotMk : LinearMap.range (quotMk P N) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient
statement:
lemma map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ).map (quotMk P N) = weightSpaceOfMap (V ⧸ N) (h P) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ ν, (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν).map (quotMk P N) ≤
      weightSpaceOfMap (V ⧸ N) (h P) ν := fun ν ↦ by
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) hv
  refine le_antisymm (hle μ) fun x hx ↦ mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) _ hle hx ?_
  rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hV, Submodule.map_top, range_quotMk]
  trivial

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_add
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_add (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (μ : Dual K H) [FiniteDimensional K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ)] :
    finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap N (h P) μ) + finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (V ⧸ N) (h P) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    (quotMk P N ∘ₗ (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ).subtype)
  rw [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype, map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P N hV,
    LinearMap.ker_comp, ker_quotMk, ← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq,
    Submodule.map_comap_subtype] at this
  rw [← this, finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule, inf_comm, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv
statement:
lemma map_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ).map (e : V →ₗ[K] W) = weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun w hw ↦ ⟨e.symm w, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply w⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (e : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) hv
  · exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (e.symm : W →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv
statement:
lemma finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) = finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv P e,
    LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq (e.toLinearEquiv : V ≃ₗ[K] W)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.quotient
statement:
theorem quotient (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) :
    IsCategoryO P (V ⧸ N)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap := map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P N hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  refine ⟨?_, fun μ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [← hmap, ← Submodule.map_iSup, hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top, Submodule.map_top,
      range_quotMk]
  · have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    rw [← hmap]
    infer_instance
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hV.exists_finset
    refine ⟨s, fun μ hμ ↦ hs μ fun h0 ↦ hμ ?_⟩
    rw [← hmap, h0, Submodule.map_bot]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.of_equiv
statement: theorem of_equiv (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) : IsCategoryO P W
proof:
:= by
  have hmap := map_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv P e
  refine ⟨?_, fun μ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [← hmap, ← Submodule.map_iSup, hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top, Submodule.map_top]
    exact LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr e.surjective
  · have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    rw [← hmap]
    infer_instance
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hV.exists_finset
    refine ⟨s, fun μ hμ ↦ hs μ fun h0 ↦ hμ ?_⟩
    rw [← hmap, h0, Submodule.map_bot]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeffAt_character (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (μ : Dual K H) :
    hV.character.coeffAt μ = finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_eq_add
statement:
theorem character_eq_add (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
    (hN : IsCategoryO P N) (hQ : IsCategoryO P (V ⧸ N)) :
    hV.character = hN.character + hQ.character
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  simp only [coeffAt_character, HahnSeries.coeff_add, ← Nat.cast_add]
  rw [finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_add P N hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.character_congr
statement:
theorem character_congr (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (e : V ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) : hV.character = hW.character
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [coeffAt_character, finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv P e]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_fWordNeg
statement: lemma map_fWordNeg (w : List ι) : mapN (fWordNeg P w) = fWord P w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fWordNeg, fWord, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun i _ ↦ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_fWordNeg
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_fWordNeg (Λ : Dual K H) (w : List ι) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ (fWordNeg P w) = fWord P w • hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_fWordNeg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.shiftEquiv_fWord
statement:
lemma shiftEquiv_fWord (Λ Λ' : Dual K H) (w : List ι) :
    shiftEquiv P Λ Λ' (fWord P w • hwv P Λ) = fWord P w • hwv P Λ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, ← equivEnvNNeg_fWordNeg,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, equivEnvNNeg_fWordNeg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_shiftEquiv_weightSpace
statement:
lemma map_shiftEquiv_weightSpace (Λ Λ' β : Dual K H) :
    (weightSpace P Λ (Λ - β)).map (shiftEquiv P Λ Λ' : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ[K] VermaModule P Λ') =
      weightSpace P Λ' (Λ' - β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace_eq_wordSpan, weightSpace_eq_wordSpan, wordSpan, wordSpan, Submodule.map_span,
    ← Set.image_comp]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_right_inj, Function.comp_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, shiftEquiv_fWord]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_sub_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_sub_eq (Λ Λ' β : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpace P Λ (Λ - β)) = finrank K (weightSpace P Λ' (Λ' - β))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_shiftEquiv_weightSpace P Λ Λ' β, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.character_eq
statement:
theorem character_eq (Λ : Dual K H) :
    (isCategoryO P Λ).character = exp P ℤ Λ * (isCategoryO P 0).character
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  rw [coeff_exp_mul, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character]
  have := finrank_weightSpace_sub_eq P Λ 0 (Λ - μ)
  rw [sub_sub_cancel, zero_sub, neg_sub] at this
  exact congrArg _ this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BlockProjectiveFunctor.commutesWithWeyl
statement:
theorem commutesWithWeyl [FiniteDimensional K V] (hlam : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hK : ∀ μ, P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ → KostantMultiplicity P
      (AdQuotient K 𝔤 (TwoSidedIdeal.ker (actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P μ))))) :
    F.CommutesWithWeyl
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hF₀ := isInBlock_verma P hA lam
  
  set S := {ν | F.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ν ≠ 0} with hS_def
  have hS : S.Finite := F.finite_setOf_vermaMult_ne_zero hF₀
  have hSint : ∀ ψ ∈ S, ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (ψ - lam) (P.coroot i) = z := fun ψ hψ i ↦ by
    refine exists_int_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (V := V) hA) (fun h0 ↦ hψ ?_) i
    have := F.vermaMult_verma_le hF₀ ψ
    rw [h0, finrank_bot] at this
    exact Nat.le_zero.mp this
  set T := {ξ | ∃ ψ ∈ S, centralCharacter P ξ = centralCharacter P ψ ∧
    ξ - ψ ∈ P.rootLattice} with hT_def
  have hT : T.Finite := by
    have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
    refine (hS.biUnion fun ψ _ ↦ Set.finite_range fun w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan ↦
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w ψ).subset fun ξ hξT ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hξ, -⟩ := hξT
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwξ⟩ := (VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_iff P hA ψ ξ).mp hξ.symm
    refine Set.mem_biUnion hψ ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    change w (ψ + P.rho) - P.rho = ξ
    rw [hwξ, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hTint : ∀ ξ ∈ hT.toFinset, ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (lam - ξ) (P.coroot i) = z := by
    intro ξ hξ i
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, -, hξψ⟩ := hT.mem_toFinset.mp hξ
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hSint ψ hψ i
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice hξψ i
    refine ⟨-a - b, ?_⟩
    have e : lam - ξ = -(ψ - lam) - (ξ - ψ) := by abel
    rw [e, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, ha, hb]
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_isDominantIntegral_add_nsmul_rho_sub lam hT.toFinset hTint
  
  set φ := lam + (N : K) • P.rho with hφ_def
  have hφ : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan φ := IsDominant.add_nsmul_rho (hA := hA) hlam N
  have hWφ : P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan φ =
      P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam :=
    integralWeylGroup_add_nsmul_rho (hA := hA) lam N
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P N)
  have hLO := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA)
    (IrreducibleModule P ((N : K) • P.rho))
  
  let D := Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ((N : K) • P.rho))
  let _ : AddCommGroup D := inferInstance
  let _ : Module K D := inferInstance
  let _ : LieRingModule 𝔤 D := inferInstance
  let _ : LieModule K 𝔤 D := inferInstance
  have hLO' := isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional (P := P) (hA := hA) D
  have hVc : ∀ b, weightSpace P D b ≠ ⊥ → -b ∈ cone P ((N : K) • P.rho) := by
    intro b hb
    refine IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero ?_
    rw [weightSpace, ← finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual P hLO.1 hLO'.1]
    exact fun h0 ↦ hb (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp h0)
  have hδ : finrank K (weightSpace P D (-((N : K) • P.rho))) = 1 := by
    rw [weightSpace, finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_dual P hLO.1 hLO'.1, neg_neg]
    exact IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self P _
  set G := tensorBlock P hA φ D (centralCharacter P lam)
  have hG : G.MapsTo lam := mapsTo_tensorBlock fun b hb ↦ by
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := hVc b hb
    have e : φ + b - lam = P.rootOf k := by
      rw [hφ_def, show b = -(-b) by abel, hk]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k
  set Hf := G.comp F hG
  
  have hkey : ∀ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam, ∀ ν,
      Hf.vermaMult (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w φ)) ν =
        F.vermaMult (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) ν := by
    intro w hw ν
    have hw' : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan φ := hWφ ▸ hw
    have hMφ := isInBlock_verma_weylDot (hA := hA) (lam := φ) hw'
    obtain ⟨e₁⟩ := G.nonempty_comp_equiv F hG _ hMφ
    obtain ⟨e₂⟩ := nonempty_tensorBlock_verma_equiv (μ₀ := φ) hlam hVc hδ w
    obtain ⟨e₃⟩ := F.nonempty_idem_range_equiv (hG _ hMφ)
      (isInBlock_verma_weylDot (hA := hA) hw) e₂.symm
    exact finrank_hom_congr_left P (e₁.trans e₃)
  
  set I := TwoSidedIdeal.ker (actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P φ))
  have hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P φ) := fun a ha ↦ (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).mp ha
  have hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤) (VermaModule P φ) a = 0 → a ∈ I :=
    fun a ha ↦ (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).mpr ha
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hp, hsum⟩ := Hf.exists_decomposition hφ hM₀ hI
  have hone : ∀ ν, Hf.vermaMult (VermaModule P φ) ν = F.vermaMult (VermaModule P lam) ν :=
    fun ν ↦ by
      have h := hkey 1 (one_mem _) ν
      rwa [weylDot_one, weylDot_one] at h
  have hcomm : ∀ G' ∈ l, G'.CommutesWithWeyl := by
    intro G' hG'
    obtain ⟨ψ, ⟨E⟩⟩ :=
      G'.exists_nonempty_equiv_projectiveCover hφ hM₀ hI (hK φ hφ) (hl G' hG').1
    refine G'.commutesWithWeyl_of_equiv_projectiveCover hφ hM₀ hI (hK φ hφ)
      (fun ξ hξ hξ' ↦ ?_) E
    have h1 : G'.vermaMult (VermaModule P φ) ψ = 1 := by
      rw [G'.vermaMult_verma_eq_multiplicity E ψ, VermaModule.multiplicity_self]
    have h2 : 1 ≤ Hf.vermaMult (VermaModule P φ) ψ := by
      rw [Hf.vermaMult_eq_sum l hp hsum (isInBlock_verma P hA φ) ψ, ← h1]
      exact List.le_sum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem hG')
    have hψ : ψ ∈ S := by
      change F.vermaMult _ ψ ≠ 0
      rw [← hone]
      omega
    exact hN N le_rfl ξ (hT.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨ψ, hψ, hξ, hξ'⟩)
  
  intro w hw ν
  have hw' : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan φ := hWφ ▸ hw
  rw [← hkey w hw, ← hone, Hf.vermaMult_eq_sum l hp hsum (isInBlock_verma_weylDot (hA := hA) hw'),
    Hf.vermaMult_eq_sum l hp hsum (isInBlock_verma P hA φ)]
  exact congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left fun G' hG' ↦ hcomm G' hG' w hw' ν)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_rep
statement:
theorem map_rep (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (u : 𝓤) (v : V) :
    f (rep P V u v) = rep P W u (f v)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing v with
  | algebraMap c => simp only [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul]
  | ι x => simp only [rep_ι, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
  | mul a b ha hb => simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_center_commute
statement:
theorem rep_center_commute (z : 𝓩) (u : 𝓤) :
    Commute (rep P V (z : 𝓤)) (rep P V u)
proof:
:= by
  change rep P V (z : 𝓤) * rep P V u = rep P V u * rep P V (z : 𝓤)
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp z.property u]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_centralBlock
statement:
theorem mem_centralBlock (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (v : V) :
    v ∈ centralBlock P V χ ↔ ∀ z : 𝓩, ∃ n : ℕ,
      ((rep P V (z : 𝓤) - χ z • 1) ^ n) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.End.mem_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_iff _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_mem_centralBlock
statement:
theorem map_mem_centralBlock (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W)
    (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ centralBlock P V χ) :
    f v ∈ centralBlock P W χ
proof:
:= by
  change v ∈ (⨅ z : 𝓩, (rep P V (z : 𝓤)).maxGenEigenspace (χ z)) at hv
  change f v ∈ (⨅ z : 𝓩, (rep P W (z : 𝓤)).maxGenEigenspace (χ z))
  simp only [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hv ⊢
  intro z
  exact Module.End.mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comp (f : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (by ext v; exact (map_rep P f (z : 𝓤) v).symm) (χ z) ⊤ (hv z)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlockMap_id
statement:
theorem centralBlockMap_id (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    centralBlockMap P (LieModuleHom.id : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) χ =
      LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  ext; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlockMap_comp
statement:
theorem centralBlockMap_comp (f : U →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V)
    (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    centralBlockMap P (g.comp f) χ =
      (centralBlockMap P g χ).comp (centralBlockMap P f χ)
proof:
:= by
  ext; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.injective_centralBlockMap
statement:
theorem injective_centralBlockMap (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Function.Injective (centralBlockMap P f χ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  exact Subtype.ext (hf (congrArg Subtype.val h))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_rep_center_sub_pow
statement:
theorem map_rep_center_sub_pow (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W)
    (z : 𝓩) (c : K) (n : ℕ) (v : V) :
    f (((rep P V (z : 𝓤) - c • 1) ^ n) v) =
      ((rep P W (z : 𝓤) - c • 1) ^ n) (f v)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_sub, map_smul, map_rep]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_centralBlock_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_centralBlock] at hv ⊢
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hv z
  exact ⟨n, hf (by rw [map_rep_center_sub_pow, hn, map_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_centralBlockMap_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_centralBlockMap_eq_range (f : U →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V)
    (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hex : g.ker = f.range) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    (centralBlockMap P g χ).ker = (centralBlockMap P f χ).range
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hgv : g v.val = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hv
    have hvRange : v.val ∈ f.range := hex ▸ hgv
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hvRange
    exact ⟨⟨u, mem_centralBlock_of_injective P f hf χ (hu ▸ v.property)⟩,
      Subtype.ext hu⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hfu : f u.val ∈ g.ker := hex.symm ▸
      (show f u.val ∈ f.range from ⟨u.val, rfl⟩)
    exact hfu

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.disjoint_centralBlock
statement:
theorem disjoint_centralBlock {χ ψ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hne : χ ≠ ψ) :
    Disjoint (centralBlock P V χ) (centralBlock P V ψ)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (χ : 𝓩 → K) ≠ (ψ : 𝓩 → K) := fun h ↦ hne (AlgHom.ext (congrFun h))
  have hd := Module.End.disjoint_iInf_maxGenEigenspace
    (fun z : 𝓩 ↦ rep P V (z : 𝓤)) hh
  rw [disjoint_iff] at hd ⊢
  ext v
  exact SetLike.ext_iff.mp hd v

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.iSupIndep_centralBlock
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_centralBlock :
    iSupIndep (fun χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K ↦ centralBlock P V χ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.iSupIndep_toSubmodule]
  exact (Module.End.independent_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_of_forall_mapsTo
    (fun z : 𝓩 ↦ rep P V (z : 𝓤))
    (fun z t c ↦ Module.End.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm
      (rep_center_commute P t (z : 𝓤)) c)).comp
    (fun _ _ h ↦ AlgHom.ext (congrFun h))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_eq_top_of_scalar
statement:
theorem centralBlock_eq_top_of_scalar (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (hχ : ∀ (z : 𝓩) (v : V), rep P V (z : 𝓤) v = χ z • v) :
    centralBlock P V χ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro v _
  rw [mem_centralBlock]
  intro z
  exact ⟨1, by simp [hχ]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_center_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have hc := congrArg (fun t : Module.End K V ↦ t v)
    (rep_center_commute P (V := V) z (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (h P a))).eq
  simpa only [Module.End.mul_apply, rep_ι, hv a, map_smul] using hc.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.isCentralLocallyFinite
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.isCentralLocallyFinite (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    IsCentralLocallyFinite P V
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := by
    rw [hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]; trivial
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun v ↦ ∃ p : Submodule K V,
    FiniteDimensional K p ∧ v ∈ p ∧
      ∀ z : 𝓩, Set.MapsTo (rep P V (z : 𝓤)) p p) hv ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro μ v hv
    exact ⟨weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ, hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ,
      hv, fun z _ hx ↦ rep_center_mem_weightSpace P z μ hx⟩
  · exact ⟨⊥, inferInstance, by simp, fun z ↦ by simp [Set.MapsTo]⟩
  · rintro x y ⟨p, hp, hxp, hpc⟩ ⟨q, hq, hyq, hqc⟩
    let := hp
    let := hq
    refine ⟨p ⊔ q, inferInstance,
      Submodule.add_mem_sup hxp hyq, ?_⟩
    intro z t ht
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp ht
    rw [map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (hpc z ha) (hqc z hb)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_centralBlockMap
statement:
theorem surjective_centralBlockMap [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hV : IsCentralLocallyFinite P V) (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Function.Surjective (centralBlockMap P f χ)
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hf w.val
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hvp, hpc⟩ := hV v
  let := hp
  let T (z : 𝓩) : Module.End K p := (rep P V (z : 𝓤)).restrict (hpc z)
  let E (μ : 𝓩 → K) : Submodule K p := ⨅ z, (T z).maxGenEigenspace (μ z)
  let F (μ : 𝓩 → K) : Submodule K W :=
    ⨅ z : 𝓩, (rep P W (z : 𝓤)).maxGenEigenspace (μ z)
  let g : p →ₗ[K] W := (f : V →ₗ[K] W).comp p.subtype
  have hT : Pairwise (fun z t ↦ Commute (T z) (T t)) := by
    intro z t _
    ext x
    exact congrArg (fun a : Module.End K V ↦ a x.val)
      (rep_center_commute P (V := V) z (t : 𝓤)).eq
  have htop : ⨆ μ, E μ = ⊤ :=
    Module.End.iSup_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_commute
      T hT (fun z ↦ (T z).iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top)
  have hF : iSupIndep F :=
    Module.End.independent_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_of_forall_mapsTo
      (fun z : 𝓩 ↦ rep P W (z : 𝓤))
      (fun z t c ↦ Module.End.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm
        (rep_center_commute P t (z : 𝓤)) c)
  have hmap (μ : 𝓩 → K) : (E μ).map g ≤ F μ := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [E, F, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    intro z
    exact Module.End.mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comp (f := T z) g
      (by ext x; exact (map_rep P f (z : 𝓤) x.val).symm) (μ z) ⊤ (hx z)
  have hw : w.val ∈ ⨆ μ, (E μ).map g := by
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, htop]
    exact ⟨⟨v, hvp⟩, Submodule.mem_top, hv⟩
  have hwχ : w.val ∈ (E (χ : 𝓩 → K)).map g :=
    hF.mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le hmap w.property hw
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hgx⟩ := hwχ
  have hxV : x.val ∈ centralBlock P V χ := by
    change x.val ∈ ⨅ z : 𝓩, (rep P V (z : 𝓤)).maxGenEigenspace (χ z)
    simp only [E, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    intro z
    exact Module.End.mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comp (f := T z) p.subtype
      (by ext; rfl) (χ z) ⊤ (hx z)
  exact ⟨⟨x.val, hxV⟩, Subtype.ext hgx⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.surjective_centralBlockMap
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.surjective_centralBlockMap [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Function.Surjective (centralBlockMap P f χ)
proof:
:=
  KacMoodyAlgebra.surjective_centralBlockMap P (hV.isCentralLocallyFinite P) f hf χ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.centralBlock
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.centralBlock (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    IsCategoryO P (centralBlock P V χ)
proof:
:=
  hV.lieSubmodule _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.shortExact_centralBlockMap
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.shortExact_centralBlockMap [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (f : U →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V)
    (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hex : g.ker = f.range) (hg : Function.Surjective g) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Function.Injective (centralBlockMap P f χ) ∧
      (centralBlockMap P g χ).ker = (centralBlockMap P f χ).range ∧
      Function.Surjective (centralBlockMap P g χ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨injective_centralBlockMap P f hf χ, ker_centralBlockMap_eq_range P f g hf hex χ,
    hV.surjective_centralBlockMap P g hg χ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_verma
statement:
theorem centralBlock_verma (Λ : Dual K H) :
    centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λ) (centralCharacter P Λ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply centralBlock_eq_top_of_scalar
  intro z v
  exact (map_smul_eq_rep P Λ LieModuleHom.id (z : 𝓤) v).symm.trans
    (centralCharacter_smul P Λ z v)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_eq_top_of_verma_surjective
statement:
theorem centralBlock_eq_top_of_verma_surjective (Λ : Dual K H)
    (f : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    centralBlock P V (centralCharacter P Λ) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  centralBlock_eq_top_of_scalar P _ (rep_center_eq_of_surjective P Λ f hf)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_irreducible
statement:
theorem centralBlock_irreducible (Λ : Dual K H) :
    centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (centralCharacter P Λ) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  centralBlock_eq_top_of_verma_surjective P Λ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _)
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_eq_bot_of_ne
statement:
theorem centralBlock_eq_bot_of_ne {χ ψ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} (hne : χ ≠ ψ)
    (hχ : centralBlock P V χ = ⊤) : centralBlock P V ψ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hd := disjoint_centralBlock P (V := V) hne
  simpa only [hχ, top_inf_eq] using hd.eq_bot

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_verma_eq_bot
statement:
theorem centralBlock_verma_eq_bot (Λ : Dual K H) (ψ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (hne : centralCharacter P Λ ≠ ψ) : centralBlock P (VermaModule P Λ) ψ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  centralBlock_eq_bot_of_ne P hne (centralBlock_verma P Λ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralBlock_irreducible_eq_bot
statement:
theorem centralBlock_irreducible_eq_bot (Λ : Dual K H) (ψ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (hne : centralCharacter P Λ ≠ ψ) : centralBlock P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) ψ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  centralBlock_eq_bot_of_ne P hne (centralBlock_irreducible P Λ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveO.directSum
statement:
theorem IsProjectiveO.directSum (hQ : ∀ j, IsProjectiveO.{w} P (Q j)) :
    IsProjectiveO.{w} P (DirectSum κ Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hM hN π hπ φ
  choose ψ hψ using fun j ↦
    hQ j hM hN π hπ (φ.comp (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ P.KacMoodyAlgebra Q j))
  refine ⟨DirectSum.toLieModule ψ, ?_⟩
  ext x
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | of j q =>
    rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, DirectSum.toLieModule_of]
    exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun (hψ j) q
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis K W
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.image fun i ↦ v ⊗ₜ[K] b i, ?_⟩
  set N := LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L
    ((Finset.univ.image fun i ↦ v ⊗ₜ[K] b i : Finset (V ⊗[K] W)) : Set (V ⊗[K] W))
  have hvN : ∀ l : W, v ⊗ₜ[K] l ∈ N := by
    intro l
    rw [← b.sum_repr l, tmul_sum]
    refine N.sum_mem fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [tmul_smul]
    exact N.smul_mem _ (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (by simp))
  let S : LieSubmodule K L V :=
    { carrier := {x | ∀ l : W, x ⊗ₜ[K] l ∈ N}
      add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy l ↦ by
        rw [add_tmul]
        exact N.add_mem (hx l) (hy l)
      zero_mem' := fun l ↦ by
        rw [zero_tmul]
        exact N.zero_mem
      smul_mem' := fun c x hx l ↦ by
        rw [← smul_tmul']
        exact N.smul_mem c (hx l)
      lie_mem := fun {y x} hx l ↦ by
        have h := N.sub_mem (N.lie_mem (x := y) (hx l)) (hx ⁅y, l⁆)
        rwa [TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, add_sub_cancel_right] at h }
  have hS : S = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← hv, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact hvN
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro z -
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x l =>
    have hx : x ∈ S := hS ▸ LieSubmodule.mem_top x
    exact hx l
  | add x y hx hy => exact N.add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top
    (hQ : ∀ j, ∃ T : Finset (Q j), LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L (T : Set (Q j)) = ⊤) :
    ∃ T : Finset (DirectSum κ Q), LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L (T : Set (DirectSum κ Q)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  choose T hT using hQ
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion fun j ↦ (T j).image (DirectSum.of Q j), ?_⟩
  set N := LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L
    ((Finset.univ.biUnion fun j ↦ (T j).image (DirectSum.of Q j) : Finset (DirectSum κ Q)) :
      Set (DirectSum κ Q))
  have hof : ∀ j (q : Q j), DirectSum.of Q j q ∈ N := by
    intro j q
    have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K L (T j : Set (Q j)) ≤
        N.comap (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ L Q j) := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
      intro t ht
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieSubmodule.mem_comap]
      exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (by
        simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, Finset.coe_univ, Set.mem_univ, Finset.coe_image,
          Set.iUnion_true, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image]
        exact ⟨j, t, ht, rfl⟩)
    rw [hT j] at hle
    exact hle (LieSubmodule.mem_top q)
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact N.zero_mem
  | of j q => exact hof j q
  | add x y hx hy => exact N.add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_rootOf_ne_bot
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_rootOf_ne_bot (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    {k : ι → ℤ | 0 ≤ k ∧ weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) ≠ ⊥}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hfin := (hM.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_ne_bot μ).preimage
    P.rootOf_injective.injOn
  refine ((Set.finite_singleton (0 : ι → ℤ)).union hfin).subset ?_
  rintro k ⟨hk, hne⟩
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · exact Or.inl hk0
  · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨k, ⟨hk, hk0⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rwa [add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finiteDimensional_aboveSpan
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.finiteDimensional_aboveSpan (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (F : Finset (Dual K H)) :
    FiniteDimensional K (aboveSpan P M F)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : ∀ μ : Dual K H, ⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) ≤
      ⨆ k : {k : ι → ℤ | 0 ≤ k ∧ weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) ≠ ⊥},
        weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) := by
    intro μ
    refine iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦ ?_
    by_cases hb : weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) = ⊥
    · rw [hb]
      exact bot_le
    · exact le_iSup_of_le (⟨k, hk, hb⟩ : {k : ι → ℤ | 0 ≤ k ∧
        weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) ≠ ⊥}) le_rfl
  have hfd : ∀ μ : F, FiniteDimensional K
      ↥(⨆ (k : ι → ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ k), weightSpace P M ((μ : Dual K H) + P.rootOf k) :
        Submodule K M) := by
    intro μ
    have := (hM.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_rootOf_ne_bot P (μ : Dual K H)).to_subtype
    have := fun k ↦ hM.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap ((μ : Dual K H) + P.rootOf k)
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (hinner μ)
  exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_iSup _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_primitive_mem_aboveSpan
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.exists_primitive_mem_aboveSpan (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    (F : Finset (Dual K H)) (hW : aboveSpan P M F ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ ν : Dual K H, ∃ v ∈ primitiveVectors P M ν, v ≠ 0 ∧ v ∈ aboveSpan P M F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ μ ∈ F, ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    refine hW (eq_bot_iff.mpr (iSup_le fun μ ↦ iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦ ?_))
    rw [hcon μ μ.2 k hk]
  obtain ⟨μ, hμF, k₀, hk₀, hne₀⟩ := hex
  set G := {k : ι → ℤ | 0 ≤ k ∧ weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) ≠ ⊥}
  have hG := hM.finite_setOf_weightSpace_add_rootOf_ne_bot P μ
  obtain ⟨k, hkG, hkmax⟩ := hG.toFinset.exists_max_image (fun k ↦ ∑ i, k i)
    ⟨k₀, hG.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨hk₀, hne₀⟩⟩
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hkG
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hkG.2
  refine ⟨μ + P.rootOf k, v, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hv, fun i ↦ ?_⟩, hv0, ?_⟩
  · have hmem := toEnd_e_mem_weightSpace (P := P) i hv
    rw [toEnd_apply_apply] at hmem
    have hw : μ + P.rootOf k + P.root i = μ + P.rootOf (k + Pi.single i 1) := by
      rw [map_add, rootOf_single, add_assoc]
    rw [hw] at hmem
    by_contra hne
    have hmemG : k + Pi.single i 1 ∈ G := ⟨add_nonneg hkG.1 (by
      intro j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simp
      · simp [hj]), fun hb ↦ hne (by rw [hb] at hmem; exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hmem)⟩
    have hle := hkmax _ (hG.mem_toFinset.mpr hmemG)
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_pi_single',
      Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte] at hle
    omega
  · exact (le_iSup_of_le (⟨μ, hμF⟩ : F) (le_iSup₂_of_le k hkG.1 le_rfl) :
      weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf k) ≤ aboveSpan P M F) hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finrank_aboveSpan_quotient_lt
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.finrank_aboveSpan_quotient_lt (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (F : Finset (Dual K H))
    (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M) {v : M} (hvW : v ∈ aboveSpan P M F) (hvN : v ∈ N) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    finrank K (aboveSpan P (M ⧸ N) F) < finrank K (aboveSpan P M F)
proof:
:= by
  have := hM.finiteDimensional_aboveSpan P F
  have hle : aboveSpan P (M ⧸ N) F ≤ (aboveSpan P M F).map (quotMk P N) := by
    refine iSup_le fun μ ↦ iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦ ?_
    refine (map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P N hM.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top _).ge.trans ?_
    exact Submodule.map_mono (le_iSup_of_le μ (le_iSup₂_of_le k hk le_rfl))
  refine (Submodule.finrank_mono hle).trans_lt ?_
  set f := (quotMk P N).domRestrict (aboveSpan P M F)
  have hrk := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f
  rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict] at hrk
  have hker : LinearMap.ker f ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hb
    have hmem : (⟨v, hvW⟩ : aboveSpan P M F) ∈ LinearMap.ker f := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.domRestrict_apply]
      exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := N)).mpr hvN
    rw [hb, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
    exact hv0 (congrArg Subtype.val hmem)
  have hpos : 0 < finrank K (LinearMap.ker f) :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 ↦ hker (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp h0)
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_projectiveCoverAmbient'_range_eq_lieSpan
statement:
theorem exists_projectiveCoverAmbient'_range_eq_lieSpan {ν : Dual K H} {v : M}
    (hv : v ∈ primitiveVectors P M ν) :
    ∃ φ : projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA ν →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M,
      ∀ x ∈ LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {v}, ∃ p, φ p = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_surjective_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA ν (projectiveCoverShift P hA ν)
  set f := (VermaModule.homEquiv P M ν).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hf : f (VermaModule.hwv P ν) = v :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((VermaModule.homEquiv P M ν).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  refine ⟨f.comp s, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← hf, ← VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range f x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hs y
  exact ⟨p, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCovered_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem isCovered_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] : IsCovered P hA M
proof:
:=
  ⟨Empty, inferInstance, inferInstance, Empty.elim, 0, fun _ ↦ ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCovered_of_subsingleton_of_aboveSpan_eq_bot
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ m : M, m = 0 := by
    intro m
    have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P M μ : Set M)) ≤ ⊥ := by
      rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe] at hx
      obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hx⟩ := hx
      have hxW : x ∈ aboveSpan P M F := by
        refine (le_iSup_of_le (⟨μ, hμ⟩ : F) (le_iSup₂_of_le (0 : ι → ℤ) le_rfl le_rfl) :
          weightSpace P M (μ + P.rootOf 0) ≤ aboveSpan P M F) ?_
        rwa [map_zero, add_zero]
      rw [hbot] at hxW
      exact hxW
    rw [hspan] at hle
    exact (LieSubmodule.mem_bot m).mp (hle (LieSubmodule.mem_top m))
  have : Subsingleton M := ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [hzero a, hzero b]⟩
  exact isCovered_of_subsingleton P hA

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.isCovered_of_quotient
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.isCovered_of_quotient (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 M)
    {ν : Dual K H} {v : M} (hv : v ∈ primitiveVectors P M ν)
    (hN : N = LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {v}) (hcov : IsCovered P hA (M ⧸ N)) :
    IsCovered P hA M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, g, hg⟩ := hcov
  obtain ⟨φv, hφv⟩ := exists_projectiveCoverAmbient'_range_eq_lieSpan P hA hv
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := IsProjectiveO.directSum (Q := fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))
    (fun j ↦ isProjectiveO_projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) hM (hM.quotient N)
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N) g
  obtain ⟨π, hπnone, hπsome⟩ : ∃ π : DirectSum (Option κ)
      (fun o ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (o.elim ν τ)) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M,
      (∀ p, π (DirectSum.of (fun o : Option κ ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (o.elim ν τ))
        none p) = φv p) ∧
      ∀ j x, π (DirectSum.of (fun o : Option κ ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (o.elim ν τ))
        (some j) x) = ψ (DirectSum.of (fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) j x) :=
    ⟨DirectSum.toLieModule fun o ↦ match o with
      | none => φv
      | some j => ψ.comp (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ 𝔤
          (fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) j),
      fun p ↦ DirectSum.toLieModule_of _ _ _, fun j x ↦ DirectSum.toLieModule_of _ _ _⟩
  refine ⟨Option κ, inferInstance, inferInstance, fun o ↦ o.elim ν τ, π, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  have hψr : ∀ q, ψ q ∈ π.range := by
    intro q
    induction q using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact π.range.zero_mem
    | of j x => exact (LieModuleHom.mem_range π _).mpr ⟨_, hπsome j x⟩
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact π.range.add_mem hx hy
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hg (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N m)
  have hmq : m - ψ q ∈ N := by
    rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, map_sub, ← hq, ← LieModuleHom.comp_apply, hψ,
      sub_self]
  rw [hN] at hmq
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hφv _ hmq
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range π _).mp
    (π.range.add_mem ((LieModuleHom.mem_range π _).mpr ⟨_, hπnone p⟩) (hψr q))
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  rw [hr, hp, sub_add_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCovered_of_finrank_aboveSpan_le
statement:
theorem isCovered_of_finrank_aboveSpan_le (d : ℕ) : ∀ (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 M] [LieModule K 𝔤 M], IsCategoryO P M → ∀ F : Finset (Dual K H),
    LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P M μ : Set M)) = ⊤ →
    finrank K (aboveSpan P M F) ≤ d → IsCovered P hA M
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro M _ _ _ _ hM F hspan hd
    have := hM.finiteDimensional_aboveSpan P F
    have hbot : aboveSpan P M F = ⊥ := Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp (Nat.le_zero.mp hd)
    exact isCovered_of_subsingleton_of_aboveSpan_eq_bot P hA hspan hbot
  | succ d ih =>
    intro M _ _ _ _ hM F hspan hd
    by_cases hbot : aboveSpan P M F = ⊥
    · exact isCovered_of_subsingleton_of_aboveSpan_eq_bot P hA hspan hbot
    obtain ⟨ν, v, hv, hv0, hvW⟩ := hM.exists_primitive_mem_aboveSpan P F hbot
    set N := LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 {v}
    refine hM.isCovered_of_quotient P hA N hv rfl
      (ih (M ⧸ N) (hM.quotient N) F ?_ ?_)
    · rw [eq_top_iff]
      rintro x -
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N x
      have hle : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P M μ : Set M)) ≤
          (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P (M ⧸ N) μ : Set (M ⧸ N)))).comap
            (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) := by
        rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
        intro y hy
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe] at hy
        obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hy⟩ := hy
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieSubmodule.mem_comap]
        refine LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ?_
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe]
        exact ⟨μ, hμ, map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) hy⟩
      rw [hspan] at hle
      exact hle (LieSubmodule.mem_top m)
    · have := hM.finrank_aboveSpan_quotient_lt P F N hvW (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan rfl) hv0
      omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_finset_lieSpan_weightSpace_eq_top
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.exists_finset_lieSpan_weightSpace_eq_top (hM : IsCategoryO P M)
    {S : Finset M} (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) :
    ∃ F : Finset (Dual K H),
      LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P M μ : Set M)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hgen : ∀ s ∈ S, ∃ F : Finset (Dual K H), s ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ F, weightSpace P M μ := by
    intro s _
    have hs : s ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpace P M μ := by
      rw [hM.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]
      trivial
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset.mp hs
  choose! Fs hFs using hgen
  set F := S.biUnion Fs
  have hspan : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P M μ : Set M)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← hS, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    intro s hs
    have hle : (⨆ μ ∈ Fs s, weightSpace P M μ) ≤
        (LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (⋃ μ ∈ F, (weightSpace P M μ : Set M))).toSubmodule :=
      iSup₂_le fun μ hμ x hx ↦ LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan
        (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨μ, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s, hs, hμ⟩, hx⟩)
    exact hle (hFs s hs)
  exact ⟨F, hspan⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.isCovered
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.isCovered (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {S : Finset M}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) : IsCovered P hA M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hspan⟩ := hM.exists_finset_lieSpan_weightSpace_eq_top P hS
  exact isCovered_of_finrank_aboveSpan_le P hA _ M hM F hspan le_rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_lieSpan_projectiveCoverAmbient'_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_finset_lieSpan_projectiveCoverAmbient'_eq_top (Λ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ T : Finset (projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ),
      LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (T : Set (projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA Λ)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA
    (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P (projectiveCoverShift P hA Λ))
  exact exists_finset_lieSpan_tmul_eq_top
    (VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isProjectiveO_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_isProjectiveO_surjective (hM : IsCategoryO P M) {S : Finset M}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set M) = ⊤) :
    ∃ (κ : Type) (_ : Fintype κ) (_ : DecidableEq κ) (τ : κ → Dual K H),
      IsCategoryO P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) ∧
      IsProjectiveO.{w'} P (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) ∧
      (∃ T : Finset (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)),
        LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (T : Set (DirectSum κ fun j ↦
          projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))) = ⊤) ∧
      ∃ π : (DirectSum κ fun j ↦ projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j)) →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ M,
        Function.Surjective π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, π, hπ⟩ := hM.isCovered P hA hS
  exact ⟨κ, inferInstance, inferInstance, τ,
    IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun j ↦ isCategoryO_projectiveCoverAmbient P hA _ _,
    IsProjectiveO.directSum fun j ↦ isProjectiveO_projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA _,
    exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top fun j ↦
      exists_finset_lieSpan_projectiveCoverAmbient'_eq_top P hA (τ j), π, hπ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.center_smul_comm
statement:
theorem center_smul_comm (Λ : Dual K H) (z : 𝓩) (u : 𝓤) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    u • ((z : 𝓤) • m) = (z : 𝓤) • (u • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp z.property u]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.center_smul_hwv_mem
statement:
theorem center_smul_hwv_mem (Λ : Dual K H) (z : 𝓩) :
    (z : 𝓤) • hwv P Λ ∈ weightSpace P Λ Λ
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  change UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (h P a) • ((z : 𝓤) • hwv P Λ) = _
  rw [center_smul_comm, ← lie_eq_smul, lie_h_hwv, smul_algebra_smul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_center_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_center_smul_eq (Λ : Dual K H) (z : 𝓩) :
    ∃ c : K, ∀ m : VermaModule P Λ, (z : 𝓤) • m = c • m
proof:
:= by
  have hz := center_smul_hwv_mem P Λ z
  rw [weightSpace_self, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hz
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨c, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P Λ m
  rw [mk_eq_smul, ← center_smul_comm, ← hc, smul_algebra_smul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.center_smul_eq
statement:
theorem center_smul_eq (Λ : Dual K H) (z : 𝓩) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    (z : 𝓤) • m = centralScalar P Λ z • m
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_center_smul_eq P Λ z) m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_smul
statement:
theorem centralCharacter_smul (Λ : Dual K H) (z : 𝓩) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    (z : 𝓤) • m = centralCharacter P Λ z • m
proof:
:=
  center_smul_eq P Λ z m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_eq_of_hom_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  have hv : φ (hwv P μ) ≠ 0 := fun he ↦ hφ ((eq_zero_iff P φ).mpr he)
  apply smul_left_injective K hv
  dsimp only
  rw [← map_smul, ← centralCharacter_smul, map_smul_eq_smul, centralCharacter_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hom_eq_zero_of_centralCharacter_ne
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hφ
  exact hne (centralCharacter_eq_of_hom_ne_zero P φ hφ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_unique
statement:
theorem centralCharacter_unique (Λ : Dual K H) (χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)
    (hχ : ∀ z : 𝓩, (z : 𝓤) • hwv P Λ = χ z • hwv P Λ) :
    χ = centralCharacter P Λ
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  exact smul_left_injective K (hwv_ne_zero P Λ)
    ((hχ z).symm.trans (centralCharacter_smul P Λ z (hwv P Λ)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.rep_center_map
statement:
theorem rep_center_map (Λ : Dual K H) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (z : 𝓩) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    rep P V (z : 𝓤) (φ m) = centralCharacter P Λ z • φ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_smul_eq_rep, centralCharacter_smul, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.rep_center_eq_of_surjective
statement:
theorem rep_center_eq_of_surjective (Λ : Dual K H) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (z : 𝓩) (v : V) : rep P V (z : 𝓤) v = centralCharacter P Λ z • v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hφ v
  rw [← map_smul_eq_rep, centralCharacter_smul, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_reflection_of_pos
statement:
theorem centralCharacter_reflection_of_pos (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {Λ : Dual K H} {i : ι} {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    centralCharacter P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) = centralCharacter P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, _⟩ := exists_injective_reflection P hA hn0 hn
  apply centralCharacter_eq_of_hom_ne_zero P φ
  intro he
  exact hwv_ne_zero P _ (hφ (by rw [he, _root_.zero_apply, map_zero]))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_reflection_of_integral
statement:
theorem centralCharacter_reflection_of_integral (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {Λ : Dual K H} (i : ι) (hi : ∃ n : ℤ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    centralCharacter P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) = centralCharacter P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hi
  rcases lt_trichotomy n 0 with hneg | rfl | hpos
  · have hcast : ((-n).toNat : K) = -(n : K) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), Int.cast_neg]
    have hp : 0 < (-n).toNat := by omega
    have he := centralCharacter_reflection_of_pos P hA
      (Λ := P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) hp (i := i) (by
        rw [sub_add_cancel, P.reflection_apply_coroot_self, hn, hcast])
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel, P.reflection_reflection, add_sub_cancel_right] using he.symm
  · rw [P.reflection_apply, hn, Int.cast_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero, add_sub_cancel_right]
  · have hcast : (n.toNat : K) = (n : K) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]
    exact centralCharacter_reflection_of_pos P hA (by omega) (hn.trans hcast.symm)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl_of_integral
statement:
theorem centralCharacter_weyl_of_integral (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (Λ : Dual K H) (hΛ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, Λ (P.coroot i) = n) :
    centralCharacter P (w (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) = centralCharacter P Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
    exact ⟨n + 1, by simp [hn]⟩
  have aux := P.weylGroup_induction hA
    (p := fun w ↦ (∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, w (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) ∧
      centralCharacter P (w (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) = centralCharacter P Λ)
    (show (∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, (1 : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
        (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) ∧ _ from
      ⟨hρ, by simp⟩) (fun i w ih ↦ ?_) hw
  · exact aux.2
  · constructor
    · intro j
      obtain ⟨nj, hj⟩ := ih.1 j
      obtain ⟨ni, hi⟩ := ih.1 i
      refine ⟨nj - A j i * ni, ?_⟩
      simp only [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, P.reflection_apply_apply,
        P.coreflection_coroot, map_sub, map_smul, hj, hi, smul_eq_mul,
        Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul]
    · rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
      have he := centralCharacter_reflection_of_integral P hA
        (Λ := w (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) i (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using ih.1 i)
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using he.trans ih.2

name: LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top {R L M : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule R L M)] :
    ∃ S : Finset M, LieSubmodule.lieSpan R L (S : Set M) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨S, rfl⟩, hS⟩ := (wellFounded_gt (α := LieSubmodule R L M)).has_min
    (Set.range fun S : Finset M ↦ LieSubmodule.lieSpan R L (S : Set M)) ⟨_, ∅, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨S, by_contra fun hne ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne)
  refine hS _ ⟨insert x S, rfl⟩ (SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mpr ⟨?_, x, ?_, hx⟩)
  · exact LieSubmodule.lieSpan_mono (by rw [Finset.coe_insert]; exact Set.subset_insert _ _)
  · exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan (by rw [Finset.coe_insert]; exact Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.of_subsingleton (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] [Subsingleton V] : IsCategoryO P V
proof:
:= by
  have := (Submodule.subsingleton_iff K).mpr ‹Subsingleton V›
  refine ⟨Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun μ ↦ ?_, ⟨∅, fun μ hμ ↦ (hμ (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim⟩⟩
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) ⊥]
  infer_instance

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isObj_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isObj_of_surjective {X Y : ModuleCat.{w} 𝓤} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom) (hX : IsObj P X) : IsObj P Y
proof:
:= by
  let φ := toLieModuleHom (P := P) f
  let q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift φ.ker φ le_rfl
  have hq : Function.Bijective q := by
    refine ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ?_, LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_surjective _ _ _ hf⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' φ.ker a
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' φ.ker b
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_mk, LieSubmodule.Quotient.lift_mk] at hab
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, LieModuleHom.mem_ker,
      map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hX.2
  refine ⟨(hX.1.quotient φ.ker).of_equiv (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective q hq), ?_⟩
  classical
  refine ⟨S.image f.hom, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.coe_image]
  exact lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective φ hf hS

    (hM : ∀ j, IsCategoryO P (M j)) : IsCategoryO P (piObj M)
proof:

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.exists_finset_lieSpan_piObj_eq_top
statement:
lemma exists_finset_lieSpan_piObj_eq_top {J : Type} [Finite J] (M : J → ModuleCat.{w} 𝓤)
    (hM : ∀ j, ∃ S : Finset (M j), LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set (M j)) = ⊤) :
    ∃ S : Finset (piObj M), LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set (piObj M)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite J
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_finset_lieSpan_directSum_eq_top (L := 𝔤) hM
  refine ⟨T.image (directSumEquivPi (P := P) M), ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.coe_image]
  exact lieSpan_image_eq_top_of_surjective (directSumEquivPi (P := P) M).toLieModuleHom
    (directSumEquivPi (P := P) M).surjective hT
