name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isClosedUnderLimitsOfShape_discrete
statement:
lemma isClosedUnderLimitsOfShape_discrete (J : Type) [Finite J] :
    (IsObj.{w} P).IsClosedUnderLimitsOfShape (Discrete J)
proof:
:= by
  refine ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderLimitsOfShape.mk' ?_
  rintro _ ⟨F, hF⟩
  let e : limit F ≅ piObj (fun j ↦ F.obj ⟨j⟩) :=
    HasLimit.isoOfNatIso (Discrete.natIsoFunctor (F := F)) ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi _
  exact (IsObj.{w} P).prop_of_iso e.symm (isObj_pi _ fun j ↦ hF ⟨j⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.isObj_of_injective
statement:
theorem isObj_of_injective {X Y : ModuleCat.{w} 𝓤} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) (hY : IsObj P Y) : IsObj P X
proof:
:= by
  let φ := toLieModuleHom (P := P) f
  let r : X →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ φ.range :=
    φ.codRestrict φ.range fun m ↦ (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩
  have hr : Function.Bijective r := by
    refine ⟨fun a b hab ↦ hf (congrArg Subtype.val hab), fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mp hy
    exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hY.2
  have := hY.1.wellFoundedGT_lieSubmodule P (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan) hS
  have : WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 X) :=
    (LieSubmodule.mapOrderEmbedding (f := φ) hf).strictMono.wellFoundedGT
  exact ⟨(hY.1.lieSubmodule φ.range).of_equiv (LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective r hr).symm,
    LieSubmodule.exists_finset_lieSpan_eq_top⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.injective_of_mono

theorem injective_of_mono {X Y : CategoryO.{w} P} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Mono f] :
    Function.Injective f.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  have := (IsObj.{w} P).preservesMonomorphisms_ι_of_isNormalEpiCategory
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective ((IsObj.{w} P).ι.map f)).mp inferInstance

name: AlgHom.exists_rep_eq_id_and_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_rep_eq_id_and_eq_zero (ρ : R →ₐ[K] Module.End K V)
    (B : (R →ₐ[K] K) → Submodule K V)
    (hB : ∀ ψ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ v ∈ B ψ, ((ρ a - ψ a • 1) ^ n) v = 0)
    (T : Finset (R →ₐ[K] K)) (χ : R →ₐ[K] K) :
    ∃ c : R, (∀ v ∈ B χ, ρ c v = v) ∧ ∀ ψ ∈ T, ψ ≠ χ → ∀ v ∈ B ψ, ρ c v = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρ : ∀ (a : R) (x : K), ρ (a - algebraMap K R x) = ρ a - x • 1 := by
    intro a x
    rw [map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  
  have step : ∃ b : R, χ b ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ ψ ∈ T, ψ ≠ χ → ∀ v ∈ B ψ, ρ b v = 0 := by
    induction T using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨1, by simp, by simp⟩
    | insert ψ T _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hbT⟩ := ih
      by_cases hψ : ψ = χ
      · refine ⟨b, hb, fun ψ' hψ' hne v hv ↦ ?_⟩
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hψ' with rfl | hψ'
        · exact absurd hψ hne
        · exact hbT ψ' hψ' hne v hv
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, χ a ≠ ψ a := by
        by_contra! h
        exact hψ (AlgHom.ext h).symm
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hB ψ a
      refine ⟨b * (a - algebraMap K R (ψ a)) ^ n, ?_, fun ψ' hψ' hne v hv ↦ ?_⟩
      · rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
        exact mul_ne_zero hb (pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha))
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hψ' with rfl | hψ'
      · rw [map_mul, map_pow, hρ, Module.End.mul_apply, hn v hv, map_zero]
      · rw [mul_comm, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hbT ψ' hψ' hne v hv, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbT⟩ := step
  set y : R := (χ b)⁻¹ • b with hy
  have hχy : χ y = 1 := by rw [hy, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hB χ y
  refine ⟨1 - (1 - y) ^ m, fun v hv ↦ ?_, fun ψ hψ hne v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h1 : ρ (1 - y) = -(ρ y - χ y • 1) := by
      rw [hχy, one_smul, map_sub, map_one, neg_sub]
    rw [map_sub, map_one, map_pow, h1, neg_pow, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
      Module.End.mul_apply, hm v hv, map_zero, sub_zero]
  · have hyv : ρ y v = 0 := by rw [hy, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hbT ψ hψ hne v hv,
      smul_zero]
    have hk : ∀ k : ℕ, ((1 - ρ y) ^ k) v = v := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, hyv,
          sub_zero, ih]
    rw [map_sub, map_one, map_pow, map_sub, map_one, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
      hk, sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralShiftPow_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem centralShiftPow_apply (z : 𝓩) (c : K) (n : ℕ) (v : V) :
    centralShiftPow P z c n v = ((rep P V (z : 𝓤) - c • 1) ^ n) v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_pow_eq_zero_of_mem_centralBlock
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ht : ∀ t ∈ s, ∃ n : ℕ,
      ((rep P V (z : 𝓤) - χ z • 1) ^ n) (centralBlockProjection P hV χ t) = 0 := fun t _ ↦
    (mem_centralBlock P χ _).mp (centralBlockProjection_mem P hV χ t) z
  choose! n hn using ht
  refine ⟨s.sup n, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  have hker : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (s : Set V) ≤
      ((centralShiftPow P z (χ z) (s.sup n)).comp (centralBlockProjection P hV χ)).ker := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    intro t ht
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, centralShiftPow_apply,
      ← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.le_sup ht), pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hn t ht,
      map_zero]
  rw [hs] at hker
  have := hker (LieSubmodule.mem_top v)
  rwa [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, centralBlockProjection_self P hV χ hv,
    centralShiftPow_apply] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_finset_centralBlockProjection_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_finset_centralBlockProjection_eq_zero (hV : IsCentralLocallyFinite P V)
    {s : Finset V} (hs : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (s : Set V) = ⊤) :
    ∃ T : Finset (𝓩 →ₐ[K] K), ∀ ψ ∉ T, ∀ v, centralBlockProjection P hV ψ v = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose T hT₀ _ using fun t : V ↦ exists_finset_sum_centralBlockProjection P hV t
  refine ⟨s.biUnion T, fun ψ hψ v ↦ ?_⟩
  have hker : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (s : Set V) ≤
      (centralBlockProjection P hV ψ).ker := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    intro t ht
    exact hT₀ t ψ fun h ↦ hψ (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t, ht, h⟩)
  rw [hs] at hker
  exact hker (LieSubmodule.mem_top v)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_eq_centralBlockProjection_of
statement:
theorem rep_eq_centralBlockProjection_of (hV : IsCentralLocallyFinite P V)
    {T : Finset (𝓩 →ₐ[K] K)} (hT : ∀ ψ ∉ T, ∀ v, centralBlockProjection P hV ψ v = 0)
    {χ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K} {c : 𝓩} (hcχ : ∀ v ∈ centralBlock P V χ, rep P V (c : 𝓤) v = v)
    (hcT : ∀ ψ ∈ T, ψ ≠ χ → ∀ v ∈ centralBlock P V ψ, rep P V (c : 𝓤) v = 0) (v : V) :
    rep P V (c : 𝓤) v = centralBlockProjection P hV χ v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS₀, hS⟩ := exists_finset_sum_centralBlockProjection P hV v
  conv_lhs => rw [← hS]
  rw [map_sum]
  have hc : ∀ ψ, rep P V (c : 𝓤) (centralBlockProjection P hV ψ v) =
      if ψ = χ then centralBlockProjection P hV χ v else 0 := by
    intro ψ
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      exact hcχ _ (centralBlockProjection_mem P hV ψ v)
    · by_cases hψ : ψ ∈ T
      · exact hcT ψ hψ h _ (centralBlockProjection_mem P hV ψ v)
      · rw [hT ψ hψ v, map_zero]
  simp only [hc, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact (hS₀ χ h).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_rep_eq_centralBlockProjection₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ := exists_finset_centralBlockProjection_eq_zero P hV hs
  obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂⟩ := exists_finset_centralBlockProjection_eq_zero P hW ht
  let ρV := (rep P V).comp (Subalgebra.center K 𝓤).val
  let ρW := (rep P W).comp (Subalgebra.center K 𝓤).val
  let ρ := (LinearMap.prodMapAlgHom K V W).comp (ρV.prod ρW)
  have hsh : ∀ (a : 𝓩) (c : K) (n : ℕ) (x : V × W), ((ρ a - c • 1) ^ n) x =
      (((ρV a - c • 1) ^ n) x.1, ((ρW a - c • 1) ^ n) x.2) := by
    intro a c n x
    have h₀ : (ρ a - c • 1) ^ n = ρ ((a - algebraMap K 𝓩 c) ^ n) := by
      rw [map_pow, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    have h₁ : (ρV a - c • 1) ^ n = ρV ((a - algebraMap K 𝓩 c) ^ n) := by
      rw [map_pow, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    have h₂ : (ρW a - c • 1) ^ n = ρW ((a - algebraMap K 𝓩 c) ^ n) := by
      rw [map_pow, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    rw [h₀, h₁, h₂]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨c, hcχ, hcT⟩ := AlgHom.exists_rep_eq_id_and_eq_zero ρ
    (fun ψ ↦ (centralBlock P V ψ).toSubmodule.prod (centralBlock P W ψ).toSubmodule)
    (fun ψ a ↦ by
      obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ := exists_pow_eq_zero_of_mem_centralBlock P hV hs ψ a
      obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ := exists_pow_eq_zero_of_mem_centralBlock P hW ht ψ a
      refine ⟨n₁ + n₂, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [hsh]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · change ((rep P V (a : 𝓤) - ψ a • 1) ^ (n₁ + n₂)) x.1 = 0
        rw [add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hn₁ x.1 hx.1, map_zero]
      · change ((rep P W (a : 𝓤) - ψ a • 1) ^ (n₁ + n₂)) x.2 = 0
        rw [pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hn₂ x.2 hx.2, map_zero])
    (T₁ ∪ T₂) χ
  have hρ : ∀ x : V × W, ρ c x = (rep P V (c : 𝓤) x.1, rep P W (c : 𝓤) x.2) := fun _ ↦ rfl
  refine ⟨c, rep_eq_centralBlockProjection_of P hV (T := T₁ ∪ T₂)
    (fun ψ hψ ↦ hT₁ ψ fun h ↦ hψ (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)) ?_ ?_,
    rep_eq_centralBlockProjection_of P hW (T := T₁ ∪ T₂)
    (fun ψ hψ ↦ hT₂ ψ fun h ↦ hψ (Finset.mem_union_right _ h)) ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    simpa [hρ] using congrArg Prod.fst (hcχ (v, 0) ⟨hv, zero_mem _⟩)
  · intro ψ hψ hne v hv
    simpa [hρ] using congrArg Prod.fst (hcT ψ hψ hne (v, 0) ⟨hv, zero_mem _⟩)
  · intro w hw
    simpa [hρ] using congrArg Prod.snd (hcχ (0, w) ⟨zero_mem _, hw⟩)
  · intro ψ hψ hne w hw
    simpa [hρ] using congrArg Prod.snd (hcT ψ hψ hne (0, w) ⟨zero_mem _, hw⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_rep_eq_centralBlockProjection
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, -⟩ := exists_rep_eq_centralBlockProjection₂ P hV hs hV hs χ
  exact ⟨z, hz⟩

name: Module.End.maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace_of_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top
statement:
lemma maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace_of_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top {f : Module.End K V}
    (hf : ⨆ μ, f.eigenspace μ = ⊤) (μ : K) : f.maxGenEigenspace μ = f.eigenspace μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ((f.genEigenspace μ).mono le_top)
  have hp : ∀ x ∈ f.maxGenEigenspace μ, f x ∈ f.maxGenEigenspace μ :=
    fun x hx ↦ mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (Commute.refl f) μ hx
  have := Submodule.inf_iSup_genEigenspace hp 1
  rw [show ⨆ μ, f.genEigenspace μ 1 = ⊤ from hf, inf_top_eq] at this
  rw [this]
  refine iSup_le fun ν ↦ ?_
  by_cases hν : ν = μ
  · subst hν; exact inf_le_right
  · rw [(f.disjoint_genEigenspace (Ne.symm hν) ⊤ 1).eq_bot]
    exact bot_le

name: Module.End.iSup_iInf_eigenspace_eq_top_of_commute
statement:
theorem iSup_iInf_eigenspace_eq_top_of_commute {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Module.End K V)
    (h : Pairwise fun i j ↦ Commute (f i) (f j)) (h' : ∀ i, ⨆ μ, (f i).eigenspace μ = ⊤) :
    ⨆ χ : ι → K, ⨅ i, (f i).eigenspace (χ i) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := iSup_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_commute f h
    fun i ↦ by simp_rw [maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace_of_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top (h' i), h' i]
  simpa only [maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace_of_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top (h' _)] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isNilpotent_toEnd_e

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional
statement: theorem isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional : IsHDiagonalizable P V
proof:
:= by
  let T : ι → Module.End K V := fun i ↦ toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (h P (P.coroot i))
  have hcomm : Pairwise fun i j ↦ Commute (T i) (T j) := fun i j _ ↦ by
    ext v
    simp only [T, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]
    rw [leibniz_lie, lie_h_h, zero_lie, zero_add]
  have hdiag : ∀ i, ⨆ μ, (T i).eigenspace μ = ⊤ := fun i ↦ eq_top_iff.mpr <|
    ((isSl2Triple P hA.isGeneralizedCartan i).iSup_eigenspace_toEnd_h_eq_top (M := V)).ge.trans
      (iSup_le fun k ↦ le_iSup (fun μ ↦ (T i).eigenspace μ) (k : K))
  let b : Basis ι K H := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' P.coroot
    P.linearIndependent_coroot (P.finrank_eq_card_of_isFiniteCartan hA).symm
  have hb : ∀ i, b i = P.coroot i := fun i ↦ by simp [b]
  rw [IsHDiagonalizable, eq_top_iff, ← Module.End.iSup_iInf_eigenspace_eq_top_of_commute T
    hcomm hdiag]
  refine iSup_le fun χ ↦ le_iSup_of_le (b.constr K χ) fun v hv ↦ ?_
  rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hv
  have hext : (LinearMap.smulRight (b.constr K χ) v : H →ₗ[K] V) =
      (LinearMap.applyₗ v : Module.End K V →ₗ[K] V) ∘ₗ
        ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V : P.KacMoodyAlgebra →ₗ[K] Module.End K V) ∘ₗ h P) :=
    b.ext fun i ↦ by
      have := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp (hv i)
      simp only [T, toEnd_apply_apply] at this
      rw [LinearMap.smulRight_apply, Basis.constr_basis, hb]
      simp [this]
  intro a
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun hext a
  simp only [LinearMap.smulRight_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.applyₗ_apply_apply, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, toEnd_apply_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional : IsIntegrable P V where
  isHDiagonalizable
proof:
:= isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional hA
  exists_pow_e_eq_zero i v := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := isNilpotent_toEnd_e (P := P) (V := V) hA.isGeneralizedCartan i
    exact ⟨n, by rw [hn, LinearMap.zero_apply]⟩
  exists_pow_f_eq_zero i v := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := isNilpotent_toEnd_f (P := P) (V := V) hA.isGeneralizedCartan i
    exact ⟨n, by rw [hn, LinearMap.zero_apply]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional : IsCategoryO P V where
  iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
proof:
:= isHDiagonalizable_of_finiteDimensional hA
  finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap _ := inferInstance
  exists_finset := by
    have hind := iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := V) (h P)
    have := hind.fintypeNeBotOfFiniteDimensional
    have hfin : {μ | weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
      Set.finite_coe_iff.mp (inferInstance : Finite {μ // weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ ≠ ⊥})
    exact ⟨hfin.toFinset, fun μ hμ ↦ ⟨μ, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hμ, 0, le_rfl, by simp⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_isInternal_irreducibleModule_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem exists_isInternal_irreducibleModule_of_finiteDimensional :
    ∃ s : Set (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V),
      DirectSum.IsInternal (fun N : s ↦ (N : Submodule K V)) ∧
      ∀ N ∈ s, ∃ Λ, P.IsDominantIntegral Λ ∧
        Nonempty (N ≃ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:=
  IsCategoryO.exists_isInternal_irreducibleModule hA.isGeneralizedCartan hA.isSymmetrizable
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA) (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional hA)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.complementedLattice_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem complementedLattice_of_finiteDimensional :
    ComplementedLattice (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V)
proof:
:=
  IsCategoryO.complementedLattice hA.isGeneralizedCartan hA.isSymmetrizable
    (isCategoryO_of_finiteDimensional hA) (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional hA)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_weylGroup_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_weylGroup_apply_eq_zero [Fintype (P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)]
    (ν : Dual K H) :
    ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  set s := ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν
  have hfix : ∀ i, P.reflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i s = s := fun i ↦ by
    let ri : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan :=
      ⟨_, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan i⟩
    simp only [s, map_sum]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft ri) _ _ fun w ↦ rfl
  have hzero : ∀ i, s (P.coroot i) = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    have := hfix i
    rw [reflection_apply, sub_eq_self, smul_eq_zero] at this
    exact this.resolve_right (P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i)
  have hspan := P.linearIndependent_coroot.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank'
    (P.finrank_eq_card_of_isFiniteCartan hA).symm
  exact LinearMap.ext_on_range hspan fun i ↦ by simp [hzero i]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    FiniteDimensional K (IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have hGC := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  let : Fintype (P.weylGroup hGC) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hI := (IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable_iff P hGC).mpr hΛ
  have hcone : ∀ μ, weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ ≠ ⊥ →
      ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ μ = Λ - P.rootOf k := fun μ hμ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
    exact VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _)
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) hx hx0
  have key : ∀ μ, weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ ≠ ⊥ → ∃ k κ : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧
      k ≤ κ ∧ μ = Λ - P.rootOf k ∧ P.rootOf κ = Fintype.card (P.weylGroup hGC) • Λ := by
    intro μ hμ
    have : ∀ w : P.weylGroup hGC, ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧
        (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = Λ - P.rootOf k := fun w ↦
      hcone _ (by rwa [Ne, weightSpace_weylGroup_eq_bot_iff hGC hI w.2])
    choose k hk0 hk using this
    refine ⟨k 1, ∑ w, k w, hk0 1, Finset.single_le_sum (fun w _ ↦ hk0 w) (Finset.mem_univ 1),
      by simpa using hk 1, ?_⟩
    have hsum : ∑ w, P.rootOf (k w) =
        ∑ w : P.weylGroup hGC, (Λ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ ↦ by rw [hk w]; abel
    rw [map_sum, hsum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_weylGroup_apply_eq_zero hA, sub_zero,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ]
  obtain ⟨-, κ, -, -, -, hκ⟩ := key Λ ((Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mpr
    ⟨_, IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ, IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P Λ⟩)
  have hfinK : (Set.univ.pi fun i ↦ Set.Icc (0 : ℤ) (κ i)).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.pi fun i ↦ Set.finite_Icc _ _
  set F : Finset (Dual K H) := (hfinK.image fun k ↦ Λ - P.rootOf k).toFinset
  have hF : ∀ μ, weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ ≠ ⊥ → μ ∈ F := fun μ hμ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨k, κ', hk0, hkκ, rfl, hκ'⟩ := key μ hμ
    have : κ' = κ := P.rootOf_injective (hκ'.trans hκ.symm)
    subst this
    exact (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr
      ⟨k, Set.mem_univ_pi.mpr fun i ↦ ⟨hk0 i, hkκ i⟩, rfl⟩
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule K (IrreducibleModule P Λ)) ≤
      F.sup (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)) := by
    rw [← (hI.isHDiagonalizable : ⨆ μ, weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ = ⊤)]
    refine iSup_le fun μ ↦ ?_
    by_cases hμ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ = ⊥
    · rw [hμ]; exact bot_le
    · exact Finset.le_sup (f := weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)) (hF μ hμ)
  have := (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap
  have : FiniteDimensional K (⊤ : Submodule K (IrreducibleModule P Λ)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le htop
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional Submodule.topEquiv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional_iff
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional_iff {Λ : Dual K H} :
    FiniteDimensional K (IrreducibleModule P Λ) ↔ P.IsDominantIntegral Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ ?_, IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional hA⟩
  exact (IrreducibleModule.isIntegrable_iff P hA.isGeneralizedCartan).mp
    (isIntegrable_of_finiteDimensional hA)

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_isDominant_weylDot
statement:
theorem exists_isDominant_weylDot (lam : Dual K H) :
    ∃ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
      P.IsDominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan
        (P.weylDot hF.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hanti⟩ := P.exists_isAntidominant_weylDot hF (-(lam + P.rho) - P.rho)
  have hW : P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan (-(lam + P.rho) - P.rho) =
      P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan lam := by
    rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hF.isGeneralizedCartan
      (μ' := -(lam + P.rho)) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩, integralWeylGroup_neg,
      ← P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hF.isGeneralizedCartan (μ := lam) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩]
  refine ⟨w, hW ▸ hw, fun v i hv n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  have h2 := hanti v i hv (-n) (by
    rw [sub_add_cancel, sub_add_cancel, map_neg, corootPairing_neg, ← weylDot_add_rho, hn]
    push_cast; ring)
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translationIncl_injective
statement:
theorem translationIncl_injective (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Function.Injective (translationIncl P (L := L) (L' := L') (M := M) χ₁ χ₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro y y' h
  apply Subtype.val_injective
  refine Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := L')
    ((centralBlock P (M ⊗[K] L) χ₁).incl : _ →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] L) Subtype.val_injective ?_
  exact (LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L').injective h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_translationIdem
statement:
theorem range_translationIdem (hL : IsCategoryO P L) (hL' : IsCategoryO P L')
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (hM : IsCategoryO P M) :
    (translationIdem P hL hL' χ₁ χ₂ M hM).range =
      (translationIncl P (L := L) (L' := L') (M := M) χ₁ χ₂).range
proof:
:= by
  set hML := hM.tensorProduct hL
  set hMLL := hML.tensorProduct hL'
  set B := centralBlock P (M ⊗[K] L) χ₁
  have hB : IsCategoryO P B := hML.centralBlock P χ₁
  have hBL := hB.tensorProduct hL'
  set j := TensorProduct.LieModule.map B.incl (LieModuleHom.id : L' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L')
  set p₁ := TensorProduct.LieModule.map (hML.centralBlockProjection P χ₁)
    (LieModuleHom.id : L' →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ L')
  set p₂ := hMLL.centralBlockProjection P χ₂
  have hj₁ : ∀ t, p₁ (j t) = j t := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
    | tmul b l =>
      change hML.centralBlockProjection P χ₁ (b : M ⊗[K] L) ⊗ₜ l = (b : M ⊗[K] L) ⊗ₜ l
      exact congrArg (· ⊗ₜ l) (centralBlockProjection_self P _ χ₁ b.property)
  have hj₂ : ∀ t, p₂ (j t) = j (hBL.centralBlockProjection P χ₂ t) := fun t ↦
    (DFunLike.congr_fun (IsCategoryO.centralBlockProjection_natural P hBL hMLL j χ₂) t).symm
  have hp₁ : ∀ u, ∃ t, p₁ u = j t := by
    intro u
    induction u with
    | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨t + t', by rw [map_add, map_add, ht, ht']⟩
    | tmul m l =>
      exact ⟨(⟨hML.centralBlockProjection P χ₁ m, centralBlockProjection_mem P _ χ₁ m⟩ : B) ⊗ₜ l,
        rfl⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hp₁ ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L').symm x)
    refine ⟨⟨hBL.centralBlockProjection P χ₂ t, centralBlockProjection_mem P _ χ₂ t⟩, ?_⟩
    change LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (j _) =
      LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (p₂ (p₁ _))
    erw [ht, hj₂]
    rfl
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨translationIncl P χ₁ χ₂ y, ?_⟩
    change LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (p₂ (p₁
      ((LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L').symm
        (LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (j y))))) =
      LieModuleEquiv.tensorAssoc K 𝔤 M L L' (j y)
    rw [LieModuleEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hj₁, hj₂,
      show hBL.centralBlockProjection P χ₂ y = y from centralBlockProjection_self P _ χ₂ y.property]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isProjectiveO_centralTranslation
statement:
theorem isProjectiveO_centralTranslation {V : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule 𝔤 V] [LieModule K 𝔤 V] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hVp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) {ν : Dual K H} (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) χ₁ χ₂ V)
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  obtain ⟨z', -, -, ⟨eν⟩⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_equiv_dual P hA hν
  have hL'O : IsCategoryO P (Module.Dual K (IrreducibleModule P ν)) :=
    IsCategoryO.of_equiv (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P _) eν.symm
  exact isProjectiveO_centralBlock P
    (hV := (hV.centralBlock P χ₁).tensorProduct (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν))
    ((isProjectiveO_centralBlock P (hV := hV) hVp χ₁).tensorProduct P hL'O) χ₂

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.character_translation_translation_verma
statement:
theorem character_translation_translation_verma {lam μ ν ν' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (lam - μ) = ν')
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Dual K H), (T : Set (Dual K H)) = {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
        P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = μ ∧
          y = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * w') lam} ∧
      (((VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)).centralTranslation P
        (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν) (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
        ).centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P μ)
          (centralCharacter P lam)).character =
        ∑ y ∈ T, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y).character
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have e := (translation_verma_equiv_of_isAntidominant P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w).some
  have hMχ : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA' w μ)) (centralCharacter P μ) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA' w.property μ) ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  have hc := character_translation_verma_of_isAntidominant (P := P) hA hlam hμ hν' hz' hzν' w
  refine ⟨hc.choose, hc.choose_spec.1, ?_⟩
  refine (IsCategoryO.character_congr _ _
    ((centralTranslationEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P μ)
      (centralCharacter P lam) e).symm.trans
      (centralBlockEquiv P (rTensorEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν')
        (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P hMχ)) (centralCharacter P lam)))).trans hc.choose_spec.2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_eq_of_eq_of_eq
statement:
private theorem eq_of_eq_of_eq_of_eq {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {a b : β} {T T' : α}
    (ha : a = f T) (hb : b = f T') (h : T = T') : a = b
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact ha.trans hb.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonempty_equiv_translation_translation_verma
statement:
theorem nonempty_equiv_translation_translation_verma {lam μ μ' ν ν' η η' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hμ' : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ')
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hstab : ∀ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = μ ↔ P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ' = μ')
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (lam - μ) = ν')
    (hη : P.IsDominantIntegral η) {y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hy : y ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hyη : y (μ' - lam) = η)
    (hη' : P.IsDominantIntegral η') {y' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hy' : y' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hyη' : y' (lam - μ') = η')
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hdom : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) :
    Nonempty (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν') (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam) (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
          (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))) ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P η') (centralCharacter P μ')
        (centralCharacter P lam) (centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P η)
          (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ')
          (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν'
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hη
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hη'
  have hV := VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
  have hVp : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) :=
    VermaModule.isProjectiveO P hA hdom
  have hsV : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤
      (({VermaModule.hwv P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)} : Finset (VermaModule P _)) :
        Set (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [Finset.coe_singleton]
    exact VermaModule.lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id
  have hc := character_translation_translation_verma P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν hν' hz' hzν' w
  have hc' := character_translation_translation_verma P hA hlam hμ' hfacet' hη hy hyη hη' hy'
    hyη' w
  have hTT : hc.choose = hc'.choose := by
    have hset : {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
          P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = μ ∧
          y = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * w') lam} =
        {y | ∃ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
          P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ' = μ' ∧
          y = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan (w * w') lam} := Set.ext fun x ↦
      ⟨fun ⟨w', h, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨w', (hstab w').mp h, hx⟩, fun ⟨w', h, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨w', (hstab w').mpr h, hx⟩⟩
    exact Finset.coe_injective (hc.choose_spec.1.trans (hset.trans hc'.choose_spec.1.symm))
  have hLν := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hLν' := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν'
  have hLη := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η
  have hLη' := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η'
  have hS₁ := exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top_of_fg P
    (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ) hV hLν hsV
  have hS₂ := exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top_of_fg P
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
    (hV.centralTranslation P hLν (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)) hLν'
    hS₁.choose_spec
  have hS₁' := exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top_of_fg P
    (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ') hV hLη hsV
  have hS₂' := exists_finset_lieSpan_centralTranslation_eq_top_of_fg P
    (centralCharacter P μ') (centralCharacter P lam)
    (hV.centralTranslation P hLη (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ')) hLη'
    hS₁'.choose_spec
  have hX := (hV.centralTranslation P hLν (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
    ).centralTranslation P hLν' (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
  have hX' := (hV.centralTranslation P hLη (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ')
    ).centralTranslation P hLη' (centralCharacter P μ') (centralCharacter P lam)
  have h1 : hX.character = ∑ y ∈ hc.choose, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y).character :=
    hc.choose_spec.2
  have h2 : hX'.character = ∑ y ∈ hc'.choose, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y).character :=
    hc'.choose_spec.2
  have hP := isProjectiveO_centralTranslation P hA
      (hV.centralTranslation P hLν (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ))
      (isProjectiveO_centralTranslation P hA hV hVp hν (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ)) hν' (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam)
  have hP' := isProjectiveO_centralTranslation P hA
      (hV.centralTranslation P hLη (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ'))
      (isProjectiveO_centralTranslation P hA hV hVp hη (centralCharacter P lam)
        (centralCharacter P μ')) hη' (centralCharacter P μ')
        (centralCharacter P lam)
  have hch : hX.character = hX'.character :=
    eq_of_eq_of_eq_of_eq (f := fun T ↦ ∑ y ∈ T, (VermaModule.isCategoryO P y).character) h1 h2
      hTT
  have key := IsProjectiveO.nonempty_equiv_of_character_eq P hA hP hX hS₂.choose_spec hP' hX'
    hS₂'.choose_spec hch
  exact key

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_bijOn_translationIdem_of_stabilizer
statement:
theorem exists_bijOn_translationIdem_of_stabilizer {lam μ μ' ν ν' η η' : Dual K H}
    (hlam : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hμ : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ)
    (hμ' : P.IsAntidominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan μ')
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hfacet' : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (lam + P.rho) v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hA.isGeneralizedCartan (μ' + P.rho) v i = 0)
    (hstab : ∀ w' : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan,
      P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ = μ ↔ P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w' μ' = μ')
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (hν' : P.IsDominantIntegral ν') {z' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz' : z' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν' : z' (lam - μ) = ν')
    (hη : P.IsDominantIntegral η) {y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hy : y ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hyη : y (μ' - lam) = η)
    (hη' : P.IsDominantIntegral η') {y' : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hy' : y' ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hyη' : y' (lam - μ') = η')
    {w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam)
    (hdom : P.IsDominant hA.isGeneralizedCartan (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K 𝔤)}
    (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := 𝔤)
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)) a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (hK : KostantMultiplicity P (AdQuotient K 𝔤 I)) :
    ∃ φ : TensorNatTrans.{0, max u₁ u₂, max u₁ u₂} K 𝔤
        (IrreducibleModule P ν ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P ν')
        (IrreducibleModule P η ⊗[K] IrreducibleModule P η'),
      ∀ (M : Type (max u₁ u₂)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule 𝔤 M]
        [LieModule K 𝔤 M] (hM : IsCategoryO P M) (s : Finset M),
        LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (s : Set M) = ⊤ →
        (∀ ξ, hM.multiplicity ξ ≠ 0 → ∃ x ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan lam,
          ξ = P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan x lam) →
        Set.BijOn (fun x ↦ translationIdem P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η)
            (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η') (centralCharacter P μ') (centralCharacter P lam)
            M hM (φ.app M x))
          (Set.range (translationIdem P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν)
            (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν') (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
            M hM))
          (Set.range (translationIdem P (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η)
            (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η') (centralCharacter P μ') (centralCharacter P lam)
            M hM))
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hν'
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hη
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA hη'
  have hV := VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)
  have htop : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ :=
    (VermaModule.centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.property lam) ▸
      centralBlock_verma P _
  have e₀ := (nonempty_equiv_translation_translation_verma P hA hlam hμ hμ' hfacet hfacet' hstab
    hν hz hzν hν' hz' hzν' hη hy hyη hη' hy' hyη' hdom).some
  have hLν := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν
  have hLν' := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P ν'
  have hLη := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η
  have hLη' := IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P η'
  have E : (translationIdem P hLν hLν' (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) _ hV).range
      ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆
      (translationIdem P hLη hLη' (centralCharacter P μ') (centralCharacter P lam) _ hV).range :=
    (((translationIdemRangeEquiv P hLν hLν' (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam)
      hV).symm.trans (translationTranslationEquiv P (L := IrreducibleModule P ν)
        (L' := IrreducibleModule P ν') htop (centralCharacter P μ)
        (centralCharacter P lam)).symm).trans e₀).trans
      ((translationTranslationEquiv P (L := IrreducibleModule P η)
        (L' := IrreducibleModule P η') htop (centralCharacter P μ')
        (centralCharacter P lam)).trans
        (translationIdemRangeEquiv P hLη hLη' (centralCharacter P μ') (centralCharacter P lam)
          hV))
  have h0 := exists_bijOn_translationIdem P hA hdom hM₀ hI hK hLν hLν' hLη hLη'
    (centralCharacter P μ) (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ')
    (centralCharacter P lam) hV
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := h0 E
  refine ⟨φ, fun M _ _ _ _ hM s hs hblock ↦ hφ M hM s hs fun ξ hξ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hblock ξ hξ
  have hint : ∀ j, ∃ k : ℤ, (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam - lam) (P.coroot j) = k :=
    P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice ((P.mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot _).mp hw)
  refine ⟨x * w⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ hint]
    exact mul_mem hx (inv_mem hw)
  · rw [← weylDot_mul, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.augDeriv_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma augDeriv_single (S : Finset κ) (μ : G) (n : ℤ) :
    augDeriv φ S (single μ n) = n * ∏ a ∈ S, φ a μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [augDeriv]

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.augDeriv_mul
statement:
lemma augDeriv_mul [DecidableEq κ] (S : Finset κ) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    augDeriv φ S (f * g) =
      ∑ T ∈ S.powerset, augDeriv φ T f * augDeriv φ (S \ T) g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [add_mul, map_add, h₁, h₂, sum_add_distrib]
  | single μ m =>
    induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [mul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, sum_add_distrib]
    | single ν n =>
      simp only [single_mul_single, augDeriv_single, map_add, prod_add, mul_sum]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun T _ ↦ ?_
      push_cast
      ring

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.augDeriv_empty_mul
statement:
lemma augDeriv_empty_mul (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    augDeriv φ ∅ (f * g) = augDeriv φ ∅ f * augDeriv φ ∅ g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [augDeriv_mul]

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.augDeriv_empty_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma augDeriv_empty_one : augDeriv φ (∅ : Finset κ) 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [one_def]

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.augDeriv_prod_mul
statement:
theorem augDeriv_prod_mul {ι : Type*} (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ G)
    (J : Finset ι) (hf : ∀ j ∈ J, augDeriv φ ∅ (f j) = 0) :
    ∀ (S : Finset κ) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ G),
      (#S < #J → augDeriv φ S ((∏ j ∈ J, f j) * g) = 0) ∧
      (#S = #J → augDeriv φ S ((∏ j ∈ J, f j) * g) =
        augDeriv φ S (∏ j ∈ J, f j) * augDeriv φ ∅ g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction J using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro S g
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ absurd h (by simp), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : S = ∅ := card_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using h)
    simp
  | @insert a J ha ih =>
    intro S g
    have hf' : ∀ j ∈ J, augDeriv φ ∅ (f j) = 0 := fun j hj ↦ hf j (mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    have hfa : augDeriv φ ∅ (f a) = 0 := hf a (mem_insert_self a J)
    
    have hexp : ∀ X, augDeriv φ S ((∏ j ∈ insert a J, f j) * X) =
        ∑ T ∈ S.powerset, augDeriv φ T (f a) * augDeriv φ (S \ T) ((∏ j ∈ J, f j) * X) := by
      intro X
      rw [prod_insert ha, mul_assoc, augDeriv_mul]
    have hcardT : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset, T ≠ ∅ → #(S \ T) < #S := fun T hT hT0 ↦ by
      rw [card_sdiff_of_subset (mem_powerset.mp hT)]
      have := card_pos.mpr (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hT0)
      have := card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp hT)
      omega
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem ha]
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [hexp]
      refine sum_eq_zero fun T hT ↦ ?_
      by_cases hT0 : T = ∅
      · rw [hT0, hfa, zero_mul]
      · rw [(ih hf' (S \ T) g).1 (by have := hcardT T hT hT0; omega), mul_zero]
    · have key : ∀ X, augDeriv φ S ((∏ j ∈ insert a J, f j) * X) =
          (∑ T ∈ S.powerset, augDeriv φ T (f a) * augDeriv φ (S \ T) (∏ j ∈ J, f j)) *
            augDeriv φ ∅ X := by
        intro X
        rw [hexp, sum_mul]
        refine sum_congr rfl fun T hT ↦ ?_
        by_cases hT0 : T = ∅
        · rw [hT0, hfa, zero_mul, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        by_cases h1 : #(S \ T) = #J
        · rw [(ih hf' (S \ T) X).2 h1, mul_assoc]
        · have hlt : #(S \ T) < #J := by have := hcardT T hT hT0; omega
          have h1' := (ih hf' (S \ T) 1).1 hlt
          rw [mul_one] at h1'
          rw [(ih hf' (S \ T) X).1 hlt, h1']; simp
      rw [key g, ← mul_one (∏ j ∈ insert a J, f j), key 1, augDeriv_empty_one, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toCharacterRing_single
statement:
lemma toCharacterRing_single (μ : Dual K H) (n : ℤ) :
    toCharacterRing P (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ n) = n • exp P ℤ μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [toCharacterRing]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_toCharacterRing
statement:
lemma coeffAt_toCharacterRing (f : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (Dual K H)) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (toCharacterRing P f).coeffAt μ = f.coeff μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [map_add, HahnSeries.coeff_add, coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hf, hg]
  | single ν n =>
    rw [toCharacterRing_single, coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_smul, ← coeffAt, coeff_exp,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases h : μ = ν
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toCharacterRing_injective
statement: lemma toCharacterRing_injective : Function.Injective (toCharacterRing P)
proof:
:= fun f g h ↦ by
  refine AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective (Finsupp.ext (f := f.coeff) (g := g.coeff) fun μ ↦ ?_)
  rw [← coeffAt_toCharacterRing P f μ, ← coeffAt_toCharacterRing P g μ, h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_posRootFinset
statement:
lemma mem_posRootFinset {α : Dual K H} :
    α ∈ posRootFinset P hA ↔ α ∈ roots P ∧ α ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  simp [posRootFinset]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.NegRootIndex.root_mem_posRootFinset
statement:
lemma NegRootIndex.root_mem_posRootFinset (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    x.root ∈ posRootFinset P hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨α, hα⟩, j⟩ := x
  refine (mem_posRootFinset P hA).mpr ⟨?_, hα⟩
  have hne : rootSpace P (-α) ≠ ⊥ := fun h ↦ by
    have : 0 < finrank K (rootSpace P (-α)) := Fin.pos j
    rw [h, finrank_bot] at this
    exact lt_irrefl 0 this
  have hroot : -α ∈ roots P :=
    ⟨neg_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 ↦ P.zero_notMem_posWeights (h0 ▸ hα), hne⟩
  simpa [NegRootIndex.root] using neg_mem_roots P hroot

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coe_negRootIndexEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_negRootIndexEquiv_apply (x : NegRootIndex P) :
    (negRootIndexEquiv P hA x : Dual K H) = x.root
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.prod_neg_single_neg_root
statement:
lemma prod_neg_single_neg_root (T : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    ∏ x ∈ T, (-AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-x.root) 1 : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (Dual K H)) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-finsetWt P T) ((-1) ^ T.card)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction T using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [finsetWt, AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]
  | @insert a T ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, ih, neg_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha,
      show finsetWt P (insert a T) = a.root + finsetWt P T from Finset.sum_insert ha,
      ← AddMonoidAlgebra.single_neg, pow_succ]
    congr 1 <;> first | ring | abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toCharacterRing_denominatorAlg
statement:
theorem toCharacterRing_denominatorAlg :
    toCharacterRing P (denominatorAlg P hA) = denominator P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype (NegRootIndex P) := Fintype.ofEquiv _ (negRootIndexEquiv P hA).symm
  have h1 : denominatorAlg P hA =
      ∑ T : Finset (NegRootIndex P), AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-finsetWt P T) ((-1) ^ T.card) := by
    rw [denominatorAlg, ← Finset.prod_coe_sort,
      ← (negRootIndexEquiv P hA).prod_comp
        (fun α ↦ (1 - AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-(α : Dual K H)) 1))]
    simp only [coe_negRootIndexEquiv_apply, sub_eq_neg_add]
    rw [Finset.prod_add, Finset.powerset_univ]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one]
    exact prod_neg_single_neg_root P T
  ext μ
  rw [coeffAt_toCharacterRing, h1, coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, denominator, coeffAt,
    HahnSeries.SummableFamily.coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [denominatorFamily, HahnSeries.SummableFamily.coe_mk, HahnSeries.coeff_single,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : μ = -finsetWt P T
  · simp [h]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h), ite_eq_right fun hμ ↦ h ((toWeightOrd P).injective hμ)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.prod_posRootFinset_reflection
statement:
lemma prod_posRootFinset_reflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA,
        P.dualBilinForm S (P.reflection hA.isGeneralizedCartan i μ) α =
      -∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S μ α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set hGC := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  set r := P.reflection hGC i
  have hr : ∀ α, P.dualBilinForm S (r μ) α = P.dualBilinForm S μ (r α) := fun α ↦ by
    have := P.dualBilinForm_reflection hGC S i (r μ) α
    simp only [r, reflection_reflection] at this
    exact this.symm
  simp_rw [hr]
  have hi : P.root i ∈ posRootFinset P hA :=
    (mem_posRootFinset P hA).mpr ⟨root_mem_roots P i, P.root_mem_posWeights i⟩
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ hi, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ hi]
  simp only [r, reflection_root_self, map_neg, neg_mul]
  congr 2
  have hmem : ∀ α ∈ (posRootFinset P hA).erase (P.root i),
      r α ∈ (posRootFinset P hA).erase (P.root i) := by
    intro α hα
    obtain ⟨hne, hα⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hα
    obtain ⟨hroot, hpos⟩ := (mem_posRootFinset P hA).mp hα
    refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, (mem_posRootFinset P hA).mpr
      ⟨apply_mem_roots P hGC (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hGC i) hroot,
        reflection_mem_posWeights P hGC hroot hpos hne⟩⟩
    have : α = -P.root i := by
      rw [← reflection_reflection P hGC i α]
      simp only [r] at h
      rw [h, reflection_root_self]
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp P.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights hpos
      (this ▸ P.neg_root_mem_negWeights i)
  exact Finset.prod_nbij' r r hmem hmem (fun α _ ↦ reflection_reflection P hGC i α)
    (fun α _ ↦ reflection_reflection P hGC i α) fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.prod_posRootFinset_weylGroup
statement:
theorem prod_posRootFinset_weylGroup (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (μ : Dual K H) :
    ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ) α =
      (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w *
        ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S μ α
proof:
:= by
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  induction w using cs.simple_induction_left generalizing μ with
  | one => simp
  | mul_simple_left w i ih =>
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple,
      prod_posRootFinset_reflection, ih]
    rcases cs.length_simple_mul w i with h | h
    · rw [h, pow_succ]; ring
    · rw [← h, pow_succ]; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualBilinForm_rho_ne_zero
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_rho_ne_zero {α : Dual K H} (hα : α ∈ P.posWeights) :
    P.dualBilinForm S P.rho α ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨hk0, hkne⟩, rfl⟩ := hα
  have h : P.dualBilinForm S P.rho (P.rootOf k) = ((∑ i, (k i : ℚ) * (S.ε i)⁻¹ : ℚ) : K) := by
    rw [rootOf_apply, map_sum]
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, dualBilinForm_rho_root, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h, Rat.cast_ne_zero]
  refine (Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ ↦ mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hk0 i)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (S.ε_pos i).le)) ?_).ne'
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, k i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h0
    exact hkne (funext h0)
  exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_ne (hk0 i) (Ne.symm hi))
    (inv_pos.mpr (S.ε_pos i))⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exists_toCharacterRing_eq_character
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.exists_toCharacterRing_eq_character {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) {κ : Type*} (φ : κ → Dual K H →+ K) :
    ∃ χ : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (Dual K H),
      toCharacterRing P χ = (isCategoryO P Λ).character ∧
        augDeriv φ ∅ χ = finrank K (IrreducibleModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional hA hΛ
  let b := (isCategoryO P Λ).weightBasis
  have : Finite (WeightBasisIndex P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)) := Module.Finite.finite_basis b
  set d : Dual K H → ℕ := fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ)
  have hfin : {μ | d μ ≠ 0}.Finite :=
    (Set.finite_range (Sigma.fst : WeightBasisIndex P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) → Dual K H)).subset
      fun μ hμ ↦ ⟨⟨μ, ⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hμ⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  set s := hfin.toFinset
  refine ⟨∑ μ ∈ s, AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ (d μ : ℤ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext μ
    rw [coeffAt_toCharacterRing, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, coeff_sum,
      Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs with hμ
    · rfl
    · simp only [s, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_not] at hμ
      exact_mod_cast hμ.symm
  · simp only [map_sum, augDeriv_single, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one, Int.cast_natCast]
    let e : WeightBasisIndex P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) ≃ Σ μ : s, Fin (d μ) :=
      { toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨⟨x.1, (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hfin).mpr (Fin.pos x.2).ne'⟩, x.2⟩
        invFun := fun y ↦ ⟨y.1.1, y.2⟩
        left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
        right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }
    rw [Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis b, Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
      Fintype.card_sigma]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_sum]
    exact (Finset.sum_coe_sort s fun μ ↦ (d μ : K)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.denominatorAlg_mul_eq_sum
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.denominatorAlg_mul_eq_sum [Fintype (P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)]
    {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) {χ : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (Dual K H)}
    (hχ : toCharacterRing P χ = (isCategoryO P Λ).character) :
    denominatorAlg P hA * (AddMonoidAlgebra.single P.rho 1 * χ) =
      ∑ w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan, AddMonoidAlgebra.single
        ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho))
        ((-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).length w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply toCharacterRing_injective P
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, hχ, toCharacterRing_denominatorAlg, toCharacterRing_single, one_smul,
    ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (denominator P),
    IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      hA.isSymmetrizable hΛ]
  ext μ
  rw [coeffAt_weylAltSum, coeffAt_toCharacterRing, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, coeff_sum,
    Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ ↦ ?_
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_mul_prod_eq_prod
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.finrank_mul_prod_eq_prod {Λ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    (finrank K (IrreducibleModule P Λ) : K) * ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S P.rho α =
      ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set hGC := hA.isGeneralizedCartan
  have := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  let _ : Fintype (P.weylGroup hGC) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let φ : Dual K H → Dual K H →+ K := fun α ↦ ((P.dualBilinForm S).flip α).toAddMonoidHom
  have hφ (α μ : Dual K H) : φ α μ = P.dualBilinForm S μ α := rfl
  set E := augDeriv φ (posRootFinset P hA)
  
  have key : ∀ Λ : Dual K H, P.IsDominantIntegral Λ → ∀ χ : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (Dual K H),
      toCharacterRing P χ = (isCategoryO P Λ).character →
      E (denominatorAlg P hA) * augDeriv φ ∅ χ =
        Fintype.card (P.weylGroup hGC) *
          ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) α := by
    intro Λ hΛ χ hχ
    have hf : ∀ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA,
        augDeriv φ ∅ (1 - AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-α) 1 : AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (Dual K H)) = 0 :=
      fun α _ ↦ by simp
    have hL : E (denominatorAlg P hA * (AddMonoidAlgebra.single P.rho 1 * χ)) =
        E (denominatorAlg P hA) * augDeriv φ ∅ χ := by
      rw [denominatorAlg, ((augDeriv_prod_mul φ (fun α ↦ 1 - AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-α) 1)
        (posRootFinset P hA) hf) (posRootFinset P hA) _).2 rfl, augDeriv_empty_mul,
        augDeriv_single, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one, Int.cast_one, one_mul]
    rw [← hL, IrreducibleModule.denominatorAlg_mul_eq_sum P hA hΛ hχ, map_sum]
    simp only [E, augDeriv_single, hφ, prod_posRootFinset_weylGroup P hA S, Int.cast_pow,
      Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_mul,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have h0 := key 0 (isDominantIntegral_zero (P := P)) 1
    (by rw [map_one, IrreducibleModule.character_zero hGC])
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hdim⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_toCharacterRing_eq_character P hA hΛ φ
  have h1 := key Λ hΛ χ hχ
  rw [augDeriv_empty_one, mul_one, zero_add] at h0
  rw [hdim] at h1
  have hW : (Fintype.card (P.weylGroup hGC) : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hW
  rw [← h1, h0]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_eq_prod_div
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.finrank_eq_prod_div {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    (finrank K (IrreducibleModule P Λ) : K) =
      ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) α / P.dualBilinForm S P.rho α
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∏ α ∈ posRootFinset P hA, P.dualBilinForm S P.rho α ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun α hα ↦
      dualBilinForm_rho_ne_zero P S ((mem_posRootFinset P hA).mp hα).2
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, eq_div_iff hne]
  exact IrreducibleModule.finrank_mul_prod_eq_prod P hA S hΛ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCompl_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
theorem isCompl_weightSpaceOfMap (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) (κ : Dual K H) :
    IsCompl (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ) (⨆ (ν) (_ : ν ≠ κ), weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (h P)) κ, codisjoint_iff.mpr (eq_top_iff.mpr ?_)⟩
  rw [← hV]
  refine iSup_le fun ν ↦ ?_
  by_cases hν : ν = κ
  · subst hν; exact le_sup_left
  · exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup₂_of_le ν hν le_rfl)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightProj_of_mem (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) {κ : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ) : weightProj P hV κ v = ⟨v, hv⟩
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_left _ hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightProj_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma weightProj_of_mem_ne (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤) {κ ν : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν) (hν : ν ≠ κ) : weightProj P hV κ v = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_eq_zero_iff _).mpr (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν
    (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hν hv))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (κ : Dual K H) (g : Module.Dual K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ)) :
    (TwistedDual.toDual P V).symm (g ∘ₗ weightProj P hV κ) ∈
      weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [TwistedDual.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff]
  intro a v
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν v hv =>
    by_cases hν : ν = κ
    · subst hν
      have hhv : ⁅h P a, v⁆ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν := by
        rw [hv a]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hv
      rw [weightProj_of_mem hV hhv, weightProj_of_mem hV hv]
      have : (⟨⁅h P a, v⁆, hhv⟩ : weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν) = ν a • ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext (hv a)
      rw [this, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    · have hhv : ⁅h P a, v⁆ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν := (hv a).symm ▸
        Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hv
      rw [weightProj_of_mem_ne hV hhv hν, weightProj_of_mem_ne hV hv hν, map_zero, mul_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [lie_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, mul_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_twistedDual
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_twistedDual (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    {κ : Dual K H} {φ : TwistedDual P V} (hφ : φ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) κ)
    (h0 : ∀ v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ, TwistedDual.toDual P V φ v = 0) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply TwistedDual.ext
  intro v
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν v hv =>
    by_cases hν : ν = κ
    · subst hν; simpa using h0 v hv
    · simpa using TwistedDual.apply_eq_zero_of_ne hφ hv (Ne.symm hν)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add] at hx hy ⊢; rw [hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpace_twistedDual
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_twistedDual (hV : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (κ : Dual K H) [FiniteDimensional K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ)] :
    finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) κ) =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) κ)
proof:
:=
  (weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hV κ).finrank_eq.trans (Subspace.dual_finrank_eq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCategoryO_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem isCategoryO_restrictedDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V) :
    IsCategoryO P (restrictedDual P V)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  refine ⟨?_, fun μ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩ -
    have key : ∀ ψ ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) μ,
        ∀ hψ : ψ ∈ restrictedDual P V,
        (⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : restrictedDual P V) ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ := by
      intro ψ hψ
      induction hψ using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem μ ψ hψ =>
        intro h'
        exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ (mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mpr hψ)
      | zero => intro _; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        intro _
        exact add_mem (ihx hx) (ihy hy)
    exact key φ hφ hφ
  · have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
    have : FiniteDimensional K (weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) μ) :=
      LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ).symm
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (weightSpaceRestrictedDualEquiv μ).symm
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hV.exists_finset
    refine ⟨s, fun μ hμ ↦ hs μ fun h0 ↦ hμ ?_⟩
    have : Subsingleton (Module.Dual K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ)) := by
      rw [h0]; infer_instance
    have := ((weightSpaceRestrictedDualEquiv μ).trans
      (weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ)).toEquiv.subsingleton
    exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mpr fun x hx ↦ by
      simpa using congrArg Subtype.val (Subsingleton.elim (⟨x, hx⟩ :
        weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ) 0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_weightSpace_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_restrictedDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ) =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  rw [(weightSpaceRestrictedDualEquiv μ).finrank_eq,
    finrank_weightSpace_twistedDual hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top μ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.multiplicity_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem multiplicity_restrictedDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV).multiplicity μ = hV.multiplicity μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsCategoryO.character_eq_iff (isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV) hV).mp ?_ μ
  ext ν
  simp only [IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character]
  rw [finrank_weightSpace_restrictedDual hV]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_lie_e
statement:
lemma toDual_lie_e (i : ι) (φ : TwistedDual P V) (v : V) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P V ⁅e P i, φ⁆ v = TwistedDual.toDual P V φ ⁅f P i, v⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [TwistedDual.lie_apply, transpose_e]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_primitiveVectors_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem finrank_primitiveVectors_restrictedDual (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (primitiveVectors P (restrictedDual P V) μ) =
      coinvDim P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hd := hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  set Wμ := weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ
  set S : Submodule K Wμ := (negSpan P (⊤ : Submodule K V)).comap Wμ.subtype
  let Θ : primitiveVectors P (restrictedDual P V) μ →ₗ[K] Module.Dual K Wμ :=
    (weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      (weightSpaceRestrictedDualEquiv μ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        Submodule.inclusion (inf_le_left : primitiveVectors P (restrictedDual P V) μ ≤
          weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ)
  have hΘ : Function.Injective Θ := by
    refine ((weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ).injective.comp
      (weightSpaceRestrictedDualEquiv μ).injective).comp (Submodule.inclusion_injective _)
  have hrange : LinearMap.range Θ = S.dualAnnihilator := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨φ, rfl⟩
      rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
      rintro ⟨s, hsμ⟩ hs
      change TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1.1 s = 0
      have hprim := (mem_primitiveVectors.mp φ.2).2
      refine negSpan_induction P (p := fun x ↦ TwistedDual.toDual P V φ.1.1 x = 0)
        (fun i n _ ↦ ?_) (map_zero _) (fun x y hx hy ↦ by rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]) hs
      rw [← toDual_lie_e]
      have := congrArg Subtype.val (hprim i)
      change ⁅e P i, φ.1.1⁆ = 0 at this
      rw [this, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    · intro hg
      rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator] at hg
      set ψ := (TwistedDual.toDual P V).symm (g ∘ₗ weightProj P hd μ)
      have hψ : ψ ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (TwistedDual P V) (h P) μ :=
        mem_weightSpace_twistedDual_comp hd μ g
      let ψ' : restrictedDual P V := ⟨ψ, Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ hψ⟩
      have hψ'w : ψ' ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (restrictedDual P V) (h P) μ :=
        mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mpr hψ
      have hψ'e (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, ψ'⁆ = 0 := by
        refine Subtype.ext (TwistedDual.ext fun v ↦ ?_)
        change TwistedDual.toDual P V ⁅e P i, ψ⁆ v = TwistedDual.toDual P V 0 v
        rw [toDual_lie_e, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
        simp only [ψ, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
        have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ := hd ▸ Submodule.mem_top
        induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
        | mem ν v hv =>
          have hfv := toEnd_f_mem_weightSpace i hv
          by_cases hν : ν - P.root i = μ
          · subst hν
            rw [show ⁅f P i, v⁆ = toEnd K 𝔤 V (f P i) v from rfl, weightProj_of_mem hd hfv]
            exact hg _ (toEnd_f_mem_negSpan P i Submodule.mem_top)
          · rw [show ⁅f P i, v⁆ = toEnd K 𝔤 V (f P i) v from rfl,
              weightProj_of_mem_ne hd hfv hν, map_zero]
        | zero => simp
        | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [lie_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
      refine ⟨⟨ψ', mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hψ'w, hψ'e⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (weightSpaceTwistedDualEquiv hd μ).apply_symm_apply g
  rw [← LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hΘ, hrange]
  have h1 := Subspace.finrank_add_finrank_dualAnnihilator_eq S
  have h2 : finrank K S = finrank K ↥(negSpan P (⊤ : Submodule K V) ⊓ Wμ) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq Wμ S, Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_comm]
  have h3 : finrank K ↥((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V).toSubmodule ⊓ Wμ) = finrank K Wμ :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (by simp)).finrank_eq
  have h4 : finrank K ↥(negSpan P (⊤ : Submodule K V) ⊓ Wμ) =
      finrank K ↥(negSpan P (⊤ : Submodule K V) ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) := rfl
  have h5 : finrank K Wμ = finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) := rfl
  unfold coinvDim
  rw [h3, LieSubmodule.top_toSubmodule]
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_dualSwapLin
statement:
lemma toDual_dualSwapLin (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P W) (b : W) (a : V) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P V (dualSwapLin f b) a = TwistedDual.toDual P W (f a).1 b
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toDual_dualSwapAux
statement:
lemma toDual_dualSwapAux (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P W) (b : W) (a : V) :
    TwistedDual.toDual P V (dualSwapAux f b) a = TwistedDual.toDual P W (f a).1 b
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualSwapAux_mem
statement:
lemma dualSwapAux_mem (hW : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ = ⊤)
    (f : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P W) (b : W) : dualSwapAux f b ∈ restrictedDual P V
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b ∈ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ := hW ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hb using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem κ b hb =>
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem κ (TwistedDual.mem_weightSpaceOfMap_iff.mpr fun a' v ↦ ?_)
    rw [toDual_dualSwapAux, toDual_dualSwapAux, LieModuleHom.map_lie, LieSubmodule.coe_bracket,
      TwistedDual.lie_apply, transpose_h, hb a', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualSwap_injective
statement:
lemma dualSwap_injective (hW : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap W (h P) μ = ⊤) :
    Function.Injective (dualSwap (V := V) hW)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
  intro f hf
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hf
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
  ext a b
  have := congrArg (fun g : W →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P V ↦ TwistedDual.toDual P V (g b).1 a) hf
  simpa [dualSwap, toDual_dualSwapAux] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_hom_restrictedDual_verma
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_restrictedDual_verma (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ)) =
      coinvDim P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hM := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  have hd := hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
  have hR := isCategoryO_restrictedDual hV
  have := hR.finiteDimensional_weightSpaceOfMap μ
  have : FiniteDimensional K (primitiveVectors P (restrictedDual P V) μ) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  have : FiniteDimensional K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P V) :=
    LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (homEquiv P _ μ).symm
  have : FiniteDimensional K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ)) :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective _ (dualSwap_injective hM)
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (dualSwap_injective (V := V) hM)
  have h2 := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective
    (dualSwap_injective (V := VermaModule P μ) (W := V) hd)
  rw [← finrank_primitiveVectors_restrictedDual hV, ← (homEquiv P _ μ).finrank_eq]
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.count_eq_finrank_hom
statement:
theorem IsStdFiltered.count_eq_finrank_hom [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    {s : Multiset (Dual K H)} (hs : IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V) s) (μ : Dual K H) :
    s.count μ = finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ restrictedDual P (VermaModule P μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_hom_restrictedDual_verma hV, hs.count_eq_coinvDim P hV]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStdFiltered.directSum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R : Finset κ → LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (⨁ j, Q j) := fun T ↦
    ⨆ j ∈ T, (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ 𝔤 Q j).range
  have hR : ∀ T : Finset κ, IsStdFiltered P (R T) (∑ j ∈ T, s j) := by
    intro T
    induction T using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa [R] using IsStdFiltered.bot (P := P) (X := ⨁ j, Q j)
    | insert a T haT ih =>
      set g := (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (R T)).comp (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ 𝔤 Q a)
      have hRa : ∀ x ∈ R T, x a = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        have hle : R T ≤ (DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K κ 𝔤 Q a).ker := by
          refine iSup₂_le fun j hj ↦ ?_
          rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
          rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker]
          exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (fun h : a = j ↦ haT (by rw [h]; exact hj))
        exact hle hx
      have hg : ∀ q ∈ (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (Q a)), g q = 0 → q = 0 := by
        intro q _ hq
        change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (R T) (DirectSum.of Q a q) = 0 at hq
        rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hq
        have := hRa _ hq
        rwa [DirectSum.of_eq_same] at this
      have h := IsStdFiltered.comap_mk P ih ((hQ a).map_of_injOn P g hg le_rfl)
      have hcomap : ((⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (Q a)).map g).comap
          (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (R T)) = R (insert a T) := by
        have hins : R (insert a T) = (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ 𝔤 Q a).range ⊔ R T := by
          simp only [R, Finset.iSup_insert]
        rw [hins]
        ext x
        rw [LieSubmodule.mem_comap, LieSubmodule.mem_sup]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨q, -, hq⟩
          change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (R T) (DirectSum.of Q a q) = _ at hq
          rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hq
          exact ⟨DirectSum.of Q a q, ⟨q, rfl⟩, x - DirectSum.of Q a q, by
            rw [← neg_mem_iff, neg_sub]; exact hq, add_sub_cancel _ _⟩
        · rintro ⟨y, ⟨q, rfl⟩, z, hz, rfl⟩
          refine ⟨q, LieSubmodule.mem_top q, ?_⟩
          change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (R T) (DirectSum.of Q a q) = _
          rw [map_add, (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (R T)).mpr hz, add_zero]
          rfl
      rw [Finset.sum_insert haT, ← hcomap]
      exact h
  have htop : R Finset.univ = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | of j q =>
      exact (le_iSup₂_of_le j (Finset.mem_univ j) le_rfl :
        (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K κ 𝔤 Q j).range ≤ R Finset.univ) ⟨q, rfl⟩
    | add x y hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  rw [← htop]
  exact hR Finset.univ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsProjectiveO.exists_isStdFiltered
statement:
theorem IsProjectiveO.exists_isStdFiltered {V : Type (max u₁ u₂)} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (hVproj : IsProjectiveO.{max u₁ u₂} P V) (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {S : Finset V}
    (hS : LieSubmodule.lieSpan K 𝔤 (S : Set V) = ⊤) :
    ∃ s : Multiset (Dual K H), IsStdFiltered P (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V) s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, τ, hQ, -, -, π, hπ⟩ :=
    exists_isProjectiveO_surjective.{max u₁ u₂, 0} P hA hV hS
  have hj : ∀ j, ∃ s, IsStdFiltered P
      (⊤ : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 (projectiveCoverAmbient' P hA (τ j))) s := by
    intro j
    set n := projectiveCoverShift P hA (τ j)
    have := IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional (P := P) hA (isDominantIntegral_nsmul_rho P n)
    obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_tensorVerma P
      (isCategoryO_dual_irreducible_nsmul_rho P hA n).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top
      (τ j + (n : K) • P.rho)
    exact ⟨_, hs⟩
  choose s hs using hj
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hVproj hQ hV π hπ LieModuleHom.id
  have hπσ (v : V) : π (σ v) = v := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hσ v
  set p := σ.comp π
  have hp : p.comp p = p := by
    refine LieModuleHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    change σ (π (σ (π x))) = σ (π x)
    rw [hπσ]
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht, -, -⟩ := exists_isStdFiltered_range_add P hQ
    (IsStdFiltered.directSum P hs) p hp
  have hinj : ∀ x ∈ p.range, π x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩ hy
    change σ (π y) = 0
    change π (σ (π y)) = 0 at hy
    rw [hπσ] at hy
    rw [hy, map_zero]
  have hmap : p.range.map π = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro v -
    exact ⟨σ v, ⟨σ v, by change σ (π (σ v)) = σ v; rw [hπσ]⟩, hπσ v⟩
  exact ⟨t, hmap ▸ ht.map_of_injOn P π hinj le_rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mkAlgHom_surjective
statement: theorem mkAlgHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkAlgHom R L)
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  induction u using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | h a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction {C : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L → Prop}
    (algebraMap : ∀ r, C (algebraMap R (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) r))
    (ι : ∀ x, C (ι R x)) (mul : ∀ a b, C a → C b → C (a * b))
    (add : ∀ a b, C a → C b → C (a + b)) (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) : C u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := mkAlgHom_surjective u
  induction t using TensorAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => rw [AlgHom.commutes]; exact algebraMap r
  | ι x => exact ι x
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul]; exact mul _ _ ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ ha hb

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lieModuleOfModule
statement:
theorem lieModuleOfModule [Module R M] [IsScalarTower R (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) M] :
    letI := lieRingModuleOfModule R L M
    LieModule R L M
proof:
:=
  letI := lieRingModuleOfModule R L M
  { smul_lie t x m := by
      change ι R (t • x) • m = t • (ι R x • m)
      rw [map_smul, smul_assoc]
    lie_smul t x m := by
      change ι R x • t • m = t • (ι R x • m)
      rw [smul_algebra_smul_comm] }

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.smul_mem_of_forall_ι_smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem_of_forall_ι_smul_mem [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower R (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) M] (N : Submodule R M)
    (hN : ∀ x : L, ∀ m ∈ N, ι R x • m ∈ N) (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ N) : u • m ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction generalizing m with
  | algebraMap r => rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact N.smul_mem r hm
  | ι x => exact hN x m hm
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [mul_smul]; exact ha (hb hm)
  | add a b ha hb => rw [add_smul]; exact N.add_mem (ha hm) (hb hm)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_of_generators
statement:
lemma lie_mem_of_generators {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra M] (N : Submodule K M)
    (he : ∀ i, ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅e P i, m⁆ ∈ N) (hf : ∀ i, ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅f P i, m⁆ ∈ N)
    (hh : ∀ a, ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅h P a, m⁆ ∈ N) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) : ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅x, m⁆ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P x
  induction x using AuxLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | he i => exact he i
  | hf i => exact hf i
  | hh a => exact hh a
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => intro m hm; rw [map_add, add_lie]; exact N.add_mem (hy m hm) (hz m hm)
  | smul c y hy => intro m hm; rw [map_smul, smul_lie]; exact N.smul_mem c (hy m hm)
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    intro m hm
    rw [LieHom.map_lie, lie_lie]
    exact N.sub_mem (hy _ (hz m hm)) (hz _ (hy m hm))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_eq_smul
statement: lemma lie_eq_smul (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (m : VermaModule P Λ) : ⁅x, m⁆ = ιᵤ x • m
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk P Λ)
proof: := (vermaIdeal P Λ).mkQ_surjective

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma mk_eq_zero_iff {u : 𝓤} : mk P Λ u = 0 ↔ u ∈ vermaIdeal P Λ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mk_eq_smul
statement: lemma mk_eq_smul (u : 𝓤) : mk P Λ u = u • hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mk_mem_vermaIdeal_of_mem_vermaGens
statement:
lemma mk_mem_vermaIdeal_of_mem_vermaGens {u : 𝓤} (hu : u ∈ vermaGens P Λ) :
    u ∈ vermaIdeal P Λ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span hu

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_hwv_of_mem_nPos
statement: lemma lie_hwv_of_mem_nPos {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nPos P) : ⁅x, hwv P Λ⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lie_eq_smul, ← mk_eq_smul, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma lie_e_hwv (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, hwv P Λ⁆ = 0
proof:
:=
  lie_hwv_of_mem_nPos P Λ (e_mem_nPos P i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_h_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma lie_h_hwv (a : H) : ⁅h P a, hwv P Λ⁆ = Λ a • hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [lie_eq_smul, ← mk_eq_smul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← algebraMap_smul 𝓤 (Λ a), ← mk_eq_smul,
    ← map_sub, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨a, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.smul_mem
statement:
lemma smul_mem (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)) (u : 𝓤)
    {m : VermaModule P Λ} (hm : m ∈ N) : u • m ∈ N
proof:
:=
  smul_mem_of_forall_ι_smul_mem N.toSubmodule (fun _ _ hm ↦ N.lie_mem hm) u hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_top_of_hwv_mem
statement:
theorem eq_top_of_hwv_mem {N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ)}
    (hN : hwv P Λ ∈ N) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro m -
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P Λ m
  rw [mk_eq_smul]
  exact smul_mem P Λ N u hN

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.rep_ι
statement: lemma rep_ι (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (v : V) : rep P V (ιᵤ x) v = ⁅x, v⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_ι_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_smul_eq_rep
statement:
lemma map_smul_eq_rep (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (u : 𝓤)
    (m : VermaModule P Λ) : φ (u • m) = rep P V u (φ m)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction generalizing m with
  | algebraMap r => rw [algebraMap_smul, map_smul, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
  | ι x => rw [rep_ι, ← lie_eq_smul, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [mul_smul, ha, hb, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [add_smul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hom_ext
statement:
