theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V}
    (h : φ (hwv P Λ) = ψ (hwv P Λ)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P Λ m
  rw [mk_eq_smul, map_smul_eq_rep, map_smul_eq_rep, h]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.evalAt_eq_zero
statement: lemma evalAt_eq_zero {u : 𝓤} (hu : u ∈ vermaIdeal P Λ) : evalAt P v u = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    rcases hu with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, rfl⟩
    · simp [he x hx]
    · simp [hh a]
  | zero => simp
  | add u w _ _ hu hw => rw [map_add, hu, hw, add_zero]
  | smul c u _ hu =>
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.applyₗ_apply_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply] at hu ⊢
    rw [hu, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lift_mk
statement: lemma lift_mk (u : 𝓤) : lift P v he hh (mk P Λ u) = rep P V u v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lift_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_hwv : lift P v he hh (hwv P Λ) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, lift_mk, map_one, Module.End.one_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.existsUnique_lieModuleHom
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lieModuleHom (v : V) (he : ∀ x ∈ nPos P, ⁅x, v⁆ = 0)
    (hh : ∀ a, ⁅h P a, v⁆ = Λ a • v) :
    ∃! φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V, φ (hwv P Λ) = v
proof:
:=
  ⟨lift P v he hh, lift_hwv P v he hh, fun _ hφ ↦ hom_ext P Λ (by rw [hφ, lift_hwv])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralTranslationMap_id
statement:
theorem centralTranslationMap_id (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (LieModuleHom.id : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) = LieModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (TensorProduct.map _ _ x.val : _) = x.val
  rw [centralBlockMap_id]
  exact congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe TensorProduct.map_id) x.val

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralTranslationMap_comp
statement:
theorem centralTranslationMap_comp (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) (f : U →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) (g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) :
    centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ (g.comp f) =
      (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ g).comp (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ f)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (TensorProduct.map _ _ x.val : _) = TensorProduct.map _ _ (TensorProduct.map _ _ x.val)
  rw [centralBlockMap_comp, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← TensorProduct.map_comp]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exact_iff_ker_eq_range
statement:
theorem exact_iff_ker_eq_range (f : U →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) (g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) :
    Function.Exact f g ↔ g.ker = f.range
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext y
    rw [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range]
    exact h y
  · intro h y
    have := congrArg (fun S : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V => y ∈ S) h
    simpa only [LieModuleHom.mem_ker, LieModuleHom.mem_range, eq_iff_iff, Set.mem_range] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.centralTranslationMap_shortExact
statement:
theorem centralTranslationMap_shortExact [CharZero K] [IsAlgClosed K] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (hZ : IsCategoryO P Z)
    (f : U →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ V) (g : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ W) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hex : g.ker = f.range)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g) (χ₁ χ₂ : 𝓩 →ₐ[K] K) :
    Function.Injective (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ f) ∧
      (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ g).ker = (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ f).range ∧
      Function.Surjective (centralTranslationMap P Z χ₁ χ₂ g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hf₁, hex₁, hg₁⟩ := hV.shortExact_centralBlockMap P f g hf hex hg χ₁
  set f₁ := centralBlockMap P f χ₁
  set g₁ := centralBlockMap P g χ₁
  let F := TensorProduct.LieModule.map f₁ (LieModuleHom.id : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z)
  let G := TensorProduct.LieModule.map g₁ (LieModuleHom.id : Z →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ Z)
  have eF : F.toLinearMap = LinearMap.rTensor Z f₁.toLinearMap := by
    rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.toLinearMap_map]
    rfl
  have eG : G.toLinearMap = LinearMap.rTensor Z g₁.toLinearMap := by
    rw [TensorProduct.LieModule.toLinearMap_map]
    rfl
  have hF : Function.Injective F := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, eF]
    exact Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := Z) _ hf₁
  have hG : Function.Surjective G := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, eG]
    exact LinearMap.rTensor_surjective Z hg₁
  have hFG : G.ker = F.range := by
    rw [← exact_iff_ker_eq_range, ← LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap,
      ← LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap G, eF, eG]
    exact rTensor_exact Z ((exact_iff_ker_eq_range P f₁ g₁).mpr hex₁) hg₁
  have hmid : IsCategoryO P (centralBlock P V χ₁ ⊗[K] Z) :=
    (hV.centralBlock P χ₁).tensorProduct hZ
  exact hmid.shortExact_centralBlockMap P F G hF hFG hG χ₂

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.translation_verma_equiv
statement:
theorem translation_verma_equiv {lam μ ν : Dual K H}
    (hlam : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -n)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, (lam + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0 → (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = 0)
    (hν : P.IsDominantIntegral ν) {z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hz : z ∈ P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) (hzν : z (μ - lam) = ν)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    Nonempty (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w μ) ≃ₗ⁅K,KacMoodyAlgebra P⁆
      centralTranslation P (IrreducibleModule P ν) (centralCharacter P lam) (centralCharacter P μ)
        (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := translation_verma P hA hlam hμ hfacet hν hz hzν w
  have hχ : centralCharacter P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam) =
      centralCharacter P lam := centralCharacter_weyl P hA.isGeneralizedCartan w.property lam
  have htop : centralBlock P (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA.isGeneralizedCartan w lam))
      (centralCharacter P lam) = ⊤ := hχ ▸ centralBlock_verma P _
  exact ⟨e.trans (centralBlockEquiv P (rTensorEquiv P (IrreducibleModule P ν)
    (equivCentralBlockOfEqTop P htop)).symm (centralCharacter P μ))⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.IsKilledBy.mono
statement: theorem IsKilledBy.mono (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hM : IsKilledBy J M) : IsKilledBy I M
proof:
:=
  fun a ha ↦ hM a (hIJ ha)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.isKilledBy_bot
statement: theorem isKilledBy_bot : IsKilledBy (⊥ : TwoSidedIdeal (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)) M
proof:
:=
  fun a ha ↦ by
    rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_bot] at ha
    rw [ha, map_zero]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.adQuotientMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem adQuotientMap_mk (hIJ : I ≤ J) (u : AdRegular R L) :
    adQuotientMap R L hIJ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.adQuotientMap_surjective
statement: theorem adQuotientMap_surjective (hIJ : I ≤ J) : Function.Surjective (adQuotientMap R L hIJ)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H u => exact ⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u, rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.quotientAction_adQuotientMap
statement:
theorem quotientAction_adQuotientMap (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hM : IsKilledBy J M) (q : AdQuotient R L I) :
    quotientAction hM (adQuotientMap R L hIJ q) = quotientAction (hM.mono hIJ) q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H u => rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorNatMap_adQuotientMap
statement:
theorem tensorNatMap_adQuotientMap (hIJ : I ≤ J) (g : V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ AdQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W)
    (hM : IsKilledBy J M) :
    tensorNatMap ((TensorProduct.LieModule.map (adQuotientMap R L hIJ) LieModuleHom.id).comp g) hM =
      tensorNatMap g (hM.mono hIJ)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  induction t with
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht]
  | tmul m v =>
    rw [tensorNatMap_tmul, tensorNatMap_tmul, LieModuleHom.comp_apply]
    change ((quotientAction hM).flip m).rTensor W
      (((adQuotientMap R L hIJ : AdQuotient R L I →ₗ[R] AdQuotient R L J)).rTensor W (g v)) = _
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp]
    congr 2
    ext q
    exact congrArg (fun f : Module.End R M ↦ f m) (quotientAction_adQuotientMap hIJ hM q)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pow_eq_zero_of_hasKilledFiltration
statement:
theorem pow_eq_zero_of_hasKilledFiltration
    (θ : ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M],
      M ⊗[R] V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M ⊗[R] V)
    (hθ : ∀ (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
      [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N] (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N)
      (t : M ⊗[R] V), (f : M →ₗ[R] N).rTensor V (θ M t) = θ N ((f : M →ₗ[R] N).rTensor V t))
    (h0 : ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M],
      IsKilledBy I M → θ M = 0)
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] {n : ℕ}
    (hM : HasKilledFiltration I M n) : (θ M : M ⊗[R] V →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] V) ^ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hM with
  | zero M =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun t ↦ ?_
    have : Subsingleton (M ⊗[R] V) := inferInstance
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | succ M N n _ hMN ih =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun t ↦ ?_
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    
    have hex : Function.Exact ((N.incl : N →ₗ[R] M).rTensor V)
        (((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M ⧸ N) : M →ₗ[R] M ⧸ N).rTensor V) :=
      _root_.rTensor_exact V (fun m ↦ by
          constructor
          · intro hm
            exact ⟨⟨m, (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mp hm⟩, rfl⟩
          · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
            exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mpr n.2)
        (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N)
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (hex (θ M t)).mp (by
      rw [hθ M (M ⧸ N) (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N) t, h0 _ hMN, zero_apply])
    have hs' : (θ M : M ⊗[R] V →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] V) t = (N.incl : N →ₗ[R] M).rTensor V s := hs.symm
    rw [hs']
    have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, ((θ M : M ⊗[R] V →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] V) ^ k) ((N.incl : N →ₗ[R] M).rTensor V s) =
        (N.incl : N →ₗ[R] M).rTensor V (((θ N : N ⊗[R] V →ₗ[R] N ⊗[R] V) ^ k) s) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ihk =>
        rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ihk, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
        exact (hθ N M N.incl _).symm
    rw [hpow, ih, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]

name: LieModuleHom.exists_comp_eq_of_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_comp_eq_of_surjective (π : X →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ Y) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hX : ∀ x : X, ∃ N : LieSubmodule K L X, x ∈ N ∧ FiniteDimensional K N)
    (hC : ∀ N : LieSubmodule K L X, FiniteDimensional K N →
      ComplementedLattice (LieSubmodule K L N))
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (f : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ Y) : ∃ g : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ X, π.comp g = f
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis K V
  choose x hx using fun i ↦ hπ (f (b i))
  choose N hxN hN using fun i ↦ hX (x i)
  let S : LieSubmodule K L X := ⨆ i, N i
  have hxS : ∀ i, x i ∈ S := fun i ↦ LieSubmodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i (hxN i)
  have : FiniteDimensional K S := by
    change FiniteDimensional K (S : Submodule K X)
    rw [LieSubmodule.iSup_toSubmodule]
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_iSup _
  have := hC S inferInstance
  let πS : S →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ Y := π.comp S.incl
  obtain ⟨C, hCk⟩ := exists_isCompl πS.ker
  let e₀ : C →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ πS.range := codRestrict πS.range (πS.comp C.incl) fun c ↦
    (πS.mem_range _).mpr ⟨c, rfl⟩
  have he₀ : Function.Bijective e₀ := by
    constructor
    · intro c c' h
      have h' : πS (c - c' : C) = 0 := by
        have := congrArg Subtype.val h
        simp only [e₀, codRestrict_apply, comp_apply] at this
        rw [LieSubmodule.coe_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
        exact this
      have hk : ((c - c' : C) : S) ∈ πS.ker := h'
      have hmem : ((c - c' : C) : S) ∈ πS.ker ⊓ C := ⟨hk, (c - c').2⟩
      rw [hCk.inf_eq_bot, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at hmem
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Subtype.ext hmem)
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := (πS.mem_range y).mp hy
      have hs : s ∈ πS.ker ⊔ C := by rw [hCk.sup_eq_top]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top s
      obtain ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_sup _ _ _).mp hs
      refine ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      simp only [e₀, codRestrict_apply, comp_apply, LieSubmodule.incl_apply]
      rw [map_add, (LieModuleHom.mem_ker).mp ha, zero_add]
  let e := LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective e₀ he₀
  have hf : ∀ v, f v ∈ πS.range := by
    intro v
    rw [← b.sum_repr v, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem (πS.range : Submodule K Y) fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem (πS.range : Submodule K Y) _
      ((πS.mem_range _).mpr ⟨⟨x i, hxS i⟩, hx i⟩)
  refine ⟨S.incl.comp (C.incl.comp ((e.symm : πS.range →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ C).comp
    (codRestrict πS.range f hf))), ?_⟩
  ext v
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply (codRestrict πS.range f hf v))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_adFiltration
statement:
theorem mem_adFiltration {n : ℕ} {u : AdRegular R L} :
    u ∈ adFiltration R L n ↔ AdRegular.equiv R L u ∈ filtration R L n
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_finiteDimensional_mem_adRegular_tensor
statement:
theorem exists_finiteDimensional_mem_adRegular_tensor [FiniteDimensional K L]
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [LieRingModule L W] [LieModule K L W]
    [FiniteDimensional K W] (t : AdRegular K L ⊗[K] W) :
    ∃ N : LieSubmodule K L (AdRegular K L ⊗[K] W), t ∈ N ∧ FiniteDimensional K N
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | add s t hs ht =>
    obtain ⟨N, hsN, hN⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨N', htN', hN'⟩ := ht
    refine ⟨N ⊔ N', add_mem (LieSubmodule.mem_sup_left hsN) (LieSubmodule.mem_sup_right htN'),
      ?_⟩
    have h := Submodule.finiteDimensional_sup (N : Submodule K (AdRegular K L ⊗[K] W)) N'
    rwa [← LieSubmodule.sup_toSubmodule] at h
  | tmul u w =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_filtration (AdRegular.equiv K L u)
    let φ := TensorProduct.LieModule.map (adFiltration K L n).incl
      (LieModuleHom.id : W →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ W)
    refine ⟨φ.range, (φ.mem_range _).mpr ⟨⟨u, hn⟩ ⊗ₜ w, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change FiniteDimensional K
      (LinearMap.range (φ : adFiltration K L n ⊗[K] W →ₗ[K] AdRegular K L ⊗[K] W))
    have : FiniteDimensional K (adFiltration K L n ⊗[K] W) := inferInstance
    exact LinearMap.finiteDimensional_range _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv_ι_mul
statement:
theorem pbwEquiv_ι_mul (x : L) (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) :
    pbwEquiv b (ι R x * u) = PBW.rho b x (pbwEquiv b u)
proof:
:= by
  change (lift R (PBW.rhoHom b) (ι R x * u)) 1 =
    PBW.rho b x ((lift R (PBW.rhoHom b) u) 1)
  rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, lift_ι_apply, PBW.rhoHom_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.rho_sub_X_mul_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictTotalDegree, restrictSupport_eq_span] at hp
  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem p hp =>
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hp
    simpa [PBW.z, X, monomial_mul_monomial, add_comm] using
      PBW.restrictTotalDegree_mono hs (PBW.rho_sub_mem b i s)
  | zero => simp
  | add p q _ _ hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, mul_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact add_mem hp hq
  | smul r p _ hp =>
    rw [map_smul, mul_smul_comm, ← smul_sub]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hp

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv_ι_basis_mul_sub_mem
statement:
theorem pbwEquiv_ι_basis_mul_sub_mem (i : σ) (n : ℕ)
    {u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L} (hu : u ∈ filtration R L n) :
    pbwEquiv b (ι R (b i) * u) - X i * pbwEquiv b u ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R n
proof:
:= by
  rw [pbwEquiv_ι_mul]
  exact rho_sub_X_mul_mem b i n ((mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv b).mp hu)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv_ι_mul_sub_mem
statement:
theorem pbwEquiv_ι_mul_sub_mem (x : L) (n : ℕ)
    {u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L} (hu : u ∈ filtration R L n) :
    pbwEquiv b (ι R x * u) - pbwEquiv b (ι R x) * pbwEquiv b u ∈
      restrictTotalDegree σ R n
proof:
:= by
  let e := (pbwEquiv b).toLinearMap
  let j := (ι R : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L).toLinearMap
  let D : L →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
    e ∘ₗ (LinearMap.mulRight R u) ∘ₗ j -
      (LinearMap.mulRight R (pbwEquiv b u)) ∘ₗ e ∘ₗ j
  change D x ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R n
  induction b.mem_span x using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    change pbwEquiv b (ι R (b i) * u) - pbwEquiv b (ι R (b i)) * pbwEquiv b u ∈ _
    rw [pbwEquiv_ι_basis]
    exact pbwEquiv_ι_basis_mul_sub_mem b i n hu
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (restrictTotalDegree σ R n).zero_mem
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    rw [map_smul]
    exact (restrictTotalDegree σ R n).smul_mem r hx

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι
statement: @[simp] theorem map_ι (x : L) : map f (ι R x) = ι R (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_id
statement: @[simp] theorem map_id : map (LieHom.id : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change map _ (ι R x) = ι R x
  rw [map_ι]
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_comp
statement: theorem map_comp : map (g.comp f) = (map g).comp (map f)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change map _ (ι R x) = map g (map f (ι R x))
  rw [map_ι, map_ι, map_ι]
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_pbwMonomial
statement:
theorem map_pbwMonomial {σ : Type*} [LinearOrder σ] (v : σ → L) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    map f (pbwMonomial R v s) = pbwMonomial R (f ∘ v) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [pbwMonomial, pbwMonomial, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun i _ ↦ map_ι f (v i)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwMonomial_mapDomain_add
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_mapDomain_add (v : σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂ → L) (s₁ : σ₁ →₀ ℕ) (s₂ : σ₂ →₀ ℕ) :
    pbwMonomial R v (s₁.mapDomain (toLex ∘ Sum.inl) + s₂.mapDomain (toLex ∘ Sum.inr)) =
      pbwMonomial R (v ∘ toLex ∘ Sum.inl) s₁ * pbwMonomial R (v ∘ toLex ∘ Sum.inr) s₂
proof:
:= by
  set f₁ : σ₁ → σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂ := toLex ∘ Sum.inl
  set f₂ : σ₂ → σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂ := toLex ∘ Sum.inr
  have hsort : ((toMultiset (s₁.mapDomain f₁ + s₂.mapDomain f₂)).sort (· ≤ ·)) =
      ((toMultiset s₁).sort (· ≤ ·)).map f₁ ++ ((toMultiset s₂).sort (· ≤ ·)).map f₂ := by
    refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (r := (· ≤ ·)) (Multiset.pairwise_sort _ _) ?_ ?_
    · rw [List.pairwise_append, List.pairwise_map, List.pairwise_map]
      refine ⟨(Multiset.pairwise_sort _ _).imp fun h ↦ ?_,
        (Multiset.pairwise_sort _ _).imp fun h ↦ ?_, fun _ ha _ hb ↦ ?_⟩
      · exact Sum.Lex.inl_le_inl_iff.2 h
      · exact Sum.Lex.inr_le_inr_iff.2 h
      · obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
        obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hb
        exact Sum.Lex.inl_le_inr a b
    · rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, Multiset.sort_eq, ← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.map_coe,
        ← Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sort_eq, Multiset.sort_eq, toMultiset_add,
        toMultiset_map, toMultiset_map]
  rw [pbwMonomial, hsort, List.map_append, List.prod_append, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mulMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mulMap_tmul (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L₁)
    (v : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L₂) :
    mulMap L₁ L₂ (u ⊗ₜ v) = map L₁.incl u * map L₂.incl v
proof:
:= by
  simp [mulMap]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.basisOfIsCompl_inl
statement:
theorem basisOfIsCompl_inl (i : σ₁) :
    basisOfIsCompl h b₁ b₂ (toLex (Sum.inl i)) = L₁.incl (b₁ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisOfIsCompl, Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Basis.map_apply,
    Basis.prod_apply]
  exact add_zero _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.basisOfIsCompl_inr
statement:
theorem basisOfIsCompl_inr (i : σ₂) :
    basisOfIsCompl h b₁ b₂ (toLex (Sum.inr i)) = L₂.incl (b₂ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisOfIsCompl, Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Basis.map_apply,
    Basis.prod_apply]
  exact zero_add _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.lexFinsuppEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem lexFinsuppEquiv_apply (s : (σ₁ →₀ ℕ) × (σ₂ →₀ ℕ)) :
    lexFinsuppEquiv s = s.1.mapDomain (toLex ∘ Sum.inl) + s.2.mapDomain (toLex ∘ Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (toLex ∘ Sum.inl : σ₁ → σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂).Injective :=
    toLex.injective.comp Sum.inl_injective
  have h₂ : (toLex ∘ Sum.inr : σ₂ → σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂).Injective :=
    toLex.injective.comp Sum.inr_injective
  ext x
  obtain ⟨x | x, rfl⟩ := toLex.surjective x
  · rw [Finsupp.add_apply,
      show toLex (Sum.inl x) = (toLex ∘ Sum.inl : σ₁ → σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂) x from rfl,
      mapDomain_apply_of_injective h₁, mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ (by simp)]
    simp [lexFinsuppEquiv]
  · rw [Finsupp.add_apply,
      show toLex (Sum.inr x) = (toLex ∘ Sum.inr : σ₂ → σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂) x from rfl,
      mapDomain_apply_of_injective h₂, mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ (by simp)]
    simp [lexFinsuppEquiv]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mulMap_pbwMonomial_tmul
statement:
theorem mulMap_pbwMonomial_tmul (s : (σ₁ →₀ ℕ) × (σ₂ →₀ ℕ)) :
    mulMap L₁ L₂ (pbwMonomial R b₁ s.1 ⊗ₜ pbwMonomial R b₂ s.2) =
      pbwMonomial R (basisOfIsCompl h b₁ b₂) (lexFinsuppEquiv s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lexFinsuppEquiv_apply, pbwMonomial_mapDomain_add, mulMap_tmul, map_pbwMonomial,
    map_pbwMonomial]
  congr 2 <;> ext i <;> simp [basisOfIsCompl_inl, basisOfIsCompl_inr]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mulMap_bijective_of_basis
statement: theorem mulMap_bijective_of_basis : Function.Bijective (mulMap L₁ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  let B := (pbwBasis b₁).tensorProduct (pbwBasis b₂)
  have : mulMap L₁ L₂ = (B.equiv (pbwBasis (basisOfIsCompl h b₁ b₂)) lexFinsuppEquiv :
      _ →ₗ[R] _) :=
    B.ext fun s ↦ by
      rw [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Basis.equiv_apply, pbwBasis_apply, ← mulMap_pbwMonomial_tmul h,
        Basis.tensorProduct_apply', pbwBasis_apply, pbwBasis_apply]
  rw [this]
  exact LinearEquiv.bijective _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_incl_injective_of_basis
statement: theorem map_incl_injective_of_basis : Function.Injective (map L₁.incl)
proof:
:= by
  have hli : LinearIndependent R
      (pbwBasis (basisOfIsCompl h b₁ b₂) ∘ fun s ↦ lexFinsuppEquiv (s, (0 : σ₂ →₀ ℕ))) :=
    (pbwBasis _).linearIndependent.comp _
      (lexFinsuppEquiv.injective.comp fun _ _ h ↦ (Prod.mk.inj h).1)
  have : (map L₁.incl).toLinearMap = (pbwBasis b₁).constr R
      (pbwBasis (basisOfIsCompl h b₁ b₂) ∘ fun s ↦ lexFinsuppEquiv (s, 0)) :=
    (pbwBasis b₁).ext fun s ↦ by
      rw [Basis.constr_basis, Function.comp_apply, pbwBasis_apply, pbwBasis_apply,
        ← mulMap_pbwMonomial_tmul h b₁ b₂ (s, 0)]
      simp
  have hinj := (pbwBasis b₁).injective_constr_of_linearIndependent (R₂ := R) hli
  rw [← this] at hinj
  exact hinj

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mulMap_bijective_of_isCompl
statement: theorem mulMap_bijective_of_isCompl : Function.Bijective (mulMap L₁ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  let : LinearOrder (Free.ChooseBasisIndex R L₁) := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  let : LinearOrder (Free.ChooseBasisIndex R L₂) := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  exact mulMap_bijective_of_basis h (Free.chooseBasis R L₁) (Free.chooseBasis R L₂)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply
statement:
theorem tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L₁ ⊗[R]
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L₂) : tensorEquivOfIsCompl h x = mulMap L₁ L₂ x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L₁)
    (v : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L₂) :
    tensorEquivOfIsCompl h (u ⊗ₜ v) = map L₁.incl u * map L₂.incl v
proof:
:=
  mulMap_tmul L₁ L₂ u v

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_incl_injective_of_isCompl
statement: theorem map_incl_injective_of_isCompl : Function.Injective (map L₁.incl)
proof:
:= by
  let : LinearOrder (Free.ChooseBasisIndex R L₁) := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  let : LinearOrder (Free.ChooseBasisIndex R L₂) := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  exact map_incl_injective_of_basis h (Free.chooseBasis R L₁) (Free.chooseBasis R L₂)

name: LinearMap.commutator_apply
statement: lemma commutator_apply (a u : A) : commutator R a u = a * u - u * a
proof: := rfl

name: LinearMap.commutator_mul
statement:
lemma commutator_mul (a u v : A) :
    commutator R a (u * v) = commutator R a u * v + u * commutator R a v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutator_apply]
  noncomm_ring

name: LinearMap.commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
lemma commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le {a u : A} {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (hu : (commutator R a ^ m) u = 0) : (commutator R a ^ n) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hmn, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hu, map_zero]

name: LinearMap.pow_commutator_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pow_commutator_mul_eq_zero (a : A) :
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (u v : A), (commutator R a ^ m) u = 0 → (commutator R a ^ n) v = 0 →
      (commutator R a ^ (m + n)) (u * v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro n u v hu _
    rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hu
    rw [hu, zero_mul, map_zero]
  | succ m ihm =>
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro u v _ hv
      rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hv
      rw [hv, mul_zero, map_zero]
    | succ n ihn =>
      intro u v hu hv
      rw [show m + 1 + (n + 1) = (m + (n + 1)) + 1 by omega, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply,
        commutator_mul, map_add]
      have h1 : (commutator R a ^ (m + (n + 1))) (commutator R a u * v) = 0 :=
        ihm (n + 1) _ v (by rwa [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ]) hv
      have h2 : (commutator R a ^ (m + 1 + n)) (u * commutator R a v) = 0 :=
        ihn u _ hu (by rwa [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ])
      rw [h1, show m + (n + 1) = m + 1 + n by omega, h2, add_zero]

name: LinearMap.commute_commutator_mulRight
statement: lemma commute_commutator_mulRight (a : A) : Commute (commutator R a) (mulRight R a)
proof:
:=
  (commute_mulLeft_right a a).sub_left (Commute.refl _)

name: LinearMap.pow_mul_eq_sum_commutator
statement:
theorem pow_mul_eq_sum_commutator (a u : A) (n : ℕ) :
    a ^ n * u =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j • ((commutator R a ^ j) u * a ^ (n - j))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : mulLeft R a = commutator R a + mulRight R a := by
    rw [commutator, sub_add_cancel]
  have h := congrArg (fun T : Module.End R A ↦ T u)
    ((commute_commutator_mulRight (R := R) a).add_pow n)
  simp only [← hL, pow_mulLeft, mulLeft_apply] at h
  rw [h, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.natCast_apply, map_nsmul,
    ((commute_commutator_mulRight (R := R) a).pow_pow j (n - j)).eq, Module.End.mul_apply,
    pow_mulRight, mulRight_apply]

name: LinearMap.pow_mul_eq_sum_mul_pow
statement:
theorem pow_mul_eq_sum_mul_pow {a u : A} {J n : ℕ} (hJ : J ≤ n)
    (hu : (commutator R a ^ (J + 1)) u = 0) :
    a ^ n * u = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), n.choose j • ((commutator R a ^ j) u * a ^ (J - j))) *
      a ^ (n - J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul_eq_sum_commutator (R := R), sum_mul]
  symm
  calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), n.choose j • ((commutator R a ^ j) u * a ^ (J - j)) * a ^ (n - J)
      = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), n.choose j • ((commutator R a ^ j) u * a ^ (n - j)) := by
        refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
        rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show J - j + (n - J) = n - j by omega]
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j • ((commutator R a ^ j) u * a ^ (n - j)) := by
        refine sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) fun j _ hj ↦ ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hj
        rw [commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le hj hu, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.commutator_ι
statement: lemma commutator_ι (x y : L) : LinearMap.commutator R (ι R x) (ι R y) = ι R ⁅x, y⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [LieHom.map_lie, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, LinearMap.commutator_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.commutator_pow_ι
statement:
lemma commutator_pow_ι (x y : L) (n : ℕ) :
    (LinearMap.commutator R (ι R x) ^ n) (ι R y) = ι R ((LieAlgebra.ad R L x ^ n) y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, Module.End.one_apply]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, commutator_ι, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply,
      LieAlgebra.ad_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_commutator_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_commutator_pow_eq_zero {x : L} (hx : ∀ y : L, ∃ n, (LieAlgebra.ad R L x ^ n) y = 0)
    (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) :
    ∃ n, (LinearMap.commutator R (ι R x) ^ n) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, mkAlgHom R L a = u := by
    induction u using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | h a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  induction a using TensorAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_one, AlgHom.commutes, LinearMap.commutator_apply, Algebra.commutes, sub_self]
  | ι y =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx y
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    change (LinearMap.commutator R (ι R x) ^ n) (ι R y) = 0
    rw [commutator_pow_ι, hn, map_zero]
  | add a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h₂
    refine ⟨max m n, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_left m n) hm,
      LinearMap.commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_right m n) hn, add_zero]
  | mul a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h₂
    exact ⟨m + n, by rw [map_mul]; exact LinearMap.pow_commutator_mul_eq_zero _ m n _ _ hm hn⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration_zero
statement: theorem filtration_zero : filtration R L 0 = 1
proof: := pow_zero _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration_succ
statement:
theorem filtration_succ (n : ℕ) : filtration R L (n + 1) =
    (1 ⊔ LinearMap.range (ι R : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L).toLinearMap) *
      filtration R L n
proof: := pow_succ' _ _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration_add
statement:
theorem filtration_add (m n : ℕ) :
    filtration R L (m + n) = filtration R L m * filtration R L n
proof: := pow_add _ _ _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration_mono
statement: theorem filtration_mono : Monotone (filtration R L)
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [filtration_succ]
  calc filtration R L n = 1 * filtration R L n := (one_mul _).symm
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_left le_sup_left _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.one_mem_filtration
statement: theorem one_mem_filtration (n : ℕ) : (1 : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) ∈ filtration R L n
proof:
:=
  filtration_mono (Nat.zero_le n) (by rw [filtration_zero]; exact Submodule.one_le.mp le_rfl)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_filtration (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    algebraMap R (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) r ∈ filtration R L n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (one_mem_filtration n)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_mem_filtration_one
statement: theorem ι_mem_filtration_one (x : L) : ι R x ∈ filtration R L 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtration, pow_one]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mul_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem mul_mem_filtration {m n : ℕ} {x y : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L}
    (hx : x ∈ filtration R L m) (hy : y ∈ filtration R L n) : x * y ∈ filtration R L (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtration_add]; exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hx hy

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem exists_mem_filtration (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) :
    ∃ n, u ∈ filtration R L n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, mkAlgHom R L a = u := by
    induction u using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | h a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  induction a using TensorAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => exact ⟨0, by rw [AlgHom.commutes]; exact algebraMap_mem_filtration r 0⟩
  | ι x => exact ⟨1, ι_mem_filtration_one x⟩
  | add a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h₂
    rw [map_add]
    exact ⟨max m n, add_mem (filtration_mono (le_max_left m n) hm)
      (filtration_mono (le_max_right m n) hn)⟩
  | mul a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h₂
    rw [map_mul]
    exact ⟨m + n, mul_mem_filtration hm hn⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.iSup_filtration
statement: theorem iSup_filtration : ⨆ n, filtration R L n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun u _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_filtration u
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem n hn

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_filtration_zero
statement:
theorem mem_filtration_zero {u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L} :
    u ∈ filtration R L 0 ↔ ∃ r : R, algebraMap R _ r = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtration_zero, Submodule.mem_one]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.commutator_mem_filtration_of_mem_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtration, pow_one] at hg
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hg
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hy
  have key : ∀ {i : ℕ} {v : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L}, v ∈ filtration R L i →
      ι R x * v - v * ι R x ∈ filtration R L i := by
    intro i v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r' => rw [Algebra.commutes, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _
    | add v₁ v₂ i _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [mul_add, add_mul, add_sub_add_comm]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂
    | mem_mul g' hg' i v hv ih =>
      obtain ⟨y', hy', z', ⟨x', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hg'
      obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hy'
      have e : ι R x * ((algebraMap R _ r' + (ι R).toLinearMap x') * v) -
          (algebraMap R _ r' + (ι R).toLinearMap x') * v * ι R x =
          ι R ⁅x, x'⁆ * v + (algebraMap R _ r' + (ι R).toLinearMap x') *
            (ι R x * v - v * ι R x) := by
        rw [LieHom.map_lie, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap,
          Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
        simp only [mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, one_mul,
          mul_assoc]
        abel
      rw [e, filtration_succ]
      refine add_mem (Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨_, rfl⟩) hv)
        (Submodule.mul_mem_mul hg' ih)
  simpa [add_mul, mul_add, Algebra.commutes, add_sub_add_comm] using key hu

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.commutator_mem_filtration
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r => rw [Algebra.commutes, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a₁ a₂ i _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [add_mul, mul_add, add_sub_add_comm]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂
  | mem_mul g hg i a ha ih =>
    have hg1 : g ∈ filtration R L 1 := by rwa [filtration, pow_one]
    have e : g * a * u - u * (g * a) = g * (a * u - u * a) + (g * u - u * g) * a := by
      noncomm_ring
    rw [e]
    refine add_mem ?_ (filtration_mono (by omega)
      (mul_mem_filtration (commutator_mem_filtration_of_mem_one hg1 hu) ha))
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (i + n) with h | h
    · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := mem_filtration_zero.mp (show a ∈ filtration R L 0 by
        rwa [show i = 0 by omega] at ha)
      rw [Algebra.commutes, sub_self, mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    · exact filtration_mono (by omega) (mul_mem_filtration hg1 ih)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.iSup_lt_filtration
statement: theorem iSup_lt_filtration (n : ℕ) : ⨆ i < n + 1, filtration R L i = filtration R L n
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun _ hi ↦ filtration_mono (by omega)) (le_iSup₂_of_le n (by omega) le_rfl)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.list_prod_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem list_prod_mem_filtration (l : List L) :
    (l.map (ι R)).prod ∈ filtration R L l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact one_mem_filtration 0
  | cons x l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.length_cons, filtration_succ]
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨x, rfl⟩) ih

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwMonomial_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_mem_filtration (v : σ → L) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    pbwMonomial R v s ∈ filtration R L s.degree
proof:
:= by
  have := list_prod_mem_filtration (R := R) (((toMultiset s).sort (· ≤ ·)).map v)
  rw [List.map_map, List.length_map, Multiset.length_sort, card_toMultiset] at this
  exact this

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_pbwEquiv_filtration
statement:
theorem map_pbwEquiv_filtration (b : Basis σ R L) (n : ℕ) :
    (filtration R L n).map (pbwEquiv b : _ →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R) = restrictTotalDegree σ R n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r =>
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      rw [← pbwMonomial_zero (R := R) b, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, pbwEquiv_pbwMonomial]
      exact z_mem_restrictTotalDegree (by simp)
    | add x y i _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | mem_mul g hg i x _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy, z, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hg
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hy
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap] at ih ⊢
      have hx : x = phi b (pbwEquiv b x) := ((pbwEquiv b).symm_apply_apply x).symm
      rw [add_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul, map_add, map_smul, hx,
        ← phi_lift, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, lift_ι_apply, rhoHom_apply]
      refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (restrictTotalDegree_mono (Nat.le_succ i) ?_)) ?_
      · simpa [← hx] using ih
      · exact (pbwEquiv b).apply_symm_apply _ ▸ rho_mem b i w ih
  · rw [restrictTotalDegree, restrictSupport_eq_span, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨pbwMonomial R b s, filtration_mono ?_ (pbwMonomial_mem_filtration b s), ?_⟩
    · exact hs
    · simp

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pbwEquiv_filtration b n]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨u, h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨v, hv, e⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  rwa [← (pbwEquiv b).injective e]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration_eq_span
statement:
theorem filtration_eq_span (b : Basis σ R L) (n : ℕ) :
    filtration R L n = Submodule.span R (pbwMonomial R b '' {s | s.degree ≤ n})
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (pbwEquiv b).injective
  rw [map_pbwEquiv_filtration, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_image, restrictTotalDegree,
    restrictSupport_eq_span]
  congr 1
  refine Set.image_congr fun s _ ↦ ?_
  simp

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_subtype
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_subtype (b : Basis σ R L) (n : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent R fun s : {s : σ →₀ ℕ // s.degree ≤ n} ↦ pbwMonomial R b s
proof:
:= by
  convert (pbwBasis b).linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective
  simp

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtrationBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem filtrationBasis_apply (b : Basis σ R L) (n : ℕ)
    (s : {s : σ →₀ ℕ // s.degree ≤ n}) :
    (filtrationBasis b n s : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) = pbwMonomial R b s
proof:
:= by
  simp [filtrationBasis, Basis.span_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_reesAlgebra
statement:
theorem mem_reesAlgebra {p : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X]} :
    p ∈ reesAlgebra R L ↔ ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ filtration R L n
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.AssociatedGraded.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk : reesAlgebra R L → AssociatedGraded R L)
proof:
:=
  RingCon.mkₐ_surjective _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.AssociatedGraded.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {p q : reesAlgebra R L} : mk p = mk q ↔ grCon R L p q
proof: := RingCon.eq _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_apply
statement:
theorem toGr_apply (n : ℕ) (x : filtration R L n) :
    toGr R L n x = AssociatedGraded.mk (reesMonomial R L n x)
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.coe_reesMonomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_reesMonomial (n : ℕ) (x : filtration R L n) :
    (reesMonomial R L n x : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X]) =
      monomial n (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_congr
statement:
theorem toGr_congr {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {x : filtration R L m} {y : filtration R L n}
    (hxy : (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) = y) : toGr R L m x = toGr R L n y
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rw [Subtype.ext hxy]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_mul
statement:
theorem toGr_mul {m n : ℕ} (x : filtration R L m) (y : filtration R L n) :
    toGr R L m x * toGr R L n y = toGr R L (m + n)
      ⟨(x * y : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L), mul_mem_filtration x.2 y.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [toGr_apply, toGr_apply, toGr_apply, ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  ext1
  simp [monomial_mul_monomial]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (x : filtration R L (n + 1)) :
    toGr R L (n + 1) x = 0 ↔ (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) ∈ filtration R L n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toGr_apply, ← map_zero AssociatedGraded.mk, mk_eq_mk_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, e⟩
    have := congr_arg (fun p : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X] ↦ p.coeff (n + 1)) e
    simp only [coe_reesMonomial, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, sub_zero, coeff_monomial_same,
      coeff_X_mul] at this
    exact this ▸ hc n
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨monomial n (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (reesMonomial R L n ⟨x, hx⟩).2
    · simp

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_zero_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem toGr_zero_eq_zero_iff (x : filtration R L 0) : toGr R L 0 x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toGr_apply, ← map_zero AssociatedGraded.mk, mk_eq_mk_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, e⟩
    have := congr_arg (fun p : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X] ↦ p.coeff 0) e
    simp only [coe_reesMonomial, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, sub_zero, coeff_monomial_same,
      coeff_X_mul_zero] at this
    exact Subtype.ext this
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, by simp⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mk_eq_sum_toGr
statement:
theorem mk_eq_sum_toGr (p : reesAlgebra R L) :
    AssociatedGraded.mk p =
      ∑ n ∈ (p : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X]).support, toGr R L n ⟨_, p.2 n⟩
proof:
:= by
  have : p = ∑ n ∈ (p : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X]).support,
      reesMonomial R L n ⟨_, p.2 n⟩ := by
    ext1
    simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, coe_reesMonomial]
    exact as_sum_support (p : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X])
  conv_lhs => rw [this]
  rw [map_sum]
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.iSup_range_toGr
statement: theorem iSup_range_toGr : ⨆ n, LinearMap.range (toGr R L n) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun a _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective a
  rw [mk_eq_sum_toGr]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem n ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem toGr_eq_zero_of_mem {k : ℕ} (x : filtration R L k)
    (hx : (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) ∈ filtration R L (k - 1))
    (h0 : k = 0 → (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) = 0) : toGr R L k x = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => rw [toGr_zero_eq_zero_iff]; exact Subtype.ext (h0 rfl)
  | succ k => exact (toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff x).mpr hx

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff (p : reesAlgebra R L) :
    AssociatedGraded.mk p = 0 ↔ ∀ n, toGr R L n ⟨_, p.2 n⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h n ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [mk_eq_sum_toGr]; exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n _ ↦ h n⟩
  rw [← map_zero AssociatedGraded.mk, mk_eq_mk_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨c, hc, e⟩ := h
  have hcoeff := congr_arg (fun q : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X] ↦ q.coeff n) e
  simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, sub_zero] at hcoeff
  refine toGr_eq_zero_of_mem _ ?_ fun h ↦ ?_ <;> dsimp only
  · cases n with
    | zero => rw [hcoeff, coeff_X_mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | succ n => rw [hcoeff, coeff_X_mul]; exact hc n
  · subst h; rw [hcoeff, coeff_X_mul_zero]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ker_toGr_zero
statement: theorem ker_toGr_zero : LinearMap.ker (toGr R L 0) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr fun x ↦ (toGr_zero_eq_zero_iff x).mp

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ker_toGr_succ
statement:
theorem ker_toGr_succ (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (toGr R L (n + 1)) =
      (filtration R L n).comap (filtration R L (n + 1)).subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff x

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.isInternal_range_toGr
statement: theorem isInternal_range_toGr : DirectSum.IsInternal fun n ↦ LinearMap.range (toGr R L n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  refine ⟨?_, iSup_range_toGr⟩
  rw [iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_zero_imp_eq_zero]
  intro s v hv hsum
  have : ∀ i, ∃ y : filtration R L i, i ∈ s → toGr R L i y = v i := fun i ↦ by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hv i hi
      exact ⟨y, fun _ ↦ hy⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h ↦ absurd h hi⟩
  choose x hx using this
  let p : reesAlgebra R L := ∑ i ∈ s, reesMonomial R L i (x i)
  have hp : AssociatedGraded.mk p = 0 := by
    rw [← hsum, map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ hx i hi
  intro i hi
  have := (mk_eq_zero_iff p).mp hp i
  rw [← hx i hi, ← this]
  refine toGr_congr rfl ?_
  simp only [p, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, coe_reesMonomial, finsetSum_coeff,
    coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq', hi, ↓reduceIte]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_mul_comm
statement:
theorem toGr_mul_comm {m n : ℕ} (x : filtration R L m) (y : filtration R L n) :
    toGr R L m x * toGr R L n y = toGr R L n y * toGr R L m x
proof:
:= by
  rw [toGr_mul, toGr_mul, toGr_congr (add_comm n m)
    (y := ⟨(y * x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L), add_comm n m ▸ mul_mem_filtration y.2 x.2⟩)
    rfl]
  have hc := commutator_mem_filtration x.2 y.2
  have h0 : toGr R L (m + n) ⟨(x * y - y * x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L),
      sub_mem (mul_mem_filtration x.2 y.2) (add_comm n m ▸ mul_mem_filtration y.2 x.2)⟩ = 0 := by
    refine toGr_eq_zero_of_mem _ hc fun h ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_filtration_zero.mp (show (x : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) ∈
      filtration R L 0 from (show m = 0 by omega) ▸ x.2)
    simp [← hr, Algebra.commutes]
  conv_rhs => rw [← add_zero (toGr R L (m + n) _), ← h0, ← map_add]
  congr 1
  ext1
  simp

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_ι (x : L) :
    symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R L x) =
      toGr R L 1 ⟨ι R x, ι_mem_filtration_one x⟩
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply (ιGr R L) x

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_zero_one
statement: theorem toGr_zero_one : toGr R L 0 ⟨1, one_mem_filtration 0⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [toGr_apply, ← map_one AssociatedGraded.mk]
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_mem_range
statement:
theorem toGr_mem_range (n : ℕ) (x : filtration R L n) :
    toGr R L n x ∈ (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r =>
    have : toGr R L 0 ⟨algebraMap R _ r, algebraMap_mem_filtration r 0⟩ =
        algebraMap R (AssociatedGraded R L) r := by
      rw [toGr_apply, ← AlgHom.commutes (AssociatedGraded.mk (R := R) (L := L)) r]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r
  | add x y i hx hy h₁ h₂ =>
    have := add_mem h₁ h₂
    rwa [← map_add] at this
  | mem_mul g hg i x hx ih =>
    have hx' : x ∈ filtration R L i := hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hg
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hy
    have h₁ : algebraMap R _ r * x ∈ filtration R L (i + 1) := by
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (filtration_mono (Nat.le_succ i) hx)
    have h₂ : ι R w * x ∈ filtration R L (i + 1) := by
      rw [filtration_succ]
      exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨w, rfl⟩) hx
    have e : (⟨(algebraMap R _ r + (ι R : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L).toLinearMap w)
        * x, by rw [filtration_succ]; exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hg hx⟩ :
        filtration R L (i + 1)) =
        ⟨_, h₁⟩ + ⟨_, h₂⟩ := Subtype.ext (add_mul _ _ _)
    rw [e, map_add, (toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff _).mpr, zero_add,
      ← toGr_congr (add_comm 1 i)
        (x := ⟨ι R w * x, mul_mem_filtration (ι_mem_filtration_one w) hx'⟩) rfl]
    · have := mul_mem (show toGr R L 1 ⟨ι R w, ι_mem_filtration_one w⟩ ∈
        (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L).range from
          ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.ι R L w, symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_ι w⟩) ih
      rwa [toGr_mul] at this
    · dsimp only
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_surjective
statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have ha : a ∈ ⨆ n, LinearMap.range (toGr R L n) := by
    rw [iSup_range_toGr]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  refine (AlgHom.mem_range _).mp (Submodule.iSup_induction _
    (motive := fun a ↦ a ∈ (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L).range) ha ?_ (zero_mem _)
    fun _ _ ↦ add_mem)
  rintro n _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact toGr_mem_range n x

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_symm_monomial
statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_symm_monomial (m : ℕ) : ∀ s : σ →₀ ℕ,
    s.degree = m → symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L
      ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm (monomial s 1)) =
      toGr R L s.degree ⟨pbwMonomial R b s, pbwMonomial_mem_filtration b s⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro s hs
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff] at hs
    subst hs
    rw [monomial_zero', MvPolynomial.C_1, map_one, map_one, ← toGr_zero_one]
    exact toGr_congr (by simp) (by simp)
  | succ m ih =>
    intro s hs
    have hne : s.support.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, Finsupp.support_eq_empty]
      rintro rfl; simp at hs
    have hts := sub_add_single_minIdx s hne
    have ht := leAll_minIdx s hne
    have htdeg := degree_sub_single_minIdx s hne
    set t := s - Finsupp.single (minIdx s hne) 1
    set j := minIdx s hne
    have e : monomial s (1 : R) = MvPolynomial.X j * monomial t 1 := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul, ← hts, add_comm]
    rw [e, map_mul, map_mul, SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_symm_X,
      symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_ι, ih t (by omega), toGr_mul]
    exact toGr_congr (by omega) (by dsimp only; rw [← hts, pbwMonomial_add_single ht])

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.mk_reesLift
statement:
theorem mk_reesLift (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    AssociatedGraded.mk (reesLift b P) =
      symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm P)
proof:
:= by
  have : AssociatedGraded.mk.toLinearMap ∘ₗ reesLift b =
      (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap :=
    (basisMonomials σ R).ext fun s ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, reesLift, Basis.constr_basis,
        AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
      rw [coe_basisMonomials, symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_symm_monomial b _ s rfl]
      rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this P

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.grInv_monomial
statement:
theorem grInv_monomial (n : ℕ) (a : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) :
    grInv b (Polynomial.monomial n a) = homogeneousComponent n (pbwEquiv b a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [grInv, sum_monomial_index]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.grInv_reesLift
statement: theorem grInv_reesLift (P : MvPolynomial σ R) : grInv b (reesLift b P) = P
proof:
:= by
  have : grInv b ∘ₗ (reesAlgebra R L).val.toLinearMap ∘ₗ reesLift b = LinearMap.id :=
    (basisMonomials σ R).ext fun s ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, reesLift, Basis.constr_basis,
        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Subalgebra.coe_val, coe_reesMonomial, grInv_monomial,
        pbwEquiv_pbwMonomial, LinearMap.id_apply]
      rw [coe_basisMonomials]
      exact homogeneousComponent_eq_self (isHomogeneous_monomial 1 rfl)
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this P

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.grInv_X_mul
statement:
theorem grInv_X_mul {c : (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)[X]} (hc : c ∈ reesAlgebra R L) :
    grInv b (Polynomial.X * c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [as_sum_support c, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n _ ↦ ?_
  rw [X_mul_monomial, grInv_monomial]
  refine homogeneousComponent_eq_zero _ _ (lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ n.lt_succ_self)
  exact (mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mp ((mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv b).mp (hc n))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_injective_of_basis
statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_injective_of_basis :
    Function.Injective (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.surjective a
  rw [← mk_reesLift, ← map_zero AssociatedGraded.mk, mk_eq_mk_iff] at ha
  obtain ⟨c, hc, e⟩ := ha
  have := congr_arg (grInv b) e
  rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, sub_zero, grInv_reesLift, grInv_X_mul b hc] at this
  rw [this, map_zero]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_bijective
statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_bijective [Module.Free R L] :
    Function.Bijective (symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded R L)
proof:
:= by
  let : LinearOrder (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R L) := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  exact ⟨symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_injective_of_basis (Module.Free.chooseBasis R L),
    symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_surjective R L⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded_ι [Module.Free R L] (x : L) :
    symmetricAlgebraEquivAssociatedGraded R L (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R L x) =
      toGr R L 1 ⟨ι R x, ι_mem_filtration_one x⟩
proof:
:=
  symmetricAlgebraToAssociatedGraded_ι x

name: exists_mul_eq_of_isNilpotent_sub
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_of_isNilpotent_sub {A : Type*} [Ring A] {e a : A} (he : e * e = e)
    (ha : e * a * e = a) (hn : IsNilpotent (a - e)) : ∃ b : A, b * a = e ∧ a * b = e
proof:
:= by
  have hea : e * a = a := by rw [← ha, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, he]
  have hae : a * e = a := by rw [← ha, mul_assoc, he]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hn.isUnit_one_add
  have hue : (u : A) * e = a := by rw [hu, add_mul, one_mul, sub_mul, hae, he, add_sub_cancel]
  have hc : Commute e (u : A) := by
    rw [hu]
    refine (Commute.one_right e).add_right ?_
    change e * (a - e) = (a - e) * e
    rw [mul_sub, sub_mul, hea, hae, he]
  refine ⟨e * ↑u⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hue, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ (u : A), Units.inv_mul, one_mul, he]
  · rw [← mul_assoc, hae, ← hue, ← hc.eq, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.hasKilledFiltration_of_isKilledByPow
statement:
theorem hasKilledFiltration_of_isKilledByPow (hM : IsKilledByPow I n M) :
    HasKilledFiltration I M n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing M with
  | zero =>
    have h := hM [] rfl (by simp)
    rw [List.prod_nil, map_one] at h
    have hz : ∀ z : M, z = 0 := fun z ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun h z
    have : Subsingleton M := ⟨fun x y ↦ by rw [hz x, hz y]⟩
    exact HasKilledFiltration.zero (R := K) (L := L) (I := I) M
  | succ n ih =>
    refine .succ M (idealSMul I M) n (ih fun l hl hlI ↦ LinearMap.ext fun ⟨m, hm⟩ ↦ ?_) ?_
    · refine Subtype.ext ?_
      change (idealSMul I M).incl (actionHom _ l.prod ⟨m, hm⟩) = 0
      rw [LieModuleHom.map_actionHom]
      change actionHom (R := K) (L := L) M l.prod m = 0
      induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem m hm =>
        obtain ⟨a, ha, m', rfl⟩ := hm
        rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, ← List.prod_concat]
        rw [hM _ (by simp [hl]) (fun b hb ↦ by
          rcases List.mem_append.mp (List.concat_eq_append ▸ hb) with hb | hb
          exacts [hlI b hb, (List.mem_singleton.mp hb) ▸ ha]), LinearMap.zero_apply]
      | zero => rw [map_zero]
      | add m m' _ _ hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', add_zero]
      | smul c m _ hm => rw [map_smul, hm, smul_zero]
    · intro a ha
      refine LinearMap.ext fun q ↦ ?_
      induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
      | H m =>
        change actionHom _ a (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (idealSMul I M) m) = 0
        rw [← LieModuleHom.map_actionHom]
        change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk _ = 0
        rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero']
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, ha, m, rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorNatTrans.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_app (ψ : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, w} K L W X)
    (φ : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, w} K L V W)
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] :
    (ψ.comp φ).app M = (ψ.app M).comp (φ.app M)
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorNatTrans.ofTensorNatMap_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofTensorNatMap_app (g : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ AdQuotient K L ⊥ ⊗[K] W)
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] :
    (ofTensorNatMap g).app M = tensorNatMap g (isKilledBy_bot (M := M))
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorNatTrans.exists_tensorNatMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_tensorNatMap_eq (φ : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L V W) :
    ∃ g : V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ AdQuotient K L I ⊗[K] W, ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
      [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] (hM : IsKilledBy I M), tensorNatMap g hM = φ.app M
proof:
:=
  ⟨evalNat (φ.app (LeftQuotient K L I)) (fun u t ↦ φ.naturality _ _ (quotientMulRight I u) t),
    fun _ _ _ _ _ hM ↦ tensorNatMap_evalNat _ _ hM _ fun _ t ↦ φ.naturality _ _ _ t⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorNatTrans.app_eq_of_app_eq
statement:
theorem app_eq_of_app_eq (φ ψ : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L V W) {M₀ : Type (max u v)}
    [AddCommGroup M₀] [Module K M₀] [LieRingModule L M₀] [LieModule K L M₀] (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I M₀)
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := L) M₀ a = 0 → a ∈ I) (h : φ.app M₀ = ψ.app M₀)
    {M : Type (max u v)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M]
    (hM : IsKilledBy I M) : φ.app M = ψ.app M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_tensorNatMap_eq (I := I) φ
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := exists_tensorNatMap_eq (I := I) ψ
  have : g = g' := tensorNatLinear_injective (V := V) (W := W) hM₀ hI (by
    rw [tensorNatLinear_apply, tensorNatLinear_apply, hg, hg', h])
  rw [← hg _ hM, ← hg' _ hM, this]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorNatTrans.isNilpotent_comp_sub
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_comp_sub (ε : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L V V)
    (α : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L V W) (β : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L W V)
    {M₀ : Type (max u v)} [AddCommGroup M₀] [Module K M₀] [LieRingModule L M₀] [LieModule K L M₀]
    (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I M₀) (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := L) M₀ a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (h : (β.app M₀).comp (α.app M₀) = ε.app M₀)
    {M : Type (max u v)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] {n : ℕ}
    (hM : HasKilledFiltration I M n) :
    IsNilpotent (((β.comp α).app M : M ⊗[K] V →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] V) - ε.app M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, pow_eq_zero_of_hasKilledFiltration (V := V)
    (fun N _ _ _ _ ↦ (β.comp α).app N - ε.app N)
    (fun N N' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f t ↦ by
      rw [sub_apply, sub_apply, map_sub, (β.comp α).naturality, ε.naturality])
    (fun N _ _ _ _ hN ↦ by rw [app_eq_of_app_eq (β.comp α) ε hM₀ hI h hN, sub_self]) hM⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.TensorNatTrans.exists_inverse_of_hasKilledFiltration
statement:
theorem exists_inverse_of_hasKilledFiltration (e : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L V V)
    (e' : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L W W) (φ : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L V W)
    (φ' : TensorNatTrans.{u, v, max u v} K L W V)
    {M₀ : Type (max u v)} [AddCommGroup M₀] [Module K M₀] [LieRingModule L M₀] [LieModule K L M₀]
    (hM₀ : IsKilledBy I M₀) (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := L) M₀ a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    (h₁ : (φ'.app M₀).comp (φ.app M₀) = e.app M₀) (h₂ : (φ.app M₀).comp (φ'.app M₀) = e'.app M₀)
    {M : Type (max u v)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] {n : ℕ}
    (hM : HasKilledFiltration I M n)
    (he : ∀ x, e.app M (e.app M x) = e.app M x) (he' : ∀ y, e'.app M (e'.app M y) = e'.app M y)
    (hφ : ∀ x, e'.app M (φ.app M (e.app M x)) = φ.app M x)
    (hφ' : ∀ y, e.app M (φ'.app M (e'.app M y)) = φ'.app M y) :
    ∃ ψ : M ⊗[K] W →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] V, ψ ∘ₗ (φ.app M : M ⊗[K] V →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] W) = e.app M ∧
      (φ.app M : M ⊗[K] V →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] W) ∘ₗ ψ = e'.app M
proof:
:= by
  have hφe : ∀ x, φ.app M (e.app M x) = φ.app M x := fun x ↦ by
    have h := hφ (e.app M x)
    rw [he] at h
    rw [← h, hφ]
  have he'φ : ∀ x, e'.app M (φ.app M x) = φ.app M x := fun x ↦ by rw [← hφ, he', hφ]
  have hφ'e' : ∀ y, φ'.app M (e'.app M y) = φ'.app M y := fun y ↦ by
    have h := hφ' (e'.app M y)
    rw [he'] at h
    rw [← h, hφ']
  have heφ' : ∀ y, e.app M (φ'.app M y) = φ'.app M y := fun y ↦ by rw [← hφ', he, hφ']
  obtain ⟨b, hb₁, -⟩ := exists_mul_eq_of_isNilpotent_sub (A := Module.End K (M ⊗[K] V))
    (e := e.app M) (a := (φ'.comp φ).app M) (LinearMap.ext he)
    (LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ by
      change e.app M (φ'.app M (φ.app M (e.app M x))) = φ'.app M (φ.app M x)
      rw [hφe, heφ'])
    (isNilpotent_comp_sub e φ φ' hM₀ hI h₁ hM)
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc₂⟩ := exists_mul_eq_of_isNilpotent_sub (A := Module.End K (M ⊗[K] W))
    (e := e'.app M) (a := (φ.comp φ').app M) (LinearMap.ext he')
    (LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ by
      change e'.app M (φ.app M (φ'.app M (e'.app M y))) = φ.app M (φ'.app M y)
      rw [hφ'e', he'φ])
    (isNilpotent_comp_sub e' φ' φ hM₀ hI h₂ hM)
  have hb : ∀ x, b (φ'.app M (φ.app M x)) = e.app M x := fun x ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun hb₁ x
  have hc : ∀ y, φ.app M (φ'.app M (c y)) = e'.app M y := fun y ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun hc₂ y
  
  have hL : ∀ y, b (φ'.app M y) = φ'.app M (c y) := fun y ↦ by
    rw [← hφ'e', ← hc, hb, heφ']
  refine ⟨b ∘ₗ (φ'.app M : M ⊗[K] W →ₗ[K] M ⊗[K] V), LinearMap.ext hb, LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  change φ.app M (b (φ'.app M y)) = e'.app M y
  rw [hL, hc]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.eq_zero_of_forall_rTensor_flip_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_rTensor_flip_eq_zero (φ : A →ₗ[K] Module.End K M)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (t : A ⊗[K] W) (ht : ∀ m, (φ.flip m).rTensor W t = 0) :
    t = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace K W
  let e := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight (M := A) b
  
  let c : _ → A ⊗[K] W →ₗ[K] A := fun i ↦
    (TensorProduct.rid K A).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (b.coord i).lTensor A
  have hc : ∀ i (s : A ⊗[K] W), e s i = c i s := fun i s ↦ by
    induction s with
    | add s s' hs hs' => rw [map_add, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hs, hs']
    | tmul a w =>
      rw [TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_apply_tmul_apply]
      simp [c]
  have hcm : ∀ i (m : M) (s : A ⊗[K] W), φ (c i s) m =
      ((TensorProduct.rid K M).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (b.coord i).lTensor M)
        ((φ.flip m).rTensor W s) := fun i m s ↦ by
    induction s with
    | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hs, hs']
    | tmul a w => simp [c]
  apply e.injective
  ext i
  rw [hc, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  apply hφ
  ext m
  rw [hcm, ht, map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorNatLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorNatLinear_apply (hM : IsKilledBy I M)
    (g : V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ AdQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W) : tensorNatLinear hM g = tensorNatMap g hM
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.quotientAction_injective
statement:
theorem quotientAction_injective (hM : IsKilledBy I M)
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := R) (L := L) M a = 0 → a ∈ I) :
    Function.Injective (quotientAction hM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro q hq
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H u =>
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, quotientAction_mk] at hq
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (hI _ hq)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorNatLinear_injective
statement:
theorem tensorNatLinear_injective (hM : IsKilledBy I M)
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := L) M a = 0 → a ∈ I) :
    Function.Injective (tensorNatLinear (V := V) (W := W) hM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro g hg
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, tensorNatLinear_apply] at hg
  ext v
  refine eq_zero_of_forall_rTensor_flip_eq_zero _ (quotientAction_injective hM hI) _ fun m ↦ ?_
  rw [← tensorNatMap_tmul, hg]
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorNatLinear_bijective
statement:
theorem tensorNatLinear_bijective (hM : IsKilledBy I M)
    (hI : ∀ a, actionHom (R := K) (L := L) M a = 0 → a ∈ I)
    [FiniteDimensional K (V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ AdQuotient K L I ⊗[K] W)]
    [FiniteDimensional K (M ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ M ⊗[K] W)]
    (hdim : Module.finrank K (V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ AdQuotient K L I ⊗[K] W) =
      Module.finrank K (M ⊗[K] V →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ M ⊗[K] W)) :
    Function.Bijective (tensorNatLinear (V := V) (W := W) hM)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := tensorNatLinear_injective (V := V) (W := W) hM hI
  exact ⟨hinj, (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mp hinj⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_toGr_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_toGr_ne_zero {u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n, ∃ hn : u ∈ filtration R L n, toGr R L n ⟨u, hn⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hmin⟩ : ∃ n, u ∈ filtration R L n ∧ ∀ k < n, u ∉ filtration R L k :=
    ⟨Nat.find (exists_mem_filtration u), Nat.find_spec (exists_mem_filtration u),
      fun _ ↦ Nat.find_min (exists_mem_filtration u)⟩
  refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [ne_eq, toGr_zero_eq_zero_iff]
    exact fun h0 ↦ hu (congrArg Subtype.val h0)
  | succ k =>
    rw [ne_eq, toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff]
    exact hmin k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular.equiv_lie
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_lie (x : L) (u : LeftRegular R L) :
    equiv R L ⁅x, u⁆ = ι R x * equiv R L u
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular.equiv_mulRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_mulRight (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) (v : LeftRegular R L) :
    equiv R L (mulRight u v) = equiv R L v * u
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.pbwMonomial_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma pbwMonomial_zero (v : σ → L) : pbwMonomial R v 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [pbwMonomial]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.pbwMonomial_add_single
statement:
lemma pbwMonomial_add_single {v : σ → L} {i : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : LeAll i s) :
    pbwMonomial R v (s + single i 1) = ι R (v i) * pbwMonomial R v s
proof:
:= by
  have hs : toMultiset (s + single i 1) = i ::ₘ toMultiset s := by
    rw [toMultiset_add, toMultiset_single, one_nsmul, add_comm, Multiset.singleton_add]
  rw [pbwMonomial, hs, Multiset.sort_cons, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, pbwMonomial]
  intro j hj
  exact h j (by simpa using hj)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.leAll_zero
statement: lemma leAll_zero (i : σ) : LeAll i 0
proof: := by simp [LeAll]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.support_nonempty_of_not_leAll
statement:
lemma support_nonempty_of_not_leAll {i : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : ¬ LeAll i s) :
    s.support.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h'
  rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, Finsupp.support_eq_empty] at h'
  exact h (h' ▸ leAll_zero i)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.minIdx_lt
statement:
lemma minIdx_lt {i : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : ¬ LeAll i s) :
    minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h) < i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LeAll, not_forall, not_le] at h
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hji⟩ := h
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.min'_le _ _ hj) hji

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.single_minIdx_le
statement:
lemma single_minIdx_le (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (h : s.support.Nonempty) :
    single (minIdx s h) 1 ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = minIdx s h
  · subst hk
    have := Finset.min'_mem s.support h
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at this
    simp only [single_eq_same]
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr this
  · simp [Ne.symm hk]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.sub_add_single_minIdx
statement:
lemma sub_add_single_minIdx (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (h : s.support.Nonempty) :
    s - single (minIdx s h) 1 + single (minIdx s h) 1 = s
proof:
:=
  tsub_add_cancel_of_le (single_minIdx_le s h)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.leAll_minIdx
statement:
lemma leAll_minIdx (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (h : s.support.Nonempty) :
    LeAll (minIdx s h) (s - single (minIdx s h) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  apply Finset.min'_le
  rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hj ⊢
  intro h0
  apply hj
  simp [h0]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.degree_sub_single_minIdx
statement:
lemma degree_sub_single_minIdx (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (h : s.support.Nonempty) :
    (s - single (minIdx s h) 1).degree + 1 = s.degree
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← sub_add_single_minIdx s h]
  rw [map_add, degree_single]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.leAll_add_single
statement:
lemma leAll_add_single {i j : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : LeAll i s) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    LeAll i (s + single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (support_add hk) with hk | hk
  · exact h k hk
  · rw [support_single _ one_ne_zero, Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
    exact hk ▸ hij

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.leAll_of_le
statement: lemma leAll_of_le {i j : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : LeAll j s) (hij : i ≤ j) : LeAll i s
proof:
:=
  fun k hk ↦ hij.trans (h k hk)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.minIdx_add_single
statement:
lemma minIdx_add_single {j : σ} {t : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : LeAll j t)
    (hne : (t + single j 1).support.Nonempty) :
    minIdx (t + single j 1) hne = j
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.min'_le
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
    simp
  · apply Finset.le_min'
    intro k hk
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (support_add hk) with hk | hk
    · exact h k hk
    · rw [support_single _ one_ne_zero, Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
      exact hk ▸ le_rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.not_leAll_add_single
statement:
lemma not_leAll_add_single {i j : σ} {t : σ →₀ ℕ} (hji : j < i) :
    ¬ LeAll i (t + single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : j ∈ (t + single j 1).support := by rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]; simp
  exact absurd (h j this) (not_le.mpr hji)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.extend_z
statement:
@[simp] lemma extend_z {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f : (σ →₀ ℕ) → M)
    (s : σ →₀ ℕ) : extend f (z R σ s) = f s
proof:
:= by
  have := (basisMonomials σ R).constr_basis R f s
  rwa [coe_basisMonomials] at this

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.eq_of_mem_restrictTotalDegree
statement:
lemma eq_of_mem_restrictTotalDegree {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {f g : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] M} {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ s : σ →₀ ℕ, s.degree ≤ n → f (z R σ s) = g (z R σ s))
    {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R n) : f p = g p
proof:
:= by
  rw [p.as_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
  have hdeg : s.degree ≤ n :=
    (le_totalDegree hs).trans ((mem_restrictTotalDegree σ n p).mp hp)
  rw [← mul_one (p.coeff s), ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_monomial, map_smul, map_smul, h s hdeg]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.z_mem_restrictTotalDegree
statement:
lemma z_mem_restrictTotalDegree {s : σ →₀ ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : s.degree ≤ n) :
    z R σ s ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_restrictTotalDegree]
  exact (totalDegree_monomial_le s 1).trans h

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.restrictTotalDegree_mono
statement:
lemma restrictTotalDegree_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    restrictTotalDegree σ R m ≤ restrictTotalDegree σ R n
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [mem_restrictTotalDegree] at hp ⊢
  exact hp.trans h

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.actAux_succ
statement:
lemma actAux_succ (n : ℕ) (i : σ) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    actAux b (n + 1) i s =
      if h : LeAll i s then z R σ (s + single i 1) else
        opAux b n (b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)))
          (opAux b n (b i) (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1)) -
            z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1 + single i 1)) +
          z R σ (s + single i 1) +
          opAux b n ⁅b i, b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h))⁆
            (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [actAux]; rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_basis_z
statement: lemma rho_basis_z (i : σ) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) : rho b (b i) (z R σ s) = actAux b s.degree i s
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.constr_apply_apply_eq
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Basis.constr_apply, Finsupp.sum, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, h]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.actAux_spec
statement:
lemma actAux_spec (m : ℕ) : ∀ s : σ →₀ ℕ, s.degree = m → ∀ i : σ,
    (∀ n, m ≤ n → actAux b n i s = rho b (b i) (z R σ s)) ∧
      rho b (b i) (z R σ s) - z R σ (s + single i 1) ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
  intro s hs i
  
  have hop : ∀ k, k < m → ∀ n, k ≤ n → ∀ x : L, ∀ p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R k,
      opAux b n x p = rho b x p := by
    intro k hk n hkn x p hp
    refine constr_apply_apply_eq b (fun l ↦ ?_) x
    refine eq_of_mem_restrictTotalDegree (fun u hu ↦ ?_) hp
    rw [extend_z, extend_z]
    rw [(ih u.degree (lt_of_le_of_lt hu hk) u rfl l).1 n (hu.trans hkn), rho_basis_z]
  have hmem : ∀ k, k < m → ∀ x : L, ∀ p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R k,
      rho b x p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk x p hp
    have : ∀ l, ∀ u : σ →₀ ℕ, u.degree ≤ k →
        rho b (b l) (z R σ u) ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R (k + 1) := by
      intro l u hu
      have h1 := (ih u.degree (lt_of_le_of_lt hu hk) u rfl l).2
      have h2 : z R σ (u + single l 1) ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R (k + 1) :=
        z_mem_restrictTotalDegree (by rw [map_add, degree_single]; omega)
      have := add_mem (restrictTotalDegree_mono (by omega) h1) h2
      rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
    rw [← b.linearCombination_repr x, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
      map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    rw [p.as_sum, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun u hu ↦ ?_
    rw [← mul_one (p.coeff u), ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_monomial, map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (this l u ((le_totalDegree hu).trans ((mem_restrictTotalDegree σ k p).mp hp)))
  by_cases hle : LeAll i s
  · have hval : ∀ n, actAux b n i s = z R σ (s + single i 1) := by
      intro n; cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => rw [actAux_succ, dite_eq_left hle]
    refine ⟨fun n _ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [rho_basis_z, hval, hval]
    · rw [rho_basis_z, hval, sub_self]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · have hne := support_nonempty_of_not_leAll hle
    set j := minIdx s hne
    set t := s - single j 1
    have htdeg : t.degree + 1 = m := hs ▸ degree_sub_single_minIdx s hne
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨t.degree, htdeg.symm⟩
    have htk : t.degree = k := by omega
    have ht := ih k (by omega) t htk i
    have hzt : z R σ t ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R k := z_mem_restrictTotalDegree htk.le
    
    have hval : ∀ n, k ≤ n → actAux b (n + 1) i s =
        rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ t) - z R σ (t + single i 1)) + z R σ (s + single i 1) +
          rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t) := by
      intro n hn
      rw [actAux_succ, dite_eq_right hle]
      change opAux b n (b j) (opAux b n (b i) (z R σ t) - z R σ (t + single i 1)) +
        z R σ (s + single i 1) + opAux b n ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t) = _
      rw [hop k (by omega) n hn _ _ hzt, hop k (by omega) n hn _ _ ht.2,
        hop k (by omega) n hn _ _ hzt]
    have hrho : rho b (b i) (z R σ s) = rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ t) -
        z R σ (t + single i 1)) + z R σ (s + single i 1) + rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t) := by
      rw [rho_basis_z, hs, hval k le_rfl]
    refine ⟨fun n hn ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = n' + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [hval n (by omega), hrho]
    · have := add_mem (hmem k (by omega) (b j) _ ht.2) (hmem k (by omega) ⁅b i, b j⁆ _ hzt)
      rw [hrho, show ∀ a c d : MvPolynomial σ R, a + c + d - c = a + d from fun a c d ↦ by abel]
      exact this

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_of_leAll
statement:
lemma rho_of_leAll {i : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : LeAll i s) :
    rho b (b i) (z R σ s) = z R σ (s + single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho_basis_z]
  cases hs : s.degree with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n => rw [actAux_succ, dite_eq_left h]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_sub_mem
statement:
lemma rho_sub_mem (i : σ) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    rho b (b i) (z R σ s) - z R σ (s + single i 1) ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R s.degree
proof:
:=
  (actAux_spec b s.degree s rfl i).2

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_mem
statement:
lemma rho_mem (k : ℕ) (x : L) {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R k) :
    rho b x p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ l, ∀ u : σ →₀ ℕ, u.degree ≤ k →
      rho b (b l) (z R σ u) ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R (k + 1) := by
    intro l u hu
    have h2 : z R σ (u + single l 1) ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R (k + 1) :=
      z_mem_restrictTotalDegree (by rw [map_add, degree_single]; omega)
    have := add_mem (restrictTotalDegree_mono (by omega) (rho_sub_mem b l u)) h2
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
  rw [← b.linearCombination_repr x, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  rw [p.as_sum, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun u hu ↦ ?_
  rw [← mul_one (p.coeff u), ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_monomial, map_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (this l u ((le_totalDegree hu).trans ((mem_restrictTotalDegree σ k p).mp hp)))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_of_not_leAll
statement:
lemma rho_of_not_leAll {i : σ} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : ¬ LeAll i s) :
    rho b (b i) (z R σ s) =
      rho b (b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)))
          (rho b (b i) (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1)) -
            z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1 + single i 1)) +
        z R σ (s + single i 1) +
        rho b ⁅b i, b (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h))⁆
          (z R σ (s - single (minIdx s (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h)) 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hne := support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h
  set j := minIdx s hne
  set t := s - single j 1
  have htdeg : t.degree + 1 = s.degree := degree_sub_single_minIdx s hne
  have hzt : z R σ t ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R t.degree := z_mem_restrictTotalDegree le_rfl
  have hop : ∀ x : L, ∀ p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R t.degree,
      opAux b t.degree x p = rho b x p := by
    intro x p hp
    refine constr_apply_apply_eq b (fun l ↦ ?_) x
    refine eq_of_mem_restrictTotalDegree (fun u hu ↦ ?_) hp
    rw [extend_z, extend_z, (actAux_spec b u.degree u rfl l).1 _ hu, rho_basis_z]
  rw [rho_basis_z, ← htdeg, actAux_succ, dite_eq_right h]
  change opAux b t.degree (b j) (opAux b t.degree (b i) (z R σ t) - z R σ (t + single i 1)) +
    z R σ (s + single i 1) + opAux b t.degree ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t) = _
  rw [hop _ _ hzt, hop _ _ (rho_sub_mem b i t), hop _ _ hzt]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_add_single_of_lt
