statement:
lemma rho_add_single_of_lt {i j : σ} {t : σ →₀ ℕ} (ht : LeAll j t) (hji : j < i) :
    rho b (b i) (z R σ (t + single j 1)) =
      rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ t) - z R σ (t + single i 1)) +
        z R σ (t + single j 1 + single i 1) + rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t)
proof:
:= by
  have h := not_leAll_add_single (t := t) hji
  rw [rho_of_not_leAll b h]
  have hj : minIdx (t + single j 1) (support_nonempty_of_not_leAll h) = j :=
    minIdx_add_single ht _
  simp only [hj, add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.comm_of_leAll
statement:
lemma comm_of_leAll {i j : σ} {t : σ →₀ ℕ} (ht : LeAll j t) (hji : j < i) :
    rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) (z R σ t)) - rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ t)) =
      rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho_of_leAll b ht, rho_add_single_of_lt b ht hji, map_sub,
    rho_of_leAll b (leAll_add_single ht hji.le), add_right_comm t (single i 1)]
  abel

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.comm_of_basis
statement:
lemma comm_of_basis {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : ∀ i j, rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) p) - rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) p) =
      rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ p) (x y : L) :
    rho b x (rho b y p) - rho b y (rho b x p) = rho b ⁅x, y⁆ p
proof:
:= by
  let F : L →ₗ[R] L →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R := LinearMap.mk₂ R
    (fun x y ↦ rho b x (rho b y p) - rho b y (rho b x p) - rho b ⁅x, y⁆ p)
    (fun x₁ x₂ y ↦ by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, add_lie]; abel)
    (fun c x y ↦ by simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_lie, smul_sub])
    (fun x y₁ y₂ ↦ by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, lie_add]; abel)
    (fun c x y ↦ by simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, lie_smul, smul_sub])
  have : F = 0 := b.ext fun i ↦ b.ext fun j ↦ by simp [F, h i j]
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun₂ this x y
  simpa [F, sub_eq_zero] using this

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rho_comm
statement:
lemma rho_comm (m : ℕ) : ∀ t : σ →₀ ℕ, t.degree = m → ∀ x y : L,
    rho b x (rho b y (z R σ t)) - rho b y (rho b x (z R σ t)) = rho b ⁅x, y⁆ (z R σ t)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
  intro t htm
  
  have ih' : ∀ k, k < m → ∀ p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R k, ∀ x y : L,
      rho b x (rho b y p) - rho b y (rho b x p) = rho b ⁅x, y⁆ p := by
    intro k hk p hp x y
    have := eq_of_mem_restrictTotalDegree (n := k)
      (f := (rho b x).comp (rho b y) - (rho b y).comp (rho b x)) (g := rho b ⁅x, y⁆)
      (fun u hu ↦ by simpa using ih u.degree (lt_of_le_of_lt hu hk) u rfl x y) hp
    simpa using this
  refine comm_of_basis b fun i j ↦ ?_
  
  have hcase : ∀ i j : σ, LeAll j t →
      rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) (z R σ t)) - rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ t)) =
        rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ t) := by
    intro i j hj
    rcases lt_trichotomy j i with hji | rfl | hij
    · exact comm_of_leAll b hj hji
    · simp
    · have := comm_of_leAll b (leAll_of_le hj hij.le) hij
      rw [← lie_skew, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, ← this]
      abel
  by_cases hj : LeAll j t
  · exact hcase i j hj
  by_cases hi : LeAll i t
  · have := hcase j i hi
    rw [← lie_skew, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, ← this]
    abel
  
  have hne := support_nonempty_of_not_leAll hi
  set ν := minIdx t hne
  set ψ := t - single ν 1
  have hνi : ν < i := minIdx_lt hi
  have hνj : ν < j := by
    have := minIdx_lt hj
    exact this
  have hψ : LeAll ν ψ := leAll_minIdx t hne
  have htψ : ψ + single ν 1 = t := sub_add_single_minIdx t hne
  have hψdeg : ψ.degree + 1 = m := htm ▸ degree_sub_single_minIdx t hne
  have hzt : z R σ t = rho b (b ν) (z R σ ψ) := by rw [rho_of_leAll b hψ, htψ]
  have hzψ : z R σ ψ ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R ψ.degree := z_mem_restrictTotalDegree le_rfl
  have ihψ := ih' ψ.degree (by omega)
  
  have key : ∀ a c : σ, ν < a → ν < c →
      rho b (b a) (rho b (b ν) (rho b (b c) (z R σ ψ))) =
        rho b (b ν) (rho b (b a) (rho b (b c) (z R σ ψ))) +
          rho b ⁅b a, b ν⁆ (rho b (b c) (z R σ ψ)) := by
    intro a c hνa hνc
    set w := rho b (b c) (z R σ ψ) - z R σ (ψ + single c 1)
    have hw : w ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R ψ.degree := rho_sub_mem b c ψ
    have hsplit : rho b (b c) (z R σ ψ) = z R σ (ψ + single c 1) + w := by
      simp [w]
    have h1 := comm_of_leAll b (leAll_add_single hψ hνc.le) hνa
    have h2 := ihψ w hw (b a) (b ν)
    rw [hsplit, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add]
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
    abel
  
  have hX : ∀ a : σ, ν < a → rho b (b a) (z R σ t) =
      rho b (b ν) (rho b (b a) (z R σ ψ)) + rho b ⁅b a, b ν⁆ (z R σ ψ) := by
    intro a hνa
    have := comm_of_leAll b hψ hνa
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at this
    rw [hzt, this, add_comm]
  have e1 : rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) (z R σ t)) =
      rho b (b ν) (rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) (z R σ ψ))) +
        rho b ⁅b i, b ν⁆ (rho b (b j) (z R σ ψ)) +
        rho b (b i) (rho b ⁅b j, b ν⁆ (z R σ ψ)) := by
    rw [hX j hνj, map_add, key i j hνi hνj]
  have e2 : rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ t)) =
      rho b (b ν) (rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ ψ))) +
        rho b ⁅b j, b ν⁆ (rho b (b i) (z R σ ψ)) +
        rho b (b j) (rho b ⁅b i, b ν⁆ (z R σ ψ)) := by
    rw [hX i hνi, map_add, key j i hνj hνi]
  have c1 := ihψ _ hzψ (b i) (b j)
  have c2 := ihψ _ hzψ ⁅b i, b ν⁆ (b j)
  have c3 := ihψ _ hzψ (b i) ⁅b j, b ν⁆
  have c4 := ihψ _ hzψ (b ν) ⁅b i, b j⁆
  have jac : ⁅b ν, ⁅b i, b j⁆⁆ + ⁅⁅b i, b ν⁆, b j⁆ + ⁅b i, ⁅b j, b ν⁆⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [lie_lie, ← lie_skew (b ν) (b j), lie_neg]
    abel
  have jac' : rho b ⁅b ν, ⁅b i, b j⁆⁆ (z R σ ψ) + rho b ⁅⁅b i, b ν⁆, b j⁆ (z R σ ψ) +
      rho b ⁅b i, ⁅b j, b ν⁆⁆ (z R σ ψ) = 0 := by
    rw [← LinearMap.add_apply, ← LinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add, ← map_add, jac]
    simp
  have c5 : rho b (b ν) (rho b (b i) (rho b (b j) (z R σ ψ))) =
      rho b (b ν) (rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (z R σ ψ)) +
        rho b (b ν) (rho b (b j) (rho b (b i) (z R σ ψ))) := by
    rw [← c1, map_sub]; abel
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at c2 c3 c4
  rw [e1, e2, hzt, c5, c4, c2, c3]
  calc _ = rho b ⁅b i, b j⁆ (rho b (b ν) (z R σ ψ)) +
        (rho b ⁅b ν, ⁅b i, b j⁆⁆ (z R σ ψ) + rho b ⁅⁅b i, b ν⁆, b j⁆ (z R σ ψ) +
          rho b ⁅b i, ⁅b j, b ν⁆⁆ (z R σ ψ)) := by abel
    _ = _ := by rw [jac', add_zero]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.rhoHom_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma rhoHom_apply (x : L) : rhoHom b x = rho b x
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.phi_z
statement: @[simp] lemma phi_z (s : σ →₀ ℕ) : phi b (z R σ s) = pbwMonomial R b s
proof: := extend_z _ s

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.phi_rho
statement:
lemma phi_rho (m : ℕ) : ∀ s : σ →₀ ℕ, s.degree = m → ∀ x : L,
    phi b (rho b x (z R σ s)) = ι R x * phi b (z R σ s)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
  intro s hsm
  have ih' : ∀ k, k < m → ∀ p ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R k, ∀ x : L,
      phi b (rho b x p) = ι R x * phi b p := by
    intro k hk p hp x
    have := eq_of_mem_restrictTotalDegree (n := k)
      (f := phi b ∘ₗ rho b x) (g := LinearMap.mulLeft R (ι R x) ∘ₗ phi b)
      (fun u hu ↦ by simpa using ih u.degree (lt_of_le_of_lt hu hk) u rfl x) hp
    simpa using this
  
  suffices h : ∀ i, phi b (rho b (b i) (z R σ s)) = ι R (b i) * phi b (z R σ s) by
    intro x
    have := b.ext (f₁ := phi b ∘ₗ (LinearMap.applyₗ (z R σ s) ∘ₗ rho b))
      (f₂ := LinearMap.mulRight R (phi b (z R σ s)) ∘ₗ (ι R : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ _).toLinearMap)
      (fun i ↦ by simpa using h i)
    simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun this x
  intro i
  by_cases hle : LeAll i s
  · rw [rho_of_leAll b hle, phi_z, phi_z, pbwMonomial_add_single hle]
  · have hne := support_nonempty_of_not_leAll hle
    have hrec := rho_of_not_leAll b hle
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, minIdx s hne = j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, htdef⟩ : ∃ t, s - single j 1 = t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hj, htdef] at hrec
    have hts : t + single j 1 = s := by rw [← htdef, ← hj]; exact sub_add_single_minIdx s hne
    have ht : LeAll j t := by rw [← htdef, ← hj]; exact leAll_minIdx s hne
    have htdeg : t.degree + 1 = m := by
      rw [← hsm, ← htdef, ← hj]; exact degree_sub_single_minIdx s hne
    have hji : j < i := hj ▸ minIdx_lt hle
    have ih'' := ih' t.degree (by omega)
    have hzt : z R σ t ∈ restrictTotalDegree σ R t.degree := z_mem_restrictTotalDegree le_rfl
    rw [hrec]
    simp only [map_add]
    rw [ih'' _ (rho_sub_mem b i t), map_sub, ih'' _ hzt (b i), ih'' _ hzt ⁅b i, b j⁆]
    rw [← hts]
    simp only [phi_z]
    rw [pbwMonomial_add_single ht,
      add_right_comm t (single j 1), pbwMonomial_add_single (leAll_add_single ht hji.le),
      LieHom.map_lie, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket]
    noncomm_ring

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.phi_lift
statement:
lemma phi_lift (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    phi b (lift R (rhoHom b) u p) = u * phi b p
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (mkAlgHom R L) := by
    intro u
    induction u using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | h a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hsurj u
  induction a using TensorAlgebra.induction generalizing p with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
      map_smul]
  | ι x =>
    have : mkAlgHom R L (TensorAlgebra.ι R x) = ι R x := rfl
    rw [this, lift_ι_apply, rhoHom_apply]
    refine eq_of_mem_restrictTotalDegree (n := p.totalDegree)
      (f := phi b ∘ₗ rho b x) (g := LinearMap.mulLeft R (ι R x) ∘ₗ phi b)
      (fun u _ ↦ by simpa using phi_rho b u.degree u rfl x)
      ((mem_restrictTotalDegree σ _ p).mpr le_rfl)
  | add a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, h₁, h₂, add_mul]
  | mul a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, h₁, h₂, mul_assoc]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.lift_pbwMonomial
statement:
lemma lift_pbwMonomial (m : ℕ) : ∀ s : σ →₀ ℕ, s.degree = m →
    lift R (rhoHom b) (pbwMonomial R b s) 1 = z R σ s
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro s hs
    rw [degree_eq_zero_iff] at hs
    subst hs
    simp only [pbwMonomial_zero, map_one, Module.End.one_apply]
    rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro s hs
    have hne : s.support.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, Finsupp.support_eq_empty]
      rintro rfl; simp at hs
    have hts := sub_add_single_minIdx s hne
    have ht := leAll_minIdx s hne
    have htdeg := degree_sub_single_minIdx s hne
    rw [← hts, pbwMonomial_add_single ht, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ih _ (by omega),
      lift_ι_apply, rhoHom_apply, rho_of_leAll b ht]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv_symm_monomial
statement:
@[simp] lemma pbwEquiv_symm_monomial (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (pbwEquiv b).symm (monomial s 1) = pbwMonomial R b s
proof:
:=
  phi_z b s

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv_pbwMonomial
statement:
@[simp] lemma pbwEquiv_pbwMonomial (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    pbwEquiv b (pbwMonomial R b s) = monomial s 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pbwEquiv_symm_monomial, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwBasis_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem pbwBasis_apply (s : σ →₀ ℕ) : pbwBasis b s = pbwMonomial R b s
proof:
:= by
  simp [pbwBasis]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwMonomial_single
statement: lemma pbwMonomial_single (i : σ) : pbwMonomial R b (single i 1) = ι R (b i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using pbwMonomial_add_single (R := R) (v := b) (leAll_zero i)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv_ι_basis
statement: theorem pbwEquiv_ι_basis (i : σ) : pbwEquiv b (ι R (b i)) = X i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pbwMonomial_single, pbwEquiv_pbwMonomial, X]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_injective_of_basis
statement:
theorem ι_injective_of_basis (b : Basis σ R L) :
    Function.Injective (ι R : L → UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hF : ∀ i, (MvPolynomial.lcoeff R (single i 1)).comp
      ((pbwEquiv b).toLinearMap.comp (ι R : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ _).toLinearMap) = b.coord i := fun i ↦
    b.ext fun j ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap,
        LinearEquiv.coe_coe, pbwEquiv_ι_basis, lcoeff_apply, coeff_X, Basis.coord_apply,
        Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_left_inj one_ne_zero]
  apply b.repr.injective
  ext i
  have := congr_arg (fun u ↦ (pbwEquiv b u).coeff (single i 1)) h
  rw [← Basis.coord_apply, ← Basis.coord_apply, ← hF i]
  simpa using this

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_injective
statement:
theorem ι_injective [Module.Free R L] :
    Function.Injective (ι R : L → UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R L
  let : LinearOrder (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R L) :=
    IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  exact ι_injective_of_basis b

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.AdRegular.equiv_lie
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_lie (x : L) (u : AdRegular R L) :
    equiv R L ⁅x, u⁆ = ι R x * equiv R L u - equiv R L u * ι R x
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.actionHom_ι
statement: theorem actionHom_ι (x : L) : actionHom (R := R) (L := L) M (ι R x) = toEnd R L M x
proof:
:=
  lift_ι_apply R _ x

name: LieModuleHom.map_actionHom
statement:
theorem _root_.LieModuleHom.map_actionHom (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (u : 𝓤) (m : M) :
    f (actionHom M u m) = actionHom N u (f m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, mkAlgHom R L t = u := by
    induction u using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | h a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  induction t using TensorAlgebra.induction generalizing m with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | ι x => simp
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
      ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
      map_add, ha, hb]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.quotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientEquiv_mk (u : AdRegular R L) :
    quotientEquiv R L I (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u) =
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk ((LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm (AdRegular.equiv R L u))
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.quotientAction_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientAction_mk (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (u : AdRegular R L) :
    quotientAction hM (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u) = actionHom M (AdRegular.equiv R L u)
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.quotientAction_lie
statement:
theorem quotientAction_lie (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (x : L) (q : AdQuotient R L I) (m : M) :
    quotientAction hM ⁅x, q⁆ m =
      ⁅x, quotientAction hM q m⁆ - quotientAction hM q ⁅x, m⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H u =>
    change actionHom M (AdRegular.equiv R L ⁅x, u⁆) m = _
    rw [AdRegular.equiv_lie, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, actionHom_ι]
    rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.orbitMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbitMap_mk (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (m : M) (u : LeftRegular R L) :
    orbitMap hM m (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u) = actionHom M (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) m
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.quotientAction_flip_eq
statement:
theorem quotientAction_flip_eq (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (m : M) :
    (quotientAction hM).flip m =
      (orbitMap hM m : LeftQuotient R L I →ₗ[R] M) ∘ₗ (quotientEquiv R L I).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext m'
  induction m' using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H u => rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.actionHom_leftQuotient_mk
statement:
theorem actionHom_leftQuotient_mk (a : 𝓤) (u : LeftRegular R L) :
    actionHom (LeftQuotient R L I) a (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u) =
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk ((LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm (a * LeftRegular.equiv R L u))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, mkAlgHom R L t = a := by
    induction a using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | h a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  induction t using TensorAlgebra.induction generalizing u with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    rfl
  | ι x =>
    change actionHom _ (ι R x) _ = _
    rw [actionHom_ι]
    rfl
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, ha, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, add_mul]
    rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.isKilledBy_leftQuotient
statement: theorem isKilledBy_leftQuotient : IsKilledBy I (LeftQuotient R L I)
proof:
:= fun a ha ↦ by
  ext q
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H u =>
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, actionHom_leftQuotient_mk]
    exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero' (N := leftIdeal R L I)).mpr
      (I.mul_mem_right _ _ ha)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.quotientMulRight_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientMulRight_mk (u : 𝓤) (v : LeftRegular R L) :
    quotientMulRight I u (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk v) =
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk ((LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm (LeftRegular.equiv R L v * u))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lie_rTensor_quotientAction
statement:
theorem lie_rTensor_quotientAction (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (x : L) (m : M)
    (t : AdQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W) :
    ⁅x, ((quotientAction hM).flip m).rTensor W t⁆ =
      ((quotientAction hM).flip ⁅x, m⁆).rTensor W t +
        ((quotientAction hM).flip m).rTensor W ⁅x, t⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, lie_add, hs, ht, lie_add, map_add, map_add]; abel
  | tmul q w =>
    simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.flip_apply, LieModule.lie_tmul_right,
      map_add, quotientAction_lie]
    rw [sub_tmul]
    abel

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorNatMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorNatMap_tmul (g : V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ AdQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W)
    (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (m : M) (v : V) :
    tensorNatMap g hM (m ⊗ₜ v) = ((quotientAction hM).flip m).rTensor W (g v)
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorNatMap_naturality
statement:
theorem tensorNatMap_naturality (g : V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ AdQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W)
    (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (hN : IsKilledBy I N) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (t : M ⊗[R] V) :
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N).rTensor W (tensorNatMap g hM t) =
      tensorNatMap g hN ((f : M →ₗ[R] N).rTensor V t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add, map_add]
  | tmul m v =>
    rw [tensorNatMap_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, tensorNatMap_tmul,
      ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp]
    congr 2
    ext q
    induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | H u => exact f.map_actionHom _ m

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.rTensor_quotientEquiv_symm_lie
statement:
theorem rTensor_quotientEquiv_symm_lie (x : L) (t : LeftQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W) :
    ((quotientEquiv R L I).symm.toLinearMap.rTensor W) ⁅x, t⁆ -
        ((quotientEquiv R L I).symm.toLinearMap.rTensor W)
          ((quotientMulRight I (ι R x) : LeftQuotient R L I →ₗ[R] _).rTensor W t) =
      ⁅x, (quotientEquiv R L I).symm.toLinearMap.rTensor W t⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | add s t hs ht =>
    simp only [lie_add, map_add]
    rw [← hs, ← ht]
    abel
  | tmul q w =>
    induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | H u =>
      simp only [LieModule.lie_tmul_right, map_add, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
        LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, quotientMulRight_mk]
      rw [add_sub_right_comm, ← sub_tmul]
      rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.evalNat_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalNat_apply
    (ψ : LeftQuotient R L I ⊗[R] V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ LeftQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W) (hψ) (v : V) :
    evalNat ψ hψ v = (quotientEquiv R L I).symm.toLinearMap.rTensor W
      (ψ (quotientOne I ⊗ₜ v))
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.evalNat_tensorNatMap
statement:
theorem evalNat_tensorNatMap (g : V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ AdQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W) :
    evalNat (tensorNatMap g (isKilledBy_leftQuotient I)) (fun u t ↦
      tensorNatMap_naturality g _ _ (quotientMulRight I u) t) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [evalNat_apply, tensorNatMap_tmul, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp]
  convert LinearMap.rTensor_id_apply (x := g v)
  ext q
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H u =>
    change (quotientEquiv R L I).symm (actionHom (LeftQuotient R L I) (AdRegular.equiv R L u)
      (quotientOne I)) = LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk u
    rw [actionHom_leftQuotient_mk]
    change (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk ((AdRegular.equiv R L).symm (AdRegular.equiv R L u * 1)) :
      AdQuotient R L I) = _
    rw [mul_one]
    rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorNatMap_evalNat
statement:
theorem tensorNatMap_evalNat
    (ψ : LeftQuotient R L I ⊗[R] V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ LeftQuotient R L I ⊗[R] W) (hψ)
    (hM : IsKilledBy I M) (ψM : M ⊗[R] V →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M ⊗[R] W)
    (hnat : ∀ (m : M) (t : LeftQuotient R L I ⊗[R] V),
      (orbitMap hM m : LeftQuotient R L I →ₗ[R] M).rTensor W (ψ t) =
        ψM ((orbitMap hM m : LeftQuotient R L I →ₗ[R] M).rTensor V t)) :
    tensorNatMap (evalNat ψ hψ) hM = ψM
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  induction t with
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht]
  | tmul m v =>
    have hm : orbitMap hM m (quotientOne I) = m := by
      rw [orbitMap_mk]
      change actionHom M 1 m = m
      rw [map_one, Module.End.one_apply]
    rw [tensorNatMap_tmul, evalNat_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp,
      quotientAction_flip_eq, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    rw [show (quotientEquiv R L I).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientEquiv R L I).symm.toLinearMap =
        LinearMap.id from by ext; simp, LinearMap.comp_id, hnat, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
      LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, hm]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.mem
statement: lemma mem (h : HasSymbol k s u) : u ∈ filtration R L k

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.of_mem
statement: lemma of_mem (h : u ∈ filtration R L k) : HasSymbol k (toGr R L k ⟨u, h⟩) u
proof: := ⟨h, rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.unique
statement: lemma unique (hs : HasSymbol k s u) (ht : HasSymbol k t u) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨h', rfl⟩ := ht
  rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.mul
statement: lemma mul (hu : HasSymbol m s u) (hw : HasSymbol n t w) : HasSymbol (m + n) (s * t) (u * w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, rfl⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨hw, rfl⟩ := hw
  exact ⟨mul_mem_filtration hu hw, (toGr_mul ⟨u, hu⟩ ⟨w, hw⟩).symm⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.one
statement: lemma one : HasSymbol 0 1 (1 : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)
proof:
:=
  ⟨one_mem_filtration 0, toGr_zero_one⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.pow
statement: lemma pow (hu : HasSymbol m s u) (q : ℕ) : HasSymbol (m * q) (s ^ q) (u ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => simpa using (one : HasSymbol 0 1 (1 : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L))
  | succ q ih => simpa [pow_succ, Nat.mul_succ] using ih.mul hu

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.congr_deg
statement: lemma congr_deg (h : HasSymbol k s u) (hk : k = m) : HasSymbol m s u
proof: := hk ▸ h

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.smul
statement: lemma smul (h : HasSymbol k s u) (c : R) : HasSymbol k (c • s) (c • u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ c hu, by rw [← map_smul]; rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.sub
statement: lemma sub (hu : HasSymbol k s u) (hw : HasSymbol k t w) : HasSymbol k (s - t) (u - w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, rfl⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨hw, rfl⟩ := hw
  exact ⟨sub_mem hu hw, by rw [← map_sub]; rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.add
statement: lemma add (hu : HasSymbol k s u) (hw : HasSymbol k t w) : HasSymbol k (s + t) (u + w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, rfl⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨hw, rfl⟩ := hw
  exact ⟨add_mem hu hw, by rw [← map_add]; rfl⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.zero_of_mem
statement: lemma zero_of_mem (h : u ∈ filtration R L k) : HasSymbol (k + 1) 0 u
proof:
:=
  ⟨filtration_mono (Nat.le_succ k) h, (toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff _).mpr h⟩

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.sub_mem
statement:
lemma sub_mem (hu : HasSymbol (k + 1) s u) (hw : HasSymbol (k + 1) s w) :
    u - w ∈ filtration R L k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, h0⟩ := hu.sub hw
  rw [sub_self] at h0
  exact (toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff ⟨u - w, h⟩).mp h0

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.of_sub_mem
statement:
lemma of_sub_mem (hw : HasSymbol (k + 1) s w) (h : u - w ∈ filtration R L k) :
    HasSymbol (k + 1) s u
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (zero_of_mem h).add hw

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.ne_zero
statement: lemma ne_zero (h : HasSymbol k s u) (hs : s ≠ 0) : u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨h0, rfl⟩ := h
  exact hs (by rw [show (⟨0, h0⟩ : filtration R L k) = 0 from rfl, map_zero])

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.HasSymbol.not_mem
statement: lemma not_mem (h : HasSymbol (k + 1) s u) (hs : s ≠ 0) : u ∉ filtration R L k
proof:
:= fun hu ↦
  hs (by obtain ⟨h', rfl⟩ := h; exact (toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff _).mpr hu)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.hasSymbol_ι
statement: lemma hasSymbol_ι (x : L) : HasSymbol 1 (toGr R L 1 ⟨ι R x, ι_mem_filtration_one x⟩) (ι R x)
proof:
:=
  HasSymbol.of_mem _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.toGr_ι_ne_zero
statement:
lemma toGr_ι_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] [Module.Free R L] {x : L} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    toGr R L 1 ⟨ι R x, ι_mem_filtration_one x⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, toGr_succ_eq_zero_iff, mem_filtration_zero]
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have h := congrArg (lift R (0 : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ R)) hr
  rw [AlgHom.commutes, lift_ι_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply,
    zero_apply] at h
  rw [h, map_zero] at hr
  exact hx (ι_injective R L (by rw [map_zero]; exact hr.symm))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_filtration_of_mul_pow_mem
statement:
theorem mem_filtration_of_mul_pow_mem [NoZeroDivisors R] [Module.Free R L]
    {y : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L} {t : AssociatedGraded R L} (hy : HasSymbol 1 t y)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) {u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L} {m q : ℕ}
    (h : u * y ^ q ∈ filtration R L (m + q)) : u ∈ filtration R L m
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hum
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hum (Submodule.zero_mem _)
  obtain ⟨e, he, hne⟩ := exists_toGr_ne_zero hu0
  have hme : m < e := by
    by_contra hle
    exact hum (filtration_mono (not_lt.mp hle) he)
  have hsym := (HasSymbol.of_mem he).mul (hy.pow q)
  rw [one_mul] at hsym
  obtain ⟨e', rfl⟩ : ∃ e', e = e' + 1 := ⟨e - 1, by omega⟩
  have hsym' : HasSymbol (e' + q + 1) _ (u * y ^ q) := hsym.congr_deg (by omega)
  exact hsym'.not_mem (mul_ne_zero hne (pow_ne_zero q ht))
    (filtration_mono (by omega) h)

name: LieHom.eq_of_map_eq
statement: lemma eq_of_map_eq {x y : L} (hxy : f x = f y) : g x = g y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub]
  exact hg _ (by rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self])

name: LieHom.descend_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma descend_apply (x : L) : descend hf g hg (f x) = g x
proof:
:=
  eq_of_map_eq g hg (surjInv_eq hf (f x))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_span_of_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_span_of_map_eq_zero (hf : Surjective f) {u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L}
    (hu : map f u = 0) : u ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span (ι R '' {x | f x = 0})
proof:
:= by
  set J := TwoSidedIdeal.span (ι R '' {x | f x = 0})
  let q := RingCon.mkₐ R J.ringCon
  have hq : ∀ v, q v = 0 ↔ v ∈ J := fun v ↦ by
    rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_iff, ← RingCon.eq]
    rfl
  let g : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ J.ringCon.Quotient := (q : _ →ₗ⁅R⁆ _).comp (ι R)
  have hg : ∀ x, f x = 0 → g x = 0 := fun x hx ↦
    (hq _).mpr (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  let ψ := lift R (LieHom.descend hf g hg)
  have : ψ.comp (map f) = q := hom_ext R (LieHom.ext fun x ↦ by
    change ψ (map f (ι R x)) = q (ι R x)
    rw [map_ι, lift_ι_apply, LieHom.descend_apply]
    rfl)
  rw [← hq, ← this, AlgHom.comp_apply, hu, map_zero]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ker_map_eq_span
statement:
theorem ker_map_eq_span (hf : Surjective f) :
    TwoSidedIdeal.ker (map f) = TwoSidedIdeal.span (ι R '' {x | f x = 0})
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun u hu ↦ mem_span_of_map_eq_zero hf ((TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).mp hu)) ?_
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker, map_ι, hx, map_zero]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lieSubalgebra_smul_def
statement:
theorem lieSubalgebra_smul_def (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L')
    (v : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) :
    u • v = map L'.incl u * v
proof: := rfl

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.basisOfIsComplSubmodule_inl
statement:
theorem basisOfIsComplSubmodule_inl (i : σ₁) :
    basisOfIsComplSubmodule h b₁ b₂ (toLex (Sum.inl i)) = L'.incl (b₁ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisOfIsComplSubmodule, Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    Basis.map_apply, Basis.prod_apply]
  exact add_zero _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.basisOfIsComplSubmodule_inr
statement:
theorem basisOfIsComplSubmodule_inr (i : σ₂) :
    basisOfIsComplSubmodule h b₁ b₂ (toLex (Sum.inr i)) = b₂ i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisOfIsComplSubmodule, Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    Basis.map_apply, Basis.prod_apply]
  exact zero_add _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.map_pbwMonomial_mul_pbwMonomial
statement:
theorem map_pbwMonomial_mul_pbwMonomial (s₁ : σ₁ →₀ ℕ) (s₂ : σ₂ →₀ ℕ) :
    map L'.incl (pbwMonomial R b₁ s₁) * pbwMonomial R (fun i ↦ (b₂ i : L)) s₂ =
      pbwMonomial R (basisOfIsComplSubmodule h b₁ b₂) (lexFinsuppEquiv (s₁, s₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lexFinsuppEquiv_apply, pbwMonomial_mapDomain_add, map_pbwMonomial]
  congr 2 <;> ext i <;> simp [basisOfIsComplSubmodule_inl, basisOfIsComplSubmodule_inr]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.linearCombination_bijective
statement:
theorem linearCombination_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (Finsupp.linearCombination (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L')
      (pbwMonomial R (fun i ↦ (b₂ i : L))))
proof:
:= by
  let B := Finsupp.basis fun _ : σ₂ →₀ ℕ ↦ pbwBasis b₁
  let e : (Σ _ : σ₂ →₀ ℕ, σ₁ →₀ ℕ) ≃ (σ₁ ⊕ₗ σ₂ →₀ ℕ) :=
    ((Equiv.sigmaEquivProd _ _).trans (Equiv.prodComm _ _)).trans lexFinsuppEquiv
  have : (Finsupp.linearCombination (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L')
      (pbwMonomial R (fun i ↦ (b₂ i : L)))).restrictScalars R =
      (B.equiv (pbwBasis (basisOfIsComplSubmodule h b₁ b₂)) e : _ →ₗ[R] _) :=
    B.ext fun ⟨s₂, s₁⟩ ↦ by
      rw [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Basis.equiv_apply, pbwBasis_apply]
      simp only [B, coe_basis, pbwBasis_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars,
        linearCombination_single, lieSubalgebra_smul_def]
      exact map_pbwMonomial_mul_pbwMonomial h b₁ b₂ s₁ s₂
  rw [← LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars R, this]
  exact LinearEquiv.bijective _

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwBasisOfIsCompl_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pbwBasisOfIsCompl_apply [Module.Free R L'] (s : σ₂ →₀ ℕ) :
    pbwBasisOfIsCompl h b₂ s = pbwMonomial R (fun i ↦ (b₂ i : L)) s
proof:
:= by
  simp [pbwBasisOfIsCompl, Basis.coe_ofRepr]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.free_of_isCompl
statement:
theorem free_of_isCompl :
    Module.Free (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L') (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)
proof:
:=
  let : LinearOrder (Free.ChooseBasisIndex R V) := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  .of_basis (pbwBasisOfIsCompl h (Free.chooseBasis R V))

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_incl_injective_of_isCompl_submodule
statement: theorem map_incl_injective_of_isCompl_submodule : Function.Injective (map L'.incl)
proof:
:= by
  let : LinearOrder (Free.ChooseBasisIndex R V) := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  set B := pbwBasisOfIsCompl h (Free.chooseBasis R V)
  have h0 : B 0 = 1 := by rw [pbwBasisOfIsCompl_apply, pbwMonomial_zero]
  intro u u' e
  have := congr_arg (fun x ↦ B.repr x 0) (show u • B 0 = u' • B 0 by
    rw [h0, lieSubalgebra_smul_def, lieSubalgebra_smul_def, mul_one, mul_one, e])
  simpa using this

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_incl_injective
statement: theorem map_incl_injective : Function.Injective (map L'.incl)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, h⟩ := L'.toSubmodule.exists_isCompl
  map_incl_injective_of_isCompl_submodule h

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.wedgeP_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma wedgeP_tmul (x : L) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (p : P) :
    wedgeP (I := I) x (e ⊗ₜ[R] p) = (ι R x * e) ⊗ₜ[R] p
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.wedgeP_mem
statement:
lemma wedgeP_mem (x : L) {q n : ℕ} {z : EP}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) : wedgeP x z ∈ rectangle (q + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, p, hp, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [wedgeP_tmul]
    apply tmul_mem_rectangle _ hp
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ']
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x) he
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (rectangle (q + 1) n).zero_mem
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r z _ hz => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hz

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.pbwTensor_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma pbwTensor_tmul (e : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (u : U) :
    pbwTensor b (e ⊗ₜ[R] u) =
      e ⊗ₜ[R] UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv b (LeftRegular.equiv R L u)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.pbwTensor_wedge
statement:
lemma pbwTensor_wedge (x : L) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] U) :
    pbwTensor b (wedge R L U x c) = wedgeP x (pbwTensor b c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul e u => rfl
  | add c d hc hd => simp only [map_add, hc, hd]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.lieAction_error
statement:
lemma lieAction_error (x : L) (l : List I) (n : ℕ) (u : U)
    (hu : LeftRegular.equiv R L u ∈ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration R L n) :
    pbwTensor b (lieAction R L U x (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u)) -
      Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R]
        UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv b (LeftRegular.equiv R L ⁅x, u⁆) ∈
      rectangle l.length n
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [Koszul.basisWord]
  | cons i l ih =>
    change pbwTensor b (lieAction R L U x
      (wedge R L U (b i) (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u))) -
      wedgeP (b i) (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R]
        UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv b (LeftRegular.equiv R L ⁅x, u⁆)) ∈ _
    rw [lieAction_wedge, map_add, pbwTensor_wedge, pbwTensor_wedge,
      add_sub_assoc, ← map_sub]
    exact add_mem
      (wedgeP_mem _ (tmul_mem_rectangle (Koszul.basisWord_mem_exteriorPower b l)
        ((UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv b).mp hu)))
      (wedgeP_mem _ ih)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.delta_wedge
statement:
lemma delta_wedge (s : Finset I) (j : I) (hj : j ∈ s)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (p : P) :
    Koszul.delta b s ((ι R (b j) * e) ⊗ₜ[R] p) =
      e ⊗ₜ[R] (MvPolynomial.X j * p) - wedgeP (b j) (Koszul.delta b s (e ⊗ₜ[R] p))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change Koszul.delta b s (Koszul.wedge b j e ⊗ₜ[R] p) = _
  simp only [Koszul.delta, LinearMap.sum_apply, Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul,
    Koszul.contract_wedge,
    sub_tmul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, map_sum, wedgeP_tmul]
  simp only [Koszul.wedge_apply]
  congr 1
  simp [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply,
    TensorProduct.ite_tmul, hj]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.diff_add_delta_basisWord
statement:
theorem diff_add_delta_basisWord (s : Finset I) (l : List I)
    (hl : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ s) (n : ℕ) (u : U)
    (hu : LeftRegular.equiv R L u ∈ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration R L n) :
    pbwTensor b (diff R L U (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u)) +
      Koszul.delta b s (pbwTensor b (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u)) ∈
      rectangle (l.length - 1) n
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [Koszul.basisWord, Koszul.delta, Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul, Koszul.contract]
  | cons j l ih =>
    let p := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv b (LeftRegular.equiv R L u)
    have haction : pbwTensor b (lieAction R L U (b j)
        (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u)) -
        Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] (MvPolynomial.X j * p) ∈ rectangle l.length n := by
      have hc := tmul_mem_rectangle (Koszul.basisWord_mem_exteriorPower b l)
        (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv_ι_basis_mul_sub_mem b j n hu)
      rw [tmul_sub] at hc
      have ha := lieAction_error b (b j) l n u hu
      rw [LeftRegular.equiv_lie] at ha
      convert add_mem ha hc using 1
      abel
    have htail : wedgeP (b j)
        (pbwTensor b (diff R L U (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u)) +
          Koszul.delta b s (pbwTensor b (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u))) ∈
        rectangle l.length n := by
      cases l with
      | nil => simp [Koszul.basisWord, Koszul.delta, Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul, Koszul.contract]
      | cons i l =>
        exact wedgeP_mem _ (ih (fun i hi => hl i (List.mem_cons_of_mem j hi)))
    change pbwTensor b (diff R L U
      (wedge R L U (b j) (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u))) +
      Koszul.delta b s ((ι R (b j) * Koszul.basisWord b l) ⊗ₜ[R] p) ∈
      rectangle l.length n
    rw [diff_wedge, map_sub, map_neg, pbwTensor_wedge,
      delta_wedge b s j (hl j (by simp))]
    convert sub_mem (neg_mem haction) htail using 1
    simp only [map_add, pbwTensor_tmul]
    abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.polynomialDiff_add_delta_basisWord
statement:
theorem polynomialDiff_add_delta_basisWord (s : Finset I) (l : List I)
    (hl : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ s) (n : ℕ) (p : P)
    (hp : p ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree I R n) :
    polynomialDiff b (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p) +
      Koszul.delta b s (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p) ∈ rectangle (l.length - 1) n
proof:
:= by
  let u := (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm ((UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv b).symm p)
  have he : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv b (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) = p := by
    simp [u]
  have hu : LeftRegular.equiv R L u ∈ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration R L n :=
    (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_filtration_iff_pbwEquiv b).mpr (he ▸ hp)
  have ht : pbwTensor b (Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] u) =
      Koszul.basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p := by rw [pbwTensor_tmul, he]
  have h := diff_add_delta_basisWord b s l hl n u hu
  rw [← ht]
  simpa only [polynomialDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.polynomialDiff_add_delta_mem
statement:
theorem polynomialDiff_add_delta_mem (s : Finset I) (q n : ℕ) (z : EP)
    (hz : z ∈ supportedTensors b s q n) :
    polynomialDiff b z + Koszul.delta b s z ∈ rectangle (q - 1) n
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, p, hq, hl, hp, rfl⟩ := hz
    simpa only [hq] using polynomialDiff_add_delta_basisWord b s l hl n p hp
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    simpa only [map_add, add_add_add_comm] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r z _ hz =>
    simpa only [map_smul, smul_add] using Submodule.smul_mem (rectangle (q - 1) n) r hz

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.isLeadingKoszul_polynomialDiff
statement: theorem isLeadingKoszul_polynomialDiff : Koszul.IsLeadingKoszul b (polynomialDiff b)
proof:
:=
  fun s q n z hz ↦ polynomialDiff_add_delta_mem b s q n z hz

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.directSum_tensor_component
statement:
theorem directSum_tensor_component [DecidableEq I]
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] (⨁ i, M i)) (i : I) :
    directSumRight R R (ExteriorAlgebra R L) M z i =
      ((DirectSum.lieModuleComponent R I L M i).toLinearMap).lTensor _ z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul e m => exact directSumRight_tmul R R e m i
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, DirectSum.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.directSum_tensor_symm_of
statement:
theorem directSum_tensor_symm_of [DecidableEq I] (i : I)
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M i) :
    (directSumRight R R (ExteriorAlgebra R L) M).symm (DirectSum.of _ i z) =
      ((DirectSum.lieModuleOf R I L M i).toLinearMap).lTensor _ z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul e m =>
    change (directSumRight R R (ExteriorAlgebra R L) M).symm
      (DirectSum.lof R _ _ i (e ⊗ₜ[R] m)) = e ⊗ₜ[R] DirectSum.lof R _ _ i m
    exact directSumRight_symm_lof_tmul R R e i m
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.directSum_cycle_boundary
statement:
theorem directSum_cycle_boundary (q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, Subsingleton (homology R L (M i) q))
    {z : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] (⨁ i, M i)}
    (hz : z ∈ cycles R L (⨁ i, M i) q) :
    z ∈ boundaries R L (⨁ i, M i) q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := directSumRight R R (ExteriorAlgebra R L) M
  have hc (i : I) : e z i ∈ boundaries R L (M i) q := by
    rw [(subsingleton_homology_iff R L (M i) q).mp (h i)]
    rw [directSum_tensor_component]
    exact lTensor_mem_cycles (DirectSum.lieModuleComponent R I L M i) hz
  have he : z = ∑ i ∈ (e z).support,
      ((DirectSum.lieModuleOf R I L M i).toLinearMap).lTensor _ (e z i) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← e.symm_apply_apply z, ← DirectSum.sum_support_of (e z)]
    simp only [map_sum, e, directSum_tensor_symm_of]
  rw [he]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
    lTensor_mem_boundaries (DirectSum.lieModuleOf R I L M i) (hc i)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.subsingleton_homology_directSum
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_directSum (q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, Subsingleton (homology R L (M i) q)) :
    Subsingleton (homology R L (⨁ i, M i) q)
proof:
:= by
  apply (subsingleton_homology_iff R L (⨁ i, M i) q).mpr
  exact le_antisymm (boundaries_le_cycles q) (fun _ hz => directSum_cycle_boundary M q h hz)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.exterior_induction
statement:
theorem exterior_induction {p : ExteriorAlgebra R L → Prop}
    (algebraMap : ∀ r : R, p (algebraMap R _ r)) (add : ∀ c c', p c → p c' → p (c + c'))
    (ι_mul : ∀ (y : L) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L), p c → p (ι R y * c)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    p c
proof:
:= by
  induction c using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r => exact algebraMap r
  | add c c' hc hc' => exact add c c' hc hc'
  | ι_mul c y hc => exact ι_mul y c hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.rid_wedge
statement:
lemma rid_wedge (y : L) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] R) :
    TensorProduct.rid R _ (wedge R L R y c) = ι R y * TensorProduct.rid R _ c
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul ω r => simp
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc', mul_add]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_one
statement: @[simp] lemma extDeriv_one (D : L →ₗ[R] L) : extDeriv D (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R L) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [extDeriv]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma extDeriv_algebraMap (D : L →ₗ[R] L) (r : R) :
    extDeriv D (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R L) r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, extDeriv_one, smul_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_ι_mul
statement:
lemma extDeriv_ι_mul (D : L →ₗ[R] L) (y : L) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    extDeriv D (ι R y * c) = ι R (D y) * c + ι R y * extDeriv D c
proof:
:= by
  have h : (TensorProduct.rid R _).symm (ι R y * c) = wedge R L R y (c ⊗ₜ 1) := rfl
  simp only [extDeriv, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, h, derivExt_wedge, map_add,
    rid_wedge]
  simp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_ι
statement: @[simp] lemma extDeriv_ι (D : L →ₗ[R] L) (y : L) : extDeriv D (ι R y) = ι R (D y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using extDeriv_ι_mul D y 1

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_add
statement: lemma extDeriv_add (D D' : L →ₗ[R] L) : extDeriv (D + D') = extDeriv D + extDeriv D'
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  induction c using exterior_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc', LinearMap.add_apply] at *
  | ι_mul y c hc =>
    simp only [extDeriv_ι_mul, LinearMap.add_apply, hc, map_add, add_mul, mul_add] at *
    abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_smul
statement: lemma extDeriv_smul (t : R) (D : L →ₗ[R] L) : extDeriv (t • D) = t • extDeriv D
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  induction c using exterior_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc', LinearMap.smul_apply] at *
  | ι_mul y c hc =>
    simp only [extDeriv_ι_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hc, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_add] at *

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_mem_exteriorPower
statement:
lemma extDeriv_mem_exteriorPower (D : L →ₗ[R] L) {k : ℕ} {c : ExteriorAlgebra R L}
    (hc : c ∈ ⋀[R]^k L) : extDeriv D c ∈ ⋀[R]^k L
proof:
:= by
  have h := derivExt_mem_chainsIn (M := R) D 0 (tmul_mem_chainsIn hc (1 : R))
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h
  change TensorProduct.rid R _ (derivExt D 0 (c ⊗ₜ 1)) ∈ _
  rw [← hs]
  clear hs
  induction s with
  | tmul ω r => simpa [incl_tmul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r ω.2
  | add s s' hs hs' => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hs hs'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.coe_extDerivDeg
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_extDerivDeg (D : L →ₗ[R] L) (k : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[R]^k L) :
    (extDerivDeg D k ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) = extDeriv D ω
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDerivDeg_add
statement:
lemma extDerivDeg_add (D D' : L →ₗ[R] L) (k : ℕ) :
    extDerivDeg (D + D') k = extDerivDeg D k + extDerivDeg D' k
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp [extDeriv_add]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDerivDeg_smul
statement:
lemma extDerivDeg_smul (t : R) (D : L →ₗ[R] L) (k : ℕ) :
    extDerivDeg (t • D) k = t • extDerivDeg D k
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp [extDeriv_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDeriv_comm
statement:
lemma extDeriv_comm {D : L →ₗ[R] L} (hD : ∀ x y : L, D ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅D x, y⁆ + ⁅x, D y⁆) (y : L)
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    extDeriv D (extDeriv (LieAlgebra.ad R L y) c) - extDeriv (LieAlgebra.ad R L y) (extDeriv D c) =
      extDeriv (LieAlgebra.ad R L (D y)) c
proof:
:= by
  induction c using exterior_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, ← hc, ← hc']; abel
  | ι_mul z c hc =>
    simp only [extDeriv_ι_mul, map_add, LieAlgebra.ad_apply]
    rw [← hc, hD]
    simp only [map_add, add_mul, mul_sub]
    abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_apply
statement:
lemma lieDeriv_apply (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    lieDeriv y f c = f (extDeriv (LieAlgebra.ad R L y) c) - ⁅y, f c⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction c using exterior_induction generalizing f with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    simp only [map_smul, lie_smul, lieDeriv_one, extDeriv_one, map_zero, smul_zero, zero_sub,
      smul_neg]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, lie_add, hc, hc']; abel
  | ι_mul z c hc =>
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (contract_lieDeriv y z f) c
    rw [contract_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, hc, contract_apply, contract_apply,
      contract_apply] at h
    rw [h, extDeriv_ι_mul, map_add, LieAlgebra.ad_apply]
    abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coAct_apply
statement:
lemma coAct_apply (a : H) (f : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L) :
    ρ.coAct a f c = ρ.φ a (f c) - f (extDeriv (ρ.D a) c)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.contract_coAct
statement:
lemma contract_coAct (a : H) (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N) :
    contract y (ρ.coAct a f) = ρ.coAct a (contract y f) - contract (ρ.D a y) f
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  simp only [contract_apply, coAct_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, extDeriv_ι_mul, map_add]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coAct_lieDeriv
statement:
lemma coAct_lieDeriv (a : H) (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N) :
    ρ.coAct a (lieDeriv y f) = lieDeriv y (ρ.coAct a f) + lieDeriv (ρ.D a y) f
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  have hc := extDeriv_comm (ρ.D_lie a) y c
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hc
  simp only [coAct_apply, lieDeriv_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, ρ.φ_lie, lie_sub, hc,
    map_add]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainDiff_coAct
statement:
theorem cochainDiff_coAct (a : H) (f : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N) :
    cochainDiff K L N (ρ.coAct a f) = ρ.coAct a (cochainDiff K L N f)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  induction c using exterior_induction generalizing f with
  | algebraMap r =>
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, coAct_apply, cochainDiff_one]
  | add c c' hc hc' => rw [map_add, map_add, hc, hc']
  | ι_mul y c hc =>
    have e₁ : ∀ g : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N, cochainDiff K L N g (ι K y * c) =
        contract y (cochainDiff K L N g) c := fun _ ↦ rfl
    have e₂ : ∀ g : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N, ρ.coAct a g (ι K y * c) =
        contract y (ρ.coAct a g) c := fun _ ↦ rfl
    rw [e₁, e₂, contract_cochainDiff, contract_coAct, contract_coAct, contract_cochainDiff,
      contract_cochainDiff]
    simp only [map_sub, map_neg, coAct_lieDeriv, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply,
      LinearMap.add_apply, ← hc]
    abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coActDeg_apply
statement:
lemma coActDeg_apply (k : ℕ) (a : H) (f : Cochains K L N k) (ω : ⋀[K]^k L) :
    ρ.coActDeg k a f ω = ρ.φ a (f ω) - f (extDerivDeg (ρ.D a) k ω)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coActDeg_comp_degProj
statement:
lemma coActDeg_comp_degProj (k : ℕ) (a : H) (f : Cochains K L N k) :
    (ρ.coActDeg k a f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) ∘ₗ (⋀[K]^k L).subtype =
      ρ.coAct a (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) ∘ₗ (⋀[K]^k L).subtype
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, coActDeg_apply, coAct_apply,
    degProj_subtype]
  congr 2
  exact (degProj_subtype k (extDerivDeg (ρ.D a) k ω)).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.δ_coActDeg
statement:
theorem δ_coActDeg (k : ℕ) (a : H) (f : Cochains K L N k) :
    δ K L N k (ρ.coActDeg k a f) = ρ.coActDeg (k + 1) a (δ K L N k f)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (cochainDiff_eq_of_eq (ρ.coActDeg_comp_degProj k a f)) ω
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply] at h
  rw [δ_apply, h, cochainDiff_coAct, coActDeg_apply, coAct_apply, δ_apply, δ_apply,
    coe_extDerivDeg]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.mem_cochainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma mem_cochainWeightSpace {k : ℕ} {μ : Module.Dual K H} {f : Cochains K L N k} :
    f ∈ ρ.cochainWeightSpace k μ ↔ ∀ a, ρ.coActDeg k a f = μ a • f
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.δ_mem_cochainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma δ_mem_cochainWeightSpace {k : ℕ} {μ : Module.Dual K H} {f : Cochains K L N k}
    (hf : f ∈ ρ.cochainWeightSpace k μ) : δ K L N k f ∈ ρ.cochainWeightSpace (k + 1) μ
proof:
:=
  fun a ↦ by rw [← δ_coActDeg, hf a, map_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coe_δWeight
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_δWeight (k : ℕ) (μ : Module.Dual K H) (f : ρ.cochainWeightSpace k μ) :
    (ρ.δWeight k μ f : Cochains K L N (k + 1)) = δ K L N k f
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.δWeight_comp_δWeight
statement:
theorem δWeight_comp_δWeight (k : ℕ) (μ : Module.Dual K H) :
    ρ.δWeight (k + 1) μ ∘ₗ ρ.δWeight k μ = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun f ↦ Subtype.ext (LinearMap.congr_fun (δ_comp_δ k) (f : Cochains K L N k))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.weightComplex_X
statement:
@[simp] lemma weightComplex_X (μ : Module.Dual K H) (k : ℕ) :
    (ρ.weightComplex μ).X k = ModuleCat.of K (ρ.cochainWeightSpace k μ)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.weightComplex_d
statement:
@[simp] lemma weightComplex_d (μ : Module.Dual K H) (k : ℕ) :
    (ρ.weightComplex μ).d k (k + 1) = ModuleCat.ofHom (ρ.δWeight k μ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [weightComplex]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.extDeriv_ιMulti
statement:
lemma extDeriv_ιMulti {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → L) (g : Fin n → Module.Dual K H)
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D (g i)) (a : H) :
    extDeriv (ρ.D a) (ιMulti K n f) = (∑ i, g i a) • ιMulti K n f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ιMulti_zero_apply]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [ιMulti_succ_apply, extDeriv_ι_mul, hf 0 a,
      ih (Matrix.vecTail f) (Matrix.vecTail g) fun i ↦ hf i.succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_smul,
      LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.extDeriv_exteriorPower_basis
statement:
lemma extDeriv_exteriorPower_basis (hbL : ∀ i, bL i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D (γ i))
    {k : ℕ} (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (a : H) :
    extDerivDeg (ρ.D a) k (bL.exteriorPower k s) =
      (∑ i ∈ s.val, γ i a) • bL.exteriorPower k s
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_extDerivDeg, _root_.exteriorPower.basis_apply, _root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti_family,
    _root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe,
    extDeriv_ιMulti (ρ := ρ) (⇑bL ∘ ⇑(Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s))
      (γ ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s) fun i ↦ hbL _]
  simp only [SetLike.val_smul, _root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe]
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort s.val, ← (Set.powersetCard.orderIsoOfFin s).toEquiv.sum_comp]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.basisWt_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma basisWt_apply {k : ℕ} (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (a : H) :
    basisWt γ s a = ∑ i ∈ s.val, γ i a
proof:
:= by
  simp [basisWt]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.mem_cochainWeightSpace_iff_basis
statement:
theorem mem_cochainWeightSpace_iff_basis {k : ℕ} {μ : Module.Dual K H} {f : Cochains K L N k} :
    f ∈ ρ.cochainWeightSpace k μ ↔
      ∀ s, f (bL.exteriorPower k s) ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ (μ + basisWt γ s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf s a
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (hf a) (bL.exteriorPower k s)
    rw [coActDeg_apply, extDeriv_exteriorPower_basis ρ bL hbL, map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h
    rw [h, LinearMap.add_apply, basisWt_apply, add_smul]
  · intro hf a
    refine (bL.exteriorPower k).ext fun s ↦ ?_
    rw [coActDeg_apply, extDeriv_exteriorPower_basis ρ bL hbL, map_smul, hf s a,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, basisWt_apply, add_smul, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.apply_basis_mem
statement:
lemma apply_basis_mem {k : ℕ} {μ : Module.Dual K H} (f : ρ.cochainWeightSpace k μ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I k) :
    (f : Cochains K L N k) (bL.exteriorPower k s) ∈
      Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ (μ + basisWt γ s)
proof:
:=
  (ρ.mem_cochainWeightSpace_iff_basis hbL).mp f.2 s

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainWeightEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma cochainWeightEquiv_apply (k : ℕ) (μ : Module.Dual K H) (f) (s) :
    (ρ.cochainWeightEquiv hbL k μ f s : N) = (f : Cochains K L N k) (bL.exteriorPower k s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.IsEquivariant.map_mem_weightSpaceOf
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [← hg.map_φ, hx a, map_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.IsEquivariant.mem_weightSpaceOf_of_map
statement:
lemma IsEquivariant.mem_weightSpaceOf_of_map (hg : IsEquivariant ρ₁ ρ₂ g)
    (hinj : Function.Injective g) {ν : Module.Dual K H} {x : N₁}
    (hx : g x ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₂.φ ν) :
    x ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₁.φ ν
proof: := fun a ↦ hinj (by rw [hg.map_φ, hx a, map_smul])

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.IsEquivariant.comp_mem_cochainWeightSpace
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (hf a) ω
  rw [coActDeg_apply] at h ⊢
  simp only [hg.D_eq, LinearMap.comp_apply, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rw [← hg.map_φ, ← map_sub, h, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coe_weightMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_weightMap (hg : IsEquivariant ρ₁ ρ₂ g) (k : ℕ) (μ : Module.Dual K H)
    (f : ρ₁.cochainWeightSpace k μ) :
    (weightMap hg k μ f : Cochains K L N₂ k) = (g : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) ∘ₗ (f : Cochains K L N₁ k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.weightMap_δWeight
statement:
lemma weightMap_δWeight (hg : IsEquivariant ρ₁ ρ₂ g) (k : ℕ) (μ : Module.Dual K H) :
    weightMap hg (k + 1) μ ∘ₗ ρ₁.δWeight k μ = ρ₂.δWeight k μ ∘ₗ weightMap hg k μ
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun f ↦ Subtype.ext (δ_comp k g (f : Cochains K L N₁ k)).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.weightComplexMap_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma weightComplexMap_f (hg : IsEquivariant ρ₁ ρ₂ g) (μ : Module.Dual K H) (k : ℕ) :
    (weightComplexMap hg μ).f k = ModuleCat.ofHom (weightMap hg k μ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.weightComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem weightComplex_shortExact {g₁ : N₁ →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N₂} {g₂ : N₂ →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N₃}
    (hg₁ : IsEquivariant ρ₁ ρ₂ g₁) (hg₂ : IsEquivariant ρ₂ ρ₃ g₂)
    (hbL : ∀ i, bL i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₁.D (γ i))
    (hinj : Function.Injective g₁) (hex : Function.Exact g₁ g₂)
    (hsurj : ∀ ν, ∀ x ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₃.φ ν,
      ∃ y ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₂.φ ν, g₂ y = x) (μ : Module.Dual K H) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (weightComplexMap hg₁ μ) (weightComplexMap hg₂ μ) (by
      ext k f : 3
      refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_)
      exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have hbL₂ : ∀ i, bL i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₂.D (γ i) := hg₁.D_eq ▸ hbL
  have hbL₃ : ∀ i, bL i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₃.D (γ i) := hg₂.D_eq ▸ hbL₂
  refine HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact _ fun k ↦ ?_
  refine ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact _ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro (f₂ : ρ₂.cochainWeightSpace k μ)
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hs : ∀ s, ∃ y ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₁.φ (μ + basisWt γ s),
          g₁ y = (f₂ : Cochains K L N₂ k) (bL.exteriorPower k s) := by
        intro s
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hex _).mp
          (LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg Subtype.val h) (bL.exteriorPower k s))
        refine ⟨y, hg₁.mem_weightSpaceOf_of_map hinj ?_, hy⟩
        rw [hy]
        exact ρ₂.apply_basis_mem hbL₂ f₂ s
      choose y hy hgy using hs
      refine ⟨(ρ₁.cochainWeightEquiv hbL k μ).symm fun s ↦ ⟨y s, hy s⟩, ?_⟩
      apply (ρ₂.cochainWeightEquiv hbL₂ k μ).injective
      funext s
      apply Subtype.ext
      change g₁ ((ρ₁.cochainWeightEquiv hbL k μ (
        (ρ₁.cochainWeightEquiv hbL k μ).symm fun s ↦ ⟨y s, hy s⟩) s : N₁)) = _
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hgy, cochainWeightEquiv_apply]
    · rintro ⟨f₁, rfl⟩
      refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_)
      exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _
  · intro (f : ρ₁.cochainWeightSpace k μ) (f' : ρ₁.cochainWeightSpace k μ) h
    refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hinj ?_)
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg Subtype.val h) ω
  · intro (f₃ : ρ₃.cochainWeightSpace k μ)
    have hs : ∀ s, ∃ y ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ₂.φ (μ + basisWt γ s),
        g₂ y = (f₃ : Cochains K L N₃ k) (bL.exteriorPower k s) :=
      fun s ↦ hsurj _ _ (ρ₃.apply_basis_mem hbL₃ f₃ s)
    choose y hy hgy using hs
    refine ⟨(ρ₂.cochainWeightEquiv hbL₂ k μ).symm fun s ↦ ⟨y s, hy s⟩, ?_⟩
    apply (ρ₃.cochainWeightEquiv hbL₃ k μ).injective
    funext s
    apply Subtype.ext
    change g₂ ((ρ₂.cochainWeightEquiv hbL₂ k μ (
      (ρ₂.cochainWeightEquiv hbL₂ k μ).symm fun s ↦ ⟨y s, hy s⟩) s : N₂)) = _
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hgy, cochainWeightEquiv_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.exteriorPower_zero_eq
statement:
lemma exteriorPower_zero_eq (ω : ⋀[K]^0 L) :
    ω = exteriorPower.zeroEquiv K L ω • (⟨1, by simp⟩ : ⋀[K]^0 L)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (⟨1, by simp⟩ : ⋀[K]^0 L) = exteriorPower.ιMulti K 0 Fin.elim0 :=
    Subtype.ext (by simp [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply])
  apply (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv K L).injective
  rw [map_smul, h1, exteriorPower.zeroEquiv_ιMulti, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.zeroEquiv_one
statement: lemma zeroEquiv_one : exteriorPower.zeroEquiv K L (⟨1, by simp⟩ : ⋀[K]^0 L) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (⟨1, by simp⟩ : ⋀[K]^0 L) = exteriorPower.ιMulti K 0 Fin.elim0 :=
    Subtype.ext (by simp [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply])
  rw [h1, exteriorPower.zeroEquiv_ιMulti]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.extDerivDeg_zero_apply
statement: lemma extDerivDeg_zero_apply (D : L →ₗ[K] L) (ω : ⋀[K]^0 L) : extDerivDeg D 0 ω = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPower_zero_eq ω, map_smul]
  refine smul_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr (Subtype.ext ?_))
  rw [coe_extDerivDeg]
  exact extDeriv_one _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainZero_one
statement: @[simp] lemma cochainZero_one (v : V) : cochainZero K L v ⟨1, by simp⟩ = v
proof:
:= by
  simp [cochainZero, zeroEquiv_one]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainZero_apply_one
statement: lemma cochainZero_apply_one (f : Cochains K L V 0) : cochainZero K L (f ⟨1, by simp⟩) = f
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
  rw [exteriorPower_zero_eq ω, map_smul, map_smul, cochainZero_one]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.mem_cochainWeightSpace_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [DerivAction.mem_cochainWeightSpace]
  refine ⟨fun hf a ↦ ?_, fun hf a ↦ LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (hf a) ⟨1, by simp⟩
    rwa [DerivAction.coActDeg_apply, extDerivDeg_zero_apply, map_zero, sub_zero,
      LinearMap.smul_apply] at h
  · rw [DerivAction.coActDeg_apply, extDerivDeg_zero_apply, map_zero, sub_zero,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, exteriorPower_zero_eq ω, map_smul, map_smul, hf a, smul_comm]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.δ_zero_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma δ_zero_eq_zero_iff {f : Cochains K L V 0} :
    δ K L V 0 f = 0 ↔ ∀ x : L, ⁅x, f ⟨1, by simp⟩⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf x ↦ ?_, fun hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h := δ_zero_apply f x
    rw [hf, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
  · refine exteriorPower.linearMap_ext (AlternatingMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)
    rw [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hm : exteriorPower.ιMulti K (0 + 1) m = (⟨ExteriorAlgebra.ι K (m 0), by simp⟩ :
        ⋀[K]^(0 + 1) L) :=
      Subtype.ext (by simp [exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply])
    rw [hm, δ_zero_apply, hf]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainMap_tmul (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (m : M) :
    chainMap e g (ω ⊗ₜ m) = ExteriorAlgebra.map e ω ⊗ₜ g m
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_wedge
statement:
lemma chainMap_wedge (y : L) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M) :
    chainMap e g (wedge R L M y c) = wedge R L' M' (e y) (chainMap e g c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul ω m => simp [map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_derivExt
statement:
lemma chainMap_derivExt {D : L →ₗ[R] L} {φ : M →ₗ[R] M} {D' : L' →ₗ[R] L'} {φ' : M' →ₗ[R] M'}
    (hD : ∀ x, e (D x) = D' (e x)) (hφ : ∀ m, g (φ m) = φ' (g m))
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M) :
    chainMap e g (derivExt D φ c) = derivExt D' φ' (chainMap e g c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using induction with
  | one m => simp [hφ]
  | wedge y c hc =>
    rw [derivExt_wedge, map_add, chainMap_wedge, chainMap_wedge, hc, chainMap_wedge,
      derivExt_wedge, hD]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma chainMap_mem_chainsIn {k : ℕ} {c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M}
    (hc : c ∈ chainsIn R L M k) : chainMap e g c ∈ chainsIn R L' M' k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing c with
  | zero =>
    refine chainsIn_zero_le (S := (chainsIn R L' M' 0).comap (chainMap e g)) (fun m ↦ ?_) hc
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, chainMap_tmul, map_one]
    exact one_tmul_mem_chainsIn _
  | succ k ih =>
    refine chainsIn_succ_le (S := (chainsIn R L' M' (k + 1)).comap (chainMap e g))
      (fun y c hc ↦ ?_) hc
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, chainMap_wedge]
    exact wedge_mem_chainsIn _ (ih hc)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_lieAction
statement:
lemma chainMap_lieAction (x : L) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M) :
    chainMap (e : L →ₗ[R] L') g (lieAction R L M x c) =
      lieAction R L' M' (e x) (chainMap (e : L →ₗ[R] L') g c)
proof:
:=
  chainMap_derivExt (e : L →ₗ[R] L') g (fun y ↦ by simp) (fun m ↦ by simp [hg]) c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_diff
statement:
theorem chainMap_diff (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M) :
    chainMap (e : L →ₗ[R] L') g (diff R L M c) = diff R L' M' (chainMap (e : L →ₗ[R] L') g c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using induction with
  | one m => simp
  | wedge y c hc =>
    rw [diff_wedge, map_sub, map_neg, chainMap_lieAction e hg, chainMap_wedge, hc,
      chainMap_wedge, diff_wedge]
    rfl
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_mem_cycles
statement:
lemma chainMap_mem_cycles {k : ℕ} {c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M}
    (hc : c ∈ cycles R L M k) : chainMap (e : L →ₗ[R] L') g c ∈ cycles R L' M' k
proof:
:=
  ⟨chainMap_mem_chainsIn _ g hc.1, LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by
    rw [← chainMap_diff e hg, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hc.2, map_zero])⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainMap_mem_boundaries
statement:
lemma chainMap_mem_boundaries {k : ℕ} {c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M}
    (hc : c ∈ boundaries R L M k) : chainMap (e : L →ₗ[R] L') g c ∈ boundaries R L' M' k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨_, chainMap_mem_chainsIn _ g hc, (chainMap_diff e hg c).symm⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace {e : L →ₗ[K] L'} {g : M →ₗ[K] M'}
    (hD : ∀ a x, e (ρ.D a x) = -ρ'.D a (e x)) (hφ : ∀ a m, g (ρ.φ a m) = -ρ'.φ a (g m))
    {ν : Dual K H} {c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] M} (hc : c ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν) :
    chainMap e g c ∈ ρ'.chainWeightSpace (-ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_chainWeightSpace.mpr fun a ↦ ?_
  have h := chainMap_derivExt e g (D' := -ρ'.D a) (φ' := -ρ'.φ a) (hD a) (hφ a) c
  have hneg : derivExt (-ρ'.D a) (-ρ'.φ a) = -derivExt (ρ'.D a) (ρ'.φ a) := by
    have h1 := derivExt_smul (ρ'.D a) (ρ'.φ a) (-1 : K)
    simp only [neg_smul, one_smul] at h1
    exact h1.trans (LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ by simp)
  rw [← θ_apply, mem_chainWeightSpace.mp hc a, map_smul, hneg, LinearMap.neg_apply,
    ← θ_apply] at h
  rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, ← neg_neg (ρ'.θ a _), ← h]
  exact (neg_smul (ν a) _).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainEquiv_apply (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] M) :
    chainEquiv e g c = chainMap (e : L →ₗ[K] L') (g : M →ₗ[K] M') c
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainEquiv_symm_apply (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L' ⊗[K] M') :
    (chainEquiv e g).symm c = chainMap (e.symm : L' →ₗ[K] L) (g.symm : M' →ₗ[K] M) c
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.symm_hD
statement: lemma symm_hD : ∀ a x, e.symm (ρ'.D a x) = -ρ.D a (e.symm x)
proof:
:= fun a x ↦ by
  have h := hD a (e.symm x)
  rw [LieEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  rw [← neg_neg (ρ'.D a x), ← h, map_neg, LieEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.symm_hφ
statement: lemma symm_hφ : ∀ a m, g.symm (ρ'.φ a m) = -ρ.φ a (g.symm m)
proof:
:= fun a m ↦ by
  have h := hφ a (g.symm m)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  rw [← neg_neg (ρ'.φ a m), ← h, map_neg, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.map_chainEquiv_chainsIn_inf
statement:
lemma map_chainEquiv_chainsIn_inf (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    (chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν).map (chainEquiv e g).toLinearMap =
      chainsIn K L' M' k ⊓ ρ'.chainWeightSpace (-ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun c hc ↦
    ⟨(chainEquiv e g).symm c, ?_, (chainEquiv e g).apply_symm_apply c⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨chainMap_mem_chainsIn _ _ hc.1, chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace hD hφ hc.2⟩
  · have h := chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace (symm_hD e hD) (symm_hφ g hφ) hc.2
    rw [neg_neg] at h
    exact ⟨chainMap_mem_chainsIn _ _ hc.1, h⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.map_chainEquiv_cycles_inf
statement:
lemma map_chainEquiv_cycles_inf (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    (cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν).map (chainEquiv e g).toLinearMap =
      cycles K L' M' k ⊓ ρ'.chainWeightSpace (-ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hg' : ∀ (x : L') (m : M'), g.symm ⁅x, m⁆ = ⁅e.symm x, g.symm m⁆ := fun x m ↦ by
    apply g.injective
    rw [hg, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LieEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun c hc ↦
    ⟨(chainEquiv e g).symm c, ?_, (chainEquiv e g).apply_symm_apply c⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨chainMap_mem_cycles e.toLieHom hg hc.1, chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace hD hφ hc.2⟩
  · have h := chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace (symm_hD e hD) (symm_hφ g hφ) hc.2
    rw [neg_neg] at h
    exact ⟨chainMap_mem_cycles e.symm.toLieHom hg' hc.1, h⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.map_chainEquiv_boundaries_inf
statement:
lemma map_chainEquiv_boundaries_inf (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    (boundaries K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν).map (chainEquiv e g).toLinearMap =
      boundaries K L' M' k ⊓ ρ'.chainWeightSpace (-ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hg' : ∀ (x : L') (m : M'), g.symm ⁅x, m⁆ = ⁅e.symm x, g.symm m⁆ := fun x m ↦ by
    apply g.injective
    rw [hg, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LieEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun c hc ↦
    ⟨(chainEquiv e g).symm c, ?_, (chainEquiv e g).apply_symm_apply c⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨chainMap_mem_boundaries e.toLieHom hg hc.1, chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace hD hφ hc.2⟩
  · have h := chainMap_mem_chainWeightSpace (symm_hD e hD) (symm_hφ g hφ) hc.2
    rw [neg_neg] at h
    exact ⟨chainMap_mem_boundaries e.symm.toLieHom hg' hc.1, h⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_of_neg
statement:
theorem finrank_homologyWeightSpace_of_neg (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H)
    [FiniteDimensional K ↥(cycles K L' M' k ⊓ ρ'.chainWeightSpace (-ν))] :
    finrank K (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k ν) = finrank K (ρ'.homologyWeightSpace k (-ν))
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := map_chainEquiv_cycles_inf e g hg hD hφ k ν
  have hB := map_chainEquiv_boundaries_inf e g hg hD hφ k ν
  let eZ := ((chainEquiv e g).submoduleMap (cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν)).trans
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hZ)
  have : FiniteDimensional K ↥(cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv eZ.symm
  have h₁ := ρ.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add k ν
  have h₂ := ρ'.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add k (-ν)
  have h₃ := LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq (chainEquiv e g) (cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν)
  have h₄ := LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq (chainEquiv e g)
    (boundaries K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν)
  rw [hZ] at h₃
  rw [hB] at h₄
  omega

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.envAction_mul
statement:
lemma envAction_mul (u v : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) :
    envAction R L N (u * v) = envAction R L N v * envAction R L N u
proof:
:= by
  simp [envAction]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.envAction_one
statement: @[simp] lemma envAction_one : envAction R L N (1 : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [envAction]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.envAction_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma envAction_ι (x : L) (n : N) :
    envAction R L N (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R x) n = -⁅x, n⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp [envAction, oppositeAction]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.envAction_comp
statement:
lemma envAction_comp {N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup N'] [Module R N'] [LieRingModule L N']
    [LieModule R L N'] (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L) :
    envAction R L N' u ∘ₗ (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') = (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ envAction R L N u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, mkAlgHom R L a = u := by
    induction u using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | h a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  induction a using TensorAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    ext n
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | ι y =>
    ext n
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      show mkAlgHom R L (TensorAlgebra.ι R y) = UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R y from rfl,
      envAction_ι, envAction_ι, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, map_neg, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
  | add a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_comp, h₁, h₂,
      LinearMap.comp_add]
  | mul a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_mul, envAction_mul, envAction_mul, Module.End.mul_eq_comp,
      Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.comp_assoc, h₁, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, h₂,
      LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainExt_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma cochainExt_tmul (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L)
    (u : LeftRegular R L) :
    cochainExt R L N f (c ⊗ₜ u) = envAction R L N (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) (f c)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainExt_one
statement:
lemma cochainExt_one (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    cochainExt R L N f (c ⊗ₜ (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm 1) = f c
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainExt_mulRight
statement:
lemma cochainExt_mulRight (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L)
    (t : E) :
    cochainExt R L N f ((LeftRegular.mulRight u : LeftRegular R L →ₗ[R] LeftRegular R L).lTensor
      _ t) = envAction R L N u (cochainExt R L N f t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | tmul c v =>
    simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LieModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap, cochainExt_tmul,
      LeftRegular.equiv_mulRight, envAction_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_apply
statement:
lemma cochainDiff_apply (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    cochainDiff R L N f c =
      cochainExt R L N f (diff R L (LeftRegular R L) (c ⊗ₜ (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm 1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainExt_cochainDiff
statement:
theorem cochainExt_cochainDiff (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    cochainExt R L N (cochainDiff R L N f) = cochainExt R L N f ∘ₗ diff R L (LeftRegular R L)
proof:
:= by
  ext c u
  simp only [TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_apply, TensorProduct.curry_apply,
    LinearMap.restrictScalars_self, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hu : c ⊗ₜ[R] u = (LeftRegular.mulRight (LeftRegular.equiv R L u) :
      LeftRegular R L →ₗ[R] LeftRegular R L).lTensor _ (c ⊗ₜ (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm 1) := by
    simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
    congr 1
    apply (LeftRegular.equiv R L).injective
    simp
  rw [cochainExt_tmul, cochainDiff_apply]
  conv_rhs => rw [hu, ← lTensor_diff, cochainExt_mulRight]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_cochainDiff
statement:
@[simp] theorem cochainDiff_cochainDiff (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    cochainDiff R L N (cochainDiff R L N f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [cochainDiff_apply, cochainExt_cochainDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, diff_diff, map_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_comp_cochainDiff
statement: theorem cochainDiff_comp_cochainDiff : cochainDiff R L N ∘ₗ cochainDiff R L N = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun f ↦ by rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, cochainDiff_cochainDiff, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_one
statement:
lemma cochainDiff_one (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    cochainDiff R L N f (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R L) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cochainDiff_apply]
  exact (congrArg (cochainExt R L N f) (diff_one_tmul _)).trans (map_zero _)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_ι
statement:
lemma cochainDiff_ι (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (x : L) :
    cochainDiff R L N f (ι R x) = ⁅x, f 1⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [cochainDiff_apply, diff_ι_tmul, map_neg, cochainExt_tmul]
  have : LeftRegular.equiv R L ⁅x, (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm 1⁆ =
      UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R x := by simp
  rw [this, envAction_ι, neg_neg]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_comp
statement:
lemma cochainDiff_comp {N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup N'] [Module R N'] [LieRingModule L N']
    [LieModule R L N'] (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    cochainDiff R L N' ((φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ f) = (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ cochainDiff R L N f
proof:
:= by
  have : cochainExt R L N' ((φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ f) =
      (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ cochainExt R L N f := by
    ext c u
    simp only [TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_apply, TensorProduct.curry_apply,
      LinearMap.restrictScalars_self, LinearMap.comp_apply, cochainExt_tmul]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (envAction_comp φ _) (f c)
  ext c
  rw [cochainDiff_apply, this, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, cochainDiff_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainExt_eq_of_mem_chainsIn
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := ht
  induction s with
  | tmul ω u =>
    have hω := LinearMap.congr_fun h ω
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply] at hω
    simp only [incl_tmul, cochainExt_tmul, hω]
  | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, hs, hs']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_eq_of_eq
statement:
lemma cochainDiff_eq_of_eq {j : ℕ} {f g : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N}
    (h : f ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^j L).subtype = g ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^j L).subtype) :
    cochainDiff R L N f ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^(j + 1) L).subtype =
      cochainDiff R L N g ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^(j + 1) L).subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, cochainDiff_apply]
  exact cochainExt_eq_of_mem_chainsIn h (diff_mem_chainsIn (tmul_mem_chainsIn ω.2 _))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.δ_apply
statement:
lemma δ_apply (k : ℕ) (f : Cochains R L N k) (ω : ⋀[R]^(k + 1) L) :
    δ R L N k f ω = cochainDiff R L N (f ∘ₗ degProj R L k) ω
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.δ_comp_δ
statement: theorem δ_comp_δ (k : ℕ) : δ R L N (k + 1) ∘ₗ δ R L N k = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext f ω
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  change (cochainDiff R L N ((δ R L N k f) ∘ₗ degProj R L (k + 1)) ∘ₗ
    (⋀[R]^(k + 2) L).subtype) ω = 0
  rw [cochainDiff_eq_of_eq (g := cochainDiff R L N (f ∘ₗ degProj R L k)) (j := k + 1)]
  · simp
  · ext ω'
    simp [δ_apply, degProj_subtype]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.δ_zero_apply
statement:
lemma δ_zero_apply (f : Cochains R L N 0) (x : L) :
    δ R L N 0 f ⟨ι R x, by simp⟩ =
      ⁅x, f ⟨1, by simp⟩⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [δ_apply]
  change cochainDiff R L N (f ∘ₗ degProj R L 0) (ι R x) = _
  rw [cochainDiff_ι, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 2
  exact degProj_subtype 0 ⟨1, _⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.δ_comp
statement:
lemma δ_comp (k : ℕ) (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (f : Cochains R L N k) :
    δ R L N' k ((φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ f) = (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ δ R L N k f
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp only [δ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, cochainDiff_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainComplex_X
statement:
@[simp] lemma cochainComplex_X (k : ℕ) :
    (cochainComplex R L N).X k = ModuleCat.of R (Cochains R L N k)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainComplex_d
statement:
@[simp] lemma cochainComplex_d (k : ℕ) :
    (cochainComplex R L N).d k (k + 1) = ModuleCat.ofHom (δ R L N k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cochainComplex]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainComplexMap_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma cochainComplexMap_f (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) (k : ℕ) :
    (cochainComplexMap φ).f k =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.llcomp R (⋀[R]^k L) N M (φ : N →ₗ[R] M))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainComplexMap_id
statement:
@[simp] lemma cochainComplexMap_id :
    cochainComplexMap (LieModuleHom.id : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) = 𝟙 (cochainComplex R L N)
proof:
:= by
  ext k f : 3
  rfl
