name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainComplexMap_comp
statement:
lemma cochainComplexMap_comp
    (ψ : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M') (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) :
    cochainComplexMap (ψ.comp φ) = cochainComplexMap φ ≫ cochainComplexMap ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext k f : 3
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.contract_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma contract_apply (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    contract y f c = f (ι R y * c)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainExt_wedge
statement:
lemma cochainExt_wedge (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (y : L) (t : E) :
    cochainExt R L N f (wedge R L (LeftRegular R L) y t) = cochainExt R L N (contract y f) t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | tmul c u => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_one
statement:
lemma lieDeriv_one (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    lieDeriv y f 1 = -⁅y, f 1⁆
proof:
:= by
  change cochainExt R L N f (lieAction R L (LeftRegular R L) y (1 ⊗ₜ _)) = _
  rw [lieAction_one_tmul, cochainExt_tmul]
  have : LeftRegular.equiv R L ⁅y, (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm 1⁆ =
      UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R y := by simp
  rw [this, envAction_ι]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.contract_lieDeriv
statement:
lemma contract_lieDeriv (y z : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    contract z (lieDeriv y f) = contract ⁅y, z⁆ f + lieDeriv y (contract z f)
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  change cochainExt R L N f (lieAction R L (LeftRegular R L) y
      (wedge R L (LeftRegular R L) z (c ⊗ₜ (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm 1))) = _
  rw [lieAction_wedge, map_add, cochainExt_wedge, cochainExt_wedge, LinearMap.add_apply,
    cochainExt_one]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.contract_cochainDiff
statement:
lemma contract_cochainDiff (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    contract y (cochainDiff R L N f) = -lieDeriv y f - cochainDiff R L N (contract y f)
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  change cochainExt R L N f (diff R L (LeftRegular R L)
      (wedge R L (LeftRegular R L) y (c ⊗ₜ (LeftRegular.equiv R L).symm 1))) = _
  rw [diff_wedge, map_sub, map_neg, cochainExt_wedge, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainPair_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma cochainPair_tmul (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L)
    (m : X) : cochainPair B f (c ⊗ₜ m) = B (f c) m
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainPair_wedge
statement:
lemma cochainPair_wedge (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (y : L) (t : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] X) :
    cochainPair B f (wedge R L X y t) = cochainPair B (contract y f) t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | tmul c m => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainPair_lieDeriv
statement:
lemma cochainPair_lieDeriv (hB : ∀ (x : L) (n : N) (m : X), B ⁅x, n⁆ m = -B n ⁅x, m⁆) (y : L)
    (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (t : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] X) :
    cochainPair B (lieDeriv y f) t = cochainPair B f (lieAction R L X y t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using induction generalizing f with
  | one m => simp [lieDeriv_one, hB]
  | wedge z t ht =>
    rw [cochainPair_wedge, contract_lieDeriv, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ht, lieAction_wedge,
      map_add, cochainPair_wedge, cochainPair_wedge]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainPair_cochainDiff
statement:
theorem cochainPair_cochainDiff (hB : ∀ (x : L) (n : N) (m : X), B ⁅x, n⁆ m = -B n ⁅x, m⁆)
    (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) (t : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] X) :
    cochainPair B (cochainDiff R L N f) t = cochainPair B f (diff R L X t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using induction generalizing f with
  | one m => simp [cochainDiff_one]
  | wedge y t ht =>
    rw [cochainPair_wedge, contract_cochainDiff, map_sub, map_neg, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.neg_apply, ht, cochainPair_lieDeriv hB, diff_wedge, map_sub, map_neg,
      cochainPair_wedge]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplex_X
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainComplex_X (k : ℕ) :
    (chainComplex R L M).X k = ModuleCat.of R (⋀[R]^k L ⊗[R] M)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplex_d
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainComplex_d (k : ℕ) :
    (chainComplex R L M).d (k + 1) k = ModuleCat.ofHom (d R L M k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chainComplex]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplexMap_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainComplexMap_f (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (k : ℕ) :
    (chainComplexMap f).f k = ModuleCat.ofHom (mapChains R L k f)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplexMap_id
statement:
@[simp] lemma chainComplexMap_id :
    chainComplexMap (LieModuleHom.id : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) = 𝟙 (chainComplex R L M)
proof:
:= by
  ext k : 2
  simp only [chainComplexMap_f, HomologicalComplex.id_f]
  ext t
  change ((LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M).lTensor _) t = t
  rw [LinearMap.lTensor_id]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplexMap_comp
statement:
lemma chainComplexMap_comp {P : Type w} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [LieRingModule L P]
    [LieModule R L P] (g : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ P) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) :
    chainComplexMap (g.comp f) = chainComplexMap f ≫ chainComplexMap g
proof:
:= by
  ext k : 2
  simp only [chainComplexMap_f, HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  ext t
  change ((g.comp f : M →ₗ[R] P).lTensor _) t = (g : N →ₗ[R] P).lTensor _
    ((f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ t)
  rw [LieModuleHom.toLinearMap_comp, LinearMap.lTensor_comp]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.exactAt_succ_iff
statement:
theorem exactAt_succ_iff (k : ℕ) :
    (chainComplex R L M).ExactAt (k + 1) ↔
      LinearMap.range (d R L M (k + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (d R L M k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ (k + 2) (k + 1) k (by simp) (by simp),
    ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker]
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor'_obj_f,
    HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor'_obj_g, chainComplex_d]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.coefficientChainSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem coefficientChainSequence_shortExact
    [∀ k : ℕ, Module.Flat R (⋀[R]^k L)]
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    (coefficientChainSequence f g hfg).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact
  intro k
  refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact]
    exact Module.Flat.lTensor_exact (⋀[R]^k L) hfg
  · rw [ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective]
    exact Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap f.toLinearMap hf
  · rw [ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective (⋀[R]^k L) hg

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.exact_transport
statement:
private theorem exact_transport
    {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{w} R)} (hS : S.Exact)
    {A B C : ModuleCat.{w} R}
    (a : S.X₁ ≅ A) (b : S.X₂ ≅ B) (c : S.X₃ ≅ C)
    (p : A ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ C)
    (hp : S.f ≫ b.hom = a.hom ≫ p) (hq : S.g ≫ c.hom = b.hom ≫ q) :
    Function.Exact p q
proof:
:= by
  have hz : p ≫ q = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_epi a.hom, ← Category.assoc, ← hp, Category.assoc, ← hq,
      ← Category.assoc, S.zero, zero_comp, comp_zero]
  let T := ShortComplex.mk p q hz
  exact (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact T).mp
    (ShortComplex.exact_of_iso (ShortComplex.isoMk a b c hp.symm hq.symm) hS)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyMap_zero_surjective
statement:
theorem homologyMap_zero_surjective (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Surjective (homologyMap R L 0 g)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, c, hc, rfl⟩
  rw [cycles_zero] at hc
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := LinearMap.lTensor_surjective (⋀[R]^0 L) hg t
  have hc : incl R L N 0 s ∈ cycles R L N 0 := by
    rw [cycles_zero]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
  refine ⟨⟨(boundaries R L N 0).mkQ (incl R L N 0 s), ⟨_, hc, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk (g.toLinearMap.lTensor _ (incl R L N 0 s)) =
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (incl R L P 0 t)
  rw [← incl_mapChains, hs]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyConnecting_comparison
statement:
lemma homologyConnecting_comparison (k : ℕ) :
    (chainComplexHomologyIso R L P (k + 1)).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k) =
      (coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg).δ (k + 1) k rfl ≫
        (chainComplexHomologyIso R L M k).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp [homologyConnecting]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyMap_exact
statement:
theorem homologyMap_exact (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (homologyMap R L k f) (homologyMap R L k g)
proof:
:= by
  exact exact_transport
    ((coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg).homology_exact₂ k)
    (chainComplexHomologyIso R L M k) (chainComplexHomologyIso R L N k)
    (chainComplexHomologyIso R L P k)
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyMap R L k f)) (ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyMap R L k g))
    (chainComplexHomologyIso_naturality k f) (chainComplexHomologyIso_naturality k g)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyMap_connecting_exact
statement:
theorem homologyMap_connecting_exact (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (homologyMap R L (k + 1) g) (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k)
proof:
:= by
  exact exact_transport
    ((coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg).homology_exact₃ (k + 1) k rfl)
    (chainComplexHomologyIso R L N (k + 1)) (chainComplexHomologyIso R L P (k + 1))
    (chainComplexHomologyIso R L M k)
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyMap R L (k + 1) g))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k))
    (chainComplexHomologyIso_naturality (k + 1) g)
    (homologyConnecting_comparison f g hfg hf hg k).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.connecting_homologyMap_exact
statement:
theorem connecting_homologyMap_exact (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k) (homologyMap R L k f)
proof:
:= by
  exact exact_transport
    ((coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg).homology_exact₁ (k + 1) k rfl)
    (chainComplexHomologyIso R L P (k + 1)) (chainComplexHomologyIso R L M k)
    (chainComplexHomologyIso R L N k)
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyMap R L k f))
    (homologyConnecting_comparison f g hfg hf hg k).symm
    (chainComplexHomologyIso_naturality k f)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyConnecting_injective
statement:
theorem homologyConnecting_injective (k : ℕ) [Subsingleton (homology R L N (k + 1))] :
    Function.Injective (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply bot_unique
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (homologyMap_connecting_exact f g hfg hf hg k x).mp hx
  rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyConnecting_surjective
statement:
theorem homologyConnecting_surjective (k : ℕ) [Subsingleton (homology R L N k)] :
    Function.Surjective (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact (connecting_homologyMap_exact f g hfg hf hg k x).mp (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.subsingleton_homology_iff
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_iff (k : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (homology R L M k) ↔ boundaries R L M k = cycles R L M k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.subsingleton_iff_eq_bot, homology, ← LinearMap.le_ker_iff_map,
    Submodule.ker_mkQ]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ le_antisymm (boundaries_le_cycles k) h, fun h ↦ h.ge⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cycles_succ_eq_map_ker
statement:
theorem cycles_succ_eq_map_ker (k : ℕ) :
    cycles R L M (k + 1) = (LinearMap.ker (d R L M k)).map (incl R L M (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · intro hc
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hc.1
    exact ⟨t, incl_mem_cycles_succ_iff.mp hc, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact incl_mem_cycles_succ_iff.mpr ht

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.subsingleton_homology_succ_iff
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_succ_iff (k : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (homology R L M (k + 1)) ↔
      LinearMap.range (d R L M (k + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (d R L M k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [subsingleton_homology_iff, boundaries_eq_map_d, cycles_succ_eq_map_ker,
    (Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (incl_injective (k + 1))).eq_iff]

name: LieModuleHom.homPrecomp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homPrecomp_apply (g : M₁ →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ M₂) (f : M₂ →ₗ[K] N₁) :
    homPrecomp N₁ g f = f ∘ₗ (g : M₁ →ₗ[K] M₂)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModuleHom.homPostcomp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homPostcomp_apply (g : N₁ →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N₂) (f : M₁ →ₗ[K] N₁) :
    homPostcomp M₁ g f = (g : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) ∘ₗ f
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.isZero_relCohomology_succ
statement:
theorem isZero_relCohomology_succ {k : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ f ∈ relCochains K L N S (k + 1), δ K L N (k + 1) f = 0 →
      ∃ g ∈ relCochains K L N S k, δ K L N k g = f) :
    IsZero (relCohomology K L N S (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.isZero_homology ?_
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ k (k + 1) (k + 1 + 1) (by simp) (by simp),
    ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
  intro f₀ hf
  let f : relCochains K L N S (k + 1) := f₀
  have h1 : relδ K L N S (k + 1) f = 0 := by
    have h := hf
    simp only [HomologicalComplex.sc', HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor'_obj_g,
      relCochainComplex_d] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩ := h f f.2 (congrArg Subtype.val h1)
  refine ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, ?_⟩
  have h2 : relδ K L N S k ⟨g, hg⟩ = f := Subtype.ext hgf
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.sc', HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor'_obj_f,
    relCochainComplex_d]
  exact h2

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homPrecomp_shortExact
statement:
theorem homPrecomp_shortExact (hM₂ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap M₂ φ μ = ⊤)
    (hM₃ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap M₃ φ μ = ⊤) (hinj : Function.Injective g₁)
    (hex : Function.Exact g₁ g₂) (hsurj : Function.Surjective g₂) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range φ) (homPrecomp N g₂))
      (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range φ) (homPrecomp N g₁)) (by
        ext k f : 3
        refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)
        change (f.1 ω) (g₂ (g₁ m)) = 0
        rw [hex.apply_apply_eq_zero, map_zero])).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := ExtOne.exists_splitData φ hM₂ hM₃ hinj hsurj fun b ↦ (hex b).trans
    (by simp [eq_comm])
  refine relCochainComplex_shortExact (fun f f' hff' ↦ LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_)
    (fun f ↦ ⟨fun hf ↦ ⟨f ∘ₗ T.s, LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_⟩, ?_⟩)
    ((LinearMap.lcomp K N T.r)) (fun f ↦ LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_) ?_
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hsurj c
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hff' m
  · have h1 := T.i_r_add_s_p m
    have h2 : f (g₁ (T.r m)) = 0 := LinearMap.congr_fun hf (T.r m)
    change f (T.s (g₂ m)) = f m
    conv_rhs => rw [← h1]
    rw [map_add, h2, zero_add]
  · rintro ⟨f', rfl⟩
    exact LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ by
      change f' (g₂ (g₁ m)) = 0
      rw [hex.apply_apply_eq_zero, map_zero]
  · change f (T.r (g₁ m)) = f m
    rw [T.r_i]
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ f
    refine LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    change ⁅φ a, f⁆ (T.r m) = ⁅φ a, f (T.r m)⁆ - f (T.r ⁅φ a, m⁆)
    rw [LieHom.lie_apply, T.r_mem a m]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.isZero_relCohomology_hom_of_shortExact_left
statement:
theorem isZero_relCohomology_hom_of_shortExact_left (hM₂ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap M₂ φ μ = ⊤)
    (hM₃ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap M₃ φ μ = ⊤) (hinj : Function.Injective g₁)
    (hex : Function.Exact g₁ g₂) (hsurj : Function.Surjective g₂) {n : ℕ}
    (h₁ : IsZero (relCohomology K L (M₁ →ₗ[K] N) (Set.range φ) n))
    (h₃ : IsZero (relCohomology K L (M₃ →ₗ[K] N) (Set.range φ) n)) :
    IsZero (relCohomology K L (M₂ →ₗ[K] N) (Set.range φ) n)
proof:
:=
  ((homPrecomp_shortExact (N := N) φ hM₂ hM₃ hinj hex hsurj).homology_exact₂ n).isZero_X₂
    (h₃.eq_of_src _ _) (h₁.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homPostcomp_shortExact
statement:
theorem homPostcomp_shortExact (hN₂ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap N₂ φ μ = ⊤)
    (hN₃ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap N₃ φ μ = ⊤) (hinj : Function.Injective g₁)
    (hex : Function.Exact g₁ g₂) (hsurj : Function.Surjective g₂) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range φ) (homPostcomp M g₁))
      (relCochainComplexMap (Set.range φ) (homPostcomp M g₂)) (by
        ext k f : 3
        refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)
        exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := ExtOne.exists_splitData φ hN₂ hN₃ hinj hsurj fun b ↦ (hex b).trans
    (by simp [eq_comm])
  refine relCochainComplex_shortExact (fun f f' hff' ↦ LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ hinj ?_)
    (fun f ↦ ⟨fun hf ↦ ⟨(T.r : N₂ →ₗ[K] N₁) ∘ₗ f, LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_⟩, ?_⟩)
    (LinearMap.llcomp K M N₃ N₂ T.s) (fun f ↦ LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ T.p_s _) ?_
  · exact LinearMap.congr_fun hff' m
  · have hfm : g₂ (f m) = 0 := LinearMap.congr_fun hf m
    exact T.i_r_of_p_eq_zero hfm
  · rintro ⟨f', rfl⟩
    exact LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ f
    refine LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    change T.s (⁅φ a, f⁆ m) = ⁅φ a, T.s (f m)⁆ - T.s (f ⁅φ a, m⁆)
    rw [LieHom.lie_apply, map_sub, T.s_mem a]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.isZero_relCohomology_hom_of_shortExact_right
statement:
theorem isZero_relCohomology_hom_of_shortExact_right (hN₂ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap N₂ φ μ = ⊤)
    (hN₃ : ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOfMap N₃ φ μ = ⊤) (hinj : Function.Injective g₁)
    (hex : Function.Exact g₁ g₂) (hsurj : Function.Surjective g₂) {n : ℕ}
    (h₁ : IsZero (relCohomology K L (M →ₗ[K] N₁) (Set.range φ) n))
    (h₃ : IsZero (relCohomology K L (M →ₗ[K] N₃) (Set.range φ) n)) :
    IsZero (relCohomology K L (M →ₗ[K] N₂) (Set.range φ) n)
proof:
:=
  ((homPostcomp_shortExact (M := M) φ hN₂ hN₃ hinj hex hsurj).homology_exact₂ n).isZero_X₂
    (h₁.eq_of_src _ _) (h₃.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.toCoord_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma toCoord_tmul (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) (x : X) :
    toCoord p Ψ (ω ⊗ₜ x) = ExteriorAlgebra.map p ω ⊗ₜ Ψ x
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.ofCoord_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofCoord_tmul (e : ExteriorAlgebra K V) (q : P) :
    ofCoord Ψ (e ⊗ₜ q) = ExteriorAlgebra.map V.subtype e ⊗ₜ Ψ.symm q
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.wedgeV_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma wedgeV_tmul (x : V) (e : ExteriorAlgebra K V) (q : P) :
    wedgeV (J := J) x (e ⊗ₜ q) = (ι K x * e) ⊗ₜ q
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.map_map_subtype
statement:
lemma map_map_subtype (e : ExteriorAlgebra K V) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.map p (ExteriorAlgebra.map V.subtype e) = e
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, map_comp_map,
    show p ∘ₗ V.subtype = LinearMap.id from LinearMap.ext hp, ExteriorAlgebra.map_id,
    AlgHom.id_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.toCoord_ofCoord
statement: @[simp] lemma toCoord_ofCoord (z : EP) : toCoord p Ψ (ofCoord Ψ z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul e q => simp [map_map_subtype hp]
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.toCoord_wedge
statement:
lemma toCoord_wedge (y : L) (c : EX) :
    toCoord p Ψ (wedge K L X y c) = wedgeV (p y) (toCoord p Ψ c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul ω x => simp [map_mul, map_apply_ι]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.ofCoord_wedgeV
statement:
lemma ofCoord_wedgeV (x : V) (z : EP) :
    ofCoord Ψ (wedgeV x z) = wedge K L X (x : L) (ofCoord Ψ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul e q => simp [map_mul, map_apply_ι]
  | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, hz, hz']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.wedgeV_mem
statement:
lemma wedgeV_mem (x : V) {q n : ℕ} {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) :
    wedgeV x z ∈ rectangle (q + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, r, hr, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [wedgeV_tmul]
    apply tmul_mem_rectangle _ hr
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ']
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x) he
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (rectangle (q + 1) n).zero_mem
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r z _ hz => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hz

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.basisWord_cons_tmul
statement:
lemma basisWord_cons_tmul (j : J) (l : List J) (q : P) :
    basisWord b (j :: l) ⊗ₜ[K] q = wedgeV (b j) (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[K] q)
proof:
:= by
  simp [basisWord]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.delta_wedgeV
statement:
lemma delta_wedgeV (s : Finset J) (j : J) (hj : j ∈ s) (e : ExteriorAlgebra K V) (q : P) :
    Koszul.delta b s ((ι K (b j) * e) ⊗ₜ[K] q) =
      e ⊗ₜ[K] (MvPolynomial.X j * q) - wedgeV (b j) (Koszul.delta b s (e ⊗ₜ[K] q))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change Koszul.delta b s (Koszul.wedge b j e ⊗ₜ[K] q) = _
  simp only [Koszul.delta, LinearMap.sum_apply, Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul, Koszul.contract_wedge,
    sub_tmul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, map_sum, wedgeV_tmul]
  simp only [Koszul.wedge_apply]
  congr 1
  simp [Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, TensorProduct.ite_tmul, hj]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.lieAction_error
statement:
lemma lieAction_error (y : L) (l : List J) (n : ℕ) {q : P}
    (hq : q ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree J K n) :
    toCoord p Ψ (lieAction K L X y (ofCoord Ψ (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ q))) -
      basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[K] Ψ ⁅y, Ψ.symm q⁆ ∈ rectangle l.length n
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [basisWord]
  | cons i l ih =>
    rw [basisWord_cons_tmul, basisWord_cons_tmul, ofCoord_wedgeV, lieAction_wedge, map_add,
      toCoord_wedge, toCoord_wedge, toCoord_ofCoord (hp := hp), hp, add_sub_assoc, ← map_sub]
    exact add_mem (wedgeV_mem _ (tmul_mem_rectangle
      (Koszul.basisWord_mem_exteriorPower b l) hq)) (wedgeV_mem _ ih)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relDiff_add_delta_basisWord
statement:
theorem relDiff_add_delta_basisWord (s : Finset J) (l : List J) (hl : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ s)
    (n : ℕ) {q : P} (hq : q ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree J K n) :
    relDiff p Ψ (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ q) + Koszul.delta b s (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ q) ∈
      rectangle (l.length - 1) n
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp [relDiff, basisWord, Koszul.delta, Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul, Koszul.contract]
  | cons j l ih =>
    have haction : toCoord p Ψ (lieAction K L X (b j) (ofCoord Ψ (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ q))) -
        basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[K] (MvPolynomial.X j * q) ∈ rectangle l.length n := by
      have h1 := lieAction_error (X := X) (hp := hp) (Ψ := Ψ) (b := b) (b j) l n hq
      have h2 : basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[K] Ψ ⁅(b j : L), Ψ.symm q⁆ -
          basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[K] (MvPolynomial.X j * q) ∈ rectangle l.length n := by
        rw [← TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
        exact tmul_mem_rectangle (Koszul.basisWord_mem_exteriorPower b l) (hlead j n q hq)
      convert add_mem h1 h2 using 1
      abel
    have htail : wedgeV (b j) (relDiff p Ψ (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ q) +
        Koszul.delta b s (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ q)) ∈ rectangle l.length n := by
      cases l with
      | nil => simp [relDiff, basisWord, Koszul.delta, Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul, Koszul.contract]
      | cons i l => exact wedgeV_mem _ (ih fun i hi ↦ hl i (List.mem_cons_of_mem j hi))
    have hw : basisWord b (j :: l) = ι K (b j) * basisWord b l := by simp [basisWord]
    rw [hw, delta_wedgeV b s j (hl j (by simp)), ← wedgeV_tmul, relDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, ofCoord_wedgeV, diff_wedge, map_sub, map_neg, toCoord_wedge, hp]
    simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    convert sub_mem (neg_mem haction) htail using 1
    simp only [relDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_add]
    abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relDiff_add_delta_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, r, hq, hl, hr, rfl⟩ := hz
    simpa only [hq] using relDiff_add_delta_basisWord (hp := hp) (b := b) (Ψ := Ψ)
      (hlead := hlead) (s := s) (l := l) hl n hr
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add, add_add_add_comm] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r z _ hz =>
    simpa only [map_smul, smul_add] using Submodule.smul_mem (rectangle (q - 1) n) r hz

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.wedgeV_zero
statement: lemma wedgeV_zero (z : EP) : wedgeV 0 z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul e q => simp
  | add z z' h h' => rw [map_add, h, h', add_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.toCoord_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma toCoord_eq_zero_of_mem (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) {w : EX}
    (hw : w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η) : toCoord p Ψ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem a w hw =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hw
    rw [toCoord_wedge, hr.map_eta, wedgeV_zero]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add w w' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add, h, h', add_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.wedge_mem_wedgeRange_of_mem
statement:
lemma wedge_mem_wedgeRange_of_mem (y : L) {w : EX} (hw : w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η) :
    wedge K L X y w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem a w hw =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hw
    have e : wedge K L X y (wedge K L X (η a) c) = wedge K L X (η a) (-wedge K L X y c) := by
      induction c with
      | tmul ω x =>
        rw [map_neg, wedge_tmul, wedge_tmul, wedge_tmul, wedge_tmul, ← neg_tmul, ← mul_assoc,
          ← mul_assoc, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (ExteriorAlgebra.ι_add_mul_swap y (η a)),
          neg_mul]
      | add c c' h h' => simp only [map_add, map_neg, h, h', neg_add]
    rw [e]
    exact wedge_mem_wedgeRange η a _
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (wedgeRange K L X η).zero_mem
  | add w w' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.ofCoord_toCoord_tmul
statement:
lemma ofCoord_toCoord_tmul (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) (x : X) :
    ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ (ω ⊗ₜ x)) = ExteriorAlgebra.map (V.subtype ∘ₗ p) ω ⊗ₜ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [toCoord_tmul, ofCoord_tmul, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, map_comp_map, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.sub_ofCoord_toCoord_mem
statement:
lemma sub_ofCoord_toCoord_mem (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (c : EX) :
    c - ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ c) ∈ wedgeRange K L X η
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul ω x =>
    rw [ofCoord_toCoord_tmul, ← sub_tmul]
    induction ω using exterior_induction with
    | algebraMap r => simp [AlgHom.commutes]
    | add ω ω' h h' =>
      rw [map_add, add_sub_add_comm, add_tmul]
      exact add_mem h h'
    | ι_mul y ω h =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hr.sub_mem y
      have e : (ι K y * ω - ExteriorAlgebra.map (V.subtype ∘ₗ p) (ι K y * ω)) ⊗ₜ[K] x =
          wedge K L X (η a) (ω ⊗ₜ x) + wedge K L X (p y : L)
            ((ω - ExteriorAlgebra.map (V.subtype ∘ₗ p) ω) ⊗ₜ x) := by
        rw [wedge_tmul, wedge_tmul, ← add_tmul, map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, ← ha,
          map_sub, sub_mul, mul_sub]
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]
        congr 1
        abel
      rw [e]
      exact add_mem (wedge_mem_wedgeRange η a _) (wedge_mem_wedgeRange_of_mem _ h)
  | add c c' h h' =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact add_mem h h'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.mem_of_toCoord_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mem_of_toCoord_eq_zero (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) {c : EX} (hc : toCoord p Ψ c = 0) :
    c ∈ wedgeRange K L X η
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hc] using sub_ofCoord_toCoord_mem (Ψ := Ψ) hr c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.map_extDeriv
statement:
lemma map_extDeriv {f D : L →ₗ[K] L} (h : ∀ y, f (D y) = D (f y)) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.map f (extDeriv D ω) = extDeriv D (ExteriorAlgebra.map f ω)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω using exterior_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp [AlgHom.commutes]
  | add ω ω' h h' => simp only [map_add, h, h']
  | ι_mul y ω ih =>
    rw [extDeriv_ι_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι,
      ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, ih, map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, extDeriv_ι_mul, h]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.ofCoord_toCoord_θ
statement:
lemma ofCoord_toCoord_θ (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (a : H) (c : EX) :
    ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ (ρ.θ a c)) = ρ.θ a (ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ c))
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul ω x =>
    rw [ρ.θ_tmul, map_add, map_add, ofCoord_toCoord_tmul, ofCoord_toCoord_tmul,
      ofCoord_toCoord_tmul, ρ.θ_tmul, map_extDeriv]
    intro y
    simp [hr.D_eq, hr.map_ad]
  | add c c' h h' => simp only [map_add, h, h']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.Pr_ofCoord_toCoord
statement:
lemma Pr_ofCoord_toCoord (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (c : EX) :
    Pr hT (ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ c)) = ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ (Pr hT c))
proof:
:=
  Module.End.weightProj_comm_of_mapsTo hT 0 (ofCoord Ψ ∘ₗ toCoord p Ψ)
    (fun ν c hc a ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [← ofCoord_toCoord_θ (Ψ := Ψ) hr a c, hc a, map_smul, map_smul]) c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.Pr_diff
statement: lemma Pr_diff (c : EX) : Pr hT (diff K L X c) = diff K L X (Pr hT c)
proof:
:=
  Module.End.weightProj_comm_of_mapsTo hT 0 (diff K L X)
    (fun ν c hc a ↦ by rw [← ρ.diff_θ, hc a, map_smul]) c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.Pr_wedge
statement:
lemma Pr_wedge (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (a : H) (c : EX) :
    Pr hT (wedge K L X (η a) c) = wedge K L X (η a) (Pr hT c)
proof:
:=
  Module.End.weightProj_comm_of_mapsTo hT 0 _ (fun ν c hc b ↦ by
    rw [ρ.θ_wedge, hr.D_eq, LieAlgebra.ad_apply, hr.lie_eta, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      zero_add, hc b, map_smul]) c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.Pr_Pr
statement: lemma Pr_Pr (c : EX) : Pr hT (Pr hT c) = Pr hT c
proof:
:=
  Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT (Module.End.weightProj_mem hT 0 c)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.θ_Pr
statement: lemma θ_Pr (a : H) (c : EX) : ρ.θ a (Pr hT c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := Module.End.weightProj_mem hT 0 c a
  simpa using h

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.lieAction_eq_θ
statement: lemma lieAction_eq_θ (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (a : H) : lieAction K L X (η a) = ρ.θ a
proof:
:= by
  have : ρ.φ a = toEnd K L X (η a) := LinearMap.ext (hr.φ_eq a)
  rw [ρ.θ_apply, hr.D_eq, this]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.diff_Pr_mem
statement:
lemma diff_Pr_mem (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) {w : EX} (hw : w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η) :
    diff K L X (Pr hT w) ∈ wedgeRange K L X η
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem a w hw =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hw
    rw [Pr_wedge hT hr, diff_wedge, lieAction_eq_θ hr, θ_Pr, neg_zero, zero_sub]
    exact neg_mem (wedge_mem_wedgeRange η a _)
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (wedgeRange K L X η).zero_mem
  | add w w' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem h h'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.ofCoord_prZero
statement:
lemma ofCoord_prZero (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (z : EP) :
    ofCoord Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z) = Pr hT (ofCoord Ψ z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prZero, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, ← Pr_ofCoord_toCoord Ψ hT hr,
    toCoord_ofCoord (hp := hp)]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_toCoord
statement:
lemma prZero_toCoord (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (c : EX) :
    prZero p Ψ hT (toCoord p Ψ c) = toCoord p Ψ (Pr hT c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prZero, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Pr_ofCoord_toCoord Ψ hT hr,
    toCoord_ofCoord (hp := hp)]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_prZero
statement:
lemma prZero_prZero (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (z : EP) :
    prZero p Ψ hT (prZero p Ψ hT z) = prZero p Ψ hT z
proof:
:= by
  change toCoord p Ψ (Pr hT (ofCoord Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z))) = _
  rw [ofCoord_prZero Ψ hp hT hr, Pr_Pr]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relDiff_toCoord_Pr
statement:
lemma relDiff_toCoord_Pr (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (c : EX) :
    relDiff p Ψ (toCoord p Ψ (Pr hT c)) = toCoord p Ψ (diff K L X (Pr hT c))
proof:
:= by
  set w := Pr hT c - ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ (Pr hT c))
  have hw : w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η := sub_ofCoord_toCoord_mem (Ψ := Ψ) hr _
  have hPw : Pr hT w = w := by
    simp only [w, map_sub, Pr_ofCoord_toCoord Ψ hT hr, Pr_Pr]
  have h0 : toCoord p Ψ (diff K L X w) = 0 := by
    rw [← hPw]
    exact toCoord_eq_zero_of_mem Ψ hr (diff_Pr_mem hT hr hw)
  have e : ofCoord Ψ (toCoord p Ψ (Pr hT c)) = Pr hT c - w := by simp only [w, sub_sub_cancel]
  rw [relDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, e, map_sub, map_sub, h0, sub_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relDiff_prZero
statement:
lemma relDiff_prZero (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (z : EP) :
    relDiff p Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z) = toCoord p Ψ (diff K L X (Pr hT (ofCoord Ψ z)))
proof:
:=
  relDiff_toCoord_Pr Ψ hT hr _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relDiff_relDiff_prZero
statement:
lemma relDiff_relDiff_prZero (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (z : EP) :
    relDiff p Ψ (relDiff p Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : diff K L X (Pr hT (ofCoord Ψ z)) = Pr hT (diff K L X (Pr hT (ofCoord Ψ z))) := by
    rw [Pr_diff hT, Pr_Pr]
  rw [relDiff_prZero Ψ hT hr, e, relDiff_toCoord_Pr Ψ hT hr, ← e, diff_diff, map_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_relDiff_prZero
statement:
lemma prZero_relDiff_prZero (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (z : EP) :
    prZero p Ψ hT (relDiff p Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z)) = relDiff p Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [relDiff_prZero Ψ hT hr, prZero_toCoord Ψ hp hT hr, Pr_diff hT, Pr_Pr]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.wordWt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordWt_nil : wordWt wt [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.wordWt_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma wordWt_cons (j : J) (l : List J) : wordWt wt (j :: l) = wt j + wordWt wt l
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordWt]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.monoWt_single_add
statement:
lemma monoWt_single_add (i : J) (m : J →₀ ℕ) :
    monoWt wt (Finsupp.single i 1 + m) = wt i + monoWt wt m
proof:
:= by
  rw [monoWt, Finsupp.sum_add_index' (h := fun j (k : ℕ) ↦ k • wt j) (fun _ ↦ zero_smul ℕ _)
    (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _),
    Finsupp.sum_single_index (h := fun j (k : ℕ) ↦ k • wt j) (zero_smul ℕ _), one_smul,
    monoWt]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.basisWord_mem_wordSpan
statement: lemma basisWord_mem_wordSpan (l : List J) : basisWord b l ∈ wordSpan b wt (wordWt wt l)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.ι_mul_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma ι_mul_mem_wordSpan (j : J) {μ : Dual K H} {e : ExteriorAlgebra K V}
    (he : e ∈ wordSpan b wt μ) : ι K (b j) * e ∈ wordSpan b wt (wt j + μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction he using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem e he =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl, rfl⟩ := he
    have : ι K (b j) * basisWord b l = basisWord b (j :: l) := by simp [basisWord]
    rw [this, ← wordWt_cons]
    exact basisWord_mem_wordSpan b wt _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.contract_basisWord_mem
statement:
lemma contract_basisWord_mem (i : J) (l : List J) :
    Koszul.contract b i (basisWord b l) ∈ wordSpan b wt (wordWt wt l - wt i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [basisWord, Koszul.contract, CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_one]
  | cons j l ih =>
    have hw : basisWord b (j :: l) = Koszul.wedge b j (basisWord b l) := by simp [basisWord]
    rw [hw, Koszul.contract_wedge]
    refine sub_mem ?_ ?_
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
        simpa using basisWord_mem_wordSpan b wt l
      · simp [Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self, Ne.symm hij]
    · have := ι_mul_mem_wordSpan b wt j ih
      rw [wordWt_cons, add_sub_assoc]
      simpa using this

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.contract_basisWord_eq_zero
statement:
lemma contract_basisWord_eq_zero {i : J} {l : List J} (hi : i ∉ l) :
    Koszul.contract b i (basisWord b l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [basisWord, Koszul.contract, CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_one]
  | cons j l ih =>
    have hw : basisWord b (j :: l) = Koszul.wedge b j (basisWord b l) := by simp [basisWord]
    have hij : i ≠ j := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self)
    rw [hw, Koszul.contract_wedge, ih (fun h ↦ hi (List.mem_cons_of_mem j h))]
    simp [Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self, Ne.symm hij]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.span_basisWord
statement: lemma span_basisWord : Submodule.span K (Set.range (basisWord b)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun e _ ↦ ?_
  clear ‹e ∈ ⊤›
  induction e using exterior_induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], by simp [basisWord]⟩)
  | add e e' h h' => exact add_mem h h'
  | ι_mul y e h =>
    have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range b) := b.span_eq ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hy
      induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem e he =>
        obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := he
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j :: l, by simp [basisWord]⟩
      | zero => simp
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul r x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul, smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.extDeriv_map_basisWord
statement:
lemma extDeriv_map_basisWord (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) (a : H) (l : List J) :
    extDeriv (ρ.D a) (ExteriorAlgebra.map V.subtype (basisWord b l)) =
      wordWt wt l a • ExteriorAlgebra.map V.subtype (basisWord b l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [basisWord]
  | cons j l ih =>
    have e : ExteriorAlgebra.map V.subtype (basisWord b (j :: l)) =
        ι K (b j : L) * ExteriorAlgebra.map V.subtype (basisWord b l) := by
      simp [basisWord, map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι]
    rw [e, extDeriv_ι_mul, ih, hw.basis, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← add_smul,
      wordWt_cons, LinearMap.add_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.extDeriv_map_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction he using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem e he =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl, rfl⟩ := he
    exact extDeriv_map_basisWord hw a l
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hx, smul_comm]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.tmul_mem_coordWt
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have hm : MvPolynomial.monomial m r = r • MvPolynomial.monomial m (1 : K) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [ofCoord_tmul, ρ.θ_tmul, extDeriv_map_mem hw a he, hm, map_smul, map_smul, hw.monomial,
    smul_comm r, tmul_smul, tmul_smul, ← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← add_smul,
    add_assoc, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, mul_comm]
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply]
  ring

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.delta_mem_coordWt
statement:
lemma delta_mem_coordWt (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) (s : Finset J) (l : List J)
    (m : J →₀ ℕ) (r : K) :
    Koszul.delta b s (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ MvPolynomial.monomial m r) ∈
      coordWt Ψ ρ (wordWt wt l + c + monoWt wt m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Koszul.delta, LinearMap.sum_apply, Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul]
  convert tmul_mem_coordWt hw (contract_basisWord_mem b wt i l) _ r using 2
  rw [monoWt_single_add]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_of_mem
statement: lemma prZero_of_mem {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ coordWt Ψ ρ 0) : prZero p Ψ hT z = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [prZero, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT hz,
    toCoord_ofCoord (hp := hp)]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma prZero_of_mem_ne {ν : Dual K H} (hν : ν ≠ 0) {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ coordWt Ψ ρ ν) :
    prZero p Ψ hT z = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [prZero, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Module.End.weightProj_of_mem_ne hT hν hz, map_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_delta
statement:
lemma prZero_delta (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) (s : Finset J) (z : EP) :
    prZero p Ψ hT (Koszul.delta b s z) = Koszul.delta b s (prZero p Ψ hT z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | add z z' h h' => simp only [map_add, h, h']
  | tmul e q =>
    have he : e ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (basisWord b)) :=
      (span_basisWord b).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction he using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem e he =>
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := he
      induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
      | monomial m r =>
        have hg := tmul_mem_coordWt hw (basisWord_mem_wordSpan b wt l) m r
        have hd := delta_mem_coordWt hw s l m r
        by_cases hν : wordWt wt l + c + monoWt wt m = 0
        · rw [hν] at hg hd
          rw [prZero_of_mem hp hT hd, prZero_of_mem hp hT hg]
        · rw [prZero_of_mem_ne hT hν hd, prZero_of_mem_ne hT hν hg, map_zero]
      | add q q' h h' => simp only [tmul_add, map_add, h, h']
    | zero => simp only [zero_tmul, map_zero]
    | add e e' _ _ h h' => simp only [add_tmul, map_add, h, h']
    | smul r e _ h => simp only [← smul_tmul', map_smul, h]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.supportedTensors_le_rectangle
statement:
lemma supportedTensors_le_rectangle (s : Finset J) (q n : ℕ) :
    supportedTensors b s q n ≤ rectangle q n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨l, r, hl, -, hr, rfl⟩
  exact tmul_mem_rectangle (hl ▸ Koszul.basisWord_mem_exteriorPower b l) hr

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_mem_supportedTensors
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, r, hl, hs, hr, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum r, tmul_sum, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun m hm ↦ ?_
    have hmem : basisWord b l ⊗ₜ MvPolynomial.monomial m (r.coeff m) ∈
        supportedTensors b s q n :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, _, hl, hs,
        (MvPolynomial.monomial_mem_restrictSupport K).mpr (Or.inl (hr hm)), rfl⟩
    have hg := tmul_mem_coordWt hw (basisWord_mem_wordSpan b wt l) m (r.coeff m)
    by_cases hν : wordWt wt l + c + monoWt wt m = 0
    · rw [hν] at hg
      rwa [prZero_of_mem hp hT hg]
    · rw [prZero_of_mem_ne hT hν hg]
      exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, zero_mem]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_mem_rectangle
statement:
lemma prZero_mem_rectangle (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) {q n : ℕ} {z : EP}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) : prZero p Ψ hT z ∈ rectangle q n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Koszul.exists_support_rectangle b q n hz
  exact supportedTensors_le_rectangle s q n (prZero_mem_supportedTensors hp hT hw hs)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.delta_univ_eq
statement:
lemma delta_univ_eq [Fintype J] {s : Finset J} {q n : ℕ} {z : EP}
    (hz : z ∈ supportedTensors b s q n) : Koszul.delta b Finset.univ z = Koszul.delta b s z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, r, -, hs, -, rfl⟩ := hz
    simp only [Koszul.delta, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) fun i _ hi ↦ ?_
    rw [Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul, contract_basisWord_eq_zero b fun h ↦ hi (hs i h), zero_tmul]
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hx]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.map_mem_exteriorPower
statement:
lemma map_mem_exteriorPower {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module K N] (f : M →ₗ[K] N) {q : ℕ} {ω : ExteriorAlgebra K M} (hω : ω ∈ ⋀[K]^q M) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.map f ω ∈ ⋀[K]^q N
proof:
:= by
  have h : (⋀[K]^q M).map (ExteriorAlgebra.map f).toLinearMap ≤ ⋀[K]^q N := by
    rw [exteriorPower, Submodule.map_pow]
    refine pow_le_pow_left' ?_ q
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f y, by simp⟩
  exact h ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.toCoord_mem_rectangle
statement:
lemma toCoord_mem_rectangle {q : ℕ} {t : EX} (ht : t ∈ chainsIn K L X q) :
    ∃ n, toCoord p Ψ t ∈ rectangle q n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := ht
  induction t with
  | tmul ω x =>
    refine ⟨(Ψ x).totalDegree, ?_⟩
    rw [incl_tmul, toCoord_tmul]
    exact tmul_mem_rectangle (map_mem_exteriorPower p ω.2)
      ((MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mpr le_rfl)
  | add t t' h h' =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := h'
    refine ⟨max n n', ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact add_mem (Koszul.rectangle_mono q (le_max_left _ _) hn)
      (Koszul.rectangle_mono q (le_max_right _ _) hn')

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.ofCoord_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma ofCoord_mem_chainsIn {q n : ℕ} {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) :
    ofCoord Ψ z ∈ chainsIn K L X q
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, r, -, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [ofCoord_tmul]
    exact tmul_mem_chainsIn (map_mem_exteriorPower _ he) _
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, zero_mem]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relKoszulOp_apply
statement:
lemma relKoszulOp_apply (z : EP) : relKoszulOp p Ψ b hT z =
    relDiff p Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z) - Koszul.delta b Finset.univ (z - prZero p Ψ hT z)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.prZero_relKoszulOp
statement:
lemma prZero_relKoszulOp (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) (z : EP) :
    prZero p Ψ hT (relKoszulOp p Ψ b hT z) = relDiff p Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [relKoszulOp_apply, map_sub, prZero_relDiff_prZero Ψ hp hT hr, prZero_delta hp hT hw,
    map_sub, prZero_prZero Ψ hp hT hr, sub_self, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relKoszulOp_relKoszulOp
statement:
lemma relKoszulOp_relKoszulOp (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) (z : EP) :
    relKoszulOp p Ψ b hT (relKoszulOp p Ψ b hT z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := prZero_relKoszulOp hp hT hr hw z
  rw [relKoszulOp_apply (z := relKoszulOp p Ψ b hT z), h, relDiff_relDiff_prZero Ψ hT hr,
    relKoszulOp_apply (z := z), sub_sub_cancel_left, map_neg,
    ← Module.End.mul_apply, Koszul.delta_sq, LinearMap.zero_apply, neg_zero, sub_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.isLeadingKoszul_relKoszulOp
statement:
lemma isLeadingKoszul_relKoszulOp (hlead : IsLeading Ψ b) (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) :
    Koszul.IsLeadingKoszul b (relKoszulOp p Ψ b hT)
proof:
:= by
  intro s q n z hz
  have h1 := prZero_mem_supportedTensors hp hT hw hz
  rw [relKoszulOp_apply, map_sub, delta_univ_eq hz, delta_univ_eq h1]
  convert relDiff_add_delta_mem hp hlead s q n h1 using 1
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.relExact
statement:
theorem relExact [CharZero K] [Finite J] (hlead : IsLeading Ψ b) (hr : IsRelData η ρ p)
    (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) {k : ℕ} (t : EX) (ht : t ∈ ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) 0)
    (hdt : diff K L X t ∈ wedgeRange K L X η) :
    ∃ s ∈ ρ.chainPiece (k + 2) 0, t - diff K L X s ∈ wedgeRange K L X η
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite J
  obtain ⟨n, hz⟩ := toCoord_mem_rectangle (p := p) (Ψ := Ψ) ht.1
  have hPt : Pr hT t = t := Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT ht.2
  have hprz : prZero p Ψ hT (toCoord p Ψ t) = toCoord p Ψ t := by
    rw [prZero_toCoord Ψ hp hT hr, hPt]
  have hrel : relDiff p Ψ (toCoord p Ψ t) = 0 := by
    have := relDiff_toCoord_Pr Ψ hT hr t
    rw [hPt] at this
    rw [this]
    exact toCoord_eq_zero_of_mem Ψ hr hdt
  have hDz : relKoszulOp p Ψ b hT (toCoord p Ψ t) = 0 := by
    rw [relKoszulOp_apply, hprz, hrel, sub_self, map_zero, sub_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hDy⟩ := Koszul.exists_primitive_of_isLeadingKoszul b
    (isLeadingKoszul_relKoszulOp hp hT hlead hw) (relKoszulOp_relKoszulOp hp hT hr hw) (k + 1) n
    (Nat.succ_pos k) hz hDz
  have hy0 : relDiff p Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT y) = toCoord p Ψ t := by
    have := congrArg (prZero p Ψ hT) hDy
    rwa [prZero_relKoszulOp hp hT hr hw, hprz] at this
  refine ⟨ofCoord Ψ (prZero p Ψ hT y),
    ⟨ofCoord_mem_chainsIn (Ψ := Ψ) (prZero_mem_rectangle hp hT hw hy), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [ofCoord_prZero Ψ hp hT hr]
    exact Module.End.weightProj_mem hT 0 _
  · refine mem_of_toCoord_eq_zero Ψ hr ?_
    rw [map_sub, ← hy0, relDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, sub_self]

name: Module.End.repr_apply_of_mem_weightSpaceOf
statement:
lemma repr_apply_of_mem_weightSpaceOf (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ weightSpaceOf T (w i)) (a : H) (m : M)
    (i : ι) : b.repr (T a m) i = w i a * b.repr m i
proof:
:= by
  have : (Finsupp.lapply i ∘ₗ b.repr.toLinearMap ∘ₗ T a) =
      w i a • (Finsupp.lapply i ∘ₗ b.repr.toLinearMap) := by
    refine b.ext fun j ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      mem_weightSpaceOf.mp (hb j) a, map_smul, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.lapply_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hij : j = i
    · subst hij; rfl
    · simp [hij]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: Module.End.weightSpaceOf_eq_span_image
statement:
theorem weightSpaceOf_eq_span_image (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ weightSpaceOf T (w i)) (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpaceOf T μ = Submodule.span K (b '' {i | w i = μ})
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun m hm ↦ ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rw [b.mem_span_image]
    intro i hi
    refine LinearMap.ext fun a ↦ ?_
    have h1 := repr_apply_of_mem_weightSpaceOf T b w hb a m i
    rw [mem_weightSpaceOf.mp hm a, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h1
    exact (mul_right_cancel₀ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) h1).symm
  · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    rw [← Set.mem_ofPred_eq.mp hi]
    exact hb i

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainBasis_apply
statement:
lemma chainBasis_apply (t : Finset I × J) :
    chainBasis bL bM t = bL.ExteriorAlgebra t.1 ⊗ₜ bM t.2
proof:
:=
  Basis.tensorProduct_apply' _ _ t

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.basis_exteriorAlgebra_eq
statement:
lemma basis_exteriorAlgebra_eq (S : Finset I) :
    bL.ExteriorAlgebra S = ιMulti K S.card (bL ∘ S.orderEmbOfFin rfl)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ExteriorAlgebra.basis_apply]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.basis_exteriorAlgebra_mem
statement: lemma basis_exteriorAlgebra_mem (S : Finset I) : bL.ExteriorAlgebra S ∈ ⋀[K]^S.card L
proof:
:= by
  rw [basis_exteriorAlgebra_eq]
  exact ιMulti_range K S.card ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainBasis_mem_chainsIn
statement: lemma chainBasis_mem_chainsIn (t : Finset I × J) : chainBasis bL bM t ∈ chainsIn K L M t.1.card
proof:
:=
  chainBasis_apply bL bM t ▸ tmul_mem_chainsIn (basis_exteriorAlgebra_mem bL t.1) _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainWt_apply
statement: lemma chainWt_apply (t : Finset I × J) : chainWt γ ν t = ∑ i ∈ t.1, γ i + ν t.2
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.ιMulti_tmul_mem_chainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma ιMulti_tmul_mem_chainWeightSpace {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → L) (g : Fin n → Dual K H)
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D (g i)) {m : M} {ν₀ : Dual K H}
    (hm : m ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν₀) :
    ιMulti K n f ⊗ₜ m ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace (∑ i, g i + ν₀)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using ρ.one_tmul_mem_chainWeightSpace hm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [ιMulti_succ_apply, ← wedge_tmul, Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc]
    exact ρ.wedge_mem_chainWeightSpace (hf 0)
      (ih (Matrix.vecTail f) (Matrix.vecTail g) fun i ↦ hf i.succ)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainBasis_mem_chainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma chainBasis_mem_chainWeightSpace (hbL : ∀ i, bL i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D (γ i))
    (hbM : ∀ j, bM j ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ (ν j)) (t : Finset I × J) :
    chainBasis bL bM t ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace (chainWt γ ν t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chainBasis_apply, basis_exteriorAlgebra_eq, chainWt]
  have := ιMulti_tmul_mem_chainWeightSpace (ρ := ρ) (bL ∘ t.1.orderEmbOfFin rfl)
    (γ ∘ t.1.orderEmbOfFin rfl) (fun i ↦ hbL _) (hbM t.2)
  convert this using 2
  conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ t.1 rfl]
  rw [Finset.sum_image fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ (t.1.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective h]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainWeightSpace_eq_span
statement:
theorem chainWeightSpace_eq_span (hbL : ∀ i, bL i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D (γ i))
    (hbM : ∀ j, bM j ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ (ν j)) (μ : Dual K H) :
    ρ.chainWeightSpace μ = Submodule.span K (chainBasis bL bM '' {t | chainWt γ ν t = μ})
proof:
:=
  Module.End.weightSpaceOf_eq_span_image ρ.θ (chainBasis bL bM) (chainWt γ ν)
    (chainBasis_mem_chainWeightSpace bL bM hbL hbM) μ

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainsIn_eq_span
statement:
theorem chainsIn_eq_span (k : ℕ) :
    chainsIn K L M k = Submodule.span K (chainBasis bL bM '' {t | t.1.card = k})
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
    induction u with
    | add u u' hu hu' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hu hu'
    | tmul ω m =>
      rw [incl_tmul]
      have hω : (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ∈
          Submodule.span K (bL.ExteriorAlgebra '' {S | S.card = k}) := by
        have h1 : ω ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (bL.exteriorPower k)) :=
          (bL.exteriorPower k).mem_span ω
        have h2 := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (⋀[K]^k L).subtype) h1
        rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at h2
        refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ h2
        rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨s.val, s.prop, ?_⟩
        rw [Function.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, ← basis_eq_coe_basis]
      have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range bM) := bM.mem_span m
      generalize (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) = ω' at hω ⊢
      induction hω using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := hx
        induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem y hy =>
          obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hy
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(S, j), hS, chainBasis_apply bL bM (S, j)⟩
        | zero => simp
        | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [tmul_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
        | smul r y _ hy => rw [tmul_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy
      | zero => simp
      | add x x' _ _ hx hx' => rw [add_tmul]; exact add_mem hx hx'
      | smul r x _ hx => rw [← smul_tmul']; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx
  · rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact (Set.mem_ofPred_eq.mp ht) ▸ chainBasis_mem_chainsIn bL bM t

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace_eq_span
statement:
theorem chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace_eq_span
    (hbL : ∀ i, bL i ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D (γ i))
    (hbM : ∀ j, bM j ∈ Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ (ν j)) (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ =
      Submodule.span K (chainBasis bL bM '' {t | t.1.card = k ∧ chainWt γ ν t = μ})
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [Submodule.mem_inf, chainsIn_eq_span bL bM, chainWeightSpace_eq_span bL bM hbL hbM,
    Basis.mem_span_image, Basis.mem_span_image, Basis.mem_span_image, ← Set.subset_inter_iff]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace_eq_span_finset
statement:
lemma chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace_eq_span_finset (k : ℕ) :
    chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ =
      Submodule.span K (Set.range fun t : s.filter (fun t ↦ t.1.card = k) ↦
        chainBasis bL bM t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace_eq_span bL bM hbL hbM]
  congr 1
  ext c
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range, Subtype.exists, Finset.mem_filter,
    ← hs]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, ⟨h2, h1⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨h2, h1⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, ⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.finiteDimensional_chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma finiteDimensional_chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace (k : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional K ↥(chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace_eq_span_finset bL bM hbL hbM hs k]
  exact FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite K (Set.finite_range _)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.finrank_chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace (k : ℕ) :
    finrank K ↥(chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) =
      (s.filter fun t ↦ t.1.card = k).card
proof:
:= by
  have hli : LinearIndependent K fun t : s.filter (fun t ↦ t.1.card = k) ↦ chainBasis bL bM t :=
    (chainBasis bL bM).linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective
  rw [chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace_eq_span_finset bL bM hbL hbM hs k, finrank_span_eq_card hli,
    Fintype.card_coe]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_chains
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_chains {N : ℕ} (hN : ∀ t ∈ s, t.1.card ≤ N) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * finrank K ↥(chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) =
      ∑ t ∈ s, (-1 : ℤ) ^ t.1.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := fun t : Finset I × J ↦ t.1.card)
    (t := Finset.range (N + 1)) fun t ht ↦ Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hN t ht))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [finrank_chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace bL bM hbL hbM hs k, Finset.sum_congr rfl
    fun t ht ↦ by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2], Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.iSup_weightSpaceOf_D
statement: lemma iSup_weightSpaceOf_D : ⨆ γ', Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ' = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun y _ ↦ Submodule.span_le.mpr (by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (γ i) (hbL i)) (bL.mem_span y)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.iSup_weightSpaceOf_φ
statement: lemma iSup_weightSpaceOf_φ : ⨆ ν', Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν' = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun m _ ↦ Submodule.span_le.mpr (by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (ν j) (hbM j)) (bM.mem_span m)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.boundaries_inf_chainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma boundaries_inf_chainWeightSpace (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    boundaries K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ =
      (chainsIn K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ).map (diff K L M)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro b ⟨hb, hbμ⟩
    have hdec := ρ.iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace (iSup_weightSpaceOf_D bL hbL)
      (iSup_weightSpaceOf_φ bM hbM) (chainsIn K L M (k + 1)) fun a _ hc ↦ ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a hc
    have hb' : b ∈ ⨆ ν', (chainsIn K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν').map (diff K L M) := by
      rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, hdec]
      exact hb
    refine Module.End.mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le ρ.θ _ (fun ν' ↦ ?_) hbμ hb'
    rintro _ ⟨c, ⟨-, hc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ρ.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace hc
  · rintro _ ⟨c, ⟨hc, hcμ⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, ρ.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace hcμ⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.finrank_chainsIn_succ
statement:
lemma finrank_chainsIn_succ (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H)
    [FiniteDimensional K ↥(chainsIn K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ)] :
    finrank K ↥(chainsIn K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) =
      finrank K ↥(cycles K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) +
        finrank K ↥(boundaries K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ)
proof:
:= by
  set C := chainsIn K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ
  
  let _ : AddCommGroup C := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup K
  have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (LinearMap.domRestrict (diff K L M) C)
  rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, LinearMap.ker_domRestrict,
    ← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
    ← boundaries_inf_chainWeightSpace bL bM hbL hbM] at this
  have hC : C ⊓ LinearMap.ker (diff K L M) = cycles K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ := by
    rw [cycles, inf_right_comm]
  rw [← this, hC, add_comm]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_homology
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_homology {N : ℕ} (hN : ∀ t ∈ s, t.1.card ≤ N) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * finrank K (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ) =
      ∑ t ∈ s, (-1 : ℤ) ^ t.1.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_chains bL bM hbL hbM hs hN]
  have hfin := finiteDimensional_chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace (ρ := ρ) bL bM hbL hbM hs
  have hZ : ∀ k, FiniteDimensional K ↥(cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) := fun k ↦
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left :
      cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ ≤ chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ)
  have hzh : ∀ k, (finrank K (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ) : ℤ) +
      finrank K ↥(boundaries K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) =
        finrank K ↥(cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) := fun k ↦ by
    rw [← Nat.cast_add, ρ.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add k μ]
  have hc0 : finrank K ↥(chainsIn K L M 0 ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) =
      finrank K ↥(cycles K L M 0 ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) := by
    rw [cycles_zero]
  have hcs : ∀ k, (finrank K ↥(chainsIn K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) : ℤ) =
      finrank K ↥(cycles K L M (k + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) +
        finrank K ↥(boundaries K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) := fun k ↦ by
    rw [← Nat.cast_add, finrank_chainsIn_succ bL bM hbL hbM k μ]
  have hbN : finrank K ↥(boundaries K L M N ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) = 0 := by
    have h0 : finrank K ↥(chainsIn K L M (N + 1) ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) = 0 := by
      rw [finrank_chainsIn_inf_chainWeightSpace bL bM hbL hbM hs, Finset.card_eq_zero,
        Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
      exact fun t ht h ↦ by have := hN t ht; omega
    rw [boundaries_inf_chainWeightSpace bL bM hbL hbM]
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (h0 ▸ Submodule.finrank_map_le _ _)
  have key : ∀ n, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * finrank K ↥(chainsIn K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * finrank K (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ) +
          (-1) ^ n * finrank K ↥(boundaries K L M n ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [hc0, ← hzh]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1), ih, Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1), hcs, ← hzh,
        pow_succ]
      ring
  rw [key N, hbN]
  simp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.gradeStep_apply
statement:
lemma gradeStep_apply (y : L) (p : ExteriorAlgebra R L × (ℕ → ExteriorAlgebra R L)) (k : ℕ) :
    gradeStep R L y p k = if k = 0 then 0 else ι R y * p.2 (k - 1)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.gradeStep_step
statement:
lemma gradeStep_step (y : L) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (g : ℕ → ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    gradeStep R L y (ι R y * ω, gradeStep R L y (ω, g)) = (0 : QuadraticForm R L) y • g
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [gradeStep_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp [← mul_assoc]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.gradeFun_algebraMap
statement:
lemma gradeFun_algebraMap (r : R) (k : ℕ) :
    gradeFun R L (algebraMap R _ r) k = if k = 0 then algebraMap R _ r else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeFun, CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_algebraMap]
  split_ifs with hk <;> simp [hk, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.gradeFun_ι_mul
statement:
lemma gradeFun_ι_mul (y : L) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (k : ℕ) :
    gradeFun R L (ι R y * ω) k = if k = 0 then 0 else ι R y * gradeFun R L ω (k - 1)
proof:
:=
  congrFun (CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_ι_mul _ _ _ _ _ _) k

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.gradeFun_mem
statement: lemma gradeFun_mem (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (k : ℕ) : gradeFun R L ω k ∈ ⋀[R]^k L
proof:
:= by
  induction ω using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction generalizing k with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [gradeFun_algebraMap]
    split_ifs with hk
    · subst hk; rw [exteriorPower, pow_zero]; exact Submodule.algebraMap_mem r
    · exact zero_mem _
  | add ω ω' hω hω' => rw [map_add, Pi.add_apply]; exact add_mem (hω k) (hω' k)
  | ι_mul ω y hω =>
    rw [gradeFun_ι_mul]
    split_ifs with hk
    · exact zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hk
      rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ']
      exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ y) (hω k)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.gradeFun_of_mem
statement:
lemma gradeFun_of_mem {k : ℕ} {ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L} (hω : ω ∈ ⋀[R]^k L) (j : ℕ) :
    gradeFun R L ω j = if j = k then ω else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing ω j with
  | zero =>
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_zero, Submodule.mem_one] at hω
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hω
    exact gradeFun_algebraMap r j
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ'] at hω
    induction hω using Submodule.mul_induction_on' generalizing j with
    | mem_mul_mem a ha b hb =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ha
      rw [gradeFun_ι_mul]
      rcases j with _ | j
      · simp
      · simp [ih hb j]
    | add a _ b _ ha hb => simp [ha, hb, ite_add_ite]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.degProj_subtype
statement: @[simp] lemma degProj_subtype (k : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[R]^k L) : degProj R L k ω = ω
proof:
:= by
  exact Subtype.ext ((gradeFun_of_mem ω.2 k).trans (ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h ↦ absurd rfl h))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.degProj_comp_subtype
statement: lemma degProj_comp_subtype (k : ℕ) : degProj R L k ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^k L).subtype = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ degProj_subtype k ω

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.proj_incl
statement: @[simp] lemma proj_incl (k : ℕ) (t : ⋀[R]^k L ⊗[R] M) : proj R L M k (incl R L M k t) = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [proj, incl, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp, degProj_comp_subtype,
    LinearMap.rTensor_id, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_injective
statement: lemma incl_injective (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (incl R L M k)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := proj R L M k) (proj_incl k)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_proj_of_mem
statement:
lemma incl_proj_of_mem {k : ℕ} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ chainsIn R L M k) :
    incl R L M k (proj R L M k c) = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hc
  rw [proj_incl]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_tmul
statement:
lemma incl_tmul (k : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[R]^k L) (m : M) :
    incl R L M k (ω ⊗ₜ m) = (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) ⊗ₜ m
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.tmul_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_chainsIn {k : ℕ} {ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L} (hω : ω ∈ ⋀[R]^k L) (m : M) :
    ω ⊗ₜ m ∈ chainsIn R L M k
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨ω, hω⟩ ⊗ₜ m, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.one_tmul_mem_chainsIn
statement: lemma one_tmul_mem_chainsIn (m : M) : (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R L) ⊗ₜ m ∈ chainsIn R L M 0
proof:
:=
  tmul_mem_chainsIn (by rw [exteriorPower, pow_zero]; exact Submodule.one_le.mp le_rfl) m

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma wedge_mem_chainsIn (y : L) {k : ℕ} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ chainsIn R L M k) :
    wedge R L M y c ∈ chainsIn R L M (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hc
  induction t with
  | tmul ω m =>
    rw [incl_tmul, wedge_tmul]
    refine tmul_mem_chainsIn ?_ m
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ']
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ y) ω.2
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ht ht'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainsIn_zero_le
statement:
lemma chainsIn_zero_le {S : Submodule R E} (h : ∀ m : M, (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R L) ⊗ₜ m ∈ S) :
    chainsIn R L M 0 ≤ S
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  induction t with
  | tmul ω m =>
    obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := ω
    change ω ⊗ₜ m ∈ S
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_zero, Submodule.mem_one] at hω
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hω
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_tmul]
    exact h _
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ht ht'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainsIn_succ_le
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  induction t with
  | tmul ω m =>
    obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := ω
    change ω ⊗ₜ m ∈ S
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ'] at hω
    induction hω using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
    | mem_mul_mem a ha b hb =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact h y _ (tmul_mem_chainsIn hb m)
    | add a _ b _ ha hb => rw [add_tmul]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ht ht'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExt_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma derivExt_mem_chainsIn (D : L →ₗ[R] L) (φ : M →ₗ[R] M) {k : ℕ} {c : E}
    (hc : c ∈ chainsIn R L M k) : derivExt D φ c ∈ chainsIn R L M k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing c with
  | zero =>
    refine chainsIn_zero_le (S := (chainsIn R L M 0).comap (derivExt D φ)) (fun m ↦ ?_) hc
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, derivExt_one_tmul]
    exact one_tmul_mem_chainsIn _
  | succ k ih =>
    refine chainsIn_succ_le (S := (chainsIn R L M (k + 1)).comap (derivExt D φ))
      (fun y c hc ↦ ?_) hc
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, derivExt_wedge]
    exact add_mem (wedge_mem_chainsIn _ hc) (wedge_mem_chainsIn _ (ih hc))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_eq_zero_of_mem_chainsIn_zero
statement: lemma diff_eq_zero_of_mem_chainsIn_zero {c : E} (hc : c ∈ chainsIn R L M 0) : diff R L M c = 0
proof:
:=
  chainsIn_zero_le (S := LinearMap.ker (diff R L M)) (fun m ↦ diff_one_tmul m) hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma diff_mem_chainsIn {k : ℕ} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ chainsIn R L M (k + 1)) :
    diff R L M c ∈ chainsIn R L M k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing c with
  | zero =>
    refine chainsIn_succ_le (S := (chainsIn R L M 0).comap (diff R L M)) (fun y c hc ↦ ?_) hc
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, diff_wedge, diff_eq_zero_of_mem_chainsIn_zero hc, map_zero,
      sub_zero]
    exact neg_mem (derivExt_mem_chainsIn _ _ hc)
  | succ k ih =>
    refine chainsIn_succ_le (S := (chainsIn R L M (k + 1)).comap (diff R L M))
      (fun y c hc ↦ ?_) hc
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, diff_wedge]
    exact sub_mem (neg_mem (derivExt_mem_chainsIn _ _ hc)) (wedge_mem_chainsIn _ (ih hc))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_d
statement:
lemma incl_d (k : ℕ) (t : ⋀[R]^(k + 1) L ⊗[R] M) :
    incl R L M k (d R L M k t) = diff R L M (incl R L M (k + 1) t)
proof:
:=
  incl_proj_of_mem (diff_mem_chainsIn ⟨t, rfl⟩)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.d_comp_d
statement: theorem d_comp_d (k : ℕ) : d R L M k ∘ₗ d R L M (k + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  refine incl_injective k ?_
  simp [incl_d]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.d_d
statement: @[simp] lemma d_d (k : ℕ) (t : ⋀[R]^(k + 2) L ⊗[R] M) : d R L M k (d R L M (k + 1) t) = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (d_comp_d k) t

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_d_zero_tmul
statement:
lemma incl_d_zero_tmul (x : L) (m : M) :
    incl R L M 0 (d R L M 0 (⟨ι R x, by simp⟩ ⊗ₜ m)) =
      -((1 : ExteriorAlgebra R L) ⊗ₜ ⁅x, m⁆)
proof:
:= by
  rw [incl_d, incl_tmul, diff_ι_tmul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.mem_cycles_iff
statement:
lemma mem_cycles_iff {k : ℕ} {c : E} :
    c ∈ cycles R L M k ↔ c ∈ chainsIn R L M k ∧ diff R L M c = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_mem_cycles_succ_iff
statement:
lemma incl_mem_cycles_succ_iff {k : ℕ} {t : ⋀[R]^(k + 1) L ⊗[R] M} :
    incl R L M (k + 1) t ∈ cycles R L M (k + 1) ↔ d R L M k t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cycles_iff, ← incl_d, map_eq_zero_iff _ (incl_injective k)]
  exact and_iff_right ⟨t, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cycles_zero
statement: lemma cycles_zero : cycles R L M 0 = chainsIn R L M 0
proof:
:=
  inf_eq_left.mpr fun _ hc ↦ diff_eq_zero_of_mem_chainsIn_zero hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.boundaries_le_cycles
statement: lemma boundaries_le_cycles (k : ℕ) : boundaries R L M k ≤ cycles R L M k
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨diff_mem_chainsIn hc, diff_diff c⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.boundaries_eq_map_d
statement:
lemma boundaries_eq_map_d (k : ℕ) :
    boundaries R L M k = (LinearMap.range (d R L M k)).map (incl R L M k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaries, chainsIn, LinearMap.range_eq_map, LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← Submodule.map_comp,
    ← Submodule.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact LinearMap.ext fun t ↦ (incl_d k t).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.ker_mkQ_cycles
statement:
theorem ker_mkQ_cycles (k : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker ((boundaries R L M k).mkQ.domRestrict (cycles R L M k)) =
      (boundaries R L M k).comap (cycles R L M k).subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  simp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_mapChains
statement:
lemma incl_mapChains (k : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (t : ⋀[R]^k L ⊗[R] M) :
    incl R L N k (mapChains R L k f t) = (f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ (incl R L M k t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [incl, incl, mapChains, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor, LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.mapChains_d
statement:
theorem mapChains_d (k : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (t : ⋀[R]^(k + 1) L ⊗[R] M) :
    mapChains R L k f (d R L M k t) = d R L N k (mapChains R L (k + 1) f t)
proof:
:= by
  refine incl_injective k ?_
  rw [incl_mapChains, incl_d, incl_d, incl_mapChains, lTensor_diff]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lTensor_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma lTensor_mem_chainsIn {k : ℕ} (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) {c : E} (hc : c ∈ chainsIn R L M k) :
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ c ∈ chainsIn R L N k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨_, incl_mapChains k f t⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lTensor_mem_cycles
statement:
lemma lTensor_mem_cycles {k : ℕ} (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) {c : E} (hc : c ∈ cycles R L M k) :
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ c ∈ cycles R L N k
proof:
:=
  ⟨lTensor_mem_chainsIn f hc.1, LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by
    rw [← lTensor_diff, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hc.2, map_zero])⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lTensor_mem_boundaries
statement:
lemma lTensor_mem_boundaries {k : ℕ} (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) {c : E} (hc : c ∈ boundaries R L M k) :
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ c ∈ boundaries R L N k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨_, lTensor_mem_chainsIn f hc, (lTensor_diff f c).symm⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.quotMap_mk
statement:
lemma quotMap_mk (k : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (c : E) :
    quotMap R L k f (Submodule.Quotient.mk c) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ((f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ c)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.quotMap_mem_homology
statement:
lemma quotMap_mem_homology {k : ℕ} (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) {x : E ⧸ boundaries R L M k}
    (hx : x ∈ homology R L M k) : quotMap R L k f x ∈ homology R L N k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨_, lTensor_mem_cycles f hc, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.coe_homologyMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_homologyMap (k : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (x : homology R L M k) :
    (homologyMap R L k f x : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] N ⧸ boundaries R L N k) =
      quotMap R L k f x
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyMap_id
statement:
@[simp] lemma homologyMap_id (k : ℕ) :
    homologyMap R L k (LieModuleHom.id : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  simp only [LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq, coe_homologyMap, Submodule.mkQ_apply, quotMap_mk]
  rw [show ((LieModuleHom.id : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M) : M →ₗ[R] M) = LinearMap.id from rfl,
    LinearMap.lTensor_id, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyMap_comp
statement:
lemma homologyMap_comp {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [LieRingModule L P]
    [LieModule R L P] (k : ℕ) (g : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ P) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) :
    homologyMap R L k (g.comp f) = homologyMap R L k g ∘ₗ homologyMap R L k f
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coe_homologyMap, Submodule.mkQ_apply, quotMap_mk,
    LieModuleHom.toLinearMap_comp, LinearMap.lTensor_comp]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.incl_onChains
statement:
lemma incl_onChains (k : ℕ) (x : ⋀[K]^k L ⊗[K] M) :
    incl K L M k (ρ.onChains a k x) = ρ.θ a (incl K L M k x)
proof:
:=
  incl_proj_of_mem (ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainComplexHomologyIso_action
statement:
theorem chainComplexHomologyIso_action (k : ℕ) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (ρ.chainEnd a) k ≫
        (chainComplexHomologyIso K L M k).hom =
      (chainComplexHomologyIso K L M k).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (ρ.homologyEnd a k)
proof:
:=
  (ρ.leftHomologyMapData a k).homologyMap_comm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.lTensor_wedge
proof:
:= by
  induction c using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x m => simp only [wedge_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
  | add c d hc hd => simp only [map_add, hc, hd]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_lTensor
statement:
lemma θ_lTensor (hD : ρ.D = σ.D)
    (hφ : ∀ a, (σ.φ a).comp f.toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap.comp (ρ.φ a))
    (a : H) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] M) :
    σ.θ a (f.toLinearMap.lTensor _ c) = f.toLinearMap.lTensor _ (ρ.θ a c)
proof:
:= by
  refine LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.induction
    (p := fun c ↦ σ.θ a (f.toLinearMap.lTensor _ c) =
      f.toLinearMap.lTensor _ (ρ.θ a c))
    (fun m ↦ ?_) (fun y c hc ↦ ?_) (fun c d hc hd ↦ ?_) c
  · simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, θ_one_tmul]
    exact congrArg (fun m ↦ (1 : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ[K] m)
      (LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ a) m)
  · rw [lTensor_wedge, θ_wedge, θ_wedge, map_add, lTensor_wedge, lTensor_wedge,
      hD, hc]
  · simp only [map_add, hc, hd]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.chainEnd_map
statement:
theorem chainEnd_map (hD : ρ.D = σ.D)
    (hφ : ∀ a, (σ.φ a).comp f.toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap.comp (ρ.φ a)) (a : H) :
    ρ.chainEnd a ≫ chainComplexMap f = chainComplexMap f ≫ σ.chainEnd a
proof:
:= by
  ext k : 2
  ext t
  apply incl_injective k
  change incl K L N k (mapChains K L k f (ρ.onChains a k t)) =
    incl K L N k (σ.onChains a k (mapChains K L k f t))
  simp only [incl_mapChains, incl_onChains]
  exact (θ_lTensor σ f hD hφ a _).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyConnecting_equivariant
statement:
theorem homologyConnecting_equivariant (a : H) (k : ℕ) :
    (ρ.homologyEnd a k).comp (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k) =
      (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k).comp (τ.homologyEnd a (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hn := HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality
    (coefficientSequenceEnd ρ σ τ f g hfg hD₁ hD₂ hφ₁ hφ₂ a)
    (coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg)
    (coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg) (k + 1) k rfl
  change (coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg).δ (k + 1) k rfl ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (ρ.chainEnd a) k =
