    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (τ.chainEnd a) (k + 1) ≫
      (coefficientChainSequence_shortExact f g hfg hf hg).δ (k + 1) k rfl at hn
  suffices hh : ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k) ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (ρ.homologyEnd a k) =
    ModuleCat.ofHom (τ.homologyEnd a (k + 1)) ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k) by
    exact congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hh
  rw [← cancel_epi (chainComplexHomologyIso K L P (k + 1)).hom,
    ← Category.assoc, homologyConnecting_comparison, Category.assoc,
    ← DerivAction.chainComplexHomologyIso_action, ← Category.assoc, hn,
    Category.assoc, ← homologyConnecting_comparison, ← Category.assoc,
    DerivAction.chainComplexHomologyIso_action, Category.assoc]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyConnecting_map_eigenvector
statement:
theorem homologyConnecting_map_eigenvector (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H)
    (z : homology K L P (k + 1))
    (hz : ∀ a, τ.homologyEnd a (k + 1) z = μ a • z) (a : H) :
    ρ.homologyEnd a k (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k z) =
      μ a • homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k z
proof:
:= by
  have he := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (homologyConnecting_equivariant ρ σ τ f g hfg hf hg hD₁ hD₂ hφ₁ hφ₂ a k) z
  change ρ.homologyEnd a k (homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k z) =
    homologyConnecting f g hfg hf hg k (τ.homologyEnd a (k + 1) z) at he
  rw [he, hz, map_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma wedge_tmul (y : L) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (m : M) :
    wedge R L M y (ω ⊗ₜ m) = (ι R y * ω) ⊗ₜ m
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_wedge
statement: @[simp] lemma wedge_wedge (y : L) (c : E) : wedge R L M y (wedge R L M y c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul ω m => simp [← mul_assoc]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp [hc, hc']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.induction
statement:
theorem induction {p : E → Prop} (one : ∀ m : M, p (1 ⊗ₜ m))
    (wedge : ∀ (y : L) (c : E), p c → p (wedge R L M y c))
    (add : ∀ c c' : E, p c → p c' → p (c + c')) (c : E) : p c
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | add c c' hc hc' => exact add c c' hc hc'
  | tmul ω m =>
    induction ω using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction generalizing m with
    | algebraMap r =>
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_tmul]
      exact one _
    | add ω ω' hω hω' => rw [add_tmul]; exact add _ _ (hω m) (hω' m)
    | ι_mul ω y hω => exact wedge y _ (hω m)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.ext_of
statement:
theorem ext_of {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {f g : E →ₗ[R] N}
    (one : ∀ m : M, f (1 ⊗ₜ m) = g (1 ⊗ₜ m))
    (wedge : ∀ (y : L) (c : E), f c = g c → f (wedge R L M y c) = g (wedge R L M y c)) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ induction one wedge (fun c c' hc hc' ↦ by simp [hc, hc']) c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExtStep_apply
statement:
lemma derivExtStep_apply (y : L) (p : ExteriorAlgebra R L × (M →ₗ[R] E)) (m : M) :
    derivExtStep D y p m = (ι R (D y) * p.1) ⊗ₜ m + wedge R L M y (p.2 m)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExtStep_step
statement:
lemma derivExtStep_step (y : L) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (g : M →ₗ[R] E) :
    derivExtStep D y (ι R y * ω, derivExtStep D y (ω, g)) =
      (0 : QuadraticForm R L) y • g
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [derivExtStep_apply, derivExtStep_apply, map_add, wedge_wedge, add_zero, wedge_tmul,
    ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← add_tmul, ← add_mul, ι_add_mul_swap]
  simp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExtFold_algebraMap
statement:
lemma derivExtFold_algebraMap (r : R) :
    derivExtFold D φ (algebraMap R _ r) =
      r • (TensorProduct.mk R (ExteriorAlgebra R L) M 1).comp φ
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_algebraMap _ _ _ _ _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExtFold_ι_mul
statement:
lemma derivExtFold_ι_mul (y : L) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    derivExtFold D φ (ι R y * ω) = derivExtStep D y (ω, derivExtFold D φ ω)
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_ι_mul _ _ _ _ _ _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExt_one_tmul
statement: @[simp] lemma derivExt_one_tmul (m : M) : derivExt D φ (1 ⊗ₜ m) = 1 ⊗ₜ φ m
proof:
:= by
  have h := derivExtFold_algebraMap D φ 1
  rw [map_one, one_smul] at h
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h m

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExt_wedge
statement:
lemma derivExt_wedge (y : L) (c : E) :
    derivExt D φ (wedge R L M y c) = wedge R L M (D y) c + wedge R L M y (derivExt D φ c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']; abel
  | tmul ω m => exact LinearMap.congr_fun (derivExtFold_ι_mul D φ y ω) m

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExt_comp_wedge
statement:
lemma derivExt_comp_wedge (y : L) :
    derivExt D φ ∘ₗ wedge R L M y = wedge R L M (D y) + wedge R L M y ∘ₗ derivExt D φ
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext (derivExt_wedge D φ y)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExt_add
statement:
lemma derivExt_add (D' : L →ₗ[R] L) (φ' : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    derivExt (D + D') (φ + φ') = derivExt D φ + derivExt (M := M) D' φ'
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of (fun m ↦ by simp [tmul_add]) fun y c hc ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, derivExt_wedge, hc, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExt_smul
statement: lemma derivExt_smul (r : R) : derivExt (r • D) (r • φ) = r • derivExt D φ
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of (fun m ↦ by simp [tmul_smul]) fun y c hc ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, derivExt_wedge, hc, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_add]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lTensor_comp_wedge
statement:
lemma lTensor_comp_wedge (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (y : L) :
    f.lTensor _ ∘ₗ wedge R L M y = wedge R L N y ∘ₗ f.lTensor _
proof:
:= by
  ext ω m
  simp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lTensor_derivExt
statement:
lemma lTensor_derivExt (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (φ' : N →ₗ[R] N) (hf : f ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ f) (c : E) :
    f.lTensor _ (derivExt D φ c) = derivExt D φ' (f.lTensor _ c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using induction with
  | one m =>
    simp only [derivExt_one_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply f φ, hf, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  | wedge y c hc =>
    rw [derivExt_wedge, map_add, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (f.lTensor _),
      ← LinearMap.comp_apply (f.lTensor _), lTensor_comp_wedge, lTensor_comp_wedge,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hc, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (f.lTensor _),
      lTensor_comp_wedge, LinearMap.comp_apply, derivExt_wedge]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAction_one_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma lieAction_one_tmul (x : L) (m : M) :
    lieAction R L M x (1 ⊗ₜ m) = 1 ⊗ₜ ⁅x, m⁆
proof:
:=
  derivExt_one_tmul _ _ m

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAction_wedge
statement:
lemma lieAction_wedge (x y : L) (c : E) :
    lieAction R L M x (wedge R L M y c) =
      wedge R L M ⁅x, y⁆ c + wedge R L M y (lieAction R L M x c)
proof:
:=
  derivExt_wedge _ _ y c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAction_lie
statement:
theorem lieAction_lie (x y : L) :
    lieAction R L M ⁅x, y⁆ =
      lieAction R L M x ∘ₗ lieAction R L M y - lieAction R L M y ∘ₗ lieAction R L M x
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of (fun m ↦ by simp [lie_lie, tmul_sub]) fun z c hc ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, lieAction_wedge, map_add, map_sub, hc,
    lie_lie]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.derivExt_comp_lieAction
statement:
lemma derivExt_comp_lieAction {D : L →ₗ[R] L} {φ : M →ₗ[R] M}
    (hD : ∀ x y, D ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅D x, y⁆ + ⁅x, D y⁆)
    (hφ : ∀ (x : L) (m : M), φ ⁅x, m⁆ = ⁅D x, m⁆ + ⁅x, φ m⁆)
    (y : L) :
    derivExt D φ ∘ₗ lieAction R L M y - lieAction R L M y ∘ₗ derivExt D φ =
      lieAction R L M (D y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of (fun m ↦ ?_) fun z c hc ↦ ?_
  · simp [hφ, tmul_add]
  · simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hc ⊢
    simp only [lieAction_wedge, derivExt_wedge, map_add, map_sub, hD, ← hc, LinearMap.add_apply]
    abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diffStep_apply
statement:
lemma diffStep_apply (y : L) (p : ExteriorAlgebra R L × (M →ₗ[R] E)) (m : M) :
    diffStep R L M y p m = -lieAction R L M y (p.1 ⊗ₜ m) - wedge R L M y (p.2 m)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diffStep_step
statement:
lemma diffStep_step (y : L) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) (g : M →ₗ[R] E) :
    diffStep R L M y (ι R y * ω, diffStep R L M y (ω, g)) =
      (0 : QuadraticForm R L) y • g
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [diffStep_apply, diffStep_apply, ← wedge_tmul, lieAction_wedge, lie_self, map_zero]
  simp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diffFold_algebraMap
statement: lemma diffFold_algebraMap (r : R) : diffFold R L M (algebraMap R _ r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [diffFold, CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_algebraMap, smul_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diffFold_ι_mul
statement:
lemma diffFold_ι_mul (y : L) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L) :
    diffFold R L M (ι R y * ω) = diffStep R L M y (ω, diffFold R L M ω)
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_ι_mul _ _ _ _ _ _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_one_tmul
statement: @[simp] lemma diff_one_tmul (m : M) : diff R L M (1 ⊗ₜ m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := diffFold_algebraMap (M := M) (L := L) (1 : R)
  rw [map_one] at h
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h m

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_wedge
statement:
lemma diff_wedge (y : L) (c : E) :
    diff R L M (wedge R L M y c) = -lieAction R L M y c - wedge R L M y (diff R L M c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']; abel
  | tmul ω m => exact LinearMap.congr_fun (diffFold_ι_mul y ω) m

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_ι_tmul
statement: lemma diff_ι_tmul (x : L) (m : M) : diff R L M (ι R x ⊗ₜ m) = -(1 ⊗ₜ ⁅x, m⁆)
proof:
:= by
  have := diff_wedge (R := R) (M := M) x (1 ⊗ₜ m)
  rw [wedge_tmul, mul_one] at this
  simp [this]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_ι_mul_ι_tmul
statement:
lemma diff_ι_mul_ι_tmul (x y : L) (m : M) :
    diff R L M ((ι R x * ι R y) ⊗ₜ m) =
      -(ι R y ⊗ₜ ⁅x, m⁆) + ι R x ⊗ₜ ⁅y, m⁆ - ι R ⁅x, y⁆ ⊗ₜ m
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := diff_wedge (R := R) (M := M) x (ι R y ⊗ₜ m)
  have h2 := lieAction_wedge (R := R) (M := M) x y (1 ⊗ₜ m)
  rw [wedge_tmul] at h1
  rw [wedge_tmul, wedge_tmul, mul_one, mul_one] at h2
  rw [h1, h2, diff_ι_tmul, lieAction_one_tmul]
  simp only [wedge_tmul, map_neg, mul_one]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_comp_derivExt
statement:
theorem diff_comp_derivExt {D : L →ₗ[R] L} {φ : M →ₗ[R] M}
    (hD : ∀ x y, D ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅D x, y⁆ + ⁅x, D y⁆)
    (hφ : ∀ (x : L) (m : M), φ ⁅x, m⁆ = ⁅D x, m⁆ + ⁅x, φ m⁆) :
    diff R L M ∘ₗ derivExt D φ = derivExt D φ ∘ₗ diff R L M
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of (fun m ↦ by simp) fun z c hc ↦ ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (derivExt_comp_lieAction hD hφ z) c
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hc h ⊢
  simp only [derivExt_wedge, map_add, diff_wedge, hc, map_sub, map_neg, ← h]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_comp_lieAction
statement:
theorem diff_comp_lieAction (x : L) :
    diff R L M ∘ₗ lieAction R L M x = lieAction R L M x ∘ₗ diff R L M
proof:
:=
  diff_comp_derivExt (fun y z ↦ by simp only [LieAlgebra.ad_apply]; exact leibniz_lie x y z)
    (fun y m ↦ by simp only [LieAlgebra.ad_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]; exact leibniz_lie x y m)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_comp_diff
statement: theorem diff_comp_diff : diff R L M ∘ₗ diff R L M = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of (fun m ↦ by simp) fun y c hc ↦ ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (diff_comp_lieAction (M := M) y) c
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hc h ⊢
  simp only [diff_wedge, map_sub, map_neg, hc, h, map_zero]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.diff_diff
statement: @[simp] lemma diff_diff (c : E) : diff R L M (diff R L M c) = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun diff_comp_diff c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lTensor_lieAction
statement:
lemma lTensor_lieAction (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (x : L) (c : E) :
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ (lieAction R L M x c) =
      lieAction R L N x ((f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ c)
proof:
:=
  lTensor_derivExt _ _ _ _ (LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ by simp) c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lTensor_diff
statement:
theorem lTensor_diff (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) (c : E) :
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ (diff R L M c) = diff R L N ((f : M →ₗ[R] N).lTensor _ c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using induction with
  | one m => simp
  | wedge y c hc =>
    rw [diff_wedge, map_sub, map_neg, lTensor_lieAction,
      ← LinearMap.comp_apply (LinearMap.lTensor _ _), lTensor_comp_wedge, LinearMap.comp_apply, hc,
      ← LinearMap.comp_apply (LinearMap.lTensor _ _), lTensor_comp_wedge, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      diff_wedge]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.tensorTrivialLinearEquiv_lie
statement:
lemma tensorTrivialLinearEquiv_lie {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (b : Module.Basis β K Z) (x : L)
    (t : M ⊗[K] TrivialLieModule K L Z) :
    tensorTrivialLinearEquiv b ⁅x, t⁆ = ⁅x, tensorTrivialLinearEquiv b t⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [lie_add, map_add, ht, ht', map_add, lie_add]
  | tmul m z =>
    ext i
    simp only [tensorTrivialLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, trivial_lie_zero, tmul_zero, add_zero, congr_tmul,
      LinearEquiv.refl_apply,
      DirectSum.lie_module_bracket_apply, finsuppLEquivDirectSum_apply,
      finsuppScalarRight_apply_tmul_apply, lie_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.subsingleton_homology_tensor_trivial
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_tensor_trivial (q : ℕ) (h : Subsingleton (homology K L M q)) :
    Subsingleton (homology K L (M ⊗[K] TrivialLieModule K L Z) q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis K Z
  exact (homologyEquiv (tensorTrivialEquiv (L := L) (M := M) b) q).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr
    (subsingleton_homology_directSum (fun _ : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex K Z ↦ M) q
      fun _ ↦ h)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.linearMap_ext_exteriorPower
statement:
lemma linearMap_ext_exteriorPower {F G : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N}
    (h : ∀ j, F ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^j L).subtype = G ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^j L).subtype) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  have hc : c ∈ ⨆ j, ⋀[R]^j L := by
    rw [(DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (fun j : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^j L)).submodule_iSup_eq_top]
    trivial
  induction hc using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem j ω hω => exact LinearMap.congr_fun (h j) ⟨ω, hω⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.degProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma degProj_of_mem {j k : ℕ} {ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L} (hω : ω ∈ ⋀[R]^j L) (h : j ≠ k) :
    degProj R L k ω = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by
    change gradeFun R L ω k = 0
    simp [gradeFun_of_mem hω k, Ne.symm h])

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.ι_mul_mem_exteriorPower
statement:
lemma ι_mul_mem_exteriorPower (y : L) {j : ℕ} {c : ExteriorAlgebra R L} (hc : c ∈ ⋀[R]^j L) :
    ι R y * c ∈ ⋀[R]^(j + 1) L
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ']
  exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ y) hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.mem_exteriorPower_zero
statement:
lemma mem_exteriorPower_zero {c : ExteriorAlgebra R L} (hc : c ∈ ⋀[R]^0 L) :
    ∃ r : R, algebraMap R _ r = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPower, pow_zero, Submodule.mem_one] at hc
  exact hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_add
statement:
lemma lieDeriv_add (y : L) (f g : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    lieDeriv y (f + g) = lieDeriv y f + lieDeriv y g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lieDeriv, map_add, LinearMap.add_comp]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_smul
statement:
lemma lieDeriv_smul (y : L) (t : R) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    lieDeriv y (t • f) = t • lieDeriv y f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lieDeriv, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_comp]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma lieDeriv_zero (y : L) : lieDeriv y (0 : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lieDeriv]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_eq
statement:
lemma lieDeriv_eq (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    lieDeriv y f = -contract y (cochainDiff R L N f) - cochainDiff R L N (contract y f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contract_cochainDiff]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_cochainDiff
statement:
theorem lieDeriv_cochainDiff (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    lieDeriv y (cochainDiff R L N f) = cochainDiff R L N (lieDeriv y f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lieDeriv_eq y (cochainDiff R L N f), lieDeriv_eq y f]
  simp [map_sub, map_neg]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieDeriv_comp
statement:
lemma lieDeriv_comp (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (y : L) (f : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N) :
    lieDeriv y ((φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ f) = (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ lieDeriv y f
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  simp [lieDeriv_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainDiff_comp_degProj
statement:
theorem cochainDiff_comp_degProj (k : ℕ) (f : Cochains R L N k) :
    cochainDiff R L N (f ∘ₗ degProj R L k) = δ R L N k f ∘ₗ degProj R L (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine linearMap_ext_exteriorPower fun j ↦ LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]
  by_cases hj : j = k + 1
  · subst hj
    rw [degProj_subtype, δ_apply]
  · rw [degProj_of_mem ω.2 hj, map_zero]
    rcases j with _ | i
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_exteriorPower_zero ω.2
      rw [← hr, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, cochainDiff_one, smul_zero]
    · have h0 : (f ∘ₗ degProj R L k) ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^i L).subtype = 0 ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^i L).subtype := by
        refine LinearMap.ext fun ω' ↦ ?_
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
        rw [degProj_of_mem ω'.2 (fun h ↦ hj (by rw [h])), map_zero]
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun (cochainDiff_eq_of_eq h0) ω
      simpa using this

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsRelative.cochainDiff
statement:
theorem IsRelative.cochainDiff {F : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N} (hF : IsRelative S F) :
    IsRelative S (cochainDiff R L N F)
proof:
:= fun y hy ↦
  ⟨by rw [contract_cochainDiff, (hF y hy).1, (hF y hy).2]; simp,
    by rw [lieDeriv_cochainDiff, (hF y hy).2, map_zero]⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsRelative.comp
statement:
lemma IsRelative.comp (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') {F : ExteriorAlgebra R L →ₗ[R] N}
    (hF : IsRelative S F) : IsRelative S ((φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ F)
proof:
:= fun y hy ↦
  ⟨by rw [show contract y ((φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ F) = (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ contract y F from rfl,
      (hF y hy).1, LinearMap.comp_zero],
    by rw [lieDeriv_comp, (hF y hy).2, LinearMap.comp_zero]⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.mem_relCochains
statement:
lemma mem_relCochains {k : ℕ} {f : Cochains R L N k} :
    f ∈ relCochains R L N S k ↔ IsRelative S (f ∘ₗ degProj R L k)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.δ_mem_relCochains
statement:
lemma δ_mem_relCochains {k : ℕ} {f : Cochains R L N k} (hf : f ∈ relCochains R L N S k) :
    δ R L N k f ∈ relCochains R L N S (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_relCochains, ← cochainDiff_comp_degProj]
  exact IsRelative.cochainDiff hf

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.coe_relδ
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_relδ (k : ℕ) (f : relCochains R L N S k) :
    (relδ R L N S k f : Cochains R L N (k + 1)) = δ R L N k f
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.relδ_comp_relδ
statement: theorem relδ_comp_relδ (k : ℕ) : relδ R L N S (k + 1) ∘ₗ relδ R L N S k = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun f ↦ Subtype.ext (LinearMap.congr_fun (δ_comp_δ k) (f : Cochains R L N k))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.relCochainComplex_X
statement:
@[simp] lemma relCochainComplex_X (k : ℕ) :
    (relCochainComplex R L N S).X k = ModuleCat.of R (relCochains R L N S k)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.relCochainComplex_d
statement:
@[simp] lemma relCochainComplex_d (k : ℕ) :
    (relCochainComplex R L N S).d k (k + 1) = ModuleCat.ofHom (relδ R L N S k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [relCochainComplex]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.comp_mem_relCochains
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_relCochains, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  exact hf.comp φ

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.coe_relMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_relMap (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (k : ℕ) (f : relCochains R L N S k) :
    (relMap S φ k f : Cochains R L N' k) = (φ : N →ₗ[R] N') ∘ₗ (f : Cochains R L N k)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.relMap_relδ
statement:
lemma relMap_relδ (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (k : ℕ) :
    relMap S φ (k + 1) ∘ₗ relδ R L N S k = relδ R L N' S k ∘ₗ relMap S φ k
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun f ↦ Subtype.ext (δ_comp k φ (f : Cochains R L N k)).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.relCochainComplexMap_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma relCochainComplexMap_f (φ : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N') (k : ℕ) :
    (relCochainComplexMap S φ).f k = ModuleCat.ofHom (relMap S φ k)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainZero_mem_relCochains
statement:
lemma cochainZero_mem_relCochains {v : V} (hv : ∀ x : L, ⁅x, v⁆ = 0) :
    cochainZero K L v ∈ relCochains K L V S 0
proof:
:= by
  intro y _
  constructor
  · refine linearMap_ext_exteriorPower fun j ↦ LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, contract_apply,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [degProj_of_mem (ι_mul_mem_exteriorPower y ω.2) (Nat.succ_ne_zero j), map_zero]
  · have h0 : cochainZero K L v ∘ₗ degProj K L 0 ∘ₗ extDeriv (LieAlgebra.ad K L y) = 0 := by
      refine linearMap_ext_exteriorPower fun j ↦ LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      rcases j with _ | j
      · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_exteriorPower_zero ω.2
        rw [← hr, extDeriv_algebraMap, map_zero, map_zero]
      · rw [degProj_of_mem (extDeriv_mem_exteriorPower _ ω.2) (Nat.succ_ne_zero j), map_zero]
    refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
    rw [lieDeriv_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    simp only [cochainZero, LinearMap.smulRight_apply, lie_smul, hv, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun h0 c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.relCochainComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem relCochainComplex_shortExact {g₁ : N₁ →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N₂} {g₂ : N₂ →ₗ⁅K,L⁆ N₃}
    (hinj : Function.Injective g₁) (hex : Function.Exact g₁ g₂) (σ : N₃ →ₗ[K] N₂)
    (hσ : ∀ n, g₂ (σ n) = n) (hσS : ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ n, σ ⁅y, n⁆ = ⁅y, σ n⁆) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (relCochainComplexMap S g₁) (relCochainComplexMap S g₂) (by
      ext k f : 3
      refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_)
      exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  refine HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact _ fun k ↦ ?_
  refine ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact _ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro (f₂ : relCochains K L N₂ S k)
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hr : ∀ ω, (f₂ : Cochains K L N₂ k) ω ∈ LinearMap.range (g₁ : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) :=
        fun ω ↦ (hex _).mp (LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg Subtype.val h) ω)
      let e := LinearEquiv.ofInjective (g₁ : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) hinj
      let f₁ : Cochains K L N₁ k :=
        e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (f₂ : Cochains K L N₂ k).codRestrict _ hr
      have hf₁ : (g₁ : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) ∘ₗ f₁ = f₂ := LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ by
        change ((e (e.symm _)) : N₂) = _
        rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        rfl
      have hcomp : ∀ F : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N₁,
          (g₁ : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) ∘ₗ F = 0 → F = 0 := fun F hF ↦
        LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ hinj (by
          rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]; exact LinearMap.congr_fun hF c)
      refine ⟨⟨f₁, fun y hy ↦ ⟨hcomp _ ?_, hcomp _ ?_⟩⟩, Subtype.ext hf₁⟩
      · rw [show (g₁ : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) ∘ₗ contract y (f₁ ∘ₗ degProj K L k) =
          contract y (((g₁ : N₁ →ₗ[K] N₂) ∘ₗ f₁) ∘ₗ degProj K L k) from rfl, hf₁]
        exact (f₂.2 y hy).1
      · rw [← lieDeriv_comp, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hf₁]
        exact (f₂.2 y hy).2
    · rintro ⟨f₁, rfl⟩
      refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_)
      exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero _
  · intro (f : relCochains K L N₁ S k) (f' : relCochains K L N₁ S k) h
    refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hinj ?_)
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg Subtype.val h) ω
  · intro (f₃ : relCochains K L N₃ S k)
    refine ⟨⟨σ ∘ₗ (f₃ : Cochains K L N₃ k), fun y hy ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [show contract y ((σ ∘ₗ (f₃ : Cochains K L N₃ k)) ∘ₗ degProj K L k) =
        σ ∘ₗ contract y ((f₃ : Cochains K L N₃ k) ∘ₗ degProj K L k) from rfl, (f₃.2 y hy).1,
        LinearMap.comp_zero]
    · have h := (f₃.2 y hy).2
      refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
      have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun h c
      rw [lieDeriv_apply] at hc ⊢
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hc ⊢
      rw [← hσS y hy, ← map_sub, hc, map_zero]
    · refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_)
      exact hσ _

name: Module.End.weightProj_comm_of_mapsTo
statement:
lemma weightProj_comm_of_mapsTo (μ : Dual K H) (φ : Module.End K Y)
    (hφ : ∀ ν, ∀ y ∈ weightSpaceOf T ν, φ y ∈ weightSpaceOf T ν) (y : Y) :
    weightProj hT μ (φ y) = φ (weightProj hT μ y)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOf T ν := hT ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν y hy =>
    by_cases h : ν = μ
    · subst h
      rw [weightProj_of_mem hT hy, weightProj_of_mem hT (hφ ν y hy)]
    · rw [weightProj_of_mem_ne hT h hy, weightProj_of_mem_ne hT h (hφ ν y hy), map_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => simp only [map_add, h, h']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_mem_wedgeRange
statement:
lemma wedge_mem_wedgeRange (η : H →ₗ[K] L) (a : H) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X) :
    wedge K L X (η a) c ∈ wedgeRange K L X η
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem a (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ c)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coAct_eq_neg_lieDeriv
statement:
lemma coAct_eq_neg_lieDeriv (a : H) (F : ExteriorAlgebra K L →ₗ[K] N) :
    ρN.coAct a F = -lieDeriv (η a) F
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  rw [coAct_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, lieDeriv_apply, hDN, hφN, neg_sub]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.mem_relCochains_range_iff
statement:
theorem mem_relCochains_range_iff {k : ℕ} {f : Cochains K L N k} :
    f ∈ relCochains K L N (Set.range η) k ↔
      f ∈ ρN.cochainWeightSpace k 0 ∧ ∀ a, contract (η a) (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hco : ∀ a, (ρN.coActDeg k a f = 0 ↔ ρN.coAct a (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) = 0) := by
    intro a
    have h := ρN.coActDeg_comp_degProj k a f
    constructor
    · intro h0
      refine linearMap_ext_exteriorPower fun j ↦ ?_
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst hj
        rw [← h, h0]; rfl
      · refine LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply,
          coAct_apply, degProj_of_mem ω.2 hj,
          degProj_of_mem (extDeriv_mem_exteriorPower (ρN.D a) ω.2) hj, map_zero, sub_zero]
    · intro h0
      refine LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ ?_
      have h' := LinearMap.congr_fun h ω
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, degProj_subtype, h0,
        LinearMap.zero_apply] at h'
      exact h'
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨fun a ↦ ?_, fun a ↦ (hf (η a) ⟨a, rfl⟩).1⟩
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul, hco, coAct_eq_neg_lieDeriv hDN hφN,
      (hf (η a) ⟨a, rfl⟩).2, neg_zero]
  · rintro ⟨hw, hc⟩ y ⟨a, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hc a, ?_⟩
    have h0 : ρN.coActDeg k a f = 0 := by
      rw [hw a, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul]
    rw [hco, coAct_eq_neg_lieDeriv hDN hφN, neg_eq_zero] at h0
    exact h0

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.exists_δ_eq_of_relExact
statement:
theorem exists_δ_eq_of_relExact {B : N →ₗ[K] X →ₗ[K] K}
    (hD : ∀ a, ρN.D a = ρ.D a) (hDN : ∀ a, ρN.D a = LieAlgebra.ad K L (η a))
    (hφN : ∀ a n, ρN.φ a n = ⁅η a, n⁆) (hab : ∀ a b, ⁅η a, η b⁆ = 0)
    (hB : ∀ (x : L) (n : N) (m : X), B ⁅x, n⁆ m = -B n ⁅x, m⁆)
    (hBφ : ∀ (a : H) (n : N) (m : X), B (ρN.φ a n) m = -B n (ρ.φ a m))
    (hinj : Function.Injective B)
    (hrep : ∀ (γ : Dual K H) (ψ : X →ₗ[K] K), (∀ a m, ψ (ρ.φ a m) = γ a * ψ m) →
      ψ ∈ LinearMap.range B)
    (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤)
    (hX : ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν = ⊤) {k : ℕ}
    (hexact : ∀ t ∈ ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) 0, diff K L X t ∈ wedgeRange K L X η →
      ∃ s ∈ ρ.chainPiece (k + 2) 0, t - diff K L X s ∈ wedgeRange K L X η)
    {f : Cochains K L N (k + 1)} (hf : f ∈ relCochains K L N (Set.range η) (k + 1))
    (hδ : δ K L N (k + 1) f = 0) :
    ∃ g ∈ relCochains K L N (Set.range η) k, δ K L N k g = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfw, hfc⟩ := (mem_relCochains_range_iff hDN hφN).mp hf
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F, F = cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L (k + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFθ : ∀ (a : H) {t}, t ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1) → F (ρ.θ a t) = 0 := by
    intro a t ht
    rw [hF, cochainPair_θ ρ ρN hD hBφ hfw a ht, LinearMap.zero_apply, neg_zero, zero_mul]
  
  have hFw : ∀ w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η, F w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    induction hw using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem a w hw =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hw
      rw [hF, cochainPair_wedge, hfc a, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    | zero => exact map_zero F
    | add w w' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add, h, h', add_zero]
  
  have hFd : ∀ s ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 2), F (diff K L X s) = 0 := by
    rintro s ⟨s, rfl⟩
    rw [hF, ← cochainPair_cochainDiff hB]
    induction s with
    | tmul ω m =>
      have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hδ ω
      rw [δ_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
      rw [incl_tmul, cochainPair_tmul, h, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, hs, hs', add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨ψ₁, hψ₁⟩ : ∃ ψ₁ : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X →ₗ[K] K,
      ∀ (t : ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) 0) (w : wedgeRange K L X η),
        ψ₁ (diff K L X t + w) = F t := by
    let D : ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) 0 × wedgeRange K L X η →ₗ[K] ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X :=
      (diff K L X ∘ₗ (ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) 0).subtype).coprod (wedgeRange K L X η).subtype
    obtain ⟨ψ₁, hψ₁⟩ := LinearMap.exists_comp_eq_of_ker_le
      (V := ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) 0 × wedgeRange K L X η) D
      ((F ∘ₗ (ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) 0).subtype).coprod 0) fun ⟨t, w⟩ htw ↦ by
        have h0 : diff K L X t + w = 0 := htw
        obtain ⟨s, hs, hts⟩ := hexact t t.2
          (by rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h0]; exact neg_mem w.2)
        have e : F t = F (↑t - diff K L X s) + F (diff K L X s) := by
          rw [← map_add, sub_add_cancel]
        exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by
          simp only [LinearMap.coprod_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
            LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
          rw [e, hFw _ hts, hFd s hs.1, add_zero])
    refine ⟨ψ₁, fun t w ↦ ?_⟩
    simpa [D] using LinearMap.congr_fun hψ₁ (t, w)
  
  have hT := ρ.iSup_chainWeightSpace hL hX
  set Pr := Module.End.weightProj hT 0
  have hwedge : ∀ (a : H) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X),
      Pr (wedge K L X (η a) c) = wedge K L X (η a) (Pr c) := by
    intro a c
    refine Module.End.weightProj_comm_of_mapsTo hT 0 _ (fun ν c hc b ↦ ?_) c
    rw [ρ.θ_wedge, ← hD, hDN, LieAlgebra.ad_apply, hab, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      zero_add, hc b, map_smul]
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψθ, hψw, hψd⟩ : ∃ ψ : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X →ₗ[K] K,
      (∀ a t, ψ (ρ.θ a t) = -(0 : Dual K H) a * ψ t) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η, ψ w = 0) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1), ψ (diff K L X t) = F t := by
    have hψ₁w : ∀ w ∈ wedgeRange K L X η, ψ₁ w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      have h := hψ₁ 0 ⟨w, hw⟩
      rwa [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero, zero_add, map_zero] at h
    refine ⟨ψ₁ ∘ₗ Pr, fun a t ↦ ?_, fun w hw ↦ ?_, fun t ht ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.weightProj_comm hT,
        mem_chainWeightSpace.mp (Module.End.weightProj_mem hT 0 t) a, map_smul,
        LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul]
      simp
    · rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      refine hψ₁w _ ?_
      induction hw using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem a w hw =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hw
        rw [hwedge]
        exact wedge_mem_wedgeRange η a _
      | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add w w' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
    · rw [← ρ.iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace hL hX (chainsIn K L X (k + 1))
        (fun a _ hc ↦ ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a hc)] at ht
      induction ht using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem ν t ht =>
        obtain ⟨htc, htw⟩ := ht
        have hdw := ρ.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace htw
        by_cases hν : ν = 0
        · subst hν
          have h := hψ₁ ⟨t, htc, htw⟩ 0
          rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, add_zero] at h
          rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT hdw, h]
        · rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.weightProj_of_mem_ne hT hν hdw, map_zero]
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, ν a ≠ 0 := by
            by_contra h
            push Not at h
            exact hν (LinearMap.ext fun a ↦ h a)
          have h1 := hFθ a htc
          rw [mem_chainWeightSpace.mp htw a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h1
          exact ((mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left ha).symm
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add t t' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, h, h']
  
  obtain ⟨g, hgw, hpair⟩ := exists_cochain_of_weight (ρ := ρ) (ρN := ρN) hD hBφ hinj hrep hL
    (k := k) ψ hψθ
  have hgc : ∀ a, contract (η a) (g ∘ₗ degProj K L k) = 0 := by
    intro a
    refine linearMap_ext_exteriorPower fun j ↦ LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hinj
      (LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, contract_apply,
      LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
    by_cases hj : j + 1 = k
    · have hω : (ι K (η a) * (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L)) ⊗ₜ m ∈ chainsIn K L X k :=
        hj ▸ tmul_mem_chainsIn (ι_mul_mem_exteriorPower (η a) ω.2) m
      have h := hpair _ hω
      rw [cochainPair_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, ← wedge_tmul,
        hψw _ (wedge_mem_wedgeRange η a _)] at h
      exact h
    · rw [degProj_of_mem (ι_mul_mem_exteriorPower (η a) ω.2) hj, map_zero, map_zero,
        LinearMap.zero_apply]
  refine ⟨g, (mem_relCochains_range_iff hDN hφN).mpr ⟨hgw, hgc⟩,
    LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hinj (LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)⟩
  have hω : (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ m ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1) := tmul_mem_chainsIn ω.2 m
  rw [δ_apply]
  change cochainPair B (cochainDiff K L N (g ∘ₗ degProj K L k)) ((ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ m)
    = _
  rw [cochainPair_cochainDiff hB, hpair _ (diff_mem_chainsIn hω), hψd _ hω, hF,
    cochainPair_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, degProj_subtype]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.ofMap_D

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.ofMap_φ
