name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.iSup_weightSpaceOf_D
statement:
theorem iSup_weightSpaceOf_D (hr : IsRelData η ρ p) (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) :
    ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun y _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hr.sub_mem y
  rw [← sub_add_cancel y (p y : L), ha]
  refine add_mem (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 fun a' ↦ ?_) ?_
  · rw [hr.D_eq, LieAlgebra.ad_apply, hr.lie_eta, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul]
  · have hy : (p y : L) ∈ (Submodule.span K (Set.range b)).map V.subtype := by
      rw [b.span_eq]
      exact ⟨p y, Submodule.mem_top, rfl⟩
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at hy
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ hy
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (wt j) fun a ↦ hw.basis a j

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.iSup_weightSpaceOf_φ
statement:
theorem iSup_weightSpaceOf_φ (hw : IsWeightCoord b wt ρ Ψ c) :
    ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← Ψ.symm_apply_apply x, (Ψ x).as_sum, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun m _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← mul_one (Ψ x |>.coeff m), ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_monomial, map_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (c + monoWt wt m) fun a ↦ hw.monomial a m)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.tensorEquivSum_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorEquivSum_tmul (q₁ : MvPolynomial J₁ K) (q₂ : MvPolynomial J₂ K) :
    tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (q₁ ⊗ₜ q₂) = rename Sum.inl q₁ * rename Sum.inr q₂
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K).toAlgHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
      MvPolynomial J₁ K →ₐ[K] _) = rename Sum.inl :=
    MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ by simp
  have h2 : ((tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K).toAlgHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
      MvPolynomial J₂ K →ₐ[K] _) = rename Sum.inr :=
    MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ by simp
  have e : q₁ ⊗ₜ[K] q₂ = (q₁ ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : MvPolynomial J₂ K)) * ((1 : MvPolynomial J₁ K) ⊗ₜ q₂) := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [e, map_mul, ← AlgHom.congr_fun h1 q₁, ← AlgHom.congr_fun h2 q₂]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.tensorEquivSum_monomial
statement:
lemma tensorEquivSum_monomial (m₁ : J₁ →₀ ℕ) (m₂ : J₂ →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (monomial m₁ 1 ⊗ₜ monomial m₂ 1) = monomial (m₁.sumElim m₂) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquivSum_tmul, rename_monomial, rename_monomial, monomial_mul_monomial, mul_one,
    Finsupp.sumElim_eq_add]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.tensorEquivSum_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_restrictTotalDegree] at *
  rw [tensorEquivSum_tmul]
  exact (totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (add_le_add ((totalDegree_rename_le _ _).trans h₁)
    ((totalDegree_rename_le _ _).trans h₂))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.tensorCoord_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma tensorCoord_tmul (x₁ : X₁) (x₂ : X₂) :
    tensorCoord Ψ₁ Ψ₂ (x₁ ⊗ₜ x₂) = tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (Ψ₁ x₁ ⊗ₜ Ψ₂ x₂)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.tensorCoord_symm_tensorEquivSum
statement:
lemma tensorCoord_symm_tensorEquivSum (q₁ : MvPolynomial J₁ K) (q₂ : MvPolynomial J₂ K) :
    (tensorCoord Ψ₁ Ψ₂).symm (tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (q₁ ⊗ₜ q₂)) =
      Ψ₁.symm q₁ ⊗ₜ Ψ₂.symm q₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, tensorCoord_tmul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.tensorCoord_symm_monomial
statement:
lemma tensorCoord_symm_monomial (m : J₁ ⊕ J₂ →₀ ℕ) :
    (tensorCoord Ψ₁ Ψ₂).symm (monomial m 1) =
      Ψ₁.symm (monomial (m.comapDomain Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn) 1) ⊗ₜ
        Ψ₂.symm (monomial (m.comapDomain Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective.injOn) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorCoord_symm_tensorEquivSum, tensorEquivSum_monomial,
    Finsupp.comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.restrictTotalDegree_induction
statement:
lemma restrictTotalDegree_induction {n : ℕ} (Q : MvPolynomial (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K → Prop)
    (h0 : Q 0) (hadd : ∀ q q', Q q → Q q' → Q (q + q')) (hsmul : ∀ (r : K) q, Q q → Q (r • q))
    (hQ : ∀ a₁ a₂ (q₁ : MvPolynomial J₁ K) (q₂ : MvPolynomial J₂ K), a₁ + a₂ ≤ n →
      q₁ ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₁ K a₁ → q₂ ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₂ K a₂ →
        Q (tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (q₁ ⊗ₜ q₂)))
    {q : MvPolynomial (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K} (hq : q ∈ restrictTotalDegree (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K n) : Q q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_restrictTotalDegree] at hq
  rw [q.as_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ Q hadd h0 fun m hm ↦ ?_
  rw [← mul_one (q.coeff m), ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_monomial]
  refine hsmul _ _ ?_
  rw [← Finsupp.comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain m, ← tensorEquivSum_monomial]
  have hdeg : m.degree ≤ n := (le_totalDegree hm).trans hq
  rw [← Finsupp.comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain m, Finsupp.sumElim_eq_add, map_add,
    Finsupp.degree_mapDomain, Finsupp.degree_mapDomain] at hdeg
  exact hQ _ _ _ _ hdeg ((mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mpr (totalDegree_monomial_le _ _))
    ((mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mpr (totalDegree_monomial_le _ _))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.monoWt_sumElim
statement:
lemma monoWt_sumElim (wt : J₁ ⊕ J₂ → Dual K H) (m₁ : J₁ →₀ ℕ) (m₂ : J₂ →₀ ℕ) :
    monoWt wt (m₁.sumElim m₂) = monoWt (wt ∘ Sum.inl) m₁ + monoWt (wt ∘ Sum.inr) m₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.sumElim_eq_add, monoWt,
    Finsupp.sum_add_index' (h := fun j (k : ℕ) ↦ k • wt j) (fun _ ↦ zero_smul ℕ _)
      (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _),
    Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (h := fun j (k : ℕ) ↦ k • wt j) (fun _ ↦ zero_smul ℕ _)
      (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _),
    Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (h := fun j (k : ℕ) ↦ k • wt j) (fun _ ↦ zero_smul ℕ _)
      (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _)]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.X_inl_mul_tensorEquivSum
statement:
lemma X_inl_mul_tensorEquivSum (j : J₁) (q₁ : MvPolynomial J₁ K) (q₂ : MvPolynomial J₂ K) :
    X (Sum.inl j) * tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (q₁ ⊗ₜ q₂) =
      tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K ((X j * q₁) ⊗ₜ q₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquivSum_tmul, tensorEquivSum_tmul, map_mul, rename_X, mul_assoc]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.X_inr_mul_tensorEquivSum
statement:
lemma X_inr_mul_tensorEquivSum (j : J₂) (q₁ : MvPolynomial J₁ K) (q₂ : MvPolynomial J₂ K) :
    X (Sum.inr j) * tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (q₁ ⊗ₜ q₂) =
      tensorEquivSum K J₁ J₂ K (q₁ ⊗ₜ (X j * q₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquivSum_tmul, tensorEquivSum_tmul, map_mul, rename_X, mul_left_comm]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.isLeading_tensorCoord
statement:
theorem isLeading_tensorCoord (b : Basis (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K V)
    (h₁ : ∀ j n (q : MvPolynomial J₁ K), q ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₁ K n →
      Ψ₁ ⁅(b (Sum.inl j) : L), Ψ₁.symm q⁆ - X j * q ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₁ K n)
    (h₁' : ∀ j n (q : MvPolynomial J₂ K), q ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₂ K n →
      Ψ₂ ⁅(b (Sum.inl j) : L), Ψ₂.symm q⁆ ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₂ K n)
    (h₂ : ∀ j n (q : MvPolynomial J₁ K), q ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₁ K n →
      Ψ₁ ⁅(b (Sum.inr j) : L), Ψ₁.symm q⁆ ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₁ K n)
    (h₂' : ∀ j n (q : MvPolynomial J₂ K), q ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₂ K n →
      Ψ₂ ⁅(b (Sum.inr j) : L), Ψ₂.symm q⁆ - X j * q ∈ restrictTotalDegree J₂ K n) :
    IsLeading (tensorCoord Ψ₁ Ψ₂) b
proof:
:= by
  intro j n q hq
  refine restrictTotalDegree_induction
    (fun q ↦ tensorCoord Ψ₁ Ψ₂ ⁅(b j : L), (tensorCoord Ψ₁ Ψ₂).symm q⁆ - X j * q ∈
      restrictTotalDegree (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K n) (by simp) (fun q q' h h' ↦ ?_) (fun r q h ↦ ?_)
    (fun a₁ a₂ q₁ q₂ ha hq₁ hq₂ ↦ ?_) hq
  · simpa only [map_add, lie_add, mul_add, add_sub_add_comm] using add_mem h h'
  · simpa only [map_smul, lie_smul, mul_smul_comm, ← smul_sub] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r h
  · have hmono : restrictTotalDegree (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K (a₁ + a₂) ≤ restrictTotalDegree (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K n :=
      fun q hq ↦ (mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mpr
        (((mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mp hq).trans ha)
    refine hmono ?_
    rw [tensorCoord_symm_tensorEquivSum, TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right, map_add,
      tensorCoord_tmul, tensorCoord_tmul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rcases j with j | j
    · rw [X_inl_mul_tensorEquivSum, add_sub_right_comm, ← map_sub, ← TensorProduct.sub_tmul]
      exact add_mem (tensorEquivSum_mem (h₁ j a₁ q₁ hq₁) hq₂)
        (tensorEquivSum_mem hq₁ (h₁' j a₂ q₂ hq₂))
    · rw [X_inr_mul_tensorEquivSum, add_sub_assoc, ← map_sub, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
      exact add_mem (tensorEquivSum_mem (h₂ j a₁ q₁ hq₁) hq₂)
        (tensorEquivSum_mem hq₁ (h₂' j a₂ q₂ hq₂))

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RelativeKoszul.isWeightCoord_tensorCoord
statement:
theorem isWeightCoord_tensorCoord {η : H →ₗ[K] L} (b : Basis (J₁ ⊕ J₂) K V)
    {wt : J₁ ⊕ J₂ → Dual K H} {c₁ c₂ : Dual K H}
    (hb : ∀ a j, ⁅η a, (b j : L)⁆ = wt j a • (b j : L))
    (hm₁ : ∀ a m, ⁅η a, Ψ₁.symm (monomial m 1)⁆ =
      (c₁ + monoWt (wt ∘ Sum.inl) m) a • Ψ₁.symm (monomial m 1))
    (hm₂ : ∀ a m, ⁅η a, Ψ₂.symm (monomial m 1)⁆ =
      (c₂ + monoWt (wt ∘ Sum.inr) m) a • Ψ₂.symm (monomial m 1)) :
    IsWeightCoord b wt (DerivAction.ofMap (X₁ ⊗[K] X₂) η) (tensorCoord Ψ₁ Ψ₂) (c₁ + c₂) where
  basis a j
proof:
:= hb a j
  monomial a m := by
    rw [DerivAction.ofMap_φ, tensorCoord_symm_monomial, TensorProduct.LieModule.lie_tmul_right,
      hm₁, hm₂, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← add_smul]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Finsupp.comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain m, monoWt_sumElim,
      Finsupp.comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain m]
    congr 1
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply]
    ring

name: Module.End.isCompl_weightSpaceOf
statement:
lemma isCompl_weightSpaceOf (hT : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOf T ν = ⊤) (μ : Dual K H) :
    IsCompl (weightSpaceOf T μ) (⨆ ν, ⨆ (_ : ν ≠ μ), weightSpaceOf T ν)
proof:
:=
  ⟨iSupIndep_weightSpaceOf T μ,
    codisjoint_iff.mpr ((iSup_split_single (fun ν ↦ weightSpaceOf T ν) μ).symm.trans hT)⟩

name: Module.End.weightProj_mem
statement: lemma weightProj_mem (μ : Dual K H) (y : Y) : weightProj hT μ y ∈ weightSpaceOf T μ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projection_apply_mem _ y

name: Module.End.weightProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightProj_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} {y : Y} (hy : y ∈ weightSpaceOf T μ) :
    weightProj hT μ y = y
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projection_apply_of_mem_left _ hy

name: Module.End.weightProj_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma weightProj_of_mem_ne {μ ν : Dual K H} (h : ν ≠ μ) {y : Y} (hy : y ∈ weightSpaceOf T ν) :
    weightProj hT μ y = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.projection_apply_eq_zero_iff _).mpr
    (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem h hy))

name: Module.End.weightProj_comm
statement:
lemma weightProj_comm (μ : Dual K H) (a : H) (y : Y) :
    weightProj hT μ (T a y) = T a (weightProj hT μ y)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOf T ν := hT ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν y hy =>
    rw [hy a, map_smul]
    by_cases h : ν = μ
    · subst h
      rw [weightProj_of_mem hT hy, hy a]
    · rw [weightProj_of_mem_ne hT h hy, map_zero, smul_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => simp only [map_add, h, h']

name: LinearMap.exists_comp_eq_of_ker_le
statement:
lemma LinearMap.exists_comp_eq_of_ker_le {K V W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (D : V →ₗ[K] W) (F : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (h : LinearMap.ker D ≤ LinearMap.ker F) : ∃ ψ : W →ₗ[K] K, ψ ∘ₗ D = F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := LinearMap.exists_extend
    ((LinearMap.ker D).liftQ F h ∘ₗ D.quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap)
  refine ⟨ψ, LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun hψ ⟨D x, LinearMap.mem_range_self D x⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_tmul
statement:
lemma θ_tmul (a : H) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L) (m : X) :
    ρ.θ a (c ⊗ₜ m) = extDeriv (ρ.D a) c ⊗ₜ m + c ⊗ₜ ρ.φ a m
proof:
:= by
  induction c using exterior_induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    have e : ∀ m' : X, algebraMap K (ExteriorAlgebra K L) r ⊗ₜ[K] m' =
        r • ((1 : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ m') := fun m' ↦ by
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_tmul']
    rw [e, e, map_smul, θ_one_tmul, extDeriv_algebraMap, zero_tmul, zero_add]
  | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [add_tmul, map_add, hc, hc']; abel
  | ι_mul y c hc =>
    rw [← wedge_tmul, θ_wedge, hc, map_add, wedge_tmul, wedge_tmul, wedge_tmul, extDeriv_ι_mul,
      add_tmul, add_assoc]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainPair_θ
statement:
lemma cochainPair_θ {B : N →ₗ[K] X →ₗ[K] K} (hD : ∀ a, ρN.D a = ρ.D a)
    (hBφ : ∀ (a : H) (n : N) (m : X), B (ρN.φ a n) m = -B n (ρ.φ a m)) {k : ℕ}
    {μ : Dual K H} {f : Cochains K L N k} (hf : f ∈ ρN.cochainWeightSpace k μ) (a : H)
    {t : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X} (ht : t ∈ chainsIn K L X k) :
    cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) (ρ.θ a t) =
      -μ a * cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := ht
  induction s with
  | tmul ω m =>
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (hf a) ω
    rw [coActDeg_apply, hD, LinearMap.smul_apply] at h
    have h' : f (extDerivDeg (ρ.D a) k ω) = ρN.φ a (f ω) - μ a • f ω := by
      rw [← h, sub_sub_cancel]
    have e : degProj K L k (extDeriv (ρ.D a) (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L)) =
        extDerivDeg (ρ.D a) k ω := by
      rw [← coe_extDerivDeg, degProj_subtype]
    rw [incl_tmul, θ_tmul, map_add, cochainPair_tmul, cochainPair_tmul, cochainPair_tmul]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, e, degProj_subtype, h', map_sub, map_smul,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hBφ, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, hs, hs', mul_add]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.comp_mk_mem_range
statement:
lemma comp_mk_mem_range {B : N →ₗ[K] X →ₗ[K] K}
    (hrep : ∀ (γ : Dual K H) (ψ : X →ₗ[K] K), (∀ a m, ψ (ρ.φ a m) = γ a * ψ m) →
      ψ ∈ LinearMap.range B)
    (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K L) :
    ∀ (χ : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X →ₗ[K] K) (γ : Dual K H),
      (∀ a t, χ (ρ.θ a t) = γ a * χ t) →
        χ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ X c ∈ LinearMap.range B
proof:
:= by
  induction c using exterior_induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    intro χ γ hχ
    have e : χ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ X (algebraMap K _ r) =
        r • (χ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ X 1) := by
      ext m
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
        ← smul_tmul', map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        TensorProduct.mk_apply]
    rw [e]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ r (hrep γ _ fun a m ↦ ?_)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply]
    rw [← θ_one_tmul, hχ]
  | add c c' hc hc' =>
    intro χ γ hχ
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.comp_add]
    exact add_mem (hc χ γ hχ) (hc' χ γ hχ)
  | ι_mul y c hc =>
    intro χ γ hχ
    have hy : y ∈ ⨆ β, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D β := hL ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem β y hy =>
      have e : χ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ X (ι K y * c) =
          (χ ∘ₗ wedge K L X y) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ X c := by
        ext m
        rfl
      rw [e]
      refine hc _ (γ - β) fun a t ↦ ?_
      have h := ρ.θ_wedge a y t
      rw [Module.End.mem_weightSpaceOf.mp hy a, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply] at h
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' h.symm, map_sub, hχ, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply]
      ring
    | zero =>
      rw [map_zero, zero_mul, map_zero, LinearMap.comp_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    | add y y' _ _ h h' =>
      rw [map_add, add_mul, map_add, LinearMap.comp_add]
      exact add_mem h h'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.exists_cochain_of_weight
statement:
lemma exists_cochain_of_weight {B : N →ₗ[K] X →ₗ[K] K} (hD : ∀ a, ρN.D a = ρ.D a)
    (hBφ : ∀ (a : H) (n : N) (m : X), B (ρN.φ a n) m = -B n (ρ.φ a m))
    (hinj : Function.Injective B)
    (hrep : ∀ (γ : Dual K H) (ψ : X →ₗ[K] K), (∀ a m, ψ (ρ.φ a m) = γ a * ψ m) →
      ψ ∈ LinearMap.range B)
    (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤) {k : ℕ} {μ : Dual K H}
    (ψ : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X →ₗ[K] K) (hψθ : ∀ a t, ψ (ρ.θ a t) = -μ a * ψ t) :
    ∃ g ∈ ρN.cochainWeightSpace k μ,
      ∀ t ∈ chainsIn K L X k, cochainPair B (g ∘ₗ degProj K L k) t = ψ t
proof:
:= by
  have hΦ : ∀ ω : ⋀[K]^k L, ψ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ X (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ∈
      LinearMap.range B := fun ω ↦ comp_mk_mem_range ρ hrep hL _ ψ (-μ) hψθ
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Cochains K L N k,
      ∀ ω m, B (g ω) m = ψ ((ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ m) :=
    ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofInjective B hinj).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (((LinearMap.llcomp K X _ K ψ) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk K _ X ∘ₗ
          (⋀[K]^k L).subtype).codRestrict (LinearMap.range B) hΦ),
      fun ω m ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply (f := B) (h := hinj)
        (⟨_, hΦ ω⟩ : LinearMap.range B)) m⟩
  refine ⟨g, fun a ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hinj (LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)
    have h := hψθ a ((ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ m)
    rw [θ_tmul, map_add] at h
    rw [coActDeg_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hBφ, hD, map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, hg, hg, hg, smul_eq_mul, coe_extDerivDeg]
    linear_combination -h
  · rintro t ⟨s, rfl⟩
    induction s with
    | tmul ω m => rw [incl_tmul, cochainPair_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, degProj_subtype, hg]
    | add s s' h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, h, h']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.exists_δ_eq_of_subsingleton_homology
statement:
theorem exists_δ_eq_of_subsingleton_homology {B : N →ₗ[K] X →ₗ[K] K}
    (hD : ∀ a, ρN.D a = ρ.D a) (hB : ∀ (x : L) (n : N) (m : X), B ⁅x, n⁆ m = -B n ⁅x, m⁆)
    (hBφ : ∀ (a : H) (n : N) (m : X), B (ρN.φ a n) m = -B n (ρ.φ a m))
    (hinj : Function.Injective B)
    (hrep : ∀ (γ : Dual K H) (ψ : X →ₗ[K] K), (∀ a m, ψ (ρ.φ a m) = γ a * ψ m) →
      ψ ∈ LinearMap.range B)
    (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤)
    (hX : ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν = ⊤)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : Subsingleton (homology K L X (k + 1)))
    {μ : Dual K H} {f : Cochains K L N (k + 1)} (hf : f ∈ ρN.cochainWeightSpace (k + 1) μ)
    (hδ : δ K L N (k + 1) f = 0) :
    ∃ g ∈ ρN.cochainWeightSpace k μ, δ K L N k g = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F, F = cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L (k + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFθ : ∀ (a : H) {t}, t ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1) → F (ρ.θ a t) = -μ a * F t := by
    intro a t ht
    rw [hF]
    exact cochainPair_θ ρ ρN hD hBφ hf a ht
  
  have hcyc : ∀ t ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1), diff K L X t = 0 → F t = 0 := by
    intro t ht ht0
    have hb : t ∈ boundaries K L X (k + 1) := by
      rw [(subsingleton_homology_iff K L X (k + 1)).mp hk]
      exact ⟨ht, LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr ht0⟩
    obtain ⟨s, ⟨s, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hb
    clear ht ht0
    rw [hF, ← cochainPair_cochainDiff hB]
    induction s with
    | tmul ω m =>
      have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hδ ω
      rw [δ_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
      rw [incl_tmul, cochainPair_tmul, h, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, hs, hs', add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨ψ₁, hψ₁d⟩ : ∃ ψ₁ : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X →ₗ[K] K,
      ∀ t ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1), ψ₁ (diff K L X t) = F t := by
    obtain ⟨ψ₁, hψ₁⟩ := LinearMap.exists_comp_eq_of_ker_le
      ((diff K L X).domRestrict (chainsIn K L X (k + 1))) (F.domRestrict (chainsIn K L X (k + 1)))
      fun t ht ↦ LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hcyc t t.2 (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ht))
    exact ⟨ψ₁, fun t ht ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun hψ₁ ⟨t, ht⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Pr, hPmem, hPself, hPne, hPcomm⟩ : ∃ Pr : Module.End K (ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X),
      (∀ t, Pr t ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace (-μ)) ∧ (∀ t ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace (-μ), Pr t = t) ∧
      (∀ ν ≠ -μ, ∀ t ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν, Pr t = 0) ∧
      (∀ a t, Pr (ρ.θ a t) = ρ.θ a (Pr t)) :=
    have hT := ρ.iSup_chainWeightSpace hL hX
    ⟨Module.End.weightProj hT (-μ), Module.End.weightProj_mem hT _,
      fun _ ↦ Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT, fun _ h _ ↦ Module.End.weightProj_of_mem_ne hT h,
      Module.End.weightProj_comm hT _⟩
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψθ, hψd⟩ : ∃ ψ : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X →ₗ[K] K,
      (∀ a t, ψ (ρ.θ a t) = -μ a * ψ t) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1), ψ (diff K L X t) = F t := by
    refine ⟨ψ₁ ∘ₗ Pr, fun a t ↦ ?_, fun t ht ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hPcomm,
        mem_chainWeightSpace.mp (hPmem t) a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.neg_apply]
    · rw [← ρ.iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace hL hX (chainsIn K L X (k + 1))
        (fun a _ hc ↦ ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a hc)] at ht
      induction ht using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem ν t ht =>
        obtain ⟨htc, htw⟩ := ht
        have hdw := ρ.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace htw
        by_cases hν : ν = -μ
        · subst hν
          rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hPself _ hdw, hψ₁d t htc]
        · rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hPne ν hν _ hdw, map_zero]
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, ν a ≠ -μ a := by
            by_contra h
            push Not at h
            exact hν (LinearMap.ext fun a ↦ (h a).trans (LinearMap.neg_apply μ a).symm)
          have h1 := hFθ a htc
          rw [mem_chainWeightSpace.mp htw a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h1
          have h2 : (ν a - -μ a) * F t = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, h1, sub_self]
          exact ((mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)).symm
      | zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | add t t' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, h, h']
  
  obtain ⟨g, hgw, hpair⟩ := exists_cochain_of_weight ρ ρN hD hBφ hinj hrep hL (k := k) ψ hψθ
  refine ⟨g, hgw, LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hinj (LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_)⟩
  have hω : (ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ m ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1) := tmul_mem_chainsIn ω.2 m
  rw [δ_apply]
  change cochainPair B (cochainDiff K L N (g ∘ₗ degProj K L k)) ((ω : ExteriorAlgebra K L) ⊗ₜ m)
    = _
  rw [cochainPair_cochainDiff hB, hpair _ (diff_mem_chainsIn hω), hψd _ hω, hF,
    cochainPair_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, degProj_subtype]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.polynomialDiff_squared
statement:
theorem polynomialDiff_squared [LinearOrder I] (b : Module.Basis I R L) (z : EP) :
    polynomialDiff b (polynomialDiff b z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polynomialDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, diff_diff, map_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.exists_rectangle_pbw_incl
statement:
theorem exists_rectangle_pbw_incl [LinearOrder I] (b : Module.Basis I R L) (q : ℕ)
    (c : ⋀[R]^q L ⊗[R] UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular R L) :
    ∃ n, pbwTensor b (incl R L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular R L) q c) ∈
      rectangle q n
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul e u =>
    refine ⟨(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwEquiv b
      (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular.equiv R L u)).totalDegree, ?_⟩
    rw [incl_tmul, pbwTensor_tmul]
    exact tmul_mem_rectangle e.2 ((MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mpr le_rfl)
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨max n m, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact add_mem (rectangle_mono q (le_max_left n m) hn)
      (rectangle_mono q (le_max_right n m) hm)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.pbwTensor_symm_mem_chainsIn
statement:
theorem pbwTensor_symm_mem_chainsIn [LinearOrder I] (b : Module.Basis I R L) (q n : ℕ)
    {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) :
    (pbwTensor b).symm z ∈ chainsIn R L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular R L) q
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, p, _, rfl⟩ := hz
    change e ⊗ₜ[R] _ ∈ _
    exact tmul_mem_chainsIn he _
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.polynomialDiff_pbwTensor
statement:
theorem polynomialDiff_pbwTensor [LinearOrder I] (b : Module.Basis I R L)
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular R L) :
    polynomialDiff b (pbwTensor b c) =
      pbwTensor b (diff R L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular R L) c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polynomialDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.polynomial_positive_acyclic
proof:
:=
  Koszul.exists_primitive_of_isLeadingKoszul b (isLeadingKoszul_polynomialDiff b)
    (polynomialDiff_squared b) q n hq hz hcycle

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.regular_positive_cycle_boundary
statement:
theorem regular_positive_cycle_boundary (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    {c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L}
    (hc : c ∈ chainsIn K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q)
    (hcycle : diff K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) c = 0) :
    c ∈ boundaries K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_rectangle_pbw_incl b q t
  have hpc : polynomialDiff b (pbwTensor b
      (incl K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q t)) = 0 := by
    rw [polynomialDiff_pbwTensor, hcycle, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩ := polynomial_positive_acyclic b q n hq hn hpc
  refine ⟨(pbwTensor b).symm y, pbwTensor_symm_mem_chainsIn b (q + 1) (n - 1) hy, ?_⟩
  apply (pbwTensor b).injective
  simpa only [polynomialDiff, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] using hdy

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.regular_cycles_eq_boundaries
statement:
theorem regular_cycles_eq_boundaries (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    cycles K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q =
      boundaries K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro c hc
    exact regular_positive_cycle_boundary b q hq hc.1 hc.2
  · exact boundaries_le_cycles q

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.regular_positive_acyclic
statement:
theorem regular_positive_acyclic (q : ℕ)
    (c : ⋀[K]^(q + 1) L ⊗[K] UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L)
    (hc : d K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q c = 0) :
    ∃ y : ⋀[K]^(q + 1 + 1) L ⊗[K] UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L,
      d K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) (q + 1) y = c
proof:
:= by
  have hb := regular_positive_cycle_boundary b (q + 1) (Nat.zero_lt_succ q)
    (c := incl K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) (q + 1) c)
    ⟨c, rfl⟩ (by rw [← incl_d, hc, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨w, ⟨y, rfl⟩, hy⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨y, incl_injective (q + 1) ?_⟩
  rw [incl_d]
  exact hy

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.CELeading.regular_subsingleton_homology
statement:
theorem regular_subsingleton_homology (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Subsingleton (homology K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q)
proof:
:= by
  apply (subsingleton_homology_iff K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q).mpr
  exact (regular_cycles_eq_boundaries b q hq).symm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.subsingleton_homology_leftRegular
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_leftRegular (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Subsingleton (homology K L (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.LeftRegular K L) q)
proof:
:= by
  let : LinearOrder (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex K L) :=
    IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  exact CELeading.regular_subsingleton_homology (Module.Free.chooseBasis K L) q hq

name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.finrank_homology_add_add
statement:
theorem finrank_homology_add_add (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat K)) [FiniteDimensional K S.X₂] :
    finrank K S.homology + finrank K (LinearMap.range S.f.hom) +
        finrank K (LinearMap.range S.g.hom) = finrank K S.X₂
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : finrank K S.homology =
      finrank K (LinearMap.ker S.g.hom ⧸ LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) :=
    S.moduleCatHomologyIso.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
  have h₂ := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles)
  have h₃ : finrank K (LinearMap.range S.f.hom) =
      finrank K (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) := by
    have e : (LinearMap.ker S.g.hom).subtype ∘ₗ S.moduleCatToCycles = S.f.hom :=
      LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, ← LinearMap.range_comp, e]
  have h₄ := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker S.g.hom
  omega

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.diff_mem_chainPiece
statement:
lemma diff_mem_chainPiece {k : ℕ} {ν : Dual K H} {c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X}
    (hc : c ∈ ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) ν) : diff K L X c ∈ ρ.chainPiece k ν
proof:
:=
  ⟨diff_mem_chainsIn hc.1, ρ.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace hc.2⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.coe_diffPiece
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_diffPiece (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) (c : ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) ν) :
    (ρ.diffPiece k ν c : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X) = diff K L X c
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.map_diff_chainPiece
statement:
lemma map_diff_chainPiece (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    (ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) ν).map (diff K L X) =
      (LinearMap.range (ρ.diffPiece k ν)).map (ρ.chainPiece k ν).subtype
proof:
:= by
  have e : (ρ.chainPiece k ν).subtype ∘ₗ ρ.diffPiece k ν =
      diff K L X ∘ₗ (ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) ν).subtype := LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
  rw [← LinearMap.range_comp, e, LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.boundaries_inf_chainWeightSpace_of_iSup
statement:
lemma boundaries_inf_chainWeightSpace_of_iSup (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    boundaries K L X k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν = (ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) ν).map (diff K L X)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun b ⟨hb, hbw⟩ ↦ ?_)
    fun _ ⟨c, hc, hb⟩ ↦ hb ▸ ⟨⟨c, hc.1, rfl⟩, ρ.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace hc.2⟩
  have hT := ρ.iSup_chainWeightSpace hL hX
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hb
  
  set Pr := Module.End.weightProj hT ν
  have hPr : ∀ c ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1),
      Pr c ∈ ρ.chainPiece (k + 1) ν ∧ Pr (diff K L X c) = diff K L X (Pr c) := by
    intro c hc
    rw [← ρ.iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace hL hX (chainsIn K L X (k + 1))
      (fun a _ hc ↦ ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a hc)] at hc
    induction hc using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem γ c hc =>
      have hdc := ρ.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace hc.2
      by_cases hγ : γ = ν
      · subst hγ
        rw [Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT hc.2, Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT hdc]
        exact ⟨hc, rfl⟩
      · rw [Module.End.weightProj_of_mem_ne hT hγ hc.2,
          Module.End.weightProj_of_mem_ne hT hγ hdc, map_zero]
        exact ⟨zero_mem _, rfl⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨by rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _, by simp only [map_zero]⟩
    | add c c' _ _ h h' =>
      simp only [map_add]
      exact ⟨add_mem h.1 h'.1, by rw [h.2, h'.2]⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hPr c hc
  exact ⟨Pr c, h₁, by rw [← h₂, Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT hbw]⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add_add
statement:
theorem finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add_add (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H)
    [FiniteDimensional K (ρ.chainPiece k ν)] :
    finrank K (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k ν) + finrank K (LinearMap.range (ρ.diffPiece k ν)) +
        finrank K ((ρ.chainPiece k ν).map (diff K L X)) = finrank K (ρ.chainPiece k ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : cycles K L X k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν =
      (LinearMap.ker ((diff K L X).domRestrict (ρ.chainPiece k ν))).map
        (ρ.chainPiece k ν).subtype := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_domRestrict, Submodule.map_comap_subtype]
    exact le_antisymm (fun c ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨h₁, h₃⟩, h₂⟩)
      fun c ⟨⟨h₁, h₃⟩, h₂⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional K ↥(cycles K L X k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (fun c ⟨⟨h₁, _⟩, h₃⟩ ↦ ⟨h₁, h₃⟩ :
      cycles K L X k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν ≤ ρ.chainPiece k ν)
  have h₁ := ρ.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add k ν
  have h₂ : finrank K ↥(boundaries K L X k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν) =
      finrank K (LinearMap.range (ρ.diffPiece k ν)) := by
    rw [ρ.boundaries_inf_chainWeightSpace_of_iSup hL hX, map_diff_chainPiece,
      Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
  have h₃ : finrank K ↥(cycles K L X k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace ν) =
      finrank K (LinearMap.ker ((diff K L X).domRestrict (ρ.chainPiece k ν))) := by
    rw [hZ, Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
  let _ : AddCommGroup (ρ.chainPiece k ν) := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup K
  have h₄ := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker ((diff K L X).domRestrict (ρ.chainPiece k ν))
  rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict] at h₄
  omega

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainPiecePair_apply
statement:
lemma cochainPiecePair_apply (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) (f : ρN.cochainWeightSpace k μ)
    (t : ρ.chainPiece k (-μ)) :
    ρ.cochainPiecePair ρN B k μ f t =
      cochainPair B ((f : Cochains K L N k) ∘ₗ degProj K L k) t
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainPair_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, ν a ≠ -μ a := by
    by_contra h'
    push Not at h'
    exact h (LinearMap.ext fun a ↦ (h' a).trans (LinearMap.neg_apply μ a).symm)
  have h1 := cochainPair_θ ρ ρN hD hBφ hf a ht.1
  rw [mem_chainWeightSpace.mp ht.2 a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h2 : (ν a - -μ a) * cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) t = 0 := by
    rw [sub_mul, h1, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainPair_eq_zero_of_chainPiece
statement:
lemma cochainPair_eq_zero_of_chainPiece {k : ℕ} {μ : Dual K H} {f : Cochains K L N k}
    (hf : f ∈ ρN.cochainWeightSpace k μ)
    (h0 : ∀ t ∈ ρ.chainPiece k (-μ), cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) t = 0)
    {t : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X} (ht : t ∈ chainsIn K L X k) :
    cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ρ.iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace hL hX (chainsIn K L X k)
    (fun a _ hc ↦ ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a hc)] at ht
  induction ht using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν t ht =>
    by_cases hν : ν = -μ
    · exact h0 t (hν ▸ ht)
    · exact ρ.cochainPair_eq_zero_of_ne ρN hD hBφ hν hf ht
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add t t' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add, h, h', add_zero]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.bijective_cochainPiecePair
statement:
theorem bijective_cochainPiecePair (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Function.Bijective (ρ.cochainPiecePair ρN B k μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun f f' hff' ↦ ?_, fun χ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub] at hff'
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    set g := f - f'
    refine Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun ω ↦ hinj (LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_))
    have := ρ.cochainPair_eq_zero_of_chainPiece ρN hL hX hD hBφ g.2
      (fun t ht ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun hff' ⟨t, ht⟩) (tmul_mem_chainsIn ω.2 m)
    rw [cochainPair_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, degProj_subtype] at this
    rw [this, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  · have hT := ρ.iSup_chainWeightSpace hL hX
    obtain ⟨χ', hχ'⟩ := LinearMap.exists_extend χ
    set Pr := Module.End.weightProj hT (-μ)
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hpair⟩ := exists_cochain_of_weight ρ ρN hD hBφ hinj hrep hL (k := k)
      (μ := μ) (χ' ∘ₗ Pr) fun a t ↦ by
        rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.weightProj_comm hT,
          mem_chainWeightSpace.mp (Module.End.weightProj_mem hT _ t) a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
          LinearMap.neg_apply]
    refine ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, LinearMap.ext fun t ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [cochainPiecePair_apply, hpair _ t.2.1, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      Module.End.weightProj_of_mem hT t.2.2]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hχ' t

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainPair_δ
statement:
lemma cochainPair_δ (hB : ∀ (x : L) (n : N) (m : X), B ⁅x, n⁆ m = -B n ⁅x, m⁆) (k : ℕ)
    (f : Cochains K L N k) {t : ExteriorAlgebra K L ⊗[K] X} (ht : t ∈ chainsIn K L X (k + 1)) :
    cochainPair B (δ K L N k f ∘ₗ degProj K L (k + 1)) t =
      cochainPair B (f ∘ₗ degProj K L k) (diff K L X t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := ht
  rw [← cochainPair_cochainDiff hB]
  induction s with
  | tmul ω m =>
    rw [incl_tmul, cochainPair_tmul, cochainPair_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, degProj_subtype,
      δ_apply]
  | add s s' h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, h, h']

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.cochainPiecePair_δWeight
statement:
lemma cochainPiecePair_δWeight (hB : ∀ (x : L) (n : N) (m : X), B ⁅x, n⁆ m = -B n ⁅x, m⁆)
    (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) (f : ρN.cochainWeightSpace k μ) :
    ρ.cochainPiecePair ρN B (k + 1) μ (ρN.δWeight k μ f) =
      (ρ.diffPiece k (-μ)).dualMap (ρ.cochainPiecePair ρN B k μ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun t ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.dualMap_apply, cochainPiecePair_apply, cochainPiecePair_apply, coe_diffPiece,
    coe_δWeight]
  exact cochainPair_δ hB k f t.2.1

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.finrank_weightComplex_homology
statement:
theorem finrank_weightComplex_homology
    (hB : ∀ (x : L) (n : N) (m : X), B ⁅x, n⁆ m = -B n ⁅x, m⁆) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hfin : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional K (ρ.chainPiece j (-μ))) (k : ℕ) :
    finrank K ((ρN.weightComplex μ).homology k) = finrank K (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k (-μ))
proof:
:= by
  set e := ρ.cochainPieceEquiv ρN hL hX hD hBφ hinj hrep
  
  have hδ : ∀ j, finrank K (LinearMap.range (ρN.δWeight j μ)) =
      finrank K (LinearMap.range (ρ.diffPiece j (-μ))) := fun j ↦ by
    have : ρN.δWeight j μ = (e (j + 1) μ).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (ρ.diffPiece j (-μ)).dualMap ∘ₗ (e j μ).toLinearMap := by
      refine LinearMap.ext fun f ↦ (e (j + 1) μ).injective ?_
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
        LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact ρ.cochainPiecePair_δWeight ρN hB j μ f
    rw [this, LinearMap.range_comp, LinearMap.range_comp, LinearEquiv.range, Submodule.map_top,
      LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]
    let _ : AddCommGroup (ρ.chainPiece j (-μ)) := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup K
    let _ : AddCommGroup (ρ.chainPiece (j + 1) (-μ)) := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup K
    exact LinearMap.finrank_range_dualMap_eq_finrank_range (ρ.diffPiece j (-μ))
  have hX₂ : finrank K ((ρN.weightComplex μ).sc k).X₂ = finrank K (ρ.chainPiece k (-μ)) :=
    let _ : AddCommGroup (ρ.chainPiece k (-μ)) := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup K
    ((e k μ).finrank_eq).trans (Subspace.dual_finrank_eq)
  have : FiniteDimensional K ((ρN.weightComplex μ).sc k).X₂ :=
    let _ : AddCommGroup (ρ.chainPiece k (-μ)) := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup K
    LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (e k μ).symm
  have hS := ((ρN.weightComplex μ).sc k).finrank_homology_add_add
  have hC := ρ.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add_add hL hX k (-μ)
  have hg : finrank K (LinearMap.range ((ρN.weightComplex μ).sc k).g.hom) =
      finrank K (LinearMap.range (ρ.diffPiece k (-μ))) := by
    change finrank K (LinearMap.range
      ((ρN.weightComplex μ).d k ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next k)).hom) = _
    rw [CochainComplex.next, weightComplex_d]
    exact hδ k
  have hf : finrank K (LinearMap.range ((ρN.weightComplex μ).sc k).f.hom) =
      finrank K ((ρ.chainPiece k (-μ)).map (diff K L X)) := by
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have h0 : (ρ.chainPiece 0 (-μ)).map (diff K L X) = ⊥ :=
        le_bot_iff.mp (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr fun c hc ↦
          diff_eq_zero_of_mem_chainsIn_zero hc.1)
      change finrank K (LinearMap.range
        ((ρN.weightComplex μ).d ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev 0) 0).hom) = _
      rw [h0, finrank_bot, CochainComplex.prev_nat_zero,
        (ρN.weightComplex μ).shape 0 0 (by simp), ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.range_zero,
        finrank_bot]
    | succ j =>
      change finrank K (LinearMap.range
        ((ρN.weightComplex μ).d ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev (j + 1)) (j + 1)).hom) = _
      rw [map_diff_chainPiece, Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ,
        weightComplex_d]
      exact hδ j
  change finrank K ((ρN.weightComplex μ).sc k).homology = _
  omega

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_mem_cycles_iff
statement:
lemma incl_mem_cycles_iff (k : ℕ) (t : ⋀[R]^k L ⊗[R] M) :
    incl R L M k t ∈ cycles R L M k ↔ ((chainComplex R L M).sc k).g t = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [cycles_zero, chainsIn, LinearMap.mem_range_self, true_iff]
    simp [HomologicalComplex.sc, HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor,
      HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor']
  | succ k =>
    rw [incl_mem_cycles_succ_iff]
    change _ ↔ ((chainComplex R L M).d (k + 1)
      ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next (k + 1))).hom t = 0
    erw [ChainComplex.next_nat_succ, chainComplex_d]
    rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.incl_mem_boundaries_iff
statement:
lemma incl_mem_boundaries_iff (k : ℕ) (t : ⋀[R]^k L ⊗[R] M) :
    incl R L M k t ∈ boundaries R L M k ↔
      t ∈ LinearMap.range (((chainComplex R L M).sc k).f.hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaries_eq_map_d]
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, (incl_injective k).eq_iff, exists_eq_right]
  change _ ↔ t ∈ LinearMap.range
    (((chainComplex R L M).d ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev k) k).hom)
  erw [ChainComplex.prev, chainComplex_d]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplexCyclesToHomology_surjective
statement:
lemma chainComplexCyclesToHomology_surjective (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (chainComplexCyclesToHomology R L M k)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, c, hc, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hc.1
  exact ⟨⟨t, (incl_mem_cycles_iff k t).mp hc⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplexCyclesToHomology_exact
statement:
lemma chainComplexCyclesToHomology_exact (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact ((chainComplex R L M).sc k).moduleCatToCycles
      (chainComplexCyclesToHomology R L M k)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  change (⟨_, _⟩ : homology R L M k) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff]
  change (boundaries R L M k).mkQ (incl R L M k t.1) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, incl_mem_boundaries_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, Subtype.ext hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, congrArg Subtype.val hx⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplexHomologyIso_homologyπ
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma chainComplexHomologyIso_homologyπ (k : ℕ) :
    (chainComplex R L M).homologyπ k ≫ (chainComplexHomologyIso R L M k).hom =
      (chainComplexLeftHomologyData R L M k).cyclesIso.hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (chainComplexCyclesToHomology R L M k)
proof:
:=
  (chainComplexLeftHomologyData R L M k).homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.chainComplexHomologyIso_naturality
statement:
theorem chainComplexHomologyIso_naturality (k : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (chainComplexMap f) k ≫
        (chainComplexHomologyIso R L N k).hom =
      (chainComplexHomologyIso R L M k).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (homologyMap R L k f)
proof:
:=
  (chainComplexLeftHomologyMapData k f).homologyMap_comm

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.tmul_mem_rectangle
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_rectangle {k n : ℕ} {ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L} (hω : ω ∈ ⋀[R]^k L)
    {u : U} (hu : LeftRegular.equiv R L u ∈ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration R L n) :
    ω ⊗ₜ[R] u ∈ rectangle R L k n
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨ω, hω, u, hu, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.rectangle_le
statement:
lemma rectangle_le {k n : ℕ} {S : Submodule R E}
    (h : ∀ (ω : ExteriorAlgebra R L), ω ∈ ⋀[R]^k L → ∀ u : U,
      LeftRegular.equiv R L u ∈ UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration R L n →
      ω ⊗ₜ[R] u ∈ S) : rectangle R L k n ≤ S
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨ω, hω, u, hu, rfl⟩
  exact h ω hω u hu

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.rectangle_mono
statement:
lemma rectangle_mono (k : ℕ) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    rectangle R L k n ≤ rectangle R L k m
proof:
:=
  rectangle_le fun _ hω _ hu ↦
    tmul_mem_rectangle hω (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration_mono h hu)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.wedge_mem_rectangle
statement:
lemma wedge_mem_rectangle (x : L) {k n : ℕ} {c : E}
    (hc : c ∈ rectangle R L k n) : wedge R L U x c ∈ rectangle R L (k + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  refine rectangle_le (S := (rectangle R L (k + 1) n).comap (wedge R L U x))
    (fun ω hω u hu ↦ ?_) hc
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, wedge_tmul]
  apply tmul_mem_rectangle _ hu
  rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ']
  exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x) hω

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.lie_mem_coefficient
proof:
:= by
  rw [LeftRegular.equiv_lie]
  simpa [Nat.add_comm] using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mul_mem_filtration
    (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_mem_filtration_one x) hu

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.lieAction_tmul_mem_rectangle
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing ω with
  | zero =>
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_zero, Submodule.mem_one] at hω
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hω
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← smul_tmul', map_smul, lieAction_one_tmul]
    apply Submodule.smul_mem
    exact tmul_mem_rectangle
      (by rw [exteriorPower, pow_zero]; exact Submodule.one_le.mp le_rfl)
      (lie_mem_coefficient x hu)
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ'] at hω
    induction hω using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
    | mem_mul_mem a ha b hb =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ha
      rw [← wedge_tmul, lieAction_wedge]
      exact add_mem
        (wedge_mem_rectangle _ (rectangle_mono k (Nat.le_succ n) (tmul_mem_rectangle hb hu)))
        (wedge_mem_rectangle _ (ih hb))
    | add a _ b _ ha hb => rw [add_tmul, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.lieAction_mem_rectangle
statement:
theorem lieAction_mem_rectangle (x : L) {k n : ℕ} {c : E}
    (hc : c ∈ rectangle R L k n) : lieAction R L U x c ∈ rectangle R L k (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  rectangle_le (S := (rectangle R L k (n + 1)).comap (lieAction R L U x))
    (fun _ hω _ hu ↦ lieAction_tmul_mem_rectangle x hω hu) hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.diff_tmul_mem_rectangle
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing ω with
  | zero =>
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ'] at hω
    induction hω using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
    | mem_mul_mem a ha b hb =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
      rw [← wedge_tmul, diff_wedge,
        diff_eq_zero_of_mem_chainsIn_zero (tmul_mem_chainsIn hb u), map_zero, sub_zero]
      exact neg_mem (lieAction_tmul_mem_rectangle x hb hu)
    | add a _ b _ ha hb => rw [add_tmul, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [exteriorPower, pow_succ'] at hω
    induction hω using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
    | mem_mul_mem a ha b hb =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
      rw [← wedge_tmul, diff_wedge]
      exact sub_mem (neg_mem (lieAction_tmul_mem_rectangle x hb hu))
        (wedge_mem_rectangle _ (ih hb))
    | add a _ b _ ha hb => rw [add_tmul, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.diff_mem_rectangle
statement:
theorem diff_mem_rectangle {k n : ℕ} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ rectangle R L (k + 1) n) :
    diff R L U c ∈ rectangle R L k (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  rectangle_le (S := (rectangle R L k (n + 1)).comap (diff R L U))
    (fun _ hω _ hu ↦ diff_tmul_mem_rectangle hω hu) hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.total_zero
statement: theorem total_zero (k : ℕ) : total R L k 0 = ⊥
proof: := by simp [total]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.tmul_mem_total
proof:
:= by
  have hkp : k < p := by omega
  simp only [total, ite_eq_left hkp, Submodule.mem_comap, incl_tmul]
  exact tmul_mem_rectangle ω.2 (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.filtration_mono (by omega) hu)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.total_mono
statement: theorem total_mono (k : ℕ) : Monotone (total R L k)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  by_cases hp : k < p
  · have hq : k < q := lt_of_lt_of_le hp hpq
    simp only [total, ite_eq_left hp, ite_eq_left hq]
    exact Submodule.comap_mono (rectangle_mono k (by omega))
  · simp [total, hp]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.exists_mem_total
statement:
theorem exists_mem_total (k : ℕ) (c : ⋀[R]^k L ⊗[R] U) :
    ∃ p, c ∈ total R L k p
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | tmul ω u =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.exists_mem_filtration
      (LeftRegular.equiv R L u)
    refine ⟨k + n + 1, ?_⟩
    simp only [total, show k < k + n + 1 by omega, ↓reduceIte, Submodule.mem_comap, incl_tmul]
    exact tmul_mem_rectangle ω.2 (by rwa [show k + n + 1 - k - 1 = n by omega])
  | add c c' hc hc' =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hc'
    exact ⟨max p q, add_mem (total_mono k (le_max_left p q) hp)
      (total_mono k (le_max_right p q) hq)⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.iSup_total
statement: theorem iSup_total (k : ℕ) : ⨆ p, total R L k p = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun c _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_mem_total k c
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem p hp

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.RegularFiltration.d_mem_total
statement:
theorem d_mem_total {k p : ℕ} {c : ⋀[R]^(k + 1) L ⊗[R] U}
    (hc : c ∈ total R L (k + 1) p) : d R L U k c ∈ total R L k p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : k + 1 < p
  · have hkp : k < p := by omega
    simp only [total, ite_eq_left hp, Submodule.mem_comap] at hc
    simp only [total, ite_eq_left hkp, Submodule.mem_comap, incl_d]
    exact rectangle_mono k (by omega) (diff_mem_rectangle hc)
  · simp only [total, ite_eq_right hp, Submodule.mem_bot] at hc
    subst c
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_apply
statement: lemma θ_apply (a : H) : ρ.θ a = derivExt (ρ.D a) (ρ.φ a)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_one_tmul
statement: @[simp] lemma θ_one_tmul (a : H) (m : M) : ρ.θ a (1 ⊗ₜ m) = 1 ⊗ₜ ρ.φ a m
proof:
:=
  derivExt_one_tmul _ _ m

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_wedge
statement:
lemma θ_wedge (a : H) (y : L) (c : E) :
    ρ.θ a (wedge K L M y c) = wedge K L M (ρ.D a y) c + wedge K L M y (ρ.θ a c)
proof:
:=
  derivExt_wedge _ _ y c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.diff_comp_θ
statement: theorem diff_comp_θ (a : H) : diff K L M ∘ₗ ρ.θ a = ρ.θ a ∘ₗ diff K L M
proof:
:=
  diff_comp_derivExt (ρ.D_lie a) (ρ.φ_lie a)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.diff_θ
statement: lemma diff_θ (a : H) (c : E) : diff K L M (ρ.θ a c) = ρ.θ a (diff K L M c)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (ρ.diff_comp_θ a) c

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma θ_mem_chainsIn (a : H) {k : ℕ} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ chainsIn K L M k) :
    ρ.θ a c ∈ chainsIn K L M k
proof:
:=
  derivExt_mem_chainsIn _ _ hc

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_mem_cycles
statement:
lemma θ_mem_cycles (a : H) {k : ℕ} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ cycles K L M k) :
    ρ.θ a c ∈ cycles K L M k
proof:
:=
  ⟨ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a hc.1, LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by
    rw [diff_θ, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hc.2, map_zero])⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θ_mem_boundaries
statement:
lemma θ_mem_boundaries (a : H) {k : ℕ} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ boundaries K L M k) :
    ρ.θ a c ∈ boundaries K L M k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨_, ρ.θ_mem_chainsIn a hc, ρ.diff_θ a c⟩

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.θQ_mk
statement:
lemma θQ_mk (k : ℕ) (a : H) (c : E) :
    ρ.θQ k a (Submodule.Quotient.mk c) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (ρ.θ a c)
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.mem_chainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma mem_chainWeightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {c : E} :
    c ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ ↔ ∀ a, ρ.θ a c = μ a • c
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.one_tmul_mem_chainWeightSpace
proof:
:=
  mem_chainWeightSpace.mpr fun a ↦ by
    rw [θ_one_tmul, Module.End.mem_weightSpaceOf.mp hm a, tmul_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.wedge_mem_chainWeightSpace
proof:
:=
  mem_chainWeightSpace.mpr fun a ↦ by
    rw [θ_wedge, Module.End.mem_weightSpaceOf.mp hy a, mem_chainWeightSpace.mp hc a, map_smul,
      map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.diff_mem_chainWeightSpace
statement:
lemma diff_mem_chainWeightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {c : E} (hc : c ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) :
    diff K L M c ∈ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ
proof:
:=
  mem_chainWeightSpace.mpr fun a ↦ by rw [← diff_θ, mem_chainWeightSpace.mp hc a, map_smul]

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.iSup_chainWeightSpace
statement:
theorem iSup_chainWeightSpace (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤)
    (hM : ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν = ⊤) : ⨆ μ, ρ.chainWeightSpace μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun c _ ↦ induction (fun m ↦ ?_) (fun y c hc ↦ ?_)
    (fun _ _ h h' ↦ add_mem h h') c
  · have hm : m ∈ ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν := hM ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hm using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem ν m hm => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν (ρ.one_tmul_mem_chainWeightSpace hm)
    | zero => simp
    | add m m' _ _ hm hm' => rw [tmul_add]; exact add_mem hm hm'
  · have hy : y ∈ ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ := hL ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem γ y hy =>
      induction hc using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem μ c hc => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (ρ.wedge_mem_chainWeightSpace hy hc)
      | zero => simp
      | add c c' _ _ hc hc' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hc hc'
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem hy hy'

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace
statement:
theorem iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤)
    (hM : ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν = ⊤)
    (N : Submodule K E) (hN : ∀ a, ∀ c ∈ N, ρ.θ a c ∈ N) :
    ⨆ μ, N ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ = N
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun _ ↦ inf_le_left) ?_
  have h := Module.End.inf_iSup_weightSpaceOf_le ρ.θ N hN
  have htop : ⨆ μ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.θ μ = ⊤ := ρ.iSup_chainWeightSpace hL hM
  rw [htop, inf_top_eq] at h
  exact h

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.homologyWeightSpace_le_homology
statement:
lemma homologyWeightSpace_le_homology (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ ≤ homology K L M k
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map_mono inf_le_left

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.homologyWeightSpace_le_quotWeightSpace
statement:
lemma homologyWeightSpace_le_quotWeightSpace (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ ≤ ρ.quotWeightSpace k μ
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨c, ⟨-, hc⟩, rfl⟩ a
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, θQ_mk, mem_chainWeightSpace.mp hc a]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.iSupIndep_homologyWeightSpace
statement: theorem iSupIndep_homologyWeightSpace (k : ℕ) : iSupIndep (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k)
proof:
:=
  (Module.End.iSupIndep_weightSpaceOf (ρ.θQ k)).mono (ρ.homologyWeightSpace_le_quotWeightSpace k)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.iSup_homologyWeightSpace
statement:
theorem iSup_homologyWeightSpace (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤)
    (hM : ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν = ⊤) (k : ℕ) :
    ⨆ μ, ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ = homology K L M k
proof:
:= by
  rw [homology, ← ρ.iSup_inf_chainWeightSpace hL hM (cycles K L M k)
    (fun a _ hc ↦ ρ.θ_mem_cycles a hc), Submodule.map_iSup]
  rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.homologyWeightSpace_eq
statement:
theorem homologyWeightSpace_eq (hL : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.D γ = ⊤)
    (hM : ⨆ ν, Module.End.weightSpaceOf ρ.φ ν = ⊤) (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ = homology K L M k ⊓ ρ.quotWeightSpace k μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_inf (ρ.homologyWeightSpace_le_homology k μ)
    (ρ.homologyWeightSpace_le_quotWeightSpace k μ)) fun x ⟨hx, hx'⟩ ↦ ?_
  rw [← ρ.iSup_homologyWeightSpace hL hM k] at hx
  exact Module.End.mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (ρ.θQ k) _
    (ρ.homologyWeightSpace_le_quotWeightSpace k) hx' hx

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.DerivAction.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add
statement:
theorem finrank_homologyWeightSpace_add (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H)
    [FiniteDimensional K ↥(cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ)] :
    finrank K (ρ.homologyWeightSpace k μ) +
        finrank K ↥(boundaries K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ) =
      finrank K ↥(cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ)
proof:
:= by
  set Z := cycles K L M k ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ
  set B := boundaries K L M k
  
  let _ : AddCommGroup Z := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup K
  have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (LinearMap.domRestrict B.mkQ Z)
  rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, LinearMap.ker_domRestrict, Submodule.ker_mkQ,
    ← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype] at this
  have hZB : Z ⊓ B = B ⊓ ρ.chainWeightSpace μ :=
    le_antisymm (fun c ⟨hc, hc'⟩ ↦ ⟨hc', hc.2⟩)
      fun c ⟨hc, hc'⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨boundaries_le_cycles k hc, hc'⟩, hc⟩
  rw [hZB] at this
  rw [homologyWeightSpace, ← this]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.injective_casimirBlockMap
statement:
theorem injective_casimirBlockMap (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (hW : IsPosFinite P W)
    (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hf : Function.Injective f) (c : K) :
    Function.Injective (hB.casimirBlockMap hA hV hW f c)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  exact Subtype.ext (hf (congrArg Subtype.val h))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.surjective_casimirBlockMap
statement:
theorem surjective_casimirBlockMap (hV : IsCategoryO P V) (hW : IsCategoryO P W)
    (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (c : K) :
    Function.Surjective (hB.casimirBlockMap hA hV.isPosFinite hW.isPosFinite f c)
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfv⟩ := (LieSubmodule.mem_map _).mp
    (hB.casimirBlock_le_map hA hV hW f hf c w.property)
  exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, Subtype.ext hfv⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.mem_casimirBlock_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hW c).mp hv
  apply (hB.mem_casimirBlock hA hV c).mpr
  refine ⟨k, hf ?_⟩
  rw [hB.map_pow_casimir_sub f hV hW, hk, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.ker_casimirBlockMap_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_casimirBlockMap_eq_range (hU : IsPosFinite P U) (hV : IsPosFinite P V)
    (hW : IsPosFinite P W) (f : U →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V)
    (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hex : g.ker = f.range) (c : K) :
    (hB.casimirBlockMap hA hV hW g c).ker =
      (hB.casimirBlockMap hA hU hV f c).range
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hgv : g v.val = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hv
    have hvRange : v.val ∈ f.range := hex ▸ hgv
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hvRange
    have huBlock : u ∈ hB.casimirBlock hA hU c :=
      hB.mem_casimirBlock_of_injective hA hU hV f hf c (hu ▸ v.property)
    exact ⟨⟨u, huBlock⟩, Subtype.ext hu⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hfu : f u.val ∈ g.ker := hex.symm ▸ (show f u.val ∈ f.range from ⟨u.val, rfl⟩)
    exact hfu

name: Module.Dual.affPoly_dvd_sub_projSubst
statement:
lemma affPoly_dvd_sub_projSubst (a : H) (c : K) (δ : Dual K H) (F : MvPolynomial (PolyIdx K H) K) :
    affPoly K H a c ∣ F - projSubst K H a c δ F
proof:
:= by
  set I := Ideal.span {affPoly K H a c}
  have hmk : (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K I).comp (projSubst K H a c δ) = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K I := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun j ↦ ?_
    have hφ : Ideal.Quotient.mk I (affPoly K H a c) = 0 :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, projSubst, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, map_sub, map_mul]
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, hφ, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f F) hmk
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] at this
  rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  exact this.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_sub_comp_eq_smul
statement:
lemma exists_sub_comp_eq_smul {D : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (hD : D ∈ polyFam P) (a : H) (c : K)
    (δ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ G ∈ polyFam P, ∀ Λ, D Λ - D (Λ - (Λ a + c) • δ) = (Λ a + c) • G Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction hD using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
    obtain ⟨p, u, rfl⟩ := hD
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := affPoly_dvd_sub_projSubst a c δ p
    refine ⟨fun Λ ↦ evalPoly K H q Λ • u, Submodule.subset_span ⟨q, u, rfl⟩, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    have h := congrFun (congrArg (evalPoly K H) hq) Λ
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, evalPoly_projSubst, evalPoly_affPoly] at h
    rw [← sub_smul, h, mul_smul]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, fun Λ ↦ by simp⟩
  | add D E _ _ hD hE =>
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hDG⟩ := hD
    obtain ⟨G', hG', hEG⟩ := hE
    refine ⟨G + G', add_mem hG hG', fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_add, ← hDG, ← hEG]
    abel
  | smul b D _ hD =>
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hDG⟩ := hD
    refine ⟨b • G, Submodule.smul_mem _ b hG, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, ← smul_sub, hDG, smul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.IsShapovalovElement.equivEnvNNeg_mem_primitiveVectors
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_primitiveVectors.mpr
    ⟨(equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace_iff P Λ _ _).mpr (h.mem_negWeightSpace Λ), fun k ↦ ?_⟩
  have hk := h.actEnv_eq_zero Λ hΛ (e P k) (e_mem_nPos P k)
  rwa [← (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).map_eq_zero_iff, equivEnvNNeg_actEnv] at hk

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.IsShapovalovElement.eq_of_corootPairing_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_corootPairing_eq [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K H] (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    {θ θ' : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻}
    (h : IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ) (h' : IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ')
    (hpos : 0 < r * ∑ j, a j) {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = r) :
    θ Λ = θ' Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hfin.isSymmetrizable
  set W := primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (Λ - r • P.rootOf fun j ↦ (a j : ℤ))
  have : FiniteDimensional K W := by
    have := finiteDimensional_weightSpace P Λ (Λ - r • P.rootOf fun j ↦ (a j : ℤ))
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  have h1 : finrank K W ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← finrank_hom (P := P) (V := VermaModule P Λ)]
    exact finrank_hom_le_one_of_finite_type P hfin S Λ _
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀⟩ := finrank_le_one_iff.mp h1
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hw₀ ⟨_, h.equivEnvNNeg_mem_primitiveVectors hΛ⟩
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hw₀ ⟨_, h'.equivEnvNNeg_mem_primitiveVectors hΛ⟩
  have e1 := congrArg Subtype.val hc
  have e2 := congrArg Subtype.val hc'
  simp only [Submodule.coe_smul] at e1 e2
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at e1
    exact h.ne_zero hpos Λ ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ).map_eq_zero_iff.mp e1.symm)
  have hk : θ' Λ = (c' / c) • θ Λ := by
    apply (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).injective
    rw [map_smul, ← e1, ← e2, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc0]
  have hs := (h'.hasSymbol hpos Λ).unique
    (by rw [hk]; exact (h.hasSymbol hpos Λ).smul (c' / c))
  have hc1 : c' / c = 1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have h0 : (c' / c - 1) • ∏ j, fSym P j ^ (r * a j) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul, ← hs, sub_self]
    exact prod_fSym_ne_zero r a ((smul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne))
  rw [hk, hc1, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.IsShapovalovElement.exists_sub_eq_smul
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eq_smul [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K H] (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    {θ θ' : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻}
    (h : IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ) (h' : IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ')
    (hpos : 0 < r * ∑ j, a j) :
    ∃ G ∈ polyFam P, ∀ Λ, θ Λ - θ' Λ = (P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i - r) • G Λ
proof:
:= by
  let φ : Dual K (Dual K H) := (Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i)).comp
    ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).toLinearMap
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : H, ∀ Λ : Dual K H, Λ b = P.corootPairing hA Λ v i :=
    ⟨(Module.evalEquiv K H).symm φ, fun Λ ↦ Module.apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply K H Λ φ⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : K, c = P.corootPairing hA P.rho v i - r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hbc : ∀ Λ : Dual K H, Λ b + c = P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i - r := by
    intro Λ
    rw [hb, hc, corootPairing_add]
    ring
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    have h2 := hb ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    rw [map_zero, corootPairing_apply, inv_mul_cancel, corootPairing_one,
      P.root_coroot_self hA] at h2
    exact two_ne_zero h2.symm
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := exists_dual_apply_eq_one (K := K) hb0
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hDG⟩ := exists_sub_comp_eq_smul
    (sub_mem_polyFam h.mem_polyFam h'.mem_polyFam) b c δ
  refine ⟨G, hG, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hΛ' : P.corootPairing hA ((Λ - (Λ b + c) • δ) + P.rho) v i = r := by
    have h3 := hbc (Λ - (Λ b + c) • δ)
    rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hδ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h3
    linear_combination -h3
  have heq := h.eq_of_corootPairing_eq hfin h' hpos hΛ'
  calc θ Λ - θ' Λ
      = (θ Λ - θ' Λ) - (θ (Λ - (Λ b + c) • δ) - θ' (Λ - (Λ b + c) • δ)) := by
        rw [heq, sub_self, sub_zero]
    _ = (Λ b + c) • G Λ := hDG Λ
    _ = _ := by rw [hbc]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hasSymbol_fEnv
statement: lemma hasSymbol_fEnv (j : ι) : HasSymbol 1 (fSym P j) (fEnv P j)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fSym_ne_zero
statement: lemma fSym_ne_zero (j : ι) : fSym P j ≠ 0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hasSymbol_list_prod
statement:
lemma hasSymbol_list_prod (r : ℕ) (a : ι → ℕ) (l : List ι) :
    HasSymbol (l.map fun j ↦ r * a j).sum (l.map fun j ↦ fSym P j ^ (r * a j)).prod
      (l.map fun j ↦ fEnv P j ^ (r * a j)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa using (HasSymbol.one : HasSymbol 0 1 (1 : 𝒰⁻))
  | cons j l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.prod_cons]
    exact (((hasSymbol_fEnv j).pow (r * a j)).congr_deg (one_mul _)).mul ih

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.hasSymbol_shapovalovLead

lemma hasSymbol_shapovalovLead (r : ℕ) (a : ι → ℕ) :
    HasSymbol (r * ∑ j, a j) (∏ j, fSym P j ^ (r * a j)) (shapovalovLead P r a)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSymbol_list_prod (P := P) r a (Finset.univ : Finset ι).toList
  rw [Finset.sum_map_toList, Finset.prod_map_toList, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_mul
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_mul (Λ : Dual K H) (j : ι) (u : 𝒰⁻) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ (fEnv P j * u) = ⁅f P j, equivEnvNNeg P Λ u⁆

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow_mul
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow_mul (Λ : Dual K H) (j : ι) (n : ℕ) (u : 𝒰⁻) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ (fEnv P j ^ n * u) =
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P j) ^ n) (equivEnvNNeg P Λ u)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_mul, ih, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply,
      toEnd_apply_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow (Λ : Dual K H) (j : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ (fEnv P j ^ n) =
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P j) ^ n) (hwv P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow_mul (P := P) Λ j n 1
  rwa [mul_one, equivEnvNNeg_one] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.IsShapovalovElement.hasSymbol
statement:
lemma hasSymbol {θ : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (h : IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ)
    (hpos : 0 < r * ∑ j, a j) (Λ : Dual K H) :
    HasSymbol (r * ∑ j, a j) (∏ j, fSym P j ^ (r * a j)) (θ Λ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero hpos.ne'
  have h1 : HasSymbol (d + 1) (∏ j, fSym P j ^ (r * a j)) (shapovalovLead P r a) :=
    (hasSymbol_shapovalovLead r a).congr_deg hd
  have h2 := h.sub_mem_filtration Λ
  rw [hd, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h2
  exact (h1.of_sub_mem h2).congr_deg hd.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.IsShapovalovElement.ne_zero
statement:
lemma ne_zero {θ : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (h : IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ) (hpos : 0 < r * ∑ j, a j)
    (Λ : Dual K H) : θ Λ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  HasSymbol.ne_zero (h.hasSymbol hpos Λ) (prod_fSym_ne_zero (P := P) r a)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.IsShapovalovElement.of_corootPairing_eq
proof:
:= h.mem_polyFam
  mem_negWeightSpace := h.mem_negWeightSpace
  actEnv_eq_zero Λ hΛ := h.actEnv_eq_zero Λ (by rw [← hc]; exact hΛ)
  sub_mem_filtration := h.sub_mem_filtration

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.isShapovalovElement_simple
statement:
theorem isShapovalovElement_simple (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (j : ι) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    IsShapovalovElement P hA 1 j r (Pi.single j 1) fun _ ↦ fEnv P j ^ r where
  mem_polyFam
proof:
:= const_mem_polyFam _
  mem_negWeightSpace Λ := by
    have hν : r • P.rootOf (fun k ↦ ((Pi.single j 1 : ι → ℕ) k : ℤ)) = r • P.root j := by
      rw [← P.rootOf_single j]
      congr 2
      ext k
      by_cases hk : k = j
      · subst hk; simp
      · simp [hk]
    rw [hν, ← equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace_iff P Λ, equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow]
    exact toEnd_f_pow_mem_weightSpace j (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ) r
  actEnv_eq_zero Λ hΛ x hx := by
    rw [corootPairing_one] at hΛ
    have hprim := toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P hA hr hΛ
    rw [actEnv_apply, equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow,
      lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hprim).2 hx, map_zero]
  sub_mem_filtration Λ := by
    have hsum : r * ∑ k, (Pi.single j 1 : ι → ℕ) k = r := by simp
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, r = d + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
    have h1 := (hasSymbol_shapovalovLead (P := P) r (Pi.single j 1)).congr_deg
      (hsum.trans hd)
    have h2 := ((hasSymbol_fEnv (P := P) j).pow r).congr_deg ((one_mul r).trans hd)
    have hprod : ∏ k, fSym P k ^ (r * (Pi.single j 1 : ι → ℕ) k) = fSym P j ^ r := by
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_single j (fun k _ hk ↦ by simp [hk]) (by simp)]
      simp
    rw [hprod] at h1
    rw [hsum, show r - 1 = d by omega]
    exact h2.sub_mem h1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_mem_polyLE_of_mem_polyFun
statement:
lemma exists_mem_polyLE_of_mem_polyFun {c : Dual K H → K} (hc : c ∈ polyFun K H) :

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.smul_mem_polyFam_of_mem_polyFun

lemma smul_mem_polyFam_of_mem_polyFun {c : Dual K H → K} (hc : c ∈ polyFun K H)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.smul_const_mem_polyFam_of_mem_polyFun
statement:
lemma smul_const_mem_polyFam_of_mem_polyFun {c : Dual K H → K} (hc : c ∈ polyFun K H)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.apply_mem_polyFun
statement: lemma apply_mem_polyFun (a : H) : (fun Λ : Dual K H ↦ Λ a) ∈ polyFun K H

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.const_mem_polyFun
statement: lemma const_mem_polyFun (c : K) : (fun _ : Dual K H ↦ c) ∈ polyFun K H

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.comp_mem_polyFam
proof:
:= by
  choose g hg using hT
  induction hF using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem F hF =>
    obtain ⟨p, u, rfl⟩ := hF
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨MvPolynomial.aeval g p, u, funext fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    have hgΛ : (fun j ↦ evalPoly K H (g j) Λ) = fun j ↦ T Λ (Module.Free.chooseBasis K H j) :=
      funext fun j ↦ congrFun (hg j) Λ
    simp only
    rw [evalPoly_aeval, hgΛ, evalPoly_apply]
  | zero => exact zero_mem_polyFam
  | add F G _ _ hF hG => exact add_mem_polyFam hF hG
  | smul a F _ hF => exact const_smul_mem_polyFam a hF

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.comp_add_smul_mem_polyFam
statement:
theorem comp_add_smul_mem_polyFam {F : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (hF : F ∈ polyFam P)
    {c : Dual K H → K} (hc : c ∈ polyFun K H) (δ δ₀ : Dual K H) :
    (fun Λ ↦ F (Λ + c Λ • δ + δ₀)) ∈ polyFam P
proof:
:= by
  refine comp_mem_polyFam hF fun j ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact add_mem (add_mem (apply_mem_polyFun _) (mul_mem hc (const_mem_polyFun _)))
    (const_mem_polyFun _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.dual_mem_polyFun
statement:
theorem dual_mem_polyFun (φ : 𝒰⁻ →ₗ[K] K) {F : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (hF : F ∈ polyFam P) :
    (fun Λ ↦ φ (F Λ)) ∈ polyFun K H
proof:
:= by
  induction hF using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem F hF =>
    obtain ⟨p, u, rfl⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨p * MvPolynomial.C (φ u), funext fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    simp
  | zero =>
    have h : (fun Λ ↦ φ ((0 : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻) Λ)) = 0 := funext fun Λ ↦ by simp
    rw [h]
    exact zero_mem _
  | add F G _ _ hF hG =>
    have h : (fun Λ ↦ φ ((F + G) Λ)) = (fun Λ ↦ φ (F Λ)) + fun Λ ↦ φ (G Λ) :=
      funext fun Λ ↦ by simp
    rw [h]
    exact add_mem hF hG
  | smul a F _ hF =>
    have h : (fun Λ ↦ φ ((a • F) Λ)) = a • fun Λ ↦ φ (F Λ) := funext fun Λ ↦ by simp
    rw [h]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hF a

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_zero_of_forall_nat
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_nat {F : Dual K H → K} (hF : F ∈ polyFun K H)
    {φ ψ : Dual K H →ₗ[K] K} {c : K} {δ : Dual K H} (hδa : φ δ = 0) (hδb : ψ δ = 1) (N : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ Λ : Dual K H, φ Λ = c → ∀ m : ℕ, N ≤ m → ψ Λ = -(m : K) → F Λ = 0)
    {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : φ Λ = c) : F Λ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hF
  have hG : linePoly K H Λ δ p = 0 := by
    refine Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot _ ?_
    refine Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (f := fun m : ℕ ↦ -((N + m : ℕ) : K) - ψ Λ)
      (fun m m' hmm ↦ ?_) fun m ↦ ?_
    · have h1 := neg_injective (sub_left_injective hmm)
      exact Nat.add_left_cancel (Nat.cast_injective h1)
    · change (linePoly K H Λ δ p).eval _ = 0
      rw [eval_linePoly]
      refine h _ ?_ (N + m) (Nat.le_add_right N m) ?_
      · rw [map_add, map_smul, hδa, smul_zero, add_zero, hΛ]
      · rw [map_add, map_smul, hδb, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
        ring
  have h0 := eval_linePoly Λ δ p 0
  rw [hG, Polynomial.eval_zero, zero_smul, add_zero] at h0
  exact h0.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_of_forall_nat
statement:
theorem mem_of_forall_nat {F : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (hF : F ∈ polyFam P) (W : Submodule K 𝒰⁻)
    {φ ψ : Dual K H →ₗ[K] K} {c : K} {δ : Dual K H} (hδa : φ δ = 0) (hδb : ψ δ = 1) (N : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ Λ : Dual K H, φ Λ = c → ∀ m : ℕ, N ≤ m → ψ Λ = -(m : K) → F Λ ∈ W)
    {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : φ Λ = c) : F Λ ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hW
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hχW⟩ := Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hW inferInstance
  refine hχ (eq_zero_of_forall_nat (dual_mem_polyFun χ hF) hδa hδb N
    (fun Λ' hΛ' m hm hb ↦ ?_) hΛ)
  have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := χ) (h Λ' hΛ' m hm hb)
  rwa [hχW, Submodule.mem_bot] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.descPochhammer_mem_polyFun
statement:
lemma descPochhammer_mem_polyFun {c : Dual K H → K} (hc : c ∈ polyFun K H) (j : ℕ) :
    (fun Λ ↦ (descPochhammer K j).eval (c Λ)) ∈ polyFun K H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨Polynomial.aeval p (descPochhammer K j), funext fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (Pi.evalAlgHom K (fun _ : Dual K H ↦ K) Λ)
    (evalPoly K H p) (descPochhammer K j)
  change evalPoly K H (Polynomial.aeval p (descPochhammer K j)) Λ =
    Polynomial.eval (evalPoly K H p Λ) (descPochhammer K j)
  rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (evalPoly K H), ← Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval]
  exact h.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.choose_eq_descPochhammer
statement:
lemma choose_eq_descPochhammer (n j : ℕ) :
    (n.choose j : K) = (descPochhammer K j).eval (n : K) / j.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [descPochhammer_eval_eq_descFactorial K, Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose,
    Nat.cast_mul, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (by exact_mod_cast j.factorial_ne_zero)]

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_simple_mul
statement:
lemma corootPairing_simple_mul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (x : Dual K H) (j : ι)
    (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.corootPairing hA x ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v) i =
      P.corootPairing hA (P.reflection hA j x) v i

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_apply_root
statement:
lemma corootPairing_apply_root (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.corootPairing hA ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) v i = 2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.coe_ad_pow_nNeg
statement:
lemma coe_ad_pow_nNeg (x y : nNeg P) (n : ℕ) :
    (((LieAlgebra.ad K (nNeg P) x ^ n) y : nNeg P) : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) =
      (LieAlgebra.ad K P.KacMoodyAlgebra x ^ n) y
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, LieAlgebra.ad_apply, LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket, ih,
      pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, LieAlgebra.ad_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_commutator_fEnv_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_commutator_fEnv_pow_eq_zero (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (j : ι) (u : 𝒰⁻) :
    ∃ n, (LinearMap.commutator K (fEnv P j) ^ n) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_commutator_pow_eq_zero (fun y ↦ ?_) u
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero P hA j (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
  exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_ad_pow_nNeg]; exact hn)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_mem_polyFam
statement:
lemma exists_commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_mem_polyFam {F : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻} (hF : F ∈ polyFam P)
    {a : 𝒰⁻} (ha : ∀ u : 𝒰⁻, ∃ n, (LinearMap.commutator K a ^ n) u = 0) :
    ∃ N, ∀ Λ, (LinearMap.commutator K a ^ N) (F Λ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hF using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem F hF =>
    obtain ⟨p, u, rfl⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ha u
    refine ⟨n, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    change (LinearMap.commutator K a ^ n) (evalPoly K H p Λ • u) = 0
    rw [map_smul, hn, smul_zero]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun Λ ↦ by simp⟩
  | add F G _ _ hF hG =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hG
    refine ⟨max m n, fun Λ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [Pi.add_apply, map_add,
      LinearMap.commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_left m n) (hm Λ),
      LinearMap.commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le (le_max_right m n) (hn Λ), add_zero]
  | smul b F _ hF =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hF
    exact ⟨n, fun Λ ↦ by rw [Pi.smul_apply, map_smul, hn Λ, smul_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.fEnv_pow_ne_zero
statement: lemma fEnv_pow_ne_zero (j : ι) (n : ℕ) : fEnv P j ^ n ≠ 0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_equivEnvNNeg
proof:
