name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_toEnd_pow
statement:
lemma map_toEnd_pow {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ) (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (n : ℕ) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    φ ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) x ^ n) m) =
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P μ) x ^ n) (φ m)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, LieModuleHom.map_lie, ih, pow_succ',
      Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_mem_primitiveVectors
proof:
:=
  mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hm).1,
    fun i ↦ by rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hm).2 i, map_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_le_one
statement:
lemma exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_le_one {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (h : finrank K V ≤ 1) {x : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (z : V) :
    ∃ c : K, c • x = z
proof:
:=
  (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' x hx).mp
    (le_antisymm h (Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨x, hx⟩)) z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_apply_eq_zero_apply_eq_one
statement:
lemma exists_apply_eq_zero_apply_eq_one {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {φ ψ : V →ₗ[K] K} {x₀ : V} (hx₀ : φ x₀ = 1) (h : ¬ ∀ x, ψ x = ψ x₀ * φ x) :
    ∃ δ, φ δ = 0 ∧ ψ δ = 1
proof:
:= by
  push Not at h
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
  have hy : φ (x - φ x • x₀) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, hx₀, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_self]
  have hy' : ψ (x - φ x • x₀) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    intro h0
    exact hx (by linear_combination h0)
  refine ⟨(ψ (x - φ x • x₀))⁻¹ • (x - φ x • x₀), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]
  · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_mul_fEnv_pow_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mul_fEnv_pow_eq [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan) {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι}
    (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) {r : ℕ} {Λ μ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ : P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = r) {j : ι} {Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hμ : (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = Q) (hΛμ : Λ = μ - (Q : K) • P.root j)
    {w : VermaModule P μ}
    (hw : w ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P μ)
      (Λ - r • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))) :
    ∃ X : 𝒰⁻, equivEnvNNeg P μ (X * fEnv P j ^ Q) = w ∧
      equivEnvNNeg P Λ X ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ)
        (Λ - r • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hfin.isSymmetrizable
  have hprim : equivEnvNNeg P μ (fEnv P j ^ Q) ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P μ) Λ := by
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow]
    have h := toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P hA hQ hμ
    have hw' : P.reflection hA j (μ + P.rho) - P.rho = Λ := by
      rw [reflection_apply, hμ, hΛμ]
      abel
    rwa [hw'] at h
  let ι' := (homEquiv P (VermaModule P μ) Λ).symm ⟨_, hprim⟩
  have hιv : ι' (hwv P Λ) = equivEnvNNeg P μ (fEnv P j ^ Q) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P (VermaModule P μ) Λ).apply_symm_apply ⟨_, hprim⟩)
  have hι0 : ι' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := hιv
    rw [h0, _root_.zero_apply, eq_comm, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at h1
    exact fEnv_pow_ne_zero j Q h1
  have hιinj := injective_of_ne_zero P hι0
  set ν := Λ - r • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
  obtain ⟨φ₁, hφ₁⟩ := exists_injective_reflectionOf hfin (P := P) (Λ := Λ) (v := v) hv hΛ
  have hψ0 : ι' (φ₁ (hwv P ν)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hwv_ne_zero P ν
    apply hφ₁
    rw [map_zero]
    apply hιinj
    rw [map_zero]
    exact h0
  set W := primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P μ) ν
  have : FiniteDimensional K W := by
    have := finiteDimensional_weightSpace P μ ν
    exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  have h1 : finrank K W ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← finrank_hom (P := P) (V := VermaModule P μ)]
    exact finrank_hom_le_one_of_finite_type P hfin S μ ν
  have hmemψ : ι' (φ₁ (hwv P ν)) ∈ W :=
    map_mem_primitiveVectors ι' (map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P φ₁)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_le_one h1 (x := ⟨_, hmemψ⟩)
    (fun h0 ↦ hψ0 (by rw [Subtype.ext_iff] at h0; exact h0)) ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hc' := congrArg Subtype.val hc
  rw [Submodule.coe_smul] at hc'
  obtain ⟨X₀, hX₀⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective (φ₁ (hwv P ν))
  refine ⟨c • X₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_equivEnvNNeg ι' hιv, map_smul (equivEnvNNeg P Λ) c X₀, hX₀, map_smul]
    exact hc'
  · rw [map_smul (equivEnvNNeg P Λ) c X₀, hX₀]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P φ₁)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.IsShapovalovElement.of_hyperplane
statement:
theorem IsShapovalovElement.of_hyperplane [FiniteDimensional K H] {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan}
    {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} {r : ℕ} {a : ι → ℕ} {θ : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻}
    (hθ : θ ∈ polyFam P) (hw : ∀ Λ, θ Λ ∈ negWeightSpace P (r • P.rootOf fun j ↦ (a j : ℤ)))
    (ha : ∀ Λ, P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = r →
      ∀ x ∈ nPos P, actEnv P Λ x (θ Λ) = 0)
    (hb : ∀ Λ, P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = r →
      θ Λ - shapovalovLead P r a ∈ filtration K (nNeg P) (r * ∑ j, a j - 1)) :
    ∃ θ', IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb'⟩ : ∃ b : H, ∀ Λ : Dual K H, Λ b = P.corootPairing hA Λ v i :=
    ⟨(Module.evalEquiv K H).symm ((Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i)).comp
      ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).toLinearMap),
      fun Λ ↦ Module.apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply K H Λ _⟩
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ, γ = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h2 : P.corootPairing hA γ v i = 2 := hγ ▸ corootPairing_apply_root hA v i
  let c : Dual K H → K := fun Λ ↦ -(P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i - r) / 2
  have hc : c ∈ polyFun K H := by
    have h3 : c = fun Λ ↦ Λ b * (-1 / 2) + (-(P.corootPairing hA P.rho v i - r) / 2) := by
      funext Λ
      simp only [c]
      rw [corootPairing_add, ← hb' Λ]
      ring
    rw [h3]
    exact add_mem (mul_mem (apply_mem_polyFun b) (const_mem_polyFun _)) (const_mem_polyFun _)
  have hcp : ∀ Λ, P.corootPairing hA ((Λ + c Λ • γ + 0) + P.rho) v i = r := by
    intro Λ
    simp only [c, add_zero, corootPairing_add, corootPairing_smul, h2]
    ring
  refine ⟨fun Λ ↦ θ (Λ + c Λ • γ + 0), ⟨comp_add_smul_mem_polyFam hθ hc γ 0, fun Λ ↦ hw _,
    fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_, fun Λ ↦ hb _ (hcp Λ)⟩⟩
  have hc0 : c Λ = 0 := by
    simp only [c]
    rw [hΛ, sub_self, neg_zero, zero_div]
  simp only [hc0, zero_smul, add_zero]
  exact ha Λ hΛ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_isShapovalovElement_step
statement:
theorem exists_isShapovalovElement_step [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan) {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι}
    {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hvk : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf k)
    {j : ι} (hp : 0 < (A *ᵥ k) j)
    (hsv : P.IsPosRoot hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v) i) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    {θβ : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻}
    (hθβ : IsShapovalovElement P hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v) i r
      (fun l ↦ ((k - (A *ᵥ k) j • Pi.single j 1 : ι → ℤ) l).toNat) θβ) :
    ∃ θ, IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r (fun l ↦ (k l).toNat) θ
proof:
:= by
  classical
                                                   
  obtain ⟨p, hpz⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, ((p : ℕ) : ℤ) = (A *ᵥ k) j := ⟨_, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hp.le⟩
  obtain ⟨k', hk'def⟩ : ∃ k', k' = k - (A *ᵥ k) j • Pi.single j 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hk'def] at hθβ
  have hβ : (((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (P.root i) = P.rootOf k' := by
    rw [simple_mul_apply_root, hvk, reflection_rootOf, hk'def]
  have hk' : 0 ≤ k' := by
    obtain ⟨k'', hk'', h''⟩ := hsv
    rw [hβ] at h''
    rw [P.rootOf_injective h'']
    exact hk''
  have hk'l : ∀ l, k' l = k l - if l = j then (p : ℤ) else 0 := by
    intro l
    rw [hk'def, hpz]
    by_cases hl : l = j
    · subst hl
      simp
    · simp [hl]
  set aγ : ι → ℕ := fun l ↦ (k l).toNat with haγdef
  set aβ : ι → ℕ := fun l ↦ (k' l).toNat with haβdef
  have haγ : ∀ l, aγ l = aβ l + if l = j then p else 0 := by
    intro l
    have h1 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k l := hk l
    have h2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k' l := hk' l
    have h3 := hk'l l
    simp only [haγdef, haβdef]
    split_ifs with hl
    · subst hl
      simp only [eq_self, ite_true] at h3
      omega
    · simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte] at h3
      omega
  have hcastγ : (fun l ↦ ((aγ l : ℕ) : ℤ)) = k := funext fun l ↦ Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hk l)
  have hsum : ∑ l, aγ l = ∑ l, aβ l + p := by
    simp only [haγ, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have hβ0 : k' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hβ
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hβ
  obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩ : ∃ l, k' l ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hβ0 (funext h)
  have hsumβ : 0 < ∑ l, aβ l := by
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (aβ l)) (Finset.mem_univ l₀))
    have h0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k' l₀ := hk' l₀
    simp only [haβdef]
    omega
  have hposβ : 0 < r * ∑ l, aβ l := Nat.mul_pos hr hsumβ
  have hposγ : 0 < r * ∑ l, aγ l := Nat.mul_pos hr (by rw [hsum]; omega)
  have hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i := ⟨k, hk, hvk⟩
  have hγj : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) (P.coroot j) = (p : K) := by
    rw [hvk, rootOf_apply_coroot, ← hpz, Int.cast_natCast]
  have hβval : P.rootOf k' = (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) - (p : K) • P.root j := by
    rw [← hβ, simple_mul_apply_root, reflection_apply, hγj]
  have hk'j : P.rootOf k' (P.coroot j) = -(p : K) := by
    rw [hβval, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hγj, P.root_coroot_self hA,
      smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : H, ∀ Λ : Dual K H, Λ b = P.corootPairing hA Λ v i :=
    ⟨(Module.evalEquiv K H).symm ((Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i)).comp
      ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).toLinearMap),
      fun Λ ↦ Module.apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply K H Λ _⟩
                                                                 
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀⟩ := exists_commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_mem_polyFam hθβ.mem_polyFam
    (exists_commutator_fEnv_pow_eq_zero hA j)
  set J := J₀ + r * p with hJdef
  have hJ : ∀ Λ, (LinearMap.commutator K (fEnv P j) ^ (J + 1)) (θβ Λ) = 0 := fun Λ ↦
    LinearMap.commutator_pow_eq_zero_of_le (by omega) (hJ₀ Λ)
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective
    (LinearMap.mulRight K (fEnv P j ^ (J - r * p)))
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr fun a b hab ↦
      mul_right_cancel₀ (fEnv_pow_ne_zero j _) (by simpa using hab))
  have hLy : ∀ X, L (X * fEnv P j ^ (J - r * p)) = X := fun X ↦ by
    simpa using congrArg (fun g ↦ g X) hL
  let Wν := negWeightSpace P (r • P.rootOf fun l ↦ ((aγ l : ℕ) : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨Wc, hWc⟩ := Submodule.exists_isCompl Wν
  let π := Wν.projection Wc hWc
  let qf : Dual K H → K := fun Λ ↦ -Λ (P.coroot j) - 1
  let nf : Dual K H → K := fun Λ ↦ qf Λ + ((r * p : ℕ) : K)
  let E : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻ := fun Λ ↦ ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (J + 1),
    ((descPochhammer K l).eval (nf Λ) * ((l.factorial : ℕ) : K)⁻¹) •
      ((LinearMap.commutator K (fEnv P j) ^ l) (θβ (Λ + qf Λ • P.root j)) * fEnv P j ^ (J - l))
  let θ₀ : Dual K H → 𝒰⁻ := fun Λ ↦ π (L (E Λ))
  have hq : qf ∈ polyFun K H := by
    have h3 : qf = fun Λ ↦ Λ (P.coroot j) * (-1) + (-1) := by
      funext Λ
      simp only [qf]
      ring
    rw [h3]
    exact add_mem (mul_mem (apply_mem_polyFun _) (const_mem_polyFun _)) (const_mem_polyFun _)
  have hn : nf ∈ polyFun K H := add_mem hq (const_mem_polyFun _)
  have hθμ : (fun Λ ↦ θβ (Λ + qf Λ • P.root j)) ∈ polyFam P := by
    simpa using comp_add_smul_mem_polyFam hθβ.mem_polyFam hq (P.root j) 0
  have hE : E ∈ polyFam P := by
    have h3 : E = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), fun Λ ↦
        ((descPochhammer K l).eval (nf Λ) * ((l.factorial : ℕ) : K)⁻¹) •
          ((LinearMap.mulRight K (fEnv P j ^ (J - l)) ∘ₗ
            (LinearMap.commutator K (fEnv P j) ^ l)) (θβ (Λ + qf Λ • P.root j))) := by
      funext Λ
      simp only [E, Finset.sum_apply]
      rfl
    rw [h3]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ ↦ smul_mem_polyFam_of_mem_polyFun
      (mul_mem (descPochhammer_mem_polyFun hn l) (const_mem_polyFun _)) (map_mem_polyFam _ hθμ)
  have hθ₀ : θ₀ ∈ polyFam P := map_mem_polyFam (π ∘ₗ L) hE
                                                                                            
                                                                       
  have key : ∀ Λ : Dual K H, P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = r → ∀ m : ℕ, J + 2 ≤ m →
      Λ (P.coroot j) = -(m : K) →
      (∀ x ∈ nPos P, actEnv P Λ x (θ₀ Λ) = 0) ∧
        θ₀ Λ - shapovalovLead P r aγ ∈ filtration K (nNeg P) (r * ∑ l, aγ l - 1) := by
    intro Λ hΛ m hm hΛm
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ : ∃ Q, m = Q + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ, μ = Λ + (Q : K) • P.root j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hqf : qf Λ = Q := by
      simp only [qf, hΛm]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hμρ : (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = Q := by
      rw [hμdef, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hΛm,
        P.root_coroot_self hA, rho_coroot, smul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hΛμ : Λ = μ - (Q : K) • P.root j := by rw [hμdef, add_sub_cancel_right]
    have hμβ : P.corootPairing hA (μ + P.rho) ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v) i = r := by
      rw [corootPairing_simple_mul, reflection_apply, hμρ,
        show μ + P.rho - (Q : K) • P.root j = Λ + P.rho by rw [hμdef]; abel]
      exact hΛ
    set nN := Q + r * p with hnN
    have hθβprim := hθβ.equivEnvNNeg_mem_primitiveVectors hμβ
    have hcastβ : (fun l ↦ ((aβ l : ℕ) : ℤ)) = k' := funext fun l ↦ Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hk' l)
    rw [hcastβ] at hθβprim
    have hν'j : (μ - r • P.rootOf k' + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = (nN : K) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K,
        show μ - (r : K) • P.rootOf k' + P.rho = (μ + P.rho) - (r : K) • P.rootOf k' by abel,
        LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hμρ, hk'j, smul_eq_mul, hnN]
      push_cast
      ring
    let ψβ := (homEquiv P (VermaModule P μ) (μ - r • P.rootOf k')).symm ⟨_, hθβprim⟩
    have hψβv : ψβ (hwv P _) = equivEnvNNeg P μ (θβ μ) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P (VermaModule P μ) _).apply_symm_apply ⟨_, hθβprim⟩)
    have hnN0 : 0 < nN := by omega
    have hfprim := toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P hA hnN0 hν'j
    have hwt : P.reflection hA j (μ - r • P.rootOf k' + P.rho) - P.rho =
        Λ - r • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      rw [reflection_apply, hν'j, hβval, hΛμ, hnN]
      simp only [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K]
      push_cast
      module
    rw [hwt] at hfprim
    have hwprim : equivEnvNNeg P μ (fEnv P j ^ nN * θβ μ) ∈ primitiveVectors P
        (VermaModule P μ) (Λ - r • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) := by
      rw [equivEnvNNeg_fEnv_pow_mul, ← hψβv, ← map_toEnd_pow]
      exact map_mem_primitiveVectors ψβ hfprim
    obtain ⟨X, hX, hXprim⟩ :=
      exists_mul_fEnv_pow_eq hfin hv hΛ (by omega : 0 < Q) hμρ hΛμ hwprim
    have hXeq : X * fEnv P j ^ Q = fEnv P j ^ nN * θβ μ := (equivEnvNNeg P μ).injective hX
    have hXW : X ∈ Wν := by
      have h3 := (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hXprim).1
      rw [hvk, ← hcastγ] at h3
      exact (equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace_iff P Λ _ X).mp h3
    have hnf : nf Λ = (nN : K) := by
      simp only [nf, hqf, hnN]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hEΛ : E Λ = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), nN.choose l •
        ((LinearMap.commutator K (fEnv P j) ^ l) (θβ μ) * fEnv P j ^ (J - l)) := by
      simp only [E, hnf, hqf, ← hμdef]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
      rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, choose_eq_descPochhammer, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hXE : X * fEnv P j ^ (J - r * p) = E Λ := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ (fEnv_pow_ne_zero j (nN - J))
      rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show J - r * p + (nN - J) = Q by omega, hXeq, hEΛ]
      exact LinearMap.pow_mul_eq_sum_mul_pow (by omega) (hJ μ)
    have hθΛ : θ₀ Λ = X := by
      change π (L (E Λ)) = X
      rw [← hXE, hLy]
      exact Submodule.projection_apply_of_mem_left hWc hXW
    refine ⟨fun x hx ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hθΛ, actEnv_apply, lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos (mem_primitiveVectors.mp hXprim).2 hx,
        map_zero]
    · rw [hθΛ]
      have hs1 := (hasSymbol_shapovalovLead (P := P) r aγ).mul ((hasSymbol_fEnv (P := P) j).pow Q)
      have hs2 := ((hasSymbol_fEnv (P := P) j).pow nN).mul (hθβ.hasSymbol hposβ μ)
      rw [one_mul] at hs1 hs2
      rw [← hXeq] at hs2
      have hsym : fSym P j ^ nN * ∏ l, fSym P l ^ (r * aβ l) =
          (∏ l, fSym P l ^ (r * aγ l)) * fSym P j ^ Q := by
        have hprod : ∏ l, fSym P l ^ (r * aγ l) =
            (∏ l, fSym P l ^ (r * aβ l)) * fSym P j ^ (r * p) := by
          simp only [haγ, mul_add, pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
          congr 1
          rw [Finset.prod_eq_single j (fun l _ hl ↦ by simp [hl]) (by simp)]
          simp
        rw [hprod, hnN, pow_add]
        ring
      rw [hsym] at hs2
      have hdeg : nN + r * ∑ l, aβ l = r * ∑ l, aγ l + Q := by
        rw [hsum, hnN]
        ring
      rw [hdeg] at hs2
      have hD : r * ∑ l, aγ l + Q = (r * ∑ l, aγ l - 1 + Q) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hD] at hs1 hs2
      have hsub := hs2.sub_mem hs1
      rw [← sub_mul] at hsub
      exact mem_filtration_of_mul_pow_mem (hasSymbol_fEnv j) (fSym_ne_zero j) hsub
                                                                                      
  have hcoef : ∀ Λ, P.corootPairing hA (Λ + P.rho) v i = r ↔
      Dual.eval K H b Λ = r - P.corootPairing hA P.rho v i := by
    intro Λ
    rw [Dual.eval_apply, hb, corootPairing_add, eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
  obtain ⟨δ, hδa, hδb⟩ : ∃ δ, Dual.eval K H b δ = 0 ∧ Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j) δ = 1 := by
    refine exists_apply_eq_zero_apply_eq_one
      (x₀ := (1 / 2 : K) • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) ?_ fun h ↦ ?_
    · rw [Dual.eval_apply, hb, corootPairing_smul, corootPairing_apply_root]
      norm_num
    · refine not_isPosRoot_of_forall_coroot_eq hfin hv (Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j)
        ((1 / 2 : K) • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))) (fun x ↦ ?_) hsv
      rw [← hb x]
      exact h x
  refine IsShapovalovElement.of_hyperplane (θ := θ₀) hθ₀
    (fun Λ ↦ Submodule.projection_apply_mem hWc _) (fun Λ hΛ x hx ↦ ?_) (fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_)
  · have h3 := mem_of_forall_nat (actEnv_mem_polyFam x hθ₀) ⊥ hδa hδb (J + 2)
      (fun Λ' hΛ' m hm hψ ↦ by
        rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
        exact (key Λ' ((hcoef Λ').mpr hΛ') m hm hψ).1 x hx) ((hcoef Λ).mp hΛ)
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp h3
  · exact mem_of_forall_nat (sub_mem_polyFam hθ₀ (const_mem_polyFam _)) _ hδa hδb (J + 2)
      (fun Λ' hΛ' m hm hψ ↦ (key Λ' ((hcoef Λ').mpr hΛ') m hm hψ).2) ((hcoef Λ).mp hΛ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_isShapovalovElement_aux
statement:
theorem exists_isShapovalovElement_aux [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) (k : ι → ℤ), 0 ≤ k →
      (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf k → ∑ l, k l = n →
      ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → ∃ θ, IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r (fun l ↦ (k l).toNat) θ
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro v i k hk hvk hn r hr
  by_cases h1 : 1 < n
  · obtain ⟨j, -, hp, hsv⟩ := exists_simple_descent hfin hk hvk (by rw [hn]; exact_mod_cast h1)
    have hβ : (((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v : P.weylGroup hA) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) =
          P.rootOf (k - (A *ᵥ k) j • Pi.single j 1 : ι → ℤ) := by
      rw [simple_mul_apply_root, hvk, reflection_rootOf]
    have hk' : 0 ≤ k - (A *ᵥ k) j • Pi.single j 1 := by
      obtain ⟨k'', hk'', h''⟩ := hsv
      rw [hβ] at h''
      rw [P.rootOf_injective h'']
      exact hk''
    have hsum' : ∑ l, (k - (A *ᵥ k) j • Pi.single j 1 : ι → ℤ) l = (n : ℤ) - (A *ᵥ k) j := by
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hn, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      simp
    have hnn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) - (A *ᵥ k) j := by
      rw [← hsum']
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ ↦ hk' l
    obtain ⟨θβ, hθβ⟩ := ih ((n : ℤ) - (A *ᵥ k) j).toNat (by omega) _ i _ hk' hβ
      (by rw [hsum', Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn]) r hr
    exact exists_isShapovalovElement_step hfin hk hvk hp hsv hr hθβ
  · have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hvk
      exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hvk
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 0 < k j := by
      by_contra! h
      exact hk0 (funext fun l ↦ le_antisymm (h l) (hk l))
    have hsplit := Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ k (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hnonneg := Finset.sum_nonneg (s := Finset.univ.erase j) fun l _ ↦ hk l
    have hrest : ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, k l = 0 := by omega
    have hkj : k j = 1 := by omega
    have hkl : ∀ l, l ≠ j → k l = 0 := fun l hl ↦
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun l _ ↦ hk l).mp hrest l
        (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hl, Finset.mem_univ l⟩)
    have hk1 : k = Pi.single j 1 := by
      funext l
      by_cases hl : l = j
      · subst hl
        simp [hkj]
      · simp [hl, hkl l hl]
    have ha : (fun l ↦ (k l).toNat) = Pi.single j 1 := by
      funext l
      by_cases hl : l = j
      · subst hl
        simp [hk1]
      · simp [hk1, hl]
    rw [ha]
    refine ⟨_, (isShapovalovElement_simple hA j hr).of_corootPairing_eq fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    exact corootPairing_eq_of_apply_root_eq hfin (v := 1) (v' := v) (i := j) (i' := i)
      (by rw [hvk, hk1, rootOf_single]; rfl) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_isShapovalovElement
statement:
theorem exists_isShapovalovElement [IsAlgClosed K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan) {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι}
    {a : ι → ℕ} (hva : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf fun l ↦ (a l : ℤ))
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) : ∃ θ, IsShapovalovElement P hA v i r a θ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := exists_isShapovalovElement_aux hfin (∑ l, a l) v i (fun l ↦ (a l : ℤ))
    (fun l ↦ by simp) hva (Nat.cast_sum _ _).symm r hr
  simp only [Int.toNat_natCast] at hθ
  exact ⟨θ, hθ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.shapovalov
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := exists_isShapovalovElement hfin hva hr
  have ha0 : 0 < ∑ l, a l := by
    by_contra h0
    have hzero : (fun l ↦ ((a l : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0 := funext fun l ↦ by
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (a l)) (Finset.mem_univ l)
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, Nat.cast_eq_zero]
      omega
    rw [hzero, map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hva
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hva
  exact ⟨θ, hθ, fun θ' hθ' ↦ hθ'.exists_sub_eq_smul hfin hθ (Nat.mul_pos hr ha0)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.simple_mul_apply_root
statement:
lemma simple_mul_apply_root (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (j : ι) (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    (((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
        (P.root i) = P.reflection hA j ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_simple_descent
statement:
theorem exists_simple_descent {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hvk : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf k) (hht : 1 < ∑ l, k l) :
    ∃ j, 0 < k j ∧ 0 < (A *ᵥ k) j ∧ P.IsPosRoot hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hpd⟩ := hfin.exists_posDef
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hht
  have hpos := hpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hk0
  rw [star_trivial, ← mulVec_mulVec] at hpos
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec_diagonal] at hpos
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 0 < k j * (d j * (A *ᵥ k) j) := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hpos.not_ge (Finset.sum_nonpos fun j _ ↦ h j)
  have h1 : 0 < d j * (A *ᵥ k) j := pos_of_mul_pos_right hj (hk j)
  have h2 : 0 < (A *ᵥ k) j := pos_of_mul_pos_right h1 (hd j).le
  have h3 : 0 < k j := pos_of_mul_pos_left hj h1.le
  refine ⟨j, h3, h2, ?_⟩
  rcases P.isPosRoot_or ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v) i with h | h
  · exact h
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := h
  rw [mul_simple_apply_root, simple_mul_apply_root, hvk, reflection_rootOf,
    ← map_neg P.rootOf] at hk'eq
  have hinj := P.rootOf_injective hk'eq
  have hkl : ∀ l, l ≠ j → k l = 0 := by
    intro l hl
    have h4 := congrFun hinj l
    simp [hl] at h4
    have h5 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k' l := hk' l
    have h6 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k l := hk l
    omega
  have hγ : P.rootOf k = (k j : K) • P.root j := by
    rw [rootOf_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j
      (fun l _ hl ↦ by rw [hkl l hl, Int.cast_zero, zero_smul]) (by simp)]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := P.mem_rootLattice.mp (P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA (v⁻¹).2
    (P.mem_rootLattice.mpr ⟨Pi.single j 1, P.rootOf_single j⟩))
  have hαi : P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1) = P.rootOf (k j • m) := by
    rw [rootOf_single, map_zsmul, hm, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, ← map_smul, ← hγ, ← hvk]
    exact (inv_apply_apply v (P.root i)).symm
  have h7 := congrFun (P.rootOf_injective hαi) i
  simp only [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h7
  have hkj : k j = 1 := Int.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right h3.le h7.symm
  have hsum : ∑ l, k l = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun l _ hl ↦ hkl l hl) (by simp), hkj]
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.not_isPosRoot_of_forall_coroot_eq
statement:
theorem not_isPosRoot_of_forall_coroot_eq [FiniteDimensional K H] {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan}
    (hfin : A.IsFiniteCartan) {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i j : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) (t : K)
    (ht : ∀ x : Dual K H, x (P.coroot j) = t * P.corootPairing hA x v i) :
    ¬ P.IsPosRoot hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v) i
proof:
:= by
  intro hsv
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hfin.isSymmetrizable
  have hform : ∀ x, P.dualBilinForm S x ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
      P.corootPairing hA x v i / S.ε i := by
    intro x
    rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S (v⁻¹).2, inv_apply_apply, dualBilinForm_root_right]
    rfl
  have hεi : (S.ε i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i
  have hεj : (S.ε j : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero j
  have hzero : ∀ x, P.dualBilinForm S x ((S.ε j : K) • P.root j -
      (t * S.ε i) • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) = 0 := by
    intro x
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, dualBilinForm_root_right, hform, ht, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hrel : (S.ε j : K) • P.root j = (t * S.ε i) • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    have h0 : (P.toDual S).symm ((S.ε j : K) • P.root j -
        (t * S.ε i) • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) = 0 :=
      (Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K _).mp fun x ↦
        (P.dualBilinForm_apply_eq S x _).symm.trans (hzero x)
    exact (LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp h0
  have ht0 : t * S.ε i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_smul, smul_eq_zero] at hrel
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero j (hrel.resolve_left hεj)
  have hγ : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = ((t * S.ε i)⁻¹ * S.ε j) • P.root j := by
    rw [mul_smul, hrel, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0, one_smul]
  have hs : (((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * v : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (P.root i) = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
    rw [simple_mul_apply_root, hγ, map_smul, reflection_apply, P.root_coroot_self hA]
    module
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := hsv
  exact not_isPosRoot_and hv ⟨k, hk, by rw [mul_simple_apply_root, ← hs, hk']⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.fNeg_ne_zero
statement: lemma fNeg_ne_zero : fNeg P i ≠ 0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isCompl_fLine_nilradNegSub
statement:
theorem isCompl_fLine_nilradNegSub :
    IsCompl (fLine P i).toSubmodule (nilradNegSub P i).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hx hx'
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
    have h1 : ((a • fNeg P i : nNeg P) : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ K ∙ f P i :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ a (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (disjoint_span_f_nilradNeg (P := P) i) _ h1 hx'
    exact Subtype.ext this
  · rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have hx : (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ (K ∙ f P i) ⊔ nilradNeg P i := by
      rw [← nNeg_eq_span_f_sup_nilradNeg (P := P) i]; exact x.2
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hy
    refine Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨a • fNeg P i, Submodule.smul_mem _ a
      (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _), ⟨z, nilradNeg_le_nNeg i hz⟩, hz, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    simpa [fNeg] using hyz

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coe_fLineBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_fLineBasis (u : Unit) :
    ((fLineBasis P i u : fLine P i) : nNeg P) = fNeg P i
proof:
:= by
  change (((LinearEquiv.toSpanNonzeroSingleton K (nNeg P) (fNeg P i) (fNeg_ne_zero P i))
    ((Basis.singleton Unit K) u) : K ∙ fNeg P i) : nNeg P) = fNeg P i
  rw [Basis.singleton_apply, LinearEquiv.toSpanNonzeroSingleton_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.pbwMonomial_fLineBasis
statement:
lemma pbwMonomial_fLineBasis (n : ℕ) :
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwMonomial K (fLineBasis P i) (Finsupp.single () n) =
      (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (fLineBasis P i ())) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show Finsupp.single () (n + 1) = Finsupp.single () n + Finsupp.single () 1 by
      rw [Finsupp.single_add],
      UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.PBW.pbwMonomial_add_single (fun _ _ ↦ le_rfl), ih, pow_succ']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.envNilrad_injective
statement: theorem envNilrad_injective : Function.Injective (envNilrad P i)
proof:

    (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_incl_injective (nilradNegSub P i))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.envNilrad_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma envNilrad_ι (x : nilradNegSub P i) :
    envNilrad P i (ιᵤ x) = ιᵤ ((x : nNeg P) : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
proof:
:= by

    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.commutator_mem_range_envNilrad
statement:
theorem commutator_mem_range_envNilrad {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra}
    (hx : ∀ y ∈ nilradNeg P i, ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i)
    (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nilradNegSub P i)) :
    ιᵤ x * envNilrad P i u - envNilrad P i u * ιᵤ x ∈ (envNilrad P i).range
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => rw [AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.commutes, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _
  | ι y =>
    rw [envNilrad_ι, ← Ring.lie_def, ← LieHom.map_lie]
    have hy : ⁅x, ((y : nNeg P) : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i := hx _ y.2
    refine ⟨ιᵤ ⟨⟨_, nilradNeg_le_nNeg i hy⟩, show _ ∈ nilradNeg P i from hy⟩, ?_⟩
    change envNilrad P i _ = _
    rw [envNilrad_ι]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, show ιᵤ x * (envNilrad P i a * envNilrad P i b) -
        envNilrad P i a * envNilrad P i b * ιᵤ x =
        (ιᵤ x * envNilrad P i a - envNilrad P i a * ιᵤ x) * envNilrad P i b +
          envNilrad P i a * (ιᵤ x * envNilrad P i b - envNilrad P i b * ιᵤ x) by noncomm_ring]
    exact add_mem (mul_mem ha ⟨b, rfl⟩) (mul_mem ⟨a, rfl⟩ hb)
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, show ιᵤ x * (envNilrad P i a + envNilrad P i b) -
        (envNilrad P i a + envNilrad P i b) * ιᵤ x =
        (ιᵤ x * envNilrad P i a - envNilrad P i a * ιᵤ x) +
          (ιᵤ x * envNilrad P i b - envNilrad P i b * ιᵤ x) by noncomm_ring]
    exact add_mem ha hb

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.nilradDecompAux_single
statement:
lemma nilradDecompAux_single (n : ℕ) (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nilradNegSub P i)) :
    nilradDecompAux P i (Finsupp.single (Finsupp.single () n) u) =
      (ιᵤ (fNeg P i)) ^ n * UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map (nilradNegSub P i).incl u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nilradDecompAux, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft_symm_apply_single, TensorProduct.congr_tmul,
    Basis.repr_symm_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul,
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.pbwBasis_apply, pbwMonomial_fLineBasis, LinearEquiv.refl_apply,
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.tensorEquivOfIsCompl_apply_tmul, map_pow,
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, LieSubalgebra.coe_incl, coe_fLineBasis]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.unitFinsuppEquiv_symm_apply

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.nilradDecomp_single
statement:
theorem nilradDecomp_single (n : ℕ) (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nilradNegSub P i)) :
    nilradDecomp P i Λ (Finsupp.single n u) =
      (ιᵤ (f P i)) ^ n • (envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ)
proof:

    unitFinsuppEquiv_symm_apply, nilradDecompAux_single, equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_mul, mul_smul,
    map_pow, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.nNegActionSpan_le_of_lie_f
statement:
lemma nNegActionSpan_le_of_lie_f (S : Submodule K V)
    (hS : ∀ i (v : V), ⁅f P i, v⁆ ∈ S) : nNegActionSpan P V ≤ S
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, v, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  change ⁅fHom P y, v⁆ ∈ S
  induction y using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on generalizing v with
  | of i => simpa only [fHom_of] using hS i v
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, add_lie]; exact S.add_mem (hx v) (hy v)
  | smul c x hx => rw [map_smul, smul_lie]; exact S.smul_mem c (hx v)
  | lie x y hx hy => rw [LieHom.map_lie, lie_lie]; exact S.sub_mem (hx _) (hy _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.disjoint_weightSpace_nNegActionSpan
statement:
lemma disjoint_weightSpace_nNegActionSpan (hV : IsHDiagonalizable P V)
    (μ : Dual K H) (hμ : ∀ i, weightSpace P V (μ + P.root i) = ⊥) :
    Disjoint (weightSpace P V μ) (nNegActionSpan P V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Submodule K V := ⨆ ν, ⨆ (_ : ν ≠ μ), weightSpace P V ν
  have hS : nNegActionSpan P V ≤ S := by
    apply nNegActionSpan_le_of_lie_f
    intro i v
    induction (diagWeightBasis hV).mem_span v using Submodule.span_induction with
    | zero => simp
    | add v w _ _ hv hw => rw [lie_add]; exact S.add_mem hv hw
    | smul c v _ hv => rw [lie_smul]; exact S.smul_mem c hv
    | mem v hv =>
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hv
      by_cases hj : j.1 - P.root i = μ
      · have heq : j.1 = μ + P.root i := sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hj
        have hz := diagWeightBasis_mem hV j
        rw [heq, hμ i, Submodule.mem_bot] at hz
        simp [hz]
      · have hle : weightSpace P V (j.1 - P.root i) ≤ S :=
          le_iSup_of_le (j.1 - P.root i) (le_iSup_of_le hj le_rfl)
        exact hle (toEnd_f_mem_weightSpace i (diagWeightBasis_mem hV j))
  exact ((iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := V) (h P)) μ).mono_right hS

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.subsingleton_of_nNegActionSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_nNegActionSpan_eq_top (hV : IsHDiagonalizable P V)
    (hb : ∃ s : Finset (Dual K H), ∀ μ, weightSpace P V μ ≠ ⊥ →
      ∃ Λ ∈ s, μ ∈ cone P Λ)
    (hspan : nNegActionSpan P V = ⊤) : Subsingleton V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  let : Nontrivial V := not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp hn
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀⟩ : ∃ μ, weightSpace P V μ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra! hz
    have ht : (⨆ μ, weightSpace P V μ) = ⊤ := hV
    simp only [hz, iSup_bot] at ht
    exact bot_ne_top ht
  let T : Set P.WeightOrd := {μ | weightSpace P V (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ) ≠ ⊥}
  have hT : T.IsPWO := by
    apply (WeightOrd.isPWO_iff P).mpr
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨s, fun μ hμ ↦ hs _ hμ⟩
  obtain ⟨μ, -, hmin⟩ := hT.exists_le_minimal
    (show WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P μ₀ ∈ T from hμ₀)
  have habove : ∀ i, weightSpace P V (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ + P.root i) = ⊥ := by
    intro i
    by_contra hi
    let ν := WeightOrd.toWeightOrd P (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P μ + P.root i)
    have hν : ν ≤ μ := by
      refine ⟨Pi.single i 1, Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one, ?_⟩
      simp only [ν, WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd, add_sub_cancel_left, rootOf_single]
    have heq : ν = μ := le_antisymm hν (hmin.2 hi hν)
    have hr : P.root i = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd P) heq
      simpa only [ν, WeightOrd.ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd, add_eq_left] using this
    have hs : (Pi.single i (1 : ℤ) : ι → ℤ) = 0 :=
      P.rootOf_injective (by rw [rootOf_single, hr, map_zero])
    have := congr_fun hs i
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hmin.1
  exact hv0 (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp
    (disjoint_weightSpace_nNegActionSpan hV _ habove) v hv (hspan ▸ Submodule.mem_top))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.subsingleton_of_coinvariants
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_coinvariants (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    [Subsingleton (V ⧸ nNegActionSpan P V)] : Subsingleton V
proof:
:= by
  apply subsingleton_of_nNegActionSpan_eq_top hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top hV.exists_finset
  apply top_unique
  intro v _
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp
    (Subsingleton.elim (Submodule.Quotient.mk v) 0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.surjective_of_coinvariantsMap
statement:
theorem surjective_of_coinvariantsMap (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    (φ : U →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective (coinvariantsMap φ)) :
    Function.Surjective φ
proof:
:= by
  let q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' φ.range
  have ht : nNegActionSpan P (V ⧸ φ.range) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro z _
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' φ.range z
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hφ (Submodule.Quotient.mk v)
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
    have hdiff : φ u - v ∈ nNegActionSpan P V :=
      (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mp hu
    have hq := map_mem_nNegActionSpan P q hdiff
    have hzero : q (φ u) = 0 :=
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ⟨u, rfl⟩
    rw [map_sub, hzero, zero_sub] at hq
    exact neg_mem_iff.mp hq
  have hQ := hV.quotient φ.range
  let : Subsingleton (V ⧸ φ.range) := subsingleton_of_nNegActionSpan_eq_top
    hQ.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top hQ.exists_finset ht
  intro v
  exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero φ.range).mp (Subsingleton.elim (q v) 0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.envNilrad_adNilrad
statement:
lemma envNilrad_adNilrad (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (hx : ∀ y ∈ nilradNeg P i, ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i) (u : 𝓤ᵢ) :
    envNilrad P i (adNilrad P i x hx u) = ιᵤ x * envNilrad P i u - envNilrad P i u * ιᵤ x
proof:
:= by
  have := LinearEquiv.ofInjective_apply (envNilrad P i).toLinearMap (h := envNilrad_injective P i)
    ((LinearEquiv.ofInjective (envNilrad P i).toLinearMap (envNilrad_injective P i)).symm
      (LinearMap.codRestrict _ ((LinearMap.mulLeft K (ιᵤ x) - LinearMap.mulRight K (ιᵤ x)) ∘ₗ
      (envNilrad P i).toLinearMap) (fun u ↦ by
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := commutator_mem_range_envNilrad P i hx u
        exact ⟨v, hv⟩) u))
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_envNilrad_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma lie_envNilrad_smul_hwv (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (hx : ∀ y ∈ nilradNeg P i, ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i) (u : 𝓤ᵢ) :
    ⁅x, envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ⁆ =
      envNilrad P i (adNilrad P i x hx u) • hwv P Λ + envNilrad P i u • ⁅x, hwv P Λ⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [envNilrad_adNilrad, lie_eq_smul, lie_eq_smul, ← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, sub_smul,
    sub_add_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_envNilrad_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma lie_e_envNilrad_smul_hwv (u : 𝓤ᵢ) :
    ⁅e P i, envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ⁆ = envNilrad P i (adE P i u) • hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [lie_envNilrad_smul_hwv, lie_e_hwv, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_h_envNilrad_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma lie_h_envNilrad_smul_hwv (u : 𝓤ᵢ) :
    ⁅h P (P.coroot i), envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ⁆ =
      envNilrad P i (adH P i u) • hwv P Λ + Λ (P.coroot i) • (envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lie_envNilrad_smul_hwv, lie_h_hwv, smul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.nilradDecomp_single'
statement:
lemma nilradDecomp_single' (n : ℕ) (u : 𝓤ᵢ) :
    nilradDecomp P i Λ (Finsupp.single n u) =
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilradDecomp_single, toEnd_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_f_nilradDecomp
statement:
theorem lie_f_nilradDecomp (g : ℕ →₀ 𝓤ᵢ) :
    ⁅f P i, nilradDecomp P i Λ g⁆ = nilradDecomp P i Λ (shiftF i g)
proof:
:= by
  have : (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i)) ∘ₗ
      (nilradDecomp P i Λ).toLinearMap = (nilradDecomp P i Λ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ shiftF i := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun n u ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, shiftF,
      Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, nilradDecomp_single']
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this g

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_h_nilradDecomp
statement:
theorem lie_h_nilradDecomp (g : ℕ →₀ 𝓤ᵢ) :
    ⁅h P (P.coroot i), nilradDecomp P i Λ g⁆ = nilradDecomp P i Λ (opH i Λ g)
proof:
:= by
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  have : (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (h P (P.coroot i))) ∘ₗ
      (nilradDecomp P i Λ).toLinearMap = (nilradDecomp P i Λ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ opH i Λ := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun n u ↦ ?_
    have hR : opH i Λ (Finsupp.single n u) =
        Finsupp.single n (adH P i u + (Λ (P.coroot i) - 2 * n) • u) := by
      simp [opH]
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, hR,
      nilradDecomp_single', nilradDecomp_single', ← Module.End.mul_apply, t.toEnd_h_mul_f_pow,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, lie_h_envNilrad_smul_hwv,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add (envNilrad P i), map_smul (envNilrad P i), add_smul,
      smul_assoc, map_add, map_add,
      map_smul (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (Λ (P.coroot i)),
      map_smul (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n)
        (Λ (P.coroot i) - 2 * n)]
    module
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this g

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_e_nilradDecomp
statement:
theorem lie_e_nilradDecomp (g : ℕ →₀ 𝓤ᵢ) :
    ⁅e P i, nilradDecomp P i Λ g⁆ = nilradDecomp P i Λ (opE i Λ g)
proof:
:= by
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  have : (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (e P i)) ∘ₗ
      (nilradDecomp P i Λ).toLinearMap = (nilradDecomp P i Λ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ opE i Λ := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun n u ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, nilradDecomp_single',
      toEnd_apply_apply]
    rcases n with _ | m
    · have hR : opE i Λ (Finsupp.single 0 u) = Finsupp.single 0 (adE P i u) := by
        simp [opE]
      rw [hR, nilradDecomp_single', pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
        lie_e_envNilrad_smul_hwv]
    · have hR : opE i Λ (Finsupp.single (m + 1) u) = Finsupp.single (m + 1) (adE P i u) +
          ((m + 1 : ℕ) : K) • Finsupp.single m (adH P i u + (Λ (P.coroot i) - m) • u) := by
        simp [opE]
      have e1 : envNilrad P i (adH P i u + (Λ (P.coroot i) - m) • u) • hwv P Λ =
          envNilrad P i (adH P i u) • hwv P Λ +
            (Λ (P.coroot i) - m) • (envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ) := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul, add_smul, smul_assoc]
      rw [hR, map_add, map_smul (nilradDecomp P i Λ) ((m + 1 : ℕ) : K), nilradDecomp_single',
        nilradDecomp_single', t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f, lie_e_envNilrad_smul_hwv,
        lie_h_envNilrad_smul_hwv, e1]
      generalize envNilrad P i (adH P i u) • hwv P Λ = a
      generalize envNilrad P i u • hwv P Λ = b
      generalize envNilrad P i (adE P i u) • hwv P Λ = c
      rw [map_sub, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul]
      push_cast
      module
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this g

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.opH_apply
statement:
lemma opH_apply (g : ℕ →₀ 𝓤ᵢ) (n : ℕ) :
    opH i Λ g n = adH P i (g n) + (Λ (P.coroot i) - 2 * n) • g n
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add g g' hg hg' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hg, hg', smul_add]; abel
  | single a u =>
    simp only [opH, Finsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      Finsupp.lsingle_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h; rfl
    · simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.opE_apply
statement:
lemma opE_apply (g : ℕ →₀ 𝓤ᵢ) (n : ℕ) :
    opE i Λ g n = adE P i (g n) +
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) • (adH P i (g (n + 1)) + (Λ (P.coroot i) - n) • g (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add g g' hg hg' =>
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hg, hg', smul_add]
    abel
  | single a u =>
    simp only [opE, Finsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
      Function.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases h1 : a = n
    · subst h1
      simp only [ite_true, show ¬(a = a + 1) from by omega, ite_false, map_zero,
        smul_zero, add_zero]
      by_cases ha : a - 1 = a
      · have : a = 0 := by omega
        subst this; simp
      · simp [ha]
    · by_cases h2 : a = n + 1
      · subst h2
        simp only [h1, ite_false, map_zero, zero_add, show n + 1 - 1 = n from by omega, ite_true]
      · simp only [h1, h2, ite_false, map_zero, add_zero, smul_zero, zero_add]
        split_ifs with h3
        · omega
        · simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.pow_apply_mul_eq_zero_of_leibniz
statement:
lemma pow_apply_mul_eq_zero_of_leibniz {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Module K R] (D : Module.End K R)
    (hD : ∀ a b, D (a * b) = D a * b + a * D b) :
    ∀ (p q : ℕ) (a b : R), (D ^ p) a = 0 → (D ^ q) b = 0 → (D ^ (p + q)) (a * b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p q
  induction hn : p + q using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing p q with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro a b ha hb
  rcases p with _ | p
  · rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at ha; rw [ha, zero_mul, map_zero]
  rcases q with _ | q
  · rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hb; rw [hb, mul_zero, map_zero]
  subst hn
  rw [show p + 1 + (q + 1) = (p + (q + 1)) + 1 by omega, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hD,
    map_add, ih (p + (q + 1)) (by omega) p (q + 1) rfl (D a) b
      (by rwa [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ]) hb,
    show p + (q + 1) = (p + 1) + q by omega,
    ih (p + 1 + q) (by omega) (p + 1) q rfl a (D b) ha
      (by rwa [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ]), add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.adLieModule
statement: lemma adLieModule : LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra 𝓤
proof:
:=
  LieModule.compLieHom 𝓤 (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ad_lie_eq
statement: lemma ad_lie_eq (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (u : 𝓤) : ⁅x, u⁆ = ιᵤ x * u - u * ιᵤ x
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_ad
proof:
:= by
  set D := toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra 𝓤 x
  have hD : ∀ a b : 𝓤, D (a * b) = D a * b + a * D b := fun a b ↦ by
    simp only [D, toEnd_apply_apply, ad_lie_eq]; noncomm_ring
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    exact ⟨1, by rw [pow_one, toEnd_apply_apply, ad_lie_eq, Algebra.commutes, sub_self]⟩
  | ι y =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx y
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have : ∀ m (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), (D ^ m) (ιᵤ z) = ιᵤ ((LieAlgebra.ad K _ x ^ m) z) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro z; rfl
      | succ m ih =>
        intro z
        rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply,
          LieAlgebra.ad_apply]
        simp only [D, toEnd_apply_apply, ad_lie_eq, ← Ring.lie_def, ← LieHom.map_lie]
    rw [this, hn, map_zero]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨p + q, pow_apply_mul_eq_zero_of_leibniz D hD p q a b hp hq⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨p + q, ?_⟩
    have h1 : (D ^ (p + q)) a = 0 := by
      rw [add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hp, map_zero]
    have h2 : (D ^ (p + q)) b = 0 := by
      rw [pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hq, map_zero]
    rw [map_add, h1, h2, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toEnd_envNilrad
statement:
lemma toEnd_envNilrad (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (hx : ∀ y ∈ nilradNeg P i, ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i)
    (w : 𝓤ᵢ) (n : ℕ) :
    (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra 𝓤 x ^ n) (envNilrad P i w) =
      envNilrad P i ((adNilrad P i x hx ^ n) w)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, toEnd_apply_apply, ad_lie_eq, ← envNilrad_adNilrad,
      ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_range_toEnd_f
proof:
:= by
  set D := nilradDecomp P i Λ
  set g := D.symm y
  have hyg : D g = y := D.apply_symm_apply y
  have hH : opH i Λ g = (-((k : K) + 1)) • g := D.injective (by
    rw [← lie_h_nilradDecomp i Λ hA, hyg, hy, map_smul, hyg])
  have hE : opE i Λ g = 0 := D.injective (by rw [← lie_e_nilradDecomp i Λ hA, hyg, he, map_zero])
  have hHn : ∀ n : ℕ, adH P i (g n) = (-((k : K) + 1) - d + 2 * n) • g n := fun n ↦ by
    have := congrArg (· n) hH
    simp only [opH_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, hd] at this
    rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq this]
    module
  have hEn : ∀ n : ℕ, adE P i (g n) = (-(((n : K) + 1) * ((n : K) + 1 - k))) • g (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    have := congrArg (· n) hE
    simp only [opE_apply, Finsupp.zero_apply, hd, hHn (n + 1)] at this
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← this]
    push_cast
    module
  
  have hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, (adE P i ^ j) (g 0) =
      (∏ n ∈ Finset.range j, (-(((n : K) + 1) * ((n : K) + 1 - k)))) • g j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_smul, hEn, smul_smul, Finset.prod_range_succ]
  have hk0 : (adE P i ^ k) (g 0) = 0 := by
    rw [hpow, Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := k - 1) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) (by
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hk]; ring), zero_smul]
  
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
    let _ := adLieRingModule P
    have _ := adLieModule P
    have hx := (isSl2Triple P hA i).eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero (M := 𝓤)
      (exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_ad P (exists_ad_e_pow_eq_zero P hA i))
      (exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_ad P (exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero P hA i))
      (x := envNilrad P i (g 0)) (m := k + 1 + d) (k := k)
      (by
        have := toEnd_envNilrad P i (h P (P.coroot i))
          (fun _ hy ↦ lie_h_mem_nilradNeg i _ hy) (g 0) 1
        rw [pow_one, pow_one, toEnd_apply_apply] at this
        rw [this, hHn 0]
        simp only [map_smul]
        push_cast
        ring_nf)
      (by omega)
      (by rw [toEnd_envNilrad P i (e P i) (fun _ hy ↦ lie_e_mem_nilradNeg i hy), hk0, map_zero])
    exact envNilrad_injective P i (by rw [hx, map_zero])
  
  refine ⟨D (Finsupp.comapDomain (· + 1) g (Set.injOn_of_injective (add_left_injective 1))), ?_⟩
  rw [lie_f_nilradDecomp, ← hyg]
  congr 1
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [hg0, shiftF, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range]
    simp
  · rw [shiftF, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply]
    exact (Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (f := (· + 1)) (add_left_injective 1) _ n).trans
      (Finsupp.comapDomain_apply _ _ _ n)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.lie_h_toEnd_f_pow
statement:
lemma lie_h_toEnd_f_pow (a : H) (n : ℕ) (x : VermaModule P Λ) :
    ⁅h P a, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) x⁆ =
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) ⁅h P a, x⁆ -
        ((n : K) * P.root i a) • (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply,
      toEnd_apply_apply, leibniz_lie, ih, lie_h_f, neg_lie, smul_lie, lie_sub, lie_smul]
    push_cast
    module

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.toEnd_f_pow_injective
statement:
lemma toEnd_f_pow_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.End.coe_pow]
  exact (toEnd_f_injective P Λ i).iterate n

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_eq_toEnd_f_pow
proof:
:= by
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  set F := toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i)
  suffices ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∃ x, (F ^ j) x = y from this k hk le_rfl
  intro j hj1 hjk
  induction j with
  | zero => omega
  | succ j ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj0
    · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_range_toEnd_f i Λ hA hd he hk hy
      exact ⟨z, by rw [pow_one]; exact hz⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ih hj0 (by omega)
    
    have hxh : ⁅h P (P.coroot i), x⁆ = (2 * (j : K) - k - 1) • x := by
      apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ j
      have := lie_h_toEnd_f_pow i Λ (P.coroot i) j x
      rw [hy, root_coroot_self P hA, eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at this
      rw [map_smul, ← this]
      module
    
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
    have hfe : ⁅f P i, ⁅e P i, x⁆⁆ = (((j' : K) + 1) * (k - j' - 1)) • x := by
      apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ j'
      have := t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f (K := K) j' x
      rw [he, hxh, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, ← sub_smul, map_smul,
        eq_comm, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at this
      rw [map_smul, this]
      push_cast
      module
    have hc : ((j' : K) + 1) * (k - j' - 1) ≠ 0 := by
      refine mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero j') ?_
      have : ((k : ℕ) : K) - j' - 1 = ((k - j' - 1 : ℕ) : K) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; push_cast; ring
      rw [this, Nat.cast_ne_zero]
      omega
    refine ⟨(((j' : K) + 1) * (k - j' - 1))⁻¹ • ⁅e P i, x⁆, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, map_smul, toEnd_apply_apply, hfe, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_mem_primitiveVectors_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  rw [mem_primitiveVectors] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_toEnd_f_pow i Λ hA hd (hy.2 i) hk (by rw [hy.1, hν])
  have hxw : ∀ a, ⁅h P a, x⁆ = (ν + k • P.root i) a • x := fun a ↦ by
    apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ k
    have := lie_h_toEnd_f_pow i Λ a k x
    rw [hy.1 a] at this
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, add_smul]
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at this
    rw [← this, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨x, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hxw, fun l ↦ ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  apply toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ k
  rw [map_zero]
  by_cases hl : l = i
  · subst hl
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have := t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f (K := K) k' x
    rw [hy.2 l, hxw, ← sub_smul, map_smul] at this
    have hz : ν (P.coroot l) + ((k' + 1) • P.root l) (P.coroot l) - k' = 0 := by
      rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hν, root_coroot_self P hA, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hz, zero_smul, smul_zero, add_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  · rw [← lie_toEnd_pow_of_lie_eq_zero (lie_e_f_of_ne P hl) k x, hy.2 l]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.toEnd_f_pow_mem_primitiveVectors_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have t := isSl2Triple P hA i
  rw [mem_primitiveVectors] at hx ⊢
  refine ⟨fun a ↦ ?_, fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [lie_h_toEnd_f_pow, hx.1 a, map_smul, ← sub_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul]
  · by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst hl
      rcases n with _ | n
      · simp [hx.2 l]
      · rw [t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f, hx.2 l, map_zero, zero_add, hx.1, ← sub_smul, map_smul]
        have : ν (P.coroot l) - n = 0 := by push_cast at hn; linear_combination hn
        rw [this, zero_smul, smul_zero]
    · rw [lie_toEnd_pow_of_lie_eq_zero (lie_e_f_of_ne P hl), hx.2 l, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_reflection_reflection
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_reflection_reflection {Λ μ : Dual K H} {i : ι} {d n : ℕ}
    (hd : Λ (P.coroot i) = d) (hn0 : 0 < n) (hn : (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (μ + P.rho) - P.rho) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)) =
      finrank K (VermaModule P μ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have hΛn : (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : K) := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hd, rho_coroot]; push_cast; ring
  have hμn : μ (P.coroot i) = (n : K) - 1 := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hn; linear_combination hn
  have hν : (P.reflection hA i (μ + P.rho) - P.rho) (P.coroot i) = -((n : K) + 1) := by
    rw [P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      root_coroot_self P hA, hμn, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [finrank_hom_reflection_eq (hA := hA) (hn0 := Nat.succ_pos d) (hn := hΛn) (fun m hm ↦ by
    rw [hν] at hm
    have : ((m + n + 1 : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by push_cast; linear_combination -hm
    exact absurd (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp this) (by omega)), finrank_hom, finrank_hom]
  
  rw [P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn]
  let T : primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) μ →ₗ[K]
      primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (μ - n • P.root i) :=
    ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n).restrict fun x hx ↦
      toEnd_f_pow_mem_primitiveVectors_of_mem i Λ (by rw [hμn]; ring) hx hA)
  have hT : Function.Bijective T := by
    refine ⟨fun x y hxy ↦ Subtype.ext (toEnd_f_pow_injective i Λ n
      (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)), fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    have hν' : (μ - n • P.root i) (P.coroot i) = -((n : K) + 1) := by
      rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, root_coroot_self P hA, hμn, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := exists_mem_primitiveVectors_of_mem i Λ hA hd hn0 hν' y.2
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at hx
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext hxy⟩
  exact (LinearEquiv.ofBijective T hT).finrank_eq.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_weylDot_self
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_weylDot_self (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  induction hl : cs.length w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ l ih =>
  subst hl
  by_cases hw1 : w = 1
  · subst hw1
    rw [weylDot_one, finrank_hom]
    have : primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) Λ = K ∙ hwv P Λ := by
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr
        (hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P Λ))
      rw [← weightSpace_self]
      exact inf_le_left
    rw [this, finrank_span_singleton (hwv_ne_zero P Λ)]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw1
  have hsl := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hs
  set w' := cs.simple s * w
  have hww' : w = cs.simple s * w' := (cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left s).symm
  have hw' : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent w' s := by
    rwa [← cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul]
  obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ := P.exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq hA hΛ hw'
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hΛ s
  have hΛn : (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot s) = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : K) := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hd, rho_coroot]; push_cast; ring
  
  have hν : ∀ m : ℕ, (P.weylDot hA w Λ) (P.coroot s) ≠ m := by
    intro m hm
    rw [hww', weylDot_simple_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, reflection_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, hn, root_coroot_self P hA, rho_coroot] at hm
    have : ((m + n + 1 : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by push_cast; linear_combination -hm
    exact absurd (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp this) (by omega)
  rw [← finrank_hom_reflection_eq (hA := hA) (hn0 := Nat.succ_pos d) (hn := hΛn) hν, hww',
    weylDot_simple_mul, finrank_hom_reflection_reflection hA hd hn0 hn]
  exact ih _ (by omega) w' rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_weylDot_le_one
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_weylDot_le_one (w w' : P.weylGroup hA) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have := exists_injective_of_bruhatLE hA hΛ ((P.coxeterSystem hA).one_bruhatLE w)
  rw [weylDot_one] at this
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := this
  let Φ : (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) →ₗ[K]
      (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) :=
    { toFun := fun ψ ↦ φ.comp ψ
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ map_add φ _ _
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ map_smul φ _ _ }
  have hΦ : Function.Injective Φ := fun ψ ψ' h ↦
    LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦ hφ (LieModuleHom.congr_fun h m)
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hΦ
  exact hle.trans (finrank_hom_weylDot_self hA hΛ w').le

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_weylDot_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_weylDot_eq_one {w w' : P.weylGroup hA}
    (h : (P.coxeterSystem hA).BruhatLE w w') :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (finrank_hom_weylDot_le_one hA hΛ w w') ?_
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_injective_of_bruhatLE hA hΛ h
  refine Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨φ, fun h0 ↦ hwv_ne_zero P _ (hφ ?_)⟩
  rw [h0, map_zero, _root_.zero_apply]

name: IsSl2Triple.casimir_symm
statement: lemma casimir_symm : casimir K M (-h) f e = casimir K M h e f
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [casimir_apply, neg_lie, lie_neg, smul_neg, neg_neg, leibniz_lie e f v, t.lie_e_f]
  module

name: IsSl2Triple.commute_casimir_f
statement: lemma commute_casimir_f : Commute (casimir K M h e f) (toEnd K L M f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← t.casimir_symm]
  exact t.symm.commute_casimir_e

name: IsSl2Triple.four_smul_f_e
statement:
lemma four_smul_f_e {c : K} {w : M} (hw : ⁅h, w⁆ = c • w) :
    (4 : K) • ⁅f, ⁅e, w⁆⁆ = casimir K M h e f w - (c * (c + 2)) • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [casimir_apply, hw, lie_smul, hw, smul_smul]
  module

name: IsSl2Triple.four_pow_smul_pow_f_pow_e
statement:
theorem four_pow_smul_pow_f_pow_e {μ : K} {x : M} (hx : ⁅h, x⁆ = μ • x) (k : ℕ) :
    (4 : K) ^ k • (toEnd K L M f ^ k) ((toEnd K L M e ^ k) x) =
      aeval (casimir K M h e f)
        (∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (X - C ((μ + 2 * j) * (μ + 2 * j + 2)))) x
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    set Ω := casimir K M h e f
    have hw : ⁅h, (toEnd K L M e ^ k) x⁆ = (μ + 2 * k) • (toEnd K L M e ^ k) x := by
      rw [← toEnd_apply_apply (R := K), ← Module.End.mul_apply, t.toEnd_h_mul_e_pow,
        LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, hx, map_smul,
        LinearMap.smul_apply, ← add_smul, add_comm]
    have hΩf : ∀ n (v : M), Ω ((toEnd K L M f ^ n) v) = (toEnd K L M f ^ n) (Ω v) := fun n v ↦ by
      rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ((t.commute_casimir_f (M := M)).pow_right n).eq,
        Module.End.mul_apply]
    have e1 : (toEnd K L M f ^ (k + 1)) ((toEnd K L M e ^ (k + 1)) x) =
        (toEnd K L M f ^ k) ⁅f, ⁅e, (toEnd K L M e ^ k) x⁆⁆ := by
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply,
        toEnd_apply_apply]
    set y := (toEnd K L M e ^ k) x
    have e2 : aeval Ω (X - C ((μ + 2 * k) * (μ + 2 * k + 2))) ((toEnd K L M f ^ k) y) =
        (toEnd K L M f ^ k) (Ω y - ((μ + 2 * k) * (μ + 2 * k + 2)) • y) := by
      rw [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, hΩf,
        map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, mul_comm, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ← ih, map_smul, e1,
      e2, ← four_smul_f_e (e := e) (f := f) hw, map_smul, smul_smul, ← pow_succ]

name: IsSl2Triple.cast_mul_ne
statement:
lemma cast_mul_ne {n m j k : ℕ} (hj : j < k) (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (-(m : K) + 2 * j) * (-(m : K) + 2 * j + 2) - n * (n + 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : ((-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j) * (-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j + 2) - n * (n + 2) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : (-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j + 1) - (n + 1) < 0 := by omega
    have h2 : 0 < (-(m : ℤ) + 2 * j + 1) + (n + 1) := by omega
    nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast this

name: IsSl2Triple.pow_f_succ_eq_zero
statement:
lemma pow_f_succ_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {w : M} (hwe : ⁅e, w⁆ = 0) (hwh : ⁅h, w⁆ = (n : K) • w)
    (hf : ∃ N, (toEnd K L M f ^ N) w = 0) : (toEnd K L M f ^ (n + 1)) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h0
  have hp : t.HasPrimitiveVectorWith ((toEnd K L M f ^ (n + 1)) w) (-(n : K) - 2) := by
    refine ⟨h0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq hwh]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f, hwe, map_zero, zero_add, hwh, sub_self, map_zero,
        smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨p, hp'⟩ := hp.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero ⟨N, by
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hN,
      map_zero]⟩
  have : ((p + n + 2 : ℕ) : K) = 0 := by push_cast; linear_combination -hp'
  exact absurd (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp this) (by omega)

name: IsSl2Triple.eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Ω := casimir K M h e f
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := t.isNilpotent_toEnd_e (K := K) (M := M)
  obtain ⟨N, hN'⟩ := t.isNilpotent_toEnd_f (K := K) (M := M)
  have hN : toEnd K L M f ^ (N + 1) = 0 := by rw [pow_succ, hN', zero_mul]
  
  set c : ℕ → K := fun j ↦ -(m : K) + 2 * j
  set P₁ := ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (X - C (c j * (c j + 2)))
  have h₁ : aeval Ω P₁ x = 0 := by
    rw [← t.four_pow_smul_pow_f_pow_e hx k, hk, map_zero, smul_zero]
  
  set g : ℕ → K[X] := fun n ↦ (X - C ((n : K) * (n + 2))) ^ d
  set s := Finset.range (N + 1)
  have h₂ : aeval Ω (∏ n ∈ s, g n) x = 0 := by
    have := t.aeval_casimir_pow_apply_eq_zero hN d (v := x) (by rw [hd, LinearMap.zero_apply])
    rwa [← map_pow, ← Finset.prod_pow] at this
  
  set A := ∏ n ∈ s.filter (· < m), g n
  set B := ∏ n ∈ s.filter (fun n ↦ ¬ n < m), g n
  have hAB : ∏ n ∈ s, g n = A * B := (Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not s (· < m) g).symm
  have hcop : IsCoprime P₁ B := by
    refine IsCoprime.prod_right fun n hn ↦ IsCoprime.pow_right (IsCoprime.prod_left fun j hj ↦ ?_)
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, not_lt] at hn
    refine isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (Ne.isUnit ?_)
    exact cast_mul_ne (Finset.mem_range.mp hj) hkm hn.2
  have hAx : aeval Ω A x = 0 := by
    have hker := Polynomial.disjoint_ker_aeval_of_isCoprime Ω hcop
    refine Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hker _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, mul_comm, map_mul,
        Module.End.mul_apply, h₁, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, mul_comm, ← hAB, h₂]
  
  set S := ⨆ (c : K) (_ : c ≠ -(m : K)), (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace c
  have hS : ∀ n < m, LinearMap.ker (aeval Ω (g n)) ≤ S := by
    intro n hn v hv
    have hvp := t.mem_primitiveSpan hN n d d (v := v) (by rw [hd, LinearMap.zero_apply]) hv
    refine (iSup_le fun j ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr ?_ :
      primitiveSpan K M h e f (n : K) ≤ S) hvp
    rintro w ⟨hwe, hwh⟩
    replace hwe : ⁅e, w⁆ = 0 := hwe
    replace hwh : ⁅h, w⁆ = (n : K) • w := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hwh
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
    by_cases hj : j ≤ n
    · refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ((n : K) - 2 * j) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ?_ ?_)
      · intro heq
        have : ((m + n : ℕ) : K) = ((2 * j : ℕ) : K) := by push_cast; linear_combination heq
        have := Nat.cast_injective this
        omega
      · rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, toEnd_apply_apply]
        exact t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq hwh j
    · rw [show j = (j - (n + 1)) + (n + 1) by omega, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply,
        t.pow_f_succ_eq_zero hwe hwh ⟨N + 1, by rw [hN, LinearMap.zero_apply]⟩, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
  have hxS : x ∈ S := by
    have hcopg : ∀ i ∈ s.filter (· < m), ∀ j ∈ s.filter (· < m), i ≠ j →
        IsCoprime (g i) (g j) := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      refine IsCoprime.pow (isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (Ne.isUnit fun hc ↦ hij ?_))
      have : ((i * (i + 2) : ℕ) : K) = ((j * (j + 2) : ℕ) : K) := by
        push_cast; linear_combination hc
      have h' := Nat.cast_injective this
      rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
      · exact absurd h' (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' h (by omega)).ne
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h' (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' h (by omega)).ne'
    have := Module.End.ker_aeval_prod_le_iSup Ω (s.filter (· < m)) g hcopg
      (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hAx)
    have hle : (⨆ n ∈ s.filter (· < m), LinearMap.ker (aeval Ω (g n))) ≤ S :=
      iSup₂_le fun n hn ↦ hS n (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    exact hle this
  have hxm : x ∈ (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace (-(m : K)) := by
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, toEnd_apply_apply, hx]
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.mp
    ((Module.End.eigenspaces_iSupIndep (toEnd K L M h)).disjoint_biSup
      (x := -(m : K)) (y := {c | c ≠ -(m : K)}) fun hc ↦ hc rfl) x hxm hxS

name: IsSl2Triple.eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero
    (he : ∀ v : M, ∃ n, (toEnd K L M e ^ n) v = 0) (hf : ∀ v : M, ∃ n, (toEnd K L M f ^ n) v = 0)
    {x : M} {m k : ℕ} (hx : ⁅h, x⁆ = -(m : K) • x) (hkm : k < m)
    (hk : (toEnd K L M e ^ k) x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := he x
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos B with rfl | hB0
  · simpa using hB
  choose A hA using fun b : ℕ ↦ hf ((toEnd K L M e ^ b) x)
  set A' := ∑ b ∈ Finset.range B, A b
  set E := toEnd K L M e
  set F := toEnd K L M f
  have hFA : ∀ b < B, ∀ a, A' ≤ a → (F ^ a) ((E ^ b) x) = 0 := by
    intro b hb a ha
    have : A b ≤ a := (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr hb)).trans ha
    rw [show a = (a - A b) + A b by omega, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hA b, map_zero]
  have hEB : ∀ b, B ≤ b → (E ^ b) x = 0 := fun b hb ↦ by
    rw [show b = (b - B) + B by omega, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hB, map_zero]
  set S : Finset M := ((Finset.range A') ×ˢ (Finset.range B)).image fun p ↦ (F ^ p.1) ((E ^ p.2) x)
  set W := Submodule.span K (S : Set M)
  have hmem : ∀ a b, (F ^ a) ((E ^ b) x) ∈ W := by
    intro a b
    by_cases hb : b < B
    · by_cases ha : a < A'
      · exact Submodule.subset_span (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr
          ⟨(a, b), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr ha, Finset.mem_range.mpr hb⟩,
            rfl⟩))
      · rw [hFA b hb a (by omega)]; exact zero_mem _
    · rw [hEB b (by omega), map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  have hwt : ∀ b : ℕ, ⁅h, (E ^ b) x⁆ = (-(m : K) + 2 * b) • (E ^ b) x := fun b ↦ by
    rw [← toEnd_apply_apply (R := K), ← Module.End.mul_apply, t.toEnd_h_mul_e_pow,
      LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, toEnd_apply_apply, hx, map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, ← add_smul, add_comm]
  have hstab : ∀ T : Module.End K M, (∀ a b, T ((F ^ a) ((E ^ b) x)) ∈ W) → ∀ v ∈ W, T v ∈ W := by
    intro T hT v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem v hv =>
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hv)
      exact hT a b
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add v w _ _ hv hw => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hv hw
    | smul c v _ hv => rw [map_smul]; exact W.smul_mem c hv
  have hfW : ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅f, v⁆ ∈ W := hstab F fun a b ↦ by
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']; exact hmem _ _
  have hhW : ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅h, v⁆ ∈ W := hstab (toEnd K L M h) fun a b ↦ by
    rw [toEnd_apply_apply, t.lie_h_pow_toEnd_f_of_eq (hwt b)]; exact W.smul_mem _ (hmem _ _)
  have heW : ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅e, v⁆ ∈ W := hstab E fun a b ↦ by
    rcases a with _ | a
    · rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']
      simpa using hmem 0 (b + 1)
    · rw [toEnd_apply_apply, t.lie_e_pow_succ_toEnd_f, hwt b, ← sub_smul, map_smul]
      refine add_mem ?_ (W.smul_mem _ (W.smul_mem _ (hmem _ _)))
      have : ⁅e, (E ^ b) x⁆ = (E ^ (b + 1)) x := by rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl
      rw [this]
      exact hmem _ _
  
  set L' := LieSubalgebra.lieSpan K L {h, e, f}
  have hL' : ∀ z ∈ L', ∀ v ∈ W, ⁅z, v⁆ ∈ W := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hhW
      · exact heW
      · exact hfW
    | zero => intro v _; rw [zero_lie]; exact zero_mem _
    | add z z' _ _ hz hz' => intro v hv; rw [add_lie]; exact add_mem (hz v hv) (hz' v hv)
    | smul c z _ hz => intro v hv; rw [smul_lie]; exact W.smul_mem c (hz v hv)
    | lie z z' _ _ hz hz' =>
      intro v hv
      rw [lie_lie]
      exact sub_mem (hz _ (hz' v hv)) (hz' _ (hz v hv))
  let Y : LieSubmodule K L' M :=
    { W with lie_mem := fun {z v} hv ↦ hL' z z.2 v hv }
  have : FiniteDimensional K Y := FiniteDimensional.span_finset K S
  let h' : L' := ⟨h, LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (by simp)⟩
  let e' : L' := ⟨e, LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (by simp)⟩
  let f' : L' := ⟨f, LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan (by simp)⟩
  have t' : IsSl2Triple h' e' f' :=
    { h_ne_zero := fun h0 ↦ t.h_ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h0)
      lie_e_f := Subtype.ext t.lie_e_f
      lie_h_e_nsmul := Subtype.ext t.lie_h_e_nsmul
      lie_h_f_nsmul := Subtype.ext t.lie_h_f_nsmul }
  have hxY : x ∈ Y := by
    change x ∈ W
    simpa using hmem 0 0
  have hpow : ∀ n (y : Y), ((toEnd K L' Y e' ^ n) y : M) = (E ^ n) (y : M) := by
    intro n y
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ← ih]
      rfl
  have := t'.eq_zero_of_toEnd_e_pow_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional (M := Y) (x := ⟨x, hxY⟩)
    (Subtype.ext hx) hkm (Subtype.ext (by rw [hpow]; exact hk))
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.subsingleton_homology_succ_iff_leftRegular_exact
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_succ_iff_leftRegular_exact (k : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (homology K (nNeg P) (VermaModule P Λ) (k + 1)) ↔
      LinearMap.range (d K (nNeg P) (LeftRegular K (nNeg P)) (k + 1)) =
        LinearMap.ker (d K (nNeg P) (LeftRegular K (nNeg P)) k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subsingleton_homology_succ_iff]
  exact (homologyEquivLeftRegular P Λ (k + 1)).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.term_categoryO
statement: theorem term_categoryO (k : ℕ) : IsCategoryO P (BGGTerm P hA Λ k)
proof:
:= by
  have := finite_level P hA k
  exact IsCategoryO.directSum _ fun _ ↦ VermaModule.isCategoryO P _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.verma_top_absent
statement:
theorem verma_top_absent (w : P.weylGroup hA) (hw : w ≠ 1) :
    VermaModule.weightSpace P (P.weylDot hA w Λ) Λ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hdiff⟩ := exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf P hA hΛ w
  have hdown : P.weylDot hA w Λ ∈ cone P Λ := by
    refine ⟨l, hl, ?_⟩
    rw [← hdiff]
    abel
  apply VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot
  intro k hk heq
  have hfix : P.weylDot hA w Λ = Λ :=
    eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hdown ⟨k, hk, heq⟩
  apply hw
  apply weylDot_injective P hA hΛ
  simpa only [Matrix.Realization.weylDot_one] using hfix

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.term_weight_below
statement:
theorem term_weight_below (k : ℕ) {μ : Dual K H} {v : BGGTerm P hA Λ k}
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P (BGGTerm P hA Λ k) μ) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) : μ ∈ cone P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, v w ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hz
    exact hv0 (DFinsupp.ext hz)
  let c := DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K _ P.KacMoodyAlgebra
    (fun w : {w : P.weylGroup hA // (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k} ↦
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) w
  have hvw := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P c hv
  have hm := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (bggEmb P hA hΛ w) hvw
  exact VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ LieModuleHom.id
    Function.surjective_id hm (fun hz ↦ hw (bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ w
      (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.term_top_absent
statement: theorem term_top_absent (k : ℕ) : weightSpace P (BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1)) Λ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mpr
  intro v hv
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro w
  have hw : (w : P.weylGroup hA) ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    have := w.2
    rw [he, (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_one] at this
    omega
  have hvw := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P
    (DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K _ P.KacMoodyAlgebra
      (fun w : {w : P.weylGroup hA // (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k + 1} ↦
        VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) w) hv
  exact ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (verma_top_absent P hA hΛ w hw)) _ hvw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.term_casimir
statement:
theorem term_casimir (k : ℕ) (v : BGGTerm P hA Λ k) :
    hB.casimir _ (term_categoryO P hA k).isPosFinite v =
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ • v
proof:
:= by
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro w
  let c := DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K _ P.KacMoodyAlgebra
    (fun w : {w : P.weylGroup hA // (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k} ↦
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) w
  change c (hB.casimir _ (term_categoryO P hA k).isPosFinite v) =
    c (P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ • v)
  rw [hB.map_casimir c (term_categoryO P hA k).isPosFinite
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _).isPosFinite, map_smul]
  apply bggEmb_injective P hA hΛ w
  rw [hB.map_casimir _ (VermaModule.isCategoryO P _).isPosFinite
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P Λ).isPosFinite, map_smul,
    hB.casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective hA _ LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.cycles_categoryO
statement: theorem cycles_categoryO (k : ℕ) : IsCategoryO P (Cycles P hA hΛ k)
proof:
:=
  (term_categoryO P hA (k + 1)).lieSubmodule _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.homology_categoryO
statement: theorem homology_categoryO (k : ℕ) : IsCategoryO P (Homology P hA hΛ k)
proof:
:=
  (cycles_categoryO P hA hΛ k).quotient _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.homology_weight_lift
statement:
theorem homology_weight_lift (k : ℕ) {μ : Dual K H}
    {x : Homology P hA hΛ k} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P (Homology P hA hΛ k) μ) :
    ∃ y : Cycles P hA hΛ k, y ∈ weightSpace P (Cycles P hA hΛ k) μ ∧
      LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (boundaries P hA hΛ k) y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace, ← map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P _
    (cycles_categoryO P hA hΛ k).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top] at hx
  exact hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.homology_weight_below
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := homology_weight_lift P hA hΛ k hx
  have hy0 : (y : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k+1)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hx0
    have : y = 0 := Subtype.ext hz
    rw [this, map_zero]
  have hyw := mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hy
  refine ⟨term_weight_below P hA hΛ _ hyw hy0, ?_⟩
  intro he
  subst μ
  exact hy0 ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (term_top_absent P hA hΛ k) y hyw)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.homology_casimir
