statement:
theorem homology_casimir (k : ℕ) (x : Homology P hA hΛ k) :
    hB.casimir _ (homology_categoryO P hA hΛ k).isPosFinite x =
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ • x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (boundaries P hA hΛ k) x
  have hy : hB.casimir _ (cycles_categoryO P hA hΛ k).isPosFinite y =
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ • y := by
    apply (Cycles P hA hΛ k).injective_incl
    rw [hB.map_casimir _ (cycles_categoryO P hA hΛ k).isPosFinite
      (term_categoryO P hA (k+1)).isPosFinite, map_smul, term_casimir P hA hΛ hB]
  rw [← hB.map_casimir _ (cycles_categoryO P hA hΛ k).isPosFinite
    (homology_categoryO P hA hΛ k).isPosFinite, hy, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.homology_subsingleton
statement:
theorem homology_subsingleton (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ i (x : Homology P hA hΛ k), ∃ n : ℕ,
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ n) x = 0) :
    Subsingleton (Homology P hA hΛ k)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  let : Nontrivial (Homology P hA hΛ k) := not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp hn
  obtain ⟨μ, x, hx, hx0, he⟩ := (homology_categoryO P hA hΛ k).exists_lie_e_eq_zero
  have hμ : P.IsDominantIntegral μ := fun i ↦
    IsSl2Triple.HasPrimitiveVectorWith.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero
      (t := isSl2Triple P hA i) ⟨hx0, hx _, he i⟩ (hf i x)
  obtain ⟨⟨l, hl, hml⟩, hne⟩ := homology_weight_below P hA hΛ k hx hx0
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hne
    simpa [hz] using hml
  apply dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_ne S hΛ hμ ⟨hl, hl0⟩
    (show Λ = μ + P.rootOf l by rw [hml, sub_add_cancel])
  exact smul_left_injective K hx0 ((homology_casimir P hA hΛ hB k x).symm.trans
    (hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero _ hx he))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.exact_of_nilpotent_mod_boundaries
statement:
theorem exact_of_nilpotent_mod_boundaries (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1)), bggDiff P hA hΛ k x = 0 →
      ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ n) x ∈
        (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)).range) :
    (bggDiff P hA hΛ k).ker = (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)).range
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ∀ i (x : Homology P hA hΛ k), ∃ n : ℕ,
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ n) x = 0 := by
    intro i x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (boundaries P hA hΛ k) x
    have hy : bggDiff P hA hΛ k y = 0 := (LieModuleHom.mem_ker).mp y.property
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf y.val hy i
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [toEnd_pow_apply_map, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    change (Cycles P hA hΛ k).incl ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ n) y) ∈
      (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)).range
    rw [← toEnd_pow_apply_map]
    exact hn
  have := homology_subsingleton P hA hΛ hB k hnil
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    have hz : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (boundaries P hA hΛ k) ⟨y, hy⟩ = 0 :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (boundaries P hA hΛ k)).mp hz
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change bggDiff P hA hΛ k (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k+1) y) = 0
    exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun (bggDiff_comp_bggDiff P hA hΛ k) y

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGCasimir.exact_of_nilpotent_mod_boundaries_symmetrizable
statement:
theorem exact_of_nilpotent_mod_boundaries_symmetrizable (hS : A.IsSymmetrizable) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1)), bggDiff P hA hΛ k x = 0 →
      ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ n) x ∈
        (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)).range) :
    (bggDiff P hA hΛ k).ker = (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)).range
proof:
:=
  exact_of_nilpotent_mod_boundaries P hA hΛ
    (isStandardForm_invForm P (isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mp hS).some) k hf

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nonneg_or_nonpos_of_rootSpace_ne_bot
statement:
lemma nonneg_or_nonpos_of_rootSpace_ne_bot {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : rootSpace P (P.rootOf k) ≠ ⊥) :
    0 ≤ k ∨ k ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  refine hk ?_
  rw [rootSpace_eq_map, AuxLieAlgebra.rootSpace_eq_bot, Submodule.map_bot]
  rintro ((⟨l, hl, hkl⟩ | hk0) | ⟨l, hl, hkl⟩)
  · have : k = -l := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_neg]; exact hkl.symm)
    exact hcon.2 (by rw [this]; exact neg_nonpos.mpr hl.1)
  · have : k = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_zero]; exact hk0)
    exact hcon.1 (le_of_eq this.symm)
  · have : k = l := P.rootOf_injective hkl.symm
    exact hcon.1 (this ▸ hl.1)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace_neg_two_smul_root_eq_bot
statement: lemma rootSpace_neg_two_smul_root_eq_bot (i : ι) : rootSpace P (-(2 • P.root i)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have h1 := chevalleyInvolution_mem_rootSpace P hx
  rw [neg_neg, rootSpace_nsmul_root_eq_bot P i le_rfl, Submodule.mem_bot] at h1
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
  have := congrArg (chevalleyInvolution P) h1
  rwa [chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution, map_zero] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_iSup_rootSpace
statement:
lemma lie_mem_iSup_rootSpace {S T R : Set (Dual K H)}
    (hST : ∀ μ ∈ S, ∀ ν ∈ T, rootSpace P μ ≠ ⊥ → rootSpace P ν ≠ ⊥ →
      rootSpace P (μ + ν) ≠ ⊥ → μ + ν ∈ R)
    {x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ S, rootSpace P μ)
    (hy : y ∈ ⨆ ν ∈ T, rootSpace P ν) : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ ⨆ ρ ∈ R, rootSpace P ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_subtype''] at hx hy
  induction hx using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | zero => rw [zero_lie]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x x' _ _ hx hx' => rw [add_lie]; exact add_mem hx hx'
  | mem μ x hx =>
    induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | zero => rw [lie_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [lie_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
    | mem ν y hy =>
      have hxy := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hx hy
      by_cases h0 : ⁅x, y⁆ = 0
      · rw [h0]; exact zero_mem _
      have hx0 : rootSpace P μ ≠ ⊥ := fun hb ↦ h0 (by
        rw [hb, Submodule.mem_bot] at hx; rw [hx, zero_lie])
      have hy0 : rootSpace P ν ≠ ⊥ := fun hb ↦ h0 (by
        rw [hb, Submodule.mem_bot] at hy; rw [hy, lie_zero])
      have hxy0 : rootSpace P (μ + ν) ≠ ⊥ := fun hb ↦ h0 (by
        have hxy' : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ rootSpace P (μ + ν) := hxy
        rwa [hb, Submodule.mem_bot] at hxy')
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _
        (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (hST μ μ.2 ν ν.2 hx0 hy0 hxy0) hxy)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_pos_of_mem_posCone
statement: lemma sum_pos_of_mem_posCone {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) : 0 < ∑ j, k j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, k j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hk.2 (funext h)
  have hj' : 0 < k j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hk.1 j) (Ne.symm hj)
  calc 0 < k j := hj'
    _ ≤ ∑ j, k j := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hk.1 j) (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.neg_root_eq_neg_rootOf
statement: lemma neg_root_eq_neg_rootOf : -P.root i = -P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootOf_single]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.add_mem_negWeights_diff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨negWeights_add P hμ.1 hν.1, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, -⟩ := hμ
  obtain ⟨⟨l, hl, rfl⟩, -⟩ := hν
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff, neg_root_eq_neg_rootOf, ← neg_add, neg_inj, ← map_add] at h
  have hkl := P.rootOf_injective h
  have h1 := sum_pos_of_mem_posCone hk
  have h2 := sum_pos_of_mem_posCone hl
  have h3 : ∑ j, (k + l) j = ∑ j, (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) j := by rw [hkl]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_pi_single', Finset.mem_univ,
    ite_true] at h3
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nilradNeg_le_nNeg
statement: lemma nilradNeg_le_nNeg : nilradNeg P i ≤ (nNeg P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [nNeg_toSubmodule_eq]
  exact iSup₂_mono' fun μ hμ ↦ ⟨μ, hμ.1, le_rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_mem_nilradNeg
statement:
lemma lie_mem_nilradNeg {x y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nilradNeg P i)
    (hy : y ∈ nilradNeg P i) : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i
proof:
:=
  lie_mem_iSup_rootSpace P (fun _ hμ _ hν _ _ _ ↦ add_mem_negWeights_diff i hμ hν) hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_mem_nilradNeg
statement:
lemma lie_h_mem_nilradNeg (a : H) {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nilradNeg P i) :
    ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i
proof:
:= by
  have ha : h P a ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ ({0} : Set (Dual K H)), rootSpace P μ :=
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem rfl fun b ↦ by
      rw [lie_h_h, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul])
  exact lie_mem_iSup_rootSpace P (fun μ hμ ν hν _ _ _ ↦ by
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hμ, zero_add]; exact hν) ha hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_f_mem_nilradNeg
statement:
lemma lie_f_mem_nilradNeg {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nilradNeg P i) :
    ⁅f P i, x⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f P i ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ ({-P.root i} : Set (Dual K H)), rootSpace P μ :=
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem rfl (by
      rw [rootSpace_neg_root]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  refine lie_mem_iSup_rootSpace P (fun μ hμ ν hν _ _ _ ↦ ?_) hf hx
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hμ]
  refine ⟨negWeights_add P (neg_root_mem_negWeights P i) hν.1, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff, add_eq_left] at h
  exact zero_notMem_negWeights P (h ▸ hν.1)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_e_mem_nilradNeg
statement:
lemma lie_e_mem_nilradNeg {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nilradNeg P i) :
    ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ nilradNeg P i
proof:
:= by
  have he : e P i ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ ({P.root i} : Set (Dual K H)), rootSpace P μ :=
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem rfl (by
      rw [rootSpace_root]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  refine lie_mem_iSup_rootSpace P (fun μ hμ ν hν _ hν0 hμν0 ↦ ?_) he hx
  obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hμ
  obtain ⟨⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, hki⟩ := hν
  beta_reduce at *
  have hki' : k ≠ Pi.single i 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hki (by rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff, rootOf_single])
  have hsum : P.root i + -P.rootOf k = P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1 - k) := by
    rw [map_sub, rootOf_single]; abel
  rw [hsum] at hμν0 ⊢
  have hk2 : k ≠ 2 • Pi.single i 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hν0
    rw [map_nsmul, rootOf_single]
    exact rootSpace_neg_two_smul_root_eq_bot P i
  rcases nonneg_or_nonpos_of_rootSpace_ne_bot P hμν0 with h | h
  · 
    exfalso
    have hk0 := hk.2
    apply hk0
    by_cases hki0 : k i = 0
    · funext j
      have := h j; have := hk.1 j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simpa using hki0
      · simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, Pi.zero_apply] at *; omega
    · exfalso
      apply hki'
      funext j
      have := h j; have := hk.1 j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply] at *; omega
      · simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, Pi.zero_apply] at *; omega
  · refine ⟨⟨k - Pi.single i 1, ⟨fun j ↦ ?_, sub_ne_zero.mpr hki'⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have := h j; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at *; omega
    · simp only [map_sub]; abel
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff, neg_root_eq_neg_rootOf, ← map_neg]
      intro h'
      have := P.rootOf_injective h'
      apply hk2
      rw [two_nsmul]
      funext j
      have := congr_fun this j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.add_apply] at this ⊢
        omega
      · simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, Pi.add_apply] at this ⊢
        omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNeg_eq_span_f_sup_nilradNeg
statement: lemma nNeg_eq_span_f_sup_nilradNeg : (nNeg P).toSubmodule = (K ∙ f P i) ⊔ nilradNeg P i
proof:
:= by
  have hS : P.negWeights = insert (-P.root i) (P.negWeights \ {-P.root i}) := by
    rw [Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.insert_eq_of_mem (neg_root_mem_negWeights P i)]
  rw [nNeg_toSubmodule_eq, hS, iSup_insert, rootSpace_neg_root]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.disjoint_span_f_nilradNeg
statement: lemma disjoint_span_f_nilradNeg : Disjoint (K ∙ f P i) (nilradNeg P i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rootSpace_neg_root]
  exact (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (h P)).disjoint_biSup fun h ↦ h.2 rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.lie_mem_nNegActionSpan
statement:
lemma lie_mem_nNegActionSpan {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ nNeg P) (m : V) :
    ⁅x, m⁆ ∈ nNegActionSpan P V
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, m, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.map_mem_nNegActionSpan
statement:
lemma map_mem_nNegActionSpan {V U : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra U]
    [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra U] (φ : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ U)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ nNegActionSpan P V) : φ v ∈ nNegActionSpan P U
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, m, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie]
    exact lie_mem_nNegActionSpan P hx _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add v w _ _ hv hw => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hv hw
  | smul c v _ hv => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.oneTmul_injective
statement: lemma oneTmul_injective : Function.Injective (oneTmul P V)
proof:
:= by
  refine Function.LeftInverse.injective
    (g := (TensorProduct.lid K V).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor V
      (algebraMapInv : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) →ₐ[K] K).toLinearMap) fun v ↦ ?_
  simp [oneTmul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.chainsIn_zero_le_range_oneTmul
statement:
lemma chainsIn_zero_le_range_oneTmul :
    chainsIn K (nNeg P) V 0 ≤ LinearMap.range (oneTmul P V)
proof:
:=
  chainsIn_zero_le fun v ↦ ⟨v, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.boundaries_zero_eq_actionSpan
statement:
theorem boundaries_zero_eq_actionSpan :
    boundaries K (nNeg P) V 0 = (nNegActionSpan P V).map (oneTmul P V)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [boundaries, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    apply chainsIn_succ_le
    intro y c hc
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := chainsIn_zero_le_range_oneTmul P V hc
    change diff K (nNeg P) V (wedge K (nNeg P) V y (1 ⊗ₜ m)) ∈
      (nNegActionSpan P V).map (oneTmul P V)
    rw [wedge_tmul, mul_one, diff_ι_tmul, LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket_of_module]
    exact neg_mem (Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨⁅(y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), m⁆,
      lie_mem_nNegActionSpan P y.2 m, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem m hm =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, v, rfl⟩ := hm
      let y : nNeg P := ⟨x, hx⟩
      refine ⟨-(ExteriorAlgebra.ι K y ⊗ₜ v), neg_mem (tmul_mem_chainsIn ?_ v), ?_⟩
      · rw [exteriorPower, pow_one]
        exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ y
      · rw [map_neg, diff_ι_tmul, neg_neg, LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket_of_module]
        rfl
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add m n _ _ hm hn => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hm hn
    | smul c m _ hm => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.toHomologyZero_surjective
statement: lemma toHomologyZero_surjective : Function.Surjective (toHomologyZero P V)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c, t, ht, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := chainsIn_zero_le_range_oneTmul P V ht.1
  exact ⟨m, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.ker_toHomologyZero
statement: theorem ker_toHomologyZero : (toHomologyZero P V).ker = nNegActionSpan P V
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  change (⟨_, _⟩ : homology K (nNeg P) V 0) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff]
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk (oneTmul P V m) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, boundaries_zero_eq_actionSpan]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvm⟩
    exact oneTmul_injective P V hvm ▸ hv
  · intro hm
    exact ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.homologyMap_toHomologyZero
statement:
lemma homologyMap_toHomologyZero (φ : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ U) (v : V) :
    homologyMap K (nNeg P) 0 (restrictNNeg P φ) (toHomologyZero P V v) =
      toHomologyZero P U (φ v)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk
    ((φ.toLinearMap).lTensor (ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P)) (1 ⊗ₜ v)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.homologyZeroMap_eq_zero_of_range_le
statement:
lemma homologyZeroMap_eq_zero_of_range_le (φ : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ U)
    (hφ : ∀ v, φ v ∈ nNegActionSpan P U) :
    homologyMap K (nNeg P) 0 (restrictNNeg P φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := toHomologyZero_surjective P V x
  have hz : toHomologyZero P U (φ v) = 0 := by
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mp
    rw [ker_toHomologyZero]
    exact hφ v
  exact (congrArg (homologyMap K (nNeg P) 0 (restrictNNeg P φ)) hv).symm.trans
    ((homologyMap_toHomologyZero P φ v).trans hz)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.VermaModule.ker_hwCoord_eq_nNegActionSpan
statement:
theorem ker_hwCoord_eq_nNegActionSpan :
    (VermaModule.hwCoord P μ).ker = nNegActionSpan P (VermaModule P μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hdecomp : ∀ m : VermaModule P μ,
        m - VermaModule.hwCoord P μ m • VermaModule.hwv P μ ∈
          nNegActionSpan P (VermaModule P μ) := by
      intro m
      have hm : m ∈ VermaModule.fWordSpan P μ := by
        rw [VermaModule.span_fWord_smul_eq_top]; trivial
      induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem m hm =>
        obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hm
        cases w with
        | nil => simp
        | cons i w =>
          dsimp only
          rw [VermaModule.fWord_smul_cons,
            VermaModule.hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P μ (f_mem_nNeg P i), zero_smul, sub_zero]
          exact lie_mem_nNegActionSpan P (f_mem_nNeg P i) _
      | zero => simp
      | add m n _ _ hm hn =>
        simpa only [map_add, add_smul, add_sub_add_comm] using add_mem hm hn
      | smul c m _ hm =>
        simpa only [map_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_eq_mul] using
          (Submodule.smul_mem (nNegActionSpan P (VermaModule P μ)) c hm)
    intro m hm
    simpa only [LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hm, zero_smul, sub_zero] using hdecomp m
  · refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, m, rfl⟩
    exact VermaModule.hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P μ hx m

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.VermaModule.finrank_homologyZero
statement:
theorem finrank_homologyZero :
    finrank K (LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homology K (nNeg P) (VermaModule P μ) 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [(homologyZeroEquiv P μ).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.VermaModule.hom_mem_nNegActionSpan
statement:
theorem hom_mem_nNegActionSpan {ν : Dual K H} (hνμ : ν ≠ μ)
    (φ : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ)
    (m : VermaModule P ν) : φ m ∈ nNegActionSpan P (VermaModule P μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_hwCoord_eq_nNegActionSpan, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  have heq := VermaModule.eq_smul_hwCoord P ν
    ((VermaModule.hwCoord P μ).comp φ.toLinearMap) (fun i m ↦ by
      change VermaModule.hwCoord P μ (φ ⁅f P i, m⁆) = 0
      rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie]
      exact VermaModule.hwCoord_lie_of_mem_nNeg P μ (f_mem_nNeg P i) _)
  have hz : VermaModule.hwCoord P μ (φ (VermaModule.hwv P ν)) = 0 := by
    exact VermaModule.hwCoord_eq_zero_of_ne P μ
      (mem_primitiveVectors.mp (VermaModule.map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P φ)).1 hνμ
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun heq m
  change VermaModule.hwCoord P μ (φ m) =
    VermaModule.hwCoord P μ (φ (VermaModule.hwv P ν)) * VermaModule.hwCoord P ν m at this
  simpa only [hz, zero_mul] using this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.bggDiff_mem_nNegActionSpan
statement:
theorem bggDiff_mem_nNegActionSpan (k : ℕ) (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1)) :
    bggDiff P hA hΛ k x ∈ nNegActionSpan P (BGGTerm P hA Λ k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | of w' x =>
    rw [bggDiff_of]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro w hw
    apply Submodule.smul_mem
    apply map_mem_nNegActionSpan P (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K _ P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ w)
    apply VermaModule.hom_mem_nNegActionSpan P _ _ (bggMap P hA hΛ w' w)
    intro heq
    have hww := weylDot_injective P hA hΛ heq
    have hlen := congrArg (P.coxeterSystem hA).length hww
    rw [w'.2, w.2] at hlen
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGMinimality.homologyZeroMap_bggDiff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem homologyZeroMap_bggDiff_eq_zero (k : ℕ) :
    LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.homologyMap K (nNeg P) 0
      (restrictNNeg P (bggDiff P hA hΛ k)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact homologyZeroMap_eq_zero_of_range_le P (bggDiff P hA hΛ k)
    (bggDiff_mem_nNegActionSpan P hA hΛ k)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_bggDiff_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_bggDiff_eq_range (k : ℕ) :
    (bggDiff P hA hΛ k).ker = (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)).range
proof:
:= by
  apply BGGCasimir.exact_of_nilpotent_mod_boundaries_symmetrizable P hA hΛ hS k
  intro x hx i
  exact BGGIntegrable.exists_pow_mem_range_of_cycle P hA hΛ k i x hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.subsingleton_homology_of_pos
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_of_pos (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Subsingleton (homology K (nNeg P) (VermaModule P Λ) q)
proof:
:= by
  exact (homologyEquivLeftRegular P Λ q).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr
    (subsingleton_homology_leftRegular q hq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGSyzygy.bggDiff_of_apply
statement:
lemma bggDiff_of_apply (k : ℕ) (u : {u : W // (cs).length u = k + 1})
    (v : {v : W // (cs).length v = k}) (m : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA u Λ)) :
    (bggDiff P hA hΛ k (DirectSum.of _ u m)) v =
      if (cs).BruhatCovBy v u then bggSign P hA v u • bggMap P hA hΛ u v m else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [bggDiff_of]
  by_cases hv : (cs).BruhatCovBy v u
  · rw [ite_eq_left hv]
    rw [DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single v]
    · change bggSign P hA v u • (DirectSum.of (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k} ↦
        VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) v (bggMap P hA hΛ u v m)) v = _
      simp
    · intro b hb hbv
      change bggSign P hA b u • (DirectSum.of (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k} ↦
        VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) b (bggMap P hA hΛ u b m)) v = _
      simp [DirectSum.of_apply, hbv]
    · intro hv'
      exact (hv' ((mem_bggBoundary P hA).mpr hv)).elim
  · rw [ite_eq_right hv, DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b hb
    have hbv : b ≠ v := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hv ((mem_bggBoundary P hA).mp hb)
    change bggSign P hA b u • (DirectSum.of (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k} ↦
        VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) b (bggMap P hA hΛ u b m)) v = _
    simp [DirectSum.of_apply, hbv]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGSyzygy.eq_zero_of_cycle_supported_on_leftDescents
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_cycle_supported_on_leftDescents (k : ℕ) (i : ι)
    (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1)) (hx : bggDiff P hA hΛ k x = 0)
    (hsupport : ∀ u : {u : W // (cs).length u = k + 1},
      ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent u i → x u = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro u
  change x u = 0
  by_cases hu : (cs).IsLeftDescent u i
  · let v : {v : W // (cs).length v = k} :=
      ⟨(cs).simple i * u, by
        have hlen := (cs).isLeftDescent_iff.mp hu
        rw [u.2] at hlen
        omega⟩
    have hcov : (cs).BruhatCovBy v u :=
      (cs).bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent hu
    have hv : ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent v i :=
      (cs).isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul.mp hu
    have hcoord : (bggDiff P hA hΛ k x) v =
        bggSign P hA v u • bggMap P hA hΛ u v (x u) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x]
      rw [map_sum, DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single u]
      · rw [bggDiff_of_apply, ite_eq_left hcov]
      · intro b hb hbu
        by_cases hbD : (cs).IsLeftDescent b i
        · have hncov : ¬ (cs).BruhatCovBy v b := by
            intro h
            have heq := h.eq_simple_mul hbD hv
            have hval : (u : W) = b := mul_left_cancel heq
            exact hbu (Subtype.ext hval.symm)
          rw [bggDiff_of_apply, ite_eq_right hncov]
        · rw [hsupport b hbD, map_zero, map_zero]
          rfl
      · intro hus
        have hu0 : x u = 0 := DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hus
        rw [hu0, map_zero, map_zero]
        rfl
    rw [hx] at hcoord
    have hsign : bggSign P hA v u ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)
    have hm : bggMap P hA hΛ u v (x u) = 0 :=
      (smul_eq_zero.mp hcoord.symm).resolve_left hsign
    exact bggMap_injective P hA hΛ hcov.1 (hm.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  · exact hsupport u hu

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGSyzygy.cycle_eq_of_ascent_coordinates
statement:
theorem cycle_eq_of_ascent_coordinates (k : ℕ) (i : ι)
    (x y : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1))
    (hx : bggDiff P hA hΛ k x = 0) (hy : bggDiff P hA hΛ k y = 0)
    (hxy : ∀ u : {u : W // (cs).length u = k + 1},
      ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent u i → x u = y u) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_cycle_supported_on_leftDescents P hA hΛ k i
  · rw [map_sub, hx, hy, sub_self]
  · intro u hu
    change x u - y u = 0
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hxy u hu)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGSyzygy.ascent_projection_injective_on_syzygy
statement:
theorem ascent_projection_injective_on_syzygy (k : ℕ) (i : ι) :
    Function.Injective (fun z : (bggDiff P hA hΛ k).ker ↦
      fun u : {u : {u : W // (cs).length u = k + 1} // ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent u i} ↦
        z.1 u.1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply cycle_eq_of_ascent_coordinates P hA hΛ k i x.1 y.1 x.2 y.2
  intro u hu
  exact congr_fun hxy ⟨u, hu⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.exists_pow_mem_bggMap_range
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mem_bggMap_range {w : W} {i : ι}
    (hw : ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent w i) (x : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) :
    ∃ N, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) x ∈
      (bggMap P hA hΛ ((cs).simple i * w) w).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ := P.exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq hA hΛ hw
  have hcov := (cs).bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_not_isLeftDescent hw
  have hne : bggMap P hA hΛ ((cs).simple i * w) w ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact VermaModule.hwv_ne_zero P _ (bggMap_injective P hA hΛ hcov.1
      (by rw [h, map_zero, _root_.zero_apply]))
  have hr := range_eq_of_finrank_hom_eq_one P (P.weylDot_simple_mul hA i w Λ)
    (VermaModule.finrank_hom_simple_mul hA hΛ hw) hne
    (VermaModule.reflectionHom_ne_zero hA hn0 hn)
  let q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (VermaModule.reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).range
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := VermaModule.exists_toEnd_f_pow_quotient_eq_zero hA hn0 hn (q x)
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  rw [hr]
  rw [toEnd_pow_apply_map, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply,
    LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'] at hN
  exact hN

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.pow_apply_coordinate
statement:
lemma pow_apply_coordinate (k : ℕ) (i : ι) (N : ℕ) (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ k)
    (w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}) :
    ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) x) w =
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) (x w)
proof:
:=
  (toEnd_pow_apply_map (DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K _ P.KacMoodyAlgebra
    (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k} ↦ VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) w)
    N (f P i) x).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.pow_apply_of
statement:
lemma pow_apply_of (k : ℕ) (i : ι) (N : ℕ)
    (w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}) (x : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) :
    (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (BGGTerm P hA Λ k) (f P i) ^ N)
        (DirectSum.of _ w x) =
      DirectSum.of _ w ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) x)
proof:
:=
  toEnd_pow_apply_map (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K _ P.KacMoodyAlgebra
    (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k} ↦ VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) w)
    N (f P i) x

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.incoming_ascent_coordinate
statement:
lemma incoming_ascent_coordinate (k : ℕ) (i : ι)
    (w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}) (hw : ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent w i)
    (m : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA ((cs).simple i * w) Λ))
    (v : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}) (hv : ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent v i) :
    (bggDiff P hA hΛ k (DirectSum.of _
      (⟨(cs).simple i * w, ((cs).not_isLeftDescent_iff.mp hw).trans
        (congrArg (· + 1) w.2)⟩ : {u : W // (cs).length u = k + 1}) m)) v =
      (DirectSum.of (fun w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k} ↦
        VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) w
        (bggSign P hA w ((cs).simple i * w) •
          bggMap P hA hΛ ((cs).simple i * w) w m)) v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [BGGSyzygy.bggDiff_of_apply]
  by_cases hvw : v = w
  · subst v
    rw [ite_eq_left ((cs).bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_not_isLeftDescent hw)]
    simp
  · have hD : (cs).IsLeftDescent ((cs).simple i * w) i := by
      rw [(cs).isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul,
        (cs).simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
      exact hw
    have hnc : ¬ (cs).BruhatCovBy v ((cs).simple i * w) := by
      intro h
      have heq := h.eq_simple_mul hD hv
      have hvw' : (v : W) = w := by simpa using heq
      exact hvw (Subtype.ext hvw')
    rw [ite_eq_right hnc]
    simp [DirectSum.of_apply, Ne.symm hvw]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.exists_pow_ascent_boundary_of
statement:
lemma exists_pow_ascent_boundary_of (k : ℕ) (i : ι)
    (w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}) (x : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) :
    ∃ N, ∃ y : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1),
      ∀ v : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}, ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent v i →
      ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (BGGTerm P hA Λ k) (f P i) ^ N)
        (DirectSum.of _ w x)) v = (bggDiff P hA hΛ k y) v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hw : (cs).IsLeftDescent w i
  · refine ⟨0, 0, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
    have hwv : w ≠ v := fun h ↦ hv (h ▸ hw)
    simp [DirectSum.of_apply, hwv]
  · obtain ⟨N, m, hm⟩ := exists_pow_mem_bggMap_range P hA hΛ hw x
    let c := bggSign P hA w ((cs).simple i * w)
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)
    refine ⟨N, DirectSum.of _
      (⟨(cs).simple i * w, ((cs).not_isLeftDescent_iff.mp hw).trans
        (congrArg (· + 1) w.2)⟩ : {u : W // (cs).length u = k + 1})
      (c⁻¹ • m), fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [incoming_ascent_coordinate P hA hΛ k i w hw _ v hv, pow_apply_of]
    rw [map_smul (bggMap P hA hΛ ((cs).simple i * w) w) c⁻¹ m,
      smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul, hm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.ascent_coordinates_pow
statement:
lemma ascent_coordinates_pow (k : ℕ) (i : ι) (N : ℕ)
    {x y : BGGTerm P hA Λ k}
    (h : ∀ w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k},
      ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent w i → x w = y w) :
    ∀ w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}, ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent w i →
      ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) x) w =
      ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) y) w
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  rw [pow_apply_coordinate, pow_apply_coordinate, h w hw]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.exists_pow_ascent_boundary
statement:
theorem exists_pow_ascent_boundary (k : ℕ) (i : ι) (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ k) :
    ∃ N, ∃ y : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1),
      ∀ w : {w : W // (cs).length w = k}, ¬ (cs).IsLeftDescent w i →
      ((toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) x) w =
        (bggDiff P hA hΛ k y) w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
  | of w x => exact exists_pow_ascent_boundary_of P hA hΛ k i w x
  | add x z hx hz =>
    obtain ⟨N, y, hy⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨M, t, ht⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨M + N,
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ M) y +
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) t, fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
    have hy' := ascent_coordinates_pow P hA k i M hy w hw
    have ht' := ascent_coordinates_pow P hA k i N ht w hw
    rw [toEnd_pow_apply_map] at hy' ht'
    rw [map_add, DFinsupp.add_apply, map_add, DFinsupp.add_apply]
    congr 1
    · rw [pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply]
      exact hy'
    · rw [Nat.add_comm M N, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply]
      exact ht'

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.BGGIntegrable.exists_pow_mem_range_of_cycle
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mem_range_of_cycle (k : ℕ) (i : ι)
    (x : BGGTerm P hA Λ (k + 1)) (hx : bggDiff P hA hΛ k x = 0) :
    ∃ N, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) x ∈
      (bggDiff P hA hΛ (k + 1)).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, y, hy⟩ := exists_pow_ascent_boundary P hA hΛ (k + 1) i x
  refine ⟨N, y, ?_⟩
  apply BGGSyzygy.cycle_eq_of_ascent_coordinates P hA hΛ k i
  · exact LieModuleHom.congr_fun (bggDiff_comp_bggDiff P hA hΛ k) y
  · rw [← toEnd_pow_apply_map, hx, map_zero]
  · intro w hw
    exact (hy w hw).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.subsingleton_homology_bggTerm_of_pos
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homology_bggTerm_of_pos (k q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Subsingleton (homology K (nNeg P) (BGGTerm P hA Λ k) q)
proof:
:= by
  exact subsingleton_homology_directSum
    (fun w : {w : P.weylGroup hA // (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k} =>
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) q
    (fun w => VermaModule.subsingleton_homology_of_pos P (P.weylDot hA w Λ) q hq)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf
statement:
lemma exists_sub_weylDot_eq_rootOf (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ Λ - P.weylDot hA w Λ = P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA (fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := P.add_rho_regular hΛ i
    exact ⟨n + 1, by rw [hn]; push_cast; rfl⟩) w
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  rw [← hwk, weylDot]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weylDot_injective
statement: lemma weylDot_injective : Function.Injective fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦ P.weylDot hA w Λ
proof:
:= by
  intro w w' h
  refine P.apply_injective_of_regular hA (P.add_rho_regular hΛ) ?_
  simpa [weylDot] using h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dotExpFamily_apply
statement:
lemma dotExpFamily_apply (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    dotExpFamily P hA hΛ w = (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w • exp P ℤ (P.weylDot hA w Λ)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [dotExpFamily, SummableFamily.coe_mk, exp, HahnSeries.coeff_smul, coeff_single,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.vermaAltFamily_apply
statement:
theorem vermaAltFamily_apply (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    vermaAltFamily P hA hΛ w = (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w •
      (VermaModule.isCategoryO P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)).character
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaAltFamily, SummableFamily.smul_apply, HahnSeries.of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul,
    dotExpFamily_apply, VermaModule.character_eq_exp_mul_kostantSeries, mul_smul_comm, mul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.hsum_dotExpFamily
statement:
lemma hsum_dotExpFamily :
    (dotExpFamily P hA hΛ).hsum =
      exp P ℤ (-P.rho) * weylAltSum P hA (IrreducibleModule.isDominantIntegral_add_rho hΛ)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  change (dotExpFamily P hA hΛ).hsum.coeff (toWeightOrd P g) = _
  rw [SummableFamily.coeff_hsum, coeff_exp_mul, coeffAt_weylAltSum, sub_neg_eq_add]
  refine finsum_congr fun w ↦ ?_
  simp only [dotExpFamily, SummableFamily.coe_mk, coeff_single]
  have : (toWeightOrd P g = toWeightOrd P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) ↔
      ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) = g + P.rho) := by
    rw [← weylDot_add_rho, add_left_inj, (toWeightOrd P).injective.eq_iff, eq_comm]
  by_cases h : toWeightOrd P g = toWeightOrd P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (this.mp h)]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun h' ↦ h (this.mpr h'))]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.hsum_vermaAltFamily
statement:
theorem hsum_vermaAltFamily :
    (vermaAltFamily P hA hΛ).hsum = (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).character
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaAltFamily, SummableFamily.hsum_smul, hsum_dotExpFamily,
    ← IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA hS hΛ]
  have h1 : exp P ℤ (-P.rho) * exp P ℤ P.rho = 1 := by
    rw [← exp_add, neg_add_cancel]; rfl
  calc kostantSeries P * (exp P ℤ (-P.rho) *
          (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P * (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).character))
      = (denominator P * kostantSeries P) * (exp P ℤ (-P.rho) * exp P ℤ P.rho) *
          (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).character := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [denominator_mul_kostantSeries, h1, one_mul, one_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsum_neg_one_pow_finrank_weightSpace
statement:
theorem finsum_neg_one_pow_finrank_weightSpace (μ : Dual K H) :
    ∑ᶠ w : P.weylGroup hA, (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w *
        (finrank K (VermaModule.weightSpace P (P.weylDot hA w Λ) μ) : ℤ) =
      finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun c ↦ HahnSeries.coeff c (toWeightOrd P μ))
    (hsum_vermaAltFamily P hA hΛ hS)
  simp only [SummableFamily.coeff_hsum, vermaAltFamily_apply,
    HahnSeries.coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum_kostantPartition
statement:
theorem IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_eq_finsum_kostantPartition (μ : Dual K H) :
    (finrank K (weightSpaceOfMap (IrreducibleModule P Λ) (h P) μ) : ℤ) =
      ∑ᶠ w : P.weylGroup hA, (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w *
        (kostantPartition P (P.weylDot hA w Λ - μ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finsum_neg_one_pow_finrank_weightSpace P hA hΛ hS μ]
  refine finsum_congr fun w ↦ ?_
  rw [← VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_sub P (P.weylDot hA w Λ), sub_sub_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.add_rho_coroot_eq
statement:
lemma add_rho_coroot_eq (i : ι) :
    (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = ((hΛ i).choose + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have := (hΛ i).choose_spec
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot]
  push_cast
  linear_combination this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bggAug_surjective
statement: theorem bggAug_surjective : Function.Surjective (bggAug P (Λ := Λ))
proof:
:=
  LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_bggAug
statement: theorem ker_bggAug : (bggAug P (Λ := Λ)).ker = maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:=
  LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_ker _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_bggDiffOne_eq_fPowSubmodule
statement:
theorem range_bggDiffOne_eq_fPowSubmodule :
    (bggDiffOne P hA hΛ).range = fPowSubmodule P Λ fun i ↦ (hΛ i).choose
proof:
:= by
  rw [bggDiffOne, DirectSum.range_toLieModule]
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_) (LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr ?_)
  · rw [VermaModule.range_eq_lieSpan, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff,
      reflectionHom_hwv]
    exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine LieSubmodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i ⟨hwv P _, ?_⟩
    rw [reflectionHom_hwv]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule
statement:
theorem maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule :
    maxSubmodule P Λ = fPowSubmodule P Λ fun i ↦ (hΛ i).choose
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = (hΛ i).choose := fun i ↦ (hΛ i).choose_spec
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule P Λ hA hn)
  have := FPowQuotient.toIrreducibleModule_injective hS hA hn
    (a₁ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _ x) (a₂ := 0) (by
      rw [map_zero]
      change LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (maxSubmodule P Λ) x = 0
      rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero']
      exact hx)
  rwa [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero'] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.range_bggDiffOne
statement: theorem range_bggDiffOne : (bggDiffOne P hA hΛ).range = (bggAug P (Λ := Λ)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_bggAug, maxSubmodule_eq_fPowSubmodule P hA hΛ hS,
    range_bggDiffOne_eq_fPowSubmodule]

name: Matrix.Realization.weylDot_add_rho
statement:
lemma weylDot_add_rho (w : P.weylGroup hA) (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.weylDot hA w μ + P.rho = (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho)
proof:
:=
  sub_add_cancel _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.weylDot_one
statement: @[simp] lemma weylDot_one (μ : Dual K H) : P.weylDot hA 1 μ = μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [weylDot]

name: Matrix.Realization.weylDot_mul
statement:
lemma weylDot_mul (v w : P.weylGroup hA) (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.weylDot hA (v * w) μ = P.weylDot hA v (P.weylDot hA w μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weylDot, weylDot, weylDot_add_rho, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.weylDot_simple_mul
statement:
lemma weylDot_simple_mul (i : ι) (w : P.weylGroup hA) (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.weylDot hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i * w) μ =
      P.reflection hA i (P.weylDot hA w μ + P.rho) - P.rho
proof:
:= by
  rw [weylDot_mul, weylDot, coxeterSystem_simple]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  have hdom : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℕ, μ (P.coroot j) = n := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hμ j
    exact ⟨n + 1, by rw [hn]; push_cast; rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA w.2 (μ := μ) fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hdom j
    exact ⟨n, by rw [hn]; norm_cast⟩
  obtain ⟨nᵢ, hnᵢ⟩ := hdom i
  set z : ℤ := nᵢ + (A *ᵥ k) i
  have hc : (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ (P.coroot i) = z := by
    rw [hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hnᵢ, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast [z]
    rfl
  
  have hw' : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w⁻¹ i := by rwa [cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff]
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hw'
  set v := w⁻¹ * cs.simple i * w
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hvm⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA hdom v
  have hv : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = μ - (z : K) • P.rootOf l := by
    simp only [v, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple, cs]
    rw [reflection_apply, hc, map_sub, map_smul, hwl]
    congr 1
    exact (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H).symm_apply_apply μ
  have h2 : P.rootOf (z • l) = (z : K) • P.rootOf l := by
    rw [map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
  rw [hv, sub_sub_cancel, ← h2] at hvm
  have hml : z • l = m := P.rootOf_injective hvm
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hwl
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hwl
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, l j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hl0 (funext h)
  have hlj : 0 < l j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hl j) (Ne.symm hj)
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := by
    have h1 := congrFun hml j
    have h2 := hm j
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2
    nlinarith
  have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hv1 : v ≠ 1 := by
      intro hv1
      have : cs.simple i = 1 := by
        have := congrArg (fun x ↦ w * x * w⁻¹) hv1
        simpa [v, mul_assoc] using this
      have hr : (((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i : P.weylGroup hA) :
          Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.root i := by
        rw [this]; rfl
      rw [coxeterSystem_simple, reflection_root_self] at hr
      exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i (by
        have : (2 : K) • P.root i = 0 := by rw [two_smul]; nth_rw 1 [← hr]; exact neg_add_cancel _
        exact (smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left two_ne_zero)
    exact P.apply_ne_self_of_regular hA hμ hv1 (by rw [hv, hz, Int.cast_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero])
  refine ⟨z.toNat, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [hc]
  exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz0).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_coroot_eq_neg_of_isLeftDescent
proof:
:= by
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  have hw' : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.simple i * w) i := by
    rwa [← cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul]
  obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ := P.exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent hA hμ hw'
  refine ⟨n, hn0, ?_⟩
  have : w = cs.simple i * (cs.simple i * w) := (cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left i).symm
  rw [this, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple, reflection_apply,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hn, root_coroot_self P hA, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.add_rho_regular
statement:
lemma add_rho_regular {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ) :
    ∀ j, ∃ n : ℕ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = n + 1
proof:
:= fun j ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ j
  exact ⟨n, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq
statement:
theorem exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq {Λ : Dual K H} (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} (hw : ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsLeftDescent w i) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ (P.weylDot hA w Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weylDot_add_rho]
  exact P.exists_apply_coroot_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent hA (P.add_rho_regular hΛ) hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.reflectionHom_hwv
statement:
lemma reflectionHom_hwv :
    reflectionHom hA hn0 hn (hwv P _) =
      (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P i) ^ n) (hwv P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectionHom, ← homEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.reflectionHom_ne_zero
statement: lemma reflectionHom_ne_zero : reflectionHom hA hn0 hn ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  toEnd_f_pow_hwv_ne_zero P Λ i n (by rw [← reflectionHom_hwv hA hn0 hn, h,
    _root_.zero_apply])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.reflectionHom_injective
statement: lemma reflectionHom_injective : Function.Injective (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn)
proof:
:=
  injective_of_ne_zero P (reflectionHom_ne_zero hA hn0 hn)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_toEnd_f_pow_quotient_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_toEnd_f_pow_quotient_eq_zero (x : VermaModule P Λ ⧸ (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).range) :
    ∃ N, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra _ (f P i) ^ N) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  set q := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).range
  refine exists_toEnd_pow_eq_zero_of_lieSpan (exists_ad_f_pow_eq_zero P hA i)
    (lieSpan_map_hwv_eq_top q (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _)) ?_ x
  rintro _ rfl
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [toEnd_pow_apply_map, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero',
    ← reflectionHom_hwv hA hn0 hn]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_primitiveVectors_of_injective
statement:
lemma mem_primitiveVectors_of_injective {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra W] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra W]
    (g : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (hg : Function.Injective g) {ν : Dual K H} {z : V}
    (hz : g z ∈ primitiveVectors P W ν) : z ∈ primitiveVectors P V ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_primitiveVectors] at hz ⊢
  refine ⟨fun a ↦ hg ?_, fun j ↦ hg ?_⟩
  · rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, hz.1 a, map_smul]
  · rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie, hz.2 j, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eq_zero_of_lie_e_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_lie_e_eq_zero {v : V} {ν : Dual K H} (hv : v ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpace P V ν)
    (he : ⁅e P i, v⁆ = 0) (hν : ∀ m : ℕ, ν (P.coroot i) ≠ m)
    (hf : ∃ N, (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V (f P i) ^ N) v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hv0
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsSl2Triple.HasPrimitiveVectorWith.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero
    (t := isSl2Triple P hA i) ⟨hv0, hv (P.coroot i), he⟩ hf
  exact hν m hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_range_reflectionHom
statement:
theorem mem_range_reflectionHom {ν : Dual K H} (hν : ∀ m : ℕ, ν (P.coroot i) ≠ m)
    {y : VermaModule P Λ} (hy : y ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) ν) :
    y ∈ (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero']
  rw [mem_primitiveVectors] at hy
  refine eq_zero_of_lie_e_eq_zero hA
    (map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _) hy.1) ?_ hν
    (exists_toEnd_f_pow_quotient_eq_zero hA hn0 hn _)
  rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'_apply, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, hy.2 i, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_reflectionHom_comp_eq
statement:
theorem exists_reflectionHom_comp_eq {ν : Dual K H} (hν : ∀ m : ℕ, ν (P.coroot i) ≠ m)
    (φ : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) :
    ∃ ψ, (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).comp ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_range_reflectionHom hν (map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P φ)
  have hzp : z ∈ primitiveVectors P _ ν :=
    mem_primitiveVectors_of_injective _ (reflectionHom_injective hA hn0 hn)
      (by rw [hz]; exact map_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P φ)
  refine ⟨(homEquiv P _ ν).symm ⟨z, hzp⟩, hom_ext P ν ?_⟩
  rw [LieModuleHom.comp_apply, ← homEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hz

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.bijective_reflectionHom_comp
statement:
theorem bijective_reflectionHom_comp {ν : Dual K H} (hν : ∀ m : ℕ, ν (P.coroot i) ≠ m) :
    Function.Bijective fun ψ : VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) ↦
      (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).comp ψ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun m ↦
      reflectionHom_injective hA hn0 hn (LieModuleHom.congr_fun h m),
    fun φ ↦ exists_reflectionHom_comp_eq hν φ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_reflection_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_reflection_eq {ν : Dual K H} (hν : ∀ m : ℕ, ν (P.coroot i) ≠ m) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)) =
      finrank K (VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  let e : (VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
        VermaModule P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)) ≃ₗ[K]
      (VermaModule P ν →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ) :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective
      { toFun := fun ψ ↦ (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).comp ψ
        map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
        map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ LieModuleHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp }
      (bijective_reflectionHom_comp hν)
  exact e.finrank_eq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_comp_reflectionHom_eq
statement:
theorem exists_comp_reflectionHom_eq {μ μ' : Dual K H} {n n' : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (μ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n) (hn0' : 0 < n') (hn' : (μ' + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n')
    {φ : VermaModule P μ' →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P μ} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ψ, ψ ≠ 0 ∧ (reflectionHom hA hn0 hn).comp ψ = φ.comp (reflectionHom hA hn0' hn')
proof:
:= by
  have hν : ∀ m : ℕ, (P.reflection hA i (μ' + P.rho) - P.rho) (P.coroot i) ≠ m := by
    intro m hm
    rw [P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn', LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      root_coroot_self P hA, nsmul_eq_mul] at hm
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, rho_coroot] at hn'
    have : ((m + 2 * n' + 1 : ℕ) : K) = n' := by push_cast; linear_combination hn' - hm
    have := Nat.cast_injective this
    omega
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_reflectionHom_comp_eq (hA := hA) (hn0 := hn0) (hn := hn) hν
    (φ.comp (reflectionHom hA hn0' hn'))
  refine ⟨ψ, fun h0 ↦ ?_, hψ⟩
  have := LieModuleHom.congr_fun hψ (hwv P _)
  rw [h0, LieModuleHom.comp_apply, _root_.zero_apply, map_zero, LieModuleHom.comp_apply]
    at this
  exact reflectionHom_ne_zero hA hn0' hn' (by
    rw [eq_zero_iff]
    exact injective_of_ne_zero P hφ (by rw [← this, map_zero]))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_simple_mul
statement:
theorem exists_injective_simple_mul {w : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι}
    (hw : ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsLeftDescent w i) :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i * w) Λ) →ₗ⁅K,
      P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ), Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ := P.exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq hA hΛ hw
  rw [weylDot_simple_mul]
  exact ⟨reflectionHom hA hn0 hn, reflectionHom_injective hA hn0 hn⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_hom_simple_mul
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_simple_mul {w : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι}
    (hw : ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsLeftDescent w i) :
    finrank K (VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i * w) Λ) →ₗ⁅K,
      P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ := P.exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq hA hΛ hw
  rw [weylDot_simple_mul]
  exact finrank_hom_reflection P hA hn0 hn

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_of_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem exists_injective_of_bruhatLE {w w' : P.weylGroup hA}
    (h : (P.coxeterSystem hA).BruhatLE w w') :
    ∃ φ : VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w' Λ) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P (P.weylDot hA w Λ), Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  induction hl : cs.length w' using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w w' with
  | _ l ih =>
  subst hl
  by_cases hw'1 : w' = 1
  · subst hw'1
    have : w = 1 := h.eq_of_length_le (by simp)
    subst this
    exact ⟨LieModuleHom.id, Function.injective_id⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw'1
  have hil := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hi
  have hsw' : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.simple i * w') i := by
    rwa [← cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul]
  by_cases hw : cs.IsLeftDescent w i
  · have hsw : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.simple i * w) i := by
      rwa [← cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul]
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := ih _ (by omega) ((simple_mul_bruhatLE_simple_mul_iff hw hi).mpr h) rfl
    obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ := P.exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq hA hΛ hsw
    obtain ⟨n', hn0', hn'⟩ := P.exists_weylDot_add_rho_coroot_eq hA hΛ hsw'
    have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hwv_ne_zero P _ (hφ (by rw [h0, map_zero,
      _root_.zero_apply]))
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ0, -⟩ := exists_comp_reflectionHom_eq hA hn0 hn hn0' hn' hφ0
    have e₁ : P.weylDot hA w Λ =
        P.reflection hA i (P.weylDot hA (cs.simple i * w) Λ + P.rho) - P.rho := by
      rw [← weylDot_simple_mul, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
    have e₂ : P.weylDot hA w' Λ =
        P.reflection hA i (P.weylDot hA (cs.simple i * w') Λ + P.rho) - P.rho := by
      rw [← weylDot_simple_mul, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
    rw [e₁, e₂]
    exact ⟨ψ, injective_of_ne_zero P hψ0⟩
  · have h' := (h.lifting_left hi hw).1
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := ih _ (by omega) h' rfl
    have := exists_injective_simple_mul hA hΛ hsw'
    rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at this
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := this
    exact ⟨φ.comp ψ, hφ.comp hψ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegDerivAction_intertwines
statement:
lemma nNegDerivAction_intertwines (f : V →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ W) (a : H) :
    ((nNegDerivAction P W).φ a).comp f.toLinearMap =
      f.toLinearMap.comp ((nNegDerivAction P V).φ a)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  exact (f.map_lie (h P a) v).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegHomologyConnecting_equivariant
statement:
theorem nNegHomologyConnecting_equivariant (a : H) (k : ℕ) :
    ((nNegDerivAction P V).homologyEnd a k).comp
        (homologyConnecting (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
          (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k) =
      (homologyConnecting (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
        (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k).comp
          ((nNegDerivAction P U).homologyEnd a (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  homologyConnecting_equivariant (nNegDerivAction P V) (nNegDerivAction P W)
    (nNegDerivAction P U) _ _ hfg hf hg rfl rfl
    (nNegDerivAction_intertwines P f) (nNegDerivAction_intertwines P g) a k

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_nNegHomologyWeightSpace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nNegHomologyWeightSpace_iff
    (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν = ⊤) (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H)
    (z : homology K (nNeg P) V k) :
    z.1 ∈ (nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace k μ ↔
      ∀ a, (nNegDerivAction P V).homologyEnd a k z = μ a • z
proof:
:= by
  rw [(nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace_eq (iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNNeg P) hV]
  constructor
  · intro hz a
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (nNegDerivAction P V).θQ k a z.1 = μ a • z.1
    exact hz.2 a
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨z.2, fun a ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (hz a)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegHomologyConnecting_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem nNegHomologyConnecting_mem_weightSpace
    (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν = ⊤) (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H)
    (z : homology K (nNeg P) U (k + 1))
    (hz : z.1 ∈ (nNegDerivAction P U).homologyWeightSpace (k + 1) μ) :
    (homologyConnecting (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
      (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k z).1 ∈
        (nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace k μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_nNegHomologyWeightSpace_iff P hV k μ _).mpr
  intro a
  have he := LinearMap.congr_fun (nNegHomologyConnecting_equivariant P f g hfg hf hg a k) z
  have hz' : (nNegDerivAction P U).homologyEnd a (k + 1) z = μ a • z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (nNegDerivAction P U).θQ (k + 1) a z.1 = μ a • z.1
    exact (nNegDerivAction P U).homologyWeightSpace_le_quotWeightSpace (k + 1) μ hz a
  change (nNegDerivAction P V).homologyEnd a k
      (homologyConnecting (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
        (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k z) =
    homologyConnecting (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
      (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k
        ((nNegDerivAction P U).homologyEnd a (k + 1) z) at he
  exact he.trans ((congrArg
    (homologyConnecting (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
      (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k) hz').trans (map_smul _ _ _))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finite_nNegProj_lie
statement:
lemma finite_nNegProj_lie (y : nNeg P) :
    {α | α ∈ P.posWeights ∧ ∃ e ∈ rootSpace P α,
      nNegProj P ⁅e, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ ≠ 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  induction (nNegBasis P).mem_span y using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine (finite_window x.root).subset fun α ⟨hα, e, he, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hα, ?_⟩
    refine sub_mem_negWeights_iff.mp (by_contra fun h ↦ hne ?_)
    exact nNegProj_eq_zero_of_mem_rootSpace (lie_mem_rootSpace_sub he (nNegBasis_mem P x)) h
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' =>
    refine (hy.union hy').subset fun α ⟨hα, e, he, hne⟩ ↦ ?_
    rw [Submodule.coe_add, lie_add, map_add] at hne
    by_cases h : nNegProj P ⁅e, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ = 0
    · rw [h, zero_add] at hne; exact Or.inr ⟨hα, e, he, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hα, e, he, h⟩
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    refine hy.subset fun α ⟨hα, e, he, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hα, e, he, fun h ↦ hne ?_⟩
    rw [Submodule.coe_smul, lie_smul, map_smul, h, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_casimirSum_nNegProj
statement:
lemma finite_casimirSum_nNegProj {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (y : nNeg P)
    (Φ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra → P.KacMoodyAlgebra → M) (hΦ : ∀ f x, nNegProj P x = 0 → Φ f x = 0) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun α ↦
      hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ Φ f ⁅e, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆) α).Finite
proof:
:=
  (finite_nNegProj_lie y).subset fun α ⟨hα, hne⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨f, -, e, he, hne⟩ := hB.exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hne
    exact ⟨hα, e, he, fun h ↦ hne (hΦ f _ h)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_casimirSum_lie_apply
statement:
lemma finite_casimirSum_lie_apply {M V : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] (hV : IsPosFinite P V)
    (v : V) (Φ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra → V → M) (hΦ : ∀ f, Φ f 0 = 0) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun α ↦
      hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ Φ f ⁅e, v⁆) α).Finite
proof:
:=
  (hV v).subset fun α ⟨hα, hne⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨f, -, e, he, hne⟩ := hB.exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hne
    exact ⟨hα, e, he, fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h, hΦ])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.wedgeProj_apply
statement:
lemma wedgeProj_apply (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    wedgeProj V x c = wedge K (nNeg P) V (nNegProj P x) c
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.wedgeProj_eq_zero
statement: lemma wedgeProj_eq_zero {x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hx : nNegProj P x = 0) : wedgeProj V x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hx, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantGTerm_add_left
statement:
lemma kostantGTerm_add_left (α : Dual K H) (y y' : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantGTerm V α (y + y') c = hB.kostantGTerm V α y c + hB.kostantGTerm V α y' c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kostantGTerm, casimirSum_def, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, lie_add, map_add,
    LinearMap.add_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantGTerm_smul_left
statement:
lemma kostantGTerm_smul_left (α : Dual K H) (r : K) (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantGTerm V α (r • y) c = r • hB.kostantGTerm V α y c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kostantGTerm, casimirSum_def, Finset.smul_sum, lie_smul, map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantGTerm_add_right
statement:
lemma kostantGTerm_add_right (α : Dual K H) (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (c c' : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantGTerm V α y (c + c') = hB.kostantGTerm V α y c + hB.kostantGTerm V α y c'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kostantGTerm, casimirSum_def, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, map_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantGTerm_smul_right
statement:
lemma kostantGTerm_smul_right (α : Dual K H) (r : K) (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantGTerm V α y (r • c) = r • hB.kostantGTerm V α y c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kostantGTerm, casimirSum_def, Finset.smul_sum, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_kostantGTerm
statement:
lemma finite_kostantGTerm (y : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun α ↦ hB.kostantGTerm V α y c).Finite
proof:
:=
  hB.finite_casimirSum_nNegProj y (fun f x ↦ wedgeProj V f (wedgeProj V x c))
    fun f x hx ↦ by rw [wedgeProj_eq_zero V hx]; simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantG_apply
statement:
lemma kostantG_apply (y : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantG V y c = (2 : K)⁻¹ • ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.kostantGTerm V α y c
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantG_wedge
statement:
lemma kostantG_wedge (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantG V y (wedge K (nNeg P) V z c) = wedge K (nNeg P) V z (hB.kostantG V y c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kostantG_apply, kostantG_apply, map_smul]
  rw [map_finsum_mem_of_finite (wedge K (nNeg P) V z) (hB.finite_kostantGTerm V y c)]
  refine congrArg ((2 : K)⁻¹ • ·) (finsum_mem_congr rfl fun α _ ↦ ?_)
  simp only [kostantGTerm, casimirSum_def, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [wedgeProj_apply]
  exact wedge_wedge_wedge_comm _ _ z c

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantG_comp_wedge
statement:
lemma kostantG_comp_wedge (y z : nNeg P) :
    hB.kostantG V y ∘ₗ wedge K (nNeg P) V z = wedge K (nNeg P) V z ∘ₗ hB.kostantG V y
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext (hB.kostantG_wedge V y z)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finsum_mem_mem_submodule
statement:
lemma finsum_mem_mem_submodule {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] (p : Submodule K N)
    (s : Set (Dual K H)) (F : Dual K H → N) (h : ∀ α ∈ s, F α ∈ p) : ∑ᶠ α ∈ s, F α ∈ p
proof:
:=
  finsum_mem_induction (· ∈ p) (zero_mem _) (fun _ _ ↦ add_mem) h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantG_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma kostantG_mem_chainsIn (y : nNeg P) {k : ℕ} {c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V}
    (hc : c ∈ chainsIn K (nNeg P) V k) : hB.kostantG V y c ∈ chainsIn K (nNeg P) V (k + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kostantG_apply]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (finsum_mem_mem_submodule _ _ _ fun α _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [kostantGTerm, casimirSum_def]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ wedge_mem_chainsIn _ (wedge_mem_chainsIn _ hc)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_coDiffTerm
statement:
lemma finite_coDiffTerm (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (v : V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun α ↦ hB.coDiffTerm V α v).Finite
proof:
:=
  hB.finite_casimirSum_lie_apply hV v (fun f w ↦ wedgeProj V f (1 ⊗ₜ w)) fun f ↦ by simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.coDiffTerm_add
statement:
lemma coDiffTerm_add (α : Dual K H) (v w : V) :
    hB.coDiffTerm V α (v + w) = hB.coDiffTerm V α v + hB.coDiffTerm V α w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coDiffTerm, casimirSum_def, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, lie_add, tmul_add, map_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.coDiffTerm_smul
statement:
lemma coDiffTerm_smul (α : Dual K H) (r : K) (v : V) :
    hB.coDiffTerm V α (r • v) = r • hB.coDiffTerm V α v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coDiffTerm, casimirSum_def, Finset.smul_sum, lie_smul, tmul_smul, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantCoDiff₀_apply
statement:
lemma kostantCoDiff₀_apply (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (v : V) :
    hB.kostantCoDiff₀ V hV v = -∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.coDiffTerm V α v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantCoDiff₀_mem_chainsIn
statement:
lemma kostantCoDiff₀_mem_chainsIn (hV : IsPosFinite P V) (v : V) :
    hB.kostantCoDiff₀ V hV v ∈ chainsIn K (nNeg P) V 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [kostantCoDiff₀_apply]
  refine neg_mem (finsum_mem_mem_submodule _ _ _ fun α _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [coDiffTerm, casimirSum_def]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ wedge_mem_chainsIn _ (one_tmul_mem_chainsIn _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantCoDiff_mem_chainsIn
proof:
:=
  coDiff_mem_chainsIn _ _ _ (hB.kostantCoDiff₀_mem_chainsIn V hV)
    (fun y _ _ hc ↦ hB.kostantG_mem_chainsIn V y hc) hc

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegHomologyConnecting_mem_weightSpace_iff
statement:
theorem nNegHomologyConnecting_mem_weightSpace_iff
    (hU : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap U (h P) ν = ⊤) (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H)
    [Subsingleton (homology K (nNeg P) W (k + 1))]
    (z : homology K (nNeg P) U (k + 1)) :
    (homologyConnecting (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
      (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k z).1 ∈
        (nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace k μ ↔
      z.1 ∈ (nNegDerivAction P U).homologyWeightSpace (k + 1) μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    apply (mem_nNegHomologyWeightSpace_iff P hU (k + 1) μ z).mpr
    intro a
    apply homologyConnecting_injective (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P f)
      (BGGMinimality.restrictNNeg P g) hfg hf hg k
    have he := LinearMap.congr_fun (nNegHomologyConnecting_equivariant P f g hfg hf hg a k) z
    have hz' := (mem_nNegHomologyWeightSpace_iff P hV k μ _).mp hz a
    exact he.symm.trans (hz'.trans (map_smul _ _ _).symm)
  · exact nNegHomologyConnecting_mem_weightSpace P f g hfg hf hg hV k μ z

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nPosEquivNNeg_D
statement:
lemma nPosEquivNNeg_D (a : H) (x : nPos P) :
    nPosEquivNNeg P ((nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).D a x) =
      -(nNegDerivAction P V).D a (nPosEquivNNeg P x)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by
    change chevalleyInvolution P ⁅h P a, (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ =
      -⁅h P a, chevalleyInvolution P (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆
    rw [LieHom.map_lie, chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_lie])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.omegaTwist_symm_φ
statement:
lemma omegaTwist_symm_φ (a : H) (m : OmegaTwist P V) :
    (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm ((nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).φ a m) =
      -(nNegDerivAction P V).φ a ((OmegaTwist.of P V).symm m)
proof:
:= by
  change ⁅chevalleyInvolution P (h P a), (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm m⁆ =
    -⁅h P a, (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm m⁆
  rw [chevalleyInvolution_h, neg_lie]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.omegaTwist_symm_lie
statement:
lemma omegaTwist_symm_lie (x : nPos P) (m : OmegaTwist P V) :
    (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm ⁅x, m⁆ = ⁅nPosEquivNNeg P x, (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm m⁆
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.finiteDimensional_nPosChains_omegaTwist
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.finiteDimensional_nPosChains_omegaTwist (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    FiniteDimensional K ↥(chainsIn K (nPos P) (OmegaTwist P V) k ⊓
      (nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).chainWeightSpace ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hC := DerivAction.map_chainEquiv_chainsIn_inf (ρ := nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V))
    (ρ' := nNegDerivAction P V) (nPosEquivNNeg P) (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm
    (nPosEquivNNeg_D P V) (omegaTwist_symm_φ P V) k ν
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_nNegChains k (-ν)
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (((DerivAction.chainEquiv (nPosEquivNNeg P)
    (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm).submoduleMap _).trans (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hC)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_nPosHomology_omegaTwist
statement:
theorem finrank_nPosHomology_omegaTwist (k : ℕ) (ν : Dual K H) :
    finrank K ((nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).homologyWeightSpace k ν) =
      finrank K ((nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace k (-ν))
proof:
:= by
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_nNegChains k (-ν)
  have : FiniteDimensional K
      ↥(cycles K (nNeg P) V k ⊓ (nNegDerivAction P V).chainWeightSpace (-ν)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left)
  exact DerivAction.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_of_neg (nPosEquivNNeg P) (OmegaTwist.of P V).symm
    (omegaTwist_symm_lie P V) (nPosEquivNNeg_D P V) (omegaTwist_symm_φ P V) k ν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finrank_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual
statement:
theorem finrank_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual (μ : Dual K H) (k : ℕ) :
    finrank K (nPosCohomology P (restrictedDual P V) μ k) =
      finrank K ((nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace k μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nPosCohomology, (nPosDerivAction P (OmegaTwist P V)).finrank_weightComplex_homology
    (nPosDerivAction P (restrictedDual P V)) (iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNPos P)
    (iSup_weightSpaceOf_omegaTwist P hV.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun a φ m ↦ dualPairing_lie P (h P a) φ m) (dualPairing_injective P)
    (fun _ _ hψ ↦ mem_range_dualPairing P hψ)
    (fun x φ m ↦ dualPairing_lie P (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) φ m)
    (fun j ↦ hV.finiteDimensional_nPosChains_omegaTwist j (-μ)) k,
    finrank_nPosHomology_omegaTwist hV, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_nPosCohomology_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_nPosCohomology_eq (μ : Dual K H) (k : ℕ) :
    finrank K (nPosCohomology P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ k) =
      finrank K ((nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(nPosCohomologyCongr P (equivRestrictedDual P Λ) μ k).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  exact finrank_nPosCohomology_restrictedDual (isCategoryO P Λ) μ k

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_nPosCohomology_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_nPosCohomology_eq_one (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    finrank K (nPosCohomology P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)
      ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) ((P.coxeterSystem hA).length w)) = 1
proof:
:=
  (finrank_nPosCohomology_eq _ _).trans (finrank_homologyWeightSpace_eq_one hA hS hΛ w)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_nPosCohomology_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_nPosCohomology_eq_zero {k : ℕ} {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA, (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k →
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho ≠ μ) :
    finrank K (nPosCohomology P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_nPosCohomology_eq]
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwμ⟩ := (homologyWeightSpace_ne_bot_iff hA hS hΛ k μ).mp fun hbot ↦
    hne (by rw [hbot, finrank_bot])
  exact h w hw hwμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finrank_ext_verma_simple
statement:
lemma finrank_ext_verma_simple (μ : Dual K H) (k : ℕ) :
    finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (simple P Λ) k) =
      finrank K (nPosCohomology P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) μ k)
proof:
:=
  (nonempty_ext_verma_mk_linearEquiv_nPosCohomology μ _ _ _ k).some.finrank_eq

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finrank_ext_verma_simple_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_ext_verma_simple_eq_one
    (w : P.weylGroup (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan) :
    finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho))
      (simple P Λ) ((P.coxeterSystem (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan).length w))
      = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_ext_verma_simple]
  exact IrreducibleModule.finrank_nPosCohomology_eq_one _
    (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isSymmetrizable hΛ w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.CategoryO.finrank_ext_verma_simple_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_ext_verma_simple_eq_zero {k : ℕ} {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : ∀ w : P.weylGroup (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan,
      (P.coxeterSystem (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isGeneralizedCartan).length w = k →
        (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho ≠ μ) :
    finrank K (Abelian.Ext.{u} (verma P μ) (simple P Λ) k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_ext_verma_simple]
  exact IrreducibleModule.finrank_nPosCohomology_eq_zero _
    (Fact.out : A.IsFiniteCartan).isSymmetrizable hΛ h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_of_homologyWeightSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem IsCategoryO.exists_of_homologyWeightSpace_ne_bot {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [LieRingModule P.KacMoodyAlgebra V] [LieModule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {k : ℕ} {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : (nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace k μ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ S : Finset (NegRootIndex P), S.card = k ∧ weightSpace P V (μ + finsetWt P S) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := hV.finiteDimensional_nNegChains k μ
  have h2 : finrank K
      ↥(chainsIn K (nNeg P) V k ⊓ (nNegDerivAction P V).chainWeightSpace μ) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot h
    obtain ⟨c, ⟨hcZ, hcμ⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun hc ↦ hx0 (by rw [hc, map_zero])
    rw [Ne, Submodule.finrank_eq_zero]
    exact fun hbot ↦ hc0 ((Submodule.mem_bot K).mp (hbot ▸ ⟨hcZ.1, hcμ⟩))
  rw [hV.finrank_nNegChains, Finset.card_ne_zero] at h2
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h2
  obtain ⟨ht1, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht
  simp only [IsCategoryO.chainIndexFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.mem_image] at ht1
  obtain ⟨S, hS, j, -, rfl⟩ := ht1
  exact ⟨S, rfl, hS⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_hsum_homologyEulerFamily
statement:
theorem exp_rho_mul_hsum_homologyEulerFamily :
    exp P ℤ P.rho * (isCategoryO P Λ).homologyEulerFamily.hsum =
      weylAltSum P hA (isDominantIntegral_add_rho hΛ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCategoryO.hsum_homologyEulerFamily, ← mul_assoc,
    exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA hS hΛ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_eq
statement:
lemma coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_eq (μ : Dual K H) :
    (denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character).coeffAt μ =
      (exp P ℤ P.rho * denominator P * (isCategoryO P Λ).character).coeffAt (μ + P.rho)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, coeff_exp_mul, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_homology_apply
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_homology_apply (w : P.weylGroup hA) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : (isCategoryO P Λ).maxDeg ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) ≤ N) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k *
        finrank K ((nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k
          ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)) =
      (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCategoryO.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_nNegHomology _ _ hN,
    coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_eq, sub_add_cancel,
    coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character_apply hA hS hΛ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_homology_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCategoryO.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_nNegHomology _ _ hN,
    coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_eq,
    coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character_eq_zero hA hS hΛ hμ]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_homologyWeightSpace_eq_one_of_weights
statement:
theorem finrank_homologyWeightSpace_eq_one_of_weights
    (hW : ∀ (k : ℕ) (μ : Dual K H),
      (nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k μ ≠ ⊥ →
        ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k ∧
          (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho = μ)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    finrank K ((nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace
      ((P.coxeterSystem hA).length w) ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n + 1 := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
    exact ⟨n, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]⟩
  
  have hzero : ∀ k ≠ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w,
      finrank K ((nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k
        ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra h0
    obtain ⟨w', hw'k, hw'⟩ := hW k _ fun hbot ↦ h0 (by rw [hbot, finrank_bot])
    have : w' = w := P.apply_injective_of_regular hA hreg (sub_left_injective hw')
    exact hk (by rw [← hw'k, this])
  have hsum := sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_homology_apply hA hS hΛ w
    (N := max ((isCategoryO P Λ).maxDeg ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho))
      ((P.coxeterSystem hA).length w)) (le_max_left _ _)
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ((P.coxeterSystem hA).length w)
    (fun k _ hk ↦ by rw [hzero k hk, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero])
    (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_max_right _ _))) h)] at hsum
  have hne : ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)
  exact_mod_cast (mul_right_inj' hne).mp (hsum.trans (mul_one _).symm)

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.cocycleMap_apply
statement:
lemma cocycleMap_apply (G : L →ₗ[R] Module.End R (ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M)) (y : L)
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M) (z : L) :
    cocycleMap G y c z = G ⁅y, z⁆ c - (lieAction R L M y (G z c) - G z (lieAction R L M y c)) +
      (lieAction R L M z (G y c) - G y (lieAction R L M z c))
proof: := rfl

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.neg_wedge_add_wedge_eq
statement:
lemma neg_wedge_add_wedge_eq (θ' : Module.End R (ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M)) (D : L →ₗ[R] L)
    (s : R) (y z : L) (c : ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M)
    (hθ' : θ' (wedge R L M z c) = wedge R L M (D z) c + wedge R L M z (θ' c)) :
    -wedge R L M z ((wedge R L M y ∘ₗ (θ' + s • LinearMap.id)) c) +
        wedge R L M y (wedge R L M (D z) c) =
      (wedge R L M y ∘ₗ (θ' + s • LinearMap.id)) (wedge R L M z c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    hθ', map_add, map_smul, wedge_wedge_comm z y, smul_neg, neg_add, neg_neg]
  abel

name: LieModule.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_smul_add_eq
statement:
lemma wedge_smul_add_eq (θ' : Module.End R (ExteriorAlgebra R L ⊗[R] M)) (s t u : R) (y : L)
