    {w : P.weylGroup hA | (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((List.finite_length_eq ι k).image (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd).subset ?_
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := (P.coxeterSystem hA).exists_isReduced w
  exact ⟨ω, hω.eq.symm.trans hw, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.injective_apply_add_rho_sub_rho
statement:
theorem injective_apply_add_rho_sub_rho :
    Function.Injective fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot i) = n + 1 := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ i
    exact ⟨n, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]⟩
  exact fun w w' h ↦ P.apply_injective_of_regular hA hreg (sub_left_injective h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_homology_eq_card
statement:
theorem finrank_homology_eq_card {T : Type*} (k : ℕ) (μ : T → Dual K H)
    (hμ : Function.Injective μ)
    (hne : ∀ ν, (nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k ν ≠ ⊥ ↔
      ∃ t, μ t = ν)
    (h1 : ∀ t, finrank K ((nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k
      (μ t)) = 1) :
    finrank K (homology K (nNeg P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ) k) = Nat.card T
proof:
:= by
  choose v hv hv0 using fun t ↦ Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot ((hne (μ t)).mpr ⟨t, rfl⟩)
  have hli := (iSupIndep.comp
    ((nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).iSupIndep_homologyWeightSpace k)
    hμ).linearIndependent _ hv hv0
  have hle (t : T) : (nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k (μ t) ≤
      K ∙ v t := fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' (⟨v t, hv t⟩ : ↥(_ : Submodule K _))
      (fun h ↦ hv0 t (congrArg Subtype.val h))).mp (h1 t) ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨c, congrArg Subtype.val hc⟩
  have hsup : homology K (nNeg P) (IrreducibleModule P Λ) k = Submodule.span K (Set.range v) := by
    rw [← iSup_nNegHomologyWeightSpace P _ (isCategoryO P Λ).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top k,
      Submodule.span_range_eq_iSup]
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun ν ↦ ?_) (iSup_le fun t ↦ ?_)
    · by_cases h : (nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k ν = ⊥
      · exact h.le.trans bot_le
      · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (hne ν).mp h
        exact (hle t).trans (le_iSup (fun t ↦ K ∙ v t) t)
    · exact ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr (hv t)).trans (le_iSup_of_le _ le_rfl)
  rw [hsup, Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (Module.Basis.span hli)]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_homology
proof:
:= by
  refine finrank_homology_eq_card k
    (fun w ↦ ((w.1 : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho)
    ((injective_apply_add_rho_sub_rho hA hΛ).comp Subtype.val_injective) (fun ν ↦ ?_)
    (fun w ↦ ?_)
  · rw [homologyWeightSpace_ne_bot_iff hA hS hΛ k ν]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, h⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, h⟩, fun ⟨w, h⟩ ↦ ⟨w.1, w.2, h⟩⟩
  · have h := finrank_homologyWeightSpace_eq_one hA hS hΛ w.1
    rwa [w.2] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.half_combination
statement:
private lemma half_combination {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] (w w' a b c d : M)
    (hw : w' = w) :
    (2 : K)⁻¹ • ((w + a - d) + (w' - b + c)) - (2 : K)⁻¹ • (a + c) + (2 : K)⁻¹ • (b + d) =
      w
proof:
:= by
  subst hw
  module

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_cocycleTermA
statement:
lemma finite_cocycleTermA (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support (hB.cocycleTermA V y z c)).Finite
proof:
:=
  hB.finite_casimirSum_nNegProj z (fun f x ↦ wedge K (nNeg P) V ⁅y, nNegProj P f⁆
    (wedgeProj V x c)) fun f x hx ↦ by simp [hx]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_cocycleTermB
statement:
lemma finite_cocycleTermB (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support (hB.cocycleTermB V y z c)).Finite
proof:
:=
  hB.finite_casimirSum_nNegProj z (fun f x ↦ wedgeProj V f
    (wedge K (nNeg P) V ⁅y, nNegProj P x⁆ c)) fun f x hx ↦ by simp [hx]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lieAction_kostantGTerm_sub
statement:
lemma lieAction_kostantGTerm_sub (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V)
    (α : Dual K H) :
    lieAction K (nNeg P) V y (hB.kostantGTerm V α z c) -
        hB.kostantGTerm V α z (lieAction K (nNeg P) V y c) =
      hB.cocycleTermA V y z c α + hB.cocycleTermB V y z c α
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kostantGTerm, cocycleTermA, cocycleTermB, casimirSum_def, map_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, wedgeProj_apply, lieAction_wedge_wedge]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ add_sub_cancel_right _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lieAction_kostantG_sub
statement:
lemma lieAction_kostantG_sub (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    lieAction K (nNeg P) V y (hB.kostantG V z c) -
        hB.kostantG V z (lieAction K (nNeg P) V y c) =
      (2 : K)⁻¹ • (∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermA V y z c α +
        ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermB V y z c α)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := map_finsum_mem_of_finite (lieAction K (nNeg P) V y)
    (hB.finite_kostantGTerm V z c)
  have h2 := finsum_mem_sub_distrib'
    (F := fun α ↦ lieAction K (nNeg P) V y (hB.kostantGTerm V α z c))
    ((hB.finite_kostantGTerm V z c).subset fun α ⟨hα, hne⟩ ↦
      ⟨hα, fun h ↦ hne (by simp only [h, map_zero])⟩)
    (hB.finite_kostantGTerm V z (lieAction K (nNeg P) V y c))
  have h3 := finsum_mem_add_distrib' (hB.finite_cocycleTermA V y z c)
    (hB.finite_cocycleTermB V y z c)
  simp only [kostantG_apply, map_smul, h1]
  refine (smul_sub _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg _ (h2.symm.trans ((finsum_mem_congr rfl
    fun α _ ↦ hB.lieAction_kostantGTerm_sub V y z c α).trans h3)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantGTerm_lie
statement:
lemma kostantGTerm_lie (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) (α : Dual K H) :
    hB.kostantGTerm V α (⁅y, z⁆ : nNeg P) c =
      hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c α + hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c α
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kostantGTerm, cocycleTermLeft, cocycleTermRight, casimirSum_def,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, bilinComp_apply, wedgeLieRight, wedgeLieLeft, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket, leibniz_lie _ (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), map_add,
    LinearMap.add_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_cocycleTermLeft
statement:
lemma finite_cocycleTermLeft {β γ : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support (hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (finite_window (β + γ)).subset fun α ⟨hα, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hα, ?_⟩
  refine sub_mem_negWeights_iff.mp (by_contra fun hn ↦ hne ?_)
  rw [cocycleTermLeft, casimirSum_def]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hx := lie_mem_rootSpace_sub (lie_mem_rootSpace_sub (rootSpaceBasis_mem P α k) hy) hz
  rw [sub_sub] at hx
  simp only [bilinComp_apply, wedgeLieRight, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, wedgeProj_apply,
    nNegProj_eq_zero_of_mem_rootSpace hx hn, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finite_cocycleTermRight
statement:
lemma finite_cocycleTermRight {β γ : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support (hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (finite_window (β + γ)).subset fun α ⟨hα, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hα, ?_⟩
  refine sub_mem_negWeights_iff.mp (by_contra fun hn ↦ hne ?_)
  rw [cocycleTermRight, casimirSum_def]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hx := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) hy
    (lie_mem_rootSpace_sub (rootSpaceBasis_mem P α k) hz)
  rw [show -β + (α - γ) = α - (β + γ) by abel] at hx
  simp only [bilinComp_apply, wedgeLieLeft, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, wedgeProj_apply,
    nNegProj_eq_zero_of_mem_rootSpace hx hn, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantG_lie
statement:
lemma kostantG_lie {β γ : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantG V ⁅y, z⁆ c = (2 : K)⁻¹ • (∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c α +
      ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kostantG_apply]
  exact congrArg _ ((finsum_mem_congr rfl fun α _ ↦ hB.kostantGTerm_lie V y z c α).trans
    (finsum_mem_add_distrib' (hB.finite_cocycleTermLeft V y z hy hz c)
      (hB.finite_cocycleTermRight V y z hy hz c)))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.wedgeProj_lie_coe
statement:
lemma wedgeProj_lie_coe (u w : nNeg P) :
    wedgeProj V ⁅(u : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), (w : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ = wedge K (nNeg P) V ⁅u, w⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket, nNegProj_coe]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.wedgeProj_lie_coe_swap
statement:
lemma wedgeProj_lie_coe_swap (u w : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    wedgeProj V ⁅(u : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), (w : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ c =
      -wedge K (nNeg P) V ⁅w, u⁆ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeProj_lie_coe, ← lie_skew, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.wedgeProj_lie_of_mem
statement:
lemma wedgeProj_lie_of_mem (y : nNeg P) {f : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hf : f ∈ nNeg P)
    (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    wedgeProj V ⁅f, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ c = -wedge K (nNeg P) V ⁅y, nNegProj P f⁆ c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, lie_nNegProj_of_mem y hf, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply,
    neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_eq_neg
statement:
lemma casimirSum_eq_neg {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    {Φ Ψ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra → P.KacMoodyAlgebra → M} {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : ∀ f ∈ rootSpace P (-μ), ∀ e, Φ f e = -Ψ f e) :
    hB.casimirSum Φ μ = -hB.casimirSum Ψ μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [casimirSum_def, casimirSum_def, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ h _ (hB.dualBasis_mem μ k) _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_lie_skew
statement:
lemma casimirSum_lie_skew {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    (Ψ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra →ₗ[K] P.KacMoodyAlgebra →ₗ[K] M) (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ Ψ f ⁅y, e⁆) μ = -hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ Ψ f ⁅e, y⁆) μ
proof:
:=
  hB.casimirSum_eq_neg fun f _ e ↦ by rw [← lie_skew, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.cocycleTermLeft_self
statement:
lemma cocycleTermLeft_self {β : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c β =
      wedge K (nNeg P) V y (wedge K (nNeg P) V (adNNeg P ((P.toDual S).symm β) z) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cocycleTermLeft, hB.casimirSum_lie_self (leftBilin V z c) hy]
  simp only [bilinComp_apply, wedgeLieRight, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, nNegProj_coe]
  rw [nNegProj_of_mem (lie_h_mem_nNeg P _ z.2)]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_leftBilin_lie_left
statement:
lemma casimirSum_leftBilin_lie_left (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V)
    {α : Dual K H} (hα : α ∈ P.posWeights) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ leftBilin V z c ⁅f, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ e) α =
      -hB.cocycleTermA V y z c α
proof:
:=
  hB.casimirSum_eq_neg fun _ hf _ ↦ wedgeProj_lie_of_mem V y
    (rootSpace_le_nNeg ((neg_mem_negWeights_iff P).mpr hα) hf) _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.cocycleTermLeft_add
statement:
lemma cocycleTermLeft_add {β : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V)
    {α : Dual K H} (hα : α ∈ P.posWeights) :
    hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c (α + β) = hB.cocycleTermA V y z c α
proof:
:= by
  have h24 := hB.casimirSum_lie_left (leftBilin V z c) hy α
  have h1 := hB.casimirSum_lie_skew (leftBilin V z c) (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (α - -β)
  have h2 := hB.casimirSum_leftBilin_lie_left V y z c hα
  rw [← sub_neg_eq_add α β]
  exact neg_injective (h1.symm.trans (h24.symm.trans h2))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_leftBilin_nNegProj
statement:
lemma casimirSum_leftBilin_nNegProj (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V)
    (α : Dual K H) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ leftBilin V z c f (nNegProj P ⁅e, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ :
      P.KacMoodyAlgebra)) α = -hB.cocycleTermB V z y c α
proof:
:=
  hB.casimirSum_eq_neg fun f _ e ↦ (congrArg (wedgeProj V f)
    (wedgeProj_lie_coe_swap V (nNegProj P ⁅e, (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆) z c)).trans (map_neg _ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finsum_cocycleTermLeft
statement:
lemma finsum_cocycleTermLeft {β γ : Dual K H} (hβ : β ∈ P.posWeights) (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c α =
      wedge K (nNeg P) V y (wedge K (nNeg P) V (adNNeg P ((P.toDual S).symm β) z) c) +
        ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermA V y z c α -
        ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermB V z y c α
proof:
:= by
  have hSL := hB.finsum_casimirSum_lie_eq (fun f x ↦ leftBilin V z c f x) (fun f ↦ map_zero _) hβ
    hy (hB.finite_cocycleTermLeft V y z hy hz c)
  have h1 := hB.cocycleTermLeft_self V y z hy c
  have h2 := finsum_mem_congr (s := P.posWeights) rfl fun α hα ↦
    hB.cocycleTermLeft_add V y z hy c hα
  have h3 := finsum_mem_congr (s := P.posWeights) rfl fun α _ ↦
    hB.casimirSum_leftBilin_nNegProj V y z c α
  calc _ = _ := hSL
    _ = _ := by
      change hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c β +
        ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermLeft V y z c (α + β) + _ = _
      simp only [h1, h2, h3, finsum_mem_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_congr
statement:
lemma casimirSum_congr {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    {Φ Ψ : P.KacMoodyAlgebra → P.KacMoodyAlgebra → M} {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : ∀ f ∈ rootSpace P (-μ), ∀ e, Φ f e = Ψ f e) :
    hB.casimirSum Φ μ = hB.casimirSum Ψ μ
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ h _ (hB.dualBasis_mem μ k) _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.wedgeProj_lie_swap
statement:
lemma wedgeProj_lie_swap (a b : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    wedgeProj V ⁅a, b⁆ c = -wedgeProj V ⁅b, a⁆ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lie_skew, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.lie_h_of_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma lie_h_of_mem_rootSpace {β : Dual K H} {y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra} (hy : y ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (a : H) : ⁅y, h P a⁆ = β a • y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lie_skew, hy a, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.cocycleTermRight_self
statement:
lemma cocycleTermRight_self {β γ : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c γ =
      β ((P.toDual S).symm γ) • wedge K (nNeg P) V z (wedge K (nNeg P) V y c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cocycleTermRight, hB.casimirSum_lie_self (rightBilin V y c) hz]
  simp only [bilinComp_apply, wedgeLieLeft, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    lie_h_of_mem_rootSpace hy, map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply, nNegProj_coe,
    LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_rightBilin_lie_left
statement:
lemma casimirSum_rightBilin_lie_left (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V)
    {α : Dual K H} (hα : α ∈ P.posWeights) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ rightBilin V y c ⁅f, (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ e) α =
      hB.cocycleTermA V z y c α
proof:
:=
  hB.casimirSum_congr fun _ hf e ↦ (wedgeProj_lie_of_mem V z
    (rootSpace_le_nNeg ((neg_mem_negWeights_iff P).mpr hα) hf) _).trans <| by
      change -(wedge K (nNeg P) V _ (wedgeProj V ⁅(y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra), e⁆ c)) = _
      rw [wedgeProj_lie_swap, map_neg, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.cocycleTermRight_add
statement:
lemma cocycleTermRight_add {γ : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V)
    {α : Dual K H} (hα : α ∈ P.posWeights) :
    hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c (α + γ) = -hB.cocycleTermA V z y c α
proof:
:= by
  have h24 := hB.casimirSum_lie_left (rightBilin V y c) hz α
  have h1 := hB.casimirSum_lie_skew (rightBilin V y c) (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (α - -γ)
  have h2 := hB.casimirSum_rightBilin_lie_left V y z c hα
  rw [← sub_neg_eq_add α γ]
  exact neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp (h1.symm.trans (h24.symm.trans h2))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.casimirSum_rightBilin_nNegProj
statement:
lemma casimirSum_rightBilin_nNegProj (y z : nNeg P) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V)
    (α : Dual K H) :
    hB.casimirSum (fun f e ↦ rightBilin V y c f (nNegProj P ⁅e, (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆ :
      P.KacMoodyAlgebra)) α = hB.cocycleTermB V y z c α
proof:
:=
  hB.casimirSum_congr fun f _ e ↦ congrArg (fun T ↦ wedgeProj V f (T c))
    (wedgeProj_lie_coe V y (nNegProj P ⁅e, (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.finsum_cocycleTermRight
statement:
lemma finsum_cocycleTermRight {β γ : Dual K H} (hγ : γ ∈ P.posWeights) (y z : nNeg P)
    (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c α =
      β ((P.toDual S).symm γ) • wedge K (nNeg P) V z (wedge K (nNeg P) V y c) -
        ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermA V z y c α +
        ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermB V y z c α
proof:
:= by
  have hSR := hB.finsum_casimirSum_lie_eq (fun f x ↦ rightBilin V y c f x) (fun f ↦ map_zero _)
    hγ hz (hB.finite_cocycleTermRight V y z hy hz c)
  have h1 := hB.cocycleTermRight_self V y z hy hz c
  have h2 := finsum_mem_congr (s := P.posWeights) rfl fun α hα ↦
    hB.cocycleTermRight_add V y z hz c hα
  have h3 := finsum_mem_congr (s := P.posWeights) rfl fun α _ ↦
    hB.casimirSum_rightBilin_nNegProj V y z c α
  calc _ = _ := hSR
    _ = _ := by
      change hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c γ +
        ∑ᶠ α ∈ P.posWeights, hB.cocycleTermRight V y z c (α + γ) + _ = _
      simp only [h1, h2, h3, finsum_mem_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.smul_wedge_wedge_eq
statement:
lemma smul_wedge_wedge_eq {β γ : Dual K H} (y z : nNeg P)
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    β ((P.toDual S).symm γ) • wedge K (nNeg P) V z (wedge K (nNeg P) V y c) =
      wedge K (nNeg P) V y (wedge K (nNeg P) V (adNNeg P ((P.toDual S).symm β) z) c)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : γ ((P.toDual S).symm β) = β ((P.toDual S).symm γ) := by
    rw [← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, ← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq]
  have had : adNNeg P ((P.toDual S).symm β) z = (-β ((P.toDual S).symm γ)) • z :=
    Subtype.ext ((hz _).trans (by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, hs]; rfl))
  calc _ = β ((P.toDual S).symm γ) • -wedge K (nNeg P) V y (wedge K (nNeg P) V z c) :=
        congrArg _ (wedge_wedge_comm _ _ _)
    _ = wedge K (nNeg P) V y (wedge K (nNeg P) V ((-β ((P.toDual S).symm γ)) • z) c) := by
        simp only [map_smul, map_neg, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, smul_neg, neg_smul]
    _ = _ := by rw [had]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.kostantG_lie_sub_lieAction
statement:
theorem kostantG_lie_sub_lieAction {β γ : Dual K H} (hβ : β ∈ P.posWeights)
    (hγ : γ ∈ P.posWeights) (y z : nNeg P) (hy : (y : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-β))
    (hz : (z : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-γ)) (c : ExteriorAlgebra K (nNeg P) ⊗[K] V) :
    hB.kostantG V ⁅y, z⁆ c -
        (lieAction K (nNeg P) V y (hB.kostantG V z c) -
          hB.kostantG V z (lieAction K (nNeg P) V y c)) +
        (lieAction K (nNeg P) V z (hB.kostantG V y c) -
          hB.kostantG V y (lieAction K (nNeg P) V z c)) =
      wedge K (nNeg P) V y (wedge K (nNeg P) V (adNNeg P ((P.toDual S).symm β) z) c)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := hB.finsum_cocycleTermLeft V hβ y z hy hz c
  have hR := hB.finsum_cocycleTermRight V hγ y z hy hz c
  have hG := (hB.kostantG_lie V y z hy hz c).trans (congrArg _ (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hL hR))
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· - ·) hG (hB.lieAction_kostantG_sub V y z c))
    (hB.lieAction_kostantG_sub V z y c)).trans
    (half_combination _ _ _ _ _ _ (smul_wedge_wedge_eq (S := S) V y z hz c))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coe_adNNeg_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_adNNeg_apply (a : H) (x : nNeg P) :
    (adNNeg P a x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) = ⁅h P a, (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra)⁆
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.weightSpaceOf_nNegDerivAction_φ
statement:
lemma weightSpaceOf_nNegDerivAction_φ (ν : Dual K H) :
    Module.End.weightSpaceOf (nNegDerivAction P V).φ ν = weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNNeg
statement: theorem iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNNeg : ⨆ γ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf (adNNeg P) γ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun y _ ↦ ?_
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (nNegBasis P)) := (nNegBasis P).mem_span y
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ hy
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (-x.root) fun a ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
  simpa using nNegBasis_mem P x a

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.iSup_nNegChainWeightSpace
statement:
theorem iSup_nNegChainWeightSpace (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν = ⊤) :
    ⨆ μ, (nNegDerivAction P V).chainWeightSpace μ = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (nNegDerivAction P V).iSup_chainWeightSpace (iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNNeg P) hV

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.iSup_nNegHomologyWeightSpace
statement:
theorem iSup_nNegHomologyWeightSpace (hV : ⨆ ν, weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) ν = ⊤) (k : ℕ) :
    ⨆ μ, (nNegDerivAction P V).homologyWeightSpace k μ = homology K (nNeg P) V k
proof:
:=
  (nNegDerivAction P V).iSup_homologyWeightSpace (iSup_weightSpaceOf_adNNeg P) hV k

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma msetWt_zero : msetWt (0 : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) = 0
proof: := Finsupp.sum_zero_index

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_add
statement: lemma msetWt_add (m m' : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) : msetWt (m + m') = msetWt m + msetWt m'
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ ↦ zero_smul _ _) fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_single
statement: @[simp] lemma msetWt_single (α : Dual K H) (n : ℕ) : msetWt (Finsupp.single α n) = n • α
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_smul _ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_mapDomain
statement:
lemma msetWt_mapDomain (f : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) :
    msetWt (m.mapDomain f) = f (msetWt m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [msetWt, Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (h := fun α (n : ℕ) ↦ n • α) (fun _ ↦ zero_smul _ _)
    fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _, msetWt, map_finsuppSum]
  simp only [map_nsmul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_nsmul_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma sum_nsmul_mem_posWeights (s : Finset (Dual K H)) (f : Dual K H → ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ α ∈ s, α ∈ P.posWeights ∧ f α ≠ 0) (hne : s.Nonempty) :
    ∑ α ∈ s, f α • α ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn (α : Dual K H) (hα : α ∈ P.posWeights) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : n • α ∈ P.posWeights := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact absurd rfl hn
    | succ n ih =>
      rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn'
      · simpa using hα
      · rw [succ_nsmul]; exact P.posWeights_add (ih hn') hα
  induction hne using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton a => simpa using hn a (hs a (by simp)).1 _ (hs a (by simp)).2
  | cons a s ha hs' ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_cons]
    exact P.posWeights_add (hn a (hs a (by simp)).1 _ (hs a (by simp)).2)
      (ih fun α hα ↦ hs α (by simp [hα]))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma msetWt_mem_posWeights {m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ} (hm : ∀ α ∈ m.support, α ∈ P.posWeights)
    (hne : m ≠ 0) : msetWt m ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:=
  sum_nsmul_mem_posWeights P _ _ (fun α hα ↦ ⟨hm α hα, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hα⟩)
    (Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hne)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_zero_of_msetWt_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_msetWt_eq_zero {m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ} (hm : ∀ α ∈ m.support, α ∈ P.posWeights)
    (h0 : msetWt m = 0) : m = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  exact P.zero_notMem_posWeights (h0 ▸ msetWt_mem_posWeights P hm hne)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_msetWt_eq_rootOf
statement:
lemma exists_msetWt_eq_rootOf {m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ} (hm : ∀ α ∈ m.support, α ∈ P.posWeights) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ msetWt m = P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with rfl | hne
  · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := msetWt_mem_posWeights P hm hne
    exact ⟨k, hk.1, h.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.neg_root_notMem_posWeights
statement: lemma neg_root_notMem_posWeights (i : ι) : -P.root i ∉ P.posWeights
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  Set.disjoint_left.mp P.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights h (P.neg_root_mem_negWeights i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.neg_root_ne_root
statement: lemma neg_root_ne_root (i : ι) : -P.root i ≠ P.root i
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 : (2 : K) • P.root i = 0 := by
    rw [two_smul]
    nth_rewrite 1 [← h]
    exact neg_add_cancel _
  exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i ((smul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left two_ne_zero)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflectMset_apply_root
statement:
lemma reflectMset_apply_root {m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ} (hm : ∀ α ∈ m.support, α ∈ P.posWeights)
    (i : ι) : reflectMset P hA i m (P.root i) = 1 - m (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (m.erase (P.root i)).mapDomain (P.reflection hA i) (P.root i) = 0 := by
    have := Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (P.reflection hA i).injective
      (m.erase (P.root i)) (-P.root i)
    rw [map_neg, reflection_root_self, neg_neg] at this
    rw [this, Finsupp.erase_ne (neg_root_ne_root i)]
    by_contra h
    exact neg_root_notMem_posWeights i (hm _ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h))
  rw [reflectMset, Finsupp.add_apply, h1, zero_add, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflectMset_apply_neg_root
statement:
lemma reflectMset_apply_neg_root (m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) (i : ι) :
    reflectMset P hA i m (-P.root i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectMset, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (neg_root_ne_root i), add_zero,
    show -P.root i = P.reflection hA i (P.root i) by simp,
    Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (P.reflection hA i).injective, Finsupp.erase_same]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.reflectMset_apply
statement:
lemma reflectMset_apply {β : Dual K H} (i : ι) (m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) (h1 : β ≠ P.root i)
    (h2 : β ≠ -P.root i) : reflectMset P hA i m β = m (P.reflection hA i β)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : P.reflection hA i β ≠ P.root i := fun h ↦ h2 (by
    rw [← P.reflection_reflection hA i β, h, reflection_root_self])
  rw [reflectMset, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne h1, add_zero]
  conv_lhs => rw [← P.reflection_reflection hA i β]
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (P.reflection hA i).injective, Finsupp.erase_ne h3]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_eq_erase_add
statement:
lemma msetWt_eq_erase_add (m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) (α : Dual K H) :
    msetWt m = msetWt (m.erase α) + m α • α
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Finsupp.erase_add_single α m]
  rw [msetWt_add, msetWt_single]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_reflectMset
statement:
lemma msetWt_reflectMset (i : ι) (m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) :
    msetWt (reflectMset P hA i m) =
      P.reflection hA i (msetWt (m.erase (P.root i))) + (1 - m (P.root i)) • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectMset, msetWt_add, msetWt_mapDomain, msetWt_single]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.degree_erase_add
statement:
lemma degree_erase_add (m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) (α : Dual K H) :
    (m.erase α).degree + m α = m.degree
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finsupp.erase_add_single α m]
  rw [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.degree_reflectMset
statement:
lemma degree_reflectMset (i : ι) (m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ) :
    (reflectMset P hA i m).degree + m (P.root i) = m.degree + (1 - m (P.root i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectMset, map_add, Finsupp.degree_mapDomain, Finsupp.degree_single, add_right_comm,
    degree_erase_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsRootMultiset.reflectMset
statement:
theorem IsRootMultiset.reflectMset {m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ} (hm : IsRootMultiset P m) (i : ι) :
    IsRootMultiset P (reflectMset P hA i m)
proof:
:= by
  have hmult (β : Dual K H) :
      finrank K (rootSpace P (-P.reflection hA i β)) = finrank K (rootSpace P (-β)) := by
    have := rank_rootSpace_weylGroup P hA (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i) (-β)
    rw [map_neg] at this
    unfold Module.finrank
    rw [this]
  refine ⟨fun β hβ ↦ ?_, fun β ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hβ
    by_cases h1 : β = P.root i
    · exact h1 ▸ P.root_mem_posWeights i
    by_cases h2 : β = -P.root i
    · exact absurd (h2 ▸ reflectMset_apply_neg_root hA m i) hβ
    rw [reflectMset_apply hA i m h1 h2] at hβ
    have hpos := hm.1 _ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hβ)
    have hroot : P.reflection hA i β ∈ roots P := by
      refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ P.zero_notMem_posWeights (h0 ▸ hpos), fun hbot ↦ hβ ?_⟩
      have := hm.2 (P.reflection hA i β)
      rw [finrank_rootSpace_neg_eq P hpos, hbot, finrank_bot] at this
      omega
    have hne : P.reflection hA i β ≠ P.root i := fun h ↦ h2 (by
      rw [← P.reflection_reflection hA i β, h, reflection_root_self])
    simpa using reflection_mem_posWeights P hA hroot hpos hne
  · by_cases h1 : β = P.root i
    · subst h1
      rw [reflectMset_apply_root hA hm.1, finrank_rootSpace_neg_root]
      omega
    by_cases h2 : β = -P.root i
    · rw [h2, reflectMset_apply_neg_root]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    rw [reflectMset_apply hA i m h1 h2, ← hmult]
    exact hm.2 _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.inv_apply_root_mem_posWeights
proof:
:= by
  choose n hn using hlam
  have key : P.dualBilinForm S lam (((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (P.root i)) = ((p / S.ε i : ℚ) : K) := by
    rw [← dualBilinForm_weylGroup P hA S w.2, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel, Subgroup.coe_one, LinearEquiv.coe_one, id, dualBilinForm_root_right, hwp]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rcases P.apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos hA (w⁻¹).2 i with ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ | ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩
  · refine ⟨k, ⟨hk, ?_⟩, hwk.symm⟩
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hwk
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hwk
  · exfalso
    rw [hwk, map_neg, dualBilinForm_rootOf_right] at key
    simp only [hn] at key
    have hq : (-(∑ j, (k j : ℚ) * ((n j + 1 : ℚ) / S.ε j)) : ℚ) = p / S.ε i := by
      exact_mod_cast (show (((-(∑ j, (k j : ℚ) * ((n j + 1 : ℚ) / S.ε j)) : ℚ) : K)) =
        ((p / S.ε i : ℚ) : K) by rw [← key]; push_cast; rfl)
    have h1 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, (k j : ℚ) * ((n j + 1 : ℚ) / S.ε j) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hk j)
        (div_nonneg (by positivity) (S.ε_pos j).le)
    have h2 : (0 : ℚ) < p / S.ε i := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp) (S.ε_pos i)
    linarith

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_rootOf_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hle ν hν
  obtain ⟨k', hk', hmk⟩ := exists_msetWt_eq_rootOf P hm
  exact ⟨k + k', add_nonneg hk hk', by rw [map_add, ← hmk]; abel⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weylGroup_of_dualBilinForm_eq_aux
statement:
theorem exists_weylGroup_of_dualBilinForm_eq_aux (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ ν ∈ Pw, ∀ m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ, IsRootMultiset P m → ∀ c : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ c → ∑ j, c j = N →
      Λ + P.rho - (ν + P.rho - msetWt m) = P.rootOf c →
      P.dualBilinForm S (ν + P.rho - msetWt m) (ν + P.rho - msetWt m) =
        P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) →
      ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) = ν + P.rho - msetWt m ∧
        (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = m.degree ∧
        ∀ α ∈ m.support, ((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) α ∈ P.negWeights
proof:
:= by
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ N ih =>
  intro ν hν m hm c hc hcN hφ hform
  set φ := ν + P.rho - msetWt m with hφdef
  have hlam : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℕ, (Λ + P.rho) (P.coroot j) = n + 1 := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ j
    exact ⟨n, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]⟩
  choose nn hnn using hlam
  have hφl : φ = Λ + P.rho - P.rootOf c := by rw [← hφ]; abel
  have hφcor (j : ι) : φ (P.coroot j) = ((nn j + 1 - (A *ᵥ c) j : ℤ) : K) := by
    rw [hφl, LinearMap.sub_apply, hnn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    ring
  by_cases hdom : ∀ j, 0 ≤ (nn j + 1 - (A *ᵥ c) j : ℤ)
  · 
    have hdiff : P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) - P.dualBilinForm S φ φ =
        P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho + φ) (P.rootOf c) := by
      have hl : Λ + P.rho = φ + P.rootOf c := by rw [hφl]; abel
      rw [hl]
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [(P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq (P.rootOf c) φ]
      ring
    rw [hform, sub_self, dualBilinForm_rootOf_right] at hdiff
    have hq : ∑ j, (c j : ℚ) * ((2 * (nn j + 1) - (A *ᵥ c) j : ℤ) / S.ε j) = 0 := by
      have : ((∑ j, (c j : ℚ) * ((2 * (nn j + 1) - (A *ᵥ c) j : ℤ) / S.ε j) : ℚ) : K) = 0 := by
        rw [hdiff]
        push_cast
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
        rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hnn, hφcor]
        push_cast
        ring
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hterm (j : ι) : 0 ≤ (c j : ℚ) * ((2 * (nn j + 1) - (A *ᵥ c) j : ℤ) / S.ε j) := by
      have h : (0 : ℤ) < 2 * (nn j + 1) - (A *ᵥ c) j := by have := hdom j; omega
      exact mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hc j)
        (div_nonneg (Int.cast_pos.mpr h).le (S.ε_pos j).le)
    have hc0 : c = 0 := by
      funext j
      have hj := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hterm j).mp hq j (Finset.mem_univ j)
      have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < ((2 * (nn j + 1) - (A *ᵥ c) j : ℤ) / S.ε j) := by
        have h : (0 : ℤ) < 2 * (nn j + 1) - (A *ᵥ c) j := by have := hdom j; omega
        exact div_pos (Int.cast_pos.mpr h) (S.ε_pos j)
      exact_mod_cast (mul_eq_zero.mp hj).resolve_right hpos.ne'
    subst hc0
    have hφΛ : φ = Λ + P.rho := by rw [hφl, map_zero, sub_zero]
    have hm0 : m = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hνk⟩ := hle ν hν
      obtain ⟨k', hk', hmk⟩ := exists_msetWt_eq_rootOf P hm.1
      have h1 : Λ + P.rho - φ = 0 := hφ.trans (map_zero _)
      have h0 : P.rootOf (k + k') = 0 := by
        rw [map_add, ← hmk, ← h1, hφdef, hνk]
        abel
      rw [← map_zero P.rootOf] at h0
      have hkk := P.rootOf_injective h0
      have hk'0 : k' = 0 := funext fun j ↦ by
        have h1 := congrFun hkk j; have h2 := hk j; have h3 := hk' j
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
        omega
      exact eq_zero_of_msetWt_eq_zero P hm.1 (by rw [hmk, hk'0, map_zero])
    subst hm0
    exact ⟨1, by simpa using hφΛ.symm, by simp, by simp⟩
  · 
    push Not at hdom
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hdom
    set p : ℤ := nn i + 1 - (A *ᵥ c) i with hp
    have hmi : m (P.root i) ≤ 1 := by
      have := hm.2 (P.root i)
      rwa [finrank_rootSpace_neg_root] at this
    set m' := reflectMset P hA i m with hm'
    have hrρ : P.reflection hA i P.rho = P.rho - P.root i := by
      rw [reflection_apply, rho_coroot, one_smul]
    have hφ' : P.reflection hA i ν + P.rho - msetWt m' = P.reflection hA i φ := by
      rw [hm', msetWt_reflectMset, hφdef, msetWt_eq_erase_add m (P.root i), map_sub, map_add,
        map_add, hrρ, map_nsmul, reflection_root_self]
      obtain h | h : m (P.root i) = 0 ∨ m (P.root i) = 1 := by omega
      · rw [h]; simp only [tsub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]; abel
      · rw [h]; simp only [tsub_self, zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero]; abel
    have hrφ : P.reflection hA i φ = φ - (p : K) • P.root i := by
      rw [reflection_apply, hφcor]
    have hc' : Λ + P.rho - (P.reflection hA i ν + P.rho - msetWt m') =
        P.rootOf (c + p • Pi.single i 1) := by
      rw [hφ', hrφ, map_add, map_zsmul, rootOf_single, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, hφl]
      abel
    obtain ⟨c'', hc''0, hc''⟩ := exists_rootOf_of_mem Pw hle (hrefl ν hν i)
      (hm.reflectMset hA i).1
    rw [← hm', hc'] at hc''
    have hc'0 : 0 ≤ c + p • Pi.single i 1 := (P.rootOf_injective hc'').symm ▸ hc''0
    have hsum : ∑ j, (c + p • Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) j = N + p := by
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hcN]
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, (c + p • Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) j :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hc'0 j
    have hlt : (N + p).toNat < N := by omega
    have hform' : P.dualBilinForm S (P.reflection hA i ν + P.rho - msetWt m')
        (P.reflection hA i ν + P.rho - msetWt m') = P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) := by
      rw [hφ', dualBilinForm_reflection, hform]
    obtain ⟨w', hw'l, hw'len, hw'inv⟩ := ih _ hlt _ (hrefl ν hν i) m'
      (hm.reflectMset hA i) _ hc'0 (by rw [hsum]; omega) hc' hform'
    
    have hpos : ((w'⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ∈
        P.posWeights := by
      refine inv_apply_root_mem_posWeights hA S (fun j ↦ ⟨nn j, hnn j⟩) w' i (p := -p)
        (by omega) ?_
      rw [hw'l, hφ', hrφ, LinearMap.sub_apply, hφcor, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        P.root_coroot_self hA i, hp]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hm'i : m' (P.root i) = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp P.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights hpos
        (hw'inv _ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h))
    rw [hm', reflectMset_apply_root hA hm.1] at hm'i
    have hmi1 : m (P.root i) = 1 := by omega
    have hdeg := degree_reflectMset (P := P) hA i m
    rw [← hm', hmi1] at hdeg
    refine ⟨(P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i * w', ?_, ?_, fun α hα ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hw'l, hφ',
        reflection_reflection]
    · have hnd : ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent w'⁻¹ i :=
        (apply_root_mem_posWeights_iff P hA).mp hpos
      rw [(P.coxeterSystem hA).not_isRightDescent_iff] at hnd
      rw [← (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_inv, _root_.mul_inv_rev, (P.coxeterSystem hA).inv_simple,
        hnd, (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_inv, hw'len]
      omega
    · rw [_root_.mul_inv_rev, (P.coxeterSystem hA).inv_simple, Subgroup.coe_mul,
        coxeterSystem_simple, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
      have hαpos := hm.1 α hα
      by_cases hαi : α = P.root i
      · subst hαi
        rw [reflection_root_self, map_neg]
        exact (neg_mem_negWeights_iff P).mpr hpos
      have hαi' : α ≠ -P.root i := fun h ↦ neg_root_notMem_posWeights i (h ▸ hαpos)
      have h1 : P.reflection hA i α ≠ P.root i := fun h ↦ hαi' (by
        rw [← P.reflection_reflection hA i α, h, reflection_root_self])
      have h2 : P.reflection hA i α ≠ -P.root i := fun h ↦ hαi (by
        rw [← P.reflection_reflection hA i α, h, map_neg, reflection_root_self, neg_neg])
      refine hw'inv _ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr ?_)
      rw [hm', reflectMset_apply hA i m h1 h2, reflection_reflection]
      exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hα

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_weylGroup_of_dualBilinForm_eq
statement:
theorem exists_weylGroup_of_dualBilinForm_eq {ν : Dual K H} (hν : ν ∈ Pw)
    {m : Dual K H →₀ ℕ} (hm : IsRootMultiset P m)
    (hform : P.dualBilinForm S (ν + P.rho - msetWt m) (ν + P.rho - msetWt m) =
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho)) :
    ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) = ν + P.rho - msetWt m ∧
      (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = m.degree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hφ⟩ := exists_rootOf_of_mem Pw hle hν hm.1
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hlen, -⟩ := exists_weylGroup_of_dualBilinForm_eq_aux hA S hΛ Pw hrefl hle
    (∑ j, c j).toNat ν hν m hm c hc (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hc j)).symm
    hφ hform
  exact ⟨w, hw, hlen⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_sum
statement:
lemma msetWt_sum {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (f : κ → Dual K H →₀ ℕ) :
    msetWt (∑ x ∈ s, f x) = ∑ x ∈ s, msetWt (f x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, msetWt_add, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.msetWt_finsetMset
statement:
@[simp] lemma msetWt_finsetMset (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    msetWt (finsetMset P S) = finsetWt P S
proof:
:= by
  simp [finsetMset, msetWt_sum, finsetWt]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.degree_finsetMset
statement:
@[simp] lemma degree_finsetMset (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    (finsetMset P S).degree = S.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [finsetMset, map_sum]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetMset_apply
statement:
lemma finsetMset_apply (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) (α : Dual K H) :
    finsetMset P S α = (S.filter fun x : NegRootIndex P ↦ x.root = α).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finsetMset, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.card_filter]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.card_filter_root_le
statement:
lemma card_filter_root_le (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) (α : Dual K H) :
    (S.filter fun x : NegRootIndex P ↦ x.root = α).card ≤ finrank K (rootSpace P (-α))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.card_range (finrank K (rootSpace P (-α)))]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x ↦ (x.2 : ℕ)) (fun x hx ↦ ?_) fun x hx y hy hxy ↦ ?_
  · obtain ⟨-, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
    have := x.2.2
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
    rwa [← hx]
  · obtain ⟨-, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    obtain ⟨-, hy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    have h1 : x.1 = y.1 := Subtype.ext (hx.trans hy.symm)
    exact Sigma.ext h1 ((Fin.heq_ext_iff (by rw [h1])).mpr hxy)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.isRootMultiset_finsetMset
statement:
theorem isRootMultiset_finsetMset (S : Finset (NegRootIndex P)) :
    IsRootMultiset P (finsetMset P S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun α hα ↦ ?_, fun α ↦ (finsetMset_apply S α).trans_le (card_filter_root_le S α)⟩
  rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, finsetMset_apply, Ne, Finset.card_eq_zero] at hα
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hα
  rw [← (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2]
  exact x.1.2

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.reflection_mem_weights
proof:
:= by
  have hV := (isIntegrable_iff P hA).mpr hΛ
  have := rank_weightSpace_weylGroup hA hV (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i) ν
  rw [Ne, ← Submodule.rank_eq_zero, this, Submodule.rank_eq_zero]
  exact hν

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hν
  exact VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' _)
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) hx hx0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exists_weylGroup_of_homologyWeightSpace_ne_bot_of_eq
statement:
theorem exists_weylGroup_of_homologyWeightSpace_ne_bot_of_eq (hΛ : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ)
    {k : ℕ} {μ : Dual K H}
    (h : (nNegDerivAction P (IrreducibleModule P Λ)).homologyWeightSpace k μ ≠ ⊥)
    (hform : P.dualBilinForm S (μ + P.rho) (μ + P.rho) =
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho)) :
    ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w = k ∧
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho = μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hne⟩ := (isCategoryO P Λ).exists_of_homologyWeightSpace_ne_bot h
  have hφ : μ + finsetWt P T + P.rho - msetWt (finsetMset P T) = μ + P.rho := by
    rw [msetWt_finsetMset]; abel
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hlen⟩ := exists_weylGroup_of_dualBilinForm_eq hA S hΛ
    {ν | weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P Λ) ν ≠ ⊥}
    (fun ν hν i ↦ reflection_mem_weights hA hΛ hν i)
    (fun ν hν ↦ exists_eq_sub_of_weightSpace_ne_bot hν) hne (isRootMultiset_finsetMset T)
    (by rw [hφ, hform])
  refine ⟨w, by rw [hlen, degree_finsetMset, hT], ?_⟩
  rw [hw, hφ, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.rootSpace_eq_bot_of_notMem
statement:
theorem rootSpace_eq_bot_of_notMem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∉ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P) :
    rootSpace P μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj :=
    (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap (M := P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) (h P)).disjoint_biSup hμ
  rwa [iSup_rootSpace_eq_top, disjoint_top] at hdisj

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.sub_single_mem_posCone_or
statement:
lemma sub_single_mem_posCone_or {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) (i : ι) :
    k - Pi.single i 1 = 0 ∨ k - Pi.single i 1 ∈ posCone ι ∨
      -P.rootOf (k - Pi.single i 1) ∉ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P
proof:
:= by
  have hl : ∀ j, (k - Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) j = k j - (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) j :=
    fun j ↦ rfl
  by_cases hl0 : k - Pi.single i 1 = 0
  · exact Or.inl hl0
  by_cases hlpos : 0 ≤ k - Pi.single i 1
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hlpos, hl0⟩)
  refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
  rintro ((⟨m, hm, hml⟩ | hml) | ⟨m, hm, hml⟩)
  · rw [neg_inj, P.rootOf_injective.eq_iff] at hml
    exact hlpos (hml ▸ hm.1)
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff, neg_eq_zero, ← map_zero P.rootOf,
      P.rootOf_injective.eq_iff] at hml
    exact hl0 hml
  · have hlm : k - Pi.single i 1 = -m := by
      apply P.rootOf_injective
      rw [map_neg, hml, neg_neg]
    obtain ⟨j', hj'⟩ : ∃ j', (k - Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) j' < 0 := by
      by_contra! h; exact hlpos h
    have hki : k i = 0 := by
      by_cases hj'i : j' = i
      · subst hj'i
        rw [hl, Pi.single_eq_same] at hj'
        have := hk.1 j'
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at this
        omega
      · rw [hl, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj'i, sub_zero] at hj'
        have := hk.1 j'
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at this
        omega
    apply hk.2
    funext j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji; exact hki
    · have h1 := hl j
      rw [hlm, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hji, sub_zero] at h1
      have h2 := hk.1 j
      have h3 := hm.1 j
      simp only [Pi.neg_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
      omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_e_eq_zero_of_minimal
statement:
theorem lie_e_eq_zero_of_minimal {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf l) = ⊥)
    {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ radicalNeg P) (hxk : x ∈ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf k))
    (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, x⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hyr : ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ radical P hA := (radical P hA).lie_mem (radicalNeg_le_radical P hA hx)
  have hyk : ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf (k - Pi.single i 1)) := by
    have := lie_mem_rootSpace P (e_mem_rootSpace P i) hxk
    rwa [map_sub, rootOf_single, neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rcases sub_single_mem_posCone_or P hk i with hl | hl | hl
  · 
    have hki : k = Pi.single i 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp hl
    rw [hki, rootOf_single] at hxk
    have := (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (radical_inf_rootSpace_neg_root P hA i) x
      ⟨radicalNeg_le_radical P hA hx, hxk⟩
    rw [this, lie_zero]
  · 
    have hyN : ⁅e P i, x⁆ ∈ (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule := by
      rw [radicalNeg_toSubmodule P hA]
      exact ⟨hyr, rootSpace_neg_le P ⟨_, hl, rfl⟩ hyk⟩
    have hlt : height (k - Pi.single i 1) < height k := by
      have := height_add (k - Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single i 1)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
      have h1 : height (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) = 1 := by simp [height]
      omega
    exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp (hmin _ hl hlt) _ ⟨hyN, hyk⟩
  · 
    rw [rootSpace_eq_bot_of_notMem P hl] at hyk
    exact hyk

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.sum_mul_le_zero_of_minimal
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_zero_of_minimal {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf l) = ⊥)
    {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ radicalNeg P) (hxk : x ∈ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf k))
    (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (i : ι) : ∑ j, A i j * k j ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_of_lie_e_eq_zero P hA i hxk hx0
    (lie_e_eq_zero_of_minimal P hA hk hmin hx hxk i)
  rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, rootOf_apply_coroot, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg] at hn
  have : (∑ j, A i j * k j : ℤ) = -n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  omega

name: LieModule.lieWeightSpan_le
statement:
lemma lieWeightSpan_le (A B : Submodule K L) (S T : Set (Dual K H)) (ν : Dual K H) :
    lieWeightSpan φ A B S T ν ≤ weightSpaceOfMap L φ ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [lieWeightSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨a, b, ⟨μ, -, μ', -, rfl, ⟨-, ha⟩, ⟨-, hb⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  exact lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap φ ha hb

name: LieModule.span_lie_le_iSup_lieWeightSpan
statement:
theorem span_lie_le_iSup_lieWeightSpan {A B : Submodule K L}
    (hA : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ A, ⁅φ a, x⁆ ∈ A) (hB : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ B, ⁅φ a, x⁆ ∈ B)
    {S T : Set (Dual K H)} (hAS : A ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ S, weightSpaceOfMap L φ μ)
    (hBT : B ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ T, weightSpaceOfMap L φ μ) :
    Submodule.span K {x | ∃ a b, (a ∈ A ∧ b ∈ B) ∧ x = ⁅a, b⁆} ≤
      ⨆ ν, lieWeightSpan φ A B S T ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨a, b, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩
  have ha' : a ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ S, (A ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap L φ μ) :=
    inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le φ A hA S ⟨ha, hAS ha⟩
  have hb' : b ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ T, (B ⊓ weightSpaceOfMap L φ μ) :=
    inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le φ B hB T ⟨hb, hBT hb⟩
  rw [← iSup_subtype''] at ha' hb'
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun a ↦ ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ _) ha' (fun μ a ha ↦ ?_)
    (by simp) (fun a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [add_lie]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂)
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun b ↦ ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ _) hb' (fun μ' b hb ↦ ?_)
    (by simp) (fun b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [lie_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂)
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ((μ : Dual K H) + μ')
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, b, ⟨μ, μ.2, μ', μ'.2, rfl, ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩)

name: LieModule.mem_lieWeightSpan_of_mem
proof:
:=
  mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le φ _ (lieWeightSpan_le φ A B S T) hxν
    (span_lie_le_iSup_lieWeightSpan φ hA hB hAS hBT hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.height_add
statement: lemma height_add (k l : ι → ℤ) : height (k + l) = height k + height l
proof:
:= by
  simp [height, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Matrix.Realization.height_pos
statement: lemma height_pos {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) : 0 < height k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk0, hk⟩ := hk
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, k i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h; exact hk (funext h)
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ ↦ hk0 j) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, lt_of_le_of_ne (hk0 i) hi.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_h_mem_range_fHom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_fHom P a y
  refine ⟨y', ?_⟩
  change π P (AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y') = ⁅π P (AuxLieAlgebra.h P a), π P (AuxLieAlgebra.fHom P y)⁆
  rw [← LieHom.map_lie, hy']

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.range_fHom_le
statement:
lemma range_fHom_le :
    LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) ≤
      ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact fHom_mem P y

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.range_fHom_le_iSup
statement:
lemma range_fHom_le_iSup :
    LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) ≤
      ⨆ ν, (Submodule.span K (f P '' {i | -P.root i = ν}) ⊔
        lieWeightSpan (h P)
          (LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra))
          (LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra))
          P.negWeights P.negWeights ν)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  induction y using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i =>
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (-P.root i) (Submodule.mem_sup_left ?_)
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl, by simp⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => simpa using Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y hy => simpa using Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  | lie y z _ _ =>
    have := span_lie_le_iSup_lieWeightSpan (h P)
      (fun a x hx ↦ lie_h_mem_range_fHom P a hx) (fun a x hx ↦ lie_h_mem_range_fHom P a hx)
      (range_fHom_le P) (range_fHom_le P)
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨fHom P y, fHom P z, ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩, ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩)
    simp only [LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, LieHom.map_lie]
    exact SetLike.le_def.mp (iSup_mono fun ν ↦ le_sup_right) this

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.coe_negProj
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_negProj (x : (fHom P).range) :
    (negProj P hA x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) = toKacMoody P hA x
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.negProj_surjective
statement: lemma negProj_surjective : Function.Surjective (negProj P hA)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨⟨fHom P y, LieHom.mem_range_self _ y⟩, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.negProj_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma negProj_eq_zero_iff {x : (fHom P).range} :
    negProj P hA x = 0 ↔ (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) ∈ radicalNeg P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, radicalNeg_toSubmodule P hA, Submodule.mem_inf,
    LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, mem_radical_iff, ← coe_negProj, ZeroMemClass.coe_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h, x.2⟩, fun h ↦ h.1⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.toKacMoody_mem_rootSpace
statement:
lemma toKacMoody_mem_rootSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) : toKacMoody P hA x ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace P μ
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  rw [← toKacMoody_h P hA, ← LieHom.map_lie, hx a, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radical_inf_rootSpace_neg_root
statement:
lemma radical_inf_rootSpace_neg_root (i : ι) :
    (radical P hA).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.root i) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  rintro x ⟨hx, hx'⟩
  rw [rootSpace_neg_root] at hx'
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx'
  have : c • KacMoodyAlgebra.f P i = 0 := by
    rw [← toKacMoody_f P hA, ← map_smul]; exact (mem_radical_iff P hA).mp hx
  rw [smul_eq_zero] at this
  rcases this with rfl | h
  · simp
  · exact absurd h (KacMoodyAlgebra.f_ne_zero P i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.radicalNeg_le_range_fHom
statement:
lemma radicalNeg_le_range_fHom :
    (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ≤
      LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.SerrePresentedAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [radicalNeg_toSubmodule P hA]; exact inf_le_right

name: LieModule.mul_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
statement:
lemma mul_mem_weightSpaceOfMap {μ ν : Dual K H} {u v : A} (hu : u ∈ weightSpaceOfMap A φ μ)
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap A φ ν) : u * v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap A φ (μ + ν)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have hu' := hu a
  have hv' := hv a
  rw [LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket] at hu' hv' ⊢
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul, ← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_smul_comm, ← hu', ← hv']
  noncomm_ring

name: LieModule.one_mem_weightSpaceOfMap
statement: lemma one_mem_weightSpaceOfMap : (1 : A) ∈ weightSpaceOfMap A φ 0
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket]; simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegFWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma nNegFWord_nil : nNegFWord P [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegFWord_cons
statement:
lemma nNegFWord_cons (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    nNegFWord P (i :: w) = ιᵤ (nNegF P i) * nNegFWord P w
proof:
:= by
  simp [nNegFWord]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.lie_h_mem_range_eHom
statement:
lemma lie_h_mem_range_eHom (a : H) {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ (eHom P).range) :
    ⁅h P a, x⁆ ∈ (eHom P).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.lie_h_eHom P a z
  refine ⟨z', ?_⟩
  change π P (AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z') = ⁅π P (AuxLieAlgebra.h P a), π P (AuxLieAlgebra.eHom P z)⁆
  rw [← LieHom.map_lie, hz']

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.ι_mem_envWeightSpace
statement:
lemma ι_mem_envWeightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ rootSpace P μ) : ιᵤ x ∈ envWeightSpace P μ
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  change ⁅ιᵤ (h P a), ιᵤ x⁆ = μ a • ιᵤ x
  rw [← LieHom.map_lie, hx a, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.mem_envDegGe_of_mem
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem l (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hl hu)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.mul_mem_envDegGe
statement:
lemma mul_mem_envDegGe {n m : ℤ} {u v : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.SerrePresentedAlgebra}
    (hu : u ∈ envDegGe P n) (hv : v ∈ envDegGe P m) : u * v ∈ envDegGe P (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [envDegGe, iSup_subtype'] at hu hv
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun u ↦ u * v ∈ _) hu (fun l u hu ↦ ?_)
    (by simp) (fun u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂)
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun v ↦ u * v ∈ _) hv (fun l' v hv ↦ ?_)
    (by simp) (fun v₁ v₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂)
  refine mem_envDegGe_of_mem P (l := l + l') ?_ ?_
  · rw [height_add]; exact add_le_add l.2 l'.2
  · rw [map_add, neg_add]; exact mul_mem_weightSpaceOfMap _ hu hv

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.map_mem_envDegGe_zero
statement: lemma map_mem_envDegGe_zero (u : Û) : jmap u ∈ envDegGe P 0
proof:
:= by
  induction u using UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ r (mem_envDegGe_of_mem P (l := 0) (by simp [height]) ?_)
    rw [map_zero, neg_zero]
    exact one_mem_weightSpaceOfMap _
  | ι x =>
    rw [UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, LieSubalgebra.coe_incl]
    have hx := range_fHom_le P ((fHom P).range.coe_mem x)
    have : (⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, rootSpace P μ) ≤
        (envDegGe P 0).comap (ιᵤ : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra →ₗ⁅K⁆ _).toLinearMap := by
      refine iSup₂_le fun μ hμ y hy ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := hμ
      exact mem_envDegGe_of_mem P (height_pos hm).le (ι_mem_envWeightSpace P hy)
    exact this hx
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul]; simpa using mul_mem_envDegGe P ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.nNegFWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma nNegFWord_nil : nNegFWord P [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.nNegFWord_cons
statement:
lemma nNegFWord_cons (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    nNegFWord P (i :: w) = ιᵤ (nNegF P i) * nNegFWord P w
proof:
:= by
  simp [nNegFWord]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.nNegFWord_append
statement:
lemma nNegFWord_append (w w' : List ι) :
    nNegFWord P (w ++ w') = nNegFWord P w * nNegFWord P w'
proof:
:= by
  simp [nNegFWord]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.counts_append
statement:
lemma counts_append (w w' : List ι) :
    AuxLieAlgebra.counts (w ++ w') = AuxLieAlgebra.counts w + AuxLieAlgebra.counts w'
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [AuxLieAlgebra.counts, List.count_append]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.mul_mem_nNegFWordSpan
statement:
lemma mul_mem_nNegFWordSpan {l l' : ι → ℤ} {u v : Û} (hu : u ∈ nNegFWordSpan P l)
    (hv : v ∈ nNegFWordSpan P l') : u * v ∈ nNegFWordSpan P (l + l')
proof:
:= by
  have := Submodule.mul_mem_mul hu hv
  rw [nNegFWordSpan, nNegFWordSpan, Submodule.span_mul_span] at this
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ this
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, _, ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨w ++ w', ?_, nNegFWord_append P w w'⟩
  change AuxLieAlgebra.counts (w ++ w') = l + l'
  rw [counts_append]
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hw hw'

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.ι_nNegF_mem_nNegFWordSpan
statement: lemma ι_nNegF_mem_nNegFWordSpan (i : ι) : ιᵤ (nNegF P i) ∈ nNegFWordSpan P (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨[i], by simp, by simp [nNegFWord]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.map_nNegFWord_mem
statement:
lemma map_nNegFWord_mem (w : List ι) :
    jmap (nNegFWord P w) ∈ envWeightSpace P (-P.rootOf (AuxLieAlgebra.counts w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using one_mem_weightSpaceOfMap _
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [nNegFWord_cons, map_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, AuxLieAlgebra.counts_cons,
      map_add, neg_add, rootOf_single]
    exact mul_mem_weightSpaceOfMap _ (ι_mem_envWeightSpace P (f_mem_rootSpace P i)) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.nNegFWordSpan_le_comap
statement:
lemma nNegFWordSpan_le_comap (l : ι → ℤ) :
    nNegFWordSpan P l ≤ (envWeightSpace P (-P.rootOf l)).comap (jmap).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [nNegFWordSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact map_nNegFWord_mem P w

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.ι_mem_span_nNegFWord
statement:
lemma ι_mem_span_nNegFWord (x : (fHom P).range) :
    ιᵤ x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (nNegFWord P))
proof:
:= by
  set W := Submodule.span K (Set.range (nNegFWord P))
  have hW : ∀ u ∈ W, ∀ v ∈ W, u * v ∈ W := fun u hu v hv ↦ by
    have := Submodule.mul_mem_mul hu hv
    rw [Submodule.span_mul_span] at this
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ this
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, rfl⟩, _, ⟨w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w ++ w', nNegFWord_append P w w'⟩
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (fHom P).surjective_rangeRestrict x
  induction z using FreeLieAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of i =>
    have : (fHom P).rangeRestrict (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i) = nNegF P i :=
      Subtype.ext (fHom_of P i)
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨[i], by simp [nNegFWord]⟩
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  | lie y z hy hz =>
    rw [LieHom.map_lie, LieHom.map_lie, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket]
    exact sub_mem (hW _ hy _ hz) (hW _ hz _ hy)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.span_nNegFWord_le
statement: lemma span_nNegFWord_le : Submodule.span K (Set.range (nNegFWord P)) ≤ ⨆ l, nNegFWordSpan P l
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (AuxLieAlgebra.counts w) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_eq_sum_mul_of_mem
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sum_mul_of_mem {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {u : Û} (hu : u ∈ nNegFWordSpan P k) :
    ∃ y : ι → Û, (∀ i, y i ∈ nNegFWordSpan P (k - Pi.single i 1)) ∧
      u = ∑ i, y i * ιᵤ (nNegF P i)
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hu
    obtain rfl | ⟨w', i, rfl⟩ := List.eq_nil_or_concat w
    · exact absurd hw.symm (by simpa using hk)
    refine ⟨Pi.single i (nNegFWord P w'), fun j ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        rw [Pi.single_eq_same]
        refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨w', ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← hw, List.concat_eq_append, counts_append]
        simp
      · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]; exact zero_mem _
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, zero_mul])
        (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same, List.concat_eq_append, nNegFWord_append]
      simp [nNegFWord]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ ↦ zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | add u v _ _ hu hv =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := hv
    exact ⟨y + y', fun i ↦ add_mem (hy i) (hy' i), by
      simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]⟩
  | smul c u _ hu =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hu
    exact ⟨c • y, fun i ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ c (hy i), by
      simp [Finset.smul_sum]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.isCompl_range_fHom_borel
statement:
theorem isCompl_range_fHom_borel :
    IsCompl (fHom P).range.toSubmodule (borel P).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr fun x hx hx' ↦ ?_,
    Submodule.codisjoint_iff_exists_add_eq.mpr fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, _, ⟨z, rfl⟩, hyz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx'
    change h P a + eHom P z = fHom P y at hyz
    have := triangular_eq_zero P hA (y := y) (a := -a) (z := -z) (by
      rw [map_neg, map_neg, ← hyz]; abel)
    exact this.1
  · obtain ⟨y, a, z, rfl⟩ := exists_triangular P x
    exact ⟨fHom P y, h P a + eHom P z, ⟨y, rfl⟩,
      Submodule.add_mem_sup ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨z, rfl⟩, (add_assoc _ _ _).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.map_incl_range_fHom_injective
statement: theorem map_incl_range_fHom_injective : Function.Injective jmap
proof:
:=
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_incl_injective_of_isCompl (isCompl_range_fHom_borel P hA)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.disjoint_envDegGe
statement:
lemma disjoint_envDegGe {n : ℤ} {l : ι → ℤ} (hl : height l < n) :
    Disjoint (envWeightSpace P (-P.rootOf l)) (envDegGe P n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ((iSupIndep_weightSpaceOfMap _) (-P.rootOf l)).mono_right ?_
  refine iSup₂_le fun l' hl' ↦ le_iSup₂_of_le (-P.rootOf l') (fun h ↦ ?_) le_rfl
  rw [neg_inj] at h
  rw [P.rootOf_injective h] at hl'
  exact absurd hl' (not_le.mpr hl)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_eq_sum_mul_f
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sum_mul_f {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) {x : (fHom P).range}
    (hx : (x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) ∈ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf k)) :
    ∃ y : ι → Û, (∀ i, y i ∈ nNegFWordSpan P (k - Pi.single i 1)) ∧
      ιᵤ x = ∑ i, y i * ιᵤ (nNegF P i)
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_eq_sum_mul_of_mem P hk.2 ?_
  have h1 : ιᵤ x ∈ ⨆ l, nNegFWordSpan P l := span_nNegFWord_le P (ι_mem_span_nNegFWord P x)
  have h2 : jmap (ιᵤ x) ∈ envWeightSpace P (-P.rootOf k) := by
    rw [UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]; exact ι_mem_envWeightSpace P hx
  let N : Dual K H → Submodule K (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) :=
    fun μ ↦ ⨆ (l : ι → ℤ) (_ : -P.rootOf l = μ), (nNegFWordSpan P l).map (jmap).toLinearMap
  have hN : ∀ μ, N μ ≤ envWeightSpace P μ := fun μ ↦ iSup₂_le fun l hl ↦ hl ▸
    Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (nNegFWordSpan_le_comap P l)
  have h3 : jmap (ιᵤ x) ∈ ⨆ μ, N μ := by
    have : (⨆ l, nNegFWordSpan P l).map (jmap).toLinearMap ≤ ⨆ μ, N μ := by
      rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
      exact iSup_le fun l ↦ le_iSup_of_le (-P.rootOf l) (le_iSup₂_of_le l rfl le_rfl)
    exact this (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem h1)
  have h4 := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le _ N hN h2 h3
  have h5 : N (-P.rootOf k) ≤ (nNegFWordSpan P k).map (jmap).toLinearMap :=
    iSup₂_le fun l hl ↦ by rw [P.rootOf_injective (neg_inj.mp hl)]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := h5 h4
  rwa [← map_incl_range_fHom_injective P hA hyx]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.ι_mem_envDegGe_of_mem_radicalNeg
statement:
lemma ι_mem_envDegGe_of_mem_radicalNeg {k : ι → ℤ}
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf l) = ⊥)
    {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ radicalNeg P) : ιᵤ x ∈ envDegGe P (height k)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, ((radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P μ) :=
    inf_iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_le (h P) _ (fun _ _ hy ↦ (radicalNeg P).lie_mem hy) _
      ⟨hx, range_fHom_le P (radicalNeg_le_range_fHom P hA hx)⟩
  have : ⨆ μ ∈ P.negWeights, ((radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P μ) ≤
      (envDegGe P (height k)).comap (ιᵤ : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra →ₗ⁅K⁆ _).toLinearMap := by
    refine iSup₂_le fun μ hμ y hy ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := hμ
    by_cases hmk : height m < height k
    · rw [hmin m hm hmk, Submodule.mem_bot] at hy
      rw [hy, Submodule.mem_comap, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · exact mem_envDegGe_of_mem P (not_lt.mp hmk) (ι_mem_envWeightSpace P hy.2)
  exact this hx'

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.eq_zero_of_map_negProj_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_map_negProj_eq_zero {k : ι → ℤ}
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf l) = ⊥)
    {l : ι → ℤ} (hl : height l < height k) {u : Û} (hu : u ∈ nNegFWordSpan P l)
    (h0 : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map (negProjN P hA) u = 0) : u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mem_span_of_map_eq_zero (negProj_surjective P hA) h0
  let I : TwoSidedIdeal Û := TwoSidedIdeal.mk' {u | jmap u ∈ envDegGe P (height k)}
    (by simp) (fun hx hy ↦ by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_add] at *; exact add_mem hx hy)
    (fun hx ↦ by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_neg] at *; exact neg_mem hx)
    (fun {x y} hy ↦ by
      have := mul_mem_envDegGe P (map_mem_envDegGe_zero P x) hy
      rwa [zero_add, ← map_mul] at this)
    (fun {x y} hx ↦ by
      have := mul_mem_envDegGe P hx (map_mem_envDegGe_zero P y)
      rwa [add_zero, ← map_mul] at this)
  have h2 : TwoSidedIdeal.span (ιᵤ '' {x | negProjN P hA x = 0}) ≤ I := by
    rw [TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_mk', Set.mem_ofPred_eq, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]
    exact ι_mem_envDegGe_of_mem_radicalNeg P hA hmin ((negProj_eq_zero_iff P hA).mp hx)
  have h3 : jmap u ∈ envDegGe P (height k) := (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_mk' _ _ _ _ _ _ u).mp (h2 h1)
  have h4 := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (disjoint_envDegGe P hl) _ (nNegFWordSpan_le_comap P l hu)
    h3
  exact map_incl_range_fHom_injective P hA (h4.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.negProj_nNegF
statement: lemma negProj_nNegF (i : ι) : negProjN P hA (nNegF P i) = KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegF P i
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (toKacMoody_f P hA i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.map_negProj_nNegFWord
statement:
lemma map_negProj_nNegFWord (w : List ι) :
    UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map (negProjN P hA) (nNegFWord P w) =
      KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegFWord P w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact map_one _
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [nNegFWord_cons, map_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, negProj_nNegF, ih,
      KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegFWord_cons]

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.map_negProj_nNegFWordSpan
statement:
lemma map_negProj_nNegFWordSpan (l : ι → ℤ) :
    (nNegFWordSpan P l).map (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map (negProjN P hA)).toLinearMap =
      KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegFWordSpan P l
proof:
:= by
  rw [nNegFWordSpan, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
  congr 1
  exact Set.image_congr fun w _ ↦ map_negProj_nNegFWord P hA w

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_fWord_nil
statement: lemma rep_fWord_nil (v : V) : rep P V (fWord P []) v = v
proof: := by simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_fWord_cons
statement:
lemma rep_fWord_cons (j : ι) (w : List ι) (v : V) :
    rep P V (fWord P (j :: w)) v = ⁅f P j, rep P V (fWord P w) v⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [VermaModule.fWord_cons, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, VermaModule.rep_ι]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace (w : List ι) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) μ) :
    rep P V (fWord P w) v ∈
      weightSpaceOfMap V (h P) (μ - P.rootOf (AuxLieAlgebra.counts w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa [rep_fWord_nil] using hv
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [rep_fWord_cons]
    convert lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (f_mem_rootSpace P j) ih using 2
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.counts_cons, map_add, rootOf_single]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_fWord_mem
statement:
lemma rep_fWord_mem (N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V) (w : List ι) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ N) : rep P V (fWord P w) v ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rwa [rep_fWord_nil]
  | cons j w ih => rw [rep_fWord_cons]; exact N.lie_mem ih

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.map_nNegFWord
statement: lemma map_nNegFWord (w : List ι) : mapN (nNegFWord P w) = fWord P w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact map_one _
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [nNegFWord_cons, map_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, ih, VermaModule.fWord_cons]
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.rep_eq_smul
statement:
lemma rep_eq_smul {Λ : Dual K H} (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K P.KacMoodyAlgebra)
    (m : VermaModule P Λ) : rep P (VermaModule P Λ) u m = u • m
proof:
:=
  (VermaModule.map_smul_eq_rep P Λ LieModuleHom.id u m).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_e_lie_f_hwv_zero
statement: lemma lie_e_lie_f_hwv_zero (i j : ι) : ⁅e P j, ⁅f P i, VermaModule.hwv P 0⁆⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leibniz_lie, lie_e_f, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, lie_zero, add_zero]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_f_hwv_zero_mem
statement:
lemma lie_f_hwv_zero_mem (i : ι) :
    ⁅f P i, VermaModule.hwv P 0⁆ ∈ VermaModule.weightSpace P 0 (-P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (f_mem_rootSpace P i) (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P 0)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygyComponent_hwv
statement:
lemma syzygyComponent_hwv (i : ι) :
    syzygyComponent P i (VermaModule.hwv P (-P.root i)) = ⁅f P i, VermaModule.hwv P 0⁆
proof:
:=
  VermaModule.lift_hwv P _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygyMap_of
statement:
lemma syzygyMap_of (i : ι) (v : VermaModule P (-P.root i)) :
    syzygyMap P (DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ VermaModule P (-P.root i)) i v) = syzygyComponent P i v
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toModule_lof (M := fun i ↦ VermaModule P (-P.root i)) K i v

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygyMap_apply
statement: lemma syzygyMap_apply (m : VermaSum P) : syzygyMap P m = ∑ i, syzygyComponent P i (m i)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_univ_of m]
  rw [map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ syzygyMap_of P i (m i)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_syzygies_iff
statement: lemma mem_syzygies_iff {m : VermaSum P} : m ∈ syzygies P ↔ syzygyMap P m = 0
proof:
:=
  LieModuleHom.mem_ker

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.apply_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:=
  map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P
    (DirectSum.lieModuleComponent K ι P.KacMoodyAlgebra (fun i ↦ VermaModule P (-P.root i)) i) hm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.of_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma of_mem_weightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {i : ι} {v : VermaModule P (-P.root i)}
    (hv : v ∈ VermaModule.weightSpace P (-P.root i) μ) :
    DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ VermaModule P (-P.root i)) i v ∈
      weightSpaceOfMap (VermaSum P) (h P) μ
proof:
:=
  map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P
    (DirectSum.lieModuleOf K ι P.KacMoodyAlgebra (fun i ↦ VermaModule P (-P.root i)) i) hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lowerSyzygies_le
statement: lemma lowerSyzygies_le (k : ι → ℤ) : lowerSyzygies P k ≤ syzygies P
proof:
:=
  LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr fun _ ht ↦ ht.1

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_f_mem_lowerSyzygySpan
statement:
lemma lie_f_mem_lowerSyzygySpan (k : ι → ℤ) (j : ι) :
    ∀ m ∈ lowerSyzygySpan P k, ⁅f P j, m⁆ ∈ lowerSyzygySpan P k
proof:
:= by
  refine VermaModule.lie_mem_span_of_forall P ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j :: w, t, ht, (rep_fWord_cons P j w t).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_mem_lowerSyzygySpan
statement:
lemma lie_h_mem_lowerSyzygySpan (k : ι → ℤ) (a : H) :
    ∀ m ∈ lowerSyzygySpan P k, ⁅h P a, m⁆ ∈ lowerSyzygySpan P k
proof:
:= by
  refine VermaModule.lie_mem_span_of_forall P ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩
  rw [rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace P w ht.2.choose_spec.2 a]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_e_mem_lowerSyzygySpan
statement:
lemma lie_e_mem_lowerSyzygySpan (k : ι → ℤ) (i : ι) :
    ∀ m ∈ lowerSyzygySpan P k, ⁅e P i, m⁆ ∈ lowerSyzygySpan P k
proof:
:= by
  refine VermaModule.lie_mem_span_of_forall P ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    obtain ⟨hts, l, hl, htl⟩ := ht
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], ⁅e P i, t⁆, ⟨(syzygies P).lie_mem hts,
      l - Pi.single i 1, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have := height_add (l - Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single i 1)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
      have h1 : height (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) = 1 := by simp [height]
      omega
    · have he : e P i ∈ rootSpace P (P.root i) := fun a ↦ lie_h_e P a i
      convert lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) he htl using 2
      rw [map_sub, rootOf_single]
      abel
    · rw [rep_fWord_nil, rep_fWord_nil]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [rep_fWord_cons, leibniz_lie, lie_e_f]
    refine add_mem ?_ (lie_f_mem_lowerSyzygySpan P k j _ ih)
    split_ifs
    · exact lie_h_mem_lowerSyzygySpan P k _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩)
    · rw [zero_lie]; exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lowerSyzygies_le_lowerSyzygySpan
statement:
lemma lowerSyzygies_le_lowerSyzygySpan (k : ι → ℤ) :
    (lowerSyzygies P k).toSubmodule ≤ lowerSyzygySpan P k
proof:
:= by
  let N : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaSum P) :=
    { lowerSyzygySpan P k with
      lie_mem := fun {x m} hm ↦ lie_mem_of_generators P (lowerSyzygySpan P k)
        (lie_e_mem_lowerSyzygySpan P k) (lie_f_mem_lowerSyzygySpan P k)
        (lie_h_mem_lowerSyzygySpan P k) x m hm }
  have : lowerSyzygies P k ≤ N := LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le.mpr fun t ht ↦
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], t, ht, (rep_fWord_nil P t).symm⟩
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_eq_sum_of_mem_iSup
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem j s hs =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hs
    refine ⟨Pi.single j t, fun j' ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hj : j' = j
      · subst hj; rwa [Pi.single_eq_same]
      · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]; exact zero_mem _
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun j' _ hj ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, lie_zero])
        (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same]
      rfl
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ ↦ zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | add s s' _ _ hs hs' =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := hs'
    exact ⟨t + t', fun j ↦ add_mem (ht j) (ht' j), by
      simp [lie_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  have : (nNegFWordSpan P l).map (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).toLinearMap ≤
      VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf l) := by
    rw [nNegFWordSpan, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have := VermaModule.fWord_smul_mem_weightSpace P Λ w
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf] at this
    simpa [map_nNegFWord] using this
  exact this (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hτ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_mem_nNegFWordSpan
proof:
:= by
  rw [VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_wordSpan] at hm
  have : VermaModule.wordSpan P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf l) ≤
      (nNegFWordSpan P l).map (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).toLinearMap := by
    rw [VermaModule.wordSpan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨nNegFWord P w, Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · apply P.rootOf_injective
      rw [← AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_eq_rootOf]
      exact sub_right_injective hw
    · simp [map_nNegFWord]
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := this hm
  exact ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_f_equivEnvNNeg
statement:
