lemma lie_f_equivEnvNNeg {Λ : Dual K H} (j : ι) (τ : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P)) :
    ⁅f P j, equivEnvNNeg P Λ τ⁆ = equivEnvNNeg P Λ (ιᵤ (nNegF P j) * τ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_mul, VermaModule.lie_eq_smul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygyComponent_equivEnvNNeg
statement:
lemma syzygyComponent_equivEnvNNeg (i : ι) (τ : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra K (nNeg P)) :
    syzygyComponent P i (equivEnvNNeg P (-P.root i) τ) =
      equivEnvNNeg P 0 (τ * ιᵤ (nNegF P i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_apply, VermaModule.map_smul_eq_rep, syzygyComponent_hwv,
    rep_eq_smul, VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_mul, VermaModule.lie_eq_smul,
    VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_apply, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygyMap_eq_equivEnvNNeg
proof:
:= by
  rw [syzygyMap_apply, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [← ht i, syzygyComponent_equivEnvNNeg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_iSup_of_mem_lowerSyzygies
statement:
lemma mem_iSup_of_mem_lowerSyzygies {k : ι → ℤ} {s : VermaSum P} (hs : s ∈ lowerSyzygies P k)
    (hsk : s ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaSum P) (h P) (-P.rootOf k)) :
    s ∈ ⨆ j, ((syzygies P).toSubmodule ⊓
      weightSpaceOfMap (VermaSum P) (h P) (-P.rootOf (k - Pi.single j 1))).map
        (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaSum P) (f P j))
proof:
:= by
  let W : Dual K H → Submodule K (VermaSum P) := fun ν ↦ Submodule.span K
    {v | ∃ w t l, height l < height k ∧ t ∈ syzygies P ∧
      t ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaSum P) (h P) (-P.rootOf l) ∧
      -P.rootOf l - P.rootOf (AuxLieAlgebra.counts w) = ν ∧ v = rep P _ (fWord P w) t}
  have hW : ∀ ν, W ν ≤ weightSpaceOfMap (VermaSum P) (h P) ν := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨w, t, l, -, -, htl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace P w htl
  have h1 : s ∈ ⨆ ν, W ν := by
    refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ : lowerSyzygySpan P k ≤ _)
      (lowerSyzygies_le_lowerSyzygySpan P k hs)
    rintro _ ⟨w, t, ⟨hts, l, hl, htl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, t, l, hl, hts, htl, rfl, rfl⟩)
  have h2 := mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le (h P) W hW hsk h1
  refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ : W _ ≤ _) h2
  rintro _ ⟨w, t, l, hl, hts, htl, hν, rfl⟩
  have hlw : l + AuxLieAlgebra.counts w = k := by
    apply P.rootOf_injective
    rw [map_add, ← neg_inj, neg_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact hν
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, w, rfl⟩ : w = [] ∨ ∃ j w', w = j :: w' := by
    cases w with
    | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
    | cons j w => exact Or.inr ⟨j, w, rfl⟩
  · rw [AuxLieAlgebra.counts_nil, add_zero] at hlw
    exact absurd hl (by rw [hlw]; exact lt_irrefl _)
  · refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j ⟨rep P _ (fWord P w) t,
      ⟨rep_fWord_mem P (syzygies P) w hts, ?_⟩, (rep_fWord_cons P j w t).symm⟩
    have e : -P.rootOf (k - Pi.single j 1) = -P.rootOf l - P.rootOf (AuxLieAlgebra.counts w) := by
      rw [← hlw, AuxLieAlgebra.counts_cons, map_sub, map_add, map_add, rootOf_single]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact rep_fWord_mem_weightSpace P w htl

name: Matrix.Realization.height_sub_single
statement:
lemma height_sub_single (k : ι → ℤ) (i : ι) :
    height (k - Pi.single i 1) = height k - 1
proof:
:= by
  have := height_add (k - Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single i 1)
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
  have h1 : height (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) = 1 := by simp [height]
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.exists_syzygy
statement:
theorem exists_syzygy {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      (radicalNeg P).toSubmodule ⊓ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf l) = ⊥)
    {x : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ radicalNeg P) (hxk : x ∈ rootSpace P (-P.rootOf k))
    (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygies P,
      s ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaSum P) (KacMoodyAlgebra.h P) (-P.rootOf k) ∧
      s ∉ KacMoodyAlgebra.lowerSyzygies P k ∧
      ∀ i, ⁅KacMoodyAlgebra.e P i, s⁆ ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.lowerSyzygies P k
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : ∀ i, height (k - Pi.single i 1) < height k := fun i ↦ by
    rw [height_sub_single]; omega
  
  let x' : (fHom P).range := ⟨x, by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := radicalNeg_le_range_fHom P hA hx
    exact ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_eq_sum_mul_f P hA hk (x := x') hxk
  have hφy : ∀ i, mapφ (y i) ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegFWordSpan P (k - Pi.single i 1) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← map_negProj_nNegFWordSpan P hA]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (hy i)
  let s : KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaSum P := ∑ i, DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule P
    (-P.root i)) i (KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P _ (mapφ (y i)))
  have hs : ∀ i, s i = KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P _ (mapφ (y i)) := fun i ↦ by
    simp [s, DirectSum.of_apply]
  have hsw : s ∈ weightSpaceOfMap (KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaSum P) (KacMoodyAlgebra.h P)
      (-P.rootOf k) := by
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ KacMoodyAlgebra.of_mem_weightSpace P ?_
    have := KacMoodyAlgebra.equivEnvNNeg_mem_weightSpace P (Λ := -P.root i) (hφy i)
    rwa [show -P.root i - P.rootOf (k - Pi.single i 1) = -P.rootOf k by
      rw [map_sub, rootOf_single]; abel] at this
  have hsS : s ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygies P := by
    rw [KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_syzygies_iff,
      KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygyMap_eq_equivEnvNNeg P (fun i ↦ (hs i).symm)]
    have : ∑ i, mapφ (y i) * ιᵤ (KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegF P i) = mapφ (ιᵤ x') := by
      rw [hxy, map_sum]
      simp_rw [map_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, negProj_nNegF]
    rw [this, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι,
      show negProjN P hA x' = 0 from (negProj_eq_zero_iff P hA (x := x')).mpr hx, map_zero,
      map_zero]
  refine ⟨s, hsS, hsw, ?_, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  swap
  · 
    refine LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨(KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygies P).lie_mem hsS,
      k - Pi.single i 1, hlt i, ?_⟩
    have he : KacMoodyAlgebra.e P i ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.rootSpace P (P.root i) :=
      fun a ↦ KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_h_e P a i
    have := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (KacMoodyAlgebra.h P) he hsw
    rwa [show P.root i + -P.rootOf k = -P.rootOf (k - Pi.single i 1) by
      rw [map_sub, rootOf_single]; abel] at this
  
  intro hsT
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_eq_sum_of_mem_iSup P
    (KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_iSup_of_mem_lowerSyzygies P hsT hsw)
  
  have hτ : ∀ j i, ∃ τ ∈ KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegFWordSpan P (k - Pi.single j 1 - Pi.single i 1),
      KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P (-P.root i) τ = t j i := fun j i ↦ by
    have := KacMoodyAlgebra.apply_mem_weightSpace P (ht j).2 i
    refine KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_mem_nNegFWordSpan P ?_
    rwa [show -P.root i - P.rootOf (k - Pi.single j 1 - Pi.single i 1) =
      -P.rootOf (k - Pi.single j 1) by
        rw [map_sub (P.rootOf) (k - Pi.single j 1), rootOf_single]; abel]
  choose τ hτS hτe using hτ
  have hlift : ∀ j i, ∃ τ' ∈ nNegFWordSpan P (k - Pi.single j 1 - Pi.single i 1),
      mapφ τ' = τ j i := fun j i ↦ by
    have := hτS j i
    rw [← map_negProj_nNegFWordSpan P hA] at this
    obtain ⟨τ', h1, h2⟩ := this
    exact ⟨τ', h1, h2⟩
  choose τ' hτ'S hτ'e using hlift
  
  have hrel : ∀ j, ∑ i, τ j i * ιᵤ (KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegF P i) = 0 := fun j ↦ by
    have h1 := (KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_syzygies_iff P).mp (ht j).1
    rwa [KacMoodyAlgebra.syzygyMap_eq_equivEnvNNeg P (hτe j),
      LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at h1
  have hρ : ∀ j, ∑ i, τ' j i * ιᵤ (nNegF P i) = 0 := fun j ↦ by
    refine eq_zero_of_map_negProj_eq_zero P hA hmin (hlt j)
      (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_) ?_
    · have := mul_mem_nNegFWordSpan P (hτ'S j i) (ι_nNegF_mem_nNegFWordSpan P i)
      rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
    · rw [map_sum]
      simp_rw [map_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, negProj_nNegF, hτ'e]
      exact hrel j
  
  have hcomp : ∀ i, mapφ (y i) = ∑ j, ιᵤ (KacMoodyAlgebra.nNegF P j) * τ j i := fun i ↦ by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun v : KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaSum P ↦ v i) hst
    simp only [hs, DirectSum.sum_apply, DirectSum.lie_module_bracket_apply] at h1
    simp_rw [← hτe, KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_f_equivEnvNNeg, ← map_sum] at h1
    exact (KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P _).injective h1
  have hy' : ∀ i, y i = ∑ j, ιᵤ (nNegF P j) * τ' j i := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    refine eq_zero_of_map_negProj_eq_zero P hA hmin (hlt i)
      (sub_mem (hy i) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ ?_)) ?_
    · have := mul_mem_nNegFWordSpan P (ι_nNegF_mem_nNegFWordSpan P j) (hτ'S j i)
      rwa [show Pi.single j 1 + (k - Pi.single j 1 - Pi.single i 1) = k - Pi.single i 1 by
        abel] at this
    · rw [map_sub, hcomp i, map_sum]
      simp_rw [map_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, negProj_nNegF, hτ'e]
      exact sub_self _
  
  apply hx0
  have hι : ιᵤ x' = 0 := by
    rw [hxy]
    simp_rw [hy', Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum, hρ, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_injective K (fHom P).range (hι.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_ne_self_of_regular
statement:
theorem apply_ne_self_of_regular {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, μ (P.coroot i) = n + 1)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA} (hw : w ≠ 1) : (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ ≠ μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw
  have hnd : ¬cs.IsRightDescent (w * cs.simple i) i := by
    rwa [← isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul]
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hnd
  have hdom : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, μ (P.coroot i) = n := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hμ i
    exact ⟨n + 1, by rw [hn]; push_cast; rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA hdom (w * cs.simple i)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hμ i
  simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple, cs] at hwk hwl
  have hw' : (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ =
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.reflection hA i μ) -
        ((m : K) + 1) • (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.reflection hA i (P.root i)) := by
    rw [reflection_apply P hA i μ, reflection_root_self, map_sub, map_smul, map_neg, hm]
    module
  have heq : μ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf (k + ((m : ℤ) + 1) • l) := by
    rw [hw', map_add, map_zsmul, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, ← hwk, ← hwl]
    push_cast
    abel
  intro h
  rw [h, sub_self, eq_comm, ← map_zero P.rootOf, P.rootOf_injective.eq_iff] at heq
  have hl0 : l = 0 := funext fun j ↦ by
    have h1 := congr_fun heq j
    have h2 := hk j
    have h3 := hl j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
    nlinarith
  rw [hl0, map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hwl
  exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hwl

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_injective_of_regular
statement:
theorem apply_injective_of_regular {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, μ (P.coroot i) = n + 1) :
    Function.Injective fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦ (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro w w' h
  by_contra hne
  have h1 : w'⁻¹ * w ≠ 1 := fun h1 ↦ hne (inv_mul_eq_one.mp h1).symm
  refine P.apply_ne_self_of_regular hA hμ h1 ?_
  simp only at h
  rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, h, Subgroup.coe_inv]
  exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ μ

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.exists_apply_eq_of_isWeylAntiInvariant
statement:
theorem exists_apply_eq_of_isWeylAntiInvariant (S : A.Symmetrization) {X : P.CharacterRing ℤ}
    (hX : X.IsWeylAntiInvariant P hA) {Λ₀ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ₀ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, Λ₀ (P.coroot i) = n + 1)
    (hsupp : ∀ μ, X.coeffAt μ ≠ 0 → (∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ Λ₀ - μ = P.rootOf k) ∧
      P.dualBilinForm S μ μ = P.dualBilinForm S Λ₀ Λ₀)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : X.coeffAt μ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) Λ₀ = μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hXw : ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA, X.coeffAt ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro w
    rw [hX w μ]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) hμ
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧
      Λ₀ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k ∧ height k = n := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := (hsupp μ hμ).1
    refine ⟨(height k).toNat, 1, k, hk, by simpa using hk', ?_⟩
    exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hk i)).symm
  obtain ⟨w, k, hk, hwk, hht⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  set ν := (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ with hν
  
  have hdom : ∀ i, ∃ m : ℕ, ν (P.coroot i) = m := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hΛ₀ i
    set m : ℤ := n + 1 - (A *ᵥ k) i
    have hm : ν (P.coroot i) = m := by
      have : ν = Λ₀ - P.rootOf k := by rw [← hwk]; abel
      rw [this, LinearMap.sub_apply, hn, rootOf_apply_coroot]
      push_cast [m]
      ring
    
    obtain ⟨k', hk', hwk'⟩ := (hsupp _ (hXw ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i * w))).1
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple, ← hν] at hwk'
    have hkk' : k' = k + m • Pi.single i 1 := by
      refine P.rootOf_injective ?_
      rw [← hwk', map_add, map_zsmul, rootOf_single, ← hwk, reflection_apply, hm,
        ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
      abel
    have hmin := Nat.find_min' hex ⟨(P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i * w, k', hk',
      by simpa only [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple] using hwk',
      (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hk' j)).symm⟩
    have hht' : height k' = height k + m := by
      rw [hkk']
      simp [height, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Pi.single_apply]
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by
      have h1 : ((height k').toNat : ℤ) = height k' :=
        Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hk' j)
      have h2 : (Nat.find hex : ℤ) ≤ height k' := by rw [← h1]; exact_mod_cast hmin
      linarith
    exact ⟨m.toNat, by rw [hm]; exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hm0).symm⟩
  
  choose n hn using hΛ₀
  choose m hm using hdom
  have hsymm := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq
  have hΛν : Λ₀ = ν + P.rootOf k := by rw [← hwk]; abel
  have h1 : P.dualBilinForm S (P.rootOf k) (Λ₀ + ν) = 0 := by
    have := (hsupp ν (hXw w)).2
    rw [hΛν] at this ⊢
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at this ⊢
    rw [hsymm ν (P.rootOf k)] at this
    linear_combination -this
  have h2 : P.dualBilinForm S (P.rootOf k) (Λ₀ + ν) =
      ((∑ i, (k i : ℚ) * ((n i + m i + 1) / S.ε i) : ℚ) : K) := by
    rw [rootOf_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hsymm, dualBilinForm_root_right]
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, hm]
    ring
  rw [h2, Rat.cast_eq_zero] at h1
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun i _ ↦ mul_nonneg
      (by exact_mod_cast hk i) (div_nonneg (by positivity) (S.ε_pos i).le)).mp h1
    ext i
    have hi := this i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [mul_eq_zero, div_eq_zero_iff] at hi
    have : (n i : ℚ) + m i + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simpa [this, (S.ε_pos i).ne'] using hi
  refine ⟨w⁻¹, ?_⟩
  rw [hΛν, hk0, map_zero, add_zero, hν, Subgroup.coe_inv]
  exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ μ

name: Matrix.Realization.CharacterRing.coeffAt_eq_finsum_of_isWeylAntiInvariant
statement:
theorem coeffAt_eq_finsum_of_isWeylAntiInvariant (S : A.Symmetrization) {X : P.CharacterRing ℤ}
    (hX : X.IsWeylAntiInvariant P hA) {Λ₀ : Dual K H}
    (hΛ₀ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, Λ₀ (P.coroot i) = n + 1) (hX₀ : X.coeffAt Λ₀ = 1)
    (hsupp : ∀ μ, X.coeffAt μ ≠ 0 → (∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ Λ₀ - μ = P.rootOf k) ∧
      P.dualBilinForm S μ μ = P.dualBilinForm S Λ₀ Λ₀) (μ : Dual K H) :
    X.coeffAt μ = ∑ᶠ w : P.weylGroup hA,
      if (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) Λ₀ = μ then (-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA, (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) Λ₀ = μ
  · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [finsum_eq_single _ w fun w' hw' ↦ ite_eq_right fun h ↦ hw'
      (P.apply_injective_of_regular hA hΛ₀ h), ite_eq_left rfl, hX w Λ₀, hX₀, mul_one]
  · rw [finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun w ↦ ite_eq_right fun h' ↦ h ⟨w, h'⟩]
    by_contra hμ
    exact h (exists_apply_eq_of_isWeylAntiInvariant S hX hΛ₀ hsupp hμ)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsCasimirModule.coeffAt_character
statement:
lemma coeffAt_character (hV : IsCasimirModule P p S V Λs c) (μ : Dual K H) :
    hV.character.coeffAt μ = finrank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsCasimirModule.coeffAt_character_mul_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coeffAt_character_mul_denominator_ne_zero {V : Type (max u v w)} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [Module (P.SuperEnveloping p) V] [IsScalarTower K (P.SuperEnveloping p) V]
    (hV : IsCasimirModule P p S V Λs c) {ν : Dual K H}
    (hν : (hV.character * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P).coeffAt ν ≠ 0) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (ν + 2 • P.rho) ν = c ∧ ∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hexp⟩ := hV.exists_expansion hA ν
  set A' : P.CharacterRing ℤ := ofFun P (fun κ ↦ a κ) ⟨Λs, fun κ hκ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hle⟩ := (ha κ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hκ)).2
    obtain ⟨d, hd, h⟩ := (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).1 hle
    exact ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, h⟩⟩
  have hF : ∀ μ, toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P ν →
      hV.character.coeffAt μ = (A' * vermaChar P p).coeffAt μ := by
    intro μ hμ
    rw [coeffAt_character, hexp μ hμ, CharacterRing.coeff_mul,
      finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := a.support)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun κ _ ↦ ?_
      rw [coeffAt_vermaChar, neg_sub]
      rfl
    · intro κ hκ
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hκ
      exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 (left_ne_zero_of_mul hκ)
  rw [coeffAt_mul_congr isNegSupported_denominator hF, mul_assoc,
    vermaChar_mul_denominator S hA hp, mul_one] at hν
  exact ha ν (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hν)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isCasimirModule_fPowQuotient
statement:
lemma isCasimirModule_fPowQuotient :
    IsCasimirModule P p S (FPowQuotient P p Λ n) {Λ} (P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ)
proof:
:=
  (IsCasimirModule.gVerma hA ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_singleton_self _, le_rfl⟩).quotient _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace_fPowQuotient_self
statement:
lemma finrank_modWeightSpace_fPowQuotient_self (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (FPowQuotient P p Λ n) Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set N := fPowSubmodule P p Λ n
  have hW := modWeightSpace_quotient N isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top Λ
  rw [modWeightSpace_self, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hW
  have hx : N.mkQ (hwv P p Λ) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by
    refine fPowSubmodule_ne_top hA hn hodd ?_
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_hwv, Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).1 h
  rw [hW]
  exact finrank_span_singleton hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isWeylInvariant_character
statement:
lemma isWeylInvariant_character :
    (character p S hA Λ n).IsWeylInvariant P hA
proof:
:= fun w hw μ ↦ by
  rw [IsCasimirModule.coeffAt_character, IsCasimirModule.coeffAt_character]
  unfold Module.finrank
  rw [rank_modWeightSpace_weylGroup hA (isIntegrable_fPowQuotient S hA hp) hw μ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character
statement:
theorem exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) :
    exp P ℤ P.rho * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P * character p S hA Λ n =
      weylAltSum P hA (KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isDominantIntegral_add_rho
        fun i ↦ ⟨n i, hn i⟩)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set hV := isCasimirModule_fPowQuotient (p := p) (Λ := Λ) (n := n) S hA
  have hcoeff : ∀ ν,
      (exp P ℤ P.rho * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P * character p S hA Λ n).coeffAt ν =
      (hV.character * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P).coeffAt (ν - P.rho) := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [mul_assoc, coeff_exp_mul, mul_comm]
  have hsupp : ∀ ν, hV.character.coeffAt ν ≠ 0 → ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ν = Λ - P.rootOf k :=
    fun ν hν ↦ by
      have hne : modWeightSpace P p (FPowQuotient P p Λ n) ν ≠ ⊥ :=
        fun h ↦ hν (by rw [IsCasimirModule.coeffAt_character, h, finrank_bot]; rfl)
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hne
      obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', d, hd, h⟩ := hV.isBounded.exists_eq_sub hx hx0
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hΛ'
      exact ⟨d, hd, hΛ' ▸ h⟩
  ext μ
  rw [coeffAt_weylAltSum]
  refine coeffAt_eq_finsum_of_isWeylAntiInvariant S
    ((KacMoodyAlgebra.isWeylAntiInvariant_exp_rho_mul_denominator hA).mul
      (isWeylInvariant_character S hA hp)) (fun i ↦ ⟨n i, by
        rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hn, rho_coroot]⟩) ?_ (fun ν hν ↦ ?_) μ
  · rw [hcoeff, add_sub_cancel_right]
    have hF : ∀ ν, toWeightOrd P ν ≤ toWeightOrd P Λ →
        hV.character.coeffAt ν = (exp P ℤ Λ).coeffAt ν := by
      intro ν hνΛ
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).1 hνΛ
      rw [← mul_one (exp P ℤ Λ), coeff_exp_mul, coeffAt_one]
      by_cases hνΛ' : ν = Λ
      · subst ν
        simp only [sub_self, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [IsCasimirModule.coeffAt_character,
          finrank_modWeightSpace_fPowQuotient_self hA hn hodd, Nat.cast_one]
      · simp only [sub_eq_zero, hνΛ', ↓reduceIte]
        by_contra h0
        obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := hsupp ν h0
        refine hνΛ' ?_
        have h0' : P.rootOf (k + d) = P.rootOf 0 := by
          rw [map_add, map_zero]
          linear_combination (norm := module) hk' + hd'
        have hkd := P.rootOf_injective h0'
        have hd0 : d = 0 := le_antisymm (fun i ↦ by
          have h1 := congr_fun hkd i
          have h2 := hk i
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 ⊢
          omega) hd
        rw [hd', hd0, map_zero, sub_zero]
    rw [coeffAt_mul_congr isNegSupported_denominator hF, coeff_exp_mul, sub_self,
      coeffAt_denominator_zero]
  · rw [hcoeff] at hν
    obtain ⟨hform, Λ', hΛ', hle⟩ := hV.coeffAt_character_mul_denominator_ne_zero hA hp hν
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hΛ'
    subst hΛ'
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).1 hle
    refine ⟨⟨k, hk, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hk' ⊢
      rw [hk']
      abel
    · have := (KacMoodyAlgebra.dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho_eq_iff S Λ' (ν - P.rho)).mpr hform.symm
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
      exact this.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.character_eq_character
statement:
theorem character_eq_character (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) :
    character p S hA Λ n = (KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P Λ).character
proof:
:= by
  have hS : A.IsSymmetrizable := Matrix.isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mpr ⟨S⟩
  have h := (exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character S hA hp hn hodd).trans
    (KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_denominator_mul_character hA hS
      fun i ↦ ⟨n i, hn i⟩).symm
  have hu : exp P ℤ (-P.rho) * vermaChar P p *
      (exp P ℤ P.rho * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← exp_add, neg_add_cancel, exp_zero,
      vermaChar_mul_denominator S hA hp, one_mul]
  rw [← one_mul (character p S hA Λ n), ← hu, mul_assoc, h, ← mul_assoc, hu, one_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exp_rho_eq_vermaChar_mul_weylAltSum
statement:
theorem exp_rho_eq_vermaChar_mul_weylAltSum :
    exp P ℤ P.rho = vermaChar P p *
      weylAltSum P hA (KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.isDominantIntegral_rho (P := P))
proof:
:= by
  have hS : A.IsSymmetrizable := Matrix.isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mpr ⟨S⟩
  rw [← KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_denominator hA hS, mul_comm (exp P ℤ _),
    ← mul_assoc, vermaChar_mul_denominator S hA hp, one_mul]

name: LinearMap.sum_apply_basis_smul_right
statement:
lemma LinearMap.sum_apply_basis_smul_right {ι K M N : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N]
    (B : M →ₗ[K] N →ₗ[K] K) (b : Basis ι K M) (a : Basis ι K N)
    (hB : ∀ k l, B (b k) (a l) = if k = l then 1 else 0) (n : N) :
    ∑ k, B (b k) n • a k = n
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← a.sum_repr n]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ congrArg (· • a k) ?_
  rw [show B (b k) n = B (b k) (∑ l, a.repr n l • a l) by rw [a.sum_repr], map_sum]
  simp [hB]

name: LinearMap.sum_apply_basis_smul_left
statement:
lemma LinearMap.sum_apply_basis_smul_left {ι K M N : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N]
    (B : M →ₗ[K] N →ₗ[K] K) (b : Basis ι K M) (a : Basis ι K N)
    (hB : ∀ k l, B (b k) (a l) = if k = l then 1 else 0) (m : M) :
    ∑ k, B m (a k) • b k = m
proof:
:=
  B.flip.sum_apply_basis_smul_right a b (fun k l ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, hB]; exact if_congr eq_comm rfl rfl) m

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootParity_add
statement:
lemma rootParity_add (k l : ι → ℤ) :
    rootParity p (k + l) = rootParity p k + rootParity p l
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootParity, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootParity_single
statement: lemma rootParity_single (j : ι) : rootParity p (Pi.single j 1) = p j
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootParity, Pi.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootParity_wordVec
statement: lemma rootParity_wordVec (w : List ι) : rootParity p (wordVec w) = (w.map p).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [rootParity]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [wordVec_cons, rootParity_add, rootParity_single, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sum_wordVec
statement: lemma sum_wordVec (w : List ι) : ∑ j, wordVec w j = w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [wordVec_cons, Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ih, Pi.single_apply,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, List.length_cons]
    push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_of_mem_nPlusRoot
statement:
lemma isHomog_of_mem_nPlusRoot {k : ι → ℤ} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ nPlusRoot P p k) : IsHomog P p (rootParity p k) x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, w, hk, rfl⟩ := hx
    have := isHomog_eLie P p i w
    rwa [add_comm, ← List.sum_cons, ← List.map_cons, ← rootParity_wordVec, hk] at this
  | zero => exact isHomog_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact hx.add hy
  | smul c x _ hx => exact hx.smul c

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightParity_rootOf
statement: lemma weightParity_rootOf (k : ι → ℤ) : weightParity P p (P.rootOf k) = rootParity p k
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : ∃ l, P.rootOf l = P.rootOf k := ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [weightParity, hμ, ↓reduceDIte]
  rw [P.rootOf_injective hμ.choose_spec]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootParity_neg
statement: lemma rootParity_neg (k : ι → ℤ) : rootParity p (-k) = rootParity p k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rootParity, Pi.neg_apply, Int.cast_neg, ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightParity_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma weightParity_neg (μ : Dual K H) : weightParity P p (-μ) = weightParity P p μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : ∃ k, P.rootOf k = μ
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hμ
    rw [← map_neg, weightParity_rootOf, weightParity_rootOf, rootParity_neg]
  · have hμ' : ¬∃ k, P.rootOf k = -μ := fun ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ hμ ⟨-k, by rw [map_neg, hk, neg_neg]⟩
    simp only [weightParity, hμ, hμ', ↓reduceDIte]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_of_mem_gRoot
statement:
theorem isHomog_of_mem_gRoot {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gRoot P p μ) :
    IsHomog P p (weightParity P p μ) x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · rw [hx0]; exact isHomog_zero _
  rcases mem_allWeights P p hx.1 hx.2 hx0 with (⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ | hμ) | ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · simp only at hx ⊢
    rw [weightParity_neg, weightParity_rootOf]
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyk, rfl⟩ := exists_omega_eq P p hx.1 hx.2
    refine (isHomog_of_mem_nPlusRoot P p ?_).omega
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf P p hk]; exact ⟨hy, hyk⟩
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hμ
    subst hμ
    rw [← map_zero P.rootOf, weightParity_rootOf, rootParity, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ ↦ by simp]
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : x ∈ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]; exact hx
    exact isHomog_h P p a
  · rw [weightParity_rootOf]
    refine isHomog_of_mem_nPlusRoot P p ?_
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf P p hk]; exact hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_nPlusRoot_generators
statement:
lemma finite_nPlusRoot_generators (k : ι → ℤ) :
    {x | ∃ i w, wordVec (i :: w) = k ∧ eLie P p i w = x}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let eL : List ι → P.SuperEnveloping p := fun l ↦ match l with
    | [] => 0
    | i :: w => eLie P p i w
  refine ((List.finite_length_eq ι (∑ j, k j).toNat).image eL).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, w, hk, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨i :: w, ?_, rfl⟩
  have := sum_wordVec (i :: w)
  rw [hk] at this
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, this]
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_maxIdeal_of_forall_invForm_right
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_maxIdeal_iff P p S hy.1).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
  refine induction_on_gTilde P p (q := fun x ↦ invForm P p S x y = 0) hx
    (fun ν x hx hxν ↦ ?_) fun x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
  by_cases hν : ν = -μ
  · subst hν; exact h0 x ⟨hx, hxν⟩
  · exact invForm_eq_zero P p S hxν hy.2 fun h ↦ hν (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_maxIdeal_of_forall_invForm_left
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_maxIdeal_of_forall_invForm_right P p S hx fun y hy ↦ ?_
  rw [invForm_swap P p S hx.1 hx.2 (isHomog_of_mem_gRoot P p hx) hy.1 hy.2
    (isHomog_of_mem_gRoot P p hy), h0 y hy, mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootPairing_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rootPairing_mk (μ : Dual K H) (x : gRoot P p μ) (y : gRoot P p (-μ)) :
    rootPairing P p S μ (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) =
      invForm P p S x y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootPairing_injective
statement: lemma rootPairing_injective (μ : Dual K H) : Function.Injective (rootPairing P p S μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun q hq ↦ ?_
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H x =>
  refine (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 ?_
  refine mem_maxIdeal_of_forall_invForm_left P p S x.2 fun y hy ↦ ?_
  simpa using congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩)) hq

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootPairing_flip_injective
statement:
lemma rootPairing_flip_injective (μ : Dual K H) :
    Function.Injective (rootPairing P p S μ).flip
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun q hq ↦ ?_
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H y =>
  refine (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 ?_
  refine mem_maxIdeal_of_forall_invForm_right P p S y.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rw [neg_neg] at hx
  simpa using congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩)) hq

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootPairing_rootBasisQ_rootCobasisQ
statement:
lemma rootPairing_rootBasisQ_rootCobasisQ (μ : Dual K H) (k l : RootIdx P p μ) :
    rootPairing P p S μ (rootBasisQ P p μ k) (rootCobasisQ P p S μ l) =
      if k = l then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ (rootBasisQ P p μ k))
    ((rootPairing P p S μ).flip.apply_symm_toPerfPair_self ((rootBasisQ P p μ).dualBasis l))
  simp only [LinearMap.flip_apply] at this
  rw [rootCobasisQ, Basis.map_apply, this, Basis.dualBasis_apply_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mk_rootBasis
statement:
lemma mk_rootBasis (μ : Dual K H) (k : RootIdx P p μ) :
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (rootBasis P p μ k) = rootBasisQ P p μ k
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ _).choose_spec

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mk_rootCobasis
statement:
lemma mk_rootCobasis (μ : Dual K H) (k : RootIdx P p μ) :
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (rootCobasis P p S μ k) = rootCobasisQ P p S μ k
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ _).choose_spec

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_rootBasis_rootCobasis
statement:
theorem invForm_rootBasis_rootCobasis (μ : Dual K H) (k l : RootIdx P p μ) :
    invForm P p S (rootBasis P p μ k) (rootCobasis P p S μ l) = if k = l then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rootPairing_mk, mk_rootBasis, mk_rootCobasis, rootPairing_rootBasisQ_rootCobasisQ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sub_sum_rootBasis_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_sum_rootBasis_mem_maxIdeal {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ gRoot P p μ) :
    x - ∑ k, invForm P p S x (rootCobasis P p S μ k) • (rootBasis P p μ k : P.SuperEnveloping p)
      ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  have := (rootPairing P p S μ).sum_apply_basis_smul_left (rootBasisQ P p μ)
    (rootCobasisQ P p S μ) (rootPairing_rootBasisQ_rootCobasisQ P p S μ)
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩)
  simp only [← mk_rootCobasis, ← mk_rootBasis, rootPairing_mk] at this
  simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, ← map_smul, ← map_sum] at this
  have h := (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).1 this.symm
  simpa [rootRad] using h

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sub_sum_rootCobasis_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_sum_rootCobasis_mem_maxIdeal {μ : Dual K H} {y : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hy : y ∈ gRoot P p (-μ)) :
    y - ∑ k, invForm P p S (rootBasis P p μ k) y • (rootCobasis P p S μ k : P.SuperEnveloping p)
      ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  have := (rootPairing P p S μ).sum_apply_basis_smul_right (rootBasisQ P p μ)
    (rootCobasisQ P p S μ) (rootPairing_rootBasisQ_rootCobasisQ P p S μ)
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩)
  simp only [← mk_rootCobasis, ← mk_rootBasis, rootPairing_mk] at this
  simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, ← map_smul, ← map_sum] at this
  have h := (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).1 this.symm
  simpa [rootRad] using h

name: Matrix.Realization.zSign_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma zSign_zero : zSign K 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [zSign]

name: Matrix.Realization.zSign_one
statement: @[simp] lemma zSign_one : zSign K 1 = -1
proof: := by simp [zSign]

name: Matrix.Realization.zmod_two_cases
statement: lemma zmod_two_cases (a : ZMod 2) : a = 0 ∨ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases a
  exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl]

name: Matrix.Realization.zSign_add
statement: lemma zSign_add (a b : ZMod 2) : zSign K (a + b) = zSign K a * zSign K b
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;> rcases zmod_two_cases b with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]

name: Matrix.Realization.zSign_mul_self
statement: lemma zSign_mul_self (a : ZMod 2) : zSign K a * zSign K a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.superSign_eq_zSign
statement:
lemma superSign_eq_zSign {ι : Type*} (p : ι → ZMod 2) (i j : ι) :
    superSign K p i j = zSign K (p i * p j)
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases (p i) with hi | hi <;> rcases zmod_two_cases (p j) with hj | hj <;>
    simp [superSign, hi, hj]

name: Matrix.Realization.paritySign_eq_zSign
statement:
lemma paritySign_eq_zSign {ι : Type*} (p : ι → ZMod 2) (i : ι) :
    paritySign K p i = zSign K (p i)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsHomog.mul
statement:
lemma IsHomog.mul {a b : ZMod 2} {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsHomog P p a x)
    (hy : IsHomog P p b y) : IsHomog P p (a + b) (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHomog, map_mul, hx, hy, smul_mul_smul_comm, zSign_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsHomog.smul
statement:
lemma IsHomog.smul {a : ZMod 2} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsHomog P p a x) (c : K) :
    IsHomog P p a (c • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHomog, map_smul, hx, smul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsHomog.neg
statement:
lemma IsHomog.neg {a : ZMod 2} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsHomog P p a x) :
    IsHomog P p a (-x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHomog, map_neg, hx, smul_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsHomog.add
statement:
lemma IsHomog.add {a : ZMod 2} {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsHomog P p a x)
    (hy : IsHomog P p a y) : IsHomog P p a (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHomog, map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_zero
statement: lemma isHomog_zero (a : ZMod 2) : IsHomog P p a 0
proof: := by simp [IsHomog]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_e
statement: lemma isHomog_e (i : ι) : IsHomog P p (p i) (e P p i)
proof: := parity_e P p i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_f
statement: lemma isHomog_f (i : ι) : IsHomog P p (p i) (f P p i)
proof: := parity_f P p i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_h
statement: lemma isHomog_h (a : H) : IsHomog P p 0 (h P p a)
proof: := by simp [IsHomog]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_of_isHomog
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases b with rfl | rfl
  · rw [superBracket_of_even_right P p x (by rw [IsEven, hy, zSign_zero, one_smul]), mul_zero,
      zSign_zero, one_smul]
  · have hy' : parity P p y = -y := by rw [hy, zSign_one, neg_one_smul]
    rw [superBracket, hx, hy', add_neg_cancel, zero_mul, zero_add, sub_neg_eq_add,
      ← two_smul K y, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_smul,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsHomog.superBracket
statement:
lemma IsHomog.superBracket {a b : ZMod 2} {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsHomog P p a x)
    (hy : IsHomog P p b y) : IsHomog P p (a + b) (superBracket P p x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog hx hy, IsHomog, map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, map_mul, hx, hy,
    smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm, zSign_add, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul,
    mul_comm (zSign K b) (zSign K a), mul_comm (zSign K (a * b))]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_jacobi
statement:
theorem superBracket_jacobi {a b c : ZMod 2} {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : IsHomog P p a x) (hy : IsHomog P p b y) (hz : IsHomog P p c z) :
    superBracket P p x (superBracket P p y z) =
      superBracket P p (superBracket P p x y) z +
        zSign K (a * b) • superBracket P p y (superBracket P p x z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog hx (hy.superBracket hz),
    superBracket_of_isHomog (hx.superBracket hy) hz,
    superBracket_of_isHomog hy (hx.superBracket hz), superBracket_of_isHomog hy hz,
    superBracket_of_isHomog hx hy, superBracket_of_isHomog hx hz]
  rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;> rcases zmod_two_cases b with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases zmod_two_cases c with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, zSign_zero, zSign_one,
      one_smul, neg_smul, show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl] <;> noncomm_ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  have hyx : ∀ {y'} {x'}, y' ∈ weightSpace P p ν → x' ∈ weightSpace P p μ →
      y' * x' ∈ weightSpace P p (μ + ν) := fun hy' hx' ↦ by
    rw [add_comm]; exact mul_mem_weightSpace P p hy' hx'
  refine sub_mem (mul_mem_weightSpace P p hx hy) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (add_mem ?_ ?_))
  · exact hyx (add_mem hy (parity_mem_weightSpace P p hy)) hx
  · exact hyx (sub_mem hy (parity_mem_weightSpace P p hy)) (parity_mem_weightSpace P p hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracketRight_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma superBracketRight_apply (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    superBracketRight P p x y = superBracket P p x y
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_smul_left
statement:
lemma superBracket_smul_left (c : K) (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    superBracket P p (c • x) y = c • superBracket P p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [superBracket, map_smul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_add,
    smul_comm c]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_zero_left
statement: lemma superBracket_zero_left (y : P.SuperEnveloping p) : superBracket P p 0 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using superBracket_smul_left (P := P) (p := p) 0 0 y

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_neg_left
statement:
lemma superBracket_neg_left (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    superBracket P p (-x) y = -superBracket P p x y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using superBracket_smul_left (P := P) (p := p) (-1) x y

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma eLie_nil (i : ι) : eLie P p i [] = e P p i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma eLie_cons (i j : ι) (w : List ι) :
    eLie P p i (j :: w) = superBracket P p (e P p j) (eLie P p i w)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_eLie
statement:
lemma isHomog_eLie (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    IsHomog P p ((w.map p).sum + p i) (eLie P p i w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using isHomog_e P p i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_assoc]
    exact (isHomog_e P p j).superBracket ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma eLie_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    eLie P p i w ∈ weightSpace P p ((w.map P.root).sum + P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using e_mem_weightSpace P p i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_assoc]
    exact superBracket_mem_weightSpace (e_mem_weightSpace P p j) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_mem_nPlus
statement: lemma eLie_mem_nPlus (i : ι) (w : List ι) : eLie P p i w ∈ nPlus P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨(i, w), rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mem_nPlus
statement: lemma e_mem_nPlus (i : ι) : e P p i ∈ nPlus P p
proof: := eLie_mem_nPlus P p i []

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_le_iff
statement:
lemma nPlus_le_iff {N : Submodule K (P.SuperEnveloping p)} :
    nPlus P p ≤ N ↔ ∀ i w, eLie P p i w ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [nPlus, Submodule.span_le, Set.range_subset_iff]
  exact Prod.forall

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_mem_nPlus
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_mem_nPlus (j : ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nPlus P p) :
    superBracket P p (e P p j) x ∈ nPlus P p
proof:
:= by
  have : nPlus P p ≤ (nPlus P p).comap (superBracketRight P p (e P p j)) :=
    (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ eLie_mem_nPlus P p i (j :: w)
  exact this hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace (a : H) {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) : superBracket P p (h P p a) x = μ a • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_even_left P p (isEven_h P p a), hx a, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_h_mem_nPlus
statement:
lemma superBracket_h_mem_nPlus (a : H) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nPlus P p) :
    superBracket P p (h P p a) x ∈ nPlus P p
proof:
:= by
  have : nPlus P p ≤ (nPlus P p).comap (superBracketRight P p (h P p a)) :=
    (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ by
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, superBracketRight_apply,
        superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p a (eLie_mem_weightSpace P p i w)]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w)
  exact this hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_h
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_h (j : ι) (a : H) :
    superBracket P p (e P p j) (h P p a) = -(P.root j a • e P p j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_even_right P p _ (isEven_h P p a), h_mul_e]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_mul_e
statement:
lemma f_mul_e (i j : ι) : f P p i * e P p j = superSign K p i j • (e P p j * f P p i) -
    superSign K p i j • if i = j then h P p (P.coroot i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [e_mul_f, superSign_comm K p j i, smul_add, smul_smul, superSign_mul_self, one_smul]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij; simp
  · simp [hij, Ne.symm hij]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_e
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_e (k j : ι) :
    superBracket P p (f P p k) (e P p j) =
      -(superSign K p k j • if k = j then h P p (P.coroot k) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_f P p k) (isHomog_e P p j), f_mul_e,
    superSign_eq_zSign]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_mem_nPlus_of_mem_sup
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, _, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
  rw [← superBracketRight_apply, map_add, superBracketRight_apply, superBracketRight_apply,
    superBracket_e_h]
  exact add_mem (superBracket_e_mem_nPlus P p j hy)
    (neg_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (e_mem_nPlus P p j)))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_eLie_mem
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_eLie_mem (k i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    superBracket P p (f P p k) (eLie P p i w) ∈ nPlus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [eLie_nil, superBracket_f_e]
    refine neg_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_)
    split_ifs
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨_, rfl⟩
    · exact zero_mem _
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [eLie_cons, superBracket_jacobi (isHomog_f P p k) (isHomog_e P p j)
      (isHomog_eLie P p i w), superBracket_f_e, superBracket_neg_left, superBracket_smul_left]
    refine Submodule.mem_sup_left (add_mem (neg_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (superBracket_e_mem_nPlus_of_mem_sup P p j ih)))
    split_ifs
    · exact superBracket_h_mem_nPlus P p _ (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w)
    · rw [superBracket_zero_left]; exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_mem_nPlus_sup
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_mem_nPlus_sup (k : ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nPlus P p) :
    superBracket P p (f P p k) x ∈ nPlus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p)
proof:
:= by
  have : nPlus P p ≤ (nPlus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p)).comap
      (superBracketRight P p (f P p k)) :=
    (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ superBracket_f_eLie_mem P p k i w
  exact this hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_e
statement: @[simp] lemma omega_e (i : ι) : omega P p (e P p i) = f P p i
proof: := lift_e _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_f
statement: @[simp] lemma omega_f (i : ι) : omega P p (f P p i) = paritySign K p i • e P p i
proof: := lift_f _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_h
statement: @[simp] lemma omega_h (a : H) : omega P p (h P p a) = -h P p a
proof: := lift_h _ a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_comp_omega
statement: lemma omega_comp_omega : (omega P p).comp (omega P p) = parity P p
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun a ↦ ?_) <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_comp_parity
statement: lemma omega_comp_parity : (omega P p).comp (parity P p) = (parity P p).comp (omega P p)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun a ↦ ?_) <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_parity
statement:
lemma omega_parity (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    omega P p (parity P p u) = parity P p (omega P p u)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : P.SuperEnveloping p →ₐ[K] _ ↦ φ u) (omega_comp_parity P p)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_superBracket
statement:
lemma omega_superBracket (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    omega P p (superBracket P p x y) = superBracket P p (omega P p x) (omega P p y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [superBracket, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_add, omega_parity]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_mem_nMinus
statement:
lemma omega_mem_nMinus {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nPlus P p) :
    omega P p x ∈ nMinus P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_mem_nMinus
statement: lemma f_mem_nMinus (i : ι) : f P p i ∈ nMinus P p
proof:
:= by
  simpa using omega_mem_nMinus P p (e_mem_nPlus P p i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_sup_range_h
statement:
lemma omega_sup_range_h :
    (nPlus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p)).map (omega P p).toLinearMap ≤
      nMinus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_sup]
  refine sup_le_sup le_rfl ?_
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨-a, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_mem_nMinus
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_mem_nMinus (j : ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nMinus P p) :
    superBracket P p (f P p j) x ∈ nMinus P p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, ← omega_e, ← omega_superBracket]
  exact omega_mem_nMinus P p (superBracket_e_mem_nPlus P p j hy)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_mem_nMinus_sup
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_mem_nMinus_sup (k : ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nMinus P p) :
    superBracket P p (e P p k) x ∈ nMinus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  have he : e P p k = paritySign K p k • omega P p (f P p k) := by
    rw [omega_f, smul_smul, paritySign_mul_self, one_smul]
  rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, he, superBracket_smul_left, ← omega_superBracket]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (omega_sup_range_h P p (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (superBracket_f_mem_nPlus_sup P p k hy)))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_h_mem_nMinus
statement:
lemma superBracket_h_mem_nMinus (a : H) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nMinus P p) :
    superBracket P p (h P p a) x ∈ nMinus P p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  have : h P p a = omega P p (h P p (-a)) := by simp
  rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, this, ← omega_superBracket]
  exact omega_mem_nMinus P p (superBracket_h_mem_nPlus P p _ hy)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_fAlg
statement: lemma parity_fAlg (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) : parity P p (fAlg P p x) = fAlg P p (parityT p x)
proof:
:= by
  have : (parity P p).comp (fAlg P p) = (fAlg P p).comp (parityT (K := K) p) :=
    FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun i ↦ by simp [parityT])
  exact congrArg (fun φ : FreeAlgebra K ι →ₐ[K] _ ↦ φ x) this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_mem_fAug
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_mem_fAug (j : ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ fAug P p) :
    superBracket P p (f P p j) x ∈ fAug P p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨FreeAlgebra.ι K j * t - (2 : K)⁻¹ • ((t + parityT p t) * FreeAlgebra.ι K j +
    (t - parityT p t) * (paritySign K p j • FreeAlgebra.ι K j)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv]
  · simp [superBracket, parity_fAlg]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_le_fAug
statement: lemma nMinus_le_fAug : nMinus P p ≤ fAug P p
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have : nPlus P p ≤ (fAug P p).comap (omega P p).toLinearMap :=
    (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ by
      induction w with
      | nil =>
        exact ⟨FreeAlgebra.ι K i, by simp [FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv], by simp⟩
      | cons j w ih =>
        rw [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, eLie_cons, omega_superBracket,
          omega_e]
        exact superBracket_f_mem_fAug P p j ih
  exact this hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_le_vermaIdeal
statement: lemma nPlus_le_vermaIdeal (Λ : Dual K H) : nPlus P p ≤ (vermaIdeal P p Λ).restrictScalars K
proof:
:= by
  refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_
  induction w with
  | nil => exact e_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem] at ih ⊢
    rw [eLie_cons, superBracket, parity_e, mul_smul_comm]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ _ ih) (Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (add_mem
      (mul_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ _ (e_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ j))
      (Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (mul_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ _ (e_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ j)))))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_add_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_add_add_eq_zero {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nMinus P p) (a : H)
    (hy : y ∈ nPlus P p) (hsum : x + h P p a + y = 0) : x = 0 ∧ a = 0 ∧ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := nMinus_le_fAug P p hx
  have ht : FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv t = 0 := ht
  have key : ∀ Λ : Dual K H, t + Λ a • 1 = 0 := fun Λ ↦ by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun u ↦ tensorRep P p Λ u 1) hsum
    have h2 := Verma.vermaIdeal_le_ker_toTensorAux P p Λ (nPlus_le_vermaIdeal P p Λ hy)
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Verma.toTensorAux_apply] at h2
    simpa [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, tensorRep_fAlg_one, tensorRep_h_one, h2] using h1
  have ha : a = 0 := (forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K a).mp fun Λ ↦ by
    have := congrArg FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv (key Λ)
    rwa [map_add, map_smul, map_one, ht, zero_add, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, map_zero] at this
  have htz : t = 0 := by simpa [ha] using key 0
  subst ha htz
  refine ⟨by simp, rfl, ?_⟩
  simpa using hsum

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightSpace_eq_weightSpaceOf
statement:
lemma weightSpace_eq_weightSpaceOf (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P p μ = Module.End.weightSpaceOf (adHLin P p) μ
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp only [mem_weightSpace, Module.End.mem_weightSpaceOf, adHLin, adH, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply,
    sub_eq_iff_eq_add']

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.le_iSup_inf_weightSpace
statement:
lemma le_iSup_inf_weightSpace (N : Submodule K (P.SuperEnveloping p))
    (hN : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ N, superBracket P p (h P p a) x ∈ N) :
    N ≤ ⨆ μ, N ⊓ weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:= by
  have := Module.End.inf_iSup_weightSpaceOf_le (adHLin P p) N fun a x hx ↦ by
    have := hN a x hx
    rwa [superBracket_of_even_left P p (isEven_h P p a)] at this
  simp only [← weightSpace_eq_weightSpaceOf, iSup_weightSpace, inf_top_eq] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsIdeal.le_iSup_ne_zero
statement:
lemma IsIdeal.le_iSup_ne_zero {I : Submodule K (P.SuperEnveloping p)} (hI : IsIdeal P p I)
    (hI0 : I ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) = ⊥) :
    I ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0}, weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (le_iSup_inf_weightSpace P p I fun a x hx ↦
    hI.superBracket_mem _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a) x hx).trans (iSup_le fun μ ↦ ?_)
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · subst hμ
    have : I ⊓ weightSpace P p 0 ≤ I ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]
      exact le_inf inf_le_left (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans hI.le_gTilde) inf_le_right)
    rw [hI0] at this
    exact this.trans bot_le
  · exact inf_le_right.trans (le_biSup (fun μ ↦ weightSpace P p μ) hμ)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isIdeal_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem isIdeal_maxIdeal : IsIdeal P p (maxIdeal P p) where
  le_gTilde
proof:
:= sSup_le fun _ hI ↦ hI.1.le_gTilde
  superBracket_mem x hx := by
    have : maxIdeal P p ≤ (maxIdeal P p).comap (superBracketRight P p x) :=
      sSup_le fun I hI y hy ↦ le_sSup hI (hI.1.superBracket_mem x hx y hy)
    exact fun y hy ↦ this hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.maxIdeal_le_iSup_ne_zero
statement:
lemma maxIdeal_le_iSup_ne_zero :
    maxIdeal P p ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0}, weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:=
  sSup_le fun _ hI ↦ hI.1.le_iSup_ne_zero P p hI.2

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.maxIdeal_inf_range_h
statement: theorem maxIdeal_inf_range_h : maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun x ⟨hx, hx0⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx0
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.1 ((iSupIndep_weightSpace P p).disjoint_biSup
    (y := {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0}) (x := 0) (by simp)) _ (h_mem_weightSpace P p a)
    (maxIdeal_le_iSup_ne_zero P p hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.le_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem le_maxIdeal {I : Submodule K (P.SuperEnveloping p)} (hI : IsIdeal P p I)
    (hI0 : I ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) = ⊥) : I ≤ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:=
  le_sSup ⟨hI, hI0⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_superBracket
statement:
lemma parity_superBracket (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    parity P p (superBracket P p x y) = superBracket P p (parity P p x) (parity P p y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [superBracket, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_add, parity_parity]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsHomog.parity_eq
statement:
lemma IsHomog.parity_eq {c : ZMod 2} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsHomog P p c x) :
    parity P p x = zSign K c • x
proof: := hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma parity_mem_gTilde {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    parity P p x ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : nPlus P p ≤ (gTilde P p).comap (parity P p).toLinearMap :=
    (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ by
      simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, (isHomog_eLie P p i w).parity_eq]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w))
  have h2 : nMinus P p ≤ (gTilde P p).comap (parity P p).toLinearMap :=
    Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ((nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ by
      simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
        (isHomog_eLie P p i w).omega.parity_eq]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (omega_mem_nMinus P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w))))
  have h3 : LinearMap.range (h P p) ≤ (gTilde P p).comap (parity P p).toLinearMap := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, (isHomog_h P p a).parity_eq,
      zSign_zero, one_smul]
    exact h_mem_gTilde P p a
  exact (sup_le (sup_le h2 h3) h1 : gTilde P p ≤ _) hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem parity_mem_maxIdeal {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ maxIdeal P p) :
    parity P p x ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  let I := (maxIdeal P p).map (parity P p).toLinearMap
  have hI : IsIdeal P p I := by
    refine ⟨Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun y hy ↦
      parity_mem_gTilde P p ((isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hy), ?_⟩
    rintro y hy _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨superBracket P p (parity P p y) z,
      (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (parity_mem_gTilde P p hy) z hz, ?_⟩
    simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, parity_superBracket, parity_parity]
  have hI0 : I ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun y ⟨⟨z, hz, hzy⟩, a, ha⟩ ↦ ?_
    have hz' : z = h P p a := by
      have := congrArg (parity P p) hzy
      simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, parity_parity] at this
      rw [this, ← ha, (isHomog_h P p a).parity_eq, zSign_zero, one_smul]
    have : z ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := ⟨hz, a, hz'.symm⟩
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h] at this
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at this ⊢
    rw [← hzy, this, map_zero]
  exact le_maxIdeal P p hI hI0 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_add_right
statement:
lemma superBracket_add_right (x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    superBracket P p x (y + z) = superBracket P p x y + superBracket P p x z
proof:
:=
  (superBracketRight P p x).map_add y z

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_smul_right
statement:
lemma superBracket_smul_right (c : K) (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    superBracket P p x (c • y) = c • superBracket P p x y
proof:
:=
  (superBracketRight P p x).map_smul c y

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_swap
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog hy hx, superBracket_of_isHomog hx hy, mul_comm b a, smul_sub,
    smul_smul, zSign_mul_self, one_smul, neg_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isInternal_weightSpace
statement: theorem isInternal_weightSpace : DirectSum.IsInternal (weightSpace P p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top (iSupIndep_weightSpace P p)
    (iSup_weightSpace P p)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wScale_of_mem
statement:
lemma wScale_of_mem (c : Dual K H → K) {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) : wScale P p c x = c μ • x
proof:
:= by
  have : (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (weightSpace P p))
      (isInternal_weightSpace P p)).symm x =
        DirectSum.lof K _ (fun μ ↦ weightSpace P p μ) μ ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    exact (DirectSum.coeLinearMap_of (weightSpace P p) μ ⟨x, hx⟩).symm
  simp only [wScale, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply, this,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.induction_on_weightSpace
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma induction_on_weightSpace {q : P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop} (x : P.SuperEnveloping p)
    (mem : ∀ μ, ∀ x ∈ weightSpace P p μ, q x) (add : ∀ x y, q x → q y → q (x + y)) : q x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction (weightSpace P p) (motive := q)
    (by rw [iSup_weightSpace]; trivial) mem (mem 0 0 (Submodule.zero_mem _)) add

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wScale_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma wScale_mem_weightSpace {c : Dual K H → K} {μ : Dual K H} (hc : ∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → c ν = 0)
    (x : P.SuperEnveloping p) : wScale P p c x ∈ weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_weightSpace P p with
  | mem ν x hx =>
    rw [wScale_of_mem P p c hx]
    by_cases hν : ν = μ
    · subst hν; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
    · rw [hc ν hν, zero_smul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_le_iSup
statement: lemma gTilde_le_iSup : gTilde P p ≤ ⨆ μ, gTilde P p ⊓ weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:=
  le_iSup_inf_weightSpace P p _ fun a _ hy ↦ superBracket_mem_gTilde P p (h_mem_gTilde P p a) hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.induction_on_gTilde
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma induction_on_gTilde {q : P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (mem : ∀ μ, ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, x ∈ weightSpace P p μ → q x)
    (add : ∀ x y, q x → q y → q (x + y)) : q x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction (fun μ ↦ gTilde P p ⊓ weightSpace P p μ) (motive := q)
    (gTilde_le_iSup P p hx) (fun μ x hx ↦ mem μ x hx.1 hx.2)
    (mem 0 0 (Submodule.zero_mem _) (Submodule.zero_mem _)) add

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wScale_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma wScale_mem_gTilde (c : Dual K H → K) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    wScale P p c x ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_gTilde P p hx (fun μ x hx hxμ ↦ ?_) (fun x y hx hy ↦ ?_)
  · rw [wScale_of_mem P p c hxμ]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.proj0_of_mem_zero
statement:
lemma proj0_of_mem_zero {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p 0) :
    proj0 P p x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [proj0, wScale_of_mem P p _ hx]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.proj0_of_mem
statement:
lemma proj0_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) : proj0 P p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [proj0, wScale_of_mem P p _ hx, hμ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.proj0_mem
statement: lemma proj0_mem (x : P.SuperEnveloping p) : proj0 P p x ∈ weightSpace P p 0
proof:
:=
  wScale_mem_weightSpace P p (fun ν hν ↦ by simp [hν]) x

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.hInv_h
statement: @[simp] lemma hInv_h (a : H) : hInv P p (h P p a) = a
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (h P p)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.2 (h_injective P p))).choose_spec a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.hComp_h
statement: @[simp] lemma hComp_h (a : H) : hComp P p (h P p a) = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [hComp, proj0_of_mem_zero P p (h_mem_weightSpace P p a)]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.hComp_of_mem
statement:
lemma hComp_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) : hComp P p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [hComp, proj0_of_mem P p hμ hx]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_hComp_of_mem_zero
statement:
lemma h_hComp_of_mem_zero [CharZero K] {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hx0 : x ∈ weightSpace P p 0) : h P p (hComp P p x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : x ∈ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]; exact ⟨hx, hx0⟩
  rw [hComp_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_hComp
statement:
lemma h_hComp [CharZero K] {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    h P p (hComp P p x) = proj0 P p x
proof:
:= by
  have : hComp P p x = hComp P p (proj0 P p x) := by
    simp [hComp, proj0_of_mem_zero P p (proj0_mem P p x)]
  rw [this]
  exact h_hComp_of_mem_zero P p (wScale_mem_gTilde P p _ hx) (proj0_mem P p x)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.degInv_of_mem
statement:
lemma degInv_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) :
    degInv P p x = (μ P.rhoCheck)⁻¹ • x
proof:
:=
  wScale_of_mem P p _ hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.degInv_of_mem_zero
statement:
lemma degInv_of_mem_zero {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p 0) :
    degInv P p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [degInv_of_mem P p hx]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_apply
statement:
lemma invForm_apply (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    invForm P p S x y = P.bilinForm S (hComp P p x) (hComp P p y) +
      P.bilinForm S (hComp P p (superBracket P p (degInv P p x) y)) P.rhoCheck
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_of_mem_zero
statement:
lemma invForm_of_mem_zero {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p 0)
    (y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    invForm P p S x y = P.bilinForm S (hComp P p x) (hComp P p y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [invForm_apply, degInv_of_mem_zero P p hx, superBracket_zero_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_h_left
statement:
lemma invForm_h_left (a : H) (y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    invForm P p S (h P p a) y = P.bilinForm S a (hComp P p y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [invForm_of_mem_zero P p S (h_mem_weightSpace P p a), hComp_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_h_h
statement:
@[simp] theorem invForm_h_h (a b : H) :
    invForm P p S (h P p a) (h P p b) = P.bilinForm S a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [invForm_h_left, hComp_h]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_of_mem
statement:
lemma invForm_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) (y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    invForm P p S x y =
      (μ P.rhoCheck)⁻¹ * P.bilinForm S (hComp P p (superBracket P p x y)) P.rhoCheck
proof:
:= by
  simp [invForm_apply, hComp_of_mem P p hμ hx, degInv_of_mem P p hx, superBracket_smul_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · subst hμ
    rw [zero_add] at hμν
    rw [invForm_of_mem_zero P p S hx, hComp_of_mem P p hμν hy, map_zero]
  · rw [invForm_of_mem P p S hμ hx,
      hComp_of_mem P p hμν (superBracket_mem_weightSpace hx hy)]
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_f
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_f (i j : ι) :
    superBracket P p (e P p i) (f P p j) = if i = j then h P p (P.coroot i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_e P p i) (isHomog_f P p j), ← superSign_eq_zSign,
    e_mul_f_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_allWeights
statement:
lemma mem_allWeights {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) : μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hμ
  have hle : gTilde P p ≤ ⨆ ν ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P, weightSpace P p ν := by
    refine sup_le (sup_le ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact (nMinus_le_iSup_weightSpace P p).trans (iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦
        le_biSup (fun ν ↦ weightSpace P p ν) (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩)))
    · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
      exact le_biSup (fun ν ↦ weightSpace P p ν) (Or.inl (Or.inr rfl))
        (h_mem_weightSpace P p a)
    · exact (nPlus_le_iSup_weightSpace P p).trans (iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦
        le_biSup (fun ν ↦ weightSpace P p ν) (Or.inr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩))
  exact hx0 (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 ((iSupIndep_weightSpace P p).disjoint_biSup hμ) _ hxμ
    (hle hx))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_isHomog_one
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_isHomog_one {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hx0 : x ∈ weightSpace P p 0) (hxa : IsHomog P p 1 x) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : x ∈ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]; exact ⟨hx, hx0⟩
  have h2 : (2 : K) • h P p a = 0 := by
    have := hxa
    rw [IsHomog, parity_h, zSign_one, neg_one_smul] at this
    rw [two_smul]; nth_rw 1 [this]; exact neg_add_cancel _
  exact (smul_eq_zero.1 h2).resolve_left two_ne_zero

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.induction_homog
statement:
lemma induction_homog {μ : Dual K H} {q : P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ)
    (hom : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, x ∈ weightSpace P p μ → IsHomog P p a x → q x)
    (add : ∀ x y, q x → q y → q (x + y)) : q x
proof:
:= by
  have hdec : x = (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x + parity P p x) + (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x - parity P p x) := by
    rw [← smul_add, add_add_sub_cancel, ← two_smul K x, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero,
      one_smul]
  rw [hdec]
  have hσ := parity_mem_gTilde P p hx
  have hσμ := parity_mem_weightSpace P p hxμ
  refine add _ _ (hom 0 _ ?_ ?_ ?_) (hom 1 _ ?_ ?_ ?_)
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (add_mem hx hσ)
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (add_mem hxμ hσμ)
  · rw [IsHomog, map_smul, map_add, parity_parity, zSign_zero, one_smul, add_comm]
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hx hσ)
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hxμ hσμ)
  · rw [IsHomog, map_smul, map_sub, parity_parity, zSign_one, neg_one_smul, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) : μ P.rhoCheck ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  AuxLieAlgebra.apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero P (mem_allWeights P p hx hxμ hx0) hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_swap
statement:
theorem invForm_swap {μ ν : Dual K H} {a b : ZMod 2} {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) (hxa : IsHomog P p a x)
    (_hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyν : y ∈ weightSpace P p ν) (hyb : IsHomog P p b y) :
    invForm P p S y x = zSign K (a * b) * invForm P p S x y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμν : μ + ν = 0
  · obtain rfl : ν = -μ := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hμν
    by_cases hμ : μ = 0
    · subst hμ
      rw [neg_zero] at hyν
      rw [invForm_of_mem_zero P p S hyν, invForm_of_mem_zero P p S hxμ,
        (P.isSymm_bilinForm S).eq (hComp P p y)]
      rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl
      · rw [zero_mul, zSign_zero, one_mul]
      · rcases zmod_two_cases b with rfl | rfl
        · rw [mul_zero, zSign_zero, one_mul]
        · rw [eq_zero_of_isHomog_one P p hx hxμ hxa]; simp
    · rw [invForm_of_mem P p S (neg_ne_zero.2 hμ) hyν, invForm_of_mem P p S hμ hxμ,
        superBracket_swap hxa hyb]
      simp only [map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        LinearMap.neg_apply, inv_neg]
      ring
  · rw [invForm_eq_zero P p S hyν hxμ (by rwa [add_comm]), invForm_eq_zero P p S hxμ hyν hμν,
      mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_e_f
statement:
theorem invForm_e_f (i j : ι) :
    invForm P p S (e P p i) (f P p j) = if i = j then (S.ε i : K) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hij
  · subst hij
    rw [invForm_of_mem P p S (P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i) (e_mem_weightSpace P p i),
      superBracket_e_f]
    simp
  · refine invForm_eq_zero P p S (e_mem_weightSpace P p i) (f_mem_weightSpace P p j) fun h0 ↦
      hij (P.linearIndependent_root.injective ?_)
    rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_zero] at h0

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lieEqForm_of_exists
statement:
lemma lieEqForm_of_exists {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (hex : ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, x ∈ weightSpace P p μ → ∀ y ∈ gTilde P p,
      y ∈ weightSpace P p (-μ) → ∃ c : K, superBracket P p x y = c • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm μ)) :
    LieEqForm P p S μ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxμ y hy hyμ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hex x hx hxμ y hy hyμ
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · simp [hx0, superBracket_zero_left]
  have hne := apply_rhoCheck_ne_zero_of_mem P p hμ hx hxμ hx0
  rw [hc, invForm_of_mem P p S hμ hxμ, hc, map_smul, hComp_h, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    bilinForm_toDual_symm_left, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lieEqForm_zero
statement: lemma lieEqForm_zero : LieEqForm P p S 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hx0 y _ hy0
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : x ∈ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]; exact ⟨hx, hx0⟩
  rw [neg_zero] at hy0
  rw [superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p a hy0, map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lieEqForm_of_notMem
statement:
lemma lieEqForm_of_notMem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∉ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P) :
    LieEqForm P p S μ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxμ y _ _
  obtain rfl : x = 0 := by
    by_contra hx0; exact hμ (mem_allWeights P p hx hxμ hx0)
  simp [superBracket_zero_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.LieEqForm.neg
statement: lemma LieEqForm.neg {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : LieEqForm P p S μ) : LieEqForm P p S (-μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxμ y hy hyμ
  rw [neg_neg] at hyμ
  refine induction_homog (q := fun x ↦ superBracket P p x y =
      invForm P p S x y • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm (-μ))) P p hx hxμ
    (fun a x hx hxμ hxa ↦ ?_) (fun x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_)
  · refine induction_homog (q := fun y ↦ superBracket P p x y =
        invForm P p S x y • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm (-μ))) P p hy hyμ
      (fun b y hy hyμ hyb ↦ ?_) (fun y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_)
    · have := hμ y hy hyμ x hx hxμ
      rw [superBracket_swap hyb hxa, this, invForm_swap P p S hy hyμ hyb hx hxμ hxa, map_neg,
        map_neg, mul_comm b a, mul_smul, smul_neg, smul_neg]
    · rw [superBracket_add_right, h₁, h₂, map_add, add_smul]
  · rw [superBracket_add_left, h₁, h₂, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_add_left
statement:
lemma superBracket_add_left (x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    superBracket P p (x + y) z = superBracket P p x z + superBracket P p y z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [superBracket, map_add, add_mul, mul_add, smul_add]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracketLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma superBracketLeft_apply (x y : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    superBracketLeft P p y x = superBracket P p x y
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_gTilde_iff
statement:
lemma mem_gTilde_iff {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} :
    x ∈ gTilde P p ↔ ∃ n ∈ nMinus P p, ∃ a, ∃ m ∈ nPlus P p, n + h P p a + m = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gTilde, Submodule.mem_sup, LinearMap.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨n, hn, _, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨n, hn, _, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, m, hm, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_le_gTilde
statement: lemma nMinus_le_gTilde : nMinus P p ≤ gTilde P p
proof: := le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.range_h_le_gTilde
statement: lemma range_h_le_gTilde : LinearMap.range (h P p) ≤ gTilde P p
proof: := le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_le_gTilde
statement: lemma nPlus_le_gTilde : nPlus P p ≤ gTilde P p
proof: := le_sup_right

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mem_gTilde
statement: lemma h_mem_gTilde (a : H) : h P p a ∈ gTilde P p
proof: := range_h_le_gTilde P p ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_sup_le_gTilde
statement: lemma nMinus_sup_le_gTilde : nMinus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p) ≤ gTilde P p
proof: := le_sup_left

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_sup_le_gTilde
statement: lemma nPlus_sup_le_gTilde : nPlus P p ⊔ LinearMap.range (h P p) ≤ gTilde P p
proof:
:=
  sup_le (nPlus_le_gTilde P p) (range_h_le_gTilde P p)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_mem_gTilde (j : ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    superBracket P p (e P p j) x ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩ := (mem_gTilde_iff P p).1 hx
  simp only [← superBracketRight_apply, map_add]
  refine add_mem (add_mem (nMinus_sup_le_gTilde P p (superBracket_e_mem_nMinus_sup P p j hn)) ?_)
    (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (superBracket_e_mem_nPlus P p j hm))
  rw [superBracketRight_apply, superBracket_e_h]
  exact neg_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (e_mem_nPlus P p j)))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_mem_gTilde (j : ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    superBracket P p (f P p j) x ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩ := (mem_gTilde_iff P p).1 hx
  simp only [← superBracketRight_apply, map_add]
  refine add_mem (add_mem (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (superBracket_f_mem_nMinus P p j hn)) ?_)
    (nPlus_sup_le_gTilde P p (superBracket_f_mem_nPlus_sup P p j hm))
  rw [superBracketRight_apply, superBracket_of_even_right P p _ (isEven_h P p a), h_mul_f]
  rw [sub_sub_cancel]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (f_mem_nMinus P p j))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_h_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma superBracket_h_mem_gTilde (b : H) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    superBracket P p (h P p b) x ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩ := (mem_gTilde_iff P p).1 hx
  simp only [← superBracketRight_apply, map_add]
  refine add_mem (add_mem (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (superBracket_h_mem_nMinus P p b hn)) ?_)
    (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (superBracket_h_mem_nPlus P p b hm))
  rw [superBracketRight_apply, superBracket_of_even_left P p (isEven_h P p b), h_mul_h, sub_self]
  exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsHomog.omega
statement:
lemma IsHomog.omega {c : ZMod 2} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsHomog P p c x) :
    IsHomog P p c (omega P p x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHomog, ← omega_parity, hx, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_le_span_homog
statement:
lemma gTilde_le_span_homog :
    gTilde P p ≤ Submodule.span K {x | x ∈ gTilde P p ∧ ∃ c, IsHomog P p c x}
proof:
:= by
  have hP : nPlus P p ≤ Submodule.span K {x | x ∈ gTilde P p ∧ ∃ c, IsHomog P p c x} :=
    (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨nPlus_le_gTilde P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w), _, isHomog_eLie P p i w⟩
  refine sup_le (sup_le ?_ ?_) hP
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have : nPlus P p ≤ (Submodule.span K {x | x ∈ gTilde P p ∧ ∃ c, IsHomog P p c x}).comap
        (omega P p).toLinearMap :=
      (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ Submodule.subset_span
        ⟨nMinus_le_gTilde P p (omega_mem_nMinus P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w)), _,
          (isHomog_eLie P p i w).omega⟩
    exact this hy
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨h_mem_gTilde P p a, 0, isHomog_h P p a⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_bracketStable
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have key : Submodule.span K {x | x ∈ gTilde P p ∧ ∃ c, IsHomog P p c x} ≤
      (gTilde P p).comap (superBracketRight P p (superBracket P p g y)) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 fun z ⟨hz, c, hc⟩ ↦ ?_
    have hj := superBracket_jacobi hg hy hc
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, superBracketRight_apply]
