    rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq hj.symm]
    exact sub_mem (hg' _ (hy' _ hz)) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hy' _ (hg' _ hz)))
  exact key (gTilde_le_span_homog P p hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mem_bracketStable
statement: lemma e_mem_bracketStable (j : ι) : e P p j ∈ bracketStable P p
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ superBracket_e_mem_gTilde P p j hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_mem_bracketStable
statement: lemma f_mem_bracketStable (j : ι) : f P p j ∈ bracketStable P p
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ superBracket_f_mem_gTilde P p j hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mem_bracketStable
statement: lemma h_mem_bracketStable (a : H) : h P p a ∈ bracketStable P p
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ superBracket_h_mem_gTilde P p a hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_le_bracketStable
statement: lemma nPlus_le_bracketStable : nPlus P p ≤ bracketStable P p
proof:
:= by
  refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using e_mem_bracketStable P p i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [eLie_cons]
    exact superBracket_mem_bracketStable P p (isHomog_e P p j) (isHomog_eLie P p i w)
      (e_mem_bracketStable P p j) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_eLie_cons
statement:
lemma omega_eLie_cons (i j : ι) (w : List ι) :
    omega P p (eLie P p i (j :: w)) = superBracket P p (f P p j) (omega P p (eLie P p i w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eLie_cons, omega_superBracket, omega_e]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_le_bracketStable
statement: lemma nMinus_le_bracketStable : nMinus P p ≤ bracketStable P p
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ((nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using f_mem_bracketStable P p i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [omega_eLie_cons]
    exact superBracket_mem_bracketStable P p (isHomog_f P p j) (isHomog_eLie P p i w).omega
      (f_mem_bracketStable P p j) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_le_bracketStable
statement: lemma gTilde_le_bracketStable : gTilde P p ≤ bracketStable P p
proof:
:=
  sup_le (sup_le (nMinus_le_bracketStable P p) (by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact h_mem_bracketStable P p a)) (nPlus_le_bracketStable P p)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_gTilde
statement:
theorem superBracket_mem_gTilde {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) : superBracket P p x y ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:=
  gTilde_le_bracketStable P p hx y hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVec_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordVec_nil : wordVec ([] : List ι) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVec_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma wordVec_cons (j : ι) (w : List ι) :
    wordVec (j :: w) = Pi.single j 1 + wordVec w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordVec]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVec_nonneg
statement: lemma wordVec_nonneg (w : List ι) : 0 ≤ wordVec w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [wordVec_cons]
    exact add_nonneg (fun k ↦ by by_cases hk : k = j <;> simp [hk]) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVec_cons_mem_posCone
statement: lemma wordVec_cons_mem_posCone (i : ι) (w : List ι) : wordVec (i :: w) ∈ posCone ι
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨wordVec_nonneg _, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  have := congrFun h0 i
  have hw := wordVec_nonneg w i
  simp only [wordVec_cons, Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply] at this hw
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootOf_wordVec
statement: lemma rootOf_wordVec (w : List ι) : P.rootOf (wordVec w) = (w.map P.root).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih => simp [ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_le_iSup_weightSpace
statement:
lemma nPlus_le_iSup_weightSpace :
    nPlus P p ≤ ⨆ k ∈ posCone ι, weightSpace P p (P.rootOf k)
proof:
:= by
  refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_
  have hw : eLie P p i w ∈ weightSpace P p (P.rootOf (wordVec (i :: w))) := by
    rw [rootOf_wordVec, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_comm]
    exact eLie_mem_weightSpace P p i w
  exact (le_biSup (fun k ↦ weightSpace P p (P.rootOf k)) (wordVec_cons_mem_posCone i w)) hw

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma omega_mem_weightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) : omega P p x ∈ weightSpace P p (-μ)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  have := congrArg (omega P p) (hx a)
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_smul, omega_h, neg_mul, mul_neg] at this
  rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul, ← neg_inj, this]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_le_iSup_weightSpace
statement:
lemma nMinus_le_iSup_weightSpace :
    nMinus P p ≤ ⨆ k ∈ posCone ι, weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ((nPlus_le_iSup_weightSpace P p).trans ?_)
  refine iSup₂_le fun k hk x hx ↦ ?_
  exact (le_biSup (fun k ↦ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf k)) hk) (omega_mem_weightSpace P p hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_le_iSup_ne_zero
statement: lemma nPlus_le_iSup_ne_zero : nPlus P p ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0}, weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:=
  (nPlus_le_iSup_weightSpace P p).trans <| iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦
    le_biSup (fun μ ↦ weightSpace P p μ) (show P.rootOf k ≠ 0 from P.rootOf_ne_zero hk.2)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_le_iSup_ne_zero
statement: lemma nMinus_le_iSup_ne_zero : nMinus P p ≤ ⨆ μ ∈ {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0}, weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:=
  (nMinus_le_iSup_weightSpace P p).trans <| iSup₂_le fun k hk ↦
    le_biSup (fun μ ↦ weightSpace P p μ)
      (show -P.rootOf k ≠ 0 from neg_ne_zero.2 (P.rootOf_ne_zero hk.2))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero
statement:
theorem gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero :
    gTilde P p ⊓ weightSpace P p 0 = LinearMap.range (h P p)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_inf (range_h_le_gTilde P p) ?_)
  · rintro x ⟨hx, hx0⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩ := (mem_gTilde_iff P p).1 hx
    have hS : n + m ∈ ⨆ μ ∈ {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0}, weightSpace P p μ :=
      add_mem (nMinus_le_iSup_ne_zero P p hn) (nPlus_le_iSup_ne_zero P p hm)
    have h0 : n + m ∈ weightSpace P p 0 := by
      have := sub_mem hx0 (h_mem_weightSpace P p a)
      rwa [add_right_comm, add_sub_cancel_right] at this
    have hnm : n + m = 0 := by
      have := (iSupIndep_weightSpace P p).disjoint_biSup (y := {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0})
        (x := 0) (by simp)
      exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 this) _ h0 hS
    have := eq_zero_of_add_add_eq_zero P p hn 0 hm (by rw [map_zero, add_zero, hnm])
    rw [this.1, this.2.2, zero_add, add_zero]
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact h_mem_weightSpace P p a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_range_h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero]
  refine ⟨superBracket_mem_gTilde P p (nPlus_le_gTilde P p hx) (nMinus_le_gTilde P p hy), ?_⟩
  simpa using superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxμ hyμ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.repE_word
statement: @[simp] lemma repE_word (i : ι) (w : List ι) : repE P p Λ i (word w) = eWord P p Λ i w
proof:
:= by
  simp [repE]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.repH_eWord
statement:
lemma repH_eWord (a : H) (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    repH P Λ a (eWord P p Λ i w) =
      (Λ a - wordWt P w a + P.root i a) • eWord P p Λ i w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [eWord]
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [eWord, map_add, map_smul, repH_mulLeft, ih, wordWt_cons, LinearMap.add_apply]
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij
      simp only [map_smul, repH_word, smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, smul_sub]
      module
    · simp only [add_zero, map_zero, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
      module

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.tensorRep_e
statement: @[simp] lemma tensorRep_e (i : ι) : tensorRep P p Λ (e P p i) = repE P p Λ i
proof: := lift_e _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.tensorRep_f
statement: @[simp] lemma tensorRep_f (i : ι) : tensorRep P p Λ (f P p i) = repF i
proof: := lift_f _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.tensorRep_h
statement: @[simp] lemma tensorRep_h (a : H) : tensorRep P p Λ (h P p a) = repH P Λ a
proof: := lift_h _ a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.tensorRep_e_one
statement: lemma tensorRep_e_one (i : ι) : tensorRep P p Λ (e P p i) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorRep_e, ← word_nil, repE_word]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.tensorRep_h_one
statement: lemma tensorRep_h_one (a : H) : tensorRep P p Λ (h P p a) 1 = Λ a • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorRep_h, ← word_nil, repH_word]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_ι
statement: @[simp] lemma fAlg_ι (i : ι) : fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.ι K i) = f P p i
proof: := by simp [fAlg]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eAlg_ι
statement: @[simp] lemma eAlg_ι (i : ι) : eAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.ι K i) = e P p i
proof: := by simp [eAlg]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.tensorRep_fAlg_one
statement: lemma tensorRep_fAlg_one (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) : tensorRep P p Λ (fAlg P p x) 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  have : (tensorRep P p Λ).comp (fAlg P p) = Algebra.lmul K T := by
    ext i
    simp [repF]
  have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ x 1) this
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_injective
statement: theorem fAlg_injective : Function.Injective (fAlg P p)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rw [← tensorRep_fAlg_one P p 0 x, ← tensorRep_fAlg_one P p 0 y, hxy]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_injective
statement: theorem h_injective : Function.Injective (h P p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro a ha
  refine (forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K a).mp fun Λ ↦ ?_
  have := tensorRep_h_one P p Λ a
  rw [ha, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero] at this
  simpa using this

name: LusztigF.weightSign_mul_self
statement:
lemma weightSign_mul_self (s : X → R) (hs : ∀ j, s j * s j = 1) (μ : X →₀ ℕ) :
    weightSign s μ * weightSign s μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSign, ← Finsupp.prod_mul]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ ↦ by
    change s j ^ μ j * s j ^ μ j = 1
    rw [← mul_pow, hs, one_pow]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_wordBasis_eq
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_wordBasis_eq (i : X) (s : X → R) (hs : ∀ j, s j * s j = 1)
    (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    twistVermaOp i s c (wordBasis R X w) =
      (weightSign s (wordWeight w) * s i) •
        vermaOp i (fun μ ↦ weightSign s μ * c μ) (wordBasis R X w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, twistVermaOp_ι_mul, ih, vermaOp_ι_mul, weightScale_wordBasis,
      weightScale_wordBasis, wordWeight_cons, weightSign_add, weightSign_single, pow_one, smul_add,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    · congr 1; ring
    · split_ifs with hij
      · subst hij
        rw [smul_smul]
        congr 1
        linear_combination (-c (wordWeight w) * weightSign s (wordWeight w) *
          weightSign s (wordWeight w)) * hs i - c (wordWeight w) *
          weightSign_mul_self s hs (wordWeight w)
      · simp

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_eq_smul
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_eq_smul (i : X) (s : X → R) (hs : ∀ j, s j * s j = 1)
    (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    twistVermaOp i s c y =
      (weightSign s μ * s i) • vermaOp i (fun ν ↦ weightSign s ν * c ν) y
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [twistVermaOp_wordBasis_eq i s hs, hw]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, smul_add]
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hy, smul_comm]

name: LusztigF.exists_twistVermaForm_eq_mul
statement:
theorem exists_twistVermaForm_eq_mul (s : X → X → R) (hs : ∀ i j, s i j * s i j = 1)
    (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (μ : X →₀ ℕ) :
    ∃ u : R, u * u = 1 ∧ ∀ y ∈ wordSpan R μ, twistVermaForm s c w y =
      u * vermaForm (fun i ν ↦ weightSign (s i) ν * c i ν) w y
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing μ with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, by simp, fun y _ ↦ by simp [twistVermaForm_apply, vermaForm_apply]⟩
  | cons i w ih =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, h⟩ := ih (μ - Finsupp.single i 1)
    refine ⟨u * (weightSign (s i) μ * s i i), ?_, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
    · linear_combination (weightSign (s i) μ * s i i) ^ 2 * hu +
        s i i * s i i * weightSign_mul_self (s i) (hs i) μ + hs i i
    · rw [twistVermaForm_cons, twistVermaOp_eq_smul i (s i) (hs i) (c i) hy, map_smul,
        h _ (vermaOp_mem_wordSpan i _ hy), vermaForm_cons, smul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: LusztigF.vermaOp_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem vermaOp_mul_coeff (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (κ : R) :
    vermaOp i (fun μ ↦ κ * c μ) = κ • vermaOp i c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← twistVermaOp_one_sign, ← twistVermaOp_one_sign, twistVermaOp_mul_coeff]

name: LusztigF.vermaForm_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem vermaForm_mul_coeff (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (κ : X → R) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaForm (fun i μ ↦ κ i * c i μ) w y = (w.map κ).prod * vermaForm c w y
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing y with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [vermaForm_cons, vermaOp_mul_coeff, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, ih, vermaForm_cons,
      List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_span_singleton
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sub_of_mem_span_singleton (hV : IsGModule P p V) {μ ν : Dual K H} {g v : V}
    (hg : g ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ) (he : ∀ j, e P p j • g = 0)
    (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V ν) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hmem : v ∈ Submodule.span 𝒰 {g}) :
    ∃ d : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ d ∧ ν = μ - P.rootOf d
proof:
:= by
  let φ : GVerma P p μ →ₗ[𝒰] V :=
    GVerma.lift hV g he fun a ↦ by rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hg a
  have hle : Submodule.span 𝒰 {g} ≤ LinearMap.range φ := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨GVerma.hwv P p μ, GVerma.lift_hwv _ _ _ _⟩
  have hB : IsBounded P p (LinearMap.range φ) {μ} :=
    GVerma.isBounded.of_surjective φ.rangeRestrict φ.surjective_rangeRestrict
  obtain ⟨μ', hμ', d, hd, hdeq⟩ := hB.exists_eq_sub (w := ⟨v, hle hmem⟩) (ν := ν)
    (fun a ↦ Subtype.ext (hv a)) (fun h ↦ hv0 (congr_arg Subtype.val h))
  exact ⟨d, hd, Finset.mem_singleton.1 hμ' ▸ hdeq⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_span_range
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sub_of_mem_span_range (hV : IsGModule P p V) {μ : ι → Dual K H} {ν : Dual K H}
    (g : ι → V) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ i)) (he : ∀ i j, e P p j • g i = 0)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V ν) (hv0 : v ≠ 0)
    (hmem : v ∈ Submodule.span 𝒰 (Set.range g)) :
    ∃ i, ∃ d : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ d ∧ ν = μ i - P.rootOf d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let φ (i : ι) : GVerma P p (μ i) →ₗ[𝒰] V :=
    GVerma.lift hV (g i) (he i) fun a ↦ by rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hg i a
  let Φ : (∀ i, GVerma P p (μ i)) →ₗ[𝒰] V :=
    ∑ i, (φ i).comp (LinearMap.proj i)
  have hle : Submodule.span 𝒰 (Set.range g) ≤ LinearMap.range Φ := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Pi.single i (GVerma.hwv P p (μ i)), ?_⟩
    simp only [Φ, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, map_zero])
      (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same, GVerma.lift_hwv]
  have hB : IsBounded P p (LinearMap.range Φ) (Finset.univ.biUnion fun i ↦ {μ i}) :=
    (isBounded_pi fun _ ↦ GVerma.isBounded).of_surjective Φ.rangeRestrict
      Φ.surjective_rangeRestrict
  obtain ⟨μ', hμ', d, hd, hdeq⟩ := hB.exists_eq_sub (w := ⟨v, hle hmem⟩) (ν := ν)
    (fun a ↦ Subtype.ext (hv a)) (fun h ↦ hv0 (congr_arg Subtype.val h))
  obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hμ'
  exact ⟨i, d, hd, Finset.mem_singleton.1 hi ▸ hdeq⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_mem
statement:
lemma fAlg_smul_hwv_mem {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ wordSpan K ν) :
    fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ ∈
      modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) (-P.rootOf (natVec ν) + Λ)
proof:
:=
  smul_mem_modWeightSpace _ (fAlg_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_wordSpan P p ht)
    (hwv_mem_modWeightSpace (Λ := Λ))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.e_smul_fAlg_smul_hwv
statement:
theorem e_smul_fAlg_smul_hwv (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i) (i : ι) (t : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    e P p i • (fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ) =
      fAlg P p (twistVermaOp i (superSign K p i) (superVermaCoeff K A n i) t) • hwv P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction t using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add, hy, hz, map_add, map_add, add_smul]
  | smul a y hy => rw [map_smul, smul_assoc, smul_comm, hy, map_smul, map_smul, smul_assoc]
  | word w =>
    induction w with
    | nil => simp [e_smul_hwv]
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, twistVermaOp_ι_mul, map_mul, fAlg_ι, mul_smul, ← mul_smul,
        e_mul_f, add_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul, ih, map_add, map_smul, map_mul, fAlg_ι,
        add_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul]
      congr 1
      split_ifs with hij
      · subst hij
        rw [weightScale_wordBasis, map_smul, smul_assoc,
          fAlg_smul_hwv_mem (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w) (P.coroot i)]
        congr 1
        rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, rootOf_apply_coroot, hn, superVermaCoeff]
        push_cast
        ring
      · simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_of_mem_fPowSubmodule
statement:
theorem fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_of_mem_fPowSubmodule (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i) (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) {ν : ι →₀ ℕ}
    (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≤ n i) {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ wordSpan K ν)
    (hmem : fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ ∈ fPowSubmodule P p Λ n) : fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h0
  obtain ⟨i, d, hd, hdeq⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_mem_span_range (μ := fun i ↦ Λ - (n i + 1) • P.root i)
    isGModule _ (fun i ↦ f_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hwv_mem_modWeightSpace i _)
    (fun i ↦ e_smul_f_pow_succ_smul_eq_zero hA (hn i) (hodd i) hwv_mem_modWeightSpace
      e_smul_hwv) (fAlg_smul_hwv_mem ht) h0 hmem
  have h0 : P.rootOf (d + ((n i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • Pi.single i 1 - natVec ν) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_add, map_zsmul, rootOf_single, map_zero, natCast_zsmul]
    linear_combination (norm := module) hdeq
  have h1 := congr_fun (P.rootOf_injective h0) i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    Pi.zero_apply, natVec] at h1
  have := hd i
  have := hν i
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at *
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.mkQ_fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mkQ_fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) (ν : ι →₀ ℕ) {t : FreeAlgebra K ι}
    (ht : t ∈ wordSpan K ν)
    (h : ∀ w, wordWeight w = ν →
      twistVermaForm (fun i ↦ superSign K p i) (superVermaCoeff K A n) w t = 0) :
    (fPowSubmodule P p Λ n).mkQ (fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ν using WellFoundedLT.induction generalizing t with
  | ind ν ih =>
  set N := fPowSubmodule P p Λ n
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x = N.mkQ (fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hx]
  
  have he : ∀ i, e P p i • x = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    rw [hx, ← map_smul, e_smul_fAlg_smul_hwv hn]
    by_cases hνi : ν i = 0
    · rw [twistVermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem i _ _ hνi ht, map_zero, zero_smul, map_zero]
    have hsi : Finsupp.single i 1 ≤ ν := Finsupp.single_le_iff.2 (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hνi)
    refine ih (ν - Finsupp.single i 1) (lt_of_le_of_ne tsub_le_self fun heq ↦ ?_)
      (twistVermaOp_mem_wordSpan i _ _ ht) fun w hw ↦ ?_
    · have := congr_arg (· i) heq
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this
      omega
    · rw [← twistVermaForm_cons]
      exact h _ (by rw [wordWeight_cons, hw, add_tsub_cancel_of_le hsi])
  by_cases hν : ν = 0
  · subst hν
    have h0 := h [] rfl
    rw [twistVermaForm_apply, twistVermaWordOp_nil, Module.End.one_apply] at h0
    rw [hx, eq_algebraMap_of_mem_wordSpan_zero ht, h0, map_zero, map_zero, zero_smul, map_zero]
  by_contra hx0
  have := isSimpleModule_fPowQuotient S hA hp hn hodd
  have htop : Submodule.span 𝒰 {x} = ⊤ :=
    (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top _).resolve_left
      (by rwa [Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot])
  have hv0 : N.mkQ (hwv P p Λ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ fPowSubmodule_ne_top hA hn hodd <| by
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h0
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_hwv (P := P) (p := p) (Λ := Λ), Submodule.span_le,
      Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact h0
  have hxw : x ∈ modWeightSpace P p (FPowQuotient P p Λ n) (-P.rootOf (natVec ν) + Λ) :=
    fun a ↦ by rw [hx, ← map_smul, fAlg_smul_hwv_mem ht a, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  have hvw : N.mkQ (hwv P p Λ) ∈ modWeightSpace P p (FPowQuotient P p Λ n) Λ :=
    fun a ↦ by rw [← map_smul, hwv_mem_modWeightSpace a, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdeq⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_mem_span_singleton isGModule_fPowQuotient hxw he hvw
    hv0 (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  have h0 : P.rootOf (natVec ν + d) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [map_add, map_zero]
    linear_combination (norm := module) hdeq
  have h1 := P.rootOf_injective h0
  refine hν (Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ ?_)
  have := congr_fun h1 i
  have := hd i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, natVec, Pi.zero_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero] at *
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.mem_superSerreIdeal_of_twistVermaForm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_superSerreIdeal_of_twistVermaForm_eq_zero (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≤ n i)
    {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ wordSpan K ν)
    (h : ∀ w, wordWeight w = ν →
      twistVermaForm (fun i ↦ superSign K p i) (superVermaCoeff K A n) w t = 0) :
    t ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := mkQ_fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero S hA hp hn hodd ν ht h
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h0
  exact (fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff_mem_superSerreIdeal S hA hp Λ).1
    (fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_of_mem_fPowSubmodule hA hn hodd hν ht h0)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superSerreFamily_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma superSerreFamily_mem_wordSpan (ij : SerrePair ι) :
    superSerreFamily K A p ij ∈ wordSpan K (superSerreWeight A ij)
proof:
:=
  sLie_mem_wordSpan (K := K) (p := p) ij.1.2 _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_superSerreIdeal_iff_mem_productSpan
statement:
theorem mem_superSerreIdeal_iff_mem_productSpan {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra K ι}
    (hy : y ∈ wordSpan K ν) :
    y ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p ↔
      y ∈ productSpan (superSerreFamily K A p) (superSerreWeight A) ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordSpan_inf_ideal_eq_productSpan (superSerreFamily_mem_wordSpan A p) ν hy]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ ↦ x ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span
      (Set.range (superSerreFamily K A p))) ?_ (zero_mem _) (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ add_mem)
      (fun a x _ hx ↦ TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ a x hx) h
    rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, b, rfl⟩
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _
      (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨⟨(i, j), hij⟩, rfl⟩)
  · intro h
    clear hy
    induction h using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨ij, rfl⟩ := hx
      simpa [superSerreFamily] using
        superSerreFree_mul_mem (K := K) (A := A) (p := p) ij.2 1
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
    | left_absorb a x _ hx => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx
    | right_absorb b x _ hx => exact mul_mem_superSerreIdeal hx b

name: LusztigF.superVermaCoeff_eq_classicalCoeff
statement:
lemma superVermaCoeff_eq_classicalCoeff (n : I → ℕ) (i : I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    superVermaCoeff K D.cartanMatrix n i μ = classicalCoeff K D n i μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [superVermaCoeff, classicalCoeff, LusztigCartanDatum.coPairing,
    Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by simp)]
  congr 3
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, natVec, mul_comm]

name: LusztigF.mem_superSerreIdeal_of_shapovalovMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_superSerreIdeal_of_shapovalovMap_eq_zero [Finite I] {p : I → ZMod 2}
    (hp : D.cartanMatrix.IsSuperAdmissible p) (n : I → ℕ) (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i))
    {c : I → (I →₀ ℕ) → K} {s : I → K} (hs : ∀ i, s i ≠ 0)
    (hc : ∀ i μ, c i μ = s i * (weightSign (superSign K p i) μ * classicalCoeff K D n i μ))
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≤ n i) {y : LusztigF K I} (hy : y ∈ weightSpace K ν)
    (h0 : shapovalovMap c ν y = 0) :
    y ∈ superSerreIdeal K D.cartanMatrix p
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := Matrix.isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.1
    D.isSymmetrizable_cartanMatrix
  refine GVerma.mem_superSerreIdeal_of_twistVermaForm_eq_zero
    (P := Matrix.Realization.std D.cartanMatrix K) (Λ := stdWeightOver D n) S
    D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix hp (stdWeightOver_coroot D n) hodd hν hy fun w hw ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨u, -, hu⟩ := exists_twistVermaForm_eq_mul (fun i ↦ superSign K p i)
    (superSign_mul_self K p) (superVermaCoeff K D.cartanMatrix n) w ν
  rw [hu y hy]
  have h1 : vermaForm c w y = 0 := congr_fun h0 ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hc' : c = fun i μ ↦ s i * (weightSign (superSign K p i) μ *
      superVermaCoeff K D.cartanMatrix n i μ) := by
    funext i μ; rw [hc, superVermaCoeff_eq_classicalCoeff]
  rw [hc', vermaForm_mul_coeff] at h1
  have hprod : (w.map s).prod ≠ 0 := List.prod_ne_zero (by simpa using fun i _ ↦ hs i)
  rw [(mul_eq_zero.1 h1).resolve_left hprod, mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma omega_mem_gTilde {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    omega P p x ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : nPlus P p ≤ (gTilde P p).comap (omega P p).toLinearMap := fun y hy ↦
    nMinus_le_gTilde P p (omega_mem_nMinus P p hy)
  have h2 : nMinus P p ≤ (gTilde P p).comap (omega P p).toLinearMap := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
    have : omega P p (omega P p y) = parity P p y :=
      congrArg (fun φ : P.SuperEnveloping p →ₐ[K] _ ↦ φ y) (omega_comp_omega P p)
    rw [this]
    exact parity_mem_gTilde P p (nPlus_le_gTilde P p hy)
  have h3 : LinearMap.range (h P p) ≤ (gTilde P p).comap (omega P p).toLinearMap := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    simpa using neg_mem (h_mem_gTilde P p a)
  exact (sup_le (sup_le h2 h3) h1 : gTilde P p ≤ _) hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_omega_eq
statement:
lemma exists_omega_eq {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-μ)) :
    ∃ y ∈ gTilde P p, y ∈ weightSpace P p μ ∧ omega P p y = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨omega P p (parity P p x), omega_mem_gTilde P p (parity_mem_gTilde P p hx), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using omega_mem_weightSpace P p (parity_mem_weightSpace P p hxμ)
  · have : omega P p (omega P p (parity P p x)) = parity P p (parity P p x) :=
      congrArg (fun φ : P.SuperEnveloping p →ₐ[K] _ ↦ φ _) (omega_comp_omega P p)
    rw [this, parity_parity]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_weightSpace_neg_root
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpace_neg_root {i : ι} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxi : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.root i)) : ∃ c : K, x = c • f P p i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyi, rfl⟩ := exists_omega_eq P p hx hxi
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_root P p hy hyi
  exact ⟨c, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_weightSpace_neg_two_root
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpace_neg_two_root {i : ι} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxi : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-(2 • P.root i))) :
    ∃ c : K, x = c • superBracket P p (f P p i) (f P p i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyi, rfl⟩ := exists_omega_eq P p hx hxi
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_two_root P p hy hyi
  exact ⟨c, by simp [omega_superBracket]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_neg_nsmul_root
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_neg_nsmul_root {i : ι} {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxi : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-(m • P.root i))) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyi, rfl⟩ := exists_omega_eq P p hx hxi
  rw [eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root P p hm hy hyi, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_nsmul_root_of_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma eq_nsmul_root_of_mem_posWeights {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights)
    {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0)
    {k : ι} {c : K} (hc : μ = c • P.root k) : μ = P.root k ∨ μ = 2 • P.root k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨ha0, ha⟩, rfl⟩ := hμ
  have hsum' : ∑ l, (a l : K) • P.root l - ∑ l, (if l = k then c else 0) • P.root l = 0 := by
    rw [← rootOf_apply, hc]
    simp [ite_smul]
  have hsum : ∑ l, ((a l : K) - if l = k then c else 0) • P.root l = 0 := by
    rw [← hsum', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ by module
  have hal : ∀ l, l ≠ k → a l = 0 := fun l hl ↦ by
    have := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_root _ hsum l
    simpa [hl] using this
  set n := (a k).toNat with hn
  have hak : a = n • Pi.single k 1 := by
    ext l
    by_cases hl : l = k
    · subst hl; simp [hn, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (ha0 l)]
    · simp [hl, hal l hl]
  have hμn : P.rootOf a = n • P.root k := by rw [hak, rootOf_nsmul_single]
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    rintro h0
    exact ha (by rw [hak, h0, zero_smul])
  rw [hμn] at hxμ ⊢
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 3 with hn3 | hn3
  · rcases (show n = 1 ∨ n = 2 by omega) with h1 | h2
    · left; rw [h1, one_smul]
    · right; rw [h2]
  · exact absurd (eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root P p hn3 hx hxμ) hx0

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_nsmul_root_or_neg
statement:
lemma eq_nsmul_root_or_neg {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hμ0 : μ ≠ 0) {k : ι} {c : K}
    (hc : μ = c • P.root k) :
    μ = P.root k ∨ μ = 2 • P.root k ∨ μ = -P.root k ∨ μ = -(2 • P.root k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_allWeights P p hx hxμ hx0 with (hμ | hμ) | hμ
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyμ, rfl⟩ := exists_omega_eq P p hx (show x ∈ weightSpace P p (-(-μ)) by
      rwa [neg_neg])
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hx0 (map_zero _)
    rcases eq_nsmul_root_of_mem_posWeights P p ((AuxLieAlgebra.mem_negWeights_iff P).mp hμ)
      hy hyμ hy0 (c := -c) (by rw [hc]; module) with h | h
    · right; right; left; rw [← h, neg_neg]
    · right; right; right; rw [← h, neg_neg]
  · exact absurd hμ hμ0
  · rcases eq_nsmul_root_of_mem_posWeights P p hμ hx hxμ hx0 hc with h | h
    · left; exact h
    · right; left; exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.zSign_injective
statement: lemma zSign_injective : Function.Injective (zSign K)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;> rcases zmod_two_cases b with rfl | rfl
  · rfl
  · rw [zSign_zero, zSign_one] at hab; norm_num at hab
  · rw [zSign_zero, zSign_one] at hab; norm_num at hab
  · rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_of_isHomog_of_isHomog
statement:
lemma eq_of_isHomog_of_isHomog {a b : ZMod 2} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx0 : x ≠ 0)
    (ha : IsHomog P p a x) (hb : IsHomog P p b x) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  refine zSign_injective (K := K) ?_
  have : (zSign K a - zSign K b) • x = 0 := by rw [sub_smul, ← ha, ← hb, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 ((smul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right hx0)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_eq_of_mem_root
statement:
lemma parity_eq_of_mem_root {k : ι} {b : ZMod 2} {y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hyk : y ∈ weightSpace P p (P.root k) ∨ y ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.root k)) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hyb : IsHomog P p b y) : b = p k
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_isHomog_of_isHomog P p hy0 hyb ?_
  rcases hyk with hyk | hyk
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_root P p hy hyk
    exact (isHomog_e P p k).smul c
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_neg_root P p hy hyk
    exact (isHomog_f P p k).smul c

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_e_of_even
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_e_of_even {k : ι} (hk : p k = 0) :
    superBracket P p (e P p k) (e P p k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_e P p k) (isHomog_e P p k), hk, mul_zero, zSign_zero,
    one_smul, sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_f_of_even
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_f_of_even {k : ι} (hk : p k = 0) :
    superBracket P p (f P p k) (f P p k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_f P p k) (isHomog_f P p k), hk, mul_zero, zSign_zero,
    one_smul, sub_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_mem_two_root_of_even
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_two_root_of_even {k : ι} (hk : p k = 0) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxk : x ∈ weightSpace P p (2 • P.root k) ∨ x ∈ weightSpace P p (-(2 • P.root k))) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hxk with hxk | hxk
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_two_root P p hx hxk
    rw [superBracket_e_e_of_even P p hk, smul_zero]
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_neg_two_root P p hx hxk
    rw [superBracket_f_f_of_even P p hk, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma superBracket_zero_right (x : P.SuperEnveloping p) : superBracket P p x 0 = 0

:=
  (superBracketRight P p x).map_zero

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_smul_eq_of_mem_root
statement:
lemma exists_smul_eq_of_mem_root {β : Dual K H} {k : ι} (hβk : β = P.root k ∨ β = -P.root k)
    {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxβ : x ∈ weightSpace P p β)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyβ : y ∈ weightSpace P p β) (hy0 : y ≠ 0) : ∃ c : K, x = c • y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hβk with rfl | rfl
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_root P p hx hxβ
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_root P p hy hyβ
    have hd : d ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hy0 (zero_smul _ _)
    exact ⟨c / d, by rw [smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ c hd]⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_neg_root P p hx hxβ
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_neg_root P p hy hyβ
    have hd : d ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hy0 (zero_smul _ _)
    exact ⟨c / d, by rw [smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ c hd]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_mem_two_of_even
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_two_of_even {β : Dual K H} {k : ι} (hk : p k = 0)
    (hβk : β = P.root k ∨ β = -P.root k) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxβ : x ∈ weightSpace P p (β + β) ∨ x ∈ weightSpace P p (-(β + β))) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_zero_of_mem_two_root_of_even P p hk hx ?_
  rcases hβk with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hxβ with h | h
  · left; rwa [two_nsmul]
  · right; rwa [two_nsmul]
  · right; rwa [two_nsmul, neg_add]
  · left; rwa [two_nsmul, ← neg_neg (P.root k + P.root k), neg_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_mem_three
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_three {β : Dual K H} {k : ι} (hβk : β = P.root k ∨ β = -P.root k)
    {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxβ : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-(β + β + β))) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hβk with rfl | rfl
  · rw [show P.root k + P.root k + P.root k = 3 • P.root k by abel] at hxβ
    exact eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_neg_nsmul_root P p le_rfl hx hxβ
  · rw [show -(-P.root k + -P.root k + -P.root k) = 3 • P.root k by abel] at hxβ
    exact eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root P p le_rfl hx hxβ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lieEqForm_root
statement: lemma lieEqForm_root (i : ι) : LieEqForm P p S (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  refine lieEqForm_of_exists (P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i) fun x hx hxμ y hy hyμ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_root P p hx hxμ
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_neg_root P p hy hyμ
  have hε : (S.ε i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i
  have hef : superBracket P p (e P p i) (f P p i) = h P p (P.coroot i) := by
    simp [superBracket_e_f]
  refine ⟨c * d * S.ε i, ?_⟩
  rw [superBracket_smul_left, superBracket_smul_right, hef, toDual_symm_root, map_smul, smul_smul,
    smul_smul, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hε, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_of_left_eq_zero
statement:
lemma invTriple_of_left_eq_zero {a b : ZMod 2} {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x = 0) :
    InvTriple P p S a b x y z
proof:
:= by
  subst hx; simp [InvTriple, superBracket_zero_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_of_middle_eq_zero
statement:
lemma invTriple_of_middle_eq_zero {a b : ZMod 2} {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hy : y = 0) :
    InvTriple P p S a b x y z
proof:
:= by
  subst hy; simp [InvTriple, superBracket_zero_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_of_right_eq_zero
statement:
lemma invTriple_of_right_eq_zero {a b : ZMod 2} {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : z = 0) :
    InvTriple P p S a b x y z
proof:
:= by
  subst hz; simp [InvTriple]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_of_smul_h_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_smul_h_eq {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {A B : K}
    (h2 : (2 : K) • ((A - B) • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm μ)) = 0) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  have hu : h P p ((P.toDual S).symm μ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hμ (by
    simpa using (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).1 (h_injective P p) _ h0)
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 ((smul_eq_zero.1 ((smul_eq_zero.1 h2).resolve_left two_ne_zero)).resolve_right
    hu)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_of_linearIndependent
statement:
lemma invTriple_of_linearIndependent {α β : Dual K H} {a b c : ZMod 2}
    {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hα : LieEqForm P p S α) (hβ : LieEqForm P p S β) (hαβ : LieEqForm P p S (α + β))
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxα : x ∈ weightSpace P p α) (hxa : IsHomog P p a x)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyβ : y ∈ weightSpace P p β) (hyb : IsHomog P p b y)
    (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p (-(α + β))) (hzc : IsHomog P p c z)
    (hind : LinearIndependent K ![α, β]) : InvTriple P p S a b x y z
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := hα x hx hxα _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hy hz)
    ((show β + -(α + β) = -α by abel) ▸ superBracket_mem_weightSpace hyβ hzγ)
  have e2 := hαβ _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hy) (superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxα hyβ) z
    hz hzγ
  have e3 := hβ y hy hyβ _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hz)
    ((show α + -(α + β) = -β by abel) ▸ superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxα hzγ)
  have hJ := superBracket_jacobi hxa hyb hzc
  rw [e1, e2, e3, map_add, map_add] at hJ
  set A := invForm P p S x (superBracket P p y z)
  set B := invForm P p S (superBracket P p x y) z
  set C := invForm P p S y (superBracket P p x z)
  have key : (A - B) • α + (-B - zSign K (a * b) * C) • β = 0 := by
    have : h P p ((P.toDual S).symm ((A - B) • α + (-B - zSign K (a * b) * C) • β)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
      linear_combination (norm := module) hJ
    exact (P.toDual S).symm.map_eq_zero_iff.1
      ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).1 (h_injective P p) _ this)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := LinearIndependent.pair_iff.1 hind _ _ key
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.1 h1, by linear_combination -h2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_of_weight_zero_left
statement:
lemma invTriple_of_weight_zero_left {β : Dual K H} {a b : ZMod 2} {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hβ : LieEqForm P p S β) (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hx0 : x ∈ weightSpace P p 0)
    (hxa : IsHomog P p a x) (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyβ : y ∈ weightSpace P p β)
    (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzβ : z ∈ weightSpace P p (-β)) : InvTriple P p S a b x y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : x ∈ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]; exact ⟨hx, hx0⟩
  by_cases ht : h P p t = 0
  · exact invTriple_of_left_eq_zero ht
  obtain rfl : a = 0 := eq_of_isHomog_of_isHomog P p ht hxa (isHomog_h P p t)
  have e1 : invForm P p S (h P p t) (superBracket P p y z) = β t * invForm P p S y z := by
    rw [hβ y hy hyβ z hz hzβ, map_smul, invForm_h_h, bilinForm_toDual_symm_right, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_comm]
  have e2 : invForm P p S (superBracket P p (h P p t) y) z = β t * invForm P p S y z := by
    rw [superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p t hyβ, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have e3 : invForm P p S y (superBracket P p (h P p t) z) = -(β t * invForm P p S y z) := by
    rw [superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p t hzβ, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.neg_apply,
      neg_mul]
  refine ⟨e1.trans e2.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [e2, e3, zero_mul, zSign_zero, one_mul, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_of_weight_zero_right
statement:
lemma invTriple_of_weight_zero_right {α : Dual K H} {a b : ZMod 2} {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hα : LieEqForm P p S α) (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxα : x ∈ weightSpace P p α)
    (hxa : IsHomog P p a x) (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyα : y ∈ weightSpace P p (-α))
    (hyb : IsHomog P p b y) (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hz0 : z ∈ weightSpace P p 0) :
    InvTriple P p S a b x y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : z ∈ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]; exact ⟨hz, hz0⟩
  have hs := invForm_swap P p S hx hxα hxa hy hyα hyb
  unfold InvTriple
  rw [superBracket_swap (isHomog_h P p t) hyb, superBracket_swap (isHomog_h P p t) hxa,
    superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p t hyα, superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p t hxα,
    hα x hx hxα y hy hyα]
  simp only [zero_mul, zSign_zero, one_smul, map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.neg_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, invForm_h_h, bilinForm_toDual_symm_left, hs]
  refine ⟨by ring, ?_⟩
  linear_combination (-(α t * invForm P p S x y)) * zSign_mul_self (K := K) (a * b)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_smul_left
statement:
lemma invTriple_smul_left {β : Dual K H} (hβ0 : β ≠ 0) {a c' : ZMod 2} {c : K}
    {y z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hβ : LieEqForm P p S β) (hββ : LieEqForm P p S (β + β))
    (hxa : IsHomog P p a (c • y)) (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyβ : y ∈ weightSpace P p β)
    (hyb : IsHomog P p 1 y) (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzβ : z ∈ weightSpace P p (-(β + β)))
    (hzc : IsHomog P p c' z) : InvTriple P p S a 1 (c • y) y z
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (c • y) 0 with h0 | h0
  · exact invTriple_of_left_eq_zero h0
  obtain rfl : a = 1 := eq_of_isHomog_of_isHomog P p h0 hxa (hyb.smul c)
  have e1 := hβ y hy hyβ _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hy hz)
    ((show β + -(β + β) = -β by abel) ▸ superBracket_mem_weightSpace hyβ hzβ)
  have e2 := hββ _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hy hy) (superBracket_mem_weightSpace hyβ hyβ) z
    hz hzβ
  have hJ := superBracket_jacobi hyb hyb hzc
  rw [e1, e2, map_add, map_add, mul_one, zSign_one] at hJ
  have hAB : invForm P p S y (superBracket P p y z) = invForm P p S (superBracket P p y y) z :=
    eq_of_smul_h_eq (P := P) (p := p) (S := S) hβ0 (by linear_combination (norm := module) hJ)
  simp only [InvTriple, superBracket_smul_left, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one, zSign_one]
  rw [hAB]
  exact ⟨rfl, by ring⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_smul_right
statement:
lemma invTriple_smul_right {β : Dual K H} (hβ0 : β ≠ 0) {a : ZMod 2} {c : K}
    {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hβ : LieEqForm P p S β) (hββ : LieEqForm P p S (β + β))
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxβ : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-(β + β))) (hxa : IsHomog P p a x)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyβ : y ∈ weightSpace P p β) (hyb : IsHomog P p 1 y) :
    InvTriple P p S a 1 x y (c • y)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy := superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hy
  have hxyβ : superBracket P p x y ∈ weightSpace P p (-β) :=
    (show -(β + β) + β = -β by abel) ▸ superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxβ hyβ
  have e1 := hββ.neg x hx hxβ _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hy hy)
    (by rw [neg_neg]; exact superBracket_mem_weightSpace hyβ hyβ)
  have e2 := hβ.neg _ hxy hxyβ y hy (by rwa [neg_neg])
  have hJ := superBracket_jacobi hxa hyb hyb
  rw [superBracket_swap (hxa.superBracket hyb) hyb, e1, e2] at hJ
  have hs := invForm_swap P p S hy hyβ hyb hxy hxyβ (hxa.superBracket hyb)
  have hAB : invForm P p S x (superBracket P p y y) = invForm P p S (superBracket P p x y) y := by
    refine eq_of_smul_h_eq (P := P) (p := p) (S := S) hβ0 ?_
    rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;>
      simp only [map_neg, map_add, zero_add, mul_one, zSign_zero, zSign_one,
        show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl] at hJ <;>
      linear_combination (norm := module) (-1 : K) • hJ
  simp only [InvTriple, superBracket_smul_right, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hAB, hs]
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp only [one_mul, zero_add, zSign_zero, zSign_one, show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl] <;>
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invTriple_of_root
statement:
lemma invTriple_of_root {α β : Dual K H} {a b c : ZMod 2} {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hα : LieEqForm P p S α) (hβ : LieEqForm P p S β) (hαβ : LieEqForm P p S (α + β))
    (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxα : x ∈ weightSpace P p α) (hxa : IsHomog P p a x)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hyβ : y ∈ weightSpace P p β) (hyb : IsHomog P p b y)
    (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p (-(α + β))) (hzc : IsHomog P p c z)
    {k : ι} (hβk : β = P.root k ∨ β = -P.root k) : InvTriple P p S a b x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact invTriple_of_left_eq_zero hx0
  by_cases hy0 : y = 0
  · exact invTriple_of_middle_eq_zero hy0
  by_cases hz0 : z = 0
  · exact invTriple_of_right_eq_zero hz0
  by_cases hα0 : α = 0
  · subst hα0
    exact invTriple_of_weight_zero_left hβ hx hxα hxa hy hyβ hz (by simpa using hzγ)
  by_cases hγ0 : α + β = 0
  · obtain rfl : β = -α := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hγ0
    exact invTriple_of_weight_zero_right hα hx hxα hxa hy hyβ hyb hz (by simpa using hzγ)
  have hβ0 : β ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hβk with rfl | rfl <;> simp [P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero k]
  by_cases hind : LinearIndependent K ![α, β]
  · exact invTriple_of_linearIndependent hα hβ hαβ hx hxα hxa hy hyβ hyb hz hzγ hzc hind
  have hc : ∃ c : K, α = c • P.root k := by
    rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hind
    simp only [not_forall] at hind
    obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hne⟩ := hind
    have hs : s ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [zero_smul, zero_add] at hst
      exact hne ⟨rfl, (smul_eq_zero.1 hst).resolve_right hβ0⟩
    have hαβ' : α = (-(s⁻¹ * t)) • β := by
      have h1 : s • α = -(t • β) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hst
      calc α = s⁻¹ • (s • α) := by rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs, one_smul]
        _ = _ := by rw [h1]; module
    rcases hβk with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨_, hαβ'⟩
    · exact ⟨s⁻¹ * t, by rw [hαβ', smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg]⟩
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc⟩ := hc
  have hdep : α = β ∨ α = β + β ∨ α = -β ∨ α = -(β + β) := by
    rcases eq_nsmul_root_or_neg P p hx hxα hx0 hα0 hc with h | h | h | h <;>
      rcases hβk with rfl | rfl <;> subst h
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (neg_neg _).symm))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (two_nsmul _))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [two_nsmul, neg_add, neg_neg])))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [two_nsmul])))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by rw [two_nsmul, neg_add]))
  have hyk : y ∈ weightSpace P p (P.root k) ∨ y ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.root k) := by
    rcases hβk with rfl | rfl
    exacts [Or.inl hyβ, Or.inr hyβ]
  have hb := parity_eq_of_mem_root P p hy hyk hy0 hyb
  rcases hdep with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · rcases zmod_two_cases (p k) with hk | hk
    · exact absurd (eq_zero_of_mem_two_of_even P p hk hβk hz (Or.inr hzγ)) hz0
    obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_mem_root P p hβk hx hxα hy hyβ hy0
    rw [hb, hk] at hyb ⊢
    exact invTriple_smul_left hβ0 hβ hαβ hxa hy hyβ hyb hz hzγ hzc
  · exact absurd (eq_zero_of_mem_three P p hβk hz hzγ) hz0
  · exact absurd (neg_add_cancel β) hγ0
  · rcases zmod_two_cases (p k) with hk | hk
    · exact absurd (eq_zero_of_mem_two_of_even P p hk hβk hx (Or.inr hxα)) hx0
    have hzβ : z ∈ weightSpace P p β := by
      rwa [show -(-(β + β) + β) = β by abel] at hzγ
    obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_mem_root P p hβk hz hzβ hy hyβ hy0
    rw [hb, hk] at hyb ⊢
    have hββ : LieEqForm P p S (β + β) := by simpa using hα.neg
    exact invTriple_smul_right hβ0 hβ hββ hx hxα hxa hy hyβ hyb

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_induction_e
statement:
lemma gTilde_induction_e {μ : Dual K H} {q : P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop}
    (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) (hμ1 : ∀ j, μ ≠ P.root j) (zero : q 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, q x → q y → q (x + y)) (smul : ∀ (c : K) x, q x → q (c • x))
    (gen : ∀ j ν (a : ZMod 2), ν ∈ P.posWeights → μ = P.root j + ν → ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p,
      x ∈ weightSpace P p ν → IsHomog P p a x → q (superBracket P p (e P p j) x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, x ∈ weightSpace P p μ → q x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hμ
  intro x hx hxμ
  have hx' : x ∈ nPlusRoot P p k := by
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf P p hk]; exact ⟨hx, hxμ⟩
  clear hx hxμ
  induction hx' using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, w, hkw, rfl⟩ := hx
    cases w with
    | nil => exact absurd (by rw [← hkw]; simp) (hμ1 i)
    | cons j w =>
      rw [eLie_cons]
      refine gen j _ _ ⟨_, wordVec_cons_mem_posCone i w, rfl⟩ ?_ _
        (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w)) (eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf P p i w)
        (isHomog_eLie P p i w)
      rw [← hkw, ← rootOf_single P j, ← map_add]
      congr 1
      simp only [wordVec_cons]
      abel
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add x y hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => exact smul c x hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_induction_f
statement:
lemma gTilde_induction_f {μ : Dual K H} {q : P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop}
    (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) (hμ1 : ∀ j, μ ≠ P.root j) (zero : q 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, q x → q y → q (x + y)) (smul : ∀ (c : K) x, q x → q (c • x))
    (gen : ∀ j ν (a : ZMod 2), ν ∈ P.posWeights → μ = P.root j + ν → ∀ y ∈ gTilde P p,
      y ∈ weightSpace P p (-ν) → IsHomog P p a y → q (superBracket P p (f P p j) y)) :
    ∀ y ∈ gTilde P p, y ∈ weightSpace P p (-μ) → q y
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy hyμ
  obtain ⟨y, hy', hyμ', rfl⟩ := exists_omega_eq P p hy hyμ
  refine gTilde_induction_e P p (q := fun x ↦ q (omega P p x)) hμ hμ1 (by simpa using zero)
    (fun x y hx hy ↦ by simpa using add _ _ hx hy) (fun c x hx ↦ by simpa using smul c _ hx)
    (fun j ν a hν hμν x hx hxν hxa ↦ ?_) y hy' hyμ'
  rw [omega_superBracket, omega_e]
  exact gen j ν a hν hμν _ (omega_mem_gTilde P p hx) (omega_mem_weightSpace P p hxν) hxa.omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.zSign_mul_mul_zSign
statement:
lemma zSign_mul_mul_zSign (a b c : ZMod 2) :
    zSign K (c * b) = zSign K (c * a) * zSign K ((a + b) * c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;> rcases zmod_two_cases b with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases zmod_two_cases c with rfl | rfl <;> simp [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.zSign_mul_zSign_mul_comm
statement: lemma zSign_mul_zSign_mul_comm (a b : ZMod 2) : zSign K (a * b) * zSign K (b * a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm b a, zSign_mul_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_superBracket_f
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_superBracket_f {μ ν κ : Dual K H} {i j : ι} {a b : ZMod 2}
    (hν : μ = P.root j + ν) (hκ : μ = P.root i + κ) (hCi : LieEqForm P p S (P.root i))
    (hCj : LieEqForm P p S (P.root j)) (hCν : LieEqForm P p S ν) (hCκ : LieEqForm P p S κ)
    (hCνi : LieEqForm P p S (ν - P.root i)) {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxν : x ∈ weightSpace P p ν) (hxa : IsHomog P p a x) (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hyκ : y ∈ weightSpace P p (-κ)) (hyb : IsHomog P p b y) :
    superBracket P p (superBracket P p (e P p j) x) (superBracket P p (f P p i) y) =
      invForm P p S (e P p j) (superBracket P p x (superBracket P p (f P p i) y)) •
        h P p ((P.toDual S).symm μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hκ' : κ = P.root j + ν - P.root i := by rw [← hν, hκ]; abel
  subst hκ' hν
  have he := nPlus_le_gTilde P p (e_mem_nPlus P p j)
  have hf := nMinus_le_gTilde P p (f_mem_nMinus P p i)
  set w := superBracket P p (f P p i) y with hw
  set u := superBracket P p x (f P p i) with hu
  set z := superBracket P p (e P p j) y with hz
  have hwG : w ∈ gTilde P p := superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hf hy
  have hwμ : w ∈ weightSpace P p (-(P.root j + ν)) := by
    have := superBracket_mem_weightSpace (f_mem_weightSpace P p i) hyκ
    rwa [show -P.root i + -(P.root j + ν - P.root i) = -(P.root j + ν) by abel] at this
  have hwd : IsHomog P p (p i + b) w := (isHomog_f P p i).superBracket hyb
  have hxw : superBracket P p x w ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.root j) := by
    have := superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxν hwμ
    rwa [show ν + -(P.root j + ν) = -P.root j by abel] at this
  have hew : superBracket P p (e P p j) w ∈ weightSpace P p (-ν) := by
    have := superBracket_mem_weightSpace (e_mem_weightSpace P p j) hwμ
    rwa [show P.root j + -(P.root j + ν) = -ν by abel] at this
  have huG : u ∈ gTilde P p := superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hf
  have huν : u ∈ weightSpace P p (ν + -P.root i) :=
    superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxν (f_mem_weightSpace P p i)
  have hzG : z ∈ gTilde P p := superBracket_mem_gTilde P p he hy
  have hzν : z ∈ weightSpace P p (-(ν + -P.root i)) := by
    have := superBracket_mem_weightSpace (e_mem_weightSpace P p j) hyκ
    rwa [show P.root j + -(P.root j + ν - P.root i) = -(ν + -P.root i) by abel] at this
  
  have h1 : invForm P p S x (superBracket P p (f P p i) z) = invForm P p S u z :=
    (invTriple_of_root hCν hCi.neg (by rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg]) hx hxν hxa hf
      (f_mem_weightSpace P p i) (isHomog_f P p i) hzG hzν ((isHomog_e P p j).superBracket hyb)
      (Or.inr rfl)).1
  
  have h2 : invForm P p S u z =
      -(zSign K ((a + p i) * p j) * invForm P p S (e P p j) (superBracket P p u y)) := by
    have ht := invTriple_of_root (a := a + p i) (b := p j) (c := b) (by
      rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]; exact hCνi) hCj
      (by convert hCκ using 2; abel) huG huν (hxa.superBracket (isHomog_f P p i))
      he (e_mem_weightSpace P p j) (isHomog_e P p j) hy
      (by rwa [show ν + -P.root i + P.root j = P.root j + ν - P.root i by abel]) hyb
      (Or.inl rfl)
    rw [ht.1, ht.2]
  
  have key : invForm P p S x (superBracket P p (e P p j) w) =
      -(zSign K (p j * a) * invForm P p S (e P p j) (superBracket P p x w)) := by
    have hew' := superBracket_jacobi (isHomog_e P p j) (isHomog_f P p i) hyb
    have hxw' := superBracket_jacobi hxa (isHomog_f P p i) hyb
    rw [← hw] at hew' hxw'
    rw [← hu] at hxw'
    rw [← hz] at hew'
    rw [hew', hxw', map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, h1, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hs := zSign_mul_mul_zSign (K := K) a (p i) (p j)
    have hsq := zSign_mul_self (K := K) ((a + p i) * p j)
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      have hyν : y ∈ weightSpace P p (-ν) := by
        rwa [show P.root i + ν - P.root i = ν by abel] at hyκ
      have hε : (S.ε i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i
      have hroot : P.root i ((P.toDual S).symm ν) = (S.ε i : K)⁻¹ * ν (P.coroot i) := by
        rw [← P.bilinForm_toDual_symm_left S (P.root i) ((P.toDual S).symm ν),
          toDual_symm_root, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, bilinForm_toDual_symm_right,
          smul_eq_mul]
      have hef : superBracket P p (e P p i) (f P p i) = h P p (P.coroot i) := by
        simp [superBracket_e_f]
      have e1 : invForm P p S x (superBracket P p (superBracket P p (e P p i) (f P p i)) y) =
          -(ν (P.coroot i) * invForm P p S x y) := by
        rw [hef, superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p _ hyν, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
          LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_mul]
      have e2 : invForm P p S (e P p i) (superBracket P p (f P p i) (superBracket P p x y)) =
          ν (P.coroot i) * invForm P p S x y := by
        have hxy := hCν x hx hxν y hy hyν
        have hei : invForm P p S (e P p i) (f P p i) = S.ε i := by simp [invForm_e_f]
        rw [hxy, superBracket_smul_right, superBracket_swap (isHomog_h P p _) (isHomog_f P p i),
          superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p _ (f_mem_weightSpace P p i), zero_mul, zSign_zero,
          one_smul, map_smul, map_neg, map_smul, hei, LinearMap.neg_apply, hroot]
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
      have hpa := zSign_mul_zSign_mul_comm (K := K) (p i) a
      rw [e1, e2, h2]
      linear_combination zSign K (p i * p i) * h2 * 0 -
        (zSign K ((a + p i) * p i) * invForm P p S (e P p i) (superBracket P p u y)) * hs -
        (zSign K (p i * a) * invForm P p S (e P p i) (superBracket P p u y)) * hsq +
        ν (P.coroot i) * invForm P p S x y * hpa
    · have hef : superBracket P p (e P p j) (f P p i) = 0 := by
        simp [superBracket_e_f, Ne.symm hij]
      have hxy : superBracket P p x y = 0 := by
        by_contra h0
        have hmem := superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxν hyκ
        rw [show ν + -(P.root j + ν - P.root i) = P.root i - P.root j by abel] at hmem
        exact AuxLieAlgebra.root_sub_root_notMem P hij
          (mem_allWeights P p (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hy) hmem h0)
      rw [hef, hxy, superBracket_zero_left, superBracket_zero_right]
      simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
      rw [h2]
      linear_combination
        -(zSign K ((a + p i) * p j) * invForm P p S (e P p j) (superBracket P p u y)) * hs -
        (zSign K (p j * a) * invForm P p S (e P p j) (superBracket P p u y)) * hsq
  have hJ := superBracket_jacobi (isHomog_e P p j) hxa hwd
  rw [hCj _ he (e_mem_weightSpace P p j) _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hwG) hxw,
    hCν _ hx hxν _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p he hwG) hew, key] at hJ
  have hs := zSign_mul_self (K := K) (p j * a)
  rw [map_add, map_add]
  linear_combination (norm := module) -hJ +
    hs • (invForm P p S (e P p j) (superBracket P p x w) • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm ν))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lieEqForm
statement: theorem lieEqForm (μ : Dual K H) : LieEqForm P p S μ
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ μ ∈ P.posWeights, μ P.rhoCheck = n → LieEqForm P p S μ := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ n IH =>
    intro μ hμ hμn
    have low : ∀ ν : Dual K H, ∀ m : ℤ, ν P.rhoCheck = m → |m| < n → LieEqForm P p S ν := by
      intro ν m hν hm
      by_cases hνw : ν ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P
      · rcases hνw with (hν' | hν') | hν'
        · obtain ⟨m', -, hνm'⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.exists_nat_eq_of_mem_negWeights P hν'
          have hmm : (m' : ℤ) = -m := by
            have : ((m' : ℤ) : K) = ((-m : ℤ) : K) := by
              push_cast; rw [← hν, hνm', neg_neg]
            exact_mod_cast this
          have := (IH m' (by rw [abs_lt] at hm; omega) _
            ((AuxLieAlgebra.mem_negWeights_iff P).mp hν')
            (by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, hνm', neg_neg])).neg
          rwa [neg_neg] at this
        · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hν']
          exact lieEqForm_zero P p S
        · obtain ⟨m', -, hνm'⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights P hν'
          have hmm : (m' : ℤ) = m := by
            have : ((m' : ℤ) : K) = ((m : ℤ) : K) := by push_cast; rw [← hν, hνm']
            exact_mod_cast this
          exact IH m' (by rw [abs_lt] at hm; omega) _ hν' hνm'
      · exact lieEqForm_of_notMem S hνw
    by_cases hμ1 : ∃ j, μ = P.root j
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hμ1
      exact lieEqForm_root P p S j
    simp only [not_exists] at hμ1
    refine lieEqForm_of_exists (fun h0 ↦ P.zero_notMem_posWeights (h0 ▸ hμ)) ?_
    refine gTilde_induction_e P p (q := fun x ↦ ∀ y ∈ gTilde P p, y ∈ weightSpace P p (-μ) →
      ∃ c : K, superBracket P p x y = c • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm μ)) hμ hμ1 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact fun y _ _ ↦ ⟨0, by simp [superBracket_zero_left]⟩
    · intro x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ y hy hyμ
      obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ := h₁ y hy hyμ
      obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂⟩ := h₂ y hy hyμ
      exact ⟨c₁ + c₂, by rw [superBracket_add_left, hc₁, hc₂, add_smul]⟩
    · intro c x hx y hy hyμ
      obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hx y hy hyμ
      exact ⟨c * c', by rw [superBracket_smul_left, hc', smul_smul]⟩
    intro j ν a hν hμν x hx hxν hxa
    refine gTilde_induction_f P p (q := fun y ↦ ∃ c : K,
      superBracket P p (superBracket P p (e P p j) x) y = c • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm μ))
      hμ hμ1 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · rintro y₁ y₂ ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ ⟨c₂, hc₂⟩
      exact ⟨c₁ + c₂, by rw [superBracket_add_right, hc₁, hc₂, add_smul]⟩
    · rintro c y ⟨c', hc'⟩
      exact ⟨c * c', by rw [superBracket_smul_right, hc', smul_smul]⟩
    intro i κ b hκ hμκ y hy hyκ hyb
    obtain ⟨mν, hmν, hνm⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights P hν
    have hνρ : ν P.rhoCheck = ((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) := by
      rw [show ν = μ - P.root j by rw [hμν]; abel, LinearMap.sub_apply, hμn, root_rhoCheck]
      push_cast; ring
    have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by
      have : ((mν : ℤ) : K) = ((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) := by rw [← hνρ, hνm, Int.cast_natCast]
      have := (Int.cast_injective (α := K)) this
      omega
    have hκρ : κ P.rhoCheck = ((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) := by
      rw [show κ = μ - P.root i by rw [hμκ]; abel, LinearMap.sub_apply, hμn, root_rhoCheck]
      push_cast; ring
    have hνiρ : (ν - P.root i) P.rhoCheck = ((n : ℤ) - 2 : ℤ) := by
      rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, hνρ, root_rhoCheck]
      push_cast; ring
    have hrρ : ∀ k, P.root k P.rhoCheck = ((1 : ℤ) : K) := fun k ↦ by simp
    have hlt : ∀ m : ℤ, (m = 1 ∨ m = n - 1 ∨ m = n - 2) → |m| < n := by
      intro m hm
      rw [abs_lt]
      omega
    exact ⟨_, superBracket_e_superBracket_f hμν hμκ (low _ _ (hrρ i) (hlt _ (Or.inl rfl)))
      (low _ _ (hrρ j) (hlt _ (Or.inl rfl))) (low _ _ hνρ (hlt _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))))
      (low _ _ hκρ (hlt _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))))
      (low _ _ hνiρ (hlt _ (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))) hx hxν hxa hy hyκ hyb⟩
  by_cases hμw : μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P
  · rcases hμw with (hμ | hμ) | hμ
    · obtain ⟨n, -, hμn⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights P
        ((AuxLieAlgebra.mem_negWeights_iff P).mp hμ)
      simpa using (hpos n _ ((AuxLieAlgebra.mem_negWeights_iff P).mp hμ) hμn).neg
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hμ]
      exact lieEqForm_zero P p S
    · obtain ⟨n, -, hμn⟩ := AuxLieAlgebra.exists_nat_of_mem_posWeights P hμ
      exact hpos n μ hμ hμn
  · exact lieEqForm_of_notMem S hμw

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.forall_gTilde_of_homog
statement:
lemma forall_gTilde_of_homog {q : P.SuperEnveloping p → P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop}
    (add_left : ∀ x₁ x₂ z, q x₁ z → q x₂ z → q (x₁ + x₂) z)
    (add_right : ∀ x z₁ z₂, q x z₁ → q x z₂ → q x (z₁ + z₂))
    (hom : ∀ (α γ : Dual K H) (a c : ZMod 2), ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, x ∈ weightSpace P p α →
      IsHomog P p a x → ∀ z ∈ gTilde P p, z ∈ weightSpace P p γ → IsHomog P p c z → q x z)
    {x z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) : q x z
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_gTilde P p (q := fun x ↦ q x z) hx (fun α x hx hxα ↦ ?_)
    (fun x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ add_left _ _ _ h₁ h₂)
  refine induction_homog P p (q := fun x ↦ q x z) hx hxα (fun a x hx hxα hxa ↦ ?_)
    (fun x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ add_left _ _ _ h₁ h₂)
  refine induction_on_gTilde P p (q := fun z ↦ q x z) hz (fun γ z hz hzγ ↦ ?_)
    (fun z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ add_right _ _ _ h₁ h₂)
  exact induction_homog P p (q := fun z ↦ q x z) hz hzγ
    (fun c z hz hzγ hzc ↦ hom α γ a c x hx hxα hxa z hz hzγ hzc)
    (fun z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ add_right _ _ _ h₁ h₂)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.midInv_of_weight
statement:
lemma midInv_of_weight {β : Dual K H} {y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hyβ : y ∈ weightSpace P p β)
    (hinv : ∀ (α : Dual K H) (a c : ZMod 2), ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, x ∈ weightSpace P p α →
      IsHomog P p a x → ∀ z ∈ gTilde P p, z ∈ weightSpace P p (-(α + β)) → IsHomog P p c z →
      invForm P p S (superBracket P p x y) z = invForm P p S x (superBracket P p y z)) :
    MidInv P p S y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx z hz
  refine forall_gTilde_of_homog P p (q := fun x z ↦ invForm P p S (superBracket P p x y) z =
    invForm P p S x (superBracket P p y z)) ?_ ?_ ?_ hx hz
  · intro x₁ x₂ z h₁ h₂
    simp only [superBracket_add_left, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂]
  · intro x z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [superBracket_add_right, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  intro α γ a c x hx hxα hxa z hz hzγ hzc
  by_cases hs : α + β + γ = 0
  · obtain rfl : γ = -(α + β) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hs
    exact hinv α a c x hx hxα hxa z hz hzγ hzc
  · rw [invForm_eq_zero P p S (superBracket_mem_weightSpace hxα hyβ) hzγ hs,
      invForm_eq_zero P p S hxα (superBracket_mem_weightSpace hyβ hzγ) (by rwa [← add_assoc])]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.midInv_e
statement: lemma midInv_e (k : ι) : MidInv P p S (e P p k)
proof:
:=
  midInv_of_weight (e_mem_weightSpace P p k) fun α _ _ _ hx hxα hxa _ hz hzγ hzc ↦
    ((invTriple_of_root (lieEqForm P p S α) (lieEqForm P p S _) (lieEqForm P p S _) hx hxα hxa
      (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (e_mem_nPlus P p k)) (e_mem_weightSpace P p k) (isHomog_e P p k)
      hz hzγ hzc (Or.inl rfl)).1).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.midInv_f
statement: lemma midInv_f (k : ι) : MidInv P p S (f P p k)
proof:
:=
  midInv_of_weight (f_mem_weightSpace P p k) fun α _ _ _ hx hxα hxa _ hz hzγ hzc ↦
    ((invTriple_of_root (lieEqForm P p S α) (lieEqForm P p S _) (lieEqForm P p S _) hx hxα hxa
      (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (f_mem_nMinus P p k)) (f_mem_weightSpace P p k) (isHomog_f P p k)
      hz hzγ hzc (Or.inr rfl)).1).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.midInv_h
statement: lemma midInv_h (t : H) : MidInv P p S (h P p t)
proof:
:= by
  refine midInv_of_weight (h_mem_weightSpace P p t) fun α a _ x _ hxα hxa z _ hzγ _ ↦ ?_
  rw [add_zero] at hzγ
  rw [superBracket_swap (isHomog_h P p t) hxa, superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p t hxα,
    superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p t hzγ, zero_mul, zSign_zero, one_smul]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.MidInv.bracket
statement:
lemma MidInv.bracket {a b : ZMod 2} {y₁ y₂ : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hy₁ : y₁ ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hy₂ : y₂ ∈ gTilde P p) (ha : IsHomog P p a y₁) (hb : IsHomog P p b y₂)
    (h₁ : MidInv P p S y₁) (h₂ : MidInv P p S y₂) : MidInv P p S (superBracket P p y₁ y₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx z hz
  refine forall_gTilde_of_homog P p (q := fun x z ↦
    invForm P p S (superBracket P p x (superBracket P p y₁ y₂)) z =
      invForm P p S x (superBracket P p (superBracket P p y₁ y₂) z)) ?_ ?_ ?_ hx hz
  · intro x₁ x₂ z e₁ e₂
    simp only [superBracket_add_left, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, e₁, e₂]
  · intro x z₁ z₂ e₁ e₂
    simp only [superBracket_add_right, map_add, e₁, e₂]
  intro α γ c d x hx _ hxc z hz _ hzd
  have J₁ := superBracket_jacobi hxc ha hb
  have J₂ := superBracket_jacobi ha hb hzd
  have hsw := superBracket_swap (hxc.superBracket hb) ha
  rw [J₁, eq_sub_of_add_eq J₂.symm, hsw]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h₂ _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hy₁) _ hz,
    h₁ x hx _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hy₂ hz),
    h₁ _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hy₂) _ hz,
    h₂ x hx _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hy₁ hz)]
  have hs : zSign K (c * a) * zSign K ((c + b) * a) = zSign K (a * b) := by
    rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl <;> rcases zmod_two_cases b with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases zmod_two_cases c with rfl | rfl <;> simp [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]
  linear_combination (-(invForm P p S x (superBracket P p y₂ (superBracket P p y₁ z)))) * hs

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_superBracket
statement:
theorem invForm_superBracket {x y z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) :
    invForm P p S (superBracket P p x y) z = invForm P p S x (superBracket P p y z)
proof:
:= by
  suffices gTilde P p ≤ midInvSubmodule P p S from this hy x hx z hz
  have hplus : ∀ i w, MidInv P p S (eLie P p i w) := by
    intro i w
    induction w with
    | nil => exact midInv_e i
    | cons j w ih =>
      exact MidInv.bracket (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (e_mem_nPlus P p j))
        (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w)) (isHomog_e P p j) (isHomog_eLie P p i w)
        (midInv_e j) ih
  have hminus : ∀ i w, MidInv P p S (omega P p (eLie P p i w)) := by
    intro i w
    induction w with
    | nil => rw [eLie_nil, omega_e]; exact midInv_f i
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [omega_eLie_cons]
      exact MidInv.bracket (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (f_mem_nMinus P p j))
        (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (omega_mem_nMinus P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w))) (isHomog_f P p j)
        (isHomog_eLie P p i w).omega (midInv_f j) ih
  refine sup_le (sup_le ?_ ?_) ?_
  · exact Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ((nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ hminus i w)
  · rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact midInv_h t
  · exact (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 hplus

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.induction_parity
proof:
:= by
  have hdec : x = (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x + parity P p x) + (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x - parity P p x) := by
    rw [← smul_add, add_add_sub_cancel, ← two_smul K x, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero,
      one_smul]
  rw [hdec]
  have hσ := hN x hx
  refine add _ _ (hom 0 _ ?_ ?_) (hom 1 _ ?_ ?_)
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (add_mem hx hσ)
  · rw [IsHomog, map_smul, map_add, parity_parity, zSign_zero, one_smul, add_comm]
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hx hσ)
  · rw [IsHomog, map_smul, map_sub, parity_parity, zSign_one, neg_one_smul, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_maxIdeal_left
statement:
lemma superBracket_mem_maxIdeal_left {r y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hr : r ∈ maxIdeal P p)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) : superBracket P p r y ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_parity P p (N := maxIdeal P p) (fun _ ↦ parity_mem_maxIdeal P p)
    (q := fun r ↦ superBracket P p r y ∈ maxIdeal P p) (fun a r hr hra ↦ ?_)
    (fun r₁ r₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [superBracket_add_left]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂) hr
  refine induction_parity P p (N := gTilde P p) (fun _ ↦ parity_mem_gTilde P p)
    (q := fun y ↦ superBracket P p r y ∈ maxIdeal P p) (fun b y hy hyb ↦ ?_)
    (fun y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [superBracket_add_right]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂) hy
  rw [superBracket_swap hyb hra]
  exact neg_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    ((isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem y hy r hr))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_toDual_symm_ne_zero
statement: lemma h_toDual_symm_ne_zero {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) : h P p ((P.toDual S).symm μ) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h0 ↦ hμ ((P.toDual S).symm.map_eq_zero_iff.1
    ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).1 (h_injective P p) _ h0))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.invForm_eq_zero_of_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem invForm_eq_zero_of_mem_maxIdeal {r y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hr : r ∈ maxIdeal P p)
    (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p) : invForm P p S r y = 0 ∧ invForm P p S y r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hR := isIdeal_maxIdeal P p
  have hle := le_iSup_inf_weightSpace P p (maxIdeal P p) fun a x hx ↦
    hR.superBracket_mem _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a) x hx
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _
    (motive := fun r ↦ invForm P p S r y = 0 ∧ invForm P p S y r = 0) (hle hr) ?_ (by simp)
    fun r₁ r₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ ⟨by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁.1, h₂.1, add_zero],
      by rw [map_add, h₁.2, h₂.2, add_zero]⟩
  rintro μ r ⟨hrR, hrμ⟩
  have hrG := hR.le_gTilde hrR
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · subst hμ
    have : r ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := ⟨hrR, by
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]; exact ⟨hrG, hrμ⟩⟩
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    simp [this]
  refine induction_on_gTilde P p
    (q := fun y ↦ invForm P p S r y = 0 ∧ invForm P p S y r = 0) hy (fun ν y hy hyν ↦ ?_)
    fun y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ ⟨by rw [map_add, h₁.1, h₂.1, add_zero],
      by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁.2, h₂.2, add_zero]⟩
  by_cases hμν : μ + ν = 0
  · obtain rfl : ν = -μ := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hμν
    have hC := lieEqForm P p S μ r hrG hrμ y hy hyν
    have hC' := lieEqForm P p S (-μ) y hy hyν r hrG (by rwa [neg_neg])
    have hm : superBracket P p r y ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) :=
      ⟨superBracket_mem_maxIdeal_left P p hrR hy, by
        rw [hC, ← map_smul]; exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _⟩
    have hm' : superBracket P p y r ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) :=
      ⟨hR.superBracket_mem y hy r hrR, by
        rw [hC', ← map_smul]; exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _⟩
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot, hC, smul_eq_zero] at hm
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot, hC', smul_eq_zero] at hm'
    exact ⟨hm.resolve_right (h_toDual_symm_ne_zero hμ),
      hm'.resolve_right (h_toDual_symm_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.2 hμ))⟩
  · exact ⟨invForm_eq_zero P p S hrμ hyν hμν,
      invForm_eq_zero P p S hyν hrμ (by rwa [add_comm])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_maxIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maxIdeal_iff {r : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hr : r ∈ gTilde P p) :
    r ∈ maxIdeal P p ↔ ∀ y ∈ gTilde P p, invForm P p S y r = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hr y hy ↦ (invForm_eq_zero_of_mem_maxIdeal P p S hr hy).2, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  let I : Submodule K (P.SuperEnveloping p) :=
    { carrier := {r | r ∈ gTilde P p ∧ ∀ y ∈ gTilde P p, invForm P p S y r = 0}
      add_mem' := fun ⟨h₁, h₁'⟩ ⟨h₂, h₂'⟩ ↦ ⟨add_mem h₁ h₂, fun y hy ↦ by
        rw [map_add, h₁' y hy, h₂' y hy, add_zero]⟩
      zero_mem' := ⟨zero_mem _, fun y _ ↦ map_zero _⟩
      smul_mem' := fun c r ⟨h, h'⟩ ↦ ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ c h, fun y hy ↦ by
        rw [map_smul, h' y hy, smul_zero]⟩ }
  have hI : IsIdeal P p I :=
    ⟨fun _ hr ↦ hr.1, fun x hx r ⟨hrG, hr0⟩ ↦ ⟨superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hx hrG, fun y hy ↦ by
      rw [← invForm_superBracket P p S hy hx hrG]
      exact hr0 _ (superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hy hx)⟩⟩
  have hI0 : I ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨-, hx⟩, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot, ← map_zero (h P p)]
    congr 1
    refine (P.nondegenerate_bilinForm S).2 t fun b ↦ ?_
    have := hx (h P p b) (h_mem_gTilde P p b)
    rwa [invForm_h_h] at this
  exact le_maxIdeal P p hI hI0 ⟨hr, h0⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superSerreFree_mul_mem
statement:
lemma superSerreFree_mul_mem {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    superSerreFree K A p i j * b ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, j, hij, b, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_mem_superSerreIdeal
statement:
lemma mul_mem_superSerreIdeal {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p)
    (a : FreeAlgebra K ι) : t * a ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, b, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact superSerreFree_mul_mem hij _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_replicate
statement:
lemma eLie_replicate (i j : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    eLie P p j (List.replicate n i) = adE P p i n (e P p j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [List.replicate_succ, eLie_cons, ih, adE_succ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_superSerreFree
statement:
lemma fAlg_superSerreFree (i j : ι) :
    fAlg P p (superSerreFree K A p i j) = serreF P p i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [superSerreFree, fAlg_sLie, eLie_replicate, ← omega_serreE, serreE]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_serreF
statement:
lemma isHomog_serreF (i j : ι) :
    IsHomog P p (((-A i j).toNat + 1 : ℕ) * p i + p j) (serreF P p i j)
proof:
:=
  isHomog_adF i _ (isHomog_f P p j)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreE_mul_f
statement:
lemma serreE_mul_f (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hp : A.IsSuperAdmissible p) {i j : ι}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ι) :
    serreE P p i j * f P p k =
      zSign K (p k * (((-A i j).toNat + 1 : ℕ) * p i + p j)) • (f P p k * serreE P p i j)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := superBracket_f_serreE (P := P) hA hp hij k
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_f P p k) (isHomog_serreE i j), sub_eq_zero] at h0
  rw [h0, smul_smul, zSign_mul_self, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mul_serreF
statement:
lemma e_mul_serreF (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hp : A.IsSuperAdmissible p) {i j : ι}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ι) :
    e P p k * serreF P p i j =
      zSign K (p k * (((-A i j).toNat + 1 : ℕ) * p i + p j)) • (serreF P p i j * e P p k)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : superBracket P p (e P p k) (serreF P p i j) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (omega P p) (superBracket_f_serreE (P := P) hA hp hij k)
    rw [omega_superBracket, omega_f, omega_serreE, superBracket_smul_left, map_zero] at this
    refine (smul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left ?_
    unfold paritySign
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  rwa [superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_e P p k) (isHomog_serreF i j), sub_eq_zero] at h0

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreF_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma serreF_mem_weightSpace (i j : ι) :
    serreF P p i j ∈ weightSpace P p (-(P.root j + ((-A i j).toNat + 1) • P.root i))
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have h := congrArg (omega P p) (serreE_mem_weightSpace (P := P) (p := p) i j a)
  rw [map_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_smul, omega_h, omega_serreE] at h
  rw [neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, neg_add, neg_neg] at h
  rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul]
  exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.mem_serreSub_iff
statement:
lemma mem_serreSub_iff {v : Verma P p Λ} :
    v ∈ serreSub P p Λ ↔ ∃ t ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p, fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreSub, Submodule.mem_map]
  simp only [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, toTensorEquiv_symm_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_serreSub_iff
statement:
lemma fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_serreSub_iff {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} :
    fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ ∈ serreSub P p Λ ↔ t ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ht ↦ mem_serreSub_iff.2 ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hst⟩ := mem_serreSub_iff.1 h
  rw [← toTensorEquiv_symm_apply, ← toTensorEquiv_symm_apply] at hst
  rwa [← (toTensorEquiv P p Λ).symm.injective hst]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.exists_fAlg_smul_hwv_eq
statement: lemma exists_fAlg_smul_hwv_eq (v : Verma P p Λ) : ∃ t, fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ = v
proof:
:=
  ⟨toTensorEquiv P p Λ v, by rw [← toTensorEquiv_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.fAlg_smul_mem_serreSub
statement:
lemma fAlg_smul_mem_serreSub (b : FreeAlgebra K ι) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ serreSub P p Λ) :
    fAlg P p b • v ∈ serreSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_serreSub_iff.1 hv
  rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul, fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_serreSub_iff]
  exact (superSerreIdeal K A p).smul_mem b ht

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.f_smul_mem_serreSub
statement:
lemma f_smul_mem_serreSub (i : ι) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ serreSub P p Λ) :
    f P p i • v ∈ serreSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  simpa using fAlg_smul_mem_serreSub (FreeAlgebra.ι K i) hv

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.serreF_smul_mem_serreSub
statement:
lemma serreF_smul_mem_serreSub {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Verma P p Λ) :
    serreF P p i j • m ∈ serreSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := exists_fAlg_smul_hwv_eq m
  rw [smul_smul, ← fAlg_superSerreFree, ← map_mul, fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_serreSub_iff]
  exact superSerreFree_mul_mem hij t

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.h_smul_mem_serreSub
statement:
theorem h_smul_mem_serreSub (a : H) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ serreSub P p Λ) :
    h P p a • v ∈ serreSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
