  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_serreSub_iff.1 hv
  clear hv
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem r hr =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, b, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [map_mul, fAlg_superSerreFree, mul_smul, smul_smul, serreF_mem_weightSpace i j a,
      add_smul, mul_smul, smul_assoc]
    exact add_mem (serreF_smul_mem_serreSub hij _)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (serreF_smul_mem_serreSub hij _))
  | zero => simp
  | add s t _ _ hs ht => rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add]; exact add_mem hs ht
  | smul b t ht' ht =>
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := exists_h_mul_fAlg (P := P) (p := p) a b
    rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_smul, smul_smul, hb', add_smul]
    refine add_mem ?_ ?_
    · rw [mul_smul]; exact fAlg_smul_mem_serreSub b ht
    · rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul]
      exact fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_serreSub_iff.2 ((superSerreIdeal K A p).smul_mem b' ht')

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.e_smul_fAlg_smul_mem_serreSub
proof:
:= by
  induction b using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing v i with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul, smul_comm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (he i)
  | grade1 j =>
    rw [fAlg_ι, smul_smul, e_mul_f, add_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (f_smul_mem_serreSub j (he i))) ?_
    split_ifs
    · exact h_smul_mem_serreSub _ hv
    · simp
  | mul b c hb hc =>
    rw [map_mul, mul_smul]
    exact hb (fAlg_smul_mem_serreSub c hv) (fun j ↦ hc hv he j) i
  | add b c hb hc =>
    rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add]
    exact add_mem (hb hv he i) (hc hv he i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.e_smul_mem_serreSub
statement:
theorem e_smul_mem_serreSub (k : ι) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ serreSub P p Λ) :
    e P p k • v ∈ serreSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_serreSub_iff.1 hv
  clear hv
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction generalizing k with
  | mem r hr =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, b, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [map_mul, fAlg_superSerreFree, mul_smul, smul_smul, e_mul_serreF hA hp hij, smul_assoc,
      mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (serreF_smul_mem_serreSub hij _)
  | zero => simp
  | add s t _ _ hs ht => rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add]; exact add_mem (hs k) (ht k)
  | smul b t ht' ht =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_smul]
    exact e_smul_fAlg_smul_mem_serreSub b (fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_serreSub_iff.2 ht') ht k

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.mem_serreSubU
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_serreSubU {v : Verma P p Λ} :
    v ∈ serreSubU P p Λ hA hp ↔ v ∈ serreSub P p Λ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.adE_e_smul_hwv
statement: lemma adE_e_smul_hwv (i j : ι) (n : ℕ) : adE P p i n (e P p j) • hwv P p Λ = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact e_smul_hwv P p Λ j
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [adE_succ, superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_e P p i) (isHomog_adE i n (isHomog_e P p j)),
      sub_smul, mul_smul, ih, smul_zero, smul_assoc, mul_smul, e_smul_hwv, smul_zero, smul_zero,
      sub_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.serreE_smul
statement: theorem serreE_smul {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Verma P p Λ) : serreE P p i j • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := exists_fAlg_smul_hwv_eq m
  suffices ∀ (t : FreeAlgebra K ι) (v : Verma P p Λ), serreE P p i j • v = 0 →
      serreE P p i j • fAlg P p t • v = 0 from this t _ (adE_e_smul_hwv i j _)
  intro t
  induction t using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => intro v hv; rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul, smul_comm, hv, smul_zero]
  | grade1 k =>
    intro v hv
    rw [fAlg_ι, smul_smul, serreE_mul_f hA hp hij, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hv, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  | mul x y hx hy => intro v hv; rw [map_mul, mul_smul]; exact hx _ (hy v hv)
  | add x y hx hy => intro v hv; rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add, hx v hv, hy v hv, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.superBracket_smul_mem
statement:
lemma superBracket_smul_mem (g : 𝒰) {z : 𝒰} (hz : ∀ m : Verma P p Λ, z • m ∈ serreSub P p Λ)
    (hσz : ∀ m : Verma P p Λ, parity P p z • m ∈ serreSub P p Λ) (m : Verma P p Λ) :
    superBracket P p g z • m ∈ serreSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [superBracket, sub_smul, add_smul, mul_smul, smul_assoc]
  exact sub_mem ((serreSubU P p Λ hA hp).smul_mem g (hz m)) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (add_mem (add_mem (hz _) (hσz _)) (sub_mem (hz _) (hσz _))))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.superBracket_mem_annSub
statement:
theorem superBracket_mem_annSub (g : 𝒰) {z : 𝒰} (hz : z ∈ annSub P p Λ) :
    superBracket P p g z ∈ annSub P p Λ
proof:
:= fun m ↦
  ⟨superBracket_smul_mem hA hp g (fun m ↦ (hz m).1) (fun m ↦ (hz m).2) m, by
    rw [parity_superBracket]
    exact superBracket_smul_mem hA hp _ (fun m ↦ (hz m).2)
      (fun m ↦ by rw [parity_parity]; exact (hz m).1) m⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.serreIdeal_le_annSub
statement: theorem serreIdeal_le_annSub : serreIdeal P p ≤ annSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  let annAd : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p) :=
    { carrier := {y | (toAd P p).symm y ∈ annSub P p Λ}
      add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy ↦ by
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      zero_mem' := by simp
      smul_mem' := fun u y hy ↦ by
        change (toAd P p).symm (u • y) ∈ annSub P p Λ
        rw [← (toAd P p).apply_symm_apply y, smul_toAd, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
        exact adRep_mem_of_forall (fun _ _ hz ↦ superBracket_mem_annSub hA hp _ hz)
          (fun _ _ hz ↦ superBracket_mem_annSub hA hp _ hz)
          (fun _ _ hz ↦ superBracket_mem_annSub hA hp _ hz) u hy }
  have hle : serreAd P p ≤ annAd := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨i, j, hij, rfl | rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · change (toAd P p).symm (toAd P p (serreE P p i j)) ∈ annSub P p Λ
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      refine fun m ↦ ⟨by rw [serreE_smul hA hp hij]; exact zero_mem _, ?_⟩
      rw [isHomog_serreE i j, smul_assoc, serreE_smul hA hp hij, smul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · change (toAd P p).symm (toAd P p (serreF P p i j)) ∈ annSub P p Λ
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      refine fun m ↦ ⟨serreF_smul_mem_serreSub hij m, ?_⟩
      rw [isHomog_serreF i j, smul_assoc]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (serreF_smul_mem_serreSub hij m)
  intro x hx
  have : (toAd P p).symm (toAd P p x) ∈ annSub P p Λ := hle ((mem_serreIdeal P p).1 hx)
  rwa [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gIdeal_eq_superSerreIdeal
statement: theorem gIdeal_eq_superSerreIdeal : gIdeal P p = superSerreIdeal K A p
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 fun r hr ↦ ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · have hx : fAlg P p r ∈ Verma.annSub P p (0 : Dual K H) := by
      refine Verma.serreIdeal_le_annSub hA hp ?_
      rw [← maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal P p S hA hp]
      exact hr
    exact Verma.fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_serreSub_iff.1 (hx (Verma.hwv P p 0)).1
  · rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, b, rfl⟩
    refine mul_mem_gIdeal (mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre ?_) b
    rw [mem_fPre, fAlg_superSerreFree]
    exact serreF_mem_maxIdeal P p S hA hp hij

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff_mem_superSerreIdeal
statement:
theorem GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff_mem_superSerreIdeal (Λ : Dual K H)
    {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} :
    fAlg P p t • GVerma.hwv P p Λ = 0 ↔ t ∈ superSerreIdeal K A p
proof:
:= by
  rw [GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff, gIdeal_eq_superSerreIdeal P p S hA hp]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.kostantPartition_add_finrank_superSerreIdeal
statement:
theorem kostantPartition_add_finrank_superSerreIdeal (ν : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    KacMoodyAlgebra.kostantPartition P (P.rootOf (natVec ν)) +
      finrank K ↥(FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν ⊓ (superSerreIdeal K A p).restrictScalars K) =
        Fintype.card (LusztigF.Words ν)
proof:
:= by
  set V := FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν with hV
  have : FiniteDimensional K V :=
    FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite K ((LusztigF.finite_setOf_wordWeight_eq ν).image _)
  set g := (GVerma.ofTensor P p (0 : Dual K H)).domRestrict V
  have hw : ∀ w : List ι, GVerma.ofTensor P p 0 ((w.map (FreeAlgebra.ι K)).prod) =
      GVerma.wordVector P p 0 w := fun w ↦ by
    rw [GVerma.ofTensor_apply, GVerma.wordVector, word_eq_wordBasis, FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_apply]
  have hrange : LinearMap.range g =
      modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0) (0 - P.rootOf (natVec ν)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, GVerma.modWeightSpace_sub_eq, hV, FreeAlgebra.wordSpan,
      Submodule.map_span, Set.image_image]
    congr 1
    ext v
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw', rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, by rw [wordVec_eq_natVec, hw'], (hw w).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw', rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, natVec_injective (P.rootOf_injective (by rwa [← wordVec_eq_natVec])), hw w⟩
  have hker : LinearMap.ker g = ((superSerreIdeal K A p).restrictScalars K).comap V.subtype := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_domRestrict, GVerma.ker_ofTensor, gIdeal_eq_superSerreIdeal P p S hA hp]
  have hSer : finrank K (((superSerreIdeal K A p).restrictScalars K).comap V.subtype) =
      finrank K ↥(V ⊓ (superSerreIdeal K A p).restrictScalars K) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype]
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g
  rw [hrange, hker, hSer, GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace_sub_eq_kostantPartition S hA hp] at hrn
  rw [hrn]
  exact LusztigF.finrank_weightSpace K ν

name: Matrix.Realization.paritySign_mul_self
statement: lemma paritySign_mul_self (i : ι) : paritySign K p i * paritySign K p i = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold paritySign; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_e
statement: @[simp] lemma parity_e (i : ι) : parity P p (e P p i) = paritySign K p i • e P p i
proof:
:=
  lift_e _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_f
statement: @[simp] lemma parity_f (i : ι) : parity P p (f P p i) = paritySign K p i • f P p i
proof:
:=
  lift_f _ i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_h
statement: @[simp] lemma parity_h (a : H) : parity P p (h P p a) = h P p a
proof: := lift_h _ a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_comp_parity
statement: lemma parity_comp_parity : (parity P p).comp (parity P p) = AlgHom.id K _
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun a ↦ ?_) <;>
    simp [smul_smul, paritySign_mul_self]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_parity
statement: @[simp] lemma parity_parity (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) : parity P p (parity P p u) = u
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : P.SuperEnveloping p →ₐ[K] _ ↦ φ u) (parity_comp_parity P p)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isEven_h
statement: lemma isEven_h (a : H) : IsEven P p (h P p a)
proof: := parity_h P p a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isEven_e
statement: lemma isEven_e {i : ι} (hi : p i = 0) : IsEven P p (e P p i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsEven, paritySign, hi]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isOdd_e
statement: lemma isOdd_e {i : ι} (hi : p i = 1) : IsOdd P p (e P p i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsOdd, parity_e, paritySign, hi, ↓reduceIte]
  exact neg_one_smul K _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isEven_f
statement: lemma isEven_f {i : ι} (hi : p i = 0) : IsEven P p (f P p i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsEven, paritySign, hi]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isOdd_f
statement: lemma isOdd_f {i : ι} (hi : p i = 1) : IsOdd P p (f P p i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsOdd, parity_f, paritySign, hi, ↓reduceIte]
  exact neg_one_smul K _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_of_even_left
statement:
lemma superBracket_of_even_left {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsEven P p x)
    (y : P.SuperEnveloping p) : superBracket P p x y = x * y - y * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket, hx, ← add_mul, add_add_sub_cancel, ← two_smul K y, smul_mul_assoc,
    smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_of_even_right
statement:
lemma superBracket_of_even_right (x : P.SuperEnveloping p) {y : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hy : IsEven P p y) : superBracket P p x y = x * y - y * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket, hy, sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero, ← two_smul K y, smul_mul_assoc,
    smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_of_odd_odd
statement:
lemma superBracket_of_odd_odd {x y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : IsOdd P p x)
    (hy : IsOdd P p y) : superBracket P p x y = x * y + y * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket, hx, hy]
  have h2 : (2 : K)⁻¹ • ((y + -y) * x + (y - -y) * -x) = -(y * x) := by
    rw [add_neg_cancel, zero_mul, zero_add, sub_neg_eq_add, ← two_smul K y, smul_mul_assoc,
      smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_smul]
    noncomm_ring
  rw [h2, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {u : P.SuperEnveloping p} :
    u ∈ weightSpace P p μ ↔ ∀ a, h P p a * u = u * h P p a + μ a • u
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma e_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) : e P p i ∈ weightSpace P p (P.root i)
proof: := fun a ↦ h_mul_e P p a i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma f_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) : f P p i ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.root i)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [h_mul_f, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma h_mem_weightSpace (b : H) : h P p b ∈ weightSpace P p 0
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [h_mul_h, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.algebraMap_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma algebraMap_mem_weightSpace (c : K) : algebraMap K _ c ∈ weightSpace P p 0
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [Algebra.commutes, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.one_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma one_mem_weightSpace : (1 : P.SuperEnveloping p) ∈ weightSpace P p 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using algebraMap_mem_weightSpace P p 1

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [← mul_assoc, hu a, add_mul, mul_assoc, hv a, smul_mul_assoc, mul_add, mul_smul_comm,
    LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul, ← mul_assoc]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma parity_mem_weightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {u : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hu : u ∈ weightSpace P p μ) : parity P p u ∈ weightSpace P p μ
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  have := congrArg (parity P p) (hu a)
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_mem_iSup_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ u hu =>
    induction hv using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem ν v hv =>
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (μ + ν) (mul_mem_weightSpace P p hu hv)
    | zero => simp
    | add v w _ _ hv hw => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hv hw
  | zero => simp
  | add u w _ _ hu hw => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hu hw

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.iSup_weightSpace
statement: theorem iSup_weightSpace : ⨆ μ, weightSpace P p μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun u _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P p u
  induction w using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c =>
    simpa using Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (algebraMap_mem_weightSpace P p c)
  | grade1 g =>
    cases g with
    | e i => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (e_mem_weightSpace P p i)
    | f i => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (f_mem_weightSpace P p i)
    | h a => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (h_mem_weightSpace P p a)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem (hx trivial) (hy trivial)
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem_iSup_weightSpace P p (hx trivial) (hy trivial)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.commute_adH
statement: lemma commute_adH (a b : H) : Commute (adH P p a) (adH P p b)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun u ↦ ?_
  simp only [adH, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, mul_sub, sub_mul, ← mul_assoc, h_mul_h P p a b]
  rw [mul_assoc u, mul_assoc u, h_mul_h P p a b]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightSpace_le_iInf
statement:
lemma weightSpace_le_iInf (μ : Dual K H) :
    weightSpace P p μ ≤ ⨅ a, (adH P p a).maxGenEigenspace (μ a)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
  refine fun a ↦ Module.End.eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace ?_
  rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, adH, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, hu a, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.iSupIndep_weightSpace
statement: theorem iSupIndep_weightSpace : iSupIndep (weightSpace P p)
proof:
:= by
  have := Module.End.independent_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_of_forall_mapsTo (adH P p)
    fun a b φ ↦ Module.End.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (commute_adH P p b a) φ
  exact (this.comp DFunLike.coe_injective).mono (weightSpace_le_iInf P p)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_mem_maxIdeal
statement: theorem omega_mem_maxIdeal {r : 𝒰} (hr : r ∈ maxIdeal P p) : omega P p r ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  have hR := isIdeal_maxIdeal P p
  have hωω' : ∀ x : 𝒰, omega P p (omega P p x) = parity P p x := fun x ↦
    DFunLike.congr_fun (omega_comp_omega P p) x
  have hωω : ∀ x : 𝒰, omega P p (omega P p (parity P p x)) = x := fun x ↦ by
    rw [hωω', parity_parity]
  let I : Submodule K 𝒰 := (maxIdeal P p).map (omega P p).toLinearMap
  have hI : IsIdeal P p I := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
      exact omega_mem_gTilde P p (hR.le_gTilde hr)
    · rintro x hx _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨superBracket P p (omega P p (parity P p x)) r,
        hR.superBracket_mem _ (omega_mem_gTilde P p (parity_mem_gTilde P p hx)) r hr, ?_⟩
      simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
      rw [omega_superBracket, hωω]
  have hI0 : I ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, ⟨a, ha⟩⟩
    simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply] at ha ⊢
    have hr' : parity P p r ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      refine ⟨parity_mem_maxIdeal P p hr, -a, ?_⟩
      rw [map_neg, ← omega_h, ha, hωω']
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot] at hr'
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot, ← hωω r, hr']
    simp
  exact le_maxIdeal P p hI hI0 ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma adE_zero (i : ι) (v : 𝒰) : adE P p i 0 v = v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_succ
statement:
lemma adE_succ (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    adE P p i (n + 1) v = superBracket P p (e P p i) (adE P p i n v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adE, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma adF_zero (i : ι) (v : 𝒰) : adF P p i 0 v = v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_succ
statement:
lemma adF_succ (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    adF P p i (n + 1) v = superBracket P p (f P p i) (adF P p i n v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adF, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_adE
statement:
lemma omega_adE (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    omega P p (adE P p i n v) = adF P p i n (omega P p v)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [adE_succ, adF_succ, omega_superBracket, omega_e, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_adE
statement:
lemma isHomog_adE (i : ι) (n : ℕ) {b : ZMod 2} {v : 𝒰} (hv : IsHomog P p b v) :
    IsHomog P p (n * p i + b) (adE P p i n v)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [adE_succ, show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) * p i + b = p i + (n * p i + b) by push_cast; ring]
    exact (isHomog_e P p i).superBracket ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma adE_mem_weightSpace (i : ι) (n : ℕ) {μ : Dual K H} {v : 𝒰} (hv : v ∈ weightSpace P p μ) :
    adE P p i n v ∈ weightSpace P p (μ + n • P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [adE_succ, succ_nsmul, ← add_assoc, add_comm _ (P.root i)]
    exact superBracket_mem_weightSpace (e_mem_weightSpace P p i) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma adE_mem_gTilde (i : ι) (n : ℕ) {v : 𝒰} (hv : v ∈ gTilde P p) :
    adE P p i n v ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hv
  | succ n ih => rw [adE_succ]; exact superBracket_e_mem_gTilde P p i ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.zSign_mul_self'
statement: lemma zSign_mul_self' (q : ZMod 2) : zSign K (q * q) = zSign K q
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases q with rfl | rfl <;> rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_superBracket_e
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_superBracket_e (i : ι) {c : ZMod 2} {ν : Dual K H} {w : 𝒰}
    (hw : IsHomog P p c w) (hwν : w ∈ weightSpace P p ν) :
    superBracket P p (f P p i) (superBracket P p (e P p i) w) =
      -((zSign K (p i) * ν (P.coroot i)) • w) +
        zSign K (p i) • superBracket P p (e P p i) (superBracket P p (f P p i) w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_jacobi (isHomog_f P p i) (isHomog_e P p i) hw, superBracket_f_e,
    ite_eq_left rfl, superBracket_neg_left, superBracket_smul_left,
    superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p _ hwν, superSign_eq_zSign, zSign_mul_self',
    smul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_adE_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hfv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [adE_succ, superBracket_jacobi (isHomog_f P p k) (isHomog_e P p i) (isHomog_adE i n hv),
      superBracket_f_e, ite_eq_right hki, smul_zero, neg_zero, superBracket_zero_left, ih,
      superBracket_zero_right, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreCoeff_zero
statement: lemma serreCoeff_zero (q : ZMod 2) (c : K) : serreCoeff q c 0 = -(zSign K q * c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases q with rfl | rfl <;> simp [serreCoeff, zSign]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreCoeff_succ
statement:
lemma serreCoeff_succ (q : ZMod 2) (c : K) (m : ℕ) :
    serreCoeff q c (m + 1) =
      -(zSign K q * (c + 2 * (m + 1 : ℕ))) + zSign K q * serreCoeff q c m
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases q with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [serreCoeff, zSign, zero_ne_one, ite_false, one_mul]
    push_cast; ring
  · rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with hm | hm
    · have hm' : ¬ Even (m + 1) := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hm.add_one
      simp only [serreCoeff, zSign, ite_true, hm, hm', ite_false]
      push_cast; ring
    · have hm' : Even (m + 1) := hm.add_one
      have hm'' : ¬ Even m := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hm
      simp only [serreCoeff, zSign, ite_true, hm', hm'', ite_false]
      push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_adE_succ
statement:
lemma superBracket_f_adE_succ (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) {b : ZMod 2} {μ : Dual K H}
    {v : 𝒰} (hv : IsHomog P p b v) (hvμ : v ∈ weightSpace P p μ)
    (hfv : superBracket P p (f P p i) v = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    superBracket P p (f P p i) (adE P p i (m + 1) v) =
      serreCoeff (p i) (μ (P.coroot i)) m • adE P p i m v
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [adE_succ, adE_zero, superBracket_f_superBracket_e i hv hvμ, hfv, superBracket_zero_right,
      smul_zero, add_zero, serreCoeff_zero, neg_smul]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [adE_succ, superBracket_f_superBracket_e i (isHomog_adE i (m + 1) hv)
      (adE_mem_weightSpace i (m + 1) hvμ), ih, superBracket_smul_right, ← adE_succ, smul_smul,
      ← neg_smul, ← add_smul, serreCoeff_succ]
    congr 1
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, P.root_coroot, hA.diag, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_serreE
statement: lemma omega_serreE (i j : ι) : omega P p (serreE P p i j) = serreF P p i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreE, omega_adE, omega_e, serreF]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreE_mem_gTilde
statement: lemma serreE_mem_gTilde (i j : ι) : serreE P p i j ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:=
  adE_mem_gTilde i _ (nPlus_le_gTilde P p (e_mem_nPlus P p j))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreE_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma serreE_mem_weightSpace (i j : ι) :
    serreE P p i j ∈ weightSpace P p (P.root j + ((-A i j).toNat + 1) • P.root i)
proof:
:=
  adE_mem_weightSpace i _ (e_mem_weightSpace P p j)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreE_weight_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma serreE_weight_mem_posWeights {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    P.root j + n • P.root i ∈ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨Pi.single j 1 + n • Pi.single i 1, ⟨?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩, by
    rw [map_add, map_nsmul, P.rootOf_single, P.rootOf_single]⟩
  · exact add_nonneg (Pi.single_nonneg.2 zero_le_one)
      (nsmul_nonneg (Pi.single_nonneg.2 zero_le_one) n)
  · have := congr_fun h0 j
    simp [hij.symm] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_f_serreE
statement:
theorem superBracket_f_serreE (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hp : A.IsSuperAdmissible p)
    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ι) : superBracket P p (f P p k) (serreE P p i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ((-A i j).toNat : ℤ) = -A i j := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by
    linarith [hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij])
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst hki
    rw [serreE, superBracket_f_adE_succ hA k (isHomog_e P p j) (e_mem_weightSpace P p j)
      (by rw [superBracket_f_e, ite_eq_right hij, smul_zero, neg_zero]), P.root_coroot]
    have hc : serreCoeff (p k) (A k j : K) (-A k j).toNat = 0 := by
      have hn' : (((-A k j).toNat : ℕ) : K) = -(A k j : K) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      unfold serreCoeff
      split_ifs with hk he
      · rw [hn']; ring
      · exact absurd (by
          obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hp k j hk
          exact ⟨(-r).toNat, by omega⟩) he
      · rw [hn']; ring
    rw [hc, zero_smul]
  by_cases hkj : k = j
  · subst hkj
    set n := (-A i k).toNat with hn_def
    have hw : superBracket P p (f P p k) (serreE P p i k) ∈
        weightSpace P p ((n + 1) • P.root i) := by
      have := superBracket_mem_weightSpace (f_mem_weightSpace P p k) (serreE_mem_weightSpace i k)
      rwa [neg_add_cancel_left] at this
    have hG : superBracket P p (f P p k) (serreE P p i k) ∈ gTilde P p :=
      superBracket_f_mem_gTilde P p k (serreE_mem_gTilde i k)
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with h2 | h2
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 1 with h1 | h1
      · 
        have hA0 : A i k = 0 := by omega
        have hA0' : A k i = 0 := (hA.zero_comm i k).1 hA0
        rw [serreE, ← hn_def, show n = 0 by omega, adE_succ, adE_zero,
          superBracket_jacobi (isHomog_f P p k) (isHomog_e P p i) (isHomog_e P p k),
          superBracket_f_e, ite_eq_right hki, superBracket_f_e, ite_eq_left rfl, smul_zero,
          neg_zero, superBracket_zero_left, zero_add,
          show ∀ y, superBracket P p (e P p i) (-y) = -superBracket P p (e P p i) y from
            fun y ↦ (superBracketRight P p (e P p i)).map_neg y,
          superBracket_smul_right, superBracket_e_h, P.root_coroot, hA0']
        simp
      · 
        have hA1 : A i k = -1 := by omega
        have hi : p i = 0 := by
          rcases zmod_two_cases (p i) with hi | hi
          · exact hi
          · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hp i k hi; omega
        refine eq_zero_of_mem_two_root_of_even P p hi hG (Or.inl ?_)
        rwa [show n + 1 = 2 by omega] at hw
    · exact eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root P p (by omega) hG hw
  · rw [serreE]
    exact superBracket_f_adE_of_ne hki _ (isHomog_e P p j)
      (by rw [superBracket_f_e, ite_eq_right hkj, smul_zero, neg_zero])

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_maxIdeal_of_superBracket_f_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_maxIdeal_of_superBracket_f_eq_zero {β : Dual K H} (hβ : β ∈ P.posWeights)
    {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxβ : x ∈ weightSpace P p β)
    (hfx : ∀ k, superBracket P p (f P p k) x = 0) : x ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hβ1 : ∃ k, β = P.root k
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hβ1
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mem_weightSpace_root P p hx hxβ
    have h0 := hfx k
    rw [superBracket_smul_right, superBracket_f_e, ite_eq_left rfl, smul_neg, neg_eq_zero,
      smul_smul] at h0
    have hh : h P p (P.coroot k) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ P.linearIndependent_coroot.ne_zero k
      ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).1 (h_injective P p) _ h0)
    have hs : superSign K p k k ≠ 0 := by unfold superSign; split_ifs <;> norm_num
    obtain rfl : c = 0 := by
      rcases smul_eq_zero.1 h0 with h0 | h0
      · exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h0).resolve_right hs
      · exact absurd h0 hh
    rw [zero_smul]
    exact zero_mem _
  push Not at hβ1
  refine (mem_maxIdeal_iff P p S hx).2 fun y hy ↦ ?_
  refine induction_on_gTilde P p (q := fun y ↦ invForm P p S y x = 0) hy
    (fun ν y hy hyν ↦ ?_) (fun y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂,
      add_zero])
  by_cases hνβ : ν + β = 0
  · obtain rfl : ν = -β := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hνβ
    refine gTilde_induction_f P p (q := fun y ↦ invForm P p S y x = 0) hβ (fun j ↦ hβ1 j)
      (by simp) (fun y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, add_zero])
      (fun c y h ↦ by rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, h, smul_zero])
      (fun j ν' a _ _ y' hy' _ hya ↦ ?_) y hy hyν
    rw [superBracket_swap hya (isHomog_f P p j), map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.neg_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, invForm_superBracket P p S hy'
        (nMinus_le_gTilde P p (f_mem_nMinus P p j)) hx, hfx, map_zero, smul_zero, neg_zero]
  · exact invForm_eq_zero P p S hyν hxβ hνβ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreE_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem serreE_mem_maxIdeal (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hp : A.IsSuperAdmissible p)
    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : serreE P p i j ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:=
  mem_maxIdeal_of_superBracket_f_eq_zero P p S (serreE_weight_mem_posWeights hij _)
    (serreE_mem_gTilde i j) (serreE_mem_weightSpace i j) (superBracket_f_serreE hA hp hij)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreF_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem serreF_mem_maxIdeal (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (hp : A.IsSuperAdmissible p)
    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : serreF P p i j ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← omega_serreE]
  exact omega_mem_maxIdeal P p (serreE_mem_maxIdeal P p S hA hp hij)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_jacobi_left
statement:
theorem superBracket_jacobi_left {a b : ZMod 2} {x y : 𝒰} (hx : IsHomog P p a x)
    (hy : IsHomog P p b y) (z : 𝒰) :
    superBracket P p x (superBracket P p y z) =
      superBracket P p (superBracket P p x y) z +
        zSign K (a * b) • superBracket P p y (superBracket P p x z)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_parity P p (N := ⊤) (fun _ _ ↦ Submodule.mem_top)
    (q := fun z ↦ superBracket P p x (superBracket P p y z) =
      superBracket P p (superBracket P p x y) z +
        zSign K (a * b) • superBracket P p y (superBracket P p x z))
    (fun c z _ hz ↦ superBracket_jacobi hx hy hz) (fun z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_) Submodule.mem_top
  simp only [superBracket_add_right, h₁, h₂, smul_add]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adLin_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma adLin_apply (x z : 𝒰) : adLin P p x z = superBracket P p x z
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_e
statement: @[simp] lemma adRep_e (i : ι) (z : 𝒰) : adRep P p (e P p i) z = superBracket P p (e P p i) z
proof:
:= by
  simp [adRep, adData]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_f
statement: @[simp] lemma adRep_f (i : ι) (z : 𝒰) : adRep P p (f P p i) z = superBracket P p (f P p i) z
proof:
:= by
  simp [adRep, adData]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_h
statement: @[simp] lemma adRep_h (a : H) (z : 𝒰) : adRep P p (h P p a) z = superBracket P p (h P p a) z
proof:
:= by
  simp [adRep, adData]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_adAgree
statement:
lemma superBracket_mem_adAgree {a b : ZMod 2} {g y : 𝒰} (hg : IsHomog P p a g)
    (hy : IsHomog P p b y) (hg' : g ∈ adAgree P p) (hy' : y ∈ adAgree P p) :
    superBracket P p g y ∈ adAgree P p
proof:
:= by
  change adRep P p _ = adLin P p _
  ext z
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog hg hy, map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, map_mul, hg', hy']
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, adLin_apply]
  rw [← superBracket_of_isHomog hg hy, superBracket_jacobi_left hg hy]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mem_adAgree
statement: lemma e_mem_adAgree (i : ι) : e P p i ∈ adAgree P p
proof:
:= by
  change adRep P p _ = adLin P p _; ext z; simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_mem_adAgree
statement: lemma f_mem_adAgree (i : ι) : f P p i ∈ adAgree P p
proof:
:= by
  change adRep P p _ = adLin P p _; ext z; simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mem_adAgree
statement: lemma h_mem_adAgree (a : H) : h P p a ∈ adAgree P p
proof:
:= by
  change adRep P p _ = adLin P p _; ext z; simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlus_le_adAgree
statement: lemma nPlus_le_adAgree : nPlus P p ≤ adAgree P p
proof:
:= by
  refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using e_mem_adAgree P p i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [eLie_cons]
    exact superBracket_mem_adAgree (isHomog_e P p j) (isHomog_eLie P p i w)
      (e_mem_adAgree P p j) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_le_adAgree
statement: lemma nMinus_le_adAgree : nMinus P p ≤ adAgree P p
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ((nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using f_mem_adAgree P p i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [omega_eLie_cons]
    exact superBracket_mem_adAgree (isHomog_f P p j) (isHomog_eLie P p i w).omega
      (f_mem_adAgree P p j) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_le_adAgree
statement: lemma gTilde_le_adAgree : gTilde P p ≤ adAgree P p
proof:
:=
  sup_le (sup_le (nMinus_le_adAgree P p) (by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact h_mem_adAgree P p a)) (nPlus_le_adAgree P p)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_of_mem_gTilde
statement:
theorem adRep_of_mem_gTilde {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (z : 𝒰) :
    adRep P p x z = superBracket P p x z
proof:
:= by
  rw [show adRep P p x = adLin P p x from gTilde_le_adAgree P p hx, adLin_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_mem_of_forall
statement:
lemma adRep_mem_of_forall {N : Submodule K 𝒰}
    (he : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ N, superBracket P p (e P p i) z ∈ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ N, superBracket P p (f P p i) z ∈ N)
    (hh : ∀ a, ∀ z ∈ N, superBracket P p (h P p a) z ∈ N) (u : 𝒰) {z : 𝒰} (hz : z ∈ N) :
    adRep P p u z ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (q := fun u ↦ ∀ z ∈ N, adRep P p u z ∈ N) u ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ z hz
  · intro c z hz
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
    exact N.smul_mem c hz
  · intro i z hz; rw [adRep_e]; exact he i z hz
  · intro i z hz; rw [adRep_f]; exact hf i z hz
  · intro a z hz; rw [adRep_h]; exact hh a z hz
  · intro x y hx hy z hz; rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem (hx z hz) (hy z hz)
  · intro x y hx hy z hz; rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]; exact hx _ (hy z hz)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_mem_gTilde
statement: lemma adRep_mem_gTilde (u : 𝒰) {z : 𝒰} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) : adRep P p u z ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:=
  adRep_mem_of_forall (fun i _ ↦ superBracket_e_mem_gTilde P p i)
    (fun i _ ↦ superBracket_f_mem_gTilde P p i) (fun a _ ↦ superBracket_h_mem_gTilde P p a) u hz

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mem_gTilde
statement: lemma e_mem_gTilde (i : ι) : e P p i ∈ gTilde P p
proof: := nPlus_le_gTilde P p (e_mem_nPlus P p i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_mem_gTilde
statement: lemma f_mem_gTilde (i : ι) : f P p i ∈ gTilde P p
proof: := nMinus_le_gTilde P p (f_mem_nMinus P p i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_mem_maxIdeal
statement:
lemma adRep_mem_maxIdeal (u : 𝒰) {z : 𝒰} (hz : z ∈ maxIdeal P p) :
    adRep P p u z ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:=
  adRep_mem_of_forall
    (fun i _ hz ↦ (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (e_mem_gTilde P p i) _ hz)
    (fun i _ hz ↦ (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (f_mem_gTilde P p i) _ hz)
    (fun a _ hz ↦ (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a) _ hz) u hz

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_toAd
statement: lemma smul_toAd (u z : 𝒰) : u • toAd P p z = toAd P p (adRep P p u z)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.toAd_mem_gTildeAd
statement: lemma toAd_mem_gTildeAd {z : 𝒰} : toAd P p z ∈ gTildeAd P p ↔ z ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:=
  (toAd P p).injective.mem_set_image

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.toAd_mem_maxIdealAd
statement: lemma toAd_mem_maxIdealAd {z : 𝒰} : toAd P p z ∈ maxIdealAd P p ↔ z ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:=
  (toAd P p).injective.mem_set_image

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreE_mem_serreAd
statement: lemma serreE_mem_serreAd {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : toAd P p (serreE P p i j) ∈ serreAd P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, ⟨i, j, hij, Or.inl rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreF_mem_serreAd
statement: lemma serreF_mem_serreAd {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : toAd P p (serreF P p i j) ∈ serreAd P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, ⟨i, j, hij, Or.inr rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreAd_le_gTildeAd
statement: lemma serreAd_le_gTildeAd : serreAd P p ≤ gTildeAd P p
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨i, j, -, rfl | rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact (toAd_mem_gTildeAd P p).2 (serreE_mem_gTilde i j)
  · refine (toAd_mem_gTildeAd P p).2 ?_
    rw [← omega_serreE]
    exact omega_mem_gTilde P p (serreE_mem_gTilde i j)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_add
statement: lemma adE_add (i : ι) (m n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) : adE P p i (m + n) v = adE P p i m (adE P p i n v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adE, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_add
statement: lemma adF_add (i : ι) (m n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) : adF P p i (m + n) v = adF P p i m (adF P p i n v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adF, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
lemma adE_eq_zero_of_le (i : ι) {k m : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) {v : 𝒰} (hv : adE P p i k v = 0) :
    adE P p i m v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hkm
  rw [adE_add, hv]
  exact map_zero _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
lemma adF_eq_zero_of_le (i : ι) {k m : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) {v : 𝒰} (hv : adF P p i k v = 0) :
    adF P p i m v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hkm
  rw [adF_add, hv]
  exact map_zero _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_e_pow_apply
statement:
lemma adRep_e_pow_apply (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    (adRep P p (e P p i) ^ n) v = adE P p i n v
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, adRep_e, adE_succ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_f_pow_apply
statement:
lemma adRep_f_pow_apply (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    (adRep P p (f P p i) ^ n) v = adF P p i n v
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, adRep_f, adF_succ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_one
statement: lemma adE_one (i : ι) (v : 𝒰) : adE P p i 1 v = superBracket P p (e P p i) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [adE_succ, adE_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_e_self
statement: lemma adE_e_self (i : ι) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) : adE P p i m (e P p i) = 0
proof:
:=
  adE_eq_zero_of_le P p i hm (superBracket_e_superBracket_e_e P p i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_f_of_ne
statement: lemma adE_f_of_ne {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) : adE P p i m (f P p j) = 0
proof:
:=
  adE_eq_zero_of_le P p i hm (by rw [adE_one, superBracket_e_f]; simp [hij])

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_h
statement: lemma adE_h (i : ι) (a : H) {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) : adE P p i m (h P p a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine adE_eq_zero_of_le P p i hm ?_
  rw [adE_add P p i 2 1, adE_one, superBracket_e_h]
  have h2 := adE_e_self P p i (le_refl 2)
  simp only [adE] at h2 ⊢
  rw [map_neg, map_smul, h2, smul_zero, neg_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adE_f_self
statement: lemma adE_f_self (i : ι) {m : ℕ} (hm : 4 ≤ m) : adE P p i m (f P p i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine adE_eq_zero_of_le P p i hm ?_
  rw [adE_add P p i 3 1, adE_one, superBracket_e_f]
  simp only [ite_true]
  exact adE_h P p i _ le_rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_omega
statement:
lemma adF_omega (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    adF P p i n (omega P p v) = omega P p (adE P p i n v)
proof: := (omega_adE P p i n v).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_f_self
statement: lemma adF_f_self (i : ι) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) : adF P p i m (f P p i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← omega_e, adF_omega, adE_e_self P p i hm, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.paritySign_smul_omega_f
statement: lemma paritySign_smul_omega_f (j : ι) : paritySign K p j • omega P p (f P p j) = e P p j
proof:
:= by
  rw [omega_f, smul_smul, paritySign_mul_self, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_e_of_ne
statement: lemma adF_e_of_ne {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) : adF P p i m (e P p j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← paritySign_smul_omega_f P p j]
  simp only [adF] at *
  rw [map_smul]
  change paritySign K p j • adF P p i m (omega P p (f P p j)) = 0
  rw [adF_omega, adE_f_of_ne P p hij hm, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_e_self
statement: lemma adF_e_self (i : ι) {m : ℕ} (hm : 4 ≤ m) : adF P p i m (e P p i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← paritySign_smul_omega_f P p i]
  simp only [adF] at *
  rw [map_smul]
  change paritySign K p i • adF P p i m (omega P p (f P p i)) = 0
  rw [adF_omega, adE_f_self P p i hm, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_h
statement: lemma adF_h (i : ι) (a : H) {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) : adF P p i m (h P p a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : h P p a = -omega P p (h P p a) := by rw [omega_h, neg_neg]
  rw [this]
  simp only [adF] at *
  rw [map_neg]
  change -adF P p i m (omega P p (h P p a)) = 0
  rw [adF_omega, adE_h P p i a hm, map_zero, neg_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_adF
statement:
lemma isHomog_adF (i : ι) (n : ℕ) {b : ZMod 2} {v : 𝒰} (hv : IsHomog P p b v) :
    IsHomog P p (n * p i + b) (adF P p i n v)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [adF_succ, show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) * p i + b = p i + (n * p i + b) by push_cast; ring]
    exact (isHomog_f P p i).superBracket ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adF_mem_gTilde
statement:
lemma adF_mem_gTilde (i : ι) (n : ℕ) {v : 𝒰} (hv : v ∈ gTilde P p) :
    adF P p i n v ∈ gTilde P p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hv
  | succ n ih => rw [adF_succ]; exact superBracket_f_mem_gTilde P p i ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_superBracket_of_odd
statement:
lemma superBracket_superBracket_of_odd {x : 𝒰} (hx : IsHomog P p 1 x) (z : 𝒰) :
    superBracket P p x (superBracket P p x z) = x ^ 2 * z - z * x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_parity P p (N := ⊤) (fun _ _ => Submodule.mem_top)
    (q := fun z => superBracket P p x (superBracket P p x z) = x ^ 2 * z - z * x ^ 2)
    (fun c z _ hz => ?_) (fun z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ => ?_) Submodule.mem_top
  · rw [superBracket_of_isHomog hx (hx.superBracket hz), superBracket_of_isHomog hx hz]
    rcases zmod_two_cases c with rfl | rfl
    · rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) * (1 + 0) = 1 from rfl, show (1 : ZMod 2) * 0 = 0 from rfl,
        zSign_one, zSign_zero]
      simp only [neg_smul, one_smul]
      noncomm_ring
    · rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) * (1 + 1) = 0 from rfl, show (1 : ZMod 2) * 1 = 1 from rfl,
        zSign_one, zSign_zero]
      simp only [neg_smul, one_smul]
      noncomm_ring
  · simp only [superBracket_add_right, h₁, h₂]
    noncomm_ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_sl2E
statement:
lemma adRep_sl2E (i : ι) :
    adRep P p (sl2E P p i) = ((sl2Deg p i : K)⁻¹) • adRep P p (e P p i) ^ sl2Deg p i
proof:
:= by
  unfold sl2E sl2Deg
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_sl2F
statement:
lemma adRep_sl2F (i : ι) :
    adRep P p (sl2F P p i) = sl2FCoeff (K := K) p i • adRep P p (f P p i) ^ sl2Deg p i
proof:
:= by
  unfold sl2F sl2Deg sl2FCoeff
  split_ifs <;> ext v <;> simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_sl2E_pow_apply
statement:
lemma adRep_sl2E_pow_apply (i : ι) (k : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    (adRep P p (sl2E P p i) ^ k) v = ((sl2Deg p i : K)⁻¹) ^ k • adE P p i (sl2Deg p i * k) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [adRep_sl2E, smul_pow, ← pow_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply, adRep_e_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_sl2F_pow_apply
statement:
lemma adRep_sl2F_pow_apply (i : ι) (k : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) :
    (adRep P p (sl2F P p i) ^ k) v = sl2FCoeff (K := K) p i ^ k • adF P p i (sl2Deg p i * k) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [adRep_sl2F, smul_pow, ← pow_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply, adRep_f_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_sl2E_apply
statement:
lemma adRep_sl2E_apply (i : ι) (z : 𝒰) :
    adRep P p (sl2E P p i) z = sl2E P p i * z - z * sl2E P p i
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases (p i) with hi | hi
  · have he : IsEven P p (e P p i) := by
      have := isHomog_e P p i; rw [hi] at this; simpa [IsHomog, IsEven] using this
    rw [adRep_sl2E]; unfold sl2Deg sl2E
    simp only [hi, zero_ne_one, ite_false, Nat.cast_one, inv_one, pow_one, one_smul, adRep_e,
      superBracket_of_even_left P p he]
  · have he : IsHomog P p 1 (e P p i) := by rw [← hi]; exact isHomog_e P p i
    have h2 : (adRep P p (e P p i) ^ 2) z = e P p i ^ 2 * z - z * e P p i ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq, Module.End.mul_apply, adRep_e, adRep_e]
      exact superBracket_superBracket_of_odd P p he z
    rw [adRep_sl2E]; unfold sl2Deg sl2E
    simp only [hi, ite_true]
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, h2, smul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_sl2F_apply
statement:
lemma adRep_sl2F_apply (i : ι) (z : 𝒰) :
    adRep P p (sl2F P p i) z = sl2F P p i * z - z * sl2F P p i
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases (p i) with hi | hi
  · have hf : IsEven P p (f P p i) := by
      have := isHomog_f P p i; rw [hi] at this; simpa [IsHomog, IsEven] using this
    rw [adRep_sl2F]; unfold sl2Deg sl2F sl2FCoeff
    simp only [hi, zero_ne_one, ite_false, pow_one, one_smul, adRep_f,
      superBracket_of_even_left P p hf]
  · have hf : IsHomog P p 1 (f P p i) := by rw [← hi]; exact isHomog_f P p i
    have h2 : (adRep P p (f P p i) ^ 2) z = f P p i ^ 2 * z - z * f P p i ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq, Module.End.mul_apply, adRep_f, adRep_f]
      exact superBracket_superBracket_of_odd P p hf z
    rw [adRep_sl2F]; unfold sl2Deg sl2F sl2FCoeff
    simp only [hi, ite_true]
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, h2, neg_mul, mul_neg, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, neg_smul,
      smul_sub]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isGood_zero
statement: lemma isGood_zero (N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p)) : IsGood P p N 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [map_zero]; exact N.zero_mem, zero_mem _, 0, isHomog_zero 0⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsGood.smul
statement:
lemma IsGood.smul {N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p)} {s : 𝒰} (hs : IsGood P p N s) (c : K) :
    IsGood P p N (c • s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, a, h₃⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨by rw [map_smul]; exact N.smul_of_tower_mem c h₁, Submodule.smul_mem _ c h₂, a,
    h₃.smul c⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_mem_of_isGood
statement:
lemma smul_mem_of_isGood {N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p)} {s : 𝒰} (hs : IsGood P p N s) {w : 𝒰}
    (hw : w ∈ gTilde P p) : s • toAd P p w ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsN, hsG, c, hsc⟩ := hs
  rw [smul_toAd, adRep_of_mem_gTilde hsG]
  refine induction_parity P p (N := gTilde P p) (fun _ hx ↦ parity_mem_gTilde P p hx)
    (q := fun w ↦ toAd P p (superBracket P p s w) ∈ N) (fun d w hw hwd ↦ ?_)
    (fun w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_) hw
  · rw [superBracket_swap hwd hsc, map_neg, map_smul, ← adRep_of_mem_gTilde hw, ← smul_toAd]
    exact N.neg_mem (N.smul_of_tower_mem _ (N.smul_mem w hsN))
  · rw [superBracket_add_right, map_add]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.pow_smul_smul_mem
statement:
lemma pow_smul_smul_mem {N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p)} {x g : 𝒰} {a b : ℕ}
    (hx : ∀ z, adRep P p x z = x * z - z * x)
    (hg : ∀ k, a ≤ k → IsGood P p N ((adRep P p x ^ k) g)) {z : 𝒰} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hzb : x ^ b • toAd P p z ∈ N) : x ^ (a + b) • (g • toAd P p z) ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  have had : ∀ k (y : 𝒰), (LieAlgebra.ad K 𝒰 x ^ k) y = (adRep P p x ^ k) y := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro y; rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro y
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih,
        LieAlgebra.ad_apply, Ring.lie_def, hx]
  have hgz : g • toAd P p z = ⁅g, toAd P p z⁆ := rfl
  rw [hgz, ← toEnd_pow_apply, LieModule.toEnd_pow_lie]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun ij hij ↦ nsmul_mem ?_ _
  rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hij
  rw [had, toEnd_pow_apply]
  change ((adRep P p x ^ ij.1) g) • (x ^ ij.2 • toAd P p z) ∈ N
  by_cases hi : a ≤ ij.1
  · rw [smul_toAd]; exact smul_mem_of_isGood (hg _ hi) (adRep_mem_gTilde _ hz)
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' (show b ≤ ij.2 by omega)
    rw [hc, pow_add, mul_smul]
    exact N.smul_mem _ (N.smul_mem _ hzb)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_pow_smul_mem
statement:
lemma exists_pow_smul_mem {N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p)} {x : 𝒰}
    (hx : ∀ z, adRep P p x z = x * z - z * x)
    (he : ∀ j, ∃ a, ∀ k, a ≤ k → IsGood P p N ((adRep P p x ^ k) (e P p j)))
    (hf : ∀ j, ∃ a, ∀ k, a ≤ k → IsGood P p N ((adRep P p x ^ k) (f P p j)))
    (hh : ∀ c, ∃ a, ∀ k, a ≤ k → IsGood P p N ((adRep P p x ^ k) (h P p c)))
    {z : 𝒰} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) : ∃ n, x ^ n • toAd P p z ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : ∀ {z : 𝒰} {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → x ^ n • toAd P p z ∈ N →
      x ^ m • toAd P p z ∈ N := by
    intro z n m hnm hn
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hnm
    rw [pow_add, mul_smul]; exact N.smul_mem _ hn
  let T : Submodule K 𝒰 :=
    { carrier := {z | z ∈ gTilde P p ∧ ∃ n, x ^ n • toAd P p z ∈ N}
      add_mem' := by
        rintro z₁ z₂ ⟨h₁, n₁, hn₁⟩ ⟨h₂, n₂, hn₂⟩
        refine ⟨add_mem h₁ h₂, n₁ + n₂, ?_⟩
        rw [map_add, smul_add]
        exact add_mem (hmono (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hn₁) (hmono (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hn₂)
      zero_mem' := ⟨zero_mem _, 0, by rw [map_zero, smul_zero]; exact N.zero_mem⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c z ⟨h₁, n, hn⟩
        refine ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ c h₁, n, ?_⟩
        rw [map_smul, smul_comm]; exact N.smul_of_tower_mem c hn }
  have hgen : ∀ g, g ∈ gTilde P p → (∃ a, ∀ k, a ≤ k → IsGood P p N ((adRep P p x ^ k) g)) →
      g ∈ T ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, superBracket P p g z ∈ T := by
    rintro g hgG ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hgG, a, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [smul_toAd, map_pow]; exact (ha a le_rfl).1
    · rintro z ⟨hzG, b, hb⟩
      refine ⟨superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hgG hzG, a + b, ?_⟩
      rw [← adRep_of_mem_gTilde hgG, ← smul_toAd]
      exact pow_smul_smul_mem hx ha hzG hb
  have hP : nPlus P p ≤ T := by
    refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_
    induction w with
    | nil => exact (hgen _ (e_mem_gTilde P p i) (he i)).1
    | cons j w ih => rw [eLie_cons]; exact (hgen _ (e_mem_gTilde P p j) (he j)).2 _ ih
  have hM : nMinus P p ≤ T := by
    refine Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ((nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_)
    simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
    induction w with
    | nil => simpa using (hgen _ (f_mem_gTilde P p i) (hf i)).1
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [omega_eLie_cons]; exact (hgen _ (f_mem_gTilde P p j) (hf j)).2 _ ih
  have hH : LinearMap.range (h P p) ≤ T := by
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact (hgen _ (h_mem_gTilde P p c) (hh c)).1
  exact (sup_le (sup_le hM hH) hP hz).2

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isGood_adE_of_eq_zero
statement:
lemma isGood_adE_of_eq_zero {N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p)} (i : ι) {g : 𝒰} {n : ℕ}
    (hg : adE P p i n g = 0) : ∀ m, n ≤ m → IsGood P p N (adE P p i m g)
proof:
:= fun _ hm ↦ by
  rw [adE_eq_zero_of_le P p i hm hg]; exact isGood_zero N

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isGood_adF_of_eq_zero
statement:
lemma isGood_adF_of_eq_zero {N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p)} (i : ι) {g : 𝒰} {n : ℕ}
    (hg : adF P p i n g = 0) : ∀ m, n ≤ m → IsGood P p N (adF P p i m g)
proof:
:= fun _ hm ↦ by
  rw [adF_eq_zero_of_le P p i hm hg]; exact isGood_zero N

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.toAd_adE
statement: lemma toAd_adE (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) : toAd P p (adE P p i n v) = e P p i ^ n • toAd P p v
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_toAd, map_pow, adRep_e_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.toAd_adF
statement: lemma toAd_adF (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (v : 𝒰) : toAd P p (adF P p i n v) = f P p i ^ n • toAd P p v
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_toAd, map_pow, adRep_f_pow_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isGood_adE_e
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij; exact ⟨2, isGood_adE_of_eq_zero i (adE_e_self P p i le_rfl)⟩
  refine ⟨(-A i j).toNat + 1, fun m hm ↦ ⟨?_, adE_mem_gTilde i m (e_mem_gTilde P p j), _,
    isHomog_adE i m (isHomog_e P p j)⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
  rw [add_comm, adE_add, toAd_adE]
  exact N.smul_mem _ (hS i j hij)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isGood_adF_f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij; exact ⟨2, isGood_adF_of_eq_zero i (adF_f_self P p i le_rfl)⟩
  refine ⟨(-A i j).toNat + 1, fun m hm ↦ ⟨?_, adF_mem_gTilde i m (f_mem_gTilde P p j), _,
    isHomog_adF i m (isHomog_f P p j)⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
  rw [add_comm, adF_add, toAd_adF]
  exact N.smul_mem _ (hS i j hij)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sl2Deg_mul_ge
statement: lemma sl2Deg_mul_ge (i : ι) (k : ℕ) : k ≤ sl2Deg p i * k
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left k (sl2Deg_pos p i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_isGood_sl2E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨n, fun k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [adRep_sl2E_pow_apply]
  exact (hn _ (hk.trans (sl2Deg_mul_ge i k))).smul _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_isGood_sl2F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨n, fun k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [adRep_sl2F_pow_apply]
  exact (hn _ (hk.trans (sl2Deg_mul_ge i k))).smul _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_pow_sl2Deg_mul
statement:
lemma e_pow_sl2Deg_mul (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    e P p i ^ (sl2Deg p i * n) = ((sl2Deg p i : K) ^ n) • sl2E P p i ^ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold sl2Deg sl2E
  split_ifs
  · rw [smul_pow, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, pow_mul]; norm_num
  · simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_pow_sl2Deg_mul
statement:
lemma f_pow_sl2Deg_mul (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    f P p i ^ (sl2Deg p i * n) = ((sl2FCoeff (K := K) p i)⁻¹ ^ n) • sl2F P p i ^ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold sl2Deg sl2F sl2FCoeff
  split_ifs
  · rw [← neg_smul, smul_pow, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, pow_mul]; norm_num
  · simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_sl2E_pow_smul_mem
proof:
:=
  exists_pow_smul_mem (adRep_sl2E_apply P p i)
    (fun j ↦ exists_isGood_sl2E i (isGood_adE_e hSE i j))
    (fun j ↦ exists_isGood_sl2E i (if hij : i = j then ⟨4, isGood_adE_of_eq_zero i
      (by subst hij; exact adE_f_self P p i le_rfl)⟩ else
      ⟨1, isGood_adE_of_eq_zero i (adE_f_of_ne P p hij le_rfl)⟩))
    (fun c ↦ exists_isGood_sl2E i ⟨3, isGood_adE_of_eq_zero i (adE_h P p i c le_rfl)⟩) hz

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_sl2F_pow_smul_mem
proof:
:=
  exists_pow_smul_mem (adRep_sl2F_apply P p i)
    (fun j ↦ exists_isGood_sl2F i (if hij : i = j then ⟨4, isGood_adF_of_eq_zero i
      (by subst hij; exact adF_e_self P p i le_rfl)⟩ else
      ⟨1, isGood_adF_of_eq_zero i (adF_e_of_ne P p hij le_rfl)⟩))
    (fun j ↦ exists_isGood_sl2F i (isGood_adF_f hSF i j))
    (fun c ↦ exists_isGood_sl2F i ⟨3, isGood_adF_of_eq_zero i (adF_h P p i c le_rfl)⟩) hz

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isIntegrable_quotient
statement:
theorem isIntegrable_quotient (N : Submodule 𝒰 (Ad P p))
    (hSE : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → toAd P p (serreE P p i j) ∈ N)
    (hSF : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → toAd P p (serreF P p i j) ∈ N) :
    IsIntegrable P p (↥(gTildeAd P p) ⧸ N.comap (gTildeAd P p).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ∀ i z, z ∈ gTilde P p → ∃ n, e P p i ^ n • toAd P p z ∈ N := by
    intro i z hz
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_sl2E_pow_smul_mem N hSE i hz
    refine ⟨sl2Deg p i * n, ?_⟩
    rw [e_pow_sl2Deg_mul, smul_assoc]
    exact N.smul_of_tower_mem _ hn
  have hF : ∀ i z, z ∈ gTilde P p → ∃ n, f P p i ^ n • toAd P p z ∈ N := by
    intro i z hz
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_sl2F_pow_smul_mem N hSF i hz
    refine ⟨sl2Deg p i * n, ?_⟩
    rw [f_pow_sl2Deg_mul, smul_assoc]
    exact N.smul_of_tower_mem _ hn
  intro i v
  induction v using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H w =>
    obtain ⟨_, z, hz, rfl⟩ := w
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hE i z hz
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hF i z hz
    refine ⟨⟨n, ?_⟩, ⟨m, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]; exact hn
    · rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]; exact hm

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smulEnd_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma smulEnd_apply (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) (v : V) : smulEnd P p V u v = u • v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_smul_eq_superBracket
statement:
lemma smul_smul_eq_superBracket {c a : ZMod 2} {z y : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : IsHomog P p c z)
    (hy : IsHomog P p a y) (w : V) :
    z • y • w = superBracket P p z y • w + zSign K (c * a) • y • z • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket_of_isHomog hz hy, sub_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul, mul_smul, sub_add_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_smul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eLie_smul_eq_zero [CharZero K] {v : V} (he : ∀ i, e P p i • v = 0) (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    eLie P p i w • v = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact he i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [eLie_cons, superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_e P p j) (isHomog_eLie P p i w), sub_smul,
      mul_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul, ih, he j]
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_eq_zero_of_mem_posWeights
statement:
lemma smul_eq_zero_of_mem_posWeights {v : V} (he : ∀ i, e P p i • v = 0) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gRoot P p μ) : x • v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hμ
  have hx' : x ∈ nPlusRoot P p k := by rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf P p hk]; exact hx
  clear hx
  induction hx' using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, w, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact eLie_smul_eq_zero he i w
  | zero => exact zero_smul _ v
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_smul, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_assoc, hx, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirSum_def
statement:
lemma casimirSum_def (F : P.SuperEnveloping p → P.SuperEnveloping p → V) (μ : Dual K H) :
    casimirSum S F μ = ∑ k, F (rootCobasis P p S μ k) (rootBasis P p μ k)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hF
  exact ⟨_, (rootCobasis P p S μ k).2, _, (rootBasis P p μ k).2, hk⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirSum_eq_zero_of_eq_bot
statement:
lemma casimirSum_eq_zero_of_eq_bot {F : P.SuperEnveloping p → P.SuperEnveloping p → V}
    (hF0 : ∀ y, F y 0 = 0) {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : gRoot P p μ = ⊥) : casimirSum S F μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have h0 : ∀ x ∈ gRoot P p μ, x = 0 := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [hμ] at hx; exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).1 hx
  rw [h0 _ (rootBasis P p μ k).2, hF0]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_eq_sum_rootBasis
proof:
:= by
  have := hV _ (sub_sum_rootBasis_mem_maxIdeal P p S hx) w
  rw [sub_smul, sub_eq_zero, Finset.sum_smul] at this
  simp only [this, smul_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_eq_sum_rootCobasis
proof:
:= by
  have := hV _ (sub_sum_rootCobasis_mem_maxIdeal P p S hy) w
  rw [sub_smul, sub_eq_zero, Finset.sum_smul] at this
  simp only [this, smul_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_gRoot
statement:
lemma superBracket_mem_gRoot {γ μ : Dual K H} {z x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p γ) (hx : x ∈ gRoot P p μ) :
    superBracket P p z x ∈ gRoot P p (γ + μ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨superBracket_mem_gTilde P p hz hx.1, superBracket_mem_weightSpace hzγ hx.2⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirSum_left
statement:
theorem casimirSum_left (hV : IsGModule P p V) {γ : Dual K H} {c : ZMod 2}
    {z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p γ)
    (hzc : IsHomog P p c z) (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ superBracket P p z y • x • v) μ =
      -(zSign K (c * weightParity P p (μ - γ)) •
        casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • superBracket P p z x • v) (μ - γ))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ k, superBracket P p z (rootCobasis P p S μ k) ∈ gRoot P p (-(μ - γ)) := fun k ↦ by
    have := superBracket_mem_gRoot hz hzγ (rootCobasis P p S μ k).2
    rwa [show γ + -μ = -(μ - γ) by abel] at this
  have hR : ∀ l, superBracket P p z (rootBasis P p (μ - γ) l) ∈ gRoot P p μ := fun l ↦ by
    have := superBracket_mem_gRoot hz hzγ (rootBasis P p (μ - γ) l).2
    rwa [add_sub_cancel] at this
  have hinv : ∀ k l, invForm P p S (rootBasis P p (μ - γ) l)
      (superBracket P p z (rootCobasis P p S μ k)) =
      -(zSign K (c * weightParity P p (μ - γ)) * invForm P p S
        (superBracket P p z (rootBasis P p (μ - γ) l)) (rootCobasis P p S μ k)) := fun k l ↦ by
    have hb := (rootBasis P p (μ - γ) l).2
    rw [← invForm_superBracket P p S hb.1 hz (rootCobasis P p S μ k).2.1,
      superBracket_swap hzc (isHomog_of_mem_gRoot P p hb)]
    rw [LinearMap.map_neg₂, LinearMap.map_smul₂, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [casimirSum_def]
  simp_rw [smul_eq_sum_rootCobasis S hV (hL _), smul_eq_sum_rootBasis S hV (hR _), Finset.smul_sum,
    smul_comm (rootCobasis P p S (μ - γ) _ : 𝒰) (invForm P p S _ _), hinv]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [neg_smul, mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_casimirSum_sub
statement:
lemma smul_casimirSum_sub {c : ZMod 2} {z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hzc : IsHomog P p c z)
    (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    z • casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • x • v) μ - casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • x • z • v) μ =
      casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ superBracket P p z y • x • v) μ +
        zSign K (c * weightParity P p μ) •
          casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • superBracket P p z x • v) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [casimirSum_def, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hy := isHomog_of_mem_gRoot P p (rootCobasis P p S μ k).2
  have hx := isHomog_of_mem_gRoot P p (rootBasis P p μ k).2
  rw [weightParity_neg] at hy
  rw [smul_smul_eq_superBracket hzc hy, smul_smul_eq_superBracket hzc hx, smul_add, smul_add,
    smul_comm (rootCobasis P p S μ k : 𝒰) (zSign K _)]
  have hs (a : ZMod 2) (x : V) : zSign K a • zSign K a • x = x := by
    rw [smul_smul, zSign_mul_self, one_smul]
  rw [hs]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirLeft_eq
statement:
lemma casimirLeft_eq (hV : IsGModule P p V) {γ : Dual K H} {c : ZMod 2}
    {z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p γ)
    (hzc : IsHomog P p c z) (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    casimirLeft S z v μ = -casimirRight S c z v (μ - γ)
proof:
:=
  casimirSum_left hV hz hzγ hzc μ v

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_casimirSum_sub_right
statement:
lemma smul_casimirSum_sub_right (hV : IsGModule P p V) {γ : Dual K H} {c : ZMod 2}
    {z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p γ)
    (hzc : IsHomog P p c z) (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    z • casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • x • v) μ - casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • x • z • v) μ =
      casimirRight S c z v μ - casimirRight S c z v (μ - γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_casimirSum_sub hzc, ← casimirLeft, casimirLeft_eq hV hz hzγ hzc, casimirRight]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_casimirSum_sub_left
statement:
lemma smul_casimirSum_sub_left (hV : IsGModule P p V) {γ : Dual K H} {c : ZMod 2}
    {z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p γ)
    (hzc : IsHomog P p c z) (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    z • casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • x • v) μ - casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • x • z • v) μ =
      casimirLeft S z v μ - casimirLeft S z v (μ + γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_casimirSum_sub hzc, ← casimirLeft, casimirLeft_eq hV hz hzγ hzc (μ + γ),
    add_sub_cancel_right]
  simp only [casimirRight]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sum_hComp_rootBasis_smul
statement:
lemma sum_hComp_rootBasis_smul (hV : IsGModule P p V) (Λ : Dual K H) (w : V) :
    ∑ k, Λ (hComp P p (rootBasis P p 0 k)) • (rootCobasis P p S 0 k : 𝒰) • w =
      h P p ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) • w
proof:
:= by
  have hh : h P p ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) ∈ gRoot P p (-0) := by
    rw [neg_zero]; exact ⟨h_mem_gTilde P p _, h_mem_weightSpace P p _⟩
  rw [smul_eq_sum_rootCobasis S hV hh]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [invForm_of_mem_zero P p S (rootBasis P p 0 k).2.2, hComp_h, bilinForm_toDual_symm_right]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sum_hComp_rootCobasis_smul
statement:
lemma sum_hComp_rootCobasis_smul (hV : IsGModule P p V) (Λ : Dual K H) (w : V) :
    ∑ k, Λ (hComp P p (rootCobasis P p S 0 k)) • (rootBasis P p 0 k : 𝒰) • w =
      h P p ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) • w
proof:
:= by
  have hh : h P p ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) ∈ gRoot P p 0 :=
    ⟨h_mem_gTilde P p _, h_mem_weightSpace P p _⟩
  rw [smul_eq_sum_rootBasis S hV hh]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [invForm_h_left, bilinForm_toDual_symm_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_of_mem_gRoot_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h_hComp_of_mem_zero P p hx.1 hx.2, superBracket_swap (isHomog_h P p _) hzc,
    superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p _ hzγ, hComp_h, zero_mul, zSign_zero, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirRight_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_hComp_rootBasis_smul hV, casimirRight, casimirSum_def, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hw : weightParity P p 0 = 0 := by
    rw [← map_zero P.rootOf, weightParity_rootOf, rootParity]; simp
  rw [superBracket_of_mem_gRoot_zero hzγ hzc (rootBasis P p 0 k).2, hw, mul_zero, zSign_zero,
    one_smul, neg_smul, smul_neg, smul_assoc, smul_comm (rootCobasis P p S 0 k : 𝒰) (γ _)]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirLeft_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_hComp_rootCobasis_smul hV, casimirLeft, casimirSum_def, Finset.smul_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hk : (rootCobasis P p S 0 k : 𝒰) ∈ gRoot P p 0 := by
    simpa using (rootCobasis P p S 0 k).2
  rw [superBracket_of_mem_gRoot_zero hzγ hzc hk, neg_smul, smul_assoc, smul_comm z (γ _)]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_h_smul_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hx : h P p a ∈ gRoot P p 0 := ⟨h_mem_gTilde P p _, h_mem_weightSpace P p _⟩
  rw [smul_smul_eq_superBracket hzc (isHomog_h P p a), superBracket_of_mem_gRoot_zero hzγ hzc hx,
    hComp_h, mul_zero, zSign_zero, one_smul, add_sub_cancel_right, neg_smul, smul_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirRight_zero_sub_casimirLeft_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [casimirRight_zero hV hzγ hzc, casimirLeft_zero hV hzγ hzc, ← smul_h_smul_sub hzγ hzc]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite
statement:
private lemma finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite {α M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] {s : Set α}
    {f g : α → M} (hf : (s ∩ Function.support f).Finite)
    (hg : (s ∩ Function.support g).Finite) :
    ∑ᶠ i ∈ s, (f i - g i) = ∑ᶠ i ∈ s, f i - ∑ᶠ i ∈ s, g i
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : (s ∩ Function.support fun i ↦ f i - g i).Finite :=
    (hf.union hg).subset fun i ⟨his, hi⟩ ↦ by
      rcases Function.support_sub f g hi with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨his, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨his, h⟩
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← finsum_mem_add_distrib' hfg hg]
  simp only [sub_add_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_allWeights_of_gRoot_ne_bot
statement:
lemma mem_allWeights_of_gRoot_ne_bot {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : gRoot P p μ ≠ ⊥) :
    μ ∈ AuxLieAlgebra.allWeights P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
  exact mem_allWeights P p hx.1 hx.2 hx0

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root
statement:
theorem finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (F : Dual K H → M) (i : ι)
    (hF : ∀ μ, gRoot P p μ = ⊥ → F μ = 0) (hfin : (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support F).Finite) :
    ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F (μ - P.root i) = F 0 + ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F μ
proof:
:= by
  have hpt (β : Dual K H) : P.posWeights.indicator (fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i)) (β + P.root i) =
      (insert 0 P.posWeights).indicator F β := by
    by_cases hβ : β ∈ insert 0 P.posWeights
    · have : β + P.root i ∈ P.posWeights := by
        rcases hβ with rfl | hβ
        · simpa using P.root_mem_posWeights i
        · exact P.posWeights_add hβ (P.root_mem_posWeights i)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem this, Set.indicator_of_mem hβ, add_sub_cancel_right]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hβ]
      by_cases h' : β + P.root i ∈ P.posWeights
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h', add_sub_cancel_right]
        refine hF β (by_contra fun hne ↦ ?_)
        rcases mem_allWeights_of_gRoot_ne_bot hne with (hneg | h0) | hpos
        · exact KacMoodyAlgebra.add_root_notMem_posWeights P hneg i h'
        · exact hβ (Or.inl h0)
        · exact hβ (Or.inr hpos)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h']
  calc ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F (μ - P.root i)
      = ∑ᶠ μ, P.posWeights.indicator (fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i)) μ := finsum_mem_def _ _
    _ = ∑ᶠ β, P.posWeights.indicator (fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i))
          (Equiv.addRight (P.root i) β) := (finsum_comp_equiv _).symm
    _ = ∑ᶠ β, (insert 0 P.posWeights).indicator F β := finsum_congr hpt
    _ = ∑ᶠ β ∈ insert 0 P.posWeights, F β := (finsum_mem_def _ _).symm
    _ = F 0 + ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, F μ := finsum_mem_insert' F P.zero_notMem_posWeights hfin

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root
statement:
lemma finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (F : Dual K H → M)
    (i : ι) (hF : ∀ μ, gRoot P p μ = ⊥ → F μ = 0)
    (hfin : (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support F).Finite) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦ F (μ - P.root i)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((hfin.insert 0).preimage (f := fun μ ↦ μ - P.root i)
    (sub_left_injective.injOn)).subset ?_
  rintro μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_insert_iff]
  by_cases h0 : μ - P.root i = 0
  · exact Or.inl h0
  refine Or.inr ⟨?_, hne⟩
  have hne' : gRoot P p (μ - P.root i) ≠ ⊥ := fun hbot ↦ hne (hF _ hbot)
  rcases mem_allWeights_of_gRoot_ne_bot hne' with (hneg | h0') | hpos
  · exact absurd (by rwa [sub_add_cancel]) (KacMoodyAlgebra.add_root_notMem_posWeights P hneg i)
  · exact absurd h0' h0
  · exact hpos

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimirTerm_apply
statement:
lemma casimirTerm_apply (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    casimirTerm P p V S μ v = casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • x • v) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [casimirTerm, casimirSum_def, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_casimirTerm
statement:
lemma finite_casimirTerm (hV : IsPosFinite P p V) (v : V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦ casimirTerm P p V S μ v).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (hV v).subset fun μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hμ, ?_⟩
  rw [Function.mem_support, casimirTerm_apply] at hne
  obtain ⟨y, -, x, hx, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hne
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, smul_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_apply
statement:
lemma casimir_apply (hV : IsPosFinite P p V) (v : V) :
    casimir S hV v = (2 : K) • h P p ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) • v + casimirTerm P p V S 0 v +
      (2 : K) • ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ v
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_casimirLeft
statement:
lemma finite_casimirLeft (hV : IsPosFinite P p V) (z : 𝒰) (v : V) :
    (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦ casimirLeft S z v μ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (hV v).subset fun μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦ ⟨hμ, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, -, x, hx, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hne
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, smul_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_casimirRight
statement:
lemma finite_casimirRight (hV : IsPosFinite P p V) {γ : Dual K H} (hγ : γ ∈ P.posWeights)
    {c : ZMod 2} {z : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hz : z ∈ gTilde P p) (hzγ : z ∈ weightSpace P p γ)
    (v : V) : (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦ casimirRight S c z v μ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((hV v).preimage (f := fun μ ↦ γ + μ) (add_right_injective γ).injOn).subset
    fun μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦ ?_
  have hne' : casimirSum S (fun y x : 𝒰 ↦ y • superBracket P p z x • v) μ ≠ 0 :=
    fun h0 ↦ hne (by simp only [casimirRight, h0, smul_zero])
  obtain ⟨y, -, x, hx, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_casimirSum_ne_zero hne'
  exact ⟨P.posWeights_add hγ hμ, _, superBracket_mem_gRoot hz hzγ hx,
    fun h0 ↦ hne (by rw [h0, smul_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_finsum_casimirTerm_sub
statement:
lemma smul_finsum_casimirTerm_sub (hV : IsPosFinite P p V) (z : 𝒰) (v : V) :
    z • ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ v -
        ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ (z • v) =
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, (z • casimirTerm P p V S μ v - casimirTerm P p V S μ (z • v))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (smulEnd P p V z).toAddMonoidHom.map_finsum_mem' (finite_casimirTerm (S := S) hV v)
  simp only [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, smulEnd_apply] at h1
  have hf : (P.posWeights ∩ Function.support fun μ ↦ z • casimirTerm P p V S μ v).Finite :=
    (finite_casimirTerm hV v).subset fun μ ⟨hμ, hne⟩ ↦
      ⟨hμ, fun h0 ↦ hne (by simp only at h0 ⊢; rw [h0, smul_zero])⟩
  rw [h1, finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite hf (finite_casimirTerm hV _)]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_e_smul
statement:
theorem casimir_e_smul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) (v : V) :
    casimir S hV' (e P p i • v) = e P p i • casimir S hV' v
proof:
:= by
  have hz := nPlus_le_gTilde P p (e_mem_nPlus P p i)
  have hzγ := e_mem_weightSpace P p i
  have hzc := isHomog_e P p i
  have hfin := finite_casimirRight (S := S) hV' (P.root_mem_posWeights i) hz hzγ v (c := p i)
  have hR0 : ∀ μ, gRoot P p μ = ⊥ → casimirRight S (p i) (e P p i) v μ = 0 := fun μ hμ ↦ by
    rw [casimirRight, casimirSum_eq_zero_of_eq_bot (fun y ↦ by simp) hμ, smul_zero]
  have hsum : e P p i • ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ v -
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ (e P p i • v) =
      -casimirRight S (p i) (e P p i) v 0 := by
    rw [smul_finsum_casimirTerm_sub hV',
      finsum_mem_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ by
        rw [casimirTerm_apply, casimirTerm_apply, smul_casimirSum_sub_right hV hz hzγ hzc μ v],
      finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite hfin
        (finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root _ i hR0 hfin),
      finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root _ i hR0 hfin]
    abel
  have h0 := smul_casimirSum_sub_right (S := S) hV hz hzγ hzc 0 v
  rw [← casimirTerm_apply, ← casimirTerm_apply] at h0
  have hL := casimirLeft_eq (S := S) hV hz hzγ hzc 0 v
  have hRL := casimirRight_zero_sub_casimirLeft_zero (S := S) hV hzγ hzc v
  have hρ := smul_h_smul_sub hzγ hzc ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) v
  rw [KacMoodyAlgebra.root_toDual_symm_root S hA] at hRL
  simp only [casimir_apply, smul_add, smul_comm (e P p i) (2 : K)]
  simp only [← smulEnd_apply P p V] at h0 hsum hρ hRL ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := module) -(2 : K) • hρ - h0 - (2 : K) • hsum + hL + hRL

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_f_smul
statement:
theorem casimir_f_smul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) (v : V) :
    casimir S hV' (f P p i • v) = f P p i • casimir S hV' v
proof:
:= by
  have hz := nMinus_le_gTilde P p (f_mem_nMinus P p i)
  have hzγ := f_mem_weightSpace P p i
  have hzc := isHomog_f P p i
  have hfin := finite_casimirLeft (S := S) hV' (f P p i) v
  have hL0 : ∀ μ, gRoot P p μ = ⊥ → casimirLeft S (f P p i) v μ = 0 :=
    fun μ hμ ↦ casimirSum_eq_zero_of_eq_bot (fun y ↦ by simp) hμ
  have hsum : f P p i • ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ v -
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ (f P p i • v) =
      -casimirLeft S (f P p i) v 0 := by
    rw [smul_finsum_casimirTerm_sub hV',
      finsum_mem_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ by
        rw [casimirTerm_apply, casimirTerm_apply, smul_casimirSum_sub_left hV hz hzγ hzc μ v,
          ← sub_eq_add_neg],
      finsum_mem_sub_distrib_of_finite hfin
        (finite_posWeights_inter_support_sub_root _ i hL0 hfin),
      finsum_mem_posWeights_sub_root _ i hL0 hfin]
    abel
  have h0 := smul_casimirSum_sub_left (S := S) hV hz hzγ hzc 0 v
  rw [← casimirTerm_apply, ← casimirTerm_apply] at h0
  have hR := casimirLeft_eq (S := S) hV hz hzγ hzc (0 + -P.root i) v
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right] at hR
  have hRL := casimirRight_zero_sub_casimirLeft_zero (S := S) hV hzγ hzc v
  have hρ := smul_h_smul_sub hzγ hzc ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) v
  simp only [map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_neg,
    KacMoodyAlgebra.root_toDual_symm_root S hA] at hRL hρ
  simp only [casimir_apply, smul_add, smul_comm (f P p i) (2 : K)]
  simp only [← smulEnd_apply P p V] at h0 hsum hρ hRL ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := module) -(2 : K) • hρ - h0 - (2 : K) • hsum + hR - hRL

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_h_smul
statement:
theorem casimir_h_smul (a : H) (v : V) :
    casimir S hV' (h P p a • v) = h P p a • casimir S hV' v
proof:
:= by
  have hz := h_mem_gTilde P p a
  have hzγ := h_mem_weightSpace P p a
  have hzc := isHomog_h P p a
  have hsum : h P p a • ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ v -
      ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ (h P p a • v) = 0 := by
    rw [smul_finsum_casimirTerm_sub hV']
    exact finsum_mem_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun μ _ ↦ by
      rw [casimirTerm_apply, casimirTerm_apply, smul_casimirSum_sub_right hV hz hzγ hzc μ v,
        sub_zero, sub_self]
  have h0 := smul_casimirSum_sub_right (S := S) hV hz hzγ hzc 0 v
  rw [← casimirTerm_apply, ← casimirTerm_apply, sub_zero, sub_self] at h0
  have hρ := smul_h_smul_sub hzγ hzc ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) v
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul, neg_zero] at hρ
  simp only [casimir_apply, smul_add, smul_comm (h P p a) (2 : K)]
  simp only [← smulEnd_apply P p V] at h0 hsum hρ ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := module) -(2 : K) • hρ - h0 - (2 : K) • hsum

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.induction_on
statement:
lemma induction_on {q : P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop} (u : 𝒰)
    (halg : ∀ c : K, q (algebraMap K _ c)) (he : ∀ i, q (e P p i)) (hf : ∀ i, q (f P p i))
    (hh : ∀ a, q (h P p a)) (hadd : ∀ x y, q x → q y → q (x + y))
    (hmul : ∀ x y, q x → q y → q (x * y)) : q u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P p u
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simpa using halg c
  | grade1 x =>
    rcases x with i | i | a
    · exact he i
    · exact hf i
    · exact hh a
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact hmul _ _ hx hy
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact hadd _ _ hx hy
