name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_smul
statement:
theorem casimir_smul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (u : 𝒰) (v : V) :
    casimir S hV' (u • v) = u • casimir S hV' v
proof:
:= by
  revert v
  refine induction_on (q := fun u ↦ ∀ v, casimir S hV' (u • v) = u • casimir S hV' v) u
    (fun c v ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ casimir_e_smul hV hV' hA i) (fun i ↦ casimir_f_smul hV hV' hA i)
    (fun a ↦ casimir_h_smul hV hV' a) ?_ ?_
  · rw [algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul, map_smul]
  · intro x y hx hy v
    rw [add_smul, map_add, hx, hy, add_smul]
  · intro x y hx hy v
    rw [mul_smul, hx, hy, mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_apply_of_e_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∑ᶠ μ ∈ P.posWeights, casimirTerm P p V S μ v = 0 := by
    refine finsum_mem_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun μ hμ ↦ ?_
    rw [casimirTerm_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
    simp only
    rw [smul_eq_zero_of_mem_posWeights he hμ (rootBasis P p μ k).2, smul_zero]
  have h0 : casimirTerm P p V S 0 v = h P p ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) • v := by
    rw [← sum_hComp_rootBasis_smul hV, casimirTerm_apply, casimirSum_def]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    have hb := (rootBasis P p 0 k).2
    rw [← h_hComp_of_mem_zero P p hb.1 hb.2, hv, smul_comm, hComp_h]
  have hsymm : P.rho ((P.toDual S).symm Λ) = Λ ((P.toDual S).symm P.rho) := by
    rw [← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, ← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq]
  rw [casimir_apply, hpos, h0, hv, hv, dualBilinForm_apply_eq, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, hsymm]
  module

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_eq_smul_of_forall_eq_smul
statement:
theorem casimir_eq_smul_of_forall_eq_smul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {Λ : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V Λ) (he : ∀ i, e P p i • v = 0)
    (hgen : ∀ w : V, ∃ u : P.SuperEnveloping p, w = u • v) (w : V) :
    casimir S hV' w = P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ • w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hgen w
  rw [casimir_smul hV hV' hA, casimir_apply_of_e_smul_eq_zero hV' hV hv he, smul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lowerCoeff_one
statement: lemma lowerCoeff_one (s : K) (k : ℕ) : lowerCoeff 1 s k = k * (s - k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [lowerCoeff]
  | succ k ih => rw [lowerCoeff, ih]; push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lowerCoeff_neg_one
statement:
lemma lowerCoeff_neg_one (s : K) (k : ℕ) :
    lowerCoeff (-1) s (2 * k) = -(2 * k) ∧ lowerCoeff (-1) s (2 * k + 1) = s - 2 * k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [lowerCoeff]
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 : lowerCoeff (-1) s (2 * (k + 1)) = -(2 * (k + 1)) := by
      rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 1 + 1 by ring, lowerCoeff, ih.2]; push_cast; ring
    refine ⟨by push_cast; exact h1, ?_⟩
    rw [lowerCoeff, h1]; push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_smul_f_pow_smul
statement:
lemma e_smul_f_pow_smul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ) (he : e P p i • v = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    e P p i • (f P p i ^ (k + 1) • v) =
      lowerCoeff (superSign K p i i) (μ (P.coroot i)) (k + 1) • (f P p i ^ k • v)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_one, pow_zero, one_smul, ← mul_smul, e_mul_f, ite_eq_left rfl, add_smul,
      smul_assoc, mul_smul, he, smul_zero, smul_zero, zero_add, hv (P.coroot i)]
    simp [lowerCoeff]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hw := f_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hv i (k + 1)
    have h2 : (μ - (k + 1) • P.root i) (P.coroot i) = μ (P.coroot i) - 2 * (k + 1 : ℕ) := by
      simp [P.root_coroot, hA.diag]; ring
    rw [pow_succ' _ (k + 1), mul_smul, ← mul_smul (e P p i), e_mul_f, ite_eq_left rfl, add_smul,
      smul_assoc, mul_smul, ih, hw (P.coroot i), h2, smul_comm (f P p i) (lowerCoeff _ _ _),
      ← mul_smul (f P p i), ← pow_succ', smul_smul, ← add_smul]
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_smul_f_pow_smul_of_ne
statement:
lemma e_smul_f_pow_smul_of_ne {i j : ι} (hji : j ≠ i) {v : V} (he : e P p j • v = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    e P p j • (f P p i ^ k • v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rwa [pow_zero, one_smul]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, ← mul_smul, e_mul_f_of_ne _ _ hji, smul_assoc, mul_smul, ih, smul_zero,
      smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_smul_f_pow_succ_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hji := eq_or_ne j i
  · rw [e_smul_f_pow_smul hA _ hv (he _), superSign_self, hn]
    split_ifs with hi
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hodd hi
      rw [show m + m + 1 = 2 * m + 1 by ring, (lowerCoeff_neg_one _ m).2]
      convert zero_smul K _ using 2
      push_cast; ring
    · rw [lowerCoeff_one]
      convert zero_smul K _ using 2
      push_cast; ring
  · exact e_smul_f_pow_smul_of_ne hji (he j) _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_nat_of_e_smul_eq_zero_of_isIntegrableAt
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ⁅sl2E P p i, v⁆ = 0 := by
    change sl2E P p i • v = 0
    unfold sl2E
    split_ifs
    · rw [smul_assoc, sq, mul_smul, he, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    · exact he
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsSl2Triple.HasPrimitiveVectorWith.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero
    (t := isSl2Triple P p (hA := hA) i) ⟨hv0, sl2H_smul hv i, hE⟩ (hV.exists_sl2F v)
  refine ⟨sl2Deg p i * m, ?_⟩
  rw [apply_coroot_eq, hm]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsBounded.exists_e_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsBounded.exists_e_smul_eq_zero {Λs : Finset (Dual K H)} (hV : IsBounded P p V Λs)
    {μ₁ : Dual K H} {v₁ : V} (hv₁ : v₁ ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ₁) (hv₁0 : v₁ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ μ, ∃ w ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ, w ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ i, e P p i • w = 0) ∧
      toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ₁
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set F := {κ | modWeightSpace P p V κ ≠ ⊥ ∧ toWeightOrd P κ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ₁}
  have hFfin : F.Finite := (finite_setOf_le_le P Λs μ₁).subset fun κ ⟨hκ, hle⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hκ
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, rfl⟩ := hV.exists_eq_sub hw hw0
    exact ⟨⟨Λ, hΛ, (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).2 ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩⟩, hle⟩
  have hne : (toWeightOrd P '' F).Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, μ₁, ⟨(Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).2 ⟨v₁, hv₁, hv₁0⟩, le_rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨μ₀, ⟨hne0, hle⟩, rfl⟩, hmin⟩ := (hFfin.image _).isPWO.exists_minimal hne
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hne0
  refine ⟨μ₀, w, hw, hw0, fun i ↦ ?_, hle⟩
  by_contra h0
  have hmem := smul_mem_modWeightSpace V (e_mem_weightSpace P p i) hw
  have hup : toWeightOrd P (P.root i + μ₀) ≤ toWeightOrd P μ₀ :=
    (toWeightOrd_le_iff P).2 ⟨Pi.single i 1, Pi.single_nonneg.2 zero_le_one, by simp⟩
  have hF : P.root i + μ₀ ∈ F := ⟨(Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).2 ⟨_, hmem, h0⟩, hup.trans hle⟩
  have h1 := (toWeightOrd P).injective (le_antisymm hup (hmin ⟨_, hF, rfl⟩ hup))
  rw [add_eq_right, ← rootOf_single, ← map_zero P.rootOf] at h1
  simpa using congr_fun (P.rootOf_injective h1) i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.hwv_mem_modWeightSpace
statement: lemma hwv_mem_modWeightSpace : hwv P p Λ ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [modWeightSpace_self]
  exact Submodule.subset_span rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isGModule_fPowQuotient
statement: lemma isGModule_fPowQuotient : IsGModule P p (FPowQuotient P p Λ n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx v
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (fPowSubmodule P p Λ n).mkQ_surjective v
  rw [← map_smul, isGModule x hx v, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.span_mkQ_hwv
statement:
lemma span_mkQ_hwv :
    Submodule.span 𝒰 {(fPowSubmodule P p Λ n).mkQ (hwv P p Λ)} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_singleton, ← Submodule.map_span, span_hwv, Submodule.map_top,
    Submodule.range_mkQ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isIntegrable_fPowQuotient
statement: theorem isIntegrable_fPowQuotient : IsIntegrable P p (FPowQuotient P p Λ n)
proof:
:= by
  set N := fPowSubmodule P p Λ n
  intro i
  refine isIntegrableAt_of_span S hA hp (s := {N.mkQ (hwv P p Λ)}) isGModule_fPowQuotient i
    span_mkQ_hwv ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ rfl
    exact ⟨1, by rw [pow_one, ← map_smul, e_smul_hwv, map_zero]⟩
  · rintro _ rfl
    refine ⟨n i + 1, ?_⟩
    rw [← map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.exists_eq_sub_of_hwv_mem_span
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sub_of_hwv_mem_span {μ : ι → Dual K H} (g : ι → GVerma P p Λ)
    (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) (μ i)) (he : ∀ i j, e P p j • g i = 0)
    (hmem : hwv P p Λ ∈ Submodule.span 𝒰 (Set.range g)) :
    ∃ i, ∃ d : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ d ∧ Λ = μ i - P.rootOf d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let φ (i : ι) : GVerma P p (μ i) →ₗ[𝒰] GVerma P p Λ :=
    lift isGModule (g i) (he i) fun a ↦ by rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact hg i a
  let Φ : (∀ i, GVerma P p (μ i)) →ₗ[𝒰] GVerma P p Λ :=
    ∑ i, (φ i).comp (LinearMap.proj i)
  have hle : Submodule.span 𝒰 (Set.range g) ≤ LinearMap.range Φ := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Pi.single i (hwv P p (μ i)), ?_⟩
    simp only [Φ, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, map_zero])
      (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same, lift_hwv]
  have hB : IsBounded P p (LinearMap.range Φ) (Finset.univ.biUnion fun i ↦ {μ i}) :=
    (isBounded_pi fun _ ↦ isBounded).of_surjective Φ.rangeRestrict
      Φ.surjective_rangeRestrict
  obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', d, hd, hdeq⟩ := hB.exists_eq_sub (w := ⟨_, hle hmem⟩) (ν := Λ)
    (fun a ↦ Subtype.ext (hwv_mem_modWeightSpace a))
    (fun h ↦ hwv_ne_zero P p Λ (congr_arg Subtype.val h))
  obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hΛ'
  exact ⟨i, d, hd, Finset.mem_singleton.1 hi ▸ hdeq⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.fPowSubmodule_ne_top
statement:
theorem fPowSubmodule_ne_top (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) : fPowSubmodule P p Λ n ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  obtain ⟨i, d, hd, hdeq⟩ := exists_eq_sub_of_hwv_mem_span (μ := fun i ↦ Λ - (n i + 1) • P.root i)
    _ (fun i ↦ f_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hwv_mem_modWeightSpace i _)
    (fun i ↦ e_smul_f_pow_succ_smul_eq_zero hA (hn i) (hodd i) hwv_mem_modWeightSpace
      e_smul_hwv) (show hwv P p Λ ∈ fPowSubmodule P p Λ n from htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  have h0 : P.rootOf (d + ((n i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • Pi.single i 1) = P.rootOf 0 := by
    rw [map_add, map_zsmul, rootOf_single, map_zero, natCast_zsmul]
    linear_combination (norm := module) hdeq
  have h1 := congr_fun (P.rootOf_injective h0) i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    Pi.zero_apply] at h1
  have := hd i
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.eq_bot_or_eq_top_fPowQuotient
statement:
theorem eq_bot_or_eq_top_fPowQuotient (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (N' : Submodule 𝒰 (FPowQuotient P p Λ n)) : N' = ⊥ ∨ N' = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set N := fPowSubmodule P p Λ n
  have hV : IsCasimirModule P p S (FPowQuotient P p Λ n) {Λ}
      (P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ) :=
    (IsCasimirModule.gVerma hA ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_singleton_self _, le_rfl⟩).quotient N
  have hint := isIntegrable_fPowQuotient (P := P) (Λ := Λ) (n := n) S hA hp
  rcases eq_or_ne N' ⊥ with h | h0
  · exact Or.inl h
  right
  have hN' := hV.submodule N'
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 h0
  obtain ⟨μ₁, hμ₁⟩ : ∃ μ₁, modWeightSpace P p N' μ₁ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    have htop := hN'.isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top
    simp only [hall, iSup_bot] at htop
    have hmem : (⟨x, hx⟩ : N') ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K N') := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact hx0 (congr_arg Subtype.val ((Submodule.mem_bot K).1 hmem))
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁, hv₁0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hμ₁
  obtain ⟨μ, w, hw, hw0, he, -⟩ := hN'.isBounded.exists_e_smul_eq_zero hv₁ hv₁0
  
  have hwV : (w : FPowQuotient P p Λ n) ∈ modWeightSpace P p _ μ := fun a ↦ by
    simpa using congr_arg Subtype.val (hw a)
  have hw0' : (w : FPowQuotient P p Λ n) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hw0 (Subtype.ext h)
  have he' : ∀ i, e P p i • (w : FPowQuotient P p Λ n) = 0 := fun i ↦
    congr_arg Subtype.val (he i)
  
  have hμdom : P.IsDominantIntegral μ := fun i ↦
    exists_nat_of_e_smul_eq_zero_of_isIntegrableAt hA (hint i) hwV hw0' (he' i)
  have hΛdom : P.IsDominantIntegral Λ := fun i ↦ ⟨n i, hn i⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', k, hk, hμk⟩ := hV.isBounded.exists_eq_sub hwV hw0'
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 hΛ'] at hμk
  
  have hc : P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ = P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ := by
    have h1 := casimir_apply_of_e_smul_eq_zero (S := S) hV.isBounded.isPosFinite hV.isGModule
      hwV he'
    rw [hV.casimir_eq] at h1
    exact (smul_left_injective K hw0' h1).symm
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    by_contra hk0
    exact KacMoodyAlgebra.dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_ne S hΛdom hμdom ⟨hk, hk0⟩
      (by rw [hμk]; abel) hc.symm
  rw [hk0, map_zero, sub_zero] at hμk
  subst μ
  
  rw [modWeightSpace_quotient N isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top, modWeightSpace_self,
    Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hwV
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hwV
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [zero_smul] at ht; exact hw0' ht.symm
  have hmem : N.mkQ (hwv P p Λ) ∈ N' := by
    have : N.mkQ (hwv P p Λ) = t⁻¹ • (w : FPowQuotient P p Λ n) := by
      rw [← ht, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0, one_smul]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact N'.smul_of_tower_mem t⁻¹ w.2
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_mkQ_hwv (n := n), Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact hmem

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isSimpleModule_fPowQuotient
statement:
theorem isSimpleModule_fPowQuotient (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) : IsSimpleModule 𝒰 (FPowQuotient P p Λ n)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (FPowQuotient P p Λ n) :=
    Submodule.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2 (fPowSubmodule_ne_top hA hn hodd)
  exact { eq_bot_or_eq_top := eq_bot_or_eq_top_fPowQuotient S hA hp hn }

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isCoatom_fPowSubmodule
statement:
theorem isCoatom_fPowSubmodule (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i)
    (hodd : ∀ i, p i = 1 → Even (n i)) : IsCoatom (fPowSubmodule P p Λ n)
proof:
:=
  isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.1 (isSimpleModule_fPowQuotient S hA hp hn hodd)

name: Matrix.Realization.superSign_comm
statement: lemma superSign_comm (i j : ι) : superSign K p i j = superSign K p j i
proof:
:= by
  simp [superSign, and_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.superSign_mul_self
statement: lemma superSign_mul_self (i j : ι) : superSign K p i j * superSign K p i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold superSign; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.superSign_self
statement: lemma superSign_self (i : ι) : superSign K p i i = if p i = 1 then -1 else 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [superSign]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk P p)
proof: := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_surjective K _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mk_rel
statement: lemma mk_rel {x y : FreeAlgebra K (AuxGen ι H)} (hxy : Rel P p x y) : mk P p x = mk P p y
proof:
:=
  RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel K hxy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mul_h
statement: lemma h_mul_h (a b : H) : h P p a * h P p b = h P p b * h P p a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [h, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, ← map_mul]
  exact mk_rel (Rel.h_h a b)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mul_f
statement:
lemma e_mul_f (i j : ι) : e P p i * f P p j =
    superSign K p i j • (f P p j * e P p i) + if i = j then h P p (P.coroot i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_rel (Rel.e_f (P := P) (p := p) i j)
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_smul] at this
  rw [e, f, this]
  split_ifs <;> simp [h]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mul_f_sub
statement:
lemma e_mul_f_sub (i j : ι) : e P p i * f P p j - superSign K p i j • (f P p j * e P p i) =
    if i = j then h P p (P.coroot i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [e_mul_f, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mul_f_of_ne
statement:
lemma e_mul_f_of_ne {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    e P p i * f P p j = superSign K p i j • (f P p j * e P p i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [e_mul_f, hij]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mul_e
statement: lemma h_mul_e (a : H) (i : ι) : h P p a * e P p i = e P p i * h P p a + P.root i a • e P p i
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_rel (Rel.h_e (P := P) (p := p) a i)
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_smul] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mul_f
statement: lemma h_mul_f (a : H) (i : ι) : h P p a * f P p i = f P p i * h P p a - P.root i a • f P p i
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_rel (Rel.h_f (P := P) (p := p) a i)
  simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_smul] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.LiftData.rel
statement:
lemma LiftData.rel (D : LiftData P p B) {x y : FreeAlgebra K (AuxGen ι H)} (hxy : Rel P p x y) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift K D.gen x = FreeAlgebra.lift K D.gen y
proof:
:= by
  cases hxy with
  | h_add a b => simp [LiftData.gen]
  | h_smul c a => simp [LiftData.gen]
  | h_h a b => simpa [LiftData.gen] using D.h_mul_h a b
  | e_f i j =>
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_smul, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, LiftData.gen, D.e_mul_f]
    split_ifs <;> simp [LiftData.gen]
  | h_e a i => simpa [LiftData.gen] using D.h_mul_e a i
  | h_f a i => simpa [LiftData.gen] using D.h_mul_f a i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (D : LiftData P p B) (x : FreeAlgebra K (AuxGen ι H)) :
    lift D (mk P p x) = FreeAlgebra.lift K D.gen x
proof:
:=
  RingQuot.liftAlgHom_mkAlgHom_apply _ _ _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lift_e
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_e (D : LiftData P p B) (i : ι) : lift D (e P p i) = D.e i
proof:
:= by
  simp [e, LiftData.gen]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lift_f
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_f (D : LiftData P p B) (i : ι) : lift D (f P p i) = D.f i
proof:
:= by
  simp [f, LiftData.gen]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lift_h
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_h (D : LiftData P p B) (a : H) : lift D (h P p a) = D.h a
proof:
:= by
  simp [h, LiftData.gen]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma hom_ext {g₁ g₂ : P.SuperEnveloping p →ₐ[K] B} (he : ∀ i, g₁ (e P p i) = g₂ (e P p i))
    (hf : ∀ i, g₁ (f P p i) = g₂ (f P p i)) (hh : ∀ a, g₁ (h P p a) = g₂ (h P p a)) :
    g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  refine RingQuot.ringQuot_ext' K _ _ (FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun x ↦ ?_))
  rcases x with i | i | a
  · exact he i
  · exact hf i
  · exact hh a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVec_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma wordVec_eq_zero_iff {w : List ι} : wordVec w = 0 ↔ w = []
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hw ↦ ?_, fun hw ↦ hw ▸ wordVec_nil⟩
  cases w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j w =>
    have := congrFun hw j
    have hj := wordVec_nonneg w j
    simp only [wordVec_cons, Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply] at this hj
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVec_cons_eq_nsmul_single
proof:
:= by
  have hji : j = i := by
    by_contra hji
    have := congrFun hw j
    have hj := wordVec_nonneg w j
    simp only [wordVec_cons, Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.smul_apply,
      Pi.single_eq_of_ne hji, smul_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this hj
    omega
  subst hji
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [wordVec_cons, add_smul, one_smul, add_comm] at hw
  exact add_right_cancel hw

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_replicate_of_wordVec
statement:
lemma eq_replicate_of_wordVec {i : ι} {w : List ι} {n : ℕ}
    (hw : wordVec w = n • Pi.single i (1 : ℤ)) : w = List.replicate n i
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n =>
      have := congrFun hw i
      simp at this
      omega
  | cons j w ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      rw [zero_smul] at hw
      exact absurd ((wordVec_eq_zero_iff).1 hw) (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
    | succ n =>
      obtain ⟨rfl, hw'⟩ := wordVec_cons_eq_nsmul_single hw
      rw [ih hw', List.replicate_succ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma wProj_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) :
    wProj P p μ x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [wProj, wScale_of_mem P p _ hx]; simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wProj_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma wProj_of_mem_ne {μ ν : Dual K H} (hν : ν ≠ μ) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p ν) : wProj P p μ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wProj, wScale_of_mem P p _ hx]; simp [hν]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf
statement:
lemma eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    eLie P p i w ∈ weightSpace P p (P.rootOf (wordVec (i :: w)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootOf_wordVec, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_comm]
  exact eLie_mem_weightSpace P p i w

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlusRoot_le_weightSpace
statement:
lemma nPlusRoot_le_weightSpace (k : ι → ℤ) :
    nPlusRoot P p k ≤ weightSpace P p (P.rootOf k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, w, hk, rfl⟩
  exact hk ▸ eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf P p i w

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wProj_mem_nPlusRoot
statement:
lemma wProj_mem_nPlusRoot (k : ι → ℤ) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ nPlus P p) :
    wProj P p (P.rootOf k) x ∈ nPlusRoot P p k
proof:
:= by
  suffices nPlus P p ≤ (nPlusRoot P p k).comap (wProj P p (P.rootOf k)) from this hx
  refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  by_cases hk : wordVec (i :: w) = k
  · rw [wProj_of_mem P p (hk ▸ eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf P p i w)]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, w, hk, rfl⟩
  · rw [wProj_of_mem_ne P p (fun h ↦ hk (P.rootOf_injective h))
      (eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf P p i w)]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wProj_nMinus
statement:
lemma wProj_nMinus {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ nMinus P p) : wProj P p (P.rootOf k) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  suffices nPlus P p ≤ (LinearMap.ker (wProj P p (P.rootOf k))).comap (omega P p).toLinearMap
    from this hy
  refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦ ?_
  refine wProj_of_mem_ne P p (fun h ↦ ?_)
    (omega_mem_weightSpace P p (eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf P p i w))
  have hsum : wordVec (i :: w) + k ∈ posCone ι :=
    ⟨add_nonneg (wordVec_nonneg _) hk.1, fun h0 ↦ hk.2 <| le_antisymm
      (by have := wordVec_nonneg (i :: w); rw [← h0]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_left this) hk.1⟩
  refine P.rootOf_ne_zero hsum.2 ?_
  rw [map_add, ← h, add_neg_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf
statement:
theorem gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) :
    gTilde P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (P.rootOf k) = nPlusRoot P p k
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_inf ?_ (nPlusRoot_le_weightSpace P p k))
  · rintro x ⟨hx, hxk⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩ := (mem_gTilde_iff P p).1 hx
    rw [← wProj_of_mem P p hxk, map_add, map_add, wProj_nMinus P p hk hn,
      wProj_of_mem_ne P p (Ne.symm (P.rootOf_ne_zero hk.2)) (h_mem_weightSpace P p a), zero_add,
      zero_add]
    exact wProj_mem_nPlusRoot P p k hm
  · refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, w, -, rfl⟩
    exact nPlus_le_gTilde P p (eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rootOf_nsmul_single
statement:
lemma rootOf_nsmul_single (i : ι) (n : ℕ) :
    P.rootOf (n • Pi.single i (1 : ℤ)) = n • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_nsmul]
  congr 1
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nsmul_single_mem_posCone
statement:
lemma nsmul_single_mem_posCone (i : ι) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n • Pi.single i (1 : ℤ) ∈ posCone ι
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ ?_, fun h0 ↦ hn ?_⟩
  · by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj; simp
    · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]
  · have := congrFun h0 i
    simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_nPlusRoot_nsmul
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ hx
  rintro _ ⟨j, w, hw, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨rfl, hw'⟩ := wordVec_cons_eq_nsmul_single hw
  rw [eq_replicate_of_wordVec hw']
  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root
proof:
:= by
  have hk := nsmul_single_mem_posCone (i := i) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  rw [← rootOf_nsmul_single] at hxn
  have : x ∈ gTilde P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (P.rootOf ((n + 1 : ℕ) • Pi.single i (1 : ℤ))) :=
    ⟨hx, hxn⟩
  rw [gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf P p hk] at this
  exact mem_nPlusRoot_nsmul P p this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_weightSpace_root
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpace_root {i : ι} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxi : x ∈ weightSpace P p (P.root i)) : ∃ c : K, x = c • e P p i
proof:
:= by
  have := mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root P p (n := 0) hx (by rwa [zero_add, one_smul])
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 this
  exact ⟨c, by simpa using hc.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_weightSpace_two_root
statement:
theorem mem_weightSpace_two_root {i : ι} {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxi : x ∈ weightSpace P p (2 • P.root i)) :
    ∃ c : K, x = c • superBracket P p (e P p i) (e P p i)
proof:
:= by
  have := mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root P p (n := 1) hx hxi
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 this
  exact ⟨c, by simpa using hc.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_superBracket_e_e
statement:
lemma superBracket_e_superBracket_e_e (i : ι) :
    superBracket P p (e P p i) (superBracket P p (e P p i) (e P p i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hJ := superBracket_jacobi (isHomog_e P p i) (isHomog_e P p i) (isHomog_e P p i)
  have hS := superBracket_swap ((isHomog_e P p i).superBracket (isHomog_e P p i))
    (isHomog_e P p i)
  rw [show p i + p i = 0 by rcases zmod_two_cases (p i) with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> rfl, zero_mul,
    zSign_zero, one_smul] at hS
  rw [show superBracket P p (superBracket P p (e P p i) (e P p i)) (e P p i) =
    -superBracket P p (e P p i) (superBracket P p (e P p i) (e P p i)) by rw [hS, neg_neg]] at hJ
  set X := superBracket P p (e P p i) (superBracket P p (e P p i) (e P p i))
  rcases zmod_two_cases (p i) with h0 | h1
  · rw [h0, mul_zero, zSign_zero] at hJ
    linear_combination (norm := module) hJ
  · rw [h1, mul_one, zSign_one] at hJ
    have h3 : (3 : K) • X = 0 := by linear_combination (norm := module) hJ
    exact (smul_eq_zero.1 h3).resolve_left (by norm_num)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eLie_replicate_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eLie_replicate_eq_zero (i : ι) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    eLie P p i (List.replicate n i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simpa using superBracket_e_superBracket_e_e P p i
  | succ n _ ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, eLie_cons, ih]
    exact (superBracketRight P p (e P p i)).map_zero

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root {i : ι} {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    {x : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxi : x ∈ weightSpace P p (m • P.root i)) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  have := mem_weightSpace_nsmul_root P p hx hxi
  rwa [eLie_replicate_eq_zero P p i (by omega), Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.2 rfl,
    Submodule.mem_bot] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sl2Deg_pos
statement: lemma sl2Deg_pos (i : ι) : 0 < sl2Deg p i
proof: := by unfold sl2Deg; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_coroot_mul_e
statement:
lemma h_coroot_mul_e (i : ι) :
    h P p (P.coroot i) * e P p i = e P p i * h P p (P.coroot i) + (2 : K) • e P p i
proof:
:= by
  rw [h_mul_e, P.root_coroot_self hA]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_coroot_mul_f
statement:
lemma h_coroot_mul_f (i : ι) :
    h P p (P.coroot i) * f P p i = f P p i * h P p (P.coroot i) - (2 : K) • f P p i
proof:
:= by
  rw [h_mul_f, P.root_coroot_self hA]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_coroot_mul_e_sq
statement:
lemma h_coroot_mul_e_sq (i : ι) :
    h P p (P.coroot i) * e P p i ^ 2 =
      e P p i ^ 2 * h P p (P.coroot i) + (4 : K) • e P p i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := h_coroot_mul_e P p hA i
  calc h P p (P.coroot i) * e P p i ^ 2
      = (h P p (P.coroot i) * e P p i) * e P p i := by rw [sq, mul_assoc]
    _ = e P p i * (h P p (P.coroot i) * e P p i) + (2 : K) • (e P p i * e P p i) := by
        rw [h₁, add_mul, mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, h₁]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [h₁, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← sq, add_assoc, ← add_smul]
        norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_coroot_mul_f_sq
statement:
lemma h_coroot_mul_f_sq (i : ι) :
    h P p (P.coroot i) * f P p i ^ 2 =
      f P p i ^ 2 * h P p (P.coroot i) - (4 : K) • f P p i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := h_coroot_mul_f P p hA i
  calc h P p (P.coroot i) * f P p i ^ 2
      = (h P p (P.coroot i) * f P p i) * f P p i := by rw [sq, mul_assoc]
    _ = f P p i * (h P p (P.coroot i) * f P p i) - (2 : K) • (f P p i * f P p i) := by
        rw [h₁, sub_mul, mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, h₁]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [h₁, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← sq, sub_sub, ← add_smul]
        norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mul_f_self_of_odd
statement:
lemma e_mul_f_self_of_odd {i : ι} (hi : p i = 1) :
    e P p i * f P p i = h P p (P.coroot i) - f P p i * e P p i
proof:
:= by
  rw [e_mul_f, superSign_self, ite_eq_left hi, ite_eq_left rfl, neg_one_smul]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_sq_mul_f_of_odd
statement:
lemma e_sq_mul_f_of_odd {i : ι} (hi : p i = 1) :
    e P p i ^ 2 * f P p i = f P p i * e P p i ^ 2 - (2 : K) • e P p i
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ := e_mul_f_self_of_odd P p hi
  calc e P p i ^ 2 * f P p i = e P p i * (e P p i * f P p i) := by rw [sq, mul_assoc]
    _ = e P p i * h P p (P.coroot i) - (e P p i * f P p i) * e P p i := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h₀]
        rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc]
    _ = e P p i * h P p (P.coroot i) - h P p (P.coroot i) * e P p i +
          f P p i * e P p i ^ 2 := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h₀]
        rw [sub_mul, sq, mul_assoc]
        abel
    _ = _ := by
        rw [h_coroot_mul_e P p hA]
        abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_sq_mul_f_sq_of_odd
statement:
lemma e_sq_mul_f_sq_of_odd {i : ι} (hi : p i = 1) :
    e P p i ^ 2 * f P p i ^ 2 = f P p i ^ 2 * e P p i ^ 2 - (2 : K) • h P p (P.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ := e_mul_f_self_of_odd P p hi
  have h₁ := e_sq_mul_f_of_odd P p hA hi
  calc e P p i ^ 2 * f P p i ^ 2 = (e P p i ^ 2 * f P p i) * f P p i := by
        rw [sq (f P p i), mul_assoc]
    _ = f P p i * (e P p i ^ 2 * f P p i) - (2 : K) • (e P p i * f P p i) := by
        rw [h₁, sub_mul, mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, h₁]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [h₁, h₀, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub]
        abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isSl2Triple
statement:
theorem isSl2Triple {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (i : ι) :
    IsSl2Triple (sl2H P p i) (sl2E P p i) (sl2F P p i)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ((sl2Deg p i : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (sl2Deg_pos p i).ne'
  have hH : sl2H P p i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sl2H, Ne, ← map_zero (h P p), (h_injective P p).eq_iff, sl2Coroot, smul_eq_zero, not_or]
    exact ⟨inv_ne_zero hd, P.linearIndependent_coroot.ne_zero i⟩
  by_cases hi : p i = 1
  · have hH' : sl2H P p i = (2 : K)⁻¹ • h P p (P.coroot i) := by
      rw [sl2H, sl2Coroot, sl2Deg, ite_eq_left hi, map_smul]; norm_num
    have hE : sl2E P p i = (2 : K)⁻¹ • e P p i ^ 2 := ite_eq_left hi
    have hF : sl2F P p i = -((2 : K)⁻¹ • f P p i ^ 2) := ite_eq_left hi
    refine ⟨hH, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hH', hE, hF, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket]
      simp only [mul_neg, neg_mul, smul_mul_smul_comm, e_sq_mul_f_sq_of_odd P p hA hi]
      module
    · rw [hH', hE, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket]
      simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm, h_coroot_mul_e_sq P p hA]
      module
    · rw [hH', hF, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket]
      simp only [mul_neg, neg_mul, smul_mul_smul_comm, h_coroot_mul_f_sq P p hA]
      module
  · have hH' : sl2H P p i = h P p (P.coroot i) := by
      rw [sl2H, sl2Coroot, sl2Deg, ite_eq_right hi]; simp
    have hE : sl2E P p i = e P p i := ite_eq_right hi
    have hF : sl2F P p i = f P p i := ite_eq_right hi
    refine ⟨hH, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hH', hE, hF, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, e_mul_f, superSign_self,
        ite_eq_right hi, ite_eq_left rfl, one_smul, add_sub_cancel_left]
    · rw [hH', hE, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, h_coroot_mul_e P p hA, add_sub_cancel_left,
        two_smul, two_smul]
    · rw [hH', hF, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, h_coroot_mul_f P p hA, sub_sub_cancel_left,
        two_smul, two_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.toEnd_pow_apply
statement: lemma toEnd_pow_apply (u : 𝒰) (n : ℕ) (v : V) : (toEnd K 𝒰 V u ^ n) v = u ^ n • v
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, pow_succ', mul_smul]; rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_smul_mem_modWeightSpace
statement:
lemma e_smul_mem_modWeightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ)
    (i : ι) : e P p i • v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ + P.root i)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [← mul_smul, h_mul_e, add_smul, mul_smul, hv a, smul_assoc, smul_comm, LinearMap.add_apply,
    add_smul, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_smul_mem_modWeightSpace
statement:
lemma f_smul_mem_modWeightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ)
    (i : ι) : f P p i • v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ - P.root i)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [← mul_smul, h_mul_f, sub_smul, mul_smul, hv a, smul_assoc, smul_comm, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    sub_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace
statement:
lemma e_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ)
    (i : ι) (n : ℕ) : e P p i ^ n • v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ + n • P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, succ_nsmul, ← add_assoc]
    exact e_smul_mem_modWeightSpace ih i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace
statement:
lemma f_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ)
    (i : ι) (n : ℕ) : f P p i ^ n • v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ - n • P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, succ_nsmul, ← sub_sub]
    exact f_smul_mem_modWeightSpace ih i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sl2E_pow_smul_mem
statement:
lemma sl2E_pow_smul_mem {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ) (i : ι)
    (n : ℕ) : sl2E P p i ^ n • v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ + (sl2Deg p i * n) • P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sl2E sl2Deg
  split_ifs
  · rw [smul_pow, smul_assoc, ← pow_mul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (e_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hv i _)
  · simpa using e_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hv i n

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sl2F_pow_smul_mem
statement:
lemma sl2F_pow_smul_mem {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ) (i : ι)
    (n : ℕ) : sl2F P p i ^ n • v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ - (sl2Deg p i * n) • P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sl2F sl2Deg
  split_ifs
  · rw [← neg_smul, smul_pow, smul_assoc, ← pow_mul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (f_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hv i _)
  · simpa using f_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hv i n

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sl2H_smul
statement:
lemma sl2H_smul {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ) (i : ι) :
    ⁅sl2H P p i, v⁆ = μ (sl2Coroot P p i) • v
proof: := hv _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsIntegrableAt.exists_sl2E
statement:
lemma IsIntegrableAt.exists_sl2E {i : ι} (hV : IsIntegrableAt P p V i) (v : V) :
    ∃ n, (toEnd K 𝒰 V (sl2E P p i) ^ n) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (hV v).1
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [toEnd_pow_apply]
  unfold sl2E
  split_ifs
  · rw [smul_pow, smul_assoc, ← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, sq, mul_smul, hn, smul_zero,
      smul_zero]
  · exact hn

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsIntegrableAt.exists_sl2F
statement:
lemma IsIntegrableAt.exists_sl2F {i : ι} (hV : IsIntegrableAt P p V i) (v : V) :
    ∃ n, (toEnd K 𝒰 V (sl2F P p i) ^ n) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (hV v).2
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [toEnd_pow_apply]
  unfold sl2F
  split_ifs
  · rw [← neg_smul, smul_pow, smul_assoc, ← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, sq, mul_smul, hn,
      smul_zero, smul_zero]
  · exact hn

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsIntegrable.exists_sl2E
statement:
lemma IsIntegrable.exists_sl2E (hV : IsIntegrable P p V) (i : ι) (v : V) :
    ∃ n, (toEnd K 𝒰 V (sl2E P p i) ^ n) v = 0
proof:
:=
  (hV i).exists_sl2E v

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsIntegrable.exists_sl2F
statement:
lemma IsIntegrable.exists_sl2F (hV : IsIntegrable P p V) (i : ι) (v : V) :
    ∃ n, (toEnd K 𝒰 V (sl2F P p i) ^ n) v = 0
proof:
:=
  (hV i).exists_sl2F v

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot_of_isIntegrableAt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hμ
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hV.exists_sl2E v
  exact (isSl2Triple P p (hA := hA) i).exists_int_of_lie_h_eq_smul hV.exists_sl2F hk
    (sl2H_smul hv i) hv0

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot'
statement:
theorem exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot' (hV : IsIntegrable P p V) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : modWeightSpace P p V μ ≠ ⊥) (i : ι) : ∃ z : ℤ, μ (sl2Coroot P p i) = z
proof:
:=
  exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot_of_isIntegrableAt hA (hV i) hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.apply_coroot_eq
statement:
lemma apply_coroot_eq (μ : Dual K H) (i : ι) :
    μ (P.coroot i) = (sl2Deg p i : K) * μ (sl2Coroot P p i)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ((sl2Deg p i : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (sl2Deg_pos p i).ne'
  rw [sl2Coroot, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hd]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot (hV : IsIntegrable P p V) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : modWeightSpace P p V μ ≠ ⊥) (i : ι) : ∃ z : ℤ, μ (P.coroot i) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot' hA hV hμ i
  exact ⟨sl2Deg p i * z, by rw [apply_coroot_eq, hz]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_int_mul_two_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot' hA hV hμ i
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  rw [apply_coroot_eq, hz, sl2Deg, ite_eq_left hi]
  norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rank_modWeightSpace_le_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt
statement:
theorem rank_modWeightSpace_le_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt {i : ι}
    (hV : IsIntegrableAt P p V i) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) ≤
      Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V (P.reflection hA i μ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊥
  · rw [hμ, rank_bot]; exact zero_le
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_int_of_modWeightSpace_ne_bot_of_isIntegrableAt hA hV hμ
  have t := isSl2Triple P p (hA := hA) i
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg z
  · 
    have hr : P.reflection hA i μ = μ - (sl2Deg p i * n) • P.root i := by
      rw [reflection_apply, apply_coroot_eq, hz, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K]
      push_cast; rfl
    let φ : modWeightSpace P p V μ →ₗ[K] modWeightSpace P p V (P.reflection hA i μ) :=
      (toEnd K 𝒰 V (sl2F P p i) ^ n).restrict fun v hv ↦ by
        rw [hr, toEnd_pow_apply]; exact sl2F_pow_smul_mem hv i n
    refine LinearMap.rank_le_of_injective φ (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp ?_)
    refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr fun v hv ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hV.exists_sl2E v
    refine t.eq_zero_of_pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero hk ?_ (congr_arg Subtype.val hv)
    rw [sl2H_smul v.2 i, hz, Int.cast_natCast]
  · 
    have hr : P.reflection hA i μ = μ + (sl2Deg p i * n) • P.root i := by
      rw [reflection_apply, apply_coroot_eq, hz, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K]
      push_cast
      module
    let φ : modWeightSpace P p V μ →ₗ[K] modWeightSpace P p V (P.reflection hA i μ) :=
      (toEnd K 𝒰 V (sl2E P p i) ^ n).restrict fun v hv ↦ by
        rw [hr, toEnd_pow_apply]; exact sl2E_pow_smul_mem hv i n
    refine LinearMap.rank_le_of_injective φ (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp ?_)
    refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr fun v hv ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hV.exists_sl2F v
    refine t.symm.eq_zero_of_pow_toEnd_f_eq_zero hk ?_ (congr_arg Subtype.val hv)
    rw [neg_lie, sl2H_smul v.2 i, hz, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, neg_smul, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rank_modWeightSpace_le_reflection
statement:
theorem rank_modWeightSpace_le_reflection (hV : IsIntegrable P p V) (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) ≤
      Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V (P.reflection hA i μ))
proof:
:=
  rank_modWeightSpace_le_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt hA (hV i) μ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rank_modWeightSpace_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt
statement:
theorem rank_modWeightSpace_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt {i : ι}
    (hV : IsIntegrableAt P p V i) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V (P.reflection hA i μ)) =
      Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (rank_modWeightSpace_le_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt hA hV μ)
  have := rank_modWeightSpace_le_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt hA hV (P.reflection hA i μ)
  rwa [reflection_reflection] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rank_modWeightSpace_reflection
statement:
theorem rank_modWeightSpace_reflection (hV : IsIntegrable P p V) (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V (P.reflection hA i μ)) =
      Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ)
proof:
:=
  rank_modWeightSpace_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt hA (hV i) μ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rank_modWeightSpace_weylGroup
proof:
:= by
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA
    (p := fun w ↦ ∀ μ, Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V (w μ)) =
      Module.rank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ))
    (fun μ ↦ rfl) (fun i w ih μ ↦ ?_) hw μ
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, rank_modWeightSpace_reflection hA hV, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.modWeightSpace_weylGroup_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem modWeightSpace_weylGroup_eq_bot_iff (hV : IsIntegrable P p V)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (μ : Dual K H) :
    modWeightSpace P p V (w μ) = ⊥ ↔ modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.rank_eq_zero, ← Submodule.rank_eq_zero, rank_modWeightSpace_weylGroup hA hV hw]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.induction
statement:
theorem induction {C : P.SuperEnveloping p → Prop} (algebraMap : ∀ c : K, C (algebraMap K _ c))
    (e : ∀ i, C (e P p i)) (f : ∀ i, C (f P p i)) (h : ∀ a, C (h P p a))
    (add : ∀ x y, C x → C y → C (x + y)) (mul : ∀ x y, C x → C y → C (x * y))
    (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) : C u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P p u
  induction w using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simpa using algebraMap c
  | grade1 g =>
    cases g with
    | e i => exact e i
    | f i => exact f i
    | h a => exact h a
  | add x y hx hy => simpa using add _ _ hx hy
  | mul x y hx hy => simpa using mul _ _ hx hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_mem_vermaIdeal
statement: lemma e_mem_vermaIdeal (i : ι) : e P p i ∈ vermaIdeal P p Λ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_sub_mem_vermaIdeal
statement: lemma h_sub_mem_vermaIdeal (a : H) : h P p a - algebraMap K _ (Λ a) ∈ vermaIdeal P p Λ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨a, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_mem_vermaIdeal
statement:
lemma mul_mem_vermaIdeal (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) {x : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hx : x ∈ vermaIdeal P p Λ) : u * x ∈ vermaIdeal P p Λ
proof:
:=
  (vermaIdeal P p Λ).smul_mem u hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_fSpan_iff
statement:
lemma mem_fSpan_iff {u : P.SuperEnveloping p} :
    u ∈ fSpan P p Λ ↔ ∃ x, u - fAlg P p x ∈ vermaIdeal P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [fSpan, Submodule.mem_sup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, by simpa using hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, _, hx, add_sub_cancel _ _⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_mem_fSpan
statement: lemma fAlg_mem_fSpan (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) : fAlg P p x ∈ fSpan P p Λ
proof:
:=
  (mem_fSpan_iff P p Λ).2 ⟨x, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_fSpan_of_mem
statement:
lemma mem_fSpan_of_mem {u : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hu : u ∈ vermaIdeal P p Λ) :
    u ∈ fSpan P p Λ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_sup_right hu

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_mul_mem_fSpan
statement:
lemma f_mul_mem_fSpan (i : ι) {u : P.SuperEnveloping p} (hu : u ∈ fSpan P p Λ) :
    f P p i * u ∈ fSpan P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (mem_fSpan_iff P p Λ).1 hu
  refine (mem_fSpan_iff P p Λ).2 ⟨FreeAlgebra.ι K i * x, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, fAlg_ι, ← mul_sub]
  exact mul_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ _ hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_mem_fSpan
statement: lemma h_mem_fSpan (a : H) : h P p a ∈ fSpan P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_fSpan_iff P p Λ).2 ⟨algebraMap K _ (Λ a), ?_⟩
  rw [AlgHom.commutes]
  exact h_sub_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gen_mul_fAlg_word_mem
statement:
lemma gen_mul_fAlg_word_mem (w : List ι) :
    (∀ i, e P p i * fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) ∈ fSpan P p Λ) ∧
      ∀ a, h P p a * fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) ∈ fSpan P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    simp only [FreeAlgebra.word_nil, map_one, mul_one]
    exact ⟨fun i ↦ mem_fSpan_of_mem P p Λ (e_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ i), h_mem_fSpan P p Λ⟩
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [FreeAlgebra.word_cons, map_mul, fAlg_ι, ← mul_assoc]
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ ?_, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [e_mul_f, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (f_mul_mem_fSpan P p Λ j (ih.1 i))) ?_
      split_ifs
      · exact ih.2 _
      · simp
    · rw [h_mul_f, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      refine sub_mem (f_mul_mem_fSpan P p Λ j (ih.2 a)) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_)
      exact f_mul_mem_fSpan P p Λ j (fAlg_mem_fSpan P p Λ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.gen_mul_fAlg_mem
statement:
lemma gen_mul_fAlg_mem (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    (∀ i, e P p i * fAlg P p x ∈ fSpan P p Λ) ∧ ∀ a, h P p a * fAlg P p x ∈ fSpan P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (FreeAlgebra.basisFreeMonoid K ι)) := by
    rw [Basis.span_eq]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    have := gen_mul_fAlg_word_mem P p Λ (FreeMonoid.toList w)
    simpa [FreeAlgebra.word] using this
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    simp only [map_add, mul_add]
    exact ⟨fun i ↦ add_mem (hy.1 i) (hz.1 i), fun a ↦ add_mem (hy.2 a) (hz.2 a)⟩
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    simp only [map_smul, mul_smul_comm]
    exact ⟨fun i ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ c (hy.1 i), fun a ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ c (hy.2 a)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_mem_fSpan
statement:
lemma mul_mem_fSpan (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) {v : P.SuperEnveloping p}
    (hv : v ∈ fSpan P p Λ) : u * v ∈ fSpan P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction generalizing v with
  | algebraMap c => rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul]; exact
      Submodule.smul_mem _ c hv
  | e i =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (mem_fSpan_iff P p Λ).1 hv
    have : e P p i * v = e P p i * fAlg P p x + e P p i * (v - fAlg P p x) := by
      rw [← mul_add, add_sub_cancel]
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem ((gen_mul_fAlg_mem P p Λ x).1 i)
      (mem_fSpan_of_mem P p Λ (mul_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ _ hx))
  | f i => exact f_mul_mem_fSpan P p Λ i hv
  | h a =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (mem_fSpan_iff P p Λ).1 hv
    have : h P p a * v = h P p a * fAlg P p x + h P p a * (v - fAlg P p x) := by
      rw [← mul_add, add_sub_cancel]
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem ((gen_mul_fAlg_mem P p Λ x).2 a)
      (mem_fSpan_of_mem P p Λ (mul_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ _ hx))
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx hv) (hy hv)
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx (hy hv)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_sub_fAlg_mem_vermaIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_sub_fAlg_mem_vermaIdeal (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    ∃ x, u - fAlg P p x ∈ vermaIdeal P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_fSpan_iff, ← mul_one u]
  exact mul_mem_fSpan P p Λ u (by simpa using fAlg_mem_fSpan P p Λ 1)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.mk_eq_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma mk_eq_smul_hwv (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk u : Verma P p Λ) = u • hwv P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.e_smul_hwv
statement: lemma e_smul_hwv (i : ι) : e P p i • hwv P p Λ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact e_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.h_smul_hwv
statement: lemma h_smul_hwv (a : H) : h P p a • hwv P p Λ = Λ a • hwv P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_smul_hwv, hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← sub_eq_zero,
    ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
  exact h_sub_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ a

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.span_hwv
statement: lemma span_hwv : Submodule.span (P.SuperEnveloping p) {hwv P p Λ} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun v _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  rw [mk_eq_smul_hwv]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ u (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.vermaIdeal_le_ker
statement:
lemma vermaIdeal_le_ker (he : ∀ i, e P p i • m = 0)
    (hh : ∀ a, h P p a • m = algebraMap K (P.SuperEnveloping p) (Λ a) • m) :
    vermaIdeal P p Λ ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton _ M m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaIdeal, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
  · simpa using he i
  · simp [sub_smul, hh a]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (he hh) (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    lift P p Λ m he hh (Submodule.Quotient.mk u) = u • m
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.lift_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_hwv (he hh) : lift P p Λ m he hh (hwv P p Λ) = m
proof:
:= by
  simp [hwv]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.lift_unique
statement:
lemma lift_unique (he hh) (φ : Verma P p Λ →ₗ[P.SuperEnveloping p] M) (hφ : φ (hwv P p Λ) = m) :
    φ = lift P p Λ m he hh
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  rw [mk_eq_smul_hwv, map_smul, map_smul, hφ, lift_hwv]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.toTensorAux_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma toTensorAux_apply (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    toTensorAux P p Λ u = tensorRep P p Λ u 1
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.vermaIdeal_le_ker_toTensorAux
statement:
lemma vermaIdeal_le_ker_toTensorAux :
    (vermaIdeal P p Λ).restrictScalars K ≤ LinearMap.ker (toTensorAux P p Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem] at hu
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, rfl⟩
    · simpa using tensorRep_e_one P p Λ i
    · simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul u x _ hx =>
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, toTensorAux_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul,
      Module.End.mul_apply] at hx ⊢
    rw [hx, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.toTensor_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma toTensor_mk (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    toTensor P p Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk u) = tensorRep P p Λ u 1
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.toTensor_mk_fAlg
statement:
lemma toTensor_mk_fAlg (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    toTensor P p Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (fAlg P p x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [toTensor_mk, tensorRep_fAlg_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.toTensorEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma toTensorEquiv_mk (u : P.SuperEnveloping p) :
    toTensorEquiv P p Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk u) = tensorRep P p Λ u 1
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.toTensorEquiv_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma toTensorEquiv_hwv : toTensorEquiv P p Λ (hwv P p Λ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hwv]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.toTensorEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma toTensorEquiv_symm_apply (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    (toTensorEquiv P p Λ).symm x = fAlg P p x • hwv P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, ← mk_eq_smul_hwv, toTensorEquiv_mk, tensorRep_fAlg_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.toEnd_f_injective
statement:
theorem toEnd_f_injective (Λ : Dual K H) (j : ι) :
    Function.Injective (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P j))
proof:
:= by
  have hf : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K (⟨f P j, f_mem_nNeg P j⟩ : nNeg P) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    f_ne_zero P j (congrArg Subtype.val
      (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι_injective (R := K) (L := nNeg P)
        (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)))
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective m
  have : toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) (f P j) (equivEnvNNeg P Λ u) =
      equivEnvNNeg P Λ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K ⟨f P j, f_mem_nNeg P j⟩ * u) := by
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_mul, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, toEnd_apply_apply, lie_eq_smul]
    rfl
  rw [this, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hm
  rw [(mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_left hf, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_sub_rootOf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_sub_rootOf_eq_bot (Λ : Dual K H) {γ : ι → ℤ} (hγ : ¬ 0 ≤ γ) :
    weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf γ) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  weightSpace_eq_bot P Λ fun _ hk h ↦ hγ (P.rootOf_injective (sub_right_injective h) ▸ hk)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.weightSpace_sub_rootOf_ne_bot
statement:
theorem weightSpace_sub_rootOf_ne_bot (Λ : Dual K H) {γ : ι → ℤ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) :
    weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf γ) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, height γ = n := ⟨(height γ).toNat,
    (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ height γ from Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hγ i)).symm⟩
  induction n generalizing γ with
  | zero =>
    have : γ = 0 := by
      have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hγ i).mp (by simpa [height] using hn)
      exact funext fun i ↦ this i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    subst this
    rw [map_zero, sub_zero]
    exact fun h ↦ hwv_ne_zero P Λ ((Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mp h _ (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ))
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 0 < γ j := by
      by_contra! h
      have : height γ = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ le_antisymm (h i) (hγ i)
      omega
    set γ' := γ - Pi.single j 1
    have hγ' : 0 ≤ γ' := fun i ↦ by
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; simp only [γ', Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.zero_apply]; omega
      · simpa [γ', hij] using hγ i
    have hn' : height γ' = n := by
      have : height γ' = height γ - 1 := by
        simp [height, γ', Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      omega
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (ih hγ' hn')
    refine fun hbot ↦ hv0 (toEnd_f_injective P Λ j ?_)
    rw [map_zero, ← Submodule.mem_bot K, ← hbot]
    have := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) (f_mem_rootSpace P j) hv
    convert this using 2
    · simp only [γ', map_sub, rootOf_single]
      abel
    · rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_primitiveVectors_of_inf_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_primitiveVectors_of_inf_ne_bot {Λ : Dual K H} {η : ι → ℤ}
    (hη : (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf η) ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ β : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ β ∧ β ≠ 0 ∧ β ≤ η ∧
      ∃ v ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (Λ - P.rootOf β), v ≠ 0 ∧
        v ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Q : (ι → ℤ) → Prop := fun β ↦ 0 ≤ β ∧ β ≤ η ∧
    (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf β) ≠ ⊥
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η := by
    by_contra h
    exact hη (by rw [weightSpace_sub_rootOf_eq_bot P Λ h, inf_bot_eq])
  obtain ⟨β, ⟨hβ0, hβη, hβ⟩, hmin⟩ :=
    exists_minimalFor_of_wellFoundedLT Q (fun β ↦ (height β).toNat) ⟨η, hη0, le_rfl, hη⟩
  obtain ⟨v, ⟨hvM, hv⟩, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hβ
  have hβne : β ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, sub_zero, inf_weightSpace_self_eq_bot P Λ (hwv_notMem_maxSubmodule P Λ)] at hβ
    exact hβ rfl
  refine ⟨β, hβ0, hβne, hβη, v, mem_primitiveVectors.mpr ⟨hv, fun i ↦ ?_⟩, hv0, hvM⟩
  set β' := β - Pi.single i 1
  have hw : ⁅e P i, v⁆ ∈ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf β') := by
    have he : e P i ∈ rootSpace P (P.root i) := fun a ↦ lie_h_e P a i
    have := lie_mem_weightSpaceOfMap (h P) he hv
    convert this using 2
    simp only [β', map_sub, rootOf_single]
    abel
  have hwM : ⁅e P i, v⁆ ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ := (maxSubmodule P Λ).lie_mem hvM
  by_cases hβ' : 0 ≤ β'
  · by_contra hne
    have hle : β' ≤ β := sub_le_self β (Pi.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one)
    have hQ : Q β' := ⟨hβ', hle.trans hβη, fun hbot ↦ hne (by
      rw [← Submodule.mem_bot K, ← hbot]; exact ⟨hwM, hw⟩)⟩
    have hh : height β' = height β - 1 := by simp [β', height, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have := hmin hQ (by simp only; omega)
    simp only at this
    have : 0 ≤ height β' := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hβ' j
    omega
  · rw [weightSpace_sub_rootOf_eq_bot P Λ hβ'] at hw
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot K).mp hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_mem_maxSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P μ m
  rw [mk_eq_smul, map_smul_eq_smul]
  exact smul_mem P Λ _ u hφ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.injective_homEquiv_symm
proof:
:= by
  refine injective_of_ne_zero P fun h ↦ hv0 ?_
  have := congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv P (VermaModule P Λ) μ).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  rw [homEquiv_apply, h, _root_.zero_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_injective_of_inf_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_injective_of_inf_ne_bot {Λ : Dual K H} {η : ι → ℤ}
    (hη : (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf η) ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ β : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ β ∧ β ≠ 0 ∧ β ≤ η ∧
      ∃ φ : VermaModule P (Λ - P.rootOf β) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ,
        Function.Injective φ ∧ ∀ m, φ m ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβne, hβη, v, hv, hv0, hvM⟩ := exists_primitiveVectors_of_inf_ne_bot P hη
  refine ⟨β, hβ0, hβne, hβη, _, injective_homEquiv_symm P hv hv0,
    map_mem_maxSubmodule P _ ?_⟩
  rw [← homEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hvM

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_maxSubmodule_of_mem_primitiveVectors
statement:
theorem mem_maxSubmodule_of_mem_primitiveVectors {Λ μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ Λ)
    {v : VermaModule P Λ} (hv : v ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) μ) :
    v ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hvw, he⟩ := mem_primitiveVectors.mp hv
  have h := eq_smul_hwCoord P Λ (contravariantForm P Λ v) fun i m ↦ by
    rw [contravariantForm_lie_right, transpose_f, he, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  rw [contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_ne P Λ hvw (hwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ) hμ, zero_smul] at h
  exact (mem_maxSubmodule_iff P Λ v).mpr fun w ↦ by rw [h, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_eq_iff
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_eq_iff (Λ b : Dual K H) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ = P.dualBilinForm S (Λ - b + 2 • P.rho) (Λ - b) ↔
      2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) b = P.dualBilinForm S b b
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq b Λ
  simp only [two_nsmul, map_add, map_sub, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply] at hs ⊢
  constructor <;> intro h
  · linear_combination h - hs
  · linear_combination h + hs

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.two_mul_dualBilinForm_eq_of_mem_primitiveVectors
statement:
theorem two_mul_dualBilinForm_eq_of_mem_primitiveVectors {Λ : Dual K H} {β : ι → ℤ}
    {v : VermaModule P Λ} (hv : v ∈ primitiveVectors P (VermaModule P Λ) (Λ - P.rootOf β))
    (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (P.rootOf β) =
      P.dualBilinForm S (P.rootOf β) (P.rootOf β)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hvw, he⟩ := mem_primitiveVectors.mp hv
  have := ((isStandardForm_invForm P S).mem_cone_and_eq_of_lie_e_eq_zero hA LieModuleHom.id
    Function.surjective_id hvw hv0 he).2
  exact (dualBilinForm_add_two_rho_eq_iff P S Λ _).mp this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_of_maxSubmodule_inf_weightSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_of_maxSubmodule_inf_weightSpace_ne_bot {Λ : Dual K H} {η : ι → ℤ}
    (hη : (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf η) ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ β : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ β ∧ β ≠ 0 ∧ β ≤ η ∧
      2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (P.rootOf β) =
        P.dualBilinForm S (P.rootOf β) (P.rootOf β) ∧
      ∃ φ : VermaModule P (Λ - P.rootOf β) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ VermaModule P Λ,
        Function.Injective φ ∧ ∀ m, φ m ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβne, hβη, v, hv, hv0, hvM⟩ := exists_primitiveVectors_of_inf_ne_bot P hη
  refine ⟨β, hβ0, hβne, hβη, two_mul_dualBilinForm_eq_of_mem_primitiveVectors P S hA hv hv0, _,
    injective_homEquiv_symm P hv hv0, map_mem_maxSubmodule P _ ?_⟩
  rw [← homEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hvM

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_ne_zero_of_forall
statement:
theorem det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_ne_zero_of_forall {Λ : Dual K H} {η : ι → ℤ}
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (b : Basis n K (weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf η)))
    (h : ∀ β : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ β → β ≠ 0 → β ≤ η →
      2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (P.rootOf β) ≠
        P.dualBilinForm S (P.rootOf β) (P.rootOf β)) :
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix b (weightSpaceForm P Λ _)).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_ne_zero_iff]
  by_contra hη
  obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβne, hβη, hβ, -⟩ := exists_of_maxSubmodule_inf_weightSpace_ne_bot P S hA hη
  exact h β hβ0 hβne hβη hβ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.inf_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_coroot
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφv⟩ := exists_injective_reflection P hA hn0 hn
  have hμ : P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho = Λ - P.rootOf (n • Pi.single i 1) := by
    rw [P.reflection_add_rho_sub_rho hA hn, map_nsmul, rootOf_single]
  have hne : (n • Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by
    have := congrFun h i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    omega
  have hprim := toEnd_f_pow_hwv_mem_primitiveVectors P hA hn0 hn
  have hM : ∀ m, φ m ∈ maxSubmodule P Λ := map_mem_maxSubmodule P φ (hφv ▸
    mem_maxSubmodule_of_mem_primitiveVectors P
      (fun h ↦ P.rootOf_ne_zero hne (sub_eq_self.mp (hμ ▸ h))) hprim)
  set γ := η - n • Pi.single i 1
  have hγ : 0 ≤ γ := sub_nonneg.mpr hη
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot
    (weightSpace_sub_rootOf_ne_bot P (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) hγ)
  intro hbot
  refine hw0 (hφ ?_)
  rw [map_zero, ← Submodule.mem_bot K, ← hbot]
  refine ⟨hM w, ?_⟩
  have hwt : Λ - P.rootOf η = (P.reflection hA i (Λ + P.rho) - P.rho) - P.rootOf γ := by
    rw [hμ, sub_sub, ← map_add]
    simp [γ]
  rw [hwt]
  exact map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P φ hw

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.two_mul_dualBilinForm_root_eq_iff
statement:
lemma two_mul_dualBilinForm_root_eq_iff (μ : Dual K H) (i : ι) (c : K) :
    2 * P.dualBilinForm S μ (P.root i) = c * P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i) ↔
      μ (P.coroot i) = c
proof:
:= by
  have hε : (S.ε i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i
  rw [dualBilinForm_root_right, dualBilinForm_root_self S hA]
  push_cast
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have h2 : (2 / (S.ε i : K)) * (μ (P.coroot i) - c) = 0 := by linear_combination h
    simpa [sub_eq_zero, hε] using h2
  · linear_combination (2 / (S.ε i : K)) * h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.inf_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_two_mul_dualBilinForm
statement:
theorem inf_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_two_mul_dualBilinForm {Λ : Dual K H} {η : ι → ℤ} {i : ι}
    {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : 2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (P.root i) =
      n * P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i))
    (hη : n • Pi.single i 1 ≤ η) :
    (maxSubmodule P Λ).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf η) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  inf_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_coroot P hA hn0
    ((two_mul_dualBilinForm_root_eq_iff P hA S _ i n).mp hn) hη

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_eq_zero_of_two_mul_dualBilinForm
statement:
theorem det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_eq_zero_of_two_mul_dualBilinForm {Λ : Dual K H}
    {η : ι → ℤ} {i : ι} {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : 2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (P.root i) =
      n * P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i))
    (hη : n • Pi.single i 1 ≤ η) {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (b : Basis m K (weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf η))) :
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix b (weightSpaceForm P Λ _)).det = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact (det_toMatrix_weightSpaceForm_ne_zero_iff P Λ _ b).mp h
    |> (inf_weightSpace_ne_bot_of_two_mul_dualBilinForm P hA S hn0 hn hη ·)
