        if Λ₀ (a k) + c k = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [linePoly_affPoly]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [h, map_zero, add_zero, ← monomial_one_one_eq_X, C_mul_monomial, mul_one]
      exact ⟨(monomial_eq_zero_iff _ _).not.mpr (hδ k hk h),
        natTrailingDegree_monomial (hδ k hk h)⟩
    · have hc0 : (C (δ (a k)) * X + C (Λ₀ (a k) + c k)).coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa using h
      exact ⟨fun h0 ↦ hc0 (by rw [h0, coeff_zero]),
        natTrailingDegree_eq_zero.mpr (.inr hc0)⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_prod, linePoly_C, natTrailingDegree_mul (C_ne_zero.mpr hc₀)
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun k hk ↦ by rw [map_pow]; exact pow_ne_zero _ (hfac k hk).1),
    natTrailingDegree_C, zero_add, natTrailingDegree_finsetProd _ _
      fun k hk ↦ by rw [map_pow]; exact pow_ne_zero _ (hfac k hk).1, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ ?_
  rw [map_pow, natTrailingDegree_pow_eq_mul, (hfac k hk).2]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Module.Dual.affPoly_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma affPoly_zero (a : H) : affPoly K H a 0 = linPoly K H a
proof:
:= by
  simp [affPoly]

name: Module.Dual.homogeneousComponent_one_affPoly
statement:
lemma homogeneousComponent_one_affPoly (a : H) (c : K) :
    MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent 1 (affPoly K H a c) = linPoly K H a
proof:
:= by
  rw [affPoly, map_add, MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_of_mem (isHomogeneous_linPoly a),
    MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero _ _ (by simp)]
  simp

name: Module.Dual.hasTop_C_mul_prod_affPoly_pow
statement:
theorem hasTop_C_mul_prod_affPoly_pow {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (a : κ → H) (c : κ → K)
    (e : κ → ℕ) (c₀ : K) :
    HasTop (∑ k ∈ s, e k) (MvPolynomial.C c₀ * ∏ k ∈ s, linPoly K H (a k) ^ e k)
      (evalPoly K H (MvPolynomial.C c₀ * ∏ k ∈ s, affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ e k))
proof:
:= by
  have hpow (k : κ) : (affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ e k).totalDegree ≤ e k :=
    (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_pow _ _).trans
      (by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left (e k) (totalDegree_affPoly_le (a k) (c k)))
  have hprod : (∏ k ∈ s, affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ e k).totalDegree ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, e k :=
    (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetProd _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ ↦ hpow k)
  refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · refine (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans ?_
    rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C, zero_add]
    exact hprod
  · rw [MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_C_mul,
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_prod_of_totalDegree_le s _ e fun k _ ↦ hpow k]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    have := MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_prod_of_totalDegree_le (Finset.range (e k))
      (fun _ ↦ affPoly K H (a k) (c k)) (fun _ ↦ 1)
      fun _ _ ↦ totalDegree_affPoly_le (a k) (c k)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finset.prod_const,
      homogeneousComponent_one_affPoly] at this
    exact this

name: Module.Dual.affProportional_zero_iff
statement:
lemma affProportional_zero_iff (a a₀ : H) :
    AffProportional a (0 : K) a₀ 0 ↔ ∃ u : K, a = u • a₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [AffProportional]

name: Module.Dual.sum_filter_eq_of_C_mul_prod_eq
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, hΛ₀, hgen⟩ := exists_forall_evalPoly_ne_zero_of_hyperplane ha₀ b₀
    ((s.filter fun k ↦ ¬ AffProportional (a k) (c k) a₀ b₀).disjSum
      (s'.filter fun k ↦ ¬ AffProportional (a' k) (c' k) a₀ b₀))
    (Sum.elim (fun k ↦ affPoly K H (a k) (c k)) fun k ↦ affPoly K H (a' k) (c' k)) (by
      rintro (k | k) hk
      · rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_filter] at hk
        exact exists_eval_ne_zero_of_not_dvd ha₀ b₀
          fun hd ↦ hk.2 (affProportional_of_affPoly_dvd ha₀ (ha k hk.1) hd)
      · rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_filter] at hk
        exact exists_eval_ne_zero_of_not_dvd ha₀ b₀
          fun hd ↦ hk.2 (affProportional_of_affPoly_dvd ha₀ (ha' k hk.1) hd))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := exists_dual_apply_ne_zero (K := K) ha₀
  have hiff {a₁ : H} {c₁ : K} (ha₁ : a₁ ≠ 0)
      (hne : ¬ AffProportional a₁ c₁ a₀ b₀ → Λ₀ a₁ + c₁ ≠ 0) :
      (Λ₀ a₁ + c₁ = 0 ↔ AffProportional a₁ c₁ a₀ b₀) ∧
        (Λ₀ a₁ + c₁ = 0 → δ a₁ ≠ 0) := by
    refine ⟨⟨fun h0 ↦ by_contra fun hn ↦ hne hn h0, fun hp ↦ hp.evalPoly_eq_zero hΛ₀⟩,
      fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl, -⟩ := (by_contra fun hn ↦ hne hn h0 : AffProportional a₁ c₁ a₀ b₀).ne_zero
      ha₁
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_ne_zero hu hδ
  have hs (k : κ) (hk : k ∈ s) := hiff (ha k hk) fun hn ↦ by
    simpa using hgen (.inl k) (Finset.inl_mem_disjSum.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, hn⟩))
  have hs' (k : κ') (hk : k ∈ s') := hiff (ha' k hk) fun hn ↦ by
    simpa using hgen (.inr k) (Finset.inr_mem_disjSum.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, hn⟩))
  have := congrArg (fun F ↦ (linePoly K H Λ₀ δ F).natTrailingDegree) h
  rw [natTrailingDegree_linePoly_prod s a c e hc₀ fun k hk ↦ (hs k hk).2,
    natTrailingDegree_linePoly_prod s' a' c' e' hc₀' fun k hk ↦ (hs' k hk).2] at this
  rwa [Finset.filter_congr fun k hk ↦ (hs k hk).1,
    Finset.filter_congr fun k hk ↦ (hs' k hk).1] at this

name: Module.Dual.exists_prod_pow_eq_C_mul_prod_pow
statement:
theorem exists_prod_pow_eq_C_mul_prod_pow {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) {a : κ → H} (c : κ → K)
    (ha : ∀ k ∈ s, a k ≠ 0) (e f : κ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ k₀ ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ s with AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₀) (c k₀), e k =
      ∑ k ∈ s with AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₀) (c k₀), f k) :
    ∃ u : K, u ≠ 0 ∧ ∏ k ∈ s, affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ e k =
      MvPolynomial.C u * ∏ k ∈ s, affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ f k
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : ∑ k ∈ s, e k generalizing e f with
  | zero =>
    have he : ∀ k ∈ s, e k = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp hn
    have hf : ∀ k ∈ s, f k = 0 := fun k₀ hk₀ ↦ by
      have := h k₀ hk₀
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk ↦ he k (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).1] at this
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp this.symm k₀
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk₀, AffProportional.refl _ _⟩)
    refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
    rw [map_one, one_mul, Finset.prod_eq_one fun k hk ↦ by rw [he k hk, pow_zero],
      Finset.prod_eq_one fun k hk ↦ by rw [hf k hk, pow_zero]]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, he₀⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero (hn.trans_ne n.succ_ne_zero)
    have hpos : ∑ k ∈ s with AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₀) (c k₀), f k ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← h k₀ hk₀]
      exact fun h0 ↦ he₀ (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp h0 k₀
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk₀, AffProportional.refl _ _⟩))
    obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁', hf₁⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hpos
    obtain ⟨hk₁, hprop⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₁'
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hva, hvc⟩ := hprop.ne_zero (ha k₁ hk₁)
    have hsum_mem {g : κ → ℕ} {k₂ : κ} (hg : g k₂ ≠ 0) {t : Finset κ} (ht : k₂ ∈ t) :
        ∑ k ∈ t, Function.update g k₂ (g k₂ - 1) k + 1 = ∑ k ∈ t, g k := by
      rw [Finset.sum_update_of_mem ht, ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ ht,
        Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
      omega
    have hsum_not {g : κ → ℕ} {k₂ : κ} {t : Finset κ} (ht : k₂ ∉ t) :
        ∑ k ∈ t, Function.update g k₂ (g k₂ - 1) k = ∑ k ∈ t, g k :=
      Finset.sum_update_of_notMem ht _ _
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hprod⟩ := ih (Function.update e k₀ (e k₀ - 1))
      (Function.update f k₁ (f k₁ - 1)) (fun k₂ hk₂ ↦ by
        have hiff : k₀ ∈ s.filter (fun k ↦ AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₂) (c k₂)) ↔
            k₁ ∈ s.filter (fun k ↦ AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₂) (c k₂)) := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hk₀, hk₁, true_and]
          exact ⟨hprop.trans, (hprop.symm (ha k₁ hk₁)).trans⟩
        have := h k₂ hk₂
        by_cases h0 : k₀ ∈ s.filter (fun k ↦ AffProportional (a k) (c k) (a k₂) (c k₂))
        · have h1 := hsum_mem he₀ h0
          have h2 := hsum_mem hf₁ (hiff.mp h0)
          omega
        · rw [hsum_not h0, hsum_not (hiff.not.mp h0)]
          exact this) (by
        have := hsum_mem he₀ hk₀
        omega)
    have hsplit {g : κ → ℕ} {k₂ : κ} (hk₂ : k₂ ∈ s) (hg : g k₂ ≠ 0) :
        ∏ k ∈ s, affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ g k = affPoly K H (a k₂) (c k₂) *
          ∏ k ∈ s, affPoly K H (a k) (c k) ^ Function.update g k₂ (g k₂ - 1) k := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ hk₂, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ hk₂,
        Function.update_self, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel
          (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hg)]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hk)]
    refine ⟨u * v⁻¹, mul_ne_zero hu (inv_ne_zero hv), ?_⟩
    have hC : MvPolynomial.C (u * v⁻¹) * MvPolynomial.C v = (MvPolynomial.C u :
        MvPolynomial (PolyIdx K H) K) := by
      rw [← map_mul, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv, mul_one]
    rw [hsplit hk₀ he₀, hsplit hk₁ hf₁, hprod, AffProportional.affPoly_eq hva hvc,
      ← mul_assoc (MvPolynomial.C (u * v⁻¹)), ← mul_assoc (MvPolynomial.C (u * v⁻¹)), hC]
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finsum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace
statement:
theorem finsum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace [IsAlgClosed K] (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H) (η : ι → ℤ)
    (hδ : ∀ x : NegRootIndex P, ∀ n : ℕ, (n + 1) • x.coeff ≤ η →
      2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ₀ + P.rho) x.root =
        ((n : K) + 1) * P.dualBilinForm S x.root x.root →
      P.dualBilinForm S δ x.root ≠ 0) :
    ∑ᶠ i : ℕ, finrank K ((jantzen P Λ₀ δ (i + 1)).toSubmodule ⊓
        weightSpace P Λ₀ (Λ₀ - P.rootOf η) : Submodule K _) =
      ∑ z ∈ (kkPairs P η).filter (fun z ↦ 2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ₀ + P.rho) z.1.root =
          ((z.2 : K) + 1) * P.dualBilinForm S z.1.root z.1.root),
        kostantPartition P (P.rootOf η - (z.2 + 1) • z.1.root)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_shapovalovDet_eq_prod_kkPairs P S hA η
  set Z := kkPairs P η
  set a : NegRootIndex P × ℕ → H := fun z ↦ (P.toDual S).symm z.1.root
  set b : NegRootIndex P × ℕ → K := fun z ↦ P.dualBilinForm S P.rho z.1.root -
    ((z.2 : K) + 1) / 2 * P.dualBilinForm S z.1.root z.1.root
  set e : NegRootIndex P × ℕ → ℕ := fun z ↦ kostantPartition P (P.rootOf η - (z.2 + 1) • z.1.root)
  set F := MvPolynomial.C c * ∏ z ∈ Z, affPoly K H (a z) (b z) ^ e z
  have hab (Λ : Dual K H) (z : NegRootIndex P × ℕ) : Λ (a z) + b z =
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) z.1.root -
        ((z.2 : K) + 1) / 2 * P.dualBilinForm S z.1.root z.1.root := by
    simp only [a, b, ← dualBilinForm_apply_eq, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
    ring
  have hF (Λ : Dual K H) : evalPoly K H F Λ = shapovalovDet P (P.rootOf η) Λ := by
    rw [h Λ]
    simp only [F, map_mul, map_prod, map_pow, Pi.mul_apply, Finset.prod_apply, Pi.pow_apply,
      evalPoly_C, evalPoly_affPoly, hab, e]
  have hiff (z : NegRootIndex P × ℕ) : Λ₀ (a z) + b z = 0 ↔
      2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ₀ + P.rho) z.1.root =
        ((z.2 : K) + 1) * P.dualBilinForm S z.1.root z.1.root := by
    rw [hab]
    constructor <;> intro h0
    · linear_combination 2 * h0
    · linear_combination h0 / 2
  have hδ' (z : NegRootIndex P × ℕ) (hz : z ∈ Z) : Λ₀ (a z) + b z = 0 → δ (a z) ≠ 0 :=
    fun h0 ↦ by
      rw [← dualBilinForm_apply_eq]
      exact hδ z.1 z.2 ((mem_kkPairs P).mp hz) ((hiff z).mp h0)
  classical
  set d := linePoly K H Λ₀ δ F
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := linePoly_C_mul_prod_ne_zero Z a b e hc hδ'
  have hdt := natTrailingDegree_linePoly_prod Z a b e hc hδ'
  have hdet (t : K) : d.eval t = shapovalovDet P (P.rootOf η) (Λ₀ + t • δ) := by
    rw [eval_linePoly, hF]
  have hsum := sum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace S Λ₀ δ (P.rootOf η) d hd0 hdet
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := Finset.range d.natTrailingDegree) fun i hi ↦ ?_,
    hsum, hdt]
  · exact Finset.sum_congr (Finset.filter_congr fun z _ ↦ hiff z) fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  · by_contra hi'
    rw [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, not_lt] at hi'
    exact hi (finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace_eq_zero S Λ₀ δ _ d hd0 hdet (by omega))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finsum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace_eq_sum_verma
statement:
theorem finsum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace_eq_sum_verma [IsAlgClosed K] (Λ₀ δ : Dual K H)
    (η : ι → ℤ)
    (hδ : ∀ x : NegRootIndex P, ∀ n : ℕ, (n + 1) • x.coeff ≤ η →
      2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ₀ + P.rho) x.root =
        ((n : K) + 1) * P.dualBilinForm S x.root x.root →
      P.dualBilinForm S δ x.root ≠ 0) :
    ∑ᶠ i : ℕ, finrank K ((jantzen P Λ₀ δ (i + 1)).toSubmodule ⊓
        weightSpace P Λ₀ (Λ₀ - P.rootOf η) : Submodule K _) =
      ∑ z ∈ (kkPairs P η).filter (fun z ↦ 2 * P.dualBilinForm S (Λ₀ + P.rho) z.1.root =
          ((z.2 : K) + 1) * P.dualBilinForm S z.1.root z.1.root),
        finrank K (weightSpace P (Λ₀ - (z.2 + 1) • z.1.root) (Λ₀ - P.rootOf η))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace P S hA Λ₀ δ η hδ]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ ↦ ?_
  have := finrank_weightSpace_sub P (Λ₀ - (z.2 + 1) • z.1.root)
    (P.rootOf η - (z.2 + 1) • z.1.root)
  rw [show Λ₀ - (z.2 + 1) • z.1.root - (P.rootOf η - (z.2 + 1) • z.1.root) =
    Λ₀ - P.rootOf η by abel] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Matrix.natTrailingDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit
statement: lemma natTrailingDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit {p : K[X]} (hp : IsUnit p) : p.natTrailingDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := Polynomial.isUnit_iff.mp hp
  exact natTrailingDegree_C r

name: Matrix.natTrailingDegree_prod
statement:
lemma natTrailingDegree_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K[X]) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).natTrailingDegree = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha,
      natTrailingDegree_mul (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
        (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i hi ↦ hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)),
      ih fun i hi ↦ hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)]

name: Matrix.X_pow_dvd_iff_le_natTrailingDegree
statement:
lemma X_pow_dvd_iff_le_natTrailingDegree {p : K[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) {i : ℕ} :
    X ^ i ∣ p ↔ i ≤ p.natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_dvd_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ le_natTrailingDegree hp h,
    fun h d hd ↦ coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree (hd.trans_le h)⟩

name: Matrix.exists_jantzenSpace_eq_span
statement:
theorem exists_jantzenSpace_eq_span (G : Matrix n n K[X]) (hG : G.det ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (v : n → n → K) (a : n → K[X]), LinearIndependent K v ∧ (∀ j, a j ≠ 0) ∧
      G.det.natTrailingDegree = ∑ j, (a j).natTrailingDegree ∧
      ∀ i, G.jantzenSpace i = Submodule.span K (v '' {j | i ≤ (a j).natTrailingDegree})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set φ := G.vecMulLinear
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ :=
    Matrix.vecMul_injective_iff.mpr (linearIndependent_rows_of_det_ne_zero hG)
  have hrank : finrank K[X] (LinearMap.range φ) = finrank K[X] (n → K[X]) :=
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj
  obtain ⟨bM, a, bN, hsnf⟩ :=
    (LinearMap.range φ).exists_smith_normal_form_of_rank_eq (Pi.basisFun K[X] n) hrank
  set e := LinearEquiv.ofInjective φ hinj
  set c := bN.map e.symm
  have hc : ∀ j, c j ᵥ* G = a j • bM j := fun j ↦ by
    rw [← hsnf]
    have : e (c j) = bN j := by simp [c]
    rw [← this]
    rfl
  have ha : ∀ j, a j ≠ 0 := fun j h ↦ bN.ne_zero j (Subtype.ext (by rw [hsnf, h, zero_smul]; rfl))
  
  set Cm : Matrix n n K[X] := (Pi.basisFun K[X] n).toMatrix c
  set Bm : Matrix n n K[X] := (Pi.basisFun K[X] n).toMatrix bM
  have hCm : IsUnit Cm.det := by
    have := Basis.invertibleToMatrix (Pi.basisFun K[X] n) c
    exact isUnit_det_of_invertible Cm
  have hBm : IsUnit Bm.det := by
    have := Basis.invertibleToMatrix (Pi.basisFun K[X] n) bM
    exact isUnit_det_of_invertible Bm
  have hmat : Cmᵀ * G = diagonal a * Bmᵀ := by
    refine Matrix.ext fun j s ↦ ?_
    have := congrFun (hc j) s
    simp only [vecMul, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
    rw [diagonal_mul]
    simp only [mul_apply, transpose_apply, Basis.toMatrix_apply, Pi.basisFun_repr, Cm, Bm]
    exact this
  have hdet : Cm.det * G.det = (∏ j, a j) * Bm.det := by
    have := congrArg det hmat
    rwa [det_mul, det_transpose, det_mul, det_diagonal, det_transpose] at this
  refine ⟨fun j s ↦ (c j s).eval 0, a, ?_, ha, ?_, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    have hdet0 : (Cm.map (eval 0)).det ≠ 0 := by
      have := RingHom.map_det (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : K)) Cm
      rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, coe_evalRingHom] at this
      rw [← this]
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrC⟩ := Polynomial.isUnit_iff.mp hCm
      rw [← hrC, eval_C]
      exact hr.ne_zero
    have := linearIndependent_cols_of_det_ne_zero hdet0
    convert this using 1
    ext j s
    simp [Cm, Basis.toMatrix_apply]
  · have h1 := congrArg natTrailingDegree hdet
    rw [natTrailingDegree_mul hCm.ne_zero hG, natTrailingDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit hCm,
      zero_add, natTrailingDegree_mul (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j _ ↦ ha j)
        hBm.ne_zero, natTrailingDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit hBm, add_zero,
      natTrailingDegree_prod _ _ fun j _ ↦ ha j] at h1
    exact h1
  · apply le_antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨w, rfl, hw⟩
      
      set γ := c.repr w
      have hw' : w = ∑ j, γ j • c j := (c.sum_repr w).symm
      have hwG : w ᵥ* G = ∑ j, (γ j * a j) • bM j := by
        rw [hw', sum_vecMul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
        rw [smul_vecMul, hc, smul_smul]
      
      choose u hu using hw
      have hrepr : ∀ j, X ^ i ∣ γ j * a j := fun j ↦ by
        have h1 : w ᵥ* G = (X : K[X]) ^ i • u := by funext s; rw [hu s]; rfl
        have h3 : bM.repr (w ᵥ* G) j = γ j * a j := by
          rw [hwG, map_sum]
          simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
        have h4 : bM.repr ((X : K[X]) ^ i • u) j = X ^ i * bM.repr u j := by
          rw [map_smul]; rfl
        exact ⟨bM.repr u j, by rw [← h3, h1, h4]⟩
      have hγ : ∀ j, (a j).natTrailingDegree < i → (γ j).eval 0 = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by
        by_contra h0
        have hγ0 : γ j ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ h0 (by rw [h, eval_zero])
        have := (X_pow_dvd_iff_le_natTrailingDegree (mul_ne_zero hγ0 (ha j))).mp (hrepr j)
        rw [natTrailingDegree_mul hγ0 (ha j)] at this
        have hγt : (γ j).natTrailingDegree = 0 :=
          natTrailingDegree_eq_zero.mpr (.inr (by rwa [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]))
        omega
      have hval : (fun s ↦ (w s).eval 0) = ∑ j, (γ j).eval 0 • fun s ↦ (c j s).eval 0 := by
        ext s
        rw [hw']
        simp [eval_finsetSum]
      rw [hval]
      refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ ?_
      by_cases hj : i ≤ (a j).natTrailingDegree
      · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩)
      · rw [hγ j (not_le.mp hj), zero_smul]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨c j, rfl, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [hc, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left ((X_pow_dvd_iff_le_natTrailingDegree (ha j)).mpr hj) _

name: Matrix.sum_finrank_jantzenSpace
statement:
theorem sum_finrank_jantzenSpace (G : Matrix n n K[X]) (hG : G.det ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range G.det.natTrailingDegree, finrank K (G.jantzenSpace (i + 1)) =
      G.det.natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, a, hv, ha, hdet, hspace⟩ := exists_jantzenSpace_eq_span G hG
  have hdim : ∀ i, finrank K (G.jantzenSpace i) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun j ↦ i ≤ (a j).natTrailingDegree).card := fun i ↦ by
    have : v '' {j | i ≤ (a j).natTrailingDegree} =
        Set.range (v ∘ Subtype.val : {j // i ≤ (a j).natTrailingDegree} → n → K) := by
      rw [Set.range_comp, Subtype.range_coe_subtype]
    rw [hspace, this, finrank_span_eq_card (hv.comp _ Subtype.val_injective), Fintype.card_subtype]
  simp_rw [hdim]
  
  have hle : ∀ j, (a j).natTrailingDegree ≤ G.det.natTrailingDegree := fun j ↦ by
    rw [hdet]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j ↦ (a j).natTrailingDegree)
      (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  conv_rhs => rw [hdet]
  simp_rw [Finset.card_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  have : (Finset.range G.det.natTrailingDegree).filter (fun i ↦ i + 1 ≤ (a j).natTrailingDegree) =
      Finset.range (a j).natTrailingDegree := by
    ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]; have := hle j; omega
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, this, Finset.card_range]

name: Matrix.jantzenSpace_eq_bot
statement:
theorem jantzenSpace_eq_bot (G : Matrix n n K[X]) (hG : G.det ≠ 0) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : G.det.natTrailingDegree < i) : G.jantzenSpace i = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, a, -, -, hdet, hspace⟩ := exists_jantzenSpace_eq_span G hG
  rw [hspace, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
  rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  exfalso
  have : (a j).natTrailingDegree ≤ G.det.natTrailingDegree := by
    rw [hdet]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j ↦ (a j).natTrailingDegree)
      (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  exact absurd hj (by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_le]; omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.exists_eval_eq_repr
statement:
lemma exists_eval_eq_repr {f : K → 𝒰⁻} (hf : f ∈ lineFam P) (s : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ) :
    ∃ q : K[X], ∀ t, q.eval t = (𝐞).repr (f t) s
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨n, u, rfl⟩ := hf
    exact ⟨X ^ n * C ((𝐞).repr u s), fun t ↦ by simp; ring⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun t ↦ by simp⟩
  | add f g _ _ hf hg =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨p + q, fun t ↦ by simp [hp, hq]⟩
  | smul a f _ hf =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
    exact ⟨C a * p, fun t ↦ by simp [hp]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_pbw_eq_zero
statement:
lemma pairAt_pbw_eq_zero (Λ : Dual K H) {s s' : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ}
    (h : negRootWt P s ≠ negRootWt P s') : pairAt P Λ (𝐞 s) (𝐞 s') = 0
proof:
:=
  contravariantForm_eq_zero_of_ne P Λ (pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace P Λ s)
    (pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace P Λ s') (fun h' ↦ h (sub_right_injective h'))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_left_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlin : ∀ u : 𝒰⁻, pairAt P Λ u (𝐞 s') =
      ((contravariantForm P Λ).flip (equivEnvNNeg P Λ (𝐞 s')) ∘ₗ
        (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).toLinearMap) u := fun _ ↦ rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [← (𝐞).linearCombination_repr u, hlin, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    map_finsuppSum]
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_subset (s₂ := ((𝐞).repr u).support ∪ partitions P β) Finset.subset_union_left
      fun s _ hs ↦ by simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs],
    Finset.sum_subset (s₁ := partitions P β) Finset.subset_union_right fun s _ hs ↦ by
      rw [pairAt_pbw_eq_zero Λ fun h ↦ hs ((mem_partitions P).mpr
        (h.trans ((mem_partitions P).mp hs'))), mul_zero]]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ by rw [← hlin]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eval_gramPoly
statement:
lemma eval_gramPoly (Λ₀ δ β : Dual K H) (s s' : partitions P β) (t : K) :
    (gramPoly P S Λ₀ δ β s s').eval t = pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (𝐞 s) (𝐞 s')
proof:
:=
  (exists_eval_eq_pairAt S Λ₀ δ (𝐞 s) (𝐞 s')).choose_spec t

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.eval_det_gramPoly
statement:
lemma eval_det_gramPoly (Λ₀ δ β : Dual K H) (t : K) :
    (gramPoly P S Λ₀ δ β).det.eval t = (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix
      (pbwWeightBasis P (Λ₀ + t • δ) β) (weightSpaceForm P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (Λ₀ + t • δ - β))).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_evalRingHom, RingHom.map_det]
  congr 1
  ext s s'
  rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply, coe_evalRingHom, eval_gramPoly,
    LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_apply, LinearMap.domRestrict_apply,
    weightBasisOf_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.coordMap_injective
statement: lemma coordMap_injective (Λ₀ β : Dual K H) : Function.Injective (coordMap P Λ₀ β)
proof:
:=
  (equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).injective.comp (linearIndependent_iff_injective_fintypeLinearCombination.mp
    ((𝐞).linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.coordMap_apply
statement:
lemma coordMap_apply (Λ₀ β : Dual K H) (v : partitions P β → K) :
    coordMap P Λ₀ β v = equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀ (∑ s, v s • 𝐞 s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.pairAt_right_eq_sum
statement:
lemma pairAt_right_eq_sum (Λ : Dual K H) (u w : 𝒰⁻) :
    pairAt P Λ u w = ∑ s' ∈ ((𝐞).repr w).support, (𝐞).repr w s' * pairAt P Λ u (𝐞 s')
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : ∀ w : 𝒰⁻, pairAt P Λ u w =
      (contravariantForm P Λ (equivEnvNNeg P Λ u) ∘ₗ (equivEnvNNeg P Λ).toLinearMap) w :=
    fun _ ↦ rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [← (𝐞).linearCombination_repr w, hlin, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    map_finsuppSum]
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ by rw [← hlin]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.symm_eq_sum_of_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma symm_eq_sum_of_mem_weightSpace {Λ₀ β : Dual K H} {m : VermaModule P Λ₀}
    (hm : m ∈ weightSpace P Λ₀ (Λ₀ - β)) :
    (equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m = ∑ s : partitions P β, (𝐞).repr ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m) s •
      𝐞 s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weightSpace_eq_span_pbwOf P Λ₀ (nNegBasis_mem P), Basis.mem_span_image] at hm
  have hrepr : (pbwOf P Λ₀ (nNegBasis P)).repr m = (𝐞).repr ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m) := by
    rw [pbwOf, Basis.map_repr, LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [hrepr] at hm
  conv_lhs => rw [← (𝐞).linearCombination_repr ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m),
    Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort (partitions P β) (fun s ↦ (𝐞).repr _ s • 𝐞 s)]
  refine Finset.sum_subset (fun s hs ↦ (mem_partitions P).mpr ?_) fun s _ hs ↦ ?_
  · have := hm hs
    simpa using this
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs, zero_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.map_coordMap_jantzenSpace
statement:
theorem map_coordMap_jantzenSpace (Λ₀ δ β : Dual K H) (i : ℕ) :
    ((gramPoly P S Λ₀ δ β).jantzenSpace i).map (coordMap P Λ₀ β) =
      (jantzen P Λ₀ δ i).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ₀ (Λ₀ - β)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨v, ⟨w, rfl, hw⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change coordMap P Λ₀ β _ ∈ jantzen P Λ₀ δ i
      rw [mem_jantzen, coordMap_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      set f : K → 𝒰⁻ := fun t ↦ ∑ s, (w s).eval t • 𝐞 s
      have hf : f ∈ lineFam P := by
        have : f = ∑ s, fun t : K ↦ (w s).eval t • 𝐞 s := by
          funext t; simp only [f, Finset.sum_apply]
        rw [this]
        exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s _ ↦ polyEval_smul_mem_lineFam _ _
      refine ⟨f, hf, rfl, fun u ↦ ?_⟩
      simp_rw [pairAt_right_eq_sum _ (f _) u]
      refine DvdXPow.sum _ fun s' _ ↦ ?_
      by_cases hs' : s' ∈ partitions P β
      · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hw ⟨s', hs'⟩
        refine ⟨C ((𝐞).repr u s') * q, fun t ↦ ?_⟩
        beta_reduce
        have e1 : pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (f t) (𝐞 s') =
            ((w ᵥ* gramPoly P S Λ₀ δ β) ⟨s', hs'⟩).eval t := by
          rw [pairAt_left_eq_sum _ β _ hs']
          simp only [f, vecMul, dotProduct, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_gramPoly]
          rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort (partitions P β)]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
          congr 1
          rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply']
          simp only [map_smul, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply,
            smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single s (fun b _ hb ↦ by
            simp only [Subtype.val_inj]; exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h ↦ absurd h hb)
            (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_univ s) h)]
          simp
        rw [e1, hq]
        simp only [eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
        ring
      · refine ⟨0, fun t ↦ ?_⟩
        have : pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (f t) (𝐞 s') = 0 := by
          simp only [f, pairAt, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ ↦ ?_
          rw [smul_eq_mul, ← pairAt, pairAt_pbw_eq_zero _ fun h ↦ hs' ((mem_partitions P).mpr
            (h.symm.trans ((mem_partitions P).mp s.2))), mul_zero]
        beta_reduce
        rw [this]
        simp
    · rw [coordMap_apply, map_sum]
      refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s _ ↦ ?_
      rw [map_smul]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      have := pbwBasisVerma_mem_weightSpace P Λ₀ s
      rwa [(mem_partitions P).mp s.2] at this
  · rintro m ⟨hmJ, hmW⟩
    change m ∈ jantzen P Λ₀ δ i at hmJ
    rw [mem_jantzen] at hmJ
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0, hfw⟩ := hmJ
    choose w hw using fun s : partitions P β ↦ exists_eval_eq_repr hf s
    refine ⟨fun s ↦ (𝐞).repr ((equivEnvNNeg P Λ₀).symm m) s, ⟨w, ?_, fun s' ↦ ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · ext s
      rw [hw, hf0]
    · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hfw (𝐞 s')
      refine ⟨q, Polynomial.funext fun t ↦ ?_⟩
      have : pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (f t) (𝐞 s') = t ^ i * q.eval t := hq t
      rw [pairAt_left_eq_sum _ β _ s'.2] at this
      rw [eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, ← this]
      simp only [vecMul, dotProduct, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, hw, eval_gramPoly]
      exact (Finset.sum_coe_sort (partitions P β)
        (fun s ↦ (𝐞).repr (f t) s * pairAt P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (𝐞 s) (𝐞 s')))
    · rw [coordMap_apply, ← symm_eq_sum_of_mem_weightSpace hmW, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace (Λ₀ δ β : Dual K H) (i : ℕ) :
    finrank K ((jantzen P Λ₀ δ i).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ₀ (Λ₀ - β) : Submodule K _) =
      finrank K ((gramPoly P S Λ₀ δ β).jantzenSpace i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_coordMap_jantzenSpace S]
  exact (LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ (coordMap_injective Λ₀ β) _)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.sum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace
statement:
theorem sum_finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace (Λ₀ δ β : Dual K H) (d : K[X]) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdet : ∀ t, d.eval t = (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix (pbwWeightBasis P (Λ₀ + t • δ) β)
      (weightSpaceForm P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (Λ₀ + t • δ - β))).det) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d.natTrailingDegree,
      finrank K ((jantzen P Λ₀ δ (i + 1)).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ₀ (Λ₀ - β) :
        Submodule K _) = d.natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (gramPoly P S Λ₀ δ β).det = d :=
    Polynomial.funext fun t ↦ by rw [eval_det_gramPoly, hdet]
  simp_rw [finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace S]
  rw [← hG]
  exact Matrix.sum_finrank_jantzenSpace _ (hG ▸ hd)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace_eq_zero (Λ₀ δ β : Dual K H) (d : K[X]) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdet : ∀ t, d.eval t = (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix (pbwWeightBasis P (Λ₀ + t • δ) β)
      (weightSpaceForm P (Λ₀ + t • δ) (Λ₀ + t • δ - β))).det) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : d.natTrailingDegree < i) :
    finrank K ((jantzen P Λ₀ δ i).toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P Λ₀ (Λ₀ - β) :
      Submodule K _) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (gramPoly P S Λ₀ δ β).det = d :=
    Polynomial.funext fun t ↦ by rw [eval_det_gramPoly, hdet]
  rw [finrank_jantzen_inf_weightSpace S, Matrix.jantzenSpace_eq_bot _ (hG ▸ hd) (hG ▸ hi),
    finrank_bot]

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mapEquiv_ι
statement: @[simp] lemma mapEquiv_ι (e : L ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ L') (x : L) : mapEquiv e (ι R x) = ι R (e x)

name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mapEquiv_symm_ι

@[simp] lemma mapEquiv_symm_ι (e : L ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ L') (x : L') :

proof:

name: Matrix.IsGeneralizedCartan.toNat_neg_add_one
proof:
:= by
  have := hA.toNat_neg_eq hij

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.ker_rangeRestrict
statement:
private lemma ker_rangeRestrict {L : Type*} [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] (φ : L →ₗ⁅K⁆ L') :
    φ.rangeRestrict.ker = φ.ker
proof:
:= by

  simp [LieHom.mem_ker, Subtype.ext_iff, LieHom.rangeRestrict_apply]

name: Matrix.SerreLieAlgebra.equivRangeOfKerEq_θ
statement:
@[simp] lemma equivRangeOfKerEq_θ (φ : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ⁅K⁆ L')
    (hφ : φ.ker = serreLieIdeal K A) (i : ι) :
    (equivRangeOfKerEq φ hφ (θ K A i) : L') = φ (FreeLieAlgebra.of K i)

:=

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.fHom_serreLieElem
statement: lemma fHom_serreLieElem (i j : ι) : fHom P (serreLieElem K A i j) = serreF P i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreLieElem, LieHom.map_ad_pow, fHom_of, fHom_of, serreF, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply,
    ad_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.eHom_serreLieElem
statement: lemma eHom_serreLieElem (i j : ι) : eHom P (serreLieElem K A i j) = serreE P i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreLieElem, LieHom.map_ad_pow, eHom_of, eHom_of, serreE_eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreLieIdeal_le_comap_fHom
statement: lemma serreLieIdeal_le_comap_fHom : serreLieIdeal K A ≤ (serreIdeal P).comap (fHom P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreLieIdeal, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LieIdeal.mem_comap, fHom_serreLieElem]
  exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, j, hij, Or.inr rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.iSup_stable
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction S (motive := fun y ↦ T y ∈ ⨆ k, S k) hy
    (fun k y hy ↦ Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem k (hS k y hy)) (by simp) fun y z hy hz ↦ ?_
  rw [map_add]
  exact add_mem hy hz

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreE_mem_serreESpan
statement: lemma serreE_mem_serreESpan {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) : serreE P i j ∈ serreESpan P
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨(i, j), hij⟩ : {p : ι × ι // p.1 ≠ p.2})
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreESpan_le_range_eHom
statement:
lemma serreESpan_le_range_eHom :
    serreESpan P ≤ LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra)
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun _ ↦ eSpan_le_range_eHom P (serreE_mem_range_eHom P _ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.map_chevalleyInvolution_serreESpan_le
statement:
lemma map_chevalleyInvolution_serreESpan_le :
    (serreESpan P).map (chevalleyInvolution P : P.AuxLieAlgebra →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) ≤
      (serreLieIdeal K A).toSubmodule.map
        (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreESpan, Submodule.map_iSup, iSup_le_iff]
  rintro ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij⟩
  rw [eSpan, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨l, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨(-1 : K) ^ (-A i j).toNat • serreLieElem K A i j,
      (serreLieIdeal K A).smul_mem _ (LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
    simp [fHom_serreLieElem, chevalleyInvolution_serreE]
  | cons k l ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨-⁅FreeLieAlgebra.of K k, y⁆, neg_mem ((serreLieIdeal K A).lie_mem hy), ?_⟩
    have hy'' : fHom P y = chevalleyInvolution P (adProd (l.map (e P)) (serreE P i j)) := hy'
    simp [hy'']

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.serreF_eq_smul
statement:
lemma serreF_eq_smul (i j : ι) :
    serreF P i j = (-1 : K) ^ (-A i j).toNat • chevalleyInvolution P (serreE P i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chevalleyInvolution_serreE, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.fHom_mem_serreIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem fHom_mem_serreIdeal_iff {y : FreeLieAlgebra K ι} :
    fHom P y ∈ serreIdeal P ↔ y ∈ serreLieIdeal K A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hy ↦ ?_, fun hy ↦ serreLieIdeal_le_comap_fHom P hy⟩
  have hω : Function.Surjective (chevalleyInvolution P) := fun x ↦
    ⟨chevalleyInvolution P x, chevalleyInvolution_chevalleyInvolution P x⟩
  have hle : serreIdeal P ≤ serreEIdeal P hA ⊔ (serreEIdeal P hA).map (chevalleyInvolution P) := by
    rw [serreIdeal, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact LieSubmodule.mem_sup_left (serreE_mem_serreESpan P hij)
    · refine LieSubmodule.mem_sup_right ?_
      rw [serreF_eq_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem (LieSubmodule.toSubmodule _) _
        (LieIdeal.mem_map (serreE_mem_serreESpan P hij))
  have hx := hle hy
  rw [← LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, LieSubmodule.sup_toSubmodule,
    LieIdeal.coe_map_of_surjective hω, Submodule.mem_sup] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := map_chevalleyInvolution_serreESpan_le P hb
  have ha0 : a = 0 := by
    have hmem : a ∈ LinearMap.range (fHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) ⊓
        LinearMap.range (eHom P : FreeLieAlgebra K ι →ₗ[K] P.AuxLieAlgebra) :=
      ⟨⟨y - y', by rw [LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, map_sub, ← hab]; simp⟩,
        serreESpan_le_range_eHom P ha⟩
    rwa [range_fHom_inf_range_eHom, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
  rw [ha0, zero_add] at hab
  exact fHom_injective P hab ▸ hy'

name: Matrix.Realization.AuxLieAlgebra.comap_fHom_serreIdeal
statement: theorem comap_fHom_serreIdeal : (serreIdeal P).comap (fHom P) = serreLieIdeal K A

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.ker_fHom

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.serreLieAlgebraEquivRangeFHom_θ
statement:
@[simp] lemma serreLieAlgebraEquivRangeFHom_θ (i : ι) :
    (serreLieAlgebraEquivRangeFHom P hA (SerreLieAlgebra.θ K A i) : P.SerrePresentedAlgebra) =

name: Matrix.Realization.SerrePresentedAlgebra.serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_θ

@[simp] lemma serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_θ (i : ι) :

      UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K ⟨f P i, FreeLieAlgebra.of K i, fHom_of P i⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreAssocAlgebraEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    SerreAssocAlgebra.equivUniversalEnveloping_θ, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.mapEquiv_ι]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_fHom
statement: theorem ker_fHom : (fHom P).ker = serreLieIdeal K A
proof:
:= by

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreLieAlgebraEquivNNeg_θ

@[simp] lemma serreLieAlgebraEquivNNeg_θ (i : ι) :

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_θ
statement:
@[simp] lemma serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_θ (i : ι) :

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_symm_ι_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_symm_ι_f (i : ι) :

        (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι K ⟨f P i, f_mem_nNeg P i⟩) =

proof:
:= by

name: RingEquiv.apply_mem_span_image_of_mem
statement:
private lemma RingEquiv.apply_mem_span_image_of_mem {S U : Type*} [Ring S] [Ring U]
    (Φ : S ≃+* U) (T : Set S) {a : S} (ha : a ∈ Submodule.span S T) :
    Φ a ∈ Submodule.span U (Φ '' T)
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ (Φ c) hx

name: RingEquiv.apply_mem_span_image_iff
statement:
private lemma RingEquiv.apply_mem_span_image_iff {S U : Type*} [Ring S] [Ring U] (Φ : S ≃+* U)
    (T : Set S) {a : S} : Φ a ∈ Submodule.span U (Φ '' T) ↔ a ∈ Submodule.span S T
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, RingEquiv.apply_mem_span_image_of_mem Φ T⟩
  have := RingEquiv.apply_mem_span_image_of_mem Φ.symm _ h
  have hT : Φ.symm '' (Φ '' T) = T := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    simp
  rwa [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hT] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.toEnd_pow_apply_eq_smul
statement:
lemma toEnd_pow_apply_eq_smul (x : P.KacMoodyAlgebra) (k : ℕ) (m : VermaModule P Λ) :
    (toEnd K P.KacMoodyAlgebra (VermaModule P Λ) x ^ k) m = ιᵤ x ^ k • m
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, toEnd_apply_apply, lie_eq_smul, pow_succ', mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.rep_apply_eq_smul
statement: lemma rep_apply_eq_smul (u : 𝓤) (m : VermaModule P Λ) : rep P (VermaModule P Λ) u m = u • m
proof:
:=
  (map_smul_eq_rep P Λ LieModuleHom.id u m).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_fPow
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_fPow (i : ι) (k : ℕ) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ (ιᵤ (nNegF P i) ^ (k + 1)) = fPowHwv P Λ i k
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_pow, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, fPowHwv,
    toEnd_pow_apply_eq_smul]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_mem_fPowSubmodule
statement:
lemma equivEnvNNeg_mem_fPowSubmodule {u : 𝓤₋} (hu : u ∈ fPowLeftIdeal P n) :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ u ∈ fPowSubmodule P Λ n
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_fPow]
    exact LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, equivEnvNNeg_mul]; exact smul_mem P Λ _ _ hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.VermaModule.mem_fPowSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_fPowSubmodule_iff {u : 𝓤₋} :
    equivEnvNNeg P Λ u ∈ fPowSubmodule P Λ n ↔ u ∈ fPowLeftIdeal P n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hu ↦ ?_, equivEnvNNeg_mem_fPowSubmodule P⟩
  
  let φ : ∀ i, VermaModule P (Λ - (n i + 1) • P.root i) →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆
      VermaModule P Λ := fun i ↦ lift P (fPowHwv P Λ i (n i))
    (fun _ hx ↦ lie_eq_zero_of_mem_nPos (lie_e_fPowHwv P Λ hA (hn i)) hx)
    (fun a ↦ fPowHwv_mem_weightSpace P Λ i (n i) a)
  set N : Submodule K (VermaModule P Λ) :=
    ((fPowLeftIdeal P n).restrictScalars K).map (equivEnvNNeg P Λ : 𝓤₋ →ₗ[K] VermaModule P Λ)
  have hle : fPowSubmodule P Λ n ≤ ⨆ i, (φ i).range := by
    rw [fPowSubmodule, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact LieSubmodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i ((LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨_, lift_hwv _ _ _ _⟩)
  have hN : (⨆ i, (φ i).range).toSubmodule ≤ N := by
    rw [LieSubmodule.iSup_toSubmodule, iSup_le_iff]
    rintro i _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (equivEnvNNeg P (Λ - (n i + 1) • P.root i)).surjective x
    refine ⟨v * ιᵤ (nNegF P i) ^ (n i + 1),
      Submodule.smul_mem _ v (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
    change equivEnvNNeg P Λ _ = φ i _
    rw [equivEnvNNeg_mul, equivEnvNNeg_fPow, equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_smul_eq_rep, hwv, ← hwv,
      lift_hwv, rep_apply_eq_smul]
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvu⟩ := hN (hle hu)
  rwa [(equivEnvNNeg P Λ).injective hvu] at hv

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_mem_fPowLeftIdeal_iff
statement:
lemma serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_mem_fPowLeftIdeal_iff {a : SerreAssocAlgebra K A} :
    serreAssocAlgebraEquiv P hA hS a ∈ VermaModule.fPowLeftIdeal P n ↔
      a ∈ SerreAssocAlgebra.thetaPowLeftIdeal K A n
proof:
:= by
  have himage : (Set.range fun i ↦ ιᵤ (nNegF P i) ^ (n i + 1)) =
      (serreAssocAlgebraEquiv P hA hS : SerreAssocAlgebra K A ≃+* 𝓤₋) ''
        Set.range fun i ↦ SerreAssocAlgebra.θ K A i ^ (n i + 1) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_image, exists_exists_eq_and]
    refine exists_congr fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [map_pow, AlgEquiv.coe_ringEquiv, serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_θ]
    rfl
  rw [VermaModule.fPowLeftIdeal, himage, SerreAssocAlgebra.thetaPowLeftIdeal,
    ← RingEquiv.apply_mem_span_image_iff
      (serreAssocAlgebraEquiv P hA hS : SerreAssocAlgebra K A ≃+* 𝓤₋)]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_apply
statement:
lemma serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_apply (a : SerreAssocAlgebra K A) :
    serreAssocToIrreducibleModule P hA hS hn a =
      FPowQuotient.equivIrreducibleModule hS hA hn (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk'
        (VermaModule.fPowSubmodule P Λ n)
          (VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P Λ (serreAssocAlgebraEquiv P hA hS a)))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_surjective
statement:
lemma serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (serreAssocToIrreducibleModule P hA hS hn)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (FPowQuotient.equivIrreducibleModule hS hA hn).surjective y
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _ x
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P Λ).surjective m
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (serreAssocAlgebraEquiv P hA hS).surjective u
  exact ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ker_serreAssocToIrreducibleModule
statement:
theorem ker_serreAssocToIrreducibleModule :
    LinearMap.ker (serreAssocToIrreducibleModule P hA hS hn) =
      (SerreAssocAlgebra.thetaPowLeftIdeal K A n).restrictScalars K
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem,
    ← serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_mem_fPowLeftIdeal_iff P hA hS,
    ← VermaModule.mem_fPowSubmodule_iff P hA hn, ← LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero']
  rw [serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_apply]
  exact (FPowQuotient.equivIrreducibleModule hS hA hn).injective.eq_iff' (map_zero _)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk (a : SerreAssocAlgebra K A) :
    serreAssocQuotientEquiv P hA hS hn (Submodule.Quotient.mk a) =
      serreAssocToIrreducibleModule P hA hS hn a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk_one
statement:
theorem serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk_one :
    serreAssocQuotientEquiv P hA hS hn (Submodule.Quotient.mk 1) = IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk, serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_apply, map_one,
    VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_one, one_smul, FPowQuotient.equivIrreducibleModule_apply]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.serreAssocQuotientEquiv_θ_smul
statement:
theorem serreAssocQuotientEquiv_θ_smul (i : ι)
    (q : SerreAssocAlgebra K A ⧸ SerreAssocAlgebra.thetaPowLeftIdeal K A n) :
    serreAssocQuotientEquiv P hA hS hn (SerreAssocAlgebra.θ K A i • q) =
      ⁅f P i, serreAssocQuotientEquiv P hA hS hn q⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H a =>
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk, serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk,
      serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_apply, serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      map_mul, serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_θ, VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_mul,
      UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, ← VermaModule.lie_eq_smul, LieModuleHom.map_lie]
    exact (FPowQuotient.equivIrreducibleModule hS hA hn).toLieModuleHom.map_lie _ _

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.degreeLinearMap_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma degreeLinearMap_single (χ : G →+ K) (g : G) (c : K) :
    degreeLinearMap χ (single g c) = single g (χ g * c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [degreeLinearMap, ← ofCoeff_single]

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.degreeDerivation_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma degreeDerivation_single (χ : G →+ K) (g : G) (c : K) :
    degreeDerivation χ (single g c) = single g (χ g * c)
proof:
:=
  degreeLinearMap_single χ g c

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.derivation_ext
statement:
lemma derivation_ext {D₁ D₂ : Derivation K K[G] K[G]}
    (h : ∀ g c, D₁ (single g c) = D₂ (single g c)) : D₁ = D₂
proof:
:=
  Derivation.ext fun x ↦ by
    induction x using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
    | single g c => exact h g c

name: AddMonoidAlgebra.lie_degreeDerivation
statement:
lemma lie_degreeDerivation (χ χ' : G →+ K) :
    ⁅degreeDerivation χ, degreeDerivation χ'⁆ = 0
proof:
:=
  derivation_ext fun g c ↦ by
    rw [Derivation.commutator_apply, Derivation.zero_apply, degreeDerivation_single,
      degreeDerivation_single,
      degreeDerivation_single, degreeDerivation_single, sub_eq_zero, mul_left_comm]

name: LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.evalHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalHom_tmul (φ : A →ₐ[R] R) (a : A) (x : L) :
    evalHom φ (a ⊗ₜ x) = φ a • x
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.lift.tmul _ _

name: LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.ad_tmul_pow_tmul
statement:
lemma ad_tmul_pow_tmul (s t : A) (x y : L) (n : ℕ) :
    (ad R (A ⊗[R] L) (s ⊗ₜ x) ^ n) (t ⊗ₜ y) = (s ^ n * t) ⊗ₜ ((ad R L x ^ n) y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, ad_apply, bracket_tmul, pow_succ' (ad R L x),
      Module.End.mul_apply, ad_apply, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.gradingHom_h
statement:
@[simp] lemma gradingHom_h (μ : ι → G) (i : ι) :
    gradingHom K A μ (h K A i) = 1 ⊗ₜ h K A i
proof:
:=
  lift_h _ i

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.gradingHom_e
statement:
@[simp] lemma gradingHom_e (μ : ι → G) (i : ι) :
    gradingHom K A μ (e K A i) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (μ i) 1 ⊗ₜ e K A i
proof:
:=
  lift_e _ i

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.gradingHom_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma gradingHom_f (μ : ι → G) (i : ι) :
    gradingHom K A μ (f K A i) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-μ i) 1 ⊗ₜ f K A i
proof:
:=
  lift_f _ i

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.augmentation_single
statement:
lemma augmentation_single (g : G) (c : K) :
    augmentation K G (AddMonoidAlgebra.single g c) = c
proof:
:= by
  simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single]

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.evalHom_comp_gradingHom
statement:
lemma evalHom_comp_gradingHom (μ : ι → G) :
    (evalHom (augmentation K G)).comp (gradingHom K A μ) = LieHom.id
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> simp

name: Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.gradingHom_injective
statement: lemma gradingHom_injective (μ : ι → G) : Function.Injective (gradingHom K A μ)
proof:
:=
  fun x y hxy ↦ by
    have h := congr(evalHom (augmentation K G) $hxy)
    rwa [← LieHom.comp_apply, ← LieHom.comp_apply, evalHom_comp_gradingHom, LieHom.id_apply,
      LieHom.id_apply] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.degreeDer_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma degreeDer_single (a : H) (μ : Dual K H) (c : K) :
    degreeDer K H a (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ c) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ (μ a * c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [degreeDer]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_degreeDer
statement: lemma lie_degreeDer (a b : H) : ⁅degreeDer K H a, degreeDer K H b⁆ = 0
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.lie_degreeDerivation _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.corootSpanToLieAlgebra_coroot
statement:
lemma corootSpanToLieAlgebra_coroot (i : ι) :
    corootSpanToLieAlgebra P ⟨P.coroot i, Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ =
      Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.h K A i
proof:
:= by
  rw [corootSpanToLieAlgebra, ← Basis.span_apply P.linearIndependent_coroot, Basis.constr_basis]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.corootSpan_induction
statement:
lemma corootSpan_induction {p : 𝔥' → Prop} (x : 𝔥')
    (hc : ∀ i, p ⟨P.coroot i, Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩) (h0 : p 0)
    (hadd : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) (hsmul : ∀ (c : K) x, p x → p (c • x)) : p x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (Basis.span P.linearIndependent_coroot)) := by
    rw [Basis.span_eq]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx; rw [Basis.span_apply]; exact hc i
  | zero => exact h0
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact hadd x y hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => exact hsmul c x hx

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_corootSpanToLieAlgebra
statement:
lemma lie_corootSpanToLieAlgebra (x y : 𝔥') :
    ⁅corootSpanToLieAlgebra P x, corootSpanToLieAlgebra P y⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using corootSpan_induction P with
  | hc i =>
    induction y using corootSpan_induction P with
    | hc j =>
      rw [corootSpanToLieAlgebra_coroot, corootSpanToLieAlgebra_coroot,
        Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lie_h_h]
    | h0 => simp
    | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, lie_add, hy, hy', add_zero]
    | hsmul c y hy => rw [map_smul, lie_smul, hy, smul_zero]
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, add_lie, hx, hx', add_zero]
  | hsmul c x hx => rw [map_smul, smul_lie, hx, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_corootSpanToLieAlgebra_e
statement:
lemma lie_corootSpanToLieAlgebra_e (x : 𝔥') (j : ι) :
    ⁅corootSpanToLieAlgebra P x, Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.e K A j⁆ =
      P.root j x • Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.e K A j
proof:
:= by
  induction x using corootSpan_induction P with
  | hc i =>
    rw [corootSpanToLieAlgebra_coroot, Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lie_h_e, root_coroot,
      Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, add_lie, hx, hy, Submodule.coe_add, map_add, add_smul]
  | hsmul c x hx =>
    rw [map_smul, smul_lie, hx, Submodule.coe_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.lie_corootSpanToLieAlgebra_f
statement:
lemma lie_corootSpanToLieAlgebra_f (x : 𝔥') (j : ι) :
    ⁅corootSpanToLieAlgebra P x, Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.f K A j⁆ =
      -(P.root j x • Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.f K A j)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using corootSpan_induction P with
  | hc i =>
    rw [corootSpanToLieAlgebra_coroot, Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.lie_h_f, root_coroot,
      Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, add_lie, hx, hy, Submodule.coe_add, map_add, add_smul, neg_add]
  | hsmul c x hx =>
    rw [map_smul, smul_lie, hx, Submodule.coe_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, smul_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.corootSpanProj_of_mem
statement: lemma corootSpanProj_of_mem {a : H} (ha : a ∈ 𝔥') : corootSpanProj P a = ⟨a, ha⟩
proof:
:=
  Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_left _ ha

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.semidirectH_apply
statement:
lemma semidirectH_apply (a : H) :
    semidirectH P a = ⟨1 ⊗ₜ corootSpanToLieAlgebra P (corootSpanProj P a),
      degreeDer K H (a - corootSpanProj P a)⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [semidirectH]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.semidirectH_coroot
statement:
lemma semidirectH_coroot (i : ι) :
    semidirectH P (P.coroot i) = ⟨1 ⊗ₜ Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.h K A i, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [semidirectH_apply, corootSpanProj_of_mem P (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩),
    corootSpanToLieAlgebra_coroot, sub_self, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.semidirectLiftData_h
statement: @[simp] lemma semidirectLiftData_h (a : H) : (semidirectLiftData P).h a = semidirectH P a
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.semidirectLiftData_e
statement:
@[simp] lemma semidirectLiftData_e (i : ι) :
    (semidirectLiftData P).e i =
      SemiDirectSum.inl ψ (gradingHom K A P.root (Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.e K A i))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.semidirectLiftData_f
statement:
@[simp] lemma semidirectLiftData_f (i : ι) :
    (semidirectLiftData P).f i =
      SemiDirectSum.inl ψ (gradingHom K A P.root (Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.f K A i))
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.maxIdeal_le_ker_semidirectLift
statement:
lemma maxIdeal_le_ker_semidirectLift :
    AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal P ≤ (AuxLieAlgebra.lift (semidirectLiftData P)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [AuxLieAlgebra.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal P hA hS, AuxLieAlgebra.serreIdeal,
    LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro x ⟨i, j, -, rfl | rfl⟩
  · have h := congr(SemiDirectSum.inl ψ (gradingHom K A P.root
      $(Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.serre_e K A i j)))
    simp only [LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie, map_zero] at h
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker, AuxLieAlgebra.serreE, LieHom.map_ad_pow,
      LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lift_e, semidirectLiftData_e]
    exact h
  · have h := congr(SemiDirectSum.inl ψ (gradingHom K A P.root
      $(Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.serre_f K A i j)))
    simp only [LieHom.map_ad_pow, LieHom.map_lie, map_zero] at h
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LieHom.mem_ker, AuxLieAlgebra.serreF, LieHom.map_ad_pow,
      LieHom.map_lie, AuxLieAlgebra.lift_f, semidirectLiftData_f]
    exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toSemidirect_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma toSemidirect_π (x : P.AuxLieAlgebra) :
    toSemidirect P hA hS (π P x) = AuxLieAlgebra.lift (semidirectLiftData P) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.toSemidirect_comp_ofToLieAlgebra
statement:
lemma toSemidirect_comp_ofToLieAlgebra :
    (toSemidirect P hA hS).comp (ofToLieAlgebra P hA) =
      (SemiDirectSum.inl ψ).comp (gradingHom K A P.root)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ToLieAlgebra.hom_ext <;> intro i
  · rw [LieHom.comp_apply, ofToLieAlgebra_h, ← π_h, toSemidirect_π, AuxLieAlgebra.lift_h,
      semidirectLiftData_h, semidirectH_coroot, LieHom.comp_apply, gradingHom_h]
    rfl
  · rw [LieHom.comp_apply, ofToLieAlgebra_e, ← π_e, toSemidirect_π, AuxLieAlgebra.lift_e,
      semidirectLiftData_e, LieHom.comp_apply]
  · rw [LieHom.comp_apply, ofToLieAlgebra_f, ← π_f, toSemidirect_π, AuxLieAlgebra.lift_f,
      semidirectLiftData_f, LieHom.comp_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.ofToLieAlgebra_injective
statement: theorem ofToLieAlgebra_injective : Function.Injective (ofToLieAlgebra P hA)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have h := congr(toSemidirect P hA hS $hxy)
  rw [← LieHom.comp_apply, ← LieHom.comp_apply, toSemidirect_comp_ofToLieAlgebra,
    LieHom.comp_apply, LieHom.comp_apply] at h
  exact gradingHom_injective P.root (SemiDirectSum.inl_injective ψ h)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coe_toLieAlgebraEquivDerived_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_toLieAlgebraEquivDerived_apply (x : Matrix.ToLieAlgebra K A) :

proof:
:=

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.subsingleton_subquotient_self
statement: lemma subsingleton_subquotient_self (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V) : Subsingleton (N.Subquotient N)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a b ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (N.comap N.incl) a
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' (N.comap N.incl) b
    rw [(LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := N.comap N.incl)).mpr
        (LieSubmodule.mem_comap.mpr a.2),
      (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := N.comap N.incl)).mpr
        (LieSubmodule.mem_comap.mpr b.2)]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.length_factorWeights_add_le
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing N with
  | nil =>
    rw [← IsLocalCompositionSeries.nil_iff.mp hl]
    simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨hle, hf', hl'⟩ := IsLocalCompositionSeries.cons_iff.mp hl
    have h := ih hl'
    cases o with
    | none =>
      have := hf.monotone hle
      simp only [factorWeights_cons_none]
      omega
    | some μ =>
      have hlt : N < N' := lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun hNN ↦ by
        subst hNN
        obtain ⟨-, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hf'
        have := subsingleton_subquotient_self N
        obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne (IrreducibleModule P μ)
        exact hxy (ψ.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
      have := hf hlt
      simp only [factorWeights_cons_some, List.length_cons]
      omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_ne_zero_of_lieModuleHom
statement:
theorem multiplicity_ne_zero_of_lieModuleHom {lam : Dual K H}
    (φ : V →ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P lam) (hφ : φ ≠ 0) : hV.multiplicity lam ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := IrreducibleModule.isIrreducible P lam
  have hs : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.range_eq_top]
    refine (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top φ.range).resolve_left fun h0 ↦ hφ ?_
    ext y
    have : φ y ∈ φ.range := (LieModuleHom.mem_range _ _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [h0, LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact this
  have h := IsCategoryO.multiplicity_eq_add_of_exact (hV.lieSubmodule φ.ker) hV
    (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam) φ.ker.incl φ Subtype.val_injective
    φ.ker.range_incl.symm hs lam
  have h1 : (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P lam).multiplicity lam = 1 := by
    rw [IrreducibleModule.multiplicity_eq]
    simp
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_minimal_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_of_multiplicity_ne_zero {f : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f)
    {S : Set (Dual K H)} (hS : ∀ μ ∈ S, hV.multiplicity μ ≠ 0) (hne : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ lam ∈ S, ∀ ν ∈ S, ν ∈ cone P lam → ν = lam
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let l : Dual K H → List (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V × Option (Dual K H)) := fun μ ↦
    (hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ).choose
  have hl (μ : Dual K H) : IsLocalCompositionSeries P μ ⊥ (l μ) ⊤ :=
    (hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ).choose_spec
  let T : Dual K H → Finset (Dual K H) := fun μ ↦ (factorWeights (l μ)).toFinset
  have hT (μ κ : Dual K H) : κ ∈ T μ ↔ hV.multiplicity κ ≠ 0 ∧ μ ∈ cone P κ := by
    simp only [T, List.mem_toFinset]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hc := (hl μ).mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights h
      exact ⟨(hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff hc (hl μ)).mpr h, hc⟩
    · rintro ⟨hm, hc⟩
      exact (hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff hc (hl μ)).mp hm
  have hTle (μ : Dual K H) : (T μ).card ≤ f ⊤ := by
    have h1 := List.toFinset_card_le (factorWeights (l μ))
    have h2 := (hl μ).length_factorWeights_add_le hf
    simp only [T]
    omega
  have hTlt {μ ν : Dual K H} (hν : ν ∈ S) (hνμ : ν ∈ cone P μ) (hne : ν ≠ μ) :
      (T μ).card < (T ν).card := by
    refine Finset.card_lt_card ((Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset fun κ hκ ↦ ?_).mpr
      ⟨ν, (hT ν ν).mpr ⟨hS ν hν, mem_cone_self ν⟩, fun h ↦ hne ?_⟩)
    · obtain ⟨hm, hc⟩ := (hT μ κ).mp hκ
      exact (hT ν κ).mpr ⟨hm, mem_cone_trans hνμ hc⟩
    · exact eq_of_mem_cone_of_mem_cone hνμ ((hT μ ν).mp h).2
  suffices H : ∀ d, ∀ μ ∈ S, f ⊤ - (T μ).card = d → ∃ lam ∈ S, ∀ ν ∈ S, ν ∈ cone P lam → ν = lam by
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hne
    exact H _ μ hμ rfl
  intro d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ d ih =>
  intro μ hμ hd
  by_cases hmin : ∀ ν ∈ S, ν ∈ cone P μ → ν = μ
  · exact ⟨μ, hμ, hmin⟩
  push Not at hmin
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hνμ, hne⟩ := hmin
  have h1 := hTlt hν hνμ hne
  have h2 := hTle ν
  exact ih _ (by omega) ν hν rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_subquotient_equiv_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_subquotient_equiv_of_ne_bot [WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V)]
    {M : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V} (hM : M ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ M' : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V, M' < M ∧ ∃ ν : Dual K H, hV.multiplicity ν ≠ 0 ∧
      Nonempty (M'.Subquotient M ≃ₗ⁅K,𝔤⁆ IrreducibleModule P ν)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨M', hM'M : M' < M, hmax⟩ := (wellFounded_gt (α := LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V)).has_min
    {N | N < M} ⟨⊥, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hM⟩
  have hmax' (N : LieSubmodule K 𝔤 V) (h₁ : M' ≤ N) (h₂ : N < M) : N = M' :=
    (eq_or_lt_of_le h₁).elim Eq.symm fun h ↦ absurd h (hmax N h₂)
  
  have hQ : IsCategoryO P (M'.Subquotient M) := (hV.lieSubmodule M).quotient _
  obtain ⟨m, hmM, hmM'⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hM'M
  have hq0 : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (M'.comap M.incl) ⟨m, hmM⟩ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    hmM' ((LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := M'.comap M.incl)).mp h)
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ, weightSpace P (M'.Subquotient M) μ ≠ ⊥ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have htop : (⊤ : Submodule K (M'.Subquotient M)) = ⊥ := by
      rw [← hQ.iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top]
      exact iSup_eq_bot.mpr hcon
    have hmem : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (M'.comap M.incl) ⟨m, hmM⟩ ∈
        (⊤ : Submodule K (M'.Subquotient M)) := Submodule.mem_top
    rw [htop, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
    exact hq0 hmem
  have hμ' : ¬ M.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V μ ≤ M'.toSubmodule := fun h ↦
    hμ ((weightSpace_subquotient_eq_bot_iff hV M' M μ).mpr h)
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, ν, h₁, h₁₂, h₂, hlt, hfac⟩ :=
    hV.exists_isLocalFactor_some hM'M.le (mem_cone_self μ) hμ'
  have hne : M₁ ≠ M₂ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
  have hM₁ : M₁ = M' := hmax' M₁ h₁ ((lt_of_le_of_ne h₁₂ hne).trans_le h₂)
  have hM₂ : M₂ = M := by
    by_contra h
    exact hne (hM₁.trans (hmax' M₂ (h₁.trans h₁₂) (lt_of_le_of_ne h₂ h)).symm)
  subst hM₁ hM₂
  obtain ⟨hμν, hψ⟩ := hfac
  refine ⟨M₁, hM'M, ν, ?_, hψ⟩
  
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries_of_le μ (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ M₁)
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries_of_le μ (le_top : M₂ ≤ ⊤)
  have hfac' : IsLocalFactor P μ M₁ M₂ (some ν) := ⟨hμν, hψ⟩
  have hl := hl₁.append (IsLocalCompositionSeries.cons_iff.mpr ⟨h₁₂, hfac', hl₂⟩)
  refine (hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff hμν hl).mpr ?_
  simp [factorWeights, List.filterMap_append]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_self (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) μ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSpace, ← map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P _
    (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top μ,
    show weightSpaceOfMap (VermaModule P μ) (h P) μ = K ∙ VermaModule.hwv P μ from
      VermaModule.weightSpace_self P μ, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  exact finrank_span_singleton (hwv_ne_zero P μ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot {μ ξ : Dual K H}
    (hξ : weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ ≠ ⊥) : ξ ∈ cone P μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hξ
  exact VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P μ _
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' _) hx hx0

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero
statement:
lemma mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero {μ ξ : Dual K H}
    (hξ : finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ) ≠ 0) : ξ ∈ cone P μ
proof:
:=
  mem_cone_of_weightSpace_ne_bot fun hbot ↦ hξ (by rw [hbot, finrank_bot])

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.finrank_inf_weightSpace_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_inf_weightSpace_eq (hξ : ν ∈ cone P ξ)
    {N M : LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V}
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν N l M) :
    finrank K ↥(M.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V ξ) =
      finrank K ↥(N.toSubmodule ⊓ weightSpace P V ξ) +
        ((factorWeights l).map
          fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing N with
  | nil =>
    rw [nil_iff.mp hl, factorWeights_nil, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero]
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨N', o⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨hNN', hf, hl'⟩ := cons_iff.mp hl
    rw [ih hl', finrank_inf_weightSpace_eq_add hV hNN' ξ]
    cases o with
    | none =>
      rw [hf ξ hξ, finrank_bot, add_zero, factorWeights_cons_none]
    | some μ =>
      obtain ⟨-, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hf
      rw [weightSpace, finrank_weightSpaceOfMap_equiv P e ξ, factorWeights_cons_some,
        List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.finrank_weightSpace_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_weightSpace_eq (hξ : ν ∈ cone P ξ)
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν ⊥ l ⊤) :
    finrank K (weightSpace P V ξ) =
      ((factorWeights l).map fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)).sum
proof:
:= by
  have := hl.finrank_inf_weightSpace_eq hV hξ
  rwa [LieSubmodule.top_toSubmodule, top_inf_eq, LieSubmodule.bot_toSubmodule, bot_inf_eq,
    finrank_bot, zero_add] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.eq_of_forall_sum_finrank_weightSpace_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_forall_sum_finrank_weightSpace_eq {ν : Dual K H} {s s' : Multiset (Dual K H)}
    (hs : ∀ μ ∈ s, ν ∈ cone P μ) (hs' : ∀ μ ∈ s', ν ∈ cone P μ)
    (h : ∀ ξ, ν ∈ cone P ξ →
      (s.map fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)).sum =
        (s'.map fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)).sum) :
    s = s'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices H : ∀ n, ∀ s s' : Multiset (Dual K H), Multiset.card (s + s') ≤ n →
      (∀ μ ∈ s + s', ν ∈ cone P μ) → (∀ ξ, ν ∈ cone P ξ →
        (s.map fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)).sum =
          (s'.map fun μ ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ) ξ)).sum) → s = s' from
    H _ s s' le_rfl (fun μ hμ ↦ (Multiset.mem_add.mp hμ).elim (hs μ) (hs' μ)) h
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro s s' hn _ _
    rw [Nat.le_zero, Multiset.card_eq_zero, add_eq_zero] at hn
    rw [hn.1, hn.2]
  | succ n ih =>
  intro s s' hn hss' h
  by_cases h0 : s + s' = 0
  · rw [add_eq_zero] at h0
    rw [h0.1, h0.2]
  
  set T : Set P.WeightOrd := toWeightOrd P '' ((s + s').toFinset : Set (Dual K H))
  have hTfin : T.Finite := (Finset.finite_toSet _).image _
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero h0
  have hTne : T.Nonempty := ⟨_, μ₀, by simpa using hμ₀, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨μ, hμT, rfl⟩, hmin⟩ := hTfin.exists_minimal hTne
  have hμ : μ ∈ s + s' := by simpa using hμT
  have key (μ' : Dual K H) (hμ' : μ' ∈ s + s')
      (hne : finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ') μ) ≠ 0) : μ' = μ := by
    have hle : toWeightOrd P μ' ≤ toWeightOrd P μ :=
      (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).mpr
        (IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero hne)
    exact (toWeightOrd P).injective (le_antisymm hle (hmin ⟨μ', by simpa using hμ', rfl⟩ hle))
  have hcount (t : Multiset (Dual K H)) (ht : t ≤ s + s') :
      (t.map fun μ' ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ') μ)).sum = t.count μ := by
    rw [Multiset.sum_map_eq_nsmul_single μ fun μ' hne hmem ↦ ?_,
      IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    by_contra h0
    exact hne (key μ' (Multiset.mem_of_le ht hmem) h0)
  have hc : s.count μ = s'.count μ := by
    rw [← hcount s (Multiset.le_add_right _ _), ← hcount s' (Multiset.le_add_left _ _)]
    exact h μ (hss' μ hμ)
  have hμs : μ ∈ s ∧ μ ∈ s' := by
    have := Multiset.count_pos.mpr hμ
    rw [Multiset.count_add] at this
    exact ⟨Multiset.count_pos.mp (by omega), Multiset.count_pos.mp (by omega)⟩
  rw [← Multiset.cons_erase hμs.1, ← Multiset.cons_erase hμs.2]
  congr 1
  refine ih _ _ ?_ (fun μ' hμ' ↦ ?_) fun ξ hξ ↦ ?_
  · have h1 := Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hμs.1
    have h2 := Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hμs.2
    have h3 := Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨_, hμs.1⟩
    have h4 := Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨_, hμs.2⟩
    rw [Multiset.card_add] at hn
    rw [Multiset.card_add, h1, h2, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
    omega
  · rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hμ' with hμ' | hμ'
    · exact hss' μ' (Multiset.mem_add.mpr (.inl (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hμ')))
    · exact hss' μ' (Multiset.mem_add.mpr (.inr (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hμ')))
  · have := h ξ hξ
    rw [← Multiset.cons_erase hμs.1, ← Multiset.cons_erase hμs.2, Multiset.map_cons,
      Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.sum_cons] at this
    exact add_left_cancel this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.sum_map_finrank_weightSpace_filter
statement:
lemma sum_map_finrank_weightSpace_filter {μ ξ : Dual K H}
    [DecidablePred fun μ' : Dual K H ↦ μ ∈ cone P μ'] (hξ : μ ∈ cone P ξ)
    (t : Multiset (Dual K H)) :
    ((t.filter fun μ' ↦ μ ∈ cone P μ').map
      fun μ' ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ') ξ)).sum =
      (t.map fun μ' ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ') ξ)).sum
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Multiset.filter_add_not (fun μ' ↦ μ ∈ cone P μ') t]
  rw [Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add, left_eq_add]
  refine Multiset.sum_eq_zero fun d hd ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨μ', hμ', rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hd
  by_contra hne
  exact (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hμ').2
    (mem_cone_trans hξ (IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero hne))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.count_factorWeights_eq
statement:
theorem IsLocalCompositionSeries.count_factorWeights_eq [DecidableEq (Dual K H)]
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {ν ν' μ : Dual K H} (hν : ν ∈ cone P μ) (hν' : ν' ∈ cone P μ)
    {l l' : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν ⊥ l ⊤) (hl' : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν' ⊥ l' ⊤) :
    (factorWeights l).count μ = (factorWeights l').count μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum {ν : Dual K H} (hν : ν ∈ cone P μ)
      {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
      (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν ⊥ l ⊤) (ξ : Dual K H) (hξ : μ ∈ cone P ξ) :
      (((factorWeights l : Multiset (Dual K H)).filter fun μ' ↦ μ ∈ cone P μ').map
        fun μ' ↦ finrank K (weightSpace P (IrreducibleModule P μ') ξ)).sum =
        finrank K (weightSpace P V ξ) := by
    rw [sum_map_finrank_weightSpace_filter hξ, hl.finrank_weightSpace_eq hV (mem_cone_trans hν hξ),
      Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sum_coe]
  have heq := eq_of_forall_sum_finrank_weightSpace_eq
    (fun μ' hμ' ↦ (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hμ').2) (fun μ' hμ' ↦ (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hμ').2)
    fun ξ hξ ↦ (hsum hν hl ξ hξ).trans (hsum hν' hl' ξ hξ).symm
  have hc := congrArg (Multiset.count μ) heq
  rwa [Multiset.count_filter_of_pos (p := fun μ' ↦ μ ∈ cone P μ') (mem_cone_self μ),
    Multiset.count_filter_of_pos (p := fun μ' ↦ μ ∈ cone P μ') (mem_cone_self μ),
    Multiset.coe_count, Multiset.coe_count] at hc

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.count_factorWeights_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem count_factorWeights_eq_multiplicity [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    {ν μ : Dual K H} (hν : ν ∈ cone P μ)
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν ⊥ l ⊤) :
    (factorWeights l).count μ = hV.multiplicity μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity, hl.count_factorWeights_eq hV hν (mem_cone_self μ)
    (hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ).choose_spec]
  convert rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem multiplicity_ne_zero_iff (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {ν μ : Dual K H} (hν : ν ∈ cone P μ)
    {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ν ⊥ l ⊤) :
    hV.multiplicity μ ≠ 0 ↔ μ ∈ factorWeights l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← hV.count_factorWeights_eq_multiplicity hν hl, ne_eq, List.count_eq_zero, not_not]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho [FiniteDimensional K H] (S : A.Symmetrization)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (μ + P.rho) (μ + P.rho) =
      P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ + P.dualBilinForm S P.rho P.rho
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq P.rho μ
  simp only [two_nsmul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at hsymm ⊢
  rw [hsymm]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho_eq_iff
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho_eq_iff [FiniteDimensional K H] (S : A.Symmetrization)
    (Λ μ : Dual K H) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) = P.dualBilinForm S (μ + P.rho) (μ + P.rho) ↔
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ = P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho, dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho, add_left_inj]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsCategoryO.exists_lie_e_mem_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  set u := ψ.symm (IrreducibleModule.hwv P μ)
  have hu : u ∈ weightSpace P (M₁.Subquotient M₂) μ :=
    map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P ψ.symm.toLieModuleHom (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace P μ)
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by simpa [u] using IrreducibleModule.hwv_ne_zero P μ
  have hue (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, u⁆ = 0 := by
    have : ⁅e P i, IrreducibleModule.hwv P μ⁆ = 0 := by
      rw [IrreducibleModule.hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero]
    rw [show u = ψ.symm.toLieModuleHom (IrreducibleModule.hwv P μ) from rfl,
      ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, this, map_zero]
  rw [weightSpace, ← map_weightSpaceOfMap_quotient P (M₁.comap M₂.incl)
    (hV.lieSubmodule M₂).iSup_weightSpaceOfMap_eq_top μ] at hu
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmu⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨m, mem_weightSpaceOfMap_lieSubmodule_iff.mp hm, m.2, fun hm₁ ↦ hu0 ?_, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← hmu]
    exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hm₁
  · have : LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' (M₁.comap M₂.incl) ⁅e P i, m⁆ = 0 := by
      rw [LieModuleHom.map_lie]
      exact (congrArg _ hmu).trans (hue i)
    rw [LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
    exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.mem_cone_and_eq_of_lie_e_mem
proof:
:= by
  set π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N
  have hπ : Function.Surjective (π.comp φ) :=
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N).comp hφ
  have hO : IsCategoryO P (V ⧸ N) := .of_surjective _ hπ
  have hw' : π w ∈ weightSpace P (V ⧸ N) μ := map_mem_weightSpaceOfMap P π hw
  have hw0 : π w ≠ 0 := by rwa [ne_eq, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  have he' (i : ι) : ⁅e P i, π w⁆ = 0 := by
    rw [← LieModuleHom.map_lie, LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact he i
  refine ⟨VermaModule.exists_eq_sub_of_mem_weightSpace P Λ _ hπ hw' hw0, ?_⟩
  exact smul_left_injective K hw0
    ((hB.casimir_eq_smul_of_surjective hA hO.isPosFinite _ hπ (π w)).symm.trans
      (hB.casimir_apply_of_lie_e_eq_zero hO.isPosFinite hw' he'))

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.mem_cone_and_eq_of_lie_e_eq_zero
proof:
:=
  hB.mem_cone_and_eq_of_lie_e_mem hA φ hφ ⊥ hw (by rwa [LieSubmodule.mem_bot])
    fun i ↦ by rw [he i]; exact LieSubmodule.zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.mem_cone_and_eq_of_mem_factorWeights
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, -, -, -, -, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ := hl.exists_of_mem_factorWeights hμ
  obtain ⟨w, hw, -, hw₁, he⟩ := (IsCategoryO.of_surjective φ hφ).exists_lie_e_mem_of_equiv ψ
  rw [dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho_eq_iff]
  exact hB.mem_cone_and_eq_of_lie_e_mem hA φ hφ M₁ hw hw₁ he

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.mem_cone_and_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_cone_and_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero {Λ : Dual K H}
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : hV.multiplicity μ ≠ 0) :
    μ ∈ cone P Λ ∧
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) = P.dualBilinForm S (μ + P.rho) (μ + P.rho)
proof:
:=
  have hl := (hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries μ).choose_spec
  hB.mem_cone_and_eq_of_mem_factorWeights hA φ hφ hl
    ((hV.multiplicity_ne_zero_iff (mem_cone_self μ) hl).mp hμ)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_cone_and_eq_of_mem_factorWeights
proof:
:=
  (isStandardForm_invForm P S).mem_cone_and_eq_of_mem_factorWeights hA φ hφ hl hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.mem_cone_and_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_cone_and_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero (S : A.Symmetrization) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : hV.multiplicity μ ≠ 0) :
    μ ∈ cone P Λ ∧
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + P.rho) (Λ + P.rho) = P.dualBilinForm S (μ + P.rho) (μ + P.rho)
