  (isStandardForm_invForm P S).mem_cone_and_eq_of_multiplicity_ne_zero hA φ hφ hV hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_eq_neg_rootOf_of_coeffAt_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exists_eq_neg_rootOf_of_coeffAt_denominator_ne_zero {ν : Dual K H}
    (h : (denominator P).coeffAt ν ≠ 0) : ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ν = -P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hν
  refine h ?_
  rw [coeffAt, denominator, SummableFamily.coeff_hsum]
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun S ↦ ?_
  simp only [denominatorFamily, SummableFamily.coe_mk]
  refine coeff_single_of_ne fun heq ↦ hν ?_
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkS⟩ := exists_finsetWt_eq_rootOf P S
  exact ⟨k, hk, by rw [← hkS]; exact (toWeightOrd P).injective heq⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_denominator_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [CharacterRing.coeff_mul, CharacterRing.coeff_mul]
  refine finsum_congr fun ν ↦ ?_
  by_cases hν : (denominator P).coeffAt ν = 0
  · rw [hν, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_neg_rootOf_of_coeffAt_denominator_ne_zero P hν
    rw [h _ ⟨k, hk, by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, add_sub_cancel_right]⟩]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_list_sum_map
statement:
lemma coeffAt_list_sum_map {α : Type*} (t : List α) (F : α → P.CharacterRing ℤ) (ξ : Dual K H) :
    (t.map F).sum.coeffAt ξ = (t.map fun a ↦ (F a).coeffAt ξ).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← ih]
    exact coeff_add

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsLocalCompositionSeries.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character
statement:
theorem IsLocalCompositionSeries.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character (hV : IsCategoryO P V)
    {ξ : Dual K H} {l : List (LieSubmodule K P.KacMoodyAlgebra V × Option (Dual K H))}
    (hl : IsLocalCompositionSeries P ξ ⊥ l ⊤) :
    (denominator P * hV.character).coeffAt ξ = ((factorWeights l).map fun μ ↦
      (denominator P * (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ).character).coeffAt ξ).sum
proof:
:= by
  have hagree (β : Dual K H) (hβ : ξ ∈ cone P β) : hV.character.coeffAt β =
      ((factorWeights l).map fun μ ↦ (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ).character).sum.coeffAt
        β := by
    rw [coeffAt_list_sum_map, IsCategoryO.coeffAt_character, hl.finrank_weightSpace_eq hV hβ,
      Nat.cast_list_sum, List.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [coeffAt_denominator_mul_eq hagree, ← List.sum_map_mul_left, coeffAt_list_sum_map]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_irreducibleModule_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_irreducibleModule_eq_zero {μ ξ : Dual K H}
    (hξ : ξ ∈ cone P μ)
    (hne : P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ ≠ P.dualBilinForm S (ξ + 2 • P.rho) ξ) :
    (denominator P * (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ).character).coeffAt ξ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hξμ⟩ := hξ
  suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (μ ξ : Dual K H) (k : ι → ℤ), 0 ≤ k → ξ = μ - P.rootOf k →
      ∑ i, k i ≤ n →
      P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ ≠ P.dualBilinForm S (ξ + 2 • P.rho) ξ →
      (denominator P * (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P μ).character).coeffAt ξ = 0 from
    H _ μ ξ k hk hξμ (Int.self_le_toNat _) hne
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro μ ξ k hk hξμ hkn hne
  have hμξ : ξ ≠ μ := fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ).exists_isLocalCompositionSeries ξ
  have hM := hl.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ)
  rw [VermaModule.denominator_mul_character, coeff_exp,
    ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h ↦ absurd h hμξ] at hM
  
  have hfac (κ : Dual K H) (hκ : κ ∈ factorWeights l) :
      κ ∈ cone P μ ∧ P.dualBilinForm S (μ + 2 • P.rho) μ =
        P.dualBilinForm S (κ + 2 • P.rho) κ := by
    have := hB.mem_cone_and_eq_of_mem_factorWeights hA LieModuleHom.id Function.surjective_id hl
      hκ
    rwa [dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho_eq_iff] at this
  
  have hzero (κ : Dual K H) (hκ : κ ∈ factorWeights l) (hne' : κ ≠ μ) :
      (denominator P * (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P κ).character).coeffAt ξ = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨⟨j, hj, hκμ⟩, hc⟩ := hfac κ hκ
    obtain ⟨k', hk', hξκ⟩ := hl.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights hκ
    have hkj : k = j + k' := P.rootOf_injective (by
      have e1 : P.rootOf k = μ - ξ := by rw [hξμ]; abel
      have e2 : P.rootOf j = μ - κ := by rw [hκμ]; abel
      have e3 : P.rootOf k' = κ - ξ := by rw [hξκ]; abel
      rw [map_add, e1, e2, e3]
      abel)
    have hj0 : j ∈ posCone ι := ⟨hj, fun h0 ↦ hne' (by rw [hκμ, h0, map_zero, sub_zero])⟩
    have h1 := one_le_sum_of_mem_posCone hj0
    have h2 : ∑ i, k i = ∑ i, j i + ∑ i, k' i := by
      rw [hkj, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rfl
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, k' i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hk' i
    exact ih (∑ i, k' i).toNat (by omega) κ ξ k' hk' hξκ (Int.self_le_toNat _)
      (by rwa [← hc])
  
  have hcount : (factorWeights l).count μ = 1 := by
    have hdim := hl.finrank_weightSpace_eq (VermaModule.isCategoryO P μ) ⟨k, hk, hξμ⟩ (ξ := μ)
    rw [show weightSpace P (VermaModule P μ) μ = K ∙ VermaModule.hwv P μ from
      VermaModule.weightSpace_self P μ, finrank_span_singleton (VermaModule.hwv_ne_zero P μ),
      List.sum_map_eq_nsmul_single μ _ fun κ hne' hκ ↦ ?_,
      IrreducibleModule.finrank_weightSpace_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hdim
    · exact hdim.symm
    · by_contra h0
      have h1 := IrreducibleModule.mem_cone_of_finrank_weightSpace_ne_zero h0
      obtain ⟨⟨j, hj, hκμ⟩, -⟩ := hfac κ hκ
      obtain ⟨j', hj', hμκ⟩ := h1
      have hjj : j + j' = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by
        have e2 : P.rootOf j = μ - κ := by rw [hκμ]; abel
        have e3 : P.rootOf j' = κ - μ := by rw [hμκ]; abel
        rw [map_add, map_zero, e2, e3]
        abel)
      have hj0 : j = 0 := le_antisymm (fun i ↦ by
        have := congrFun hjj i
        have := hj' i
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at *
        omega) hj
      exact hne' (by rw [hκμ, hj0, map_zero, sub_zero])
  rw [List.sum_map_eq_nsmul_single μ _ fun κ hne' hκ ↦ hzero κ hκ hne', hcount,
    one_smul] at hM
  exact hM.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.IsStandardForm.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_ne_zero {Λ : Dual K H}
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {ξ : Dual K H} (hξ : (denominator P * hV.character).coeffAt ξ ≠ 0) :
    ξ ∈ cone P Λ ∧
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ = P.dualBilinForm S (ξ + 2 • P.rho) ξ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hV.exists_isLocalCompositionSeries ξ
  rw [hl.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character hV] at hξ
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hne⟩ : ∃ κ ∈ factorWeights l,
      (denominator P * (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryO P κ).character).coeffAt ξ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hξ (List.sum_eq_zero fun x hx ↦ by
      obtain ⟨κ, hκ, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      exact h κ hκ)
  have hfac := hB.mem_cone_and_eq_of_mem_factorWeights hA φ hφ hl hκ
  rw [dualBilinForm_add_rho_add_rho_eq_iff] at hfac
  have hξκ := hl.mem_cone_of_mem_factorWeights hκ
  refine ⟨mem_cone_trans hξκ hfac.1, hfac.2.trans ?_⟩
  by_contra hc
  exact hne (hB.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_irreducibleModule_eq_zero hA hξκ hc)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_ne_zero (S : A.Symmetrization)
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {Λ : Dual K H}
    (φ : VermaModule P Λ →ₗ⁅K,P.KacMoodyAlgebra⁆ V) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hV : IsCategoryO P V) {ξ : Dual K H} (hξ : (denominator P * hV.character).coeffAt ξ ≠ 0) :
    ξ ∈ cone P Λ ∧
      P.dualBilinForm S (Λ + 2 • P.rho) Λ = P.dualBilinForm S (ξ + 2 • P.rho) ξ
proof:
:=
  (isStandardForm_invForm P S).coeffAt_denominator_mul_character_ne_zero hA φ hφ hV hξ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top
statement:
lemma IsBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top {Λs : Finset (Dual K H)} (hV : IsBounded P p V Λs) :
    ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun v _ ↦ ?_
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ (hV v)
  rintro w ⟨Λ, -, d, -, hw⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ hw

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.modWeightSpace_eq_weightSpaceOf
statement:
lemma modWeightSpace_eq_weightSpaceOf (μ : Dual K H) :
    modWeightSpace P p V μ = Module.End.weightSpaceOf (hAct P p V) μ
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.map_modWeightSpace_equiv
statement:
lemma map_modWeightSpace_equiv (φ : V ≃ₗ[P.SuperEnveloping p] W) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (modWeightSpace P p V μ).map (φ.restrictScalars K).toLinearMap = modWeightSpace P p W μ
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ a
    rw [← map_smul, hv a]; exact φ.toLinearMap.map_smul_of_tower _ _
  · intro hw
    refine ⟨φ.symm w, fun a ↦ ?_, φ.apply_symm_apply w⟩
    rw [← map_smul, hw a]; exact φ.symm.toLinearMap.map_smul_of_tower _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finrank_modWeightSpace_equiv
statement:
lemma finrank_modWeightSpace_equiv (φ : V ≃ₗ[P.SuperEnveloping p] W) (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) = finrank K (modWeightSpace P p W μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_modWeightSpace_equiv φ, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.map_modWeightSpace_submodule
statement:
lemma map_modWeightSpace_submodule (μ : Dual K H) :
    (modWeightSpace P p N μ).map (N.subtype.restrictScalars K) =
      modWeightSpace P p V μ ⊓ N.restrictScalars K
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, Submodule.coe_subtype,
    Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun a ↦ ?_, w.2⟩
    have := congr_arg Subtype.val (hw a)
    simpa using this
  · rintro ⟨hv, hvN⟩
    exact ⟨⟨v, hvN⟩, fun a ↦ Subtype.ext (by simpa using hv a), rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.iSup_modWeightSpace_submodule
statement:
lemma iSup_modWeightSpace_submodule (hV : ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊤) :
    ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p N μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun v _ ↦ ?_
  have hle := Module.End.inf_iSup_weightSpaceOf_le (hAct P p V) (N.restrictScalars K)
    fun a m hm ↦ N.smul_mem (h P p a) hm
  have hv : (v : V) ∈ N.restrictScalars K ⊓ ⨆ μ, Module.End.weightSpaceOf (hAct P p V) μ := by
    refine ⟨v.2, ?_⟩
    simp only [← modWeightSpace_eq_weightSpaceOf, hV]
    trivial
  have hmap : ⨆ μ, (N.restrictScalars K ⊓ Module.End.weightSpaceOf (hAct P p V) μ) =
      (⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p N μ).map (N.subtype.restrictScalars K) := by
    rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
    refine iSup_congr fun μ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_modWeightSpace_submodule, inf_comm, modWeightSpace_eq_weightSpaceOf]
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwv⟩ := hmap ▸ hle hv
  have : w = v := Subtype.ext hwv
  exact this ▸ hw

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finrank_modWeightSpace_submodule
statement:
lemma finrank_modWeightSpace_submodule (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p N μ) =
      finrank K ↥(modWeightSpace P p V μ ⊓ N.restrictScalars K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_modWeightSpace_submodule]
  exact (LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _
    (fun x y h ↦ Subtype.ext h) _))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.map_modWeightSpace_le_quotient
statement:
lemma map_modWeightSpace_le_quotient (μ : Dual K H) :
    (modWeightSpace P p V μ).map (N.mkQ.restrictScalars K) ≤ modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ N) μ
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ a
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, hv a, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.modWeightSpace_quotient
statement:
lemma modWeightSpace_quotient (hV : ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊤) (μ : Dual K H) :
    modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ N) μ = (modWeightSpace P p V μ).map (N.mkQ.restrictScalars K)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (map_modWeightSpace_le_quotient N μ)
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := N.mkQ_surjective x
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ ν, modWeightSpace P p V ν := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ _).1 hv
  have hsum : N.mkQ (c.sum fun _ x ↦ x) - N.mkQ (c μ) ∈
      ⨆ ν, ⨆ (_ : ν ≠ μ), modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ N) ν := by
    have : N.mkQ (c.sum fun _ x ↦ x) - N.mkQ (c μ) =
        (c.erase μ).sum fun _ x ↦ N.mkQ x := by
      rw [← Finsupp.add_sum_erase' c μ (fun _ x ↦ x) (fun _ ↦ rfl), map_add, add_sub_cancel_left,
        map_finsuppSum]
    rw [this]
    refine Submodule.finsuppSum_mem _ _ _ _ fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    have hνμ : ν ≠ μ := fun h ↦ hν (h ▸ Finsupp.erase_same)
    rw [Finsupp.erase_ne hνμ]
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hνμ
      (map_modWeightSpace_le_quotient N ν ⟨c ν, hc ν, rfl⟩))
  have hmem : N.mkQ (c.sum fun _ x ↦ x) - N.mkQ (c μ) ∈ modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ N) μ :=
    sub_mem hx (map_modWeightSpace_le_quotient N μ ⟨c μ, hc μ, rfl⟩)
  have h0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 ((iSupIndep_modWeightSpace (V ⧸ N)) μ) _ hmem hsum
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at h0
  rw [h0]
  exact ⟨c μ, hc μ, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finrank_modWeightSpace_eq_add
statement:
theorem finrank_modWeightSpace_eq_add (hV : ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊤) (μ : Dual K H)
    [FiniteDimensional K (modWeightSpace P p V μ)] :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) =
      finrank K (modWeightSpace P p N μ) + finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ N) μ)
proof:
:= by
  set f := (N.mkQ.restrictScalars K).domRestrict (modWeightSpace P p V μ)
  have hrange : LinearMap.range f = modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ N) μ := by
    rw [modWeightSpace_quotient N hV, LinearMap.range_domRestrict]
  have hker : finrank K (LinearMap.ker f) =
      finrank K ↥(modWeightSpace P p V μ ⊓ N.restrictScalars K) := by
    refine LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
      ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective ((modWeightSpace P p V μ).subtype)
        (Submodule.injective_subtype _) _).trans (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ ?_))
    ext v
    simp only [Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_inf,
      Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, Submodule.coe_subtype]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨w.2, ?_⟩
      simpa [f, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] using hw
    · rintro ⟨hv, hvN⟩
      exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, by simpa [f, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] using hvN, rfl⟩
  rw [← LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f, hrange, hker,
    finrank_modWeightSpace_submodule, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_adRep_pow_mem_maxIdeal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  rw [smul_toAd, toAd_mem_maxIdealAd P p, map_pow] at hn
  refine ⟨n, fun k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hk
  rw [add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_pow]
  exact adRep_mem_maxIdeal _ hn

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.pow_smul_smul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma pow_smul_smul_eq_zero (hV : IsGModule P p V) {x g : 𝒰} {a b : ℕ}
    (hx : ∀ z, adRep P p x z = x * z - z * x)
    (hg : ∀ k, a ≤ k → (adRep P p x ^ k) g ∈ maxIdeal P p) {v : V} (hv : x ^ b • v = 0) :
    x ^ (a + b) • (g • v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have had : ∀ k (y : 𝒰), (LieAlgebra.ad K 𝒰 x ^ k) y = (adRep P p x ^ k) y := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro y; rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro y
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih,
        LieAlgebra.ad_apply, Ring.lie_def, hx]
  have hgv : g • v = ⁅g, v⁆ := rfl
  rw [hgv, ← toEnd_pow_apply, LieModule.toEnd_pow_lie]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ij hij ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hij
  rw [had, toEnd_pow_apply]
  change _ • ((adRep P p x ^ ij.1) g • (x ^ ij.2 • v)) = 0
  by_cases hi : a ≤ ij.1
  · rw [hV _ (hg _ hi), smul_zero]
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' (show b ≤ ij.2 by omega)
    rw [hc, pow_add, mul_smul, hv, smul_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.pow_smul_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
lemma pow_smul_eq_zero_of_le {x : 𝒰} {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) {v : V} (hv : x ^ n • v = 0) :
    x ^ k • v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hnk
  rw [pow_add, mul_smul, hv, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_e_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma exists_e_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff (i : ι) (v : V) :
    (∃ n, e P p i ^ n • v = 0) ↔ ∃ n, sl2E P p i ^ n • v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ∀ n, ((sl2Deg p i : K) ^ n) ≠ 0 := fun n ↦
    pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast (sl2Deg_pos p i).ne')
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n (sl2Deg_pos p i))
    have := congr_arg (e P p i ^ c • ·) hn
    simp only [smul_zero, ← mul_smul, ← pow_add] at this
    rw [add_comm, ← hc, e_pow_sl2Deg_mul, smul_assoc] at this
    exact (smul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left (hd n)
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨sl2Deg p i * n, by rw [e_pow_sl2Deg_mul, smul_assoc, hn, smul_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_f_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma exists_f_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff (i : ι) (v : V) :
    (∃ n, f P p i ^ n • v = 0) ↔ ∃ n, sl2F P p i ^ n • v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : sl2FCoeff (K := K) p i ≠ 0 := by
    unfold sl2FCoeff; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hd : ∀ n, ((sl2FCoeff (K := K) p i)⁻¹ ^ n) ≠ 0 := fun n ↦ pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hc0)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n (sl2Deg_pos p i))
    have := congr_arg (f P p i ^ c • ·) hn
    simp only [smul_zero, ← mul_smul, ← pow_add] at this
    rw [add_comm, ← hc, f_pow_sl2Deg_mul, smul_assoc] at this
    exact (smul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left (hd n)
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨sl2Deg p i * n, by rw [f_pow_sl2Deg_mul, smul_assoc, hn, smul_zero]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.span_hwv
statement: lemma GVerma.span_hwv (Λ : Dual K H) : Submodule.span 𝒰 {GVerma.hwv P p Λ} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun v _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := GVerma.exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv v
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span rfl)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_adRep_sl2E_pow_mem
statement:
lemma exists_adRep_sl2E_pow_mem (i : ι) {g : 𝒰} (hg : g ∈ gTilde P p) :
    ∃ a, ∀ k, a ≤ k → (adRep P p (sl2E P p i) ^ k) g ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:=
  exists_adRep_pow_mem_maxIdeal (exists_sl2E_pow_smul_mem (maxIdealAd P p)
    (fun _ _ hij ↦ (toAd_mem_maxIdealAd P p).2 (serreE_mem_maxIdeal P p S hA hp hij)) i hg)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_adRep_sl2F_pow_mem
statement:
lemma exists_adRep_sl2F_pow_mem (i : ι) {g : 𝒰} (hg : g ∈ gTilde P p) :
    ∃ a, ∀ k, a ≤ k → (adRep P p (sl2F P p i) ^ k) g ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:=
  exists_adRep_pow_mem_maxIdeal (exists_sl2F_pow_smul_mem (maxIdealAd P p)
    (fun _ _ hij ↦ (toAd_mem_maxIdealAd P p).2 (serreF_mem_maxIdeal P p S hA hp hij)) i hg)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isIntegrableAt_of_span
proof:
:= by
  let NE := nilSubmodule P p V hV (adRep_sl2E_apply P p i)
    (fun j ↦ exists_adRep_sl2E_pow_mem S hA hp i (e_mem_gTilde P p j))
    (fun j ↦ exists_adRep_sl2E_pow_mem S hA hp i (f_mem_gTilde P p j))
    (fun c ↦ exists_adRep_sl2E_pow_mem S hA hp i (h_mem_gTilde P p c))
  let NF := nilSubmodule P p V hV (adRep_sl2F_apply P p i)
    (fun j ↦ exists_adRep_sl2F_pow_mem S hA hp i (e_mem_gTilde P p j))
    (fun j ↦ exists_adRep_sl2F_pow_mem S hA hp i (f_mem_gTilde P p j))
    (fun c ↦ exists_adRep_sl2F_pow_mem S hA hp i (h_mem_gTilde P p c))
  have hE : NE = ⊤ := eq_top_iff.2 (hs ▸ Submodule.span_le.2 fun v hv ↦
    (exists_e_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff i v).1 (hse v hv))
  have hF : NF = ⊤ := eq_top_iff.2 (hs ▸ Submodule.span_le.2 fun v hv ↦
    (exists_f_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff i v).1 (hsf v hv))
  intro v
  refine ⟨(exists_e_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff i v).2 ?_, (exists_f_pow_smul_eq_zero_iff i v).2 ?_⟩
  · have : v ∈ NE := hE ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact this
  · have : v ∈ NF := hF ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isIntegrableAt_quotient
statement:
theorem isIntegrableAt_quotient (Λ : Dual K H) (i : ι) (m : ℕ) :
    IsIntegrableAt P p
      (GVerma P p Λ ⧸ Submodule.span 𝒰 {f P p i ^ m • hwv P p Λ}) i
proof:
:= by
  set N := Submodule.span 𝒰 {f P p i ^ m • hwv P p Λ}
  refine isIntegrableAt_of_span S hA hp (s := {N.mkQ (hwv P p Λ)}) ?_ i ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx v
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := N.mkQ_surjective v
    rw [← map_smul, isGModule x hx v, map_zero]
  · rw [← Set.image_singleton, ← Submodule.map_span, span_hwv, Submodule.map_top,
      Submodule.range_mkQ]
  · rintro _ rfl
    exact ⟨1, by rw [pow_one, ← map_smul, e_smul_hwv, map_zero]⟩
  · rintro _ rfl
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    rw [← map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact Submodule.subset_span rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_nat_of_e_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ⁅sl2E P p i, v⁆ = 0 := by
    change sl2E P p i • v = 0
    unfold sl2E
    split_ifs
    · rw [smul_assoc, sq, mul_smul, he, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    · exact he
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsSl2Triple.HasPrimitiveVectorWith.exists_nat_of_exists_pow_eq_zero
    (t := isSl2Triple P p (hA := hA) i) ⟨hv0, sl2H_smul hv i, hE⟩ (hV.exists_sl2F i v)
  exact ⟨n, by rw [apply_coroot_eq, hn]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_serreIdeal
statement: lemma mem_serreIdeal {x : 𝒰} : x ∈ serreIdeal P p ↔ toAd P p x ∈ serreAd P p
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreIdeal_le_gTilde
statement: lemma serreIdeal_le_gTilde : serreIdeal P p ≤ gTilde P p
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦
  (toAd_mem_gTildeAd P p).1 (serreAd_le_gTildeAd P p hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma adRep_mem_serreIdeal (u : 𝒰) {z : 𝒰} (hz : z ∈ serreIdeal P p) :
    adRep P p u z ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:

  exact (serreAd P p).smul_mem u hz

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isIdeal_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem isIdeal_serreIdeal : IsIdeal P p (serreIdeal P p) where
  le_gTilde
proof:
:= serreIdeal_le_gTilde P p
  superBracket_mem x hx y hy := by
    rw [← adRep_of_mem_gTilde hx]
    exact adRep_mem_serreIdeal x hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreE_mem_serreIdeal

  serreE_mem_serreAd P p hij

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreF_mem_serreIdeal
