name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal
statement: theorem serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal : serreIdeal P p ≤ maxIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  have : serreAd P p ≤ maxIdealAd P p := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨i, j, hij, rfl | rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact (toAd_mem_maxIdealAd P p).2 (serreE_mem_maxIdeal P p S hA hp hij)
    · exact (toAd_mem_maxIdealAd P p).2 (serreF_mem_maxIdeal P p S hA hp hij)
  exact fun x hx ↦ (toAd_mem_maxIdealAd P p).1 (this hx)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_e_mem_serreIdeal_of_minimal
statement:
theorem superBracket_e_mem_serreIdeal_of_minimal {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      maxIdeal P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf l) ≤ serreIdeal P p)
    {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ maxIdeal P p) (hxk : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf k)) (i : ι) :
    superBracket P p (e P p i) x ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  have hyr : superBracket P p (e P p i) x ∈ maxIdeal P p :=
    (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (e_mem_gTilde P p i) _ hx
  have hyk : superBracket P p (e P p i) x ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf (k - Pi.single i 1)) := by
    have := superBracket_mem_weightSpace (e_mem_weightSpace P p i) hxk
    rwa [map_sub, rootOf_single, neg_sub, sub_eq_neg_add, add_comm]
  have hyg := (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hyr
  rcases SerrePresentedAlgebra.sub_single_mem_posCone_or P hk i with hl | hl | hl
  · rw [hl, map_zero, neg_zero] at hyk
    have : superBracket P p (e P p i) x ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]
      exact ⟨hyr, hyg, hyk⟩
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _
  · have hlt : height (k - Pi.single i 1) < height k := by
      have := height_add (k - Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single i 1)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
      have h1 : height (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) = 1 := by simp [height]
      omega
    exact hmin _ hl hlt ⟨hyr, hyk⟩
  · by_contra hne
    exact hl (mem_allWeights P p hyg hyk fun h0 ↦ hne (h0 ▸ zero_mem _))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sum_mul_le_zero_of_minimal
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_zero_of_minimal {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      maxIdeal P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf l) ≤ serreIdeal P p)
    {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ maxIdeal P p) (hxk : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf k))
    (hxS : x ∉ serreIdeal P p) (i : ι) : ∑ j, A i j * k j ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hV := isIntegrable_quotient (serreAd P p) (fun _ _ hij ↦ serreE_mem_serreAd P p hij)
    (fun _ _ hij ↦ serreF_mem_serreAd P p hij)
  have hxg := (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hx
  have hmk : ∀ (y : 𝒰) (hy : y ∈ gTilde P p),
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := (serreAd P p).comap (gTildeAd P p).subtype)
        ⟨toAd P p y, (toAd_mem_gTildeAd P p).2 hy⟩ = 0 ↔ y ∈ serreIdeal P p) := fun y hy ↦ by
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    rfl
  set v := Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := (serreAd P p).comap (gTildeAd P p).subtype)
    ⟨toAd P p x, (toAd_mem_gTildeAd P p).2 hxg⟩
  have hsmul : ∀ u : 𝒰, u • v = Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := (serreAd P p).comap
      (gTildeAd P p).subtype) ⟨toAd P p (adRep P p u x),
        (toAd_mem_gTildeAd P p).2 (adRep_mem_gTilde u hxg)⟩ := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hxS ((hmk x hxg).1 h0)
  have hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p _ (-P.rootOf k) := fun a ↦ by
    rw [hsmul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
    congr 1
    ext
    change toAd P p (adRep P p (h P p a) x) = (-P.rootOf k) a • toAd P p x
    rw [adRep_of_mem_gTilde (h_mem_gTilde P p a), superBracket_h_of_mem_weightSpace P p a hxk,
      map_smul]
  have he : e P p i • v = 0 := by
    rw [hsmul, hmk _ (adRep_mem_gTilde _ hxg), adRep_of_mem_gTilde (e_mem_gTilde P p i)]
    exact superBracket_e_mem_serreIdeal_of_minimal hk hmin hx hxk i
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_of_e_smul_eq_zero hA hV hv hv0 he
  rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, rootOf_apply_coroot, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg] at hn
  have : (∑ j, A i j * k j : ℤ) = -((sl2Deg p i * n : ℕ) : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nPlusRoot_le_nPlus
statement: lemma nPlusRoot_le_nPlus (k : ι → ℤ) : nPlusRoot P p k ≤ nPlus P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨i, w, _, hx⟩ ↦ hx ▸ eLie_mem_nPlus P p i w

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_word_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fAlg_word_mem_weightSpace (w : List ι) :
    fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf (wordVec w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rw [FreeAlgebra.word_nil, map_one]; simpa using one_mem_weightSpace P p
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [FreeAlgebra.word_cons, map_mul, fAlg_ι, wordVec_cons, map_add, rootOf_single, neg_add]
    exact mul_mem_weightSpace P p (f_mem_weightSpace P p j) ih

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_nMinus_or_mem_nPlus_of_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem mem_nMinus_or_mem_nPlus_of_mem_weightSpace {μ : Dual K H} {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) : x ∈ nMinus P p ∨ x ∈ nPlus P p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact Or.inl (hx0 ▸ zero_mem _)
  rcases mem_allWeights P p hx hxμ hx0 with (⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ | h0) | ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · left
    have h1 : omega P p (parity P p x) ∈ gTilde P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (P.rootOf k) :=
      ⟨omega_mem_gTilde P p (parity_mem_gTilde P p hx),
        by simpa using omega_mem_weightSpace P p (parity_mem_weightSpace P p hxμ)⟩
    rw [gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf P p hk] at h1
    have h2 := omega_mem_nMinus P p (nPlusRoot_le_nPlus P p k h1)
    rwa [← AlgHom.comp_apply, omega_comp_omega, parity_parity] at h2
  · exact absurd h0 hμ
  · right
    refine nPlusRoot_le_nPlus P p k ?_
    rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_rootOf P p hk]
    exact ⟨hx, hxμ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_fPre
statement: lemma mem_fPre {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} : t ∈ fPre P p ↔ fAlg P p t ∈ maxIdeal P p
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre
statement: lemma mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ fPre P p) : t ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ht

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_h_mul_fAlg
statement:
lemma exists_h_mul_fAlg (a : H) (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    ∃ y, h P p a * fAlg P p x = fAlg P p x * h P p a + fAlg P p y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => exact ⟨0, by simp [Algebra.commutes]⟩
  | grade1 i =>
    refine ⟨-(P.root i a) • FreeAlgebra.ι K i, ?_⟩
    rw [fAlg_ι, h_mul_f, map_smul, fAlg_ι, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', hx⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', hy⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨x' * y + x * y', ?_⟩
    simp only [map_mul, map_add]
    rw [← mul_assoc, hx, add_mul, mul_assoc, hy]
    noncomm_ring
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', hx⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', hy⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨x' + y', by simp only [map_add, mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy]; abel⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_h_mul_fAlg_of_mem_fPre
statement:
lemma exists_h_mul_fAlg_of_mem_fPre (a : H) {r : FreeAlgebra K ι} (hr : r ∈ fPre P p) :
    ∃ y ∈ fPre P p, h P p a * fAlg P p r = fAlg P p r * h P p a + fAlg P p y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_h_mul_fAlg a r
  refine ⟨y, ?_, hy⟩
  have : fAlg P p y = superBracket P p (h P p a) (fAlg P p r) := by
    rw [superBracket_of_even_left P p (isEven_h P p a), hy, add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [mem_fPre, this]
  exact (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a) _ hr

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_smul_of_smul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma superBracket_smul_of_smul_eq_zero {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Module (P.SuperEnveloping p) V] [IsScalarTower K (P.SuperEnveloping p) V] {x : 𝒰} {m : V}
    (hx : x • m = 0) (hσx : parity P p x • m = 0) (y : 𝒰) :
    superBracket P p x y • m = x • y • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [superBracket, sub_smul, smul_assoc, add_smul, mul_smul (y + _), mul_smul (y - _), hx, hσx]
  simp [mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.mem_gSub_iff
statement:
lemma mem_gSub_iff {v : Verma P p Λ} :
    v ∈ gSub P p Λ ↔ ∃ t ∈ gIdeal P p, fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [gSub, Submodule.mem_map]
  simp only [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, toTensorEquiv_symm_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff
statement:
lemma fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} :
    fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ ∈ gSub P p Λ ↔ t ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ht ↦ mem_gSub_iff.2 ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hst⟩ := mem_gSub_iff.1 h
  rw [← toTensorEquiv_symm_apply, ← toTensorEquiv_symm_apply] at hst
  rwa [← (toTensorEquiv P p Λ).symm.injective hst]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.fAlg_smul_mem_gSub
statement:
lemma fAlg_smul_mem_gSub (b : FreeAlgebra K ι) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ gSub P p Λ) :
    fAlg P p b • v ∈ gSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_gSub_iff.1 hv
  rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul, fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff]
  exact (gIdeal P p).smul_mem b ht

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.f_smul_mem_gSub
statement:
lemma f_smul_mem_gSub (i : ι) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ gSub P p Λ) :
    f P p i • v ∈ gSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  simpa using fAlg_smul_mem_gSub (FreeAlgebra.ι K i) hv

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.smul_hwv_mem_gSub
statement: theorem smul_hwv_mem_gSub {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ maxIdeal P p) : x • hwv P p Λ ∈ gSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hle := le_iSup_inf_weightSpace P p (maxIdeal P p) (fun a y hy ↦
    (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a) y hy) hx
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun y ↦ y • hwv P p Λ ∈ gSub P p Λ) hle ?_
    (by simp) (fun y z hy hz ↦ by rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem hy hz)
  rintro μ y ⟨hy, hyμ⟩
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · subst hμ
    have : y ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]
      exact ⟨(isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hy, hyμ⟩
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    simp [this]
  rcases mem_nMinus_or_mem_nPlus_of_mem_weightSpace ((isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hy) hyμ hμ
    with hn | hn
  · obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := nMinus_le_fAug P p hn
    exact fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff.2 (mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre hy)
  · have := nPlus_le_vermaIdeal P p Λ hn
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem] at this
    rw [← mk_eq_smul_hwv, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 this]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.h_smul_mem_gSub
statement:
theorem h_smul_mem_gSub (a : H) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ gSub P p Λ) :
    h P p a • v ∈ gSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_gSub_iff.1 hv
  clear hv
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem r hr =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hry⟩ := exists_h_mul_fAlg_of_mem_fPre a hr
    rw [smul_smul, hry, add_smul, mul_smul, h_smul_hwv, smul_comm]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff.2
      (mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre hr))) (fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff.2 (mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre hy))
  | zero => simp
  | add s t _ _ hs ht => rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add]; exact add_mem hs ht
  | smul b t ht' ht =>
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := exists_h_mul_fAlg a b
    rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_smul, smul_smul, hb', add_smul]
    refine add_mem ?_ ?_
    · rw [mul_smul]; exact fAlg_smul_mem_gSub b ht
    · rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul]
      exact fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff.2 ((gIdeal P p).smul_mem b' ht')

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.e_smul_fAlg_smul_mem_gSub
statement:
lemma e_smul_fAlg_smul_mem_gSub (b : FreeAlgebra K ι) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ gSub P p Λ)
    (he : ∀ j, e P p j • v ∈ gSub P p Λ) (i : ι) : e P p i • fAlg P p b • v ∈ gSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction b using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing v i with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul, smul_comm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (he i)
  | grade1 j =>
    rw [fAlg_ι, smul_smul, e_mul_f, add_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (f_smul_mem_gSub j (he i))) ?_
    split_ifs
    · exact h_smul_mem_gSub _ hv
    · simp
  | mul b c hb hc =>
    rw [map_mul, mul_smul]
    exact hb (fAlg_smul_mem_gSub c hv) (fun j ↦ hc hv he j) i
  | add b c hb hc =>
    rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add]
    exact add_mem (hb hv he i) (hc hv he i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.e_smul_mem_gSub
statement:
theorem e_smul_mem_gSub (i : ι) {v : Verma P p Λ} (hv : v ∈ gSub P p Λ) :
    e P p i • v ∈ gSub P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := mem_gSub_iff.1 hv
  clear hv
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction generalizing i with
  | mem r hr =>
    rw [← superBracket_smul_of_smul_eq_zero (e_smul_hwv P p Λ i) (by
      rw [parity_e, smul_assoc, e_smul_hwv, smul_zero])]
    exact smul_hwv_mem_gSub ((isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (e_mem_gTilde P p i) _ hr)
  | zero => simp
  | add s t _ _ hs ht => rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add]; exact add_mem (hs i) (ht i)
  | smul b t ht' ht =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_smul]
    exact e_smul_fAlg_smul_mem_gSub b (fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff.2 ht') ht i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.mem_gSubU
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_gSubU {v : Verma P p Λ} : v ∈ gSubU P p Λ ↔ v ∈ gSub P p Λ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.Verma.smul_mem_gSubU
statement:
theorem smul_mem_gSubU (u : 𝒰) {m : Verma P p Λ} (hm : ∀ x ∈ maxIdeal P p, x • m ∈ gSubU P p Λ)
    {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ maxIdeal P p) : x • u • m ∈ gSubU P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction generalizing m x with
  | algebraMap c => rw [algebraMap_smul, smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ c (hm x hx)
  | add y z hy hz => rw [add_smul, smul_add]; exact add_mem (hy hm hx) (hz hm hx)
  | mul y z hy hz => rw [mul_smul]; exact hy (fun x hx ↦ hz hm hx) hx
  | e i => exact gen_aux (isHomog_e P p i) (e_mem_gTilde P p i) hm hx
  | f i => exact gen_aux (isHomog_f P p i) (f_mem_gTilde P p i) hm hx
  | h a => exact gen_aux (isHomog_h P p a) (h_mem_gTilde P p a) hm hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv
statement: lemma exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv (v : GVerma P p Λ) : ∃ t, fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective (Verma.gSubU P p Λ) v
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective (vermaIdeal P p Λ) v
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_sub_fAlg_mem_vermaIdeal P p Λ u
  have : (Submodule.Quotient.mk u : Verma P p Λ) = fAlg P p t • Verma.hwv P p Λ := by
    rw [← Verma.mk_eq_smul_hwv]; exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).2 ht
  exact ⟨t, by rw [this, hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.e_smul_hwv
statement: lemma e_smul_hwv (i : ι) : e P p i • hwv P p Λ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Verma.e_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.h_smul_hwv
statement: lemma h_smul_hwv (a : H) : h P p a • hwv P p Λ = Λ a • hwv P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Verma.h_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isGModule
statement: theorem isGModule : IsGModule P p (GVerma P p Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx v
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective (Verma.gSubU P p Λ) v
  have h1 : x • v ∈ Verma.gSubU P p Λ := by
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective (vermaIdeal P p Λ) v
    rw [Verma.mk_eq_smul_hwv]
    exact Verma.smul_mem_gSubU u (fun y hy ↦ Verma.mem_gSubU.2 (Verma.smul_hwv_mem_gSub hy)) hx
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 h1]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} :
    fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ = 0 ↔ t ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Verma.mem_gSubU,
    Verma.fAlg_smul_hwv_mem_gSub_iff]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.fAlg_word_smul_hwv_mem
statement:
lemma fAlg_word_smul_hwv_mem (w : List ι) :
    fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) • hwv P p Λ ∈
      modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) (Λ - P.rootOf (wordVec w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_neg_add]
  exact smul_mem_modWeightSpace _ (fAlg_word_mem_weightSpace P p w) h_smul_hwv

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.isBounded
statement: theorem isBounded : IsBounded P p (GVerma P p Λ) {Λ}
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv v
  have ht : t ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (FreeAlgebra.basisFreeMonoid K ι)) := by
    rw [Basis.span_eq]; trivial
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_singleton_self Λ, wordVec (FreeMonoid.toList w),
      wordVec_nonneg _, ?_⟩
    simpa [FreeAlgebra.word] using fAlg_word_smul_hwv_mem (Λ := Λ) (FreeMonoid.toList w)
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, smul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.gSubU_le_ker
statement:
lemma gSubU_le_ker :
    Verma.gSubU P p Λ ≤ LinearMap.ker (Verma.lift P p Λ m he hh)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Verma.mem_gSub_iff.1 (Verma.mem_gSubU.1 hv)
  clear hv
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_smul, Verma.lift_hwv]
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem r hr => exact hV _ hr m
  | zero => simp
  | add s t _ _ hs ht => rw [map_add, add_smul, hs, ht, add_zero]
  | smul b t _ ht => rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_smul, ht, smul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.lift_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_hwv : lift hV m he hh (hwv P p Λ) = m
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, hwv]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_setOf_rootOf_wordVec_eq
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_rootOf_wordVec_eq (β : Dual K H) :
    {w : List ι | P.rootOf (wordVec w) = β}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hβ : ∃ d, P.rootOf d = β
  · refine (List.finite_length_eq (α := ι) (n := (∑ i, hβ.choose i).toNat)).subset fun w hw ↦ ?_
    have : wordVec w = hβ.choose := P.rootOf_injective (hw.trans hβ.choose_spec.symm)
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [← this, sum_wordVec, Int.toNat_natCast]
  · exact Set.Finite.subset Set.finite_empty fun w hw ↦ hβ ⟨_, hw⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightProj_zero_eq_zero_of_mem_fPre
statement:
lemma weightProj_zero_eq_zero_of_mem_fPre {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ fPre P p) :
    FreeAlgebra.weightProj K 0 t = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply fAlg_injective P p
  rw [map_zero, ← wProj_fAlg]
  have h0 : -P.rootOf (natVec (0 : ι →₀ ℕ)) = 0 := by
    have : natVec (0 : ι →₀ ℕ) = 0 := by funext i; simp [natVec]
    rw [this, map_zero, neg_zero]
  rw [h0]
  have hle : (⨆ μ ∈ {μ : Dual K H | μ ≠ 0}, weightSpace P p μ) ≤ LinearMap.ker (wProj P p 0) :=
    iSup₂_le fun μ hμ y hy ↦ LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (wProj_of_mem_ne P p hμ hy)
  exact LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (hle (maxIdeal_le_iSup_ne_zero P p ((mem_fPre).1 ht)))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightProj_zero_eq_zero_of_mem_gIdeal
statement:
lemma weightProj_zero_eq_zero_of_mem_gIdeal {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ gIdeal P p) :
    FreeAlgebra.weightProj K 0 t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact weightProj_zero_eq_zero_of_mem_fPre hx
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add y z hy hz => rw [add_mul, map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
    | smul c y hy => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hy, smul_zero]
    | word w =>
      rw [FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis_mul]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 h, tsub_zero, hx, mul_zero]
      · rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.one_notMem_gIdeal
statement: lemma one_notMem_gIdeal : (1 : FreeAlgebra K ι) ∉ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := weightProj_zero_eq_zero_of_mem_gIdeal h
  rw [← FreeAlgebra.word_nil (R := K) (X := ι), word_eq_wordBasis,
    FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis] at this
  simp only [LusztigF.wordWeight_nil, ↓reduceIte] at this
  rw [← word_eq_wordBasis, FreeAlgebra.word_nil] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.hwv_ne_zero
statement: theorem hwv_ne_zero : hwv P p Λ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  refine one_notMem_gIdeal (P := P) (p := p) ((fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff (Λ := Λ)).1 ?_)
  rw [map_one, one_smul, h0]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.wordVector_nil
statement: lemma wordVector_nil : wordVector P p Λ [] = hwv P p Λ
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordVector, FreeAlgebra.word_nil]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.wordVector_mem
statement:
lemma wordVector_mem (w : List ι) :
    wordVector P p Λ w ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) (Λ - P.rootOf (wordVec w))
proof:
:=
  fAlg_word_smul_hwv_mem w

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.span_wordVector
statement: lemma span_wordVector : Submodule.span K (Set.range (wordVector P p Λ)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.eq_top_iff'.2 fun v ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv v
  have ht : t ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (FreeAlgebra.basisFreeMonoid K ι)) := by
    rw [Basis.span_eq]; trivial
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨FreeMonoid.toList w, by simp [wordVector, FreeAlgebra.word]⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, smul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.modWeightSpace_sub_eq
statement:
theorem modWeightSpace_sub_eq (β : Dual K H) :
    modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) (Λ - β) =
      Submodule.span K (wordVector P p Λ '' {w | P.rootOf (wordVec w) = β})
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun v hv ↦ ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · have hG : ∀ g ∈ Set.range (wordVector P p Λ), ∃ ν, g ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) ν :=
      fun g ⟨w, hw⟩ ↦ ⟨_, hw ▸ wordVector_mem w⟩
    have := (iSupIndep_modWeightSpace (GVerma P p Λ)).mem_span_inter hG
      (span_wordVector P p Λ ▸ Submodule.mem_top) hv
    rw [← Submodule.span_insert_zero (R := K)]
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ this
    rintro g ⟨⟨w, rfl⟩, hg⟩
    by_cases h0 : wordVector P p Λ w = 0
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · refine Or.inr ⟨w, ?_, rfl⟩
      by_contra hne
      refine h0 (Submodule.disjoint_def.1
        ((iSupIndep_modWeightSpace (GVerma P p Λ)).pairwiseDisjoint
          (fun h ↦ hne (sub_right_injective h))) _ (wordVector_mem w) hg)
  · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hw ▸ wordVector_mem w

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.ofTensor_apply
statement: lemma ofTensor_apply (t : FreeAlgebra K ι) : ofTensor P p Λ t = fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.ker_ofTensor
statement: lemma ker_ofTensor : LinearMap.ker (ofTensor P p Λ) = (gIdeal P p).restrictScalars K
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ofTensor_apply, fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.surjective_ofTensor
statement: lemma surjective_ofTensor : Function.Surjective (ofTensor P p Λ)
proof:
:=
  fun v ↦ exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv v

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.shiftEquiv_fAlg_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma shiftEquiv_fAlg_smul_hwv (Λ' : Dual K H) (t : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    shiftEquiv P p Λ Λ' (fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ) = fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ'
proof:
:= by
  have : ((ofTensor P p Λ).quotKerEquivOfSurjective surjective_ofTensor).symm
      (fAlg P p t • hwv P p Λ) = Submodule.Quotient.mk t := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]; rfl
  simp only [shiftEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, this, Submodule.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.shiftEquiv_wordVector
statement:
lemma shiftEquiv_wordVector (Λ' : Dual K H) (w : List ι) :
    shiftEquiv P p Λ Λ' (wordVector P p Λ w) = wordVector P p Λ' w
proof:
:=
  shiftEquiv_fAlg_smul_hwv Λ' _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.map_shiftEquiv_modWeightSpace
statement:
lemma map_shiftEquiv_modWeightSpace (Λ' β : Dual K H) :
    (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) (Λ - β)).map (shiftEquiv P p Λ Λ').toLinearMap =
      modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ') (Λ' - β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modWeightSpace_sub_eq, modWeightSpace_sub_eq, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_image]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, shiftEquiv_wordVector]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_modWeightSpace (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) μ) = vermaDim P p (Λ - μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaDim, ← LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq (shiftEquiv P p Λ 0), ← zero_sub,
    ← map_shiftEquiv_modWeightSpace, sub_sub_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.modWeightSpace_self
statement:
lemma modWeightSpace_self :
    modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) Λ = Submodule.span K {hwv P p Λ}
proof:
:= by
  have h := modWeightSpace_sub_eq P p Λ 0
  rw [sub_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    rw [← map_zero P.rootOf] at hw
    rw [wordVec_eq_zero_iff.1 (P.rootOf_injective hw), wordVector_nil]
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨[], by simp, wordVector_nil⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.vermaDim_zero
statement: lemma vermaDim_zero : vermaDim P p 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaDim, neg_zero, modWeightSpace_self, finrank_span_singleton (hwv_ne_zero P p 0)]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.exists_eq_rootOf_of_vermaDim_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exists_eq_rootOf_of_vermaDim_ne_zero {β : Dual K H} (hβ : vermaDim P p β ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ d ∧ β = P.rootOf d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  apply hβ
  have h := modWeightSpace_sub_eq P p 0 β
  rw [zero_sub] at h
  rw [vermaDim, h]
  have : wordVector P p 0 '' {w | P.rootOf (wordVec w) = β} = ∅ := by
    refine Set.image_eq_empty.2 (Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun w hw ↦ ?_)
    exact hne _ (wordVec_nonneg w) hw.symm
  rw [this, Submodule.span_empty, finrank_bot]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.natVec_injective
statement: lemma natVec_injective : Function.Injective (natVec (ι := ι))
proof:
:= fun a b h ↦
  Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ by simpa [natVec] using congrFun h i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVec_eq_natVec
statement: lemma wordVec_eq_natVec (w : List ι) : wordVec w = natVec (LusztigF.wordWeight w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => funext i; simp [natVec]
  | cons j w ih =>
    funext i
    rw [wordVec_cons, LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, Pi.add_apply, ih]
    rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
    · simp [natVec]
    · simp [natVec, hij]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.word_eq_wordBasis
statement:
lemma word_eq_wordBasis (w : List ι) :
    FreeAlgebra.word (R := K) w = FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rw [FreeAlgebra.word_nil, FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_nil]
  | cons j w ih => rw [FreeAlgebra.word_cons, ih, FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_wordBasis_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fAlg_wordBasis_mem_weightSpace (w : List ι) :
    fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι w) ∈
      weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf (natVec (LusztigF.wordWeight w)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← word_eq_wordBasis, ← wordVec_eq_natVec]
  exact fAlg_word_mem_weightSpace P p w

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_wordSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [← hw]; exact fAlg_wordBasis_mem_weightSpace P p w
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wProj_fAlg
statement:
lemma wProj_fAlg (ν : ι →₀ ℕ) (t : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    wProj P p (-P.rootOf (natVec ν)) (fAlg P p t) =
      fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | smul c x hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hx, map_smul, map_smul]
  | word w =>
    rw [FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis]
    split_ifs with hw
    · rw [wProj_of_mem P p]
      rw [← hw]
      exact fAlg_wordBasis_mem_weightSpace P p w
    · rw [map_zero]
      exact wProj_of_mem_ne P p
        (fun h ↦ hw (natVec_injective (P.rootOf_injective (neg_injective h))))
        (fAlg_wordBasis_mem_weightSpace P p w)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wProj_mem
statement:
lemma wProj_mem {N : Submodule K 𝒰} (hN : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ N, superBracket P p (h P p a) x ∈ N)
    {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ N) (μ : Dual K H) : wProj P p μ x ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun x ↦ wProj P p μ x ∈ N)
    (le_iSup_inf_weightSpace P p N hN hx) (fun ν y hy ↦ ?_) (by simp) fun y z hy hz ↦ by
      rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  by_cases hνμ : ν = μ
  · subst hνμ
    rw [wProj_of_mem P p hy.2]
    exact hy.1
  · rw [wProj_of_mem_ne P p hνμ hy.2]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightProj_mem_fPre
statement:
lemma weightProj_mem_fPre {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ fPre P p) (ν : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν t ∈ fPre P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_fPre, ← wProj_fAlg]
  exact wProj_mem (fun a x hx ↦ (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a) x hx)
    ht _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_weightProj_mem_of_mem_gIdeal
statement:
lemma fAlg_weightProj_mem_of_mem_gIdeal {M : Submodule 𝒰 𝒰} {t : FreeAlgebra K ι}
    (ht : t ∈ gIdeal P p) (ν : ι →₀ ℕ)
    (hM : ∀ μ ≤ ν, ∀ r ∈ fPre P p, r ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K μ → fAlg P p r ∈ M) :
    fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν t) ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction generalizing ν with
  | mem r hr => exact hM ν le_rfl _ (weightProj_mem_fPre hr ν) (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν r)
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem (hy ν hM) (hz ν hM)
  | smul a y _ ih =>
    change fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν (a * y)) ∈ M
    induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add a b ha hb => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul c a ha => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, map_smul]; exact M.smul_of_tower_mem c ha
    | word w =>
      rw [FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis_mul]
      split_ifs with hw
      · rw [map_mul]
        exact M.smul_mem _ (ih _ fun μ hμ ↦ hM μ (hμ.trans tsub_le_self))
      · simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_eq_sum_mul_ι
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sum_mul_ι {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) {t : FreeAlgebra K ι}
    (ht : t ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν) :
    ∃ c : ι → FreeAlgebra K ι, (∀ i, c i ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K (ν - Finsupp.single i 1)) ∧
      (∀ i, ν i = 0 → c i = 0) ∧ t = ∑ i, c i * FreeAlgebra.ι K i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction ht using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw =>
    subst hw
    rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' w with rfl | ⟨w', i, rfl⟩
    · exact absurd rfl hν
    · refine ⟨Pi.single i (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι w'), fun j ↦ ?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
        · rw [Pi.single_eq_same]
          refine FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq ?_
          simp [LusztigF.wordWeight_append]
        · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]
          exact zero_mem _
      · rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hji
        · simp [LusztigF.wordWeight_append] at hj
        · exact Pi.single_eq_of_ne hji _
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, zero_mul])
          (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same, FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_append]
        simp
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ ↦ zero_mem _, fun _ _ ↦ rfl, by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hd0, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨c + d, fun i ↦ add_mem (hc i) (hd i), fun i hi ↦ by simp [hc0 i hi, hd0 i hi],
      by simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]⟩
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨a • c, fun i ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ a (hc i), fun i hi ↦ by simp [hc0 i hi],
      by simp [Finset.smul_sum]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.map_adRep
statement:
lemma map_adRep {φ : 𝒰 →ₐ[K] 𝒰}
    (hφ : ∀ x y, φ (superBracket P p x y) = superBracket P p (φ x) (φ y))
    (hgT : ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, φ x ∈ gTilde P p) (u z : 𝒰) :
    φ (adRep P p u z) = adRep P p (φ u) (φ z)
proof:
:= by
  revert z
  refine induction_on (q := fun u ↦ ∀ z, φ (adRep P p u z) = adRep P p (φ u) (φ z)) u
    (fun c z ↦ ?_) (fun i z ↦ ?_) (fun i z ↦ ?_) (fun a z ↦ ?_) ?_ ?_
  · simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  · rw [adRep_e, hφ, adRep_of_mem_gTilde (hgT _ (e_mem_gTilde P p i))]
  · rw [adRep_f, hφ, adRep_of_mem_gTilde (hgT _ (f_mem_gTilde P p i))]
  · rw [adRep_h, hφ, adRep_of_mem_gTilde (hgT _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a))]
  · intro x y hx hy z
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
  · intro x y hx hy z
    simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.map_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma map_mem_serreIdeal {φ : 𝒰 →ₐ[K] 𝒰}
    (hφ : ∀ x y, φ (superBracket P p x y) = superBracket P p (φ x) (φ y))
    (hgT : ∀ x ∈ gTilde P p, φ x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hS : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → φ (serreE P p i j) ∈ serreIdeal P p ∧ φ (serreF P p i j) ∈ serreIdeal P p)
    {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal P p) : φ x ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_serreIdeal] at hx
  suffices ∀ y ∈ serreAd P p, φ ((toAd P p).symm y) ∈ serreIdeal P p from this _ hx
  intro y hy
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨i, j, hij, rfl | rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    · exact (hS i j hij).1
    · exact (hS i j hij).2
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => simpa using (serreIdeal P p).add_mem hy hy'
  | smul u y _ hy =>
    change φ (adRep P p u ((toAd P p).symm y)) ∈ serreIdeal P p
    rw [map_adRep hφ hgT]
    exact adRep_mem_serreIdeal _ hy

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_serreE
statement:
lemma isHomog_serreE (i j : ι) :
    IsHomog P p (((-A i j).toNat + 1 : ℕ) * p i + p j) (serreE P p i j)
proof:
:=
  isHomog_adE i _ (isHomog_e P p j)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.parity_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma parity_mem_serreIdeal {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal P p) :
    parity P p x ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_serreIdeal (parity_superBracket P p) (fun _ ↦ parity_mem_gTilde P p)
    (fun i j hij ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩) hx
  · rw [isHomog_serreE i j]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (serreE_mem_serreIdeal P p hij)
  · rw [← omega_serreE, ← omega_parity, isHomog_serreE i j, map_smul, omega_serreE]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (serreF_mem_serreIdeal P p hij)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.omega_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma omega_mem_serreIdeal {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal P p) :
    omega P p x ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_serreIdeal (omega_superBracket P p) (fun _ ↦ omega_mem_gTilde P p)
    (fun i j hij ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩) hx
  · rw [omega_serreE]
    exact serreF_mem_serreIdeal P p hij
  · rw [← omega_serreE, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, omega_comp_omega]
    exact parity_mem_serreIdeal (serreE_mem_serreIdeal P p hij)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.superBracket_mem_of_mem_left
statement:
lemma superBracket_mem_of_mem_left {I : Submodule K 𝒰} (hI : IsIdeal P p I)
    (hσ : ∀ x ∈ I, parity P p x ∈ I) {y x : 𝒰} (hy : y ∈ I) (hx : x ∈ gTilde P p) :
    superBracket P p y x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_parity P p (N := I) (q := fun y ↦ superBracket P p y x ∈ I) hσ
    (fun a y hy hya ↦ ?_) (fun y y' h h' ↦ ?_) hy
  · refine induction_parity P p (N := gTilde P p) (q := fun x ↦ superBracket P p y x ∈ I)
      (fun _ ↦ parity_mem_gTilde P p) (fun b x hx hxb ↦ ?_) (fun x x' h h' ↦ ?_) hx
    · rw [superBracket_swap hxb hya]
      exact I.neg_mem (I.smul_mem _ (hI.superBracket_mem x hx y hy))
    · rw [superBracket_add_right]; exact I.add_mem h h'
  · rw [superBracket_add_left]; exact I.add_mem h h'

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_setOf_le_le
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_le_le (Λs : Finset (Dual K H)) (ν : Dual K H) :
    {κ | (∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P κ) ∧
      toWeightOrd P κ ≤ toWeightOrd P ν}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : Dual K H → ι → ℤ := fun Λ ↦
    if hc : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - ν then hc.choose else 0
  refine (Λs.finite_toSet.biUnion fun Λ _ ↦ ((Set.Finite.pi (t := fun i ↦ Set.Icc 0 (c Λ i))
    fun i ↦ Set.finite_Icc _ _).image fun d ↦ Λ - P.rootOf d)).subset ?_
  rintro κ ⟨⟨Λ, hΛ, hΛκ⟩, hκν⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).1 hΛκ
  obtain ⟨e, he, hκ⟩ := (toWeightOrd_le_iff P).1 hκν
  have hld : P.rootOf (d + e) = Λ - ν := by
    rw [map_add, ← hκ]
    abel
  have hex : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - ν := ⟨_, hld⟩
  have hc : c Λ = d + e := P.rootOf_injective (by
    simp only [c, hex, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [hex.choose_spec, hld])
  refine Set.mem_biUnion hΛ ⟨d, fun i _ ↦ ⟨hd i, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hc, Pi.add_apply, le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
  exact he i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isBounded_of_iSup
statement:
lemma isBounded_of_iSup {Λs : Finset (Dual K H)} (hV : ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊤)
    (hc : ∀ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ ≠ ⊥ → ∃ Λ ∈ Λs, ∃ d : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ d ∧ μ = Λ - P.rootOf d) :
    IsBounded P p V Λs
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have hv : v ∈ ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ := hV ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  rw [Submodule.iSup_eq_span] at hv
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 (fun w hw ↦ ?_) hv
  obtain ⟨μ, hw⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hw
  by_cases h0 : w = 0
  · rw [h0]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, hμ⟩ := hc μ ((Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).2 ⟨w, hw, h0⟩)
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, hμ ▸ hw⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finiteDimensional_modWeightSpace_quotient
statement:
lemma finiteDimensional_modWeightSpace_quotient (hV : ⨆ μ, modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊤)
    (μ : Dual K H) [FiniteDimensional K (modWeightSpace P p V μ)] :
    FiniteDimensional K (modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ N) μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modWeightSpace_quotient N hV]
  infer_instance

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finiteDimensional_modWeightSpace_submodule
statement:
lemma finiteDimensional_modWeightSpace_submodule (μ : Dual K H)
    [FiniteDimensional K (modWeightSpace P p V μ)] :
    FiniteDimensional K (modWeightSpace P p N μ)
proof:
:= by
  have e := Submodule.equivMapOfInjective (N.subtype.restrictScalars K)
    (fun x y h ↦ Subtype.ext h) (modWeightSpace P p N μ)
  rw [map_modWeightSpace_submodule] at e
  have : FiniteDimensional K ↥(modWeightSpace P p V μ ⊓ N.restrictScalars K) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  exact Module.Finite.equiv e.symm

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsCasimirModule.quotient
statement:
lemma quotient (hV : IsCasimirModule P p S V Λs c) (N : Submodule (P.SuperEnveloping p) V) :
    IsCasimirModule P p S (V ⧸ N) Λs c where
  isGModule r hr x
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := N.mkQ_surjective x
    rw [← map_smul, hV.isGModule r hr y, map_zero]
  isBounded := hV.isBounded.of_surjective N.mkQ N.mkQ_surjective
  finiteDimensional μ := by
    have := hV.finiteDimensional μ
    exact finiteDimensional_modWeightSpace_quotient N hV.isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top μ
  casimir_eq x := by
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := N.mkQ_surjective x
    rw [← map_casimir S hV.isBounded.isPosFinite, hV.casimir_eq y, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsCasimirModule.submodule
statement:
lemma submodule (hV : IsCasimirModule P p S V Λs c) (N : Submodule (P.SuperEnveloping p) V) :
    IsCasimirModule P p S N Λs c where
  isGModule r hr x
proof:
:= Subtype.ext (hV.isGModule r hr x)
  isBounded := isBounded_of_iSup
    (iSup_modWeightSpace_submodule N hV.isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top) fun μ hμ ↦ by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hμ
      refine hV.isBounded.exists_eq_sub (w := (x : V)) (fun a ↦ ?_)
        fun h ↦ hx0 (Subtype.ext h)
      simpa using congr_arg Subtype.val (hx a)
  finiteDimensional μ := by
    have := hV.finiteDimensional μ
    exact finiteDimensional_modWeightSpace_submodule N μ
  casimir_eq x := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [← N.subtype_apply, map_casimir S _ hV.isBounded.isPosFinite, N.subtype_apply,
      hV.casimir_eq]
    rfl)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsCasimirModule.gVerma
statement:
lemma gVerma {μ₀ : Dual K H} (hμ₀ : ∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ₀) :
    IsCasimirModule P p S (GVerma P p μ₀) Λs (P.dualBilinForm S (μ₀ + 2 • P.rho) μ₀) where
  isGModule
proof:
:= GVerma.isGModule
  isBounded := isBounded_of_iSup GVerma.isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top fun μ hμ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hμ
    obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', d, hd, rfl⟩ := GVerma.isBounded.exists_eq_sub hx hx0
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hΛ'
    subst hΛ'
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hΛμ⟩ := hμ₀
    obtain ⟨d', hd', rfl⟩ := (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).1 hΛμ
    exact ⟨Λ, hΛ, d' + d, add_nonneg hd' hd, by rw [map_add]; abel⟩
  finiteDimensional _ := inferInstance
  casimir_eq v := casimir_eq_smul_of_forall_eq_smul GVerma.isGModule _ hA
    (fun a ↦ GVerma.h_smul_hwv a) GVerma.e_smul_hwv
    (fun w ↦ by obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := GVerma.exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv w; exact ⟨_, ht.symm⟩) v

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsCasimirModule.expansion_aux
statement:
private theorem expansion_aux (F : Finset (Dual K H))
    (hF : ∀ κ μ, κ ∈ F → toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P κ →
      (∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ) → μ ∈ F)
    (T : Finset (Dual K H)) (n : ℕ) (V : Type (max u v w)) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Module (P.SuperEnveloping p) V] [IsScalarTower K (P.SuperEnveloping p) V]
    (hV : IsCasimirModule P p S V Λs c)
    (hT : ∀ κ ∈ F, (∃ μ ∈ F, modWeightSpace P p V μ ≠ ⊥ ∧ toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P κ) →
      κ ∈ T)
    (hn : ∑ μ ∈ F, finrank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) = n) :
    ∃ a : Dual K H →₀ ℤ, (∀ κ ∈ a.support, P.dualBilinForm S (κ + 2 • P.rho) κ = c ∧ κ ∈ F) ∧
      ∀ μ ∈ F, (finrank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) : ℤ) =
        a.sum fun κ m ↦ m * (GVerma.vermaDim P p (κ - μ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction T using Finset.strongInduction generalizing n V with
  | H T ihT =>
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing V with
  | _ n ihn =>
  classical
  by_cases hall : ∀ μ ∈ F, modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊥
  · refine ⟨0, by simp, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [Finsupp.sum_zero_index, hall μ hμ, finrank_bot, Nat.cast_zero]
  push Not at hall
  
  have hfin : (toWeightOrd P '' {μ | μ ∈ F ∧ modWeightSpace P p V μ ≠ ⊥}).Finite :=
    (F.finite_toSet.subset fun μ hμ ↦ hμ.1).image _
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨μ₀, ⟨hμ₀F, hne⟩, rfl⟩, hmin⟩ := hfin.isPWO.exists_minimal
    (hall.imp fun μ hμ ↦ ⟨_, hμ, rfl⟩)
  have hmin' : ∀ μ ∈ F, modWeightSpace P p V μ ≠ ⊥ → toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ₀ →
      μ = μ₀ := fun μ hμ hμne hle ↦
    (toWeightOrd P).injective (le_antisymm hle (hmin ⟨μ, ⟨hμ, hμne⟩, rfl⟩ hle))
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hne
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, hΛ₀, d₀, hd₀, hμ₀⟩ := hV.isBounded.exists_eq_sub hv hv0
  have hcone : ∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ₀ :=
    ⟨Λ₀, hΛ₀, (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).2 ⟨d₀, hd₀, hμ₀⟩⟩
  
  have he : ∀ i, e P p i • v = 0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra h0
    have hmem := smul_mem_modWeightSpace V (e_mem_weightSpace P p i) hv
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, heq⟩ := hV.isBounded.exists_eq_sub hmem h0
    have hup : toWeightOrd P (P.root i + μ₀) ≤ toWeightOrd P μ₀ :=
      (toWeightOrd_le_iff P).2 ⟨Pi.single i 1, Pi.single_nonneg.2 zero_le_one, by simp⟩
    have hF' : P.root i + μ₀ ∈ F := hF μ₀ _ hμ₀F hup
      ⟨Λ, hΛ, (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).2 ⟨d, hd, heq⟩⟩
    have h1 := hmin' _ hF' ((Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).2 ⟨_, hmem, h0⟩) hup
    rw [add_eq_right, ← rootOf_single, ← map_zero P.rootOf] at h1
    simpa using congr_fun (P.rootOf_injective h1) i
  have hh : ∀ a, h P p a • v = algebraMap K (P.SuperEnveloping p) (μ₀ a) • v := fun a ↦ by
    rw [algebraMap_smul]
    exact hv a
  set φ := GVerma.lift hV.isGModule v he hh
  have hφ : φ (GVerma.hwv P p μ₀) = v := GVerma.lift_hwv _ _ _ _
  
  have hc0 : P.dualBilinForm S (μ₀ + 2 • P.rho) μ₀ = c := by
    have h1 := casimir_apply_of_e_smul_eq_zero (S := S) hV.isBounded.isPosFinite hV.isGModule hv he
    rw [hV.casimir_eq] at h1
    exact (smul_left_injective K hv0 h1).symm
  have hVerma : IsCasimirModule P p S (GVerma P p μ₀) Λs c := hc0 ▸ gVerma hA hcone
  
  set Kr := LinearMap.ker φ
  have hKr := hVerma.submodule Kr
  have hKr0 : modWeightSpace P p Kr μ₀ = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    have hx' : (x : GVerma P p μ₀) ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p μ₀) μ₀ := fun a ↦ by
      simpa using congr_arg Subtype.val (hx a)
    rw [GVerma.modWeightSpace_self, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hx'
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hx'
    have hx0 : φ x = 0 := x.2
    rw [← ht, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, hφ, smul_eq_zero] at hx0
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [← ht, hx0.resolve_right hv0, zero_smul]
    rfl
  have hμ₀T : μ₀ ∈ T := hT μ₀ hμ₀F ⟨μ₀, hμ₀F, hne, le_rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨aK, haK, haK'⟩ := ihT (T.erase μ₀) (Finset.erase_ssubset hμ₀T) _ Kr hKr
    (fun κ hκF ⟨μ, hμF, hμne, hμκ⟩ ↦ by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hμne
      have hx' : (x : GVerma P p μ₀) ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p μ₀) μ :=
        fun a ↦ by simpa using congr_arg Subtype.val (hx a)
      obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ', d, hd, hμd⟩ := GVerma.isBounded.exists_eq_sub hx'
        fun h ↦ hx0 (Subtype.ext h)
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 hΛ'] at hμd
      have hle : toWeightOrd P μ₀ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ :=
        (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).2 ⟨d, hd, hμd⟩
      have hneq : μ ≠ μ₀ := fun h ↦ hμne (h ▸ hKr0)
      have hlt : toWeightOrd P μ₀ < toWeightOrd P κ :=
        (lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h ↦ hneq ((toWeightOrd P).injective h).symm).trans_le hμκ
      exact Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h ↦ hlt.ne (by rw [h]),
        hT κ hκF ⟨μ₀, hμ₀F, hne, hlt.le⟩⟩) rfl
  
  set R := LinearMap.range φ
  have hQ := hV.quotient R
  have htop := hV.isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top
  have hsplit : ∀ μ, finrank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) =
      finrank K (modWeightSpace P p R μ) + finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (V ⧸ R) μ) :=
    fun μ ↦ by
      have := hV.finiteDimensional μ
      exact finrank_modWeightSpace_eq_add R htop μ
  have hR0 : 0 < finrank K (modWeightSpace P p R μ₀) := by
    have := hV.finiteDimensional μ₀
    have := finiteDimensional_modWeightSpace_submodule R μ₀
    refine Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.2
      ⟨⟨⟨v, GVerma.hwv P p μ₀, hφ⟩, fun a ↦ Subtype.ext (hv a)⟩, fun h ↦ hv0 ?_⟩
    simpa using congr_arg (fun x : modWeightSpace P p R μ₀ ↦ ((x : R) : V)) h
  obtain ⟨aQ, haQ, haQ'⟩ := ihn _ (hn ▸ Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun μ _ ↦ by rw [hsplit μ]; omega)
      ⟨μ₀, hμ₀F, by rw [hsplit μ₀]; omega⟩) (V ⧸ R) hQ
    (fun κ hκF ⟨μ, hμF, hμne, hμκ⟩ ↦ hT κ hκF ⟨μ, hμF, fun h0 ↦ hμne (by
      rw [modWeightSpace_quotient R htop, h0, Submodule.map_bot]), hμκ⟩) rfl
  
  refine ⟨aQ + Finsupp.single μ₀ 1 - aK, fun κ hκ ↦ ?_, fun μ hμF ↦ ?_⟩
  · have : κ ∈ aQ.support ∨ κ = μ₀ ∨ κ ∈ aK.support := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hκ
      rw [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hcon.1,
        Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hcon.2.2, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hcon.2.1]
      simp
    rcases this with h | rfl | h
    · exact haQ κ h
    · exact ⟨hc0, hμ₀F⟩
    · exact haK κ h
  · have e2 := finrank_modWeightSpace_eq_add Kr
      GVerma.isBounded.iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top μ
    have e3 : finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p μ₀ ⧸ Kr) μ) =
        finrank K (modWeightSpace P p R μ) :=
      finrank_modWeightSpace_equiv (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange φ) μ
    have e4 := GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace (P := P) (p := p) (Λ := μ₀) μ
    rw [Finsupp.sum_sub_index (fun _ _ _ ↦ sub_mul _ _ _),
      Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ ↦ zero_mul _) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_mul _ _ _),
      Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_mul _), ← haQ' μ hμF, ← haK' μ hμF, hsplit μ]
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsCasimirModule.exists_expansion
statement:
theorem exists_expansion {V : Type (max u v w)} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Module (P.SuperEnveloping p) V] [IsScalarTower K (P.SuperEnveloping p) V]
    (hV : IsCasimirModule P p S V Λs c) (ν : Dual K H) :
    ∃ a : Dual K H →₀ ℤ, (∀ κ ∈ a.support, P.dualBilinForm S (κ + 2 • P.rho) κ = c ∧
        ∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P κ) ∧
      ∀ μ, toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P ν →
        (finrank K (modWeightSpace P p V μ) : ℤ) =
          a.sum fun κ m ↦ m * (GVerma.vermaDim P p (κ - μ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set F := (finite_setOf_le_le P Λs ν).toFinset
  have hmemF : ∀ κ, κ ∈ F ↔ (∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P κ) ∧
      toWeightOrd P κ ≤ toWeightOrd P ν := fun κ ↦ Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _
  have hF : ∀ κ μ, κ ∈ F → toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P κ →
      (∃ Λ ∈ Λs, toWeightOrd P Λ ≤ toWeightOrd P μ) → μ ∈ F := fun κ μ hκ hμκ hμ ↦
    (hmemF μ).2 ⟨hμ, hμκ.trans ((hmemF κ).1 hκ).2⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haF⟩ := expansion_aux hA F hF F _ V hV (fun κ hκ _ ↦ hκ) rfl
  refine ⟨a, fun κ hκ ↦ ⟨(ha κ hκ).1, ((hmemF κ).1 (ha κ hκ).2).1⟩, fun μ hμ ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hμF : μ ∈ F
  · exact haF μ hμF
  have h0 : modWeightSpace P p V μ = ⊥ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hne
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, heq⟩ := hV.isBounded.exists_eq_sub hx hx0
    exact hμF ((hmemF μ).2
      ⟨⟨Λ, hΛ, (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).2 ⟨d, hd, heq⟩⟩, hμ⟩)
  rw [h0, finrank_bot, Nat.cast_zero, Finsupp.sum]
  refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun κ hκ ↦ ?_).symm
  have hd : GVerma.vermaDim P p (κ - μ) = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨d, hd, heq⟩ := GVerma.exists_eq_rootOf_of_vermaDim_ne_zero hne
    obtain ⟨⟨Λ, hΛ, hΛκ⟩, -⟩ := (hmemF κ).1 (ha κ hκ).2
    refine hμF ((hmemF μ).2 ⟨⟨Λ, hΛ, hΛκ.trans ?_⟩, hμ⟩)
    exact (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).2 ⟨d, hd, by rw [← heq, sub_sub_cancel]⟩
  rw [hd, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_leftSerre_of_mem
statement: lemma mem_leftSerre_of_mem {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal P p) : x ∈ leftSerre P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_f_mem_leftSerre
statement:
lemma mul_f_mem_leftSerre {m : 𝒰} (hm : m ∈ leftSerre P p) (i : ι) :
    m * f P p i ∈ leftSerre P p
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    have hy : y ∈ serreIdeal P p := hy
    have key : y * f P p i = superBracket P p y (f P p i) + (2 : K)⁻¹ •
        ((f P p i + parity P p (f P p i)) * y + (f P p i - parity P p (f P p i)) *
          parity P p y) := by
      rw [superBracket, sub_add_cancel]
    rw [key]
    refine add_mem (mem_leftSerre_of_mem (superBracket_mem_of_mem_left (isIdeal_serreIdeal P p)
      (fun _ ↦ parity_mem_serreIdeal) hy (f_mem_gTilde P p i))) ?_
    refine Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (add_mem ?_ ?_)
    · exact (leftSerre P p).smul_mem _ (mem_leftSerre_of_mem hy)
    · exact (leftSerre P p).smul_mem _ (mem_leftSerre_of_mem (parity_mem_serreIdeal hy))
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul u x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]; exact (leftSerre P p).smul_mem u hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.adRep_h_mem_of_mem_leftSerre
statement:
lemma adRep_h_mem_of_mem_leftSerre {m : 𝒰} (hm : m ∈ leftSerre P p) (a : H) :
    adRep P p m (h P p a) ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    rw [adRep_of_mem_gTilde (serreIdeal_le_gTilde P p hy)]
    exact superBracket_mem_of_mem_left (isIdeal_serreIdeal P p)
      (fun _ ↦ parity_mem_serreIdeal) hy (h_mem_gTilde P p a)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul u x _ hx =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact adRep_mem_serreIdeal u hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_serreIdeal_of_mem
statement:
lemma mem_serreIdeal_of_mem {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ leftSerre P p)
    (hxg : x ∈ gTilde P p) (hxμ : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) : x ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, μ a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h0
    exact hμ (LinearMap.ext fun a ↦ not_not.1 fun h ↦ h0 ⟨a, h⟩)
  have h1 := adRep_h_mem_of_mem_leftSerre hx a
  rw [adRep_of_mem_gTilde hxg, superBracket_of_even_right P p x (isEven_h P p a), hxμ a,
    sub_add_cancel_left] at h1
  have := (serreIdeal P p).smul_mem (-(μ a)⁻¹) h1
  rwa [smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg, inv_smul_smul₀ ha] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_smul_f_smul_hwv_zero
statement:
lemma e_smul_f_smul_hwv_zero (i j : ι) :
    e P p j • f P p i • GVerma.hwv P p 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_smul, e_mul_f, add_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul, GVerma.e_smul_hwv, smul_zero,
    smul_zero, zero_add]
  split_ifs
  · rw [GVerma.h_smul_hwv, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul]
  · rw [zero_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_smul_f_smul_hwv_zero
statement:
lemma h_smul_f_smul_hwv_zero (i : ι) (a : H) :
    h P p a • f P p i • GVerma.hwv P p 0 =
      algebraMap K 𝒰 ((-P.root i) a) • f P p i • GVerma.hwv P p 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_smul, h_mul_f, sub_smul, mul_smul, GVerma.h_smul_hwv, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_smul,
    smul_zero, zero_sub, algebraMap_smul, smul_assoc, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.syzComponent_fAlg_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma syzComponent_fAlg_smul_hwv (i : ι) (t : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    syzComponent P p i (fAlg P p t • GVerma.hwv P p (-P.root i)) =
      fAlg P p t • f P p i • GVerma.hwv P p 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul, syzComponent, GVerma.lift_hwv]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.syzMap_apply
statement: lemma syzMap_apply (v : SyzSource P p) : syzMap P p v = ∑ i, syzComponent P p i (v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [syzMap]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_modWeightSpace_syzSource
statement:
lemma mem_modWeightSpace_syzSource {μ : Dual K H} {v : SyzSource P p} :
    v ∈ modWeightSpace P p (SyzSource P p) μ ↔
      ∀ i, v i ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p (-P.root i)) μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hv i a ↦ congrFun (hv a) i, fun hv a ↦ funext fun i ↦ hv i a⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_smul_mem_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma f_smul_mem_lowerSpan (k : ι → ℤ) (j : ι) {m : SyzSource P p}
    (hm : m ∈ lowerSpan P p k) : f P p j • m ∈ lowerSpan P p k
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩ := hv
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨j :: w, t, ht, ?_⟩
    rw [FreeAlgebra.word_cons, map_mul, fAlg_ι, mul_smul]
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.h_smul_mem_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma h_smul_mem_lowerSpan (k : ι → ℤ) (a : H) {m : SyzSource P p}
    (hm : m ∈ lowerSpan P p k) : h P p a • m ∈ lowerSpan P p k
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩ := hv
    have hg : fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) • t ∈ lowerSpan P p k :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨-, l, -, htl⟩ := ht
    rw [← mul_smul, fAlg_word_mem_weightSpace P p w a, add_smul, mul_smul, htl a, smul_assoc,
      smul_comm]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hg) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hg)
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.e_smul_mem_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma e_smul_mem_lowerSpan (k : ι → ℤ) (i : ι) {m : SyzSource P p}
    (hm : m ∈ lowerSpan P p k) : e P p i • m ∈ lowerSpan P p k
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩ := hv
    induction w with
    | nil =>
      obtain ⟨hts, l, hl, htl⟩ := ht
      refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], e P p i • t, ⟨(syzygies P p).smul_mem _ hts,
        l - Pi.single i 1, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [height_sub_single]; omega
      · have := smul_mem_modWeightSpace (SyzSource P p) (e_mem_weightSpace P p i) htl
        convert this using 2
        rw [map_sub, rootOf_single]
        abel
      · rw [FreeAlgebra.word_nil, map_one, one_smul, one_smul]
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [FreeAlgebra.word_cons, map_mul, fAlg_ι, mul_smul, ← mul_smul, e_mul_f, add_smul,
        smul_assoc, mul_smul]
      refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (f_smul_mem_lowerSpan k j ih)) ?_
      split_ifs
      · exact h_smul_mem_lowerSpan k _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, t, ht, rfl⟩)
      · rw [zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_mem_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma smul_mem_lowerSpan (k : ι → ℤ) (u : 𝒰) {m : SyzSource P p}
    (hm : m ∈ lowerSpan P p k) : u • m ∈ lowerSpan P p k
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (q := fun u ↦ ∀ m ∈ lowerSpan P p k, u • m ∈ lowerSpan P p k) u
    (fun c m hm ↦ ?_) (fun i m hm ↦ e_smul_mem_lowerSpan k i hm)
    (fun i m hm ↦ f_smul_mem_lowerSpan k i hm) (fun a m hm ↦ h_smul_mem_lowerSpan k a hm)
    (fun x y hx hy m hm ↦ ?_) (fun x y hx hy m hm ↦ ?_) m hm
  · rw [algebraMap_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hm
  · rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem (hx m hm) (hy m hm)
  · rw [mul_smul]; exact hx _ (hy m hm)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lowerSyz_le_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma lowerSyz_le_lowerSpan (k : ι → ℤ) {s : SyzSource P p} (hs : s ∈ lowerSyz P p k) :
    s ∈ lowerSpan P p k
proof:
:= by
  let N : Submodule 𝒰 (SyzSource P p) :=
    { toAddSubmonoid := (lowerSpan P p k).toAddSubmonoid
      smul_mem' := fun u _ hm ↦ smul_mem_lowerSpan k u hm }
  have : lowerSyz P p k ≤ N := Submodule.span_le.2 fun t ht ↦
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], t, ht, by rw [FreeAlgebra.word_nil, map_one, one_smul]⟩
  exact this hs

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.lowerSyz_le_syzygies
statement: lemma lowerSyz_le_syzygies (k : ι → ℤ) : lowerSyz P p k ≤ syzygies P p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ht ↦ ht.1

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_eq_sum_f_smul
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sum_f_smul {k : ι → ℤ} {s : SyzSource P p} (hs : s ∈ lowerSyz P p k)
    (hsk : s ∈ modWeightSpace P p (SyzSource P p) (-P.rootOf k)) :
    ∃ y : ι → SyzSource P p, (∀ j, y j ∈ syzygies P p) ∧ s = ∑ j, f P p j • y j
proof:
:= by
  have hG : ∀ g ∈ {v | ∃ w t, t ∈ lowerSet P p k ∧ v = fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) • t},
      ∃ ν, g ∈ modWeightSpace P p (SyzSource P p) ν := by
    rintro _ ⟨w, t, ⟨-, l, -, htl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, smul_mem_modWeightSpace _ (fAlg_word_mem_weightSpace P p w) htl⟩
  have := (iSupIndep_modWeightSpace (SyzSource P p)).mem_span_inter hG
    (lowerSyz_le_lowerSpan k hs) hsk
  clear hs hsk
  induction this using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
    obtain ⟨⟨w, t, ⟨hts, l, hl, htl⟩, rfl⟩, hgk⟩ := hg
    by_cases g0 : fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) • t = 0
    · exact ⟨0, fun _ ↦ zero_mem _, by simp [g0]⟩
    have hgν := smul_mem_modWeightSpace _ (fAlg_word_mem_weightSpace P p w) htl
    have hν : -P.rootOf (wordVec w) + -P.rootOf l = -P.rootOf k := by
      by_contra hne
      exact g0 (Submodule.disjoint_def.1
        ((iSupIndep_modWeightSpace (SyzSource P p)).pairwiseDisjoint hne) _ hgν hgk)
    have hwl : wordVec w + l = k := P.rootOf_injective (by
      rw [map_add, ← neg_inj, neg_add]; exact hν)
    cases w with
    | nil => rw [wordVec_nil, zero_add] at hwl; exact absurd hl (by rw [hwl]; exact lt_irrefl _)
    | cons j w =>
      refine ⟨Pi.single j (fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.word w) • t), fun j' ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases eq_or_ne j' j with rfl | hj
        · rw [Pi.single_eq_same]; exact (syzygies P p).smul_mem _ hts
        · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]; exact zero_mem _
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun j' _ hj ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, smul_zero])
          (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same, FreeAlgebra.word_cons, map_mul, fAlg_ι, mul_smul]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ ↦ zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + b, fun j ↦ add_mem (ha j) (hb j), by simp [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]⟩
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨c • a, fun j ↦ Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ c (ha j), by
      simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_comm c]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isGModule_syzSource
statement: lemma isGModule_syzSource : IsGModule P p (SyzSource P p)
proof:
:=
  fun r hr v ↦ funext fun i ↦ GVerma.isGModule r hr (v i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isBounded_syzSource
statement:
lemma isBounded_syzSource :
    IsBounded P p (SyzSource P p) (Finset.univ.biUnion fun i ↦ {-P.root i})
proof:
:=
  isBounded_pi fun _ ↦ GVerma.isBounded

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isPosFinite_syzSource
statement: lemma isPosFinite_syzSource : IsPosFinite P p (SyzSource P p)
proof:
:=
  isBounded_syzSource.isPosFinite

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.hwv_mem_modWeightSpace
statement:
lemma hwv_mem_modWeightSpace (Λ : Dual K H) :
    GVerma.hwv P p Λ ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) Λ
proof:
:=
  GVerma.h_smul_hwv

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.casimir_syzSource
statement:
lemma casimir_syzSource (S : A.Symmetrization) (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (v : SyzSource P p) :
    casimir S isPosFinite_syzSource v = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have := map_casimir S isPosFinite_syzSource GVerma.isBounded.isPosFinite
    (LinearMap.proj i : SyzSource P p →ₗ[𝒰] GVerma P p (-P.root i)) v
  rw [LinearMap.proj_apply] at this
  change (casimir S isPosFinite_syzSource v) i = 0
  rw [this, LinearMap.proj_apply, casimir_eq_smul_of_forall_eq_smul GVerma.isGModule _ hA
    (hwv_mem_modWeightSpace _) GVerma.e_smul_hwv
    (fun w ↦ let ⟨t, ht⟩ := GVerma.exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv w; ⟨fAlg P p t, ht.symm⟩),
    P.dualBilinForm_neg_root_add_two_rho S hA i, zero_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_lowerSyz_of_e_smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  set N := lowerSyz P p k
  have hQ : IsPosFinite P p (SyzSource P p ⧸ N) :=
    (isBounded_syzSource.of_surjective N.mkQ N.mkQ_surjective).isPosFinite
  have hQG : IsGModule P p (SyzSource P p ⧸ N) := fun r hr v ↦ by
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := N.mkQ_surjective v
    rw [← map_smul, isGModule_syzSource r hr v, map_zero]
  have h1 := map_casimir S isPosFinite_syzSource hQ N.mkQ s
  rw [casimir_syzSource S hA, map_zero] at h1
  have hsQ : N.mkQ s ∈ modWeightSpace P p (SyzSource P p ⧸ N) (-P.rootOf k) := fun a ↦ by
    rw [← map_smul, hs a, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  have heQ : ∀ i, e P p i • N.mkQ s = 0 := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]; exact he i
  rw [casimir_apply_of_e_smul_eq_zero hQ hQG hsQ heQ] at h1
  have := (smul_eq_zero.1 h1.symm).resolve_left
    (P.dualBilinForm_neg_rootOf_add_two_rho_ne_zero S hk hle)
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).1 this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_natVec_eq
statement: lemma exists_natVec_eq [Finite ι] {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) : ∃ ν : ι →₀ ℕ, natVec ν = k
proof:
:=
  ⟨Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun i ↦ (k i).toNat,
    funext fun i ↦ by simp [natVec, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hk i)]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.height_natVec_le
statement: lemma height_natVec_le {μ ν : ι →₀ ℕ} (h : μ ≤ ν) : height (natVec μ) ≤ height (natVec ν)
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ by simpa [natVec] using h i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.natVec_tsub_single
statement:
lemma natVec_tsub_single {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} {i : ι} (hi : 1 ≤ ν i) :
    natVec (ν - Finsupp.single i 1) = natVec ν - Pi.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
  · simp [natVec]; omega
  · simp [natVec, hj]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.ι_eq_wordBasis
statement: lemma ι_eq_wordBasis (i : ι) : FreeAlgebra.ι K i = FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι [i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← word_eq_wordBasis, FreeAlgebra.word_cons, FreeAlgebra.word_nil, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordWeight_singleton
statement: lemma wordWeight_singleton (i : ι) : LusztigF.wordWeight [i] = Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
