  rw [LusztigF.wordWeight_cons]; simp

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wProj_nPlus
statement:
lemma wProj_nPlus {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) {m : 𝒰} (hm : m ∈ nPlus P p) :
    wProj P p (-P.rootOf k) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices nPlus P p ≤ LinearMap.ker (wProj P p (-P.rootOf k)) from this hm
  refine (nPlus_le_iff P p).2 fun i w ↦
    wProj_of_mem_ne P p (fun h ↦ ?_) (eLie_mem_weightSpace_rootOf P p i w)
  refine P.rootOf_ne_zero (posCone_add (wordVec_cons_mem_posCone i w) hk).2 ?_
  rw [map_add, h, neg_add_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_fAlg_eq
statement:
lemma exists_fAlg_eq {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} (hν : natVec ν ∈ posCone ι) {x : 𝒰} (hxg : x ∈ gTilde P p)
    (hxν : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf (natVec ν))) :
    ∃ t ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν, fAlg P p t = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, a, m, hm, rfl⟩ := (mem_gTilde_iff P p).1 hxg
  obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := nMinus_le_fAug P p hn
  refine ⟨FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν t, FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν t, ?_⟩
  have hx := wProj_of_mem P p hxν
  rw [map_add, map_add, wProj_of_mem_ne P p (fun h ↦ P.rootOf_ne_zero hν.2 (neg_eq_zero.1 h.symm))
    (h_mem_weightSpace P p a), wProj_nPlus hν hm, add_zero, add_zero, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
    wProj_fAlg] at hx
  exact hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_weightProj_mem_leftSerre
statement:
lemma fAlg_weightProj_mem_leftSerre {k : ι → ℤ}
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      maxIdeal P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf l) ≤ serreIdeal P p)
    {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ gIdeal P p) {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} (hν : height (natVec ν) < height k) :
    fAlg P p (FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν t) ∈ leftSerre P p
proof:
:= by
  refine fAlg_weightProj_mem_of_mem_gIdeal ht ν fun μ hμ r hr hrμ ↦ ?_
  have hrw := fAlg_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_wordSpan P p hrμ
  by_cases hμ0 : natVec μ = 0
  · have : fAlg P p r ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]
      refine ⟨(isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hr, ?_⟩
      rwa [hμ0, map_zero, neg_zero] at hrw
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _
  · refine mem_leftSerre_of_mem (hmin _ ⟨fun i ↦ by simp [natVec], hμ0⟩
      ((height_natVec_le hμ).trans_lt hν) ⟨hr, hrw⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_serreIdeal_of_minimal
statement:
theorem mem_serreIdeal_of_minimal (S : A.Symmetrization) (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (hmin : ∀ l ∈ posCone ι, height l < height k →
      maxIdeal P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf l) ≤ serreIdeal P p)
    {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ maxIdeal P p) (hxk : x ∈ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf k)) :
    x ∈ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hxS
  have hle := fun i ↦ sum_mul_le_zero_of_minimal hA hk hmin hx hxk hxS i
  obtain ⟨ν, rfl⟩ := exists_natVec_eq hk.1
  have hxg := (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hx
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, rfl⟩ := exists_fAlg_eq hk hxg hxk
  have hν0 : ν ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hk.2 (by rw [h]; funext i; simp [natVec])
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0, ht⟩ := exists_eq_sum_mul_ι hν0 ht₀
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : SyzSource P p,
      ∀ i, s i = fAlg P p (c i) • GVerma.hwv P p (-P.root i) := ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  
  have hss : s ∈ syzygies P p := by
    change syzMap P p s = 0
    rw [syzMap_apply]
    have : ∑ i, syzComponent P p i (s i) = fAlg P p t₀ • GVerma.hwv P p 0 := by
      rw [ht, map_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [hs, syzComponent_fAlg_smul_hwv, map_mul, fAlg_ι, mul_smul]
    rw [this]
    exact GVerma.isGModule _ hx _
  have hsk : s ∈ modWeightSpace P p (SyzSource P p) (-P.rootOf (natVec ν)) := by
    refine mem_modWeightSpace_syzSource.2 fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [hs]
    by_cases hi : ν i = 0
    · rw [hc0 i hi, map_zero, zero_smul]
      exact zero_mem _
    · have := smul_mem_modWeightSpace _ (fAlg_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_wordSpan P p (hc i))
        (hwv_mem_modWeightSpace (P := P) (p := p) (-P.root i))
      convert this using 2
      rw [natVec_tsub_single (by omega), map_sub, rootOf_single]
      abel
  
  have he : ∀ j, e P p j • s ∈ lowerSyz P p (natVec ν) := fun j ↦
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨(syzygies P p).smul_mem _ hss, natVec ν - Pi.single j 1,
      by rw [height_sub_single]; omega, by
        have := smul_mem_modWeightSpace (SyzSource P p) (e_mem_weightSpace P p j) hsk
        convert this using 2
        rw [map_sub, rootOf_single]
        abel⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hsy⟩ := exists_eq_sum_f_smul (mem_lowerSyz_of_e_smul_mem S hA hk hle hsk he) hsk
  choose τ hτ using fun j i ↦ GVerma.exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv (y j i)
  
  have hg : ∀ i, c i - ∑ j, FreeAlgebra.ι K j * τ j i ∈ gIdeal P p := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff (Λ := -P.root i), map_sub, sub_smul, map_sum,
      Finset.sum_smul, sub_eq_zero, ← hs i, hsy, Finset.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, map_mul, fAlg_ι, mul_smul, hτ]
  have hρ : ∀ j, ∑ i, τ j i * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∈ gIdeal P p := fun j ↦ by
    rw [← GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff (Λ := 0), map_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
    have := hy j
    change syzMap P p (y j) = 0 at this
    rw [syzMap_apply] at this
    rw [← this]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← hτ j i, syzComponent_fAlg_smul_hwv, map_mul, fAlg_ι, mul_smul]
  have key : t₀ = ∑ i, (c i - ∑ j, FreeAlgebra.ι K j * τ j i) * FreeAlgebra.ι K i +
      ∑ j, FreeAlgebra.ι K j * ∑ i, τ j i * FreeAlgebra.ι K i := by
    rw [ht, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero]
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    abel
  
  have hmem : fAlg P p t₀ ∈ leftSerre P p := by
    rw [← FreeAlgebra.weightProj_self ht₀, key]
    simp only [map_add, map_sum]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ ?_)
    · rw [ι_eq_wordBasis, FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mul_wordBasis, wordWeight_singleton]
      split_ifs with hw
      · rw [map_mul, ← ι_eq_wordBasis, fAlg_ι]
        refine mul_f_mem_leftSerre (fAlg_weightProj_mem_leftSerre hmin (hg i) ?_) i
        rw [natVec_tsub_single (Finsupp.single_le_iff.1 hw), height_sub_single]
        omega
      · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    · rw [ι_eq_wordBasis, FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis_mul, wordWeight_singleton]
      split_ifs with hw
      · rw [map_mul, ← ι_eq_wordBasis, fAlg_ι]
        refine (leftSerre P p).smul_mem (f P p j) (fAlg_weightProj_mem_leftSerre hmin (hρ j) ?_)
        rw [natVec_tsub_single (Finsupp.single_le_iff.1 hw), height_sub_single]
        omega
      · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  exact hxS (mem_serreIdeal_of_mem (neg_ne_zero.2 (P.rootOf_ne_zero hk.2)) hmem hxg hxk)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.maxIdeal_inf_weightSpace_le_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem maxIdeal_inf_weightSpace_le_serreIdeal (S : A.Symmetrization)
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι) :
    maxIdeal P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf k) ≤ serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k ∈ posCone ι, height k < n →
      maxIdeal P p ⊓ weightSpace P p (-P.rootOf k) ≤ serreIdeal P p from
    this _ k hk (by omega : height k < ((height k).toNat + 1 : ℕ))
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro k hk h; have := height_pos hk; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro k hk hkn x ⟨hx, hxk⟩
    exact mem_serreIdeal_of_minimal S hA hk (fun l hl hlk ↦ ih l hl (by omega)) hx hxk

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem maxIdeal_eq_serreIdeal (S : A.Symmetrization) (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    (hp : A.IsSuperAdmissible p) : maxIdeal P p = serreIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun y hy ↦ ?_) (serreIdeal_le_maxIdeal P p S hA hp)
  have hN : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ maxIdeal P p, superBracket P p (h P p a) x ∈ maxIdeal P p :=
    fun a x hx ↦ (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (h_mem_gTilde P p a) x hx
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun x ↦ x ∈ serreIdeal P p)
    (le_iSup_inf_weightSpace P p _ hN hy) (fun μ x hx ↦ ?_) (zero_mem _)
    fun _ _ ↦ add_mem
  obtain ⟨hxR, hxμ⟩ := hx
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · rw [hx0]; exact zero_mem _
  rcases mem_allWeights P p ((isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hxR) hxμ hx0 with
    (⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ | rfl) | ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · exact maxIdeal_inf_weightSpace_le_serreIdeal S hA hk ⟨hxR, hxμ⟩
  · have : x ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      refine ⟨hxR, ?_⟩
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]
      exact ⟨(isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde hxR, hxμ⟩
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact absurd this hx0
  · have h1 := maxIdeal_inf_weightSpace_le_serreIdeal S hA hk
      ⟨omega_mem_maxIdeal P p hxR, omega_mem_weightSpace P p hxμ⟩
    have h2 := omega_mem_serreIdeal h1
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, omega_comp_omega] at h2
    simpa using parity_mem_serreIdeal h2

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rankOneCoeff_one
statement:
lemma rankOneCoeff_one (s : K) (k : ℕ) :
    rankOneCoeff 1 s k = -(k * (s + k - 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [rankOneCoeff]
  | succ k ih => rw [rankOneCoeff, ih]; push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rankOneCoeff_neg_one
statement:
lemma rankOneCoeff_neg_one (s : K) (k : ℕ) :
    rankOneCoeff (-1) s (2 * k) = 2 * k ∧ rankOneCoeff (-1) s (2 * k + 1) = s + 2 * k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [rankOneCoeff]
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 : rankOneCoeff (-1) s (2 * (k + 1)) = 2 * (k + 1) := by
      rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 1 + 1 by ring, rankOneCoeff, ih.2]; push_cast; ring
    refine ⟨by push_cast; exact h1, ?_⟩
    rw [show 2 * (k + 1) + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) + 1 by rfl, rankOneCoeff, h1]; push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.f_smul_e_pow_smul
statement:
lemma f_smul_e_pow_smul (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) {μ : Dual K H} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ) (hf : f P p i • v = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    f P p i • (e P p i ^ (k + 1) • v) =
      rankOneCoeff (superSign K p i i) (μ (P.coroot i)) (k + 1) • (e P p i ^ k • v)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_one, pow_zero, one_smul, ← mul_smul, f_mul_e, ite_eq_left rfl]
    simp only [sub_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hf, smul_zero, zero_sub, hv _]
    simp [rankOneCoeff, smul_smul]
  | succ k ih =>
    set σ := superSign K p i i
    have hw := e_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hv i (k + 1)
    have h1 : f P p i • (e P p i ^ (k + 1 + 1) • v) = σ • (e P p i • (f P p i •
        (e P p i ^ (k + 1) • v))) - σ • (h P p (P.coroot i) • (e P p i ^ (k + 1) • v)) := by
      rw [pow_succ' _ (k + 1), mul_smul, ← mul_smul, f_mul_e, ite_eq_left rfl, sub_smul,
        smul_assoc, smul_assoc, mul_smul]
    have h2 : (μ + (k + 1) • P.root i) (P.coroot i) = μ (P.coroot i) + 2 * (k + 1 : ℕ) := by
      simp [P.root_coroot, hA.diag]; ring
    have h3 : rankOneCoeff σ (μ (P.coroot i)) (k + 1 + 1) =
        σ * (rankOneCoeff σ (μ (P.coroot i)) (k + 1) - (μ (P.coroot i) + 2 * (k + 1 : ℕ))) :=
      rfl
    rw [h1, ih, hw, h2, smul_comm (e P p i) (rankOneCoeff _ _ _), ← mul_smul (e P p i),
      ← pow_succ', h3, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← sub_smul, mul_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_nat_of_f_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n, e P p i ^ (n + 1) • v = 0 := ⟨N, by
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, hN, smul_zero]⟩
  set m := Nat.find hex
  have hm : e P p i ^ (m + 1) • v = 0 := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hm' : e P p i ^ m • v ≠ 0 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h0 | hpos
    · rw [h0, pow_zero, one_smul]; exact hv0
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      have := Nat.find_min hex (show n < m by omega)
      rwa [hn]
  have hc := f_smul_e_pow_smul hA i hv hf m
  rw [hm, smul_zero, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero] at hc
  have hc := hc.resolve_right hm'
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  rw [superSign_self] at hc
  split_ifs at hc
  · obtain ⟨j, hj | hj⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' (m + 1)
    · rw [hj, (rankOneCoeff_neg_one _ j).1] at hc
      have : (j : K) = 0 := by linear_combination hc / 2
      have : j = 0 := by exact_mod_cast this
      omega
    · rw [hj, (rankOneCoeff_neg_one _ j).2] at hc
      have : (m : K) = 2 * j := by exact_mod_cast (show m = 2 * j by omega)
      linear_combination hc + this
  · rw [rankOneCoeff_one] at hc
    have h1 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero m
    push_cast at hc h1
    have := (mul_eq_zero.1 (neg_eq_zero.1 hc)).resolve_left h1
    linear_combination this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_e_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_e_pow_smul_eq_zero {Λ : Dual K H} (hV : IsBounded P p V {Λ}) (i : ι)
    {μ : Dual K H} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V μ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, e P p i ^ N • v = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv0 : v = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [hv0, smul_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨μ', hΛ, d₀, -, hd₀⟩ := hV.exists_eq_sub hv hv0
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hΛ
  rw [hΛ] at hd₀
  refine ⟨(d₀ i).toNat + 1, ?_⟩
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨_, hΛ', d, hd, hdeq⟩ := hV.exists_eq_sub (e_pow_smul_mem_modWeightSpace hv i _) hne
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hΛ'
  rw [hΛ'] at hdeq
  have : P.rootOf d = P.rootOf (d₀ - (((d₀ i).toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • Pi.single i 1) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_zsmul, rootOf_single, natCast_zsmul]
    rw [hd₀] at hdeq
    calc P.rootOf d = Λ - (Λ - P.rootOf d) := by abel
      _ = Λ - (Λ - P.rootOf d₀ + (((d₀ i).toNat + 1 : ℕ) • P.root i)) := by rw [hdeq]
      _ = _ := by abel
  have h := congr_fun (P.rootOf_injective this) i
  have := hd i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    Pi.zero_apply] at h this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.eq_zero_of_f_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hv0
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_e_pow_smul_eq_zero hV i hv
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_of_f_smul_eq_zero hA i hv hv0 hf hN
  exact hμ m hm

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_gIdeal_of_ι_mul_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff (Λ := (2 : K)⁻¹ • P.rho)] at hit ⊢
  refine eq_zero_of_f_smul_eq_zero hA GVerma.isBounded i
    (μ := (2 : K)⁻¹ • P.rho - P.rootOf (natVec ν)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [sub_eq_neg_add]
    exact smul_mem_modWeightSpace _ (fAlg_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_wordSpan P p ht)
      GVerma.h_smul_hwv
  · rwa [← mul_smul, ← fAlg_ι P p i, ← map_mul]
  · intro m hm
    rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, rho_coroot, rootOf_apply_coroot,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hm
    have h2 : (1 : K) = 2 * (((A *ᵥ natVec ν) i : ℤ) - (m : ℤ) : ℤ) := by
      push_cast; linear_combination 2 * hm
    have h2' : (1 : ℤ) = 2 * ((A *ᵥ natVec ν) i - m) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_mem_wordSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw =>
    induction hy using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
    | word u hu =>
      rw [← FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_append]
      exact FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq (by rw [LusztigF.wordWeight_append, hw, hu])
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.ι_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma ι_mem_wordSpan (i : ι) :
    FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K (Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ι_eq_wordBasis]
  exact FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq (wordWeight_singleton i)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.oddDeg_add
statement: lemma oddDeg_add (μ ν : ι →₀ ℕ) : oddDeg p (μ + ν) = oddDeg p μ + oddDeg p ν
proof:
:= by
  simp [oddDeg, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.oddDeg_single
statement: lemma oddDeg_single (j : ι) : oddDeg p (Finsupp.single j 1) = (p j).val
proof:
:= by
  classical simp [oddDeg, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.natCast_oddDeg_single_add
statement:
lemma natCast_oddDeg_single_add (j : ι) (ν : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ((oddDeg p (Finsupp.single j 1 + ν) : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = p j + (oddDeg p ν : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddDeg_add, oddDeg_single, Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isHomog_fAlg
statement:
lemma isHomog_fAlg {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν) :
    IsHomog P p (oddDeg p ν : ZMod 2) (fAlg P p t)
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw =>
    subst hw
    induction w with
    | nil => simp [IsHomog, oddDeg]
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, map_mul, fAlg_ι, LusztigF.wordWeight_cons,
        natCast_oddDeg_single_add]
      exact (isHomog_f P p j).mul ih
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact isHomog_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact hx.add hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact hx.smul c

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sum_weightProj
statement:
lemma sum_weightProj (x : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    ∑ ν ∈ ((FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι).repr x).support.image LusztigF.wordWeight,
      FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν x = x
proof:
:= by
  set c := (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι).repr x
  have hx : x = ∑ w ∈ c.support, c w • FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι w := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis K ι).linearCombination_repr x]
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [hx]
  conv_lhs => rw [hx]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis, smul_ite, smul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  simp [Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hw]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sLie_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma sLie_mem_wordSpan (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    sLie p i w ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K (Finsupp.single i 1 + LusztigF.wordWeight w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa [sLie] using ι_mem_wordSpan i
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [sLie, LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, add_left_comm]
    refine sub_mem (mul_mem_wordSpan (ι_mem_wordSpan j) ih)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_)
    rw [add_comm (Finsupp.single j 1)]
    exact mul_mem_wordSpan ih (ι_mem_wordSpan j)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.fAlg_sLie
statement:
lemma fAlg_sLie (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    fAlg P p (sLie p i w) = omega P p (eLie P p i w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [sLie]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [sLie, eLie_cons, omega_superBracket, omega_e, ← ih,
      superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_f P p j) (ih ▸ (isHomog_eLie P p i w).omega P p)]
    simp [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.nMinus_le_map_span_sLie
statement:
lemma nMinus_le_map_span_sLie :
    nMinus P p ≤ (Submodule.span K (Set.range fun x : ι × List ι ↦ sLie p x.1 x.2)).map
      (fAlg P p).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [nMinus, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, nPlus_le_iff]
  intro i w
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.map_span]
  refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨sLie p i w, ⟨(i, w), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, fAlg_sLie]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_span_sLie_of_mem_fPre
statement:
theorem mem_span_sLie_of_mem_fPre {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ fPre P p)
    (htν : t ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν) :
    t ∈ Submodule.span K {x | ∃ i w, Finsupp.single i 1 + LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν ∧
      sLie p i w = x}
proof:
:= by
  have hw := fAlg_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_wordSpan P p htν
  have hg := (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).le_gTilde (mem_fPre.1 ht)
  by_cases hν : ν = 0
  · subst hν
    have : fAlg P p t ∈ maxIdeal P p ⊓ LinearMap.range (h P p) := by
      refine ⟨mem_fPre.1 ht, ?_⟩
      rw [← gTilde_inf_weightSpace_zero P p]
      refine ⟨hg, ?_⟩
      have h0 : natVec (0 : ι →₀ ℕ) = 0 := by ext; simp [natVec]
      rwa [h0, map_zero, neg_zero] at hw
    rw [maxIdeal_inf_range_h, Submodule.mem_bot, ← map_zero (fAlg P p)] at this
    rw [fAlg_injective P p this]
    exact zero_mem _
  have hk : natVec ν ∈ posCone ι := ⟨fun i ↦ by simp [natVec], fun h ↦ hν
    (natVec_injective (h.trans (by ext; simp [natVec])))⟩
  have hμ : -P.rootOf (natVec ν) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.2 (P.rootOf_ne_zero hk.2)
  rcases mem_nMinus_or_mem_nPlus_of_mem_weightSpace hg hw hμ with hn | hn
  · obtain ⟨s, hs, hst⟩ := nMinus_le_map_span_sLie hn
    rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply] at hst
    rw [← FreeAlgebra.weightProj_self htν, ← fAlg_injective P p hst]
    clear hst
    induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨⟨i, w⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [FreeAlgebra.weightProj_of_mem (sLie_mem_wordSpan i w)]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, w, h, rfl⟩
      · exact zero_mem _
    | zero => simp
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  · have h1 := wProj_of_mem P p hw
    rw [wProj_nPlus hk hn, eq_comm, ← map_zero (fAlg P p)] at h1
    rw [fAlg_injective P p h1]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.zSign_natCast
statement: lemma zSign_natCast (n : ℕ) : zSign K (n : ZMod 2) = (-1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.cast_succ, zSign_add, ih, zSign_one, pow_succ]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.natCast_oddDeg_wordWeight
statement:
lemma natCast_oddDeg_wordWeight (w : List ι) :
    ((oddDeg p (LusztigF.wordWeight w) : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = (w.map p).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [oddDeg]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, natCast_oddDeg_single_add, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.revSign_single_add
statement:
lemma revSign_single_add (j : ι) (ν : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    revSign K p (Finsupp.single j 1 + ν) =
      -(zSign K (p j * (oddDeg p ν : ZMod 2)) * revSign K p ν)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑ i, (Finsupp.single j 1 + ν : ι →₀ ℕ) i = ∑ i, ν i + 1 := by
    classical simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finsupp.single_apply, add_comm]
  rw [revSign, revSign, h1, oddDeg_add, oddDeg_single]
  rcases zmod_two_cases (p j) with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · simp [pow_succ]
  · rw [show (1 : ZMod 2).val = 1 from rfl, one_mul, zSign_natCast, add_comm 1,
      Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.choose_one_right, pow_add, pow_add, pow_one]
    ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rev_ι
statement: lemma rev_ι (j : ι) : LusztigF.rev K ι (FreeAlgebra.ι K j) = FreeAlgebra.ι K j
proof:
:=
  LusztigF.rev_θ j

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rev_sLie
statement:
lemma rev_sLie (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    LusztigF.rev K ι (sLie p i w) =
      revSign K p (Finsupp.single i 1 + LusztigF.wordWeight w) • sLie p i w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    have : (p i).val.choose 2 = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by have := ZMod.val_lt (p i); omega)
    classical simp [sLie, revSign, oddDeg_single, this, Finsupp.single_apply]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [sLie, map_sub, map_smul, LusztigF.rev_mul, LusztigF.rev_mul, ih, rev_ι,
      LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, add_left_comm, revSign_single_add j, natCast_oddDeg_single_add,
      natCast_oddDeg_wordWeight, add_comm (p i)]
    set z := zSign K (p j * ((w.map p).sum + p i))
    have hz : z * z = 1 := zSign_mul_self K _
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul, neg_mul, neg_smul]
    rw [show z * revSign K p (Finsupp.single i 1 + LusztigF.wordWeight w) * z =
      revSign K p (Finsupp.single i 1 + LusztigF.wordWeight w) by
        rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, hz, one_mul], mul_comm z]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rev_of_mem_span_sLie
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => obtain ⟨i, w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy; exact rev_sLie i w
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, smul_add]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rev_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma rev_mem_wordSpan {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν) :
    LusztigF.rev K ι t ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan K ν
proof:
:=
  LusztigF.rev_mem_weightSpace ht

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rev_mem_fPre
statement: theorem rev_mem_fPre {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ fPre P p) : LusztigF.rev K ι t ∈ fPre P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_weightProj t, map_sum]
  refine sum_mem fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  have h1 := weightProj_mem_fPre ht ν
  rw [rev_of_mem_span_sLie (mem_span_sLie_of_mem_fPre h1 (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν t))]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h1

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.weightProj_mem_gIdeal
statement:
theorem weightProj_mem_gIdeal {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ gIdeal P p) (ν : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν t ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff (Λ := 0)]
  have := fAlg_weightProj_mem_of_mem_gIdeal
    (M := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton 𝒰 (GVerma P p 0) (GVerma.hwv P p 0))) ht ν
    fun μ _ r hr _ ↦ by
      simp [GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff, mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre hr]
  simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_ι_mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre
statement:
lemma mul_ι_mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre {r : FreeAlgebra K ι} (hr : r ∈ fPre P p) (j : ι) :
    r * FreeAlgebra.ι K j ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_weightProj r, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine sum_mem fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  have hs := weightProj_mem_fPre hr ν
  have hh := isHomog_fAlg (P := P) (p := p) (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν r)
  set s := FreeAlgebra.weightProj K ν r
  set z := zSign K (p j * (oddDeg p ν : ZMod 2))
  have hb : FreeAlgebra.ι K j * s - z • (s * FreeAlgebra.ι K j) ∈ fPre P p := by
    rw [mem_fPre, map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, map_mul, fAlg_ι,
      ← superBracket_of_isHomog (isHomog_f P p j) hh]
    exact (isIdeal_maxIdeal P p).superBracket_mem _ (f_mem_gTilde P p j) _ (mem_fPre.1 hs)
  have : s * FreeAlgebra.ι K j = z • (FreeAlgebra.ι K j * s -
      (FreeAlgebra.ι K j * s - z • (s * FreeAlgebra.ι K j))) := by
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, smul_smul, zSign_mul_self, one_smul]
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (sub_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ (FreeAlgebra.ι K j)
    (mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre hs)) (mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre hb))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mul_mem_gIdeal
statement:
theorem mul_mem_gIdeal {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ gIdeal P p) (a : FreeAlgebra K ι) :
    t * a ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  have hι : ∀ t ∈ gIdeal P p, ∀ j, t * FreeAlgebra.ι K j ∈ gIdeal P p := by
    intro t ht j
    induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem r hr => exact mul_ι_mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre hr j
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing t with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def]; exact Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ c ht
  | grade1 j => exact hι t ht j
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hb (ha ht)
  | add a b ha hb => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem (ha ht) (hb ht)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.rev_mem_gIdeal
statement:
theorem rev_mem_gIdeal {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (ht : t ∈ gIdeal P p) :
    LusztigF.rev K ι t ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem r hr => exact mem_gIdeal_of_mem_fPre (rev_mem_fPre hr)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, LusztigF.rev_mul]; exact mul_mem_gIdeal hx _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_gIdeal_of_mul_ι_mem
proof:
:= by
  have := rev_mem_gIdeal hit
  rw [LusztigF.rev_mul, rev_ι] at this
  have := rev_mem_gIdeal (mem_gIdeal_of_ι_mul_mem hA (rev_mem_wordSpan ht) i this)
  rwa [LusztigF.rev_rev] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_gIdeal_of_ι_mul_mem'
statement:
theorem mem_gIdeal_of_ι_mul_mem' (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (i : ι)
    (hit : FreeAlgebra.ι K i * t ∈ gIdeal P p) : t ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_weightProj t]
  refine sum_mem fun ν _ ↦ mem_gIdeal_of_ι_mul_mem hA (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν t) i ?_
  have := weightProj_mem_gIdeal hit (Finsupp.single i 1 + ν)
  rwa [ι_eq_wordBasis, FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis_mul, wordWeight_singleton,
    ite_eq_left le_self_add, add_tsub_cancel_left, ← ι_eq_wordBasis] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.mem_gIdeal_of_mul_ι_mem'
statement:
theorem mem_gIdeal_of_mul_ι_mem' (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {t : FreeAlgebra K ι} (i : ι)
    (hit : t * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∈ gIdeal P p) : t ∈ gIdeal P p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_weightProj t]
  refine sum_mem fun ν _ ↦ mem_gIdeal_of_mul_ι_mem hA (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν t) i ?_
  have := weightProj_mem_gIdeal hit (ν + Finsupp.single i 1)
  rwa [ι_eq_wordBasis, FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mul_wordBasis, wordWeight_singleton,
    ite_eq_left le_add_self, add_tsub_cancel_right, ← ι_eq_wordBasis] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.syzComponent_injective
statement:
theorem syzComponent_injective (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    Function.Injective (syzComponent P p i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := GVerma.exists_eq_fAlg_smul_hwv v
  rw [syzComponent_fAlg_smul_hwv, ← mul_smul, ← fAlg_ι P p i, ← map_mul,
    GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff] at hv
  exact GVerma.fAlg_smul_hwv_eq_zero_iff.2 (mem_gIdeal_of_mul_ι_mem' hA i hv)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.toWeightOrd_le_of_eq_add
statement:
lemma toWeightOrd_le_of_eq_add {μ ν : Dual K H} {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (h : ν = μ + P.rootOf k) : toWeightOrd P ν ≤ toWeightOrd P μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨k, hk, by simp only [ofWeightOrd_toWeightOrd]; rw [h, add_sub_cancel_left]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.toWeightOrd_lt_of_eq_add
statement:
lemma toWeightOrd_lt_of_eq_add {μ ν : Dual K H} {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ posCone ι)
    (h : ν = μ + P.rootOf k) : toWeightOrd P ν < toWeightOrd P μ
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (toWeightOrd_le_of_eq_add hk.1 h) fun he ↦ hk.2 ?_
  have : ν = μ := (toWeightOrd P).injective he
  rw [this, left_eq_add, ← map_zero P.rootOf] at h
  exact P.rootOf_injective h

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_mul_congr
proof:
:= by
  rw [CharacterRing.coeff_mul, CharacterRing.coeff_mul]
  refine finsum_congr fun ν ↦ ?_
  by_cases h0 : d.coeffAt (μ - ν) = 0
  · rw [h0, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hμν⟩ := hd _ h0
  have hν : ν = μ + P.rootOf k := by rw [← neg_neg (P.rootOf k), ← hμν]; abel
  rw [h ν (toWeightOrd_le_of_eq_add hk hν)]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsNegSupported.mul
statement:
lemma IsNegSupported.mul {c d : P.CharacterRing ℤ} (hc : IsNegSupported P c)
    (hd : IsNegSupported P d) : IsNegSupported P (c * d)
proof:
:= by
  intro μ hμ
  rw [CharacterRing.coeff_mul] at hμ
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ : ∃ ν, c.coeffAt ν * d.coeffAt (μ - ν) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hμ (finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero h)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h1⟩ := hc ν (left_ne_zero_of_mul hν)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, h2⟩ := hd _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hν)
  refine ⟨a + b, add_nonneg ha hb, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, neg_add, ← h1, ← h2, add_sub_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsNegSupported.coeffAt_mul_zero
statement:
lemma IsNegSupported.coeffAt_mul_zero {c d : P.CharacterRing ℤ} (hc : IsNegSupported P c)
    (hd : IsNegSupported P d) : (c * d).coeffAt 0 = c.coeffAt 0 * d.coeffAt 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [CharacterRing.coeff_mul, finsum_eq_single _ 0 fun ν hν ↦ ?_, zero_sub, neg_zero]
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h1⟩ := hc ν (left_ne_zero_of_mul h)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, h2⟩ := hd _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul h)
  rw [h1, zero_sub, neg_neg] at h2
  have hab : a + b = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_add, h2, neg_add_cancel, map_zero])
  have : a = 0 := le_antisymm (hab ▸ le_add_of_nonneg_right hb) ha
  rw [this, map_zero, neg_zero] at h1
  exact hν h1

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isNegSupported_denominator
statement: lemma isNegSupported_denominator : IsNegSupported P (KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P)
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ KacMoodyAlgebra.exists_eq_neg_rootOf_of_coeffAt_denominator_ne_zero P h

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_denominator_zero
statement: lemma coeffAt_denominator_zero : (KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P).coeffAt 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_denominator, finsum_eq_single _ ∅ fun S hS ↦ ?_]
  · simp [KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetWt]
  · rw [ite_eq_right_iff]
    intro h
    exact absurd (neg_eq_zero.1 h)
      (KacMoodyAlgebra.finsetWt_ne_zero P (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hS))

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_vermaChar
statement:
lemma coeffAt_vermaChar (μ : Dual K H) :
    (vermaChar P p).coeffAt μ = GVerma.vermaDim P p (-μ)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isNegSupported_vermaChar
statement: lemma isNegSupported_vermaChar : IsNegSupported P (vermaChar P p)
proof:
:= fun μ hμ ↦ by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, h⟩ := GVerma.exists_eq_rootOf_of_vermaDim_ne_zero (P := P) (p := p)
    (β := -μ) fun h ↦ hμ (by rw [coeffAt_vermaChar, h, Nat.cast_zero])
  exact ⟨d, hd, by rw [← h, neg_neg]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_vermaChar_zero
statement: lemma coeffAt_vermaChar_zero : (vermaChar P p).coeffAt 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeffAt_vermaChar, neg_zero, GVerma.vermaDim_zero, Nat.cast_one]

name: FreeAlgebra.word_append_singleton
statement:
lemma _root_.FreeAlgebra.word_append_singleton (w : List ι) (i : ι) :
    FreeAlgebra.word (R := K) (w ++ [i]) = FreeAlgebra.word w * FreeAlgebra.ι K i
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [FreeAlgebra.word_nil, FreeAlgebra.word_cons]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, FreeAlgebra.word_cons, FreeAlgebra.word_cons, ih, mul_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.wordVector_append
statement:
lemma wordVector_append (w : List ι) (i : ι) :
    GVerma.wordVector P p 0 (w ++ [i]) =
      syzComponent P p i (GVerma.wordVector P p (-P.root i) w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GVerma.wordVector, GVerma.wordVector, syzComponent_fAlg_smul_hwv,
    FreeAlgebra.word_append_singleton, map_mul, mul_smul, fAlg_ι]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.syzComponent_mem_range
statement:
lemma syzComponent_mem_range (i : ι) (v : GVerma P p (-P.root i)) :
    syzComponent P p i v ∈ LinearMap.range (syzMap P p)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Pi.single i v, ?_⟩
  rw [syzMap_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, map_zero])
    (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.syzComponent_mem_iSup
statement:
lemma syzComponent_mem_iSup (i : ι) (v : GVerma P p (-P.root i)) :
    syzComponent P p i v ∈ ⨆ μ, ⨆ (_ : μ ≠ 0), modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (GVerma.wordVector P p (-P.root i))) := by
    rw [GVerma.span_wordVector]; trivial
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [← wordVector_append]
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ?_ (GVerma.wordVector_mem _))
    rw [zero_sub, neg_ne_zero, ← map_zero P.rootOf]
    intro h
    exact (by simp : w ++ [i] ≠ []) (wordVec_eq_zero_iff.1 (P.rootOf_injective h))
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [(syzComponent P p i).map_smul_of_tower]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.hwv_notMem_range_syzMap
statement: lemma hwv_notMem_range_syzMap : GVerma.hwv P p 0 ∉ LinearMap.range (syzMap P p)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
  have h1 : GVerma.hwv P p 0 ∈ ⨆ μ, ⨆ (_ : μ ≠ 0), modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0) μ := by
    rw [← hv, syzMap_apply]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ syzComponent_mem_iSup i (v i)
  have h0 : GVerma.hwv P p 0 ∈ modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0) 0 := by
    rw [GVerma.modWeightSpace_self]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  exact GVerma.hwv_ne_zero P p 0
    (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_modWeightSpace (GVerma P p 0) 0) _ h0 h1)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finrank_modWeightSpace_quotient_range_syzMap
statement:
lemma finrank_modWeightSpace_quotient_range_syzMap (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0 ⧸ LinearMap.range (syzMap P p)) μ) =
      if μ = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hV := (GVerma.isBounded (P := P) (p := p) (Λ := 0)).iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top
  rw [modWeightSpace_quotient _ hV]
  split_ifs with hμ
  · subst hμ
    rw [GVerma.modWeightSpace_self, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      finrank_span_singleton]
    intro h
    exact hwv_notMem_range_syzMap ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 h)
  · have h := GVerma.modWeightSpace_sub_eq P p 0 (-μ)
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add] at h
    rw [h, Submodule.map_span]
    rw [Submodule.span_eq_bot.2 ?_, finrank_bot]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat w with rfl | ⟨w', i, rfl⟩
    · refine absurd ?_ hμ
      rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hw
      simpa [wordVec_eq_zero_iff.2 rfl] using hw.symm
    · rw [List.concat_eq_append] at *
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      rw [wordVector_append]
      exact syzComponent_mem_range i _

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.range_syzComponent_eq
statement:
lemma range_syzComponent_eq (i : ι) :
    LinearMap.range (syzComponent P p i) = Submodule.span 𝒰 {f P p i ^ 1 • GVerma.hwv P p 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← GVerma.span_hwv, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton, pow_one]
  congr 2
  have := syzComponent_fAlg_smul_hwv (P := P) (p := p) i 1
  rwa [map_one, one_smul, one_smul] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finrank_modWeightSpace_range_syzComponent
statement:
lemma finrank_modWeightSpace_range_syzComponent (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (LinearMap.range (syzComponent P p i)) μ) =
      GVerma.vermaDim P p (-P.root i - μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finrank_modWeightSpace_equiv (LinearEquiv.ofInjective _ (syzComponent_injective hA i)),
    GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finrank_modWeightSpace_quotient_range_syzComponent
statement:
lemma finrank_modWeightSpace_quotient_range_syzComponent (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι)
    (μ : Dual K H) :
    (finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0 ⧸ LinearMap.range (syzComponent P p i)) μ) :
      ℤ) = (vermaChar P p).coeffAt μ - (vermaChar P p).coeffAt (μ + P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  have hV := (GVerma.isBounded (P := P) (p := p) (Λ := 0)).iSup_modWeightSpace_eq_top
  have h := finrank_modWeightSpace_eq_add (LinearMap.range (syzComponent P p i)) hV μ
  rw [finrank_modWeightSpace_range_syzComponent hA, GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace, zero_sub] at h
  have h' : -P.root i - μ = -(μ + P.root i) := by abel
  rw [coeffAt_vermaChar, coeffAt_vermaChar, h, h']
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_one_sub_exp_mul
statement:
lemma coeffAt_one_sub_exp_mul (i : ι) (c : P.CharacterRing ℤ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    ((1 - exp P ℤ (-P.root i)) * c).coeffAt μ = c.coeffAt μ - c.coeffAt (μ + P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul, one_mul]
  simp only [coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_sub]
  rw [← coeffAt, ← coeffAt, ← coeffAt, coeff_exp_mul, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_mul_reflection_of_anti
proof:
:= by
  rw [CharacterRing.coeff_mul, CharacterRing.coeff_mul, ← finsum_comp_equiv r.toEquiv,
    ← finsum_neg_distrib]
  refine finsum_congr fun ν ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearEquiv.coe_toEquiv, hc, ← map_sub, hd, neg_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_one
statement:
lemma coeffAt_one (μ : Dual K H) :
    (1 : P.CharacterRing ℤ).coeffAt μ = if μ = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exp_zero (P := P) (R := ℤ), coeff_exp]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_add
statement:
lemma coeffAt_add (c d : P.CharacterRing ℤ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (c + d).coeffAt μ = c.coeffAt μ + d.coeffAt μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_add]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_sub
statement:
lemma coeffAt_sub (c d : P.CharacterRing ℤ) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (c - d).coeffAt μ = c.coeffAt μ - d.coeffAt μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_sub]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.coeffAt_vermaChar_reflection
statement:
lemma coeffAt_vermaChar_reflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (vermaChar P p).coeffAt (P.reflection hA i μ) -
        (vermaChar P p).coeffAt (P.reflection hA i μ + P.root i) =
      (vermaChar P p).coeffAt μ - (vermaChar P p).coeffAt (μ + P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finrank_modWeightSpace_quotient_range_syzComponent hA,
    ← finrank_modWeightSpace_quotient_range_syzComponent hA]
  have hint := GVerma.isIntegrableAt_quotient (P := P) (p := p) S hA hp 0 i 1
  rw [← range_syzComponent_eq] at hint
  have h : finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0 ⧸ LinearMap.range (syzComponent P p i))
      (P.reflection hA i μ)) =
      finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p 0 ⧸ LinearMap.range (syzComponent P p i)) μ) :=
    congrArg Cardinal.toNat
      (rank_modWeightSpace_reflection_of_isIntegrableAt (V := GVerma P p 0 ⧸
        LinearMap.range (syzComponent P p i)) hA hint μ)
  rw [h]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.exists_posCone_of_coeffAt_vermaChar_mul_denominator_sub_one_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeffAt_sub, coeffAt_one] at h
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · subst hμ
    rw [isNegSupported_vermaChar.coeffAt_mul_zero isNegSupported_denominator,
      coeffAt_vermaChar_zero, coeffAt_denominator_zero] at h
    simp at h
  · simp only [hμ, ite_false, sub_zero] at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := (isNegSupported_vermaChar.mul isNegSupported_denominator) μ h
    refine ⟨k, ⟨hk, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    rintro rfl
    simp at hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.sum_mul_le_zero_of_maximal
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_zero_of_maximal {β : Dual K H} {k : ι → ℤ} (hβ : β = -P.rootOf k)
    (hne : (vermaChar P p * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P - 1).coeffAt β ≠ 0)
    (hmax : ∀ μ, toWeightOrd P μ < toWeightOrd P β →
      (vermaChar P p * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P - 1).coeffAt μ = 0)
    (i : ι) : ∑ j, A i j * k j ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set D := vermaChar P p
  set R := KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P
  set Y := D * R - 1 with hYdef
  set r := P.reflection hA i
  set E : P.CharacterRing ℤ := 1 - exp P ℤ (-P.root i)
  set W := E * (exp P ℤ P.rho * Y)
  have hrρ : r P.rho = P.rho - P.root i := by
    rw [reflection_apply, rho_coroot, one_smul]
  have hEρ : ∀ μ, (E * exp P ℤ P.rho).coeffAt (r μ) = -(E * exp P ℤ P.rho).coeffAt μ := by
    intro μ
    rw [coeffAt_one_sub_exp_mul, coeffAt_one_sub_exp_mul, coeff_exp, coeff_exp, coeff_exp,
      coeff_exp]
    have h1 : r μ = P.rho ↔ μ + P.root i = P.rho := by
      rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← hrρ]
      constructor
      · intro h; rw [← h, reflection_reflection]
      · intro h; rw [h, reflection_reflection]
    have h2 : r μ + P.root i = P.rho ↔ μ = P.rho := by
      rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← hrρ]
      exact r.injective.eq_iff
    simp only [h1, h2]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hED : ∀ μ, (E * D).coeffAt (r μ) = (E * D).coeffAt μ := by
    intro μ
    rw [coeffAt_one_sub_exp_mul, coeffAt_one_sub_exp_mul]
    exact coeffAt_vermaChar_reflection S hA hp i μ
  have hWeq : W = exp P ℤ P.rho * R * (E * D) - E * exp P ℤ P.rho := by
    simp only [W, hYdef]; ring
  have hW : ∀ μ, W.coeffAt (r μ) = -W.coeffAt μ := by
    intro μ
    rw [hWeq, coeffAt_sub, coeffAt_sub, coeffAt_mul_reflection_of_anti
      (KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_exp_rho_mul_denominator_reflection hA i) hED, hEρ]
    ring
  have hWY : ∀ μ, W.coeffAt μ = Y.coeffAt (μ - P.rho) - Y.coeffAt (μ + P.root i - P.rho) := by
    intro μ
    rw [coeffAt_one_sub_exp_mul, coeff_exp_mul, coeff_exp_mul]
  have hsingle : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 < n → Pi.single i n ∈ posCone ι := fun n hn ↦
    ⟨Pi.single_nonneg.2 hn.le, fun h ↦ hn.ne' (by simpa using congrFun h i)⟩
  have hroot : ∀ n : ℤ, P.rootOf (Pi.single i n) = (n : K) • P.root i := by
    intro n
    simp [rootOf_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  set s := ∑ j, A i j * k j
  have hβα : β (P.coroot i) = -(s : K) := by
    rw [hβ, LinearMap.neg_apply, rootOf_apply_coroot]
    simp [s, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  
  have hWmm : W.coeffAt (β + P.rho) = Y.coeffAt β := by
    have e : β + P.rho + P.root i - P.rho = β + P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1) := by
      rw [hroot, Int.cast_one, one_smul]; abel
    have h0 := hmax _ (toWeightOrd_lt_of_eq_add (hsingle 1 one_pos) rfl)
    rw [hWY, e, h0, add_sub_cancel_right, sub_zero]
  by_contra hs
  push Not at hs
  set n := s - 1
  have hrmm : r (β + P.rho) = β + P.rootOf (Pi.single i n) + P.rho := by
    rw [reflection_apply, hroot]
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, hβα, rho_coroot, n]
    push_cast
    module
  have h1 : W.coeffAt (r (β + P.rho)) = Y.coeffAt (β + P.rootOf (Pi.single i n)) := by
    have e : β + P.rootOf (Pi.single i n) + P.rho + P.root i - P.rho =
        β + P.rootOf (Pi.single i n) + P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1) := by
      rw [hroot 1, Int.cast_one, one_smul]; abel
    have e' : β + P.rootOf (Pi.single i (n + 1)) =
        β + P.rootOf (Pi.single i n) + P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1) := by
      rw [hroot, hroot, hroot]; push_cast; module
    have h0 := hmax _ (toWeightOrd_lt_of_eq_add (hsingle (n + 1) (by omega)) rfl)
    rw [e'] at h0
    rw [hWY, hrmm, e, h0, add_sub_cancel_right, sub_zero]
  rw [hW, hWmm] at h1
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (show 0 ≤ n by omega) with hn | hn
  · rw [← hn, Pi.single_zero, map_zero, add_zero] at h1
    exact hne (by omega)
  · rw [hmax _ (toWeightOrd_lt_of_eq_add (hsingle n hn) rfl)] at h1
    exact hne (by omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.dualBilinForm_eq_zero_of_maximal
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_eq_zero_of_maximal {β : Dual K H} {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hβ : β = -P.rootOf k)
    (hne : (vermaChar P p * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P - 1).coeffAt β ≠ 0)
    (hmax : ∀ μ, toWeightOrd P μ < toWeightOrd P β →
      (vermaChar P p * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P - 1).coeffAt μ = 0) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (β + 2 • P.rho) β = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set D := vermaChar P p
  set R := KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P
  set Y := D * R - 1 with hYdef
  set N := LinearMap.range (syzMap P p)
  have hT : IsCasimirModule P p S (GVerma P p 0 ⧸ N) {0} 0 := by
    have h := (IsCasimirModule.gVerma (S := S) (Λs := {0}) (μ₀ := 0) hA
      ⟨0, Finset.mem_singleton_self _, le_rfl⟩).quotient N
    rwa [map_zero] at h
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hexp⟩ := hT.exists_expansion hA β
  have haneg : ∀ κ, a κ ≠ 0 → ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ κ = 0 - P.rootOf k := fun κ hκ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hle⟩ := (ha κ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hκ)).2
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hΛ
    subst hΛ
    exact (toWeightOrd_le_toWeightOrd_iff_exists_eq_sub P).1 hle
  set A' : P.CharacterRing ℤ := ofFun P (fun κ ↦ a κ) ⟨{0}, fun κ hκ ↦
    ⟨0, Finset.mem_singleton_self _, haneg κ hκ⟩⟩
  have hA'neg : IsNegSupported P A' := fun κ hκ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := haneg κ hκ
    exact ⟨k, hk, by rw [h, zero_sub]⟩
  set F := A' * D
  have hF : ∀ μ, toWeightOrd P μ ≤ toWeightOrd P β →
      F.coeffAt μ = (1 : P.CharacterRing ℤ).coeffAt μ := by
    intro μ hμ
    have h := hexp μ hμ
    rw [finrank_modWeightSpace_quotient_range_syzMap] at h
    have hsum : F.coeffAt μ = a.sum fun κ m ↦ m * (GVerma.vermaDim P p (κ - μ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [CharacterRing.coeff_mul, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := a.support)]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun κ _ ↦ ?_
        rw [coeffAt_vermaChar, neg_sub]
        rfl
      · intro κ hκ
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hκ
        exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 (left_ne_zero_of_mul hκ)
    rw [coeffAt_one, hsum, ← h]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have ha0 : a 0 = 1 := by
    have h := hF 0 (toWeightOrd_le_of_eq_add hk (by rw [hβ, neg_add_cancel]))
    rw [hA'neg.coeffAt_mul_zero isNegSupported_vermaChar, coeffAt_vermaChar_zero, mul_one,
      coeffAt_one] at h
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at h
    exact h
  have hR : R.coeffAt β = a β + Y.coeffAt β := by
    have h1 : R.coeffAt β = (F * R).coeffAt β := by
      rw [coeffAt_mul_congr isNegSupported_denominator hF, one_mul]
    have h2 : F * R = A' + Y * A' := by simp only [F, Y]; ring
    have h3 : (Y * A').coeffAt β = Y.coeffAt β := by
      rw [CharacterRing.coeff_mul, finsum_eq_single _ β fun ν hν ↦ ?_, sub_self]
      · change Y.coeffAt β * a 0 = _
        rw [ha0, mul_one]
      by_contra h
      obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := hA'neg _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul h)
      have hν' : ν = β + P.rootOf k' := by rw [← neg_neg (P.rootOf k'), ← hk'eq]; abel
      have hk'0 : k' ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [map_zero, add_zero] at hν'; exact hν hν'
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul h (hmax ν (toWeightOrd_lt_of_eq_add ⟨hk', hk'0⟩ hν'))
    rw [h1, h2, coeffAt_add, h3]
    rfl
  by_cases haβ : a β = 0
  · rw [haβ, zero_add] at hR
    have hS := Matrix.isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization.mpr ⟨S⟩
    have hR' : (exp P ℤ P.rho * R).coeffAt (β + P.rho) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [coeff_exp_mul, add_sub_cancel_right, hR]; exact hne
    rw [KacMoodyAlgebra.IrreducibleModule.exp_rho_mul_denominator hA hS] at hR'
    change (∑ᶠ w : P.weylGroup hA, if (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) P.rho = β + P.rho then
      ((-1) ^ (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w : ℤ) else 0) ≠ 0 at hR'
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : P.weylGroup hA,
        (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) P.rho = β + P.rho := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hR' (finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun w ↦ by simp [h w])
    have hγ : P.dualBilinForm S (β + P.rho) (β + P.rho) = P.dualBilinForm S P.rho P.rho := by
      rw [← hw, P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S w.2]
    have hs : P.dualBilinForm S β P.rho = P.dualBilinForm S P.rho β :=
      (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq β P.rho
    simp only [two_smul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at hγ ⊢
    linear_combination hγ - hs
  · have h := (ha β (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 haβ)).1
    exact h

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.vermaChar_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem vermaChar_mul_denominator :
    vermaChar P p * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  set Y := vermaChar P p * KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator P - 1 with hY
  by_contra hY0
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Y.isPWO_support.exists_minimal (HahnSeries.support_nonempty_iff.2 hY0)
  set β := ofWeightOrd P m
  have hmβ : toWeightOrd P β = m := toWeightOrd_ofWeightOrd P m
  have hne : Y.coeffAt β ≠ 0 := by
    change Y.coeff (toWeightOrd P β) ≠ 0
    rw [hmβ]; exact hm.prop
  have hmax : ∀ μ, toWeightOrd P μ < toWeightOrd P β → Y.coeffAt μ = 0 := by
    intro μ hμ
    by_contra h
    exact hm.not_lt (show Y.coeff (toWeightOrd P μ) ≠ 0 from h) (hmβ ▸ hμ)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hβk⟩ := exists_posCone_of_coeffAt_vermaChar_mul_denominator_sub_one_ne_zero hne
  have h0 := dualBilinForm_eq_zero_of_maximal S hA hk.1 hβk hne hmax
  rw [hβk] at h0
  exact P.dualBilinForm_neg_rootOf_add_two_rho_ne_zero S hk
    (sum_mul_le_zero_of_maximal S hA hp hβk hne hmax) h0

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.vermaChar_eq_kostantSeries
statement: theorem vermaChar_eq_kostantSeries : vermaChar P p = KacMoodyAlgebra.kostantSeries P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one (vermaChar P p), ← KacMoodyAlgebra.denominator_mul_kostantSeries, ← mul_assoc,
    vermaChar_mul_denominator S hA hp, one_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace_sub_eq_kostantPartition
statement:
theorem GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace_sub_eq_kostantPartition (Λ β : Dual K H) :
    finrank K (modWeightSpace P p (GVerma P p Λ) (Λ - β)) =
      KacMoodyAlgebra.kostantPartition P β
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun c : P.CharacterRing ℤ ↦ c.coeffAt (-β))
    (vermaChar_eq_kostantSeries S hA hp)
  simp only [coeffAt_vermaChar, neg_neg, KacMoodyAlgebra.coeffAt_kostantSeries] at h
  rw [GVerma.finrank_modWeightSpace, sub_sub_cancel]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: iSupIndep.mem_span_inter
statement:
lemma iSupIndep.mem_span_inter {R M κ : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {W : κ → Submodule R M} (hW : iSupIndep W) {G : Set M} (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ ν, g ∈ W ν)
    {v : M} (hv : v ∈ Submodule.span R G) {μ : κ} (hvμ : v ∈ W μ) :
    v ∈ Submodule.span R (G ∩ W μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : κ → Submodule R M := fun ν ↦ Submodule.span R (G ∩ W ν)
  have hNW : ∀ ν, N ν ≤ W ν := fun ν ↦ Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ hg ↦ hg.2
  have hle : Submodule.span R G ≤ ⨆ ν, N ν := Submodule.span_le.2 fun g hg ↦ by
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := hG g hg
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν (Submodule.subset_span ⟨hg, hν⟩)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcv⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ _).1 (hle hv)
  have hw : v - c μ ∈ W μ ⊓ ⨆ ν, ⨆ (_ : ν ≠ μ), W ν := by
    refine ⟨sub_mem hvμ (hNW μ (hc μ)), ?_⟩
    have : v - c μ = (c.erase μ).sum fun _ x ↦ x := by
      rw [← hcv, ← Finsupp.add_sum_erase' c μ (fun _ x ↦ x) (fun _ ↦ rfl), add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [this]
    refine Submodule.finsuppSum_mem _ _ _ _ fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    have hνμ : ν ≠ μ := fun h ↦ hν (h ▸ Finsupp.erase_same)
    rw [Finsupp.erase_ne hνμ]
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ν (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hνμ (hNW ν (hc ν)))
  rw [(hW μ).eq_bot, Submodule.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at hw
  rw [hw]
  exact hc μ

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.smul_mem_modWeightSpace
statement:
lemma smul_mem_modWeightSpace {μ ν : Dual K H} {x : 𝒰} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace P p μ) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V ν) : x • v ∈ modWeightSpace P p V (μ + ν)
proof:
:= fun a ↦ by
  rw [smul_smul, hx a, add_smul, mul_smul, hv a, smul_comm, smul_assoc, LinearMap.add_apply,
    add_smul, add_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.modWeightSpace_le_iInf
statement:
lemma modWeightSpace_le_iInf (μ : Dual K H) :
    modWeightSpace P p V μ ≤ ⨅ a, (smulEnd P p V (h P p a)).maxGenEigenspace (μ a)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
  refine fun a ↦ Module.End.eigenspace_le_maxGenEigenspace ?_
  rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, smulEnd_apply, hv a]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.iSupIndep_modWeightSpace
statement: theorem iSupIndep_modWeightSpace : iSupIndep (modWeightSpace P p V)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : ∀ a b, Commute (smulEnd P p V (h P p a)) (smulEnd P p V (h P p b)) :=
    fun a b ↦ LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ by
      simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, smulEnd_apply, smul_smul, h_mul_h P p a b]
  have := Module.End.independent_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_of_forall_mapsTo
    (fun a ↦ smulEnd P p V (h P p a))
    fun a b φ ↦ Module.End.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (hcomm b a) φ
  exact (this.comp DFunLike.coe_injective).mono (modWeightSpace_le_iInf V)

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsBounded.exists_eq_sub
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  simp only [not_exists, not_and] at hne
  have hsub : boundedVectors P p V Λs ∩ modWeightSpace P p V ν ⊆ {0} := by
    rintro g ⟨⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, hg⟩, hgν⟩
    exact Submodule.disjoint_def.1 ((iSupIndep_modWeightSpace V).pairwiseDisjoint
      (Ne.symm (hne Λ hΛ d hd))) g hg hgν
  have := (iSupIndep_modWeightSpace V).mem_span_inter (G := boundedVectors P p V Λs)
    (fun g ⟨Λ, _, d, _, hg⟩ ↦ ⟨_, hg⟩) (hV w) hw
  have := Submodule.span_mono hsub this
  rw [Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.2 rfl, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  exact hw0 this

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsBounded.of_surjective
statement:
lemma IsBounded.of_surjective {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [Module 𝒰 W]
    [IsScalarTower K 𝒰 W] {Λs : Finset (Dual K H)} (hV : IsBounded P p V Λs) (φ : V →ₗ[𝒰] W)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : IsBounded P p W Λs
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hφ w
  have : Submodule.map (φ.restrictScalars K) (Submodule.span K (boundedVectors P p V Λs)) ≤
      Submodule.span K (boundedVectors P p W Λs) := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span_le]
    rintro g ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, hg⟩
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, ← map_smul, hg a, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  exact this ⟨v, hV v, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.isBounded_pi
statement:
lemma isBounded_pi [DecidableEq (Dual K H)] {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)]
    [∀ i, Module K (M i)] [∀ i, Module 𝒰 (M i)] [∀ i, IsScalarTower K 𝒰 (M i)]
    {Λs : ι → Finset (Dual K H)} (hM : ∀ i, IsBounded P p (M i) (Λs i)) :
    IsBounded P p (∀ i, M i) (Finset.univ.biUnion Λs)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single v]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have : Submodule.map (LinearMap.single K M i)
      (Submodule.span K (boundedVectors P p (M i) (Λs i))) ≤
      Submodule.span K (boundedVectors P p (∀ i, M i) (Finset.univ.biUnion Λs)) := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span_le]
    rintro g ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, hg⟩
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨Λ, Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hΛ⟩, d, hd,
      fun a ↦ ?_⟩
    funext j
    rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
    · simp [LinearMap.single_apply, hg a]
    · simp [LinearMap.single_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]
  exact this ⟨v i, hM i (v i), rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.finite_setOf_add_eq_sub
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_add_eq_sub {Λs : Finset (Dual K H)} (Λ₀ : Dual K H) (d₀ : ι → ℤ) :
    {μ | μ ∈ P.posWeights ∧ ∃ Λ ∈ Λs, ∃ d : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ d ∧
      μ + (Λ₀ - P.rootOf d₀) = Λ - P.rootOf d}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : Dual K H → ι → ℤ := fun Λ ↦
    if hc : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - Λ₀ + P.rootOf d₀ then hc.choose else 0
  refine (Λs.finite_toSet.biUnion fun Λ _ ↦ ((Set.Finite.pi (t := fun i ↦ Set.Icc 0 (c Λ i))
    fun i ↦ Set.finite_Icc _ _).image P.rootOf)).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨l, hl, rfl⟩, Λ, hΛ, d, hd, heq⟩
  have hld : P.rootOf (l + d) = Λ - Λ₀ + P.rootOf d₀ := by
    rw [map_add]
    linear_combination (norm := abel_nf) heq
  have hex : ∃ c, P.rootOf c = Λ - Λ₀ + P.rootOf d₀ := ⟨_, hld⟩
  have hc : c Λ = l + d := P.rootOf_injective (by
    simp only [c, hex, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [hex.choose_spec, hld])
  refine Set.mem_biUnion hΛ ⟨l, fun i _ ↦ ⟨hl.1 i, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hc, Pi.add_apply, le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
  exact hd i

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.IsBounded.isPosFinite
statement:
theorem IsBounded.isPosFinite {Λs : Finset (Dual K H)} (hV : IsBounded P p V Λs) :
    IsPosFinite P p V
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun v _ ↦
    {μ | μ ∈ P.posWeights ∧ ∃ x ∈ gRoot P p μ, x • v ≠ 0}.Finite) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (hV v)
  · rintro w ⟨Λ₀, -, d₀, -, hw⟩
    refine (finite_setOf_add_eq_sub P (Λs := Λs) Λ₀ d₀).subset ?_
    rintro μ ⟨hμ, x, hx, hxw⟩
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, d, hd, heq⟩ := hV.exists_eq_sub (smul_mem_modWeightSpace V hx.2 hw) hxw
    exact ⟨hμ, Λ, hΛ, d, hd, heq⟩
  · simp
  · intro v w _ _ hv hw
    refine (hv.union hw).subset ?_
    rintro μ ⟨hμ, x, hx, hxv⟩
    by_cases h1 : x • v = 0
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hμ, x, hx, by rwa [smul_add, h1, zero_add] at hxv⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hμ, x, hx, h1⟩
  · intro c v _ hv
    refine hv.subset ?_
    rintro μ ⟨hμ, x, hx, hxv⟩
    exact ⟨hμ, x, hx, fun h0 ↦ hxv (by rw [smul_comm, h0, smul_zero])⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.map_casimirTerm
statement:
lemma map_casimirTerm (φ : V →ₗ[𝒰] W) (μ : Dual K H) (v : V) :
    φ (casimirTerm P p V S μ v) = casimirTerm P p W S μ (φ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [casimirTerm_apply, casimirSum_def, map_sum, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.SuperEnveloping.map_casimir
statement:
theorem map_casimir (hV : IsPosFinite P p V) (hW : IsPosFinite P p W) (φ : V →ₗ[𝒰] W) (v : V) :
    φ (casimir S hV v) = casimir S hW (φ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [casimir_apply, casimir_apply, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, map_smul,
    map_casimirTerm, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  congr 2
  have := (φ.toAddMonoidHom).map_finsum_mem' (finite_casimirTerm (S := S) hV v)
  simp only [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe] at this
  rw [this]
  exact finsum_mem_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ map_casimirTerm φ μ v

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_of_sq_eq_one
statement:
lemma qInt_of_sq_eq_one {K : Type*} [Field K] {ε : K} (hε : ε ^ 2 = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    qInt ε n = n * ε ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : ε⁻¹ = ε := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (by rw [← sq, hε])
  rw [qInt, hinv]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ show ε ^ (n - 1 - s) * ε ^ s = ε ^ (n - 1) by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by have := Finset.mem_range.1 hs; omega)]]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one
statement:
lemma qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] {ε : K}
    (hε : ε ^ 2 = 1) (n : ℕ) : qFactorial ε n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hε0 : ε ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hε
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [qFactorial_succ, qInt_of_sq_eq_one hε]
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast n.succ_ne_zero) (pow_ne_zero _ hε0)) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_Uw_of_mem_canonicalBasisAt
statement:
lemma mem_Uw_of_mem_canonicalBasisAt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasisAt D ν) : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_of_mem_canonicalBasisAt
statement:
lemma eq_of_mem_canonicalBasisAt {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hν : x ∈ canonicalBasisAt D ν) (hμ : x ∈ canonicalBasisAt D μ) : ν = μ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [canonicalBasisAt_eq_range] at hν
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hν
    exact negGlobal_ne_zero D b
  have h1 := proj_of_mem_Uw (mem_Uw_of_mem_canonicalBasisAt D hν) (toZ ν)
  rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (mem_Uw_of_mem_canonicalBasisAt D hμ)] at h1
  have hne : toZ μ ≠ toZ ν := fun h' ↦ h (toZ_injective h').symm
  have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa [hne, eq_comm] using h1
  exact h0 hx0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finiteDimensional_Uw
statement: lemma finiteDimensional_Uw (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : FiniteDimensional 𝕂 (Uw D 𝕧 ν)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.natCard_canonicalBasisAt

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finrank_Uw_add_finrank_serreSpan
statement:
lemma finrank_Uw_add_finrank_serreSpan (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank 𝕂 (Uw D 𝕧 ν) + finrank ℚ (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) ν) =
      Fintype.card (Words ν)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hv := transcendental_ratFunc_X
  have hv0 : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hvn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ n ≠ 1 := fun _ hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn
  set V := LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν
  set f := (serreSubmodule D 𝕧).mkQ.domRestrict V
  have hrange : LinearMap.range f = Uw D 𝕧 ν := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict]; rfl
  have hker : LinearMap.ker f = (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ 𝕧 ^ D.d i) ν).comap V.subtype := by
    ext y
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply, f,
      LinearMap.domRestrict_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero,
      mem_serreSubmodule]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ (mem_serreSpan_of_mem_radical_and_finrank_serreSpan D hv ν).1 _
      (serreIdeal_le_radical hv0 hvn h) y.2, serreSpan_le_serreIdeal D hv0 hvn⟩
  have hSer : finrank 𝕂 ((serreSpan D (fun i ↦ 𝕧 ^ D.d i) ν).comap V.subtype) =
      finrank 𝕂 (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ 𝕧 ^ D.d i) ν) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
      inf_eq_right.2 (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν)]
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f
  rw [hrange, hker, hSer, finrank_weightSpace,
    (mem_serreSpan_of_mem_radical_and_finrank_serreSpan D hv ν).2] at hrn
  exact hrn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coe_integralGenerator_one
statement:
lemma coe_integralGenerator_one (i : I) :
    (integralGenerator D i 1 : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i)
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coe_integralWord
statement:
lemma coe_integralWord (w : List I) :
    (integralWord D w : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (wordBasis 𝕂 I w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralWord, wordBasis_apply, map_list_prod, SubmonoidClass.coe_list_prod, List.map_map,
    List.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left fun i _ ↦ ?_

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralWord_mem_span
statement:
lemma integralWord_mem_span (w : List I) :
    integralWord D w ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜
      (integralCanonicalBasis D '' canonicalIndexAt D (wordWeight w))
proof:
:= by
  set ν := wordWeight w
  set x : Um D 𝕧 := Submodule.Quotient.mk (wordBasis 𝕂 I w)
  have hxw : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν :=
    Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan (R := 𝕂) w)
  have hxi : x ∈ negIntegral D := by
    rw [mem_negIntegral]
    change negativeToQuotient D _ ∈ _
    rw [negativeToQuotient_mk, ← coe_integralWord]
    exact (integralWord D w).2
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (canonicalBasisAt D ν) := by
    rw [span_canonicalBasisAt_laurent]; exact ⟨hxi, hxw⟩
  have key : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (canonicalBasisAt D ν)), ∃ h : y ∈ negIntegral D,
      negIntegralEquiv D ⟨y, h⟩ ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜
        (integralCanonicalBasis D '' canonicalIndexAt D ν) := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem b hb =>
      have hbi : b ∈ negIntegral D := by
        have := Submodule.subset_span (R := 𝒜) hb
        rw [span_canonicalBasisAt_laurent] at this
        exact this.1
      refine ⟨hbi, Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨b, Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ν hb⟩, hb, ?_⟩⟩
      exact Subtype.ext (integralCanonicalBasis_apply D _)
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨zero_mem _, ?_⟩
      rw [show (⟨0, zero_mem _⟩ : negIntegral D) = 0 from rfl, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
      obtain ⟨hy, hy'⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨add_mem hy hz, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨y + z, add_mem hy hz⟩ : negIntegral D) = ⟨y, hy⟩ + ⟨z, hz⟩ := rfl
      rw [this, map_add]
      exact add_mem hy' hz'
    | smul c y _ hy =>
      obtain ⟨hy, hy'⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨c • y, Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy⟩ : negIntegral D) = c • ⟨y, hy⟩ := rfl
      rw [this, map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy'
  obtain ⟨h, hmem⟩ := key x hx
  convert hmem using 1
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [coe_integralWord]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalProj_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [canonicalProj, Module.Basis.constr_basis]
    by_cases h : μ = ν
    · subst h; simp [hb]
    · have hb' : b ∉ canonicalIndexAt D ν := fun h' ↦ h (eq_of_mem_canonicalBasisAt D hb h')
      simp [h, hb']
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_θ
statement:
lemma quasiClassicalHom_θ (i : I) :
    quasiClassicalHom D F (θ F i) = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (integralGenerator D i 1)
proof:
:=
  FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_wordBasis
statement:
lemma quasiClassicalHom_wordBasis (w : List I) :
    quasiClassicalHom D F (wordBasis F I w) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (integralWord D w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBasis_apply, map_list_prod, integralWord, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun i _ ↦ quasiClassicalHom_θ D F i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_weightProj
statement:
lemma quasiClassicalHom_weightProj (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (x : LusztigF F I) :
    quasiClassicalHom D F (weightProj F ν x) =
      (canonicalProj D ν).baseChange F (quasiClassicalHom D F x)
proof:
:= by
  have : (quasiClassicalHom D F).toLinearMap ∘ₗ weightProj F ν =
      (canonicalProj D ν).baseChange F ∘ₗ (quasiClassicalHom D F).toLinearMap := by
    refine (wordBasis F I).ext fun w ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, weightProj_wordBasis, quasiClassicalHom_wordBasis,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
      canonicalProj_of_mem D (integralWord_mem_span D w)]
    split_ifs
    · rw [quasiClassicalHom_wordBasis, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
    · rw [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coe_smul_integralForm
statement:
lemma coe_smul_integralForm (c : 𝒜) (y : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ((c • y : quotientIntegralForm D) : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧) =
      integralLaurentEval c • (y : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerreU_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma qSerreU_integralGenerator {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    qSerreU (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (serreExp D i j) (integralGenerator D i 1)
      (integralGenerator D j 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hT : integralLaurentEval (laurentTUnit (D.d i) : 𝒜) = 𝕧 ^ D.d i := by
    simp [laurentTUnit]
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hcoe : ((qSerreU (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (serreExp D i j) (integralGenerator D i 1)
      (integralGenerator D j 1) : quotientIntegralForm D) : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧) =
      toQuotient D 𝕧 (qSerre (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (serreExp D i j) (θ 𝕂 i) (θ 𝕂 j)) := by
    simp only [qSerreU, qSerre, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
    rw [coe_smul_integralForm, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one,
      map_qBinomialU, hT]
    simp [coe_integralGenerator_one]
  rw [hcoe, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, toQuotient_eq_zero_iff]
  exact serreIdeal_le_radical_ratFunc D (qSerre_mem_serreIdeal hij
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root RatFunc.X_ne_zero (fun _ hn ↦ ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one hn) _ _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_eq_prod
statement:
lemma qFactorial_eq_prod {K : Type*} [Field K] (ε : K) (n : ℕ) :
    qFactorial ε n = ∏ m ∈ Finset.range n, qInt ε (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [qFactorial_succ, ih, Finset.prod_range_succ, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_laurentQFactorial
statement:
lemma map_laurentQFactorial {K : Type*} [Field K] (φ : 𝒜 →+* K) (d n : ℕ) :
    φ (laurentQFactorial d n) = qFactorial (φ (laurentTUnit d : 𝒜)) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurentQFactorial, map_prod, qFactorial_eq_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ map_qNatU _ φ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralGenerator_pow
statement:
lemma integralGenerator_pow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    integralGenerator D i 1 ^ n = laurentQFactorial (D.d i) n • integralGenerator D i n
proof:
:= by
  have hT : integralLaurentEval (laurentTUnit (D.d i) : 𝒜) = 𝕧 ^ D.d i := by
    simp [laurentTUnit]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_smul_integralForm, map_laurentQFactorial, hT, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow,
    coe_integralGenerator_one]
  simp only [integralGenerator, quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    (fun _ hn ↦ ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one hn) _ _), one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algebraMap_laurentTUnit
statement: lemma algebraMap_laurentTUnit (n : ℕ) : algebraMap 𝒜 F (laurentTUnit n : 𝒜) = ε ^ n
proof:
:= by
