  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_serreWord
statement:
lemma quasiClassicalHom_serreWord {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    quasiClassicalHom D F (serreWord D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : quasiClassicalHom D F (serreWord D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) i j) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (qSerreU (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (serreExp D i j)
        (integralGenerator D i 1) (integralGenerator D j 1)) := by
    simp only [serreWord, qSerre, qSerreU, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow,
      quasiClassicalHom_θ]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
    conv_rhs => rw [← algebraMap_smul F]
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, map_qBinomialU, algebraMap_laurentTUnit]
  rw [h, qSerreU_integralGenerator D hij, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_surjective
statement:
theorem quasiClassicalHom_surjective (hε : ∀ i, (ε ^ D.d i) ^ 2 = 1) :
    Function.Surjective (quasiClassicalHom D F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlgHom.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← adjoin_baseChangeGenerator D F, Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
  have hc : algebraMap 𝒜 F (laurentQFactorial (D.d i) n) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_laurentQFactorial, algebraMap_laurentTUnit]
    exact qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one (hε i) n
  have h : (1 : F) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator D i n =
      (algebraMap 𝒜 F (laurentQFactorial (D.d i) n))⁻¹ •
        quasiClassicalHom D F (θ F i ^ n) := by
    rw [map_pow, quasiClassicalHom_θ, ← map_pow, integralGenerator_pow, map_smul,
      ← algebraMap_smul F (laurentQFactorial (D.d i) n), smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
  change (1 : F) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator D i n ∈ _
  rw [h]
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (AlgHom.mem_range_self _ _) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreSpan_quasi_le_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma serreSpan_quasi_le_serreIdeal (hε : ∀ i, (ε ^ D.d i) ^ 2 = 1) {ν : I →₀ ℕ}
    {y : LusztigF F I} (hy : y ∈ serreSpan D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) ν) : y ∈ serreIdeal D ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨hg, -⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
    refine TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ ?_)
    exact qSerre_mem_serreIdeal hg (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one (hε _) _)
  | zero => exact (serreIdeal D ε).zero_mem
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => exact smul_mem_serreIdeal c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_serreSpan
statement:
lemma quasiClassicalHom_serreSpan {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {y : LusztigF F I}
    (hy : y ∈ serreSpan D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) ν) : quasiClassicalHom D F y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨hg, -⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [serreProduct, map_mul, map_mul, quasiClassicalHom_serreWord D F hg, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_serreExp_symm
statement:
lemma pow_serreExp_symm (i j : I) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ε ^ D.d i) ^ (serreExp D i j - 1) = (ε ^ D.d j) ^ (serreExp D j i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
  congr 1
  have h1 := D.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm i j
  have h2 := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have h3 := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  simp only [serreExp]
  zify [show 1 ≤ (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat by omega,
    show 1 ≤ (1 - D.cartanMatrix j i).toNat by omega]
  rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]
  linarith

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_serreSpan_of_quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mem_serreSpan_of_quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero (hε : ∀ i, (ε ^ D.d i) ^ 2 = 1)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) {y : LusztigF F I} (hy : y ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace F ν)
    (h0 : quasiClassicalHom D F y = 0) : y ∈ serreSpan D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set V := LusztigF.weightSpace F ν
  set g := (quasiClassicalHom D F).toLinearMap.domRestrict V
  set S := (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) ν).comap V.subtype
  have hSg : S ≤ LinearMap.ker g := fun z hz ↦ quasiClassicalHom_serreSpan D F hz
  have hSer : finrank F S = finrank F (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) ν) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
      inf_eq_right.2 (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν)]
  
  set fam : canonicalIndexAt D ν → F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D :=
    fun b ↦ baseChangeCanonicalBasis D F b
  have hli : LinearIndependent F fam :=
    (baseChangeCanonicalBasis D F).linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective
  have hfam : Set.range fam ⊆ LinearMap.range g := by
    rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := quasiClassicalHom_surjective D F hε (fam b)
    refine ⟨⟨weightProj F ν z, weightProj_mem ν z⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.domRestrict_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, quasiClassicalHom_weightProj, hz]
    simp only [fam, baseChangeCanonicalBasis_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
    rw [canonicalProj_of_mem D (μ := ν) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, b.2, rfl⟩)]
    simp
  have e : canonicalIndexAt D ν ≃ canonicalBasisAt D ν :=
    { toFun := fun b ↦ ⟨b.1.1, b.2⟩
      invFun := fun x ↦ ⟨⟨x.1, Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ν x.2⟩, x.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  have := finite_canonicalBasisAt D ν
  have := Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (canonicalIndexAt D ν)
  have hcard : Fintype.card (canonicalIndexAt D ν) ≤ finrank F (LinearMap.range g) := by
    rw [← finrank_span_eq_card hli]
    exact Submodule.finrank_mono (Submodule.span_le.2 hfam)
  have hnat : Fintype.card (canonicalIndexAt D ν) = finrank 𝕂 (Uw D 𝕧 ν) := by
    rw [← natCard_canonicalBasisAt, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_congr e]
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g
  have hV : finrank F V = Fintype.card (Words ν) := finrank_weightSpace F ν
  have hsum := finrank_Uw_add_finrank_serreSpan D ν
  have hdim : finrank F (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) ν) =
      finrank ℚ (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) ν) := by
    rw [finrank_serreSpan_of_sq_eq_one D hε (pow_serreExp_symm D F), finrank_serreSpan_one]
  have hSk : S = LinearMap.ker g :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hSg (by omega)
  have : (⟨y, hy⟩ : V) ∈ LinearMap.ker g := h0
  rw [← hSk] at this
  exact this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_iff (hε : ∀ i, (ε ^ D.d i) ^ 2 = 1) (x : LusztigF F I) :
    quasiClassicalHom D F x = 0 ↔ x ∈ serreIdeal D ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [← sum_weightProj x]
    refine Finset.sum_induction _ (· ∈ serreIdeal D ε)
      (fun a b ha hb ↦ TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ ha hb) (serreIdeal D ε).zero_mem fun ν _ ↦ ?_
    refine serreSpan_quasi_le_serreIdeal D F hε
      (mem_serreSpan_of_quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero D F hε ν (weightProj_mem ν x) ?_)
    rw [quasiClassicalHom_weightProj, hx, map_zero]
  · intro hx
    induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [serreElement, qSerreDiv_eq (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one (hε i) _), map_smul]
      change _ • quasiClassicalHom D F (serreWord D (fun i ↦ ε ^ D.d i) i j) = 0
      rw [quasiClassicalHom_serreWord D F hij, smul_zero]
    | zero => exact map_zero _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
    | neg y _ hy => rw [map_neg, hy, neg_zero]
    | left_absorb a y _ hy => rw [map_mul, hy, mul_zero]
    | right_absorb b y _ hy => rw [map_mul, hy, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalEquiv_θ
statement:
lemma quasiClassicalEquiv_θ (hε : ∀ i, (ε ^ D.d i) ^ 2 = 1) (i : I) :
    quasiClassicalEquiv D F hε (θ F i) = (1 : F) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i 1
proof:
:= by
  change quasiClassicalHom D F (θ F i) = _
  rw [quasiClassicalHom_θ, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralCanonicalBasis_apply
statement:
lemma integralCanonicalBasis_apply (b : canonicalBasis D) :
    (integralCanonicalBasis D b : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧) = negativeQuotientEquiv D b
proof:
:= by
  simp [integralCanonicalBasis, negIntegralEquiv, Module.Basis.span_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseChangeCanonicalBasis_apply
statement:
lemma baseChangeCanonicalBasis_apply (b : canonicalBasis D) :
    baseChangeCanonicalBasis D S b = 1 ⊗ₜ integralCanonicalBasis D b
proof:
:=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.basis_apply _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoin_baseChangeGenerator
statement:
theorem adjoin_baseChangeGenerator :
    Algebra.adjoin S (Set.range fun p : I × ℕ ↦
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator D p.1 p.2) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set T := Algebra.adjoin S (Set.range fun p : I × ℕ ↦
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator D p.1 p.2)
  have key : ∀ (x : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧) (hx : x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D),
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] (⟨x, hx⟩ : quotientIntegralForm D) ∈ T := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨(i, n), rfl⟩
    | algebraMap r =>
      have : (⟨algebraMap 𝒜 _ r, Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r⟩ : quotientIntegralForm D) =
          algebraMap 𝒜 (quotientIntegralForm D) r := rfl
      rw [this, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
        ← algebraMap_smul S r, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
      exact T.smul_mem T.one_mem _
    | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      have : (⟨x + y, add_mem hx hy⟩ : quotientIntegralForm D) = ⟨x, hx⟩ + ⟨y, hy⟩ := rfl
      rw [this, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
      exact add_mem ihx ihy
    | mul x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      have : (⟨x * y, mul_mem hx hy⟩ : quotientIntegralForm D) = ⟨x, hx⟩ * ⟨y, hy⟩ := rfl
      rw [this, ← mul_one (1 : S), ← Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
      exact mul_mem ihx ihy
  refine top_unique fun z hz ↦ ?_
  clear hz
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn z (fun s a ↦ ?_)
    (fun x y hx hy ↦ add_mem hx hy)
  rw [← mul_one s, ← smul_eq_mul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (key a a.2) s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.factorial_ne_zero
statement: theorem factorial_ne_zero (j : ℕ) : qFactorial (RatFunc.X : Coeff) j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using qFactorial_X_pow_ne_zero (K := ℚ) 1 j one_pos

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.dividedBasis_apply
statement:
theorem dividedBasis_apply (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dividedBasis n j = (qFactorial (RatFunc.X : Coeff) j)⁻¹ • Pi.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [dividedBasis, Module.Basis.unitsSMul_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.F_pow_highest
statement:
theorem F_pow_highest (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    rep n ((F sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ()) ^ (j : ℕ)) (highest n) = Pi.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rep, map_pow, simpleRep_F]
  apply ext_coord
  intro l
  have hj := j.2
  rw [coord_opF_pow, highest, coord_single, coord_single, Fin.val_zero]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.dividedBasis_eq
statement:
theorem dividedBasis_eq (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dividedBasis n j =
      rep n (qDivPow (RatFunc.X : Coeff) j (F sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ())) (highest n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, F_pow_highest, dividedBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.E_highest
statement:
theorem E_highest (n : ℕ) :
    rep n (E sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ()) (highest n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rep, highest, simpleRep_E_single, Fin.val_zero, lt_self_iff_false,
    ↓reduceDIte]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.F_pow_highest_zero
statement:
theorem F_pow_highest_zero (n : ℕ) :
    rep n (F sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X () ^ (n + 1)) (highest n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rep, map_pow, simpleRep_F]
  apply ext_coord
  intro l
  rw [coord_opF_pow, coord_zero]
  split_ifs with h
  · omega
  · rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.irreducible
statement:
theorem irreducible (n : ℕ) (W : Submodule Coeff (Space n))
    (hW : ∀ u x, x ∈ W → rep n u x ∈ W) : W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
proof:
:=
  simpleRep_irreducible RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    (fun _ hm ↦ LusztigF.ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one hm) (by simp) W hW

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem moduleBar_apply (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    moduleBar n x j = RatFunc.bar (x j)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem moduleBar_involutive (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) :
    moduleBar n (moduleBar n x) = x
proof: := by ext j; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_add
statement:
theorem moduleBar_add (n : ℕ) (x y : Space n) :
    moduleBar n (x + y) = moduleBar n x + moduleBar n y
proof: := by ext j; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_smul
statement:
theorem moduleBar_smul (n : ℕ) (c : Coeff) (x : Space n) :
    moduleBar n (c • x) = RatFunc.bar c • moduleBar n x
proof: := by ext j; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.coord_moduleBar
statement:
theorem coord_moduleBar (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n (moduleBar n x) l = RatFunc.bar (coord n x l)
proof:
:= by

  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.bar_qInt
statement:
theorem bar_qInt (j : ℕ) : RatFunc.bar (qInt (RatFunc.X : Coeff) j) =
    qInt RatFunc.X j
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_one, qBinomial_one_right] using bar_qBinomial (K := ℚ) 1 j 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_highest
statement: @[simp] theorem moduleBar_highest (n : ℕ) : moduleBar n (highest n) = highest n
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [moduleBar, highest, Pi.single_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_dividedBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem moduleBar_dividedBasis (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    moduleBar n (dividedBasis n j) = dividedBasis n j
proof:
:= by
  have hq := bar_inv_qFactorial (K := ℚ) 1 j
  simp only [pow_one] at hq
  rw [dividedBasis_apply, moduleBar_smul, hq]
  congr 1
  ext l
  simp [moduleBar, Pi.single_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_E
statement:
theorem moduleBar_E (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) :
    moduleBar n (rep n (E sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ()) x) =
      rep n (E sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ()) (moduleBar n x)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [rep, moduleBar, opE, eCoeff, bar_qInt, coord_moduleBar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_F
statement:
theorem moduleBar_F (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) :
    moduleBar n (rep n (F sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ()) x) =
      rep n (F sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ()) (moduleBar n x)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [rep, simpleRep_F, moduleBar_apply, opF, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  split_ifs <;> simp [coord_moduleBar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_K
statement:
theorem moduleBar_K (n : ℕ) (μ : ℤ) (x : Space n) :
    moduleBar n (rep n (K sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X μ) x) =
      rep n (K sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X (-μ)) (moduleBar n x)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [rep, moduleBar, opK, map_zpow₀, zpow_neg, neg_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.dividedBasis_weight
statement:
theorem dividedBasis_weight (n : ℕ) (μ : ℤ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    rep n (K sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X μ) (dividedBasis n j) =
      ((RatFunc.X : Coeff) ^ (μ * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * j))) • dividedBasis n j
proof:
:= by
  rw [dividedBasis_apply, map_smul]
  simp only [rep, simpleRep_K_single, one_zpow, one_mul]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.localRing_isLocalization
statement:
theorem localRing_isLocalization :
    IsLocalization (Polynomial.idealX ℚ).asIdeal.primeCompl LocalRing
proof: := inferInstance

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.latticeBasis_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem latticeBasis_coe (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (latticeBasis n j : Space n) = dividedBasis n j
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.restrictScalars_apply _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.dividedBasis_mem_lattice
statement:
theorem dividedBasis_mem_lattice (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dividedBasis n j ∈ lattice n
proof: := Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.lattice_spans
statement:
theorem lattice_spans (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span Coeff (lattice n : Set (Space n)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← (dividedBasis n).span_eq]
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact dividedBasis_mem_lattice n j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.mem_lattice_iff
statement:
theorem mem_lattice_iff (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) :
    x ∈ lattice n ↔ ∀ j, (dividedBasis n).repr x j ∈ LocalRing
proof:
:= by
  rw [lattice, Module.Basis.mem_span_iff_repr_mem]
  constructor
  · intro h j
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h j
    exact ha ▸ a.property
  · intro h j
    exact ⟨⟨_, h j⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.lower_dividedBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem lower_dividedBasis (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    lower n (dividedBasis n j) =
      if h : (j : ℕ) + 1 < n + 1 then dividedBasis n ⟨j + 1, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (dividedBasis n).constr_basis Coeff _ j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.raise_dividedBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem raise_dividedBasis (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    raise n (dividedBasis n j) =
      if h : 0 < (j : ℕ) then dividedBasis n ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (dividedBasis n).constr_basis Coeff _ j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.lower_mem_lattice
statement:
theorem lower_mem_lattice (n : ℕ) {x : Space n} (hx : x ∈ lattice n) :
    lower n x ∈ lattice n
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [lower_dividedBasis]
    split_ifs
    · exact dividedBasis_mem_lattice n _
    · exact (lattice n).zero_mem
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa using (lattice n).add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    simpa using (lattice n).smul_mem a hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.raise_mem_lattice
statement:
theorem raise_mem_lattice (n : ℕ) {x : Space n} (hx : x ∈ lattice n) :
    raise n x ∈ lattice n
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [raise_dividedBasis]
    split_ifs
    · exact dividedBasis_mem_lattice n _
    · exact (lattice n).zero_mem
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa using (lattice n).add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    simpa using (lattice n).smul_mem a hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.evalZero_denominator
statement:
theorem evalZero_denominator (s : (Polynomial.idealX ℚ).asIdeal.primeCompl) :
    IsUnit (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : ℚ) s)
proof:
:= by
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  have hs := s.property
  simpa only [Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff, Polynomial.idealX_span,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Polynomial.X_dvd_iff,
    Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom] using hs

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residue_polynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem residue_polynomial (p : Polynomial ℚ) :
    residue (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) LocalRing p) = p.eval 0
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.lift_eq evalZero_denominator p

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residue_localX
statement: @[simp] theorem residue_localX : residue localX = 0
proof: := by simp [localX]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residue_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem residue_eq_zero_iff (x : LocalRing) :
    residue x = 0 ↔ ∃ y : LocalRing, x = localX * y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq
    (Polynomial.idealX ℚ).asIdeal.primeCompl x
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hp : p.eval 0 = 0 := by
      have he := (IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec evalZero_denominator p 0 s).mp h
      simpa using he
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mpr
      (by simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using hp)
    refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' LocalRing q s, ?_⟩
    exact (IsLocalization.mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul (S := LocalRing) Polynomial.X q s).symm
  · rintro ⟨y, h⟩
    rw [h, map_mul, residue_localX, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residue_rat
statement: @[simp] theorem residue_rat (c : ℚ) : residue (algebraMap ℚ LocalRing c) = c
proof:
:= by
  change residue (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) LocalRing (Polynomial.C c)) = c
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.latticeResidue_constantLift
statement:
@[simp] theorem latticeResidue_constantLift (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℚ) :
    latticeResidue n (constantLift n c) = c
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [latticeResidue, constantLift, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.latticeResidue_surjective
statement: theorem latticeResidue_surjective (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (latticeResidue n)
proof:
:=
  fun c ↦ ⟨constantLift n c, latticeResidue_constantLift n c⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.latticeResidue_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem latticeResidue_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : lattice n) :
    latticeResidue n x = 0 ↔ ∃ y : lattice n, x = localX • y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have h : ∀ j, ∃ y : LocalRing, (latticeBasis n).repr x j = localX * y := by
      intro j
      apply (residue_eq_zero_iff _).mp
      exact congrFun hx j
    choose c hc using h
    refine ⟨∑ j, c j • latticeBasis n j, ?_⟩
    apply (latticeBasis n).repr.injective
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro j
    simpa [Finsupp.single_apply] using hc j
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    ext j
    simp [latticeResidue]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.latticeResidue_ker
statement: theorem latticeResidue_ker (n : ℕ) : (latticeResidue n).ker = xLattice n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change latticeResidue n x = 0 ↔ ∃ y, localX • y = x
  rw [latticeResidue_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [eq_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residueEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem residueEquiv_mk (n : ℕ) (x : lattice n) :
    residueEquiv n (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = latticeResidue n x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residueBasis_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem residueBasis_eq (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    residueBasis n j = Submodule.Quotient.mk (latticeBasis n j)
proof:
:= by
  apply (residueEquiv n).injective
  ext k
  simp [residueBasis, latticeResidue, Pi.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.local_mem_valuation
statement: lemma local_mem_valuation {x : Coeff} (hx : x ∈ LocalRing) : zeroValuation x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.zeroValuation_X_lt_one
statement: lemma zeroValuation_X_lt_one : zeroValuation (RatFunc.X : Coeff) < 1
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.bar_polynomial_eq
statement:
lemma bar_polynomial_eq (p : Polynomial ℚ) :
    RatFunc.bar (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p) =
      Polynomial.aeval (RatFunc.X⁻¹ : Coeff) p
proof:
:= by
  have h : RatFunc.bar.toAlgHom.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℚ (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff) =
      Polynomial.aeval (RatFunc.X⁻¹ : Coeff) := by
    apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
    simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.polynomial_bar_regular_constant
statement:
lemma polynomial_bar_regular_constant (p : Polynomial ℚ)
    (hp : RatFunc.bar (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p) ∈ LocalRing) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p = algebraMap ℚ Coeff c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : p = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hz]⟩
  have hpos : 1 < zeroValuation (RatFunc.X⁻¹ : Coeff) :=
    (Valuation.val_lt_one_iff zeroValuation RatFunc.X_ne_zero).mp zeroValuation_X_lt_one
  have hv := local_mem_valuation hp
  rw [bar_polynomial_eq,
    Polynomial.valuation_aeval_eq_valuation_X_pow_natDegree_of_one_lt_valuation_X
      _ hpos hz] at hv
  have hdeg : p.natDegree = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hv) (one_lt_pow₀ hpos hn)
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdeg]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.polynomial_of_regular_laurent_presentation
statement:
lemma polynomial_of_regular_laurent_presentation (x : Coeff) (hx : x ∈ LocalRing)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℚ)
    (heq : x * RatFunc.X ^ n = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p) :
    ∃ q : Polynomial ℚ, x = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff q
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing p with
  | zero => exact ⟨p, by simpa using heq⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have hvp : zeroValuation (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p) < 1 := by
      rw [← heq, map_mul, map_pow]
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (local_mem_valuation hx) zero_le)
      rw [one_mul]
      exact pow_lt_one₀ zero_le zeroValuation_X_lt_one (by omega)
    have hdiv : Polynomial.X ∣ p := by
      have hm := (valuation_lt_one_iff_mem (Polynomial.idealX ℚ) p).mp hvp
      simpa [Polynomial.idealX, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] using hm
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hdiv
    apply ih q
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (RatFunc.X_ne_zero (K := ℚ))
    calc
      x * RatFunc.X ^ n * RatFunc.X = x * RatFunc.X ^ (n + 1) := by ring
      _ = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff (Polynomial.X * q) := heq
      _ = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff q * RatFunc.X := by
        simp [mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.laurentToCoeff_toLaurent
statement:
lemma laurentToCoeff_toLaurent (p : Polynomial ℚ) :
    laurentToCoeff p.toLaurent = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurentToCoeff, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_toLaurent]
  change Polynomial.aeval (RatFunc.X : Coeff) p = _
  rw [← RatFunc.algebraMap_X, Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply,
    Polynomial.aeval_X_left_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.laurentToCoeff_T
statement:
lemma laurentToCoeff_T (n : ℕ) :
    laurentToCoeff (LaurentPolynomial.T n) = (RatFunc.X : Coeff) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [laurentToCoeff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.laurentToCoeff_injective
statement: lemma laurentToCoeff_injective : Function.Injective laurentToCoeff
proof:
:= by
  suffices hzero : ∀ l, laurentToCoeff l = 0 → l = 0 by
    intro l m h
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply hzero
    simp [h]
  intro l hl
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := l.exists_T_pow
  have he : algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg laurentToCoeff hp
    simpa only [map_mul, laurentToCoeff_toLaurent, hl, zero_mul] using h
  have hpzero : p = 0 := (RatFunc.algebraMap_injective ℚ) (by simpa using he)
  have hmul : l * LaurentPolynomial.T (n : ℤ) = 0 := by
    rw [← hp, hpzero, map_zero]
  exact (LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T (n : ℤ)).mul_right_cancel (by simpa using hmul)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.laurent_regular_polynomial
statement:
lemma laurent_regular_polynomial (l : LaurentPolynomial ℚ)
    (hl : laurentToCoeff l ∈ LocalRing) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℚ, laurentToCoeff l = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := l.exists_T_pow
  apply polynomial_of_regular_laurent_presentation _ hl n p
  have h := congrArg laurentToCoeff hp
  simpa only [map_mul, laurentToCoeff_toLaurent, laurentToCoeff_T] using h.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.laurent_regular_bar_regular_constant
statement:
theorem laurent_regular_bar_regular_constant (l : LaurentPolynomial ℚ)
    (hzero : laurentToCoeff l ∈ LocalRing)
    (hinfty : RatFunc.bar (laurentToCoeff l) ∈ LocalRing) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, laurentToCoeff l = algebraMap ℚ Coeff c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := laurent_regular_polynomial l hzero
  rw [hp] at hinfty ⊢
  exact polynomial_bar_regular_constant p hinfty

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.scalar_laurent_intersection
statement:
theorem scalar_laurent_intersection (x : Coeff)
    (hlaurent : x ∈ Set.range laurentToCoeff)
    (hzero : x ∈ LocalRing) (hinfty : RatFunc.bar x ∈ LocalRing) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, x = algebraMap ℚ Coeff c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hlaurent
  exact laurent_regular_bar_regular_constant l hzero hinfty

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.dividedBasis_repr_bar
statement:
theorem dividedBasis_repr_bar (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (dividedBasis n).repr (moduleBar n x) j = RatFunc.bar ((dividedBasis n).repr x j)
proof:
:= by
  have h : moduleBar n x =
      ∑ k, RatFunc.bar ((dividedBasis n).repr x k) • dividedBasis n k := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (dividedBasis n).sum_repr x]
    change (moduleBarEquiv n) (∑ k, (dividedBasis n).repr x k • dividedBasis n k) = _
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [moduleBarEquiv, AddEquiv.coe_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      moduleBar_smul, moduleBar_dividedBasis]
  rw [h]
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.lattice_repr_coe
statement:
theorem lattice_repr_coe (n : ℕ) (x : lattice n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((latticeBasis n).repr x j : Coeff) = (dividedBasis n).repr (x : Space n) j
proof:
:=
  (dividedBasis n).restrictScalars_repr_apply LocalRing x j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.local_rat_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem local_rat_coe (c : ℚ) :
    ((algebraMap ℚ LocalRing c) : Coeff) = algebraMap ℚ Coeff c
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) Coeff (Polynomial.C c) = _
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.constantSection_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem constantSection_eq (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℚ) :
    constantSection n c = constantLift n c
proof:
:= by
  simp [constantSection, constantLift]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.constantLift_repr
statement:
@[simp] theorem constantLift_repr (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℚ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (latticeBasis n).repr (constantLift n c) j = algebraMap ℚ LocalRing (c j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [constantLift, map_sum, map_smul, Module.Basis.repr_self]
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Algebra.smul_def]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.mem_laurentForm_iff
statement:
theorem mem_laurentForm_iff (n : ℕ) (x : Space n) :
    x ∈ laurentForm n ↔ ∀ j, (dividedBasis n).repr x j ∈ Set.range laurentToCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurentForm, Module.Basis.mem_span_iff_repr_mem]
  constructor
  · intro h j
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h j
    exact ha ▸ a.property
  · intro h j
    exact ⟨⟨_, h j⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.inTriple_iff_constant
statement:
theorem inTriple_iff_constant (n : ℕ) (x : lattice n) :
    InTriple n x ↔ ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℚ, constantSection n c = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hl, hb⟩
    have hc : ∀ j, ∃ c : ℚ,
        ((latticeBasis n).repr x j : Coeff) = algebraMap ℚ Coeff c := by
      intro j
      rw [lattice_repr_coe]
      apply scalar_laurent_intersection
      · exact (mem_laurentForm_iff n x).mp hl j
      · exact (mem_lattice_iff n x).mp x.property j
      · simpa only [dividedBasis_repr_bar] using (mem_lattice_iff n _).mp hb j
    choose c hc using hc
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    apply (latticeBasis n).repr.injective
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro j
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    simpa only [constantSection_eq, constantLift_repr, local_rat_coe] using (hc j).symm
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    have hc (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
        (dividedBasis n).repr (constantSection n c : Space n) j =
          algebraMap ℚ Coeff (c j) := by
      rw [← lattice_repr_coe]
      simp only [constantSection_eq, constantLift_repr, local_rat_coe]
    constructor
    · rw [mem_laurentForm_iff]
      intro j
      rw [hc]
      exact ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C (c j), by simp [laurentToCoeff]⟩
    · rw [mem_lattice_iff]
      intro j
      rw [dividedBasis_repr_bar, hc]
      simpa using (algebraMap ℚ LocalRing (c j)).property

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.triple_eq_constantResidue
statement:
theorem triple_eq_constantResidue (n : ℕ) (x : tripleLattice n) :
    (x : lattice n) = constantSection n (latticeResidue n x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (inTriple_iff_constant n x).mp x.property
  rw [← hc]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.tripleProjection_bijective
statement: theorem tripleProjection_bijective (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (tripleProjection n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    have hr : latticeResidue n x = latticeResidue n y :=
      congrArg (residueEquiv n) h
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    rw [triple_eq_constantResidue n x, triple_eq_constantResidue n y, hr]
  · intro q
    refine ⟨⟨constantSection n (residueEquiv n q),
      (inTriple_iff_constant n _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    apply (residueEquiv n).injective
    change latticeResidue n (constantSection n (residueEquiv n q)) = _
    simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.latticeBasis_mem_triple
statement:
theorem latticeBasis_mem_triple (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    latticeBasis n j ∈ tripleLattice n
proof:
:= by
  change InTriple n (latticeBasis n j)
  constructor
  · rw [latticeBasis_coe]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j)
  · simpa using dividedBasis_mem_lattice n j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.balancedEquiv_symm_residueBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem balancedEquiv_symm_residueBasis (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (balancedEquiv n).symm (residueBasis n j) = globalLift n j
proof:
:= by
  apply (balancedEquiv n).injective
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, balancedEquiv, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
    tripleProjection, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
    Submodule.mkQ_apply, globalLift] using residueBasis_eq n j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.globalLift_coe
statement:
theorem globalLift_coe (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((globalLift n j : lattice n) : Space n) =
      rep n (qDivPow (RatFunc.X : Coeff) j (F sl2RootDatum RatFunc.X ())) (highest n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [globalLift, latticeBasis_coe] using dividedBasis_eq n j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.globalLift_unique
statement:
theorem globalLift_unique (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (x : tripleLattice n)
    (hx : tripleProjection n x = residueBasis n j) : x = globalLift n j
proof:
:= by
  apply (tripleProjection_bijective n).injective
  rw [hx]
  exact residueBasis_eq n j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.globalBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem globalBasis_apply (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    globalBasis n j = globalLift n j
proof:
:= by
  exact balancedEquiv_symm_residueBasis n j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.moduleBar_globalLift
statement:
theorem moduleBar_globalLift (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    moduleBar n ((globalLift n j : lattice n) : Space n) =
      ((globalLift n j : lattice n) : Space n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [globalLift]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residueLower_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem residueLower_basis (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    residueLower n (residueBasis n j) =
      if h : (j : ℕ) + 1 < n + 1 then residueBasis n ⟨j + 1, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [residueBasis_eq]
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk
    (⟨lower n (latticeBasis n j), _⟩ : lattice n) = _
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [residueBasis_eq]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    simp [h]
  · change (xLattice n).mkQ _ = 0
    have hz : (⟨lower n (latticeBasis n j),
        lower_mem_lattice n (latticeBasis n j).property⟩ : lattice n) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.val_injective
      simp [h]
    rw [hz, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.RankOne.residueRaise_basis
statement:
@[simp] theorem residueRaise_basis (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    residueRaise n (residueBasis n j) =
      if h : 0 < (j : ℕ) then residueBasis n ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [residueBasis_eq]
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk
    (⟨raise n (latticeBasis n j), _⟩ : lattice n) = _
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [residueBasis_eq]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    simp [h]
  · change (xLattice n).mkQ _ = 0
    have hz : (⟨raise n (latticeBasis n j),
        raise_mem_lattice n (latticeBasis n j).property⟩ : lattice n) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.val_injective
      simp [h]
    rw [hz, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.K_injective
statement:
theorem K_injective (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) :
    Function.Injective (ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hleft : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v (-1)) * ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, K_neg_mul_K, map_one]
  have hh := congrArg (ρ (K sl2RootDatum v (-1))) h
  simpa only [← Module.End.mul_apply, hleft, Module.End.one_apply] using hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.rep_K_mul_E
statement:
theorem rep_K_mul_E (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) :
    ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) * ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) =
      v ^ 2 • (ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) * ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg ρ (K_mul_E sl2RootDatum v 1 ())

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.rep_K_mul_F
statement:
theorem rep_K_mul_F (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) :
    ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) * ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) =
      v⁻¹ ^ 2 • (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) * ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [zpow_neg, inv_pow] using congrArg ρ (K_mul_F sl2RootDatum v 1 ())

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.sq_pow_ne_one
statement:
private theorem sq_pow_ne_one (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) : (v ^ 2) ^ r ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul]
  exact hv' _ (by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.inv_sq_pow_ne_one
statement:
private theorem inv_sq_pow_ne_one (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) : (v⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ r ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply sq_pow_ne_one hv' r hr
  simpa only [inv_pow, inv_inv, inv_one] using congrArg Inv.inv h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.K_apply_F_pow
statement:
theorem K_apply_F_pow (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) {a : k} {m : M}
    (hm : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m) (r : ℕ) :
    ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) ((ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ r) m) =
      ((v⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ r * a) • ((ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ r) m)
proof:
:=
  Module.End.apply_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute (rep_K_mul_F ρ) hm r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.exists_last_nonzero_F_pow
statement:
theorem exists_last_nonzero_F_pow [FiniteDimensional k M]
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) {a : k} {m : M}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hm0 : m ≠ 0) (hm : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (∀ i ≤ n, (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ i) m ≠ 0) ∧
      (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (n + 1)) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hz, _, _⟩ := Module.End.exists_last_nonzero_pow_of_q_commute
    (pow_ne_zero 2 (inv_ne_zero hv)) (inv_sq_pow_ne_one hv') ha (rep_K_mul_F ρ) hm hm0
  exact ⟨n, hn, hz⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.K_neg_apply_of_K_apply
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (ρ (K sl2RootDatum v (-1))) hm
  have hleft : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v (-1)) * ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, K_neg_mul_K, map_one]
  simp only [← Module.End.mul_apply, hleft, Module.End.one_apply, map_smul] at h
  calc
    _ = a⁻¹ • (a • ρ (K sl2RootDatum v (-1)) m) := by
      rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
    _ = a⁻¹ • m := by rw [← h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.E_apply_F_pow_succ
statement:
theorem E_apply_F_pow_succ (hv : v ≠ 0) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    {a : k} {m : M} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hm : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m)
    (hE : ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0) (r : ℕ) :
    ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) ((ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (r + 1)) m) =
      (qInt v (r + 1) * (v - v⁻¹)⁻¹ * (v⁻¹ ^ r * a - v ^ r * a⁻¹)) •
        ((ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ r) m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun u : Sl2 v => ρ u m)
    (E_mul_F_pow_sub (R := sl2RootDatum) hv () r)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, sl2Datum_d, pow_one,
    Kt, sl2RootDatum_ktilde, hm, K_neg_apply_of_K_apply ρ ha hm, hE, map_zero,
    sub_zero, map_sub, map_smul, smul_smul, smul_sub, sub_smul, mul_assoc,
    mul_sub] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.E_apply_K_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun u : Sl2 v => ρ u m) (K_mul_E sl2RootDatum v μ ())
  simp only [map_mul, map_smul, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hE, map_zero] at h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left (zpow_ne_zero _ hv)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.E_apply_F_pow_succ_of_E
statement:
theorem E_apply_F_pow_succ_of_E (hv : v ≠ 0) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) {m : M}
    (hE : ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0) (r : ℕ) :
    ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) ((ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (r + 1)) m) =
      (qInt v (r + 1) * (v - v⁻¹)⁻¹) • (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ r)
        (v⁻¹ ^ r • ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m - v ^ r • ρ (K sl2RootDatum v (-1)) m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun u : Sl2 v => ρ u m)
    (E_mul_F_pow_sub (R := sl2RootDatum) hv () r)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, sl2Datum_d, pow_one,
    Kt, sl2RootDatum_ktilde, hE, map_zero, sub_zero] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.exists_highestVector_of_F_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_highestVector_of_F_pow_eq_zero (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) (s : ℕ) :
    ∀ m : M, m ≠ 0 → ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0 → (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ s) m = 0 →
      ∃ (a : k) (m : M), a ≠ 0 ∧ m ≠ 0 ∧
        ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m ∧ ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hden : v - v⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hv' 2 two_pos
    have h' := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    calc
      v ^ 2 = v * v := pow_two v
      _ = v * v⁻¹ := by rw [← h']
      _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hv
  induction s with
  | zero =>
    intro m hm0 _ h
    exact absurd (by simpa using h) hm0
  | succ r ih =>
    intro m hm0 hE hz
    set Kp := ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1)
    set Kn := ρ (K sl2RootDatum v (-1))
    set m' := v⁻¹ ^ r • Kp m - v ^ r • Kn m with hm'
    have hEm' : ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m' = 0 := by
      rw [hm', map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, E_apply_K_eq_zero hv ρ hE,
        E_apply_K_eq_zero hv ρ hE, smul_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    by_cases h' : m' = 0
    · have hKn : Kp (Kn m) = m := by
        rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, K_mul_K_neg, map_one, Module.End.one_apply]
      have hKK : Kp (Kp m) = (v ^ r * v ^ r) • m := by
        have h2 := congrArg Kp h'
        rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, hKn, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h2
        calc Kp (Kp m) = v ^ r • (v⁻¹ ^ r • Kp (Kp m)) := by
              rw [smul_smul, inv_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hv), one_smul]
          _ = (v ^ r * v ^ r) • m := by rw [h2, smul_smul]
      by_cases hw : Kp m + v ^ r • m = 0
      · refine ⟨-v ^ r, m, neg_ne_zero.2 (pow_ne_zero _ hv), hm0, ?_, hE⟩
        rw [neg_smul, ← sub_eq_zero, sub_neg_eq_add]
        exact hw
      · refine ⟨v ^ r, Kp m + v ^ r • m, pow_ne_zero _ hv, hw, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [map_add, map_smul, hKK, smul_add, smul_smul, add_comm]
        · rw [map_add, map_smul, E_apply_K_eq_zero hv ρ hE, hE, smul_zero, add_zero]
    · have hc : qInt v (r + 1) * (v - v⁻¹)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (qInt_ne_zero hv (hv' _ (by omega))) (inv_ne_zero hden)
      have h := E_apply_F_pow_succ_of_E hv ρ hE r
      rw [hz, map_zero] at h
      exact ih m' h' hEm' ((smul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left hc)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.exists_highestVector
statement:
theorem exists_highestVector [FiniteDimensional k M] [Nontrivial M]
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) :
    ∃ (a : k) (m : M), a ≠ 0 ∧ m ≠ 0 ∧
      ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m ∧ ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Module.End.isNilpotent_of_q_commute (K_injective ρ) (sq_pow_ne_one hv')
    (rep_K_mul_E ρ)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.End.isNilpotent_of_q_commute (K_injective ρ) (inv_sq_pow_ne_one hv')
    (rep_K_mul_F ρ)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
  have hex : ∃ j, (ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ j) x = 0 := ⟨n, by rw [hn]; rfl⟩
  have hj : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := Nat.find_spec hex
    rw [h, pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at this
    exact hx this
  refine exists_highestVector_of_F_pow_eq_zero hv hv' ρ s
    ((ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (Nat.find hex - 1)) x)
    (Nat.find_min hex (by omega)) ?_ (by rw [hs]; rfl)
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj)]
  exact Nat.find_spec hex

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.highest_eigenvalue_sq
statement:
theorem highest_eigenvalue_sq (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    {a : k} {m : M} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hm : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m)
    (hE : ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ n) m ≠ 0)
    (hz : (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (n + 1)) m = 0) :
    a ^ 2 = (v ^ n) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hden : v - v⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hv' 2 two_pos
    have h' := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    calc
      v ^ 2 = v * v := pow_two v
      _ = v * v⁻¹ := by rw [← h']
      _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hv
  have hq : qInt v (n + 1) ≠ 0 := qInt_ne_zero hv (hv' _ (by omega))
  have h := E_apply_F_pow_succ hv ρ ha hm hE n
  rw [hz, map_zero] at h
  have hc := (smul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_right hn
  have heq : v⁻¹ ^ n * a = v ^ n * a⁻¹ := by
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left
      (mul_ne_zero hq (inv_ne_zero hden)))
  rw [inv_pow] at heq
  field_simp at heq
  exact heq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.exists_highestString
statement:
theorem exists_highestString [FiniteDimensional k M] [Nontrivial M]
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (σ : k) (m : M), σ ^ 2 = 1 ∧ m ≠ 0 ∧
      ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = (σ * v ^ n) • m ∧
      ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0 ∧
      (∀ i ≤ n, (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ i) m ≠ 0) ∧
      (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (n + 1)) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, m, ha, hm0, hm, hE⟩ := exists_highestVector hv hv' ρ
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hz⟩ := exists_last_nonzero_F_pow hv hv' ρ ha hm0 hm
  have ha2 := highest_eigenvalue_sq hv hv' ρ ha hm hE (hn n le_rfl) hz
  refine ⟨n, a / v ^ n, m, ?_, hm0, ?_, hE, hn, hz⟩
  · rw [div_pow, ha2, div_self (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv))]
  · simpa only [div_mul_cancel₀ a (pow_ne_zero _ hv)] using hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.F_string_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem F_string_linearIndependent (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    {a : k} {m : M} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hm : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : ∀ i ≤ n, (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ i) m ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent k (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m)
proof:
:= by
  apply (ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1)).eigenvectors_linearIndependent'
    (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (v⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ (i : ℕ) * a)
  · exact (Module.End.pow_mul_injective_of_forall_pow_ne_one
      (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hv)) (inv_sq_pow_ne_one hv') ha).comp Fin.val_injective
  · intro i
    exact ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (K_apply_F_pow ρ hm i), hn i (by omega)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sl2Datum_cartanMatrix
statement: @[simp] lemma sl2Datum_cartanMatrix (i j : Unit) : sl2Datum.cartanMatrix i j = 2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sl2RootDatum_root
statement: @[simp] lemma sl2RootDatum_root (i : Unit) (μ : ℤ) : sl2RootDatum.root i μ = 2 * μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sl2RootDatum_ktilde
statement: @[simp] lemma sl2RootDatum_ktilde (i : Unit) : ktilde sl2RootDatum i = 1
