name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_of_lt
statement: lemma coord_of_lt (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) {l : ℕ} (h : l < n + 1) : coord n x l = x ⟨l, h⟩
proof:
:=
  by simp [coord, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_of_le
statement: lemma coord_of_le (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) {l : ℕ} (h : n + 1 ≤ l) : coord n x l = 0
proof:
:=
  by simp [coord]; omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_fin
statement: @[simp] lemma coord_fin (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : coord n x j = x j
proof:
:=
  coord_of_lt x j.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma coord_zero (l : ℕ) : coord n (0 : Fin (n + 1) → k) l = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold coord; split_ifs <;> rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_add
statement:
lemma coord_add (x y : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n (x + y) l = coord n x l + coord n y l
proof:
:= by
  unfold coord; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_sub
statement:
lemma coord_sub (x y : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n (x - y) l = coord n x l - coord n y l
proof:
:= by
  unfold coord; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_smul
statement: lemma coord_smul (c : k) (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) : coord n (c • x) l = c * coord n x l
proof:
:= by
  unfold coord; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.eCoeff_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma eCoeff_zero : eCoeff v n σ 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [eCoeff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.eCoeff_succ_self
statement: @[simp] lemma eCoeff_succ_self : eCoeff v n σ (n + 1) = 0
proof: := by simp [eCoeff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_opF
statement:
lemma coord_opF (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n (opF n x) l = if 0 < l ∧ l < n + 1 then coord n x (l - 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : l < n + 1
  · rw [coord_of_lt _ hl]
    change (if l = 0 then 0 else coord n x (l - 1)) = _
    by_cases h0 : l = 0 <;> simp [h0, hl]
  · rw [coord_of_le _ (by omega)]; simp; omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_opE
statement:
lemma coord_opE (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n (opE v n σ x) l = eCoeff v n σ (l + 1) * coord n x (l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : l < n + 1
  · rw [coord_of_lt _ hl]; rfl
  · rw [coord_of_le _ (by omega), coord_of_le _ (by omega), mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_opK
statement:
lemma coord_opK (μ : ℤ) (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n (opK v n σ μ x) l = σ ^ μ * v ^ (μ * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * l)) * coord n x l
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : l < n + 1
  · rw [coord_of_lt _ hl, coord_of_lt _ hl]; rfl
  · rw [coord_of_le _ (by omega), coord_of_le _ (by omega), mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.ext_coord
statement: lemma ext_coord {x y : Fin (n + 1) → k} (h : ∀ l, coord n x l = coord n y l) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  ext j; simpa using h j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.eCoeff_succ_sub
statement:
lemma eCoeff_succ_sub (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv2 : v ^ 2 ≠ 1) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) {l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ n) :
    eCoeff v n σ (l + 1) - eCoeff v n σ l = (v - v⁻¹)⁻¹ *
      (σ ^ (1 : ℤ) * v ^ ((1 : ℤ) * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * l)) -
        σ ^ (-1 : ℤ) * v ^ ((-1 : ℤ) * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * l)))
proof:
:= by
  have hD : v - v⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hv2
    have : v * v = v * v⁻¹ := congrArg (v * ·) (sub_eq_zero.1 h)
    rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ hv, ← sq] at this
  have hq : ∀ m, qInt v m = (v ^ m - (v ^ m)⁻¹) / (v - v⁻¹) := fun m ↦ by
    rw [eq_div_iff hD, mul_comm, qInt_mul_sub, inv_pow]
  have hσ' : σ⁻¹ = σ := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (by rw [← sq, hσ])
  have hz : (n : ℤ) - 2 * l = ((n - l : ℕ) : ℤ) - (l : ℤ) := by push_cast [hl]; ring
  have ha : v ^ l ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hb : v ^ (n - l) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  simp only [eCoeff, one_mul, zpow_one, neg_one_mul, zpow_neg, hz, zpow_sub₀ hv, zpow_natCast,
    hσ']
  rw [hq, hq, hq, hq, show n + 1 - (l + 1) = n - l by omega, show n + 1 - l = n - l + 1 by omega,
    pow_succ, pow_succ]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.opKHom_apply
statement:
lemma opKHom_apply (hv : v ≠ 0) (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (μ : ℤ) :
    opKHom v n σ hv hσ (.ofAdd μ) = opK v n σ μ
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.relations
statement:
theorem relations (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv2 : v ^ 2 ≠ 1) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) :
    Relations sl2RootDatum v (fun _ ↦ opE v n σ) (fun _ ↦ opF n)
      (opKHom v n σ hv (by rintro rfl; simp at hσ)) where
  K_mul_E μ i
proof:
:= LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ext_coord fun l ↦ by
    simp only [opKHom_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, coord_smul, coord_opK,
      coord_opE, sl2RootDatum_root]
    rw [show μ * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * l) = 2 * μ + μ * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) by
      push_cast; ring, zpow_add₀ hv]
    ring
  K_mul_F μ i := LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ext_coord fun l ↦ by
    simp only [opKHom_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, coord_smul, coord_opK,
      coord_opF, sl2RootDatum_root]
    split_ifs with h
    · obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l', l = l' + 1 := ⟨l - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [show μ * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        -(2 * μ) + μ * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * ((l + 1 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) by push_cast; ring, zpow_add₀ hv]
      ring
    · simp
  E_mul_F i j := LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ext_coord fun l ↦ by
    obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i j
    simp only [↓reduceIte, sl2Datum_d, pow_one, sl2RootDatum_ktilde, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, opKHom_apply, coord_sub, coord_smul,
      coord_opE, coord_opF, coord_opK]
    by_cases hl : l < n + 1
    · have key := eCoeff_succ_sub hv hv2 hσ (show l ≤ n by omega)
      have e1 : eCoeff v n σ (l + 1) * (if 0 < l + 1 ∧ l + 1 < n + 1 then coord n x (l + 1 - 1)
          else 0) = eCoeff v n σ (l + 1) * coord n x l := by
        split_ifs with h
        · rfl
        · obtain rfl : l = n := by omega
          simp
      have e2 : (if 0 < l ∧ l < n + 1 then eCoeff v n σ (l - 1 + 1) * coord n x (l - 1 + 1)
          else 0) = eCoeff v n σ l * coord n x l := by
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
        · obtain rfl : l = 0 := by omega
          simp
      rw [e1, e2]
      linear_combination coord n x l * key
    · rw [coord_of_le x (show n + 1 ≤ l by omega)]
      simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero]
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | simp
  serre_E i j h := absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) h
  serre_F i j h := absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_E
statement: @[simp] lemma simpleRep_E (i : Unit) : simpleRep v n σ hv hv2 hσ (E sl2RootDatum v i) = opE v n σ
proof:
:=
  lift_E _ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_F
statement: @[simp] lemma simpleRep_F (i : Unit) : simpleRep v n σ hv hv2 hσ (F sl2RootDatum v i) = opF n
proof:
:=
  lift_F _ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_K
statement: @[simp] lemma simpleRep_K (μ : ℤ) : simpleRep v n σ hv hv2 hσ (K sl2RootDatum v μ) = opK v n σ μ
proof:
:=
  lift_K _ μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_single
statement:
lemma coord_single (j : Fin (n + 1)) (c : k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n (Pi.single j c) l = if l = j then c else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.2
  by_cases hl : l < n + 1
  · rw [coord_of_lt _ hl, Pi.single_apply]
    simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
  · rw [coord_of_le _ (by omega)]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_F_single
statement:
theorem simpleRep_F_single (i : Unit) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    simpleRep v n σ hv hv2 hσ (F sl2RootDatum v i) (Pi.single j 1) =
      if h : (j : ℕ) + 1 < n + 1 then Pi.single ⟨j + 1, h⟩ 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [simpleRep_F]
  refine ext_coord fun l ↦ ?_
  have hj := j.2
  rw [coord_opF]
  by_cases h : (j : ℕ) + 1 < n + 1
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, coord_single]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, coord_single, coord_zero]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_E_single
statement:
theorem simpleRep_E_single (i : Unit) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    simpleRep v n σ hv hv2 hσ (E sl2RootDatum v i) (Pi.single j 1) =
      if h : 0 < (j : ℕ) then eCoeff v n σ j • Pi.single ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [simpleRep_E]
  refine ext_coord fun l ↦ ?_
  have hj := j.2
  rw [coord_opE, coord_single]
  by_cases h : 0 < (j : ℕ)
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, coord_smul, coord_single]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · rw [h1]
    · exfalso; omega
    · exfalso; omega
    · simp
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, coord_zero]
    split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_K_single
statement:
theorem simpleRep_K_single (μ : ℤ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    simpleRep v n σ hv hv2 hσ (K sl2RootDatum v μ) (Pi.single j 1) =
      (σ ^ μ * v ^ (μ * ((n : ℤ) - 2 * j))) • Pi.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simpleRep_K]
  refine ext_coord fun l ↦ ?_
  rw [coord_opK, coord_smul, coord_single]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; rfl
  · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_opF_pow
statement:
lemma coord_opF_pow (a : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n ((opF n ^ a) x) l = if a ≤ l ∧ l < n + 1 then coord n x (l - a) else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing l with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, zero_le, true_and, Nat.sub_zero]
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · exact coord_of_le x (by omega)
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, coord_opF, ih]
    split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl | (congr 1; omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.coord_opE_pow
statement:
lemma coord_opE_pow (a : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) → k) (l : ℕ) :
    coord n ((opE v n σ ^ a) x) l =
      (∏ t ∈ Finset.range a, eCoeff v n σ (l + 1 + t)) * coord n x (l + a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, coord_opE, ih, Finset.prod_range_succ',
      show l + 1 + a = l + (a + 1) by omega]
    simp only [add_zero]
    have : ∏ t ∈ Finset.range a, eCoeff v n σ (l + 1 + 1 + t) =
        ∏ t ∈ Finset.range a, eCoeff v n σ (l + 1 + (t + 1)) :=
      Finset.prod_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ by rw [show l + 1 + 1 + t = l + 1 + (t + 1) by omega]
    rw [this]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_irreducible
statement:
theorem simpleRep_irreducible (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → v ^ m ≠ 1) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1)
    (W : Submodule k (Fin (n + 1) → k))
    (hW : ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, x ∈ W → simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x ∈ W) :
    W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hW0 : W = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hW0
  right
  have hσ0 : σ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hσ
  have hFW : ∀ a y, y ∈ W → (opF n ^ a) y ∈ W := fun a y hy ↦ by
    have := hW (F sl2RootDatum v () ^ a) y hy
    rwa [map_pow, simpleRep_F] at this
  have hEW : ∀ a y, y ∈ W → (opE v n σ ^ a) y ∈ W := fun a y hy ↦ by
    have := hW (E sl2RootDatum v () ^ a) y hy
    rwa [map_pow, simpleRep_E] at this
  have hsmul : ∀ (c : k) y, c ≠ 0 → c • y ∈ W → y ∈ W := fun c y hc h ↦ by
    simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc] using W.smul_mem c⁻¹ h
  obtain ⟨x, hxW, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hW0
  have hex : ∃ l, coord n x l ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hx0 (ext_coord fun l ↦ by simp [h l])
  set j0 := Nat.find hex
  have hj0 : coord n x j0 ≠ 0 := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hmin : ∀ l < j0, coord n x l = 0 := fun l hl ↦ by simpa using Nat.find_min hex hl
  have hj0n : j0 < n + 1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hj0 (coord_of_le x (by omega))
  
  have h1 : (opF n ^ (n - j0)) x = coord n x j0 • Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1 :=
    ext_coord fun l ↦ by
      rw [coord_opF_pow, coord_smul, coord_single, Fin.val_last]
      split_ifs with h h'
      · rw [h', show n - (n - j0) = j0 by omega, mul_one]
      · rw [hmin _ (by omega), mul_zero]
      · exfalso; omega
      · rw [mul_zero]
  have hn : Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : k) ∈ W := hsmul _ _ hj0 (h1 ▸ hFW _ _ hxW)
  
  have hP : ∏ t ∈ Finset.range n, eCoeff v n σ (0 + 1 + t) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
    intro t ht
    have ht := Finset.mem_range.1 ht
    have hq : ∀ m, 0 < m → qInt v m ≠ 0 := fun m hm ↦ qInt_ne_zero hv (hv' _ (by omega))
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hσ0 (hq _ (by omega))) (hq _ (by omega))
  have h2 : (opE v n σ ^ n) (Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1) =
      (∏ t ∈ Finset.range n, eCoeff v n σ (0 + 1 + t)) • Pi.single 0 1 :=
    ext_coord fun l ↦ by
      rw [coord_opE_pow, coord_single, coord_smul, coord_single, Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero]
      split_ifs with h h'
      · subst h'; simp
      · exfalso; omega
      · omega
      · rw [mul_zero, mul_zero]
  have h0 : Pi.single (0 : Fin (n + 1)) (1 : k) ∈ W := hsmul _ _ hP (h2 ▸ hEW _ _ hn)
  
  have hall : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), Pi.single j (1 : k) ∈ W := fun j ↦ by
    have h3 : (opF n ^ (j : ℕ)) (Pi.single 0 1) = Pi.single j (1 : k) := ext_coord fun l ↦ by
      have := j.2
      rw [coord_opF_pow, coord_single, coord_single, Fin.val_zero]
      split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)
    exact h3 ▸ hFW _ _ h0
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro y -
  rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single y]
  refine W.sum_mem fun j _ ↦ ?_
  have : Pi.single j (y j) = y j • Pi.single j (1 : k) := by
    ext l; by_cases h : l = j <;> simp [h]
  rw [this]
  exact W.smul_mem _ (hall j)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.stringsLT_mono
statement: lemma stringsLT_mono {n : ℤ} {N N' : ℕ} (h : N ≤ N') : V.stringsLT n N ≤ V.stringsLT n N'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono fun _ ⟨j, η, hj, hη, hE, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨j, η, by omega, hη, hE, hx⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.stringsLT_le_wt
statement: lemma stringsLT_le_wt (n : ℤ) (N : ℕ) : V.stringsLT n N ≤ V.wt n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨j, η, -, hη, -, rfl⟩
  have := dF_mem hη j
  rwa [show n + 2 * (j : ℤ) - 2 * j = n by ring] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_mem_stringsLT
statement:
lemma dF_mem_stringsLT {n : ℤ} {N j : ℕ} {η : M} (hj : j < N) (hη : η ∈ V.wt (n + 2 * j))
    (hE : V.E η = 0) : V.dF j η ∈ V.stringsLT n N
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, η, hj, hη, hE, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.mem_stringsLT_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mem_stringsLT_of_nonneg {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) {N : ℕ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n)
    (hN : (V.E ^ N) m = 0) : m ∈ V.stringsLT n N
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ (N : ℕ) (m : M), (V.E ^ N) m = qFactorial q N • V.dE N m := fun N m ↦ by
    rw [dE_apply, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq N),
      one_smul]
  induction N generalizing m with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hN; rw [hN]; exact zero_mem _
  | succ N ih =>
    set y := V.dE N m
    have hy : y ∈ V.wt (n + 2 * N) := dE_mem hm N
    have hyE : V.E y = 0 := by
      have h1 : V.dE (N + 1) m = 0 := by
        rw [hpow] at hN
        exact (smul_eq_zero.1 hN).resolve_left (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq _)
      rw [E_dE hq0 hq, h1, smul_zero]
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) = n + 2 * N := ⟨(n + 2 * N).toNat, by omega⟩
    have hNp : N ≤ p := by omega
    set c := qBinomial q p N
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := qBinomial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq hNp
    set m' := m - c⁻¹ • V.dF N y
    have hy' : y ∈ V.wt (p : ℤ) := hp ▸ hy
    have hm' : m' ∈ V.wt n := by
      refine sub_mem hm (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_)
      have := dF_mem hy N
      rwa [show n + 2 * (N : ℤ) - 2 * N = n by ring] at this
    have hEm' : (V.E ^ N) m' = 0 := by
      rw [hpow, map_sub, map_smul, dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hy' hyE le_rfl hNp, Nat.sub_self,
        show p - N + N = p by omega, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul, dF_zero, sub_self,
        smul_zero]
    have h1 := V.stringsLT_mono (Nat.le_succ N) (ih hm' hEm')
    have h2 : V.dF N y ∈ V.stringsLT n (N + 1) := dF_mem_stringsLT (Nat.lt_succ_self N) hy hyE
    have : m = m' + c⁻¹ • V.dF N y := by simp [m']
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem h1 (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.mem_stringsLT_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem mem_stringsLT_of_nonpos {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≤ 0) {N : ℕ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n)
    (hN : (V.F ^ N) m = 0) : m ∈ V.stringsLT n (N + (-n).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mem_stringsLT_of_nonneg (V := V.flip) hq0 hq (n := -n) (by omega)
    (by simpa using hm) hN
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ h
  rintro _ ⟨j, ξ, hj, hξ, hFξ, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℕ, (P : ℤ) = 2 * j - n := ⟨(2 * j - n).toNat, by omega⟩
  have hjP : j ≤ P := by omega
  have hξ' : ξ ∈ V.flip.wt (P : ℤ) := by
    rw [flip_wt] at hξ ⊢
    convert hξ using 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨hη, hηE⟩ := flip_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hq hξ' hFξ
  have e := dF_eq_flip_dF (V := V.flip) hq0 hq hξ' hFξ hjP
  rw [flip_flip] at hη hηE e
  rw [e]
  refine dF_mem_stringsLT (by omega) ?_ hηE
  convert hη using 2
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq'
statement:
lemma qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq' {a kk u : ℕ} (hka : kk ≤ a) (hu : u ≤ kk)
    (hf : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0) :
    qBinomial q a kk * qBinomial q kk u = qBinomial q a u * qBinomial q (a - u) (kk - u)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) hka
  have h2 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) hu
  have h3 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (show u ≤ a by omega)
  have h4 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (show kk - u ≤ a - u by omega)
  rw [show a - u - (kk - u) = a - kk by omega] at h4
  have hX : qFactorial q u * qFactorial q (kk - u) * qFactorial q (a - kk) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (hf _) (hf _)) (hf _)
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hX
  linear_combination (qBinomial q a kk * qFactorial q (a - kk)) * h2 + h1 -
    (qBinomial q a u * qFactorial q u) * h4 - h3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq
statement:
lemma qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq {a kk u : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ kk) :
    qBinomial q a kk * qBinomial q kk u = qBinomial q a u * qBinomial q (a - u) (kk - u)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt kk a with hka | hka
  · exact qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq' hka hu (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq)
  · rcases le_or_gt u a with hua | hua
    · rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q hka,
        qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q (show a - u < kk - u by omega), zero_mul, mul_zero]
    · rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q hka, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q hua, zero_mul, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.neg_one_pow_sub
statement: lemma neg_one_pow_sub {r u : ℕ} (h : u ≤ r) : (-1 : k) ^ (r - u) = (-1) ^ r * (-1) ^ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, pow_add, mul_comm ((-1 : k) ^ u), mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
    ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.inv_pow_sub
statement: lemma inv_pow_sub {r u : ℕ} (h : u ≤ r) : q⁻¹ ^ (r - u) = q⁻¹ ^ r * q ^ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  have := pow_ne_zero u hq0
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, pow_add, inv_pow]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.psi_coeff
statement:
lemma psi_coeff {p r kk : ℕ} (hk : kk ≤ r) (hh : r ≤ p + kk) :
    (-1) ^ p * q ^ p * ∑ s ∈ range (r + 1), (if s ≤ p then (-1) ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ s else 0) *
      (qBinomial q (p - s + kk) (p - s) * qBinomial q kk (r - s)) =
      (-1) ^ (p + kk - r) * q ^ ((p + kk - r) * (kk + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hk
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ : ∃ h, p = h + d := ⟨p - d, by omega⟩
  rw [show h + d + kk - (kk + d) = h by omega]
  
  rw [← sum_range_reflect]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  
  rw [← sum_subset (range_subset_range.2 (show kk + 1 ≤ kk + d + 1 by omega))]
  swap
  · intro u hu hu'
    simp only [mem_range, not_lt] at hu hu'
    rw [show kk + d - (kk + d - u) = u by omega, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q (by omega : kk < u),
      mul_zero, mul_zero]
  have hterm : ∀ u ∈ range (kk + 1), (if kk + d - u ≤ h + d then
      (-1) ^ (kk + d - u) * q⁻¹ ^ (kk + d - u) else 0) *
      (qBinomial q (h + d - (kk + d - u) + kk) (h + d - (kk + d - u)) *
        qBinomial q kk (kk + d - (kk + d - u))) =
      (-1) ^ (kk + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (kk + d) *
        ((-1) ^ u * q ^ u * qBinomial q (h + u) u * qBinomial q h (kk - u)) := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [mem_range] at hu
    rw [show kk + d - (kk + d - u) = u by omega]
    split_ifs with hs
    · rw [show h + d - (kk + d - u) + kk = h + u by omega,
        show h + d - (kk + d - u) = h + u - kk by omega,
        qBinomial_symm q (show kk ≤ h + u by omega),
        qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq hq0 hq (show u ≤ kk by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        neg_one_pow_sub (show u ≤ kk + d by omega), inv_pow_sub hq0 (show u ≤ kk + d by omega)]
      ring
    · rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q (show h < kk - u by omega)]
      ring
  rw [sum_congr rfl hterm, ← mul_sum, sum_qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_zero hq0 h kk]
  rw [inv_pow, neg_pow (q ^ (h + 1)), ← pow_mul]
  have hqd : q ^ (kk + d) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hq0
  field_simp
  have e1 : ((-1 : k) ^ d) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, pow_mul', neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  have e2 : ((-1 : k) ^ kk) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, pow_mul', neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  rw [pow_add (-1 : k) h d, pow_add (-1 : k) kk d]
  linear_combination ((-1 : k) ^ h * q ^ (h + d) * q ^ ((h + 1) * kk) * ((-1) ^ kk) ^ 2) * e1 +
    ((-1 : k) ^ h * q ^ (h + d) * q ^ ((h + 1) * kk)) * e2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.psi_apply
statement:
lemma psi_apply (p r : ℕ) (w : M) : V.psi p r w = ∑ s ∈ range (r + 1),
    (if s ≤ p then (-1) ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ s else 0) • V.dE (r - s) (V.dF (p - s) w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [psi, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_eq_psi_of_mem
statement:
theorem T_eq_psi_of_mem {p r : ℕ} {w : M} (hw : w ∈ V.stringsLT ((p : ℤ) - r) (r + 1)) :
    V.T q w = ((-1) ^ p * q ^ p) • V.psi p r w
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hx, smul_comm]
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨kk, ζ, hkk, hζ, hE, rfl⟩ := hx
    rcases lt_or_ge ((p : ℤ) - r + 2 * kk) 0 with hneg | hnn
    · rw [eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg hq0 hq hζ hE hneg]
      simp
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℕ, (P : ℤ) = p - r + 2 * kk := ⟨_, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn⟩
    rw [← hP] at hζ
    by_cases hkP : kk ≤ P
    swap
    · rw [dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hζ hE (by omega)]
      simp
    have hh : r ≤ p + kk := by omega
    rw [T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hζ hE hkP, psi_apply]
    have hterm : ∀ s ∈ range (r + 1), (if s ≤ p then (-1) ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ s else 0) •
        V.dE (r - s) (V.dF (p - s) (V.dF kk ζ)) =
        ((if s ≤ p then (-1) ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ s else 0) *
          (qBinomial q (p - s + kk) (p - s) * qBinomial q kk (r - s))) • V.dF (P - kk) ζ := by
      intro s hs
      simp only [mem_range] at hs
      split_ifs with hsp
      swap
      · simp
      rw [dF_dF hq0 hq, map_smul]
      rcases le_or_gt (r - s) kk with hrs | hrs
      · rw [dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hζ hE (show r - s ≤ p - s + kk by omega)
          (show p - s + kk ≤ P by omega), show P - (p - s + kk) + (r - s) = kk by omega,
          show p - s + kk - (r - s) = P - kk by omega, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
      · rw [dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hζ hE (show (P : ℤ) < (p - s + kk : ℕ) by omega),
          map_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q hrs, mul_zero, mul_zero,
          zero_smul]
    rw [sum_congr rfl hterm, ← sum_smul, smul_smul, psi_coeff hq0 hq (by omega) hh,
      show p + kk - r = P - kk by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_of_lowest
statement:
theorem T_of_lowest {t : k} (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : ∀ n j, qBinomial t n j = qBinomial q n j)
    {p : ℕ} {ξ : M} (hξ : ξ ∈ V.wt (-p)) (hF : V.F ξ = 0) : V.T t ξ = V.dE p ξ
proof:
:= by
  have hξ' : ξ ∈ V.flip.wt p := by rwa [flip_wt]
  have h := T_dF_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hq ht0 ht hξ' hF (Nat.zero_le p)
  rw [flip_dF, dE_zero, Nat.sub_zero, zero_add, mul_one] at h
  rw [T_eq_zpow_smul_flip_T hq0 hq ht0 ht hξ, h, smul_smul, flip_dF]
  have hne : (-t) ^ p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.2 ht0)
  rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← neg_pow t, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_eq_flip_psi
statement:
theorem T_eq_flip_psi {p r : ℕ} {w : M} (hw : w ∈ V.flip.stringsLT ((p : ℤ) - r) (r + 1)) :
    V.T q w = ((-1) ^ r * q ^ r) • V.flip.psi p r w
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : w ∈ V.wt ((r : ℤ) - p) := by
    have := V.flip.stringsLT_le_wt _ _ hw
    rwa [flip_wt, neg_sub] at this
  rw [T_eq_zpow_smul_flip_T hq0 hq hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hmem,
    T_eq_psi_of_mem (V := V.flip) hq0 hq hw, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have hne : (-q) ^ p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.2 hq0)
  rw [zpow_sub₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 hq0), zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, ← neg_pow q p, ← neg_pow q r,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.comm_dF
statement:
lemma comm_dF (Z : Module.End k M) (h : ∀ m, Z (V.F m) = V.F (Z m)) (n : ℕ) (x : M) :
    Z (V.dF n x) = V.dF n (Z x)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ (N : ℕ) m, Z ((V.F ^ N) m) = (V.F ^ N) (Z m) := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ N ih => intro m; rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, h, ih]
  rw [dF_apply, dF_apply, map_smul, hc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.comm_dE
statement:
lemma comm_dE (Z : Module.End k M) (h : ∀ m, Z (V.E m) = V.E (Z m)) (n : ℕ) (x : M) :
    Z (V.dE n x) = V.dE n (Z x)
proof:
:=
  comm_dF (V := V.flip) Z h n x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_comp_eq_of_psi
statement:
theorem T_comp_eq_of_psi (W : IntegrableSl2 q M) (T Z X G : Module.End k M) (r : ℕ) (κ : ℕ → k)
    (hT : ∀ (p : ℕ) (w : M), w ∈ W.stringsLT ((p : ℤ) - r) (r + 1) → T w = κ p • W.psi p r w)
    (hZF : ∀ m, Z (W.F m) = W.F (Z m)) (hZwt : ∀ n, ∀ m ∈ W.wt n, Z m ∈ W.wt (n - r))
    (hZE : ∀ (p : ℕ) η, η ∈ W.wt p → W.E η = 0 → (W.E ^ (r + 1)) (Z η) = 0)
    (hX : ∀ (p : ℕ) η, η ∈ W.wt p → W.E η = 0 → X (T η) = κ p • W.psi p r (Z η))
    (hG : ∀ m, T (W.F m) = G (T m)) (hXG : ∀ m, X (G m) = G (X m)) (m : M) :
    T (Z m) = X (T m)
proof:
:= by
  have hstr : ∀ (p : ℕ) η, η ∈ W.wt p → W.E η = 0 → ∀ j,
      T (Z (W.dF j η)) = X (T (W.dF j η)) := by
    intro p η hη hE j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      rw [dF_zero, hX p η hη hE]
      apply hT
      have hZη : Z η ∈ W.wt ((p : ℤ) - r) := hZwt _ η hη
      rcases le_or_gt (r : ℤ) p with hrp | hrp
      · exact mem_stringsLT_of_nonneg hq0 hq (by omega) hZη (hZE p η hη hE)
      · have hF : (W.F ^ (p + 1)) (Z η) = 0 := by
          have hc : ∀ (N : ℕ) m, (W.F ^ N) (Z m) = Z ((W.F ^ N) m) := by
            intro N
            induction N with
            | zero => simp
            | succ N ih => intro m; rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
                ih, hZF]
          have h0 := dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (show (p : ℤ) < (p + 1 : ℕ) by
            push_cast; omega)
          rw [dF_apply] at h0
          rw [hc, (smul_eq_zero.1 h0).resolve_left
            (inv_ne_zero (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq _)), map_zero]
        have := mem_stringsLT_of_nonpos hq0 hq (by omega) hZη hF
        rwa [show p + 1 + (-((p : ℤ) - r)).toNat = r + 1 by omega] at this
    | succ j ih =>
      have hb := qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos j)
      have e : W.dF (j + 1) η = (qInt q (j + 1))⁻¹ • W.F (W.dF j η) := by
        rw [F_dF hq0 hq, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul]
      rw [e, map_smul, map_smul, hZF, hG, ih, map_smul, map_smul, hG, hXG]
  have key := W.ext_wt (f := T ∘ₗ Z) (g := X ∘ₗ T) fun n m hm ↦
    eq_on_wt hq0 hq (T ∘ₗ Z) (X ∘ₗ T) (fun p j η _ _ hη hE ↦ hstr p η hη hE j) hm
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qIntZ_zero : qIntZ q 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [qIntZ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_neg
statement: lemma qIntZ_neg (n : ℤ) : qIntZ q (-n) = -qIntZ q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [qIntZ, qIntZ, neg_neg, ← neg_div, neg_sub]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_natCast
statement: lemma qIntZ_natCast (hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) : qIntZ q n = qInt q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [qIntZ, div_eq_iff hq, mul_comm, qInt_mul_sub, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_one
statement: lemma qIntZ_one (hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) : qIntZ q 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [qIntZ, zpow_one, zpow_neg_one, div_self hq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_ne_one_of_pow_ne_one
statement:
lemma zpow_ne_one_of_pow_ne_one (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    q ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq n with h | h
  · rw [h, zpow_natCast]; exact hq _ (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hn)
  · rw [h, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_ne_one]; exact hq _ (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hn)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one
statement: lemma sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine hq 2 two_pos ?_
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
  rw [sq]
  nth_rw 2 [h]
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_ne_zero
statement: lemma qIntZ_ne_zero {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : qIntZ q n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine div_ne_zero ?_ (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq)
  rw [sub_ne_zero]
  intro h
  refine zpow_ne_one_of_pow_ne_one hq (show n + n ≠ 0 by omega) ?_
  rw [zpow_add₀ hq0]
  nth_rw 2 [h]
  rw [← zpow_add₀ hq0, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one
statement: lemma qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : qInt q n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← qIntZ_natCast (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq)]
  exact qIntZ_ne_zero hq0 hq (by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one
statement: lemma qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (n : ℕ) : qFactorial q n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  qFactorial_ne_zero hq0 fun m hm _ ↦ hq _ (by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one
statement: lemma qBinomial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one {n j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) : qBinomial q n j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have e := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) h
  rw [h0, zero_mul, zero_mul] at e
  exact qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq n e.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_succ_mul_add
statement:
lemma qIntZ_succ_mul_add (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) (b : ℕ) :
    qIntZ q (b + 1) * qIntZ q (n - b) + qIntZ q (n - 2 * b - 2) =
      qIntZ q (b + 2) * qIntZ q (n - b - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q - q⁻¹ = 0
  · simp [qIntZ, hq]
  simp only [qIntZ, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add, neg_neg, two_mul, zpow_add₀ hq0, zpow_neg,
    zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_E
statement: @[simp] lemma flip_E : V.flip.E = V.F
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_F
statement: @[simp] lemma flip_F : V.flip.F = V.E
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_wt
statement: @[simp] lemma flip_wt (n : ℤ) : V.flip.wt n = V.wt (-n)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_dE
statement: @[simp] lemma flip_dE (a : ℕ) : V.flip.dE a = V.dF a
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_dF
statement: @[simp] lemma flip_dF (a : ℕ) : V.flip.dF a = V.dE a
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dE_apply
statement: lemma dE_apply (a : ℕ) (m : M) : V.dE a m = (qFactorial q a)⁻¹ • (V.E ^ a) m
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_apply
statement: lemma dF_apply (a : ℕ) (m : M) : V.dF a m = (qFactorial q a)⁻¹ • (V.F ^ a) m
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dE_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma dE_zero (m : M) : V.dE 0 m = m
proof: := by simp [dE_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma dF_zero (m : M) : V.dF 0 m = m
proof: := by simp [dF_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.E_pow_mem
statement: lemma E_pow_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) (a : ℕ) : (V.E ^ a) m ∈ V.wt (n + 2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    have := V.E_mem ih
    rwa [show n + 2 * (a : ℤ) + 2 = n + 2 * ((a + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.F_pow_mem
statement: lemma F_pow_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) (a : ℕ) : (V.F ^ a) m ∈ V.wt (n - 2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  have := V.flip.E_pow_mem (n := -n) (by simpa using hm) a
  simpa [show -(-(n : ℤ) + 2 * a) = n - 2 * a by ring] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dE_mem
statement: lemma dE_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) (a : ℕ) : V.dE a m ∈ V.wt (n + 2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dE_apply]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (E_pow_mem hm a)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_mem
statement: lemma dF_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) (a : ℕ) : V.dF a m ∈ V.wt (n - 2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dF_apply]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (F_pow_mem hm a)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.E_F_pow_succ
statement:
lemma E_F_pow_succ (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) (b : ℕ) :
    V.E ((V.F ^ (b + 1)) m) = (V.F ^ (b + 1)) (V.E m) +
      (qIntZ q (b + 1) * qIntZ q (n - b)) • (V.F ^ b) m
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero =>
    have := V.E_F_sub hm
    simp only [pow_one, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, sub_zero, qIntZ_one hq, one_mul, pow_zero,
      Module.End.one_apply]
    rw [← this]
    abel
  | succ b ih =>
    set w := (V.F ^ (b + 1)) m
    have hw : w ∈ V.wt (n - 2 * (b + 1 : ℕ)) := F_pow_mem hm (b + 1)
    have h2 := V.E_F_sub hw
    have e1 : (V.F ^ (b + 1 + 1)) m = V.F w := by rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    have e2 : (V.F ^ (b + 1 + 1)) (V.E m) = V.F ((V.F ^ (b + 1)) (V.E m)) := by
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    have e3 : V.F ((V.F ^ b) m) = w := by rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']
    have key := qIntZ_succ_mul_add hq0 n b
    rw [e1, e2, sub_eq_iff_eq_add.1 h2, ih, map_add, map_smul, e3]
    have hc : qIntZ q (n - 2 * ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) + qIntZ q (b + 1) * qIntZ q (n - b) =
        qIntZ q ((b + 1 : ℕ) + 1) * qIntZ q (n - (b + 1 : ℕ)) := by
      push_cast
      rw [show n - 2 * ((b : ℤ) + 1) = n - 2 * b - 2 by ring, add_comm, key,
        show (b : ℤ) + 1 + 1 = b + 2 by ring, show n - ((b : ℤ) + 1) = n - b - 1 by ring]
    rw [← hc, add_smul]
    abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.F_dF
statement: lemma F_dF (b : ℕ) (m : M) : V.F (V.dF b m) = qInt q (b + 1) • V.dF (b + 1) m
proof:
:= by
  have hb := qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos b)
  rw [dF_apply, dF_apply, map_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ', smul_smul,
    qFactorial_succ, mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.E_dE
statement: lemma E_dE (b : ℕ) (m : M) : V.E (V.dE b m) = qInt q (b + 1) • V.dE (b + 1) m
proof:
:=
  F_dF (V := V.flip) hq0 hq b m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.E_dF_succ
statement:
lemma E_dF_succ {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) (b : ℕ) :
    V.E (V.dF (b + 1) m) = V.dF (b + 1) (V.E m) + qIntZ q (n - b) • V.dF b m
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 := sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq
  have hb := qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos b)
  have hf := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq b
  have hc : qIntZ q ((b : ℤ) + 1) = qInt q (b + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast qIntZ_natCast hq2 (b + 1)
  rw [dF_apply, dF_apply, dF_apply, map_smul, E_F_pow_succ hq0 hq2 hm b, smul_add, smul_smul,
    smul_smul, hc, qFactorial_succ]
  congr 2
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.E_dF_succ_of_primitive
statement:
lemma E_dF_succ_of_primitive {p : ℤ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt p) (hE : V.E η = 0) (b : ℕ) :
    V.E (V.dF (b + 1) η) = qIntZ q (p - b) • V.dF b η
proof:
:= by
  rw [E_dF_succ hq0 hq hη, hE, map_zero, zero_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg {p : ℤ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt p) (hE : V.E η = 0)
    (hp : p < 0) : η = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := V.exists_F_pow_eq_zero η
  have h : ∀ b, V.dF b η = 0 → V.dF 0 η = 0 := by
    intro b
    induction b with
    | zero => exact id
    | succ b ih =>
      intro hb
      apply ih
      have e := E_dF_succ_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE b
      rw [hb, map_zero] at e
      exact (smul_eq_zero.1 e.symm).resolve_left (qIntZ_ne_zero hq0 hq (by omega))
  have := h N (by rw [dF_apply, hN, smul_zero])
  simpa using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive
statement:
lemma dF_eq_zero_of_primitive {p : ℤ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt p) (hE : V.E η = 0) {b : ℕ}
    (hb : p < b) : V.dF b η = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge p 0 with hp | hp
  · rw [eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg hq0 hq hη hE hp, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hp
  have hb' : p + 1 ≤ b := by omega
  induction b, hb' using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    refine eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg hq0 hq (dF_mem hη (p + 1)) ?_ (by push_cast; omega)
    rw [E_dF_succ_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE p, sub_self, qIntZ_zero, zero_smul]
  | succ b hb ih =>
    have hb1 := qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos b)
    have e := F_dF hq0 hq (V := V) b η
    rw [ih (by omega), map_zero] at e
    exact (smul_eq_zero.1 e.symm).resolve_left hb1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_of_primitive
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 := sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq
  induction a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih =>
    have hi := qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos a)
    have e : V.dE (a + 1) (V.dF b η) = (qInt q (a + 1))⁻¹ • V.E (V.dE a (V.dF b η)) := by
      rw [E_dE hq0 hq, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hi, one_smul]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, b - a = c + 1 := ⟨b - a - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [e, ih (by omega), map_smul, hc, E_dF_succ_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE c, smul_smul,
      smul_smul, show b - (a + 1) = c by omega]
    congr 1
    
    have hN : (p : ℤ) - c = ((p - b + a + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hN, qIntZ_natCast hq2, show p - b + (a + 1) = (p - b + a) + 1 by omega]
    have h1 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (show a ≤ p - b + a by omega)
    have h2 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q)
      (show a + 1 ≤ p - b + a + 1 by omega)
    rw [show p - b + a + 1 - (a + 1) = p - b + a - a by omega, qFactorial_succ q (p - b + a),
      qFactorial_succ q a] at h2
    have hf1 := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq a
    have hf2 := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (p - b + a - a)
    rw [← h1] at h2
    have h3 : qBinomial q (p - b + a + 1) (a + 1) * qInt q (a + 1) =
        qInt q (p - b + a + 1) * qBinomial q (p - b + a) a := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hf1 hf2)
      linear_combination h2
    rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ hi]
    linear_combination -h3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_mem_strings
statement:
lemma dF_mem_strings {n : ℤ} {j : ℕ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt (n + 2 * j)) (hE : V.E η = 0) :
    V.dF j η ∈ V.strings n
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, η, hη, hE, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.mem_strings_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma mem_strings_of_nonneg {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) :
    m ∈ V.strings n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := V.exists_E_pow_eq_zero m
  have hpow : ∀ (N : ℕ) (m : M), (V.E ^ N) m = qFactorial q N • V.dE N m := fun N m ↦ by
    rw [dE_apply, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq N),
      one_smul]
  induction N generalizing m with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] at hN; rw [hN]; exact zero_mem _
  | succ N ih =>
    set y := V.dE N m
    have hy : y ∈ V.wt (n + 2 * N) := dE_mem hm N
    have hyE : V.E y = 0 := by
      have h1 : V.dE (N + 1) m = 0 := by
        rw [hpow] at hN
        exact (smul_eq_zero.1 hN).resolve_left (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq _)
      rw [E_dE hq0 hq, h1, smul_zero]
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) = n + 2 * N := ⟨(n + 2 * N).toNat, by omega⟩
    have hNp : N ≤ p := by omega
    set c := qBinomial q p N
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := qBinomial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq hNp
    set m' := m - c⁻¹ • V.dF N y
    have hy' : y ∈ V.wt (p : ℤ) := hp ▸ hy
    have hm' : m' ∈ V.wt n := by
      refine sub_mem hm (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_)
      have := dF_mem hy N
      rwa [show n + 2 * (N : ℤ) - 2 * N = n by ring] at this
    have hEm' : (V.E ^ N) m' = 0 := by
      rw [hpow, map_sub, map_smul, dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hy' hyE le_rfl hNp, Nat.sub_self,
        show p - N + N = p by omega, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul, dF_zero, sub_self,
        smul_zero]
    have h1 := ih hm' hEm'
    have h2 : V.dF N y ∈ V.strings n := dF_mem_strings hy hyE
    have : m = m' + c⁻¹ • V.dF N y := by simp [m']
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem h1 (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.mem_strings
statement: theorem mem_strings {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) : m ∈ V.strings n
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn | hn
  · exact mem_strings_of_nonneg hq0 hq hn hm
  
  have h := mem_strings_of_nonneg (V := V.flip) hq0 hq (n := -n) (by omega)
    (by simpa using hm)
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ h
  rintro _ ⟨j, ξ, hξ, hFξ, rfl⟩
  
  simp only [flip_wt, flip_E] at hξ hFξ
  rw [show -(-n + 2 * (j : ℤ)) = n - 2 * j by ring] at hξ
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) = 2 * j - n := ⟨(2 * j - n).toNat, by omega⟩
  have hjp : j ≤ p := by omega
  have hξ' : ξ ∈ V.flip.wt (p : ℤ) := by
    rw [flip_wt, hp, show -(2 * (j : ℤ) - n) = n - 2 * j by ring]
    exact hξ
  set η := V.dE p ξ
  have hη : η ∈ V.wt (p : ℤ) := by
    have := dE_mem hξ p
    rwa [show n - 2 * (j : ℤ) + 2 * p = p by omega] at this
  have hηE : V.E η = 0 := by
    have h0 := dF_eq_zero_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hq hξ' hFξ
      (show (p : ℤ) < (p + 1 : ℕ) by push_cast; omega)
    rw [flip_dF] at h0
    rw [E_dE hq0 hq, h0, smul_zero]
  
  have hξη : V.dF p η = ξ := by
    have := dE_dF_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hq hξ' hFξ (le_refl p) (le_refl p)
    simpa using this
  
  have e : V.flip.dF j ξ = V.dF (p - j) η := by
    rw [flip_dF, ← hξη, dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hηE hjp le_rfl,
      show p - p + j = j by omega, qBinomial_self, one_smul]
  rw [e]
  refine dF_mem_strings ?_ hηE
  rwa [show n + 2 * ((p - j : ℕ) : ℤ) = p by push_cast [hjp]; omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflChar_self
statement: lemma reflChar_self (j : I) (c : I → kˣ) : reflChar D j c j = (c j)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change c j * c j ^ (-D.cartanMatrix j j) = (c j)⁻¹
  rw [D.cartanMatrix_self]
  group

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflChar_reflChar
statement: lemma reflChar_reflChar (j : I) (c : I → kˣ) : reflChar D j (reflChar D j c) = c
proof:
:= by
  funext l
  change reflChar D j c l * reflChar D j c j ^ (-D.cartanMatrix j l) = c l
  rw [reflChar_self]
  change c l * c j ^ (-D.cartanMatrix j l) * (c j)⁻¹ ^ (-D.cartanMatrix j l) = c l
  group

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_serreAux
statement:
lemma diagHom_serreAux (c : I → kˣ) (q x : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : I) :
    diagHom R v c (serreAux q x m (E R v a) (E R v b)) =
      ((c a : k) ^ m * c b) • serreAux q x m (E R v a) (E R v b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show diagHom R v c (serreAux q x m (E R v a) (E R v b)) =
      serreAux q x m ((c a : k) • E R v a) ((c b : k) • E R v b) by
    simp [serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow], serreAux_smul_smul']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_serreAux_F
statement:
lemma diagHom_serreAux_F (c : I → kˣ) (q x : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : I) :
    diagHom R v c (serreAux q x m (F R v a) (F R v b)) =
      (((c a : k) ^ m)⁻¹ * (c b : k)⁻¹) • serreAux q x m (F R v a) (F R v b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show diagHom R v c (serreAux q x m (F R v a) (F R v b)) =
      serreAux q x m ((c a : k)⁻¹ • F R v a) ((c b : k)⁻¹ • F R v b) by
    simp [serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow], serreAux_smul_smul', inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.units_zpow_negA
statement:
lemma units_zpow_negA (c : kˣ) {j l : I} (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    ((c ^ (-D.cartanMatrix j l) : kˣ) : k) = (c : k) ^ negA D j l
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hjl, neg_neg, zpow_natCast, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_comp_of_hasImages
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, diagHom_E, map_smul, H.map_E]
    by_cases hl : l = j
    · subst hl
      simp only [↓reduceIte, braidEi, map_neg, map_mul, diagHom_F, Kt, diagHom_K, smul_neg,
        smul_mul_assoc, reflChar_self, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    · simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte, braidEj, map_smul, diagHom_serreAux, smul_smul, reflChar,
        Units.val_mul, units_zpow_negA _ (Ne.symm hl)]
      congr 1
      ring
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, diagHom_F, map_smul, H.map_F]
    by_cases hl : l = j
    · subst hl
      simp only [↓reduceIte, braidFi, map_neg, map_mul, diagHom_E, diagHom_K, smul_neg,
        mul_smul_comm, reflChar_self, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, inv_inv]
    · simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte, braidFj, map_smul, diagHom_serreAux_F, smul_smul, reflChar,
        Units.val_mul, units_zpow_negA _ (Ne.symm hl)]
      congr 1
      rw [mul_inv]
      ring
  · simp [H.map_K]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.diagHom_symm_apply_of_hasImages
proof:
:= by
  apply T.injective
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (diagHom_comp_of_hasImages H (reflChar D j c)) (T.symm x)
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, reflChar_reflChar] at h
  have h2 : T (T.symm x) = x := T.apply_symm_apply x
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  calc T (diagHom R v c (T.symm x)) = diagHom R v (reflChar D j c) (T (T.symm x)) := h.symm
    _ = _ := by rw [h2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsSignPow.one
statement: lemma IsSignPow.one : IsSignPow v (1 : I → kˣ)
proof: := fun _ ↦ ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsSignPow.mul
statement:
lemma IsSignPow.mul [NeZero v] {c c' : I → kˣ} (h : IsSignPow v c) (h' : IsSignPow v c') :
    IsSignPow v (c * c')
proof:
:= fun l ↦ by
  obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := h l
  obtain ⟨e', m', he'⟩ := h' l
  refine ⟨e + e', m + m', ?_⟩
  rw [Pi.mul_apply, Units.val_mul, he, he', zpow_add₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero),
    zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsSignPow.zpow_apply
statement:
lemma IsSignPow.zpow_apply {c : I → kˣ} (h : IsSignPow v c) (l : I) (z : ℤ) :
    ∃ e m : ℤ, ((c l ^ z : kˣ) : k) = (-1) ^ e * v ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := h l
  exact ⟨e * z, m * z, by rw [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, he, mul_zpow, zpow_mul, zpow_mul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsSignPow.reflChar
statement:
lemma IsSignPow.reflChar [NeZero v] {c : I → kˣ} (h : IsSignPow v c) (j : I) :
    IsSignPow v (reflChar D j c)
proof:
:= fun l ↦ by
  obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := h l
  obtain ⟨e', m', he'⟩ := h.zpow_apply j (-D.cartanMatrix j l)
  refine ⟨e + e', m + m', ?_⟩
  rw [QuantumGroup.reflChar, Units.val_mul, he, he', zpow_add₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero),
    zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsSignPow.inv
statement: lemma IsSignPow.inv {c : I → kˣ} (h : IsSignPow v c) : IsSignPow v c⁻¹
proof:
:=
  fun l ↦ by
    obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := h.zpow_apply l (-1)
    exact ⟨e, m, by rw [Pi.inv_apply, ← zpow_neg_one, he]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_neg'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_K
statement:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_E_self
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_E_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    braidPrimeEquiv R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i)) =
      ((-1) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
        (K R v (n • ktilde R i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidPrimeEquiv_apply, chevalley_qDivPow_E, braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_self hv R,
    map_smul, map_mul, chevalley_K, chevalley_qDivPow_E, smul_neg, neg_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_F_self
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_F_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    braidPrimeEquiv R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i)) =
      ((-1) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i) * K R v (-(n • ktilde R i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidPrimeEquiv_apply, chevalley_qDivPow_F, braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_self hv R,
    map_smul, map_mul, chevalley_K, chevalley_qDivPow_F]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_E_ne
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_E_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :
    braidPrimeEquiv R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), ((-1 : k) ^ r * (v ^ D.d i) ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) r (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) *
          qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidPrimeEquiv_apply, chevalley_qDivPow_E, braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_ne hv R hji,
    braidFjDiv, map_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_smul, map_mul, chevalley_qDivPow_F]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_F_ne
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_qDivPow_F_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :

      ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), ((-1 : k) ^ r * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (F R v j) *
          qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) r (F R v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidPrimeEquiv_apply, chevalley_qDivPow_F, braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne hv R hji,
    braidEjDiv, map_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_smul, map_mul, chevalley_qDivPow_E]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_symm_qDivPow_E_self
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_symm_qDivPow_E_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) :

    chevalley_qDivPow_E]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_symm_qDivPow_F_self
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_symm_qDivPow_F_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) :

theorem braidPrimeEquiv_symm_qDivPow_E_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_symm_qDivPow_F_ne

theorem braidPrimeEquiv_symm_qDivPow_F_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isSignPow_chevalleyScalar_zpow
statement:
lemma isSignPow_chevalleyScalar_zpow (i : I) (c : I → ℤ) :
    IsSignPow v (fun j ↦ chevalleyScalar D v i ^ c j)
proof:
:= fun j ↦
  ⟨c j, D.d i * c j, by
    rw [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, chevalleyScalar, Units.val_mk0, neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_zpow,
      ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_eq_braidPrimeEquiv_diagHom
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_eq_braidPrimeEquiv_diagHom (i : I) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i x = braidPrimeEquiv R hv i (diagHom R v (braidSign D v i) x)
proof:
:= by
  have H := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have h3 : reflChar D i (chevalleyScalar D v) * (chevalleyScalar D v)⁻¹ =
      (braidSign D v i)⁻¹ := by
    funext l
    simp only [reflChar, braidSign, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.inv_apply, zpow_neg]
    rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
  have hD : ∀ (c c' : I → kˣ) (z : QuantumGroup R v),
      diagHom R v c (diagHom R v c' z) = diagHom R v (c * c') z := fun c c' z ↦ by
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, diagHom_comp_diagHom]
  
  have key : ∀ z, braidPrimeEquiv R hv i z =
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (diagHom R v (braidSign D v i)⁻¹ z) := by
    intro z
    have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun (chevalley_comp_comp_diagHom H)
      (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v)⁻¹ z)
    have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (diagHom_comp_of_hasImages H (chevalleyScalar D v))
      (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v)⁻¹ z)
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom] at h1 h2
    rw [hD, mul_inv_cancel, diagHom_one, AlgHom.id_apply] at h1
    rw [braidPrimeEquiv_apply, h1, h2, hD, h3]
  rw [key, hD, inv_mul_cancel, diagHom_one, AlgHom.id_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_eq_braidEquivOfNotRoot_diagHom
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_eq_braidEquivOfNotRoot_diagHom (i : I) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    braidPrimeEquiv R hv i x =
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (diagHom R v (braidSign D v i)⁻¹ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidEquivOfNotRoot_eq_braidPrimeEquiv_diagHom hv, ← AlgHom.comp_apply,
    diagHom_comp_diagHom, mul_inv_cancel, diagHom_one, AlgHom.id_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidPrimeEquiv_symm_eq_diagHom_symm
statement:
theorem braidPrimeEquiv_symm_eq_diagHom_symm (i : I) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    (braidPrimeEquiv R hv i).symm x =
      diagHom R v (braidSign D v i) ((braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, braidPrimeEquiv_eq_braidEquivOfNotRoot_diagHom hv,
    ← AlgHom.comp_apply, diagHom_comp_diagHom, inv_mul_cancel, diagHom_one, AlgHom.id_apply,
    AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_diagHom_list_braid
statement:
theorem exists_diagHom_list_braid (ω : List I) {c : I → kˣ} (hc : IsSignPow v c) :
    ∃ c' : I → kˣ, IsSignPow v c' ∧ ∀ x, diagHom R v c ((ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod x)
      = (ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (diagHom R v c' x)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing c with
  | nil => exact ⟨c, hc, fun x ↦ rfl⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨c', hc', h⟩ := ih (hc.reflChar i)
    refine ⟨c', hc', fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    have H := diagHom_comp_of_hasImages (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i) c
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [← h]
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun H _ :)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_diagHom_list_braid_symm
statement:
theorem exists_diagHom_list_braid_symm (ω : List I) {c : I → kˣ} (hc : IsSignPow v c) :
    ∃ c' : I → kˣ, IsSignPow v c' ∧
      ∀ x, diagHom R v c ((ω.map fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv j).symm).prod x) =
        (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv j).symm).prod (diagHom R v c' x)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing c with
  | nil => exact ⟨c, hc, fun x ↦ rfl⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨c', hc', h⟩ := ih (hc.reflChar i)
    refine ⟨c', hc', fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [diagHom_symm_apply_of_hasImages (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i), h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_list_braidPrime_eq
statement:
theorem exists_list_braidPrime_eq (ω : List I) :
    ∃ c : I → kˣ, IsSignPow v c ∧ ∀ x, (ω.map (braidPrimeEquiv R hv)).prod x =
      (ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (diagHom R v c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, IsSignPow.one, fun x ↦ by simp [diagHom_one]⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨c', hc', h'⟩ := exists_diagHom_list_braid (R := R) hv ω
      (isSignPow_chevalleyScalar_zpow (D := D) i (D.cartanMatrix i)).inv
    refine ⟨c' * c, hc'.mul hc, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [h, braidPrimeEquiv_eq_braidEquivOfNotRoot_diagHom hv,
      show braidSign D v i = fun j ↦ chevalleyScalar D v i ^ D.cartanMatrix i j from rfl, h',
      ← AlgHom.comp_apply (diagHom R v c'), diagHom_comp_diagHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_list_braidPrime_symm_eq
statement:
theorem exists_list_braidPrime_symm_eq (ω : List I) :
    ∃ c : I → kˣ, IsSignPow v c ∧ ∀ x, (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidPrimeEquiv R hv j).symm).prod x =
      (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv j).symm).prod (diagHom R v c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, IsSignPow.one, fun x ↦ by simp [diagHom_one]⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨c', hc', h'⟩ := exists_diagHom_list_braid_symm (R := R) hv (i :: ω)
      (isSignPow_chevalleyScalar_zpow (D := D) i (D.cartanMatrix i))
    refine ⟨c' * c, hc'.mul hc, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    have h'' := h' (diagHom R v c x)
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply] at h'' ⊢
    rw [h, braidPrimeEquiv_symm_eq_diagHom_symm hv,
      show braidSign D v i = fun j ↦ chevalleyScalar D v i ^ D.cartanMatrix i j from rfl, h'',
      ← AlgHom.comp_apply (diagHom R v c'), diagHom_comp_diagHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_list_braidPrime_qDivPow_E
statement:
theorem exists_list_braidPrime_qDivPow_E (ω : List I) (i : I) :
    ∃ e m : ℤ, ∀ t : ℕ, (ω.map (braidPrimeEquiv R hv)).prod (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) t (E R v i)) =
      (((-1) ^ e * v ^ m) ^ t) •
        (ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) t (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_list_braidPrime_eq (R := R) hv ω
  obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := hc i
  exact ⟨e, m, fun t ↦ by rw [h, diagHom_qDivPow_E, map_smul, he]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_list_braidPrime_symm_qDivPow_E
statement:
theorem exists_list_braidPrime_symm_qDivPow_E (ω : List I) (i : I) :
    ∃ e m : ℤ, ∀ t : ℕ,
      (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidPrimeEquiv R hv j).symm).prod (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) t (E R v i)) =
        (((-1) ^ e * v ^ m) ^ t) • (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv j).symm).prod
          (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) t (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_list_braidPrime_symm_eq (R := R) hv ω
  obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := hc i
  exact ⟨e, m, fun t ↦ by rw [h, diagHom_qDivPow_E, map_smul, he]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.map_T_of_eq
statement:
theorem map_T_of_eq {q q' : k} {M M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [AddCommGroup M']
    [Module k M'] (V : IntegrableSl2 q M) (V' : IntegrableSl2 q' M') (hq : q = q')
    (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (hE : ∀ m, f (V.E m) = V'.E (f m)) (hF : ∀ m, f (V.F m) = V'.F (f m))
    (hwt : ∀ n, ∀ m ∈ V.wt n, f m ∈ V'.wt n) {t t' : k} (ht : t = t') (m : M) :
    f (V.T t m) = V'.T t' (f m)
proof:
:= by
  subst hq ht
  exact V.map_T V' f hE hF hwt t m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp
proof:
:= by
  have := nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace hv hM l t hm
  convert this using 2
  ext μ
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul,
    AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_nodeWt_of_comp
statement:
lemma mem_nodeWt_of_comp {a b : I} (Wm : Module.End k M) (φ : Y →+ Y)
    (hW : ∀ Λ, ∀ m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ, Wm m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ.comp φ))
    (hφ : φ (R.coroot b) = R.coroot a) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ nodeWt R v M a n) :
    Wm m ∈ nodeWt R v M b n
proof:
:= by
  refine nodeWt_induction (P := fun m ↦ Wm m ∈ nodeWt R v M b n) hm (by simp)
    (fun x y hx hy ↦ by rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy) fun Λ hΛ x hx ↦ ?_
  have := mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := b) (hW Λ x hx)
  rwa [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hφ, hΛ] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_conj
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_conj {a b : I} (Wm : Module.End k M)
    (W : QuantumGroup R v →ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R v) (hW : ∀ (u : QuantumGroup R v) m,
      Wm (u • m) = W u • Wm m) (hE : W (E R v b) = E R v a) (hF : W (F R v b) = F R v a)
    (hwt : ∀ n, ∀ m ∈ nodeWt R v M b n, Wm m ∈ nodeWt R v M a n) (hd : D.d b = D.d a)
    (m : M) :
    Wm ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM b).T (v ^ D.d b) m) =
      (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM a).T (v ^ D.d a) (Wm m)
proof:
:=
  IntegrableSl2.map_T_of_eq _ _ (by rw [hd]) Wm
    (fun m ↦ by change Wm (E R v b • m) = E R v a • Wm m; rw [hW, hE])
    (fun m ↦ by change Wm (F R v b • m) = F R v a • Wm m; rw [hW, hF])
    hwt (by rw [hd]) m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_comm
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_comm (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) (m : M) :
    nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j m) =
      nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i m)
proof:
:= by
  have h0' : D.cartanMatrix j i = 0 := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).1 h0
  refine (nodeSl2_T_conj hv hM (nodeT R v M hv hM j) Tj
    (fun u m ↦ nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hj u m) ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl m).symm
  · rw [Hj.map_E, ite_eq_right hij, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0']
  · rw [Hj.map_F, ite_eq_right hij, braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0']
  · intro n m hm
    refine mem_nodeWt_of_comp (nodeT R v M hv hM j) (reflY R j)
      (fun Λ m hm ↦ nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM j _ hm) ?_ hm
    simp [reflY_apply, R.root_coroot, h0]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_braid_three
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_braid_three (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (m : M) :
    nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i m)) =
      nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j m))
proof:
:= by
  have hqi := (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv i).sub_ne
  refine nodeSl2_T_conj hv hM (nodeT R v M hv hM i * nodeT R v M hv hM j) (Ti.comp Tj)
    (fun u m ↦ ?_) (Hi.three_double_E Hj hij h h' hqi) (Hi.three_double_F Hj hij h h' hqi) ?_
    (D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h') m
  · simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply]
    rw [nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hj, nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hi]
  · intro n m hm
    refine mem_nodeWt_of_comp _ ((reflY R j).comp (reflY R i)) (fun Λ m hm ↦ ?_) ?_ hm
    · exact nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM i _
        (nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM j _ hm)
    · simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, R.root_coroot, h, h',
        D.cartanMatrix_self]
      module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_braid_four
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_braid_four (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (m : M) :
    nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j m))) =
      nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i
        (nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i m)))
proof:
:= by
  have hS (l : I) := braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv l
  have hq (l : I) := (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv l).sub_ne
  have hg (l : I) := braidGeneric_of_braidSerreGeneric (hq l) (hS l)
  have hT (l : I) := transformedSerre_of_braidSerreGeneric (R := R) (hq l) (hS l)
  have hsi := sum_ne_zero_of_qFactorial_three (pow_ne_zero (D.d i) (NeZero.ne v))
    (LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv i 3)
  have ei := (braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages (hg i) (hT i)).unique Hi
  have ej := (braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages (hg j) (hT j)).unique Hj
  refine (nodeSl2_T_conj hv hM (nodeT R v M hv hM j * nodeT R v M hv hM i *
    nodeT R v M hv hM j) (Tj.comp (Ti.comp Tj)) (fun u m ↦ ?_) ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl m).symm
  · simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply]
    rw [nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hj, nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hi, nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hj]
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, ← ei, ← ej]
    exact braidHom_double_triple_Ei (hg i) (hT i) (hg j) (hT j) hij h h' hsi
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, ← ei, ← ej]
    exact braidHom_double_triple_Fi (hg i) (hT i) (hg j) (hT j) hij h h' hsi
  · intro n m hm
    refine mem_nodeWt_of_comp _ (((reflY R j).comp (reflY R i)).comp (reflY R j))
      (fun Λ m hm ↦ ?_) ?_ hm
    · exact nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM j _ (nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM i _
        (nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM j _ hm))
    · simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, R.root_coroot, h, h',
        D.cartanMatrix_self]
      module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_braid_six
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_braid_six (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (m : M) :
    nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j
      (nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j m))))) =
      nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i (nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i
        (nodeT R v M hv hM j (nodeT R v M hv hM i m)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hq := (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv i).sub_ne
  have h3 := LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) (NeZero.ne v) hv i 3
  refine (nodeSl2_T_conj hv hM (nodeT R v M hv hM j * nodeT R v M hv hM i *
    nodeT R v M hv hM j * nodeT R v M hv hM i * nodeT R v M hv hM j)
    (Tj.comp (Ti.comp (Tj.comp (Ti.comp Tj)))) (fun u m ↦ ?_) ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl m).symm
  · simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply]
    rw [nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hj, nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hi, nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hj,
      nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hi, nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM Hj]
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply]
    exact tripleSix_Ei Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply]
    exact tripleSix_Fi Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
  · intro n m hm
    refine mem_nodeWt_of_comp _ (((((reflY R j).comp (reflY R i)).comp (reflY R j)).comp
      (reflY R i)).comp (reflY R j)) (fun Λ m hm ↦ ?_) ?_ hm
    · exact nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM j _ (nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM i _
        (nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM j _ (nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM i _
          (nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace_comp hv hM j _ hm))))
    · simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, R.root_coroot, h, h',
        D.cartanMatrix_self]
      module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.symmTerm_apply
statement:
lemma symmTerm_apply (t : k) (n : ℤ) (a c : ℕ) (m : M) :
    V.symmTerm t n a c m = if 0 ≤ n + a + c then
      ((-1) ^ (n + a + c).toNat * t ^ (n + a + c).toNat * t⁻¹ ^ (a * c)) •
        V.dE a (V.dF (n + a + c).toNat (V.dE c m)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmTerm
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
lemma pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le {f : Module.End k M} {x : M} {N b : ℕ} (h : (f ^ N) x = 0)
    (hb : N ≤ b) : (f ^ b) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hb, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, h, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dE_eq_zero_of_le
statement: lemma dE_eq_zero_of_le {x : M} {N b : ℕ} (h : (V.E ^ N) x = 0) (hb : N ≤ b) : V.dE b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dE_apply, pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le h hb, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_le
statement: lemma dF_eq_zero_of_le {x : M} {N b : ℕ} (h : (V.F ^ N) x = 0) (hb : N ≤ b) : V.dF b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dF_apply, pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le h hb, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.hasFiniteSupport_symmTerm
statement:
lemma hasFiniteSupport_symmTerm (t : k) (n : ℤ) (m : M) :
    (Function.support fun ac : ℕ × ℕ ↦ V.symmTerm t n ac.1 ac.2 m).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := V.exists_E_pow_eq_zero m
  choose B hB using fun c : ℕ ↦ V.exists_F_pow_eq_zero ((V.E ^ c) m)
  set A := (∑ c ∈ range N, B c) + n.natAbs
  refine (Set.Finite.subset (range A ×ˢ range N).finite_toSet) ?_
  intro ⟨a, c⟩ hac
  by_contra hnot
  apply hac
  simp only [coe_product, coe_range, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Iio, not_and_or, not_lt] at hnot
  simp only [symmTerm_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  swap
  · rfl
  rcases hnot with ha | hc
  · rcases le_or_gt N c with hc | hc
    · rw [dE_eq_zero_of_le hN hc, map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
    have hBc : B c ≤ ∑ c ∈ range N, B c := single_le_sum (by simp) (mem_range.2 hc)
    have hb : B c ≤ (n + a + c).toNat := by omega
    rw [dE_apply c m, map_smul, dF_eq_zero_of_le (hB c) hb, smul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
  · rw [dE_eq_zero_of_le hN hc, map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.isInternal
statement: lemma isInternal : DirectSum.IsInternal V.wt
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top V.iSupIndep_wt V.iSup_wt

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.decompose_of_mem
statement:
lemma decompose_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) :
    V.decompose m = DirectSum.of (fun n ↦ V.wt n) n ⟨m, hm⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [decompose, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact (DirectSum.coeLinearMap_of (A := V.wt) n ⟨m, hm⟩).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_of_mem
statement: lemma T_of_mem (t : k) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) : V.T t m = V.symmWt t n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [T, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, decompose_of_mem V hm,
    ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of k, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_of_mem'
statement:
lemma T_of_mem' (t : k) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) :
    V.T t m = ∑ᶠ ac : ℕ × ℕ, V.symmTerm t n ac.1 ac.2 m
proof:
:=
  V.T_of_mem t hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.ext_wt
statement:
lemma ext_wt {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N] {f g : M →ₗ[k] N}
    (h : ∀ n, ∀ m ∈ V.wt n, f m = g m) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have : ⊤ ≤ LinearMap.eqLocus f g := V.iSup_wt ▸ iSup_le fun n m hm ↦ h n m hm
  ext m
  exact this Submodule.mem_top

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_mem
statement: theorem T_mem (t : k) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) : V.T t m ∈ V.wt (-n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_of_mem' V t hm, finsum_eq_sum _ (V.hasFiniteSupport_symmTerm t n m)]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun ⟨a, c⟩ _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [symmTerm_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    have hb : (((n + a + c).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = n + a + c := Int.toNat_of_nonneg h
    have := dE_mem (dF_mem (dE_mem hm c) (n + a + c).toNat) a
    rwa [hb, show n + 2 * (c : ℤ) - 2 * (n + a + c) + 2 * a = -n by ring] at this
  · exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.map_T
statement:
theorem map_T {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module k M'] (V' : IntegrableSl2 q M')
    (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (hE : ∀ m, f (V.E m) = V'.E (f m)) (hF : ∀ m, f (V.F m) = V'.F (f m))
    (hwt : ∀ n, ∀ m ∈ V.wt n, f m ∈ V'.wt n) (t : k) (m : M) :
    f (V.T t m) = V'.T t (f m)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ (g : Module.End k M) (g' : Module.End k M'), (∀ m, f (g m) = g' (f m)) →
      ∀ (a : ℕ) m, f ((g ^ a) m) = (g' ^ a) (f m) := by
    intro g g' hg a
    induction a with
    | zero => simp
    | succ a ih => intro m; rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply,
        Module.End.mul_apply, hg, ih]
  have hdE : ∀ a m, f (V.dE a m) = V'.dE a (f m) := fun a m ↦ by
    rw [dE_apply, dE_apply, map_smul, hpow _ _ hE]
  have hdF : ∀ a m, f (V.dF a m) = V'.dF a (f m) := fun a m ↦ by
    rw [dF_apply, dF_apply, map_smul, hpow _ _ hF]
  have key : ∀ n, ∀ m ∈ V.wt n, f (V.T t m) = V'.T t (f m) := by
    intro n m hm
    rw [T_of_mem' V t hm, T_of_mem' V' t (hwt n m hm),
      map_finsum f (V.hasFiniteSupport_symmTerm t n m)]
    congr 1
    ext ⟨a, c⟩
    simp only [symmTerm_apply]
    split_ifs
    · rw [map_smul, hdE, hdF, hdE]
    · exact map_zero f
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (V.ext_wt (f := f ∘ₗ V.T t) (g := V'.T t ∘ₗ f) key) m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_flip
statement: lemma flip_flip : V.flip.flip = V
proof:
:= by
  cases V
  simp only [flip, neg_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_dF
statement: lemma dF_dF (a b : ℕ) (m : M) : V.dF a (V.dF b m) = qBinomial q (a + b) a • V.dF (a + b) m
proof:
:= by
  have h := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (show a ≤ a + b by omega)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  have ha := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq a
  have hb := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq b
  have hab := qBinomial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (show a ≤ a + b by omega)
  rw [dF_apply, dF_apply, dF_apply, map_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, smul_smul,
    smul_smul, ← h]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.wt_induction
statement:
lemma wt_induction {n : ℤ} {P : M → Prop} (h0 : P 0) (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hsmul : ∀ (c : k) x, P x → P (c • x))
    (hgen : ∀ (p j : ℕ) (η : M), j ≤ p → n = p - 2 * j → η ∈ V.wt p → V.E η = 0 →
      P (V.dF j η)) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) : P m
proof:
:= by
  have h := mem_strings (V := V) hq0 hq hm
  rw [strings] at h
  clear hm
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, η, hη, hE, rfl⟩ := hx
    rcases lt_or_ge (n + 2 * j) 0 with hneg | hnn
    · rw [eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg hq0 hq hη hE hneg, map_zero]
      exact h0
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) = n + 2 * j := ⟨_, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn⟩
    rw [← hp] at hη
    by_cases hjp : j ≤ p
    · exact hgen p j η hjp (by omega) hη hE
    · rw [dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (by omega)]
      exact h0
  | zero => exact h0
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact hadd x y hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => exact hsmul c x hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.eq_on_wt
proof:
:=
  wt_induction (P := fun m ↦ f m = g m) hq0 hq (by simp)
    (fun x y hx hy ↦ by simp [hx, hy]) (fun c x hx ↦ by simp [hx]) hgen hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
lemma dE_dF_eq_zero_of_lt {p : ℕ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt p) (hE : V.E η = 0) {j c : ℕ}
    (hjp : j ≤ p) (hjc : j < c) : V.dE c (V.dF j η) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine dE_eq_zero_of_le (N := j + 1) ?_ hjc
  have h := dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (le_refl j) hjp
  rw [Nat.sub_self, dF_zero, dE_apply] at h
  have hf := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq j
  have h' : (V.E ^ j) (V.dF j η) = (qFactorial q j * qBinomial q (p - j + j) j) • η := by
    rw [mul_smul, ← h, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hf, one_smul]
  rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, h', map_smul, hE, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_flip_dF
statement:
lemma dF_eq_flip_dF {p : ℕ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt p) (hE : V.E η = 0) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ p) :
    V.dF i η = V.flip.dF (p - i) (V.dF p η)
proof:
:= by
  rw [flip_dF, dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (Nat.sub_le p i) le_rfl,
    show p - p + (p - i) = p - i by omega, qBinomial_self, one_smul, Nat.sub_sub_self hi]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_primitive
statement:
lemma flip_primitive {p : ℕ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt p) (hE : V.E η = 0) :
    V.dF p η ∈ V.flip.wt p ∧ V.flip.E (V.dF p η) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have := dF_mem hη p
    rw [flip_wt, show -(p : ℤ) = p - 2 * p by ring]
    exact this
  · rw [flip_E, F_dF hq0 hq, dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (by push_cast; omega),
      smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.sum_symm_coeff
statement:
lemma sum_symm_coeff {t : k} (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : ∀ n j, qBinomial t n j = qBinomial q n j)
    (h j : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ range (j + 1), ∑ c ∈ range (j + 1), (-t) ^ (h + a + c) * t⁻¹ ^ (a * c) *
      (qBinomial q (h + c) c * qBinomial q (h + a) (j - c) * qBinomial q j a) =
      (-t) ^ h * (-t ^ (h + 1)) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  have inner : ∀ a ∈ range (j + 1), ∑ c ∈ range (j + 1), (-t) ^ (h + a + c) * t⁻¹ ^ (a * c) *
      (qBinomial q (h + c) c * qBinomial q (h + a) (j - c) * qBinomial q j a) =
      qBinomial q j a * (-t) ^ (h + a) * ∑ c ∈ range (j + 1),
        (-1) ^ c * (t * t⁻¹ ^ a) ^ c * qBinomial t (h + c) c * qBinomial t (h + a) (j - c) := by
    intro a _
    rw [mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun c _ ↦ ?_
    rw [ht, ht, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, pow_add, neg_pow t c]
    ring
  rw [sum_congr rfl inner, sum_eq_single 0]
  · rw [qBinomial_zero_right, pow_zero, mul_one, add_zero, one_mul]
    rw [sum_qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_zero ht0 h j]
  · intro a ha ha0
    rw [sum_qBinomial_mul_qBinomial_eq_zero ht0 h (by omega)
      (by simp only [mem_range] at ha; omega), mul_zero]
  · intro h0
    simp at h0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_dF_of_primitive
statement:
theorem T_dF_of_primitive {t : k} (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : ∀ n j, qBinomial t n j = qBinomial q n j)
    {p : ℕ} {η : M} (hη : η ∈ V.wt p) (hE : V.E η = 0) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ p) :
    V.T t (V.dF j η) = ((-1) ^ (p - j) * t ^ ((p - j) * (j + 1))) • V.dF (p - j) η
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ : ∃ h, p = h + j := ⟨p - j, by omega⟩
  rw [show h + j - j = h by omega]
  set n : ℤ := h - j with hn
  have hm : V.dF j η ∈ V.wt n := by
    have := dF_mem hη j
    rwa [show ((h + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * j = n by push_cast; ring] at this
  
  have hterm : ∀ a ∈ range (j + 1), ∀ c ∈ range (j + 1),
      (-t) ^ j • V.symmTerm t n a c (V.dF j η) = ((-t) ^ (h + a + c) * t⁻¹ ^ (a * c) *
        (qBinomial q (h + c) c * qBinomial q (h + a) (j - c) * qBinomial q j a)) •
          V.dF h η := by
    intro a ha c hc
    simp only [mem_range] at ha hc
    rw [symmTerm_apply]
    split_ifs with hb
    · obtain ⟨b, hb'⟩ : ∃ b : ℕ, (b : ℤ) = n + a + c := ⟨_, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hb⟩
      rw [← hb', Int.toNat_natCast]
      rw [dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (show c ≤ j by omega) (by omega), map_smul,
        dF_dF hq0 hq, map_smul, map_smul, show b + (j - c) = h + a by omega,
        dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (show a ≤ h + a by omega) (by omega),
        show h + j - (h + a) + a = j by omega, show h + a - a = h by omega,
        show h + j - j + c = h + c by omega]
      simp only [smul_smul]
      congr 1
      have hbsymm : qBinomial q (h + a) b = qBinomial q (h + a) (j - c) := by
        rw [show b = h + a - (j - c) by omega, qBinomial_symm q (by omega)]
      rw [hbsymm, show h + a + c = b + j by omega, pow_add, neg_pow t b]
      ring
    · rw [smul_zero, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q (show h + a < j - c by omega), mul_zero,
        zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  
  have hsupp : (Function.support fun ac : ℕ × ℕ ↦ V.symmTerm t n ac.1 ac.2 (V.dF j η)) ⊆
      ↑(range (j + 1) ×ˢ range (j + 1)) := by
    intro ⟨a, c⟩ hac
    by_contra hnot
    apply hac
    simp only [coe_product, coe_range, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Iio, not_and_or, not_lt] at hnot
    simp only [symmTerm_apply]
    split_ifs with hb
    swap
    · rfl
    rcases le_or_gt (j + 1) c with hc | hc
    · rw [dE_dF_eq_zero_of_lt hq0 hq hη hE (by omega) (by omega), map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
    have ha : j + 1 ≤ a := by omega
    rw [dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (show c ≤ j by omega) (by omega), map_smul, dF_dF hq0 hq,
      dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (by push_cast; omega), smul_zero, smul_zero,
      map_zero, smul_zero]
  have hsum : (-t) ^ j • V.T t (V.dF j η) = ((-t) ^ h * (-t ^ (h + 1)) ^ j) • V.dF h η := by
    rw [T_of_mem' V t hm, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsupp, smul_sum, sum_product,
      ← sum_symm_coeff ht0 ht h j, sum_smul]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun a ha ↦ ?_
    rw [sum_smul]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun c hc ↦ hterm a ha c hc
  have hne : (-t) ^ j ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.2 ht0)
  apply smul_right_injective M hne
  simp only
  rw [hsum, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [neg_pow t h, neg_pow t j, neg_pow (t ^ (h + 1)) j]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.qBinomial_inv_eq
statement: lemma qBinomial_inv_eq (n j : ℕ) : qBinomial t⁻¹ n j = qBinomial q n j
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomial_inv, ht]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.flip_T_inv_T
statement: theorem flip_T_inv_T (m : M) : V.flip.T t⁻¹ (V.T t m) = m
proof:
:= by
  have ht' := qBinomial_inv_eq ht
  have key := V.ext_wt (f := V.flip.T t⁻¹ ∘ₗ V.T t) (g := LinearMap.id) fun n m hm ↦
    eq_on_wt hq0 hq (V.flip.T t⁻¹ ∘ₗ V.T t) LinearMap.id (fun p j η hj _ hη hE ↦ by
      obtain ⟨hη', hE'⟩ := flip_primitive hq0 hq hη hE
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
      rw [T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq ht0 ht hη hE hj, map_smul,
        dF_eq_flip_dF hq0 hq hη hE (Nat.sub_le p j), Nat.sub_sub_self hj,
        T_dF_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hq (inv_ne_zero ht0) ht' hη' hE' hj,
        ← dF_eq_flip_dF hq0 hq hη hE hj, smul_smul]
      conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul k (V.dF j η)]
      congr 1
      rw [inv_pow, ← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm _ _ ((-1) ^ (p - j)), ← pow_add,
        ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ ht0)])
      hm
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_flip_T_inv
statement: theorem T_flip_T_inv (m : M) : V.T t (V.flip.T t⁻¹ m) = m
proof:
:= by
  have := flip_T_inv_T (V := V.flip) hq0 hq (inv_ne_zero ht0) (qBinomial_inv_eq ht) m
  rwa [flip_flip, inv_inv] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.symmEquiv_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma symmEquiv_apply (m : M) : V.symmEquiv hq0 hq ht0 ht m = V.T t m

statement:
@[simp] lemma symmEquiv_symm_apply (m : M) :
