name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_eq_zpow_smul_flip_T
statement:
theorem T_eq_zpow_smul_flip_T {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) :
    V.T t m = (-t) ^ n • V.flip.T t m
proof:
:=
  eq_on_wt hq0 hq (V.T t) ((-t) ^ n • V.flip.T t) (fun p j η hj hn hη hE ↦ by
    obtain ⟨hη', hE'⟩ := flip_primitive hq0 hq hη hE
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq ht0 ht hη hE hj,
      dF_eq_flip_dF hq0 hq hη hE hj,
      T_dF_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hq ht0 ht hη' hE' (Nat.sub_le p j),
      Nat.sub_sub_self hj, smul_smul]
    have e : V.flip.dF j (V.dF p η) = V.dF (p - j) η := by
      rw [dF_eq_flip_dF hq0 hq hη hE (Nat.sub_le p j), Nat.sub_sub_self hj]
    rw [e]
    congr 1
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ : ∃ h, p = h + j := ⟨p - j, by omega⟩
    rw [show h + j - j = h by omega, hn, show ((h + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * j = (h : ℤ) - (j : ℤ) by
      push_cast; ring, zpow_sub₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 ht0), zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    have hne : (-t) ^ j ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.2 ht0)
    field_simp
    rw [neg_pow t, neg_pow t]
    ring) hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_E
statement:
theorem T_E {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) :
    V.T t (V.E m) = -(t ^ (-n)) • V.F (V.T t m)
proof:
:=
  eq_on_wt hq0 hq (V.T t ∘ₗ V.E) (-(t ^ (-n)) • (V.F ∘ₗ V.T t)) (fun p j η hj hn hη hE ↦ by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    rcases j with _ | j
    · rw [T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq ht0 ht hη hE hj, Nat.sub_zero, dF_zero, hE, map_zero,
        map_smul, F_dF hq0 hq, dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (by push_cast; omega),
        smul_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ : ∃ h, p = h + 1 + j := ⟨p - j - 1, by omega⟩
    have hηp : η ∈ V.wt ((h + 1 + j : ℕ) : ℤ) := hη
    rw [E_dF_succ_of_primitive hq0 hq hηp hE j, map_smul,
      T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq ht0 ht hη hE (j := j) (by omega),
      T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq ht0 ht hη hE hj,
      show h + 1 + j - j = h + 1 by omega, show h + 1 + j - (j + 1) = h by omega]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rw [F_dF hq0 hq]
    simp only [smul_smul]
    rw [show ((h + 1 + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - j = ((h + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
      qIntZ_natCast (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq)]
    congr 1
    rw [hn, show -(((h + 1 + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (h : ℕ) by
      push_cast; ring, zpow_sub₀ ht0, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    have hne : t ^ h ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ ht0
    field_simp
    ring) hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.T_F
statement:
theorem T_F {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ V.wt n) :
    V.T t (V.F m) = -(t ^ (n - 2)) • V.E (V.T t m)
proof:
:=
  eq_on_wt hq0 hq (V.T t ∘ₗ V.F) (-(t ^ (n - 2)) • (V.E ∘ₗ V.T t)) (fun p j η hj hn hη hE ↦ by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    rw [F_dF hq0 hq, map_smul, T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq ht0 ht hη hE hj]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hj with rfl | hjp
    · rw [dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (by push_cast; omega), map_zero, smul_zero,
        Nat.sub_self, dF_zero, hE, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ : ∃ h, p = h + 1 + j := ⟨p - j - 1, by omega⟩
    have hηp : η ∈ V.wt ((h + 1 + j : ℕ) : ℤ) := hη
    rw [T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq ht0 ht hη hE (j := j + 1) (by omega),
      show h + 1 + j - j = h + 1 by omega, show h + 1 + j - (j + 1) = h by omega,
      E_dF_succ_of_primitive hq0 hq hηp hE h]
    simp only [smul_smul]
    rw [show ((h + 1 + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - h = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
      qIntZ_natCast (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq)]
    congr 1
    rw [hn, show ((h + 1 + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) - 2 = (h : ℕ) - ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by
      push_cast; ring, zpow_sub₀ ht0, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    have hne : t ^ (j + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ ht0
    field_simp
    ring) hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_wordProd
statement:
lemma mapHom_wordProd (φ : R.Hom R') (T : I → QuantumGroup R v ≃ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R v)
    (T' : I → QuantumGroup R' v ≃ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R' v)
    (H : ∀ l, HasBraidGeneratorImages l (T l).toAlgHom)
    (H' : ∀ l, HasBraidGeneratorImages l (T' l).toAlgHom) (w : List I) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    mapHom v φ ((w.map T).prod u) = (w.map T').prod (mapHom v φ u)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a w ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [← ih]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (mapHom_comp_of_hasBraidGeneratorImages φ (H a) (H' a)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.alternatingWord_apply_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem alternatingWord_apply_mem_adjoin {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra k A]
    (T : I → A ≃ₐ[k] A) (E : I → A) {i j l : I} {m : ℕ}
    (hpre : ∀ n < m, ((alternatingWord i j n).map T).prod (E i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E i, E j} ∧
      ((alternatingWord j i n).map T).prod (E j) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E i, E j})
    (hli : T i (E l) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E i, E l})
    (hlj : T j (E l) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E j, E l}) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ m) :
    ((alternatingWord i j n).map T).prod (E l) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E) ∧
      ((alternatingWord j i n).map T).prod (E l) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E)
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : ∀ a b : I, Algebra.adjoin k {E a, E b} ≤ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E) :=
    fun a b ↦ Algebra.adjoin_mono (by rintro _ (rfl | rfl) <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [alternatingWord, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, AlgEquiv.one_apply, and_self]
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨l, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (by omega)
    obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := hpre n (by omega)
    simp only [alternatingWord_succ, List.concat_eq_append, List.map_append, List.prod_append,
      List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    constructor
    · refine (Algebra.adjoin_le (S := (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E)).comap
        ((alternatingWord j i n).map T).prod.toAlgHom) ?_) hlj
      rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
      · exact hpair i j p2
      · exact h2
    · refine (Algebra.adjoin_le (S := (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E)).comap
        ((alternatingWord i j n).map T).prod.toAlgHom) ?_) hli
      rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
      · exact hpair i j p1
      · exact h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairRoot_mem
statement:
theorem pairRoot_mem {i l : I} (hil : i ≠ l)
    (hpair : D.cartanMatrix i l * D.cartanMatrix l i ≤ 3) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i l = 0 ∨ n < D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i l) :
    ((alternatingWord i l n).map fun i ↦ braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq i) (hS i)).prod
      (E R v i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v l}
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfGeneric_images (R := R) hq hS
  have h2 : ∀ {i l : I}, l ≠ i → D.cartanMatrix i l = -2 → qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2 ≠ 0 :=
    fun hli h ↦ by simpa [b2_negA h] using qFactorial_negA_ne hq hS hli
  have h3' : ∀ {i l : I}, l ≠ i → D.cartanMatrix i l = -3 → qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 3 ≠ 0 :=
    fun hli h ↦ by simpa [tripleSix_negA h] using qFactorial_negA_ne hq hS hli
  rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hil] at hn
  have hl := E_mem_pair_left (k := k) (R := R) (v := v) (i := i) (j := l)
  have hr := E_mem_pair_right (k := k) (R := R) (v := v) (i := i) (j := l)
  rcases cartan_pair_cases hil hpair with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ |
    ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ <;>
    simp only [h1, h1'] at hn <;> norm_num [Matrix.coxeterEntry] at hn <;>
    interval_cases n <;>
    simp only [alternatingWord, List.concat_eq_append, List.nil_append, List.cons_append,
      List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one,
      AlgEquiv.mul_apply, AlgEquiv.one_apply]
  all_goals first
    | exact hl
    | skip
  
  · rw [show (braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq l) (hS l)) (E R v i) = E R v i from
      a1a1_rootVector_two hil.symm h1' (HT l)]
    exact hl
  
  · exact (a2_words (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)).1
  · rw [show (braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq i) (hS i))
        ((braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq l) (hS l)) (E R v i)) = E R v l from
      (a2_words (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)).2]
    exact hr
  
  · exact (b2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h2 hil.symm h1)).1
  · exact (b2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h2 hil.symm h1)).2.1
  · convert hl using 1
    exact (b2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)
      (h2 hil.symm h1)).2.2
  
  · rw [Set.pair_comm]
    exact (b2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h2 hil h1')).1
  · rw [Set.pair_comm]
    exact (b2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h2 hil h1')).2.1
  · convert hl using 1
    exact (b2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l)
      (h2 hil h1')).2.2
  
  · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).1
  · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.1
  · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.2.1
  · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.2.2.1
  · convert hl using 1
    exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)
      (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.2.2.2
  
  · rw [Set.pair_comm]
    exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).1
  · rw [Set.pair_comm]
    exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).2.1
  · rw [Set.pair_comm]
    exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).2.2.1
  · rw [Set.pair_comm]
    exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).2.2.2.1
  · convert hl using 1
    exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l)
      (h3' hil h1')).2.2.2.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeT_surjective
statement: lemma nodeT_surjective (l : I) : Function.Surjective (nodeT R v M hv hM l)
proof:
:= fun m ↦
  ⟨(nodeSl2 R v M hv hM l).flip.T (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ m,
    IntegrableSl2.T_flip_T_inv (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) (pow_d_ne_one hv l)
      (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) m⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordT_surjective
statement:
lemma wordT_surjective (w : List I) :
    Function.Surjective ((w.map (nodeT R v M hv hM)).prod)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact Function.surjective_id
  | cons a w ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Module.End.coe_mul]
    exact (nodeT_surjective hv hM a).comp ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordT_smul
statement:
lemma wordT_smul (T : I → QuantumGroup R v ≃ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R v)
    (H : ∀ l, HasBraidGeneratorImages l (T l).toAlgHom) (w : List I) (u : QuantumGroup R v)
    (m : M) : (w.map (nodeT R v M hv hM)).prod (u • m) =
      (w.map T).prod u • (w.map (nodeT R v M hv hM)).prod m
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a w ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Module.End.mul_apply, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [ih]
    exact nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM (H a) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages
statement:
lemma braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages (R : D.RootDatum Y) (l : I) :
    HasBraidGeneratorImages l (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv l).toAlgHom
proof:
:=
  braidEquivOfGeneric_images (R := R)
    (fun l ↦ (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv l).sub_ne)
    (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv) l

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordT_braid
statement:
theorem wordT_braid {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfin : D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) :
    ((alternatingWord i j (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map (nodeT R v M hv hM)).prod =
      ((alternatingWord j i (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
        (nodeT R v M hv hM)).prod
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R
  rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij]
  rcases cartan_pair_cases hij hfin with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ |
    ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ <;>
    simp only [h1, h1'] <;> norm_num [Matrix.coxeterEntry] <;>
    simp only [alternatingWord, List.concat_eq_append, List.nil_append, List.cons_append,
      List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one] <;>
    ext m <;> simp only [Module.End.mul_apply]
  · exact nodeSl2_T_comm hv hM (HT j) hij h1 m
  · exact (nodeSl2_T_braid_three hv hM (HT i) (HT j) hij h1 h1' m).symm
  · exact nodeSl2_T_braid_four hv hM (HT i) (HT j) hij h1 h1' m
  · exact (nodeSl2_T_braid_four hv hM (HT j) (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 m).symm
  · exact nodeSl2_T_braid_six hv hM (HT i) (HT j) hij h1 h1' m
  · exact (nodeSl2_T_braid_six hv hM (HT j) (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 m).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_plusHom_eq
statement:
lemma exists_plusHom_eq {z : QuantumGroup R v} (hz : z ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    ∃ x, plusHom R v x = z
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ≤ (plusHom R v).range :=
    Algebra.adjoin_le (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨LusztigF.θ k i, plusHom_θ R v i⟩)
  exact this hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coxeterMatrix_comm
statement:
lemma coxeterMatrix_comm (i j : I) :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j
proof:
:=
  D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.symmetric j i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordProd_E_outer
statement:
theorem wordProd_E_outer (R : D.RootDatum Y) {i j l : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfin : D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) (hli : l ≠ i) (hlj : l ≠ j) :
    ((alternatingWord i j (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (E R v l) =
    ((alternatingWord j i (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (E R v l)
proof:
:= by
  set m := D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j with hm
  set R' := R.freeCoroot
  have HT' := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R'
  have key : ((alternatingWord i j m).map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R' hv)).prod (E R' v l) =
      ((alternatingWord j i m).map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R' hv)).prod (E R' v l) := by
    have hq := fun l ↦ (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv l).sub_ne
    have hS := braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv
    have hfin' : D.cartanMatrix j i * D.cartanMatrix i j ≤ 3 := by rwa [mul_comm]
    have hpre : ∀ n < m, ((alternatingWord i j n).map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R' hv)).prod
          (E R' v i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E R' v i, E R' v j} ∧
        ((alternatingWord j i n).map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R' hv)).prod (E R' v j) ∈
          Algebra.adjoin k {E R' v i, E R' v j} := fun n hn ↦ by
      refine ⟨pairRoot_mem (R := R') hq hS hij hfin n (Or.inr hn), ?_⟩
      have := pairRoot_mem (R := R') hq hS hij.symm hfin' n
        (Or.inr (by rwa [coxeterMatrix_comm]))
      rwa [Set.pair_comm] at this
    have hmem := alternatingWord_apply_mem_adjoin (braidEquivOfNotRoot R' hv) (E R' v) hpre
      (by rw [Set.pair_comm]; exact map_E_mem_pair (HT' i) hli)
      (by rw [Set.pair_comm]; exact map_E_mem_pair (HT' j) hlj) m le_rfl
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_plusHom_eq (sub_mem hmem.1 hmem.2)
    have h0 : plusHom R' v x = 0 := by
      refine plusHom_eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero hv R.exists_le_freeCoroot x fun Λ m0 ↦ ?_
      have hM := ChevalleyTwist.isIntegrable (FPowQuotient.isIntegrable (R := R') (v := v) Λ)
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ := wordT_surjective hv hM (alternatingWord i j m) m0
      rw [hx, sub_smul, ← wordT_smul hv hM _ HT' (alternatingWord i j m) (E R' v l) m',
        wordT_braid hv hM hij hfin,
        ← wordT_smul hv hM _ HT' (alternatingWord j i m) (E R' v l) m', sub_self]
    rw [h0, eq_comm, sub_eq_zero] at hx
    exact hx
  have e1 := mapHom_wordProd R.freeCorootHom (braidEquivOfNotRoot R' hv)
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) HT' (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R) (alternatingWord i j m)
    (E R' v l)
  have e2 := mapHom_wordProd R.freeCorootHom (braidEquivOfNotRoot R' hv)
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) HT' (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R) (alternatingWord j i m)
    (E R' v l)
  rw [mapHom_E] at e1 e2
  rw [← e1, ← e2, key]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_wordProd_diagHom
statement:
lemma chevalley_wordProd_diagHom (R : D.RootDatum Y) (w : List I) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    chevalley R v ((w.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod
      (chevalley R v (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v) u))) =
      diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v) ((w.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod u)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing u with
  | nil => exact DFunLike.congr_fun (chevalley_comp_chevalley R v) _
  | cons a w ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    have hw : (w.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod
        (chevalley R v (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v) u)) =
        chevalley R v (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v)
          ((w.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod u)) := by
      rw [← ih u]
      exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (chevalley_comp_chevalley R v) _).symm
    rw [hw]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun
      (chevalley_comp_comp_diagHom (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R a)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordProd_F_outer
statement:
theorem wordProd_F_outer (R : D.RootDatum Y) {i j l : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfin : D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) (hli : l ≠ i) (hlj : l ≠ j) :
    ((alternatingWord i j (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (F R v l) =
    ((alternatingWord j i (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (F R v l)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ w : List I, (chevalleyScalar D v l : k) •
      chevalley R v ((w.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (F R v l)) =
      diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v) ((w.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (E R v l)) := by
    intro w
    rw [← chevalley_wordProd_diagHom hv R w (E R v l), diagHom_E, map_smul, chevalley_E,
      map_smul, map_smul]
  have h := congrArg (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v))
    (wordProd_E_outer hv R hij hfin hli hlj)
  rw [← key, ← key] at h
  have h' := smul_right_injective _ (Units.ne_zero (chevalleyScalar D v l)) h
  have := congrArg (chevalley R v) h'
  simpa only [← AlgHom.comp_apply, chevalley_comp_chevalley, AlgHom.id_apply] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algEquiv_eq_of_generators
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective (hom_ext hE hF hK)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordProd_pair
statement:
theorem wordProd_pair (R : D.RootDatum Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfin : D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) :
    (∀ l, (l = i ∨ l = j) →
      ((alternatingWord i j (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (E R v l) =
      ((alternatingWord j i (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (E R v l) ∧
      ((alternatingWord i j (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (F R v l) =
      ((alternatingWord j i (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (F R v l)) ∧
    ∀ μ, ((alternatingWord i j (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (K R v μ) =
      ((alternatingWord j i (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod (K R v μ)
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R
  have hq (l : I) := (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv l).sub_ne
  have hS := braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root (D := D) hv
  have hg (l : I) := braidGeneric_of_braidSerreGeneric (hq l) (hS l)
  have hT (l : I) := transformedSerre_of_braidSerreGeneric (R := R) (hq l) (hS l)
  have hs (l : I) := sum_ne_zero_of_qFactorial_three (pow_ne_zero (D.d l) (NeZero.ne v))
    (LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv l 3)
  have h3 (l : I) := LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) (NeZero.ne v) hv l 3
  have hK (l : I) (μ : Y) : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv l (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R l μ) :=
    (HT l).map_K μ
  rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij]
  rcases cartan_pair_cases hij hfin with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ |
    ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩
  · 
    have hc := HasBraidGeneratorImages.equiv_comm (HT i) (HT j) hij h1
    simp only [h1, h1', mul_zero, Int.toNat_zero, Matrix.coxeterEntry, alternatingWord,
      List.concat_eq_append, List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one]
    exact ⟨fun l _ ↦ ⟨by rw [hc], by rw [hc]⟩, fun μ ↦ by rw [hc]⟩
  all_goals
    simp only [h1, h1']; norm_num [Matrix.coxeterEntry]
    simp only [alternatingWord, List.concat_eq_append, List.nil_append, List.cons_append,
      List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
  · 
    have hqj : v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := hq j
    refine ⟨⟨⟨((HT i).three_Ei (HT j) hij h1 h1' (hq i)).symm,
      ((HT i).three_Fi (HT j) hij h1 h1' (hq i)).symm⟩,
      (HT j).three_Ei (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 hqj, (HT j).three_Fi (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 hqj⟩,
      fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [hK, reflY_braid_of_simply_laced_edge h1 h1']
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨⟨braidHom_double_four_Ei (hg i) (hT i) (hg j) (hT j) hij h1 h1' (hs i),
      braidHom_double_four_Fi (hg i) (hT i) (hg j) (hT j) hij h1 h1' (hs i)⟩,
      braidHom_double_four_Ej (hg i) (hT i) (hg j) (hT j) hij h1 h1',
      braidHom_double_four_Fj (hg i) (hT i) (hg j) (hT j) hij h1 h1'⟩, fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [hK, reflY_braid_of_double_edge h1 h1']
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨⟨(braidHom_double_four_Ej (hg j) (hT j) (hg i) (hT i) hij.symm h1' h1).symm,
      (braidHom_double_four_Fj (hg j) (hT j) (hg i) (hT i) hij.symm h1' h1).symm⟩,
      (braidHom_double_four_Ei (hg j) (hT j) (hg i) (hT i) hij.symm h1' h1 (hs j)).symm,
      (braidHom_double_four_Fi (hg j) (hT j) (hg i) (hT i) hij.symm h1' h1 (hs j)).symm⟩,
      fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [hK, reflY_braid_of_double_edge h1' h1]
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨⟨tripleSix_six_Ei (HT i) (HT j) hij h1 h1' (hq i) (h3 i),
      tripleSix_six_Fi (HT i) (HT j) hij h1 h1' (hq i) (h3 i)⟩,
      tripleSix_six_Ej (HT i) (HT j) hij h1 h1' (hq i) (h3 i),
      tripleSix_six_Fj (HT i) (HT j) hij h1 h1' (hq i) (h3 i)⟩, fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [hK, reflY_braid_six_of_triple_edge h1 h1']
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨⟨(tripleSix_six_Ej (HT j) (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 (hq j) (h3 j)).symm,
      (tripleSix_six_Fj (HT j) (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 (hq j) (h3 j)).symm⟩,
      (tripleSix_six_Ei (HT j) (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 (hq j) (h3 j)).symm,
      (tripleSix_six_Fi (HT j) (HT i) hij.symm h1' h1 (hq j) (h3 j)).symm⟩, fun μ ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [hK, reflY_braid_six_of_triple_edge h1' h1]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot
statement:
theorem isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij hm
  have hMij := Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne D.cartanMatrix hij
  have hfin : D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hm (by rw [hMij]; exact Matrix.coxeterEntry_of_four_le (by omega))
  change ((alternatingWord i j (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j)).map _).prod =
    ((alternatingWord j i (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i)).map _).prod
  rw [coxeterMatrix_comm i j]
  obtain ⟨hpair, hK⟩ := wordProd_pair hv R hij hfin
  refine algEquiv_eq_of_generators (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) hK
  · by_cases hl : l = i ∨ l = j
    · exact (hpair l hl).1
    · obtain ⟨hli, hlj⟩ := not_or.1 hl
      exact wordProd_E_outer hv R hij hfin hli hlj
  · by_cases hl : l = i ∨ l = j
    · exact (hpair l hl).2
    · obtain ⟨hli, hlj⟩ := not_or.1 hl
      exact wordProd_F_outer hv R hij hfin hli hlj

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidArtinHomOfNotRoot_artinGenerator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem braidArtinHomOfNotRoot_artinGenerator (i : I) :
    braidArtinHomOfNotRoot R hv (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.artinGenerator i) =
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i

:=
  CoxeterMatrix.artinLift_artinGenerator _ _ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_nodeWt_of_mem
statement:
lemma mem_nodeWt_of_mem {i : I} {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) :
    m ∈ nodeWt R v M i (Λ (R.coroot i))
proof:
:=
  (le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (_ : Λ' (R.coroot i) = Λ (R.coroot i)) ↦
    weightSpace R v M Λ') Λ rfl le_rfl) hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeWt_induction
statement:
lemma nodeWt_induction {i : I} {n : ℤ} {P : M → Prop} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ nodeWt R v M i n)
    (h0 : P 0) (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hmem : ∀ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, Λ (R.coroot i) = n → ∀ x ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ, P x) : P m
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := P) hm
    (fun Λ _ hx ↦ Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := P) hx
      (fun hΛ y hy ↦ hmem Λ hΛ y hy) h0 hadd) h0 hadd

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_mem_nodeWt
statement:
lemma E_smul_mem_nodeWt [NeZero v] {i : I} {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ nodeWt R v M i n)
    (j : I) : E R v j • m ∈ nodeWt R v M i (n + D.cartanMatrix i j)
proof:
:= by
  refine nodeWt_induction (P := fun x ↦ E R v j • x ∈ nodeWt R v M i (n + D.cartanMatrix i j))
    hm (by simp) (fun x y hx hy ↦ by rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy) fun Λ hΛ x hx ↦ ?_
  have := mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := i) (E_smul_mem_weightSpace hx j)
  rwa [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hΛ, R.root_coroot] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_smul_mem_nodeWt
statement:
lemma F_smul_mem_nodeWt [NeZero v] {i : I} {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ nodeWt R v M i n)
    (j : I) : F R v j • m ∈ nodeWt R v M i (n - D.cartanMatrix i j)
proof:
:= by
  refine nodeWt_induction (P := fun x ↦ F R v j • x ∈ nodeWt R v M i (n - D.cartanMatrix i j))
    hm (by simp) (fun x y hx hy ↦ by rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy) fun Λ hΛ x hx ↦ ?_
  have := mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := i) (F_smul_mem_weightSpace hx j)
  rwa [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, hΛ, R.root_coroot] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Kt_smul_of_mem_nodeWt
statement:
lemma Kt_smul_of_mem_nodeWt {i : I} {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ nodeWt R v M i n) :
    Kt R v i • m = (v ^ D.d i) ^ n • m
proof:
:=
  nodeWt_induction (P := fun x ↦ Kt R v i • x = (v ^ D.d i) ^ n • x) hm (by simp)
    (fun x y hx hy ↦ by rw [smul_add, hx, hy, smul_add]) fun Λ hΛ x hx ↦ by
      rw [Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hx, hΛ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_nodeWt
statement:
lemma K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_nodeWt {i : I} {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ nodeWt R v M i n) :
    K R v (-ktilde R i) • m = (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-n) • m
proof:
:=
  nodeWt_induction (P := fun x ↦ K R v (-ktilde R i) • x = (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-n) • x) hm (by simp)
    (fun x y hx hy ↦ by rw [smul_add, hx, hy, smul_add]) fun Λ hΛ x hx ↦ by
      rw [K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hx, hΛ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.iSupIndep_nodeWt
statement:
lemma iSupIndep_nodeWt [NeZero v] (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) :
    iSupIndep (nodeWt R v M i)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have h := (iSupIndep_weightSpace (R := R) (M := M) hv).disjoint_biSup_biSup
    (s := {Λ : Y →+ ℤ | Λ (R.coroot i) = n}) (t := {Λ : Y →+ ℤ | Λ (R.coroot i) ≠ n})
    (Set.disjoint_left.2 fun _ h1 h2 ↦ h2 h1)
  refine h.mono le_rfl ?_
  refine iSup₂_le fun n' hn' ↦ iSup₂_le fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_
  exact le_biSup (weightSpace R v M) (show Λ (R.coroot i) ≠ n from hΛ ▸ hn')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.iSup_nodeWt
statement: lemma iSup_nodeWt (hM : IsIntegrable R v M) (i : I) : ⨆ n, nodeWt R v M i n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]
  exact iSup_le fun Λ ↦ (le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (Λ' : Y →+ ℤ)
    (_ : Λ' (R.coroot i) = Λ (R.coroot i)) ↦ weightSpace R v M Λ') Λ rfl le_rfl).trans
    (le_iSup (nodeWt R v M i) (Λ (R.coroot i)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_d_ne_one
statement:
lemma pow_d_ne_one (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (v ^ D.d i) ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [← pow_mul]
  exact hv _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) hn)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.act_qDivPow
statement:
lemma act_qDivPow (q : k) (n : ℕ) (a : QuantumGroup R v) :
    act R v M (qDivPow q n a) = qDivPow q n (act R v M a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_E
statement: lemma nodeSl2_E : (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).E = act R v M (E R v i)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_F
statement: lemma nodeSl2_F : (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).F = act R v M (F R v i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_dE_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma nodeSl2_dE_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (a : ℕ) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dE a m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ + (a : ℤ) • R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_apply]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  rw [nodeSl2_E, ← map_pow, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
  induction a with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul]
    have := E_smul_mem_weightSpace ih i
    rwa [add_assoc, ← add_one_zsmul, show ((a : ℤ) + 1) = ((a + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring]
      at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_dF_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma nodeSl2_dF_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (b : ℕ) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF b m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ - (b : ℤ) • R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_apply]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  rw [nodeSl2_F, ← map_pow, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
  induction b with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul]
    have := F_smul_mem_weightSpace ih i
    rwa [sub_sub, ← add_one_zsmul, show ((b : ℤ) + 1) = ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring]
      at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hm' : m ∈ V.wt (Λ (R.coroot i)) := mem_nodeWt_of_mem hm
  rw [IntegrableSl2.T_of_mem' V t hm', finsum_eq_sum _ (V.hasFiniteSupport_symmTerm t _ m)]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun ⟨a, c⟩ _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [IntegrableSl2.symmTerm_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    have hb : (((Λ (R.coroot i) + a + c).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = Λ (R.coroot i) + a + c :=
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg h
    have := nodeSl2_dE_mem_weightSpace hv hM i (nodeSl2_dF_mem_weightSpace hv hM i
      (nodeSl2_dE_mem_weightSpace hv hM i hm c) (Λ (R.coroot i) + a + c).toNat) a
    convert this using 2
    rw [hb]
    ext μ
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_smul,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_K
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_K (t : k) (μ : Y) (m : M) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T t (K R v μ • m) =
      K R v (reflY R i μ) • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T t m
proof:
:= by
  have hm : m ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v M Λ := hM.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun m ↦ (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T t
    (K R v μ • m) = K R v (reflY R i μ) • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T t m) hm
    (fun Λ x hx ↦ ?_) (by simp) fun x y hx hy ↦ by
      rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]
  rw [hx μ, map_smul, nodeSl2_T_mem_weightSpace hv hM i t hx (reflY R i μ)]
  congr 2
  rw [reflY_apply]
  simp only [map_sub, map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_mul_smul_eq_zero_of_qSerre
statement:
lemma pow_mul_smul_eq_zero_of_qSerre {q : k} {m : ℕ} {a b : QuantumGroup R v} {x : M}
    (h : qSerre q m a b = 0) (hx : a • x = 0) : (a ^ m * b) • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : qSerre q m a b • x = 0 := by rw [h, zero_smul]
  rw [qSerre, Finset.sum_smul] at e
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun r _ hr ↦ ?_) (fun h ↦ (h (by simp)).elim)] at e
  · simpa using e
  · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hr
    rw [smul_assoc, pow_succ a r, ← mul_assoc, mul_smul (a ^ (m - (r + 1)) * b * a ^ r) a x, hx,
      smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_E_self
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_E_self (m : M) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) (E R v i • m) =
      Ti (E R v i) • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) m
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hqr := pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv i
  rw [H.map_E]
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  have key := V.ext_wt (f := V.T (v ^ D.d i) ∘ₗ act R v M (E R v i))
    (g := act R v M (braidEi R i) ∘ₗ V.T (v ^ D.d i)) fun n m hm ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
      have hT := V.T_mem (v ^ D.d i) hm
      rw [show E R v i • m = V.E m from rfl,
        IntegrableSl2.T_E hq0 hqr hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hm, braidEi, neg_smul, neg_smul, mul_smul,
        Kt_smul_of_mem_nodeWt hT, smul_comm]
      rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_F_self
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_F_self (m : M) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) (F R v i • m) =
      Ti (F R v i) • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) m
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hqr := pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv i
  rw [H.map_F]
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  have key := V.ext_wt (f := V.T (v ^ D.d i) ∘ₗ act R v M (F R v i))
    (g := act R v M (braidFi R i) ∘ₗ V.T (v ^ D.d i)) fun n m hm ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Algebra.lsmul_apply]
      have hT : E R v i • V.T (v ^ D.d i) m ∈ nodeWt R v M i (-n + 2) :=
        V.E_mem (V.T_mem (v ^ D.d i) hm)
      rw [show F R v i • m = V.F m from rfl,
        IntegrableSl2.T_F hq0 hqr hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hm, braidFi, neg_smul, neg_smul, mul_smul,
        K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_nodeWt hT, show -(-n + 2) = n - 2 by ring]
      rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_E_ne
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_E_ne {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (m : M) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) (E R v j • m) =
      Ti (E R v j) • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) m
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hqr := pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv i
  have hij : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hji
  have hr : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) ≠ 0 :=
    qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hqr _
  have hEF : E R v j * F R v i = F R v i * E R v j := by
    have := E_mul_F_sub (R := R) (v := v) j i
    simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
  have hZF : ∀ x, act R v M (E R v j) (V.F x) = V.F (act R v M (E R v j) x) := fun x ↦ by
    change E R v j • F R v i • x = F R v i • E R v j • x
    rw [← mul_smul, hEF, mul_smul]
  have hZwt : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ V.wt n, act R v M (E R v j) x ∈ V.wt (n - negA D i j) := by
    intro n x hx
    have := E_smul_mem_nodeWt hx j
    rwa [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at this
  have hZE : ∀ (p : ℕ) η, η ∈ V.wt p → V.E η = 0 →
      (V.E ^ (negA D i j + 1)) (act R v M (E R v j) η) = 0 := by
    intro p η _ hE
    have hs := serre_E (R := R) (v := v) hij
    rw [one_sub_cartanMatrix_toNat hij] at hs
    change (act R v M (E R v i) ^ (negA D i j + 1)) (act R v M (E R v j) η) = 0
    rw [← map_pow, Algebra.lsmul_apply, Algebra.lsmul_apply, ← mul_smul]
    exact pow_mul_smul_eq_zero_of_qSerre hs hE
  have hX : ∀ (p : ℕ) η, η ∈ V.wt p → V.E η = 0 →
      act R v M (Ti (E R v j)) (V.T (v ^ D.d i) η) =
        ((-1) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) • V.psi p (negA D i j) (act R v M (E R v j) η) := by
    intro p η hη hE
    have hT0 : V.T (v ^ D.d i) η = ((-1) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) • V.dF p η := by
      have := IntegrableSl2.T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hqr hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hη hE (Nat.zero_le p)
      simpa using this
    rw [hT0, map_smul, H.map_E]
    simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [braidEj_eq_sum hr, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, IntegrableSl2.psi_apply]
    congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, map_mul, map_mul, act_qDivPow, act_qDivPow, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
    change ((-1) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ s) •
      V.dE (negA D i j - s) (act R v M (E R v j) (V.dE s (V.dF p η))) = _
    split_ifs with hsp
    · rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hqr hη hE hsp le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, zero_add,
        qBinomial_self, one_smul, IntegrableSl2.comm_dF (V := V) _ hZF]
    · rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_eq_zero_of_lt hq0 hqr hη hE le_rfl (by omega), map_zero,
        map_zero, smul_zero, zero_smul]
  have hG : ∀ x, V.T (v ^ D.d i) (V.F x) =
      act R v M (Ti (F R v i)) (V.T (v ^ D.d i) x) :=
    fun x ↦ nodeSl2_T_F_self hv hM H x
  have hXG : ∀ x, act R v M (Ti (E R v j)) (act R v M (Ti (F R v i)) x) =
      act R v M (Ti (F R v i)) (act R v M (Ti (E R v j)) x) := fun x ↦ by
    change Ti (E R v j) • Ti (F R v i) • x = Ti (F R v i) • Ti (E R v j) • x
    rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, hEF]
  exact IntegrableSl2.T_comp_eq_of_psi hq0 hqr V (V.T (v ^ D.d i)) (act R v M (E R v j))
    (act R v M (Ti (E R v j))) (act R v M (Ti (F R v i))) (negA D i j)
    (fun p ↦ (-1) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) (fun _ _ hw ↦ IntegrableSl2.T_eq_psi_of_mem hq0 hqr hw)
    hZF hZwt hZE hX hG hXG m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_F_ne
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_F_ne {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (m : M) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) (F R v j • m) =
      Ti (F R v j) • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) m
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hqr := pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv i
  have hij : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hji
  have hr : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) ≠ 0 :=
    qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hqr _
  have hEF : E R v i * F R v j = F R v j * E R v i := by
    have := E_mul_F_sub (R := R) (v := v) i j
    simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
  have hZF : ∀ x, act R v M (F R v j) (V.flip.F x) = V.flip.F (act R v M (F R v j) x) :=
    fun x ↦ by
      change F R v j • E R v i • x = E R v i • F R v j • x
      rw [← mul_smul, ← hEF, mul_smul]
  have hZwt : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ V.flip.wt n, act R v M (F R v j) x ∈ V.flip.wt (n - negA D i j) := by
    intro n x hx
    have := F_smul_mem_nodeWt (show x ∈ nodeWt R v M i (-n) from hx) j
    rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij, show -n - -(negA D i j : ℤ) = -(n - negA D i j) by ring]
      at this
    exact this
  have hZE : ∀ (p : ℕ) η, η ∈ V.flip.wt p → V.flip.E η = 0 →
      (V.flip.E ^ (negA D i j + 1)) (act R v M (F R v j) η) = 0 := by
    intro p η _ hE
    have hs := serre_F (R := R) (v := v) hij
    rw [one_sub_cartanMatrix_toNat hij] at hs
    change (act R v M (F R v i) ^ (negA D i j + 1)) (act R v M (F R v j) η) = 0
    rw [← map_pow, Algebra.lsmul_apply, Algebra.lsmul_apply, ← mul_smul]
    exact pow_mul_smul_eq_zero_of_qSerre hs hE
  have hX : ∀ (p : ℕ) η, η ∈ V.flip.wt p → V.flip.E η = 0 →
      act R v M (Ti (F R v j)) (V.T (v ^ D.d i) η) =
        ((-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) •
          V.flip.psi p (negA D i j) (act R v M (F R v j) η) := by
    intro p η hη hE
    rw [IntegrableSl2.T_of_lowest hq0 hqr hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hη hE, H.map_F]
    simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [braidFj_eq_sum (NeZero.ne v) hr, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, IntegrableSl2.psi_apply,
      smul_sum]
    conv_rhs => rw [← sum_range_reflect]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    simp only [mem_range] at hs
    rw [map_smul, map_mul, map_mul, act_qDivPow, act_qDivPow, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      show negA D i j - (negA D i j - s) = s by omega]
    change ((-1) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i) ^ s) •
      V.flip.dE s (act R v M (F R v j) (V.flip.dE (negA D i j - s) (V.flip.dF p η))) = _
    split_ifs with hsp
    · rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hqr hη hE hsp le_rfl, Nat.sub_self,
        zero_add, qBinomial_self, one_smul, IntegrableSl2.comm_dF (V := V.flip) _ hZF, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [IntegrableSl2.neg_one_pow_sub (show s ≤ negA D i j by omega),
        IntegrableSl2.inv_pow_sub hq0 (show s ≤ negA D i j by omega)]
      have h1 : ((-1 : k) ^ negA D i j) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [← pow_mul, pow_mul', neg_one_sq, one_pow]
      have h2 : (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, one_pow]
      linear_combination (-(-1) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i) ^ s) * h2 +
        (-(-1) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i) ^ s * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j *
          (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j)) * h1
    · rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_eq_zero_of_lt (V := V.flip) hq0 hqr hη hE le_rfl (by omega),
        map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero, zero_smul, smul_zero]
  have hG : ∀ x, V.T (v ^ D.d i) (V.flip.F x) =
      act R v M (Ti (E R v i)) (V.T (v ^ D.d i) x) :=
    fun x ↦ nodeSl2_T_E_self hv hM H x
  have hXG : ∀ x, act R v M (Ti (F R v j)) (act R v M (Ti (E R v i)) x) =
      act R v M (Ti (E R v i)) (act R v M (Ti (F R v j)) x) := fun x ↦ by
    change Ti (F R v j) • Ti (E R v i) • x = Ti (E R v i) • Ti (F R v j) • x
    rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, hEF]
  exact IntegrableSl2.T_comp_eq_of_psi hq0 hqr V.flip (V.T (v ^ D.d i)) (act R v M (F R v j))
    (act R v M (Ti (F R v j))) (act R v M (Ti (E R v i))) (negA D i j)
    (fun _ ↦ (-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)
    (fun _ _ hw ↦ IntegrableSl2.T_eq_flip_psi hq0 hqr hw) hZF hZwt hZE hX hG hXG m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_T_smul
statement:
theorem nodeSl2_T_smul (u : QuantumGroup R v) (m : M) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) (u • m) =
      Ti u • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) m
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on R v (P := fun u ↦ ∀ m, (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) (u • m) =
    Ti u • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) m) u ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ m
  · intro c m
    rw [algebraMap_smul, map_smul, AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul]
  · intro l m
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst hl
      exact nodeSl2_T_E_self hv hM H m
    · exact nodeSl2_T_E_ne hv hM H hl m
  · intro l m
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst hl
      exact nodeSl2_T_F_self hv hM H m
    · exact nodeSl2_T_F_ne hv hM H hl m
  · intro μ m
    rw [H.map_K]
    exact nodeSl2_T_K hv hM i _ μ m
  · intro x y hx hy m
    rw [add_smul, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_smul]
  · intro x y hx hy m
    rw [mul_smul, hx, hy, map_mul, mul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_smul_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_qSerre
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro N hN; simpa using hx N (by simpa using hN)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro N hN
    have hN' : N₀ + m * n + m ≤ N := by rw [Nat.mul_succ] at hN; omega
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, ← mul_smul]
    have hmem := pow_mul_mem_span_of_qSerre h N
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun y _ ↦ y • (b ^ n • x) = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hmem
    · rintro _ ⟨r, hr, -, rfl⟩
      rw [mul_smul, mul_smul, ih (N - r) (by omega), smul_zero, smul_zero]
    · simp
    · intro y z _ _ hy hz; rw [add_smul, hy, hz, add_zero]
    · intro c y _ hy; rw [smul_assoc, hy, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEjDiv_mem_adjoin
statement:
lemma braidEjDiv_mem_adjoin (i j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    braidEjDiv R v i j n ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ∀ l, E R v l ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) :=
    fun l ↦ Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨l, rfl⟩
  have hD : ∀ q l c, qDivPow q c (E R v l) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) :=
    fun q l c ↦ Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (hE l) c) _
  exact Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun r _ ↦ Subalgebra.smul_mem _
    (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (hD _ _ _) (hD _ _ _)) (hD _ _ _)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEjDiv_smul_T_of_primitive
statement:
lemma braidEjDiv_smul_T_of_primitive (hji : j ≠ i) (n p : ℕ) {η : M}
    (hη : η ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).wt p) (hE : (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).E η = 0) :
    braidEjDiv R v i j n • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) η =
      ((-1) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).psi p (negA D i j * n)
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) • η)
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hqr := pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv i
  have hEF : qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) * F R v i =
      F R v i * qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) := by
    have h1 : E R v j * F R v i = F R v i * E R v j := by
      have := E_mul_F_sub (R := R) (v := v) j i
      simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte] at this
      exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
    simp only [qDivPow, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [((show Commute (E R v j) (F R v i) from h1).pow_left n).eq]
  have hZF : ∀ x, act R v M (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) (V.F x) =
      V.F (act R v M (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) x) := fun x ↦ by
    change qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) • F R v i • x =
      F R v i • qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) • x
    rw [← mul_smul, hEF, mul_smul]
  have hT0 : V.T (v ^ D.d i) η = ((-1) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) • V.dF p η := by
    have := IntegrableSl2.T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hqr hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hη hE (Nat.zero_le p)
    simpa using this
  rw [hT0, smul_comm, IntegrableSl2.psi_apply]
  congr 1
  rw [braidEjDiv, sum_smul]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_assoc]
  change ((-1) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ s) • act R v M (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - s)
    (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) s (E R v i)) (V.dF p η) = _
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
    act_qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - s) (E R v i), act_qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) s (E R v i)]
  change ((-1) ^ s * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ s) • V.dE (negA D i j * n - s)
    (act R v M (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) (V.dE s (V.dF p η))) = _
  split_ifs with hsp
  · rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hqr hη hE hsp le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, zero_add,
      qBinomial_self, one_smul, IntegrableSl2.comm_dF (V := V) _ hZF]
    rfl
  · rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_eq_zero_of_lt hq0 hqr hη hE le_rfl (by omega), map_zero,
      map_zero, smul_zero, zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.T_qDivPow_E_smul_of_primitive
statement:
lemma T_qDivPow_E_smul_of_primitive (hji : j ≠ i) (n p : ℕ) {η : M}
    (hη : η ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).wt p) (hE : (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).E η = 0) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) • η) =
      braidEjDiv R v i j n • (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).T (v ^ D.d i) η
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hqr := pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv i
  have hij : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hji
  set r := negA D i j * n with hr
  rw [braidEjDiv_smul_T_of_primitive hv hM hji n p hη hE]
  apply IntegrableSl2.T_eq_psi_of_mem hq0 hqr
  set Z := qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)
  
  have hZη : Z • η ∈ V.wt ((p : ℤ) - r) := by
    have hpow : ∀ (c : ℕ) (x : M) (m : ℤ), x ∈ V.wt m →
        E R v j ^ c • x ∈ V.wt (m - negA D i j * c) := by
      intro c
      induction c with
      | zero => intro x m hx; simpa using hx
      | succ c ih =>
        intro x m hx
        rw [pow_succ', mul_smul]
        have := E_smul_mem_nodeWt (ih x m hx) j
        rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij] at this
        change _ ∈ nodeWt R v M i _
        convert this using 2
        push_cast; ring
    have := hpow n η p hη
    rw [show (p : ℤ) - (negA D i j * n : ℕ) = p - negA D i j * n by push_cast; ring]
    simp only [Z, qDivPow, smul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ this
  
  have hZE : (V.E ^ (r + 1)) (Z • η) = 0 := by
    have hs := serre_E (R := R) (v := v) hij
    rw [one_sub_cartanMatrix_toNat hij] at hs
    have hx : ∀ N, 1 ≤ N → E R v i ^ N • η = 0 := by
      intro N hN
      obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hN
      rw [pow_succ, mul_smul]
      change E R v i ^ N • V.E η = 0
      rw [hE, smul_zero]
    have := pow_smul_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_qSerre hs hx n (r + 1) (by rw [hr]; omega)
    change (act R v M (E R v i) ^ (r + 1)) (Z • η) = 0
    rw [← map_pow]
    change E R v i ^ (r + 1) • (Z • η) = 0
    simp only [Z, qDivPow, smul_assoc, smul_comm _ ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d j) n)⁻¹)]
    rw [this, smul_zero]
  rcases le_or_gt (r : ℤ) p with hrp | hrp
  · exact IntegrableSl2.mem_stringsLT_of_nonneg hq0 hqr (by omega) hZη hZE
  · have hEF : Z * F R v i = F R v i * Z := by
      have h1 : E R v j * F R v i = F R v i * E R v j := by
        have := E_mul_F_sub (R := R) (v := v) j i
        simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte] at this
        exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
      simp only [Z, qDivPow, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
      rw [((show Commute (E R v j) (F R v i) from h1).pow_left n).eq]
    have hF : (V.F ^ (p + 1)) (Z • η) = 0 := by
      have hc : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : M), (V.F ^ N) (Z • x) = Z • (V.F ^ N) x := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero => simp
        | succ N ih =>
          intro x
          rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih]
          change F R v i • (Z • (V.F ^ N) x) = Z • (F R v i • (V.F ^ N) x)
          rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, hEF]
      have h0 := IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive hq0 hqr hη hE
        (show (p : ℤ) < (p + 1 : ℕ) by push_cast; omega)
      rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_apply] at h0
      rw [hc, (smul_eq_zero.1 h0).resolve_left
        (inv_ne_zero (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hqr _)), smul_zero]
    have := IntegrableSl2.mem_stringsLT_of_nonpos hq0 hqr (by omega) hZη hF
    rwa [show p + 1 + (-((p : ℤ) - r)).toNat = r + 1 by omega] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.T_qDivPow_E_smul_of_lowest
proof:
:= by
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hqr := pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv i
  set η := V.dE p m with hηdef
  
  have hm' : m ∈ V.flip.wt p := by simpa using hm
  have hη : η ∈ V.wt p := by
    have := V.dE_mem hm p
    rwa [show -(p : ℤ) + 2 * p = p by ring] at this
  have hηE : V.E η = 0 := by
    rw [hηdef, IntegrableSl2.E_dE hq0 hqr]
    have := IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hqr hm' hF
      (show (p : ℤ) < (p + 1 : ℕ) by push_cast; omega)
    rw [IntegrableSl2.flip_dF] at this
    rw [this, smul_zero]
  have hdF : V.dF p η = m := by
    have := IntegrableSl2.dE_dF_of_primitive (V := V.flip) hq0 hqr hm' hF (le_refl p) le_rfl
    simpa using this
  have hT : V.T (v ^ D.d i) η = ((-1) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) • m := by
    have := IntegrableSl2.T_dF_of_primitive hq0 hqr hq0 (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hη hηE (Nat.zero_le p)
    simpa [hdF] using this
  have hc : ((-1 : k) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (pow_ne_zero _ hq0)
  have key := nodeSl2_T_smul hv hM H (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) η
  rw [T_qDivPow_E_smul_of_primitive hv hM hji n p hη hηE, hT] at key
  have key2 : ((-1 : k) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) • (Ti (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) • m) =
      ((-1 : k) ^ p * (v ^ D.d i) ^ p) • (braidEjDiv R v i j n • m) := by
    rw [smul_comm _ (Ti _) m, smul_comm _ (braidEjDiv R v i j n) m]
    exact key.symm
  exact smul_right_injective M hc key2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_eq_zero_of_smul_lowest
statement:
theorem plusHom_eq_zero_of_smul_lowest
    (hcor : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) (x : LusztigF k I)
    (h : ∀ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) → plusHom R v x •
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v (FPowQuotient R v Λ)
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (hwv R v Λ)) = 0) :
    plusHom R v x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : minusHom R v x = 0 := by
    set N := ∑ ν ∈ (LusztigF.gradingHom k I x).coeff.support, ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := hcor N
    have hΛ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Λ (R.coroot i) := fun i ↦ (hΛ i).trans' (by positivity)
    rw [minusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv]
    refine mem_serreIdeal_of_toVerma_mem_fPowSubmodule hv (Λ := Λ) hΛ0 (fun ν hν i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · have hνs : ν ∈ (LusztigF.gradingHom k I x).coeff.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hν
      have h1 : ν i ≤ ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i := by
        by_cases hi : i ∈ ν.support
        · exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hi
        · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi]; exact Nat.zero_le _
      have h2 : ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i ≤ N :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ν : I →₀ ℕ ↦ ∑ i ∈ ν.support, ν i)
          (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hνs
      have := hΛ i
      omega
    · have := h Λ hΛ0
      rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, chevalley_comp_plusHom,
        LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
      exact this
  rwa [plusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv, ← minusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_E_mem_adjoin
statement:
lemma qDivPow_E_mem_adjoin (q : k) (j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q n (E R v j) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self j)) n) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne_aux
statement:
lemma braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne_aux
    (hcor : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ Λ : Y →+ ℤ, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ (R.coroot i)) {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i)
    (n : ℕ) : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) =
      braidEjDiv R v i j n
proof:
:= by
  have H := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have hmem : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) -
      braidEjDiv R v i j n ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) := by
    refine sub_mem ?_ (braidEjDiv_mem_adjoin i j n)
    simp only [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow]
    refine Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Subalgebra.pow_mem _ ?_ n) _
    have := H.map_E j
    simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte] at this
    change (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).toAlgHom (E R v j) ∈ _
    rw [this]
    exact braidEj_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩) (Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_plusHom_eq hmem
  have h0 : plusHom R v x = 0 := by
    refine plusHom_eq_zero_of_smul_lowest hv hcor x fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_
    set M := ChevalleyTwist R v (FPowQuotient R v Λ)
    have hM : IsIntegrable R v M := ChevalleyTwist.isIntegrable (FPowQuotient.isIntegrable Λ)
    set g := ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v (FPowQuotient R v Λ)
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (VermaModule.hwv R v Λ))
    have hg : g ∈ weightSpace R v M (-Λ) := by
      intro μ
      rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_K, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
        VermaModule.K_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, map_smul, map_neg,
        AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]
    have hgw : g ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).wt (-((Λ (R.coroot i)).toNat : ℤ)) := by
      have := mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := i) hg
      rwa [AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, ← Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hΛ i)] at this
    have hgF : (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).F g = 0 := by
      change F R v i • g = 0
      rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_F, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
        VermaModule.E_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero]
    have := T_qDivPow_E_smul_of_lowest hv hM H hji n _ hgw hgF
    rw [hx, sub_smul, sub_eq_zero]
    exact this
  rw [h0, eq_comm, sub_eq_zero] at hx
  exact hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne (R : D.RootDatum Y) {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) = braidEjDiv R v i j n
proof:
:= by
  have key := braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne_aux hv (R := R.freeCoroot)
    R.exists_le_freeCoroot hji n
  have e := mapHom_wordProd R.freeCorootHom (braidEquivOfNotRoot R.freeCoroot hv)
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R.freeCoroot)
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R) [i] (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R.freeCoroot v j))
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one] at e
  rw [key] at e
  have h1 : mapHom v R.freeCorootHom (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R.freeCoroot v j)) =
      qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) := by
    simp [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow]
  have h2 : mapHom v R.freeCorootHom (braidEjDiv R.freeCoroot v i j n) = braidEjDiv R v i j n := by
    simp [braidEjDiv, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, qDivPow, map_pow]
  rw [h1, h2] at e
  exact e.symm

statement: lemma chevalley_chevalley (x : QuantumGroup R v) : chevalley R v (chevalley R v x) = x
