:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (chevalley_comp_chevalley R v) x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_diagHom_braidEjDiv
statement:
lemma chevalley_diagHom_braidEjDiv (i j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    chevalley R v (diagHom R v (chevalleyScalar D v) (braidEjDiv R v i j n)) =
      ((chevalleyScalar D v j : k) ^ n) • braidFjDiv R v i j n
proof:
:= by
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  rw [braidEjDiv, braidFjDiv, map_sum, map_sum, smul_sum, ← sum_range_reflect]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [mem_range] at hr
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, negA D i j * n = r + t := ⟨negA D i j * n - r, by omega⟩
  simp only [map_smul, map_mul, diagHom_qDivPow_E, chevalley_qDivPow_E, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  rw [show negA D i j * n + 1 - 1 - r = t by omega, show negA D i j * n - r = t by omega,
    show negA D i j * n - t = r by omega]
  congr 1
  simp only [chevalleyScalar, Units.val_mk0]
  rw [neg_pow (v ^ D.d i), neg_pow (v ^ D.d i), neg_pow (v ^ D.d j)]
  field_simp
  have h1 : v ^ (t * D.d i) * v⁻¹ ^ (t * D.d i) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne v), one_pow]
  have h2 : (-1 : k) ^ (t * 2) = 1 := Even.neg_one_pow ⟨t, by ring⟩
  ring_nf
  linear_combination (v ^ (D.d j * n) * (-1 : k) ^ (t * 2)) * h1 + v ^ (D.d j * n) * h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_pow_eq_choose_smul
statement:
lemma mul_pow_eq_choose_smul {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {a b : B} {c : k}
    (h : b * a = c • (a * b)) (n : ℕ) : (a * b) ^ n = c ^ n.choose 2 • (a ^ n * b ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ m : ℕ, b ^ m * a = c ^ m • (a * b ^ m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      calc b ^ (m + 1) * a = b ^ m * (b * a) := by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
        _ = c • ((b ^ m * a) * b) := by rw [h, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
        _ = c ^ (m + 1) • (a * b ^ (m + 1)) := by
          rw [ih, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, ← pow_succ']
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc (a * b) ^ (n + 1) = c ^ n.choose 2 • (a ^ n * (b ^ n * a) * b) := by
          rw [pow_succ, ih, smul_mul_assoc]; congr 1; noncomm_ring
      _ = c ^ (n + 1).choose 2 • (a ^ (n + 1) * b ^ (n + 1)) := by
          rw [hb, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, ← pow_add, Nat.choose_succ_succ,
            Nat.choose_one_right, add_comm n]
          congr 1
          rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; noncomm_ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.two_mul_choose_two
statement: lemma two_mul_choose_two (n : ℕ) : 2 * n.choose 2 = n * (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.choose_two_right, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.even_mul_pred_self n).two_dvd]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Kt_mul_F_self
statement:
lemma Kt_mul_F_self (i : I) :
    Kt R v i * F R v i = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (F R v i * Kt R v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kt, K_mul_F, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self, inv_pow, ← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast,
    ← zpow_neg]
  push_cast; ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_K_neg_self
statement:
lemma E_mul_K_neg_self (i : I) :
    E R v i * K R v (-ktilde R i) = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 • (K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := K_mul_E R v (-ktilde R i) i
  rw [map_neg, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self] at h
  rw [h, smul_smul, ← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
  push_cast; ring_nf; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_self
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_self (R : D.RootDatum Y) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i)) =
      ((-1) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i) * K R v (n • ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  have H := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have hE : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v i) = -(F R v i * Kt R v i) := by
    have := H.map_E i
    simpa using this
  rw [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, hE, neg_pow,
    show ((-1 : QuantumGroup R v) ^ n) = algebraMap k _ ((-1) ^ n) by simp, ← Algebra.smul_def,
    mul_pow_eq_choose_smul (Kt_mul_F_self i), Kt, K_pow, ← pow_mul, two_mul_choose_two,
    qDivPow, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_self
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_self (R : D.RootDatum Y) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i)) =
      ((-1) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
        (K R v (n • -ktilde R i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  have H := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have hF : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v i) = -(K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i) := by
    have := H.map_F i
    simpa using this
  rw [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, hF, neg_pow,
    show ((-1 : QuantumGroup R v) ^ n) = algebraMap k _ ((-1) ^ n) by simp, ← Algebra.smul_def,
    mul_pow_eq_choose_smul (E_mul_K_neg_self i), K_pow, ← pow_mul, two_mul_choose_two,
    qDivPow, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_ne
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_ne (R : D.RootDatum Y) {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (F R v j)) = braidFjDiv R v i j n
proof:
:= by
  have H := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (chevalley_comp_comp_diagHom H) (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j))
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, diagHom_qDivPow_E, map_smul, chevalley_qDivPow_E] at h
  have hE' : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).toAlgHom (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) =
      braidEjDiv R v i j n := braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne hv R hji n
  rw [hE'] at h
  have h' := congrArg (chevalley R v) h
  rw [map_smul, chevalley_chevalley, chevalley_diagHom_braidEjDiv] at h'
  exact smul_right_injective _ (pow_ne_zero _ (Units.ne_zero _)) h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_qDivPow
statement:
lemma braidReversal_qDivPow (q : k) (n : ℕ) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    braidReversal (qDivPow q n x) = qDivPow q n (braidReversal x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow, map_smul, braidReversal_pow, qDivPow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply
statement:
lemma braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply (R : D.RootDatum Y) (i : I) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm x =
      braidReversal (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (braidReversal x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_E_ne
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_E_ne (R : D.RootDatum Y) {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i)
    (n : ℕ) : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j)) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), ((-1 : k) ^ r * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) r (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (E R v j) *
          qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_E,
    braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne hv R hji, braidEjDiv, map_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_E, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_F_ne
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_F_ne (R : D.RootDatum Y) {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i)
    (n : ℕ) : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm (qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (F R v j)) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), ((-1 : k) ^ r * (v ^ D.d i) ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d j) n (F R v j) *
          qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) r (F R v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_F,
    braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_ne hv R hji, braidFjDiv, map_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_F, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_E_self
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_E_self (R : D.RootDatum Y) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i)) =
      ((-1) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
        (K R v (-(n • ktilde R i)) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_E,
    braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_self hv R, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_K,
    braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_F]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_F_self
statement:
theorem braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_F_self (R : D.RootDatum Y) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i)) =
      ((-1) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i) * K R v (n • ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_F,
    braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_self hv R, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_K,
    braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_E, smul_neg, neg_neg]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.closedNorm_geometric
statement:
lemma closedNorm_geometric (q : k) (hq : q ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    1 - q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (m + 1)) =
      (1 - q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹ ^ m * qInt q (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = q⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * (q ^ (m + 1) - q⁻¹ ^ (m + 1)) := by
      rw [mul_sub, ← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← qInt_mul_sub, pow_succ]
      have hc := inv_mul_cancel₀ hq
      linear_combination (q⁻¹ ^ m * qInt q (m + 1)) * hc

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.closedNorm_coefficient
statement:
lemma closedNorm_coefficient (q : k) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hd : 1 - q⁻¹ ^ 2 ≠ 0) (n m : ℕ) :
    (1 - q⁻¹ ^ 2)⁻¹ * derivativeCoefficient q (q⁻¹ ^ (n + m + 1)) (n + 1) =
      q ^ n * q⁻¹ ^ m * qInt q (n + 1) * qInt q (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivativeCoefficient_closed q _ hq]
  have hp : q ^ (2 * n) * (q⁻¹ ^ (n + m + 1)) ^ 2 = q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (m + 1)) := by
    rw [show n + m + 1 = n + (m + 1) by omega, pow_add, mul_pow,
      ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm n 2, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow, one_mul]
    ring
  rw [hp, closedNorm_geometric q hq]
  have hc := inv_mul_cancel₀ hd
  linear_combination q ^ n * q⁻¹ ^ m * qInt q (n + 1) * qInt q (m + 1) * hc

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.closedNorm_binomial_step
statement:
lemma closedNorm_binomial_step (q : k) (hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (A n : ℕ) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * qBinomial q A (n + 1) =
      qInt q (A - n) * qBinomial q A n
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hq
  have h := qBinomial_mul_sub q A n
  simpa only [← qInt_mul_sub, mul_assoc] using h.symm

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.form_skewGenerator_closed
statement:
theorem form_skewGenerator_closed (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hroot : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    form D v (skewGenerator D v i j n) (skewGenerator D v i j n) =
      thetaNorm D v j * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (n * (negA D i j - n)) *
        qBinomial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) n * qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let q := v ^ D.d i
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hr : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → q ^ r ≠ 1 := fun r hr ↦ by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [← pow_mul]
    exact hroot _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) hr)
  have hdiff : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq hr
  have hd : 1 - q⁻¹ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he : q⁻¹ ^ 2 = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    have := congrArg (fun z : k ↦ z⁻¹) he
    simp only [← inv_pow, inv_inv, inv_one] at this
    exact hr 2 (by omega) this
  have ht : v ^ D.dot i j = q⁻¹ ^ negA D i j := by
    apply zpow_dot_eq hij
    rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij]
    omega
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [skewGenerator_zero, form_θ_θ]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, negA D i j = n + m + 1 := ⟨negA D i j - n - 1, by omega⟩
    have hprev : negA D i j - n = m + 1 := by omega
    have hnext : negA D i j - (n + 1) = m := by omega
    rw [form_skewGenerator_succ D v i hij, ih (by omega)]
    change (1 - q⁻¹ ^ 2)⁻¹ * derivativeCoefficient q (v ^ D.dot i j) (n + 1) *
      (thetaNorm D v j * q⁻¹ ^ (n * (negA D i j - n)) *
        qBinomial q (negA D i j) n * qFactorial q n ^ 2) = _
    rw [ht, hm, closedNorm_coefficient q hq hd]
    rw [← hm]
    change _ = thetaNorm D v j * q⁻¹ ^ ((n + 1) * (negA D i j - (n + 1))) *
      qBinomial q (negA D i j) (n + 1) * qFactorial q (n + 1) ^ 2
    rw [hprev, hnext, qFactorial_succ]
    have hp : q ^ n * q⁻¹ ^ m * q⁻¹ ^ (n * (m + 1)) = q⁻¹ ^ ((n + 1) * m) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show m + n * (m + 1) = n + (n + 1) * m by ring,
        pow_add, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow, one_mul]
    have hb := closedNorm_binomial_step q hdiff (negA D i j) n
    rw [hprev] at hb
    calc
      _ = thetaNorm D v j * (q ^ n * q⁻¹ ^ m * q⁻¹ ^ (n * (m + 1))) *
          qInt q (n + 1) * (qInt q (m + 1) * qBinomial q (negA D i j) n) *
          qFactorial q n ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hp, ← hb]; ring

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.form_skewDividedGenerator_closed
statement:
theorem form_skewDividedGenerator_closed (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hroot : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    form D v (skewDividedGenerator D v i j n) (skewDividedGenerator D v i j n) =
      thetaNorm D v j * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (n * (negA D i j - n)) *
        qBinomial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) n
proof:
:= by
  have hf := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) hv hroot i n
  simp only [skewDividedGenerator, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [form_skewGenerator_closed D v hv hroot hij n hn]
  field_simp

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.form_skewDividedGenerator_complement
statement:
theorem form_skewDividedGenerator_complement (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hroot : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    form D v (skewDividedGenerator D v i j n) (skewDividedGenerator D v i j n) =
      form D v (skewDividedGenerator D v i j (negA D i j - n))
        (skewDividedGenerator D v i j (negA D i j - n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_skewDividedGenerator_closed D v hv hroot hij n hn,
    form_skewDividedGenerator_closed D v hv hroot hij _ (Nat.sub_le _ _),
    Nat.sub_sub_self hn, qBinomial_symm _ hn, Nat.mul_comm (negA D i j - n) n]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.quotientForm_skewDividedGenerator_closed
statement:
theorem quotientForm_skewDividedGenerator_closed [Finite I] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    quotientForm D
        (toQuotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) (skewDividedGenerator D RatFunc.X i j n))
        (toQuotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) (skewDividedGenerator D RatFunc.X i j n)) =
      thetaNorm D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) j *
        (RatFunc.X ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (n * (negA D i j - n)) *
        qBinomial (RatFunc.X ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientForm_toQuotient]
  exact form_skewDividedGenerator_closed D RatFunc.X RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    ratFunc_X_not_root hij n hn

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.quotientForm_skewDividedGenerator_complement
statement:
theorem quotientForm_skewDividedGenerator_complement [Finite I] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    quotientForm D
        (toQuotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) (skewDividedGenerator D RatFunc.X i j n))
        (toQuotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) (skewDividedGenerator D RatFunc.X i j n)) =
      quotientForm D
        (toQuotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
          (skewDividedGenerator D RatFunc.X i j (negA D i j - n)))
        (toQuotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
          (skewDividedGenerator D RatFunc.X i j (negA D i j - n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientForm_toQuotient, quotientForm_toQuotient]
  exact form_skewDividedGenerator_complement D RatFunc.X RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    ratFunc_X_not_root hij n hn

name: RestrictedBraidConsumer.actual_maps
statement:
theorem actual_maps (i : I) {x z y w : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0) (hz : quotientLDeriv D i z = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y)
    (hzw : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R z) = quotientPlus R w) :
    quotientForm D y w = quotientForm D x z
proof:
:=
  restricted_braid_isometry R i hx hz hxy hzw

name: RestrictedBraidConsumer.adapted_tail_pairing
statement:
theorem adapted_tail_pairing (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w)) (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 c))
      (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 d)) =
    quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) c)
      (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) d)
proof:
:= by
  exact restricted_inverse_braid_isometry R i
    (quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw c).symm
    (quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw d).symm

name: RestrictedBraidConsumer.adapted_pbw_pairing_recursion
statement:
theorem adapted_pbw_pairing_recursion (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w))
    (c d : Fin (i :: w).length → ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) (integralPBWPreimage R hw d) =
      if c 0 = d 0 then GrandLoop.coefU D 𝕧 i (c 0) *
        quotientForm D
          (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) (fun n ↦ c n.succ))
          (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) (fun n ↦ d n.succ))
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralPBWPreimage_cons R hw c, integralPBWPreimage_cons R hw d,
    quotientForm_divided_mul_of_mem_skewGenerators D i (c 0) (d 0)
      ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i _).mpr
        (quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw (fun n ↦ c n.succ)))
      ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i _).mpr
        (quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw (fun n ↦ d n.succ))),
    adapted_tail_pairing R hw]

name: RestrictedBraidConsumer.adapted_pbw_norm_recursion
statement:
theorem adapted_pbw_norm_recursion (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w))
    (c : Fin (i :: w).length → ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) =
      GrandLoop.coefU D 𝕧 i (c 0) *
        quotientForm D
          (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) (fun n ↦ c n.succ))
          (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) (fun n ↦ c n.succ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ite_true] using adapted_pbw_pairing_recursion R hw c c

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.complement_complement
statement: lemma complement_complement (g : Gen D i) : complement D i (complement D i g) = g
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [complement, Nat.sub_sub_self g.property.2]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.complement_injective
statement: lemma complement_injective : Function.Injective (complement D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have := congrArg (complement D i) h
  simpa only [complement_complement] using this

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.awayDegree_add
statement:
lemma awayDegree_add (ν μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    awayDegree i (ν + μ) = awayDegree i ν + awayDegree i μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.sum_add_index
  · intros; simp
  · intro j _ a b; split_ifs <;> simp

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.awayDegree_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma awayDegree_zero : awayDegree i (0 : I →₀ ℕ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [awayDegree]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.awayDegree_generator
statement:
@[simp] lemma awayDegree_generator (g : Gen D i) :
    awayDegree i (generatorDegree D i g) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [generatorDegree, awayDegree_add]
  simp [awayDegree, Finsupp.sum_single_index, Ne.symm g.property.1]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.generatorDegree_injective
statement: lemma generatorDegree_injective : Function.Injective (generatorDegree D i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a b h
  have hj : a.val.1 = b.val.1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hh := congrArg (fun ν : I →₀ ℕ ↦ ν a.val.1) h
    simp [generatorDegree, a.property.1, hne] at hh
  have hn := congrArg (fun ν : I →₀ ℕ ↦ ν i) h
  simp only [generatorDegree, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hn
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext hj
  simpa [Ne.symm a.property.1, Ne.symm b.property.1] using hn

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.awayDegree_word
statement:
lemma awayDegree_word (f : Gen D i → Gen D i) (l : List (Gen D i)) :
    awayDegree i (wordDegree D i f l) = l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [wordDegree]
  | cons g l ih => simp [wordDegree, awayDegree_add, ih, Nat.add_comm]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.sourceGen_degree
statement:
lemma sourceGen_degree (g : Gen D i) :
    sourceGen D i g ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D) (generatorDegree D i g)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i g.val.1 g.val.2, ?_, rfl⟩
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  simpa [generatorDegree, Finsupp.smul_single] using
    (RightStringComparison.skewGenerator_degree (D := D) i g.val.1 g.val.2)

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.targetGen_degree
statement:
lemma targetGen_degree (g : Gen D i) :
    targetGen D i g ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D)
      (generatorDegree D i (complement D i g))
proof:
:=
  RightStringComparison.degree_rev (sourceGen_degree D i (complement D i g))

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.generatorWord_degree
statement:
lemma generatorWord_degree (f : Gen D i → Quotient D 𝕧) (σ : Gen D i → Gen D i)
    (hf : ∀ g, f g ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D) (generatorDegree D i (σ g)))
    (l : List (Gen D i)) :
    generatorWord D i f l ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D) (wordDegree D i σ l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, one_mem_weightSpace, (toQuotient D 𝕧).map_one⟩
  | cons g l ih => exact RightStringComparison.degree_mul (hf g) ih

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.quotientForm_degree_ne
statement:
lemma quotientForm_degree_ne {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} (hne : ν ≠ μ)
    {x y : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D) ν)
    (hy : y ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D) μ) : quotientForm D x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
  change quotientForm D (toQuotient D 𝕧 a) (toQuotient D 𝕧 b) = 0
  rw [quotientForm_toQuotient]
  exact form_eq_zero_of_ne D 𝕧 hne ha hb

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.generatorWord_pairing_zero
statement:
lemma generatorWord_pairing_zero (f : Gen D i → Quotient D 𝕧) (σ : Gen D i → Gen D i)
    (hf : ∀ g, f g ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D) (generatorDegree D i (σ g)))
    (g : Gen D i) (l : List (Gen D i)) (hl : l.length ≠ 1) :
    quotientForm D (f g) (generatorWord D i f l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientForm_degree_ne D
    (ν := generatorDegree D i (σ g)) (μ := wordDegree D i σ l) _ (hf g)
    (generatorWord_degree D i f σ hf l)
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (awayDegree i) h
  rw [awayDegree_generator, awayDegree_word] at hh
  exact hl hh.symm

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.one_word_pairing_zero
statement:
lemma one_word_pairing_zero (f : Gen D i → Quotient D 𝕧) (σ : Gen D i → Gen D i)
    (hf : ∀ g, f g ∈ RightStringComparison.degreeSpace (D := D) (generatorDegree D i (σ g)))
    (l : List (Gen D i)) (hl : l.length ≠ 0) :
    quotientForm D 1 (generatorWord D i f l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientForm_degree_ne D (ν := 0) (μ := wordDegree D i σ l) _
    ⟨1, one_mem_weightSpace, (toQuotient D 𝕧).map_one⟩ (generatorWord_degree D i f σ hf l)
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (awayDegree i) h
  rw [awayDegree_zero, awayDegree_word] at hh
  exact hl hh.symm

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.generator_pairing
statement:
lemma generator_pairing (g h : Gen D i) :
    quotientForm D (targetGen D i g) (targetGen D i h) =
      quotientForm D (sourceGen D i g) (sourceGen D i h)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : g = h
  · subst h
    rw [targetGen, quotientForm_rev]
    exact (quotientForm_skewDividedGenerator_complement D g.property.1
      g.val.2 g.property.2).symm
  · have hs : generatorDegree D i g ≠ generatorDegree D i h :=
      fun hh ↦ he (generatorDegree_injective D i hh)
    have ht : generatorDegree D i (complement D i g) ≠
        generatorDegree D i (complement D i h) :=
      fun hh ↦ he (complement_injective D i (generatorDegree_injective D i hh))
    rw [quotientForm_degree_ne D ht (targetGen_degree D i g) (targetGen_degree D i h),
      quotientForm_degree_ne D hs (sourceGen_degree D i g) (sourceGen_degree D i h)]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.generator_word_pairing
statement:
theorem generator_word_pairing (g : Gen D i) (l : List (Gen D i)) :
    quotientForm D (targetGen D i g) (targetWord D i l) =
      quotientForm D (sourceGen D i g) (sourceWord D i l)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : l.length = 1
  · cases l with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons h t =>
      cases t with
      | nil => simpa [sourceWord, targetWord, generatorWord] using generator_pairing D i g h
      | cons h' t => simp at hl
  · rw [generatorWord_pairing_zero D i (targetGen D i) (complement D i)
        (targetGen_degree D i) g l hl,
      generatorWord_pairing_zero D i (sourceGen D i) id (sourceGen_degree D i) g l hl]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.one_word_pairing
statement:
theorem one_word_pairing (l : List (Gen D i)) :
    quotientForm D 1 (targetWord D i l) = quotientForm D 1 (sourceWord D i l)
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons g l =>
    rw [one_word_pairing_zero D i (targetGen D i) (complement D i)
        (targetGen_degree D i) (g :: l) (by simp),
      one_word_pairing_zero D i (sourceGen D i) id (sourceGen_degree D i)
        (g :: l) (by simp)]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_projection
statement:
lemma projectedBraid_projection (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    projectedBraid R i (quotientSkewProjection D i x) = projectedBraid R i x
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientPlus_injective R
  rw [projectedBraid_spec, projectedBraid_spec,
    quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i
      (quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D i (quotientSkewProjection_mem D i x))]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectedBraid_of_mem R i ⟨a*b, mul_mem ha hb⟩,
    projectedBraid_of_mem R i ⟨a, ha⟩, projectedBraid_of_mem R i ⟨b, hb⟩]
  exact (braidRestriction R i).map_mul ⟨a,ha⟩ ⟨b,hb⟩

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_algebraMap
statement:
lemma projectedBraid_algebraMap (c : 𝕂) :
    projectedBraid R i (algebraMap 𝕂 _ c) = algebraMap 𝕂 _ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectedBraid_of_mem R i ⟨_, (quotientSkewGenerators D i).algebraMap_mem c⟩]
  exact (braidRestriction R i).commutes c

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_right
statement:
lemma projectedBraid_right {a : Quotient D 𝕧} (ha : a ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    quotientRDeriv D i (projectedBraid R i a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hker := (mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i a).mp ha
  apply braid_image_right R i hker
  rw [projectedBraid_spec, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i hker]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.original_compatibility
statement:
lemma original_compatibility {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    TensorProduct.map (projectedBraid R i) (projectedBraid R i) (quotientComul D x) =
      TensorProduct.map (rightProjection (D := D) i) (rightProjection (D := D) i)
        (quotientComul D (projectedBraid R i x))
proof:
:= by
  have hker := (mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i x).mp hx
  have hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) =
      quotientPlus R (projectedBraid R i x) := by
    rw [projectedBraid_spec, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i hker]
  have h := projected_braid_compatibility R i hker hxy
  have he : (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ projectedBraid R i =
      ((braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ quotientSkewProjection D i := by
    ext a
    exact projectedBraid_spec R i a
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (quotientPlus_injective R))
  have hmap : TensorProduct.map (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
      (TensorProduct.map (projectedBraid R i) (projectedBraid R i) (quotientComul D x)) =
      TensorProduct.map (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
        (TensorProduct.map (rightProjection (D := D) i) (rightProjection (D := D) i)
          (quotientComul D (projectedBraid R i x))) := by
    simpa only [TensorProduct.map_map, he] using h
  have hh := congrArg (TensorProduct.map r r) hmap
  simpa only [TensorProduct.map_map, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hr, LinearMap.id_comp] using hh

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.quotientForm_rightProjection_of_ker
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = quotientForm D (quotientSkewProjection D i (quotientRev D x)) (quotientRev D y) := by
      have h := quotientForm_rev D (quotientSkewProjection D i (quotientRev D x))
        (quotientRev D y)
      simpa only [rightProjection, LinearMap.comp_apply, quotientRev_rev] using h
    _ = quotientForm D (quotientRev D x) (quotientRev D y) :=
      quotientForm_skewProjection_of_ker D i _ (left_rev_zero i hy)
    _ = _ := quotientForm_rev D x y

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.right_projected_pair
statement:
lemma right_projected_pair (z : Quotient D 𝕧) {a b : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (ha : quotientRDeriv D i a = 0) (hb : quotientRDeriv D i b = 0) :
    (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
      (TensorProduct.map (rightProjection (D := D) i) (rightProjection (D := D) i)
        (quotientComul D z)) (a ⊗ₜ b) = quotientForm D z (a*b)
proof:
:= by
  have h (t : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) :
      (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
        (TensorProduct.map (rightProjection (D := D) i) (rightProjection (D := D) i) t)
        (a ⊗ₜ b) = (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) t (a ⊗ₜ b) := by
    induction t with
    | tmul c d =>
      simp only [map_tmul, LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul,
        quotientForm_rightProjection_of_ker i c ha, quotientForm_rightProjection_of_ker i d hb]
    | add s t hs ht => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hs, ht]
  rw [h, quotientComul_pair]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.pairing_mul_step
statement:
lemma pairing_mul_step {a b : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (ha : a ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) (hb : b ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i)
    (hfa : ∀ z ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i,
      quotientForm D (projectedBraid R i a) (projectedBraid R i z) = quotientForm D a z)
    (hfb : ∀ z ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i,
      quotientForm D (projectedBraid R i b) (projectedBraid R i z) = quotientForm D b z)
    {z : Quotient D 𝕧} (hz : z ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    quotientForm D (projectedBraid R i (a*b)) (projectedBraid R i z) =
      quotientForm D (a*b) z
proof:
:= by
  have hp (u : Quotient D 𝕧) : quotientSkewProjection D i u ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i :=
    (kernelProjection (D := D) i u).property
  have hpair (t : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) :
      (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
        (TensorProduct.map (projectedBraid R i) (projectedBraid R i) t)
        (projectedBraid R i a ⊗ₜ projectedBraid R i b) =
      (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
        (TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientSkewProjection D i) t)
        (a ⊗ₜ b) := by
    induction t with
    | tmul c d =>
      simp only [map_tmul, LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul]
      congr 1
      · rw [quotientForm_comm D _ (projectedBraid R i b),
          ← projectedBraid_projection R i d, hfb _ (hp d), quotientForm_comm]
      · rw [quotientForm_comm D _ (projectedBraid R i a),
          ← projectedBraid_projection R i c, hfa _ (hp c), quotientForm_comm]
    | add s t hs ht => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hs, ht]
  rw [projectedBraid_mul R i ha hb, quotientForm_comm D _ (projectedBraid R i z),
    ← right_projected_pair i _ (projectedBraid_right R i ha) (projectedBraid_right R i hb),
    ← original_compatibility R i hz, hpair]
  exact (projectedQuotientComul_pair D i z
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i a).mp ha)
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i b).mp hb)).trans (quotientForm_comm D z (a*b))

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_isometry
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction generalizing z with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩ := ha
    let g : Gen D i := ⟨(j,n), hij, hn⟩
    change quotientForm D (projectedBraid R i (sourceGen D i g)) (projectedBraid R i z) = _
    rw [projectedBraid_generator]
    exact generator_kernel_pairing R i g hz
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [projectedBraid_algebraMap, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, one_kernel_pairing R i hz]
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha hz, hb hz]
  | mul a b ha hb hfa hfb =>
    exact pairing_mul_step R i ha hb (fun z hz ↦ hfa hz) (fun z hz ↦ hfb hz) hz

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.restricted_braid_isometry
statement:
theorem restricted_braid_isometry {x z y w : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0) (hz : quotientLDeriv D i z = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y)
    (hzw : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R z) = quotientPlus R w) :
    quotientForm D y w = quotientForm D x z
proof:
:= by
  have hy : projectedBraid R i x = y := by
    apply quotientPlus_injective R
    rw [projectedBraid_spec, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i hx, hxy]
  have hw : projectedBraid R i z = w := by
    apply quotientPlus_injective R
    rw [projectedBraid_spec, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i hz, hzw]
  rw [← hy, ← hw]
  exact projectedBraid_isometry R i
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i x).mpr hx)
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i z).mpr hz)

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.restricted_inverse_braid_isometry
statement:
theorem restricted_inverse_braid_isometry {x z y w : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hyx : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
      (quotientPlus R y) = quotientPlus R x)
    (hwz : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
      (quotientPlus R w) = quotientPlus R z) :
    quotientForm D x z = quotientForm D y w
proof:
:= by
  apply (restricted_braid_isometry R i (inverse_positive_left R i hyx)
    (inverse_positive_left R i hwz) ?_ ?_).symm
  · rw [← hyx, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  · rw [← hwz, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.rDeriv_skewAdjoint
statement:
lemma rDeriv_skewAdjoint (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (skewAdjoint D v i x) =
      x - twist D v i (twist D v i x) +
        v ^ D.dot i i • skewAdjoint D v i (rDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [skewAdjoint_apply, map_sub, rDeriv_mul_θ, rDeriv_θ_mul,
    ite_true, rDeriv_twist, smul_sub, mul_smul_comm]
  module

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.rDeriv_skewGenerator_succ
statement:
lemma rDeriv_skewGenerator_succ {j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    rDeriv D v i (skewGenerator D v i j (n + 1)) =
      derivativeCoefficient (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.dot i j) (n + 1) •
        skewGenerator D v i j n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [skewGenerator_succ, rDeriv_skewAdjoint, skewGenerator_zero,
      rDeriv_θ, hij, ite_false, map_zero, smul_zero, add_zero, twist_θ,
      map_smul, derivativeCoefficient, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_zero]
    module
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [skewGenerator_succ, rDeriv_skewAdjoint, ih, map_smul,
      ← skewGenerator_succ, twist_skewGenerator, map_smul, twist_skewGenerator,
      smul_smul, smul_smul, zpow_dot_self]
    simp only [derivativeCoefficient]
    module

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.form_skewGenerator_succ
statement:
theorem form_skewGenerator_succ {j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    form D v (skewGenerator D v i j (n + 1)) (skewGenerator D v i j (n + 1)) =
      thetaNorm D v i * derivativeCoefficient (v ^ D.d i) (v ^ D.dot i j) (n + 1) *
        form D v (skewGenerator D v i j n) (skewGenerator D v i j n)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => arg 1; rw [skewGenerator_succ, skewAdjoint_apply]
  rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, form_mul_θ, form_θ_mul,
    lDeriv_skewGenerator D v i hij, map_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero,
    rDeriv_skewGenerator_succ D v i hij, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.derivativeCoefficient_closed
statement:
lemma derivativeCoefficient_closed (q t : k) (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    derivativeCoefficient q t (n + 1) =
      q ^ n * qInt q (n + 1) * (1 - q ^ (2 * n) * t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [derivativeCoefficient, qInt]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [derivativeCoefficient, ih, qInt_succ (n + 1)]
    have he : q ^ n * qInt q (n + 1) * (q ^ 2 - 1) = q ^ (2 * (n + 1)) - 1 := by
      have h := qInt_mul_sub (v := q) (n + 1)
      have h' := congrArg (fun z : k ↦ q ^ (n + 1) * z) h
      rw [mul_sub, ← mul_pow, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow] at h'
      simp only [pow_mul, pow_succ, mul_pow] at h' ⊢
      field_simp at h' ⊢
      linear_combination h'
    simp only [pow_mul, pow_succ] at he ⊢
    field_simp
    linear_combination he

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.exists_forward
statement:
lemma exists_forward (x : quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    ∃ y : Quotient D 𝕧,
      quotientPlus R y = braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := braid_positive_of_mem_skewGenerators R i x.property
  exact ⟨toQuotient D 𝕧 a, ha⟩

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.braidRestriction_spec
statement:
lemma braidRestriction_spec (x : quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    quotientPlus R (braidRestriction R i x) =
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x)
proof:
:=
  (exists_forward R i x).choose_spec

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_of_mem
statement:
lemma projectedBraid_of_mem (x : quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    projectedBraid R i x = braidRestriction R i x
proof:
:= by
  change braidRestriction R i (kernelProjection (D := D) i x) = braidRestriction R i x
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i x).mp x.property)

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_spec
statement:
lemma projectedBraid_spec (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientPlus R (projectedBraid R i x) =
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i
        (quotientPlus R (quotientSkewProjection D i x))
proof:
:=
  braidRestriction_spec R i (kernelProjection (D := D) i x)

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.sourceGen_mem
statement: lemma sourceGen_mem (g : Gen D i) : sourceGen D i g ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨g.val.1, g.property.1, g.val.2, g.property.2, rfl⟩

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.sourceWord_mem
statement: lemma sourceWord_mem (l : List (Gen D i)) : sourceWord D i l ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact one_mem _
  | cons g l ih => exact mul_mem (sourceGen_mem i g) ih

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_generator
statement:
lemma projectedBraid_generator (g : Gen D i) :
    projectedBraid R i (sourceGen D i g) = targetGen D i g
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientPlus_injective R
  rw [projectedBraid_spec, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i _).mp (sourceGen_mem i g))]
  simpa only [targetGen, sourceGen, complement, quotientRev_toQuotient] using
    braid_skewDividedGenerator R g.property.1 g.val.2 g.property.2

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.projectedBraid_word
statement:
lemma projectedBraid_word (l : List (Gen D i)) :
    projectedBraid R i (sourceWord D i l) = targetWord D i l
proof:
:= by
  have h (l : List (Gen D i)) :
      braidRestriction R i ⟨sourceWord D i l, sourceWord_mem i l⟩ = targetWord D i l := by
    induction l with
    | nil => exact (braidRestriction R i).map_one
    | cons g l ih =>
      change braidRestriction R i
        (⟨sourceGen D i g, sourceGen_mem i g⟩ * ⟨sourceWord D i l, sourceWord_mem i l⟩) = _
      rw [map_mul, ih]
      rw [← projectedBraid_of_mem]
      exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z * targetWord D i l) (projectedBraid_generator R i g)
  rw [projectedBraid_of_mem R i ⟨_, sourceWord_mem i l⟩]
  exact h l

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.mem_sourceWord_span
statement:
theorem mem_sourceWord_span {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (sourceWord D i))
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : ∀ a ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (sourceWord D i)),
      ∀ b ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (sourceWord D i)),
      a * b ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (sourceWord D i)) := by
    intro a ha b hb
    induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := ha
      induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem b hb =>
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hb
        have he : sourceWord D i (l ++ m) = sourceWord D i l * sourceWord D i m := by
          induction l with
          | nil => simp [sourceWord, generatorWord]
          | cons g l ih =>
            simpa [sourceWord, generatorWord, mul_assoc] using
              congrArg (fun z ↦ sourceGen D i g * z) ih
        rw [← he]
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨l ++ m, rfl⟩
      | zero => simp
      | add b c _ _ hb hc => simpa only [mul_add] using add_mem hb hc
      | smul c b _ hb => simpa only [mul_smul_comm] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c hb
    | zero => simp
    | add a c _ _ ha hc => simpa only [add_mul] using add_mem ha hc
    | smul c a _ ha => simpa only [smul_mul_assoc] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    let g : Gen D i := ⟨(j,n), hij, hn⟩
    have he : sourceWord D i [g] = toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j n) :=
      mul_one _
    rw [← he]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨[g], rfl⟩
  | algebraMap c =>
    have h := Submodule.subset_span (R := 𝕂) (s := Set.range (sourceWord D i)) ⟨[], rfl⟩
    simpa only [sourceWord, generatorWord, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one] using
      Submodule.smul_mem _ c h
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => exact add_mem ha hb
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb => exact hmul a ha b hb

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.generator_kernel_pairing
statement:
lemma generator_kernel_pairing (g : Gen D i) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    quotientForm D (targetGen D i g) (projectedBraid R i x) =
      quotientForm D (sourceGen D i g) x
proof:
:= by
  have hs := mem_sourceWord_span i hx
  clear hx
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [projectedBraid_word]
    exact generator_word_pairing D i g l
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | smul c a _ ha => simp only [map_smul, ha]

name: RestrictedBraidIsometry.one_kernel_pairing
statement:
lemma one_kernel_pairing {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    quotientForm D 1 (projectedBraid R i x) = quotientForm D 1 x
proof:
:= by
  have hs := mem_sourceWord_span i hx
  clear hx
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [projectedBraid_word]
    exact one_word_pairing D i l
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | smul c a _ ha => simp only [map_smul, ha]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_neg_one_pow_qBinomial
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_qBinomial (hq : q ≠ 0) (n m : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ range (m + 1), (-1) ^ s * q ^ (-((s : ℤ) * n)) * qBinomial q (n + 1) s =
      (-1) ^ m * q ^ (-((m : ℤ) * (n + 1))) * qBinomial q n m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih, qBinomial_succ_succ]
    rcases le_or_gt m n with h | h
    · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
      rw [show m + c - m = c by omega, inv_pow, ← zpow_natCast q c, ← zpow_natCast q (m + 1),
        ← zpow_neg]
      have e1 : q ^ (-(((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((m + c : ℕ) : ℤ))) * q ^ (-((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          q ^ (-(((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((m + c : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ))) := by
        rw [← zpow_add₀ hq]; push_cast; ring_nf
      have e2 : q ^ (-(((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((m + c : ℕ) : ℤ))) * q ^ (c : ℤ) =
          q ^ (-((m : ℤ) * ((m + c : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ))) := by
        rw [← zpow_add₀ hq]; push_cast; ring_nf
      rw [pow_succ]
      linear_combination (-(-1) ^ m * qBinomial q (m + c) (m + 1)) * e1 +
        (-(-1) ^ m * qBinomial q (m + c) m) * e2
    · rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q h, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q (by omega : n < m + 1)]
      ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qFactorial_mul_eq (q : k) (l p : ℕ) :
    qFactorial q (l * p) =
      (∏ j ∈ range p, qBinomial q (l * (j + 1)) l) * qFactorial q l ^ p
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ p ih =>
    have h := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q)
      (show l ≤ l * (p + 1) from Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right l (Nat.succ_pos p))
    rw [show l * (p + 1) - l = l * p by rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_sub_cancel], ih] at h
    rw [← h, prod_range_succ, pow_succ]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.prod_qBinomial_mul_root
statement:
theorem prod_qBinomial_mul_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (p : ℕ) :
    ∏ j ∈ range p, qBinomial q (l * (j + 1)) l = (p.factorial : k) * q ^ (l ^ 2 * p.choose 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ p ih =>
    have hb := qBinomInt_mul_mul hq hl hprim hl0 ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) 1
    rw [← Nat.cast_mul, mul_one, qBinomInt_natCast, Ring.choose_natCast, Nat.choose_one_right]
      at hb
    rw [prod_range_succ, ih, hb, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.choose_one_right]
    have e : q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * (((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) * ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = q ^ (l ^ 2 * p) := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast]
      refine zpow_eq_of_dvd hq hl ⟨l, ?_⟩
      push_cast; ring
    rw [e]
    push_cast
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomial_root
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomial_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) {r a : ℕ} (hra : r ≤ a) (hal : a < l) :
    ∑ s ∈ range (l - a), (-1) ^ (l - r + 1 + s) *
        q ^ (-(((l : ℤ) - r) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1 + s)) + s) * qBinomial q (l - r) s =
      q ^ ((l : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) * qBinomial q a r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, l - r = n + 1 := ⟨l - r - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, l - a = m + 1 := ⟨l - a - 1, by omega⟩
  have hlr : (l : ℤ) - r = n + 1 := by omega
  
  have hsum : ∑ s ∈ range (l - a), (-1) ^ (l - r + 1 + s) *
        q ^ (-(((l : ℤ) - r) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1 + s)) + s) * qBinomial q (l - r) s =
      (-1) ^ n * q ^ (-(((n : ℤ) + 1) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1))) *
        ∑ s ∈ range (m + 1), (-1) ^ s * q ^ (-((s : ℤ) * n)) * qBinomial q (n + 1) s := by
    rw [hm, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hn, hlr, show n + 1 + 1 + s = n + s + 2 by ring, pow_add, pow_add]
    have : q ^ (-(((n : ℤ) + 1) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1 + s)) + s) =
        q ^ (-(((n : ℤ) + 1) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1))) * q ^ (-((s : ℤ) * n)) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hq]; ring_nf
    rw [this]
    ring
  rw [hsum, sum_neg_one_pow_qBinomial hq]
  
  have hsymm : qBinomial q n m = qBinomial q n (a - r) := by
    rw [← qBinomial_symm q (show a - r ≤ n by omega), show n - (a - r) = m by omega]
  have hvd := qBinomInt_add hq (l : ℤ) (Int.negSucc r) (a - r)
  rw [show (l : ℤ) + Int.negSucc r = (n : ℕ) by rw [Int.negSucc_eq]; omega,
    qBinomInt_natCast, sum_eq_single 0] at hvd
  · rw [qBinomInt_negSucc, show r + (a - r - 0) = a by omega, Nat.sub_zero,
      qBinomial_symm q hra] at hvd
    rw [hsymm, hvd]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, qBinomInt_zero_right, mul_one]
    have e : q ^ (-(((n : ℤ) + 1) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1))) * q ^ (-((m : ℤ) * (n + 1))) = 1 := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hq, ← zpow_zero q]
      congr 1
      have : (m : ℤ) = l - a - 1 := by omega
      rw [this]; ring
    have es : ((-1 : k) ^ n * (-1) ^ m * (-1) ^ (a - r)) = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, show n + m + (a - r) = 2 * (l - r - 1) by omega, pow_mul]
      simp
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hra]
    linear_combination (q ^ ((l : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) * qBinomial q a r) *
      ((-1) ^ n * (-1) ^ m * (-1) ^ (a - r) * e + es)
  · intro i hi hi0
    have hil : i < l := by have := mem_range.1 hi; omega
    rw [qBinomInt_natCast, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_root hq hl hprim (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi0) hil]
    ring
  · intro h
    exact absurd (mem_range.2 (Nat.succ_pos _)) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.root_hyps'
statement:
private lemma root_hyps' (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) :
    algebraMap R (FractionRing R) v ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap R (FractionRing R) v ^ (2 * l) = 1 ∧
      ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → algebraMap R (FractionRing R) v ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  refine ⟨(v.isUnit.map _).ne_zero, by rw [← map_pow, hl, map_one], fun t h0 ht h ↦ ?_⟩
  exact hprim t h0 ht (hinj (by rw [map_pow, h, map_one]))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.prod_qBinomialU_mul_root
statement:
theorem prod_qBinomialU_mul_root (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (p : ℕ) :
    ∏ j ∈ range p, qBinomialU v (l * (j + 1)) l =
      (p.factorial : R) * (v : R) ^ (l ^ 2 * p.choose 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := root_hyps' hl hprim
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  simp only [map_prod, map_qBinomialU, map_mul, map_natCast, map_pow]
  exact prod_qBinomial_mul_root h0 h1 h2 hl0 p

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomialU_root
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomialU_root (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) {r a : ℕ} (hra : r ≤ a)
    (hal : a < l) :
    ∑ s ∈ range (l - a), (-1) ^ (l - r + 1 + s) *
        ((v ^ (-(((l : ℤ) - r) * ((a : ℤ) - l + 1 + s)) + s) : Rˣ) : R) *
          qBinomialU v (l - r) s =
      ((v ^ ((l : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) : Rˣ) : R) * qBinomialU v a r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := root_hyps' hl hprim
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, map_units_zpow, map_qBinomialU]
  exact sum_qBinomial_root h0 h1 h2 hra hal

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_mul_mul_eq_pow
statement:
theorem gaussBinom_mul_mul_eq_pow (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    gaussBinom v (l * a₁) (l * t₁) = gaussBinom (v ^ (l ^ 2)) a₁ t₁
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (((v ^ (l ^ 2) : Rˣ) : R)) ^ (2 * 1) = 1 := by
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← pow_mul, show l ^ 2 * (2 * 1) = 2 * l * l by ring, pow_mul,
      hl, one_pow]
  have h := gaussBinom_mul_mul (v := v ^ (l ^ 2)) h1 (fun t h0 ht ↦ by omega) one_pos a₁ t₁
  rw [Nat.cast_one, one_mul, one_mul] at h
  rw [h, gaussBinom_mul_mul hl hprim hl0, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_natCast
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomInt_natCast (n t : ℕ) : qBinomInt q n t = qBinomial q n t
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_negSucc
statement:
lemma qBinomInt_negSucc (n t : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (Int.negSucc n) t = (-1) ^ t * qBinomial q (n + t) t
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomInt_zero_right (a : ℤ) : qBinomInt q a 0 = 1
proof:
