  cases a <;> simp [qBinomInt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_inv
statement: lemma qBinomInt_inv (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) : qBinomInt q⁻¹ a t = qBinomInt q a t
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> simp [qBinomInt, qBinomial_inv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_qBinomIntSeries
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_qBinomIntSeries (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    coeff t (qBinomIntSeries q a) = qBinomInt q a t
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | ofNat n => simp [qBinomIntSeries, qBinomInt]
  | negSucc n =>
    simp only [qBinomIntSeries, coeff_qBinomialInvSeries, qBinomInt]
    rw [show n + 1 + t - 1 = n + t by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomIntSeries_zero : qBinomIntSeries q 0 = 1
proof: := qBinomialSeries_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialInvSeries_inv
statement: lemma qBinomialInvSeries_inv (h : ℕ) : qBinomialInvSeries q⁻¹ h = qBinomialInvSeries q h
proof:
:= by
  ext n; simp [qBinomial_inv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_C'
statement: lemma rescale_C' (a c : k) : rescale a (C c) = C c
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n <;> simp [coeff_rescale, coeff_C]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_add_one
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (a : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (a + 1) = (1 + C (q ^ a) * X) * rescale q⁻¹ (qBinomIntSeries q a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with n | _ | n
  · rw [show (Int.ofNat n : ℤ) + 1 = Int.ofNat (n + 1) from rfl]
    simp only [qBinomIntSeries, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    exact qBinomialSeries_succ hq n
  · 
    have h := congrArg (rescale q⁻¹) (qBinomialInvSeries_succ_mul (q := q) 0)
    simp only [qBinomialInvSeries_zero, map_one, map_mul, map_add, rescale_X, pow_zero] at h
    change qBinomIntSeries q 0 =
      (1 + C (q ^ Int.negSucc 0) * X) * rescale q⁻¹ (qBinomialInvSeries q 1)
    rw [qBinomIntSeries_zero, zpow_negSucc, pow_one]
    linear_combination -h
  · have h := congrArg (rescale q⁻¹) (qBinomialInvSeries_succ_mul (q := q⁻¹) (n + 1))
    simp only [qBinomialInvSeries_inv, inv_inv, map_mul, map_add, map_one, rescale_X,
      rescale_C', rescale_rescale, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, rescale_one,
      RingHom.id_apply] at h
    rw [show Int.negSucc (n + 1) + 1 = Int.negSucc n by omega]
    simp only [qBinomIntSeries]
    have hc : C (q ^ Int.negSucc (n + 1)) = (C (q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)) * C q⁻¹ : PowerSeries k) := by
      rw [← map_mul, zpow_negSucc, ← pow_succ, inv_pow]
    rw [hc]
    linear_combination -h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_qBinomIntSeries_add_one
statement:
lemma rescale_qBinomIntSeries_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b : ℤ) :
    rescale (q ^ (-(b + 1))) (qBinomIntSeries q a) * rescale (q ^ a) (qBinomIntSeries q (b + 1)) =
      (1 + C (q ^ (a + b)) * X) * rescale q⁻¹
        (rescale (q ^ (-b)) (qBinomIntSeries q a) * rescale (q ^ a) (qBinomIntSeries q b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomIntSeries_add_one hq b]
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_one, rescale_X, rescale_C', rescale_rescale]
  have e1 : q ^ (-b) * q⁻¹ = q ^ (-(b + 1)) := by rw [neg_add, zpow_add₀ hq, zpow_neg_one]
  have e3 : C (q ^ (a + b)) = (C (q ^ b) * C (q ^ a) : PowerSeries k) := by
    rw [← map_mul, zpow_add₀ hq, mul_comm]
  rw [e1, e3, mul_comm q⁻¹ (q ^ a)]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_add
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_add (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (a + b) =
      rescale (q ^ (-b)) (qBinomIntSeries q a) * rescale (q ^ a) (qBinomIntSeries q b)
proof:
:= by
  induction b using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [rescale_one]
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, qBinomIntSeries_add_one hq, ih, rescale_qBinomIntSeries_add_one hq]
  | pred i ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℤ, -(i : ℤ) = c + 1 := ⟨-(i : ℤ) - 1, by ring⟩
    rw [show -(i : ℤ) - 1 = c by omega]
    rw [hc, ← add_assoc, qBinomIntSeries_add_one hq, rescale_qBinomIntSeries_add_one hq] at ih
    have hne : (1 + C (q ^ (a + c)) * X : PowerSeries k) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := congrArg constantCoeff h0
      simp at this
    have h2 := congrArg (rescale q) (mul_left_cancel₀ hne ih)
    simpa only [rescale_rescale, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, rescale_one, RingHom.id_apply] using h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_add
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_add (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (a + b) t = ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1),
      q ^ (a * (t - i : ℕ) - b * i) * qBinomInt q a i * qBinomInt q b (t - i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_qBinomIntSeries, qBinomIntSeries_add hq, coeff_mul,
    Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [coeff_rescale, coeff_qBinomIntSeries]
  have h : (q ^ (-b)) ^ i * (q ^ a) ^ (t - i) = q ^ (a * (t - i : ℕ) - b * i) := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
    ring_nf
  linear_combination (qBinomInt q a i * qBinomInt q b (t - i)) * h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_eq_zero_of_root
statement:
theorem qBinomial_eq_zero_of_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) {t : ℕ} (ht0 : 0 < t) (htl : t < l) :
    qBinomial q l t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) htl.le
  obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ : ∃ l', l = l' + 1 := ⟨l - 1, by omega⟩
  have hsub : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hprim 1 one_pos (by omega)
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    rw [mul_one, sq]
    nth_rewrite 2 [h]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hq
  have hint : qInt q (l' + 1) = 0 := by
    have h := qInt_mul_sub (v := q) (l' + 1)
    have h2 : q⁻¹ ^ (l' + 1) = q ^ (l' + 1) := by
      rw [inv_pow, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, eq_comm, inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left]
      rw [← pow_add, ← two_mul, hl]
    rw [h2, sub_self] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_left hsub
  rw [qFactorial_succ, hint, zero_mul] at key
  have hf : ∀ n, n < l' + 1 → qFactorial q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qFactorial_ne_zero (v := q) hq fun m hm hmn ↦ hprim m hm (by omega)
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 key with h | h
  · exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right (hf t htl)
  · exact absurd h (hf _ (by omega))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_eq_of_root
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_eq_of_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) :
    qBinomIntSeries q l = 1 + X ^ l
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_qBinomIntSeries, qBinomInt_natCast, map_add, coeff_one, coeff_X_pow]
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy n l with h | rfl | h
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp [hl0.ne]
    · simp [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_root hq hl hprim hn h, hn.ne', h.ne]
  · simp [hl0.ne']
  · simp [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q h, h.ne', show n ≠ 0 by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_eq_of_dvd
statement:
lemma zpow_eq_of_dvd (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1) {z z' : ℤ}
    (h : 2 * (l : ℤ) ∣ z - z') : q ^ z = q ^ z'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h
  rw [show z = z' + 2 * l * w by omega, zpow_add₀ hq, zpow_mul, show (2 * (l : ℤ)) = (2 * l : ℕ)
    by push_cast; ring, zpow_natCast, hl, one_zpow, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_expand
statement:
lemma rescale_expand (c : k) (f : PowerSeries k) (hl0 : 0 < l) :
    rescale c (expand l hl0.ne' f) = expand l hl0.ne' (rescale (c ^ l) f)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_rescale, coeff_expand, coeff_expand]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hl0, coeff_rescale, pow_mul]
  · rw [mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootSeries_zero
statement: lemma rootSeries_zero (hl0 : 0 < l) : rootSeries q l hl0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootSeries]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_one_add_X_pow
statement:
lemma rescale_one_add_X_pow (c : k) :
    rescale c (1 + X ^ l : PowerSeries k) = 1 + C (c ^ l) * X ^ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, map_one, map_pow, rescale_X, mul_pow, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootSeries_add_one
statement:
lemma rootSeries_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (m : ℤ) :
    rootSeries q l hl0 (m + 1) =
      rescale (q ^ (-(l : ℤ))) (rootSeries q l hl0 m) *
        (1 + C (q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * m)) * X ^ l)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : binomialSeries k ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (1 + X : PowerSeries k) := by
    rw [binomialSeries_nat, pow_one]
  rw [Nat.cast_one] at h1
  simp only [rootSeries]
  rw [rescale_expand _ _ hl0, binomialSeries_add, h1, map_mul, map_mul, rescale_rescale,
    map_add, map_one, rescale_X, map_add, map_one, map_mul, expand_C, expand_X]
  congr 2
  · congr 1
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
    congr 1
    exact zpow_eq_of_dvd hq hl ⟨l, by ring⟩
  · rw [zpow_eq_of_dvd hq hl (z := (l : ℤ) ^ 2 * (m + 1 + 1)) (z' := (l : ℤ) ^ 2 * m)
      ⟨l, by ring⟩]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_mul_add_one
statement:
lemma qBinomIntSeries_mul_add_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (m : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (l * (m + 1)) = rescale (q ^ (-(l : ℤ))) (qBinomIntSeries q (l * m)) *
      (1 + C (q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * m)) * X ^ l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_add_one, qBinomIntSeries_add hq, qBinomIntSeries_eq_of_root hq hl hprim hl0,
    rescale_one_add_X_pow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
  congr 4
  ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomIntSeries_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qBinomIntSeries_mul_eq (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (m : ℤ) :
    qBinomIntSeries q (l * m) = rootSeries q l hl0 m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [mul_zero, qBinomIntSeries_zero, rootSeries_zero]
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [qBinomIntSeries_mul_add_one hq hl hprim hl0, ih, rootSeries_add_one hq hl hl0]
  | pred i ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℤ, -(i : ℤ) = c + 1 := ⟨-(i : ℤ) - 1, by ring⟩
    rw [show -(i : ℤ) - 1 = c by omega]
    rw [hc, qBinomIntSeries_mul_add_one hq hl hprim hl0, rootSeries_add_one hq hl hl0] at ih
    have hne : (1 + C (q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * c)) * X ^ l : PowerSeries k) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := congrArg constantCoeff h0
      simp [hl0.ne'] at this
    have h2 := congrArg (rescale (q ^ (l : ℤ))) (mul_right_cancel₀ hne ih)
    simpa only [rescale_rescale, ← zpow_add₀ hq, neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, rescale_one,
      RingHom.id_apply] using h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a : ℤ} (ha : (l : ℤ) ∣ a)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : ¬ l ∣ t) : qBinomInt q a t = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ha
  rw [← coeff_qBinomIntSeries, qBinomIntSeries_mul_eq hq hl hprim hl0, rootSeries,
    coeff_expand_of_not_dvd _ _ _ ht]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_mul_mul
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_mul_mul (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (l * a₁) (l * t₁) =
      q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * (a₁ + 1) * t₁) * ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_qBinomIntSeries, qBinomIntSeries_mul_eq hq hl hprim hl0, rootSeries,
    coeff_expand_mul, coeff_rescale, binomialSeries_coeff, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul,
    zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul_eq (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a₀ t₀ : ℕ} (ha₀ : a₀ < l)
    (ht₀ : t₀ < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (a₀ + l * a₁) (t₀ + l * t₁) =
      q ^ ((l : ℤ) * a₀ * t₁ - l * a₁ * t₀) * qBinomial q a₀ t₀ *
        qBinomInt q (l * a₁) (l * t₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomInt_add hq, sum_eq_single t₀]
  · rw [qBinomInt_natCast, show t₀ + l * t₁ - t₀ = l * t₁ by omega]
    congr 3
    push_cast
    ring
  · intro i hi hit
    rcases lt_or_ge a₀ i with h | h
    · rw [qBinomInt_natCast, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q h, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · rw [qBinomInt_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hq hl hprim hl0 (dvd_mul_right _ _), mul_zero]
      rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      have hi' : i ≤ t₀ + l * t₁ := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hi)
      have e : t₀ + l * t₁ = i + l * c := by omega
      have := congrArg (· % l) e
      simp only [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ht₀,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (h.trans_lt ha₀)] at this
      exact hit this.symm
  · intro h
    exact absurd (mem_range.2 (by omega)) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul
statement:
theorem qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a₀ t₀ : ℕ} (ha₀ : a₀ < l)
    (ht₀ : t₀ < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (a₀ + l * a₁) (t₀ + l * t₁) =
      q ^ ((a₀ * t₁ - a₁ * t₀) * l + (a₁ + 1) * t₁ * (l : ℤ) ^ 2) * qBinomial q a₀ t₀ *
        ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul_eq hq hl hprim hl0 ha₀ ht₀,
    qBinomInt_mul_mul hq hl hprim hl0]
  have : q ^ ((a₀ * t₁ - a₁ * t₀) * l + (a₁ + 1) * t₁ * (l : ℤ) ^ 2) =
      q ^ ((l : ℤ) * a₀ * t₁ - l * a₁ * t₀) * q ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * (a₁ + 1) * t₁) := by
    rw [← zpow_add₀ hq]
    ring_nf
  rw [this]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_sq_add_eq
statement:
theorem pow_sq_add_eq (hl : q ^ (2 * l) = 1) (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1)
    (hl0 : 0 < l) : q ^ (l ^ 2 + l) = (-1) ^ (l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hε : (q ^ l) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, hl]
  rw [show l ^ 2 + l = l * (l + 1) by ring, pow_mul]
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd l with ⟨m, rfl⟩ | ⟨m, rfl⟩
  · have hm : q ^ (m + m) ≠ 1 := by
      rw [← two_mul]; exact hprim m (by omega) (by omega)
    have h1 : q ^ (m + m) = -1 := by
      have : (q ^ (m + m) - 1) * (q ^ (m + m) + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination hε
      exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
        ((mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.2 hm))
    rw [h1]
  · rw [show 2 * m + 1 + 1 = 2 * (m + 1) by ring, pow_mul, pow_mul, hε]
    simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_natCast
statement: @[simp] lemma gaussBinom_natCast (n t : ℕ) : gaussBinom v n t = qBinomialU v n t
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialU_map
statement:
lemma qBinomialU_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (n t : ℕ) :
    φ (qBinomialU v n t) = qBinomialU (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom v) n t
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing t with
  | zero => cases t <;> simp [qBinomialU]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases t with
    | zero => simp [qBinomialU]
    | succ t =>
      simp [qBinomialU, ih, Units.coe_map_inv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_gaussBinom
statement:
lemma map_gaussBinom {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    φ (gaussBinom v a t) = gaussBinom (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom v) a t
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> simp [gaussBinom, qBinomialU_map]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_gaussBinom_field
statement:
lemma map_gaussBinom_field {k : Type*} [Field k] (φ : R →+* k) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    φ (gaussBinom v a t) = qBinomInt (φ v) a t
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> simp [gaussBinom, qBinomInt, map_qBinomialU]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_units_zpow
statement:
lemma map_units_zpow {k : Type*} [Field k] (φ : R →+* k) (z : ℤ) :
    φ ((v ^ z : Rˣ) : R) = φ v ^ z
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | ofNat n => simp
  | negSucc n =>
    rw [zpow_negSucc, zpow_negSucc, map_units_inv, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.root_hyps
statement:
private lemma root_hyps (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) :
    algebraMap R (FractionRing R) v ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap R (FractionRing R) v ^ (2 * l) = 1 ∧
      ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → algebraMap R (FractionRing R) v ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  refine ⟨(v.isUnit.map _).ne_zero, by rw [← map_pow, hl, map_one], fun t h0 ht h ↦ ?_⟩
  exact hprim t h0 ht (hinj (by rw [map_pow, h, map_one]))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := root_hyps hl hprim
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  rw [map_gaussBinom_field, map_zero, qBinomInt_eq_zero_of_not_dvd h0 h1 h2 hl0 ha ht]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_mul_mul
statement:
theorem gaussBinom_mul_mul (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    gaussBinom v (l * a₁) (l * t₁) =
      ((v ^ ((l : ℤ) ^ 2 * (a₁ + 1) * t₁) : Rˣ) : R) * ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := root_hyps hl hprim
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  rw [map_gaussBinom_field, map_mul, map_units_zpow, map_intCast,
    qBinomInt_mul_mul h0 h1 h2 hl0]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.gaussBinom_add_mul_add_mul
statement:
theorem gaussBinom_add_mul_add_mul (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) {a₀ t₀ : ℕ}
    (ha₀ : a₀ < l) (ht₀ : t₀ < l) (a₁ : ℤ) (t₁ : ℕ) :
    gaussBinom v (a₀ + l * a₁) (t₀ + l * t₁) =
      ((v ^ ((a₀ * t₁ - a₁ * t₀) * l + (a₁ + 1) * t₁ * (l : ℤ) ^ 2) : Rˣ) : R) *
        gaussBinom v a₀ t₀ * ((Ring.choose a₁ t₁ : ℤ) : R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := root_hyps hl hprim
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  rw [map_gaussBinom_field, map_mul, map_mul, map_units_zpow, map_intCast,
    map_gaussBinom_field, qBinomInt_natCast, qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul h0 h1 h2 hl0 ha₀ ht₀]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_sq_add_eq_of_root
statement:
theorem pow_sq_add_eq_of_root (hl : (v : R) ^ (2 * l) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < l → (v : R) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hl0 : 0 < l) :
    (v : R) ^ (l ^ 2 + l) = (-1) ^ (l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ := root_hyps hl hprim
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)
  rw [map_pow, pow_sq_add_eq h1 h2 hl0, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]

name: FiniteIntertwining.km_F_pow
statement:
lemma km_F_pow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    K R v (-ktilde R i) * F R v i ^ n =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * n) • (F R v i ^ n * K R v (-ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
      K_neg_ktilde_mul_F, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ,
      smul_smul, ← pow_add]
    congr 2

name: FiniteIntertwining.E_term
statement:
lemma E_term (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + K R v (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) *
        ((F R v i ^ (n + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (n + 1))) -
      ((F R v i ^ (n + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (n + 1))) *
        (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) =
      (qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹) •
        ((F R v i ^ n * ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ n • Kt R v i -
          (v ^ D.d i) ^ n • K R v (-ktilde R i))) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (n + 1))) +
      ((F R v i ^ (n + 1) * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (2*(n + 1)) • K R v (-ktilde R i) -
          Kt R v i)) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (n + 1+1)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [add_mul, mul_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul, mul_one]
  rw [← pow_succ', ← pow_succ, km_F_pow]
  have h := congrArg (fun z : QuantumGroup R v ↦ z ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (n + 1)))
    (E_mul_F_pow_sub (R := R) hv i n)
  simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, sub_tmul, ← smul_tmul', smul_sub, smul_smul] at h ⊢
  rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n+2 by omega, ← h]
  abel

name: FiniteIntertwining.coeff_cancel
statement:
lemma coeff_cancel {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : qInt q (n + 1) ≠ 0) :
    coeff q (n + 1) * (qInt q (n + 1) * (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹) * q⁻¹ ^ n = coeff q n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff, div_eq_mul_inv]
  calc
    _ = coeff q n * ((q - q⁻¹)*(q - q⁻¹)⁻¹) *
        (qInt q (n + 1) * (qInt q (n + 1))⁻¹) * (q^n * q⁻¹^n) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hd, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn, ← mul_pow,
                    mul_inv_cancel₀ hq]; simp

name: FiniteIntertwining.coeff_cancel'
statement:
lemma coeff_cancel' {q : k} (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : qInt q (n + 1) ≠ 0) :
    coeff q (n + 1) * (qInt q (n + 1) * (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹) * q ^ n =
      coeff q n * q ^ (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff, div_eq_mul_inv]
  calc
    _ = coeff q n * ((q - q⁻¹)*(q - q⁻¹)⁻¹) *
        (qInt q (n + 1) * (qInt q (n + 1))⁻¹) * q^(2 * n) := by rw [two_mul, pow_add]; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hd, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn]; simp

name: FiniteIntertwining.coeff_E_term
statement:
lemma coeff_E_term (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I)
    (hd : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) ≠ 0) :
    (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + K R v (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) *
        (coeff (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) • ((F R v i ^ (n + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (n + 1)))) -
      (coeff (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) • ((F R v i ^ (n + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (n + 1)))) *
        (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) =
      coeff (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) • boundaryE R v i (n + 1) -
        coeff (v ^ D.d i) n • boundaryE R v i n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← smul_sub, E_term R v hv]
  simp only [boundaryE, smul_add, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, sub_tmul, ← smul_tmul',
    smul_sub, smul_smul]
  have h1 := coeff_cancel (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hd n hn
  have h2 := coeff_cancel' hd n hn
  simp only [mul_assoc] at h1 h2 ⊢
  rw [h1, h2]
  abel

name: FiniteIntertwining.partialSum_E
statement:
theorem partialSum_E (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I)
    (hd : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ n, qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + K R v (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) *
        partialSum R v i N -
      partialSum R v i N *
        (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) =
      coeff (v ^ D.d i) N • boundaryE R v i N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    simp [partialSum, coeff, boundaryE, sub_tmul, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def,
      add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
  | succ N ih =>
    have hs : partialSum R v i (N + 1) = partialSum R v i N +
        coeff (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1) • ((F R v i ^ (N + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ (N + 1))) := by
      exact Finset.sum_range_succ _ _
    rw [hs, mul_add, add_mul (partialSum R v i N)]
    have ht := coeff_E_term R v hv i hd N (hn N)
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at ih ht
    rw [ih, ht]
    abel

name: FiniteIntertwining.flipChevalley_tmul
statement:
lemma flipChevalley_tmul (a b : QuantumGroup R v) :
    flipChevalley R v (a ⊗ₜ[k] b) = chevalley R v b ⊗ₜ[k] chevalley R v a
proof:
:= by
  simp [flipChevalley]

name: FiniteIntertwining.flipChevalley_partialSum
statement:
lemma flipChevalley_partialSum (i : I) (N : ℕ) :
    flipChevalley R v (partialSum R v i N) = partialSum R v i N
proof:
:= by
  simp [partialSum, flipChevalley_tmul]

name: FiniteIntertwining.partialSum_F
statement:
theorem partialSum_F (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I)
    (hd : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ n, qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    (F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] Kt R v i + (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v i) *
        partialSum R v i N -
      partialSum R v i N *
        (F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R i) + (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v i) =
      coeff (v ^ D.d i) N • ((F R v i ^ (N + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k]
        (E R v i ^ N * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * N) • Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i))))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (flipChevalley R v) (partialSum_E R v hv i hd hn N)
  simpa [map_sub, map_mul, map_add, flipChevalley_partialSum, flipChevalley_tmul,
    boundaryE, Kt, add_comm] using h

name: FiniteIntertwining.partialSum_K
statement:
theorem partialSum_K (hv : v ≠ 0) (i : I) (μ : Y) (N : ℕ) :
    (K R v μ ⊗ₜ[k] K R v μ) * partialSum R v i N =
      partialSum R v i N * (K R v μ ⊗ₜ[k] K R v μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Commute (K R v μ ⊗ₜ[k] K R v μ) (F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) := by
    change _ * _ = _ * _
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
      K_mul_F, K_mul_E, ← smul_tmul', ← tmul_smul, smul_smul,
      ← zpow_add₀ hv, neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]
  unfold partialSum
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  exact congrArg (coeff (v ^ D.d i) n • ·)
    (by simpa only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow] using (h.pow_right n).eq)

name: FiniteIntertwining.curly_eq
statement: lemma curly_eq (q : k) (n : ℕ) : curly q n = qFactorial q n * (q - q⁻¹) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [curly]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [curly, Finset.prod_range_succ, ← curly, ih, qFactorial_succ,
      ← qInt_mul_sub, pow_succ]
    ring

name: FiniteIntertwining.coeff_closed
statement:
lemma coeff_closed (q : k) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff q n = q ^ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range n, a) * (q - q⁻¹) ^ n / qFactorial q n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [coeff]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [coeff, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_add, pow_succ, qFactorial_succ]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
    ring

name: FiniteIntertwining.coeff_curly
statement:
lemma coeff_curly (q : k) (n : ℕ) (hn : qFactorial q n ≠ 0) :
    coeff q n = q ^ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range n, a) * curly q n * (qFactorial q n)⁻¹ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_closed, curly_eq]
  field_simp

name: FiniteIntertwining.term_divided
statement:
lemma term_divided (i : I) (n : ℕ) (hn : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0) :
    coeff (v ^ D.d i) n • ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ n)) =
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range n, a) * curly (v ^ D.d i) n) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i) ⊗ₜ[k] qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_curly _ _ hn]
  simp only [qDivPow, ← smul_tmul', ← tmul_smul, smul_smul, pow_two, mul_assoc]

name: FiniteIntertwining.braidDelta_E
statement:
lemma braidDelta_E (i : I) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (E R v i) =
      E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + K R v (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i
proof:
:= by
  let T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i
  have hT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).injective
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T)
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).symm ((comul R v) (T (E R v i)))) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hE : T (E R v i) = braidEi R i := by simpa using hT.map_E i
  have hK : ∀ μ, T (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ) := hT.map_K
  simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, hE, hK, braidEi, Kt,
    add_mul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, tmul_neg, neg_tmul, K_neg_mul_K, add_comm]

name: FiniteIntertwining.braidDelta_F
statement:
lemma braidDelta_F (i : I) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (F R v i) =
      F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] Kt R v i + (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v i
proof:
:= by
  let T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i
  have hT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).injective
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T)
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).symm ((comul R v) (T (F R v i)))) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hF : T (F R v i) = braidFi R i := by simpa using hT.map_F i
  have hK : ∀ μ, T (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ) := hT.map_K
  simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, hF, hK, braidFi, Kt,
    mul_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, tmul_neg, neg_tmul, K_neg_mul_K, add_comm]

name: FiniteIntertwining.braidDelta_K
statement:
lemma braidDelta_K (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (K R v μ) = K R v μ ⊗ₜ[k] K R v μ
proof:
:= by
  let T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i
  have hT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).injective
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T)
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).symm ((comul R v) (T (K R v μ)))) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hK : ∀ μ, T (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ) := hT.map_K
  simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, hK]

name: FiniteIntertwining.partialSum_source
statement:
theorem partialSum_source (i : I) (N : ℕ) :
    partialSum R v i N = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n * (n - 1) / 2) * curly (v ^ D.d i) n) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i) ⊗ₜ[k] qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  simpa only [Finset.sum_range_id] using
    term_divided R v i n (LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv i n)

name: FiniteIntertwining.intertwine_E
statement:
theorem intertwine_E (i : I) (N : ℕ) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (E R v i) * partialSum R v i N -
      partialSum R v i N * comul R v (E R v i) =
      coeff (v ^ D.d i) N • boundaryE R v i N
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidDelta_E, comul_E]
  exact partialSum_E R v (NeZero.ne v) i
    (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv i).sub_ne
    (fun n ↦ qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))
      (vd_pow_ne_one hv i) (Nat.succ_pos n)) N

name: FiniteIntertwining.intertwine_F
statement:
theorem intertwine_F (i : I) (N : ℕ) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (F R v i) * partialSum R v i N -
      partialSum R v i N * comul R v (F R v i) =
      coeff (v ^ D.d i) N • ((F R v i ^ (N + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k]
        (E R v i ^ N * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * N) • Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidDelta_F, comul_F]
  exact partialSum_F R v (NeZero.ne v) i
    (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv i).sub_ne
    (fun n ↦ qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))
      (vd_pow_ne_one hv i) (Nat.succ_pos n)) N

name: FiniteIntertwining.intertwine_K
statement:
theorem intertwine_K (i : I) (μ : Y) (N : ℕ) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (K R v μ) * partialSum R v i N =
      partialSum R v i N * comul R v (K R v μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidDelta_K, comul_K]
  exact partialSum_K R v (NeZero.ne v) i μ N

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_tmul
statement:
lemma lowestPair_tmul (a b : QuantumGroup R v)
    (x : VermaModule R v Λ₁) (y : VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] b) (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
      (chevalley R v a • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (chevalley R v b • y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lowestPair, TensorModule.act_tmul]

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_term_zero_of_lowerSpan
statement:
lemma lowestPair_term_zero_of_lowerSpan (i : I) (N n : ℕ)
    {x : VermaModule R v Λ₁} (hx : x ∈ VermaModule.lowerSpan R v Λ₁ i N)
    (y : VermaModule R v Λ₂) (hn : N ≤ n) :
    lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ n)) (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowestPair_tmul]
  simp only [map_pow, chevalley_F, chevalley_E]
  have he : E R v i ^ n • x = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
    rw [add_comm N r, pow_add, mul_smul,
      VermaModule.E_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_mem_lowerSpan i N hx, smul_zero]
  rw [he, zero_tmul]

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem lowestPair_eventually_zero (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ n)) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := VermaModule.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero (R := R) (v := v) i x
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [lowestPair_tmul]
    simp only [map_pow, chevalley_F, chevalley_E]
    have he : E R v i ^ n • x = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
      rw [add_comm N r, pow_add, mul_smul, hN, smul_zero]
    rw [he, zero_tmul]
  | add z w hz hw =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hw
    exact ⟨max N M, fun n hn ↦ by
      rw [map_add, hN n (le_trans (le_max_left N M) hn),
        hM n (le_trans (le_max_right N M) hn), add_zero]⟩

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_stabilizes
statement:
theorem lowestPair_stabilizes (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ M, N ≤ M →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i M) z =
        lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := lowestPair_eventually_zero R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i z
  refine ⟨N, fun M hM ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [partialSum, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (Nat.add_le_add_right hM 1))
  intro n _ hn
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hn
  rw [hN n (by omega), smul_zero]

name: FiniteIntertwining.boundaryE_factor
statement:
lemma boundaryE_factor (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    boundaryE R v i n =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * n) •
        (((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ n)) * (K R v (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i)) -
        ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ n)) * (Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [boundaryE, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, ← pow_succ,
    mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, sub_tmul, ← smul_tmul']

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_boundaryE_eventually
statement:
theorem lowestPair_boundaryE_eventually (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (boundaryE R v i n) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := lowestPair_eventually_zero R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i
    (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (K R v (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) z)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := lowestPair_eventually_zero R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i
    (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) z)
  refine ⟨max N M, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [boundaryE_factor]
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply, hN n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn),
    hM n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn), smul_zero, sub_zero]

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_boundaryF_eventually
statement:
theorem lowestPair_boundaryF_eventually (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂
      ((F R v i ^ (n + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k]
        (E R v i ^ n * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * n) • Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)))) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := lowestPair_eventually_zero R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i
    (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] Kt R v i) z)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := lowestPair_eventually_zero R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i
    (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R i)) z)
  refine ⟨max N M, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  have hf : ((F R v i ^ (n + 1)) ⊗ₜ[k]
        (E R v i ^ n * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * n) • Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)))) =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * n) •
        (((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ n)) * (F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] Kt R v i)) -
        ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (E R v i ^ n)) * (F R v i ⊗ₜ[k] K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, ← pow_succ,
      mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, tmul_sub, tmul_smul]
  rw [hf]
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply, hN n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn),
    hM n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn), smul_zero, sub_zero]

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_intertwine_E
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_E (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i (E R v i))
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i n) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i n)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (E R v i)) z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := lowestPair_boundaryE_eventually R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i z
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun a ↦ lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ a z) (intertwine_E R v hv i n)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply, hN n hn, smul_zero, sub_eq_zero] using h

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_intertwine_F
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_F (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i (F R v i))
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i n) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i n)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (F R v i)) z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := lowestPair_boundaryF_eventually R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i z
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun a ↦ lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ a z) (intertwine_F R v hv i n)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply, hN n hn, smul_zero, sub_eq_zero] using h

name: FiniteIntertwining.lowestPair_intertwine_E_pow
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_E_pow (i : I) (m : ℕ)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i (E R v i ^ m))
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i n) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i n)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (E R v i ^ m)) z)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing z with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := lowestPair_intertwine_E R v Λ₁ Λ₂ hv i z
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := ih (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (E R v i)) z)
    refine ⟨max N M, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [pow_succ, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    rw [hN n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn), hM n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)]

name: MixedIntertwining.comul_chevalley
statement:
lemma comul_chevalley (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    comul R v (chevalley R v x) = flipChevalley R v (comul R v x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (comul R v).comp (chevalley R v) =
      (flipChevalley R v).comp (comul R v) := by
    apply hom_ext
    · intro j
      simp [flipChevalley_tmul, Kt, add_comm]
    · intro j
      simp [flipChevalley_tmul, Kt, add_comm]
    · intro μ
      simp [flipChevalley_tmul]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: MixedIntertwining.comul_negativeRootString
statement:
theorem comul_negativeRootString {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : ℕ) :
    comul R v (chevalley R v (rankTwoXp R v i j m)) =
      (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] chevalley R v (rankTwoXp R v i j m) +
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m t •
            (chevalley R v (rankTwoXp R v i j t) ⊗ₜ[k]
              (F R v i ^ (m - t) * (K R v (-ktilde R i) ^ t * K R v (-ktilde R j))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_chevalley, comul_rootString R v hij]
  simp [rootTerm, flipChevalley_tmul, Kt]

name: MixedIntertwining.chevalley_rootString
statement:
lemma chevalley_rootString (i j : I) (m : ℕ) :
    chevalley R v (rankTwoXp R v i j m) =
      BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (F R v i) (F R v j) m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [rankTwoXp_zero, BraidDiagonal.X]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [rankTwoXp_succ, map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, chevalley_E, ih,
      BraidDiagonal.X_succ]

name: MixedIntertwining.comul_braid_F
statement:
theorem comul_braid_F (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    comul R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v j)) =
      ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ negA D i j *
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) •
        ((1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] chevalley R v (rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j)) +
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (negA D i j + 1),
            coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (negA D i j) t •
              (chevalley R v (rankTwoXp R v i j t) ⊗ₜ[k]
                (F R v i ^ (negA D i j - t) *
                  (K R v (-ktilde R i) ^ t * K R v (-ktilde R j)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hc : (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j *
      ((v ^ D.d i) * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  have hf : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v j) =
      ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ negA D i j *
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) • chevalley R v (rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j)) := by
    have h := (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i).map_F j
    change braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v j) = _ at h
    rw [h, ite_eq_right hij.symm, chevalley_rootString,
      BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq (pow_ne_zero _ hq), hc]
    rfl
  rw [hf, map_smul, comul_negativeRootString R v hij]

name: MixedIntertwining.braidDelta_E_offdiag_expansion
statement:
theorem braidDelta_E_offdiag_expansion (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j) =
      (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹ •
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i)
          (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i)).symm
          (rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j) ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) +
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (negA D i j + 1),
              coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (negA D i j) t •
                rootTerm R v i j (negA D i j) t)
proof:
:= by
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i)
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i)).symm
      (comul R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v j))) = _
  rw [comul_braid_E R v hv hij, map_smul]

name: MixedIntertwining.lowestPair_uniform_second_cutoff
statement:
theorem lowestPair_uniform_second_cutoff (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∀ b : QuantumGroup R v,
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] b) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := VermaModule.exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero (R := R) (v := v) i x
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn b ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [lowestPair_tmul]
    simp only [map_pow, chevalley_F]
    have he : E R v i ^ n • x = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
      rw [add_comm N r, pow_add, mul_smul, hN, smul_zero]
    rw [he, zero_tmul]
  | add z w hz hw =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hw
    exact ⟨max N M, fun n hn b ↦ by
      rw [map_add, hN n (le_trans (le_max_left N M) hn) b,
        hM n (le_trans (le_max_right N M) hn) b, add_zero]⟩

name: MixedIntertwining.lowestPair_translated_uniform_cutoff
statement:
theorem lowestPair_translated_uniform_cutoff (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) (a : QuantumGroup R v) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∀ b : QuantumGroup R v,
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ ((F R v i ^ n * a) ⊗ₜ[k] b) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := lowestPair_uniform_second_cutoff R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i
    (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) z)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn b ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := hN n hn b
  simpa only [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    mul_one] using h

name: MixedIntertwining.coproductCoeff_above
statement:
lemma coproductCoeff_above (q Q : k) {m t : ℕ} (h : m < t) :
    coproductCoeff q Q m t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing t with
  | zero => simp [coproductCoeff, Nat.ne_of_gt h]
  | succ m ih =>
    cases t with
    | zero => omega
    | succ t => simp [coproductCoeff, ih (by omega : m < t), ih (by omega : m < t + 1)]

name: MixedIntertwining.coproductCoeff_diag
statement: lemma coproductCoeff_diag (q Q : k) (m : ℕ) : coproductCoeff q Q m m = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [coproductCoeff]
  | succ m ih => simp [coproductCoeff, coproductCoeff_above q Q (Nat.lt_succ_self m), ih]

name: MixedIntertwining.root_weight
statement:
lemma root_weight {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (t : ℕ) :
    Kt R v i * rankTwoXp R v i j t =
      shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) t •
        (rankTwoXp R v i j t * Kt R v i)
proof:
:= by
  apply K_mul_X (Kt_mul_E i)
  simpa only [Kt] using
    (show K R v (ktilde R i) * E R v j =
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ • (E R v j * K R v (ktilde R i)) by
        rw [K_mul_E, zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne hij])

name: MixedIntertwining.torus_E
statement:
lemma torus_E {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (t : ℕ) :
    (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j) * E R v i =
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * t) * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹) •
        (E R v i * (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j))
proof:
:= by
  have hj : Kt R v j * E R v i =
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ • (E R v i * Kt R v j) := by
    rw [Kt, K_mul_E, root_ktilde_comm, zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne hij]
  have hi : Kt R v i ^ t * E R v i =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * t) • (E R v i * Kt R v i ^ t) := by
    induction t with
    | zero => simp
    | succ t ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, ih, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, Kt_mul_E,
        smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', ← pow_add]
      congr 2
  rw [mul_assoc, hj, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, hi, smul_mul_assoc,
    smul_smul, mul_assoc, mul_comm (((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹)]

name: MixedIntertwining.rootTerm_step
statement:
lemma rootTerm_step {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (m t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ m) :
    (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) *
        rootTerm R v i j m t -
      shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m •
        (rootTerm R v i j m t *
          (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i)) =
      (1 - (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (m + t)) *
        ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ ^ 2) • rootTerm R v i j (m + 1) t +
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (m - t)) • rootTerm R v i j (m + 1) (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hK : (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j) * Kt R v i =
      Kt R v i ^ (t + 1) * Kt R v j := by
    rw [mul_assoc, show Kt R v j * Kt R v i = Kt R v i * Kt R v j from
      K_comm R v _ _, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
  have hpow := mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul (Kt_mul_E (R := R) (v := v) i) (m - t)
  rw [← pow_mul] at hpow
  have hleftE : E R v i * (E R v i ^ (m - t) * (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j)) =
      E R v i ^ (m - t + 1) * (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
  have hrightE : (E R v i ^ (m - t) * (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j)) * E R v i =
      shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) t •
        (E R v i ^ (m - t + 1) * (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j)) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, torus_E R v hij t, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
    rfl
  have hleftK : Kt R v i * (E R v i ^ (m - t) * (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j)) =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (m - t)) •
        (E R v i ^ (m - t) * (Kt R v i ^ (t + 1) * Kt R v j)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hpow, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (Kt R v i),
      ← pow_succ']
  have hrightK : (E R v i ^ (m - t) * (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v j)) * Kt R v i =
      E R v i ^ (m - t) * (Kt R v i ^ (t + 1) * Kt R v j) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hK]
  have hmt : m + 1 - t = (m - t) + 1 := by omega
  have hmt' : m + 1 - (t + 1) = m - t := by omega
  have hs : shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (m - t)) *
        shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) t := by
    simp only [BraidDiagonal.shift]
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show 2 * (m - t) + 2 * t = 2 * m by omega]
  have hst : shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m *
      shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) t =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (m + t)) * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [BraidDiagonal.shift, mul_add, pow_add]
    ring
  simp only [rootTerm, add_mul, mul_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    mul_one, one_mul, smul_add, hmt, hmt', rankTwoXp_succ,
    hleftE, hrightE, hleftK, hrightK, tmul_sub, tmul_smul, smul_tmul',
    smul_sub, smul_smul, hst, sub_smul, one_smul]
  rw [hs]
  abel

name: MixedIntertwining.coproductCoeff_sum
statement:
lemma coproductCoeff_sum (q Q : k) (m : ℕ) (f : ℕ → M) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 2), coproductCoeff q Q (m + 1) t • f t) =
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), coproductCoeff q Q m t •
        ((1 - q ^ (2 * (m + t)) * Q⁻¹ ^ 2) • f t +
          q ^ (2 * (m - t)) • f (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hf := Finset.sum_range_succ'
    (fun t ↦ ((1 - q ^ (2 * (m + t)) * Q⁻¹ ^ 2) * coproductCoeff q Q m t) • f t)
    (m + 1)
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, coproductCoeff_above q Q (Nat.lt_succ_self m)] at hf
  simp only [mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero] at hf
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [coproductCoeff, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, smul_add, smul_smul]
  have hfirst : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      (coproductCoeff q Q m t * (1 - q ^ (2 * (m + t)) * Q⁻¹ ^ 2)) • f t) =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      ((1 - q ^ (2 * (m + t)) * Q⁻¹ ^ 2) * coproductCoeff q Q m t) • f t) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _; rw [mul_comm]
  rw [hfirst, hf]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]
  have hb : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      (q ^ (2 * (m - t)) * coproductCoeff q Q m t) • f (t + 1)) =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      (coproductCoeff q Q m t * q ^ (2 * (m - t))) • f (t + 1)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _; rw [mul_comm]
  rw [hb]
  abel

name: MixedIntertwining.comul_rootString
statement:
theorem comul_rootString [NeZero v] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : ℕ) :
    comul R v (rankTwoXp R v i j m) =
      rankTwoXp R v i j m ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) +
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m t •
            rootTerm R v i j m t
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [rankTwoXp_zero, coproductCoeff, rootTerm]
  | succ m ih =>
    have hbase :
        (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) *
            (rankTwoXp R v i j m ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) -
          shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m •
            ((rankTwoXp R v i j m ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) *
              (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i)) =
          rankTwoXp R v i j (m + 1) ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) := by
      simp only [add_mul, mul_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
        one_mul, mul_one, root_weight R v hij, smul_tmul', smul_add,
        rankTwoXp_succ, sub_tmul]
      abel
    conv_lhs => rw [rankTwoXp_succ]
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, comul_E, ih]
    rw [show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 by omega, coproductCoeff_sum]
    have hh : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m t •
          ((E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i) *
              rootTerm R v i j m t -
            shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m •
              (rootTerm R v i j m t *
                (E R v i ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) + Kt R v i ⊗ₜ[k] E R v i))) =
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m t •
            ((1 - (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (m + t)) *
              ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ ^ 2) • rootTerm R v i j (m + 1) t +
              (v ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (m - t)) • rootTerm R v i j (m + 1) (t + 1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [rootTerm_step R v hij m t (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using ht)]
    rw [← hh, ← hbase]
    simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      smul_smul, add_mul, mul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
      Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.smul_sum]
    simp only [mul_comm (BraidDiagonal.shift _ _ _) _]
    module

name: MixedIntertwining.rootString_serre
statement:
lemma rootString_serre [NeZero v] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  rw [rankTwoXp, X_eq_serreAux hq (pow_ne_zero _ hq)]
  rw [pow_succ', mul_inv_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hq (pow_ne_zero _ hq)), serreAux_one]
  simpa only [one_sub_cartanMatrix_toNat hij] using (serre_E (R := R) (v := v) hij)

name: MixedIntertwining.rootString_serre_coproduct
statement:
theorem rootString_serre_coproduct [NeZero v] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (negA D i j + 2),
      coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)
        (negA D i j + 1) t • rootTerm R v i j (negA D i j + 1) t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comul_rootString R v hij (negA D i j + 1)
  rw [rootString_serre R v hij, map_zero, zero_tmul, zero_add] at h
  exact h.symm

name: MixedIntertwining.comul_braid_E
statement:
theorem comul_braid_E [NeZero v] (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    comul R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v j)) =
      (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹ •
        (rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j) ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) +
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (negA D i j + 1),
            coproductCoeff (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (negA D i j) t •
              rootTerm R v i j (negA D i j) t)
proof:
:= by
  have h : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v j) =
      (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹ • rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j) :=
    map_E_eq_rankTwoXp (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i) hij
  rw [h, map_smul, comul_rootString R v hij]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.mem_frobWeights
statement:
lemma mem_frobWeights {ζ : Y →+ ℤ} :
    ζ ∈ R.frobWeights l ↔ ∀ i, (D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) ∣ ζ (R.coroot i)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobCoroot_apply
statement:
lemma frobCoroot_apply (i : I) (ζ : R.frobWeights l) :
    R.frobCoroot l i ζ = ζ.1 (R.coroot i) / D.frobOrder l i
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobOrder_mul_frobCoroot
statement:
lemma frobOrder_mul_frobCoroot (i : I) (ζ : R.frobWeights l) :
    (D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) * R.frobCoroot l i ζ = ζ.1 (R.coroot i)
proof:
:=
  Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (ζ.2 i)

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.coe_frobRoot
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_frobRoot (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) :
    (R.frobRoot hl j : Y →+ ℤ) = (D.frobOrder l j : ℤ) • R.root j
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobRootDatum_coroot
statement:
@[simp] lemma frobRootDatum_coroot (hl : 0 < l) (i : I) :
    (R.frobRootDatum hl).coroot i = R.frobCoroot l i
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobRootDatum_root
statement:
@[simp] lemma frobRootDatum_root (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) (y : R.frobWeights l →+ ℤ) :
    (R.frobRootDatum hl).root j y = y (R.frobRoot hl j)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobRootDatum_root_coroot
statement:
lemma frobRootDatum_root_coroot (hl : 0 < l) (i j : I) :
    (R.frobRootDatum hl).root j (R.frobCoroot l i) = (D.frobenius hl).cartanMatrix i j
proof:
:=
  (R.frobRootDatum hl).root_coroot i j

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobDualHom_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma frobDualHom_apply (μ : Y) (ζ : R.frobWeights l) : R.frobDualHom l μ ζ = ζ.1 μ
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobDualHom_coroot
statement:
lemma frobDualHom_coroot (i : I) :
    R.frobDualHom l (R.coroot i) = (D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) • R.frobCoroot l i
proof:
:= by
  ext ζ
  simp [frobOrder_mul_frobCoroot]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobRootDatum_root_frobDualHom
statement:
lemma frobRootDatum_root_frobDualHom (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) (μ : Y) :
    (R.frobRootDatum hl).root j (R.frobDualHom l μ) = D.frobOrder l j * R.root j μ
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.IsXRegular.frobRootDatum
statement:
theorem IsXRegular.frobRootDatum {R : D.RootDatum Y} (hR : R.IsXRegular) (hl : 0 < l) :
    (R.frobRootDatum hl).IsXRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsXRegular, linearIndependent_iff'] at hR ⊢
  intro s g hg i hi
  have h := hR s (fun j ↦ g j * D.frobOrder l j) ?_ i hi
  · exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right (by exact_mod_cast (D.frobOrder_pos hl i).ne')
  · ext μ
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun hg (R.frobDualHom l μ)
    simpa [frobRootDatum_root_frobDualHom, mul_assoc] using this

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.IsYRegular.frobRootDatum
statement:
theorem IsYRegular.frobRootDatum [Module.Free ℤ Y] {R : D.RootDatum Y} (hR : R.IsYRegular)
    (hl : 0 < l) : (R.frobRootDatum hl).IsYRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsYRegular, linearIndependent_iff'] at hR ⊢
  intro s g hg i hi
  have hdvd : ∀ j, (D.frobOrder l j : ℤ) ∣ l := fun j ↦ by exact_mod_cast D.frobOrder_dvd (l := l) j
  have h := hR s (fun j ↦ g j * ((l : ℤ) / D.frobOrder l j)) ?_ i hi
  · refine (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right ?_
    intro h0
    have := Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (hdvd i)
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at this
    exact hl.ne' (by exact_mod_cast this.symm)
  · 
    refine (Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff ℤ _).1 fun η ↦ ?_
    have hη : (l : ℤ) • η.toAddMonoidHom ∈ R.frobWeights l := fun j ↦ by
      simpa using (hdvd j).mul_right (η (R.coroot j))
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun hg ⟨_, hη⟩
    simp only [frobRootDatum_coroot, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply,
      frobCoroot_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_) this
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdvd j
    have h0 : (D.frobOrder l j : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (D.frobOrder_pos hl j).ne'
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe]
    rw [hc, Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ h0, mul_assoc (D.frobOrder l j : ℤ),
      Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ h0, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isPrimitiveRoot_cyclotomicZeta
statement:
lemma isPrimitiveRoot_cyclotomicZeta {l' : ℕ} (h : 0 < l') :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (cyclotomicZeta l') l'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ker_cyclotomicEval
statement:
lemma ker_cyclotomicEval {l' : ℕ} (h : 0 < l') :
    RingHom.ker (cyclotomicEval l') = Ideal.span {laurentCyclotomic l'}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hp
    obtain ⟨n, q, hq⟩ := LaurentPolynomial.exists_T_pow p
    have hq0 : aeval (cyclotomicZeta l') q = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (cyclotomicEval l') hq
      rw [map_mul, hp, zero_mul, cyclotomicEval, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_toLaurent] at this
      rwa [aeval_def]
    have hd : cyclotomic l' ℤ ∣ q := by
      rw [cyclotomic_eq_minpoly (isPrimitiveRoot_cyclotomicZeta h) h]
      exact minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_dvd ((isPrimitiveRoot_cyclotomicZeta h).isIntegral h) hq0
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hd
    have : p = laurentCyclotomic l' * (toLaurent r * LaurentPolynomial.T (-(n : ℤ))) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, laurentCyclotomic, ← map_mul, hq, mul_assoc, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add,
        add_neg_cancel, LaurentPolynomial.T_zero, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker,
      cyclotomicEval, laurentCyclotomic, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_toLaurent]
    have := (isPrimitiveRoot_cyclotomicZeta h).isRoot_cyclotomic h
    rw [IsRoot.def, ← map_cyclotomic_int, eval_map] at this
    exact this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cyclotomicQuotientEval_injective
statement: lemma cyclotomicQuotientEval_injective : Function.Injective (cyclotomicQuotientEval l')
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← ker_cyclotomicEval (Nat.pos_of_neZero l'),
    RingHom.mem_ker]
  exact hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cyclotomicFractionEval_v
statement:
lemma cyclotomicFractionEval_v :
    cyclotomicFractionEval l'
      (algebraMap 𝒜 (FractionRing (CyclotomicQuotient l')) (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) =
        cyclotomicZeta l'
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l'), cyclotomicFractionEval,
    IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap]
  simp only [cyclotomicQuotientEval, cyclotomicEval, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq,
    Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_T, zpow_one]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cyclotomicFraction_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma cyclotomicFraction_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff {l : ℕ} (hl' : l' = 2 * l ∨ (Odd l ∧ l' = l))
    (t : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (FractionRing (CyclotomicQuotient l')) (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) ^ (2 * t) = 1 ↔
      l ∣ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (cyclotomicFractionEval l').injective.eq_iff, map_pow, map_one, cyclotomicFractionEval_v,
    (isPrimitiveRoot_cyclotomicZeta (Nat.pos_of_neZero l')).pow_eq_one_iff_dvd]
  rcases hl' with rfl | ⟨hodd, rfl⟩
  · exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left two_pos
  · exact (Nat.coprime_two_right.2 hodd).dvd_mul_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseChangeMap_tmul
statement:
lemma baseChangeMap_tmul (b : B) (x : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    baseChangeMap D B F (b ⊗ₜ x) = algebraMap B F b ⊗ₜ x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseChangeMap_injective
statement:
lemma baseChangeMap_injective (h : Function.Injective (algebraMap B F)) :
    Function.Injective (baseChangeMap D B F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  refine (baseChangeCanonicalBasis D B).repr.injective ?_
  ext b
  have key : ∀ y : B ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D,
      (baseChangeCanonicalBasis D F).repr (baseChangeMap D B F y) b =
        algebraMap B F ((baseChangeCanonicalBasis D B).repr y b) := by
    intro y
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul c y =>
      rw [baseChangeMap_tmul, baseChangeCanonicalBasis, baseChangeCanonicalBasis,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.basis_repr_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.basis_repr_tmul]
      simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.mapRange_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply 𝒜 B F]
    | add y z hy hz => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hy, hz]
  have := key x
  rw [hx, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply, eq_comm, ← map_zero (algebraMap B F)] at this
  simpa using h this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitBase_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma frobSplitBase_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobSplitBase D hl0 hl hprim ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i n) =
      baseChangeMap D B F ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i (D.frobOrder l i * n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSplitBase, AlgHom.comp_apply, baseChangeMap_tmul, baseChangeMap_tmul, map_one,
    AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply, frobSplit_integralGenerator]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitBase_mem_range
statement:
lemma frobSplitBase_mem_range (x : B ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)) :
    frobSplitBase D hl0 hl hprim x ∈ (baseChangeMap D B F).range
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.adjoin B (Set.range fun p : I × ℕ ↦
      (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) p.1 p.2) ≤
      (baseChangeMap D B F).range.comap (frobSplitBase D hl0 hl hprim) := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (frobSplitBase_integralGenerator D hl0 hl hprim i n).symm⟩
  rw [adjoin_baseChangeGenerator] at this
  exact this Algebra.mem_top

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseChangeMap_frobSplitOfInjective
statement:
lemma baseChangeMap_frobSplitOfInjective
    (x : B ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)) :
    baseChangeMap D B F (frobSplitOfInjective D hl0 hl hprim hBF x) =
      frobSplitBase D hl0 hl hprim x
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSplitOfInjective, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    ((AlgEquiv.ofInjective _ (baseChangeMap_injective D hBF)).apply_symm_apply _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitOfInjective_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem frobSplitOfInjective_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobSplitOfInjective D hl0 hl hprim hBF
        ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i n) =
      (1 : B) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i (D.frobOrder l i * n)
proof:
:=
  baseChangeMap_injective D hBF (by
    rw [baseChangeMap_frobSplitOfInjective, frobSplitBase_integralGenerator])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cancelBaseChangeRing_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cancelBaseChangeRing_tmul (R S T : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] (X : Type*) [Ring X]
    [Algebra R X] (t : T) (s : S) (x : X) :
    cancelBaseChangeRing R S T X (t ⊗ₜ (s ⊗ₜ x)) = (s • t) ⊗ₜ x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cancelBaseChangeRing_symm_tmul

@[simp]
lemma cancelBaseChangeRing_symm_tmul (R S T : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]

    [Algebra R X] (t : T) (x : X) :
    (cancelBaseChangeRing R S T X).symm (t ⊗ₜ x) = t ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ x)
proof:
:=

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitCyclotomic_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem frobSplitCyclotomic_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobSplitCyclotomic D hl0 hl'
        ((1 : CyclotomicQuotient l') ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i n) =
      (1 : CyclotomicQuotient l') ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i (D.frobOrder l i * n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitGeneral_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem frobSplitGeneral_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobSplitGeneral D hl0 hl' R ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i n) =
      (1 : R) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i (D.frobOrder l i * n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSplitGeneral, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    cancelBaseChangeRing_symm_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    frobSplitCyclotomic_integralGenerator, cancelBaseChangeRing_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_frobSplitGeneral
statement:
theorem eq_frobSplitGeneral
    (φ : R ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0) →ₐ[R] R ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D)
    (hφ : ∀ i n, φ ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i n) =
      (1 : R) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i (D.frobOrder l i * n)) :
    φ = frobSplitGeneral D hl0 hl' R
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (adjoin_baseChangeGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) R) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hφ, frobSplitGeneral_integralGenerator]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobRootSum_injective
statement:
lemma frobRootSum_injective {l : ℕ} (hl0 : 0 < l) {μ ν : I →₀ ℕ}
    (h : frobRootSum D R l μ = frobRootSum D R l ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have key : ∀ μ : I →₀ ℕ,
      frobRootSum D R l μ = ∑ j, ((μ j * D.frobOrder l j : ℕ) : ℤ) • R.root j := by
    intro μ
    rw [frobRootSum, Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by simp)]
    simp only [natCast_zsmul]
  rw [key, key] at h
  have h2 : ∑ j, (((μ j * D.frobOrder l j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((ν j * D.frobOrder l j : ℕ) : ℤ)) •
      R.root j = 0 := by
    simp only [sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h, sub_self]
  have h3 := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.1 hR _ h2
  ext j
  have hj := h3 j
  rw [sub_eq_zero, Nat.cast_inj] at hj
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 j) hj

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobPair_frobGen_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
lemma frobPair_frobGen_eq_zero_of_ne {l : ℕ} (hl0 : 0 < l) {μ ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : μ ≠ ν)
    {x y : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I} (hx : x ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan 𝒜 μ)
    (hy : y ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan 𝒜 ν) :
    frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l x) (frobGen D l y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine integralLaurentEval_injective ?_
  rw [integralLaurentEval_frobPair_frobGen, map_zero]
  refine (IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR
    (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)).eq_zero_of_ne ?_ (frobVec_mem_weightSpace Λ l hx)
    (frobVec_mem_weightSpace Λ l hy)
    (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
  intro he
  exact h (frobRootSum_injective hR hl0 (sub_right_injective he))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobPairBase_frobSplitHom_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word u hu =>
    induction hy using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
    | word w hw =>
      rw [frobSplitHom_wordBasis, frobSplitHom_wordBasis, frobPairBase_tmul,
        frobPair_frobGen_eq_zero_of_ne hR Λ hl0 h (hu ▸ FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan u)
          (hw ▸ FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w), map_zero, zero_mul]
    | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hy, smul_zero]
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobPairBase_frobSplitHom_weightProj
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
  | smul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hx]
  | word u =>
    rw [FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis]
    split_ifs with hu
    · rfl
    · simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      rw [frobPairBase_frobSplitHom_eq_zero_of_ne hR Λ k hl0 hu
        (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan u) hz]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad_of_le
statement:
theorem quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad_of_le {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : ∀ w ∈ ((FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I).repr y).support, ∀ i,
      wordWeight w i ≤ frobTop Λ l i)
    (hrad : frobSplitHom D k l y ∈ frobRad hR Λ k) :
    quasiClassicalHom (D.frobenius hl0) k y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq := sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim (F := k)
  rw [← sum_weightProj y, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ν hν ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hν
  refine (quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_iff (D.frobenius hl0) k hq _).2
    (serreSpan_quasi_le_serreIdeal (D.frobenius hl0) k hq
      (mem_serreSpan_of_frobPairBase_eq_zero hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ (hy w hw)
        (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem _ _) fun u ↦ ?_))
  by_cases hu : wordWeight u = wordWeight w
  · rw [frobPairBase_frobSplitHom_weightProj hR Λ k hl0 y
      (hu ▸ FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan u)]
    rw [frobRad, LinearMap.mem_ker] at hrad
    rw [hrad, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  · exact frobPairBase_frobSplitHom_eq_zero_of_ne hR Λ k hl0 (Ne.symm hu)
      (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem _ _) (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan u)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobDomHom_coroot

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobKer
statement:
lemma baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobKer {i : I} (hi : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i) {w}
    (hw : w ∈ frobWords D F l) : baseGen D F i 1 * w ∈ frobKer D F l
