name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_frobKer
statement:
lemma mul_mem_frobKer (z : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) {x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D}
    (hx : x ∈ frobKer D F l) : z * x ∈ frobKer D F l
proof:
:=
  (frobKer D F l).smul_mem z hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.smul_mem_frobKer
statement:
lemma smul_mem_frobKer (c : F) {x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D} (hx : x ∈ frobKer D F l) :
    c • x ∈ frobKer D F l
proof:
:= by
  rw [show c • x = algebraMap F _ c * x from Algebra.smul_def c x]
  exact mul_mem_frobKer _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobKer_le_frobRad
statement:
lemma frobKer_le_frobRad {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] {R : D.RootDatum Y} (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (Λ : Dom R) (hΛ : ∀ i, 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i → D.frobOrder l i ∣ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) :
    frobKerF D F l ≤ frobRad hR Λ F
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, w, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ hw i hi
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul z x _ hx => exact mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ F z hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplit_comp_quasiClassicalHom
statement:
lemma frobSplit_comp_quasiClassicalHom :
    (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim).comp (quasiClassicalHom (D.frobenius hl0) F) =
      frobSplitHom D F l
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun i ↦ ?_)
  change frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim (quasiClassicalHom (D.frobenius hl0) F (θ F i)) =
    frobSplitHom D F l (θ F i)
  rw [quasiClassicalHom_θ, frobSplitHom_θ]
  exact frobSplit_integralGenerator_one D hl0 hl hprim i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplit_mem_span_frobWords
statement:
lemma frobSplit_mem_span_frobWords (y : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)) :
    frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim y ∈
      Submodule.span F (frobWords D F l : Set (F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := quasiClassicalHom_surjective (D.frobenius hl0) F
    (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim) y
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, frobSplit_comp_quasiClassicalHom, frobWords,
    ← Algebra.adjoin_eq_span, Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule]
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes]; exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c
  | grade1 j =>
    rw [← θ, frobSplitHom_θ]
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨j, rfl⟩
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_frobSplit_mem_frobKer
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_frobSplit_mem_frobKer {y : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)}
    (hy : frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim y ∈ frobKerF D F l) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := quasiClassicalHom_surjective (D.frobenius hl0) F
    (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim) y
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, frobSplit_comp_quasiClassicalHom] at hy
  set N := ∑ w ∈ ((FreeAlgebra.wordBasis F I).repr y).support, ∑ i, wordWeight w i
  have hΛ : ∀ i, 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i → D.frobOrder l i ∣
      ((frobDom D l N).1 (D.extendedRootDatum.coroot i)).toNat := fun i _ ↦ frobDom_dvd D l N i
  refine quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad_of_le
    D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum (frobDom D l N) hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ (fun w hw i ↦ ?_)
    (frobKer_le_frobRad hl0 hl hprim hA D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum _ hΛ hy)
  rw [frobTop_frobDom D l N hl0]
  exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans
    (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun w ↦ ∑ i, wordWeight w i) (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplit_injective
statement: theorem frobSplit_injective : Function.Injective (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim)
proof:
:=
  (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun _ hy ↦
    eq_zero_of_frobSplit_mem_frobKer hl0 hl hprim hA (hy ▸ zero_mem _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_frobOrder_eq_frobSplit
statement:
lemma baseGen_frobOrder_eq_frobSplit (j : I) :
    baseGen D F j (D.frobOrder l j) =
      frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) j 1)
proof:
:=
  (frobSplit_integralGenerator_one D hl0 hl hprim j).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobWords_le_range
statement:
lemma frobWords_le_range :
    (frobWords D F l : Set (F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D)) ⊆
      Set.range (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨_, (baseGen_frobOrder_eq_frobSplit hl0 hl hprim j).symm⟩
  | one => exact ⟨1, map_one _⟩
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a * b, map_mul _ _ _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_one_mul_frobSplit_mem_frobKer
statement:
lemma baseGen_one_mul_frobSplit_mem_frobKer {i : I} (hi : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i)
    (y : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)) :
    baseGen D F i 1 * frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim y ∈ frobKer D F l
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobSplit_mem_span_frobWords hl0 hl hprim y
  generalize frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim y = x at h ⊢
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobKer hi hx
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hz
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact smul_mem_frobKer c hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_one_mem_frobKer
statement:
lemma baseGen_one_mem_frobKer {i : I} (hi : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i) :
    baseGen D F i 1 ∈ frobKer D F l
proof:
:= by
  simpa using baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobKer (D := D) (F := F) hi (one_mem _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isCompl_frobKer
statement:
theorem isCompl_frobKer :
    IsCompl (LinearMap.range (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim).toLinearMap) (frobKerF D F l)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.disjoint_def.2 fun x hx hk ↦ ?_, codisjoint_iff.2 (eq_top_iff.2 ?_)⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply] at hk ⊢
    rw [eq_zero_of_frobSplit_mem_frobKer hl0 hl hprim hA hk, map_zero]
  set S := LinearMap.range (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim).toLinearMap ⊔ frobKerF D F l
  have hgen : ∀ g ∈ frobeniusGenerators D F l, ∀ z ∈ S, g * z ∈ S := by
    intro g hg z hz
    obtain ⟨w, ⟨y, rfl⟩, k, hk, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz
    rw [mul_add]
    refine add_mem ?_ (Submodule.mem_sup_right (mul_mem_frobKer g hk))
    rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
    rcases hg with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    · refine Submodule.mem_sup_left
        ⟨((1 : F) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) j 1) * y, ?_⟩
      rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_mul, ← baseGen_frobOrder_eq_frobSplit hl0 hl hprim]
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (baseGen_one_mul_frobSplit_mem_frobKer hl0 hl hprim hi y)
  have hP : ∀ a, ∀ z ∈ S, a * z ∈ S := by
    intro a
    have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin F (frobeniusGenerators D F l) := by
      rw [adjoin_frobeniusGenerators D hl0 hl hprim]; trivial
    induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem g hg => exact hgen g hg
    | algebraMap c =>
      intro z hz
      rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
      exact S.smul_mem c hz
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => intro z hz; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (ha z hz) (hb z hz)
    | mul a b _ _ ha hb => intro z hz; rw [mul_assoc]; exact ha _ (hb z hz)
  intro x _
  have h1 : (1 : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) ∈ S :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨1, by rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one]⟩
  simpa using hP x 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobLin_frobSplit
statement:
lemma frobLin_frobSplit (y : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)) :
    frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim y) = y
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_left _ _ _ _ y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobLin_of_mem
statement:
lemma frobLin_of_mem {x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D} (hx : x ∈ frobKer D F l) :
    frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA x = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_right' _ _ _ _ x hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_eq_frobSplit_add
statement:
lemma exists_eq_frobSplit_add (x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ∃ y k, k ∈ frobKer D F l ∧ x = frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim y + k
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim).toLinearMap ⊔ frobKerF D F l := by
    rw [(isCompl_frobKer hl0 hl hprim hA).sup_eq_top]; trivial
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, k, hk, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
  exact ⟨y, k, hk, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobLin_mul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, k, hk, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_frobSplit_add hl0 hl hprim hA x
  rw [map_add (frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA), frobLin_of_mem hl0 hl hprim hA hk, add_zero,
    frobLin_frobSplit, mul_add]
  rcases hg with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  · dsimp only
    rw [baseGen_frobOrder_eq_frobSplit hl0 hl hprim, ← map_mul, map_add (frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA),
      frobLin_frobSplit, frobLin_frobSplit, frobLin_of_mem hl0 hl hprim hA (mul_mem_frobKer _ hk),
      add_zero]
  · rw [frobLin_of_mem hl0 hl hprim hA (baseGen_one_mem_frobKer hi), zero_mul,
      frobLin_of_mem hl0 hl hprim hA (add_mem
        (baseGen_one_mul_frobSplit_mem_frobKer hl0 hl hprim hi y) (mul_mem_frobKer _ hk))]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobLin_one
statement: lemma frobLin_one : frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim), frobLin_frobSplit]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobLin_mul
statement:
lemma frobLin_mul (a x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA (a * x) = frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA a * frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA x
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin F (frobeniusGenerators D F l) := by
    rw [adjoin_frobeniusGenerators D hl0 hl hprim]; trivial
  induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction generalizing x with
  | mem g hg => exact frobLin_mul_of_mem hl0 hl hprim hA hg x
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, ← mul_one (algebraMap F _ c), ← Algebra.smul_def,
      map_smul, frobLin_one, smul_one_mul]
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_mul]
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb => rw [mul_assoc, ha, hb, ha, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frob_apply
statement:
lemma frob_apply (x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frob hl0 hl hprim hA x = frobLin hl0 hl hprim hA x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frob_frobSplit
statement:
theorem frob_frobSplit (y : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)) :
    frob hl0 hl hprim hA (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim y) = y
proof:
:=
  frobLin_frobSplit hl0 hl hprim hA y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frob_comp_frobSplit
statement: theorem frob_comp_frobSplit : (frob hl0 hl hprim hA).comp (frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim) = 1
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext (frob_frobSplit hl0 hl hprim hA)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frob_baseGen
statement:
theorem frob_baseGen (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frob hl0 hl hprim hA (baseGen D F i n) =
      if D.frobOrder l i ∣ n then baseGen (D.frobenius hl0) F i (n / D.frobOrder l i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hL := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [← frobSplit_integralGenerator D hl0 hl hprim, frob_frobSplit,
      Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hL]
  · have hi : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i := by
      by_contra h2
      exact h (by rw [show D.frobOrder l i = 1 by omega]; exact one_dvd n)
    have ha : n % D.frobOrder l i < D.frobOrder l i := Nat.mod_lt _ hL
    have ha0 : n % D.frobOrder l i ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hmul⟩ := baseGen_mul_baseGen_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i ha
      (n / D.frobOrder l i)
    rw [Nat.mod_add_div] at hmul
    have h0 : frob hl0 hl hprim hA (baseGen D F i (n % D.frobOrder l i)) = 0 := by
      rw [baseGen_eq_smul_pow_of_lt D hl0 hl hprim i ha, map_smul, map_pow, frob_apply,
        frobLin_of_mem hl0 hl hprim hA (baseGen_one_mem_frobKer hi), zero_pow ha0, smul_zero]
    rw [← inv_smul_smul₀ hc (baseGen D F i n), ← hmul, map_smul, map_mul, h0, zero_mul,
      smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_frob
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (adjoin_baseChangeGenerator D F) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
  exact (hφ i n).trans (frob_baseGen hl0 hl hprim hA i n).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coe_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma coe_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    (integralGenerator D i n : LusztigF.Quotient D 𝕧) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [integralGenerator, quotientIntegralGenerator, fDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralLaurentEval_T
statement: lemma integralLaurentEval_T (z : ℤ) : integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.T z) = 𝕧 ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp [integralLaurentEval, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_T]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralGenerator_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma integralGenerator_zero (i : I) : integralGenerator D i 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [coe_integralGenerator, fDivPow, qDivPow, qFactorial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator (i : I) (r s : ℕ) :
    integralGenerator D i r * integralGenerator D i s =
      qBinomialU (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (r + s) r • integralGenerator D i (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : integralLaurentEval (laurentTUnit (D.d i) : 𝒜) = 𝕧 ^ D.d i := by
    simp [laurentTUnit]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_smul_integralForm, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator,
    coe_integralGenerator, ← map_mul, fDivPow_mul_fDivPow, map_smul, map_qBinomialU, hT]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_integralGenerator_higherSerre
statement:
theorem sum_integralGenerator_higherSerre {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ)
    (h : -D.cartanMatrix i j * n < m) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ((-1 : 𝒜) ^ p.1 * LaurentPolynomial.T ((-1) * p.1 *
        (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * ((m : ℤ) - 1)))) •
      (integralGenerator D i p.1 * integralGenerator D j n * integralGenerator D i p.2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, ← toQuotient_higherSerre hij n m (Or.inr rfl) h, higherSerre,
    map_sum, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [coe_smul_integralForm, map_smul, MulMemClass.coe_mul, MulMemClass.coe_mul,
    coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator, map_mul, map_mul,
    map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, integralLaurentEval_T]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algebraMap_T
statement: lemma algebraMap_T (z : ℤ) : algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T z) = ε ^ z
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ m : ℕ, algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T m) = ε ^ m := fun m ↦ by
    rw [← map_pow, LaurentPolynomial.T_pow, mul_one]
  rcases z with m | m
  · simpa using hpow m
  · have h : algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T (Int.negSucc m)) * ε ^ (m + 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← hpow, ← map_mul, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add, Int.negSucc_eq]
      push_cast
      rw [neg_add_cancel, LaurentPolynomial.T_zero, map_one]
    rw [zpow_negSucc, eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_mul_baseGen
statement:
lemma baseGen_mul_baseGen (i : I) (r s : ℕ) :
    baseGen D F i r * baseGen D F i s =
      qBinomial (ε ^ D.d i) (r + s) r • baseGen D F i (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseGen, baseGen, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one,
    integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← algebraMap_smul F,
    map_qBinomialU, algebraMap_laurentTUnit]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitHom_θ
statement: lemma frobSplitHom_θ (i : I) : frobSplitHom D F l (θ F i) = baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i)
proof:
:=
  FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff
statement: lemma pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff (m : ℕ) : ε ^ (2 * m) = 1 ↔ l ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hm
    have hmod : ε ^ (2 * (m % l)) = 1 := by
      rw [show 2 * m = 2 * (m % l) + 2 * l * (m / l) by rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_add, Nat.mod_add_div],
        pow_add, pow_mul _ (2 * l), hl, one_pow, mul_one] at h
      exact h
    exact hprim (m % l) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 ↦ hm (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0))
      (Nat.mod_lt _ hl0) hmod
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    rw [← mul_assoc, pow_mul, hl, one_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero
statement: lemma algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero : ε ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro h
  rw [h, zero_pow (by omega)] at hl
  exact zero_ne_one hl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_d_pow_frobOrder
statement: lemma pow_d_pow_frobOrder (i : I) : (ε ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * D.frobOrder l i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul, show D.d i * (2 * D.frobOrder l i) = 2 * (D.frobOrder l i * D.d i) by ring,
    pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff hl0 hl hprim]
  exact D.dvd_frobOrder_mul_d hl0 i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_d_pow_ne_one
statement:
lemma pow_d_pow_ne_one (i : I) :
    ∀ t, 0 < t → t < D.frobOrder l i → (ε ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht0 ht h
  rw [← pow_mul, show D.d i * (2 * t) = 2 * (t * D.d i) by ring,
    pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff hl0 hl hprim] at h
  have h' : (D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) ∣ (t : ℤ) :=
    (D.frobOrder_dvd_iff hl0 i t).2 (by exact_mod_cast h)
  exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd ht0 (by exact_mod_cast h')) (by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sq_pow_frobenius_d
statement: lemma sq_pow_frobenius_d (i : I) : (ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.frobenius_d, ← pow_mul, show D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * D.d i * 2 =
      2 * (D.frobOrder l i * (D.frobOrder l i * D.d i)) by ring,
    pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff hl0 hl hprim]
  exact (D.dvd_frobOrder_mul_d hl0 i).mul_left _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_frobOrder_pow
statement:
lemma baseGen_frobOrder_pow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i) ^ n =
      qFactorial (ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) n • baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * n)
proof:
:= by
  set L := D.frobOrder l i
  set q := ε ^ D.d i
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero hl0 hl)
  have hqL := pow_d_pow_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i
  have hqp := pow_d_pow_ne_one D hl0 hl hprim i
  have hL := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  have hstar : ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i = q ^ (L ^ 2) := by
    rw [D.frobenius_d, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  have hsq : (q ^ (L ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1 := hstar ▸ sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim i
  have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, qBinomial q (L * n + L) (L * n) = (q ^ (L ^ 2)) ^ n * (n + 1 : F) := by
    intro n
    have := qBinomInt_mul_mul hq hqL hqp hL ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) n
    rw [show (L : ℤ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((L * n + L : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
      qBinomInt_natCast, Ring.choose_natCast, Nat.choose_succ_self_right] at this
    rw [this, ← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast (n := L ^ 2 * n)]
    push_cast
    congr 1
    refine zpow_eq_of_dvd hq hqL ?_
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.even_mul_succ_self n
    refine ⟨L * c, ?_⟩
    have hc' : ((n : ℤ) * (n + 1)) = c + c := by exact_mod_cast hc
    linear_combination (L : ℤ) ^ 2 * hc'
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [baseGen, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, integralGenerator_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, smul_mul_assoc, baseGen_mul_baseGen, smul_smul, hb, hstar, qFactorial_succ,
      qInt_of_sq_eq_one hsq, show L * n + L = L * (n + 1) by ring]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_baseGen_frobenius_serre
statement:
theorem sum_baseGen_frobenius_serre {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal (1 - (D.frobenius hl0).cartanMatrix i j).toNat, ((-1 : F) ^ p.1) •
      (baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * p.1) * baseGen D F j (D.frobOrder l j) *
        baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * p.2)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set L := D.frobOrder l i
  set M := D.frobOrder l j
  set q := algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) ^ D.d i with hqdef
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero hl0 hl)
  have hqL := pow_d_pow_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i
  have hqp := pow_d_pow_ne_one D hl0 hl hprim i
  have hL := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  have hdi := D.d_pos i
  have ha : D.cartanMatrix i j ≤ 0 := by
    have h1 := D.dot_nonpos i j hij
    rw [← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix] at h1
    by_contra h2
    have : (0 : ℤ) < D.d i * D.cartanMatrix i j := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hdi) (by omega)
    omega
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α : ℕ, D.cartanMatrix i j = -α := ⟨(-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat, by omega⟩
  set N := M * α
  have hN : L ∣ N := by
    have h := D.frobOrder_dvd_mul_cartanMatrix hl0 i j
    rw [hα, mul_neg, dvd_neg] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hm : (1 - (D.frobenius hl0).cartanMatrix i j).toNat = N / L + 1 := by
    have h := D.frobOrder_mul_cartanMatrix_frobenius hl0 i j
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hN
    have hc0 : (M : ℤ) * α = L * c := by exact_mod_cast hc
    have hc' : (L : ℤ) * (D.frobenius hl0).cartanMatrix i j = L * (-c) := by
      rw [h, hα]; linear_combination -hc0
    rw [mul_right_injective₀ (by exact_mod_cast hL.ne' : (L : ℤ) ≠ 0) hc', hc,
      Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hL]
    omega
  rw [hm]
  refine sum_frobenius_serre hq hqL hqp hL hN (fun r ↦ baseGen D F i r) (baseGen D F j M)
    (fun r s ↦ baseGen_mul_baseGen D F i r s) fun t ht ↦ ?_
  have h0 := congrArg (fun z ↦ (1 : F) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] z)
    (sum_integralGenerator_higherSerre D hij M (N + L - t)
      (by rw [hα, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; push_cast [N]; linarith))
  simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_sum, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero] at h0
  rw [← h0]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  have hc : algebraMap 𝒜 F ((-1) ^ p.1 * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1 * p.1 *
      (-(D.dot i j) * M - D.d i * (((N + L - t : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)))) =
      (-1) ^ p.1 * q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1 - t)) := by
    rw [hqdef, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, algebraMap_T, ← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix, hα,
      ← zpow_natCast (n := D.d i), ← zpow_mul]
    congr 2
    push_cast [N, Nat.cast_sub (show t ≤ N + L by omega)]
    ring
  rw [show ∀ (c : 𝒜) (x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D), c • x = algebraMap 𝒜 F c • x from
    fun c x ↦ (algebraMap_smul F c x).symm, hc, baseGen, baseGen, baseGen,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitHom_qDivPow
statement:
lemma frobSplitHom_qDivPow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobSplitHom D F l (qDivPow (algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) n
      (θ F i)) = baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, frobSplitHom_θ, baseGen_frobOrder_pow D hl0 hl hprim, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim i) n),
    one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitHom_serreElement
statement:
theorem frobSplitHom_serreElement {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    frobSplitHom D F l
      (serreElement (D.frobenius hl0) (algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set m := (1 - (D.frobenius hl0).cartanMatrix i j).toNat
  have h := sum_baseGen_frobenius_serre D hl0 hl hprim hij
  have key : ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ((-1 : F) ^ p.2) •
      (baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * p.1) * baseGen D F j (D.frobOrder l j) *
        baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * p.2)) = 0 := by
    rw [← smul_zero ((-1 : F) ^ m), ← h, smul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    have hp' : p.1 + p.2 = m := mem_antidiagonal.1 hp
    rw [← hp', pow_add, mul_comm ((-1 : F) ^ p.1), mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul,
      neg_one_sq, one_pow, mul_one]
  rw [← Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap, Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk] at key
  rw [serreElement, qSerreDiv, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, map_mul, frobSplitHom_qDivPow D hl0 hl hprim, frobSplitHom_θ]
  simpa using key

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitHom_eq_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact frobSplitHom_serreElement D hl0 hl hprim hij
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | neg y _ hy => rw [map_neg, hy, neg_zero]
  | left_absorb a y _ hy => rw [map_mul, hy, mul_zero]
  | right_absorb b y _ hy => rw [map_mul, hy, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplit_integralGenerator_one
statement:
lemma frobSplit_integralGenerator_one (i : I) :
    frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i 1) =
      baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSplit, AlgHom.comp_apply, ← quasiClassicalEquiv_θ (D.frobenius hl0) F
    (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim) i, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact frobSplitHom_θ D F l i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_eq_smul_pow
statement:
lemma baseGen_eq_smul_pow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    (1 : F) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i n =
      (qFactorial (algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) n)⁻¹ •
        ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, one_pow, integralGenerator_pow, TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
    show ∀ (c : 𝒜) (x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0)),
      c • x = algebraMap 𝒜 F c • x from fun c x ↦ (algebraMap_smul F c x).symm,
    map_laurentQFactorial, algebraMap_laurentTUnit, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim i) n),
    one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplit_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem frobSplit_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i n) =
      baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * n)
proof:
:= by
  have hF := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim i) n
  rw [baseGen_eq_smul_pow D hl0 hl hprim, map_smul, map_pow, frobSplit_integralGenerator_one,
    baseGen_frobOrder_pow D hl0 hl hprim, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hF, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_frobSplit
statement:
theorem eq_frobSplit
    (φ : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0) →ₐ[F] F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D)
    (hφ : ∀ i, φ ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) i 1) =
      baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i)) :
    φ = frobSplit D hl0 hl hprim
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (adjoin_baseChangeGenerator (D.frobenius hl0) F) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [baseGen_eq_smul_pow D hl0 hl hprim, map_smul, map_smul, map_pow, map_pow, hφ,
    frobSplit_integralGenerator_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_neg_one_pow_zpow_qBinomial
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_zpow_qBinomial (hq : q ≠ 0) {a : ℕ} (haL : a < L) :
    ∑ t ∈ range L, (-1) ^ t * q ^ ((t : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - 1)) * qBinomial q a t =
      if a = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_subset (range_subset_range.2 (show a + 1 ≤ L by omega))]
  · rcases a with _ | n
    · simp
    · have h := sum_neg_one_pow_qBinomial (inv_ne_zero hq) n (n + 1)
      rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt _ (Nat.lt_succ_self n), mul_zero] at h
      simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [← h]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
      rw [qBinomial_inv, inv_zpow', neg_neg]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
  · intro t _ ht
    rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt _ (by simpa using ht), mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_mul_sub_one_eq
statement:
lemma zpow_mul_sub_one_eq (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * L) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < L → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hL : 0 < L) :
    q ^ ((L : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1)) = (-1) ^ (L + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_sq_add_eq hl hprim hL, ← zpow_natCast]
  exact zpow_eq_of_dvd hq hl ⟨-1, by push_cast; ring⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_frobSerreCoeff
statement:
theorem sum_frobSerreCoeff (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * L) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < L → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hL : 0 < L) {N : ℕ} (hN : L ∣ N)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ N + L) :
    ∑ t ∈ range L, ((-1) ^ t * q ^ (((N : ℤ) + L - 1) * t)) *
        ((-1) ^ r * q ^ ((r : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1 - t)) * qBinomial q (N + L - r) t) =
      if L ∣ r then (-1) ^ (r / L) else 0
proof:
:= by
  set s := N + L - r with hs
  set a := s % L
  set b := s / L
  have hsab : s = a + L * b := (Nat.mod_add_div s L).symm
  have haL : a < L := Nat.mod_lt s hL
  have key : ∀ t ∈ range L, ((-1) ^ t * q ^ (((N : ℤ) + L - 1) * t)) *
      ((-1) ^ r * q ^ ((r : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1 - t)) * qBinomial q s t) =
      ((-1) ^ r * q ^ ((r : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1))) *
        ((-1) ^ t * q ^ ((t : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - 1)) * qBinomial q a t) := by
    intro t ht
    have ht : t < L := mem_range.1 ht
    have hb := qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul hq hl hprim hL haL ht (b : ℤ) 0
    rw [mul_zero, add_zero, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_add, ← hsab, qBinomInt_natCast,
      Ring.choose_zero_right, Int.cast_one, mul_one] at hb
    rw [hb]
    have he : q ^ (((N : ℤ) + L - 1) * t) * q ^ ((r : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1 - t)) *
        q ^ (((a : ℤ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - b * t) * L + (b + 1) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) * (L : ℤ) ^ 2) =
        q ^ ((r : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1)) * q ^ ((t : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - 1)) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hq, ← zpow_add₀ hq, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
      congr 1
      have : (s : ℤ) = N + L - r := by omega
      have h2 : (s : ℤ) = a + L * b := by exact_mod_cast hsab
      push_cast
      linear_combination (t : ℤ) * h2 - t * this
    linear_combination ((-1) ^ t * (-1) ^ r * qBinomial q a t) * he
  rw [sum_congr rfl key, ← mul_sum, sum_neg_one_pow_zpow_qBinomial hq haL]
  have hLr : L ∣ r ↔ a = 0 := by
    change L ∣ r ↔ s % L = 0
    rw [← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
    have hNL : L ∣ N + L := dvd_add hN dvd_rfl
    constructor
    · exact fun h ↦ Nat.dvd_sub hNL h
    · intro h
      have := Nat.dvd_sub hNL h
      rwa [hs, Nat.sub_sub_self hr] at this
  by_cases h : L ∣ r
  · simp only [h, hLr.1 h, ↓reduceIte, mul_one]
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left p hL, pow_mul]
    have e : q ^ ((((L * p : ℕ)) : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1)) = (q ^ ((L : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1))) ^ p := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]; push_cast; ring_nf
    rw [e, zpow_mul_sub_one_eq hq hl hprim hL, ← mul_pow, ← pow_add,
      show L + (L + 1) = 2 * L + 1 by ring, pow_succ, pow_mul]
    simp
  · have ha : a ≠ 0 := fun h' ↦ h (hLr.2 h')
    simp [h, ha]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_frobenius_serre
statement:
theorem sum_frobenius_serre (hq : q ≠ 0) (hl : q ^ (2 * L) = 1)
    (hprim : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < L → q ^ (2 * t) ≠ 1) (hL : 0 < L) {N : ℕ} (hN : L ∣ N)
    (x : ℕ → A) (y : A) (hx : ∀ r s, x r * x s = qBinomial q (r + s) r • x (r + s))
    (hg : ∀ t < L, ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal (N + L - t),
      ((-1) ^ p.1 * q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1 - t))) • (x p.1 * y * x p.2) = 0) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal (N / L + 1), ((-1 : k) ^ p.1) • (x (L * p.1) * y * x (L * p.2)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set z : ℕ → A := fun r ↦ x r * y * x (N + L - r)
  set c : ℕ → ℕ → k := fun t r ↦ (-1) ^ t * q ^ (((N : ℤ) + L - 1) * t)
  set d : ℕ → ℕ → k := fun t r ↦ (-1) ^ r * q ^ ((r : ℤ) * ((L : ℤ) - 1 - t))
  
  have h1 : ∀ t ∈ range L, (∑ p ∈ antidiagonal (N + L - t), d t p.1 • (x p.1 * y * x p.2)) *
      x t = ∑ r ∈ range (N + L + 1), (d t r * qBinomial q (N + L - r) t) • z r := by
    intro t ht
    have ht : t < L := mem_range.1 ht
    rw [Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, sum_mul]
    rw [← sum_subset (range_subset_range.2 (show N + L - t + 1 ≤ N + L + 1 by omega))]
    · refine sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
      have hr : r ≤ N + L - t := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hr)
      simp only [z, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hx, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
      rw [show N + L - t - r + t = N + L - r by omega]
      congr 2
      rw [show N + L - t - r = (N + L - r) - t by omega]
      exact qBinomial_symm q (by omega)
    · intro r hr0 hr
      have : N + L - r < t := by simp at hr hr0; omega
      rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt _ this, mul_zero, zero_smul]
  have h2 : ∑ t ∈ range L, c t 0 • ((∑ p ∈ antidiagonal (N + L - t),
      d t p.1 • (x p.1 * y * x p.2)) * x t) = 0 :=
    sum_eq_zero fun t ht ↦ by rw [hg t (mem_range.1 ht), zero_mul, smul_zero]
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ by rw [h1 t ht]] at h2
  simp only [smul_sum, smul_smul] at h2
  rw [sum_comm] at h2
  have h3 : ∑ r ∈ range (N + L + 1), (if L ∣ r then (-1 : k) ^ (r / L) else 0) • z r = 0 := by
    rw [← h2]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
    rw [← sum_smul, ← sum_frobSerreCoeff hq hl hprim hL hN
      (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hr))]
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hN
  have hML : N / L + 1 = M + 1 := by rw [hM, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left M hL]
  have hsub : (range (M + 2)).image (L * ·) ⊆ range (N + L + 1) := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hr
    have hp : p ≤ M + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hp)
    refine mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_iff.2 ?_)
    rw [hM]; nlinarith
  rw [hML, Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, ← h3, ← sum_subset hsub,
    sum_image fun a _ b _ h ↦ Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hL h]
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
    have hp : p ≤ M + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hp)
    simp only [dvd_mul_right L p, ↓reduceIte, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left p hL]
    simp only [z]
    congr 3
    rw [hM, Nat.mul_sub, mul_add, mul_one]
  · intro r hr hr'
    have hLr : ¬ L ∣ r := by
      rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      refine hr' (mem_image.2 ⟨p, mem_range.2 ?_, rfl⟩)
      have := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hr)
      rw [hM] at this
      have : L * p ≤ L * (M + 1) := by linarith
      have := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left this hL
      omega
    simp [hLr]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toQuotient_rev_eq

lemma toQuotient_rev_eq {x y : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (h : toQuotient D 𝕧 x = toQuotient D 𝕧 y) :
    toQuotient D 𝕧 (rev 𝕂 I x) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (rev 𝕂 I y)
proof:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator_eq_sum_rev
statement:
theorem integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator_eq_sum_rev {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {a n m : ℕ}
    (ha : D.cartanMatrix i j = -a) (hm : a * n < m) :
    integralGenerator D j n * integralGenerator D i m =
      ∑ r ∈ range (a * n + 1), laurentHigherSerreCoeff D i a n m (m - r) •
        (integralGenerator D i (m - r) * integralGenerator D j n * integralGenerator D i r)
proof:
:= by
  have h : toQuotient D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i m * fDivPow D j n) = toQuotient D 𝕧
      (∑ r ∈ range (a * n + 1), higherSerreCoeff D i a n m (m - r) •
        (fDivPow D i r * fDivPow D j n * fDivPow D i (m - r))) := by
    rw [toQuotient_fDivPow_mul_fDivPow hij ha hm, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
  have h' := toQuotient_rev_eq D h
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, rev_mul, rev_fDivPow] at h'
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator, ← map_mul, h',
    AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [coe_smul_integralForm, integralLaurentEval_laurentHigherSerreCoeff, MulMemClass.coe_mul,
    MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator]
  simp only [map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralGenerator_mul_comm

lemma integralGenerator_mul_comm (i : I) (r s : ℕ) :

proof:

  simp only [MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_integralGenerator, ← map_mul, fDivPow, qDivPow,
    smul_mul_smul_comm, pow_mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_mul_comm
statement:
lemma baseGen_mul_comm (i : I) (r s : ℕ) :
    baseGen D F i r * baseGen D F i s = baseGen D F i s * baseGen D F i r
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_one_mul_baseGen_frobOrder_eq_sum
statement:
theorem baseGen_one_mul_baseGen_frobOrder_eq_sum {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {a : ℕ}
    (ha : D.cartanMatrix i j = -a) (hal : a < D.frobOrder l i) :
    baseGen D F j 1 * baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (a + 1), ((ε ^ D.d i) ^ ((D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) *
        qBinomial (ε ^ D.d i) a r) •
          (baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i - r) * baseGen D F j 1 * baseGen D F i r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseGen]
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one,
    integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator_eq_sum_rev D hij ha (by omega), mul_one,
    TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← algebraMap_smul F,
    algebraMap_laurentHigherSerreCoeff D hl0 hl hprim i (by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hr) hal,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad
statement:
theorem baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad
    (hA : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l j → ∀ a : ℕ, D.cartanMatrix i j = -a →
      a < D.frobOrder l i)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i → D.frobOrder l i ∣ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat)
    {w : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D}
    (hw : w ∈ Submonoid.closure (Set.range fun j ↦ baseGen D F j (D.frobOrder l j))) :
    ∀ i, 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i → baseGen D F i 1 * w ∈ frobRad hR Λ F
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submonoid.closure_induction_left with
  | one =>
    intro i hi
    rw [mul_one]
    exact baseGen_one_mem_frobRad hR Λ hl0 hl hprim i hi (hΛ i hi)
  | mul_left s hs w _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hs
    intro i hi
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [← mul_assoc, baseGen_mul_comm, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ F _ (ih i hi)
    have hji : D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 0 := by
      have h1 := D.dot_nonpos j i (Ne.symm hij)
      rw [← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix] at h1
      by_contra h2
      have : (0 : ℤ) < D.d j * D.cartanMatrix j i :=
        mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast D.d_pos j) (by omega)
      omega
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℕ, D.cartanMatrix j i = -a := ⟨(-D.cartanMatrix j i).toNat, by omega⟩
    have hal := hA j i (Ne.symm hij) hi a ha
    rw [← mul_assoc, baseGen_one_mul_baseGen_frobOrder_eq_sum D hl0 hl hprim (Ne.symm hij) ha hal,
      sum_mul]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r hr ↦ ?_
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    rw [mem_range] at hr
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with rfl | hr0
    · rw [show baseGen D F j 0 = 1 by
        rw [baseGen, integralGenerator_zero, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def], mul_one, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ F _ (ih i hi)
    · have hj : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l j := by omega
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r', r = r' + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
      have hmem : baseGen D F j (r + 1) * w ∈ frobRad hR Λ F := by
        rw [show baseGen D F j (r + 1) = _ from
          baseGen_eq_smul_pow_of_lt D hl0 hl hprim j (show r + 1 < D.frobOrder l j by omega),
          smul_mul_assoc, pow_succ, mul_assoc]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ F _ (ih j hj))
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ F _ hmem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_frobWords_sup_frobRad
statement:
theorem span_frobWords_sup_frobRad [CharZero F]
    (hA : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l j → ∀ a : ℕ, D.cartanMatrix i j = -a →
      a < D.frobOrder l i)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i → D.frobOrder l i ∣ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) :
    Submodule.span F
        (Submonoid.closure (Set.range fun j ↦ baseGen D F j (D.frobOrder l j)) :
          Set (F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D)) ⊔ frobRad hR Λ F = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set W := Submonoid.closure (Set.range fun j ↦ baseGen D F j (D.frobOrder l j))
  set M := Submodule.span F (W : Set (F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D)) ⊔ frobRad hR Λ F
  have hgen : ∀ g ∈ frobeniusGenerators D F l, ∀ m ∈ M, g * m ∈ M := by
    intro g hg m hm
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hm
    clear hm
    rw [mul_add]
    refine add_mem ?_ (Submodule.mem_sup_right (mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ F g hz))
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem w hw =>
      rcases hg with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left
          (Submodule.subset_span (W.mul_mem (Submonoid.subset_closure ⟨j, rfl⟩) hw))
      · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ hw i hi)
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact M.smul_mem c hx
  have key : ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin F (frobeniusGenerators D F l), ∀ m ∈ M, x * m ∈ M := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem g hg => exact hgen g hg
    | algebraMap c =>
      intro m hm
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul]
      exact M.smul_mem c hm
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => intro m hm; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx m hm) (hy m hm)
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => intro m hm; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hy m hm)
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  have h1 : (1 : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) ∈ M :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span W.one_mem)
  simpa using key x (by rw [adjoin_frobeniusGenerators D hl0 hl hprim]; trivial) 1 h1

name: LusztigCartanDatum.frobOrder_pos
statement: lemma frobOrder_pos (hl : 0 < l) (i : I) : 0 < D.frobOrder l i
proof:
:=
  Nat.div_pos (Nat.gcd_le_left _ hl) (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hl)

name: LusztigCartanDatum.frobOrder_dvd
statement: lemma frobOrder_dvd (i : I) : D.frobOrder l i ∣ l
proof:
:=
  Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)

name: LusztigCartanDatum.frobOrder_dvd_iff
statement:
lemma frobOrder_dvd_iff (hl : 0 < l) (i : I) (n : ℤ) :
    (D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ (l : ℤ) ∣ n * D.d i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g, Nat.gcd l (D.d i) = g := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg : 0 < g := hgdef ▸ Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hl
  obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := hgdef ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_left l (D.d i)
  obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := hgdef ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_right l (D.d i)
  have hfo : D.frobOrder l i = l' := by
    rw [frobOrder, hgdef, hl', Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime l' d' := by
    have := Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd (m := l) (n := D.d i) (hgdef ▸ hg)
    rw [hgdef] at this
    rwa [hl', hd', Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg] at this
  have hlz : (l : ℤ) = g * l' := by exact_mod_cast hl'
  have hdz : (D.d i : ℤ) = g * d' := by exact_mod_cast hd'
  rw [hfo, hlz, hdz, show n * ((g : ℤ) * d') = g * (n * d') by ring,
    mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (by exact_mod_cast hg.ne')]
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ h.mul_right _
  · exact fun h ↦ (Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hcop).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right h

name: LusztigCartanDatum.dvd_frobOrder_mul_d
statement: lemma dvd_frobOrder_mul_d (hl : 0 < l) (i : I) : l ∣ D.frobOrder l i * D.d i
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (D.frobOrder_dvd_iff hl i _).1 dvd_rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.frobOrder_dvd_mul_cartanMatrix
statement:
lemma frobOrder_dvd_mul_cartanMatrix (hl : 0 < l) (i j : I) :
    (D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) ∣ D.frobOrder l j * D.cartanMatrix i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.frobOrder_dvd_iff hl, mul_assoc, mul_comm (D.cartanMatrix i j), D.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm,
    ← mul_assoc]
  exact (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (D.dvd_frobOrder_mul_d hl j)).mul_right _

name: LusztigCartanDatum.frobenius_dot
statement:
lemma frobenius_dot (hl : 0 < l) (i j : I) :
    (D.frobenius hl).dot i j = D.frobOrder l i * D.frobOrder l j * D.dot i j
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.frobenius_d
statement: lemma frobenius_d (hl : 0 < l) (i : I) : (D.frobenius hl).d i = D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * D.d i
proof:
:= by
  have h := (D.frobenius hl).two_mul_d i
  rw [frobenius_dot, ← D.two_mul_d i] at h
  have : ((D.frobenius hl).d i : ℤ) = D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * D.d i := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

name: LusztigCartanDatum.frobOrder_mul_cartanMatrix_frobenius
statement:
lemma frobOrder_mul_cartanMatrix_frobenius (hl : 0 < l) (i j : I) :
    (D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) * (D.frobenius hl).cartanMatrix i j =
      D.frobOrder l j * D.cartanMatrix i j
proof:
:= by
  have h := (D.frobenius hl).d_mul_cartanMatrix i j
  rw [frobenius_d, frobenius_dot, ← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix] at h
  have hi : (0 : ℤ) < D.frobOrder l i * D.d i := by
    have := D.frobOrder_pos hl i; have := D.d_pos i; positivity
  push_cast at h
  have : ((D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) * D.d i) * ((D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) *
      (D.frobenius hl).cartanMatrix i j - D.frobOrder l j * D.cartanMatrix i j) = 0 := by
    linear_combination h
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h0 | h0
  · exact absurd h0 hi.ne'
  · linarith

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_mul_baseGen_frobOrder
statement:
lemma baseGen_mul_baseGen_frobOrder (i : I) {a : ℕ} (ha : a < D.frobOrder l i) (b : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ baseGen D F i a * baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i * b) =
      c • baseGen D F i (a + D.frobOrder l i * b)
proof:
:= by
  set L := D.frobOrder l i
  set q := ε ^ D.d i
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero hl0 hl)
  refine ⟨qBinomial q (a + L * b) a, ?_, baseGen_mul_baseGen D F i a (L * b)⟩
  have h := qBinomInt_add_mul_add_mul hq (pow_d_pow_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i)
    (pow_d_pow_ne_one D hl0 hl hprim i) (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i) ha ha (b : ℤ) 0
  rw [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_add, qBinomInt_natCast,
    Ring.choose_zero_right, Int.cast_one, mul_one, qBinomial_self, mul_one] at h
  rw [h]
  exact zpow_ne_zero _ hq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_eq_smul_pow_of_lt
statement:
lemma baseGen_eq_smul_pow_of_lt (i : I) {a : ℕ} (ha : a < D.frobOrder l i) :
    baseGen D F i a = (qFactorial (ε ^ D.d i) a)⁻¹ • baseGen D F i 1 ^ a
proof:
:= by
  have hq : ε ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero hl0 hl)
  have hF : qFactorial (ε ^ D.d i) a ≠ 0 :=
    qFactorial_ne_zero hq fun m hm hma ↦ pow_d_pow_ne_one D hl0 hl hprim i m hm (by omega)
  rw [baseGen, baseGen, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, one_pow, integralGenerator_pow,
    TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
    show ∀ (c : 𝒜) (x : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D),
      c • x = algebraMap 𝒜 F c • x from fun c x ↦ (algebraMap_smul F c x).symm,
    map_laurentQFactorial, algebraMap_laurentTUnit, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hF, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoin_frobeniusGenerators
statement:
theorem adjoin_frobeniusGenerators :
    Algebra.adjoin F (frobeniusGenerators D F l) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← adjoin_baseChangeGenerator D F, Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
  dsimp only
  set S := Algebra.adjoin F (frobeniusGenerators D F l)
  set L := D.frobOrder l i
  have hL := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  
  have hfrob : ∀ b, baseGen D F i (L * b) ∈ S := by
    intro b
    have hF := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_sq_eq_one (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim i) b
    have h := baseGen_frobOrder_pow D hl0 hl hprim i b
    have : baseGen D F i (L * b) =
        (qFactorial (ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) b)⁻¹ • baseGen D F i L ^ b := by
      rw [h, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hF, one_smul]
    rw [this]
    exact S.smul_mem (S.pow_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)) _) _
  
  have hsmall : ∀ a, a < L → baseGen D F i a ∈ S := by
    intro a ha
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge L 2 with h2 | h2
    · obtain rfl : a = 0 := by omega
      rw [baseGen, integralGenerator_zero, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
      exact S.one_mem
    · rw [baseGen_eq_smul_pow_of_lt D hl0 hl hprim i ha]
      exact S.smul_mem (S.pow_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨i, h2, rfl⟩)) _) _
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := baseGen_mul_baseGen_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i (Nat.mod_lt n hL) (n / L)
  rw [Nat.mod_add_div] at h
  have : baseGen D F i n = c⁻¹ • (baseGen D F i (n % L) * baseGen D F i (L * (n / L))) := by
    rw [h, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
  change baseGen D F i n ∈ S
  rw [this]
  exact S.smul_mem (S.mul_mem (hsmall _ (Nat.mod_lt n hL)) (hfrob _)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coPairing_add
statement:
lemma coPairing_add (i : I) (μ ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    D.coPairing i (μ + ν) = D.coPairing i μ + D.coPairing i ν
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (fun _ _ _ ↦ by push_cast; ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coPairing_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma coPairing_single (i j : I) (m : ℕ) :
    D.coPairing i (Finsupp.single j m) = m * D.cartanMatrix i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [LusztigCartanDatum.coPairing]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_serreExp_sub_one
statement:
lemma pow_serreExp_sub_one {q : K} (hq : q ^ 2 = 1) (i k : I) :
    q ^ (serreExp D i k - 1) = q ^ (-D.cartanMatrix i k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hik : i = k
  · subst hik
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self, show (-2 : ℤ) = -((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) by norm_num, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
      hq, inv_one]
    simp [serreExp, D.cartanMatrix_self]
  · have h := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos i k hik
    have : serreExp D i k - 1 = (-D.cartanMatrix i k).toNat := by simp only [serreExp]; omega
    rw [this, ← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSign_pow_serreExp
statement:
lemma weightSign_pow_serreExp {q : K} (hq : q ^ 2 = 1) (i : I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    weightSign (fun k ↦ q ^ (serreExp D i k - 1)) μ = q ^ (-D.coPairing i μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hq
  induction μ using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add μ ν hμ hν => rw [weightSign_add, hμ, hν, coPairing_add, neg_add, zpow_add₀ hq0]
  | single j m =>
    rw [weightSign_single, pow_serreExp_sub_one D hq, coPairing_single, ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_mul]
    congr 1
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobRootSum_coroot
statement:
lemma frobRootSum_coroot {l : ℕ} (hl0 : 0 < l) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) :
    frobRootSum D R l μ (R.coroot i) = D.frobOrder l i * (D.frobenius hl0).coPairing i μ
proof:
:= by
  induction μ using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add μ ν hμ hν =>
    rw [frobRootSum_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hμ, hν, coPairing_add, mul_add]
  | single j m =>
    rw [frobRootSum_single, AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, R.root_coroot, coPairing_single,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    linear_combination -(m : ℤ) * D.frobOrder_mul_cartanMatrix_frobenius hl0 i j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobPair_comm
statement: lemma frobPair_comm (x y : quotientIntegralForm D) : frobPair hR Λ x y = frobPair hR Λ y x
proof:
:=
  integralLaurentEval_injective (by
    rw [integralLaurentEval_frobPair, integralLaurentEval_frobPair, IrreducibleModule.form_comm])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobPairBase_comm
statement:
lemma frobPairBase_comm (k : Type*) [Field k] [Algebra 𝒜 k]
    (X Z : k ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frobPairBase hR Λ k X Z = frobPairBase hR Λ k Z X
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.BilinForm.IsSymm.baseChange (A := k)
    (LinearMap.isSymm_def.2 (frobPair_comm hR Λ))).eq X Z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coroot_eq_frobOrder_mul_frobTop
statement:
lemma coroot_eq_frobOrder_mul_frobTop (i : I) :
    Λ.1 (R.coroot i) = D.frobOrder l i * frobTop Λ l i
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i) := Λ.2 i
  have hdvd : D.frobOrder l i ∣ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat := by
    by_cases h2 : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i
    · exact hΛ i h2
    · rw [show D.frobOrder l i = 1 by have := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i; omega]
      exact one_dvd _
  rw [frobTop, ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd, Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algebraMap_frobCoeff
statement:
lemma algebraMap_frobCoeff (i : I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 k (frobCoeff Λ l i μ) =
      (ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) ^ (frobTop Λ l i + 1) *
        (ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) ^ (-(D.frobenius hl0).coPairing i μ) *
          (((frobTop Λ l i : ℤ) - (D.frobenius hl0).coPairing i μ : ℤ) : k)
proof:
:= by
  have hε : ε ≠ 0 := by
    rintro h
    rw [h, zero_pow (by omega)] at hl
    exact zero_ne_one hl
  set φ := algebraMap 𝒜 k
  set u : kˣ := Units.map φ.toMonoidHom (laurentTUnit (D.d i))
  have hu : (u : k) = ε ^ D.d i := algebraMap_laurentTUnit k (D.d i)
  set a₁ : ℤ := (frobTop Λ l i : ℤ) - (D.frobenius hl0).coPairing i μ
  have harg : (Λ.1 - frobRootSum D R l μ) (R.coroot i) = D.frobOrder l i * a₁ := by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, coroot_eq_frobOrder_mul_frobTop Λ hl0 hΛ, frobRootSum_coroot hl0]
    ring
  rw [frobCoeff, map_gaussBinom, harg, show D.frobOrder l i = D.frobOrder l i * 1 from
      (mul_one _).symm, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_one, mul_one,
    gaussBinom_mul_mul (v := u) (by rw [hu]; exact pow_d_pow_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i)
      (by rw [hu]; exact pow_d_pow_ne_one D hl0 hl hprim i) (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i),
    Ring.choose_one_right, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, hu, D.frobenius_d hl0]
  have hq0 : ε ^ (D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * D.d i) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hε
  rw [show ((ε ^ D.d i) ^ ((D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) ^ 2 * (a₁ + 1) * ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      (ε ^ (D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * D.d i)) ^ (((frobTop Λ l i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) +
        -(D.frobenius hl0).coPairing i μ) by
    rw [← zpow_natCast ε (D.d i), ← zpow_natCast ε (_ * _), ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul]
    congr 1
    simp only [a₁]
    push_cast
    ring,
    zpow_add₀ hq0, zpow_natCast]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_serreSpan_of_frobPairBase_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_serreSpan_of_frobPairBase_eq_zero {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≤ frobTop Λ l i)
    {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν)
    (hpair : ∀ w : List I, frobPairBase hR Λ k (frobSplitHom D k l y)
      (frobSplitHom D k l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I w)) = 0) :
    y ∈ serreSpan (D.frobenius hl0) (fun i ↦ ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) ν
proof:
:= by
  set D' := D.frobenius hl0
  have hε : ε ≠ 0 := by
    rintro h
    rw [h, zero_pow (by omega)] at hl
    exact zero_ne_one hl
  have hq : ∀ i, (ε ^ D'.d i) ^ 2 = 1 := sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim
  refine mem_serreSpan_of_shapovalovMap_eq_zero_of_sq_eq_one D' hq (fun i j _ ↦ ?_)
    (frobTop Λ l) (c := fun i ↦ algebraMap 𝒜 k ∘ frobCoeff Λ l i)
    (s := fun i ↦ (ε ^ D'.d i) ^ (frobTop Λ l i + 1)) (fun i ↦ pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hε))
    (fun i μ ↦ ?_) hν hy ?_
  · rw [pow_serreExp_sub_one D' (hq i), pow_serreExp_sub_one D' (hq j), ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_natCast ε (D'.d j), ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul]
    congr 1
    have := D'.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm i j
    linarith
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, algebraMap_frobCoeff Λ hl0 hl hprim hΛ,
      weightSign_pow_serreExp D' (hq i), classicalCoeff]
  · funext w
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ, h⟩ := exists_frobPairBase_eq_vermaForm hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ (k := k) w.1 ν
    have h0 := hpair w.1
    rw [frobPairBase_comm, h y hy] at h0
    rw [shapovalovMap_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h0).resolve_left hκ.ne_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_serreSpan_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad
statement:
theorem mem_serreSpan_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≤ frobTop Λ l i)
    {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν)
    (hrad : frobSplitHom D k l y ∈ frobRad hR Λ k) :
    y ∈ serreSpan (D.frobenius hl0) (fun i ↦ ε ^ (D.frobenius hl0).d i) ν
proof:
:=
  mem_serreSpan_of_frobPairBase_eq_zero hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ hν hy fun w ↦ by
    rw [frobRad, LinearMap.mem_ker] at hrad
    rw [hrad, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad
statement:
theorem quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad {ν : I →₀ ℕ}
    (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≤ frobTop Λ l i) {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν)
    (hrad : frobSplitHom D k l y ∈ frobRad hR Λ k) :
    quasiClassicalHom (D.frobenius hl0) k y = 0
proof:
:=
  (quasiClassicalHom_eq_zero_iff (D.frobenius hl0) k (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim) y).2
    (serreSpan_quasi_le_serreIdeal (D.frobenius hl0) k (sq_pow_frobenius_d D hl0 hl hprim)
      (mem_serreSpan_of_frobSplitHom_mem_frobRad hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ hν hy hrad))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_frobPair_mul_left
statement:
lemma exists_frobPair_mul_left (z y : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ∃ w : quotientIntegralForm D, ∀ x, frobPair hR Λ (z * x) y = frobPair hR Λ x w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hw⟩ := rho_quotientMinus_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ z.2
    (quotientMinus_smul_hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ y.2)
  rw [evq_eq_quotientMinus_smul] at hw
  refine ⟨⟨negativeQuotientEquiv D n, hn⟩, fun x ↦ integralLaurentEval_injective ?_⟩
  rw [integralLaurentEval_frobPair, integralLaurentEval_frobPair, Subalgebra.coe_mul, map_mul,
    mul_smul, IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt), ← hw]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_F_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma E_smul_F_smul_hwv (i j : I) :
    E R 𝕧 j • F R 𝕧 i • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 =
      if j = i then qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hη := IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv (R := R) (v := 𝕧) (Λ := Λ.1) j
  rw [← mul_smul, ← sub_add_cancel (E R 𝕧 j * F R 𝕧 i) (F R 𝕧 i * E R 𝕧 j), add_smul,
    mul_smul (F R 𝕧 i), hη, smul_zero, add_zero, E_mul_F_sub]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    have hq : 𝕧 ^ D.d j - (𝕧 ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
      sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne _)) fun n hn ↦ by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        exact pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos j) hn)
    have hN : Λ.1 (ktilde R j) = (D.d j : ℤ) * ((Λ.1 (R.coroot j)).toNat : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Λ.2 j), ktilde, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have key : (𝕧 ^ D.d j - (𝕧 ^ D.d j)⁻¹)⁻¹ *
        ((𝕧 ^ D.d j) ^ (Λ.1 (R.coroot j)).toNat - ((𝕧 ^ D.d j) ^ (Λ.1 (R.coroot j)).toNat)⁻¹) =
        qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (Λ.1 (R.coroot j)).toNat := by
      rw [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ hq, qInt_mul_sub (v := 𝕧 ^ D.d j), inv_pow]
    rw [smul_assoc, sub_smul, Kt, hw_K_smul_hwv, hw_K_smul_hwv, map_neg, ← sub_smul, smul_smul,
      hN, zpow_neg, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, key]
  · rw [zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoF_smul_F_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma rhoF_smul_F_smul_hwv (i j : I) :
    rhoF R 𝕧 j • F R 𝕧 i • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 =
      if j = i then (𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) - D.d i * (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) *
        qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul, E_smul_F_smul_hwv]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    have hN : Λ.1 (-ktilde R j) = -((D.d j : ℤ) * ((Λ.1 (R.coroot j)).toNat : ℤ)) := by
      rw [map_neg, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Λ.2 j), ktilde, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [smul_comm (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R j)) (qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d j) _), hw_K_smul_hwv, hN, smul_smul,
      smul_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne _), zpow_natCast]
    ring_nf
  · rw [smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralLaurentEval_qNatU
statement:
lemma integralLaurentEval_qNatU (d N : ℕ) :
    integralLaurentEval (qNatU (laurentTUnit d) N) = qInt (𝕧 ^ d) N
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_qNatU]
  congr 1
  change integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.T (d : ℤ)) = _
  rw [integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_natCast]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.laurent_smul_comm
statement:
lemma laurent_smul_comm (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (c : 𝒜) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    u • c • m = c • u • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [hw_laurent_smul_eq, hw_laurent_smul_eq, smul_algebra_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_rho_quotientMinus_smul_F_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma exists_rho_quotientMinus_smul_F_smul_hwv (i : I) {y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hy : y ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ∃ m ∈ hwIntegral Λ, ∃ a : 𝒜,
      rho R 𝕧 (quotientMinus R y) • F R 𝕧 i • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 =
        qNatU (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat • m +
          a • F R 𝕧 i • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1
proof:
:= by
  set c := qNatU (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat
  set φ := F R 𝕧 i • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1
  induction hy using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨j, n, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, map_qDivPow', quotientMinus_θ, qDivPow, map_smul, rho_pow,
      rho_F, smul_assoc]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, 1, by simp [qFactorial]⟩
    rw [pow_succ, mul_smul, rhoF_smul_F_smul_hwv]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      rcases n with _ | n
      · refine ⟨LaurentPolynomial.T ((D.d j : ℤ) - D.d j * (Λ.1 (R.coroot j)).toNat) •
          IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1, Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ), 0, ?_⟩
        rw [zero_smul, add_zero, hw_laurent_smul_eq, hw_laurent_smul_eq, integralLaurentEval_T,
          integralLaurentEval_qNatU]
        simp [qFactorial, qInt, smul_smul, mul_comm]
      · refine ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, ?_⟩
        rw [smul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero, pow_succ, mul_smul,
          smul_comm (rhoF R 𝕧 j) (_ : 𝕂), rhoF_smul_hwv, smul_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    · exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, by simp⟩
  | algebraMap c' =>
    refine ⟨0, zero_mem _, c', ?_⟩
    rw [show algebraMap 𝒜 (Quotient D 𝕧) c' =
      algebraMap 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) (integralLaurentEval c') from rfl, AlgHom.commutes,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, rho_one, smul_assoc, one_smul,
      ← hw_laurent_smul_eq, smul_zero, zero_add]
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, a₁, h₁⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, a₂, h₂⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨m₁ + m₂, add_mem hm₁ hm₂, a₁ + a₂, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, map_add, add_smul, h₁, h₂, smul_add, add_smul]
    abel
  | mul a b _ hb' ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, a₁, h₁⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, a₂, h₂⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨rho R 𝕧 (quotientMinus R b) • m₁ + a₁ • m₂,
      add_mem (rho_quotientMinus_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ hb' hm₁) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hm₂),
      a₁ * a₂, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, rho_mul, mul_smul, h₁, smul_add, laurent_smul_comm, laurent_smul_comm, h₂,
      smul_add, smul_add, smul_comm a₁ c, smul_smul, add_assoc, smul_smul a₁ a₂]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_frobPair_integralGenerator_one_eq
statement:
theorem exists_frobPair_integralGenerator_one_eq (i : I) (y : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ∃ a : 𝒜, frobPair hR Λ (integralGenerator D i 1) y =
      qNatU (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, a, h⟩ := exists_rho_quotientMinus_smul_F_smul_hwv hR Λ i y.2
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := isLaurent_formL_hwv hR Λ hm
  refine ⟨b, integralLaurentEval_injective ?_⟩
  have hθ : quotientMinus R (integralGenerator D i 1 : Quotient D 𝕧) = F R 𝕧 i := by
    change quotientMinus R (quotientIntegralGenerator D i 1) = F R 𝕧 i
    rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, map_qDivPow', quotientMinus_θ]
    simp [qDivPow, qFactorial, qInt]
  rw [integralLaurentEval_frobPair, map_mul, hb, hθ, IrreducibleModule.form_comm,
    IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt), h, map_add,
    hw_laurent_smul_eq (m := m), hw_laurent_smul_eq (m := F R 𝕧 i • _), map_smul, map_smul,
    IrreducibleModule.form_hwv_F_smul, smul_zero, add_zero, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobPairBase_tmul
statement:
lemma frobPairBase_tmul (a b : F) (x y : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frobPairBase hR Λ F (a ⊗ₜ x) (b ⊗ₜ y) = algebraMap 𝒜 F (frobPair hR Λ x y) * (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobPairBase, LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul, Algebra.smul_def]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_frobRad_iff
statement:
lemma mem_frobRad_iff (X : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    X ∈ frobRad hR Λ F ↔ ∀ y, frobPairBase hR Λ F X (1 ⊗ₜ y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h y ↦ by rw [frobRad, LinearMap.mem_ker] at h; rw [h, LinearMap.zero_apply],
    fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [frobRad, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  refine LinearMap.ext fun Z ↦ ?_
  induction Z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul b y =>
    rw [show b ⊗ₜ[𝒜] y = b • ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] y) by rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one], map_smul, h, smul_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add Z Z' hZ hZ' => rw [map_add, hZ, hZ', map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_frobRad
statement:
theorem mul_mem_frobRad (Z : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) {X : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D}
    (hX : X ∈ frobRad hR Λ F) : Z * X ∈ frobRad hR Λ F
proof:
:= by
  induction Z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a z =>
    rw [show a ⊗ₜ[𝒜] z = a • ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] z) by rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one], smul_mul_assoc]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ((mem_frobRad_iff hR Λ F _).2 fun y ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_frobPair_mul_left hR Λ z y
    have key : ∀ X : F ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D,
        frobPairBase hR Λ F ((1 ⊗ₜ z) * X) (1 ⊗ₜ y) = frobPairBase hR Λ F X (1 ⊗ₜ w) := by
      intro X
      induction X using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul b x =>
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul, frobPairBase_tmul, frobPairBase_tmul,
          hw x]
      | add X X' h h' => rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
          LinearMap.add_apply, h, h']
    rw [key, (mem_frobRad_iff hR Λ F X).1 hX w]
  | add Z Z' hZ hZ' => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hZ hZ'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_one
statement:
lemma qInt_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_one {q : F} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q ^ 2 ≠ 1) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : q ^ (2 * N) = 1) : qInt q N = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hq2
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    rw [sq]
    nth_rw 2 [h]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0
  have hNN : q ^ N - q⁻¹ ^ N = 0 := by
    rw [inv_pow, sub_eq_zero]
    exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [← pow_add, ← two_mul, hN])
  have h := qInt_mul_sub (v := q) N
  rw [hNN] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_left hq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_one_mem_frobRad
statement:
theorem baseGen_one_mem_frobRad (i : I) (hi : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i)
    (hΛ : D.frobOrder l i ∣ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) :
    baseGen D F i 1 ∈ frobRad hR Λ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_frobRad_iff]
  intro y
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_frobPair_integralGenerator_one_eq hR Λ i y
  have hq0 : algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) ^ D.d i ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero hl0 hl)
  have hq2 := pow_d_pow_ne_one D hl0 hl hprim i 1 one_pos (by omega)
  rw [mul_one] at hq2
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hΛ
  have hN : (algebraMap 𝒜 F (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) ^ D.d i) ^ (2 * (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) =
      1 := by
    rw [hc, ← mul_assoc, pow_mul, pow_d_pow_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i, one_pow]
  rw [baseGen, frobPairBase_tmul, ha, map_mul, map_qNatU, algebraMap_laurentTUnit,
    qInt_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_one F hq0 hq2 hN, zero_mul, zero_mul]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobEval_apply

    R.frobWt l ν = R.frobEval l ⟨ν, h⟩
proof:
