name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobWt_add
statement:
lemma frobWt_add {ν μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l) (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    R.frobWt l (ν + μ) = R.frobWt l ν + R.frobWt l μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.frobWt_of_mem hν, R.frobWt_of_mem hμ, R.frobWt_of_mem (add_mem hν hμ), ← map_add]
  rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobWt_sub
statement:
lemma frobWt_sub {ν μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l) (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    R.frobWt l (ν - μ) = R.frobWt l ν - R.frobWt l μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.frobWt_of_mem hν, R.frobWt_of_mem hμ, R.frobWt_of_mem (sub_mem hν hμ), ← map_sub]
  rfl

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobWt_inj
statement:
lemma frobWt_inj {ν μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l) (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    R.frobWt l ν = R.frobWt l μ ↔ ν = μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.frobWt_of_mem hν, R.frobWt_of_mem hμ, (R.frobEval_injective l).eq_iff, Subtype.mk.injEq]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.nsmul_root_eq
statement:
lemma nsmul_root_eq (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n) :
    n • R.root j = ((n / D.frobOrder l j : ℕ) • R.frobRoot hl j : R.frobWeights l)
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [AddSubgroup.coe_nsmul, coe_frobRoot,
    AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_mul_cancel hn).symm

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.nsmul_root_mem
statement:
lemma nsmul_root_mem (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n) :
    n • R.root j ∈ R.frobWeights l
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.nsmul_root_eq hl j hn]; exact SetLike.coe_mem _

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobWt_nsmul_root
statement:
lemma frobWt_nsmul_root (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n) :
    R.frobWt l (n • R.root j) = (n / D.frobOrder l j) • (R.frobRootDatum hl).root j
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.frobWt_of_mem (R.nsmul_root_mem hl j hn), ← frobEval_frobRoot, ← map_nsmul]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (R.nsmul_root_eq hl j hn)

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff
statement:
lemma add_nsmul_root_mem_iff (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n)
    {μ : Y →+ ℤ} : μ + n • R.root j ∈ R.frobWeights l ↔ μ ∈ R.frobWeights l
proof:
:=
  add_mem_cancel_right (R.nsmul_root_mem hl j hn)

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.add_nsmul_neg_root_mem_iff
statement:
lemma add_nsmul_neg_root_mem_iff (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n)
    {μ : Y →+ ℤ} : μ + n • -R.root j ∈ R.frobWeights l ↔ μ ∈ R.frobWeights l
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using add_mem h (R.nsmul_root_mem hl j hn),
    fun h ↦ sub_mem h (R.nsmul_root_mem hl j hn)⟩

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobWt_add_nsmul_root
statement:
lemma frobWt_add_nsmul_root (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n)
    {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    R.frobWt l (μ + n • R.root j) =
      R.frobWt l μ + (n / D.frobOrder l j) • (R.frobRootDatum hl).root j
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.frobWt_add hμ (R.nsmul_root_mem hl j hn), R.frobWt_nsmul_root hl j hn]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobWt_add_nsmul_neg_root
statement:
lemma frobWt_add_nsmul_neg_root (hl : 0 < l) (j : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n)
    {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    R.frobWt l (μ + n • -R.root j) =
      R.frobWt l μ + (n / D.frobOrder l j) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl).root j
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg, R.frobWt_sub hμ (R.nsmul_root_mem hl j hn),
    R.frobWt_nsmul_root hl j hn, smul_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.frobOrder_mul_frobWt_coroot
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.frobWt_of_mem hμ]
  exact R.frobOrder_mul_frobCoroot l i ⟨μ, hμ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobDiv_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma frobDiv_nil : FrobDiv D l []
proof: := fun _ h ↦ absurd h List.not_mem_nil

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobDiv_cons
statement:
lemma frobDiv_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    FrobDiv D l (p :: w) ↔ D.frobOrder l p.1 ∣ p.2 ∧ FrobDiv D l w
proof:
:=
  List.forall_mem_cons

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobDivW_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma frobDivW_nil : frobDivW D l [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobDivW_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma frobDivW_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    frobDivW D l (p :: w) = (p.1, p.2 / D.frobOrder l p.1) :: frobDivW D l w
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wtW_mem_frobWeights
statement:
lemma wtW_mem_frobWeights (hl : 0 < l) {w : List (I × ℕ)} (hw : FrobDiv D l w) :
    wtW R w ∈ R.frobWeights l
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact zero_mem _
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [frobDiv_cons] at hw
    rw [wtW_cons]
    exact add_mem (R.nsmul_root_mem hl p.1 hw.1) (ih hw.2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobWt_wtW
statement:
lemma frobWt_wtW (hl : 0 < l) {w : List (I × ℕ)} (hw : FrobDiv D l w) :
    R.frobWt l (wtW R w) = wtW (R.frobRootDatum hl) (frobDivW D l w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    simp only [wtW, frobDivW_nil, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, R.frobWt_of_mem (zero_mem _)]
    exact (R.frobEval l).map_zero
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [frobDiv_cons] at hw
    rw [wtW_cons, frobDivW_cons, wtW_cons,
      R.frobWt_add (R.nsmul_root_mem hl p.1 hw.1) (wtW_mem_frobWeights R hl hw.2),
      R.frobWt_nsmul_root hl p.1 hw.1, ih hw.2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.sub_wtW_mem
statement:
lemma sub_wtW_mem (hl : 0 < l) {ν : Y →+ ℤ} (hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l) {w : List (I × ℕ)}
    (hw : FrobDiv D l w) : ν - wtW R w ∈ R.frobWeights l
proof:
:=
  sub_mem hν (wtW_mem_frobWeights R hl hw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobWt_sub_wtW
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.frobWt_sub hν (wtW_mem_frobWeights R hl hw), frobWt_wtW R hl hw]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff (i : I) (t : ℕ) :
    (frobUnit D (l' := l') i : CyclotomicQuotient l') ^ (2 * t) = 1 ↔ D.frobOrder l i ∣ t
proof:
:= by
  have := neZero_of_frobeniusLevel hl0 hl'
  have hT : (frobUnit D (l' := l') i : CyclotomicQuotient l') =
      algebraMap 𝒜 _ (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) ^ D.d i := by
    rw [← map_pow, LaurentPolynomial.T_pow, mul_one]; rfl
  rw [hT, ← pow_mul, ← (IsFractionRing.injective (CyclotomicQuotient l')
    (FractionRing (CyclotomicQuotient l'))).eq_iff, _root_.map_one, map_pow,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, mul_comm (D.d i), mul_assoc,
    cyclotomicFraction_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff hl', ← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast,
    ← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast (m := D.frobOrder l i), D.frobOrder_dvd_iff hl0, Nat.cast_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_gaussBinom_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have := neZero_of_frobeniusLevel hl0 hl'
  rw [map_gaussBinom]
  exact gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
    ((frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff D hl0 hl' i _).2 dvd_rfl)
    (fun t h0 ht h ↦ Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt h0 ht
      ((frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff D hl0 hl' i t).1 h))
    (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i) ha ht

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_gaussBinom_mul_mul
statement:
lemma algebraMap_gaussBinom_mul_mul (i : I) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l')
        (gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (D.frobOrder l i * a) (D.frobOrder l i * t)) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l')
        (gaussBinom (laurentTUnit ((D.frobenius hl0).d i)) a t)
proof:
:= by
  have := neZero_of_frobeniusLevel hl0 hl'
  rw [map_gaussBinom, map_gaussBinom]
  refine (gaussBinom_mul_mul_eq_pow
    ((frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff D hl0 hl' i _).2 dvd_rfl)
    (fun t h0 ht h ↦ Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt h0 ht
      ((frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff D hl0 hl' i t).1 h))
    (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i) a t).trans ?_
  congr 1
  ext
  change algebraMap 𝒜 _ (LaurentPolynomial.T (D.d i)) ^ _ = algebraMap 𝒜 _ (LaurentPolynomial.T _)
  rw [← map_pow, LaurentPolynomial.T_pow, D.frobenius_d hl0]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.oneA_eq_triT
statement: lemma oneA_eq_triT (μ : Y →+ ℤ) : oneA R μ = triT R μ [] []
proof: := Subtype.ext (one_eq_triT μ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fA_eq_triT
statement: lemma fA_eq_triT (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) : fA R j m μ = triT R μ [(j, m)] []
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (divF_eq_triT j m μ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eA_eq_triT
statement:
lemma eA_eq_triT (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    eA R i n μ = triT R (μ + n • R.root i) [] [(i, n)]
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (divE_eq_triT i n μ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.oneA_mul_triT
statement:
lemma oneA_mul_triT (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    oneA R μ * triT R ν w w' = if μ = ν - wtW R w then triT R ν w w' else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [NonUnitalSubalgebra.coe_mul, oneA, one_mul_triT]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fA_mul_triT
statement:
lemma fA_mul_triT (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fA R j m μ * triT R ν w w' = if μ = ν - wtW R w then triT R ν ((j, m) :: w) w' else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [NonUnitalSubalgebra.coe_mul, fA, divF_mul_triT]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eA_mul_triT_nil
statement:
lemma eA_mul_triT_nil (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    eA R i n μ * triT R ν [] w' =
      if μ = ν then triT R (ν + n • R.root i) [] ((i, n) :: w') else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [NonUnitalSubalgebra.coe_mul, eA, divE_mul_triT_nil]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triT_cons'
statement:
lemma triT_cons' (j : I) (m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    triT R ν ((j, m) :: w) w' = fA R j m (ν - wtW R w) * triT R ν w w'
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (triT_cons j m ν w w')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index
statement:
lemma eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index (i j : I) (n m : ℕ) {μ ν : Y →+ ℤ} (h : μ ≠ ν + m • -R.root j) :
    eA R i n μ * fA R j m ν = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (elt_mul_elt_of_ne h _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eA_mul_fA_of_ne
statement:
lemma eA_mul_fA_of_ne {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    eA R i n (ν + m • -R.root j) * fA R j m ν = fA R j m (ν + n • R.root i) * eA R i n ν
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (dE_mul_dF_of_ne hij n m ν)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eA_mul_fA_self
statement:
lemma eA_mul_fA_self (i : I) (n m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    eA R i n (ν + m • -R.root i) * fA R i m ν =
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), if t ≤ m then
        gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (ν (R.coroot i) + n - m) t •
          (fA R i (m - t) (ν + (n - t) • R.root i) * eA R i (n - t) ν) else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [NonUnitalSubalgebra.coe_mul]
  change dE R 𝕧 i n (ν + m • -R.root i) * dF R 𝕧 i m ν = _
  rw [dE_mul_dF (fun _ hn ↦ ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one hn), AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
  split_ifs
  · rw [NonUnitalSubalgebra.coe_smul, laurent_smul,
      integralLaurentEval_gaussBinom _ (D.d_pos i)]
    rfl
  · rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobF_apply
statement:
lemma frobF_apply (x : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frobF hl0 hl' hA S x = frobGeneral D hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ x)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobF_thetaW
statement:
lemma frobF_thetaW (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    frobF hl0 hl' hA S (thetaW D w) =
      if FrobDiv D l w then (1 : S) ⊗ₜ thetaW (D.frobenius hl0) (frobDivW D l w) else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [frobF_apply, thetaW_nil, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, _root_.map_one]
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [frobF_apply, thetaW_cons, ← one_mul (1 : S), ← Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
      _root_.map_mul, frobGeneral_integralGenerator, ← frobF_apply, ih, frobValue, frobDiv_cons,
      frobDivW_cons, thetaW_cons]
    by_cases h1 : D.frobOrder l p.1 ∣ p.2 <;> by_cases h2 : FrobDiv D l w <;>
      simp [h1, h2, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_triSumEquiv
statement:
lemma frobA_triSumEquiv (y : (Y →+ ℤ) →₀ quotientIntegralForm D ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (triSumEquiv R y) =
      Finsupp.lsum ℕ (fun ν ↦ TensorProduct.lift (frobBil R hl0 hl' hA S ν)) y
proof:
:=
  congrArg (Finsupp.lsum ℕ fun ν ↦ TensorProduct.lift (frobBil R hl0 hl' hA S ν))
    ((triSumEquiv R).symm_apply_apply y)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_triA
statement:
lemma frobA_triA (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (x x' : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (triA R ν x x') = frobBil R hl0 hl' hA S ν x x'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← triSumEquiv_single, frobA_triSumEquiv]
  exact (Finsupp.lsum_single ℕ _ ν _).trans (TensorProduct.lift.tmul _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_triT
statement:
lemma frobA_triT (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (triT R ν w w') =
      if ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ FrobDiv D l w ∧ FrobDiv D l w' then
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ triT (R.frobRootDatum hl0) (R.frobWt l ν) (frobDivW D l w) (frobDivW D l w')
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [triT, frobA_triA, frobBil]
  by_cases hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l
  · simp only [hν, ↓reduceIte, true_and, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply,
      LinearMap.restrictScalars₁₂_apply_apply, frobF_thetaW]
    by_cases h : FrobDiv D l w <;> by_cases h' : FrobDiv D l w' <;>
      simp [h, h', triS_tmul, triT]
  · simp [hν]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_oneA
statement:
lemma frobA_oneA (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (oneA R μ) =
      if μ ∈ R.frobWeights l then (1 : S) ⊗ₜ oneA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) (R.frobWt l μ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [oneA_eq_triT, frobA_triT, oneA_eq_triT]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_fA
statement:
lemma frobA_fA (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m μ) =
      if μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ m then
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j (m / D.frobOrder l j) (R.frobWt l μ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fA_eq_triT, frobA_triT, fA_eq_triT]
  simp [frobDiv_cons]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA
statement:
lemma frobA_eA (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n μ) =
      if μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n then
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (n / D.frobOrder l i) (R.frobWt l μ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eA_eq_triT, frobA_triT, eA_eq_triT]
  by_cases hn : D.frobOrder l i ∣ n
  · rw [R.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff hl0 i hn]
    by_cases hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l
    · simp [hμ, hn, frobDiv_cons, R.frobWt_add_nsmul_root hl0 i hn hμ]
    · simp [hμ]
  · simp [hn, frobDiv_cons]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.tmul_one_mul_tmul_one
statement:
lemma tmul_one_mul_tmul_one {A : Type*} [NonUnitalRing A] [Module 𝒜 A] [IsScalarTower 𝒜 A A]
    [SMulCommClass 𝒜 A A] (x y : A) :
    ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] x) * ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] y) = (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_oneA_mul_triT
statement:
lemma frobA_oneA_mul_triT (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (oneA R μ * triT R ν w w') =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (oneA R μ) * frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (triT R ν w w')
proof:
:= by
  rw [oneA_mul_triT, apply_ite (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S), map_zero, frobA_oneA, frobA_triT]
  by_cases hΦ : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ FrobDiv D l w ∧ FrobDiv D l w'
  · obtain ⟨hν, hw, hw'⟩ := hΦ
    have hν' := sub_wtW_mem R hl0 hν hw
    by_cases hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l
    · simp only [hν, hw, hw', hμ, and_self, ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one, oneA_mul_triT]
      have key : R.frobWt l μ = R.frobWt l ν - wtW (R.frobRootDatum hl0) (frobDivW D l w) ↔
          μ = ν - wtW R w := by rw [← frobWt_sub_wtW R hl0 hν hw, R.frobWt_inj hμ hν']
      by_cases h : μ = ν - wtW R w
      · simp only [key.2 h, ↓reduceIte]; simp [h]
      · simp only [mt key.1 h, ↓reduceIte]; simp [h]
    · have : μ ≠ ν - wtW R w := fun h ↦ hμ (h ▸ hν')
      simp [hμ, this]
  · simp [hΦ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_fA_mul_triT
statement:
lemma frobA_fA_mul_triT (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m μ * triT R ν w w') =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m μ) * frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (triT R ν w w')
proof:
:= by
  rw [fA_mul_triT, apply_ite (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S), map_zero, frobA_fA, frobA_triT,
    frobA_triT, frobDiv_cons, frobDivW_cons]
  by_cases hΦ : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ FrobDiv D l w ∧ FrobDiv D l w'
  · obtain ⟨hν, hw, hw'⟩ := hΦ
    have hν' := sub_wtW_mem R hl0 hν hw
    by_cases hm : D.frobOrder l j ∣ m
    · by_cases hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l
      · simp only [hν, hw, hw', hμ, hm, and_self, ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one,
          fA_mul_triT]
        have key : R.frobWt l μ = R.frobWt l ν - wtW (R.frobRootDatum hl0) (frobDivW D l w) ↔
            μ = ν - wtW R w := by rw [← frobWt_sub_wtW R hl0 hν hw, R.frobWt_inj hμ hν']
        by_cases h : μ = ν - wtW R w
        · simp only [key.2 h, ↓reduceIte]; simp [h]
        · simp only [mt key.1 h, ↓reduceIte]; simp [h]
      · have : μ ≠ ν - wtW R w := fun h ↦ hμ (h ▸ hν')
        simp [hμ, this]
    · simp [hm]
  · have : ¬ (ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ (D.frobOrder l j ∣ m ∧ FrobDiv D l w) ∧ FrobDiv D l w') :=
      fun h ↦ hΦ ⟨h.1, h.2.1.2, h.2.2⟩
    simp only [this, hΦ, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero, ite_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_tmul_one_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', Algebra.smul_def,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') S, h, map_zero, zero_mul,
    TensorProduct.zero_tmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_tmul_one_congr
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.smul_tmul', Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') S c,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') S c', h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_coeff_eq_zero
statement:
lemma algebraMap_coeff_eq_zero (i : I) {ν : Y →+ ℤ} (hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l) {n m t : ℕ}
    (htn : t ≤ n) (htm : t ≤ m) (hn : D.frobOrder l i ∣ n - t) (hm : D.frobOrder l i ∣ m - t)
    (ht : ¬ D.frobOrder l i ∣ t) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l')
      (gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (ν (R.coroot i) + n - m) t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine algebraMap_gaussBinom_eq_zero D hl0 hl' i ?_ ht
  have h : (n : ℤ) - m = ((n - t : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((m - t : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub htn, Nat.cast_sub htm]; ring
  rw [add_sub_assoc, h]
  exact dvd_add ⟨_, (R.frobOrder_mul_frobWt_coroot hl0 i hν).symm⟩
    (dvd_sub (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 hn) (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 hm))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frob_term_eq_zero
statement:
lemma frob_term_eq_zero (i : I) (n m t : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (htn : t ≤ n)
    (h : ¬ (ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ m ∧
      D.frobOrder l i ∣ t)) :
    (if t ≤ m then gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (ν (R.coroot i) + n - m) t •
        (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R i (m - t) (ν + (n - t) • R.root i)) *
          frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i (n - t) ν)) else 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with htm
  · rw [frobA_fA, frobA_eA]
    by_cases h1 : ν + (n - t) • R.root i ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ m - t
    · by_cases h2 : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n - t
      · have ht : ¬ D.frobOrder l i ∣ t := fun ht ↦ h ⟨h2.1,
          by simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel htn] using Nat.dvd_add h2.2 ht,
          by simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel htm] using Nat.dvd_add h1.2 ht, ht⟩
        simp only [h1, h2, and_self, ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one]
        exact smul_tmul_one_eq_zero S
          (algebraMap_coeff_eq_zero R hl0 hl' i h2.1 htn htm h2.2 h1.2 ht) _
      · simp [h2]
    · simp [h1]
  · rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_term
statement:
lemma frobA_term (i : I) (n m t : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (if t ≤ m then
        gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (ν (R.coroot i) + n - m) t •
          (fA R i (m - t) (ν + (n - t) • R.root i) * eA R i (n - t) ν) else 0) =
      if t ≤ m then gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (ν (R.coroot i) + n - m) t •
          (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R i (m - t) (ν + (n - t) • R.root i)) *
            frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i (n - t) ν)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs
  · rw [map_smul, eA_eq_triT i (n - t) ν, frobA_fA_mul_triT, ← eA_eq_triT]
  · exact map_zero _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_frobA_fA_eq_zero
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_frobA_fA_eq_zero (i : I) (n m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ)
    (h : ¬ (ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ m)) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n (ν + m • -R.root i)) *
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R i m ν) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobA_eA, frobA_fA]
  by_cases h1 : ν + m • -R.root i ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n
  · by_cases h2 : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ m
    · exact absurd ⟨h2.1, h1.2, h2.2⟩ h
    · simp only [h2, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
  · simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frob_sum_eq_zero
statement:
lemma frob_sum_eq_zero (i : I) (n m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ)
    (h : ¬ (ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ m)) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (if t ≤ m then
        gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i)) (ν (R.coroot i) + n - m) t •
          (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R i (m - t) (ν + (n - t) • R.root i)) *
            frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i (n - t) ν)) else 0) = 0
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t ht ↦ frob_term_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S i n m t ν
    (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 ht)) fun h' ↦ h ⟨h'.1, h'.2.1, h'.2.2.1⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frob_sum_reindex
statement:
lemma frob_sum_reindex (i : I) (a b : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (D.frobOrder l i * a + 1), (if t ≤ D.frobOrder l i * b then
        gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i))
            (ν (R.coroot i) + (D.frobOrder l i * a : ℕ) - (D.frobOrder l i * b : ℕ)) t •
          (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S
              (fA R i (D.frobOrder l i * b - t) (ν + (D.frobOrder l i * a - t) • R.root i)) *
            frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i (D.frobOrder l i * a - t) ν)) else 0) =
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), (if D.frobOrder l i * t ≤ D.frobOrder l i * b then
        gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i))
            (ν (R.coroot i) + (D.frobOrder l i * a : ℕ) - (D.frobOrder l i * b : ℕ))
            (D.frobOrder l i * t) •
          (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R i (D.frobOrder l i * b - D.frobOrder l i * t)
              (ν + (D.frobOrder l i * a - D.frobOrder l i * t) • R.root i)) *
            frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i (D.frobOrder l i * a - D.frobOrder l i * t) ν))
        else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hLpos := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  have hsub : (Finset.range (a + 1)).image (D.frobOrder l i * ·) ⊆
      Finset.range (D.frobOrder l i * a + 1) := by
    intro t ht
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at ht ⊢
    obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := ht
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 ht'))
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub ?_, Finset.sum_image ?_]
  · exact fun x _ y _ h ↦ Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hLpos h
  · intro t ht ht'
    refine frob_term_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S i _ _ t ν
      (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 ht)) fun h ↦ ht' ?_
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h.2.2.2
    refine Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨c, Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le ?_), rfl⟩
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left_iff hLpos).1 (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 ht))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frob_term_mul
statement:
lemma frob_term_mul (i : I) (a b t : ℕ) {ν : Y →+ ℤ} (hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    (if D.frobOrder l i * t ≤ D.frobOrder l i * b then
        gaussBinom (laurentTUnit (D.d i))
            (ν (R.coroot i) + (D.frobOrder l i * a : ℕ) - (D.frobOrder l i * b : ℕ))
            (D.frobOrder l i * t) •
          (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R i (D.frobOrder l i * b - D.frobOrder l i * t)
              (ν + (D.frobOrder l i * a - D.frobOrder l i * t) • R.root i)) *
            frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i (D.frobOrder l i * a - D.frobOrder l i * t) ν))
        else 0) =
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (if t ≤ b then
        gaussBinom (laurentTUnit ((D.frobenius hl0).d i))
            (R.frobWt l ν ((R.frobRootDatum hl0).coroot i) + a - b) t •
          (fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (b - t)
              (R.frobWt l ν + (a - t) • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
            eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (a - t) (R.frobWt l ν)) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hLpos := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  rw [← Nat.mul_sub, ← Nat.mul_sub]
  simp only [Nat.mul_le_mul_left_iff hLpos]
  split_ifs with htb
  · rw [frobA_fA, frobA_eA]
    simp only [(R.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff hl0 i (dvd_mul_right _ (a - t))).2 hν, hν,
      dvd_mul_right, and_self, ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one,
      R.frobWt_add_nsmul_root hl0 i (dvd_mul_right _ (a - t)) hν,
      Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hLpos, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
    refine smul_tmul_one_congr (l' := l') S ?_ _
    rw [← algebraMap_gaussBinom_mul_mul D hl0 hl' i]
    congr 2
    rw [← R.frobOrder_mul_frobWt_coroot hl0 i hν]
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_fA_self
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_fA_self (i : I) (n m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n (ν + m • -R.root i) * fA R i m ν) =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n (ν + m • -R.root i)) *
        frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R i m ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eA_mul_fA_self, map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ frobA_term R hl0 hl' hA S i n m t ν]
  by_cases hmain : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ m
  swap
  · exact (frob_sum_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S i n m ν hmain).trans
      (frobA_eA_mul_frobA_fA_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S i n m ν hmain).symm
  obtain ⟨hν, ⟨a, rfl⟩, ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩ := hmain
  have hLpos := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  rw [frob_sum_reindex R hl0 hl' hA S i a b ν,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ frob_term_mul R hl0 hl' hA S i a b t hν,
    ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
    ← eA_mul_fA_self (R := R.frobRootDatum hl0) i a b (R.frobWt l ν), ← tmul_one_mul_tmul_one,
    frobA_eA, frobA_fA]
  simp only [(R.add_nsmul_neg_root_mem_iff hl0 i (dvd_mul_right _ b)).2 hν, hν,
    dvd_mul_right, and_self, ↓reduceIte,
    R.frobWt_add_nsmul_neg_root hl0 i (dvd_mul_right _ b) hν, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hLpos]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_add_one_succ
statement:
lemma qBinomInt_add_one_succ (hq : q ≠ 0) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    qBinomInt q (a + 1) (t + 1) =
      q ^ (-((t : ℤ) + 1)) * qBinomInt q a (t + 1) + q ^ (a - t) * qBinomInt q a t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_qBinomIntSeries, qBinomIntSeries_add_one hq, add_mul, one_mul, map_add,
    mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_rescale, coeff_rescale,
    coeff_qBinomIntSeries, coeff_qBinomIntSeries, inv_pow, inv_pow, ← zpow_natCast,
    ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_neg, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomInt_eq_qBinomZ
statement:
lemma qBinomInt_eq_qBinomZ {q : 𝕂} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (m : ℤ)
    (t : ℕ) : qBinomInt q m t = qBinomZ q m t
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    have ht : qIntZ q ((t : ℤ) + 1) ≠ 0 := qIntZ_ne_zero hq0 hq (by omega)
    have hc : q ^ (-((t : ℤ) + 1)) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hq0
    induction m using Int.induction_on with
    | zero =>
      rw [Modified.qBinomZ_zero_succ, ← Nat.cast_zero, qBinomInt_natCast, qBinomial_zero_succ]
    | succ m hm => rw [qBinomInt_add_one_succ hq0, Modified.qBinomZ_succ_succ_eq hq0 _ _ ht, hm, ih]
    | pred m hm =>
      have h1 := qBinomInt_add_one_succ hq0 (-(m : ℤ) - 1) t
      have h2 := Modified.qBinomZ_succ_succ_eq hq0 (-(m : ℤ) - 1) t ht
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h1 h2
      rw [hm, h2, ih] at h1
      exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hc (add_right_cancel h1)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralLaurentEval_gaussBinom
statement:
lemma integralLaurentEval_gaussBinom (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (m : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    integralLaurentEval (gaussBinom (laurentTUnit d) m t) = qBinomZ (𝕧 ^ d) m t
proof:
:= by
  have hv : integralLaurentEval (laurentTUnit d : 𝒜) = 𝕧 ^ d := by
    change integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.T (d : ℤ)) = _
    rw [integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_natCast]
  rw [map_gaussBinom_field, hv]
  refine qBinomInt_eq_qBinomZ (pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero) (fun n hn ↦ ?_) m t
  rw [← pow_mul]
  exact pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt _ (Nat.mul_pos hd hn)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientMinus_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma quotientMinus_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    quotientMinus R (integralGenerator D i n : Quotient D 𝕧) = qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i)
proof:
:= by

  rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, map_qDivPow', quotientMinus_θ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_quotientMinus_smul_hwv_eq
statement:
lemma exists_quotientMinus_smul_hwv_eq {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ) :
    ∃ z : quotientIntegralForm D,
      quotientMinus R (z : Quotient D 𝕧) • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 = m
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_nullSub_iff
statement:
lemma mem_nullSub_iff {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} :
    m ∈ nullSub hR Λ k ↔ m ∈ hwIntegral Λ ∧ ∀ m' ∈ hwIntegral Λ, ∀ a : 𝒜,
      integralLaurentEval a = formL hvt hR Λ m m' → algebraMap 𝒜 k a = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nullSub_le
statement: lemma nullSub_le : nullSub hR Λ k ≤ hwIntegral Λ
proof: := fun _ h ↦ h.1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dF_smul_mem_nullSub
statement:
lemma dF_smul_mem_nullSub (j : I) (n : ℕ) {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hm : m ∈ nullSub hR Λ k) : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j) • m ∈ nullSub hR Λ k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ j n hm.1, fun m' hm' a ha ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := rho_qDivPow_F_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ j n hm'
  refine hm.2 _ h a ?_
  rw [ha, IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad_of_two_le
statement:
theorem baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad_of_two_le [CharZero k] (i : I) (hi : 2 ≤ D.frobOrder l i)
    (Z : k ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) : baseGen D k i 1 * Z ∈ frobRad hR Λ k
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : Z ∈ (⊤ : Submodule k (k ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D)) := trivial
  rw [← span_frobWords_sup_frobRad hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ, Submodule.mem_sup] at hZ
  obtain ⟨s, hs, r, hr, rfl⟩ := hZ
  rw [mul_add]
  refine add_mem ?_ (mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ k _ hr)
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw => exact baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ hw i hi
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dF_smul_mem_nullSub_of_lt
statement:
theorem dF_smul_mem_nullSub_of_lt [CharZero k] (i : I) {b : ℕ} (hb0 : 0 < b)
    (hb : b < D.frobOrder l i) {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) b (F R 𝕧 i) • m ∈ nullSub hR Λ k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ i b hm, fun m' hm' a ha ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := exists_quotientMinus_smul_hwv_eq Λ hm
  obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := exists_quotientMinus_smul_hwv_eq Λ hm'
  have e : a = frobPair hR Λ (integralGenerator D i b * z) z' := integralLaurentEval_injective (by
    rw [ha, integralLaurentEval_frobPair, Subalgebra.coe_mul, map_mul, mul_smul,
      quotientMinus_integralGenerator])
  have hX : (1 : k) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] (integralGenerator D i b * z) ∈ frobRad hR Λ k := by
    rw [show (1 : k) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] (integralGenerator D i b * z) =
        baseGen D k i b * (1 ⊗ₜ[𝒜] z) by rw [baseGen, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul],
      baseGen_eq_smul_pow_of_lt D hl0 hl hprim i hb, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel hb0, pow_succ',
      smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (baseGen_one_mul_mem_frobRad_of_two_le hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ i (by omega) _)
  have h0 := LinearMap.congr_fun ((LinearMap.mem_ker).1 hX) ((1 : k) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] z')
  rw [frobPairBase_tmul, mul_one, mul_one, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h0
  rw [e, h0]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobRootSum_add

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobRootSum_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobRootSum_single

@[simp] lemma frobRootSum_single (l : ℕ) (j : I) (n : ℕ) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobVec_mem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobVec_one

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobVec_ι_mul

proof:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobVec_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobVec_smul
statement:
lemma frobVec_smul (c : 𝒜) (x : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I) :

proof:

    ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobVec_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw =>
    subst hw
    induction w with
    | nil =>
      simpa using IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := 𝕧) (Λ := Λ.1)
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, frobVec_ι_mul, wordWeight_cons, frobRootSum_add,
        frobRootSum_single, one_mul, sub_add_eq_sub_sub_swap]
      exact qDivPow_F_smul_mem_weightSpace ih j _
  | zero => rw [← zero_smul 𝒜 (0 : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I), frobVec_smul, zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [frobVec_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [frobVec_smul, hw_laurent_smul_eq]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_rho_dF_smul_eq
statement:
lemma exists_rho_dF_smul_eq (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) (n : ℕ) : ∃ e : ℤ,
    ∀ m ∈ weightSpace R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) μ,
      rho R 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i)) • m =
        𝕧 ^ e • (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) • m)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∃ e : ℤ, ∀ m ∈ weightSpace R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) μ,
      (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) * E R 𝕧 i) ^ n • m = 𝕧 ^ e • (E R 𝕧 i ^ n • m) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, fun m _ ↦ by simp⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨e + (μ + (n + 1) • R.root i) (-ktilde R i), fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, he m hm, smul_comm _ (𝕧 ^ e), mul_smul, ← mul_smul (E R 𝕧 i),
        ← pow_succ', E_pow_smul_mem_weightSpace Λ hm i (n + 1) (-ktilde R i), smul_smul,
        ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne _)]
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h1
  refine ⟨(D.d i * n : ℕ) + e, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [qDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, rho_pow, rho_F, rhoF, smul_pow, smul_assoc, smul_assoc,
    he m hm, smul_assoc, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne _), zpow_natCast,
    pow_mul]
  ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralLaurentEval_frobPair_frobGen
statement:
lemma integralLaurentEval_frobPair_frobGen (x y : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I) :
    integralLaurentEval (frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l x) (frobGen D l y)) =
      formL hvt hR Λ (frobVec Λ l x) (frobVec Λ l y)
proof:
:=
  integralLaurentEval_frobPair hR Λ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobPair_nil
statement:
lemma frobPair_nil (hl0 : 0 < l) (y : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I) :
    frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I [])) (frobGen D l y) =
      FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul c x hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hx]
  | word u =>
    refine integralLaurentEval_injective ?_
    rw [integralLaurentEval_frobPair_frobGen, FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_nil, frobVec_one]
    cases u with
    | nil => simp
    | cons j u =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, D.frobOrder l j = n + 1 :=
        Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 j).ne'
      rw [← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, frobVec_ι_mul, hn, qDivPow, smul_assoc, map_smul,
        pow_succ', mul_smul, IrreducibleModule.form_hwv_F_smul, smul_zero]
      simp [FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dE_smul_frobVec_sub_mem
statement:
theorem dE_smul_frobVec_sub_mem (i : I) (x : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (D.frobOrder l i) (E R 𝕧 i) • frobVec Λ l x -
      frobVec Λ l (vermaOp i (frobCoeff Λ l i) x) ∈ nullSub hR Λ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, D.frobOrder l i = n + 1 :=
    Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i).ne'
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis with
  | zero =>
    rw [← zero_smul 𝒜 (0 : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I), map_smul, frobVec_smul, frobVec_smul, zero_smul,
      zero_smul, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, frobVec_add, frobVec_add, smul_add]
    convert add_mem hx hy using 1
    abel
  | smul c x hx =>
    rw [map_smul, frobVec_smul, frobVec_smul, laurent_smul_comm, ← smul_sub]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx
  | word w =>
    induction w with
    | nil =>
      rw [FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_nil, vermaOp_one, frobVec_one, hn,
        qDivPow_E_smul_hwv Λ i n.succ_pos, ← zero_smul 𝒜 (0 : FreeAlgebra 𝒜 I), frobVec_smul,
        zero_smul, sub_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, vermaOp_ι_mul, frobVec_ι_mul, frobVec_add,
        frobVec_ι_mul]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl, weightScale_of_mem _ (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w),
          frobVec_smul]
        have hm := frobVec_mem_weightSpace Λ l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan (R := 𝒜) w)
        rw [hn, qDivPow_E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul hvn_ratFunc hm, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ']
        set m := frobVec Λ l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I w)
        have hlast : efTerm R 𝕧 i ((Λ.1 - frobRootSum D R l (wordWeight w)) (R.coroot i))
            (n + 1) (n + 1) (n + 1) m = frobCoeff Λ l i (wordWeight w) • m := by
          rw [efTerm, ite_eq_left le_rfl, frobCoeff, hn, hw_laurent_smul_eq,
            integralLaurentEval_gaussBinom _ (D.d_pos i), Nat.sub_self, qDivPow_zero',
            qDivPow_zero', one_smul, one_smul, add_sub_cancel_right]
        have hfirst : efTerm R 𝕧 i ((Λ.1 - frobRootSum D R l (wordWeight w)) (R.coroot i))
            (n + 1) (n + 1) 0 m - qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n + 1) (F R 𝕧 i) •
              frobVec Λ l (vermaOp i (frobCoeff Λ l i) (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I w)) ∈
              nullSub hR Λ k := by
          rw [efTerm, ite_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _), qBinomZ_zero, one_smul, Nat.sub_zero,
            ← smul_sub]
          rw [hn] at ih
          exact dF_smul_mem_nullSub hR Λ i _ ih
        have hmid : ∑ t ∈ range n, efTerm R 𝕧 i
            ((Λ.1 - frobRootSum D R l (wordWeight w)) (R.coroot i)) (n + 1) (n + 1) (t + 1) m ∈
              nullSub hR Λ k := by
          refine sum_mem fun t ht ↦ ?_
          rw [mem_range] at ht
          rw [efTerm, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Modified.isLaurent_qBinomZ (D.d i) (D.d_pos i)
            ((Λ.1 - frobRootSum D R l (wordWeight w)) (R.coroot i) + ↑(n + 1) - ↑(n + 1)) (t + 1)
          rw [← ha, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
          refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (dF_smul_mem_nullSub_of_lt hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ i
            (by omega) (by omega) (dE_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ i _ (frobVec_mem Λ l _)))
        convert add_mem (add_mem hmid hfirst) (zero_mem (nullSub hR Λ k)) using 1
        rw [hlast]
        abel
      · rw [ite_eq_right hij, frobVec_zero, add_zero]
        have hc : Commute (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (D.frobOrder l i) (E R 𝕧 i))
            (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (D.frobOrder l j) (F R 𝕧 j)) :=
          ((Commute.pow_pow (E_mul_F_of_ne (R := R) (v := 𝕧) hij) _ _).smul_left _).smul_right _
        rw [← mul_smul, hc.eq, mul_smul, ← smul_sub]
        exact dF_smul_mem_nullSub hR Λ j _ ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_frobPair_cons_eq
statement:
theorem exists_frobPair_cons_eq (i : I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) : ∃ e : ℤ,
    ∀ x ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan 𝒜 μ, ∀ w : List I,
      algebraMap 𝒜 k (frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I (i :: w)))
        (frobGen D l x)) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 k (LaurentPolynomial.T e) *
        algebraMap 𝒜 k (frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I w))
          (frobGen D l (vermaOp i (frobCoeff Λ l i) x)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_rho_dF_smul_eq Λ (Λ.1 - frobRootSum D R l μ) i (D.frobOrder l i)
  refine ⟨e, fun x hx w ↦ ?_⟩
  set mw := frobVec Λ l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I w)
  have hN := dE_smul_frobVec_sub_mem hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ (k := k) i x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := isLaurent_formL hR Λ hN.1 (frobVec_mem Λ l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I w))
  have hk := hN.2 _ (frobVec_mem Λ l _) a ha
  rw [IrreducibleModule.form_comm, map_sub] at ha
  have key : frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I (i :: w))) (frobGen D l x) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T e * (frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I w))
        (frobGen D l (vermaOp i (frobCoeff Λ l i) x)) + a) := by
    refine integralLaurentEval_injective ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_add, integralLaurentEval_T, integralLaurentEval_frobPair_frobGen,
      integralLaurentEval_frobPair_frobGen, ha,
      ← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, frobVec_ι_mul,
      IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt),
      he _ (frobVec_mem_weightSpace Λ l hx), map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [key, map_mul, map_add, hk, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_frobPair_eq_vermaForm
statement:
theorem exists_frobPair_eq_vermaForm (w : List I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) : ∃ κ : k, IsUnit κ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan 𝒜 μ,
      algebraMap 𝒜 k (frobPair hR Λ (frobGen D l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I w))
        (frobGen D l x)) =
      κ * algebraMap 𝒜 k (vermaForm (fun i ↦ frobCoeff Λ l i) w x)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing μ with
  | nil =>
    exact ⟨1, isUnit_one, fun x _ ↦ by
      rw [one_mul, frobPair_nil hR Λ (l := l) hl0, vermaForm_nil]⟩
  | cons i w ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_frobPair_cons_eq hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ (k := k) i μ
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hκ'⟩ := ih (μ - Finsupp.single i 1)
    refine ⟨algebraMap 𝒜 k (LaurentPolynomial.T e) * κ,
      ((LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T e).map _).mul hκ, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [he x hx w, hκ' _ (vermaOp_mem_wordSpan _ _ hx), vermaForm_cons, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobSplitHom_wordBasis
statement:
lemma frobSplitHom_wordBasis (u : List I) :
    frobSplitHom D k l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I u) =
      (1 : k) ⊗ₜ frobGen D l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝒜 I u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  | cons j u ih =>
    rw [← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, ← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, map_mul, map_mul, ih,
      frobGen, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, ← frobGen]
    rw [show frobSplitHom D k l (FreeAlgebra.ι k j) = baseGen D k j (D.frobOrder l j) from
      frobSplitHom_θ D k l j, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_frobPairBase_eq_vermaForm
statement:
theorem exists_frobPairBase_eq_vermaForm (w : List I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) : ∃ κ : k, IsUnit κ ∧
    ∀ y ∈ FreeAlgebra.wordSpan k μ,
      frobPairBase hR Λ k (frobSplitHom D k l (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I w))
        (frobSplitHom D k l y) =
      κ * vermaForm (fun i ↦ algebraMap 𝒜 k ∘ frobCoeff Λ l i) w y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hκ'⟩ := exists_frobPair_eq_vermaForm hR Λ hl0 hl hprim hA hΛ (k := k) w μ
  refine ⟨κ, hκ, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  induction hy using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word u hu =>
    rw [frobSplitHom_wordBasis, frobSplitHom_wordBasis, frobPairBase_tmul, mul_one,
      hκ' _ (hu ▸ FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan u), map_vermaForm,
      FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_wordBasis, mul_one]
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hy, hz, mul_add]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hy, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobBase_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma frobBase_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobBase D hl0 hl hprim hA ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i n) =
      baseChangeMap (D.frobenius hl0) B F (frobValue D hl0 B i n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobBase, AlgHom.comp_apply, baseChangeMap_tmul, map_one, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
    frob_baseGen, frobValue]
  split_ifs
  · rw [baseChangeMap_tmul, map_one]
  · rw [map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobBase_mem_range
statement:
lemma frobBase_mem_range (x : B ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    frobBase D hl0 hl hprim hA x ∈ (baseChangeMap (D.frobenius hl0) B F).range
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.adjoin B (Set.range fun p : I × ℕ ↦
      (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] integralGenerator D p.1 p.2) ≤
      (baseChangeMap (D.frobenius hl0) B F).range.comap (frobBase D hl0 hl hprim hA) := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (frobBase_integralGenerator D hl0 hl hprim hA i n).symm⟩
  rw [adjoin_baseChangeGenerator] at this
  exact this Algebra.mem_top

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseChangeMap_frobOfInjective
statement:
lemma baseChangeMap_frobOfInjective (x : B ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D) :
    baseChangeMap (D.frobenius hl0) B F (frobOfInjective D hl0 hl hprim hA hBF x) =
      frobBase D hl0 hl hprim hA x
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobOfInjective, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    ((AlgEquiv.ofInjective _ (baseChangeMap_injective (D.frobenius hl0) hBF)).apply_symm_apply _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobOfInjective_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem frobOfInjective_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobOfInjective D hl0 hl hprim hA hBF ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i n) =
      frobValue D hl0 B i n
proof:
:=
  baseChangeMap_injective (D.frobenius hl0) hBF (by
    rw [baseChangeMap_frobOfInjective, frobBase_integralGenerator])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobCyclotomic_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem frobCyclotomic_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobCyclotomic D hl0 hl' hA ((1 : CyclotomicQuotient l') ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i n) =
      frobValue D hl0 (CyclotomicQuotient l') i n
proof:
:= by

  exact frobOfInjective_integralGenerator _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.frobGeneral_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem frobGeneral_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    frobGeneral D hl0 hl' hA R ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i n) =
      frobValue D hl0 R i n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobGeneral, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    cancelBaseChangeRing_symm_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    frobCyclotomic_integralGenerator, AlgHom.id_apply, frobValue]
  split_ifs
  · rw [cancelBaseChangeRing_tmul, Algebra.smul_def, map_one, one_mul]
  · rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    exact (cancelBaseChangeRing 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') R _).map_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_frobGeneral
statement:
theorem eq_frobGeneral
    (φ : R ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm D →ₐ[R] R ⊗[𝒜] quotientIntegralForm (D.frobenius hl0))
    (hφ : ∀ i n, φ ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ integralGenerator D i n) = frobValue D hl0 R i n) :
    φ = frobGeneral D hl0 hl' hA R
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (adjoin_baseChangeGenerator D R) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, n⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hφ, frobGeneral_integralGenerator]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.integralLaurentEval_braidCoeffE
statement:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_oneA

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_sum_of_mem
statement:
lemma elt_sum_of_mem {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ s, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l₁ - l₂)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ (∑ t ∈ s, f t) (Submodule.sum_mem _ hf) =
      ∑ t ∈ s.attach, elt l₁ l₂ (f t) (hf t t.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := elt_sum (l₁ := l₁) (l₂ := l₂) s.attach (fun t ↦ f t) fun t ↦ hf t t.2
  rw [← h]
  exact elt_congr (Finset.sum_attach s f).symm _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_smul_triple_E
statement:
lemma elt_smul_triple_E (c : 𝒜) {k : 𝕂} (hc : integralLaurentEval c = k) (i j : I) (a n r : ℕ)
    (w L : Y →+ ℤ) (e : w + r • R.root i + n • R.root j + a • R.root i = L)
    (h : k • (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) a (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (E R 𝕧 j) *
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - w)) :
    elt L w (k • (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) a (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (E R 𝕧 j) *
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (E R 𝕧 i))) h =
      c • (divE R i a (w + r • R.root i + n • R.root j) * divE R j n (w + r • R.root i) *
        divE R i r w)
proof:
:= by
  subst hc e
  rw [divE, divE, divE, elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt, laurent_smul, ← elt_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_smul_triple_F
statement:
lemma elt_smul_triple_F (c : 𝒜) {k : 𝕂} (hc : integralLaurentEval c = k) (i j : I) (a n r : ℕ)
    (w L : Y →+ ℤ) (e : w + a • -R.root i + n • -R.root j + r • -R.root i = L)
    (h : k • (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (F R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j) *
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) a (F R 𝕧 i)) ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - w)) :
    elt L w (k • (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (F R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j) *
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) a (F R 𝕧 i))) h =
      c • (divF R i r (w + a • -R.root i + n • -R.root j) * divF R j n (w + a • -R.root i) *
        divF R i a w)
proof:
:= by
  subst hc e
  rw [divF, divF, divF, elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt, laurent_smul, ← elt_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_eA_ne
statement:
lemma braidA_eA_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    braidA i (eA R j n μ) = ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), braidCoeffE D i r •
      (eA R i (negA D i j * n - r) (μ.comp (reflY R i) + r • R.root i + n • R.root j) *
        eA R j n (μ.comp (reflY R i) + r • R.root i) * eA R i r (μ.comp (reflY R i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hT : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (E R 𝕧 j)) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (E R 𝕧 j) *
          qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (E R 𝕧 i)) :=
    braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne ratFunc_X_not_root R hji n
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1),
      ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (E R 𝕧 j) *
          qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈
        adWeightSpace R 𝕧 ((μ + n • R.root j).comp (reflY R i) - μ.comp (reflY R i)) := by
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ≤ negA D i j * n := by rw [mem_range] at hr; omega
    rw [comp_sub_comp, ← wt_E_ne hji n r hr']
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mul_mem_adWeightSpace (mul_mem_adWeightSpace
      (qDivPow_E_mem _ i _) (qDivPow_E_mem _ j n)) (qDivPow_E_mem _ i r))
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [braidA_apply, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  change braid ratFunc_X_not_root i (divE R j n μ) = _
  rw [divE, braid_elt ratFunc_X_not_root i _ _ _
      (by rw [hT]; exact Submodule.sum_mem _ hmem),
    elt_congr hT _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ hmem), elt_sum_of_mem _ _ hmem]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.sum_attach]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  have hr' : (r : ℕ) ≤ negA D i j * n := by have := r.2; rw [mem_range] at this; omega
  refine (elt_smul_triple_E (braidCoeffE D i r) (integralLaurentEval_braidCoeffE i r) i j _ n r
    _ _ ?_ _).trans rfl
  rw [AddMonoidHom.add_comp, ← wt_E_ne hji n r hr']
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_fA_ne
statement:
lemma braidA_fA_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    braidA i (fA R j n μ) = ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), braidCoeffF D i r •
      (fA R i r (μ.comp (reflY R i) + (negA D i j * n - r) • -R.root i + n • -R.root j) *
        fA R j n (μ.comp (reflY R i) + (negA D i j * n - r) • -R.root i) *
        fA R i (negA D i j * n - r) (μ.comp (reflY R i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hT : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j)) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1), ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (F R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j) *
          qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (F R 𝕧 i)) :=
    braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_ne ratFunc_X_not_root R hji n
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1),
      ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ r) •
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (F R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j) *
          qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (F R 𝕧 i)) ∈
        adWeightSpace R 𝕧 ((μ + n • -R.root j).comp (reflY R i) - μ.comp (reflY R i)) := by
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ≤ negA D i j * n := by rw [mem_range] at hr; omega
    rw [comp_sub_comp, ← wt_F_ne hji n r hr']
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mul_mem_adWeightSpace (mul_mem_adWeightSpace
      (qDivPow_F_mem _ i r) (qDivPow_F_mem _ j n)) (qDivPow_F_mem _ i _))
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [braidA_apply, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  change braid ratFunc_X_not_root i (divF R j n μ) = _
  rw [divF, braid_elt ratFunc_X_not_root i _ _ _
      (by rw [hT]; exact Submodule.sum_mem _ hmem),
    elt_congr hT _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ hmem), elt_sum_of_mem _ _ hmem]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.sum_attach]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  have hr' : (r : ℕ) ≤ negA D i j * n := by have := r.2; rw [mem_range] at this; omega
  refine (elt_smul_triple_F (braidCoeffF D i r) (integralLaurentEval_braidCoeffF i r) i j _ n r
    _ _ ?_ _).trans rfl
  rw [AddMonoidHom.add_comp, ← wt_F_ne' hji n r hr']
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.comp_reflY_ktilde
statement:
lemma comp_reflY_ktilde (i : I) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (μ.comp (reflY R i)) (n • ktilde R i) = -((D.d i * n : ℕ) : ℤ) * μ (R.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY, ktilde, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, zmultiplesHom_apply, map_nsmul, map_sub, map_zsmul,
    R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_eA_self
statement:
lemma braidA_eA_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    braidA i (eA R i n μ) = selfCoeffE D i n (μ (R.coroot i)) • fA R i n (μ.comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= by
  have hT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_self ratFunc_X_not_root R i n
  have hF := qDivPow_F_mem (R := R) (𝕧 ^ D.d i) i n
  have hm : ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ n * (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) * K R 𝕧 (n • ktilde R i)) ∈
      adWeightSpace R 𝕧 ((μ + n • R.root i).comp (reflY R i) - μ.comp (reflY R i)) := by
    rw [comp_sub_comp, ← wt_E_self]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (by
      simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hF (K_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) (v := 𝕧) _))
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [braidA_apply]
  change braid ratFunc_X_not_root i (divE R i n μ) = _
  rw [divE, braid_elt ratFunc_X_not_root i _ _ _ (by rw [hT]; exact hm), elt_congr hT _ hm]
  have hl : (μ + n • R.root i).comp (reflY R i) = μ.comp (reflY R i) + n • -R.root i := by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.add_comp, ← wt_E_self]
  have hF' : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧
      ((μ + n • R.root i).comp (reflY R i) - μ.comp (reflY R i)) := by
    rw [hl, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hF
  rw [elt_smul _ _ _ (by simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hF' (K_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R)
      (v := 𝕧) (n • ktilde R i))), elt_mul_K _ _ _ hF', smul_smul]
  change _ = selfCoeffE D i n (μ (R.coroot i)) • divF R i n (μ.comp (reflY R i))
  rw [laurent_smul, divF]
  congr 1
  · rw [selfCoeffE, _root_.map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, _root_.map_one, integralLaurentEval_T,
      comp_reflY_ktilde, zpow_sub₀ (RatFunc.X_ne_zero), zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, neg_mul,
      zpow_neg, inv_pow, ← pow_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  · exact elt_index hl rfl rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_fA_self
statement:
lemma braidA_fA_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    braidA i (fA R i n μ) = selfCoeffF D i n (μ (R.coroot i)) • eA R i n (μ.comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= by
  have hT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_self ratFunc_X_not_root R i n
  have hE := qDivPow_E_mem (R := R) (𝕧 ^ D.d i) i n
  have hm : ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ n * (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ (n * (n - 1))) •
      (K R 𝕧 (n • -ktilde R i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈
      adWeightSpace R 𝕧 ((μ + n • -R.root i).comp (reflY R i) - μ.comp (reflY R i)) := by
    rw [comp_sub_comp, ← wt_F_self]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (by
      simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (K_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) (v := 𝕧) _) hE)
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [braidA_apply]
  change braid ratFunc_X_not_root i (divF R i n μ) = _
  rw [divF, braid_elt ratFunc_X_not_root i _ _ _ (by rw [hT]; exact hm), elt_congr hT _ hm]
  have hl : (μ + n • -R.root i).comp (reflY R i) = μ.comp (reflY R i) + n • R.root i := by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.add_comp, ← wt_F_self]
  have hE' : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧
      ((μ + n • -R.root i).comp (reflY R i) - μ.comp (reflY R i)) := by
    rw [hl, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hE
  have hw : ((μ + n • -R.root i).comp (reflY R i)) (n • -ktilde R i) =
      ((D.d i * n : ℕ) : ℤ) * μ (R.coroot i) - 2 * ((D.d i * (n * n) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [hl, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, smul_neg, map_neg, map_neg, comp_reflY_ktilde,
      AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, map_nsmul, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast; ring
  rw [elt_smul _ _ _ (by simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (K_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R)
      (v := 𝕧) (n • -ktilde R i)) hE'), elt_K_mul _ _ _ hE', smul_smul]
  change _ = selfCoeffF D i n (μ (R.coroot i)) • divE R i n (μ.comp (reflY R i))
  rw [laurent_smul, divE]
  congr 1
  · rw [selfCoeffF, _root_.map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, _root_.map_one, integralLaurentEval_T, hw,
      show ((D.d i * (n * (n - 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((D.d i * n : ℕ) : ℤ) * μ (R.coroot i) -
        2 * ((D.d i * (n * n) : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((D.d i * (n * (n - 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ) +
          (((D.d i * n : ℕ) : ℤ) * μ (R.coroot i) - 2 * ((D.d i * (n * n) : ℕ) : ℤ)) by ring,
      zpow_add₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero, zpow_natCast, ← pow_mul]
    ring
  · exact elt_index hl rfl rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coroot_comp_reflY_apply
statement:
lemma coroot_comp_reflY_apply (i j : I) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    (μ.comp (reflY R i)) (R.coroot j) = μ (R.coroot j) - D.cartanMatrix j i * μ (R.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [reflY, R.root_coroot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights
statement:
lemma comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights (i : I) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    μ.comp (reflY R i) ∈ R.frobWeights l
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  rw [coroot_comp_reflY_apply]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hμ i
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := D.frobOrder_dvd_mul_cartanMatrix hl0 j i
  refine dvd_sub (hμ j) ⟨d * c, ?_⟩
  rw [hc]
  linear_combination c * hd

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights_iff
statement:
lemma comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights_iff (i : I) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} :
    μ.comp (reflY R i) ∈ R.frobWeights l ↔ μ ∈ R.frobWeights l
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights R hl0 i⟩
  have h' := comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights R hl0 i h
  rwa [show (μ.comp (reflY R i)).comp (reflY R i) = μ by ext y; simp [reflY_reflY]] at h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobWt_comp_reflY
statement:
lemma frobWt_comp_reflY (i : I) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l) :
    R.frobWt l (μ.comp (reflY R i)) =
      (R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights R hl0 i hμ
  have hsub : (⟨μ.comp (reflY R i), hs⟩ : R.frobWeights l) =
      ⟨μ, hμ⟩ - (R.frobCoroot l i ⟨μ, hμ⟩) • R.frobRoot hl0 i := by
    refine Subtype.ext (AddMonoidHom.ext fun y ↦ ?_)
    have h := R.frobOrder_mul_frobCoroot l i ⟨μ, hμ⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply,
      zmultiplesHom_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul, AddSubgroup.coe_sub,
      AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul, R.coe_frobRoot, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply] at h ⊢
    rw [← h]
    ring
  rw [R.frobWt_of_mem hs, R.frobWt_of_mem hμ, hsub]
  ext y
  simp only [R.frobEval_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY_apply,
    R.frobRootDatum_root hl0, R.frobRootDatum_coroot hl0, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.neg_one_pow_mul_pow_of_root
proof:
:= by
  have key : (-1 : A) ^ L * x ^ L = -x ^ (L ^ 2) := by
    linear_combination (-(x ^ (L ^ 2))) * h1 + x ^ L * h2
  rw [pow_mul, pow_mul, ← mul_pow, key, pow_mul, neg_pow, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.inv_pow_of_root
proof:
:= by
  have hN : ∀ N, ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) ^ N * (u : A) ^ N = 1 := fun N ↦ by
    rw [← mul_pow, Units.inv_mul, one_pow]
  have hc : ((-1 : A) ^ (L + 1)) * (-1) ^ (L + 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linear_combination hN (2 * L) - ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) ^ (2 * L) * h1
  · linear_combination ((-1 : A) ^ (L + 1)) * hN (L ^ 2 + L) -
      ((-1 : A) ^ (L + 1)) * ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) ^ (L ^ 2 + L) * h2 -
      ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) ^ (L ^ 2 + L) * hc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobUnit_root
statement:
lemma frobUnit_root (i : I) :
    (frobUnit D (l' := l') i : CyclotomicQuotient l') ^ (2 * D.frobOrder l i) = 1 ∧
      (frobUnit D (l' := l') i : CyclotomicQuotient l') ^ (D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 + D.frobOrder l i) =
        (-1) ^ (D.frobOrder l i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := neZero_of_frobeniusLevel hl0 hl'
  have h1 := (frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff D hl0 hl' i _).2 dvd_rfl
  exact ⟨h1, pow_sq_add_eq_of_root h1 (fun t h0 ht h ↦ Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt h0 ht
    ((frobUnit_pow_two_mul_eq_one_iff D hl0 hl' i t).1 h)) (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_T_natCast_mul
statement:
lemma algebraMap_T_natCast_mul (i : I) (k : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (LaurentPolynomial.T ((D.d i * k : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
      (frobUnit D (l' := l') i : CyclotomicQuotient l') ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((D.d i * k : ℕ) : ℤ) = k * (D.d i : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_pow,
    map_pow]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_T_neg_natCast_mul
statement:
lemma algebraMap_T_neg_natCast_mul (i : I) (k : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (LaurentPolynomial.T (-((D.d i * k : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      (((frobUnit D (l' := l') i)⁻¹ : (CyclotomicQuotient l')ˣ) : CyclotomicQuotient l') ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [show -((D.d i * k : ℕ) : ℤ) = k * (-(D.d i : ℤ)) by push_cast; ring,
    ← LaurentPolynomial.T_pow, map_pow]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_add
statement:
lemma algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_add (i : I) (m : ℤ) (e : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') ((-1) ^ (D.frobOrder l i * e) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (m + ((D.d i * (D.frobOrder l i * e) : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') ((-1) ^ e *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (m + ((D.d i * (D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * e) : ℕ) : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := frobUnit_root D hl0 hl' i
  rw [_root_.map_mul, _root_.map_mul, LaurentPolynomial.T_add, LaurentPolynomial.T_add,
    _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_mul, algebraMap_T_natCast_mul, algebraMap_T_natCast_mul, map_pow,
    map_pow, map_neg, _root_.map_one]
  linear_combination algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (LaurentPolynomial.T m) *
    neg_one_pow_mul_pow_of_root h1 h2 e

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_sub
statement:
lemma algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_sub (i : I) (m : ℤ) (e : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') ((-1) ^ (D.frobOrder l i * e) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (m - ((D.d i * (D.frobOrder l i * e) : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') ((-1) ^ e *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (m - ((D.d i * (D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * e) : ℕ) : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := inv_pow_of_root (frobUnit_root D hl0 hl' i).1 (frobUnit_root D hl0 hl' i).2
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_mul, LaurentPolynomial.T_add,
    LaurentPolynomial.T_add, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_mul, algebraMap_T_neg_natCast_mul,
    algebraMap_T_neg_natCast_mul, map_pow, map_pow, map_neg, _root_.map_one]
  linear_combination algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (LaurentPolynomial.T m) *
    neg_one_pow_mul_pow_of_root h1 h2 e

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.natCast_mul_pred
statement: lemma natCast_mul_pred (a : ℕ) : ((a * (a - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) = a * a - a
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a => push_cast; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_selfCoeffE
statement:
lemma algebraMap_selfCoeffE [Finite I] (i : I) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l')
        (selfCoeffE D i (D.frobOrder l i * n) (D.frobOrder l i * k)) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (selfCoeffE (D.frobenius hl0) i n k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_add D hl0 hl' i
    (-((D.d i : ℤ) * D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * n * n) - (D.d i : ℤ) * D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * n * k) n
  rw [selfCoeffE, selfCoeffE, D.frobenius_d hl0, Nat.cast_mul (D.d i), natCast_mul_pred,
    Nat.cast_mul _ (n * (n - 1)), natCast_mul_pred]
  convert h using 4 <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_selfCoeffF
statement:
lemma algebraMap_selfCoeffF [Finite I] (i : I) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l')
        (selfCoeffF D i (D.frobOrder l i * n) (D.frobOrder l i * k)) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (selfCoeffF (D.frobenius hl0) i n k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_sub D hl0 hl' i
    (-((D.d i : ℤ) * D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * n * n) + (D.d i : ℤ) * D.frobOrder l i ^ 2 * n * k) n
  rw [selfCoeffF, selfCoeffF, D.frobenius_d hl0, Nat.cast_mul (D.d i), natCast_mul_pred,
    Nat.cast_mul _ (n * (n - 1)), natCast_mul_pred]
  convert h using 4 <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_braidCoeffE
statement:
lemma algebraMap_braidCoeffE (i : I) (r : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (braidCoeffE D i (D.frobOrder l i * r)) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (braidCoeffE (D.frobenius hl0) i r)
proof:
:= by
  have h := algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_sub D hl0 hl' i 0 r
  rw [zero_sub, zero_sub] at h
  rw [braidCoeffE, braidCoeffE, D.frobenius_d hl0]
  convert h using 5
  push_cast; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.algebraMap_braidCoeffF
statement:
lemma algebraMap_braidCoeffF (i : I) (r : ℕ) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (braidCoeffF D i (D.frobOrder l i * r)) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (CyclotomicQuotient l') (braidCoeffF (D.frobenius hl0) i r)
proof:
:= by
  have h := algebraMap_neg_one_pow_T_add D hl0 hl' i 0 r
  rw [zero_add, zero_add] at h
  rw [braidCoeffF, braidCoeffF, D.frobenius_d hl0]
  convert h using 4
  push_cast; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobOrder_mul_negA_frobenius
statement:
lemma frobOrder_mul_negA_frobenius {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    D.frobOrder l i * negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j = D.frobOrder l j * negA D i j
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.frobOrder_mul_cartanMatrix_frobenius hl0 i j
  rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij, cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij] at h
  have h' : ((D.frobOrder l i * negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      ((D.frobOrder l j * negA D i j : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    push_cast; linarith
  exact_mod_cast h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.sum_range_mul_of_dvd
statement:
lemma sum_range_mul_of_dvd {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (N : ℕ)
    (f : ℕ → M) (hf : ∀ r, ¬ L ∣ r → f r = 0) :
    ∑ r ∈ range (L * N + 1), f r = ∑ r ∈ range (N + 1), f (L * r)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : (range (N + 1)).image (L * ·) ⊆ range (L * N + 1) := by
    intro t ht
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, mem_range] at ht ⊢
    obtain ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ := ht
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 ht'))
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub ?_, Finset.sum_image fun x _ y _ h ↦ Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hL h]
  intro t ht ht'
  refine hf t fun ⟨c, hc⟩ ↦ ht' ?_
  subst hc
  exact Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨c, mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left_iff hL).1 (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ht)))), rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.sum_range_eq_of_mul
statement:
lemma sum_range_eq_of_mul {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {L A N : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hA : A = L * N) {g h : ℕ → M} (hg : ∀ r, ¬ L ∣ r → g r = 0)
    (hgh : ∀ r ∈ range (N + 1), g (L * r) = h r) :
    ∑ r ∈ range (A + 1), g r = ∑ r ∈ range (N + 1), h r
proof:
:= by
  subst hA
  rw [sum_range_mul_of_dvd hL N g hg]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hgh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_oneA
statement:
lemma frobA_braidA_oneA (i : I) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (braidA i (oneA R μ)) = braidR S i (Fr (oneA R μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidA_oneA, frobA_oneA, frobA_oneA, comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights_iff R hl0 i]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [braidR_tmul, braidA_oneA, frobWt_comp_reflY R hl0 i h]
  · rw [map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_eA_self
statement:
lemma frobA_braidA_eA_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (braidA i (eA R i n μ)) = braidR S i (Fr (eA R i n μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidA_eA_self, map_smul, frobA_fA, frobA_eA, comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights_iff R hl0 i]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨hμ, ⟨n', rfl⟩⟩ := h
    rw [braidR_tmul, braidA_eA_self, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, frobWt_comp_reflY R hl0 i hμ,
      Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i)]
    refine smul_tmul_one_congr (l' := l') S ?_ _
    rw [← R.frobOrder_mul_frobWt_coroot hl0 i hμ]
    exact algebraMap_selfCoeffE D hl0 hl' i n' _
  · exact (smul_zero _).trans (LinearEquiv.map_zero _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_fA_self
statement:
lemma frobA_braidA_fA_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (braidA i (fA R i n μ)) = braidR S i (Fr (fA R i n μ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidA_fA_self, map_smul, frobA_eA, frobA_fA, comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights_iff R hl0 i]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨hμ, ⟨n', rfl⟩⟩ := h
    rw [braidR_tmul, braidA_fA_self, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, frobWt_comp_reflY R hl0 i hμ,
      Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i)]
    refine smul_tmul_one_congr (l' := l') S ?_ _
    rw [← R.frobOrder_mul_frobWt_coroot hl0 i hμ]
    exact algebraMap_selfCoeffF D hl0 hl' i n' _
  · exact (smul_zero _).trans (LinearEquiv.map_zero _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_triple_E
statement:
lemma frobA_triple_E (i j : I) (a n r : ℕ) (w : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (eA R i a (w + r • R.root i + n • R.root j) * eA R j n (w + r • R.root i) * eA R i r w) =
      if w ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ a ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ r
      then (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (a / D.frobOrder l i)
          (R.frobWt l w + (r / D.frobOrder l i) • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i +
            (n / D.frobOrder l j) • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j) *
        eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j (n / D.frobOrder l j)
          (R.frobWt l w + (r / D.frobOrder l i) • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
        eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (r / D.frobOrder l i) (R.frobWt l w)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobA_mul, frobA_mul, frobA_eA, frobA_eA, frobA_eA]
  by_cases hw : w ∈ R.frobWeights l
  · by_cases hr : D.frobOrder l i ∣ r
    · have hw1 := (R.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff hl0 i hr).2 hw
      by_cases hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n
      · have hw2 := (R.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff hl0 j hn).2 hw1
        by_cases ha : D.frobOrder l i ∣ a
        · simp only [hw, hw1, hw2, hr, hn, ha, and_self, ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one,
            R.frobWt_add_nsmul_root hl0 j hn hw1, R.frobWt_add_nsmul_root hl0 i hr hw]
        · simp only [ha, and_false, false_and, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
      · simp only [hn, and_false, false_and, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, mul_zero]
    · simp only [hr, and_false, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
  · simp only [hw, false_and, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_triple_F
statement:
lemma frobA_triple_F (i j : I) (a n r : ℕ) (w : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (fA R i r (w + a • -R.root i + n • -R.root j) * fA R j n (w + a • -R.root i) *
        fA R i a w) =
      if w ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ a ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ r
      then (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (r / D.frobOrder l i)
          (R.frobWt l w + (a / D.frobOrder l i) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i +
            (n / D.frobOrder l j) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j) *
        fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j (n / D.frobOrder l j)
          (R.frobWt l w + (a / D.frobOrder l i) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
        fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (a / D.frobOrder l i) (R.frobWt l w)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobA_mul, frobA_mul, frobA_fA, frobA_fA, frobA_fA]
  by_cases hw : w ∈ R.frobWeights l
  · by_cases ha : D.frobOrder l i ∣ a
    · have hw1 := (R.add_nsmul_neg_root_mem_iff hl0 i ha).2 hw
      by_cases hn : D.frobOrder l j ∣ n
      · have hw2 := (R.add_nsmul_neg_root_mem_iff hl0 j hn).2 hw1
        by_cases hr : D.frobOrder l i ∣ r
        · simp only [hw, hw1, hw2, hr, hn, ha, and_self, ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one,
            R.frobWt_add_nsmul_neg_root hl0 j hn hw1, R.frobWt_add_nsmul_neg_root hl0 i ha hw]
        · simp only [hr, and_false, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
      · simp only [hn, and_false, false_and, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, mul_zero]
    · simp only [ha, and_false, false_and, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
  · simp only [hw, false_and, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_eq_zero
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_eq_zero {j : I} {n : ℕ} {μ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (h : ¬ (μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n)) : Fr (eA R j n μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [frobA_eA]
  exact ite_eq_right h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_fA_eq_zero
statement:
lemma frobA_fA_eq_zero {j : I} {n : ℕ} {μ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (h : ¬ (μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n)) : Fr (fA R j n μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [frobA_fA]
  exact ite_eq_right h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_frobA_triple_E_eq_zero
statement:
lemma smul_frobA_triple_E_eq_zero (c : 𝒜) (i j : I) (a n r : ℕ) (w : Y →+ ℤ)
    (h : ¬ (w ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ a ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n ∧
      D.frobOrder l i ∣ r)) :
    c • Fr (eA R i a (w + r • R.root i + n • R.root j) * eA R j n (w + r • R.root i) *
      eA R i r w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [frobA_triple_E, ite_eq_right h]
  exact smul_zero _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braid_term_E
statement:
lemma frobA_braid_term_E {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l)
    (n' r : ℕ) :
    braidCoeffE D i (D.frobOrder l i * r) •
        Fr (eA R i (negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') - D.frobOrder l i * r)
            (μ.comp (reflY R i) + (D.frobOrder l i * r) • R.root i +
              (D.frobOrder l j * n') • R.root j) *
          eA R j (D.frobOrder l j * n') (μ.comp (reflY R i) + (D.frobOrder l i * r) • R.root i) *
          eA R i (D.frobOrder l i * r) (μ.comp (reflY R i))) =
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (braidCoeffE (D.frobenius hl0) i r •
        (eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r)
            ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
              r • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i + n' • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j) *
          eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j n' ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
              r • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
          eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i r ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hLpos := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  have hb : negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') =
      D.frobOrder l i * (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n') := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, frobOrder_mul_negA_frobenius D hl0 hji.symm,
      mul_comm (negA D i j)]
  rw [frobA_triple_E, hb, ← Nat.mul_sub, ite_eq_left ⟨comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights R hl0 i hμ,
    dvd_mul_right _ _, dvd_mul_right _ _, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  refine (smul_tmul_one_congr (l' := l') S (algebraMap_braidCoeffE D hl0 hl' i r) _).trans ?_
  simp only [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hLpos, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 j),
    frobWt_comp_reflY R hl0 i hμ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidR_frobA_eA_ne
statement:
lemma braidR_frobA_eA_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l)
    (n' : ℕ) :
    braidR S i (Fr (eA R j (D.frobOrder l j * n') μ)) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' + 1),
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (braidCoeffE (D.frobenius hl0) i r •
          (eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r)
              ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
                r • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i + n' • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j) *
            eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j n' ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
                r • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
            eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i r
              ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [frobA_eA, ite_eq_left ⟨hμ, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩,
    Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 j), braidR_tmul, braidA_eA_ne hji,
    TensorProduct.tmul_sum]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_eA_ne
statement:
lemma frobA_braidA_eA_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (braidA i (eA R j n μ)) = braidR S i (Fr (eA R j n μ))
proof:
:= by
  have hLpos := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  rw [braidA_eA_ne hji, map_sum]
  by_cases h : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n
  · obtain ⟨hμ, n', rfl⟩ := h
    have hb : negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') =
        D.frobOrder l i * (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n') := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, frobOrder_mul_negA_frobenius D hl0 hji.symm,
        mul_comm (negA D i j)]
    refine (sum_range_eq_of_mul hLpos hb (fun r hr ↦ ?_) fun r _ ↦ ?_).trans
      (braidR_frobA_eA_ne R hl0 hl' hA S hji hμ n').symm
    · exact (map_smul _ _ _).trans
        (smul_frobA_triple_E_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S _ i j _ _ r _ fun hc ↦ hr hc.2.2.2)
    · exact (map_smul _ _ _).trans (frobA_braid_term_E R hl0 hl' hA S hji hμ n' r)
  · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ ↦ ?_).trans ((congrArg (braidR S i)
      (frobA_eA_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S h)).trans (LinearEquiv.map_zero _)).symm
    exact (map_smul _ _ _).trans (smul_frobA_triple_E_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S _ i j _ _ r _
      fun hc ↦ h ⟨(comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights_iff R hl0 i).1 hc.1, hc.2.2.1⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_frobA_triple_F_eq_zero
statement:
lemma smul_frobA_triple_F_eq_zero (c : 𝒜) (i j : I) (a n r : ℕ) (w : Y →+ ℤ)
    (h : ¬ (w ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ a ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n ∧
      D.frobOrder l i ∣ r)) :
    c • Fr (fA R i r (w + a • -R.root i + n • -R.root j) * fA R j n (w + a • -R.root i) *
      fA R i a w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [frobA_triple_F, ite_eq_right h]
  exact smul_zero _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braid_term_F
statement:
lemma frobA_braid_term_F {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l)
    (n' r : ℕ) :
    braidCoeffF D i (D.frobOrder l i * r) •
        Fr (fA R i (D.frobOrder l i * r)
            (μ.comp (reflY R i) +
              (negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') - D.frobOrder l i * r) • -R.root i +
              (D.frobOrder l j * n') • -R.root j) *
          fA R j (D.frobOrder l j * n') (μ.comp (reflY R i) +
            (negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') - D.frobOrder l i * r) • -R.root i) *
          fA R i (negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') - D.frobOrder l i * r)
            (μ.comp (reflY R i))) =
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (braidCoeffF (D.frobenius hl0) i r •
        (fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i r
            ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
              (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i +
              n' • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j) *
          fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j n' ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
              (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
          fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r)
            ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hLpos := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
