  have hb : negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') =
      D.frobOrder l i * (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n') := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, frobOrder_mul_negA_frobenius D hl0 hji.symm,
      mul_comm (negA D i j)]
  rw [frobA_triple_F, hb, ← Nat.mul_sub, ite_eq_left ⟨comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights R hl0 i hμ,
    dvd_mul_right _ _, dvd_mul_right _ _, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  refine (smul_tmul_one_congr (l' := l') S (algebraMap_braidCoeffF D hl0 hl' i r) _).trans ?_
  simp only [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hLpos, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 j),
    frobWt_comp_reflY R hl0 i hμ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidR_frobA_fA_ne
statement:
lemma braidR_frobA_fA_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l)
    (n' : ℕ) :
    braidR S i (Fr (fA R j (D.frobOrder l j * n') μ)) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' + 1),
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ (braidCoeffF (D.frobenius hl0) i r •
          (fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i r
              ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
                (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i +
                n' • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j) *
            fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j n' ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i) +
                (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
            fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n' - r)
              ((R.frobWt l μ).comp (reflY (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [frobA_fA, ite_eq_left ⟨hμ, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩,
    Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (D.frobOrder_pos hl0 j), braidR_tmul, braidA_fA_ne hji,
    TensorProduct.tmul_sum]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_fA_ne
statement:
lemma frobA_braidA_fA_ne {i j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (braidA i (fA R j n μ)) = braidR S i (Fr (fA R j n μ))
proof:
:= by
  have hLpos := D.frobOrder_pos hl0 i
  rw [braidA_fA_ne hji, map_sum]
  by_cases h : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ n
  · obtain ⟨hμ, n', rfl⟩ := h
    have hb : negA D i j * (D.frobOrder l j * n') =
        D.frobOrder l i * (negA (D.frobenius hl0) i j * n') := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, frobOrder_mul_negA_frobenius D hl0 hji.symm,
        mul_comm (negA D i j)]
    refine (sum_range_eq_of_mul hLpos hb (fun r hr ↦ ?_) fun r _ ↦ ?_).trans
      (braidR_frobA_fA_ne R hl0 hl' hA S hji hμ n').symm
    · exact (map_smul _ _ _).trans
        (smul_frobA_triple_F_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S _ i j _ _ r _ fun hc ↦ hr hc.2.2.2)
    · exact (map_smul _ _ _).trans (frobA_braid_term_F R hl0 hl' hA S hji hμ n' r)
  · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ ↦ ?_).trans ((congrArg (braidR S i)
      (frobA_fA_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S h)).trans (LinearEquiv.map_zero _)).symm
    exact (map_smul _ _ _).trans (smul_frobA_triple_F_eq_zero R hl0 hl' hA S _ i j _ _ r _
      fun hc ↦ h ⟨(comp_reflY_mem_frobWeights_iff R hl0 i).1 hc.1, hc.2.2.1⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_eA
statement:
lemma frobA_braidA_eA (i j : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (braidA i (eA R j n μ)) = braidR S i (Fr (eA R j n μ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hji
  · exact frobA_braidA_eA_self R hl0 hl' hA S j n μ
  · exact frobA_braidA_eA_ne R hl0 hl' hA S hji n μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_fA
statement:
lemma frobA_braidA_fA (i j : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    Fr (braidA i (fA R j n μ)) = braidR S i (Fr (fA R j n μ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hji
  · exact frobA_braidA_fA_self R hl0 hl' hA S j n μ
  · exact frobA_braidA_fA_ne R hl0 hl' hA S hji n μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_add
proof:
:=
  ((congrArg Fr ((braidA i).map_add a b)).trans (LinearMap.map_add _ _ _)).trans
    ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) ha hb).trans (((braidR S i).map_add _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (braidR S i) (LinearMap.map_add _ a b).symm)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_zero
statement: lemma frobA_braidA_zero (i : I) : Fr (braidA i 0) = braidR S i (Fr 0)
proof:
:=
  ((congrArg Fr (braidA i).map_zero).trans (LinearMap.map_zero _)).trans
    ((braidR S i).map_zero.symm.trans (congrArg (braidR S i) (LinearMap.map_zero _).symm))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_mul
proof:
:=
  ((congrArg Fr (braidA_mul i a b)).trans (frobA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S _ _)).trans
    ((congrArg₂ (· * ·) ha hb).trans ((braidR_mul S i _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (braidR S i) (frobA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S a b).symm)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA_smul
proof:
:= by
  have h (y : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm (R.frobRootDatum hl0)) : braidR S i (c • y) = c • braidR S i y := by
    rw [← algebraMap_smul S c y, LinearEquiv.map_smul, algebraMap_smul]
  exact ((congrArg Fr ((braidA i).map_smul c a)).trans (LinearMap.map_smul _ c _)).trans
    ((congrArg (c • ·) ha).trans ((h _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (braidR S i) (LinearMap.map_smul _ c a).symm)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_braidA
statement: theorem frobA_braidA (i : I) (x : aForm R) : Fr (braidA i x) = braidR S i (Fr x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  unfold aForm at hx
  induction hx using NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, n, μ, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact frobA_braidA_oneA R hl0 hl' hA S i μ
    · exact frobA_braidA_eA R hl0 hl' hA S i j n μ
    · exact frobA_braidA_fA R hl0 hl' hA S i j n μ
  | add x x' hx hx' ih ih' =>
    exact frobA_braidA_add R hl0 hl' hA S i (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) (b := ⟨x', hx'⟩) ih ih'
  | zero => exact frobA_braidA_zero R hl0 hl' hA S i
  | mul x x' hx hx' ih ih' =>
    exact frobA_braidA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S i (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) (b := ⟨x', hx'⟩) ih ih'
  | smul c x hx ih => exact frobA_braidA_smul R hl0 hl' hA S i c (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_braidR
statement:
theorem frobR_braidR (i : I) (z : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R) :
    frobR R hl0 hl' hA S (braidR S i z) = braidR S i (frobR R hl0 hl' hA S z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul s x =>
    rw [braidR_tmul, frobR_tmul, frobR_tmul, LinearEquiv.map_smul,
      frobA_braidA R hl0 hl' hA S i x]
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    exact ((congrArg (frobR R hl0 hl' hA S) ((braidR S i).map_add z z')).trans
      (map_add _ _ _)).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) hz hz').trans
        (((braidR S i).map_add _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (braidR S i) (map_add _ z z').symm)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_braidR_symm
statement:
theorem frobR_braidR_symm (i : I) (z : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R) :
    frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((braidR S i).symm z) =
      (braidR S i).symm (frobR R hl0 hl' hA S z)
proof:
:= by
  refine (braidR (R := R.frobRootDatum hl0) S i).injective ?_
  rw [← frobR_braidR R hl0 hl' hA S i, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index (i j : I) (n m : ℕ) {μ ν : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hμ : μ ≠ ν + m • -R.root j) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n μ * fA R j m ν) =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n μ) * frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index i j n m hμ, map_zero, frobA_eA, frobA_fA]
  by_cases h1 : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n
  · by_cases h2 : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l j ∣ m
    · have h : R.frobWt l μ ≠
          R.frobWt l ν + (m / D.frobOrder l j) • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j :=
        fun h ↦ hμ (by
          rwa [← R.frobWt_add_nsmul_neg_root hl0 j h2.2 h2.1,
            R.frobWt_inj h1.1 ((R.add_nsmul_neg_root_mem_iff hl0 j h2.2).2 h2.1)] at h)
      simp only [h1, h2, and_self, ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one,
        eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index (R := R.frobRootDatum hl0) i j _ _ h, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    · simp only [h2, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
  · simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_fA_mul_eA
statement:
lemma frobA_fA_mul_eA (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m μ * eA R i n ν) =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m μ) * frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eA_eq_triT, frobA_fA_mul_triT]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.tmul_eA_mul_fA_of_ne
statement:
lemma tmul_eA_mul_fA_of_ne {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ)
    (ν : (R.frobWeights l →+ ℤ) →+ ℤ) :
    (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i n (ν + m • -(R.frobRootDatum hl0).root j) *
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j m ν =
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) j m (ν + n • (R.frobRootDatum hl0).root i) *
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i n ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_one_mul_tmul_one, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one, eA_mul_fA_of_ne hij]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_fA_of_ne
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_fA_of_ne {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n (ν + m • -R.root j) * fA R j m ν) =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n (ν + m • -R.root j)) *
        frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eA_mul_fA_of_ne hij, frobA_fA_mul_eA, frobA_fA, frobA_eA, frobA_eA, frobA_fA]
  by_cases hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l
  · by_cases hn : D.frobOrder l i ∣ n
    · by_cases hm : D.frobOrder l j ∣ m
      · simp only [(R.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff hl0 i hn).2 hν,
          (R.add_nsmul_neg_root_mem_iff hl0 j hm).2 hν, hν, hn, hm, and_self, ↓reduceIte,
          R.frobWt_add_nsmul_root hl0 i hn hν, R.frobWt_add_nsmul_neg_root hl0 j hm hν]
        exact (tmul_eA_mul_fA_of_ne R hl0 S hij _ _ _).symm
      · simp only [hm, and_false, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, mul_zero]
    · simp only [hn, and_false, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  · simp only [hν, false_and, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_fA
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_fA (i j : I) (n m : ℕ) (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n μ * fA R j m ν) =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n μ) * frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (fA R j m ν)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : μ = ν + m • -R.root j
  · subst hμ
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      exact frobA_eA_mul_fA_self R hl0 hl' hA S i n m ν
    · exact frobA_eA_mul_fA_of_ne R hl0 hl' hA S hij n m ν
  · exact frobA_eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index R hl0 hl' hA S i j n m hμ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_mul_of_triT
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 {z | ∃ ν w w', z = triT R ν w w'} := mem_span_triA_thetaW y
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨ν, w, w', rfl⟩ := ha
    exact h ν w w'
  | zero => rw [mul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, mul_add]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, map_smul]
    exact (congrArg (c • ·) ha).trans (mul_smul_comm c _ _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_oneA_mul
statement: lemma frobA_oneA_mul (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : aForm R) : Fr (oneA R μ * y) = Fr (oneA R μ) * Fr y
proof:
:=
  frobA_mul_of_triT R hl0 hl' hA S (fun ν w w' ↦ frobA_oneA_mul_triT R hl0 hl' hA S μ ν w w') y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_fA_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_fA_mul (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : aForm R) :
    Fr (fA R j m μ * y) = Fr (fA R j m μ) * Fr y
proof:
:=
  frobA_mul_of_triT R hl0 hl' hA S
    (fun ν w w' ↦ frobA_fA_mul_triT R hl0 hl' hA S j m μ ν w w') y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_fA_mul_eA_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_fA_mul_eA_mul (j : I) (m : ℕ) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ)
    (T : aForm R) (hT : Fr (eA R i n μ * T) = Fr (eA R i n μ) * Fr T) :
    Fr (fA R j m ν * eA R i n μ * T) = Fr (fA R j m ν * eA R i n μ) * Fr T
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc]
  refine (frobA_fA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S j m ν _).trans ?_
  refine ((congrArg (Fr (fA R j m ν) * ·) hT).trans (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (· * Fr T) (frobA_fA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S j m ν _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_ite_smul_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_ite_smul_mul (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (c : 𝒜) (x T : aForm R)
    (h : Fr (x * T) = Fr x * Fr T) :
    Fr ((if p then c • x else 0) * T) = Fr (if p then c • x else 0) * Fr T
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs
  · simp only [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]
    exact congrArg (c • ·) h
  · rw [zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_fA_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_fA_mul (i j : I) (n m : ℕ) (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (T : aForm R)
    (hT : ∀ i' n' μ', Fr (eA R i' n' μ' * T) = Fr (eA R i' n' μ') * Fr T) :
    Fr (eA R i n μ * fA R j m ν * T) = Fr (eA R i n μ * fA R j m ν) * Fr T
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : μ = ν + m • -R.root j
  swap
  · rw [eA_mul_fA_of_ne_index i j n m hμ, zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
  subst hμ
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    rw [eA_mul_fA_self, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ frobA_ite_smul_mul R hl0 hl' hA S _ _ _ T
      (frobA_fA_mul_eA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S _ _ _ _ _ _ T (hT _ _ _))
  · rw [eA_mul_fA_of_ne hij]
    exact frobA_fA_mul_eA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S _ _ _ _ _ _ T (hT _ _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_triT_nil
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_triT_nil (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n μ * triT R ν [] w') =
      frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (eA R i n μ) * frobA R hl0 hl' hA S (triT R ν [] w')
proof:
:= by
  rw [eA_mul_triT_nil, apply_ite (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S), map_zero, frobA_eA, frobA_triT,
    frobA_triT, frobDiv_cons, frobDivW_cons, frobDivW_nil]
  by_cases hn : D.frobOrder l i ∣ n
  swap
  · simp only [hn, false_and, and_false, ↓reduceIte, ite_self, zero_mul]
  by_cases hν : ν ∈ R.frobWeights l
  swap
  · simp only [(R.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff hl0 i hn), hν, false_and, ↓reduceIte, ite_self,
      mul_zero]
  by_cases hw' : FrobDiv D l w'
  swap
  · simp only [hw', and_false, ↓reduceIte, ite_self, mul_zero]
  by_cases hμ : μ ∈ R.frobWeights l
  swap
  · have : μ ≠ ν := fun h ↦ hμ (h ▸ hν)
    simp only [this, hμ, false_and, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
  simp only [(R.add_nsmul_root_mem_iff hl0 i hn), hn, hν, hw', hμ, frobDiv_nil, and_self,
    ↓reduceIte, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one, eA_mul_triT_nil, R.frobWt_add_nsmul_root hl0 i hn hν,
    R.frobWt_inj hμ hν]
  by_cases h : μ = ν
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul_triT
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul_triT (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    Fr (eA R i n μ * triT R ν w w') = Fr (eA R i n μ) * Fr (triT R ν w w')
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing i n μ with
  | nil => exact frobA_eA_mul_triT_nil R hl0 hl' hA S i n μ ν w'
  | cons p w ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, m⟩ := p
    rw [triT_cons', ← mul_assoc]
    refine (frobA_eA_mul_fA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S i j n m μ _ _ ih).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (· * Fr (triT R ν w w')) (frobA_eA_mul_fA R hl0 hl' hA S i j n m μ _)).trans ?_
    exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).trans
      (congrArg (Fr (eA R i n μ) * ·) (frobA_fA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S j m _ _).symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_eA_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_eA_mul (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : aForm R) :
    Fr (eA R i n μ * y) = Fr (eA R i n μ) * Fr y
proof:
:=
  frobA_mul_of_triT R hl0 hl' hA S
    (fun ν w w' ↦ frobA_eA_mul_triT R hl0 hl' hA S i n μ ν w w') y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_add_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_add_mul {a b : aForm R} (ha : ∀ y, Fr (a * y) = Fr a * Fr y)
    (hb : ∀ y, Fr (b * y) = Fr b * Fr y) (y : aForm R) : Fr ((a + b) * y) = Fr (a + b) * Fr y
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, add_mul]
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (ha y) (hb y)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_mul_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_mul_mul {a b : aForm R} (ha : ∀ y, Fr (a * y) = Fr a * Fr y)
    (hb : ∀ y, Fr (b * y) = Fr b * Fr y) (y : aForm R) : Fr (a * b * y) = Fr (a * b) * Fr y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc]
  refine ((ha _).trans (congrArg (Fr a * ·) (hb y))).trans ?_
  exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (· * Fr y) (ha b).symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_smul_mul
statement:
lemma frobA_smul_mul (c : 𝒜) {a : aForm R} (ha : ∀ y, Fr (a * y) = Fr a * Fr y) (y : aForm R) :
    Fr ((c • a) * y) = Fr (c • a) * Fr y
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc]
  exact congrArg (c • ·) (ha y)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_zero_mul
statement: lemma frobA_zero_mul (y : aForm R) : Fr (0 * y) = Fr 0 * Fr y
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobA_mul
statement: theorem frobA_mul (x y : aForm R) : Fr (x * y) = Fr x * Fr y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  revert y
  unfold aForm at hx
  induction hx using NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, n, μ, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact frobA_oneA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S μ
    · exact frobA_eA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S i n μ
    · exact frobA_fA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S i n μ
  | add x x' hx hx' ih ih' =>
    exact frobA_add_mul R hl0 hl' hA S (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) (b := ⟨x', hx'⟩) ih ih'
  | zero => exact frobA_zero_mul R hl0 hl' hA S
  | mul x x' hx hx' ih ih' =>
    exact frobA_mul_mul R hl0 hl' hA S (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) (b := ⟨x', hx'⟩) ih ih'
  | smul c x hx ih => exact frobA_smul_mul R hl0 hl' hA S c (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_frobA_add
statement:
lemma eq_frobA_add {a b : aForm R} (ha : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ a) = Fr a)
    (hb : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ b) = Fr b) : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ (a + b)) = Fr (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_frobA_zero
statement: lemma eq_frobA_zero : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ (0 : aForm R)) = Fr 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_frobA_mul
statement:
lemma eq_frobA_mul {a b : aForm R} (ha : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ a) = Fr a)
    (hb : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ b) = Fr b) : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ (a * b)) = Fr (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tmul_one_mul_tmul_one, _root_.map_mul, ha, hb, frobA_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_frobA_smul
statement:
lemma eq_frobA_smul (c : 𝒜) {a : aForm R} (ha : φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ a) = Fr a) :
    φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ (c • a)) = Fr (c • a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← algebraMap_smul S c, map_smul, algebraMap_smul, ha, map_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_frobA_of_forall
statement:
lemma eq_frobA_of_forall (φ : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R →ₙₐ[S] S ⊗[𝒜] aForm (R.frobRootDatum hl0))
    (h1 : ∀ μ, φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ oneA R μ) = Fr (oneA R μ))
    (hE : ∀ i n μ, φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ eA R i n μ) = Fr (eA R i n μ))
    (hF : ∀ i n μ, φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ fA R i n μ) = Fr (fA R i n μ)) (x : aForm R) :
    φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ x) = Fr x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  unfold aForm at hx
  induction hx using NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, n, μ, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact h1 μ
    · exact hE i n μ
    · exact hF i n μ
  | add x x' hx hx' ih ih' =>
    exact eq_frobA_add R hl0 hl' hA S φ (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) (b := ⟨x', hx'⟩) ih ih'
  | zero => exact eq_frobA_zero R hl0 hl' hA S φ
  | mul x x' hx hx' ih ih' =>
    exact eq_frobA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S φ (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) (b := ⟨x', hx'⟩) ih ih'
  | smul c x hx ih => exact eq_frobA_smul R hl0 hl' hA S φ c (a := ⟨x, hx⟩) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_mul_tmul
statement:
lemma frobR_mul_tmul (s t : S) (a b : aForm R) :
    LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) ((s ⊗ₜ[𝒜] a) * (t ⊗ₜ[𝒜] b)) =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (s ⊗ₜ[𝒜] a) *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (t ⊗ₜ[𝒜] b)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S))
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul s t a b)).trans <|
    (congrArg ((s * t) • ·) (frobA_mul R hl0 hl' hA S a b)).trans
      (smul_mul_smul_comm s _ t _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_mul_add_left
statement:
lemma frobR_mul_add_left (x x' y : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R)
    (hx : LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (x * y) =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) x *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) y)
    (hx' : LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (x' * y) =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) x' *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) y) :
    LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) ((x + x') * y) =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (x + x') *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) y
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S)) (add_mul x x' y)).trans <|
    ((LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S)).map_add (x * y) (x' * y)).trans <|
      (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hx').trans <| (add_mul _ _ _).symm.trans <|
        congrArg (· * LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) y)
          ((LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S)).map_add x x').symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_mul_add_right
statement:
lemma frobR_mul_add_right (x y y' : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R)
    (hy : LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (x * y) =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) x *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) y)
    (hy' : LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (x * y') =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) x *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) y') :
    LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (x * (y + y')) =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) x *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (y + y')
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S)) (mul_add x y y')).trans <|
    ((LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S)).map_add (x * y) (x * y')).trans <|
      (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hy hy').trans <| (mul_add _ _ _).symm.trans <|
        congrArg (LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) x * ·)
          ((LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S)).map_add y y').symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_mul_aux
statement:
lemma frobR_mul_aux (x y : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R) :
    LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) (x * y) =
      LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) x *
        LinearMap.liftBaseChange S (frobA R hl0 hl' hA S) y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add x x' hx hx' => exact frobR_mul_add_left R hl0 hl' hA S x x' y hx hx'
  | tmul s a =>
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add y y' hy hy' => exact frobR_mul_add_right R hl0 hl' hA S _ y y' hy hy'
    | tmul t b => exact frobR_mul_tmul R hl0 hl' hA S s t a b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_tmul
statement: lemma frobR_tmul (s : S) (x : aForm R) : frobR R hl0 hl' hA S (s ⊗ₜ x) = s • Fr x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_one_tmul
statement: lemma frobR_one_tmul (x : aForm R) : frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ x) = Fr x
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobR_tmul, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_oneA
statement:
theorem frobR_oneA (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ oneA R μ) =
      if μ ∈ R.frobWeights l then (1 : S) ⊗ₜ oneA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) (R.frobWt l μ)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobR_one_tmul, frobA_oneA]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_eA
statement:
theorem frobR_eA (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ eA R i n μ) =
      if μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n then
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ eA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (n / D.frobOrder l i) (R.frobWt l μ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobR_one_tmul, frobA_eA]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.frobR_fA
statement:
theorem frobR_fA (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ fA R i n μ) =
      if μ ∈ R.frobWeights l ∧ D.frobOrder l i ∣ n then
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ fA (R.frobRootDatum hl0) i (n / D.frobOrder l i) (R.frobWt l μ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobR_one_tmul, frobA_fA]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_frobR
statement:
theorem eq_frobR (φ : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R →ₙₐ[S] S ⊗[𝒜] aForm (R.frobRootDatum hl0))
    (h1 : ∀ μ, φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ oneA R μ) = frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ oneA R μ))
    (hE : ∀ i n μ, φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ eA R i n μ) = frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ eA R i n μ))
    (hF : ∀ i n μ, φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ fA R i n μ) = frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ fA R i n μ)) :
    φ = frobR R hl0 hl' hA S
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x : aForm R, φ ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ x) = frobR R hl0 hl' hA S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ x) := fun x ↦ by
    rw [frobR_one_tmul]
    refine eq_frobA_of_forall R hl0 hl' hA S φ (fun μ ↦ ?_) (fun i n μ ↦ ?_) (fun i n μ ↦ ?_) x
    · rw [h1, frobR_one_tmul]
    · rw [hE, frobR_one_tmul]
    · rw [hF, frobR_one_tmul]
  ext z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul s x =>
    rw [← mul_one s, ← smul_eq_mul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul, map_smul, key]
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hz hz'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralLaurentEval_laurentHigherSerreCoeff
statement:
lemma integralLaurentEval_laurentHigherSerreCoeff (i : I) (a n m s : ℕ) :
    integralLaurentEval (laurentHigherSerreCoeff D i a n m s) = higherSerreCoeff D i a n m s
proof:
:= by
  have hT : integralLaurentEval (laurentTUnit (D.d i) : 𝒜) = 𝕧 ^ D.d i := by
    simp [laurentTUnit]
  simp only [laurentHigherSerreCoeff, higherSerreCoeff, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg,
    map_one, integralLaurentEval_T, map_qBinomialU, hT]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator_eq_sum
statement:
theorem integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator_eq_sum {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {a n m : ℕ}
    (ha : D.cartanMatrix i j = -a) (hm : a * n < m) :
    integralGenerator D i m * integralGenerator D j n =
      ∑ r ∈ range (a * n + 1), laurentHigherSerreCoeff D i a n m (m - r) •
        (integralGenerator D i r * integralGenerator D j n * integralGenerator D i (m - r))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator, ← map_mul,
    toQuotient_fDivPow_mul_fDivPow hij ha hm, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [coe_smul_integralForm, integralLaurentEval_laurentHigherSerreCoeff, MulMemClass.coe_mul,
    MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator, coe_integralGenerator,
    map_mul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algebraMap_laurentHigherSerreCoeff
statement:
lemma algebraMap_laurentHigherSerreCoeff (i : I) {a r : ℕ} (hra : r ≤ a)
    (hal : a < D.frobOrder l i) :
    algebraMap 𝒜 F (laurentHigherSerreCoeff D i a 1 (D.frobOrder l i) (D.frobOrder l i - r)) =
      (ε ^ D.d i) ^ ((D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) * qBinomial (ε ^ D.d i) a r
proof:
:= by
  set L := D.frobOrder l i
  set q := ε ^ D.d i
  have hε := algebraMap_T_one_ne_zero (F := F) hl0 hl
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hε
  rw [← sum_qBinomial_root hq (pow_d_pow_frobOrder D hl0 hl hprim i)
    (pow_d_pow_ne_one D hl0 hl hprim i) hra hal, laurentHigherSerreCoeff, map_sum, mul_one]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, algebraMap_T, map_qBinomialU,
    algebraMap_laurentTUnit, show (L - r + 1 + s) = L - r + 1 + s from rfl]
  congr 2
  rw [zpow_mul, zpow_natCast]
  congr 1
  push_cast [show r ≤ L by omega]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.baseGen_frobOrder_mul_baseGen
statement:
theorem baseGen_frobOrder_mul_baseGen {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {a : ℕ}
    (ha : D.cartanMatrix i j = -a) (hal : a < D.frobOrder l i) :
    baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i) * baseGen D F j 1 =
      ∑ r ∈ range (a + 1), ((ε ^ D.d i) ^ ((D.frobOrder l i : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - r)) *
        qBinomial (ε ^ D.d i) a r) •
          (baseGen D F i r * baseGen D F j 1 * baseGen D F i (D.frobOrder l i - r))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseGen]
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one,
    integralGenerator_mul_integralGenerator_eq_sum D hij ha (by omega), mul_one,
    TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← algebraMap_smul F,
    algebraMap_laurentHigherSerreCoeff D hl0 hl hprim i (by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hr) hal,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, mul_one]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.isXRegular_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem isXRegular_of_isFiniteCartan (hA : D.cartanMatrix.IsFiniteCartan) :
    R.IsXRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsXRegular, linearIndependent_iff]
  intro l hl
  have hz : D.cartanMatrix.mulVec (fun i ↦ l i) = 0 := by
    funext i
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hl (R.coroot i)
    simpa [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype,
      map_sum, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, R.root_coroot,
      Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm] using h
  have h := Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_det_ne_zero hA.det_pos.ne'
    (hz.trans (Matrix.mulVec_zero _).symm)
  ext i
  exact congr_fun h i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_weightSpaceOf_adTorus
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  simp only [adTorus, weightFunctional, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    Finsupp.sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply, Finset.sum_smul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ by
    rw [conj_eq_of_mem_adWeightSpace hx μ, smul_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightFunctional_injective
statement:
private lemma weightFunctional_injective (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective (weightFunctional (k := k) (v := v) (Y := Y))
proof:
:= by
  intro χ ψ h
  ext μ
  have he : v ^ χ μ = v ^ ψ μ := by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h (Finsupp.single μ 1)
    simpa [weightFunctional] using this
  by_contra hn
  exact zpow_ne_one_of_not_root hv (sub_ne_zero.2 hn) (by
    rw [zpow_sub₀ (NeZero.ne v), he, div_self (zpow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.iSupIndep_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_adWeightSpace (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    iSupIndep (adWeightSpace R v)
proof:
:=
  ((Module.End.iSupIndep_weightSpaceOf (adTorus (R := R) (v := v))).comp
    (weightFunctional_injective hv)).mono fun _ _ hx ↦ mem_weightSpaceOf_adTorus hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_adWeightSpace
proof:
:= by
  intro μ
  rw [← mul_assoc, hx μ, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc x, hy μ, mul_smul_comm,
    smul_smul, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusWeightSpace_le_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma plusWeightSpace_le_adWeightSpace (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    plusWeightSpace R v ν ≤ adWeightSpace R v (R.rootSum ν)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  change plusHom R v y ∈ _
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    induction w with
    | nil => simp [LusztigF.monomial, LusztigF.wordWeight, adWeightSpace]
    | cons i w ih =>
      simp only [LusztigF.monomial_cons, LusztigF.wordWeight_cons,
        R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, map_mul, plusHom_θ]
      exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (E_mem_adWeightSpace i) ih
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => simpa only [map_add] using (adWeightSpace R v _).add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => simpa only [map_smul] using (adWeightSpace R v _).smul_mem c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.iSup_plusWeightSpace
statement:
theorem iSup_plusWeightSpace :
    (⨆ ν, plusWeightSpace R v ν) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  simp only [plusWeightSpace, ← Submodule.map_iSup, LusztigF.iSup_weightSpace,
    Submodule.map_top]
  exact congrArg Subalgebra.toSubmodule (range_plusHom R v)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_characterFiber
proof:
:= by
  apply (iSupIndep_adWeightSpace hv).mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le
    (fun ψ ↦ (show (⨆ ν, ⨆ (_ : R.rootSum ν = ψ), plusWeightSpace R v ν) ≤
      adWeightSpace R v ψ from iSup_le fun ν ↦ iSup_le fun h ↦
        h ▸ plusWeightSpace_le_adWeightSpace ν)) hχ
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨆ ν, plusWeightSpace R v ν := by rwa [iSup_plusWeightSpace]
  apply (show (⨆ ν, plusWeightSpace R v ν) ≤
    ⨆ ψ, ⨆ ν, ⨆ (_ : R.rootSum ν = ψ), plusWeightSpace R v ν from ?_) hx'
  exact iSup_le fun ν ↦ le_iSup_of_le (R.rootSum ν)
    (le_iSup_of_le ν (le_iSup_of_le rfl le_rfl))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_plusWeightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem mem_plusWeightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))
    (hχ : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v (R.rootSum ν)) : x ∈ plusWeightSpace R v ν
proof:
:= by
  have hf := mem_characterFiber hv hx hχ
  apply (show (⨆ μ, ⨆ (_ : R.rootSum μ = R.rootSum ν), plusWeightSpace R v μ) ≤
    plusWeightSpace R v ν from ?_) hf
  refine iSup_le fun μ ↦ iSup_le fun h ↦ ?_
  have hm : μ = ν := by
    by_contra hn
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR hn
    exact hy (DFunLike.congr_fun h y)
  subst hm
  exact le_rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_degree_of_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem exists_degree_of_mem_adWeightSpace (hR : R.IsXRegular)
    (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))
    (hχ : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ν : I →₀ ℕ, R.rootSum ν = χ ∧ x ∈ plusWeightSpace R v ν
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ ν, R.rootSum ν = χ := by
    by_contra! hn
    have hf := mem_characterFiber hv hx hχ
    simp only [hn, iSup_of_empty, iSup_bot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hf
    exact hx0 hf
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨ν, hν, mem_plusWeightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace hR hv hx (hν.symm ▸ hχ)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_ne_zero_of_not_root
statement:
lemma E_ne_zero_of_not_root (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) :
    E R v i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs := (plusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv (LusztigF.θ k i)).1 (by simpa using h)
  have he := LusztigF.nodeEval_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal i hs
  rw [LusztigF.nodeEval_θ_self] at he
  exact Polynomial.X_ne_zero he

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearCombination_coroot
statement:
lemma linearCombination_coroot (β : I →₀ ℤ) (i : I) :
    (Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ R.root β) (R.coroot i) =
      β.sum (fun j a ↦ a * D.cartanMatrix i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, R.root_coroot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVectorDegree_eq_cartan_fold
statement:
lemma rootVectorDegree_eq_cartan_fold (ω : List I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn =
      (ω.take n).foldr (fun i β ↦
        β - (β.sum fun j a ↦ a * D.cartanMatrix i j) • Finsupp.single i 1)
        (Finsupp.single ω[n] 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rootVectorDegree, linearCombination_coroot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVectorDegree_character
statement:
lemma rootVectorDegree_character (ω : List I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ R.root (rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn) =
      rootVectorWeight R ω n hn
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootVectorDegree rootVectorWeight
  generalize ω.take n = w
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [wordWeightAction]
  | cons i w ih =>
    simp only [List.foldr_cons, map_sub, map_smul, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
      one_smul, wordWeightAction]
    rw [← ih, comp_reflY_eq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearCombination_natCast
statement:
lemma linearCombination_natCast (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ R.root (ν.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp)) =
      R.rootSum ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (by simp)]
  simp only [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum, natCast_zsmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mem_plusWeightSpace
statement: lemma E_mem_plusWeightSpace (i : I) : E R v i ∈ plusWeightSpace R v (Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using plusHom_mem_plusWeightSpace R v (LusztigF.θ_mem_weightSpace i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_zero
statement:
lemma rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_zero
    (T : I → QuantumGroup R v ≃ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R v)
    (ω : List I) (hω : 0 < ω.length) :
    CoxeterSystem.rootVector T (E R v) ω 0 hω ∈
      plusWeightSpace R v (Finsupp.single ω[0] 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [CoxeterSystem.rootVector] using (E_mem_plusWeightSpace (R := R) (v := v) ω[0])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.one_mem_plusWeightSpace
statement: lemma one_mem_plusWeightSpace : (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ plusWeightSpace R v 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using plusHom_mem_plusWeightSpace R v LusztigF.one_mem_weightSpace

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_plusWeightSpace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨a * b, LusztigF.mul_mem_weightSpace ha hb, map_mul (plusHom R v) a b⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_mem_plusWeightSpace
statement:
lemma pow_mem_plusWeightSpace {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ plusWeightSpace R v ν) (n : ℕ) : x ^ n ∈ plusWeightSpace R v (n • ν)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using (one_mem_plusWeightSpace (R := R) (v := v))
  | succ n ih => simpa [pow_succ, succ_nsmul] using mul_mem_plusWeightSpace ih hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.list_prod_mem_plusWeightSpace
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact one_mem_plusWeightSpace
  | cons a l ih =>
    exact mul_mem_plusWeightSpace (hl a (by simp)) (ih fun b hb ↦ hl b (by simp [hb]))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_character
statement:
theorem rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_character {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) {ν : I →₀ ℕ}
    (hν : R.rootSum ν = rootVectorWeight R ω n hn) :
    CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn ∈
      plusWeightSpace R v ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, hχ⟩ :=
    rootVector_mem_adjoin_and_adWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hv hA hω n hn
  exact mem_plusWeightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace (R.isXRegular_of_isFiniteCartan hA)
    hv hx (hν.symm ▸ hχ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_rootVector_degree_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem exists_rootVector_degree_of_isFiniteCartan {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    ∃ ν : I →₀ ℕ,
      ν.mapRange (fun a : ℕ ↦ (a : ℤ)) (by simp) = rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn ∧
      CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn ∈
        plusWeightSpace R v ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, hχ⟩ :=
    rootVector_mem_adjoin_and_adWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hv hA hω n hn
  have hx0 : CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn ≠ 0 := by
    exact fun h ↦ E_ne_zero_of_not_root hv ω[n]
      (((ω.take n).map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod.injective
        (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hm⟩ := exists_degree_of_mem_adWeightSpace
    (R.isXRegular_of_isFiniteCartan hA) hv hx hχ hx0
  refine ⟨ν, ?_, hm⟩
  apply (linearIndependent_iff_injective_finsuppLinearCombination.1
    (R.isXRegular_of_isFiniteCartan hA))
  rw [linearCombination_natCast, rootVectorDegree_character, hν]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVectorDegree_nonneg_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem rootVectorDegree_nonneg_of_isFiniteCartan {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) (i : I) :
    0 ≤ rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, _⟩ := exists_rootVector_degree_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hA hv hω n hn
  rw [← hν]
  exact Int.natCast_nonneg _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan {ω : List I}
    (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn ∈
      plusWeightSpace R v (positiveRootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hm⟩ := exists_rootVector_degree_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hA hv hω n hn
  have he : positiveRootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn = ν := by
    ext i
    simp [positiveRootVectorDegree, ← hν]
  rwa [he]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.positiveRootVectorDegree_character_of_isFiniteCartan
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearCombination_natCast, ← rootVectorDegree_character]
  congr 1
  ext i
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (rootVectorDegree_nonneg_of_isFiniteCartan hA hv hω n hn i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomial_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan {ω : List I}
    (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c ∈
      plusWeightSpace R v (pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_eq_prod]
  let l := List.ofFn fun n : Fin ω.length ↦
    (c n • positiveRootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.2,
      CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n n.2 ^ c n)
  have hl : ∀ a ∈ l, a.2 ∈ plusWeightSpace R v a.1 := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 ha
    exact pow_mem_plusWeightSpace
      (rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan hA hv hω n n.2) _
  simpa [l, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, pbwMonomialDegree] using
    list_prod_mem_plusWeightSpace l hl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquiv_E_mem_plusWeightSpace_twoLetter
statement:
theorem braidEquiv_E_mem_plusWeightSpace_twoLetter {i j : I}
    (hω : cs.IsReduced [i, j]) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v j) ∈
      plusWeightSpace R v (Finsupp.single i 1 + Finsupp.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_character (R := R) hA hv hω 1 (by simp)
    (ν := Finsupp.single i 1 + Finsupp.single j 1) (by
      simp [rootVectorWeight, wordWeightAction, comp_reflY_eq, R.rootSum_add,
        R.root_coroot, hij, add_comm])
  simpa [CoxeterSystem.rootVector] using hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x1_mul_z_raw
statement:
lemma x1_mul_z_raw (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (h2 : (1 + (q ^ 2)) ≠ 0)
    (h6 : (1 + (q ^ 4) + (-1 * (q ^ 2))) ≠ 0)
    (hS4 : qSerre q 4 e f = 0) (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e = 0) :
    G2PBW.x1 q e f * G2PBW.z q e f =
      (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (G2PBW.z q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedFullPBWBasis_apply
statement:
theorem simplyLacedFullPBWBasis_apply (a c : Fin w.length → ℕ) (μ : Y) :
    simplyLacedFullPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀ (a, μ, c) =
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) w a * QuantumGroup.K R v μ *
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w c
proof:
:= by
  simp [simplyLacedFullPBWBasis, simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis_apply, simplyLacedPBWBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedFullPBWBasis_sum_repr
statement:
theorem simplyLacedFullPBWBasis_sum_repr (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    ((simplyLacedFullPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀).repr x).sum
      (fun t a ↦ a • (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) w t.1 *
        QuantumGroup.K R v t.2.1 *
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w t.2.2)) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hvec (t : (Fin w.length → ℕ) × Y × (Fin w.length → ℕ)) :
      simplyLacedFullPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀ t =
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) w t.1 *
          QuantumGroup.K R v t.2.1 *
          CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w t.2.2 :=
    simplyLacedFullPBWBasis_apply R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀ t.1 t.2.2 t.2.1
  simpa only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, hvec] using
    (simplyLacedFullPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀).linearCombination_repr x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_simplyLacedFullPBWBasis
statement:
theorem exists_simplyLacedFullPBWBasis :
    ∃ w : List I, cs.IsReduced w ∧ cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement ∧
      ∃ b : Basis ((Fin w.length → ℕ) × Y × (Fin w.length → ℕ)) k (QuantumGroup R v),
        ∀ a μ c, b (a, μ, c) =
          CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) w a * QuantumGroup.K R v μ *
            CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced cs.longestElement
  exact ⟨w, hw, he.symm, simplyLacedFullPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw he.symm,
    fun a μ c ↦ simplyLacedFullPBWBasis_apply R hv hSL cs hD hw he.symm a c μ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_f_step
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_f_step (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    q ^ 3 * adjointCoeff q a b c d (l + 1) =
      adjointCoeff q a b c (d + 1) l * q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjointCoeff, adjointExponent, pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_D_step
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_D_step (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    q ^ (3 * l + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * adjointCoeff q a b c (d + 1) l =
      adjointCoeff q a (b + 1) c d l * q ^ (3 * a + (b + 1)) *
        q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjointCoeff, adjointExponent, pow_add, pow_mul, mul_pow, pow_one]
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_DC_step
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_DC_step (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    -(q ^ (3 * l) * q⁻¹ ^ d * adjointCoeff q a b c (d + 2) l) =
      adjointCoeff q a b (c + 1) d l * q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) * q⁻¹ ^ d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjointCoeff, adjointExponent, pow_add, pow_mul, mul_pow, pow_one]
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_C_step
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_C_step (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * adjointCoeff q a b (c + 1) d l =
      -(adjointCoeff q a (b + 2) c d l * q ^ (3 * a) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 2))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjointCoeff, adjointExponent, pow_add, pow_mul, mul_pow, pow_one]
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_B_step
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_B_step (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * adjointCoeff q a (b + 1) c d l =
      adjointCoeff q (a + 1) b c d l * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 3 * c + d)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjointCoeff, adjointExponent, pow_add, pow_mul, mul_pow, pow_one]
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_recurrence_all
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_recurrence_all (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    qInt q (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c + d) * adjointCoeff q a b c d l =
      (if d = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ 3 * adjointCoeff q a b c (d - 1) (l + 1) * qInt q d) +
      (if b = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ (3 * l + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * adjointCoeff q a (b - 1) c (d + 1) l *
          qInt q 2 * qInt q b) +
      (if c = 0 then 0 else
        -(q ^ (3 * l) * q⁻¹ ^ d * adjointCoeff q a b (c - 1) (d + 2) l) *
          qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c) +
      (if b ≤ 1 then 0 else
        (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) *
          adjointCoeff q a (b - 2) (c + 1) d l) * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b) +
      (if a = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * adjointCoeff q (a - 1) (b + 1) c d l *
          qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : (if d = 0 then 0 else
      q ^ 3 * adjointCoeff q a b c (d - 1) (l + 1) * qInt q d) =
      adjointCoeff q a b c d l * q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c) * qInt q d := by
    cases d with
    | zero => simp [qInt]
    | succ d => simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        adjointCoeff_f_step]
  have hD : (if b = 0 then 0 else
      q ^ (3 * l + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * adjointCoeff q a (b - 1) c (d + 1) l *
        qInt q 2 * qInt q b) =
      adjointCoeff q a b c d l * q ^ (3 * a + b) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 1) *
        qInt q 2 * qInt q b := by
    cases b with
    | zero => simp [qInt]
    | succ b => simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        adjointCoeff_D_step hq]
  have hDC : (if c = 0 then 0 else
      -(q ^ (3 * l) * q⁻¹ ^ d * adjointCoeff q a b (c - 1) (d + 2) l) *
        qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c) =
      adjointCoeff q a b c d l * q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) * q⁻¹ ^ d *
        qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c := by
    cases c with
    | zero => simp [qInt]
    | succ c => simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        adjointCoeff_DC_step hq]
  have hC : (if b ≤ 1 then 0 else
      (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) *
        adjointCoeff q a (b - 2) (c + 1) d l) * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b) =
      -(adjointCoeff q a b c d l * (q ^ 2 - 1) * q ^ (3 * a) *
        q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 2) * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b) := by
    rcases b with _ | (_ | b)
    · simp [qInt]
    · simp [qInt]
    · simp only [show b + 1 + 1 = b + 2 by omega, show ¬ b + 2 ≤ 1 by omega, ite_false,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel, show b + 2 - 1 = b + 1 by omega, adjointCoeff_C_step hq]
      ring
  have hB : (if a = 0 then 0 else
      q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * adjointCoeff q (a - 1) (b + 1) c d l *
        qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a) =
      adjointCoeff q a b c d l * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 3 * c + d) *
        qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a := by
    cases a with
    | zero => simp [qInt]
    | succ a => simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        adjointCoeff_B_step hq]
  rw [hF, hD, hDC, hC, hB]
  linear_combination adjointCoeff q a b c d l * adjoint_scalar_all hq a b c d

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_recurrence
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_recurrence (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    qInt q (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c + d) * adjointCoeff q a b c d l =
      (if d = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ 3 * adjointCoeff q a b c (d - 1) (l + 1) * qInt q d) +
      (if b = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ (3 * l + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * adjointCoeff q a (b - 1) c (d + 1) l *
          qInt q 2 * qInt q b) +
      (if c = 0 then 0 else
        -(q ^ (3 * l) * q⁻¹ ^ d * adjointCoeff q a b (c - 1) (d + 2) l) *
          qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c) +
      (if b ≤ 1 then 0 else
        (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) *
          adjointCoeff q a (b - 2) (c + 1) d l) * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b) +
      (if a = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ (3 * l + d) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * adjointCoeff q (a - 1) (b + 1) c d l *
          qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact adjointCoeff_recurrence_all hq a b c d l

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.qInt_two
statement: lemma qInt_two (q : k) : qInt q 2 = q + q⁻¹
proof: := by simp [qInt, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.qSerre_two_left
statement:
lemma qSerre_two_left (hq : q ≠ 0) (e f : B) :
    qSerre q 2 e f = e * qComm q e f - q • (qComm q e f * e)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial_one_right,
    qBinomial_self, qBinomial_zero_right, qInt_two, qComm]
  simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
    smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
    Nat.add_one_sub_one]
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hq]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.qSerre_two_right
statement:
lemma qSerre_two_right (hq : q ≠ 0) (e f : B) :
    qSerre q 2 f e = qComm q e f * f - q • (f * qComm q e f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial_one_right,
    qBinomial_self, qBinomial_zero_right, qInt_two, qComm]
  simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
    smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
    Nat.add_one_sub_one]
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hq]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.mul_eq_qComm
statement: lemma mul_eq_qComm (hq : q ≠ 0) (e f : B) : f * e = q • (e * f) - q • qComm q e f
proof:
:= by
  rw [qComm, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.qComm_mul_left_of_qSerre
statement:
lemma qComm_mul_left_of_qSerre (hq : q ≠ 0) (hS : qSerre q 2 e f = 0) :
    qComm q e f * e = q⁻¹ • (e * qComm q e f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qSerre_two_left hq, sub_eq_zero] at hS
  rw [hS, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.mul_qComm_right_of_qSerre
statement:
lemma mul_qComm_right_of_qSerre (hq : q ≠ 0) (hS : qSerre q 2 f e = 0) :
    f * qComm q e f = q⁻¹ • (qComm q e f * f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qSerre_two_right hq, sub_eq_zero] at hS
  rw [hS, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.mul_pow_succ_left
statement:
lemma mul_pow_succ_left (hfe : f * e = q • (e * f) - q • X)
    (hXe : X * e = q⁻¹ • (e * X)) (n : ℕ) :
    f * e ^ (n + 1) = q ^ (n + 1) • (e ^ (n + 1) * f) - (q * qInt q (n + 1)) • (e ^ n * X)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hfe, qInt]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ e (n + 1), ← mul_assoc f, ih]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hfe, hXe]
    simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [← mul_assoc (e ^ n) e X, ← pow_succ e n, qInt_succ (v := q) (n + 1)]
    match_scalars <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.mul_pow_succ_left_assoc
statement:
lemma mul_pow_succ_left_assoc (hfe : f * e = q • (e * f) - q • X)
    (hXe : X * e = q⁻¹ • (e * X)) (n : ℕ) (y : B) :
    f * (e ^ (n + 1) * y) =
      q ^ (n + 1) • (e ^ (n + 1) * (f * y)) - (q * qInt q (n + 1)) • (e ^ n * (X * y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_pow_succ_left hfe hXe, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.mul_pow_assoc_of_mul_eq
statement:
lemma mul_pow_assoc_of_mul_eq (hfX : f * X = q⁻¹ • (X * f)) (n : ℕ) (y : B) :
    f * (X ^ n * y) = q⁻¹ ^ n • (X ^ n * (f * y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul hfX, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opE_single
statement:
lemma opE_single (a b c : ℕ) (x : k) :
    opE (Finsupp.single (a, b, c) x) = Finsupp.single (a + 1, b, c) x
proof:
:= by
  simp [opE]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opF_single
statement:
lemma opF_single (a b c : ℕ) (x : k) :
    opF q (Finsupp.single (a, b, c) x) =
      x • ((q ^ a * q⁻¹ ^ b) • Finsupp.single (a, b, c + 1) (1 : k) -
        (q * qInt q a) • Finsupp.single (a - 1, b + 1, c) 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [opF]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opX_single
statement:
lemma opX_single (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) (x : k) :
    opX q (Finsupp.single (a, b, c) x) = (x * q⁻¹ ^ a) • Finsupp.single (a, b + 1, c) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm := qInt_mul_sub (v := q) a
  have hqq : q⁻¹ * q = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hq
  simp only [opX, qComm, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
    opF_single, opE_single, map_sub, map_smul, qInt_succ (v := q) a, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  cases a with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Nat.zero_sub, zero_add, qInt_zero, mul_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    match_scalars
    · linear_combination (-x * q⁻¹ ^ b) * hqq
    · linear_combination x * hqq
  | succ a =>
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    match_scalars
    · linear_combination (-x * q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ b) * hqq
    · linear_combination (-x) * hm + (x * q⁻¹ * qInt q (a + 1) + x * q ^ (a + 1)) * hqq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opE_opX
statement: lemma opE_opX (hq : q ≠ 0) : opE * opX q = q • (opX q * opE)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun p x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, opE_single, opX_single hq, map_smul]
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  linear_combination (-(x * q⁻¹ ^ a)) * mul_inv_cancel₀ hq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opX_opF
statement: lemma opX_opF (hq : q ≠ 0) : opX q * opF q = q • (opF q * opX q)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun p x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
  rcases a with _ | a
  · simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, opF_single, opX_single hq, map_smul,
      qInt_zero, mul_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero, smul_smul]
    match_scalars
    linear_combination (-(x * q⁻¹ ^ b)) * mul_inv_cancel₀ hq
  · simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, opF_single, opX_single hq, map_smul,
      map_sub, smul_sub, smul_smul, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    match_scalars
    · linear_combination (-(x * q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ b)) * mul_inv_cancel₀ hq
    · linear_combination (x * q * qInt q (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ a) * mul_inv_cancel₀ hq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opF_pow_single
statement:
lemma opF_pow_single (c : ℕ) :
    (opF q ^ c) (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0) 1) = Finsupp.single (0, 0, c) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ c ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, opF_single]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opX_pow_single
statement:
lemma opX_pow_single (hq : q ≠ 0) (b c : ℕ) :
    (opX q ^ b) (Finsupp.single (0, 0, c) 1) = Finsupp.single (0, b, c) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ b ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, opX_single hq]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.opE_pow_single
statement:
lemma opE_pow_single (a b c : ℕ) :
    (opE ^ a) (Finsupp.single (0, b, c) (1 : k)) = Finsupp.single (a, b, c) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ a ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, opE_single]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.monoMap_single
statement:
lemma monoMap_single (p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) (x : k) :
    monoMap k e X f (Finsupp.single p x) = x • mono e X f p
proof:
:= by
  simp [monoMap]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.monoMap_opE
statement: lemma monoMap_opE (s : Space k) : monoMap k e X f (opE s) = e * monoMap k e X f s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add, mul_add]
  | single p x =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
    simp [opE_single, monoMap_single, mono, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.monoMap_opF
statement:
lemma monoMap_opF (hfe : f * e = q • (e * f) - q • X)
    (hXe : X * e = q⁻¹ • (e * X)) (hfX : f * X = q⁻¹ • (X * f)) (s : Space k) :
    monoMap k e X f (opF q s) = f * monoMap k e X f s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add, mul_add]
  | single p x =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
    rw [opF_single, map_smul, map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, monoMap_single, monoMap_single,
      monoMap_single, mul_smul_comm]
    simp only [mono, one_smul, mul_assoc]
    rcases a with _ | a
    · simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, qInt_zero, mul_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero,
        mul_pow_assoc_of_mul_eq hfX, pow_succ' f c, smul_smul]
    · rw [mul_pow_succ_left_assoc hfe hXe, mul_pow_assoc_of_mul_eq hfX, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        pow_succ' X b, pow_succ' f c]
      simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.monoMap_single_zero
statement: lemma monoMap_single_zero : monoMap k e X f (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0) 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [monoMap_single, mono]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.rep_θ_left
statement: @[simp] lemma rep_θ_left : rep q i (θ k i) = opE
proof: := by simp [rep]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.rep_θ_right
statement: lemma rep_θ_right (hij : i ≠ j) : rep q i (θ k j) = opF q
proof: := by simp [rep, hij.symm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.rep_qSerre
statement:
lemma rep_qSerre (q' : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : LusztigF k I) :
    rep q i (qSerre q' m a b) = qSerre q' m (rep q i a) (rep q i b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.rep_qComm
statement: lemma rep_qComm (hij : i ≠ j) : rep q i (qComm q (θ k i) (θ k j)) = opX q
proof:
:= by
  simp [qComm, rep_θ_right hij, opX]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two
statement:
lemma toNat_one_sub_eq_two {i j : I} (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1) :
    (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.serreIdeal_le_ker_rep
statement:
theorem serreIdeal_le_ker_rep [NeZero v] (hij : i ≠ j) (hall : ∀ l, l = i ∨ l = j)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (h2 : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2 ≠ 0) :
    serreIdeal D v ≤ TwoSidedIdeal.ker (rep (v ^ D.d i) i)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  rw [serreIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨l, m, hlm, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker]
  rcases hall l with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hall m with rfl | rfl
  · exact absurd rfl hlm
  · rw [serreElement, toNat_one_sub_eq_two h, qSerreDiv_eq h2, map_smul,
      rep_qSerre, rep_θ_left, rep_θ_right hij, qSerre_two_left hq]
    change _ • (opE * opX _ - _ • (opX _ * opE)) = 0
    rw [opE_opX hq, sub_self, smul_zero]
  · rw [serreElement, toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', ← D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h',
      qSerreDiv_eq h2, map_smul, rep_qSerre, rep_θ_left, rep_θ_right hlm.symm,
      qSerre_two_right hq]
    change _ • (opX _ * opF _ - _ • (opF _ * opX _)) = 0
    rw [opX_opF hq, sub_self, smul_zero]
  · exact absurd rfl hlm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_braidEj_eq_qComm
statement: lemma a2_braidEj_eq_qComm : braidEj R v i j = qComm (v ^ D.d i) (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:=
  braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_E_mul_E
statement:
lemma a2_E_mul_E : E R v j * E R v i =
    v ^ D.d i • (E R v i * E R v j) - v ^ D.d i • braidEj R v i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [a2_braidEj_eq_qComm h]
  exact mul_eq_qComm (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_braidEj_mul_E
statement:
lemma a2_braidEj_mul_E : braidEj R v i j * E R v i =
    (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ • (E R v i * braidEj R v i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [a2_braidEj_eq_qComm h]
  refine qComm_mul_left_of_qSerre (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) ?_
  have hS := serre_E R v hij
  rwa [toNat_one_sub_eq_two h] at hS

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_E_mul_braidEj
statement:
lemma a2_E_mul_braidEj : E R v j * braidEj R v i j =
    (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ • (braidEj R v i j * E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [a2_braidEj_eq_qComm h]
  refine mul_qComm_right_of_qSerre (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) ?_
  have hS := serre_E R v hij.symm
  rwa [toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', ← D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h'] at hS

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_monoMap_rep
statement:
theorem a2_monoMap_rep (x : LusztigF k I) (s : Space k) :
    monoMap k (E R v i) (braidEj R v i j) (E R v j) (rep (v ^ D.d i) i x s) =
      plusHom R v x * monoMap k (E R v i) (braidEj R v i j) (E R v j) s
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing s with
  | grade0 r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul,
      Algebra.smul_def]
  | grade1 l =>
    rcases hall l with rfl | rfl
    · change monoMap k _ _ _ (rep _ l (θ k l) s) = plusHom R v (θ k l) * _
      rw [rep_θ_left, plusHom_θ, monoMap_opE]
    · change monoMap k _ _ _ (rep _ i (θ k l) s) = plusHom R v (θ k l) * _
      rw [rep_θ_right hij, plusHom_θ, monoMap_opF (a2_E_mul_E h) (a2_braidEj_mul_E h hij)
        (a2_E_mul_braidEj h hij h')]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, add_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_a2PBWMono
statement:
theorem span_a2PBWMono :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (a2PBWMono R v i j)) =
      Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    change a2PBWMono R v i j p ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
    have hE : ∀ l, E R v l ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) :=
      fun l ↦ Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨l, rfl⟩
    have hX : braidEj R v i j ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) := by
      rw [a2_braidEj_eq_qComm h, qComm]
      exact sub_mem (mul_mem (hE i) (hE j)) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem (hE j) (hE i)) _)
    exact mul_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem (hE i) _) (pow_mem hX _)) (pow_mem (hE j) _)
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_freeAlgebra_lift]
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change FreeAlgebra.lift k (E R v) x ∈ _
    have hx : FreeAlgebra.lift k (E R v) x =
        monoMap k (E R v i) (braidEj R v i j) (E R v j)
          (rep (v ^ D.d i) i x (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0) 1)) := by
      rw [a2_monoMap_rep h hij h' hall, monoMap_single_zero, mul_one]
      rfl
    rw [hx, monoMap, ← Finsupp.range_linearCombination]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_a2PBWMono
statement: theorem linearIndependent_a2PBWMono : LinearIndependent k (a2PBWMono R v i j)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  let fm : Space k →ₗ[k] LusztigF k I :=
    Finsupp.linearCombination k (mono (θ k i) (qComm (v ^ D.d i) (θ k i) (θ k j)) (θ k j))
  have hplus : ∀ s, plusHom R v (fm s) =
      monoMap k (E R v i) (braidEj R v i j) (E R v j) s := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add]
    | single p x =>
      simp only [fm, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul, monoMap_single, mono, map_mul,
        map_pow, plusHom_θ, a2_braidEj_eq_qComm h, qComm, map_sub]
  have hrep : ∀ s, rep (v ^ D.d i) i (fm s) (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0) 1) = s := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hs, ht]
    | single p x =>
      obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
      simp only [fm, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mono,
        map_mul, map_pow, rep_θ_left, rep_θ_right hij, rep_qComm hij, Module.End.mul_apply,
        opF_pow_single, opX_pow_single hq, opE_pow_single]
      rw [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [linearIndependent_iff]
  intro s hs
  have h0 : plusHom R v (fm s) = 0 := (hplus s).trans hs
  have hker := serreIdeal_le_ker_rep hij hall h h'
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i 2) ((plusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv' _).1 h0)
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker] at hker
  rw [← hrep s, hker, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2PBWBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem a2PBWBasis_apply (p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    (a2PBWBasis R v h hij h' hall hv' p : QuantumGroup R v) = a2PBWMono R v i j p
proof:
:= by
  simp [a2PBWBasis, Module.Basis.span_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_rootVector_two
statement:
theorem a2_rootVector_two (hij : i ≠ j) (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S) :
    S (E R v j) = braidEj R v i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [HS.map_E, hij.symm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_rootVector_three
statement:
theorem a2_rootVector_three [NeZero v] (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S)
    (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j) (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hqi : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    S (T (E R v i)) = E R v j
proof:
:=
  HS.three_double_E HT hij h h' hqi

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2PBWMono_eq_rootVectors
statement:
theorem a2PBWMono_eq_rootVectors [NeZero v] (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S)
    (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j) (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hqi : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    a2PBWMono R v i j p = E R v i ^ p.1 * S (E R v j) ^ p.2.1 * S (T (E R v i)) ^ p.2.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [a2_rootVector_two hij HS, a2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hqi]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2PBWBasis_apply_braidEquiv
statement:
theorem a2PBWBasis_apply_braidEquiv (p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    (a2PBWBasis R v h hij h' hall hv' p : QuantumGroup R v) =
      E R v i ^ p.1 * twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv' (E R v j) ^ p.2.1 *
        twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv'
          (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm) hv'
            (E R v i)) ^ p.2.2
proof:
:= by
  have HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i
      (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv').toAlgHom :=
    braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages
      (twoNode_braidGeneric hij hall (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' i j))
      (twoNode_transformedSerre hij hall (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' i j))
  have HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j
      (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm) hv').toAlgHom :=
    braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages
      (twoNode_braidGeneric hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm)
        (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' j).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' j i))
      (twoNode_transformedSerre hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm)
        (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' j).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' j i))
  rw [a2PBWBasis_apply, a2PBWMono_eq_rootVectors HS HT hij h h'
    (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.orderedSpan_mul_genRing
statement:
lemma orderedSpan_mul_genRing {x y : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f)
    (hy : y ∈ genRing q Λ e f) : x * y ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have stable : ∀ y ∈ genRing q Λ e f, ∀ x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f,
      x * y ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Subring.closure_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      rcases hy with (⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩) | ⟨n, rfl⟩
      · intro x hx
        rw [← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def]
        exact smul_mem_orderedSpan hc hx
      · exact fun x hx => orderedSpan_mul_e hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ n hx
      · exact fun x hx => orderedSpan_mul_f hpi hqΛ hiΛ n hx
    | zero => intro x _; rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | one => intro x hx; rwa [mul_one]
    | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
      intro x hx
      rw [mul_add]
      exact add_mem (hy x hx) (hz x hx)
    | neg y _ hy =>
      intro x hx
      rw [mul_neg]
      exact neg_mem (hy x hx)
    | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
      intro x hx
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact hz (x * y) (hy x hx)
  exact stable y hy x hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.genRing_le_orderedSpan
statement:
theorem genRing_le_orderedSpan :
    (genRing q Λ e f).toAddSubgroup ≤ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simpa only [one_mul] using
    orderedSpan_mul_genRing hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ one_mem_orderedSpan hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.orderedSpan_eq_genRing
statement:
theorem orderedSpan_eq_genRing :
    orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f = (genRing q Λ e f).toAddSubgroup
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (orderedSpan_le_genRing_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ)
    (genRing_le_orderedSpan hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.orderedSpan_mul
statement:
theorem orderedSpan_mul {x y : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f)
    (hy : y ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f) :
    x * y ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:=
  orderedSpan_mul_genRing hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ hx
    (orderedSpan_le_genRing_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ hy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_mem
statement:
lemma serreAux_mem {q c : k} {m : ℕ} {a b : QuantumGroup R v} (ha : a ∈ P) (hb : b ∈ P) :
    serreAux q c m a b ∈ P
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun _ _ ↦
    Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem ha _) hb) (pow_mem ha _)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEj_mem
statement: lemma braidEj_mem {a b : I} (ha : E R v a ∈ P) (hb : E R v b ∈ P) : braidEj R v a b ∈ P
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (serreAux_mem ha hb) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.X_mem
statement:
lemma X_mem {q Q : k} {a b : QuantumGroup R v} (ha : a ∈ P) (hb : b ∈ P) (n : ℕ) :
    X q Q a b n ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hb
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [X_succ]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem ha ih) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem ih ha) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_X_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact h1
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [X_succ, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem ha ih) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem ih ha) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mem_pair_left
statement: lemma E_mem_pair_left : E R v i ∈ P
proof: := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mem_pair_right
statement: lemma E_mem_pair_right : E R v j ∈ P
proof: := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_E_mem_pair
statement: lemma map_E_mem_pair (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j) : T (E R v i) ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [HT.map_E, ite_eq_right hij]
  exact braidEj_mem E_mem_pair_right E_mem_pair_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_words
statement:
lemma a2_words [NeZero v] (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S) (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    T (E R v i) ∈ P ∧ S (T (E R v i)) = E R v j
proof:
:=
  ⟨map_E_mem_pair HT hij, a2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hq⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_words_short
statement:
lemma b2_words_short :
    T (E R v i) ∈ P ∧ S (T (E R v i)) ∈ P ∧ T (S (T (E R v i))) = E R v i
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  refine ⟨map_E_mem_pair HT hij, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [b2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hq]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem E_mem_pair_left E_mem_pair_right 1) _
  · rw [b2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hq, map_smul, b2_T_X_one HT hij h h' hq h2,
      b2_cc_two hq0 hq]
    rw [b2_qFactorial_two hq0] at h2 ⊢
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_words_long
statement:
lemma b2_words_long :
    S (E R v j) ∈ P ∧ T (S (E R v j)) ∈ P ∧ S (T (S (E R v j))) = E R v j
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, b2_rootVector_four HS HT hij h h' hq h2⟩
  · rw [b2_rootVector_two HS hij h]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem E_mem_pair_left E_mem_pair_right 2) _
  · rw [b2_rootVector_two HS hij h, map_smul]
    refine Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (map_X_mem (map_E_mem_pair HT hij) ?_ 1) _
    rw [b2_T_X_one HT hij h h' hq h2]
    exact E_mem_pair_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_map_X_mem
statement:
lemma g2_map_X_mem (n : ℕ) :
    T (X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 3) (E R v i) (E R v j) (n + 1)) ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  refine map_X_mem (map_E_mem_pair HT hij) ?_ n
  rw [tripleSix_T_X_one HT hij h h' hq h3]
  exact E_mem_pair_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_words_short
statement:
lemma g2_words_short :
    T (E R v i) ∈ P ∧ S (T (E R v i)) ∈ P ∧ T (S (T (E R v i))) ∈ P ∧
      S (T (S (T (E R v i)))) ∈ P ∧ T (S (T (S (T (E R v i))))) = E R v i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨map_E_mem_pair HT hij, ?_, ?_, ?_, tripleSix_Ei HS HT hij h h' hq h3⟩
  · rw [tripleSix_T_Ei HT hij, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem E_mem_pair_left E_mem_pair_right 2) _
  · rw [tripleSix_T_Ei HT hij, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq, map_smul]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (g2_map_X_mem HT hij h h' hq h3 1) _
  · rw [tripleSix_T_Ei HT hij, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq, map_smul, map_smul,
      tripleSix_S_TX2 HS HT hij h h' hq h3]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Subalgebra.smul_mem _
      (X_mem E_mem_pair_left E_mem_pair_right 1) _) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_words_long
statement:
lemma g2_words_long :
    S (E R v j) ∈ P ∧ T (S (E R v j)) ∈ P ∧ S (T (S (E R v j))) ∈ P ∧
      T (S (T (S (E R v j)))) ∈ P ∧ S (T (S (T (S (E R v j))))) = E R v j
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, tripleSix_Ej HS HT hij h h' hq h3⟩
  · rw [tripleSix_S_Ej HS hij h]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem E_mem_pair_left E_mem_pair_right 3) _
  · rw [tripleSix_S_Ej HS hij h, map_smul]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (g2_map_X_mem HT hij h h' hq h3 2) _
  · rw [tripleSix_S_Ej HS hij h, map_smul, map_smul, tripleSix_T_X_succ HT hij 2, map_sub,
      map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq,
      tripleSix_S_TX2 HS HT hij h h' hq h3]
    refine Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (sub_mem (mul_mem ?_ ?_) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _
      (mul_mem ?_ ?_) _)) _ <;>
      exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem E_mem_pair_left E_mem_pair_right _) _
  · simp only [tripleSix_S_Ej HS hij h, map_smul, tripleSix_T_X_succ HT hij 2, map_sub,
      map_mul, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq, tripleSix_S_TX2 HS HT hij h h' hq h3]
    repeat' first | apply Subalgebra.smul_mem | apply sub_mem | apply mul_mem
    · exact g2_map_X_mem HT hij h h' hq h3 1
    · exact g2_map_X_mem HT hij h h' hq h3 0
    · exact g2_map_X_mem HT hij h h' hq h3 0
    · exact g2_map_X_mem HT hij h h' hq h3 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cartan_pair_cases
statement:
lemma cartan_pair_cases {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfin : D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) :
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = 0 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = 0) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -2 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -2) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -3 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -3)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
  have hx := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have hy := hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  by_cases h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h0, (hA.zero_comm i j).1 h0⟩
  have h0' : D.cartanMatrix j i ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ h0 ((hA.zero_comm i j).2 h)
  have e1 : -3 ≤ D.cartanMatrix i j := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hx (show D.cartanMatrix j i + 1 ≤ 0 by omega)]
  have e2 : -3 ≤ D.cartanMatrix j i := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hy (show D.cartanMatrix i j + 1 ≤ 0 by omega)]
  right
  interval_cases hi : D.cartanMatrix i j <;> interval_cases hj : D.cartanMatrix j i <;> simp_all

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEquivOfGeneric_images
statement:
lemma braidEquivOfGeneric_images (l : I) :
    HasBraidGeneratorImages l (braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq l) (hS l)).toAlgHom
proof:
:=
  braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages (braidGeneric_of_braidSerreGeneric (hq l) (hS l))
    (transformedSerre_of_braidSerreGeneric (hq l) (hS l))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_negA_ne
statement:
lemma qFactorial_negA_ne {i j : I} (hij : j ≠ i) :
    qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (braidGeneric_of_braidSerreGeneric (hq i) (hS i)).qFactorial_ne j hij

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoRootProperty_braidEquivOfGeneric
statement:
theorem rankTwoRootProperty_braidEquivOfGeneric :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.RankTwoRootProperty
      (fun i ↦ braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq i) (hS i)) (E R v)
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfGeneric_images (R := R) hq hS
  have h2 : ∀ {i l : I}, l ≠ i → D.cartanMatrix i l = -2 → qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2 ≠ 0 :=
    fun hli h ↦ by simpa [b2_negA h] using qFactorial_negA_ne hq hS hli
  have h3' : ∀ {i l : I}, l ≠ i → D.cartanMatrix i l = -3 → qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 3 ≠ 0 :=
    fun hli h ↦ by simpa [tripleSix_negA h] using qFactorial_negA_ne hq hS hli
  constructor
  · intro i l hil n hn
    by_cases hfin : D.cartanMatrix i l * D.cartanMatrix l i ≤ 3
    swap
    · exact alternatingWord_prod_E_mem_adjoin_of_four_le HT hq hil hfin n
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hil] at hn
    have hl := E_mem_pair_left (k := k) (R := R) (v := v) (i := i) (j := l)
    have hr := E_mem_pair_right (k := k) (R := R) (v := v) (i := i) (j := l)
    rcases cartan_pair_cases hil hfin with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ |
      ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ <;>
      simp only [h1, h1'] at hn <;> norm_num [Matrix.coxeterEntry] at hn <;>
      interval_cases n <;>
      simp only [alternatingWord, List.concat_eq_append, List.nil_append, List.cons_append,
        List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one,
