        AlgEquiv.mul_apply, AlgEquiv.one_apply]
    all_goals first
      | exact hl
      | skip
    
    · rw [show (braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq l) (hS l)) (E R v i) = E R v i from
        a1a1_rootVector_two hil.symm h1' (HT l)]
      exact hl
    
    · exact (a2_words (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)).1
    · rw [show (braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq i) (hS i))
          ((braidEquivOfGeneric (R := R) (hq l) (hS l)) (E R v i)) = E R v l from
        (a2_words (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)).2]
      exact hr
    
    · exact (b2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h2 hil.symm h1)).1
    · exact (b2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h2 hil.symm h1)).2.1
    · convert hl using 1
      exact (b2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)
        (h2 hil.symm h1)).2.2
    
    · rw [Set.pair_comm]
      exact (b2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h2 hil h1')).1
    · rw [Set.pair_comm]
      exact (b2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h2 hil h1')).2.1
    · convert hl using 1
      exact (b2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l)
        (h2 hil h1')).2.2
    
    · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).1
    · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.1
    · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.2.1
    · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.2.2.1
    · convert hl using 1
      exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)
        (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.2.2.2
    
    · rw [Set.pair_comm]
      exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).1
    · rw [Set.pair_comm]
      exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).2.1
    · rw [Set.pair_comm]
      exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).2.2.1
    · rw [Set.pair_comm]
      exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).2.2.2.1
    · convert hl using 1
      exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l)
        (h3' hil h1')).2.2.2.2
  · intro i l hil n hn
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hil] at hn
    by_cases hfin : D.cartanMatrix i l * D.cartanMatrix l i ≤ 3
    swap
    · rw [Matrix.coxeterEntry_of_four_le (by omega)] at hn
      omega
    rcases cartan_pair_cases hil hfin with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ |
      ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ <;>
      simp only [h1, h1'] at hn <;> norm_num [Matrix.coxeterEntry] at hn <;>
      subst hn <;>
      simp only [alternatingWord, List.concat_eq_append, List.nil_append, List.cons_append,
        List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one,
        AlgEquiv.mul_apply] <;>
      norm_num
    · exact a1a1_rootVector_two hil.symm h1' (HT l)
    · exact (a2_words (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i)).2
    · exact (b2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h2 hil.symm h1)).2.2
    · exact (b2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h2 hil h1')).2.2
    · exact (g2_words_short (HT i) (HT l) hil h1 h1' (hq i) (h3' hil.symm h1)).2.2.2.2
    · exact (g2_words_long (HT l) (HT i) hil.symm h1' h1 (hq l) (h3' hil h1')).2.2.2.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidLift_E_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem braidLift_E_mem_adjoin {w : W} {i : I} (hwi : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.X2_mul_X3
statement: lemma X2_mul_X3 : X2 q e f * X3 q e f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (X3 q e f * X2 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := x2_mul_x3_raw hq (by simpa only [add_comm] using h4) hS4 hS2
  simp only [X2, X3, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, h, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Z_mul_X2
statement: lemma Z_mul_X2 : Z q e f * X2 q e f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (X2 q e f * Z q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have h6' : 1 + q ^ 4 + -1 * q ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by convert h6 using 1; ring
  have h := z_mul_x2_raw hq h6' (by simpa only [add_comm] using h4) hS4 hS2
  simp only [Z, X2, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, h, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x1_mul_Z
statement: lemma x1_mul_Z : G2PBW.x1 q e f * Z q e f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (Z q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have h6' : 1 + q ^ 4 + -1 * q ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by convert h6 using 1; ring
  have h2' : 1 + q ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using square_add_one_ne_zero hq h2
  have h := x1_mul_z_raw hq h2' h6' hS4 hS2
  simp only [Z, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, h, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Z_def
statement:
lemma Z_def : qInt q 3 • Z q e f = X2 q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f -
    q • (G2PBW.x1 q e f * X2 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Z, X2, G2PBW.z, smul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul,
    qFactorial_three]
  match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Z_mul_X3
statement:
lemma Z_mul_X3 : Z q e f * X3 q e f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (X3 q e f * Z q e f) -
    ((q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 / (q ^ 2 * qInt q 3)) • (X2 q e f ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := X2_mul_X3 hq h4 hS4 hS2
  have hD := x1_mul_X3 hq h2 h3 hS4 hS2
  apply smul_right_injective B h3
  simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul]
  rw [← smul_mul_assoc, Z_def h2 h3, mul_comm (qInt q 3) ((q ^ 3)⁻¹), ← smul_smul,
    ← mul_smul_comm (qInt q 3) (X3 q e f) (Z q e f), Z_def h2 h3]
  linear_combination (norm := skip) X2 q e f * hD + hA * G2PBW.x1 q e f -
    q • (G2PBW.x1 q e f * hA) - q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (hD * X2 q e f)
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_assoc]
  match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan
statement:
lemma smul_mem_orderedSpan {z : k} (hz : z ∈ Λ) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f) : z • x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨z', hz', i, a, b', c, d, l, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure
      ⟨z * z', mul_mem hz hz', i, a, b', c, d, l, by rw [smul_smul]⟩
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.M6_mem_orderedSpan
statement:
lemma M6_mem_orderedSpan (i a b' c d l : ℕ) :
    M6 q e A b C D f i a b' c d l ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨1, one_mem _, i, a, b', c, d, l, by rw [one_smul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.one_mem_orderedSpan
statement: lemma one_mem_orderedSpan : (1 : B) ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
    M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
      (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 0 0 0 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen
statement:
lemma mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen {z : B}
    (hz : ∀ i a b' c d l, z * M6 q e A b C D f i a b' c d l ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f)
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f) :
    z * x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨z', hz', i, a, b', c, d, l, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [mul_smul_comm]
    exact smul_mem_orderedSpan hz' (hz i a b' c d l)
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [mul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_e_mul_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_e_mul_mem (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (n : ℕ) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f) :
    qDivPow q n e * x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  refine mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen (fun i a b' c d l => ?_) hx
  rw [M6, ← mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow e n i
    (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi _), smul_mul_assoc]
  exact smul_mem_orderedSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _)
    (M6_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _ _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.square_eq_divided
statement:
private lemma square_eq_divided (t : k) (x : B) (h2 : qInt t 2 ≠ 0) :
    x ^ 2 = qInt t 2 • qDivPow t 2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hh : qFactorial t 2 = qInt t 2 := by simp [qFactorial, qInt]
  simp [qDivPow, hh, smul_smul, h2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_mem_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_mem_all (r s : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q r e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_sum_all hq hqi hpi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ => AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun x _ => ?_
  exact smul_mem_orderedSpan (adjoint_straightening_coeff_mem Λ hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
    (M6_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _ _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_mem (r s : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q r e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_mem_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' r s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.D_mul_qDivPow_e_mem
statement: theorem D_mul_qDivPow_e_mem (r : ℕ) : D * qDivPow q r e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  rw [D_mul_qDivPow_e hq hqi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ => smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) ?_
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | n))
  · simpa [shortMixedAdjoint, M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) r 0 0 0 1 0
  · simp only [shortMixedAdjoint, mul_smul_comm]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem hqΛ (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) (r - 1) 0 1 0 0 0
  · simp only [shortMixedAdjoint, mul_smul_comm]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 3)
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) (r - 2) 1 0 0 0 0
  · simp [shortMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.C_mul_qDivPow_e_mem
statement: theorem C_mul_qDivPow_e_mem (r : ℕ) : C * qDivPow q r e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : q ^ 2 - 1 ∈ Λ := sub_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (one_mem _)
  have hp : q ^ 3 ∈ Λ := pow_mem hqΛ _
  have hp' : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by rw [← inv_pow]; exact pow_mem hqΛ' _
  rw [C_mul_qDivPow_e hq hqi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ => smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) ?_
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | (_ | n)))
  · simpa [squareMixedAdjoint, M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) r 0 0 1 0 0
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, square_eq_divided q b (hqi 2 (by decide)),
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem hq2 (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) (r - 1) 0 2 0 0 0
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, mul_smul_comm]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan
      (mul_mem (mul_mem hq2 (pow_mem hqΛ' _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 3))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) (r - 2) 1 1 0 0 0
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, square_eq_divided (q ^ 3) A (hpi 2 (by decide)),
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem
      (mul_mem (mul_mem hq2 (pow_mem hqΛ' _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 3))
      (B2Integral.qInt_mem hp hp' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) (r - 3) 2 0 0 0 0
  · simp [squareMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_qDivPow_b_mem
statement: theorem f_mul_qDivPow_b_mem (r : ℕ) : f * qDivPow q r b ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : q ^ 2 - 1 ∈ Λ := sub_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (one_mem _)
  have hp : q ^ 3 ∈ Λ := pow_mem hqΛ _
  have hp' : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by rw [← inv_pow]; exact pow_mem hqΛ' _
  rw [f_mul_qDivPow_b hq hqi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ => smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) ?_
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | (_ | n)))
  · simpa [squareMixedAdjoint, M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_assoc] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 r 0 0 1
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, square_eq_divided q D (hqi 2 (by decide)),
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem hq2 (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 (r - 1) 0 2 0
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, mul_smul_comm]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan
      (mul_mem (mul_mem hq2 (pow_mem hqΛ' _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 3))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_assoc] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 (r - 2) 1 1 0
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, square_eq_divided (q ^ 3) C (hpi 2 (by decide)),
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem
      (mul_mem (mul_mem hq2 (pow_mem hqΛ' _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 3))
      (B2Integral.qInt_mem hp hp' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 (r - 3) 2 0 0
  · simp [squareMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_mul_A_mem
statement: theorem qDivPow_D_mul_A_mem (r : ℕ) : qDivPow q r D * A ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : q ^ 2 - 1 ∈ Λ := sub_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (one_mem _)
  have hp : q ^ 3 ∈ Λ := pow_mem hqΛ _
  have hp' : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by rw [← inv_pow]; exact pow_mem hqΛ' _
  rw [qDivPow_D_mul_A hq hqi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ => smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) ?_
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | (_ | n)))
  · simpa [reverseSquareMixedAdjoint, M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 1 0 0 r 0
  · simp only [reverseSquareMixedAdjoint, square_eq_divided q b (hqi 2 (by decide)),
      smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem hq2 (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 2 0 (r - 1) 0
  · simp only [reverseSquareMixedAdjoint, smul_mul_assoc]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan
      (mul_mem (mul_mem hq2 (pow_mem hqΛ' _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 3))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 1 1 (r - 2) 0
  · simp only [reverseSquareMixedAdjoint, square_eq_divided (q ^ 3) C (hpi 2 (by decide)),
      smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem
      (mul_mem (mul_mem hq2 (pow_mem hqΛ' _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 3))
      (B2Integral.qInt_mem hp hp' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 0 2 (r - 3) 0
  · simp [reverseSquareMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_qDivPow_A_mem
statement:
theorem f_mul_qDivPow_A_mem (r : ℕ) :
    f * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r A ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : q ^ 2 - 1 ∈ Λ := sub_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (one_mem _)
  have hp : q ^ 3 ∈ Λ := pow_mem hqΛ _
  have hp' : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by rw [← inv_pow]; exact pow_mem hqΛ' _
  rw [f_mul_qDivPow_A hq (hqi 2 (by decide)) (hqi 3 (by decide)) hpi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ => smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hp hp' _ _ _) ?_
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | n))
  · simpa [longMixedAdjoint, M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 r 0 0 0 1
  · simp only [longMixedAdjoint]
    rw [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]
    apply sub_mem
    · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) hq2)
      simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_assoc] using
        M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
          (D := D) (f := f) 0 (r - 1) 1 0 1 0
    · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (sub_mem (add_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (one_mem _))
      simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
        M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
          (D := D) (f := f) 0 (r - 1) 0 1 0 0
  · simp only [longMixedAdjoint, mul_smul_comm]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (mul_mem hqΛ (pow_mem hq2 _))
      (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 (r - 2) 3 0 0 0
  · simp [longMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_A_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_A_mem (r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) r f * A ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : q ^ 2 - 1 ∈ Λ := sub_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (one_mem _)
  have hp : q ^ 3 ∈ Λ := pow_mem hqΛ _
  have hp' : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by rw [← inv_pow]; exact pow_mem hqΛ' _
  rw [qDivPow_f_mul_A hq (hqi 2 (by decide)) (hqi 3 (by decide)) hpi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ => smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hp hp' _ _ _) ?_
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | n))
  · simpa [reverseLongMixedAdjoint, M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 1 0 0 0 r
  · simp only [reverseLongMixedAdjoint]
    rw [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc]
    apply sub_mem
    · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) hq2)
      simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
        M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
          (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 1 0 1 (r - 1)
    · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (sub_mem (add_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (one_mem _))
      simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
        M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
          (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 0 1 0 (r - 1)
  · simp only [reverseLongMixedAdjoint, smul_mul_assoc]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (mul_mem hqΛ (pow_mem hq2 _))
      (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using
      M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
        (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 0 0 3 (r - 2)
  · simp [reverseLongMixedAdjoint]

name: CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma pbwMonomial_nil (c : Fin ([] : List B).length → ℕ) :
    pbwMonomial T E [] c = 1
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_cons
statement:
lemma pbwMonomial_cons (i : B) (ω : List B) (c : Fin (i :: ω).length → ℕ) :
    pbwMonomial T E (i :: ω) c =
      E i ^ c ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ * T i (pbwMonomial T E ω fun n ↦ c n.succ)
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.rootVector_cons_zero
statement:
lemma rootVector_cons_zero (i : B) (ω : List B) (h : 0 < (i :: ω).length) :
    rootVector T E (i :: ω) 0 h = E i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootVector]

name: CoxeterSystem.rootVector_cons_succ
statement:
lemma rootVector_cons_succ (i : B) (ω : List B) (n : ℕ) (h : n + 1 < (i :: ω).length) :
    rootVector T E (i :: ω) (n + 1) h =
      T i (rootVector T E ω n (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h))
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootVector, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]

name: CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_eq_prod
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_eq_prod (ω : List B) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    pbwMonomial T E ω c =
      (List.ofFn fun n : Fin ω.length ↦ rootVector T E ω n n.2 ^ c n).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih =>
    have h := List.ofFn_succ (f := fun n : Fin (ω.length + 1) ↦ rootVector T E (i :: ω) n n.2 ^ c n)
    rw [pbwMonomial_cons, ih]
    change _ = (List.ofFn fun n : Fin (ω.length + 1) ↦ rootVector T E (i :: ω) n n.2 ^ c n).prod
    rw [h, List.prod_cons, map_list_prod, List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
    apply congrArg List.prod
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext n
    rw [Function.comp_apply, map_pow]
    exact congrArg (· ^ c n.succ) (rootVector_cons_succ T E i ω n _).symm

name: CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing P with
  | nil => exact one_mem P
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [pbwMonomial_cons]
    refine mul_mem (pow_mem ?_ _) ?_
    · rw [← rootVector_cons_zero T E i ω (Nat.succ_pos _)]
      exact h 0 _
    · have h' : ∀ n (hn : n < ω.length), rootVector T E ω n hn ∈ P.comap (T i).toAlgHom := by
        intro n hn
        rw [Subalgebra.mem_comap]
        change T i (rootVector T E ω n hn) ∈ P
        rw [← rootVector_cons_succ T E i ω n (Nat.succ_lt_succ hn)]
        exact h (n + 1) _
      exact ih h' _

name: CoxeterSystem.independent_single_map
statement:
private theorem independent_single_map {k M N J : Type*} [Field k]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    {m : J → M} (hm : LinearIndependent k m) (f : (ℕ →₀ M) →ₗ[k] N)
    (hf : LinearMap.ker f = ⊥) :
    LinearIndependent k
      (f ∘ fun ix : Σ _ : ℕ, J ↦ Finsupp.single ix.1 (m ix.2))
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finsupp.linearIndependent_single (fun _ : ℕ ↦ m) (fun _ ↦ hm)).map' f hf

name: CoxeterSystem.linearIndependent_pbwMonomial
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_pbwMonomial {S : Submodule k A}
    (hS : ∀ (i : B) (f : ℕ →₀ A), (∀ a, f a ∈ S) →
      (f.sum fun a x ↦ E i ^ a * T i x) = 0 → f = 0)
    (ω : List B) (hω : ∀ n c, pbwMonomial T E (ω.drop n) c ∈ S) :
    LinearIndependent k (pbwMonomial T E ω)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil =>
    change LinearIndependent k fun _ : Fin 0 → ℕ ↦ (1 : A)
    exact linearIndependent_unique_iff.2 one_ne_zero
  | cons i ω ih =>
    have ih' : LinearIndependent k (pbwMonomial T E ω) := ih fun n c ↦ hω (n + 1) c
    have hm : ∀ c, pbwMonomial T E ω c ∈ S := hω 1
    set m' : (Fin ω.length → ℕ) → S := fun c ↦ ⟨pbwMonomial T E ω c, hm c⟩ with hm'_def
    have hm' : LinearIndependent k m' := LinearIndependent.of_comp S.subtype ih'
    let Φ : (ℕ →₀ S) →ₗ[k] A :=
      Finsupp.lsum k fun a ↦
        (LinearMap.mulLeft k (E i ^ a)) ∘ₗ (T i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ S.subtype
    have hΦ : LinearMap.ker Φ = ⊥ := by
      rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
      intro g hg
      have h0 := hS i (g.mapRange S.subtype (map_zero _)) (fun a ↦ by simp) (by
        rw [Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index fun a ↦ by simp]
        exact hg)
      ext a
      simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun h0 a
    have h1 : LinearIndependent k
        (Φ ∘ fun ix : Σ _ : ℕ, (Fin ω.length → ℕ) ↦ Finsupp.single ix.1 (m' ix.2)) := by
      exact independent_single_map hm' Φ hΦ
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun c : Fin (i :: ω).length → ℕ ↦
        (⟨c ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩, fun n ↦ c n.succ⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, (Fin ω.length → ℕ)) := by
      intro c c' h
      simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq] at h
      funext n
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) n
      · exact h.1
      · exact congr_fun h.2 j
    convert h1.comp _ hinj using 1
    funext c
    simp [Φ, m', pbwMonomial_cons]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomial_commuting_eq
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_commuting_eq
    (Hi : HasBraidGeneratorImages i (T i).toAlgHom)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) (c : Fin [i, j].length → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j] c =
      E R v i ^ c 0 * E R v j ^ c 1
proof:
:= by
  have hE : (T i) (E R v j) = E R v j := by
    change (T i).toAlgHom (E R v j) = _
    rw [Hi.map_E, ite_eq_right hij.symm, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0]
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial, map_pow, map_one, mul_one]
  exact congrArg (fun x ↦ E R v i ^ c 0 * x ^ c 1) hE

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_commuting_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_commuting_braid
    (Hi : HasBraidGeneratorImages i (T i).toAlgHom)
    (Hj : HasBraidGeneratorImages j (T j).toAlgHom)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j])) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
  have hc := E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (R := R) (v := v) h0
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨![c 1, c 0], ?_⟩
    rw [pbwMonomial_commuting_eq R v T Hj hij.symm h0',
      pbwMonomial_commuting_eq R v T Hi hij h0]
    exact (hc.pow_pow (c 0) (c 1)).eq.symm
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨![c 1, c 0], ?_⟩
    rw [pbwMonomial_commuting_eq R v T Hi hij h0,
      pbwMonomial_commuting_eq R v T Hj hij.symm h0']
    exact (hc.pow_pow (c 1) (c 0)).eq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_commuting_context
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_commuting_context
    (Hi : HasBraidGeneratorImages i (T i).toAlgHom)
    (Hj : HasBraidGeneratorImages j (T j).toAlgHom)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
      (p ++ [i, j] ++ s))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
        (p ++ [j, i] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  apply CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_context T (E R v)
    (span_pbwMonomial_commuting_braid R v T Hi Hj hij h0)
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one]
    using Hi.equiv_comm Hj hij h0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_commuting_context_of_not_root
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_commuting_context_of_not_root [NeZero v]
    (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [i, j] ++ s))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [j, i] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  have H (l : I) : HasBraidGeneratorImages l
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' l).toAlgHom :=
    braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages
      (braidGeneric_of_braidSerreGeneric (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' l).sub_ne
        (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv' l))
      (transformedSerre_of_braidSerreGeneric
        (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' l).sub_ne (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv' l))
  exact span_pbwMonomial_commuting_context R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')
    (H i) (H j) hij h0 p s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_mul_X
statement:
lemma shift_pow_mul_X (x : R) (n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    (shift x ^ n) (X * F) = x ^ n • (X * (shift x ^ n) F)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shift_pow_apply, mul_comp, X_comp, smul_eq_C_mul]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_newtonOp
statement:
lemma shift_newtonOp (x : R) (j n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    shift x (newtonOp x j n F) = newtonOp x j n (shift x F)
proof:
:= by
  have hc (H : R[X]) : shift x ((shift x ^ 3) H) = (shift x ^ 3) (shift x H) :=
    congrArg (fun T : Module.End R R[X] ↦ T H) (Commute.self_pow (shift x) 3).eq
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [newtonOp_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [newtonOp_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_sub, map_smul, hc, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_newtonOp
statement:
lemma shift_pow_newtonOp (x : R) (j n k : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    (shift x ^ k) (newtonOp x j n F) = newtonOp x j n ((shift x ^ k) F)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, shift_newtonOp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_succ_start_mul_X
statement:
lemma newtonOp_succ_start_mul_X (x : R) (j t : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    newtonOp x (j + 1) t (X * F) = x ^ (3 * t) • (X * newtonOp x j t F)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [newtonOp_zero]
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [newtonOp_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, ih, map_smul, shift_pow_mul_X]
    simp only [smul_eq_C_mul, show 3 * (t + 1) = 3 * t + 3 by omega,
      show 3 * (j + 1 + t) = 3 * (j + t) + 3 by omega, pow_add, map_mul]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_mul_X
statement:
lemma newtonOp_mul_X (x : R) (t : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    newtonOp x 0 (t + 1) (X * F) =
      x ^ (3 * t) • (X * (x ^ 3 • ((shift x ^ 3) (newtonOp x 0 t F)) -
        newtonOp x 0 t F))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show t + 1 = 1 + t by omega, newtonOp_add]
  simp only [zero_add, Module.End.mul_apply]
  have hfirst : newtonOp x 0 1 (X * F) = X * (x ^ 3 • ((shift x ^ 3) F) - F) := by
    rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 from rfl, newtonOp_succ, newtonOp_zero]
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      zero_add, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, shift_pow_mul_X,
      smul_eq_C_mul]
    ring
  rw [hfirst, newtonOp_succ_start_mul_X x 0 t]
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, ← shift_pow_newtonOp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonPolynomial_dilation
statement:
theorem newtonPolynomial_dilation (t : ℕ) :
    (1 + X) * (newtonPolynomial (t + 1)).comp (C (X : ℤ[X]) * X) =
      (1 + C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1))) * X) * newtonPolynomial (t + 1) +
        C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t)) *
          (C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1))) - 1) * X * newtonPolynomial t
proof:
:= by
  change shift (X : ℤ[X]) (newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 (t + 1) 1) = _
  rw [shift_newtonOp]
  simp only [shift_apply, one_comp, mul_one, map_add]
  have hx := newtonOp_mul_X (X : ℤ[X]) t (1 : ℤ[X][X])
  rw [mul_one] at hx
  rw [hx]
  have hs : (shift (X : ℤ[X]) ^ 3) (newtonPolynomial t) =
      newtonPolynomial (t + 1) + (X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t) • newtonPolynomial t := by
    simp only [newtonPolynomial, newtonOp_succ, Module.End.mul_apply,
      LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, zero_add]
    abel
  change newtonPolynomial (t + 1) +
    (X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t) • (X * ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ 3 •
      ((shift (X : ℤ[X]) ^ 3) (newtonPolynomial t)) - newtonPolynomial t)) = _
  rw [hs]
  simp only [smul_eq_C_mul, show 3 * (t + 1) = 3 * t + 3 by omega, pow_add, map_mul]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonCoeff_recurrence
statement:
theorem newtonCoeff_recurrence (n t : ℕ) :
    ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (n + 1) - 1) * newtonCoeff (n + 1) (t + 1) =
      ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1)) - (X : ℤ[X]) ^ n) * newtonCoeff n (t + 1) +
        (X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t) * ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1)) - 1) * newtonCoeff n t
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg (fun F : ℤ[X][X] ↦ F.coeff (n + 1)) (newtonPolynomial_dilation t)
  simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, one_mul, coeff_add, coeff_sub, coeff_X_mul,
    comp_C_mul_X_coeff, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul] at hc
  unfold newtonCoeff
  linear_combination hc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonCoeff_gaussian_recurrence
statement:
theorem newtonCoeff_gaussian_recurrence (n t : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 3 * (t + 1)) :
    gaussian (n + 1) * newtonCoeff (n + 1) (t + 1) =
      (X : ℤ[X]) ^ n * gaussian (3 * (t + 1) - n) * newtonCoeff n (t + 1) +
        (X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t) * gaussian (3 * (t + 1)) * newtonCoeff n t
proof:
:= by
  have hg (m : ℕ) : gaussian m * ((X : ℤ[X]) - 1) = X ^ m - 1 :=
    geom_sum_mul X m
  have he : (X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1)) =
      X ^ n * X ^ (3 * (t + 1) - n) := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hn]
  have hz : (X : ℤ[X]) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using (X_sub_C_ne_zero (1 : ℤ))
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hz
  have hrec := newtonCoeff_recurrence n t
  rw [← hg (n + 1), ← hg (3 * (t + 1))] at hrec
  have hd : (X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1)) - X ^ n =
      X ^ n * (gaussian (3 * (t + 1) - n) * (X - 1)) := by
    rw [hg, he]
    ring
  rw [hd] at hrec
  linear_combination hrec

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.progressionProduct_zero
statement: lemma progressionProduct_zero (k : ℕ) : progressionProduct k 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [progressionProduct]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.progressionProduct_succ
statement:
lemma progressionProduct_succ (k n : ℕ) :
    progressionProduct k (n + 1) = progressionProduct k n * gaussian (k * (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [progressionProduct, prod_range_succ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonCoeff_zero_succ
statement: lemma newtonCoeff_zero_succ (t : ℕ) : newtonCoeff 0 (t + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [newtonCoeff, newtonPolynomial_succ, newtonPolynomial_zero]
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [newtonCoeff, newtonPolynomial_succ, coeff_sub, mul_coeff_zero,
      coeff_add, coeff_one_zero, coeff_X_zero, coeff_C_zero, comp_C_mul_X_coeff,
      pow_zero, mul_one, add_zero] at *
    rw [ih]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: lemma newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt (n t : ℕ) (h : n < t) : newtonCoeff n t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing t with
  | zero => obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : t ≠ 0)
            exact newtonCoeff_zero_succ t
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : t ≠ 0)
    have hr := newtonCoeff_gaussian_recurrence n t (by omega)
    rw [ih (t + 1) (by omega), ih t (by omega), mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hr
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hr).resolve_left (gaussian_ne_zero (n + 1) (by omega))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_gt
statement: lemma newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_gt (n t : ℕ) (h : 3 * t < n) : newtonCoeff n t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing t with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    cases t with
    | zero => simp [newtonCoeff, newtonPolynomial_zero, coeff_one]
    | succ t =>
      have hr := newtonCoeff_recurrence n t
      rw [ih t (by omega), mul_zero, add_zero] at hr
      have hz : ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * (t + 1)) - X ^ n) * newtonCoeff n (t + 1) = 0 := by
        by_cases he : n = 3 * (t + 1)
        · rw [he, sub_self, zero_mul]
        · rw [ih (t + 1) (by omega), mul_zero]
      rw [hz] at hr
      have hn : (X : ℤ[X]) ^ (n + 1) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro he
        have hc := congrArg (fun p : ℤ[X] ↦ p.coeff (n + 1)) he
        simp [coeff_one] at hc
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hr).resolve_left hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
lemma squarePolynomial_eq_zero (n t : ℕ) (h : ¬ (t ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 3 * t)) :
    squarePolynomial n t = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [squarePolynomial, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_spec_all
statement:
lemma squarePolynomial_spec_all (n t : ℕ) :
    progressionProduct 3 t * squarePolynomial n t =
      progressionProduct 1 (3 * t - n) * progressionProduct 3 (n - t) * newtonCoeff n t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : t ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 3 * t
  · exact squarePolynomial_spec n t h.1 h.2
  · rw [squarePolynomial_eq_zero n t h]
    have hz : newtonCoeff n t = 0 := by
      by_cases hnt : n < t
      · exact newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt n t hnt
      · exact newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_gt n t (by omega)
    rw [hz, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_zero_zero
statement: lemma squarePolynomial_zero_zero : squarePolynomial 0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply squarePolynomial_unique 0 0 (by omega) (by omega)
  simp [progressionProduct_zero, newtonCoeff, newtonPolynomial_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_recurrence_first
statement:
lemma squarePolynomial_recurrence_first (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n)
    (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t + 2) :
    progressionProduct 1 (3 * t + 2 - n) * progressionProduct 3 (n - t) *
        gaussian (3 * (t + 1) - n) * newtonCoeff n (t + 1) =
      progressionProduct 3 (t + 1) * gaussian (3 * (n - t)) *
        squarePolynomial n (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : n = t
  · subst n
    rw [newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt t (t + 1) (by omega)]
    simp [gaussian]
  · have ha : n - t = (n - (t + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    have hb : 3 * (t + 1) - n = (3 * t + 2 - n) + 1 := by omega
    have hs := squarePolynomial_spec_all n (t + 1)
    rw [hb, progressionProduct_succ 1, one_mul] at hs
    rw [ha, progressionProduct_succ 3 (n - (t + 1))]
    rw [hb]
    linear_combination -gaussian (3 * (n - (t + 1) + 1)) * hs

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_recurrence_second
statement:
lemma squarePolynomial_recurrence_second (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n) :
    progressionProduct 1 (3 * t + 2 - n) * progressionProduct 3 (n - t) *
        gaussian (3 * (t + 1)) * newtonCoeff n t =
      progressionProduct 3 (t + 1) * gaussian (3 * t + 2 - n) *
        gaussian (3 * t + 1 - n) * squarePolynomial n t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : n ≤ 3 * t
  · have hb : 3 * t + 2 - n = (3 * t - n) + 1 + 1 := by omega
    have hb' : 3 * t + 1 - n = (3 * t - n) + 1 := by omega
    have hs := squarePolynomial_spec n t htn he
    rw [hb, hb', progressionProduct_succ, progressionProduct_succ,
      progressionProduct_succ]
    simp only [one_mul]
    linear_combination -gaussian (3 * (t + 1)) * gaussian (3 * t - n + 1 + 1) *
      gaussian (3 * t - n + 1) * hs
  · rw [newtonCoeff_eq_zero_of_gt n t (by omega),
      squarePolynomial_eq_zero n t (by omega), mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_recurrence
statement:
theorem squarePolynomial_recurrence (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n)
    (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t + 2) :
    gaussian (n + 1) * squarePolynomial (n + 1) (t + 1) =
      (X : ℤ[X]) ^ n * gaussian (3 * (n - t)) * squarePolynomial n (t + 1) +
        X ^ (3 * t) * gaussian (3 * t + 2 - n) * gaussian (3 * t + 1 - n) *
          squarePolynomial n t
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (progressionProduct_ne_zero 3 (t + 1) (by decide))
  have hs := squarePolynomial_spec (n + 1) (t + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [show 3 * (t + 1) - (n + 1) = 3 * t + 2 - n by omega,
    show n + 1 - (t + 1) = n - t by omega] at hs
  have hr := newtonCoeff_gaussian_recurrence n t (by omega)
  have h₁ := squarePolynomial_recurrence_first n t htn hnt
  have h₂ := squarePolynomial_recurrence_second n t htn
  linear_combination gaussian (n + 1) * hs +
    progressionProduct 1 (3 * t + 2 - n) * progressionProduct 3 (n - t) * hr +
    X ^ n * h₁ + X ^ (3 * t) * h₂

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qInt_add
statement: lemma qInt_add (a b : ℕ) : t⁻¹ ^ b * qInt t a + t ^ a * qInt t b = qInt t (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp [qInt]
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, qInt_succ, qInt_succ, ← ih]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.straighten_param
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [sCoefParam, qDivPow_zero']
  | succ r ih =>
    have hc := hti (r + 1) (Nat.succ_pos r)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    have hL : qInt t (r + 1) • (W 0 * qDivPow t (r + 1) a) = W 0 * qDivPow t r a * a := by
      rw [mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self a r hc, mul_smul_comm]
    have hT : ∀ n ∈ range (r + 1), sCoefParam t u r n • (qDivPow t (r - n) a * W n) * a =
        (sCoefParam t u r n * (u * t⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) * qInt t (r - n + 1)) •
            (qDivPow t (r + 1 - n) a * W n) -
          (sCoefParam t u r n * qInt t (n + 1)) • (qDivPow t (r - n) a * W (n + 1)) := by
      intro n hn
      have hnr : n ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hn)
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hW, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
        A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self a _ (hti _ (Nat.succ_pos _)),
        show r - n + 1 = r + 1 - n by omega, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul,
        smul_smul, mul_assoc (sCoefParam t u r n)]
    rw [hL, ih, sum_mul, sum_congr rfl hT, sum_sub_distrib, smul_sum,
      sum_range_succ (fun n ↦ (sCoefParam t u r n * qInt t (n + 1)) •
        (qDivPow t (r - n) a * W (n + 1))) r,
      sum_range_succ' (fun n ↦ (sCoefParam t u r n * (u * t⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) * qInt t (r - n + 1)) •
        (qDivPow t (r + 1 - n) a * W n)) r,
      sum_range_succ' _ (r + 1), sum_range_succ _ r]
    have hmid : ∀ n ∈ range r,
        qInt t (r + 1) • (sCoefParam t u (r + 1) (n + 1) •
            (qDivPow t (r + 1 - (n + 1)) a * W (n + 1))) =
          (sCoefParam t u r (n + 1) * (u * t⁻¹ ^ (2 * (n + 1))) * qInt t (r - (n + 1) + 1)) •
              (qDivPow t (r + 1 - (n + 1)) a * W (n + 1)) -
            (sCoefParam t u r n * qInt t (n + 1)) • (qDivPow t (r - n) a * W (n + 1)) := by
      intro n hn
      have hnr : n < r := mem_range.1 hn
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, r = n + 1 + c := ⟨r - (n + 1), by omega⟩
      rw [show n + 1 + c + 1 - (n + 1) = c + 1 by omega, show n + 1 + c - n = c + 1 by omega,
        show n + 1 + c - (n + 1) + 1 = c + 1 by omega, smul_smul, ← sub_smul]
      congr 1
      have key := qInt_add (t := t) (c + 1) (n + 1)
      have hinv : t⁻¹ ^ (c + 1) * t ^ (c + 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0, one_pow]
      simp only [sCoefParam, show n + 1 + c + 1 - (n + 1) = c + 1 by omega,
        show n + 1 + c - (n + 1) = c by omega, show n + 1 + c - n = c + 1 by omega]
      rw [show n + 1 + c + 1 = c + 1 + (n + 1) by omega, ← key]
      linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (-((-1) ^ n * u ^ (c + 1) * t⁻¹ ^ (n * (c + 1)) *
        qInt t (n + 1))) * hinv
    rw [sum_congr rfl hmid, sum_sub_distrib]
    have h0 : qInt t (r + 1) • (sCoefParam t u (r + 1) 0 • (qDivPow t (r + 1 - 0) a * W 0)) =
        (sCoefParam t u r 0 * (u * t⁻¹ ^ (2 * 0)) * qInt t (r - 0 + 1)) •
          (qDivPow t (r + 1 - 0) a * W 0) := by
      rw [smul_smul]
      congr 1
      simp only [sCoefParam, pow_zero, Nat.sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, mul_one, pow_add]
      ring
    have hlast : qInt t (r + 1) • (sCoefParam t u (r + 1) (r + 1) •
        (qDivPow t (r + 1 - (r + 1)) a * W (r + 1))) =
        -((sCoefParam t u r r * qInt t (r + 1)) • (qDivPow t (r - r) a * W (r + 1))) := by
      rw [smul_smul, Nat.sub_self, Nat.sub_self, ← neg_smul]
      congr 1
      simp only [sCoefParam, Nat.sub_self, mul_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [h0, hlast]
    abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.straighten
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sCoef, sCoefParam, pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm] using
    straighten_param ht0 hti (t ^ N) hW r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.fe
statement: lemma fe : f * e = q ^ 2 • (e * f) - q ^ 2 • y
proof: := H.fe

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.ye
statement: lemma ye : y * e = e * y - qInt q 2 • X
proof: := H.ye

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.Xe
statement: lemma Xe : X * e = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ • (e * X)
proof:
:= by
  have h := H.xe
  rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_comm, ← smul_smul] at h
  exact smul_right_injective B (hqi 2 (by norm_num)) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.fy
statement: lemma fy : f * y = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ • (y * f)
proof: := H.fy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.yX
statement: lemma yX : y * X = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ • (X * y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := H.yx (pow_ne_zero 2 hq0)
  rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm] at h
  exact smul_right_injective B (hqi 2 (by norm_num)) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.fX
statement: lemma fX : f * X = X * f - (q ^ 2 - 1) • qDivPow q 2 y
proof:
:= by
  have h := H.fx (pow_ne_zero 2 hq0)
  have hy : y * y = qInt q 2 • qDivPow q 2 y := by
    rw [← A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self y 1 (hqi 2 (by norm_num)), A2Integral.qDivPow_one']
  rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, hy, smul_comm (q ^ 2 - 1), ← smul_sub] at h
  exact smul_right_injective B (hqi 2 (by norm_num)) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qInt_two_mul
statement: lemma qInt_two_mul (b : ℕ) : qInt q 2 * qInt (q ^ 2) b = qInt q (2 * b)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : qInt q 2 = q + q⁻¹ := by simp [qInt, sum_range_succ]
  induction b with
  | zero => simp [qInt]
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (b + 1) = 2 * b + 1 + 1 by ring, qInt_succ (v := q) (2 * b + 1),
      qInt_succ (v := q) (2 * b), ← ih, qInt_succ (v := q ^ 2) b, h2]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qBinomial_two_add
statement:
lemma qBinomial_two_add (h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0) (hF : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0) (b : ℕ) :
    qBinomial q (2 * b + 2) (2 * b) = qInt (q ^ 2) (b + 1) * qInt q (2 * b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have e := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q)
    (show 2 * b ≤ 2 * b + 2 by omega)
  have h2' : qFactorial q 2 = qInt q 2 := by simp [qFactorial, qInt]
  have hF2 : qFactorial q (2 * b + 2) =
      qInt q (2 * b + 1 + 1) * (qInt q (2 * b + 1) * qFactorial q (2 * b)) := by
    rw [qFactorial_succ, qFactorial_succ]
  rw [show 2 * b + 2 - 2 * b = 2 by omega, h2', hF2] at e
  have hm := qInt_two_mul (q := q) (b + 1)
  rw [show 2 * (b + 1) = 2 * b + 1 + 1 by ring] at hm
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero h2 (hF (2 * b)))
  linear_combination e - qInt q (2 * b + 1) * qFactorial q (2 * b) * hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm
statement:
lemma qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm {u u' c : k} {w a : B} (h : w * a = c • (a * w)) (m n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow u m w * qDivPow u' n a = c ^ (m * n) • (qDivPow u' n a * qDivPow u m w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm, pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul h m n, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.Xd_e
statement:
lemma Xd_e (b : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X * e = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ b • (e * qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using
    qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm (u := q ^ 2) (u' := q) (Xe hqi H) b 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.yd_Xd
statement:
lemma yd_Xd (c b : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q c y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X =
      (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (c * b) • (qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X * qDivPow q c y)
proof:
:=
  qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm (yX hq0 hqi H) c b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.fd_yd
statement:
lemma fd_yd (d c : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f * qDivPow q c y =
      (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (d * c) • (qDivPow q c y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f)
proof:
:=
  qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm (fy H) d c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.yd_e
statement:
lemma yd_e (c : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q (c + 1) y * e =
      e * qDivPow q (c + 1) y - (q⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q 2) • (X * qDivPow q c y)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => simp [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero', ye H]
  | succ c ih =>
    have hc : qInt q (c + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt q (c + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    have h1 : qInt q (c + 1 + 1) • (qDivPow q (c + 1 + 1) y * e) =
        y * (qDivPow q (c + 1) y * e) := by
      rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow q y (c + 1) hc, mul_assoc]
    rw [h1, ih, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ye H, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc y X, yX hq0 hqi H]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow q y (c + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow q y c hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q) (c + 1)]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try simp only [inv_pow])
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.fd_e
statement:
lemma fd_e (D : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 2) (D + 1) f * e =
      (q ^ 2) ^ (D + 1) • (e * qDivPow (q ^ 2) (D + 1) f) - q ^ 2 • (y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) D f)
proof:
:= by
  induction D with
  | zero => simp [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero', fe H]
  | succ D ih =>
    have hc : qInt (q ^ 2) (D + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt (q ^ 2) (D + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow (q ^ 2) f (D + 1) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc f e, fe H, ← mul_assoc f y, fy H]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow (q ^ 2) f (D + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow (q ^ 2) f D hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q ^ 2) (D + 1)]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.fd_X
statement:
lemma fd_X (D : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 2) (D + 1) f * X = X * qDivPow (q ^ 2) (D + 1) f -
      ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ D) • (qDivPow q 2 y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) D f)
proof:
:= by
  induction D with
  | zero => simp [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero', fX hq0 hqi H]
  | succ D ih =>
    have hc : qInt (q ^ 2) (D + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt (q ^ 2) (D + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    have hfy2 : f * qDivPow q 2 y = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (qDivPow q 2 y * f) := by
      simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using fd_yd (q := q) H 1 2
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow (q ^ 2) f (D + 1) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc f X, fX hq0 hqi H, ← mul_assoc f, hfy2]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow (q ^ 2) f (D + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow (q ^ 2) f D hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q ^ 2) (D + 1)]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try simp only [inv_pow])
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.M3_congr
statement:
lemma M3_congr {q : k} {X y f : B} {b c d b' c' d' : ℕ} (hb : b = b') (hc : c = c')
    (hd : d = d') : M3 q X y f b c d = M3 q X y f b' c' d'
proof:
:= by
  subst hb hc hd; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.M3_e
statement:
lemma M3_e (b c d : ℕ) :
    M3 q X y f b c d * e = ((q ^ 2) ^ d * (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ b) • (e * M3 q X y f b c d) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else ((q ^ 2) ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q 2 * qInt (q ^ 2) (b + 1)) •
        M3 q X y f (b + 1) (c - 1) d) -
      (if d = 0 then 0 else (q ^ 2 * qInt q (c + 1)) • M3 q X y f b (c + 1) (d - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hXX : qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X * X = qInt (q ^ 2) (b + 1) • qDivPow (q ^ 2) (b + 1) X :=
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self X b (hpi _ (by omega))
  have hyy : qDivPow q c y * y = qInt q (c + 1) • qDivPow q (c + 1) y :=
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self y c (hqi _ (by omega))
  have hYe : qDivPow q c y * e = e * qDivPow q c y -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else (q⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q 2) • (X * qDivPow q (c - 1) y)) := by
    rcases c with _ | c
    · simp [qDivPow_zero']
    · simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact yd_e hq0 hqi H c
  have hFe : qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f * e = (q ^ 2) ^ d • (e * qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f) -
      (if d = 0 then 0 else q ^ 2 • (y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d - 1) f)) := by
    rcases d with _ | d
    · simp [qDivPow_zero']
    · simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact fd_e hq0 hpi H d
  have hXe := Xd_e hqi H b
  simp only [M3]
  set P := qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X
  set Q := qDivPow q c y
  set F := qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f
  have h1 : P * Q * F * e = (q ^ 2) ^ d • (P * (Q * e) * F) - P * Q *
      (if d = 0 then 0 else q ^ 2 • (y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d - 1) f)) := by
    rw [mul_assoc (P * Q) F e, hFe, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc (P * Q) e F,
      mul_assoc P Q e]
  have h2 : P * (Q * e) * F = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ b • (e * (P * Q * F)) - P *
      (if c = 0 then 0 else (q⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q 2) • (X * qDivPow q (c - 1) y)) * F := by
    rw [hYe, mul_sub, sub_mul, ← mul_assoc P e Q, hXe, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have h3 : P * (if c = 0 then 0 else (q⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q 2) • (X * qDivPow q (c - 1) y)) *
      F = if c = 0 then 0 else (q⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q 2 * qInt (q ^ 2) (b + 1)) •
        (qDivPow (q ^ 2) (b + 1) X * qDivPow q (c - 1) y * F) := by
    split_ifs
    · simp
    · rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc P X, hXX, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc,
        smul_smul]
  have h4 : P * Q * (if d = 0 then 0 else q ^ 2 • (y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d - 1) f)) =
      if d = 0 then 0 else (q ^ 2 * qInt q (c + 1)) • (P * qDivPow q (c + 1) y *
        qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d - 1) f) := by
    split_ifs
    · simp
    · rw [mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc P Q y, hyy, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
        smul_smul]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  split_ifs <;> module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.Wt_e
statement:
lemma Wt_e (n s m : ℕ) :
    Wt q X y f n s m * e = (q ^ (2 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * Wt q X y f n s m) -
      At q X y f n s m - Bt q X y f n s m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Wt, At, Bt]
  by_cases hv : n ≤ 2 * m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m ≤ s
  · rw [ite_eq_left hv, smul_mul_assoc, M3_e hq0 hqi hpi H, mul_smul_comm]
    have hlam : (q ^ 2) ^ (s - m) * (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (n - m) = q ^ (2 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) := by
      obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ : ∃ s', s = m + s' := ⟨s - m, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = m + n' := ⟨n - m, by omega⟩
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      have h1 : q ^ (2 * m) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * m) = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, one_pow]
      linear_combination (-(q ^ (2 * s') * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n'))) * h1
    rw [hlam]
    split_ifs <;> first
      | (exfalso; omega)
      | (simp only [smul_sub, sub_zero, smul_smul]; module)
  · rw [ite_eq_right hv, ite_eq_right (show ¬ (n ≤ 2 * m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m ≤ s ∧ n < 2 * m) by omega),
      ite_eq_right (show ¬ (n ≤ 2 * m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m < s) by omega)]
    simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.At_add_Bt
statement:
lemma At_add_Bt (n s m : ℕ) (hm : m < s) :
    At q X y f n s (m + 1) + Bt q X y f n s m = qInt q (n + 1) • Wt q X y f (n + 1) s (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [At, Bt, Wt]
  by_cases hA : n ≤ 2 * (m + 1) ∧ m + 1 ≤ n ∧ m + 1 ≤ s ∧ n < 2 * (m + 1)
  · rw [ite_eq_left hA, ite_eq_left (show n + 1 ≤ 2 * (m + 1) ∧ m + 1 ≤ n + 1 ∧ m + 1 ≤ s by omega),
      M3_congr (b := n - (m + 1) + 1) (c := 2 * (m + 1) - n - 1) (d := s - (m + 1))
        (b' := n + 1 - (m + 1)) (c' := 2 * (m + 1) - (n + 1)) (d' := s - (m + 1))
        (by omega) (by omega) rfl]
    by_cases hB : n ≤ 2 * m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m < s
    · rw [ite_eq_left hB, M3_congr (b := n - m) (c := 2 * m - n + 1) (d := s - m - 1)
        (b' := n + 1 - (m + 1)) (c' := 2 * (m + 1) - (n + 1)) (d' := s - (m + 1))
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega), ← add_smul, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      obtain ⟨β, γ, D, hn, hm', hs⟩ : ∃ β γ D, n = 2 * β + γ + 2 ∧ m = β + γ + 1 ∧
          s = D + β + γ + 2 := ⟨n - m - 1, 2 * m - n, s - m - 1, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
      rw [show n - (m + 1) = β by omega, show s - (m + 1) = D by omega,
        show 2 * (m + 1) - n - 1 = γ + 1 by omega, show n - m = β + 1 by omega,
        show s - m = D + 1 by omega, show 2 * m - n + 1 = γ + 1 by omega,
        show n + 1 - (m + 1) = β + 1 by omega, hm', hn,
        show 2 * β + γ + 2 + 1 = 2 * β + 2 + (γ + 1) by ring]
      have key1 := qInt_add (t := q) (2 * β + 2) (γ + 1)
      have key2 := qInt_two_mul (q := q) (β + 1)
      rw [show 2 * (β + 1) = 2 * β + 2 by ring] at key2
      linear_combination (q ^ (2 * (β * D) + 2 * (β + γ + 1 + 1)) * (q ^ 2) ^ D * q⁻¹ ^ (γ + 1)) *
        key2 + q ^ (2 * ((β + 1) * D) + 2 * (β + γ + 1 + 1)) * key1
    · rw [ite_eq_right hB, add_zero, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      obtain ⟨D, hn, hs⟩ : ∃ D, n = 2 * m + 1 ∧ s = D + m + 1 := ⟨s - m - 1, by omega, by omega⟩
      rw [show n - (m + 1) = m by omega, show s - (m + 1) = D by omega,
        show 2 * (m + 1) - n - 1 = 0 by omega, show n + 1 - (m + 1) = m + 1 by omega, hn,
        show 2 * m + 1 + 1 = 2 * (m + 1) by ring, ← qInt_two_mul (q := q) (m + 1)]
      ring
  · by_cases hB : n ≤ 2 * m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m < s
    · rw [ite_eq_right hA, ite_eq_left hB,
        ite_eq_left (show n + 1 ≤ 2 * (m + 1) ∧ m + 1 ≤ n + 1 ∧ m + 1 ≤ s by
        omega), zero_add, M3_congr (b := n - m) (c := 2 * m - n + 1) (d := s - m - 1)
        (b' := n + 1 - (m + 1)) (c' := 2 * (m + 1) - (n + 1)) (d' := s - (m + 1))
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega), smul_smul]
      congr 1
      obtain ⟨D, hn, hs⟩ : ∃ D, n = m ∧ s = D + m + 1 := ⟨s - m - 1, by omega, by omega⟩
      rw [show n - m = 0 by omega, show 2 * m - n + 1 = m + 1 by omega,
        show n + 1 - (m + 1) = 0 by omega, hn]
      ring
    · rw [ite_eq_right hA, ite_eq_right hB,
        ite_eq_right (show ¬ (n + 1 ≤ 2 * (m + 1) ∧ m + 1 ≤ n + 1 ∧ m + 1 ≤ s) by omega)]
      simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.W_e
statement:
lemma W_e (n s : ℕ) :
    W q X y f n s * e = (q ^ (2 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * W q X y f n s) -
      qInt q (n + 1) • W q X y f (n + 1) s
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ m ∈ range (s + 1), (At q X y f n s m + Bt q X y f n s m) =
      qInt q (n + 1) • W q X y f (n + 1) s := by
    have hA0 : At q X y f n s 0 = 0 := by simp [At]
    have hBs : Bt q X y f n s s = 0 := by simp [Bt]
    have hW0 : Wt q X y f (n + 1) s 0 = 0 := by simp [Wt]
    rw [sum_add_distrib, W, smul_sum, sum_range_succ' (At q X y f n s),
      sum_range_succ (Bt q X y f n s),
      sum_range_succ' (fun m ↦ qInt q (n + 1) • Wt q X y f (n + 1) s m), hA0, hBs, hW0, smul_zero,
      add_zero, add_zero, add_zero, ← sum_add_distrib]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ At_add_Bt n s m (mem_range.1 hm)
  rw [W, sum_mul, sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ Wt_e hq0 hqi hpi H n s m, sum_sub_distrib,
    sum_sub_distrib, ← smul_sum, ← mul_sum, sub_sub, ← sum_add_distrib, hsum]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.W_zero
statement: lemma W_zero (s : ℕ) : W q X y f 0 s = qDivPow (q ^ 2) s f
proof:
:= by
  rw [W, sum_range_succ', sum_eq_zero fun m _ ↦ by simp [Wt]]
  simp [Wt, M3, qDivPow_zero']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 2) s f * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), sCoef q (2 * s) r n • (qDivPow q (r - n) e * W q X y f n s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← W_zero (q := q) (X := X) (y := y) s]
  exact straighten hq0 hqi (2 * s) (W := fun n ↦ W q X y f n s)
    (fun n ↦ W_e hq0 hqi hpi H n s) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.V_X
statement:
lemma V_X (s n : ℕ) :
    V q y f s n * X = ((q ^ 2) ^ 0 * (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (X * V q y f s n) -
      qInt (q ^ 2) (n + 1) • V q y f s (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hyX (c : ℕ) : qDivPow q c y * X = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ c • (X * qDivPow q c y) := by
    simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using yd_Xd hq0 hqi H c 1
  have hF := A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi
  rcases lt_trichotomy n s with h | rfl | h
  · obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D, s - n = D + 1 := ⟨s - n - 1, by omega⟩
    simp only [V, ite_eq_left h.le, ite_eq_left (show n + 1 ≤ s by omega), hD,
      show s - (n + 1) = D by omega]
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, fd_X hq0 hqi hpi H D, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, hyX,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc (qDivPow q (2 * n) y), A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow y _ _
        (hF _), qBinomial_two_add (hqi 2 (by norm_num)) hF,
      show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 by ring]
    simp only [nu, prod_range_succ, show s - 1 - n = D by omega, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
      mul_assoc]
    module
  · simp only [V, le_refl, ite_true, Nat.sub_self, qDivPow_zero', mul_one,
      show ¬ n + 1 ≤ n by omega, ite_false, smul_zero, sub_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, hyX, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]
  · simp [V, show ¬ n ≤ s by omega, show ¬ n + 1 ≤ s by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.V_zero
statement: lemma V_zero (s : ℕ) : V q y f s 0 = qDivPow (q ^ 2) s f
proof:
:= by
  simp [V, nu, qDivPow_zero']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_X
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_X (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 2) s f * qDivPow (q ^ 2) r X =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), sCoef (q ^ 2) 0 r n • (qDivPow (q ^ 2) (r - n) X * V q y f s n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← V_zero (q := q) (y := y) s]
  exact straighten (pow_ne_zero 2 hq0) hpi 0 (W := fun n ↦ V q y f s n)
    (fun n ↦ V_X hq0 hqi hpi H s n) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan
statement:
lemma smul_mem_orderedSpan {c : k} (hc : c ∈ Λ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f) :
    c • x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c', hc', a, b, c'', d, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c * c', mul_mem hc hc', a, b, c'', d, by rw [smul_smul]⟩
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.M4_mem_orderedSpan
statement: lemma M4_mem_orderedSpan (a b c d : ℕ) : M4 q e X y f a b c d ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨1, one_mem _, a, b, c, d, by rw [one_smul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.one_mem_orderedSpan
statement: lemma one_mem_orderedSpan : (1 : B) ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  simpa [M4, M3, qDivPow_zero'] using M4_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (X := X)
    (y := y) (f := f) 0 0 0 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact smul_mem_orderedSpan hc (hz a b c' d)
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [mul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qInt_mem
statement: lemma qInt_mem {t : k} (ht : t ∈ Λ) (ht' : t⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (n : ℕ) : qInt t n ∈ Λ
proof:
:=
  sum_mem fun _ _ ↦ mul_mem (pow_mem ht _) (pow_mem ht' _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.sCoef_mem
statement: lemma sCoef_mem {t : k} (ht : t ∈ Λ) (ht' : t⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (N r n : ℕ) : sCoef t N r n ∈ Λ
proof:
:=
  mul_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem (neg_mem (one_mem _)) _) (pow_mem ht _)) (pow_mem ht' _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.nu_mem
statement: lemma nu_mem (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s n : ℕ) : nu q s n ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : q ^ 2 ∈ Λ := pow_mem hqΛ 2
  have hp' : (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by rw [← inv_pow]; exact pow_mem hqΛ' 2
  exact prod_mem fun j _ ↦ mul_mem (mul_mem (sub_mem hp (one_mem _)) (pow_mem hp' _))
    (qInt_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qDivPow_e_mul_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_e_mul_mem (n : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f) :
    qDivPow q n e * x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  refine mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen (fun a b c d ↦ ?_) hx
  rw [M4, ← mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow e n a
    (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi _), smul_mul_assoc]
  exact smul_mem_orderedSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _) (M4_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.M4_mul_M3_mem
statement:
lemma M4_mul_M3_mem (a b' c' d' b c d : ℕ) :
    M4 q e X y f a b' c' d' * M3 q X y f b c d ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  have hp : q ^ 2 ∈ Λ := pow_mem hqΛ 2
  have hp' : (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by rw [← inv_pow]; exact pow_mem hqΛ' 2
  have hFq := A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi
  have hFp := A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hpi
  have e1 : M4 q e X y f a b' c' d' * M3 q X y f b c d =
      qDivPow q a e * (qDivPow (q ^ 2) b' X * (qDivPow q c' y *
        ((qDivPow (q ^ 2) d' f * qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X) * (qDivPow q c y *
          qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f)))) := by
    simp only [M4, M3, mul_assoc]
  rw [e1, qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_X hq0 hqi hpi H, sum_mul, mul_sum, mul_sum, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [V]
  split_ifs with hn
  · have hYX : ∀ z, qDivPow q c' y * (qDivPow (q ^ 2) (b - n) X * z) =
        (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ (c' * (b - n)) • (qDivPow (q ^ 2) (b - n) X * (qDivPow q c' y * z)) := by
      intro z; rw [← mul_assoc, yd_Xd hq0 hqi H, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    have hFY : qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d' - n) f * (qDivPow q c y * qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f) =
        (q ^ 2)⁻¹ ^ ((d' - n) * c) • (qDivPow q c y * (qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d' - n) f *
          qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, fd_yd H, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    have hXX : ∀ z, qDivPow (q ^ 2) b' X * (qDivPow (q ^ 2) (b - n) X * z) =
        qBinomial (q ^ 2) (b' + (b - n)) b' • (qDivPow (q ^ 2) (b' + (b - n)) X * z) := by
      intro z; rw [← mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow X _ _ (hFp _), smul_mul_assoc]
    have hYY : ∀ z, qDivPow q c' y * (qDivPow q (2 * n) y * (qDivPow q c y * z)) =
        (qBinomial q (c' + 2 * n) c' * qBinomial q (c' + 2 * n + c) (c' + 2 * n)) •
          (qDivPow q (c' + 2 * n + c) y * z) := by
      intro z
      rw [← mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow y _ _ (hFq _), smul_mul_assoc,
        ← mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow y _ _ (hFq _), smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
    have hFF : qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d' - n) f * qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f =
        qBinomial (q ^ 2) (d' - n + d) (d' - n) • qDivPow (q ^ 2) (d' - n + d) f :=
      A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow f _ _ (hFp _)
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
    rw [hYX, hFY]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm]
    rw [hXX, hYY, hFF]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    refine smul_mem_orderedSpan ?_ ?_
    · repeat' (first
        | exact sCoef_mem hp hp' _ _ _
        | exact nu_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _
        | exact A2Integral.qBinomial_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _
        | exact A2Integral.qBinomial_mem hp hp' _ _
        | exact pow_mem hp' _
        | apply mul_mem)
    · simpa only [M4, M3, mul_assoc] using M4_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (X := X)
        (y := y) (f := f) a (b' + (b - n)) (c' + 2 * n + c) (d' - n + d)
  · simp only [smul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_mem (s : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 2) s f * x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  refine mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen (fun a b c d ↦ ?_) hx
  rw [M4, ← mul_assoc, qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e hq0 hqi hpi H, sum_mul]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  rw [W, mul_sum, smul_sum, sum_mul]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun m _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [Wt]
  split_ifs
  · rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, smul_mul_assoc]
    refine smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) ?_
    exact M4_mul_M3_mem hq0 hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  · simp only [mul_zero, smul_zero, zero_mul]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.smul_mem_T
statement: lemma smul_mem_T {c : k} (hc : c ∈ Λ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ T) : c • x ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]; exact mul_mem (hΛT c hc) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.summand_mem
statement:
lemma summand_mem {r s n m : ℕ}
    (hX : n ≤ 2 * m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m ≤ s → qDivPow (q ^ 2) (n - m) X ∈ T)
    (hY : n ≤ 2 * m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m ≤ s → qDivPow q (2 * m - n) y ∈ T) :
    sCoef q (2 * s) r n • (qDivPow q (r - n) e * Wt q X y f n s m) ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  refine smul_mem_T hΛT (sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) ?_
  simp only [Wt]
  split_ifs with hv
  · rw [mul_smul_comm]
    refine smul_mem_T hΛT (pow_mem hqΛ _) (mul_mem (heT _) ?_)
    exact mul_mem (mul_mem (hX hv) (hY hv)) (hfT _)
  · rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.qDivPow_X_mem_and_qDivPow_y_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_X_mem_and_qDivPow_y_mem (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ b ≤ N, qDivPow (q ^ 2) b X ∈ T ∧ qDivPow q b y ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro b hb
    obtain rfl : b = 0 := by omega
    simp only [qDivPow_zero']
    exact ⟨one_mem _, one_mem _⟩
  | succ N ih =>
    
    have hy : qDivPow q (N + 1) y ∈ T := by
      have hFE := mul_mem (hfT (N + 1)) (heT (N + 1))
      rw [qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e hq0 hqi hpi H, sum_range_succ, W, mul_sum, smul_sum,
        sum_range_succ (fun m ↦ sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (N + 1) (N + 1) •
          (qDivPow q (N + 1 - (N + 1)) e * Wt q X y f (N + 1) (N + 1) m)) (N + 1)] at hFE
      have hrest : ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (N + 1) n •
            (qDivPow q (N + 1 - n) e * W q X y f n (N + 1)) +
          ∑ m ∈ range (N + 1), sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (N + 1) (N + 1) •
            (qDivPow q (N + 1 - (N + 1)) e * Wt q X y f (N + 1) (N + 1) m) ∈ T := by
        refine add_mem (sum_mem fun n hn ↦ ?_) (sum_mem fun m hm ↦ ?_)
        · have hn := mem_range.1 hn
          rw [W, mul_sum, smul_sum]
          refine sum_mem fun m _ ↦ summand_mem hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT ?_ ?_
          · intro hv; exact (ih _ (by omega)).1
          · intro hv; exact (ih _ (by omega)).2
        · have hm := mem_range.1 hm
          refine summand_mem hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT ?_ ?_
          · intro hv; exact (ih _ (by omega)).1
          · intro hv; exact (ih _ (by omega)).2
      have hlast : sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (N + 1) (N + 1) • (qDivPow q (N + 1 - (N + 1)) e *
          Wt q X y f (N + 1) (N + 1) (N + 1)) =
          ((-1) ^ (N + 1) * q ^ (2 * (N + 1))) • qDivPow q (N + 1) y := by
        simp [sCoef, Wt, M3, qDivPow_zero', smul_smul, show 2 * (N + 1) - (N + 1) = N + 1 by omega]
      rw [← add_assoc, hlast] at hFE
      have h2 := sub_mem hFE hrest
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at h2
      have hu : ((-1) ^ (N + 1) * q ^ (2 * (N + 1)))⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
        rw [mul_inv, ← inv_pow, ← inv_pow]
        exact mul_mem (pow_mem (by simp) _) (pow_mem hqΛ' _)
      have := smul_mem_T hΛT hu h2
      rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
        (pow_ne_zero _ hq0)), one_smul] at this
    
    have hX : qDivPow (q ^ 2) (N + 1) X ∈ T := by
      have hFE := mul_mem (hfT (N + 1)) (heT (2 * N + 2))
      rw [qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e hq0 hqi hpi H, sum_range_succ, W, mul_sum, smul_sum,
        sum_range_succ (fun m ↦ sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (2 * N + 2) (2 * N + 2) •
          (qDivPow q (2 * N + 2 - (2 * N + 2)) e * Wt q X y f (2 * N + 2) (N + 1) m))
          (N + 1)] at hFE
      have hrest : ∑ n ∈ range (2 * N + 2), sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (2 * N + 2) n •
            (qDivPow q (2 * N + 2 - n) e * W q X y f n (N + 1)) +
          ∑ m ∈ range (N + 1), sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (2 * N + 2) (2 * N + 2) •
            (qDivPow q (2 * N + 2 - (2 * N + 2)) e * Wt q X y f (2 * N + 2) (N + 1) m) ∈ T := by
        refine add_mem (sum_mem fun n hn ↦ ?_) (sum_mem fun m hm ↦ ?_)
        · have hn := mem_range.1 hn
          rw [W, mul_sum, smul_sum]
          refine sum_mem fun m _ ↦ summand_mem hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT ?_ ?_
          · intro hv; exact (ih _ (by omega)).1
          · intro hv
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (2 * m - n) (N + 1) with h | h
            · exact (ih _ (by omega)).2
            · rw [show 2 * m - n = N + 1 by omega]; exact hy
        · have hm := mem_range.1 hm
          refine summand_mem hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT ?_ ?_
          · intro hv; exact (ih _ (by omega)).1
          · intro hv; exact (ih _ (by omega)).2
      have hlast : sCoef q (2 * (N + 1)) (2 * N + 2) (2 * N + 2) •
          (qDivPow q (2 * N + 2 - (2 * N + 2)) e * Wt q X y f (2 * N + 2) (N + 1) (N + 1)) =
          q ^ (2 * (N + 1)) • qDivPow (q ^ 2) (N + 1) X := by
        have h1 : 2 * N + 2 - (N + 1) = N + 1 := by omega
        have h2 : 2 * (N + 1) - (2 * N + 2) = 0 := by omega
        have hm1 : (-1 : k) ^ (2 * N + 2) = 1 := by
          rw [show 2 * N + 2 = 2 * (N + 1) by ring, pow_mul]; simp
        simp [sCoef, Wt, M3, qDivPow_zero', h1, h2, hm1, show 2 * N + 2 ≤ 2 * (N + 1) by omega,
          show ¬ 2 * N + 1 < N by omega]
      rw [← add_assoc, hlast] at hFE
      have h2 := sub_mem hFE hrest
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at h2
      have := smul_mem_T hΛT (pow_mem hqΛ' (2 * (N + 1))) h2
      rwa [smul_smul, ← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_pow, one_smul] at this
    intro b hb
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge b (N + 1) with h | h
    · exact ih b (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : b = N + 1 := by omega
      exact ⟨hX, hy⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing
statement:
theorem coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing :
    (orderedSpan q Λ e X y f : Set B) = genRing q Λ e f
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ : ∀ c ∈ Λ, algebraMap k B c ∈ genRing q Λ e f := fun c hc ↦
    Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩))
  have he : ∀ a, qDivPow q a e ∈ genRing q Λ e f := fun a ↦
    Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨a, rfl⟩))
  have hf : ∀ d, qDivPow (q ^ 2) d f ∈ genRing q Λ e f := fun d ↦
    Subring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨d, rfl⟩)
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, rfl⟩ := hx
      have hg := qDivPow_X_mem_and_qDivPow_y_mem hq0 hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛ he hf (max b c')
      exact smul_mem_T hΛ hc (mul_mem (he a) (mul_mem (mul_mem (hg b (le_max_left _ _)).1
        (hg c' (le_max_right _ _)).2) (hf d)))
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  · intro hx
    have key : ∀ z ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f, x * z ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f := by
      induction hx using Subring.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        rcases hx with (⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩) | ⟨n, rfl⟩
        · intro z hz; rw [← Algebra.smul_def]; exact smul_mem_orderedSpan hc hz
        · exact fun z hz ↦ qDivPow_e_mul_mem hqi hqΛ hqΛ' n hz
        · exact fun z hz ↦ qDivPow_f_mul_mem hq0 hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' n hz
      | zero => intro z _; rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
      | one => intro z hz; rwa [one_mul]
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => intro z hz; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx z hz) (hy z hz)
      | neg x _ hx => intro z hz; rw [neg_mul]; exact neg_mem (hx z hz)
      | mul x y _ _ hx hy => intro z hz; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hy z hz)
    simpa using key 1 one_mem_orderedSpan

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomialDegree_cast_apply
statement:
theorem pbwMonomialDegree_cast_apply {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) (i : I) :
    (pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c i : ℤ) =
      (∑ n : Fin ω.length, c n • rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.isLt) i
proof:
:= by
  have hcast (n : Fin ω.length) :
      (positiveRootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.isLt i : ℤ) =
        rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.isLt i :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (rootVectorDegree_nonneg_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hD hv hω n n.isLt i)
  simp [pbwMonomialDegree, List.sum_ofFn, hcast]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomialDegree_realization
statement:
theorem pbwMonomialDegree_realization {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    P.rootOf (fun i ↦ (pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c i : ℤ)) =
      prefixExponentWeight P hD ω c
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [pbwMonomialDegree_cast_apply R P hD hv hω]
  exact realize_sum_rootVectorDegree R P hD ω c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomialDegree_eq_iff
statement:
theorem pbwMonomialDegree_eq_iff {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c = ν ↔
      prefixExponentWeight P hD ω c = P.rootOf (fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pbwMonomialDegree_realization R P hD hv hω]
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; rfl
  · intro h
    have he := P.rootOf_injective h
    ext i
    exact_mod_cast congrFun he i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.card_pbwMonomialDegree_fiber
statement:
theorem card_pbwMonomialDegree_fiber {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Nat.card {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ // pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c = ν} =
      kostantPartition P (P.rootOf (fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  have e : {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ // pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c = ν} ≃
      {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ //
        prefixExponentWeight P hD ω c = P.rootOf (fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ))} :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun c ↦ pbwMonomialDegree_eq_iff R P hD hv hω c ν)
  exact (Nat.card_congr e).trans (card_prefixExponentFiber P hD hω hw _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomialDegree_fiber
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomialDegree_fiber [CharZero k] (htrans : Transcendental ℚ v)
    {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (fun c :
      {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ // pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c = ν} ↦
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c.1)) =
      plusWeightSpace R v ν
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight
    (fun c ↦ pbwMonomialDegree_eq_iff R P hD hv hω c ν)).trans
      (prefixExponentFiberEquiv P hD hω hw (P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ)))
  have : Finite {s : NegRootIndex P →₀ ℕ // negRootWt P s =
      P.rootOf (fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ))} :=
    (finite_setOf_negRootWt_eq P _).to_subtype
  have : Finite {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ // pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c = ν} :=
    Finite.of_injective e e.injective
  let := Fintype.ofFinite {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ // pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c = ν}
  apply (linearIndependent_iff_span_eq_plusWeightSpace htrans P ν _ ?_ ?_).mp
  · exact (linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hv hD hω).comp
      _ Subtype.val_injective
  · intro c
    simpa only [c.property] using
      pbwMonomial_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hD hv hω c.1
  · rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact card_pbwMonomialDegree_fiber R P hD hv hω hw ν

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan [CharZero k] (htrans : Transcendental ℚ v)
    {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range
      (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    rw [← iSup_plusWeightSpace]
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (pbwMonomialDegree (R := R) ω c)
      (pbwMonomial_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hD hv hω c)
  · rw [← iSup_plusWeightSpace]
    apply iSup_le
    intro ν
    rw [← span_pbwMonomialDegree_fiber R P hD hv htrans hω hw ν]
    apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c.1, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finiteTypePBWBasis_apply
statement:
theorem finiteTypePBWBasis_apply
    {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD)
    (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    (finiteTypePBWBasis R P hD hv hω hw c : QuantumGroup R v) =
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteTypePBWBasis, Basis.map_apply, Basis.span_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_finiteTypePBWBasis
statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypePBWBasis :
