    ∃ ω : List I, (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω ∧
      (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD ∧
      ∃ b : Basis (Fin ω.length → ℕ) k
      (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))),
      ∀ c, (b c : QuantumGroup R v) =
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hw⟩ :=
    (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).exists_isReduced (finiteTypeLongest P hD)
  exact ⟨ω, hω, hw.symm, finiteTypePBWBasis R P hD hv hω hw.symm,
    finiteTypePBWBasis_apply R P hD hv hω hw.symm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointSum_mem_all
statement: lemma adjointSum_mem_all (n s : ℕ) : adjointSum q A b C D f n s ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    have hFE := T.mul_mem (hfT s) (heT n)
    rw [qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_all hq hqi hpi H, sum_range_succ] at hFE
    have hrest : ∑ j ∈ range n, B2Integral.sCoef q (3 * s) n j •
        (qDivPow q (n - j) e * adjointSum q A b C D f j s) ∈ T := by
      exact T.sum_mem fun j hj => B2Integral.smul_mem_T hΛT
        (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) (T.mul_mem (heT _) (ih j (mem_range.mp hj)))
    have hlast := T.sub_mem hFE hrest
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at hlast
    simp only [B2Integral.sCoef, Nat.sub_self, mul_zero, zero_mul, pow_zero, mul_one,
      qDivPow_zero', one_mul] at hlast
    have hu : ((-1 : k) ^ n)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
      rw [← inv_pow]
      exact Λ.pow_mem (by simp) _
    have hh := B2Integral.smul_mem_T hΛT hu hlast
    rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num : (-1 : k) ≠ 0)),
      one_smul] at hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_ne_zero
statement: lemma adjointCoeff_ne_zero (a b c d l : ℕ) : adjointCoeff q a b c d l ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (pow_ne_zero _ hq)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_inv_mem
statement: lemma adjointCoeff_inv_mem (a b c d l : ℕ) : (adjointCoeff q a b c d l)⁻¹ ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjointCoeff, mul_inv, ← inv_pow, ← inv_pow]
  exact Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (by simp) _) (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ' _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.extract_adjoint_monomial
statement:
private lemma extract_adjoint_monomial (r s : ℕ) (y : AdjointIndex)
    (hy : y ∈ adjointIndices r s)
    (hrest : ∀ x ∈ adjointIndices r s, x ≠ y →
      M5 q A b C D f x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2 ∈ T) :
    M5 q A b C D f y.1 y.2.1 y.2.2.1 y.2.2.2.1 y.2.2.2.2 ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := adjointSum_mem_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT r s
  rw [adjointSum, ← sum_erase_add _ _ hy] at hsum
  have hr : ∑ x ∈ (adjointIndices r s).erase y,
      adjointCoeff q x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2 •
        M5 q A b C D f x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2 ∈ T := by
    refine T.sum_mem fun x hx => ?_
    rcases mem_erase.mp hx with ⟨hne, hx⟩
    exact B2Integral.smul_mem_T hΛT (adjointCoeff_mem Λ hqΛ _ _ _ _ _) (hrest x hx hne)
  have hh := T.sub_mem hsum hr
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at hh
  have hh' := B2Integral.smul_mem_T hΛT
    (adjointCoeff_inv_mem hqΛ' y.1 y.2.1 y.2.2.1 y.2.2.2.1 y.2.2.2.2) hh
  rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (adjointCoeff_ne_zero hq _ _ _ _ _), one_smul] at hh'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_roots_mem_by_height
statement:
private theorem qDivPow_roots_mem_by_height (N : ℕ) :
    (∀ a, 4 * a = N → qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A ∈ T) ∧
    (∀ b', 3 * b' = N → qDivPow q b' b ∈ T) ∧
    (∀ c, 5 * c = N → qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C ∈ T) ∧
    (∀ d, 2 * d = N → qDivPow q d D ∈ T)
proof:
:= by
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h N ih =>
    have known (a b' c d l : ℕ) (ha : 4 * a < N) (hb : 3 * b' < N)
        (hc : 5 * c < N) (hd : 2 * d < N) : M5 q A b C D f a b' c d l ∈ T := by
      exact T.mul_mem (T.mul_mem (T.mul_mem (T.mul_mem
        ((ih _ ha).1 a rfl) ((ih _ hb).2.1 b' rfl)) ((ih _ hc).2.2.1 c rfl))
        ((ih _ hd).2.2.2 d rfl)) (hfT l)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have hmem : (t, 0, 0, 0, 0) ∈ adjointIndices (3 * t) t := by simp
      have hh := extract_adjoint_monomial hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT
        (3 * t) t (t, 0, 0, 0, 0) hmem ?_
      · simpa only [M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', mul_one] using hh
      rintro ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩ hx hne
      have hx' := (mem_adjointIndices _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hx
      simp only [ne_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hne
      exact known a b' c d l (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro t ht
      have hmem : (0, t, 0, 0, 0) ∈ adjointIndices (2 * t) t := by simp
      have hh := extract_adjoint_monomial hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT
        (2 * t) t (0, t, 0, 0, 0) hmem ?_
      · simpa only [M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', mul_one, one_mul] using hh
      rintro ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩ hx hne
      have hx' := (mem_adjointIndices _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hx
      simp only [ne_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hne
      exact known a b' c d l (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro t ht
      have hmem : (0, 0, t, 0, 0) ∈ adjointIndices (3 * t) (2 * t) := by simp
      have hh := extract_adjoint_monomial hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT
        (3 * t) (2 * t) (0, 0, t, 0, 0) hmem ?_
      · simpa only [M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', mul_one, one_mul] using hh
      rintro ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩ hx hne
      have hx' := (mem_adjointIndices _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hx
      simp only [ne_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hne
      exact known a b' c d l (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro t ht
      have hmem : (0, 0, 0, t, 0) ∈ adjointIndices t t := by simp
      have hh := extract_adjoint_monomial hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT
        t t (0, 0, 0, t, 0) hmem ?_
      · simpa only [M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', mul_one, one_mul] using hh
      rintro ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩ hx hne
      have hx' := (mem_adjointIndices _ _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hx
      simp only [ne_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hne
      exact known a b' c d l (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_roots_mem_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_roots_mem_all (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) n A ∈ T ∧ qDivPow q n b ∈ T ∧
      qDivPow (q ^ 3) n C ∈ T ∧ qDivPow q n D ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  have hh := qDivPow_roots_mem_by_height hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT
  exact ⟨(hh (4 * n)).1 n rfl, (hh (3 * n)).2.1 n rfl,
    (hh (5 * n)).2.2.1 n rfl, (hh (2 * n)).2.2.2 n rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.orderedSpan_le_genRing_all
statement:
theorem orderedSpan_le_genRing_all :
    orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f ≤ (genRing q Λ e f).toAddSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ : ∀ z ∈ Λ, algebraMap k B z ∈ genRing q Λ e f := fun z hz =>
    Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩))
  have he : ∀ n, qDivPow q n e ∈ genRing q Λ e f := fun n =>
    Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, rfl⟩))
  have hf : ∀ n, qDivPow (q ^ 3) n f ∈ genRing q Λ e f := fun n =>
    Subring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨n, rfl⟩)
  have hh := qDivPow_roots_mem_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛ he hf
  intro x hx
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz, i, a, b', c, d, l, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact B2Integral.smul_mem_T hΛ hz (mul_mem (he i)
      (mul_mem (mul_mem (mul_mem (mul_mem (hh a).1 (hh b').2.1) (hh c).2.2.1)
        (hh d).2.2.2) (hf l)))
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointSum_mem
statement: lemma adjointSum_mem (n s : ℕ) : adjointSum q A b C D f n s ∈ T
proof:
:= by

theorem qDivPow_roots_mem (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) n A ∈ T ∧ qDivPow q n b ∈ T ∧
      qDivPow (q ^ 3) n C ∈ T ∧ qDivPow q n D ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact qDivPow_roots_mem_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ' hΛT heT hfT n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.orderedSpan_le_genRing
statement:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_map_adjoin_E
statement:
theorem chevalley_map_adjoin_E :
    (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))).map (chevalleyEquiv R v).toAlgHom =
      Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgHom.map_adjoin, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg Set.range
  funext i
  exact chevalley_E R v i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalleyPlusEquivMinus_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chevalleyPlusEquivMinus_apply
    (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    (chevalleyPlusEquivMinus R v x : QuantumGroup R v) = chevalley R v x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negativeBraidEquiv_chevalley
statement:
theorem negativeBraidEquiv_chevalley (i : I) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    negativeBraidEquiv R hv i (chevalley R v x) =
      chevalley R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i x)
proof:
:= by
  change (chevalleyEquiv R v)
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i ((chevalleyEquiv R v).symm (chevalleyEquiv R v x))) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_rootVector
statement:
theorem chevalley_rootVector (ω : List I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    chevalley R v (CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn) =
      CoxeterSystem.rootVector (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω n hn
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing n with
  | nil => simp at hn
  | cons i ω ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [CoxeterSystem.rootVector_cons_zero]
    | succ n =>
      rw [CoxeterSystem.rootVector_cons_succ, CoxeterSystem.rootVector_cons_succ,
        ← negativeBraidEquiv_chevalley, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_pbwMonomial
statement:
theorem chevalley_pbwMonomial (ω : List I) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    chevalley R v (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c) =
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω c
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_cons, CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_cons,
      map_mul, map_pow, chevalley_E, ← negativeBraidEquiv_chevalley, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_negativePBWMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_negativePBWMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan
    {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω) :
    LinearIndependent k
      (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hv hD hω).map'
    (chevalleyEquiv R v).toLinearMap (chevalleyEquiv R v).toLinearEquiv.ker
  change LinearIndependent k (fun c ↦ chevalley R v
    (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c)) at h
  simpa only [chevalley_pbwMonomial] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply
statement:
theorem finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply
    {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD)
    (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    (finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis R hv P hD hω hw c : QuantumGroup R v) =
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω c
proof:
:= by
  change chevalley R v (finiteTypePBWBasis R P hD hv hω hw c) = _
  rw [finiteTypePBWBasis_apply, chevalley_pbwMonomial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_sum_repr
statement:
theorem finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_sum_repr
    {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD)
    (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v))) :
    ((finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis R hv P hD hω hw).repr x).sum
      (fun c a ↦ a • CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω c) = (x : QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v))).val
    ((finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis R hv P hD hω hw).linearCombination_repr x)
  simpa only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul,
    Subalgebra.val_apply,
    finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply_chevalley
statement:
theorem finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply_chevalley
    {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD)
    (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    (finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis R hv P hD hω hw c : QuantumGroup R v) =
      chevalley R v
        (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply, chevalley_pbwMonomial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis
statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis :
    ∃ ω : List I, (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω ∧
      (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD ∧
      ∃ b : Basis (Fin ω.length → ℕ) k (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v))),
      ∀ c, (b c : QuantumGroup R v) =
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hw⟩ :=
    (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).exists_isReduced (finiteTypeLongest P hD)
  exact ⟨ω, hω, hw.symm, finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis R hv P hD hω hw.symm,
    finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply R hv P hD hω hw.symm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareStepTerm_apply
statement:
lemma squareStepTerm_apply (i : SquareIndex) (a b c : ℕ) :
    squareStepTerm q i (a, b, c) =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else if i = (a - 1, b + 1, c) then
        q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a else 0) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else if i = (a, b - 2, c + 1) then
        (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨u, v, w⟩
  simp only [squareStepTerm, Finsupp.add_apply]
  congr 1
  · split_ifs <;> simp_all [Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq]
    all_goals omega
  · split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Order.lt_two_iff, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply,
      not_le, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.right_eq_add, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero,
      and_false, not_false_eq_true, inv_pow, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right_iff,
      mul_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero, pow_eq_zero_iff', ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,
      and_imp, add_tsub_cancel_right, and_true, true_and, not_and]
    all_goals first | omega |
      (rw [ite_eq_left (by omega : b - 2 + 2 = b), show b - 2 + 1 = b - 1 by omega])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareStep_apply
statement:
lemma squareStep_apply (F : SquareIndex →₀ k) (a b c : ℕ) :
    squareStep q F (a, b, c) =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else
        F (a - 1, b + 1, c) * (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a)) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else
        F (a, b - 2, c + 1) *
          ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [squareStep, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, squareStepTerm_apply,
    mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · split_ifs with ha
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero, sum_ite_eq']
      split_ifs with hs
      · rfl
      · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs, zero_mul]
  · split_ifs with hb
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero, sum_ite_eq']
      split_ifs with hs
      · rfl
      · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareCoeff_recurrence
statement:
lemma squareCoeff_recurrence (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (s n a b c : ℕ) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * squareCoeff q s (n + 1) (a, b, c) =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else
        squareCoeff q s n (a - 1, b + 1, c) *
          (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a)) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else
        squareCoeff q s n (a, b - 2, c + 1) *
          ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b))
proof:
:= by
  have hn := hqi (n + 1) (by omega)
  simp only [squareCoeff, squareNumerator, squareStep_apply, qFactorial_succ, mul_inv_rev]
  split_ifs <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareCoeff_eq_zero_of_grade
statement:
lemma squareCoeff_eq_zero_of_grade (s n : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ)
    (h : ¬ (3 * a + b = 2 * n ∧ a + b + 2 * c = 2 * s)) :
    squareCoeff q s n (a, b, c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : squareNumerator q s n (a, b, c) = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    exact h (squareNumerator_grade q s n (a, b, c) hn)
  simp [squareCoeff, hz]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareCoeff_eq_squareScalar
statement:
theorem squareCoeff_eq_squareScalar (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (s n t : ℕ) (hts : t ≤ s) (htn : t ≤ n) (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t) :
    squareCoeff q s n (n - t, 3 * t - n, s - t) =
      q ^ (-3 * (s - t : ℕ) * (t : ℤ)) * squareScalar q n t
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing t with
  | zero =>
    have ht : t = 0 := by omega
    subst t
    simp [squareCoeff, squareNumerator, qFactorial, squareScalar_zero_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : t ≠ 0)
    have ha : n + 1 - (t + 1) = n - t := by omega
    have hb : 3 * (t + 1) - (n + 1) = 3 * t + 2 - n := by omega
    rw [ha, hb]
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (hqi (n + 1) (by omega))
    rw [squareCoeff_recurrence hqi]
    have hfirst :
        (if n - t = 0 then 0 else
          squareCoeff q s n (n - t - 1, 3 * t + 2 - n + 1, s - (t + 1)) *
            (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (3 * t + 2 - n) + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (n - t))) =
        q ^ (-3 * (s - (t + 1) : ℕ) * ((t : ℤ) + 1)) *
          (q ^ (-(2 * (3 * t + 2 - n : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ)) *
            (qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (n - t)) * squareScalar q n (t + 1)) := by
      split_ifs with he
      · rw [squareScalar_eq_zero n (t + 1) (by omega)]
        ring
      · rw [show n - t - 1 = n - (t + 1) by omega,
          show 3 * t + 2 - n + 1 = 3 * (t + 1) - n by omega,
          ih (t + 1) hts (by omega) (by omega)]
        rw [← zpow_natCast q⁻¹ (2 * (3 * t + 2 - n) + 1), inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg]
        push_cast
        ring
    have hsecond :
        (if 3 * t + 2 - n < 2 then 0 else
          squareCoeff q s n (n - t, 3 * t + 2 - n - 2, s - (t + 1) + 1) *
            ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (s - (t + 1)) *
              qInt q (3 * t + 2 - n - 1) * qInt q (3 * t + 2 - n))) =
        q ^ (-3 * (s - (t + 1) : ℕ) * ((t : ℤ) + 1)) *
          ((q ^ 2 - 1) * q ^ (-3 * (t : ℤ)) * qInt q (3 * t + 1 - n) *
            qInt q (3 * t + 2 - n) * squareScalar q n t) := by
      split_ifs with he
      · rw [squareScalar_eq_zero n t (by omega)]
        ring
      · rw [show 3 * t + 2 - n - 2 = 3 * t - n by omega,
          show s - (t + 1) + 1 = s - t by omega,
          show 3 * t + 2 - n - 1 = 3 * t + 1 - n by omega,
          ih t (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]
        have hp : q ^ (-3 * (s - t : ℕ) * (t : ℤ)) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (s - (t + 1)) =
            q ^ (-3 * (s - (t + 1) : ℕ) * ((t : ℤ) + 1)) * q ^ (-3 * (t : ℤ)) := by
          rw [← zpow_natCast (q ^ 3)⁻¹, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg,
            ← zpow_natCast q 3, ← zpow_mul]
          simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
          congr 1
          have hc : ((s - t : ℕ) : ℤ) = (s - (t + 1) : ℕ) + 1 := by omega
          rw [hc]
          ring
        linear_combination
          (q ^ 2 - 1) * qInt q (3 * t + 1 - n) * qInt q (3 * t + 2 - n) *
            squareScalar q n t * hp
    rw [hfirst, hsecond]
    have hr := squareScalar_recurrence hq n t (by omega) (by omega)
    push_cast
    linear_combination -q ^ (-3 * (s - (t + 1) : ℕ) * ((t : ℤ) + 1)) * hr

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareCoeff_mem
statement:
theorem squareCoeff_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s n : ℕ) (i : SquareIndex) :
    squareCoeff q s n i ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨a, b, c⟩
  by_cases hg : 3 * a + b = 2 * n ∧ a + b + 2 * c = 2 * s
  · have hi : (a, b, c) = (n - (n - a), 3 * (n - a) - n, s - (n - a)) := by
      ext <;> dsimp <;> omega
    rw [hi, squareCoeff_eq_squareScalar hq hqi s n (n - a) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]
    exact Λ.mul_mem (laurent_zpow_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ _) (squareScalar_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ _ _)
  · rw [squareCoeff_eq_zero_of_grade s n a b c hg]
    exact Λ.zero_mem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s C * qDivPow q r e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum hq hqi hpi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have hscoef : B2Integral.sCoefParam q 1 r n ∈ Λ := by
    simpa only [B2Integral.sCoefParam, one_pow, mul_one] using
      Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.neg_mem Λ.one_mem) n) (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ (n * (r - n)))
  apply smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (Λ.mul_mem hscoef (squareCoeff_mem hq hqi Λ hqΛ hqiΛ s n i))
  simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', mul_assoc] using
    M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
      (D := D) (f := f) (r - n) i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2 0 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.Ad_ed
statement:
lemma SquareRel.Ad_ed (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (a r : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A * qDivPow q r e =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (a * r) • (qDivPow q r e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A)
proof:
:=
  B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm H.Ae a r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Ad_ed
statement:
lemma Ad_ed (a r : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A * qDivPow q r e =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (a * r) • (qDivPow q r e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A)
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.Ad_ed H.squareRel a r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.bd_Ad
statement:
lemma bd_Ad (b' a : ℕ) : qDivPow q b' b * qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (b' * a) • (qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A * qDivPow q b' b)
proof:
:=
  B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm H.BA b' a

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Cd_bd
statement:
lemma Cd_bd (c b' : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C * qDivPow q b' b =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c * b') • (qDivPow q b' b * qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C)
proof:
:=
  B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm H.CB c b'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Dd_Cd
statement:
lemma Dd_Cd (d c : ℕ) : qDivPow q d D * qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (d * c) • (qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C * qDivPow q d D)
proof:
:=
  B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm H.DC d c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.fd_Dd
statement:
lemma fd_Dd (s d : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q d D =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (s * d) • (qDivPow q d D * qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f)
proof:
:=
  B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm H.fD s d

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.Ad_e
statement:
lemma SquareRel.Ad_e (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (a : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A * e =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a • (e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_one] using SquareRel.Ad_ed H a 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Ad_e
statement:
lemma Ad_e (a : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A * e =
    (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a • (e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A)
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.Ad_e H.squareRel a

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.bd_e
statement:
lemma SquareRel.bd_e (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (n : ℕ) : qDivPow q (n + 1) b * e =
    q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) • (e * qDivPow q (n + 1) b) -
      (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n + 1) * qInt q 3) • (A * qDivPow q n b)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero'] using H.Be
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc : qInt q (n + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt q (n + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow q b (n + 1) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc b e, H.Be, ← mul_assoc b A, H.BA]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow q b (n + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow q b n hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q) (n + 1)]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try simp only [inv_pow])
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.bd_e
statement:
lemma bd_e (n : ℕ) : qDivPow q (n + 1) b * e =
    q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) • (e * qDivPow q (n + 1) b) -
      (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n + 1) * qInt q 3) • (A * qDivPow q n b)
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.bd_e hq hqi H.squareRel n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.Cd_e
statement:
lemma SquareRel.Cd_e (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (n : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) (n + 1) C * e =
    e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (n + 1) C -
      ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ n) • (b ^ 2 * qDivPow (q ^ 3) n C)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero'] using H.Ce
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc : qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    have hCb : C * b ^ 2 = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (b ^ 2 * C) :=
      mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul H.CB 2
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow (q ^ 3) C (n + 1) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc C e, H.Ce, ← mul_assoc C, hCb]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow (q ^ 3) C (n + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow (q ^ 3) C n hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q ^ 3) (n + 1)]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try simp only [inv_pow])
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Cd_e
statement:
lemma Cd_e (n : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) (n + 1) C * e =
    e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (n + 1) C -
      ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ n) • (b ^ 2 * qDivPow (q ^ 3) n C)
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.Cd_e hq hpi H.squareRel n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.fd_e
statement:
lemma fd_e (n : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) (n + 1) f * e =
    (q ^ 3) ^ (n + 1) • (e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (n + 1) f) -
      q ^ 3 • (D * qDivPow (q ^ 3) n f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero'] using H.fe
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc : qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1) ≠ 0 := hpi _ (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow (q ^ 3) f (n + 1) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc f e, H.fe, ← mul_assoc f D, H.fD]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow (q ^ 3) f (n + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow (q ^ 3) f n hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q ^ 3) (n + 1)]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Dd_e
statement:
lemma Dd_e (n : ℕ) : qDivPow q (n + 2) D * e =
    q ^ (n + 2) • (e * qDivPow q (n + 2) D) -
      (q * qInt q 2) • (b * qDivPow q (n + 1) D) +
      (q⁻¹ ^ n * qInt q 3) • (C * qDivPow q n D)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hc : qInt q 2 ≠ 0 := hqi 2 (by decide)
    have hDD : qInt q 2 • qDivPow q 2 D = D * D := by
      rw [← mul_qDivPow q D 1 hc, A2Integral.qDivPow_one']
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero', pow_zero, one_mul,
      mul_one, smul_add, smul_sub]
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, hDD,
      smul_comm (qInt q 2) (q ^ 2) (e * qDivPow q 2 D),
      ← mul_smul_comm (qInt q 2) e (qDivPow q 2 D), hDD]
    rw [mul_assoc, H.De, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc D e, H.De, H.DB]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc,
      qInt_two, qInt_three hq]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc : qInt q (n + 2 + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt q (n + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    have hc'' : qInt q (n + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [show n + 1 + 2 = n + 2 + 1 by omega, ← smul_mul_assoc,
      ← mul_qDivPow q D (n + 2) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_add, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc D e, H.De,
      ← mul_assoc D b, H.DB, ← mul_assoc D C, H.DC]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow q D (n + 2) hc,
      mul_qDivPow q D (n + 1) hc', mul_qDivPow q D n hc'', mul_smul_comm,
      smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q) (n + 2), qInt_succ (v := q) (n + 1), qInt_two]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try simp only [inv_pow])
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: PBWInfinityLattice.integral_span_longest
statement:
theorem integral_span_longest :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range fun c ↦
      (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)) =
        (quotientIntegralForm D).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective
    (f := (quotientPlusIntegral R).toLinearMap) (quotientPlus_injective R)
  rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  change Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range fun c ↦
    quotientPlus R (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)) = _
  simp only [quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage]
  rw [span_pbwDivSymm_longest_eq_all cs hw hw₀]
  exact congrArg Subalgebra.toSubmodule (map_quotientIntegralForm_plus R).symm

name: PBWInfinityLattice.field_span_longest
statement:
theorem field_span_longest :
    Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range fun c ↦
      (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← span_quotientIntegralForm D]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range fun c ↦
      (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)) := by
    rw [integral_span_longest R hw hw₀]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hx'
  classical
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro c _
  change integralLaurentEval (a c) • (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) ∈ _
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨c, rfl⟩)

name: PBWInfinityLattice.intersection_longest_eq_lattice
statement: theorem intersection_longest_eq_lattice : intersection R hw = lattice D
proof:
:= by
  rw [intersection, field_span_longest R hw hw₀, Submodule.restrictScalars_top, inf_top_eq]

name: PBWInfinityLattice.longestBasis_apply
statement:
theorem longestBasis_apply (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (longestBasis R hw hw₀ c : Quotient D 𝕧) = integralPBWPreimage R hw c
proof:
:= by
  simp [longestBasis, intersectionBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.alternatingWord_prod_apply_mem_aux
statement:
theorem alternatingWord_prod_apply_mem_aux (hj : T j (E i) ∈ Zj)
    (hij : ∀ x ∈ Zj, T i x ∈ Zi) (hji : ∀ x ∈ Zi, T j x ∈ Zj) (n : ℕ) :
    ((CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j (n + 1)).map T).prod (E i) ∈
      (if Even n then Zj else Zi)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord] using hj
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord_succ' i j (n + 1), List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
      AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    by_cases hn : Even n
    · have h1 : ¬Even (n + 1) := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hn.add_one
      simp only [hn, h1, ↓reduceIte] at ih ⊢
      exact hij _ ih
    · have h1 : Even (n + 1) := (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hn).add_one
      simp only [hn, h1, ↓reduceIte] at ih ⊢
      exact hji _ ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.alternatingWord_prod_apply_mem
statement:
theorem alternatingWord_prod_apply_mem {P : Subalgebra k A} (hj : T j (E i) ∈ Zj)
    (hij : ∀ x ∈ Zj, T i x ∈ Zi) (hji : ∀ x ∈ Zi, T j x ∈ Zj) (hZi : Zi ≤ P) (hZj : Zj ≤ P)
    (hE : E i ∈ P) (n : ℕ) :
    ((CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j n).map T).prod (E i) ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simpa [CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord] using hE
  | succ n =>
    have h := alternatingWord_prod_apply_mem_aux hj hij hji n
    split_ifs at h
    exacts [hZj h, hZi h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXp_zero
statement: lemma rankTwoXp_zero (i j : I) : rankTwoXp R v i j 0 = E R v j
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXm_zero
statement: lemma rankTwoXm_zero (i j : I) : rankTwoXm R v i j 0 = E R v j
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXp_succ
statement:
lemma rankTwoXp_succ (i j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    rankTwoXp R v i j (n + 1) = E R v i * rankTwoXp R v i j n -
      shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) n • (rankTwoXp R v i j n * E R v i)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXm_succ
statement:
lemma rankTwoXm_succ (i j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    rankTwoXm R v i j (n + 1) = E R v i * rankTwoXm R v i j n -
      shift (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j) n • (rankTwoXm R v i j n * E R v i)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXp_mem
statement: lemma rankTwoXp_mem (hi : E R v i ∈ P) (hj : E R v j ∈ P) (n : ℕ) : rankTwoXp R v i j n ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hj
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [rankTwoXp_succ]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem hi ih) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem ih hi) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXm_mem
statement: lemma rankTwoXm_mem (hi : E R v i ∈ P) (hj : E R v j ∈ P) (n : ℕ) : rankTwoXm R v i j n ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hj
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [rankTwoXm_succ]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem hi ih) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem ih hi) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_rankTwoXp_add_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, rankTwoXp_succ, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem hE ih) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem ih hE) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_adjoin_mem
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦
  (Algebra.adjoin_le (S := P.comap T) fun y hy ↦ (Subalgebra.mem_comap _ _ _).2 (h y hy)) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXp_one
statement:
lemma rankTwoXp_one (hij : i ≠ j) :
    rankTwoXp R v i j 1 = (-((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹) • rankTwoXm R v j i 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp := twoNode_param_pow (D := D) (v := v) hij
  have h0 : (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))
  rw [rankTwoXp_succ, rankTwoXm_succ, rankTwoXp_zero, rankTwoXm_zero, inv_pow, hp]
  simp only [shift, pow_zero, mul_zero, one_mul, inv_inv, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  rw [neg_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ h0]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoXp_one'
statement:
lemma rankTwoXp_one' (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∃ c : k, rankTwoXp R v i j 1 = c • rankTwoXm R v j i 1
proof: := ⟨_, rankTwoXp_one hij⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_E_self
statement: lemma map_E_self : S (E R v i) = braidEi R i
proof:
:= by
  simp [HS.map_E]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_E_eq_rankTwoXp
statement:
lemma map_E_eq_rankTwoXp (hij : i ≠ j) :
    S (E R v j) = (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹ • rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hc : (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ =
      (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  rw [HS.map_E, ite_eq_right hij.symm, rankTwoXp, X_eq_serreAux hq0 (pow_ne_zero _ hq0), hc]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_map_rankTwoXm
statement:
lemma exists_map_rankTwoXm (hij : i ≠ j) (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    ∀ m ≤ negA D i j, ∃ c : k,
      S (rankTwoXm R v i j m) = c • rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j - m)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    exact ⟨_, by rw [rankTwoXm_zero, map_E_eq_rankTwoXp HS hij, Nat.sub_zero]⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih (by omega)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, negA D i j - m = n + 1 := ⟨negA D i j - m - 1, by omega⟩
    have hn' : negA D i j - (m + 1) = n := by omega
    have H := braidDiagonal_hyp R v (NeZero.ne v) hij hq
    have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
    have hs : shift (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j) m =
        shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) := by
      have ha : negA D i j = n + 1 + m := by omega
      simp only [shift, inv_pow, inv_inv]
      rw [ha]
      generalize v ^ D.d i = q at hq0 ⊢
      field_simp
      ring
    have hstep : braidEi R i * rankTwoXp R v i j (n + 1) -
        shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) •
          (rankTwoXp R v i j (n + 1) * braidEi R i) =
        (-(shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) *
          cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1))) • rankTwoXp R v i j n :=
      H.stepE (K_neg_mul_Kt i) n
    refine ⟨c * -(shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) *
      cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1)), ?_⟩
    rw [hn', rankTwoXm_succ, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, hc, map_E_self HS, hn, hs,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm _ c, ← smul_sub, hstep, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mem_pair_left'
statement: lemma E_mem_pair_left' : E R v i ∈ P
proof: := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mem_pair_right'
statement: lemma E_mem_pair_right' : E R v j ∈ P
proof: := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoZ_le_pair
statement: lemma rankTwoZ_le_pair : rankTwoZ R v i j ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
  rintro x (rfl | rfl) <;>
    exact rankTwoXp_mem (R := R) (v := v) (i := i) (j := j) E_mem_pair_left' E_mem_pair_right' _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoZ_le_pair'
statement: lemma rankTwoZ_le_pair' : rankTwoZ R v j i ≤ P
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_E_mem_rankTwoZ
statement:
lemma map_E_mem_rankTwoZ (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    T (E R v i) ∈ rankTwoZ R v j i
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_E_eq_rankTwoXp HT hij.symm]
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_rankTwoXp_succ_mem_rankTwoZ
statement:
lemma map_rankTwoXp_succ_mem_rankTwoZ (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hqj : v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (ha' : 1 ≤ negA D j i) (m : ℕ) :
    T (rankTwoXp R v i j (m + 1)) ∈ rankTwoZ R v j i
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  refine map_rankTwoXp_add_mem (map_E_mem_rankTwoZ HT hij) ?_ m
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_map_rankTwoXm HT hij.symm hqj 1 ha'
  rw [rankTwoXp_one hij, map_smul, hc, smul_smul]
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_rankTwoZ_le
statement:
lemma map_rankTwoZ_le (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hqj : v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (ha : 2 ≤ negA D i j) (ha' : 1 ≤ negA D j i) :
    ∀ x ∈ rankTwoZ R v i j, T x ∈ rankTwoZ R v j i
proof:
:= by
  refine map_adjoin_mem ?_
  rintro x (rfl | rfl)
  · have e : negA D i j = negA D i j - 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [e]
    exact map_rankTwoXp_succ_mem_rankTwoZ HT hij hqj ha' _
  · have e : negA D i j - 1 = negA D i j - 2 + 1 := by omega
    rw [e]
    exact map_rankTwoXp_succ_mem_rankTwoZ HT hij hqj ha' _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_E_mem_rankTwoZm
statement:
lemma map_E_mem_rankTwoZm (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (ha' : negA D j i = 1) : T (E R v i) ∈ rankTwoZm R v i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_E_eq_rankTwoXp HT hij.symm, ha', rankTwoXp_one hij.symm, smul_smul]
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_rankTwoXp_add_two_mem
statement:
lemma map_rankTwoXp_add_two_mem (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hqj : v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (ha' : negA D j i = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    T (rankTwoXp R v i j (m + 2)) ∈ rankTwoZm R v i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  refine map_rankTwoXp_add_mem (map_E_mem_rankTwoZm HT hij ha') ?_ m
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_map_rankTwoXm HT hij.symm hqj 1 ha'.ge
  have h1 : T (rankTwoXp R v i j 1) = ((-((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹) * c) • E R v i := by
    rw [rankTwoXp_one hij, map_smul, hc, ha', Nat.sub_self, rankTwoXp_zero, smul_smul]
  have hE : T (E R v i) = ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d j) 1)⁻¹ * -((v ^ D.d j) ^ negA D j i)⁻¹) •
      rankTwoXm R v i j 1 := by
    rw [map_E_eq_rankTwoXp HT hij.symm, ha', rankTwoXp_one hij.symm, smul_smul, ha']
  have hs : shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) 1 *
      shift (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j) 1 = 1 := by
    simp only [shift, inv_pow, inv_inv]
    generalize v ^ D.d i = q at hq0 ⊢
    field_simp
  set α := (qFactorial (v ^ D.d j) 1)⁻¹ * -((v ^ D.d j) ^ negA D j i)⁻¹
  set β := -((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ * c
  set s := shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) 1
  set s' := shift (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j) 1
  have key : α • rankTwoXm R v i j 1 * β • E R v i - s • (β • E R v i * α • rankTwoXm R v i j 1) =
      (α * β * -s) • rankTwoXm R v i j 2 := by
    have hs' : s * s' = 1 := hs
    have e : α * β * -s * s' = -(α * β) := by linear_combination (-(α * β)) * hs'
    rw [rankTwoXm_succ i j 1, smul_sub, smul_smul, e]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    module
  rw [rankTwoXp_succ, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, h1, hE, key]
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoZ₃_le_pair
statement: lemma rankTwoZ₃_le_pair : rankTwoZ₃ R v i j ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
  rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;>
    exact rankTwoXp_mem (R := R) (v := v) (i := i) (j := j) E_mem_pair_left' E_mem_pair_right' _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rankTwoZm_le_pair
statement: lemma rankTwoZm_le_pair : rankTwoZm R v i j ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
  rintro x (rfl | rfl) <;>
    exact rankTwoXm_mem (R := R) (v := v) (i := i) (j := j) E_mem_pair_left' E_mem_pair_right' _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_E_mem_rankTwoZ₃
statement:
lemma map_E_mem_rankTwoZ₃ (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    S (E R v j) ∈ rankTwoZ₃ R v i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_E_eq_rankTwoXp HS hij]
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_rankTwoZm_le
statement:
lemma map_rankTwoZm_le (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hqi : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (ha : 2 ≤ negA D i j) :
    ∀ x ∈ rankTwoZm R v i j, S x ∈ rankTwoZ₃ R v i j
proof:
:= by
  refine map_adjoin_mem ?_
  rintro x (rfl | rfl)
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_map_rankTwoXm HS hij hqi 1 (by omega)
    rw [hc]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)) _
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_map_rankTwoXm HS hij hqi 2 ha
    rw [hc]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_rankTwoZ₃_le
statement:
lemma map_rankTwoZ₃_le (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hqj : v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (ha : 4 ≤ negA D i j) (ha' : negA D j i = 1) :
    ∀ x ∈ rankTwoZ₃ R v i j, T x ∈ rankTwoZm R v i j
proof:
:= by
  refine map_adjoin_mem ?_
  rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl)
  · rw [show negA D i j = negA D i j - 2 + 2 by omega]
    exact map_rankTwoXp_add_two_mem HT hij hqj ha' _
  · rw [show negA D i j - 1 = negA D i j - 3 + 2 by omega]
    exact map_rankTwoXp_add_two_mem HT hij hqj ha' _
  · rw [show negA D i j - 2 = negA D i j - 4 + 2 by omega]
    exact map_rankTwoXp_add_two_mem HT hij hqj ha' _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.alternatingWord_prod_E_mem_adjoin_of_four_le
statement:
theorem alternatingWord_prod_E_mem_adjoin_of_four_le
    (HT : ∀ l, HasBraidGeneratorImages l (Tf l).toAlgHom)
    (hq : ∀ l, v ^ D.d l - (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h4 : ¬D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ((CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j n).map Tf).prod (E R v i) ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij, cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij.symm, neg_mul_neg] at h4
  have h4' : 4 ≤ negA D i j * negA D j i := by
    have : (4 : ℤ) ≤ (negA D i j : ℤ) * negA D j i := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have ha0 : negA D i j ≠ 0 := by rintro h; simp [h] at h4'
  have ha0' : negA D j i ≠ 0 := by rintro h; simp [h] at h4'
  obtain ⟨Zi, Zj, hj, hZij, hZji, hZi, hZj⟩ : ∃ Zi Zj : Subalgebra k (QuantumGroup R v),
      Tf j (E R v i) ∈ Zj ∧ (∀ x ∈ Zj, Tf i x ∈ Zi) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Zi, Tf j x ∈ Zj) ∧
        Zi ≤ P ∧ Zj ≤ P := by
    by_cases h1 : negA D i j = 1
    · rw [h1, one_mul] at h4'
      exact ⟨rankTwoZm R v j i, rankTwoZ₃ R v j i, map_E_mem_rankTwoZ₃ (HT j) hij.symm,
        map_rankTwoZ₃_le (HT i) hij.symm (hq i) h4' h1,
        map_rankTwoZm_le (HT j) hij.symm (hq j) (by omega),
        by rw [Set.pair_comm]; exact rankTwoZm_le_pair,
        by rw [Set.pair_comm]; exact rankTwoZ₃_le_pair⟩
    by_cases h1' : negA D j i = 1
    · rw [h1', mul_one] at h4'
      exact ⟨rankTwoZ₃ R v i j, rankTwoZm R v i j, map_E_mem_rankTwoZm (HT j) hij h1',
        map_rankTwoZm_le (HT i) hij (hq i) (by omega),
        map_rankTwoZ₃_le (HT j) hij (hq j) h4' h1', rankTwoZ₃_le_pair, rankTwoZm_le_pair⟩
    · exact ⟨rankTwoZ R v i j, rankTwoZ R v j i, map_E_mem_rankTwoZ (HT j) hij,
        map_rankTwoZ_le (HT i) hij.symm (hq i) (by omega) (by omega),
        map_rankTwoZ_le (HT j) hij (hq j) (by omega) (by omega),
        rankTwoZ_le_pair, rankTwoZ_le_pair'⟩
  exact alternatingWord_prod_apply_mem hj hZij hZji hZi hZj E_mem_pair_left' n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.inv_of_op
statement:
lemma inv_of_op {p : k} {e x y f : B} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (H : B2PBW.Rel p (op e) (op x) (op y) (op f)) :
    B2PBW.Rel p⁻¹ e (p • x) (-p • y) f
proof:
:= by
  have hfe := congrArg unop H.fe
  have hye := congrArg unop H.ye
  have hxe := congrArg unop H.xe
  have hfy := congrArg unop H.fy
  simp only [unop_mul, unop_sub, unop_smul, unop_op] at hfe hye hxe hfy
  constructor
  · rw [hfe]
    simp only [neg_smul, smul_neg, smul_sub, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp, one_smul]
    abel
  · simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [hye]
    module
  · simp only [inv_inv, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [hxe]
    simp only [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp, mul_one]
  · simp only [inv_inv, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [hfy]
    simp only [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.orderedSpan_inv
statement: lemma orderedSpan_inv : orderedSpan q⁻¹ Λ e X y f = orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedSpan, M4, M3, inv_pow, A2Integral.qDivPow_inv']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.genRing_inv
statement: lemma genRing_inv : genRing q⁻¹ Λ e f = genRing q Λ e f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [genRing, inv_pow, A2Integral.qDivPow_inv']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.orderedSpan_smul_le
statement:
lemma orderedSpan_smul_le {u v : k} (hu : u ∈ Λ) (hv : v ∈ Λ) :
    orderedSpan q Λ e (u • X) (v • y) f ≤ orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_
  rintro z ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, rfl⟩
  simp only [M4, M3, qDivPow_smul_pow, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  exact smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem hc (mul_mem (pow_mem hv _) (pow_mem hu _)))
    (M4_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (X := X) (y := y) (f := f) a b c' d)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.orderedSpan_smul
statement:
lemma orderedSpan_smul {u v : k} (hu0 : u ≠ 0) (hv0 : v ≠ 0)
    (hu : u ∈ Λ) (hu' : u⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (hv : v ∈ Λ) (hv' : v⁻¹ ∈ Λ) :
    orderedSpan q Λ e (u • X) (v • y) f = orderedSpan q Λ e X y f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (orderedSpan_smul_le hu hv) ?_
  have h := orderedSpan_smul_le (q := q) (e := e) (X := u • X) (y := v • y) (f := f) hu' hv'
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu0, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv0, one_smul] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2Integral.coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing_of_op
statement:
theorem coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing_of_op (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 2) n ≠ 0)
    (H : B2PBW.Rel (q ^ 2) (op e) (qInt q 2 • op X) (op y) (op f))
    (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) :
    (orderedSpan q Λ e X y f : Set B) = genRing q Λ e f
proof:
:= by
  have H' := H.inv_of_op (pow_ne_zero 2 hq0)
  have hrel : B2PBW.Rel (q⁻¹ ^ 2) e
      (qInt q⁻¹ 2 • (q ^ 2 • X)) (-q ^ 2 • y) f := by
    simpa only [inv_pow, A2Integral.qInt_inv', smul_smul, mul_comm, unop_op] using H'
  have hqi' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q⁻¹ n ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [A2Integral.qInt_inv'] using hqi
  have hpi' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q⁻¹ ^ 2) n ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [inv_pow, A2Integral.qInt_inv'] using hpi
  have h := coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing (inv_ne_zero hq0) hqi' hpi' hrel hqΛ'
    (by simpa only [inv_inv] using hqΛ)
  rw [orderedSpan_inv, genRing_inv, orderedSpan_smul (pow_ne_zero 2 hq0)
    (neg_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero 2 hq0)) (pow_mem hqΛ 2)
    (by simpa only [inv_pow] using pow_mem hqΛ' 2) (neg_mem (pow_mem hqΛ 2))
    (by simpa only [inv_neg, inv_pow] using neg_mem (pow_mem hqΛ' 2))] at h
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.qInt_gaussian_pos
statement:
lemma qInt_gaussian_pos (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    qInt q n = q ^ (1 - (n : ℤ)) *
      (gaussian n).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := qInt_gaussian (inv_ne_zero hq) n
  rw [A2Integral.qInt_inv', inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg] at h
  simpa only [neg_sub, inv_zpow, zpow_neg, inv_pow, inv_inv, zpow_ofNat] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.normalize_a
statement:
lemma normalize_a (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) :
    (if a = 0 then 0 else q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a *
      laurentScalar q (a - 1) (b + 1) c) =
    scale q a b c * (gaussian (3 * a)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial (a - 1) (b + 1) c).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with _ | a
  · simp [gaussian]
  · simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false, ↓reduceIte,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [show q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (a + 1) =
      q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q (3 * (a + 1)) by
        rw [mul_assoc, qInt_three_mul_all]]
    simp only [qInt_gaussian_pos hq, laurentScalar, scale]
    have hp : q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * q ^ (1 - (3 * (a + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        q ^ weight a (b + 1) c =
        q ^ (1 - (2 * ((a + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + b + c) + weight (a + 1) b c) := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast q⁻¹, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg]
      simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      unfold weight
      ring
    push_cast at hp ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 : k) ^ c *
      (gaussian (3 * (a + 1))).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a (b + 1) c).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) * hp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.normalize_btwo
statement:
lemma normalize_btwo (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) :
    (if b < 2 then 0 else (q ^ 2 - 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) *
      qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b * laurentScalar q a (b - 2) (c + 1)) =
    scale q a b c * (1 - q ^ 2) * (q ^ 2) ^ (3 * a) *
      (gaussian (b - 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (gaussian b).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a (b - 2) (c + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with _ | _ | b
  · simp [gaussian]
  · simp [gaussian]
  · simp only [show ¬b + 1 + 1 < 2 by omega, ↓reduceIte,
      show b + 1 + 1 - 1 = b + 1 by omega, show b + 1 + 1 - 2 = b by omega]
    simp only [qInt_gaussian_pos hq, laurentScalar, scale, pow_succ (-1 : k) c]
    have hp : q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * q ^ (1 - (b + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        q ^ (1 - (b + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * q ^ weight a b (c + 1) =
        q ^ (1 - (2 * (a : ℤ) + (b + 1 + 1 : ℕ) + c) + weight a (b + 1 + 1) c) *
          (q ^ 2) ^ (3 * a) := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast q⁻¹, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg,
        ← zpow_natCast (q ^ 2), ← zpow_natCast q 2, ← zpow_mul]
      simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      unfold weight
      ring
    push_cast at hp ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 : k) ^ c * (1 - q ^ 2) *
      (gaussian (b + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (gaussian (b + 1 + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a b (c + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) * hp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.normalize_bone
statement:
lemma normalize_bone (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) :
    (if b = 0 then 0 else q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (4 * c) * qInt q 2 * qInt q b *
      laurentScalar q a (b - 1) c) =
    scale q a b c * (q ^ 2) ^ (3 * a + b - 1) * (1 + q ^ 2) *
      (gaussian b).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a (b - 1) c).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with _ | b
  · simp [gaussian]
  · simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false, ↓reduceIte,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hg : (gaussian 2).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) = 1 + q ^ 2 := by
      simp [gaussian, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    simp only [qInt_gaussian_pos hq, hg, laurentScalar, scale]
    have hp : q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (4 * c) * q ^ (1 - (2 : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        q ^ (1 - (b + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * q ^ weight a b c =
        q ^ (1 - (2 * (a : ℤ) + (b + 1 : ℕ) + c) + weight a (b + 1) c) *
          (q ^ 2) ^ (3 * a + (b + 1) - 1) := by
      rw [show 3 * a + (b + 1) - 1 = 3 * a + b by omega,
        ← zpow_natCast q⁻¹, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg,
        ← zpow_natCast q (a + 1), ← zpow_natCast (q ^ 2),
        ← zpow_natCast q 2, ← zpow_mul]
      simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      unfold weight
      ring
    push_cast at hp ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 : k) ^ c * (1 + q ^ 2) *
      (gaussian (b + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a b c).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) * hp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.normalize_c
statement:
lemma normalize_c (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) :
    -(if c = 0 then 0 else q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * c) *
      qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c * laurentScalar q a b (c - 1)) =
    scale q a b c * (q ^ 2) ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) *
      (gaussian (3 * c)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a b (c - 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with _ | c
  · simp [gaussian]
  · simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false, ↓reduceIte,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [show q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (c + 1)) * qInt q 3 *
      qInt (q ^ 3) (c + 1) = q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (c + 1)) *
      qInt q (3 * (c + 1)) by rw [mul_assoc _ (qInt q 3), qInt_three_mul_all]]
    simp only [qInt_gaussian_pos hq, laurentScalar, scale, pow_succ (-1 : k) c]
    have hp : q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (c + 1)) *
        q ^ (1 - (3 * (c + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * q ^ weight a b c =
        q ^ (1 - (2 * (a : ℤ) + b + (c + 1 : ℕ)) + weight a b (c + 1)) *
          (q ^ 2) ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast q⁻¹, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg,
        ← zpow_natCast q (2 * a + 2), ← zpow_natCast (q ^ 2),
        ← zpow_natCast q 2, ← zpow_mul]
      simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      unfold weight
      ring
    push_cast at hp ⊢
    linear_combination -(-1 : k) ^ c *
      (gaussian (3 * (c + 1))).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a b c).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) * hp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.laurentScalar_recurrence
statement:
lemma laurentScalar_recurrence (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) :
    qInt q (2 * a + b + c) * laurentScalar q a b c =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a *
        laurentScalar q (a - 1) (b + 1) c) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else (q ^ 2 - 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) *
        qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b * laurentScalar q a (b - 2) (c + 1)) +
      (if b = 0 then 0 else q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (4 * c) * qInt q 2 * qInt q b *
        laurentScalar q a (b - 1) c) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * c) * qInt q 3 *
        qInt (q ^ 3) c * laurentScalar q a b (c - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, normalize_a hq, normalize_btwo hq, normalize_bone hq, normalize_c hq]
  have hr := congrArg (fun p : ℤ[X] ↦ p.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2))
    (scalarPolynomial_recurrence a b c)
  simp only [eval₂_mul, eval₂_add, eval₂_sub, eval₂_pow, eval₂_X, eval₂_one] at hr
  have hl : qInt q (2 * a + b + c) * laurentScalar q a b c =
      scale q a b c * (gaussian (2 * a + b + c)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
        (scalarPolynomial a b c).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) := by
    simp only [qInt_gaussian_pos hq, laurentScalar, scale]
    have hp : q ^ (1 - (2 * a + b + c : ℕ) : ℤ) * q ^ weight a b c =
        q ^ (1 - (2 * (a : ℤ) + b + c) + weight a b c) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hq]
      push_cast
      rfl
    linear_combination (-1 : k) ^ c *
      (gaussian (2 * a + b + c)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) *
      (scalarPolynomial a b c).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ 2) * hp
  rw [hl]
  linear_combination scale q a b c * hr

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.laurentScalar_zero
statement: lemma laurentScalar_zero : laurentScalar q 0 0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [laurentScalar, scalarPolynomial_zero, weight]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.deScalar_eq_laurentScalar
statement:
theorem deScalar_eq_laurentScalar (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) :
    deScalar q a b c = laurentScalar q a b c
proof:
:= by
  generalize hn : 2 * a + b + c = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing a b c with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hzero : n = 0
    · have ha : a = 0 := by omega
      have hb : b = 0 := by omega
      have hc : c = 0 := by omega
      subst a; subst b; subst c
      rw [deScalar_zero, laurentScalar_zero]
    have hpos : 0 < 2 * a + b + c := by omega
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (hqi _ hpos)
    rw [deScalar_recurrence hqi a b c hpos, laurentScalar_recurrence hq]
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      · congr 1
        · split_ifs with ha
          · rfl
          · rw [ih (2 * (a - 1) + (b + 1) + c) (by omega) (a - 1) (b + 1) c rfl]
        · split_ifs with hb
          · rfl
          · rw [ih (2 * a + (b - 2) + (c + 1)) (by omega) a (b - 2) (c + 1) rfl]
      · split_ifs with hb
        · rfl
        · rw [ih (2 * a + (b - 1) + c) (by omega) a (b - 1) c rfl]
    · split_ifs with hc
      · rfl
      · rw [ih (2 * a + b + (c - 1)) (by omega) a b (c - 1) rfl]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.laurentScalar_mem
statement:
lemma laurentScalar_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ)
    (a b c : ℕ) : laurentScalar q a b c ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  exact Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.neg_mem Λ.one_mem) c)
    (laurent_zpow_mem Λ hqΛ hiΛ _))
    (intPolynomial_eval_mem Λ (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ 2) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deScalar_mem
statement:
theorem deScalar_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (a b c : ℕ) :
    deScalar q a b c ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [DECancellation.deScalar_eq_laurentScalar hq hqi]
  exact DECancellation.laurentScalar_mem Λ hqΛ hiΛ a b c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.z_mul_x2_raw
statement:
lemma z_mul_x2_raw (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (h6 : (1 + (q ^ 4) + (-1 * (q ^ 2))) ≠ 0)
    (h4 : (1 + (q ^ 4)) ≠ 0)
    (hS4 : qSerre q 4 e f = 0) (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e = 0) :
    G2PBW.z q e f * G2PBW.x2 q e f =
      (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (G2PBW.x2 q e f * G2PBW.z q e f)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreTriSubmodule_eq_tensorSup
statement:
theorem serreTriSubmodule_eq_tensorSup :
    serreTriSubmodule Y D v =
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (serreSubmodule D v).subtype
        (LinearMap.id : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y ⊗[k] LusztigF k I →ₗ[k] _)) ⊔
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : LusztigF k I →ₗ[k] _)
        (toralSerreSubmodule (Y := Y) (D := D) v).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨y, g, x, rfl, hy | hx⟩
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨⟨y, mem_serreSubmodule.mpr hy⟩ ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x), rfl⟩
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right
        ⟨y ⊗ₜ ⟨g ⊗ₜ x, ⟨g ⊗ₜ ⟨x, mem_serreSubmodule.mpr hx⟩, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  · apply sup_le
    · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
      induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul y w =>
        exact tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_left' (D := D) (v := v) (Y := Y)
          (mem_serreSubmodule.mp y.property) w
      | add a b ha hb => simpa only [map_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
    · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
      induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul y w =>
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := w.property
        change y ⊗ₜ w.val ∈ _
        rw [← hz]
        clear hz w
        induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
        | tmul g x =>
          exact tmul_mem_serreTriSubmodule_right y g
            (mem_serreSubmodule.mp x.property)
        | add a b ha hb =>
          simpa only [map_add, tmul_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
      | add a b ha hb => simpa only [map_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul
    (y : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v))) (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y)
    (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    triangularMultiplicationEquiv R v hv (y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x)) =
      (y : QuantumGroup R v) * zeroHom R v g * (x : QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (serreQuotientEquivMinus R v hv).surjective y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (serreQuotientEquivPlus R v hv).surjective x
  induction y using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H y =>
    induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | H x => simp [triangularMultiplicationEquiv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finiteTypeFullPBWBasis_apply
statement:
theorem finiteTypeFullPBWBasis_apply (a c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) (μ : Y) :
    finiteTypeFullPBWBasis R v hv P hD hω hw (a, μ, c) =
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω a * QuantumGroup.K R v μ *
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteTypeFullPBWBasis, finiteTypeNegativePBWBasis_apply, finiteTypePBWBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finiteTypeFullPBWBasis_sum_repr
statement:
theorem finiteTypeFullPBWBasis_sum_repr (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    ((finiteTypeFullPBWBasis R v hv P hD hω hw).repr x).sum
      (fun t a ↦ a • (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω t.1 *
        QuantumGroup.K R v t.2.1 *
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω t.2.2)) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hvec (t : (Fin ω.length → ℕ) × Y × (Fin ω.length → ℕ)) :
      finiteTypeFullPBWBasis R v hv P hD hω hw t =
        CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω t.1 *
          QuantumGroup.K R v t.2.1 *
          CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω t.2.2 :=
    finiteTypeFullPBWBasis_apply R v hv P hD hω hw t.1 t.2.2 t.2.1
  simpa only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, hvec] using
    (finiteTypeFullPBWBasis R v hv P hD hω hw).linearCombination_repr x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_finiteTypeFullPBWBasis
statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypeFullPBWBasis :
    ∃ ω : List I, (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω ∧
      (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD ∧
      ∃ b : Basis ((Fin ω.length → ℕ) × Y × (Fin ω.length → ℕ)) k (QuantumGroup R v),
        ∀ a μ c, b (a, μ, c) =
          CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) ω a * QuantumGroup.K R v μ *
            CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hw⟩ :=
    (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).exists_isReduced (finiteTypeLongest P hD)
  exact ⟨ω, hω, hw.symm, finiteTypeFullPBWBasis R v hv P hD hω hw.symm,
    fun a μ c ↦ finiteTypeFullPBWBasis_apply R v hv P hD hω hw.symm a c μ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.cubic_div_mul
statement:
lemma cubic_div_mul {t c : k} {x z y : B} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hti : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt t n ≠ 0)
    (hyx : y * x = t⁻¹ • (x * y) - c • z)
    (hyz : y * z = (t ^ 3)⁻¹ • (z * y)) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow t (n + 1) y * x = t⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) • (x * qDivPow t (n + 1) y) -
      (t⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) * c) • (z * qDivPow t n y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero'] using hyx
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc : qInt t (n + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hti _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt t (n + 1) ≠ 0 := hti _ (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow t y (n + 1) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc y x, hyx, ← mul_assoc y z, hyz]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow t y (n + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow t y n hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := t) (n + 1)]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try simp only [inv_pow])
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_mul_cube
statement:
lemma qDivPow_mul_cube (q : k) (z : B)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q n z * z ^ 3 =
      (qInt q (n + 1) * qInt q (n + 2) * qInt q (n + 3)) • qDivPow q (n + 3) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, pow_two, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self z n (hqi _ (by omega)), smul_mul_assoc,
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self z (n + 1) (hqi _ (by omega)), smul_smul,
    smul_mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self z (n + 2) (hqi _ (by omega)), smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.longCoeff_step_all
statement:
lemma longCoeff_step_all (n d : ℕ) :
    qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1) * longCoeff q (n + 1 + d) (n + 1) =
      longCoeff q (n + 1 + d) n * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (2 * d) *
        ((q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 / (q ^ 2 * qInt q 3)) *
        (qInt q (3 * n + 1) * qInt q (3 * n + 2) * qInt q (3 * n + 3))
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := hqi 3 (by omega)
  have hp := qInt_three_mul_all (q := q) (n + 1)
  rw [show 3 * (n + 1) = 3 * n + 3 by omega] at hp
  simp only [longCoeff, prod_range_succ, longStep, show n + 1 + d - 1 - n = d by omega]
  rw [← hp]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.longCoeff_step
statement:
lemma longCoeff_step (n d : ℕ) :
    qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1) * longCoeff q (n + 1 + d) (n + 1) =
      longCoeff q (n + 1 + d) n * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (2 * d) *
        ((q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 / (q ^ 2 * qInt q 3)) *
        (qInt q (3 * n + 1) * qInt q (3 * n + 2) * qInt q (3 * n + 3))
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact longCoeff_step_all hq hqi n d

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.longW_mul_all
statement:
lemma longW_mul_all (s n : ℕ) :
    longW q z y s n * x = ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ s * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) •
      (x * longW q z y s n) - qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1) • longW q z y s (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hz (a : ℕ) : qDivPow q a z * x =
      (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a • (x * qDivPow q a z) := by
    simpa only [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_one] using
      B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm (u := q) (u' := q ^ 3) hzx a 1
  have hyz3 : y * z ^ 3 = ((q ^ 3) ^ 3)⁻¹ • (z ^ 3 * y) := by
    rw [show z ^ 3 = z * z * z by noncomm_ring]
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hyz, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc z y, hyz,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc z z y, mul_assoc _ y, hyz,
      mul_smul_comm,
      smul_smul]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    ring
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy n s with h | rfl | h
  · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, s = n + 1 + d := ⟨s - n - 1, by omega⟩
    have hsn : n + 1 + d - n = d + 1 := by omega
    have hsn' : n + 1 + d - (n + 1) = d := by omega
    simp only [longW, show n ≤ n + 1 + d by omega, show n + 1 ≤ n + 1 + d by omega,
      ite_true, hsn, hsn', smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    rw [cubic_div_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hq) hpi hyx hyz3 d, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc _ x, hz, smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ (z ^ 3),
      qDivPow_mul_cube q z hqi]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
      show 3 * (n + 1) = 3 * n + 3 by omega]
    have hc := longCoeff_step_all hq hqi n d
    match_scalars
    · simp only [inv_pow]
      ring
    · linear_combination hc
  · simp only [longW, le_refl, ite_true, Nat.sub_self, qDivPow_zero', mul_one,
      show ¬ n + 1 ≤ n by omega, ite_false, smul_zero, sub_zero, smul_mul_assoc, hz,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [inv_pow]
    ring
  · simp [longW, show ¬ n ≤ s by omega, show ¬ n + 1 ≤ s by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.longW_mul
statement:
lemma longW_mul (s n : ℕ) :
    longW q z y s n * x = ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ s * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) •
      (x * longW q z y s n) - qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1) • longW q z y s (n + 1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_long_pair_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_long_pair_all (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s y * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r x =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam (q ^ 3) ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow (q ^ 3) (r - n) x * longW q z y s n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [longW_zero] using B2Integral.straighten_param (pow_ne_zero _ hq) hpi
    ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ s) (longW_mul_all hq hqi hpi hyx hzx hyz s) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_long_pair
statement:
theorem qDivPow_long_pair (s r : ℕ) :

      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam (q ^ 3) ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow (q ^ 3) (r - n) x * longW q z y s n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.longCoeff_mem
statement:
lemma longCoeff_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s n : ℕ) :
    longCoeff q s n ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  apply Λ.prod_mem
  intro j _
  have hInv : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by simpa only [inv_pow] using Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ 3
  exact Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem
    (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.sub_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ 2) Λ.one_mem) 2)
      (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ 2)) (Λ.pow_mem hInv _))
    (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqiΛ _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqiΛ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.long_pair_coeff_mem
statement:
lemma long_pair_coeff_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s r n : ℕ) :
    B2Integral.sCoefParam (q ^ 3) ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ s) r n * longCoeff q s n ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hInv : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by simpa only [inv_pow] using Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ 3
  exact Λ.mul_mem
    (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.neg_mem Λ.one_mem) _)
      (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.pow_mem hInv _) _)) (Λ.pow_mem hInv _))
    (longCoeff_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ s n)
