name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deStepTerm_apply
statement:
lemma deStepTerm_apply (i : DEIndex) (a b c d : ℕ) :
    deStepTerm q i (a, b, c, d) =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else if i = (a - 1, b + 1, c, d) then
        q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a else 0) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else if i = (a, b - 2, c + 1, d) then
        q ^ d * (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b else 0) +
      (if b = 0 then 0 else if i = (a, b - 1, c, d + 1) then
        q * qInt q 2 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q b else 0) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else if i = (a, b, c - 1, d + 2) then
        q⁻¹ ^ d * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨u, v, w, z⟩
  simp only [deStepTerm, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.sub_apply]
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    · congr 1
      · split_ifs <;> simp_all [Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq] <;> omega
      · split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply,
          Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq]
        all_goals
          (try split_ifs) <;> simp_all <;> try omega
        all_goals rw [show b - 2 + 1 = b - 1 by omega]; simp
    · split_ifs <;> simp_all [Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq] <;> omega
  · split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq]
    all_goals
      (try split_ifs) <;> simp_all <;> try omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deStep_apply
statement:
lemma deStep_apply (F : DEIndex →₀ k) (a b c d : ℕ) :
    deStep q F (a, b, c, d) =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else F (a - 1, b + 1, c, d) *
        (q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a)) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else F (a, b - 2, c + 1, d) *
        (q ^ d * (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b)) +
      (if b = 0 then 0 else F (a, b - 1, c, d + 1) *
        (q * qInt q 2 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q b)) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else F (a, b, c - 1, d + 2) *
        (q⁻¹ ^ d * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [deStep, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, deStepTerm_apply,
    mul_add, mul_sub, sum_add_distrib, sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    · congr 1
      all_goals
        split_ifs
        · simp
        · simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero, sum_ite_eq']
          split_ifs with hs
          · rfl
          · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs, zero_mul]
    · split_ifs
      · simp
      · simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero, sum_ite_eq']
        split_ifs with hs
        · rfl
        · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs, zero_mul]
  · split_ifs
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero, sum_ite_eq']
      split_ifs with hs
      · rfl
      · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deNumerator_eq_zero_of_grade
statement:
lemma deNumerator_eq_zero_of_grade (s n a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ¬ (2 * a + b + c = n ∧ a + b + 2 * c + d = s)) :
    deNumerator q s n (a, b, c, d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a b c d with
  | zero =>
    simp only [deNumerator, Finsupp.single_apply]
    rw [ite_eq_right (by simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [deNumerator, deStep_apply]
    have h₁ : a ≠ 0 → deNumerator q s n (a - 1, b + 1, c, d) = 0 :=
      fun ha ↦ ih _ _ _ _ (by omega)
    have h₂ : ¬ b < 2 → deNumerator q s n (a, b - 2, c + 1, d) = 0 :=
      fun hb ↦ ih _ _ _ _ (by omega)
    have h₃ : b ≠ 0 → deNumerator q s n (a, b - 1, c, d + 1) = 0 :=
      fun hb ↦ ih _ _ _ _ (by omega)
    have h₄ : c ≠ 0 → deNumerator q s n (a, b, c - 1, d + 2) = 0 :=
      fun hc ↦ ih _ _ _ _ (by omega)
    split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deCoeff_recurrence
statement:
lemma deCoeff_recurrence (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (s n a b c d : ℕ) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * deCoeff q s (n + 1) (a, b, c, d) =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a - 1, b + 1, c, d) *
        (q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a)) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a, b - 2, c + 1, d) *
        (q ^ d * (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b)) +
      (if b = 0 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a, b - 1, c, d + 1) *
        (q * qInt q 2 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q b)) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a, b, c - 1, d + 2) *
        (q⁻¹ ^ d * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c))
proof:
:= by
  have hn := hqi (n + 1) (by omega)
  simp only [deCoeff, deNumerator, deStep_apply, qFactorial_succ, mul_inv_rev]
  split_ifs <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deCoeff_eq_zero_of_grade
statement:
lemma deCoeff_eq_zero_of_grade (s n a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ¬ (2 * a + b + c = n ∧ a + b + 2 * c + d = s)) :
    deCoeff q s n (a, b, c, d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [deCoeff, deNumerator_eq_zero_of_grade s n a b c d h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deScale_A
statement:
lemma deScale_A (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    deScale q (a - 1) c d * (q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1)) =
      deScale q a c d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold deScale
  have hp : q ^ ((d : ℤ) * ((a - 1 : ℕ) - c)) * q ^ d =
      q ^ ((d : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - c)) := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast q d, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
    congr 1
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ a)]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [← mul_assoc, hp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deScale_BB
statement:
lemma deScale_BB (hq : q ≠ 0) (a c d : ℕ) :
    deScale q a (c + 1) d * (q ^ d * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c) =
      deScale q a c d * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deScale, ← inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
  have hp : q ^ ((d : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - (c + 1 : ℕ))) * q ^ d =
      q ^ ((d : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) - c)) := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast q d, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [← mul_assoc, hp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deScale_B
statement:
lemma deScale_B (hq : q ≠ 0) (a c d : ℕ) :
    deScale q a c (d + 1) * (q * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c) =
      deScale q a c d * (q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (4 * c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show q * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c = q ^ (1 : ℤ) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c by rw [zpow_one]]
  simp only [deScale, ← zpow_natCast, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_mul]
  simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deScale_C
statement:
lemma deScale_C (hq : q ≠ 0) (a c d : ℕ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    deScale q a (c - 1) (d + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ d =
      deScale q a c d * (q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * c))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deScale, ← zpow_natCast, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg]
  simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
  congr 1
  rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ c)]
  push_cast
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deCoeff_eq_deScalar
statement:
theorem deCoeff_eq_deScalar (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (s n a b c d : ℕ) (hn : 2 * a + b + c = n) (hs : a + b + 2 * c + d = s) :
    deCoeff q s n (a, b, c, d) = deScale q a c d * deScalar q a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a b c d with
  | zero =>
    have ha : a = 0 := by omega
    have hb : b = 0 := by omega
    have hc : c = 0 := by omega
    subst a; subst b; subst c
    have hd : d = s := by omega
    subst d
    simp [deCoeff, deNumerator, qFactorial, deScale]
  | succ n ih =>
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (hqi (n + 1) (by omega))
    rw [deCoeff_recurrence hqi]
    have hr := deScalar_recurrence hqi a b c (by omega)
    rw [hn] at hr
    have h₁ :
        (if a = 0 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a - 1, b + 1, c, d) *
          (q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a)) =
        deScale q a c d * (if a = 0 then 0 else
          q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a *
            deScalar q (a - 1) (b + 1) c) := by
      split_ifs with ha
      · ring
      · rw [ih _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        linear_combination
          deScalar q (a - 1) (b + 1) c * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a *
            deScale_A hq a b c d ha
    have h₂ :
        (if b < 2 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a, b - 2, c + 1, d) *
          (q ^ d * (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b)) =
        deScale q a c d * (if b < 2 then 0 else
          (q ^ 2 - 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b *
            deScalar q a (b - 2) (c + 1)) := by
      split_ifs with hb
      · ring
      · rw [ih _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        linear_combination
          (q ^ 2 - 1) * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b * deScalar q a (b - 2) (c + 1) *
            deScale_BB hq a c d
    have h₃ :
        (if b = 0 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a, b - 1, c, d + 1) *
          (q * qInt q 2 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q b)) =
        deScale q a c d * (if b = 0 then 0 else
          q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (4 * c) * qInt q 2 * qInt q b * deScalar q a (b - 1) c) := by
      split_ifs with hb
      · ring
      · rw [ih _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        linear_combination
          qInt q 2 * qInt q b * deScalar q a (b - 1) c * deScale_B hq a c d
    have h₄ :
        (if c = 0 then 0 else deCoeff q s n (a, b, c - 1, d + 2) *
          (q⁻¹ ^ d * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c)) =
        deScale q a c d * (if c = 0 then 0 else
          q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * c) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c *
            deScalar q a b (c - 1)) := by
      split_ifs with hc
      · ring
      · rw [ih _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        linear_combination
          qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c * deScalar q a b (c - 1) * deScale_C hq a c d hc
    rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
    linear_combination -deScale q a c d * hr

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deCoeff_mem
statement:
theorem deCoeff_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s n : ℕ) (i : DEIndex) :
    deCoeff q s n i ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨a, b, c, d⟩
  by_cases hg : 2 * a + b + c = n ∧ a + b + 2 * c + d = s
  · rw [deCoeff_eq_deScalar hq hqi s n a b c d hg.1 hg.2]
    exact Λ.mul_mem (laurent_zpow_mem Λ hqΛ hiΛ _) (deScalar_mem hq hqi Λ hqΛ hiΛ _ _ _)
  · rw [deCoeff_eq_zero_of_grade s n a b c d hg]
    exact Λ.zero_mem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deNumerator_grade
statement:
lemma deNumerator_grade (s n : ℕ) (i : DEIndex) (hi : deNumerator q s n i ≠ 0) :
    2 * i.1 + i.2.1 + i.2.2.1 = n ∧ i.1 + i.2.1 + 2 * i.2.2.1 + i.2.2.2 = s
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  exact hi (deNumerator_eq_zero_of_grade s n i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2 hn)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deStepTerm_eval
statement:
lemma deStepTerm_eval (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (i : DEIndex) :
    deEval q A b C D (deStepTerm q i) =
      (q ^ i.2.2.2 * q⁻¹ ^ i.2.1 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ i.1) •
        (e * deMonomial q A b C D i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2) -
      deMonomial q A b C D i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2 * e
proof:
:= by
  have hm := deMonomial_e hq hqi hpi H i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2
  simp only [deStepTerm, map_add, map_sub, deEval]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_zero, Finsupp.linearCombination_single] <;>
    simp_all only [ite_true, ite_false] <;> abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deNumerator_eval_mul
statement:
lemma deNumerator_eval_mul (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (s n : ℕ) :
    deEval q A b C D (deNumerator q s n) * e =
      (q ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * deEval q A b C D (deNumerator q s n)) -
        deEval q A b C D (deNumerator q s (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ht (i : DEIndex) (hi : i ∈ (deNumerator q s n).support) :
      deEval q A b C D (deStepTerm q i) =
        (q ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) •
          (e * deMonomial q A b C D i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2) -
        deMonomial q A b C D i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2 * e := by
    rw [deStepTerm_eval hq hqi hpi H]
    have hg := deNumerator_grade s n i (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi)
    have hp : q ^ i.2.2.2 * q⁻¹ ^ i.2.1 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ i.1 =
        q ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) := by
      simp only [← zpow_natCast, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      omega
    rw [hp]
  simp only [deNumerator, deStep, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    map_sum, map_smul]
  simp only [deEval, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have h := ht i hi
  simp only [deEval, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] at h
  rw [← Finset.smul_sum, h, smul_sub]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deW_zero
statement: lemma deW_zero (s : ℕ) : deW q A b C D s 0 = qDivPow q s D
proof:
:= by
  simp [deW, deNumerator, deEval, deMonomial, P3, qFactorial, qDivPow_zero']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deW_mul
statement:
lemma deW_mul (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (s n : ℕ) :
    deW q A b C D s n * e = (q ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * deW q A b C D s n) -
      qInt q (n + 1) • deW q A b C D s (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := hqi (n + 1) (by omega)
  simp only [deW, smul_mul_assoc, deNumerator_eval_mul hq hqi hpi H,
    smul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, qFactorial_succ, mul_inv_rev]
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    ring
  · congr 1
    field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deW_sum
statement:
lemma deW_sum (s n : ℕ) : deW q A b C D s n =
    ∑ i ∈ (deNumerator q s n).support,
      deCoeff q s n i • deMonomial q A b C D i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deW, deEval, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, deCoeff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deW_eq_sum
statement:
theorem deW_eq_sum (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (s n : ℕ) :
    deW q A b C D s n = ∑ i ∈ (deNumerator q s n).support,
      (q ^ ((i.2.2.2 : ℤ) * ((i.1 : ℤ) - i.2.2.1)) *
        deScalar q i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1) •
          deMonomial q A b C D i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [deW_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hg := deNumerator_grade s n i (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi)
  rw [deCoeff_eq_deScalar hq hqi s n i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2 hg.1 hg.2, deScale]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_e
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_e (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s D * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef q s r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * deW q A b C D s n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← deW_zero (q := q) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C) s]
  exact B2Integral.straighten hq hqi s (deW_mul hq hqi hpi H s) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_e_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_e_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) {Λ : Subring k} (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ)
    (s r : ℕ) : qDivPow q s D * qDivPow q r e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_e hq hqi hpi H]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hiΛ s r n)
  rw [deW_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_smul_comm]
  apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (deCoeff_mem hq hqi Λ hqΛ hiΛ s n i)
  simpa [M6, M5, deMonomial, qDivPow_zero', mul_assoc] using
    M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
      (D := D) (f := f) (r - n) i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2.1 i.2.2.2 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x2_mul_x3_raw
statement:
lemma x2_mul_x3_raw (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (h4 : (1 + (q ^ 4)) ≠ 0)
    (hS4 : qSerre q 4 e f = 0) (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e = 0) :
    G2PBW.x2 q e f * G2PBW.x3 q e f =
      (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (G2PBW.x3 q e f * G2PBW.x2 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ((q ^ 7) * (1 + (q ^ 4))) ≠ 0 := by
    aesop
  have key : ((q ^ 7) * (1 + (q ^ 4))) •
      (G2PBW.x2 q e f * G2PBW.x3 q e f - (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (G2PBW.x3 q e f * G2PBW.x2 q e f)) =
      ((-1 * (q ^ 2))) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * e * e * e)) +
      ((q ^ 2)) • ((f) * ((qSerre q 4 e f) * (e))) +
      ((q + (q ^ 3))) • ((f * e) * (qSerre q 4 e f)) +
      (((-1 * (q ^ 2)) + (-1 * (q ^ 4)) + (-1 * (q ^ 8)))) • ((qSerre q 4 e f) * (f * e)) +
      (((q ^ 5) + (q ^ 7))) • ((qSerre q 4 e f) * (e * f)) +
      ((-1 + (-1 * (q ^ 4)) + (-1 * (q ^ 6)))) • ((e * f) * (qSerre q 4 e f)) +
      ((1 + (q ^ 2) + (q ^ 4) + (q ^ 6))) • ((e) * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * e * e))) +
      ((q ^ 6)) • ((e) * ((qSerre q 4 e f) * (f))) +
      ((-1 + (-1 * (q ^ 2)) + (-1 * (q ^ 6)) + (-1 * (q ^ 8)) + (-2 * (q ^ 4)))) • ((e * e) *
        ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * e))) +
      (((q ^ 2) + (q ^ 4) + (q ^ 6) + (q ^ 8))) • ((e * e * e) * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e))) +
      ((-1 * (q ^ 6))) • ((e * e * e * e) * (qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e)) := by
    simp only [G2PBW.x1, G2PBW.x2, G2PBW.x3, qSerre,
      Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
      smul_sub, smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add,
      Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  rw [hS4, hS2] at key
  simp only [zero_mul, mul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero] at key
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((smul_eq_zero.mp key).resolve_left hd)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Rel.squareRel_shift
statement: theorem Rel.squareRel_shift (H : Rel q e A b C D f) : SquareRel q b C D f
proof:
:=
  ⟨H.CB, H.DB, H.DC, H.fB, H.fD⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Rel.squareRel_op
statement:
theorem Rel.squareRel_op (H : Rel q e A b C D f) :
    SquareRel q (op D) (op C) (op b) (op A) where
  Ae
proof:
:= by simpa only [op_mul, op_smul] using congrArg op H.DC
  Be := by simpa only [op_mul, op_smul, op_sub] using congrArg op H.DB
  BA := by simpa only [op_mul, op_smul] using congrArg op H.CB
  Ce := by simpa only [op_mul, op_smul, op_sub, op_pow] using congrArg op H.DA
  CB := by simpa only [op_mul, op_smul] using congrArg op H.BA

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.square_straightening_coeff_mem
statement:
lemma square_straightening_coeff_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s r n : ℕ) (i : SquareIndex) :
    B2Integral.sCoefParam q 1 r n * squareCoeff q s n i ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  apply Λ.mul_mem _ (squareCoeff_mem hq hqi Λ hqΛ hqiΛ s n i)
  simpa only [B2Integral.sCoefParam, one_pow, mul_one] using
    Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.neg_mem Λ.one_mem) n) (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ (n * (r - n)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_b_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_b_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q r b ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  rw [SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum hq hqi hpi H.squareRel_shift]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (square_straightening_coeff_mem hq hqi hqΛ hqiΛ s r n i)
  simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', mul_assoc] using
    M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
      (D := D) (f := f) 0 0 (r - n) i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.unop_qDivPow
statement:
private lemma unop_qDivPow (t : k) (n : ℕ) (x : B) :
    unop (qDivPow t n (op x)) = qDivPow t n x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qDivPow, unop_smul, unop_pow, unop_op]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_A_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_A_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s D * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r A ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg unop
    (SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum hq hqi hpi H.squareRel_op r s)
  simp only [unop_mul, unop_sum, unop_smul, unop_qDivPow] at h
  rw [h]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (square_straightening_coeff_mem hq hqi hqΛ hqiΛ r s n i)
  simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', mul_assoc] using
    M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b) (C := C)
      (D := D) (f := f) 0 i.2.2 i.2.1 i.1 (s - n) 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mem_adjoin
statement: lemma E_mem_adjoin (l : I) : E R v l ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨l, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.X_mem_adjoin
statement:
lemma X_mem_adjoin (q Q : k) (n : ℕ) :
    X q Q (E R v i) (E R v j) n ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact E_mem_adjoin j
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [X_succ]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem (E_mem_adjoin i) ih)
      (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem ih (E_mem_adjoin i)) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a1a1_rootVector_two
statement:
theorem a1a1_rootVector_two (hij : i ≠ j) (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0)
    (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S) : S (E R v j) = E R v j
proof:
:= by
  rw [HS.map_E, ite_eq_right hij.symm, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.a2_rootVectors_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem a2_rootVectors_mem_adjoin [NeZero v] (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S)
    (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j) (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    S (E R v j) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (T (E R v i)) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [a2_rootVector_two hij HS, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem (E_mem_adjoin i) (E_mem_adjoin j))
      (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem (E_mem_adjoin j) (E_mem_adjoin i)) _)
  · rw [a2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hq]
    exact E_mem_adjoin j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_shift_zero
statement: lemma b2_shift_zero : BraidDiagonal.shift q (q ^ 2) 0 = (q ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [BraidDiagonal.shift]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_shift_one
statement: lemma b2_shift_one (hq : q ≠ 0) : BraidDiagonal.shift q (q ^ 2) 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BraidDiagonal.shift]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_shift_two
statement: lemma b2_shift_two (hq : q ≠ 0) : BraidDiagonal.shift q (q ^ 2) 2 = q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BraidDiagonal.shift]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_qFactorial_two
statement: lemma b2_qFactorial_two (hq : q ≠ 0) : qFactorial q 2 = q + q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qFactorial, qInt, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_cc_one
statement: lemma b2_cc_one (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) : cc q (q ^ 2) 1 = q + q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd
  rw [cc_mul hq hd 0]
  simp only [qInt, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_cc_two
statement: lemma b2_cc_two (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) : cc q (q ^ 2) 2 = q + q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd
  rw [cc_mul hq hd 1]
  simp only [qInt, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_negA
statement: lemma b2_negA (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2) : negA D i j = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [negA, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_sub_ne
statement: lemma b2_sub_ne : v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  rw [parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h']
  rw [b2_qFactorial_two hq0] at h2
  have e : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 - ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2)⁻¹ =
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) * (v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [e]
  exact mul_ne_zero hq h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_lowerE
statement:
lemma b2_lowerE (n : ℕ) :
    (Xb (n + 1)) * braidEi R i -
        (BraidDiagonal.shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) (n + 1))⁻¹ •
          (braidEi R i * Xb (n + 1)) =
      cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) (n + 1) • Xb n
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hs : BraidDiagonal.shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    simp [BraidDiagonal.shift, hq0]
  have H := braidDiagonal_hyp R v (NeZero.ne v) hij hq
  rw [b2_negA h] at H
  rw [tripleSix_flip hs (H.stepE (K_neg_mul_Kt i) n), smul_smul]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_rootVector_two
statement: theorem b2_rootVector_two : S (E R v j) = (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ • Xb 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hc : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 * (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2)⁻¹ = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  rw [HS.map_E, ite_eq_right hij.symm, X_eq_serreAux hq0 (pow_ne_zero _ hq0), hc]
  unfold braidEj
  rw [b2_negA h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_rootVector_three
statement:
theorem b2_rootVector_three : S (T (E R v i)) =
    ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ * cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) 2) • Xb 1
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have L : (Xb 2) * braidEi R i -
      (BraidDiagonal.shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) 2)⁻¹ • (braidEi R i * Xb 2) =
      cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) 2 • Xb 1 := b2_lowerE hij h hq 1
  rw [b2_shift_two hq0] at L
  rw [HT.map_E, ite_eq_right hij, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h',
    parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h', map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul,
    b2_rootVector_two HS hij h, HS.map_E, ite_eq_left rfl]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
  rw [smul_comm, ← smul_sub, L, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_T_X_one
statement: lemma b2_T_X_one : T (Xb 1) = E R v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_succ (n := 0), map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, HT.map_E, ite_eq_right hij, X,
    HT.map_E,
    ite_eq_left rfl, b2_shift_zero, ← parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h']
  exact degreeOne_braidEj_mul_braidEi_sub (R := R) h' (b2_sub_ne h h' hq h2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_rootVector_four
statement: theorem b2_rootVector_four : S (T (S (E R v j))) = E R v j
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have L : (Xb 1) * braidEi R i -
      (BraidDiagonal.shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) 1)⁻¹ • (braidEi R i * Xb 1) =
      cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) 1 • Xb 0 := b2_lowerE hij h hq 0
  rw [b2_shift_one hq0, inv_one] at L
  rw [b2_rootVector_two HS hij h, map_smul, map_smul, X_succ (n := 1), map_sub, map_mul,
    map_smul, map_mul, b2_T_X_one HT hij h h' hq h2, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul,
    b2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hq, HS.map_E, ite_eq_left rfl, b2_shift_one hq0]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
  rw [smul_comm, ← smul_sub, L, smul_smul, smul_smul, b2_qFactorial_two hq0,
    b2_cc_one hq0 hq, b2_cc_two hq0 hq]
  rw [b2_qFactorial_two hq0] at h2
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, mul_one, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_rootVectors_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem b2_rootVectors_mem_adjoin :
    E R v i ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (E R v j) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (T (E R v i)) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (T (S (E R v j))) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨E_mem_adjoin i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [b2_rootVector_two HS hij h]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem_adjoin _ _ 2) _
  · rw [b2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hq]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem_adjoin _ _ 1) _
  · rw [b2_rootVector_four HS HT hij h h' hq h2]
    exact E_mem_adjoin j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_rootVectors_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem g2_rootVectors_mem_adjoin :
    E R v i ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (E R v j) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (T (E R v i)) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (T (S (E R v j))) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (T (S (T (E R v i)))) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      S (T (S (T (S (E R v j))))) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨E_mem_adjoin i, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [tripleSix_S_Ej HS hij h]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem_adjoin _ _ 3) _
  · rw [tripleSix_T_Ei HT hij, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem_adjoin _ _ 2) _
  · rw [tripleSix_S_Ej HS hij h, map_smul, map_smul, tripleSix_T_X_succ HT hij 2, map_sub,
      map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq,
      tripleSix_S_TX2 HS HT hij h h' hq h3]
    refine Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (sub_mem (mul_mem ?_ ?_) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _
      (mul_mem ?_ ?_) _)) _ <;>
      exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem_adjoin _ _ _) _
  · rw [tripleSix_T_Ei HT hij, tripleSix_S_Yv HS hij h h' hq, map_smul, map_smul,
      tripleSix_S_TX2 HS HT hij h h' hq h3]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (X_mem_adjoin (R := R) _ _ 1) _) _
  · rw [tripleSix_Ej HS HT hij h h' hq h3]
    exact E_mem_adjoin j

statement: @[simp] lemma cβ_zero : cβ p 0 = 0

statement: @[simp] lemma cγ_zero : cγ p 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [cγ]

statement: @[simp] lemma cg_zero : cg p 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [cg]

statement: @[simp] lemma cd_zero : cd p 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [cd]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.cγ_one
statement: lemma cγ_one (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) : cγ p 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cγ, cβ, pow_one]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opE_single
statement:
lemma opE_single (A B C D : ℕ) (x : k) :
    opE (Finsupp.single (A, B, C, D) x) = Finsupp.single (A + 1, B, C, D) x
proof:
:= by
  simp [opE]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opF_single
statement:
lemma opF_single (A B C D : ℕ) (x : k) :
    opF p (Finsupp.single (A, B, C, D) x) =
      x • ((p ^ A * (p ^ C)⁻¹) • Finsupp.single (A, B, C, D + 1) (1 : k) -
        (p ^ A * (p - 1) * cd p B) • Finsupp.single (A, B - 1, C + 2, D) 1 +
        (cβ p A * (p ^ B)⁻¹) • Finsupp.single (A - 1, B, C + 1, D) 1 +
        cγ p A • Finsupp.single (A - 2, B + 1, C, D) 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [opF]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opY_single
statement:
lemma opY_single (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) (A B C D : ℕ) (x : k) :
    opY p (Finsupp.single (A, B, C, D) x) =
      (x * (p ^ B)⁻¹) • Finsupp.single (A, B, C + 1, D) 1 +
        (x * cg p A) • Finsupp.single (A - 1, B + 1, C, D) 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases A with _ | _ | A <;> rcases B with _ | B <;>
  · simp only [opY, A2PBW.qComm, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
      opF_single, opE_single, map_sub, map_add, map_smul, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    b2_norm h1 h2
    match_scalars <;> b2_scalars

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opX_single
statement:
lemma opX_single (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) (A B C D : ℕ) (x : k) :
    opX p (Finsupp.single (A, B, C, D) x) =
      (x * (p ^ A)⁻¹) • Finsupp.single (A, B + 1, C, D) 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases A with _ | A <;>
  · simp only [opX, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, opE_single, opY_single hp h1 h2,
      map_add, map_smul]
    b2_norm h1 h2
    match_scalars <;> b2_scalars

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opX_mul_opE
statement:
lemma opX_mul_opE (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) :
    opX p * opE = p⁻¹ • (opE * opX p)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun m x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨A, B, C, D⟩ := m
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, opE_single, opX_single hp h1 h2,
    map_smul, smul_smul]
  match_scalars
  b2_scalars

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opF_mul_opY
statement:
lemma opF_mul_opY (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) :
    opF p * opY p = p⁻¹ • (opY p * opF p)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun m x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨A, B, C, D⟩ := m
  rcases A with _ | _ | _ | A <;> rcases B with _ | B <;>
  · simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, opF_single, opY_single hp h1 h2,
      map_add, map_sub, map_smul, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    b2_norm h1 h2
    match_scalars <;> b2_scalars

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opF_pow_single
statement:
lemma opF_pow_single (D : ℕ) :
    (opF p ^ D) (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0, 0) 1) = Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0, D) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction D with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ D ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, opF_single]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opY_pow_single
statement:
lemma opY_pow_single (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) (C D : ℕ) :
    (opY p ^ C) (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0, D) 1) = Finsupp.single (0, 0, C, D) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction C with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ C ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, opY_single hp h1 h2]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opX_pow_single
statement:
lemma opX_pow_single (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) (B C D : ℕ) :
    (opX p ^ B) (Finsupp.single (0, 0, C, D) 1) = Finsupp.single (0, B, C, D) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction B with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ B ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, opX_single hp h1 h2]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.opE_pow_single'
statement:
lemma opE_pow_single' {k : Type*} [Field k] (A B C D : ℕ) :
    (opE ^ A) (Finsupp.single (0, B, C, D) (1 : k)) = Finsupp.single (A, B, C, D) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction A with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ A ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, opE_single]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.qSerre_three_eq
statement:
lemma qSerre_three_eq {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (e f : B) :
    qSerre q 3 e f = e * (e * A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) e f - A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) e f * e) -
      q ^ 2 • ((e * A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) e f - A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) e f * e) * e)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial, A2PBW.qComm]
  simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
    smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
    Nat.add_one_sub_one]
  match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fe'
statement: lemma fe' (z : B) : f * (e * z) = p • (e * (f * z)) - p • (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, H.fe, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.ye'
statement: lemma ye' (z : B) : y * (e * z) = e * (y * z) - x * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, H.ye, sub_mul, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.xe'
statement: lemma xe' (z : B) : x * (e * z) = p⁻¹ • (e * (x * z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, H.xe, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fy'
statement: lemma fy' (z : B) : f * (y * z) = p⁻¹ • (y * (f * z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, H.fy, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fx
statement: lemma fx (hp : p ≠ 0) : f * x = x * f - (p - 1) • (y * y)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = e * y - y * e := by rw [H.ye]; abel
  rw [hx]
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, H.fe', H.fy', H.fe, H.fy, mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub,
    smul_smul]
  match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fx'
statement: lemma fx' (hp : p ≠ 0) (z : B) : f * (x * z) = x * (f * z) - (p - 1) • (y * (y * z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, H.fx hp, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.yx
statement: lemma yx (hp : p ≠ 0) : y * x = p⁻¹ • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : f * (e * x) = f * (p • (x * e)) := by
    rw [H.xe, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp, one_smul]
  simp only [H.fe', H.fx' hp, H.fx hp, H.fe, H.ye', H.ye, H.xe', mul_smul_comm, mul_sub,
    smul_sub, smul_smul] at h1
  linear_combination (norm := skip) (-(p ^ 2)⁻¹) • h1
  simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.xe_pow
statement: lemma xe_pow (n : ℕ) (z : B) : x * (e ^ n * z) = (p ^ n)⁻¹ • (e ^ n * (x * z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul H.xe, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.yx_pow
statement: lemma yx_pow (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (z : B) : y * (x ^ n * z) = (p ^ n)⁻¹ • (x ^ n * (y * z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul (H.yx hp), smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fy_pow
statement: lemma fy_pow (n : ℕ) (z : B) : f * (y ^ n * z) = (p ^ n)⁻¹ • (y ^ n * (f * z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul H.fy, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fx_pow
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_one, H.fx' hp, pow_zero, one_mul]
    congr 2
    simp only [cd]
    field_simp
    ring
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ' x (n + 1), mul_assoc, H.fx' hp, ih]
    simp only [H.yx_pow hp, mul_smul_comm, mul_sub, smul_smul]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
    match_scalars <;> b2_scalars

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.ye_pow
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_one, H.ye', pow_zero, one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_one_smul k (x * z)]
    congr 2
    simp only [cg]
    field_simp
    ring
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ' e (n + 1), mul_assoc, H.ye', ih, H.xe_pow]
    simp only [mul_add, mul_smul_comm]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
    match_scalars <;> b2_scalars

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fe_pow_one
statement: lemma fe_pow_one (z : B) : f * (e ^ 1 * z) = p • (e ^ 1 * (f * z)) - p • (e ^ 0 * (y * z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_one, pow_zero, one_mul, H.fe']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.Rel.fe_pow
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_succ' e 1, pow_one, mul_assoc, H.fe', H.fe', H.ye']
    simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, pow_zero, one_mul]
    match_scalars <;> b2_scalars
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ' e (n + 2), mul_assoc, H.fe', ih, H.ye_pow hp h1]
    simp only [mul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_add, smul_smul]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
    match_scalars <;> b2_scalars

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.pow_add_two'
statement: lemma pow_add_two' (a : B) (n : ℕ) : a ^ (n + 2) = a * (a * a ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ', pow_succ']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.monoMap_single
statement:
lemma monoMap_single (m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) (c : k) :
    monoMap k e x y f (Finsupp.single m c) = c • mono e x y f m
proof:
:= by
  simp [monoMap]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.monoMap_opE
statement: lemma monoMap_opE (s : Space k) : monoMap k e x y f (opE s) = e * monoMap k e x y f s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add, mul_add]
  | single m c =>
    obtain ⟨A, B, C, D⟩ := m
    simp [opE_single, monoMap_single, mono, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.monoMap_opF
statement:
lemma monoMap_opF (H : Rel p e x y f) (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0)
    (s : Space k) : monoMap k e x y f (opF p s) = f * monoMap k e x y f s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add, mul_add]
  | single m c =>
    obtain ⟨A, B, C, D⟩ := m
    rw [opF_single, monoMap_single, mul_smul_comm]
    simp only [map_smul, map_add, map_sub, monoMap_single, mono]
    rcases A with _ | _ | A <;> rcases B with _ | B <;>
    · b2_norm h1 h2
      simp only [one_smul, one_mul, H.fe_pow hp h1 h2, pow_one, H.fe', H.fx_pow hp h1 h2,
        H.yx_pow hp, H.fy_pow]
      simp only [pow_add_two', pow_succ' f, pow_succ' y, pow_succ' x, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
        smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
      all_goals (match_scalars <;> b2_scalars)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.rep_θ_left
statement: @[simp] lemma rep_θ_left : rep p i (θ k i) = opE
proof: := by simp [rep]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.rep_θ_right
statement: lemma rep_θ_right (hij : i ≠ j) : rep p i (θ k j) = opF p
proof: := by simp [rep, hij.symm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.rep_qSerre
statement:
lemma rep_qSerre (q : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : LusztigF k I) :
    rep p i (qSerre q m a b) = qSerre q m (rep p i a) (rep p i b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, map_sum, map_smul, map_mul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_three
statement:
lemma toNat_one_sub_eq_three (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2) :
    (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.param_ne
statement:
lemma param_ne {q : k} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (h2 : qFactorial q 2 ≠ 0) :
    q ^ 2 ≠ 0 ∧ q ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 ∧ (q ^ 2) ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [b2_qFactorial_two hq0] at h2
  have e1 : q ^ 2 - 1 = q * (q - q⁻¹) := by field_simp
  have e2 : (q ^ 2) ^ 2 - 1 = q ^ 2 * ((q - q⁻¹) * (q + q⁻¹)) := by field_simp; ring
  exact ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hq0, e1 ▸ mul_ne_zero hq0 hq,
    e2 ▸ mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hq0) (mul_ne_zero hq h2)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.serreIdeal_le_ker_rep
statement:
theorem serreIdeal_le_ker_rep [NeZero v] (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hall : ∀ l, l = i ∨ l = j) (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) :
    serreIdeal D v ≤ TwoSidedIdeal.ker (rep ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) i)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨hp, h1, h2⟩ := param_ne hq0 (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i 2)
  rw [serreIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨l, m, hlm, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker]
  rcases hall l with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hall m with rfl | rfl
  · exact absurd rfl hlm
  · rw [serreElement, toNat_one_sub_eq_three h,
      qSerreDiv_eq (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' l 3), map_smul,
      rep_qSerre, rep_θ_left, rep_θ_right hij, qSerre_three_eq hq0]
    change _ • (opE * opX _ - _ • (opX _ * opE)) = 0
    rw [opX_mul_opE hp h1 h2, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp, one_smul, sub_self, smul_zero]
  · have hj := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) (NeZero.ne v) hv' l 2
    rw [parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h'] at hj
    rw [serreElement, A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h',
      qSerreDiv_eq hj, map_smul, rep_qSerre, rep_θ_left, rep_θ_right hlm.symm,
      A2PBW.qSerre_two_right hp]
    change _ • (opY _ * opF _ - _ • (opF _ * opY _)) = 0
    rw [opF_mul_opY hp h1 h2, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp, one_smul, sub_self, smul_zero]
  · exact absurd rfl hlm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2RootY_mem
statement: lemma b2RootY_mem : b2RootY R v i j ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:=
  sub_mem (mul_mem (E_mem_adjoin i) (E_mem_adjoin j))
    (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem (E_mem_adjoin j) (E_mem_adjoin i)) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2RootX_mem
statement: lemma b2RootX_mem : b2RootX R v i j ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:=
  sub_mem (mul_mem (E_mem_adjoin i) b2RootY_mem)
    (mul_mem b2RootY_mem (E_mem_adjoin i))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_rel
statement:
theorem b2_rel :
    B2PBW.Rel ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j) where
  fe
proof:
:= A2PBW.mul_eq_qComm (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))) _ _
  ye := by rw [b2RootX]; abel
  xe := by
    have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
    have hS := serre_E R v hij
    rw [toNat_one_sub_eq_three h, qSerre_three_eq hq0, sub_eq_zero] at hS
    rw [b2RootX, b2RootY, hS, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hq0), one_smul]
  fy := by
    have hS := serre_E R v hij.symm
    rw [A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h'] at hS
    exact A2PBW.mul_qComm_right_of_qSerre (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))) hS

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_braidEj_eq
statement: theorem b2_braidEj_eq : braidEj R v i j = (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ • b2RootX R v i j
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hc : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 * (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2)⁻¹ = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  have hX := BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq0 (pow_ne_zero 2 hq0) (E R v i) (E R v j) 2
  rw [hc] at hX
  unfold braidEj
  rw [b2_negA h, ← hX, BraidDiagonal.X_succ (n := 1), BraidDiagonal.X_succ (n := 0),
    b2_shift_one hq0, b2_shift_zero,
    one_smul]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2_monoMap_rep
statement:
theorem b2_monoMap_rep (a : LusztigF k I) (s : Space k) :
    monoMap k (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j)
        (rep ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) i a s) =
      plusHom R v a *
        monoMap k (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j) s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, h1, hp2⟩ := param_ne (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) hq h2
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing s with
  | grade0 r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul,
      Algebra.smul_def]
  | grade1 l =>
    rcases hall l with rfl | rfl
    · change monoMap (B := QuantumGroup R v) k _ _ _ _ (rep _ l (θ k l) s) = plusHom R v (θ k l) * _
      rw [rep_θ_left, plusHom_θ, monoMap_opE]
    · change monoMap (B := QuantumGroup R v) k _ _ _ _ (rep _ i (θ k l) s) = plusHom R v (θ k l) * _
      rw [rep_θ_right hij, plusHom_θ, monoMap_opF (b2_rel hij h h') hp h1 hp2]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, add_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_b2Mono
statement:
theorem span_b2Mono :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (mono (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j))) =
      Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    change mono _ _ _ _ m ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
    exact mul_mem (pow_mem (E_mem_adjoin i) _) (mul_mem (pow_mem b2RootX_mem _)
      (mul_mem (pow_mem b2RootY_mem _) (pow_mem (E_mem_adjoin j) _)))
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_freeAlgebra_lift]
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    change FreeAlgebra.lift k (E R v) a ∈ _
    have ha : FreeAlgebra.lift k (E R v) a =
        monoMap k (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j)
          (rep ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) i a (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0, 0) 1)) := by
      rw [b2_monoMap_rep hij h h' hq h2 hall]
      simp only [monoMap_single, mono, pow_zero, one_smul, mul_one]
      rfl
    rw [ha, monoMap, ← Finsupp.range_linearCombination]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_b2Mono
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_b2Mono :
    LinearIndependent k (mono (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j))
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨hp, h1, hp2⟩ := param_ne hq0 (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i 2)
  let θY : LusztigF k I := A2PBW.qComm ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) (θ k i) (θ k j)
  let θX : LusztigF k I := θ k i * θY - θY * θ k i
  let fm : Space k →ₗ[k] LusztigF k I :=
    Finsupp.linearCombination k (mono (θ k i) θX θY (θ k j))
  have hY : rep ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) i θY = opY ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) := by
    simp [θY, A2PBW.qComm, rep_θ_right hij, opY]
  have hX : rep ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) i θX = opX ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) := by
    simp only [θX, map_sub, map_mul, hY, rep_θ_left]
    rfl
  have hplus : ∀ s, plusHom R v (fm s) =
      monoMap k (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j) s := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht, map_add]
    | single m c =>
      simp only [fm, θX, θY, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul, monoMap_single, mono,
        map_mul, map_pow, map_sub, plusHom_θ, A2PBW.qComm, b2RootX, b2RootY]
  have hrep : ∀ s, rep ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) i (fm s) (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0, 0) 1) = s := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hs, ht]
    | single m c =>
      obtain ⟨a, b, c', d⟩ := m
      simp only [fm, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mono,
        map_mul, map_pow, rep_θ_left, rep_θ_right hij, hX, hY, Module.End.mul_apply,
        opF_pow_single, opY_pow_single hp h1 hp2, opX_pow_single hp h1 hp2, opE_pow_single']
      rw [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [linearIndependent_iff]
  intro s hs
  have h0 : plusHom R v (fm s) = 0 := (hplus s).trans hs
  have hker := serreIdeal_le_ker_rep hv' hij hall h h' ((plusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hv' _).1 h0)
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker] at hker
  rw [← hrep s, hker, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2PBWMono_eq_smul
statement:
lemma b2PBWMono_eq_smul [NeZero v] (m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    b2PBWMono R v i j m = ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ^ m.2.1) •
      mono (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [b2PBWMono, b2_braidEj_eq h, smul_pow, mono]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_b2PBWMono
statement:
theorem span_b2PBWMono (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (h2 : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2 ≠ 0) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (b2PBWMono R v i j)) =
      Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_b2Mono hij h h' hq h2 hall]
  have hc : (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero h2
  apply le_antisymm <;> rw [Submodule.span_le] <;> rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  · rw [b2PBWMono_eq_smul h]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)
  · have e : mono (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j) m =
        ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ^ m.2.1)⁻¹ • b2PBWMono R v i j m := by
      rw [b2PBWMono_eq_smul h, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hc), one_smul]
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, e]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_b2PBWMono
statement: theorem linearIndependent_b2PBWMono : LinearIndependent k (b2PBWMono R v i j)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    inv_ne_zero (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i 2)
  have hl := (linearIndependent_b2Mono (R := R) hij h h' hall hv').units_smul
    (fun m ↦ Units.mk0 _ (pow_ne_zero m.2.1 hc))
  convert hl using 1
  funext m
  rw [b2PBWMono_eq_smul h, Pi.smul_apply', Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2PBWBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem b2PBWBasis_apply (m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    (b2PBWBasis R v h hij h' hall hv' m : QuantumGroup R v) = b2PBWMono R v i j m
proof:
:= by
  simp [b2PBWBasis, Module.Basis.span_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2PBWMono_eq_rootVectors
statement:
theorem b2PBWMono_eq_rootVectors [NeZero v] (HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i S)
    (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j T) (hij : i ≠ j) (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2)
    (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (h2 : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2 ≠ 0) (m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    b2PBWMono R v i j m = E R v i ^ m.1 * (S (E R v j) ^ m.2.1 *
      (S (T (E R v i)) ^ m.2.2.1 * S (T (S (E R v j))) ^ m.2.2.2))
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hY : S (T (E R v i)) = b2RootY R v i j := by
    rw [b2_rootVector_three HS HT hij h h' hq, b2_cc_two hq0 hq, ← b2_qFactorial_two hq0,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul, BraidDiagonal.X_succ (n := 0), b2_shift_zero]
    rfl
  rw [b2_rootVector_four HS HT hij h h' hq h2, a2_rootVector_two hij HS, hY]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2PBWBasis_apply_braidEquiv
statement:
theorem b2PBWBasis_apply_braidEquiv (m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    (b2PBWBasis R v h hij h' hall hv' m : QuantumGroup R v) =
      E R v i ^ m.1 * (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv' (E R v j) ^ m.2.1 *
        (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv'
          (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm) hv'
            (E R v i)) ^ m.2.2.1 *
        twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv'
          (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm) hv'
            (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv' (E R v j))) ^ m.2.2.2))
proof:
:= by
  have HS : HasBraidGeneratorImages i
      (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij hall hv').toAlgHom :=
    braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages
      (twoNode_braidGeneric hij hall (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' i j))
      (twoNode_transformedSerre hij hall (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' i j))
  have HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages j
      (twoNodeBraidEquiv_of_not_root (R := R) hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm) hv').toAlgHom :=
    braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages
      (twoNode_braidGeneric hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm)
        (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' j).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' j i))
      (twoNode_transformedSerre hij.symm (fun l ↦ (hall l).symm)
        (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' j).sub_ne
        (twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv' j i))
  rw [b2PBWBasis_apply, b2PBWMono_eq_rootVectors HS HT hij h h'
    (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i 2)]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_f_mem
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_f_mem (l : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) :
    x * qDivPow (q ^ 3) l f ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, i, a, j, c, d, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan hw
    simpa only [prefixMonomial, M6, M5, P3, mul_assoc] using
      (M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b)
        (C := C) (D := D) (f := f) i a j c d l)
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [neg_mul]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_orderedSpan
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_orderedSpan {x y : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D)
    (hy : y ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f) :
    x * y ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen _ hy
  intro i a j c d l
  have ht : M6 q e A b C D f i a j c d l =
      prefixMonomial q e A b C D i a j c d * qDivPow (q ^ 3) l f := by
    simp only [M6, M5, P3, prefixMonomial, mul_assoc]
  rw [ht, ← mul_assoc]
  exact prefixSpan_mul_f_mem l
    (prefixSpan_mul hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ hx (prefixMonomial_mem i a j c d))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.orderedSpan_mul_f
statement:
lemma orderedSpan_mul_f (r : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f) :
    x * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r f ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, i, a, j, c, d, l, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan hw
    have ht : M6 q e A b C D f i a j c d l =
        prefixMonomial q e A b C D i a j c d * qDivPow (q ^ 3) l f := by
      simp only [M6, M5, P3, prefixMonomial, mul_assoc]
    rw [ht, mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow f l r
      (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hpi _), mul_smul_comm]
    have hp : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by simpa only [← inv_pow] using pow_mem hiΛ 3
    exact smul_mem_orderedSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem (pow_mem hqΛ 3) hp _ _)
      (prefixSpan_mul_f_mem (l + r) (prefixMonomial_mem i a j c d))
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [neg_mul]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.orderedSpan_mul_e
statement:
lemma orderedSpan_mul_e (r : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f) :
    x * qDivPow q r e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, i, a, j, c, d, l, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    apply smul_mem_orderedSpan hw
    have ht : M6 q e A b C D f i a j c d l =
        prefixMonomial q e A b C D i a j c d * qDivPow (q ^ 3) l f := by
      simp only [M6, M5, P3, prefixMonomial, mul_assoc]
    rw [ht, mul_assoc]
    exact prefixSpan_mul_orderedSpan hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ (prefixMonomial_mem i a j c d)
      (qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_mem_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ r l)
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [neg_mul]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_A_mem_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_A_mem_all (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r A ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow_A_eq_sum hq hqi hpi H, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_smul_comm]
  apply smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (mul_mem (pow_mem (neg_mem (one_mem Λ)) j) (pow_mem hiΛ j))
  simp only [← mul_assoc]
  exact orderedSpan_mul_e hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ j
    (orderedSpan_mul_f hpi hqΛ hiΛ r
      (qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_mem_all hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ (3 * r - j) s))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qFactorial_three
statement: lemma qFactorial_three : qFactorial q 3 = qInt q 2 * qInt q 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [qFactorial, qInt, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qInt_two
statement: lemma qInt_two : qInt q 2 = q + q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [qInt, sum_range_succ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qInt_three
statement: lemma qInt_three (hq : q ≠ 0) : qInt q 3 = q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [qInt, sum_range_succ, hq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qFactorial_three_ne_zero
statement: lemma qFactorial_three_ne_zero : qFactorial q 3 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [qFactorial_three]
  exact mul_ne_zero h2 h3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.square_add_one_ne_zero
statement: lemma square_add_one_ne_zero : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : q * qInt q 2 = q ^ 2 + 1 := by rw [qInt_two, mul_add]; field_simp
  rw [← h]
  exact mul_ne_zero hq h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x2_eq
statement: lemma x2_eq : G2PBW.x2 q e f = qInt q 2 • X2 q e f
proof:
:= by
  rw [X2, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x3_eq
statement: lemma x3_eq : G2PBW.x3 q e f = qFactorial q 3 • X3 q e f
proof:
:= by
  rw [X3, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (qFactorial_three_ne_zero h2 h3), one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.z_eq
statement: lemma z_eq : G2PBW.z q e f = qFactorial q 3 • Z q e f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Z, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (qFactorial_three_ne_zero h2 h3), one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_e
statement: lemma f_mul_e : f * e = q ^ 3 • (e * f) - q ^ 3 • G2PBW.x1 q e f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [G2PBW.x1, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 hq), one_smul]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x1_mul_e
statement:
lemma x1_mul_e : G2PBW.x1 q e f * e =
    q • (e * G2PBW.x1 q e f) - (q * qInt q 2) • X2 q e f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← smul_smul, ← x2_eq h2, G2PBW.x2]
  simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_smul]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.X2_mul_e
statement:
lemma X2_mul_e : X2 q e f * e =
    q⁻¹ • (e * X2 q e f) - (q⁻¹ * qInt q 3) • X3 q e f
proof:
:= by
  rw [X2, X3, qFactorial_three, G2PBW.x3]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x1_mul_X2
statement:
lemma x1_mul_X2 : G2PBW.x1 q e f * X2 q e f =
    q⁻¹ • (X2 q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f) - (q⁻¹ * qInt q 3) • Z q e f
proof:
:= by
  rw [X2, Z, qFactorial_three, G2PBW.z]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.X3_mul_e
statement: lemma X3_mul_e : X3 q e f * e = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (e * X3 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [X3, smul_mul_assoc, G2PBW.x3_mul_e hq hS4, mul_smul_comm, smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Z_mul_e
statement: lemma Z_mul_e : Z q e f * e = e * Z q e f - (q ^ 2 - 1) • (X2 q e f ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Z, X2, smul_mul_assoc, G2PBW.z_mul_e hq hS4 hS2 (square_add_one_ne_zero hq h2),
    mul_smul_comm, smul_add, qFactorial_three, smul_pow]
  simp only [smul_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, pow_two]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp [square_add_one_ne_zero hq h2]
  simp only [qInt_two, qInt_three hq]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.serre_op
statement: private lemma serre_op : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 (op f) (op e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [qSerre_op, hS2, op_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.unop_y1
statement: private lemma unop_y1 : unop (G2PBW.y1 q (op e) (op f)) = G2PBW.x1 q e f
proof:
:= by
  simp [G2PBW.y1, G2PBW.x1]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.unop_y2
statement: private lemma unop_y2 : unop (G2PBW.y2 q (op e) (op f)) = G2PBW.x2 q e f
proof:
:= by
  simp [G2PBW.y2, G2PBW.x2, unop_y1]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.unop_y3
statement: private lemma unop_y3 : unop (G2PBW.y3 q (op e) (op f)) = G2PBW.z q e f
proof:
:= by
  simp [G2PBW.y3, G2PBW.z, unop_y1, unop_y2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.unop_w
statement: private lemma unop_w : unop (G2PBW.w q (op e) (op f)) = G2PBW.x3 q e f
proof:
:= by
  simp [G2PBW.w, G2PBW.x3, unop_y2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_x1
statement: lemma f_mul_x1 : f * G2PBW.x1 q e f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (G2PBW.x1 q e f * f)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [unop_mul, unop_smul, unop_op, unop_y1] using
    congrArg unop (G2PBW.y1_mul_f hq (serre_op hS2))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_X2
statement: lemma f_mul_X2 : f * X2 q e f = X2 q e f * f - (q ^ 2 - 1) • (G2PBW.x1 q e f ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg unop (G2PBW.y2_mul_f hq (serre_op hS2))
  simp only [unop_mul, unop_add, unop_smul, unop_op, unop_y1, unop_y2] at h
  rw [X2, mul_smul_comm, h, smul_add, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, pow_two]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp
  rw [qInt_two]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_Z
statement:
lemma f_mul_Z : f * Z q e f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (Z q e f * f) -
    ((q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 / (q ^ 2 * qInt q 3)) • (G2PBW.x1 q e f ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg unop (G2PBW.y3_mul_f hq (serre_op hS2))
  simp only [unop_mul, unop_add, unop_smul, unop_op, unop_y1, unop_y3] at h
  rw [Z, mul_smul_comm, h, smul_add, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm, smul_smul,
    qFactorial_three]
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp
  rw [qInt_two]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_X3
statement:
lemma f_mul_X3 : f * X3 q e f = q ^ 3 • (X3 q e f * f) +
    (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1) • Z q e f - (q ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - 1)) •
      (X2 q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg unop (G2PBW.w_mul_f hq (serre_op hS2))
  simp only [unop_mul, unop_add, unop_smul, unop_op, unop_y1, unop_y2, unop_y3, unop_w] at h
  rw [X3, Z, X2, mul_smul_comm, h]
  simp only [smul_add, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul]
  rw [qFactorial_three]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp
  rw [qInt_three hq]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.x1_mul_X3
statement:
lemma x1_mul_X3 : G2PBW.x1 q e f * X3 q e f =
    X3 q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f - (q ^ 2 - 1) • (X2 q e f ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h : G2PBW.x1 q e f * G2PBW.x3 q e f =
      G2PBW.x3 q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f +
        (G2PBW.z q e f * e - e * G2PBW.z q e f) := by
    simp only [G2PBW.x3, G2PBW.z, G2PBW.x2, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  calc
    G2PBW.x1 q e f * X3 q e f =
        X3 q e f * G2PBW.x1 q e f + (Z q e f * e - e * Z q e f) := by
      simp only [X3, Z, mul_smul_comm, h, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [Z_mul_e hq h2 h3 hS4 hS2]; abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.fa_two_A
statement:
private lemma fa_two_A (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 f * A =
      q ^ 6 • (A * qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 f) +
      (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1) • (C * f) -
      (q ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - 1)) • (b * D * f) +
      (q * (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 * qInt q 2) • qDivPow q 3 D
proof:
:= by
  have hh := qDivPow_f_mul_A hq (hqi 2 (by omega)) (hqi 3 (by omega)) hpi H 2
  rw [hh]
  simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, B2Integral.sCoef, mul_one, inv_pow, mul_assoc,
    reverseLongMixedAdjoint, sum_range_succ, range_one, sum_singleton, pow_zero, tsub_zero,
    zero_mul, inv_one, one_mul, pow_one, Nat.add_one_sub_one, neg_mul,
    A2Integral.qDivPow_one', sub_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, even_two, Even.neg_pow, one_pow, tsub_self, mul_zero,
    qDivPow_zero', add_left_inj]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_two_mul_qDivPow_A_two
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_two_mul_qDivPow_A_two (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 f * qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 A =
      q ^ 12 • (qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 A * qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 f) +
      (q ^ 3 * (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1)) • (A * C * f) -
      (q ^ 5 * (q ^ 2 - 1)) • (A * b * D * f) +
      (q ^ 3 * (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 + 1)) •
        (A * qDivPow q 3 D + qDivPow q 3 b * f) +
      ((q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 + 1)) • (qDivPow q 2 b * qDivPow q 2 D) -
      ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 8 + q ^ 4 - 1) * q⁻¹ ^ 4) • (b * C * D) +
      ((q ^ 14 + q ^ 12 - q ^ 8 + q ^ 6 - q ^ 4 - q ^ 2 + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ 6) •
        qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 C
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := hqi 2 (by omega)
  have h3 := hqi 3 (by omega)
  have hp2 := hpi 2 (by omega)
  have hD := qDivPow_D_mul_A hq hqi H 3
  have hA : qInt (q ^ 3) 2 • qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 A = A * A := by
    rw [← mul_qDivPow (q ^ 3) A 1 hp2, A2Integral.qDivPow_one']
  apply smul_right_injective B hp2
  simp only
  rw [← mul_smul_comm, hA, ← mul_assoc, fa_two_A hq hqi hpi H]
  simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [mul_assoc A (qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 f) A, fa_two_A hq hqi hpi H,
    mul_assoc C f A, H.fA, mul_assoc (b * D) f A, H.fA, hD]
  simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  rw [← mul_assoc C A, H.CA, ← mul_assoc (b * D) A, mul_assoc b D A, H.DA]
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  rw [← mul_assoc b A, H.BA, mul_assoc b D C, H.DC,
    mul_assoc b D (b * D), ← mul_assoc D b D, H.DB]
  simp only [sum_range_succ, reverseSquareMixedAdjoint, B2Integral.sCoef,
    qDivPow, qFactorial, qInt, sum_range_succ]
  norm_num
  simp only [mul_sub, mul_add, add_mul, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
    smul_sub, smul_smul, pow_succ, pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul, mul_assoc]
  rw [← mul_assoc C b, H.CB]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  have hn2 : 1 + q ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply h2
    rw [qInt_two]
    field_simp
    linear_combination hz
  have hn3 : 1 + q ^ 2 + q ^ 4 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply h3
    rw [qInt_three hq]
    field_simp
    linear_combination hz
  have hnp2 : 1 + q ^ 6 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hp2
    rw [qInt_two]
    field_simp
    linear_combination hz
  have hn23 : 1 + q ^ 2 * 2 + q ^ 4 * 2 + q ^ 6 ≠ 0 := by
    convert mul_ne_zero hn2 hn3 using 1
    ring
  match_scalars <;> field_simp
  all_goals ring_nf
  all_goals field_simp [hn2, hn3, hnp2, hn23]
  all_goals ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_two_mul_qDivPow_A_two_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_two_mul_qDivPow_A_two_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 f * qDivPow (q ^ 3) 2 A ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have hm := M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b)
    (C := C) (D := D) (f := f)
  have hδ : q ^ 2 - 1 ∈ Λ := sub_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (one_mem _)
  have hα : q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1 ∈ Λ :=
    sub_mem (add_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (one_mem _)
  have hplus : q ^ 2 + 1 ∈ Λ := add_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (one_mem _)
  rw [qDivPow_f_two_mul_qDivPow_A_two hq hqi hpi H]
  refine add_mem (sub_mem (add_mem (add_mem (sub_mem (add_mem ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (pow_mem hqΛ 12)
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using hm 0 2 0 0 0 2
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) hα)
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using hm 0 1 0 1 0 1
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) hδ)
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using hm 0 1 1 0 1 1
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (pow_mem hδ _)) hplus)
    apply add_mem
    · simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using hm 0 1 0 0 3 0
    · simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using hm 0 0 3 0 0 1
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (pow_mem hδ _) hplus)
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using hm 0 0 2 0 2 0
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (mul_mem hδ
      (sub_mem (add_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (one_mem _))) (pow_mem hiΛ _))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using hm 0 0 1 1 1 0
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (mul_mem (add_mem (sub_mem (sub_mem (add_mem
      (sub_mem (add_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (pow_mem hqΛ _))
      (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (pow_mem hqΛ _)) (one_mem _)) (pow_mem hiΛ _))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using hm 0 0 0 2 0 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.Rel.squareRel
statement:
theorem Rel.squareRel {q : k} {e A b C D f : B} (H : Rel q e A b C D f) :
    SquareRel q e A b C
proof: := ⟨H.Ae, H.Be, H.BA, H.Ce, H.CB⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.rel_of_serre
statement:
theorem rel_of_serre (hq : q ≠ 0) (h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0) (h3 : qInt q 3 ≠ 0)
    (h4 : q ^ 4 + 1 ≠ 0) (h6 : q ^ 4 - q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0)
    (hS4 : qSerre q 4 e f = 0) (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e = 0) :
    Rel q e (X3 q e f) (X2 q e f) (Z q e f) (G2PBW.x1 q e f) f where
  Ae
proof:
:= X3_mul_e hq hS4
  Be := X2_mul_e hq h2 h3
  BA := X2_mul_X3 hq h4 hS4 hS2
  Ce := Z_mul_e hq h2 h3 hS4 hS2
  CA := Z_mul_X3 hq h2 h3 h4 hS4 hS2
  CB := Z_mul_X2 hq h4 h6 hS4 hS2
  De := x1_mul_e hq h2
  DA := x1_mul_X3 hq h2 h3 hS4 hS2
  DB := x1_mul_X2 hq h2 h3
  DC := x1_mul_Z hq h2 h6 hS4 hS2
  fe := f_mul_e hq
  fA := f_mul_X3 hq h2 h3 hS2
  fB := f_mul_X2 hq h2 hS2
  fC := f_mul_Z hq h2 h3 hS2
  fD := f_mul_x1 hq hS2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.fourth_add_one_ne_zero
statement: lemma fourth_add_one_ne_zero (hn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) : q ^ 4 + 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h4 : q ^ 4 = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hz
  apply hn 8 (by decide)
  rw [show 8 = 4 * 2 by decide, pow_mul, h4]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.sixth_cyclotomic_ne_zero
statement:
lemma sixth_cyclotomic_ne_zero (hn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) :
    q ^ 4 - q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h6 : q ^ 6 = -1 := by linear_combination (q ^ 2 + 1) * hz
  apply hn 12 (by decide)
  rw [show 12 = 6 * 2 by decide, pow_mul, h6]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.rel_of_not_root
statement:
theorem rel_of_not_root (hq : q ≠ 0) (hn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1)
    (hS4 : qSerre q 4 e f = 0) (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e = 0) :
    Rel q e (X3 q e f) (X2 q e f) (Z q e f) (G2PBW.x1 q e f) f
proof:
:=
  rel_of_serre hq (qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq hn (by decide))
    (qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq hn (by decide)) (fourth_add_one_ne_zero hn)
    (sixth_cyclotomic_ne_zero hn) hS4 hS2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.g2c3_eq
statement:
lemma g2c3_eq {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hf : qFactorial q 3 ≠ 0) : g2c3 q = (qInt q 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (qFactorial_three (q := q) ▸ hf)).1
  have h3 : qInt q 3 ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (qFactorial_three (q := q) ▸ hf)).2
  rw [g2c3, tripleSix_cc_three hq hd, ← qInt_three hq, qFactorial_three]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.g2c2_eq
statement:
lemma g2c2_eq {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hf : qFactorial q 3 ≠ 0) : g2c2 q = qInt q 2
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (qFactorial_three (q := q) ▸ hf)).1
  have h3 : qInt q 3 ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (qFactorial_three (q := q) ▸ hf)).2
  rw [g2c2, tripleSix_cc_three hq hd, tripleSix_cc_two hq hd,
    ← qInt_three hq, ← qInt_two, qFactorial_three]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.altVec_g2_normalized
statement:
theorem altVec_g2_normalized : OrderedSpan.altVec T (E R v) i j 6 =
    ![E R v i, G2Integral.X3 (v ^ D.d i) (E R v i) (E R v j),
      G2Integral.X2 (v ^ D.d i) (E R v i) (E R v j),
      G2Integral.Z (v ^ D.d i) (E R v i) (E R v j),
      G2PBW.x1 (v ^ D.d i) (E R v i) (E R v j), E R v j]
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have h2 : qInt (v ^ D.d i) 2 ≠ 0 :=
    (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (G2Integral.qFactorial_three (q := v ^ D.d i) ▸ hf)).1
  rw [altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq hf,
    G2Integral.g2c3_eq hq0 hq hf, G2Integral.g2c2_eq hq0 hq hf]
  simp only [G2Integral.X3, G2Integral.X2, G2Integral.Z, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2,
    mul_one, one_smul]

name: LusztigF.wordWeight_eq_single_one_iff
statement:
lemma wordWeight_eq_single_one_iff (w : List I) (i : I) :
    wordWeight w = Finsupp.single i 1 ↔ w = [i]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hl : w.length = 1 := by simpa [h] using length_eq_sum_wordWeight w
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hl
    have hj : j = i := by
      by_contra hji
      have := congrArg (fun ν : I →₀ ℕ ↦ ν j) h
      simp [wordWeight, hji] at this
    subst j
    rfl
  · rintro rfl
    simp [wordWeight]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_rootVector_eq_smul_E
statement:
theorem exists_rootVector_eq_smul_E (i : I) :
    ∃ (n : Fin ω.length) (a : k), a ≠ 0 ∧
      CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n n.isLt = a • E R v i
proof:
:= by
  let := P.finite_weylGroup hD
  have hm : P.root i ∈ P.prefixRoots hD.isGeneralizedCartan ω := by
    exact (congrArg (P.root i ∈ ·)
      (P.prefixRoots_set_of_longest hD.isGeneralizedCartan hω hw)).mpr
        ⟨root_mem_roots P i, P.root_mem_posWeights i⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hm
  have hn' : n < ω.length := by simpa using hn
  have hd : rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn' = Finsupp.single i 1 := by
    have hr := (rootVectorDegree_realization R P ω n hn').trans he
    have hs : P.rootOf (fun j ↦ (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℤ)) j) = P.root i := by
      convert P.rootOf_single i using 2
      ext j
      simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
    have hc := P.rootOf_injective (hr.trans hs.symm)
    ext j
    exact congrFun hc j
  have hp : positiveRootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn' = Finsupp.single i 1 := by
    simp [positiveRootVectorDegree, hd]
  have hx := rootVector_mem_plusWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan (R := R) hD hv hω n hn'
  rw [hp, plusWeightSpace_single] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
  have hx0 : CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn' ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact E_ne_zero_of_not_root hv ω[n]
      (((ω.take n).map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod.injective
        (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  refine ⟨⟨n, hn'⟩, a, ?_, ha.symm⟩
  intro ha0
  exact hx0 (ha.symm.trans (by simp [ha0]))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoin_rootVector_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem adjoin_rootVector_of_isFiniteCartan :
    Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (fun n : Fin ω.length ↦
      CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n n.isLt)) =
      Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root hv hω n n.isLt
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_rootVector_eq_smul_E R hv P hD hω hw i
    have hm := Algebra.subset_adjoin (R := k)
      (s := Set.range (fun n : Fin ω.length ↦
        CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n n.isLt)) ⟨n, rfl⟩
    dsimp only at hm
    rw [he] at hm
    simpa [smul_smul, ha] using Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hm a⁻¹
