name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt
statement:
lemma qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    qFactorial q n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [qFactorial]
  | succ n ih => rw [qFactorial_succ]; exact mul_ne_zero (hqi _ n.succ_pos) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow
statement:
lemma qDivPow_mul_qDivPow (x : B) (n m : ℕ) (h : qFactorial q (n + m) ≠ 0) :
    qDivPow q n x * qDivPow q m x = qBinomial q (n + m) n • qDivPow q (n + m) x
proof:
:= by
  have e := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (Nat.le_add_right n m)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at e
  have hn : qFactorial q n ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h (by rw [← e, h0]; ring)
  have hm : qFactorial q m ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h (by rw [← e, h0]; ring)
  have hB : qBinomial q (n + m) n ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h (by rw [← e, h0]; ring)
  simp only [qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm, ← pow_add, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [← e]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.mul_qDivPow_succ
statement:
lemma mul_qDivPow_succ (P : ℕ) :
    β * qDivPow q (P + 1) α =
      q ^ (P + 1) • (qDivPow q (P + 1) α * β) - q • (qDivPow q P α * γ)
proof:
:= by
  induction P with
  | zero =>
    rw [qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero', one_mul, zero_add, pow_one, hβα]
  | succ P ih =>
    have hc := hqi (P + 2) (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    have hq : q * qInt q (P + 2) = qInt q (P + 1) + q ^ (P + 2) := by
      have h := qInt_succ (v := q) (P + 1)
      rw [show P + 1 + 1 = P + 2 from rfl] at h
      rw [h, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, one_mul, ← pow_succ']
    have e2 : qDivPow q P α * α = qInt q (P + 1) • qDivPow q (P + 1) α :=
      qDivPow_mul_self α P (hqi _ (by omega))
    have e3 : qDivPow q (P + 1) α * α = qInt q (P + 2) • qDivPow q (P + 2) α :=
      qDivPow_mul_self α (P + 1) hc
    set X := qDivPow q (P + 2) α * β
    set Y := qDivPow q (P + 1) α * γ
    calc qInt q (P + 2) • (β * qDivPow q (P + 1 + 1) α)
        = β * qDivPow q (P + 1) α * α := by
          rw [mul_assoc, e3, mul_smul_comm]
      _ = (q ^ (P + 1) • (qDivPow q (P + 1) α * β) - q • (qDivPow q P α * γ)) * α := by
          rw [ih]
      _ = q ^ (P + 1) • (qDivPow q (P + 1) α * (β * α)) -
            qDivPow q P α * (q • (γ * α)) := by
          simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
      _ = q ^ (P + 1) • (qDivPow q (P + 1) α * (q • (α * β) - q • γ)) -
            qDivPow q P α * (α * γ) := by
          rw [hβα, ← hαγ]
      _ = (q ^ (P + 1) * q) • (qDivPow q (P + 1) α * α * β) -
            (q ^ (P + 1) * q) • Y - qDivPow q P α * α * γ := by
          simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc, Y]
      _ = (q ^ (P + 1) * q * qInt q (P + 2)) • X - (q ^ (P + 1) * q) • Y -
            qInt q (P + 1) • Y := by
          rw [e3, e2, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      _ = qInt q (P + 2) • (q ^ (P + 1 + 1) • X - q • Y) := by
          linear_combination (norm := module) hq • Y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qInt_identity
statement:
lemma qInt_identity (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (s b : ℕ) :
    qInt q (b + 1) + q ^ (b + s + 2) * qInt q (s + 1) = q ^ (s + 1) * qInt q (s + b + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← qIntZ_natCast hq, ← qIntZ_natCast hq, ← qIntZ_natCast hq]
  simp only [qIntZ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, zpow_add₀ hq0, zpow_neg,
    zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_eq_sum
statement:
theorem qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_eq_sum (hqq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (P Q : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q Q β * qDivPow q P α = ∑ n ∈ range (Q + 1), sTerm q α β γ P Q n
proof:
:= by
  have hβγ' : β * γ = q⁻¹ • (γ * β) := by
    rw [hβγ.symm, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_smul]
  have hβdγ : ∀ n, β * qDivPow q n γ = q⁻¹ ^ n • (qDivPow q n γ * β) := fun n ↦ by
    rw [qDivPow, mul_smul_comm, mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul hβγ' n, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm]
  induction Q with
  | zero => simp [sTerm, qDivPow_zero']
  | succ Q ih =>
    have hc := hqi (Q + 1) (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    let coef : ℕ → k := fun n ↦ (-1 : k) ^ n * q ^ ((P - n) * (Q - n) + n)
    let M : ℕ → B := fun n ↦
      qDivPow q (P - n) α * qDivPow q n γ * qDivPow q (Q + 1 - n) β
    let g1 : ℕ → B := fun n ↦ if n ≤ P then
      (coef n * q ^ (P - n) * q⁻¹ ^ n * qInt q (Q + 1 - n)) • M n else 0
    let g2 : ℕ → B := fun n ↦ if n + 1 ≤ P then
      (-(coef n * q * qInt q (n + 1))) • M (n + 1) else 0
    have hL : qInt q (Q + 1) • (qDivPow q (Q + 1) β * qDivPow q P α) =
        ∑ n ∈ range (Q + 1), β * sTerm q α β γ P Q n := by
      rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow q β Q hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sum]
    have hT : ∀ n ∈ range (Q + 1), β * sTerm q α β γ P Q n = g1 n + g2 n := by
      intro n hn
      have hnQ : n ≤ Q := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hn)
      have hββ : β * qDivPow q (Q - n) β = qInt q (Q + 1 - n) • qDivPow q (Q + 1 - n) β := by
        rw [mul_qDivPow q β _ (hqi _ (by omega)), show Q - n + 1 = Q + 1 - n by omega]
      simp only [sTerm, g1, g2]
      by_cases hP : n ≤ P
      · simp only [hP, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
        by_cases hP' : n + 1 ≤ P
        · simp only [hP', ↓reduceIte]
          obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, P - n = m + 1 := ⟨P - n - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [hm, mul_qDivPow_succ hq0 hqi hβα hαγ m]
          simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
          rw [← mul_assoc β (qDivPow q n γ), hβdγ, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc (qDivPow q n γ) β,
            hββ, ← mul_assoc γ (qDivPow q n γ), mul_qDivPow q γ n (hqi _ (by omega)),
            smul_mul_assoc]
          simp only [M, coef, hm, show P - (n + 1) = m by omega,
            show Q + 1 - (n + 1) = Q - n by omega, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
          module
        · simp only [hP', ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
          have hPn : P - n = 0 := by omega
          rw [hPn, qDivPow_zero', mul_one, hβdγ, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hββ]
          simp only [M, coef, hPn, qDivPow_zero', one_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
          module
      · have hP' : ¬ n + 1 ≤ P := by omega
        simp only [hP, hP', ↓reduceIte, mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hL, sum_congr rfl hT, sum_add_distrib, smul_sum]
    have hs1 : ∑ n ∈ range (Q + 1), g1 n = ∑ n ∈ range (Q + 2), g1 n := by
      rw [sum_range_succ _ (Q + 1)]
      simp only [g1, Nat.sub_self, qInt, range_zero, sum_empty, mul_zero, zero_smul, ite_self,
        add_zero]
    have hs2 : ∑ n ∈ range (Q + 1), g2 n =
        ∑ n ∈ range (Q + 2), (if n = 0 then 0 else g2 (n - 1)) := by
      rw [sum_range_succ' _ (Q + 1)]
      simp
    rw [hs1, hs2, ← sum_add_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
    have htQ : t ≤ Q + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ht)
    rcases t with _ | s
    · simp only [g1, sTerm, zero_le, ↓reduceIte, Nat.sub_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul,
        add_zero, smul_smul, M, coef]
      congr 1
      ring
    · simp only [g1, g2, sTerm, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hsP : s + 1 ≤ P
      · simp only [hsP, ↓reduceIte, smul_smul, M, ← add_smul]
        congr 1
        obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, P = s + 1 + a := ⟨P - (s + 1), by omega⟩
        have e1 : s + 1 + a - (s + 1) = a := by omega
        have e2 : s + 1 + a - s = a + 1 := by omega
        have hsQ : s ≤ Q := by omega
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, Q = s + b := ⟨Q - s, by omega⟩
        simp only [coef, e1, e2, show s + b + 1 - (s + 1) = b by omega,
          show s + b - (s + 1) = b - 1 by omega, show s + b - s = b by omega]
        rcases b with _ | b
        · simp [qInt]
          ring
        · have hid := qInt_identity hq0 hqq s b
          simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, show s + (b + 1) + 1 = s + b + 2 by omega]
          have hqi' : q⁻¹ ^ (s + 1) * q ^ (s + 1) = 1 := by
            rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_pow]
          linear_combination ((-1 : k) ^ (s + 1) * q ^ (a * b + a)) * hid +
            ((-1 : k) ^ (s + 1) * q ^ (a * b + a) * qInt q (b + 1)) * hqi'
      · simp only [hsP, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qInt_inv'
statement: lemma qInt_inv' (n : ℕ) : qInt q⁻¹ n = qInt q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [qInt, qInt, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hs
  rw [inv_inv, mul_comm]
  congr 2
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qFactorial_inv'
statement: lemma qFactorial_inv' (n : ℕ) : qFactorial q⁻¹ n = qFactorial q n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [qFactorial, qFactorial, ih, qInt_inv']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qDivPow_inv'
statement: lemma qDivPow_inv' (n : ℕ) (x : B) : qDivPow q⁻¹ n x = qDivPow q n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow, qDivPow, qFactorial_inv']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_eq_sum_lusztig
statement:
theorem qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_eq_sum_lusztig (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hqq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) {α β γ : B} (hγ : γ = α * β - q⁻¹ • (β * α))
    (hαγ : α * γ = q • (γ * α)) (hβγ : q • (β * γ) = γ * β) (p r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q p α * qDivPow q r β = ∑ n ∈ range (p + 1),
      if n ≤ r then q⁻¹ ^ ((p - n) * (r - n)) •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) β * qDivPow q n γ * qDivPow q (p - n) α) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq0' : q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hq0
  have hqi' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q⁻¹ n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by rw [qInt_inv']; exact hqi n hn
  have hqq' : q⁻¹ - q⁻¹⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by rw [inv_inv, ← neg_sub]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 hqq
  have h1 : α * β = q⁻¹ • (β * α) - q⁻¹ • ((-q) • γ) := by
    rw [hγ, smul_smul, mul_neg, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, neg_smul, one_smul]; abel
  have h2 : β * ((-q) • γ) = q⁻¹ • (((-q) • γ) * β) := by
    rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← hβγ, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      show q⁻¹ * -q * q = -q by field_simp]
  have h3 : q⁻¹ • (α * ((-q) • γ)) = ((-q) • γ) * α := by
    rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_neg, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, neg_smul, one_smul, hαγ,
      smul_mul_assoc, neg_smul]
  have L := qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_eq_sum hq0' hqi' h1 h2 h3 hqq' r p
  rw [qDivPow_inv', qDivPow_inv'] at L
  rw [L]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [sTerm]
  split_ifs with hn
  · rw [qDivPow_inv', qDivPow_inv', qDivPow_inv',
      show qDivPow q n ((-q) • γ) = (qFactorial q n)⁻¹ • ((-q) • γ) ^ n from rfl, smul_pow,
      smul_smul, show qDivPow q n γ = (qFactorial q n)⁻¹ • γ ^ n from rfl]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    have e1 : (-1 : k) ^ n * (-1) ^ n = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    have e2 : q⁻¹ ^ n * q ^ n = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_pow]
    calc (-1) ^ n * q⁻¹ ^ ((r - n) * (p - n) + n) * ((qFactorial q n)⁻¹ * (-q) ^ n)
        = ((-1) ^ n * (-1) ^ n) * (q⁻¹ ^ n * q ^ n) * (q⁻¹ ^ ((p - n) * (r - n)) *
            (qFactorial q n)⁻¹) := by
          rw [neg_pow, pow_add, mul_comm (r - n) (p - n)]; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [e1, e2, one_mul, one_mul]
  · rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qBinomial_mem
statement: lemma qBinomial_mem (n j : ℕ) : qBinomial q n j ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => cases j <;> simp [one_mem, zero_mem]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp [one_mem]
    | succ j =>
      rw [qBinomial_succ_succ]
      exact add_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ' _) (ih _)) (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ _) (ih _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan
statement:
lemma smul_mem_orderedSpan {c : k} (hc : c ∈ Λ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ) :
    c • x ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c', hc', a, b, d, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c * c', mul_mem hc hc', a, b, d, by rw [smul_smul]⟩
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.monomial_mem_orderedSpan
statement:
lemma monomial_mem_orderedSpan (a b d : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q a α * qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q d β ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨1, one_mem _, a, b, d, (one_smul _ _).symm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.one_mem_orderedSpan
statement: lemma one_mem_orderedSpan : (1 : B) ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [qDivPow_zero'] using monomial_mem_orderedSpan (Λ := Λ) (q := q) (α := α) (β := β)
    (γ := γ) 0 0 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen
statement:
lemma mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen {y : B}
    (hy : ∀ a b d : ℕ, y * (qDivPow q a α * qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q d β) ∈
      orderedSpan Λ q α β γ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ) :
    y * x ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, d, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact smul_mem_orderedSpan hc (hy a b d)
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hz
  | neg x _ hx => rw [mul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qDivPow_α_mul_mem
statement:
lemma qDivPow_α_mul_mem (P : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ) :
    qDivPow q P α * x ∈ orderedSpan Λ q α β γ
proof:
:= by
  refine mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen (fun a b d ↦ ?_) hx
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, qDivPow_mul_qDivPow α P a
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi _), smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc]
  exact smul_mem_orderedSpan (qBinomial_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _) (monomial_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2Integral.qDivPow_β_mul_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hβγ' : β * γ = q⁻¹ • (γ * β) := by
    rw [hβγ.symm, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_smul]
  have hcomm : ∀ m b : ℕ, qDivPow q m β * qDivPow q b γ =
      q⁻¹ ^ (m * b) • (qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q m β) := fun m b ↦ by
    simp only [qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm, pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul hβγ' m b, smul_smul,
      mul_comm]
  have hF : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0 := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi
  refine mul_mem_orderedSpan_of_gen (fun a b d ↦ ?_) hx
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_eq_sum hq0 hqi hβα hαγ hβγ hqq, sum_mul,
    sum_mul]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [sTerm]
  split_ifs
  · set m := Q - n
    have key : qDivPow q m β * qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q d β =
        (q⁻¹ ^ (m * b) * qBinomial q (m + d) m) • (qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q (m + d) β) := by
      rw [hcomm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, qDivPow_mul_qDivPow β m d (hF _), mul_smul_comm,
        smul_smul]
    have key2 : qDivPow q n γ * qDivPow q b γ = qBinomial q (n + b) n • qDivPow q (n + b) γ :=
      qDivPow_mul_qDivPow γ n b (hF _)
    have e : ((-1 : k) ^ n * q ^ ((a - n) * m + n)) •
        (qDivPow q (a - n) α * qDivPow q n γ * qDivPow q m β) * qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q d β =
        ((-1 : k) ^ n * q ^ ((a - n) * m + n) * (q⁻¹ ^ (m * b) * qBinomial q (m + d) m) *
          qBinomial q (n + b) n) •
          (qDivPow q (a - n) α * qDivPow q (n + b) γ * qDivPow q (m + d) β) := by
      have : qDivPow q (a - n) α * qDivPow q n γ * qDivPow q m β * qDivPow q b γ *
          qDivPow q d β = qDivPow q (a - n) α * qDivPow q n γ *
            (qDivPow q m β * qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q d β) := by noncomm_ring
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, this, key, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
        mul_assoc (qDivPow q (a - n) α), key2, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul,
        smul_smul, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [e]
    refine smul_mem_orderedSpan ?_ (monomial_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _)
    refine mul_mem (mul_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem (neg_mem (one_mem _)) _) (pow_mem hqΛ _))
      (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ' _) (qBinomial_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _))) (qBinomial_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _)
  · simp only [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedPBWBasis_apply
statement:
theorem simplyLacedPBWBasis_apply (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (simplyLacedPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀ c : QuantumGroup R v) =
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [simplyLacedPBWBasis, Basis.map_apply, Basis.span_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedPBWBasis_sum_repr
statement:
theorem simplyLacedPBWBasis_sum_repr (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    ((simplyLacedPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀).repr x).sum
      (fun c a ↦ a • CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w c) = (x : QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))).val
    ((simplyLacedPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀).linearCombination_repr x)
  simpa only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul,
    Subalgebra.val_apply, simplyLacedPBWBasis_apply] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis_apply
statement:
theorem simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis_apply (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀ c : QuantumGroup R v) =
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) w c
proof:
:= by
  change chevalley R v (simplyLacedPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀ c) = _
  rw [simplyLacedPBWBasis_apply, chevalley_pbwMonomial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis_sum_repr
statement:
theorem simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis_sum_repr (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v))) :
    ((simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀).repr x).sum
      (fun c a ↦ a • CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) w c) = (x : QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v))).val
    ((simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw hw₀).linearCombination_repr x)
  simpa only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul,
    Subalgebra.val_apply, simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis_apply] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_simplyLacedPBWBases
statement:
theorem exists_simplyLacedPBWBases :
    ∃ w : List I, cs.IsReduced w ∧ cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement ∧
      ∃ (bp : Basis (Fin w.length → ℕ) k (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))))
        (bn : Basis (Fin w.length → ℕ) k (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v)))),
        (∀ c, (bp c : QuantumGroup R v) =
          CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w c) ∧
        (∀ c, (bn c : QuantumGroup R v) =
          CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (negativeBraidEquiv R hv) (F R v) w c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced cs.longestElement
  exact ⟨w, hw, he.symm, simplyLacedPBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw he.symm,
    simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis R hv hSL cs hD hw he.symm,
    simplyLacedPBWBasis_apply R hv hSL cs hD hw he.symm,
    simplyLacedNegativePBWBasis_apply R hv hSL cs hD hw he.symm⟩

name: PBWInfinityLattice.mem_lattice_iff
statement:
theorem mem_lattice_iff (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    x ∈ lattice D ↔ x ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PBWInfinityLattice.pairing_integral
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact GrandLoop.formU_mem (hvt := transcendental_ratFunc_X)
    (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx hy

name: PBWInfinityLattice.norm_unit
statement:
theorem norm_unit {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ u : 𝔄ˣ, quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)
      (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) = algebraMap 𝔄 𝕂 (u : 𝔄)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := PBWProductNorm.norm_residue R hw c
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := isUnit_one_add_mul InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal a
  exact ⟨u, ha.trans (congrArg (algebraMap 𝔄 𝕂) hu.symm)⟩

name: PBWInfinityLattice.pairing_sum
statement:
theorem pairing_sum {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (a : (Fin w.length → ℕ) →₀ 𝕂) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (a.sum fun d k ↦ k • (integralPBWPreimage R hw d : Quotient D 𝕧))
      (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) =
      a c * quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change a.sum (fun d k ↦ k * quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw d)
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)) = _
  apply Finsupp.sum_eq_single c
  · intro d _ hdc
    rw [PBWProductNorm.orthogonal R hw d c hdc, mul_zero]
  · intro _
    exact zero_mul _

name: PBWInfinityLattice.coefficients_integral
statement:
theorem coefficients_integral {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (a : (Fin w.length → ℕ) →₀ 𝕂)
    (ha : (a.sum fun c k ↦ k • (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)) ∈
      quotientCrystalLattice D) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ b : 𝔄, a c = algebraMap 𝔄 𝕂 b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := pairing_integral ha (PBWProductNorm.mem_lattice_degree R hw c)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := norm_unit R hw c
  rw [pairing_sum R hw a c, hu] at hb
  refine ⟨b * ↑(u⁻¹), ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun z : 𝕂 ↦ z * algebraMap 𝔄 𝕂 (↑(u⁻¹) : 𝔄)) hb
  simpa only [mul_assoc, ← _root_.map_mul, Units.mul_inv, _root_.map_one, mul_one] using h

name: PBWInfinityLattice.field_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem field_linearIndependent {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) :
    LinearIndependent 𝕂 (fun c ↦ (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  ext c
  have h := congrArg (fun x ↦ quotientForm D x (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)) hab
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply] at h
  rw [pairing_sum R hw a c, pairing_sum R hw b c] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := norm_unit R hw c
  rw [hu] at h
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (u.isUnit.map (algebraMap 𝔄 𝕂)).ne_zero h

name: PBWInfinityLattice.local_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem local_linearIndependent {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) :
    LinearIndependent 𝔄 (fun c ↦ (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearIndependent.restrict_scalars (K := 𝕂) _ (field_linearIndependent R hw)
  simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one] using InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap

name: PBWInfinityLattice.mem_intersection_iff
statement:
theorem mem_intersection_iff {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    x ∈ intersection R hw ↔ x ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D ∧
      x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range fun c ↦
        (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧))
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PBWInfinityLattice.intersection_eq_span
statement:
theorem intersection_eq_span {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) :
    intersection R hw = Submodule.span 𝔄
      (Set.range fun c ↦ (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hx.2
    have hi := coefficients_integral R hw a hx.1
    classical
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro c _
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hi c
    rw [hb]
    change (algebraMap 𝔄 𝕂 b) • (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) ∈ _
    rw [algebraMap_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ b (Submodule.subset_span ⟨c, rfl⟩)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨PBWProductNorm.mem_lattice_degree R hw c, Submodule.subset_span ⟨c, rfl⟩⟩

name: PBWInfinityLattice.mem_lattice_iff_mem_span
statement:
theorem mem_lattice_iff_mem_span {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂
      (Set.range fun c ↦ (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧))) :
    x ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D ↔ x ∈ Submodule.span 𝔄
      (Set.range fun c ↦ (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← intersection_eq_span R hw, mem_intersection_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h, hx⟩, And.left⟩

name: PBWInfinityLattice.intersectionBasis_apply
statement:
theorem intersectionBasis_apply {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (intersectionBasis R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) = integralPBWPreimage R hw c
proof:
:= by
  simp [intersectionBasis, Module.Basis.span_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerreDiv_zero_left
statement: lemma qSerreDiv_zero_left {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (b : B) : qSerreDiv q m 0 b = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with rfl | hr
  · simp [qDivPow, zero_pow hm]
  · simp [qDivPow, zero_pow hr.ne']

name: LusztigF.nodeEval_θ_self
statement: @[simp] lemma nodeEval_θ_self (i : I) : nodeEval k i (θ k i) = X
proof: := by simp [nodeEval]

name: LusztigF.nodeEval_θ_of_ne
statement: lemma nodeEval_θ_of_ne {i j : I} (h : j ≠ i) : nodeEval k i (θ k j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [nodeEval, h]

name: LusztigF.nodeEval_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem nodeEval_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal {D : LusztigCartanDatum I} {v : k} (i : I)
    {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) : nodeEval k i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [serreElement, map_qSerreDiv]
    by_cases hb : b = i
    · subst hb
      rw [nodeEval_θ_of_ne hab, qSerreDiv_zero_left]
      have := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos a b hab
      omega
    · rw [nodeEval_θ_of_ne hb, qSerreDiv_zero_right]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg, hx, neg_zero]
  | left_absorb a x _ hx => rw [map_mul, hx, mul_zero]
  | right_absorb b x _ hx => rw [map_mul, hx, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.range_plusHom
statement: theorem range_plusHom : (plusHom R v).range = Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.map_top, ← FreeAlgebra.adjoin_range_ι, AlgHom.map_adjoin, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 2
  funext i
  simp [plusHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_neg_K_mul_F_pow
statement:
lemma exists_neg_K_mul_F_pow (i : I) (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ (-(K R v (-ktilde R i) * F R v i)) ^ a =
      c • (F R v i ^ a * K R v (-(a • ktilde R i)))
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by simp⟩
  | succ a ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨-(c * v ^ (-R.root i (-((a + 1) • ktilde R i)))),
      neg_ne_zero.2 (mul_ne_zero hc (zpow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))), ?_⟩
    have hK : K R v (-(a • ktilde R i)) * K R v (-ktilde R i) =
        K R v (-((a + 1) • ktilde R i)) := by
      rw [K_add, succ_nsmul, neg_add]
    rw [pow_succ, h, mul_neg, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (K R v _), hK, K_mul_F,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, smul_smul, neg_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_sum_F_pow_K_mul
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_sum_F_pow_K_mul (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {i : I}
    (c : ℕ → k) (hc : ∀ a, c a ≠ 0) (μ : ℕ → Y) (f : ℕ →₀ QuantumGroup R v)
    (hf : ∀ a, f a ∈ (plusHom R v).range)
    (h1 : (f.sum fun a x ↦ (c a • (F R v i ^ a * K R v (μ a))) * x) = 0) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  choose X hX using hf
  change ∀ a, (plusHom R v) (X a) = f a at hX
  set z : TriSpace k I Y := ∑ a ∈ f.support,
    (c a • θ k i ^ a) ⊗ₜ[k] ((AddMonoidAlgebra.single (μ a) (1 : k)) ⊗ₜ[k] X a)
    with hz_def
  have hz : triMap (R := R) (v := v) z = 0 := by
    rw [← h1, hz_def, map_sum, Finsupp.sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
    rw [triMap_tmul, map_smul, map_pow, minusHom_θ, zeroHom_single, hX]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  have hzW := mem_serreTriSubmodule_of_triMap_eq_zero R v hv' hz
  ext b
  rw [Finsupp.zero_apply]
  by_cases hb : b ∈ f.support
  swap
  · exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hb
  let ℓ : LusztigF k I →ₗ[k] k := (Polynomial.lcoeff k b) ∘ₗ (nodeEval k i).toLinearMap
  let π : TriSpace k I Y →ₗ[k] LusztigF k I ⧸ serreSubmodule D v :=
    (TensorProduct.lid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map ℓ
      ((TensorProduct.lid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (augmentation Y).toLinearMap (serreSubmodule D v).mkQ)
  have hπ : ∀ y g x', π (y ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x')) =
      ℓ y • augmentation Y g • Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) x' :=
    fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
  have hℓ : ∀ a, ℓ (c a • θ k i ^ a) = if a = b then c a else 0 := by
    intro a
    simp only [ℓ, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_smul, map_pow,
      nodeEval_θ_self, Polynomial.lcoeff_apply, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
      smul_eq_mul]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · rw [mul_one]
    · exact absurd h1.symm h2
    · exact absurd h2.symm h1
    · rw [mul_zero]
  have hW : serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker π := by
    rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨y, g, x', rfl, h | h⟩
    · have : ℓ y = 0 := by
        simp [ℓ, nodeEval_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal i h]
      simp [hπ, this]
    · have : Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) x' = 0 :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (mem_serreSubmodule.2 h)
      simp [hπ, this]
  have hzπ := hW hzW
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hz_def, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem b hb, hπ, hℓ, ite_eq_left rfl,
    augmentation_single, one_smul, smul_eq_zero, or_iff_right (hc b),
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hzπ
  · rw [← hX b]
    exact (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).1
      (serreIdeal_le_ker_plusHom (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) hv' (mem_serreSubmodule.1 hzπ))
  · intro a _ hab
    rw [hπ, hℓ, ite_eq_right hab, zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_sum_E_pow_mul_map
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_sum_E_pow_mul_map (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) {i : I}
    {T : QuantumGroup R v →ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R v} (hT : Function.Injective T)
    (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages i T) (f : ℕ →₀ QuantumGroup R v)
    (hf : ∀ a, f a ∈ (plusHom R v).range) (h : (f.sum fun a x ↦ E R v i ^ a * T x) = 0) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  set G : QuantumGroup R v := -(K R v (-ktilde R i) * F R v i) with hG_def
  have hG : T G = E R v i := by
    rw [hG_def, map_neg, map_mul, HT.map_K, HT.map_F, ite_eq_left rfl, reflY_neg_ktilde, mul_neg,
      neg_neg, ← mul_assoc, Kt_mul_K_neg, one_mul]
  have h1 : (f.sum fun a x ↦ G ^ a * x) = 0 := by
    apply hT
    rw [map_zero, ← h, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, hG]
  choose c hc hGc using fun a ↦ exists_neg_K_mul_F_pow (R := R) (v := v) i a
  refine eq_zero_of_sum_F_pow_K_mul (i := i) hv' c hc (fun a ↦ -(a • ktilde R i)) f hf ?_
  rw [← h1]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [hG_def, hGc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomial_mem_adjoin_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_mem_adjoin_of_isReduced {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) ω c ∈
      Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:=
  pbwMonomial_mem _ _ (fun n hn ↦ rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root hv' hω n hn) c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) :
    LinearIndependent k (pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) ω)
proof:
:= by
  refine linearIndependent_pbwMonomial
    (S := Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))) ?_ ω ?_
  · intro i f hf h
    refine eq_zero_of_sum_E_pow_mul_map hv' (T := (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' i).toAlgHom)
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' i).injective (braidEquivOfNotRoot_images hv' i) f
      (fun a ↦ ?_) h
    rw [range_plusHom]
    exact hf a
  · intro n c
    exact pbwMonomial_mem_adjoin_of_isReduced hv' (hω.drop n) c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isFiniteCartan [Fintype I]

    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) :
    LinearIndependent k (pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) ω)

  linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced hv' hω

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qInt_gaussian
statement:
lemma qInt_gaussian (hq : q ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    qInt q m = q ^ ((m : ℤ) - 1) *
      (gaussian m).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qInt, gaussian, eval₂_finsetSum, eval₂_pow, eval₂_X, mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hi : i < m := mem_range.mp hi
  rw [← zpow_natCast q (m - 1 - i), ← zpow_natCast q⁻¹ i, inv_zpow,
    ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_natCast (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) i, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add₀ hq, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
  congr 1
  have hm : (m - 1 - i : ℕ) = (m : ℤ) - 1 - i := by omega
  rw [hm]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareScalar_eq_zero
statement:
lemma squareScalar_eq_zero (n t : ℕ) (h : ¬ (t ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 3 * t)) :
    squareScalar q n t = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [squareScalar, squarePolynomial_eq_zero n t h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareScalar_zero_zero
statement: lemma squareScalar_zero_zero : squareScalar q 0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [squareScalar, squarePolynomial_zero_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareScalar_recurrence
statement:
lemma squareScalar_recurrence (hq : q ≠ 0) (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n)
    (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t + 2) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * squareScalar q (n + 1) (t + 1) =
      q ^ (-(2 * (3 * t + 2 - n : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ)) *
        (qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (n - t)) * squareScalar q n (t + 1) +
      (q ^ 2 - 1) * q ^ (-3 * (t : ℤ)) * qInt q (3 * t + 1 - n) *
        qInt q (3 * t + 2 - n) * squareScalar q n t
proof:
:= by
  have hr := congrArg (fun p : ℤ[X] ↦ p.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)))
    (squarePolynomial_recurrence n t htn hnt)
  simp only [eval₂_mul, eval₂_add, eval₂_pow, eval₂_X] at hr
  have ha : ((n - t : ℕ) : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) - t := by omega
  have hb : ((3 * t + 2 - n : ℕ) : ℤ) = 3 * (t : ℤ) + 2 - n := by omega
  rw [qInt_three_mul_all]
  simp only [squareScalar, qInt_gaussian hq]
  have hfirst :
      q ^ (-(2 * (3 * t + 2 - n : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ)) *
          q ^ ((3 * (n - t : ℕ) : ℕ) - 1 : ℤ) *
          q ^ (3 * (n : ℤ) ^ 2 - 9 * n * (t + 1) + 9 * (t + 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (t + 1)) =
        q ^ ((n : ℤ) + (3 * (n + 1) ^ 2 - 9 * (n + 1) * (t + 1) +
          9 * (t + 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (t + 1))) * (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) ^ n := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)), ← zpow_mul]
    simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [ha, hb]
    ring
  have hleft : q ^ (n : ℤ) *
      q ^ (3 * ((n : ℤ) + 1) ^ 2 - 9 * (n + 1) * (t + 1) +
        9 * (t + 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (t + 1)) =
      q ^ ((n : ℤ) + (3 * (n + 1) ^ 2 - 9 * (n + 1) * (t + 1) +
        9 * (t + 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (t + 1))) := (zpow_add₀ hq _ _).symm
  by_cases he : n ≤ 3 * t
  · have hb' : ((3 * t + 1 - n : ℕ) : ℤ) = 3 * (t : ℤ) + 1 - n := by omega
    have hsecond :
        q ^ (-3 * (t : ℤ)) * q ^ ((3 * t + 1 - n : ℕ) - 1 : ℤ) *
          q ^ ((3 * t + 2 - n : ℕ) - 1 : ℤ) *
          q ^ (3 * (n : ℤ) ^ 2 - 9 * n * t + 9 * t ^ 2 - 2 * t) =
        q ^ ((n : ℤ) + (3 * (n + 1) ^ 2 - 9 * (n + 1) * (t + 1) +
          9 * (t + 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (t + 1))) * (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) ^ (3 * t) := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)), ← zpow_mul]
      simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      rw [hb', hb]
      ring
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right, pow_succ (q ^ 2 - 1) t]
    linear_combination
      (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ t * (q ^ 2 - 1) *
        q ^ ((n : ℤ) + (3 * (n + 1) ^ 2 - 9 * (n + 1) * (t + 1) +
          9 * (t + 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (t + 1))) * hr +
      (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ t * (q ^ 2 - 1) *
        (gaussian (n + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
        (squarePolynomial (n + 1) (t + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * hleft -
      (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ t * (q ^ 2 - 1) *
        (gaussian (3 * (n - t))).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
        (squarePolynomial n (t + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * hfirst -
      (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ t * (q ^ 2 - 1) *
        (gaussian (3 * t + 2 - n)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
        (gaussian (3 * t + 1 - n)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
        (squarePolynomial n t).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * hsecond
  · have hz := squarePolynomial_eq_zero n t (by omega)
    simp only [hz, eval₂_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hr ⊢
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
    linear_combination
      (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ (t + 1) *
        q ^ ((n : ℤ) + (3 * (n + 1) ^ 2 - 9 * (n + 1) * (t + 1) +
          9 * (t + 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (t + 1))) * hr +
      (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ (t + 1) *
        (gaussian (n + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
        (squarePolynomial (n + 1) (t + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * hleft -
      (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ (t + 1) *
        (gaussian (3 * (n - t))).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
        (squarePolynomial n (t + 1)).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) (q ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * hfirst

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.laurent_zpow_mem
statement:
lemma laurent_zpow_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (z : ℤ) :
    q ^ z ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | ofNat n => simpa using Λ.pow_mem hqΛ n
  | negSucc n => simpa [zpow_negSucc, inv_pow] using Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ (n + 1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.intPolynomial_eval_mem
statement:
lemma intPolynomial_eval_mem (Λ : Subring k) {x : k} (hx : x ∈ Λ) (p : ℤ[X]) :
    p.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom k) x ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p r hp hr => simpa only [eval₂_add] using Λ.add_mem hp hr
  | monomial n a =>
    simpa only [eval₂_monomial, Int.coe_castRingHom] using
      Λ.mul_mem (intCast_mem Λ a) (Λ.pow_mem hx n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareScalar_mem
statement:
lemma squareScalar_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (n t : ℕ) :
    squareScalar q n t ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  exact Λ.mul_mem
    (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.sub_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ 2) Λ.one_mem) t)
      (laurent_zpow_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ _))
    (intPolynomial_eval_mem Λ (laurent_zpow_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ _) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mem_adWeightSpace
statement: lemma E_mem_adWeightSpace (i : I) : E R v i ∈ adWeightSpace R v (R.root i)
proof:
:=
  fun μ ↦ K_mul_E R v μ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_mem_adWeightSpace
statement: lemma F_mem_adWeightSpace (i : I) : F R v i ∈ adWeightSpace R v (-R.root i)
proof:
:=
  fun μ ↦ K_mul_F R v μ i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.conj_eq_of_mem_adWeightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx μ, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_mul_K_neg, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.HasBraidGeneratorImages.map_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem HasBraidGeneratorImages.map_mem_adWeightSpace {i : I}
    {T : QuantumGroup R v →ₐ[k] QuantumGroup R v} (HT : HasBraidGeneratorImages i T)
    {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v} (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) :
    T x ∈ adWeightSpace R v (χ.comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h := congrArg T (hx (reflY R i μ))
  simpa only [map_mul, map_smul, HT.map_K, reflY_reflY, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comp_reflY_eq
statement:
lemma comp_reflY_eq (χ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) :
    χ.comp (reflY R i) = χ - χ (R.coroot i) • R.root i
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, reflY_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul,
    AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.word_braid_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem word_braid_mem_adWeightSpace
    (hT : ∀ i, HasBraidGeneratorImages i (T i).toAlgHom)
    (ω : List I) {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) :
    (ω.map T).prod x ∈ adWeightSpace R v (wordWeightAction R ω χ)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simpa [wordWeightAction] using hx
  | cons i ω ih =>
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, wordWeightAction,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom] using
      (hT i).map_mem_adWeightSpace ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem rootVector_mem_adWeightSpace
    (hT : ∀ i, HasBraidGeneratorImages i (T i).toAlgHom)
    (ω : List I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    CoxeterSystem.rootVector T (E R v) ω n hn ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (rootVectorWeight R ω n hn)
proof:
:=
  word_braid_mem_adWeightSpace hT (ω.take n) (E_mem_adWeightSpace ω[n])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_mem_adWeightSpace_of_not_root
statement:
theorem rootVector_mem_adWeightSpace_of_not_root (ω : List I) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n < ω.length) :
    CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (rootVectorWeight R ω n hn)
proof:
:=
  rootVector_mem_adWeightSpace
    (braidEquivOfGeneric_images
      (fun i ↦ (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv i).sub_ne)
      (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv)) ω n hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_conj_of_not_root
statement:
theorem rootVector_conj_of_not_root (ω : List I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) (μ : Y) :
    K R v μ * CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn *
        K R v (-μ) =
      v ^ rootVectorWeight R ω n hn μ •
        CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn
proof:
:=
  conj_eq_of_mem_adWeightSpace (rootVector_mem_adWeightSpace_of_not_root hv ω n hn) μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_mem_adjoin_and_adWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem rootVector_mem_adjoin_and_adWeightSpace_of_isFiniteCartan [Fintype I]
    {W : Type*} [Group W] {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W}
    (_hA : D.cartanMatrix.IsFiniteCartan) {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn ∈
        Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)) ∧
      CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) ω n hn ∈
        adWeightSpace R v (rootVectorWeight R ω n hn)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root hv hω n hn,
    rootVector_mem_adWeightSpace_of_not_root hv ω n hn⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deMonomial_e
statement:
theorem deMonomial_e (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (a b' c d : ℕ) :
    deMonomial q A b C D a b' c d * e =
      (q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ b' * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a) •
        (e * deMonomial q A b C D a b' c d) -
      (if b' = 0 then 0 else
        (q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (b' - 1) + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (a + 1)) •
          deMonomial q A b C D (a + 1) (b' - 1) c d) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else
        (q ^ d * (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) *
          qInt q (b' + 1) * qInt q (b' + 2)) •
          deMonomial q A b C D a (b' + 2) (c - 1) d) -
      (if d = 0 then 0 else
        (q * qInt q 2 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b' + 1)) •
          deMonomial q A b C D a (b' + 1) c (d - 1)) +
      (if d ≤ 1 then 0 else
        (q⁻¹ ^ (d - 2) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (c + 1)) •
          deMonomial q A b C D a b' (c + 1) (d - 2))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [M5, deMonomial, pow_zero, one_mul, qDivPow_zero', mul_one,
    ite_true, sub_zero] using M5_e hq hqi hpi H a b' c d 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deScalar_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma deScalar_zero : deScalar q 0 0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [deScalar]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.deScalar_recurrence
statement:
lemma deScalar_recurrence (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (a b c : ℕ) (hn : 0 < 2 * a + b + c) :
    qInt q (2 * a + b + c) * deScalar q a b c =
      (if a = 0 then 0 else
        q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a * deScalar q (a - 1) (b + 1) c) +
      (if b < 2 then 0 else
        (q ^ 2 - 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c) * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b *
          deScalar q a (b - 2) (c + 1)) +
      (if b = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (4 * c) * qInt q 2 * qInt q b * deScalar q a (b - 1) c) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else
        q ^ (2 * a + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * c) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c *
          deScalar q a b (c - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [deScalar, ite_eq_right (by omega), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hqi _ hn), one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_two_mul_qDivPow_e_two
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_two_mul_qDivPow_e_two (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) :
    qDivPow q 2 D * qDivPow q 2 e =
      q ^ 4 • (qDivPow q 2 e * qDivPow q 2 D) -
      (q ^ 2 * qInt q 2) • (e * b * D) +
      (q * qInt q 3) • (e * C) +
      (q * qInt q 3) • (A * D) +
      (2 * q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) • qDivPow q 2 b
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := hqi 2 (by decide)
  have he : qInt q 2 • qDivPow q 2 e = e * e := by
    rw [← mul_qDivPow q e 1 h2, A2Integral.qDivPow_one']
  have hb : qInt q 2 • qDivPow q 2 b = b * b := by
    rw [← mul_qDivPow q b 1 h2, A2Integral.qDivPow_one']
  have hDe := Dd_e hq hqi H 0
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero', pow_zero,
    one_mul, mul_one] at hDe
  apply smul_right_injective B h2
  simp only
  rw [← mul_smul_comm, he]
  simp only [smul_add, smul_sub]
  rw [smul_comm (qInt q 2) (q ^ 4), ← smul_mul_assoc, he,
    smul_comm (qInt q 2) (2 * q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2), hb]
  rw [← mul_assoc, hDe]
  simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [mul_assoc e (qDivPow q 2 D) e, hDe,
    mul_assoc b D e, H.De, H.Ce]
  simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  rw [← mul_assoc b e D, H.Be]
  simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul, pow_two, mul_assoc]
  rw [qInt_two, qInt_three hq]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_two_mul_qDivPow_e_two_mem
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_two_mul_qDivPow_e_two_mem (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f)
    (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) :
    qDivPow q 2 D * qDivPow q 2 e ∈ orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  have hm := M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b)
    (C := C) (D := D) (f := f)
  have h3 : q * qInt q 3 ∈ Λ := mul_mem hqΛ (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hiΛ _)
  rw [qDivPow_D_two_mul_qDivPow_e_two hq hqi H]
  refine add_mem (add_mem (add_mem (sub_mem ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan (pow_mem hqΛ 4)
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using hm 2 0 0 0 2 0
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan
      (mul_mem (pow_mem hqΛ 2) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hiΛ _))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_assoc] using
      hm 1 0 1 0 1 0
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan h3
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using hm 1 0 0 1 0 0
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan h3
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero', A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] using hm 0 1 0 0 1 0
  · apply smul_mem_orderedSpan
      (add_mem (add_mem (mul_mem (by norm_num : (2 : k) ∈ Λ) (pow_mem hqΛ 2)) (one_mem Λ))
        (pow_mem hiΛ 2))
    simpa [M6, M5, P3, qDivPow_zero'] using hm 0 0 2 0 0 0

name: Matrix.Realization.length_prefixRoots
statement:
@[simp] lemma length_prefixRoots (ω : List I) :
    (P.prefixRoots hA ω).length = ω.length
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i ω ih => simp [prefixRoots, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.getElem_prefixRoots
statement:
lemma getElem_prefixRoots (ω : List I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    (P.prefixRoots hA ω)[n]'(by simpa using hn) =
      ((ω.take n).map (P.reflection hA)).prod (P.root ω[n])
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing n with
  | nil => simp at hn
  | cons i ω ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [prefixRoots]
    | succ n => simpa [prefixRoots, LinearEquiv.mul_apply] using
        congrArg (P.reflection hA i) (ih n (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hn))

name: Matrix.Realization.not_descent_inv_tail
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsReduced ω := by
    simpa using hω.drop 1
  rw [(P.coxeterSystem hA).not_isRightDescent_iff]
  rw [← (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_inv
    (((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω)⁻¹ * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i)]
  simpa [mul_inv_rev, CoxeterSystem.wordProd_cons, CoxeterSystem.IsReduced] using
    hω.trans (congrArg Nat.succ ht.symm)

name: Matrix.Realization.prefixRoots_set
statement:
theorem prefixRoots_set {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsReduced ω) :
    {μ | μ ∈ P.prefixRoots hA ω} =
      inversionSet P (((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω)⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp [prefixRoots, inversionSet_one]
  | cons i ω ih =>
    have ht : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.drop 1
    have hd := P.not_descent_inv_tail hA hω
    have hnot : P.root i ∉ inversionSet P
        (((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω)⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) := by
      rw [root_mem_inversionSet_iff, P.apply_root_mem_negWeights_iff hA]
      exact hd
    have hmem : P.root i ∈ inversionSet P
        ((((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω)⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA).val *
          P.reflection hA i) := by
      rw [root_mem_inversionSet_mul_reflection_iff, P.apply_root_mem_posWeights_iff hA]
      exact hd
    have himg := image_reflection_inversionSet_diff P hA
      (((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω)⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) i
    rw [Set.sdiff_singleton_eq_self hnot] at himg
    rw [CoxeterSystem.wordProd_cons, _root_.mul_inv_rev,
      CoxeterSystem.inv_simple, Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple]
    rw [← Set.insert_sdiff_self_of_mem hmem, ← himg, ← ih ht]
    ext μ
    simp [prefixRoots, Set.mem_image]

name: Matrix.Realization.nodup_prefixRoots
statement:
theorem nodup_prefixRoots {ω : List I} (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsReduced ω) :
    (P.prefixRoots hA ω).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp [prefixRoots]
  | cons i ω ih =>
    have ht : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.drop 1
    refine List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, (ih ht).map (P.reflection hA i).injective⟩
    rintro h
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, he⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    have hp : μ ∈ P.posWeights :=
      (show μ ∈ inversionSet P
        (((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω)⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) from
          (congrArg (μ ∈ ·) (P.prefixRoots_set hA ht)).mp hμ).2.1
    have he' : μ = -P.root i := by
      simpa using congrArg (P.reflection hA i) he
    rw [he'] at hp
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp P.disjoint_posWeights_negWeights hp
      ((P.neg_mem_negWeights_iff).mpr (P.root_mem_posWeights i))

name: Matrix.Realization.longestElement_apply_mem_negWeights
statement:
theorem longestElement_apply_mem_negWeights [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)]
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.posWeights) :
    (((P.coxeterSystem hA).longestElement : P.weylGroup hA).val μ) ∈ P.negWeights
proof:
:= by
  let w := (P.coxeterSystem hA).longestElement
  have hs : ∀ i, -(w.val (P.root i)) ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range P.root) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := (P.isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp
      ((P.coxeterSystem hA).isRightDescent_longestElement i)
    exact P.mem_closure_range_root_iff.mpr ⟨k, hk, by simp [w, he]⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hμ
  have hc : P.rootOf k ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range P.root) :=
    P.mem_closure_range_root_iff.mpr ⟨k, hk.1, rfl⟩
  have hn : -(w.val (P.rootOf k)) ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range P.root) := by
    generalize P.rootOf k = x at hc ⊢
    induction hc using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hs i
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa [map_add, add_comm] using add_mem hx hy
  obtain ⟨l, hl, he⟩ := P.mem_closure_range_root_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨l, ⟨hl, ?_⟩, by simpa using congrArg Neg.neg he⟩
  intro hl0
  have hz : P.rootOf k = 0 := w.val.injective (by simpa [hl0] using he.symm)
  exact hk.2 (P.rootOf_injective (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm))

name: Matrix.Realization.prefixRoots_set_of_longest
statement:
theorem prefixRoots_set_of_longest [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)] {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω = (P.coxeterSystem hA).longestElement) :
    {μ | μ ∈ P.prefixRoots hA ω} = roots P ∩ P.posWeights
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.prefixRoots_set hA hω, hw, (P.coxeterSystem hA).inv_longestElement]
  ext μ
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩,
    fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, h.2, P.longestElement_apply_mem_negWeights hA h.2⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.prefixRoots_A2
statement:
theorem prefixRoots_A2 {i j : I} (hij : A i j = -1) (hji : A j i = -1) :
    P.prefixRoots hA [i, j, i] = [P.root i, P.root i + P.root j, P.root j]
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : P.reflection hA i (P.root j) = P.root i + P.root j := by
    rw [P.reflection_root, hij]
    module
  have h₂ : P.reflection hA j (P.root i) = P.root i + P.root j := by
    rw [P.reflection_root, hji]
    module
  simp [prefixRoots, h₁, h₂, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.realize_cartan_reflection
statement:
private lemma realize_cartan_reflection (i : I) (β : I →₀ ℤ) :
    P.rootOf (fun j ↦ (β - (β.sum fun j a ↦ a * D.cartanMatrix i j) •
      Finsupp.single i 1 : I →₀ ℤ) j) =
      P.reflection D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix i (P.rootOf fun j ↦ β j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [P.reflection_rootOf]
  congr 1
  ext j
  simp [Finsupp.sum_fintype, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm,
    Finsupp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVectorDegree_realization
statement:
theorem rootVectorDegree_realization (ω : List I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    P.rootOf (fun j ↦ rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n hn j) =
      (P.prefixRoots D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix ω)[n]'(by simpa using hn)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [P.getElem_prefixRoots _ ω n hn, rootVectorDegree_eq_cartan_fold]
  generalize ω.take n = w
  generalize ω[n] = i
  have hf : ∀ (w : List I) (β : I →₀ ℤ),
      P.rootOf (fun j ↦ (w.foldr (fun i β ↦
        β - (β.sum fun j a ↦ a * D.cartanMatrix i j) • Finsupp.single i 1) β) j) =
      (w.map (P.reflection D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix)).prod
        (P.rootOf fun j ↦ β j) := by
    intro w β
    induction w with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons i w ih =>
      simp only [List.foldr_cons, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, LinearEquiv.mul_apply,
        realize_cartan_reflection, ih]
  rw [hf]
  congr 1
  convert P.rootOf_single i using 2
  ext j
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.x3_mul_e
statement:
theorem x3_mul_e :
    x3 q e f * e = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (e * x3 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have key : x3 q e f * e - ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (e * x3 q e f)) =
      (-1 / q ^ 3) • ((qSerre q 4 e f)) := by
    simp only [x1, x2, x3, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_add, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub,
      smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero,
      Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, key, hS4]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.z_mul_e
statement:
theorem z_mul_e (hq2 : (q ^ 2 + 1) ≠ 0) :
    z q e f * e = e * z q e f + (-(q ^ 6 - 1) / (q * (q ^ 2 + 1))) • (x2 q e f * x2 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have key : z q e f * e - (e * z q e f + (-(q ^ 6 - 1) / (q * (q ^ 2 +
      1))) • (x2 q e f * x2 q e f)) =
      (q / (q ^ 2 + 1)) • ((qSerre q 4 e f) * f) +
        (-1 / (q ^ 5 * (q ^ 2 + 1))) • (f * ((qSerre q 4 e f))) +
        (1 / (q ^ 5 * (q ^ 2 + 1))) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * (e * e))) +
        (-(q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1) / (q ^ 5 * (q ^ 2 + 1))) •
          (e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * e))) +
        ((q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1) / (q ^ 3 * (q ^ 2 + 1))) • (e * e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * e)) +
        (-q / (q ^ 2 + 1)) • (e * (e * e) * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e))) := by
    simp only [x1, x2, z, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub,
      smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero,
      Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, key, hS2, hS4]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.y1_mul_f
statement:
theorem y1_mul_f :
    y1 q e f * f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (f * y1 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have key : y1 q e f * f - ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (f * y1 q e f)) =
      (-1 / q ^ 3) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e)) := by
    simp only [y1, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_add, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub,
      smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero,
      Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, key, hS2]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.y3_mul_f
statement:
theorem y3_mul_f :
    y3 q e f * f = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (f * y3 q e f) + (-(q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 +
        1) / q ^ 3) • (y1 q e f * (y1 q e f * y1 q e f))
proof:
:= by
  have key : y3 q e f * f - ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (f * y3 q e f) + (-(q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 +
      1) / q ^ 3) • (y1 q e f * (y1 q e f * y1 q e f))) =
      (-1 / q ^ 3) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (f * (e * e))) +
        (-1) • (f * e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * e)) +
        ((q ^ 2 + 1) / q ^ 4) • (f * (e * e) * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e))) +
        ((q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1) / q ^ 6) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * (f * e))) +
        (-1 / q ^ 6) • (e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (f * e))) +
        (1 / q ^ 3) • (e * f * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * e)) +
        (-(q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1) / q ^ 7) • (e * (f * e) * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e))) +
        (-(q ^ 2 + 1) / q ^ 7) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * (e * f))) +
        (1 / q ^ 9) • (e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * f))) +
        (1 / q ^ 6) • (e * (e * f) * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e))) := by
    simp only [y1, y2, y3, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub,
      smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero,
      Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, key, hS2]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.y2_mul_f
statement:
theorem y2_mul_f :
    y2 q e f * f = f * y2 q e f + (-(q ^ 4 - 1) / q) • (y1 q e f * y1 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have key : y2 q e f * f - (f * y2 q e f + (-(q ^ 4 - 1) / q) • (y1 q e f * y1 q e f)) =
      (-1) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * e) +
        (1 / q ^ 4) • (e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e))) := by
    simp only [y1, y2, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub,
      smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero,
      Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, key, hS2]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.w_mul_f
statement:
theorem w_mul_f :
    w q e f * f = q ^ 3 • (f * w q e f) + (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1) • y3 q e f +
        (-(q ^ 6 - 1)) • (y1 q e f * y2 q e f)
proof:
:= by
  have key : w q e f * f - (q ^ 3 • (f * w q e f) + (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1) • y3 q e f +
      (-(q ^ 6 - 1)) • (y1 q e f * y2 q e f)) =
      (-q ^ 3) • ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * (e * e)) +
        ((q ^ 2 + 1) / q) • (e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e) * e)) +
        (-1 / q ^ 3) • (e * e * ((qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e))) := by
    simp only [y1, y2, y3, w, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub,
      smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero,
      Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, key, hS2]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.smul_wordProd_mem
statement:
lemma smul_wordProd_mem {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → B) {a b : Fin n} (κ : k) (u : List (Fin n))
    (hu : u.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) (hab : ∀ m ∈ u, a < m ∧ m < b) :
    κ • wordProd y u ∈ innerSpan k y a b
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_mem _ κ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨u, hu, hab, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.baseRel_fwd
statement:
theorem baseRel_fwd (hq2 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) {s2 c3 c4 c5 : k} (hs2 : s2 ≠ 0) (hc3 : c3 ≠ 0)
    (hc5 : c5 ≠ 0) :
    BaseRel k ![e, s2 • x3 q e f, c3 • x2 q e f, c4 • z q e f, c5 • x1 q e f, f]
proof:
:= by
  set V : Fin 6 → B := ![e, s2 • x3 q e f, c3 • x2 q e f, c4 • z q e f, c5 • x1 q e f, f]
  intro l
  fin_cases l
  · refine ⟨(q ^ 3)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change (s2 • x3 q e f) * e - (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (e * (s2 • x3 q e f)) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 1
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, x3_mul_e hq hS4, smul_comm, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  · refine ⟨q⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change (c3 • x2 q e f) * e - q⁻¹ • (e * (c3 • x2 q e f)) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 2
    have hw : wordProd V [1] = s2 • x3 q e f := mul_one _
    convert smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 2) (-(c3 * q⁻¹ * s2⁻¹)) [1] (by decide)
      (by decide) using 1
    rw [hw, x3]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    change (c4 • z q e f) * e - (1 : k) • (e * (c4 • z q e f)) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 3
    have hw : wordProd V [2, 2] = (c3 • x2 q e f) * ((c3 • x2 q e f) * 1) := rfl
    convert smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 3)
      (c4 * (-(q ^ 6 - 1) / (q * (q ^ 2 + 1))) / c3 ^ 2) [2, 2] (by decide) (by decide) using 1
    rw [hw, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, z_mul_e hq hS4 hS2 hq2]
    simp only [mul_one, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_add, smul_smul]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  · refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    change (c5 • x1 q e f) * e - q • (e * (c5 • x1 q e f)) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 4
    have hw : wordProd V [2] = c3 • x2 q e f := mul_one _
    convert smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 4) (-(c5 * q / c3)) [2] (by decide)
      (by decide) using 1
    rw [hw, x2]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  · refine ⟨q ^ 3, ?_⟩
    change f * e - q ^ 3 • (e * f) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 5
    have hw : wordProd V [4] = c5 • x1 q e f := mul_one _
    convert smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 5) (-(q ^ 3 / c5)) [4] (by decide)
      (by decide) using 1
    rw [hw, x1]
    simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2PBW.baseRel_rev
statement:
theorem baseRel_rev {s2 c3 c5 : k} (hs2 : s2 ≠ 0) (hc3 : c3 ≠ 0) :
    BaseRel k ![f, y1 q e f, s2 • y3 q e f, c3 • y2 q e f, c5 • w q e f, e]
proof:
:= by
  set V : Fin 6 → B := ![f, y1 q e f, s2 • y3 q e f, c3 • y2 q e f, c5 • w q e f, e]
  intro l
  fin_cases l
  · refine ⟨(q ^ 3)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change y1 q e f * f - (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (f * y1 q e f) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 1
    rw [y1_mul_f hq hS2, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  · refine ⟨(q ^ 3)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change (s2 • y3 q e f) * f - (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (f * (s2 • y3 q e f)) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 2
    have hw : wordProd V [1, 1, 1] = y1 q e f * (y1 q e f * (y1 q e f * 1)) := rfl
    convert smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 2)
      (s2 * (-(q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 + 1) / q ^ 3)) [1, 1, 1] (by decide) (by decide) using 1
    rw [hw, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, y3_mul_f hq hS2]
    simp only [mul_one, smul_add, smul_smul]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    change (c3 • y2 q e f) * f - (1 : k) • (f * (c3 • y2 q e f)) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 3
    have hw : wordProd V [1, 1] = y1 q e f * (y1 q e f * 1) := rfl
    convert smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 3) (c3 * (-(q ^ 4 - 1) / q)) [1, 1] (by decide)
      (by decide) using 1
    rw [hw, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, y2_mul_f hq hS2]
    simp only [mul_one, smul_add, smul_smul]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  · refine ⟨q ^ 3, ?_⟩
    change (c5 • w q e f) * f - q ^ 3 • (f * (c5 • w q e f)) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 4
    have hw2 : wordProd V [2] = s2 • y3 q e f := mul_one _
    have hw13 : wordProd V [1, 3] = y1 q e f * ((c3 • y2 q e f) * 1) := rfl
    convert add_mem (smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 4) (c5 * (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1) / s2) [2]
      (by decide) (by decide)) (smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 4) (c5 * (-(q ^ 6 - 1)) / c3)
      [1, 3] (by decide) (by decide)) using 1
    rw [hw2, hw13, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, w_mul_f hq hS2]
    simp only [mul_one, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_smul_comm]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)
  · refine ⟨q ^ 3, ?_⟩
    change e * f - q ^ 3 • (f * e) ∈ innerSpan k V 0 5
    have hw : wordProd V [1] = y1 q e f := mul_one _
    convert smul_wordProd_mem V (a := 0) (b := 5) (-(q ^ 3)) [1] (by decide) (by decide) using 1
    rw [hw, y1]
    simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul]
    match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_one'
statement: lemma braidReversal_one' : braidReversal (1 : QuantumGroup R v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [braidReversal]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_mem_adjoin
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [braidReversal_E]
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨l, rfl⟩
  | algebraMap a =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, braidReversal_one']
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (one_mem _) _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [braidReversal_mul]; exact mul_mem hy hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_neg_F_mul_Kt_pow
statement:
lemma exists_neg_F_mul_Kt_pow (i : I) (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ (-(F R v i * Kt R v i)) ^ a = c • (F R v i ^ a * K R v (a • ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by simp⟩
  | succ a ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨-(c * v ^ (-R.root i (a • ktilde R i))),
      neg_ne_zero.2 (mul_ne_zero hc (zpow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))), ?_⟩
    have hK : K R v (a • ktilde R i) * Kt R v i = K R v ((a + 1) • ktilde R i) := by
      rw [Kt, K_add, succ_nsmul]
    rw [pow_succ, h, mul_neg, smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc (F R v i ^ a), K_mul_F,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hK, smul_smul, neg_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.list_braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply
statement:
lemma list_braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply (ω : List I) (y : QuantumGroup R v) :
    (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' j).symm).prod y =
      braidReversal ((ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')).prod (braidReversal y))
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing y with
  | nil => simp [braidReversal_involutive y]
  | cons i ω ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [ih, braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply, braidReversal_involutive]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_symm_mem_adjoin_of_not_root
statement:
theorem rootVector_symm_mem_adjoin_of_not_root {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    rootVector (fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' j).symm) (E R v) ω n hn ∈
      Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:= by
  have h := rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root (R := R) hv' hω n hn
  simp only [rootVector] at h ⊢
  rw [list_braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply, braidReversal_E]
  exact braidReversal_mem_adjoin h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_sum_E_pow_mul_symm
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_sum_E_pow_mul_symm {i : I} (f : ℕ →₀ QuantumGroup R v)
    (hf : ∀ a, f a ∈ (plusHom R v).range)
    (h : (f.sum fun a x ↦ E R v i ^ a * (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' i).symm x) = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv' R i
  have hG : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' i (E R v i) = -(F R v i * Kt R v i) := by
    have := HT.map_E i
    simpa using this
  have h1 : (f.sum fun a x ↦ (-(F R v i * Kt R v i)) ^ a * x) = 0 := by
    apply (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' i).symm.injective
    rw [map_zero, ← h, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, ← hG, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  choose c hc hGc using fun a ↦ exists_neg_F_mul_Kt_pow (R := R) (v := v) i a
  refine eq_zero_of_sum_F_pow_K_mul (i := i) hv' c hc (fun a ↦ a • ktilde R i) f hf ?_
  rw [← h1]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [hGc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_symm_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_symm_of_isReduced {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) :
    LinearIndependent k
      (pbwMonomial (fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' j).symm) (E R v) ω)
proof:
:= by
  refine linearIndependent_pbwMonomial
    (S := Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))) ?_ ω ?_
  · intro i f hf h
    refine eq_zero_of_sum_E_pow_mul_symm hv' f (fun a ↦ ?_) h
    rw [range_plusHom]
    exact hf a
  · intro n c
    exact pbwMonomial_mem _ _
      (fun m hm ↦ rootVector_symm_mem_adjoin_of_not_root hv' (hω.drop n) m hm) c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma hermite_zero (x z : R) : hermite x z 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_one
statement: @[simp] lemma hermite_one (x z : R) : hermite x z 1 = 1 + x * z
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_step
statement:
lemma hermite_step (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    hermite x z (n + 2) = (1 + x ^ (n + 2) * z) * hermite x z (n + 1) +
      x ^ (n + 2) * (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) * z ^ 2 * hermite x z n
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_identities
statement:
lemma hermite_identities (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (hermite x (x * z) (n + 1) = x ^ (n + 1) * hermite x z (n + 1) +
      (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) * hermite x (x * z) n) ∧
    (hermite x z (n + 1) =
      (1 + x * z + x ^ 2 * z ^ 2) * hermite x (x * z) n -
        x ^ (n + 2) * z ^ 2 * hermite x z n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp; ring
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hn⟩ := ih
    constructor
    · simp only [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega, hermite_step, hs]
      simp only [pow_add, pow_one] at hn ⊢
      linear_combination -(x ^ (n + 2) * (1 - x ^ (n + 1))) * hn
    · rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega, hermite_step, hs]
      simp only [pow_add, pow_one] at hn ⊢
      linear_combination (1 - x * x ^ n) * hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_shift
statement:
lemma hermite_shift (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    hermite x (x * z) (n + 1) = x ^ (n + 1) * hermite x z (n + 1) +
      (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) * hermite x (x * z) n
proof:
:=
  (hermite_identities x z n).1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_newton
statement:
lemma hermite_newton (x z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    hermite x z (n + 1) =
      (1 + x * z + x ^ 2 * z ^ 2) * hermite x (x * z) n -
        x ^ (n + 2) * z ^ 2 * hermite x z n
proof:
:=
  (hermite_identities x z n).2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_a
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_a (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x (a + 1) b c = scalarPoly x a (b + 1) c +
      x ^ (2 * a + b + c + 2) * scalarPoly x a b c
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_c
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_c (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x a b (c + 1) = scalarPoly x a (b + 1) c +
      x ^ (a + b + 2 * c + 2) * scalarPoly x a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing b with
  | zero =>
    simp only [scalarPoly, triple, Nat.zero_add]
    rw [hermite_newton]
    simp only [pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]
    ring
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [scalarPoly_a, scalarPoly_a, scalarPoly_a, ih (b + 1), ih b]
    simp only [pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_symm
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_symm (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x a b c = scalarPoly x c b a
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing b c with
  | zero =>
    induction c generalizing b with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ c ih =>
      rw [scalarPoly_c, scalarPoly_a, ih (b + 1), ih b]
      simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_zero]
      rw [show b + 2 * c + 2 = 2 * c + b + 2 by omega]
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [scalarPoly_a, scalarPoly_c, ih (b + 1) c, ih b c]
    rw [show 2 * a + b + c + 2 = c + b + 2 * a + 2 by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.residual_c
statement:
lemma residual_c (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) :
    residual x a b (c + 1) = residual x a (b + 1) c +
      x ^ (a + b + 2 * c + 2) * residual x a b c
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with _ | a <;> rcases b with _ | _ | b <;> rcases c with _ | c
  all_goals simp only [residual, Nat.mul_add,
    Nat.mul_one, Nat.add_zero, Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.zero_sub, Nat.sub_self,
    pow_zero, sub_self, zero_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  all_goals try simp (disch := omega) only [Nat.add_sub_assoc, Nat.reduceSub]
  all_goals simp only [scalarPoly_c, scalarPoly_a]
  all_goals simp only [pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one, pow_zero]
  all_goals ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.hermite_boundary
statement:
lemma hermite_boundary (x z : R) (b : ℕ) :
    (1 - (x * z) ^ 2 * x ^ b) * hermite x (x * z) b -
      (1 - x * z) * hermite x z (b + 1) -
      (x * z) ^ 3 * (1 - x ^ (2 * b)) * hermite x (x * z) (b - 1) -
      (x * z) ^ 4 * x ^ b * (1 - x ^ (b - 1)) * (1 - x ^ b) *
        hermite x (x * z) (b - 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with _ | _ | b
  · simp; ring
  · norm_num only [hermite]; ring
  · have hn := hermite_newton x z (b + 2)
    have hs := hermite_shift x z (b + 1)
    have hb := hermite_step x (x * z) b
    simp only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      show b + 2 - 1 = b + 1 by omega] at hn hs hb ⊢
    simp only [pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one] at hn hs hb ⊢
    linear_combination -(1 - x * z) * hn +
      (x * z) ^ 2 * (1 - x ^ (b + 2)) * hb -
      (x * z) ^ 2 * (1 - x * z) * hs

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPoly_last_zero
statement:
lemma scalarPoly_last_zero (x : R) (a b : ℕ) :
    scalarPoly x a b 0 = triple x a * hermite x (x ^ a) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [scalarPoly_symm]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.residual_zero_right
statement: lemma residual_zero_right (x : R) (a b : ℕ) : residual x a b 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with _ | a
  · rcases b with _ | _ | b
    · simp [residual]
    · simp [residual, scalarPoly, triple, hermite]; ring
    · simp only [residual, scalarPoly_c, scalarPoly_last_zero]
      simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_zero,
        Nat.add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.zero_sub,
        show b + 2 - 1 = b + 1 by omega, triple, pow_zero, sub_self,
        zero_mul, mul_zero, one_mul, sub_zero]
      have hb := hermite_step x 1 b
      simp only [pow_add, pow_one, one_pow, mul_one] at hb ⊢
      linear_combination (1 - x ^ (b + 2)) * hb
  · have he := hermite_boundary x (x ^ a) b
    rw [show x * x ^ a = x ^ (a + 1) by ring] at he
    rcases b with _ | _ | b
    all_goals simp only [residual, scalarPoly_c, scalarPoly_last_zero]
    all_goals simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_zero,
      Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.zero_sub,
      Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, sub_self, zero_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero] at he ⊢
    all_goals try simp (disch := omega) only [Nat.add_sub_assoc, Nat.reduceSub] at he ⊢
    all_goals simp only [triple, pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one] at he ⊢
    all_goals linear_combination triple x a * (1 + x ^ (a + 1) + x ^ (2 * (a + 1))) * he

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.residual_eq_zero
statement: lemma residual_eq_zero (x : R) (a b c : ℕ) : residual x a b c = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction c generalizing b with
  | zero => exact residual_zero_right x a b
  | succ c ih => rw [residual_c, ih, ih, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPolynomial_zero
statement: lemma scalarPolynomial_zero : scalarPolynomial 0 0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [scalarPolynomial, scalarPoly, triple]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.DECancellation.scalarPolynomial_recurrence
statement:
theorem scalarPolynomial_recurrence (a b c : ℕ) :
    gaussian (2 * a + b + c) * scalarPolynomial a b c =
      gaussian (3 * a) * scalarPolynomial (a - 1) (b + 1) c +
      (1 - X) * X ^ (3 * a) * gaussian (b - 1) * gaussian b *
        scalarPolynomial a (b - 2) (c + 1) +
      X ^ (3 * a + b - 1) * (1 + X) * gaussian b * scalarPolynomial a (b - 1) c +
      X ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) * gaussian (3 * c) * scalarPolynomial a b (c - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hg (n : ℕ) : 1 - (X : ℤ[X]) ^ n = -(gaussian n * (X - 1)) := by
    rw [show gaussian n * ((X : ℤ[X]) - 1) = X ^ n - 1 from geom_sum_mul X n]
    ring
  have hz : (X : ℤ[X]) - 1 ≠ 0 := by simpa using (X_sub_C_ne_zero (1 : ℤ))
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hz
  have hr := residual_eq_zero (X : ℤ[X]) a b c
  simp only [residual, hg] at hr
  simp only [scalarPolynomial]
  linear_combination -hr

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.mem_adjointIndices
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_adjointIndices (n s a b c d l : ℕ) :
    (a, b, c, d, l) ∈ adjointIndices n s ↔
      a + b + 2 * c + d + l = s ∧ 3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c + d = n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjointIndices, mem_filter, mem_product, mem_range]
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointIndices_zero
statement: lemma adjointIndices_zero (s : ℕ) : adjointIndices 0 s = {(0, 0, 0, 0, s)}
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩
  simp only [mem_adjointIndices, mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq]
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointIndices_eq_empty
statement:
lemma adjointIndices_eq_empty {n s : ℕ} (h : 3 * s < n) :
    adjointIndices n s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ hi
  simp only [mem_adjointIndices] at hi
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.sum_transport
statement:
private lemma sum_transport {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V]
    (S T : Finset AdjointIndex) (P Q : AdjointIndex → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q]
    (i j : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex)
    (hi : ∀ x ∈ S, P x → i x ∈ T ∧ Q (i x))
    (hj : ∀ x ∈ T, Q x → j x ∈ S ∧ P (j x))
    (hji : ∀ x ∈ S, P x → j (i x) = x)
    (hij : ∀ x ∈ T, Q x → i (j x) = x)
    (F : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → V) :
    (∑ x ∈ S, if P x then F x (i x) else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ T, if Q x then F (j x) x else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_filter, ← sum_filter]
  apply sum_nbij' i j
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hx, hp⟩
    exact mem_filter.mpr (hi x hx hp)
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hx, hp⟩
    exact mem_filter.mpr (hj x hx hp)
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hx, hp⟩
    exact hji x hx hp
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hx, hp⟩
    exact hij x hx hp
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hx, hp⟩
    rw [hji x hx hp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.sum_adjoint_shift_f
statement:
lemma sum_adjoint_shift_f (n s : ℕ) (F : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → V) :
    (∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s, if x.2.2.2.2 ≠ 0 then
      F x (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.2 - 1) else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices (n + 1) s, if x.2.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
        F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.2 + 1) x else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_transport _ _ _ _
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b, c, d + 1, l - 1))
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b, c, d - 1, l + 1))
  all_goals
    rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ hx hp
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices] at hx
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
    dsimp only at hp ⊢
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.sum_adjoint_shift_D
statement:
lemma sum_adjoint_shift_D (n s : ℕ) (F : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → V) :
    (∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s, if x.2.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
