      F x (x.1, x.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices (n + 1) s, if x.2.1 ≠ 0 then
        F (x.1, x.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_transport _ _ _ _
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b + 1, c, d - 1, l))
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b - 1, c, d + 1, l))
  all_goals
    rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ hx hp
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices] at hx
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, and_true]
    dsimp only at hp ⊢
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.sum_adjoint_shift_DC
statement:
lemma sum_adjoint_shift_DC (n s : ℕ) (F : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → V) :
    (∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s, if 1 < x.2.2.2.1 then
      F x (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.1 - 2, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices (n + 1) s, if x.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
        F (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.1 + 2, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_transport _ _ _ _
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b, c + 1, d - 2, l))
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b, c - 1, d + 2, l))
  all_goals
    rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ hx hp
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices] at hx
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, and_true]
    dsimp only at hp ⊢
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.sum_adjoint_shift_C
statement:
lemma sum_adjoint_shift_C (n s : ℕ) (F : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → V) :
    (∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s, if x.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
      F x (x.1, x.2.1 + 2, x.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices (n + 1) s, if 1 < x.2.1 then
        F (x.1, x.2.1 - 2, x.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_transport _ _ _ _
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b + 2, c - 1, d, l))
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a, b - 2, c + 1, d, l))
  all_goals
    rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ hx hp
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices] at hx
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, and_true]
    dsimp only at hp ⊢
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.sum_adjoint_shift_B
statement:
lemma sum_adjoint_shift_B (n s : ℕ) (F : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → V) :
    (∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s, if x.2.1 ≠ 0 then
      F x (x.1 + 1, x.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices (n + 1) s, if x.1 ≠ 0 then
        F (x.1 - 1, x.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_transport _ _ _ _
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a + 1, b - 1, c, d, l))
    (fun ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ => (a - 1, b + 1, c, d, l))
  all_goals
    rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩ hx hp
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices] at hx
    simp only [mem_adjointIndices, Prod.mk.injEq, and_true]
    dsimp only at hp ⊢
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointSum_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma adjointSum_zero (q : k) (A b C D f : B) (s : ℕ) :
    adjointSum q A b C D f 0 s = qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f
proof:
:= by
  simp [adjointSum, adjointIndices_zero, adjointCoeff, adjointExponent, M5, P3,
    qDivPow_zero']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointSum_eq_zero
statement:
lemma adjointSum_eq_zero (q : k) (A b C D f : B) {n s : ℕ} (h : 3 * s < n) :
    adjointSum q A b C D f n s = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [adjointSum, adjointIndices_eq_empty h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjoint_lead
statement:
private lemma adjoint_lead {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n s a b c d l : ℕ)
    (h : (a, b, c, d, l) ∈ adjointIndices n s) :
    (q ^ 3) ^ l * q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ b * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a =
      q ^ (3 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (mem_adjointIndices n s a b c d l).mp h
  simp only [inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
  field_simp
  simp only [← pow_add]
  congr 1
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointSum_e_all
statement:
lemma adjointSum_e_all (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (n s : ℕ) :
    adjointSum q A b C D f n s * e =
      (q ^ (3 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * adjointSum q A b C D f n s) -
        qInt q (n + 1) • adjointSum q A b C D f (n + 1) s
proof:
:= by
  let coeff : AdjointIndex → k := fun ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩ => adjointCoeff q a b' c d l
  let M : AdjointIndex → B := fun ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩ => M5 q A b C D f a b' c d l
  let Ff : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → B := fun x y =>
    (q ^ 3 * coeff x * qInt q y.2.2.2.1) • M y
  let FD : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → B := fun x y =>
    (q ^ (3 * y.2.2.2.2 + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * y.2.2.1) * coeff x *
      qInt q 2 * qInt q y.2.1) • M y
  let FDC : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → B := fun x y =>
    (-(q ^ (3 * y.2.2.2.2) * q⁻¹ ^ y.2.2.2.1 * coeff x) *
      qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) y.2.2.1) • M y
  let FC : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → B := fun x y =>
    ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ (3 * y.2.2.2.2 + y.2.2.2.1) *
      q⁻¹ ^ (3 * y.2.2.1) * coeff x) * qInt q (y.2.1 - 1) * qInt q y.2.1) • M y
  let FB : AdjointIndex → AdjointIndex → B := fun x y =>
    (q ^ (3 * y.2.2.2.2 + y.2.2.2.1) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * y.2.1 + 1) * coeff x *
      qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) y.1) • M y
  have step (x : AdjointIndex) (hx : x ∈ adjointIndices n s) :
      (coeff x • M x) * e =
        (q ^ (3 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * (coeff x • M x)) -
        (if x.2.2.2.2 ≠ 0 then
          Ff x (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.2 - 1) else 0) -
        (if x.2.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
          FD x (x.1, x.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) -
        (if 1 < x.2.2.2.1 then
          FDC x (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.1 - 2, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) -
        (if x.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
          FC x (x.1, x.2.1 + 2, x.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) -
        (if x.2.1 ≠ 0 then
          FB x (x.1 + 1, x.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) else 0) := by
    rcases x with ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩
    dsimp only [coeff, M, Ff, FD, FDC, FC, FB]
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, M5_e hq hqi hpi H,
      ← adjoint_lead hq n s a b' c d l hx]
    simp only [show b' + 2 - 1 = b' + 1 by omega,
      show (1 < d) ↔ ¬ d ≤ 1 by omega, ite_not]
    split_ifs <;>
      simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_zero, smul_smul,
        pow_add, pow_one, pow_mul, inv_pow] <;> module
  have incoming (x : AdjointIndex) (hx : x ∈ adjointIndices (n + 1) s) :
      qInt q (n + 1) • (coeff x • M x) =
        (if x.2.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
          Ff (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.2 + 1) x else 0) +
        (if x.2.1 ≠ 0 then
          FD (x.1, x.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0) +
        (if x.2.2.1 ≠ 0 then
          FDC (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.1 - 1, x.2.2.2.1 + 2, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0) +
        (if 1 < x.2.1 then
          FC (x.1, x.2.1 - 2, x.2.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0) +
        (if x.1 ≠ 0 then
          FB (x.1 - 1, x.2.1 + 1, x.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2) x else 0) := by
    rcases x with ⟨a, b', c, d, l⟩
    have hn := ((mem_adjointIndices (n + 1) s a b' c d l).mp hx).2
    dsimp only [coeff, M, Ff, FD, FDC, FC, FB]
    rw [smul_smul, ← hn, adjointCoeff_recurrence_all hq]
    simp only [add_smul, ite_not, show (1 < b') ↔ ¬ b' ≤ 1 by omega,
      ite_smul, zero_smul]
  change (∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s, coeff x • M x) * e =
    (q ^ (3 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) •
      (e * ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s, coeff x • M x) -
    qInt q (n + 1) • ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices (n + 1) s, coeff x • M x
  rw [sum_mul]
  simp_rw [sum_congr rfl step]
  simp only [sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [sum_adjoint_shift_f n s Ff, sum_adjoint_shift_D n s FD,
    sum_adjoint_shift_DC n s FDC, sum_adjoint_shift_C n s FC,
    sum_adjoint_shift_B n s FB]
  simp only [mul_sum, smul_sum]
  rw [sum_congr rfl incoming]
  simp only [sum_add_distrib]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointSum_e
statement:
lemma adjointSum_e (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (n s : ℕ) :
    adjointSum q A b C D f n s * e =
      (q ^ (3 * s) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * adjointSum q A b C D f n s) -
        qInt q (n + 1) • adjointSum q A b C D f (n + 1) s
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact adjointSum_e_all hq hqi hpi H n s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_all (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r s : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef q (3 * s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * adjointSum q A b C D f n s)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [adjointSum_zero] using
    B2Integral.straighten hq hqi (3 * s) (fun n => adjointSum_e_all hq hqi hpi H n s) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r s : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef q (3 * s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * adjointSum q A b C D f n s)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_all hq hqi hpi H r s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_sum_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_sum_all (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r s : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s,
        (B2Integral.sCoef q (3 * s) r n *
          adjointCoeff q x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2) •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e *
          M5 q A b C D f x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_all hq hqi hpi H]
  simp only [adjointSum, mul_sum, smul_sum, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_sum
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_sum (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r s : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s f * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), ∑ x ∈ adjointIndices n s,
        (B2Integral.sCoef q (3 * s) r n *
          adjointCoeff q x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2) •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e *
          M5 q A b C D f x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact qDivPow_f_mul_qDivPow_e_sum_all hq hqi hpi H r s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjoint_straightening_coeff_mem
statement:
lemma adjoint_straightening_coeff_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ)
    (r s n a b c d l : ℕ) :
    B2Integral.sCoef q (3 * s) r n * adjointCoeff q a b c d l ∈ Λ
proof:
:=
  Λ.mul_mem (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hqΛ' _ _ _) (adjointCoeff_mem Λ hqΛ _ _ _ _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.tripleFactor_mul_qInt
statement:
lemma tripleFactor_mul_qInt {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    tripleFactor q n * qInt q n = qInt q (3 * n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 3 * n = n + n + n by omega, qInt_add, qInt_add]
  have hcancel : q⁻¹ ^ n * q ^ n = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
  simp only [tripleFactor, two_mul, pow_add]
  linear_combination -(qInt q n) * hcancel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qInt_three_mul_all
statement: lemma qInt_three_mul_all {q : k} (n : ℕ) : qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) n = qInt q (3 * n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q ^ 3) n, mul_add, mul_left_comm, ih,
      show 3 * (n + 1) = 3 * n + 3 by omega, qInt_add, inv_pow, pow_mul]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qInt_three_mul
statement:
lemma qInt_three_mul {q : k} (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) n = qInt q (3 * n)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd
  rw [← mul_assoc, qInt_mul_sub, inv_pow, qInt_mul_sub, qInt_mul_sub]
  simp only [inv_pow, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortFactor_succ
statement:
lemma shortFactor_succ (q : k) (n : ℕ) :
    shortFactor q (n + 1) = shortFactor q n * tripleFactor q (n + 1)
proof: := prod_range_succ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortCoeff_step_all
statement:
lemma shortCoeff_step_all {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n d : ℕ) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * shortCoeff q (n + 1 + d) (n + 1) =
      shortCoeff q (n + 1 + d) n * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * d + 1) * qInt q 3 *
        qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := tripleFactor_mul_qInt hq (n + 1)
  rw [← qInt_three_mul_all] at hf
  have hp : q ^ (2 * n + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (n + 1 + d)) = q⁻¹ ^ (2 * d + 1) := by
    rw [show 2 * (n + 1 + d) = (2 * n + 1) + (2 * d + 1) by omega, pow_add q⁻¹,
      ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow, one_mul]
  have hc : shortCoeff q (n + 1 + d) (n + 1) =
      shortCoeff q (n + 1 + d) n * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * d + 1) * tripleFactor q (n + 1) := by
    simp only [shortCoeff, shortFactor_succ,
      show (n + 1) * (n + 1) = n * n + (2 * n + 1) by ring,
      show 2 * (n + 1 + d) * (n + 1) = 2 * (n + 1 + d) * n + 2 * (n + 1 + d) by ring,
      pow_add]
    linear_combination q ^ (n * n) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (n + 1 + d) * n) *
      shortFactor q n * tripleFactor q (n + 1) * hp
  rw [hc]
  linear_combination shortCoeff q (n + 1 + d) n * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * d + 1) * hf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortCoeff_step
statement:
lemma shortCoeff_step {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (n d : ℕ) :
    qInt q (n + 1) * shortCoeff q (n + 1 + d) (n + 1) =
      shortCoeff q (n + 1 + d) n * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * d + 1) * qInt q 3 *
        qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact shortCoeff_step_all hq n d

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.short_div_mul
statement:
lemma short_div_mul (n : ℕ) : qDivPow q (n + 1) y * x =
    q⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) • (x * qDivPow q (n + 1) y) -
      (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n + 1) * qInt q 3) • (z * qDivPow q n y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero'] using hyx
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc : qInt q (n + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    have hc' : qInt q (n + 1) ≠ 0 := hqi _ (by omega)
    refine smul_right_injective B hc ?_
    simp only
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_qDivPow q y (n + 1) hc, mul_assoc, ih, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc y x, hyx, ← mul_assoc y z, hyz]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_qDivPow q y (n + 1) hc,
      mul_qDivPow q y n hc', mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_succ (v := q) (n + 1)]
    match_scalars
    all_goals (try simp only [inv_pow])
    all_goals (try field_simp)
    all_goals (try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortW_zero
statement: lemma shortW_zero (s : ℕ) : shortW q z y s 0 = qDivPow q s y
proof:
:= by
  simp [shortW, shortCoeff, shortFactor, qDivPow_zero']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortW_mul_all
statement:
lemma shortW_mul_all (s n : ℕ) :
    shortW q z y s n * x = (q⁻¹ ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (x * shortW q z y s n) -
      qInt q (n + 1) • shortW q z y s (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hz (a : ℕ) : qDivPow (q ^ 3) a z * x =
      (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a • (x * qDivPow (q ^ 3) a z) := by
    simpa only [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_one] using
      B2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow_comm (u := q ^ 3) (u' := q) hzx a 1
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy n s with h | rfl | h
  · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, s = n + 1 + d := ⟨s - n - 1, by omega⟩
    have hsn : n + 1 + d - n = d + 1 := by omega
    have hsn' : n + 1 + d - (n + 1) = d := by omega
    simp only [shortW, show n ≤ n + 1 + d by omega, show n + 1 ≤ n + 1 + d by omega,
      ite_true, hsn, hsn', smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    rw [short_div_mul hq hqi hyx hyz d, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm,
      ← mul_assoc _ x, hz, smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ z,
      A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self z n (hpi _ (by omega))]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    have hc := shortCoeff_step_all hq n d
    match_scalars
    · simp only [inv_pow]
      ring
    · linear_combination hc
  · simp only [shortW, le_refl, ite_true, Nat.sub_self, qDivPow_zero', mul_one,
      show ¬ n + 1 ≤ n by omega, ite_false, smul_zero, sub_zero, smul_mul_assoc, hz,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [inv_pow]
    ring
  · simp [shortW, show ¬ n ≤ s by omega, show ¬ n + 1 ≤ s by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortW_mul
statement:
lemma shortW_mul (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (s n : ℕ) :
    shortW q z y s n * x = (q⁻¹ ^ s * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (x * shortW q z y s n) -
      qInt q (n + 1) • shortW q z y s (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact shortW_mul_all hq hqi hpi hyx hzx hyz s n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_short_pair_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_short_pair_all (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s y * qDivPow q r x =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q (q⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) x * shortW q z y s n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [shortW_zero] using B2Integral.straighten_param hq hqi (q⁻¹ ^ s)
    (shortW_mul_all hq hqi hpi hyx hzx hyz s) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_short_pair
statement:
theorem qDivPow_short_pair (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s y * qDivPow q r x =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q (q⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) x * shortW q z y s n)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact qDivPow_short_pair_all hq hqi hpi hyx hzx hyz s r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.tripleFactor_mem
statement:
lemma tripleFactor_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (n : ℕ) :
    tripleFactor q n ∈ Λ
proof:
:=
  Λ.add_mem (Λ.add_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ _) Λ.one_mem) (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortFactor_mem
statement:
lemma shortFactor_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (n : ℕ) :
    shortFactor q n ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  exact Λ.prod_mem fun j _ ↦ tripleFactor_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ (j + 1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortCoeff_mem
statement:
lemma shortCoeff_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s n : ℕ) :
    shortCoeff q s n ∈ Λ
proof:
:=
  Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ _) (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ _))
    (shortFactor_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.short_pair_coeff_mem
statement:
lemma short_pair_coeff_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (s r n : ℕ) :
    B2Integral.sCoefParam q (q⁻¹ ^ s) r n * shortCoeff q s n ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  exact Λ.mul_mem
    (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.neg_mem Λ.one_mem) _)
      (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ _) _)) (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ _))
    (shortCoeff_mem Λ hqΛ hqiΛ s n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_b_mul_qDivPow_e_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_b_mul_qDivPow_e_all (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s b * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q (q⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * shortW q A b s n)
proof:
:=
  qDivPow_short_pair_all hq hqi hpi H.Be H.Ae H.BA s r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_b_mul_qDivPow_e
statement:
theorem qDivPow_b_mul_qDivPow_e (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s b * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q (q⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * shortW q A b s n)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact qDivPow_b_mul_qDivPow_e_all hq hqi hpi H s r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_b_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_b_all (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s D * qDivPow q r b =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q (q⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) b * shortW q C D s n)
proof:
:=
  qDivPow_short_pair_all hq hqi hpi H.DB H.CB H.DC s r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_b
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_b (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q s D * qDivPow q r b =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q (q⁻¹ ^ s) r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) b * shortW q C D s n)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_b_all hq hqi hpi H s r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixMonomial_mem
statement:
lemma prefixMonomial_mem (i a j c d : ℕ) :
    prefixMonomial q e A b C D i a j c d ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨1, one_mem _, i, a, j, c, d, by rw [one_smul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.smul_mem_prefixSpan
statement:
lemma smul_mem_prefixSpan {z : k} (hz : z ∈ Λ) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) : z • x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, i, a, j, c, d, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure
      ⟨z * w, mul_mem hz hw, i, a, j, c, d, by rw [smul_smul]⟩
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_of_monomial
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_of_monomial {y : B}
    (hy : ∀ i a j c d, prefixMonomial q e A b C D i a j c d * y ∈
      prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) :
    x * y ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, i, a, j, c, d, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact smul_mem_prefixSpan hw (hy i a j c d)
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [neg_mul]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.inv_cube_mem
statement: private lemma inv_cube_mem : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_pow]
  exact pow_mem hiΛ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_D
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_D (r : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) :
    x * qDivPow q r D ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  apply prefixSpan_mul_of_monomial _ hx
  intro i a j c d
  rw [prefixMonomial, mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow D d r
    (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi _), mul_smul_comm]
  exact smul_mem_prefixSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem hqΛ hiΛ _ _)
    (prefixMonomial_mem i a j c (d + r))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_C
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_C (r : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) :
    x * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r C ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  apply prefixSpan_mul_of_monomial _ hx
  intro i a j c d
  rw [prefixMonomial, mul_assoc, Dd_Cd H, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc _ (qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C),
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow C c r (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hpi _),
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  exact smul_mem_prefixSpan (pow_mem (inv_cube_mem hiΛ) _)
    (smul_mem_prefixSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem (pow_mem hqΛ 3) (inv_cube_mem hiΛ) _ _)
      (prefixMonomial_mem i a j (c + r) d))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_b
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_b (r : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) :
    x * qDivPow q r b ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  apply prefixSpan_mul_of_monomial _ hx
  intro i a j c d
  rw [prefixMonomial, mul_assoc, qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_b_all hq hqi hpi H, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases hn : n ≤ d
  · simp only [shortW, hn, ite_true, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (short_pair_coeff_mem Λ hqΛ hiΛ d r n)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    apply prefixSpan_mul_D hqi hqΛ hiΛ
    apply prefixSpan_mul_C hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
    rw [mul_assoc, Cd_bd H, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_assoc _ (qDivPow q j b),
      A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow b j (r - n)
        (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi _), mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
    apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (pow_mem (inv_cube_mem hiΛ) _)
    apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem hqΛ hiΛ _ _)
    simpa only [prefixMonomial, qDivPow_zero', mul_one] using
      (prefixMonomial_mem (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b)
        (C := C) (D := D) i a (j + (r - n)) c 0)
  · simp [shortW, hn]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefix_three_mul_A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, bd_Ad H, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc _ (qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A),
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow A a r (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hpi _),
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (pow_mem (inv_cube_mem hiΛ) _)
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem (pow_mem hqΛ 3) (inv_cube_mem hiΛ) _ _)
  simpa only [prefixMonomial, qDivPow_zero', mul_one] using
    (prefixMonomial_mem (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b)
      (C := C) (D := D) i (a + r) j 0 0)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefix_four_mul_A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_A_all hq hqi hpi H, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases hn : n ≤ c
  · simp only [longW, hn, ite_true, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (long_pair_coeff_mem Λ hqΛ hiΛ c r n)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    apply prefixSpan_mul_C hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
    apply prefixSpan_mul_b hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
    exact prefix_three_mul_A hpi H hqΛ hiΛ i a j (r - n)
  · simp [longW, hn]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_A
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_A (r : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) :
    x * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r A ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  apply prefixSpan_mul_of_monomial _ hx
  intro i a j c d
  have ht := congrArg MulOpposite.unop
    (SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum hq hqi hpi H.squareRel_op r d)
  simp only [MulOpposite.unop_mul, unop_sum, MulOpposite.unop_smul,
    qDivPow, MulOpposite.unop_pow, MulOpposite.unop_op] at ht
  change qDivPow q d D * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r A = _ at ht
  rw [prefixMonomial, mul_assoc, ht, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun v _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_smul_comm]
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (square_straightening_coeff_mem hq hqi hqΛ hiΛ r d n v)
  change (qDivPow q i e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A * qDivPow q j b *
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C) * (qDivPow (q ^ 3) v.2.2 A *
      (qDivPow q v.2.1 b * (qDivPow (q ^ 3) v.1 C * qDivPow q (d - n) D))) ∈ _
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
  apply prefixSpan_mul_D hqi hqΛ hiΛ
  apply prefixSpan_mul_C hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  apply prefixSpan_mul_b hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  exact prefix_four_mul_A hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ i a j c v.2.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefix_two_mul_e
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, Ad_ed H, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow e i r (A2Integral.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_qInt hqi _),
    smul_mul_assoc]
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (pow_mem (inv_cube_mem hiΛ) _)
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem hqΛ hiΛ _ _)
  simpa only [prefixMonomial, qDivPow_zero', mul_one] using
    (prefixMonomial_mem (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b)
      (C := C) (D := D) (i + r) a 0 0 0)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefix_three_mul_e
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, qDivPow_b_mul_qDivPow_e_all hq hqi hpi H, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases hn : n ≤ j
  · simp only [shortW, hn, ite_true, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (short_pair_coeff_mem Λ hqΛ hiΛ j r n)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    apply prefixSpan_mul_b hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
    apply prefixSpan_mul_A hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
    exact prefix_two_mul_e hqi H hqΛ hiΛ i a (r - n)
  · simp [shortW, hn]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefix_four_mul_e
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum hq hqi hpi H, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun v _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_smul_comm]
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (square_straightening_coeff_mem hq hqi hqΛ hiΛ c r n v)
  simp only [← mul_assoc]
  apply prefixSpan_mul_C hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  apply prefixSpan_mul_b hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  apply prefixSpan_mul_A hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  exact prefix_three_mul_e hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ i a j (r - n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul_e
statement:
lemma prefixSpan_mul_e (r : ℕ) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) :
    x * qDivPow q r e ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  apply prefixSpan_mul_of_monomial _ hx
  intro i a j c d
  rw [prefixMonomial, mul_assoc, qDivPow_D_mul_qDivPow_e hq hqi hpi H, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_smul_comm]
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (B2Integral.sCoef_mem hqΛ hiΛ d r n)
  rw [deW_sum, mul_sum, mul_sum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun v _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]
  apply smul_mem_prefixSpan (deCoeff_mem hq hqi Λ hqΛ hiΛ d n v)
  simp only [deMonomial, P3, ← mul_assoc]
  apply prefixSpan_mul_D hqi hqΛ hiΛ
  apply prefixSpan_mul_C hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  apply prefixSpan_mul_b hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  apply prefixSpan_mul_A hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ
  exact prefix_four_mul_e hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ i a j c (r - n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.prefixSpan_mul
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_mul {x y : B} (hx : x ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D)
    (hy : y ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D) : x * y ∈ prefixSpan q Λ e A b C D
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, i, a, j, c, d, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [mul_smul_comm]
    apply smul_mem_prefixSpan hw
    simp only [prefixMonomial, ← mul_assoc]
    exact prefixSpan_mul_D hqi hqΛ hiΛ d
      (prefixSpan_mul_C hpi H hqΛ hiΛ c
        (prefixSpan_mul_b hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ j
          (prefixSpan_mul_A hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ a
            (prefixSpan_mul_e hq hqi hpi H hqΛ hiΛ i hx))))
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [mul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qInt_double_decomp
statement:
lemma qInt_double_decomp (hq : q ≠ 0) (b : ℕ) :
    qInt q (2 * b) = q ^ (b - 1) * qInt q 2 * qInt q b -
      (q ^ 2 - 1) * q⁻¹ ^ 2 * qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b
proof:
:= by
  cases b with
  | zero => simp [qInt]
  | succ b =>
    have hh := qInt_mul_sub (v := q) b
    rw [show 2 * (b + 1) = (b + 1) + (b + 1) by omega, qInt_add]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, qInt_two, pow_add, pow_one]
    linear_combination (norm := (field_simp; ring)) q⁻¹ * qInt q (b + 1) * hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjoint_scalar_all
statement:
lemma adjoint_scalar_all (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d : ℕ) :
    qInt q (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c + d) =
      q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c) * qInt q d +
      q ^ (3 * a + b) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 1) * qInt q 2 * qInt q b +
      q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) * q⁻¹ ^ d * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c -
      (q ^ 2 - 1) * q ^ (3 * a) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 2) *
        qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b +
      q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 3 * c + d) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a
proof:
:= by
  have ha := qInt_three_mul_all (q := q) a
  have hc := qInt_three_mul_all (q := q) c
  have hb := qInt_double_decomp hq b
  rw [qInt_add]
  rw [show 3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c = 3 * a + (2 * b + 3 * c) by omega]
  rw [qInt_add, qInt_add, ← ha, ← hc, hb]
  cases b with
  | zero => simp [qInt, pow_add]; ring
  | succ b =>
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_add, pow_one]
    field_simp
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjoint_scalar
statement:
lemma adjoint_scalar (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (a b c d : ℕ) :
    qInt q (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c + d) =
      q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b + 3 * c) * qInt q d +
      q ^ (3 * a + b) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 1) * qInt q 2 * qInt q b +
      q ^ (3 * a + 2 * b) * q⁻¹ ^ d * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) c -
      (q ^ 2 - 1) * q ^ (3 * a) * q⁻¹ ^ (3 * c + d + 2) *
        qInt q (b - 1) * qInt q b +
      q⁻¹ ^ (2 * b + 3 * c + d) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) a
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hd
  exact adjoint_scalar_all hq a b c d

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointCoeff_mem
statement:
lemma adjointCoeff_mem (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (a b c d l : ℕ) :
    adjointCoeff q a b c d l ∈ Λ
proof:
:=
  Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem (Λ.neg_mem Λ.one_mem) _) (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.qSerre_three_eq_rev
statement:
lemma qSerre_three_eq_rev {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (e f : B) :
    qSerre q 3 e f =
      q ^ 2 • (e * (A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e * e - e * A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e)) -
        (A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e * e - e * A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e) * e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial, A2PBW.qComm]
  simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
    smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc, zero_add, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
    Nat.add_one_sub_one]
  match_scalars <;> (field_simp; try ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.rel_op
statement:
theorem rel_op {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) {e f : B} (hS3 : qSerre q 3 e f = 0)
    (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 2) 2 f e = 0) :
    Rel (q ^ 2) (op e) (op (A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e * e - e * A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e))
      (op (A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e)) (op f) where
  fe
proof:
:= by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [unop_mul, unop_sub, unop_smul, unop_op]
    exact A2PBW.mul_eq_qComm (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) f e
  ye := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [unop_mul, unop_sub, unop_op]
    abel
  xe := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [unop_mul, unop_smul, unop_op]
    rw [qSerre_three_eq_rev hq, sub_eq_zero] at hS3
    rw [← hS3, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq), one_smul]
  fy := by
    apply unop_injective
    simp only [unop_mul, unop_smul, unop_op]
    exact A2PBW.qComm_mul_left_of_qSerre (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) hS2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.span_revMono_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem span_revMono_eq_adjoin {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h1 : q ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0)
    (h2 : (q ^ 2) ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) {e f : B} (hS3 : qSerre q 3 e f = 0)
    (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 2) 2 f e = 0) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range fun m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ ↦
      f ^ m.1 * (A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e ^ m.2.1 *
        ((A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e * e - e * A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e) ^ m.2.2.1 *
          e ^ m.2.2.2))) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {e, f}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  set y := A2PBW.qComm (q ^ 2) f e
  set x := y * e - e * y
  set g : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → B := fun m ↦ f ^ m.1 * (y ^ m.2.1 * (x ^ m.2.2.1 * e ^ m.2.2.2))
  have H := span_mono_eq_adjoin (rel_op hq hS3 hS2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) h1 h2
  have hr : Set.range (mono (op e) (op x) (op y) (op f)) =
      (opLinearEquiv k : B ≃ₗ[k] Bᵐᵒᵖ).toLinearMap '' Set.range g := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨g (d, c, b, a), ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change op (f ^ d * (y ^ c * (x ^ b * e ^ a))) = _
      simp only [mono, op_mul, op_pow, mul_assoc]
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(d, c, b, a), ?_⟩
      change _ = op (f ^ a * (y ^ b * (x ^ c * e ^ d)))
      simp only [mono, op_mul, op_pow, mul_assoc]
  have hA : Algebra.adjoin k {op e, op f} = (Algebra.adjoin k ({e, f} : Set B)).op := by
    rw [Subalgebra.op_adjoin]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact Or.inl (by rw [← h, op_unop])
      · exact Or.inr (by rw [← h, op_unop])
  rw [hr, Submodule.span_image, hA] at H
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have h' : op z ∈ (Submodule.span k (Set.range g)).map
        (opLinearEquiv k : B ≃ₗ[k] Bᵐᵒᵖ).toLinearMap := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rw [H] at h'
    exact Subalgebra.mem_op.mp h'
  · intro hz
    have h' : op z ∈ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin k ({e, f} : Set B)).op :=
      Subalgebra.mem_op.mpr hz
    rw [← H] at h'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := h'
    rwa [show y = z from op_injective hyz] at hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_b2RevMono_pair
statement:
theorem span_b2RevMono_pair :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range fun m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ ↦
      E R v j ^ m.1 * (b2RevRootY R v i j ^ m.2.1 *
        (b2RevRootX R v i j ^ m.2.2.1 * E R v i ^ m.2.2.2))) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨_, h1, hp2⟩ := B2PBW.param_ne hq0 hq h2
  have hS3 := serre_E R v hij
  rw [B2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_three h] at hS3
  have hS2 := serre_E R v hij.symm
  rw [A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h'] at hS2
  exact B2PBW.span_revMono_eq_adjoin hq0 h1 hp2 hS3 hS2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_b2RevPBWMono_pair
statement:
theorem span_b2RevPBWMono_pair :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range fun m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ ↦
      E R v j ^ m.1 * (b2RevRootY R v i j ^ m.2.1 *
        (((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ • b2RevRootX R v i j) ^ m.2.2.1 * E R v i ^ m.2.2.2))) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_b2RevMono_pair R v hij h h' hq h2]
  have hc : (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero h2
  have e (m : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
      E R v j ^ m.1 * (b2RevRootY R v i j ^ m.2.1 *
        (((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ • b2RevRootX R v i j) ^ m.2.2.1 * E R v i ^ m.2.2.2)) =
      ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ^ m.2.2.1) • (E R v j ^ m.1 * (b2RevRootY R v i j ^ m.2.1 *
        (b2RevRootX R v i j ^ m.2.2.1 * E R v i ^ m.2.2.2))) := by
    rw [smul_pow]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
  apply le_antisymm <;> rw [Submodule.span_le] <;> rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  · dsimp only
    rw [e]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)
  · dsimp only
    have hm := (inv_smul_eq_iff₀ (pow_ne_zero m.2.2.1 hc)).mpr (e m)
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← hm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.b2RootY_eq_X
statement:
lemma b2RootY_eq_X :
    b2RootY R v i j = BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) (E R v i) (E R v j) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [BraidDiagonal.X_succ (n := 0), b2_shift_zero]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomial_b2_eq
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_b2_eq (c : Fin [i, j, i, j].length → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i, j] c =
      b2PBWMono R v i j (c 0, c 1, c 2, c 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [b2PBWMono_eq_rootVectors Hi Hj hij h h' hq h2]
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial, map_mul, map_pow, map_one, mul_one]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomial_b2_rev_eq
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_b2_rev_eq (c : Fin [j, i, j, i].length → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i, j, i] c =
      E R v j ^ c 0 * (b2RevRootY R v i j ^ c 1 *
        (((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ • b2RevRootX R v i j) ^ c 2 * E R v i ^ c 3))
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hY' : (T j) (E R v i) = b2RevRootY R v i j := by
    have e := a2_rootVector_two hij.symm Hj
    change (T j) (E R v i) = _ at e
    rw [e, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h', parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h']
    rfl
  have hY : (T j) (b2RootY R v i j) = E R v i := by
    rw [b2RootY_eq_X R v (j := j)]
    exact b2_T_X_one Hj hij h h' hq h2
  have hX : (T j) ((T i) (E R v j)) = (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ • b2RevRootX R v i j := by
    have e := a2_rootVector_two hij Hi
    change (T i) (E R v j) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_braidEj_eq h, map_smul, b2RootX, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, hY, hY']
    rfl
  have hE : (T j) ((T i) ((T j) (E R v i))) = E R v i := by
    have e := b2_rootVector_three Hi Hj hij h h' hq
    change (T i) ((T j) (E R v i)) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_cc_two hq0 hq, ← b2_qFactorial_two hq0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul,
      ← b2RootY_eq_X, hY]
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial, map_mul, map_pow, map_one, mul_one]
  change E R v j ^ c 0 * ((T j) (E R v i) ^ c 1 * ((T j) ((T i) (E R v j)) ^ c 2 *
    (T j) ((T i) ((T j) (E R v i))) ^ c 3)) = _
  rw [hE, hX, hY']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_b2
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_b2 :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i, j])) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i, j]) =
      Set.range (b2PBWMono R v i j) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, (pbwMonomial_b2_eq R v hij h h' hq h2 T Hi Hj c).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨![a, b, c, d], pbwMonomial_b2_eq R v hij h h' hq h2 T Hi Hj _⟩
  rw [hr]
  exact span_b2PBWMono_pair R v hij h h' hq h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_b2_rev
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_b2_rev :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i, j, i])) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_b2RevPBWMono_pair R v hij h h' hq h2]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(c 0, c 1, c 2, c 3), (pbwMonomial_b2_rev_eq R v hij h h' hq h2 T Hi Hj c).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨![a, b, c, d], pbwMonomial_b2_rev_eq R v hij h h' hq h2 T Hi Hj _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_b2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_b2_braid :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i, j])) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i, j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwMonomial_b2 R v hij h h' hq h2 T Hi Hj,
    span_pbwMonomial_b2_rev R v hij h h' hq h2 T Hi Hj]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_b2_context
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_b2_context
    (hT : T i * T j * T i * T j = T j * T i * T j * T i) (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
      (p ++ [i, j, i, j] ++ s))) =
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
      (p ++ [j, i, j, i] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  apply CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_context
    T (E R v) (span_pbwMonomial_b2_braid R v hij h h' hq h2 T Hi Hj)
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil,
    mul_one, ← mul_assoc] using hT

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_b2_context_of_not_root
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_b2_context_of_not_root
    (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [i, j, i, j] ++ s))) =
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [j, i, j, i] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  apply span_pbwMonomial_b2_context R v hij h h' (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i 2) (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot_images hv' i) (braidEquivOfNotRoot_images hv' j)
  have hLift : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') :=
    isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv'
  have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 4 := by
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h, h']
    rfl
  have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 4 := by
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h, h']
    rfl
  have e := hLift i j hij (by omega)
  simpa [CoxeterSystem.braidWord, hm, hm', CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord,
    ← mul_assoc] using e

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.gaussian_ne_zero
statement: lemma gaussian_ne_zero (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : gaussian m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussian, ← prod_cyclotomic_eq_geom_sum hm]
  exact prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ ↦ cyclotomic_ne_zero i ℤ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.progressionProduct_ne_zero
statement:
lemma progressionProduct_ne_zero (k n : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    progressionProduct k n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _
  exact gaussian_ne_zero _ (by positivity)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.cyclotomic_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma cyclotomic_emultiplicity (d e : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (cyclotomic e ℤ) = if d = e then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst e
    simpa using emultiplicity_pow_self_of_prime (cyclotomic.irreducible hd).prime 1
  · apply emultiplicity_eq_zero.mpr
    intro hdiv
    apply h
    apply cyclotomic_injective (R := ℤ)
    exact eq_of_monic_of_associated (cyclotomic.monic d ℤ) (cyclotomic.monic e ℤ)
      ((cyclotomic.irreducible hd).associated_of_dvd (cyclotomic.irreducible he) hdiv)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.gaussian_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma gaussian_emultiplicity (d m : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) (hm : 0 < m) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (gaussian m) = if d ∣ m then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [gaussian, ← prod_cyclotomic_eq_geom_sum hm,
    Finset.emultiplicity_prod (cyclotomic.irreducible (by omega : 0 < d)).prime]
  have he (e : ℕ) (he : e ∈ m.divisors.erase 1) : 0 < e :=
    Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors (mem_of_mem_erase he)
  simp_rw [sum_congr rfl (fun e he' ↦ cyclotomic_emultiplicity d e (by omega) (he e he'))]
  simp [Nat.mem_divisors, hm.ne', show d ≠ 1 by omega]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.progressionProduct_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma progressionProduct_emultiplicity (k n d : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hd : 1 < d) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (progressionProduct k n) =
      (#{i ∈ range n | d ∣ k * (i + 1)} : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [progressionProduct,
    Finset.emultiplicity_prod (cyclotomic.irreducible (by omega : 0 < d)).prime]
  rw [sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ gaussian_emultiplicity d (k * (i + 1)) hd
    (by positivity))]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.factorial_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma factorial_emultiplicity (n d : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (progressionProduct 1 n) = (n / d : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [progressionProduct_emultiplicity 1 n d (by decide) hd]
  simp only [one_mul, Nat.card_multiples]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.tripleProduct_emultiplicity
statement:
lemma tripleProduct_emultiplicity (n h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic (3 * h) ℤ) (progressionProduct 3 n) = (n / h : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [progressionProduct_emultiplicity 3 n (3 * h) (by decide) (by omega)]
  simp only [Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (by decide : 0 < 3), Nat.card_multiples]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.tripleProduct_emultiplicity_of_not_dvd
statement:
lemma tripleProduct_emultiplicity_of_not_dvd (n d : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) (h3 : ¬3 ∣ d) :
    emultiplicity (cyclotomic d ℤ) (progressionProduct 3 n) = (n / d : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : d.Coprime 3 := ((Nat.prime_three.coprime_iff_not_dvd).mpr h3).symm
  rw [progressionProduct_emultiplicity 3 n d (by decide) hd]
  simp only [hc.dvd_mul_left, Nat.card_multiples]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.prime_dvd_progressionProduct
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := (hp.dvd_finsetProd_iff _).mp hdiv
  change p ∣ gaussian (k * (i + 1)) at hi
  rw [gaussian, ← prod_cyclotomic_eq_geom_sum (by positivity : 0 < k * (i + 1))] at hi
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hpd⟩ := (hp.dvd_finsetProd_iff _).mp hi
  have hd0 := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors (mem_of_mem_erase hd)
  have hd1 := ne_of_mem_erase hd
  exact ⟨d, by omega,
    hp.irreducible.associated_of_dvd (cyclotomic.irreducible hd0) hpd⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonCoeff_factorial_dvd
statement:
theorem newtonCoeff_factorial_dvd (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n) (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t) :
    progressionProduct 3 t ∣ progressionProduct 1 (3 * t - n) *
      progressionProduct 3 (n - t) * newtonCoeff n t
proof:
:= by
  apply (dvd_iff_emultiplicity_le (progressionProduct_ne_zero 3 t (by decide))).mpr
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpd : p ∣ progressionProduct 3 t
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hassoc⟩ := prime_dvd_progressionProduct 3 t (by decide) hp hpd
    rw [← emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_left hassoc,
      ← emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_left hassoc]
    have hprime := (cyclotomic.irreducible (show 0 < d by omega)).prime
    rw [emultiplicity_mul hprime, emultiplicity_mul hprime,
      factorial_emultiplicity _ d hd]
    by_cases h3 : 3 ∣ d
    · obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := h3
      have hh : 0 < h := by omega
      rw [tripleProduct_emultiplicity t h hh, tripleProduct_emultiplicity (n - t) h hh]
      have hv := le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd (cyclotomic_pow_dvd_newtonCoeff h hh n t)
      have hf := square_floor_comparison (n - t) (3 * t - n) n h hh (by omega)
      have hb : t / h ≤ (3 * t - n) / (3 * h) + (n - t) / h +
          (t / h - n / (3 * h)) := by omega
      have hb' : (t / h : ℕ∞) ≤ ((3 * t - n) / (3 * h) : ℕ) +
          ((n - t) / h : ℕ) + (t / h - n / (3 * h) : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
      exact hb'.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hv)
    · rw [tripleProduct_emultiplicity_of_not_dvd t d hd h3,
        tripleProduct_emultiplicity_of_not_dvd (n - t) d hd h3]
      have hb : t / d ≤ (3 * t - n) / d + (n - t) / d := by
        by_cases ha : t ≤ n - t
        · exact (Nat.div_le_div_right (c := d) ha).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
        · exact (Nat.div_le_div_right (c := d) (show t ≤ 3 * t - n by omega)).trans
            (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
      have hb' : (t / d : ℕ∞) ≤ ((3 * t - n) / d : ℕ) + ((n - t) / d : ℕ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hb
      exact hb'.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le)
  · rw [emultiplicity_eq_zero.mpr hpd]
    exact bot_le

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_spec
statement:
theorem squarePolynomial_spec (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n) (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t) :
    progressionProduct 3 t * squarePolynomial n t =
      progressionProduct 1 (3 * t - n) * progressionProduct 3 (n - t) * newtonCoeff n t
proof:
:= by
  rw [squarePolynomial, dite_eq_left ⟨htn, hnt⟩]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (newtonCoeff_factorial_dvd n t htn hnt)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.squarePolynomial_unique
statement:
theorem squarePolynomial_unique (n t : ℕ) (htn : t ≤ n) (hnt : n ≤ 3 * t)
    (H : ℤ[X]) (hH : progressionProduct 3 t * H =
      progressionProduct 1 (3 * t - n) * progressionProduct 3 (n - t) * newtonCoeff n t) :
    H = squarePolynomial n t
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (progressionProduct_ne_zero 3 t (by decide))
  exact hH.trans (squarePolynomial_spec n t htn hnt).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareStepTerm_grade
statement:
lemma squareStepTerm_grade (q : k) (i j : SquareIndex) (n s : ℕ)
    (hi : 3 * i.1 + i.2.1 = 2 * n ∧ i.1 + i.2.1 + 2 * i.2.2 = 2 * s)
    (hj : ¬ (3 * j.1 + j.2.1 = 2 * (n + 1) ∧
      j.1 + j.2.1 + 2 * j.2.2 = 2 * s)) : squareStepTerm q i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [squareStepTerm, Finsupp.add_apply]
  have h₁ : (if i.2.1 = 0 then 0 else
      Finsupp.single (i.1 + 1, i.2.1 - 1, i.2.2)
        (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (i.2.1 - 1) + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (i.1 + 1))) j = 0 := by
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · apply Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne
      intro he
      subst j
      apply hj
      dsimp
      omega
  have h₂ : (if i.2.2 = 0 then 0 else
      Finsupp.single (i.1, i.2.1 + 2, i.2.2 - 1)
        ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (i.2.2 - 1) *
          qInt q (i.2.1 + 1) * qInt q (i.2.1 + 2))) j = 0 := by
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · apply Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne
      intro he
      subst j
      apply hj
      dsimp
      omega
  rw [h₁, h₂, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareNumerator_grade
statement:
lemma squareNumerator_grade (q : k) (s n : ℕ) (i : SquareIndex)
    (hi : squareNumerator q s n i ≠ 0) :
    3 * i.1 + i.2.1 = 2 * n ∧ i.1 + i.2.1 + 2 * i.2.2 = 2 * s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero =>
    have he : (0, 0, s) = i := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hi (Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hn))
    subst i
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    by_contra hn
    apply hi
    simp only [squareNumerator, squareStep, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
      Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    rw [squareStepTerm_grade q j i n s (ih j (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hj)) hn,
      mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareNumerator_eq_zero
statement:
lemma squareNumerator_eq_zero (q : k) (s n : ℕ) (hn : 3 * s < n) :
    squareNumerator q s n = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_contra hi
  have hg := squareNumerator_grade q s n i hi
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.squareStepTerm_eval
statement:
lemma SquareRel.squareStepTerm_eval (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (i : SquareIndex) :
    squareEval q A b C (squareStepTerm q i) =
      (q⁻¹ ^ i.2.1 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ i.1) • (e * P3 q A b C i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2) -
        P3 q A b C i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2 * e
proof:
:= by
  have hm := SquareRel.P3_e hq hqi hpi H i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2
  simp only [squareStepTerm, map_add, squareEval]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_zero, Finsupp.linearCombination_single] <;>
    simp_all only [ite_true, ite_false] <;> abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareStepTerm_eval
statement:
lemma squareStepTerm_eval (i : SquareIndex) :
    squareEval q A b C (squareStepTerm q i) =
      (q⁻¹ ^ i.2.1 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ i.1) • (e * P3 q A b C i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2) -
        P3 q A b C i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2 * e
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.squareStepTerm_eval hq hqi hpi H.squareRel i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.squareNumerator_eval_mul
statement:
lemma SquareRel.squareNumerator_eval_mul (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (s n : ℕ) :
    squareEval q A b C (squareNumerator q s n) * e =
      q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) • (e * squareEval q A b C (squareNumerator q s n)) -
        squareEval q A b C (squareNumerator q s (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ht (i : SquareIndex) (hi : i ∈ (squareNumerator q s n).support) :
      squareEval q A b C (squareStepTerm q i) =
        q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) • (e * P3 q A b C i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2) -
          P3 q A b C i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2 * e := by
    rw [SquareRel.squareStepTerm_eval hq hqi hpi H]
    have hg := (squareNumerator_grade q s n i (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi)).1
    rw [← inv_pow q 3, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add,
      show i.2.1 + 3 * i.1 = 2 * n by omega]
  simp only [squareNumerator, squareStep, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    map_sum, map_smul]
  simp only [squareEval, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have h := ht i hi
  simp only [squareEval, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] at h
  rw [← Finset.smul_sum, h, smul_sub]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareNumerator_eval_mul
statement:
lemma squareNumerator_eval_mul (s n : ℕ) :
    squareEval q A b C (squareNumerator q s n) * e =
      q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) • (e * squareEval q A b C (squareNumerator q s n)) -
        squareEval q A b C (squareNumerator q s (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.squareNumerator_eval_mul hq hqi hpi H.squareRel s n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareStepTerm_mem
statement:
lemma squareStepTerm_mem (q : k) (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ)
    (i j : SquareIndex) : squareStepTerm q i j ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by simpa only [← inv_pow] using Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ 3
  have h₁ : q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (i.2.1 - 1) + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (i.1 + 1) ∈ Λ :=
    Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqiΛ _) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqiΛ _))
      (B2Integral.qInt_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ 3) hp _)
  have h₂ : (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (i.2.2 - 1) *
      qInt q (i.2.1 + 1) * qInt q (i.2.1 + 2) ∈ Λ :=
    Λ.mul_mem (Λ.mul_mem
      (Λ.mul_mem (Λ.sub_mem (Λ.pow_mem hqΛ 2) Λ.one_mem) (Λ.pow_mem hp _))
      (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqiΛ _)) (B2Integral.qInt_mem hqΛ hqiΛ _)
  simp only [squareStepTerm, Finsupp.add_apply]
  apply Λ.add_mem
  · split_ifs <;> simp only [Finsupp.zero_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    · exact Λ.zero_mem
    · split_ifs <;> first | assumption | exact Λ.zero_mem
  · split_ifs <;> simp only [Finsupp.zero_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    · exact Λ.zero_mem
    · split_ifs <;> first | assumption | exact Λ.zero_mem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareNumerator_mem
statement:
lemma squareNumerator_mem (q : k) (Λ : Subring k) (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hqiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ)
    (s n : ℕ) (i : SquareIndex) : squareNumerator q s n i ∈ Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero =>
    simp only [squareNumerator, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact Λ.one_mem
    · exact Λ.zero_mem
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [squareNumerator, squareStep, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
      Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Λ.sum_mem fun j _ ↦ Λ.mul_mem (ih j) (squareStepTerm_mem q Λ hqΛ hqiΛ j i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareW_sum
statement:
lemma squareW_sum (s n : ℕ) : squareW q A b C s n =
    ∑ i ∈ (squareNumerator q s n).support,
      squareCoeff q s n i • P3 q A b C i.1 i.2.1 i.2.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [squareW, squareEval, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, squareCoeff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareW_zero
statement: lemma squareW_zero (s : ℕ) : squareW q A b C s 0 = qDivPow (q ^ 3) s C
proof:
:= by
  simp [squareW, squareNumerator, squareEval, P3, qFactorial, qDivPow_zero']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.squareW_mul
statement:
lemma SquareRel.squareW_mul (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (s n : ℕ) :
    squareW q A b C s n * e = q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) • (e * squareW q A b C s n) -
      qInt q (n + 1) • squareW q A b C s (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := hqi (n + 1) (by omega)
  simp only [squareW, smul_mul_assoc, SquareRel.squareNumerator_eval_mul hq hqi hpi H,
    smul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, qFactorial_succ, mul_inv_rev]
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    ring
  · congr 1
    field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareW_mul
statement:
lemma squareW_mul (s n : ℕ) :
    squareW q A b C s n * e = q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) • (e * squareW q A b C s n) -
      qInt q (n + 1) • squareW q A b C s (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.squareW_mul hq hqi hpi H.squareRel s n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareW_eq_zero
statement: lemma squareW_eq_zero (s n : ℕ) (hn : 3 * s < n) : squareW q A b C s n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [squareW, squareNumerator_eq_zero q s n hn]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field
statement:
theorem SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s C * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q 1 r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * squareW q A b C s n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← squareW_zero (q := q) (A := A) (b := b) s]
  exact B2Integral.straighten_param hq hqi 1
    (fun n ↦ by simpa only [one_mul] using SquareRel.squareW_mul hq hqi hpi H s n) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field
statement:
theorem qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s C * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoefParam q 1 r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * squareW q A b C s n)
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field hq hqi hpi H.squareRel s r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum
statement:
theorem SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s C * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), ∑ i ∈ (squareNumerator q s n).support,
        (B2Integral.sCoefParam q 1 r n * squareCoeff q s n i) •
          (qDivPow q (r - n) e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) i.1 A *
            qDivPow q i.2.1 b * qDivPow (q ^ 3) i.2.2 C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field hq hqi hpi H]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  rw [squareW_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [P3, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum
statement:
theorem qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum (s r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) s C * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), ∑ i ∈ (squareNumerator q s n).support,
        (B2Integral.sCoefParam q 1 r n * squareCoeff q s n i) •
          (qDivPow q (r - n) e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) i.1 A *
            qDivPow q i.2.1 b * qDivPow (q ^ 3) i.2.2 C)
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.qDivPow_C_mul_qDivPow_e_field_sum hq hqi hpi H.squareRel s r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_mem_plusWeightSpace
statement:
theorem plusHom_mem_plusWeightSpace {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) : plusHom R v x ∈ plusWeightSpace R v ν
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ker_plusHom_inf_weightSpace
statement:
theorem ker_plusHom_inf_weightSpace [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) (ν : I →₀ ℕ)
    {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) :
    plusHom R v x = 0 ↔ x ∈ serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental hv
  have hvn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1 := fun _ hn ↦ pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hv hn
  rw [plusHom_eq_zero_iff R v hvn]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ (mem_serreSpan_of_mem_radical_and_finrank_serreSpan D hv ν).1 x
    (serreIdeal_le_radical hv0 hvn h) hx, serreSpan_le_serreIdeal D hv0 hvn⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finrank_plusWeightSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_plusWeightSpace [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank k (plusWeightSpace R v ν) + finrank ℚ (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) ν) =
      Fintype.card (Words ν)
proof:
:= by
  set V := weightSpace k ν
  set f := (plusHom R v).toLinearMap.domRestrict V
  have hrange : LinearMap.range f = plusWeightSpace R v ν := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict]; rfl
  have hker : LinearMap.ker f = (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν).comap V.subtype := by
    ext y
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply]
    exact ker_plusHom_inf_weightSpace hv ν y.2
  have hSer : finrank k ((serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν).comap V.subtype) =
      finrank k (serreSpan D (fun i ↦ v ^ D.d i) ν) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
      inf_eq_right.2 (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν)]
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f
  rw [hrange, hker, hSer, finrank_weightSpace,
    (mem_serreSpan_of_mem_radical_and_finrank_serreSpan D hv ν).2] at hrn
  exact hrn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finrank_plusWeightSpace_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_plusWeightSpace_eq [Finite I] (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) {k' Y' : Type*}
    [Field k'] [CharZero k'] [AddCommGroup Y'] (R' : D.RootDatum Y') {v' : k'} [NeZero v']
    (hv' : Transcendental ℚ v') (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank k (plusWeightSpace R v ν) = finrank k' (plusWeightSpace R' v' ν)
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_plusWeightSpace (R := R) hv ν
  have h' := finrank_plusWeightSpace (R := R') hv' ν
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_apply
statement:
lemma shift_apply (x : R) (F : R[X]) :
    shift x F = (1 + X) * F.comp (C x * X)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_apply
statement:
lemma shift_pow_apply (x : R) (n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    (shift x ^ n) F = linearFactors x n * F.comp (C (x ^ n) * X)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [linearFactors]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, shift_apply, ih]
    simp only [mul_comp, comp_assoc, mul_comp, C_comp, X_comp]
    have hc : C (x ^ n) * (C x * X) = C (x ^ (n + 1)) * X := by
      rw [pow_succ, map_mul]
      ring
    rw [hc]
    have hp : (1 + X) * (linearFactors x n).comp (C x * X) =
        linearFactors x (n + 1) := by
      simp only [linearFactors, Polynomial.prod_comp, add_comp, one_comp, mul_comp, C_comp, X_comp]
      rw [prod_range_succ']
      simp only [pow_zero, map_one, one_mul]
      rw [mul_comm (1 + X)]
      congr 1
      apply prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [pow_succ, map_mul]
      ring
    rw [← mul_assoc, hp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_cube_apply
statement:
lemma shift_cube_apply (x : R) (F : R[X]) :
    (shift x ^ 3) F = (1 + X) * (1 + C x * X) * (1 + C (x ^ 2) * X) *
      F.comp (C (x ^ 3) * X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shift_pow_apply]
  simp [linearFactors, prod_range_succ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_zero
statement: lemma newtonOp_zero (x : R) (j : ℕ) : newtonOp x j 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [newtonOp, newtonFactors]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_succ
statement:
lemma newtonOp_succ (x : R) (j n : ℕ) :
    newtonOp x j (n + 1) =
      (shift x ^ 3 - x ^ (3 * (j + n)) • 1) * newtonOp x j n
proof:
:= by
  unfold newtonOp newtonFactors
  rw [prod_range_succ, mul_comm]
  simp only [map_mul, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_add
statement:
lemma newtonOp_add (x : R) (j n m : ℕ) :
    newtonOp x j (n + m) = newtonOp x (j + n) m * newtonOp x j n
proof:
:= by
  unfold newtonOp newtonFactors
  rw [prod_range_add, mul_comm, map_mul]
  congr 2
  apply prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 3
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_map
statement:
lemma shift_pow_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (x : R)
    (n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    ((shift x ^ n) F).map f = (shift (f x) ^ n) (F.map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shift_pow_apply, shift_pow_apply]
  simp [linearFactors, Polynomial.map_comp, Polynomial.map_prod]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_map
statement:
lemma newtonOp_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (x : R)
    (j n : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    (newtonOp x j n F).map f = newtonOp (f x) j n (F.map f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [newtonOp_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [newtonOp_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, smul_eq_C_mul, Polynomial.map_sub,
      Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, map_C, map_pow, shift_pow_map, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.shift_pow_preserves_X_dvd
statement:
lemma shift_pow_preserves_X_dvd (x : R) (n m : ℕ) (F : R[X])
    (hF : X ^ m ∣ F) : X ^ m ∣ (shift x ^ n) F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, rfl⟩ := hF
  refine ⟨linearFactors x n * C (x ^ n) ^ m * H.comp (C (x ^ n) * X), ?_⟩
  simp only [shift_pow_apply, mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, mul_pow]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_preserves_X_dvd
statement:
lemma newtonOp_preserves_X_dvd (x : R) (j n m : ℕ) (F : R[X])
    (hF : X ^ m ∣ F) : X ^ m ∣ newtonOp x j n F
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [newtonOp_zero] using hF
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [newtonOp_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, smul_eq_C_mul]
    exact dvd_sub (shift_pow_preserves_X_dvd x 3 m _ ih) (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right ih _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.linearFactors_eq
statement:
theorem linearFactors_eq (x : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x n) :
    linearFactors x n = 1 - (-X) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsPrimitiveRoot (C x : R[X]) n :=
    hx.map_of_injective (Polynomial.C_injective)
  have hp := X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod hc hn (rfl : (-X : R[X]) ^ n = (-X) ^ n)
  have he := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (1 : R[X])) hp
  simpa [linearFactors, eval_prod, mul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] using he.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.primitive_cube
statement:
lemma primitive_cube {x : R} {h : ℕ} (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x (3 * h)) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (x ^ 3) h
proof:
:= by
  have hp := hx.pow_of_dvd (by decide : 3 ≠ 0) (dvd_mul_right 3 h)
  simpa using hp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonFactors_block
statement:
theorem newtonFactors_block {x : R} {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x (3 * h)) (j : ℕ) :
    newtonFactors x j h = X ^ h - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hq := primitive_cube hx
  have ha : (x ^ (3 * j)) ^ h = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, show 3 * j * h = 3 * h * j by ring, pow_mul, hx.pow_eq_one, one_pow]
  have hp := X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod hq hh ha
  rw [C_1] at hp
  rw [hp]
  apply prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 2
  rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonOp_block
statement:
theorem newtonOp_block {x : R} {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hx : IsPrimitiveRoot x (3 * h)) (j : ℕ) (F : R[X]) :
    newtonOp x j h F = -((-X) ^ (3 * h)) * F
proof:
:= by
  rw [newtonOp, newtonFactors_block hh hx]
  simp only [map_sub, map_pow, aeval_X, map_one, ← pow_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    Module.End.one_apply]
  rw [shift_pow_apply, linearFactors_eq x (3 * h) (by omega) hx, hx.pow_eq_one]
  simp only [map_one, one_mul, comp_X]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.cyclotomic_dvd_newtonOp_coeff
statement:
theorem cyclotomic_dvd_newtonOp_coeff (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (j m n : ℕ)
    (hn : n < m + 3 * h) :
    cyclotomic (3 * h) ℤ ∣ (newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) j h (X ^ m)).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < 3 * h := by omega
  let ζ := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / (↑(3 * h) : ℂ))
  have hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 * h) := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp (3 * h) hd.ne'
  rw [cyclotomic_eq_minpoly hζ hd]
  apply minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_dvd (hζ.isIntegral hd)
  have he := newtonOp_map (aeval ζ).toRingHom (X : ℤ[X]) j h (X ^ m)
  have he' := congrArg (fun P : ℂ[X] ↦ P.coeff n) he
  simp only [coeff_map, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, aeval_X,
    Polynomial.map_pow, map_X] at he'
  rw [he', newtonOp_block hh hζ]
  apply (X_pow_dvd_iff (n := m + 3 * h)).mp ?_ n hn
  refine ⟨-((-1 : ℂ[X]) ^ (3 * h)), ?_⟩
  rw [neg_pow, pow_add]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.apply_cyclotomicBlocks
statement:
lemma apply_cyclotomicBlocks (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (u r : ℕ) (F : ℤ[X][X]) :
    applyBlocks (fun j ↦ cyclotomicBlock h hh (u + j * h))
      (newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 u F) r =
        newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 (u + r * h) F
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [applyBlocks]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [applyBlocks, ih]
    change newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) (u + r * h) h
      (newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 (u + r * h) F) = _
    rw [show u + (r + 1) * h = (u + r * h) + h by ring,
      newtonOp_add _ 0 (u + r * h) h]
    simp only [zero_add, Module.End.mul_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.cyclotomic_pow_dvd_newtonOp_coeff
statement:
theorem cyclotomic_pow_dvd_newtonOp_coeff (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (t n : ℕ)
    (F : ℤ[X][X]) :
    cyclotomic (3 * h) ℤ ^ (t / h - n / (3 * h)) ∣
      (newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 t F).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  have hv := coeff_dvd_pow_of_blocks
    (fun j ↦ cyclotomicBlock h hh (t % h + j * h)) (by omega : 0 < 3 * h)
    (newtonOp (X : ℤ[X]) 0 (t % h) F) (t / h) n
  rw [apply_cyclotomicBlocks] at hv
  simpa only [Nat.mod_add_div', Nat.add_comm] using hv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonPolynomial_zero
statement: lemma newtonPolynomial_zero : newtonPolynomial 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [newtonPolynomial, newtonOp_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.newtonPolynomial_succ
statement:
lemma newtonPolynomial_succ (t : ℕ) :
    newtonPolynomial (t + 1) =
      (1 + X) * (1 + C (X : ℤ[X]) * X) * (1 + C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ 2) * X) *
        (newtonPolynomial t).comp (C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ 3) * X) -
          C ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ (3 * t)) * newtonPolynomial t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [newtonPolynomial, newtonOp_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, smul_eq_C_mul, zero_add, shift_cube_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.cyclotomic_pow_dvd_newtonCoeff
statement:
theorem cyclotomic_pow_dvd_newtonCoeff (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (n t : ℕ) :
    cyclotomic (3 * h) ℤ ^ (t / h - n / (3 * h)) ∣ newtonCoeff n t
proof:
:=
  cyclotomic_pow_dvd_newtonOp_coeff h hh t n 1

name: CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_zero_exponents
statement:
lemma pbwMonomial_zero_exponents (w : List B) :
    pbwMonomial T E w (fun _ ↦ 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w ih => simp [pbwMonomial_cons, ih]

name: CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwSpan
statement:
lemma one_mem_pbwSpan (w : List B) :
    (1 : A) ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pbwMonomial_zero_exponents T E w]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwSpan_cons
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
    have he : E i * pbwMonomial T E (i :: w) c =
        pbwMonomial T E (i :: w) (Fin.cons (c 0 + 1) (fun n ↦ c n.succ)) := by
      change E i * (E i ^ c 0 * T i (pbwMonomial T E w (fun n ↦ c n.succ))) =
        E i ^ (c 0 + 1) * T i (pbwMonomial T E w (fun n ↦ c n.succ))
      rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc]
    rw [he]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [mul_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => simpa only [mul_smul_comm] using Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_reduced_cons_longest
statement:
lemma exists_reduced_cons_longest {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    {M : CoxeterMatrix B} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (i : B) :
    ∃ u : List B, cs.IsReduced (i :: u) ∧ cs.wordProd (i :: u) = cs.longestElement
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced (cs.simple i * cs.longestElement)
  have hp : cs.wordProd (i :: u) = cs.longestElement := by
    rw [cs.wordProd_cons, ← he]
    simp
  refine ⟨u, ?_, hp⟩
  unfold IsReduced
  rw [hp, List.length_cons, ← hu.eq, ← he]
  exact ((cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp (cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_mem_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_simplyLaced
statement:
theorem E_mul_mem_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_simplyLaced (i : I) {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))) :
    E R v i * x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu₀⟩ := CoxeterSystem.exists_reduced_cons_longest cs i
  have hs := span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_simplyLaced R v hv hSL cs hu hw
    (hu₀.trans hw₀.symm)
  rw [← hs] at hx ⊢
  exact CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwSpan_cons _ _ i u hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoin_le_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_simplyLaced
statement:
theorem adjoin_le_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_simplyLaced :
    (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))).toSubmodule ≤
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
  have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ S := CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwSpan _ _ w
  intro x hx
  have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact fun y hy ↦ E_mul_mem_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_simplyLaced
        R v hv hSL cs hw hw₀ i hy
    | algebraMap a =>
      intro y hy
      simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using S.smul_mem a hy
    | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
      intro y hy
      simpa only [add_mul] using S.add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
    | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
      intro y hy
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using hx (z * y) (hz y hy)
  simpa only [mul_one] using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_isFiniteCartan_of_simplyLaced
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_isFiniteCartan_of_simplyLaced [Fintype I]
    (_hD : D.cartanMatrix.IsFiniteCartan) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_mem _ _
      (fun n hn ↦ rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root hv hw n hn) c
  · exact adjoin_le_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_simplyLaced R v hv hSL cs hw hw₀

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.P3_b
statement:
lemma P3_b (a b' c : ℕ) : P3 q A b C a b' c * b =
    ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b' + 1)) • P3 q A b C a (b' + 1) c
proof:
:= by
  have hc : qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C * b = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c • (b * qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C) := by
    simpa only [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', mul_one] using Cd_bd H c 1
  rw [P3, mul_assoc _ _ b, hc, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ _ b,
    A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self b b' (hqi _ (by omega)), mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
    smul_smul]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.P3_C
statement:
lemma P3_C (a b' c : ℕ) : P3 q A b C a b' c * C =
    qInt (q ^ 3) (c + 1) • P3 q A b C a b' (c + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P3, mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self C c (hpi _ (by omega)), mul_smul_comm]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareRel.P3_e
statement:
lemma SquareRel.P3_e (H : SquareRel q e A b C) (a b' c : ℕ) : P3 q A b C a b' c * e =
    (q⁻¹ ^ b' * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a) • (e * P3 q A b C a b' c) -
      (if b' = 0 then 0 else
        (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (b' - 1) + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (a + 1)) •
          P3 q A b C (a + 1) (b' - 1) c) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else
        ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q (b' + 1) * qInt q (b' + 2)) •
          P3 q A b C a (b' + 2) (c - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hAA := A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self A a (hpi _ (by omega))
  have hbb : qDivPow q b' b * b ^ 2 =
      (qInt q (b' + 1) * qInt q (b' + 2)) • qDivPow q (b' + 2) b := by
    rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self b b' (hqi _ (by omega)),
      smul_mul_assoc, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self b (b' + 1) (hqi _ (by omega)), smul_smul]
  have hBe : qDivPow q b' b * e = q⁻¹ ^ b' • (e * qDivPow q b' b) -
      (if b' = 0 then 0 else (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (b' - 1) + 1) * qInt q 3) •
        (A * qDivPow q (b' - 1) b)) := by
    cases b' with
    | zero => simp [qDivPow_zero']
    | succ n =>
      simpa only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
        SquareRel.bd_e hq hqi H n
  have hCe : qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C * e = e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1)) •
        (b ^ 2 * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (c - 1) C)) := by
    cases c with
    | zero => simp [qDivPow_zero']
    | succ n =>
      simpa only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
        SquareRel.Cd_e hq hpi H n
  set P := qDivPow (q ^ 3) a A
  set Q := qDivPow q b' b
  set S := qDivPow (q ^ 3) c C
  have h1 : P * Q * S * e = P * (Q * e) * S - P * Q *
      (if c = 0 then 0 else ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1)) •
        (b ^ 2 * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (c - 1) C)) := by
    rw [mul_assoc (P * Q) S e, hCe, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc (P * Q) e S, mul_assoc P Q e]
  have h2 : P * (Q * e) * S = (q⁻¹ ^ b' * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a) • (e * (P * Q * S)) -
      (if b' = 0 then 0 else
        (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (b' - 1) + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (a + 1)) •
          P3 q A b C (a + 1) (b' - 1) c) := by
    rw [hBe, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc,
      ← mul_assoc P e, SquareRel.Ad_e H a, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
    split_ifs
    · simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, mul_assoc]
      rfl
    · rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc P A, hAA, smul_mul_assoc,
        smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      simp only [P3, mul_assoc]
      rfl
  have h3 : P * Q *
