      (if c = 0 then 0 else ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1)) •
        (b ^ 2 * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (c - 1) C)) =
      if c = 0 then 0 else
        ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q (b' + 1) * qInt q (b' + 2)) •
          P3 q A b C a (b' + 2) (c - 1) := by
    split_ifs
    · simp
    · rw [mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc P Q, hbb, mul_smul_comm,
        smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      simp only [P3, mul_assoc]
      rfl
  exact h1.trans (by rw [h2, h3]; rfl)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.P3_e
statement:
lemma P3_e (a b' c : ℕ) : P3 q A b C a b' c * e =
    (q⁻¹ ^ b' * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a) • (e * P3 q A b C a b' c) -
      (if b' = 0 then 0 else
        (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (b' - 1) + 1) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (a + 1)) •
          P3 q A b C (a + 1) (b' - 1) c) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else
        ((q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) * qInt q (b' + 1) * qInt q (b' + 2)) •
          P3 q A b C a (b' + 2) (c - 1))
proof:
:=
  SquareRel.P3_e hq hqi hpi H.squareRel a b' c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.M5_e
statement:
lemma M5_e (a b' c d l : ℕ) : M5 q A b C D f a b' c d l * e =
    ((q ^ 3) ^ l * q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ b' * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ a) •
      (e * M5 q A b C D f a b' c d l) -
      (if b' = 0 then 0 else
        ((q ^ 3) ^ l * q ^ d * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (b' - 1) + 1) *
          qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (a + 1)) • M5 q A b C D f (a + 1) (b' - 1) c d l) -
      (if c = 0 then 0 else
        ((q ^ 3) ^ l * q ^ d * (q ^ 2 - 1) * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (c - 1) *
          qInt q (b' + 1) * qInt q (b' + 2)) • M5 q A b C D f a (b' + 2) (c - 1) d l) -
      (if d = 0 then 0 else
        ((q ^ 3) ^ l * q * qInt q 2 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b' + 1)) •
          M5 q A b C D f a (b' + 1) c (d - 1) l) +
      (if d ≤ 1 then 0 else
        ((q ^ 3) ^ l * q⁻¹ ^ (d - 2) * qInt q 3 * qInt (q ^ 3) (c + 1)) •
          M5 q A b C D f a b' (c + 1) (d - 2) l) -
      (if l = 0 then 0 else (q ^ 3 * qInt q (d + 1)) •
        M5 q A b C D f a b' c (d + 1) (l - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hDD := A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self D d (hqi _ (by omega))
  have hDe : qDivPow q d D * e = q ^ d • (e * qDivPow q d D) -
      (if d = 0 then 0 else (q * qInt q 2) • (b * qDivPow q (d - 1) D)) +
      (if d ≤ 1 then 0 else (q⁻¹ ^ (d - 2) * qInt q 3) •
        (C * qDivPow q (d - 2) D)) := by
    rcases d with _ | (_ | n)
    · simp [qDivPow_zero']
    · simpa [A2Integral.qDivPow_one', qDivPow_zero'] using H.De
    · simpa only [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega, show ¬ n + 2 = 0 by omega,
        show ¬ n + 2 ≤ 1 by omega, ite_false,
        show n + 2 - 1 = n + 1 by omega, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using Dd_e hq hqi H n
  have hFe : qDivPow (q ^ 3) l f * e = (q ^ 3) ^ l • (e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) l f) -
      (if l = 0 then 0 else q ^ 3 • (D * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (l - 1) f)) := by
    cases l with
    | zero => simp [qDivPow_zero']
    | succ n =>
      simpa only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using fd_e hq hpi H n
  set P := P3 q A b C a b' c
  set V := qDivPow q d D
  set F := qDivPow (q ^ 3) l f
  have hPb : P * b = ((q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ c * qInt q (b' + 1)) •
      P3 q A b C a (b' + 1) c := P3_b hqi H a b' c
  have hPC : P * C = qInt (q ^ 3) (c + 1) •
      P3 q A b C a b' (c + 1) := P3_C hpi a b' c
  have h1 : P * V * F * e = (q ^ 3) ^ l • (P * (V * e) * F) -
      (if l = 0 then 0 else (q ^ 3 * qInt q (d + 1)) •
        M5 q A b C D f a b' c (d + 1) (l - 1)) := by
    rw [mul_assoc (P * V) F e, hFe, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
      ← mul_assoc (P * V) e F, mul_assoc P V e]
    split_ifs
    · simp
    · rw [mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc (P * V) D, mul_assoc P V D, hDD,
        mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      rfl
  have h2 : P * (V * e) * F = q ^ d • ((P * e) * V * F) -
      P * (if d = 0 then 0 else (q * qInt q 2) • (b * qDivPow q (d - 1) D)) * F +
      P * (if d ≤ 1 then 0 else (q⁻¹ ^ (d - 2) * qInt q 3) •
        (C * qDivPow q (d - 2) D)) * F := by
    rw [hDe, mul_add, mul_sub, add_mul, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm,
      smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc P e]
  change P * V * F * e = _
  rw [h1, h2, P3_e hq hqi hpi H]
  split_ifs <;>
    simp only [M5, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero, mul_sub,
      sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul,
      ← mul_assoc P b, ← mul_assoc P C, hPb, hPC]
  all_goals
    simp only [V, F, mul_assoc]

name: CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_cons
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_cons (i : B) (w : List B) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (i :: w))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range fun n : ℕ ↦ E i ^ n) *
        (Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E w))).map (T i).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_mul_span]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨c 0, rfl⟩, _, ⟨_, ⟨(fun n ↦ c n.succ), rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩, _, ⟨_, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Fin.cons n c, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_append
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_append (p s : List B) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (p ++ s))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E p)) *
        (Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E s))).map
          ((p.map T).prod).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    have hnil : Set.range (pbwMonomial T E []) = {1} := by
      ext x
      simp [pbwMonomial]
    simp [hnil, ← Submodule.one_eq_span, show (1 : A →ₗ[k] A) = LinearMap.id by rfl]
  | cons i p ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, span_pbwMonomial_cons, ih, span_pbwMonomial_cons]
    have hmap (P Q : Submodule k A) :
        (P * Q).map (T i).toLinearMap = P.map (T i).toLinearMap *
          Q.map (T i).toLinearMap := Submodule.map_mul P Q (T i).toAlgHom
    rw [hmap, mul_assoc, ← Submodule.map_comp]
    rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_prefix
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_prefix {u w : List B}
    (hspan : Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E w))) (p : List B) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (p ++ u))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (p ++ w)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwMonomial_append, span_pbwMonomial_append, hspan]

name: CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_context
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_context {u w : List B}
    (hspan : Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E w)))
    (hT : (u.map T).prod = (w.map T).prod) (p s : List B) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (p ++ u ++ s))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (p ++ w ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (u ++ s))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E (w ++ s))) := by
    rw [span_pbwMonomial_append, span_pbwMonomial_append, hspan, hT]
  let S (w : List B) := Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwMonomial T E w))
  exact (congrArg S (List.append_assoc p u s)).trans
    ((span_pbwMonomial_prefix T E hs p).trans
      (congrArg S (List.append_assoc p w s)).symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_a2_context
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_a2_context
    (hT : T i * T j * T i = T j * T i * T j) (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
      (p ++ [i, j, i] ++ s))) =
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
      (p ++ [j, i, j] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  apply CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_context
    T (E R v) (span_pbwMonomial_a2_braid R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq)
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil,
    mul_one, ← mul_assoc] using hT

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_a2_context_of_not_root
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_a2_context_of_not_root
    (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [i, j, i] ++ s))) =
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [j, i, j] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  have H (l : I) : HasBraidGeneratorImages l
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv' l).toAlgHom :=
    braidHom_hasBraidGeneratorImages
      (braidGeneric_of_braidSerreGeneric (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' l).sub_ne
        (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv' l))
      (transformedSerre_of_braidSerreGeneric
        (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' l).sub_ne (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv' l))
  apply span_pbwMonomial_a2_context R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')
    (H i) (H j) hij h h' (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
  have hLift : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') :=
    isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv'
  have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 3 := by
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h, h']
    rfl
  have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 3 := by
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h, h']
    rfl
  have e := hLift i j hij (by omega)
  simpa [CoxeterSystem.braidWord, hm, hm', CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord,
    ← mul_assoc] using e.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.monoMap_pair_rep
statement:
private theorem monoMap_pair_rep
    (hfe : f * e = q • (e * f) - q • X)
    (hXe : X * e = q⁻¹ • (e * X)) (hfX : f * X = q⁻¹ • (X * f))
    (x : FreeAlgebra k Bool) (s : Space k) :
    monoMap k e X f (rep q false x s) =
      FreeAlgebra.lift k (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then f else e) x * monoMap k e X f s
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing s with
  | grade0 a =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul,
      Algebra.smul_def]
  | grade1 b =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      change monoMap k e X f (rep q false (θ k false) s) = _
      rw [rep_θ_left, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, monoMap_opE]
      rfl
    | true =>
      change monoMap k e X f (rep q false (θ k true) s) = _
      rw [rep_θ_right (by decide : false ≠ true), FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply,
        monoMap_opF hfe hXe hfX]
      rfl
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, add_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.A2PBW.span_mono_qComm_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem span_mono_qComm_eq_adjoin (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hS : qSerre q 2 e f = 0) (hS' : qSerre q 2 f e = 0) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (mono e (qComm q e f) f)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {e, f}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : Set.range (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then f else e) = {e, f} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
      cases b <;> simp
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨false, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨true, rfl⟩
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    change mono e (qComm q e f) f p ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f}
    have he : e ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f} := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
    have hf : f ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f} := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
    have hX : qComm q e f ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f} :=
      sub_mem (mul_mem he hf) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem hf he) _)
    exact mul_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem he _) (pow_mem hX _)) (pow_mem hf _)
  · rw [← hpair, Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_freeAlgebra_lift]
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change FreeAlgebra.lift k (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then f else e) x ∈ _
    have hx := monoMap_pair_rep (mul_eq_qComm hq e f)
      (qComm_mul_left_of_qSerre hq hS) (mul_qComm_right_of_qSerre hq hS')
      x (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0) 1)
    rw [monoMap_single_zero, mul_one] at hx
    rw [← hx, monoMap, ← Finsupp.range_linearCombination]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_a2PBWMono_pair
statement:
theorem span_a2PBWMono_pair :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (a2PBWMono R v i j)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hS := serre_E R v hij
  have hS' := serre_E R v hij.symm
  rw [A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two h] at hS
  rw [A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', ← D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h'] at hS'
  change Submodule.span k
    (Set.range (A2PBW.mono (E R v i) (braidEj R v i j) (E R v j))) = _
  rw [a2_braidEj_eq_qComm h]
  exact A2PBW.span_mono_qComm_eq_adjoin (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) hS hS'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_a2PBWMono_pair_reverse
statement:
theorem span_a2PBWMono_pair_reverse :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (a2PBWMono R v i j)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (a2PBWMono R v j i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_a2PBWMono_pair R v hij h h', span_a2PBWMono_pair R v hij.symm h' h,
    Set.pair_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.root_prefixRootIndex
statement:
@[simp] lemma root_prefixRootIndex {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω) (n : Fin ω.length) :
    (prefixRootIndex P hA hω n).root =
      (P.prefixRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan ω)[n.val]'
    (by simpa only [P.length_prefixRoots] using n.isLt)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negRootIndex_ext_of_root_eq
statement: lemma negRootIndex_ext_of_root_eq {x y : NegRootIndex P} (h : x.root = y.root) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x.2.val < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_eq x.2.isLt
    (finrank_rootSpace_of_mem_roots P hA (neg_mem_roots P x.root_mem_roots))
  have hy : y.2.val < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_eq y.2.isLt
    (finrank_rootSpace_of_mem_roots P hA (neg_mem_roots P y.root_mem_roots))
  exact NegRootIndex.ext h (by omega)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.bijective_prefixRootIndex
statement:
theorem bijective_prefixRootIndex {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω =
      finiteTypeLongest P hA) :
    Function.Bijective (prefixRootIndex P hA hω)
proof:
:= by
  let := P.finite_weylGroup hA
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n m h
    have he := congrArg NegRootIndex.root h
    simp only [root_prefixRootIndex] at he
    exact Fin.ext ((P.nodup_prefixRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan hω).getElem_inj_iff.mp he)
  · intro x
    have hm : x.root ∈ P.prefixRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan ω := by
      exact (congrArg (x.root ∈ ·)
        (P.prefixRoots_set_of_longest hA.isGeneralizedCartan hω hw)).mpr
          ⟨x.root_mem_roots, x.root_mem_posWeights⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hm
    refine ⟨⟨n, by simpa using hn⟩, negRootIndex_ext_of_root_eq P hA ?_⟩
    exact he

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.negRootWt_prefixExponentEquiv
statement:
theorem negRootWt_prefixExponentEquiv {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω =
      finiteTypeLongest P hA) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    negRootWt P (prefixExponentEquiv P hA hω hw c) = prefixExponentWeight P hA ω c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [prefixExponentEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, AddEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe,
    AddEquiv.coe_toEquiv, Finsupp.domCongr_apply, Finsupp.equivMapDomain_eq_mapDomain, negRootWt]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (h := fun (x : NegRootIndex P) (n : ℕ) ↦ n • x.root)
    (fun _ ↦ zero_nsmul _) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_nsmul _ _ _)]
  simp [Finsupp.sum_fintype, prefixRootIndexEquiv, prefixExponentWeight]

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.card_prefixExponentFiber
statement:
theorem card_prefixExponentFiber {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hA.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω =
      finiteTypeLongest P hA) (β : Dual K H) :
    Nat.card {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ // prefixExponentWeight P hA ω c = β} =
      kostantPartition P β
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr (prefixExponentFiberEquiv P hA hω hw β)

name: Matrix.Realization.KacMoodyAlgebra.prefixExponentWeight_A2
statement:
theorem prefixExponentWeight_A2 {i j : I} (hij : A i j = -1) (hji : A j i = -1)
    (c : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    prefixExponentWeight P hA [i, j, i] c =
      (c 0 + c 1) • P.root i + (c 1 + c 2) • P.root j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prefixExponentWeight, P.prefixRoots_A2 hA.isGeneralizedCartan hij hji]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, smul_add, add_nsmul]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.realize_sum_rootVectorDegree
statement:
theorem realize_sum_rootVectorDegree (ω : List I) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    P.rootOf (fun j ↦ (∑ n : Fin ω.length, c n • rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.isLt) j) =
      prefixExponentWeight P hD ω c
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun j ↦ (∑ n : Fin ω.length,
      c n • rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.isLt) j) =
      ∑ n : Fin ω.length, c n • (fun j ↦ rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.isLt j) := by
    ext j
    simp
  rw [he, map_sum]
  simp only [map_nsmul, rootVectorDegree_realization, prefixExponentWeight]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.card_realized_rootVectorDegree_fiber
statement:
theorem card_realized_rootVectorDegree_fiber {ω : List I}
    (hω : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).IsReduced ω)
    (hw : (P.coxeterSystem hD.isGeneralizedCartan).wordProd ω = finiteTypeLongest P hD)
    (β : Module.Dual K H) :
    Nat.card {c : Fin ω.length → ℕ //
      P.rootOf (fun j ↦ (∑ n : Fin ω.length, c n • rootVectorDegree (R := R) ω n n.isLt) j)
        = β} = kostantPartition P β
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realize_sum_rootVectorDegree R P hD]
  exact card_prefixExponentFiber P hD hω hw β

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_of_braidMove_of_simplyLaced
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_of_braidMove_of_simplyLaced {u w : List I}
    (hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.BraidMove u w) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, s, i, j, hij, _, rfl, rfl⟩ := hm
  rcases hSL hij with h0 | h1
  · have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
    have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h0, h0']
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h0, h0']
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact span_pbwMonomial_commuting_context_of_not_root R v hv' hij h0 p s
  · have h1' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1 := by
      rcases hSL hij.symm with hz | hn
      · have := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm j i).mp hz
        omega
      · exact hn
    have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h1, h1']
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h1, h1']
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact (span_pbwMonomial_a2_context_of_not_root R v hij h1 h1' hv' p s).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_simplyLaced
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_simplyLaced {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) w))
proof:
:= by
  exact CoxeterSystem.eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove
    (fun _ _ _ hm ↦ span_pbwMonomial_of_braidMove_of_simplyLaced R v hv' hSL hm)
    hu (CoxeterSystem.reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hu hw huw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.filtered_zero
statement: lemma filtered_zero (π : R) (d : ℕ) (F : R[X]) : Filtered π d 0 F
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.Block.filtered
statement:
theorem Block.filtered {π : R} {d r : ℕ} (T : Block π d) (hd : 0 < d)
    {F : R[X]} (hF : Filtered π d r F) : Filtered π d (r + 1) (T.toLinearMap F)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  conv_rhs => rw [F.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow]
  simp only [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_sum, map_smul, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_smul,
    smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.dvd_sum
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : n < j
  · rw [T.triangular j n hj, mul_zero]
    exact dvd_zero _
  · have hjn : j / d ≤ n / d := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega : j ≤ n)
    by_cases he : j / d = n / d
    · have hlt : n < j + d := by
        have hn := Nat.mod_lt n hd
        have hj' := Nat.mod_add_div j d
        have hn' := Nat.mod_add_div n d
        rw [← he] at hn'
        omega
      have hm := mul_dvd_mul (hF j) (T.raises j n hlt)
      rw [← pow_succ] at hm
      exact (pow_dvd_pow π (by omega : r + 1 - n / d ≤ r - j / d + 1)).trans hm
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left
        ((pow_dvd_pow π (by omega : r + 1 - n / d ≤ r - j / d)).trans (hF j)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.coeff_dvd_pow_of_blocks
statement:
theorem coeff_dvd_pow_of_blocks {π : R} {d : ℕ} (T : ℕ → Block π d)
    (hd : 0 < d) (F : R[X]) (r n : ℕ) :
    π ^ (r - n / d) ∣ (applyBlocks T F r).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Filtered π d r (applyBlocks T F r) := by
    induction r with
    | zero => exact filtered_zero π d F
    | succ r ih => exact (T r).filtered hd ih
  exact hf n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.square_floor_comparison
statement:
theorem square_floor_comparison (a b n h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hw : 3 * a + b = 2 * n) :
    n / (3 * h) ≤ a / h + b / (3 * h)
proof:
:= by
  have ha := Nat.mod_lt a hh
  have hb := Nat.mod_lt b (by omega : 0 < 3 * h)
  have ea := Nat.mod_add_div a h
  have eb := Nat.mod_add_div b (3 * h)
  have en := Nat.mod_add_div n (3 * h)
  by_contra hn
  have hc : a / h + b / (3 * h) + 1 ≤ n / (3 * h) := by omega
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (3 * h) hc
  have hz : 0 ≤ h * (a / h) + h * (b / (3 * h)) := Nat.zero_le _
  nlinarith only [hw, ha, hb, ea, eb, en, hm, hz,
    Nat.zero_le (n % (3 * h))]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.SquareCancellation.square_deficit_le
statement:
theorem square_deficit_le (a b n t h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hw : 3 * a + b = 2 * n) :
    t / h - a / h - b / (3 * h) ≤ t / h - n / (3 * h)
proof:
:= by
  have := square_floor_comparison a b n h hh hw
  omega

name: LusztigF.toVerma_apply
statement:
lemma toVerma_apply (y : LusztigF K I) :
    toVerma D P Λ y = VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg P Λ (serreAssocAlgebraEquiv P
      D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix D.isSymmetrizable_cartanMatrix
        (SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom K D.cartanMatrix y))
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.toVerma_one
statement: lemma toVerma_one : toVerma D P Λ 1 = VermaModule.hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVerma_apply, map_one, map_one, VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_apply, map_one, one_smul]

name: LusztigF.toVerma_θ_mul
statement:
lemma toVerma_θ_mul (j : I) (y : LusztigF K I) :
    toVerma D P Λ (θ K j * y) = ⁅f P j, toVerma D P Λ y⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVerma_apply, toVerma_apply, map_mul, map_mul, VermaModule.equivEnvNNeg_mul]
  change UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map (LieSubalgebra.incl (nNeg P))
    (serreAssocAlgebraEquiv P _ _ (SerreAssocAlgebra.θ K D.cartanMatrix j)) • _ = _
  rw [serreAssocAlgebraEquiv_θ, UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.map_ι, ← VermaModule.lie_eq_smul]
  rfl

name: LusztigF.toVerma_wordBasis
statement:
lemma toVerma_wordBasis (w : List I) :
    toVerma D P Λ (wordBasis K I w) = VermaModule.fWord P w • VermaModule.hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rw [wordBasis_nil, toVerma_one, VermaModule.fWord_nil, one_smul]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, toVerma_θ_mul, ih, VermaModule.fWord_smul_cons]

name: LusztigF.wordWt_eq_rootOf
statement:
lemma wordWt_eq_rootOf (w : List I) :
    AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt P w = P.rootOf fun i ↦ (wordWeight w i : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_nil, ← map_zero P.rootOf]
    congr 1
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt_cons, ih, ← rootOf_single, ← map_add]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; simp [wordWeight_cons]
    · simp [wordWeight_cons, h]

name: LusztigF.weightSpace_verma_eq_map
statement:
theorem weightSpace_verma_eq_map (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    VermaModule.weightSpace P Λ (Λ - P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ)) =
      (weightSpace K ν).map (toVerma D P Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_wordSpan, VermaModule.wordSpan, weightSpace_eq_span,
    Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 1
  ext m
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have hw' : wordWeight w = ν := by
      have h1 : AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt P w = P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ) :=
        sub_right_injective hw
      rw [wordWt_eq_rootOf] at h1
      have h2 := P.rootOf_injective h1
      ext i
      exact_mod_cast congr_fun h2 i
    exact ⟨⟨w, hw'⟩, (toVerma_wordBasis D P Λ w)⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨w, ?_, (toVerma_wordBasis D P Λ w).symm⟩
    change Λ - AuxLieAlgebra.wordWt P w = _
    rw [wordWt_eq_rootOf, hw]

name: LusztigF.serreSpan_le_serreAssocIdeal
statement:
lemma serreSpan_le_serreAssocIdeal (ν : I →₀ ℕ) {y : LusztigF K I}
    (hy : y ∈ serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν) : y ∈ serreAssocIdeal K D.cartanMatrix
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨hg, -⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
    have hs : serreWord D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g.2.1 g.2.2.1 ∈ serreAssocIdeal K D.cartanMatrix := by
      have h := serreAssocElem_eq_smul_serreWord (K := K) D hg
      have hmem : serreAssocElem K D.cartanMatrix g.2.1 g.2.2.1 ∈
          serreAssocIdeal K D.cartanMatrix :=
        TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨_, _, hg, rfl⟩
      have hu : ((-1 : K) ^ serreExp D g.2.1 g.2.2.1) *
          ((-1 : K) ^ serreExp D g.2.1 g.2.2.1) = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow]
      have : serreWord D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g.2.1 g.2.2.1 =
          ((-1 : K) ^ serreExp D g.2.1 g.2.2.1) •
            serreAssocElem K D.cartanMatrix g.2.1 g.2.2.1 := by
        rw [h, smul_smul, hu, one_smul]
      rw [this, Algebra.smul_def]
      exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hmem
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hs)
  | zero => exact (serreAssocIdeal K D.cartanMatrix).zero_mem
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.toVerma_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreSpan
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVerma_apply, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff, map_eq_zero_iff _ (AlgEquiv.injective _),
    SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, serreSpan_le_serreAssocIdeal D ν⟩
  have := weightProj_mem_serreSpan D _ (serreAssocIdeal_le_span_serreWord D h) ν
  rwa [weightProj_self hy] at this

name: LusztigF.kostantPartition_add_finrank_serreSpan
statement:
theorem kostantPartition_add_finrank_serreSpan (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    kostantPartition P (P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ)) +
      finrank K (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν) = Fintype.card (Words ν)
proof:
:= by
  set V := weightSpace K ν
  set g := (toVerma D P 0).domRestrict V
  have hrange : LinearMap.range g =
      VermaModule.weightSpace P 0 (0 - P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, weightSpace_verma_eq_map]
  have hker : LinearMap.ker g = (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν).comap V.subtype := by
    ext y
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply]
    exact toVerma_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreSpan D P 0 y.2
  have hSer : finrank K ((serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν).comap V.subtype) =
      finrank K (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν) := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
      inf_eq_right.2 (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν)]
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g
  rw [hrange, hker, hSer, finrank_weightSpace,
    VermaModule.finrank_weightSpace_sub] at hrn
  exact hrn

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_serreProduct_one
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_serreProduct_one (g : List I × I × I × List I) :
    mapCoeffs (algebraMap ℚ K) (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g) =
      serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [serreProduct, serreWord, qSerre, map_mul, map_sum, mapCoeffs_smul, map_pow,
    mapCoeffs_wordBasis, θ, mapCoeffs_ι, qBinomial_one, map_neg, map_one, map_natCast]

name: LusztigF.finrank_serreSpan_one_eq_span_wordCoord
statement:
lemma finrank_serreSpan_one_eq_span_wordCoord (F : Type*) [Field F] (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank F (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : F)) ν) = finrank F (Submodule.span F
      (Set.range fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦
        wordCoord F ν (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : F)) g.1)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S := serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : F)) ν
  have hinj : Function.Injective ((wordCoord F ν).comp S.subtype) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro y hy
    exact Subtype.ext (eq_zero_of_wordCoord_eq_zero (serreSpan_le_weightSpace D _ ν y.2) hy)
  have hmap : S.map (wordCoord F ν) = Submodule.span F
      (Set.range fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦
        wordCoord F ν (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : F)) g.1)) := by
    change (Submodule.span F _).map _ = _
    rw [Submodule.map_span, Set.image_image, Set.image_eq_range]
  rw [(LinearEquiv.ofInjective _ hinj).finrank_eq, LinearMap.range_comp,
    Submodule.range_subtype, hmap]

name: LusztigF.finrank_serreSpan_one
statement:
theorem finrank_serreSpan_one (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank K (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν) = finrank ℚ (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) ν)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ g : serreIndices D ν, wordCoord K ν (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g.1) =
      algebraMap ℚ K ∘ wordCoord ℚ ν (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g.1) := by
    intro g
    funext w
    rw [Function.comp_apply, wordCoord_apply, wordCoord_apply, ← mapCoeffs_serreProduct_one,
      wordBasis_repr_mapCoeffs]
  rw [finrank_serreSpan_one_eq_span_wordCoord D K, finrank_serreSpan_one_eq_span_wordCoord D ℚ,
    show (fun g : serreIndices D ν ↦
      wordCoord K ν (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g.1)) = fun g ↦
      algebraMap ℚ K ∘ wordCoord ℚ ν (serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℚ)) g.1) from funext hc]
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.finrank_span_algebraMap_comp_le _) ?_
  exact Submodule.finrank_span_le_of_comp_ratHom (RingHom.id ℚ) (algebraMap ℚ K)
    (algebraMap ℚ K).injective _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finrank_plusWeightSpace_eq_kostantPartition
statement:
theorem finrank_plusWeightSpace_eq_kostantPartition (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank k (plusWeightSpace R v ν) =
      kostantPartition (Realization.std D.cartanMatrix ℚ)
        ((Realization.std D.cartanMatrix ℚ).rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := finrank_plusWeightSpace (R := R) hv ν
  have h2 := kostantPartition_add_finrank_serreSpan D (Realization.std D.cartanMatrix ℚ) ν
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finrank_plusWeightSpace_eq_kostantPartition'
statement:
theorem finrank_plusWeightSpace_eq_kostantPartition' (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) {K H : Type*}
    [Field K] [CharZero K] [AddCommGroup H] [Module K H] (P : Realization D.cartanMatrix K H)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    finrank k (plusWeightSpace R v ν) = kostantPartition P (P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := finrank_plusWeightSpace (R := R) hv ν
  have h2 := kostantPartition_add_finrank_serreSpan D P ν
  rw [finrank_serreSpan_one] at h2
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_iff_span_eq_plusWeightSpace
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_iff_span_eq_plusWeightSpace (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) {K H : Type*}
    [Field K] [CharZero K] [AddCommGroup H] [Module K H] (P : Realization D.cartanMatrix K H)
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : ι → QuantumGroup R v)
    (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ plusWeightSpace R v ν)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = kostantPartition P (P.rootOf fun i ↦ (ν i : ℤ))) :
    LinearIndependent k b ↔ Submodule.span k (Set.range b) = plusWeightSpace R v ν
proof:
:= by
  have hV : FiniteDimensional k (weightSpace k ν) := by
    rw [weightSpace_eq_span]
    exact FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite k (Set.finite_range _)
  have hS : FiniteDimensional k (plusWeightSpace R v ν) := by
    unfold plusWeightSpace
    infer_instance
  have hdim := finrank_plusWeightSpace_eq_kostantPartition' (R := R) hv P ν
  constructor
  · intro hli
    refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
      (Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hb)) ?_
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hli, hcard, hdim]
  · intro h
    rw [linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span, Set.finrank, h, hdim, hcard]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pbwMonomial_a2_eq
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_a2_eq (c : Fin [i, j, i].length → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i] c =
      a2PBWMono R v i j (c 0, c 1, c 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ := a2_rootVector_two hij Hi
  have h₃ := a2_rootVector_three Hi Hj hij h h' hq
  change (T i) (E R v j) = braidEj R v i j at h₂
  change (T i) ((T j) (E R v i)) = E R v j at h₃
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial, map_mul, map_pow, map_one, mul_one]
  change E R v i ^ c 0 * ((T i) (E R v j) ^ c 1 *
    (T i) ((T j) (E R v i)) ^ c 2) = _
  rw [h₂, h₃]
  exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_a2
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_a2 :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i])) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i]) =
      Set.range (a2PBWMono R v i j) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(c 0, c 1, c 2), (pbwMonomial_a2_eq R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq c).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, b, c⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨![a, b, c], pbwMonomial_a2_eq R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq _⟩
  rw [hr]
  exact span_a2PBWMono_pair R v hij h h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_a2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_a2_braid :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i])) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i, j]))
proof:
:= by
  have hqj : v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [← D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h']
  rw [span_pbwMonomial_a2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq,
    span_pbwMonomial_a2 R v T Hj Hi hij.symm h' h hqj, Set.pair_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.wordProd_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordProd_nil : wordProd x [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.wordProd_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma wordProd_cons (a : Fin n) (w : List (Fin n)) :
    wordProd x (a :: w) = x a * wordProd x w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordProd]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.wordProd_append
statement:
lemma wordProd_append (u w : List (Fin n)) :
    wordProd x (u ++ w) = wordProd x u * wordProd x w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordProd]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.inv_swap
statement:
lemma inv_swap {a b : Fin n} (hab : a < b) (p s : List (Fin n)) :
    inv (p ++ a :: b :: s) < inv (p ++ b :: a :: s)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    simp [inv, hab, not_lt.mpr hab.le]
    omega
  | cons c p ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, inv]
    rw [((List.Perm.swap b a s).append_left p).countP_eq]
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.cnt_swap
statement:
lemma cnt_swap (a b : Fin n) (p s : List (Fin n)) :
    cnt (p ++ a :: b :: s) = cnt (p ++ b :: a :: s)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact ((List.Perm.swap b a s).append_left p).count_eq i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.cnt_lt
statement:
lemma cnt_lt {a b : Fin n} (hab : a < b) (p s u : List (Fin n)) (hu : ∀ m ∈ u, a < m) :
    toLex (cnt (p ++ u ++ s)) < toLex (cnt (p ++ b :: a :: s))
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : ∀ j, j ≤ a → u.count j = 0 := fun j hj ↦
    List.count_eq_zero.mpr fun hm ↦ absurd (hu j hm) (not_lt.mpr hj)
  refine ⟨a, fun j hj ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hj' : j < a := hj
    simp [cnt, hu0 j hj'.le, (hj'.trans hab).ne', hj'.ne']
  · simp [cnt, hu0 a le_rfl, hab.ne']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.exists_descent
statement:
lemma exists_descent : ∀ w : List (Fin n), ¬ w.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) →
    ∃ p a b s, a < b ∧ w = p ++ b :: a :: s
proof:
| [], h => absurd List.Pairwise.nil h
  | c :: w, h => by
    by_cases hw : w.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)
    · obtain ⟨d, hd, hcd⟩ : ∃ d ∈ w, ¬ c ≤ d := by
        by_contra hh
        exact h (List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨fun d hd ↦ by
          by_contra h'
          exact hh ⟨d, hd, h'⟩, hw⟩)
      replace hcd := not_le.mp hcd
      obtain ⟨d₀, w', rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (List.ne_nil_of_mem hd)
      have h₀ : d₀ ≤ d := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hd with rfl | hd'
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact (List.pairwise_cons.mp hw).1 d hd'
      exact ⟨[], d₀, c, w', lt_of_le_of_lt h₀ hcd, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, a, b, s, hab, rfl⟩ := exists_descent w hw
      exact ⟨c :: p, a, b, s, hab, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.wordProd_mem_sortedSpan
statement:
theorem wordProd_mem_sortedSpan (h : IsLS k x) (w : List (Fin n)) :
    wordProd x w ∈ sortedSpan k x
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ N : Lex (Fin n → ℕ), ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ w : List (Fin n),
      toLex (cnt w) = N → inv w = m → wordProd x w ∈ sortedSpan k x from H _ _ w rfl rfl
  intro N
  induction N using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | _ N ihN =>
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ihm =>
  intro w hN hm
  by_cases hs : w.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)
  · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, hs, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, a, b, s, hab, rfl⟩ := exists_descent w hs
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h a b hab
  have e : wordProd x (p ++ b :: a :: s) = c • wordProd x (p ++ a :: b :: s) +
      wordProd x p * (x b * x a - c • (x a * x b)) * wordProd x s := by
    simp only [wordProd_append, wordProd_cons, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
      mul_assoc]
    abel
  rw [e]
  refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (ihm _ (hm ▸ inv_swap hab p s) _
    (by rw [cnt_swap]; exact hN) rfl)) ?_
  have key : ∀ y ∈ innerSpan k x a b, wordProd x p * y * wordProd x s ∈ sortedSpan k x := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨u, -, hu, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [← wordProd_append, ← wordProd_append]
      exact ihN _ (hN ▸ cnt_lt hab p s u fun m hm ↦ (hu m hm).1) _ _ rfl rfl
    | zero => simp
    | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
      simpa only [mul_add, add_mul] using add_mem hy hz
    | smul r y _ hy =>
      simpa only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy
  exact key _ hc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.mono_insert
statement:
lemma mono_insert : ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → B) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (a : Fin n),
    (∀ i < a, c i = 0) → x a * mono x c = mono x (Function.update c a (c a + 1))
proof:
| 0, _, _, a, _ => a.elim0
  | n + 1, x, c, a, hc => by
    have hsplit (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) :
        mono x d = x 0 ^ d 0 * mono (fun i ↦ x i.succ) (fun i ↦ d i.succ) := by
      simp [mono, List.ofFn_succ]
    rw [hsplit, hsplit]
    cases a using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Function.update_self]
      have hu : (fun i : Fin n ↦ Function.update c 0 (c 0 + 1) i.succ) = fun i ↦ c i.succ := by
        funext i
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)]
      rw [hu, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
    | succ a =>
      have h0 : c 0 = 0 := hc 0 (Fin.succ_pos a)
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero a).symm, h0]
      simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]
      have hu : (fun i : Fin n ↦ Function.update c a.succ (c a.succ + 1) i.succ) =
          Function.update (fun i ↦ c i.succ) a (c a.succ + 1) := by
        funext i
        by_cases hi : i = a
        · subst hi; simp
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne (fun h ↦ hi (Fin.succ_injective _ h)),
            Function.update_of_ne hi]
      rw [hu]
      exact mono_insert (fun i ↦ x i.succ) (fun i ↦ c i.succ) a
        fun i hi ↦ hc i.succ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr hi)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.wordProd_eq_mono_of_pairwise
statement:
lemma wordProd_eq_mono_of_pairwise : ∀ w : List (Fin n), w.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) →
    wordProd x w = mono x (cnt w)
proof:
| [], _ => by
    simp [mono, cnt]
  | a :: w, hw => by
    obtain ⟨ha, hw⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.mp hw
    rw [wordProd_cons, wordProd_eq_mono_of_pairwise w hw, mono_insert]
    · congr 1
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = a
      · subst hi; simp [cnt]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]
        simp [cnt, Ne.symm hi]
    · intro i hi
      exact List.count_eq_zero.mpr fun hm ↦ absurd (ha i hm) (not_le.mpr hi)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.span_mono_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem span_mono_eq_adjoin (h : IsLS k x) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (mono x)) = (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x)).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    change mono x c ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x)
    exact list_prod_mem fun y hy ↦ by
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hy
      exact pow_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)) _
  · have hS : sortedSpan k x ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range (mono x)) := by
      rw [sortedSpan, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      rw [wordProd_eq_mono_of_pairwise w hw]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
    refine le_trans ?_ hS
    have h1 : (1 : B) ∈ sortedSpan k x := Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], List.Pairwise.nil, rfl⟩
    have hmul : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ sortedSpan k x, x j * y ∈ sortedSpan k x := by
      intro j y hy
      induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hy =>
        obtain ⟨w, -, rfl⟩ := hy
        rw [← wordProd_cons]
        exact wordProd_mem_sortedSpan x h _
      | zero => simp
      | add y z _ _ hy hz => simpa only [mul_add] using add_mem hy hz
      | smul r y _ hy => simpa only [mul_smul_comm] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ∀ y ∈ sortedSpan k x, z * y ∈ sortedSpan k x := by
      induction hz using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hz
        exact hmul j
      | algebraMap r =>
        intro y hy
        simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy
      | add z w _ _ hz hw =>
        intro y hy
        simpa only [add_mul] using add_mem (hz y hy) (hw y hy)
      | mul z w _ _ hz hw =>
        intro y hy
        simpa only [mul_assoc] using hz (w * y) (hw y hy)
    simpa only [mul_one] using hz' 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.map_innerSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hab, rfl⟩ := hz
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨u.map Fin.succ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact List.pairwise_map.mpr (hu.imp fun h ↦ Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mpr h)
    · intro m hm
      obtain ⟨m', hm', rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
      exact ⟨Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr (hab m' hm').1, Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr (hab m' hm').2⟩
    · simp [wordProd, List.map_map, map_list_prod, Function.comp_def]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => simpa only [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.isLS_cons
statement:
theorem isLS_cons {e : B} {x' : Fin n → B} (φ : B →ₐ[k] B) (h : IsLS k x')
    (hb : BaseRel k (Fin.cons e (fun i ↦ φ (x' i)) : Fin (n + 1) → B)) :
    IsLS k (Fin.cons e (fun i ↦ φ (x' i)) : Fin (n + 1) → B)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  cases a using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
    cases b using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact absurd hab (lt_irrefl _)
    | succ b => exact hb b
  | succ a =>
    cases b using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact absurd hab (not_lt.mpr (Fin.zero_le _))
    | succ b =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h a b (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hab)
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      have := map_innerSpan (e := e) φ hc
      simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, Fin.cons_succ] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.innerSpan_castSucc_le
statement:
lemma innerSpan_castSucc_le (y : Fin (n + 1) → B) (a b : Fin n) :
    innerSpan k y a.castSucc b.castSucc ≤ innerSpan k (fun i ↦ y i.castSucc) a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, hab, rfl⟩
  have hlift : ∀ u : List (Fin (n + 1)), (∀ m ∈ u, m < b.castSucc) →
      ∃ u' : List (Fin n), u = u'.map Fin.castSucc := by
    intro u
    induction u with
    | nil => exact fun _ ↦ ⟨[], rfl⟩
    | cons m u ih =>
      intro hm
      obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := ih fun m' h' ↦ hm m' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h')
      have hm' : (m : ℕ) < n :=
        lt_trans (Fin.lt_def.mp (hm m List.mem_cons_self)) b.isLt
      exact ⟨Fin.castLT m hm' :: u', by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := hlift u fun m hm ↦ (hab m hm).2
  refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨u', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (List.pairwise_map.mp hu).imp fun h ↦ Fin.castSucc_le_castSucc_iff.mp h
  · intro m hm
    have := hab _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hm)
    exact ⟨Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mp this.1, Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mp this.2⟩
  · simp [wordProd, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.IsLS.castSucc
statement:
theorem IsLS.castSucc {y : Fin (n + 1) → B} (h : IsLS k y) :
    IsLS k fun i : Fin n ↦ y i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h a.castSucc b.castSucc (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mpr hab)
  exact ⟨c, innerSpan_castSucc_le y a b hc⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.BaseRel.castSucc
statement:
theorem BaseRel.castSucc {y : Fin (n + 2) → B} (h : BaseRel k y) :
    BaseRel k fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ y i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h l.castSucc
  exact ⟨c, innerSpan_castSucc_le y 0 l.succ hc⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjExpCoeff_left
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjExpCoeff, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [mul_left_comm]
  simp only [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
  congr 2
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjExpCoeff_right
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjExpCoeff, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
  have hh : ((n : ℤ) + 1 - (j + 1)) * ((N : ℤ) - (n + 1) + 1) + (n - j) =
      ((n : ℤ) - j) * ((N : ℤ) - n + 1) := by ring
  rw [hh]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointExpansion
statement:
private theorem adjointExpansion (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) (x : B) (W : ℕ → B)
    (hW : ∀ n, qInt q (n + 1) • W (n + 1) =
      q ^ ((N : ℤ) - 2 * n) • (x * W n) - W n * x) (n : ℕ) :
    W n = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), adjExpCoeff q N n j •
      (qDivPow q (n - j) x * W 0 * qDivPow q j x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.zero_add, sum_range_one, adjExpCoeff, pow_zero,
      Nat.cast_zero, Nat.sub_self, sub_self, zero_mul, zpow_zero, one_mul, qDivPow_zero', mul_one,
      one_smul]
  | succ n ih =>
    let X : ℕ → B := fun j => qDivPow q (n + 1 - j) x * W 0 * qDivPow q j x
    let L : ℕ → B := fun j =>
      (adjExpCoeff q N (n + 1) j * q ^ (-(j : ℤ)) * qInt q (n + 1 - j)) • X j
    let R : ℕ → B := fun j =>
      (adjExpCoeff q N (n + 1) (j + 1) * q ^ ((n : ℤ) - j) * qInt q (j + 1)) • X (j + 1)
    have hL (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range (n + 1)) :
        q ^ ((N : ℤ) - 2 * n) • (x * (adjExpCoeff q N n j •
          (qDivPow q (n - j) x * W 0 * qDivPow q j x))) = L j := by
      have hnj : n - j + 1 = n + 1 - j := by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega
      simp only [L, X, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
        mul_qDivPow q x (n - j) (hqi _ (by omega)), smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      rw [adjExpCoeff_left hq, hnj]
    have hR (j : ℕ) (_hj : j ∈ range (n + 1)) :
        -((adjExpCoeff q N n j •
          (qDivPow q (n - j) x * W 0 * qDivPow q j x)) * x) = R j := by
      have hnj : n + 1 - (j + 1) = n - j := by omega
      simp only [R, X, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
        A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_self x j (hqi _ (by omega)), mul_smul_comm,
        smul_smul, ← neg_smul, hnj]
      rw [← neg_mul, adjExpCoeff_right hq, mul_assoc]
    refine smul_right_injective B (hqi (n + 1) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only
    rw [hW, ih]
    simp only [mul_sum, sum_mul, smul_sum]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← sum_neg_distrib]
    rw [sum_congr rfl hL, sum_congr rfl hR]
    change (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), L j) + (∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), R j) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1 + 1), qInt q (n + 1) •
        (adjExpCoeff q N (n + 1) j • X j)
    rw [sum_range_succ' L n, sum_range_succ R n,
      sum_range_succ' _ (n + 1), sum_range_succ _ n]
    have hmid (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ range n) :
        L (j + 1) + R j = qInt q (n + 1) • (adjExpCoeff q N (n + 1) (j + 1) • X (j + 1)) := by
      have hjn : j < n := mem_range.mp hj
      have hn : n + 1 - (j + 1) + (j + 1) = n + 1 := by omega
      have hz : ((n : ℤ) - j) = (n + 1 - (j + 1) : ℕ) := by omega
      simp only [L, R, smul_smul, ← add_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [hz, zpow_natCast, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
      have hh := B2Integral.qInt_add (t := q) (n + 1 - (j + 1)) (j + 1)
      rw [hn] at hh
      linear_combination adjExpCoeff q N (n + 1) (j + 1) * hh
    have hfirst : L 0 = qInt q (n + 1) • (adjExpCoeff q N (n + 1) 0 • X 0) := by
      simp only [L, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, zpow_zero, mul_one, Nat.sub_zero, smul_smul]
      rw [mul_comm]
    have hlast : R n = qInt q (n + 1) •
        (adjExpCoeff q N (n + 1) (n + 1) • X (n + 1)) := by
      simp only [R, sub_self, zpow_zero, mul_one, smul_smul]
      rw [mul_comm]
    have hs := sum_congr rfl hmid
    rw [sum_add_distrib] at hs
    rw [hfirst, hlast, ← hs]
    abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointIndices_extreme
statement: lemma adjointIndices_extreme (s : ℕ) : adjointIndices (3 * s) s = {(s, 0, 0, 0, 0)}
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a, b, c, d, l⟩
  simp only [mem_adjointIndices, mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq]
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.adjointSum_extreme
statement:
lemma adjointSum_extreme (q : k) (A b C D f : B) (s : ℕ) :
    adjointSum q A b C D f (3 * s) s = q ^ (3 * s) • qDivPow (q ^ 3) s A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adjointSum, adjointIndices_extreme, sum_singleton, adjointCoeff,
    adjointExponent, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero, Nat.zero_add, pow_zero, one_mul, M5, P3,
    qDivPow_zero', mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_A_eq_sum
statement:
theorem qDivPow_A_eq_sum (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) r A = ∑ j ∈ range (3 * r + 1),
      ((-1 : k) ^ j * q⁻¹ ^ j) •
        (qDivPow q (3 * r - j) e * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r f * qDivPow q j e)
proof:
:= by
  have hlead (n : ℕ) : q ^ (((3 * r : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * n) =
      q ^ (3 * r) * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n) := by
    simp only [← zpow_natCast q, ← zpow_natCast q⁻¹, inv_zpow,
      ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
    congr 1
  have hW (n : ℕ) : qInt q (n + 1) • adjointSum q A b C D f (n + 1) r =
      q ^ (((3 * r : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * n) • (e * adjointSum q A b C D f n r) -
        adjointSum q A b C D f n r * e := by
    rw [hlead]
    have hh := adjointSum_e_all hq hqi hpi H n r
    rw [hh]
    abel
  have hh := adjointExpansion hq hqi (3 * r) e
    (fun n => adjointSum q A b C D f n r) hW (3 * r)
  rw [adjointSum_extreme, adjointSum_zero] at hh
  refine smul_right_injective B (pow_ne_zero (3 * r) hq) ?_
  simp only
  rw [hh, smul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [adjExpCoeff, sub_self, zero_add, mul_one,
    ← zpow_natCast q, ← zpow_natCast q⁻¹, inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg]
  rw [mul_left_comm]
  simp only [← zpow_add₀ hq, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cartanMatrix_pair_cases
statement:
lemma cartanMatrix_pair_cases {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h3 : D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) :
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = 0 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = 0) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -2 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -2) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -3 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -3)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
  have ha := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have hb := hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  have hz := hA.zero_comm i j
  set a := D.cartanMatrix i j
  set b := D.cartanMatrix j i
  by_cases h0 : a = 0
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h0, hz.mp h0⟩
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ h0 (hz.mpr h)
  have ha1 : a ≤ -1 := by omega
  have hb1 : b ≤ -1 := by omega
  have ha3 : -3 ≤ a := by nlinarith
  have hb3 : -3 ≤ b := by nlinarith
  interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> simp_all

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_of_braidMove_of_not_root
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_of_braidMove_of_not_root
    (hfin : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) {u w : List I}
    (hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.BraidMove u w) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, s, i, j, hij, _, rfl, rfl⟩ := hm
  rcases cartanMatrix_pair_cases hij (hfin i j hij) with
    ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact span_pbwMonomial_commuting_context_of_not_root R v hv hij ha p s
  · have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact (span_pbwMonomial_a2_context_of_not_root R v hij ha hb hv p s).symm
  · have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 4 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 4 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact span_pbwMonomial_b2_context_of_not_root R v hij ha hb hv p s
  · have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 4 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 4 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact (span_pbwMonomial_b2_context_of_not_root R v hij.symm hb ha hv p s).symm
  · have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 6 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 6 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact span_pbwMonomial_g2_context_of_not_root R v hij ha hb hv p s
  · have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 6 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 6 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha, hb]
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw']
    exact (span_pbwMonomial_g2_context_of_not_root R v hij.symm hb ha hv p s).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_not_root
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_not_root
    (hfin : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≤ 3) {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove
    (fun _ _ _ hm ↦ span_pbwMonomial_of_braidMove_of_not_root R v hv hfin hm)
    hu (CoxeterSystem.reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hu hw huw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_isFiniteCartan [Fintype I]
    (hA : D.cartanMatrix.IsFiniteCartan) {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
proof:
:=
  span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_not_root R v hv
    (fun _ _ hij ↦ hA.mul_le_three hij) cs hu hw huw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_mem_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem E_mul_mem_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_isFiniteCartan (i : I) {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))) :
    E R v i * x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu₀⟩ := CoxeterSystem.exists_reduced_cons_longest cs i
  have hs := span_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced_of_isFiniteCartan R v hv hA cs hu hw
    (hu₀.trans hw₀.symm)
  rw [← hs] at hx ⊢
  exact CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwSpan_cons _ _ i u hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_isFiniteCartan :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_mem _ _
      (fun n hn ↦ rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root hv hw n hn) c
  · let S := Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv) (E R v) w))
    have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ S := CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwSpan _ _ w
    intro x hx
    have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact fun y hy ↦ E_mul_mem_span_pbwMonomial_longest_of_isFiniteCartan
          R v hv hA cs hw hw₀ i hy
      | algebraMap a =>
        intro y hy
        simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using S.smul_mem a hy
      | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy
        simpa only [add_mul] using S.add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
      | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy
        simpa only [mul_assoc] using hx (z * y) (hz y hy)
    simpa only [mul_one] using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.shortMixedAdjoint_e
statement:
lemma shortMixedAdjoint_e (hq : q ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (n : ℕ) :
    shortMixedAdjoint q A b D n * e =
      (q ^ 1 * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * shortMixedAdjoint q A b D n) -
        qInt q (n + 1) • shortMixedAdjoint q A b D (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | n))
  · simpa [shortMixedAdjoint, qInt] using H.De
  · simp only [shortMixedAdjoint, smul_mul_assoc, H.Be, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    norm_num only
    match_scalars <;> field_simp
  · simp only [shortMixedAdjoint, smul_mul_assoc, H.Ae, mul_smul_comm, smul_zero,
      sub_zero, smul_smul]
    norm_num only
    congr 1
    field_simp
  · simp [shortMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.squareMixedAdjoint_e
statement:
lemma squareMixedAdjoint_e (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hAe : A * e = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (e * A))
    (hbe : b * e = q⁻¹ • (e * b) - (q⁻¹ * qInt q 3) • A)
    (hbA : b * A = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (A * b))
    (hCe : C * e = e * C - (q ^ 2 - 1) • b ^ 2) (n : ℕ) :
    squareMixedAdjoint q A b C n * e =
      (q ^ 0 * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (e * squareMixedAdjoint q A b C n) -
        qInt q (n + 1) • squareMixedAdjoint q A b C (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbb : b ^ 2 * e = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (e * b ^ 2) -
      (q⁻¹ ^ 3 * qInt q 3 * qInt q 2) • (A * b) := by
    rw [pow_two, mul_assoc, hbe, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm,
      ← mul_assoc b e, hbe, hbA]
    simp only [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, smul_smul]
    rw [qInt_two]
    match_scalars <;> field_simp
    ring
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | (_ | n)))
  · simpa [squareMixedAdjoint, qInt] using hCe
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, smul_mul_assoc, hbb, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    norm_num only
    module
  · simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc A b e, hbe, mul_sub,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc A e, hAe, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, smul_smul,
      smul_sub, pow_two]
    norm_num only
    match_scalars <;> field_simp
  · have hAA := mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul (B := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (by
      simpa only [MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul] using
        congrArg MulOpposite.op hAe) 2
    have hAA' : A ^ 2 * e = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (e * A ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [MulOpposite.unop_mul, MulOpposite.unop_pow, MulOpposite.unop_smul,
        MulOpposite.unop_op] using congrArg MulOpposite.unop hAA
    simp only [squareMixedAdjoint, smul_mul_assoc, hAA', mul_smul_comm,
      smul_zero, sub_zero, smul_smul]
    norm_num only
    congr 1
    field_simp
  · simp [squareMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.D_mul_qDivPow_e
statement:
theorem D_mul_qDivPow_e (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r : ℕ) :
    D * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef q 1 r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * shortMixedAdjoint q A b D n)
proof:
:= by
  exact B2Integral.straighten hq hqi 1 (shortMixedAdjoint_e hq H) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.C_mul_qDivPow_e
statement:
theorem C_mul_qDivPow_e (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r : ℕ) :
    C * qDivPow q r e =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef q 0 r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) e * squareMixedAdjoint q A b C n)
proof:
:= by
  exact B2Integral.straighten hq hqi 0 (squareMixedAdjoint_e hq H.Ae H.Be H.BA H.Ce) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_qDivPow_b
statement:
theorem f_mul_qDivPow_b (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r : ℕ) :
    f * qDivPow q r b =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef q 0 r n •
        (qDivPow q (r - n) b * squareMixedAdjoint q C D f n)
proof:
:= by
  exact B2Integral.straighten hq hqi 0 (squareMixedAdjoint_e hq H.CB H.DB H.DC H.fB) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_D_mul_A
statement:
theorem qDivPow_D_mul_A (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow q r D * A =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef q 0 r n •
        (reverseSquareMixedAdjoint q C b A n * qDivPow q (r - n) D)
proof:
:= by
  let op := MulOpposite.op (α := B)
  have hs := squareMixedAdjoint_e hq (e := op D) (A := op C) (b := op b) (C := op A)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul] using congrArg op H.DC)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul, MulOpposite.op_sub]
      using congrArg op H.DB)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul] using congrArg op H.CB)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul, MulOpposite.op_sub,
      MulOpposite.op_pow] using congrArg op H.DA)
  have hrev (n : ℕ) : MulOpposite.unop (squareMixedAdjoint q (op C) (op b) (op A) n) =
      reverseSquareMixedAdjoint q C b A n := by
    rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | (_ | n))) <;>
      simp [squareMixedAdjoint, reverseSquareMixedAdjoint, op]
  have hh := congrArg MulOpposite.unop (B2Integral.straighten hq hqi 0 hs r)
  simpa only [show squareMixedAdjoint q (op C) (op b) (op A) 0 = op A from rfl,
    MulOpposite.unop_mul, Finset.unop_sum, MulOpposite.unop_smul, hrev, qDivPow,
    MulOpposite.unop_pow, op, MulOpposite.unop_op] using hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.longMixedAdjoint_right
statement:
lemma longMixedAdjoint_right (hq : q ≠ 0) (h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0) (h3 : qInt q 3 ≠ 0)
    (hbA : b * A = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (A * b))
    (hDA : D * A = A * D - (q ^ 2 - 1) • b ^ 2)
    (hCA : C * A = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ • (A * C) -
      ((q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 / (q ^ 2 * qInt q 3)) • b ^ 3)
    (hfA : f * A = q ^ 3 • (A * f) + (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 - 1) • C -
      (q ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - 1)) • (b * D)) (n : ℕ) :
    longMixedAdjoint q b C D f n * A =
      ((q ^ 3) ^ 1 * (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ (2 * n)) • (A * longMixedAdjoint q b C D f n) -
        qInt (q ^ 3) (n + 1) • longMixedAdjoint q b C D f (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 + q ^ 2 + q ^ 4 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply h3
    rw [qInt_three hq]
    field_simp
    linear_combination hz
  have hW2 : (q * (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 * qInt q 2) • qDivPow q 3 b =
      (q * (q ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 / qInt q 3) • b ^ 3 := by
    simp only [qDivPow, qFactorial_three, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | n))
  · simp only [longMixedAdjoint]
    norm_num [qInt]
    rw [hfA]
    abel
  · simp only [longMixedAdjoint, hW2, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc,
      mul_assoc b D A, hDA, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc b A, hbA, hCA,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    norm_num only
    rw [qInt_two, qInt_three hq]
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul, mul_assoc]
    match_scalars <;> field_simp
    ring_nf
    field_simp
    ring
  · have hbb := mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul (B := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (by
      simpa only [MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul] using
        congrArg MulOpposite.op hbA) 3
    have hbA : b ^ 3 * A = (q ^ 3)⁻¹ ^ 3 • (A * b ^ 3) := by
      simpa only [MulOpposite.unop_mul, MulOpposite.unop_pow, MulOpposite.unop_smul,
        MulOpposite.unop_op] using congrArg MulOpposite.unop hbb
    simp only [longMixedAdjoint, hW2, smul_mul_assoc, hbA, mul_smul_comm,
      smul_zero, sub_zero, smul_smul]
    norm_num only
    congr 1
    field_simp
  · simp [longMixedAdjoint]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.f_mul_qDivPow_A
statement:
theorem f_mul_qDivPow_A (hq : q ≠ 0) (h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0) (h3 : qInt q 3 ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r : ℕ) :
    f * qDivPow (q ^ 3) r A =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef (q ^ 3) 1 r n •
        (qDivPow (q ^ 3) (r - n) A * longMixedAdjoint q b C D f n)
proof:
:= by
  exact B2Integral.straighten (pow_ne_zero _ hq) hpi 1
    (longMixedAdjoint_right hq h2 h3 H.BA H.DA H.CA H.fA) r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.G2Integral.qDivPow_f_mul_A
statement:
theorem qDivPow_f_mul_A (hq : q ≠ 0) (h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0) (h3 : qInt q 3 ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0) (H : Rel q e A b C D f) (r : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (q ^ 3) r f * A =
      ∑ n ∈ range (r + 1), B2Integral.sCoef (q ^ 3) 1 r n •
        (reverseLongMixedAdjoint q b C D A n * qDivPow (q ^ 3) (r - n) f)
proof:
:= by
  let op := MulOpposite.op (α := B)
  have hs := longMixedAdjoint_right hq h2 h3
    (A := op f) (b := op D) (C := op C) (D := op b) (f := op A)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul] using congrArg op H.fD)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul, MulOpposite.op_sub,
      MulOpposite.op_pow] using congrArg op H.fB)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul, MulOpposite.op_sub,
      MulOpposite.op_pow] using congrArg op H.fC)
    (by simpa only [op, MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_smul, MulOpposite.op_sub,
      MulOpposite.op_add] using congrArg op H.fA)
  have hrev (n : ℕ) : MulOpposite.unop (longMixedAdjoint q (op D) (op C) (op b) (op A) n) =
      reverseLongMixedAdjoint q b C D A n := by
    rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | n)) <;>
      simp [longMixedAdjoint, reverseLongMixedAdjoint, op, qDivPow]
  have hh := congrArg MulOpposite.unop
    (B2Integral.straighten (pow_ne_zero _ hq) hpi 1 hs r)
  simpa only [show longMixedAdjoint q (op D) (op C) (op b) (op A) 0 = op A from rfl,
    MulOpposite.unop_mul, Finset.unop_sum, MulOpposite.unop_smul, hrev, qDivPow,
    MulOpposite.unop_pow, op, MulOpposite.unop_op] using hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.monoMap_pair_rep
statement:
private theorem monoMap_pair_rep (H : Rel p e x y f)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0)
    (a : FreeAlgebra k Bool) (s : Space k) :
    monoMap k e x y f (rep p false a s) =
      FreeAlgebra.lift k (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then f else e) a *
        monoMap k e x y f s
proof:
:= by
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing s with
  | grade0 r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul,
      Algebra.smul_def]
  | grade1 b =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      change monoMap k e x y f (rep p false (θ k false) s) = _
      rw [rep_θ_left, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, monoMap_opE]
      rfl
    | true =>
      change monoMap k e x y f (rep p false (θ k true) s) = _
      rw [rep_θ_right (by decide : false ≠ true), FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply,
        monoMap_opF H hp h1 h2]
      rfl
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, add_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.B2PBW.span_mono_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem span_mono_eq_adjoin (H : Rel p e x y f)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : p ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (mono e x y f)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {e, f}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : Set.range (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then f else e) = {e, f} := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
      cases b <;> simp
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨false, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨true, rfl⟩
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    change mono e x y f m ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f}
    have he : e ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f} := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
    have hf : f ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f} := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
    have hy : y = e * f - p⁻¹ • (f * e) := by
      rw [H.fe, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp, one_smul,
        one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]
    have hx : x = e * y - y * e := by rw [H.ye]; abel
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f} := by
      rw [hy]
      exact sub_mem (mul_mem he hf) (Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (mul_mem hf he) _)
    have hx_mem : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {e, f} := by
      rw [hx]
      exact sub_mem (mul_mem he hy_mem) (mul_mem hy_mem he)
    exact mul_mem (pow_mem he _) (mul_mem (pow_mem hx_mem _)
      (mul_mem (pow_mem hy_mem _) (pow_mem hf _)))
  · rw [← hpair, Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_freeAlgebra_lift]
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    change FreeAlgebra.lift k (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then f else e) a ∈ _
    have ha := monoMap_pair_rep H hp h1 h2 a (Finsupp.single (0, 0, 0, 0) 1)
    simp only [monoMap_single, mono, pow_zero, one_smul, mul_one] at ha
    rw [← ha, monoMap, ← Finsupp.range_linearCombination]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_b2Mono_pair
statement:
theorem span_b2Mono_pair :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range
      (B2PBW.mono (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j))) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, h1, hp2⟩ := B2PBW.param_ne (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) hq h2
  exact B2PBW.span_mono_eq_adjoin (b2_rel hij h h') hp h1 hp2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_b2PBWMono_pair
statement:
theorem span_b2PBWMono_pair :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (b2PBWMono R v i j)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_b2Mono_pair R v hij h h' hq h2]
  have hc : (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero h2
  apply le_antisymm <;> rw [Submodule.span_le] <;> rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  · rw [b2PBWMono_eq_smul h]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)
  · have hm : B2PBW.mono (E R v i) (b2RootX R v i j) (b2RootY R v i j) (E R v j) m =
        ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 2)⁻¹ ^ m.2.1)⁻¹ • b2PBWMono R v i j m := by
      rw [b2PBWMono_eq_smul h, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hc), one_smul]
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.altVec_castSucc
statement:
lemma altVec_castSucc : ∀ (a b : I) (m : ℕ),
    (fun i : Fin m ↦ altVec T E a b (m + 1) i.castSucc) = altVec T E a b m
proof:
| _, _, 0 => funext fun i ↦ i.elim0
  | a, b, m + 1 => by
    funext i
    cases i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ i =>
      change altVec T E a b (m + 2) i.succ.castSucc = altVec T E a b (m + 1) i.succ
      rw [← Fin.succ_castSucc]
      exact congrArg (T a) (congrFun (altVec_castSucc b a m) i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.baseRel_altVec_le
statement:
lemma baseRel_altVec_le {a b : I} : ∀ d m : ℕ,
    BaseRel k (altVec T E a b (m + d + 1)) → BaseRel k (altVec T E a b (m + 1))
proof:
| 0, _, h => h
  | d + 1, m, h => by
    have h' : BaseRel k (fun i : Fin (m + d + 1) ↦ altVec T E a b (m + d + 1 + 1) i.castSucc) :=
      h.castSucc
    rw [altVec_castSucc] at h'
    exact baseRel_altVec_le d m h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.isLS_altVec
statement:
theorem isLS_altVec {N : ℕ} {a b : I} (hab : BaseRel k (altVec T E a b (N + 1)))
    (hba : BaseRel k (altVec T E b a (N + 1))) :
    ∀ m, m ≤ N + 1 → IsLS k (altVec T E a b m) ∧ IsLS k (altVec T E b a m)
proof:
| 0, _ => ⟨fun x ↦ x.elim0, fun x ↦ x.elim0⟩
  | m + 1, hm => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := isLS_altVec hab hba m (by omega)
    have hN : m + (N - m) = N := by omega
    refine ⟨isLS_cons (T a).toAlgHom h2 ?_, isLS_cons (T b).toAlgHom h1 ?_⟩
    · refine baseRel_altVec_le T E (N - m) m ?_
      rw [hN]
      exact hab
    · refine baseRel_altVec_le T E (N - m) m ?_
      rw [hN]
      exact hba

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.mono_altVec_zero
statement: lemma mono_altVec_zero (a b : I) (c : Fin 0 → ℕ) : mono (altVec T E a b 0) c = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mono]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.mono_altVec_succ
statement:
lemma mono_altVec_succ (a b : I) (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) :
    mono (altVec T E a b (m + 1)) c =
      E a ^ c 0 * T a (mono (altVec T E b a m) fun i ↦ c i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mono, List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons, map_list_prod, List.map_ofFn,
    Function.comp_def, map_pow]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.OrderedSpan.pbwMonomial_eq_mono_altVec_six
statement:
theorem pbwMonomial_eq_mono_altVec_six (a b : I) (c : Fin 6 → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T E [a, b, a, b, a, b] c = mono (altVec T E a b 6) c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mono_altVec_succ, mono_altVec_zero, CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_cons,
    CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_nil]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_X_one
statement: lemma g2_X_one : Xg 1 = G2PBW.x1 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_succ, tripleSix_shift_zero]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_X_two
statement: lemma g2_X_two (hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0) : Xg 2 = G2PBW.x2 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_succ, tripleSix_shift_one hq0, g2_X_one]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_X_three
statement: lemma g2_X_three (hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0) : Xg 3 = G2PBW.x3 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_succ, tripleSix_shift_two hq0, g2_X_two R v hq0]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_Tj_Ei
statement: lemma g2_Tj_Ei : (T j) (E R v i) = G2PBW.y1 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  have e := tripleSix_T_Ei Hj hij
  change (T j) (E R v i) = _ at e
  rw [e, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h', parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge h h']
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_Ti_Ej
statement: lemma g2_Ti_Ej : (T i) (E R v j) = (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.x3 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  have e := tripleSix_S_Ej Hi hij h
  change (T i) (E R v j) = _ at e
  rw [e, g2_X_three R v (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_TiTj_Ei
statement: lemma g2_TiTj_Ei : (T i) ((T j) (E R v i)) = g2c3 q • G2PBW.x2 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := tripleSix_T_Ei Hj hij
  change (T j) (E R v i) = _ at e1
  have e2 := tripleSix_S_Yv Hi hij h h' hq
  change (T i) _ = _ at e2
  rw [e1, e2, g2_X_two R v (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_Tj_X1
statement: lemma g2_Tj_X1 : (T j) (G2PBW.x1 q (E R v i) (E R v j)) = E R v i
proof:
:= by
  have e := tripleSix_T_X_one Hj hij h h' hq h3
  change (T j) _ = _ at e
  rwa [g2_X_one] at e

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_Tj_X2
statement: lemma g2_Tj_X2 : (T j) (G2PBW.x2 q (E R v i) (E R v j)) = G2PBW.y2 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [G2PBW.x2, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, g2_Tj_X1 R v T Hj hij h h' hq h3,
    g2_Tj_Ei R v T Hj hij h h']
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_Tj_X3
statement: lemma g2_Tj_X3 : (T j) (G2PBW.x3 q (E R v i) (E R v j)) = G2PBW.y3 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [G2PBW.x3, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, g2_Tj_X2 R v T Hj hij h h' hq h3,
    g2_Tj_Ei R v T Hj hij h h']
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_TiTj_X2
statement:
lemma g2_TiTj_X2 :
    (T i) ((T j) (G2PBW.x2 q (E R v i) (E R v j))) = g2c2 q • G2PBW.x1 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  have e := tripleSix_S_TX2 Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
