  change (T i) ((T j) _) = _ at e
  rw [g2_X_two R v (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)), g2_X_one] at e
  exact e

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_TiTjTi_Ej
statement:
lemma g2_TiTjTi_Ej : (T i) ((T j) ((T i) (E R v j))) =
    ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ * g2c3 q * g2c2 q) • G2PBW.z q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [g2_Ti_Ej R v T Hi hij h, map_smul, map_smul, G2PBW.x3, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul,
    map_mul, g2_Tj_Ei R v T Hj hij h h', map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul,
    g2_TiTj_X2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]
  have e : (T i) (G2PBW.y1 q (E R v i) (E R v j)) = g2c3 q • G2PBW.x2 q (E R v i) (E R v j) := by
    rw [← g2_Tj_Ei R v T Hj hij h h', g2_TiTj_Ei R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq]
  rw [e, G2PBW.z]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_TiTjTiTj_Ei
statement:
lemma g2_TiTjTiTj_Ei : (T i) ((T j) ((T i) ((T j) (E R v i)))) =
    (g2c3 q * g2c2 q) • G2PBW.x1 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [g2_TiTj_Ei R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq, map_smul, map_smul,
    g2_TiTj_X2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_TjTi_Ej
statement:
lemma g2_TjTi_Ej : (T j) ((T i) (E R v j)) =
    (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y3 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [g2_Ti_Ej R v T Hi hij h, map_smul, g2_Tj_X3 R v T Hj hij h h' hq h3]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_TjTiTj_Ei
statement:
lemma g2_TjTiTj_Ei : (T j) ((T i) ((T j) (E R v i))) =
    g2c3 q • G2PBW.y2 q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [g2_TiTj_Ei R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq, map_smul, g2_Tj_X2 R v T Hj hij h h' hq h3]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.g2_TjTiTjTi_Ej
statement:
lemma g2_TjTiTjTi_Ej : (T j) ((T i) ((T j) ((T i) (E R v j)))) =
    ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ * g2c3 q * g2c2 q) • G2PBW.w q (E R v i) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [g2_TiTjTi_Ej R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3, map_smul, G2PBW.z, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul,
    map_mul, g2_Tj_X2 R v T Hj hij h h' hq h3, g2_Tj_X1 R v T Hj hij h h' hq h3]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.altVec_g2
statement:
theorem altVec_g2 : altVec T (E R v) i j 6 =
    ![E R v i, (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.x3 q (E R v i) (E R v j),
      g2c3 q • G2PBW.x2 q (E R v i) (E R v j),
      ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ * g2c3 q * g2c2 q) • G2PBW.z q (E R v i) (E R v j),
      (g2c3 q * g2c2 q) • G2PBW.x1 q (E R v i) (E R v j), E R v j]
proof:
:= by
  funext l
  fin_cases l
  · rfl
  · exact g2_Ti_Ej R v T Hi hij h
  · exact g2_TiTj_Ei R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq
  · exact g2_TiTjTi_Ej R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
  · exact g2_TiTjTiTj_Ei R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
  · have e := tripleSix_Ej Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
    exact e

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.altVec_g2_rev
statement:
theorem altVec_g2_rev : altVec T (E R v) j i 6 =
    ![E R v j, G2PBW.y1 q (E R v i) (E R v j),
      (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y3 q (E R v i) (E R v j),
      g2c3 q • G2PBW.y2 q (E R v i) (E R v j),
      ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ * g2c3 q * g2c2 q) • G2PBW.w q (E R v i) (E R v j), E R v i]
proof:
:= by
  funext l
  fin_cases l
  · rfl
  · exact g2_Tj_Ei R v T Hj hij h h'
  · exact g2_TjTi_Ej R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
  · exact g2_TjTiTj_Ei R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
  · exact g2_TjTiTjTi_Ej R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
  · have e := tripleSix_Ei Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3
    exact e

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLS_altVec_g2
statement:
theorem isLS_altVec_g2 :
    IsLS k (altVec T (E R v) i j 6) ∧ IsLS k (altVec T (E R v) j i 6)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  obtain ⟨h2', h3'⟩ := tripleSix_qInt_ne h3 hv
  have hq2 : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have e : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 + 1 = v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) := by field_simp
    rw [e]
    exact mul_ne_zero hq0 h2'
  have hS4 := serre_E R v hij
  rw [h, show (1 - (-3 : ℤ)).toNat = 4 by rfl] at hS4
  have hS2 := serre_E R v hij.symm
  rw [h', show (1 - (-1 : ℤ)).toNat = 2 by rfl, parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge h h'] at hS2
  have hs2 : (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 3)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero h3
  have hc3 : g2c3 (v ^ D.d i) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [g2c3, tripleSix_cc_three hq0 hq]
    exact mul_ne_zero hs2 h3'
  have hc2 : g2c2 (v ^ D.d i) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [g2c2, tripleSix_cc_three hq0 hq, tripleSix_cc_two hq0 hq]
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hs2 h3') (pow_ne_zero _ h2')
  refine isLS_altVec T (E R v) (N := 5) ?_ ?_ 6 le_rfl
  · rw [altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]
    exact G2PBW.baseRel_fwd hq0 hS4 hS2 hq2 hs2 hc3 (mul_ne_zero hc3 hc2)
  · rw [altVec_g2_rev R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]
    exact G2PBW.baseRel_rev hq0 hS2 hs2 hc3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoin_range_altVec_g2
proof:
:= by
  have hi : E R v i ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j} := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
  have hj : E R v j ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j} := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    rcases hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]
      fin_cases l
      · exact hi
      · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (G2PBW.x3_mem _ _ _) _
      · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (G2PBW.x2_mem _ _ _) _
      · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (G2PBW.z_mem _ _ _) _
      · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (G2PBW.x1_mem _ _ _) _
      · exact hj
    · rw [altVec_g2_rev R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]
      fin_cases l
      · exact hj
      · exact G2PBW.y1_mem _ _ _
      · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (G2PBW.y3_mem _ _ _) _
      · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (G2PBW.y2_mem _ _ _) _
      · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (G2PBW.w_mem _ _ _) _
      · exact hi
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
    · rcases hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨5, by rw [altVec_g2_rev R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]; rfl⟩
    · rcases hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨5, by rw [altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]; rfl⟩
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨0, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_g2
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_g2 :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i, j, i, j]) =
      Set.range (mono (altVec T (E R v) i j 6)) :=
    congrArg Set.range (funext (pbwMonomial_eq_mono_altVec_six T (E R v) i j))
  rw [hr, span_mono_eq_adjoin _ (isLS_altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3).1,
    adjoin_range_altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3 i j (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_g2_rev
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_g2_rev :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i, j, i, j, i])) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k {E R v i, E R v j}).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i, j, i, j, i]) =
      Set.range (mono (altVec T (E R v) j i 6)) :=
    congrArg Set.range (funext (pbwMonomial_eq_mono_altVec_six T (E R v) j i))
  rw [hr, span_mono_eq_adjoin _ (isLS_altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3).2,
    adjoin_range_altVec_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3 j i (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_g2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_g2_braid :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v) [j, i, j, i, j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwMonomial_g2 R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3,
    span_pbwMonomial_g2_rev R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_g2_context
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_g2_context
    (hT : T i * T j * T i * T j * T i * T j = T j * T i * T j * T i * T j * T i)
    (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
      (p ++ [i, j, i, j, i, j] ++ s))) =
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial T (E R v)
      (p ++ [j, i, j, i, j, i] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  apply CoxeterSystem.span_pbwMonomial_context
    T (E R v) (span_pbwMonomial_g2_braid R v T Hi Hj hij h h' hq h3)
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil,
    mul_one, ← mul_assoc] using hT

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_pbwMonomial_g2_context_of_not_root
statement:
theorem span_pbwMonomial_g2_context_of_not_root
    (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (p s : List I) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [i, j, i, j, i, j] ++ s))) =
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) (p ++ [j, i, j, i, j, i] ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  apply span_pbwMonomial_g2_context R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot_images hv' i) (braidEquivOfNotRoot_images hv' j) hij h h'
    (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i 3)
  have hLift : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') :=
    isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv'
  have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 6 := by
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h, h']
    rfl
  have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 6 := by
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h, h']
    rfl
  have e := hLift i j hij (by omega)
  simpa [CoxeterSystem.braidWord, hm, hm', CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord,
    ← mul_assoc] using e

name: PBWProductNorm.preimage_nil
statement:
theorem preimage_nil (hw : cs.IsReduced []) (c : Fin [].length → ℕ) :
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientPlus_injective R
  rw [quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage, _root_.map_one]
  simp [pbwDivSymm, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial]

name: PBWProductNorm.pairing
statement:
theorem pairing {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) (integralPBWPreimage R hw d) =
      if c = d then ∏ n : Fin w.length, GrandLoop.coefU D 𝕧 (w.get n) (c n) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    have hcd : c = d := funext fun n ↦ Fin.elim0 n
    have hf : quotientForm D 1 1 = 1 := by
      simpa using quotientForm_toQuotient D (1 : LusztigF 𝕂 I) 1
    simp [preimage_nil, hcd, hf]
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [RestrictedBraidConsumer.adapted_pbw_pairing_recursion R hw c d,
      ih (by simpa using hw.drop 1)]
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    have he : c = d ↔ c 0 = d 0 ∧
        (fun n : Fin w.length ↦ c n.succ) = (fun n : Fin w.length ↦ d n.succ) := by
      constructor
      · rintro rfl
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨h0, ht⟩
        funext n
        refine Fin.cases h0 (fun k ↦ congrFun ht k) n
    by_cases h0 : c 0 = d 0
    · by_cases ht : (fun n : Fin w.length ↦ c n.succ) = (fun n : Fin w.length ↦ d n.succ)
      · simp [he.mpr ⟨h0, ht⟩]
      · have hcd : c ≠ d := fun h ↦ ht (he.mp h).2
        simp [h0, ht, hcd]
    · have hcd : c ≠ d := fun h ↦ h0 (he.mp h).1
      simp [h0, hcd]

name: PBWProductNorm.orthogonal
statement:
theorem orthogonal {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ)
    (hcd : c ≠ d) :
    quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) (integralPBWPreimage R hw d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairing R hw c d, hcd, ite_false]

name: PBWProductNorm.norm
statement:
theorem norm {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) =
      ∏ n : Fin w.length, GrandLoop.coefU D 𝕧 (w.get n) (c n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairing R hw c c, ite_true]

name: PBWProductNorm.norm_residue
statement:
theorem norm_residue {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ a : InfinityLocalRing,
      quotientForm D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) =
        algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 (1 + InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer * a)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [norm R hw c]
    simp
  | cons i w ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := quotientForm_divided_norm_factor D i (c 0)
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ih (by simpa using hw.drop 1) (fun n ↦ c n.succ)
    refine ⟨a + b + InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer * a * b, ?_⟩
    rw [RestrictedBraidConsumer.adapted_pbw_norm_recursion R hw c, ha, hb, ← _root_.map_mul]
    congr 1
    ring

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin_aux
statement:
private theorem braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin_aux (hT : M.IsBraidLiftable T)
    (hR : M.RankTwoRootProperty T E) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ w, ℓ w = n → ∀ i, ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i →
      cs.braidLift T w (E i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E) ∧
        ∀ j, w * s i = s j * w → cs.braidLift T w (E i) = E j
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro w hw i hwi
  by_cases h1 : w = 1
  · subst h1
    refine ⟨?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [braidLift_one, AlgEquiv.one_apply]
      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rw [one_mul, mul_one] at hj
      rw [braidLift_one, AlgEquiv.one_apply, cs.simple_injective hj]
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one h1
  have hki : i ≠ k₀ := by rintro rfl; exact hwi hk
  set J : Set B := {i, k₀} with hJ
  obtain ⟨w', hw', u, hu, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_mem_minCosetReps_mul_eq J w
  have hlen := length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hw' hu
  have hu1 : u ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [mul_one] at hk
    exact hw' k₀ (by simp [hJ]) hk
  have hlu : 0 < ℓ u := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h ↦ hu1 (cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  have hlt : ℓ w' < n := by omega
  have hw'i : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w' i := hw' i (by simp [hJ])
  have hw'k : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w' k₀ := hw' k₀ (by simp [hJ])
  
  have hui : ¬cs.IsRightDescent u i := by
    have h2 := length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hw'
      (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hu (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup (show i ∈ J by simp [hJ])))
    rw [cs.not_isRightDescent_iff, mul_assoc, h2, hlen] at hwi
    rw [cs.not_isRightDescent_iff]
    omega
  have hsplit : cs.braidLift T (w' * u) = cs.braidLift T w' * cs.braidLift T u :=
    braidLift_mul hT hlen
  obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_wordProd_alternatingWord hki hu hui
  have hred := cs.isReduced_alternatingWord i k₀ (k := m) (by omega)
  have hTu : cs.braidLift T (π (alternatingWord i k₀ m)) =
      ((alternatingWord i k₀ m).map T).prod := braidLift_wordProd hT hred
  have ihi := ih _ hlt w' rfl i hw'i
  have ihk := ih _ hlt w' rfl k₀ hw'k
  refine ⟨?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [hsplit, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, hTu]
    have hle : Algebra.adjoin k {E i, E k₀} ≤
        (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E)).comap (cs.braidLift T w').toAlgHom := by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff, Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact ⟨ihi.1, ihk.1⟩
    exact hle (hR.mem i k₀ hki m hm)
  · 
    set u := π (alternatingWord i k₀ m) with hu_def
    set t := u * s i * u⁻¹ with ht_def
    have ht : t ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J :=
      Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hu (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup (by simp [hJ])))
        (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hu)
    have hwt : w' * t = s j * w' := by
      calc w' * t = w' * u * s i * u⁻¹ := by rw [ht_def]; group
        _ = s j * w' := by rw [hj]; group
    have hlt' := length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hw' ht
    have ht1 : t ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      rw [ht_def, mul_inv_eq_one, mul_eq_left] at h
      have := cs.length_simple i
      rw [h, length_one] at this
      exact absurd this (by norm_num)
    have hlt1 : ℓ t = 1 := by
      have := cs.length_simple_mul w' j
      have h0 : 0 < ℓ t := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h ↦ ht1 (cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
      rw [← hwt, hlt'] at this
      omega
    obtain ⟨ω, hωred, hωJ, hωe⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup ht
    have hωlen : ω.length = 1 := by rw [← hωred.eq, hωe, hlt1]
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hωlen
    rw [wordProd_singleton] at hωe
    have hlJ : l ∈ J := hωJ l (by simp)
    have hul : u * s i = s l * u := by
      rw [hωe, ht_def, inv_mul_cancel_right]
    rcases eq_of_alternatingWord_mul_simple_eq hki hm hul with ⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨hm1, hl⟩
    · exact absurd rfl hu1
    rw [hsplit, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, hTu, hR.eq i k₀ hki m hm1, ← hl]
    have hw'l : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w' l := hw' l hlJ
    refine (ih _ hlt w' rfl l hw'l).2 j ?_
    rw [hωe]; exact hwt

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin (hT : M.IsBraidLiftable T) (hR : M.RankTwoRootProperty T E)
    {w : W} {i : B} (hwi : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i) :
    cs.braidLift T w (E i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E)
proof:
:=
  (braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin_aux hT hR _ w rfl i hwi).1

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_apply_eq_of_mul_simple_eq
statement:
theorem braidLift_apply_eq_of_mul_simple_eq (hT : M.IsBraidLiftable T)
    (hR : M.RankTwoRootProperty T E) {w : W} {i j : B} (hwi : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i)
    (h : w * s i = s j * w) : cs.braidLift T w (E i) = E j
proof:
:=
  (braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin_aux hT hR _ w rfl i hwi).2 j h

name: CoxeterSystem.rootVector_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem rootVector_mem_adjoin (hT : M.IsBraidLiftable T) (hR : M.RankTwoRootProperty T E)
    {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ω.length) :
    rootVector T E ω n hn ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range E)
proof:
:= by
  have hred : cs.IsReduced (ω.take n) := hω.take n
  have hred' : cs.IsReduced (ω.take (n + 1)) := hω.take (n + 1)
  have hsplit : ω.take (n + 1) = ω.take n ++ [ω[n]] := by
    rw [List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hn]
    rfl
  have hwi : ¬cs.IsRightDescent (π (ω.take n)) ω[n] := by
    rw [cs.not_isRightDescent_iff, ← wordProd_singleton, ← wordProd_append, ← hsplit, hred'.eq,
      hred.eq]
    simp [List.length_take]
    omega
  have := braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin hT hR hwi
  rwa [braidLift_wordProd hT hred] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidLift_E_mem_adjoin_of_not_root
statement:
theorem braidLift_E_mem_adjoin_of_not_root {w : W} {i : I} (hwi : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i) :
    cs.braidLift (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') w (E R v i) ∈
      Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.braidLift_apply_mem_adjoin (isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')
    (rankTwoRootProperty_braidEquivOfGeneric
      (fun i ↦ (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne)
      (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv')) hwi

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidLift_E_eq_of_not_root
statement:
theorem braidLift_E_eq_of_not_root {w : W} {i j : I} (hwi : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i)
    (h : w * cs.simple i = cs.simple j * w) :
    cs.braidLift (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') w (E R v i) = E R v j
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.braidLift_apply_eq_of_mul_simple_eq (isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')
    (rankTwoRootProperty_braidEquivOfGeneric
      (fun i ↦ (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne)
      (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv')) hwi h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root
statement:
theorem rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root {ω : List I} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n < ω.length) :
    CoxeterSystem.rootVector (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv') (E R v) ω n hn ∈
      Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.rootVector_mem_adjoin (isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv')
    (rankTwoRootProperty_braidEquivOfGeneric
      (fun i ↦ (shortNode_braidGeneric_of_not_root hv' i).sub_ne)
      (braidSerreGeneric_of_not_root hv')) hω n hn

name: mulVec_map_of_eq
statement:
private lemma mulVec_map_of_eq {R K ι n : Type*} [CommRing R] [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    (φ : R →+* K) (p : ι → n → R) (c : ι → K) :
    ((Matrix.of fun x a ↦ p a x).map φ) *ᵥ c = ∑ a, c a • (φ ∘ p a)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm]

name: LinearIndependent.of_comp_ratHom
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.of_comp_ratHom {R F ι n : Type*} [CommRing R] [Field F] [Finite ι]
    [Finite n] (φ₁ : R →+* ℚ) (φ₂ : R →+* F) (hφ₂ : Function.Injective φ₂)
    (p : ι → n → R) (h : LinearIndependent ℚ fun a ↦ φ₁ ∘ p a) :
    LinearIndependent F fun a ↦ φ₂ ∘ p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have := Fintype.ofFinite n
  set M : Matrix n ι R := Matrix.of fun x a ↦ p a x
  
  have h₁ : ((M.map φ₁)ᵀ * M.map φ₁).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.2 h0
    have hMc : M.map φ₁ *ᵥ c = 0 := by
      have : (M.map φ₁ *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (M.map φ₁ *ᵥ c) = 0 := by
        have e : (M.map φ₁ *ᵥ c) ⬝ᵥ (M.map φ₁ *ᵥ c) =
            c ⬝ᵥ (((M.map φ₁)ᵀ * M.map φ₁) *ᵥ c) := by
          rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec c, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
        rw [e, hc0, dotProduct_zero]
      exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 this
    rw [mulVec_map_of_eq] at hMc
    exact hc (funext (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.1 h c hMc))
  have hR : (Mᵀ * M).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply h₁
    have := RingHom.map_det φ₁ (Mᵀ * M)
    rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.transpose_map, h0, map_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  have h₂ : ((M.map φ₂)ᵀ * M.map φ₂).det ≠ 0 := by
    have := RingHom.map_det φ₂ (Mᵀ * M)
    rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.transpose_map] at this
    rw [← this]
    exact fun h0 ↦ hR (hφ₂ (h0.trans (map_zero φ₂).symm))
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro c hc
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne
  apply h₂
  refine Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.1 ⟨c, fun h0 ↦ ha (by simp [h0]), ?_⟩
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_map_of_eq, hc, Matrix.mulVec_zero]

name: LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_injective_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_injective_of_transcendental {k : Type*} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    {v : k} (hv : Transcendental ℚ v) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ k) (Units.mk0 v hv0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨n, f', hf'⟩ := LaurentPolynomial.exists_T_pow f
  have h1 : LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ k) (Units.mk0 v hv0) (Polynomial.toLaurent f')
      = 0 := by
    rw [hf', map_mul, hf, zero_mul]
  rw [LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_toLaurent] at h1
  have h2 : f' = 0 := (transcendental_iff.1 hv) f' (by rwa [Polynomial.aeval_def])
  have h3 : f * LaurentPolynomial.T n = 0 := by rw [← hf', h2, map_zero]
  have hu : IsUnit (LaurentPolynomial.T (n : ℤ) : LaurentPolynomial ℚ) :=
    LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T _
  exact (hu.mul_left_eq_zero).1 h3

name: FreeAlgebra.product_mem
statement:
lemma product_mem (hs : ∀ j, s j ∈ wordSpan R (wt j)) (g : List X × J × List X) :
    product s g ∈ wordSpan R (productWeight wt g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have e : productWeight wt g - LusztigF.wordWeight g.2.2 =
      LusztigF.wordWeight g.1 + wt g.2.1 := add_tsub_cancel_right _ _
  have h : weightProj R (productWeight wt g) (product s g) = product s g := by
    have h1 : LusztigF.wordWeight g.2.2 ≤ productWeight wt g := le_add_self
    have h2 : LusztigF.wordWeight g.1 ≤ LusztigF.wordWeight g.1 + wt g.2.1 := le_self_add
    rw [product, weightProj_mul_wordBasis, ite_eq_left h1, e, weightProj_wordBasis_mul,
      ite_eq_left h2, add_tsub_cancel_left, weightProj_self (hs _)]
  rw [← h]
  exact weightProj_mem _ _

name: FreeAlgebra.productSpan_le_wordSpan
statement:
lemma productSpan_le_wordSpan (hs : ∀ j, s j ∈ wordSpan R (wt j)) (ν : X →₀ ℕ) :
    productSpan s wt ν ≤ wordSpan R ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [productSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  exact (show productWeight wt g = ν from hg) ▸ product_mem hs g

name: FreeAlgebra.product_mem_productSpan
statement:
lemma product_mem_productSpan (g : List X × J × List X) :
    product s g ∈ productSpan s wt (productWeight wt g)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, rfl, rfl⟩

name: FreeAlgebra.productSpan_le_ideal
statement:
lemma productSpan_le_ideal (ν : X →₀ ℕ) :
    (productSpan s wt ν : Set (FreeAlgebra R X)) ⊆ TwoSidedIdeal.span (Set.range s)
proof:
:= by
  change productSpan s wt ν ≤ (TwoSidedIdeal.span (Set.range s)).asIdeal.restrictScalars R
  rw [productSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨g, -, rfl⟩
  exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _
    (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self g.2.1)))

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mul_mem_productSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hy
    have e1 : wordBasis R X a * product s g = product s (a ++ g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2) := by
      simp only [product, wordBasis_append, mul_assoc]
    have e2 : LusztigF.wordWeight a + μ = productWeight wt (a ++ g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2) := by
      rw [← show productWeight wt g = μ from hg]
      simp only [productWeight, LusztigF.wordWeight_append, add_assoc]
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact product_mem_productSpan s wt _
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: FreeAlgebra.mul_wordBasis_mem_productSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hy
    have e1 : product s g * wordBasis R X b = product s (g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2 ++ b) := by
      simp only [product, wordBasis_append, mul_assoc]
    have e2 : μ + LusztigF.wordWeight b = productWeight wt (g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2 ++ b) := by
      rw [← show productWeight wt g = μ from hg]
      simp only [productWeight, LusztigF.wordWeight_append, add_assoc]
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact product_mem_productSpan s wt _
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem_productSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction generalizing ν with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [weightProj_of_mem (hs j)]
    split_ifs with h
    · have := product_mem_productSpan s wt ([], j, [])
      simp only [product, productWeight, wordBasis_nil, one_mul, mul_one,
        LusztigF.wordWeight_nil, zero_add, add_zero] at this
      exact h ▸ this
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem (hy ν) (hz ν)
  | neg y _ hy => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem (hy ν)
  | left_absorb a y _ hy =>
    induction a using induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_mul, map_add]; exact add_mem ha ha'
    | smul c a ha => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha
    | word w =>
      rw [weightProj_wordBasis_mul]
      split_ifs with h
      · have := wordBasis_mul_mem_productSpan w (hy (ν - LusztigF.wordWeight w))
        rwa [add_tsub_cancel_of_le h] at this
      · exact zero_mem _
  | right_absorb b y _ hy =>
    induction b using induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add b b' hb hb' => rw [mul_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hb hb'
    | smul c b hb => rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hb
    | word w =>
      rw [weightProj_mul_wordBasis]
      split_ifs with h
      · have := mul_wordBasis_mem_productSpan w (hy (ν - LusztigF.wordWeight w))
        rwa [tsub_add_cancel_of_le h] at this
      · exact zero_mem _

name: FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_inf_ideal_eq_productSpan
statement:
theorem wordSpan_inf_ideal_eq_productSpan (hs : ∀ j, s j ∈ wordSpan R (wt j)) (ν : X →₀ ℕ)
    {x : FreeAlgebra R X} (hxν : x ∈ wordSpan R ν) :
    x ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span (Set.range s) ↔ x ∈ productSpan s wt ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun hx ↦ productSpan_le_ideal ν hx⟩
  rw [← weightProj_self hxν]
  exact weightProj_mem_productSpan hs hx ν

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis
statement:
lemma weightProj_wordBasis (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (w : List X) :
    weightProj R ν (wordBasis R X w) = if LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν then wordBasis R X w else 0
proof:
:=
  (wordBasis R X).constr_basis R _ w

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightProj_of_mem {ν μ : X →₀ ℕ} {x : FreeAlgebra R X} (hx : x ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    weightProj R ν x = if μ = ν then x else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [weightProj_wordBasis, hw]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_self
statement:
lemma weightProj_self {ν : X →₀ ℕ} {x : FreeAlgebra R X} (hx : x ∈ wordSpan R ν) :
    weightProj R ν x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [weightProj_of_mem hx]

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem
statement: lemma weightProj_mem (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) : weightProj R ν x ∈ wordSpan R ν
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  | word w =>
    rw [weightProj_wordBasis]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq h
    · exact zero_mem _

name: FreeAlgebra.wordWeight_add_eq_iff
statement: lemma wordWeight_add_eq_iff {a b ν : X →₀ ℕ} : a + b = ν ↔ a ≤ ν ∧ b = ν - a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact ⟨le_self_add, (add_tsub_cancel_left a b).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩; exact add_tsub_cancel_of_le h

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_wordBasis_mul
statement:
lemma weightProj_wordBasis_mul (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (a : List X) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    weightProj R ν (wordBasis R X a * x) =
      if LusztigF.wordWeight a ≤ ν then
        wordBasis R X a * weightProj R (ν - LusztigF.wordWeight a) x else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz]; split_ifs <;> simp [mul_add]
  | smul c y hy => rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hy]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | word w =>
    rw [← wordBasis_append, weightProj_wordBasis, weightProj_wordBasis, LusztigF.wordWeight_append]
    by_cases h1 : LusztigF.wordWeight a ≤ ν
    · by_cases h2 : LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν - LusztigF.wordWeight a
      · have h := wordWeight_add_eq_iff.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩
        simp [h1, h2]
      · have h : ¬ LusztigF.wordWeight a + LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν :=
          fun h ↦ h2 (wordWeight_add_eq_iff.1 h).2
        simp [h, h1, h2]
    · have h : ¬ LusztigF.wordWeight a + LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν :=
        fun h ↦ h1 (wordWeight_add_eq_iff.1 h).1
      simp [h, h1]

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mul_wordBasis
statement:
lemma weightProj_mul_wordBasis (ν : X →₀ ℕ) (b : List X) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    weightProj R ν (x * wordBasis R X b) =
      if LusztigF.wordWeight b ≤ ν then
        weightProj R (ν - LusztigF.wordWeight b) x * wordBasis R X b else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [add_mul, map_add, hy, hz]; split_ifs <;> simp [add_mul]
  | smul c y hy => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hy]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | word w =>
    rw [← wordBasis_append, weightProj_wordBasis, weightProj_wordBasis, LusztigF.wordWeight_append,
      add_comm]
    by_cases h1 : LusztigF.wordWeight b ≤ ν
    · by_cases h2 : LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν - LusztigF.wordWeight b
      · have h := wordWeight_add_eq_iff.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩
        simp [h1, h2]
      · have h : ¬ LusztigF.wordWeight b + LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν :=
          fun h ↦ h2 (wordWeight_add_eq_iff.1 h).2
        simp [h, h1, h2]
    · have h : ¬ LusztigF.wordWeight b + LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν :=
        fun h ↦ h1 (wordWeight_add_eq_iff.1 h).1
      simp [h, h1]

name: FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mul_ι_pow
statement:
lemma weightProj_mul_ι_pow {ν : X →₀ ℕ} {i : X} {N : ℕ} (h : ν i < N)
    (x : FreeAlgebra R X) : weightProj R ν (x * ι R i ^ N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hN : ι R i ^ N = wordBasis R X (List.replicate N i) := by simp
  rw [hN, weightProj_mul_wordBasis, ite_eq_right_iff]
  intro hle
  exfalso
  have := hle i
  rw [LusztigF.wordWeight_apply, List.count_replicate_self] at this
  omega

name: LusztigF.wordWeight_replicate
statement:
lemma wordWeight_replicate (N : ℕ) (i : I) :
    wordWeight (List.replicate N i) = N • Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih => rw [List.replicate_succ, wordWeight_cons, ih, succ_nsmul, add_comm]

name: LusztigF.serreWord_mem
statement: lemma serreWord_mem (i j : I) : serreWord D q i j ∈ weightSpace K (serreWeight D i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreWord, qSerre]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r hr ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  have hr := Finset.mem_range.1 hr
  have e : θ K i ^ (serreExp D i j - r) * θ K j * θ K i ^ r =
      wordBasis K I (List.replicate (serreExp D i j - r) i ++ [j] ++ List.replicate r i) := by
    simp [List.prod_replicate, mul_assoc]
  rw [e]
  refine wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq ?_
  rw [wordWeight_append, wordWeight_append, wordWeight_replicate, wordWeight_replicate, serreWeight]
  simp only [wordWeight_cons, wordWeight_nil, add_zero]
  rw [add_comm _ (r • _), ← add_assoc, ← add_nsmul, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (by omega)]

name: LusztigF.serreProduct_mem
statement:
lemma serreProduct_mem (g : List I × I × I × List I) :
    serreProduct D q g ∈ weightSpace K (serreIndexWeight D g)
proof:
:=
  mul_mem_weightSpace (mul_mem_weightSpace (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan g.1) (serreWord_mem D q _ _))
    (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan g.2.2.2)

name: LusztigF.serreSpan_le_weightSpace
statement: lemma serreSpan_le_weightSpace (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : serreSpan D q ν ≤ weightSpace K ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨g, ⟨_, hg⟩, rfl⟩
  exact hg ▸ serreProduct_mem D q g

name: LusztigF.serreProduct_mem_serreSpan
statement:
lemma serreProduct_mem_serreSpan {g : List I × I × I × List I} (hg : g.2.1 ≠ g.2.2.1) :
    serreProduct D q g ∈ serreSpan D q (serreIndexWeight D g)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, ⟨hg, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: LusztigF.wordBasis_mul_mem_serreSpan
statement:
lemma wordBasis_mul_mem_serreSpan (a : List I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF K I}
    (hx : x ∈ serreSpan D q μ) : wordBasis K I a * x ∈ serreSpan D q (wordWeight a + μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨hg, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    have e1 : wordBasis K I a * serreProduct D q g =
        serreProduct D q (a ++ g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2.1, g.2.2.2) := by
      simp only [serreProduct, wordBasis_append, mul_assoc]
    have e2 : wordWeight a + serreIndexWeight D g =
        serreIndexWeight D (a ++ g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2.1, g.2.2.2) := by
      simp only [serreIndexWeight, wordWeight_append, add_assoc]
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact serreProduct_mem_serreSpan D q hg
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.mul_wordBasis_mem_serreSpan
statement:
lemma mul_wordBasis_mem_serreSpan (b : List I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF K I}
    (hx : x ∈ serreSpan D q μ) : x * wordBasis K I b ∈ serreSpan D q (μ + wordWeight b)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨g, ⟨hg, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    have e1 : serreProduct D q g * wordBasis K I b =
        serreProduct D q (g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2.1, g.2.2.2 ++ b) := by
      simp only [serreProduct, wordBasis_append, mul_assoc]
    have e2 : serreIndexWeight D g + wordWeight b =
        serreIndexWeight D (g.1, g.2.1, g.2.2.1, g.2.2.2 ++ b) := by
      simp only [serreIndexWeight, wordWeight_append, add_assoc]
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact serreProduct_mem_serreSpan D q hg
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.weightProj_mem_serreSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction generalizing ν with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [weightProj_of_mem (serreWord_mem D q i j)]
    split_ifs with h
    · have := serreProduct_mem_serreSpan D q (g := ([], i, j, [])) hij
      simp only [serreProduct, serreIndexWeight, wordBasis_nil, one_mul, mul_one, wordWeight_nil,
        zero_add, add_zero] at this
      exact h ▸ this
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem (hy ν) (hz ν)
  | neg y _ hy => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem (hy ν)
  | left_absorb a y _ hy =>
    induction a using induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_mul, map_add]; exact add_mem ha ha'
    | smul c a ha => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha
    | word w =>
      rw [weightProj_wordBasis_mul]
      split_ifs with h
      · have := wordBasis_mul_mem_serreSpan D q w (hy (ν - wordWeight w))
        rwa [add_tsub_cancel_of_le h] at this
      · exact zero_mem _
  | right_absorb b y _ hy =>
    induction b using induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add b b' hb hb' => rw [mul_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hb hb'
    | smul c b hb => rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hb
    | word w =>
      rw [weightProj_mul_wordBasis]
      split_ifs with h
      · have := mul_wordBasis_mem_serreSpan D q w (hy (ν - wordWeight w))
        rwa [tsub_add_cancel_of_le h] at this
      · exact zero_mem _

name: LusztigCartanDatum.coPairing_single_add
statement:
lemma coPairing_single_add (i j : I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    D.coPairing i (Finsupp.single j 1 + μ) = D.cartanMatrix i j + D.coPairing i μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [coPairing, Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (by intros; push_cast; ring)]
  simp [coPairing]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.coPairing_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma coPairing_zero (i : I) : D.coPairing i 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [coPairing]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.coPairing_wordWeight_cons
statement:
lemma coPairing_wordWeight_cons (i j : I) (w : List I) :
    D.coPairing i (LusztigF.wordWeight (j :: w)) =
      D.cartanMatrix i j + D.coPairing i (LusztigF.wordWeight w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, coPairing_single_add]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot_single_eq
statement:
lemma weightDot_single_eq (i : I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    D.weightDot (Finsupp.single i 1) μ = D.d i * D.coPairing i μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LusztigCartanDatum.weightDot, coPairing, Finsupp.mul_sum]
  simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, Finsupp.sum_fun_zero, Finsupp.sum_single_index,
    Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun l _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix]; ring

name: LusztigF.evalAt_laurentT
statement: lemma evalAt_laurentT (v : k) (hv : v ≠ 0) : evalAt v hv (laurentT : LaurentPolynomial ℚ) = v
proof:
:= by
  have : ((laurentT : (LaurentPolynomial ℚ)ˣ) : LaurentPolynomial ℚ) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1 :=
    rfl
  rw [this, evalAt, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_T, zpow_one, Units.val_mk0]

name: LusztigF.evalAt_laurentT_pow
statement:
lemma evalAt_laurentT_pow (v : k) (hv : v ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    evalAt v hv ((laurentT ^ d : (LaurentPolynomial ℚ)ˣ) : LaurentPolynomial ℚ) = v ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, map_pow, evalAt_laurentT]

name: LusztigF.evalAt_one_vermaCoeff
statement:
lemma evalAt_one_vermaCoeff (n : I → ℤ) (i : I) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    evalAt (1 : ℚ) one_ne_zero (vermaCoeff D n i μ) = ((n i - D.coPairing i μ : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaCoeff, map_qIntU_of_eq_one]
  rw [evalAt_laurentT_pow, one_pow]

name: LusztigF.form_diagTwist_left
statement:
theorem form_diagTwist_left (c : I → k) (y x : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v (diagTwist c y) x = form D v y (diagTwist c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_right generalizing x with
  | algebraMap a => simp
  | smul a y hy => simp [hy]
  | add y z hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
  | mul_θ y j hy =>
    rw [map_mul, diagTwist_θ, mul_smul_comm, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, form_mul_θ, hy,
      form_mul_θ, rDeriv_diagTwist, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_mem_radical
statement:
lemma diagTwist_mem_radical (c : I → k) {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ radical D v) :
    diagTwist c x ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_radical_iff']
  intro y
  rw [← form_diagTwist_left, (mem_radical_iff' D v).1 hx]

name: LusztigF.counit_eq_zero_of_mem_radical
statement: lemma counit_eq_zero_of_mem_radical {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ radical D v) : counit x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← form_one_right D v x]; exact (mem_radical_iff D v).1 hx 1

name: LusztigF.vermaOpQ_apply
statement:
lemma vermaOpQ_apply (n : I → ℤ) (i : I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    vermaOpQ D v n i y = (qDenom D v i)⁻¹ • ((v ^ D.d i) ^ n i • twist D v⁻¹ i (lDeriv D v i y) -
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ n i)⁻¹ • rDeriv D v i y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.vermaOpQ_θ_mul
statement:
theorem vermaOpQ_θ_mul (hv : v ≠ 0) (n : I → ℤ) (i j : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k μ) :
    vermaOpQ D v n i (θ k j * y) = θ k j * vermaOpQ D v n i y +
      if i = j then ((qDenom D v i)⁻¹ * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n i - D.coPairing i μ) -
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-(n i - D.coPairing i μ)))) • y else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hvd : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hσ : twist D v⁻¹ i y = (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-D.coPairing i μ) • y := by
    rw [twist_of_mem (inv_ne_zero hv) i hy, D.weightDot_single_eq, inv_zpow', zpow_neg,
      zpow_neg, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast]
  have hσ' : twist D v i y = (v ^ D.d i) ^ D.coPairing i μ • y := by
    rw [twist_of_mem hv i hy, D.weightDot_single_eq, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast]
  rw [vermaOpQ_apply, vermaOpQ_apply, lDeriv_θ_mul, rDeriv_θ_mul, map_add, map_smul, map_mul,
    twist_θ]
  have e1 : v ^ D.dot i j • ((v⁻¹ ^ D.dot i j • θ k j) * twist D v⁻¹ i (lDeriv D v i y)) =
      θ k j * twist D v⁻¹ i (lDeriv D v i y) := by
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, inv_zpow', ← zpow_add₀ hv, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]
  rw [e1]
  split_ifs with hij
  · subst hij
    rw [hσ, hσ']
    simp only [smul_add, mul_smul_comm, mul_sub, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [zpow_sub₀ hvd, zpow_neg, zpow_neg, zpow_sub₀ hvd, inv_div]
    module
  · simp only [map_zero, zero_add, add_zero, smul_sub, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm]

name: LusztigF.vermaOpQ_mem_radical
statement:
theorem vermaOpQ_mem_radical (n : I → ℤ) {i : I} (hi : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 ≠ 1)
    {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ radical D v) : vermaOpQ D v n i y ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := thetaNorm_ne_zero D v hi
  have hsm : ∀ (c : k) {z : LusztigF k I}, z ∈ radical D v → c • z ∈ radical D v :=
    fun c z hz ↦ by rw [Algebra.smul_def]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hz
  rw [vermaOpQ_apply, twist_eq_diagTwist]
  exact hsm _ (TwoSidedIdeal.sub_mem _
    (hsm _ (diagTwist_mem_radical D v _ (lDeriv_mem_radical D v hθ hy)))
    (hsm _ (rDeriv_mem_radical D v hθ hy)))

name: LusztigF.evalAt_vermaCoeff
statement:
lemma evalAt_vermaCoeff (hv : v ≠ 0) {i : I} (hi : qDenom D v i ≠ 0) (n : I → ℤ)
    (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    evalAt v hv (vermaCoeff D n i μ) = (qDenom D v i)⁻¹ *
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n i - D.coPairing i μ) - (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-(n i - D.coPairing i μ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := sub_mul_map_qIntU (laurentT ^ D.d i) (evalAt v hv) (n i - D.coPairing i μ)
  rw [evalAt_laurentT_pow] at h
  rw [vermaCoeff, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hi]
  exact h

name: LusztigF.wordSpan_eq_weightSpace
statement: lemma wordSpan_eq_weightSpace (μ : I →₀ ℕ) : wordSpan k μ = weightSpace k μ
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.vermaOpQ_eq_vermaOp
statement:
theorem vermaOpQ_eq_vermaOp (hv : v ≠ 0) (n : I → ℤ) {i : I} (hi : qDenom D v i ≠ 0) :
    vermaOpQ D v n i = vermaOp i fun μ ↦ evalAt v hv (vermaCoeff D n i μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (wordBasis k I).ext fun w ↦ ?_
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [vermaOp_wordBasis, wordBasis_nil, vermaOpQ_apply]
    simp [vermaOpWord]
  | cons j w ih =>
    have hw : wordBasis k I w ∈ weightSpace k (wordWeight w) := wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, vermaOp_ι_mul, ← ih, weightScale_wordBasis]
    erw [vermaOpQ_θ_mul D hv n i j hw]
    rw [evalAt_vermaCoeff D hv hi]

name: LusztigF.vermaForm_eq_zero_of_mem_radical
statement:
theorem vermaForm_eq_zero_of_mem_radical (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ i, (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 ≠ 1)
    (n : I → ℤ) (w : List I) {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ radical D v) :
    vermaForm (fun i μ ↦ evalAt v hv (vermaCoeff D n i μ)) w y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq : ∀ i, qDenom D v i ≠ 0 := fun i h0 ↦ by
    have hvd : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
    apply hv' i
    rw [qDenom, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    field_simp at h0
    exact h0
  suffices h : ∀ w (y : LusztigF k I), y ∈ radical D v →
      vermaWordOp (fun i μ ↦ evalAt v hv (vermaCoeff D n i μ)) w y ∈ radical D v by
    rw [vermaForm_apply]
    exact counit_eq_zero_of_mem_radical D v (h w y hy)
  intro w
  induction w with
  | nil => intro y hy; exact hy
  | cons i w ih =>
    intro y hy
    rw [vermaWordOp_cons]
    refine ih _ ?_
    rw [← vermaOpQ_eq_vermaOp D hv n (hq i)]
    exact vermaOpQ_mem_radical D n (hv' i) hy

name: LusztigF.vermaOp_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma vermaOp_wordBasis (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    vermaOp i c (wordBasis R X w) = vermaOpWord i c w
proof:
:=
  (wordBasis R X).constr_basis R _ w

name: LusztigF.weightScale_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma weightScale_wordBasis (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    weightScale c (wordBasis R X w) = c (wordWeight w) • wordBasis R X w
proof:
:=
  (wordBasis R X).constr_basis R _ w

name: LusztigF.weightScale_of_mem
statement:
lemma weightScale_of_mem (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X}
    (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) : weightScale c y = c μ • y
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [weightScale_wordBasis, hw]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, smul_add]
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_comm]

name: LusztigF.vermaOp_one
statement: @[simp] lemma vermaOp_one (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) : vermaOp i c 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordBasis_nil, vermaOp_wordBasis, vermaOpWord]

name: LusztigF.vermaOp_ι_mul
statement:
theorem vermaOp_ι_mul (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (j : X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaOp i c (ι R j * y) = ι R j * vermaOp i c y + if i = j then weightScale c y else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz =>
    rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add, mul_add]
    split_ifs
    · rw [map_add]; abel
    · simp only [add_zero]
  | smul a y hy =>
    rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hy, map_smul, smul_add, mul_smul_comm]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | word w =>
    rw [ι_mul_wordBasis, vermaOp_wordBasis, vermaOp_wordBasis, vermaOpWord, weightScale_wordBasis]

name: LusztigF.vermaWordOp_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma vermaWordOp_nil (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) : vermaWordOp c [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.vermaWordOp_cons
statement:
lemma vermaWordOp_cons (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaWordOp c (i :: w) y = vermaWordOp c w (vermaOp i (c i) y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.vermaForm_apply
statement:
lemma vermaForm_apply (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaForm c w y = algebraMapInv (vermaWordOp c w y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.vermaForm_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma vermaForm_nil (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaForm c [] y = algebraMapInv y
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.vermaForm_cons
statement:
lemma vermaForm_cons (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    vermaForm c (i :: w) y = vermaForm c w (vermaOp i (c i) y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_vermaOpWord
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_vermaOpWord (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (vermaOpWord i c w) = vermaOpWord i (φ ∘ c) w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [vermaOpWord]
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [vermaOpWord, map_add, map_mul, mapCoeffs_ι, ih]
    split_ifs <;> simp [mapCoeffs_smul, map_list_prod, Function.comp_def]

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_vermaOp
statement:
theorem mapCoeffs_vermaOp (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (vermaOp i c y) = vermaOp i (φ ∘ c) (mapCoeffs φ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add, map_add]
  | smul a y hy => rw [map_smul, mapCoeffs_smul, hy, mapCoeffs_smul, map_smul]
  | word w => rw [vermaOp_wordBasis, mapCoeffs_vermaOpWord, mapCoeffs_wordBasis, vermaOp_wordBasis]

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_vermaWordOp
statement:
theorem mapCoeffs_vermaWordOp (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (vermaWordOp c w y) = vermaWordOp (fun i ↦ φ ∘ c i) w (mapCoeffs φ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing y with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w ih => rw [vermaWordOp_cons, ih, mapCoeffs_vermaOp, vermaWordOp_cons]

name: LusztigF.map_vermaForm
statement:
theorem map_vermaForm (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    φ (vermaForm c w y) = vermaForm (fun i ↦ φ ∘ c i) w (mapCoeffs φ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaForm_apply, vermaForm_apply, ← mapCoeffs_vermaWordOp, algebraMapInv_mapCoeffs]

name: LusztigF.single_add_tsub_single
statement:
lemma single_add_tsub_single {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {i : X} (h : μ i ≠ 0) :
    μ - Finsupp.single i 1 + Finsupp.single i 1 = μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext j
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs with hij
  · subst hij; omega
  · omega

name: LusztigF.vermaOpWord_eq_zero
statement:
lemma vermaOpWord_eq_zero (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) (hw : wordWeight w i = 0) :
    vermaOpWord i c w = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j w ih =>
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; simp at hw
    have hw' : wordWeight w i = 0 := by
      simp only [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.add_apply] at hw; omega
    simp [vermaOpWord, ih hw', hij]

name: LusztigF.vermaOpWord_mem
statement:
lemma vermaOpWord_mem (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    vermaOpWord i c w ∈ wordSpan R (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [vermaOpWord]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [vermaOpWord]
    refine add_mem ?_ ?_
    · by_cases hwi : wordWeight w i = 0
      · rw [vermaOpWord_eq_zero i c w hwi, mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      · have h := ι_mul_mem_wordSpan (R := R) j ih
        convert h using 2
        rw [wordWeight_cons]
        ext l
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> omega
    · split_ifs with hij
      · subst hij
        refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq ?_)
        rw [wordWeight_cons, add_comm, add_tsub_cancel_right]
      · exact zero_mem _

name: LusztigF.vermaOp_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma vermaOp_mem_wordSpan (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X}
    (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) : vermaOp i c y ∈ wordSpan R (μ - Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [vermaOp_wordBasis, ← hw]; exact vermaOpWord_mem i c w
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.vermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma vermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} (hμ : μ i = 0)
    {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) : vermaOp i c y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [vermaOp_wordBasis, vermaOpWord_eq_zero i c w (hw ▸ hμ)]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]

name: LusztigF.vermaWordOp_mem
statement:
lemma vermaWordOp_mem (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X}
    (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    vermaWordOp c w y ∈ wordSpan R (μ - wordWeight w) ∧
      (¬ wordWeight w ≤ μ → vermaWordOp c w y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing μ y with
  | nil => simpa using hy
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [vermaWordOp_cons]
    by_cases hμi : μ i = 0
    · rw [vermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem i (c i) hμi hy, map_zero]
      exact ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (vermaOp_mem_wordSpan i (c i) hy)
      have e : μ - Finsupp.single i 1 - wordWeight w = μ - wordWeight (i :: w) := by
        rw [wordWeight_cons, tsub_tsub]
      refine ⟨e ▸ h1, fun h ↦ h2 fun hle ↦ h ?_⟩
      rw [wordWeight_cons, ← single_add_tsub_single hμi, add_comm (Finsupp.single i 1)]
      exact add_le_add_left hle _

name: LusztigF.vermaForm_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := vermaWordOp_mem c w hy
  rw [vermaForm_apply]
  by_cases hle : wordWeight w ≤ μ
  · refine algebraMapInv_eq_zero_of_mem_wordSpan (fun h0 ↦ hμ ?_) h1
    exact le_antisymm hle (tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.1 h0)
  · rw [h2 hle, map_zero]

name: LusztigCartanDatum.isSymmetrizable_cartanMatrix
statement: theorem isSymmetrizable_cartanMatrix : D.cartanMatrix.IsSymmetrizable
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ D.d i, fun i ↦ Int.natCast_pos.2 (D.d_pos i), Matrix.IsSymm.ext fun i j ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul, D.d_mul_cartanMatrix, D.dot_comm]

name: LusztigF.toIrreducible_apply
statement:
lemma toIrreducible_apply (y : LusztigF K I) :
    toIrreducible D P hn y = serreAssocToIrreducibleModule P D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
      D.isSymmetrizable_cartanMatrix hn (SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom K D.cartanMatrix y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.toIrreducible_one
statement: lemma toIrreducible_one : toIrreducible D P hn 1 = IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [toIrreducible_apply, map_one, ← serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk, serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk_one]

name: LusztigF.toIrreducible_θ_mul
statement:
lemma toIrreducible_θ_mul (j : I) (y : LusztigF K I) :
    toIrreducible D P hn (θ K j * y) = ⁅f P j, toIrreducible D P hn y⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [toIrreducible_apply, toIrreducible_apply, ← serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk,
    ← serreAssocQuotientEquiv_mk, ← serreAssocQuotientEquiv_θ_smul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
    map_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  rfl

name: LusztigF.toIrreducible_surjective
statement: lemma toIrreducible_surjective : Function.Surjective (toIrreducible D P hn)
proof:
:=
  (serreAssocToIrreducibleModule_surjective P _ _ hn).comp
    (SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_surjective K D.cartanMatrix)

name: LusztigF.lie_h_irreducible_hwv
statement:
lemma lie_h_irreducible_hwv (a : H) :
    ⁅h P a, IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ⁆ = Λ a • IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [IrreducibleModule.hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_h_hwv, map_smul]

name: LusztigF.lie_e_irreducible_hwv
statement: lemma lie_e_irreducible_hwv (i : I) : ⁅e P i, IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IrreducibleModule.hwv, ← LieModuleHom.map_lie, VermaModule.lie_e_hwv, map_zero]

name: LusztigF.lie_h_toIrreducible
statement:
lemma lie_h_toIrreducible (i : I) (w : List I) :
    ⁅h P (P.coroot i), toIrreducible D P hn (wordBasis K I w)⁆ =
      classicalCoeff K D n i (wordWeight w) • toIrreducible D P hn (wordBasis K I w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [wordBasis_nil, toIrreducible_one, lie_h_irreducible_hwv, hn]
    simp [classicalCoeff]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, toIrreducible_θ_mul, leibniz_lie, lie_h_f, neg_lie, smul_lie, ih,
      lie_smul, P.root_coroot]
    simp only [classicalCoeff, D.coPairing_wordWeight_cons]
    push_cast
    module

name: LusztigF.lie_e_toIrreducible
statement:
theorem lie_e_toIrreducible (i : I) (y : LusztigF K I) :
    ⁅e P i, toIrreducible D P hn y⁆ =
      toIrreducible D P hn (vermaOp i (classicalCoeff K D n i) y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, lie_add, hy, hz, map_add, map_add]
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul, lie_smul, hy, map_smul, map_smul]
  | word w =>
    induction w with
    | nil =>
      rw [wordBasis_nil, toIrreducible_one, lie_e_irreducible_hwv, vermaOp_one, map_zero]
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, toIrreducible_θ_mul, leibniz_lie, lie_e_f, ih, vermaOp_ι_mul,
        map_add, toIrreducible_θ_mul, weightScale_wordBasis]
      split_ifs with hij
      · subst hij
        rw [lie_h_toIrreducible, map_smul, add_comm]
      · rw [zero_lie, zero_add, map_zero, add_zero]

name: LusztigF.contravariantForm_hwv_toIrreducible
statement:
lemma contravariantForm_hwv_toIrreducible (y : LusztigF K I) :
    IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm P Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv P Λ)
      (toIrreducible D P hn y) = counit y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_left with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, map_smul, toIrreducible_one,
      IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_hwv_hwv]
    simp
  | smul c y hy => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hy, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add]
  | θ_mul j y _ =>
    rw [toIrreducible_θ_mul, (IrreducibleModule.isSymm_contravariantForm P Λ).eq,
      IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_lie_left, transpose_f,
      lie_e_irreducible_hwv, map_zero, map_mul, counit_θ, zero_mul]

name: LusztigF.contravariantForm_toIrreducible
statement:
theorem contravariantForm_toIrreducible (w : List I) (y : LusztigF K I) :
    IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm P Λ (toIrreducible D P hn (wordBasis K I w))
      (toIrreducible D P hn y) = vermaForm (classicalCoeff K D n) w y
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing y with
  | nil => rw [wordBasis_nil, toIrreducible_one, contravariantForm_hwv_toIrreducible]; rfl
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, toIrreducible_θ_mul, IrreducibleModule.contravariantForm_lie_left,
      transpose_f, lie_e_toIrreducible, ih, vermaForm_cons]

name: LusztigF.serreAssocElem_eq_smul_serreWord
statement:
lemma serreAssocElem_eq_smul_serreWord {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    serreAssocElem K D.cartanMatrix i j =
      (-1 : K) ^ serreExp D i j • serreWord D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat + 1 = serreExp D i j :=
    D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.toNat_neg_add_one hij
  rw [serreAssocElem, hN, serreWord, qSerre, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ serreExp D i j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  set N := serreExp D i j
  rw [show N + 1 - 1 - r = N - r by omega, Nat.sub_sub_self hr, qBinomial_one,
    Nat.choose_symm hr, smul_smul]
  have hs : (-1 : K) ^ N * (-1) ^ r = (-1) ^ (N - r) := by
    rw [← pow_add, show N + r = 2 * r + (N - r) by omega, pow_add, pow_mul, neg_one_sq,
      one_pow, one_mul]
  rw [← mul_assoc, hs]

name: LusztigF.serreAssocIdeal_le_span_serreWord
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreAssocIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
  rw [serreAssocElem_eq_smul_serreWord D hij, Algebra.smul_def]
  exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩)

name: LusztigF.mem_serreSpan_of_vermaForm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_serreSpan_of_vermaForm_eq_zero (P : Realization D.cartanMatrix K H)
    (hn : ∀ i, Λ (P.coroot i) = n i) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ∀ i, ν i ≤ n i)
    {y : LusztigF K I} (hy : y ∈ weightSpace K ν)
    (h : ∀ w, wordWeight w = ν → vermaForm (classicalCoeff K D n) w y = 0) :
    y ∈ serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ∀ w, vermaForm (classicalCoeff K D n) w y = 0 := fun w ↦ by
    by_cases hw : wordWeight w = ν
    · exact h w hw
    · exact vermaForm_eq_zero_of_ne _ w hw hy
  
  have hY : toIrreducible D P hn y = 0 := by
    refine (IrreducibleModule.nondegenerate_contravariantForm P Λ).2 _ fun u ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toIrreducible_surjective D P hn u
    induction x using induction_wordBasis with
    | zero => simp
    | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx', add_zero]
    | smul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hx, smul_zero]
    | word w => rw [contravariantForm_toIrreducible, h' w]
  
  have hker : SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom K D.cartanMatrix y ∈
      SerreAssocAlgebra.thetaPowLeftIdeal K D.cartanMatrix n := by
    have hmem : SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom K D.cartanMatrix y ∈ LinearMap.ker
        (serreAssocToIrreducibleModule P D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
          D.isSymmetrizable_cartanMatrix hn) := hY
    rw [ker_serreAssocToIrreducibleModule] at hmem
    exact hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).1 hker
  choose b hb using fun i ↦ SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_surjective K D.cartanMatrix (c i)
  have hz : y - ∑ i, b i * θ K i ^ (n i + 1) ∈ serreAssocIdeal K D.cartanMatrix := by
    rw [← SerreAssocAlgebra.mkAlgHom_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, map_sum, ← hc, sub_eq_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, hb, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  
  have := weightProj_mem_serreSpan D _ (serreAssocIdeal_le_span_serreWord D hz) ν
  rwa [map_sub, map_sum, weightProj_self hy,
    Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ weightProj_mul_ι_pow (by have := hν i; omega) _,
    sub_zero] at this

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma wordBasis_apply (w : List X) : wordBasis R X w = (w.map (ι R)).prod
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordBasis, basisFreeMonoid, equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid, FreeMonoid.lift_apply]

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordBasis_nil : wordBasis R X [] = 1
proof: := by simp

name: FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis
statement:
lemma ι_mul_wordBasis (x : X) (w : List X) :
    ι R x * wordBasis R X w = wordBasis R X (x :: w)
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_append
statement:
lemma wordBasis_append (w w' : List X) :
    wordBasis R X (w ++ w') = wordBasis R X w * wordBasis R X w'
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: FreeAlgebra.span_wordBasis
statement: lemma span_wordBasis : Submodule.span R (Set.range (wordBasis R X)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (wordBasis R X).span_eq

name: FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis
statement:
theorem induction_wordBasis {P : FreeAlgebra R X → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (smul : ∀ (c : R) x, P x → P (c • x))
    (word : ∀ w, P (wordBasis R X w)) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) : P x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (wordBasis R X)) := by
    rw [span_wordBasis]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy; exact word w
  | zero => exact zero
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add y z hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => exact smul c y hy

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_ι
statement: @[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_ι (x : X) : mapCoeffs φ (ι R x) = ι S x
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapCoeffs]

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_algebraMap (c : R) :
    mapCoeffs φ (algebraMap R (FreeAlgebra R X) c) = algebraMap S _ (φ c)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra R (FreeAlgebra S X) := Algebra.compHom (FreeAlgebra S X) φ
  exact (lift R (ι S)).commutes c

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_smul
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_smul (c : R) (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (c • x) = φ c • mapCoeffs φ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, mapCoeffs_algebraMap, ← Algebra.smul_def]

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_wordBasis (w : List X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (wordBasis R X w) = wordBasis S X w
proof:
:= by
  simp [map_list_prod, Function.comp_def]

name: FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_eq_sum
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_eq_sum (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ x = ((wordBasis R X).repr x).sum fun w c ↦ φ c • wordBasis S X w
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← (wordBasis R X).linearCombination_repr x]
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, Finsupp.sum]
  simp only [mapCoeffs_smul, mapCoeffs_wordBasis]

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_repr_mapCoeffs
statement:
theorem wordBasis_repr_mapCoeffs (x : FreeAlgebra R X) (w : List X) :
    (wordBasis S X).repr (mapCoeffs φ x) w = φ ((wordBasis R X).repr x w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mapCoeffs_eq_sum, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  simp only [map_smul, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 h, map_zero]

name: FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv_mapCoeffs
statement:
theorem algebraMapInv_mapCoeffs (x : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    algebraMapInv (mapCoeffs φ x) = φ (algebraMapInv x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [mapCoeffs_algebraMap]
    simp [algebraMapInv]
  | grade1 x => simp [algebraMapInv]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma wordBasis_mem_wordSpan (w : List X) :
    wordBasis R X w ∈ wordSpan R (LusztigF.wordWeight w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBasis_apply]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩

name: FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq
statement:
lemma wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq {w : List X} {μ : X →₀ ℕ} (h : LusztigF.wordWeight w = μ) :
    wordBasis R X w ∈ wordSpan R μ
proof:
:=
  h ▸ wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w

name: FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction
statement:
theorem wordSpan_induction {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {P : (x : FreeAlgebra R X) → x ∈ wordSpan R μ → Prop}
    (word : ∀ w (hw : LusztigF.wordWeight w = μ),
      P (wordBasis R X w) (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq hw))
    (zero : P 0 (zero_mem _))
    (add : ∀ x y hx hy, P x hx → P y hy → P (x + y) (add_mem hx hy))
    (smul : ∀ (c : R) x hx, P x hx → P (c • x) (Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx))
    {x : FreeAlgebra R X} (hx : x ∈ wordSpan R μ) : P x hx
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    have := word w hw
    simpa using this
  | zero => exact zero
  | add y z hy hz ihy ihz => exact add y z hy hz ihy ihz
  | smul c y hy ih => exact smul c y hy ih

name: FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma ι_mul_mem_wordSpan (x : X) {μ : X →₀ ℕ} {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    ι R x * y ∈ wordSpan R (Finsupp.single x 1 + μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  | word w hw =>
    rw [ι_mul_wordBasis]
    exact wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq (by rw [LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, hw])

name: FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv_eq_zero_of_mem_wordSpan
statement:
lemma algebraMapInv_eq_zero_of_mem_wordSpan {μ : X →₀ ℕ} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {y : FreeAlgebra R X}
    (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) : algebraMapInv y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]
  | word w hw =>
    cases w with
    | nil => exact absurd hw.symm (by simpa using hμ)
    | cons x w => simp [algebraMapInv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_of_sq_eq_one
statement:
theorem qBinomial_of_sq_eq_one {ε : k} (hε : ε ^ 2 = 1) (n j : ℕ) :
    qBinomial ε n j = ε ^ (j * (n - j)) * n.choose j
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : ε⁻¹ = ε := by
    exact inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (by rw [← sq, hε])
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => cases j <;> simp [qBinomial]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j =>
      rw [qBinomial_succ_succ, ih, ih, hinv]
      rcases lt_trichotomy (j + 1) (n + 1) with h | h | h
      · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, n = j + 1 + t := ⟨n - (j + 1), by omega⟩
        rw [show j + 1 + t - (j + 1) = t by omega, show j + 1 + t - j = t + 1 by omega,
          show j + 1 + t + 1 - (j + 1) = t + 1 by omega, Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.cast_add,
          ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_add,
          show j + 1 + (j + 1) * t = (j + 1) * (t + 1) by ring,
          show t + 1 + j * (t + 1) = (j + 1) * (t + 1) by ring]
        ring
      · obtain rfl : j = n := by omega
        simp
      · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega), Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega),
          Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)]
        simp

name: LusztigF.signWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma signWord_nil : signWord σ [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.signWord_cons
statement:
lemma signWord_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    signWord σ (i :: w) = (w.map (σ i)).prod * signWord σ w
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.signWord_append
statement:
lemma signWord_append (u w : List I) :
    signWord σ (u ++ w) = signWord σ u * signWord σ w * signCross σ u w
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [signCross]
  | cons i u ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, signWord_cons, ih, signCross, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
      List.map_append, List.prod_append]
    ring

name: LusztigF.signCross_perm_right
statement:
lemma signCross_perm_right {u w w' : List I} (h : w.Perm w') :
    signCross σ u w = signCross σ u w'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [signCross]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun a _ ↦ (h.map (σ a)).prod_eq

name: LusztigF.signCross_perm_left
statement:
lemma signCross_perm_left {u u' w : List I} (h : u.Perm u') :
    signCross σ u w = signCross σ u' w
proof:
:=
  (h.map _).prod_eq

name: LusztigF.sq_prod_map
statement: lemma sq_prod_map {l : List I} {f : I → K} (hf : ∀ i, f i ^ 2 = 1) : (l.map f).prod ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i l ih => rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_pow, hf, ih, one_mul]

name: LusztigF.signWord_sq
statement: lemma signWord_sq (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1) (w : List I) : signWord σ w ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih => rw [signWord_cons, mul_pow, sq_prod_map (hσ i), ih, one_mul]

name: LusztigF.signCross_sq
statement: lemma signCross_sq (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1) (u w : List I) : signCross σ u w ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  sq_prod_map fun a ↦ sq_prod_map (hσ a)

name: LusztigF.signWord_replicate
statement:
lemma signWord_replicate (hσ : ∀ i, σ i i = 1) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    signWord σ (List.replicate n i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate_succ, signWord_cons, ih, hσ]

name: LusztigF.signWord_serre
statement:
lemma signWord_serre (hσ : ∀ i, σ i i = 1) (i j : I) (m r : ℕ) :
    signWord σ (List.replicate (m - r) i ++ j :: List.replicate r i) =
      σ i j ^ (m - r) * σ j i ^ r
proof:
:= by
  simp [signWord_append, signWord_replicate hσ, signWord_cons, signCross, List.map_replicate,
    List.prod_replicate, hσ]
  ring

name: LusztigF.signTwist_wordBasis
statement:
lemma signTwist_wordBasis (w : List I) :
    signTwist σ (wordBasis K I w) = signWord σ w • wordBasis K I w
proof:
:=
  (wordBasis K I).constr_basis K _ w

name: LusztigF.signTwist_signTwist
statement:
lemma signTwist_signTwist (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1) (x : LusztigF K I) :
    signTwist σ (signTwist σ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have : signTwist σ ∘ₗ signTwist σ = LinearMap.id :=
    (wordBasis K I).ext fun w ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, signTwist_wordBasis, map_smul, signTwist_wordBasis, smul_smul,
        ← sq, signWord_sq hσ, one_smul, LinearMap.id_apply]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this x

name: LusztigF.pow_mul_mul_pow
statement:
lemma pow_mul_mul_pow (i j : I) (m r : ℕ) :
    θ K i ^ (m - r) * θ K j * θ K i ^ r =
      wordBasis K I (List.replicate (m - r) i ++ j :: List.replicate r i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.prod_replicate, mul_assoc]

name: LusztigF.signTwist_serreProduct
statement:
lemma signTwist_serreProduct {q : I → K} (hq : ∀ i, q i ^ 2 = 1) (hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1)
    (hσd : ∀ i, σ i i = 1)
    (hσq : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → σ i j * σ j i = q i ^ (serreExp D i j - 1))
    {g : List I × I × I × List I} (hg : g.2.1 ≠ g.2.2.1) :
    ∃ s : K, s ≠ 0 ∧ signTwist σ (serreProduct D q g) =
      s • serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, i, j, b⟩ := g
  simp only at hg
  set m := serreExp D i j
  set w : ℕ → List I := fun r ↦ List.replicate (m - r) i ++ j :: List.replicate r i
  have key : ∀ r, r ≤ m → (w r).Perm (j :: List.replicate m i) := fun r hr ↦
    List.perm_middle.trans (by rw [← List.replicate_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr])
  have hperm : ∀ r, r ≤ m → (w r).Perm (w 0) := fun r hr ↦
    (key r hr).trans (key 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).symm
  set κ := signWord σ a * signWord σ b * signCross σ a (w 0) * signCross σ (a ++ w 0) b
  have hsign : ∀ r, r ≤ m → signWord σ (a ++ w r ++ b) = κ * (σ i j ^ (m - r) * σ j i ^ r) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [signWord_append, signWord_append, signCross_perm_right σ (hperm r hr),
      signCross_perm_left σ ((hperm r hr).append_left a), signWord_serre hσd]
    ring
  have hsq : ∀ x : K, x ^ 2 = 1 → x ≠ 0 := fun x hx h ↦ by simp [h] at hx
  refine ⟨κ * σ i j ^ m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine hsq _ ?_
    simp only [κ, mul_pow, signWord_sq hσ, signCross_sq hσ, one_mul]
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, hσ, one_pow]
  have hexp : ∀ r, r ≤ m → q i ^ (r * (m - r)) * (σ i j ^ (m - r) * σ j i ^ r) = σ i j ^ m := by
    intro r hr
    have h1 : σ i j ^ (m - r) * σ j i ^ r = σ i j ^ m * (σ i j * σ j i) ^ r := by
      have : σ i j ^ m = σ i j ^ (m - r) * σ i j ^ r := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]
      rw [this, mul_pow, show σ i j ^ (m - r) * σ i j ^ r * (σ i j ^ r * σ j i ^ r) =
        σ i j ^ (m - r) * (σ i j ^ 2) ^ r * σ j i ^ r by ring, hσ, one_pow, mul_one]
    have h2 : q i ^ (r * (m - r)) * q i ^ ((m - 1) * r) = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_add]
      suffices h : Even (r * (m - r) + (m - 1) * r) by
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
        rw [ht, ← two_mul, pow_mul, hq, one_pow]
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd r with ⟨s, hs⟩ | ⟨s, hs⟩
      · exact ⟨s * (m - r) + (m - 1) * s, by subst hs; ring⟩
      · refine ⟨r * (m - s - 1), ?_⟩
        have : m - r + (m - 1) = 2 * (m - s - 1) := by omega
        rw [mul_comm (m - 1) r, ← mul_add, this]; ring
    rw [h1, hσq i j hg, ← pow_mul]
    linear_combination (σ i j ^ m) * h2
  simp only [serreProduct, serreWord, qSerre, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum,
    Finset.smul_sum, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr : r ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hr)
  rw [pow_mul_mul_pow, ← wordBasis_append, ← wordBasis_append, signTwist_wordBasis,
    hsign r hr, smul_smul, smul_smul, qBinomial_of_sq_eq_one (hq i), qBinomial_one]
  congr 1
  rw [← hexp r hr]
  ring

name: LusztigF.finrank_serreSpan_of_sq_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_serreSpan_of_sq_eq_one {q : I → K} (hq : ∀ i, q i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hsym : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → q i ^ (serreExp D i j - 1) = q j ^ (serreExp D j i - 1))
    (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Module.finrank K (serreSpan D q ν) = Module.finrank K (serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : LinearOrder I := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  set σ : I → I → K := fun i j ↦ if i < j then q i ^ (serreExp D i j - 1) else 1
  have hσ : ∀ i j, σ i j ^ 2 = 1 := fun i j ↦ by
    simp only [σ]; split_ifs
    · rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, hq, one_pow]
    · exact one_pow 2
  have hσd : ∀ i, σ i i = 1 := fun i ↦ by simp [σ]
  have hσq : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → σ i j * σ j i = q i ^ (serreExp D i j - 1) := fun i j hij ↦ by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
    · simp [σ, h, h.not_gt]
    · simp [σ, h, h.not_gt, hsym i j hij]
  let T : LusztigF K I ≃ₗ[K] LusztigF K I :=
    LinearEquiv.ofInvolutive (signTwist σ) (signTwist_signTwist hσ)
  have hmap : (serreSpan D q ν).map (T : LusztigF K I →ₗ[K] LusztigF K I) =
      serreSpan D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) ν := by
    rw [serreSpan, Submodule.map_span]
    refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨s, -, hs⟩ := signTwist_serreProduct D hq hσ hσd hσq hg.1
      change signTwist σ _ ∈ _
      rw [hs]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩)
    · rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs⟩ := signTwist_serreProduct D hq hσ hσd hσq hg.1
      have : serreProduct D (fun _ ↦ (1 : K)) g = s⁻¹ • T (serreProduct D q g) := by
        change _ = s⁻¹ • signTwist σ _
        rw [hs, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs0, one_smul]
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
  rw [← hmap, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_wordBasis
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistVermaOp_wordBasis (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    twistVermaOp i s c (wordBasis R X w) = twistVermaOpWord i s c w
proof:
:=
  (wordBasis R X).constr_basis R _ w

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistVermaOp_one (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) :
    twistVermaOp i s c 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordBasis_nil, twistVermaOp_wordBasis, twistVermaOpWord]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_ι_mul
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_ι_mul (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (j : X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaOp i s c (ι R j * y) =
      s j • (ι R j * twistVermaOp i s c y) + if i = j then weightScale c y else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz =>
    rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add, mul_add, smul_add]
    split_ifs
    · rw [map_add]; abel
    · simp only [add_zero]
  | smul a y hy =>
    rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hy, map_smul, smul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_comm a (s j)]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | word w =>
    rw [ι_mul_wordBasis, twistVermaOp_wordBasis, twistVermaOp_wordBasis, twistVermaOpWord,
      weightScale_wordBasis]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_one_sign
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_one_sign (i : X) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) :
    twistVermaOp i (fun _ ↦ 1) c = vermaOp i c
proof:
:= by
  refine (wordBasis R X).ext fun w ↦ ?_
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, twistVermaOp_ι_mul, ih, vermaOp_ι_mul, one_smul]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem twistVermaOp_mul_coeff (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (κ : R) :
    twistVermaOp i s (fun μ ↦ κ * c μ) = κ • twistVermaOp i s c
proof:
:= by
  refine (wordBasis R X).ext fun w ↦ ?_
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [← ι_mul_wordBasis, twistVermaOp_ι_mul, ih, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      twistVermaOp_ι_mul, weightScale_wordBasis, weightScale_wordBasis, smul_add, mul_smul_comm,
      smul_comm κ (s j)]
    split_ifs <;> simp [mul_smul]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistVermaWordOp_nil (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_cons
statement:
lemma twistVermaWordOp_cons (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c (i :: w) y = twistVermaWordOp s c w (twistVermaOp i (s i) (c i) y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LusztigF.twistVermaForm_apply
statement:
lemma twistVermaForm_apply (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaForm s c w y = algebraMapInv (twistVermaWordOp s c w y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.twistVermaForm_cons
statement:
lemma twistVermaForm_cons (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (i : X) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaForm s c (i :: w) y = twistVermaForm s c w (twistVermaOp i (s i) (c i) y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.twistVermaForm_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem twistVermaForm_mul_coeff (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (κ : X → R)
    (w : List X) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    twistVermaForm s (fun i μ ↦ κ i * c i μ) w y = (w.map κ).prod * twistVermaForm s c w y
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing y with
  | nil => simp [twistVermaForm_apply]
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [twistVermaForm_cons, twistVermaOp_mul_coeff, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, ih,
      twistVermaForm_cons, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_twistVermaOpWord
statement:
lemma mapCoeffs_twistVermaOpWord (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
