    mapCoeffs φ (twistVermaOpWord i s c w) = twistVermaOpWord i (φ ∘ s) (φ ∘ c) w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [twistVermaOpWord]
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [twistVermaOpWord, map_add, mapCoeffs_smul, map_mul, mapCoeffs_ι, ih,
      Function.comp_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp [mapCoeffs_smul, map_list_prod, Function.comp_def]

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_twistVermaOp
statement:
theorem mapCoeffs_twistVermaOp (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (twistVermaOp i s c y) = twistVermaOp i (φ ∘ s) (φ ∘ c) (mapCoeffs φ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add, map_add]
  | smul a y hy => rw [map_smul, mapCoeffs_smul, hy, mapCoeffs_smul, map_smul]
  | word w =>
    rw [twistVermaOp_wordBasis, mapCoeffs_twistVermaOpWord, mapCoeffs_wordBasis,
      twistVermaOp_wordBasis]

name: LusztigF.mapCoeffs_twistVermaWordOp
statement:
theorem mapCoeffs_twistVermaWordOp (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    mapCoeffs φ (twistVermaWordOp s c w y) =
      twistVermaWordOp (fun i ↦ φ ∘ s i) (fun i ↦ φ ∘ c i) w (mapCoeffs φ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing y with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [twistVermaWordOp_cons, ih, mapCoeffs_twistVermaOp, twistVermaWordOp_cons]

name: LusztigF.map_twistVermaForm
statement:
theorem map_twistVermaForm (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (y : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    φ (twistVermaForm s c w y) =
      twistVermaForm (fun i ↦ φ ∘ s i) (fun i ↦ φ ∘ c i) w (mapCoeffs φ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistVermaForm_apply, twistVermaForm_apply, ← mapCoeffs_twistVermaWordOp,
    algebraMapInv_mapCoeffs]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOpWord_eq_zero
statement:
lemma twistVermaOpWord_eq_zero (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    (hw : wordWeight w i = 0) : twistVermaOpWord i s c w = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j w ih =>
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; simp at hw
    have hw' : wordWeight w i = 0 := by
      simp only [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.add_apply] at hw; omega
    simp [twistVermaOpWord, ih hw', hij]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOpWord_mem
statement:
lemma twistVermaOpWord_mem (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) :
    twistVermaOpWord i s c w ∈ wordSpan R (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [twistVermaOpWord]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [twistVermaOpWord]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_) ?_
    · by_cases hwi : wordWeight w i = 0
      · rw [twistVermaOpWord_eq_zero i s c w hwi, mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      · have h := ι_mul_mem_wordSpan (R := R) j ih
        convert h using 2
        rw [wordWeight_cons]
        ext l
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> omega
    · split_ifs with hij
      · subst hij
        refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (wordBasis_mem_wordSpan_of_eq ?_)
        rw [wordWeight_cons, add_comm, add_tsub_cancel_right]
      · exact zero_mem _

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_mem_wordSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [twistVermaOp_wordBasis, ← hw]; exact twistVermaOpWord_mem i s c w
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.twistVermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma twistVermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem (i : X) (s : X → R) (c : (X →₀ ℕ) → R) {μ : X →₀ ℕ}
    (hμ : μ i = 0) {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) : twistVermaOp i s c y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw => rw [twistVermaOp_wordBasis, twistVermaOpWord_eq_zero i s c w (hw ▸ hμ)]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_mem
statement:
lemma twistVermaWordOp_mem (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X) {μ : X →₀ ℕ}
    {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c w y ∈ wordSpan R (μ - wordWeight w) ∧
      (¬ wordWeight w ≤ μ → twistVermaWordOp s c w y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing μ y with
  | nil => simpa using hy
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [twistVermaWordOp_cons]
    by_cases hμi : μ i = 0
    · rw [twistVermaOp_eq_zero_of_mem i (s i) (c i) hμi hy, map_zero]
      exact ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (twistVermaOp_mem_wordSpan i (s i) (c i) hy)
      have e : μ - Finsupp.single i 1 - wordWeight w = μ - wordWeight (i :: w) := by
        rw [wordWeight_cons, tsub_tsub]
      refine ⟨e ▸ h1, fun h ↦ h2 fun hle ↦ h ?_⟩
      rw [wordWeight_cons, ← single_add_tsub_single hμi, add_comm (Finsupp.single i 1)]
      exact add_le_add_left hle _

name: LusztigF.twistVermaForm_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem twistVermaForm_eq_zero_of_ne (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    {μ : X →₀ ℕ} (hμ : wordWeight w ≠ μ) {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R μ) :
    twistVermaForm s c w y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := twistVermaWordOp_mem s c w hy
  rw [twistVermaForm_apply]
  by_cases hle : wordWeight w ≤ μ
  · refine algebraMapInv_eq_zero_of_mem_wordSpan (fun h0 ↦ hμ ?_) h1
    exact le_antisymm hle (tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.1 h0)
  · rw [h2 hle, map_zero]

name: LusztigF.eq_algebraMap_of_mem_wordSpan_zero
statement:
lemma eq_algebraMap_of_mem_wordSpan_zero {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R 0) :
    y = algebraMap R _ (algebraMapInv y)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw =>
    cases w with
    | nil => simp
    | cons j w => simp [wordWeight_cons] at hw
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, map_add, ← hy, ← hz]
  | smul a y _ hy =>
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ← hy, Algebra.smul_def]

name: LusztigF.twistVermaWordOp_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem twistVermaWordOp_eq_algebraMap (s : X → X → R) (c : X → (X →₀ ℕ) → R) (w : List X)
    {y : FreeAlgebra R X} (hy : y ∈ wordSpan R (wordWeight w)) :
    twistVermaWordOp s c w y = algebraMap R _ (twistVermaForm s c w y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (twistVermaWordOp_mem s c w hy).1
  rw [tsub_self] at h
  exact eq_algebraMap_of_mem_wordSpan_zero h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntegrable_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem isIntegrable_dfinsupp (hM : ∀ i, IsIntegrable R v (M i)) :
    IsIntegrable R v (Π₀ i, M i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have nil : ∀ (X : QuantumGroup R v), (∀ i (m : M i), ∃ n : ℕ, X ^ n • m = 0) →
      ∀ m : Π₀ i, M i, ∃ n : ℕ, X ^ n • m = 0 := fun X hX m ↦ by
    induction m using DFinsupp.induction with
    | h0 => exact ⟨0, smul_zero _⟩
    | ha i b f _ _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ := hX i b
      obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨n₁ + n₂, ?_⟩
      have h1 : X ^ n₁ • DFinsupp.single i b = 0 := by
        rw [← DFinsupp.lsingle_apply (R := QuantumGroup R v), ← map_smul, hn₁, map_zero]
      have e1 : X ^ (n₁ + n₂) • DFinsupp.single i b = 0 := by
        rw [add_comm, pow_add, mul_smul, h1, smul_zero]
      have e2 : X ^ (n₁ + n₂) • f = 0 := by rw [pow_add, mul_smul, hn₂, smul_zero]
      rw [smul_add, e1, e2, add_zero]
  refine ⟨eq_top_iff.2 fun m _ ↦ ?_, fun i ↦ nil _ fun j ↦ (hM j).exists_E_pow_smul_eq_zero i,
    fun i ↦ nil _ fun j ↦ (hM j).exists_F_pow_smul_eq_zero i⟩
  induction m using DFinsupp.induction with
  | h0 => exact zero_mem _
  | ha i b f _ _ ih =>
    refine add_mem ?_ (ih trivial)
    have hb : b ∈ ⨆ Λ, weightSpace R v (M i) Λ := (hM i).iSup_weightSpace_eq_top ▸ trivial
    have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem
      (f := ((DFinsupp.lsingle (R := QuantumGroup R v) (M := M) i).restrictScalars k)) hb
    rw [Submodule.map_iSup] at this
    refine SetLike.le_def.1 (iSup_mono fun Λ ↦ ?_) this
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_weightSpace _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_dfinsuppLattice
statement: lemma mem_dfinsuppLattice {m : Π₀ j, M j} : m ∈ dfinsuppLattice L ↔ ∀ j, m j ∈ L j
proof:
:= by
  simp [dfinsuppLattice]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.single_mem_dfinsuppLattice
statement:
lemma single_mem_dfinsuppLattice {j : ι} {x : M j} (hx : x ∈ L j) :
    DFinsupp.single j x ∈ dfinsuppLattice L
proof:
:= mem_dfinsuppLattice.2 fun l ↦ by
  rw [DFinsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact hx
  · exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coe_dfinsuppLatticeIncl
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_dfinsuppLatticeIncl (j : ι) (x : L j) :
    (dfinsuppLatticeIncl L j x : Π₀ j, M j) = DFinsupp.single j (x : M j)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coe_dfinsuppLatticeProj
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_dfinsuppLatticeProj (j : ι) (x : dfinsuppLattice L) :
    (dfinsuppLatticeProj L j x : M j) = (x : Π₀ j, M j) j
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppLatticeProj_incl_self
statement:
lemma dfinsuppLatticeProj_incl_self (j : ι) (x : L j) :
    dfinsuppLatticeProj L j (dfinsuppLatticeIncl L j x) = x
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by simp)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppLatticeProj_incl_of_ne
statement:
lemma dfinsuppLatticeProj_incl_of_ne {j l : ι} (h : j ≠ l) (x : L j) :
    dfinsuppLatticeProj L l (dfinsuppLatticeIncl L j x) = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by simp [DFinsupp.single_apply, h])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_eq_sum_dfinsuppLatticeIncl
statement:
lemma exists_eq_sum_dfinsuppLatticeIncl (x : dfinsuppLattice L) :
    ∃ s : Finset ι, x = ∑ j ∈ s, dfinsuppLatticeIncl L j (dfinsuppLatticeProj L j x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(x : Π₀ j, M j).support, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [Submodule.coe_sum]
  simp only [coe_dfinsuppLatticeIncl, coe_dfinsuppLatticeProj]
  exact (x : Π₀ j, M j).sum_single.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppLatticeProj_lsum
statement:
lemma dfinsuppLatticeProj_lsum (l : ι) (y : Π₀ j, L j) :
    dfinsuppLatticeProj L l (DFinsupp.lsum ℕ (dfinsuppLatticeIncl L) y) = y l
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DFinsupp.induction with
  | h0 => simp
  | ha j b f _ _ ih =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, ih, DFinsupp.lsum_single, DFinsupp.add_apply]
    congr 1
    by_cases h : j = l
    · subst h; rw [dfinsuppLatticeProj_incl_self, DFinsupp.single_eq_same]
    · rw [dfinsuppLatticeProj_incl_of_ne L h]
      simp [DFinsupp.single_apply, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.smul_top_le_comap
statement:
lemma smul_top_le_comap {P P' : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P] [AddCommGroup P']
    [Module A P'] (f : P →ₗ[A] P') :
    (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A P) ≤ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A P').comap f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, Submodule.map_smul'']
  exact Submodule.smul_mono le_rfl le_top

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self
statement:
lemma dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self (j : ι) (b) :
    dfinsuppQuotProj L c j (dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j b) = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ b
  simp [dfinsuppQuotProj, dfinsuppQuotIncl, dfinsuppLatticeProj_incl_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_of_ne
statement:
lemma dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_of_ne {j l : ι} (h : j ≠ l) (b) :
    dfinsuppQuotProj L c l (dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppQuotIncl_injective
statement: lemma dfinsuppQuotIncl_injective (j : ι) : Function.Injective (dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self L c j)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mk_eq_sum_dfinsuppQuotIncl
statement:
lemma mk_eq_sum_dfinsuppQuotIncl (x : dfinsuppLattice L) : ∃ s : Finset ι,
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : dfinsuppLattice L ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A _)) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j (Submodule.Quotient.mk (dfinsuppLatticeProj L j x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_eq_sum_dfinsuppLatticeIncl L x
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [hs]
  simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, map_sum]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppQuotIncl'_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dfinsuppQuotIncl'_apply (j : ι) (b) :
    dfinsuppQuotIncl' L c j b = dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j b
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dfinsuppQuotProj'_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dfinsuppQuotProj'_apply (j : ι) (b) :
    dfinsuppQuotProj' L c j b = dfinsuppQuotProj L c j b
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_dfinsuppQuotIncl
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_dfinsuppQuotIncl
    {B : ∀ j, Set (L j ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A (L j)))}
    (hB : ∀ j, LinearIndependent (A ⧸ Ideal.span {c}) (Subtype.val : B j → _)) :
    LinearIndependent (A ⧸ Ideal.span {c}) fun x : Σ j, B j ↦ dfinsuppQuotIncl L c x.1 x.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  rintro s g hs ⟨l, b⟩ hx
  have h := congrArg (dfinsuppQuotProj' L c l) hs
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h
  have hG : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∉ Set.range (Sigma.mk (β := fun j ↦ B j) l) →
      dfinsuppQuotProj' L c l (g x • dfinsuppQuotIncl L c x.1 x.2) = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨j, b'⟩ - hj
    have hjl : j ≠ l := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hj ⟨b', rfl⟩
    rw [map_smul, dfinsuppQuotProj'_apply, dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_of_ne L c hjl, smul_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_preimage (Sigma.mk (β := fun j ↦ B j) l) s sigma_mk_injective.injOn _ hG] at h
  simp only [map_smul, dfinsuppQuotProj'_apply, dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self] at h
  exact linearIndependent_iff'.1 (hB l) _ _ h b (Finset.mem_preimage.2 hx)
