name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalLattice.dfinsupp
statement:
theorem IsCrystalLattice.dfinsupp (hL : ∀ j, IsCrystalLattice hv (hM j) (L j)) :
    IsCrystalLattice hv (isIntegrable_dfinsupp hM) (dfinsuppLattice L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := fun j ↦ (hL j).free
  refine
    { span_eq_top := eq_top_iff.2 fun m _ ↦ ?_
      free := Module.Free.of_equiv (dfinsuppLatticeEquiv L)
      weightSetProj_mem := fun S m hm ↦ mem_dfinsuppLattice.2 fun j ↦ ?_
      kashiwaraE_mem := fun i m hm ↦ mem_dfinsuppLattice.2 fun j ↦ ?_
      kashiwaraF_mem := fun i m hm ↦ mem_dfinsuppLattice.2 fun j ↦ ?_ }
  · classical
    induction m using DFinsupp.induction with
    | h0 => exact zero_mem _
    | ha j b f _ _ ih =>
      refine add_mem ?_ (ih trivial)
      have hb : b ∈ Submodule.span k (L j : Set (M j)) := (hL j).span_eq_top ▸ trivial
      have h := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := DFinsupp.lsingle (R := k) (M := M) j) hb
      rw [Submodule.map_span] at h
      refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ h
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact single_mem_dfinsuppLattice hx
  · rw [weightSetProj_dfinsupp_apply]
    exact (hL j).weightSetProj_mem S _ (mem_dfinsuppLattice.1 hm j)
  · rw [kashiwaraE_dfinsupp_apply]
    exact (hL j).kashiwaraE_mem i _ (mem_dfinsuppLattice.1 hm j)
  · rw [kashiwaraF_dfinsupp_apply]
    exact (hL j).kashiwaraF_mem i _ (mem_dfinsuppLattice.1 hm j)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalLattice.of_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem IsCrystalLattice.of_dfinsupp
    (hLs : IsCrystalLattice hv (isIntegrable_dfinsupp hM) (dfinsuppLattice L))
    (hfree : ∀ j, Module.Free A (L j)) (j : ι) : IsCrystalLattice hv (hM j) (L j) where
  span_eq_top
proof:
:= by
    classical
    have h := congrArg (Submodule.map (DFinsupp.lapply (R := k) (M := M) j)) hLs.span_eq_top
    rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top,
      LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 fun m ↦ ⟨DFinsupp.single j m, by simp⟩] at h
    refine eq_top_iff.2 (h ▸ Submodule.span_mono ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact mem_dfinsuppLattice.1 hx j
  free := hfree j
  weightSetProj_mem S m hm := by
    classical
    have h := mem_dfinsuppLattice.1 (hLs.weightSetProj_mem S _ (single_mem_dfinsuppLattice hm)) j
    rwa [weightSetProj_dfinsupp_apply, DFinsupp.single_eq_same] at h
  kashiwaraE_mem i m hm := by
    classical
    have h := mem_dfinsuppLattice.1 (hLs.kashiwaraE_mem i _ (single_mem_dfinsuppLattice hm)) j
    rwa [kashiwaraE_dfinsupp_apply, DFinsupp.single_eq_same] at h
  kashiwaraF_mem i m hm := by
    classical
    have h := mem_dfinsuppLattice.1 (hLs.kashiwaraF_mem i _ (single_mem_dfinsuppLattice hm)) j
    rwa [kashiwaraF_dfinsupp_apply, DFinsupp.single_eq_same] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalLattice.eQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl
statement:
lemma IsCrystalLattice.eQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl
    (hLs : IsCrystalLattice hv (isIntegrable_dfinsupp hM) (dfinsuppLattice L))
    (hL : ∀ j, IsCrystalLattice hv (hM j) (L j)) (c : A) (i : I) (j : ι) (b) :
    hLs.eQ c i (dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j b) = dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j ((hL j).eQ c i b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ b
  exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk
    (Subtype.ext
      (map_kashiwaraE hv (hM j) i (isIntegrable_dfinsupp hM) (DFinsupp.lsingle j) x).symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalLattice.fQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl
statement:
lemma IsCrystalLattice.fQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl
    (hLs : IsCrystalLattice hv (isIntegrable_dfinsupp hM) (dfinsuppLattice L))
    (hL : ∀ j, IsCrystalLattice hv (hM j) (L j)) (c : A) (i : I) (j : ι) (b) :
    hLs.fQ c i (dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j b) = dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j ((hL j).fQ c i b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ b
  exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk
    (Subtype.ext
      (map_kashiwaraF hv (hM j) i (isIntegrable_dfinsupp hM) (DFinsupp.lsingle j) x).symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.dfinsupp
statement:
theorem IsCrystalBase.dfinsupp {hL : ∀ j, IsCrystalLattice hv (hM j) (L j)} (hc : ¬IsUnit c)
    {B : ∀ j, Set (L j ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A (L j)))}
    (hB : ∀ j, IsCrystalBase (hL j) c (B j)) :
    IsCrystalBase (IsCrystalLattice.dfinsupp hL) c (dfinsuppBase L c B)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (A ⧸ Ideal.span {c}) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by rwa [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top])
  have hQe := (IsCrystalLattice.dfinsupp hL).eQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl hL c
  have hQf := (IsCrystalLattice.dfinsupp hL).fQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl hL c
  have hinj := dfinsuppQuotIncl_injective L c
  
  have hFi := linearIndependent_dfinsuppQuotIncl L c fun j ↦ (hB j).linearIndependent
  have hrange : Set.range (fun x : Σ j, B j ↦ dfinsuppQuotIncl L c x.1 x.2) =
      dfinsuppBase L c B := by
    refine Set.ext fun b ↦ ⟨?_, fun hb ↦ ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨j, b', hb'⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, b', hb', rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, b', hb', rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hb
      exact ⟨⟨j, b', hb'⟩, rfl⟩
  refine
    { linearIndependent := ?_
      span_eq_top := eq_top_iff.2 fun b _ ↦ ?_
      exists_weight := ?_
      eQ_mem := ?_
      fQ_mem := ?_
      fQ_eq_iff := ?_ }
  · rw [← hrange]
    exact (linearIndepOn_id_range_iff hFi.injective).2 hFi
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ b
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := mk_eq_sum_dfinsuppQuotIncl L c x
    rw [hs]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ ?_
    have hb : Submodule.Quotient.mk (dfinsuppLatticeProj L j x) ∈
        Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {c}) (B j) := (hB j).span_eq_top ▸ trivial
    have h := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := dfinsuppQuotIncl' L c j) hb
    rw [Submodule.map_span] at h
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ h
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, y, hy, rfl⟩
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨j, b₀, hb₀, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hb
    obtain ⟨Λ, x, hx, hxb⟩ := (hB j).exists_weight b₀ hb₀
    refine ⟨Λ, dfinsuppLatticeIncl L j x, map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lsingle j) hx, ?_⟩
    rw [← hxb]
    rfl
  · intro i b hb
    obtain ⟨j, b₀, hb₀, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hb
    rw [hQe]
    rcases (hB j).eQ_mem i b₀ hb₀ with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, _, h, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [h, map_zero])
  · intro i b hb
    obtain ⟨j, b₀, hb₀, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hb
    rw [hQf]
    rcases (hB j).fQ_mem i b₀ hb₀ with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, _, h, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [h, map_zero])
  · intro i b hb b' hb'
    obtain ⟨j, b₀, hb₀, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hb
    obtain ⟨l, b₁, hb₁, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hb'
    rw [hQf, hQe]
    by_cases h : j = l
    · subst h
      rw [(hinj j).eq_iff, (hinj j).eq_iff]
      exact (hB j).fQ_eq_iff i b₀ hb₀ b₁ hb₁
    · refine iff_of_false (fun H ↦ ?_) (fun H ↦ ?_)
      · have := congrArg (dfinsuppQuotProj L c l) H
        rw [dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_of_ne L c h, dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self] at this
        exact (hB l).zero_notMem hc (this ▸ hb₁)
      · have := congrArg (dfinsuppQuotProj L c j) H
        rw [dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_of_ne L c (Ne.symm h), dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self] at this
        exact (hB j).zero_notMem hc (this ▸ hb₀)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.of_dfinsupp
proof:
:= by
  have hQe := hLs.eQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl (hLs.of_dfinsupp hM hfree) c
  have hQf := hLs.fQ_dfinsuppQuotIncl (hLs.of_dfinsupp hM hfree) c
  have hinj := dfinsuppQuotIncl_injective L c j
  have hmem : ∀ b ∈ B j, dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j b ∈ dfinsuppBase L c B :=
    fun b hb ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, b, hb, rfl⟩
  have hback : ∀ y, dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j y ∈ dfinsuppBase L c B → y ∈ B j ∨ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨l, b, hb, he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
    by_cases h : l = j
    · subst h
      exact Or.inl (hinj he ▸ hb)
    · have := congrArg (dfinsuppQuotProj L c j) he
      rw [dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_of_ne L c h, dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self] at this
      exact Or.inr this.symm
  refine
    { linearIndependent := ?_
      span_eq_top := eq_top_iff.2 fun b _ ↦ ?_
      exists_weight := fun b hb ↦ ?_
      eQ_mem := fun i b hb ↦ ?_
      fQ_mem := fun i b hb ↦ ?_
      fQ_eq_iff := fun i b hb b' hb' ↦ ?_ }
  · have := hB.linearIndependent.comp (fun b : B j ↦ ⟨_, hmem b b.2⟩)
      fun b₁ b₂ h ↦ Subtype.ext (hinj (congrArg Subtype.val h))
    exact this.of_comp (dfinsuppQuotIncl' L c j)
  · have h1 : dfinsuppQuotIncl L c j b ∈ Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {c})
        (dfinsuppBase L c B) := hB.span_eq_top ▸ trivial
    have h2 := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := dfinsuppQuotProj' L c j) h1
    rw [Submodule.map_span, dfinsuppQuotProj'_apply,
      dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self] at h2
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ h2
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨l, b', hb', rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
    rw [dfinsuppQuotProj'_apply]
    by_cases h : l = j
    · subst h
      rw [dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self]
      exact Submodule.subset_span hb'
    · rw [dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_of_ne L c h]
      exact zero_mem _
  · obtain ⟨Λ, x, hx, hxb⟩ := hB.exists_weight _ (hmem b hb)
    refine ⟨Λ, dfinsuppLatticeProj L j x, map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lapply j) hx, ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (dfinsuppQuotProj L c j) hxb
    rwa [dfinsuppQuotProj_incl_self] at this
  · rcases hB.eQ_mem i _ (hmem b hb) with h | h
    · rw [hQe] at h
      exact hback _ h
    · rw [hQe] at h
      exact Or.inr (hinj (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  · rcases hB.fQ_mem i _ (hmem b hb) with h | h
    · rw [hQf] at h
      exact hback _ h
    · rw [hQf] at h
      exact Or.inr (hinj (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  · rw [← hinj.eq_iff, ← hQf, ← hinj.eq_iff, ← hQe]
    exact hB.fQ_eq_iff i _ (hmem b hb) _ (hmem b' hb')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsUnitPow.inPow
statement: lemma IsUnitPow.inPow {e : ℤ} {κ : k} (h : IsUnitPow ϖ e κ) : InPow ϖ e κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, -, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨u, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsUnitPow.mul
statement:
lemma IsUnitPow.mul {e e' : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (hq : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0) (h : IsUnitPow ϖ e κ)
    (h' : IsUnitPow ϖ e' κ') : IsUnitPow ϖ (e + e') (κ * κ')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩ := h'
  exact ⟨u * u', hu.mul hu', by rw [zpow_add₀ hq, map_mul]; ring⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsUnitPow.neg
statement: lemma IsUnitPow.neg {e : ℤ} {κ : k} (h : IsUnitPow ϖ e κ) : IsUnitPow ϖ e (-κ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨-u, hu.neg, by rw [map_neg, mul_neg]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsUnitPow.inv
statement: lemma IsUnitPow.inv {e : ℤ} {κ : k} (h : IsUnitPow ϖ e κ) : IsUnitPow ϖ (-e) κ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨↑v⁻¹, v⁻¹.isUnit, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_inv, zpow_neg]
  congr 1
  exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [← map_mul, v.inv_mul, map_one])).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsUnitPow.div
statement:
lemma IsUnitPow.div {e e' : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (hq : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0) (h : IsUnitPow ϖ e κ)
    (h' : IsUnitPow ϖ e' κ') : IsUnitPow ϖ (e - e') (κ / κ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact h.mul hq h'.inv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isUnitPow_zpow
statement: lemma isUnitPow_zpow (e : ℤ) : IsUnitPow ϖ e (algebraMap A k ϖ ^ e)
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, isUnit_one, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isUnitPow_one
statement: lemma isUnitPow_one : IsUnitPow ϖ 0 (1 : k)
proof: := ⟨1, isUnit_one, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InPow.add
statement:
lemma InPow.add {e : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (h : InPow ϖ e κ) (h' : InPow ϖ e κ') :
    InPow ϖ e (κ + κ')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := h'
  exact ⟨a + a', by rw [map_add, mul_add]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InPow.neg
statement: lemma InPow.neg {e : ℤ} {κ : k} (h : InPow ϖ e κ) : InPow ϖ e (-κ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨-a, by rw [map_neg, mul_neg]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InPow.sub
statement:
lemma InPow.sub {e : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (h : InPow ϖ e κ) (h' : InPow ϖ e κ') :
    InPow ϖ e (κ - κ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h.add h'.neg

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inPow_zero
statement: lemma inPow_zero (e : ℤ) : InPow ϖ e (0 : k)
proof: := ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InPow.congr_right
statement: lemma InPow.congr_right {e : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (h : InPow ϖ e κ) (hκ : κ = κ') : InPow ϖ e κ'
proof:
:=
  hκ ▸ h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InPow.mul
statement:
lemma InPow.mul {e e' : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (hq : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0) (h : InPow ϖ e κ)
    (h' : InPow ϖ e' κ') : InPow ϖ (e + e') (κ * κ')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := h'
  exact ⟨a * a', by rw [zpow_add₀ hq, map_mul]; ring⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InPow.mono
statement:
lemma InPow.mono {e e' : ℤ} {κ : k} (hq : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0) (hee' : e ≤ e')
    (h : InPow ϖ e' κ) : InPow ϖ e κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, e' = e + d := ⟨(e' - e).toNat, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨ϖ ^ d * a, by rw [hd, zpow_add₀ hq, map_mul, map_pow, zpow_natCast]; ring⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InPow.sum
statement:
lemma InPow.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {e : ℤ} {f : ι → k} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, InPow ϖ e (f i)) :
    InPow ϖ e (∑ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using inPow_zero e
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact (h i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).add
      (ih fun j hj ↦ h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inPow_algebraMap
statement: lemma inPow_algebraMap (a : A) : InPow ϖ 0 (algebraMap A k a)
proof: := ⟨a, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsOnePow.inPow
statement: lemma IsOnePow.inPow {e : ℤ} {κ : k} (h : IsOnePow ϖ e κ) : InPow ϖ e κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isOnePow_zpow
statement: lemma isOnePow_zpow (e : ℤ) : IsOnePow ϖ e (algebraMap A k ϖ ^ e)
proof: := ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isOnePow_one
statement: lemma isOnePow_one : IsOnePow ϖ 0 (1 : k)
proof: := ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsOnePow.mul
statement:
lemma IsOnePow.mul {e e' : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (hq : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0) (h : IsOnePow ϖ e κ)
    (h' : IsOnePow ϖ e' κ') : IsOnePow ϖ (e + e') (κ * κ')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨a + a' + ϖ * a * a', ?_⟩
  rw [zpow_add₀ hq]
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_one]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsOnePow.sub_one
statement: lemma IsOnePow.sub_one {κ : k} (h : IsOnePow ϖ 0 κ) : InPow ϖ 1 (κ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a, by simp [map_add, map_mul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isUnit_one_add_mul
statement: lemma isUnit_one_add_mul (a : A) : IsUnit (1 + ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  have h : -(ϖ * a) ∈ nonunits A :=
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 ((Ideal.neg_mem_iff _).2 (Ideal.mul_mem_right a _ hϖ))
  simpa using IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits _ h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsOnePow.isUnitPow
statement: lemma IsOnePow.isUnitPow {e : ℤ} {κ : k} (h : IsOnePow ϖ e κ) : IsUnitPow ϖ e κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨_, isUnit_one_add_mul hϖ a, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsOnePow.inv
statement:
lemma IsOnePow.inv {e : ℤ} {κ : k} (h : IsOnePow ϖ e κ) :
    IsOnePow ϖ (-e) κ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := isUnit_one_add_mul hϖ a
  refine ⟨-(a * ↑u⁻¹), ?_⟩
  have h0 : (↑u⁻¹ : A) * (1 + ϖ * a) = 1 := by rw [← hu]; exact u.inv_mul
  have h1 : (1 + ϖ * -(a * ↑u⁻¹)) * (1 + ϖ * a) = 1 := by
    have e : (1 + ϖ * -(a * ↑u⁻¹)) = ↑u⁻¹ := by linear_combination (-1 : A) * h0
    rw [e, h0]
  have h2 : algebraMap A k (1 + ϖ * -(a * ↑u⁻¹)) = (algebraMap A k (1 + ϖ * a))⁻¹ :=
    eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [← map_mul, h1, map_one])
  rw [h2, mul_inv, zpow_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsOnePow.div
statement:
lemma IsOnePow.div {e e' : ℤ} {κ κ' : k} (hq : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0) (h : IsOnePow ϖ e κ)
    (h' : IsOnePow ϖ e' κ') : IsOnePow ϖ (e - e') (κ / κ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact h.mul hq (h'.inv hϖ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isOnePow_qInt
statement:
lemma isOnePow_qInt {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsOnePow ϖ (1 - n) (qInt (algebraMap A k ϖ) n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
  
  refine ⟨∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, ϖ ^ (2 * (n - s) - 1), ?_⟩
  set q := algebraMap A k ϖ
  have hsum : (1 : A) + ϖ * ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, ϖ ^ (2 * (n - s) - 1) =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ϖ ^ (2 * (n - s)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, mul_zero, pow_zero, add_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
    rw [← pow_succ']
    congr 1
    have := Finset.mem_range.1 hs
    omega
  rw [hsum, map_sum, qInt, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ ?_
  have hs := Finset.mem_range.1 hs
  rw [map_pow, inv_pow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg,
    ← zpow_add₀ hq, ← zpow_add₀ hq]
  congr 1
  push_cast [show s ≤ n by omega, show 2 * (n - s) = 2 * n - 2 * s by omega]
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isOnePow_qBinomial
statement:
lemma isOnePow_qBinomial {n m : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    IsOnePow ϖ (-(m * (n - m) : ℕ)) (qBinomial (algebraMap A k ϖ) n m)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => obtain rfl : m = 0 := by omega
            simpa using isOnePow_one
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases m with _ | m
    · simpa using isOnePow_one
    set q := algebraMap A k ϖ
    rw [qBinomial_succ_succ]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n (m + 1) with hlt | hge
    · 
      obtain rfl : m = n := by omega
      simpa [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self m)] using isOnePow_one
    · 
      obtain ⟨a₁, h₁⟩ := ih hge
      obtain ⟨a₂, h₂⟩ := ih (show m ≤ n by omega)
      refine ⟨a₁ + ϖ ^ (2 * (n - m) - 1) * (1 + ϖ * a₂), ?_⟩
      rw [h₁, h₂, inv_pow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_natCast q (n - m)]
      have e₁ : (-((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) + (-((m + 1) * (n - (m + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          -((m + 1) * (n + 1 - (m + 1)) : ℕ) := by
        push_cast [show m + 1 ≤ n by omega, show m ≤ n by omega]; ring
      have e₂ : ((n - m : ℕ) : ℤ) + (-(m * (n - m) : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          -((m + 1) * (n + 1 - (m + 1)) : ℕ) + ((2 * (n - m) - 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) := by
        push_cast [show m + 1 ≤ n by omega, show m ≤ n by omega,
          show 1 ≤ 2 * (n - m) by omega]
        ring
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hq, e₁, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hq, e₂, zpow_add₀ hq,
        zpow_natCast, ← map_pow]
      simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_one]
      ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSetProj_singleton_kashiwaraF
statement:
lemma weightSetProj_singleton_kashiwaraF (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (m : M) :
    weightSetProj hv hM {Λ - R.root i} (kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i m) =
      kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i (weightSetProj hv hM {Λ} m)
proof:
:= by
  have := ext_weightSpace hM
    (f := weightSetProj hv hM {Λ - R.root i} ∘ₗ kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i)
    (g := kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i ∘ₗ weightSetProj hv hM {Λ}) fun Λ' m hm ↦ by
      classical
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [weightSetProj_of_mem hv hM _ (kashiwaraF_mem_weightSpace hv hM i hm),
        weightSetProj_of_mem hv hM _ hm]
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, sub_left_inj]
      split_ifs <;> simp
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSetProj_singleton_kashiwaraF_pow
statement:
lemma weightSetProj_singleton_kashiwaraF_pow (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (j : ℕ) (m : M) :
    weightSetProj hv hM {Λ - j • R.root i} ((kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i ^ j) m) =
      (kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i ^ j) (weightSetProj hv hM {Λ} m)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, succ_nsmul, ← sub_sub,
      weightSetProj_singleton_kashiwaraF, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive
statement:
lemma kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive {p : ℤ} {η : M} (hη : E R v i • η = 0)
    (hp : η ∈ nodeWt R v M i p) (j : ℕ) :
    (kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i ^ j) η = (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF j η
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [qDivPow]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih]
    exact IntegrableSl2.fTilde_dF (V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i) _ _ hη hp j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_smul_mem_span_kashiwaraF
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  obtain ⟨N, η, hη, -, -, hsum⟩ := IntegrableSl2.exists_sum_dF (V := V) (pow_d_ne_zero i)
    (pow_d_ne_one hv i) (mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := i) hx)
  have hF : F R v i • x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, qInt (v ^ D.d i) (j + 1) •
      (kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i ^ (j + 1)) (η j) := by
    change V.F x = _
    rw [hsum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [V.F_dF (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv i),
      kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv hM i (hη j).2 (hη j).1]
  have hFx : F R v i • x ∈ weightSpace R v M (μ - R.root i) := F_smul_mem_weightSpace hx i
  have hP := weightSetProj_of_mem hv hM {μ - R.root i} hFx
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, ↓reduceIte] at hP
  rw [← hP, hF, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, _,
    weightSetProj_singleton_mem hv hM (μ + j • R.root i) (η j), ?_⟩)
  rw [← weightSetProj_singleton_kashiwaraF_pow]
  congr 2
  rw [succ_nsmul]
  abel_nf

name: LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective
statement:
lemma _root_.LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective (hR : R.IsXRegular) :
    Function.Injective R.rootSum
proof:
:= fun ν ν' h ↦ by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := R.exists_rootSum_ne hR hne
  exact hμ (by rw [h])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.fWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma fWord_nil : fWord hR hv' hΛ [] = hwv R v Λ
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.fWord_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma fWord_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    fWord hR hv' hΛ (i :: w) =
      kashiwaraF R v _ hv' (isIntegrable hR hv' hΛ) i (fWord hR hv' hΛ w)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fWord_mem_weightSpace (w : List I) :
    fWord hR hv' hΛ w ∈
      weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ) (Λ - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using hwv_mem_weightSpace
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [fWord_cons, LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul,
      add_comm, ← sub_sub]
    exact kashiwaraF_mem_weightSpace hv' _ i ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.exists_eq_sub_rootSum
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have hle := weightSpace_quotient_le_map hv' VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
    (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R v Λ) Λ'
  rw [VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot hv' h, Submodule.map_bot] at hle
  exact hx0 ((Submodule.mem_bot k).1 (hle hx))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.span_fWord
statement: theorem span_fWord : Submodule.span k (Set.range (fWord (Λ := Λ) hR hv' hΛ)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set W := Submodule.span k (Set.range (fWord (Λ := Λ) hR hv' hΛ))
  set hI := isIntegrable hR hv' hΛ
  have hW : ∀ i, ∀ m ∈ W, kashiwaraF R v _ hv' hI i m ∈ W := by
    intro i m hm
    have : W.map (kashiwaraF R v _ hv' hI i) ≤ W := by
      rw [Submodule.map_span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i :: w, rfl⟩
    exact this ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  have hWpow : ∀ i j, ∀ m ∈ W, (kashiwaraF R v _ hv' hI i ^ j) m ∈ W := by
    intro i j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro m hm; simpa using hm
    | succ j ih => intro m hm; rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; exact hW i _ (ih m hm)
  have key : ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ,
      weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ) (Λ - R.rootSum ν) ≤ W := by
    intro ν
    induction hn : (ν.sum fun _ n ↦ n) using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing ν with
    | _ n ih =>
    intro x hx
    have hle := weightSpace_quotient_le_map hv' VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top
      (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R v Λ) (Λ - R.rootSum ν)
    rw [VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_map hv' hR ν] at hle
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hle hx
    clear hx hle
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
      cases w with
      | nil =>
        have : (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R v Λ).mkQ.restrictScalars k
            (VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ (LusztigF.monomial k [])) = hwv R v Λ := by
          simp [VermaModule.toVerma_apply, hwv]
        rw [this]
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], rfl⟩
      | cons i w =>
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hw
        set z : IrreducibleModule R v Λ := Submodule.Quotient.mk
          (VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ (LusztigF.monomial k w))
        have hz : z ∈ weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ)
            (Λ - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) :=
          map_mem_weightSpace (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R v Λ).mkQ
            (VermaModule.toVerma_mem_weightSpace (LusztigF.monomial_mem_weightSpace w))
        have hxz : (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R v Λ).mkQ.restrictScalars k
            (VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ (LusztigF.monomial k (i :: w))) = F R v i • z := by
          simp only [LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, Submodule.mkQ_apply, z,
            LusztigF.monomial_cons, VermaModule.toVerma_apply, map_mul, mul_smul, minusHom_θ,
            Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
        rw [hxz]
        refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) (F_smul_mem_span_kashiwaraF hv' hI i hz)
        rintro _ ⟨j, u, hu, rfl⟩
        refine hWpow i (j + 1) u ?_
        by_cases hu0 : u = 0
        · rw [hu0]; exact zero_mem _
        obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ := exists_eq_sub_rootSum hv' hu hu0
        have hroot : R.rootSum (ν' + Finsupp.single i j) = R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w) := by
          rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single]
          have := congrArg (fun μ ↦ Λ - μ) hν'
          simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at this
          rw [← this]
          abel
        have hνw := LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR hroot
        have hlt : (ν'.sum fun _ n ↦ n) < n := by
          rw [← hn, ← hw, LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, ← hνw,
            Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (by simp), Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (by simp),
            Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl, Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl]
          omega
        rw [hν'] at hu
        exact ih _ hlt ν' rfl hu
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← hI.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top]
  refine iSup_le fun Λ' ↦ ?_
  intro x hx
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · rw [hx0]; exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨ν, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_sub_rootSum hv' hx hx0
  exact key ν hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice
statement: lemma fWord_mem_lattice (w : List I) : fWord hR hv' hΛ w ∈ lattice hR hv' hΛ A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_lattice
statement: lemma hwv_mem_lattice : hwv R v Λ ∈ lattice hR hv' hΛ A
proof:
:=
  fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' hΛ A []

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.span_lattice
statement: theorem span_lattice : Submodule.span k (lattice hR hv' hΛ A : Set (IrreducibleModule R v Λ)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.2 <| (span_fWord hR hv' hΛ).symm.le.trans <|
    Submodule.span_mono (by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' hΛ A w)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.kashiwaraF_mem_lattice
proof:
:= by
  have : (lattice hR hv' hΛ A).map
      ((kashiwaraF R v _ hv' (isIntegrable hR hv' hΛ) i).restrictScalars A) ≤
      lattice hR hv' hΛ A := by
    rw [lattice, Submodule.map_span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' hΛ A (i :: w)
  exact this ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.weightSetProj_mem_lattice
proof:
:= by
  have : (lattice hR hv' hΛ A).map
      ((weightSetProj hv' (isIntegrable hR hv' hΛ) S).restrictScalars A) ≤
      lattice hR hv' hΛ A := by
    rw [lattice, Submodule.map_span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    classical
    rw [LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars,
      weightSetProj_of_mem hv' _ S (fWord_mem_weightSpace hR hv' hΛ w)]
    split_ifs
    · exact fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' hΛ A w
    · exact zero_mem _
  exact this ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma diagTwist_mem_weightSpace (c : I → k) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) : diagTwist c x ∈ weightSpace k ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    induction w with
    | nil => simpa [monomial] using one_mem_weightSpace
    | cons l w ih =>
      rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, diagTwist_θ, smul_mul_assoc, wordWeight_cons]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mul_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace l) ih)
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.toZ_injective
statement: lemma toZ_injective : Function.Injective (toZ (I := I))
proof:
:= fun ν μ h ↦ by
  ext i
  have := congr($h i)
  simpa [toZ] using this

name: LusztigF.toZ_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma toZ_apply (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) : toZ ν i = ν i
proof: := by simp [toZ]

name: LusztigF.toZ_add
statement: lemma toZ_add (ν μ : I →₀ ℕ) : toZ (ν + μ) = toZ ν + toZ μ
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp

name: LusztigF.toZ_single
statement: lemma toZ_single (i : I) (n : ℕ) : toZ (Finsupp.single i n) = Finsupp.single i (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext j
  rw [toZ_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LusztigF.nonneg_toZ
statement: lemma nonneg_toZ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : 0 ≤ toZ ν
proof: := fun i ↦ by simp

name: LusztigF.ofZ_toZ
statement: lemma ofZ_toZ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : ofZ (toZ ν) = ν
proof: := by ext i; simp [ofZ]

name: LusztigF.toZ_ofZ
statement: lemma toZ_ofZ {γ : I →₀ ℤ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) : toZ (ofZ γ) = γ
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [ofZ, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hγ i)]

name: LusztigF.zWeightProj_of_mem
statement:
lemma zWeightProj_of_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν)
    (γ : I →₀ ℤ) : zWeightProj k γ x = if toZ ν = γ then x else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold zWeightProj
  by_cases h1 : 0 ≤ γ
  · rw [ite_eq_left h1, weightProj_of_mem hx]
    by_cases h2 : toZ ν = γ
    · rw [ite_eq_left (by rw [← h2, ofZ_toZ]), ite_eq_left h2]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h ↦ h2 (by rw [h, toZ_ofZ h1])), ite_eq_right h2]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_right (fun (h2 : toZ ν = γ) ↦ h1 (h2 ▸ nonneg_toZ ν))]
    rfl

name: LusztigF.ext_weightSpace
statement:
lemma ext_weightSpace {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N] {φ ψ : LusztigF k I →ₗ[k] N}
    (h : ∀ ν, ∀ x ∈ weightSpace k ν, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ ν, weightSpace k (I := I) ν := by rw [iSup_weightSpace]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν x hx => exact h ν x hx
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: LusztigF.zWeightProj_θ_mul
statement:
lemma zWeightProj_θ_mul (i : I) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    zWeightProj k γ (θ k i * x) = θ k i * zWeightProj k (γ - Finsupp.single i 1) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := ext_weightSpace (φ := zWeightProj k γ ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i))
    (ψ := LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i) ∘ₗ zWeightProj k (γ - Finsupp.single i 1)) fun ν x hx ↦ by
    have hθx : θ k i * x ∈ weightSpace k (Finsupp.single i 1 + ν) :=
      mul_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace i) hx
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, zWeightProj_of_mem hθx,
      zWeightProj_of_mem hx]
    rw [toZ_add, toZ_single, Nat.cast_one]
    by_cases h : Finsupp.single i (1 : ℤ) + toZ ν = γ
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (by rw [← h]; abel)]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun h' ↦ h (by rw [h']; abel)), mul_zero]
  exact congr($this x)

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_monomial_eq_zero
statement:
lemma lDeriv_monomial_eq_zero (i : I) (w : List I) (hw : wordWeight w i = 0) :
    lDeriv D v i (monomial k w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons l w ih =>
    have hl : l ≠ i := by
      rintro rfl; simp at hw
    have hw' : wordWeight w i = 0 := by
      simp only [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.add_apply] at hw; omega
    rw [monomial_cons, lDeriv_θ_mul, ih hw']
    simp [Ne.symm hl]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_monomial_mem
statement:
lemma lDeriv_monomial_mem (i : I) (w : List I) :
    ∀ μ, wordWeight w = μ + Finsupp.single i 1 →
      lDeriv D v i (monomial k w) ∈ weightSpace k μ
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro μ h
    have := congr($h i)
    simp at this
  | cons l w ih =>
    intro μ h
    rw [monomial_cons, lDeriv_θ_mul]
    rw [wordWeight_cons] at h
    have h1 : θ k l * lDeriv D v i (monomial k w) ∈ weightSpace k μ := by
      by_cases hwi : wordWeight w i = 0
      · rw [lDeriv_monomial_eq_zero D v i w hwi, mul_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · have hw : wordWeight w = (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1) + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
          ext j
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
          split_ifs with hij
          · subst hij; omega
          · omega
        have hμ : μ = Finsupp.single l 1 + (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1) := by
          ext j
          have := congr($h j)
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply] at this ⊢
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst hij
            simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this ⊢
            omega
          · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)] at this ⊢
            omega
        rw [hμ]
        exact mul_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace l) (ih _ hw)
    split_ifs with hil
    · subst hil
      have : wordWeight w = μ := by
        rw [add_comm] at h; exact add_right_cancel h
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (this ▸ monomial_mem_weightSpace w)
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h1)
    · rw [zero_add]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h1

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma lDeriv_mem_weightSpace (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) : lDeriv D v i y ∈ weightSpace k μ
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact lDeriv_monomial_mem D v i w μ hw
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma lDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} (hμ : μ i = 0) {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k μ) : lDeriv D v i y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact lDeriv_monomial_eq_zero D v i w hμ
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]

name: LusztigF.bosonE_apply
statement: lemma bosonE_apply (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : bosonE D v i x = lDeriv D v i x
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.bosonF_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma bosonF_apply (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : bosonF i x = θ k i * x
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.bosonE_θ_mul
statement:
theorem bosonE_θ_mul (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    bosonE D v i (θ k j * x) =
      v ^ D.dot i j • (θ k j * bosonE D v i x) + if i = j then x else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bosonE_apply, lDeriv_θ_mul, add_comm, bosonE_apply]

name: LusztigF.bosonE_bosonF
statement:
theorem bosonE_bosonF (i : I) :
    bosonE D v i * bosonF i = ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹⁻¹ ^ 2) • (bosonF i * bosonE D v i) + 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, bosonF_apply, bosonE_θ_mul, ite_true,
    LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply]
  rw [zpow_dot_self, inv_inv]

name: LusztigF.bosonE_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma bosonE_mem_weightSpace (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) : bosonE D v i x ∈ weightSpace k μ
proof:
:=
  lDeriv_mem_weightSpace D v i hx

name: LusztigF.bosonE_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma bosonE_eq_zero_of_mem (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} (hμ : μ i = 0) {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k μ) : bosonE D v i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bosonE_apply, lDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D v i hμ hx]

name: LusztigF.bosonE_pow_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma bosonE_pow_eq_zero_of_mem (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k μ) : (bosonE D v i ^ (μ i + 1)) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction h : μ i generalizing μ x with
  | zero => rw [zero_add, pow_one]; exact bosonE_eq_zero_of_mem i h hx
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨μ', rfl⟩ : ∃ μ', μ = μ' + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
      refine ⟨μ - Finsupp.single i 1, ?_⟩
      ext l
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst hl; simp [h]
      · simp [Ne.symm hl]
    have hμ' : μ' i = n := by simpa using h
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact ih (bosonE_mem_weightSpace i hx) hμ'

name: LusztigF.exists_bosonE_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_bosonE_pow_eq_zero (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, (bosonE D v i ^ N) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ ν, weightSpace k (I := I) ν := by rw [iSup_weightSpace]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν x hx => exact ⟨ν i + 1, bosonE_pow_eq_zero_of_mem i hx⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N + N', ?_⟩
    have h1 : (bosonE D v i ^ (N + N')) x = 0 := by
      rw [add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hN, map_zero]
    have h2 : (bosonE D v i ^ (N + N')) y = 0 := by
      rw [pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hN', map_zero]
    rw [map_add, h1, h2, add_zero]

name: LusztigF.zWeightProj_bosonE
statement:
lemma zWeightProj_bosonE (i : I) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    zWeightProj k γ (bosonE D v i x) = bosonE D v i (zWeightProj k (γ + Finsupp.single i 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := ext_weightSpace (φ := zWeightProj k γ ∘ₗ bosonE D v i)
    (ψ := bosonE D v i ∘ₗ zWeightProj k (γ + Finsupp.single i 1)) fun ν x hx ↦ by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, zWeightProj_of_mem hx]
    by_cases hν : ν i = 0
    · rw [bosonE_eq_zero_of_mem i hν hx, map_zero]
      split_ifs <;> simp [bosonE_eq_zero_of_mem i hν hx]
    · obtain ⟨μ, rfl⟩ : ∃ μ, ν = μ + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
        refine ⟨ν - Finsupp.single i 1, ?_⟩
        ext l
        by_cases hl : l = i
        · subst hl; simp; omega
        · simp [Ne.symm hl]
      rw [zWeightProj_of_mem (bosonE_mem_weightSpace i hx), toZ_add, toZ_single, Nat.cast_one]
      by_cases h : toZ μ = γ
      · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (by rw [h])]
      · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun h' ↦ h (add_right_cancel h')), map_zero]
  exact congr($this x)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.serreSubmodule_le_comap_bosonF
statement:
lemma serreSubmodule_le_comap_bosonF (i : I) :
    serreSubmodule D v ≤ (serreSubmodule D v).comap (bosonF (k := k) i)
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  rw [mem_serreSubmodule] at hx
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, mem_serreSubmodule, bosonF_apply]
  exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.serreSubmodule_le_comap_zWeightProj
statement:
lemma serreSubmodule_le_comap_zWeightProj (γ : I →₀ ℤ) :
    serreSubmodule D v ≤ (serreSubmodule D v).comap (zWeightProj k γ)
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  rw [mem_serreSubmodule] at hx
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, mem_serreSubmodule, zWeightProj]
  split_ifs
  · exact weightProj_mem_serreIdeal hx _
  · exact (serreIdeal D v).zero_mem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.f_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma f_mk (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : f D v i (mk x) = mk (θ k i * x)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.proj_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma proj_mk (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    proj D v γ (mk x) = mk (zWeightProj k γ x)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.ext_mk
statement:
lemma ext_mk {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N] {φ ψ : NegativePart D v →ₗ[k] N}
    (h : ∀ x, φ (mk x) = ψ (mk x)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (LinearMap.ext h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.proj_f
statement:
lemma proj_f (i : I) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (u : NegativePart D v) :
    proj D v γ (f D v i u) = f D v i (proj D v (γ - Finsupp.single i 1) u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  simp only [f_mk, proj_mk, zWeightProj_θ_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.mem_weightSpace_iff
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpace_iff (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (u : NegativePart D v) :
    u ∈ weightSpace D v ν ↔ proj D v (toZ ν) u = u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, proj_mk, zWeightProj_of_mem hx]
    simp
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
    rw [← h, proj_mk]
    refine ⟨zWeightProj k (toZ ν) x, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [zWeightProj, ite_eq_left (nonneg_toZ ν), ofZ_toZ]
    exact weightProj_mem ν x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.serreSubmodule_le_comap_bosonE
statement:
lemma serreSubmodule_le_comap_bosonE (i : I) :
    serreSubmodule D v ≤ (serreSubmodule D v).comap (bosonE D v i)
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  rw [mem_serreSubmodule] at hx
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, mem_serreSubmodule, bosonE_apply]
  exact lDeriv_mem_serreIdeal hv hv' i hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.e_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma e_mk (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : e D v hv hv' i (mk x) = mk (bosonE D v i x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.boson_e
statement: @[simp] lemma boson_e (i : I) : (boson D v hv hv' i).e = e D v hv hv' i
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.boson_f
statement: @[simp] lemma boson_f (i : I) : (boson D v hv hv' i).f = f D v i
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero
statement: lemma pow_d_ne_zero (i : I) : (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0
proof: := inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one
statement: lemma pow_d_ne_one (i : I) : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun n hn h ↦ by
  rw [inv_pow, inv_eq_one, ← pow_mul] at h
  exact hv' _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) hn) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.kashiwaraE_kashiwaraF
statement:
theorem kashiwaraE_kashiwaraF (i : I) (u : NegativePart D v) :
    kashiwaraE D v hv hv' i (kashiwaraF D v hv hv' i u) = u
proof:
:=
  BosonModule.eTilde_fTilde _ _ u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.kashiwaraF_injective
statement: theorem kashiwaraF_injective (i : I) : Function.Injective (kashiwaraF D v hv hv' i)
proof:
:=
  BosonModule.fTilde_injective _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.proj_e
statement:
lemma proj_e (i : I) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (u : NegativePart D v) :
    proj D v γ (e D v hv hv' i u) = e D v hv hv' i (proj D v (γ + Finsupp.single i 1) u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  simp only [e_mk, proj_mk, zWeightProj_bosonE]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.proj_kashiwaraE
statement:
theorem proj_kashiwaraE (i : I) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (u : NegativePart D v) :
    proj D v γ (kashiwaraE D v hv hv' i u) =
      kashiwaraE D v hv hv' i (proj D v (γ + Finsupp.single i 1) u)
proof:
:=
  BosonModule.map_eTilde_shift _ _ (boson D v hv hv' i) (proj D v) (Finsupp.single i 1)
    (proj_e hv hv' i) (proj_f i) γ u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.proj_kashiwaraF
statement:
theorem proj_kashiwaraF (i : I) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (u : NegativePart D v) :
    proj D v γ (kashiwaraF D v hv hv' i u) =
      kashiwaraF D v hv hv' i (proj D v (γ - Finsupp.single i 1) u)
proof:
:=
  BosonModule.map_fTilde_shift _ _ (boson D v hv hv' i) (proj D v) (Finsupp.single i 1)
    (proj_e hv hv' i) (proj_f i) γ u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_weightSpace_iff] at hu ⊢
  rw [proj_kashiwaraE, ← Nat.cast_one, ← toZ_single, ← toZ_add, hu]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.kashiwaraF_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_weightSpace_iff] at hu ⊢
  rw [proj_kashiwaraF, toZ_add, toZ_single, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right, hu]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.fWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma fWord_nil : fWord D v hv hv' ([] : List I) = mk 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.fWord_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma fWord_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    fWord D v hv hv' (i :: w) = kashiwaraF D v hv hv' i (fWord D v hv hv' w)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.fWord_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fWord_mem_weightSpace (w : List I) :
    fWord D v hv hv' w ∈ weightSpace D v (wordWeight w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, one_mem_weightSpace, rfl⟩
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [fWord_cons, wordWeight_cons, add_comm]
    exact kashiwaraF_mem_weightSpace hv hv' i ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf
statement: lemma fWord_mem_latticeInf (w : List I) : fWord D v hv hv' w ∈ latticeInf D v hv hv' A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.one_mem_latticeInf
statement: lemma one_mem_latticeInf : (mk 1 : NegativePart D v) ∈ latticeInf D v hv hv' A
proof:
:=
  fWord_mem_latticeInf hv hv' []

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.kashiwaraF_mem_latticeInf
statement:
theorem kashiwaraF_mem_latticeInf (i : I) {u : NegativePart D v}
    (hu : u ∈ latticeInf D v hv hv' A) : kashiwaraF D v hv hv' i u ∈ latticeInf D v hv hv' A
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hu
    exact fWord_mem_latticeInf hv hv' (i :: w)
  | zero => simp
  | add u u' _ _ hu hu' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hu hu'
  | smul a u _ hu =>
    rw [← algebraMap_smul k a u, map_smul, algebraMap_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hu

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.mem_span_basis
proof:
:= by
  have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := L.subtype) (e.mem_span ⟨x, hx⟩)
  rwa [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.lattice_eq_span
statement:
lemma lattice_eq_span {κ₁ κ₂ : Type*} (e₁ : Module.Basis κ₁ A L₁)
    (e₂ : Module.Basis κ₂ A L₂) :
    lattice k A L₁ L₂ = Submodule.span A
      (Set.range fun p : κ₁ × κ₂ ↦ mk M₁ M₂ ((e₁ p.1 : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (e₂ p.2 : M₂)))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hmk : ∀ (c : A) (z : M₁ ⊗[k] M₂), mk M₁ M₂ (c • z) = c • mk M₁ M₂ z := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    set S := Submodule.span A
      (Set.range fun p : κ₁ × κ₂ ↦ mk M₁ M₂ ((e₁ p.1 : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (e₂ p.2 : M₂)))
    have key : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range fun a ↦ (e₁ a : M₁)),
        ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range fun a ↦ (e₂ a : M₂)), mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) ∈ S := by
      intro x hx y hy
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
        induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem y hy =>
          obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(a, b), rfl⟩
        | zero => simp
        | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [tmul_add, map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
        | smul c y _ h => rw [tmul_smul, hmk]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c h
      | zero => simp
      | add x x' _ _ h h' => rw [add_tmul, map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
      | smul c x _ h => rw [← smul_tmul', hmk]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c h
    exact key x (mem_span_basis e₁ hx) y (mem_span_basis e₂ hy)
  · rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact tmul_mem_lattice (e₁ p.1).2 (e₂ p.2).2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.exists_basis_coe
statement:
lemma exists_basis_coe {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [Module A M]
    [IsScalarTower A k M] {L : Submodule A M} (hL : Submodule.span k (L : Set M) = ⊤)
    {κ : Type*} (e : Module.Basis κ A L) :
    ∃ b : Module.Basis κ k M, ∀ a, b a = e a
proof:
:= by
  have hli := linearIndependent_coe_of_basis hϖ0 hk e
  have hsp : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun a ↦ (e a : M)) := by
    rw [← hL, Submodule.span_le]
    intro x hx
    exact Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars A k _ (mem_span_basis e hx)
  exact ⟨Module.Basis.mk hli hsp, fun a ↦ Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.free_lattice
statement:
theorem free_lattice (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A k)) [Module.Free A L₁]
    [Module.Free A L₂] (hL₁ : Submodule.span k (L₁ : Set M₁) = ⊤)
    (hL₂ : Submodule.span k (L₂ : Set M₂) = ⊤) : Module.Free A (lattice k A L₁ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  let e₁ := Module.Free.chooseBasis A L₁
  let e₂ := Module.Free.chooseBasis A L₂
  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁⟩ := exists_basis_coe hϖ0 hk hL₁ e₁
  obtain ⟨b₂, hb₂⟩ := exists_basis_coe hϖ0 hk hL₂ e₂
  have hli : LinearIndependent k
      (fun p : _ × _ ↦ mk M₁ M₂ ((e₁ p.1 : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (e₂ p.2 : M₂))) := by
    have := (b₁.tensorProduct b₂).linearIndependent.map' (mk M₁ M₂).toLinearMap
      (mk M₁ M₂).ker
    have e : (fun p : _ × _ ↦ mk M₁ M₂ ((e₁ p.1 : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (e₂ p.2 : M₂))) =
        (mk M₁ M₂).toLinearMap ∘ (b₁.tensorProduct b₂) := by
      funext ⟨a, b⟩
      change _ = mk M₁ M₂ ((b₁.tensorProduct b₂) (a, b))
      rw [Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply, hb₁, hb₂]
    rw [e]
    exact this
  have hliA := hli.restrict_scalars (R := A) (by
    intro a a' h
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one] at h
    exact hinj h)
  have := Module.Free.of_basis (Module.Basis.span hliA)
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (lattice_eq_span e₁ e₂).symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.span_lattice_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_lattice_eq_top (hL₁ : Submodule.span k (L₁ : Set M₁) = ⊤)
    (hL₂ : Submodule.span k (L₂ : Set M₂) = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span k (lattice k A L₁ L₂ : Set (TensorModule k M₁ M₂)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun z _ ↦ ?_
  have h : Submodule.span k (Set.image2 (fun x y ↦ x ⊗ₜ[k] y) (L₁ : Set M₁) (L₂ : Set M₂)) =
      (⊤ : Submodule k (M₁ ⊗[k] M₂)) := by
    change Submodule.span k (Set.image2 (fun x y ↦ TensorProduct.mk k M₁ M₂ x y) _ _) = ⊤
    rw [← Submodule.map₂_span_span, hL₁, hL₂, TensorProduct.map₂_mk_top_top_eq_top]
  have hz : (mk M₁ M₂).symm z ∈ Submodule.span k
      (Set.image2 (fun x y ↦ x ⊗ₜ[k] y) (L₁ : Set M₁) (L₂ : Set M₂)) := by
    rw [h]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  refine Submodule.span_mono (R := k) ?_ hz
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact tmul_mem_lattice (k := k) hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.linearIndependent_base
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_base (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A k)) [Module.Free A L₁]
    [Module.Free A L₂] (hL₁ : Submodule.span k (L₁ : Set M₁) = ⊤)
    (hL₂ : Submodule.span k (L₂ : Set M₂) = ⊤)
    (hB₁ : LinearIndependent (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) (Subtype.val : B₁ → _))
    (hB₁' : Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) B₁ = ⊤)
    (hB₂ : LinearIndependent (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) (Subtype.val : B₂ → _))
    (hB₂' : Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) B₂ = ⊤) :
    LinearIndependent (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) (Subtype.val : base k B₁ B₂ → _)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg β₀ hβ₀
  have hrep : ∀ β : base k B₁ B₂, ∃ (x : L₁) (y : L₂), Submodule.Quotient.mk x ∈ B₁ ∧
      Submodule.Quotient.mk y ∈ B₂ ∧
      β.1 = Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, tmul_mem_lattice (k := k) x.2 y.2⟩ := fun β ↦ β.2
  choose X Y hX hY hXY using hrep
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ := exists_coord hB₁ hB₁' ⟨_, hX β₀⟩
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩ := exists_coord hB₂ hB₂' ⟨_, hY β₀⟩
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (Ideal.span {ϖ}).mkQ p₁
    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (Ideal.span {ϖ}).mkQ p₂
    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
  obtain ⟨F₁, hF₁⟩ := exists_extend hϖ0 hk hL₁ f₁
  obtain ⟨F₂, hF₂⟩ := exists_extend hϖ0 hk hL₂ f₂
  choose g' hg' using fun β ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (g β)
  have hzL : ∑ β ∈ s, g' β • mk M₁ M₂ ((X β : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (Y β : M₂)) ∈ lattice k A L₁ L₂ :=
    Submodule.sum_mem _ fun β _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (tmul_mem_lattice (X β).2 (Y β).2)
  have hz : ∑ β ∈ s, g' β • mk M₁ M₂ ((X β : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (Y β : M₂)) ∈
      ϖ • lattice k A L₁ L₂ := by
    refine (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff ϖ ⟨_, hzL⟩).1 ?_
    rw [← hg]
    have e : (⟨_, hzL⟩ : lattice k A L₁ L₂) =
        ∑ β ∈ s, g' β • (⟨_, tmul_mem_lattice (k := k) (X β).2 (Y β).2⟩ : lattice k A L₁ L₂) :=
      Subtype.ext (by simp)
    rw [e, ← Submodule.mkQ_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun β _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hXY β, ← hg' β]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := exists_eq_algebraMap_of_mem_smul F₁ F₂
    (fun x hx ↦ ⟨f₁ ⟨x, hx⟩, hF₁ ⟨x, hx⟩⟩) (fun y hy ↦ ⟨f₂ ⟨y, hy⟩, hF₂ ⟨y, hy⟩⟩) hz
  have e : ∀ (x : M₁) (y : M₂), TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.mul k k).compl₁₂ F₁ F₂)
      ((mk M₁ M₂).symm (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y))) = F₁ x * F₂ y := fun x y ↦ by simp
  have hsum : algebraMap A k (∑ β ∈ s, g' β * f₁ (X β) * f₂ (Y β)) = algebraMap A k a := by
    rw [← he, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun β _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← algebraMap_smul k (g' β), map_smul, map_smul, e, smul_eq_mul, hF₁, hF₂, map_mul,
      map_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hs0 : ∑ β ∈ s, g β * p₁ (X β) * p₂ (Y β) = 0 := by
    have h1 := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {ϖ})) (hinj hsum)
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 ha, map_sum] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun β _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hg', ← hf₁, ← hf₂]
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single β₀] at hs0
  · rwa [(hp₁ _ (hX β₀)).1 rfl, (hp₂ _ (hY β₀)).1 rfl, mul_one, mul_one] at hs0
  · intro β _ hne
    by_cases h1 : (⟨_, hX β⟩ : B₁) = ⟨_, hX β₀⟩
    · by_cases h2 : (⟨_, hY β⟩ : B₂) = ⟨_, hY β₀⟩
      · exfalso
        apply hne
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [hXY β, hXY β₀, ← tmulL_mk, ← tmulL_mk, Subtype.mk.inj h1, Subtype.mk.inj h2]
      · rw [(hp₂ _ (hY β)).2 h2, mul_zero]
    · rw [(hp₁ _ (hX β)).2 h1, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro h
    exact absurd hβ₀ h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.mem_of_mk_mem_of_span_eq_top
statement:
lemma mem_of_mk_mem_of_span_eq_top {N P : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P] {B : Set (N ⧸ (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A N))}
    (hB : Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) B = ⊤)
    (f : N →ₗ[A] P ⧸ (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A P)) (hf : ∀ n, f (ϖ • n) = 0)
    (S : Submodule (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) (P ⧸ (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A P)))
    (hS : ∀ n, Submodule.Quotient.mk n ∈ B → f n ∈ S) (n : N) : f n ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A N) ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
    refine Submodule.smul_le.2 fun r hr n _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hr
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, mul_smul, map_smul, hf, smul_zero]
  let g := (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A N).liftQ f hle
  have key : ∀ q, g q ∈ S := by
    intro q
    have hq : q ∈ Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) B := hB ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem q hq =>
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
      exact hS n hq
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact S.zero_mem
    | add q q' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact S.add_mem h h'
    | smul c q _ h =>
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (g (Submodule.Quotient.mk n))
      rw [Module.Quotient.mk_smul_mk, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, map_smul, ← hp,
        ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← Module.Quotient.mk_smul_mk]
      rw [← hp] at h
      exact S.smul_mem _ h
  exact key (Submodule.Quotient.mk n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.span_base_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_base_eq_top (hB₁ : Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) B₁ = ⊤)
    (hB₂ : Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) B₂ = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) (base k B₁ B₂) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set S := Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) (base k B₁ B₂)
  have hmk : ∀ (c : A) (z : M₁ ⊗[k] M₂), mk M₁ M₂ (c • z) = c • mk M₁ M₂ z := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  have h0 : ∀ z : lattice k A L₁ L₂,
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (ϖ • z) : lattice k A L₁ L₂ ⧸
        (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A (lattice k A L₁ L₂))) = 0 := fun z ↦
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2
      (Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self ϖ) Submodule.mem_top)
  let fR : L₁ → L₂ →ₗ[A] lattice k A L₁ L₂ ⧸
      (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A (lattice k A L₁ L₂)) := fun x ↦
    { toFun := fun y ↦ Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, tmul_mem_lattice (k := k) x.2 y.2⟩
      map_add' := fun y y' ↦ by
        rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]
        congr 1
        exact Subtype.ext (by simp [tmul_add])
      map_smul' := fun a y ↦ by
        rw [RingHom.id_apply, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
        congr 1
        refine Subtype.ext ?_
        change mk M₁ M₂ ((x : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (a • (y : M₂))) = a • mk M₁ M₂ ((x : M₁) ⊗ₜ[k] (y : M₂))
        rw [tmul_smul, hmk] }
  let fL : L₂ → L₁ →ₗ[A] lattice k A L₁ L₂ ⧸
      (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A (lattice k A L₁ L₂)) := fun y ↦
    { toFun := fun x ↦ Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, tmul_mem_lattice (k := k) x.2 y.2⟩
      map_add' := fun x x' ↦ by
        rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]
        congr 1
        exact Subtype.ext (by simp [add_tmul])
      map_smul' := fun a x ↦ by
        rw [RingHom.id_apply, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
        congr 1 }
  have hR : ∀ (x : L₁) (y : L₂), fR x (ϖ • y) = 0 := fun x y ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.map_smul]
    exact h0 _
  have hL : ∀ (y : L₂) (x : L₁), fL y (ϖ • x) = 0 := fun y x ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.map_smul]
    exact h0 _
  have h1 : ∀ x : L₁, Submodule.Quotient.mk x ∈ B₁ → ∀ y : L₂, fR x y ∈ S := fun x hx ↦
    mem_of_mk_mem_of_span_eq_top hB₂ (fR x) (hR x) S
      (fun y hy ↦ Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩)
  have h2 : ∀ (x : L₁) (y : L₂), fR x y ∈ S := fun x y ↦
    mem_of_mk_mem_of_span_eq_top hB₁ (fL y) (hL y) S (fun x hx ↦ h1 x hx y) x
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro q -
  obtain ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact h2 ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  | zero => exact S.zero_mem
  | add z z' _ _ h h' => exact S.add_mem h h'
  | smul a z _ h => exact S.smul_mem (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.mem_lattice_of_tmul
statement:
lemma mem_lattice_of_tmul (hL₁ : ∀ S, ∀ m ∈ L₁, weightSetProj hv h₁ S m ∈ L₁)
    (hL₂ : ∀ S, ∀ m ∈ L₂, weightSetProj hv h₂ S m ∈ L₂) (T : Module.End k (TensorModule k M₁ M₂))
    (hT : ∀ (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (x : M₁) (y : M₂), x ∈ L₁ → x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ Λ → y ∈ L₂ →
      y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ Λ' → T (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)) ∈ lattice k A L₁ L₂)
    {z : TensorModule k M₁ M₂} (hz : z ∈ lattice k A L₁ L₂) : T z ∈ lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
    beta_reduce
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsw⟩ := exists_sum_weightSetProj hv h₁ x
    obtain ⟨s', hs', hsw'⟩ := exists_sum_weightSetProj hv h₂ y
    have e : mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = ∑ Λ ∈ s, ∑ Λ' ∈ s',
        mk M₁ M₂ (weightSetProj hv h₁ {Λ} x ⊗ₜ[k] weightSetProj hv h₂ {Λ'} y) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hs, ← hs']
      simp only [sum_tmul, tmul_sum, map_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    rw [e, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun Λ _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_sum]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun Λ' _ ↦ hT Λ Λ' _ _ (hL₁ _ _ hx) (hsw Λ) (hL₂ _ _ hy) (hsw' Λ')
  | zero => simp
  | add z z' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | smul a z _ h => rw [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.isCrystalLattice_tensor
statement:
theorem isCrystalLattice_tensor (hL₁ : IsCrystalLattice hv h₁ L₁)
    (hL₂ : IsCrystalLattice hv h₂ L₂) :
    IsCrystalLattice hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) (lattice k A L₁ L₂) where
  span_eq_top
proof:
:= span_lattice_eq_top hL₁.span_eq_top hL₂.span_eq_top
  free := by
    have := hL₁.free
    have := hL₂.free
    have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
    exact free_lattice hϖ0 hk hinj hL₁.span_eq_top hL₂.span_eq_top
  weightSetProj_mem S m hm := weightSetProj_mem hL₁.weightSetProj_mem hL₂.weightSetProj_mem S hm
  kashiwaraE_mem i m hm := mem_lattice_of_tmul hL₁.weightSetProj_mem hL₂.weightSetProj_mem _
    (fun _ _ _ _ hx hxw hy hyw ↦ kashiwaraE_tmul_mem hv h₁ h₂ i (hL₁.kashiwaraF_mem i)
      (hL₂.kashiwaraF_mem i) (fun _ y hy _ ↦ hL₁.kashiwaraE_mem i y hy)
      (fun _ y hy _ ↦ hL₂.kashiwaraE_mem i y hy) hϖ hϖv hx hxw hy hyw) hm
  kashiwaraF_mem i m hm := mem_lattice_of_tmul hL₁.weightSetProj_mem hL₂.weightSetProj_mem _
    (fun _ _ _ _ hx hxw hy hyw ↦ kashiwaraF_tmul_mem hv h₁ h₂ i (hL₁.kashiwaraF_mem i)
      (hL₂.kashiwaraF_mem i) (fun _ y hy _ ↦ hL₁.kashiwaraE_mem i y hy)
      (fun _ y hy _ ↦ hL₂.kashiwaraE_mem i y hy) hϖ hϖv hx hxw hy hyw) hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kashiwaraE_pow_mem_of
statement:
lemma kashiwaraE_pow_mem_of (hE : ∀ y ∈ L, kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i y ∈ L) (m : ℕ) {y : M}
    (hy : y ∈ L) : (kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i ^ m) y ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa using hy
  | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; exact hE _ ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kashiwaraF_pow_dF
statement:
lemma kashiwaraF_pow_dF {p : ℤ} {u : M} (hE : E R v i • u = 0) (hp : u ∈ nodeWt R v M i p)
    (m j : ℕ) :
    (kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i ^ m) ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF j u) =
      (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF (j + m) u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv hM i hE hp j, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add,
    add_comm, kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv hM i hE hp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kashiwaraE_pow_dF
statement:
lemma kashiwaraE_pow_dF {a : ℕ} {u : M} (hE : E R v i • u = 0)
    (hp : u ∈ nodeWt R v M i a) {m j : ℕ} (hmj : m ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ a) :
    (kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i ^ m) ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF j u) =
      (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF (j - m) u
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l, j - m = l + 1 := ⟨j - m - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hl, show j - (m + 1) = l by omega]
    exact IntegrableSl2.eTilde_dF_succ (V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i) (pow_d_ne_zero i)
      (pow_d_ne_one hv i) hE hp (by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kashiwaraE_pow_dF_eq_zero
statement:
lemma kashiwaraE_pow_dF_eq_zero {a : ℕ} {u : M} (hE : E R v i • u = 0)
    (hp : u ∈ nodeWt R v M i a) {m j : ℕ} (hjm : j < m) :
    (kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i ^ m) ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF j u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j ≤ a
  · obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, m = (l + 1) + j := ⟨m - j - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, kashiwaraE_pow_dF hE hp le_rfl hj, Nat.sub_self,
      IntegrableSl2.dF_zero, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
    rw [show kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i u = 0 from
      IntegrableSl2.eTilde_of_primitive (V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i) (pow_d_ne_zero i)
        (pow_d_ne_one hv i) hE hp, map_zero]
  · rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive (V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i) (pow_d_ne_zero i)
      (pow_d_ne_one hv i) hp hE (by omega), map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalLattice.dF_notMem_smul
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hu
  have := kashiwaraE_pow_mem_of ((hL.isKashiwaraStable i).smul c).eTilde_mem j h
  rwa [kashiwaraE_pow_dF hE hp le_rfl hj, Nat.sub_self, IntegrableSl2.dF_zero] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.mem_nodeWt
statement: lemma mem_nodeWt (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) : u ∈ nodeWt R v M i a
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.coroot]; exact mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i h.mem_weightSpace

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.dF_mem
statement:
lemma dF_mem (hL : IsCrystalLattice hv hM L) (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) (j : ℕ) :
    (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF j u ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv hM i h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt]
  exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv hM i (hL.kashiwaraF_mem i) _ h.mem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.ne_zero
statement: lemma ne_zero (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) : u ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h0 ↦
  h.notMem (h0 ▸ zero_mem _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.exists_string
statement:
theorem exists_string (hB : IsCrystalBase hL c B) (hc : ¬IsUnit c) (i : I) {μ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (x : L) (hxw : (x : M) ∈ weightSpace R v M μ) (hxB : Submodule.Quotient.mk x ∈ B) :
    ∃ (s a : ℕ) (u : M), IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u ∧
      ∃ hu : u ∈ L, Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨u, hu⟩ ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, η, hηw, hηE, hη2, -, hx⟩ := exists_sum_dF_weight hv hM i hxw
  have hu : ∑ j ∈ range N, (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF j (η j) ∈ L := hx ▸ x.2
  have hxe : (⟨_, hu⟩ : L) = x := Subtype.ext hx.symm
  obtain ⟨s, hsN, hs, hsB, -, hsmod⟩ := (hL.isKashiwaraStable i).exists_of_mk_mem c B
    (hB.zero_notMem hc) (hB.eQ_mem i) (hB.fQ_eq_iff i) N (μ (R.coroot i)) η
    (fun j ↦ ⟨mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i (hηw j), hηE j⟩) hη2 hu (by rw [hxe]; exact hxB)
  have hne : η s ∉ c • L := fun h ↦ hB.zero_notMem hc
    (by rwa [(IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff c ⟨η s, hs⟩).2 h] at hsB)
  have h2 := hη2 s fun h0 ↦ hne (h0 ▸ zero_mem _)
  refine ⟨s, (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * s).toNat, η s, ⟨hs, hηw s, hηE s, by omega, hne, by omega,
    by rw [hx]; exact hsmod⟩, hs, hsB⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.mk_eq
statement:
lemma mk_eq (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) (hx : x ∈ L) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩ : L ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, h.dF_mem hL s⟩
proof:
:=
  (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff c _ _).2 h.sub_mem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.fQ_mk_dF
statement:
lemma fQ_mk_dF (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) (j : ℕ) :
    hL.fQ c i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, h.dF_mem hL j⟩) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, h.dF_mem hL (j + 1)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have e := kashiwaraF_pow_dF (hv := hv) (hM := hM) h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt 1 j
  rw [pow_one] at e
  exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (Subtype.ext e)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.eQ_mk_dF_succ
statement:
lemma eQ_mk_dF_succ (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < a) :
    hL.eQ c i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, h.dF_mem hL (j + 1)⟩) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, h.dF_mem hL j⟩
proof:
:= by
  have e := kashiwaraE_pow_dF (hv := hv) (hM := hM) h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt
    (show 1 ≤ j + 1 by omega) (show j + 1 ≤ a by omega)
  rw [pow_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at e
  exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (Subtype.ext e)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.eQ_mk_dF_zero
statement:
lemma eQ_mk_dF_zero (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) :
    hL.eQ c i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨_, h.dF_mem hL 0⟩) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e := kashiwaraE_pow_dF_eq_zero (hv := hv) (hM := hM) h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt
    (show 0 < 1 by omega)
  rw [pow_one] at e
  change (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, hL.kashiwaraE_mem i _ (h.dF_mem hL 0)⟩ : L) :
    L ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L)) = 0
  rw [IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff]
  change kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF 0 u) ∈ c • L
  rw [e]
  exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.eQ_pow_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma eQ_pow_eq_zero_iff (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) (hx : x ∈ L) (m : ℕ) :
    (hL.eQ c i ^ m) (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩) = 0 ↔ s < m
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.mk_eq (hL := hL) hx]
  have hpow : ∀ z : L, (hL.eQ c i ^ m) (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) = Submodule.Quotient.mk
      ⟨_, kashiwaraE_pow_mem_of (hL.kashiwaraE_mem i) m z.2⟩ := by
    intro z
    induction m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih]
      exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (Subtype.ext (by
        simp only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl))
  rw [hpow, IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff]
  change (kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i ^ m) ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF s u) ∈ c • L ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h0
    by_contra hkm
    rw [kashiwaraE_pow_dF h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt (by omega) h.le] at h0
    exact hL.dF_notMem_smul c h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt h.notMem (by have := h.le; omega) h0
  · intro hkm
    rw [kashiwaraE_pow_dF_eq_zero h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt hkm]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsStringRep.fQ_pow_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma fQ_pow_eq_zero_iff (h : IsStringRep hv hM L c i μ x s a u) (hx : x ∈ L) (m : ℕ) :
    (hL.fQ c i ^ m) (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩) = 0 ↔ a < s + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.mk_eq (hL := hL) hx]
  have hpow : ∀ z : L, (hL.fQ c i ^ m) (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) = Submodule.Quotient.mk
      ⟨_, kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv hM i (hL.kashiwaraF_mem i) m z.2⟩ := by
    intro z
    induction m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih]
      exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (Subtype.ext (by
        simp only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; rfl))
  rw [hpow, IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff]
  change (kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i ^ m) ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF s u) ∈ c • L ↔ _
  rw [kashiwaraF_pow_dF h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    by_contra ham
    exact hL.dF_notMem_smul c h.E_smul h.mem_nodeWt h.notMem (by omega) h0
  · intro ham
    rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive (V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i) (pow_d_ne_zero i)
      (pow_d_ne_one hv i) h.mem_nodeWt h.E_smul (by push_cast; omega)]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.exists_eQ_fQ_counts
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, p, -, hep, he, hf⟩ := hB.exists_counts hc i ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact ⟨e, p - e, he, fun a ↦ (hf a).trans (by omega)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.counts_of_fQ_eq
statement:
lemma counts_of_fQ_eq (hB : IsCrystalBase hL c B) (i : I) {b b'} (hb : b ∈ B) (hb' : b' ∈ B)
    (h : hL.fQ c i b = b') {e φ e' φ' : ℕ} (he : ∀ a, (hL.eQ c i ^ a) b = 0 ↔ e < a)
    (hφ : ∀ a, (hL.fQ c i ^ a) b = 0 ↔ φ < a) (he' : ∀ a, (hL.eQ c i ^ a) b' = 0 ↔ e' < a)
    (hφ' : ∀ a, (hL.fQ c i ^ a) b' = 0 ↔ φ' < a) : e' = e + 1 ∧ φ = φ' + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h' := (hB.fQ_eq_iff i b hb b' hb').1 h
  have hE : ∀ m, e' < m + 1 ↔ e < m := fun m ↦ by
    rw [← he' (m + 1), ← he m, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, h']
  have hF : ∀ m, φ < m + 1 ↔ φ' < m := fun m ↦ by
    rw [← hφ (m + 1), ← hφ' m, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, h]
  have h1 := hE e
  have h2 := (hE (e + 1)).2 (by omega)
  have h3 := hF φ'
  have h4 := (hF (φ' + 1)).2 (by omega)
  simp only [lt_self_iff_false, iff_false, not_lt] at h1 h3
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.fQ_tmulL_of_isStringRep
statement:
theorem fQ_tmulL_of_isStringRep {μ₁ μ₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : M₁} {y : M₂} (hx : x ∈ L₁)
    (hy : y ∈ L₂) (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ μ₁) (hyw : y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ₂)
    {s₁ a s₂ b : ℕ} {u : M₁} {u' : M₂} (sx : IsStringRep hv h₁ L₁ ϖ i μ₁ x s₁ a u)
    (sy : IsStringRep hv h₂ L₂ ϖ i μ₂ y s₂ b u') :
    hL.fQ ϖ i (tmulL k (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩ :
        L₁ ⧸ (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A L₁)) (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩)) =
      if s₁ < b - s₂ then
        tmulL k (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩) (hL₂.fQ ϖ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩))
      else
        tmulL k (hL₁.fQ ϖ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩)) (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := kashiwaraF_tmul_sub_mem hv h₁ h₂ i (hL₁.kashiwaraF_mem i) (hL₂.kashiwaraF_mem i)
    (fun _ z hz _ ↦ hL₁.kashiwaraE_mem i z hz) (fun _ z hz _ ↦ hL₂.kashiwaraE_mem i z hz) hϖ hϖv
    hxw hy hyw sx.mem sx.mem_weightSpace sx.E_smul sx.coroot sx.ne_zero sx.le sy.mem
    sy.mem_weightSpace sy.E_smul sy.coroot sy.ne_zero sy.le sx.sub_mem sy.sub_mem
  rw [tmulL_mk, sx.mk_eq (hL := hL₁) hx, sy.mk_eq (hL := hL₂) hy]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [sy.fQ_mk_dF, tmulL_mk]
    simp only [h, ↓reduceIte] at hmain
    exact (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff ϖ _ _).2 hmain
  · rw [sx.fQ_mk_dF, tmulL_mk]
    simp only [h, ↓reduceIte] at hmain
    exact (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff ϖ _ _).2 hmain

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.eQ_tmulL_of_isStringRep
statement:
theorem eQ_tmulL_of_isStringRep {μ₁ μ₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : M₁} {y : M₂} (hx : x ∈ L₁)
    (hy : y ∈ L₂) (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ μ₁) (hyw : y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ₂)
    {s₁ a s₂ b : ℕ} {u : M₁} {u' : M₂} (sx : IsStringRep hv h₁ L₁ ϖ i μ₁ x s₁ a u)
    (sy : IsStringRep hv h₂ L₂ ϖ i μ₂ y s₂ b u') :
    hL.eQ ϖ i (tmulL k (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩ :
        L₁ ⧸ (Ideal.span {ϖ} • ⊤ : Submodule A L₁)) (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩)) =
      if s₁ ≤ b - s₂ then
        tmulL k (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩) (hL₂.eQ ϖ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩))
      else
        tmulL k (hL₁.eQ ϖ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩)) (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := kashiwaraE_tmul_sub_mem hv h₁ h₂ i (hL₁.kashiwaraF_mem i) (hL₂.kashiwaraF_mem i)
    (fun _ z hz _ ↦ hL₁.kashiwaraE_mem i z hz) (fun _ z hz _ ↦ hL₂.kashiwaraE_mem i z hz) hϖ hϖv
    hxw hy hyw sx.mem sx.mem_weightSpace sx.E_smul sx.coroot sx.ne_zero sx.le sy.mem
    sy.mem_weightSpace sy.E_smul sy.coroot sy.ne_zero sy.le sx.sub_mem sy.sub_mem
  rw [tmulL_mk, sx.mk_eq (hL := hL₁) hx, sy.mk_eq (hL := hL₂) hy]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte] at hmain
    obtain _ | t := s₂
    · simp only [↓reduceIte, sub_zero] at hmain
      rw [sy.eQ_mk_dF_zero, tmulL_zero_right]
      exact (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff ϖ _).2 hmain
    · simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hmain
      rw [sy.eQ_mk_dF_succ (by have := sy.le; omega), tmulL_mk]
      exact (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff ϖ _ _).2 hmain
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte] at hmain
    obtain _ | t := s₁
    · omega
    · rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hmain
      rw [sx.eQ_mk_dF_succ (by have := sx.le; omega), tmulL_mk]
      exact (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff ϖ _ _).2 hmain

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.exists_isStringRep_pair
statement:
lemma exists_isStringRep_pair {b₁ b₂} (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ B₁) (hb₂ : b₂ ∈ B₂) :
    ∃ (μ₁ μ₂ : Y →+ ℤ) (x : M₁) (y : M₂) (hx : x ∈ L₁) (hy : y ∈ L₂),
      x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ μ₁ ∧ y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ₂ ∧
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩ = b₁ ∧ Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y, hy⟩ = b₂ ∧
      ∃ (s₁ a s₂ b : ℕ) (u : M₁) (u' : M₂), IsStringRep hv h₁ L₁ ϖ i μ₁ x s₁ a u ∧
        IsStringRep hv h₂ L₂ ϖ i μ₂ y s₂ b u'
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ¬IsUnit ϖ := (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal ϖ).1 hϖ
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxw, hxb⟩ := hB₁.exists_mk_eq ⟨b₁, hb₁⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hyw, hyb⟩ := hB₂.exists_mk_eq ⟨b₂, hb₂⟩
  obtain ⟨s₁, a, u, sx, -⟩ := hB₁.exists_string hc i ⟨x, hx⟩ hxw (by rw [hxb]; exact hb₁)
  obtain ⟨s₂, b, u', sy, -⟩ := hB₂.exists_string hc i ⟨y, hy⟩ hyw (by rw [hyb]; exact hb₂)
  exact ⟨_, _, x, y, hx, hy, hxw, hyw, hxb, hyb, s₁, a, s₂, b, u, u', sx, sy⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.fQ_tmulL_integrable
statement:
theorem fQ_tmulL_integrable {b₁ b₂} (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ B₁) (hb₂ : b₂ ∈ B₂) {e₁ φ₂ : ℕ}
    (he : ∀ a, (hL₁.eQ ϖ i ^ a) b₁ = 0 ↔ e₁ < a) (hφ : ∀ a, (hL₂.fQ ϖ i ^ a) b₂ = 0 ↔ φ₂ < a) :
    hL.fQ ϖ i (tmulL k b₁ b₂) =
      if e₁ < φ₂ then tmulL k b₁ (hL₂.fQ ϖ i b₂) else tmulL k (hL₁.fQ ϖ i b₁) b₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ₁, μ₂, x, y, hx, hy, hxw, hyw, rfl, rfl, s₁, a, s₂, b, u, u', sx, sy⟩ :=
    exists_isStringRep_pair hϖ i hB₁ hB₂ hb₁ hb₂
  have h1 : e₁ = s₁ := eq_of_forall_gt_iff fun m ↦
    (he m).symm.trans (sx.eQ_pow_eq_zero_iff (hL := hL₁) hx m)
  have h2 : φ₂ = b - s₂ := eq_of_forall_gt_iff fun m ↦
    (hφ m).symm.trans ((sy.fQ_pow_eq_zero_iff (hL := hL₂) hy m).trans (by have := sy.le; omega))
  subst h1 h2
  exact fQ_tmulL_of_isStringRep hϖ hϖv hL i hx hy hxw hyw sx sy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.eQ_tmulL_integrable
statement:
theorem eQ_tmulL_integrable {b₁ b₂} (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ B₁) (hb₂ : b₂ ∈ B₂) {e₁ φ₂ : ℕ}
    (he : ∀ a, (hL₁.eQ ϖ i ^ a) b₁ = 0 ↔ e₁ < a) (hφ : ∀ a, (hL₂.fQ ϖ i ^ a) b₂ = 0 ↔ φ₂ < a) :
    hL.eQ ϖ i (tmulL k b₁ b₂) =
      if e₁ ≤ φ₂ then tmulL k b₁ (hL₂.eQ ϖ i b₂) else tmulL k (hL₁.eQ ϖ i b₁) b₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ₁, μ₂, x, y, hx, hy, hxw, hyw, rfl, rfl, s₁, a, s₂, b, u, u', sx, sy⟩ :=
    exists_isStringRep_pair hϖ i hB₁ hB₂ hb₁ hb₂
  have h1 : e₁ = s₁ := eq_of_forall_gt_iff fun m ↦
    (he m).symm.trans (sx.eQ_pow_eq_zero_iff (hL := hL₁) hx m)
  have h2 : φ₂ = b - s₂ := eq_of_forall_gt_iff fun m ↦
    (hφ m).symm.trans ((sy.fQ_pow_eq_zero_iff (hL := hL₂) hy m).trans (by have := sy.le; omega))
  subst h1 h2
  exact eQ_tmulL_of_isStringRep hϖ hϖv hL i hx hy hxw hyw sx sy
