name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.fTilde_of_ker
statement: theorem fTilde_of_ker {x : M} (hx : V.e x = 0) : V.fTilde hq0 hq x = V.f x
proof:
:= by
  have := fTilde_df hq0 hq hx 0
  rw [df_zero] at this
  rw [this, df_apply, zero_add, pow_one, qFactorial_succ, qFactorial, mul_one]
  have : qInt q 1 = 1 := by simp [qInt]
  rw [this, inv_one, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.ext_df
statement:
theorem ext_df {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N] {φ ψ : M →ₗ[k] N}
    (h : ∀ n (x : M), V.e x = 0 → φ (V.df n x) = ψ (V.df n x)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  have : φ ∘ₗ (V.stringEquiv hq0 hq).toLinearMap = ψ ∘ₗ (V.stringEquiv hq0 hq).toLinearMap := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun n x ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, stringEquiv_apply, stringMap_single]
    exact h n x x.2
  ext m
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun this ((V.stringEquiv hq0 hq).symm m)
  simpa using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.eTilde_fTilde
statement: theorem eTilde_fTilde (m : M) : V.eTilde hq0 hq (V.fTilde hq0 hq m) = m
proof:
:= by
  have : V.eTilde hq0 hq ∘ₗ V.fTilde hq0 hq = LinearMap.id :=
    ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun n x hx ↦ by
      simp [fTilde_df hq0 hq hx, eTilde_df_succ hq0 hq hx]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.fTilde_injective
statement: theorem fTilde_injective : Function.Injective (V.fTilde hq0 hq)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (eTilde_fTilde hq0 hq)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.fTilde_eTilde_add_component
statement:
theorem fTilde_eTilde_add_component (m : M) :
    V.fTilde hq0 hq (V.eTilde hq0 hq m) + V.component hq0 hq 0 m = m
proof:
:= by
  have : V.fTilde hq0 hq ∘ₗ V.eTilde hq0 hq + V.component hq0 hq 0 = LinearMap.id :=
    ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun n x hx ↦ by
      rcases n with _ | n
      · have h0 : V.component hq0 hq 0 x = x := by simpa using component_df hq0 hq hx 0 0
        simp [eTilde_of_ker hq0 hq hx, h0]
      · simp [eTilde_df_succ hq0 hq hx, fTilde_df hq0 hq hx, component_df hq0 hq hx]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.eTilde_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem eTilde_eq_zero_iff (m : M) : V.eTilde hq0 hq m = 0 ↔ V.e m = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, eTilde_of_ker hq0 hq⟩
  have := fTilde_eTilde_add_component (V := V) hq0 hq m
  rw [h, map_zero, zero_add] at this
  rw [← this]
  exact e_component hq0 hq 0 m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.fTilde_pow_apply
statement:
theorem fTilde_pow_apply {x : M} (hx : V.e x = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (V.fTilde hq0 hq ^ n) x = V.df n x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, fTilde_df hq0 hq hx]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_df
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ (n : ℕ) m, φ ((V.f ^ n) m) = (V'.f ^ n) (φ m) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih => intro m; rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply,
        Module.End.mul_apply, hf, ih]
  rw [df_apply, df_apply, map_smul, hpow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_eTilde
statement:
theorem map_eTilde {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module k M'] (V' : BosonModule q M')
    (φ : M →ₗ[k] M') (he : ∀ m, φ (V.e m) = V'.e (φ m)) (hf : ∀ m, φ (V.f m) = V'.f (φ m))
    (m : M) : φ (V.eTilde hq0 hq m) = V'.eTilde hq0 hq (φ m)
proof:
:= by
  have : φ ∘ₗ V.eTilde hq0 hq = V'.eTilde hq0 hq ∘ₗ φ := ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun n x hx ↦ by
    have hx' : V'.e (φ x) = 0 := by rw [← he, hx, map_zero]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [map_df hf]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · rw [df_zero, df_zero, eTilde_of_ker hq0 hq hx, eTilde_of_ker hq0 hq hx', map_zero]
    · rw [eTilde_df_succ hq0 hq hx, eTilde_df_succ hq0 hq hx', map_df hf]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_fTilde
statement:
theorem map_fTilde {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module k M'] (V' : BosonModule q M')
    (φ : M →ₗ[k] M') (he : ∀ m, φ (V.e m) = V'.e (φ m)) (hf : ∀ m, φ (V.f m) = V'.f (φ m))
    (m : M) : φ (V.fTilde hq0 hq m) = V'.fTilde hq0 hq (φ m)
proof:
:= by
  have : φ ∘ₗ V.fTilde hq0 hq = V'.fTilde hq0 hq ∘ₗ φ := ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun n x hx ↦ by
    have hx' : V'.e (φ x) = 0 := by rw [← he, hx, map_zero]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [map_df hf, fTilde_df hq0 hq hx, fTilde_df hq0 hq hx', map_df hf]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_component
statement:
theorem map_component {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module k M'] (V' : BosonModule q M')
    (φ : M →ₗ[k] M') (he : ∀ m, φ (V.e m) = V'.e (φ m)) (hf : ∀ m, φ (V.f m) = V'.f (φ m))
    (n : ℕ) (m : M) : φ (V.component hq0 hq n m) = V'.component hq0 hq n (φ m)
proof:
:= by
  have : φ ∘ₗ V.component hq0 hq n = V'.component hq0 hq n ∘ₗ φ :=
      ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun n' x hx ↦ by
    have hx' : V'.e (φ x) = 0 := by rw [← he, hx, map_zero]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [map_df hf, component_df hq0 hq hx, component_df hq0 hq hx']
    split_ifs <;> simp
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_df_shift
statement:
lemma map_df_shift (hf : ∀ γ m, φ γ (V.f m) = V'.f (φ (γ - δ) m)) (n : ℕ) (γ : Γ) (m : M) :
    φ γ (V.df n m) = V'.df n (φ (γ - n • δ) m)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ (n : ℕ) (γ : Γ) m, φ γ ((V.f ^ n) m) = (V'.f ^ n) (φ (γ - n • δ) m) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro γ m
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, hf, ih,
        sub_sub, succ_nsmul, add_comm δ]
  rw [df_apply, df_apply, map_smul, hpow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_component_shift
statement:
theorem map_component_shift (he : ∀ γ m, φ γ (V.e m) = V'.e (φ (γ + δ) m))
    (hf : ∀ γ m, φ γ (V.f m) = V'.f (φ (γ - δ) m)) (n : ℕ) (γ : Γ) (m : M) :
    V'.component hq0 hq n (φ γ m) = φ (γ - n • δ) (V.component hq0 hq n m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, -, hm⟩ := V.exists_sum_component hq0 hq m
  have hker : ∀ j, V'.e (φ (γ - j • δ) (V.component hq0 hq j m)) = 0 := fun j ↦ by
    have := he (γ - j • δ - δ) (V.component hq0 hq j m)
    rw [e_component, map_zero, sub_add_cancel] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hsum : φ γ m = ∑ j ∈ range N, V'.df j (φ (γ - j • δ) (V.component hq0 hq j m)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hm]
    rw [map_sum]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ map_df_shift V' φ δ hf j γ _
  rw [hsum, component_sum hq0 hq hker]
  split_ifs with hn
  · rfl
  · have : V.component hq0 hq n m = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (V.component hq0 hq n) hm
      rw [component_sum hq0 hq (fun j ↦ e_component hq0 hq j m),
        ite_eq_right_iff.2 (fun h' ↦ absurd h' hn)] at h
      exact h
    rw [this, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_eTilde_shift
statement:
theorem map_eTilde_shift (he : ∀ γ m, φ γ (V.e m) = V'.e (φ (γ + δ) m))
    (hf : ∀ γ m, φ γ (V.f m) = V'.f (φ (γ - δ) m)) (γ : Γ) (m : M) :
    φ γ (V.eTilde hq0 hq m) = V'.eTilde hq0 hq (φ (γ + δ) m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, -, hm⟩ := V.exists_sum_component hq0 hq m
  have hker : ∀ j, V'.e (φ (γ + δ - j • δ) (V.component hq0 hq j m)) = 0 := fun j ↦ by
    have := he (γ + δ - j • δ - δ) (V.component hq0 hq j m)
    rw [e_component, map_zero, sub_add_cancel] at this
    exact this.symm
  conv_lhs => rw [hm]
  conv_rhs => rw [hm]
  rw [map_sum, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_df_shift V' φ δ hf j (γ + δ)]
  rcases j with _ | j
  · rw [df_zero, df_zero, eTilde_of_ker hq0 hq (e_component hq0 hq 0 m),
      eTilde_of_ker hq0 hq (by simpa using hker 0), map_zero]
  · rw [eTilde_df_succ hq0 hq (e_component hq0 hq _ m), eTilde_df_succ hq0 hq (hker _),
      map_df_shift V' φ δ hf j γ]
    congr 2
    rw [succ_nsmul]
    abel_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.map_fTilde_shift
statement:
theorem map_fTilde_shift (he : ∀ γ m, φ γ (V.e m) = V'.e (φ (γ + δ) m))
    (hf : ∀ γ m, φ γ (V.f m) = V'.f (φ (γ - δ) m)) (γ : Γ) (m : M) :
    φ γ (V.fTilde hq0 hq m) = V'.fTilde hq0 hq (φ (γ - δ) m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, -, hm⟩ := V.exists_sum_component hq0 hq m
  have hker : ∀ j, V'.e (φ (γ - δ - j • δ) (V.component hq0 hq j m)) = 0 := fun j ↦ by
    have := he (γ - δ - j • δ - δ) (V.component hq0 hq j m)
    rw [e_component, map_zero, sub_add_cancel] at this
    exact this.symm
  conv_lhs => rw [hm]
  conv_rhs => rw [hm]
  rw [map_sum, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_df_shift V' φ δ hf j (γ - δ), fTilde_df hq0 hq (e_component hq0 hq _ m),
    fTilde_df hq0 hq (hker _), map_df_shift V' φ δ hf (j + 1) γ]
  congr 2
  rw [succ_nsmul]
  abel_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.stable_iSup
statement:
lemma stable_iSup {ι : Type*} {Mt : Type*} [AddCommGroup Mt] [Module k Mt] [Module A Mt]
    [IsScalarTower A k Mt] (T : Module.End k Mt) (P : ι → Submodule A Mt)
    (hP : ∀ j, ∀ z ∈ P j, T z ∈ P j) {z : Mt} (hz : z ∈ ⨆ j, P j) : T z ∈ ⨆ j, P j
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem j z hz => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (hP j z hz)
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.nonneg_of_primitive
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact h0 (IntegrableSl2.eq_zero_of_primitive_of_neg (V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i)
    (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv i) hp hE (by omega))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.exists_stable_tmul_of_strings
statement:
theorem exists_stable_tmul_of_strings (hf₁ : ∀ y ∈ L₁, kashiwaraF R v M₁ hv h₁ i y ∈ L₁)
    (hf₂ : ∀ y ∈ L₂, kashiwaraF R v M₂ hv h₂ i y ∈ L₂) {μ₁ μ₂ : Y →+ ℤ}
    [IsLocalRing A] {ϖ : A} (hϖ : ϖ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {η : ℕ → M₁} {ζ : ℕ → M₂}
    (hηw : ∀ j : ℕ, η j ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ (μ₁ + j • R.root i)) (hηE : ∀ j, E R v i • η j = 0)
    (hη2 : ∀ j : ℕ, η j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ μ₁ (R.coroot i) + j)
    (hζw : ∀ j : ℕ, ζ j ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ (μ₂ + j • R.root i)) (hζE : ∀ j, E R v i • ζ j = 0)
    (hζ2 : ∀ j : ℕ, ζ j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ μ₂ (R.coroot i) + j)
    (hηL : ∀ j < N₁, η j ∈ L₁) (hζL : ∀ j < N₂, ζ j ∈ L₂) :
    ∃ N : Submodule A (TensorModule k M₁ M₂),
      mk M₁ M₂ ((∑ j ∈ range N₁, (nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF j (η j)) ⊗ₜ[k]
        (∑ j ∈ range N₂, (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).dF j (ζ j))) ∈ N ∧
      N ≤ lattice k A L₁ L₂ ∧
      (∀ z ∈ N, kashiwaraF R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i z ∈ N) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ N, kashiwaraE R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i z ∈ N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set a : ℕ → ℕ := fun s ↦ (μ₁ (R.coroot i) + 2 * s).toNat
  set b : ℕ → ℕ := fun t ↦ (μ₂ (R.coroot i) + 2 * t).toNat
  have hηp : ∀ s, η s ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).prim (a s) := fun s ↦ by
    by_cases h0 : η s = 0
    · rw [h0]; exact zero_mem _
    · have := hη2 s h0
      refine ⟨?_, hηE s⟩
      have hw := mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i (hηw s)
      rwa [show ((a s : ℕ) : ℤ) = μ₁ (R.coroot i) + 2 * s by simp only [a]; omega]
  have hζp : ∀ t, ζ t ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).prim (b t) := fun t ↦ by
    by_cases h0 : ζ t = 0
    · rw [h0]; exact zero_mem _
    · have := hζ2 t h0
      refine ⟨?_, hζE t⟩
      have hw := mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i (hζw t)
      rwa [show ((b t : ℕ) : ℤ) = μ₂ (R.coroot i) + 2 * t by simp only [b]; omega]
  let P : Fin N₁ × Fin N₂ → Submodule A (TensorModule k M₁ M₂) := fun st ↦
    pieceLattice hv h₁ h₂ i A (a st.1) (b st.2) (η st.1) (ζ st.2)
  refine ⟨⨆ st, P st, ?_, iSup_le fun st ↦ ?_, fun z hz ↦ stable_iSup _ P (fun st z hz ↦ ?_) hz,
    fun z hz ↦ stable_iSup _ P (fun st z hz ↦ ?_) hz⟩
  · rw [sum_tmul, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s hs ↦ ?_
    rw [tmul_sum, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t ht ↦ ?_
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨s, mem_range.1 hs⟩, ⟨t, mem_range.1 ht⟩)
      (tmul_mem_pieceLattice hv h₁ h₂ i (hηp s) (hζp t) s t)
  · refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨s', t'⟩, rfl⟩
    refine tmul_mem_lattice ?_ ?_
    · rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv h₁ i (hηE st.1) (hηp st.1).1]
      exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv h₁ i hf₁ _ (hηL _ st.1.2)
    · rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv h₂ i (hζE st.2) (hζp st.2).1]
      exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv h₂ i hf₂ _ (hζL _ st.2.2)
  · by_cases h0 : η st.1 = 0 ∨ ζ st.2 = 0
    · have hP : P st = ⊥ := by
        refine eq_bot_iff.2 (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
        rintro _ ⟨⟨s', t'⟩, rfl⟩
        rcases h0 with h0 | h0 <;> simp [h0]
      rw [hP, Submodule.mem_bot] at hz ⊢
      rw [hz, map_zero]
    · push Not at h0
      exact kashiwaraF_mem_pieceLattice hv h₁ h₂ i hϖ hϖv (hηp st.1) (hζp st.2) h0.1 h0.2 hz
  · by_cases h0 : η st.1 = 0 ∨ ζ st.2 = 0
    · have hP : P st = ⊥ := by
        refine eq_bot_iff.2 (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
        rintro _ ⟨⟨s', t'⟩, rfl⟩
        rcases h0 with h0 | h0 <;> simp [h0]
      rw [hP, Submodule.mem_bot] at hz ⊢
      rw [hz, map_zero]
    · push Not at h0
      exact kashiwaraE_mem_pieceLattice hv h₁ h₂ i hϖ hϖv (hηp st.1) (hζp st.2) h0.1 h0.2 hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.exists_stable_tmul
statement:
theorem exists_stable_tmul (hf₁ : ∀ y ∈ L₁, kashiwaraF R v M₁ hv h₁ i y ∈ L₁)
    (hf₂ : ∀ y ∈ L₂, kashiwaraF R v M₂ hv h₂ i y ∈ L₂) {μ₁ μ₂ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (he₁ : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ L₁, y ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ (μ₁ + j • R.root i) →
      kashiwaraE R v M₁ hv h₁ i y ∈ L₁)
    (he₂ : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ L₂, y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ (μ₂ + j • R.root i) →
      kashiwaraE R v M₂ hv h₂ i y ∈ L₂)
    [IsLocalRing A] {ϖ : A} (hϖ : ϖ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹)
    {x : M₁} {y : M₂} (hx : x ∈ L₁) (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ μ₁) (hy : y ∈ L₂)
    (hyw : y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ₂) :
    ∃ N : Submodule A (TensorModule k M₁ M₂), mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) ∈ N ∧
      N ≤ lattice k A L₁ L₂ ∧
      (∀ z ∈ N, kashiwaraF R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i z ∈ N) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ N, kashiwaraE R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i z ∈ N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, η, hηw, hηE, hη2, -, rfl⟩ := exists_sum_dF_weight hv h₁ i hxw
  obtain ⟨N₂, ζ, hζw, hζE, hζ2, -, rfl⟩ := exists_sum_dF_weight hv h₂ i hyw
  exact exists_stable_tmul_of_strings hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ hϖ hϖv hηw hηE hη2 hζw hζE hζ2
    (mem_of_sum_mem_weight hv h₁ i hf₁ N₁ μ₁ η hηw hηE hη2 he₁ hx)
    (mem_of_sum_mem_weight hv h₂ i hf₂ N₂ μ₂ ζ hζw hζE hζ2 he₂ hy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.kashiwaraF_tmul_mem
statement:
theorem kashiwaraF_tmul_mem {x : M₁} {y : M₂} (hx : x ∈ L₁) (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ μ₁)
    (hy : y ∈ L₂) (hyw : y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ₂) :
    kashiwaraF R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)) ∈ lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hle, hf, -⟩ := exists_stable_tmul hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ he₁ he₂ hϖ hϖv hx hxw hy hyw
  exact hle (hf _ hN)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.kashiwaraE_tmul_mem
statement:
theorem kashiwaraE_tmul_mem {x : M₁} {y : M₂} (hx : x ∈ L₁) (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ μ₁)
    (hy : y ∈ L₂) (hyw : y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ₂) :
    kashiwaraE R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)) ∈ lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hle, -, he⟩ := exists_stable_tmul hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ he₁ he₂ hϖ hϖv hx hxw hy hyw
  exact hle (he _ hN)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.exists_smul_weight
statement:
lemma exists_smul_weight {ϖ : A} (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0) {S : Submodule k M₁}
    {z : M₁} (hz : z ∈ ϖ • L₁) (hzS : z ∈ S) : ∃ z₀ ∈ L₁, z₀ ∈ S ∧ z = ϖ • z₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hz
  refine ⟨z₀, hz₀, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [← algebraMap_smul k] at hzS
  have := S.smul_mem (algebraMap A k ϖ)⁻¹ hzS
  rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hϖv, one_smul] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.pieceLattice_le_lattice
statement:
lemma pieceLattice_le_lattice (hf₁ : ∀ y ∈ L₁, kashiwaraF R v M₁ hv h₁ i y ∈ L₁)
    (hf₂ : ∀ y ∈ L₂, kashiwaraF R v M₂ hv h₂ i y ∈ L₂) {a b : ℕ} {u : M₁} {u' : M₂}
    (hu : u ∈ L₁) (hup : u ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).prim a) (hu' : u' ∈ L₂)
    (hu'p : u' ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).prim b) :
    pieceLattice hv h₁ h₂ i A a b u u' ≤ lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨s, t⟩, rfl⟩
  refine tmul_mem_lattice ?_ ?_
  · rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv h₁ i hup.2 hup.1]
    exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv h₁ i hf₁ _ hu
  · rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv h₂ i hu'p.2 hu'p.1]
    exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv h₂ i hf₂ _ hu'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.smul_le_smul_of_le
statement:
lemma smul_le_smul_of_le {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] {P Q : Submodule A N}
    (h : P ≤ Q) (c : A) : c • P ≤ c • Q
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hz
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (h hz₀)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.exists_tmul_decomp
statement:
lemma exists_tmul_decomp : ∃ x₀ ∈ L₁, x₀ ∈ weightSpace R v M₁ μ₁ ∧ ∃ y₀ ∈ L₂,
    y₀ ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ₂ ∧ mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
      mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).dF k₂ u') +
        ϖ • mk M₁ M₂ (x₀ ⊗ₜ[k] y) +
        ϖ • mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] y₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀w, hxe⟩ := exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hxu
    (sub_mem hxw (dF_mem_weightSpace hv h₁ i huw))
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hy₀w, hye⟩ := exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hyu
    (sub_mem hyw (dF_mem_weightSpace hv h₂ i hu'w))
  refine ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀w, y₀, hy₀, hy₀w, ?_⟩
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add'] at hxe hye
  have hmk : ∀ (c : A) (z : M₁ ⊗[k] M₂), mk M₁ M₂ (c • z) = c • mk M₁ M₂ z := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  have h2 : mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
      mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).dF k₂ u') +
        ϖ • mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] y₀) := by
    rw [hye, tmul_add, tmul_smul, map_add, hmk]
  have h1 : mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] y) +
      ϖ • mk M₁ M₂ (x₀ ⊗ₜ[k] y) := by
    rw [← hmk, smul_tmul', ← map_add, ← add_tmul, ← hxe]
  rw [h1, h2]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.kashiwaraF_tmul_sub_mem
statement:
theorem kashiwaraF_tmul_sub_mem :
    kashiwaraF R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)) -
      (if k₁ < b - k₂ then
        mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).dF (k₂ + 1) u')
      else
        mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF (k₁ + 1) u ⊗ₜ[k] (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).dF k₂ u'))
      ∈ ϖ • lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀w, y₀, hy₀, hy₀w, he⟩ := exists_tmul_decomp hv h₁ h₂ i hϖv hxw hyw huw
    hu'w hxu hyu
  have hup : u ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).prim a :=
    ⟨by rw [hua]; exact mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i huw, huE⟩
  have hu'p : u' ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).prim b :=
    ⟨by rw [hu'b]; exact mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i hu'w, hu'E⟩
  have hFu : (nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ∈ L₁ := by
    rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv h₁ i huE hup.1]
    exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv h₁ i hf₁ _ hu
  have hmain := kashiwaraF_piece_sub hv h₁ h₂ i hϖ hϖv hup hu'p hu0 hu'0 hk₁ hk₂
  have hle := smul_le_smul_of_le (pieceLattice_le_lattice hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ hu hup hu' hu'p) ϖ
  rw [he, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower,
    add_sub_right_comm, add_sub_right_comm]
  refine add_mem (add_mem (hle hmain) ?_) ?_
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _
      (kashiwaraF_tmul_mem hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ he₁ he₂ hϖ hϖv hx₀ hx₀w hy hyw)
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _
      (kashiwaraF_tmul_mem hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ he₁ he₂ hϖ hϖv hFu
        (dF_mem_weightSpace hv h₁ i huw) hy₀ hy₀w)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.kashiwaraE_tmul_sub_mem
statement:
theorem kashiwaraE_tmul_sub_mem :
    kashiwaraE R v _ hv (isIntegrable h₁ h₂) i (mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)) -
      (if k₁ ≤ b - k₂ then
        (if k₂ = 0 then 0 else
          mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ⊗ₜ[k] (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).dF (k₂ - 1) u'))
      else
        mk M₁ M₂ ((nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF (k₁ - 1) u ⊗ₜ[k] (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).dF k₂ u'))
      ∈ ϖ • lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀w, y₀, hy₀, hy₀w, he⟩ := exists_tmul_decomp hv h₁ h₂ i hϖv hxw hyw huw
    hu'w hxu hyu
  have hup : u ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).prim a :=
    ⟨by rw [hua]; exact mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i huw, huE⟩
  have hu'p : u' ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M₂ hv h₂ i).prim b :=
    ⟨by rw [hu'b]; exact mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i hu'w, hu'E⟩
  have hFu : (nodeSl2 R v M₁ hv h₁ i).dF k₁ u ∈ L₁ := by
    rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive hv h₁ i huE hup.1]
    exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem hv h₁ i hf₁ _ hu
  have hmain := kashiwaraE_piece_sub hv h₁ h₂ i hϖ hϖv hup hu'p hu0 hu'0 hk₁ hk₂
  have hle := smul_le_smul_of_le (pieceLattice_le_lattice hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ hu hup hu' hu'p) ϖ
  rw [he, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower,
    add_sub_right_comm, add_sub_right_comm]
  refine add_mem (add_mem (hle hmain) ?_) ?_
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _
      (kashiwaraE_tmul_mem hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ he₁ he₂ hϖ hϖv hx₀ hx₀w hy hyw)
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _
      (kashiwaraE_tmul_mem hv h₁ h₂ i hf₁ hf₂ he₁ he₂ hϖ hϖv hFu
        (dF_mem_weightSpace hv h₁ i huw) hy₀ hy₀w)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem barTensor_tmul (x y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    barTensor R (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) = barHom R x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] barHom R y
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_one
statement: @[simp] theorem barTensor_one : barTensor R 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_mul
statement:
theorem barTensor_mul (s t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    barTensor R (s * t) = barTensor R s * barTensor R t
proof:
:= by
  induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [add_mul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, add_mul]
  | tmul x y =>
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [mul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, mul_add]
    | tmul x' y' => simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_barTensor
statement:
@[simp] theorem barTensor_barTensor (t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    barTensor R (barTensor R t) = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul x y => simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientBar_mem
statement:
lemma quotientBar_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν) :
    quotientBar D x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨LusztigF.bar a, LusztigF.bar_mem_weightSpace ha, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_quotientWeightSpace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨a * b, LusztigF.mul_mem_weightSpace ha hb, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_quotientMinus
statement:
theorem barHom_quotientMinus (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    barHom R (quotientMinus R x) = quotientMinus R (quotientBar D x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  rw [quotientMinus_toQuotient, barHom_minusHom, quotientBar_toQuotient,
    quotientMinus_toQuotient]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_quotientPlus
statement:
theorem barHom_quotientPlus (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    barHom R (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R (quotientBar D x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  rw [quotientPlus_toQuotient, barHom_plusHom, quotientBar_toQuotient,
    quotientPlus_toQuotient]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_mem_weightTensor
statement:
theorem barTensor_mem_weightTensor {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (ht : t ∈ weightTensor R ν) : barTensor R t ∈ weightTensor R ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := ht
  induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | tmul x y =>
    refine ⟨⟨quotientBar D x, quotientBar_mem x.2⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨quotientBar D y, quotientBar_mem y.2⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [barHom_quotientMinus, barHom_quotientPlus]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_weightTensor
statement:
theorem mul_mem_weightTensor {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} {s t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hs : s ∈ weightTensor R ν) (ht : t ∈ weightTensor R μ) : s * t ∈ weightTensor R (ν + μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := ht
  induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_mul]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | tmul x y =>
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, mul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | tmul x' y' =>
      refine ⟨⟨x * x', mul_mem_quotientWeightSpace x.2 x'.2⟩ ⊗ₜ
        ⟨y * y', mul_mem_quotientWeightSpace y.2 y'.2⟩, ?_⟩
      simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRBarProd_mem
statement: theorem quasiRBarProd_mem (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : quasiRBarProd R ν ∈ weightTensor R ν
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [← hp]
  exact mul_mem_weightTensor R (quasiR_mem_range R p.1)
    (barTensor_mem_weightTensor R (quasiR_mem_range R p.2))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRBarProd_zero
statement: theorem quasiRBarProd_zero : quasiRBarProd R 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [quasiRBarProd]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_antidiagonal_sub_single
statement:
lemma sum_antidiagonal_sub_single {T : Type*} [AddCommMonoid T] (i : I) (ν : I →₀ ℕ)
    (f : (I →₀ ℕ) → (I →₀ ℕ) → T) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal ν, (if p.1 i = 0 then 0 else f (p.1 - Finsupp.single i 1) p.2) =
      if ν i = 0 then 0 else
        ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal (ν - Finsupp.single i 1), f p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hν
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have : p.1 i = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (· i) hp
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at this
      omega
    simp [this]
  · have e : ∀ p : (I →₀ ℕ) × (I →₀ ℕ),
        (if p.1 i = 0 then 0 else f (p.1 - Finsupp.single i 1) p.2) =
          if p.1 i ≠ 0 then f (p.1 - Finsupp.single i 1) p.2 else 0 := fun p ↦ by
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    simp_rw [e]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun p ↦ (p.1 - Finsupp.single i 1, p.2))
      (fun q ↦ (q.1 + Finsupp.single i 1, q.2)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢
      obtain ⟨hp, hpi⟩ := hp
      ext j
      have := congrArg (· j) hp
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply] at this ⊢
      split_ifs at * with h <;> (try subst h) <;> omega
    · intro q hq
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq ⊢
      refine ⟨?_, by simp⟩
      ext j
      have := congrArg (· j) hq
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply] at this ⊢
      split_ifs at * with h <;> (try subst h) <;> omega
    · intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hp
      refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
      ext j
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs at * with h <;> (try subst h) <;> omega
    · intro q _
      simp
    · intro p _
      rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_antidiagonal_sub_single'
statement:
lemma sum_antidiagonal_sub_single' {T : Type*} [AddCommMonoid T] (i : I) (ν : I →₀ ℕ)
    (f : (I →₀ ℕ) → (I →₀ ℕ) → T) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal ν, (if p.2 i = 0 then 0 else f p.1 (p.2 - Finsupp.single i 1)) =
      if ν i = 0 then 0 else
        ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal (ν - Finsupp.single i 1), f p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.sum_antidiagonal_swap ν
    (fun a b ↦ if b i = 0 then 0 else f a (b - Finsupp.single i 1)),
    sum_antidiagonal_sub_single i ν (fun a b ↦ f b a)]
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · rw [Finsupp.sum_antidiagonal_swap]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_E_sub
statement:
lemma quasiR_E_sub (a : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * quasiR R a - quasiR R a * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) =
      if a i = 0 then 0 else
        quasiR R (a - Finsupp.single i 1) * (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) -
          (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) * quasiR R (a - Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with ha
  · rw [quasiR_E_of_eq_zero R i ha, sub_self]
  · have h := quasiR_E R i (a - Finsupp.single i 1)
    rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Finsupp.single_le_iff.2 (by omega))] at h
    rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, h, add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_quasiR_E_sub
statement:
lemma barTensor_quasiR_E_sub (b : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * barTensor R (quasiR R b) - barTensor R (quasiR R b) * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) =
      if b i = 0 then 0 else
        barTensor R (quasiR R (b - Finsupp.single i 1)) * (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) -
          (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) *
            barTensor R (quasiR R (b - Finsupp.single i 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (barTensor R) (quasiR_E_sub R i b)
  rw [map_sub, barTensor_mul, barTensor_mul, barTensor_tmul, barHom_E, map_one] at h
  rw [h]
  split_ifs
  · simp
  · rw [map_sub, barTensor_mul, barTensor_mul, barTensor_tmul, barTensor_tmul, barHom_K,
      barHom_K, barHom_E, neg_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRBarProd_E_sub
statement:
theorem quasiRBarProd_E_sub (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * quasiRBarProd R ν - quasiRBarProd R ν * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) =
      if ν i = 0 then 0 else
        quasiRBarProd R (ν - Finsupp.single i 1) * (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) -
          (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) * quasiRBarProd R (ν - Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  set e := E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
  set kp := K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i
  set km := K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i
  have key : ∀ a b : I →₀ ℕ, e * (quasiR R a * barTensor R (quasiR R b)) -
      quasiR R a * barTensor R (quasiR R b) * e =
      (if a i = 0 then 0 else
        quasiR R (a - Finsupp.single i 1) * km * barTensor R (quasiR R b) -
          kp * quasiR R (a - Finsupp.single i 1) * barTensor R (quasiR R b)) +
      (if b i = 0 then 0 else
        quasiR R a * barTensor R (quasiR R (b - Finsupp.single i 1)) * kp -
          quasiR R a * km * barTensor R (quasiR R (b - Finsupp.single i 1))) := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := quasiR_E_sub R i a
    have h2 := barTensor_quasiR_E_sub R i b
    have : e * (quasiR R a * barTensor R (quasiR R b)) -
        quasiR R a * barTensor R (quasiR R b) * e =
        (e * quasiR R a - quasiR R a * e) * barTensor R (quasiR R b) +
          quasiR R a * (e * barTensor R (quasiR R b) - barTensor R (quasiR R b) * e) := by
      noncomm_ring
    rw [this, h1, h2]
    congr 1
    · split_ifs
      · simp
      · rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc]
    · split_ifs
      · simp
      · rw [mul_sub, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  rw [quasiRBarProd, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [key, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_antidiagonal_sub_single i ν
      (fun a b ↦ quasiR R a * km * barTensor R (quasiR R b) -
        kp * quasiR R a * barTensor R (quasiR R b)),
    sum_antidiagonal_sub_single' i ν
      (fun a b ↦ quasiR R a * barTensor R (quasiR R b) * kp -
        quasiR R a * km * barTensor R (quasiR R b))]
  split_ifs
  · simp
  · rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, quasiRBarProd, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_quasiR_mul_barTensor
statement:
theorem sum_quasiR_mul_barTensor (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal ν, quasiR R p.1 * barTensor R (quasiR R p.2) =
      if ν = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  change quasiRBarProd R ν = _
  induction h : ν.degree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing ν with
  | _ n ih =>
  split_ifs with hν
  · rw [hν, quasiRBarProd_zero]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := quasiRBarProd_mem R ν
  rw [← ht]
  suffices t = 0 by rw [this, map_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_forall_E_commute R hν t fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [ht, ← sub_eq_zero, quasiRBarProd_E_sub]
  split_ifs with hνi
  · rfl
  · have hlt : (ν - Finsupp.single i 1).degree < n := by
      rw [← h]
      have hle : Finsupp.single i 1 ≤ ν := Finsupp.single_le_iff.2 (by omega)
      conv_rhs => rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle]
      rw [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]
      omega
    rw [ih _ hlt _ rfl]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_barTensor_mul_quasiR
statement:
theorem sum_barTensor_mul_quasiR (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal ν, barTensor R (quasiR R p.1) * quasiR R p.2 =
      if ν = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (barTensor R) (sum_quasiR_mul_barTensor R ν)
  simp only [map_sum, barTensor_mul, barTensor_barTensor] at h
  rw [h]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_smul

proof:

  | add a b ha hb => rw [smul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | tmul x y => rw [smul_tmul', barTensor_tmul, barTensor_tmul, barHom_smul, smul_tmul']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.actPair_quasiR_tmul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := quasiR_mem_range R ν
  rw [← hs]
  clear hs
  induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [map_tmul, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype,

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.support_quasiR_finite
statement:
lemma support_quasiR_finite (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    (Function.support fun ν ↦ act₂ (quasiR R ν) z).Finite
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb =>
    refine (ha.union hb).subset fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    simp only [Function.mem_support, map_add] at hν
    by_contra hc
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at hc
    exact hν (by rw [hc.1, hc.2, add_zero])
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h y
    refine (Finsupp.finite_of_degree_lt (σ := I) N).subset fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    by_contra hc
    exact hν (actPair_quasiR_tmul_eq_zero (hN ν (not_lt.1 hc)) x)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRAct_apply
statement:
theorem quasiRAct_apply (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    quasiRAct h z = ∑ᶠ ν, act₂ (quasiR R ν) z
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.finsum_eq_add_shift
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s := hφ.toFinset
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (· + Finsupp.single i 1) ((· + Finsupp.single i 1) ⁻¹' ↑s) :=
    fun a _ b _ hab ↦ add_right_cancel hab
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset φ (s := s) (by simp [s]),
    finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := s) (fun ν hν ↦ by
      simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, not_forall] at hν
      simpa [s] using hν.2),
    finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := s.preimage _ hinj) (fun μ hμ ↦ by
      simpa [s] using hμ)]
  have hg : ∑ μ ∈ s.preimage _ hinj, φ (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) =
      ∑ ν ∈ s, if ν i = 0 then 0 else φ ν := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_preimage (· + Finsupp.single i 1) s hinj
      (fun ν ↦ if ν i = 0 then 0 else φ ν)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ ?_
      simp
    · intro ν _ hν
      split_ifs with hc
      · rfl
      refine absurd ⟨ν - Finsupp.single i 1, tsub_add_cancel_of_le fun j ↦ ?_⟩ hν
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same]; omega
      · simp [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hj]
  rw [hg, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.actPair_quasiRAct_of
statement:
lemma actPair_quasiRAct_of (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (i : I)
    {a b a' b' : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (h₀ : ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, ν i = 0 → a * quasiR R ν = quasiR R ν * a')
    (h₁ : ∀ μ : I →₀ ℕ, a * quasiR R (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) + b * quasiR R μ =
      quasiR R (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) * a' + quasiR R μ * b')
    (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    act₂ (a + b) (quasiRAct h z) = quasiRAct h (act₂ (a' + b') z)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin := support_quasiR_finite h z
  have hfin' := support_quasiR_finite h (act₂ a' z)
  have hfin'' := support_quasiR_finite h (act₂ b' z)
  have hA : (Function.support fun ν ↦ act₂ a (act₂ (quasiR R ν) z)).Finite :=
    hfin.subset (Function.support_comp_subset (map_zero _) _)
  have hB : (Function.support fun ν ↦ act₂ b (act₂ (quasiR R ν) z)).Finite :=
    hfin.subset (Function.support_comp_subset (map_zero _) _)
  have hshift {φ : (I →₀ ℕ) → M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂} (hφ : (Function.support φ).Finite) :
      (Function.support fun μ ↦ φ (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)).Finite :=
    hφ.preimage fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ add_right_cancel h
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, quasiRAct_apply]
  rw [map_finsum _ hfin, map_finsum _ hfin, finsum_eq_add_shift i hA,
    finsum_eq_add_shift i hfin', add_assoc, add_assoc, ← finsum_add_distrib (hshift hA) hB,
    ← finsum_add_distrib (hshift hfin') hfin'']
  congr 1
  · refine finsum_congr fun ν ↦ ?_
    split_ifs with hν
    · rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, h₀ ν hν, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    · rfl
  · refine finsum_congr fun μ ↦ ?_
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul, LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] using
      congrArg (fun t ↦ act₂ t z) (h₁ μ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.actPair_quasiRAct_of_commute
statement:
lemma actPair_quasiRAct_of_commute (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂)
    {a : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (ha : ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, a * quasiR R ν = quasiR R ν * a) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    act₂ a (quasiRAct h z) = quasiRAct h (act₂ a z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quasiRAct_apply, quasiRAct_apply, map_finsum _ (support_quasiR_finite h z)]
  refine finsum_congr fun ν ↦ ?_
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, ha ν, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.act_quasiRAct
statement:
theorem act_quasiRAct (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    TensorModule.act R 𝕧 M₁ M₂ u (quasiRAct h z) = quasiRAct h (act₂ (barComul R u) z)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on generalizing z with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, barComul_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply,
      Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul]
  | E i =>
    rw [TensorModule.act, AlgHom.comp_apply, comul_E, barComul_E]
    exact actPair_quasiRAct_of h i (fun ν hν ↦ quasiR_E_of_eq_zero R i hν) (quasiR_E R i) z
  | F i =>
    rw [TensorModule.act, AlgHom.comp_apply, comul_F, barComul_F,
      add_comm (F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)),
      add_comm (F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i))]
    exact actPair_quasiRAct_of h i (fun ν hν ↦ quasiR_F_of_eq_zero R i hν) (quasiR_F R i) z
  | K μ =>
    rw [TensorModule.act, AlgHom.comp_apply, comul_K, barComul_K]
    exact actPair_quasiRAct_of_commute h (fun ν ↦ quasiR_K R μ ν) z
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, hx, map_mul, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_smul_of_barHom
statement: lemma map_smul_of_barHom (c : 𝕂) (m : M₁) : ψ₁ (c • m) = RatFunc.bar c • ψ₁ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul (QuantumGroup R 𝕧), hψ₁, barHom_algebraMap, algebraMap_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barPair_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem barPair_tmul (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) = ψ₁ x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] ψ₂ y
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barPair_actPair
statement:
theorem barPair_actPair (t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ (act₂ t z) = act₂ (barTensor R t) (barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add,
      LinearMap.add_apply]
  | tmul a b =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz', map_add, map_add]
    | tmul x y => simp [TensorModule.act_tmul, hψ₁, hψ₂]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.act_quasiRAct_barPair
statement:
theorem act_quasiRAct_barPair (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    TensorModule.act R 𝕧 M₁ M₂ u (quasiRAct h (barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ z)) =
      quasiRAct h (barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 M₁ M₂ (barHom R u) z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [act_quasiRAct, TensorModule.act, AlgHom.comp_apply, barPair_actPair, ← barComul_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_serreIdeal_of_minusHom_mul_K_add
statement:
theorem mem_serreIdeal_of_minusHom_mul_K_add {μ ν : Y} (h : μ ≠ ν) {y y' : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : minusHom R v y * K R v μ + minusHom R v y' * K R v ν = 0) : y ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  have hz : y ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ (1 : k) ⊗ₜ (1 : LusztigF k I)) +
      y' ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single ν (1 : k) ⊗ₜ (1 : LusztigF k I)) ∈
        serreTriSubmodule Y D v :=
    mem_serreTriSubmodule_of_triMap_eq_zero R v hv' (by simpa using hy)
  let π : TriSpace k I Y →ₗ[k] LusztigF k I ⧸ serreSubmodule D v :=
    (TensorProduct.rid k _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (serreSubmodule D v).mkQ
      ((TensorProduct.lid k k).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (Finsupp.lapply μ ∘ₗ (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).toLinearMap)
          (LusztigF.counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap)
  have hπ : ∀ y' (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) x, π (y' ⊗ₜ (g ⊗ₜ x)) =
      (g.coeff μ • LusztigF.counit x) • Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) y' :=
    fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl
  have hW : serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker π := by
    rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨y', g, x, rfl, h | h⟩
    · have : Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := serreSubmodule D v) y' = 0 :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (mem_serreSubmodule.2 h)
      simp [hπ, this]
    · simp [hπ, counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal h]
  have := hW hz
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, hπ, hπ] at this
  simp only [map_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
  classical
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_true, h.symm, ite_false,
    zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this
  exact mem_serreSubmodule.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_forall_quotientRDeriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_quotientRDeriv_eq_zero {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0)
    {y : Quotient D 𝕧} (hy : y ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν)
    (h : ∀ i, quotientRDeriv D i y = 0) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  rw [toQuotient_eq_zero_iff]
  refine mem_radical_of_rDeriv_mem D 𝕧 ?_ fun i ↦ ?_
  · have := quotientForm_eq_zero_of_ne D hν hy (one_mem_quotientWeightSpace_zero)
    rwa [← map_one (toQuotient D 𝕧), quotientForm_toQuotient, form_one_right] at this
  · rw [← toQuotient_eq_zero_iff, ← quotientRDeriv_toQuotient]
    exact h i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientMinus_mul_K_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem quotientMinus_mul_K_add_eq_zero {μ ν : Y} (h : μ ≠ ν) {a b : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hab : quotientMinus R a * K R 𝕧 μ + quotientMinus R b * K R 𝕧 ν = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 b
  rw [toQuotient_eq_zero_iff, radical_eq_serreIdeal_ratFunc]
  exact mem_serreIdeal_of_minusHom_mul_K_add R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root h hab

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ktilde_ne_neg
statement: lemma ktilde_ne_neg (i : I) : ktilde R i ≠ -ktilde R i
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg (R.root i) h
  rw [map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot] at h'
  have := D.dot_self_pos i
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sub_inv_ratFunc_ne_zero
statement: lemma sub_inv_ratFunc_ne_zero (i : I) : 𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 : (𝕧 ^ D.d i : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have h1 : (𝕧 ^ D.d i) * 𝕧 ^ D.d i = 1 := by
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    nth_rewrite 2 [h]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ h0
  refine ratFunc_X_not_root (D.d i * 2) (by have := D.d_pos i; omega) ?_
  rw [pow_mul, sq, h1]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_injective
statement: private lemma pairMap_injective {μ ν : Y} (h : μ ≠ ν) : Function.Injective (pairMap R μ ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hab
  simp only [pairMap, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.fst_apply,
    LinearMap.snd_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply] at hab
  have ha := quotientMinus_mul_K_add_eq_zero R h hab
  have hb := quotientMinus_mul_K_add_eq_zero R h.symm (by rw [add_comm]; exact hab)
  simp [ha, hb]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rTensor_quotientRDeriv_eq_zero_of_commute
statement:
theorem rTensor_quotientRDeriv_eq_zero_of_commute {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (i : I) {W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module 𝕂 W] (g : W →ₗ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (t : quotientWeightSpace D ν ⊗[𝕂] W)
    (h : (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) *
        map ((quotientMinus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype) g t =
      map ((quotientMinus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype) g t *
        (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1)) :
    (quotientRDeriv D i ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype).rTensor W t = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hνi : ν i = 0
  · have : quotientRDeriv D i ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype = 0 :=
      LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ quotientRDeriv_eq_zero i hνi y.2
    rw [this, LinearMap.rTensor_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨μ, rfl⟩ : ∃ μ, ν = μ + Finsupp.single i 1 :=
    ⟨ν - Finsupp.single i 1, (tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Finsupp.single_le_iff.2
      (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hνi))).symm⟩
  set S := (quotientWeightSpace D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)).subtype
  set γ : 𝕂 := (𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹
  set c : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ R.rootSum μ (-ktilde R i)
  set P := LinearMap.prod (c • (quotientLDeriv D i ∘ₗ S)) (-(quotientRDeriv D i ∘ₗ S))
  have key : LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (E R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ S -
      LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (E R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ S =
        γ • (pairMap R (ktilde R i) (-ktilde R i) ∘ₗ P) := by
    ext y
    have hK := K_mul_quotientMinus_of_mem R (ktilde R i) (quotientLDeriv_mem i y.2)
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
      LinearMap.mulRight_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, pairMap, P,
      LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply, LinearMap.prod_apply,
      Function.prod, E_mul_quotientMinus_sub]
    simp only [S, Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, map_smul, map_neg, hK, c, γ, smul_mul_assoc, neg_mul,
      sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [tmul_mul_map, map_mul_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_one, LinearMap.mulRight_one,
    LinearMap.id_comp, ← sub_eq_zero, ← LinearMap.sub_apply, ← map_sub_left', key,
    map_smul_left, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_zero, or_iff_right (inv_ne_zero (sub_inv_ratFunc_ne_zero i)),
    ← LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_comp,
    LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
  have h1 := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap g hg
    (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have h2 := Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _
    (pairMap_injective R (ktilde_ne_neg R i)) (h1.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have h3 := congrArg ((LinearMap.snd 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) (Quotient D 𝕧)).rTensor W) h2
  rw [map_zero, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp] at h3
  simpa only [P, LinearMap.snd_prod, LinearMap.rTensor_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply,
    neg_eq_zero] using h3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_forall_E_commute
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_E_commute {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0)
    (t : quotientWeightSpace D ν ⊗[𝕂] quotientWeightSpace D ν)
    (hE : ∀ i, (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) *
        map ((quotientMinus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype)
          ((quotientPlus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype) t =
      map ((quotientMinus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype)
          ((quotientPlus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype) t *
        (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1)) : t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hg : Function.Injective
      ((quotientPlus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype) :=
    (quotientPlus_injective R).comp (Submodule.injective_subtype _)
  have hr : ∀ i, (quotientRDeriv D i ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype).rTensor
      (quotientWeightSpace D ν) t = 0 := fun i ↦
    rTensor_quotientRDeriv_eq_zero_of_commute R i _ hg t (hE i)
  let L : quotientWeightSpace D ν →ₗ[𝕂] (I → Quotient D 𝕧) :=
    LinearMap.pi fun i ↦ quotientRDeriv D i ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype
  have hL : Function.Injective L := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro y hy
    exact Subtype.ext (eq_zero_of_forall_quotientRDeriv_eq_zero hν y.2
      fun i ↦ congrFun hy i)
  have hLsum : L = ∑ i, LinearMap.single 𝕂 (fun _ ↦ Quotient D 𝕧) i ∘ₗ
      (quotientRDeriv D i ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype) := by
    ext y j
    simp [L, Pi.single_apply]
  refine Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap L hL ?_
  have hsum := map_sum (LinearMap.rTensorHom (M := quotientWeightSpace D ν))
    (fun i ↦ LinearMap.single 𝕂 (fun _ ↦ Quotient D 𝕧) i ∘ₗ
      (quotientRDeriv D i ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype)) Finset.univ
  rw [map_zero, hLsum]
  refine (congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe hsum) t).trans ?_
  rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
  change LinearMap.rTensor _ (_ ∘ₗ _) t = 0
  rw [LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, hr i, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_unique
statement:
theorem quasiR_unique (Θ' : (I →₀ ℕ) → QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (h0 : Θ' 0 = 1)
    (hmem : ∀ ν, Θ' ν ∈ LinearMap.range (map
      ((quotientMinus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype)
      ((quotientPlus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype)))
    (hE : ∀ i μ, (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * Θ' (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) +
        (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) * Θ' μ =
      Θ' (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) +
        Θ' μ * (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i))
    (hE0 : ∀ i ν, ν i = 0 → (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * Θ' ν = Θ' ν * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1)) :
    Θ' = quasiR R
proof:
:= by
  funext ν
  induction ν using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | _ ν ih =>
  by_cases hν : ν = 0
  · subst hν; rw [h0, quasiR_zero]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Submodule.sub_mem _ (hmem ν) (quasiR_mem_range R ν)
  suffices t = 0 by rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← ht, this, map_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_forall_E_commute R hν t fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [ht, mul_sub, sub_mul, sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add]
  by_cases hνi : ν i = 0
  · rw [hE0 i ν hνi, quasiR_E_of_eq_zero R i hνi, add_comm]
  obtain ⟨μ, rfl⟩ : ∃ μ, ν = μ + Finsupp.single i 1 :=
    ⟨ν - Finsupp.single i 1, (tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Finsupp.single_le_iff.2
      (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hνi))).symm⟩
  have hμ : Θ' μ = quasiR R μ :=
    ih μ (lt_add_of_pos_right μ (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero)))
  have h1 := hE i μ
  have h2 := quasiR_E R i μ
  rw [hμ] at h1
  rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq h1, eq_sub_of_add_eq h2]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tmul_mem_plusPart
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_plusPart (a : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I}
    (hx : x ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν) : a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] plusHom R 𝕧 x ∈ plusPart R ν
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, x, hx, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barTensor_mem_plusPart
statement:
lemma barTensor_mem_plusPart {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (ht : t ∈ plusPart R ν) : barTensor R t ∈ plusPart R ν
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem t ht =>
    obtain ⟨a, x, hx, rfl⟩ := ht
    rw [barTensor_tmul, barHom_plusHom]
    exact tmul_mem_plusPart _ (LusztigF.bar_mem_weightSpace hx)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add s t _ _ hs ht => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hs ht
  | smul c t _ ht => rw [barTensor_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ht

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_plusPart
statement:
lemma mul_mem_plusPart {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} {s t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hs : s ∈ plusPart R ν) (ht : t ∈ plusPart R μ) : s * t ∈ plusPart R (ν + μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem s hs =>
    obtain ⟨a, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hs
    induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem t ht =>
      obtain ⟨b, y, hy, rfl⟩ := ht
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, ← map_mul]
      exact tmul_mem_plusPart _ (LusztigF.mul_mem_weightSpace hx hy)
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add t t' _ _ ht ht' => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem ht ht'
    | smul c t _ ht => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ht
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add s s' _ _ hs hs' => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hs hs'
  | smul c s _ hs => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hs

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_mem_plusPart
statement: lemma quasiR_mem_plusPart [Finite I] (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : quasiR R ν ∈ plusPart R ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := quasiR_mem_range R ν
  rw [← hs]
  clear hs
  induction s using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | tmul a b =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, e⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 b.2
    rw [map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype, ← e]
    exact tmul_mem_plusPart _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.actPair_eq_zero_of_mem_plusPart
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem t ht =>
    obtain ⟨a, x', hx', rfl⟩ := ht
    rw [TensorModule.act_tmul, hy x' hx', tmul_zero]
  | zero => rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add s t _ _ hs ht => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hs, ht, add_zero]
  | smul c t _ ht => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ht, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_smul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma plusHom_smul_eq_zero (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (y : M₂) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, N ≤ ν.degree →
      ∀ x ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν, plusHom R 𝕧 x • y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h y
  exact ⟨N, fun ν hν x hx ↦ hN ν hν _ (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.support_actPair_finite
statement:
lemma support_actPair_finite (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂)
    {T : (I →₀ ℕ) → QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hT : ∀ ν, T ν ∈ plusPart R ν)
    (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) : (Function.support fun ν ↦ act₂ (T ν) z).Finite
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb =>
    refine (ha.union hb).subset fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    simp only [Function.mem_support, map_add] at hν
    by_contra hc
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at hc
    exact hν (by rw [hc.1, hc.2, add_zero])
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := plusHom_smul_eq_zero h y
    refine (Finsupp.finite_of_degree_lt (σ := I) N).subset fun ν hν ↦ ?_
    by_contra hc
    exact hν (actPair_eq_zero_of_mem_plusPart (hT ν) (hN ν (not_lt.1 hc)) x)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRAct_finsum_barTensor
statement:
theorem quasiRAct_finsum_barTensor (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    quasiRAct h (∑ᶠ ν, act₂ (barTensor R (quasiR R ν)) z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ ν, barTensor R (quasiR R ν) ∈ plusPart R ν :=
    fun ν ↦ barTensor_mem_plusPart (quasiR_mem_plusPart ν)
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_add]
    rw [finsum_add_distrib (support_actPair_finite h hT a) (support_actPair_finite h hT b),
      map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := plusHom_smul_eq_zero h y
    set S := (Finsupp.finite_of_degree_lt (σ := I) (N + 1)).toFinset
    have hS (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : ν ∈ S ↔ ν.degree < N + 1 := by simp [S]
    
    have hvan {ν' ν'' : I →₀ ℕ} (hd : N ≤ ν'.degree + ν''.degree) :
        act₂ (quasiR R ν' * barTensor R (quasiR R ν'')) (x ⊗ₜ y) = 0 :=
      actPair_eq_zero_of_mem_plusPart (mul_mem_plusPart (quasiR_mem_plusPart ν') (hT ν''))
        (hN _ (by rwa [_root_.map_add])) x
    set a : (I →₀ ℕ) × (I →₀ ℕ) → M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂ :=
      fun p ↦ act₂ (quasiR R p.1 * barTensor R (quasiR R p.2)) (x ⊗ₜ y)
    have h1 : ∑ᶠ ν, act₂ (barTensor R (quasiR R ν)) (x ⊗ₜ y) =
        ∑ ν'' ∈ S, act₂ (barTensor R (quasiR R ν'')) (x ⊗ₜ y) := by
      refine finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun ν hν ↦ ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hS]
      by_contra hc
      exact hν (actPair_eq_zero_of_mem_plusPart (hT ν) (hN ν (by omega)) x)
    have h2 (ν'' : I →₀ ℕ) : quasiRAct h (act₂ (barTensor R (quasiR R ν'')) (x ⊗ₜ y)) =
        ∑ ν' ∈ S, a (ν', ν'') := by
      rw [quasiRAct_apply]
      refine (finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun ν' hν' ↦ ?_).trans
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν' _ ↦ ?_)
      · rw [Finset.mem_coe, hS]
        by_contra hc
        refine hν' ?_
        beta_reduce
        rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← _root_.map_mul]
        exact hvan (by omega)
      · simp only [a, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    rw [h1, map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν'' _ ↦ h2 ν'', Finset.sum_comm,
      ← Finset.sum_product' (f := fun ν' ν'' ↦ a (ν', ν''))]
    
    have h3 : ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, a p = ∑ ν ∈ S, ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal ν, a p := by
      set T := (S ×ˢ S).filter fun p ↦ p.1 + p.2 ∈ S
      have e1 : ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, a p = ∑ p ∈ T, a p := by
        refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) fun p hp hpT ↦ ?_).symm
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, not_and, hS] at hpT
        exact hvan (by have := hpT hp; rw [_root_.map_add] at this; omega)
      rw [e1, Finset.sum_sigma']
      refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun p ↦ ⟨p.1 + p.2, p⟩) (fun q ↦ q.2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro p hp
        simp only [T, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
        simp [Finset.mem_sigma, hp.2]
      · rintro ⟨ν, p⟩ hq
        simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
        obtain ⟨hν, rfl⟩ := hq
        simp only [T, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, hS] at hν ⊢
        rw [_root_.map_add] at hν
        exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by rw [_root_.map_add]; omega⟩
      · intro p _; rfl
      · rintro ⟨ν, p⟩ hq
        simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
        obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hq
        rfl
      · intro p _; rfl
    rw [h3, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem 0 ((hS 0).2 (by simp))]
    · simp only [a]
      rw [← LinearMap.sum_apply, ← _root_.map_sum, sum_quasiR_mul_barTensor]
      simp
    · intro ν _ hν
      simp only [a]
      rw [← LinearMap.sum_apply, ← _root_.map_sum, sum_quasiR_mul_barTensor]
      simp [hν]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barPair_barPair
statement:
lemma barPair_barPair (hψ₁' : ∀ m, ψ₁ (ψ₁ m) = m) (hψ₂' : ∀ m, ψ₂ (ψ₂ m) = m)
    (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) : barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ (barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul x y => rw [barPair_tmul, barPair_tmul, hψ₁', hψ₂']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barPair_quasiRAct
statement:
lemma barPair_quasiRAct (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ (quasiRAct h z) =
      ∑ᶠ ν, act₂ (barTensor R (quasiR R ν)) (barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quasiRAct_apply, map_finsum _ (support_quasiR_finite h z)]
  exact finsum_congr fun ν ↦ barPair_actPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ _ z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRAct_barPair_involutive
statement:
theorem quasiRAct_barPair_involutive (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂)
    (hψ₁' : ∀ m, ψ₁ (ψ₁ m) = m) (hψ₂' : ∀ m, ψ₂ (ψ₂ m) = m) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    quasiRAct h (barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ (quasiRAct h (barPair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ z))) = z
proof:
:= by

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.sum_tmul_eq_sum_tmul_of_adjoint
statement:
theorem sum_tmul_eq_sum_tmul_of_adjoint {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V) {b bs : ι → V} {c cs : κ → V} (L M : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hc : ∀ s, L (b s) = ∑ t, B (L (b s)) (cs t) • c t)
    (hbs : ∀ t, M (cs t) = ∑ s, B (M (cs t)) (b s) • bs s)
    (hLM : ∀ s t, B (L (b s)) (cs t) = B (M (cs t)) (b s)) :
    ∑ s, L (b s) ⊗ₜ[K] bs s = ∑ t, c t ⊗ₜ[K] M (cs t)
proof:
:= by
  calc ∑ s, L (b s) ⊗ₜ[K] bs s
      = ∑ s, ∑ t, B (L (b s)) (cs t) • (c t ⊗ₜ[K] bs s) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
        conv_lhs => rw [hc s]
        rw [TensorProduct.sum_tmul]
        simp only [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    _ = ∑ t, ∑ s, B (M (cs t)) (b s) • (c t ⊗ₜ[K] bs s) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp only [hLM]
    _ = ∑ t, c t ⊗ₜ[K] M (cs t) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
        conv_rhs => rw [hbs t]
        rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
        simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nondegenerate_quotientWeightForm
statement:
theorem nondegenerate_quotientWeightForm (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (quotientWeightForm D ν).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ x : quotientWeightSpace D ν, (∀ y, quotientWeightForm D ν x y = 0) → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨x, ⟨a, ha, hax⟩⟩ := x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change x = 0
    apply quotientForm_separates D
    intro y
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
    subst hax
    change quotientForm D (toQuotient D 𝕧 a) (toQuotient D 𝕧 b) = 0
    rw [quotientForm_toQuotient]
    have hwa : FreeAlgebra.weightProj 𝕂 ν a = a := by
      rw [FreeAlgebra.weightProj_of_mem (R := 𝕂) ha]; simp
    rw [← hwa, form_weightProj, ← quotientForm_toQuotient]
    exact hx ⟨_, ⟨_, FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν b, rfl⟩⟩
  refine ⟨key, fun y hy ↦ key y fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [(isSymm_quotientWeightForm D ν).eq]
  exact hy x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_sum_dualBasis_left
statement:
theorem eq_sum_dualBasis_left {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D ν)) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν) :
    x = ∑ s, quotientForm D x (quotientDualBasis b s) • (b s : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  set hB := nondegenerate_quotientWeightForm D ν
  have h := (b.sum_repr ⟨x, hx⟩).symm
  have hrepr : ∀ s, b.repr ⟨x, hx⟩ s =
      quotientWeightForm D ν ⟨x, hx⟩ ((quotientWeightForm D ν).dualBasis hB b s) := by
    intro s
    conv_lhs => rw [← LinearMap.BilinForm.dualBasis_dualBasis hB
      (isSymm_quotientWeightForm D ν) b]
    rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.dualBasis_repr_apply]
  have := congrArg Subtype.val h
  simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, hrepr] at this
  exact this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_sum_dualBasis_right
statement:
theorem eq_sum_dualBasis_right {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D ν)) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν) :
    x = ∑ s, quotientForm D x (b s) • (quotientDualBasis b s : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  set hB := nondegenerate_quotientWeightForm D ν
  have h := (((quotientWeightForm D ν).dualBasis hB b).sum_repr ⟨x, hx⟩).symm
  have := congrArg Subtype.val h
  simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul,
    LinearMap.BilinForm.dualBasis_repr_apply] at this
  exact this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_lDeriv_eq
statement:
lemma quotientForm_lDeriv_eq (i : I) (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint
statement:
theorem sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (b : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D ν))
    (c : Module.Basis κ 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D μ)) (L M : Module.End 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧))
    (hL : ∀ x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν, L x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D μ)
    (hM : ∀ y ∈ quotientWeightSpace D μ, M y ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν)
    (hLM : ∀ x y, quotientForm D (L x) y = quotientForm D (M y) x) :
    ∑ s, L (b s) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (quotientDualBasis b s : Quotient D 𝕧) =
      ∑ t, (c t : Quotient D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] M (quotientDualBasis c t)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.BilinForm.sum_tmul_eq_sum_tmul_of_adjoint (quotientForm D) L M
    (fun s ↦ eq_sum_dualBasis_left c (hL _ (b s).2))
    (fun t ↦ eq_sum_dualBasis_right b (hM _ (quotientDualBasis c t).2))
    (fun _ _ ↦ hLM _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint'
statement:
theorem sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint' {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (b : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D ν))
    (c : Module.Basis κ 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D μ)) (L M : Module.End 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧))
    (hL : ∀ x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν, L x ∈ quotientWeightSpace D μ)
    (hM : ∀ y ∈ quotientWeightSpace D μ, M y ∈ quotientWeightSpace D ν)
    (hLM : ∀ x y, quotientForm D (L x) y = quotientForm D (M y) x) :
    ∑ s, (b s : Quotient D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] L (quotientDualBasis b s) =
      ∑ t, M (c t) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (quotientDualBasis c t : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.BilinForm.sum_tmul_eq_sum_tmul_of_adjoint (quotientForm D)
    (b := fun s ↦ (quotientDualBasis b s : Quotient D 𝕧)) (bs := fun s ↦ (b s : Quotient D 𝕧))
    (c := fun t ↦ (quotientDualBasis c t : Quotient D 𝕧)) (cs := fun t ↦ (c t : Quotient D 𝕧))
    L M (fun s ↦ eq_sum_dualBasis_right c (hL _ (quotientDualBasis b s).2))
    (fun t ↦ eq_sum_dualBasis_left b (hM _ (c t).2)) (fun _ _ ↦ hLM _ _)
  have := congrArg (TensorProduct.comm 𝕂 _ _) h
  simpa only [map_sum, TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_quotientMinus_sub
statement:
theorem E_mul_quotientMinus_sub (i : I) (y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    E R 𝕧 i * quotientMinus R y - quotientMinus R y * E R 𝕧 i =
      (𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) * quotientMinus R (quotientLDeriv D i y) -
          quotientMinus R (quotientRDeriv D i y) * K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  have h := congrArg (chevalley R 𝕧) (F_mul_plusHom (R := R) (v := 𝕧) i a)
  simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_smul, chevalley_F, chevalley_plusHom, chevalley_K,
    neg_neg] at h
  simp only [quotientLDeriv_toQuotient, quotientRDeriv_toQuotient, quotientMinus_toQuotient]
  rw [h, smul_sub, smul_sub]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_mul_quotientPlus_sub
statement:
theorem F_mul_quotientPlus_sub (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    F R 𝕧 i * quotientPlus R x - quotientPlus R x * F R 𝕧 i =
      -((𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        (quotientPlus R (quotientRDeriv D i x) * K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) -
          K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) * quotientPlus R (quotientLDeriv D i x)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  simp only [quotientLDeriv_toQuotient, quotientRDeriv_toQuotient, quotientPlus_toQuotient]
  rw [F_mul_plusHom]
  abel

name: TensorProduct.tmul_mul_map
statement:
lemma tmul_mul_map (a : A) (b : B) (f : M →ₗ[K] A) (g : N →ₗ[K] B) (t : M ⊗[K] N) :
    (a ⊗ₜ[K] b) * map f g t =
      map (LinearMap.mulLeft K a ∘ₗ f) (LinearMap.mulLeft K b ∘ₗ g) t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y => simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [mul_add, hx, hy]

name: TensorProduct.map_mul_tmul
statement:
lemma map_mul_tmul (a : A) (b : B) (f : M →ₗ[K] A) (g : N →ₗ[K] B) (t : M ⊗[K] N) :
    map f g t * (a ⊗ₜ[K] b) =
      map (LinearMap.mulRight K a ∘ₗ f) (LinearMap.mulRight K b ∘ₗ g) t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y => simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [add_mul, hx, hy]

name: TensorProduct.map_sub_left'
statement:
lemma map_sub_left' (f₁ f₂ : M →ₗ[K] P) (g : N →ₗ[K] Q) :
    map (f₁ - f₂) g = map f₁ g - map f₂ g
proof:
:= by
  ext x y

name: TensorProduct.map_sub_right'
statement:
lemma map_sub_right' (f : M →ₗ[K] P) (g₁ g₂ : N →ₗ[K] Q) :
    map f (g₁ - g₂) = map f g₁ - map f g₂
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp [tmul_sub]

name: TensorProduct.map_comp_apply_rTensor
statement:
lemma map_comp_apply_rTensor {S : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S] (f : M →ₗ[K] P)
    (g : N →ₗ[K] Q) (f' : S →ₗ[K] M) (t : S ⊗[K] N) :
    map (f ∘ₗ f') g t = map f g (f'.rTensor N t)

:= by

name: TensorProduct.map_comp_apply_lTensor
statement:
lemma map_comp_apply_lTensor {S : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [Module K S] (f : M →ₗ[K] P)
    (g : N →ₗ[K] Q) (g' : S →ₗ[K] N) (t : M ⊗[K] S) :

:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRTensor_eq_sum
statement:
theorem quasiRTensor_eq_sum {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D ν)) :
    quasiRTensor D ν = ∑ s, (b s : Quotient D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (quotientDualBasis b s : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:=
  sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint _ b LinearMap.id LinearMap.id (fun _ hx ↦ hx) (fun _ hy ↦ hy)
    (fun x y ↦ quotientForm_comm D x y)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRTensor_zero
statement: theorem quasiRTensor_zero : quasiRTensor D 0 = 1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1
proof:
:= by
  set b := Module.finBasis 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D 0)
  calc quasiRTensor D 0
      = ∑ s, quotientForm D 1 (b s) • ((1 : Quotient D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
          (quotientDualBasis b s : Quotient D 𝕧)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
        conv_lhs => rw [eq_smul_one_of_mem_zero (b s).2]
        rw [smul_tmul', quotientForm_comm]
    _ = 1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1 := by
        simp_rw [← tmul_smul, ← tmul_sum]
        rw [← eq_sum_dualBasis_right b one_mem_quotientWeightSpace_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rTensor_quotientLDeriv_quasiRTensor
statement:
theorem rTensor_quotientLDeriv_quasiRTensor (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (quotientLDeriv D i).rTensor _ (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) =
      (thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹ •
        (LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i))).lTensor _ (quasiRTensor D μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint
    (Module.finBasis 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)))
    (Module.finBasis 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D μ)) (quotientLDeriv D i)
    ((thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹ • LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i)))
    (fun _ hx ↦ quotientLDeriv_mem i hx)
    (fun _ hy ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (θ_mul_mem_quotientWeightSpace i hy))
    (fun x y ↦ quotientForm_lDeriv_eq i x y)
  simp only [quasiRTensor, map_sum, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul,
    Finset.smul_sum, ← tmul_smul]
  simpa only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rTensor_quotientRDeriv_quasiRTensor
statement:
theorem rTensor_quotientRDeriv_quasiRTensor (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (quotientRDeriv D i).rTensor _ (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) =
      (thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹ •
        (LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i))).lTensor _ (quasiRTensor D μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint
    (Module.finBasis 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)))
    (Module.finBasis 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D μ)) (quotientRDeriv D i)
    ((thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹ • LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i)))
    (fun _ hx ↦ quotientRDeriv_mem i hx)
    (fun _ hy ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mul_θ_mem_quotientWeightSpace i hy))
    (fun x y ↦ quotientForm_rDeriv_eq i x y)
  simp only [quasiRTensor, map_sum, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul,
    Finset.smul_sum, ← tmul_smul]
  simpa only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lTensor_quotientLDeriv_quasiRTensor
statement:
theorem lTensor_quotientLDeriv_quasiRTensor (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (quotientLDeriv D i).lTensor _ (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) =
      (thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹ •
        (LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i))).rTensor _ (quasiRTensor D μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_tmul_dualBasis_of_adjoint'
    (Module.finBasis 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)))
    (Module.finBasis 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D μ)) (quotientLDeriv D i)
    ((thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹ • LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i)))
    (fun _ hx ↦ quotientLDeriv_mem i hx)
    (fun _ hy ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (θ_mul_mem_quotientWeightSpace i hy))
    (fun x y ↦ quotientForm_lDeriv_eq i x y)
  simp only [quasiRTensor, map_sum, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul,
    Finset.smul_sum, smul_tmul']
  simpa only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRCoeff_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma quasiRCoeff_zero : quasiRCoeff D 0 = 1
proof: := Finsupp.prod_zero_index

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRCoeff_add_single
statement:
lemma quasiRCoeff_add_single (μ : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) :
    quasiRCoeff D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) = -(𝕧 ^ D.d i) * quasiRCoeff D μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold quasiRCoeff
  rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index' (by simp) (fun _ _ _ ↦ by rw [pow_add]), mul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [Finsupp.prod_single_index (by simp), pow_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inv_sub_inv_mul_thetaNorm_inv
statement:
lemma inv_sub_inv_mul_thetaNorm_inv (i : I) :
    (𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹ = (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  set w : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  have hw : w ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hw2 : w - w⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply ratFunc_X_not_root (D.d i * 2) (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) (by decide))
    rw [pow_mul, sq]
    change w * w = 1
    have h' : w = w⁻¹ := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    nth_rewrite 2 [h']
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hw
  rw [thetaNorm, inv_inv]
  have : 1 - w⁻¹ ^ 2 = w⁻¹ * (w - w⁻¹) := by field_simp
  rw [this, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ w⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw2, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiRCoeff_add_single_mul_add
statement:
lemma quasiRCoeff_add_single_mul_add (μ : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) :
    quasiRCoeff D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) *
        ((𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹) + quasiRCoeff D μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_sub_inv_mul_thetaNorm_inv, quasiRCoeff_add_single]
  have hw : (𝕧 ^ D.d i : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_eq_sum

    (b : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 (quotientWeightSpace D ν)) :
    quasiR R ν = quasiRCoeff D ν •
      ∑ s, quotientMinus R (b s) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] quotientPlus R (quotientDualBasis b s)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_mem_range

      ((quotientPlus R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientWeightSpace D ν).subtype))
proof:

  refine ⟨quasiRCoeff D ν • ∑ s, b s ⊗ₜ[𝕂] quotientDualBasis b s, ?_⟩
  simp [quasiR, quasiRTensor, b, map_sum]
