name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.commE
statement:
private lemma commE :
    LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (E R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap -
        LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (E R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap =
      (𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        ((LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i)) ∘ₗ (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
            quotientLDeriv D i -
          (LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) ∘ₗ (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
            quotientRDeriv D i)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simpa using E_mul_quotientMinus_sub R i y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.commF
statement:
private lemma commF :
    LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (F R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap -
        LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (F R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap =
      (𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        ((LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) ∘ₗ (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
            quotientLDeriv D i -
          (LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i)) ∘ₗ (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
            quotientRDeriv D i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have h := F_mul_quotientPlus_sub R i x
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [h, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.commE_quasiRTensor
statement:
private lemma commE_quasiRTensor (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
        (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) -
      map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
          (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) =
      ((𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹) •
        ((K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) *
            map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quasiRTensor D μ) -
          map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quasiRTensor D μ) *
            (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_mul_map, map_mul_tmul, tmul_mul_map, map_mul_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_one,
    LinearMap.mulRight_one, LinearMap.id_comp, ← LinearMap.sub_apply, ← map_sub_left', commE,
    map_smul_left, map_sub_left', LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    map_comp_apply_rTensor _ _ (quotientLDeriv D i),
    map_comp_apply_rTensor _ _ (quotientRDeriv D i),
    rTensor_quotientLDeriv_quasiRTensor, rTensor_quotientRDeriv_quasiRTensor, map_smul,
    map_smul, ← map_comp_apply_lTensor, ← map_comp_apply_lTensor, quotientPlus_comp_mulLeft,
    quotientPlus_comp_mulRight]
  simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.commF_quasiRTensor
statement:
private lemma commF_quasiRTensor (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i) * map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
        (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) -
      map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
          (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) * (1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i) =
      ((𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (thetaNorm D 𝕧 i)⁻¹) •
        ((F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) *
            map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quasiRTensor D μ) -
          map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quasiRTensor D μ) *
            (F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_mul_map, map_mul_tmul, tmul_mul_map, map_mul_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_one,
    LinearMap.mulRight_one, LinearMap.id_comp, ← LinearMap.sub_apply, ← map_sub_right', commF,
    map_smul_right, map_sub_right', LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    map_comp_apply_lTensor _ _ (quotientLDeriv D i),
    map_comp_apply_lTensor _ _ (quotientRDeriv D i),
    lTensor_quotientLDeriv_quasiRTensor, lTensor_quotientRDeriv_quasiRTensor, map_smul,
    map_smul, ← map_comp_apply_rTensor, ← map_comp_apply_rTensor, quotientMinus_comp_mulLeft,
    quotientMinus_comp_mulRight]
  simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_E
statement:
theorem quasiR_E (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * quasiR R (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) +
        (K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) * quasiR R μ =
      quasiR R (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) +
        quasiR R μ * (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [quasiR, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  have h := commE_quasiRTensor R i μ
  set A := map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
    (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1))
  set B := map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quasiRTensor D μ)
  calc _ = quasiRCoeff D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) •
        ((E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * A - A * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1)) + quasiRCoeff D μ •
          ((K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i) * B - B * (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] E R 𝕧 i)) := by
        simp only [smul_sub]; abel
    _ = 0 := by
        rw [h, smul_smul, ← add_smul, quasiRCoeff_add_single_mul_add, zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_E_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem quasiR_E_of_eq_zero {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν i = 0) :
    (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1) * quasiR R ν = quasiR R ν * (E R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [quasiR, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← smul_sub]
  rw [tmul_mul_map, map_mul_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_one, LinearMap.mulRight_one,
    LinearMap.id_comp, ← LinearMap.sub_apply, ← map_sub_left', commE, map_smul_left,
    map_sub_left', LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    map_comp_apply_rTensor _ _ (quotientLDeriv D i),
    map_comp_apply_rTensor _ _ (quotientRDeriv D i),
    rTensor_quotientLDeriv_quasiRTensor_of_eq_zero hν,
    rTensor_quotientRDeriv_quasiRTensor_of_eq_zero hν]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_F
statement:
theorem quasiR_F (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    (1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i) * quasiR R (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) +
        (F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) * quasiR R μ =
      quasiR R (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) * (1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i) +
        quasiR R μ * (F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [quasiR, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  have h := commF_quasiRTensor R i μ
  set A := map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
    (quasiRTensor D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1))
  set B := map (quotientMinus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quasiRTensor D μ)
  calc _ = quasiRCoeff D (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) •
        ((1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i) * A - A * (1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i)) + quasiRCoeff D μ •
          ((F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) * B - B * (F R 𝕧 i ⊗ₜ[𝕂] K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i))) := by
        simp only [smul_sub]; abel
    _ = 0 := by
        rw [h, smul_smul, ← add_smul, quasiRCoeff_add_single_mul_add, zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_F_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem quasiR_F_of_eq_zero {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν i = 0) :
    (1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i) * quasiR R ν = quasiR R ν * (1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] F R 𝕧 i)

  rw [tmul_mul_map, map_mul_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_one, LinearMap.mulRight_one,
    LinearMap.id_comp, ← LinearMap.sub_apply, ← map_sub_right', commF, map_smul_right,

    map_comp_apply_lTensor _ _ (quotientLDeriv D i),

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_K
statement:
theorem quasiR_K (l : Y) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :

proof:
:= by

  congr 1
  simp only [quasiRTensor, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, map_tmul,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_

    K_mul_quotientPlus_of_mem R l (Subtype.prop _), smul_tmul_smul, ← zpow_add₀

name: LusztigF.integralLaurentEval_injective
statement: theorem integralLaurentEval_injective : Function.Injective integralLaurentEval
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra ℚ (RatFunc ℚ) := RatFunc.instAlgebraOfPolynomial ℚ ℚ
  have hv : Transcendental ℤ (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) :=
    Transcendental.restrictScalars (Int.cast_injective (α := ℚ)) RatFunc.transcendental_X
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := LaurentPolynomial.exists_T_pow f
  have h1 : integralLaurentEval (Polynomial.toLaurent p) = 0 := by
    rw [hp, map_mul, hf, zero_mul]
  rw [integralLaurentEval, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_toLaurent] at h1
  have h2 : p = 0 := (transcendental_iff.1 hv) p (by rwa [Polynomial.aeval_def])
  have h3 : f * LaurentPolynomial.T n = 0 := by rw [← hp, h2, map_zero]
  exact (LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T (R := ℤ) (n : ℤ)).mul_left_eq_zero.mp h3

name: LusztigF.integralLaurentEval_T

:= by
  simp [integralLaurentEval]

name: LusztigF.bar_integralLaurentEval
statement:
theorem bar_integralLaurentEval (f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    RatFunc.bar (integralLaurentEval f) =
      integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.invert f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | C_mul_T n a =>
    simp [integralLaurentEval, map_zpow₀]

name: LusztigF.serreBar_integral_algebraMap
statement:
theorem serreBar_integral_algebraMap (a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    serreBar D (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (SerreBarQuotient (K := ℚ) D) a) =
      algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (SerreBarQuotient (K := ℚ) D)
        (LaurentPolynomial.invert a)
proof:
:= by
  change serreBar D (algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) _ (integralLaurentEval a)) = _

name: LusztigF.serreBar_mem_integralForm
statement:
theorem serreBar_mem_integralForm {x : SerreBarQuotient (K := ℚ) D}
    (hx : x ∈ serreIntegralForm D) : serreBar D x ∈ serreIntegralForm D
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [serreIntegralGenerator, serreBar_qDivPow]
    exact serreIntegralGenerator_mem D i n
  | algebraMap a =>
    rw [serreBar_integral_algebraMap]
    exact (serreIntegralForm D).algebraMap_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LusztigF.serreBar_mem_integralForm_iff
statement:
theorem serreBar_mem_integralForm_iff (x : SerreBarQuotient (K := ℚ) D) :
    serreBar D x ∈ serreIntegralForm D ↔ x ∈ serreIntegralForm D
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx ↦ by simpa using serreBar_mem_integralForm D hx, serreBar_mem_integralForm D⟩

name: LusztigF.span_serreIntegralForm
statement:
theorem span_serreIntegralForm :
    Submodule.span (RatFunc ℚ) (serreIntegralForm D : Set (SerreBarQuotient (K := ℚ) D)) =
      ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h : Algebra.adjoin (RatFunc ℚ)
      (serreIntegralForm D : Set (SerreBarQuotient (K := ℚ) D)) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    clear hx
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := RingCon.mkₐ_surjective (α := RatFunc ℚ)
      (serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)).ringCon x
    change toSerreBarQuotient D x ∈ _
    induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c =>
      rw [AlgHom.commutes]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c
    | grade1 i =>
      apply Algebra.subset_adjoin
      simpa [serreIntegralGenerator, θ, QuantumGroup.qDivPow, QuantumGroup.qFactorial,
        QuantumGroup.qInt] using serreIntegralGenerator_mem D i 1
    | mul x y hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  have hc : Submonoid.closure
      (serreIntegralForm D : Set (SerreBarQuotient (K := ℚ) D)) =
        (serreIntegralForm D).toSubmonoid := Submonoid.closure_eq _
  have hh := congrArg Subalgebra.toSubmodule h
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_eq_span, hc] at hh
  exact hh

name: LusztigF.serreIntegralBar_involutive
statement: theorem serreIntegralBar_involutive : Function.Involutive (serreIntegralBar D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact Subtype.ext (serreBar_serreBar (K := ℚ) D x.val)

name: LusztigF.serreIntegralBar_smul
statement:
theorem serreIntegralBar_smul (a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : serreIntegralForm D) :
    serreIntegralBar D (a • x) = LaurentPolynomial.invert a • serreIntegralBar D x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change serreBar (K := ℚ) D (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) _ a * ↑x) =
    algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) _ (LaurentPolynomial.invert a) * serreBar (K := ℚ) D ↑x
  rw [map_mul, serreBar_integral_algebraMap]

name: LusztigF.quotientIntegralGenerator_mem

name: LusztigF.span_quotientIntegralForm

      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c
    | grade1 i =>

      simpa [quotientIntegralGenerator, θ, QuantumGroup.qDivPow, QuantumGroup.qFactorial,
        QuantumGroup.qInt] using quotientIntegralGenerator_mem D i 1
    | mul x y hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

  have hh := congrArg Subalgebra.toSubmodule h

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_integral_algebraMap
statement:
theorem quotientBar_integral_algebraMap (a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_mem_integralForm

    rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, quotientBar_qDivPow]

  | algebraMap a =>

    exact (quotientIntegralForm D).algebraMap_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_mem_integralForm_iff
statement:
theorem quotientBar_mem_integralForm_iff (x : Quotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)) :

name: LusztigF.quotientIntegralBar_involutive

name: LusztigF.quotientIntegralBar_smul
statement:
theorem quotientIntegralBar_smul (a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : quotientIntegralForm D) :

name: RatFunc.transcendental_X_inv
statement: private theorem transcendental_X_inv : Transcendental K ((X : RatFunc K)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by

name: RatFunc.barHom_X
statement: @[simp] theorem barHom_X : barHom (X : RatFunc K) = X⁻¹

:= by
  exact algEquivOfTranscendental_X _ _

name: RatFunc.barHom_involutive
statement: theorem barHom_involutive : Function.Involutive (barHom (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (barHom (K := K)).comp barHom = AlgHom.id K (RatFunc K) := by
    apply IsLocalization.algHom_ext (nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial K))
    apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
    change barHom (barHom (X : RatFunc K)) = X
    simp

name: RatFunc.bar_X

name: RatFunc.bar_bar

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_qBinomial
statement:
theorem bar_qBinomial (d n j : ℕ) :
    RatFunc.bar (qBinomial ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n j) =
      qBinomial (RatFunc.X ^ d) n j
proof:
:= by
  have h (n j : ℕ) :
      RatFunc.bar (qBinomial ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n j) =
        qBinomial ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d)⁻¹ n j := by
    induction n generalizing j with
    | zero => cases j <;> simp
    | succ n ih =>
      cases j with
      | zero => simp
      | succ j => simp only [qBinomial_succ_succ, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
          map_inv₀, RatFunc.bar_X, ih, inv_pow]
  rw [h, qBinomial_inv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_qFactorial
statement:
theorem bar_qFactorial (d n : ℕ) :
    RatFunc.bar (qFactorial ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n) =
      qFactorial (RatFunc.X ^ d) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [qFactorial_succ, map_mul, ← qBinomial_one_right, bar_qBinomial,
      qBinomial_one_right, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_inv_qFactorial
statement:
theorem bar_inv_qFactorial (d n : ℕ) :
    RatFunc.bar ((qFactorial ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n)⁻¹) =
      (qFactorial (RatFunc.X ^ d) n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_inv₀, bar_qFactorial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_X_pow_ne_zero
statement:
theorem qFactorial_X_pow_ne_zero (d n : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    qFactorial ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply qFactorial_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero)
  intro m hm _
  rw [← pow_mul]
  exact LusztigF.ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one (Nat.mul_pos hd (by omega))

name: LusztigF.bar_bar
statement: @[simp] theorem bar_bar (x : LusztigF (RatFunc K) I) : bar (bar x) = x

@[simp] theorem bar_algebraMap (c : RatFunc K) :

name: LusztigF.bar_qDivPow
statement:
theorem bar_qDivPow (d n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    bar (QuantumGroup.qDivPow ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n (θ (RatFunc K) i)) =

name: LusztigF.bar_serreElement
statement:
theorem bar_serreElement (D : LusztigCartanDatum I) (i j : I) :
    bar (serreElement D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) i j) =
      serreElement D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) i j
proof:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.skew_twist_eq_shift
statement:
lemma skew_twist_eq_shift {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    (𝕧 ^ D.dot i i) ^ n * 𝕧 ^ D.dot i j =
      BraidDiagonal.shift (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) n
proof:
:= by
  have hA := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have hd := LusztigF.zpow_dot_eq (D := D) (v := 𝕧) hij
    (m := negA D i j) (by simp only [negA]; omega)
  rw [LusztigF.zpow_dot_self, hd, BraidDiagonal.shift, pow_mul, inv_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plus_rev_skewGenerator
statement:
lemma plus_rev_skewGenerator {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    plusHom R 𝕧 (rev 𝕂 I (skewGenerator D 𝕧 i j n)) =
      rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [rankTwoXp_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [skewGenerator_succ, skewAdjoint_apply, twist_skewGenerator, map_sub,
      rev_mul, rev_mul, rev_θ, map_smul, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_smul,
      plusHom_θ, ih, skew_twist_eq_shift hij, smul_mul_assoc]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braid_skewGenerator
statement:
lemma braid_skewGenerator {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i
      (plusHom R 𝕧 (skewGenerator D 𝕧 i j n)) =
        (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n / qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (negA D i j - n)) •
          rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j (negA D i j - n)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 𝕧 ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hq : 𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0
      (fun m hm ↦ by rw [← pow_mul]; exact ratFunc_X_not_root _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) hm))
  have hfac (m : ℕ) := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D)
    RatFunc.X_ne_zero ratFunc_X_not_root i m
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simpa using map_E_eq_rankTwoXp HT hij
  | succ m ih =>
    have hm : m ≤ negA D i j := by omega
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, negA D i j - m = r + 1 := ⟨negA D i j - m - 1, by omega⟩
    have hr' : negA D i j - (m + 1) = r := by omega
    let s := BraidDiagonal.shift (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) m
    let t := BraidDiagonal.shift (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (r + 1)
    have hst : s * t = 1 := by
      have ha : negA D i j = r + 1 + m := by omega
      dsimp [s, t, BraidDiagonal.shift]
      rw [ha]
      field_simp
      ring
    have H := (braidDiagonal_hyp R 𝕧 RatFunc.X_ne_zero hij hq).stepE (K_neg_mul_Kt i) r
    change braidEi R i * rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j (r + 1) -
      t • (rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j (r + 1) * braidEi R i) =
      (-(t * cc (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (r + 1))) •
        rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j r at H
    have H' : rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j (r + 1) * braidEi R i -
        s • (braidEi R i * rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j (r + 1)) =
        cc (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (r + 1) •
          rankTwoXp R 𝕧 i j r := by
      have h := congrArg (fun z : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ↦ (-s) • z) H
      have hneg : (-s) * (-(t * cc (𝕧 ^ D.d i)
          ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (r + 1))) =
          cc (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (r + 1) := by
        rw [neg_mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, hst, one_mul]
      have hnegst : (-s) * t = -1 := by rw [neg_mul, hst]
      change (-s) • (_ - t • _) = (-s) • ((-(t * _)) • _) at h
      rw [smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul, hnegst, hneg] at h
      simpa only [neg_smul, one_smul, neg_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using h
    have hc : qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) m / qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (r + 1) *
        cc (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (r + 1) =
        qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m + 1) / qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r := by
      rw [cc_pow hq0 hq (by omega), show negA D i j - r = m + 1 by omega,
        qFactorial_succ, qFactorial_succ]
      have hfr := hfac (r + 1)
      rw [qFactorial_succ] at hfr
      have hqr := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hfr).1
      field_simp [hqr, hfac]
    rw [skewGenerator_succ, skewAdjoint_apply, twist_skewGenerator, map_sub,
      map_mul, map_mul, map_smul, plusHom_θ, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_smul,
      ih hm, hr, skew_twist_eq_shift hij]
    have hself := map_E_self HT
    change braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (E R 𝕧 i) = _ at hself
    rw [hself, hr']
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [smul_comm s, ← smul_sub, H', smul_smul, hc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braid_skewDividedGenerator
statement:
theorem braid_skewDividedGenerator {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i
      (quotientPlus R (toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j n))) =
        quotientPlus R (toQuotient D 𝕧
          (rev 𝕂 I (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j (negA D i j - n))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quotientPlus_toQuotient, skewDividedGenerator, map_smul,
    braid_skewGenerator R hij n hn, plus_rev_skewGenerator R hij, smul_smul]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀
    (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) RatFunc.X_ne_zero ratFunc_X_not_root i n), one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braid_symm_rev_skewDividedGenerator
statement:
theorem braid_symm_rev_skewDividedGenerator {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n ≤ negA D i j) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
      (quotientPlus R (toQuotient D 𝕧
        (rev 𝕂 I (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j (negA D i j - n))))) =
      quotientPlus R (toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← braid_skewDividedGenerator R hij n hn, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braid_positive_of_mem_skewGenerators
statement:
lemma braid_positive_of_mem_skewGenerators (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) ∈
      (plusHom R 𝕧).range
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [braid_skewDividedGenerator R hij n hn, quotientPlus_toQuotient]
    exact AlgHom.mem_range_self _ _
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul, map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_iff_braid_positive
statement:
theorem quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_iff_braid_positive (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientLDeriv D i x = 0 ↔
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) ∈
        (plusHom R 𝕧).range
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact braid_positive_of_mem_skewGenerators R i
      ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i x).mpr hx)
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨N, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_quotientSkewGenerators_decomposition D i x
    cases N with
    | zero => simpa using congrArg (quotientLDeriv D i) he
    | succ N =>
      let T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i
      let b (n : ℕ) := (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n)⁻¹ • T (quotientPlus R (a n))
      let f : ℕ →₀ QuantumGroup R 𝕧 :=
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), Finsupp.single n (b n)) -
          Finsupp.single 0 (T (quotientPlus R x))
      have hb (n : ℕ) : b n ∈ (plusHom R 𝕧).range :=
        Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (braid_positive_of_mem_skewGenerators R i (ha n)) _
      have hf (n : ℕ) : f n ∈ (plusHom R 𝕧).range := by
        dsimp [f]
        simp only [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
        apply sub_mem
        · apply Subalgebra.sum_mem
          intro m hm
          by_cases hmn : m = n
          · subst m; simpa using hb n
          · simp [hmn]
        · by_cases hn : n = 0
          · subst n; simpa using hx
          · simp [Ne.symm hn]
      let L : (ℕ →₀ QuantumGroup R 𝕧) →ₗ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧 :=
        Finsupp.lsum 𝕂 (fun n ↦
          (LinearMap.mulLeft 𝕂 (E R 𝕧 i ^ n)).comp T.symm.toLinearMap)
      have hL : L f = 0 := by
        have he' := congrArg (quotientPlus R) he
        simp only [map_sum, map_mul] at he'
        have hgen (n : ℕ) : quotientPlus R (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) =
            (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n)⁻¹ • E R 𝕧 i ^ n := by
          simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]
        simp only [hgen, smul_mul_assoc] at he'
        dsimp [f]
        rw [map_sub, map_sum]
        simp only [L, Finsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply,
          b, map_smul, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, pow_zero, one_mul]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr he'.symm
      have hz : f = 0 := eq_zero_of_sum_E_pow_mul_symm ratFunc_X_not_root f hf hL
      have h0 := congrArg (fun g : ℕ →₀ QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ↦ g 0) hz
      have hax : a 0 = x := by
        apply quotientPlus_injective R
        apply T.injective
        simpa [f, b, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, sub_eq_zero] using h0
      rw [← hax]
      exact (mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i (a 0)).mp (ha 0)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff_braid_positive
statement:
theorem mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff_braid_positive (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i ↔
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) ∈
        (plusHom R 𝕧).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff, quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_iff_braid_positive R]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
statement:
theorem quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
    (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w)) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientPlus R (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 c)) =
      (Ta R i).symm (quotientPlus R
        (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage, quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage]
  simp [pbwDivSymm, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, Ed, qDivPow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
statement:
theorem braid_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
    (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w)) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    Ta R i (quotientPlus R (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 c))) =
      quotientPlus R (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.integralPBWPreimage_cons
statement:
theorem integralPBWPreimage_cons
    (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w)) (c : Fin (i :: w).length → ℕ) :
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) =
      quotientIntegralGenerator D i (c 0) *
        (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 (fun n ↦ c n.succ)) : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientPlus_injective R
  rw [_root_.map_mul, quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage,
    quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero, quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage]
  have hgen : quotientPlus R (quotientIntegralGenerator D i (c 0)) = Ed R i (c 0) := by
    simpa [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow] using
      quotientPlus_dividedPower R i (c 0)
  rw [hgen]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
statement:
theorem quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
    (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w)) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientLDeriv D i (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 c)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_iff_braid_positive R i _).mpr
  change Ta R i (quotientPlus R (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 c))) ∈ _
  rw [braid_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧
    (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) c)
  exact ⟨x, congrArg (quotientPlus R) hx⟩

name: LusztigF.rev_apply
statement: lemma rev_apply (x : LusztigF k I) : rev k I x = MulOpposite.unop (revHom k I x)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.rev_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma rev_θ (i : I) : rev k I (θ k i) = θ k i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rev_apply, revHom]

name: LusztigF.rev_one
statement: @[simp] lemma rev_one : rev k I (1 : LusztigF k I) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rev_apply]

name: LusztigF.rev_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma rev_algebraMap (c : k) : rev k I (algebraMap k (LusztigF k I) c) =
    algebraMap k _ c
proof:
:= by
  simp [rev_apply]

name: LusztigF.rev_mul
statement: lemma rev_mul (x y : LusztigF k I) : rev k I (x * y) = rev k I y * rev k I x
proof:
:= by
  simp [rev_apply]

name: LusztigF.rev_rev
statement: lemma rev_rev (x : LusztigF k I) : rev k I (rev k I x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 i => exact (congrArg _ (rev_θ i)).trans (rev_θ i)
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [rev_mul, rev_mul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.rev_monomial
statement: lemma rev_monomial (w : List I) : rev k I (monomial k w) = monomial k w.reverse
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [monomial_cons, rev_mul, ih, rev_θ, List.reverse_cons]
    simp [monomial, List.map_append, List.prod_append]

name: LusztigF.rev_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma rev_mem_weightSpace {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) :
    rev k I x ∈ weightSpace k ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [rev_monomial]
    convert monomial_mem_weightSpace w.reverse using 2
    induction w with
    | nil => simp
    | cons i w ih =>
      rw [List.reverse_cons, wordWeight_append, ← ih, wordWeight_cons, add_comm]
      simp [wordWeight]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_rev
statement:
lemma diagTwist_rev (c : I → k) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    diagTwist c (rev k I x) = rev k I (diagTwist c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 a => simp
  | grade1 i => simp
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [rev_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul, rev_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]

name: LusztigF.counit_rev
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_rev (x : LusztigF k I) : counit (rev k I x) = counit x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 a => simp
  | grade1 i => simp
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [rev_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul, mul_comm]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_rev
statement:
theorem rDeriv_rev (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (rev k I x) = rev k I (lDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 j => simp [apply_ite]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [rev_mul, rDeriv_mul, lDeriv_mul, map_add, rev_mul, rev_mul, ha, hb, twist_eq_diagTwist,
      diagTwist_rev]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_rev
statement:
theorem lDeriv_rev (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (rev k I x) = rev k I (rDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (rev k I) (rDeriv_rev D v i (rev k I x))
  rw [rev_rev, rev_rev] at this
  exact this.symm

name: LusztigF.form_rev
statement: theorem form_rev (x y : LusztigF k I) : form D v (rev k I x) (rev k I y) = form D v x y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis generalizing y with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]
  | smul c a ha => simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha]
  | word w =>
    induction w generalizing y with
    | nil =>
      rw [FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_nil, rev_one, form_one_left, form_one_left, counit_rev]
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [← FreeAlgebra.ι_mul_wordBasis, rev_mul, show FreeAlgebra.ι k j = θ k j from rfl, rev_θ,
        form_mul_θ, form_θ_mul, rDeriv_rev, ih]

name: LusztigF.rev_qDivPow
statement:
lemma rev_qDivPow (q : k) (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    rev k I (qDivPow q n (θ k i)) = qDivPow q n (θ k i)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ m : ℕ, rev k I (θ k i ^ m) = θ k i ^ m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ, rev_mul, ih, rev_θ, ← pow_succ', pow_succ]
  rw [qDivPow, map_smul, this]

name: LusztigF.rev_serreElement
statement:
lemma rev_serreElement (i j : I) :
    rev k I (serreElement D v i j) =
      (-1 : k) ^ (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat • serreElement D v i j
proof:
:= by
  set m := (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat
  rw [serreElement]
  unfold qSerreDiv
  rw [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr := Finset.mem_range.1 hr
  rw [map_smul, rev_mul, rev_mul, rev_qDivPow, rev_qDivPow, rev_θ, smul_smul, ← mul_assoc,
    show m - (m + 1 - 1 - r) = r by omega, show m + 1 - 1 - r = m - r by omega]
  congr 1
  rw [← pow_add, show m + r = (m - r) + 2 * r by omega, pow_add, pow_mul]
  simp

name: LusztigF.rev_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem rev_mem_serreIdeal {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    rev k I x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [rev_serreElement]
    exact smul_mem_serreIdeal _ (serreElement_mem_serreIdeal hij)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.neg_mem _ hx
  | left_absorb a x _ hx => rw [rev_mul]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ hx
  | right_absorb b x _ hx => rw [rev_mul]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.expandInf_apply
statement:
lemma expandInf_apply (f : 𝕂) :
    expandInf f = algebraMap 𝕂 (LaurentSeries ℚ) (RatFunc.bar f)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_intSeriesInf
statement: lemma mem_intSeriesInf {f : 𝕂} : f ∈ intSeriesInf ↔ ∃ g, intSeriesHom g = expandInf f
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.expandInf_inv_X
statement: lemma expandInf_inv_X : expandInf 𝕧⁻¹ = intSeriesHom PowerSeries.X
proof:
:= by
  simp [expandInf_apply, intSeriesHom, map_inv₀, RatFunc.bar_X, HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries_X]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inv_X_mem_intSeriesInf
statement: lemma inv_X_mem_intSeriesInf : 𝕧⁻¹ ∈ intSeriesInf
proof:
:=
  ⟨PowerSeries.X, expandInf_inv_X.symm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.one_sub_inv_X_pow_inv_mem
statement: lemma one_sub_inv_X_pow_inv_mem {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : (1 - 𝕧⁻¹ ^ m)⁻¹ ∈ intSeriesInf
proof:
:= by
  set g : PowerSeries ℤ := 1 - PowerSeries.X ^ m
  have hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = ((1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) := by
    simp [g, map_sub, map_pow, zero_pow hm.ne']
  refine ⟨PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1, ?_⟩
  have h1 : expandInf (1 - 𝕧⁻¹ ^ m) = intSeriesHom g := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_one, map_pow, expandInf_inv_X, g]
  rw [map_inv₀, h1]
  refine eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left ?_
  rw [← map_mul, mul_comm, PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit g 1 hg, map_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.intSeriesInf_le_intLaurentInf
statement: lemma intSeriesInf_le_intLaurentInf : intSeriesInf ≤ intLaurentInf
proof:
:=
  fun f hf ↦ ⟨0, by simpa using hf⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_X_mem_intLaurentInf
statement: lemma zpow_X_mem_intLaurentInf (k : ℤ) : 𝕧 ^ k ∈ intLaurentInf
proof:
:= by
  have hX : 𝕧 ∈ intLaurentInf :=
    ⟨1, by rw [pow_one, inv_mul_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero]; exact one_mem _⟩
  rcases k with k | k
  · rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]; exact pow_mem hX k
  · rw [zpow_negSucc, ← inv_pow]
    exact intSeriesInf_le_intLaurentInf (pow_mem inv_X_mem_intSeriesInf _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coefU_factor
statement:
lemma coefU_factor (i : I) (r : ℕ) :
    (qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (r + 1))⁻¹ * thetaNorm D 𝕧 i * ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ r) =
      (1 - 𝕧⁻¹ ^ (2 * D.d i * (r + 1)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i with hq
  have hd := D.d_pos i
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hpow : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → q ^ m ≠ 1 := fun m hm ↦ by
    rw [hq, ← pow_mul]; exact ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one (Nat.mul_pos hd hm)
  have hint := qInt_mul_sub (v := q⁻¹) (r + 1)
  have hsub : q⁻¹ - q⁻¹⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [inv_inv, sub_ne_zero]
    intro h
    exact hpow 2 two_pos (by rw [sq]; nth_rewrite 1 [← h]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0)
  have hn : q ^ (2 * (r + 1)) ≠ 1 := hpow _ (by omega)
  have hrhs : 𝕧⁻¹ ^ (2 * D.d i * (r + 1)) = q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (r + 1)) := by
    rw [hq, inv_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 (D.d i), mul_assoc]
  have hint' : qInt q⁻¹ (r + 1) = (q⁻¹ ^ (r + 1) - q⁻¹⁻¹ ^ (r + 1)) / (q⁻¹ - q⁻¹⁻¹) :=
    eq_div_of_mul_eq hsub (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hint)
  rw [hrhs, thetaNorm, ← hq, hint']
  have h1 : 1 - q ^ 2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (hpow 2 two_pos).symm
  have h3 : 1 - q ^ (2 * (r + 1)) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hn.symm
  have hr0 : q ^ (r + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hq0
  simp only [inv_inv, inv_pow]
  have e1 : (q ^ (r + 1))⁻¹ - q ^ (r + 1) = (1 - q ^ (2 * (r + 1))) / q ^ (r + 1) := by
    field_simp; ring
  have e2 : q⁻¹ - q = (1 - q ^ 2) / q := by field_simp
  have e3 : 1 - (q ^ 2)⁻¹ = -(1 - q ^ 2) / q ^ 2 := by field_simp; ring
  have e4 : 1 - (q ^ (2 * (r + 1)))⁻¹ = -(1 - q ^ (2 * (r + 1))) / q ^ (2 * (r + 1)) := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coefU_mem_intSeriesInf
statement: lemma coefU_mem_intSeriesInf (i : I) (n : ℕ) : coefU D 𝕧 i n ∈ intSeriesInf
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact one_mem _
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [coefU, coefU_factor]
    exact mul_mem ih (one_sub_inv_X_pow_inv_mem (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos two_pos
      (D.d_pos i)) r.succ_pos))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivMonomial_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma fDivMonomial_nil : fDivMonomial D [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivMonomial_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma fDivMonomial_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fDivMonomial D (p :: w) = fDivPow D p.1 p.2 * fDivMonomial D w
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivMonomial_append
statement:
lemma fDivMonomial_append (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fDivMonomial D (w ++ w') = fDivMonomial D w * fDivMonomial D w'
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p w ih => simp [ih, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivMonomial_singleton
statement: lemma fDivMonomial_singleton (i : I) (n : ℕ) : fDivMonomial D [(i, n)] = fDivPow D i n
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivPow_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fDivPow_mem_weightSpace (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    fDivPow D i n ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (n • Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using (one_mem_weightSpace (k := 𝕂) (I := I))
  | succ n ih => simpa [pow_succ, add_smul] using mul_mem_weightSpace ih (θ_mem_weightSpace i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivMonomial_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fDivMonomial_mem_weightSpace (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fDivMonomial D w ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (divWeight w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa [divWeight] using (one_mem_weightSpace (k := 𝕂) (I := I))
  | cons p w ih => exact mul_mem_weightSpace (fDivPow_mem_weightSpace D p.1 p.2) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivPow_zero
statement: lemma fDivPow_zero (i : I) : fDivPow D i 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [qDivPow, qFactorial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_X_ne_zero
statement: lemma qInt_X_ne_zero (i : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  qInt_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero) (by
    rw [← pow_mul]; exact ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) (by omega)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.θ_mul_fDivPow
statement:
lemma θ_mul_fDivPow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    θ 𝕂 i * fDivPow D i n = qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n + 1) • fDivPow D i (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fDivPow, qDivPow, qFactorial, mul_inv, smul_smul, mul_smul_comm]
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (qInt_X_ne_zero D i n.succ_pos), one_mul, pow_succ']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivPow_succ
statement:
lemma fDivPow_succ (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    fDivPow D i (n + 1) = (qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n + 1))⁻¹ • (θ 𝕂 i * fDivPow D i n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [θ_mul_fDivPow, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (qInt_X_ne_zero D i n.succ_pos), one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_fDivPow_mem
statement: lemma counit_fDivPow_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ) : LusztigF.counit (fDivPow D i n) ∈ intSeriesInf
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [fDivPow_zero, map_one]; exact one_mem _
  · simp [fDivPow, qDivPow, zero_mem]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_fDivMonomial_mem
statement:
lemma counit_fDivMonomial_mem (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    LusztigF.counit (fDivMonomial D w) ∈ intSeriesInf
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [one_mem]
  | cons p w ih => rw [fDivMonomial_cons, map_mul]; exact mul_mem (counit_fDivPow_mem D _ _) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_smul_mem_fIntegral
statement:
lemma zpow_smul_mem_fIntegral (k : ℤ) {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ fIntegral D) :
    (𝕧 ^ k) • x ∈ fIntegral D
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨l, w, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨k + l, w, by rw [smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero]⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.laurent_smul_mem_fIntegral
statement:
lemma laurent_smul_mem_fIntegral (a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I}
    (hx : x ∈ fIntegral D) : integralLaurentEval a • x ∈ fIntegral D
proof:
:= by
  induction a using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact add_mem hp hq
  | C_mul_T n c =>
    have hC : integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.C c) = (c : 𝕂) := by
      simp [integralLaurentEval]
    rw [map_mul, hC, integralLaurentEval_T, mul_smul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (zpow_smul_mem_fIntegral D n hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_fIntegral
statement:
lemma mul_mem_fIntegral {x y : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ fIntegral D) (hy : y ∈ fIntegral D) :
    x * y ∈ fIntegral D
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, w, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨l, w', rfl⟩ := hy
      refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨k + l, w ++ w', ?_⟩
      rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, ← zpow_add₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero, fDivMonomial_append]
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hz
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twist_fDivPow
statement:
lemma twist_fDivPow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    twist D 𝕧 i (fDivPow D i n) = ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ 2) ^ n • fDivPow D i n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, twist_θ, smul_pow, zpow_dot_self]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_fDivPow
statement:
theorem comul_fDivPow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    LusztigF.comul D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i n) = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n,
      ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ (p.1 * p.2)) • (fDivPow D i p.1 ⊗ₜ[𝕂] fDivPow D i p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 𝕧 ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [fDivPow_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fDivPow_succ, map_smul, comul_θ_mul, ih, map_sum, map_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, map_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, θ_mul_fDivPow, twist_fDivPow, tmul_smul, smul_tmul',
      smul_smul, sum_add_distrib]
    set F : ℕ × ℕ → LusztigF 𝕂 I ⊗[𝕂] LusztigF 𝕂 I := fun p ↦
      (((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ ((p.1 - 1) * p.2) * qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) p.1) • fDivPow D i p.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        fDivPow D i p.2 with hFdef
    set G : ℕ × ℕ → LusztigF 𝕂 I ⊗[𝕂] LusztigF 𝕂 I := fun p ↦
      ((qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) p.2 * ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ (p.1 * (p.2 - 1)) * ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ 2) ^ p.1)) •
        fDivPow D i p.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] fDivPow D i p.2 with hGdef
    have hF := Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ (f := F) (n := n)
    have hG := Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ' (f := G) (n := n)
    simp only [F, G, qInt_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_smul, zero_tmul, zero_add,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hF hG
    rw [← hF, ← hG, ← sum_add_distrib, smul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [← add_tmul, ← add_smul, smul_tmul', smul_smul]
    congr 2
    rw [HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
    simp only at hp ⊢
    have hc : qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n + 1) ≠ 0 := qInt_X_ne_zero D i n.succ_pos
    rcases a with _ | a
    · obtain rfl : b = n + 1 := by omega
      simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc]
    rcases b with _ | b
    · obtain rfl : a = n := by omega
      simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc]
    have h := qInt_add (v := 𝕧 ^ D.d i) (a + 1) (b + 1)
    rw [show a + 1 + (b + 1) = n + 1 by omega] at h
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [h] at hc
    rw [h]
    generalize 𝕧 ^ D.d i = q at hq0 hc ⊢
    generalize qInt q (a + 1) = A at hc ⊢
    generalize qInt q (b + 1) = B at hc ⊢
    have key : q⁻¹ ^ (b + 1) * q ^ ((a + 1) * (b + 1)) = q ^ (a * (b + 1)) := by
      rw [inv_pow, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hq0), ← pow_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ hc]
    linear_combination (-A) * key

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_smul_mem_fIntegralTensor
statement:
lemma zpow_smul_mem_fIntegralTensor (k : ℤ) {X : LusztigF 𝕂 I ⊗[𝕂] LusztigF 𝕂 I}
    (hX : X ∈ fIntegralTensor D) : (𝕧 ^ k) • X ∈ fIntegralTensor D
proof:
:= by
  induction hX using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem X hX =>
    obtain ⟨l, w, w', rfl⟩ := hX
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨k + l, w, w', by
      rw [smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero]⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add X Y _ _ hX hY => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hX hY
  | smul c X _ hX =>
    rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul 𝕂, smul_comm, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hX

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twistedMul_mem_fIntegralTensor
proof:
:= by
  induction hX using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem X hX =>
    obtain ⟨k, a, b, rfl⟩ := hX
    induction hY using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem Y hY =>
      obtain ⟨l, c, d, rfl⟩ := hY
      rw [map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        twistedMul_tmul_tmul D 𝕧 RatFunc.X_ne_zero (fDivMonomial_mem_weightSpace D b)
          (fDivMonomial_mem_weightSpace D c), ← fDivMonomial_append, ← fDivMonomial_append]
      refine zpow_smul_mem_fIntegralTensor D _ (zpow_smul_mem_fIntegralTensor D _
        (zpow_smul_mem_fIntegralTensor D _
          (Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, a ++ c, b ++ d, by simp⟩)))
    | zero => simp
    | add Y Y' _ _ hY hY' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hY hY'
    | smul c Y _ hY => rw [map_zsmul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hY
  | zero => simp
  | add X X' _ _ hX hX' => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem hX hX'
  | smul c X _ hX =>
    rw [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hX

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_fDivPow_mem
statement:
lemma comul_fDivPow_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    LusztigF.comul D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i n) ∈ fIntegralTensor D
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_fDivPow]
  refine sum_mem fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, ← fDivMonomial_singleton,
    ← fDivMonomial_singleton]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_fDivMonomial_mem
statement:
lemma comul_fDivMonomial_mem (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    LusztigF.comul D 𝕧 (fDivMonomial D w) ∈ fIntegralTensor D
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, [], [], by simp⟩
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [fDivMonomial_cons, comul_mul]
    exact twistedMul_mem_fIntegralTensor D (comul_fDivPow_mem D p.1 p.2) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_mem_fIntegralTensor
statement:
theorem comul_mem_fIntegralTensor {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ fIntegral D) :
    LusztigF.comul D 𝕧 x ∈ fIntegralTensor D
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, w, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul]
    exact zpow_smul_mem_fIntegralTensor D k (comul_fDivMonomial_mem D w)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_zsmul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_fDivPow_fDivPow_mem
statement:
lemma form_fDivPow_fDivPow_mem (i j : I) (m t : ℕ) :
    LusztigF.form D 𝕧 (fDivPow D j m) (fDivPow D i t) ∈ intSeriesInf
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : m • Finsupp.single j (1 : ℕ) = t • Finsupp.single i 1
  · have hmt : m = t := by
      simpa using congrArg (fun f : I →₀ ℕ ↦ f.sum fun _ n ↦ n) hw
    subst hmt
    rcases m.eq_zero_or_pos with h0 | hpos
    · subst h0
      rw [fDivPow_zero, fDivPow_zero, form_one_one]; exact one_mem _
    have hji : j = i := by
      have := congrArg (fun f : I →₀ ℕ ↦ f j) hw
      by_contra hne
      simp [hne, hpos.ne'] at this
    subst hji
    have h := quotientForm_integralGenerator D j m
    have hg : quotientIntegralGenerator D j m = toQuotient D 𝕧 (fDivPow D j m) := by
      simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]
    rw [hg, quotientForm_toQuotient] at h
    rw [h]
    exact coefU_mem_intSeriesInf D j m
  · rw [form_eq_zero_of_ne D 𝕧 hw (fDivPow_mem_weightSpace D j m)
      (fDivPow_mem_weightSpace D i t)]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_fDivMonomial_fDivPow_mem
statement:
lemma form_fDivMonomial_fDivPow_mem (w : List (I × ℕ)) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    LusztigF.form D 𝕧 (fDivMonomial D w) (fDivPow D i n) ∈ intLaurentInf
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    rw [fDivMonomial_nil, LusztigF.form_comm, form_one_right]
    exact intSeriesInf_le_intLaurentInf (counit_fDivPow_mem D i n)
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [fDivMonomial_cons, form_mul_left, comul_fDivPow, map_sum]
    refine sum_mem fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, formTensor_tmul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine mul_mem ?_ (mul_mem (intSeriesInf_le_intLaurentInf
      (form_fDivPow_fDivPow_mem D _ _ _ _)) (ih _))
    rw [← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast]
    exact zpow_X_mem_intLaurentInf _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_fDivMonomial_mem
statement:
lemma form_fDivMonomial_mem (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    LusztigF.form D 𝕧 (fDivMonomial D w) (fDivMonomial D w') ∈ intLaurentInf
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing w' with
  | nil =>
    rw [fDivMonomial_nil, LusztigF.form_comm, form_one_right]
    exact intSeriesInf_le_intLaurentInf (counit_fDivMonomial_mem D w')
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [fDivMonomial_cons, form_mul_left]
    have key : ∀ X ∈ fIntegralTensor D,
        LusztigF.formTensor D 𝕧 (fDivPow D p.1 p.2 ⊗ₜ fDivMonomial D w) X ∈ intLaurentInf := by
      intro X hX
      induction hX using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem X hX =>
        obtain ⟨k, a, b, rfl⟩ := hX
        rw [map_smul, formTensor_tmul, smul_eq_mul, LusztigF.form_comm]
        exact mul_mem (zpow_X_mem_intLaurentInf k)
          (mul_mem (form_fDivMonomial_fDivPow_mem D a _ _) (ih b))
      | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add X Y _ _ hX hY => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hX hY
      | smul c X _ hX => rw [map_zsmul]; exact zsmul_mem hX c
    exact key _ (comul_fDivMonomial_mem D w')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.form_mem_intLaurentInf
statement:
theorem form_mem_intLaurentInf {x y : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ fIntegral D)
    (hy : y ∈ fIntegral D) : LusztigF.form D 𝕧 x y ∈ intLaurentInf
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, w, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨l, w', rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_mem (zpow_X_mem_intLaurentInf l)
        (mul_mem (zpow_X_mem_intLaurentInf k) (form_fDivMonomial_mem D w w'))
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_zsmul]; exact zsmul_mem hy c
  | zero => rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem hx hz
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply]; exact zsmul_mem hx c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_fIntegral_of_mem_quotientIntegralForm
statement:
lemma exists_fIntegral_of_mem_quotientIntegralForm {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) : ∃ x' ∈ fIntegral D, toQuotient D 𝕧 x' = x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨fDivPow D i n, ?_, by simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, [(i, n)], by simp⟩
  | algebraMap a =>
    refine ⟨integralLaurentEval a • 1, laurent_smul_mem_fIntegral D a
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, [], by simp⟩), ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, map_one, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
    rfl
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨x' + y', add_mem hx' hy', map_add _ _ _⟩
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨x' * y', mul_mem_fIntegral D hx' hy', map_mul _ _ _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_mem_intLaurentInf
statement:
theorem quotientForm_mem_intLaurentInf {x y : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D)
    (hy : y ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) : quotientForm D x y ∈ intLaurentInf
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := exists_fIntegral_of_mem_quotientIntegralForm D hx
  obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := exists_fIntegral_of_mem_quotientIntegralForm D hy
  rw [quotientForm_toQuotient]
  exact form_mem_intLaurentInf D hx' hy'

name: LusztigF.twistAct_θ
statement:
lemma twistAct_θ (i : I) : twistAct D v (θ k i) =
    TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [twistAct]

name: LusztigF.twistAct_one_tmul
statement: lemma twistAct_one_tmul (b d : LusztigF k I) : twistAct D v b (1 ⊗ₜ d) = 1 ⊗ₜ (b * d)
proof:
:= by
  induction b using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing d with
  | grade0 c =>
    simp only [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
    rw [← Algebra.smul_def, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  | grade1 i => simp [twistAct_θ]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, ha, mul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, add_mul, tmul_add]

name: LusztigF.twistAct_tmul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hb using Submodule.span_induction generalizing d with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    induction w generalizing d with
    | nil => simp [Module.End.one_apply]
    | cons l w ih =>
      rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_smul, twistAct_θ, map_tmul,
        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, twist_of_mem hv l hc, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, smul_tmul',
        smul_smul, wordWeight_cons, D.weightDot_add_left, zpow_add₀ hv, mul_assoc, mul_comm,
        smul_tmul']
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hy, hz, add_mul, tmul_add, smul_add]
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hy, smul_mul_assoc, tmul_smul, smul_comm]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_tmul
statement:
lemma twistedMul_tmul (a b : LusztigF k I) (Z : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    twistedMul D v (a ⊗ₜ b) Z = (LinearMap.mulLeft k a).rTensor _ (twistAct D v b Z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [twistedMul, twistedMulAux]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_tmul_tmul_θ
statement:
lemma twistedMul_tmul_tmul_θ (a c d : LusztigF k I) (i : I) :
    twistedMul D v (a ⊗ₜ θ k i) (c ⊗ₜ d) = (a * twist D v i c) ⊗ₜ (θ k i * d)
proof:
:= by
  simp [twistedMul_tmul, twistAct_θ]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_tmul_tmul
statement:
theorem twistedMul_tmul_tmul (hv : v ≠ 0) {β γ : I →₀ ℕ} {x₂ x₁' : LusztigF k I}
    (h₂ : x₂ ∈ weightSpace k β) (h₁ : x₁' ∈ weightSpace k γ) (x₁ x₂' : LusztigF k I) :
    twistedMul D v (x₁ ⊗ₜ x₂) (x₁' ⊗ₜ x₂') =
      v ^ D.weightDot β γ • ((x₁ * x₁') ⊗ₜ (x₂ * x₂'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistedMul_tmul, twistAct_tmul_of_mem hv h₂ h₁, map_smul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
    LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_one_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistedMul_one_left (Z : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    twistedMul D v (1 ⊗ₜ 1) Z = Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistedMul_tmul, map_one, show LinearMap.mulLeft k (1 : LusztigF k I) = LinearMap.id from
    LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ one_mul x, LinearMap.rTensor_id]
  rfl

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_one_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma twistedMul_one_right (X : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    twistedMul D v X (1 ⊗ₜ 1) = X
proof:
:= by
  induction X with
  | tmul a b => simp [twistedMul_tmul, twistAct_one_tmul]
  | add X Y hX hY => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hX, hY]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_rTensor_mulLeft
statement:
lemma twistedMul_rTensor_mulLeft (a : LusztigF k I) (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    twistedMul D v ((LinearMap.mulLeft k a).rTensor _ W) =
      (LinearMap.mulLeft k a).rTensor _ ∘ₗ twistedMul D v W
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | tmul c d =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun Z ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, twistedMul_tmul,
      LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [show LinearMap.mulLeft k (a * c) = LinearMap.mulLeft k a ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft k c from
      LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ mul_assoc _ _ _, LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, hX, hY, LinearMap.comp_add]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_twistAct
statement:
lemma twistedMul_twistAct (b : LusztigF k I) (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    twistedMul D v (twistAct D v b W) = twistAct D v b ∘ₗ twistedMul D v W
proof:
:= by
  induction b using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing W with
  | grade0 c =>
    simp only [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_eq_smul_id, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      LinearMap.id_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_comp, LinearMap.id_comp]
  | grade1 i =>
    induction W with
    | tmul c d =>
      refine LinearMap.ext fun Z ↦ ?_
      simp only [twistAct_θ, map_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
        twistedMul_tmul, map_mul, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
      generalize twistAct D v d Z = W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f => simp
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, hX, hY]
    | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, hX, hY, LinearMap.comp_add]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ha, hb, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, LinearMap.add_comp]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_assoc
statement:
theorem twistedMul_assoc (X Y Z : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    twistedMul D v (twistedMul D v X Y) Z = twistedMul D v X (twistedMul D v Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  induction X generalizing Z with
  | tmul a b =>
    rw [twistedMul_tmul, twistedMul_rTensor_mulLeft, LinearMap.comp_apply, twistedMul_twistAct,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, twistedMul_tmul]
  | add X X' hX hX' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hX, hX']

name: LusztigF.comul_apply
statement: lemma comul_apply (x : LusztigF k I) : comul D v x = rEnd D v x (1 ⊗ₜ 1)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.rEnd_θ_apply
statement:
lemma rEnd_θ_apply (i : I) (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    rEnd D v (θ k i) W = (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ W +
      TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)) W
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rEnd, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, twistedMul_tmul,
    map_one, Module.End.one_apply, twistAct_θ]
  congr 1
  rw [show LinearMap.mulLeft k (1 : LusztigF k I) = LinearMap.id from
    LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ one_mul x, LinearMap.rTensor_id, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: LusztigF.comul_one
statement: @[simp] lemma comul_one : comul D v (1 : LusztigF k I) = 1 ⊗ₜ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [comul_apply]

name: LusztigF.comul_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma comul_algebraMap (c : k) :
    comul D v (algebraMap k (LusztigF k I) c) = c • ((1 : LusztigF k I) ⊗ₜ 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [comul_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]

name: LusztigF.comul_θ
statement: @[simp] theorem comul_θ (i : I) : comul D v (θ k i) = θ k i ⊗ₜ 1 + 1 ⊗ₜ θ k i
proof:
:= by
  simp [comul_apply, rEnd_θ_apply]

name: LusztigF.comul_θ_mul
statement:
lemma comul_θ_mul (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    comul D v (θ k i * x) = (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ (comul D v x) +
      TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)) (comul D v x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_apply, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, rEnd_θ_apply, ← comul_apply]

name: LusztigF.twistedMul_comul
statement: lemma twistedMul_comul (x : LusztigF k I) : twistedMul D v (comul D v x) = rEnd D v x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun Z ↦ ?_
    simp [Module.algebraMap_end_apply]
  | grade1 i =>
    rw [comul_apply]
    simp only [rEnd, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, twistedMul_one_right]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    have : comul D v (a * b) = rEnd D v a (comul D v b) := by
      rw [comul_apply, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ← comul_apply]
    rw [this, map_mul, ← ha, ← hb]
    refine LinearMap.ext fun Z ↦ ?_
    rw [Module.End.mul_apply, twistedMul_assoc]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.comul_mul
statement:
theorem comul_mul (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    comul D v (x * y) = twistedMul D v (comul D v x) (comul D v y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistedMul_comul, comul_apply, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, ← comul_apply]

name: LusztigF.rid_lTensor_counit_comul
statement:
theorem rid_lTensor_counit_comul (x : LusztigF k I) :
    TensorProduct.rid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.lTensor _ (comul D v x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_left with
  | algebraMap c => simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | smul c x hx => simp [hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | θ_mul i x hx =>
    rw [comul_θ_mul, map_add, map_add]
    generalize comul D v x = W at hx
    have h1 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        TensorProduct.rid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.lTensor _
          ((LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ W)) =
        θ k i * TensorProduct.rid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.lTensor _ W) := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f => simp
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, hX, hY, mul_add]
    have h2 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        (counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.lTensor _
          (TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)) W) = 0 := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f => simp
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, hX, hY, add_zero]
    rw [h1, hx, h2, map_zero, add_zero]

name: LusztigF.lid_rTensor_counit_comul
statement:
theorem lid_rTensor_counit_comul (x : LusztigF k I) :
    TensorProduct.lid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.rTensor _ (comul D v x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_left with
  | algebraMap c => simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | smul c x hx => simp [hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | θ_mul i x hx =>
    rw [comul_θ_mul, map_add, map_add]
    generalize comul D v x = W at hx
    have h1 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        (counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.rTensor _
          ((LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ W) = 0 := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f => simp
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, hX, hY, add_zero]
    have h2 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        TensorProduct.lid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.rTensor _
          (TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)) W)) =
        θ k i * TensorProduct.lid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.rTensor _ W) := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f => simp
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, hX, hY, mul_add]
    rw [h1, h2, hx, map_zero, zero_add]

name: LusztigF.comul_twist
statement:
theorem comul_twist (j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    comul D v (twist D v j x) =
      TensorProduct.map (twist D v j).toLinearMap (twist D v j).toLinearMap (comul D v x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_left with
  | algebraMap c => simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | smul c x hx => simp [hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | θ_mul i x hx =>
    rw [map_mul, twist_θ, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, comul_θ_mul, comul_θ_mul, hx]
    have e1 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        TensorProduct.map (twist D v j).toLinearMap (twist D v j).toLinearMap
          ((LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ W) = v ^ D.dot j i •
          (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _
            (TensorProduct.map (twist D v j).toLinearMap (twist D v j).toLinearMap W) := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f => simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, smul_add, hX, hY]
    have e2 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        TensorProduct.map (twist D v j).toLinearMap (twist D v j).toLinearMap
          (TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)) W) =
        v ^ D.dot j i • TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i))
            (TensorProduct.map (twist D v j).toLinearMap (twist D v j).toLinearMap W) := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f => simp [twist_comm D v i j, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, smul_add, hX, hY]
    rw [map_add, e1, e2, smul_add]

name: LusztigF.lTensor_rDeriv_comul
statement:
theorem lTensor_rDeriv_comul [DecidableEq I] (j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    (rDeriv D v j).lTensor _ (comul D v x) = comul D v (rDeriv D v j x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_left with
  | algebraMap c => simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | smul c x hx => simp [hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | θ_mul i x hx =>
    rw [comul_θ_mul, rDeriv_θ_mul, map_add, map_add, comul_θ_mul, ← hx]
    have key : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        (rDeriv D v j).lTensor _ ((LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ W) +
          (rDeriv D v j).lTensor _
            (TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)) W) =
        (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i)).rTensor _ ((rDeriv D v j).lTensor _ W) +
          TensorProduct.map (twist D v i).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k i))
            ((rDeriv D v j).lTensor _ W) +
          if j = i then TensorProduct.map (twist D v j).toLinearMap (twist D v j).toLinearMap W
          else 0 := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f =>
        simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, map_tmul,
          LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, rDeriv_θ_mul]
        split_ifs with h
        · subst h; rw [tmul_add]; abel
        · simp
      | add X Y hX hY =>
        simp only [map_add] at hX hY ⊢
        split_ifs at hX hY ⊢ <;> [rw [← add_add_add_comm, hX, hY]; rw [← add_add_add_comm, hX, hY]]
        <;> abel
    rw [key]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h; rw [comul_twist]
    · simp

name: LusztigF.lid_rTensor_counit_rDeriv_comul
statement:
theorem lid_rTensor_counit_rDeriv_comul [DecidableEq I] (i : I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    TensorProduct.lid k _ (((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ rDeriv D v i).rTensor _
      (comul D v y)) = lDeriv D v i y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_left with
  | algebraMap c => simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | smul c x hx => simp [hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | θ_mul j y hy =>
    rw [comul_θ_mul, map_add, map_add, lDeriv_θ_mul]
    have e1 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        TensorProduct.lid k _ (((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ rDeriv D v i).rTensor _
          ((LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j)).rTensor _ W)) = (if i = j then (1 : k) else 0) •
          TensorProduct.lid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.rTensor _ W) := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f =>
        simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
          Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, counit_rDeriv_θ_mul, lid_tmul]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, smul_add, hX, hY]
    have e2 : ∀ W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I,
        TensorProduct.lid k _ (((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ rDeriv D v i).rTensor _
          (TensorProduct.map (twist D v j).toLinearMap (LinearMap.mulLeft k (θ k j)) W)) =
        v ^ D.dot i j • (θ k j * TensorProduct.lid k _
          (((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ rDeriv D v i).rTensor _ W)) := by
      intro W
      induction W with
      | tmul e f =>
        simp only [map_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
          Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, lid_tmul, rDeriv_twist, map_smul,
          counit_twist, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
      | add X Y hX hY => simp only [map_add, smul_add, mul_add, hX, hY]
    rw [e1, e2, hy, lid_rTensor_counit_comul]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: LusztigF.form_apply
statement: lemma form_apply (x y : LusztigF k I) : form D v x y = counit (formEnd D v x y)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.formEnd_apply_one
statement:
lemma formEnd_apply_one (x : LusztigF k I) :
    formEnd D v x 1 = algebraMap k _ (counit x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | grade1 i => simp [formEnd]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, ha,
      map_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_smul,
      mul_comm]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.form_algebraMap_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma form_algebraMap_left (c : k) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v (algebraMap k _ c) y = c * counit y
proof:
:= by
  simp [form_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply]

name: LusztigF.form_algebraMap_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma form_algebraMap_right (x : LusztigF k I) (c : k) :
    form D v x (algebraMap k _ c) = c * counit x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, form_apply, formEnd_apply_one]
  simp

name: LusztigF.form_one_left
statement: @[simp] lemma form_one_left (y : LusztigF k I) : form D v 1 y = counit y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using form_algebraMap_left D v 1 y

name: LusztigF.form_one_right
statement: @[simp] lemma form_one_right (x : LusztigF k I) : form D v x 1 = counit x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using form_algebraMap_right D v x 1

name: LusztigF.form_one_one
statement: theorem form_one_one : form D v (1 : LusztigF k I) 1 = 1
proof: := by simp

name: LusztigF.form_mul_θ
statement:
theorem form_mul_θ (x : LusztigF k I) (i : I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v (x * θ k i) y = thetaNorm D v i * form D v x (rDeriv D v i y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [form_apply, formEnd]

name: LusztigF.form_θ_θ
statement:
theorem form_θ_θ (i j : I) :
    form D v (θ k i) (θ k j) = if i = j then thetaNorm D v i else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := form_mul_θ D v 1 i (θ k j)
  rw [one_mul] at this
  rw [this, rDeriv_θ]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LusztigF.form_mul_θ_right
statement:
theorem form_mul_θ_right (x y : LusztigF k I) (j : I) :
    form D v x (y * θ k j) = thetaNorm D v j * form D v (rDeriv D v j x) y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_right generalizing y with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | smul c x hx => simp [hx, mul_left_comm]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp [hx, hx', mul_add]
  | mul_θ x i hx =>
    rw [form_mul_θ, rDeriv_mul_θ, map_add, map_smul, hx, rDeriv_mul_θ]
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, form_mul_θ,
      smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; simp only [ite_true]
    · simp only [h, Ne.symm h, ite_false, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, D.dot_comm]
      ring

name: LusztigF.form_comm
statement: theorem form_comm (x y : LusztigF k I) : form D v x y = form D v y x
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_right generalizing x with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | smul c y hy => simp [hy]
  | add y y' hy hy' => simp [hy, hy']
  | mul_θ y j hy => rw [form_mul_θ_right, hy, form_mul_θ]

name: LusztigF.isSymm_form
statement: theorem isSymm_form : LinearMap.IsSymm (form D v)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.isSymm_def.2 fun x y ↦ by simpa using form_comm D v x y

name: LusztigF.formTensor_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma formTensor_tmul (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : LusztigF k I) :
    formTensor D v (x₁ ⊗ₜ x₂) (y₁ ⊗ₜ y₂) = form D v x₁ y₁ * form D v x₂ y₂
proof:
:= by
  simp [formTensor, mul_comm]

name: LusztigF.formTensor_comm
statement:
lemma formTensor_comm (X Y : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    formTensor D v X Y = formTensor D v Y X
proof:
:= by
  induction X generalizing Y with
  | tmul a b =>
    induction Y with
    | tmul c d => simp [form_comm D v a, form_comm D v b]
    | add Y Z hY hZ => simp [hY, hZ]
  | add X X' hX hX' => simp [hX, hX']

name: LusztigF.formTensor_tmul_one
statement:
lemma formTensor_tmul_one (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    formTensor D v W (y ⊗ₜ 1) =
      form D v (TensorProduct.rid k _ ((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap.lTensor _ W)) y
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | tmul a b => simp [mul_comm]
  | add X Y hX hY => simp [hX, hY]

name: LusztigF.formTensor_tmul_mul_θ
statement:
lemma formTensor_tmul_mul_θ (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) (y z : LusztigF k I) (j : I) :
    formTensor D v W (y ⊗ₜ (z * θ k j)) =
      thetaNorm D v j * formTensor D v ((rDeriv D v j).lTensor _ W) (y ⊗ₜ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | tmul a b => simp [form_mul_θ_right, mul_left_comm]
  | add X Y hX hY => simp [hX, hY, mul_add]

name: LusztigF.form_mul_right
statement:
theorem form_mul_right (x y' y'' : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v x (y' * y'') = formTensor D v (comul D v x) (y' ⊗ₜ y'')
proof:
:= by
  induction y'' using induction_right generalizing x with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      tmul_smul, map_smul, formTensor_tmul_one, rid_lTensor_counit_comul]
  | smul c y hy => rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hy, tmul_smul, map_smul]
  | add y z hy hz => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz, tmul_add, map_add]
  | mul_θ y j hy =>
    rw [← mul_assoc, form_mul_θ_right, hy, formTensor_tmul_mul_θ, lTensor_rDeriv_comul]

name: LusztigF.form_mul_left
statement:
theorem form_mul_left (x' x'' y : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v (x' * x'') y = formTensor D v (x' ⊗ₜ x'') (comul D v y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_comm, form_mul_right, formTensor_comm]

name: LusztigF.formTensor_θ_tmul
statement:
lemma formTensor_θ_tmul (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) :
    formTensor D v (θ k i ⊗ₜ x) W = thetaNorm D v i * form D v x (TensorProduct.lid k _
      (((counit (k := k) (I := I)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ rDeriv D v i).rTensor _ W))
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | tmul a b =>
    have := form_mul_θ D v 1 i a
    rw [one_mul] at this
    simp [this, mul_assoc]
  | add X Y hX hY => simp [hX, hY, mul_add]

name: LusztigF.form_θ_mul
statement:
theorem form_θ_mul (i : I) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v (θ k i * x) y = thetaNorm D v i * form D v x (lDeriv D v i y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_mul_left, formTensor_θ_tmul, lid_rTensor_counit_rDeriv_comul]

name: LusztigF.twist_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma twist_mem_weightSpace (i : I) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) : twist D v i x ∈ weightSpace k ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    induction w with
    | nil => simpa [monomial] using one_mem_weightSpace
    | cons l w ih =>
      rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, twist_θ, smul_mul_assoc, wordWeight_cons]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (mul_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace l) ih)
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.counit_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma counit_eq_zero_of_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) : counit x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    cases w with
    | nil => exact absurd hw.symm hν
    | cons l w => simp
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
  | smul c y _ hy => simp [hy]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_monomial_eq_zero
statement:
lemma rDeriv_monomial_eq_zero (i : I) (w : List I) (hw : wordWeight w i = 0) :
    rDeriv D v i (monomial k w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons l w ih =>
    have hl : l ≠ i := by
      rintro rfl; simp at hw
    have hw' : wordWeight w i = 0 := by
      simp only [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.add_apply] at hw; omega
    rw [monomial_cons, rDeriv_θ_mul, ih hw']
    simp [Ne.symm hl]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_monomial_mem
statement:
lemma rDeriv_monomial_mem (i : I) (w : List I) :
    ∀ μ, wordWeight w = μ + Finsupp.single i 1 →
      rDeriv D v i (monomial k w) ∈ weightSpace k μ
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro μ h
    have := congr($h i)
    simp at this
  | cons l w ih =>
    intro μ h
    rw [monomial_cons, rDeriv_θ_mul]
    rw [wordWeight_cons] at h
    
    have h1 : θ k l * rDeriv D v i (monomial k w) ∈ weightSpace k μ := by
      by_cases hwi : wordWeight w i = 0
      · rw [rDeriv_monomial_eq_zero D v i w hwi, mul_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · have hw : wordWeight w = (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1) + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
          ext j
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
          split_ifs with hij
          · subst hij; omega
          · omega
        have hμ : μ = Finsupp.single l 1 + (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1) := by
          ext j
          have := congr($h j)
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply] at this ⊢
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst hij
            simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this ⊢
            omega
          · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)] at this ⊢
            omega
        rw [hμ]
        exact mul_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace l) (ih _ hw)
    split_ifs with hil
    · subst hil
      have : wordWeight w = μ := by
        rw [add_comm] at h; exact add_right_cancel h
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ h1
        (this ▸ twist_mem_weightSpace D v i (monomial_mem_weightSpace w))
    · rw [add_zero]; exact h1

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma rDeriv_mem_weightSpace (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k (μ + Finsupp.single i 1)) : rDeriv D v i y ∈ weightSpace k μ
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact rDeriv_monomial_mem D v i w μ hw
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma rDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} (hμ : μ i = 0) {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k μ) : rDeriv D v i y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact rDeriv_monomial_eq_zero D v i w hμ
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]

name: LusztigF.form_monomial_eq_zero
statement:
lemma form_monomial_eq_zero (w : List I) :
    ∀ μ y, y ∈ weightSpace k μ → wordWeight w ≠ μ → form D v (monomial k w) y = 0
proof:
:= by
