  induction w using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
    intro μ y hy hμ
    rw [monomial_nil, form_one_left, counit_eq_zero_of_mem (Ne.symm hμ) hy]
  | append_singleton w i ih =>
    intro μ y hy hμ
    rw [monomial_append, show monomial k [i] = θ k i by simp [monomial], form_mul_θ]
    by_cases hμi : μ i = 0
    · rw [rDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D v i hμi hy, map_zero, mul_zero]
    · have hμ' : μ = (μ - Finsupp.single i 1) + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
        ext j
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split_ifs with hij
        · subst hij; omega
        · omega
      rw [hμ'] at hy
      rw [ih _ _ (rDeriv_mem_weightSpace D v i hy), mul_zero]
      intro h
      apply hμ
      rw [wordWeight_append, h, hμ']
      simp

name: LusztigF.form_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem form_eq_zero_of_ne {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} (hνμ : ν ≠ μ) {x y : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k μ) : form D v x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact form_monomial_eq_zero D v w μ y hy (hw ▸ hνμ)
  | zero => simp
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => simp [hx, hz]
  | smul c x _ hx => simp [hx]

name: LusztigF.formTensor_tmul_eq_zero_left
statement:
lemma formTensor_tmul_eq_zero_left {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : ∀ y, form D v x y = 0)
    (z : LusztigF k I) (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) : formTensor D v (x ⊗ₜ z) W = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | tmul a b => simp [hx]
  | add X Y hX hY => simp [hX, hY]

name: LusztigF.formTensor_tmul_eq_zero_right
statement:
lemma formTensor_tmul_eq_zero_right {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : ∀ y, form D v x y = 0)
    (z : LusztigF k I) (W : LusztigF k I ⊗[k] LusztigF k I) : formTensor D v (z ⊗ₜ x) W = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | tmul a b => simp [hx]
  | add X Y hX hY => simp [hX, hY]

name: LusztigF.mem_radical_iff
statement: theorem mem_radical_iff {x : LusztigF k I} : x ∈ radical D v ↔ ∀ y, form D v x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [radical, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_mk']

name: LusztigF.mem_radical_iff'
statement: theorem mem_radical_iff' {x : LusztigF k I} : x ∈ radical D v ↔ ∀ y, form D v y x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_radical_iff, form_comm D v x]

name: LusztigF.thetaNorm_ne_zero
statement: lemma thetaNorm_ne_zero {i : I} (h : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 ≠ 1) : thetaNorm D v i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine inv_ne_zero fun h0 ↦ h ?_
  rw [sub_eq_zero, inv_pow, eq_comm, inv_eq_one] at h0
  exact h0

name: LusztigF.mem_radical_of_rDeriv_mem
statement:
theorem mem_radical_of_rDeriv_mem {x : LusztigF k I} (hx0 : counit x = 0)
    (hx : ∀ i, rDeriv D v i x ∈ radical D v) : x ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_radical_iff']
  intro y
  induction y using induction_right with
  | algebraMap c => rw [form_algebraMap_left, hx0, mul_zero]
  | smul c y hy => simp [hy]
  | add y z hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
  | mul_θ y i _ => rw [form_mul_θ, (mem_radical_iff' D v).1 (hx i), mul_zero]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_mem_radical
statement:
theorem rDeriv_mem_radical {i : I} (hi : thetaNorm D v i ≠ 0) {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ radical D v) : rDeriv D v i x ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_radical_iff']
  intro y
  have := form_mul_θ D v y i x
  rw [(mem_radical_iff' D v).1 hx] at this
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this.symm).resolve_left hi

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_mem_radical
statement:
theorem lDeriv_mem_radical {i : I} (hi : thetaNorm D v i ≠ 0) {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ radical D v) : lDeriv D v i x ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_radical_iff']
  intro y
  have := form_θ_mul D v i y x
  rw [(mem_radical_iff' D v).1 hx] at this
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this.symm).resolve_left hi

name: LusztigF.toQuotient_surjective
statement: theorem toQuotient_surjective : Function.Surjective (toQuotient D v)
proof:
:=
  RingCon.mkₐ_surjective _

name: LusztigF.toQuotient_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem toQuotient_eq_zero_iff {x : LusztigF k I} : toQuotient D v x = 0 ↔ x ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_iff, ← RingCon.eq]
  rfl

name: LusztigF.counit_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_θ (i : I) : counit (θ k i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [counit, FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv]

name: LusztigF.counit_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_algebraMap (c : k) : counit (algebraMap k (LusztigF k I) c) = c
proof:
:=
  FreeAlgebra.algebraMap_leftInverse c

name: LusztigF.induction_left
statement:
theorem induction_left {P : LusztigF k I → Prop} (algebraMap : ∀ c, P (algebraMap k _ c))
    (smul : ∀ (c : k) x, P x → P (c • x)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (θ_mul : ∀ i x, P x → P (θ k i * x)) (x : LusztigF k I) : P x
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a : LusztigF k I, ∀ y, P y → P (a * y) := by
    intro a
    induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c => intro y hy; rw [← Algebra.smul_def]; exact smul c y hy
    | grade1 i => exact θ_mul i
    | mul a b ha hb => intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact ha _ (hb _ hy)
    | add a b ha hb => intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add _ _ (ha _ hy) (hb _ hy)
  simpa using key x 1 (by simpa using algebraMap 1)

name: LusztigF.induction_right
statement:
theorem induction_right {P : LusztigF k I → Prop} (algebraMap : ∀ c, P (algebraMap k _ c))
    (smul : ∀ (c : k) x, P x → P (c • x)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (mul_θ : ∀ x i, P x → P (x * θ k i)) (x : LusztigF k I) : P x
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a : LusztigF k I, ∀ y, P y → P (y * a) := by
    intro a
    induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c => intro y hy; rw [← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def]; exact smul c y hy
    | grade1 i => exact fun y hy ↦ mul_θ y i hy
    | mul a b ha hb => intro y hy; rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hb _ (ha _ hy)
    | add a b ha hb => intro y hy; rw [mul_add]; exact add _ _ (ha _ hy) (hb _ hy)
  simpa using key x 1 (by simpa using algebraMap 1)

name: LusztigF.monomial_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma monomial_nil : monomial k ([] : List I) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.monomial_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma monomial_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    monomial k (i :: w) = θ k i * monomial k w
proof: := by simp [monomial]

name: LusztigF.monomial_append
statement:
lemma monomial_append (w w' : List I) :
    monomial k (w ++ w') = monomial k w * monomial k w'
proof: := by simp [monomial]

name: LusztigF.wordWeight_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordWeight_nil : wordWeight ([] : List I) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.wordWeight_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma wordWeight_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    wordWeight (i :: w) = Finsupp.single i 1 + wordWeight w
proof: := by simp [wordWeight]

name: LusztigF.wordWeight_append
statement:
lemma wordWeight_append (w w' : List I) :
    wordWeight (w ++ w') = wordWeight w + wordWeight w'
proof: := by simp [wordWeight]

name: LusztigF.wordWeight_apply
statement:
lemma wordWeight_apply (w : List I) (i : I) [DecidableEq I] :
    wordWeight w i = w.count i
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    simp only [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.add_apply, ih, List.count_cons, Finsupp.single_apply,
      beq_iff_eq]
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: LusztigF.length_eq_sum_wordWeight
statement: lemma length_eq_sum_wordWeight (w : List I) : w.length = (wordWeight w).sum fun _ n ↦ n
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [wordWeight_cons, Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (by simp), ← ih]
    simp [add_comm]

name: LusztigF.monomial_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma monomial_mem_weightSpace (w : List I) : monomial k w ∈ weightSpace k (wordWeight w)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩

name: LusztigF.one_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma one_mem_weightSpace : (1 : LusztigF k I) ∈ weightSpace k 0
proof:
:=
  monomial_mem_weightSpace (k := k) ([] : List I)

name: LusztigF.algebraMap_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma algebraMap_mem_weightSpace (c : k) : algebraMap k (LusztigF k I) c ∈ weightSpace k 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ one_mem_weightSpace

name: LusztigF.θ_mem_weightSpace
statement: lemma θ_mem_weightSpace (i : I) : θ k i ∈ weightSpace k (Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [monomial] using monomial_mem_weightSpace (k := k) [i]

name: LusztigF.mul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma mul_mem_weightSpace {ν μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x y : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν)
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace k μ) : x * y ∈ weightSpace k (ν + μ)
proof:
:= by
  have : weightSpace k ν * weightSpace k μ ≤ weightSpace k (ν + μ) := by
    rw [weightSpace, weightSpace, Submodule.span_mul_span]
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, _, ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hw hw'
    dsimp only
    rw [← monomial_append, ← hw, ← hw', ← wordWeight_append]
    exact monomial_mem_weightSpace _
  exact this (Submodule.mul_mem_mul hx hy)

name: LusztigF.span_monomial
statement: lemma span_monomial : Submodule.span k (Set.range (monomial k (I := I))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (monomial k (I := I))) from
    eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ h x
  intro x
  induction x using induction_left with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], rfl⟩)
  | smul c x hx => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
  | add x y hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | θ_mul i x hx =>
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i :: w, monomial_cons i w⟩
    | zero => simp
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LusztigF.iSup_weightSpace
statement: theorem iSup_weightSpace : ⨆ ν, weightSpace k (I := I) ν = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_monomial, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (monomial_mem_weightSpace w)

name: LusztigF.gradingHom_monomial
statement:
lemma gradingHom_monomial (w : List I) :
    gradingHom k I (monomial k w) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (wordWeight w) (monomial k w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, ih]
    simp [gradingHom, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]

name: LusztigF.gradingHom_of_mem
statement:
lemma gradingHom_of_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace k ν) :
    gradingHom k I x = AddMonoidAlgebra.single ν x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [gradingHom_monomial, hw]
  | zero => simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_zero]
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add]
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    rw [map_smul, hy, AddMonoidAlgebra.smul_single]

name: LusztigF.iSupIndep_weightSpace
statement: theorem iSupIndep_weightSpace : iSupIndep (weightSpace k (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro ν
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hx hx'
  have h1 : (gradingHom k I x).coeff ν = x := by
    rw [gradingHom_of_mem hx]; simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single]
  have h2 : ∀ y ∈ ⨆ μ, ⨆ (_ : μ ≠ ν), weightSpace k μ, (gradingHom k I y).coeff ν = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem μ y hy =>
      induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
      | mem hμ y hy =>
        rw [gradingHom_of_mem hy]
        simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, hμ]
      | zero => simp
      | add y z _ _ hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
    | zero => simp
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
  rw [← h1, h2 x hx']

name: LusztigF.finite_setOf_wordWeight_eq
statement: lemma finite_setOf_wordWeight_eq (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : {w : List I | wordWeight w = ν}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ n, {w : List I | w.length = n ∧ ∀ i ∈ w, i ∈ ν.support}.Finite := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact (Set.finite_singleton []).subset fun w hw ↦ List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hw.1
    | succ n ih =>
      refine ((ν.support.finite_toSet.image2 (· :: ·) ih)).subset ?_
      rintro (_ | ⟨i, w⟩) ⟨hl, hw⟩
      · simp at hl
      · exact ⟨i, hw i (by simp), w, ⟨by simpa using hl, fun j hj ↦ hw j (by simp [hj])⟩, rfl⟩
  refine (key (ν.sum fun _ n ↦ n)).subset ?_
  rintro w rfl
  refine ⟨length_eq_sum_wordWeight w, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, wordWeight_apply]
    exact (List.count_pos_iff.2 hi).ne'

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma diagTwist_θ (c : I → k) (j : I) : diagTwist c (θ k j) = c j • θ k j
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagTwist]

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_diagTwist
statement:
lemma diagTwist_diagTwist (c c' : I → k) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    diagTwist c (diagTwist c' x) = diagTwist (c * c') x
proof:
:= by
  have : (diagTwist c).comp (diagTwist c') = diagTwist (k := k) (c * c') := by
    ext l
    simp [smul_smul, mul_comm]
  exact congr($this x)

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_comm
statement:
lemma diagTwist_comm (c c' : I → k) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    diagTwist c (diagTwist c' x) = diagTwist c' (diagTwist c x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagTwist_diagTwist, diagTwist_diagTwist, mul_comm]

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_one
statement: @[simp] lemma diagTwist_one (x : LusztigF k I) : diagTwist (fun _ ↦ (1 : k)) x = x
proof:
:= by
  have : diagTwist (k := k) (I := I) (fun _ ↦ 1) = AlgHom.id k _ := by ext l; simp
  rw [this, AlgHom.id_apply]

name: LusztigF.counit_diagTwist
statement:
@[simp] lemma counit_diagTwist (c : I → k) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    counit (diagTwist c x) = counit x
proof:
:= by
  have : counit.comp (diagTwist (k := k) (I := I) c) = counit := by ext l; simp
  exact congr($this x)

name: LusztigF.twist_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma twist_θ (i j : I) : twist D v i (θ k j) = v ^ D.dot i j • θ k j
proof:
:= by
  simp [twist]

name: LusztigF.twist_comm
statement:
lemma twist_comm (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    twist D v i (twist D v j x) = twist D v j (twist D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  have : (twist D v i).comp (twist D v j) = (twist D v j).comp (twist D v i) := by
    ext l
    simp [smul_smul, mul_comm]
  exact congr($this x)

name: LusztigF.counit_twist
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_twist (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : counit (twist D v i x) = counit x
proof:
:= by
  have : counit.comp (twist D v i) = counit := by ext l; simp
  exact congr($this x)

name: LusztigF.twist_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    induction w with
    | nil => simp
    | cons l w ih =>
      rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, ih, twist_θ, smul_mul_smul_comm, wordWeight_cons,
        D.weightDot_add_right, D.weightDot_single_single, zpow_add₀ hv]
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, smul_add]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_comm]

name: LusztigF.rMat_entries
statement:
lemma rMat_entries (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rMat D v i x 0 0 = x ∧ rMat D v i x 1 0 = 0 ∧ rMat D v i x 1 1 = twist D v i x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp [Matrix.algebraMap_matrix_apply]
  | grade1 j => simp [rMat]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, ha.1, ha.2.1, ha.2.2, hb.1, hb.2.1,
      hb.2.2]
    simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha.1, ha.2.1, ha.2.2, hb.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2]

name: LusztigF.lMat_entries
statement:
lemma lMat_entries (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lMat D v i x 0 0 = twist D v i x ∧ lMat D v i x 1 0 = 0 ∧ lMat D v i x 1 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp [Matrix.algebraMap_matrix_apply]
  | grade1 j => simp [lMat]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, ha.1, ha.2.1, ha.2.2, hb.1, hb.2.1,
      hb.2.2]
    simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha.1, ha.2.1, ha.2.2, hb.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_apply
statement: lemma rDeriv_apply (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : rDeriv D v i x = rMat D v i x 0 1
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_apply
statement: lemma lDeriv_apply (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) : lDeriv D v i x = lMat D v i x 0 1
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem rDeriv_mul (i : I) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (x * y) = x * rDeriv D v i y + rDeriv D v i x * twist D v i y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rDeriv_apply, map_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, (rMat_entries D v i x).1,
    (rMat_entries D v i y).2.2]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem lDeriv_mul (i : I) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (x * y) = lDeriv D v i x * y + twist D v i x * lDeriv D v i y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lDeriv_apply, map_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, (lMat_entries D v i x).1,
    (lMat_entries D v i y).2.2]
  rw [add_comm]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma rDeriv_θ (i j : I) : rDeriv D v i (θ k j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rDeriv_apply, rMat]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma lDeriv_θ (i j : I) : lDeriv D v i (θ k j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lDeriv_apply, lMat]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] lemma rDeriv_algebraMap (i : I) (c : k) : rDeriv D v i (algebraMap k _ c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rDeriv_apply, Matrix.algebraMap_matrix_apply]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] lemma lDeriv_algebraMap (i : I) (c : k) : lDeriv D v i (algebraMap k _ c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lDeriv_apply, Matrix.algebraMap_matrix_apply]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_one
statement: @[simp] lemma rDeriv_one (i : I) : rDeriv D v i 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rDeriv_algebraMap D v i (1 : k)

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_one
statement: @[simp] lemma lDeriv_one (i : I) : lDeriv D v i 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using lDeriv_algebraMap D v i (1 : k)

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_θ_mul
statement:
lemma rDeriv_θ_mul (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (θ k j * x) = θ k j * rDeriv D v i x + if i = j then twist D v i x else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_θ]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_mul_θ
statement:
lemma rDeriv_mul_θ (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (x * θ k j) =
      (if i = j then x else 0) + v ^ D.dot i j • (rDeriv D v i x * θ k j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_θ, twist_θ, mul_smul_comm]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_θ_mul
statement:
lemma lDeriv_θ_mul (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (θ k j * x) =
      (if i = j then x else 0) + v ^ D.dot i j • (θ k j * lDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lDeriv_mul, lDeriv_θ, twist_θ, smul_mul_assoc]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_twist
statement:
lemma rDeriv_twist (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (twist D v j x) = v ^ D.dot i j • twist D v j (rDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 l =>
    simp only [twist_θ, map_smul, rDeriv_θ]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp [h, D.dot_comm]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_mul, ha, hb, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, twist_comm D v i j]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_twist
statement:
lemma lDeriv_twist (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (twist D v j x) = v ^ D.dot i j • twist D v j (lDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 l =>
    simp only [twist_θ, map_smul, lDeriv_θ]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp [h, D.dot_comm]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, lDeriv_mul, lDeriv_mul, ha, hb, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, twist_comm D v i j]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.twist_eq_diagTwist
statement: lemma twist_eq_diagTwist (i : I) : twist D v i = diagTwist fun j ↦ v ^ D.dot i j
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_diagTwist
statement:
lemma rDeriv_diagTwist (c : I → k) (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    rDeriv D v i (diagTwist c x) = c i • diagTwist c (rDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 a => simp
  | grade1 l =>
    simp only [diagTwist_θ, map_smul, rDeriv_θ]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_mul, ha, hb, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, twist_eq_diagTwist,
      diagTwist_comm c]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_diagTwist
statement:
lemma lDeriv_diagTwist (c : I → k) (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    lDeriv D v i (diagTwist c x) = c i • diagTwist c (lDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 a => simp
  | grade1 l =>
    simp only [diagTwist_θ, map_smul, lDeriv_θ]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_mul, lDeriv_mul, lDeriv_mul, ha, hb, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, twist_eq_diagTwist,
      diagTwist_comm c]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.counit_rDeriv_θ_mul
statement:
lemma counit_rDeriv_θ_mul (i j : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    counit (rDeriv D v i (θ k j * x)) = if i = j then counit x else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rDeriv_θ_mul]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: LusztigF.rMat_θ
statement:
lemma rMat_θ (l n : I) : rMat D v l (θ k n) =
    !![θ k n, if l = n then 1 else 0; 0, v ^ D.dot l n • θ k n]
proof:
:= by
  simp [rMat]

name: LusztigF.zpow_dot_eq
statement:
lemma zpow_dot_eq {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {m : ℕ} (hm : (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = m + 1) :
    v ^ D.dot i j = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hA := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix).offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have ha : D.cartanMatrix i j = -(m : ℤ) := by omega
  have h1 : D.dot i j = -((D.d i * m : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix, ha]; push_cast; ring
  rw [h1, _root_.zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, pow_mul, inv_pow]

name: LusztigF.zpow_dot_self
statement: lemma zpow_dot_self (i : I) : v ^ D.dot i i = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.two_mul_d, show (2 * (D.d i : ℤ)) = ((D.d i * 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
    zpow_natCast, pow_mul]

name: LusztigF.qSerre_diagonal
statement:
private lemma qSerre_diagonal (ν : k) (M : ℕ) (f g : Fin 2 → LusztigF k I) :
    qSerre ν M (diagonal f) (diagonal g) = diagonal (qSerre ν M f g)
proof:
:= by
  have := map_qSerre (v := ν)
    (Matrix.diagonalAlgHom k : (Fin 2 → LusztigF k I) →ₐ[k] Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) _) M f g
  exact this.symm

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_qSerre
statement:
theorem rDeriv_qSerre (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (l : I) :
    rDeriv D v l (qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix).offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  set m := (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat with hm_def
  have hM : (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = m + 1 := by omega
  have hν : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  rw [rDeriv_apply, map_qSerre, hM, rMat_θ, rMat_θ]
  by_cases hli : l = i
  · subst hli
    simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [zpow_dot_self, zpow_dot_eq hij hM]
    set u : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := diagonal ![θ k l, (v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l]
    set w : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := !![0, 1; 0, 0]
    set b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) :=
      diagonal ![θ k j, (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k j]
    have hU : !![θ k l, 1; 0, (v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l] = u + w := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [u, w]
    have hB : !![θ k j, 0; 0, (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k j] = b + 0 := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [b]
    have hwu : w * u = (v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • (u * w) := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [u, w, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hwb : w * b = (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ ^ m • (b * w) := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [b, w, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hU, hB, qSerre_add hν hwu hwb (by simp), qSerre_zero_right, add_zero, qSerre_diagonal,
      diagonal_apply_ne _ (by decide)]
  · by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst hlj
      simp only [hli, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [zpow_dot_self, D.dot_comm, zpow_dot_eq hij hM]
      set u : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) :=
        diagonal ![θ k i, (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k i]
      set e : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := !![0, 1; 0, 0]
      set b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := diagonal ![θ k l, (v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l]
      have hU : !![θ k i, 0; 0, (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k i] = u := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [u]
      have hB : !![θ k l, 1; 0, (v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l] = b + e := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [b, e]
      have heu : e * u = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m • (u * e) := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [u, e, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      rw [hU, hB, qSerre_add_right, qSerre_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_smul hν heu, add_zero,
        qSerre_diagonal, diagonal_apply_ne _ (by decide)]
    · simp only [hli, hlj, ↓reduceIte]
      have hU : !![θ k i, 0; 0, v ^ D.dot l i • θ k i] =
          diagonal ![θ k i, v ^ D.dot l i • θ k i] := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp
      have hB : !![θ k j, 0; 0, v ^ D.dot l j • θ k j] =
          diagonal ![θ k j, v ^ D.dot l j • θ k j] := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp
      rw [hU, hB, qSerre_diagonal, diagonal_apply_ne _ (by decide)]

name: LusztigF.lMat_θ
statement:
lemma lMat_θ (l n : I) : lMat D v l (θ k n) =
    !![v ^ D.dot l n • θ k n, if l = n then 1 else 0; 0, θ k n]
proof:
:= by
  simp [lMat]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_qSerre
statement:
theorem lDeriv_qSerre (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (l : I) :
    lDeriv D v l (qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix).offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  set m := (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat with hm_def
  have hM : (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = m + 1 := by omega
  have hν : (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv)
  rw [lDeriv_apply, map_qSerre, hM, lMat_θ, lMat_θ, ← qSerre_inv]
  by_cases hli : l = i
  · subst hli
    simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [zpow_dot_self, zpow_dot_eq hij hM]
    set u : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := diagonal ![(v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l, θ k l]
    set w : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := !![0, 1; 0, 0]
    set b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) :=
      diagonal ![(v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k j, θ k j]
    have hU : !![(v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l, 1; 0, θ k l] = u + w := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [u, w]
    have hB : !![(v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k j, 0; 0, θ k j] = b + 0 := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [b]
    have hwu : w * u = (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (u * w) := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;>
        simp [u, w, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_smul,
          inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv))]
    have hwb : w * b = (v ^ D.d l)⁻¹⁻¹ ^ m • (b * w) := by
      ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;>
        simp [b, w, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_smul,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv))]
    rw [hU, hB, qSerre_add hν hwu hwb (by simp), qSerre_zero_right, add_zero, qSerre_diagonal,
      diagonal_apply_ne _ (by decide)]
  · by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst hlj
      simp only [hli, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [zpow_dot_self, D.dot_comm, zpow_dot_eq hij hM]
      set u : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) :=
        diagonal ![(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k i, θ k i]
      set e : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := !![0, 1; 0, 0]
      set b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (LusztigF k I) := diagonal ![(v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l, θ k l]
      have hU : !![(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ m • θ k i, 0; 0, θ k i] = u := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [u]
      have hB : !![(v ^ D.d l) ^ 2 • θ k l, 1; 0, θ k l] = b + e := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [b, e]
      have heu : e * u = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹⁻¹ ^ m • (u * e) := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;>
          simp [u, e, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_smul,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv))]
      rw [hU, hB, qSerre_add_right, qSerre_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_smul hν heu, add_zero,
        qSerre_diagonal, diagonal_apply_ne _ (by decide)]
    · simp only [hli, hlj, ↓reduceIte]
      have hU : !![v ^ D.dot l i • θ k i, 0; 0, θ k i] =
          diagonal ![v ^ D.dot l i • θ k i, θ k i] := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp
      have hB : !![v ^ D.dot l j • θ k j, 0; 0, θ k j] =
          diagonal ![v ^ D.dot l j • θ k j, θ k j] := by
        ext a c; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp
      rw [hU, hB, qSerre_diagonal, diagonal_apply_ne _ (by decide)]

name: LusztigF.qSerre_mem_radical
statement:
theorem qSerre_mem_radical (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j) ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_radical_iff']
  intro y
  induction y using induction_right with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [form_algebraMap_left, map_qSerre, counit_θ, counit_θ, qSerre_zero_right, mul_zero]
  | smul c y hy => simp [hy]
  | add y z hy hz => simp [hy, hz]
  | mul_θ y l _ => rw [form_mul_θ, rDeriv_qSerre hv hij, map_zero, mul_zero]

name: LusztigF.serreElement_mem_radical
statement:
theorem serreElement_mem_radical (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfact : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ≠ 0) :
    serreElement D v i j ∈ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreElement, qSerreDiv_eq hfact, Algebra.smul_def]
  exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ (qSerre_mem_radical hv hij)

name: LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root
statement:
lemma qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I)
    (M : ℕ) : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) M ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine qFactorial_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv) fun n hn _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← pow_mul]
  exact hv' _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) (by omega))

name: LusztigF.serreIdeal_le_radical
statement:
theorem serreIdeal_le_radical (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    serreIdeal D v ≤ radical D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
  exact serreElement_mem_radical hv hij (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv hv' i _)

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_serreElement
statement:
lemma diagTwist_serreElement (c : I → k) (i j : I) :
    diagTwist c (serreElement D v i j) =
      (c i ^ (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat * c j) • serreElement D v i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreElement, map_qSerreDiv, diagTwist_θ, diagTwist_θ, qSerreDiv_smul_smul]

name: LusztigF.smul_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma smul_mem_serreIdeal (c : k) {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    c • x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx

name: LusztigF.serreElement_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma serreElement_mem_serreIdeal {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    serreElement D v i j ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:=
  TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩

name: LusztigF.diagTwist_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem diagTwist_mem_serreIdeal (c : I → k) {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    diagTwist c x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [diagTwist_serreElement]
    exact smul_mem_serreIdeal _ (serreElement_mem_serreIdeal hij)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.neg_mem _ hx
  | left_absorb a x _ hx => rw [map_mul]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx
  | right_absorb b x _ hx => rw [map_mul]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ hx

name: LusztigF.twist_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma twist_mem_serreIdeal (l : I) {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    twist D v l x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_eq_diagTwist]; exact diagTwist_mem_serreIdeal _ hx

name: LusztigF.qSerre_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma qSerre_mem_serreIdeal {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfact : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat (θ k i) (θ k j) ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  have h := serreElement_mem_serreIdeal (D := D) (v := v) (k := k) hij
  rw [serreElement, qSerreDiv_eq hfact] at h
  have := smul_mem_serreIdeal (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat) h
  rwa [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hfact, one_smul] at this

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_serreElement
statement:
lemma rDeriv_serreElement (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfact : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ≠ 0) (l : I) :
    rDeriv D v l (serreElement D v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreElement, qSerreDiv_eq hfact, map_smul, rDeriv_qSerre hv hij, smul_zero]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_serreElement
statement:
lemma lDeriv_serreElement (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hfact : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat ≠ 0) (l : I) :
    lDeriv D v l (serreElement D v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreElement, qSerreDiv_eq hfact, map_smul, lDeriv_qSerre hv hij, smul_zero]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem rDeriv_mem_serreIdeal (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (l : I)
    {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) : rDeriv D v l x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [rDeriv_serreElement hv hij (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv hv' i _)]
    exact (serreIdeal D v).zero_mem
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.neg_mem _ hx
  | left_absorb a x hx' hx =>
    rw [rDeriv_mul]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx)
      (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ (twist_mem_serreIdeal l hx'))
  | right_absorb b x hx' hx =>
    rw [rDeriv_mul]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ hx')
      (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ hx)

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem lDeriv_mem_serreIdeal (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (l : I)
    {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) : lDeriv D v l x ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [lDeriv_serreElement hv hij (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root hv hv' i _)]
    exact (serreIdeal D v).zero_mem
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.neg_mem _ hx
  | left_absorb a x hx' hx =>
    rw [lDeriv_mul]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx')
      (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ hx)
  | right_absorb b x hx' hx =>
    rw [lDeriv_mul]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ hx)
      (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _ (twist_mem_serreIdeal l hx'))

name: LusztigF.counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
theorem counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    counit x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [serreElement, map_qSerreDiv, counit_θ, counit_θ, qSerreDiv_zero_right]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg, hx, neg_zero]
  | left_absorb a x _ hx => rw [map_mul, hx, mul_zero]
  | right_absorb b x _ hx => rw [map_mul, hx, zero_mul]

name: LusztigF.bar_mem_serreIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have h : serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ≤
      (serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K)).comap bar := by
    apply TwoSidedIdeal.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_comap, bar_serreElement]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
  exact (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_comap bar).mp (h hx)

name: LusztigF.bar_mem_serreIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem bar_mem_serreIdeal_iff (x : LusztigF (RatFunc K) I) :
    bar x ∈ serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ↔
      x ∈ serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx ↦ by simpa using bar_mem_serreIdeal D hx, bar_mem_serreIdeal D⟩

name: LusztigF.serreIdeal_comap_bar
statement:
theorem serreIdeal_comap_bar :
    (serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K)).comap bar =
      serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_comap bar).trans (bar_mem_serreIdeal_iff D x)

name: LusztigF.serreBar_toSerreBarQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem serreBar_toSerreBarQuotient (x : LusztigF (RatFunc K) I) :
    serreBar D (toSerreBarQuotient D x) = toSerreBarQuotient D (bar x)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.serreBar_serreBar
statement:
@[simp] theorem serreBar_serreBar (x : SerreBarQuotient (K := K) D) :
    serreBar D (serreBar D x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := RingCon.mkₐ_surjective (α := RatFunc K)
    (serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K)).ringCon x
  change toSerreBarQuotient D (bar (bar x)) = toSerreBarQuotient D x
  rw [bar_bar]

name: LusztigF.serreBar_smul
statement:
theorem serreBar_smul (c : RatFunc K) (x : SerreBarQuotient (K := K) D) :
    serreBar D (c • x) = RatFunc.bar c • serreBar D x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := RingCon.mkₐ_surjective (α := RatFunc K)
    (serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K)).ringCon x
  change serreBar D (c • toSerreBarQuotient D x) =
    RatFunc.bar c • serreBar D (toSerreBarQuotient D x)
  rw [← map_smul, serreBar_toSerreBarQuotient, bar_smul, map_smul,
    serreBar_toSerreBarQuotient]

name: LusztigF.serreBar_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem serreBar_algebraMap (c : RatFunc K) :
    serreBar D (algebraMap (RatFunc K) (SerreBarQuotient (K := K) D) c) =
      algebraMap (RatFunc K) (SerreBarQuotient (K := K) D) (RatFunc.bar c)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one, map_one] using
    serreBar_smul D c (1 : SerreBarQuotient (K := K) D)

name: LusztigF.serreBar_θ
statement:
@[simp] theorem serreBar_θ (i : I) :
    serreBar D (toSerreBarQuotient D (θ (RatFunc K) i)) =
      toSerreBarQuotient D (θ (RatFunc K) i)
proof: := by simp

name: LusztigF.serreBar_qDivPow
statement:
theorem serreBar_qDivPow (d n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    serreBar D (QuantumGroup.qDivPow ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n
      (toSerreBarQuotient D (θ (RatFunc K) i))) =
    QuantumGroup.qDivPow ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ d) n
      (toSerreBarQuotient D (θ (RatFunc K) i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [QuantumGroup.qDivPow, serreBar_smul, QuantumGroup.bar_qFactorial]

name: LusztigF.bar_monomial
statement: theorem bar_monomial (w : List I) : bar (monomial (RatFunc K) w) = monomial (RatFunc K) w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih => simp only [monomial_cons, map_mul, bar_θ, ih]

name: LusztigF.bar_mem_weightSpace
statement:
theorem bar_mem_weightSpace {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF (RatFunc K) I}
    (hx : x ∈ weightSpace (RatFunc K) ν) : bar x ∈ weightSpace (RatFunc K) ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [bar_monomial]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (weightSpace (RatFunc K) ν).zero_mem
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using (weightSpace (RatFunc K) ν).add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => simpa only [bar_smul] using
      (weightSpace (RatFunc K) ν).smul_mem (RatFunc.bar c) hx

name: LusztigF.bar_mem_radical_iff
statement:
theorem bar_mem_radical_iff (x : LusztigF (RatFunc ℚ) I) :
    bar x ∈ radical D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ↔
      x ∈ radical D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_serreIdeal_ratFunc D]
  exact bar_mem_serreIdeal_iff D x

name: LusztigF.radical_comap_bar
statement:
theorem radical_comap_bar :
    (radical D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)).comap bar =
      radical D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_comap bar).trans (bar_mem_radical_iff D x)

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBar_toQuotient (x : LusztigF (RatFunc ℚ) I) :
    quotientBar D (toQuotient D RatFunc.X x) = toQuotient D RatFunc.X (bar x)
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_quotientBar
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBar_quotientBar (x : Quotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)) :
    quotientBar D (quotientBar D x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) x
  simp

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_smul
statement:
theorem quotientBar_smul (c : RatFunc ℚ) (x : Quotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)) :
    quotientBar D (c • x) = RatFunc.bar c • quotientBar D x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) x
  rw [← map_smul, quotientBar_toQuotient, bar_smul, map_smul, quotientBar_toQuotient]

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBar_algebraMap (c : RatFunc ℚ) :
    quotientBar D (algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) (Quotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)) c) =
      algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) (Quotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)) (RatFunc.bar c)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one, map_one] using
    quotientBar_smul D c (1 : Quotient D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ))

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_θ
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBar_θ (i : I) :
    quotientBar D (toQuotient D RatFunc.X (θ (RatFunc ℚ) i)) =
      toQuotient D RatFunc.X (θ (RatFunc ℚ) i)
proof: := by simp

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_qDivPow
statement:
theorem quotientBar_qDivPow (d n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    quotientBar D (QuantumGroup.qDivPow ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ d) n
      (toQuotient D RatFunc.X (θ (RatFunc ℚ) i))) =
    QuantumGroup.qDivPow ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ d) n
      (toQuotient D RatFunc.X (θ (RatFunc ℚ) i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [QuantumGroup.qDivPow, quotientBar_smul, QuantumGroup.bar_qFactorial]

name: LusztigF.skewAdjoint_apply
statement:
lemma skewAdjoint_apply (x : LusztigF k I) :
    skewAdjoint D v i x = x * θ k i - θ k i * twist D v i x
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.skewAdjoint_mul
statement:
lemma skewAdjoint_mul (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    skewAdjoint D v i (x * y) = x * skewAdjoint D v i y +
      skewAdjoint D v i x * twist D v i y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [skewAdjoint_apply, map_mul]
  noncomm_ring

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_skewAdjoint
statement:
lemma lDeriv_skewAdjoint [DecidableEq I] {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : lDeriv D v i x = 0) :
    lDeriv D v i (skewAdjoint D v i x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [skewAdjoint_apply, lDeriv_mul, lDeriv_twist, hx]

name: LusztigF.skewGenerator_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma skewGenerator_zero (j : I) : skewGenerator D v i j 0 = θ k j
proof: := rfl

name: LusztigF.skewGenerator_succ
statement:
lemma skewGenerator_succ (j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    skewGenerator D v i j (n + 1) = skewAdjoint D v i (skewGenerator D v i j n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [skewGenerator, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_skewGenerator
statement:
lemma lDeriv_skewGenerator [DecidableEq I] {j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    lDeriv D v i (skewGenerator D v i j n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hij]
  | succ n ih => rw [skewGenerator_succ]; exact lDeriv_skewAdjoint D v i ih

name: LusztigF.twist_skewGenerator
statement:
lemma twist_skewGenerator (j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    twist D v i (skewGenerator D v i j n) =
      ((v ^ D.dot i i) ^ n * v ^ D.dot i j) • skewGenerator D v i j n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [skewGenerator_succ, skewAdjoint_apply, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul,
      twist_θ, ih, map_smul, ih]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, smul_sub, pow_succ]
    module

name: LusztigF.skewGenerator_eq_rev_serreAux
statement:
lemma skewGenerator_eq_rev_serreAux (hv : v ≠ 0) (j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    skewGenerator D v i j n = rev k I
      (LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux (v ^ D.d i)
        ((v ^ D.d i) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * v ^ D.dot i j) n (θ k i) (θ k j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc : (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * v ^ D.dot i j *
        (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ = (v ^ D.d i) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * v ^ D.dot i j := by
      rw [pow_succ]; field_simp
    have hd : (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * v ^ D.dot i j *
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ n = (v ^ D.dot i i) ^ n * v ^ D.dot i j := by
      rw [zpow_dot_self, pow_succ]; field_simp; ring
    rw [skewGenerator_succ, skewAdjoint_apply, twist_skewGenerator,
      LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux_succ' hq, hc, hd, map_sub, map_smul,
      rev_mul, rev_mul, rev_θ, ← ih, mul_smul_comm]

name: LusztigF.skewDividedGenerator_eq_sum
statement:
lemma skewDividedGenerator_eq_sum (hv : v ≠ 0) (j : I) (n : ℕ)
    (hfac : LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0) :
    skewDividedGenerator D v i j n =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ((-1 : k) ^ r * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ n * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * v ^ D.dot i j) ^ r) •
          (LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) r (θ k i) * θ k j *
            LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (n - r) (θ k i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpow (m : ℕ) : rev k I (θ k i ^ m) = θ k i ^ m := by
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ, rev_mul, ih, rev_θ, ← pow_succ', pow_succ]
  simp only [skewDividedGenerator, skewGenerator_eq_rev_serreAux D v i hv,
    LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreAux, map_sum, map_smul, rev_mul, hpow, rev_θ,
    Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hr
  have hr : r ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
  have hf := LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := v ^ D.d i) hr
  have h1 : LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, mul_zero, zero_mul] at hf; exact hfac hf.symm
  have h2 : LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (n - r) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at hf; exact hfac hf.symm
  have h3 : LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial (v ^ D.d i) n r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, zero_mul, zero_mul] at hf; exact hfac hf.symm
  congr 1
  rw [← hf]
  field_simp

name: LusztigF.skewGenerator_mem
statement:
lemma skewGenerator_mem {j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    skewGenerator D v i j n ∈ skewGenerated D v i
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨j, hij, n, rfl⟩

name: LusztigF.lDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem_skewGenerated
statement:
lemma lDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem_skewGenerated [DecidableEq I] {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ skewGenerated D v i) : lDeriv D v i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, hij, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact lDeriv_skewGenerator D v i hij n
  | algebraMap a => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => simp [lDeriv_mul, hx, hy]

name: LusztigF.twist_mem_skewGenerated
statement:
lemma twist_mem_skewGenerated {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ skewGenerated D v i) : twist D v i x ∈ skewGenerated D v i
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, hij, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [twist_skewGenerator]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (skewGenerator_mem D v i hij n) _
  | algebraMap a => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LusztigF.skewAdjoint_mem_skewGenerated
statement:
lemma skewAdjoint_mem_skewGenerated {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ skewGenerated D v i) : skewAdjoint D v i x ∈ skewGenerated D v i
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, hij, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [← skewGenerator_succ]
    exact skewGenerator_mem D v i hij (n + 1)
  | algebraMap a =>
    have : skewAdjoint D v i (algebraMap k _ a) = 0 := by
      simp [skewAdjoint_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y hx hy hdx hdy =>
    rw [skewAdjoint_mul]
    exact add_mem (mul_mem hx hdy) (mul_mem hdx (twist_mem_skewGenerated D v i hy))

name: LusztigF.skewString_mem
statement:
lemma skewString_mem (n : ℕ) {a : LusztigF k I} (ha : a ∈ skewGenerated D v i) :
    θ k i ^ n * a ∈ skewStringSpan D v i
proof: := Submodule.subset_span ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩

name: LusztigF.mul_theta_mem_skewStringSpan
statement:
lemma mul_theta_mem_skewStringSpan {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ skewStringSpan D v i) (j : I) : x * θ k j ∈ skewStringSpan D v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      have he : (θ k i ^ n * a) * θ k i =
          θ k i ^ n * skewAdjoint D v i a + θ k i ^ (n + 1) * twist D v i a := by
        rw [skewAdjoint_apply, pow_succ]
        noncomm_ring
      rw [he]
      exact add_mem (skewString_mem D v i n (skewAdjoint_mem_skewGenerated D v i ha))
        (skewString_mem D v i (n + 1) (twist_mem_skewGenerated D v i ha))
    · rw [mul_assoc]
      exact skewString_mem D v i n (mul_mem ha (skewGenerator_mem D v i hij 0))
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LusztigF.skewStringSpan_eq_top
statement: theorem skewStringSpan_eq_top : skewStringSpan D v i = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hm (y : LusztigF k I) : ∀ x ∈ skewStringSpan D v i,
      x * y ∈ skewStringSpan D v i := by
    induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 a =>
      intro x hx
      simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx
    | grade1 j => exact fun x hx ↦ mul_theta_mem_skewStringSpan D v i hx j
    | add y z hy hz =>
      intro x hx
      rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem (hy x hx) (hz x hx)
    | mul y z hy hz =>
      intro x hx
      rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hz _ (hy x hx)
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  have hone : (1 : LusztigF k I) ∈ skewStringSpan D v i := by
    simpa using skewString_mem D v i 0 (one_mem (skewGenerated D v i))
  simpa using hm x 1 hone

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotientLDeriv_toQuotient (i : I) (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientLDeriv D i (toQuotient D 𝕧 x) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (lDeriv D 𝕧 i x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quotientLDeriv, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientSkewGenerated D i) : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  change quotientLDeriv D i (toQuotient D 𝕧 y) = 0
  rw [quotientLDeriv_toQuotient, lDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem_skewGenerated D 𝕧 i hy, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientSkewProjection_of_ker
statement:
lemma quotientSkewProjection_of_ker (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0) : quotientSkewProjection D i x = x
proof:
:= by
  have he : (bos (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i).e
      ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm x) = 0 := by
    apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).injective
    simpa [quotientLDeriv] using hx
  simp only [quotientSkewProjection, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  have h := BosonModule.component_df
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero i)
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i)
    he 0 0
  simpa using congrArg (negativeQuotientEquiv D) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientSkewProjection_divided_mul
statement:
lemma quotientSkewProjection_divided_mul (i : I) (n : ℕ) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0) :
    quotientSkewProjection D i (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n * x) =
      if n = 0 then x else 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : (bos (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i).e
      ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm x) = 0 := by
    apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).injective
    simpa [quotientLDeriv] using hx
  have hd := negativeQuotientEquiv_df D i n ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm x)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hd
  rw [← hd]
  simp only [quotientSkewProjection, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [BosonModule.component_df _ _ he]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientSkewProjection_string
statement:
lemma quotientSkewProjection_string (i : I) (n : ℕ) {a : LusztigF 𝕂 I}
    (ha : a ∈ skewGenerated D 𝕧 i) :
    quotientSkewProjection D i (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i ^ n * a)) ∈
      quotientSkewGenerated D i
proof:
:= by
  have hm : toQuotient D 𝕧 a ∈ quotientSkewGenerated D i := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  have hfac : qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0 :=
    qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root RatFunc.X_ne_zero
      (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i n
  have hp : toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i ^ n * a) =
      qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n •
        (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n * toQuotient D 𝕧 a) := by
    simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow, smul_smul, hfac]
  rw [hp, map_smul, quotientSkewProjection_divided_mul D i n
    (quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D i hm)]
  split_ifs
  · exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hm _
  · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientSkewProjection_mem
statement:
lemma quotientSkewProjection_mem (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientSkewProjection D i x ∈ quotientSkewGenerated D i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  have hx : x ∈ skewStringSpan D 𝕧 i := by rw [skewStringSpan_eq_top]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact quotientSkewProjection_string D i n ha
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul]; exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hx _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_quotientSkewGenerated_iff
statement:
theorem mem_quotientSkewGenerated_iff (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    x ∈ quotientSkewGenerated D i ↔ quotientLDeriv D i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D i
  · intro hx
    rw [← quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i hx]
    exact quotientSkewProjection_mem D i x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toQuotient_skewGenerator_eq_zero
statement:
lemma toQuotient_skewGenerator_eq_zero (i j : I) (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat < n) :
    toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewGenerator D 𝕧 i j n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat = (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat + 1 := by
    have := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
    omega
  have hq : 𝕧 ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hbase : toQuotient D 𝕧
      (skewGenerator D 𝕧 i j ((-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [skewGenerator_eq_rev_serreAux D 𝕧 i RatFunc.X_ne_zero,
      zpow_dot_eq hij hN]
    have hc : (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ ((-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat + 1) * (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ *
        ((𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat) = 1 := by
      simp only [pow_succ, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hq]
      rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
    rw [hc, serreAux_one, ← hN]
    apply (toQuotient_eq_zero_iff_mem_serreIdeal D transcendental_ratFunc_X).mpr
    exact rev_mem_serreIdeal D 𝕧 (qSerre_mem_serreIdeal hij
      (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root RatFunc.X_ne_zero
        (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i _))
  induction n, Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact hbase
  | succ n _ ih =>
    rw [skewGenerator_succ, skewAdjoint_apply, twist_skewGenerator,
      map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_smul, ih (by omega)]
    simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientSkewGenerators_eq
statement:
lemma quotientSkewGenerators_eq (i : I) :
    quotientSkewGenerators D i = quotientSkewGenerated D i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro _ ⟨j, hij, n, _, rfl⟩
    rw [skewDividedGenerator, map_smul]
    have hm : toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewGenerator D 𝕧 i j n) ∈ quotientSkewGenerated D i :=
      ⟨_, skewGenerator_mem D 𝕧 i hij n, rfl⟩
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hm _
  · rintro x ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    change toQuotient D 𝕧 x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨j, hij, n, rfl⟩ := hx
      by_cases hn : n ≤ (-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat
      · have hm : toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j n) ∈
            quotientSkewGenerators D i := Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩
        have hf := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) RatFunc.X_ne_zero
          (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i n
        have he : toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewGenerator D 𝕧 i j n) =
            qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n •
              toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j n) := by
          simp [skewDividedGenerator, smul_smul, hf]
        rw [he]; exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hm _
      · rw [toQuotient_skewGenerator_eq_zero D i j hij n (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hn)]
        exact zero_mem _
    | algebraMap c => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff
statement:
theorem mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i ↔ quotientLDeriv D i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientSkewGenerators_eq, mem_quotientSkewGenerated_iff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_quotientSkewGenerators_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_quotientSkewGenerators_decomposition (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → Quotient D 𝕧), (∀ n, a n ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) ∧
      x = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, quotientIntegralGenerator D i n * a n
proof:
:= by
  let V := bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i
  have hq0 := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (D := D) (v := 𝕧) RatFunc.X_ne_zero i
  have hq := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (D := D)
    (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i
  let u := (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm x
  obtain ⟨N, _, hN⟩ := V.exists_sum_component hq0 hq u
  refine ⟨N, fun n ↦ negativeQuotientEquiv D (V.component hq0 hq n u), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    rw [mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff]
    simp only [quotientLDeriv, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change negativeQuotientEquiv D (V.e (V.component hq0 hq n u)) = 0
    rw [V.e_component hq0 hq, map_zero]
  · have h := congrArg (negativeQuotientEquiv D) hN
    simpa only [u, V, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_sum, negativeQuotientEquiv_df] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_divided_mul_of_mem_skewGenerators
statement:
theorem quotientForm_divided_mul_of_mem_skewGenerators (i : I) (r s : ℕ)
    {x y : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i)
    (hy : y ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i) :
    quotientForm D (quotientIntegralGenerator D i r * x)
      (quotientIntegralGenerator D i s * y) =
      if r = s then coefU D 𝕧 i r * quotientForm D x y else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine quotientForm_divided_mul D i ?_ ?_ r s
  · apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).injective
    simpa [quotientLDeriv] using (mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i x).mp hx
  · apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).injective
    simpa [quotientLDeriv] using (mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i y).mp hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_separates
statement:
lemma quotientForm_separates (x : Quotient D 𝕧)
    (hx : ∀ y, quotientForm D x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  rw [toQuotient_eq_zero_iff, mem_radical_iff]
  intro b
  simpa using hx (toQuotient D 𝕧 b)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_comm
statement:
lemma quotientForm_comm (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientForm D x y = quotientForm D y x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  simp only [quotientForm_toQuotient, form_comm D 𝕧 a b]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_tensor_separates
statement:
lemma quotientForm_tensor_separates (z : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧)
    (hz : ∀ x y, (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) z (x ⊗ₜ y) = 0) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := quotientForm D
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧)
  let e := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight (M := Quotient D 𝕧) b
  have hleft (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
      TensorProduct.lid 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) ((B.flip x).rTensor _ z) = 0 := by
    apply quotientForm_separates
    intro y
    have he : B (TensorProduct.lid 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) ((B.flip x).rTensor _ z)) y =
        B.tmul B z (x ⊗ₜ y) := by
      clear hz
      induction z with
      | tmul a c => simp [mul_comm]
      | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hv]
    exact he.trans (hz x y)
  apply e.injective
  ext j
  change e z j = 0
  apply quotientForm_separates
  intro x
  have he : B (e z j) x =
      b.coord j (TensorProduct.lid 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) ((B.flip x).rTensor _ z)) := by
    clear hz hleft
    induction z with
    | tmul a c => simp [e, mul_comm]
    | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hv]
  rw [he, hleft, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientTensorMap_pair
statement:
lemma quotientTensorMap_pair (z : LusztigF 𝕂 I ⊗[𝕂] LusztigF 𝕂 I)
    (a b : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) (quotientTensorMap D z)
      (toQuotient D 𝕧 a ⊗ₜ toQuotient D 𝕧 b) = formTensor D 𝕧 z (a ⊗ₜ b)
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul c d => simp [quotientTensorMap, formTensor, quotientForm_toQuotient]
  | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientTensorMap_comul_radical
statement:
lemma quotientTensorMap_comul_radical {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I}
    (hx : x ∈ radical D 𝕧) : quotientTensorMap D (LusztigF.comul D 𝕧 x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientForm_tensor_separates
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 b
  rw [quotientTensorMap_pair, ← form_mul_right]
  exact (mem_radical_iff D 𝕧).mp hx (a * b)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientComul_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotientComul_toQuotient (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientComul D (toQuotient D 𝕧 x) = quotientTensorMap D (LusztigF.comul D 𝕧 x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [quotientComul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientComul_pair
statement:
lemma quotientComul_pair (x a b : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) (quotientComul D x) (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      quotientForm D x (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 b
  rw [quotientComul_toQuotient, quotientTensorMap_pair, ← form_mul_right, ← map_mul,
    quotientForm_toQuotient]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_lDeriv
statement:
lemma quotientForm_lDeriv (i : I) (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    thetaNorm D 𝕧 i * quotientForm D (quotientLDeriv D i x) y =
      quotientForm D x (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i) * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  rw [quotientLDeriv_toQuotient, ← map_mul, quotientForm_toQuotient,
    quotientForm_toQuotient, form_comm D 𝕧 x, form_θ_mul, form_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_rTensor_comul
statement:
lemma quotientLDeriv_rTensor_comul (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    (quotientLDeriv D i).rTensor _ (quotientComul D x) =
      quotientComul D (quotientLDeriv D i x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply quotientForm_tensor_separates
  intro a b
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
  have hn : thetaNorm D 𝕧 i ≠ 0 := thetaNorm_ne_zero D 𝕧 (by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    exact ratFunc_X_not_root _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) (by decide)))
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hn
  have he (z : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) :
      thetaNorm D 𝕧 i * (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
        ((quotientLDeriv D i).rTensor _ z) (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) z
        ((toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i) * a) ⊗ₜ b) := by
    induction z with
    | tmul c d =>
      simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rw [mul_left_comm, quotientForm_lDeriv]
    | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, mul_add, hu, hv]
  rw [he, quotientComul_pair, quotientComul_pair, quotientForm_lDeriv, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientComul_left_kernel
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientLDeriv_rTensor_comul, hx, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientSkewProjection_rTensor_comul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧)
  let e := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight (M := Quotient D 𝕧) b
  have he (f : Module.End 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧))
      (z : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) (j) : e (f.rTensor _ z) j = f (e z j) := by
    induction z with
    | tmul a c => simp [e]
    | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hu, hv]
  apply e.injective
  ext j
  rw [he]
  apply quotientSkewProjection_of_ker
  rw [← he, quotientComul_left_kernel D i hx, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientComul_mem_skewTensor
statement:
theorem quotientComul_mem_skewTensor (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0) :
    quotientComul D x ∈ LinearMap.range
      (TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewGenerators D i).toSubmodule.subtype
        (LinearMap.id : Module.End 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧)))
proof:
:= by
  let p : Quotient D 𝕧 →ₗ[𝕂] (quotientSkewGenerators D i).toSubmodule :=
    (quotientSkewProjection D i).codRestrict _ fun y ↦ by
      rw [quotientSkewGenerators_eq]
      exact quotientSkewProjection_mem D i y
  refine ⟨TensorProduct.map p LinearMap.id (quotientComul D x), ?_⟩
  have he (z : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) :
      TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewGenerators D i).toSubmodule.subtype LinearMap.id
        (TensorProduct.map p LinearMap.id z) = (quotientSkewProjection D i).rTensor _ z := by
    induction z with
    | tmul a b => rfl
    | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, hu, hv]
  rw [he, quotientSkewProjection_rTensor_comul D i hx]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_skewProjection_of_ker
statement:
lemma quotientForm_skewProjection_of_ker (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧)
    {y : Quotient D 𝕧} (hy : quotientLDeriv D i y = 0) :
    quotientForm D (quotientSkewProjection D i x) y = quotientForm D x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, a, ha, rfl⟩ := exists_quotientSkewGenerators_decomposition D i x
  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  have ha' := (mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i (a n)).mp (ha n)
  rw [quotientSkewProjection_divided_mul D i n ha']
  have h := quotientForm_divided_mul_of_mem_skewGenerators D i n 0 (ha n)
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i y).mpr hy)
  have hzero : quotientIntegralGenerator D i 0 = 1 := by
    simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]
  rw [hzero, one_mul] at h
  rw [h]
  split_ifs with hn0
  · subst n
    simp [GrandLoop.coefU]
  · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientSkewProjection_selfAdjoint
statement:
theorem quotientSkewProjection_selfAdjoint (i : I) (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientForm D (quotientSkewProjection D i x) y =
      quotientForm D x (quotientSkewProjection D i y)
proof:
:= by
  have hp (z : Quotient D 𝕧) : quotientLDeriv D i (quotientSkewProjection D i z) = 0 :=
    quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D i (quotientSkewProjection_mem D i z)
  calc
    quotientForm D (quotientSkewProjection D i x) y =
        quotientForm D y (quotientSkewProjection D i x) := quotientForm_comm D _ _
    _ = quotientForm D (quotientSkewProjection D i y)
        (quotientSkewProjection D i x) :=
      (quotientForm_skewProjection_of_ker D i y (hp x)).symm
    _ = quotientForm D (quotientSkewProjection D i x)
        (quotientSkewProjection D i y) := quotientForm_comm D _ _
    _ = _ := quotientForm_skewProjection_of_ker D i x (hp y)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.projectedQuotientComul_pair
statement:
theorem projectedQuotientComul_pair (i : I) (z : Quotient D 𝕧)
    {x y : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0)
    (hy : quotientLDeriv D i y = 0) :
    (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) (projectedQuotientComul D i z) (x ⊗ₜ y) =
      quotientForm D z (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  have he (w : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) :
      (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
        (TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientSkewProjection D i) w)
        (x ⊗ₜ y) = (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) w (x ⊗ₜ y) := by
    induction w with
    | tmul a b =>
      simp only [map_tmul, LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul,
        quotientForm_skewProjection_of_ker D i a hx,
        quotientForm_skewProjection_of_ker D i b hy]
    | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hv]
  change (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
    (TensorProduct.map _ _ (quotientComul D z)) _ = _
  rw [he, quotientComul_pair]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientRev_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotientRev_toQuotient (a : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientRev D (toQuotient D 𝕧 a) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (rev 𝕂 I a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quotientRev, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient, GrandLoop.starU_mk]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientRev_rev
statement: @[simp] lemma quotientRev_rev (x : Quotient D 𝕧) : quotientRev D (quotientRev D x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  simp [rev_rev]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientRev_mul
statement:
lemma quotientRev_mul (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientRev D (x * y) = quotientRev D y * quotientRev D x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  simp only [← map_mul, quotientRev_toQuotient, rev_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_rev
statement:
lemma quotientForm_rev (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientForm D (quotientRev D x) (quotientRev D y) = quotientForm D x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  simp only [quotientRev_toQuotient, quotientForm_toQuotient, form_rev]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientRDeriv_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotientRDeriv_toQuotient (i : I) (a : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientRDeriv D i (toQuotient D 𝕧 a) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (rDeriv D 𝕧 i a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [quotientRDeriv, lDeriv_rev, rev_rev]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientRDeriv_mul_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  rw [quotientRDeriv_toQuotient] at hx hy
  rw [← map_mul, quotientRDeriv_toQuotient, rDeriv_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, hx, hy]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_rDeriv
statement:
lemma quotientForm_rDeriv (i : I) (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    thetaNorm D 𝕧 i * quotientForm D (quotientRDeriv D i x) y =
      quotientForm D x (y * toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  rw [quotientRDeriv_toQuotient, ← map_mul, quotientForm_toQuotient,
    quotientForm_toQuotient, form_comm D 𝕧 x, form_mul_θ, form_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientRDeriv_lTensor_comul
statement:
theorem quotientRDeriv_lTensor_comul (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    (quotientRDeriv D i).lTensor _ (quotientComul D x) =
      quotientComul D (quotientRDeriv D i x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply quotientForm_tensor_separates
  intro a b
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
  have hn : thetaNorm D 𝕧 i ≠ 0 := thetaNorm_ne_zero D 𝕧 (by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    exact ratFunc_X_not_root _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) (by decide)))
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hn
  have he (z : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) :
      thetaNorm D 𝕧 i * (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D)
        ((quotientRDeriv D i).lTensor _ z) (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      (quotientForm D).tmul (quotientForm D) z
        (a ⊗ₜ (b * toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i))) := by
    induction z with
    | tmul c d =>
      simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, quotientForm_rDeriv]
    | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, mul_add, hu, hv]
  rw [he, quotientComul_pair, quotientComul_pair, quotientForm_rDeriv, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientComul_right_kernel
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientRDeriv_lTensor_comul, hx, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientRDeriv_braid_image
statement:
theorem quotientRDeriv_braid_image (i : I) {x y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y) :
    quotientRDeriv D i y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∀ x ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i, ∃ y : Quotient D 𝕧,
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y ∧
      quotientRDeriv D i y = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨toQuotient D 𝕧 (rev 𝕂 I
        (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j ((-D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat - n))),
        braid_skewDividedGenerator R hij n hn, ?_⟩
      simp only [quotientRDeriv_toQuotient, rDeriv_rev, skewDividedGenerator,
        map_smul, lDeriv_skewGenerator D 𝕧 i hij]
      simp
    | algebraMap c =>
      refine ⟨algebraMap 𝕂 _ c, by simp, ?_⟩
      rw [← (toQuotient D 𝕧).commutes, quotientRDeriv_toQuotient]
      simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hx0⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hy0⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨x' + y', by simp only [map_add, hx', hy'], by simp [hx0, hy0]⟩
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hx0⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hy0⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨x' * y', by simp only [map_mul, hx', hy'], quotientRDeriv_mul_zero D i hx0 hy0⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := hex x ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i x).mpr hx)
  have : z = y := quotientPlus_injective R (hz.symm.trans hxy)
  simpa only [this] using hz0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientComul_mem_rightKernelTensor
statement:
theorem quotientComul_mem_rightKernelTensor (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientRDeriv D i x = 0) :
    quotientComul D x ∈ LinearMap.range
      ((LinearMap.ker (quotientRDeriv D i)).subtype.lTensor (Quotient D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  have he : (LinearMap.ker (quotientRDeriv D i)).subtype.lTensor (Quotient D 𝕧) =
      AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧)
        (LinearMap.ker (quotientRDeriv D i)).subtype := by
    ext a b
    rfl
  have hf : (quotientRDeriv D i).lTensor (Quotient D 𝕧) =
      AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) (quotientRDeriv D i) := by
    ext a b
    rfl
  rw [he, ← Module.Flat.ker_lTensor_eq 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) (quotientRDeriv D i), ← hf]
  exact quotientComul_right_kernel D i hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientComul_braid_coideal
statement:
theorem quotientComul_braid_coideal (i : I) {x y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y) :
    quotientComul D x ∈ LinearMap.range
      (TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewGenerators D i).toSubmodule.subtype
        (LinearMap.id : Module.End 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧))) ∧
    quotientComul D y ∈ LinearMap.range
      ((LinearMap.ker (quotientRDeriv D i)).subtype.lTensor (Quotient D 𝕧))
proof:
:=
  ⟨quotientComul_mem_skewTensor D i hx,
    quotientComul_mem_rightKernelTensor D i (quotientRDeriv_braid_image D R i hx hxy)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.quotientComul_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
statement:
theorem quotientComul_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero
    (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w)) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientComul D (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 c)) ∈ LinearMap.range
      (TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewGenerators D i).toSubmodule.subtype
        (LinearMap.id : Module.End 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧))) ∧
    quotientComul D (integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) c) ∈
      LinearMap.range
        ((LinearMap.ker (quotientRDeriv D i)).subtype.lTensor (Quotient D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientComul_braid_coideal D R i
  · exact quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw c
  · exact braid_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.X_pow_pow
statement: lemma X_pow_pow (a b : ℕ) : ((𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ a) ^ b = 𝕧 ^ ((a : ℤ) * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast]; push_cast; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.X_zpow_pow
statement: lemma X_zpow_pow (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ) : ((𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ a) ^ b = 𝕧 ^ (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.X_pow_eq
statement: lemma X_pow_eq (a : ℕ) : ((𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ a) = 𝕧 ^ (a : ℤ)
proof: := (zpow_natCast _ _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_X_one
statement: lemma qInt_X_one (i : I) : qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [qInt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivPow_one
statement: lemma fDivPow_one (i : I) : fDivPow D i 1 = θ 𝕂 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [fDivPow, qDivPow, qFactorial, qInt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_fDivPow_succ
statement:
lemma rDeriv_fDivPow_succ (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    rDeriv D 𝕧 i (fDivPow D i (n + 1)) = (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ n • fDivPow D i n
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (𝕧 ^ D.d i : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [fDivPow_one, fDivPow_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fDivPow_succ D i (n + 1), map_smul, rDeriv_θ_mul, ih]
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    rw [twist_fDivPow, mul_smul_comm, θ_mul_fDivPow, smul_smul, ← add_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    have h := qInt_X_ne_zero D i (Nat.succ_pos (n + 1))
    have e : (𝕧 ^ D.d i : 𝕂) ^ n * qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n + 1) + ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ 2) ^ (n + 1) =
        (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1) * qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n + 1 + 1) := by
      rw [qInt_succ (n + 1)]; field_simp; ring
    rw [e, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_fDivPow_zero
statement: lemma rDeriv_fDivPow_zero (h i : I) : rDeriv D 𝕧 h (fDivPow D i 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fDivPow_zero, rDeriv_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne
statement:
lemma rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne {h i : I} (hhi : h ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :
    rDeriv D 𝕧 h (fDivPow D i n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ m : ℕ, rDeriv D 𝕧 h (θ 𝕂 i ^ m) = 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', rDeriv_θ_mul, ih, mul_zero, zero_add, ite_eq_right_iff]
      exact fun h ↦ absurd h hhi
  rw [fDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, this, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twist_fDivPow'
statement:
lemma twist_fDivPow' (h i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    twist D 𝕧 h (fDivPow D i n) = (𝕧 ^ D.dot h i) ^ n • fDivPow D i n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, twist_θ, smul_pow]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_fDivPow_succ
statement: lemma counit_fDivPow_succ (i : I) (n : ℕ) : LusztigF.counit (fDivPow D i (n + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow]
  simp
