name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_higherSerre_self
statement:
theorem rDeriv_higherSerre_self {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ) :
    rDeriv D 𝕧 i (higherSerre D i j n (m + 1) (-1)) =
      (𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * m) - 𝕧 ^ (2 * D.dot i j * n + 3 * D.d i * m)) •
        higherSerre D i j n m (-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have key : ∀ r s : ℕ, rDeriv D 𝕧 i (fDivPow D i r * fDivPow D j n * fDivPow D i s) =
      fDivPow D i r * fDivPow D j n * rDeriv D 𝕧 i (fDivPow D i s) +
        ((𝕧 ^ D.dot i i) ^ s * (𝕧 ^ D.dot i j) ^ n) •
          (rDeriv D 𝕧 i (fDivPow D i r) * fDivPow D j n * fDivPow D i s) := by
    intro r s
    rw [rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hij, mul_zero, zero_add,
      twist_fDivPow', twist_fDivPow']
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
  rw [higherSerre, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, key, smul_add, sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ', Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ]
  simp only [rDeriv_fDivPow_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, smul_zero, zero_add,
    rDeriv_fDivPow_succ, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
  rw [higherSerre, smul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [smul_smul, ← add_smul]
  congr 1
  have hs : ((p.2 : ℤ)) = m - p.1 := by omega
  simp only [X_pow_pow, X_zpow_pow, pow_succ, sub_mul, mul_sub,
    show D.dot i i = 2 * D.d i from (D.two_mul_d i).symm]
  simp only [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hX, neg_mul, mul_neg]
  simp only [one_mul]
  rw [mul_left_comm _ ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ p.1), mul_left_comm _ ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ p.1),
    ← zpow_add₀ hX, ← zpow_add₀ hX, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  congr 3 <;> (push_cast; rw [hs]; ring)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_higherSerre_right
statement:
theorem rDeriv_higherSerre_right {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ) :
    rDeriv D 𝕧 j (higherSerre D i j (n + 1) m (-1)) =
      ((𝕧 ^ D.d j) ^ n * 𝕧 ^ (D.dot i j * m)) • higherSerre D i j n m (-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  rw [higherSerre, higherSerre, map_sum, smul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [map_smul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hij.symm,
    rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hij.symm, rDeriv_fDivPow_succ, twist_fDivPow', twist_fDivPow',
    D.dot_comm j i]
  simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, smul_zero, add_zero, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
    smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have hs : ((p.2 : ℤ)) = m - p.1 := by omega
  simp only [X_pow_pow, X_zpow_pow]
  simp only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm _ ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ p.1)]
  simp only [← zpow_add₀ hX]
  congr 2
  push_cast; rw [hs]; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_higherSerre_right_zero
statement:
theorem rDeriv_higherSerre_right_zero {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : ℕ) :
    rDeriv D 𝕧 j (higherSerre D i j 0 m (-1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [higherSerre, map_sum]
  refine sum_eq_zero fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hij.symm,
    rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hij.symm, rDeriv_fDivPow_zero]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rDeriv_higherSerre_of_ne
statement:
theorem rDeriv_higherSerre_of_ne {h i j : I} (hi : h ≠ i) (hj : h ≠ j) (n m : ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    rDeriv D 𝕧 h (higherSerre D i j n m e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [higherSerre, map_sum]
  refine sum_eq_zero fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_mul, rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hi, rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hi,
    rDeriv_fDivPow_of_ne D hj]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_higherSerre
statement:
lemma counit_higherSerre (i j : I) (n m : ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    LusztigF.counit (higherSerre D i j n (m + 1) e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [higherSerre, map_sum]
  refine sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [map_smul, map_mul, map_mul]
  rcases p with ⟨_ | r, _ | s⟩
  · simp at hp
  · simp [counit_fDivPow_succ]
  · simp [counit_fDivPow_succ]
  · simp [counit_fDivPow_succ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.smul_mem_radical
statement:
lemma smul_mem_radical (c : 𝕂) {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ radical D 𝕧) :
    c • x ∈ radical D 𝕧
proof:
:=
  (mem_radical_iff D 𝕧).2 fun y ↦ by simp [(mem_radical_iff D 𝕧).1 hx y]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical_aux
statement:
lemma higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical_aux {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ)
    (hj : ∀ m : ℕ, -D.cartanMatrix i j * n < m →
      rDeriv D 𝕧 j (higherSerre D i j n m (-1)) ∈ radical D 𝕧) (m : ℕ)
    (h : -D.cartanMatrix i j * n < m) : higherSerre D i j n m (-1) ∈ radical D 𝕧
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 ≤ -D.cartanMatrix i j := by
    have := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos i j hij; omega
  have hd := D.d_mul_cartanMatrix i j
  induction m with
  | zero => push_cast at h; nlinarith
  | succ m ihm =>
    refine mem_radical_of_rDeriv_mem D 𝕧 (counit_higherSerre _ _ _ _ _) fun k ↦ ?_
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst hki
      rw [rDeriv_higherSerre_self hij]
      by_cases hm : -D.cartanMatrix k j * n < (m : ℤ)
      · exact smul_mem_radical _ (ihm hm)
      · have hm' : (m : ℤ) = -D.cartanMatrix k j * n := by push_cast at h ⊢; omega
        rw [show (2 * D.dot k j * n + 3 * D.d k * m : ℤ) = D.d k * m by
          rw [hm', ← hd]; ring, sub_self, zero_smul]
        exact zero_mem _
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst hkj
      exact hj _ h
    · rw [rDeriv_higherSerre_of_ne hki hkj]
      exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical
statement:
theorem higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ)
    (h : -D.cartanMatrix i j * n < m) : higherSerre D i j n m (-1) ∈ radical D 𝕧
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 ≤ -D.cartanMatrix i j := by
    have := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.offDiag_nonpos i j hij; omega
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    refine higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical_aux hij 0 (fun m _ ↦ ?_) m h
    rw [rDeriv_higherSerre_right_zero hij]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ n ihn =>
    refine higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical_aux hij (n + 1) (fun m hm ↦ ?_) m h
    rw [rDeriv_higherSerre_right hij]
    exact smul_mem_radical _ (ihn m (by push_cast at hm; nlinarith))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rev_higherSerre
statement:
lemma rev_higherSerre (i j : I) (n m : ℕ) (e : ℤ) :
    rev 𝕂 I (higherSerre D i j n m e) =
      ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ m * 𝕧 ^ (e * m * (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * ((m : ℤ) - 1)))) •
        higherSerre D i j n m (-e)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  rw [higherSerre, higherSerre, map_sum, smul_sum, ← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  simp only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap, map_smul, rev_mul, fDivPow, rev_qDivPow, smul_smul,
    mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  have hs : (p.2 : ℤ) = m - p.1 := by omega
  have hm : (-1 : 𝕂) ^ p.2 = (-1) ^ m * (-1) ^ p.1 := by
    have h2 : ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ p.1) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]; simp
    rw [← hp, pow_add]
    linear_combination (-(-1 : 𝕂) ^ p.2) * h2
  rw [hm, mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_left_comm (𝕧 ^ _ : 𝕂) ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ p.1), ← zpow_add₀ hX]
  congr 2
  rw [hs]; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rev_mem_radical
statement: lemma rev_mem_radical {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ radical D 𝕧) : rev 𝕂 I x ∈ radical D 𝕧
proof:
:=
  (mem_radical_iff D 𝕧).2 fun y ↦ by
    rw [← rev_rev y, form_rev, (mem_radical_iff D 𝕧).1 hx]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.higherSerre_one_mem_radical
statement:
theorem higherSerre_one_mem_radical {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n m : ℕ)
    (h : -D.cartanMatrix i j * n < m) : higherSerre D i j n m 1 ∈ radical D 𝕧
proof:
:= by
  have := rev_mem_radical (smul_mem_radical
    ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ m * 𝕧 ^ ((-1) * m * (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * ((m : ℤ) - 1))))⁻¹
    (higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical hij n m h))
  have hr := rev_higherSerre (D := D) i j n m (-1)
  rw [neg_neg] at hr
  rwa [map_smul, hr, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (by simp) (zpow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero)), one_smul] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.higherSerre_mem_radical
proof:
:= by
  rcases he with rfl | rfl
  · exact higherSerre_one_mem_radical hij n m h
  · exact higherSerre_neg_one_mem_radical hij n m h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toQuotient_higherSerre
proof:
:=
  (toQuotient_eq_zero_iff D 𝕧).2 (higherSerre_mem_radical hij n m he h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qFactorial_X_ne_zero
statement: lemma qFactorial_X_ne_zero (i : I) (M : ℕ) : qFactorial ((𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ D.d i) M ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root RatFunc.X_ne_zero (fun _ hn ↦ ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one hn) i M

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fDivPow_mul_fDivPow
statement:
lemma fDivPow_mul_fDivPow (i : I) (r s : ℕ) :
    fDivPow D i r * fDivPow D i s = qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (r + s) r • fDivPow D i (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  have e := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := (𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ D.d i)
    (Nat.le_add_right r s)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at e
  have hr := qFactorial_X_ne_zero D i r
  have hs := qFactorial_X_ne_zero D i s
  have hB : qBinomial ((𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ D.d i) (r + s) r ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    qFactorial_X_ne_zero D i (r + s) (by rw [← e, h0]; ring)
  simp only [fDivPow, qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm, ← pow_add, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [← e]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toQuotient_fDivPow_mul_fDivPow
statement:
theorem toQuotient_fDivPow_mul_fDivPow {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {a n m : ℕ}
    (ha : D.cartanMatrix i j = -a) (hm : a * n < m) :
    toQuotient D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i m * fDivPow D j n) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (a * n + 1), higherSerreCoeff D i a n m (m - r) •
        toQuotient D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i r * fDivPow D j n * fDivPow D i (m - r))
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hdot : D.dot i j = -((D.d i : ℤ) * a) := by rw [← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix, ha]; ring
  obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ : ∃ Y : ℕ → Quotient D 𝕧,
      ∀ r, Y r = toQuotient D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i r * fDivPow D j n * fDivPow D i (m - r)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℕ → ℕ → 𝕂, ∀ q r, c q r = (-1) ^ r *
      𝕧 ^ ((1 : ℤ) * (r : ℤ) * (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * (((m - q : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1))) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℕ → 𝕂, ∀ q, w q = (-1) ^ q * 𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * (-((m : ℤ) * q) + q)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℕ → 𝕂, ∀ r,
      C r = ∑ q ∈ range (m - a * n), w q * c q r * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m - r) q :=
    ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  
  have h2 : ∀ q ≤ m, toQuotient D 𝕧 (higherSerre D i j n (m - q) 1 * fDivPow D i q) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), (c q r * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m - r) q) • Y r := by
    intro q hq
    rw [higherSerre, sum_mul, map_sum, Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk,
      ← sum_subset (range_mono (by omega : m - q + 1 ≤ m + 1))
        (f := fun r ↦ (c q r * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m - r) q) • Y r) ?_]
    · refine sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
      rw [mem_range] at hr
      dsimp only
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc (fDivPow D i r * fDivPow D j n), fDivPow_mul_fDivPow,
        mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, map_smul,
        show m - q - r + q = m - r by omega, show m - q - r = m - r - q by omega,
        qBinomial_symm _ (by omega : q ≤ m - r), hY, hc]
    · intro r hr' hr
      rw [mem_range, not_lt] at hr
      rw [mem_range] at hr'
      rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt _ (by omega : m - r < q), mul_zero, zero_smul]
  
  have h3 : ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), C r • Y r = 0 := by
    have : ∑ q ∈ range (m - a * n),
        w q • toQuotient D 𝕧 (higherSerre D i j n (m - q) 1 * fDivPow D i q) = 0 := by
      refine sum_eq_zero fun q hq ↦ ?_
      rw [mem_range] at hq
      have hq' : a * n < m - q := by omega
      rw [map_mul, toQuotient_higherSerre hij n (m - q) (Or.inl rfl)
        (by rw [ha, neg_neg]; exact_mod_cast hq'), zero_mul, smul_zero]
    calc ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), C r • Y r
        = ∑ q ∈ range (m - a * n),
            w q • ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), (c q r * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m - r) q) • Y r := by
          simp only [hC, smul_sum, smul_smul, sum_smul]
          rw [sum_comm]
          refine sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ sum_congr rfl fun q _ ↦ ?_
          rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun q hq ↦ by rw [h2 q (by rw [mem_range] at hq; omega)]
      _ = 0 := this
  
  have hCzero : ∀ r, a * n < r → r < m → C r = 0 := by
    intro r hr1 hr2
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, m - r = t + 1 := ⟨m - r - 1, by omega⟩
    have hmz : (m : ℤ) = r + t + 1 := by omega
    have h134 := sum_qBinomial_mul_inv_pow_eq_zero (v := (𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ D.d i)
      (pow_ne_zero _ hX) t
    rw [hC, ht, ← sum_subset (range_mono (by omega : t + 2 ≤ m - a * n))
      (f := fun q ↦ w q * c q r * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (t + 1) q) ?_]
    · rw [← mul_zero ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * 𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * (r * ((a : ℤ) * n - m + 1)))),
        ← h134, mul_sum]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun q hq ↦ ?_
      rw [mem_range] at hq
      have hqm : q ≤ m := by omega
      have hpow : (((𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ t) ^ q = 𝕧 ^ (-((D.d i : ℤ) * t * q)) := by
        rw [inv_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg]
        push_cast; ring_nf
      have hexp : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * (-((m : ℤ) * q) + q)) *
          𝕧 ^ ((1 : ℤ) * (r : ℤ) * (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * (((m - q : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1))) =
          𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * (r * ((a : ℤ) * n - m + 1))) * 𝕧 ^ (-((D.d i : ℤ) * t * q)) := by
        rw [← zpow_add₀ hX, ← zpow_add₀ hX, hdot, Nat.cast_sub hqm]
        congr 1
        linear_combination (-(D.d i : ℤ) * q) * hmz
      rw [hw, hc, hpow]
      linear_combination ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ q * (-1) ^ r * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (t + 1) q) * hexp
    · intro q _ hq
      rw [mem_range, not_lt] at hq
      rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt _ (by omega : t + 1 < q), mul_zero]
  
  have hCm : C m = c 0 m := by
    rw [hC, sum_eq_single 0 (fun q _ hq ↦ by
        rw [Nat.sub_self, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt _ (by omega : 0 < q), mul_zero])
      (fun h ↦ absurd (mem_range.2 (by omega : 0 < m - a * n)) h),
      Nat.sub_self, qBinomial_zero_right, mul_one, hw]
    simp
  have hCm0 : C m ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hCm, hc]; exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (zpow_ne_zero _ hX)
  have hγ : ∀ r ≤ m, C m * higherSerreCoeff D i a n m (m - r) = -C r := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, m = r + s := ⟨m - r, by omega⟩
    have hmz : (m : ℤ) = r + s := by omega
    have hss : ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ s) * (-1) ^ s = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]; norm_num
    rw [hCm, higherSerreCoeff, hC, mul_sum, ← sum_neg_distrib, show m - r = s by omega]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun q hq ↦ ?_
    rw [mem_range] at hq
    have hqm : q ≤ m := by omega
    have hexp : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ^ ((1 : ℤ) * ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) *
          (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * (((m - 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1))) *
        𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * (-(s : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) * n - m + 1 + q) + q)) =
        𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * (-((m : ℤ) * q) + q)) *
          𝕧 ^ ((1 : ℤ) * (r : ℤ) * (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * (((m - q : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1))) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hX, ← zpow_add₀ hX, hdot, Nat.cast_sub hqm, Nat.sub_zero]
      congr 1
      linear_combination ((D.d i : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) * n + q + 1 - m)) * hmz
    rw [hc, hc, hw, hs, pow_add, pow_add, pow_add, pow_one, ← hs]
    linear_combination
      (-(-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * (-1) ^ q * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) s q *
        𝕧 ^ ((1 : ℤ) * ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) * (-(D.dot i j) * n - D.d i * (((m - 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1))) *
        𝕧 ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * (-(s : ℤ) * ((a : ℤ) * n - m + 1 + q) + q))) * hss +
      (-(-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * (-1) ^ q * qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) s q) * hexp
  
  have hsplit : ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), C r • Y r =
      ∑ r ∈ range (a * n + 1), C r • Y r + C m • Y m := by
    rw [sum_range_succ, ← sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (by omega : a * n + 1 ≤ m),
      sum_eq_zero (s := Ico _ _) fun r hr ↦ by
        rw [mem_Ico] at hr; rw [hCzero r (by omega) hr.2, zero_smul], add_zero]
  have hYm : toQuotient D 𝕧 (fDivPow D i m * fDivPow D j n) = Y m := by
    rw [hY, Nat.sub_self, fDivPow_zero D, mul_one]
  rw [hYm]
  apply smul_right_injective _ hCm0
  dsimp only
  rw [smul_sum, sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ by
    rw [smul_smul, hγ r (by rw [mem_range] at hr; omega), neg_smul]]
  rw [sum_neg_distrib, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]
  simp only [← hY]
  rw [← hsplit, h3]

name: LusztigF.ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one
statement:
theorem ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one {K : Type*} [Field K] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (RatFunc.X : RatFunc K) ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [← RatFunc.algebraMap_X, ← map_pow, ← map_one (algebraMap (Polynomial K) (RatFunc K))] at h
  have := congr_arg Polynomial.natDegree (RatFunc.algebraMap_injective K h)
  simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow, Polynomial.natDegree_one] at this
  omega

name: LusztigF.serreIdeal_le_radical_ratFunc
statement:
theorem serreIdeal_le_radical_ratFunc {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (D : LusztigCartanDatum I) :
    serreIdeal D (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ≤ radical D RatFunc.X
proof:
:=
  serreIdeal_le_radical RatFunc.X_ne_zero fun _ hn ↦ ratFunc_X_pow_ne_one hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap

  change RatFunc.bar (algebraMap Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing 𝕂 x) =
    RatFunc.bar (algebraMap Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing 𝕂 y) at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
statement:
lemma exists_pow_mul (c : 𝕂) :

      algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 (uniformizer ^ m) * c =
        algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 a
proof:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_quotientCrystalLattice_iff
statement:
theorem mem_quotientCrystalLattice_iff {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    x ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D ↔
      ∃ a : InfinityLocalRing, quotientForm D x x = algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 a
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact mem_latInf_iff_formU_mem (hvt := transcendental_ratFunc_X)
    (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negativeQuotientEquiv_df
statement:
theorem negativeQuotientEquiv_df (i : I) (n : ℕ) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv D
        ((bos (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i).df n x) =
      quotientIntegralGenerator D i n * negativeQuotientEquiv D x
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ x : Um D 𝕧, negativeQuotientEquiv D (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i x) =
      toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i) * negativeQuotientEquiv D x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    change toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i * x) = _
    exact map_mul _ _ _
  have hp : ∀ n : ℕ, negativeQuotientEquiv D ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n) x) =
      toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i) ^ n * negativeQuotientEquiv D x := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, hf, ih, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
  rw [BosonModule.df_apply, map_smul]
  change (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ n)⁻¹ •
      negativeQuotientEquiv D ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n) x) = _
  rw [hp, qFactorial_inv]
  exact (smul_mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_divided_mul
statement:
theorem quotientForm_divided_mul (i : I) {x y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : (bos (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i).e
      ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm x) = 0)
    (hy : (bos (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i).e
      ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y) = 0) (r s : ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (quotientIntegralGenerator D i r * x) (quotientIntegralGenerator D i s * y) =
      if r = s then coefU D 𝕧 i r * quotientForm D x y else 0
proof:
:= by
  have he (n : ℕ) (z : Quotient D 𝕧) :
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n * z) =
        (bos (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i).df n
          ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm z) := by
    apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).injective
    rw [(negativeQuotientEquiv D).apply_symm_apply, negativeQuotientEquiv_df,
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
  change formU _ ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm _) ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm _) = _
  rw [he, he]
  exact formU_df_df _ i hx hy r s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_divided_norm_factor
statement:
theorem quotientForm_divided_norm_factor (i : I) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : InfinityLocalRing, coefU D 𝕧 i r =
      algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 (1 + InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer * a)
proof:
:=
  exists_coefU InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer i r

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_integralGenerator
statement:
theorem quotientForm_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    quotientForm D (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) =
      coefU D 𝕧 i n
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm 1 = Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 : LusztigF 𝕂 I) := by
    simpa using negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient D (1 : LusztigF 𝕂 I)
  have he : (bos (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i).e
      ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hone]
    change NegativePart.e D 𝕧 RatFunc.X_ne_zero
      (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i (NegativePart.mk 1) = 0
    simp [NegativePart.e_mk, LusztigF.bosonE]
  have hf : quotientForm D 1 1 = 1 := by
    simpa using quotientForm_toQuotient D (1 : LusztigF 𝕂 I) 1
  simpa [hf] using quotientForm_divided_mul D i he he n n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientForm_integralGenerator_residue
statement:
theorem quotientForm_integralGenerator_residue (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : InfinityLocalRing,
      quotientForm D (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) =
        algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 (1 + InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientForm_integralGenerator]
  exact quotientForm_divided_norm_factor D i n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientIntegralGenerator_mem_lattice
statement:
theorem quotientIntegralGenerator_mem_lattice (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    quotientIntegralGenerator D i n ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ n : ℕ, θ 𝕂 i ^ n ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (n • Finsupp.single i 1) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using (one_mem_weightSpace (k := 𝕂) (I := I))
    | succ n ih =>
      simpa [pow_succ, add_smul] using mul_mem_weightSpace ih (θ_mem_weightSpace i)
  have hg : quotientIntegralGenerator D i n =
      toQuotient D 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i)) := by
    simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]
  have hw : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) ∈
      Uw D 𝕧 (n • Finsupp.single i 1) := by
    rw [hg, negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient]
    exact ⟨_, Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hp n), rfl⟩
  apply (mem_quotientCrystalLattice_iff D hw).mpr
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := quotientForm_integralGenerator_residue D i n
  exact ⟨_, ha⟩

name: LusztigF.twist_mapCoeffs
statement:
theorem twist_mapCoeffs (i : I) (x : LusztigF K I) :
    twist D (φ v) i (mapCoeffs φ x) = mapCoeffs φ (twist D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 j => simp [mapCoeffs_smul, map_zpow₀]
  | mul a b ha hb => simp only [map_mul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.rDeriv_mapCoeffs
statement:
theorem rDeriv_mapCoeffs (i : I) (x : LusztigF K I) :
    rDeriv D (φ v) i (mapCoeffs φ x) = mapCoeffs φ (rDeriv D v i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 j => simp only [mapCoeffs_ι, rDeriv_θ]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_mul, rDeriv_mul, ha, hb, twist_mapCoeffs, map_add]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.thetaNorm_map
statement: theorem thetaNorm_map (i : I) : φ (thetaNorm D v i) = thetaNorm D (φ v) i
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaNorm, map_inv₀]

name: LusztigF.formEnd_mapCoeffs
statement:
theorem formEnd_mapCoeffs (x y : LusztigF K I) :
    formEnd D (φ v) (mapCoeffs φ x) (mapCoeffs φ y) = mapCoeffs φ (formEnd D v x y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing y with
  | grade0 c => simp [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, mapCoeffs_smul]
  | grade1 i =>
    simp [formEnd, mapCoeffs_smul, rDeriv_mapCoeffs, thetaNorm_map]
  | mul a b ha hb => simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, ha]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]

name: LusztigF.form_mapCoeffs
statement:
theorem form_mapCoeffs (x y : LusztigF K I) :
    form D (φ v) (mapCoeffs φ x) (mapCoeffs φ y) = φ (form D v x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_apply, form_apply, formEnd_mapCoeffs]
  exact algebraMapInv_mapCoeffs φ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.elt_mem
statement:
lemma IsGen.elt_mem {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (h : IsGen R x χ) {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hl : l₁ - l₂ = χ) (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l₁ - l₂)) : elt l₁ l₂ x hx ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
  have e : l₁ = l₂ + χ := by rw [← hl]; abel
  rw [elt_index e rfl rfl hx]
  exact h l₂

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.congr
statement:
lemma IsGen.congr {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ χ' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : IsGen R x χ) (e : χ = χ') :
    IsGen R x χ'
proof:
:=
  e ▸ h

statement:
lemma IsGen.of_eq {x y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (e : x = y) (h : IsGen R y χ) :
    IsGen R x χ
proof:
:=
  e ▸ h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.mul
statement:
lemma IsGen.mul {x y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ χ' : Y →+ ℤ} (hx : IsGen R x χ)
    (hy : IsGen R y χ') : IsGen R (x * y) (χ + χ')
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mul_mem_adWeightSpace hx.1 hy.1, fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  have hx' : x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l + (χ + χ') - (l + χ')) := by
    rw [show l + (χ + χ') - (l + χ') = χ by abel]; exact hx.1
  have hy' : y ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l + χ' - l) := by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hy.1
  rw [← elt_mul_elt _ _ _ hx' hy']
  exact mul_mem (hx.elt_mem (by abel) _) (hy.elt_mem (by abel) _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.add
statement:
lemma IsGen.add {x y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hx : IsGen R x χ) (hy : IsGen R y χ) :
    IsGen R (x + y) χ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨add_mem hx.1 hy.1, fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [elt_add _ _ (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hx.1)
    (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hy.1)]
  exact add_mem (hx.2 l) (hy.2 l)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_zero'
statement:
lemma elt_zero' (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) (h : (0 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l₁ - l₂)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ 0 h = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt]
  exact (congrArg _ (map_zero _)).trans (map_zero _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_zero
statement: lemma isGen_zero (χ : Y →+ ℤ) : IsGen R 0 χ
proof:
:=
  ⟨zero_mem _, fun l ↦ by rw [elt_zero']; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.smul
statement:
lemma IsGen.smul {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hx : IsGen R x χ) {c : 𝕂}
    (hc : IsLaurent c) : IsGen R (c • x) χ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx.1, fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [elt_smul _ _ _ (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hx.1)]
  exact smul_mem_aForm hc (hx.2 l)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.sum
statement:
lemma IsGen.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {x : ι → QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hx : ∀ r ∈ s, IsGen R (x r) χ) : IsGen R (∑ r ∈ s, x r) χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using isGen_zero χ
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [sum_insert ha]
    exact (hx a (mem_insert_self a s)).add (ih fun r hr ↦ hx r (mem_insert_of_mem hr))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.K_mul
statement:
lemma IsGen.K_mul {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hx : IsGen R x χ) (μ : Y) :
    IsGen R (K R 𝕧 μ * x) χ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (K_mem_adWeightSpace μ) hx.1, fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [elt_K_mul _ _ _ (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hx.1)]
  exact smul_mem_aForm (isLaurent_zpow _) (hx.2 l)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsGen.mul_K
statement:
lemma IsGen.mul_K {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hx : IsGen R x χ) (μ : Y) :
    IsGen R (x * K R 𝕧 μ) χ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hx.1 (K_mem_adWeightSpace μ), fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [elt_mul_K _ _ _ (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hx.1)]
  exact smul_mem_aForm (isLaurent_zpow _) (hx.2 l)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_one

proof:
:=
  ⟨one_mem_adWeightSpace, fun l ↦ by
    rw [elt_index (add_zero l) rfl rfl _ (by rw [sub_self]; exact one_mem_adWeightSpace)]
    exact one_mem_aForm l⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.root_comp_reflY_apply
statement:
lemma root_comp_reflY_apply (j : I) (μ : Y) :
    (R.root j).comp (reflY R i) μ = R.root j μ - R.root i μ * D.cartanMatrix i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [reflY_apply, R.root_coroot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.root_reflY_apply'
statement:
lemma root_reflY_apply' (j : I) (μ : Y) :
    R.root j (reflY R i μ) = R.root j μ - R.root i μ * D.cartanMatrix i j
proof:
:=
  root_comp_reflY_apply j μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_E_ne
statement:
lemma wt_E_ne {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ negA D i j * n) :
    (negA D i j * n - r) • R.root i + n • R.root j + r • R.root i =
      (n • R.root j).comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext μ
  have hc := cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA (D := D) (Ne.symm hji)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    nsmul_eq_mul, root_reflY_apply', hc]
  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hr]; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_E_ne'
statement:
lemma wt_E_ne' {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ negA D i j * n) :
    r • R.root i + n • R.root j + (negA D i j * n - r) • R.root i =
      (n • R.root j).comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wt_E_ne hji n r hr]; abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_F_ne'
statement:
lemma wt_F_ne' {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ negA D i j * n) :
    (negA D i j * n - r) • -R.root i + n • -R.root j + r • -R.root i =
      (n • -R.root j).comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext μ
  have hc := cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA (D := D) (Ne.symm hji)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, root_reflY_apply', hc]
  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hr]; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_F_ne
statement:
lemma wt_F_ne {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ negA D i j * n) :
    r • -R.root i + n • -R.root j + (negA D i j * n - r) • -R.root i =
      (n • -R.root j).comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wt_F_ne' hji n r hr]; abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_E_self
statement: lemma wt_E_self (n : ℕ) : n • -R.root i = (n • R.root i).comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [root_reflY_apply', D.cartanMatrix_self]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_F_self
statement: lemma wt_F_self (n : ℕ) : n • R.root i = (n • -R.root i).comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [root_reflY_apply', D.cartanMatrix_self]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_braidEjDiv
statement:
lemma isGen_braidEjDiv {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :
    IsGen R (braidEjDiv R 𝕧 i j n) ((n • R.root j).comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= by
  refine IsGen.sum _ fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr' : r ≤ negA D i j * n := by rw [mem_range] at hr; omega
  refine IsGen.smul (IsGen.congr (((isGen_E i _).mul (isGen_E j n)).mul (isGen_E i r))
    (wt_E_ne hji n r hr')) ?_
  exact isLaurent_neg_one.pow r |>.mul (isLaurent_inv_pow_pow _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_braidFjDiv
statement:
lemma isGen_braidFjDiv {j : I} (hji : j ≠ i) (n : ℕ) :
    IsGen R (braidFjDiv R 𝕧 i j n) ((n • -R.root j).comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= by
  refine IsGen.sum _ fun r hr ↦ ?_
  have hr' : r ≤ negA D i j * n := by rw [mem_range] at hr; omega
  refine IsGen.smul (IsGen.congr (((isGen_F i r).mul (isGen_F j n)).mul (isGen_F i _))
    (wt_F_ne hji n r hr')) ?_
  exact isLaurent_neg_one.pow r |>.mul (isLaurent_pow_pow _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_elt_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [braid_elt ratFunc_X_not_root i l₁ l₂ hu (by rw [hχ]; exact hT.1)]
  exact hT.elt_mem hχ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_symm_elt_mem
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.comp_sub_comp
statement:
lemma comp_sub_comp (l χ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    (l + χ).comp (reflY R i) - l.comp (reflY R i) = χ.comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  ext μ; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_gen_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hv := ratFunc_X_not_root
  rcases hx with ⟨l, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, n, l, rfl | rfl⟩
  · have h1 : ∀ l : Y →+ ℤ, l.comp (reflY R i) - l.comp (reflY R i) = 0 := fun l ↦ sub_self _
    refine ⟨braid_elt_mem i _ (IsGen.of_eq (_root_.map_one _) isGen_one) (h1 l),
      braid_symm_elt_mem i _ (IsGen.of_eq (_root_.map_one _) isGen_one) (h1 l)⟩
  · by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      refine ⟨braid_elt_mem j _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_self hv R j n)
          (((isGen_F j n).mul_K _).smul ((isLaurent_neg_one.pow n).mul
            (isLaurent_inv_pow_pow _ _)))) ?_,
        braid_symm_elt_mem j _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_E_self hv R j n)
          (((isGen_F j n).K_mul _).smul ((isLaurent_neg_one.pow n).mul
            (isLaurent_inv_pow_pow _ _)))) ?_⟩ <;>
      rw [comp_sub_comp, ← wt_E_self]
    · refine ⟨braid_elt_mem i _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne hv R hji n)
          (isGen_braidEjDiv i hji n)) (comp_sub_comp i _ _),
        braid_symm_elt_mem i _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_E_ne hv R hji n)
          (IsGen.sum _ fun r hr ↦ ?_)) (comp_sub_comp i _ _)⟩
      have hr' : r ≤ negA D i j * n := by rw [mem_range] at hr; omega
      refine IsGen.smul (IsGen.congr (((isGen_E i r).mul (isGen_E j n)).mul (isGen_E i _))
        (wt_E_ne' hji n r hr')) ?_
      exact isLaurent_neg_one.pow r |>.mul (isLaurent_inv_pow_pow _ _)
  · by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      refine ⟨braid_elt_mem j _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_self hv R j n)
          (((isGen_E j n).K_mul _).smul ((isLaurent_neg_one.pow n).mul
            (isLaurent_pow_pow _ _)))) ?_,
        braid_symm_elt_mem j _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_F_self hv R j n)
          (((isGen_E j n).mul_K _).smul ((isLaurent_neg_one.pow n).mul
            (isLaurent_pow_pow _ _)))) ?_⟩ <;>
      rw [comp_sub_comp, ← wt_F_self]
    · refine ⟨braid_elt_mem i _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_ne hv R hji n)
          (isGen_braidFjDiv i hji n)) (comp_sub_comp i _ _),
        braid_symm_elt_mem i _ (IsGen.of_eq (braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_F_ne hv R hji n)
          (IsGen.sum _ fun r hr ↦ ?_)) (comp_sub_comp i _ _)⟩
      have hr' : r ≤ negA D i j * n := by rw [mem_range] at hr; omega
      refine IsGen.smul (IsGen.congr (((isGen_F i _).mul (isGen_F j n)).mul (isGen_F i r))
        (wt_F_ne' hji n r hr')) ?_
      exact isLaurent_neg_one.pow r |>.mul (isLaurent_pow_pow _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_mem_aForm
statement:
theorem braid_mem_aForm {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aForm R) :
    braid ratFunc_X_not_root i x ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact (braid_gen_mem i hx).1
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [braid_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul, map_smul, ← laurent_smul]; exact SMulMemClass.smul_mem a hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_symm_mem_aForm
statement:
theorem braid_symm_mem_aForm {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aForm R) :
    (braid ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm x ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact (braid_gen_mem i hx).2
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    have : (braid ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm (x * y) =
        (braid ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm x * (braid ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm y := by
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, braid_mul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
        LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [this]; exact mul_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul, map_smul, ← laurent_smul]; exact SMulMemClass.smul_mem a hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.stab_smul
statement:
lemma stab_smul (f : Modified R 𝕧 ≃ₗ[𝕂] Modified R 𝕧) (a : 𝒜) (x : Modified R 𝕧) :
    f (a • x) = a • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurent_smul, map_smul, laurent_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.restrictHom_mul
statement:
lemma restrictHom_mul (f : stab R) (x y : aForm R) :
    restrictHom R f (x * y) = restrictHom R f x * restrictHom R f y
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (f.2.2.2 x y)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isBraidLiftable_braidStab
statement:
theorem isBraidLiftable_braidStab :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidStab (R := R))
proof:
:= fun i j hij hm ↦ by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := isBraidLiftable_braid (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root i j hij hm
  rw [← (stab R).coe_subtype, map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma braidA_apply (i : I) (x : aForm R) :
    (braidA i x : Modified R 𝕧) = braid ratFunc_X_not_root i x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma braidA_symm_apply (i : I) (x : aForm R) :
    ((braidA i).symm x : Modified R 𝕧) = (braid ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidA_mul
statement: lemma braidA_mul (i : I) (x y : aForm R) : braidA i (x * y) = braidA i x * braidA i y
proof:
:=
  restrictHom_mul _ x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isBraidLiftable_braidA
statement:
theorem isBraidLiftable_braidA :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidA (R := R))
proof:
:= fun i j hij hm ↦ by
  have h := congrArg (restrictHom R) (isBraidLiftable_braidStab (R := R) i j hij hm)
  rwa [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChangeHom_tmul
statement:
lemma baseChangeHom_tmul (e : aForm R ≃ₗ[𝒜] aForm R) (s : S) (x : aForm R) :
    baseChangeHom R S e (s ⊗ₜ x) = s ⊗ₜ e x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChangeHom_mul
statement:
lemma baseChangeHom_mul {e : aForm R ≃ₗ[𝒜] aForm R} (he : ∀ x y, e (x * y) = e x * e y)
    (x y : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R) :
    baseChangeHom R S e (x * y) = baseChangeHom R S e x * baseChangeHom R S e y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, add_mul]
  | tmul s a =>
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, mul_add]
    | tmul s' b =>
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, baseChangeHom_tmul, baseChangeHom_tmul,
        baseChangeHom_tmul, he, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidR_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma braidR_tmul (i : I) (s : S) (x : aForm R) :
    braidR S i (s ⊗ₜ x) = s ⊗ₜ braidA i x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidR_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma braidR_symm_tmul (i : I) (s : S) (x : aForm R) :
    (braidR S i).symm (s ⊗ₜ x) = s ⊗ₜ (braidA i).symm x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidR_mul
statement:
lemma braidR_mul (i : I) (x y : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R) :
    braidR S i (x * y) = braidR S i x * braidR S i y
proof:
:=
  baseChangeHom_mul S (braidA_mul i) x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isBraidLiftable_braidR
statement:
theorem isBraidLiftable_braidR :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidR (R := R) S)
proof:
:= fun i j hij hm ↦ by
  have h := congrArg (baseChangeHom R S) (isBraidLiftable_braidA (R := R) i j hij hm)
  rwa [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidArtinHomR_artinGenerator
statement:
@[simp] theorem braidArtinHomR_artinGenerator (i : I) :
    braidArtinHomR (R := R) S (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.artinGenerator i) = braidR S i
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f ↦ baseChangeHom R S (restrictHom R f))
    (CoxeterMatrix.artinLift_artinGenerator _ _ i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidArtinHomR_mul
statement:
theorem braidArtinHomR_mul (g : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup)
    (x y : S ⊗[𝒜] aForm R) :
    braidArtinHomR S g (x * y) = braidArtinHomR S g x * braidArtinHomR S g y
proof:
:=
  baseChangeHom_mul S (restrictHom_mul _) x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem barHom_mem_adWeightSpace {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ) : barHom R x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h := congrArg (barHom R) (hx (-μ))
  rwa [map_mul, barHom_smul, map_mul, barHom_K, neg_neg, bar_zpow_X, map_neg, neg_neg] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_mem_modRel
statement:
theorem barHom_mem_modRel {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ modRel R 𝕧 l₁ l₂) : barHom R x ∈ modRel R 𝕧 l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · refine Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨-μ, barHom R u, barHom_mem_adWeightSpace hu, ?_⟩)
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, barHom_K, barHom_algebraMap, bar_zpow_X, map_neg]
    · refine Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨-μ, barHom R u, barHom_mem_adWeightSpace hu, ?_⟩)
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, barHom_K, barHom_algebraMap, bar_zpow_X, map_neg]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [barHom_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_elt
statement:
theorem bar_elt (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l₁ - l₂)) :
    bar R (elt l₁ l₂ u hu) = elt l₁ l₂ (barHom R u) (barHom_mem_adWeightSpace hu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, bar, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_smul
statement: theorem bar_smul (c : 𝕂) (x : Modified R 𝕧) : bar R (c • x) = RatFunc.bar c • bar R x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]
  | helt l₁ l₂ u hu =>
    rw [← elt_smul, bar_elt, bar_elt, ← elt_smul]
    exact elt_congr (barHom_smul R c u) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_bar
statement: @[simp] theorem bar_bar (x : Modified R 𝕧) : bar R (bar R x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | helt l₁ l₂ u hu =>
    rw [bar_elt, bar_elt]
    exact elt_congr (barHom_barHom R u) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_mul
statement: theorem bar_mul (x y : Modified R 𝕧) : bar R (x * y) = bar R x * bar R y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => rw [zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, add_mul]
  | helt a b u hu =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => rw [mul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, mul_add]
  | helt c d w hw =>
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst hbc
    rw [elt_mul_elt, bar_elt, bar_elt, bar_elt, elt_mul_elt]
    exact elt_congr (_root_.map_mul _ _ _) _ _
  · rw [elt_mul_elt_of_ne hbc, map_zero, bar_elt, bar_elt, elt_mul_elt_of_ne hbc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_one
statement: @[simp] theorem bar_one (l : Y →+ ℤ) : bar R (one l) = one l
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, bar_elt]
  exact elt_congr (_root_.map_one (barHom R)) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_leftAct
statement:
theorem bar_leftAct (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 𝕧 ^ n ≠ 1) (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (x : Modified R 𝕧) : bar R (leftAct R 𝕧 hv u x) = leftAct R 𝕧 hv (barHom R u) (bar R x)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | hadd u u' hu hu' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hu']
  | hhom χ u hχ =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | helt l₁ l₂ t ht =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv hχ, bar_elt, bar_elt, leftAct_elt hv (barHom_mem_adWeightSpace hχ)]
    exact elt_congr (_root_.map_mul _ _ _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_leftActOne
statement:
theorem bar_leftActOne (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 𝕧 ^ n ≠ 1) (l : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    bar R (leftActOne R hv l u) = leftActOne R hv l (barHom R u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftActOne_apply, bar_leftAct, bar_one, leftActOne_apply]

name: LusztigF.wordBasis_eq_monomial
statement:
lemma wordBasis_eq_monomial {k : Type*} [Field k] (w : List I) :
    FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I w = monomial k w
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_apply]; rfl

name: LusztigF.weightScale_monomial
statement:
lemma weightScale_monomial (c : (I →₀ ℕ) → k) (w : List I) :
    weightScale c (monomial k w) = c (wordWeight w) • monomial k w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordBasis_eq_monomial, weightScale_wordBasis]

name: LusztigF.form_weightScale
statement:
lemma form_weightScale (c : (I →₀ ℕ) → k) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    form D v x (weightScale c y) = form D v (weightScale c x) y
proof:
:= by
  have h : (form D v).compl₁₂ LinearMap.id (weightScale c) =
      (form D v).compl₁₂ (weightScale c) LinearMap.id :=
    LinearMap.ext_basis (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) fun w w' ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
        LinearMap.id_apply, weightScale_wordBasis, weightScale_wordBasis, map_smul,
        LinearMap.map_smul₂, wordBasis_eq_monomial, wordBasis_eq_monomial]
      by_cases hw : wordWeight w = wordWeight w'
      · rw [hw]
      · rw [form_eq_zero_of_ne D v hw (monomial_mem_weightSpace w)
          (monomial_mem_weightSpace w'), smul_zero, smul_zero]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ktildeSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma ktildeSum_zero : ktildeSum R (0 : I →₀ ℕ) = 0
proof: := Finsupp.sum_zero_index

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ktildeSum_add
statement:
lemma ktildeSum_add (ν ν' : I →₀ ℕ) :
    ktildeSum R (ν + ν') = ktildeSum R ν + ktildeSum R ν'
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ ↦ zero_smul _ _) fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ktildeSum_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma ktildeSum_single (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    ktildeSum R (Finsupp.single i n) = n • ktilde R i
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_smul _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rootSum_ktilde_eq_root_ktildeSum
statement:
lemma rootSum_ktilde_eq_root_ktildeSum (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) :
    R.rootSum ν (ktilde R i) = R.root i (ktildeSum R ν)
proof:
:= by
  induction ν using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum]
  | add ν ν' h h' =>
    rw [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, h, h', ktildeSum_add,
      map_add]
  | single j n =>
    rw [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_single, ktildeSum_single, AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply,
      map_nsmul, root_ktilde_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.normSq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma normSq_zero : normSq R (0 : I →₀ ℕ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [normSq, LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.normSq_single_add
statement:
lemma normSq_single_add (i : I) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    normSq R (Finsupp.single i 1 + ν) =
      normSq R ν + 2 * R.root i (ktildeSum R ν) + 2 * D.d i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normSq, LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_add, ktildeSum_add,
    LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_single, ktildeSum_single, one_smul,
    AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add, rootSum_ktilde_eq_root_ktildeSum, root_ktilde_eq_dot,
    ← D.two_mul_d]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.normSq_wordWeight_emod_two
statement: lemma normSq_wordWeight_emod_two (w : List I) : normSq R (wordWeight w) % 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih => rw [wordWeight_cons, normSq_single_add]; omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordChar_eq_rootSum
statement: lemma wordChar_eq_rootSum (w : List I) : wordChar R w = R.rootSum (wordWeight w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum]
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [wordChar_cons, wordWeight_cons, LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_add,
      LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_single, one_smul, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_monomial_mul_K
statement:
lemma minusHom_monomial_mul_K (w : List I) (μ : Y) :
    minusHom R v (monomial k w) * K R v μ =
      v ^ R.rootSum (wordWeight w) μ • (K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_K_of_mem_adWeightSpace (minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w), AddMonoidHom.neg_apply,
    neg_neg, wordChar_eq_rootSum]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_minusHom_monomial
statement:
theorem rho_minusHom_monomial (w : List I) :
    rho R v (minusHom R v (monomial k w)) =
      v ^ (-(normSq R (wordWeight w) / 2)) •
        (plusHom R v (monomial k w.reverse) * K R v (-ktildeSum R (wordWeight w)))
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih =>
    have he := normSq_wordWeight_emod_two (R := R) w
    have h1 : K R v (-ktildeSum R (wordWeight w)) * (K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i) =
        v ^ R.root i (-(ktilde R i + ktildeSum R (wordWeight w))) •
          (E R v i * K R v (-(ktilde R i + ktildeSum R (wordWeight w)))) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, K_add, ← neg_add_rev, K_mul_E]
    rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, minusHom_θ, rho_mul, ih, rho_F, rhoF, List.reverse_cons,
      monomial_append, map_mul, monomial_cons, monomial_nil, mul_one, plusHom_θ, wordWeight_cons,
      ktildeSum_add, ktildeSum_single, one_smul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, h1,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    have hd : (2 : ℤ) * D.d i = D.dot i i := D.two_mul_d i
    rw [normSq_single_add, map_neg, map_add, root_ktilde_eq_dot, ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_add₀ hv, ← zpow_add₀ hv]
    congr 1
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma rho_mem_adWeightSpace {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) : rho R v x ∈ adWeightSpace R v (-χ)
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h := congrArg (rho R v) (hx μ)
  rw [rho_mul, map_smul, rho_mul, rho_K] at h
  rw [AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, h, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero,
    one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_plusHom
statement: lemma chevalley_plusHom (x : LusztigF k I) : chevalley R v (plusHom R v x) = minusHom R v x
proof:
:= by
  have : (chevalley R v).comp (plusHom R v) = minusHom R v :=
    FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun i ↦ by simp [plusHom, minusHom])
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun this x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_minusHom
statement: lemma chevalley_minusHom (x : LusztigF k I) : chevalley R v (minusHom R v x) = plusHom R v x
proof:
:= by
  have : (chevalley R v).comp (minusHom R v) = plusHom R v :=
    FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext fun i ↦ by simp [plusHom, minusHom])
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun this x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.induction_plusHom_K_minusHom
statement:
theorem induction_plusHom_K_minusHom (hv : v ≠ 0) {P : QuantumGroup R v → Prop}
    (u : QuantumGroup R v) (h0 : P 0) (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hsmul : ∀ (c : k) x, P x → P (c • x))
    (hmon : ∀ w μ w', P (plusHom R v (monomial k w) * K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w'))) :
    P u
proof:
:= by
  have hu : chevalley R v u ∈ triangularSpan R v := by
    rw [span_triangular hv]; trivial
  suffices key : ∀ x ∈ triangularSpan R v, P (chevalley R v x) by
    simpa only [chevalley_chevalley] using key _ hu
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hx
    simpa only [map_mul, chevalley_minusHom, chevalley_K, chevalley_plusHom] using hmon w (-μ) w'
  | zero => simpa using h0
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using hadd _ _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using hsmul c _ hx

lemma formPair_eq_zero_left (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D v)
    (y : LusztigF k I) : formPair R v ζ μ x y = 0

statement:
lemma formPair_eq_zero_right (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) (x : LusztigF k I) {y : LusztigF k I}
    (hy : y ∈ serreIdeal D v) : formPair R v ζ μ x y = 0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreTriSubmodule_le_ker_formTriLin
statement:
lemma serreTriSubmodule_le_ker_formTriLin (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    serreTriSubmodule Y D v ≤ LinearMap.ker (formTriLin R v ζ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [serreTriSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨y, g, x, rfl, hy | hx⟩
  · have h : (formTri R v ζ).flip y = 0 :=
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.basis Y k).ext fun μ ↦ LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ by
        rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.basis_apply, formTri_single,
          formPair_eq_zero_left hv _ _ hy, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, formTriLin_tmul,
      ← LinearMap.flip_apply (formTri R v ζ) g y, h]
    rfl
  · have h : ((formTri R v ζ).flip y).flip x = 0 :=
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.basis Y k).ext fun μ ↦ by
        rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.basis_apply,
          formTri_single, formPair_eq_zero_right hv _ _ _ hx, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    have h' := LinearMap.congr_fun h g
    simp only [LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h'
    simp [formTriLin_tmul, h']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom
statement:
theorem formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (x : LusztigF k I) (μ : Y)
    (y : LusztigF k I) :
    formFunctional R v hv ζ (plusHom R v x * K R v μ * minusHom R v y) =
      form D v (rev k I x) (weightScale (formScale R v ζ μ) y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : chevalley R v (plusHom R v x * K R v μ * minusHom R v y) =
      triangularEquiv R v hv (Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (x ⊗ₜ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-μ) 1 ⊗ₜ y))) := by
    rw [triangularEquiv_mk, zeroHom_single, map_mul, map_mul, chevalley_plusHom, chevalley_K,
      chevalley_minusHom]
  rw [formFunctional, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, h,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Submodule.liftQ_apply, formTriLin_tmul,
    formTri_single, neg_neg, formPair_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial
statement:
theorem formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (x : LusztigF k I) (μ : Y)
    (w : List I) :
    formFunctional R v hv ζ (plusHom R v x * K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w)) =
      formScale R v ζ μ (wordWeight w) * form D v (rev k I x) (monomial k w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom, weightScale_monomial, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_mul_K
statement:
theorem formFunctional_mul_K (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) (μ : Y) :
    formFunctional R v hv ζ (u * K R v μ) = v ^ ζ μ * formFunctional R v hv ζ u
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := NeZero.ne v
  induction u using induction_plusHom_K_minusHom hv0 with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, mul_add]
  | hsmul c x hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, map_smul, hx, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_left_comm]
  | hmon w ν w' =>
    rw [mul_assoc, minusHom_monomial_mul_K, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ (K R v ν),
      K_add, map_smul, formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial,
      formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    simp only [formScale, map_add, ← zpow_add₀ hv0]
    congr 1
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_K_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [hz μ, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_smul, formFunctional_mul_K]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_rho_minusHom_monomial
statement:
lemma formFunctional_rho_minusHom_monomial (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List I) :
    formFunctional R v hv ζ
        (rho R v (minusHom R v (monomial k w)) * minusHom R v (monomial k w')) =
      form D v (monomial k w) (monomial k w')
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := NeZero.ne v
  rw [rho_minusHom_monomial, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul,
    formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial, rev_monomial, List.reverse_reverse, smul_eq_mul,
    ← mul_assoc]
  by_cases hw : wordWeight w = wordWeight w'
  · have he := normSq_wordWeight_emod_two (R := R) w
    rw [← hw, formScale, ← zpow_add₀ hv0, map_neg, map_neg]
    have h0 : -(normSq R (wordWeight w) / 2) + (-(normSq R (wordWeight w) / 2) -
        -R.rootSum (wordWeight w) (ktildeSum R (wordWeight w)) + -ζ (ktildeSum R (wordWeight w)) +
        ζ (ktildeSum R (wordWeight w))) = 0 := by
      change _ + (_ - -normSq R (wordWeight w) + _ + _) = _
      omega
    rw [h0, zpow_zero, one_mul]
  · rw [form_eq_zero_of_ne D v hw (monomial_mem_weightSpace w) (monomial_mem_weightSpace w'),
      mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_rho_minusHom
statement:
theorem formFunctional_rho_minusHom (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (x y : LusztigF k I) (μ : Y) :
    formFunctional R v hv ζ (rho R v (minusHom R v x) * minusHom R v y * K R v μ) =
      v ^ ζ μ * form D v x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [formFunctional_mul_K]
  congr 1
  have h : ((LinearMap.mul k (QuantumGroup R v)).compr₂ (formFunctional R v hv ζ)).compl₁₂
      (rho R v ∘ₗ (minusHom R v).toLinearMap) (minusHom R v).toLinearMap = form D v :=
    LinearMap.ext_basis (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) fun w w' ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply',
        LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, wordBasis_eq_monomial]
      exact formFunctional_rho_minusHom_monomial hv ζ w w'
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.induction_rho_minusHom
statement:
theorem induction_rho_minusHom [NeZero v] {P : QuantumGroup R v → Prop}
    (u : QuantumGroup R v) (h0 : P 0) (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hsmul : ∀ (c : k) x, P x → P (c • x))
    (hmon : ∀ w w' μ, P (rho R v (minusHom R v (monomial k w)) *
      minusHom R v (monomial k w') * K R v μ)) : P u
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := NeZero.ne v
  induction u using induction_plusHom_K_minusHom hv0 with
  | h0 => exact h0
  | hadd x y hx hy => exact hadd x y hx hy
  | hsmul c x hx => exact hsmul c x hx
  | hmon w μ w' =>
    have hkey := rho_minusHom_monomial (R := R) (v := v) w.reverse
    rw [List.reverse_reverse] at hkey
    set e := -(normSq R (wordWeight w.reverse) / 2)
    set κ := ktildeSum R (wordWeight w.reverse)
    have hE : plusHom R v (monomial k w) =
        (v ^ e)⁻¹ • (rho R v (minusHom R v (monomial k w.reverse)) * K R v κ) := by
      rw [hkey, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero, mul_one, smul_smul,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ hv0), one_smul]
    rw [hE, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ (K R v κ), K_add, mul_assoc,
      K_mul_minusHom_monomial, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
    exact hsmul _ _ (hsmul _ _ (hmon _ _ _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_chevalleyIntegral_plus
statement:
lemma map_chevalleyIntegral_plus :
    (Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i))).map
        ((chevalleyEquiv R 𝕧).restrictScalars 𝒜 : _ →ₐ[𝒜] _) =
      Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range fun n ↦ qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i))

  congr 1
  simp only [Set.image_iUnion, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 1
  funext i
  congr 1
  funext n
  exact chevalley_qDivPow_E (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.plus_le_span_pbwDiv_all
statement:
lemma plus_le_span_pbwDiv_all :
    (Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))).toSubmodule ≤
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
  have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ S :=
    span_laurent_le_span (CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwDivSpan (Ta R) (Ed R) Ed_zero w)
  intro x hx
  have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      intro y hy
      induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hy =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hy
        have := qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_all (R := R) cs hw
          (hw₀ ▸ cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i) 1
          (Submodule.subset_span ⟨c, rfl⟩)
        rw [A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] at this
        exact span_laurent_le_span this
      | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
      | smul a y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
    | algebraMap a =>
      intro y hy
      rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
      exact S.smul_mem a hy
    | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
      intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
    | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
      intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
  simpa using hmul 1 h1

statement:
lemma aTriangularBasisPBWAll_apply (t : (Fin w.length → ℕ) × (Y →+ ℤ) × (Fin w.length → ℕ)) :
    (aTriangularBasisPBWAll (R := R) cs hw hw₀ t : Modified R 𝕧) =
      elt (t.2.1 - pbwWt R w t.1) (t.2.1 - pbwWt R w t.2.2)
        (chevalley R 𝕧 (pbwDiv R w t.1) * pbwDiv R w t.2.2) (by
          have := mul_mem_adWeightSpace
            (map_mem_adWeightSpace (omegaAut R) (pbwDiv_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) w t.1))
            (pbwDiv_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) w t.2.2)
          rw [wt_omegaAut] at this
          convert this using 2 <;> first | rfl | abel)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aTriangularBasisPBWAll, aTriangularBasis_apply, triFun]
  exact elt_congr (by rw [pbwMinusBasisAll_apply, pbwPlusBasisAll_apply]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.actPair_tensorMap
statement:
lemma actPair_tensorMap (f : M₁ →ₗ[QuantumGroup R 𝕧] N₁) (g : M₂ →ₗ[QuantumGroup R 𝕧] N₂)
    (t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (z : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) :
    TensorModule.actPair R 𝕧 N₁ N₂ t (tensorMap f g z) =
      tensorMap f g (TensorModule.actPair R 𝕧 M₁ M₂ t z)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
      map_add]
  | tmul a b =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz', map_add, map_add]
    | tmul x y =>
      rw [map_tmul, TensorModule.act_tmul, TensorModule.act_tmul, map_tmul]
      simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsPlusLocallyNilpotent.of_surjective
statement:
theorem IsPlusLocallyNilpotent.of_surjective (h : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R M₂)
    (g : M₂ →ₗ[QuantumGroup R 𝕧] N₂) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R N₂
proof:
:= by
  intro n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidInvariantSymm
statement: theorem braidInvariantSymm : BraidInvariantSymm R
proof:
:= by
  apply braidInvariantSymm_of_span_pbwDivSymm_g2
  intro i j hij h3
  have hA := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
  have h1 := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have h2 := hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  have hcases : (D.cartanMatrix i j = -3 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
      (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -3) := by
    generalize D.cartanMatrix i j = a at *
    generalize D.cartanMatrix j i = b at *
    have ha0 : a < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (by intro h; simp [h] at h3)
    have hb0 : b < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne h2 (by intro h; simp [h] at h3)
    have ha : -3 ≤ a := by nlinarith
    have hb : -3 ≤ b := by nlinarith
    interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> simp_all
  rcases hcases with ⟨h, h'⟩ | ⟨h, h'⟩
  · exact span_pbwDivSymm_g2_braid hij h h'
  · exact (span_pbwDivSymm_g2_braid hij.symm h' h).symm
