name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.orderedSpan_smul_le
statement:
private lemma orderedSpan_smul_le {Λ : Subring k} {e A b C D f : B} {u v w t : k}
    (hu : u ∈ Λ) (hv : v ∈ Λ) (hw : w ∈ Λ) (ht : t ∈ Λ) :
    G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ e (u • A) (v • b) (w • C) (t • D) f ≤
      G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_
  rintro z ⟨c, hc, a, b', c', d, l, m, rfl⟩
  simp only [G2Integral.M6, G2Integral.M5, G2Integral.P3, qDivPow_smul_pow,
    smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  exact G2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan
    (mul_mem hc (mul_mem (pow_mem ht _) (mul_mem (pow_mem hw _)
      (mul_mem (pow_mem hv _) (pow_mem hu _)))))
    (G2Integral.M6_mem_orderedSpan (q := q) (Λ := Λ) (e := e) (A := A) (b := b)
      (C := C) (D := D) (f := f) a b' c' d l m)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.orderedSpan_smul
statement:
private lemma orderedSpan_smul {Λ : Subring k} {e A b C D f : B} {u v w t : k}
    (hu0 : u ≠ 0) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) (ht0 : t ≠ 0)
    (hu : u ∈ Λ) (hv : v ∈ Λ) (hw : w ∈ Λ) (ht : t ∈ Λ)
    (hui : u⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (hvi : v⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (hwi : w⁻¹ ∈ Λ) (hti : t⁻¹ ∈ Λ) :
    G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ e (u • A) (v • b) (w • C) (t • D) f =
      G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ e A b C D f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (orderedSpan_smul_le hu hv hw ht) ?_
  have hh := orderedSpan_smul_le (q := q) (e := e) (A := u • A) (b := v • b)
    (C := w • C) (D := t • D) (f := f) hui hvi hwi hti
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu0, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv0,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ hw0, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0, one_smul] using hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.orderedSpan_op_normalized
statement:
private lemma orderedSpan_op_normalized {Λ : Subring k}
    (hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0)
    (hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0)
    (hS4 : qSerre q 4 e f = 0) (hS2 : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 f e = 0)
    (hn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1)
    (hqΛ : q ∈ Λ) (hiΛ : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ) :
    G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ e
      (unop (G2Integral.X3 q (op e) (op f)))
      (unop (G2Integral.X2 q (op e) (op f)))
      (unop (G2Integral.Z q (op e) (op f)))
      (unop (G2PBW.x1 q (op e) (op f))) f =
      (G2Integral.genRing q Λ e f).toAddSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ∀ (c d : k) (x : B), c • d • x = d • c • x :=
    fun c d x => smul_comm c d x
  simp only [G2Integral.X3, G2Integral.X2, G2Integral.Z, unop_smul,
    unop_x1_inv hq, unop_x2_inv hq, unop_x3_inv hq, unop_z_inv hq]
  simp only [hnorm (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹, hnorm (qInt q 2)⁻¹]
  rw [← A2Integral.qFactorial_inv' (q := q) 3, ← A2Integral.qInt_inv' (q := q) 2]
  rw [orderedSpan_smul (neg_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hq)))
    (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hq)) (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hq))
    (neg_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hq)))
    (neg_mem (pow_mem hiΛ _)) (pow_mem hiΛ _) (pow_mem hiΛ _)
    (neg_mem (pow_mem hiΛ _))
    (by simpa only [inv_neg, inv_pow, inv_inv] using neg_mem (pow_mem hqΛ 3))
    (by simpa only [inv_pow, inv_inv] using pow_mem hqΛ 4)
    (by simpa only [inv_pow, inv_inv] using pow_mem hqΛ 6)
    (by simpa only [inv_neg, inv_pow, inv_inv] using neg_mem (pow_mem hqΛ 3))]
  have H := G2Integral.rel_of_not_root (inv_ne_zero hq)
    (fun n hn' => by simpa only [inv_pow, inv_ne_one] using hn n hn')
    (by simpa only [qSerre_inv] using hS4)
    (by simpa only [inv_pow, qSerre_inv] using hS2)
  have hh := G2Integral.orderedSpan_eq_genRing (inv_ne_zero hq)
    (by simpa only [A2Integral.qInt_inv'] using hqi)
    (by simpa only [inv_pow, A2Integral.qInt_inv'] using hpi) H hiΛ
    (by simpa only [inv_inv] using hqΛ)
  simpa only [G2Integral.orderedSpan, G2Integral.genRing, G2Integral.M6,
    G2Integral.M5, G2Integral.P3, inv_pow, A2Integral.qDivPow_inv',
    G2Integral.X3, G2Integral.X2, G2Integral.Z] using hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_g2
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_g2 :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 3 := parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have hf : qFactorial q 3 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 3
  have hS4 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
  rw [h, show (1 - (-3 : ℤ)).toNat = 4 by rfl] at hS4
  have hS2 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
  rw [h', show (1 - (-1 : ℤ)).toNat = 2 by rfl, hd] at hS2
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have hv := altVec_g2_normalized R 𝕧 T Hi Hj hij h h' hq hf
  have ht1 : T i (E R 𝕧 j) = G2Integral.X3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) := congrFun hv (1 : Fin 6)
  have ht2 : T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = G2Integral.X2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) := congrFun hv (2 : Fin 6)
  have ht3 : T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))) = G2Integral.Z q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (3 : Fin 6)
  have ht4 : T i (T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)))) = G2PBW.x1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (4 : Fin 6)
  have ht5 : T i (T j (T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))))) = E R 𝕧 j := congrFun hv (5 : Fin 6)
  let V := ![braidReversal (E R 𝕧 i),
    braidReversal (G2Integral.X3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    braidReversal (G2Integral.X2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    braidReversal (G2Integral.Z q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    braidReversal (G2PBW.x1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    braidReversal (E R 𝕧 j)]
  have hV : V = ![E R 𝕧 i,
      unop (G2Integral.X3 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j))),
      unop (G2Integral.X2 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j))),
      unop (G2Integral.Z q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j))),
      unop (G2PBW.x1 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j))), E R 𝕧 j] := by
    simp only [V, G2Integral.X3, G2Integral.X2, G2Integral.Z,
      G2PBW.x3, G2PBW.x2, G2PBW.x1, G2PBW.z, unop_sub, unop_smul,
      unop_mul, unop_op, map_sub, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E]
  have hsymm : ∀ k z, (T k).symm z = braidReversal (T k (braidReversal z)) :=
    fun k z ↦ braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply' k z
  have hTa : ∀ k z, (Ta R k).symm z = (T k).symm z := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 6 → ℕ, pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j, i, j] c =
      G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5)
        (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3) (c 4) (c 5) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, hTa, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one,
      mul_one]
    simp only [Ed, hmap]
    simp only [hsymm, braidReversal_E, braidReversal_involutive _]
    rw [ht5, ht4, ht3, ht2, ht1, braidReversal_E, hd]
    simp only [V, G2Integral.M6, G2Integral.M5, G2Integral.P3,
      mul_assoc, braidReversal_E]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) ↔
      x ∈ G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) := fun x ↦ by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact G2Integral.M6_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _ _ _
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U]
        exact G2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, l, m, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [← laurent_smul_U, show
          G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) a b c' d l m =
          pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j, i, j] ![a, b, c', d, l, m] by rw [hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  have hS : G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) =
      (G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)).toAddSubgroup := by
    rw [hV]
    exact orderedSpan_op_normalized hq0 _ _ hqi hpi hS4 hS2
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hqΛ hqΛ'
  ext x
  rw [hconv, hS]
  change x ∈ G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) ↔ x ∈ adjoinPair i j
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_g2_genRing hd]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_g2_rev
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_g2_rev :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i, j, i])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 3 := parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have hf : qFactorial q 3 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 3
  have hS4 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
  rw [h, show (1 - (-3 : ℤ)).toNat = 4 by rfl] at hS4
  have hS2 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
  rw [h', show (1 - (-1 : ℤ)).toNat = 2 by rfl, hd] at hS2
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have hv := altVec_g2_rev R 𝕧 T Hi Hj hij h h' hq hf
  rw [G2Integral.g2c3_eq hq0 hq hf, G2Integral.g2c2_eq hq0 hq hf] at hv
  have h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0 := hqi 2 (by decide)
  simp only [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, mul_one] at hv
  have ht1 : T j (E R 𝕧 i) = G2PBW.y1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) := congrFun hv (1 : Fin 6)
  have ht2 : T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j)) = (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (2 : Fin 6)
  have ht3 : T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))) = (qInt q 2)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (3 : Fin 6)
  have ht4 : T j (T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j)))) = (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.w q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (4 : Fin 6)
  have ht5 : T j (T i (T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))))) = E R 𝕧 i := congrFun hv (5 : Fin 6)
  let V := ![op (braidReversal (E R 𝕧 i)),
    op (braidReversal ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.w q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j))),
    op (braidReversal ((qInt q 2)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j))),
    op (braidReversal ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j))),
    op (braidReversal (G2PBW.y1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j))),
    op (braidReversal (E R 𝕧 j))]
  have hV : V = ![op (E R 𝕧 i),
      unop (G2Integral.X3 q (op (op (E R 𝕧 i))) (op (op (E R 𝕧 j)))),
      unop (G2Integral.X2 q (op (op (E R 𝕧 i))) (op (op (E R 𝕧 j)))),
      unop (G2Integral.Z q (op (op (E R 𝕧 i))) (op (op (E R 𝕧 j)))),
      unop (G2PBW.x1 q (op (op (E R 𝕧 i))) (op (op (E R 𝕧 j)))), op (E R 𝕧 j)] := by
    simp only [V, G2Integral.X3, G2Integral.X2, G2Integral.Z,
      G2PBW.x3, G2PBW.x2, G2PBW.x1, G2PBW.z, G2PBW.w, G2PBW.y3,
      G2PBW.y2, G2PBW.y1, op_sub, op_smul, op_mul, unop_sub, unop_smul,
      unop_mul, unop_op, map_sub, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E]
  have hsymm : ∀ k z, (T k).symm z = braidReversal (T k (braidReversal z)) :=
    fun k z ↦ braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply' k z
  have hTa : ∀ k z, (Ta R k).symm z = (T k).symm z := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 6 → ℕ, op (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i, j, i] c) =
      G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5)
        (c 5) (c 4) (c 3) (c 2) (c 1) (c 0) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, hTa, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one,
      mul_one]
    simp only [Ed, hmap]
    simp only [hsymm, braidReversal_E, braidReversal_involutive _]
    rw [ht5, ht4, ht3, ht2, ht1, braidReversal_E, hd]
    simp only [V, G2Integral.M6, G2Integral.M5, G2Integral.P3,
      op_mul, mul_assoc, braidReversal_E]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i, j, i])) ↔
      op x ∈ G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact G2Integral.M6_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _ _ _
      | zero => rw [op_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [op_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U, op_smul]
        exact G2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      rw [← unop_op x]
      generalize op x = z at hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, l, m, rfl⟩ := hz
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [unop_smul, ← laurent_smul_U, show
          unop (G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) a b c' d l m) =
          pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i, j, i] ![m, l, d, c', b, a] by
            rw [← unop_op (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i, j, i] _), hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => rw [unop_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [unop_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => rw [unop_neg]; exact neg_mem hx
  have hS : G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) =
      (G2Integral.genRing q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j))).toAddSubgroup := by
    rw [hV]
    exact orderedSpan_op_normalized hq0 (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) hqi hpi
      (by rw [qSerre_op, hS4, op_zero, smul_zero])
      (by rw [qSerre_op, hS2, op_zero, smul_zero])
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hqΛ hqΛ'
  have hgen : G2Integral.genRing q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) =
      (G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)).op := by
    rw [G2Integral.genRing, G2Integral.genRing, Subring.op_closure]
    congr 1
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩) | ⟨n, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, hz⟩ | ⟨n, hz⟩) | ⟨n, hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, unop_injective hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩
  ext x
  rw [hconv, hS, hgen]
  change x ∈ G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) ↔ x ∈ adjoinPair i j
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_g2_genRing hd]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_g2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_g2_braid :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i, j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwDivSymm_g2 hij h h', span_pbwDivSymm_g2_rev hij h h']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_adjoinPair_eq_g2_genRing
statement:
lemma coe_adjoinPair_eq_g2_genRing {i j : I} (hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ 3) :
    (adjoinPair (R := R) i j : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) =
      G2Integral.genRing (𝕧 ^ D.d i) LusztigF.integralLaurentEval.range (E R 𝕧 i)
        (E R 𝕧 j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Subalgebra.coe_toSubring, Algebra.adjoin_eq_ring_closure, G2Integral.genRing]
  have h1 : Set.range (algebraMap 𝒜 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) =
      algebraMap 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) '' (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval.range : Set 𝕂) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have h2 : Set.range (Ed R j) = Set.range fun n : ℕ ↦ qDivPow ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ 3) n (E R 𝕧 j) := by
    rw [← hd]; rfl
  rw [h1, h2, ← Set.union_assoc]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_g2
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_g2 :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 3 := parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have hf : qFactorial q 3 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 3
  have hS4 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
  rw [h, show (1 - (-3 : ℤ)).toNat = 4 by rfl] at hS4
  have hS2 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
  rw [h', show (1 - (-1 : ℤ)).toNat = 2 by rfl, hd] at hS2
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have H := G2Integral.rel_of_not_root hq0
    (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hS4 hS2
  have hv := altVec_g2_normalized R 𝕧 T Hi Hj hij h h' hq hf
  have ht1 : T i (E R 𝕧 j) = G2Integral.X3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) := congrFun hv (1 : Fin 6)
  have ht2 : T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = G2Integral.X2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) := congrFun hv (2 : Fin 6)
  have ht3 : T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))) = G2Integral.Z q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (3 : Fin 6)
  have ht4 : T i (T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)))) = G2PBW.x1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (4 : Fin 6)
  have ht5 : T i (T j (T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))))) = E R 𝕧 j := congrFun hv (5 : Fin 6)
  let V := ![E R 𝕧 i,
    G2Integral.X3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j),
    G2Integral.X2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j),
    G2Integral.Z q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j),
    G2PBW.x1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j),
    E R 𝕧 j]
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 6 → ℕ, pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j, i, j] c =
      G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5)
        (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3) (c 4) (c 5) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one,
      mul_one, Ed, hmap]
    change qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (c 0) (E R 𝕧 i) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (c 1) (T i (E R 𝕧 j)) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (c 2) (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (c 3) (T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j)))) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (c 4) (T i (T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))))) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (c 5) (T i (T j (T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))))))))))) = _
    rw [ht5, ht4, ht3, ht2, ht1, hd]
    simp only [V, G2Integral.M6, G2Integral.M5, G2Integral.P3,
      mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) ↔
      x ∈ G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) := fun x ↦ by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact G2Integral.M6_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _ _ _
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U]
        exact G2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, l, m, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [← laurent_smul_U, show
          G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) a b c' d l m =
          pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j, i, j] ![a, b, c', d, l, m] by rw [hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  have hS : G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) =
      (G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)).toAddSubgroup := by
    exact G2Integral.orderedSpan_eq_genRing hq0 hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ'
  ext x
  rw [hconv, hS]
  change x ∈ G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) ↔ x ∈ adjoinPair i j
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_g2_genRing hd]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_g2_rev
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_g2_rev :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i, j, i])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 3 := parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 3) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have hf : qFactorial q 3 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 3
  have hS4 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
  rw [h, show (1 - (-3 : ℤ)).toNat = 4 by rfl] at hS4
  have hS2 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
  rw [h', show (1 - (-1 : ℤ)).toNat = 2 by rfl, hd] at hS2
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have H := G2Integral.rel_of_not_root hq0
    (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
    (e := op (E R 𝕧 i)) (f := op (E R 𝕧 j))
    (by rw [qSerre_op, hS4, op_zero, smul_zero])
    (by rw [qSerre_op, hS2, op_zero, smul_zero])
  have hv := altVec_g2_rev R 𝕧 T Hi Hj hij h h' hq hf
  rw [G2Integral.g2c3_eq hq0 hq hf, G2Integral.g2c2_eq hq0 hq hf] at hv
  have h2 : qInt q 2 ≠ 0 := hqi 2 (by decide)
  simp only [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, mul_one] at hv
  have ht1 : T j (E R 𝕧 i) = G2PBW.y1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) := congrFun hv (1 : Fin 6)
  have ht2 : T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j)) = (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (2 : Fin 6)
  have ht3 : T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))) = (qInt q 2)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (3 : Fin 6)
  have ht4 : T j (T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j)))) = (qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.w q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) :=
    congrFun hv (4 : Fin 6)
  have ht5 : T j (T i (T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))))) = E R 𝕧 i := congrFun hv (5 : Fin 6)
  let V := ![op (E R 𝕧 i),
    op ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.w q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    op ((qInt q 2)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y2 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    op ((qFactorial q 3)⁻¹ • G2PBW.y3 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    op (G2PBW.y1 q (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)),
    op (E R 𝕧 j)]
  have hV : V = ![op (E R 𝕧 i),
      G2Integral.X3 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)),
      G2Integral.X2 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)),
      G2Integral.Z q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)),
      G2PBW.x1 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)), op (E R 𝕧 j)] := by
    simp only [V, G2Integral.X3, G2Integral.X2, G2Integral.Z,
      G2PBW.x3, G2PBW.x2, G2PBW.x1, G2PBW.z, G2PBW.w, G2PBW.y3,
      G2PBW.y2, G2PBW.y1, op_sub, op_smul, op_mul]
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 6 → ℕ, op (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i, j, i] c) =
      G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5)
        (c 5) (c 4) (c 3) (c 2) (c 1) (c 0) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one,
      mul_one, Ed, hmap]
    change op (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (c 0) (E R 𝕧 j) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (c 1) (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (c 2) (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (c 3) (T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)))) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) (c 4) (T j (T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))))) *
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (c 5) (T j (T i (T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)))))))))))) = _
    rw [ht5, ht4, ht3, ht2, ht1, hd]
    simp only [V, G2Integral.M6, G2Integral.M5, G2Integral.P3,
      op_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i, j, i])) ↔
      op x ∈ G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact G2Integral.M6_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _ _ _
      | zero => rw [op_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [op_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U, op_smul]
        exact G2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      rw [← unop_op x]
      generalize op x = z at hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, l, m, rfl⟩ := hz
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [unop_smul, ← laurent_smul_U, show
          unop (G2Integral.M6 q (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) a b c' d l m) =
          pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i, j, i] ![m, l, d, c', b, a] by
            rw [← unop_op (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i, j, i] _), hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => rw [unop_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [unop_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => rw [unop_neg]; exact neg_mem hx
  have hS : G2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (V 0) (V 1) (V 2) (V 3) (V 4) (V 5) =
      (G2Integral.genRing q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j))).toAddSubgroup := by
    rw [hV]
    exact G2Integral.orderedSpan_eq_genRing hq0 hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ'
  have hgen : G2Integral.genRing q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) =
      (G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)).op := by
    rw [G2Integral.genRing, G2Integral.genRing, Subring.op_closure]
    congr 1
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩) | ⟨n, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, hz⟩ | ⟨n, hz⟩) | ⟨n, hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, unop_injective hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩
  ext x
  rw [hconv, hS, hgen]
  change x ∈ G2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j) ↔ x ∈ adjoinPair i j
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_g2_genRing hd]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_g2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_g2_braid :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i, j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwDiv_g2 hij h h', span_pbwDiv_g2_rev hij h h']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isLaurent_zero
statement: lemma isLaurent_zero : IsLaurent 0
proof: := ⟨0, _root_.map_zero _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isLaurent_one
statement: lemma isLaurent_one : IsLaurent 1
proof: := ⟨1, _root_.map_one _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsLaurent.add
statement: lemma IsLaurent.add {c c' : 𝕂} (h : IsLaurent c) (h' : IsLaurent c') : IsLaurent (c + c')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h; obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := h'; exact ⟨a + a', map_add _ _ _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsLaurent.neg
statement: lemma IsLaurent.neg {c : 𝕂} (h : IsLaurent c) : IsLaurent (-c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h; exact ⟨-a, map_neg _ _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsLaurent.sub
statement: lemma IsLaurent.sub {c c' : 𝕂} (h : IsLaurent c) (h' : IsLaurent c') : IsLaurent (c - c')
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h.add h'.neg

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isLaurent_vd_zpow
statement: lemma isLaurent_vd_zpow (d : ℕ) (m : ℤ) : IsLaurent ((𝕧 ^ d) ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]; exact isLaurent_zpow _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qBinomZ_succ_succ_eq
statement:
lemma qBinomZ_succ_succ_eq {q : 𝕂} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (m : ℤ) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : qIntZ q ((t : ℤ) + 1) ≠ 0) :
    qBinomZ q (m + 1) (t + 1) = q ^ (-((t : ℤ) + 1)) * qBinomZ q m (t + 1) +
      q ^ (m - t) * qBinomZ q m t
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomZ_succ_succ, qBinomZ_succ]
  have key : qIntZ q (m + 1) = q ^ (-((t : ℤ) + 1)) * qIntZ q (m - t) +
      q ^ (m - t) * qIntZ q ((t : ℤ) + 1) := by
    by_cases hq : q - q⁻¹ = 0
    · simp [qIntZ, hq]
    simp only [qIntZ, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add, neg_neg, zpow_add₀ hq0, zpow_neg, zpow_one]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [key]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qBinomZ_zero_succ
statement: lemma qBinomZ_zero_succ (q : 𝕂) (t : ℕ) : qBinomZ q 0 (t + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [qBinomZ_succ]
  | succ t ih => rw [qBinomZ_succ, ih, zero_mul, zero_div]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isLaurent_qBinomZ
statement:
theorem isLaurent_qBinomZ (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (m : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    IsLaurent (qBinomZ (𝕧 ^ d) m t)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (𝕧 ^ d : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (𝕧 ^ d) ^ n ≠ 1 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← pow_mul]; exact ratFunc_X_not_root _ (Nat.mul_pos hd hn)
  induction t generalizing m with
  | zero => exact isLaurent_one
  | succ t ih =>
    have ht : qIntZ (𝕧 ^ d) ((t : ℤ) + 1) ≠ 0 := qIntZ_ne_zero hq0 hq (by omega)
    have hrec := fun m ↦ qBinomZ_succ_succ_eq hq0 m t ht
    induction m using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [qBinomZ_zero_succ]; exact isLaurent_zero
    | succ m hm =>
      rw [hrec]
      exact ((isLaurent_vd_zpow d _).mul hm).add ((isLaurent_vd_zpow d _).mul (ih m))
    | pred m hm =>
      have e := hrec (-(m : ℤ) - 1)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at e
      have : qBinomZ (𝕧 ^ d) (-(m : ℤ) - 1) (t + 1) = (𝕧 ^ d) ^ ((t : ℤ) + 1) *
          (qBinomZ (𝕧 ^ d) (-(m : ℤ)) (t + 1) -
            (𝕧 ^ d) ^ ((-(m : ℤ) - 1) - t) * qBinomZ (𝕧 ^ d) (-(m : ℤ) - 1) t) := by
        rw [e, add_sub_cancel_right, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hq0, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero,
          one_mul]
      rw [this]
      exact (isLaurent_vd_zpow d _).mul (hm.sub ((isLaurent_vd_zpow d _).mul (ih _)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma ePow_nil : ePow R ([] : List (I × ℕ)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma fPow_nil : fPow R ([] : List (I × ℕ)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wtW_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wtW_nil : wtW R ([] : List (I × ℕ)) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_cons
statement:
lemma ePow_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    ePow R (p :: w) = qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d p.1) p.2 (E R 𝕧 p.1) * ePow R w
proof:
:= by
  simp [ePow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_cons
statement:
lemma fPow_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fPow R (p :: w) = qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d p.1) p.2 (F R 𝕧 p.1) * fPow R w
proof:
:= by
  simp [fPow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wtW_cons
statement:
lemma wtW_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    wtW R (p :: w) = p.2 • R.root p.1 + wtW R w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wtW]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_mem
statement: lemma ePow_mem (w : List (I × ℕ)) : ePow R w ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (wtW R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [ePow_cons, wtW_cons]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (qDivPow_E_mem _ p.1 p.2) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_mem
statement: lemma fPow_mem (w : List (I × ℕ)) : fPow R w ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (-wtW R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [fPow_cons, wtW_cons, neg_add, ← smul_neg]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (qDivPow_F_mem _ p.1 p.2) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_mul_ePow_mem
statement:
lemma fPow_mul_ePow_mem (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fPow R w * ePow R w' ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (wtW R w' - wtW R w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_neg_add]; exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (fPow_mem w) (ePow_mem w')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_mul_fPow_mem
statement:
lemma ePow_mul_fPow_mem (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    ePow R w * fPow R w' ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (wtW R w - wtW R w')
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (ePow_mem w) (fPow_mem w')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_ePow
statement: lemma isGen_ePow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : IsGen R (ePow R w) (wtW R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using isGen_one
  | cons p w ih => rw [ePow_cons, wtW_cons]; exact (isGen_E p.1 p.2).mul ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_fPow
statement: lemma isGen_fPow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : IsGen R (fPow R w) (-wtW R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using isGen_one
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [fPow_cons, wtW_cons, neg_add, ← smul_neg]; exact (isGen_F p.1 p.2).mul ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_fPow_ePow_mem
statement:
lemma elt_fPow_ePow_mem {w w' : List (I × ℕ)} {L l : Y →+ ℤ}
    (h : fPow R w * ePow R w' ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l)) : elt L l _ h ∈ aFormFE R
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_ePow_fPow_mem
statement:
lemma elt_ePow_fPow_mem {w w' : List (I × ℕ)} {L l : Y →+ ℤ}
    (h : ePow R w * fPow R w' ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l)) : elt L l _ h ∈ aFormEF R
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.latFE_le
statement: lemma latFE_le (χ : Y →+ ℤ) : (latFE R χ : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) ⊆ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, w', -, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w')
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_mem_latFE
statement:
lemma smul_mem_latFE {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsLaurent c) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ latFE R χ) : c • x ∈ latFE R χ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c', w, w', hc', hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c * c', w, w', hc.mul hc', hw, by rw [smul_smul]⟩
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.F_mul_mem_latFE
statement:
lemma F_mul_mem_latFE {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (i : I) (n : ℕ) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ latFE R χ) : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) * x ∈ latFE R (χ + n • -R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, w', hc, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c, (i, n) :: w, w', hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [wtW_cons, smul_neg]; abel
    · rw [fPow_cons, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [mul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Good.of_mem
statement: lemma Good.of_mem {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : u ∈ latFE R χ) : Good R u χ
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ ⟨u, hu, by rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Good.add
statement:
lemma Good.add {u u' : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : Good R u χ) (hu' : Good R u' χ) :
    Good R (u + u') χ
proof:
:= fun l ↦ by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := hu l
  obtain ⟨s', hs', h'⟩ := hu' l
  exact ⟨s + s', add_mem hs hs', by rw [add_sub_add_comm]; exact add_mem h h'⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Good.smul
statement:
lemma Good.smul {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : Good R u χ) {c : 𝕂}
    (hc : IsLaurent c) : Good R (c • u) χ
proof:
:= fun l ↦ by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := hu l
  exact ⟨c • s, smul_mem_latFE hc hs, by rw [← smul_sub]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.good_zero
statement: lemma good_zero (χ : Y →+ ℤ) : Good R 0 χ
proof: := Good.of_mem (zero_mem _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Good.sum
statement:
lemma Good.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {u : ι → QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ s, Good R (u t) χ) : Good R (∑ t ∈ s, u t) χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using good_zero χ
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [sum_insert ha]
    exact (hu a (mem_insert_self a s)).add (ih fun t ht ↦ hu t (mem_insert_of_mem ht))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Good.congr
statement:
lemma Good.congr {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ χ' : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : Good R u χ) (e : χ = χ') :
    Good R u χ'
proof: := e ▸ hu

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Good.F_mul
statement:
lemma Good.F_mul {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : Good R u χ) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    Good R (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) * u) (χ + n • -R.root i)
proof:
:= fun l ↦ by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := hu l
  exact ⟨_, F_mul_mem_latFE i n hs, by rw [← mul_sub]; exact mul_mem_rightRel _ h⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_mem_rightRel_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨μ, w, rfl⟩ := ha
    have e : w * (K R 𝕧 μ - algebraMap 𝕂 _ (𝕧 ^ (l + ψ) μ)) * x =
        𝕧 ^ ψ μ • ((w * x) * (K R 𝕧 μ - algebraMap 𝕂 _ (𝕧 ^ l μ))) := by
      simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, hx μ,
        mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_one, smul_sub, smul_smul, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
      rw [add_comm (l μ), zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)]
    rw [e]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨μ, w * x, rfl⟩)
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.nsmul_add_nsmul_neg
statement:
lemma nsmul_add_nsmul_neg (α : Y →+ ℤ) {N M' t : ℕ} (h1 : t ≤ N) (h2 : t ≤ M') :
    (N - t) • α + (M' - t) • -α = N • α + M' • -α
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply,
    nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_sub h2]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.good_E_mul_fPow_mul_ePow
statement:
lemma good_E_mul_fPow_mul_ePow (i : I) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) (n : ℕ) :
    Good R (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * (fPow R w * ePow R w'))
      (wtW R w' - wtW R w + n • R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    refine Good.of_mem (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨1, [], (i, n) :: w', isLaurent_one, ?_, ?_⟩)
    · rw [wtW_cons, wtW_nil]; abel
    · rw [one_smul, fPow_nil, ePow_cons, one_mul, one_mul]
  | cons p w ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, m⟩ := p
    set x := fPow R w * ePow R w'
    have hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (wtW R w' - wtW R w) := fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w'
    have e0 : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * (fPow R ((j, m) :: w) * ePow R w') =
        qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) m (F R 𝕧 j) * x := by
      simp only [x, fPow_cons, mul_assoc]
    have ew : wtW R w' - wtW R ((j, m) :: w) + n • R.root i =
        wtW R w' - wtW R w + n • R.root i + m • -R.root j := by
      rw [wtW_cons, smul_neg]; abel
    rw [e0, ew]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      intro l
      set c : ℕ → 𝕂 := fun t ↦ qBinomZ (𝕧 ^ D.d i)
        ((l + (wtW R w' - wtW R w)) (R.coroot i) + n - m) t
      have hr := qDivPow_E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub_mem (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root i n m
        (l + (wtW R w' - wtW R w))
      have hrx := mul_mem_rightRel_of_mem hr hx
      have hS : Good R ((∑ t ∈ range (n + 1), if t ≤ m then c t •
          (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m - t) (F R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n - t) (E R 𝕧 i))
          else 0) * x) (wtW R w' - wtW R w + n • R.root i + m • -R.root i) := by
        rw [sum_mul]
        refine Good.sum _ fun t ht ↦ ?_
        have htn : t ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ht)
        split_ifs with htm
        · rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
          refine Good.smul (Good.congr ((ih (n - t)).F_mul i (m - t)) ?_)
            (isLaurent_qBinomZ _ (D.d_pos i) _ _)
          rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, nsmul_add_nsmul_neg (R.root i) htn htm]
        · rw [zero_mul]; exact good_zero _
      obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := hS l
      refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_assoc]
      have : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) m (F R 𝕧 i) * x) - s =
          (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) m (F R 𝕧 i) -
            ∑ t ∈ range (n + 1), (if t ≤ m then c t • (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m - t) (F R 𝕧 i) *
              qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n - t) (E R 𝕧 i)) else 0)) * x +
          ((∑ t ∈ range (n + 1), if t ≤ m then c t • (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (m - t) (F R 𝕧 i) *
              qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (n - t) (E R 𝕧 i)) else 0) * x - s) := by
        noncomm_ring
      rw [this]
      exact add_mem hrx h
    · have hc : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) m (F R 𝕧 j) =
          qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) m (F R 𝕧 j) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) := by
        simp only [qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm]
        rw [((Commute.pow_pow (E_mul_F_of_ne (R := R) (v := 𝕧) hij) n m)).eq, mul_comm (_ : 𝕂)]
      rw [hc, mul_assoc]
      exact (ih n).F_mul j m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Good.E_mul
statement:
lemma Good.E_mul {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : Good R u χ) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    Good R (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * u) (χ + n • R.root i)
proof:
:= fun l ↦ by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := hu l
  have hEs : Good R (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * s) (χ + n • R.root i) := by
    clear h
    induction hs using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w, w', hc, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [mul_smul_comm]
      exact (good_E_mul_fPow_mul_ePow i w w' n).smul hc
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact good_zero _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact hx.add hy
    | neg x _ hx =>
      rw [mul_neg, ← neg_one_smul 𝕂]; exact hx.smul isLaurent_neg_one
  obtain ⟨s', hs', h'⟩ := hEs l
  refine ⟨s', hs', ?_⟩
  have : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * u - s' =
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * (u - s) +
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) * s - s') := by noncomm_ring
  rw [this]
  exact add_mem (mul_mem_rightRel _ h) h'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsWord.good
statement: lemma IsWord.good {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : IsWord R u χ) : Good R u χ
proof:
:= by
  induction hu with
  | one => exact Good.of_mem (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨1, [], [], isLaurent_one, by simp,
      by simp⟩)
  | E i n _ ih => exact ih.E_mul i n
  | F i n _ ih => exact ih.F_mul i n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsWord.mem
statement:
lemma IsWord.mem {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : IsWord R u χ) :
    u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ
proof:
:= by
  induction hu with
  | one => exact one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | E i n _ ih => rw [add_comm]; exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (qDivPow_E_mem _ i n) ih
  | F i n _ ih => rw [add_comm]; exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (qDivPow_F_mem _ i n) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsWord.mul
statement:
lemma IsWord.mul {u u' : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ χ' : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : IsWord R u χ)
    (hu' : IsWord R u' χ') : IsWord R (u * u') (χ + χ')
proof:
:= by
  induction hu with
  | one => simpa using hu'
  | E i n _ ih => rw [mul_assoc, add_right_comm]; exact IsWord.E i n ih
  | F i n _ ih => rw [mul_assoc, add_right_comm]; exact IsWord.F i n ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isWord_ePow
statement: lemma isWord_ePow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : IsWord R (ePow R w) (wtW R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact IsWord.one
  | cons p w ih => rw [ePow_cons, wtW_cons, add_comm]; exact IsWord.E p.1 p.2 ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isWord_fPow
statement: lemma isWord_fPow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : IsWord R (fPow R w) (-wtW R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using IsWord.one
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [fPow_cons, wtW_cons, neg_add, ← smul_neg, add_comm]; exact IsWord.F p.1 p.2 ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_mem_aFormFE_of_mem_latFE
statement:
lemma elt_mem_aFormFE_of_mem_latFE {L l : Y →+ ℤ} {s : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hs : s ∈ latFE R (L - l)) : elt L l s (latFE_le _ hs) ∈ aFormFE R
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, w', hc, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hc
    rw [elt_smul _ _ _ (hw ▸ fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w'), ← laurent_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (elt_fPow_ePow_mem _)
  | zero => rw [elt_zero']; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [elt_add _ _ (latFE_le _ hx) (latFE_le _ hy)]; exact add_mem ihx ihy
  | neg x hx ih =>
    have e : elt L l (-x) (latFE_le _ (neg_mem hx)) = -elt L l x (latFE_le _ hx) := by
      rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← elt_add, elt_congr (neg_add_cancel x) _ (zero_mem _),
        elt_zero']
    rw [e]; exact neg_mem ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsWord.elt_mem_aFormFE
statement:
theorem IsWord.elt_mem_aFormFE {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {L l : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : IsWord R u (L - l)) :
    elt L l u hu.mem ∈ aFormFE R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := hu.good l
  rw [elt_eq_of_sub_mem_rightRel ratFunc_X_not_root hu.mem (latFE_le _ hs) h]
  exact elt_mem_aFormFE_of_mem_latFE hs

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_zero_of_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_adWeightSpace {χ χ' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : χ ≠ χ') {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ) (hu' : u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ') : u = 0
proof:
:=
  Submodule.disjoint_def.1 ((iSupIndep_adWeightSpace ratFunc_X_not_root).pairwiseDisjoint h) u
    hu hu'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.IsWord.elt_mem_aFormFE'
statement:
theorem IsWord.elt_mem_aFormFE' {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} {χ L l : Y →+ ℤ} (hu : IsWord R u χ)
    (h : u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l)) : elt L l u h ∈ aFormFE R
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hχ : χ = L - l
  · subst hχ; exact hu.elt_mem_aFormFE
  · rw [elt_congr (eq_zero_of_mem_adWeightSpace hχ hu.mem h) h (zero_mem _), elt_zero']
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_mem_aFormFE
statement:
lemma mul_mem_aFormFE {x y : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aFormFE R) (hy : y ∈ aFormFE R) :
    x * y ∈ aFormFE R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨u, u', L', l', h', rfl⟩ := hy
      by_cases hl : l = L'
      · subst hl
        rw [elt_mul_elt]
        exact (((isWord_fPow w).mul (isWord_ePow w')).mul
          ((isWord_fPow u).mul (isWord_ePow u'))).elt_mem_aFormFE' _
      · rw [elt_mul_elt_of_ne hl]; exact zero_mem _
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul a y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hz
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aForm_eq_aFormFE
statement: theorem aForm_eq_aFormFE : (aForm R).toSubmodule = aFormFE R
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · induction hx using NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨l, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, n, l, rfl | rfl⟩
      · exact IsWord.one.elt_mem_aFormFE' _
      · have hw : IsWord R (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i)) (n • R.root i) := by
          simpa using IsWord.E i n (IsWord.one (R := R))
        exact hw.elt_mem_aFormFE' _
      · have hw : IsWord R (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i)) (n • -R.root i) := by
          simpa using IsWord.F i n (IsWord.one (R := R))
        exact hw.elt_mem_aFormFE' _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => exact mul_mem_aFormFE hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx
  · rintro _ ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩
    have hg := (isGen_fPow (R := R) w).mul (isGen_ePow w')
    by_cases hχ : L - l = -wtW R w + wtW R w'
    · exact hg.elt_mem hχ h
    · rw [elt_congr (eq_zero_of_mem_adWeightSpace (Ne.symm hχ) hg.1 h) h (zero_mem _), elt_zero']
      exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_omegaAut
statement: lemma wt_omegaAut (l : Y →+ ℤ) : wt (omegaAut R) l = -l
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  have h : (omegaAut R).1.2⁻¹ μ = -μ := by
    have := autY_apply_inv (omegaAut R).1.2 μ
    change -((omegaAut R).1.2⁻¹ μ) = μ at this
    exact neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp this
  rw [wt_apply, h, map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_omega_elt
statement:
lemma map_omega_elt {L l : Y →+ ℤ} {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l))
    (hu' : chevalley R 𝕧 u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (-L - -l)) :
    map (omegaAut R) (elt L l u hu) = elt (-L) (-l) (chevalley R 𝕧 u) hu'
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_elt]
  exact elt_index (wt_omegaAut L) (wt_omegaAut l) rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.chevalley_ePow
statement: lemma chevalley_ePow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : chevalley R 𝕧 (ePow R w) = fPow R w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p w ih => rw [ePow_cons, fPow_cons, _root_.map_mul, map_qDivPow', chevalley_E, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.chevalley_fPow

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_omega_mem_aForm
statement:
lemma map_omega_mem_aForm {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aForm R) :
    map (omegaAut R) x ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨l, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, n, l, rfl | rfl⟩
    · rw [one, map_omega_elt _ (by rw [_root_.map_one, sub_self]; exact one_mem_adWeightSpace)]
      exact (isGen_one.of_eq (_root_.map_one _)).elt_mem (sub_self _) _
    · rw [divE, map_omega_elt _ (by
        rw [map_qDivPow', chevalley_E]
        convert qDivPow_F_mem (R := R) _ i n using 2
        rw [smul_neg]; abel)]
      exact (isGen_F i n).of_eq (by rw [map_qDivPow', chevalley_E]) |>.elt_mem
        (by rw [smul_neg]; abel) _
    · rw [divF, map_omega_elt _ (by
        rw [map_qDivPow', chevalley_F]
        convert qDivPow_E_mem (R := R) _ i n using 2
        rw [smul_neg]; abel)]
      exact (isGen_E i n).of_eq (by rw [map_qDivPow', chevalley_F]) |>.elt_mem
        (by rw [smul_neg]; abel) _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [map_omega_smul]; exact SMulMemClass.smul_mem a hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_omega_mem_aFormEF
statement:
lemma map_omega_mem_aFormEF {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aFormFE R) :
    map (omegaAut R) x ∈ aFormEF R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩ := hx
    have h' : ePow R w * fPow R w' ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (-L - -l) := by
      have := map_mem_adWeightSpace_sub (omegaAut R) h
      rw [wt_omegaAut, wt_omegaAut] at this
      convert this using 1
      change _ = chevalley R 𝕧 _
      rw [_root_.map_mul, chevalley_fPow, chevalley_ePow]
    rw [map_omega_elt h (by rwa [_root_.map_mul, chevalley_fPow, chevalley_ePow])]
    rw [elt_congr (by rw [_root_.map_mul, chevalley_fPow, chevalley_ePow]) _ h']
    exact elt_ePow_fPow_mem h'
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [map_omega_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_omega_map_omega
statement: lemma map_omega_map_omega (x : Modified R 𝕧) : map (omegaAut R) (map (omegaAut R) x) = x
proof:

  have h : omegaAut R * omegaAut R = 1 := torusAut_ext ratFunc_X_not_root (by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aForm_eq_aFormEF
statement: theorem aForm_eq_aFormEF : (aForm R).toSubmodule = aFormEF R
proof:

  · have h1 : map (omegaAut R) x ∈ aFormFE R := by
      rw [← aForm_eq_aFormFE]; exact map_omega_mem_aForm hx
    simpa [map_omega_map_omega] using map_omega_mem_aFormEF h1
  · have h1 : map (omegaAut R) x ∈ (aForm R).toSubmodule := by
      rw [aForm_eq_aFormFE]; exact map_omega_mem_aFormFE hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_diagHom_pbwDiv
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing χ with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial]⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := ih (fun n ↦ c n.succ) (hχ.reflChar i)
    obtain ⟨e', m', he'⟩ := hχ i
    refine ⟨e' * c 0 + e, m' * c 0 + m, ?_⟩
    have H := diagHom_comp_of_hasImages (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i) χ
    rw [pbwDiv, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, Ta_apply]
    rw [show diagHom R 𝕧 χ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i
        (CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial (Ta R) (Ed R) ω fun n ↦ c n.succ)) =
        braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (diagHom R 𝕧 (reflChar D i χ)
          (CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial (Ta R) (Ed R) ω fun n ↦ c n.succ)) from
      DFunLike.congr_fun H _]
    rw [he, map_smul, Ed, diagHom_qDivPow_E, he', smul_mul_smul_comm, ← Ta_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_pow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul,
      zpow_add₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero), zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)]
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_diagHom_pbwDivSymm
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing χ with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial]⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := ih (fun n ↦ c n.succ) (hχ.reflChar i)
    obtain ⟨e', m', he'⟩ := hχ i
    refine ⟨e' * c 0 + e, m' * c 0 + m, ?_⟩
    rw [pbwDivSymm, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, Ta_symm_apply,
      diagHom_symm_apply_of_hasImages (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i)]
    rw [he, map_smul, Ed, diagHom_qDivPow_E, he', smul_mul_smul_comm, ← Ta_symm_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_pow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul,
      zpow_add₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero), zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)]
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_pbwDivPrime_eq_smul
statement:
lemma exists_pbwDivPrime_eq_smul (ω : List I) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ e m : ℤ, pbwDivPrime R ω c = ((-1) ^ e * 𝕧 ^ m) • pbwDiv R ω c
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial]⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := ih (fun n ↦ c n.succ)
    obtain ⟨e', m', he'⟩ := exists_diagHom_pbwDiv (R := R) ω (fun n ↦ c n.succ)
      (isSignPow_chevalleyScalar_zpow (D := D) (v := 𝕧) i (D.cartanMatrix i)).inv
    refine ⟨e + e', m + m', ?_⟩
    rw [pbwDivPrime, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, pbwDiv, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons,
      TaPrime_apply, ← pbwDivPrime, he, map_smul,
      braidPrimeEquiv_eq_braidEquivOfNotRoot_diagHom ratFunc_X_not_root,
      show braidSign D 𝕧 i = fun j ↦ chevalleyScalar D 𝕧 i ^ D.cartanMatrix i j from rfl,
      he', map_smul, smul_smul, mul_smul_comm, ← Ta_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [zpow_add₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero), zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_pbwDivPrimeSymm_eq_smul
statement:
lemma exists_pbwDivPrimeSymm_eq_smul (ω : List I) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ e m : ℤ, pbwDivPrimeSymm R ω c = ((-1) ^ e * 𝕧 ^ m) • pbwDivSymm R ω c
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial]⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, m, he⟩ := ih (fun n ↦ c n.succ)
    obtain ⟨e', m', he'⟩ := exists_diagHom_pbwDivSymm (R := R) (i :: ω) c
      (isSignPow_chevalleyScalar_zpow (D := D) (v := 𝕧) i (D.cartanMatrix i))
    set M := pbwDivSymm R ω (fun n ↦ c n.succ)
    set E0 := qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (c 0) (E R 𝕧 i)
    set Tinv := (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
    set b := braidSign D 𝕧 i
    have hb : ((b i : 𝕂ˣ) : 𝕂) = 𝕧 ^ (2 * (D.d i : ℤ)) := by
      simp only [b, braidSign, D.cartanMatrix_self, chevalleyScalar, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val,
        Units.val_mk0]
      rw [show (2 : ℤ) = ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, zpow_natCast, neg_sq, ← pow_mul, mul_comm,
        ← zpow_natCast]
      push_cast; ring_nf
    have hb0 : ((b i : 𝕂ˣ) : 𝕂) ^ c 0 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (Units.ne_zero _)
    have hsplit : pbwDivSymm R (i :: ω) c = E0 * Tinv M := rfl
    have h1 : ((b i : 𝕂ˣ) : 𝕂) ^ c 0 • (E0 * diagHom R 𝕧 b (Tinv M)) =
        ((-1) ^ e' * 𝕧 ^ m') • (E0 * Tinv M) := by
      rw [← hsplit, ← he', hsplit, _root_.map_mul, diagHom_qDivPow_E, smul_mul_assoc]
      rfl
    have h2 : E0 * diagHom R 𝕧 b (Tinv M) =
        ((((b i : 𝕂ˣ) : 𝕂) ^ c 0)⁻¹ * ((-1) ^ e' * 𝕧 ^ m')) • (E0 * Tinv M) := by
      rw [← smul_smul, ← h1, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb0, one_smul]
    refine ⟨e + e', m + m' - 2 * D.d i * c 0, ?_⟩
    change E0 * (TaPrime R i).symm (pbwDivPrimeSymm R ω fun n ↦ c n.succ) = _
    rw [hsplit, TaPrime_symm_apply, he, map_smul,
      braidPrimeEquiv_symm_eq_diagHom_symm ratFunc_X_not_root, mul_smul_comm]
    change ((-1) ^ e * 𝕧 ^ m) • (E0 * diagHom R 𝕧 b (Tinv M)) = _
    rw [h2, smul_smul, hb]
    congr 1
    rw [zpow_add₀ (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero), zpow_sub₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧),
      zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧), ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_unit_eval
statement:
lemma exists_unit_eval (e m : ℤ) :
    ∃ u : 𝒜ˣ, LusztigF.integralLaurentEval (u : 𝒜) = (-1) ^ e * 𝕧 ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : LaurentPolynomial.T m * LaurentPolynomial.T (-m) = (1 : 𝒜) := by
    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add, add_neg_cancel, LaurentPolynomial.T_zero]
  have h2 : LaurentPolynomial.T (-m) * LaurentPolynomial.T m = (1 : 𝒜) := by
    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add, neg_add_cancel, LaurentPolynomial.T_zero]
  have hT : LusztigF.integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.T m) = 𝕧 ^ m := by
    simp
  rcases Int.even_or_odd e with he | he
  · exact ⟨⟨_, _, h1, h2⟩, by rw [he.neg_one_zpow, one_mul]; exact hT⟩
  · exact ⟨-⟨_, _, h1, h2⟩, by
      rw [he.neg_one_zpow, Units.val_neg, map_neg, neg_one_mul]; exact congrArg _ hT⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_range_eq_of_units_smul
statement:
lemma span_range_eq_of_units_smul {ι : Type*} {f g : ι → QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (u : ι → 𝒜ˣ)
    (h : ∀ c, f c = u c • g c) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range f) = Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    rw [h, Units.smul_def]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨c, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    rw [show g c = (u c)⁻¹ • f c by rw [h, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel, one_smul], Units.smul_def]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨c, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_units_pbwDivPrime
statement:
lemma exists_units_pbwDivPrime (ω : List I) :
    ∃ u : (Fin ω.length → ℕ) → 𝒜ˣ, ∀ c, pbwDivPrime R ω c = u c • pbwDiv R ω c
proof:
:= by
  choose e m he using exists_pbwDivPrime_eq_smul (R := R) ω
  choose u hu using fun c ↦ exists_unit_eval (e c) (m c)
  exact ⟨u, fun c ↦ by rw [Units.smul_def, laurent_smul_U, hu, he]⟩

proof:

  choose u hu using fun c ↦ exists_unit_eval (e c) (m c)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivPrime
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivPrime (ω : List I) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivPrime R ω)) =

proof:
:= by

    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
