name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.actComp_aux
statement:
lemma actComp_aux (χ : Y →+ ℤ) (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) :
    (modRel R v p.1 p.2).comap (adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2)).subtype ≤
      LinearMap.ker ((actAux (R := R) (v := v) χ p).compr₂
        (Comp.mk R v (p.1 + χ, p.2))).flip
proof:
:= fun b hb ↦ by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  ext a
  exact (Comp.mk_eq_zero (p := (p.1 + χ, p.2))).2 (mul_mem_modRel_add a.2 hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.actComp_mk
statement:
lemma actComp_mk (χ : Y →+ ℤ) (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (a : adWeightSpace R v χ)
    (b : adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2)) :
    actComp χ p a (Comp.mk R v p b) = Comp.mk R v (p.1 + χ, p.2) (actAux χ p a b)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.actHom_elt
statement:
lemma actHom_elt (χ : Y →+ ℤ) (a : adWeightSpace R v χ) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ)
    {t : QuantumGroup R v} (ht : t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    actHom χ a (elt l₁ l₂ t ht) =
      elt (l₁ + χ) l₂ (a.1 * t) (mul_mem_adWeightSpace_add_sub a.2 ht)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actHom, LinearMap.flip_apply, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    LinearMap.compr₂_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.adDecompose_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [adDecompose, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change u = DirectSum.coeLinearMap _ (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun χ ↦ adWeightSpace R v χ) χ ⟨u, hu⟩)
  rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.coeLinearMap_of]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftAct_elt
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftAct, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, adDecompose_of_mem hv hu,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof, actHom_elt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftAct_zero_left
statement:
lemma leftAct_zero_left (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (x : Modified R v) :
    leftAct R v hv 0 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftAct_mul
statement:
theorem leftAct_mul (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (u u' : QuantumGroup R v)
    (x : Modified R v) :
    leftAct R v hv (u * u') x = leftAct R v hv u (leftAct R v hv u' x)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd a b ha hb => simp only [add_mul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]
  | hhom χ a ha =>
  induction u' using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd b c hb hc => simp only [mul_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hb, hc]
  | hhom χ' b hb =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | helt l₁ l₂ t ht =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv (mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hb), leftAct_elt hv hb, leftAct_elt hv ha]
    exact elt_index (by abel) rfl (mul_assoc _ _ _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftAct_one
statement:
theorem leftAct_one (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (x : Modified R v) :
    leftAct R v hv 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | helt l₁ l₂ t ht =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv one_mem_adWeightSpace]
    exact elt_index (add_zero l₁) rfl (one_mul t) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftAct_one_eq_elt
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, leftAct_elt hv hu]
  exact elt_index (by abel) rfl (mul_one u) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twistAd_mem_plus
proof:
:= by
  induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of μ =>
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.of_apply, twistAd_single]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (adK_mem_plus _ hx) _
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a ha => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]; exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ ha c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PhiU_apply
statement:
lemma PhiU_apply (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v)))
    (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    PhiU R hv ζ ((y : QuantumGroup R v) * zeroHom R v g * x) =
      y ⊗ₜ (⟨twistAd R v ζ g x, twistAd_mem_plus ζ g x.2⟩ :
        Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul R v hv, PhiU, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  simp [phiPlus]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PhiU_mul_plus
statement:
lemma PhiU_mul_plus (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v)))
    (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    PhiU R hv ζ ((y : QuantumGroup R v) * x) = y ⊗ₜ x
proof:
:= by
  have h := PhiU_apply hv ζ y 1 x
  rw [map_one, mul_one] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PhiU_mul_K
statement:
lemma PhiU_mul_K (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) (ν : Y) :
    PhiU R hv ζ (u * K R v ν) = v ^ ζ ν • PhiU R hv ζ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (triangularMultiplicationEquiv R v hv).surjective u
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_mul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | tmul y z =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [tmul_add, map_add, add_mul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
    | tmul g x =>
      induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
      | of μ =>
        rw [triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul]
        have hx' := adK_mem_plus (R := R) (-ν) x.2
        have e : (y : QuantumGroup R v) * zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.of k Y (.ofAdd μ)) * x *
            K R v ν = y * zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (μ + ν) 1) *
              (⟨_, hx'⟩ : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) := by
          simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.of_apply, toAdd_ofAdd, zeroHom_single]
          rw [adK_apply, neg_neg, ← K_add]
          simp only [mul_assoc]
          rw [← mul_assoc (K R v ν) (K R v (-ν)), K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul]
        rw [e, PhiU_apply, PhiU_apply, ← tmul_smul]
        congr 1
        ext
        simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.of_apply, toAdd_ofAdd, twistAd_single, Subalgebra.coe_smul]
        rw [adK_add, ← adK_add ν (-ν), add_neg_cancel, adK_zero]
        simp only [smul_smul, one_mul, map_add, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
        congr 1
        ring
      | add a b ha hb =>
        rw [add_tmul, tmul_add, map_add, add_mul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
      | smul c a ha =>
        rw [← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, ha, map_smul, smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.PhiU_modRel
statement:
lemma PhiU_modRel {L ζ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v} (hx : x ∈ modRel R v L ζ) :
    PhiU R hv ζ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · rw [sub_mul, map_sub, hu μ, map_smul, PhiU_mul_K, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v),
        AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_add_cancel, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_mul_assoc,
        one_mul, map_smul, sub_self]
    · rw [mul_sub, map_sub, PhiU_mul_K, ← Algebra.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
        smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, map_smul, sub_self]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Phi_elt
statement:
lemma Phi_elt (ζ L l : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v} (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l)) :
    Phi R hv ζ (elt L l u hu) = if l = ζ then PhiU R hv ζ u else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Phi, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  by_cases h : l = ζ
  · subst h
    simp only [phiComp, Comp.mk, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte]
    rfl
  · simp [phiComp, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bm_mul_bp_mem
statement:
lemma bm_mul_bp_mem (i : ι) (l : Y →+ ℤ) (j : κ) :
    (bm i : QuantumGroup R v) * bp j ∈ adWeightSpace R v ((l - wm i) - (l - wp j))
proof:
:= by
  have := mul_mem_adWeightSpace (hm i) (hp j)
  convert this using 2
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.linearIndependent_triFun
statement: theorem linearIndependent_triFun : LinearIndependent k (triFun bm bp wm wp hm hp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg t0 ht0
  obtain ⟨i0, l0, j0⟩ := t0
  let ℓ : Modified R v →ₗ[k] k :=
    Finsupp.lapply (i0, j0) ∘ₗ (bm.tensorProduct bp).repr.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      Phi R hv (l0 - wp j0)
  have hℓ : ∀ t, ℓ (triFun bm bp wm wp hm hp t) = if t = (i0, l0, j0) then 1 else 0 := by
    rintro ⟨i, l, j⟩
    simp only [ℓ, LinearMap.comp_apply, triFun, Phi_elt, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    by_cases h : l - wp j = l0 - wp j0
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [PhiU_mul_plus]
      have e : (bm.tensorProduct bp).repr (bm i ⊗ₜ bp j) = Finsupp.single (i, j) 1 := by
        rw [← Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self]
      rw [e, Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      by_cases hij : (i, j) = (i0, j0)
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.1 hij
        have : l = l0 := by simpa using h
        subst this
        simp
      · have hne : (i, l, j) ≠ (i0, l0, j0) := by
          rintro ⟨⟩
          exact hij rfl
        simp [hij, hne]
    · have hne : (i, l, j) ≠ (i0, l0, j0) := by
        rintro ⟨⟩
        exact h rfl
      simp [h, hne]
  have := congrArg ℓ hg
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at this
  simp only [map_smul, hℓ, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] at this
  simpa [ht0] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fullBasis_mem
statement:
lemma fullBasis_mem (t : ι × Y × κ) :
    ((bm.tensorProduct ((AddMonoidAlgebra.basis Y k).tensorProduct bp)).map
      (triangularMultiplicationEquiv R v hv) t) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (wp t.2.2 - wm t.1)
proof:
:= by
  have e : ((bm.tensorProduct ((AddMonoidAlgebra.basis Y k).tensorProduct bp)).map
      (triangularMultiplicationEquiv R v hv) t) = bm t.1 * K R v t.2.1 * bp t.2.2 := by
    obtain ⟨i, μ, j⟩ := t
    rw [Module.Basis.map_apply, Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply,
      Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply, triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.basis_apply, zeroHom_single]
  rw [e, sub_eq_neg_add]
  simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (mul_mem_adWeightSpace (hm t.1) (K_mem_adWeightSpace t.2.1))
    (hp t.2.2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_triFun
statement: theorem span_triFun : Submodule.span k (Set.range (triFun bm bp wm wp hm hp)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using Modified.induction_on with
  | h0 => exact zero_mem _
  | hadd x y hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | helt L l u hu =>
    set FB := (bm.tensorProduct ((AddMonoidAlgebra.basis Y k).tensorProduct bp)).map
      (triangularMultiplicationEquiv R v hv)
    have hFB : ∀ t, FB t = bm t.1 * K R v t.2.1 * bp t.2.2 := fun t ↦ by
      obtain ⟨i, μ, j⟩ := t
      rw [Module.Basis.map_apply, Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply,
        Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply, triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.basis_apply, zeroHom_single]
    set S := (FB.repr u).support
    let f : ι × Y × κ → QuantumGroup R v := fun t ↦
      if wp t.2.2 - wm t.1 = L - l then FB.repr u t • FB t else 0
    have hf : ∀ t, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := fun t ↦ by
      simp only [f]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (h ▸ fullBasis_mem hv bm bp wm wp hm hp t)
      · exact zero_mem _
    have hu' : u = ∑ t ∈ S, f t := by
      have hsum : u = ∑ t ∈ S, FB.repr u t • FB t := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← FB.linearCombination_repr u]
        rfl
      have hrest : u - ∑ t ∈ S, f t ∈ otherWeights R v (L - l) := by
        have e : u - ∑ t ∈ S, f t = ∑ t ∈ S, (FB.repr u t • FB t - f t) := by
          rw [sum_sub_distrib, ← hsum]
        rw [e]
        refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ ?_
        simp only [f]
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _
        · rw [sub_zero]
          exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem h
            (fullBasis_mem hv bm bp wm wp hm hp t)))
      have hin : u - ∑ t ∈ S, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) :=
        sub_mem hu (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ hf t)
      have h0 : u - ∑ t ∈ S, f t = 0 := by
        have hmem : u - ∑ t ∈ S, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) ⊓ otherWeights R v (L - l) :=
          ⟨hin, hrest⟩
        rw [inf_otherWeights hv (L - l)] at hmem
        exact (Submodule.mem_bot k).1 hmem
      exact (sub_eq_zero.1 h0)
    rw [elt_congr hu' hu (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ hf t), elt_sum S f hf]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ ?_
    by_cases h : wp t.2.2 - wm t.1 = L - l
    · have e : elt L l (f t) (hf t) = (FB.repr u t * v ^ (wp t.2.2) t.2.1 *
          v ^ (l t.2.1)) • triFun bm bp wm wp hm hp (t.1, l + wp t.2.2, t.2.2) := by
        have hK : (bm t.1 : QuantumGroup R v) * K R v t.2.1 * bp t.2.2 =
            v ^ (wp t.2.2) t.2.1 • ((bm t.1 : QuantumGroup R v) * bp t.2.2 * K R v t.2.1) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, hp t.2.2 t.2.1, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
        have hmem := bm_mul_bp_mem bm bp wm wp hm hp t.1 (l + wp t.2.2) t.2.2
        have hmem' : (bm t.1 : QuantumGroup R v) * bp t.2.2 ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := by
          convert hmem using 2; rw [← h]; abel
        have hmemK : (bm t.1 : QuantumGroup R v) * bp t.2.2 * K R v t.2.1 ∈
            adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := by
          simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hmem' (K_mem_adWeightSpace t.2.1)
        have e1 : f t = (FB.repr u t * v ^ (wp t.2.2) t.2.1) •
            ((bm t.1 : QuantumGroup R v) * bp t.2.2 * K R v t.2.1) := by
          simp only [f, h, ↓reduceIte, hFB, hK, smul_smul]
        rw [elt_congr e1 (hf t) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hmemK), elt_smul _ _ _ hmemK,
          elt_mul_K _ _ _ hmem', smul_smul, triFun]
        congr 1
        refine elt_index ?_ ?_ rfl _ _
        · change L = l + wp t.2.2 - wm t.1
          rw [add_sub_assoc, h]; abel
        · change l = l + wp t.2.2 - wp t.2.2
          abel
      rw [e]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    · simp only [f, h, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [elt_eq_zero _ (zero_mem _)]
      exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triangularBasis_apply
statement:
lemma triangularBasis_apply (t : ι × (Y →+ ℤ) × κ) :
    triangularBasis hv bm bp wm wp hm hp t = triFun bm bp wm wp hm hp t
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_op
statement:
lemma qDivPow_op {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra 𝕂 A] (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x : A) :
    qDivPow t n (op x) = op (qDivPow t n x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qDivPow, op_smul, op_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_adjoinPair_eq_genRing
statement:
lemma coe_adjoinPair_eq_genRing {i j : I} (hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ 2) :
    (adjoinPair (R := R) i j : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) =
      B2Integral.genRing (𝕧 ^ D.d i) LusztigF.integralLaurentEval.range (E R 𝕧 i)
        (E R 𝕧 j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Subalgebra.coe_toSubring, Algebra.adjoin_eq_ring_closure, B2Integral.genRing]
  have h1 : Set.range (algebraMap 𝒜 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) =
      algebraMap 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) '' (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval.range : Set 𝕂) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have h2 : Set.range (Ed R j) = Set.range fun n : ℕ ↦ qDivPow ((𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ 2) n (E R 𝕧 j) := by
    rw [← hd]; rfl
  rw [h1, h2, ← Set.union_assoc]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_b2
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_b2 :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  set X := braidEj R 𝕧 i j
  set y := b2RootY R 𝕧 i j
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 2 := parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 2) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have h2 : qFactorial q 2 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 2
  have hF2 : qFactorial q 2 = qInt q 2 := by simp [qFactorial, qInt]
  have H : B2PBW.Rel (q ^ 2) (E R 𝕧 i) (qInt q 2 • X) y (E R 𝕧 j) := by
    have e : qInt q 2 • X = b2RootX R 𝕧 i j := by
      rw [show X = _ from b2_braidEj_eq h, smul_smul, ← hF2, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]
    rw [e]
    exact b2_rel hij h h'
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have hT2 : T i (E R 𝕧 j) = X := a2_rootVector_two hij Hi
  have hT3 : T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = y := by
    have e := b2_rootVector_three Hi Hj hij h h' hq
    change T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_cc_two hq0 hq, ← b2_qFactorial_two hq0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul,
      BraidDiagonal.X_succ (n := 0), b2_shift_zero]
    rfl
  have hT4 : T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))) = E R 𝕧 j := b2_rootVector_four Hi Hj hij h h' hq h2
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 4 → ℕ, pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j] c =
      B2Integral.M4 q (E R 𝕧 i) X y (E R 𝕧 j) (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one, mul_one]
    change Ed R i _ * (T i (Ed R j _) * (T i (T j (Ed R i _)) * T i (T j (T i (Ed R j _))))) = _
    rw [Ed, Ed, Ed, Ed, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hT4, hT3, hT2, hd]
    simp only [B2Integral.M4, B2Integral.M3, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j])) ↔
      x ∈ B2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) X y (E R 𝕧 j) := fun x ↦ by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact B2Integral.M4_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U]
        exact B2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [← laurent_smul_U, show B2Integral.M4 q (E R 𝕧 i) X y (E R 𝕧 j) a b c' d =
          pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j] ![a, b, c', d] by rw [hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  have hS := B2Integral.coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing hq0 hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ'
  ext x
  rw [hconv, Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, ← SetLike.mem_coe, hS, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_genRing hd]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_b2_rev
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_b2_rev :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  set y' := b2RevRootY R 𝕧 i j
  set X' := (qFactorial q 2)⁻¹ • b2RevRootX R 𝕧 i j
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 2 := parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 2) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have h2 : qFactorial q 2 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 2
  have hF2 : qFactorial q 2 = qInt q 2 := by simp [qFactorial, qInt]
  have hS3 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
  rw [B2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_three h] at hS3
  have hS2 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
  rw [A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', hd] at hS2
  have H : B2PBW.Rel (q ^ 2) (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (qInt q 2 • op X') (op y') (op (E R 𝕧 j)) := by
    have e : qInt q 2 • op X' = op (b2RevRootX R 𝕧 i j) := by
      rw [← op_smul, smul_smul, ← hF2, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]
    rw [e]
    exact B2PBW.rel_op hq0 hS3 hS2
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have hY' : T j (E R 𝕧 i) = y' := by
    have e := a2_rootVector_two hij.symm Hj
    change T j (E R 𝕧 i) = _ at e
    rw [e, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h', parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h']
    rfl
  have hY : T j (b2RootY R 𝕧 i j) = E R 𝕧 i := by
    rw [b2RootY_eq_X R 𝕧 (j := j)]
    exact b2_T_X_one Hj hij h h' hq h2
  have hX : T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j)) = X' := by
    have e := a2_rootVector_two hij Hi
    change T i (E R 𝕧 j) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_braidEj_eq h, _root_.map_smul, b2RootX, _root_.map_sub, _root_.map_mul,
      _root_.map_mul, hY, hY']
    rfl
  have hE : T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))) = E R 𝕧 i := by
    have e := b2_rootVector_three Hi Hj hij h h' hq
    change T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_cc_two hq0 hq, ← b2_qFactorial_two hq0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul,
      ← b2RootY_eq_X, hY]
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 4 → ℕ, op (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i] c) =
      B2Integral.M4 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op X') (op y') (op (E R 𝕧 j)) (c 3) (c 2) (c 1)
        (c 0) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one, mul_one]
    change op (Ed R j _ * (T j (Ed R i _) * (T j (T i (Ed R j _)) *
      T j (T i (T j (Ed R i _)))))) = _
    rw [Ed, Ed, Ed, Ed, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hE, hX, hY', hd]
    simp only [B2Integral.M4, B2Integral.M3, qDivPow_op, op_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i])) ↔
      op x ∈ B2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op X') (op y') (op (E R 𝕧 j)) := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact B2Integral.M4_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _
      | zero => rw [op_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [op_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U, op_smul]
        exact B2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      rw [← unop_op x]
      generalize op x = z at hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, rfl⟩ := hz
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [unop_smul, ← laurent_smul_U, show unop (B2Integral.M4 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op X')
          (op y') (op (E R 𝕧 j)) a b c' d) = pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i] ![d, c', b, a] by
            rw [← unop_op (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i] _), hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => rw [unop_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [unop_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => rw [unop_neg]; exact neg_mem hx
  have hS := B2Integral.coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing hq0 hqi hpi H hqΛ hqΛ'
  have hgen : B2Integral.genRing q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) =
      (B2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)).op := by
    rw [B2Integral.genRing, B2Integral.genRing, Subring.op_closure]
    congr 1
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩) | ⟨n, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, hz⟩ | ⟨n, hz⟩) | ⟨n, hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, unop_injective hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩
  ext x
  rw [hconv, Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, ← SetLike.mem_coe, hS, hgen, SetLike.mem_coe,
    Subring.mem_op, unop_op, ← SetLike.mem_coe, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_genRing hd]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_b2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_b2_braid :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwDiv_b2 hij h h', span_pbwDiv_b2_rev hij h h']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.cartanMatrix_cases
statement:
lemma cartanMatrix_cases (hij : i ≠ j) (hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j ≠ 0) :
    (D.cartanMatrix i j = 0 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = 0) ∨
      (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
      (D.cartanMatrix i j = -2 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
      (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -2) ∨
      D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hA := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
  have h1 := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have h2 := hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  have hz := hA.zero_comm i j
  rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij] at hm
  generalize D.cartanMatrix i j = a at *
  generalize D.cartanMatrix j i = b at *
  have hle : a * b ≤ 3 := by
    by_contra hc
    apply hm
    generalize hP : a * b = P at hc
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, P.toNat = n + 4 := ⟨P.toNat - 4, by omega⟩
    rw [hn]
    rfl
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with rfl | ha
  · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, hz.mp rfl⟩
  · have hb : b < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne h2 fun hb ↦ ha.ne (hz.mpr hb)
    have ha' : -3 ≤ a := by nlinarith
    have hb' : -3 ≤ b := by nlinarith
    interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> simp_all

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidInvariant_of_span_pbwDiv_g2
statement:
theorem braidInvariant_of_span_pbwDiv_g2
    (hG : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i = 3 →
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
        Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j, i, j, i]))) : BraidInvariant R
proof:
:= by
  intro u w hm
  obtain ⟨p, s, i, j, hij, hmij, rfl, rfl⟩ := hm
  have hT : ((CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j).map (Ta R)).prod =
      ((CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i).map (Ta R)).prod := by
    ext x
    rw [list_Ta_apply, list_Ta_apply,
      isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i j hij hmij]
  have hw : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℤ), D.cartanMatrix i j = a → D.cartanMatrix j i = b →
      (a * b).toNat = n → D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = Matrix.coxeterEntry n ∧
        D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = Matrix.coxeterEntry n := by
    intro n a b ha hb hn
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha,
      hb, mul_comm b, hn]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  rcases cartanMatrix_cases hij hmij with ⟨h0, h0'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h2, h2'⟩ | ⟨h2, h2'⟩ | h3'
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 0 0 0 h0 h0' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (Ta R) (Ed R) (span_pbwDiv_commuting h0) hT p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 1 (-1) (-1) h1 h1' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (Ta R) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDiv_a2_braid hij h1 h1').symm hT p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 2 (-2) (-1) h2 h2' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (Ta R) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDiv_b2_braid hij h2 h2') hT p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 2 (-1) (-2) h2 h2' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (Ta R) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDiv_b2_braid hij.symm h2' h2).symm hT p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 3 _ _ rfl rfl (by rw [h3']; rfl)
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j =
        [i, j, i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i =
        [j, i, j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (Ta R) (Ed R)
      (hG i j hij h3') hT p s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidInvariant_of_mul_ne_three
statement:
theorem braidInvariant_of_mul_ne_three
    (h3 : ∀ i j, D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≠ 3) : BraidInvariant R
proof:
:=
  braidInvariant_of_span_pbwDiv_g2 fun i j _ h ↦ absurd h (h3 i j)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R u)) = Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove (fun _ _ _ hm ↦ hB _ _ hm)
    hu (CoxeterSystem.reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hu hw huw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    {i : I} (hi : cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.wordProd w) i) (t : ℕ) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i) * x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu₀⟩ := exists_reduced_cons_of_isLeftDescent cs hi
  have hs := span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant hB cs hu hw hu₀
  rw [← hs] at hx ⊢
  exact CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwDivSpan_cons (Ta R) (Ed R) i u (Ed_mul_mem_span i t) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
  have hplus : ∀ c, pbwDiv R w c ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i)) := fun c ↦ by
    have hc := pbwDiv_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, AlgEquiv.one_apply] at hc
    generalize pbwDiv R w c = y at hc ⊢
    induction hc using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact hplus c
  · intro x hx
    have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ S :=
      CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwDivSpan (Ta R) (Ed R) Ed_zero w
    have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
        exact fun y hy ↦ qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_of_braidInvariant hB cs hw
          (hw₀ ▸ cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i) n hy
      | algebraMap a =>
        intro y hy
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
        exact S.smul_mem a hy
      | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
      | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
    simpa using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_span_pbwDiv_longest_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem coe_span_pbwDiv_longest_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    (Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w)) : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) = aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      simpa using pbwDiv_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul_U]; exact smul_mem_aPlus ⟨a, rfl⟩ hx
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant hB cs hw hw₀]
    induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_of_mul_ne_three
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_of_mul_ne_three {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R u)) = Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:=
  span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant (braidInvariant_of_mul_ne_three h3) cs hu hw huw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_of_mul_ne_three
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_of_mul_ne_three {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    {i : I} (hi : cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.wordProd w) i) (t : ℕ) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i) * x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:=
  qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_of_braidInvariant (braidInvariant_of_mul_ne_three h3) cs hw hi t
    hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_of_mul_ne_three
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_of_mul_ne_three {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]

  span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant (braidInvariant_of_mul_ne_three h3) cs hw hw₀

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_span_pbwDiv_longest_of_mul_ne_three
statement:
theorem coe_span_pbwDiv_longest_of_mul_ne_three {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPlus_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientPlus_toQuotient (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientPlus R (toQuotient D 𝕧 x) = plusHom R 𝕧 x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPlus_injective
statement: theorem quotientPlus_injective : Function.Injective (quotientPlus R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  rw [toQuotient_eq_zero_iff, radical_eq_serreIdeal_ratFunc]
  exact (plusHom_eq_zero_iff R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root x).mp hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPlus_dividedPower
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientPlus_dividedPower (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    quotientPlus R (toQuotient D 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i))) =
      Modified.Ed R i n
proof:
:= by
  simp [Modified.Ed, qDivPow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_quotientIntegralForm_plus
statement:
theorem map_quotientIntegralForm_plus :
    (quotientIntegralForm D).map (quotientPlusIntegral R) =
      Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Modified.Ed R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientIntegralForm, AlgHom.map_adjoin]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨i, n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, ⟨n, ?_⟩⟩
    simp [quotientPlusIntegral, quotientIntegralGenerator, Modified.Ed, qDivPow]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
    refine ⟨quotientIntegralGenerator D i n, ⟨i, n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [quotientPlusIntegral, quotientIntegralGenerator, Modified.Ed, qDivPow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwDivSymm_mem_integralPlus
statement:
theorem pbwDivSymm_mem_integralPlus {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {w : List I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    pbwDivSymm R w c ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, AlgEquiv.one_apply] at hc
  generalize pbwDivSymm R w c = y at hc ⊢
  induction hc using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
    induction w' with
    | nil => exact one_mem _
    | cons a w' ih =>
      exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨a.1, ⟨a.2, rfl⟩⟩)) ih
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add _ _ _ _ ha hb => exact add_mem ha hb
  | neg _ _ ha => exact neg_mem ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.existsUnique_integralPBWPreimage
statement:
theorem existsUnique_integralPBWPreimage {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {w : List I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃! x : quotientIntegralForm D, quotientPlus R x = pbwDivSymm R w c
proof:
:= by
  have h := pbwDivSymm_mem_integralPlus R hw c
  rw [← map_quotientIntegralForm_plus R] at h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, he, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  exact Subtype.ext (quotientPlus_injective R (hy.trans he.symm))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage
statement:
theorem quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {w : List I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    quotientPlus R (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) = pbwDivSymm R w c
proof:
:=
  (existsUnique_integralPBWPreimage R hw c).exists.choose_spec

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.integralPBWPreimage_singleton
statement:
theorem integralPBWPreimage_singleton {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {i : I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced [i]) (c : Fin [i].length → ℕ) :
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) = quotientIntegralGenerator D i (c 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientPlus_injective R
  rw [quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage]
  simp [pbwDivSymm, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, quotientIntegralGenerator, Ed, qDivPow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.integralPBWPreimage_singleton_mem_lattice
statement:
theorem integralPBWPreimage_singleton_mem_lattice {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {i : I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced [i]) (c : Fin [i].length → ℕ) :
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralPBWPreimage_singleton]
  exact quotientIntegralGenerator_mem_lattice D i (c 0)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isCompl_otherWeights
statement:
lemma isCompl_otherWeights (χ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    IsCompl (adWeightSpace R v χ) (otherWeights R v χ)
proof:
:=
  isCompl_iff.2 ⟨disjoint_iff.2 (inf_otherWeights hv χ), codisjoint_iff.2 (sup_otherWeights χ)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.projW_of_mem
statement:
lemma projW_of_mem {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v} (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) :
    projW R hv χ x = x
proof:
:= by
  have := Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_left (isCompl_otherWeights (R := R) hv χ) ⟨x, hx⟩
  simp only [projW, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.projW_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma projW_of_mem_ne {χ χ' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : χ' ≠ χ) {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ') : projW R hv χ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ otherWeights R v χ :=
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem χ' (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem h hx)
  have := Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_right (isCompl_otherWeights (R := R) hv χ) hx'
  simp [projW, this]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_of_mem_aMinusW
statement:
lemma isGen_of_mem_aMinusW {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aMinusW R χ) :
    IsGen R x χ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, hc, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact (isGen_fPow w).smul hc
  | zero => exact isGen_zero χ
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact hx.add hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [← neg_one_smul 𝕂]; exact hx.smul isLaurent_neg_one

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_of_mem_aPlusW
statement:
lemma isGen_of_mem_aPlusW {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlusW R χ) :
    IsGen R x χ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, hc, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact (isGen_ePow w).smul hc
  | zero => exact isGen_zero χ
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact hx.add hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [← neg_one_smul 𝕂]; exact hx.smul isLaurent_neg_one

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.projW_mem_aMinusW
statement:
lemma projW_mem_aMinusW {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aMinus R) (χ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    projW R ratFunc_X_not_root χ x ∈ aMinusW R χ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, hc, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul]
    by_cases h : -wtW R w = χ
    · rw [projW_of_mem _ (h ▸ fPow_mem w)]
      exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c, w, hc, h, rfl⟩
    · rw [projW_of_mem_ne _ h (fPow_mem w), smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.projW_mem_aPlusW
statement:
lemma projW_mem_aPlusW {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlus R) (χ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    projW R ratFunc_X_not_root χ x ∈ aPlusW R χ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, hc, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul]
    by_cases h : wtW R w = χ
    · rw [projW_of_mem _ (h ▸ ePow_mem w)]
      exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c, w, hc, h, rfl⟩
    · rw [projW_of_mem_ne _ h (ePow_mem w), smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_of_mem_aMinus
statement:
lemma isGen_of_mem_aMinus {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aMinus R) {χ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hχ : x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ) : IsGen R x χ
proof:
:= by
  have := projW_mem_aMinusW hx χ
  rw [projW_of_mem _ hχ] at this
  exact isGen_of_mem_aMinusW this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isGen_of_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma isGen_of_mem_aPlus {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlus R) {χ : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hχ : x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ) : IsGen R x χ
proof:
:= by
  have := projW_mem_aPlusW hx χ
  rw [projW_of_mem _ hχ] at this
  exact isGen_of_mem_aPlusW this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.basis_repr_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma basis_repr_eq_zero_of_mem {ι : Type*} {S : Subalgebra 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)}
    (b : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 S) (w : ι → Y →+ ℤ)
    (hb : ∀ i, (b i : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (w i)) {χ : Y →+ ℤ} (y : S)
    (hy : (y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ) {i : ι} (hi : w i ≠ χ) :
    b.repr y i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := (b.repr y).support
  have hsum : y = ∑ i' ∈ A, b.repr y i' • b i' := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← b.linearCombination_repr y]
    rfl
  have hproj : (y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) =
      ∑ i' ∈ A, (if w i' = χ then b.repr y i' • (b i' : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) else 0) := by
    rw [← projW_of_mem ratFunc_X_not_root hy]
    conv_lhs => rw [hsum]
    rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, map_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun i' _ ↦ ?_
    rw [SetLike.val_smul, map_smul]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [projW_of_mem _ (h ▸ hb i')]
    · rw [projW_of_mem_ne _ h (hb i'), smul_zero]
  have hz : y = ∑ i' ∈ A.filter (fun i' ↦ w i' = χ), b.repr y i' • b i' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hproj, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, sum_filter]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun i' _ ↦ ?_
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hz, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  refine sum_eq_zero fun i' hi' ↦ ?_
  have hne : i' ≠ i := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hi (mem_filter.1 hi').2
  rw [map_smul, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne.symm,
    smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_mem_laurentCoords
proof:
:= fun t ↦ by
  simpa using hc.mul (hx t)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.basis_mem_laurentCoords
statement:
lemma basis_mem_laurentCoords {T : Type*} (B : Module.Basis T 𝕂 (Modified R 𝕧)) (t : T) :
    B t ∈ laurentCoords R B
proof:
:= fun t' ↦ by
  classical
  rw [Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs
  exacts [isLaurent_one, isLaurent_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triFun_mem_aForm
statement:
lemma triFun_mem_aForm (hbm : ∀ i, (bm i : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ aMinus R)
    (hbp : ∀ j, (bp j : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ aPlus R) (t : ι × (Y →+ ℤ) × κ) :
    triFun bm bp wm wp hm hp t ∈ aForm R
proof:
:=
  ((isGen_of_mem_aMinus (hbm t.1) (hm t.1)).mul (isGen_of_mem_aPlus (hbp t.2.2) (hp t.2.2))).elt_mem
    (by abel) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_fPow_ePow_mem_laurentCoords
statement:
lemma elt_fPow_ePow_mem_laurentCoords
    (hbmF : ∀ w i, IsLaurent (bm.repr ⟨fPow R w, fPow_mem_minus w⟩ i))
    (hbpE : ∀ w j, IsLaurent (bp.repr ⟨ePow R w, ePow_mem_plus w⟩ j))
    {w w' : List (I × ℕ)} {L l : Y →+ ℤ}
    (h : fPow R w * ePow R w' ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l)) :
    elt L l _ h ∈ laurentCoords R (triangularBasis ratFunc_X_not_root bm bp wm wp hm hp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hχ : L - l = wtW R w' - wtW R w
  swap
  · rw [elt_congr (eq_zero_of_mem_adWeightSpace (Ne.symm hχ) (fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w') h) h
      (zero_mem _), elt_zero']
    exact zero_mem _
  set a := bm.repr ⟨fPow R w, fPow_mem_minus w⟩
  set b := bp.repr ⟨ePow R w', ePow_mem_plus w'⟩
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 → wm i = wtW R w := fun i hi ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    exact hi (basis_repr_eq_zero_of_mem bm (fun i ↦ -wm i) hm ⟨fPow R w, fPow_mem_minus w⟩
      (fPow_mem w) (fun h' ↦ hne (neg_injective h')))
  have hb : ∀ j, b j ≠ 0 → wp j = wtW R w' := fun j hj ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    exact hj (basis_repr_eq_zero_of_mem bp wp hp ⟨ePow R w', ePow_mem_plus w'⟩ (ePow_mem w') hne)
  have hF : fPow R w = ∑ i ∈ a.support, a i • (bm i : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) := by
    have h0 := congrArg Subtype.val (bm.linearCombination_repr ⟨fPow R w, fPow_mem_minus w⟩)
    simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
      SetLike.val_smul] at h0
    exact h0.symm
  have hE : ePow R w' = ∑ j ∈ b.support, b j • (bp j : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) := by
    have h0 := congrArg Subtype.val (bp.linearCombination_repr ⟨ePow R w', ePow_mem_plus w'⟩)
    simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
      SetLike.val_smul] at h0
    exact h0.symm
  let g : ι × κ → QuantumGroup R 𝕧 := fun p ↦
    (a p.1 * b p.2) • ((bm p.1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) * bp p.2)
  have hg : ∀ p, g p ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l) := fun p ↦ by
    by_cases h0 : a p.1 * b p.2 = 0
    · simp only [g, h0, zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.1 h0
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      rw [hχ, ← ha p.1 h1, ← hb p.2 h2, sub_eq_neg_add]
      exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (hm p.1) (hp p.2)
  have hprod : fPow R w * ePow R w' = ∑ p ∈ a.support ×ˢ b.support, g p := by
    rw [hF, hE, sum_mul_sum, sum_product]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [g, smul_mul_smul_comm]
  rw [elt_congr hprod h (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun p _ ↦ hg p), elt_sum _ g hg]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun p _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases h0 : a p.1 * b p.2 = 0
  · rw [elt_congr (by simp only [g, h0, zero_smul]) (hg p) (zero_mem _), elt_zero']
    exact zero_mem _
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.1 h0
    have hmem := bm_mul_bp_mem bm bp wm wp hm hp p.1 (l + wp p.2) p.2
    have hmem' : (bm p.1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) * bp p.2 ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l) := by
      rw [hχ, ← ha p.1 h1, ← hb p.2 h2, sub_eq_neg_add]
      exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (hm p.1) (hp p.2)
    rw [elt_smul _ _ _ hmem']
    refine smul_mem_laurentCoords ((hbmF w p.1).mul (hbpE w' p.2)) ?_
    have e : elt L l _ hmem' = triangularBasis ratFunc_X_not_root bm bp wm wp hm hp
        (p.1, l + wp p.2, p.2) := by
      rw [triangularBasis_apply, triFun]
      refine elt_index ?_ ?_ rfl _ _
      · change L = l + wp p.2 - wm p.1
        rw [ha p.1 h1, hb p.2 h2, add_sub_assoc, ← hχ]; abel
      · change l = l + wp p.2 - wp p.2
        abel
    rw [e]
    exact basis_mem_laurentCoords _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mem_laurentCoords_of_mem_aForm
statement:
lemma mem_laurentCoords_of_mem_aForm
    (hbmF : ∀ w i, IsLaurent (bm.repr ⟨fPow R w, fPow_mem_minus w⟩ i))
    (hbpE : ∀ w j, IsLaurent (bp.repr ⟨ePow R w, ePow_mem_plus w⟩ j))
    {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aForm R) :
    x ∈ laurentCoords R (triangularBasis ratFunc_X_not_root bm bp wm wp hm hp)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ aFormFE R := by rw [← aForm_eq_aFormFE]; exact hx
  clear hx
  induction hx' using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact elt_fPow_ePow_mem_laurentCoords bm bp wm wp hm hp hbmF hbpE h
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul]; exact smul_mem_laurentCoords ⟨a, rfl⟩ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aTriangularBasis_apply
statement:
lemma aTriangularBasis_apply (hbm : ∀ i, (bm i : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ aMinus R)
    (hbp : ∀ j, (bp j : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ aPlus R)
    (hbmF : ∀ w i, IsLaurent (bm.repr ⟨fPow R w, fPow_mem_minus w⟩ i))
    (hbpE : ∀ w j, IsLaurent (bp.repr ⟨ePow R w, ePow_mem_plus w⟩ j)) (t : ι × (Y →+ ℤ) × κ) :
    (aTriangularBasis bm bp wm wp hm hp hbm hbp hbmF hbpE t : Modified R 𝕧) =
      triFun bm bp wm wp hm hp t
proof:
:= by
  simp [aTriangularBasis, triangularBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_adWeightSpace_sub_sub
proof:
:= by
  rw [show l₁ - (l₂ - χ) = (l₁ - l₂) + χ by abel]
  exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_modRel_sub
proof:
:=
  mul_mem_modRel_left ha (by rwa [sub_sub_cancel])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ractHom_elt
statement:
lemma ractHom_elt (χ : Y →+ ℤ) (b : adWeightSpace R v χ) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ)
    {t : QuantumGroup R v} (ht : t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    ractHom χ b (elt l₁ l₂ t ht) =
      elt l₁ (l₂ - χ) (t * b.1) (mul_mem_adWeightSpace_sub_sub ht b.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ractHom, LinearMap.flip_apply, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.compr₂_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.rightAct_elt
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightAct, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, adDecompose_of_mem hv hu,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof, ractHom_elt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.rightAct_mul
statement:
theorem rightAct_mul (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (u u' : QuantumGroup R v)
    (x : Modified R v) :
    rightAct R v hv (u * u') x = rightAct R v hv u' (rightAct R v hv u x)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd a b ha hb => simp only [add_mul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]
  | hhom χ a ha =>
  induction u' using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd b c hb hc => simp only [mul_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hb, hc]
  | hhom χ' b hb =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | helt l₁ l₂ t ht =>
    rw [rightAct_elt hv (mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hb), rightAct_elt hv ha, rightAct_elt hv hb]
    exact elt_index rfl (by abel) (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.rightAct_one
statement:
theorem rightAct_one (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (x : Modified R v) :
    rightAct R v hv 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | helt l₁ l₂ t ht =>
    rw [rightAct_elt hv one_mem_adWeightSpace]
    exact elt_index rfl (sub_zero l₂) (mul_one t) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidPrime_elt
statement:
lemma braidPrime_elt (i : I) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (hu' : braidPrimeEquiv R hv i u ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (l₁.comp (reflY R i) - l₂.comp (reflY R i))) :
    braidPrime hv i (elt l₁ l₂ u hu) =
      elt (l₁.comp (reflY R i)) (l₂.comp (reflY R i)) (braidPrimeEquiv R hv i u) hu'
proof:
:= by
  change map (braidPrimeAut hv i) _ = _
  rw [map_elt]
  exact elt_index (by ext μ; simp [braidPrimeAut]) (by ext μ; simp [braidPrimeAut]) rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidPrime_mul
statement:
lemma braidPrime_mul (i : I) (x y : Modified R v) :
    braidPrime hv i (x * y) = braidPrime hv i x * braidPrime hv i y
proof:
:=
  mapHom_mul _ x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidPrime_one
statement:
lemma braidPrime_one (i : I) (l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    braidPrime (R := R) hv i (one l) = one (l.comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, braidPrime_elt hv i l l _
    (by rw [_root_.map_one, sub_self]; exact one_mem_adWeightSpace), one]
  exact elt_congr (_root_.map_one _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidPrime_symm_elt
statement:
lemma braidPrime_symm_elt (i : I) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (hu' : (braidPrimeEquiv R hv i).symm u ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (l₁.comp (reflY R i) - l₂.comp (reflY R i))) :
    (braidPrime hv i).symm (elt l₁ l₂ u hu) =
      elt (l₁.comp (reflY R i)) (l₂.comp (reflY R i)) ((braidPrimeEquiv R hv i).symm u) hu'
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ l : Y →+ ℤ, (l.comp (reflY R i)).comp (reflY R i) = l := fun l ↦ by
    ext μ; simp
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, braidPrime_elt hv i _ _ hu' (by
    rw [hc, hc, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]; exact hu)]
  exact elt_index (hc l₁).symm (hc l₂).symm (AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _).symm _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidPrime_eq_map_omega
statement:
lemma braidPrime_eq_map_omega (i : I) (x : Modified R 𝕧) :
    braidPrime ratFunc_X_not_root i x =
      map (omegaAut R) (braid ratFunc_X_not_root i (map (omegaAut R) x))
proof:
:= by
  have h : braidPrimeAut (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root i =
      omegaAut R * braidAut ratFunc_X_not_root i * omegaAut R :=
    torusAut_ext ratFunc_X_not_root (by ext u; rfl)
  change map _ x = map _ (map _ (map _ x))
  rw [map_map, map_map, h, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidPrime_mem_aForm
statement:
theorem braidPrime_mem_aForm (i : I) {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aForm R) :
    braidPrime ratFunc_X_not_root i x ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidPrime_eq_map_omega]
  exact map_omega_mem_aForm (braid_mem_aForm i (map_omega_mem_aForm hx))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidPrime_symm_mem_aForm
statement:
theorem braidPrime_symm_mem_aForm (i : I) {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aForm R) :
    (braidPrime ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm x ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  have e : (braidPrime (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm x =
      map (omegaAut R) ((braid ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm (map (omegaAut R) x)) := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, braidPrime_eq_map_omega, map_omega_map_omega,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_omega_map_omega]
  rw [e]
  exact map_omega_mem_aForm (braid_symm_mem_aForm i (map_omega_mem_aForm hx))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isLaurent_sign_pow
statement: lemma isLaurent_sign_pow (e m : ℤ) (t : ℕ) : IsLaurent (((-1 : 𝕂) ^ e * 𝕧 ^ m) ^ t)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsLaurent.pow (IsLaurent.mul ?_ (isLaurent_zpow m)) t
  rcases Int.even_or_odd e with he | he
  · rw [he.neg_one_zpow]; exact isLaurent_one
  · rw [he.neg_one_zpow]; exact isLaurent_neg_one

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_braidPrime_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
statement:
theorem list_braidPrime_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
    {W : Type*} [Group W] {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W}
    {ω : List I} {i : I} (hω : cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i])) (t : ℕ) :
    (ω.map (braidPrimeEquiv R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈
      aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, m, h⟩ := exists_list_braidPrime_qDivPow_E (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root ω i
  rw [h]
  exact smul_mem_aPlus (isLaurent_sign_pow e m t) (list_braid_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus hω t)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_braidPrime_symm_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
statement:
theorem list_braidPrime_symm_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
    {W : Type*} [Group W] {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W}
    {ω : List I} {i : I} (hω : cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i])) (t : ℕ) :
    (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidPrimeEquiv R ratFunc_X_not_root j).symm).prod
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈ aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, m, h⟩ := exists_list_braidPrime_symm_qDivPow_E (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root ω i
  rw [h]
  exact smul_mem_aPlus (isLaurent_sign_pow e m t) (list_braid_symm_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus hω t)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.formFunctional_rho_mul_eq_zero_left
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := NeZero.ne v
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · have hub : rho R v u * b ∈ adWeightSpace R v 0 := by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (rho_mem_adWeightSpace hu) hb
      rw [rho_mul, map_sub, rho_K, rho_algebraMap, mul_sub, sub_mul,
        ← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def, smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul, mul_assoc,
        hb μ, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, map_smul, formFunctional_mul_K, smul_eq_mul,
        smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hv0, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_add_cancel,
        sub_self]
    · have hub : rho R v u * b ∈ adWeightSpace R v 0 := by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (rho_mem_adWeightSpace hu) hb
      rw [rho_mul, map_sub, rho_K, rho_algebraMap, sub_mul, sub_mul, mul_assoc,
        mul_assoc, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_sub, map_smul, formFunctional_K_mul hv _ hub,
        smul_eq_mul, sub_self]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, add_mul, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.formFunctional_rho_mul_eq_zero_right
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := NeZero.ne v
  have ha' := rho_mem_adWeightSpace ha
  induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · have hau : rho R v a * u ∈ adWeightSpace R v 0 := by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha' hu
      rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, ← Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul_comm, map_sub,
        map_smul, ← mul_assoc, mul_K_of_mem_adWeightSpace ha', smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
        map_smul, formFunctional_K_mul hv _ hau, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
        ← zpow_add₀ hv0]
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, neg_neg, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_add_cancel,
        sub_self]
    · rw [mul_sub, mul_sub, ← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul, formFunctional_mul_K, smul_eq_mul, sub_self]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.formEltAux_apply
statement:
lemma formEltAux_apply (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (a b : adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2)) :
    formEltAux R v hv p a b = formFunctional R v hv p.2 (rho R v a.1 * b.1)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.formComp_mk
statement:
lemma formComp_mk (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (a b : adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2)) :
    formComp R v hv p (Comp.mk R v p a) (Comp.mk R v p b) =
      formFunctional R v hv p.2 (rho R v a.1 * b.1)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_elt_elt_self
statement:
lemma form_elt_elt_self (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {a b : QuantumGroup R v}
    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) (hb : b ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    form R v hv (elt l₁ l₂ a ha) (elt l₁ l₂ b hb) =
      formFunctional R v hv l₂ (rho R v a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [form, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.compl₂_apply, elt, DirectSum.component.lof_self]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_elt_elt_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  rw [form, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.compl₂_apply, elt, DirectSum.component.of]
  split_ifs with h'
  · exact absurd h' (Ne.symm h)
  · exact map_zero _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_elt_elt
statement:
lemma form_elt_elt {l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {a b : QuantumGroup R v}
    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) (hb : b ∈ adWeightSpace R v (m₁ - m₂)) :
    form R v hv (elt l₁ l₂ a ha) (elt m₁ m₂ b hb) =
      if (l₁, l₂) = (m₁, m₂) then formFunctional R v hv l₂ (rho R v a * b) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
    exact form_elt_elt_self hv l₁ l₂ ha hb
  · exact form_elt_elt_of_ne hv h ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_mul_one
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
    rw [one_mul_elt, elt_mul_one]
  · by_cases h₁ : l₁ = m₁
    · subst h₁
      have h₂ : m₂ ≠ l₂ := fun h₂ ↦ h (by rw [h₂])
      rw [one_mul_elt, one, elt_mul_elt_of_ne h₂]
    · rw [one, elt_mul_elt_of_ne h₁, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem form_one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero {l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : Y →+ ℤ} (h : (l₁, l₂) ≠ (m₁, m₂))
    (x y : Modified R v) : form R v hv (one l₁ * x * one l₂) (one m₁ * y * one m₂) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => rw [mul_add', add_mul', map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx', add_zero]
  | helt a₁ a₂ a ha =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add', add_mul', map_add, hy, hy', add_zero]
  | helt b₁ b₂ b hb =>
    rw [one_mul_mul_one, one_mul_mul_one]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · rw [form_elt_elt_of_ne hv (by rwa [← h₁, ← h₂])]
    all_goals simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_leftAct_left
statement:
theorem form_leftAct_left (u : QuantumGroup R v) (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (leftAct R v hv u x) y = form R v hv x (leftAct R v hv (rho R v u) y)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd u u' hu hu' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hu']
  | hhom χ u hu =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ a ha =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, hy, hy']
  | helt m₁ m₂ b hb =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv hu, leftAct_elt hv (rho_mem_adWeightSpace hu), form_elt_elt,
      form_elt_elt, rho_mul, mul_assoc]
    have : ((l₁ + χ, l₂) = (m₁, m₂)) ↔ ((l₁, l₂) = (m₁ + -χ, m₂)) := by
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; exact ⟨by abel, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; exact ⟨by abel, rfl⟩
    simp only [this]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_minusHom_leftAct_one
statement:
theorem form_minusHom_leftAct_one (l : Y →+ ℤ) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    form R v hv (leftAct R v hv (minusHom R v x) (one l))
      (leftAct R v hv (minusHom R v y) (one l)) = LusztigF.form D v x y
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((form R v hv).compl₁₂ (leftAct R v hv ∘ₗ (minusHom R v).toLinearMap |>.flip (one l))
      (leftAct R v hv ∘ₗ (minusHom R v).toLinearMap |>.flip (one l))) = LusztigF.form D v :=
    LinearMap.ext_basis (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) fun w w' ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, wordBasis_eq_monomial]
      rw [one, leftAct_elt hv (minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w),
        leftAct_elt hv (minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w'), form_elt_elt]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [mul_one, mul_one, ← mul_one (minusHom R v (monomial k w')), ← K_zero R v,
          ← mul_assoc, formFunctional_rho_minusHom, map_zero, zpow_zero, one_mul]
      · refine (LusztigF.form_eq_zero_of_ne D v (fun hw ↦ h ?_) (monomial_mem_weightSpace w)
          (monomial_mem_weightSpace w')).symm
        rw [wordChar_eq_rootSum, wordChar_eq_rootSum, hw]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_of_one_leftAct
statement:
theorem eq_of_one_leftAct {B B' : Modified R v →ₗ[k] Modified R v →ₗ[k] k}
    (ha : ∀ l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂, (l₁, l₂) ≠ (m₁, m₂) → ∀ x y,
      B (one l₁ * x * one l₂) (one m₁ * y * one m₂) = 0)
    (ha' : ∀ l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂, (l₁, l₂) ≠ (m₁, m₂) → ∀ x y,
      B' (one l₁ * x * one l₂) (one m₁ * y * one m₂) = 0)
    (hb : ∀ u x y, B (leftAct R v hv u x) y = B x (leftAct R v hv (rho R v u) y))
    (hb' : ∀ u x y, B' (leftAct R v hv u x) y = B' x (leftAct R v hv (rho R v u) y))
    (h : ∀ ζ z, B (one ζ) (leftAct R v hv z (one ζ)) = B' (one ζ) (leftAct R v hv z (one ζ))) :
    B = B'
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ LinearMap.ext fun y ↦ ?_
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ a hA =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, hy, hy']
  | helt m₁ m₂ b hB =>
    by_cases hlm : (l₁, l₂) = (m₁, m₂)
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hlm
      have hz : rho R v a * b ∈ adWeightSpace R v ((l₂ + 0) - l₂) := by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (rho_mem_adWeightSpace hA) hB
      have e : leftAct R v hv (rho R v a) (elt l₁ l₂ b hB) =
          leftAct R v hv (rho R v a * b) (one l₂) := by
        rw [leftAct_mul, leftAct_one_eq_elt hv hB]
      rw [← leftAct_one_eq_elt hv hA, hb, hb', e, h]
    · have e₁ := one_mul_mul_one l₁ l₂ l₁ l₂ hA
      have e₂ := one_mul_mul_one m₁ m₂ m₁ m₂ hB
      simp only [↓reduceIte] at e₁ e₂
      rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ha _ _ _ _ hlm, ha' _ _ _ _ hlm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional
statement:
theorem one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional {B : Modified R v →ₗ[k] Modified R v →ₗ[k] k}
    (hb : ∀ u x y, B (leftAct R v hv u x) y = B x (leftAct R v hv (rho R v u) y))
    (hc : ∀ l x y, B (leftAct R v hv (minusHom R v x) (one l))
      (leftAct R v hv (minusHom R v y) (one l)) = LusztigF.form D v x y)
    (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (z : QuantumGroup R v) :
    B (one ζ) (leftAct R v hv z (one ζ)) = formFunctional R v hv ζ z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using induction_rho_minusHom with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | hsmul c x hx => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, map_smul, hx]
  | hmon w w' μ =>
    have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (ζ - ζ) := by
      rw [sub_self]; exact one_mem_adWeightSpace
    have h2 : K R v μ * 1 ∈ adWeightSpace R v (ζ - ζ) := by
      rw [sub_self, mul_one]; exact K_mem_adWeightSpace μ
    have hK : leftAct R v hv (K R v μ) (one ζ) = v ^ ζ μ • one ζ := by
      rw [one, leftAct_elt hv (K_mem_adWeightSpace μ), elt_index (add_zero ζ) rfl rfl _ h2,
        elt_K_mul ζ ζ μ h1 h2]
    rw [leftAct_mul, leftAct_mul, hK, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, ← hb, hc,
      formFunctional_rho_minusHom, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_form
statement:
theorem eq_form {B : Modified R v →ₗ[k] Modified R v →ₗ[k] k}
    (ha : ∀ l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂, (l₁, l₂) ≠ (m₁, m₂) → ∀ x y,
      B (one l₁ * x * one l₂) (one m₁ * y * one m₂) = 0)
    (hb : ∀ u x y, B (leftAct R v hv u x) y = B x (leftAct R v hv (rho R v u) y))
    (hc : ∀ l x y, B (leftAct R v hv (minusHom R v x) (one l))
      (leftAct R v hv (minusHom R v y) (one l)) = LusztigF.form D v x y) :
    B = form R v hv
proof:
:=
  eq_of_one_leftAct hv ha (fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ form_one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero hv h) hb
    (form_leftAct_left hv) fun ζ z ↦ by
      rw [one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional hv hb hc, one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional hv
        (form_leftAct_left hv) (form_minusHom_leftAct_one hv)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_comm
statement: theorem form_comm (x y : Modified R v) : form R v hv x y = form R v hv y x
proof:
:= by
  have h := eq_form hv (B := (form R v hv).flip)
    (fun _ _ _ _ h x y ↦ form_one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero hv (Ne.symm h) y x)
    (fun u x y ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, form_leftAct_left, rho_rho])
    (fun l x y ↦ by rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, form_minusHom_leftAct_one, LusztigF.form_comm])
  exact (LinearMap.flip_apply _ _ _).symm.trans (LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h y x)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_mem_adWeightSpace
statement: lemma K_mem_adWeightSpace (μ : Y) : K R v μ ∈ adWeightSpace R v 0
proof:
:= fun ν ↦ by
  rw [K_add, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_smul, K_add, add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algebraMap_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mem_adWeightSpace (c : k) :
    algebraMap k (QuantumGroup R v) c ∈ adWeightSpace R v 0
proof:
:= fun ν ↦ by
  rw [AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_smul, Algebra.commutes]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.one_mem_adWeightSpace
statement: lemma one_mem_adWeightSpace : (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ adWeightSpace R v 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using algebraMap_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) (v := v) 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma pow_mem_adWeightSpace {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ n ∈ adWeightSpace R v (n • χ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, succ_nsmul]; exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace ih hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_K_of_mem_adWeightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx μ, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sub_mem_adWeightSpace_zero
statement:
lemma sub_mem_adWeightSpace_zero (μ : Y) (c : k) :
    K R v μ - algebraMap k (QuantumGroup R v) c ∈ adWeightSpace R v 0
proof:
:=
  sub_mem (K_mem_adWeightSpace μ) (algebraMap_mem_adWeightSpace c)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modRel_le
statement: lemma modRel_le (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) : modRel R v l₁ l₂ ≤ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro x (⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩)
  · simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (sub_mem_adWeightSpace_zero μ (v ^ l₁ μ)) hu
  · simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hu (sub_mem_adWeightSpace_zero μ (v ^ l₂ μ))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_modRel_left
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · refine Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨μ, u * b, ?_, by rw [mul_assoc]⟩)
      simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hu hb
    · have hub : u * b ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₃) := by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hu hb
      have e : u * (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₂ μ)) * b =
          v ^ ((l₂ - l₃) μ) • (u * b * (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₃ μ))) := by
        have hc : v ^ ((l₂ - l₃) μ) * v ^ l₃ μ = v ^ l₂ μ := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_add_cancel]
        have hKb := hb μ
        simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, hKb,
          mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_one, smul_sub, smul_smul, hc]
      rw [e]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, u * b, hub, rfl⟩))
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_modRel_right
proof:
:= by
  induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · have hau : a * u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₃) := by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hu
      have e : a * ((K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₂ μ)) * u) =
          v ^ (-(l₁ - l₂) μ) • ((K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₁ μ)) * (a * u)) := by
        have hc : v ^ (-(l₁ - l₂) μ) * v ^ l₁ μ = v ^ l₂ μ := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), AddMonoidHom.sub_apply]; ring_nf
        have haK := mul_K_of_mem_adWeightSpace ha μ
        simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, ← mul_assoc, haK,
          mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul, hc]
      rw [e]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨μ, a * u, hau, rfl⟩))
    · refine Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, a * u, ?_, by rw [mul_assoc]⟩)
      simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hu
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Comp.mk_surjective
statement:
lemma Modified.Comp.mk_surjective (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) :
    Function.Surjective (Modified.Comp.mk R v p)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Comp.mk_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Modified.Comp.mk_eq_zero {p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)} {x : adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2)} :
    Modified.Comp.mk R v p x = 0 ↔ x.1 ∈ modRel R v p.1 p.2
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.compMul_aux₁
statement:
lemma compMul_aux₁ (l₁ l₂ l₃ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    (modRel R v l₂ l₃).comap (adWeightSpace R v (l₂ - l₃)).subtype ≤
      LinearMap.ker ((mulAux (R := R) (v := v) l₁ l₂ l₃).compr₂ (Submodule.mkQ
        ((modRel R v l₁ l₃).comap (adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₃)).subtype))).flip
proof:
:= fun b hb ↦ by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  ext a
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (mul_mem_modRel_right a.2 hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.compMul_aux₂
statement:
lemma compMul_aux₂ (l₁ l₂ l₃ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    (modRel R v l₁ l₂).comap (adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)).subtype ≤
      LinearMap.ker (Submodule.liftQ _ _ (compMul_aux₁ (R := R) (v := v) l₁ l₂ l₃)).flip
proof:
:=
  fun a ha ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    ext b
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (mul_mem_modRel_left ha b.2)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.compMul_mk
statement:
lemma compMul_mk (l₁ l₂ l₃ : Y →+ ℤ) (a : adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (b : adWeightSpace R v (l₂ - l₃)) :
    compMul l₁ l₂ l₃ (Comp.mk R v (l₁, l₂) a) (Comp.mk R v (l₂, l₃) b) =
      Comp.mk R v (l₁, l₃) (mulAux l₁ l₂ l₃ a b)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mulComp_self
statement:
lemma mulComp_self (l₁ l₂ l₄ : Y →+ ℤ) (x : Comp R v (l₁, l₂)) (y : Comp R v (l₂, l₄)) :
    mulComp (l₁, l₂) (l₂, l₄) x y =
      DirectSum.lof k _ (Comp R v) (l₁, l₄) (compMul l₁ l₂ l₄ x y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mulComp, LinearMap.compr₂_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mulComp_of_ne
statement:
lemma mulComp_of_ne {l₁ l₂ l₃ l₄ : Y →+ ℤ} (h : l₂ ≠ l₃) (x : Comp R v (l₁, l₂))
    (y : Comp R v (l₃, l₄)) : mulComp (l₁, l₂) (l₃, l₄) x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [mulComp, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_def
statement: lemma mul_def (x y : Modified R v) : x * y = mulBil R v x y
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.lof_mul_lof
statement:
lemma lof_mul_lof (p q : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (x : Comp R v p) (y : Comp R v q) :
    (DirectSum.lof k _ (Comp R v) p x : Modified R v) * DirectSum.lof k _ (Comp R v) q y =
      mulComp p q x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_def, mulBil, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.flip_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    LinearMap.flip_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_mul_elt
statement:
lemma elt_mul_elt (l₁ l₂ l₃ : Y →+ ℤ) {a b : QuantumGroup R v}
    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) (hb : b ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₂ - l₃)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ a ha * elt l₂ l₃ b hb =
      elt l₁ l₃ (a * b) (by simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt, elt, lof_mul_lof, mulComp_self, compMul_mk]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_mul_elt_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt, elt, lof_mul_lof, mulComp_of_ne h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_add
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt, elt, elt, ← map_add, ← map_add]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_smul
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt, elt, ← map_smul, ← map_smul]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_congr
statement:
lemma elt_congr {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {a b : QuantumGroup R v} (h : a = b)
    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) (hb : b ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ a ha = elt l₁ l₂ b hb
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_eq_zero
statement:
lemma elt_eq_zero {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {a : QuantumGroup R v} (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (h : a ∈ modRel R v l₁ l₂) : elt l₁ l₂ a ha = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt, (Comp.mk_eq_zero (p := (l₁, l₂)) (x := ⟨a, ha⟩)).2 h, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_K_mul
statement:
lemma elt_K_mul (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) {a : QuantumGroup R v}
    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (hKa : K R v μ * a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ (K R v μ * a) hKa = v ^ l₁ μ • elt l₁ l₂ a ha
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₁ μ)) * a ∈ modRel R v l₁ l₂ :=
    Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨μ, a, ha, rfl⟩)
  have h : K R v μ * a = (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₁ μ)) * a + v ^ l₁ μ • a := by
    rw [sub_mul, Algebra.smul_def]; abel
  rw [elt_congr h _ (add_mem (modRel_le _ _ hm) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha)),
    elt_add _ _ (modRel_le _ _ hm) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha), elt_eq_zero _ hm, zero_add,
    elt_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_mul_K
statement:
lemma elt_mul_K (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) {a : QuantumGroup R v}
