    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (haK : a * K R v μ ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ (a * K R v μ) haK = v ^ l₂ μ • elt l₁ l₂ a ha
proof:
:= by
  have hm : a * (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₂ μ)) ∈ modRel R v l₁ l₂ :=
    Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, a, ha, rfl⟩)
  have h : a * K R v μ = a * (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₂ μ)) + v ^ l₂ μ • a := by
    rw [mul_sub, ← Algebra.commutes, Algebra.smul_def]; abel
  rw [elt_congr h _ (add_mem (modRel_le _ _ hm) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha)),
    elt_add _ _ (modRel_le _ _ hm) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha), elt_eq_zero _ hm, zero_add,
    elt_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_index
statement:
lemma elt_index {l₁ l₂ l₁' l₂' : Y →+ ℤ} (h₁ : l₁ = l₁') (h₂ : l₂ = l₂')
    {a b : QuantumGroup R v} (hab : a = b) (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (hb : b ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁' - l₂')) : elt l₁ l₂ a ha = elt l₁' l₂' b hb
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂ hab; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {P : Modified R v → Prop} (x : Modified R v) (h0 : P 0)
    (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (helt : ∀ l₁ l₂ u (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)), P (elt l₁ l₂ u hu)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact h0
  | of p y =>
    obtain ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, rfl⟩ := Comp.mk_surjective R v p y
    simpa [elt, DirectSum.lof_eq_of] using helt p.1 p.2 u hu
  | add x y hx hy => exact hadd x y hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.add_mul'
statement: lemma add_mul' (x y z : Modified R v) : (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_def, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_add'
statement: lemma mul_add' (x y z : Modified R v) : x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_def, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.zero_mul'
statement: lemma zero_mul' (x : Modified R v) : 0 * x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_def, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_zero'
statement: lemma mul_zero' (x : Modified R v) : x * 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_def, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_mul'
statement: lemma smul_mul' (c : k) (x y : Modified R v) : (c • x) * y = c • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_def, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_smul'
statement: lemma mul_smul' (c : k) (x y : Modified R v) : x * (c • y) = c • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_def, map_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_assoc'
statement: lemma mul_assoc' (x y z : Modified R v) : x * y * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [zero_mul']
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul', add_mul', hx, hx', add_mul']
  | helt a b u hu =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [mul_zero', zero_mul']
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add', add_mul', hy, hy', add_mul', mul_add']
  | helt c d w hw =>
  induction z using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [mul_zero']
  | hadd z z' hz hz' => rw [mul_add', hz, hz', mul_add', mul_add']
  | helt e f t ht =>
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst hbc
    by_cases hde : d = e
    · subst hde
      rw [elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt]
      exact elt_congr (mul_assoc _ _ _) _ _
    · rw [elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt_of_ne hde, elt_mul_elt_of_ne hde, mul_zero']
  · rw [elt_mul_elt_of_ne hbc, zero_mul']
    by_cases hde : d = e
    · subst hde
      rw [elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt_of_ne hbc]
    · rw [elt_mul_elt_of_ne hde, mul_zero']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_elt
statement:
lemma one_mul_elt (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) : one l₁ * elt l₁ l₂ u hu = elt l₁ l₂ u hu
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, elt_mul_elt]
  exact elt_congr (one_mul u) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_mul_one
statement:
lemma elt_mul_one (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) : elt l₁ l₂ u hu * one l₂ = elt l₁ l₂ u hu
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, elt_mul_elt]
  exact elt_congr (mul_one u) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_one_self
statement: lemma one_mul_one_self (l : Y →+ ℤ) : one (R := R) (v := v) l * one l = one l
proof:
:=
  elt_mul_one _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_one_of_ne
statement: lemma one_mul_one_of_ne {l l' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : l ≠ l') : one (R := R) (v := v) l * one l' = 0
proof:
:=
  elt_mul_elt_of_ne h _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.autY_apply_inv
statement: lemma autY_apply_inv (g : Y ≃ₗ[ℤ] Y) (μ : Y) : g (g⁻¹ μ) = μ
proof: := g.apply_symm_apply μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.autY_inv_apply
statement: lemma autY_inv_apply (g : Y ≃ₗ[ℤ] Y) (μ : Y) : g⁻¹ (g μ) = μ
proof: := g.symm_apply_apply μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.autY_mul_apply
statement: lemma autY_mul_apply (g h : Y ≃ₗ[ℤ] Y) (μ : Y) : (g * h) μ = g (h μ)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma wt_apply (g : torusAut R v) (l : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) : wt g l μ = l (g.1.2⁻¹ μ)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_injective
statement: lemma wt_injective (g : torusAut R v) : Function.Injective (wt g)
proof:
:= fun l l' h ↦ by
  ext μ
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun h (g.1.2 μ)
  simpa [autY_inv_apply] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_mul
statement: lemma wt_mul (g h : torusAut R v) (l : Y →+ ℤ) : wt g (wt h l) = wt (g * h) l
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [wt_apply, Subgroup.coe_mul, Prod.snd_mul, mul_inv_rev, autY_mul_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_one
statement: lemma wt_one (l : Y →+ ℤ) : wt (1 : torusAut R v) l = l
proof:
:= by
  ext μ; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma map_mem_adWeightSpace (g : torusAut R v) {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) : g.1.1 x ∈ adWeightSpace R v (wt g χ)
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h := congrArg g.1.1 (hx (g.1.2⁻¹ μ))
  rw [_root_.map_mul, map_smul, _root_.map_mul, g.2, autY_apply_inv] at h
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_mem_adWeightSpace_sub
proof:
:=
  map_mem_adWeightSpace g hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_mem_modRel
statement:
lemma map_mem_modRel (g : torusAut R v) {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ modRel R v l₁ l₂) : g.1.1 x ∈ modRel R v (wt g l₁) (wt g l₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · refine Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨g.1.2 μ, g.1.1 u, map_mem_adWeightSpace_sub g hu, ?_⟩)
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, g.2, AlgEquiv.commutes, wt_apply, autY_inv_apply]
    · refine Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨g.1.2 μ, g.1.1 u, map_mem_adWeightSpace_sub g hu, ?_⟩)
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, g.2, AlgEquiv.commutes, wt_apply, autY_inv_apply]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_elt
statement:
lemma map_elt (g : torusAut R v) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    map g (elt l₁ l₂ u hu) =
      elt (wt g l₁) (wt g l₂) (g.1.1 u) (map_mem_adWeightSpace_sub g hu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_mul
statement: lemma map_mul (g : torusAut R v) (x y : Modified R v) : map g (x * y) = map g x * map g y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero]
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, add_mul]
  | helt a b u hu =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, mul_add]
  | helt c d w hw =>
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst hbc
    rw [elt_mul_elt, map_elt, map_elt, map_elt, elt_mul_elt]
    exact elt_congr (_root_.map_mul _ _ _) _ _
  · rw [elt_mul_elt_of_ne hbc, map_zero, map_elt, map_elt,
      elt_mul_elt_of_ne fun h ↦ hbc (wt_injective g h)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_map
statement: lemma map_map (g h : torusAut R v) (x : Modified R v) : map g (map h x) = map (g * h) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [map_zero]
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]
  | helt a b u hu =>
    rw [map_elt, map_elt, map_elt]
    exact elt_index (wt_mul g h a) (wt_mul g h b) rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_one
statement: lemma map_one (x : Modified R v) : map (1 : torusAut R v) x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [map_zero]
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]
  | helt a b u hu =>
    rw [map_elt]
    exact elt_index (wt_one a) (wt_one b) rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mapHom_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma mapHom_apply (g : torusAut R v) (x : Modified R v) : mapHom R v g x = map g x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mapHom_mul
statement:
lemma mapHom_mul (g : torusAut R v) (x y : Modified R v) :
    mapHom R v g (x * y) = mapHom R v g x * mapHom R v g y
proof:
:=
  map_mul g x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.K_injective
statement: lemma K_injective {μ ν : Y} (h : K R v μ = K R v ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  have h' : zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ 1) =
      zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.single ν 1) := by
    simpa [zeroHom, AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single] using h
  exact (AddMonoidAlgebra.single_left_inj one_ne_zero).1 (zeroHom_injective R v hv h')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.torusAut_ext
statement: lemma torusAut_ext {g h : torusAut R v} (h₁ : g.1.1 = h.1.1) : g = h
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h₁ (LinearEquiv.ext fun μ ↦ K_injective hv (by
    rw [← g.2 μ, ← h.2 μ, h₁])))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.reflAut_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma reflAut_apply (i : I) (μ : Y) : reflAut R i μ = reflY R i μ
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.reflAut_inv_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma reflAut_inv_apply (i : I) (μ : Y) : (reflAut R i)⁻¹ μ = reflY R i μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reflY_reflY (R := R) i ((reflAut R i)⁻¹ μ)]
  exact congrArg (reflY R i) (autY_apply_inv (reflAut R i) μ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_braidAut
statement: lemma wt_braidAut (i : I) (l : Y →+ ℤ) : wt (braidAut (R := R) hv i) l = l.comp (reflY R i)
proof:
:= by
  ext μ; simp [braidAut]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidAut_wordProd
statement:
lemma braidAut_wordProd (ω : List I) :
    ((ω.map (braidAut hv)).prod : torusAut R v).1.1 =
      (ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a ω ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Subgroup.coe_mul, Prod.fst_mul, ih]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isBraidLiftable_braidAut
statement:
theorem isBraidLiftable_braidAut :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braidAut (R := R) hv)
proof:
:= fun i j hij hm ↦
  torusAut_ext hv (by
    rw [braidAut_wordProd, braidAut_wordProd]
    exact isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i j hij hm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_elt
statement:
lemma braid_elt (i : I) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (hu' : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i u ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (l₁.comp (reflY R i) - l₂.comp (reflY R i))) :
    braid hv i (elt l₁ l₂ u hu) =
      elt (l₁.comp (reflY R i)) (l₂.comp (reflY R i)) (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i u) hu'
proof:
:= by
  rw [braid, mapHom_apply, map_elt]
  exact elt_index (wt_braidAut hv i l₁) (wt_braidAut hv i l₂) rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_mul
statement: lemma braid_mul (i : I) (x y : Modified R v) : braid hv i (x * y) = braid hv i x * braid hv i y
proof:
:=
  mapHom_mul _ x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_one
statement: lemma braid_one (i : I) (l : Y →+ ℤ) : braid (R := R) hv i (one l) = one (l.comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, braid_elt hv i l l _ (by rw [_root_.map_one, sub_self]; exact one_mem_adWeightSpace),
    one]
  exact elt_congr (_root_.map_one _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braid_symm_elt
statement:
lemma braid_symm_elt (i : I) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
    (hu' : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm u ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (l₁.comp (reflY R i) - l₂.comp (reflY R i))) :
    (braid hv i).symm (elt l₁ l₂ u hu) =
      elt (l₁.comp (reflY R i)) (l₂.comp (reflY R i))
        ((braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm u) hu'
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ l : Y →+ ℤ, (l.comp (reflY R i)).comp (reflY R i) = l := fun l ↦ by
    ext μ; simp
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, braid_elt hv i _ _ hu' (by
    rw [hc, hc, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]; exact hu)]
  exact elt_index (hc l₁).symm (hc l₂).symm (AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _).symm _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isBraidLiftable_braid
statement:
theorem isBraidLiftable_braid :
    D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable (braid (R := R) hv)
proof:
:= fun i j hij hm ↦ by
  have h := congrArg (mapHom R v) (isBraidLiftable_braidAut (R := R) hv i j hij hm)
  rwa [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidArtinHom_artinGenerator
statement:
@[simp] theorem braidArtinHom_artinGenerator (i : I) :
    braidArtinHom (R := R) hv (D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.artinGenerator i) = braid hv i
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (mapHom R v) (CoxeterMatrix.artinLift_artinGenerator _ _ i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidArtinHom_mul
statement:
theorem braidArtinHom_mul (g : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.ArtinGroup) (x y : Modified R v) :
    braidArtinHom hv g (x * y) = braidArtinHom hv g x * braidArtinHom hv g y
proof:
:=
  mapHom_mul _ x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidInvariant
statement: theorem braidInvariant : BraidInvariant R
proof:
:= by
  apply braidInvariant_of_span_pbwDiv_g2
  intro i j hij h3
  have hA := D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix
  have h1 := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have h2 := hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  have hcases : (D.cartanMatrix i j = -3 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) ∨
      (D.cartanMatrix i j = -1 ∧ D.cartanMatrix j i = -3) := by
    generalize D.cartanMatrix i j = a at *
    generalize D.cartanMatrix j i = b at *
    have ha0 : a < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (by intro h; simp [h] at h3)
    have hb0 : b < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne h2 (by intro h; simp [h] at h3)
    have ha : -3 ≤ a := by nlinarith
    have hb : -3 ≤ b := by nlinarith
    interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> simp_all
  rcases hcases with ⟨h, h'⟩ | ⟨h, h'⟩
  · exact span_pbwDiv_g2_braid hij h h'
  · exact (span_pbwDiv_g2_braid hij.symm h' h).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_all
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_all {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R u)) = Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:=
  span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant (braidInvariant (R := R)) cs hu hw huw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_all
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_all {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    {i : I} (hi : cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.wordProd w) i) (t : ℕ) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i) * x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:=
  qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv_of_braidInvariant (braidInvariant (R := R)) cs hw hi t
    hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_all
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_all {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i))).toSubmodule
proof:
:=
  span_pbwDiv_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant (braidInvariant (R := R)) cs hw hw₀

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_span_pbwDiv_longest_all
statement:
theorem coe_span_pbwDiv_longest_all {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    (Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w)) : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) = aPlus R
proof:
:=
  coe_span_pbwDiv_longest_of_braidInvariant (braidInvariant (R := R)) cs hw hw₀

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_rho
statement:
theorem chevalley_rho (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    chevalley R v (rho R v u) = rho R v (chevalley R v u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | E i => rw [rho_E, rhoE, map_smul, map_mul, chevalley_E, chevalley_F, rho_F, rhoF, Kt,
      chevalley_K]
  | F i => rw [rho_F, rhoF, map_smul, map_mul, chevalley_F, chevalley_K, neg_neg, chevalley_E,
      rho_E, rhoE, Kt]
  | K μ => rw [rho_K, chevalley_K, rho_K]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [rho_mul, map_mul, hx, hy, map_mul, rho_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.chevalleyAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma chevalleyAut_apply (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    (chevalleyAut R v).1.1 u = chevalley R v u
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_chevalleyAut
statement: lemma wt_chevalleyAut (l : Y →+ ℤ) : wt (chevalleyAut R v) l = -l
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  have h : (chevalleyAut R v).1.2⁻¹ μ = -μ := by
    have := autY_apply_inv (chevalleyAut R v).1.2 μ
    change -((chevalleyAut R v).1.2⁻¹ μ) = μ at this
    exact neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp this
  rw [wt_apply, h, map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_chevalleyAut_one
statement: lemma map_chevalleyAut_one (l : Y →+ ℤ) : map (chevalleyAut R v) (one l) = one (-l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, map_elt, one]
  exact elt_index (wt_chevalleyAut l) (wt_chevalleyAut l) (_root_.map_one _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wt_add
statement: lemma wt_add (g : torusAut R v) (l l' : Y →+ ℤ) : wt g (l + l') = wt g l + wt g l'
proof:
:= by
  ext μ; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_leftAct
statement:
theorem map_leftAct (g : torusAut R v) (u : QuantumGroup R v) (x : Modified R v) :
    map g (leftAct R v hv u x) = leftAct R v hv (g.1.1 u) (map g x)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd u u' hu hu' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hu']
  | hhom χ u hu =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ t ht =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv hu, map_elt, map_elt, leftAct_elt hv (map_mem_adWeightSpace g hu)]
    exact elt_index (wt_add g l₁ χ) rfl (_root_.map_mul _ _ _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_map_chevalleyAut
statement:
theorem form_map_chevalleyAut (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (map (chevalleyAut R v) x) (map (chevalleyAut R v) y) = form R v hv x y
proof:
:= by
  set g := chevalleyAut R v
  have h := eq_form hv (B := (form R v hv).compl₁₂ (map g) (map g))
    (fun _ _ _ _ hne ↦ one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero_of_elt (fun l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b ha hb hne ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, map_elt, map_elt]
      refine form_elt_elt_of_ne hv (fun h ↦ hne ?_) _ _
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h ⊢
      exact ⟨wt_injective g h.1, wt_injective g h.2⟩) hne)
    (fun u x y ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, map_leftAct, form_leftAct_left,
        map_leftAct, chevalleyAut_apply, chevalleyAut_apply, chevalley_rho])
    (fun l x y ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, map_leftAct, map_leftAct, map_chevalleyAut_one,
        chevalleyAut_apply, chevalleyAut_apply, chevalley_minusHom, chevalley_minusHom,
        form_plusHom_leftAct_one])
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordChar_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordChar_nil : wordChar R ([] : List I) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordChar_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma wordChar_cons (i : I) (w : List I) :
    wordChar R (i :: w) = R.root i + wordChar R w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordChar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace (w : List I) :
    plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (wordChar R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [LusztigF.monomial_cons, map_mul, plusHom_θ, wordChar_cons]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (E_mem_adWeightSpace i) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace (w : List I) :
    minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (-wordChar R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [LusztigF.monomial_cons, map_mul, minusHom_θ, wordChar_cons, neg_add]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (F_mem_adWeightSpace i) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.list_prod_E_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma list_prod_E_mem_adWeightSpace (w : List I) :
    (w.map (E R v)).prod ∈ adWeightSpace R v (wordChar R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, wordChar_cons]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (E_mem_adWeightSpace i) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.list_prod_F_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma list_prod_F_mem_adWeightSpace (w : List I) :
    (w.map (F R v)).prod ∈ adWeightSpace R v (-wordChar R w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, wordChar_cons, neg_add]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (F_mem_adWeightSpace i) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triangular_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma triangular_mem_adWeightSpace (w : List I) (μ : Y) (w' : List I) :
    minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) * K R v μ * plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w') ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (-wordChar R w + wordChar R w')
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (mul_mem_adWeightSpace
    (minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w) (K_mem_adWeightSpace μ))
    (plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.iSup_adWeightSpace
statement: theorem iSup_adWeightSpace : ⨆ χ, adWeightSpace R v χ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_triangular (R := R) (NeZero.ne v), triangularSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (triangular_mem_adWeightSpace w μ w')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_injective_of_not_root
statement:
lemma zpow_injective_of_not_root {v : k} (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective fun n : ℤ ↦ v ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a b : ℤ, a < b → v ^ a ≠ v ^ b := fun a b hab h ↦ by
    have h1 : v ^ (b - a) = 1 := by
      rw [zpow_sub₀ hv0, ← h, div_self (zpow_ne_zero _ hv0)]
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (sub_nonneg.2 hab.le)
    rw [hn, zpow_natCast] at h1
    exact hv n (by omega) h1
  intro a b h
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with hab | rfl | hab
  · exact absurd h (key a b hab)
  · rfl
  · exact absurd h.symm (key b a hab)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isInternal_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem isInternal_adWeightSpace [NeZero v] (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (adWeightSpace R v)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_adWeightSpace hv) (iSup_adWeightSpace R v)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modRel_le_lusztigRel
statement: lemma modRel_le_lusztigRel (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) : modRel R v l₁ l₂ ≤ lusztigRel R v l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro x (⟨μ, u, -, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, -, rfl⟩)
  · exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨μ, u, rfl⟩)
  · exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, u, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_lusztigRel_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ, χ μ ≠ (l₁ - l₂) μ := by
    by_contra h; exact hχ (AddMonoidHom.ext fun μ ↦ not_not.1 fun h' ↦ h ⟨μ, h'⟩)
  set c : k := v ^ (χ μ + l₂ μ) - v ^ l₁ μ
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 fun h ↦ hμ (by
    have := zpow_injective_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv h
    rw [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply]; omega)
  have e : c • u = (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₁ μ)) * u -
      v ^ χ μ • (u * (K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l₂ μ))) := by
    rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, hu μ]
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, mul_smul_comm, mul_one,
      smul_sub, smul_smul, c, sub_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
    abel
  have : c • u ∈ lusztigRel R v l₁ l₂ := by
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨μ, u, rfl⟩))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, u, rfl⟩)))
  simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c⁻¹ this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sup_otherWeights
statement:
lemma sup_otherWeights (χ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    adWeightSpace R v χ ⊔ otherWeights R v χ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← iSup_adWeightSpace R v, iSup_le_iff]
  intro χ'
  by_cases h : χ' = χ
  · subst h; exact le_sup_left
  · exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_biSup (fun χ' ↦ adWeightSpace R v χ') h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inf_otherWeights
statement:
lemma inf_otherWeights (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (χ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    adWeightSpace R v χ ⊓ otherWeights R v χ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  ((iSupIndep_adWeightSpace hv).disjoint_biSup (x := χ) (y := {χ' | χ' ≠ χ})
    (by simp)).eq_bot

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_otherWeights_left
proof:
:= by
  induction hb using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem χ' x hx =>
    induction hx using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem h x hx =>
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem χ' (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem h (by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hx))
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_otherWeights_right
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem χ' x hx =>
    induction hx using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem h x hx =>
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem χ' (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem h (by
        simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace hx hb))
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.otherWeights_le_lusztigRel
statement:
lemma otherWeights_le_lusztigRel (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    otherWeights R v (l₁ - l₂) ≤ lusztigRel R v l₁ l₂
proof:
:=
  iSup₂_le fun _ h _ hx ↦ mem_lusztigRel_of_ne hv h hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lusztigRel_eq
statement:
theorem lusztigRel_eq (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    lusztigRel R v l₁ l₂ = modRel R v l₁ l₂ ⊔ otherWeights R v (l₁ - l₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le (modRel_le_lusztigRel l₁ l₂) (otherWeights_le_lusztigRel hv l₁ l₂))
  have hdec : ∀ u : QuantumGroup R v, ∃ a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂),
      ∃ b ∈ otherWeights R v (l₁ - l₂), u = a + b := fun u ↦
    Submodule.mem_sup.1 (by rw [sup_otherWeights]; trivial) |>.imp fun a ⟨ha, b, hb, e⟩ ↦
      ⟨ha, b, hb, e.symm⟩
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro x (⟨μ, u, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, rfl⟩)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hdec u
    rw [mul_add]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨μ, a, ha, rfl⟩)))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (mul_mem_otherWeights_left (sub_mem_adWeightSpace_zero μ _) hb))
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hdec u
    rw [add_mul]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, a, ha, rfl⟩)))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (mul_mem_otherWeights_right hb (sub_mem_adWeightSpace_zero μ _)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adWeightSpace_inf_lusztigRel
statement:
theorem adWeightSpace_inf_lusztigRel (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂) ⊓ lusztigRel R v l₁ l₂ = modRel R v l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [lusztigRel_eq hv, inf_comm, sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (modRel_le l₁ l₂), inf_comm,
    inf_otherWeights hv, sup_bot_eq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.compToLusztig_mk
statement:
lemma compToLusztig_mk (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (x : adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2)) :
    compToLusztig p (Comp.mk R v p x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk x.1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.compToLusztig_bijective
statement:
lemma compToLusztig_bijective (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) :
    Function.Bijective (compToLusztig (R := R) (v := v) p)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Comp.mk_surjective R v p z
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, compToLusztig_mk, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hz
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot, Comp.mk_eq_zero, ← adWeightSpace_inf_lusztigRel hv]
    exact ⟨x.2, hz⟩
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1
      (show u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2) ⊔ otherWeights R v (p.1 - p.2) by
        rw [sup_otherWeights]; trivial)
    refine ⟨Comp.mk R v p ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [compToLusztig_mk, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
    simpa using neg_mem (otherWeights_le_lusztigRel hv p.1 p.2 hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.compEquivLusztig_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma compEquivLusztig_mk (p : (Y →+ ℤ) × (Y →+ ℤ)) (x : adWeightSpace R v (p.1 - p.2)) :
    compEquivLusztig hv p (Comp.mk R v p x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk x.1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_laurentSpan_of_mem
statement: lemma mem_laurentSpan_of_mem {S : Set V} {s : V} (hs : s ∈ S) : s ∈ laurentSpan S
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, s, hs, by rw [zpow_zero, one_smul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan
statement:
lemma zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan {S : Set V} (k : ℤ) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ laurentSpan S) :
    (𝕧 ^ k) • x ∈ laurentSpan S
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨l, s, hs, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨k + l, s, hs, by rw [smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero]⟩
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan
statement:
lemma laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan {S : Set V} {c : 𝕂} (hc : Modified.IsLaurent c) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ laurentSpan S) : c • x ∈ laurentSpan S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hc
  induction a using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact add_mem hp hq
  | C_mul_T n c =>
    have hC : LusztigF.integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.C c) = (c : 𝕂) := by
      simp [LusztigF.integralLaurentEval]
    rw [_root_.map_mul, hC, LusztigF.integralLaurentEval_T, mul_smul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan n hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_mem_laurentSpan
statement:
lemma map_mem_laurentSpan {S : Set V} {T : Set W} (f : V →ₗ[𝕂] W)
    (hf : ∀ s ∈ S, f s ∈ laurentSpan T) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ laurentSpan S) :
    f x ∈ laurentSpan T
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, s, hs, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul]; exact zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan k (hf s hs)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_zsmul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_F_smul_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow, smul_assoc]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, succ_nsmul, sub_add_eq_sub_sub]
    exact F_smul_mem_weightSpace ih i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_smul_qDivPow_F_smul
statement:
lemma F_smul_qDivPow_F_smul (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) (m : ℕ) (z : M) :
    F R v i • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) m (F R v i) • z) =
      qInt (v ^ D.d i) (m + 1) • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (m + 1) (F R v i) • z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_smul, mul_qDivPow _ _ _ (qInt_vd_ne_zero hv i m.succ_pos), smul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.qDivPow_F_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem qDivPow_F_smul_tmul (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) (x : M₁) {μ : Y →+ ℤ}
    {y : M₂} (hy : y ∈ weightSpace R v M₂ μ) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i) • mk M₁ M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
      ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, (v ^ D.d i) ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2 - p.1 * μ (R.coroot i)) •
        mk M₁ M₂ ((qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) p.1 (F R v i) • x) ⊗ₜ[k]
          (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) p.2 (F R v i) • y))
proof:
:= by
  set q := v ^ D.d i with hqdef
  set h := μ (R.coroot i) with hh
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [qDivPow_zero']
  | succ n ih =>
    have hne : qInt q (n + 1) ≠ 0 := qInt_vd_ne_zero hv i n.succ_pos
    have hK : ∀ t : ℕ, K R v (-ktilde R i) • (qDivPow q t (F R v i) • y) =
        q ^ (-(h - 2 * t)) • (qDivPow q t (F R v i) • y) := by
      intro t
      rw [K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace (qDivPow_F_smul_mem_weightSpace hy i t),
        AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.nsmul_apply, R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self]
      congr 2
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
    refine smul_right_injective _ hne ?_
    simp only
    rw [← F_smul_qDivPow_F_smul hv, ih, Finset.smul_sum]
    have hL : ∀ p ∈ antidiagonal n, F R v i • (q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2 - p.1 * h) •
        mk M₁ M₂ ((qDivPow q p.1 (F R v i) • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (qDivPow q p.2 (F R v i) • y))) =
        (q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2 - p.1 * h) * qInt q (p.1 + 1) * q ^ (-(h - 2 * p.2))) •
          mk M₁ M₂ ((qDivPow q (p.1 + 1) (F R v i) • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (qDivPow q p.2 (F R v i) • y)) +
        (q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2 - p.1 * h) * qInt q (p.2 + 1)) •
          mk M₁ M₂ ((qDivPow q p.1 (F R v i) • x) ⊗ₜ[k]
            (qDivPow q (p.2 + 1) (F R v i) • y)) := by
      intro p _
      rw [smul_comm, F_smul_tmul, hK, F_smul_qDivPow_F_smul hv, F_smul_qDivPow_F_smul hv]
      simp only [← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, map_add, LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
      congr 2
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hL, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.smul_sum]
    have hR : ∀ p ∈ antidiagonal (n + 1), qInt q (n + 1) • (q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2 - p.1 * h) •
        mk M₁ M₂ ((qDivPow q p.1 (F R v i) • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (qDivPow q p.2 (F R v i) • y))) =
        (q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2 - p.1 * h) * q ^ (p.2 : ℤ) * qInt q p.1) •
          mk M₁ M₂ ((qDivPow q p.1 (F R v i) • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (qDivPow q p.2 (F R v i) • y)) +
        (q ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2 - p.1 * h) * q ^ (-(p.1 : ℤ)) * qInt q p.2) •
          mk M₁ M₂ ((qDivPow q p.1 (F R v i) • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (qDivPow q p.2 (F R v i) • y)) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      rw [smul_smul, ← add_smul, ← hp, add_comm p.1 p.2, qInt_add, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
        zpow_natCast, inv_pow]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hR, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ,
      Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ']
    simp only [qInt_zero, mul_zero, zero_smul, zero_add]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
      congr 1
      rw [mul_right_comm, ← zpow_add₀ hq0, ← zpow_add₀ hq0]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
      congr 1
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hq0]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice
statement:
lemma fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ ∈ vermaLattice R Λ
proof:
:=
  mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_smul_hwv_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma fPow_smul_hwv_mem_weightSpace (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ ∈ weightSpace R 𝕧 (VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ) (-wtW R w + Λ)
proof:
:=
  smul_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace (fPow_mem w) VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_append
statement: lemma fPow_append (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) : fPow R (w ++ w') = fPow R w * fPow R w'
proof:
:= by
  simp [fPow, List.prod_append]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_smul_mem_vermaLattice
statement:
lemma fPow_smul_mem_vermaLattice (w : List (I × ℕ)) {x : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ}
    (hx : x ∈ vermaLattice R Λ) : fPow R w • x ∈ vermaLattice R Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_laurentSpan (DistribSMul.toLinearMap 𝕂 _ (fPow R w)) ?_ hx
  rintro _ ⟨w', rfl⟩
  rw [DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply, ← mul_smul, ← fPow_append]
  exact fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice Λ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaLattice
statement:
lemma qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaLattice (i : I) (n : ℕ) {x : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ}
    (hx : x ∈ vermaLattice R Λ) : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) • x ∈ vermaLattice R Λ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [fPow] using fPow_smul_mem_vermaLattice [(i, n)] hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_smul_mem_vermaLattice
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_smul_mem_vermaLattice (i : I) (N : ℕ) {x : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ}
    (hx : x ∈ vermaLattice R Λ) : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) N (E R 𝕧 i) • x ∈ vermaLattice R Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_laurentSpan (DistribSMul.toLinearMap 𝕂 _ (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) N (E R 𝕧 i)))
    ?_ hx
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply]
  induction w generalizing N with
  | nil =>
    rcases N with _ | N
    · rw [qDivPow_zero', one_smul]; exact fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice Λ []
    · rw [fPow_nil, one_smul, qDivPow, smul_assoc, pow_succ, mul_smul, VermaModule.E_smul_hwv,
        smul_zero, smul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
  | cons p w ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, M⟩ := p
    rw [fPow_cons, mul_smul]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [qDivPow_E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul ratFunc_X_not_root (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_weightSpace Λ w)]
      refine sum_mem fun t _ ↦ ?_
      unfold efTerm
      split_ifs
      · exact laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan (isLaurent_qBinomZ _ (D.d_pos i) _ _)
          (qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaLattice _ _ (ih _))
      · exact zero_mem _
    · have hc : Commute (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) N (E R 𝕧 i)) (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) M (F R 𝕧 j)) :=
        ((Commute.pow_pow (E_mul_F_of_ne (R := R) (v := 𝕧) hij) N M).smul_left _).smul_right _
      rw [← mul_smul, hc.eq, mul_smul]
      exact qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaLattice _ _ (ih N)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.tmul_mem_vermaTensorLattice
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_mem_laurentSpan (T := {z | ∃ w w' : List (I × ℕ), z = TensorModule.mk _ _
    (tw (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R w' • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'))})
    ((TensorModule.mk _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.mk 𝕂 _ _).flip b ∘ₗ (tw).toLinearMap)
    ?_ ha
  · exact h
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have h' := map_mem_laurentSpan (T := {z | ∃ w w' : List (I × ℕ), z = TensorModule.mk _ _
    (tw (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R w' • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'))})
    ((TensorModule.mk _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.mk 𝕂 _ _ (tw (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ))) ?_ hb
  · exact h'
  rintro _ ⟨w', rfl⟩
  exact mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨w, w', rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_F_smul_toTwist
statement:
lemma qDivPow_F_smul_toTwist (i : I) (n : ℕ) (a : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) • tw a = tw (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) • a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, map_qDivPow', chevalley_F]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaTensorLattice
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_laurentSpan (DistribSMul.toLinearMap 𝕂 _ (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i)))
    ?_ hz
  rintro _ ⟨w, w', rfl⟩
  rw [DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply, TensorModule.qDivPow_F_smul_tmul ratFunc_X_not_root i _
    (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_weightSpace Λ' w')]
  refine sum_mem fun p _ ↦ laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan (isLaurent_vd_zpow _ _) ?_
  rw [qDivPow_F_smul_toTwist]
  exact tmul_mem_vermaTensorLattice
    (qDivPow_E_smul_mem_vermaLattice _ _ (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice Λ w))
    (qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaLattice _ _ (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice Λ' w'))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_smul_mem_vermaTensorLattice
statement:
lemma fPow_smul_mem_vermaTensorLattice (w : List (I × ℕ)) {z : VT}
    (hz : z ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ') : fPow R w • z ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rwa [fPow_nil, one_smul]
  | cons p w ih => rw [fPow_cons, mul_smul]; exact qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaTensorLattice _ _ ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_smul_vermaTensorHwv
statement:
lemma ePow_smul_vermaTensorHwv (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    ePow R w • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ' =
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (tw (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')
proof:
:= by
  have e : ePow R w = plusHom R 𝕧
      ((w.map fun p ↦ qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d p.1) p.2 (LusztigF.θ 𝕂 p.1)).prod) := by
    simp only [ePow, map_list_prod, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, map_qDivPow', plusHom_θ]
  rw [vermaTensorHwv, e, plusHom_smul_tmul_hwv, ← e, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_ePow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_mul_ePow_smul_mem
statement:
lemma fPow_mul_ePow_smul_mem (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    (fPow R w * ePow R w') • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ' ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_smul, ePow_smul_vermaTensorHwv]
  refine fPow_smul_mem_vermaTensorLattice w (tmul_mem_vermaTensorLattice
    (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice Λ w') ?_)
  simpa using fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice Λ' []

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_vermaTensorHwv_mem_of_mem_aForm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← weightAct_leftActOne ratFunc_X_not_root _ _ (vermaTensorHwv_mem_weightSpace Λ Λ')]
  have hu' : leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (Λ' - Λ) u ∈ (aForm R).toSubmodule := hu
  rw [aForm_eq_aFormFE] at hu'
  generalize leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (Λ' - Λ) u = x at hu' ⊢
  induction hu' using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [weightAct_elt]
    split_ifs
    · exact fPow_mul_ePow_smul_mem w w'
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul, map_smul]; exact laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan ⟨a, rfl⟩ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.degW_cons
statement: lemma degW_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) : degW (p :: w) = degW w + p.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [degW, add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_cons'
statement:
lemma fPow_cons' (i : I) (n : ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) * fPow R w = fPow R ((i, n) :: w)
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_mem_aForm_of_mem_fePowSpan
statement:
lemma leftActOne_mem_aForm_of_mem_fePowSpan (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hu : u ∈ fePowSpan R) : leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root ζ u ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul, leftActOne_eq_elt ratFunc_X_not_root (fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w')]
    refine smul_mem_aForm (isLaurent_zpow k) ?_
    have h := elt_fPow_ePow_mem (R := R) (L := ζ + (wtW R w' - wtW R w)) (l := ζ)
      (by simpa using fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w')
    rw [← aForm_eq_aFormFE] at h
    exact h
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_zsmul]; exact zsmul_mem hx c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mem_fePowImage
statement:
lemma mem_fePowImage {z : VT} :
    z ∈ fePowImage R Λ Λ' ↔ ∃ u ∈ fePowSpan R, u • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ' = z
proof:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.zpow_smul_mem_fePowImage
statement:
lemma zpow_smul_mem_fePowImage (k : ℤ) {z : VT} (hz : z ∈ fePowImage R Λ Λ') :
    (𝕧 ^ k) • z ∈ fePowImage R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := mem_fePowImage.1 hz
  exact mem_fePowImage.2 ⟨(𝕧 ^ k) • u, zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan k hu, smul_assoc _ _ _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_mul_ePow_smul_mem_fePowImage
statement:
lemma fPow_mul_ePow_smul_mem_fePowImage (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :

:=
  mem_fePowImage.2 ⟨_, mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.degTensorSpan_mono
statement:
lemma degTensorSpan_mono {d d' : ℕ} (h : d ≤ d') :
    degTensorSpan (R := R) Λ Λ' d ≤ degTensorSpan Λ Λ' d'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono fun _ ⟨a, ha, w, hw, e⟩ ↦ ⟨a, ha, w, lt_of_lt_of_le hw h, e⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_tmul_mem_degTensorSpan
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_tmul', ← LinearEquiv.map_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_F_smul_mem_degTensorSpan
proof:
:= by
  have h : degTensorSpan Λ Λ' d ≤ (degTensorSpan Λ Λ' (d + n)).comap
      ((DistribSMul.toLinearMap 𝕂 VT (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i))).restrictScalars ℤ) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, w, hw, rfl⟩
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
      DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply]
    rw [TensorModule.qDivPow_F_smul_tmul ratFunc_X_not_root i _
      (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_weightSpace Λ' w)]
    refine sum_mem fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [qDivPow_F_smul_toTwist, ← mul_smul, fPow_cons']
    refine smul_tmul_mem_degTensorSpan (isLaurent_vd_zpow _ _)
      (qDivPow_E_smul_mem_vermaLattice _ _ ha) ?_
    rw [degW_cons]
    have := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.1 hp
    omega
  exact h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_F_smul_tmul_sub_mem
statement:
lemma qDivPow_F_smul_tmul_sub_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ) {a : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ}
    (ha : a ∈ vermaLattice R Λ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) • mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')) -
      mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R ((i, n) :: w) • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')) ∈
      degTensorSpan Λ Λ' (degW w + n)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ((0, n) : ℕ × ℕ) ∈ antidiagonal n :=
    Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.2 (zero_add n)
  rw [TensorModule.qDivPow_F_smul_tmul ratFunc_X_not_root i _
    (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_weightSpace Λ' w), ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ h0]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, sub_self, zpow_zero, one_smul, qDivPow_zero']
  rw [fPow_cons, mul_smul, add_sub_cancel_left]
  refine sum_mem fun p hp ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨hp0, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hp
  rw [qDivPow_F_smul_toTwist, ← mul_smul, fPow_cons']
  refine smul_tmul_mem_degTensorSpan (isLaurent_vd_zpow _ _)
    (qDivPow_E_smul_mem_vermaLattice _ _ ha) ?_
  rw [degW_cons]
  have h1 := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.1 hp
  have h2 : p.1 ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hp0 (Prod.ext h (by simp only; omega))
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_smul_tmul_hwv_sub_mem
statement:
lemma fPow_smul_tmul_hwv_sub_mem {a : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ} (ha : a ∈ vermaLattice R Λ)
    (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fPow R w • mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ') -
      mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')) ∈ degTensorSpan Λ Λ' (degW w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rw [fPow_nil, one_smul, one_smul, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _
  | cons p w ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, n⟩ := p
    have e : fPow R ((i, n) :: w) • mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ') -
        mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R ((i, n) :: w) • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')) =
        qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) • (fPow R w • mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ') -
          mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'))) +
        (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) •
          mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R w • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')) -
          mkT (tw a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (fPow R ((i, n) :: w) • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'))) := by
      rw [smul_sub, fPow_cons, mul_smul]
      abel
    rw [e, degW_cons]
    exact add_mem (qDivPow_F_smul_mem_degTensorSpan i n ih) (qDivPow_F_smul_tmul_sub_mem i n ha w)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.degTensorSpan_le_fePowImage
statement:
lemma degTensorSpan_le_fePowImage (d : ℕ) :
    degTensorSpan (R := R) Λ Λ' d ≤ fePowImage R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => exact Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨_, _, _, hw, _⟩ ↦ absurd hw (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ d ih =>
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, w', hw', rfl⟩
    have key : vermaLattice R Λ ≤ (fePowImage R Λ Λ').comap
        (((TensorModule.mk _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          (TensorProduct.mk 𝕂 _ _).flip (fPow R w' • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ') ∘ₗ
            (tw).toLinearMap).restrictScalars ℤ) := by
      refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨k, _, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
        LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.flip_apply,
        TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.map_smul, ← smul_tmul']
      refine zpow_smul_mem_fePowImage k ?_
      have hg := fPow_smul_tmul_hwv_sub_mem (Λ' := Λ')
        (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice (R := R) Λ w) w'
      rw [← ePow_smul_vermaTensorHwv, ← mul_smul] at hg
      have hT := ih (degTensorSpan_mono (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hw') hg)
      have := sub_mem (fPow_mul_ePow_smul_mem_fePowImage w' w) hT
      rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
    exact key ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaTensorLattice_le_fePowImage
statement:
lemma vermaTensorLattice_le_fePowImage :
    vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ' ≤ fePowImage R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨k, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact degTensorSpan_le_fePowImage (degW w' + 1) (smul_tmul_mem_degTensorSpan (isLaurent_zpow k)
    (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_vermaLattice Λ w) (Nat.lt_succ_self _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_mem_aForm_iff
statement:
theorem leftActOne_mem_aForm_iff (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (Λ' - Λ) u ∈ aForm R ↔
      u • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ' ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨smul_vermaTensorHwv_mem_of_mem_aForm, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u', hu', e⟩ := mem_fePowImage.1 (vermaTensorLattice_le_fePowImage h)
  have h0 : (u - u') • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ' = 0 := by rw [sub_smul, e, sub_self]
  rw [smul_vermaTensorHwv_eq_zero_iff ratFunc_X_not_root, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h0
  rw [h0]
  exact leftActOne_mem_aForm_of_mem_fePowSpan _ hu'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaTensorEquiv_mem_iff
statement:
theorem vermaTensorEquiv_mem_iff (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ)
    (x : LinearMap.range (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (Λ' - Λ))) :
    vermaTensorEquiv ratFunc_X_not_root Λ Λ' x ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ' ↔
      (x : Modified R 𝕧) ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := x
  rw [vermaTensorEquiv_apply, leftActOne_mem_aForm_iff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Ta_symm_apply
statement:
lemma Ta_symm_apply (i : I) (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    (Ta R i).symm x = (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwDivSymm_eq_smul
statement:
lemma pbwDivSymm_eq_smul (ω : List I) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R) ω c =
      (∏ t : Fin ω.length, (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d ω[t]) (c t))⁻¹) •
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root j).symm)
        (E R 𝕧) ω c
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial]
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_cons, ih]
    change _ = (∏ t : Fin (ω.length + 1), (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d (i :: ω)[t]) (c t))⁻¹) • _
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    rw [Ta_symm_apply, map_smul, Ed, qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.linearIndependent_pbwDivSymm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hli := linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_symm_of_isReduced (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root hω
  rw [linearIndependent_iff'] at hli ⊢
  intro s g hg c hc
  have hs : ∀ c : Fin ω.length → ℕ,
      (∏ t : Fin ω.length, (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d ω[t]) (c t))⁻¹) ≠ 0 := fun c ↦
    prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun t _ ↦ inv_ne_zero (qFactorial_vd_ne_zero _ _)
  have h := hli s (fun c : Fin ω.length → ℕ ↦ LusztigF.integralLaurentEval (g c) *
    ∏ t : Fin ω.length, (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d ω[t]) (c t))⁻¹) (by
      simpa [laurent_smul_U, pbwDivSymm_eq_smul, smul_smul] using hg) c hc
  exact LusztigF.integralLaurentEval_injective (by
    rw [map_zero]; exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right (hs c))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qSerre_two_inv
statement:
lemma qSerre_two_inv (q : 𝕂) (a b : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    qSerre q⁻¹ 2 a b = qSerre q 2 a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [qSerre_two, qSerre_two, inv_inv, add_comm q⁻¹]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_a2
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_a2 :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  set p : 𝕂 := q⁻¹
  set α := E R 𝕧 i
  set β := E R 𝕧 j
  
  set γ := β * α - q⁻¹ • (α * β)
  set γp := α * β - p⁻¹ • (β * α)
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hq0
  have hqroot := vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hqroot hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt p n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [A2Integral.qInt_inv']; exact hqi n hn
  have hqq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hqroot
  have hpp : p - p⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [inv_inv, ← neg_sub]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 hqq
  have hdij : D.d j = D.d i := (D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h').symm
  have hγp : γp = (-q) • γ := by
    simp only [γp, γ, p, inv_inv, smul_sub, smul_smul, neg_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, neg_smul,
      one_smul]
    abel
  have hβα : β * α = p • (α * β) - p • γp := by
    simp only [γp, p, inv_inv, smul_sub, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_smul]; abel
  have hS1 : qSerre p 2 α β = 0 := by
    have := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
    rwa [h, show (1 - -1 : ℤ).toNat = 2 from rfl, ← qSerre_two_inv] at this
  have hS2 : qSerre p 2 β α = 0 := by
    have := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
    rwa [h', show (1 - -1 : ℤ).toNat = 2 from rfl, hdij, ← qSerre_two_inv] at this
  have hαγ : α * γp = p • (γp * α) := by
    have e : α * γp - p • (γp * α) = qSerre p 2 α β := by
      rw [qSerre_two]
      simp only [γp, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hp0, one_smul, sq, mul_assoc, add_smul]
      abel
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, e, hS1]
  have hβγ : p • (β * γp) = γp * β := by
    have e : p • (β * γp) - γp * β = -qSerre p 2 β α := by
      rw [qSerre_two]
      simp only [γp, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hp0, one_smul, sq, mul_assoc, add_smul]
      abel
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, e, hS2, neg_zero]
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hpΛ : p ∈ Λ := hqΛ'
  have hpΛ' : p⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by simpa [p] using hqΛ
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  
  have hT2 : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm β = γ := by
    have e := a2_rootVector_two hij (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i)
    simp only [AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom] at e
    rw [braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply, braidReversal_E, e,
      braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h, map_sub, map_smul, braidReversal_mul,
      braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E, braidReversal_E]
  have hT3 : (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
      ((braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root j).symm α) = β := by
    have e := list_braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root [i, j] α
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one,
      AlgEquiv.mul_apply] at e
    have e3 := a2_rootVector_three (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i)
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j) hij h h' hqq
    simp only [AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom] at e3
    rw [e, braidReversal_E, e3, braidReversal_E]
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 3 → ℕ, pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i] c =
      qDivPow q (c 0) α * qDivPow q (c 1) γ * qDivPow q (c 2) β := fun c ↦ by
    have e1 : ∀ n, (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm (Ed R j n) =
        qDivPow q n γ := fun n ↦ by rw [Ed, hmap, hT2, hdij]
    have e2 : ∀ n, (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
        ((braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root j).symm (Ed R i n)) = qDivPow q n β :=
      fun n ↦ by rw [Ed, hmap, hmap, hT3]
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_symm_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one,
      mul_one]
    rw [e1, e2, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  
  have hmono' : ∀ a b d : ℕ, qDivPow p a α * qDivPow p b γp * qDivPow p d β =
      ((-q) ^ b) • (qDivPow q a α * qDivPow q b γ * qDivPow q d β) := fun a b d ↦ by
    rw [A2Integral.qDivPow_inv', A2Integral.qDivPow_inv', A2Integral.qDivPow_inv', hγp,
      qDivPow, qDivPow, smul_pow, smul_smul,
      mul_comm, ← smul_smul, ← qDivPow, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hmq : ∀ b : ℕ, (-q) ^ b ∈ Λ := fun b ↦ pow_mem (neg_mem hqΛ) b
  have hmq' : ∀ b : ℕ, ((-q) ^ b)⁻¹ ∈ Λ := fun b ↦ by
    rw [← inv_pow, inv_neg]; exact pow_mem (neg_mem hqΛ') b
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i])) ↔
      x ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ p α β γp := fun x ↦ by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]
        have e := hmono' (c 0) (c 1) (c 2)
        rw [← inv_smul_eq_iff₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.2 hq0))] at e
        rw [← e]
        exact A2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (hmq' _)
          (A2Integral.monomial_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _)
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U]
        exact A2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, e, f, g, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono', smul_smul]
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 (Subring.mul_mem _ hc (hmq f))
        rw [← ha, ← laurent_smul_U, show qDivPow q e α * qDivPow q f γ * qDivPow q g β =
          pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i] ![e, f, g] by rw [hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  have hγd : ∀ n, qDivPow q n γ ∈ adjoinPair (R := R) i j := fun n ↦ by
    have e : qDivPow q n γ = ∑ r ∈ range (negA D i j * n + 1),
        ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ r * (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ r) •
          (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) r (E R 𝕧 i) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (E R 𝕧 j) *
            qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (negA D i j * n - r) (E R 𝕧 i)) := by
      rw [← braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_qDivPow_E_ne ratFunc_X_not_root R hij.symm n, hmap, hT2,
        hdij]
    rw [e]
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun r _ ↦ smul_mem_of_isLaurent
      ((isLaurent_neg_one.pow r).mul (isLaurent_inv_pow_pow _ _)) ?_
    refine mul_mem (mul_mem ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, hmono]
      refine mul_mem (mul_mem ?_ (hγd _)) ?_
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨c 2, by rw [Ed, hdij]⟩)
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hx a
  · have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ p α β γp :=
      A2Integral.one_mem_orderedSpan
    have hmul : ∀ y ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ p α β γp,
        x * y ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ p α β γp := by
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩
        · intro y hy
          rw [Ed, ← A2Integral.qDivPow_inv']
          exact A2Integral.qDivPow_α_mul_mem hpi hpΛ hpΛ' n hy
        · intro y hy
          rw [Ed, hdij, ← A2Integral.qDivPow_inv']
          exact A2Integral.qDivPow_β_mul_mem hp0 hpi hβα hαγ hβγ hpΛ hpΛ' hpp n hy
      | algebraMap a =>
        intro y hy
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def, laurent_smul_U]
        exact A2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hy
      | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
      | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
    rw [hconv]
    simpa using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_a2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_a2_braid :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwDivSymm_a2 hij h h', span_pbwDivSymm_a2 hij.symm h' h, adjoinPair, adjoinPair,
    Set.union_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_commuting
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_commuting (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
  have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h0; exact two_ne_zero h0
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  have hE : ∀ {a b : I}, D.cartanMatrix a b = 0 → a ≠ b →
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root a).symm (E R 𝕧 b) = E R 𝕧 b := by
    intro a b hab hne
    have H := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R a
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    change _ = (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root a).toAlgHom (E R 𝕧 b)
    rw [H.map_E, ite_eq_right hne.symm, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hab]
  have hmono : ∀ {a b : I}, D.cartanMatrix a b = 0 → a ≠ b → ∀ c : Fin 2 → ℕ,
      pbwDivSymm R [a, b] c = Ed R a (c 0) * Ed R b (c 1) := fun hab hne c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_symm_apply, _root_.map_one, mul_one, Ed, hmap,
      hE hab hne]
    rfl
  have hc : ∀ m n, Ed R i m * Ed R j n = Ed R j n * Ed R i m := fun m n ↦ by
    simp only [Ed, qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm]
    rw [((Commute.pow_pow (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (R := R) (v := 𝕧) h0) m n)).eq,
      mul_comm (_ : 𝕂)]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨![c 1, c 0], by rw [hmono h0' hij.symm, hmono h0 hij, hc]; rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨![c 1, c 0], by rw [hmono h0' hij.symm, hmono h0 hij, hc]; rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_Ta_symm_apply
statement:
lemma list_Ta_symm_apply (u : List I) (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    (u.map fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm).prod x =
      (u.map fun i ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm).prod x
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i u ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, ih, Ta_symm_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_symm_prod_eq_symm
statement:
lemma list_symm_prod_eq_symm (u : List I) :
    (u.map fun i ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm).prod =
      ((u.reverse.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod).symm
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i u ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ih, List.reverse_cons, List.map_append, List.prod_append,
      List.map_singleton, List.prod_singleton]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_of_braidMove
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_of_braidMove {u w : List I}
    (hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix.BraidMove u w) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R u)) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, s, i, j, hij, hmij, rfl, rfl⟩ := hm
  have hT0 := isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i j hij hmij
  have key : ∀ u w : List I,
      (u.reverse.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod =
        (w.reverse.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod →
      (u.map fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm).prod = (w.map fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm).prod := by
    intro u w huw
    ext x
    rw [list_Ta_symm_apply, list_Ta_symm_apply, list_symm_prod_eq_symm, list_symm_prod_eq_symm,
      huw]
  rcases hSL hij with h0 | h1
  · have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
    have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h0, h0']
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h0, h0']
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw'] at hT0 ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context _ (Ed R) (span_pbwDivSymm_commuting h0)
      (key [i, j] [j, i] (by simpa using hT0.symm)) p s
  · have h1' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1 := by
      rcases hSL hij.symm with hz | hn
      · have := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm j i).mp hz
        omega
      · exact hn
    have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h1, h1']
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h1, h1']
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw'] at hT0 ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context _ (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDivSymm_a2_braid hij h1 h1').symm (key [j, i, j] [i, j, i] (by simpa using hT0)) p s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_of_isReduced {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R u)) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove
    (fun _ _ _ hm ↦ span_pbwDivSymm_of_braidMove hSL hm)
    hu (CoxeterSystem.reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hu hw huw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDivSymm
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDivSymm {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    {i : I} (hi : cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.wordProd w) i) (t : ℕ) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i) * x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu₀⟩ := exists_reduced_cons_of_isLeftDescent cs hi
  have hs := span_pbwDivSymm_of_isReduced (R := R) hSL cs hu hw hu₀
  rw [← hs] at hx ⊢
  exact CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwDivSpan_cons _ (Ed R) i u (Ed_mul_mem_span i t) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} :
    ∀ (w p : List I), cs.IsReduced (p ++ w) → ∀ c : Fin w.length → ℕ,
      (p.map fun i ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm).prod
        (pbwDivSymm R w c) ∈ aPlus R
proof:
| [], p, _, c => by
    simpa [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial] using ePow_mem_aPlus (R := R) []
  | i :: w, p, hpw, c => by
    rw [pbwDivSymm, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, Ta_symm_apply,
      ← AlgEquiv.mul_apply, ← List.prod_concat]
    rw [show (p.map fun i ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm).concat
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm =
        (p.concat i).map fun i ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm by
      simp]
    refine mul_mem_aPlus ?_ (pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus w (p.concat i) (by simpa using hpw) _)
    have hred : cs.IsReduced (p ++ [i]) := by
      have := hpw.take (p.length + 1)
      rwa [show (p ++ i :: w).take (p.length + 1) = p ++ [i] by
        rw [List.take_length_add_append]
        rfl] at this
    exact list_braid_symm_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus hred _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_longest_eq
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_longest_eq {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))
  have hplus : ∀ c, pbwDivSymm R w c ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i)) := fun c ↦ by
    have hc := pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, AlgEquiv.one_apply] at hc
    generalize pbwDivSymm R w c = y at hc ⊢
    induction hc using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact hplus c
  · intro x hx
    have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ S :=
      CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwDivSpan _ (Ed R) Ed_zero w
    have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
        exact fun y hy ↦ qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDivSymm hSL cs hw
          (hw₀ ▸ cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i) n hy
      | algebraMap a =>
        intro y hy
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
        exact S.smul_mem a hy
      | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
      | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
    simpa using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_span_pbwDivSymm_longest
statement:
theorem coe_span_pbwDivSymm_longest {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    (Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w)) : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) = aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      simpa using pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul_U]; exact smul_mem_aPlus ⟨a, rfl⟩ hx
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, span_pbwDivSymm_longest_eq hSL cs hw hw₀]
    induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
