name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TendstoAtInfinity.add
statement:
theorem add (hf : TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ f c) (hg : TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ g d) :
    TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ (fun Λ ↦ f Λ + g Λ) (c + d)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hf m
  obtain ⟨M', hM'⟩ := hg m
  refine ⟨max M M', fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hM Λ fun i ↦ (le_max_left _ _).trans (hΛ i)
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hM' Λ fun i ↦ (le_max_right _ _).trans (hΛ i)
  refine ⟨a + a', ?_⟩
  rw [mul_add, map_add, ← ha, ← ha']
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TendstoAtInfinity.const_mul
statement:
theorem const_mul (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a)
    (hf : TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ f c) (b : k) :
    TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ (fun Λ ↦ b * f Λ) (b * c)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  obtain ⟨e, b', hb'⟩ := hk b
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hf (m + e)
  refine ⟨M, fun Λ hΛ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hM Λ hΛ
  refine ⟨b' * a, ?_⟩
  rw [← mul_sub, ha, pow_add]
  simp only [map_mul] at hb' ⊢
  rw [← hb']
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TendstoAtInfinity.comp_add
statement:
theorem comp_add [Finite I] (hf : TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ f c) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ (fun Λ ↦ f (ζ + Λ)) c
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  intro m
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hf m
  refine ⟨M + ∑ i, |ζ (R.coroot i)|, fun Λ hΛ ↦ hM _ fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := hΛ i
  have h2 : |ζ (R.coroot i)| ≤ ∑ j, |ζ (R.coroot j)| :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j ↦ |ζ (R.coroot j)|) (fun j _ ↦ abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h3 := neg_abs_le (ζ (R.coroot i))
  rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.tendstoAtInfinity_form_minusHom
statement:
theorem tendstoAtInfinity_form_minusHom [CharZero k] [Finite I] {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra A k] {ϖ : A}
    (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ
      (fun Λ ↦ form Λ hR hv' (minusHom R v x • hwv R v Λ) (minusHom R v y • hwv R v Λ))
      (LusztigF.form D v x y)
proof:
:=
  fun m ↦ exists_form_minusHom_sub_mem hR hv' hk hϖv x y m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.K_smul_hwv
statement: lemma K_smul_hwv (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) : K R v μ • hwv R v Λ = v ^ Λ μ • hwv R v Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, VermaModule.K_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.minusHom_smul_tmul
statement:
lemma minusHom_smul_tmul (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (x : LusztigF k I) (m : IrreducibleModule R v Λ') :
    minusHom R v x • TensorModule.mk (ChevalleyTwist R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ)) _
        (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _ (hwv R v Λ) ⊗ₜ[k] m) =
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _ (hwv R v Λ) ⊗ₜ[k]
        (minusHom R v x • m))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing m with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_smul]
  | grade1 i =>
    have hE : F R v i • ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v (IrreducibleModule R v Λ) (hwv R v Λ) = 0 := by
      rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_F, hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
        VermaModule.E_smul_hwv, Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero, map_zero]
    rw [← LusztigF.θ, minusHom_θ, TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, hE, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, zero_add]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_smul, ha, hb, add_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, mul_smul, hb, ha, mul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.K_smul_tensorHwv
statement:
lemma K_smul_tensorHwv (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) :
    K R v μ • tensorHwv (R := R) (v := v) Λ Λ' = v ^ (Λ' - Λ) μ • tensorHwv Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHwv, TensorModule.K_smul_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_K,
    K_smul_hwv, K_smul_hwv, LinearEquiv.map_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
    ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul, map_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [map_neg, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_eq_add_neg, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.tensorForm_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorForm_tmul (Λ Λ' : Y →+ ℤ) (m m' : IrreducibleModule R v Λ') :
    tensorForm hR hv' Λ Λ'
        (TensorModule.mk _ _ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _ (hwv R v Λ) ⊗ₜ[k] m))
        (TensorModule.mk _ _ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _ (hwv R v Λ) ⊗ₜ[k] m')) =
      form Λ' hR hv' m m'
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorForm, TensorModule.form_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.form_toTwist, form_hwv, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IrreducibleModule.tendstoAtInfinity_tensorForm
statement:
theorem tendstoAtInfinity_tensorForm [CharZero k] [Finite I] {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra A k] {ϖ : A}
    (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (u u' : QuantumGroup R v) :
    TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ
      (fun Λ ↦ tensorForm hR hv' Λ (ζ + Λ) (u • tensorHwv Λ (ζ + Λ))
        (u' • tensorHwv Λ (ζ + Λ)))
      (Modified.form R v hv' (Modified.leftAct R v hv' u (Modified.one ζ))
        (Modified.leftAct R v hv' u' (Modified.one ζ)))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ z : QuantumGroup R v, TendstoAtInfinity R ϖ
      (fun Λ ↦ tensorForm hR hv' Λ (ζ + Λ) (tensorHwv Λ (ζ + Λ)) (z • tensorHwv Λ (ζ + Λ)))
      (Modified.form R v hv' (Modified.one ζ) (Modified.leftAct R v hv' z (Modified.one ζ))) := by
    intro z
    induction z using induction_rho_minusHom with
    | h0 => exact fun m ↦ ⟨0, fun Λ _ ↦ ⟨0, by simp⟩⟩
    | hadd x y hx hy =>
      convert hx.add hy using 1
      · funext Λ; rw [add_smul, map_add]
      · rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
    | hsmul c x hx =>
      convert hx.const_mul hk c using 1
      · funext Λ; rw [smul_assoc, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      · rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    | hmon w w' μ =>
      have hlim := ((tendstoAtInfinity_form_minusHom hR hv' hk hϖv
        (LusztigF.monomial k w) (LusztigF.monomial k w')).comp_add ζ).const_mul hk (v ^ ζ μ)
      convert hlim using 1
      · funext Λ
        rw [mul_smul, K_smul_tensorHwv, add_sub_cancel_right,
          smul_comm (rho R v (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w)) *
            minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) (v ^ ζ μ), map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul,
          ← isContravariant_tensorForm hR hv', tensorHwv, minusHom_smul_tmul,
          minusHom_smul_tmul, tensorForm_tmul]
      · rw [Modified.one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional hv' (Modified.form_leftAct_left hv')
          (Modified.form_minusHom_leftAct_one hv'), formFunctional_rho_minusHom]
  convert key (rho R v u * u') using 1
  · funext Λ; rw [isContravariant_tensorForm hR hv', mul_smul]
  · rw [Modified.form_leftAct_left hv', Modified.leftAct_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordWeight_reverse
statement: lemma wordWeight_reverse (w : List I) : wordWeight w.reverse = wordWeight w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [List.reverse_cons, wordWeight_append, ih, wordWeight_cons, wordWeight_cons,
      wordWeight_nil, add_zero, add_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_plusHom_monomial
statement:
theorem rho_plusHom_monomial (w : List I) :
    rho R v (plusHom R v (monomial k w)) =
      v ^ (normSq R (wordWeight w) / 2) •
        (K R v (ktildeSum R (wordWeight w)) * minusHom R v (monomial k w.reverse))
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have h := congrArg (rho R v) (rho_minusHom_monomial (k := k) (R := R) (v := v) w.reverse)
  rw [rho_rho, map_smul, rho_mul, rho_K, List.reverse_reverse, wordWeight_reverse] at h
  rw [h, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, ← mul_assoc, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul,
    ← zpow_add₀ hv, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_plusHom
statement:
lemma braidReversal_plusHom (x : LusztigF k I) :
    braidReversal (plusHom R v x) = plusHom R v (rev k I x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, rev_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, braidReversal_algebraMap]
  | grade1 i =>
    rw [show FreeAlgebra.ι k i = θ k i from rfl, plusHom_θ, rev_θ, plusHom_θ, braidReversal_E]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, braidReversal_mul, ha, hb, rev_mul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.formFunctional_braidReversal
proof:
:= by
  have hz' : z ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l - l) := by rw [sub_self]; exact hz
  have h := form_sigma_sigma hv (one l) (elt l l z hz')
  rw [one, sigma_elt, sigma_elt, form_elt_elt_self, form_elt_elt_self, rho_one, one_mul,
    show braidReversal (1 : QuantumGroup R v) = 1 by simp [braidReversal], rho_one,
    one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_plusHom_leftAct_one
statement:
theorem form_plusHom_leftAct_one (l : Y →+ ℤ) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    form R v hv (leftAct R v hv (plusHom R v x) (one l))
      (leftAct R v hv (plusHom R v y) (one l)) = LusztigF.form D v x y
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((form R v hv).compl₁₂ (leftAct R v hv ∘ₗ (plusHom R v).toLinearMap |>.flip (one l))
      (leftAct R v hv ∘ₗ (plusHom R v).toLinearMap |>.flip (one l))) = LusztigF.form D v :=
    LinearMap.ext_basis (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) fun w w' ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, wordBasis_eq_monomial]
      rw [one, leftAct_elt hv (plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w),
        leftAct_elt hv (plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w'), form_elt_elt]
      split_ifs with h
      · have hχ : wordChar R w = wordChar R w' := by
          simpa using (Prod.mk.inj h).1
        have hz : rho R v (plusHom R v (monomial k w) * 1) * (plusHom R v (monomial k w') * 1) ∈
            adWeightSpace R v 0 := by
          have := mul_mem_adWeightSpace
            (rho_mem_adWeightSpace (plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) (v := v) w))
            (plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) (v := v) w')
          rwa [hχ, neg_add_cancel, ← mul_one (plusHom R v (monomial k w')),
            ← mul_one (plusHom R v (monomial k w))] at this
        rw [← formFunctional_braidReversal hv l hz, mul_one, mul_one, braidReversal_mul,
          rho_plusHom_monomial, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_K,
          braidReversal_minusHom, braidReversal_plusHom, rev_monomial, rev_monomial,
          List.reverse_reverse, mul_smul_comm, map_smul, ← mul_assoc, formFunctional_mul_K,
          ← mul_one (plusHom R v (monomial k w'.reverse)), ← K_zero R v,
          formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial, rev_monomial, List.reverse_reverse,
          LusztigF.form_comm, formScale, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
          ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]
        convert one_mul (LusztigF.form D v (monomial k w) (monomial k w'))
        convert zpow_zero v using 2
        simp only [map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, map_zero, neg_neg]
        ring
      · refine (LusztigF.form_eq_zero_of_ne D v (fun hw ↦ h ?_) (monomial_mem_weightSpace w)
          (monomial_mem_weightSpace w')).symm
        rw [wordChar_eq_rootSum, wordChar_eq_rootSum, hw]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.thetaW_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma thetaW_nil : thetaW D [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.thetaW_cons
statement:
lemma thetaW_cons (p : I × ℕ) (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    thetaW D (p :: w) = integralGenerator D p.1 p.2 * thetaW D w
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaW]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.thetaW_append
statement:
lemma thetaW_append (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    thetaW D (w ++ w') = thetaW D w * thetaW D w'
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaW]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_mem_span_thetaW
statement:
lemma mul_mem_span_thetaW {a b : quotientIntegralForm D}
    (ha : a ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (thetaW D)))
    (hb : b ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (thetaW D))) :
    a * b ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (thetaW D))
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := ha
    induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem b hb =>
      obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hb
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w ++ w', thetaW_append w w'⟩
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add b c _ _ hb hc => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hb hc
    | smul c b _ hb => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hb
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a c _ _ ha hc => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem ha hc
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [smul_mul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_thetaW
statement:
theorem mem_span_thetaW (x : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (thetaW D))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨[(i, n)], by simp [thetaW, integralGenerator]⟩
  | algebraMap a =>
    have : (⟨algebraMap 𝒜 _ a, Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ a⟩ : quotientIntegralForm D) =
        a • thetaW D [] := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], rfl⟩)
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => exact mul_mem_span_thetaW hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPlus_integralGenerator
statement:

    quotientPlus R (integralGenerator D i n : Quotient D 𝕧) =
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i)
proof:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientMinus_thetaW
statement:

proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [thetaW_cons, Subalgebra.coe_mul, map_mul, ih, quotientMinus_integralGenerator,
      Modified.fPow_cons]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientPlus_thetaW
statement:
lemma quotientPlus_thetaW (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    quotientPlus R (thetaW D w : Quotient D 𝕧) = Modified.ePow R w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triK_apply
statement:
lemma triK_apply (l : Y →+ ℤ) (x x' : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    triK R l x x' = leftAct R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (quotientMinus R x)
      (rightAct R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (quotientPlus R x') (one l))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triK_eq_elt
statement:
lemma triK_eq_elt (l : Y →+ ℤ) {x x' : Quotient D 𝕧} {a b : Y →+ ℤ}
    (hx : quotientMinus R x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (-a))
    (hx' : quotientPlus R x' ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 b) :
    triK R l x x' = elt (l - a) (l - b) (quotientMinus R x * quotientPlus R x')
      (by
        rw [show l - a - (l - b) = -a + b by abel]
        exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace hx hx')
proof:
:= by
  rw [triK_apply, one, rightAct_elt _ hx', leftAct_elt _ hx]
  exact elt_index (by abel) rfl (by rw [one_mul]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triK_thetaW
statement:
lemma triK_thetaW (l : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    triK R l (thetaW D w) (thetaW D w') =
      elt (l - wtW R w) (l - wtW R w') (fPow R w * ePow R w')
        (by
          rw [show l - wtW R w - (l - wtW R w') = wtW R w' - wtW R w by abel]
          exact fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w')
proof:
:= by
  rw [triK_eq_elt l (a := wtW R w) (b := wtW R w') (by rw [quotientMinus_thetaW]; exact fPow_mem w)
    (by rw [quotientPlus_thetaW]; exact ePow_mem w')]
  exact elt_index rfl rfl (by rw [quotientMinus_thetaW, quotientPlus_thetaW]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triK_thetaW_mem_aForm
statement:
lemma triK_thetaW_mem_aForm (l : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    triK R l (thetaW D w) (thetaW D w') ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  rw [triK_thetaW]
  change _ ∈ (aForm R).toSubmodule
  rw [aForm_eq_aFormFE]
  exact elt_fPow_ePow_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_laurent_smul
statement:
lemma coe_laurent_smul (a : 𝒜) (x : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ((a • x : quotientIntegralForm D) : Quotient D 𝕧) =
      integralLaurentEval a • (x : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triK_mem_aForm
statement:
lemma triK_mem_aForm (l : Y →+ ℤ) (x x' : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    triK R l x x' ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  have hx := mem_span_thetaW x
  have hx' := mem_span_thetaW x'
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := ha
    induction hx' using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem b hb =>
      obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hb
      exact triK_thetaW_mem_aForm l w w'
    | zero => rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add b c _ _ hb hc => rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hb hc
    | smul c b _ hb =>
      rw [coe_laurent_smul, map_smul]
      exact smul_mem_aForm ⟨c, rfl⟩ hb
  | zero => rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a c _ _ ha hc => rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem ha hc
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    rw [coe_laurent_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    exact smul_mem_aForm ⟨c, rfl⟩ ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_triA
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_triA (l : Y →+ ℤ) (x x' : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    (triA R l x x' : Modified R 𝕧) = triK R l x x'
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triA_thetaW
statement:
lemma triA_thetaW (l : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    (triA R l (thetaW D w) (thetaW D w') : Modified R 𝕧) =
      elt (l - wtW R w) (l - wtW R w') (fPow R w * ePow R w')
        (by
          rw [show l - wtW R w - (l - wtW R w') = wtW R w' - wtW R w by abel]
          exact fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w')
proof:
:=
  triK_thetaW l w w'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.minusQ_eq_quotientMinus
statement:
lemma minusQ_eq_quotientMinus (x : GrandLoop.Um D 𝕧) :
    minusQ R hvn_ratFunc x = quotientMinus R (negativeQuotientEquiv D x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triA_integralCanonicalBasis
statement:
lemma triA_integralCanonicalBasis (l : Y →+ ℤ) (b b' : canonicalBasis D) :
    triA R l (integralCanonicalBasis D b) (integralCanonicalBasis D b') =
      aTriangularBasisCanonical R (b, l, b')
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_triA, aTriangularBasisCanonical_apply, triangularBasisCanonical_apply,
    integralCanonicalBasis_apply, integralCanonicalBasis_apply]
  have hm := canonicalMinusBasis_mem (R := R) b
  have hp := canonicalPlusBasis_mem (R := R) b'
  rw [canonicalMinusBasis_apply, minusQ_eq_quotientMinus] at hm
  rw [canonicalPlusBasis_apply, plusQ_eq_quotientPlus] at hp
  rw [triK_eq_elt l hm hp]
  exact elt_index rfl rfl (by rw [canonicalMinusBasis_apply, canonicalPlusBasis_apply,
    minusQ_eq_quotientMinus, plusQ_eq_quotientPlus]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triSumEquiv_single
statement:
theorem triSumEquiv_single (l : Y →+ ℤ) (x x' : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    triSumEquiv R (Finsupp.single l (x ⊗ₜ x')) = triA R l x x'
proof:
:= by
  have h : (TensorProduct.mk 𝒜 _ _).compr₂
      ((triSumEquiv R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ Finsupp.lsingle l) = triA R l := by
    refine (integralCanonicalBasis D).ext fun b ↦ (integralCanonicalBasis D).ext fun b' ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
      Function.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [triA_integralCanonicalBasis]
    have : Finsupp.single l (integralCanonicalBasis D b ⊗ₜ integralCanonicalBasis D b') =
        triSumBasis D ⟨l, b, b'⟩ := by
      rw [triSumBasis, Finsupp.coe_basis]
      exact congrArg _ (Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply _ _ _ _).symm
    rw [this, triSumEquiv, Module.Basis.equiv_apply]
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x x'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mem_span_triA_thetaW
statement:
theorem mem_span_triA_thetaW (z : aForm R) :
    z ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 {y | ∃ l w w', y = triA R l (thetaW D w) (thetaW D w')}
proof:
:= by
  set P := Submodule.span 𝒜 {y | ∃ l w w', y = triA R l (thetaW D w) (thetaW D w')}
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (triSumEquiv R).surjective z
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add f g hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hf hg
  | single l t =>
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add t t' ht ht' => rw [Finsupp.single_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ht ht'
    | tmul x x' =>
      rw [triSumEquiv_single]
      have hx := mem_span_thetaW x
      have hx' := mem_span_thetaW x'
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem a ha =>
        obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := ha
        induction hx' using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem b hb =>
          obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hb
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, w, w', rfl⟩
        | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
        | add b c _ _ hb hc => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hb hc
        | smul c b _ hb => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hb
      | zero => rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
      | add a c _ _ ha hc => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem ha hc
      | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_triT
statement:
lemma coe_triT (l : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    (triT R l w w' : Modified R 𝕧) =
      elt (l - wtW R w) (l - wtW R w') (fPow R w * ePow R w')
        (by
          rw [show l - wtW R w - (l - wtW R w') = wtW R w' - wtW R w by abel]
          exact fPow_mul_ePow_mem w w')
proof:
:=
  triA_thetaW l w w'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_eq_triT
statement: lemma one_eq_triT (l : Y →+ ℤ) : (one l : Modified R 𝕧) = triT R l [] []
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_triT, one]
  exact elt_index (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.divF_eq_triT
statement: lemma divF_eq_triT (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) : divF R j m μ = triT R μ [(j, m)] []
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_triT, divF]
  exact elt_index (by simp [wtW_cons, sub_eq_add_neg]) (by simp)
    (by simp [fPow_cons]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.divE_eq_triT
statement:
lemma divE_eq_triT (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    divE R i n μ = triT R (μ + n • R.root i) [] [(i, n)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_triT, divE]
  exact elt_index (by simp) (by simp [wtW_cons]) (by simp [ePow_cons]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_mul_elt'
statement:
lemma elt_mul_elt' {l₁ l₂ l₂' l₃ : Y →+ ℤ} (h : l₂ = l₂') {a b : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l₁ - l₂)) (hb : b ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (l₂' - l₃)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ a ha * elt l₂' l₃ b hb =
      elt l₁ l₃ (a * b) (by subst h; simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact elt_mul_elt _ _ _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_triT
statement:
lemma one_mul_triT (μ l : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    (one μ : Modified R 𝕧) * triT R l w w' =
      if μ = l - wtW R w then (triT R l w w' : Modified R 𝕧) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_triT]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact one_mul_elt _ _ _
  · rw [one]; exact elt_mul_elt_of_ne h _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.divF_mul_triT
statement:
lemma divF_mul_triT (j : I) (m : ℕ) (μ l : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    divF R j m μ * triT R l w w' =
      if μ = l - wtW R w then (triT R l ((j, m) :: w) w' : Modified R 𝕧) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_triT]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    rw [divF, elt_mul_elt, coe_triT]
    exact elt_index (by rw [wtW_cons]; simp only [smul_neg]; abel) rfl
      (by rw [fPow_cons, mul_assoc]) _ _
  · rw [divF]; exact elt_mul_elt_of_ne h _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.divE_mul_triT_nil
statement:
lemma divE_mul_triT_nil (i : I) (n : ℕ) (μ l : Y →+ ℤ) (w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    divE R i n μ * triT R l [] w' =
      if μ = l then (triT R (l + n • R.root i) [] ((i, n) :: w') : Modified R 𝕧) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_triT]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    rw [divE, elt_mul_elt' (by simp), coe_triT]
    exact elt_index (by simp) (by rw [wtW_cons]; abel)
      (by rw [ePow_cons, fPow_nil, one_mul, one_mul]) _ _
  · rw [divE]; exact elt_mul_elt_of_ne (by simpa using h) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triT_cons
statement:
lemma triT_cons (j : I) (m : ℕ) (l : Y →+ ℤ) (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    (triT R l ((j, m) :: w) w' : Modified R 𝕧) = divF R j m (l - wtW R w) * triT R l w w'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [divF_mul_triT, ↓reduceIte]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triS_tmul
statement:
lemma triS_tmul (l : Y →+ ℤ) (s s' : S) (x x' : quotientIntegralForm D) :
    triS R S l (s ⊗ₜ x) (s' ⊗ₜ x') = (s * s') ⊗ₜ triA R l x x'
proof:
:= by
  simp [triS, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons
statement:
lemma pbwDivMonomial_cons (i : B) (ω : List B) (c : Fin (i :: ω).length → ℕ) :
    pbwDivMonomial T Ed (i :: ω) c =
      Ed i (c ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩) * T i (pbwDivMonomial T Ed ω fun n ↦ c n.succ)
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_cons
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivMonomial_cons (i : B) (w : List B) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed (i :: w))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (Ed i)) *
        (Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed w))).map (T i).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_mul_span]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨c 0, rfl⟩, _, ⟨_, ⟨(fun n ↦ c n.succ), rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩, _, ⟨_, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Fin.cons n c, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_append
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivMonomial_append (p s : List B) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed (p ++ s))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed p)) *
        (Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed s))).map
          ((p.map T).prod).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    have hnil : Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed []) = {1} := by
      ext x
      simp [pbwDivMonomial]
    simp [hnil, ← Submodule.one_eq_span, show (1 : A →ₗ[k] A) = LinearMap.id by rfl]
  | cons i p ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, span_pbwDivMonomial_cons, ih, span_pbwDivMonomial_cons]
    have hmap (P Q : Submodule k A) :
        (P * Q).map (T i).toLinearMap = P.map (T i).toLinearMap *
          Q.map (T i).toLinearMap := Submodule.map_mul P Q (T i).toAlgHom
    rw [hmap, mul_assoc, ← Submodule.map_comp]
    rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivMonomial_context {u w : List B}
    (hspan : Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed u)) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed w)))
    (hT : (u.map T).prod = (w.map T).prod) (p s : List B) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed (p ++ u ++ s))) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed (p ++ w ++ s)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc, span_pbwDivMonomial_append,
    span_pbwDivMonomial_append T Ed p (w ++ s), span_pbwDivMonomial_append T Ed u,
    span_pbwDivMonomial_append T Ed w, hspan, hT]

name: CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_zero_exponents
statement:
lemma pbwDivMonomial_zero_exponents (hEd : ∀ i, Ed i 0 = 1) (w : List B) :
    pbwDivMonomial T Ed w (fun _ ↦ 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w ih => simp [pbwDivMonomial_cons, ih, hEd]

name: CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwDivSpan
statement:
lemma one_mem_pbwDivSpan (hEd : ∀ i, Ed i 0 = 1) (w : List B) :
    (1 : A) ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (pbwDivMonomial T Ed w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pbwDivMonomial_zero_exponents T Ed hEd w]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwDivSpan_cons
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwDivMonomial_cons] at hx ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
  | mem_mul_mem a ha b hb =>
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    refine Submodule.mul_mem_mul ?_ hb
    induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem a ha => obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ha; exact hy n
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul c a _ ha => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Ta_apply
statement:
lemma Ta_apply (i : I) (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    Ta R i x = braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Ed_zero
statement: lemma Ed_zero (i : I) : Ed R i 0 = 1
proof: := qDivPow_zero' _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwDiv_eq_smul
statement:
lemma pbwDiv_eq_smul (ω : List I) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial (Ta R) (Ed R) ω c =
      (∏ t : Fin ω.length, (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d ω[t]) (c t))⁻¹) •
      CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root) (E R 𝕧) ω c
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial]
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, CoxeterSystem.pbwMonomial_cons, ih]
    change _ = (∏ t : Fin (ω.length + 1), (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d (i :: ω)[t]) (c t))⁻¹) • _
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    rw [Ta_apply, map_smul, Ed, qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qFactorial_vd_ne_zero
statement: lemma qFactorial_vd_ne_zero (i : I) (n : ℕ) : qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) (NeZero.ne 𝕧) ratFunc_X_not_root i n

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.linearIndependent_pbwDiv
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hli := linearIndependent_pbwMonomial_of_isReduced (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root hω
  rw [linearIndependent_iff'] at hli ⊢
  intro s g hg c hc
  have hs : ∀ c : Fin ω.length → ℕ,
      (∏ t : Fin ω.length, (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d ω[t]) (c t))⁻¹) ≠ 0 := fun c ↦
    prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun t _ ↦ inv_ne_zero (qFactorial_vd_ne_zero _ _)
  have h := hli s (fun c : Fin ω.length → ℕ ↦ LusztigF.integralLaurentEval (g c) *
    ∏ t : Fin ω.length, (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d ω[t]) (c t))⁻¹) (by
      simpa [laurent_smul_U, pbwDiv_eq_smul, smul_smul] using hg) c hc
  exact LusztigF.integralLaurentEval_injective (by
    rw [map_zero]; exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right (hs c))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qSerre_two
statement:
lemma qSerre_two (q : 𝕂) (a b : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    qSerre q 2 a b = a ^ 2 * b - (q + q⁻¹) • (a * b * a) + b * a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, sum_range_succ, range_zero, sum_empty, zero_add, qBinomial_zero_right,
    qBinomial_one_right, qBinomial_self, pow_zero, pow_one, mul_one, one_mul, one_smul,
    Nat.sub_zero, show 2 - 1 = 1 from rfl, Nat.sub_self]
  simp only [qInt, sum_range_succ, range_zero, sum_empty, zero_add]
  simp only [Nat.add_one_sub_one, tsub_zero, pow_one, pow_zero, mul_one, tsub_self, one_mul,
    neg_mul, neg_add_rev, even_two, Even.neg_pow, one_pow, one_smul, add_left_inj]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul, neg_add, add_comm (-q)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_mem_of_isLaurent

lemma smul_mem_of_isLaurent {S : Subalgebra 𝒜 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)} {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsLaurent c)
    {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ S) : c • x ∈ S

lemma isLaurent_iff_mem_range (c : 𝕂) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_a2
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_a2 :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i])) = (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  set α := E R 𝕧 i
  set β := E R 𝕧 j
  set γ := braidEj R 𝕧 i j
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqroot := vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hqroot hn
  have hqq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hqroot
  have hdij : D.d j = D.d i := (D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h').symm
  have hγ : γ = α * β - q⁻¹ • (β * α) := braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h
  have hβα : β * α = q • (α * β) - q • γ := by
    rw [hγ, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, one_smul]; abel
  have hS1 : qSerre q 2 α β = 0 := by
    have := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
    rwa [h, show (1 - -1 : ℤ).toNat = 2 from rfl] at this
  have hS2 : qSerre q 2 β α = 0 := by
    have := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
    rwa [h', show (1 - -1 : ℤ).toNat = 2 from rfl, hdij] at this
  have hαγ : α * γ = q • (γ * α) := by
    have e : α * γ - q • (γ * α) = qSerre q 2 α β := by
      rw [qSerre_two, hγ]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, one_smul, sq, mul_assoc, add_smul]
      abel
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, e, hS1]
  have hβγ : q • (β * γ) = γ * β := by
    have e : q • (β * γ) - γ * β = -qSerre q 2 β α := by
      rw [qSerre_two, hγ]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, one_smul, sq, mul_assoc, add_smul]
      abel
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, e, hS2, neg_zero]
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  
  have hT2 : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i β = γ :=
    a2_rootVector_two hij (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i)
  have hT3 : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root j α) = β :=
    a2_rootVector_three (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i)
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j) hij h h' hqq
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 3 → ℕ, pbwDiv R [i, j, i] c =
      qDivPow q (c 0) α * qDivPow q (c 1) γ * qDivPow q (c 2) β := fun c ↦ by
    have e1 : ∀ n, braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (Ed R j n) = qDivPow q n γ :=
      fun n ↦ by rw [Ed, hmap, hT2, hdij]
    have e2 : ∀ n, braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root j (Ed R i n)) = qDivPow q n β := fun n ↦ by
      rw [Ed, hmap, hmap, hT3]
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one, mul_one]
    rw [e1, e2, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i])) ↔
      x ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ q α β γ := fun x ↦ by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact A2Integral.monomial_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U]
        exact A2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, e, f, g, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [← laurent_smul_U, show qDivPow q e α * qDivPow q f γ * qDivPow q g β =
          pbwDiv R [i, j, i] ![e, f, g] by rw [hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  have hγd : ∀ n, qDivPow q n γ ∈ adjoinPair (R := R) i j := fun n ↦ by
    have e : qDivPow q n γ = braidEjDiv R 𝕧 i j n := by
      have := braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_E_ne ratFunc_X_not_root R hij.symm n
      rw [hdij] at this
      rw [← hT2, ← hmap]
      exact this
    rw [e, braidEjDiv]
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun r _ ↦ smul_mem_of_isLaurent
      ((isLaurent_neg_one.pow r).mul (isLaurent_inv_pow_pow _ _)) ?_
    refine mul_mem (mul_mem ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · rw [hconv] at hx
    induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc, e, f, g, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc (mul_mem (mul_mem ?_ (hγd f)) ?_)
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨g, by rw [Ed, hdij]⟩)
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  · have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ q α β γ :=
      A2Integral.one_mem_orderedSpan
    have hmul : ∀ y ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ q α β γ,
        x * y ∈ A2Integral.orderedSpan Λ q α β γ := by
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩
        · exact fun y hy ↦ A2Integral.qDivPow_α_mul_mem hqi hqΛ hqΛ' n hy
        · intro y hy
          rw [Ed, hdij]
          exact A2Integral.qDivPow_β_mul_mem hq0 hqi hβα hαγ hβγ hqΛ hqΛ' hqq n hy
      | algebraMap a =>
        intro y hy
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def, laurent_smul_U]
        exact A2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hy
      | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
      | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
    rw [hconv]
    simpa using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_a2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_a2_braid :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j, i])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i, j]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pbwDiv_a2 hij h h', span_pbwDiv_a2 hij.symm h' h, adjoinPair, adjoinPair,
    Set.union_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_commuting
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_commuting (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [i, j])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R [j, i]))
proof:
:= by
  have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
  have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h0; exact two_ne_zero h0
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  have hE : ∀ {a b : I}, D.cartanMatrix a b = 0 → a ≠ b →
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root a (E R 𝕧 b) = E R 𝕧 b := by
    intro a b hab hne
    have H := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R a
    change (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root a).toAlgHom (E R 𝕧 b) = _
    rw [H.map_E, ite_eq_right hne.symm, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hab]
  have hmono : ∀ {a b : I}, D.cartanMatrix a b = 0 → a ≠ b → ∀ c : Fin 2 → ℕ,
      pbwDiv R [a, b] c = Ed R a (c 0) * Ed R b (c 1) := fun hab hne c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_apply, _root_.map_one, mul_one, Ed, hmap,
      hE hab hne]
    rfl
  have hc : ∀ m n, Ed R i m * Ed R j n = Ed R j n * Ed R i m := fun m n ↦ by
    simp only [Ed, qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm]
    rw [((Commute.pow_pow (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (R := R) (v := 𝕧) h0) m n)).eq,
      mul_comm (_ : 𝕂)]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨![c 1, c 0], by rw [hmono h0' hij.symm, hmono h0 hij, hc]; rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨![c 1, c 0], by rw [hmono h0' hij.symm, hmono h0 hij, hc]; rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_Ta_apply
statement:
lemma list_Ta_apply (u : List I) (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    (u.map (Ta R)).prod x = (u.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod x
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i u ih => simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, ih, Ta_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_of_braidMove
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, s, i, j, hij, hmij, rfl, rfl⟩ := hm
  have hT : ((CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j).map (Ta R)).prod =
      ((CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i).map (Ta R)).prod := by
    ext x
    rw [list_Ta_apply, list_Ta_apply,
      isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i j hij hmij]
  rcases hSL hij with h0 | h1
  · have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
    have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h0, h0']
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 2 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h0, h0']
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw'] at hT ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (Ta R) (Ed R) (span_pbwDiv_commuting h0) hT p s
  · have h1' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1 := by
      rcases hSL hij.symm with hz | hn
      · have := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm j i).mp hz
        omega
      · exact hn
    have hm : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, h1, h1']
      rfl
    have hm' : D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = 3 := by
      rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, h1, h1']
      rfl
    have hw : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    have hw' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]
      rw [hm']
      rfl
    rw [hw, hw'] at hT ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (Ta R) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDiv_a2_braid hij h1 h1').symm hT p s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R u)) = Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove
    (fun _ _ _ hm ↦ span_pbwDiv_of_braidMove hSL hm)
    hu (CoxeterSystem.reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hu hw huw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_reduced_cons_of_isLeftDescent
statement:
lemma exists_reduced_cons_of_isLeftDescent {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : W} {i : I}
    (hi : cs.IsLeftDescent w i) :
    ∃ u : List I, cs.IsReduced (i :: u) ∧ cs.wordProd (i :: u) = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced (cs.simple i * w)
  have hp : cs.wordProd (i :: u) = w := by
    rw [cs.wordProd_cons, ← he]
    simp
  refine ⟨u, ?_, hp⟩
  unfold CoxeterSystem.IsReduced
  rw [hp, List.length_cons, ← hu.eq, ← he]
  exact ((cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hi).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Ed_mul_mem_span
statement:
lemma Ed_mul_mem_span (i : I) (t n : ℕ) :
    Ed R i t * Ed R i n ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (Ed R i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ed, Ed, A2Integral.qDivPow_mul_qDivPow _ t n (qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i _)]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : IsLaurent (qBinomial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) (t + n) t) :=
    RingHom.mem_range.1 (A2Integral.qBinomial_mem (RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow _))
      (RingHom.mem_range.2 (by have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i); rwa [inv_pow] at this)) _ _)
  rw [← ha, ← laurent_smul_U]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨t + n, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    {i : I} (hi : cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.wordProd w) i) (t : ℕ) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i) * x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu₀⟩ := exists_reduced_cons_of_isLeftDescent cs hi
  have hs := span_pbwDiv_of_isReduced (R := R) hSL cs hu hw hu₀
  rw [← hs] at hx ⊢
  exact CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwDivSpan_cons (Ta R) (Ed R) i u (Ed_mul_mem_span i t) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma mul_mem_aPlus {x y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlus R) (hy : y ∈ aPlus R) :
    x * y ∈ aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, hc, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨c', w', hc', rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, ← ePow_append]
      exact smul_mem_aPlus (hc.mul hc') (ePow_mem_aPlus _)
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | neg y _ hy => rw [mul_neg]; exact neg_mem hy
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hz
  | neg x _ hx => rw [neg_mul]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwDiv_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma pbwDiv_mem_aPlus {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} :
    ∀ (w p : List I), cs.IsReduced (p ++ w) → ∀ c : Fin w.length → ℕ,
      (p.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod (pbwDiv R w c) ∈ aPlus R
proof:
| [], p, _, c => by
    simpa [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial] using ePow_mem_aPlus (R := R) []
  | i :: w, p, hpw, c => by
    rw [pbwDiv, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, Ta_apply, ← AlgEquiv.mul_apply,
      ← List.prod_concat, ← List.map_concat]
    refine mul_mem_aPlus ?_ (pbwDiv_mem_aPlus w (p.concat i) (by simpa using hpw) _)
    have hred : cs.IsReduced (p ++ [i]) := by
      have := hpw.take (p.length + 1)
      rwa [show (p ++ i :: w).take (p.length + 1) = p ++ [i] by
        rw [List.take_length_add_append]
        rfl] at this
    exact list_braid_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus hred _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDiv_longest_eq
statement:
theorem span_pbwDiv_longest_eq {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
  have hplus : ∀ c, pbwDiv R w c ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i)) := fun c ↦ by
    have hc := pbwDiv_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, AlgEquiv.one_apply] at hc
    generalize pbwDiv R w c = y at hc ⊢
    induction hc using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact hplus c
  · intro x hx
    have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ S :=
      CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwDivSpan (Ta R) (Ed R) Ed_zero w
    have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
        exact fun y hy ↦ qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv hSL cs hw
          (hw₀ ▸ cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i) n hy
      | algebraMap a =>
        intro y hy
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
        exact S.smul_mem a hy
      | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
      | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
    simpa using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_span_pbwDiv_longest
statement:
theorem coe_span_pbwDiv_longest {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    (Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w)) : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) = aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      simpa using pbwDiv_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul_U]; exact smul_mem_aPlus ⟨a, rfl⟩ hx
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, span_pbwDiv_longest_eq hSL cs hw hw₀]
    induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_mul_plusHom_of_mem
statement:
lemma K_mul_plusHom_of_mem {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I} (hx : x ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k μ)
    (l : Y) :
    K R v l * plusHom R v x = v ^ R.rootSum μ l • (plusHom R v x * K R v l)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w l, wordChar_eq_rootSum, hw]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, mul_add, hx, hy, add_mul, smul_add]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, mul_smul_comm, hx, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_mul_plusHom
statement:
lemma F_mul_plusHom (i : I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    F R v i * plusHom R v x = plusHom R v x * F R v i -
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (plusHom R v (rDeriv D v i x) * K R v (ktilde R i) -
        K R v (-ktilde R i) * plusHom R v (lDeriv D v i x))
proof:
:= by
  have h : plusHom R v x * F R v i - F R v i * plusHom R v x =
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (plusHom R v (rDeriv D v i x) * K R v (ktilde R i) -
        K R v (-ktilde R i) * plusHom R v (lDeriv D v i x)) :=
    (relations R v).toPreRelations.lift_mul_sub (NeZero.ne v) i x
  rw [← h]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_rho_E_mul_aux
statement:
lemma formFunctional_rho_E_mul_aux (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) {μx ν' : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF k I}
    (hx : x ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k μx) (hr : rDeriv D v i x ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν')
    (hl : rev k I (lDeriv D v i x) ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace k ν')
    (hμ : μx = ν' + Finsupp.single i 1 ∨ (rDeriv D v i x = 0 ∧ lDeriv D v i x = 0))
    (μ : Y) (w' : List I) :
    formFunctional R v hv (ζ - R.root i)
        (rho R v (E R v i) * (plusHom R v x * K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w'))) =
      formFunctional R v hv ζ
        (plusHom R v x * K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w') * rhoBar R v (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := NeZero.ne v
  
  have hFZ : ∀ Z : QuantumGroup R v, F R v i * (plusHom R v x * Z) =
      plusHom R v x * (F R v i * Z) - (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        (plusHom R v (rDeriv D v i x) * (K R v (ktilde R i) * Z) -
          K R v (-ktilde R i) * (plusHom R v (lDeriv D v i x) * Z)) := fun Z ↦ by
    rw [← mul_assoc, F_mul_plusHom, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, sub_mul]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hexp : rho R v (E R v i) * (plusHom R v x * K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w')) =
      v ^ D.d i • (K R v (ktilde R i) *
        (plusHom R v x * (F R v i * (K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w'))))) -
      (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹) • (K R v (ktilde R i) *
        (plusHom R v (rDeriv D v i x) * (K R v (ktilde R i) *
          (K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w'))))) +
      (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹) • (K R v (ktilde R i) *
        (K R v (-ktilde R i) * (plusHom R v (lDeriv D v i x) *
          (K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w'))))) := by
    rw [rho_E, rhoE, Kt, smul_mul_assoc]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    rw [hFZ]
    simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    abel
  have hA : K R v (ktilde R i) *
      (plusHom R v x * (F R v i * (K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w')))) =
      (v ^ R.rootSum μx (ktilde R i) * v ^ R.root i μ) •
        (plusHom R v x * K R v (ktilde R i + μ) * minusHom R v (monomial k (i :: w'))) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, K_mul_plusHom_of_mem hx, smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (F R v i),
      F_mul_K hv0, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, monomial_cons,
      map_mul, minusHom_θ, ← K_add]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hB : K R v (ktilde R i) * (plusHom R v (rDeriv D v i x) *
      (K R v (ktilde R i) * (K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w')))) =
      v ^ R.rootSum ν' (ktilde R i) • (plusHom R v (rDeriv D v i x) *
        K R v (ktilde R i + (ktilde R i + μ)) * minusHom R v (monomial k w')) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, K_mul_plusHom_of_mem hr, smul_mul_assoc, ← K_add, ← K_add]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hC : K R v (ktilde R i) * (K R v (-ktilde R i) * (plusHom R v (lDeriv D v i x) *
      (K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w')))) =
      plusHom R v (lDeriv D v i x) * K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w') := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  
  have hRt : plusHom R v x * K R v μ * minusHom R v (monomial k w') * rhoBar R v (E R v i) =
      ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * v ^ R.rootSum (wordWeight w') (-ktilde R i)) •
        (plusHom R v x * K R v (μ + -ktilde R i) *
          minusHom R v (monomial k (w' ++ [i]))) := by
    rw [rhoBar_E, rhoBarE, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ (minusHom R v _),
      minusHom_monomial_mul_K, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, monomial_append,
      map_mul, monomial_cons, monomial_nil, mul_one, minusHom_θ, ← K_add]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  
  have hfA : form D v (rev k I x) (monomial k (i :: w')) =
      thetaNorm D v i * form D v (rev k I (rDeriv D v i x)) (monomial k w') := by
    rw [monomial_cons, form_comm, form_θ_mul, lDeriv_rev, form_comm]
  have hfR : form D v (rev k I x) (monomial k (w' ++ [i])) =
      thetaNorm D v i * form D v (rev k I (lDeriv D v i x)) (monomial k w') := by
    rw [monomial_append, monomial_cons, monomial_nil, mul_one, form_mul_θ_right, rDeriv_rev]
  rw [hexp, hRt, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hA, hB, hC, map_smul,
    map_smul, formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial,
    formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial, formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial,
    formFunctional_plusHom_K_minusHom_monomial, hfA, hfR]
  rcases hμ with rfl | ⟨h0r, h0l⟩
  swap
  · simp [h0r, h0l]
  by_cases hν : ν' = wordWeight w'
  · subst hν
    have he := normSq_wordWeight_emod_two (R := R) w'
    have hd : (2 : ℤ) * D.d i = D.dot i i := D.two_mul_d i
    have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv0
    have ht : thetaNorm D v i = v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
      rw [thetaNorm, show v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ =
        ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹))⁻¹ by rw [mul_inv, inv_inv]]
      congr 1
      rw [mul_sub, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, sq]
    have e1 : v ^ R.rootSum (wordWeight w' + Finsupp.single i 1) (ktilde R i) * v ^ R.root i μ *
        formScale R v (ζ - R.root i) (ktilde R i + μ) (wordWeight (i :: w')) * v ^ D.d i =
        v ^ R.rootSum (wordWeight w') (ktilde R i) *
          formScale R v (ζ - R.root i) (ktilde R i + (ktilde R i + μ)) (wordWeight w') := by
      rw [formScale, formScale, ← zpow_natCast]
      simp only [← zpow_add₀ hv0]
      congr 1
      simp only [wordWeight_cons, normSq_single_add, LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_add,
        LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_single, one_smul, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
        AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, map_add, ktildeSum_add, ktildeSum_single,
        rootSum_ktilde_eq_root_ktildeSum, root_ktilde_eq_dot]
      omega
    have e2 : formScale R v (ζ - R.root i) μ (wordWeight w') = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ *
        v ^ R.rootSum (wordWeight w') (-ktilde R i) *
          formScale R v ζ (μ + -ktilde R i) (wordWeight (w' ++ [i])) := by
      rw [formScale, formScale, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg]
      simp only [← zpow_add₀ hv0]
      congr 1
      simp only [wordWeight_append, wordWeight_cons, wordWeight_nil, add_zero,
        add_comm (wordWeight w') (Finsupp.single i 1), normSq_single_add,
        LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_add, LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_single,
        one_smul, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, map_add, map_neg,
        ktildeSum_add, ktildeSum_single, rootSum_ktilde_eq_root_ktildeSum, root_ktilde_eq_dot]
      omega
    generalize form D v (rev k I (rDeriv D v i x)) (monomial k w') = fr
    generalize form D v (rev k I (lDeriv D v i x)) (monomial k w') = fl
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [ht]
    linear_combination
      (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ * fr) * e1 +
      (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ * fl) * e2
  · have h1 : form D v (rev k I (rDeriv D v i x)) (monomial k w') = 0 :=
      form_eq_zero_of_ne D v hν (rev_mem_weightSpace hr) (monomial_mem_weightSpace w')
    have h2 : form D v (rev k I (lDeriv D v i x)) (monomial k w') = 0 :=
      form_eq_zero_of_ne D v hν hl (monomial_mem_weightSpace w')
    simp [h1, h2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_rho_E_mul
statement:
theorem formFunctional_rho_E_mul (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    formFunctional R v hv (ζ - R.root i) (rho R v (E R v i) * u) =
      formFunctional R v hv ζ (u * rhoBar R v (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_plusHom_K_minusHom (NeZero.ne v) with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_mul, map_add]
  | hsmul c x hx => rw [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hx, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]
  | hmon w μ w' =>
    have hw := monomial_mem_weightSpace (k := k) w
    by_cases hi : wordWeight w i = 0
    · have h0r : rDeriv D v i (monomial k w) = 0 := rDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D v i hi hw
      have h0l' : rev k I (lDeriv D v i (monomial k w)) = 0 := by
        rw [← rDeriv_rev]; exact rDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D v i hi (rev_mem_weightSpace hw)
      have h0l : lDeriv D v i (monomial k w) = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (rev k I) h0l'
        rwa [rev_rev, map_zero] at h
      refine formFunctional_rho_E_mul_aux hv ζ i (ν' := 0) hw ?_ ?_ (Or.inr ⟨h0r, h0l⟩) μ w'
      · rw [h0r]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · rw [h0l']; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · have hle : Finsupp.single i 1 ≤ wordWeight w :=
        Finsupp.single_le_iff.2 (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hi)
      have hμ : wordWeight w = (wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1) + Finsupp.single i 1 :=
        (tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle).symm
      have hw' : monomial k w ∈
          LusztigF.weightSpace k ((wordWeight w - Finsupp.single i 1) + Finsupp.single i 1) :=
        hμ ▸ hw
      refine formFunctional_rho_E_mul_aux hv ζ i hw (rDeriv_mem_weightSpace D v i hw') ?_
        (Or.inl hμ) μ w'
      rw [← rDeriv_rev]
      exact rDeriv_mem_weightSpace D v i (rev_mem_weightSpace hw')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rhoBar_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma rhoBar_mem_adWeightSpace {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) : rhoBar R v x ∈ adWeightSpace R v (-χ)
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h := congrArg (rhoBar R v) (hx μ)
  rw [rhoBar_mul, map_smul, rhoBar_mul, rhoBar_K] at h
  rw [AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, h, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero,
    one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_rightAct_left_of_mem
statement:
lemma form_rightAct_left_of_mem {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ)
    (H : ∀ ζ z, z ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ →
      formFunctional R v hv (ζ - χ) (rho R v u * z) = formFunctional R v hv ζ (z * rhoBar R v u))
    (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (rightAct R v hv u x) y = form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v u) y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ a ha =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, hy, hy']
  | helt m₁ m₂ b hb =>
    rw [rightAct_elt hv hu, rightAct_elt hv (rhoBar_mem_adWeightSpace hu), form_elt_elt,
      form_elt_elt]
    have e : ((l₁, l₂ - χ) = (m₁, m₂)) ↔ ((l₁, l₂) = (m₁, m₂ - -χ)) := by
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, sub_neg_eq_add, sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₃
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h₂
      have hz : rho R v a * b ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ := by
        have := mul_mem_adWeightSpace (rho_mem_adWeightSpace ha) hb
        convert this using 2
        abel
      rw [rho_mul, mul_assoc, H _ _ hz, mul_assoc]
    · exact absurd (e.1 h₁) h₂
    · exact absurd (e.2 h₃) h₁
    · rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_rightAct_left_rhoBar
statement:
lemma form_rightAct_left_rhoBar {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (H : ∀ x y, form R v hv (rightAct R v hv u x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v u) y))
    (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v u) x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v (rhoBar R v u)) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_comm, ← H, form_comm, rhoBar_rhoBar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_rightAct_left_mul
statement:
lemma form_rightAct_left_mul {u u' : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : ∀ x y, form R v hv (rightAct R v hv u x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v u) y))
    (hu' : ∀ x y, form R v hv (rightAct R v hv u' x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v u') y))
    (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (rightAct R v hv (u * u') x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v (u * u')) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightAct_mul, hu', hu, ← rightAct_mul, ← rhoBar_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_rightAct_left_smul
statement:
lemma form_rightAct_left_smul (c : k) {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : ∀ x y, form R v hv (rightAct R v hv u x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v u) y))
    (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (rightAct R v hv (c • u) x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v (c • u)) y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hu]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_rightAct_left
statement:
theorem form_rightAct_left (u : QuantumGroup R v) (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (rightAct R v hv u x) y = form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v u) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ∀ i x y, form R v hv (rightAct R v hv (E R v i) x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v (E R v i)) y) :=
    fun i ↦ form_rightAct_left_of_mem hv (E_mem_adWeightSpace i) fun ζ z _ ↦
      formFunctional_rho_E_mul hv ζ i z
  have hK : ∀ μ x y, form R v hv (rightAct R v hv (K R v μ) x) y =
      form R v hv x (rightAct R v hv (rhoBar R v (K R v μ)) y) :=
    fun μ ↦ form_rightAct_left_of_mem hv (K_mem_adWeightSpace μ) fun ζ z hz ↦ by
      have h := hz μ
      rw [AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_smul] at h
      rw [rho_K, rhoBar_K, sub_zero, h]
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on generalizing x y with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    refine form_rightAct_left_smul hv c (fun x y ↦ ?_) x y
    rw [rightAct_one, rhoBar_one, rightAct_one]
  | E i => exact hE i x y
  | K μ => exact hK μ x y
  | F i =>
    have h := form_rightAct_left_rhoBar hv (u := rhoBar R v (F R v i)) (fun x y ↦ by
      rw [rhoBar_F, rhoBarF]
      exact form_rightAct_left_smul hv _ (form_rightAct_left_mul hv (hK _) (hE i)) x y) x y
    rwa [rhoBar_rhoBar] at h
  | add u u' hu hu' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hu']
  | mul u u' hu hu' => exact form_rightAct_left_mul hv hu hu' x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_apply
statement:
theorem leftActOne_apply (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    leftActOne R hv μ u = leftAct R v hv u (one μ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_one
statement: theorem leftActOne_one (μ : Y →+ ℤ) : leftActOne R hv μ 1 = one μ
proof:
:=
  leftAct_one hv _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_eq_elt
proof:
:=
  leftAct_one_eq_elt hv _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_elt_eq_ite
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    exact one_mul_elt _ _ _
  · exact elt_mul_elt_of_ne h _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftAct_mul_right
statement:
theorem leftAct_mul_right (u : QuantumGroup R v) (x y : Modified R v) :
    leftAct R v hv u (x * y) = leftAct R v hv u x * y
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, add_mul]
  | hhom χ u hu =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => simp only [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ s hs =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy']
  | helt m₁ m₂ t ht =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv hu]
    by_cases h : l₂ = m₁
    · subst h
      rw [elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt, leftAct_elt hv hu]
      exact elt_index rfl rfl (mul_assoc u s t).symm _ _
    · rw [elt_mul_elt_of_ne h, elt_mul_elt_of_ne h, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_mul_leftActOne
statement:
theorem leftActOne_mul_leftActOne {χ χ' : Y →+ ℤ} {u u' : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) (hu' : u' ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ') (μ ν : Y →+ ℤ) :
    leftActOne R hv μ u * leftActOne R hv ν u' =
      if μ = ν + χ' then leftActOne R hv ν (u * u') else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftActOne_eq_elt hv hu, leftActOne_eq_elt hv hu']
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    rw [elt_mul_elt, leftActOne_eq_elt hv (mul_mem_adWeightSpace hu hu')]
    exact elt_index (by abel) rfl rfl _ _
  · exact elt_mul_elt_of_ne h _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_mul
statement:
theorem leftActOne_mul (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) (w : Modified R v) :
    leftActOne R hv μ u * w = leftAct R v hv u (one μ * w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftAct_mul_right, leftActOne_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftAct_K_elt
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : K R v x * t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂) := by
    simpa using mul_mem_adWeightSpace (K_mem_adWeightSpace x) ht
  rw [leftAct_elt hv (K_mem_adWeightSpace x), elt_index (add_zero l₁) rfl rfl _ h2,
    elt_K_mul l₁ l₂ x ht h2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_K
statement:
theorem leftActOne_K (μ : Y →+ ℤ) (x : Y) :
    leftActOne R hv μ (K R v x) = v ^ μ x • one μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftActOne_apply, one, leftAct_K_elt]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_one_mul
statement:
theorem form_one_mul (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (one ν * x) y = form R v hv x (one ν * y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ s hs =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, hy, hy']
  | helt m₁ m₂ t ht =>
    rw [one_mul_elt_eq_ite, one_mul_elt_eq_ite]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · rfl
    · rw [map_zero, form_elt_elt_of_ne hv]
      intro h
      exact h2 (h1.trans (Prod.mk.inj h).1)
    · rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, form_elt_elt_of_ne hv]
      intro h
      exact h1 (h2.trans (Prod.mk.inj h).1.symm)
    · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_leftAct_rho_E
statement:
theorem one_mul_leftAct_rho_E (i : I) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w : Modified R v) :
    one ν * leftAct R v hv (rho R v (E R v i)) w =
      (v ^ D.d i * v ^ ν (ktilde R i)) • leftAct R v hv (F R v i) (one (ν + R.root i) * w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, mul_add, hx, hy, mul_add, map_add, smul_add]
  | helt m₁ m₂ t ht =>
    rw [rho_E, rhoE, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, leftAct_mul,
      leftAct_elt hv (F_mem_adWeightSpace i), leftAct_K_elt, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm,
      one_mul_elt_eq_ite, one_mul_elt_eq_ite]
    by_cases h : ν = m₁ + -R.root i
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (by rw [h]; abel),
        leftAct_elt hv (F_mem_adWeightSpace i), smul_smul, h]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun h' ↦ h (by rw [← h']; abel)), smul_zero, map_zero,
        smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_leftAct_rho_F
statement:
theorem one_mul_leftAct_rho_F (i : I) (ν : Y →+ ℤ) (w : Modified R v) :
    one ν * leftAct R v hv (rho R v (F R v i)) w =
      (v ^ D.d i * v ^ ν (-ktilde R i)) •
        leftAct R v hv (E R v i) (one (ν - R.root i) * w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, mul_add, hx, hy, mul_add, map_add, smul_add]
  | helt m₁ m₂ t ht =>
    rw [rho_F, rhoF, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, leftAct_mul,
      leftAct_elt hv (E_mem_adWeightSpace i), leftAct_K_elt, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm,
      one_mul_elt_eq_ite, one_mul_elt_eq_ite]
    by_cases h : ν = m₁ + R.root i
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (by rw [h]; abel),
        leftAct_elt hv (E_mem_adWeightSpace i), smul_smul, h]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun h' ↦ h (by rw [← h']; abel)), smul_zero, map_zero,
        smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: LinearMap.bijective_of_sub_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem LinearMap.bijective_of_sub_mem_filtration {R V : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module R V] (S : V →ₗ[R] V) (G : ℕ → Submodule R V) (h0 : G 0 = ⊥)
    (htop : ∀ z, ∃ d, z ∈ G d) (hS : ∀ d, ∀ z ∈ G (d + 1), S z - z ∈ G d) :
    Function.Bijective S
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ d, ∀ z ∈ G d, S z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero => intro z hz _; rw [h0] at hz; exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).1 hz
    | succ d ih =>
      intro z hz hSz
      refine ih z ?_ hSz
      have h := hS d z hz
      rw [hSz, zero_sub] at h
      exact neg_mem_iff.1 h
  have hsurj : ∀ d, ∀ w ∈ G d, ∃ u, S u = w := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero => intro w hw; rw [h0] at hw; exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, (Submodule.mem_bot R).1 hw]⟩
    | succ d ih =>
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih _ (hS d w hw)
      exact ⟨w - u, by rw [map_sub, hu, sub_sub_cancel]⟩
  refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero S).2 fun z hz ↦ ?_, fun w ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := htop z
    exact hinj d z hd hz
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := htop w
    exact hsurj d w hd

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  rw [← mul_smul, hu μ, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hm μ, smul_comm u, smul_smul,
    AddMonoidHom.add_apply, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.modRel_smul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma modRel_smul_eq_zero {L ζ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M ζ)
    {x : QuantumGroup R v} (hx : x ∈ modRel R v L ζ) : x • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · have hum := smul_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace hu hm
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at hum
      rw [mul_smul, sub_smul, hum μ, algebraMap_smul, sub_self]
    · rw [mul_smul, sub_smul, hm μ, algebraMap_smul, sub_self, smul_zero]
  | zero => rw [zero_smul]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_smul, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_assoc, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.weightAct_elt
statement:
lemma weightAct_elt (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M ζ) (L l : Y →+ ℤ)
    {u : QuantumGroup R v} (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l)) :
    weightAct R ζ m hm (elt L l u hu) = if l = ζ then u • m else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightAct, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  by_cases h : l = ζ
  · subst h
    simp only [weightActComp, Comp.mk, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte]
    rfl
  · simp [weightActComp, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.weightAct_leftActOne
statement:
theorem weightAct_leftActOne (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M ζ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    weightAct R ζ m hm (leftActOne R hv ζ u) = u • m
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => rw [map_zero, map_zero, zero_smul]
  | hadd a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_smul]
  | hhom χ u hu => rw [leftActOne_eq_elt hv hu, weightAct_elt]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_mul_K
statement:
lemma leftActOne_mul_K (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v)
    (μ : Y) : leftActOne R hv ζ (u * K R v μ) = v ^ ζ μ • leftActOne R hv ζ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftActOne_apply, leftAct_mul, ← leftActOne_apply, leftActOne_K, map_smul,
    leftActOne_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaTensorHwv_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma vermaTensorHwv_mem_weightSpace :
    vermaTensorHwv R v Λ Λ' ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ' - Λ)
proof:
:= by
  have hξ : ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _ (VermaModule.hwv R v Λ) ∈
      weightSpace R v (ChevalleyTwist R v (VermaModule R v Λ)) (-Λ) := fun μ ↦ by
    rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_K, VermaModule.K_smul_hwv, LinearEquiv.map_smul,
      map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]
  have h := TensorModule.tmul_mem_weightSpace hξ (VermaModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R)
    (v := v) (Λ := Λ'))
  rwa [neg_add_eq_sub] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.plusHom_smul_tmul_hwv
statement:
lemma plusHom_smul_tmul_hwv {M₁ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module k M₁]
    [Module (QuantumGroup R v) M₁] [IsScalarTower k (QuantumGroup R v) M₁]
    (x : LusztigF k I) (a : M₁) :
    plusHom R v x • TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ') (a ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.hwv R v Λ') =
      TensorModule.mk _ _ ((plusHom R v x • a) ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.hwv R v Λ')
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing a with
  | grade0 c =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul, ← map_smul, smul_tmul']
  | grade1 i =>
    rw [← LusztigF.θ, plusHom_θ, TensorModule.E_smul_tmul, VermaModule.E_smul_hwv, tmul_zero,
      add_zero]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [_root_.map_mul, mul_smul, hb, ha, mul_smul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_smul, ha, hb, add_smul, add_tmul, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.monomial_mem_degSpan
statement:
lemma monomial_mem_degSpan {w : List I} {d : ℕ} (h : w.length < d) :
    LusztigF.monomial k w ∈ degSpan k I d
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, h, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.degSpan_mono
statement: lemma degSpan_mono {d d' : ℕ} (h : d ≤ d') : degSpan k I d ≤ degSpan k I d'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun _ hw ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le hw h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.degSpan_zero
statement: lemma degSpan_zero : degSpan k I 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [degSpan]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_mem_degSpan
statement: lemma exists_mem_degSpan (y : LusztigF k I) : ∃ d, y ∈ degSpan k I d
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range (LusztigF.monomial k (I := I))) := by
    rw [LusztigF.span_monomial]; trivial
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨w.length + 1, monomial_mem_degSpan (Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨max d d', add_mem (degSpan_mono (le_max_left _ _) hd)
      (degSpan_mono (le_max_right _ _) hd')⟩
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨d, Submodule.smul_mem _ c hd⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.θ_mul_mem_degSpan
statement:
lemma θ_mul_mem_degSpan (i : I) {d : ℕ} {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ degSpan k I d) :
    LusztigF.θ k i * y ∈ degSpan k I (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [← LusztigF.monomial_cons]
    exact monomial_mem_degSpan (by simpa using hw)
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaDegSpan_mono
statement:
lemma vermaDegSpan_mono {d d' : ℕ} (h : d ≤ d') :
    vermaDegSpan R v Λ' d ≤ vermaDegSpan R v Λ' d'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map_mono (degSpan_mono h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan
statement:
lemma K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan (μ : Y) {d : ℕ} {b : VermaModule R v Λ'}
    (hb : b ∈ vermaDegSpan R v Λ' d) : K R v μ • b ∈ vermaDegSpan R v Λ' d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hb
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [VermaModule.toVerma_mem_weightSpace (LusztigF.monomial_mem_weightSpace w) μ]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ⟨_, monomial_mem_degSpan hw, rfl⟩
  | zero => rw [map_zero, smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, smul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.F_smul_toVerma
statement:
lemma F_smul_toVerma (i : I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    F R v i • VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ' y = VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ' (LusztigF.θ k i * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [VermaModule.toVerma_apply, VermaModule.toVerma_apply, _root_.map_mul, minusHom_θ, mul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.F_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan
statement:
lemma F_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan (i : I) {d : ℕ} {b : VermaModule R v Λ'}
    (hb : b ∈ vermaDegSpan R v Λ' d) : F R v i • b ∈ vermaDegSpan R v Λ' (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hb
  rw [F_smul_toVerma]
  exact ⟨_, θ_mul_mem_degSpan i hy, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.tmul_mem_tensorDegSpan
proof:
:=
  Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ Submodule.mem_top hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.tensorDegSpan_mono
statement:
lemma tensorDegSpan_mono {d d' : ℕ} (h : d ≤ d') :
    tensorDegSpan (R := R) (v := v) M₁ Λ' d ≤ tensorDegSpan M₁ Λ' d'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map₂_le_map₂_right (vermaDegSpan_mono Λ' h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.F_smul_mem_tensorDegSpan
proof:
:= by
  have h : tensorDegSpan (R := R) (v := v) M₁ Λ' d ≤ (tensorDegSpan M₁ Λ' (d + 1)).comap
      (DistribSMul.toLinearMap k _ (F R v i)) := by
    refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun a _ b hb ↦ ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Submodule.mem_comap, DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply]
    rw [TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, map_add]
    exact add_mem (tmul_mem_tensorDegSpan Λ' _ (vermaDegSpan_mono Λ' (Nat.le_succ d)
      (K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ' _ hb))) (tmul_mem_tensorDegSpan Λ' _
        (F_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ' i hb))
  exact h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.minusHom_monomial_smul_tmul_hwv_sub_mem
statement:
lemma minusHom_monomial_smul_tmul_hwv_sub_mem (w : List I) (a : M₁) :
    minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) •
        TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ') (a ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.hwv R v Λ') -
      TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ')
        (a ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ' (LusztigF.monomial k w)) ∈
      tensorDegSpan M₁ Λ' w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [LusztigF.monomial_nil, _root_.map_one, one_smul, VermaModule.toVerma_apply,
      _root_.map_one, one_smul, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  | cons i w ih =>
