    set b := VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ' (LusztigF.monomial k w)
    have hb : b ∈ vermaDegSpan R v Λ' (w.length + 1) :=
      ⟨_, monomial_mem_degSpan (Nat.lt_succ_self _), rfl⟩
    have e : minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k (i :: w)) •
          TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ') (a ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.hwv R v Λ') -
        TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ')
          (a ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ' (LusztigF.monomial k (i :: w))) =
        F R v i • (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) •
          TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ') (a ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.hwv R v Λ') -
          TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ') (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) +
        TensorModule.mk M₁ (VermaModule R v Λ')
          ((F R v i • a) ⊗ₜ[k] (K R v (-ktilde R i) • b)) := by
      rw [smul_sub, TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, LusztigF.monomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, minusHom_θ,
        mul_smul, F_smul_toVerma, ← LusztigF.monomial_cons, map_add]
      abel
    rw [e, List.length_cons]
    exact add_mem (F_smul_mem_tensorDegSpan Λ' i ih)
      (tmul_mem_tensorDegSpan Λ' _ (K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ' _ hb))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triMul_tmul
statement:
lemma triMul_tmul (y x : LusztigF k I) :
    triMul R hv' (Submodule.Quotient.mk y ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      minusHom R v y * plusHom R v x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_leftActOne_eq_triMul
statement:
lemma exists_leftActOne_eq_triMul (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    ∃ z, leftActOne R hv' ζ u = leftActOne R hv' ζ (triMul R hv' z)
proof:
:= by
  induction VermaModule.mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨(v ^ R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w') μ * v ^ ζ μ) •
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (LusztigF.monomial k w) ⊗ₜ
        Submodule.Quotient.mk (LusztigF.monomial k w')), ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, triMul_tmul, mul_assoc,
      K_mul_plusHom_of_mem (LusztigF.monomial_mem_weightSpace w') μ, mul_smul_comm, map_smul,
      ← mul_assoc, leftActOne_mul_K, smul_smul]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨z + z', by rw [map_add, hz, hz', map_add, map_add]⟩
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨c • z, by rw [map_smul, hz, map_smul, map_smul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triEquiv_tmul
statement:
lemma triEquiv_tmul (y : fQ) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    triEquiv R hv' Λ Λ' (y ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      TensorModule.mk _ _ ((plusHom R v x • ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _
        (VermaModule.hwv R v Λ)) ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.equivSerreQuotient (R := R) Λ' hv' y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_plusHom]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triAct_sub_triEquiv_mem
statement:
lemma triAct_sub_triEquiv_mem (w : List I) (x : LusztigF k I) :
    triAct R hv' Λ Λ' (Submodule.Quotient.mk (LusztigF.monomial k w) ⊗ₜ
        Submodule.Quotient.mk x) -
      triEquiv R hv' Λ Λ' (Submodule.Quotient.mk (LusztigF.monomial k w) ⊗ₜ
        Submodule.Quotient.mk x) ∈
      tensorDegSpan _ Λ' w.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [triEquiv_tmul, VermaModule.equivSerreQuotient_mk, ← VermaModule.toVerma_apply]
  change (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) * plusHom R v x) • vermaTensorHwv R v Λ Λ' - _ ∈ _
  rw [mul_smul, vermaTensorHwv, plusHom_smul_tmul_hwv]
  exact minusHom_monomial_smul_tmul_hwv_sub_mem Λ' w _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bijective_triAct
statement: theorem bijective_triAct : Function.Bijective (triAct R hv' Λ Λ')
proof:
:= by
  set e := triEquiv R hv' Λ Λ'
  set G : ℕ → Submodule k (fQ ⊗[k] fQ) := fun d ↦
    Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk k fQ fQ) ((degSpan k I d).map (Submodule.mkQ _)) ⊤
  have hGmono : ∀ {d d'}, d ≤ d' → G d ≤ G d' := fun h ↦
    Submodule.map₂_le_map₂_left (Submodule.map_mono (degSpan_mono h))
  have hW : ∀ d, ∀ z ∈ tensorDegSpan _ Λ' d, e.symm z ∈ G d := by
    intro d z hz
    have h : tensorDegSpan (ChevalleyTwist R v (VermaModule R v Λ)) Λ' d ≤ (G d).comap
        e.symm.toLinearMap := by
      refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun a _ b hb ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hb
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := ((VermaModule.equivSerreQuotient (R := R) Λ hv').trans
        (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _)).surjective a
      have e' : e (Submodule.Quotient.mk y ⊗ₜ q) = TensorModule.mk _ _
          (((VermaModule.equivSerreQuotient (R := R) Λ hv').trans
            (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R v _)) q ⊗ₜ[k] VermaModule.toVerma R v Λ' y) := rfl
      simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
        Submodule.mem_comap]
      rw [← e', LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ Submodule.mem_top
    exact h hz
  have hS : ∀ d, ∀ z ∈ G (d + 1),
      (e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ triAct R hv' Λ Λ') z - z ∈ G d := by
    intro d z hz
    have h : G (d + 1) ≤ (G d).comap (e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ triAct R hv' Λ Λ' - LinearMap.id) := by
      refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun p hp q _ ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _ q
      simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, Submodule.mem_comap]
      induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hy =>
        obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
        have hmem := hW d _ (tensorDegSpan_mono (R := R) (v := v) Λ' (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hw)
          (triAct_sub_triEquiv_mem hv' Λ Λ' w x))
        rwa [map_sub, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hmem
      | zero => rw [map_zero, zero_tmul, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add, add_tmul, map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
      | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, ← smul_tmul', map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
    simpa using h hz
  have hbij := LinearMap.bijective_of_sub_mem_filtration
    (e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ triAct R hv' Λ Λ') G
    (by simp [G, degSpan_zero]) (fun z ↦ ?_) hS
  · have h : triAct R hv' Λ Λ' = e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ triAct R hv' Λ Λ') := by
      ext; simp
    rw [h, LinearMap.coe_comp]
    exact e.bijective.comp hbij
  · induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul p q =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _ p
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_mem_degSpan y
      exact ⟨d, Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ ⟨y, hd, rfl⟩ Submodule.mem_top⟩
    | add z z' hz hz' =>
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := hz'
      exact ⟨max d d', add_mem (hGmono (le_max_left _ _) hd) (hGmono (le_max_right _ _) hd')⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_vermaTensorHwv_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem smul_vermaTensorHwv_eq_zero_iff (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    u • vermaTensorHwv R v Λ Λ' = 0 ↔ leftActOne R hv' (Λ' - Λ) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_leftActOne_eq_triMul hv' (Λ' - Λ) u
    have hm := vermaTensorHwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) Λ Λ'
    have h' : triAct R hv' Λ Λ' z = 0 := by
      change triMul R hv' z • vermaTensorHwv R v Λ Λ' = 0
      rw [← weightAct_leftActOne hv' _ _ hm, ← hz, weightAct_leftActOne, h]
    rw [hz, (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).1 (bijective_triAct hv' Λ Λ').1 z h', map_zero,
      map_zero]
  · rw [← weightAct_leftActOne hv' _ _ (vermaTensorHwv_mem_weightSpace Λ Λ'), h, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.surjective_smul_vermaTensorHwv
statement:
theorem surjective_smul_vermaTensorHwv :
    Function.Surjective fun u : QuantumGroup R v ↦ u • vermaTensorHwv R v Λ Λ'
proof:
:= fun n ↦ by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (bijective_triAct hv' Λ Λ').2 n
  exact ⟨triMul R hv' z, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaTensorEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem vermaTensorEquiv_apply (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    vermaTensorEquiv hv' Λ Λ' ⟨leftActOne R hv' (Λ' - Λ) u, u, rfl⟩ =
      u • vermaTensorHwv R v Λ Λ'
proof:
:=
  weightAct_leftActOne hv' _ _ _ u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomZ_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qBinomZ_zero (m : ℤ) : qBinomZ q m 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomZ_succ
statement:
lemma qBinomZ_succ (m : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    qBinomZ q m (t + 1) = qBinomZ q m t * qIntZ q (m - t) / qIntZ q (t + 1)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomZ_succ_succ
statement:
lemma qBinomZ_succ_succ (m : ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    qBinomZ q (m + 1) (t + 1) = qBinomZ q m t * qIntZ q (m + 1) / qIntZ q (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [qBinomZ_succ]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [qBinomZ_succ, ih, qBinomZ_succ]
    have e : m + 1 - ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = m - t := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e]
    push_cast
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_mul_sub_mul
statement:
lemma qIntZ_mul_sub_mul (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (x y s : ℤ) :
    qIntZ q x * qIntZ q y - qIntZ q (x - s) * qIntZ q (y - s) =
      qIntZ q s * qIntZ q (x + y - s)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q - q⁻¹ = 0
  · simp [qIntZ, hq]
  simp only [qIntZ, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add, neg_neg, zpow_add₀ hq0, zpow_neg]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_mul_qBinomZ_succ
statement:
lemma qIntZ_mul_qBinomZ_succ (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (m N : ℤ) (t : ℕ) (ht : qIntZ q (t + 1) ≠ 0) :
    qIntZ q (N + 1) * qBinomZ q (m + 1) (t + 1) =
      qIntZ q (N - t) * qBinomZ q m (t + 1) + qIntZ q (m + N + 1 - t) * qBinomZ q m t
proof:
:= by
  rw [qBinomZ_succ_succ, qBinomZ_succ]
  have h := qIntZ_mul_sub_mul hq0 (N + 1) (m + 1) (t + 1)
  have e1 : N + 1 - (t + 1) = N - t := by ring
  have e2 : m + 1 - (t + 1) = m - t := by ring
  have e3 : N + 1 + (m + 1) - (t + 1) = m + N + 1 - t := by ring
  rw [e1, e2, e3] at h
  field_simp
  linear_combination qBinomZ q m t * h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_zero'
statement: lemma qDivPow_zero' {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (q : k) (x : B) : qDivPow q 0 x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [qDivPow, qFactorial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mul_qDivPow
statement:
lemma mul_qDivPow (q : k) {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (x : B) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : qInt q (n + 1) ≠ 0) : x * qDivPow q n x = qInt q (n + 1) • qDivPow q (n + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qDivPow, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, qFactorial_succ, mul_inv, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hn, one_mul, pow_succ']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.vd_pow_ne_one
statement: lemma vd_pow_ne_one (i : I) : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (v ^ D.d i) ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [← pow_mul]; exact hv _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) hn)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qInt_vd_ne_zero
statement: lemma qInt_vd_ne_zero (i : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : qInt (v ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) (vd_pow_ne_one hv i) hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qIntZ_vd_ne_zero
statement: lemma qIntZ_vd_ne_zero (i : I) {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : qIntZ (v ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  qIntZ_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)) (vd_pow_ne_one hv i) hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_E_smul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma pow_E_smul_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (i : I)
    (n : ℕ) : E R v i ^ n • m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ + n • R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, succ_nsmul, ← add_assoc]
    exact E_smul_mem_weightSpace ih i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_E_smul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma qDivPow_E_smul_mem_weightSpace {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ)
    (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i) • m ∈ weightSpace R v M (Λ + n • R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow, smul_assoc]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_E_smul_mem_weightSpace hm i n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul
statement:
lemma E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ) (i : I)
    (n : ℕ) :
    E R v i • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) (F R v i) • m) =
      qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) (F R v i) • (E R v i • m) +
        qIntZ (v ^ D.d i) (Λ (R.coroot i) - n) • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i) • m)
proof:
:= by
  set q := v ^ D.d i with hqdef
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have h := E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) i n (qInt_vd_ne_zero hv i n.succ_pos)
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h
  have hK : ((q)⁻¹ ^ n • Kt R v i - q ^ n • K R v (-ktilde R i)) • m =
      (q⁻¹ ^ n * q ^ Λ (R.coroot i) - q ^ n * q ^ (-Λ (R.coroot i))) • m := by
    rw [sub_smul, smul_assoc, smul_assoc, Kt_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hm,
      K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_weightSpace hm, smul_smul, smul_smul, sub_smul]
  have hc : (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * (q⁻¹ ^ n * q ^ Λ (R.coroot i) - q ^ n * q ^ (-Λ (R.coroot i))) =
      qIntZ q (Λ (R.coroot i) - n) := by
    rw [qIntZ, div_eq_inv_mul, neg_sub, zpow_sub₀ hq0, zpow_sub₀ hq0, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
      inv_pow]
    ring
  rw [← mul_smul, h, add_smul, mul_smul, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hK, smul_comm _ (_ : k),
    smul_smul, hc]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_mul_qDivPow_E
statement:
lemma E_mul_qDivPow_E (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    E R v i * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i) =
      qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) • qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) (E R v i)
proof:
:=
  mul_qDivPow _ _ n (qInt_vd_ne_zero hv i n.succ_pos)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul {Λ : Y →+ ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ weightSpace R v M Λ)
    (i : I) (N M' : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) N (E R v i) • qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) M' (F R v i) • m =
      ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), efTerm R v i (Λ (R.coroot i)) N M' t m
proof:
:= by
  set h := Λ (R.coroot i)
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [efTerm, qDivPow_zero']
  | succ N ih =>
    have hc : qInt (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1) ≠ 0 := qInt_vd_ne_zero hv i N.succ_pos
    have hcZ : qIntZ (v ^ D.d i) ((N : ℤ) + 1) = qInt (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1) := by
      rw [← qIntZ_natCast (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one hv i))]; push_cast; rfl
    refine smul_right_injective M hc ?_
    simp only
    have hL : qInt (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1) • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1) (E R v i) •
        qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) M' (F R v i) • m) =
        ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), E R v i • efTerm R v i h N M' t m := by
      rw [← smul_assoc, ← E_mul_qDivPow_E hv, mul_smul, ih, smul_sum]
    let g1 : ℕ → M := fun t ↦ if t ≤ M' then
      (qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (h + N - M') t * qIntZ (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1 - t)) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (F R v i) • qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1 - t) (E R v i) • m)
      else 0
    let g2 : ℕ → M := fun t ↦ if t + 1 ≤ M' then
      (qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (h + N - M') t * qIntZ (v ^ D.d i) (h + N - M' + N + 1 - t)) •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - (t + 1)) (F R v i) •
          qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1 - (t + 1)) (E R v i) • m) else 0
    have hT : ∀ t ∈ range (N + 1), E R v i • efTerm R v i h N M' t m = g1 t + g2 t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [mem_range] at ht
      have hx := qDivPow_E_smul_mem_weightSpace hm i (N - t)
      have hEx : E R v i • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (E R v i) • m) =
          qIntZ (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1 - t) • (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1 - t) (E R v i) • m) := by
        rw [← mul_smul, E_mul_qDivPow_E hv, smul_assoc,
          ← qIntZ_natCast (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one hv i)) (N - t + 1)]
        have e1 : (((N - t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = N + 1 - t := by omega
        have e2 : N - t + 1 = N + 1 - t := by omega
        rw [e1, e2]
      simp only [g1, g2, efTerm]
      by_cases h1 : t ≤ M'
      · simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases h2 : t + 1 ≤ M'
        · simp only [h2, ↓reduceIte]
          obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, M' - t = n + 1 := ⟨M' - t - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [show M' - (t + 1) = n by omega, show N + 1 - (t + 1) = N - t by omega, hn,
            smul_comm, E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul hv hx, hEx, smul_add, smul_comm _ (_ : k),
            smul_smul, smul_smul]
          have e3 : (Λ + (N - t) • R.root i) (R.coroot i) - n = h + N - M' + N + 1 - t := by
            simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, R.root_coroot,
              D.cartanMatrix_self, nsmul_eq_mul, h]
            push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (show t ≤ N by omega)]
            omega
          rw [e3, smul_smul]
        · simp only [h2, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
          have ht' : M' - t = 0 := by omega
          rw [ht', qDivPow_zero', one_smul, smul_comm, hEx, smul_smul, one_smul]
      · have h1' : ¬ t + 1 ≤ M' := by omega
        simp only [h1, h1', ↓reduceIte, smul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hL, sum_congr rfl hT, sum_add_distrib, smul_sum]
    have hs1 : ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), g1 t = ∑ t ∈ range (N + 2), g1 t := by
      rw [sum_range_succ _ (N + 1)]
      simp only [g1]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hs2 : ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), g2 t =
        ∑ t ∈ range (N + 2), (if t = 0 then 0 else g2 (t - 1)) := by
      rw [sum_range_succ' _ (N + 1)]
      simp
    rw [hs1, hs2, ← sum_add_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
    rcases t with _ | s
    · simp only [g1, efTerm, zero_le, ↓reduceIte, qBinomZ_zero, one_mul, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero,
        add_zero, one_smul, Nat.sub_zero, hcZ]
    · simp only [g1, g2, efTerm, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hs : s + 1 ≤ M'
      · simp only [hs, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [← add_smul, smul_smul (qInt (v ^ D.d i) (N + 1))]
        congr 1
        have hsZ : qIntZ (v ^ D.d i) ((s : ℤ) + 1) ≠ 0 := qIntZ_vd_ne_zero hv i (by omega)
        have key := qIntZ_mul_qBinomZ_succ hq0 (h + N - M') N s hsZ
        have e1 : h + ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - M' = h + N - M' + 1 := by push_cast; ring
        have e2 : (N : ℤ) + 1 - ((s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = N - s := by push_cast; ring
        rw [e1, e2, ← hcZ]
        linear_combination -key
      · simp only [hs, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_qDivPow'
statement:
lemma map_qDivPow' {B B' : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [Ring B'] [Algebra k B'] (f : B →ₐ[k] B')
    (q : k) (n : ℕ) (x : B) : f (qDivPow q n x) = qDivPow q n (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mul_mem_rightRel
statement:
lemma mul_mem_rightRel {l : Y →+ ℤ} (a : QuantumGroup R v) {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ rightRel R v l) : a * x ∈ rightRel R v l
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨μ, w, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨μ, a * w, by rw [mul_assoc]⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.rightRel_le
statement:
lemma rightRel_le (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) :
    rightRel R v l₂ ≤ modRel R v l₁ l₂ ⊔ otherWeights R v (l₁ - l₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro x ⟨μ, w, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1
    (show w ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂) ⊔ otherWeights R v (l₁ - l₂) by
      rw [sup_otherWeights]; trivial)
  rw [add_mul]
  exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨μ, a, ha, rfl⟩)))
    (Submodule.mem_sup_right (mul_mem_otherWeights_right hb (sub_mem_adWeightSpace_zero μ _)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_eq_of_sub_mem_rightRel
proof:
:= by
  have hm : u - u' ∈ modRel R v l₁ l₂ := by
    have h1 : u - u' ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂) ⊓
        (modRel R v l₁ l₂ ⊔ otherWeights R v (l₁ - l₂)) := ⟨sub_mem hu hu', rightRel_le l₁ l₂ h⟩
    rwa [inf_comm, sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (modRel_le l₁ l₂), inf_comm, inf_otherWeights hv,
      sup_bot_eq] at h1
  rw [elt_congr (sub_add_cancel u u').symm hu (add_mem (sub_mem hu hu') hu'),
    elt_add _ _ (sub_mem hu hu') hu', elt_eq_zero _ hm, zero_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_sum
statement:
lemma elt_sum {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → QuantumGroup R v)
    (hf : ∀ t, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    elt l₁ l₂ (∑ t ∈ s, f t) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ hf t) =
      ∑ t ∈ s, elt l₁ l₂ (f t) (hf t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using elt_eq_zero (l₁ := l₁) (l₂ := l₂) (zero_mem _) (zero_mem _)
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [elt_congr (sum_insert ha) _ (add_mem (hf a) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ hf t)),
      sum_insert ha, elt_add _ _ (hf a) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ hf t), ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mk_one_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma mk_one_mem_weightSpace (l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk 1 : QuantumGroup R v ⧸ rightRelU R v l) ∈
      weightSpace R v (QuantumGroup R v ⧸ rightRelU R v l) l
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h : K R v μ - algebraMap k _ (v ^ l μ) ∈ rightRelU R v l :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨μ, 1, (one_mul _).symm⟩
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, ← sub_eq_zero,
    ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero,
    Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub_mem
statement:
lemma qDivPow_E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub_mem (i : I) (N M' : ℕ) (l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) N (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) M' (F R v i) -
      ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), (if t ≤ M' then qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (E R v i))
        else 0) ∈ rightRel R v l
proof:
:= by
  have h := qDivPow_E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul hv (mk_one_mem_weightSpace R l) i N M'
  have e : ∀ a : QuantumGroup R v,
      a • (Submodule.Quotient.mk 1 : QuantumGroup R v ⧸ rightRelU R v l) =
        Submodule.Quotient.mk a := fun a ↦ by
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have e' : ∀ t, efTerm R v i (l (R.coroot i)) N M' t
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk 1 : QuantumGroup R v ⧸ rightRelU R v l) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (if t ≤ M' then qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (E R v i))
        else 0) := fun t ↦ by
    rw [efTerm]
    split_ifs
    · rw [← mul_smul, e, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
    · rfl
  rw [← mul_smul, e, sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ e' t] at h
  simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply] at h
  rw [← map_sum, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at h
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.chevalley_mem_rightRel
statement:
lemma chevalley_mem_rightRel {l : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v} (hx : x ∈ rightRel R v l) :
    chevalley R v x ∈ rightRel R v (-l)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨μ, w, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨-μ, chevalley R v w, ?_⟩
    rw [_root_.map_mul, _root_.map_sub, chevalley_K, AlgHom.commutes, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply,
      map_neg, neg_neg]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_F_mul_qDivPow_E_sub_mem
statement:
lemma qDivPow_F_mul_qDivPow_E_sub_mem (i : I) (N M' : ℕ) (l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) N (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) M' (E R v i) -
      ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), (if t ≤ M' then qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (-l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (F R v i))
        else 0) ∈ rightRel R v l
proof:
:= by
  have h := chevalley_mem_rightRel (qDivPow_E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub_mem (R := R) hv i N M' (-l))
  rw [neg_neg] at h
  convert h using 1
  simp only [_root_.map_sub, _root_.map_mul, map_qDivPow', chevalley_E, chevalley_F, map_sum,
    AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]
  congr 1
  refine sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
  split_ifs <;> simp [map_qDivPow']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.divPowE_mem
statement:
lemma divPowE_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (E R v i) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (n • R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_mem_adWeightSpace (E_mem_adWeightSpace i) n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.divPowF_mem
statement:
lemma divPowF_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) n (F R v i) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (n • -R.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_mem_adWeightSpace (fun μ ↦ K_mul_F R v μ i) n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.elt_eq_sum_of_sub_mem
statement:
lemma elt_eq_sum_of_sub_mem {L l : Y →+ ℤ} {u : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l)) (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → QuantumGroup R v)
    (hf : ∀ t, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l)) (h : u - ∑ t ∈ range n, f t ∈ rightRel R v l) :
    elt L l u hu = ∑ t ∈ range n, elt L l (f t) (hf t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [elt_eq_of_sub_mem_rightRel hv hu (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t _ ↦ hf t) h, elt_sum]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.nsmul_neg_add_nsmul
statement:
lemma nsmul_neg_add_nsmul (α : Y →+ ℤ) {N M' t : ℕ} (h1 : t ≤ N) (h2 : t ≤ M') :
    (M' - t) • -α + (N - t) • α = M' • -α + N • α
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply,
    nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_sub h2]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.dE_mul_dF
statement:
theorem dE_mul_dF (i : I) (N M' : ℕ) (l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    dE R v i N (l + M' • -R.root i) * dF R v i M' l =
      ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), if t ≤ M' then
        qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
          (dF R v i (M' - t) (l + (N - t) • R.root i) * dE R v i (N - t) l) else 0
proof:
:= by
  set L := l + M' • -R.root i + N • R.root i
  have hLl : L - l = M' • -R.root i + N • R.root i := by simp only [L]; abel
  let f : ℕ → QuantumGroup R v := fun t ↦ if t ≤ M' ∧ t ≤ N then
    qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
      (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (E R v i)) else 0
  have hFE : ∀ t, t ≤ M' → t ≤ N → qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (F R v i) *
      qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (E R v i) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := fun t h1 h2 ↦ by
    rw [hLl, ← nsmul_neg_add_nsmul (R.root i) h2 h1]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (divPowF_mem i _) (divPowE_mem i _)
  have hf : ∀ t, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := fun t ↦ by
    simp only [f]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hFE t h.1 h.2)
    · exact zero_mem _
  have hEF : qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) N (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) M' (F R v i) ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := by
    rw [hLl, add_comm]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (divPowE_mem i _) (divPowF_mem i _)
  have hsum : ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), f t = ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), (if t ≤ M' then
      qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (E R v i))
      else 0) := sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ by
    have : t ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ht)
    simp only [f, this, and_true]
  have h := qDivPow_E_mul_qDivPow_F_sub_mem (R := R) hv i N M' l
  rw [← hsum] at h
  have e : dE R v i N (l + M' • -R.root i) * dF R v i M' l = elt L l _ hEF := by
    rw [dE, dF, elt_mul_elt]
  rw [e, elt_eq_sum_of_sub_mem hv hEF (N + 1) f hf h]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
  have htN : t ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ht)
  by_cases htM : t ≤ M'
  · simp only [f, htM, htN, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [elt_smul _ _ _ (hFE t htM htN), dF, dE, elt_mul_elt]
    congr 1
    refine elt_index ?_ rfl rfl _ _
    simp only [L]
    rw [add_assoc, ← nsmul_neg_add_nsmul (R.root i) htN htM]
    abel
  · simp only [f, htM, false_and, ↓reduceIte]
    exact elt_eq_zero _ (zero_mem _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.dF_mul_dE
statement:
theorem dF_mul_dE (i : I) (N M' : ℕ) (l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    dF R v i N (l + M' • R.root i) * dE R v i M' l =
      ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), if t ≤ M' then
        qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (-l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
          (dE R v i (M' - t) (l + (N - t) • -R.root i) * dF R v i (N - t) l) else 0
proof:
:= by
  set L := l + M' • R.root i + N • -R.root i
  have hLl : L - l = M' • R.root i + N • -R.root i := by simp only [L]; abel
  let f : ℕ → QuantumGroup R v := fun t ↦ if t ≤ M' ∧ t ≤ N then
    qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (-l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
      (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (F R v i)) else 0
  have hEF : ∀ t, t ≤ M' → t ≤ N → qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (E R v i) *
      qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (F R v i) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := fun t h1 h2 ↦ by
    have e := nsmul_neg_add_nsmul (-R.root i) h2 h1
    rw [neg_neg] at e
    rw [hLl, ← e]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (divPowE_mem i _) (divPowF_mem i _)
  have hf : ∀ t, f t ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := fun t ↦ by
    simp only [f]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hEF t h.1 h.2)
    · exact zero_mem _
  have hFE : qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) N (F R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) M' (E R v i) ∈
      adWeightSpace R v (L - l) := by
    rw [hLl, add_comm]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (divPowF_mem i _) (divPowE_mem i _)
  have hsum : ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), f t = ∑ t ∈ range (N + 1), (if t ≤ M' then
      qBinomZ (v ^ D.d i) (-l (R.coroot i) + N - M') t •
        (qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (M' - t) (E R v i) * qDivPow (v ^ D.d i) (N - t) (F R v i))
      else 0) := sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ by
    have : t ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ht)
    simp only [f, this, and_true]
  have h := qDivPow_F_mul_qDivPow_E_sub_mem (R := R) hv i N M' l
  rw [← hsum] at h
  have e : dF R v i N (l + M' • R.root i) * dE R v i M' l = elt L l _ hFE := by
    rw [dE, dF, elt_mul_elt]
  rw [e, elt_eq_sum_of_sub_mem hv hFE (N + 1) f hf h]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
  have htN : t ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ht)
  by_cases htM : t ≤ M'
  · simp only [f, htM, htN, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [elt_smul _ _ _ (hEF t htM htN), dF, dE, elt_mul_elt]
    congr 1
    refine elt_index ?_ rfl rfl _ _
    have e := nsmul_neg_add_nsmul (R.root i) htM htN
    simp only [L]
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm (M' • R.root i), ← e]
    abel
  · simp only [f, htM, false_and, ↓reduceIte]
    exact elt_eq_zero _ (zero_mem _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.dE_mul_dF_of_ne
statement:
theorem dE_mul_dF_of_ne {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (a b : ℕ) (l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    dE R v i a (l + b • -R.root j) * dF R v j b l =
      dF R v j b (l + a • R.root i) * dE R v i a l
proof:
:= by
  rw [dE, dF, dF, dE, elt_mul_elt, elt_mul_elt]
  refine elt_index (by abel) rfl ?_ _ _
  simp only [qDivPow, smul_mul_smul_comm]
  rw [((Commute.pow_pow (E_mul_F_of_ne (R := R) (v := v) hij) a b)).eq, mul_comm (_ : k)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwDiv_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma pbwDiv_mem_adWeightSpace (ω : List I) (c : Fin ω.length → ℕ) :
    pbwDiv R ω c ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (pbwWt R ω c)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simpa [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, pbwWt] using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [pbwDiv, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, pbwWt, Ta_apply]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (qDivPow_E_mem _ i _)
      ((braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i).map_mem_adWeightSpace (ih _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aPlus_le_plus
statement:
lemma aPlus_le_plus {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlus R) :
    x ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (ePow_mem_plus w) c
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_laurent_le_span
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact Submodule.subset_span hx
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul_U]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isLaurent_repr_of_mem_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧,
      y ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range fun i ↦ (b i : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) →
      ∃ hy : y ∈ S, ∀ i, IsLaurent (b.repr ⟨y, hy⟩ i) := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨(b j).2, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [show (⟨(b j : QuantumGroup R 𝕧), (b j).2⟩ : S) = b j from rfl, b.repr_self,
        Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs
      exacts [isLaurent_one, isLaurent_zero]
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨zero_mem _, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [show (⟨0, zero_mem _⟩ : S) = 0 from rfl, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
      exact isLaurent_zero
    | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
      obtain ⟨hy, hy'⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨add_mem hy hz, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [show (⟨y + z, add_mem hy hz⟩ : S) = ⟨y, hy⟩ + ⟨z, hz⟩ from rfl, map_add,
        Finsupp.add_apply]
      exact (hy' i).add (hz' i)
    | smul a y _ hy =>
      obtain ⟨hy, hy'⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨by rw [laurent_smul_U]; exact S.smul_mem hy _, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [show (⟨a • y, by rw [laurent_smul_U]; exact S.smul_mem hy _⟩ : S) =
        LusztigF.integralLaurentEval a • ⟨y, hy⟩ from rfl, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      exact (show IsLaurent _ from ⟨a, rfl⟩).mul (hy' i)
  obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := key _ hx
  exact h i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwDiv_mem_plus
statement:
lemma pbwDiv_mem_plus (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    pbwDiv R w c ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))
proof:
:=
  aPlus_le_plus (by simpa using pbwDiv_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.plus_le_span_pbwDiv
statement:
lemma plus_le_span_pbwDiv :
    (Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))).toSubmodule ≤
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (pbwDiv R w))
  have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ S :=
    span_laurent_le_span (CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwDivSpan (Ta R) (Ed R) Ed_zero w)
  intro x hx
  have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      intro y hy
      induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hy =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hy
        have := qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDiv (R := R) hSL cs hw
          (hw₀ ▸ cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i) 1
          (Submodule.subset_span ⟨c, rfl⟩)
        rw [A2Integral.qDivPow_one'] at this
        exact span_laurent_le_span this
      | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
      | smul a y _ hy => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
    | algebraMap a =>
      intro y hy
      rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
      exact S.smul_mem a hy
    | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
      intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
    | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
      intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
  simpa using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwPlusBasis_apply
statement:
lemma pbwPlusBasis_apply (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (pbwPlusBasis (R := R) hSL cs hw hw₀ c : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) = pbwDiv R w c
proof:
:= by
  simp [pbwPlusBasis]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.map_chevalley_plus
statement:
lemma map_chevalley_plus :
    (Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))).map (chevalleyEquiv R 𝕧 : _ →ₐ[𝕂] _) =
      Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (F R 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgHom.map_adjoin, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 2
  funext i
  exact chevalley_E R 𝕧 i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.chevalleyPlusMinus_apply
statement:
lemma chevalleyPlusMinus_apply (x : Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))) :
    (chevalleyPlusMinus R x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) = chevalley R 𝕧 x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.pbwMinusBasis_apply
statement:
lemma pbwMinusBasis_apply (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (pbwMinusBasis (R := R) hSL cs hw hw₀ c : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) = chevalley R 𝕧 (pbwDiv R w c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pbwMinusBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, chevalleyPlusMinus_apply, pbwPlusBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.chevalley_mem_aMinus
statement:
lemma chevalley_mem_aMinus {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlus R) :
    chevalley R 𝕧 x ∈ aMinus R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, hc, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul, chevalley_ePow]
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c, w, hc, rfl⟩
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aTriangularBasisPBW_apply
statement:
lemma aTriangularBasisPBW_apply (t : (Fin w.length → ℕ) × (Y →+ ℤ) × (Fin w.length → ℕ)) :
    (aTriangularBasisPBW (R := R) hSL cs hw hw₀ t : Modified R 𝕧) =
      elt (t.2.1 - pbwWt R w t.1) (t.2.1 - pbwWt R w t.2.2)
        (chevalley R 𝕧 (pbwDiv R w t.1) * pbwDiv R w t.2.2) (by
          have := mul_mem_adWeightSpace
            (map_mem_adWeightSpace (omegaAut R) (pbwDiv_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) w t.1))
            (pbwDiv_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) w t.2.2)
          rw [wt_omegaAut] at this
          convert this using 2 <;> first | rfl | abel)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aTriangularBasisPBW, aTriangularBasis_apply, triFun]
  exact elt_congr (by rw [pbwMinusBasis_apply, pbwPlusBasis_apply]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_chevalley
statement:
theorem barHom_chevalley (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    barHom R (chevalley R 𝕧 u) = chevalley R 𝕧 (barHom R u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, barHom_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes]
  | E i => rw [chevalley_E, barHom_F, barHom_E, chevalley_E]
  | F i => rw [chevalley_F, barHom_E, barHom_F, chevalley_F]
  | K μ => rw [chevalley_K, barHom_K, barHom_K, chevalley_K]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [map_mul, map_mul, hx, hy, map_mul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barHom_qDivPow
statement:
theorem barHom_qDivPow (d n : ℕ) (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    barHom R (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ d) n x) = qDivPow (𝕧 ^ d) n (barHom R x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qDivPow, qDivPow, barHom_smul, bar_inv_qFactorial, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.barHom_fPow
statement: theorem barHom_fPow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : barHom R (fPow R w) = fPow R w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p w ih => rw [fPow_cons, _root_.map_mul, barHom_qDivPow, barHom_F, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.barHom_ePow
statement: theorem barHom_ePow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : barHom R (ePow R w) = ePow R w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p w ih => rw [ePow_cons, _root_.map_mul, barHom_qDivPow, barHom_E, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.barHom_mem_fePowSpan
statement:
theorem barHom_mem_fePowSpan {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hu : u ∈ fePowSpan R) :
    barHom R u ∈ fePowSpan R
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [barHom_smul, bar_zpow_X, _root_.map_mul, barHom_fPow, barHom_ePow]
    exact zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan _ (mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨w, w', rfl⟩)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_zsmul]; exact zsmul_mem hx c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.vermaIdeal_le_comap_bar
statement:
lemma vermaIdeal_le_comap_bar :
    vermaIdeal R 𝕧 Λ ≤ (vermaIdeal R 𝕧 Λ).comap (barSemilinear R)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, rfl⟩)
  · change barHom R (E R 𝕧 i) ∈ vermaIdeal R 𝕧 Λ
    rw [barHom_E]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · change barHom R (K R 𝕧 μ - algebraMap 𝕂 _ (𝕧 ^ Λ μ)) ∈ vermaIdeal R 𝕧 Λ
    rw [map_sub, barHom_K, barHom_algebraMap, bar_zpow_X, ← map_neg]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨-μ, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.bar_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma bar_mk (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    bar R Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk u) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (barHom R u)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.bar_smul
statement:
lemma bar_smul (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (m : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ) :
    bar R Λ (u • m) = barHom R u • bar R Λ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, bar_mk, bar_mk, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.bar_bar
statement: @[simp] lemma bar_bar (m : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ) : bar R Λ (bar R Λ m) = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  rw [bar_mk, bar_mk, barHom_barHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.bar_hwv
statement: @[simp] lemma bar_hwv : bar R Λ (hwv R 𝕧 Λ) = hwv R 𝕧 Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwv, bar_mk, map_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.plusHom_smul_toVerma_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  induction hx' using FreeAlgebra.wordSpan_induction with
  | word w hw =>
    rw [plusHom_smul_toVerma ratFunc_X_not_root,
      (LusztigF.vermaWordOp_mem _ w.reverse hx).2 (by rwa [wordWeight_reverse, hw]), map_zero]
  | zero => rw [map_zero, zero_smul]
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, add_smul, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, smul_assoc, hy, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.isPlusLocallyNilpotent
statement: theorem isPlusLocallyNilpotent : IsPlusLocallyNilpotent R (VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toVerma_surjective (Λ := Λ) ratFunc_X_not_root m
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ μ, LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (I := I) μ := by
    rw [LusztigF.iSup_weightSpace]; trivial
  induction hy using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem μ y hy =>
    refine ⟨μ.degree + 1, fun ν hν x hx ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hx
    rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, quotientPlus_toQuotient]
    refine plusHom_smul_toVerma_eq_zero (fun hle ↦ ?_) hy hx₀
    have := Finsupp.degree_mono hle
    omega
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ _ x _ ↦ by rw [map_zero, smul_zero]⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨max N N', fun ν hν x hx ↦ by
      rw [map_add, smul_add, hN ν (le_of_max_le_left hν) x hx,
        hN' ν (le_of_max_le_right hν) x hx, add_zero]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.twistBar_toTwist

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.twistBar_smul

lemma twistBar_smul (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (m : Mt) :

proof:
:= by

    twistBar_toTwist, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaBarPair_tmul
statement:
lemma vermaBarPair_tmul (a : Mt) (b : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ') :
    vermaBarPair R Λ Λ' (a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b) = twistBar R Λ a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.bar R Λ' b
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaBarPair_smul
statement:
lemma vermaBarPair_smul (c : 𝕂) (z : Mt ⊗[𝕂] VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ') :

proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [smul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | tmul a b =>
    rw [smul_tmul', vermaBarPair_tmul, vermaBarPair_tmul,
      map_smul_of_barHom (twistBar R Λ) twistBar_smul, smul_tmul']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaBarPair_vermaBarPair
statement:
@[simp] lemma vermaBarPair_vermaBarPair (z : Mt ⊗[𝕂] VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ') :

proof:

  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul a b =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (tw).surjective a
    rw [vermaBarPair_tmul, vermaBarPair_tmul, twistBar_toTwist, twistBar_toTwist,
      VermaModule.bar_bar, VermaModule.bar_bar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.vermaBarPair_mem
statement:
lemma vermaBarPair_mem {z : VT} (hz : z ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ') :
    mkT (vermaBarPair R Λ Λ' ((mkT).symm z)) ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul, vermaBarPair_smul, bar_zpow_X, map_smul]
    refine zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan _ (mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨w, w', ?_⟩)
    exact congrArg mkT (vermaBarPair_fPow w w')
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_zsmul, map_zsmul, map_zsmul]; exact zsmul_mem hx c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.quasiRAct_hwv
statement:
lemma quasiRAct_hwv :
    quasiRAct (VermaModule.isPlusLocallyNilpotent R Λ')
      (tw (VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ') =
      tw (VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [quasiRAct_apply,
    finsum_eq_single _ 0 fun ν hν ↦ actPair_quasiR_tmul_eq_zero (fun x hx ↦ ?_) _,
    quasiR_zero, _root_.map_one, Module.End.one_apply]
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hx
  rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, quotientPlus_toQuotient, VermaModule.plusHom_smul_hwv,
    LusztigF.counit_eq_zero_of_mem hν hx₀, zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fePowImage_le_vermaTensorLattice
statement: lemma fePowImage_le_vermaTensorLattice : fePowImage R Λ Λ' ≤ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ hz
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := mem_fePowImage.1 hz
  clear hz
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [smul_assoc]
    exact zpow_smul_mem_laurentSpan k (fPow_mul_ePow_smul_mem w w')
  | zero => rw [zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_assoc]; exact zsmul_mem hx c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.quasiRAct_mem_vermaTensorLattice
statement:
theorem quasiRAct_mem_vermaTensorLattice {z : VT} (hz : z ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ') :
    mkT (quasiRAct (VermaModule.isPlusLocallyNilpotent R Λ') ((mkT).symm z)) ∈
      vermaTensorLattice R Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u', hu', e⟩ :=
    mem_fePowImage.1 (vermaTensorLattice_le_fePowImage (vermaBarPair_mem hz))
  have hz' :
      (mkT).symm z = vermaBarPair R Λ Λ' ((mkT).symm (u' • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ')) := by
    rw [e, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, vermaBarPair_vermaBarPair]
  have key : TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (barHom R u') (quasiRAct
      (VermaModule.isPlusLocallyNilpotent R Λ') (vermaBarPair R Λ Λ'
        (tw (VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'))) =
      quasiRAct (VermaModule.isPlusLocallyNilpotent R Λ') (vermaBarPair R Λ Λ'
        (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u' (tw (VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
          VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'))) := by
    have h := act_quasiRAct_barPair (twistBar R Λ) (VermaModule.bar R Λ') twistBar_smul
      VermaModule.bar_smul (VermaModule.isPlusLocallyNilpotent R Λ') (barHom R u')
      (tw (VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')
    rw [barHom_barHom] at h
    exact h
  rw [vermaBarPair_tmul, twistBar_toTwist, VermaModule.bar_hwv, VermaModule.bar_hwv,
    quasiRAct_hwv] at key
  rw [hz']
  change mkT (quasiRAct _ (vermaBarPair R Λ Λ' (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u'
    (tw (VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ')))) ∈ _
  rw [← key]
  exact fePowImage_le_vermaTensorLattice
    (mem_fePowImage.2 ⟨_, barHom_mem_fePowSpan hu', rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_algebraMap

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma braidReversal_mem_adWeightSpace {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) : braidReversal x ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h := congrArg braidReversal (hx (-μ))
  rw [braidReversal_mul, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_K, neg_neg] at h
  rw [h, smul_smul, map_neg, ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_mem_adWeightSpace_sub
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_mem_modRel
statement:
lemma braidReversal_mem_modRel {l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ modRel R v l₁ l₂) : braidReversal x ∈ modRel R v (-l₂) (-l₁)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · refine Submodule.subset_span
        (Or.inr ⟨-μ, braidReversal u, braidReversal_mem_adWeightSpace_sub hu, ?_⟩)
      rw [braidReversal_mul, map_sub, braidReversal_K, braidReversal_algebraMap, map_neg,
        AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, neg_neg]
    · refine Submodule.subset_span
        (Or.inl ⟨-μ, braidReversal u, braidReversal_mem_adWeightSpace_sub hu, ?_⟩)
      rw [braidReversal_mul, map_sub, braidReversal_K, braidReversal_algebraMap, map_neg,
        AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, neg_neg]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_rho
statement:
theorem braidReversal_rho (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    braidReversal (rho R v u) = rhoBar R v (braidReversal u)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have hc : ∀ i : I, v ^ D.d i * v ^ (-D.dot i i) = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := fun i ↦
    eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [mul_right_comm]; exact zpow_dot_mul hv i)
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | E i =>
    rw [rho_E, rhoE, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_F, Kt, braidReversal_K,
      braidReversal_E, rhoBar_E, rhoBarE, F_mul_K hv, smul_smul, map_neg, root_ktilde_eq_dot, hc]
  | F i =>
    rw [rho_F, rhoF, map_smul, braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E, braidReversal_K, neg_neg,
      braidReversal_F, rhoBar_F, rhoBarF, Kt, E_mul_K hv, smul_smul, root_ktilde_eq_dot, hc]
  | K μ => rw [rho_K, braidReversal_K, rhoBar_K]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    rw [rho_mul, braidReversal_mul, hx, hy, braidReversal_mul x y, rhoBar_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidReversal_minusHom
statement:
lemma braidReversal_minusHom (x : LusztigF k I) :
    braidReversal (minusHom R v x) = minusHom R v (rev k I x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, rev_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, braidReversal_algebraMap]
  | grade1 i =>
    rw [show FreeAlgebra.ι k i = θ k i from rfl, minusHom_θ, rev_θ, minusHom_θ, braidReversal_F]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, braidReversal_mul, ha, hb, rev_mul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.sigma_elt
statement:
lemma sigma_elt (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v} (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    sigma (elt l₁ l₂ u hu) =
      elt (-l₂) (-l₁) (braidReversal u) (braidReversal_mem_adWeightSpace_sub hu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigma, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.sigma_leftAct
statement:
theorem sigma_leftAct (u : QuantumGroup R v) (x : Modified R v) :
    sigma (leftAct R v hv u x) = rightAct R v hv (braidReversal u) (sigma x)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd u u' hu hu' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hu']
  | hhom χ u hu =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ t ht =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv hu, sigma_elt, sigma_elt,
      rightAct_elt hv (braidReversal_mem_adWeightSpace hu)]
    exact elt_index rfl (by abel) (braidReversal_mul _ _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero_of_elt
statement:
lemma one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero_of_elt {B : Modified R v →ₗ[k] Modified R v →ₗ[k] k}
    (h : ∀ l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂))
      (hb : b ∈ adWeightSpace R v (m₁ - m₂)), (l₁, l₂) ≠ (m₁, m₂) →
        B (elt l₁ l₂ a ha) (elt m₁ m₂ b hb) = 0)
    {l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ : Y →+ ℤ} (hne : (l₁, l₂) ≠ (m₁, m₂)) (x y : Modified R v) :
    B (one l₁ * x * one l₂) (one m₁ * y * one m₂) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => rw [mul_add, add_mul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx', add_zero]
  | helt a₁ a₂ a ha =>
  rw [one_mul_mul_one]
  split_ifs with h₁
  swap; · simp
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, add_mul, map_add, hy, hy', add_zero]
  | helt b₁ b₂ b hb =>
    rw [one_mul_mul_one]
    split_ifs with h₂
    · exact h _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (by rw [← h₁, ← h₂]; exact hne)
    · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_sigma_sigma
statement:
theorem form_sigma_sigma (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R v hv (sigma x) (sigma y) = form R v hv x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := eq_form hv (B := (form R v hv).compl₁₂ sigma sigma)
    (fun _ _ _ _ hne ↦ one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero_of_elt (fun l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ a b ha hb hne ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, sigma_elt, sigma_elt]
      refine form_elt_elt_of_ne hv (fun h ↦ hne ?_) _ _
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, neg_inj] at h ⊢
      exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩) hne)
    (fun u x y ↦ by
      rw [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, sigma_leftAct, form_rightAct_left,
        ← braidReversal_rho, ← sigma_leftAct])
    (fun l x y ↦ by
      have h : ((form R v hv).compl₁₂
          (sigma ∘ₗ (leftAct R v hv ∘ₗ (minusHom R v).toLinearMap).flip (one l))
          (sigma ∘ₗ (leftAct R v hv ∘ₗ (minusHom R v).toLinearMap).flip (one l))) =
            LusztigF.form D v :=
        LinearMap.ext_basis (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I) fun w w' ↦ by
          simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
            AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, wordBasis_eq_monomial]
          rw [one, leftAct_elt hv (minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w),
            leftAct_elt hv (minusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w'), sigma_elt, sigma_elt,
            form_elt_elt]
          have h1 : braidReversal (1 : QuantumGroup R v) = 1 := by simp [braidReversal]
          split_ifs with h
          · rw [braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_mul, h1, one_mul, one_mul,
              braidReversal_minusHom, braidReversal_minusHom,
              ← mul_one (minusHom R v (rev k I (monomial k w'))), ← K_zero R v, ← mul_assoc,
              formFunctional_rho_minusHom, map_zero, zpow_zero, one_mul, LusztigF.form_rev]
          · refine (LusztigF.form_eq_zero_of_ne D v (fun hw ↦ h ?_) (monomial_mem_weightSpace w)
              (monomial_mem_weightSpace w')).symm
            rw [wordChar_eq_rootSum, wordChar_eq_rootSum, hw]
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x y)
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toBaseChange_mem_modRel
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>

    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩

    · exact Or.inr ⟨μ, _, toBaseChange_mem_adWeightSpace hu, by simp⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

proof:
