name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_list_prod_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem span_list_prod_eq_adjoin (G : I → QuantumGroup R v) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range fun w : List I ↦ (w.map G).prod) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range G)).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact Subalgebra.list_prod_mem _ fun x hx ↦ by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_eq_span, Submodule.span_le]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := Submonoid.exists_list_of_mem_closure hx
    have key : ∀ l : List (QuantumGroup R v), (∀ y ∈ l, y ∈ Set.range G) →
        ∃ w : List I, w.map G = l := by
      intro l hl
      induction l with
      | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
      | cons a l ih =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hl a List.mem_cons_self
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ih fun b hb ↦ hl b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
        exact ⟨i :: w, by simp [hw]⟩
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := key l hl
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_basis_adjoin_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem exists_basis_adjoin_adWeightSpace {G : I → QuantumGroup R v} {c : I → Y →+ ℤ}
    (hG : ∀ i, G i ∈ adWeightSpace R v (c i)) :
    ∃ (t : Set (QuantumGroup R v)) (b : Module.Basis t k (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range G)))
      (w : t → Y →+ ℤ), ∀ i, (b i : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (w i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hts, hspan, hli⟩ :=
    exists_linearIndependent k (Set.range fun w : List I ↦ (w.map G).prod)
  have h : Submodule.span k (Set.range ((↑) : t → QuantumGroup R v)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range G)).toSubmodule := by
    rw [Subtype.range_coe, hspan, span_list_prod_eq_adjoin]
  refine ⟨t, (Module.Basis.span hli).map (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ h),
    fun x ↦ ((hts x.2).choose.map c).sum, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  have hb : ((Module.Basis.span hli).map (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ h) x : QuantumGroup R v) = x := by
    simp
  rw [hb, ← (hts x.2).choose_spec]
  exact list_prod_mem_adWeightSpace hG _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toBaseChange_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_mem_adjoin {G : I → QuantumGroup R v}
    {G' : I → QuantumGroup R (algebraMap k L v)} (hG : ∀ i, toBaseChange R v (G i) = G' i)
    {x : QuantumGroup R v} (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range G)) :
    toBaseChange (L := L) R v x ∈ Algebra.adjoin L (Set.range G')
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [hG]
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩
  | algebraMap c => rw [toBaseChange_algebraMap]; exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adjoin_le_span_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem adjoin_le_span_toBaseChange {G : I → QuantumGroup R v}
    {G' : I → QuantumGroup R (algebraMap k L v)} (hG : ∀ i, toBaseChange R v (G i) = G' i) :
    (Algebra.adjoin L (Set.range G')).toSubmodule ≤
      Submodule.span L (toBaseChange R v '' Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range G))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨G i, Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩, hG i⟩
  | algebraMap c =>
    have h : algebraMap L (QuantumGroup R (algebraMap k L v)) c = c • toBaseChange R v 1 := by
      rw [map_one, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one c]
    rw [h]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, one_mem _, rfl⟩)
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    have h := Submodule.mul_mem_mul hx hy
    rw [Submodule.span_mul_span] at h
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ h
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, _, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a * b, mul_mem ha hb, map_mul _ _ _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_range_quantumGroup_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem span_range_quantumGroup_toBaseChange :
    Submodule.span L (Set.range (QuantumGroup.toBaseChange (L := L) R v)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr ?_
  rintro x -
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (QuantumGroup.baseChangeEquiv (L := L) R v).surjective x
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul c y =>
    rw [QuantumGroup.baseChangeEquiv_tmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  | add a b ha hb => rw [_root_.map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.toBaseChange_elt
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_elt (l₁ l₂ : Y →+ ℤ) {a : QuantumGroup R v}
    (ha : a ∈ adWeightSpace R v (l₁ - l₂)) :
    toBaseChange L R v (elt l₁ l₂ a ha) =
      elt l₁ l₂ (QuantumGroup.toBaseChange R v a) (toBaseChange_mem_adWeightSpace ha)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toBaseChange, elt, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, DirectSum.lof_eq_of,
    DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.toBaseChange_one
statement: theorem toBaseChange_one (l : Y →+ ℤ) : toBaseChange L R v (one l) = one l
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, toBaseChange_elt]
  exact elt_index rfl rfl (_root_.map_one _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.toBaseChange_mul
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_mul (x y : Modified R v) :
    toBaseChange L R v (x * y) = toBaseChange L R v x * toBaseChange L R v y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, _root_.map_add, _root_.map_add, add_mul, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ a ha =>
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, _root_.map_add, _root_.map_add, mul_add, hy, hy']
  | helt l₃ l₄ b hb =>
    by_cases h : l₂ = l₃
    · subst h
      rw [elt_mul_elt, toBaseChange_elt, toBaseChange_elt, toBaseChange_elt, elt_mul_elt]
      exact elt_index rfl rfl (_root_.map_mul _ _ _) _ _
    · rw [elt_mul_elt_of_ne h, toBaseChange_elt, toBaseChange_elt, elt_mul_elt_of_ne h,
        _root_.map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.toBaseChange_leftAct
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_leftAct (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (u : QuantumGroup R v)
    (x : Modified R v) :
    toBaseChange L R v (leftAct R v hv u x) =
      leftAct R (algebraMap k L v) (not_root_algebraMap hv) (QuantumGroup.toBaseChange R v u)
        (toBaseChange L R v x)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using induction_adWeightSpace with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd u u' hu hu' => simp only [_root_.map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hu, hu']
  | hhom χ u hu =>
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x x' hx hx' => simp only [_root_.map_add, hx, hx']
  | helt l₁ l₂ a ha =>
    rw [leftAct_elt hv hu, toBaseChange_elt, toBaseChange_elt,
      leftAct_elt _ (toBaseChange_mem_adWeightSpace hu)]
    exact elt_index rfl rfl (_root_.map_mul _ _ _) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChange_isScalarTower
statement: theorem baseChange_isScalarTower : IsScalarTower k L (Modified R (algebraMap k L v))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c l x ↦ by rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul]; rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChangeLinearMap_tmul
statement:
theorem baseChangeLinearMap_tmul (c : L) (x : Modified R v) :
    baseChangeLinearMap L R v (c ⊗ₜ x) = c • toBaseChange L R v x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bijective_baseChangeLinearMap
statement:
theorem bijective_baseChangeLinearMap (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    Function.Bijective (baseChangeLinearMap L R v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨tm, bm, wm, hm⟩ :=
    exists_basis_adjoin_adWeightSpace (F_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) (v := v))
  obtain ⟨tp, bp, wp, hp⟩ :=
    exists_basis_adjoin_adWeightSpace (E_mem_adWeightSpace (R := R) (v := v))
  have hm' : ∀ i, (bm i : QuantumGroup R v) ∈ adWeightSpace R v (-(-wm i)) := by simpa using hm
  let bm' := basisToBaseChange (L := L) bm
    (fun x hx ↦ toBaseChange_mem_adjoin (fun i ↦ toBaseChange_F i) hx)
    (adjoin_le_span_toBaseChange fun i ↦ toBaseChange_F i)
  let bp' := basisToBaseChange (L := L) bp
    (fun x hx ↦ toBaseChange_mem_adjoin (fun i ↦ toBaseChange_E i) hx)
    (adjoin_le_span_toBaseChange fun i ↦ toBaseChange_E i)
  have hbm' : ∀ i, (bm' i : QuantumGroup R (algebraMap k L v)) =
      QuantumGroup.toBaseChange R v (bm i) := fun i ↦ by
    simp [bm', basisToBaseChange]
  have hbp' : ∀ i, (bp' i : QuantumGroup R (algebraMap k L v)) =
      QuantumGroup.toBaseChange R v (bp i) := fun i ↦ by
    simp [bp', basisToBaseChange]
  let Bk := triangularBasis hv bm bp (fun i ↦ -wm i) wp hm' hp
  let BL := triangularBasis (not_root_algebraMap hv) bm' bp' (fun i ↦ -wm i) wp
    (fun i ↦ by rw [hbm']; exact toBaseChange_mem_adWeightSpace (hm' i))
    (fun i ↦ by rw [hbp']; exact toBaseChange_mem_adWeightSpace (hp i))
  have key : ∀ t, baseChangeLinearMap L R v (Algebra.TensorProduct.basis L Bk t) = BL t := by
    intro t
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.basis_apply, baseChangeLinearMap_tmul, one_smul,
      triangularBasis_apply, triangularBasis_apply, triFun, triFun, toBaseChange_elt]
    exact elt_index rfl rfl (by rw [_root_.map_mul, hbm', hbp']) _ _
  have he : baseChangeLinearMap L R v =
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.basis L Bk).equiv BL (Equiv.refl _)).toLinearMap :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.basis L Bk).ext fun t ↦ by
      rw [key, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Module.Basis.equiv_apply]
      rfl
  rw [he]
  exact LinearEquiv.bijective _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChangeEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem baseChangeEquiv_tmul (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (c : L) (x : Modified R v) :
    baseChangeEquiv L R v hv (c ⊗ₜ x) = c • toBaseChange L R v x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul
statement:
theorem baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (x : Modified R v) :
    baseChangeEquiv L R v hv (1 ⊗ₜ x) = toBaseChange L R v x
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseChangeEquiv_tmul, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_range_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem span_range_toBaseChange (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) :
    Submodule.span L (Set.range (toBaseChange L R v)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr ?_
  rintro x -
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (baseChangeEquiv L R v hv).surjective x
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul c y =>
    rw [baseChangeEquiv_tmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  | add a b ha hb => rw [_root_.map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bilin_eq_of_span
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext_on hs fun x hx ↦ LinearMap.ext_on hs fun y hy ↦ h x hx y hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChangeForm_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem baseChangeForm_toBaseChange (x y : Modified R v) :
    baseChangeForm L R v hv (toBaseChange L R v x) (toBaseChange L R v y) =
      algebraMap k L (form R v hv x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseChangeForm, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, ← baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul hv,
    ← baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul hv]
  simp [LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.baseChangeForm_eq_form
statement:
theorem baseChangeForm_eq_form :
    baseChangeForm L R v hv = form R (algebraMap k L v) (not_root_algebraMap hv)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := span_range_toBaseChange (L := L) (R := R) hv
  have hsU := span_range_quantumGroup_toBaseChange (L := L) (R := R) (v := v)
  refine eq_form _ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ h
    have := bilin_eq_of_span hs (f := (baseChangeForm L R v hv).compl₁₂
      ((LinearMap.mulRight L (one l₂)).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft L (one l₁)))
      ((LinearMap.mulRight L (one m₂)).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft L (one m₁)))) (g := 0) ?_
    · exact fun x y ↦ by simpa using congr($this x y)
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
      LinearMap.mulRight_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [← toBaseChange_one, ← toBaseChange_one, ← toBaseChange_one, ← toBaseChange_one,
      ← toBaseChange_mul, ← toBaseChange_mul, ← toBaseChange_mul, ← toBaseChange_mul,
      baseChangeForm_toBaseChange, form_one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero hv h, _root_.map_zero]
  · intro u
    have hu : u ∈ Submodule.span L (Set.range (QuantumGroup.toBaseChange (L := L) R v)) := by
      rw [hsU]; trivial
    induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem u hu =>
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hu
      have := bilin_eq_of_span hs (f := (baseChangeForm L R v hv).compl₁₂
        (leftAct R _ (not_root_algebraMap hv) (QuantumGroup.toBaseChange R v u)) LinearMap.id)
        (g := (baseChangeForm L R v hv).compl₁₂ LinearMap.id
          (leftAct R _ (not_root_algebraMap hv) (rho R _ (QuantumGroup.toBaseChange R v u)))) ?_
      · exact fun x y ↦ congr($this x y)
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
      simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
      rw [← toBaseChange_rho, ← toBaseChange_leftAct hv, ← toBaseChange_leftAct hv,
        baseChangeForm_toBaseChange, baseChangeForm_toBaseChange, form_leftAct_left]
    | zero => intro x y; simp
    | add u u' _ _ hu hu' => intro x y; simp [hu, hu']
    | smul c u _ hu => intro x y; simp [hu]
  · intro l
    have hw : Submodule.span L (Set.range (FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs (algebraMap k L) :
        LusztigF k I → LusztigF L I)) = ⊤ := by
      refine eq_top_iff.mpr (le_trans (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis L I).span_eq.ge ?_)
      refine Submodule.span_mono ?_
      rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨FreeAlgebra.wordBasis k I w, FreeAlgebra.mapCoeffs_wordBasis _ w⟩
    have := bilin_eq_of_span hw (f := (baseChangeForm L R v hv).compl₁₂
      ((leftAct R _ (not_root_algebraMap hv)).flip (one l) ∘ₗ
        (minusHom R (algebraMap k L v)).toLinearMap)
      ((leftAct R _ (not_root_algebraMap hv)).flip (one l) ∘ₗ
        (minusHom R (algebraMap k L v)).toLinearMap)) (g := LusztigF.form D (algebraMap k L v)) ?_
    · exact fun x y ↦ congr($this x y)
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
    rw [← toBaseChange_minusHom, ← toBaseChange_minusHom, ← toBaseChange_one,
      ← toBaseChange_leftAct hv, ← toBaseChange_leftAct hv, baseChangeForm_toBaseChange,
      form_minusHom_leftAct_one, LusztigF.form_mapCoeffs]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem form_toBaseChange (x y : Modified R v) :
    form R (algebraMap k L v) (not_root_algebraMap hv) (toBaseChange L R v x)
      (toBaseChange L R v y) = algebraMap k L (form R v hv x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← baseChangeForm_eq_form hv, baseChangeForm_toBaseChange]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_baseChangeEquiv
statement:
theorem form_baseChangeEquiv (x y : L ⊗[k] Modified R v) :
    form R (algebraMap k L v) (not_root_algebraMap hv) (baseChangeEquiv L R v hv x)
      (baseChangeEquiv L R v hv y) = LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange L (form R v hv) x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← baseChangeForm_eq_form hv, baseChangeForm, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.formFunctional_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem formFunctional_toBaseChange (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (z : QuantumGroup R v) :
    formFunctional R (algebraMap k L v) (not_root_algebraMap hv) ζ
      (QuantumGroup.toBaseChange R v z) = algebraMap k L (formFunctional R v hv ζ z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional _ (form_leftAct_left _) (form_minusHom_leftAct_one _),
    ← one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional hv (form_leftAct_left hv) (form_minusHom_leftAct_one hv),
    ← toBaseChange_one, ← toBaseChange_leftAct hv, form_toBaseChange]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_nondegenerate_of_baseChange
statement:
theorem form_nondegenerate_of_baseChange
    (hK : ∀ x : Modified R v, (∀ y, form R v hv x y = 0) → x = 0) {w : L}
    (hw : algebraMap k L v = w) [NeZero w] (hw' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → w ^ n ≠ 1)
    (x : Modified R w) (hx : ∀ y, form R w hw' x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst hw
  exact LinearMap.BilinForm.eq_zero_of_baseChange_equiv (form R v hv) hK _
    (baseChangeEquiv L R v hv) (fun x y ↦ form_baseChangeEquiv hv x _) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_aeval
statement:
theorem nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_aeval {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L] {w : L}
    (hw : Transcendental ℚ w) :
    nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial ℚ) ≤
      (nonZeroDivisors L).comap (Polynomial.aeval w).toRingHom
proof:
:= fun p hp ↦
  mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero fun h ↦ hw ⟨p, nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hp, h⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ratFuncEmbedding_X
statement:
theorem ratFuncEmbedding_X {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L] (w : L) (hw : Transcendental ℚ w) :
    ratFuncEmbedding w hw RatFunc.X = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [ratFuncEmbedding, ← RatFunc.algebraMap_X, ← div_one (algebraMap _ (RatFunc ℚ) _),
    ← map_one (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ)), RatFunc.liftRingHom_apply_div]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_nondegenerate_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem Modified.form_nondegenerate_of_transcendental
    (hQ : ∀ x : Modified R (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ),
      (∀ y, Modified.form R _ ratFunc_X_not_root x y = 0) → x = 0)
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L] {w : L} (hw : Transcendental ℚ w) [NeZero w]
    (x : Modified R w)
    (hx : ∀ y, Modified.form R w (fun _ hn ↦ LusztigF.pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hw hn) x y = 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let _ := (ratFuncEmbedding w hw).toAlgebra
  exact Modified.form_nondegenerate_of_baseChange ratFunc_X_not_root hQ
    (ratFuncEmbedding_X w hw) (fun _ hn ↦ LusztigF.pow_ne_one_of_transcendental hw hn) x hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.transcendental_inv_X
statement:
theorem transcendental_inv_X :
    Transcendental ℚ (algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) (AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ)) RatFunc.X)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Transcendental, IsAlgebraic.inv_iff (R := ℚ), ← Transcendental,
    transcendental_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) _).injective]
  convert RatFunc.transcendental_X (K := ℚ)
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.transcendental_inv_mul_X
statement:
theorem transcendental_inv_mul_X {t : AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ)} (ht : t ^ 2 = -1) :
    Transcendental ℚ (t * algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) (AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ)) RatFunc.X)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; norm_num at ht
  have hta : IsAlgebraic ℚ t := ⟨Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 1, fun h ↦ by
    simpa using congr(Polynomial.natDegree $h), by simp [ht]⟩
  intro h
  rw [IsAlgebraic.inv_iff (R := ℚ)] at h
  have := (Subalgebra.algebraicClosure ℚ (AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ))).mul_mem
    (hta.inv : t⁻¹ ∈ Subalgebra.algebraicClosure ℚ _) (h : _ ∈ Subalgebra.algebraicClosure ℚ _)
  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht0, one_mul] at this
  exact transcendental_inv_X (IsAlgebraic.inv_iff (R := ℚ).mpr this)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adK_apply
statement: lemma adK_apply (μ : Y) (x : QuantumGroup R v) : adK R v μ x = K R v μ * x * K R v (-μ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [adK, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adK_zero
statement: lemma adK_zero (x : QuantumGroup R v) : adK R v 0 x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [adK_apply, neg_zero, K_zero, one_mul, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adK_add
statement:
lemma adK_add (μ ν : Y) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    adK R v (μ + ν) x = adK R v μ (adK R v ν x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adK_apply]
  have h : K R v (-ν) * K R v (-μ) = K R v (-(μ + ν)) := by rw [K_add]; congr 1; abel
  rw [← K_add, ← h]; simp only [mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twistAd_single
statement:
lemma twistAd_single (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (μ : Y) (c : k) (x : QuantumGroup R v) :
    twistAd R v ζ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single μ c) x = (c * v ^ ζ μ) • adK R v μ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [twistAd, AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single, mul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.adK_mem_plus
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [adK_apply, conj_eq_of_mem_adWeightSpace (E_mem_adWeightSpace i)]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)) _
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [adK_apply, ← Algebra.commutes, mul_assoc, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, mul_one]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    have : adK R v μ (x * y) = adK R v μ x * adK R v μ y := by
      simp only [adK_apply, mul_assoc]
      rw [← mul_assoc (K R v (-μ)) (K R v μ), K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero, one_mul]
    rw [this]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.theta_apply
statement:
lemma theta_apply (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v)))
    (g : AddMonoidAlgebra k Y) (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    theta R hv ζ ((y : QuantumGroup R v) * zeroHom R v g * x) =
      counit R v (y : QuantumGroup R v) • twistAd R v ζ g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul R v hv, theta, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  simp [psiTheta, phiTheta]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.theta_mul_plus
statement:
lemma theta_mul_plus (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (F R v)))
    (x : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) :
    theta R hv ζ ((y : QuantumGroup R v) * x) = counit R v (y : QuantumGroup R v) • x
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta_apply hv ζ y 1 x
  rwa [map_one, mul_one, map_one, Module.End.one_apply] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.theta_plus
statement:
lemma theta_plus (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {x : QuantumGroup R v}
    (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) : theta R hv ζ x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta_mul_plus hv ζ 1 ⟨x, hx⟩
  simpa using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.theta_mul_K
statement:
lemma theta_mul_K (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) (ν : Y) :
    theta R hv ζ (u * K R v ν) = v ^ ζ ν • theta R hv ζ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (triangularMultiplicationEquiv R v hv).surjective u
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_mul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | tmul y z =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => rw [tmul_add, map_add, add_mul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
    | tmul g x =>
      induction g using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
      | of μ =>
        rw [triangularMultiplicationEquiv_tmul]
        have hx' := adK_mem_plus (R := R) (-ν) x.2
        have e : (y : QuantumGroup R v) * zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.of k Y (.ofAdd μ)) * x *
            K R v ν = y * zeroHom R v (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (μ + ν) 1) *
              (⟨_, hx'⟩ : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (E R v))) := by
          simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.of_apply, toAdd_ofAdd, zeroHom_single]
          rw [adK_apply, neg_neg, ← K_add]
          simp only [mul_assoc]
          rw [← mul_assoc (K R v ν) (K R v (-ν)), K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul]
        rw [e, theta_apply, theta_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.of_apply, twistAd_single,
          twistAd_single, adK_add, ← adK_add ν (-ν), add_neg_cancel, adK_zero]
        simp only [smul_smul, one_mul, map_add, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v), toAdd_ofAdd]
        congr 1
        ring
      | add a b ha hb =>
        rw [add_tmul, tmul_add, map_add, add_mul, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
      | smul c a ha =>
        rw [← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, ha, map_smul, smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.theta_K_mul
statement:
lemma theta_K_mul (ζ χ : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v} (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v χ) (μ : Y) :
    theta R hv ζ (K R v μ * u) = v ^ (χ + ζ) μ • theta R hv ζ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [hu μ, map_smul, theta_mul_K, smul_smul, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne v)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.theta_modRel
statement:
lemma theta_modRel {L ζ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R v} (hx : x ∈ modRel R v L ζ) :
    theta R hv ζ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨μ, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · rw [sub_mul, map_sub, theta_K_mul hv ζ _ hu, sub_add_cancel, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
        smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, map_smul, sub_self]
    · rw [mul_sub, map_sub, theta_mul_K, ← Algebra.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
        smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, map_smul, sub_self]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Theta_elt
statement:
lemma Theta_elt (ζ L l : Y →+ ℤ) {u : QuantumGroup R v} (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R v (L - l)) :
    Theta R hv ζ (elt L l u hu) = if l = ζ then theta R hv ζ u else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Theta, elt, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  by_cases h : l = ζ
  · subst h
    simp only [thetaComp, Comp.mk, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte]
    rfl
  · simp [thetaComp, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_mem_aPlus
statement: lemma ePow_mem_aPlus (w : List (I × ℕ)) : ePow R w ∈ aPlus R
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨1, w, isLaurent_one, (one_smul _ _).symm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.smul_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma smul_mem_aPlus {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsLaurent c) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlus R) :
    c • x ∈ aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c', w, hc', rfl⟩ := hx
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c * c', w, hc.mul hc', by rw [smul_smul]⟩
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_F_mem_minus
statement:
lemma qDivPow_F_mem_minus (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (F R 𝕧))
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (pow_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)) n) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.fPow_mem_minus
statement:
lemma fPow_mem_minus (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    fPow R w ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (F R 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact one_mem _
  | cons p w ih => rw [fPow_cons]; exact mul_mem (qDivPow_F_mem_minus p.1 p.2) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mem_plus
statement:
lemma qDivPow_E_mem_plus (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (pow_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)) n) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_mem_plus
statement:
lemma ePow_mem_plus (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    ePow R w ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact one_mem _
  | cons p w ih => rw [ePow_cons]; exact mul_mem (qDivPow_E_mem_plus p.1 p.2) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.isLaurent_counit_fPow
statement: lemma isLaurent_counit_fPow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : IsLaurent (counit R 𝕧 (fPow R w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using isLaurent_one
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [fPow_cons, _root_.map_mul]
    refine IsLaurent.mul ?_ ih
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.2 with h | h
    · rw [h, qDivPow_zero', _root_.map_one]; exact isLaurent_one
    · rw [qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, counit_F, zero_pow h.ne', smul_zero]; exact isLaurent_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.Theta_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma Theta_mem_aPlus (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aFormFE R) :
    Theta R ratFunc_X_not_root ζ x ∈ aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, w', L, l, h, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [Theta_elt]
    split_ifs
    · have e := theta_mul_plus ratFunc_X_not_root ζ ⟨fPow R w, fPow_mem_minus w⟩
        ⟨ePow R w', ePow_mem_plus w'⟩
      simp only at e
      rw [e]
      exact smul_mem_aPlus (isLaurent_counit_fPow w) (ePow_mem_aPlus w')
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    rw [laurent_smul, map_smul]; exact smul_mem_aPlus ⟨a, rfl⟩ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mem_aPlus_of_elt_mem_aForm
proof:
:= by
  have h' : elt L ζ x hxw ∈ aFormFE R := by
    rw [← aForm_eq_aFormFE]; exact h
  have := Theta_mem_aPlus ζ h'
  simp only [Theta_elt, ↓reduceIte] at this
  rwa [theta_plus ratFunc_X_not_root ζ hx] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.wordWeightAction_sub
statement:
lemma wordWeightAction_sub (ω : List I) (L l : Y →+ ℤ) :
    wordWeightAction R ω (L - l) = wordWeightAction R ω L - wordWeightAction R ω l
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i ω ih => simp only [wordWeightAction, ih, AddMonoidHom.sub_comp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.word_braid_mem
statement:
lemma word_braid_mem {ω : List I} {L l : Y →+ ℤ} {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l)) :
    (ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod u ∈
      adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (wordWeightAction R ω L - wordWeightAction R ω l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wordWeightAction_sub]
  exact word_braid_mem_adWeightSpace
    (fun i ↦ braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i) ω hu

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_braid_elt
statement:
lemma list_braid_elt (ω : List I) {L l : Y →+ ℤ} {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hu : u ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (L - l)) :
    (ω.map (braid (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod (elt L l u hu) =
      elt (wordWeightAction R ω L) (wordWeightAction R ω l)
        ((ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod u) (word_braid_mem hu)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ih,
      braid_elt ratFunc_X_not_root i _ _ _ (by
        rw [← AddMonoidHom.sub_comp]
        exact (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i).map_mem_adWeightSpace
          (word_braid_mem hu))]
    exact elt_index rfl rfl (by rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_braid_mem_aForm
statement:
lemma list_braid_mem_aForm (ω : List I) {x : Modified R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aForm R) :
    (ω.map (braid (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod x ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact hx
  | cons i ω ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    exact braid_mem_aForm i ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_braid_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
statement:
theorem list_braid_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
    {W : Type*} [Group W] {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W}
    {ω : List I} {i : I} (hω : cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i])) (t : ℕ) :
    (ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈
      aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have hE : (ω.map T).prod (E R 𝕧 i) ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧)) := by
    have := rootVector_mem_adjoin_of_not_root (R := R) ratFunc_X_not_root hω ω.length
      (by simp)
    simpa [CoxeterSystem.rootVector, T] using this
  have hx : (ω.map T).prod (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈
      Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧)) := by
    have e := map_qDivPow' ((ω.map T).prod : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] _).toAlgHom (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t
      (E R 𝕧 i)
    simp only [AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom] at e
    rw [e]
    exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (pow_mem hE t) _
  have hd := list_braid_mem_aForm ω (divE_mem (R := R) i t 0)
  rw [divE, list_braid_elt] at hd
  exact mem_aPlus_of_elt_mem_aForm hx _ hd

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidReversal_one
statement: lemma braidReversal_one : braidReversal (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [braidReversal]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.ePow_append
statement: lemma ePow_append (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) : ePow R (w ++ w') = ePow R w * ePow R w'
proof:
:= by
  simp [ePow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidReversal_ePow
statement: lemma braidReversal_ePow (w : List (I × ℕ)) : braidReversal (ePow R w) = ePow R w.reverse
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa using braidReversal_one
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [ePow_cons, braidReversal_mul, ih, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_E,
      List.reverse_cons, ePow_append]
    simp [ePow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidReversal_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma braidReversal_mem_aPlus {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ aPlus R) :
    braidReversal x ∈ aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, w, hc, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul, braidReversal_ePow]
    exact smul_mem_aPlus hc (ePow_mem_aPlus _)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply'
statement:
lemma braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply' (i : I) (y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm y =
      braidReversal (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (braidReversal y))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_braid_symm_apply
statement:
lemma list_braid_symm_apply (ω : List I) (y : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root j).symm).prod y =
      braidReversal ((ω.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod
        (braidReversal y))
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing y with
  | nil => simp [braidReversal_involutive y]
  | cons i ω ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    rw [ih, braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply', braidReversal_involutive]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.list_braid_symm_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
statement:
theorem list_braid_symm_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus
    {W : Type*} [Group W] {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W}
    {ω : List I} {i : I} (hω : cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i])) (t : ℕ) :
    (ω.map fun j ↦ (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root j).symm).prod
      (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i)) ∈ aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  rw [list_braid_symm_apply, braidReversal_qDivPow, braidReversal_E]
  exact braidReversal_mem_aPlus (list_braid_qDivPow_E_mem_aPlus hω t)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_b2
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_b2 :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  set X := braidEj R 𝕧 i j
  set y := b2RootY R 𝕧 i j
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 2 := parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 2) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have h2 : qFactorial q 2 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 2
  have hF2 : qFactorial q 2 = qInt q 2 := by simp [qFactorial, qInt]
  have H : B2PBW.Rel (q ^ 2) (E R 𝕧 i) (qInt q 2 • X) y (E R 𝕧 j) := by
    have e : qInt q 2 • X = b2RootX R 𝕧 i j := by
      rw [show X = _ from b2_braidEj_eq h, smul_smul, ← hF2, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]
    rw [e]
    exact b2_rel hij h h'
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have hT2 : T i (E R 𝕧 j) = X := a2_rootVector_two hij Hi
  have hT3 : T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = y := by
    have e := b2_rootVector_three Hi Hj hij h h' hq
    change T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_cc_two hq0 hq, ← b2_qFactorial_two hq0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul,
      BraidDiagonal.X_succ (n := 0), b2_shift_zero]
    rfl
  have hT4 : T i (T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j))) = E R 𝕧 j := b2_rootVector_four Hi Hj hij h h' hq h2
  have hsymm : ∀ k z, (T k).symm z = braidReversal (T k (braidReversal z)) :=
    fun k z ↦ braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply' k z
  have Hs : B2PBW.Rel (q ^ 2) (op (E R 𝕧 i))
      (qInt q 2 • op (braidReversal X)) (op (braidReversal y)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) := by
    constructor <;> apply unop_injective
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_sub, unop_smul, unop_op, map_sub, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal H.fe
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_sub, unop_smul, unop_op, map_sub, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal H.ye
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_smul, unop_op, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal H.xe
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_smul, unop_op, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal H.fy
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 4 → ℕ, pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j] c =
      B2Integral.M4 q (E R 𝕧 i) (braidReversal X) (braidReversal y) (E R 𝕧 j)
        (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_symm_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one, mul_one]
    change Ed R i _ * ((T i).symm (Ed R j _) * ((T i).symm ((T j).symm (Ed R i _)) *
      (T i).symm ((T j).symm ((T i).symm (Ed R j _))))) = _
    rw [Ed, Ed, Ed, Ed, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap]
    simp only [hsymm, braidReversal_E, braidReversal_involutive _]
    rw [hT4, hT3, hT2, braidReversal_E, hd]
    simp only [B2Integral.M4, B2Integral.M3, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j])) ↔
      x ∈ B2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (braidReversal X) (braidReversal y)
        (E R 𝕧 j) := fun x ↦ by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact B2Integral.M4_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U]
        exact B2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [← laurent_smul_U, show B2Integral.M4 q (E R 𝕧 i) (braidReversal X)
          (braidReversal y) (E R 𝕧 j) a b c' d =
          pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j] ![a, b, c', d] by rw [hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  have hS := B2Integral.coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing_of_op hq0 hqi hpi Hs hqΛ hqΛ'
  ext x
  rw [hconv, Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, ← SetLike.mem_coe, hS, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_genRing hd]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_b2_rev
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_b2_rev :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i])) =
      (adjoinPair (R := R) i j).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : 𝕂 := 𝕧 ^ D.d i
  set y' := b2RevRootY R 𝕧 i j
  set X' := (qFactorial q 2)⁻¹ • b2RevRootX R 𝕧 i j
  have hd : 𝕧 ^ D.d j = q ^ 2 := parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hqi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt q n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦
    qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i) hn
  have hpi : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → qInt (q ^ 2) n ≠ 0 := fun n hn ↦ by
    rw [← hd]
    exact qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))
      (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root j) hn
  have hq : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 (vd_pow_ne_one (D := D) ratFunc_X_not_root i)
  have h2 : qFactorial q 2 ≠ 0 := qFactorial_vd_ne_zero i 2
  have hF2 : qFactorial q 2 = qInt q 2 := by simp [qFactorial, qInt]
  have hS3 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij
  rw [B2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_three h] at hS3
  have hS2 := serre_E R 𝕧 hij.symm
  rw [A2PBW.toNat_one_sub_eq_two h', hd] at hS2
  have H : B2PBW.Rel (q ^ 2) (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (qInt q 2 • op X') (op y') (op (E R 𝕧 j)) := by
    have e : qInt q 2 • op X' = op (b2RevRootX R 𝕧 i j) := by
      rw [← op_smul, smul_smul, ← hF2, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]
    rw [e]
    exact B2PBW.rel_op hq0 hS3 hS2
  set Λ : Subring 𝕂 := (LusztigF.integralLaurentEval).range
  have hqΛ : q ∈ Λ := RingHom.mem_range.2 (isLaurent_pow (D.d i))
  have hqΛ' : q⁻¹ ∈ Λ := by
    have := isLaurent_inv_pow (D.d i)
    rw [inv_pow] at this
    exact RingHom.mem_range.2 this
  have hmap : ∀ (f : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ≃ₐ[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (t : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) (x),
      f (qDivPow t n x) = qDivPow t n (f x) := fun f t n x ↦ map_qDivPow' f.toAlgHom t n x
  set T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root
  have Hi := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i
  have Hj := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R j
  have hY' : T j (E R 𝕧 i) = y' := by
    have e := a2_rootVector_two hij.symm Hj
    change T j (E R 𝕧 i) = _ at e
    rw [e, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h', parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge h h']
    rfl
  have hY : T j (b2RootY R 𝕧 i j) = E R 𝕧 i := by
    rw [b2RootY_eq_X R 𝕧 (j := j)]
    exact b2_T_X_one Hj hij h h' hq h2
  have hX : T j (T i (E R 𝕧 j)) = X' := by
    have e := a2_rootVector_two hij Hi
    change T i (E R 𝕧 j) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_braidEj_eq h, _root_.map_smul, b2RootX, _root_.map_sub, _root_.map_mul,
      _root_.map_mul, hY, hY']
    rfl
  have hE : T j (T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i))) = E R 𝕧 i := by
    have e := b2_rootVector_three Hi Hj hij h h' hq
    change T i (T j (E R 𝕧 i)) = _ at e
    rw [e, b2_cc_two hq0 hq, ← b2_qFactorial_two hq0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2, one_smul,
      ← b2RootY_eq_X, hY]
  have hsymm : ∀ k z, (T k).symm z = braidReversal (T k (braidReversal z)) :=
    fun k z ↦ braidEquivOfNotRoot_symm_apply' k z
  have Hs : B2PBW.Rel (q ^ 2) (op (op (E R 𝕧 i)))
      (qInt q 2 • op (op (braidReversal X'))) (op (op (braidReversal y')))
      (op (op (E R 𝕧 j))) := by
    constructor <;> apply unop_injective <;> apply unop_injective
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_sub, unop_smul, unop_op, map_sub, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal (congrArg unop H.fe)
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_sub, unop_smul, unop_op, map_sub, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal (congrArg unop H.ye)
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_smul, unop_op, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal (congrArg unop H.xe)
    · simpa only [unop_mul, unop_smul, unop_op, map_smul,
        braidReversal_mul, braidReversal_E] using congrArg braidReversal (congrArg unop H.fy)
  have hmono : ∀ c : Fin 4 → ℕ, op (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i] c) =
      B2Integral.M4 q (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (braidReversal X')) (op (braidReversal y'))
        (op (E R 𝕧 j)) (c 3) (c 2) (c 1) (c 0) := fun c ↦ by
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, Ta_symm_apply, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_one, mul_one]
    change op (Ed R j _ * ((T j).symm (Ed R i _) * ((T j).symm ((T i).symm (Ed R j _)) *
      (T j).symm ((T i).symm ((T j).symm (Ed R i _)))))) = _
    rw [Ed, Ed, Ed, Ed, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap, hmap]
    simp only [hsymm, braidReversal_E, braidReversal_involutive _]
    rw [hE, hX, hY', braidReversal_E, hd]
    simp only [B2Integral.M4, B2Integral.M3, qDivPow_op, op_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hconv : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i])) ↔
      op x ∈ B2Integral.orderedSpan q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (braidReversal X'))
        (op (braidReversal y')) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [hmono]; exact B2Integral.M4_mem_orderedSpan _ _ _ _
      | zero => rw [op_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [op_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | smul a x _ hx =>
        rw [laurent_smul_U, op_smul]
        exact B2Integral.smul_mem_orderedSpan (RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) hx
    · intro hx
      rw [← unop_op x]
      generalize op x = z at hx
      induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
        obtain ⟨c, hc, a, b, c', d, rfl⟩ := hz
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hc
        rw [unop_smul, ← laurent_smul_U, show unop (B2Integral.M4 q (op (E R 𝕧 i))
          (op (braidReversal X'))
          (op (braidReversal y')) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) a b c' d) =
          pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i] ![d, c', b, a] by
            rw [← unop_op (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i] _), hmono]; rfl]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => rw [unop_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [unop_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
      | neg x _ hx => rw [unop_neg]; exact neg_mem hx
  have hS := B2Integral.coe_orderedSpan_eq_genRing_of_op hq0 hqi hpi Hs hqΛ hqΛ'
  have hgen : B2Integral.genRing q Λ (op (E R 𝕧 i)) (op (E R 𝕧 j)) =
      (B2Integral.genRing q Λ (E R 𝕧 i) (E R 𝕧 j)).op := by
    rw [B2Integral.genRing, B2Integral.genRing, Subring.op_closure]
    congr 1
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩) | ⟨n, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [qDivPow_op]⟩
    · rintro ((⟨c, hc, hz⟩ | ⟨n, hz⟩) | ⟨n, hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c, hc, unop_injective hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨n, unop_injective (by simpa [qDivPow_op] using hz)⟩
  ext x
  rw [hconv, Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, ← SetLike.mem_coe, hS, hgen, SetLike.mem_coe,
    Subring.mem_op, unop_op, ← SetLike.mem_coe, ← coe_adjoinPair_eq_genRing hd]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_b2_braid
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_b2_braid :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j])) =
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i]))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidInvariantSymm_of_span_pbwDivSymm_g2
statement:
theorem braidInvariantSymm_of_span_pbwDivSymm_g2
    (hG : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i = 3 →
      Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [i, j, i, j, i, j])) =
        Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R [j, i, j, i, j, i]))) :
    BraidInvariantSymm R
proof:
:= by
  intro u w hm
  obtain ⟨p, s, i, j, hij, hmij, rfl, rfl⟩ := hm
  have hT0 := isBraidLiftable_braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i j hij hmij
  have key : ∀ u w : List I,
      (u.reverse.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod =
        (w.reverse.map (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root)).prod →
      (u.map fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm).prod = (w.map fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm).prod := by
    intro u w huw
    ext x
    rw [list_Ta_symm_apply, list_Ta_symm_apply, list_symm_prod_eq_symm, list_symm_prod_eq_symm,
      huw]
  have hw : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℤ), D.cartanMatrix i j = a → D.cartanMatrix j i = b →
      (a * b).toNat = n → D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = Matrix.coxeterEntry n ∧
        D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = Matrix.coxeterEntry n := by
    intro n a b ha hb hn
    rw [Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij, Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne _ hij.symm, ha,
      hb, mul_comm b, hn]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  rcases cartanMatrix_cases hij hmij with ⟨h0, h0'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h2, h2'⟩ | ⟨h2, h2'⟩ | h3'
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 0 0 0 h0 h0' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT0 ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDivSymm_commuting h0)
      (key [i, j] [j, i] (by simpa using hT0.symm)) p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 1 (-1) (-1) h1 h1' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT0 ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDivSymm_a2_braid hij h1 h1').symm
      (key [j, i, j] [i, j, i] (by simpa using hT0)) p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 2 (-2) (-1) h2 h2' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT0 ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDivSymm_b2_braid hij h2 h2')
      (key [i, j, i, j] [j, i, j, i] (by simpa using hT0.symm)) p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 2 (-1) (-2) h2 h2' rfl
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j = [i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i = [j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT0 ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R)
      (span_pbwDivSymm_b2_braid hij.symm h2' h2).symm
      (key [i, j, i, j] [j, i, j, i] (by simpa using hT0.symm)) p s
  · obtain ⟨hm, hm'⟩ := hw 3 _ _ rfl rfl (by rw [h3']; rfl)
    have e : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix i j =
        [i, j, i, j, i, j] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm]; rfl
    have e' : CoxeterSystem.braidWord D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix j i =
        [j, i, j, i, j, i] := by
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord]; rw [hm']; rfl
    rw [e, e'] at hT0 ⊢
    exact CoxeterSystem.span_pbwDivMonomial_context (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R)
      (hG i j hij h3')
      (key [i, j, i, j, i, j] [j, i, j, i, j, i] (by simpa using hT0.symm)) p s

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.braidInvariantSymm_of_mul_ne_three
statement:
theorem braidInvariantSymm_of_mul_ne_three
    (h3 : ∀ i j, D.cartanMatrix i j * D.cartanMatrix j i ≠ 3) : BraidInvariantSymm R
proof:
:=
  braidInvariantSymm_of_span_pbwDivSymm_g2 fun i j _ h ↦ absurd h (h3 i j)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {u w : List I}
    (hu : cs.IsReduced u) (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (huw : cs.wordProd u = cs.wordProd w) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R u)) = Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))
proof:
:=
  CoxeterSystem.eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove (fun _ _ _ hm ↦ hB _ _ hm)
    hu (CoxeterSystem.reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hu hw huw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDivSymm_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDivSymm_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    {i : I} (hi : cs.IsLeftDescent (cs.wordProd w) i) (t : ℕ) {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t (E R 𝕧 i) * x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu₀⟩ := exists_reduced_cons_of_isLeftDescent cs hi
  have hs := span_pbwDivSymm_of_isReduced_of_braidInvariant hB cs hu hw hu₀
  rw [← hs] at hx ⊢
  exact CoxeterSystem.mul_mem_pbwDivSpan_cons (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R) i u
    (Ed_mul_mem_span i t) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.span_pbwDivSymm_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem span_pbwDivSymm_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w)) =
      (Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i))).toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  let S := Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w))
  have hplus : ∀ c, pbwDivSymm R w c ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Ed R i)) := fun c ↦ by
    have hc := pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, AlgEquiv.one_apply] at hc
    generalize pbwDivSymm R w c = y at hc ⊢
    induction hc using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact hplus c
  · intro x hx
    have h1 : (1 : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) ∈ S :=
      CoxeterSystem.one_mem_pbwDivSpan (fun i ↦ (Ta R i).symm) (Ed R) Ed_zero w
    have hmul : ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S := by
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
        exact fun y hy ↦ qDivPow_E_mul_mem_span_pbwDivSymm_of_braidInvariant hB cs hw
          (hw₀ ▸ cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i) n hy
      | algebraMap a =>
        intro y hy
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
        exact S.smul_mem a hy
      | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem (hx y hy) (hz y hy)
      | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
        intro y hy; rw [mul_assoc]; exact hx _ (hz y hy)
    simpa using hmul 1 h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.coe_span_pbwDivSymm_longest_of_braidInvariant
statement:
theorem coe_span_pbwDivSymm_longest_of_braidInvariant {W : Type*} [Group W] [Finite W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W) {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) :
    (Submodule.span 𝒜 (Set.range (pbwDivSymm R w)) : Set (QuantumGroup R 𝕧)) = aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      simpa using pbwDivSymm_mem_aPlus (R := R) w [] (by simpa using hw) c
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul_U]; exact smul_mem_aPlus ⟨a, rfl⟩ hx
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, span_pbwDivSymm_longest_eq_of_braidInvariant hB cs hw hw₀]
    induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, w', hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine smul_mem_of_isLaurent hc ?_
      induction w' with
      | nil => exact one_mem _
      | cons p w' ih =>
        rw [ePow_cons]
        exact mul_mem (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)) ih
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => exact neg_mem hx
