  decide

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.artinHom_G₂_images
statement:
theorem artinHom_G₂_images {D : LusztigCartanDatum (Fin 2)} (R : D.RootDatum Y)
    (hD : D.cartanMatrix = CartanMatrix.G₂) (hpow : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → v ^ m ≠ 1) (l : Fin 2) :
    HasBraidGeneratorImages l
      (artinHom_G₂ R hD hpow (TripleEdgeArtinGroup.generator l)).toAlgHom
proof:
:=
  tripleEdgeArtinHom_of_not_root_images _ _ _ _ _ l

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.shift_succ
statement: lemma shift_succ (n : ℕ) : shift q Q (n + 1) = q ^ 2 * shift q Q n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shift]; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.cc_eq
statement: lemma cc_eq (m : ℕ) : cc q Q m = Q * alpha q m - Q⁻¹ * beta q m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [cc, alpha, beta]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [cc, ih, alpha, beta, shift, mul_inv, inv_inv, inv_pow]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.sq_sub_one_ne
statement: lemma sq_sub_one_ne (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) : q ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hd
  have e : q - q⁻¹ = q⁻¹ * (q ^ 2 - 1) := by field_simp
  rw [e, h, mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.alpha_mul
statement:
lemma alpha_mul (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    (q - q⁻¹) * alpha q (d + 1) = q⁻¹ ^ d * qInt q (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp [alpha, qInt, hd]
  | succ d ih =>
    have h1 : qInt q 1 = 1 := by simp [qInt]
    rw [alpha, mul_add, ih, show d + 1 + 1 = 1 + (d + 1) by ring, qInt_add 1 (d + 1), h1]
    simp only [inv_pow]
    field_simp [sq_sub_one_ne hq hd]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.beta_mul
statement:
lemma beta_mul (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    (q - q⁻¹) * beta q (d + 1) = q ^ d * qInt q (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp [beta, qInt, hd]
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [beta, mul_add, ih, qInt_succ (d + 1)]
    field_simp [sq_sub_one_ne hq hd]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.beta_succ
statement:
lemma beta_succ (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    beta q (d + 1) = q ^ (2 * d) * alpha q (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd
  rw [beta_mul hq hd, mul_left_comm, alpha_mul hq hd, inv_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.beta_succ_mul_alpha
statement:
lemma beta_succ_mul_alpha (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    beta q (d + 1) * alpha q d = q ^ 2 * beta q d * alpha q (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | zero => simp [alpha, beta]
  | succ d =>
    rw [beta_succ hq hd (d + 1), beta_succ hq hd d,
      show 2 * (d + 1) = 2 * d + 2 by ring, pow_add]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.one_sub_mul_alpha
statement:
lemma one_sub_mul_alpha (hq : q ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (1 - q ^ (2 * m) * Q⁻¹ * Q⁻¹) * alpha q (m + 1) = Q⁻¹ * cc q Q (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cc_eq, beta_succ hq hd]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.cc_mul
statement:
lemma cc_mul (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (q - q⁻¹) * cc q Q (m + 1) = qInt q (m + 1) * (Q * q⁻¹ ^ m - Q⁻¹ * q ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cc_eq, mul_sub, mul_left_comm, alpha_mul hq hd, mul_left_comm (q - q⁻¹) Q⁻¹,
    beta_mul hq hd]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.coefA_mul_alpha
statement:
lemma coefA_mul_alpha (hq : q ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (c : k) :
    ∀ n m, n < m → coefA q Q c n (m + 1) * alpha q (m + 1 - n) =
      shift q Q n * cc q Q (m + 1) * coefA q Q c n m
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro m _
    have h := one_sub_mul_alpha (Q := Q) hq hQ hd m
    simp only [coefA, shift, Nat.sub_zero, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
    linear_combination coefA q Q c 0 m * h
  | succ n ih =>
    intro m hm
    have h1 := ih m (by omega)
    have h2 := beta_succ_mul_alpha hq hd (m - n)
    rw [show m + 1 - n = m - n + 1 by omega] at h1
    simp only [coefA, show m + 1 - (n + 1) = m - n by omega,
      show m + 1 - n = m - n + 1 by omega]
    rw [shift_succ]
    linear_combination (-coefA q Q c n (m + 1)) * h2 + (-(q ^ 2) * beta q (m - n)) * h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.coefA_diag
statement:
lemma coefA_diag (hq : q ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (c : k) (n : ℕ) :
    (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * coefA q Q c n (n + 1) = -(shift q Q n * cc q Q (n + 1)) * coefB q Q c n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [coefA, coefB, cc, shift, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, zero_add]
    field_simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 := coefA_mul_alpha hq hQ hd c n (n + 1) (by omega)
    have h2 := beta_succ (q := q) hq hd 1
    simp only [show n + 1 + 1 - n = 2 by omega] at h1
    simp only [coefA, coefB, show n + 1 + 1 - n = 2 by omega]
    rw [shift_succ, ← ih]
    simp only [mul_one] at h2
    rw [h2]
    linear_combination (-(q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * q ^ 2) * h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.coefB_eq_prod
statement:
lemma coefB_eq_prod (c : k) (n : ℕ) :
    coefB q Q c n = (∏ t ∈ range n, -(shift q Q t * cc q Q (t + 1))) * c
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [coefB]
  | succ n ih => rw [coefB, ih, prod_range_succ]; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.qFactorial_eq_prod
statement: lemma qFactorial_eq_prod (n : ℕ) : qFactorial q n = ∏ t ∈ range n, qInt q (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [qFactorial]
  | succ n ih => rw [qFactorial_succ, ih, prod_range_succ, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.cc_pow
statement:
lemma cc_pow (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) {r t : ℕ} (ht : t < r) :
    cc q (q ^ r) (t + 1) = qInt q (t + 1) * qInt q (r - t)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd
  rw [cc_mul hq hd, mul_left_comm, qInt_mul_sub]
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ : ∃ u, r = t + u := ⟨r - t, by omega⟩
  rw [show t + u - t = u by omega, pow_add]
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.coefB_pow
statement:
lemma coefB_pow (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : q - q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (c : k) (r : ℕ) :
    coefB q (q ^ r) c r = ((-1) ^ r * q⁻¹ ^ r * qFactorial q r ^ 2) * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefB_eq_prod]
  congr 1
  rw [prod_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ by rw [cc_pow hq hd (mem_range.1 ht)]]
  have e1 : ∏ t ∈ range r, -(shift q (q ^ r) t * (qInt q (t + 1) * qInt q (r - t))) =
      (∏ t ∈ range r, (-1 : k)) * (∏ t ∈ range r, q ^ (2 * t)) *
        (∏ t ∈ range r, (q ^ r)⁻¹) * (∏ t ∈ range r, qInt q (t + 1)) *
          ∏ t ∈ range r, qInt q (r - t) := by
    simp only [← prod_mul_distrib, shift]
    refine prod_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
    ring
  have e2 : ∏ t ∈ range r, qInt q (r - t) = ∏ t ∈ range r, qInt q (t + 1) := by
    rw [← prod_range_reflect]
    refine prod_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
    rw [show r - (r - 1 - t) = t + 1 by have := mem_range.1 ht; omega]
  have e3 : (∏ t ∈ range r, q ^ (2 * t)) * (∏ t ∈ range r, (q ^ r)⁻¹) = q⁻¹ ^ r := by
    rw [prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, prod_const, card_range, ← mul_sum, mul_comm 2,
      sum_range_id_mul_two, inv_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
    field_simp
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    cases r with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ r => simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]; ring
  rw [e1, e2, ← qFactorial_eq_prod, prod_const, card_range]
  linear_combination (-1 : k) ^ r * qFactorial q r ^ 2 * e3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.X_succ
statement:
lemma X_succ (E x : B) (n : ℕ) :
    X q Q E x (n + 1) = E * X q Q E x n - shift q Q n • (X q Q E x n * E)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.mul_X
statement:
lemma mul_X {E x w : B} {t μ : k} (hwE : w * E = t • (E * w)) (hwx : w * x = μ • (x * w))
    (n : ℕ) : w * X q Q E x n = (μ * t ^ n) • (X q Q E x n * w)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [X] using hwx
  | succ n ih =>
    have hwE' (z : B) : w * (E * z) = t • (E * (w * z)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, hwE, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    have ih' (z : B) : w * (X q Q E x n * z) = (μ * t ^ n) • (X q Q E x n * (w * z)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    rw [X_succ, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, hwE', ih', ih, hwE]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, sub_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc, pow_succ]
    congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.F_mul_step
statement:
lemma F_mul_step {E F K K' Y Z : B} {γ s : k}
    (hEF : E * F - F * E = (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K'))
    (hK'E : K' * E = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (E * K'))
    (hKY : K * Y = s • (Y * K)) (hK'Y : K' * Y = s⁻¹ • (Y * K'))
    (hFY : F * Y = Y * F + γ • (Z * K'))
    (hZ : γ • (E * Z - (q⁻¹ ^ 2 * s) • (Z * E)) = γ • Y) :
    F * (E * Y - s • (Y * E)) =
      (E * Y - s • (Y * E)) * F + (γ + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * (s⁻¹ - s)) • (Y * K')
proof:
:= by
  have hFE : F * E = E * F - (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K') := by rw [← hEF]; abel
  have hZ' : γ • (E * Z * K') - (γ * (q⁻¹ ^ 2 * s)) • (Z * E * K') = γ • (Y * K') := by
    have := congrArg (· * K') hZ
    simpa only [smul_mul_assoc, sub_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul] using this
  calc F * (E * Y - s • (Y * E))
      = (F * E) * Y - s • ((F * Y) * E) := by
        rw [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    _ = (E * F - (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K')) * Y - s • ((Y * F + γ • (Z * K')) * E) := by
        rw [hFE, hFY]
    _ = E * (F * Y) - (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K * Y) + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K' * Y)
          - s • (Y * (F * E)) - (s * γ) • (Z * (K' * E)) := by
        simp only [sub_mul, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul]
        abel
    _ = E * (Y * F + γ • (Z * K')) - (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (s • (Y * K))
          + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (s⁻¹ • (Y * K'))
          - s • (Y * (E * F - (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K')))
          - (s * γ) • (Z * (q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (E * K'))) := by
        rw [hFY, hKY, hK'Y, hFE, hK'E]
    _ = (E * Y - s • (Y * E)) * F + (γ + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * (s⁻¹ - s)) • (Y * K') +
          ((γ • (E * Z * K') - (γ * (q⁻¹ ^ 2 * s)) • (Z * E * K')) - γ • (Y * K')) := by
        simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
          smul_sub, smul_smul, add_smul, sub_smul]
        module
    _ = (E * Y - s • (Y * E)) * F + (γ + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * (s⁻¹ - s)) • (Y * K') := by
        rw [hZ', sub_self, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.inv_sq_mul_shift_succ
statement:
lemma inv_sq_mul_shift_succ (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    q⁻¹ ^ 2 * shift q Q (n + 1) = shift q Q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [shift_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_pow, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.K_mul_X
statement:
lemma K_mul_X {E x K : B} (hKE : K * E = q ^ 2 • (E * K)) (hKx : K * x = Q⁻¹ • (x * K))
    (n : ℕ) : K * X q Q E x n = shift q Q n • (X q Q E x n * K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_X hKE hKx, shift, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.K'_mul_X
statement:
lemma K'_mul_X {E x K' : B} (hK'E : K' * E = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (E * K')) (hK'x : K' * x = Q • (x * K'))
    (n : ℕ) : K' * X q Q E x n = (shift q Q n)⁻¹ • (X q Q E x n * K')
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_X hK'E hK'x, shift, ← pow_mul, mul_inv, inv_inv, inv_pow, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.F_mul_X
statement:
lemma F_mul_X (hq : q ≠ 0) {E F K K' x : B}
    (hEF : E * F - F * E = (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K'))
    (hKE : K * E = q ^ 2 • (E * K)) (hK'E : K' * E = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (E * K'))
    (hxF : x * F = F * x) (hKx : K * x = Q⁻¹ • (x * K)) (hK'x : K' * x = Q • (x * K'))
    (n : ℕ) :
    F * X q Q E x (n + 1) = X q Q E x (n + 1) * F + cc q Q (n + 1) • (X q Q E x n * K')
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have h := F_mul_step (Z := 0) (γ := 0) (s := shift q Q 0) hEF hK'E
      (K_mul_X hKE hKx 0) (K'_mul_X hK'E hK'x 0) (by simp [X, hxF]) (by simp)
    simpa [cc, X_succ] using h
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := F_mul_step (Y := X q Q E x (n + 1)) (Z := X q Q E x n) (γ := cc q Q (n + 1))
      (s := shift q Q (n + 1)) hEF hK'E (K_mul_X hKE hKx _) (K'_mul_X hK'E hK'x _) ih
      (by rw [inv_sq_mul_shift_succ hq, X_succ])
    rw [X_succ E x (n + 1), h]; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.bracket_succ_succ
statement:
lemma bracket_succ_succ {E F K x y : B} {Q' γ : k} {n m : ℕ}
    (hEY : E * X q Q' F y (m + 1) = X q Q' F y (m + 1) * E + γ • (X q Q' F y m * K))
    (hKX : K * X q Q E x n = shift q Q n • (X q Q E x n * K)) :
    X q Q E x (n + 1) * X q Q' F y (m + 1) - X q Q' F y (m + 1) * X q Q E x (n + 1) =
      E * (X q Q E x n * X q Q' F y (m + 1) - X q Q' F y (m + 1) * X q Q E x n) -
        shift q Q n • ((X q Q E x n * X q Q' F y (m + 1) - X q Q' F y (m + 1) * X q Q E x n) * E) -
          (shift q Q n * γ) • ((X q Q E x n * X q Q' F y m - X q Q' F y m * X q Q E x n) * K)
proof:
:= by
  have hYE (z : B) : X q Q' F y (m + 1) * (E * z) =
      E * (X q Q' F y (m + 1) * z) - γ • (X q Q' F y m * (K * z)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hEY]
    simp only [add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    abel
  rw [X_succ E x n]
  simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
  rw [hEY, hYE, hKX]
  simp only [mul_add, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.comm_succ_succ
statement:
lemma comm_succ_succ {E F K x y : B} {γ : k} {n m : ℕ}
    (hEY : E * X q Q F y (m + 1) = X q Q F y (m + 1) * E + γ • (X q Q F y m * K))
    (hKX : K * X q Q E x n = shift q Q n • (X q Q E x n * K)) :
    comm q Q E F x y (n + 1) (m + 1) = E * comm q Q E F x y n (m + 1) -
      shift q Q n • (comm q Q E F x y n (m + 1) * E) -
        (shift q Q n * γ) • (comm q Q E F x y n m * K)
proof:
:=
  bracket_succ_succ hEY hKX

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.comm_zero_succ
statement:
lemma comm_zero_succ {E F x y : B} (hxF : x * F = F * x) (m : ℕ) :
    comm q Q E F x y 0 (m + 1) =
      F * comm q Q E F x y 0 m - shift q Q m • (comm q Q E F x y 0 m * F)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comm, X, sub_mul, mul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, smul_sub]
  rw [← mul_assoc x F, hxF, mul_assoc]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.E_mul_F_pow
statement:
lemma E_mul_F_pow {E F K K' : B} (hEF : E * F - F * E = (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K'))
    (hKF : K * F = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (F * K)) (hK'F : K' * F = q ^ 2 • (F * K')) (d : ℕ) :
    E * F ^ (d + 1) = F ^ (d + 1) * E + F ^ d * (alpha q (d + 1) • K - beta q (d + 1) • K')
proof:
:= by
  have hEF' : E * F = F * E + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K') := by rw [← hEF]; abel
  induction d with
  | zero => simp [alpha, beta, hEF', smul_sub]
  | succ d ih =>
    have h1 := mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul hKF (d + 1)
    have h2 := mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul hK'F (d + 1)
    have ha : alpha q (d + 1 + 1) = alpha q (d + 1) + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (d + 1)) := rfl
    have hb : beta q (d + 1 + 1) = beta q (d + 1) + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ * q ^ (2 * (d + 1)) := rfl
    rw [ha, hb, pow_mul, pow_mul]
    rw [pow_succ' F (d + 1), ← mul_assoc, hEF', add_mul, mul_assoc, ih]
    simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub,
      h1, h2, add_smul, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
    module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.E_comm_F_pow_mul
statement:
lemma E_comm_F_pow_mul {E F K K' T : B} {s ρ : k}
    (hEF : E * F - F * E = (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K'))
    (hKF : K * F = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (F * K)) (hK'F : K' * F = q ^ 2 • (F * K'))
    (hTE : T * E = ρ • (E * T)) (hsρ : s * ρ = 1) (d : ℕ) :
    E * (F ^ (d + 1) * T) - s • (F ^ (d + 1) * T * E) =
      F ^ d * (alpha q (d + 1) • (K * T) - beta q (d + 1) • (K' * T))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, E_mul_F_pow hEF hKF hK'F, mul_assoc (F ^ (d + 1)) T E, hTE]
  simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc, hsρ,
    one_smul, mul_sub]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.E_mul_Y
statement:
lemma E_mul_Y (m : ℕ) :
    E * X q Q F y (m + 1) = X q Q F y (m + 1) * E + cc q Q (m + 1) • (X q Q F y m * K)
proof:
:= by
  have hFE : F * E - E * F = (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K' - K) := by
    rw [← neg_sub, h.EF, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]
  exact F_mul_X h.q_ne hFE h.K'F h.KF h.Ey.symm h.K'y h.Ky m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.comm_zero_zero
statement: lemma comm_zero_zero : comm q Q E F x y 0 0 = c • (L - L')
proof:
:= by
  simpa [comm, X] using h.xy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.comm_zero_succ'
statement:
lemma comm_zero_succ' (m : ℕ) :
    comm q Q E F x y 0 (m + 1) = coefA q Q c 0 (m + 1) • (F ^ (m + 1) * L')
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [comm_zero_succ h.xF, h.comm_zero_zero]
    simp only [coefA, shift, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, zero_add, pow_one, smul_sub,
      mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, h.LF, h.L'F, smul_smul]
    have hQ := h.Q_ne
    match_scalars <;> field_simp
    ring
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [comm_zero_succ h.xF, ih,
      show coefA q Q c 0 (m + 1 + 1) = coefA q Q c 0 (m + 1) *
        (1 - q ^ (2 * (m + 1)) * Q⁻¹ * Q⁻¹) by rw [coefA.eq_2]]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, h.L'F, smul_smul]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', ← pow_succ, shift]
    module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.T_mul_E
statement:
lemma T_mul_E (n : ℕ) :
    K' ^ n * L' * E = (Q * (q⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ n) • (E * (K' ^ n * L'))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := pow_mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul h.K'E n 1
  simp only [pow_one, mul_one] at h1
  rw [mul_assoc, h.L'E, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, h1, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_assoc,
    mul_comm Q]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.shift_mul_T
statement: lemma shift_mul_T (n : ℕ) : shift q Q n * (Q * (q⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := h.q_ne
  have := h.Q_ne
  simp only [shift, ← pow_mul, inv_pow]
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.T_mul_K
statement: lemma T_mul_K (n : ℕ) : K' ^ n * L' * K = K * (K' ^ n * L')
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Commute K' K := h.K'K
  rw [mul_assoc, h.L'K, ← mul_assoc, (hc.pow_left n).eq, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.shape
statement:
theorem shape (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ m, n < m → comm q Q E F x y n m = coefA q Q c n m • (F ^ (m - n) * (K' ^ n * L'))) ∧
      comm q Q E F x y n n = coefB q Q c n • (K ^ n * L - K' ^ n * L')
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      simpa using h.comm_zero_succ' m
    · simpa [coefB] using h.comm_zero_zero
  | succ n ih =>
    have hKX := K_mul_X (q := q) (Q := Q) h.KE h.Kx n
    have hstep := E_comm_F_pow_mul (T := K' ^ n * L') h.EF h.KF h.K'F (h.T_mul_E n)
      (h.shift_mul_T n)
    have hT : K' ^ (n + 1) * L' = K' * (K' ^ n * L') := by rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc]
    have hE (A : k) (d : ℕ) :
        E * (A • (F ^ (d + 1) * (K' ^ n * L'))) -
            shift q Q n • (A • (F ^ (d + 1) * (K' ^ n * L')) * E) =
          A • (F ^ d * (alpha q (d + 1) • (K * (K' ^ n * L')) -
            beta q (d + 1) • (K' * (K' ^ n * L')))) := by
      rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm (shift q Q n) A, ← smul_sub, hstep]
    have hK (A : k) (d : ℕ) : A • (F ^ d * (K' ^ n * L')) * K =
        A • (F ^ d * (K * (K' ^ n * L'))) := by
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, h.T_mul_K]
    refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, m = n + 1 + d := ⟨m - (n + 1), by omega⟩
      have hA := coefA_mul_alpha h.q_ne h.Q_ne h.sub_ne c n m (by omega)
      rw [show m + 1 - n = d + 1 + 1 by omega] at hA
      rw [comm_succ_succ (h.E_mul_Y m) hKX, ih.1 (m + 1) (by omega), ih.1 m (by omega),
        show m + 1 - n = d + 1 + 1 by omega, show m - n = d + 1 by omega,
        show m + 1 - (n + 1) = d + 1 by omega, hE, hK, hT, coefA.eq_3,
        show m + 1 - n = d + 1 + 1 by omega]
      simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, smul_sub, smul_smul]
      match_scalars
      · linear_combination hA
      · ring
    · have hA := coefA_diag h.q_ne h.Q_ne h.sub_ne c n
      have hL : (K ^ n * L) * K = K ^ (n + 1) * L := by
        rw [mul_assoc, h.LK, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
      rw [comm_succ_succ (h.E_mul_Y n) hKX, ih.1 (n + 1) (by omega), ih.2,
        show n + 1 - n = 0 + 1 by omega, hE, smul_mul_assoc, sub_mul, hL, h.T_mul_K, hT]
      simp only [coefB, alpha, beta, pow_zero, one_mul, zero_add, mul_sub, smul_sub,
        smul_smul, mul_smul_comm]
      set A := coefA q Q c n (n + 1)
      set γ := cc q Q (n + 1)
      match_scalars <;> first | ring1 | linear_combination hA | linear_combination -hA

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.Hyp.comm_self
statement:
theorem Hyp.comm_self {c : k} {E F K K' L L' x y : B} {r : ℕ}
    (h : Hyp q (q ^ r) c E F K K' L L' x y) :
    comm q (q ^ r) E F x y r r =
      ((-1) ^ r * q⁻¹ ^ r * qFactorial q r ^ 2 * c) • (K ^ r * L - K' ^ r * L')
proof:
:= by
  rw [(h.shape r).2, coefB_pow h.q_ne h.sub_ne]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.comm_succ_zero
statement:
lemma comm_succ_zero {E F x y : B} {Q' : k} (hEy : E * y = y * E) (n : ℕ) :
    X q Q E x (n + 1) * X q Q' F y 0 - X q Q' F y 0 * X q Q E x (n + 1) =
      E * (X q Q E x n * X q Q' F y 0 - X q Q' F y 0 * X q Q E x n) -
        shift q Q n • ((X q Q E x n * X q Q' F y 0 - X q Q' F y 0 * X q Q E x n) * E)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [X, sub_mul, mul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, smul_sub]
  rw [← mul_assoc y E, ← hEy, mul_assoc]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.X_comm_X_of_commute
statement:
theorem X_comm_X_of_commute (hq : q ≠ 0) {E F K K' x y : B} {Q' : k}
    (hEF : E * F - F * E = (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K - K'))
    (hK'F : K' * F = q ^ 2 • (F * K')) (hKF : K * F = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (F * K))
    (hKE : K * E = q ^ 2 • (E * K)) (hKx : K * x = Q⁻¹ • (x * K))
    (hxF : x * F = F * x) (hEy : E * y = y * E)
    (hK'y : K' * y = Q'⁻¹ • (y * K')) (hKy : K * y = Q' • (y * K)) (hxy : x * y = y * x)
    (n m : ℕ) : X q Q E x n * X q Q' F y m = X q Q' F y m * X q Q E x n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  have hFE : F * E - E * F = (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (K' - K) := by
    rw [← neg_sub, hEF, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]
  have hEY (m : ℕ) := F_mul_X (Q := Q') hq hFE hK'F hKF hEy.symm hK'y hKy m
  have h0 : ∀ m, X q Q E x 0 * X q Q' F y m - X q Q' F y m * X q Q E x 0 = 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simpa [X, sub_eq_zero] using hxy
    | succ m ih =>
      have := comm_zero_succ (q := q) (Q := Q') (E := E) (F := F) (x := x) (y := y) hxF m
      simp only [comm] at this
      rw [show X q Q E x 0 = X q Q' E x 0 from rfl, this,
        ← show X q Q E x 0 = X q Q' E x 0 from rfl, ih]
      simp
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => exact h0 m
  | succ n ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => rw [comm_succ_zero hEy, ih 0]; simp
    | succ m =>
      rw [bracket_succ_succ (hEY m) (K_mul_X hKE hKx n), ih (m + 1), ih m]
      simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux
statement:
lemma X_eq_serreAux (hq : q ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (E x : B) (n : ℕ) :
    X q Q E x n = serreAux q (q ^ n * (q * Q)⁻¹) n E x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [X, serreAux]
  | succ n ih =>
    have e1 : q ^ (n + 1) * (q * Q)⁻¹ * q⁻¹ = q ^ n * (q * Q)⁻¹ := by field_simp; ring
    have e2 : q ^ (n + 1) * (q * Q)⁻¹ * q ^ n = shift q Q n := by
      simp only [shift]; field_simp; ring
    rw [X_succ, ih, serreAux_succ' hq, e1, e2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_pow
statement: lemma K_pow (μ : Y) (n : ℕ) : K R v μ ^ n = K R v (n • μ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, K_add, succ_nsmul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_ktilde_of_ne
statement:
lemma reflY_ktilde_of_ne {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    reflY R i (ktilde R j) = ktilde R j + negA D i j • ktilde R i
proof:
:= by
  have hr : R.root i (ktilde R j) = -((D.d i : ℤ) * negA D i j) := by
    rw [root_ktilde_comm, root_ktilde, cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij]
    ring
  rw [reflY_apply, hr, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, mul_smul]
  simp only [ktilde, natCast_zsmul]
  rw [smul_comm (D.d i) (negA D i j)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne
statement:
lemma zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    v ^ R.root j (ktilde R i) = ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [root_ktilde, cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij, mul_neg, zpow_neg, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast,
    zpow_natCast]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidDiagonal_hyp
statement:
lemma braidDiagonal_hyp (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    BraidDiagonal.Hyp (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹)⁻¹
      (E R v i) (F R v i) (Kt R v i) (K R v (-ktilde R i)) (Kt R v j) (K R v (-ktilde R j))
      (E R v j) (F R v j)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne (R := R) (v := v) hij
  have h2 : v ^ R.root i (ktilde R j) = ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)⁻¹ := by
    rw [root_ktilde_comm, h1]
  exact
    { q_ne := pow_ne_zero _ hv
      Q_ne := pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)
      sub_ne := hq
      EF := by simpa using E_mul_F_sub R v i i
      KE := Kt_mul_E i
      K'E := by rw [K_neg_ktilde_mul_E, inv_pow]
      KF := Kt_mul_F i
      K'F := K_neg_ktilde_mul_F i
      LF := by rw [Kt, K_mul_F, zpow_neg, h2, inv_inv]
      L'E := by rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, zpow_neg, h2, inv_inv]
      L'F := by rw [K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg, h2]
      LK := K_comm R v _ _
      L'K := K_comm R v _ _
      K'K := K_comm R v _ _
      xF := E_mul_F_of_ne hij.symm
      Ey := E_mul_F_of_ne hij
      Kx := by rw [Kt, K_mul_E, h1]
      K'x := by rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, zpow_neg, h1, inv_inv]
      Ky := by rw [Kt, K_mul_F, zpow_neg, h1, inv_inv]
      K'y := by rw [K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg, h1]
      xy := by simpa using E_mul_F_sub R v j j }

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEj_mul_braidFj_sub
statement:
theorem braidEj_mul_braidFj_sub (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hr : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) ≠ 0) :
    braidEj R v i j * braidFj R v i j - braidFj R v i j * braidEj R v i j =
      (v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
        (braidK R v i (.ofAdd (ktilde R j)) - braidK R v i (.ofAdd (-ktilde R j)))
proof:
:= by
  set q := v ^ D.d i with hqdef
  set r := negA D i j with hrdef
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hQ : q ^ r ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hq0
  have hc : q ^ r * (q * q ^ r)⁻¹ = q⁻¹ := by field_simp
  have hC := (braidDiagonal_hyp R v hv hij hq).comm_self
  rw [← hqdef, ← hrdef] at hC
  have hX : braidEj R v i j =
      (qFactorial q r)⁻¹ • BraidDiagonal.X q (q ^ r) (E R v i) (E R v j) r := by
    rw [BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq0 hQ, hc]; rfl
  have hY : braidFj R v i j = ((qFactorial q r)⁻¹ * (-1) ^ r * q ^ r) •
      BraidDiagonal.X q (q ^ r) (F R v i) (F R v j) r := by
    rw [BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq0 hQ, hc]; rfl
  have hK1 : Kt R v i ^ r * Kt R v j = braidK R v i (.ofAdd (ktilde R j)) := by
    rw [braidK_apply, reflY_ktilde_of_ne hij, Kt, K_pow, Kt, K_add, add_comm]
  have hK2 : K R v (-ktilde R i) ^ r * K R v (-ktilde R j) =
      braidK R v i (.ofAdd (-ktilde R j)) := by
    rw [braidK_apply, map_neg, reflY_ktilde_of_ne hij, K_pow, K_add, neg_add, smul_neg,
      add_comm]
  rw [hX, hY, smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm,
    mul_comm ((qFactorial q r)⁻¹ * (-1) ^ r * q ^ r) (qFactorial q r)⁻¹, ← smul_sub]
  change _ • BraidDiagonal.comm q (q ^ r) _ _ _ _ r r = _
  rw [hC, hK1, hK2, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have hs : ((-1 : k) ^ r) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]; simp
  have hqq : q ^ r * q⁻¹ ^ r = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, one_pow]
  have hf : (qFactorial q r)⁻¹ * qFactorial q r = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr
  set c := (v ^ D.d j - (v ^ D.d j)⁻¹)⁻¹
  linear_combination
    (((qFactorial q r)⁻¹ * qFactorial q r + 1) * ((-1) ^ r) ^ 2 * (q ^ r * q⁻¹ ^ r) * c) * hf +
      ((q ^ r * q⁻¹ ^ r) * c) * hs + c * hqq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEj_commute_braidFj
statement:
theorem braidEj_commute_braidFj (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j l : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (hil : i ≠ l)
    (hjl : j ≠ l) : braidEj R v i j * braidFj R v i l = braidFj R v i l * braidEj R v i j
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hc (r : ℕ) : (v ^ D.d i) ^ r * (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ r)⁻¹ = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  have h1 := zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne (R := R) (v := v) hij
  have h2 := zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne (R := R) (v := v) hil
  have H := BraidDiagonal.X_comm_X_of_commute (q := v ^ D.d i) (Q := (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)
    (Q' := (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i l) hq0 (E := E R v i) (F := F R v i) (K := Kt R v i)
    (K' := K R v (-ktilde R i)) (x := E R v j) (y := F R v l)
    (by simpa using E_mul_F_sub R v i i) (K_neg_ktilde_mul_F i) (Kt_mul_F i) (Kt_mul_E i)
    (by rw [Kt, K_mul_E, h1]) (E_mul_F_of_ne hij.symm) (E_mul_F_of_ne hil)
    (by rw [K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg, h2]) (by rw [Kt, K_mul_F, zpow_neg, h2, inv_inv])
    (E_mul_F_of_ne hjl) (negA D i j) (negA D i l)
  rw [BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq0 (pow_ne_zero _ hq0), hc,
    BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq0 (pow_ne_zero _ hq0), hc] at H
  simp only [braidEj, braidFj, smul_mul_smul_comm, H, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.centre_three
statement:
private lemma centre_three (a b c u u' : B) (q t : k) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hca : c * a = a * c - t • (u - u'))
    (hcb : c * b = b * c)
    (hua : u * a = q ^ 2 • (a * u))
    (hub : u * b = q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (b * u))
    (huc : u * c = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (c * u))
    (hu'a : u' * a = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (a * u'))
    (hu'b : u' * b = q ^ 3 • (b * u'))
    (hu'c : u' * c = q ^ 2 • (c * u'))
    (hu'u : u' * u = 1) (huu' : u * u' = 1) :
    qSerre q 4 (-(c * u))
      (a ^ 3 * b - ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹) • (a ^ 2 * b * a) +
        ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a ^ 2) -
        q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (b * a ^ 3)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hca_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hca
  have hcb_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hcb
  have hua_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hua
  have hub_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hub
  have huc_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) huc
  have hu'a_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hu'a
  have hu'b_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hu'b
  have hu'c_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hu'c
  have hu'u_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hu'u
  have huu'_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) huu'
  simp only [mul_assoc, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul] at *
  simp (config := { maxSteps := 1000000 }) only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial,
    Nat.reduceSub, pow_succ, pow_zero,
    mul_one, one_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, one_smul,
    mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_add, add_mul,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_neg, mul_assoc,
    hua, hub, hca_assoc, hcb_assoc, hua_assoc, hub_assoc, huc_assoc, hu'a_assoc,
    hu'b_assoc, hu'c_assoc, hu'u_assoc]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp [hq] <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triple_lowering
statement:
private lemma triple_lowering (a b c u u' : B) (q t : k) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hca : c * a = a * c - t • (u - u')) (hcb : c * b = b * c)
    (hua : u * a = q ^ 2 • (a * u))
    (hub : u * b = q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (b * u))
    (hu'a : u' * a = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (a * u'))
    (hu'b : u' * b = q ^ 3 • (b * u')) (hu'u : u' * u = 1) :
    let X := a ^ 3 * b - ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹) • (a ^ 2 * b * a) +
      ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a ^ 2) -
      q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (b * a ^ 3);
    -(c * u) * X - q ^ 3 • (X * -(c * u)) =
      (t * (1 - q ^ 6)) • (a ^ 2 * b - ((q + q⁻¹) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a) +
        q⁻¹ ^ 4 • (b * a ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hca_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hca
  have hcb_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hcb
  have hua_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hua
  have hub_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hub
  have hu'a_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hu'a
  have hu'b_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * z) hu'b
  simp only [mul_assoc, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc] at *
  simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_add, add_mul, mul_neg, neg_mul,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_neg, mul_assoc,
    hua, hub, hca_assoc, hcb_assoc, hua_assoc, hub_assoc, hu'a_assoc, hu'b_assoc,
    hu'u, mul_one]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp [hq] <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tripleEdge_originalSerre_certificate
statement:
theorem tripleEdge_originalSerre_certificate (a b : B) (q : k) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hs : qSerre q 4 a b = 0) (ht : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 b a = 0) :
    let X := (a ^ 3 * b - ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹) • (a ^ 2 * b * a) +
      ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a ^ 2) -
      q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (b * a ^ 3))
    let Y := (a ^ 2 * b - ((q + q⁻¹) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a) +
      q⁻¹ ^ 4 • (b * a ^ 2))
    (q ^ 7 * (q ^ 4 + 1)) • (Y * X - q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (X * Y)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have he : (q ^ 7 * (q ^ 4 + 1)) • ((a ^ 2 * b - ((q + q⁻¹) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a) +
      q⁻¹ ^ 4 • (b * a ^ 2)) * (a ^ 3 * b - ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹) • (a ^ 2 * b * a) +
      ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a ^ 2) -
      q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (b * a ^ 3)) -
      q⁻¹ ^ 3 • ((a ^ 3 * b - ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹) • (a ^ 2 * b * a) +
      ((q ^ 2 + 1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a ^ 2) -
      q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (b * a ^ 3)) * (a ^ 2 * b - ((q + q⁻¹) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) • (a * b * a) +
      q⁻¹ ^ 4 • (b * a ^ 2)))) =
      (q ^ 5 * (1 + q ^ 2)) • (qSerre q 4 a b * a * b) -
      (q ^ 2 * (1 + q ^ 2 + q ^ 6)) • (qSerre q 4 a b * b * a) +
      q ^ 6 • (a * qSerre q 4 a b * b) +
      q ^ 2 • (b * qSerre q 4 a b * a) -
      (1 + q ^ 4 + q ^ 6) • (a * b * qSerre q 4 a b) +
      (q * (1 + q ^ 2)) • (b * a * qSerre q 4 a b) -
      q ^ 2 • (qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 b a * a ^ 4) +
      ((q ^ 4 + 1) * (1 + q ^ 2)) • (a * qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 b a * a ^ 3) -
      ((q ^ 4 + 1) * (1 + q ^ 2 + q ^ 4)) • (a ^ 2 * qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 b a * a ^ 2) +
      (q ^ 2 * (q ^ 4 + 1) * (1 + q ^ 2)) • (a ^ 3 * qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 b a * a) -
      q ^ 6 • (a ^ 4 * qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 b a) := by
    simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial,
      Nat.reduceSub, pow_succ, pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul, mul_zero, add_zero,
      zero_add, one_smul, mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_add,
      add_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add, smul_sub, mul_assoc]
    match_scalars <;> field_simp [hq] <;> ring
  rw [he, hs, ht]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triple_reverse_serre
statement:
private lemma triple_reverse_serre (X A Y : B) (q t : k) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hAX : A * X - q ^ 3 • (X * A) = t • Y)
    (hYX : Y * X - q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (X * Y) = 0) :
    qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 X A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : qSerre (q ^ 3) 2 X A =
      (A * X - q ^ 3 • (X * A)) * X -
        q⁻¹ ^ 3 • (X * (A * X - q ^ 3 • (X * A))) := by
    simp [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, qBinomial, pow_two, mul_assoc,
      mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul, hq, add_smul]
    module
  rw [he, hAX]
  rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_comm, ← smul_sub, hYX, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three
statement:
theorem braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) :
    braidEj R v i j = (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 3)⁻¹ •
      (E R v i ^ 3 * E R v j -
        (((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 + 1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) •
          (E R v i ^ 2 * E R v j * E R v i) +
        (((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 + 1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) •
          (E R v i * E R v j * E R v i ^ 2) -
        (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 3 • (E R v j * E R v i ^ 3))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [braidEj, negA, h, Int.reduceNeg, neg_neg, Int.reduceToNat]
  congr 1
  simp only [serreAux, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial,
    Nat.reduceSub, pow_succ, pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul, mul_zero, add_zero,
    zero_add, one_smul, mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero (D.d i) hv] <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three
statement:
theorem chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) :
    chevalley R v (braidEj R v i j) = -(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 3 • braidFj R v i j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [braidEj, braidFj, negA, h, Int.reduceNeg, neg_neg, Int.reduceToNat,
    map_smul, serreAux, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, chevalley_E, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  field_simp [pow_ne_zero (D.d i) hv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge
statement:
theorem parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) :
    v ^ D.d j = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hd : D.d j = D.d i * 3 := by
    have hs := D.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm i j
    rw [h, h'] at hs
    omega
  rw [hd, pow_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three
statement:
lemma reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) :
    reflY R i (ktilde R j) = ktilde R j + 3 • ktilde R i
proof:
:= by
  have hr : R.root i (ktilde R j) = -((D.d i : ℤ) * 3) := by
    rw [root_ktilde, ← D.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm i j, h]
    ring
  rw [reflY_apply, hr, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, mul_smul, natCast_zsmul]
  simp only [ktilde, ← natCast_zsmul, smul_smul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  rw [mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidEi_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidEi_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat
      (braidEi R i) (braidEj R v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h
    norm_num at h
  have hca : F R v i * E R v i = E R v i * F R v i -
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    have hc := E_mul_F_sub R v i i
    simp only [ite_true] at hc
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hc
  have hub : Kt R v i * E R v j =
      (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 3 • (E R v j * Kt R v i) := by
    rw [Kt, K_mul_E, root_ktilde, h, mul_neg, zpow_neg, zpow_mul,
      zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat, inv_pow]
  have hu'b : K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v j =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ 3 • (E R v j * K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, root_ktilde, h, mul_neg, neg_neg, zpow_mul,
      zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat]
  have hs := centre_three (E R v i) (E R v j) (F R v i)
    (Kt R v i) (K R v (-ktilde R i)) (v ^ D.d i)
    (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hca
    (E_mul_F_of_ne hij.symm).symm (Kt_mul_E i) hub (Kt_mul_F i)
    (by simpa only [inv_pow] using K_neg_ktilde_mul_E (R := R) (v := v) i)
    hu'b (K_neg_ktilde_mul_F i) (K_neg_mul_Kt i) (Kt_mul_K_neg i)
  rw [h, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three hv h]
  change qSerre (v ^ D.d i) 4 (braidEi R i) (_ • _) = 0
  have he := qSerre_smul_smul (v := v ^ D.d i) 4
    (braidEi (v := v) R i)
    (E R v i ^ 3 * E R v j -
      (((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 + 1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) •
        (E R v i ^ 2 * E R v j * E R v i) +
      (((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 + 1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) •
        (E R v i * E R v j * E R v i ^ 2) -
      (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 3 • (E R v j * E R v i ^ 3))
    1 (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 3)⁻¹
  rw [one_smul, one_pow, one_mul, hs, smul_zero] at he
  exact he

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidFi_braidFj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidFi_braidFj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat
      (braidFi R i) (braidFj R v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs := congrArg (chevalley R v)
    (qSerre_braidEi_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three (R := R) hv h)
  rw [map_qSerre, map_zero, chevalley_braidEi hv,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three hv h, qSerre_smul_smul] at hs
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_left
    (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)))
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv)))))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tripleEdge_braidEi_braidEj_qcomm
statement:
theorem tripleEdge_braidEi_braidEj_qcomm (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) :
    braidEi R i * braidEj R v i j -
        (v ^ D.d i) ^ 3 • (braidEj R v i j * braidEi R i) =
      ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 3)⁻¹ *
        ((v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (1 - (v ^ D.d i) ^ 6))) •
      (E R v i ^ 2 * E R v j -
        ((v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) •
          (E R v i * E R v j * E R v i) +
        (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 4 • (E R v j * E R v i ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h
    norm_num at h
  have hca : F R v i * E R v i = E R v i * F R v i -
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    have hc := E_mul_F_sub R v i i
    simp only [ite_true] at hc
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hc
  have hub : Kt R v i * E R v j =
      (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 3 • (E R v j * Kt R v i) := by
    rw [Kt, K_mul_E, root_ktilde, h, mul_neg, zpow_neg, zpow_mul,
      zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat, inv_pow]
  have hu'b : K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v j =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ 3 • (E R v j * K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, root_ktilde, h, mul_neg, neg_neg, zpow_mul,
      zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat]
  have hAX := triple_lowering (E R v i) (E R v j) (F R v i)
    (Kt R v i) (K R v (-ktilde R i)) (v ^ D.d i)
    (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hca
    (E_mul_F_of_ne hij.symm).symm (Kt_mul_E i) hub
    (by simpa only [inv_pow] using K_neg_ktilde_mul_E (R := R) (v := v) i)
    hu'b (K_neg_mul_Kt i)
  rw [braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three hv h]
  simpa only [braidEi, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    smul_add, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_add, add_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
    congrArg (fun z : QuantumGroup R v ↦ (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) 3)⁻¹ • z) hAX

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidEj_braidEi_of_triple_edge
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidEj_braidEi_of_triple_edge (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (h4 : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 4 + 1 ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j i).toNat
      (braidEj R v i j) (braidEi R i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h
    norm_num at h
  have hp := parameter_eq_cube_of_triple_edge (v := v) h h'
  have hca : F R v i * E R v i = E R v i * F R v i -
      (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R v i - K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    have hc := E_mul_F_sub R v i i
    simp only [ite_true] at hc
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hc
  have hub : Kt R v i * E R v j =
      (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 3 • (E R v j * Kt R v i) := by
    rw [Kt, K_mul_E, root_ktilde, h, mul_neg, zpow_neg, zpow_mul,
      zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat, inv_pow]
  have hu'b : K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v j =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ 3 • (E R v j * K R v (-ktilde R i)) := by
    rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, root_ktilde, h, mul_neg, neg_neg, zpow_mul,
      zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat]
  have hAX := triple_lowering (E R v i) (E R v j) (F R v i)
    (Kt R v i) (K R v (-ktilde R i)) (v ^ D.d i)
    (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hca
    (E_mul_F_of_ne hij.symm).symm (Kt_mul_E i) hub
    (by simpa only [inv_pow] using K_neg_ktilde_mul_E (R := R) (v := v) i)
    hu'b (K_neg_mul_Kt i)
  have hs : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) 4 (E R v i) (E R v j) = 0 := by
    simpa only [h, Int.reduceSub, Int.reduceToNat] using serre_E R v hij
  have ht : qSerre ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 3) 2 (E R v j) (E R v i) = 0 := by
    simpa only [h', hp, Int.reduceSub, Int.reduceToNat] using serre_E R v hij.symm
  have hYX := tripleEdge_originalSerre_certificate (E R v i) (E R v j) (v ^ D.d i)
    (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hs ht
  have hYX0 := (smul_eq_zero.mp hYX).resolve_left
    (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)) h4)
  have H := triple_reverse_serre _ _ _ (v ^ D.d i) _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hAX hYX0
  rw [h', hp, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three hv h]
  change qSerre ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 3) 2 (_ • _) (braidEi R i) = 0
  rw [← one_smul k (braidEi (v := v) R i), qSerre_smul_smul]
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr H))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidFj_braidFi_of_triple_edge
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidFj_braidFi_of_triple_edge (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -3) (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (h4 : (v ^ D.d i) ^ 4 + 1 ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j i).toNat
      (braidFj R v i j) (braidFi R i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs := congrArg (chevalley R v)
    (qSerre_braidEj_braidEi_of_triple_edge (R := R) hv h h' h4)
  rw [map_qSerre, map_zero, chevalley_braidEi hv,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_three hv h, qSerre_smul_smul] at hs
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_left
    (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv)))))
      (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_transformedSerre
statement:
theorem twoNode_transformedSerre (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hN : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) ((negA D j i + 1) * negA D i j - 2) ≠ 0) :
    TransformedSerre R v i where
  serre_E l m hlm hl
proof:
:= by
    rcases hall l with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hall m with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hlm rfl).elim
    · exact (hl rfl).elim
    · simpa [braidImageE, hij.symm] using twoNode_qSerre_braidEj_braidEi (R := R) hij hq hN
    · exact (hlm rfl).elim
  serre_F l m hlm hl := by
    rcases hall l with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hall m with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hlm rfl).elim
    · exact (hl rfl).elim
    · simpa [braidImageF, hij.symm] using twoNode_qSerre_braidFj_braidFi (R := R) hij hq hN
    · exact (hlm rfl).elim

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_braidGeneric
statement:
theorem twoNode_braidGeneric (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hN : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) ((negA D j i + 1) * negA D i j - 2) ≠ 0) :
    BraidGeneric D v i where
  sub_ne
proof:
:= hq
  qFactorial_ne l hl := by
    rcases hall l with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hl rfl).elim
    · rcases le_or_gt (negA D i l) 1 with h | h
      · obtain h0 | h0 : negA D i l = 0 ∨ negA D i l = 1 := by omega
        · simp [h0]
        · simp [h0, qFactorial, qInt]
      · have hs := (twoNode_negA_pos (D := D) hij
          (by rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij]; omega)).2
        refine TwoNode.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_le (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le ?_) hN
        nlinarith

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root
statement:
theorem twoNode_qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i j : I) :
    qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) ((negA D j i + 1) * negA D i j - 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv' i _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shortNode_qFactorial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem shortNode_qFactorial_ne_zero (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (hr : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j) ≠ 0)
    (hb : qBinomial (v ^ D.d i) (2 * negA D i j - 2) (negA D i j - 1) ≠ 0) :
    qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) ((negA D j i + 1) * negA D i j - 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hji : negA D j i = 1 := by simp [negA, h']
  have hr' : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j - 1) ≠ 0 :=
    TwoNode.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_le (by omega) hr
  have hm := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := v ^ D.d i)
    (show negA D i j - 1 ≤ 2 * negA D i j - 2 by omega)
  rw [show 2 * negA D i j - 2 - (negA D i j - 1) = negA D i j - 1 by omega] at hm
  rw [hji, show (1 + 1) * negA D i j - 2 = 2 * negA D i j - 2 by ring_nf, ← hm]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hb hr') hr'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.degreeOne_serreAux_braidEj_eq_zero
statement:
theorem degreeOne_serreAux_braidEj_eq_zero (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hN : qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D j i - 1) ≠ 0) :
    serreAux (v ^ D.d j) (v ^ D.d j) (negA D j i) (braidEj R v i j) (E R v j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h
    norm_num at h
  have hn : negA D i j = 0 + 1 := by simp [negA, h]
  have h1 := twoNode_serreAux_top (R := R) hij hq hn
    (by rwa [hn, zero_add, mul_one, show negA D j i + 1 - 2 = negA D j i - 1 by omega])
  rw [twoNode_braidEj_eq_X R v (NeZero.ne v) hn]
  simpa [qFactorial, qInt, BraidDiagonal.X] using h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shortNodeBraidEquiv_eq_twoNodeBraidEquiv
statement:
theorem shortNodeBraidEquiv_eq_twoNodeBraidEquiv (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)

    (hb : qBinomial (v ^ D.d i) (2 * negA D i j - 2) (negA D i j - 1) ≠ 0) :
    shortNodeBraidEquiv (R := R) hij hall h' hg hb =
      twoNodeBraidEquiv hij hall hg.sub_ne
        (shortNode_qFactorial_ne_zero h' (hg.qFactorial_ne j hij.symm) hb)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.degreeOneBraidEquiv_eq_twoNodeBraidEquiv
statement:

    degreeOneBraidEquiv (R := R) hij hall h hq (degreeOne_serreAux_braidEj_eq_zero h hq hN) =
      twoNodeBraidEquiv hij hall hq
        (by rwa [show negA D i j = 1 by simp [negA, h], mul_one,

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tripleEdgeOtherBraidEquiv_eq_twoNodeBraidEquiv
statement:
theorem tripleEdgeOtherBraidEquiv_eq_twoNodeBraidEquiv (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.neighbours_qSerre_two
statement:
private lemma neighbours_qSerre_two {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B]
    (q : k) (a b : B) :
    qSerre q 2 a b = a * (a * b) - (q + q⁻¹) • (a * (b * a)) + b * (a * a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, qBinomial, pow_two, mul_assoc]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.commute_quantumCommutators_of_serre_two
statement:
theorem commute_quantumCommutators_of_serre_two
    {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {q : k} {a b c : B}
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hs : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hab : qSerre q 2 a b = 0) (hac : qSerre q 2 a c = 0)
    (hbc : Commute b c) :
    Commute (a * b - q⁻¹ • (b * a)) (a * c - q⁻¹ • (c * a))
proof:
:= by
  have hb := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * c) hab
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * b) hac
  have hb' := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ c * x) hab
  have hc' := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ b * x) hac
  simp only [neighbours_qSerre_two, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_assoc] at hb hc hb' hc'
  have hmid : a * (b * (c * a)) = a * (c * (b * a)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc b c a, hbc.eq, mul_assoc]
  have hlast : b * (c * (a * a)) = c * (b * (a * a)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc b c (a * a), hbc.eq, mul_assoc]
  have hfirst : a * (a * (b * c)) = a * (a * (c * b)) := by rw [hbc.eq]
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (smul_eq_zero.mp (show (q + q⁻¹) •
    ((a * b - q⁻¹ • (b * a)) * (a * c - q⁻¹ • (c * a)) -
      (a * c - q⁻¹ • (c * a)) * (a * b - q⁻¹ • (b * a))) = 0 from ?_)).resolve_left hs
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub,
    smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  rw [hmid]
  rw [hfirst] at hb
  rw [hlast] at hc'
  linear_combination (norm := (match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring))
    -hb + hc + q⁻¹ ^ 2 • hb' - q⁻¹ ^ 2 • hc'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidEj_commute_braidEj_of_orthogonal_neighbours
statement:
theorem braidEj_commute_braidEj_of_orthogonal_neighbours
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = -1) (hjl : j ≠ l)
    (hzero : D.cartanMatrix j l = 0)
    (hs : v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    Commute (braidEj R v i j) (braidEj R v i l)
proof:
:= by
  have hij' : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hij
    norm_num at hij
  have hil' : i ≠ l := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hil
    norm_num at hil
  have hab : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) 2 (E R v i) (E R v j) = 0 := by
    simpa [hij] using serre_E R v hij'
  have hac : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) 2 (E R v i) (E R v l) = 0 := by
    simpa [hil] using serre_E R v hil'
  have hbc : Commute (E R v j) (E R v l) := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa [hzero, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, sub_eq_add_neg] using serre_E R v hjl
  rw [braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hil]
  exact commute_quantumCommutators_of_serre_two (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hs hab hac hbc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.braidFj_commute_braidFj_of_orthogonal_neighbours
statement:
theorem braidFj_commute_braidFj_of_orthogonal_neighbours
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = -1) (hjl : j ≠ l)
    (hzero : D.cartanMatrix j l = 0)
    (hs : v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    Commute (braidFj R v i j) (braidFj R v i l)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := braidEj_commute_braidEj_of_orthogonal_neighbours
    (R := R) hv hij hil hjl hzero hs
  have hc := congrArg (chevalley R v) hp.eq
  rw [map_mul, map_mul,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hv hij,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hv hil] at hc
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul] at hc
  have hq : -(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv))
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (smul_eq_zero.mp (show (-(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * -(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) •
    (braidFj R v i j * braidFj R v i l - braidFj R v i l * braidFj R v i j) = 0
    from ?_)).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hq hq)
  simpa only [smul_sub] using sub_eq_zero.mpr hc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starBraid_relations
statement:
theorem starBraid_relations :
    Relations R v (fun l ↦ if l = i then braidEi R i else braidEj R v i l)
      (fun l ↦ if l = i then braidFi R i else braidFj R v i l) (braidK R v i) where
  K_mul_E μ l
proof:
:= by
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst l
      simpa only [↓reduceIte] using braidK_mul_braidEi (R := R) (v := v) _ μ
    · simpa only [hl, ↓reduceIte] using
        braidK_mul_braidEj (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) (Ne.symm hl) μ
  K_mul_F μ l := by
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst l
      simpa only [↓reduceIte] using braidK_mul_braidFi (R := R) (v := v) _ μ
    · simpa only [hl, ↓reduceIte] using
        braidK_mul_braidFj (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) (Ne.symm hl) μ
  E_mul_F l m := by
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst l
      by_cases hm : m = i
      · subst m
        simpa only [↓reduceIte] using braidEi_mul_braidFi_sub (R := R) (v := v) i
      · simpa only [hm, (Ne.symm hm), ↓reduceIte] using
          braidEi_mul_braidFj_sub (R := R) (v := v) (Ne.symm hm)
    · by_cases hm : m = i
      · subst m
        simpa only [hl, ↓reduceIte] using
          braidEj_mul_braidFi_sub (R := R) (v := v) (Ne.symm hl)
      · by_cases hlm : l = m
        · subst m
          simpa only [hl, ↓reduceIte] using
            braidEj_mul_braidFj_sub_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one
              (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) (hedge l hl).1 hq
        · simpa only [hl, hm, hlm, ↓reduceIte] using
            braidEj_mul_braidFj_sub_of_two_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one
              (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) (hedge l hl).1 (hedge m hm).1 hlm hq
  serre_E l m hlm := by
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst l
      simpa only [hlm.symm, ↓reduceIte] using
        qSerre_braidEi_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one
          (R := R) (hedge m hlm.symm).1 hq
    · by_cases hm : m = i
      · subst m
        simpa only [hl, ↓reduceIte] using
          qSerre_braidEj_braidEi_of_simply_laced_edge
            (R := R) (hedge l hl).1 (hedge l hl).2 hq
      · have hc := braidEj_commute_braidEj_of_orthogonal_neighbours
          (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) (hedge l hl).1 (hedge m hm).1
          hlm (hleaf l m hl hm hlm) hs
        simp [hl, hm, hleaf l m hl hm hlm, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, hc.eq]
  serre_F l m hlm := by
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · subst l
      simpa only [hlm.symm, ↓reduceIte] using
        qSerre_braidFi_braidFj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one
          (R := R) (hedge m hlm.symm).1 hq
    · by_cases hm : m = i
      · subst m
        simpa only [hl, ↓reduceIte] using
          qSerre_braidFj_braidFi_of_simply_laced_edge
            (R := R) (hedge l hl).1 (hedge l hl).2 hq
      · have hc := braidFj_commute_braidFj_of_orthogonal_neighbours
          (R := R) (NeZero.ne v) (hedge l hl).1 (hedge m hm).1
          hlm (hleaf l m hl hm hlm) hs
        simp [hl, hm, hleaf l m hl hm hlm, qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, hc.eq]
