name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.coef_top
proof:
:= by
  have m3 : q ^ ((m + 1) * (m + 1)) * shift q (q ^ (m + 2)) 1 ^ (m + 1) = q ^ (m + 1) := by
    rw [shift_eq_zpow hq, pow_mul_zpow_pow hq, ← zpow_natCast]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have m4 : q ^ ((m + 2) * m) * shift q (q ^ (m + 2)) 0 ^ m = 1 := by
    rw [shift_eq_zpow hq, pow_mul_zpow_pow hq, ← zpow_zero q]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  simp only [gauss, coeff]
  rw [show 2 * (m + 1) - (m + 1) = m + 1 by omega, show 2 * (m + 1) - (m + 2) = m by omega,
    show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 from rfl]
  linear_combination qBinomial q (2 * (m + 1)) (m + 1) * m3 -
    q ^ (m + 2) * qBinomial q (2 * (m + 1)) (m + 2) * m4

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.coef_next
statement:
lemma coef_next (hq : q ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    gauss q (2 * (m + 1)) m * shift q (q ^ (m + 2)) 1 ^ (2 * (m + 1) - m) -
        q ^ (m + 2) * (gauss q (2 * (m + 1)) (m + 1) *
          shift q (q ^ (m + 2)) 0 ^ (2 * (m + 1) - (m + 1))) =
      -q ^ (m + 2) * coeff q (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have m1 : q ^ (m * (m + 2)) * shift q (q ^ (m + 2)) 1 ^ (m + 2) = 1 := by
    rw [shift_eq_zpow hq, pow_mul_zpow_pow hq, ← zpow_zero q]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have m2 : q ^ (m + 2) * (q ^ ((m + 1) * (m + 1)) * shift q (q ^ (m + 2)) 0 ^ (m + 1)) = q := by
    rw [shift_eq_zpow hq, pow_mul_zpow_pow hq, ← zpow_natCast q (m + 2), ← zpow_add₀ hq]
    convert zpow_one q using 2
    push_cast
    ring
  have hs : qBinomial q (2 * (m + 1)) m = qBinomial q (2 * (m + 1)) (m + 2) := by
    have := qBinomial_symm q (show m + 2 ≤ 2 * (m + 1) by omega)
    rwa [show 2 * (m + 1) - (m + 2) = m by omega] at this
  have h1 := qBinomial_mul_sub q (2 * (m + 1)) (m + 1)
  rw [show 2 * (m + 1) - (m + 1) = m + 1 by omega, show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 from rfl] at h1
  have e0 : q ^ (m + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
  have e0' : q ^ (m + 2) * q⁻¹ ^ (m + 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
  set b0 := qBinomial q (2 * (m + 1)) (m + 1)
  set b1 := qBinomial q (2 * (m + 1)) (m + 2)
  have h1' : (q ^ (2 * m + 3) - q) * b0 = (q ^ (2 * m + 4) - 1) * b1 := by
    linear_combination q ^ (m + 2) * h1 + q * b0 * e0 - b1 * e0'
  simp only [gauss, coeff]
  rw [show 2 * (m + 1) - m = m + 2 by omega, show 2 * (m + 1) - (m + 1) = m + 1 by omega,
    show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 from rfl, hs]
  linear_combination b1 * m1 - b0 * m2 + h1'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.leibniz
statement:
lemma leibniz (e x : B) (a b : ℕ) :
    e * (X q Q e x a * X q Q e x b) -
        (shift q Q 0 * shift q Q (a + b)) • (X q Q e x a * X q Q e x b * e) =
      X q Q e x (a + 1) * X q Q e x b + shift q Q a • (X q Q e x a * X q Q e x (b + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_succ, X_succ, ← shift_mul_shift]
  simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.e_mul_lvl
statement:
lemma e_mul_lvl (e x : B) (N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → k) (hc : c (N + 1) = 0) :
    e * lvl q Q e x N c - (shift q Q 0 * shift q Q N) • (lvl q Q e x N c * e) =
      lvl q Q e x (N + 1) (step q Q c)
proof:
:= by
  set g : ℕ → B := fun a ↦ (shift q Q a * c a) • (X q Q e x a * X q Q e x (N + 1 - a)) with hg
  have hL : e * lvl q Q e x N c - (shift q Q 0 * shift q Q N) • (lvl q Q e x N c * e) =
      ∑ a ∈ range (N + 1), c a • (X q Q e x (a + 1) * X q Q e x (N - a)) +
        ∑ a ∈ range (N + 1), g a := by
    rw [lvl, mul_sum, sum_mul, smul_sum, ← sum_sub_distrib, ← sum_add_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun a ha ↦ ?_
    have ha := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ha)
    have hl := leibniz (q := q) (Q := Q) e x a (N - a)
    rw [show a + (N - a) = N by omega, show N - a + 1 = N + 1 - a by omega] at hl
    rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm (shift q Q 0 * shift q Q N), ← smul_sub, hl, hg]
    simp only [smul_add, smul_smul]
    rw [mul_comm (c a)]
  have hR : lvl q Q e x (N + 1) (step q Q c) =
      ∑ a ∈ range (N + 1), c a • (X q Q e x (a + 1) * X q Q e x (N - a)) +
        ∑ a ∈ range (N + 1 + 1), g a := by
    rw [lvl, sum_range_succ', sum_range_succ' g, ← add_assoc, ← sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    · refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
      simp only [step, hg, add_smul, Nat.add_sub_add_right]
  rw [hL, hR, sum_range_succ g (N + 1)]
  simp [hg, hc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.dIter_sub_smul
statement:
lemma dIter_sub_smul (e : B) (N m : ℕ) (z w : B) (t : k) :
    dIter q Q e N m (z - t • w) = dIter q Q e N m z - t • dIter q Q e N m w
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [dIter, ih, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub]
    module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.dIter_zero_right
statement: lemma dIter_zero_right (e : B) (N m : ℕ) : dIter q Q e N m 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => simp [dIter, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.dIter_lvl
statement:
lemma dIter_lvl (e x : B) (c : ℕ → k) (hc : ∀ m, coef q Q c m (m + 2) = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    dIter q Q e 1 m (lvl q Q e x 1 c) = lvl q Q e x (m + 1) (coef q Q c m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [dIter, ih, Nat.add_comm 1 m, e_mul_lvl e x (m + 1) _ (hc m)]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.lvl_one_delta_one
statement: lemma lvl_one_delta_one (e x : B) : lvl q Q e x 1 (delta 1) = X q Q e x 1 * x
proof:
:= by
  simp [lvl, delta, X]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.lvl_one_delta_zero
statement: lemma lvl_one_delta_zero (e x : B) : lvl q Q e x 1 (delta 0) = x * X q Q e x 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [lvl, delta, X]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.coef_delta_support
statement:
lemma coef_delta_support (hq : q ≠ 0) {a₀ : ℕ} (h : a₀ ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    coef q Q (delta a₀) m (m + 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, h1⟩ := coef_delta (Q := Q) hq a₀ m
  rw [show m + 2 = a₀ + (m + 2 - a₀) by omega, h1, gauss_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega), zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.X_add_eq_zero
statement: lemma X_add_eq_zero (e x : B) {n : ℕ} (h : X q Q e x n = 0) (t : ℕ) : X q Q e x (n + t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ t ih => rw [← add_assoc, X_succ, ih]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.lvl_eq_of_vanish
statement:
lemma lvl_eq_of_vanish (e x : B) (n : ℕ) (hX : ∀ t, X q Q e x (n + 2 + t) = 0) (c : ℕ → k) :
    lvl q Q e x (2 * n + 1) c = c n • (X q Q e x n * X q Q e x (n + 1)) +
      c (n + 1) • (X q Q e x (n + 1) * X q Q e x n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lvl, sum_eq_add_of_mem n (n + 1) (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega) (by omega)]
  · rw [show 2 * n + 1 - n = n + 1 by omega, show 2 * n + 1 - (n + 1) = n by omega]
  · intro a ha hne
    have ha := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 ha)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne.1 with h | h
    · rw [show 2 * n + 1 - a = n + 2 + (n - 1 - a) by omega, hX, mul_zero, smul_zero]
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, a = n + 2 + t := ⟨a - (n + 2), by omega⟩
      rw [hX, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.X_succ_mul_X
statement:
theorem X_succ_mul_X {e x : B} (hq : q ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hS : X q (q ^ (n + 1)) e x (n + 2) = 0)
    (hT : X q (q ^ (n + 1)) e x 1 * x = q ^ (n + 1) • (x * X q (q ^ (n + 1)) e x 1))
    (hα : coeff q n ≠ 0) :
    X q (q ^ (n + 1)) e x (n + 1) * X q (q ^ (n + 1)) e x n =
      q ^ (n + 1) • (X q (q ^ (n + 1)) e x n * X q (q ^ (n + 1)) e x (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simpa [X] using hT
  | succ m =>
    set Q := q ^ (m + 1 + 1) with hQ
    have hX := X_add_eq_zero e x hS
    have hΦ : X q Q e x 1 * x - Q • (x * X q Q e x 1) = 0 := sub_eq_zero.2 hT
    have hD := congrArg (dIter q Q e 1 (2 * (m + 1))) hΦ
    rw [dIter_sub_smul, dIter_zero_right, ← lvl_one_delta_one, ← lvl_one_delta_zero,
      dIter_lvl e x _ (coef_delta_support hq le_rfl), dIter_lvl e x _ (coef_delta_support hq
        zero_le_one), lvl_eq_of_vanish e x _ hX, lvl_eq_of_vanish e x _ hX] at hD
    obtain ⟨-, c1⟩ := coef_delta (Q := Q) hq 1 (2 * (m + 1))
    obtain ⟨-, c0⟩ := coef_delta (Q := Q) hq 0 (2 * (m + 1))
    have e1 := c1 (m + 1)
    have e2 := c1 m
    have e3 := c0 (m + 2)
    have e4 := c0 (m + 1)
    rw [show 1 + (m + 1) = m + 1 + 1 by ring] at e1
    rw [show 1 + m = m + 1 by ring] at e2
    rw [zero_add] at e3 e4
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4] at hD
    have hA := coef_top hq m
    have hB := coef_next hq m
    rw [show q ^ (m + 2) = Q from rfl] at hA hB
    set A := coeff q (m + 1)
    have key : A • (X q Q e x (m + 1 + 1) * X q Q e x (m + 1) -
        Q • (X q Q e x (m + 1) * X q Q e x (m + 1 + 1))) = 0 := by
      rw [← hD]
      linear_combination (norm := module)
        -hA • (X q Q e x (m + 1 + 1) * X q Q e x (m + 1)) -
          hB • (X q Q e x (m + 1) * X q Q e x (m + 1 + 1))
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 ((smul_eq_zero.1 key).resolve_left hα)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.X_one_mul_sub
statement:
lemma X_one_mul_sub (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (e x : B) :
    X q Q e x 1 * x - Q • (x * X q Q e x 1) = qSerre Q 2 x e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qSerre, sum_range_succ, sum_range_zero, X, shift, qBinomial_one_right,
    qBinomial_self, qBinomial_zero_right, qInt]
  simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    pow_zero, pow_one, pow_two, one_mul, mul_one, zero_add, Nat.reduceSub, Nat.sub_self]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.serreAux_inv
statement:
lemma serreAux_inv (v c : k) (m : ℕ) (a b : B) :
    serreAux v⁻¹ c m a b = serreAux v c m a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [serreAux, qBinomial_inv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.serreAux_deg_one
statement: lemma serreAux_deg_one (v c : k) (a b : B) : serreAux v c 1 a b = a * b - c • (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [serreAux, sum_range_succ, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.qSerre_succ_eq
statement:
lemma qSerre_succ_eq {p : k} (hp : p ≠ 0) (s : ℕ) (a b : B) :
    qSerre p (s + 1) a b = serreAux p p s a (a * b - p⁻¹ ^ s • (b * a))
proof:
:=
  qSerre_succ_eq_serreAux_of_mul_sub_inv_pow_smul hp s rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ShortNode.qSerre_X_eq
statement:
theorem qSerre_X_eq {c : k} {E F K K' L L' x y : B} {n : ℕ}
    (h : Hyp q (q ^ (n + 1)) c E F K K' L L' x y) (hK'K : K' * K = 1)
    {p : k} (hp : p ≠ 0) {s : ℕ} (hps : p ^ s = q ^ (n + 1)) :
    qSerre p (s + 1) (X q (q ^ (n + 1)) E x (n + 1)) (-(F * K)) =
      cc q (q ^ (n + 1)) (n + 1) •
        serreAux p p s (X q (q ^ (n + 1)) E x (n + 1)) (X q (q ^ (n + 1)) E x n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qSerre_succ_eq hp, ← serreAux_smul_right]
  congr 1
  have hQ : q ^ (n + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ h.q_ne
  have hst := h.stepE hK'K n
  have hsh : shift q (q ^ (n + 1)) (n + 1) = q ^ (n + 1) := by
    simp only [shift]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hsh] at hst
  rw [inv_pow, hps]
  set Z := X q (q ^ (n + 1)) E x (n + 1)
  have e : Z * -(F * K) - (q ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ • (-(F * K) * Z) =
      (-(q ^ (n + 1))⁻¹) • (-(F * K) * Z - q ^ (n + 1) • (Z * -(F * K))) := by
    rw [smul_sub, smul_smul, neg_mul (q ^ (n + 1))⁻¹, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ]
    module
  rw [e, hst, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_param_pow
statement:
lemma twoNode_param_pow {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (v ^ D.d j) ^ negA D j i = (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j
proof:
:= by
  have hs := D.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm i j
  rw [cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij, cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij.symm] at hs
  have h : D.d j * negA D j i = D.d i * negA D i j := by
    have h' : ((D.d j * negA D j i : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((D.d i * negA D i j : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast h'
  rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_braidEj_eq_X
statement:
lemma twoNode_braidEj_eq_X (hv : v ≠ 0) {i j : I} {n : ℕ} (hn : negA D i j = n + 1) :
    braidEj R v i j = (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1))⁻¹ •
      BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hc : (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1) * (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  rw [BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq0 (pow_ne_zero _ hq0), hc, braidEj, hn]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_qSerre_braidEj_braidEi_eq
statement:
theorem twoNode_qSerre_braidEj_braidEi_eq [NeZero v] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : negA D i j = n + 1) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j i).toNat (braidEj R v i j) (braidEi R i) =
      ((qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1))⁻¹ ^ (negA D j i + 1) *
          BraidDiagonal.cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (n + 1)) •
        serreAux (v ^ D.d j) (v ^ D.d j) (negA D j i)
          (BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) (n + 1))
          (BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) n)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have hH := braidDiagonal_hyp R v hv hij hq
  rw [hn] at hH
  have hps : (v ^ D.d j) ^ negA D j i = (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [twoNode_param_pow hij, hn]
  have h1 := qSerre_smul_smul (v := v ^ D.d j) (negA D j i + 1)
    (BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) (n + 1))
    (braidEi R i) (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1))⁻¹ 1
  rw [one_smul, mul_one] at h1
  rw [one_sub_cartanMatrix_toNat hij.symm, twoNode_braidEj_eq_X R v hv hn, h1,
    ShortNode.qSerre_X_eq hH (K_neg_mul_Kt i) (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hps, smul_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_exists_negA_eq_succ
statement:
lemma twoNode_exists_negA_eq_succ {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) : ∃ n, negA D i j = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs := D.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm i j
  rw [h', cartanMatrix_eq_neg_negA hij] at hs
  have := D.d_pos j
  refine ⟨negA D i j - 1, ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (negA D i j) with h0 | h0
  · rw [h0] at hs
    simp at hs
    omega
  · omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shortNode_X_succ_mul_X
statement:
theorem shortNode_X_succ_mul_X [NeZero v] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) {n : ℕ} (hn : negA D i j = n + 1)
    (hα : ShortNode.coeff (v ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0) :
    BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) (n + 1) *
        BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) n =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1) •
        (BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) n *
          BraidDiagonal.X (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1)) (E R v i) (E R v j) (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hQ : (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hq0
  refine ShortNode.X_succ_mul_X hq0 ?_ ?_ hα
  · have hc : (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 2) * (v ^ D.d i * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ = 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [BraidDiagonal.X_eq_serreAux hq0 hQ, hc, serreAux_one]
    have hs := serre_E R v hij
    rwa [one_sub_cartanMatrix_toNat hij, hn] at hs
  · have hs := serre_E R v hij.symm
    have hji : negA D j i = 1 := by simp [negA, h']
    have hp := twoNode_param_pow (D := D) (v := v) hij
    rw [hji, pow_one, hn] at hp
    rw [h', hp, show (1 - (-1 : ℤ)).toNat = 2 by norm_num] at hs
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ShortNode.X_one_mul_sub hQ, hs]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shortNode_qSerre_braidEj_braidEi
statement:
theorem shortNode_qSerre_braidEj_braidEi [NeZero v] {i j : I} (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hb : qBinomial (v ^ D.d i) (2 * negA D i j - 2) (negA D i j - 1) ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j i).toNat (braidEj R v i j) (braidEi R i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h'
    norm_num at h'
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := twoNode_exists_negA_eq_succ hij h'
  rw [hn, show 2 * (n + 1) - 2 = 2 * n by omega, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hb
  have hji : negA D j i = 1 := by simp [negA, h']
  have hp := twoNode_param_pow (D := D) (v := v) hij
  rw [hji, pow_one, hn] at hp
  have hX := shortNode_X_succ_mul_X (R := R) hij h' hn
    (ShortNode.coeff_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hq hb)
  rw [twoNode_qSerre_braidEj_braidEi_eq hij hq hn, hji, ShortNode.serreAux_deg_one, hp, hX,
    sub_self, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_chevalley_braidEj
statement:
theorem twoNode_chevalley_braidEj (hv : v ≠ 0) (i j : I) :
    chevalley R v (braidEj R v i j) =
      ((-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j) • braidFj R v i j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [braidEj, braidFj, map_smul, map_serreAux, chevalley_E, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have e1 : ((-1 : k) ^ negA D i j) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  have e2 : (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hv), one_pow]
  set f := (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹
  linear_combination (-f * ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j)) * e1 - f * e2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twoNode_qSerre_braidFj_braidFi_of_braidEj
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have hs := congrArg (chevalley R v) hE
  rw [map_qSerre, map_zero, chevalley_braidEi hv, twoNode_chevalley_braidEj hv,
    qSerre_smul_smul] at hs
  refine (smul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (mul_ne_zero
    (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)) (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero
      (pow_ne_zero _ hv))))) (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.shortNode_qSerre_braidFj_braidFi
statement:
theorem shortNode_qSerre_braidFj_braidFi [NeZero v] {i j : I} (h' : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hb : qBinomial (v ^ D.d i) (2 * negA D i j - 2) (negA D i j - 1) ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j i).toNat (braidFj R v i j) (braidFi R i) = 0
proof:
:=
  twoNode_qSerre_braidFj_braidFi_of_braidEj (shortNode_qSerre_braidEj_braidEi h' hq hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.path_qSerre_two
statement:
private lemma path_qSerre_two (q : k) (a b : B) :
    qSerre q 2 a b = a * (a * b) - (q + q⁻¹) • (a * (b * a)) + b * (a * a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, qBinomial, pow_two, mul_assoc]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_quantumCommutator_of_path
statement:
theorem qSerre_quantumCommutator_of_path {q : k} {a b c : B}
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hs : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    (hab : qSerre q 2 a b = 0) (hbc : qSerre q 2 b c = 0)
    (hac : Commute a c) :
    qSerre q 2 (a * b - q⁻¹ • (b * a)) c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * (b * c)) hab
  have h2 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ b * (x * c)) hab
  have h3 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ b * (c * x)) hab
  have h4 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * (c * b)) hab
  have h5 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ c * (x * b)) hab
  have h6 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ c * (b * x)) hab
  have h7 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * (a * a)) hbc
  have h8 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ a * (x * a)) hbc
  have h9 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ a * (a * x)) hbc
  have hca (x : B) : c * (a * x) = a * (c * x) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, mul_assoc]
  apply (smul_eq_zero.mp (show (q + q⁻¹) •
    qSerre q 2 (a * b - q⁻¹ • (b * a)) c = 0 from ?_)).resolve_left hs
  simp only [path_qSerre_two, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul,
    mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, hca] at h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := (match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring))
    -h1 - q⁻¹ ^ 2 • h2 + (q⁻¹ ^ 3 + q⁻¹) • h3 + (q⁻¹ + q) • h4 -
      h5 - q⁻¹ ^ 2 • h6 + q⁻¹ ^ 2 • h7 - (q⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) • h8 + h9

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_quantumCommutator_of_path_reverse
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ a * x) hcb
  have h2 := congrArg (fun x : B ↦ x * a) hcb
  have hca (x : B) : c * (a * x) = a * (c * x) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, mul_assoc]
  simp only [path_qSerre_two, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, hca] at h1 h2 ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := module) h1 - r • h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_path
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_path
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (hji : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hjl : D.cartanMatrix j l = -1)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0)
    (hs : v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j l).toNat
      (braidEj R v i j) (braidEj R v i l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : D.d i = D.d j := by
    have h := D.d_mul_cartanMatrix_comm i j
    rw [hij, hji, mul_neg_one, mul_neg_one] at h
    exact_mod_cast neg_injective h
  have hij' : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hij
    norm_num at hij
  have hjl' : j ≠ l := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hjl
    norm_num at hjl
  have hab : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) 2 (E R v i) (E R v j) = 0 := by
    simpa [hij] using serre_E R v hij'
  have hbc : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) 2 (E R v j) (E R v l) = 0 := by
    simpa [hjl, hd] using serre_E R v hjl'
  rw [braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil, hjl, ← hd]
  exact qSerre_quantumCommutator_of_path (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hs hab hbc
    (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_path_reverse
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_path_reverse
    (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1) (hlj : D.cartanMatrix l j = -1)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d l) (1 - D.cartanMatrix l j).toNat
      (braidEj R v i l) (braidEj R v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlj' : l ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hlj
    norm_num at hlj
  have hcb : qSerre (v ^ D.d l) 2 (E R v l) (E R v j) = 0 := by
    simpa [hlj] using serre_E R v hlj'
  rw [braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil, hlj]
  exact qSerre_quantumCommutator_of_path_reverse hcb
    (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_path
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_path
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (hji : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hjl : D.cartanMatrix j l = -1)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0)
    (hs : v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j l).toNat
      (braidFj R v i j) (braidFj R v i l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (chevalley R v)
    (qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_path (R := R) hv hij hji hjl hil hs)
  rw [map_qSerre, map_zero,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hv hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil, chevalley_E] at h
  rw [braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil]
  have h' := qSerre_smul_smul (v := v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j l).toNat
    (braidFj R v i j) (F R v l) (-(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) 1
  simp only [one_smul, mul_one] at h'
  rw [h'] at h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left
    (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv))))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_path_reverse
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_path_reverse
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (hlj : D.cartanMatrix l j = -1) (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d l) (1 - D.cartanMatrix l j).toNat
      (braidFj R v i l) (braidFj R v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (chevalley R v)
    (qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_path_reverse (R := R) hij hlj hil)
  rw [map_qSerre, map_zero,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hv hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil, chevalley_E] at h
  rw [braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil]
  have h' := qSerre_smul_smul (v := v ^ D.d l) (1 - D.cartanMatrix l j).toNat
    (F R v l) (braidFj R v i j) 1 (-(v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)
  simp only [one_smul, one_pow, one_mul] at h'
  rw [h'] at h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left
    (neg_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.double_path_positive
statement:
private theorem double_path_positive (a b c : B) (q : k) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hS : qSerre q 3 a b = 0) (hU : qSerre (q ^ 2) 2 b c = 0)
    (hac : Commute a c)
    (hn : (1 + q⁻¹ ^ 4) * (1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2 + q⁻¹ ^ 4) ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (q ^ 2) 2
      (a ^ 2 * b - ((q + q⁻¹) * q⁻¹) • (a * b * a) + q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (b * a ^ 2))
      c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (z) * (a * b * c)) hS
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a) * (z) * (b * c)) hS
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a * b) * (z) * (c)) hS
  have h3 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a * b * c) * (z)) hS
  have h4 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (z) * (a * c * b)) hS
  have h5 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a) * (z) * (c * b)) hS
  have h6 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a * c) * (z) * (b)) hS
  have h7 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a * c * b) * (z)) hS
  have h8 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (z) * (b * a * c)) hS
  have h9 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (b) * (z) * (a * c)) hS
  have h10 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (b * a) * (z) * (c)) hS
  have h11 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (b * a * c) * (z)) hS
  have h12 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (b * c) * (z) * (a)) hS
  have h13 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (c) * (z) * (a * b)) hS
  have h14 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (z) * (c * b * a)) hS
  have h15 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (c) * (z) * (b * a)) hS
  have h16 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (c * b) * (z) * (a)) hS
  have h17 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (c * b * a) * (z)) hS
  have h26 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (z) * (a * a * a * a)) hU
  have h27 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a) * (z) * (a * a * a)) hU
  have h28 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a * a) * (z) * (a * a)) hU
  have h29 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a * a * a) * (z) * (a)) hU
  have h30 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ (a * a * a * a) * (z)) hU
  have hca (z : B) : c * (a * z) = a * (c * z) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, mul_assoc]
  apply (smul_eq_zero.mp (show
    ((1 + q⁻¹ ^ 4) * (1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2 + q⁻¹ ^ 4)) •
      qSerre (q ^ 2) 2
        (a ^ 2 * b - ((q + q⁻¹) * q⁻¹) • (a * b * a) +
          q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (b * a ^ 2)) c = 0 from ?_)).resolve_left hn
  simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial,
    Nat.reduceSub, pow_succ, pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero,
    zero_add, one_smul, mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_add,
    add_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, hca]
    at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 h10 h11 h12 h13 h14 h15 h16 h17 h26 h27 h28 h29 h30 ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := (match_scalars <;> field_simp [hq] <;> ring))
    (-(q⁻¹ ^ 2) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 6)) • h0 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 4)) • h1 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 6) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 8) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 10)) • h2 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 2 + q⁻¹ ^ 4 + 2 * q⁻¹ ^ 6 + 2 * q⁻¹ ^ 8 + q⁻¹ ^ 10 + q⁻¹ ^ 12) • h3 +
      (1 + q⁻¹ ^ 2 + 2 * q⁻¹ ^ 4 + q⁻¹ ^ 6 + q⁻¹ ^ 8) • h4 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 2 + q⁻¹ ^ 6) • h5 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 4)) • h6 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 6) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 8) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 10)) • h7 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 2 + q⁻¹ ^ 4 + q⁻¹ ^ 6 + q⁻¹ ^ 8) • h8 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 8) • h9 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 6 + q⁻¹ ^ 8 + q⁻¹ ^ 10) • h10 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 6) + -(2 * q⁻¹ ^ 8) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 10) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 12)) • h11 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 6) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 10)) • h12 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 2) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 6)) • h13 +
      (-(1) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 2) + -(2 * q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(2 * q⁻¹ ^ 6) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 8) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 10)) • h14 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 2 + q⁻¹ ^ 4 + q⁻¹ ^ 6 + q⁻¹ ^ 8) • h15 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 8) • h16 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 6 + q⁻¹ ^ 8 + q⁻¹ ^ 10) • h17 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 8) • h26 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 6) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 8) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 10)) • h27 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 2 + q⁻¹ ^ 4 + 2 * q⁻¹ ^ 6 + q⁻¹ ^ 8 + q⁻¹ ^ 10) • h28 +
      (-(q⁻¹ ^ 2) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 4) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 6) + -(q⁻¹ ^ 8)) • h29 +
      (q⁻¹ ^ 4) • h30

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_double_path
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_double_path
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2)
    (hji : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hjl : D.cartanMatrix j l = -1)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0)
    (hn : (1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 4) *
      (1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 4) ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j l).toNat
      (braidEj R v i j) (braidEj R v i l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hij' : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hij
    norm_num at hij
  have hjl' : j ≠ l := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hjl
    norm_num at hjl
  have hp := parameter_eq_square_of_double_edge (v := v) hij hji
  have hS : qSerre (v ^ D.d i) 3 (E R v i) (E R v j) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hij, Int.reduceSub, Int.reduceToNat] using serre_E R v hij'
  have hU : qSerre ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) 2 (E R v j) (E R v l) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hjl, hp, Int.reduceSub, Int.reduceToNat] using serre_E R v hjl'
  rw [braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_two hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil, hp, hjl]
  change qSerre ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) 2 (_ • _) (E R v l) = 0
  rw [← one_smul k (E R v l), qSerre_smul_smul]
  exact smul_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr (double_path_positive _ _ _ _
    (pow_ne_zero _ hv) hS hU (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil) hn))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_double_path
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_double_path
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2)
    (hji : D.cartanMatrix j i = -1) (hjl : D.cartanMatrix j l = -1)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0)
    (hn : (1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 4) *
      (1 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 4) ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j l).toNat
      (braidFj R v i j) (braidFj R v i l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (chevalley R v)
    (qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_double_path (R := R) hv hij hji hjl hil hn)
  rw [map_qSerre, map_zero,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_two hv hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil, chevalley_E] at h
  rw [braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil]
  have h' := qSerre_smul_smul (v := v ^ D.d j) (1 - D.cartanMatrix j l).toNat
    (braidFj R v i j) (F R v l) ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) 1
  simp only [one_smul, mul_one] at h'
  rw [h'] at h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left
    (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv))))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_double_path_reverse
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_double_path_reverse
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2)
    (hlj : D.cartanMatrix l j = -1) (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d l) (1 - D.cartanMatrix l j).toNat
      (braidEj R v i l) (braidEj R v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlj' : l ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hlj
    norm_num at hlj
  have hcb : qSerre (v ^ D.d l) 2 (E R v l) (E R v j) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hlj, Int.reduceSub, Int.reduceToNat] using serre_E R v hlj'
  have hac := E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (R := R) (v := v) hil
  have hY := qSerre_quantumCommutator_of_path_reverse
    (r := (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) hcb hac
  have hX := qSerre_quantumCommutator_of_path_reverse (r := (1 : k)) hY hac
  have he :
      E R v i * (E R v i * E R v j - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (E R v j * E R v i)) -
        (1 : k) • ((E R v i * E R v j - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (E R v j * E R v i)) *
          E R v i) =
      E R v i ^ 2 * E R v j -
        ((v ^ D.d i + (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) •
          (E R v i * E R v j * E R v i) +
        (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 • (E R v j * E R v i ^ 2) := by
    simp only [one_smul, pow_two, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm,
      smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    match_scalars <;> field_simp [pow_ne_zero (D.d i) hv]
    ring
  rw [he] at hX
  rw [braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_two hij, hlj]
  change qSerre (v ^ D.d l) 2 (E R v l) (_ • _) = 0
  rw [← one_smul k (E R v l), qSerre_smul_smul, hX, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_double_path_reverse
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidFj_braidFj_of_double_path_reverse
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2)
    (hlj : D.cartanMatrix l j = -1) (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d l) (1 - D.cartanMatrix l j).toNat
      (braidFj R v i l) (braidFj R v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (chevalley R v)
    (qSerre_braidEj_braidEj_of_double_path_reverse (R := R) hv hij hlj hil)
  rw [map_qSerre, map_zero,
    chevalley_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_two hv hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil, chevalley_E] at h
  rw [braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hil]
  have h' := qSerre_smul_smul (v := v ^ D.d l) (1 - D.cartanMatrix l j).toNat
    (F R v l) (braidFj R v i j) 1 ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2)
  simp only [one_smul, one_pow, one_mul] at h'
  rw [h'] at h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left
    (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hv)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_qadj_comm
statement:
theorem simplyLaced_qadj_comm {a b : B} (c : B) (r s : k) (hab : Commute a b) :
    b * (a * c - r • (c * a)) - s • ((a * c - r • (c * a)) * b) =
      a * (b * c - s • (c * b)) - r • ((b * c - s • (c * b)) * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hswap (x : B) : b * (a * x) = a * (b * x) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hab.symm.eq, mul_assoc]
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub,
    smul_smul, mul_assoc, hswap, hab.symm.eq]
  module

      (c * b - s • (b * c)) * a - r • (a * (c * b - s • (b * c)))
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_comm_E
statement:
theorem simplyLaced_comm_E (hij : i ≠ j) (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) (l : I) :
    Ti (Tj (E R v l)) = Tj (Ti (E R v l))
proof:
:= by
  have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
  by_cases hli' : l = i
  · subst l
    simp [hij, braidEi, Kt, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0',
      braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0', reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0']
  · by_cases hlj' : l = j
    · subst l
      simp [hij.symm, braidEi, Kt, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0,
        braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0, reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0]
    · rcases hei l hli' with hi0 | ⟨hi1, _⟩ <;>
        rcases hej l hlj' with hj0 | ⟨hj1, _⟩
      · simp [hli', hlj', braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hi0,
          braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0]
      · simp [hli', hlj', hij.symm, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hi0,
          braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hj1]
      · simp [hli', hlj', hij, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0,
          braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0', braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hi1]
      · simp only [simplyLacedBraid_E, hli', hlj', hij, hij.symm, ↓reduceIte,
          braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hi1,
          braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hj1, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul,
          braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0']
        exact simplyLaced_qadj_comm _ _ _ (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_comm_F
statement:
theorem simplyLaced_comm_F (hij : i ≠ j) (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) (l : I) :
    Ti (Tj (F R v l)) = Tj (Ti (F R v l))
proof:
:= by
  have h0' := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp h0
  by_cases hli' : l = i
  · subst l
    simp [hij, braidFi, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0',
      braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0', reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0']
  · by_cases hlj' : l = j
    · subst l
      simp [hij.symm, braidFi, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0,
        braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0, reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0]
    · rcases hei l hli' with hi0 | ⟨hi1, _⟩ <;>
        rcases hej l hlj' with hj0 | ⟨hj1, _⟩
      · simp [hli', hlj', braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hi0,
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0]
      · simp [hli', hlj', hij.symm, braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hi0,
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0,
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (NeZero.ne v) hj1]
      · simp [hli', hlj', hij, braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0,
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0',
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (NeZero.ne v) hi1]
      · simp only [simplyLacedBraid_F, hli', hlj', hij, hij.symm, ↓reduceIte,
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (NeZero.ne v) hi1,
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (NeZero.ne v) hj1,
          map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0,
          braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0']
        exact simplyLaced_qadj_right_comm _ _ _ (F_commute_F_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero h0)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedBraid_comm
statement:
theorem simplyLacedBraid_comm (hij : i ≠ j) (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) :
    (Ti).comp Tj = (Tj).comp Ti
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · exact simplyLaced_comm_E i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h0 l
  · exact simplyLaced_comm_F i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h0 l
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, simplyLacedBraid_K,
      reflY_comm_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero i j h0]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedBraidEquiv_comm
statement:
theorem simplyLacedBraidEquiv_comm (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h0 : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) :
    (simplyLacedBraidEquiv (R := R) i hei hli hpi hqi hsi).trans
      (simplyLacedBraidEquiv j hej hlj hpj hqj hsj) =
    (simplyLacedBraidEquiv j hej hlj hpj hqj hsj).trans
      (simplyLacedBraidEquiv i hei hli hpi hqi hsi)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro x
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
    (simplyLacedBraid_comm i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h0) x).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_double_E
statement: theorem simplyLaced_double_E : Ti (Tj (E R v i)) = E R v j
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplyLacedBraid_E, ite_eq_right hij,
    braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h']
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, simplyLacedBraid_E, hij.symm, ↓reduceIte,
    ← D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h'] using a2Braid_recover_Ej (R := R) i j h hqi

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_double_F
statement: theorem simplyLaced_double_F : Ti (Tj (F R v i)) = F R v j
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplyLacedBraid_F, ite_eq_right hij,
    braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (NeZero.ne v) h']
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, simplyLacedBraid_F, hij.symm, ↓reduceIte,
    ← D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h'] using a2Braid_recover_Fj (R := R) i j h hqi

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_braid_Ei
statement: theorem simplyLaced_braid_Ei : Ti (Tj (Ti (E R v i))) = Tj (Ti (Tj (E R v i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplyLaced_double_E i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h']
  simp only [simplyLacedBraid_E, ↓reduceIte, braidEi, map_neg, map_mul, Kt,
    simplyLacedBraid_K,
    simplyLaced_double_F i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h',
    reflY_reflY_ktilde_of_simply_laced_edge h h']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_braid_Fi
statement: theorem simplyLaced_braid_Fi : Ti (Tj (Ti (F R v i))) = Tj (Ti (Tj (F R v i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplyLaced_double_F i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h']
  simp only [simplyLacedBraid_F, ↓reduceIte, braidFi, map_neg, map_mul,
    simplyLacedBraid_K,
    simplyLaced_double_E i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h',
    reflY_reflY_ktilde_of_simply_laced_edge h h']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_braid_E_extra
statement:
theorem simplyLaced_braid_E_extra (l : I) (hli' : l ≠ i) (hlj' : l ≠ j)
    (hi1 : D.cartanMatrix i l = -1) (hj0 : D.cartanMatrix j l = 0) :
    Ti (Tj (Ti (E R v l))) = Tj (Ti (Tj (E R v l)))
proof:
:= by
  have hiEl : Ti (E R v l) =
      E R v i * E R v l - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ • (E R v l * E R v i) := by
    simp [hli', braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hi1]
  have hjEl : Tj (E R v l) = E R v l := by
    simp [hlj', braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0]
  have hjEi : Tj (E R v i) =
      E R v j * E R v i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ • (E R v i * E R v j) := by
    simp [hij, braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h',
      D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h']
  calc
    Ti (Tj (Ti (E R v l))) =
        E R v j * Ti (E R v l) - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ • (Ti (E R v l) * E R v j) := by
      rw [hiEl, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, hjEl,
        map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul,
        simplyLaced_double_E i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h', hiEl]
    _ = Tj (E R v i) * E R v l - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ • (E R v l * Tj (E R v i)) := by
      rw [hiEl, hjEi]
      exact simplyLaced_qjacobi _ _ (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0)
    _ = Tj (Ti (Tj (E R v l))) := by
      rw [hjEl, hiEl, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, hjEl]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLaced_braid_F_extra
statement:
theorem simplyLaced_braid_F_extra (l : I) (hli' : l ≠ i) (hlj' : l ≠ j)
    (hi1 : D.cartanMatrix i l = -1) (hj0 : D.cartanMatrix j l = 0) :
    Ti (Tj (Ti (F R v l))) = Tj (Ti (Tj (F R v l)))
proof:
:= by
  have hiFl : Ti (F R v l) =
      F R v l * F R v i - (v ^ D.d i) • (F R v i * F R v l) := by
    simp [hli', braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (NeZero.ne v) hi1]
  have hjFl : Tj (F R v l) = F R v l := by
    simp [hlj', braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0]
  have hjFi : Tj (F R v i) =
      F R v i * F R v j - (v ^ D.d i) • (F R v j * F R v i) := by
    simp [hij, braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (NeZero.ne v) h',
      D.d_eq_of_simply_laced_edge h h']
  calc
    Ti (Tj (Ti (F R v l))) =
        Ti (F R v l) * F R v j - (v ^ D.d i) • (F R v j * Ti (F R v l)) := by
      rw [hiFl, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, hjFl,
        map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul,
        simplyLaced_double_F i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h', hiFl]
    _ = F R v l * Tj (F R v i) - (v ^ D.d i) • (Tj (F R v i) * F R v l) := by
      rw [hiFl, hjFi]
      exact simplyLaced_qjacobi_right _ _ (F_commute_F_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0)
    _ = Tj (Ti (Tj (F R v l))) := by
      rw [hjFl, hiFl, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, hjFl]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedBraid_braid
statement:
theorem simplyLacedBraid_braid :
    (Ti).comp ((Tj).comp Ti) = (Tj).comp ((Ti).comp Tj)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · by_cases hli' : l = i
    · subst l
      exact simplyLaced_braid_Ei i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h'
    · by_cases hlj' : l = j
      · subst l
        exact (simplyLaced_braid_Ei j i hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hei hli hpi hqi hsi hij.symm h' h).symm
      · rcases hei l hli' with hi0 | ⟨hi1, _⟩
        · rcases hej l hlj' with hj0 | ⟨hj1, _⟩
          · simp [hli', hlj', braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hi0,
              braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0]
          · exact (simplyLaced_braid_E_extra j i hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hei hli hpi hqi hsi
              hij.symm h' h l hlj' hli' hj1 hi0).symm
        · exact simplyLaced_braid_E_extra i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj
            hij h h' l hli' hlj' hi1 (hli j l h hi1 (Ne.symm hlj'))
  · by_cases hli' : l = i
    · subst l
      exact simplyLaced_braid_Fi i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h'
    · by_cases hlj' : l = j
      · subst l
        exact (simplyLaced_braid_Fi j i hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hei hli hpi hqi hsi hij.symm h' h).symm
      · rcases hei l hli' with hi0 | ⟨hi1, _⟩
        · rcases hej l hlj' with hj0 | ⟨hj1, _⟩
          · simp [hli', hlj', braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hi0,
              braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero hj0]
          · exact (simplyLaced_braid_F_extra j i hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hei hli hpi hqi hsi
              hij.symm h' h l hlj' hli' hj1 hi0).symm
        · exact simplyLaced_braid_F_extra i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj
            hij h h' l hli' hlj' hi1 (hli j l h hi1 (Ne.symm hlj'))
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, simplyLacedBraid_K,
      reflY_braid_of_simply_laced_edge h h']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.simplyLacedBraidEquiv_braid
statement:
theorem simplyLacedBraidEquiv_braid :
    let ei := simplyLacedBraidEquiv (R := R) i hei hli hpi hqi hsi
    let ej := simplyLacedBraidEquiv (R := R) j hej hlj hpj hqj hsj
    (ei.trans ej).trans ei = (ej.trans ei).trans ej
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (simplyLacedBraid_braid i j hei hli hpi hqi hsi hej hlj hpj hqj hsj hij h h') x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nextEdge_qSerre_reverse
statement:
theorem nextEdge_qSerre_reverse (q r : k) (n : ℕ) (a b c : B)
    (hcb : qSerre q n c b = 0) (hac : Commute a c) :
    qSerre q n c (a * b - r • (b * a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : qSerre q n c (a * b) = a * qSerre q n c b := by
    simp only [qSerre, Finset.mul_sum, mul_smul_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    congr 1
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, (hac.symm.pow_left (n - t)).eq]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hright : qSerre q n c (b * a) = qSerre q n c b * a := by
    simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    congr 1
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    rw [(hac.pow_right t).eq]
  calc
    _ = qSerre q n c (a * b) - r • qSerre q n c (b * a) := by
      simp only [qSerre, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
        smul_sub, smul_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.smul_sum]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t _
      rw [mul_comm]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hleft, hright, hcb]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nextEdge_qSerre_three
statement:
theorem nextEdge_qSerre_three (q : k) (a b c : B) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hs : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hc : q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0)
    (hab : qSerre q 2 a b = 0) (hbc : qSerre q 3 b c = 0)
    (hac : Commute a c) :
    qSerre q 3 (a * b - q⁻¹ • (b * a)) c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z * a * b * b * c) hab
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * z * b * b * c) hab
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * b * z * b * c) hab
  have h3 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * b * b * z * c) hab
  have h4 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * b * b * c * z) hab
  have h5 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z * a * b * c * b) hab
  have h6 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * z * b * c * b) hab
  have h7 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * b * z * c * b) hab
  have h8 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * b * c * z * b) hab
  have h9 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * b * c * b * z) hab
  have h10 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z * a * c * b * b) hab
  have h11 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * z * c * b * b) hab
  have h12 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * c * z * b * b) hab
  have h13 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * c * b * z * b) hab
  have h14 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * c * b * b * z) hab
  have h16 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * z * a * b * c) hab
  have h17 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * a * z * b * c) hab
  have h21 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * z * a * c * b) hab
  have h22 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * a * z * c * b) hab
  have h23 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * a * c * z * b) hab
  have h25 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z * b * b * a * c) hab
  have h26 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * z * b * a * c) hab
  have h27 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * b * z * a * c) hab
  have h28 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * b * a * z * c) hab
  have h29 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * b * a * c * z) hab
  have h30 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * b * c * z * a) hab
  have h31 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * c * z * a * b) hab
  have h32 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z * b * c * b * a) hab
  have h33 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * z * c * b * a) hab
  have h34 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * c * z * b * a) hab
  have h35 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * c * b * z * a) hab
  have h36 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ b * c * b * a * z) hab

  have h40 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ c * b * z * a * b) hab
  have h41 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ c * b * a * z * b) hab
  have h43 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z * c * b * b * a) hab
  have h44 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ c * z * b * b * a) hab
  have h45 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ c * b * z * b * a) hab
  have h46 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ c * b * b * z * a) hab
  have h47 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ c * b * b * a * z) hab
  have h84 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z * a * a * a) hbc
  have h85 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * z * a * a) hbc
  have h86 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * a * z * a) hbc
  have h87 := congrArg (fun z : B ↦ a * a * a * z) hbc
  have hca (z : B) : c * (a * z) = a * (c * z) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, mul_assoc]
  apply (smul_eq_zero.mp (show ((q + q⁻¹) * (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1)) •
    qSerre q 3 (a * b - q⁻¹ • (b * a)) c = 0 from ?_)).resolve_left

  simp only [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, qBinomial,

    zero_add, one_smul, mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_add,

    mul_assoc, hac.symm.eq, hca]

       h22 h23 h25 h26 h27 h28 h29 h30 h31 h32 h33 h34 h35 h36 h37 h40 h41 h43 h44 h45 h46 h47 h84

    (-q⁻¹ - 2 * q - 2 * q ^ 3 - q ^ 5) • h22 +
    (q⁻¹ + 2 * q + 2 * q ^ 3 + q ^ 5) • h23 +
    (q⁻¹ + q + q ^ 3) • h25 +

    (q⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) • h28 +
    (-q⁻¹ ^ 4 - 2 * q⁻¹ ^ 2 - 2 * 1 - q ^ 2) • h29 +
