name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.doubleEdgeBraid_comp_doubleEdgeBraidInv
statement:
theorem doubleEdgeBraid_comp_doubleEdgeBraidInv :
    (doubleEdgeBraid (R := R) i j hij hall h h' hq hs).comp
      (doubleEdgeBraidInv i j hij hall h h' hq hs) = AlgHom.id k (QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · rcases hall l with hl | hl
    · subst l
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, doubleEdgeBraidInv_Ei, braidInvEi, map_neg, map_mul,
        doubleEdgeBraid_F, ↓reduceIte, braidFi, doubleEdgeBraid_K, reflY_ktilde,
        mul_neg, neg_neg, AlgHom.id_apply, ← mul_assoc, K_mul_K_neg, one_mul]
    · subst l
      simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, doubleEdgeBraidInv_Ej, map_add, map_sub, map_mul,
        map_pow, map_smul, doubleEdgeBraid_E, hij.symm, ↓reduceIte, AlgHom.id_apply] using
        doubleEdge_recover_Ej (NeZero.ne v) h hq hs
  · rcases hall l with hl | hl
    · subst l
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, doubleEdgeBraidInv_Fi, braidInvFi, map_neg, map_mul,
        doubleEdgeBraid_E, ↓reduceIte, braidEi, Kt, doubleEdgeBraid_K, reflY_ktilde,
        neg_mul, neg_neg, AlgHom.id_apply, mul_assoc, K_mul_K_neg, mul_one]
    · subst l
      simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, doubleEdgeBraidInv_Fj, map_add, map_sub, map_mul,
        map_pow, map_smul, doubleEdgeBraid_F, hij.symm, ↓reduceIte, AlgHom.id_apply] using
        doubleEdge_recover_Fj (NeZero.ne v) h hq hs
  · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.doubleEdgeBraidInv_comp_doubleEdgeBraid
statement:
theorem doubleEdgeBraidInv_comp_doubleEdgeBraid :
    (doubleEdgeBraidInv (R := R) i j hij hall h h' hq hs).comp
      (doubleEdgeBraid i j hij hall h h' hq hs) = AlgHom.id k (QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro x
  have hc := congrArg braidReversal
    (DFunLike.congr_fun (doubleEdgeBraid_comp_doubleEdgeBraidInv (R := R) i j hij hall h h' hq hs)
      (braidReversal x))
  simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, doubleEdgeBraidInv_apply, braidReversal_involutive x,
    AlgHom.id_apply] using hc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.higher_mixed_2_1
statement:
private lemma higher_mixed_2_1 (a b c d u u' : B) (q : k)
    (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hac : a * c = c * a + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (u - u'))
    (hbd : b * d = d * b)
    (had : a * d = d * a)
    (hbc : b * c = c * b)
    (hua : u * a = q ^ 2 • (a * u))
    (huc : u * c = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (c * u))
    (hu'a : u' * a = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (a * u'))
    (hu'c : u' * c = q ^ 2 • (c * u'))
    (hub : u * b = q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (b * u))
    (hud : u * d = q • (d * u))
    (hu'b : u' * b = q ^ 2 • (b * u'))
    (hu'd : u' * d = q⁻¹ • (d * u')) :
    let X := ((q + q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (a ^ 2 * b - ((q + q⁻¹) * q⁻¹) • (a * b * a) + q⁻¹ ^ 2 • (b * a ^ 2)))
    let Z := (d * c - q • (c * d))
    X * Z - Z * X = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hac_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) hac
  have hbd_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) hbd
  have had_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) had
  have hbc_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) hbc
  have hua_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) hua
  have huc_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) huc
  have hu'a_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) hu'a
  have hu'c_assoc (z : B) := congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) hu'c

statement:
private lemma higher_mixed_1_2 (a b c d u u' : B) (q : k)
    (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hac : a * c = c * a + (q - q⁻¹)⁻¹ • (u - u'))
    (hbd : b * d = d * b)

    (hbc : b * c = c * b)

theorem braidEj_mul_braidFj_sub_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_two_neg_one
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = -2)
    (hil : D.cartanMatrix i l = -1) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    braidEj R v i j * braidFj R v i l - braidFj R v i l * braidEj R v i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hij' : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hij
    norm_num at hij
  have hil' : i ≠ l := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at hil
    norm_num at hil
  have he : v ^ ((D.d i : ℤ) * 2) = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, zpow_ofNat]
  rw [braidEj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_two hij,
    braidFj_eq_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one hv hil]
  exact higher_mixed_2_1
    (E R v i) (E R v j) (F R v i) (F R v l)
    (Kt R v i) (K R v (-ktilde R i)) (v ^ D.d i) (pow_ne_zero _ hv)
    (by simpa only [↓reduceIte] using
      (sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp (E_mul_F_sub R v i i)))
    (E_mul_F_of_ne hjl) (E_mul_F_of_ne hil') (E_mul_F_of_ne hij'.symm)
    (by rw [Kt, K_mul_E, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self, he])
    (by rw [Kt, K_mul_F, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self, zpow_neg, he, inv_pow])
    (by rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self, zpow_neg, he, inv_pow])
    (by rw [K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg, root_ktilde, D.cartanMatrix_self, he])
    (by rw [Kt, K_mul_E, root_ktilde, hij, mul_neg, zpow_neg, he, inv_pow])
    (by rw [Kt, K_mul_F, root_ktilde, hil, mul_neg_one, neg_neg, zpow_natCast])
    (by rw [K_mul_E, map_neg, root_ktilde, hij, mul_neg, neg_neg, he])
    (by rw [K_mul_F, map_neg, neg_neg, root_ktilde, hil, mul_neg_one, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_two_expansion
statement:
private lemma qSerre_two_expansion (q : k) (a b : B) :
    qSerre q 2 a b = a * (a * b) - (q + q⁻¹) • (a * (b * a)) + b * (a * a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qSerre, Finset.sum_range_succ, qBinomial, pow_two, mul_assoc]
  module

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qSerre_braidEi_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem qSerre_braidEi_braidEj_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one [NeZero v]
    (h : D.cartanMatrix i j = -1)
    (hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0) :
    qSerre (v ^ D.d i) (1 - D.cartanMatrix i j).toNat
      (braidEi R i) (braidEj R v i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv := NeZero.ne v
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [D.cartanMatrix_self] at h
    norm_num at h
  let q := v ^ D.d i
  let A := braidEi (v := v) R i
  let X := braidEj R v i j
  let b := E R v j
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hv
  have hKX : Kt R v i * X = q • (X * Kt R v i) := by
    have ht := braidK_mul_braidEj (R := R) hv hij (-ktilde R i)
    rw [braidK_apply, reflY_neg_ktilde, map_neg, root_ktilde, h,
      mul_neg_one, neg_neg, zpow_natCast] at ht
    exact ht
  have hAX : A * X - q • (X * A) = -q • b := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun z : QuantumGroup R v ↦ z * Kt R v i)
      (braidEj_mul_Fi_sub_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one (R := R) h hq)
    change (X * F R v i - F R v i * X) * Kt R v i =
      -(b * K R v (-ktilde R i)) * Kt R v i at hc
    simp only [sub_mul, neg_mul, mul_assoc, K_neg_mul_Kt, mul_one] at hc
    dsimp [A, braidEi]
    simp only [neg_mul, mul_neg, mul_assoc]
    rw [hKX, mul_smul_comm]
    linear_combination (norm := module) congrArg (fun z : QuantumGroup R v ↦ q • z) hc
  have hAb : A * b = q⁻¹ • (b * A) := by
    change -(F R v i * Kt R v i) * E R v j =
      q⁻¹ • (E R v j * -(F R v i * Kt R v i))
    simp only [neg_mul, mul_neg, smul_neg, mul_assoc]
    rw [Kt_mul_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_neg_one h, mul_smul_comm,
      ← mul_assoc, ← E_mul_F_of_ne hij.symm, mul_assoc]
  have he : qSerre q 2 A X = A * (A * X - q • (X * A)) -
      q⁻¹ • ((A * X - q • (X * A)) * A) := by
    rw [qSerre_two_expansion]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub,
      smul_smul, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_smul, add_smul]
    module
  rw [h]
  change qSerre q 2 A X = 0
  rw [he, hAX]
  simp [hAb, smul_smul, hq0]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.commute_serreAux
statement:
theorem commute_serreAux {a b c : B} (ha : Commute c a) (hb : Commute c b)
    (q t : k) (r : ℕ) : Commute c (serreAux q t r a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold serreAux
  apply Commute.sum_right
  intro j _
  exact (((ha.pow_right (r - j)).mul_right hb).mul_right (ha.pow_right j)).smul_right _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolated_relations
statement:
private theorem isolated_relations (i : I)
    (hi : ∀ j, j ≠ i → D.cartanMatrix i j = 0)
    (e f : QuantumGroup R v)
    (hE : ∀ μ, braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ) * e = v ^ R.root i μ • (e * braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ)))
    (hF : ∀ μ, braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ) * f = v ^ (-R.root i μ) • (f * braidK R v i (.ofAdd μ)))
    (hEF : e * f - f * e = (v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ •
      (braidK R v i (.ofAdd (ktilde R i)) - braidK R v i (.ofAdd (-ktilde R i))))
    (heE : ∀ j, j ≠ i → Commute e (E R v j))
    (heF : ∀ j, j ≠ i → Commute e (F R v j))
    (hfE : ∀ j, j ≠ i → Commute f (E R v j))
    (hfF : ∀ j, j ≠ i → Commute f (F R v j)) :
    Relations R v (fun j ↦ if j = i then e else E R v j)
      (fun j ↦ if j = i then f else F R v j) (braidK R v i) where
  K_mul_E μ j
proof:
:= by
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j; simpa only [↓reduceIte] using hE μ
    · simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte, braidK_apply, K_mul_E, root_reflY, hi j hj,
        mul_zero, sub_zero]
  K_mul_F μ j := by
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j; simpa only [↓reduceIte] using hF μ
    · simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte, braidK_apply, K_mul_F, root_reflY, hi j hj,
        mul_zero, sub_zero]
  E_mul_F j l := by
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst l; simpa only [↓reduceIte] using hEF
      · simp only [hl, Ne.symm hl, ↓reduceIte]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (heF l hl).eq
    · by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst l
        simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hfE j hj).symm.eq
      · simp only [hj, hl, ↓reduceIte, braidK_apply, map_neg,
          reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hi j hj)]
        exact E_mul_F_sub R v j l
  serre_E j l hjl := by
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      have hl := Ne.symm hjl
      simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte, hi l hl, sub_zero, Int.toNat_one]
      exact qSerre_one_eq_zero_of_commute _ (heE l hl)
    · by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst l
        have hji := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp (hi j hj)
        simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte, hji, sub_zero, Int.toNat_one]
        exact qSerre_one_eq_zero_of_commute _ (heE j hj).symm
      · simpa only [hj, hl, ↓reduceIte] using serre_E R v hjl
  serre_F j l hjl := by
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      have hl := Ne.symm hjl
      simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte, hi l hl, sub_zero, Int.toNat_one]
      exact qSerre_one_eq_zero_of_commute _ (hfF l hl)
    · by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst l
        have hji := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp (hi j hj)
        simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte, hji, sub_zero, Int.toNat_one]
        exact qSerre_one_eq_zero_of_commute _ (hfF j hj).symm
      · simpa only [hj, hl, ↓reduceIte] using serre_F R v hjl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_commute_E_of_root_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem K_commute_E_of_root_eq_zero (μ : Y) (j : I) (h : R.root j μ = 0) :
    Commute (K R v μ) (E R v j)
proof:
:= by
  change K R v μ * E R v j = E R v j * K R v μ
  simp [K_mul_E, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.K_commute_F_of_root_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem K_commute_F_of_root_eq_zero (μ : Y) (j : I) (h : R.root j μ = 0) :
    Commute (K R v μ) (F R v j)
proof:
:= by
  change K R v μ * F R v j = F R v j * K R v μ
  simp [K_mul_F, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraid_relations
statement:
theorem isolatedBraid_relations (i : I) (hi : ∀ j, j ≠ i → D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) :
    Relations R v (fun j ↦ if j = i then braidEi R i else E R v j)
      (fun j ↦ if j = i then braidFi R i else F R v j) (braidK R v i)
proof:
:= by
  refine isolated_relations i hi _ _ (braidK_mul_braidEi i) (braidK_mul_braidFi i)
    (braidEi_mul_braidFi_sub i) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro j hj
    exact ((show Commute (F R v i) (E R v j) from (E_mul_F_of_ne hj).symm).mul_left
      (K_commute_E_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [root_ktilde, hi j hj]))).neg_left
  · intro j hj
    exact ((F_commute_F_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hi j hj)).mul_left
      (K_commute_F_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [root_ktilde, hi j hj]))).neg_left
  · intro j hj
    exact ((K_commute_E_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [map_neg, root_ktilde, hi j hj])).mul_left
      (E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hi j hj))).neg_left
  · intro j hj
    exact ((K_commute_F_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [map_neg, root_ktilde, hi j hj])).mul_left
      (E_mul_F_of_ne (Ne.symm hj))).neg_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraidInv_relations
statement:
theorem isolatedBraidInv_relations (i : I) (hi : ∀ j, j ≠ i → D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) :
    Relations R v (fun j ↦ if j = i then braidInvEi R i else E R v j)
      (fun j ↦ if j = i then braidInvFi R i else F R v j) (braidK R v i)
proof:
:= by
  refine isolated_relations i hi _ _ (braidK_mul_braidInvEi i) (braidK_mul_braidInvFi i)
    (braidInvEi_mul_braidInvFi_sub i) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro j hj
    exact ((K_commute_E_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [map_neg, root_ktilde, hi j hj])).mul_left
      (E_mul_F_of_ne hj).symm).neg_left
  · intro j hj
    exact ((K_commute_F_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [map_neg, root_ktilde, hi j hj])).mul_left
      (F_commute_F_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hi j hj))).neg_left
  · intro j hj
    exact ((E_commute_E_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hi j hj)).mul_left
      (K_commute_E_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [root_ktilde, hi j hj]))).neg_left
  · intro j hj
    exact ((show Commute (E R v i) (F R v j) from E_mul_F_of_ne (Ne.symm hj)).mul_left
      (K_commute_F_of_root_eq_zero _ j (by simp [root_ktilde, hi j hj]))).neg_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraid_E
statement:
@[simp] theorem isolatedBraid_E (j : I) :
    isolatedBraid i hi (E R v j) = if j = i then braidEi R i else E R v j
proof: := lift_E _ j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraid_F
statement:
@[simp] theorem isolatedBraid_F (j : I) :
    isolatedBraid i hi (F R v j) = if j = i then braidFi R i else F R v j
proof: := lift_F _ j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraid_K
statement:
@[simp] theorem isolatedBraid_K (μ : Y) :
    isolatedBraid i hi (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ)
proof: := lift_K _ μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraidInv_E
statement:
@[simp] theorem isolatedBraidInv_E (j : I) :
    isolatedBraidInv i hi (E R v j) = if j = i then braidInvEi R i else E R v j
proof: := lift_E _ j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraidInv_F
statement:
@[simp] theorem isolatedBraidInv_F (j : I) :
    isolatedBraidInv i hi (F R v j) = if j = i then braidInvFi R i else F R v j
proof: := lift_F _ j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraidInv_K
statement:
@[simp] theorem isolatedBraidInv_K (μ : Y) :
    isolatedBraidInv i hi (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ)
proof: := lift_K _ μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraidInv_comp_isolatedBraid
statement:
theorem isolatedBraidInv_comp_isolatedBraid :
    (isolatedBraidInv (R := R) i hi).comp (isolatedBraid i hi) =
      AlgHom.id k (QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun j ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, isolatedBraid_E, ↓reduceIte, braidEi, map_neg, map_mul,
        isolatedBraidInv_F, braidInvFi, Kt, isolatedBraidInv_K, reflY_ktilde, neg_mul,
        neg_neg, AlgHom.id_apply, mul_assoc, K_mul_K_neg, mul_one]
    · simp [hj]
  · by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, isolatedBraid_F, ↓reduceIte, braidFi, map_neg, map_mul,
        isolatedBraidInv_E, braidInvEi, isolatedBraidInv_K, reflY_ktilde, mul_neg,
        neg_neg, AlgHom.id_apply, ← mul_assoc, K_mul_K_neg, one_mul]
    · simp [hj]
  · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraid_comp_isolatedBraidInv
statement:
theorem isolatedBraid_comp_isolatedBraidInv :
    (isolatedBraid (R := R) i hi).comp (isolatedBraidInv i hi) =
      AlgHom.id k (QuantumGroup R v)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (fun j ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, isolatedBraidInv_E, ↓reduceIte, braidInvEi, map_neg,
        map_mul, isolatedBraid_F, braidFi, isolatedBraid_K, reflY_ktilde, mul_neg,
        neg_neg, AlgHom.id_apply, ← mul_assoc, K_mul_K_neg, one_mul]
    · simp [hj]
  · by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, isolatedBraidInv_F, ↓reduceIte, braidInvFi, map_neg,
        map_mul, isolatedBraid_E, braidEi, Kt, isolatedBraid_K, reflY_ktilde, neg_mul,
        neg_neg, AlgHom.id_apply, mul_assoc, K_mul_K_neg, mul_one]
    · simp [hj]
  · simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.reflY_comm_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero
statement:
theorem reflY_comm_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (j : I) (hij : D.cartanMatrix i j = 0) (μ : Y) :
    reflY R i (reflY R j μ) = reflY R j (reflY R i μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hji := (D.isGeneralizedCartan_cartanMatrix.zero_comm i j).mp hij
  simp [reflY_apply, R.root_coroot, hij, hji]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isolatedBraid_comp_comm
statement:
theorem isolatedBraid_comp_comm (j : I)
    (hj : ∀ l, l ≠ j → D.cartanMatrix j l = 0) :
    (isolatedBraid (R := R) (v := v) i hi).comp (isolatedBraid j hj) =
      (isolatedBraid j hj).comp (isolatedBraid i hi)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; rfl
  refine hom_ext (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun l ↦ ?_) (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  · by_cases hli : l = i
    · subst l
      simp [hij, braidEi, Kt,
        reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hj i hij)]
    · by_cases hlj : l = j
      · subst l
        simp [Ne.symm hij, braidEi, Kt,
          reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hi j (Ne.symm hij))]
      · simp [hli, hlj]
  · by_cases hli : l = i
    · subst l
      simp [hij, braidFi,
        reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hj i hij)]
    · by_cases hlj : l = j
      · subst l
        simp [Ne.symm hij, braidFi,
          reflY_ktilde_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero (hi j (Ne.symm hij))]
      · simp [hli, hlj]
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, isolatedBraid_K]
    rw [reflY_comm_of_cartanMatrix_eq_zero i j (hi j (Ne.symm hij))]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_pullback
statement: lemma mem_pullback {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} : x ∈ pullback L Φ ↔ Φ x ∈ L
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_pullback_symm
statement:
lemma mem_pullback_symm (x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) :
    x ∈ L ↔ Φ.symm x ∈ pullback L Φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_pullback, Φ.apply_symm_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.isCrystalLattice_pullback
statement:
lemma isCrystalLattice_pullback
    (hL : IsCrystalLattice (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) L) :
    IsCrystalLattice (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) (pullback L Φ)
proof:
:=
  hL.of_equiv (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) Φ.symm (mem_pullback_symm L Φ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.isCrystalBase_pullback
statement:
lemma isCrystalBase_pullback
    {hL : IsCrystalLattice (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) L}
    {B : Set (QDS L ϖ)} (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) :
    IsCrystalBase (isCrystalLattice_pullback (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Φ hL) ϖ
      (pullbackBase L Φ B)
proof:
:=
  hB.of_equiv (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) Φ.symm (mem_pullback_symm L Φ) fun _ ↦
    (Function.Injective.mem_set_image
      (IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.symm.restrictScalars k) (mem_pullback_symm L Φ) ϖ).injective).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff
statement:
lemma mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff {B : Set (QDS L ϖ)} {y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hy : y ∈ pullback L Φ) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨y, hy⟩ : pullback L Φ) : QDS (pullback L Φ) ϖ) ∈
      pullbackBase L Φ B ↔ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨Φ y, hy⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨y, hy⟩ : pullback L Φ) : QDS (pullback L Φ) ϖ) =
      IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.symm.restrictScalars k) (mem_pullback_symm L Φ) ϖ
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨Φ y, hy⟩ : L)) := by
    exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (Subtype.ext (Φ.symm_apply_apply y).symm)
  rw [h, pullbackBase, Function.Injective.mem_set_image
    (IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.symm.restrictScalars k) (mem_pullback_symm L Φ) ϖ).injective]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.IsLatticeIso.trans
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x ↦ h.1 x, fun j ↦ (h.2 j).elim fun h1 h2 ↦ ⟨h1, (mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff Φ h1).1 h2⟩⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_not_map_eq
statement:
lemma projDS_not_map_eq (x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) :
    projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) (Φ x) = projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := projDS_add_projDS_not Λ (· ∈ S) x
  conv_lhs => rw [← h, map_add, hΦS, hΦn]
  ext j
  simp only [map_add, DFinsupp.add_apply, projDS_apply]
  by_cases hj : j ∈ S <;> simp [hj]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_mem_pullback
statement:
lemma projDS_mem_pullback {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : x ∈ pullback L Φ) :
    projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x ∈ pullback L Φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_pullback, hΦS]
  exact hPS _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_not_mem_pullback
statement:
lemma projDS_not_mem_pullback {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hx : x ∈ pullback L Φ) : projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x ∈ pullback L Φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_pullback, hΦn, ← projDS_not_map_eq hΦS hΦn]
  exact projDS_notMem_mem hPS hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_mem_of_kashiwaraF_stable
statement:
lemma projDS_mem_of_kashiwaraF_stable (L' : Submodule A (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1))
    (hF : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ L', fDS hvt hR Λ i x ∈ L')
    (hv : ∀ j ∈ T, DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1) ∈ L')
    {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ) :
    projDS Λ (· ∈ T) x ∈ L'
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DFinsupp.induction with
  | h0 => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | ha j b f hf _ ih =>
    have hx' := (mem_dsSum Λ).1 hx
    have hb : b ∈ lat hvt hR A (Λ j) := by simpa [hf] using hx' j
    rw [map_add]
    refine add_mem ?_ (ih ((mem_dsSum Λ).2 fun l ↦ ?_))
    · rw [DFinsupp.filterLinearMap_apply, DFinsupp.filter_single]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact single_mem_of_kashiwaraF_stable Λ L' hF (hv j h) hb
      · exact zero_mem _
    · by_cases hl : l = j
      · subst hl; rw [hf]; exact zero_mem _
      · simpa [DFinsupp.single_apply, Ne.symm hl] using hx' l

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_lat_of_mem_pullback
statement:
lemma mem_lat_of_mem_pullback {y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hy : y ∈ pullback L Φ) {j : J} (hj : j ∈ T) : y j ∈ lat hvt hR A (Λ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_eq_sum_weightSetProj hv' (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) y
  rw [hs, DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun μ _ ↦ mem_lat_of_kashiwaraE_stable hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ
    (T : Set J) (pullback L Φ) (fun i x hx ↦ hL'.kashiwaraE_mem i x hx) ?_
    (hL'.weightSetProj_mem _ y hy) (weightSetProj_singleton_mem hv' _ μ y) hj
  intro x hx l hl hxw
  have hxS : Φ (projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x) ∈ L := projDS_mem_pullback hΦS hPS hx
  have hw : projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x ∈ hwSpan v Λ T :=
    mem_hwSpan_of_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hmax hTS
      (by rw [← hT l hl]; exact map_mem_weightSpace (projDS Λ (· ∈ S)) hxw)
      fun j hj ↦ by rw [projDS_apply]; simp [hj]
  have h := hD2 _ hxS (hΦT _ hw)
  rw [Φ.symm_apply_apply] at h
  have := (mem_dsSum Λ).1 h l
  rwa [projDS_apply, ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true (hTsub _ hl))] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_mem_dsSum_of_mem_pullback
statement:
lemma projDS_mem_dsSum_of_mem_pullback {y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hy : y ∈ pullback L Φ) : projDS Λ (· ∈ T) y ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_dsSum Λ).2 fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [projDS_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact mem_lat_of_mem_pullback hΦS hPS hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hmax hT hTS hTsub hL' hΦT hD2 hy h
  · exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_sdiff_mem_pullback
statement:
lemma projDS_sdiff_mem_pullback {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hx : x ∈ pullback L Φ) : projDS Λ (· ∈ S \ (T : Set J)) x ∈ pullback L Φ
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := projDS_mem_pullback hΦS hPS hx
  have h2 := projDS_mem_of_kashiwaraF_stable (pullback L Φ)
    (fun i x hx ↦ hL'.kashiwaraF_mem i x hx) hv
    (projDS_mem_dsSum_of_mem_pullback hΦS hPS hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hmax hT hTS hTsub hL' hΦT
      hD2 hx)
  have e : projDS Λ (· ∈ S \ (T : Set J)) x =
      projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x - projDS Λ (· ∈ T) (projDS Λ (· ∈ T) x) := by
    ext j
    simp only [DFinsupp.sub_apply, projDS_apply, Set.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_coe]
    by_cases hjT : j ∈ T
    · simp [hjT, hTsub _ hjT]
    · by_cases hjS : j ∈ S <;> simp [hjT, hjS]
  rw [e]
  exact sub_mem h1 h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_pullback_iff_of_sdiff
statement:
lemma mem_pullback_iff_of_sdiff {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hx0 : ∀ j ∈ S \ (T : Set J), x j = 0) : x ∈ pullback L Φ ↔ x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  have e : x = projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x + projDS Λ (· ∈ T) x := by
    ext j
    simp only [DFinsupp.add_apply, projDS_apply]
    by_cases hjT : j ∈ T
    · simp [hjT, hTsub _ hjT]
    · by_cases hjS : j ∈ S
      · simp [hjT, hjS, hx0 j ⟨hjS, hjT⟩]
      · simp [hjT, hjS]
  have hoffn : ∀ z : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, ∀ j ∈ S,
      projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) z j = 0 := fun z j hj ↦ by
    rw [projDS_apply]
    simp [hj]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [e]
    refine add_mem ?_ (projDS_mem_dsSum_of_mem_pullback hΦS hPS hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hmax hT hTS
      hTsub hL' hΦT hD2 h)
    have h' := projDS_not_mem_pullback hΦS hΦn hPS h
    rw [mem_pullback, hΦn] at h'
    exact (hoff _ (hoffn x)).1 h'
  · intro h
    rw [e]
    refine add_mem ?_ (projDS_mem_of_kashiwaraF_stable (pullback L Φ)
      (fun i x hx ↦ hL'.kashiwaraF_mem i x hx) hv h)
    rw [mem_pullback, hΦn]
    refine (hoff _ (hoffn x)).2 ((mem_dsSum Λ).2 fun j ↦ ?_)
    rw [projDS_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact zero_mem _
    · exact (mem_dsSum Λ).1 h j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.IsSplit.exists_pullback
statement:
theorem IsSplit.exists_pullback {S : Set J} [DecidablePred (· ∈ S)]
    {L : Submodule A (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1)}
    {hL : IsCrystalLattice (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) L}
    {B : Set (QDS L ϖ)} (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) (hS : IsSplit hvt hR S L B) {j₀ : J}
    (hj₀ : j₀ ∈ S) (hmax : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 + R.rootSum ν → ν = 0)
    [FiniteDimensional k (weightSpace R v (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (Λ j₀).1)]
    {T : Finset J} (hT : ∀ j ∈ T, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1)
    (hTS : ∀ j ∈ S, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 → j ∈ T) (hTsub : ∀ j ∈ T, j ∈ S) :
    ∃ g : hwSpan v Λ T ≃ₗ[k] hwSpan v Λ T,
      IsSplit hvt hR (S \ (T : Set J)) (pullback L (autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g))
        (pullbackBase L (autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g) B)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ j ∉ S, (Λ j).1 ≠ (Λ j₀).1 := fun j hj ↦ hS.ne j hj j₀ hj₀
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_normalize hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hS.projDS_mem hS.mem_iff hmax hne hB hT
    hTS hTsub
  let Φ := autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g
  have hΦS : ∀ x, Φ (projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x) = projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (Φ x) := fun x ↦
    (projDS_autMap hT g.toLinearMap (· ∈ S) (fun j hj ↦ hTsub j hj) x).symm
  have hΦn : ∀ x, Φ (projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x) = projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x := fun x ↦
    autMap_projDS_of_notMem hT g.toLinearMap (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) (fun j hj h ↦ h (hTsub j hj)) x
  have hΦT : ∀ x ∈ hwSpan v Λ T, Φ x ∈ hwSpan v Λ T := fun x hx ↦
    autMap_mem_hwSpan hT g.toLinearMap hx
  have hD1 := hg.1
  have hD2 : ∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ hwSpan v Λ T → Φ.symm x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ := hg.2
  have hv : ∀ j ∈ T, DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1) ∈ pullback L Φ :=
    fun j hj ↦ (hD1 j hj).fst
  have hL' := isCrystalLattice_pullback (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Φ hL
  have hPS := hS.projDS_mem
  refine ⟨g, fun x hx ↦ projDS_sdiff_mem_pullback hΦS hPS hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hmax hT hTS hTsub
      hL' hΦT hD2 hv hx,
    fun x hx0 ↦ mem_pullback_iff_of_sdiff hΦS hΦn hPS hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hmax hT hTS hTsub hL'
      hΦT hD2 hv hS.mem_iff hx0, fun j hj ↦ ?_, fun j hj j' hj' ↦ ?_⟩
  · by_cases hjS : j ∈ S
    · have hjT : j ∈ T := by
        by_contra h
        exact hj ⟨hjS, h⟩
      refine (hD1 j hjT).elim fun h1 h2 ↦ ?_
      exact ⟨h1, (mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff Φ h1).2 h2⟩
    · refine (hS.hwv_mem j hjS).elim fun h1 h2 ↦ ?_
      have he : Φ (DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)) =
          DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1) :=
        autMap_single_of_notMem hT g.toLinearMap (fun h ↦ hjS (hTsub j h)) _
      have h1' : DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1) ∈ pullback L Φ := by
        rw [mem_pullback, he]
        exact h1
      exact ⟨h1', (mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff Φ h1').2
        ((exists_mem_mk_mem he h1 h2).elim fun _ h ↦ h)⟩
  · obtain ⟨hj'S, hj'T⟩ := hj'
    by_cases hjS : j ∈ S
    · have hjT : j ∈ T := by
        by_contra h
        exact hj ⟨hjS, h⟩
      rw [hT j hjT]
      exact fun h ↦ hj'T (hTS j' hj'S h.symm)
    · exact hS.ne j hjS j' hj'S

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.single_fW_cons
statement:
lemma single_fW_cons (j : J) (i : I) (w : List I) :
    DFinsupp.single j (fW hvt hR (Λ j) (i :: w)) =
      fDS hvt hR Λ i (DFinsupp.single j (fW hvt hR (Λ j) w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_fW, single_fW]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.IsLatticeIso.mk_mem_or
statement:
lemma IsLatticeIso.mk_mem_or (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B)
    {Φ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]
      Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (h : IsLatticeIso hvt hR L B Φ) (j : J) (w : List I)
    (hw : Φ (DFinsupp.single j (fW hvt hR (Λ j) w)) ∈ L) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, hw⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B ∨
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, hw⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  induction w with
  | nil => exact Or.inl ((h.2 j).elim fun _ h2 ↦ h2)
  | cons i w ih =>
    have hw' : Φ (DFinsupp.single j (fW hvt hR (Λ j) w)) ∈ L :=
      (h.1 _).1 (single_mem_dfinsuppLattice (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ (Λ j).2 A w))
    have e : Φ (DFinsupp.single j (fW hvt hR (Λ j) (i :: w))) =
        kashiwaraF R v _ hv' (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) i (Φ (DFinsupp.single j (fW hvt hR (Λ j) w))) := by
      rw [single_fW_cons]
      exact map_kashiwaraF hv' (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) i (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) Φ.toLinearMap _
    have hq : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, hw⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) =
        hL.fQ ϖ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, hw'⟩ : L)) :=
      congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (Subtype.ext e)
    rcases ih hw' with h1 | h1
    · rw [hq]
      exact hB.fQ_mem i _ h1
    · rw [hq, h1, map_zero]
      exact Or.inr rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.IsLatticeIso.mem_dsBase_iff
statement:
theorem IsLatticeIso.mem_dsBase_iff (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B)
    {Φ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]
      Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (h : IsLatticeIso hvt hR L B Φ)
    (b : QDS (dsSum hvt hR A Λ) ϖ) :
    b ∈ dsBase hvt hR A ϖ Λ ↔ IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.restrictScalars k) h.1 ϖ b ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  have hc := not_isUnit_ϖ hϖ
  have : Nontrivial (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ}) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by rwa [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top])
  set Q := IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.restrictScalars k) h.1 ϖ
  have hB₀ := IsCrystalBase.dfinsupp (M := fun j ↦ IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) hc
    fun j ↦ isCrystalBaseHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ j)
  have hB₁ := hB₀.of_equiv (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) Φ h.1 (B' := Q '' dsBase hvt hR A ϖ Λ)
    fun _ ↦ (Q.injective.mem_set_image).symm
  have hsub : Q '' dsBase hvt hR A ϖ Λ ⊆ B := by
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hbj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hb
    obtain ⟨b', ⟨⟨w, rfl⟩, hne⟩, rfl⟩ := hbj
    have hw : Φ (DFinsupp.single j (fW hvt hR (Λ j) w)) ∈ L :=
      (h.1 _).1 (single_mem_dfinsuppLattice (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ (Λ j).2 A w))
    have hQ : Q (dfinsuppQuotIncl _ ϖ j (Submodule.Quotient.mk
        ⟨fW hvt hR (Λ j) w, IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ (Λ j).2 A w⟩)) =
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, hw⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) := rfl
    rw [hQ]
    refine (h.mk_mem_or hB j w hw).resolve_right fun h0 ↦ hne ?_
    rw [← hQ, map_eq_zero_iff _ Q.injective] at h0
    exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ (dfinsuppQuotIncl_injective _ ϖ j)).1 h0
  have heq := IsCrystalBase.eq_of_subset_of_span_eq_top hsub hB₁.span_eq_top hB.linearIndependent
  rw [← heq, Q.injective.mem_set_image]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_summandsAbove_self
statement: lemma mem_summandsAbove_self (j : J) : j ∈ summandsAbove Λ j
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, by rw [R.rootSum_zero, add_zero]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.summandsAbove_subset
statement:
lemma summandsAbove_subset {j j' : J} (h : j' ∈ summandsAbove Λ j) :
    summandsAbove Λ j' ⊆ summandsAbove Λ j
proof:
:= by
  rintro l ⟨ν', hν'⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := h
  exact ⟨ν + ν', by rw [hν', hν, R.rootSum_add, add_assoc]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.finiteDimensional_weightSpace_of_finite
statement:
lemma finiteDimensional_weightSpace_of_finite (j : J) (hfin : (summandsAbove Λ j).Finite) :
    FiniteDimensional k (weightSpace R v (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (Λ j).1)
proof:
:= by
  have := hfin.to_subtype
  have hfd : ∀ j', FiniteDimensional k
      (weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j').1) (Λ j).1) :=
    fun j' ↦ IrreducibleModule.finiteDimensional_weightSpace hR
      (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) _
  have h0 : ∀ x ∈ weightSpace R v (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (Λ j).1,
      ∀ j' ∉ summandsAbove Λ j, x j' = 0 := fun x hx j' hj' ↦ by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := IrreducibleModule.exists_eq_sub_rootSum (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
      (map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lapply (R := QuantumGroup R v) j') hx) hne
    exact hj' ⟨ν, by rw [hν, sub_add_cancel]⟩
  let f : weightSpace R v (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (Λ j).1 →ₗ[k]
      ∀ j' : summandsAbove Λ j, weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j').1) (Λ j).1 :=
    LinearMap.pi fun j' ↦ ((DFinsupp.lapply (R := QuantumGroup R v)
      (M := fun j ↦ IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) j').restrictScalars k).restrict
        fun x hx ↦ map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lapply (R := QuantumGroup R v)
          (M := fun j ↦ IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) j'.1) hx
  refine Module.Finite.of_injective f fun x y h ↦ Subtype.ext (DFinsupp.ext fun j' ↦ ?_)
  by_cases hj' : j' ∈ summandsAbove Λ j
  · exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun h ⟨j', hj'⟩)
  · rw [h0 _ x.2 j' hj', h0 _ y.2 j' hj']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_maximal_of_finite
statement:
lemma exists_maximal_of_finite {S : Set J} {j : J} (hj : j ∈ S)
    (hfin : (summandsAbove Λ j).Finite) :
    ∃ j₀ ∈ S, ∀ j' ∈ S, ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, (Λ j').1 = (Λ j₀).1 + R.rootSum ν → ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hF : (summandsAbove Λ j ∩ S).Finite := hfin.subset Set.inter_subset_left
  obtain ⟨j₀, ⟨hj₀a, hj₀S⟩, hmin⟩ := Set.exists_min_image (summandsAbove Λ j ∩ S)
    (fun j' ↦ (summandsAbove Λ j' ∩ S).ncard) hF ⟨j, mem_summandsAbove_self j, hj⟩
  refine ⟨j₀, hj₀S, fun j' hj'S ν hν ↦ by_contra fun hν0 ↦ ?_⟩
  have hj'a : j' ∈ summandsAbove Λ j₀ := ⟨ν, hν⟩
  have hsub : summandsAbove Λ j' ∩ S ⊂ summandsAbove Λ j₀ ∩ S := by
    refine ⟨Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ (summandsAbove_subset hj'a), fun h ↦ hν0 ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ := (h ⟨mem_summandsAbove_self j₀, hj₀S⟩).1
    have h0 : R.rootSum (ν + ν') = R.rootSum 0 := by
      rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_zero]
      calc R.rootSum ν + R.rootSum ν' = ((Λ j₀).1 + R.rootSum ν + R.rootSum ν') - (Λ j₀).1 := by
            abel
        _ = 0 := by rw [← hν, ← hν', sub_self]
    exact (add_eq_zero.1 (LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR h0)).1
  have hlt := Set.ncard_lt_ncard hsub
    (hF.subset (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ (summandsAbove_subset hj₀a)))
  exact absurd (hmin j' ⟨summandsAbove_subset hj₀a hj'a, hj'S⟩) (not_le.2 hlt)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.ds_apply_eq_of_single
statement:
lemma ds_apply_eq_of_single {F G : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]
      Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} {P : J → Prop}
    (h : ∀ j, P j → ∀ y, F (DFinsupp.single j y) = G (DFinsupp.single j y))
    {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : ∀ j, x j ≠ 0 → P j) : F x = G x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DFinsupp.induction with
  | h0 => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | ha j b f hf hb ih =>
    have hfP : ∀ l, f l ≠ 0 → P l := fun l hl ↦ by
      by_cases hlj : l = j
      · subst hlj
        exact absurd hf hl
      · exact hx l (by rwa [DFinsupp.add_apply, DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne hlj, zero_add])
    rw [map_add, map_add, ih hfP,
      h j (hx j (by rwa [DFinsupp.add_apply, DFinsupp.single_eq_same, hf, add_zero])) b]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_eq_self
statement:
lemma projDS_eq_self {p : J → Prop} [DecidablePred p] {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hx : ∀ j, ¬p j → x j = 0) : projDS Λ p x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [projDS_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact (hx j h).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.autEquiv_eq_self
statement:
lemma autEquiv_eq_self (g : hwSpan v Λ T ≃ₗ[k] hwSpan v Λ T)
    {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : ∀ j ∈ T, x j = 0) :
    autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := autMap_projDS_of_notMem (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hT g.toLinearMap (fun j ↦ j ∉ T)
    (fun j hj h ↦ h hj) x
  rwa [projDS_eq_self fun j hj ↦ hx j (not_not.1 hj)] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.autEquiv_symm_apply_eq_zero
statement:
lemma autEquiv_symm_apply_eq_zero (g : hwSpan v Λ T ≃ₗ[k] hwSpan v Λ T) (p : J → Prop)
    (hp : ∀ j ∈ T, p j) {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hx : ∀ j, ¬p j → x j = 0) {j : J} (hj : ¬p j) :
    (autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g).symm x j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := projDS_autMap (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hT g.symm.toLinearMap p hp x
  rw [projDS_eq_self hx, ← autEquiv_symm_apply] at h
  rw [← h, projDS_apply]
  simp [hj]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.IsSplit.congr

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_pullback_trans
statement:
lemma mem_pullback_trans {L : Submodule A (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1)}
    {Φ ψ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]

:=

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.IsSplit.of_pullback_pullback
proof:
:= mem_pullback_trans.2 (h.projDS_mem x (mem_pullback_trans.1 hx))
  mem_iff x hx := mem_pullback_trans.trans (h.mem_iff x hx)
  hwv_mem j hj := (h.hwv_mem j hj).elim fun h1 h2 ↦
    ⟨mem_pullback_trans.2 h1, (mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff (ψ.trans Φ) _).2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.Le.trans
statement:
lemma SplitStage.Le.trans {a b c : SplitStage hvt hR L B} (hab : a.Le b) (hbc : b.Le c) :
    a.Le c
proof:
:=
  ⟨hab.1.trans hbc.1, fun x hx ↦ (hbc.2 x fun j hj ↦ hx j fun h ↦ hj (hab.1 h)).trans
    (hab.2 x hx)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.nonempty
statement: lemma SplitStage.nonempty : Nonempty (SplitStage hvt hR L B)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨∅, LinearEquiv.refl _ _, fun _ _ ↦ rfl, fun x hx j hj ↦ hx j hj,
    ⟨fun x hx ↦ ?_, fun x hx ↦ ?_, fun j hj ↦ absurd (Set.mem_compl (Set.notMem_empty j)) hj,
      fun j hj ↦ absurd (Set.mem_compl (Set.notMem_empty j)) hj⟩⟩⟩
  · rwa [projDS_eq_self fun j hj ↦ absurd (Set.mem_compl (Set.notMem_empty j)) hj]
  · have hx0 : x = 0 := DFinsupp.ext fun j ↦ hx j (Set.mem_compl (Set.notMem_empty j))
    subst hx0
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ zero_mem _, fun _ ↦ zero_mem _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.exists_mem_chain
statement:
lemma SplitStage.exists_mem_chain (hne : c.Nonempty) (s : Finset J)
    (hs : ∀ j ∈ s, ∃ a ∈ c, j ∈ a.U) : ∃ a ∈ c, ∀ j ∈ s, j ∈ a.U
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact hne.elim fun a ha ↦ ⟨a, ha, fun j hj ↦ absurd hj (Finset.notMem_empty j)⟩
  | insert j s _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, has⟩ := ih fun l hl ↦ hs l (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hl)
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hjb⟩ := hs j (Finset.mem_insert_self j s)
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab
      exact ⟨a, ha, fun l hl ↦ (Finset.mem_insert.1 hl).elim (fun h ↦ h ▸ hjb) (has l)⟩
    · rcases hc ha hb hab with h | h
      · exact ⟨b, hb, fun l hl ↦ (Finset.mem_insert.1 hl).elim (fun h ↦ h ▸ hjb)
          fun hl ↦ h.1 (has l hl)⟩
      · exact ⟨a, ha, fun l hl ↦ (Finset.mem_insert.1 hl).elim (fun h' ↦ h' ▸ h.1 hjb) (has l)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.exists_mem_chain_vec
statement:
lemma SplitStage.exists_mem_chain_vec (hne : c.Nonempty) (x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) :
    ∃ a ∈ c, ∀ j, x j ≠ 0 → (∃ b ∈ c, j ∈ b.U) → j ∈ a.U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha, has⟩ := SplitStage.exists_mem_chain c hc hne
    (x.support.filter fun j ↦ ∃ b ∈ c, j ∈ b.U) fun j hj ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.1 hj).2
  exact ⟨a, ha, fun j hj hjc ↦ has j (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hj, hjc⟩)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.limMap_eq
statement:
lemma SplitStage.limMap_eq {a : SplitStage hvt hR L B} (ha : a ∈ c)
    {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : ∀ j, x j ≠ 0 → (∃ b ∈ c, j ∈ b.U) → j ∈ a.U) :
    SplitStage.limMap c x = a.Φ x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ds_apply_eq_of_single
    (G := (a.Φ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]
      Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1)) (P := fun j ↦ (∃ b ∈ c, j ∈ b.U) → j ∈ a.U)
    (fun j hj y ↦ ?_) hx
  simp only [SplitStage.limMap, DFinsupp.lsum_single]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨hb, hjb⟩ := h.choose_spec
    have hja := hj h
    have hsupp : ∀ (d : SplitStage hvt hR L B), j ∈ d.U →
        ∀ l ∉ d.U, (DFinsupp.single j y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) l = 0 :=
      fun d hjd l hl ↦ DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by rintro rfl; exact hl hjd)
    change h.choose.Φ (DFinsupp.single j y) = a.Φ (DFinsupp.single j y)
    by_cases hab : a = h.choose
    · rw [← hab]
    · rcases hc ha hb hab with h' | h'
      · exact h'.2 _ (hsupp a hja)
      · exact (h'.2 _ (hsupp _ hjb)).symm
  · have hja : j ∉ a.U := fun hja ↦ h ⟨a, ha, hja⟩
    exact (a.map_eq_self _ fun l hl ↦ DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by rintro rfl; exact hja hl)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.limMap_bijective
statement:
lemma SplitStage.limMap_bijective (hne : c.Nonempty) :
    Function.Bijective (SplitStage.limMap c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := SplitStage.exists_mem_chain_vec c hc hne x
    rw [SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha hax] at hx
    exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ a.Φ.injective).1 hx
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hay⟩ := SplitStage.exists_mem_chain_vec c hc hne y
    set y₁ := projDS Λ (· ∈ a.U) y
    set y₂ := projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ a.U) y
    have hy₁ : ∀ j ∉ a.U, y₁ j = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by simp [y₁, hj]
    have hy₂ : ∀ j ∈ a.U, y₂ j = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by simp [y₂, hj]
    refine ⟨a.Φ.symm y₁ + y₂, ?_⟩
    rw [SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha, map_add, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      a.map_eq_self _ hy₂, projDS_add_projDS_not]
    intro j hj hjc
    by_contra hja
    rw [DFinsupp.add_apply, a.symm_apply_eq_zero _ hy₁ j hja, zero_add] at hj
    have hj' : y j ≠ 0 := by simpa [y₂, hja] using hj
    exact hja (hay j hj' hjc)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.exists_le
statement: lemma SplitStage.exists_le (hne : c.Nonempty) : ∃ ub : SplitStage hvt hR L B, ∀ a ∈ c, a.Le ub
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set U' : Set J := {j | ∃ b ∈ c, j ∈ b.U}
  set Φ := SplitStage.limEquiv c hc hne
  have hΦ : ∀ x, Φ x = SplitStage.limMap c x := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have key : ∀ x, ∃ a ∈ c, Φ x = a.Φ x ∧ ∀ j ∈ U', x j ≠ 0 → j ∈ a.U := fun x ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := SplitStage.exists_mem_chain_vec c hc hne x
    exact ⟨a, ha, SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha hax, fun j hj hx ↦ hax j hx hj⟩
  
  have hfix : ∀ x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, (∀ j ∈ U', x j = 0) → Φ x = x :=
    fun x hx ↦ hne.elim fun a ha ↦ by
      rw [hΦ, SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha fun j hj hjc ↦ absurd (hx j hjc) hj]
      exact a.map_eq_self x fun j hj ↦ hx j ⟨a, ha, hj⟩
  refine ⟨⟨U', Φ, hfix, fun x hx j hj ↦ ?_, ⟨fun x hx ↦ ?_, fun x hx ↦ ?_,
    fun j hj ↦ ?_, fun j hj j' hj' ↦ ?_⟩⟩, fun a ha ↦ ⟨fun j hj ↦ ⟨a, ha, hj⟩, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨a, ha, -, hax⟩ := key x
    have hxa : ∀ l ∉ a.U, x l = 0 := fun l hl ↦ by
      by_contra h
      exact hl (hax l (by_contra fun h' ↦ h (hx l h')) h)
    have hz := a.symm_apply_eq_zero x hxa
    have hΦz : Φ (a.Φ.symm x) = x := by
      rw [hΦ, SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha fun l hl _ ↦ by_contra fun h ↦ hl (hz l h),
        LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [Φ.symm_apply_eq.2 hΦz.symm]
    exact hz j fun h ↦ hj ⟨a, ha, h⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hΦx, hax⟩ := key x
    have hxa : x ∈ pullback L a.Φ := by rw [mem_pullback, ← hΦx]; exact hx
    have hp := a.isSplit.projDS_mem x hxa
    have he : projDS Λ (· ∈ U'ᶜ) x = projDS Λ (· ∈ a.Uᶜ) x := by
      ext j
      simp only [projDS_apply, Set.mem_compl_iff]
      by_cases hja : j ∈ a.U
      · simp [hja, show j ∈ U' from ⟨a, ha, hja⟩]
      · by_cases hjU : j ∈ U'
        · simp only [hjU, not_true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, hja, not_false_eq_true]
          by_contra h
          exact hja (hax j hjU (Ne.symm h))
        · simp [hjU, hja]
    rw [mem_pullback, he, hΦ, SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha]
    · exact hp
    · intro j hj hjc
      have hj' : j ∉ a.U ∧ x j ≠ 0 := by simpa using hj
      exact absurd (hax j hjc hj'.2) hj'.1
  · 
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hΦx, hax⟩ := key x
    rw [mem_pullback, hΦx]
    refine a.isSplit.mem_iff x fun j hj ↦ ?_
    by_contra h
    by_cases hjU : j ∈ U'
    · exact hj (hax j hjU h)
    · exact h (hx j hjU)
  · 
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hja⟩ : j ∈ U' := not_not.1 hj
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := a.isSplit.hwv_mem j (not_not.2 hja)
    have he : Φ (DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)) =
        a.Φ (DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)) := by
      rw [hΦ, SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha]
      intro l hl _
      by_contra hla
      exact hl (DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by rintro rfl; exact hla hja))
    obtain ⟨h1', h2'⟩ := exists_mem_mk_mem he h1 ((mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff a.Φ h1).1 h2)
    exact ⟨h1', (mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff Φ h1').2 h2'⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hja⟩ : j ∈ U' := not_not.1 hj
    exact a.isSplit.ne j (not_not.2 hja) j' fun h ↦ hj' ⟨a, ha, h⟩
  · rw [hΦ, SplitStage.limMap_eq c hc ha]
    intro j hj _
    by_contra h
    exact hj (hx j h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.SplitStage.exists_lt
statement:
lemma SplitStage.exists_lt [Finite I] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A k)) (hϖ : ϖ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹)
    (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a)
    (hfund : ∀ j : I, ∃ Λ : Dom R, ∀ i, Λ.1 (R.coroot i) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    {hL : IsCrystalLattice (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) L}
    (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B)
    (hup : ∀ j, (summandsAbove Λ j).Finite) (a : SplitStage hvt hR L B) {j : J} (hj : j ∉ a.U) :
    ∃ b : SplitStage hvt hR L B, a.Le b ∧ ¬b.U ⊆ a.U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀S, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_of_finite (hR := hR) (S := a.Uᶜ) hj (hup j)
  set T : Finset J := (hup j₀).toFinset.filter fun j' ↦ j' ∉ a.U ∧ (Λ j').1 = (Λ j₀).1
  have hT : ∀ j' ∈ T, (Λ j').1 = (Λ j₀).1 := fun j' h ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).2.2
  have hTS : ∀ j' ∈ a.Uᶜ, (Λ j').1 = (Λ j₀).1 → j' ∈ T := fun j' hj' h ↦
    Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨(hup j₀).mem_toFinset.2 ⟨0, by rw [R.rootSum_zero, add_zero, h]⟩, hj', h⟩
  have hTsub : ∀ j' ∈ T, j' ∈ a.Uᶜ := fun j' h ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).2.1
  have := finiteDimensional_weightSpace_of_finite (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) j₀ (hup j₀)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := a.isSplit.exists_pullback hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
    (isCrystalBase_pullback (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) a.Φ hB) hj₀S hmax hT hTS hTsub
  set ψ := autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g
  have hψ : ∀ x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, (∀ j ∉ a.U, x j = 0) → ψ x = x :=
    fun x hx ↦ autEquiv_eq_self hT g fun l hl ↦ hx l (hTsub l hl)
  have hfix : ∀ x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, (∀ j ∈ a.U ∪ T, x j = 0) →
      (ψ.trans a.Φ) x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, autEquiv_eq_self hT g fun l hl ↦ hx l (Or.inr hl)]
    exact a.map_eq_self x fun l hl ↦ hx l (Or.inl hl)
  have hsymm : ∀ x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, (∀ j ∉ a.U ∪ T, x j = 0) →
      ∀ j ∉ a.U ∪ T, (ψ.trans a.Φ).symm x j = 0 := fun x hx l hl ↦ by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_trans_apply]
    refine autEquiv_symm_apply_eq_zero hT g (· ∈ a.U ∪ T) (fun l hl ↦ Or.inr hl) (fun l hl ↦ ?_) hl
    
    have hx₂ : a.Φ.symm (projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ a.U) x) = projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ a.U) x :=
      a.Φ.symm_apply_eq.2 (a.map_eq_self _ fun j hj ↦ by simp [hj]).symm
    have hlU : l ∉ a.U := fun h ↦ hl (Or.inl h)
    rw [← projDS_add_projDS_not Λ (· ∈ a.U) x, map_add, hx₂, DFinsupp.add_apply,
      a.symm_apply_eq_zero _ (fun j hj ↦ by simp [hj]) l hlU, zero_add]
    simp [hlU, hx l hl]
  have hset : a.Uᶜ \ (T : Set J) = (a.U ∪ T)ᶜ := by
    ext l
    simp
  refine ⟨⟨a.U ∪ T, ψ.trans a.Φ, hfix, hsymm, IsSplit.congr hset hg.of_pullback_pullback⟩,
    ⟨Set.subset_union_left, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, hψ x hx]
  · exact hTsub j₀ (hTS j₀ hj₀S rfl) (h (Or.inr (hTS j₀ hj₀S rfl)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_isLatticeIso
statement:
theorem exists_isLatticeIso (hup : ∀ j, (summandsAbove Λ j).Finite) (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) :
    ∃ Φ, IsLatticeIso hvt hR L B Φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hch : ∀ c : Set (SplitStage hvt hR L B), IsChain SplitStage.Le c →
      ∃ ub, ∀ a ∈ c, a.Le ub := fun c hc ↦ c.eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim
    (fun h ↦ SplitStage.nonempty.elim fun a ↦
      ⟨a, fun b hb ↦ (Set.notMem_empty b (h ▸ hb)).elim⟩)
    (SplitStage.exists_le c hc)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_maximal_of_chains_bounded hch SplitStage.Le.trans
  have hU : ∀ j, j ∈ m.U := fun j ↦ by_contra fun hj ↦
    (SplitStage.exists_lt hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hB hup m hj).elim fun b hb ↦
      hb.2 (hm b hb.1).1
  refine ⟨m.Φ, fun x ↦ (m.isSplit.mem_iff x fun j hj ↦ absurd (hU j) hj).symm, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := m.isSplit.hwv_mem j (not_not.2 (hU j))
  exact ⟨h1, (mk_mem_pullbackBase_iff m.Φ h1).1 h2⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_autEquiv_of_isCrystalBase
statement:
theorem exists_autEquiv_of_isCrystalBase (hup : ∀ j, (summandsAbove Λ j).Finite)
    (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) :
    ∃ (Φ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]
        Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (hΦ : ∀ x, x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ ↔ Φ x ∈ L),
      ∀ b, b ∈ dsBase hvt hR A ϖ Λ ↔ IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.restrictScalars k) hΦ ϖ b ∈ B
proof:
:=
  (exists_isLatticeIso hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hup hB).elim fun Φ h ↦
    ⟨Φ, h.1, h.mem_dsBase_iff hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hB⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_equiv_of_isCrystalBase
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_of_isCrystalBase (hup : ∀ j, (summandsAbove Λ j).Finite)
    (ψ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
    (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) :
    ∃ (Φ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
      (hΦ : ∀ x, x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ ↔ Φ x ∈ L),
      ∀ b, b ∈ dsBase hvt hR A ϖ Λ ↔ IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.restrictScalars k) hΦ ϖ b ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  let L₀ : Submodule A (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) :=
    L.comap (((ψ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M).restrictScalars
      k).restrictScalars A)
  have hLL₀ : ∀ m, m ∈ L ↔ ψ.symm m ∈ L₀ := fun m ↦ by
    change _ ↔ ψ (ψ.symm m) ∈ L
    rw [ψ.apply_symm_apply]
  set Qψ := IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (ψ.symm.restrictScalars k) hLL₀ ϖ
  have hB₀ := hB.of_equiv (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) ψ.symm hLL₀ (B' := Qψ '' B)
    fun _ ↦ (Qψ.injective.mem_set_image).symm
  refine (exists_autEquiv_of_isCrystalBase hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hup hB₀).elim fun Φ₀ h ↦
    h.elim fun hΦ₀ hb₀ ↦ ⟨Φ₀.trans ψ, hΦ₀, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hb₀ b]
  have e : IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ₀.restrictScalars k) hΦ₀ ϖ b =
      Qψ (IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv ((Φ₀.trans ψ).restrictScalars k) hΦ₀ ϖ b) := by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ b
    exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (Subtype.ext (ψ.symm_apply_apply _).symm)
  rw [e, Qψ.injective.mem_set_image]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.finite_summandsAbove_of_isCategoryOInt
statement:
lemma finite_summandsAbove_of_isCategoryOInt (hO : IsCategoryOInt R v M)
    (ψ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M) (j : J) :
    (summandsAbove Λ j).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := hO.exists_finset
  
  have hmem : ∀ j', ψ (DFinsupp.single j' (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j').1)) ∈
      weightSpace R v M (Λ j').1 := fun j' ↦
    map_mem_weightSpace (ψ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
      (map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lsingle (R := QuantumGroup R v)
        (M := fun j ↦ IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) j') IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace)
  have hne : ∀ j', ψ (DFinsupp.single j' (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j').1)) ≠ 0 := fun j' h ↦ by
    rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ ψ.injective, DFinsupp.single_eq_zero] at h
    exact hwv_ne_zero hR hv' _ h
  
  set N : Set (I →₀ ℕ) := ⋃ μ ∈ (s₀ : Set (Y →+ ℤ)),
    ⋃ σ ∈ {σ : I →₀ ℕ | R.rootSum σ = μ - (Λ j).1}, Set.Icc 0 σ
  have hN : N.Finite := Set.Finite.biUnion s₀.finite_toSet fun μ _ ↦
    Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.Subsingleton.finite fun σ hσ σ' hσ' ↦
      LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR (hσ.trans hσ'.symm))
      fun σ _ ↦ Set.finite_Icc 0 σ
  
  have hfib : ∀ μ, {j' | (Λ j').1 = μ}.Finite := fun μ ↦ by
    have := hO.finiteDimensional_weightSpace μ
    let f : {j' | (Λ j').1 = μ} → weightSpace R v M μ := fun j' ↦
      ⟨ψ (DFinsupp.single j'.1 (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j'.1).1)), by
        convert hmem j'.1
        exact (show (Λ j'.1).1 = μ from j'.2).symm⟩
    have hli : LinearIndependent k fun j' : {j' | (Λ j').1 = μ} ↦
        ψ (DFinsupp.single j'.1 (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j'.1).1)) :=
      (linearIndependent_dfinsuppSingle (fun j ↦ IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)
        (fun j ↦ hwv_ne_zero hR hv' _) _).map'
        ((ψ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) →ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M).restrictScalars k)
        (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.2 ψ.injective)
    have hf : LinearIndependent k f := LinearIndependent.of_comp (weightSpace R v M μ).subtype hli
    exact Set.finite_coe_iff.1 hf.finite
  refine (hN.biUnion fun ν _ ↦ hfib ((Λ j).1 + R.rootSum ν)).subset fun j' ⟨ν, hν⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, ρ, hρ⟩ := hs₀ _ ((Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).2 ⟨_, hmem j', hne j'⟩)
  refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := ν) (Set.mem_biUnion hμ (Set.mem_biUnion (x := ν + ρ) ?_ ?_)) hν
  · change R.rootSum (ν + ρ) = μ - (Λ j).1
    rw [R.rootSum_add]
    calc R.rootSum ν + R.rootSum ρ = ((Λ j).1 + R.rootSum ν) - (Λ j).1 + R.rootSum ρ := by abel
      _ = μ - (Λ j).1 := by rw [← hν, hρ]; abel
  · exact ⟨zero_le, le_self_add⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_equiv_of_isCategoryOInt
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_of_isCategoryOInt (hO : IsCategoryOInt R v M) (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) :
    ∃ (s : Set (Submodule (QuantumGroup R v) M)) (Λ : s → Dom R)
      (Φ : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M)
      (hΦ : ∀ x, x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ ↔ Φ x ∈ L),
      ∀ b, b ∈ dsBase hvt hR A ϖ Λ ↔ IntegrableSl2.quotEquiv (Φ.restrictScalars k) hΦ ϖ b ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, Λ₀, hdom, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ :=
    hO.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hvt hR
  let Λ : s → Dom R := fun j ↦ ⟨Λ₀ j, hdom j⟩
  let ψ' : (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v] M := ψ
  exact ⟨s, Λ, exists_equiv_of_isCrystalBase hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
    (finite_summandsAbove_of_isCategoryOInt (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hO ψ') ψ' hB⟩

name: Crystal.exists_equiv_isHighestWeight_tensor
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_isHighestWeight_tensor (t : ∀ j, B j) (t₂ : B₂) {x : X} {n : ι → ℤ}
    (hx : C₂.wt t₂ = x) (hn : ∀ i, D.coroot i x = n i) (h₁ : C₁.IsSeminormal)
    (h₂ : C₂.IsSeminormal) (ht : ∀ j b, (C j).IsHighestWeight b ↔ b = t j)
    (ht₂ : ∀ b, C₂.IsHighestWeight b ↔ b = t₂) (Ξ : Equiv (Crystal.sigma C) (C₂.tensor C₁)) :
    ∃ e : J ≃ {b // ∀ i, C₁.ε i b ≤ (n i : WithBot ℤ)},
      ∀ j, (C j).wt (t j) = x + C₁.wt (e j)
proof:
:= by
  have hhw : ∀ b : B₂ × B₁, (C₂.tensor C₁).IsHighestWeight b ↔
      b.1 = t₂ ∧ ∀ i, C₁.ε i b.2 ≤ (n i : WithBot ℤ) := by
    rintro ⟨b₂, b₁⟩
    rw [IsSeminormal.isHighestWeight_tensor_iff h₂ h₁, ht₂]
    exact and_congr_right fun h ↦ by rw [h, hx]; simp only [hn]
  have htop : ∀ j, (C₂.tensor C₁).IsHighestWeight (Ξ ⟨j, t j⟩) := fun j ↦ by
    rw [← Equiv.coe_toStrictHom, StrictHom.isHighestWeight_apply_iff, isHighestWeight_sigma_iff,
      ht]
  let f : J → {b // ∀ i, C₁.ε i b ≤ (n i : WithBot ℤ)} :=
    fun j ↦ ⟨(Ξ ⟨j, t j⟩).2, ((hhw _).1 (htop j)).2⟩
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    refine ⟨fun j j' h ↦ ?_, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
    · have h2 : (Ξ ⟨j, t j⟩).2 = (Ξ ⟨j', t j'⟩).2 := congrArg Subtype.val h
      have h1 : (Ξ ⟨j, t j⟩).1 = (Ξ ⟨j', t j'⟩).1 :=
        ((hhw _).1 (htop j)).1.trans ((hhw _).1 (htop j')).1.symm
      exact (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.1 (Ξ.toEquiv.injective (Prod.ext h1 h2))).1
    · obtain ⟨⟨j, x⟩, hx⟩ := Ξ.toEquiv.surjective (t₂, b.1)
      rw [Equiv.coe_toEquiv] at hx
      have hh : (C₂.tensor C₁).IsHighestWeight (Ξ ⟨j, x⟩) := by
        rw [hx, hhw]
        exact ⟨rfl, b.2⟩
      rw [← Equiv.coe_toStrictHom, StrictHom.isHighestWeight_apply_iff,
        isHighestWeight_sigma_iff, ht] at hh
      subst hh
      exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hx)⟩
  refine ⟨_root_.Equiv.ofBijective f hf, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := Ξ.wt_apply ⟨j, t j⟩
  change C₂.wt (Ξ _).1 + C₁.wt (Ξ _).2 = _ at h
  rw [((hhw _).1 (htop j)).1, hx] at h
  exact h.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_crystalEquiv_sigma_tensor
statement:
theorem exists_crystalEquiv_sigma_tensor (μ ν : Dom R) :
    ∃ (s : Set (Submodule (QuantumGroup R v)
        (TensorModule k (IrreducibleModule R v μ.1) (IrreducibleModule R v ν.1))))
      (Λ : s → Dom R)
      (_ : Crystal.Equiv (Crystal.sigma fun j ↦ crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ j))
        ((crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund ν).tensor
          (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund μ))),
      Nonempty ((Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ≃ₗ[QuantumGroup R v]
        TensorModule k (IrreducibleModule R v μ.1) (IrreducibleModule R v ν.1))
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hB₁ := isCrystalBaseHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund μ
  have hB₂ := isCrystalBaseHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund ν
  have hO : IsCategoryOInt R v
      (TensorModule k (IrreducibleModule R v μ.1) (IrreducibleModule R v ν.1)) :=
    TensorModule.isCategoryOInt hR hv' (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryOInt hR hv' μ.2)
      (IrreducibleModule.isCategoryOInt hR hv' ν.2)
  obtain ⟨Θ⟩ := TensorModule.nonempty_crystalEquiv_integrable hϖ hϖv hB₁ hB₂ hk hinj
  obtain ⟨s, Λ, Φ, -, -, hΨ⟩ :=
    exists_crystalEquiv_sigma_of_isCategoryOInt (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hO
      (TensorModule.isCrystalBase_tensor_integrable hϖ hϖv hB₁ hB₂ hk hinj)
  exact ⟨s, Λ, Φ.trans Θ.symm, hΨ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.nonempty_tensor_equiv_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem nonempty_tensor_equiv_dfinsupp (μ ν : Dom R) :
    Nonempty ((Π₀ b : {b // ∀ i, (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund μ).ε i b ≤
          ((ν.1 (R.coroot i) : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ)},
        IrreducibleModule R v (ν.1 + (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund μ).wt b)) ≃ₗ[
          QuantumGroup R v]
      TensorModule k (IrreducibleModule R v μ.1) (IrreducibleModule R v ν.1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, Λ, Ξ, ⟨Ψ⟩⟩ := exists_crystalEquiv_sigma_tensor hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund μ ν
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Crystal.exists_equiv_isHighestWeight_tensor
    (fun j ↦ topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ (Λ j)) (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ ν)
    (wt_topHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund ν) (fun i ↦ rfl)
    (isSeminormal_crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund μ)
    (isSeminormal_crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund ν)
    (fun j ↦ isHighestWeight_crystalHW_iff hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ j))
    (isHighestWeight_crystalHW_iff hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund ν) Ξ
  have hwt : ∀ j, ν.1 + (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund μ).wt (e j).1 = (Λ j).1 :=
    fun j ↦ (he j).symm.trans (wt_topHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ j))
  exact ⟨(DFinsupp.domLCongrOfEq (fun Λ' : Y →+ ℤ ↦ IrreducibleModule R v Λ')
    (fun j ↦ (Λ j).1) _ e hwt).trans Ψ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.nonempty_tensor_equiv_dfinsupp_ratFunc
statement:
theorem nonempty_tensor_equiv_dfinsupp_ratFunc (μ ν : Dom D.extendedRootDatum) :
    Nonempty ((Π₀ b : {b // ∀ i, (crystalHW transcendental_vInf D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
            injective_algebraMap_localRing localX_mem_maximalIdeal algebraMap_localX
            exists_pow_localX_mul D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum μ).ε i b ≤
          ((ν.1 (D.extendedRootDatum.coroot i) : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ)},
        IrreducibleModule D.extendedRootDatum vInf (ν.1 +
          (crystalHW transcendental_vInf D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
            injective_algebraMap_localRing localX_mem_maximalIdeal algebraMap_localX
            exists_pow_localX_mul D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum μ).wt b)) ≃ₗ[
          QuantumGroup D.extendedRootDatum vInf]
      TensorModule (RatFunc ℚ) (IrreducibleModule D.extendedRootDatum vInf μ.1)
        (IrreducibleModule D.extendedRootDatum vInf ν.1))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_tensor_equiv_dfinsupp injective_algebraMap_localRing localX_mem_maximalIdeal
    algebraMap_localX exists_pow_localX_mul D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum μ ν

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_negLat
statement:
lemma mem_negLat {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] {L : Submodule A M} {n : ℕ} {x : M} :
    x ∈ negLat L ϖ n ↔ ϖ ^ n • x ∈ L
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.le_negLat
statement:
lemma le_negLat {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (L : Submodule A M) (n : ℕ) :
    L ≤ negLat L ϖ n
proof: := fun _ hx ↦ mem_negLat.2 (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.lattice_negLat_left
statement:
lemma lattice_negLat_left {M₁ M₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module k M₁] [Module A M₁]
    [IsScalarTower A k M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module k M₂] [Module A M₂] [IsScalarTower A k M₂]
    {L₁ : Submodule A M₁} {L₂ : Submodule A M₂} {n : ℕ} {z : TensorModule k M₁ M₂}
    (hz : z ∈ TensorModule.lattice k A (negLat L₁ ϖ n) L₂) :
    ϖ ^ n • z ∈ TensorModule.lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
    change TensorModule.mk _ _ (ϖ ^ n • (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)) ∈ _
    rw [smul_tmul']
    exact TensorModule.tmul_mem_lattice (mem_negLat.1 hx) hy
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.lattice_negLat_right
statement:
lemma lattice_negLat_right {M₁ M₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module k M₁] [Module A M₁]
    [IsScalarTower A k M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module k M₂] [Module A M₂] [IsScalarTower A k M₂]
    {L₁ : Submodule A M₁} {L₂ : Submodule A M₂} {n : ℕ} {z : TensorModule k M₁ M₂}
    (hz : z ∈ TensorModule.lattice k A L₁ (negLat L₂ ϖ n)) :
    ϖ ^ n • z ∈ TensorModule.lattice k A L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
    change TensorModule.mk _ _ (ϖ ^ n • (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)) ∈ _
    rw [← tmul_smul]
    exact TensorModule.tmul_mem_lattice hx (mem_negLat.1 hy)
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.localE_succ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy0 : y = 0
  · rw [hy0, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨ν', rfl⟩ := exists_eq_add_single hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) Λ hyw hy0
  have hyw' : y ∈ wsp Λ ν' := by
    convert hyw using 2
    rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single]
    abel
  refine hA ν'.degree ?_ Λ ν' rfl i y hy hyw'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kashiwaraF_mem_negLat
statement:
lemma kashiwaraF_mem_negLat (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) (n : ℕ) {y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1}
    (hy : y ∈ negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ n) : fK hvt hR Λ i y ∈ negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ n

:=
  mem_of_fW_mem Λ ν ((lat hvt hR A Λ).comap

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_strings_negLat
statement:
lemma exists_strings_negLat {r N : ℕ} (hA : ∀ s < r, PropA hvt hR A s) {Λ : Dom R}
    (hP : PropAN hvt hR A ϖ r N Λ) (i : I) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν.degree = r)
    {y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1} (hy : y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) (hyw : y ∈ wsp Λ ν) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ) (ζ : ℕ → IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1),
      (∀ j : ℕ, ζ j ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν + j • R.root i)) ∧
      (∀ j, E R v i • ζ j = 0) ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, ζ j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i) + j) ∧
      y = ∑ j ∈ range M, dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ i j (ζ j) ∧
      ∀ j < M, ζ j ∈ negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ζ, hζw, hζE, hζ2, -, hye⟩ :=
    exists_sum_dF_weight (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i hyw
  refine ⟨M, ζ, hζw, hζE, hζ2, hye, ?_⟩
  rcases M with _ | M
  · intro j hj; omega
  have he := hP.mem i hν hy hyw
  rw [hye, kashiwaraE_sum _ _ i hζw hζE hζ2] at he
  have hs := mem_of_sum_mem_weight (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i
    (L := negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ N) (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_negLat Λ i N hy) M _
    (fun j ↦ ζ (j + 1))
    (fun j ↦ by rw [add_assoc, ← succ_nsmul']; exact hζw (j + 1)) (fun j ↦ hζE (j + 1))
    (fun j h ↦ by
      have := hζ2 _ h
      rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self]
      push_cast at this ⊢; omega)
    (fun j y hy hyw ↦ localE_succ_negLat hA Λ hν i N (j + 1) (by omega) hy
      (by rwa [succ_nsmul', ← add_assoc]))
    (mem_negLat.2 he)
  intro j hj
  rcases j with _ | j
  · have hrest : ∑ j ∈ range M, dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ i (j + 1) (ζ (j + 1)) ∈
        negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ N := by
      refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj ↦ ?_
      rw [← kashiwaraF_pow_of_primitive _ _ i (hζE (j + 1))
        (mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i (hζw (j + 1)))]
      exact kashiwaraF_pow_mem _ _ i (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_negLat Λ i N hy) _
        (hs j (mem_range.1 hj))
    have := sub_mem (le_negLat _ N (hye ▸ hy)) hrest
    rw [sum_range_succ', IntegrableSl2.dF_zero, add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    exact this
  · exact hs j (by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.hwv_strings
statement:
lemma hwv_strings (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) :
    let η : ℕ → IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1 := fun s ↦ if s = 0 then IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1
      else 0
    (∀ j : ℕ, η j ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ.1 + j • R.root i)) ∧ (∀ j, E R v i • η j = 0) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, η j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i) + j) ∧
      (∑ j ∈ range 1, dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ i j (η j) = IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1) ∧
      (∀ j < 1, η j ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ ?_, fun j ↦ ?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_, by simp, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
  · beta_reduce
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h; simpa using IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ.1)
    · exact zero_mem _
  · beta_reduce
    split_ifs
    · exact IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i
    · exact smul_zero _
  · beta_reduce at hj
    split_ifs at hj with h
    · subst h; have := Λ.2 i; simpa using this
    · exact absurd rfl hj
  · obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
    simpa using IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_lattice hR _ Λ.2 A

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eT_smul_mem_LL
proof:
:= by
  set hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  refine mem_of_fW_tmul_mem Λ₁ Λ₂ ν ((LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂).comap
    (((ϖ ^ N) • eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i).restrictScalars A)) (fun w₁ w₂ hw ↦ ?_) hz hzw
  change ϖ ^ N • eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i _ ∈ LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂
  have hlen : w₁.length + w₂.length = r := by
    rw [← degree_wordWeight, ← degree_wordWeight, ← map_add, hw, hν]
  rcases w₁ with _ | ⟨j₁, w₁'⟩
  · 
    simp only [List.length_nil, zero_add] at hlen
    have hw₂ : LusztigF.wordWeight w₂ = ν := by simpa using hw
    obtain ⟨M, ζ, hζw, hζE, hζ2, hye, hζL⟩ := exists_strings_negLat hA hP₂ i hν
      (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂) (hw₂ ▸ fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₂ w₂)
    obtain ⟨hηw, hηE, hη2, hηs, hηL⟩ := hwv_strings (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) (A := A) Λ₁ i
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hle, -, hPe⟩ := TensorModule.exists_stable_tmul_of_strings hv'
      (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i (L₁ := lat hvt hR A Λ₁)
      (L₂ := negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ₂) ϖ N) (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ₁ i hy)
      (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_negLat Λ₂ i N hy) hϖ hϖv hηw hηE hη2 hζw hζE hζ2 hηL hζL
    rw [hηs, ← hye] at hP
    exact lattice_negLat_right (hle (hPe _ hP))
  rcases w₂ with _ | ⟨j₂, w₂'⟩
  · 
    simp only [List.length_nil, add_zero] at hlen
    have hw₁ : LusztigF.wordWeight (j₁ :: w₁') = ν := by simpa using hw
    obtain ⟨M, η, hηw, hηE, hη2, hxe, hηL⟩ := exists_strings_negLat hA hP₁ i hν
      (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A _) (hw₁ ▸ fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₁ _)
    obtain ⟨hζw, hζE, hζ2, hζs, hζL⟩ := hwv_strings (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) (A := A) Λ₂ i
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hle, -, hPe⟩ := TensorModule.exists_stable_tmul_of_strings hv'
      (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i (L₁ := negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ₁) ϖ N)
      (L₂ := lat hvt hR A Λ₂) (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_negLat Λ₁ i N hy)
      (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ₂ i hy) hϖ hϖv hηw hηE hη2 hζw hζE hζ2 hηL hζL
    rw [hζs, ← hxe] at hP
    exact lattice_negLat_left (hle (hPe _ hP))
  
  simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
  have h₁ : ∀ s ≤ (j₁ :: w₁').length, PropA hvt hR A s := fun s hs ↦ hA s (by simp at hs ⊢; omega)
  have h₂ : ∀ s ≤ (j₂ :: w₂').length, PropA hvt hR A s := fun s hs ↦ hA s (by simp at hs ⊢; omega)
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (TensorModule.kashiwaraE_tmul_mem hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₁)
    (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ₁ i hy)
    (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ₂ i hy) (localE h₁ Λ₁ (degree_wordWeight _) i)
    (localE h₂ Λ₂ (degree_wordWeight _) i) hϖ hϖv
    (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A _) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₁ _)
    (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A _) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₂ _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_rootSum_of_LL
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  refine hz0 ?_
  have hP := TensorModule.weightSetProj_singleton_mem_of (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
    (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) (isInt hvt hR Λ₂)
    (fun S _ hm ↦ weightSetProj_mem_lat hvt hR A Λ₁ S hm)
    (fun S _ hm ↦ weightSetProj_mem_lat hvt hR A Λ₂ S hm) μ ⊥
    (fun a b hab x hx hxw y hy hyw ↦ ?_) hz
  · rw [weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ hzw] at hP
    simpa using hP
  by_cases h0 : x = 0 ∨ y = 0
  · rcases h0 with h0 | h0 <;> simp [h0]
  push Not at h0
  obtain ⟨ν₁, rfl⟩ :=
    IrreducibleModule.exists_eq_sub_rootSum (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hxw h0.1
  obtain ⟨ν₂, rfl⟩ :=
    IrreducibleModule.exists_eq_sub_rootSum (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hyw h0.2
  exact absurd (by rw [← hab, R.rootSum_add]; abel) (hne (ν₁ + ν₂))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.transport
statement:
lemma transport {ν ν' : Dom R} (h : ν.1 = ν'.1) (n : ℕ) (i : I) (w : List I)
    (hmem : ϖ ^ n • eK hvt hR ν i (fW hvt hR ν w) ∈ lat hvt hR A ν) :
    ϖ ^ n • eK hvt hR ν' i (fW hvt hR ν' w) ∈ lat hvt hR A ν'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ν
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ν'
  simp only at h
  subst h
  exact hmem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorEmb_fW
statement:
lemma tensorEmb_fW (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) (w : List I) :
    tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) =
      fTw hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ w (TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₂.1))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact tensorEmb_hwv hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [fW_cons, fTw_cons, ← ih]
    exact map_kashiwaraF (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) i
      (isIntT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂) _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorProj_fTw
statement:
lemma tensorProj_fTw (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) (w : List I) :
    tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fTw hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ w (TensorModule.mk _ _
      (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k] IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₂.1))) =
      fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w
