name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorProj_eT
statement:
lemma tensorProj_eT (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) (i : I) (z : TM v Λ₁ Λ₂) :
    tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i z) =
      eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 z)
proof:
:=
  map_kashiwaraE (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isIntT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂) i
    (isInt hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) _ z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorEmb_eK
statement:
lemma tensorEmb_eK (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) (i : I) (x : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1) :
    tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i x) =
      eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 x)
proof:
:=
  map_kashiwaraE (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) i
    (isIntT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂) _ x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.step₁
statement:
theorem step₁ {n N : ℕ} (hA : ∀ s < n + 2, PropA hvt hR A s)
    (hB : ∀ s < n + 2, PropB hvt hR A ϖ s) (hC : ∀ s < n + 2, PropC hvt hR A ϖ s)
    (hF : PropF hvt hR A (n + 1)) {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} {j : I}
    (hj : ∀ i, Λ₂.1 (R.coroot i) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hP₁ : PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) (N + 1) Λ₁) (hP₂ : PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) (N + 1) Λ₂)
    (u : List I) (hu : u.length = n) (i' i : I) :
    ϖ ^ N • eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (u ++ [j, i'])) ∈
      lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  set w := u ++ [j, i']
  have hwlen : w.length = n + 2 := by simp [w, hu]
  obtain ⟨w₁, w₂, h1, h2, h3, h5, h4⟩ := fTw_fund hϖ hϖv hinj hj u i' (by rwa [hu])
    (by rwa [hu]) (by rwa [hu])
  set vv := TensorModule.mk (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁.1) (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₂.1)
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k] IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₂.1)
  set W := fTw hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ w vv
  have hvvw : vv ∈ weightSpace R v (TM v Λ₁ Λ₂) (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum 0) := by
    simpa using fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ [] []
  have hWw : W ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) := by
    simpa using fTw_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ w hvvw
  have hmw : TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) ∈
      weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) := by
    rw [← h5]; exact fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace Λ₁ Λ₂ w₁ w₂
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hz₀w, he⟩ := TensorModule.exists_smul_weight hϖ0 h4 (sub_mem hWw hmw)
  have hdeg : (LusztigF.wordWeight w).degree = n + 2 := by rw [degree_wordWeight, hwlen]
  
  have hA₁ : ∀ s ≤ w₁.length, PropA hvt hR A s := fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega)
  have hA₂ : ∀ s ≤ w₂.length, PropA hvt hR A s := fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega)
  have hm := TensorModule.kashiwaraE_tmul_mem (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
    (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ₁ i hy)
    (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ₂ i hy) (localE hA₁ Λ₁ (degree_wordWeight w₁) i)
    (localE hA₂ Λ₂ (degree_wordWeight w₂) i) hϖ hϖv
    (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A w₁) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₁ w₁)
    (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₂ w₂)
  have hz := eT_smul_mem_LL hϖ hϖv (fun s hs ↦ hA s hs) hP₁ hP₂ i hdeg hz₀ hz₀w
  have hWL : ϖ ^ N • eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W ∈ LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂ := by
    have hWe : W = TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) + ϖ • z₀ := by
      rw [← he, add_sub_cancel]
    rw [hWe, map_add, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, smul_add, smul_smul, ← pow_succ]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hm) hz
  
  have hΨ : tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (ϖ ^ N • eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W) =
      ϖ ^ N • eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) := by
    rw [← algebraMap_smul k (ϖ ^ N) (eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W), LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower,
      tensorProj_eT, tensorProj_fTw, algebraMap_smul]
  rw [← hΨ]
  by_cases h0 : ϖ ^ N • eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W = 0
  · rw [h0, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  have hew := Submodule.smul_mem (weightSpace R v (TM v Λ₁ Λ₂) _) ((algebraMap A k ϖ) ^ N)
    (kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isIntT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂) i hWw)
  rw [← map_pow, algebraMap_smul] at hew
  obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ := exists_rootSum_of_LL hWL hew h0
  have hν : LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν' + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
    refine LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR ?_
    rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]
    calc R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)
        = Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w) + R.root i) +
          R.root i := by abel
      _ = Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum ν') + R.root i := by rw [hν']
      _ = R.rootSum ν' + R.root i := by abel
  have hd' : ν'.degree = n + 1 := by
    have := hdeg; rw [hν, map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at this; omega
  exact hF Λ₁ Λ₂ ν' hd' _ hWL (hν' ▸ hew)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eT_hwv_tmul_sub
statement:
lemma eT_hwv_tmul_sub [IsLocalRing A] (hϖ : ϖ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} (i : I) {n M : ℕ} {μ : Y →+ ℤ}
    {ζ : ℕ → IrreducibleModule R v Λ₂.1}
    (hζw : ∀ j : ℕ, ζ j ∈ weightSpace R v _ (μ + j • R.root i)) (hζE : ∀ j, E R v i • ζ j = 0)
    (hζ2 : ∀ j : ℕ, ζ j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ μ (R.coroot i) + j)
    (hζL : ∀ j < M, ζ j ∈ negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ₂) ϖ n) :
    eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i (TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
        ∑ j ∈ range M, dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₂ i j (ζ j))) -
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
        eK hvt hR Λ₂ i (∑ j ∈ range M, dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₂ i j (ζ j))) ∈
      ϖ • TensorModule.lattice k A (lat hvt hR A Λ₁) (negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ₂) ϖ n)
proof:
:= by
  set hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  rcases M with _ | M
  · simp
  rw [kashiwaraE_sum hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i hζw hζE hζ2, tmul_sum, tmul_sum, map_sum, map_sum,
    map_sum]
  have hv0 : IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ∈
      (nodeSl2 R v _ hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) i).prim (Λ₁.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat :=
    ⟨by
      have := mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := i)
        (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ₁.1))
      rwa [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Λ₁.2 i)], IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i⟩
  have key : ∀ t : ℕ, t < M + 1 → eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i (TensorModule.mk _ _
      (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k] dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₂ i t (ζ t))) -
      (if t = 0 then 0 else TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
        dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₂ i (t - 1) (ζ t))) ∈
      ϖ • TensorModule.lattice k A (lat hvt hR A Λ₁) (negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ₂) ϖ n) := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases h0 : ζ t = 0
    · simp [h0]
    have hb := hζ2 t h0
    have hζp : ζ t ∈ (nodeSl2 R v _ hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i).prim
        (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * t).toNat :=
      ⟨by rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]; exact mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i (hζw t),
        hζE t⟩
    have h := TensorModule.kashiwaraE_piece_sub hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i
      (A := A) hϖ hϖv hv0 hζp (hwv_ne_zero hR hv' Λ₁.1) h0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      (s := 0) (t := t) (by omega)
    simp only [IntegrableSl2.dF_zero, Nat.zero_le, ↓reduceIte] at h
    refine TensorModule.smul_le_smul_of_le (TensorModule.pieceLattice_le_lattice hv'
      (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ₁ i hy)
      (fun _ hy ↦ kashiwaraF_mem_negLat Λ₂ i n hy)
      (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A) hv0 (hζL t ht) hζp) ϖ h
  have := Submodule.sum_mem _ fun t (ht : t ∈ range (M + 1)) ↦ key t (mem_range.1 ht)
  convert this using 1
  rw [sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [sum_range_succ']
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.step₂
statement:
theorem step₂ {n N : ℕ} (hA : ∀ s < n + 2, PropA hvt hR A s)
    (hB : ∀ s < n + 2, PropB hvt hR A ϖ s) (hC : ∀ s < n + 2, PropC hvt hR A ϖ s)
    (hE : PropE hvt hR A (n + 1)) (hF : PropF hvt hR A (n + 1)) {μ Λj : Dom R} {j : I}
    (hj : ∀ i, Λj.1 (R.coroot i) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hPμ : PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) (N + 1) μ) (hPj : PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) (N + 1) Λj)
    (u : List I) (hu : u.length = n) (i' i : I) :
    ϖ ^ N • eK hvt hR μ i (fW hvt hR μ (u ++ [j, i'])) ∈ lat hvt hR A μ
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  set hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  set w := u ++ [j, i']
  have hwlen : w.length = n + 2 := by simp [w, hu]
  have hdeg : (LusztigF.wordWeight w).degree = n + 2 := by rw [degree_wordWeight, hwlen]
  set y := fW hvt hR μ w
  have hyL : y ∈ lat hvt hR A μ := IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ μ.2 A w
  have hyw : y ∈ wsp μ (LusztigF.wordWeight w) := fW_mem_wsp hvt hR μ w
  by_cases hy0 : y ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A μ
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hy₀w, he⟩ := TensorModule.exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hy0 hyw
    rw [he, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, smul_smul, ← pow_succ]
    exact hPμ.mem i hdeg hy₀ hy₀w
  
  have h1 := step₁ hϖ hϖv hinj hA hB hC hF hj hPμ hPj u hu i' i
  have h2 := transport (ν := μ + Λj) (ν' := Λj + μ) (by simp [add_comm]) N i w h1
  
  set vv := TensorModule.mk (IrreducibleModule R v Λj.1) (IrreducibleModule R v μ.1)
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] IrreducibleModule.hwv R v μ.1)
  have hvvw : vv ∈ weightSpace R v (TM v Λj μ) (Λj.1 + μ.1 - R.rootSum 0) := by
    simpa using fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λj μ [] []
  have hWw := fTw_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λj μ w hvvw
  rw [zero_add] at hWw
  have hc : ϖ ^ N • eT hvt hR Λj μ i (fTw hvt hR Λj μ w vv) ∈ LL hvt hR A Λj μ := by
    have hΦ : tensorEmb hvt hR Λj.2 μ.2 (ϖ ^ N • eK hvt hR (Λj + μ) i (fW hvt hR (Λj + μ) w)) =
        ϖ ^ N • eT hvt hR Λj μ i (fTw hvt hR Λj μ w vv) := by
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k (ϖ ^ N), LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, tensorEmb_eK, tensorEmb_fW,
        algebraMap_smul]
    rw [← hΦ]
    by_cases h0 : ϖ ^ N • eK hvt hR (Λj + μ) i (fW hvt hR (Λj + μ) w) = 0
    · rw [h0, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    have hew := Submodule.smul_mem (weightSpace R v (IrreducibleModule R v (Λj + μ).1) _)
      ((algebraMap A k ϖ) ^ N) (kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR (Λj + μ)) i
        (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR (Λj + μ) w))
    rw [← map_pow, algebraMap_smul] at hew
    obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ := exists_eq_add_single hR hv' (Λj + μ) (j := 1)
      (by rwa [one_smul]) h0
    have hd' : ν'.degree = n + 1 := by
      have := hdeg; rw [hν', map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at this; omega
    refine hE Λj μ ν' hd' _ h2 ?_
    convert hew using 2
    rw [hν', R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]
    abel
  
  have hd := fTw_hwv_tmul hϖ hϖv hinj (Λ₁ := Λj) (Λ₂ := μ) w (by rwa [hwlen]) (by rwa [hwlen])
    (by rwa [hwlen]) hy0
  have hmw : TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] y) ∈
      weightSpace R v (TM v Λj μ) (Λj.1 + μ.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) := by
    simpa using fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λj μ [] w
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hz₀w, he⟩ := TensorModule.exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hd (sub_mem hWw hmw)
  have hz := eT_smul_mem_LL hϖ hϖv (fun s hs ↦ hA s hs) hPj hPμ i hdeg hz₀ hz₀w
  have hvy : ϖ ^ N • eT hvt hR Λj μ i (TensorModule.mk _ _
      (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] y)) ∈ LL hvt hR A Λj μ := by
    have e : TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] y) =
        fTw hvt hR Λj μ w vv - ϖ • z₀ := by rw [← he, sub_sub_cancel]
    rw [e, map_sub, smul_sub, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, smul_smul, ← pow_succ]
    exact sub_mem hc hz
  
  obtain ⟨M, ζ, hζw, hζE, hζ2, hye, hζL⟩ := exists_strings_negLat hA hPμ i hdeg hyL hyw
  have he' := eT_hwv_tmul_sub (Λ₁ := Λj) hϖ hϖv i hζw hζE hζ2 hζL
  rw [← hye] at he'
  have hstep : ϖ ^ N • TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
      eK hvt hR μ i y) ∈ LL hvt hR A Λj μ := by
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hz₁e⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 he'
    have : ϖ ^ N • (eT hvt hR Λj μ i (TensorModule.mk _ _
        (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] y)) - TensorModule.mk _ _
        (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] eK hvt hR μ i y)) ∈ LL hvt hR A Λj μ := by
      rw [← hz₁e, smul_smul, ← pow_succ]
      exact lattice_negLat_right hz₁
    rw [smul_sub] at this
    simpa using sub_mem hvy this
  
  have hS := Sh_mem hstep
  rwa [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, Sh_tmul, IrreducibleModule.form_hwv, one_smul] at hS

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.propA_zero
statement: theorem propA_zero : PropA hvt hR A 0
proof:
:= by
  intro Λ ν hν i x hx hxw
  have hν0 : ν = 0 := (Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff ν).1 hν
  subst hν0
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_smul_hwv hx hxw
  rw [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  have : eK hvt hR Λ i (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1) = 0 :=
    IntegrableSl2.eTilde_of_primitive (pow_d_ne_zero i)
      (pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i) (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i)
      (mem_nodeWt_of_mem (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ.1)))
  rw [this]
  exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.propA_one
statement: theorem propA_one : PropA hvt hR A 1
proof:
:= by
  set hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  intro Λ ν hν i x hx hxw
  refine mem_of_fW_mem Λ ν ((lat hvt hR A Λ).comap ((eK hvt hR Λ i).restrictScalars A))
    (fun w hw ↦ ?_) hx hxw
  change eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w) ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ
  have hlen : w.length = 1 := by rw [← degree_wordWeight, hw, hν]
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, w = [j] := by
    rcases w with _ | ⟨j, _ | ⟨_, _⟩⟩ <;> simp at hlen; exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have hvn := mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := j)
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ.1))
  have hf : fW hvt hR Λ [j] =
      dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ j 1 (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1) := by
    have := kashiwaraF_dF (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hvn (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv j) 0
    rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_zero] at this
    rw [fW_cons, fW_nil]
    exact this
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    rw [hf]
    by_cases hp : (0 : ℤ) < Λ.1 (R.coroot i)
    · have := IntegrableSl2.eTilde_dF_succ (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i)
        (V := nodeSl2 R v _ hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i) (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i) hvn
        (j := 0) (by simpa using hp)
      change eK hvt hR Λ i _ = _ at this
      rw [this, IntegrableSl2.dF_zero]
      exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_lattice hR _ Λ.2 A
    · rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) hvn
        (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i) (by push_cast; omega), map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
  · have hE : E R v i • fW hvt hR Λ [j] = 0 := by
      rw [hf, IntegrableSl2.dF_apply, smul_comm, pow_one]
      change _ • (E R v i • F R v j • IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1) = 0
      have h := E_mul_F_sub R v i j
      simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte, sub_eq_zero] at h
      rw [← mul_smul, h, mul_smul, IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    have := IntegrableSl2.eTilde_of_primitive (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i)
      (V := nodeSl2 R v _ hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i) hE
      (mem_nodeWt_of_mem (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ [j]))
    change eK hvt hR Λ i _ = _ at this
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_smul_mem_lat
statement:
lemma exists_smul_mem_lat (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A),
      algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a) (Λ : Dom R)
    (x : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1) : ∃ m : ℕ, ϖ ^ m • x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span k (lat hvt hR A Λ : Set (IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1)) := by
    rw [IrreducibleModule.span_lattice]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact ⟨0, by simpa using hx⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨m₁, h₁⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨m₂, h₂⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨m₁ + m₂, ?_⟩
    rw [smul_add, pow_add]
    refine add_mem ?_ ?_
    · rw [mul_comm, mul_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h₁
    · rw [mul_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h₂
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨m', b, hb⟩ := hk c
    refine ⟨m' + m, ?_⟩
    have : ϖ ^ (m' + m) • c • a = b • (ϖ ^ m • a) := by
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k (ϖ ^ (m' + m)), ← algebraMap_smul k b, ← algebraMap_smul k (ϖ ^ m),
        smul_smul, smul_smul, ← hb, pow_add, map_mul]
      ring_nf
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.PropAN.mono
statement:
lemma PropAN.mono {r N N' : ℕ} {Λ : Dom R} (h : PropAN hvt hR A ϖ r N Λ) (hNN : N ≤ N') :
    PropAN hvt hR A ϖ r N' Λ
proof:
:= fun i w hw ↦ by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hNN
  rw [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (h i w hw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_propAN
statement:
lemma exists_propAN [Finite I] (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A),
      algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a) (r : ℕ) (Λ : Dom R) :
    ∃ N, PropAN hvt hR A ϖ r N Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hfin := List.finite_length_eq I r
  choose m hm using fun (p : I × List I) ↦
    exists_smul_mem_lat (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hk Λ (eK hvt hR Λ p.1 (fW hvt hR Λ p.2))
  refine ⟨(Finset.univ ×ˢ hfin.toFinset).sup m, fun i w hw ↦ ?_⟩
  have hle : m (i, w) ≤ (Finset.univ ×ˢ hfin.toFinset).sup m :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := m) (by simp [hw])
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
  rw [hd, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hm (i, w))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.propA_add_two
statement:
theorem propA_add_two [Finite I] [IsLocalRing A] (hϖ : ϖ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A k))
    (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a)
    (hfund : ∀ j : I, ∃ Λ : Dom R, ∀ i, Λ.1 (R.coroot i) = if i = j then 1 else 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hA : ∀ s < n + 2, PropA hvt hR A s) (hB : ∀ s < n + 2, PropB hvt hR A ϖ s)
    (hC : ∀ s < n + 2, PropC hvt hR A ϖ s) (hE : PropE hvt hR A (n + 1))
    (hF : PropF hvt hR A (n + 1)) : PropA hvt hR A (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite I
  choose Λf hΛf using hfund
  intro μ ν hν i x hx hxw
  let Q : ℕ → Prop := fun N ↦ PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) N μ ∧
    ∀ j, PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) N (Λf j)
  have hstep : ∀ N, Q (N + 1) → Q N := by
    intro N hQ
    have key : ∀ ρ : Dom R, PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) (N + 1) ρ →
        PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) N ρ := by
      intro ρ hρ i w hw
      obtain ⟨u, a, b, rfl⟩ : ∃ u a b, w = u ++ [a, b] := by
        have hl : (w.drop n).length = 2 := by simp; omega
        obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ : ∃ a b, w.drop n = [a, b] := by
          match w.drop n, hl with
          | [a, b], _ => exact ⟨a, b, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨w.take n, a, b, by rw [← hab, List.take_append_drop]⟩
      exact step₂ hϖ hϖv hinj hA hB hC hE hF (hΛf a) hρ (hQ.2 a) u
        (by simp at hw; omega) b i
    exact ⟨key μ hQ.1, fun j ↦ key _ (hQ.2 j)⟩
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_propAN (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hk (n + 2) μ
  choose Nf hNf using fun j ↦ exists_propAN (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) (ϖ := ϖ) hk (n + 2) (Λf j)
  set N₁ := max N₀ (Finset.univ.sup Nf)
  have hQ₁ : Q N₁ := ⟨hN₀.mono (le_max_left _ _), fun j ↦ (hNf j).mono
    ((Finset.le_sup (f := Nf) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans (le_max_right _ _))⟩
  have hQ0 : Q 0 := by
    have : ∀ m N, N + m = N₁ → Q N := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro N h; simpa [← h] using hQ₁
      | succ m ih => intro N h; exact hstep N (ih (N + 1) (by omega))
    exact this N₁ 0 (by simp)
  simpa using hQ0.1.mem i hν hx hxw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.linearIndependent_of_mk
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_of_mk [IsDomain A] [IsPrincipalIdealRing A] [Module.IsTorsionFree A M]
    (hB : IsCrystalBase hL c B) (hc : ¬IsUnit c) {ι : Type*} (y : ι → M) (hy : ∀ b, y b ∈ L)
    (f : ι → B) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hyf : ∀ b, Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨y b, hy b⟩ = (f b).1) : LinearIndependent A y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Nontrivial (A ⧸ Ideal.span {c}) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by rwa [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top])
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg i hi
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal (Ideal.span (g '' ↑s))).principal
  have hgd : ∀ j ∈ s, g j ∈ Ideal.span {d} := fun j hj ↦ by
    rw [← Ideal.submodule_span_eq, ← hd]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem g hj)
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · simpa [hd0] using hgd i hi
  exfalso
  choose! g' hg' using fun j hj ↦ Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hgd j hj)
  have h0 : ∑ j ∈ s, g' j • y j = 0 := by
    have : d • ∑ j ∈ s, g' j • y j = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.smul_sum, ← hg]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
      rw [smul_smul, mul_comm, hg' j hj]
    exact ((Module.isTorsionFree_iff_smul_eq_zero.mp inferInstance) d _ this).resolve_left hd0
  have h1 : ∑ j ∈ s, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c}) (g' j) •
      ((f j : B) : L ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L)) = 0 := by
    have hsum : (∑ j ∈ s, g' j • (⟨y j, hy j⟩ : L)) = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext (by simpa [Submodule.coe_sum] using h0)
    have := congrArg (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L).mkQ hsum
    rw [map_sum, map_zero] at this
    rw [← this]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_smul, ← hyf j]
    rfl
  have hc' := linearIndependent_iff'.mp (hB.linearIndependent.comp f hf) s _ h1
  have hd' : d ∈ Ideal.span {c * d} := by
    have hle : Ideal.span (g '' ↑s) ≤ Ideal.span {c * d} := by
      refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
      rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp
        (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp (hc' j hj))
      rw [← hg' j hj, ← ht]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨t, by ring⟩
    refine hle ?_
    rw [hd]
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self d
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hd'
  have : t * c = 1 := by
    have h2 : (t * c - 1) * d = 0 := by linear_combination ht
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_right hd0)
  exact hc (IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one_right t this)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.exists_sub_sum_mem
statement:
lemma exists_sub_sum_mem (hB : IsCrystalBase hL c B) (x : B → L)
    (hxb : ∀ b, Submodule.Quotient.mk (x b) = b.1) (z : L) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) (g : Fin n → B), (z : M) - ∑ i, a i • (x (g i) : M) ∈ c • L
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (Submodule.Quotient.mk z : L ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L)) ∈
      Submodule.span (A ⧸ Ideal.span {c}) B := hB.span_eq_top ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨n, f, g, hfg⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_set'.mp hz
  choose a ha using fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (f i)
  refine ⟨n, a, g, ?_⟩
  have e : (Submodule.Quotient.mk z : L ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (∑ i, a i • x (g i)) := by
    rw [← hfg]
    have e' : ∀ i, f i • ((g i : B) : L ⧸ (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L)) =
        (Ideal.span {c} • ⊤ : Submodule A L).mkQ (a i • x (g i)) := fun i ↦ by
      rw [← ha i, ← hxb (g i)]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ e' i, ← map_sum]
    rfl
  have := (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff c _ _).mp e
  simpa [Submodule.coe_sum] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsCrystalBase.eq_of_subset_of_span_eq_top
statement:
lemma eq_of_subset_of_span_eq_top {R' N : Type*} [Ring R'] [Nontrivial R'] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R' N] {B₁ B₂ : Set N} (hsub : B₁ ⊆ B₂) (hspan : Submodule.span R' B₁ = ⊤)
    (hli : LinearIndependent R' (Subtype.val : B₂ → N)) : B₁ = B₂
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm hsub fun b hb ↦ ?_
  by_contra hb'
  have hspan' : b ∈ Submodule.span R' (Subtype.val '' {x : B₂ | x ≠ ⟨b, hb⟩}) := by
    have h1 : b ∈ Submodule.span R' B₁ := by rw [hspan]; trivial
    refine Submodule.span_mono (fun x hx ↦ ?_) h1
    refine ⟨⟨x, hsub hx⟩, fun h ↦ hb' ?_, rfl⟩
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp only at this
    rw [← this]; exact hx
  exact hli.notMem_span_image (s := {x : B₂ | x ≠ ⟨b, hb⟩}) (x := ⟨b, hb⟩) (fun h ↦ h rfl) hspan'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.isFractionRing_of
statement:
lemma isFractionRing_of [IsDomain A] (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A k))
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹)
    (hk : ∀ c : k, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A k a) :
    IsFractionRing A k
proof:
:= by
  have : FaithfulSMul A k := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective A k).2 hinj
  refine IsFractionRing.of_field A k fun c ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, a, ha⟩ := hk c
  have h0 : algebraMap A k (ϖ ^ m) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_pow, hϖv]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v))
  exact ⟨a, ϖ ^ m, by rw [← ha, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h0]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.linearIndependent_dfinsuppSingle
proof:
:= by
  refine linearIndependent_iff'.2 fun t c hsum j hj ↦ ?_
  have h := congrArg (fun f : Π₀ i, M i ↦ f j.1) hsum
  simp only [DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply, DFinsupp.zero_apply] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun i _ hij ↦ by
      rw [DFinsupp.smul_apply, DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne (fun h ↦ hij (Subtype.ext h).symm),
        smul_zero])
    (fun hj' ↦ absurd hj hj'), DFinsupp.smul_apply, DFinsupp.single_eq_same] at h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right (hw _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_linearEquiv_of_basis
statement:
lemma exists_linearEquiv_of_basis {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module k V] {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*}
    {f₁ : ι₁ → V} {f₂ : ι₂ → V} (h₁ : LinearIndependent k f₁)
    (hs₁ : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range f₁)) (h₂ : LinearIndependent k f₂)
    (hs₂ : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range f₂)) :
    ∃ (e : ι₁ ≃ ι₂) (g : V ≃ₗ[k] V), ∀ j, g (f₁ j) = f₂ (e j)
proof:
:= by
  set b₁ := Module.Basis.mk h₁ hs₁
  set b₂ := Module.Basis.mk h₂ hs₂
  refine ⟨b₁.indexEquiv b₂, b₁.equiv b₂ (b₁.indexEquiv b₂), fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← Module.Basis.mk_apply h₁ hs₁ j, ← Module.Basis.mk_apply h₂ hs₂, Module.Basis.equiv_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.top_le_span_range_of_le
statement:
lemma top_le_span_range_of_le {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N] (p : Submodule k N)
    {ι : Type*} (f : ι → p) (h : p ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun i ↦ (f i : N))) :
    ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  intro y _
  have hmap : (Submodule.span k (Set.range f)).map p.subtype =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range fun i ↦ (f i : N)) := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]; rfl
  have hy : (y : N) ∈ (Submodule.span k (Set.range f)).map p.subtype := by
    rw [hmap]; exact h y.2
  obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hy
  rwa [Subtype.ext hyy] at hy'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.map_mem_smul_of_mem'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hm
  rw [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (hf x hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_add_root
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_add_root {j : J} (hj : j ∈ S) (i : I)
    {y : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hy : y ∈ weightSpace R v _ ((Λ j₀).1 + R.root i)) :
    y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hy0
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ :=
    IrreducibleModule.exists_eq_sub_rootSum (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hy hy0
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hν
  have h := hmax j hj (ν + Finsupp.single i 1) (by
    rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul, ← hν]; abel)
  simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun h i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_of_ne
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_of_ne {j : J} (hj : j ∈ S) (hne : (Λ j).1 ≠ (Λ j₀).1)
    {y : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hy : y ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ j₀).1) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hy0
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ :=
    IrreducibleModule.exists_eq_sub_rootSum (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) hy hy0
  have h := hmax j hj ν (by rw [hν]; abel)
  rw [h, R.rootSum_zero, sub_zero] at hν
  exact hne hν.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_add_root
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [projDS_apply, DFinsupp.zero_apply]
  split_ifs with hj
  · exact eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_add_root (hvt := hvt) hmax hj i
      (map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lapply (R := QuantumGroup R v) j) hx)
  · rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_hwSpan_of_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← DFinsupp.sum_single (f := x)]
  refine Submodule.dfinsuppSum_mem _ _ _ fun j _ ↦ ?_
  have hxj : x j ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ j₀).1 :=
    map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lapply (R := QuantumGroup R v) j) hx
  by_cases hj : j ∈ S
  · by_cases hje : (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_eq_smul_hwv_of_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) (Λ j)
        (x := x j) (by rw [← hje] at hxj; exact hxj)
      rw [hc, DFinsupp.single_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (single_hwv_mem_hwSpan (hTS j hj hje))
    · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_of_ne (hvt := hvt) hmax hj hje hxj, DFinsupp.single_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
  · rw [hxS j hj, DFinsupp.single_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.single_hwv_mem_dsSum
statement:
lemma single_hwv_mem_dsSum [DecidableEq J] (j : J) :
    DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1) ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_dsSum Λ).2 fun l ↦ ?_
  by_cases hl : l = j
  · subst hl
    rw [DFinsupp.single_eq_same]
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_lattice hR _ (Λ l).2 A
  · rw [DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne hl]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_hwSpan_equiv
statement:
lemma exists_hwSpan_equiv [DecidableEq J] {T : Finset J} {ι : Type*}
    {u : ι → Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hu : ∀ b, u b ∈ hwSpan v Λ T)
    (hli : LinearIndependent k u) (hsp : ∀ y ∈ hwSpan v Λ T, y ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range u)) :
    ∃ (e : T ≃ ι) (g : hwSpan v Λ T ≃ₗ[k] hwSpan v Λ T), (∀ (j : J) (hj : j ∈ T),
      (g ⟨_, single_hwv_mem_hwSpan hj⟩ : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) = u (e ⟨j, hj⟩)) ∧
      ∀ b, (g.symm ⟨u b, hu b⟩ : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) =
        DFinsupp.single (e.symm b : J) (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ (e.symm b : J)).1)
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  let u' : ι → hwSpan v Λ T := fun b ↦ ⟨u b, hu b⟩
  have hli' : LinearIndependent k u' := LinearIndependent.of_comp (hwSpan v Λ T).subtype hli
  have hsp' : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range u') :=
    top_le_span_range_of_le _ u' fun y hy ↦ hsp y hy
  have hliβ : LinearIndependent k (hwFamily v Λ T) :=
    LinearIndependent.of_comp (hwSpan v Λ T).subtype
      (linearIndependent_dfinsuppSingle (fun j ↦ IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)
        (fun j ↦ hwv_ne_zero hR hv' _) (T : Set J))
  have hspβ : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span k (Set.range (hwFamily v Λ T)) := by
    refine top_le_span_range_of_le _ (hwFamily v Λ T) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e, g, hg⟩ := exists_linearEquiv_of_basis hliβ hspβ hli' hsp'
  refine ⟨e, g, fun j hj ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (hg ⟨j, hj⟩), fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := hg (e.symm b)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (g.symm_apply_eq.2 h.symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_mem_mk_mem
statement:
lemma exists_mem_mk_mem {L : Submodule A (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1)} {B : Set (QDS L ϖ)}
    {x y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (h : x = y) (hy : y ∈ L)
    (hB : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨y, hy⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B) :
    ∃ hx : x ∈ L, (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨x, hx⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact ⟨hy, hB⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_notMem_mem
statement:
lemma projDS_notMem_mem {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : x ∈ L) :
    projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  have h : projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x = x - projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x :=
    eq_sub_of_add_eq' (projDS_add_projDS_not Λ (· ∈ S) x)
  rw [h]
  exact sub_mem hx (hPS x hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_smul_iff_mem_smul_dsSum
statement:
lemma mem_smul_iff_mem_smul_dsSum {y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1}
    (hy : ∀ j ∈ S, y j = 0) : y ∈ ϖ • L ↔ y ∈ ϖ • dsSum hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hyP : projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) y = y := by
    ext j
    rw [projDS_apply]
    by_cases h : j ∈ S <;> simp [h, hy]
  have hoffP : ∀ z : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, ∀ j ∈ S,
      projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) z j = 0 := fun z j hj ↦ by
    rw [projDS_apply]
    simp [hj]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← hyP]
    exact map_mem_smul_of_mem' (f := (projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S)).restrictScalars k)
      (fun m hm ↦ (hoff _ (hoffP m)).1 (projDS_notMem_mem hPS hm)) h
  · intro h
    rw [← hyP]
    refine map_mem_smul_of_mem' (f := (projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S)).restrictScalars k)
      (fun m hm ↦ (hoff _ (hoffP m)).2 ((mem_dsSum Λ).2 fun j ↦ ?_)) h
    rw [projDS_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact zero_mem _
    · exact (mem_dsSum Λ).1 hm j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_mem_smul_of_eDS_notMem
statement:
lemma projDS_mem_smul_of_eDS_notMem {j₀ : J}
    (hmax : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 + R.rootSum ν → ν = 0)
    (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : x ∈ L)
    (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ j₀).1)
    (hxB : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨x, hx⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B) {i : I}
    (hi : eDS hvt hR Λ i x ∉ ϖ • L) :
    projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x ∈ ϖ • L
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have he : hL.eQ ϖ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨eDS hvt hR Λ i x, hL.kashiwaraE_mem i x hx⟩ := rfl
  have hne : hL.eQ ϖ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he]
    exact fun h ↦ hi ((IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff ϖ _).1 h)
  have hb' := (hB.eQ_mem i _ hxB).resolve_right hne
  have hf := (hB.fQ_eq_iff i _ hb' _ hxB).2 rfl
  rw [he] at hf
  have hsub : fDS hvt hR Λ i (eDS hvt hR Λ i x) - x ∈ ϖ • L :=
    (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff ϖ ⟨_, hL.kashiwaraF_mem i _ (hL.kashiwaraE_mem i x hx)⟩
      ⟨x, hx⟩).1 hf
  have h0 : projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (fDS hvt hR Λ i (eDS hvt hR Λ i x)) = 0 := by
    have h := projDS_eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_add_root (hvt := hvt) hmax i
      (kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) i hxw)
    rw [← fDS_projDS]
    erw [h]
    exact map_zero _
  have := map_mem_smul_of_mem' (f := (projDS Λ (· ∈ S)).restrictScalars k) hPS hsub
  rwa [map_sub, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, h0, zero_sub,
    neg_mem_iff] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_notMem_mem_smul_of_eDS_mem
statement:
lemma projDS_notMem_mem_smul_of_eDS_mem {μ : Y →+ ℤ} (hne : ∀ j ∉ S, (Λ j).1 ≠ μ)
    {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : x ∈ L) (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v _ μ)
    (he : ∀ i, eDS hvt hR Λ i x ∈ ϖ • L) : projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x ∈ ϖ • L
proof:
:= by
  set y := projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x with hy
  have hyoff : ∀ j ∈ S, y j = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by
    rw [hy, projDS_apply]
    simp [hj]
  have hyL : y ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ := (hoff y hyoff).1 (projDS_notMem_mem hPS hx)
  have hyw : y ∈ weightSpace R v _ μ := map_mem_weightSpace (projDS Λ _) hxw
  have hey : ∀ i, eDS hvt hR Λ i y ∈ ϖ • dsSum hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro i
    have hoff' : ∀ j ∈ S, eDS hvt hR Λ i y j = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by
      rw [eDS_apply, hyoff j hj, map_zero]
    refine (mem_smul_iff_mem_smul_dsSum hPS hoff hoff').1 ?_
    rw [hy, eDS_projDS]
    exact map_mem_smul_of_mem' (f := (projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S)).restrictScalars k)
      (fun m hm ↦ projDS_notMem_mem hPS hm) (he i)
  refine (mem_smul_iff_mem_smul_dsSum hPS hoff hyoff).2 ((mem_smul_dsSum Λ).2 fun j ↦ ?_)
  by_cases hj : j ∈ S
  · rw [hyoff j hj]
    exact zero_mem _
  · exact mem_smul_lat_of_eK_of_ne hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ j) (hne j hj).symm
      ((mem_dsSum Λ).1 hyL j)
      (map_mem_weightSpace (DFinsupp.lapply (R := QuantumGroup R v) j) hyw)
      fun i ↦ eDS_apply Λ i y j ▸ (mem_smul_dsSum Λ).1 (hey i) j

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.projDS_mem_smul_or
statement:
lemma projDS_mem_smul_or {j₀ : J}
    (hmax : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 + R.rootSum ν → ν = 0)
    (hne : ∀ j ∉ S, (Λ j).1 ≠ (Λ j₀).1) (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B)
    {x : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1} (hx : x ∈ L)
    (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ j₀).1)
    (hxB : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨x, hx⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B) :
    projDS Λ (· ∈ S) x ∈ ϖ • L ∨ projDS Λ (fun j ↦ j ∉ S) x ∈ ϖ • L
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ i, eDS hvt hR Λ i x ∈ ϖ • L
  · exact Or.inr (projDS_notMem_mem_smul_of_eDS_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hPS hoff hne hx hxw h)
  · push Not at h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    exact Or.inl (projDS_mem_smul_of_eDS_notMem hPS hmax hB hx hxw hxB hi)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_normalize_of_family
statement:
lemma exists_normalize_of_family {μ : Y →+ ℤ} {T : Finset J} (hT : ∀ j ∈ T, (Λ j).1 = μ)
    {ι : Type*} (u : ι → Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (hu_mem : ∀ b, u b ∈ L)
    (hu_hw : ∀ b, u b ∈ hwSpan v Λ T)
    (hu_B : ∀ b, (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨u b, hu_mem b⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B)
    (hlik : LinearIndependent k u)
    (hspank : ∀ y ∈ hwSpan v Λ T, y ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range u))
    (hW : ∀ y ∈ L, y ∈ hwSpan v Λ T → y ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range u)) :
    ∃ g : hwSpan v Λ T ≃ₗ[k] hwSpan v Λ T,
      (∀ j ∈ T, ∃ h : autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g
          (DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)) ∈ L,
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, h⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ hwSpan v Λ T → (autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g).symm x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  have key := exists_hwSpan_equiv (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) (Λ := Λ) (T := T) (ι := ι) (u := u)
    hu_hw hlik hspank
  refine key.elim fun e he ↦ he.elim fun g hg ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨hg, hgs⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨g, fun j hj ↦ ?_, fun y hyL hyT ↦ ?_⟩
  · have heq : autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g (DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)) =
        u (e ⟨j, hj⟩) := by
      rw [autEquiv_apply, autMap_single_hwv hT _ hj]
      exact hg j hj
    exact exists_mem_mk_mem (L := L) (B := B) heq (hu_mem _) (hu_B _)
  · let φ := ((autMap hvt hR Λ hT g.symm.toLinearMap).restrictScalars k).restrictScalars A
    have hle : Submodule.span A (Set.range u) ≤ (dsSum hvt hR A Λ).comap φ := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
      change autMap hvt hR Λ hT g.symm.toLinearMap (u b) ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ
      rw [autMap_eq hT _ (hu_hw b)]
      change (g.symm ⟨u b, hu_hw b⟩ : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ∈ _
      rw [hgs b]
      exact single_hwv_mem_dsSum Λ _
    rw [autEquiv_symm_apply]
    exact hle (hW y hyL hyT)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.le_span_of_maximal
statement:
lemma le_span_of_maximal {j₀ : J}
    [FiniteDimensional k (weightSpace R v (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (Λ j₀).1)]
    (hmax : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 + R.rootSum ν → ν = 0)
    (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) {T : Finset J}
    (hT : ∀ j ∈ T, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1) (hTS : ∀ j ∈ S, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 → j ∈ T)
    (hTsub : ∀ j ∈ T, j ∈ S) (x : B → L)
    (hxw : ∀ b, (x b : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ∈ weightSpace R v _ (hB.wt b))
    (hxb : ∀ b, Submodule.Quotient.mk (x b) = b.1) :
    L ⊓ (hwSpan v Λ T).restrictScalars A ≤ Submodule.span A (Set.range fun
      b : {b : B // hB.wt b = (Λ j₀).1 ∧ projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b).1 ∉ ϖ • L} ↦
        projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b.1).1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have : IsFractionRing A k := isFractionRing_of hinj hϖv hk
  have hS : ∀ y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, ∀ j, j ∉ S →
      projDS Λ (· ∈ S) y j = 0 := fun y j hj ↦ by rw [projDS_apply]; simp [hj]
  have hhw : ∀ y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1,
      y ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ j₀).1 → projDS Λ (· ∈ S) y ∈ hwSpan v Λ T := fun y hy ↦
    mem_hwSpan_of_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hmax hTS
      (map_mem_weightSpace (projDS Λ (· ∈ S)) hy) (hS y)
  let ι := {b : B // hB.wt b = (Λ j₀).1 ∧ projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b).1 ∉ ϖ • L}
  let u : ι → Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1 := fun b ↦ projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b.1).1
  have hu_hw : ∀ b, u b ∈ hwSpan v Λ T := fun b ↦ hhw _ (by have := hxw b.1; rwa [b.2.1] at this)
  set W : Submodule A (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) :=
    L ⊓ (hwSpan v Λ T).restrictScalars A with hW
  have hsmulW : ∀ z ∈ ϖ • L, z ∈ hwSpan v Λ T → z ∈ (Ideal.span {ϖ} : Ideal A) • W := by
    intro z hz hzT
    obtain ⟨z', hz', rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hz
    have hz'T : z' ∈ hwSpan v Λ T := by
      have : z' = v • (ϖ • z') := by
        rw [← algebraMap_smul k ϖ z', hϖv, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne v), one_smul]
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ v hzT
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self ϖ) ⟨hz', hz'T⟩
  let P : Module.End k (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) :=
    (projDS Λ (· ∈ S)).restrictScalars k ∘ₗ weightSetProj hv' (isIntDS hvt hR Λ) {(Λ j₀).1}
  have hPL : ∀ m ∈ L, P m ∈ L := fun m hm ↦ hPS _ (hL.weightSetProj_mem _ m hm)
  have hPx : ∀ b : B, P (x b) = if hB.wt b = (Λ j₀).1 then projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b).1 else 0 :=
    fun b ↦ by
      simp only [P, LinearMap.comp_apply, weightSetProj_of_mem hv' _ _ (hxw b),
        Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      split_ifs <;> simp
  have hW_le : W ≤ Submodule.span A (Set.range u) := by
    have hfg : W.FG := Submodule.FG.of_le (hL.fg_latticeWeightSpace (Λ j₀).1)
      fun w hw ↦ ⟨hw.1, mem_weightSpace_of_mem_hwSpan hT hw.2⟩
    refine Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot hfg
      (I := Ideal.span {ϖ}) ?_ fun w hw ↦ ?_
    · rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top, Ideal.span_le,
        Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hϖ
    obtain ⟨n, a, g, hsum⟩ := hB.exists_sub_sum_mem x hxb ⟨w, hw.1⟩
    let d : B → Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1 := fun b ↦
      if h : hB.wt b = (Λ j₀).1 ∧ projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b).1 ∉ ϖ • L then u ⟨b, h⟩ else 0
    have hd : ∀ b, d b ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range u) := fun b ↦ by
      simp only [d]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
      · exact zero_mem _
    have hdhw : ∀ b, d b ∈ hwSpan v Λ T := fun b ↦ by
      simp only [d]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hu_hw _
      · exact zero_mem _
    have he : ∀ b, P (x b) - d b ∈ ϖ • L := fun b ↦ by
      rw [hPx]
      simp only [d]
      by_cases h1 : hB.wt b = (Λ j₀).1
      · by_cases h2 : projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b).1 ∈ ϖ • L
        · rw [ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true h1),
            dite_eq_right_of_eq_false (eq_false fun h ↦ h.2 h2), sub_zero]
          exact h2
        · rw [ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true h1), dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true ⟨h1, h2⟩),
            sub_self]
          exact zero_mem _
      · rw [ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (eq_false h1),
          dite_eq_right_of_eq_false (eq_false fun h ↦ h1 h.1), sub_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
    have hPw : P w = w := by
      simp only [P, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        weightSetProj_of_mem hv' _ _ (mem_weightSpace_of_mem_hwSpan hT hw.2),
        Set.mem_singleton_iff, ↓reduceIte]
      exact projDS_eq_self_of_mem_hwSpan _ (fun j hj ↦ hTsub j hj) hw.2
    have h1 := map_mem_smul_of_mem' (f := P) hPL hsum
    rw [map_sub, map_sum, hPw] at h1
    simp only [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower] at h1
    set z := w - ∑ i, a i • d (g i) with hz
    have hzL : z ∈ ϖ • L := by
      have : z = (w - ∑ i, a i • P (x (g i))) + ∑ i, a i • (P (x (g i)) - d (g i)) := by
        rw [hz]; simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; abel
      rw [this]
      exact add_mem h1 (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (he _))
    have hzT : z ∈ hwSpan v Λ T :=
      sub_mem hw.2 (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (hdhw _))
    refine Submodule.mem_sup.2 ⟨∑ i, a i • d (g i),
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hd _), z, hsmulW z hzL hzT, ?_⟩
    rw [hz]; abel
  exact hW_le

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_normalize
statement:
theorem exists_normalize {j₀ : J}
    [FiniteDimensional k (weightSpace R v (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) (Λ j₀).1)]
    (hmax : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 + R.rootSum ν → ν = 0)
    (hne : ∀ j ∉ S, (Λ j).1 ≠ (Λ j₀).1) (hB : IsCrystalBase hL ϖ B) {T : Finset J}
    (hT : ∀ j ∈ T, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1) (hTS : ∀ j ∈ S, (Λ j).1 = (Λ j₀).1 → j ∈ T)
    (hTsub : ∀ j ∈ T, j ∈ S) :
    ∃ g : hwSpan v Λ T ≃ₗ[k] hwSpan v Λ T,
      (∀ j ∈ T, ∃ h : autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g
          (DFinsupp.single j (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v (Λ j).1)) ∈ L,
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨_, h⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ hwSpan v Λ T → (autEquiv hvt hR Λ hT g).symm x ∈ dsSum hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hc : ¬IsUnit ϖ := not_isUnit_ϖ hϖ
  have : FaithfulSMul A k := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective A k).2 hinj
  have : IsFractionRing A k := isFractionRing_of hinj hϖv hk
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree A (Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) :=
    Module.IsTorsionFree.trans_faithfulSMul A k _
  choose x hxw hxb using hB.exists_mk_eq
  
  have hS : ∀ y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1, ∀ j, j ∉ S →
      projDS Λ (· ∈ S) y j = 0 := fun y j hj ↦ by rw [projDS_apply]; simp [hj]
  have hhw : ∀ y : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1,
      y ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ j₀).1 → projDS Λ (· ∈ S) y ∈ hwSpan v Λ T := fun y hy ↦
    mem_hwSpan_of_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hmax hTS
      (map_mem_weightSpace (projDS Λ (· ∈ S)) hy) (hS y)
  
  let ι := {b : B // hB.wt b = (Λ j₀).1 ∧ projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b).1 ∉ ϖ • L}
  let u : ι → Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1 := fun b ↦ projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b.1).1
  have hu_mem : ∀ b, u b ∈ L := fun b ↦ hPS _ (x b.1).2
  have hxw' : ∀ b : ι, ((x b.1).1 : Π₀ j, IrreducibleModule R v (Λ j).1) ∈
      weightSpace R v _ (Λ j₀).1 := fun b ↦ by have := hxw b.1; rwa [b.2.1] at this
  have hu_hw : ∀ b, u b ∈ hwSpan v Λ T := fun b ↦ hhw _ (hxw' b)
  have hu_mk : ∀ b, (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨u b, hu_mem b⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) = b.1.1 := by
    intro b
    have hxB : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨(x b.1).1, (x b.1).2⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B := by
      rw [Subtype.coe_eta, hxb]; exact b.1.2
    have h := (projDS_mem_smul_or hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hPS hoff hmax hne hB (x b.1).2
      (hxw' b) hxB).resolve_left b.2.2
    rw [← hxb b.1]
    refine (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff ϖ _ _).2 ?_
    have h2 := projDS_add_projDS_not Λ (· ∈ S) (x b.1).1
    have h3 : u b - (x b.1).1 = -projDS Λ (fun j ↦ ¬j ∈ S) (x b.1).1 := by
      calc u b - (x b.1).1 = u b - (projDS Λ (· ∈ S) (x b.1).1 +
            projDS Λ (fun j ↦ ¬j ∈ S) (x b.1).1) := by rw [h2]
        _ = _ := by simp only [u]; abel
    rw [h3]
    exact neg_mem h
  have hliA : LinearIndependent A u :=
    hB.linearIndependent_of_mk hc u hu_mem (fun b ↦ b.1) Subtype.val_injective hu_mk
  have hlik : LinearIndependent k u := (LinearIndependent.iff_fractionRing A k).1 hliA
  
  have hW_le := le_span_of_maximal (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hPS hmax hB hT hTS hTsub
    x hxw hxb
  have hspank : ∀ y ∈ hwSpan v Λ T, y ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range u) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hay⟩ := exists_smul_mem_of_span_eq_top hL.span_eq_top y
    have h2 : a • y ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range u) :=
      Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars A k _
        (hW_le ⟨hay, Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ a hy⟩)
    have ha' : algebraMap A k a ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).2 ha
    have : y = (algebraMap A k a)⁻¹ • (a • y) := by
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k a y, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha', one_smul]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2
  have hu_B : ∀ b, (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨u b, hu_mem b⟩ : L) : QDS L ϖ) ∈ B := fun b ↦
    (congrArg (· ∈ B) (hu_mk b)).mpr b.1.2
  have hWu : ∀ y ∈ L, y ∈ hwSpan v Λ T → y ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range u) :=
    fun y hyL hyT ↦ hW_le ⟨hyL, hyT⟩
  exact exists_normalize_of_family hT u hu_mem hu_hw hu_B hlik hspank hWu

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kEs_kFs
statement: lemma kEs_kFs (i : I) (u : Um D v) : kEs hvt i (kFs (D := D) hvt i u) = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [kEs_apply, kFs_apply, starU_starU, kE_kF, starU_starU]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.rmulF_eq_kFs_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [rmulF_apply, ← kF_pow_eq_df (hvt := hvt) i he]
  clear he
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ← ih, kFs_apply,
      starU_starU]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kE_kFs_pow
statement:
lemma kE_kFs_pow {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : ℕ) (u : Um D v) :
    kE hvt j ((kFs hvt i ^ m) u) = (kFs hvt i ^ m) (kE hvt j u)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing u with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    rw [kE_kFs hij, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kFs_mem_smul_latInf
statement:
lemma kFs_mem_smul_latInf [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) {u : Um D v}
    (hu : u ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A) : kFs hvt i u ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A
proof:
:=
  starU_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
    (kF_mem_smul_latInf i (starU_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hu))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kEs_mem_smul_latInf
statement:
lemma kEs_mem_smul_latInf [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) {u : Um D v}
    (hu : u ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A) : kEs hvt i u ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A
proof:
:=
  starU_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
    (kashiwaraE_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i
      (starU_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hu))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kFs_pow_mem_smul_iff
statement:
lemma kFs_pow_mem_smul_iff [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) (m : ℕ) (u : Um D v) :
    (kFs hvt i ^ m) u ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A ↔ u ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing u with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have := kEs_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i h
      rw [kEs_kFs] at this
      exact (ih u).1 this
    · intro h
      exact kFs_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i ((ih u).2 h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mkB_eq_mkB_iff
statement:
lemma mkB_eq_mkB_iff (w w' : List I) :
    mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w = mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w' ↔
      fWi (D := D) hvt w - fWi hvt w' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkB, mkB, Subtype.mk.injEq, IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_eq_mkB
statement: lemma exists_eq_mkB (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) : ∃ w, b = mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_eq_mk_of_mem_BInf b.2
  exact ⟨w, Subtype.ext hw⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.wtInf_mkB
statement:
lemma wtInf_mkB (w : List I) :
    wtInf (R := R) (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w) = -R.rootSum (wordWeight w)
proof:
:=
  wtInf_eq (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund _ rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.epsInf_mkB
statement:
lemma epsInf_mkB (j : I) (w : List I) {n : ℕ}
    (h1 : (kE hvt j ^ n) (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A)
    (h2 : (kE hvt j ^ (n + 1)) (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A) :
    epsInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w) = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hzero : ∀ c, (eQInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j ^ c)
      (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w).1 = 0 ↔
      (kE hvt j ^ c) (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨h, he⟩ := eQInf_pow_mk hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j c (fwInf hvt A w)
    rw [mkB, he, IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff]
  have hfind : Nat.find (exists_eQInf_pow_eq_zero (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j
      (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w)) = n + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.find_eq_iff]
    refine ⟨(hzero _).2 h2, fun c hc h ↦ h1 ?_⟩
    rw [hzero] at h
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (show c ≤ n by omega)
    rw [hd, add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply]
    clear hd hc
    induction d with
    | zero => simpa using h
    | succ d ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
      exact kashiwaraE_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j ih
  rw [epsInf, hfind, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eInf_mkB_eq_none
statement:
lemma eInf_mkB_eq_none (j : I) (w : List I)
    (h : kE hvt j (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A) :
    eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w) = none
proof:
:= by
  have hz : eQInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w).1 = 0 := by
    rw [mkB, eQInf_mk, IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_zero_iff]
    exact h
  simp [eInf, hz]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eInf_mkB_eq_some
statement:
lemma eInf_mkB_eq_some (j : I) (w w' : List I)
    (h : kE hvt j (fWi (D := D) hvt w) - fWi hvt w' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A) :
    eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w) =
      some (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w')
proof:
:= by
  rw [eInf_eq_some_iff, mkB, mkB, eQInf_mk]
  exact (IntegrableSl2.mk_eq_mk_iff ϖ _ _).2 h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_eps
statement:
lemma exists_eps (j : I) (w : List I) : ∃ n : ℕ,
    (kE hvt j ^ n) (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A ∧
      (kE hvt j ^ (n + 1)) (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n, (kE hvt j ^ (n + 1)) (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A :=
    ⟨wordWeight w j, by rw [kE_pow_eq_zero j (fWi_mem_Uw (hvt := hvt) w)]; exact zero_mem _⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, ?_, Nat.find_spec hex⟩
  rcases h : Nat.find hex with _ | n
  · simpa using fWi_notMem (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w
  · exact Nat.find_min hex (show n < Nat.find hex by omega)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.psiInf_eq
statement:
theorem psiInf_eq [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) {w : List I} {m : ℕ}
    {P : Um D v} {w₀ : List I}
    (he : (bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e (starU D v P) = 0)
    (hw₀ : P - fWi hvt w₀ ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A)
    (hw : fWi hvt w - rmulF hvt i m P ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A) :
    psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w) =
      (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀, -(m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  set b := mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w
  have hb := (exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b).choose_spec
  set w' := (exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b).choose
  obtain ⟨-, -, he', hP'₀, hw'r, -⟩ := (exists_starStr (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv
    hk hfund i w').choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec
  set m' := (exists_starStr (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w').choose
  set P' := (exists_starStr (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w').choose_spec.choose
  set w₀' := (exists_starStr (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i
    w').choose_spec.choose_spec.choose
  have hww' : fWi (D := D) hvt w - fWi hvt w' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A :=
    (mkB_eq_mkB_iff (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w w').1 hb
  have hP0 : P ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A := fun h ↦ fWi_notMem (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀
    (by simpa using sub_mem h hw₀)
  have h1 : rmulF hvt i m P - rmulF hvt i m' P' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    have := add_mem (sub_mem hww' hw) hw'r
    convert this using 1; abel
  have hpsi : psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b =
      (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀', -(m' : ℤ)) := rfl
  obtain ⟨hmm, hPP'⟩ := eq_of_rmulF_sub_mem (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i he he' hP0 h1
  rw [hpsi, ← hmm]
  congr 1
  rw [mkB_eq_mkB_iff]
  have := add_mem (sub_mem (neg_mem hP'₀) hPP') hw₀
  convert this using 1; abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.psiInf_spec
statement:
theorem psiInf_spec [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) (w : List I) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (P : Um D v) (w₀ : List I), P ∈ latInf hvt A ∧ P ∈ Uw D v (wordWeight w₀) ∧
      (bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e (starU D v P) = 0 ∧
      P - fWi hvt w₀ ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A ∧ fWi hvt w - rmulF hvt i m P ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A ∧
      wordWeight w₀ + Finsupp.single i m = wordWeight w ∧
      psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w) =
        (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀, -(m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, hP, hPw, he, hw₀, hw, hwt⟩ :=
    exists_starStr (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w
  exact ⟨m, P, w₀, hP, hPw, he, hw₀, hw, hwt, psiInf_eq hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i he hw₀ hw⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.wtInf_psiInf
statement:
theorem wtInf_psiInf [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) :
    wtInf (R := R) (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b).1 +
      (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b).2 • R.root i = wtInf (R := R) b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b
  obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, -, -, -, -, -, hwt, hpsi⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w
  rw [hpsi, wtInf_mkB, wtInf_mkB, ← hwt, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, neg_smul,
    natCast_zsmul]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.epsInf_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma epsInf_eq_zero_iff (j : I) (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) :
    epsInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b = 0 ↔ eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b = none
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb0 : ¬ (eQInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j ^ 0) b.1 = 0 := by
    simpa using fun h' ↦ zero_notMem_BInf (h' ▸ b.2)
  have hpos : 0 < Nat.find (exists_eQInf_pow_eq_zero (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b) :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 ↦ hb0 (h0 ▸ Nat.find_spec
      (exists_eQInf_pow_eq_zero (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b))
  have hnone : eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b = none ↔
      eQInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b.1 = 0 := by
    unfold eInf; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
  rw [hnone, epsInf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 : Nat.find (exists_eQInf_pow_eq_zero (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b) = 1 := by
      omega
    have := Nat.find_spec (exists_eQInf_pow_eq_zero (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b)
    rwa [h1, pow_one] at this
  · intro h
    have : Nat.find (exists_eQInf_pow_eq_zero (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b) ≤ 1 :=
      Nat.find_min' _ (by rw [pow_one]; exact h)
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.e_psiInf_of_ne
statement:
theorem e_psiInf_of_ne [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) :
    ((crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).tensor
        (Crystal.elementary (D := R.crystalDatum) i)).e j
        (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b) =
      (eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b).map (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b
  obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, -, -, he, hw₀, hw, -, hpsi⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w
  rw [hpsi]
  have hte : ((crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).tensor
      (Crystal.elementary (D := R.crystalDatum) i)).e j
        (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀, -(m : ℤ)) =
      (eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀)).map
        (·, -(m : ℤ)) := by
    simp [Crystal.tensor, Crystal.elementary, Ne.symm hij, crystalInf]
  rw [hte]
  have hcomm : kE hvt j (fWi (D := D) hvt w) - (kFs hvt i ^ m) (kE hvt j P) ∈
      ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    have := kashiwaraE_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j hw
    rwa [map_sub, rmulF_eq_kFs_pow i m he, kE_kFs_pow hij] at this
  have hP0 : kE hvt j P - kE hvt j (fWi (D := D) hvt w₀) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    have := kashiwaraE_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j hw₀
    rwa [map_sub] at this
  rcases kE_fWi_cases (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j w₀ with h0 | ⟨w₀', h0⟩
  · have hP : kE hvt j P ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
      have := add_mem hP0 h0; simpa using this
    have h1 : kE hvt j (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
      have := add_mem hcomm
        ((kFs_pow_mem_smul_iff (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i m _).2 hP)
      simpa using this
    rw [eInf_mkB_eq_none hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j w₀ h0,
      eInf_mkB_eq_none hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j w h1]
    rfl
  · have hP' : kE hvt j P - fWi hvt w₀' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
      have := add_mem hP0 h0
      convert this using 1; abel
    have hne : kE hvt j (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
      intro h
      have h2 : (kFs hvt i ^ m) (kE hvt j P) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
        have := sub_mem h hcomm; simpa using this
      rw [kFs_pow_mem_smul_iff (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund] at h2
      exact fWi_notMem (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀' (by simpa using sub_mem h2 hP')
    rcases kE_fWi_cases (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j w with h1 | ⟨w', h1⟩
    · exact absurd h1 hne
    have he' := e_starU_kE_eq_zero (hvt := hvt) hij he
    rw [eInf_mkB_eq_some hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j w₀ w₀' h0,
      eInf_mkB_eq_some hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j w w' h1, Option.map_some, Option.map_some,
      psiInf_eq hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i he' hP' (m := m)]
    rw [rmulF_eq_kFs_pow i m he']
    have := sub_mem hcomm h1
    convert this using 1; abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.e_psiInf_self
statement:
theorem e_psiInf_self [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I)
    (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) :
    ((crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).tensor
        (Crystal.elementary (D := R.crystalDatum) i)).e i
        (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b) =
      (eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b).map (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b
  obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, hPL, hPw, he, hw₀, hw, -, hpsi⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w
  obtain ⟨kk, hkk1, hkk2⟩ := exists_eps (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w₀
  have heps := epsInf_mkB (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w₀ hkk1 hkk2
  have hmain := kE_rmulF (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i hPL hPw he hw₀ hkk1 hkk2 hw
  have hP0 : P ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A := fun h ↦ fWi_notMem (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀
    (by simpa using sub_mem h hw₀)
  have hkP : kE hvt i P - kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w₀) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    have := kashiwaraE_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i hw₀
    rwa [map_sub] at this
  rw [hpsi]
  have hte : ((crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).tensor
      (Crystal.elementary (D := R.crystalDatum) i)).e i
        (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀, -(m : ℤ)) =
      if (m : ℤ) ≤ kk - R.rootSum (wordWeight w₀) (R.coroot i) then
        (eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀)).map
          (·, -(m : ℤ))
      else some (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀, -(m : ℤ) + 1) := by
    simp only [Crystal.tensor, Crystal.elementary, crystalInf, ite_true, neg_neg, heps,
      wtInf_mkB]
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, WithBot.coe_le_coe, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    rfl
  rw [hte]
  split_ifs with hm
  · obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hmain.1 hm
    by_cases hEP : kE hvt i P ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A
    · have h0 : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w₀) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
        simpa using sub_mem hEP hkP
      rw [eInf_mkB_eq_none hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w₀ h0,
        eInf_mkB_eq_none hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w (hA hEP)]
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨P', hP'L, he', hP'E, hwP'⟩ := hB hEP
      have h0 : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w₀) ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A := fun h ↦
        hEP (by simpa using add_mem hkP h)
      rcases kE_fWi_cases (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w₀ with h0' | ⟨w₀', h0'⟩
      · exact absurd h0' h0
      have hne : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
        intro h
        have h2 : (kFs hvt i ^ m) P' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
          rw [← rmulF_eq_kFs_pow i m he']; simpa using sub_mem h hwP'
        rw [kFs_pow_mem_smul_iff (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund] at h2
        exact hEP (by simpa using sub_mem h2 hP'E)
      rcases kE_fWi_cases (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w with h1 | ⟨w', h1⟩
      · exact absurd h1 hne
      have hP'0 : P' - fWi hvt w₀' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
        have := add_mem (add_mem hP'E hkP) h0'
        convert this using 1; abel
      rw [eInf_mkB_eq_some hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w₀ w₀' h0',
        eInf_mkB_eq_some hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w w' h1, Option.map_some, Option.map_some,
        psiInf_eq hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i he' hP'0 (m := m)]
      have := sub_mem hwP' h1
      convert this using 1; abel
  · have hB := hmain.2 (lt_of_not_ge hm)
    have hne : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
      intro h
      have h2 : (kFs hvt i ^ (m - 1)) P ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
        rw [← rmulF_eq_kFs_pow i (m - 1) he]; simpa using sub_mem h hB
      rw [kFs_pow_mem_smul_iff (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund] at h2
      exact hP0 h2
    rcases kE_fWi_cases (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w with h1 | ⟨w', h1⟩
    · exact absurd h1 hne
    have hb' : psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w') =
        (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w₀, -((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
      refine psiInf_eq hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i he hw₀ ?_
      have := sub_mem hB h1
      convert this using 1; abel
    have hsome := eInf_mkB_eq_some (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w w' h1
    rw [hsome, Option.map_some, hb']
    
    have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by
      by_contra hm0
      obtain rfl : m = 0 := by omega
      have hwt1 := wtInf_psiInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i
        (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w')
      have hwt2 := wtInf_psiInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i
        (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w)
      rw [hb'] at hwt1
      rw [hpsi] at hwt2
      have hwe := wtInf_eInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i _ _
        ((eInf_eq_some_iff (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i _ _).1 hsome)
      have hroot : R.root i = 0 := by
        have : wtInf (R := R) (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w') =
            wtInf (R := R) (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w) := by
          rw [← hwt1, ← hwt2]
        rw [this] at hwe
        simpa using hwe
      have h2 := R.crystalDatum.coroot_root_self i
      simp [hroot] at h2
    congr 2
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hm1]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.e_psiInf
statement:
theorem e_psiInf [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i j : I) (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) :
    ((crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).tensor
        (Crystal.elementary (D := R.crystalDatum) i)).e j
        (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b) =
      (eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b).map (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij; exact e_psiInf_self (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b
  · exact e_psiInf_of_ne (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hij b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eps_psiInf
statement:
theorem eps_psiInf [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i j : I) (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) :
    ((crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).tensor
        (Crystal.elementary (D := R.crystalDatum) i)).ε j
        (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b) =
      ((epsInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  set C := (crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).tensor
    (Crystal.elementary (D := R.crystalDatum) i)
  induction hn : epsInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b generalizing b with
  | zero =>
    have hb := (epsInf_eq_zero_iff hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b).1 hn
    have hC := e_psiInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i j b
    rw [hb, Option.map_none] at hC
    set b₀ := (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b).1
    set n := (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b).2
    have hpair : psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b = (b₀, n) := rfl
    rw [hpair] at hC ⊢
    by_cases hij : j = i
    · subst hij
      simp only [C, Crystal.tensor, Crystal.elementary, crystalInf, ite_true] at hC ⊢
      split_ifs at hC with hle
      · rw [Option.map_eq_none_iff, ← epsInf_eq_zero_iff] at hC
        rw [hC] at hle ⊢
        refine max_eq_left ?_
        norm_cast at hle ⊢
        simp only [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.crystalDatum_coroot] at hle ⊢
        omega
      · simp at hC
    · simp only [C, Crystal.tensor, Crystal.elementary, crystalInf, hij, ite_false, bot_le,
        ite_true, Option.map_eq_none_iff] at hC ⊢
      rw [← epsInf_eq_zero_iff] at hC
      rw [hC]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hne : eInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b ≠ none := by
      rw [Ne, ← epsInf_eq_zero_iff]; omega
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 hne
    have hε := (crystalInf (hvt := hvt) hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund).ε_e j b b' hb'
    have hC := e_psiInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i j b
    rw [hb', Option.map_some] at hC
    have hεC := C.ε_e j _ _ hC
    have hn' : epsInf hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j b' = n := by
      simp only [crystalInf, hn] at hε
      norm_cast at hε
      omega
    rw [hεC, ih b' hn']
    norm_cast

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.psiInf_injective
statement:
theorem psiInf_injective [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) :
    Function.Injective (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i)
proof:
:= by
  intro b b' h
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b
  obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b'
  obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, -, -, he, hw₀, hw, -, hpsi⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w
  obtain ⟨m', P', w₀', -, -, he', hw₀', hw', -, hpsi'⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w'
  rw [hpsi, hpsi', Prod.mk.injEq, neg_inj, Nat.cast_inj] at h
  obtain ⟨h0, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [mkB_eq_mkB_iff] at h0 ⊢
  have hPP : P - P' ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    have := add_mem (sub_mem hw₀ hw₀') h0
    convert this using 1; abel
  have heP : (bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e (starU D v (P - P')) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, he, he', sub_zero]
  have hr := (kFs_pow_mem_smul_iff (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i m _).2 hPP
  rw [← rmulF_eq_kFs_pow i m heP, map_sub] at hr
  have := add_mem (sub_mem hw hw') hr
  convert this using 1; abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.psiInf_one
statement:
theorem psiInf_one [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I) :
    psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund []) =
      (mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund [], 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, -, -, -, hw₀, hw, hwt, hpsi⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i []
  have hm : m = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (· i) hwt
    simp [wordWeight] at this
    omega
  subst hm
  rw [hpsi, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, Prod.mk.injEq, mkB_eq_mkB_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
  have := add_mem hw₀ (by simpa using hw)
  convert neg_mem this using 1; abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.psiInf_snd_nonpos
statement:
theorem psiInf_snd_nonpos [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (i : I)
    (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) : (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b).2 ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b
  obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, hP, hPw, he, hw₀, hw, hwt, hpsi⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i w
  rw [hpsi]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kEs_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [kEs_apply]
  have : kE hvt i (starU D v P) = 0 :=
    BosonModule.eTilde_of_ker (V := bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i)
      (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v) i)
      (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i) he
  rw [this, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_psiInf_snd_neg
statement:
theorem exists_psiInf_snd_neg [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})]
    (b : BInf (D := D) hvt A ϖ) (hb : b ≠ mkB hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund []) :
    ∃ i, (psiInf hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i b).2 < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_mkB (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund b
  obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := exists_fWi_sub_starU_mem (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (D := D) (A := A) w
  cases w' with
  | nil =>
    exfalso
    apply hb
    rw [mkB_eq_mkB_iff]
    have h1 : starU D v (fWi (D := D) hvt []) = fWi hvt [] := by
      change starU D v (Submodule.Quotient.mk 1) = Submodule.Quotient.mk 1
      rw [starU_mk, rev_one]
    rwa [h1] at hw'
  | cons j w'' =>
    refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨m, P, w₀, -, -, he, -, hw, -, hpsi⟩ := psiInf_spec hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j w
    rw [hpsi]
    suffices hm : m ≠ 0 by simp only [Left.neg_neg_iff, Nat.cast_pos]; omega
    rintro rfl
    have hc : fWi (D := D) hvt (j :: w'') = kF hvt j (fWi hvt w'') := rfl
    have h1 := kEs_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j hw'
    rw [map_sub, kEs_apply (u := starU D v _), starU_starU, hc, kE_kF] at h1
    have h2 := kEs_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund j hw
    rw [map_sub, rmulF_zero, kEs_eq_zero j he, sub_zero] at h2
    have h3 : starU D v (fWi (D := D) hvt w'') ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
      simpa using sub_mem h2 h1
    have h4 := starU_mem_smul_latInf (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund h3
    rw [starU_starU] at h4
    exact fWi_notMem (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund w'' h4

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kEs_apply
statement: lemma kEs_apply (i : I) (u : Um D v) : kEs hvt i u = starU D v (kE hvt i (starU D v u))
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kFs_apply
statement: lemma kFs_apply (i : I) (u : Um D v) : kFs hvt i u = starU D v (kF hvt i (starU D v u))
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.starU_e_starU_mk
statement:
lemma starU_e_starU_mk (i : I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    starU D v ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e
      (starU D v (Submodule.Quotient.mk y))) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (rDeriv D v i y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [starU_mk]
  change starU D v (Submodule.Quotient.mk (lDeriv D v i (rev k I y))) = _
  rw [starU_mk, lDeriv_rev, rev_rev]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.starU_f_starU_mk
statement:
lemma starU_f_starU_mk (i : I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    starU D v (NegativePart.f D v i (starU D v (Submodule.Quotient.mk y))) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (y * θ k i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [starU_mk, NegativePart.f_mk, starU_mk, rev_mul, rev_rev, rev_θ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.starU_e_starU_comm
statement:
lemma starU_e_starU_comm (i j : I) (u : Um D v) :
    starU D v ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e (starU D v
      ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e u))) =
    (bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e (starU D v
      ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e (starU D v u)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  change starU D v ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e (starU D v
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (lDeriv D v i y)))) = _
  rw [starU_e_starU_mk (hvt := hvt), starU_e_starU_mk (hvt := hvt)]
  change _ = Submodule.Quotient.mk (lDeriv D v i (rDeriv D v j y))
  rw [lDeriv_rDeriv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.starU_e_starU_f_comm
statement:
lemma starU_e_starU_f_comm {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Um D v) :
    starU D v ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e (starU D v
      (NegativePart.f D v i u))) =
    NegativePart.f D v i (starU D v
      ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e (starU D v u)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  rw [NegativePart.f_mk, starU_e_starU_mk (hvt := hvt), starU_e_starU_mk (hvt := hvt),
    NegativePart.f_mk,
    rDeriv_θ_mul, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hij), add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.starU_f_starU_e_comm
statement:
lemma starU_f_starU_e_comm {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Um D v) :
    starU D v (NegativePart.f D v j (starU D v
      ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e u))) =
    (bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i).e (starU D v
      (NegativePart.f D v j (starU D v u)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  change starU D v (NegativePart.f D v j (starU D v
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (lDeriv D v i y)))) = _
  rw [starU_f_starU_mk, starU_f_starU_mk]
  change _ = Submodule.Quotient.mk (lDeriv D v i (y * θ k j))
  rw [lDeriv_mul, lDeriv_θ, ite_eq_right hij, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.starU_f_starU_f_comm
statement:
lemma starU_f_starU_f_comm (i j : I) (u : Um D v) :
    starU D v (NegativePart.f D v j (starU D v (NegativePart.f D v i u))) =
    NegativePart.f D v i (starU D v (NegativePart.f D v j (starU D v u)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  rw [NegativePart.f_mk, starU_f_starU_mk, starU_f_starU_mk, NegativePart.f_mk, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kEs_e_comm
statement:
lemma kEs_e_comm {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Um D v) :
    kEs hvt i ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e u) =
      (bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e (kEs hvt i u)
proof:
:= by
  set B := bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
  
  have h := BosonModule.map_eTilde (V := B i) (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v) i)
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i) (B i)
    (starU D v ∘ₗ (B j).e ∘ₗ starU D v)
    (fun m ↦ starU_e_starU_comm (hvt := hvt) i j m)
    (fun m ↦ starU_e_starU_f_comm (hvt := hvt) hij m) (starU D v u)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, starU_starU] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (starU D v) h
  rw [starU_starU] at h2
  rw [kEs_apply, kEs_apply]
  exact h2.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kEs_f_comm
statement:
lemma kEs_f_comm {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Um D v) :
    kEs hvt i (NegativePart.f D v j u) = NegativePart.f D v j (kEs hvt i u)
proof:
:= by
  set B := bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
  have h := BosonModule.map_eTilde (V := B i) (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v) i)
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i) (B i)
    (starU D v ∘ₗ NegativePart.f D v j ∘ₗ starU D v)
    (fun m ↦ starU_f_starU_e_comm (hvt := hvt) hij m)
    (fun m ↦ starU_f_starU_f_comm i j m) (starU D v u)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, starU_starU] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (starU D v) h
  rw [starU_starU] at h2
  rw [kEs_apply, kEs_apply]
  exact h2.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kFs_e_comm
statement:
lemma kFs_e_comm {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Um D v) :
    kFs hvt i ((bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e u) =
      (bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) j).e (kFs hvt i u)
proof:
:= by
  set B := bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
  have h := BosonModule.map_fTilde (V := B i) (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v) i)
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i) (B i)
    (starU D v ∘ₗ (B j).e ∘ₗ starU D v)
    (fun m ↦ starU_e_starU_comm (hvt := hvt) i j m)
    (fun m ↦ starU_e_starU_f_comm (hvt := hvt) hij m) (starU D v u)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, starU_starU] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (starU D v) h
  rw [starU_starU] at h2
  rw [kFs_apply, kFs_apply]
  exact h2.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.kFs_f_comm
statement:
lemma kFs_f_comm {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Um D v) :
    kFs hvt i (NegativePart.f D v j u) = NegativePart.f D v j (kFs hvt i u)
proof:
:= by
  set B := bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
  have h := BosonModule.map_fTilde (V := B i) (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v) i)
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i) (B i)
    (starU D v ∘ₗ NegativePart.f D v j ∘ₗ starU D v)
    (fun m ↦ starU_f_starU_e_comm (hvt := hvt) hij m)
    (fun m ↦ starU_f_starU_f_comm i j m) (starU D v u)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, starU_starU] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (starU D v) h
  rw [starU_starU] at h2
  rw [kFs_apply, kFs_apply]
  exact h2.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_tmul_cmp
statement:
theorem exists_tmul_cmp (i : I) (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ μ Λl : Dom R, (∀ j, (N : ℤ) ≤ μ.1 (R.coroot j)) → ∀ k₁ ≤ M, ∀ k₂ ≤ M,
      ∀ y₁ ∈ lat hvt hR A Λl, ∀ y₂ ∈ lat hvt hR A Λl, y₁ ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λl →
        TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR μ (List.replicate k₁ i) ⊗ₜ[k] y₁) -
