  have hL₂ := isCrystalLattice_lat (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₂
  have hB₁ := isCrystalBaseHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁
  have hB₂ := isCrystalBaseHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₂
  have := hL₁.free
  have := hL₂.free
  obtain ⟨e₁, e₂⟩ := TensorModule.mk_eq_of_tmul_sub_mem hinj hϖ0 hk hL₁.span_eq_top
    hL₂.span_eq_top hB₁.linearIndependent hB₁.span_eq_top hB₂.linearIndependent hB₂.span_eq_top
    (x := fwL hvt hR A Λ₁ w₁) (x' := fwL hvt hR A Λ₁ w₁') (y := fwL hvt hR A Λ₂ w₂)
    (y' := fwL hvt hR A Λ₂ w₂') (mkHW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ hw₁).2 (mkHW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁' hw₁').2
    (mkHW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂ hw₂).2 (mkHW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂' hw₂').2 hdiff
  exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext e₂.symm) (Subtype.ext e₁.symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.fIter_crystalHW_of_isStr
statement:
lemma fIter_crystalHW_of_isStr (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) {a : ℕ} {u : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1} :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) {w : List I} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {kk : ℕ},
      IsStr hvt hR ϖ Λ i ν (fW hvt hR Λ w) kk a u →
      ∀ hw : fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ,
      (j ≤ a - kk → ((crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ).fIter i j
          (mkHW hvt hR Λ w hw)).isSome) ∧
        (a - kk < j → (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ).fIter i j
          (mkHW hvt hR Λ w hw) = none)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  have hall := allProp (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => exact fun _ _ ↦ ⟨fun _ ↦ rfl, fun h ↦ absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    intro w ν kk hx hw
    by_cases hka : kk + 1 ≤ a
    · have hx' := hx.kashiwaraF hka
      rw [← fW_cons] at hx'
      have hiw : fW hvt hR Λ (i :: w) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
        hx'.notMem_x (fun s _ ↦ (hall s).1) rfl hϖ0
      rw [Crystal.fIter_succ, f_crystalHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ i hw hiw, Option.bind_some]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih hx' hiw
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ h1 (by omega), fun h ↦ h2 (by omega)⟩
    · have hka' : kk = a := by have := hx.le; omega
      have hiw : fW hvt hR Λ (i :: w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
        have := hx.kashiwaraF_mem hka'
        rwa [← fW_cons] at this
      rw [Crystal.fIter_succ, f_crystalHW_mkHW_eq_none hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ i hw hiw]
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ by omega, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.φ_crystalHW_of_isStr
statement:
lemma φ_crystalHW_of_isStr {Λ : Dom R} {i : I} {w : List I} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {kk a : ℕ}
    {u : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1} (hx : IsStr hvt hR ϖ Λ i ν (fW hvt hR Λ w) kk a u)
    (hw : fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ) :
    (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ).φ i (mkHW hvt hR Λ w hw) = ((a - kk : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hC := isSeminormal_crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hC.exists_φ_eq i (mkHW hvt hR Λ w hw)
  have h1 := (fIter_crystalHW_of_isStr hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ i (a - kk) hx hw).1 le_rfl
  have h2 := (fIter_crystalHW_of_isStr hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ i (a - kk + 1) hx hw).2
    (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  rw [hC.isSome_fIter_iff, hp] at h1
  have h2' := mt (hC.isSome_fIter_iff (i := i) (b := mkHW hvt hR Λ w hw) (a - kk + 1)).2
    (by rw [h2]; simp)
  rw [hp] at h2' ⊢
  have e1 : a - kk ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have e2 : ¬ a - kk + 1 ≤ p := fun h ↦ h2' (by exact_mod_cast h)
  have : p = a - kk := by omega
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.ε_crystalHW_of_isStr
proof:
:= by
  have hC := isSeminormal_crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ
  have hφ := φ_crystalHW_of_isStr hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hx hw
  rw [Crystal.φ_eq, wt_mkHW, LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.crystalDatum_coroot] at hφ
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hC.exists_ε_eq i (mkHW hvt hR Λ w hw)
  rw [he] at hφ ⊢
  have hn := hx.node
  have hle := hx.le
  rw [← WithBot.coe_natCast, ← WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_inj] at hφ
  have : (e : ℤ) = kk := by push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hle] at hφ; omega
  rw [← WithBot.coe_natCast, this]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.fW_tmul_notMem
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  have hL₁ := isCrystalLattice_lat (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁
  have hL₂ := isCrystalLattice_lat (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₂
  have hB₁ := isCrystalBaseHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁
  have hB₂ := isCrystalBaseHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₂
  have := hL₁.free
  have := hL₂.free
  exact TensorModule.mk_tmul_notMem hinj hϖ0 hk hL₁.span_eq_top hL₂.span_eq_top
    hB₁.linearIndependent hB₁.span_eq_top hB₂.linearIndependent hB₂.span_eq_top
    (not_isUnit_ϖ hϖ) (x := fwL hvt hR A Λ₁ w₁) (y := fwL hvt hR A Λ₂ w₂)
    (mkHW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ hw₁).2 (mkHW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂ hw₂).2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.fW_mem_of_tensorEmb_sub
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hw
  exact notMem_of_tensorEmb_fW_sub hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hw h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.map_f_mkHW_of_sub
statement:
lemma map_f_mkHW_of_sub {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} (i : I) {w w₁ w₂ : List I}
    (hw : fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂))
    (hw₁ : fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₁) (hw₂ : fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂ ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₂)
    (h : tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (i :: w)) -
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂) :
    ((crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ₁ + Λ₂)).f i (mkHW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w hw)).map
        (tensorHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂) =
      some (mkHW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂ hw₂, mkHW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ hw₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hiw : fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (i :: w) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂) := fun hm ↦
    fW_tmul_notMem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hw₁ hw₂ (by
      have := sub_mem (tensorEmb_mem_smul_LL hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hm
        (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR _ (i :: w))) h
      simpa using this)
  rw [f_crystalHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i hw hiw, Option.map_some]
  exact congrArg some (tensorHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hiw hw₁ hw₂ h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorEmb_fW_cons_sub
statement:
lemma tensorEmb_fW_cons_sub {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} (i : I) {w w₁ w₂ : List I}
    (hww : wordWeight w₁ + wordWeight w₂ = wordWeight w)
    (h : tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) -
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂)
    {k₁ a₁ k₂ a₂ : ℕ} {u₁ : IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁.1} {u₂ : IrreducibleModule R v Λ₂.1}
    (hx : IsStr hvt hR ϖ Λ₁ i (wordWeight w₁) (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁) k₁ a₁ u₁)
    (hy : IsStr hvt hR ϖ Λ₂ i (wordWeight w₂) (fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) k₂ a₂ u₂) :
    tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (i :: w)) -
      (if k₁ < a₂ - k₂ then TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ (i :: w₂))
        else TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ (i :: w₁) ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂)) ∈
      ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hall := allProp (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
  have hAll : ∀ d, ∀ s ≤ d, PropA hvt hR A s := fun _ s _ ↦ (hall s).1
  have hrule := fT_tmul hϖ hϖv (hAll _) (hAll _) rfl rfl hx hy
  have hwt : tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) -
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) ∈
      weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (wordWeight w)) :=
    sub_mem (tensorEmb_fW_mem_weightSpace Λ₁ Λ₂ w)
      (hww ▸ fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ w₁ w₂)
  have hstep := fT_mem_smul_LL hϖ hϖv (hAll _) i rfl h hwt
  rw [map_sub] at hstep
  have hΦ : tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (i :: w)) =
      fT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w)) := by
    rw [tensorEmb_fW, tensorEmb_fW, fTw_cons]
  have hcong := add_mem hstep hrule
  rw [sub_add_sub_cancel, ← hΦ, ← fW_cons, ← fW_cons] at hcong
  exact hcong

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.f_tensorHW
statement:
theorem f_tensorHW (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) (i : I)
    (b : IrreducibleModule.base hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (Λ₁ + Λ₂).2 A ϖ) :
    ((crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₂).tensor
        (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁)).f i
        (tensorHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ b) =
      ((crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ₁ + Λ₂)).f i b).map
        (tensorHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  have hall := allProp (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
  have hAll : ∀ d, ∀ s ≤ d, PropA hvt hR A s := fun _ s _ ↦ (hall s).1
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := exists_mkHW (hvt := hvt) (Λ₁ + Λ₂) b
  obtain ⟨w₁, w₂, hww, h⟩ := exists_tensorEmb_fW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ w
  obtain ⟨hw₁, hw₂⟩ := notMem_of_tensorEmb_fW_sub_tmul hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hw h
  rw [tensorHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hw hw₁ hw₂ h]
  obtain ⟨k₁, a₁, u₁, hx⟩ := exists_isStr hϖ0 (hAll _) (fun s _ ↦ (hall s).2.1)
    (fun s _ ↦ (hall s).2.2.1) Λ₁ i rfl (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A w₁)
    (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₁ w₁) (w := w₁) (by rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _) hw₁
  obtain ⟨k₂, a₂, u₂, hy⟩ := exists_isStr hϖ0 (hAll _) (fun s _ ↦ (hall s).2.1)
    (fun s _ ↦ (hall s).2.2.1) Λ₂ i rfl (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂)
    (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) (w := w₂) (by rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _) hw₂
  have hcong := tensorEmb_fW_cons_sub hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i hww h hx hy
  rw [Crystal.tensor_f]
  dsimp only
  rw [ε_crystalHW_of_isStr hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hx hw₁,
    φ_crystalHW_of_isStr hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hy hw₂]
  by_cases hc : k₁ < a₂ - k₂
  · have hc' : ((k₁ : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) < (((a₂ - k₂ : ℕ) : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
    simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hcong
    simp only [hc', ↓reduceIte]
    have hy' := hy.kashiwaraF (by omega)
    rw [← fW_cons] at hy'
    have hiw₂ : fW hvt hR Λ₂ (i :: w₂) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₂ :=
      hy'.notMem_x (hAll _) rfl hϖ0
    rw [f_crystalHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₂ i hw₂ hiw₂, Option.map_some]
    exact (map_f_mkHW_of_sub hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i hw hw₁ hiw₂ hcong).symm
  · have hc' : ¬ ((k₁ : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) < (((a₂ - k₂ : ℕ) : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hc
    simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hcong
    simp only [hc', ↓reduceIte]
    by_cases hka : k₁ + 1 ≤ a₁
    · have hx' := hx.kashiwaraF hka
      rw [← fW_cons] at hx'
      have hiw₁ : fW hvt hR Λ₁ (i :: w₁) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₁ :=
        hx'.notMem_x (hAll _) rfl hϖ0
      rw [f_crystalHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ i hw₁ hiw₁, Option.map_some]
      exact (map_f_mkHW_of_sub hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund i hw hiw₁ hw₂ hcong).symm
    · have hiw₁ : fW hvt hR Λ₁ (i :: w₁) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₁ := by
        have := hx.kashiwaraF_mem (by have := hx.le; omega)
        rwa [← fW_cons] at this
      have hiw : fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (i :: w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂) :=
        fW_mem_of_tensorEmb_sub hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hcong (tmul_mem_smul_left hiw₁
          (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂))
      rw [f_crystalHW_mkHW_eq_none hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ i hw₁ hiw₁,
        f_crystalHW_mkHW_eq_none hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i hw hiw]
      simp only [Option.map_none]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.wt_tensorHW
statement:
theorem wt_tensorHW (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R)
    (b : IrreducibleModule.base hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (Λ₁ + Λ₂).2 A ϖ) :
    ((crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₂).tensor
        (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁)).wt
        (tensorHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ b) =
      (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (Λ₁ + Λ₂)).wt b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := exists_mkHW (hvt := hvt) (Λ₁ + Λ₂) b
  obtain ⟨w₁, w₂, hww, h⟩ := exists_tensorEmb_fW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ w
  obtain ⟨hw₁, hw₂⟩ := notMem_of_tensorEmb_fW_sub_tmul hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hw h
  rw [tensorHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund hw hw₁ hw₂ h, Crystal.tensor_wt, wt_mkHW, wt_mkHW,
    wt_mkHW, ← hww, R.rootSum_add, Dom.add_val]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorHWHom_apply
statement:
lemma tensorHWHom_apply (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R)
    (b : IrreducibleModule.base hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (Λ₁ + Λ₂).2 A ϖ) :
    tensorHWHom hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ b =
      tensorHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ b
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorHWHom_topHW
statement:
theorem tensorHWHom_topHW (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) :
    tensorHWHom hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ (Λ₁ + Λ₂)) =
      (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ₂, topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHWHom_apply, topHW]
  refine tensorHW_mkHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund _ _ _ ?_
  rw [tensorEmb_fW]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.castHW_topHW
statement:
lemma castHW_topHW {Λ Λ' : Dom R} (h : Λ = Λ') :
    castHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund h (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ) = topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.nsmulDom_one
statement: lemma nsmulDom_one (Λ : Dom R) : nsmulDom R 1 Λ = Λ
proof: := Subtype.ext (one_nsmul _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.nsmulDom_succ
statement: lemma nsmulDom_succ (n : ℕ) (Λ : Dom R) : nsmulDom R (n + 1) Λ = nsmulDom R n Λ + Λ
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [nsmulDom_val, Dom.add_val, nsmulDom_val, succ_nsmul])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.powHW_topHW
statement:
theorem powHW_topHW (Λ : Dom R) : ∀ n : ℕ,
    powHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ n (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ (nsmulDom R (n + 1) Λ)) =
      Crystal.TPow.replicate (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ) (n + 1)
proof:
| 0 => by
    have h := castHW_topHW (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (nsmulDom_one Λ)
    change (Crystal.tensorUnit (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ)).symm
      (castHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (nsmulDom_one Λ)
        (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ (nsmulDom R 1 Λ))) = _
    rw [h]
    rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    have h := castHW_topHW (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (nsmulDom_succ (n + 1) Λ)
    change ((tensorHWHom hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (nsmulDom R (n + 1) Λ) Λ
        (castHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (nsmulDom_succ (n + 1) Λ)
          (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ (nsmulDom R (n + 2) Λ)))).1,
      powHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ n
        (tensorHWHom hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (nsmulDom R (n + 1) Λ) Λ
          (castHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund (nsmulDom_succ (n + 1) Λ)
            (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ (nsmulDom R (n + 2) Λ)))).2) = _
    rw [h, tensorHWHom_topHW, powHW_topHW Λ n]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.e_topHW
statement:
lemma e_topHW (Λ : Dom R) (j : I) :
    (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ).e j (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ) = none
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Option.eq_none_iff_forall_ne_some]
  intro c hc
  have hw := (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ).wt_e j _ _ hc
  obtain ⟨w, hw', rfl⟩ := exists_mkHW (hvt := hvt) Λ c
  rw [topHW, wt_mkHW, wt_mkHW] at hw
  have h1 : R.rootSum (wordWeight w + Finsupp.single j 1) = R.rootSum 0 := by
    rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul, R.rootSum_zero]
    simp only [wordWeight_nil, R.rootSum_zero, sub_zero,
      LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.crystalDatum_root] at hw
    have := congrArg (· - Λ.1) hw
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel_left, add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    rw [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr this.symm]
    abel
  have h2 := congrArg (· j) (LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR h1)
  simp at h2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_similarityPowHW
statement:
theorem exists_similarityPowHW [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (Λ : Dom R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ T : Crystal.Similarity (crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ)
      ((crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ).tensorPow (n + 1)) (n + 1),
      T (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ) = Crystal.TPow.replicate (topHW hvt hR hinj hϖ Λ) (n + 1) ∧
      Function.Injective T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_similarityHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund n.succ_pos Λ
  refine ⟨S.compStrictHom (powHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ n), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Crystal.Similarity.compStrictHom_apply, hS, powHW_topHW]
  · exact Crystal.Similarity.injective_of_fWord _
      (exists_fWord_crystalHW hvt hR hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ)
      (e_topHW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eT_mem_smul_LL
statement:
lemma eT_mem_smul_LL {d : ℕ} (hA : ∀ s ≤ d, PropA hvt hR A s) {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} (i : I)
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν.degree = d) {z : TM v Λ₁ Λ₂} (hz : z ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂)
    (hzw : z ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum ν)) :
    eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i z ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hz₀w, rfl⟩ := TensorModule.exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hz hzw
  rw [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (eT_mem_LL hϖ hϖv hA i hν hz₀ hz₀w)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.fTw_mem_LL
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => simpa using hz
  | cons i u ih =>
    rw [fTw_cons]
    refine fT_mem_LL hϖ hϖv (d := (ν + LusztigF.wordWeight u).degree)
      (fun s hs ↦ hA s ?_) i rfl (ih fun s hs ↦ hA s (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega))
      (fTw_mem_weightSpace Λ₁ Λ₂ u hzw)
    rw [map_add, degree_wordWeight] at hs
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.Sh_fTw_sub
statement:
lemma Sh_fTw_sub {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} :
    ∀ w : List I, (∀ s < w.length, PropA hvt hR A s) → (∀ s < w.length, PropB hvt hR A ϖ s) →
      (∀ s < w.length, PropC hvt hR A ϖ s) →
      Sh hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ (fTw hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ w (TensorModule.mk _ _
        (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k] IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₂.1))) -
        fW hvt hR Λ₂ w ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hvvw : TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
      IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₂.1) ∈ weightSpace R v (TM v Λ₁ Λ₂)
        (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum 0) := by
    simpa using fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ [] []
  intro w
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro _ _ _
    simp [Sh_tmul]
  | cons i w ih =>
    intro hA hB hC
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hA hB hC
    have hih := ih (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega)) (fun s hs ↦ hB s (by omega))
      (fun s hs ↦ hC s (by omega))
    have hmem := fTw_mem_LL hϖ hϖv (Λ₁ := Λ₁) (Λ₂ := Λ₂) w (ν := 0)
      (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by simp at hs; omega)) (fW_tmul_mem_LL Λ₁ Λ₂ [] []) hvvw
    have hS := Sh_fT_sub_mem hϖ hϖv (d := w.length) (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega))
      (fun s hs ↦ hB s (by omega)) (fun s hs ↦ hC s (by omega)) i
      (ν := LusztigF.wordWeight w) (degree_wordWeight w) hmem
      (by simpa using fTw_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ w hvvw)
    have hf := kashiwaraF_mem_smul_lat Λ₂ i hih
    rw [map_sub] at hf
    rw [fTw_cons, fW_cons]
    simpa using add_mem hS hf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.smul_tensorProj
statement:
lemma smul_tensorProj (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) (c : A) (z : TM v Λ₁ Λ₂) :
    tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (c • z) = c • tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul k c z, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, algebraMap_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.smul_tensorEmb
statement:
lemma smul_tensorEmb (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R) (c : A) (x : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1) :
    tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (c • x) = c • tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul k c x, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, algebraMap_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorProj_mem_smul
statement:
lemma tensorProj_mem_smul {n : ℕ} (hF : PropF hvt hR A (n + 1)) {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} (i : I)
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν.degree = n + 2) {z : TM v Λ₁ Λ₂} (hz : z ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂)
    (hzw : z ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum ν + R.root i)) :
    tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 z ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hz₀w, rfl⟩ := TensorModule.exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hz hzw
  rw [smul_tensorProj]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ ?_
  by_cases h0 : z₀ = 0
  · rw [h0, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ := exists_rootSum_of_LL hz₀ hz₀w h0
  have hνν : ν = ν' + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
    refine LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR ?_
    rw [R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]
    calc R.rootSum ν = Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum ν + R.root i) + R.root i := by
          abel
      _ = Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum ν') + R.root i := by rw [hν']
      _ = R.rootSum ν' + R.root i := by abel
  have hd : ν'.degree = n + 1 := by
    have := hν; rw [hνν, map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at this; omega
  exact hF Λ₁ Λ₂ ν' hd _ hz₀ (hν' ▸ hz₀w)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.tensorEmb_mem_smul
statement:
lemma tensorEmb_mem_smul {n : ℕ} (hE : PropE hvt hR A (n + 1)) {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} (i : I)
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν.degree = n + 2) {x : IrreducibleModule R v (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1}
    (hx : x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂))
    (hxw : x ∈ weightSpace R v _ ((Λ₁ + Λ₂).1 - R.rootSum ν + R.root i)) :
    tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 x ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀w, rfl⟩ := TensorModule.exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hx hxw
  rw [smul_tensorEmb]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ ?_
  by_cases h0 : x₀ = 0
  · rw [h0, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ := exists_eq_add_single hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (Λ₁ + Λ₂)
    (j := 1) (by rwa [one_smul]) h0
  have hd : ν'.degree = n + 1 := by
    have := hν; rw [hν', map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at this; omega
  refine hE Λ₁ Λ₂ ν' hd _ hx₀ ?_
  convert hx₀w using 2
  rw [hν', R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.stepB
statement:
theorem stepB {n : ℕ} (hA : ∀ s ≤ n + 2, PropA hvt hR A s)
    (hB : ∀ s < n + 2, PropB hvt hR A ϖ s) (hC : ∀ s < n + 2, PropC hvt hR A ϖ s)
    (hF : PropF hvt hR A (n + 1)) (hG : PropG hvt hR A ϖ (n + 1)) {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Dom R} {j : I}
    (hj : ∀ i, Λ₂.1 (R.coroot i) = if i = j then 1 else 0) (u : List I) (hu : u.length = n)
    (i' i : I) :
    eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (u ++ [j, i'])) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂) ∨
      ∃ w' : List I, eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (u ++ [j, i'])) -
        fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  set hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  set w := u ++ [j, i']
  have hwlen : w.length = n + 2 := by simp [w, hu]
  have hdeg : (LusztigF.wordWeight w).degree = n + 2 := by rw [degree_wordWeight, hwlen]
  obtain ⟨w₁, w₂, h1, h2, h3, h5, h4⟩ := fTw_fund hϖ hϖv hinj hj u i'
    (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega)) (by rwa [hu]) (by rwa [hu])
  set vv := TensorModule.mk (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₁.1) (IrreducibleModule R v Λ₂.1)
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₁.1 ⊗ₜ[k] IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ₂.1)
  set W := fTw hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ w vv
  have hvvw : vv ∈ weightSpace R v (TM v Λ₁ Λ₂) (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum 0) := by
    simpa using fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ [] []
  have hWw : W ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) := by
    simpa using fTw_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ w hvvw
  have hmw : TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) ∈
      weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) := by
    rw [← h5]; exact fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace Λ₁ Λ₂ w₁ w₂
  have hEw : eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W ∈
      weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w) + R.root i) :=
    kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isIntT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂) i hWw
  have hΨ : tensorProj hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W) =
      eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) := by
    rw [tensorProj_eT, tensorProj_fTw]
  have he1 : eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W -
      eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i (TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂)) ∈
      ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂ := by
    rw [← map_sub]; exact eT_mem_smul_LL hϖ hϖv hA i hdeg h4 (sub_mem hWw hmw)
  
  have hleft : eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂ →
      eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂) ∨
        ∃ w' : List I, eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) -
          fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂) := fun h ↦ Or.inl
    (hΨ ▸ tensorProj_mem_smul hϖv hF i hdeg h hEw)
  have htail : ∀ w₁' w₂' : List I, LusztigF.wordWeight w₁' + LusztigF.wordWeight w₂' +
      Finsupp.single i 1 = LusztigF.wordWeight w →
      eT hvt hR Λ₁ Λ₂ i W -
        TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁' ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂') ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂ →
      eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂) ∨
        ∃ w' : List I, eK hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) i (fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w) -
          fW hvt hR (Λ₁ + Λ₂) w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λ₁ + Λ₂) := by
    intro w₁' w₂' hww hcong
    have hzw : TensorModule.mk _ _ (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁' ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂') ∈
        weightSpace R v _ (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w) + R.root i) := by
      convert fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ₁ Λ₂ w₁' w₂' using 2
      rw [← hww, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]
      abel
    have hk := tensorProj_mem_smul hϖv hF i hdeg hcong (sub_mem hEw hzw)
    rw [map_sub, hΨ] at hk
    have hlen' : w₁'.length + w₂'.length = n + 1 := by
      have := congrArg Finsupp.degree hww
      rw [map_add, map_add, degree_wordWeight, degree_wordWeight, Finsupp.degree_single, hdeg]
        at this
      omega
    rcases hG Λ₁ Λ₂ w₁' w₂' hlen' with hg | ⟨w', hg⟩
    · exact Or.inl (by simpa using add_mem hk hg)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨w', by simpa using add_mem hk hg⟩
  
  by_cases hx0 : fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁ ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₁
  · refine hleft ?_
    have := eT_mem_smul_LL hϖ hϖv hA i hdeg (tmul_mem_smul_left hx0
      (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂)) hmw
    simpa using add_mem he1 this
  by_cases hy0 : fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂ ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₂
  · refine hleft ?_
    have := eT_mem_smul_LL hϖ hϖv hA i hdeg (tmul_mem_smul_right
      (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A w₁) hy0) hmw
    simpa using add_mem he1 this
  have hd₁ : w₁.length < n + 2 := by omega
  have hd₂ : w₂.length < n + 2 := by omega
  obtain ⟨k₁, a, u₁, hxs⟩ := exists_isStr hϖ0 (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega))
    (fun s hs ↦ hB s (by omega)) (fun s hs ↦ hC s (by omega)) Λ₁ i (degree_wordWeight w₁)
    (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A w₁) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₁ w₁)
    (w := w₁) (by simp) hx0
  obtain ⟨k₂, b, u₂, hys⟩ := exists_isStr hϖ0 (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega))
    (fun s hs ↦ hB s (by omega)) (fun s hs ↦ hC s (by omega)) Λ₂ i (degree_wordWeight w₂)
    (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₂ w₂)
    (w := w₂) (by simp) hy0
  have hrule := eT_tmul hϖ hϖv (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega)) (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega))
    (degree_wordWeight w₁) (degree_wordWeight w₂) hxs hys
  have hc1 := add_mem he1 hrule
  split_ifs at hc1 with hc
  · 
    by_cases hey : eK hvt hR Λ₂ i (fW hvt hR Λ₂ w₂) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₂
    · refine hleft ?_
      simpa using add_mem hc1 (tmul_mem_smul_right
        (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A w₁) hey)
    obtain ⟨w₂', hw₂'⟩ := (hB w₂.length hd₂ Λ₂ w₂ rfl i).resolve_left hey
    have hew₂ := kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i
      (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₂ w₂)
    obtain ⟨ν₂, hν₂⟩ := exists_eq_add_single hR hv' Λ₂ (j := 1) (by rwa [one_smul])
      (fun h ↦ hey (by rw [h]; exact zero_mem _))
    have hw₂ν : LusztigF.wordWeight w₂' = ν₂ := wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem hvt hR A ϖ Λ₂
      (by
        have := kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₂) i (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₂ w₂)
        convert this using 2
        rw [hν₂, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]; abel) hey hw₂'
    refine htail w₁ w₂' (by rw [hw₂ν, add_assoc, ← hν₂, h5]) ?_
    have := add_mem hc1 (tmul_mem_smul_right (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₁.2 A w₁)
      hw₂')
    convert this using 1
    rw [tmul_sub, map_sub]
    abel
  · 
    by_cases hex : eK hvt hR Λ₁ i (fW hvt hR Λ₁ w₁) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ₁
    · refine hleft ?_
      simpa using add_mem hc1 (tmul_mem_smul_left hex
        (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂))
    obtain ⟨w₁', hw₁'⟩ := (hB w₁.length hd₁ Λ₁ w₁ rfl i).resolve_left hex
    have hew₁ := kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) i
      (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₁ w₁)
    obtain ⟨ν₁, hν₁⟩ := exists_eq_add_single hR hv' Λ₁ (j := 1) (by rwa [one_smul])
      (fun h ↦ hex (by rw [h]; exact zero_mem _))
    have hw₁ν : LusztigF.wordWeight w₁' = ν₁ := wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem hvt hR A ϖ Λ₁
      (by
        have := kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ₁) i (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ₁ w₁)
        convert this using 2
        rw [hν₁, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]; abel) hex hw₁'
    refine htail w₁' w₂ (by rw [hw₁ν, add_right_comm, ← hν₁, h5]) ?_
    have := add_mem hc1 (tmul_mem_smul_left hw₁'
      (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ₂.2 A w₂))
    convert this using 1
    rw [sub_tmul, map_sub]
    abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.transportB
statement:
lemma transportB {ν ν' : Dom R} (h : ν.1 = ν'.1) (i : I) (w : List I)
    (hmem : eK hvt hR ν i (fW hvt hR ν w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A ν ∨
      ∃ w' : List I, eK hvt hR ν i (fW hvt hR ν w) - fW hvt hR ν w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A ν) :
    eK hvt hR ν' i (fW hvt hR ν' w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A ν' ∨
      ∃ w' : List I, eK hvt hR ν' i (fW hvt hR ν' w) - fW hvt hR ν' w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A ν'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ν
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ν'
  simp only at h
  subst h
  exact hmem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.eK_fW_single
statement:
lemma eK_fW_single (Λ : Dom R) (i j : I) :
    eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ [j]) = 0 ∨
      eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ [j]) = IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1
proof:
:= by
  set hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hvn := mem_nodeWt_of_mem (i := j)
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ.1))
  have hf : fW hvt hR Λ [j] =
      dFV (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ j 1 (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1) := by
    have := kashiwaraF_dF (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hvn (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv j) 0
    rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_zero] at this
    rw [fW_cons, fW_nil]
    exact this
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    rw [hf]
    by_cases hp : (0 : ℤ) < Λ.1 (R.coroot i)
    · have := IntegrableSl2.eTilde_dF_succ (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i)
        (V := nodeSl2 R v _ hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i) (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i) hvn
        (j := 0) (by simpa using hp)
      change eK hvt hR Λ i _ = _ at this
      rw [this, IntegrableSl2.dF_zero]
      exact Or.inr rfl
    · rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_eq_zero_of_primitive (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) hvn
        (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i) (by push_cast; omega), map_zero]
      exact Or.inl rfl
  · have hE : E R v i • fW hvt hR Λ [j] = 0 := by
      rw [hf, IntegrableSl2.dF_apply, smul_comm, pow_one]
      change _ • (E R v i • F R v j • IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1) = 0
      have h := E_mul_F_sub R v i j
      simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte, sub_eq_zero] at h
      rw [← mul_smul, h, mul_smul, IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    exact Or.inl (IntegrableSl2.eTilde_of_primitive (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i)
      (V := nodeSl2 R v _ hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i) hE
      (mem_nodeWt_of_mem (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ [j])))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.propB_zero
statement: theorem propB_zero : PropB hvt hR A ϖ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro Λ w hw i
  rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at hw
  subst hw
  left
  have : eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ []) = 0 :=
    IntegrableSl2.eTilde_of_primitive (pow_d_ne_zero i)
      (pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i) (IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv i)
      (mem_nodeWt_of_mem (IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace (R := R) (v := v) (Λ := Λ.1)))
  rw [this]
  exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.propB_one
statement: theorem propB_one : PropB hvt hR A ϖ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro Λ w hw i
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, w = [j] := by
    rcases w with _ | ⟨j, _ | ⟨_, _⟩⟩ <;> simp at hw; exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rcases eK_fW_single (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λ i j with h | h
  · left; rw [h]; exact zero_mem _
  · right; exact ⟨[], by rw [h, fW_nil, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.propB_add_two
statement:
theorem propB_add_two [Finite I] [IsLocalRing A] (hϖ : ϖ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A k))
    (hfund : ∀ j : I, ∃ Λ : Dom R, ∀ i, Λ.1 (R.coroot i) = if i = j then 1 else 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hA : ∀ s ≤ n + 2, PropA hvt hR A s) (hB : ∀ s < n + 2, PropB hvt hR A ϖ s)
    (hC : ∀ s < n + 2, PropC hvt hR A ϖ s) (hE : PropE hvt hR A (n + 1))
    (hF : PropF hvt hR A (n + 1)) (hG : PropG hvt hR A ϖ (n + 1)) :
    PropB hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  set hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  choose Λf hΛf using hfund
  intro Λ w hw i
  have hdeg : (LusztigF.wordWeight w).degree = n + 2 := by rw [degree_wordWeight, hw]
  by_cases hw0 : fW hvt hR Λ w ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
  · exact Or.inl (localE_smul hA Λ hdeg i 0 hϖ0 hw0 (by simpa using fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w))
  obtain ⟨u, a, b, rfl⟩ : ∃ u a b, w = u ++ [a, b] := by
    have hl : (w.drop n).length = 2 := by simp; omega
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ : ∃ a b, w.drop n = [a, b] := by
      match w.drop n, hl with
      | [a, b], _ => exact ⟨a, b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w.take n, a, b, by rw [← hab, List.take_append_drop]⟩
  set w := u ++ [a, b]
  set Λj := Λf a
  have hu : u.length = n := by simp [w] at hw; omega
  have hSB := transportB (ν := Λ + Λj) (ν' := Λj + Λ) (by simp [add_comm]) i w
    (stepB hϖ hϖv hinj hA hB hC hF hG (hΛf a) u hu b i)
  set vv := TensorModule.mk (IrreducibleModule R v Λj.1) (IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1)
    (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λ.1)
  set W := fTw hvt hR Λj Λ w vv
  have hvvw : vv ∈ weightSpace R v (TM v Λj Λ) (Λj.1 + Λ.1 - R.rootSum 0) := by
    simpa using fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λj Λ [] []
  have hWw : W ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λj.1 + Λ.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) := by
    simpa using fTw_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λj Λ w hvvw
  have hmw : TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ w) ∈
      weightSpace R v (TM v Λj Λ) (Λj.1 + Λ.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w)) := by
    simpa using fW_tmul_mem_weightSpace (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) Λj Λ [] w
  have hd := fTw_hwv_tmul hϖ hϖv hinj (Λ₁ := Λj) (Λ₂ := Λ) w (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega))
    (by rwa [hw]) (by rwa [hw]) hw0
  have hE1 : eT hvt hR Λj Λ i W - eT hvt hR Λj Λ i (TensorModule.mk _ _
      (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k] fW hvt hR Λ w)) ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λj Λ := by
    rw [← map_sub]; exact eT_mem_smul_LL hϖ hϖv hA i hdeg hd (sub_mem hWw hmw)
  have hP0 : PropAN hvt hR A ϖ (n + 2) 0 Λ := fun i' w' hw' ↦ by
    simpa using hA (n + 2) le_rfl Λ _ (by rw [degree_wordWeight, hw']) i' _
      (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ.2 A w') (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w')
  obtain ⟨M, ζ, hζw, hζE, hζ2, hye, hζL⟩ := exists_strings_negLat (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega))
    hP0 i hdeg (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ.2 A w) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w)
  have hE2 := eT_hwv_tmul_sub (Λ₁ := Λj) hϖ hϖv i hζw hζE hζ2 hζL
  rw [← hye] at hE2
  have hLL : TensorModule.lattice k A (lat hvt hR A Λj) (negLat (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ 0) ≤
      LL hvt hR A Λj Λ := fun z hz ↦ by simpa using lattice_negLat_right hz
  have hcong : eT hvt hR Λj Λ i W - TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
      eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w)) ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λj Λ := by
    simpa using add_mem hE1 (TensorModule.smul_le_smul_of_le hLL ϖ hE2)
  have hΦW : tensorEmb hvt hR Λj.2 Λ.2 (eK hvt hR (Λj + Λ) i (fW hvt hR (Λj + Λ) w)) =
      eT hvt hR Λj Λ i W := by rw [tensorEmb_eK, tensorEmb_fW]
  have hSapp : ∀ z, TensorModule.mk _ _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R v Λj.1 ⊗ₜ[k]
      eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w)) - z ∈ ϖ • LL hvt hR A Λj Λ →
      eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w) - Sh hvt hR Λj Λ z ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro z hz
    have := Sh_mem_smul hz
    rwa [map_sub, Sh_tmul, IrreducibleModule.form_hwv, one_smul] at this
  have hew := kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR (Λj + Λ)) i
    (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR (Λj + Λ) w)
  
  have hleft : eK hvt hR (Λj + Λ) i (fW hvt hR (Λj + Λ) w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λj + Λ) →
      eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro h
    have h1 := tensorEmb_mem_smul hϖv hE i hdeg h hew
    rw [hΦW] at h1
    simpa using hSapp 0 (by simpa using sub_mem h1 hcong)
  rcases hSB with h | ⟨w', hw'⟩
  · exact Or.inl (hleft h)
  by_cases h0 : eK hvt hR (Λj + Λ) i (fW hvt hR (Λj + Λ) w) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A (Λj + Λ)
  · exact Or.inl (hleft h0)
  obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ := exists_eq_add_single hR hv' (Λj + Λ) (j := 1) (by rwa [one_smul])
    (fun h ↦ h0 (by rw [h]; exact zero_mem _))
  have hew' : eK hvt hR (Λj + Λ) i (fW hvt hR (Λj + Λ) w) ∈ wsp (Λj + Λ) ν' := by
    convert hew using 2
    rw [hν', R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]; abel
  have hw'ν := wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem hvt hR A ϖ (Λj + Λ) hew' h0 hw'
  have hw'len : w'.length = n + 1 := by
    rw [← degree_wordWeight, hw'ν]
    have := hdeg; rw [hν', map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at this; omega
  have h1 := tensorEmb_mem_smul hϖv hE i hdeg hw' (sub_mem hew (by
    convert fW_mem_wsp hvt hR (Λj + Λ) w' using 2
    rw [hw'ν, hν', R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]; abel))
  rw [map_sub, hΦW, tensorEmb_fW] at h1
  have h2 := hSapp _ (by simpa using sub_mem h1 hcong)
  have h3 := Sh_fTw_sub hϖ hϖv (Λ₁ := Λj) (Λ₂ := Λ) w' (fun s hs ↦ hA s (by omega))
    (fun s hs ↦ hB s (by omega)) (fun s hs ↦ hC s (by omega))
  exact Or.inr ⟨w', by simpa using add_mem h2 h3⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.form_dF_succ
statement:
lemma form_dF_succ {B : LinearMap.BilinForm k M}
    (hF : ∀ (p : ℤ) x y, y ∈ V.wt p → B (V.F x) y = q ^ (-(p + 1)) * B x (V.E y))
    (r : ℕ) (x y : M) {p : ℤ} (hy : y ∈ V.wt p) :
    B (V.dF (r + 1) x) y = (qInt q (r + 1))⁻¹ * q ^ (-(p + 1)) * B (V.dF r x) (V.E y)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := qInt_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos r)
  have h : V.dF (r + 1) x = (qInt q (r + 1))⁻¹ • V.F (V.dF r x) := by
    rw [F_dF hq0 hq, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul]
  rw [h, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hF p _ _ hy, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.form_dF_dF
statement:
theorem form_dF_dF {B : LinearMap.BilinForm k M} (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (hF : ∀ (p : ℤ) x y, y ∈ V.wt p → B (V.F x) y = q ^ (-(p + 1)) * B x (V.E y))
    {p n : ℤ} {η ζ : M} (hη : η ∈ V.prim p) (hζ : ζ ∈ V.prim n) :
    ∀ r s, B (V.dF r η) (V.dF s ζ) = if r = s then polCoef q n r * B η ζ else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro s
    rcases s with _ | s
    · simp [polCoef]
    · rw [hB, form_dF_succ hq0 hq hF s ζ _ (by simpa using hη.1), dF_zero, hη.2, map_zero,
        mul_zero]
      simp
  | succ r ih =>
    intro s
    rcases s with _ | s
    · rw [form_dF_succ hq0 hq hF r η _ (by simpa using hζ.1), dF_zero, hζ.2, map_zero, mul_zero]
      simp
    · have hs : V.dF (s + 1) ζ ∈ V.wt (n - 2 * (s + 1 : ℕ)) := V.dF_mem hζ.1 _
      rw [form_dF_succ hq0 hq hF r η _ hs, E_dF_succ_of_primitive hq0 hq hζ.1 hζ.2, map_smul,
        smul_eq_mul, ih s]
      by_cases h : r = s
      · subst h
        simp only [↓reduceIte, polCoef]
        rw [show -((n - 2 * ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) + 1) = 2 * (r : ℤ) + 1 - n by push_cast; ring]
        ring
      · simp [h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.qIntZ_eq_qInt_inv
statement: lemma qIntZ_eq_qInt_inv (m : ℕ) : qIntZ q m = qInt q⁻¹ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← qIntZ_inv, qIntZ_natCast]
  rw [inv_inv, ← neg_sub]
  exact neg_ne_zero.2 (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.isOnePow_polCoef
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : algebraMap A k w ≠ 0 := by rw [hwq]; exact inv_ne_zero hq0
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero => intro _; exact isOnePow_one
  | succ r ih =>
    intro hr
    have h1 : IsOnePow w r (qInt q (r + 1))⁻¹ := by
      have h := (isOnePow_qInt hw0 (Nat.succ_pos r)).inv hw
      rw [hwq, ← qIntZ_eq_qInt_inv hq0 hq, qIntZ_natCast (sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq)]
        at h
      convert h using 1; push_cast; ring
    have h2 : IsOnePow w (n - 2 * r - 1) (q ^ (2 * (r : ℤ) + 1 - n)) := by
      have h := isOnePow_zpow (k := k) (ϖ := w) (n - 2 * r - 1)
      rw [hwq, inv_zpow', show -(n - 2 * (r : ℤ) - 1) = 2 * r + 1 - n by ring] at h
      exact h
    have h3 : IsOnePow w (1 - (n - r)) (qIntZ q (n - r)) := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, n - r = m := ⟨(n - r).toNat, by omega⟩
      have h := isOnePow_qInt hw0 (n := m) (by omega)
      rw [hwq, ← qIntZ_eq_qInt_inv hq0 hq] at h
      rw [hm]; exact h
    have h := (ih (by omega)).mul hw0 ((h1.mul hw0 h2).mul hw0 h3)
    rw [polCoef]
    convert h using 1; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.form_dF_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum, sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ form_dF_dF hq0 hq hB hF hη (hζ s) r s]
  simp [mem_range.2 hr]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.form_fTilde_sum
statement:
lemma form_fTilde_sum {n m : ℤ} {η ζ : ℕ → M} (hη : ∀ j : ℕ, η j ∈ V.prim (n + 2 * j))
    (hζ : ∀ s : ℕ, ζ s ∈ V.prim (m + 2 * s)) (N : ℕ) :
    B (V.fTilde hq0 hq (∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF j (η j))) (∑ s ∈ range (N + 1), V.dF s (ζ s)) =
      ∑ j ∈ range N, polCoef q (m + 2 * (j + 1 : ℕ)) (j + 1) * B (η j) (ζ (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum (V.fTilde hq0 hq), map_sum B, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
  rw [fTilde_dF hq0 hq (hη j).2 (hη j).1,
    form_dF_sum hq0 hq hB hF (hη j) hζ (by have := mem_range.1 hj; omega)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.form_sum_eTilde
statement:
lemma form_sum_eTilde {n m : ℤ} {η ζ : ℕ → M} (hη : ∀ j : ℕ, η j ∈ V.prim (n + 2 * j))
    (hζ : ∀ s : ℕ, ζ s ∈ V.prim (m + 2 * s)) (hζ' : ∀ s : ℕ, ζ s ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ m + s) (N : ℕ) :
    B (∑ j ∈ range N, V.dF j (η j)) (V.eTilde hq0 hq (∑ s ∈ range (N + 1), V.dF s (ζ s))) =
      ∑ j ∈ range N, polCoef q (m + 2 * (j + 1 : ℕ)) j * B (η j) (ζ (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eTilde_sum hq0 hq hζ hζ' N, map_sum B, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hζ1 : ∀ s : ℕ, ζ (s + 1) ∈ V.prim (m + 2 + 2 * s) := fun s ↦ by
    convert hζ (s + 1) using 2; push_cast; ring
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
  rw [form_dF_sum hq0 hq hB hF (hη j) hζ1 (mem_range.1 hj)]
  congr 2; push_cast; ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsContravariant.nodeSl2_F
statement:
lemma IsContravariant.nodeSl2_F (hB : IsContravariant R v B) (i : I) (p : ℤ) (x y : M)
    (hy : y ∈ (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).wt p) :
    B ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).F x) y =
      (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-(p + 1)) * B x ((nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).E y)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : E R v i • y ∈ nodeWt R v M i (p + 2) := (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).E_mem hy
  change B (F R v i • x) y = _ * B x (E R v i • y)
  rw [hB, rho_F, rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul, K_neg_ktilde_smul_of_mem_nodeWt hE, smul_smul,
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  have h0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  rw [show -(p + 1) = 1 + -(p + 2) by ring, zpow_add₀ h0, zpow_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_range_eq_of_le
proof:
:= by
  refine sum_subset (range_mono hN) fun j _ hj ↦ ?_
  rw [hη j (by simpa using hj), hf]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsContravariant.exists_strings
statement:
theorem IsContravariant.exists_strings (hB : IsContravariant R v B) (hBs : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (i : I) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} {x y : M} (hx : x ∈ weightSpace R v M μ)
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace R v M (μ - R.root i)) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (η ζ : ℕ → M),
      (∀ j : ℕ, η j ∈ weightSpace R v M (μ + j • R.root i)) ∧ (∀ j, E R v i • η j = 0) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, η j ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ μ (R.coroot i) + j) ∧
      (∀ s : ℕ, ζ s ∈ weightSpace R v M (μ - R.root i + s • R.root i)) ∧
      (∀ s, E R v i • ζ s = 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℕ, ζ s ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ (μ - R.root i) (R.coroot i) + s) ∧
      x = ∑ j ∈ range N, (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF j (η j) ∧
      y = ∑ s ∈ range (N + 1), (nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i).dF s (ζ s) ∧
      B (kashiwaraF R v M hv hM i x) y = ∑ j ∈ range N,
        IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) (j + 1) * B (η j) (ζ (j + 1)) ∧
      B x (kashiwaraE R v M hv hM i y) = ∑ j ∈ range N,
        IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) j * B (η j) (ζ (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, η, h1, hE, h2, hN₁, hxs⟩ := exists_sum_dF_weight hv hM i hx
  obtain ⟨N₂, ζ, h1', hE', h2', hN₂, hys⟩ := exists_sum_dF_weight hv hM i hy
  set V := nodeSl2 R v M hv hM i
  have hxN : x = ∑ j ∈ range (max N₁ N₂), V.dF j (η j) := by
    rw [hxs]; exact sum_range_eq_of_le (fun j ↦ map_zero _) (le_max_left _ _) hN₁
  have hyN : y = ∑ s ∈ range (max N₁ N₂ + 1), V.dF s (ζ s) := by
    rw [hys]
    exact sum_range_eq_of_le (fun j ↦ map_zero _) (by have := le_max_right N₁ N₂; omega) hN₂
  have hηp : ∀ j : ℕ, η j ∈ V.prim (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) := fun j ↦
    ⟨mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i (h1 j), hE j⟩
  have hζp : ∀ s : ℕ, ζ s ∈ V.prim ((μ - R.root i) (R.coroot i) + 2 * s) := fun s ↦
    ⟨mem_nodeWt_of_mem_add_nsmul i (h1' s), hE' s⟩
  have hF : ∀ (p : ℤ) x y, y ∈ V.wt p →
      B (V.F x) y = (v ^ D.d i) ^ (-(p + 1)) * B x (V.E y) := fun p x y hy ↦
    IsContravariant.nodeSl2_F hv hM hB i p x y hy
  have hm : ∀ j : ℕ, (μ - R.root i) (R.coroot i) + 2 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j := fun j ↦ by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self]; push_cast; ring
  refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, η, ζ, h1, hE, h2, h1', hE', h2', hxN, hyN, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change B (V.fTilde (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv i) x) y = _
    rw [hxN, hyN, IntegrableSl2.form_fTilde_sum (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv i) hBs hF hηp
      hζp]
    simp only [hm]
  · change B x (V.eTilde (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv i) y) = _
    rw [hxN, hyN, IntegrableSl2.form_sum_eTilde (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv i) hBs hF hηp
      hζp h2']
    simp only [hm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_polCoef
statement:
lemma exists_polCoef [IsLocalRing A] (hϖ : ϖ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hϖv : algebraMap A k ϖ = v⁻¹) (hv' : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) {n : ℤ} {r : ℕ}
    (hr : (r : ℤ) ≤ n) :
    ∃ a : A, IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) n r = algebraMap A k (1 + ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := D.d_pos i
  set w := ϖ ^ D.d i with hw_def
  have hw : w ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ hϖ _ hd
  have hwv : algebraMap A k w = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ := by rw [map_pow, hϖv, inv_pow]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IntegrableSl2.isOnePow_polCoef (pow_d_ne_zero i) (pow_d_ne_one hv' i) hw hwv
    r hr
  obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ : ∃ d', D.d i = d' + 1 := ⟨D.d i - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨ϖ ^ d' * a, ?_⟩
  rw [ha, zpow_zero, one_mul, hw_def, hd', pow_succ]
  ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_span_fW_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hP : ∀ z ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ, weightSetProj (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)
      (isInt hvt hR Λ) {Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν} z ∈
        Submodule.span A (fW hvt hR Λ '' {w | LusztigF.wordWeight w = ν}) := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
      rw [weightSetProj_fW (hvt := hvt)]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, h, rfl⟩
      · exact zero_mem _
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul c a _ ha => rw [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha
  have := hP x hx
  rw [weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ hxw] at this
  simpa using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.exists_strings_lat
statement:
lemma exists_strings_lat (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) {μ : Y →+ ℤ} {x y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1}
    (hxL : x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) (hx : x ∈ weightSpace R v _ μ) (hyL : y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (hy : y ∈ weightSpace R v _ (μ - R.root i)) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (η ζ : ℕ → IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1),
      (∀ j < N, η j ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) ∧ (∀ j < N, ζ (j + 1) ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, η j ∈ weightSpace R v _ (μ + j • R.root i)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ζ (j + 1) ∈ weightSpace R v _ (μ + j • R.root i)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ζ (j + 1) ≠ 0 → ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) ∧
      formL hvt hR Λ (fK hvt hR Λ i x) y = ∑ j ∈ range N,
        IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) (j + 1) *
          formL hvt hR Λ (η j) (ζ (j + 1)) ∧
      formL hvt hR Λ x (eK hvt hR Λ i y) = ∑ j ∈ range N,
        IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) j *
          formL hvt hR Λ (η j) (ζ (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hall := allProp (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  obtain ⟨N, η, ζ, h1, hE, h2, h1', hE', h2', hxs, hys, hf, he⟩ :=
    (IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR hv').exists_strings hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ)
      (IrreducibleModule.form_comm hR hv') i hx hy
  have hfL : ∀ y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ, fK hvt hR Λ i y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := fun _ hy ↦
    kashiwaraF_mem_lat Λ i hy
  have heL : ∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ, y ∈ weightSpace R v _ (μ + j • R.root i) →
      eK hvt hR Λ i y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := fun _ _ hy _ ↦
    kashiwaraE_mem_lat (fun r ↦ (hall r).1) Λ i hy
  have heL' : ∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ,
      y ∈ weightSpace R v _ (μ - R.root i + j • R.root i) → eK hvt hR Λ i y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ :=
    fun _ _ hy _ ↦ kashiwaraE_mem_lat (fun r ↦ (hall r).1) Λ i hy
  have hηL := mem_of_sum_mem_weight hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i hfL N μ η h1 hE h2 heL (hxs ▸ hxL)
  have hζL := mem_of_sum_mem_weight hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i hfL (N + 1) (μ - R.root i) ζ h1' hE'
    h2' heL' (hys ▸ hyL)
  have hc : (μ - R.root i) (R.coroot i) = μ (R.coroot i) - 2 := by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self]
  refine ⟨N, η, ζ, hηL, fun j hj ↦ hζL (j + 1) (by omega), h1, fun j ↦ ?_, fun j hj ↦ ?_, hf, he⟩
  · have e : μ - R.root i + (j + 1) • R.root i = μ + j • R.root i := by rw [succ_nsmul]; abel
    exact e ▸ h1' (j + 1)
  · have := h2' (j + 1) hj
    rw [hc] at this
    push_cast at this ⊢
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.formL_mem_of_mem_wsp
statement:
theorem formL_mem_of_mem_wsp (Λ : Dom R) : ∀ n (ν : I →₀ ℕ), ν.degree = n →
    ∀ x y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1, x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ → x ∈ wsp Λ ν →
      y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ → y ∈ wsp Λ ν → ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ x y = algebraMap A k a
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro ν hν x y hxL hxw hyL hyw
  have hspan := mem_span_fW_of_mem hxL hxw
  clear hxL hxw
  induction hspan using Submodule.span_induction with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨p + q, by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hp, hq, map_add]⟩
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨c * p, by
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k c a, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hp, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]⟩
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
    rcases w with _ | ⟨i, w₁⟩
    · exact exists_form_hwv (hvt := hvt) hyL
    · have hνe : ν = LusztigF.wordWeight w₁ + Finsupp.single i 1 := by
        rw [← (show LusztigF.wordWeight _ = ν from hw), LusztigF.wordWeight_cons, add_comm]
      have e2 : R.rootSum ν = R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w₁) + R.root i := by
        rw [hνe, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_nsmul]
      set μ := Λ.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w₁) with hμ
      have hy' : y ∈ weightSpace R v _ (μ - R.root i) := by
        have : μ - R.root i = Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν := by rw [hμ, e2]; abel
        rw [this]; exact hyw
      obtain ⟨N, η, ζ, hηL, hζL, hηw, hζw, hζn, hf, -⟩ := exists_strings_lat hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
        Λ i (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A w₁) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w₁) hyL hy'
      rw [fW_cons, hf]
      have hterm : ∀ j ∈ range N, ∃ a : A,
          IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) (j + 1) *
            formL hvt hR Λ (η j) (ζ (j + 1)) = algebraMap A k a := by
        intro j hj
        by_cases hz : ζ (j + 1) = 0
        · exact ⟨0, by simp [hz]⟩
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_polCoef hϖ hϖv hv' i (hζn j hz)
        have hzw : ζ (j + 1) ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν + (j + 1) • R.root i) := by
          have : Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν + (j + 1) • R.root i = μ + j • R.root i := by
            rw [hμ, e2, succ_nsmul]; abel
          rw [this]; exact hζw j
        obtain ⟨ν'', hν''⟩ := exists_eq_add_single hR hv' Λ hzw hz
        have hdeg : ν''.degree < n := by
          rw [← hν, hν'', map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]; omega
        have hw'' : Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν'' = μ + j • R.root i := by
          have e1 : R.rootSum ν = R.rootSum ν'' + (j + 1) • R.root i := by
            rw [hν'', R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single]
          calc Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν'' = Λ.1 - (R.rootSum ν'' + (j + 1) • R.root i) +
                (j + 1) • R.root i := by abel
            _ = μ + j • R.root i := by rw [← e1, e2, hμ, succ_nsmul]; abel
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ih _ hdeg ν'' rfl (η j) (ζ (j + 1)) (hηL j (mem_range.1 hj))
          (show η j ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν'') by rw [hw'']; exact hηw j)
          (hζL j (mem_range.1 hj))
          (show ζ (j + 1) ∈ weightSpace R v _ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν'') by rw [hw'']; exact hζw j)
        exact ⟨(1 + ϖ * c) * a, by rw [hc, ha, map_mul]⟩
      choose! a ha using hterm
      exact ⟨∑ j ∈ range N, a j, by rw [map_sum]; exact sum_congr rfl ha⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.formL_mem
statement:
theorem formL_mem (Λ : Dom R) {x y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1} (hx : x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (hy : y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) : ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ x y = algebraMap A k a
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨p + q, by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hp, hq, map_add]⟩
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨c * p, by
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k c a, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hp, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]⟩
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨p + q, by rw [map_add, hp, hq, map_add]⟩
    | smul c a _ ha =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
      exact ⟨c * p, by rw [← algebraMap_smul k c a, map_smul, hp, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]⟩
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w₂, rfl⟩ := hy
      by_cases h : LusztigF.wordWeight w₁ = LusztigF.wordWeight w₂
      · exact formL_mem_of_mem_wsp hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ _ _ rfl _ _
          (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A w₁) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w₁)
          (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A w₂) (h ▸ fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w₂)
      · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        rw [map_zero]
        refine (IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR hv').eq_zero_of_ne (fun e ↦ h ?_)
          (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w₁) (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w₂) hv'
        exact LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR (sub_right_injective e)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.formL_mem_smul
statement:
lemma formL_mem_smul (Λ : Dom R) {x y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1} (hx : x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (hy : y ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ) : ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ x y = algebraMap A k (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := formL_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hx hy₀
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [← algebraMap_smul k ϖ y₀, map_smul, ha, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.formL_smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [IrreducibleModule.form_comm]
  exact formL_mem_smul hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hy hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.formL_fK_sub_eK_mem
statement:
theorem formL_fK_sub_eK_mem (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) {x y : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1}
    (hx : x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) (hy : y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) :
    ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ (fK hvt hR Λ i x) y - formL hvt hR Λ x (eK hvt hR Λ i y) =
      algebraMap A k (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨p + q, by
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, mul_add]
      rw [← hp, ← hq]
      ring⟩
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨c * p, by
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k c a]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_sub, hp, ← map_mul]
      ring_nf⟩
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨w₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨p + q, by simp only [map_add, mul_add]; rw [← hp, ← hq]; ring⟩
    | smul c a _ ha =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
      exact ⟨c * p, by
        rw [← algebraMap_smul k c a]
        simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← mul_sub, hp, ← map_mul]
        ring_nf⟩
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w₂, rfl⟩ := hy
      set μ := Λ.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w₁)
      have hx' : fW hvt hR Λ w₁ ∈ weightSpace R v _ μ := fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w₁
      have hy₀ := fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w₂
      by_cases h : Λ.1 - R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w₂) = μ - R.root i
      · obtain ⟨N, η, ζ, hηL, hζL, -, -, hζn, hf, he⟩ := exists_strings_lat hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
          Λ i (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A w₁) hx'
          (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A w₂) (h ▸ hy₀)
        rw [hf, he, ← sum_sub_distrib]
        have hterm : ∀ j ∈ range N, ∃ a : A,
            IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) (j + 1) *
              formL hvt hR Λ (η j) (ζ (j + 1)) -
            IntegrableSl2.polCoef (v ^ D.d i) (μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) j *
              formL hvt hR Λ (η j) (ζ (j + 1)) = algebraMap A k (ϖ * a) := by
          intro j hj
          by_cases hz : ζ (j + 1) = 0
          · exact ⟨0, by simp [hz]⟩
          have h1 := hζn j hz
          obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ := exists_polCoef hϖ hϖv hv' i h1
          obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := exists_polCoef hϖ hϖv hv' i (n := μ (R.coroot i) + 2 * j) (r := j)
            (by push_cast at h1; omega)
          obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := formL_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ (hηL j (mem_range.1 hj))
            (hζL j (mem_range.1 hj))
          exact ⟨(c₁ - c₀) * b, by
            rw [hc₁, hc₀, hb, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_sub]; ring_nf⟩
        choose! a ha using hterm
        exact ⟨∑ j ∈ range N, a j, by rw [mul_sum, map_sum]; exact sum_congr rfl ha⟩
      · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        have hf0 : formL hvt hR Λ (fK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w₁)) (fW hvt hR Λ w₂) = 0 :=
          (IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR hv').eq_zero_of_ne (Ne.symm h)
            (kashiwaraF_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i hx') hy₀ hv'
        have he0 : formL hvt hR Λ (fW hvt hR Λ w₁) (eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w₂)) = 0 :=
          (IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR hv').eq_zero_of_ne
            (fun e ↦ h (by rw [e]; abel)) hx'
            (kashiwaraE_mem_weightSpace hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) i hy₀) hv'
        rw [hf0, he0]; simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.formL_fW_fW
statement:
theorem formL_fW_fW (Λ : Dom R) (w w' : List I) (hw : fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (hw' : fW hvt hR Λ w' ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ) :
    ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ (fW hvt hR Λ w) (fW hvt hR Λ w') =
      (if fW hvt hR Λ w - fW hvt hR Λ w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ then 1 else 0) +
        algebraMap A k (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hall := allProp (hvt := hvt) (hR := hR) hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hL : ∀ w, fW hvt hR Λ w ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A
  induction w generalizing w' with
  | nil =>
    by_cases hw'n : w' = []
    · subst hw'n
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · have hnot : fW hvt hR Λ [] - fW hvt hR Λ w' ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := fun h ↦ by
        have h0 := wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem hvt hR A ϖ Λ (hwv_mem_wsp Λ) hw h
        exact hw'n (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by rw [← degree_wordWeight, h0, map_zero]))
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      simp only [hnot, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero, map_zero, add_zero]
      exact form_hwv_fW (hvt := hvt) Λ hw'n
  | cons i w₀ ih =>
    have hw₀ : fW hvt hR Λ w₀ ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := fun h ↦
      hw (by rw [fW_cons]; exact kashiwaraF_mem_smul_lat Λ i h)
    have hC : ∀ r, PropC hvt hR A ϖ r := fun r ↦ (hall r).2.2.1
    obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := formL_fK_sub_eK_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ i (hL w₀) (hL w')
    rw [← fW_cons] at ha₁
    have hcase : eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w') ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ ∨
        ∃ w₁, fW hvt hR Λ w₁ ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ ∧
          eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w') - fW hvt hR Λ w₁ ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
      rcases (hall w'.length).2.1 Λ w' rfl i with h | ⟨w₁, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · by_cases h₁ : fW hvt hR Λ w₁ ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
        · exact Or.inl (by simpa using add_mem h h₁)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨w₁, h₁, h⟩
    rcases hcase with h | ⟨w₁, hw₁, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂⟩ := formL_mem_smul hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ (hL w₀) h
      have hnot : fW hvt hR Λ (i :: w₀) - fW hvt hR Λ w' ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := fun h' ↦ by
        have := (fK_sub_mem_iff hC Λ i hw₀ hw').1 h'
        exact hw₀ (by simpa using sub_mem h this)
      refine ⟨a₁ + a₂, ?_⟩
      simp only [hnot, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
      rw [mul_add, map_add, ← ha₁, ← ha₂]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂⟩ := formL_mem_smul hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ (hL w₀) h
      obtain ⟨a₃, ha₃⟩ := ih w₁ hw₀ hw₁
      have hiff : fW hvt hR Λ w₀ - fW hvt hR Λ w₁ ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ ↔
          fW hvt hR Λ (i :: w₀) - fW hvt hR Λ w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
        constructor
        · intro h'
          refine (fK_sub_mem_iff hC Λ i hw₀ hw').2 ?_
          have := sub_mem h h'
          convert this using 1; abel
        · intro h'
          have := sub_mem ((fK_sub_mem_iff hC Λ i hw₀ hw').1 h') h
          convert neg_mem this using 1; abel
      refine ⟨a₁ + a₂ + a₃, ?_⟩
      rw [← hiff]
      have e : formL hvt hR Λ (fW hvt hR Λ w₀) (eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w')) =
          formL hvt hR Λ (fW hvt hR Λ w₀) (eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ w') - fW hvt hR Λ w₁) +
            formL hvt hR Λ (fW hvt hR Λ w₀) (fW hvt hR Λ w₁) := by
        rw [map_sub]; ring
      rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq ha₁, e, ha₂, ha₃]
      simp only [map_add, map_mul]
      ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_smul_lat_of_formL_mem
statement:
theorem mem_smul_lat_of_formL_mem (Λ : Dom R) {z : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1}
    (hz : z ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (h : ∀ w, fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ →
      ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ z (fW hvt hR Λ w) = algebraMap A k (ϖ * a)) :
    z ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hL : ∀ w, fW hvt hR Λ w ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A
  set P := ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1 hz
  set W := c.support.filter fun w ↦ fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ P
  obtain ⟨S, hSW, hSd, hcov⟩ := exists_reps_mod P (fW hvt hR Λ) W
  choose! r hrS hr using hcov
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : List I → A, ∀ s, a s = ∑ w ∈ W with r w = s, c w := ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  set y := ∑ s ∈ S, a s • fW hvt hR Λ s with hy
  have hy' : y = ∑ w ∈ W, c w • fW hvt hR Λ (r w) := by
    rw [hy, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := r) (t := S) hrS]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [ha, Finset.sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hw).2]
  have hzy : z - y ∈ P := by
    rw [hy', ← hc, Finsupp.sum, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not c.support
      (fun w ↦ fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ P), add_sub_right_comm, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w hw ↦ ?_) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w hw ↦ ?_)
    · rw [← smul_sub]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hr w hw)
    · have := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hw).2
      push Not at this
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ this
  choose! e he using fun s' (hs' : s' ∈ S) s (hs : s ∈ S) ↦
    formL_fW_fW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ s' s (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hSW hs')).2
      (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hSW hs)).2
  have hyP : ∀ s ∈ S, a s ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ} := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ := h s (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hSW hs)).2
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := formL_smul_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hzy (hL s)
    have key : ∀ s' ∈ S, formL hvt hR Λ (a s' • fW hvt hR Λ s') (fW hvt hR Λ s) =
        (if s' = s then algebraMap A k (a s) else 0) +
          algebraMap A k (ϖ * (a s' * e s' s)) := by
      intro s' hs'
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, he s' hs' s hs, smul_eq_mul]
      by_cases hss : s' = s
      · subst hss; simp only [sub_self, zero_mem, ↓reduceIte, map_mul]; ring
      · have hn : fW hvt hR Λ s' - fW hvt hR Λ s ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := hSd s' hs' s hs hss
        simp only [hn, hss, ↓reduceIte, map_mul]; ring
    have hyy : formL hvt hR Λ y (fW hvt hR Λ s) = algebraMap A k (a s) +
        algebraMap A k (ϖ * ∑ s' ∈ S, a s' * e s' s) := by
      rw [hy, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl key, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq' S s]
      simp only [hs, ↓reduceIte, mul_sum, map_sum]
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨t₀ - t₁ - ∑ s' ∈ S, a s' * e s' s, hinj ?_⟩
    have e1 : formL hvt hR Λ z (fW hvt hR Λ s) =
        formL hvt hR Λ (z - y) (fW hvt hR Λ s) + formL hvt hR Λ y (fW hvt hR Λ s) := by
      rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]; ring
    rw [ht₀, ht₁, hyy] at e1
    simp only [map_mul, map_sub] at e1 ⊢
    linear_combination e1
  have hyS : y ∈ P := by
    rw [hy]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s hs ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (hyP s hs)
    rw [← hb, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hL s))
  simpa using add_mem hzy hyS

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_lat_iff_formL_mem
statement:
theorem mem_lat_iff_formL_mem (Λ : Dom R) (u : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1) :
    u ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ ↔
      ∀ y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ, ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ u y = algebraMap A k a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun hu y hy ↦ formL_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hu hy, fun hu ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hL : ∀ w, fW hvt hR Λ w ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ϖ ^ n • u ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := DualLattice.exists_pow_smul_mem hk
    (by rw [IrreducibleModule.span_lattice]; trivial)
  set n := Nat.find hex with hn
  have hxL : ϖ ^ n • u ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hnot (by simpa [h] using hxL)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
  have hmL : ϖ ^ m • u ∉ lat hvt hR A Λ := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  refine hmL ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1
    (mem_smul_lat_of_formL_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hxL fun w _ ↦ by
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hu _ (hL w)
      refine ⟨ϖ ^ m * a, ?_⟩
      rw [← algebraMap_smul k, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha, smul_eq_mul, ← map_mul, hm,
        pow_succ', mul_assoc])
  have : y = ϖ ^ m • u := by
    have e : (algebraMap A k ϖ) • y = (algebraMap A k ϖ) • (ϖ ^ m • u) := by
      rw [algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul, hyx, hm, pow_succ', mul_smul]
    exact smul_right_injective _ hϖ0 e
  exact this ▸ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_smul_lat_of_formL_self_mem
statement:
theorem mem_smul_lat_of_formL_self_mem [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (Λ : Dom R)
    {z : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1} (hz : z ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) {b₀ : A}
    (hzz : formL hvt hR Λ z z = algebraMap A k (ϖ * b₀)) :
    z ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hL : ∀ w, fW hvt hR Λ w ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A
  set P := ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1 hz
  set W := c.support.filter fun w ↦ fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ P
  obtain ⟨S, hSW, hSd, hcov⟩ := exists_reps_mod P (fW hvt hR Λ) W
  choose! r hrS hr using hcov
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : List I → A, ∀ s, a s = ∑ w ∈ W with r w = s, c w := ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  set y := ∑ s ∈ S, a s • fW hvt hR Λ s with hy
  have hy' : y = ∑ w ∈ W, c w • fW hvt hR Λ (r w) := by
    rw [hy, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := r) (t := S) hrS]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [ha, Finset.sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hw).2]
  have hzy : z - y ∈ P := by
    rw [hy', ← hc, Finsupp.sum, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not c.support
      (fun w ↦ fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ P), add_sub_right_comm, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w hw ↦ ?_) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w hw ↦ ?_)
    · rw [← smul_sub]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hr w hw)
    · have := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hw).2
      push Not at this
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ this
  have hyL : y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hL s)
  
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := formL_mem_smul hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hz hzy
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := formL_smul_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hzy hyL
  have hzy' : formL hvt hR Λ z z - formL hvt hR Λ y y = algebraMap A k (ϖ * (t₁ + t₂)) := by
    have : formL hvt hR Λ z z - formL hvt hR Λ y y =
        formL hvt hR Λ z (z - y) + formL hvt hR Λ (z - y) y := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]; ring
    rw [this, ht₁, ht₂, ← map_add, mul_add]
  
  choose! e he using fun s' (hs' : s' ∈ S) s (hs : s ∈ S) ↦
    formL_fW_fW hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ s' s (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hSW hs')).2
      (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hSW hs)).2
  have key : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ s' ∈ S, formL hvt hR Λ (a s • fW hvt hR Λ s) (a s' • fW hvt hR Λ s') =
      (if s = s' then algebraMap A k (a s ^ 2) else 0) +
        algebraMap A k (ϖ * (a s * a s' * e s s')) := by
    intro s hs s' hs'
    rw [← algebraMap_smul k (a s), ← algebraMap_smul k (a s'), map_smul, map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, he s hs s' hs', smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hss : s = s'
    · subst hss; simp only [sub_self, zero_mem, ↓reduceIte, map_mul, map_pow]; ring
    · have hn : fW hvt hR Λ s - fW hvt hR Λ s' ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := hSd s hs s' hs' hss
      simp only [hn, hss, ↓reduceIte, map_mul]; ring
  have hyy : formL hvt hR Λ y y = algebraMap A k (∑ s ∈ S, a s ^ 2) +
      algebraMap A k (ϖ * ∑ s ∈ S, ∑ s' ∈ S, a s * a s' * e s s') := by
    rw [hy]
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s' hs' ↦ key s hs s' hs']
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ by simp [hs]
  
  have hsum : ∑ s ∈ S, a s ^ 2 ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ} := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨b₀ - (t₁ + t₂) - ∑ s ∈ S, ∑ s' ∈ S, a s * a s' * e s s', ?_⟩
    apply hinj
    have h1 := hzy'
    rw [hzz, hyy] at h1
    simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_add] at h1 ⊢
    linear_combination h1
  have hall : ∀ s ∈ S, a s ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ} := by
    intro s hs
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    refine eq_zero_of_sum_sq_eq_zero S (fun s ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (a s)) ?_ s hs
    simp only [← map_pow, ← map_sum]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hsum
  have hyS : y ∈ P := by
    rw [hy]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s hs ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (hall s hs)
    rw [← hb, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hL s))
  simpa using add_mem hzy hyS

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.GrandLoop.mem_lat_iff_formL_self_mem
statement:
theorem mem_lat_iff_formL_self_mem [IsFormallyReal (A ⧸ Ideal.span {ϖ})] (Λ : Dom R)
    (u : IrreducibleModule R v Λ.1) :
    u ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ ↔ ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ u u = algebraMap A k a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun hu ↦ formL_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hu hu, fun ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ϖ ^ n • u ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := DualLattice.exists_pow_smul_mem hk
    (by rw [IrreducibleModule.span_lattice]; trivial)
  set n := Nat.find hex with hn
  have hxL : ϖ ^ n • u ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hnot (by simpa [h] using hxL)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
  have hmL : ϖ ^ m • u ∉ lat hvt hR A Λ := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A k ϖ ≠ 0 := by rw [hϖv]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne v)
  have hxx : formL hvt hR Λ (ϖ ^ n • u) (ϖ ^ n • u) =
      algebraMap A k (ϖ * (ϖ ^ (2 * n - 1) * a₀)) := by
    simp only [← algebraMap_smul k (ϖ ^ n) u, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha₀, smul_eq_mul]
    have e2 : n + n = 2 * n - 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_succ', e2]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1
    (mem_smul_lat_of_formL_self_mem hinj hϖ hϖv hk hfund Λ hxL hxx)
  refine hmL ?_
  have : y = ϖ ^ m • u := by
    have e : (algebraMap A k ϖ) • y = (algebraMap A k ϖ) • (ϖ ^ m • u) := by
      rw [algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul, hyx, hm, pow_succ', mul_smul]
    exact smul_right_injective _ hϖ0 e
  exact this ▸ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.unop_opZ_algebraMap
statement:
lemma unop_opZ_algebraMap (c : k) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    (opZ D v z (algebraMap k _ c)).unop y = c • y
proof:
:= by
  simp [opZ, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.unop_opZ_θ
statement:
lemma unop_opZ_θ (j : I) (y : LusztigF k I) :
    (opZ D v z (θ k j)).unop y = Lop D v j y - z j • Rop D v j y
proof:
:= by
  simp [opZ, θ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.unop_opZ_mul
statement:
lemma unop_opZ_mul (a b y : LusztigF k I) :
    (opZ D v z (a * b)).unop y = (opZ D v z b).unop ((opZ D v z a).unop y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map_mul, MulOpposite.unop_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.unop_opZ_add
statement:
lemma unop_opZ_add (a b y : LusztigF k I) :
    (opZ D v z (a + b)).unop y = (opZ D v z a).unop y + (opZ D v z b).unop y
proof:
:= by
  simp [map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.exists_unop_opZ_mul_θ
statement:
lemma exists_unop_opZ_mul_θ {i : I} (hz : z i = 1) (a : LusztigF k I) :
    ∀ y, ∃ y', (opZ D v z a).unop (y * θ k i) = y' * θ k i
proof:
:= by
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => exact fun y ↦ ⟨c • y, by rw [unop_opZ_algebraMap, smul_mul_assoc]⟩
  | grade1 j =>
    intro y
    refine ⟨thetaNorm D v j • lDeriv D v j y - z j • ((v ^ D.d j * (qDenom D v j)⁻¹) •
      (v ^ D.dot j i • v ^ D.dot j i • twist D v j (rDeriv D v j y))), ?_⟩
    have hθ : ι k j = θ k j := rfl
    rw [hθ, unop_opZ_θ, Lop, Rop, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, lDeriv_mul, rDeriv_mul_θ, lDeriv_θ,
      map_add, map_smul, map_mul, twist_θ]
    by_cases h : j = i
    · subst h
      simp only [↓reduceIte]
      rw [hz, thetaNorm_eq]
      simp only [mul_one, one_smul, smul_add, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
      abel
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero, add_zero, map_zero, zero_add, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc,
        mul_smul_comm]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    intro y
    obtain ⟨y₁, h₁⟩ := ha y
    obtain ⟨y₂, h₂⟩ := hb y₁
    exact ⟨y₂, by rw [unop_opZ_mul, h₁, h₂]⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
    intro y
    obtain ⟨y₁, h₁⟩ := ha y
    obtain ⟨y₂, h₂⟩ := hb y
    exact ⟨y₁ + y₂, by rw [unop_opZ_add, h₁, h₂, add_mul]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_mul_θ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem shapZ_mul_θ_eq_zero {i : I} (hz : z i = 1) (x y : LusztigF k I) :
    shapZ D v z x (y * θ k i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y', h⟩ := exists_unop_opZ_mul_θ (D := D) (v := v) hz x y
  rw [shapZ, h, map_mul]
  simp [θ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.unop_opZ_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma unop_opZ_mem_serreIdeal (a : LusztigF k I) :
    ∀ y ∈ serreIdeal D v, (opZ D v z a).unop y ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c =>
    intro y hy
    rw [unop_opZ_algebraMap]; exact smul_mem_serreIdeal c hy
  | grade1 j =>
    intro y hy
    rw [show ι k j = θ k j from rfl, unop_opZ_θ, Lop, Rop]
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
    refine TwoSidedIdeal.sub_mem _ (smul_mem_serreIdeal _ ?_) (smul_mem_serreIdeal _
      (smul_mem_serreIdeal _ ?_))
    · exact lDeriv_mem_serreIdeal (NeZero.ne v) hv' j hy
    · exact twist_mem_serreIdeal j (rDeriv_mem_serreIdeal (NeZero.ne v) hv' j hy)
  | mul a b ha hb => intro y hy; rw [unop_opZ_mul]; exact hb _ (ha y hy)
  | add a b ha hb =>
    intro y hy; rw [unop_opZ_add]; exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ (ha y hy) (hb y hy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.shapZ_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem shapZ_eq_zero_of_mem (x : LusztigF k I) {y : LusztigF k I} (hy : y ∈ serreIdeal D v) :
    shapZ D v z x y = 0
proof:
:=
  counit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal (unop_opZ_mem_serreIdeal hv' x y hy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.zWall_self
statement: @[simp] lemma zWall_self (i : I) : zWall (k := k) i i = 1
proof: := by simp [zWall]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.VermaModule.unop_opZ_zWall
statement:
lemma unop_opZ_zWall (i : I) (a : LusztigF k I) :
    ∀ y, rDeriv D v i y ∈ serreIdeal D v →
      (opZ D v (zWall i) a).unop y - (opZ D v 0 a).unop y ∈ serreIdeal D v ∧
        rDeriv D v i ((opZ D v 0 a).unop y) ∈ serreIdeal D v
proof:
:= by
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c =>
    intro y hy
    rw [unop_opZ_algebraMap, unop_opZ_algebraMap, sub_self, map_smul]
    exact ⟨TwoSidedIdeal.zero_mem _, smul_mem_serreIdeal c hy⟩
  | grade1 j =>
    intro y hy
    rw [show ι k j = θ k j from rfl, unop_opZ_θ, unop_opZ_θ, Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, sub_zero,
      sub_sub_cancel_left]
    refine ⟨TwoSidedIdeal.neg_mem _ ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases h : j = i
      · subst h
        rw [zWall_self, one_smul, Rop]
        simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
        exact smul_mem_serreIdeal _ (twist_mem_serreIdeal j hy)
      · simp only [zWall, h, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul]
        exact TwoSidedIdeal.zero_mem _
    · rw [Lop, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, ← lDeriv_rDeriv]
      exact smul_mem_serreIdeal _ (lDeriv_mem_serreIdeal (NeZero.ne v) hv' j hy)
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ha y hy
    obtain ⟨h₃, h₄⟩ := hb _ h₂
    refine ⟨?_, by rw [unop_opZ_mul]; exact h₄⟩
    rw [unop_opZ_mul, unop_opZ_mul]
    have : (opZ D v (zWall i) b).unop ((opZ D v (zWall i) a).unop y) -
        (opZ D v 0 b).unop ((opZ D v 0 a).unop y) =
        (opZ D v (zWall i) b).unop ((opZ D v (zWall i) a).unop y - (opZ D v 0 a).unop y) +
          ((opZ D v (zWall i) b).unop ((opZ D v 0 a).unop y) -
            (opZ D v 0 b).unop ((opZ D v 0 a).unop y)) := by
      rw [map_sub]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ (unop_opZ_mem_serreIdeal hv' b _ h₁) h₃
  | add a b ha hb =>
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ha y hy
    obtain ⟨h₃, h₄⟩ := hb y hy
    rw [unop_opZ_add, unop_opZ_add, map_add]
