name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residue_integer_of_local_power
statement:
theorem residue_integer_of_local_power (a : LocalRing) (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℤ)
    (h : a * localX ^ n = integerLocalPolynomial p) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, residue a = z
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing p with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
      (congrArg residue h).trans (residue_integerLocalPolynomial p)
  | succ n ih =>
    have hz : p.coeff 0 = 0 := by
      have hh := congrArg residue h
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, residue_localX, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero n),
        mul_zero, residue_integerLocalPolynomial] at hh
      exact_mod_cast hh.symm
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mpr hz
    apply ih q
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ irreducible_localX.ne_zero
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, h, hq, map_mul]
    simp [integerLocalPolynomial, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residue_integer_of_laurent_at_zero
statement:
theorem residue_integer_of_laurent_at_zero (a : LocalRing) (f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
    (h : algebraMap LocalRing (RatFunc ℚ) a = integralLaurentEval f) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, residue a = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := LaurentPolynomial.exists_T_pow f
  apply residue_integer_of_local_power a n p
  apply injective_algebraMap_localRing
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, algebraMap_localX, map_integerLocalPolynomial, hp, map_mul,
    integralLaurentEval_T, h]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.InfinityLocalRing.residue_integer_of_laurent
statement:
theorem InfinityLocalRing.residue_integer_of_laurent (a : InfinityLocalRing)
    (f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
    (h : algebraMap InfinityLocalRing (RatFunc ℚ) a = integralLaurentEval f) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, residue a = z
proof:
:= by
  apply residue_integer_of_laurent_at_zero a (LaurentPolynomial.invert f)
  have hh := congrArg RatFunc.bar h
  change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar (algebraMap LocalRing (RatFunc ℚ) a)) = _ at hh
  simpa only [RatFunc.bar_bar, bar_integralLaurentEval] using hh

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integral_top_string_coefficient
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨(D.d i : ℤ) * n + z, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, BosonModule.e_df_succ (hq0 D i) (hq D i) hx,
      map_smul, hz, smul_smul]
    simp only [inv_inv]
    rw [zpow_add₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negative_e_mem_integral
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [quotientLDeriv, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using quotientLDeriv_mem_integralForm D i hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negative_df_mem_integral
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeQuotientEquiv_df]
  exact mul_mem (quotientIntegralGenerator_mem D i n) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negative_component_mem_integral
statement:
theorem negative_component_mem_integral (i : I) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) (n : ℕ) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv D ((V D i).component (hq0 D i) (hq D i) n x) ∈
      quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (V D i).exists_e_pow_eq_zero x
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x with
  | h N ih =>
    cases N with
    | zero =>
      have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa using hN
      simp [hx0]
    | succ N =>
      let y := ((V D i).e ^ N) x
      have hy0 : (V D i).e y = 0 := by
        rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']
        exact hN
      have hyI : negativeQuotientEquiv D y ∈ quotientIntegralForm D := by
        have hp (m : ℕ) : negativeQuotientEquiv D (((V D i).e ^ m) x) ∈
            quotientIntegralForm D := by
          induction m with
          | zero => exact hx
          | succ m hm =>
            rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
            exact negative_e_mem_integral D i hm
        exact hp N
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := integral_top_string_coefficient D i hy0 N
      let t := 𝕧 ^ (-z) • (V D i).df N y
      have htI : negativeQuotientEquiv D t ∈ quotientIntegralForm D := by
        rw [map_smul]
        exact zpow_smul_mem_quotientIntegralForm D (-z) (negative_df_mem_integral D i N hyI)
      have ht : ((V D i).e ^ N) t = y := by
        rw [map_smul, hz, smul_smul, ← zpow_add₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero, neg_add_cancel,
          zpow_zero, one_smul]
      have hrem : ((V D i).e ^ N) (x - t) = 0 := by
        rw [map_sub, ht]
        exact sub_self _
      have hi := ih N (Nat.lt_succ_self N) (by simpa using sub_mem hx htI) hrem
      have hct : negativeQuotientEquiv D
          ((V D i).component (hq0 D i) (hq D i) n t) ∈ quotientIntegralForm D := by
        rw [map_smul, BosonModule.component_df (hq0 D i) (hq D i) hy0, map_smul]
        split_ifs
        · exact zpow_smul_mem_quotientIntegralForm D (-z) hyI
        · simp
      have heq : x = (x - t) + t := by abel
      rw [heq, map_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem hi hct

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negative_kE_mem_integral
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, _, heq⟩ := (V D i).exists_sum_component (hq0 D i) (hq D i) x
  rw [heq, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply (quotientIntegralForm D).sum_mem
  intro n _
  have hn := negative_component_mem_integral D i hx n
  have he := (V D i).e_component (hq0 D i) (hq D i) n x
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [BosonModule.df_zero]
    change negativeQuotientEquiv D ((V D i).eTilde (hq0 D i) (hq D i) _) ∈ _
    rw [BosonModule.eTilde_of_ker (hq0 D i) (hq D i) he, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ n =>
    change negativeQuotientEquiv D ((V D i).eTilde (hq0 D i) (hq D i) _) ∈ _
    rw [BosonModule.eTilde_df_succ (hq0 D i) (hq D i) he]
    exact negative_df_mem_integral D i n hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negative_kF_mem_integral
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, _, heq⟩ := (V D i).exists_sum_component (hq0 D i) (hq D i) x
  rw [heq, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply (quotientIntegralForm D).sum_mem
  intro n _
  change negativeQuotientEquiv D ((V D i).fTilde (hq0 D i) (hq D i) _) ∈ _
  rw [BosonModule.fTilde_df (hq0 D i) (hq D i)
    ((V D i).e_component (hq0 D i) (hq D i) n x)]
  exact negative_df_mem_integral D i (n + 1) (negative_component_mem_integral D i hx n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.integralPBWPreimage_kE_mem
statement:
theorem integralPBWPreimage_kE_mem {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {w : List I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) (i : I) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv D (kE transcendental_ratFunc_X i
      ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralPBWPreimage R hw c))) ∈
        quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:=
  negative_kE_mem_integral D i (by
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using (integralPBWPreimage R hw c).property)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.raiseAlong_mem_lattice
statement:
lemma raiseAlong_mem_lattice (w : List I) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ latInf hvt A) : raiseAlong D w x ∈ latInf hvt A
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing x with
  | nil => exact hx
  | cons i w ih => exact ih (kE_mem_original_lattice D i hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.raiseAlong_mem_integral
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing x with
  | nil => exact hx
  | cons i w ih => exact ih (negative_kE_mem_integral D i hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formU_nil
statement:
lemma formU_nil (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    formU hv' (fWi hvt []) x = VermaModule.counitQ D 𝕧 x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  change form D 𝕧 1 y = LusztigF.counit y
  exact form_one_left D 𝕧 y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.counit_mem_infinity
statement:
theorem counit_mem_infinity {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ latInf hvt A) :
    ∃ a : A, VermaModule.counitQ D 𝕧 x = algebraMap A 𝕂 a
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  rw [← formU_nil D]
  exact formU_mem (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ []) hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.word_pairing_sub_raised_counit
statement:
theorem word_pairing_sub_raised_counit (w : List I) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ latInf hvt A) :
    ∃ a : A, formU hv' (fWi hvt w) x -
      VermaModule.counitQ D 𝕧 (raiseAlong D w x) = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  induction w generalizing x with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    change formU hv' (fWi hvt []) x - VermaModule.counitQ D 𝕧 x = _
    rw [formU_nil, sub_self, mul_zero, map_zero]
  | cons i w ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := formU_kF_sub_kE_mem (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
      InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
      InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum i (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ w) hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ih (kE_mem_original_lattice D i hx)
    refine ⟨a + b, ?_⟩
    change formU hv' (kF hvt i (fWi hvt w)) x -
      VermaModule.counitQ D 𝕧 (raiseAlong D w (kE hvt i x)) = _
    rw [mul_add, map_add, ← ha, ← hb]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.word_pairing_integer_residue
statement:
theorem word_pairing_integer_residue (w : List I) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hxI : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D)
    (hxL : x ∈ latInf hvt A) :
    ∃ (z : ℤ) (a : A), formU hv' (fWi hvt w) x =
      (z : 𝕂) + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := counit_mem_infinity D (raiseAlong_mem_lattice D w hxL)
  have hb' : algebraMap A 𝕂 b =
      originalAugmentation D (negativeQuotientEquiv D (raiseAlong D w x)) := by
    simpa [originalAugmentation] using hb.symm
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := originalAugmentation_residue_integer D
    (raiseAlong_mem_integral D w hxI) b hb'
  have hz' : Sl2.RankOne.residue ((show Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing from b) -
      (z : Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing)) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, map_intCast, hz, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc⟩ := (Sl2.RankOne.residue_eq_zero_iff _).mp hz'
  let c : A := c₀
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := word_pairing_sub_raised_counit D w hxL
  refine ⟨z, a + c, ?_⟩
  have he : b = (z : A) + ϖ * c := by
    change b - (z : A) = ϖ * c at hc
    linear_combination hc
  rw [hb, he, map_add, map_intCast] at ha
  rw [mul_add, map_add]
  linear_combination ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.originalAugmentation_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem originalAugmentation_toQuotient (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    originalAugmentation D (toQuotient D 𝕧 x) = LusztigF.counit x
proof:
:= by
  simp [originalAugmentation]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.originalAugmentation_one
statement: @[simp] theorem originalAugmentation_one : originalAugmentation D 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using originalAugmentation_toQuotient D (1 : LusztigF 𝕂 I)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.originalAugmentation_mul
statement:
lemma originalAugmentation_mul (x y : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    originalAugmentation D (x * y) =
      originalAugmentation D x * originalAugmentation D y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 y
  rw [← map_mul, originalAugmentation_toQuotient, map_mul,
    originalAugmentation_toQuotient, originalAugmentation_toQuotient]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.originalAugmentation_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma originalAugmentation_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    originalAugmentation D (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hg : quotientIntegralGenerator D i n =
      toQuotient D 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i)) := by
    simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]
  rw [hg, originalAugmentation_toQuotient]
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [qDivPow, qFactorial]
  | succ n => simp [qDivPow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.originalAugmentation_mem_laurent
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [originalAugmentation_integralGenerator]
    split_ifs
    · exact one_mem _
    · exact zero_mem _
  | algebraMap a =>
    change originalAugmentation D (algebraMap 𝕂 _ (integralLaurentEval a)) ∈ _
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, originalAugmentation_one, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one]
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [originalAugmentation_mul]; exact mul_mem hx hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.originalAugmentation_residue_integer
statement:
theorem originalAugmentation_residue_integer {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) (a : InfinityLocalRing)
    (ha : algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 a = originalAugmentation D x) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, Sl2.RankOne.residue a = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := originalAugmentation_mem_laurent D hx
  exact InfinityLocalRing.residue_integer_of_laurent a f (ha.trans hf.symm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_smul_mem_quotientIntegralForm
statement:
lemma zpow_smul_mem_quotientIntegralForm (z : ℤ) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) : 𝕧 ^ z • x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:= by
  have h := (quotientIntegralForm D).smul_mem hx (LaurentPolynomial.T z)
  change integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.T z) • x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D at h
  simpa only [integralLaurentEval_T] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_one
statement: @[simp] lemma quotientLDeriv_one (i : I) : quotientLDeriv D i 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_one, lDeriv_one, map_zero] using quotientLDeriv_toQuotient D i 1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_integralGenerator_succ
statement:
lemma quotientLDeriv_integralGenerator_succ (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    quotientLDeriv D i (quotientIntegralGenerator D i (n + 1)) =
      (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ n • quotientIntegralGenerator D i n
proof:
:= by
  let V := bos (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i
  let x := (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm 1
  have hx : V.e x = 0 := by
    apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).injective
    simpa only [quotientLDeriv, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      map_zero] using quotientLDeriv_one D i
  have hd (m : ℕ) : negativeQuotientEquiv D (V.df m x) =
      quotientIntegralGenerator D i m := by
    simpa only [x, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, mul_one] using
      negativeQuotientEquiv_df D i m x
  rw [← hd (n + 1)]
  simp only [quotientLDeriv, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [BosonModule.e_df_succ (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero i)
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one
      (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i) hx, map_smul, hd]
  simp only [inv_inv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_integralGenerator_mem
statement:
lemma quotientLDeriv_integralGenerator_mem (i j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    quotientLDeriv D i (quotientIntegralGenerator D j n) ∈ quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow, qFactorial]
    | succ n =>
      rw [quotientLDeriv_integralGenerator_succ]
      have h := zpow_smul_mem_quotientIntegralForm D (D.d i * n)
        (quotientIntegralGenerator_mem D i n)
      simpa only [zpow_mul, zpow_natCast] using h
  · have hp : ∀ n : ℕ, lDeriv D 𝕧 i (θ 𝕂 j ^ n) = 0 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih => simp [pow_succ, lDeriv_mul, ih, hij]
    have he : quotientIntegralGenerator D j n =
        toQuotient D 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (θ 𝕂 j)) := by
      simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]
    rw [he, quotientLDeriv_toQuotient]
    simp [qDivPow, hp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_integral_derivative_lift
statement:
lemma exists_integral_derivative_lift (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ∃ a : LusztigF 𝕂 I, toQuotient D 𝕧 a = x ∧
      toQuotient D 𝕧 (twist D 𝕧 i a) ∈ quotientIntegralForm D ∧
      toQuotient D 𝕧 (lDeriv D 𝕧 i a) ∈ quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    let a := qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (θ 𝕂 j)
    have ha : toQuotient D 𝕧 a = quotientIntegralGenerator D j n := by
      simp [a, qDivPow, quotientIntegralGenerator]
    refine ⟨a, ha, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have ht : twist D 𝕧 i a = (𝕧 ^ D.dot i j) ^ n • a := by
        simp only [a, qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow, twist_θ, smul_pow, smul_smul]
        congr 1
        exact mul_comm _ _
      rw [ht, map_smul, ha]
      have h := zpow_smul_mem_quotientIntegralForm D (D.dot i j * (n : ℤ))
        (quotientIntegralGenerator_mem D j n)
      simpa only [zpow_mul, zpow_natCast] using h
    · rw [← quotientLDeriv_toQuotient, ha]
      exact quotientLDeriv_integralGenerator_mem D i j n
  | algebraMap c =>
    refine ⟨algebraMap 𝕂 _ (integralLaurentEval c), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (toQuotient D 𝕧).commutes _
    · rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes]
      exact (quotientIntegralForm D).algebraMap_mem c
    · simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl, hat, had⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl, hbt, hbd⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨a + b, map_add _ _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hat hbt
    · simpa only [map_add] using add_mem had hbd
  | mul x y hx hy hdx hdy =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl, hat, had⟩ := hdx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl, hbt, hbd⟩ := hdy
    refine ⟨a * b, map_mul _ _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [map_mul] using mul_mem hat hbt
    · rw [lDeriv_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul]
      exact add_mem (mul_mem had hy) (mul_mem hat hbd)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientLDeriv_mem_integralForm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl, _, had⟩ := exists_integral_derivative_lift D i hx
  rwa [quotientLDeriv_toQuotient]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_mem
statement:
theorem quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_mem {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {w : List I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) (i : I) :
    quotientLDeriv D i (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) ∈ quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:=
  quotientLDeriv_mem_integralForm D i (integralPBWPreimage R hw c).property

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fWi_mem_original_integral
statement:
theorem fWi_mem_original_integral (w : List I) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv D (fWi transcendental_ratFunc_X w) ∈ quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    change negativeQuotientEquiv D (Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 : LusztigF 𝕂 I)) ∈ _
    change toQuotient D 𝕧 1 ∈ _
    rw [map_one]
    exact one_mem _
  | cons i w ih => exact negative_kF_mem_integral D i ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kE_mem_original_lattice
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact kashiwaraE_mem_latInf' (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum i x hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.raisingWord_mem_original_intersection
statement:
theorem raisingWord_mem_original_intersection (u : List I) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hxI : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D)
    (hxL : x ∈ latInf transcendental_ratFunc_X InfinityLocalRing) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv D (u.foldr (fun i y ↦ kE transcendental_ratFunc_X i y) x) ∈
      quotientIntegralForm D ∧
      u.foldr (fun i y ↦ kE transcendental_ratFunc_X i y) x ∈
        latInf transcendental_ratFunc_X InfinityLocalRing
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => exact ⟨hxI, hxL⟩
  | cons i u ih =>
    exact ⟨negative_kE_mem_integral D i ih.1, kE_mem_original_lattice D i ih.2⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.integralPBWPreimage_raisingWord_mem
statement:
theorem integralPBWPreimage_raisingWord_mem {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {cs : CoxeterSystem D.cartanMatrix.coxeterMatrix W} {w : List I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) (u : List I) :
    let x := (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)
    negativeQuotientEquiv D (u.foldr (fun i y ↦ kE transcendental_ratFunc_X i y) x) ∈
      quotientIntegralForm D ∧
      u.foldr (fun i y ↦ kE transcendental_ratFunc_X i y) x ∈
        latInf transcendental_ratFunc_X InfinityLocalRing
proof:
:= by
  apply raisingWord_mem_original_intersection D u
  · simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using (integralPBWPreimage R hw c).property
  · exact PBWProductNorm.mem_lattice_degree R hw c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_integer_crystal_residue_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_integer_crystal_residue_coordinates {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hxI : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D)
    (hxL : x ∈ latInf hvt A) :
    ∃ a : List I →₀ ℤ, x - a.sum (fun w n ↦ (n : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈
      ϖ • latInf hvt A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1 hxL
  set W := c.support
  obtain ⟨S, -, hSd, hcov⟩ := exists_reps_mod (ϖ • latInf hvt A) (fWi (D := D) hvt) W
  choose! r hrS hr using hcov
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : List I → A, ∀ s, a s = ∑ w ∈ W with r w = s, c w :=
    ⟨_, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  set y : Um D 𝕧 := ∑ s ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (a s) • fWi (D := D) hvt s with hy
  have hy' : y = ∑ w ∈ W, algebraMap A 𝕂 (c w) • fWi (D := D) hvt (r w) := by
    rw [hy, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := r) (t := S) hrS]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [ha, map_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hw).2]
  have hxy : x - y ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    rw [hy', ← hc, Finsupp.sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [← algebraMap_smul 𝕂, ← smul_sub, algebraMap_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hr w hw)
  choose e he using fun s s' ↦
    formU_fWi_fWi (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
      InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
      InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum s s'
  have hpair : ∀ s ∈ S, formU hv' (fWi (D := D) hvt s) y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (a s) +
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * ∑ t ∈ S, a t * e s t) := by
    intro s hs
    have key : ∀ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (a t) *
        formU hv' (fWi (D := D) hvt s) (fWi (D := D) hvt t) =
        (if s = t then algebraMap A 𝕂 (a t) else 0) +
          algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * (a t * e s t)) := by
      intro t ht
      rw [he]
      by_cases h : s = t
      · subst h
        simp only [sub_self, zero_mem, ↓reduceIte, map_mul]
        ring
      · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.2 (fun h' ↦ absurd h' (hSd s hs t ht h))]
        simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, map_mul]
        ring
    rw [hy]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ key t ht]
    simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hs, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hcoeff : ∀ s ∈ S, ∃ (z : ℤ) (b : A), a s - (z : A) = ϖ * b := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨z, b, hb⟩ := word_pairing_integer_residue D s hxI hxL
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := formU_mem_smul (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
      InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
      InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ s) hxy
    refine ⟨z, b - t - ∑ u ∈ S, a u * e s u, ?_⟩
    apply InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    rw [map_sub, hb, hpair s hs] at ht
    simp only [map_sub, map_intCast, map_mul] at ht ⊢
    linear_combination -ht
  choose! z b hb using hcoeff
  let zf : List I →₀ ℤ := Finsupp.onFinset S (fun s ↦ if s ∈ S then z s else 0)
    (by intro s hs; by_contra h; simp [h] at hs)
  have hzf : zf.sum (fun w n ↦ (n : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w) =
      ∑ s ∈ S, (z s : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt s := by
    rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset zf (show zf.support ⊆ S from
      Finsupp.support_onFinset_subset) _ (fun _ _ ↦ by simp)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ by simp [zf, hs]
  refine ⟨zf, ?_⟩
  have hyz : y - zf.sum (fun w n ↦ (n : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    rw [hy, hzf, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s hs ↦ ?_
    rw [← sub_smul, ← map_intCast (algebraMap A 𝕂), ← map_sub, hb s hs,
      algebraMap_smul, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ s))
  simpa using add_mem hxy hyz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNeg_T_one_mul_mul
statement:
lemma isNeg_T_one_mul_mul {f g : LaurentPolynomial ℤ} (hf : f.IsNeg) (hg : g.IsNeg) :
    (T 1 * (f * g)).IsNeg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro n hn
  rw [coeff_T_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul, Finsupp.sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha ↦ ?_
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b hb ↦ ite_eq_right fun hab ↦ ?_
  have ha' : a < 0 := lt_of_not_ge fun h ↦ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 ha) (hf a h)
  have hb' : b < 0 := lt_of_not_ge fun h ↦ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hb) (hg b h)
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_intCast
statement:
private lemma coeff_intCast (k n : ℤ) :
    (k : LaurentPolynomial ℤ).coeff n = if n = 0 then k else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.intCast_def, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [eq_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_zero
statement: lemma isIntInv_zero : IsIntInv 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIntInv, mul_zero]; exact isNegLaurent_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_one
statement: lemma isIntInv_one : IsIntInv 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIntInv, mul_one]; exact isNegLaurent_inv_X

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.add
statement: lemma IsIntInv.add {c d : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) (hd : IsIntInv d) : IsIntInv (c + d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIntInv, mul_add]; exact IsNegLaurent.add hc hd

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.neg
statement: lemma IsIntInv.neg {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) : IsIntInv (-c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIntInv, mul_neg]; exact IsNegLaurent.neg hc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.sub
statement: lemma IsIntInv.sub {c d : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) (hd : IsIntInv d) : IsIntInv (c - d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact hc.add hd.neg

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsNegLaurent.isIntInv
statement: lemma IsNegLaurent.isIntInv {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsNegLaurent c) : IsIntInv c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hc
  exact isNegLaurent_inv_X_mul ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsNegLaurent.mul_isIntInv
statement:
lemma IsNegLaurent.mul_isIntInv {c d : 𝕂} (hc : IsNegLaurent c) (hd : IsIntInv d) :
    IsNegLaurent (c * d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨T 1 * (a * b), isNeg_T_one_mul_mul ha hb, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, hb', integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_one, mul_left_comm (integralLaurentEval a),
    ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧), one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.mul
statement: lemma IsIntInv.mul {c d : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) (hd : IsIntInv d) : IsIntInv (c * d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIntInv, ← mul_assoc]; exact IsNegLaurent.mul_isIntInv hc hd

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_intCast
statement: lemma isIntInv_intCast (n : ℤ) : IsIntInv n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨T (-1) * (n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ), fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [coeff_T_mul, coeff_intCast, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
  · rw [map_mul, map_intCast, integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_neg_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_X_mul_iff
statement: lemma isIntInv_X_mul_iff {c : 𝕂} : IsIntInv (𝕧 * c) ↔ IsNegLaurent c
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIntInv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧), one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_of_isIntInv
statement:
private lemma exists_of_isIntInv {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) :
    ∃ p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ, (T (-1) * p).IsNeg ∧ integralLaurentEval p = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨T 1 * a, by rwa [← mul_assoc, ← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero, one_mul], ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, he, integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_one, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne 𝕧),
    one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.exists_int_sub
statement: lemma IsIntInv.exists_int_sub {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) : ∃ n : ℤ, IsNegLaurent (c - n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := exists_of_isIntInv hc
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, p - (p.coeff 0 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ), fun n hn ↦ ?_, by
    rw [map_sub, map_intCast]⟩
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, coeff_intCast]
  rcases hn.eq_or_lt with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · have := hp (n - 1) (by omega)
    rw [coeff_T_mul, sub_neg_eq_add, sub_add_cancel] at this
    rw [this, ite_eq_right (by omega), sub_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.exists_int_of_bar
statement:
lemma IsIntInv.exists_int_of_bar {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) (hc' : IsIntInv (RatFunc.bar c)) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, c = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := exists_of_isIntInv hc
  obtain ⟨p', hp', he⟩ := exists_of_isIntInv hc'
  rw [bar_integralLaurentEval] at he
  obtain rfl := integralLaurentEval_injective he
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_intCast integralLaurentEval]
  congr 1
  ext n
  rw [coeff_intCast]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h | h
    · have := hp' (-n - 1) (by omega)
      rwa [coeff_T_mul, invert_apply, show -(-n - 1 - -1) = n by ring] at this
    · have := hp (n - 1) (by omega)
      rwa [coeff_T_mul, sub_neg_eq_add, sub_add_cancel] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsNegLaurent.eq_zero_of_intCast
statement: lemma IsNegLaurent.eq_zero_of_intCast {n : ℤ} (hn : IsNegLaurent n) : n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := hn.eq_zero_of_bar_eq (by rw [map_intCast])
  exact_mod_cast this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.le_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero
statement:
lemma le_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero {h h' : TensorIdx Λ Λ'}
    (h0 : (e).repr (c h) h' ≠ 0) : h ≤ h'
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  exact h0 (by rw [repr_tensorCanonical, ite_eq_right hn])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_suppClosure
statement:
lemma mem_suppClosure {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} {h : TensorIdx Λ Λ'} :
    h ∈ suppClosure hR Λ Λ' z ↔ ∃ k ∈ ((e).repr z).support, k ≤ h
proof:
:= by
  simp [suppClosure]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.suppClosure_ssubset
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : ∀ k, k ∈ ((e).repr (z - (e).repr z i • c i)).support →
      (k ∈ ((e).repr z).support ∨ i ≤ k) ∧ k ≠ i := by
    intro k hk
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, map_sub, LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.sub_apply,
      Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra hn
      rw [not_or, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, not_not] at hn
      exact hk (by rw [hn.1, repr_tensorCanonical, ite_eq_right hn.2, mul_zero, sub_zero])
    · rintro rfl
      exact hk (by rw [repr_tensorCanonical_self, mul_one, sub_self])
  refine Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset (fun h hh ↦ ?_) |>.2 ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hkh⟩ := (mem_suppClosure hR Λ Λ').1 hh
    rcases (hsupp k hk).1 with hk' | hk'
    · exact (mem_suppClosure hR Λ Λ').2 ⟨k, hk', hkh⟩
    · exact (mem_suppClosure hR Λ Λ').2 ⟨i, hi.1, hk'.trans hkh⟩
  · exact (mem_suppClosure hR Λ Λ').2 ⟨i, hi.1, le_rfl⟩
  · rw [mem_suppClosure]
    rintro ⟨k, hk, hki⟩
    obtain ⟨hk', hne⟩ := hsupp k hk
    rcases hk' with hk' | hk'
    · exact hne (le_antisymm hki (hi.2 hk' hki))
    · exact hne (le_antisymm hki hk')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.induction_tensorCanonical
statement:
lemma induction_tensorCanonical (L : AddSubgroup (TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1))
    (Q : 𝕂 → Prop)
    (hQ : ∀ z ∈ L, ∀ h, Q ((e).repr z h)) (hL : ∀ a h, Q a → a • c h ∈ L)
    (P : (TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) → Prop) (hP0 : P 0)
    (hPadd : ∀ z a h, P z → Q a → P (z + a • c h)) :
    ∀ z ∈ L, P z
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n, ∀ z ∈ L, (suppClosure hR Λ Λ' z).card = n → P z from
    fun z hz ↦ this _ z hz rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    rintro z hz rfl
    by_cases h0 : z = 0
    · rw [h0]; exact hP0
    have hs : ((e).repr z).support.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff]
      exact fun h ↦ h0 ((e).repr.map_eq_zero_iff.1 h)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ((e).repr z).support.exists_minimal hs
    have hz' : z - (e).repr z i • c i ∈ L := sub_mem hz (hL _ i (hQ z hz i))
    have := ih _ (Finset.card_lt_card (suppClosure_ssubset hR Λ Λ' hi)) _ hz' rfl
    simpa using hPadd _ _ i this (hQ z hz i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_tensorCanonical
statement: lemma span_tensorCanonical : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range c)
proof:
:= by
  intro z _
  refine induction_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' ⊤ (fun _ ↦ True) (fun _ _ _ ↦ trivial)
    (fun _ _ _ ↦ AddSubgroup.mem_top _) (· ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range c))
    (zero_mem _) (fun z a h hz _ ↦ add_mem hz (Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨h, rfl⟩))) z (AddSubgroup.mem_top z)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_tensorCanonical
statement: lemma linearIndependent_tensorCanonical : LinearIndependent 𝕂 c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg i hi
  by_contra hgi
  set s' := s.filter fun k ↦ g k ≠ 0
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := s'.exists_minimal ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hi, hgi⟩⟩
  have hj' := Finset.mem_filter.1 hj.1
  have key := congrArg (fun z ↦ (e).repr z j) hg
  simp only [map_sum, LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at key
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj'.1, repr_tensorCanonical_self, mul_one] at key
  · exact hj'.2 key
  · intro k hk hkj
    by_cases hgk : g k = 0
    · rw [hgk, zero_mul]
    by_cases hr : (e).repr (c k) j = 0
    · rw [hr, mul_zero]
    exact absurd (le_antisymm (hj.2 (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hk, hgk⟩)
      (le_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero hR Λ Λ' hr))
      (le_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero hR Λ Λ' hr)).symm hkj

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorCanonicalBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tensorCanonicalBasis_apply (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    tensorCanonicalBasis hR Λ Λ' h = c h
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorCanonicalBasis_add_smul
statement:
lemma repr_tensorCanonicalBasis_add_smul (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) (a : 𝕂)
    (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    (cb).repr (z + a • c h) = (cb).repr z + Finsupp.single h a
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, LinearEquiv.map_smul, ← tensorCanonicalBasis_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self,
    Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorPsi_tensorCanonicalBasis
statement:
lemma repr_tensorPsi_tensorCanonicalBasis (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1)
    (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    (cb).repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' z) h = RatFunc.bar ((cb).repr z h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hk : ∀ k, tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' ((cb).repr z k • cb k) = RatFunc.bar ((cb).repr z k) • cb k := by
    intro k
    rw [tensorPsi_smul, tensorCanonicalBasis_apply, tensorPsi_tensorCanonical,
      ← tensorCanonicalBasis_apply hR Λ Λ']
  conv_lhs => rw [← (cb).linearCombination_repr z]
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  simp_rw [hk]
  rw [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  simp_rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  split_ifs with hh
  · rfl
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hh, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_tensorLatNeg_iff
statement:
lemma mem_tensorLatNeg_iff {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} :
    z ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ' ↔ 𝕧 • z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:=
  (smul_mem_tensorLat_iff hR Λ Λ').symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorLatNeg_le
statement: lemma tensorLatNeg_le : tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ' ≤ tensorLat hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz h ↦ (hz h).isIntInv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_repr_tensorCanonical
statement: lemma isIntInv_repr_tensorCanonical (h h' : TensorIdx Λ Λ') : IsIntInv ((e).repr (c h) h')
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne h' h with rfl | hne
  · rw [repr_tensorCanonical_self]; exact isIntInv_one
  · exact (isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' hne).isIntInv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical
statement:
lemma isLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical (h h' : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    Modified.IsLaurent ((e).repr (c h) h')
proof:
:= by
  rw [repr_tensorCanonical]
  split_ifs
  · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · exact Modified.isLaurent_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLat
statement:
lemma smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLat {a : 𝕂} (ha : IsIntInv a) (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    a • c h ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= fun h' ↦ by
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ha.mul (isIntInv_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h h')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLatA
statement:
lemma smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLatA {a : 𝕂} (ha : Modified.IsLaurent a)
    (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') : a • c h ∈ tensorLatA hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= fun h' ↦ by
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ha.mul (isLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h h')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_tensorLat_iff_canonical
statement:
theorem mem_tensorLat_iff_canonical {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} :
    z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ' ↔ ∀ h, IsIntInv ((cb).repr z h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · refine induction_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' (tensorLat hR Λ Λ') IsIntInv (fun z hz h ↦ hz h)
      (fun _ h ha ↦ smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLat hR Λ Λ' ha h)
      (fun z ↦ ∀ h, IsIntInv ((cb).repr z h)) (fun h ↦ by simpa using isIntInv_zero) ?_ z
    intro z a i hz ha h
    rw [repr_tensorCanonicalBasis_add_smul, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact (hz h).add ha
    · simpa using hz h
  · intro hz
    rw [← (cb).linearCombination_repr z, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
    refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun h _ ↦ ?_
    rw [tensorCanonicalBasis_apply]
    exact smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLat hR Λ Λ' (hz h) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_tensorLatA_iff
statement:
theorem mem_tensorLatA_iff {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} :
    z ∈ tensorLatA hR Λ Λ' ↔ ∀ h, Modified.IsLaurent ((cb).repr z h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · refine induction_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' (tensorLatA hR Λ Λ') Modified.IsLaurent
      (fun z hz h ↦ hz h)
      (fun _ h ha ↦ smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLatA hR Λ Λ' ha h)
      (fun z ↦ ∀ h, Modified.IsLaurent ((cb).repr z h))
      (fun h ↦ by simpa using Modified.isLaurent_zero) ?_ z
    intro z a i hz ha h
    rw [repr_tensorCanonicalBasis_add_smul, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact (hz h).add ha
    · simpa using hz h
  · intro hz
    rw [← (cb).linearCombination_repr z, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
    refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun h _ ↦ ?_
    rw [tensorCanonicalBasis_apply]
    exact smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLatA hR Λ Λ' (hz h) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_int_repr_of_mem
statement:
lemma exists_int_repr_of_mem {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1}
    (hz : z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ')
    (hz' : tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ') (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    ∃ n : ℤ, (cb).repr z h = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_tensorLat_iff_canonical] at hz hz'
  refine (hz h).exists_int_of_bar ?_
  rw [← repr_tensorPsi_tensorCanonicalBasis]
  exact hz' h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_tensorLatBar_iff
statement:
lemma mem_tensorLatBar_iff {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} :
    z ∈ tensorLatBar hR Λ Λ' ↔ z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ' ∧ tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorLatBar, AddSubgroup.mem_inf, AddSubgroup.mem_map]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ⟨_, h, tensorPsi_tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' z⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rwa [tensorPsi_tensorPsi]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorLatResidue_apply
statement:
lemma tensorLatResidue_apply (x : tensorLatBar hR Λ Λ') :
    tensorLatResidue hR Λ Λ' x =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (⟨x, (AddSubgroup.mem_inf.1 x.2).1⟩ : tensorLat hR Λ Λ')
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorLatResidue_eq_mk
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorLatResidue_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientAddGroup.eq,
    AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf, AddSubgroup.coe_add, AddSubgroup.coe_neg, neg_add_eq_sub]
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLatBar
statement: lemma tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLatBar (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') : c h ∈ tensorLatBar hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_tensorLatBar_iff, tensorPsi_tensorCanonical]
  have := smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLat hR Λ Λ' isIntInv_one h
  rw [one_smul] at this
  exact ⟨this, this⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_sub_sum_mem_tensorLatNeg
statement:
lemma exists_sub_sum_mem_tensorLatNeg {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1}
    (hz : z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ') :
    ∃ (s : Finset (TensorIdx Λ Λ')) (n : TensorIdx Λ Λ' → ℤ),
      z - ∑ h ∈ s, (n h : 𝕂) • c h ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : ∀ h, ∃ n : ℤ, IsNegLaurent ((e).repr z h - n) :=
    fun h ↦ IsIntInv.exists_int_sub (hz h)
  choose n hn using hn
  refine ⟨((e).repr z).support, n, ?_⟩
  have hz' : z = ∑ h ∈ ((e).repr z).support, (e).repr z h • e h := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (e).linearCombination_repr z]
    rfl
  nth_rw 1 [hz']
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun h _ ↦ ?_
  have : (e).repr z h • e h - (n h : 𝕂) • c h =
      ((e).repr z h - n h) • e h - (n h : 𝕂) • (c h - e h) := by
    rw [sub_smul, smul_sub]; abel
  rw [this]
  refine sub_mem (fun h' ↦ ?_) (fun h' ↦ ?_)
  · rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs
    · rw [mul_one]; exact hn h
    · rw [mul_zero]; exact isNegLaurent_zero
  · rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    refine IsNegLaurent.mul_isIntInv ?_ (isIntInv_intCast _)
    rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with hh
    · subst hh
      rw [repr_tensorCanonical_self, sub_self]
      exact isNegLaurent_zero
    · rw [sub_zero]
      exact isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' (Ne.symm hh)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bijective_tensorLatResidue
statement: theorem bijective_tensorLatResidue : Function.Bijective (tensorLatResidue hR Λ Λ')
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun ⟨z, hz⟩ hz0 ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_tensorLatBar_iff] at hz
    rw [tensorLatResidue, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply,
      QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff, AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf] at hz0
    change z ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ' at hz0
    rw [mem_tensorLatNeg_iff, mem_tensorLat_iff_canonical] at hz0
    refine Subtype.ext ((cb).repr.map_eq_zero_iff.1 (Finsupp.ext fun h ↦ ?_))
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_int_repr_of_mem hR Λ Λ' hz.1 hz.2 h
    have h1 := hz0 h
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, isIntInv_X_mul_iff, hn] at h1
    rw [hn, h1.eq_zero_of_intCast, Int.cast_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _ y
    have hw : (w : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ' := w.2
    have hex := exists_sub_sum_mem_tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ' hw
    obtain ⟨s, n, hsn⟩ := hex
    have hmem : ∑ h ∈ s, (n h : 𝕂) • c h ∈ tensorLatBar hR Λ Λ' :=
      AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun h _ ↦ by
        rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul 𝕂]
        exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLatBar hR Λ Λ' h) _
    exact ⟨⟨_, hmem⟩, tensorLatResidue_eq_mk hR Λ Λ' hsn⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_infinity_smul
statement:
lemma hwBar_infinity_smul (b : LocalRing) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwBar hR Λ ((show InfinityLocalRing from b) • m) = b • hwBar hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 (show InfinityLocalRing from b) m, hwBar_smul,
    ← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 b (hwBar hR Λ m)]
  congr 1
  change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar (algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 b)) = _
  rw [RatFunc.bar_bar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_local_smul
statement:
lemma hwBar_local_smul (b : LocalRing) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwBar hR Λ (b • m) = (show InfinityLocalRing from b) • hwBar hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hwBar_hwBar hR Λ m, ← hwBar_infinity_smul]
  exact hwBar_hwBar hR Λ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_latBar_iff
statement:
lemma mem_latBar_iff (x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    x ∈ latBar hR Λ ↔ hwBar hR Λ x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_localX_smul_latBar_iff
statement:
lemma mem_localX_smul_latBar_iff (x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    x ∈ localX • latBar hR Λ ↔ hwBar hR Λ x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hwBar hR Λ y, hy, (hwBar_local_smul hR Λ localX y).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨hwBar hR Λ y, (mem_latBar_iff hR Λ _).2 (by rwa [hwBar_hwBar]), ?_⟩
    rw [← hwBar_hwBar hR Λ x, ← hxy]
    exact (hwBar_infinity_smul hR Λ localX y).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_proj
statement:
lemma evq_proj (Λ : Dom R) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    evq hvt Λ (NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) x) =
      weightSetProj (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) {Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν}
        (evq hvt Λ x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction_wordBasis with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]
  | smul c a ha => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, map_smul, map_smul, ha, map_smul, map_smul]
  | word w =>
    have hw : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I w) : Um D 𝕧) ∈
        Uw D 𝕧 (wordWeight w) :=
      ⟨_, FreeAlgebra.wordBasis_mem_wordSpan w, rfl⟩
    rw [proj_of_mem_Uw hw, weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ (evq_mem_wsp hR hw Λ)]
    have hiff : (Λ.1 - R.rootSum (wordWeight w) ∈ ({Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν} : Set _)) ↔
        wordWeight w = ν := by
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR (sub_right_injective h),
        fun h ↦ by rw [h]⟩
    by_cases h : wordWeight w = ν
    · simp [h]
    · have hz : LusztigF.toZ (wordWeight w) ≠ LusztigF.toZ ν :=
        fun e ↦ h (LusztigF.toZ_injective e)
      simp [hz, hiff, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.proj_mem_Uw
statement:
lemma proj_mem_Uw (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (u : Um D 𝕧) :
    NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) u ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  refine ⟨_, ?_, (NegativePart.proj_mk _ _).symm⟩
  simp only [zWeightProj, ite_eq_left (nonneg_toZ ν), ofZ_toZ]
  exact weightProj_mem ν y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBalanced_sub
statement:
lemma negBalanced_sub {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x y : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negBalanced D ν)
    (hy : y ∈ negBalanced D ν) : x - y ∈ negBalanced D ν
proof:
:=
  ⟨sub_mem hx.1 hy.1, sub_mem hx.2.1 hy.2.1, sub_mem hx.2.2.1 hy.2.2.1, sub_mem hx.2.2.2 hy.2.2.2⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negLift_eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
lemma negLift_eq_of_sub_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν)
    {w w' : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}}
    (hww : fWi (D := D) hvt w.1 - fWi hvt w'.1 ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    negLift h w = negLift h w'
proof:
:= by
  refine sub_eq_zero.1 (h.2 _ (negBalanced_sub (negLift_mem h w) (negLift_mem h w')) ?_)
  have e : negLift h w - negLift h w' = (negLift h w - fWi hvt w.1) -
      (negLift h w' - fWi hvt w'.1) + (fWi hvt w.1 - fWi hvt w'.1) := by abel
  rw [e]
  exact add_mem (sub_mem (negLift_sub_mem h w) (negLift_sub_mem h w')) hww

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_mem_lat'
statement:
lemma evq_mem_lat' {u : Um D 𝕧} (hu : u ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A) (Λ : Dom R) :
    evq hvt Λ u ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:=
  evq_mem_lat_of_mem_latticeInf InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund hu Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_mem_smul_lat'
statement:
lemma evq_mem_smul_lat' {u : Um D 𝕧} (hu : u ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) (Λ : Dom R) :
    evq hvt Λ u ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:=
  evq_mem_smul_lat InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund hu Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_negLift_sub_mem
statement:
theorem evq_negLift_sub_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν)
    (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}) (Λ : Dom R) :
    evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) - fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  have e : evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) - fW hvt hR Λ w.1 = evq hvt Λ (negLift h w - fWi hvt w.1) +
      (evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt w.1) - fW hvt hR Λ w.1) := by rw [map_sub]; abel
  rw [e]
  exact add_mem (evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund (negLift_sub_mem h w) Λ)
    (evq_fWord_sub_fW_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund w.1 Λ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_negLift_mem
statement:
theorem evq_negLift_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν)
    (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}) (Λ : Dom R) :
    evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) ∈ hwBalanced hR Λ ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hZ, hw, h₀, -⟩ := negLift_mem h w
  refine ⟨⟨_, hZ, rfl⟩, evq_mem_wsp hR hw Λ, evq_mem_lat' hfund h₀ Λ, ?_⟩
  rw [mem_latBar_iff, hwBar_evq, negBar_eq_of_mem h (negLift_mem h w)]
  exact evq_mem_lat' hfund h₀ Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwLift_mem
statement:
lemma hwLift_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R) (b : hwCrystal hR Λ ν) :
    hwLift hR h Λ b ∈ hwBalanced hR Λ ν
proof:
:=
  evq_negLift_mem hfund h _ Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwLift_sub_mem
statement:
lemma hwLift_sub_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R) (b : hwCrystal hR Λ ν) :
    hwLift hR h Λ b - fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out b).1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:=
  evq_negLift_sub_mem hfund h _ Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_hwLift
statement:
lemma hwBar_hwLift {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R) (b : hwCrystal hR Λ ν) :
    hwBar hR Λ (hwLift hR h Λ b) = hwLift hR h Λ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [hwLift, hwBar_evq, negBar_eq_of_mem h (negLift_mem h _)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residueIndependent_hwLift
statement:
theorem residueIndependent_hwLift {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R) :
    ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ (hwLift hR h Λ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun b ↦ (hwLift_mem hfund h Λ b).2.2.1, fun s a hs b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  have hD : ∀ r, PropD hvt hR A ϖ r := fun r ↦
    (allProp InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
      InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund r).2.2.2.1
  have hsum : ∑ c ∈ s, a c • fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out c).1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    have e : ∑ c ∈ s, a c • fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out c).1 = ∑ c ∈ s, a c • hwLift hR h Λ c -
        ∑ c ∈ s, a c • (hwLift hR h Λ c - fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out c).1) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ ↦ by rw [smul_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem hs (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (hwLift_sub_mem hfund h Λ c))
  have := coeff_mem_of_sum_mem hD Λ s (fun c ↦ (Quotient.out c).1)
    (fun c₁ _ c₂ _ he ↦ Quotient.out_injective (Subtype.ext he))
    (fun c _ ↦ (Quotient.out c).2.2)
    (fun c₁ _ c₂ _ hne hmem ↦ hne (by
      rw [← Quotient.out_eq c₁, ← Quotient.out_eq c₂]
      exact Quotient.sound hmem))
    a hsum b hb
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residueIndependent_hwLift_bar
statement:
theorem residueIndependent_hwLift_bar {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R) :
    ResidueIndependent LocalRing (latBar hR Λ) localX (hwLift hR h Λ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun b ↦ (hwLift_mem hfund h Λ b).2.2.2, fun s a hs b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [mem_localX_smul_latBar_iff, map_sum] at hs
  simp_rw [hwBar_local_smul, hwBar_hwLift h Λ] at hs
  exact (residueIndependent_hwLift hfund h Λ).2 s (fun c ↦ show InfinityLocalRing from a c) hs b hb

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_negLift_mem_span
statement:
lemma evq_negLift_mem_span {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R)
    (hvan : ∀ w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}, fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ →
      evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) = 0) (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}) :
    evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (hwLift hR h Λ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw0 : fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
  · rw [hvan w hw0]; exact zero_mem _
  let b : hwCrystal hR Λ ν := ⟦⟨w.1, w.2, hw0⟩⟧
  have hrel : fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out b).1 - fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
    Quotient.mk_out (s := hwCrystalSetoid hR Λ ν) ⟨w.1, w.2, hw0⟩
  have hi := fWi_sub_mem_of_fW_sub_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund _ w.1 (Quotient.out b).1 rfl hw0
    (by rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem hrel)
  have e : evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) = hwLift hR h Λ b := by
    rw [hwLift, negLift_eq_of_sub_mem h (w' := ⟨(Quotient.out b).1, (Quotient.out b).2.1⟩) hi]
  rw [e]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_hwLift
statement:
theorem mem_span_hwLift {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R)
    (hvan : ∀ w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}, fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ →
      evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) = 0) {x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hxZ : x ∈ hwIntegral Λ) (hxw : x ∈ wsp Λ ν) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (hwLift hR h Λ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hxZ
  have e : evq hvt Λ u = evq hvt Λ (NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) u) := by
    rw [evq_proj hR, weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ hxw]
    simp
  rw [e]
  have key : ∀ z ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (negLift h)),
      evq hvt Λ z ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (hwLift hR h Λ)) := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact evq_negLift_mem_span hfund h Λ hvan w
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy =>
      rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  exact key _ (mem_span_negLift h (proj_mem_negIntegral D _ hu) (proj_mem_Uw ν u))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_hwBalanced_of_mem_span_int
statement:
lemma mem_hwBalanced_of_mem_span_int {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {Λ : Dom R} {ι : Type*}
    {g : ι → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hg : ∀ b, g b ∈ hwBalanced hR Λ ν)
    {y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hy : y ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g)) :
    y ∈ hwBalanced hR Λ ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy; exact hg b
  | zero => exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _, zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    exact ⟨add_mem hy.1 hz.1, add_mem hy.2.1 hz.2.1, add_mem hy.2.2.1 hz.2.2.1,
      add_mem hy.2.2.2 hz.2.2.2⟩
  | smul n y _ hy =>
    exact ⟨zsmul_mem hy.1 n, zsmul_mem hy.2.1 n, zsmul_mem hy.2.2.1 n, zsmul_mem hy.2.2.2 n⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwGlobalAt_of_vanishing
statement:
theorem hwGlobalAt_of_vanishing {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (Λ : Dom R)
    (hvan : ∀ w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}, fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ →
      evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) = 0) :
    HwGlobalAt hR Λ ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x hxZ hxw hx₀ ↦ ?_, fun x hx hxϖ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_int_sub_mem_of_mem_span (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ)
      (residueIndependent_hwLift hfund h Λ) (mem_span_hwLift hfund h Λ hvan hxZ hxw) hx₀
    exact ⟨y, mem_hwBalanced_of_mem_span_int (hwLift_mem hfund h Λ) hy, hxy⟩
  · exact balanced_eq_zero_of_mem_span (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ)
      (residueIndependent_hwLift hfund h Λ) (residueIndependent_hwLift_bar hfund h Λ)
      (mem_span_hwLift hfund h Λ hvan hx.1 hx.2.1) hxϖ hx.2.2.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma pow_mem_weightSpace {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν)
    (n : ℕ) : x ^ n ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (n • ν)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using one_mem_weightSpace
  | succ n ih => simpa [pow_succ, succ_nsmul] using mul_mem_weightSpace ih hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_homogeneous_of_mem_closure
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨n • Finsupp.single i 1, QuantumGroup.qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i),
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace i) n), ?_,
      quotientIntegralGenerator_mem D i n⟩
    rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, QuantumGroup.qDivPow, QuantumGroup.qDivPow, map_smul,
      map_pow]
  | one => exact ⟨0, 1, one_mem_weightSpace, map_one _, one_mem _⟩
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨ν, z, hz, rfl, hzI⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨μ, z', hz', rfl, hz'I⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨ν + μ, z * z', mul_mem_weightSpace hz hz', map_mul _ _ _, mul_mem hzI hz'I⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negIntegral_le_span
statement:
theorem negIntegral_le_span :
    negIntegral D ≤ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
      {x | ∃ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (z : LusztigF 𝕂 I), z ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν ∧
        x = NegativePart.mk (D := D) (v := 𝕧) z ∧ x ∈ negIntegral D}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (quotientIntegralForm D) :=
    (mem_negIntegral D x).1 hx
  rw [quotientIntegralForm, Algebra.adjoin_eq_span] at h
  rw [← (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm_apply_apply x]
  generalize negativeQuotientEquiv D x = y at h
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨ν, z, hz, rfl, hzI⟩ := exists_homogeneous_of_mem_closure D hy
    have hmk : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (toQuotient D 𝕧 z) = NegativePart.mk z :=
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm_apply_eq.2 rfl
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, z, hz, hmk, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_negIntegral, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hzI
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    have : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (c • y) = c • (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y := by
      change (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralLaurentEval c • y) =
        integralLaurentEval c • (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y
      exact map_smul _ _ _
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.proj_mem_negIntegral
statement:
theorem proj_mem_negIntegral (γ : I →₀ ℤ) {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D) :
    proj D 𝕧 γ x ∈ negIntegral D
proof:
:= by
  have h := negIntegral_le_span D hx
  clear hx
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨ν, z, hz, rfl, hzI⟩ := hx
    classical
    rw [proj_mk, zWeightProj_of_mem hz]
    split_ifs
    · exact hzI
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_nil_of_wordWeight_eq_zero
statement: lemma eq_nil_of_wordWeight_eq_zero {w : List I} (hw : wordWeight w = 0) : w = []
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w =>
    have := congrArg (· i) hw
    simp [LusztigF.wordWeight_cons] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobal_zero
statement: lemma negGlobal_zero (b : negCrystal D 0) : negGlobal D 0 b = fWi hvt []
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b = Quotient.mk _ ⟨[], rfl⟩ := by
    rw [← Quotient.out_eq b]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (eq_nil_of_wordWeight_eq_zero (Quotient.out b).2)
  have hy : fWi (D := D) hvt [] ∈ negBalanced D 0 := by
    refine ⟨fWi_mem_negIntegral D [], fWi_mem_Uw [], NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ [], ?_⟩
    rw [mem_latInfBar_iff, negBar_fWi_nil]
    exact NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ []
  rw [hb]
  exact (negGlobal_eq_of_sub_mem D hy rfl (by rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _)).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.le_of_negDepthGe
statement:
lemma le_of_negDepthGe {i : I} {m : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν}
    (hb : NegDepthGe D i m b) : m ≤ ν i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hb
  have h := wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem_ratFunc D hu
  rw [(Quotient.out b).2, LusztigF.wordWeight_append, LusztigF.wordWeight_replicate] at h
  rw [h]
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_negDepth
statement:
lemma exists_negDepth {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    ∃ i n, 0 < n ∧ NegDepthGe D i n b ∧ ¬ NegDepthGe D i (n + 1) b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hcw : (Quotient.out b).1 with
  | nil =>
    exact absurd (by rw [← (Quotient.out b).2, hcw]; rfl) hν
  | cons i w =>
    have h1 : NegDepthGe D i 1 b := by
      refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
      rw [hcw, List.replicate_one, List.singleton_append, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _
    have hle := le_of_negDepthGe D h1
    refine ⟨i, Nat.findGreatest (fun m ↦ NegDepthGe D i m b) (ν i), ?_,
      Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := fun m ↦ NegDepthGe D i m b) hle h1, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (Nat.le_findGreatest hle h1)
    · exact Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest (Nat.lt_succ_self _) (le_of_negDepthGe D h) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signedBasis_diff_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem signedBasis_diff_eq_iUnion :
    signedBasis D \ {fWi hvt [], -fWi hvt []} =
      ⋃ (i : I) (n : ℕ) (_ : 0 < n), signedBasisAt D i n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_iUnion,
    exists_prop]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hx1⟩
    obtain ⟨ν, b, hx⟩ := (mem_signedBasis_iff D).1 hx
    have hν : ν ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> rw [negGlobal_zero] at hx1 <;> simp at hx1
    obtain ⟨i, n, hn, hb, hb'⟩ := exists_negDepth D hν b
    exact ⟨i, n, hn, (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, hb, hb', hx⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, n, hn, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨ν, b, hb, -, hx⟩ := (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).1 hx
    refine ⟨(mem_signedBasis_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, hx⟩, fun h1 ↦ ?_⟩
    have hν : 0 < ν i := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (le_of_negDepthGe D hb)
    have h0 : x = negGlobal D 0 (Quotient.mk _ ⟨[], rfl⟩) ∨
        x = -negGlobal D 0 (Quotient.mk _ ⟨[], rfl⟩) := by
      rw [negGlobal_zero]
      exact h1
    obtain ⟨h, -⟩ := signed_eq_signed D hx h0
    rw [h] at hν
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hν

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_canonicalBasisAt_iff
statement:
theorem mem_canonicalBasisAt_iff {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ canonicalBasisAt D ν ↔ (ν = 0 ∧ x = fWi hvt []) ∨
      ∃ (i : I) (n : ℕ) (_ : 0 < n ∧ n ≤ ν i) (y : signedBasisAt D i 0),
        (y : Um D 𝕧) ∈ canonicalBasisAt D (ν - Finsupp.single i n) ∧
          x = signedStringMap D i n y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (_ | @⟨ν, i, n, hn, y, hy⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · refine Or.inr ⟨i, n, ⟨hn, by simp⟩, y, ?_, rfl⟩
      change IsCanonicalAt D _ _
      rwa [add_tsub_cancel_right]
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, n, ⟨hn, hnν⟩, y, hy, rfl⟩)
    · exact IsCanonicalAt.one
    · have h := IsCanonicalAt.step hn y hy
      rwa [tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Finsupp.single_le_iff.2 hnν)] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.not_negDepthGe_of_mem_signedBasisAt_zero
statement:
lemma not_negDepthGe_of_mem_signedBasisAt_zero {i : I} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν}
    (h : negGlobal D ν b ∈ signedBasisAt D i 0) : ¬ NegDepthGe D i 1 b
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  refine h.2 ⟨h.1.1, ?_⟩
  exact negFilt_le_range D i 1 ν (negGlobal_mem_negFilt D hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasisAt_eq_range
statement:
theorem canonicalBasisAt_eq_range (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    canonicalBasisAt D ν = Set.range (negGlobal D ν)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    induction hx with
    | one => exact ⟨Quotient.mk _ ⟨[], rfl⟩, negGlobal_zero D _⟩
    | @step ν i n hn y hy ih =>
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ih
      have hb0 := not_negDepthGe_of_mem_signedBasisAt_zero D (hb ▸ y.2)
      exact ⟨negCrystalF D i n b,
        (signedStringMap_signed D y hb0 (Or.inl ⟨hb.symm, rfl⟩)).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    induction h : ν.degree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing ν with
    | _ d ih =>
      by_cases hν : ν = 0
      · subst hν
        rw [negGlobal_zero]
        exact IsCanonicalAt.one
      obtain ⟨i, n, hn, hc, hc'⟩ := exists_negDepth D hν c
      obtain ⟨ν', b, hμ, hb, rfl⟩ := exists_negCrystalF_eq D hc hc'
      subst hμ
      have hdeg : ν'.degree < d := by
        rw [← h, map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]
        omega
      have hy : negGlobal D ν' b ∈ signedBasisAt D i 0 :=
        (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).2 ⟨ν', b, negDepthGe_zero D i b, hb, Or.inl rfl⟩
      have := IsCanonicalAt.step (D := D) hn ⟨_, hy⟩ (ih _ hdeg ν' b rfl)
      rwa [signedStringMap_signed D ⟨_, hy⟩ hb (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_canonicalBasis_iff
statement:
theorem mem_canonicalBasis_iff {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ canonicalBasis D ↔ ∃ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν), x = negGlobal D ν b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalBasis, Set.mem_iUnion, canonicalBasisAt_eq_range, Set.mem_range,
    eq_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signedBasis_eq_union
statement: theorem signedBasis_eq_union : signedBasis D = canonicalBasis D ∪ -canonicalBasis D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_neg, mem_canonicalBasis_iff, mem_signedBasis_iff,
    neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ν, b, h | h⟩
    exacts [Or.inl ⟨ν, b, h⟩, Or.inr ⟨ν, b, h⟩]
  · rintro (⟨ν, b, h⟩ | ⟨ν, b, h⟩)
    exacts [⟨ν, b, Or.inl h⟩, ⟨ν, b, Or.inr h⟩]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_negGlobal_mem_range
statement:
lemma starU_negGlobal_mem_range {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    starU D 𝕧 (negGlobal D ν b) ∈ Set.range (negGlobal D ν)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := GrandLoop.starU_fWi_sub_mem (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum (D := D) (Quotient.out b).1
  have h1 : starU D 𝕧 (negGlobal D ν b) - starU D 𝕧 (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1) ∈
      ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    rw [← map_sub]
    exact starU_mem_smul_latInf' (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b)
  have h2 : starU D 𝕧 (negGlobal D ν b) - fWi hvt w' ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel _ (starU D 𝕧 (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1))]
    exact add_mem h1 hw'
  have hG := negGlobal_mem D ν b
  have hy : starU D 𝕧 (negGlobal D ν b) ∈ negBalanced D ν :=
    ⟨starU_mem_negIntegral hG.1, starU_mem_Uw hG.2.1,
      starU_mem_latInf (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
        InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
        InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
        D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hG.2.2.1,
      starU_mem_latInfBar hG.2.2.2⟩
  have hw : wordWeight w' = ν := by
    by_contra hw
    have h3 := proj_mem_smul_latInf (toZ (wordWeight w')) h2
    rw [map_sub, proj_of_mem_Uw hy.2.1, proj_of_mem_Uw (fWi_mem_Uw w'), ite_eq_left rfl,
      ite_eq_right fun e ↦ hw (LusztigF.toZ_injective e).symm, zero_sub] at h3
    exact fWi_notMem_ratFunc D w' (by simpa using neg_mem h3)
  exact ⟨_, (negGlobal_eq_of_sub_mem D hy hw h2).symm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasisAt_inter_neg
statement:
theorem canonicalBasisAt_inter_neg (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    canonicalBasisAt D ν ∩ -canonicalBasisAt D ν = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rintro x ⟨hx, hx'⟩
  rw [canonicalBasisAt_eq_range] at hx hx'
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Set.mem_neg.1 hx'
  have hb'' : negGlobal D ν b' = -negGlobal D ν b := hb'
  obtain ⟨h, hc⟩ := signed_eq_signed D (y := negGlobal D ν b') (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inr hb'')
  have hc' : b' = b := hc
  subst hc'
  exact negGlobal_ne_neg D b' hb''

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_image_canonicalBasisAt
statement:
theorem starU_image_canonicalBasisAt (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    starU D 𝕧 '' canonicalBasisAt D ν = canonicalBasisAt D ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalBasisAt_eq_range]
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ fun x hx ↦ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact starU_negGlobal_mem_range D b
  · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨_, starU_negGlobal_mem_range D b, starU_starU _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasisAt_inter_neg_starU
statement:
theorem canonicalBasisAt_inter_neg_starU (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    canonicalBasisAt D ν ∩ -(starU D 𝕧 '' canonicalBasisAt D ν) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [starU_image_canonicalBasisAt, canonicalBasisAt_inter_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_canonicalBasisAt
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_canonicalBasisAt (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent 𝕂 (Subtype.val : canonicalBasisAt D ν → Um D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalBasisAt_eq_range]
  exact (linearIndepOn_id_range_iff (linearIndependent_negGlobal D ν).injective).2
    (linearIndependent_negGlobal D ν)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_canonicalBasisAt_laurent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_canonicalBasisAt_laurent (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Subtype.val : canonicalBasisAt D ν → Um D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalBasisAt_eq_range]
  exact (linearIndepOn_id_range_iff (linearIndependent_negGlobal_laurent D ν).injective).2
    (linearIndependent_negGlobal_laurent D ν)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_canonicalBasisAt
statement:
theorem span_canonicalBasisAt (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Submodule.span 𝕂 (canonicalBasisAt D ν) = Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalBasisAt_eq_range]
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) fun x hx ↦ mem_span_negGlobal_field D hx
  rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  exact (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_canonicalBasisAt_laurent
statement:
theorem span_canonicalBasisAt_laurent (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (canonicalBasisAt D ν) = negIntegralWeight D ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalBasisAt_eq_range]
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) fun x hx ↦ mem_span_negGlobal D hx.1 hx.2
  rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨(negGlobal_mem D ν b).1, (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_negGlobal_sigma
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_negGlobal_sigma :
    LinearIndependent 𝕂 fun p : Σ ν, negCrystal D ν ↦ negGlobal D p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg ⟨ν, b⟩ hp
  have h := congrArg (NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν)) hg
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h
  have e : ∀ q ∈ s, NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) (g q • negGlobal D q.1 q.2) =
      if q.1 = ν then g q • negGlobal D q.1 q.2 else 0 := by
    intro q _
    rw [map_smul, proj_of_mem_Uw (negGlobal_mem D q.1 q.2).2.1]
    by_cases hq : q.1 = ν
    · rw [ite_eq_left (congrArg LusztigF.toZ hq), ite_eq_left hq]
    · rw [ite_eq_right fun e ↦ hq (LusztigF.toZ_injective e), ite_eq_right hq, smul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e] at h
  rw [← Finset.sum_preimage (Sigma.mk ν) s (sigma_mk_injective.injOn) _ (fun q _ hq ↦ by
    obtain ⟨μ, c⟩ := q
    refine ite_eq_right fun e ↦ ?_
    subst e
    exact hq ⟨c, rfl⟩)] at h
  simp only [ite_true] at h
  exact linearIndependent_iff'.1 (linearIndependent_negGlobal D ν) _ (fun c ↦ g ⟨ν, c⟩) h b
    (Finset.mem_preimage.2 hp)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasis_eq_range
statement:
lemma canonicalBasis_eq_range :
    canonicalBasis D = Set.range fun p : Σ ν, negCrystal D ν ↦ negGlobal D p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_canonicalBasis_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ν, b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨ν, b⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨ν, b⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨ν, b, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_canonicalBasis
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_canonicalBasis :
    LinearIndependent 𝕂 (Subtype.val : canonicalBasis D → Um D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalBasis_eq_range]
  exact (linearIndepOn_id_range_iff (linearIndependent_negGlobal_sigma D).injective).2
    (linearIndependent_negGlobal_sigma D)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_canonicalBasis_laurent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_canonicalBasis_laurent :
    LinearIndependent (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Subtype.val : canonicalBasis D → Um D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s c hc i hi
  have h := linearIndependent_iff'.1 (linearIndependent_canonicalBasis D) s
    (fun j ↦ integralLaurentEval (c j)) (by simpa only [laurent_smul_eq] using hc) i hi
  exact integralLaurentEval_injective (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_canonicalBasis
statement: theorem span_canonicalBasis : Submodule.span 𝕂 (canonicalBasis D) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ ?_
  refine (iSup_le fun ν ↦ ?_ : ⨆ ν, Uw D 𝕧 ν ≤ _) (mem_iSup_Uw D x)
  rw [← span_canonicalBasisAt]
  exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.subset_iUnion (canonicalBasisAt D) ν)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_canonicalBasis_laurent
statement:
theorem span_canonicalBasis_laurent :
    Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (canonicalBasis D) = negIntegral D
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) fun x hx ↦ ?_
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨ν, b, rfl⟩ := (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 hx
    exact (negGlobal_mem D ν b).1
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ _).1 (mem_iSup_Uw D x)
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  have hp : NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (toZ ν) (f.sum fun _ y ↦ y) = f ν := by
    rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single ν]
    · rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (hf ν), ite_eq_left rfl]
    · intro μ _ hμ
      rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (hf μ), ite_eq_right fun e ↦ hμ (LusztigF.toZ_injective e)]
    · intro hν
      rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hν, map_zero]
  have hν : f ν ∈ negIntegralWeight D ν := ⟨hp ▸ proj_mem_negIntegral D _ hx, hf ν⟩
  rw [← span_canonicalBasisAt_laurent] at hν
  exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.subset_iUnion (canonicalBasisAt D) ν) hν

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.serreSubmodule_le_comap_freeBarSL
statement:
lemma serreSubmodule_le_comap_freeBarSL :
    serreSubmodule D 𝕧 ≤ (serreSubmodule D 𝕧).comap (freeBarSL (I := I))
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  rw [mem_serreSubmodule] at hx
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, mem_serreSubmodule]
  exact LusztigF.bar_mem_serreIdeal D hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma negBar_mk (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    negBar D (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (LusztigF.bar x)
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_negBar
statement: @[simp] lemma negBar_negBar (x : Um D 𝕧) : negBar D (negBar D x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_smul
statement: lemma negBar_smul (c : 𝕂) (x : Um D 𝕧) : negBar D (c • x) = RatFunc.bar c • negBar D x
proof:
:=
  (negBar D).map_smulₛₗ c x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_injective
statement: lemma negBar_injective : Function.Injective (negBar D)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (negBar_negBar D)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negativeQuotientEquiv_negBar
statement:
lemma negativeQuotientEquiv_negBar (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    negativeQuotientEquiv D (negBar D x) = quotientBar D (negativeQuotientEquiv D x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  exact (quotientBar_toQuotient D x).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_infinity_smul
statement:
lemma negBar_infinity_smul (b : LocalRing) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    negBar D ((show InfinityLocalRing from b) • x) = b • negBar D x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 (show InfinityLocalRing from b) x, negBar_smul,
    ← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 b (negBar D x)]
  congr 1
  change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar (algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 b)) = _
  rw [RatFunc.bar_bar]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_local_smul
statement:
lemma negBar_local_smul (b : LocalRing) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    negBar D (b • x) = (show InfinityLocalRing from b) • negBar D x
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← negBar_negBar D x, ← negBar_infinity_smul]
  exact negBar_negBar D _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_latInfBar_iff
statement:
lemma mem_latInfBar_iff (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    x ∈ latInfBar D ↔ negBar D x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt InfinityLocalRing
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_localX_smul_latInfBar_iff
statement:
lemma mem_localX_smul_latInfBar_iff (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    x ∈ localX • latInfBar D ↔
      negBar D x ∈ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • latInf (D := D) hvt InfinityLocalRing
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨negBar D y, hy, (negBar_local_smul D localX y).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨negBar D y, (mem_latInfBar_iff D _).2 (by rwa [negBar_negBar]), ?_⟩
    rw [← negBar_negBar D x, ← hxy]
    exact (negBar_infinity_smul D localX y).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residueIndependent_latInfBar
statement:
lemma residueIndependent_latInfBar {ι : Type*} {g : ι → Um D 𝕧}

      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer g) :
    ResidueIndependent LocalRing (latInfBar D) localX (fun i ↦ negBar D (g i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ (mem_latInfBar_iff D _).2 (by rw [negBar_negBar]; exact hg.1 i), ?_⟩
  intro s a hs i hi
  rw [mem_localX_smul_latInfBar_iff, map_sum] at hs
  simp_rw [negBar_local_smul, negBar_negBar] at hs
  exact hg.2 s (fun i ↦ show InfinityLocalRing from a i) hs i hi
