name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.T_sub_T_neg
statement:
lemma T_sub_T_neg (n : ℕ) :
    (T (n : ℤ) - T (-(n : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) =
      (T 1 - T (-1)) * ∑ k ∈ range n, T ((n : ℤ) - 1 - 2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, ((T 1 - T (-1)) * T ((n : ℤ) - 1 - 2 * k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) =
      T ((n : ℤ) - 2 * k) - T ((n : ℤ) - 2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
    intro k
    rw [sub_mul, ← T_add, ← T_add]
    congr 2
    · ring
    · push_cast; ring
  simp_rw [h]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_sub' (f := fun k : ℕ ↦ (T ((n : ℤ) - 2 * k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ))]
  congr 2
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_sub_invert_eq_mul
statement:
lemma exists_sub_invert_eq_mul (c : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    ∃ d : LaurentPolynomial ℤ, c - invert c = (T 1 - T (-1)) * d
proof:
:= by
  refine LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' c ?_ ?_
  · rintro p q ⟨d, hd⟩ ⟨e, he⟩
    refine ⟨d + e, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, mul_add, ← hd, ← he]
    ring
  · intro n z
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : LaurentPolynomial ℤ, T n - T (-n) = (T 1 - T (-1)) * d := by
      obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg n
      · exact ⟨_, T_sub_T_neg m⟩
      · refine ⟨-∑ k ∈ range m, T ((m : ℤ) - 1 - 2 * k), ?_⟩
        rw [neg_neg, mul_neg, ← T_sub_T_neg m]
        ring
    refine ⟨C z * d, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, invert_C, invert_T, ← mul_sub, hd]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_sub_quotientBar_eq_smul
statement:
lemma exists_sub_quotientBar_eq_smul {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) :
    ∃ y ∈ quotientIntegralForm D,
      x - quotientBar D x =
        (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 - LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • y
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨0, zero_mem _, ?_⟩
    rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, quotientBar_qDivPow, sub_self, smul_zero]
  | algebraMap c =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_sub_invert_eq_mul c
    refine ⟨algebraMap _ _ d, (quotientIntegralForm D).algebraMap_mem d, ?_⟩
    rw [quotientBar_integral_algebraMap, ← map_sub, hd, map_mul, Algebra.smul_def]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hyb⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨a + b, add_mem ha hb, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, smul_add, ← hxa, ← hyb]
    abel
  | mul x y hx' hy' hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hyb⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨a * y + quotientBar D x * b,
      add_mem (mul_mem ha hy') (mul_mem (quotientBar_mem_integralForm D hx') hb), ?_⟩
    have e : x * y - quotientBar D (x * y) =
        (x - quotientBar D x) * y + quotientBar D x * (y - quotientBar D y) := by
      rw [map_mul]; noncomm_ring
    rw [e, hxa, hyb, smul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_sub_negBar_eq_smul
statement:
lemma exists_sub_negBar_eq_smul {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D) :
    ∃ y ∈ negIntegral D, x - negBar D x = (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂) • y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_sub_quotientBar_eq_smul D hx
  refine ⟨(negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y, by simpa [mem_negIntegral] using hy, ?_⟩
  apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).injective
  rw [map_sub, negativeQuotientEquiv_negBar, hxy, map_smul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change integralLaurentEval _ • y = _
  simp [integralLaurentEval_T]

lemma finite_setOf_degree_cbWt_le (N : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  have hfin : {w : List I | w.length ≤ N}.Finite := List.finite_length_le I N
  refine ((hfin.image fun w ↦ negGlobal D (wordWeight w) ⟦⟨w, rfl⟩⟧).preimage
    Subtype.val_injective.injOn).subset fun b hb ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := ((mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 b.2).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := exists_negGlobal_eq_word (cbWt D b) β

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorPsi
statement:
lemma repr_tensorPsi (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1)
    (j : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' z) j =
      ∑ k ∈ ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr z).support,
        RatFunc.bar ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr z k) *
          (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ' k)) j
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').linearCombination_repr z]
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_apply']
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [tensorPsi_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_eq_sum_of_vanish
statement:
private lemma sum_eq_sum_of_vanish {α M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    {S T : Finset α} (f : α → M) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, x ∉ T → f x = 0)
    (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, x ∉ S → f x = 0) : ∑ x ∈ S, f x = ∑ x ∈ T, f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc ∑ x ∈ S, f x = ∑ x ∈ S ∪ T, f x := Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left
        fun x hx hxS ↦ hT x ((Finset.mem_union.1 hx).resolve_left hxS) hxS
    _ = ∑ x ∈ T, f x := (Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right
        fun x hx hxT ↦ hS x ((Finset.mem_union.1 hx).resolve_right hxT) hxT).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLusztigMatrix_tensorRho
statement:
theorem isLusztigMatrix_tensorRho : IsLusztigMatrix (tensorRho hR Λ Λ') where
  self h
proof:
:= integralLaurentEval_injective (by
    rw [integralLaurentEval_tensorRho, map_one]; exact repr_tensorPsi_self hR Λ Λ' h)
  inv h h' hh := by
    classical
    apply integralLaurentEval_injective
    have hΨ : (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ'
        (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ' h))) h' =
        (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ' h) h' := by rw [tensorPsi_tensorPsi]
    rw [repr_tensorPsi, Module.Basis.repr_self] at hΨ
    rw [map_sum, apply_ite integralLaurentEval, map_one, map_zero]
    simp only [map_mul, ← bar_integralLaurentEval, integralLaurentEval_tensorRho]
    rw [← sum_eq_sum_of_vanish (S := ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr
      (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ' h))).support), hΨ, Finsupp.single_apply]
    · intro x _ hx
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc, not_and_or] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [repr_tensorPsi_eq_zero_of_not_le hR Λ Λ' hx, map_zero, zero_mul]
      · rw [repr_tensorPsi_eq_zero_of_not_le hR Λ Λ' hx, mul_zero]
    · intro x _ hx
      rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hx, map_zero, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorLt_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero

theorem tensorLt_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero {h h' : TensorIdx Λ Λ'} (hne : h' ≠ h)
    (h0 : (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h) h' ≠ 0) :
    TensorLt Λ Λ' h' h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [repr_tensorCanonical] at h0
  by_cases hh : h ≤ h'

proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [repr_tensorCanonical]
  split_ifs with hh
  · exact ⟨_, (isLusztigFamily_tensorPi hR Λ Λ').isNeg h h' (lt_of_le_of_ne hh hne.symm), rfl⟩
  · exact isNegLaurent_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPsi_tensorCanonical
statement:
theorem tensorPsi_tensorCanonical (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h) = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').ext_elem fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [repr_tensorPsi]
  set c := (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h)
  by_cases hj : h ≤ (j : TensorIdx Λ Λ')
  · rw [repr_tensorCanonical, ite_eq_left hj,
      (isLusztigFamily_tensorPi hR Λ Λ').eq_sum h j hj, map_sum]
    refine sum_eq_sum_of_vanish _ (fun x hx hxI ↦ ?_) (fun x hx hxS ↦ ?_) |>.trans
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    · have hhx : h ≤ (x : TensorIdx Λ Λ') := by
        by_contra hn
        exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hx (by rw [repr_tensorCanonical, ite_eq_right hn])
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc, not_and] at hxI
      rw [repr_tensorPsi_eq_zero_of_not_le hR Λ Λ' (hxI hhx), mul_zero]
    · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hxS, map_zero, zero_mul]
    · rw [map_mul, integralLaurentEval_tensorRho, ← bar_integralLaurentEval,
        repr_tensorCanonical, ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hx).1]
  · rw [repr_tensorCanonical, ite_eq_right hj]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx ↦ ?_
    have hhx : h ≤ (x : TensorIdx Λ Λ') := by
      by_contra hn
      exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hx (by rw [repr_tensorCanonical, ite_eq_right hn])
    rw [repr_tensorPsi_eq_zero_of_not_le hR Λ Λ' fun hxj ↦ hj (hhx.trans hxj), mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_tensorPsi_eq
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_tensorPsi_eq {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1}
    (hz : tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' z = z) (hneg : 𝕧 • z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ') : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [smul_mem_tensorLat_iff] at hneg
  by_contra hne
  set s := ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr z).support
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff]
    exact fun e ↦ hne ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr.map_eq_zero_iff.1 e)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := s.exists_minimal hs
  have key : (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' z) j =
      (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ').repr z j := by rw [hz]
  rw [repr_tensorPsi, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj.1,
    repr_tensorPsi_tensorBasisIdx_self, mul_one] at key
  · exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hj.1 ((hneg j).eq_zero_of_bar_eq key)
  · intro k hk hkj
    by_cases hkj' : k ≤ (j : TensorIdx Λ Λ')
    · exact absurd (le_antisymm (hj.2 hk hkj') hkj').symm hkj
    · rw [repr_tensorPsi_eq_zero_of_not_le hR Λ Λ' hkj', mul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.existsUnique_tensorCanonical
statement:
theorem existsUnique_tensorCanonical (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    ∃! x, x ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ' ∧ tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' x = x ∧
      𝕧 • (x - tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ' h) ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hneg : 𝕧 • (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h - tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ' h) ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ' := by
    rw [smul_mem_tensorLat_iff]
    intro h'
    rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases hh : h = h'
    · subst hh
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, repr_tensorCanonical_self, sub_self]
      exact isNegLaurent_zero
    · rw [ite_eq_right hh, sub_zero]
      exact isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' (Ne.symm hh)
  refine ⟨tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h, ⟨?_, tensorPsi_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h, hneg⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro h'
    by_cases hh : h' = h
    · subst hh
      rw [repr_tensorCanonical_self, mul_one]
      exact isNegLaurent_inv_X
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' hh
      rw [← he]
      exact isNegLaurent_inv_X_mul ha
  · rintro x ⟨-, hx, hx'⟩
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    refine eq_zero_of_tensorPsi_eq hR Λ Λ' ?_ ?_
    · rw [map_sub, hx, tensorPsi_tensorCanonical]
    · have := sub_mem hx' hneg
      rwa [← smul_sub, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFiltGlobalAt
statement:
theorem negFiltGlobalAt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (i : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    NegFiltGlobalAt D i n ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := exists_dom_ge (R := R) hfund ν.degree
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, hgF, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, hgu, hgw⟩ := hwFiltGlobalAt hR hfund hIH Λ i hn
  choose x hx hxg using hgF
  have hxw : ∀ k, x k ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν := fun k ↦ (mem_negFilt_le D (hx k)).2
  have hL : ∀ {z : Um D 𝕧}, z ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν →
      (z ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A ↔ evq hvt Λ z ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) := fun hz ↦
    mem_latticeInf_iff InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund hΛ hz
  have hLs : ∀ {z : Um D 𝕧}, z ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A → z ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν →
      (z ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A ↔ evq hvt Λ z ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ) := fun hz hzw ↦
    mem_smul_latInf_iff InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund hΛ hz hzw
  have hsum : ∀ (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → A),
      evq hvt Λ (∑ k ∈ s, a k • x k) = ∑ k ∈ s, a k • g k := fun s a ↦ by
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, hxg]
  have hr₀ : ResidueIndependent A (latInf (D := D) hvt A) ϖ x := by
    refine ⟨fun k ↦ (hL (hxw k)).2 (by rw [hxg]; exact hg₀.1 k), fun s a hs k hk ↦ ?_⟩
    refine hg₀.2 s a ?_ k hk
    rw [← hsum]
    exact evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund hs Λ
  have hr₁ : ResidueIndependent LocalRing (latInfBar D) localX x := by
    refine ⟨fun k ↦ ?_, fun s a hs k hk ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_latInfBar_iff, hL (negBar_mem_Uw D (hxw k)), ← hwBar_evq hR, hxg]
      exact hg₁.1 k
    · refine hg₁.2 s a ?_ k hk
      rw [mem_localX_smul_latInfBar_iff] at hs
      have : evq hvt Λ (negBar D (∑ k ∈ s, a k • x k)) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
        evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund hs Λ
      rw [← hwBar_evq hR, ← mem_localX_smul_latBar_iff] at this
      simpa only [map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, hxg] using this
  have hinj : Function.Injective ((evq hvt Λ).comp (Uw D 𝕧 ν).subtype) :=
    evq_injective (hR := hR) hΛ
  refine ⟨ι, x, u, hx, hr₀, hr₁, fun y hy ↦ ?_, fun k ↦ ?_, hgw⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1
      (hspan _ (evq_mem_hwFilt Λ hy))
    have hz : (c.sum fun k a ↦ a • x k) ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range x) :=
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)
    have hzF : (c.sum fun k a ↦ a • x k) ∈ negFilt D i n ν :=
      Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hx) hz
    have hez : evq hvt Λ (c.sum fun k a ↦ a • x k) = evq hvt Λ y := by
      rw [← hc, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
      rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, hxg, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
    have := @hinj ⟨_, (mem_negFilt_le D hzF).2⟩ ⟨y, (mem_negFilt_le D hy).2⟩ hez
    rw [← show (c.sum fun k a ↦ a • x k) = y from congrArg Subtype.val this]
    exact hz
  · have hfw : fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u k) ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν := by
      rw [← hgw k]; exact fWi_mem_Uw _
    have hzw : x k - fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u k) ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν :=
      sub_mem (hxw k) hfw
    have hzL : x k - fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u k) ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
      sub_mem (hr₀.1 k) (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ _)
    refine (hLs hzL hzw).2 ?_
    have h3 : evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u k)) -
        fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ u k) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
      evq_fWord_sub_fW_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
        InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
        InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund _ Λ
    have e : evq hvt Λ (x k - fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u k)) =
        (g k - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ u k)) -
          (evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u k)) -
            fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ u k)) := by
      rw [map_sub, hxg]; abel
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem (hgu k) h3

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFilt_eq_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, -, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, -, -⟩ := negFiltGlobalAt hR hfund hIH i hn
  exact balanced_eq_zero_of_mem_span (laurent_smul_eq D) hg₀ hg₁ (hspan x hx) hxϖ hx₁

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_negFilt_sub_mem
statement:
theorem exists_negFilt_sub_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (i : I) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negFilt D i n ν) (hx₀ : x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    ∃ y ∈ negFilt D i n ν, y ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A ∧ y ∈ latInfBar D ∧
      x - y ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, hgF, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, -, -⟩ := negFiltGlobalAt hR hfund hIH i hn
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_int_sub_mem_of_mem_span (laurent_smul_eq D) hg₀ (hspan x hx) hx₀
  have key : ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g),
      y ∈ negFilt D i n ν ∧ y ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A ∧ y ∈ latInfBar D := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy => obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hy; exact ⟨hgF k, hg₀.1 k, hg₁.1 k⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩
    | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => exact ⟨add_mem hy.1 hy'.1, add_mem hy.2.1 hy'.2.1,
        add_mem hy.2.2 hy'.2.2⟩
    | smul m y _ hy => exact ⟨zsmul_mem hy.1 m, zsmul_mem hy.2.1 m, zsmul_mem hy.2.2 m⟩
  exact ⟨y, (key y hy).1, (key y hy).2.1, (key y hy).2.2, hxy⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.algebraMap_ne_zero_of_ne
statement:
lemma algebraMap_ne_zero_of_ne (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K)) (hϖ : ϖ ≠ 0) :
    algebraMap A K ϖ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_zero (algebraMap A K)]; exact fun h ↦ hϖ (hinj h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inv_smul_smul_uniformizer
statement:
lemma inv_smul_smul_uniformizer (hϖ : algebraMap A K ϖ ≠ 0) (y : V) :
    (algebraMap A K ϖ)⁻¹ • ϖ • y = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul K ϖ y, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hϖ, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ResidueIndependent.mem_of_pow
statement:
lemma ResidueIndependent.mem_of_pow (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K)) (hϖ : ϖ ≠ 0)
    (hg : ResidueIndependent A L ϖ g) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : ι → K), (∀ i ∈ s, ∃ a : A, algebraMap A K (ϖ ^ m) * c i = algebraMap A K a) →
      ∑ i ∈ s, c i • g i ∈ L → ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ a : A, c i = algebraMap A K a
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro c hc _ i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hc i hi
    exact ⟨a, by simpa using ha⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro c hc hsum
    choose! a ha using hc
    have hmem : ∑ i ∈ s, a i • g i ∈ ϖ • L := by
      have : ∑ i ∈ s, a i • g i = ϖ • ((ϖ ^ m) • ∑ i ∈ s, c i • g i) := by
        rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
        rw [← algebraMap_smul K (a i), ← ha i hi, ← algebraMap_smul K ϖ,
          ← algebraMap_smul K (ϖ ^ m), smul_smul, smul_smul, ← map_mul, ← pow_succ']
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (L.smul_mem _ hsum)
    have hdiv := hg.2 s a hmem
    refine ih c (fun i hi ↦ ?_) hsum
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hdiv i hi
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (algebraMap_ne_zero_of_ne hinj hϖ)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← pow_succ', ha i hi, hb, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ResidueIndependent.exists_eq_of_sum_mem
statement:
theorem ResidueIndependent.exists_eq_of_sum_mem (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K))
    (hϖ : ϖ ≠ 0) (hk : ∀ c : K, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A K (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A K a)
    (hg : ResidueIndependent A L ϖ g)
    (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → K) (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, c i • g i ∈ L) :
    ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ a : A, c i = algebraMap A K a
proof:
:= by
  choose m a ha using fun i ↦ hk (c i)
  refine hg.mem_of_pow hinj hϖ s (∑ i ∈ s, m i) c (fun i hi ↦ ?_) hsum
  refine ⟨ϖ ^ (∑ j ∈ s, m j - m i) * a i, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, ← ha i, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← pow_add,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hi)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ResidueIndependent.exists_eq_of_sum_mem_smul
statement:
theorem ResidueIndependent.exists_eq_of_sum_mem_smul
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K)) (hϖ : ϖ ≠ 0)
    (hk : ∀ c : K, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A K (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A K a)
    (hg : ResidueIndependent A L ϖ g)
    (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → K) (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, c i • g i ∈ ϖ • L) :
    ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ a : A, c i = algebraMap A K (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hsum
  have hϖ' := algebraMap_ne_zero_of_ne (K := K) hinj hϖ
  have h : ∑ i ∈ s, ((algebraMap A K ϖ)⁻¹ * c i) • g i ∈ L := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ s, ((algebraMap A K ϖ)⁻¹ * c i) • g i = y := by
      simp_rw [mul_smul]
      rw [← Finset.smul_sum, ← hxy, inv_smul_smul_uniformizer hϖ']
    rw [this]; exact hy
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hg.exists_eq_of_sum_mem hinj hϖ hk s _ h i hi
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, ← ha, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hϖ', one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ResidueIndependent.exists_eq_of_sum_mem_pow
statement:
theorem ResidueIndependent.exists_eq_of_sum_mem_pow
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K)) (hϖ : ϖ ≠ 0)
    (hk : ∀ c : K, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A K (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A K a)
    (hg : ResidueIndependent A L ϖ g) (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ) (c : ι → K)
    (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, c i • g i ∈ ϖ ^ n • L) :
    ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ a : A, c i = algebraMap A K (ϖ ^ n * a)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, one_smul, one_mul] at hsum ⊢
    exact hg.exists_eq_of_sum_mem hinj hϖ hk s c hsum
  | succ n ih =>
    have hϖ' := algebraMap_ne_zero_of_ne (K := K) hinj hϖ
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hsum
    have h : ∑ i ∈ s, ((algebraMap A K ϖ)⁻¹ * c i) • g i ∈ ϖ ^ n • L := by
      have : ∑ i ∈ s, ((algebraMap A K ϖ)⁻¹ * c i) • g i = ϖ ^ n • y := by
        simp_rw [mul_smul]
        rw [← Finset.smul_sum, ← hxy, pow_succ', mul_smul, inv_smul_smul_uniformizer hϖ']
      rw [this]; exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ hy
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ih _ h i hi
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, map_mul, ← ha, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hϖ', one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ResidueIndependent.linearIndependent
statement:
theorem ResidueIndependent.linearIndependent [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K)) (hϖ : ϖ ≠ 0)
    (hk : ∀ c : K, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : A), algebraMap A K (ϖ ^ m) * c = algebraMap A K a)
    (hg : ResidueIndependent A L ϖ g) (hirr : Irreducible ϖ) : LinearIndependent K g
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s c hc i hi
  have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a : A, c i = algebraMap A K (ϖ ^ n * a) := fun n ↦
    hg.exists_eq_of_sum_mem_pow hinj hϖ hk s n c (by rw [hc]; exact zero_mem _) i hi
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hall 0
  rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at ha
  by_contra hne
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hne (by simp [ha])
  obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.associated_pow_irreducible ha0 hirr
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hall (n + 1)
  have : a = ϖ ^ (n + 1) * b := hinj (by rw [← ha, hb])
  
  have h2 : ϖ ^ n * (ϖ * (b * u)) = ϖ ^ n * 1 :=
    calc ϖ ^ n * (ϖ * (b * u)) = ϖ ^ (n + 1) * b * u := by ring
      _ = a * u := by rw [this]
      _ = ϖ ^ n * 1 := by rw [hu, mul_one]
  have h3 : ϖ * (b * u) = 1 := mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hϖ) h2
  exact hirr.not_isUnit (isUnit_iff_exists_inv.2 ⟨_, h3⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ResidueIndependent.sumElim
statement:
theorem ResidueIndependent.sumElim {κ : Type*} (hg : ResidueIndependent A L ϖ g) {y : κ → V}
    (W : Submodule A V) (hgW : ∀ i, g i ∈ W) (hy : ∀ s, y s ∈ L)
    (hyW : ∀ (t : Finset κ) (a : κ → A), ∑ s ∈ t, a s • y s ∈ ϖ • L ⊔ W → ∀ s ∈ t, ϖ ∣ a s) :
    ResidueIndependent A L ϖ (Sum.elim g y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x ↦ ?_, fun t a ht ↦ ?_⟩
  · cases x with
    | inl i => exact hg.1 i
    | inr s => exact hy s
  rw [Finset.sum_sum_eq_sum_toLeft_add_sum_toRight] at ht
  simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at ht
  have hW : ∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, a (Sum.inl i) • g i ∈ W :=
    Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ W.smul_mem _ (hgW i)
  have hright : ∀ s ∈ t.toRight, ϖ ∣ a (Sum.inr s) := by
    refine hyW t.toRight (fun s ↦ a (Sum.inr s)) ?_
    have : ∑ s ∈ t.toRight, a (Sum.inr s) • y s =
        (∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, a (Sum.inl i) • g i + ∑ s ∈ t.toRight, a (Sum.inr s) • y s) -
          ∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, a (Sum.inl i) • g i := by abel
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left ht) (Submodule.mem_sup_right hW)
  have hR : ∑ s ∈ t.toRight, a (Sum.inr s) • y s ∈ ϖ • L := by
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s hs ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hright s hs
    rw [hb, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (L.smul_mem _ (hy s))
  have hleft : ∀ i ∈ t.toLeft, ϖ ∣ a (Sum.inl i) := by
    refine hg.2 t.toLeft (fun i ↦ a (Sum.inl i)) ?_
    have : ∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, a (Sum.inl i) • g i =
        (∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, a (Sum.inl i) • g i + ∑ s ∈ t.toRight, a (Sum.inr s) • y s) -
          ∑ s ∈ t.toRight, a (Sum.inr s) • y s := by abel
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ ht hR
  intro x hx
  cases x with
  | inl i => exact hleft i (Finset.mem_toLeft.2 hx)
  | inr s => exact hright s (Finset.mem_toRight.2 hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residueIndependent_mod_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem residueIndependent_mod_of_sub_mem {κ : Type*} (W : Submodule A V) {f y : κ → V}
    (hfy : ∀ s, y s - f s ∈ W)
    (hf : ∀ (t : Finset κ) (a : κ → A), ∑ s ∈ t, a s • f s ∈ ϖ • L ⊔ W → ∀ s ∈ t, ϖ ∣ a s)
    (t : Finset κ) (a : κ → A) (ht : ∑ s ∈ t, a s • y s ∈ ϖ • L ⊔ W) : ∀ s ∈ t, ϖ ∣ a s
proof:
:= by
  refine hf t a ?_
  have : ∑ s ∈ t, a s • f s = ∑ s ∈ t, a s • y s - ∑ s ∈ t, a s • (y s - f s) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ by rw [smul_sub]; abel
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.sub_mem _ ht
    (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s _ ↦ W.smul_mem _ (hfy s)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.integralLaurentEval_mem_range_laurentToCoeff
statement:
lemma integralLaurentEval_mem_range_laurentToCoeff (f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    integralLaurentEval f ∈ Set.range laurentToCoeff
proof:
:= by
  refine LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' f ?_ ?_
  · rintro p q ⟨p', hp⟩ ⟨q', hq⟩
    exact ⟨p' + q', by rw [map_add, map_add, hp, hq]⟩
  · intro n a
    refine ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C (a : ℚ) * LaurentPolynomial.T n, ?_⟩
    simp [laurentToCoeff, integralLaurentEval]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_int_of_laurent_regular
statement:
theorem exists_int_of_laurent_regular (f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (a : InfinityLocalRing)
    (ha : algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 a = integralLaurentEval f) (b : LocalRing)
    (hb : algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 b = integralLaurentEval f) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, integralLaurentEval f = z
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : integralLaurentEval f ∈ LocalRing := hb ▸ b.2
  have hinf : RatFunc.bar (integralLaurentEval f) ∈ LocalRing := by
    rw [← ha]
    change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar (algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 a)) ∈ LocalRing
    rw [RatFunc.bar_bar]
    exact (show LocalRing from a).2
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := scalar_laurent_intersection _
    (integralLaurentEval_mem_range_laurentToCoeff f) hzero hinf
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := residue_integer_of_laurent_at_zero b f hb
  have hbc : b = algebraMap ℚ LocalRing c :=
    injective_algebraMap_localRing (by rw [hb, hc]; exact (local_rat_coe c).symm)
  rw [hbc, residue_rat] at hz
  exact ⟨z, by rw [hc, hz, map_intCast]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_laurent_regular_uniformizer
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_laurent_regular_uniformizer (f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (a : InfinityLocalRing)
    (ha : algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 (InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer * a) =
      integralLaurentEval f) (b : LocalRing)
    (hb : algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 b = integralLaurentEval f) :
    integralLaurentEval f = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_int_of_laurent_regular f _ ha b hb
  let a' : LocalRing := a
  have h1 : algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 (localX * a') =
      algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 (z : LocalRing) := by
    have h := congrArg RatFunc.bar (ha.trans hz)
    change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar (algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 (localX * a'))) =
      RatFunc.bar (z : 𝕂) at h
    rw [RatFunc.bar_bar, map_intCast] at h
    rw [h, map_intCast]
  have h2 := congrArg residue (injective_algebraMap_localRing h1)
  rw [map_mul, residue_localX, zero_mul, map_intCast] at h2
  rw [hz]
  exact_mod_cast h2.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_inv_X_sub_eq_localX_mul
statement:
lemma exists_inv_X_sub_eq_localX_mul :
    ∃ u : LocalRing, algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 (localX * u) = (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hw : IsUnit (localX ^ 2 - 1 : LocalRing) := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, maximalIdeal_localRing, ← ker_residue,
      RingHom.mem_ker]
    simp
  refine ⟨↑hw.unit⁻¹, ?_⟩
  have h1 : algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 (localX ^ 2 - 1) * algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 ↑hw.unit⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, map_one]
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, map_one, algebraMap_localX, inv_inv] at h1
  rw [map_mul, algebraMap_localX, inv_inv, eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1]
  have hX : (RatFunc.X : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have h2 : (RatFunc.X ^ 2 - 1 : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h1
  have h3 : (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂) = (RatFunc.X ^ 2 - 1) * RatFunc.X⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  rw [h3, mul_inv, inv_inv, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_inv_X_sub_eq_uniformizer_mul
statement:
lemma exists_inv_X_sub_eq_uniformizer_mul :
    ∃ u : InfinityLocalRing, algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 (InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer * u) =
      (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_inv_X_sub_eq_localX_mul
  refine ⟨-u, ?_⟩
  change RatFunc.bar (algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 (localX * -u)) = _
  rw [mul_neg, map_neg, hu, map_neg, map_inv₀, map_sub, RatFunc.bar_X, map_inv₀, RatFunc.bar_X,
    inv_inv, ← inv_neg, neg_sub]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_laurent_split
statement:
lemma exists_laurent_split (c : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    ∃ (c₀ c₁ : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (a : InfinityLocalRing) (b : LocalRing), c = c₀ + c₁ ∧
      algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂 a = integralLaurentEval c₀ ∧
      algebraMap LocalRing 𝕂 b = integralLaurentEval c₁
proof:
:= by
  refine LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' c ?_ ?_
  · rintro p q ⟨p₀, p₁, a, b, rfl, ha, hb⟩ ⟨q₀, q₁, a', b', rfl, ha', hb'⟩
    exact ⟨p₀ + q₀, p₁ + q₁, a + a', b + b', by ring, by rw [map_add, map_add, ha, ha'],
      by rw [map_add, map_add, hb, hb']⟩
  · intro n z
    rcases le_or_gt n 0 with hn | hn
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.exists_eq_neg_ofNat hn
      refine ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C z * LaurentPolynomial.T (-(m : ℤ)), 0,
        (z : InfinityLocalRing) * InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer ^ m, 0, by ring, ?_, by simp⟩
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer, map_mul,
        integralLaurentEval_T, map_intCast, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_pow]
      simp [integralLaurentEval]
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hn.le
      refine ⟨0, LaurentPolynomial.C z * LaurentPolynomial.T (m : ℤ), 0,
        (z : LocalRing) * localX ^ m, by ring, by simp, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, algebraMap_localX, inv_inv, map_mul, integralLaurentEval_T,
        map_intCast, zpow_natCast]
      simp [integralLaurentEval]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_field_of_mem_span_laurent
statement:
lemma mem_span_field_of_mem_span_laurent
    (hsmul : ∀ (c : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : V), c • x = integralLaurentEval c • x) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => exact Submodule.subset_span hy
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [hsmul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.balanced_coeff_int
statement:
theorem balanced_coeff_int
    (h₀ : ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing L₀ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer g)
    (h₁ : ResidueIndependent LocalRing L₁ localX g) (s : Finset ι)
    (c : ι → LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (hs₀ : ∑ i ∈ s, integralLaurentEval (c i) • g i ∈ L₀)
    (hs₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, integralLaurentEval (c i) • g i ∈ L₁) :
    ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, integralLaurentEval (c i) = z
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₀.exists_eq_of_sum_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    (show InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer ≠ 0 from irreducible_localX.ne_zero)
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul s _ hs₀ i hi
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h₁.exists_eq_of_sum_mem injective_algebraMap_localRing
    irreducible_localX.ne_zero exists_pow_localX_mul s _ hs₁ i hi
  exact exists_int_of_laurent_regular _ a ha.symm b hb.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.balanced_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem balanced_coeff_zero
    (h₀ : ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing L₀ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer g)
    (h₁ : ResidueIndependent LocalRing L₁ localX g) (s : Finset ι)
    (c : ι → LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
    (hs₀ : ∑ i ∈ s, integralLaurentEval (c i) • g i ∈ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • L₀)
    (hs₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, integralLaurentEval (c i) • g i ∈ L₁) :
    ∀ i ∈ s, integralLaurentEval (c i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₀.exists_eq_of_sum_mem_smul InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    (show InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer ≠ 0 from irreducible_localX.ne_zero)
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul s _ hs₀ i hi
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h₁.exists_eq_of_sum_mem injective_algebraMap_localRing
    irreducible_localX.ne_zero exists_pow_localX_mul s _ hs₁ i hi
  exact eq_zero_of_laurent_regular_uniformizer _ a ha.symm b hb.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_split_of_mem_span
statement:
lemma exists_split_of_mem_span (hg₀ : ∀ i, g i ∈ L₀) (hg₁ : ∀ i, g i ∈ L₁) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)) :
    ∃ x₀ x₁ : V, x = x₀ + x₁ ∧ x₀ ∈ L₀ ∧ x₁ ∈ L₁ ∧
      x₀ ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g) ∧
      x₁ ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1 hx
  choose c₀ c₁ a b hc ha hb using exists_laurent_split
  refine ⟨c.sum fun i e ↦ c₀ e • g i, c.sum fun i e ↦ c₁ e • g i, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Finsupp.sum_add]
    exact Finsupp.sum_congr fun i _ ↦ by rw [← add_smul, ← hc (c i)]
  · refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
    dsimp only
    rw [hsmul, ← ha, algebraMap_smul]
    exact L₀.smul_mem _ (hg₀ i)
  · refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
    dsimp only
    rw [hsmul, ← hb, algebraMap_smul]
    exact L₁.smul_mem _ (hg₁ i)
  · exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_residueIndependent_extension
statement:
theorem exists_residueIndependent_extension {κ : Type*}
    (h₀ : ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing L₀ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer g)
    (h₁ : ResidueIndependent LocalRing L₁ localX g) (f : κ → V)
    (hf₀ : ∀ s, ∃ l ∈ L₀, f s - l ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g))
    (hf₁ : ∀ s, ∃ l ∈ L₁, f s - l ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g))
    (hr₀ : ∀ (t : Finset κ) (a : κ → InfinityLocalRing), ∑ s ∈ t, a s • f s ∈
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • L₀ ⊔
        (Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)).restrictScalars InfinityLocalRing →
      ∀ s ∈ t, InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer ∣ a s)
    (hr₁ : ∀ (t : Finset κ) (a : κ → LocalRing), ∑ s ∈ t, a s • f s ∈
      localX • L₁ ⊔ (Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)).restrictScalars LocalRing →
      ∀ s ∈ t, localX ∣ a s) :
    ∃ y : κ → V, (∀ s, y s - f s ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)) ∧
      ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing L₀ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer (Sum.elim g y) ∧
      ResidueIndependent LocalRing L₁ localX (Sum.elim g y)
proof:
:= by
  set N := Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)
  have hy : ∀ s, ∃ y : V, y - f s ∈ N ∧ y ∈ L₀ ∧ y ∈ L₁ := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀, hn₀⟩ := hf₀ s
    obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁, hn₁⟩ := hf₁ s
    
    have hd : l₀ - l₁ ∈ N := by
      have : l₀ - l₁ = (f s - l₁) - (f s - l₀) := by abel
      rw [this]; exact sub_mem hn₁ hn₀
    obtain ⟨m₀, m₁, hm, hm₀, hm₁, hm₀', hm₁'⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_mem_span hsmul h₀.1 h₁.1 hd
    refine ⟨l₀ - m₀, ?_, sub_mem hl₀ hm₀, ?_⟩
    · have : l₀ - m₀ - f s = -(f s - l₀) - m₀ := by abel
      rw [this]; exact sub_mem (neg_mem hn₀) hm₀'
    · have : l₀ - m₀ = l₁ + m₁ := by
        rw [show l₀ - m₀ = (l₀ - l₁) + l₁ - m₀ by abel, hm]; abel
      rw [this]; exact add_mem hl₁ hm₁
  choose y hyN hy₀ hy₁ using hy
  have hNK : ∀ s, y s - f s ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g) := fun s ↦
    mem_span_field_of_mem_span_laurent hsmul (hyN s)
  refine ⟨y, hyN, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact h₀.sumElim _ (fun i ↦ (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i))) hy₀
      (residueIndependent_mod_of_sub_mem _ hNK hr₀)
  · exact h₁.sumElim _ (fun i ↦ (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i))) hy₁
      (residueIndependent_mod_of_sub_mem _ hNK hr₁)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.balanced_eq_zero_of_mem_span
statement:
theorem balanced_eq_zero_of_mem_span
    (h₀ : ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing L₀ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer g)
    (h₁ : ResidueIndependent LocalRing L₁ localX g) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g))
    (hx₀ : x ∈ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • L₀) (hx₁ : x ∈ L₁) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1 hx
  have hc : (c.sum fun i a ↦ a • g i) = ∑ i ∈ c.support, integralLaurentEval (c i) • g i :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ hsmul _ _
  rw [hc] at hx₀ hx₁ ⊢
  have h := balanced_coeff_zero h₀ h₁ c.support c hx₀ hx₁
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ by rw [h i hi, zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.balanced_eq_of_sub_eq_smul
statement:
theorem balanced_eq_of_sub_eq_smul
    (h₀ : ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing L₀ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer g)
    (h₁ : ResidueIndependent LocalRing L₁ localX g) {x x' y : V} (hx₀ : x ∈ L₀) (hx₁ : x ∈ L₁)
    (hx₀' : x' ∈ L₀) (hx₁' : x' ∈ L₁)
    (hy : y ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g))
    (hxy : x - x' = (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂) • y) : x = x'
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' : (RatFunc.X : 𝕂) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [sq]; nth_rewrite 2 [sub_eq_zero.1 h]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    exact pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X 2 two_pos h'
  have hy' : y = (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂)⁻¹ • (x - x') := by
    rw [hxy, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
  have hy0 : y = 0 := by
    refine balanced_eq_zero_of_mem_span hsmul h₀ h₁ hy ?_ ?_
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_inv_X_sub_eq_uniformizer_mul
      rw [hy', ← hu, algebraMap_smul, mul_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (L₀.smul_mem _ (sub_mem hx₀ hx₀'))
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_inv_X_sub_eq_localX_mul
      rw [hy', ← hu, algebraMap_smul]
      exact L₁.smul_mem _ (sub_mem hx₁ hx₁')
  rw [hy0, smul_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hxy
  exact hxy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.df_df
proof:
:= by
  have ha := BosonModule.qFactorial_ne_zero' hq0 hq a
  have hb := BosonModule.qFactorial_ne_zero' hq0 hq b
  have hab := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (Nat.le_add_right a b)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hab
  have hbin : qBinomial q (a + b) a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul, zero_mul] at hab
    exact BosonModule.qFactorial_ne_zero' hq0 hq (a + b) hab.symm
  rw [BosonModule.df_apply, BosonModule.df_apply, BosonModule.df_apply, map_smul, smul_smul,
    smul_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, ← hab]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_mem_Uw
statement:
lemma df_mem_Uw (i : I) (k : ℕ) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {y : Um D 𝕧} (hy : y ∈ Uw D 𝕧 μ) :
    (bosv i).df k y ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (μ + Finsupp.single i k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩ := hy
  have hpow : ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i) ^ k) (Submodule.Quotient.mk Y : Um D 𝕧) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (θ 𝕂 i ^ k * Y) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, NegativePart.f_mk, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
  rw [BosonModule.df_apply]
  refine (Uw D 𝕧 _).smul_mem _ ?_
  change ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i) ^ k) (Submodule.Quotient.mk Y : Um D 𝕧) ∈ _
  rw [hpow, add_comm]
  refine ⟨_, mul_mem_weightSpace ?_ hY, rfl⟩
  simpa using pow_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace (k := 𝕂) i) k

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_mem_negIntegral
statement:
lemma df_mem_negIntegral (i : I) (k : ℕ) {y : Um D 𝕧} (hy : y ∈ negIntegral D) :
    (bosv i).df k y ∈ negIntegral D
proof:
:=
  negative_df_mem_integral D i k hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_mem_negFilt
statement:
lemma df_mem_negFilt (i : I) {n k : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ ν i)
    {y : Um D 𝕧} (hy : y ∈ negIntegral D) (hyw : y ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (ν - Finsupp.single i k)) :
    (bosv i).df k y ∈ negFilt D i n ν
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, y, hnk, hk, hy, hyw, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sub_single_add_single
statement:
lemma sub_single_add_single {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {i : I} {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ ν i) :
    ν - Finsupp.single i k + Finsupp.single i k = ν
proof:
:=
  tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Finsupp.single_le_iff.2 hk)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFilt_antitone
statement:
lemma negFilt_antitone (i : I) {n n' : ℕ} (h : n ≤ n') (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    negFilt D i n' ν ≤ negFilt D i n ν
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono fun _ ⟨k, y, hk, hkν, hy, hyw, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨k, y, h.trans hk, hkν, hy, hyw, hx⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_negFilt_le
statement:
lemma mem_negFilt_le {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negFilt D i n ν) :
    x ∈ negIntegral D ∧ x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, y, -, hk, hy, hyw, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨df_mem_negIntegral D i k hy, ?_⟩
    have := df_mem_Uw D i k hyw
    rwa [sub_single_add_single hk] at this
  | zero => exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact ⟨add_mem hx.1 hy.1, add_mem hx.2 hy.2⟩
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    refine ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx.1, ?_⟩
    rw [laurent_smul_eq]
    exact (Uw D 𝕧 ν).smul_mem _ hx.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comp_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
lemma comp_eq_zero_of_lt (i : I) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 μ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : μ i < k) : comp (D := D) hvt i k x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hkE : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : Um D 𝕧), comp (D := D) hvt i m y = comp hvt i 0 ((kE hvt i ^ m) y) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      intro y
      rw [← comp_kE, ih, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
  rw [hkE, show k = (k - (μ i + 1)) + (μ i + 1) by omega, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply,
    kE_pow_eq_zero i hx, map_zero, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_sub_df_comp_mem_negFilt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hsum⟩ := exists_sum_comp (D := D) i x
  have hsum' : x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (bosv i).df k (comp hvt i k x) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hN N le_rfl, map_zero, add_zero]
    exact hsum
  have hd : (bosv i).df n x - (bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 x) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (bosv i).df n ((bosv i).df (k + 1) (comp hvt i (k + 1) x)) := by
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    conv_lhs => rw [hsum']
    rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_range_succ', BosonModule.df_zero]
  rw [hd]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases hk : k + 1 ≤ (ν - Finsupp.single i n) i
  · have hkn : n + (k + 1) ≤ ν i := by
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hk
      omega
    have hc : comp hvt i (k + 1) x ∈ negIntegral D :=
      negative_component_mem_integral D i hx (k + 1)
    have hcw : comp hvt i (k + 1) x ∈
        Uw D 𝕧 (ν - Finsupp.single i n - Finsupp.single i (k + 1)) :=
      @component_mem_Uw _ _ _ _ D _ _ _ transcendental_ratFunc_X i _ x hxw (k + 1)
    have hw : ν - Finsupp.single i n - Finsupp.single i (k + 1) =
        ν - Finsupp.single i (n + (k + 1)) := by
      ext l
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst hl; simp; omega
      · simp [Ne.symm hl]
    rw [hw] at hcw
    rw [BosonModule.df_df _ (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne 𝕧) i)
      (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i), qBinomial_inv]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := isLaurent_qBinomial (D.d i) (n + (k + 1)) n
    rw [← ha, ← laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (df_mem_negFilt D i (by omega) hkn hc hcw)
  · rw [comp_eq_zero_of_lt D i hxw (by omega), map_zero, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.proj_df
statement:
lemma proj_df (i : I) (m : ℕ) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (z : Um D 𝕧) :
    NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 γ ((bosv i).df m z) =
      (bosv i).df m (NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (γ - Finsupp.single i (m : ℤ)) z)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ (m : ℕ) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (z : Um D 𝕧), NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 γ
      (((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i) ^ m) z) =
        ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i) ^ m) (NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (γ - Finsupp.single i (m : ℤ)) z) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      intro γ z
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, NegativePart.proj_f, ih, Module.End.mul_apply,
        sub_sub, ← Finsupp.single_add]
      push_cast
      rw [add_comm (1 : ℤ)]
  rw [BosonModule.df_apply, BosonModule.df_apply, map_smul, NegativePart.boson_f, hpow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.proj_df_mem_negFilt
proof:
:= by
  rw [proj_df]
  by_cases hm : m ≤ ν i
  · have e : LusztigF.toZ ν - Finsupp.single i (m : ℤ) = LusztigF.toZ (ν - Finsupp.single i m) := by
      ext l
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst hl; simp; omega
      · simp [Ne.symm hl]
    rw [e]
    exact df_mem_negFilt D i hnm hm (proj_mem_negIntegral D _ hz) (proj_mem_Uw _ _)
  · have h0 : NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν - Finsupp.single i (m : ℤ)) z = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
      have hn : ¬ (0 ≤ LusztigF.toZ ν - Finsupp.single i (m : ℤ)) := by
        intro h
        have := h i
        simp at this
        omega
      rw [NegativePart.proj_mk]
      simp [zWeightProj, hn]
    rw [h0, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_comp_sub_kF_pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (D := D) (NeZero.ne 𝕧) i
  have hq := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i
  have h := BosonModule.fTilde_eTilde_add_component (V := bosv i) hq0 hq x
  have hpow : ∀ (m : ℕ) {u : Um D 𝕧}, u ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A →
      (kF hvt i ^ m) u ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro u hu; simpa using hu
    | succ m ih =>
      intro u hu
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
      exact kF_mem_smul_latInf i (ih hu)
  have key : (kF hvt i ^ n) x =
      (kF hvt i ^ n) (kF hvt i (kE hvt i x)) + (bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 x) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← h]
    rw [map_add, ← BosonModule.fTilde_pow_apply (V := bosv i) hq0 hq (e_comp i 0 x)]
    rfl
  have e : (bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 x) - (kF hvt i ^ n) x =
      -((kF hvt i ^ n) (kF hvt i (kE hvt i x))) := by
    rw [key]; abel
  rw [e]
  exact neg_mem (hpow n (kF_mem_smul_latInf i hx))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_hwFilt

lemma mem_hwFilt (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_hwFilt_le
statement:
lemma mem_hwFilt_le {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hm : m ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν) : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ ∧ m ∈ wsp Λ ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨hxZ, hxw⟩ := mem_negFilt_le D hx
  exact ⟨⟨x, hxZ, rfl⟩, evq_mem_wsp hR hxw Λ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwFilt_le_succ
proof:
:= by
  set P := weightSetProj (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ)
    {Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν}
  
  have hgen : ∀ (m : ℕ), n + 1 ≤ m → ∀ y ∈ hwIntegral Λ,
      P ((nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).dF m y) ∈
        hwFilt Λ i (n + 1) ν := by
    rintro m hm _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rw [← evq_df (hR := hR), ← evq_proj hR]
    exact evq_mem_hwFilt Λ (proj_df_mem_negFilt D i hm ν hz)
  have hspan : ∀ u ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
      {x | ∃ (j : ℕ) (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1), y ∈ hwIntegral Λ ∧
        y ∈ (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).wt
          ((((-(Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i)).toNat - 1) + 1 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
        x = (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).dF
          (((-(Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i)).toNat - 1) + 1 + j) y},
      P u ∈ hwFilt Λ i (n + 1) ν := by
    intro u hu
    induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨j, y, hy, -, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact hgen _ (by omega) y hy
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx =>
      rw [hw_laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, y, hnk, hk, hy, hyw, rfl⟩ := hx
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n k with hlt | hle
    · exact evq_mem_hwFilt Λ (df_mem_negFilt D i hlt hk hy hyw)
    have hkn : k = n := le_antisymm hle hnk
    subst hkn
    set u := evq hvt Λ ((bosv i).df k y)
    have huw : u ∈ wsp Λ ν := by
      have := df_mem_Uw D i k hyw
      rw [sub_single_add_single hk] at this
      exact evq_mem_wsp hR this Λ
    have huZ : u ∈ hwIntegral Λ := ⟨_, df_mem_negIntegral D i k hy, rfl⟩
    have hwt : u ∈ (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).wt
        (-((((-(Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i)).toNat - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
      rw [nodeSl2_wt]
      have e : (-((((-(Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i)).toNat - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i) := by omega
      rw [e]
      exact mem_nodeWt_of_mem huw
    have hu := (mem_hwIntegral_wt_iff hR Λ i _ u).1 ⟨huZ, hwt⟩
    have hPu : P u = u := by
      rw [weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ huw]
      simp
    rw [← hPu]
    exact hspan u hu
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasisHW_subset_add
statement:
lemma canonicalBasisHW_subset_add (Λ Λ' : Dom R) :
    canonicalBasisHW D Λ ⊆ canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_canonicalBasisHW_iff] at hx ⊢
  refine ⟨hx.1, fun i hi ↦ hx.2 i (rightRange_anti D i ?_ hi)⟩
  have := Λ'.2 i
  simp only [Dom.add_val, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPsi_hwv
statement:
theorem tensorPsi_hwv :
    tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1) =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPsi_apply, barPair_tmul, twBar_toTwist]
  change quasiRAct (isPlusLocallyNilpotent_hw Λ')
    (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (hwBar hR Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1)) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      hwBar hR Λ' (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1)) = _
  rw [hwBar_hwv, hwBar_hwv, quasiRAct_apply, finsum_eq_single _ 0 fun ν hν ↦
    actPair_quasiR_eq_zero hR Λ Λ' (fun h ↦ hν (nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 h.1))
      (tmul_mem_tensorWt Λ Λ' (hwv_mem_hwWt Λ) (hwv_mem_hwWt Λ')),
    quasiR_zero, map_one, Module.End.one_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPsi_act_hwv
statement:
lemma tensorPsi_act_hwv (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u
      (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1)) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (barHom R u)
        (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
          IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← barHom_barHom R u]
  rw [← act_tensorPsi, tensorPsi_hwv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_tensorPsi
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_tensorPsi (z : TwL (Λ' + Λ) ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ' + Λ'').1) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (tensorPsi hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') z) =
      tensorPsi hR Λ Λ'' (tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := exists_act_tmul_hwv_eq (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') z

    tensorPsi_act_hwv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorCanonical_sub_tensorBasisIdx_mem
statement:
lemma tensorCanonical_sub_tensorBasisIdx_mem (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ') :
    tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h - tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ' h ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h'
  rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases hh : h = h'
  · subst hh
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, repr_tensorCanonical_self, sub_self]
    exact isNegLaurent_zero
  · rw [ite_eq_right hh, sub_zero]
    exact isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' (Ne.symm hh)

lemma tensorCanonical_sub_mem_tensorLatNeg (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ' h - tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ'

:=
  tensorCanonical_sub_tensorBasisIdx_mem hR Λ Λ' h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_repr_tensorTransition
statement:
lemma isIntInv_repr_tensorTransition
    (h : canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ) × canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ''))
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    IsIntInv ((tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'').repr
      (tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (tensorBasis hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') h)) p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := repr_tensorTransition_sub hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (canonicalBasisHW_subset D _ h.1.2)
    (canonicalBasisHW_subset D _ h.2.2) p
  rw [tensorBasis_apply]
  have hite : IsIntInv (if (p.1 : Um D 𝕧) = h.1 ∧ (p.2 : Um D 𝕧) = h.2 then (1 : 𝕂) else 0) := by
    split_ifs
    exacts [isIntInv_one, isIntInv_zero]
  convert this.isIntInv.add hite using 1
  exact (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_mem_tensorLatNeg_of_mem
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_mem_tensorLatNeg_of_mem
    {z : TwL (Λ' + Λ) ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ' + Λ'').1}
    (hz : z ∈ tensorLatNeg hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'')) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' z ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ''
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  rw [← (tensorBasisIdx hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'')).linearCombination_repr z,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, map_finsuppSum, map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum_apply]
  refine isNegLaurent_finsuppSum _ fun h _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact (hz h).mul_isIntInv (isIntInv_repr_tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' h p)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_sub_mem
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_sub_mem (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
    (b'' : canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (tensorCanonical hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'')
      (tensorIdxAdd Λ Λ' Λ'' b b'')) - tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (b, b'') ∈
        tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ''
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := tensorTransition_mem_tensorLatNeg_of_mem hR Λ Λ' Λ''
    (tensorCanonical_sub_mem_tensorLatNeg hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') (tensorIdxAdd Λ Λ' Λ'' b b''))
  have h₂ := tensorTransition_sub_mem_tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ' Λ'' b b''
  have h₃ := tensorCanonical_sub_mem_tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ'' (b, b'')
  rw [map_sub, tensorBasis_apply, coe_tensorIdxAdd_fst, coe_tensorIdxAdd_snd] at h₁
  convert add_mem (add_mem h₁ h₂) (neg_mem h₃) using 1
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_mem
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_mem (b : canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ))
    (b'' : canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ''))
    (h : (b : Um D 𝕧) ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ∨ (b'' : Um D 𝕧) ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (tensorCanonical hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') (b, b'')) ∈
      tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ''
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := tensorTransition_mem_tensorLatNeg_of_mem hR Λ Λ' Λ''
    (tensorCanonical_sub_mem_tensorLatNeg hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') (b, b''))
  have h₂ := tensorTransition_mem_tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ' Λ'' b b'' h
  rw [map_sub, tensorBasis_apply] at h₁
  convert add_mem h₁ h₂ using 1
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_tensorCanonical
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_tensorCanonical (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
    (b'' : canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (tensorCanonical hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'')
      (tensorIdxAdd Λ Λ' Λ'' b b'')) = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (b, b'')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_tensorPsi_eq hR Λ Λ'' ?_ ((mem_tensorLatNeg_iff hR Λ Λ'').1
    (tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_sub_mem hR Λ Λ' Λ'' b b''))
  have e₁ := tensorPsi_tensorCanonical hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') (tensorIdxAdd Λ Λ' Λ'' b b'')
  have e₂ := tensorPsi_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (b, b'')
  rw [map_sub, ← tensorTransition_tensorPsi, e₁, e₂]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_eq_zero (b : canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ))
    (b'' : canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ''))
    (h : (b : Um D 𝕧) ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ∨ (b'' : Um D 𝕧) ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (tensorCanonical hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') (b, b'')) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_zero_of_tensorPsi_eq hR Λ Λ'' ?_ ((mem_tensorLatNeg_iff hR Λ Λ'').1
    (tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_mem hR Λ Λ' Λ'' b b'' h))
  have e := tensorPsi_tensorCanonical hR (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'') (b, b'')
  rw [← tensorTransition_tensorPsi, e]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_repr_columnCanonicalBasis_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem Modified.exists_repr_columnCanonicalBasis_eq_algebraMap (x : Modified R 𝕧) {a₀ : A}
    (hxx : Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc x x = algebraMap A 𝕂 a₀)
    (s : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ a : A, (columnCanonicalBasis hR).repr x s = algebraMap A 𝕂 a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set e := columnCanonicalBasis hR
  set c := e.repr x
  set S := c.support
  set F := Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc
  have hirr : Irreducible (ϖ : A) := irreducible_localX
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 ϖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]
    exact inv_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  by_cases hsS : s ∉ S
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero]; exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hsS⟩
  rw [not_not] at hsS
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨s, hsS⟩
  
  choose m d hd using fun t ↦ InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul (c t)
  set M := S.sup m
  have hd' : ∀ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ M) * c t =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ (M - m t) * d t) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [_root_.map_mul, ← hd, ← mul_assoc, ← _root_.map_mul, ← pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.le_sup ht)]
  have hd0 : ∀ t ∈ S, ϖ ^ (M - m t) * d t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t ht h
    have := hd' t ht
    rw [h, map_zero, mul_eq_zero, map_pow] at this
    rcases this with h1 | h1
    · exact pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0 h1
    · exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 ht h1
  choose! n u hu using fun t (ht : t ∈ S) ↦
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible (hd0 t ht) hirr
  
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image n hS
  set f : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D → A :=
    fun t ↦ (u t : A) * ϖ ^ (n t - n t₀)
  have hc : ∀ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ M) * c t =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ n t₀) * algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hd' t ht, hu t ht, ← _root_.map_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (hmin t ht)]
  have hM0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ M) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_pow]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0
  
  by_cases hle : M ≤ n t₀
  · refine ⟨ϖ ^ (n t₀ - M) * f s, mul_left_cancel₀ hM0 ?_⟩
    rw [hc s hsS, ← _root_.map_mul, ← _root_.map_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [show ϖ ^ M * (ϖ ^ (n t₀ - M) * f s) = ϖ ^ (M + (n t₀ - M)) * f s by ring,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel' hle]
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, M = n t₀ + (k + 1) := ⟨M - n t₀ - 1, by omega⟩
  set y := ∑ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t) • e t
  have hy : algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ n t₀) • y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ M) • x := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← e.linearCombination_repr x, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    rw [Finsupp.sum, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
    rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, hc t ht]
  have hyy : F y y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * (ϖ ^ k * ϖ ^ (k + 1) * a₀)) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z ↦ F z z) hy
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hxx] at h
    have h0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ n t₀) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [map_pow]
      exact pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero h0 h0)
    rw [hk] at h
    simp only [map_pow, _root_.map_mul] at h ⊢
    linear_combination h
  
  choose a ha using form_columnCanonicalBasis_sub_mem hR
  have hF : ∀ t t', F (e t) (e t') =
      (if t = t' then 1 else 0) + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a t t') := fun t t' ↦ by
    rw [← ha t t']
    ring
  have hexp : F y y = ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S,
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t) * (algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t') * F (e t') (e t)) := by
    simp only [y, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsum : F y y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (∑ t ∈ S, f t ^ 2 +
      ϖ * ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S, f t * f t' * a t' t) := by
    rw [hexp, _root_.map_add, map_sum, _root_.map_mul, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum,
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
    simp only [hF, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', ht, ↓reduceIte, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, _root_.map_mul, map_pow]
    congr 1
    · ring
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t' _ ↦ by ring
  
  rw [hyy] at hsum
  have hA := InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap hsum
  have hmem : ∑ t ∈ S, f t ^ 2 ∈ Ideal.span {(ϖ : A)} := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact ⟨ϖ ^ k * ϖ ^ (k + 1) * a₀ - ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S, f t * f t' * a t' t,
      by linear_combination -hA⟩
  have hsum' := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hmem
  simp only [map_sum, map_pow] at hsum'
  have h₀ := eq_zero_of_sum_sq_eq_zero S _ hsum' t₀ ht₀
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h₀
  simp only [f, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one] at h₀
  exact hirr.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_unit h₀ (u t₀).isUnit)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mem_signedColumnCanonicalBasis_iff
statement:
theorem Modified.mem_signedColumnCanonicalBasis_iff (β : Modified R 𝕧) :
    β ∈ signedCanonicalBasis R ↔
      ∃ t, β = columnCanonicalBasis hR t ∨ β = -columnCanonicalBasis hR t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hβ, hbar, a₀, hform⟩
    
    have hint : ∀ t, ∃ n : ℤ, (columnCanonicalBasis hR).repr β t = n := by
      intro t
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_repr_columnCanonicalBasis_eq_algebraMap hR β hform t
      have hp : (columnCanonicalBasis hR).repr β t = _ :=
        repr_columnCanonicalBasis_coe hR ⟨β, hβ⟩ t
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (isIntInv_of_algebraMap_eq _ a (ha.symm.trans hp)).exists_int_sub
      rw [← hp] at hn
      refine ⟨n, sub_eq_zero.1 (hn.eq_zero_of_bar_eq ?_)⟩
      rw [map_sub, map_intCast, ← repr_bar_columnCanonicalBasis, hbar]
    choose n hn using hint
    set e := columnCanonicalBasis hR
    set S := (e.repr β).support
    set F := Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc
    have hβ' : β = ∑ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (n t) • e t := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← e.linearCombination_repr β]
      rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
      rw [hn t, map_intCast]
    
    choose a ha using form_columnCanonicalBasis_sub_mem hR
    have hF : ∀ t t', F (e t) (e t') =
        (if t = t' then 1 else 0) + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a t t') := fun t t' ↦ by
      rw [← ha t t']
      ring
    have hexp : F β β = ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S,
        algebraMap A 𝕂 (n t) * (algebraMap A 𝕂 (n t') * F (e t') (e t)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hβ']
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Finset.mul_sum]
    have hsum : F β β = algebraMap A 𝕂 (∑ t ∈ S, (n t : A) ^ 2 +
        ϖ * ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S, (n t : A) * n t' * a t' t) := by
      rw [hexp, _root_.map_add, map_sum, _root_.map_mul, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum,
        ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
      simp only [hF, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq', ht, ↓reduceIte, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, _root_.map_mul, map_pow]
      congr 1
      · ring
      · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t' _ ↦ by ring
    rw [hform] at hsum
    have hA := InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap hsum
    
    have hZ : ∑ t ∈ S, n t ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have hL : Modified.IsLaurent (((∑ t ∈ S, n t ^ 2 - 1 : ℤ)) : 𝕂) :=
        ⟨(∑ t ∈ S, n t ^ 2 - 1 : ℤ), map_intCast _ _⟩
      have hneg := isNegLaurent_of_isLaurent hL
        (a₀ - ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S, (n t : A) * n t' * a t' t) (by
          rw [← map_intCast (algebraMap A 𝕂)]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          linear_combination -hA)
      have := hneg.eq_zero_of_intCast
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hne⟩ : ∃ t₀ ∈ S, n t₀ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have h : ∀ t ∈ S, n t = 0 := fun t ht ↦ by
        by_contra h''
        exact hne ⟨t, ht, h''⟩
      have h0 : ∑ t ∈ S, n t ^ 2 = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t ht ↦ by rw [h t ht]; ring
      rw [h0] at hZ
      exact zero_ne_one hZ
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase S _ ht₀] at hZ
    have hrest : 0 ≤ ∑ t ∈ S.erase t₀, n t ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun t _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
    have hpos : 0 < n t₀ ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hne))
    have h1 : n t₀ ^ 2 = 1 := by linarith
    have h0 : ∑ t ∈ S.erase t₀, n t ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hrest0 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun t _ ↦ sq_nonneg (n t)).1 h0
    have hrepr : e.repr β = Finsupp.single t₀ (n t₀ : 𝕂) := by
      ext t
      rw [hn t, Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [h]
      · by_cases htS : t ∈ S
        · rw [(pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).1 (hrest0 t (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨Ne.symm h, htS⟩)),
            Int.cast_zero]
        · rw [← hn t]
          exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 htS
    have hβe : β = (n t₀ : 𝕂) • e t₀ := by
      rw [← Module.Basis.repr_symm_single, ← hrepr, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hpm : (n t₀ - 1) * (n t₀ + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination h1
    refine ⟨t₀, ?_⟩
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hpm with h | h
    · left
      rw [hβe, show n t₀ = 1 by linarith, Int.cast_one, one_smul]
    · right
      rw [hβe, show n t₀ = -1 by linarith, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, neg_smul, one_smul]
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl | rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_columnCanonicalBasis_sub_mem hR t t
      refine ⟨columnCanonicalBasis_mem_aForm hR t, bar_columnCanonicalBasis hR t, a, ?_⟩
      rw [_root_.map_add, _root_.map_one, ← ha]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_columnCanonicalBasis_sub_mem hR t t
      refine ⟨neg_mem (columnCanonicalBasis_mem_aForm hR t), ?_, a, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_neg, bar_columnCanonicalBasis]
      · simp only [map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_neg]
        rw [_root_.map_add, _root_.map_one, ← ha]
        simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnCanonicalBasis_eq_modifiedCanonicalBasis
statement:
theorem Modified.columnCanonicalBasis_eq_modifiedCanonicalBasis :
    columnCanonicalBasis hR = modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hold : ∀ t, modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY t - triangularBasisOne R t ∈
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (triangularBasisOne R ''
        {s | canonicalPairDegree D s < canonicalPairDegree D t}) := by
    rintro ⟨ζ, b, b''⟩
    simpa only [modifiedCanonicalBasis_apply] using
      modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt hR hY (ζ, b, b'')
  have hcol : ∀ t, columnCanonicalBasis hR t - triangularBasisOne R t ∈
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (triangularBasisOne R ''
        {s | canonicalPairDegree D s < canonicalPairDegree D t}) := by
    rintro ⟨ζ, b, b''⟩
    simpa only [columnCanonicalBasis_apply] using columnCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt hR (ζ, b, b'')
  have ho : ∀ {i j}, canonicalPairDegree D j ≤ canonicalPairDegree D i →
      (triangularBasisOne R).repr (modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY j) i =
        Finsupp.single j 1 i :=
    fun hij ↦ (triangularBasisOne R).repr_apply_of_unitriangular hold hij
  have hc : ∀ {i j}, canonicalPairDegree D j ≤ canonicalPairDegree D i →
      (triangularBasisOne R).repr (columnCanonicalBasis hR j) i =
        Finsupp.single j 1 i :=
    fun hij ↦ (triangularBasisOne R).repr_apply_of_unitriangular hcol hij
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro t
  have hmem : modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY t ∈ signedCanonicalBasis R := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_modifiedCanonicalBasis_sub_mem hR hY t t
    refine ⟨modifiedCanonicalBasis_mem_aForm hR hY t,
      bar_modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY t, a, ?_⟩
    rw [_root_.map_add, _root_.map_one, ← ha]
    simp
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (mem_signedColumnCanonicalBasis_iff hR _).1 hmem
  have hts : t = s := by
    by_contra hne
    rcases le_total (canonicalPairDegree D t) (canonicalPairDegree D s) with hle | hle
    · rcases hs with hs | hs
      · have h := congrArg (fun x ↦ (triangularBasisOne R).repr x s) hs
        rw [ho hle, hc le_rfl] at h
        simp [hne] at h
      · have h := congrArg (fun x ↦ (triangularBasisOne R).repr x s) hs
        rw [map_neg, Finsupp.neg_apply, ho hle, hc le_rfl] at h
        simp [hne] at h
    · rcases hs with hs | hs
      · have h := congrArg (fun x ↦ (triangularBasisOne R).repr x t) hs
        rw [ho le_rfl, hc hle] at h
        simp [Ne.symm hne] at h
      · have h := congrArg (fun x ↦ (triangularBasisOne R).repr x t) hs
        rw [map_neg, Finsupp.neg_apply, ho le_rfl, hc hle] at h
        simp [Ne.symm hne] at h
  subst s
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · exact hs.symm
  · have h := congrArg (fun x ↦ (triangularBasisOne R).repr x t) hs
    rw [map_neg, Finsupp.neg_apply, ho le_rfl, hc le_rfl] at h
    norm_num at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.columnCanonical_eq_modifiedCanonical
proof:
:= by

    (Modified.columnCanonicalBasis_eq_modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusQ_mem_aPlus
statement:
lemma plusQ_mem_aPlus {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D) :
    Modified.plusQ R hvn_ratFunc x ∈ Modified.aPlus R
proof:
:= by
  have h : quotientPlusIntegral R (negativeQuotientEquiv D x) ∈
      Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Modified.Ed R i)) := by
    rw [← map_quotientIntegralForm_plus]
    exact ⟨_, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [plusQ_eq_quotientPlus]
  change quotientPlusIntegral R (negativeQuotientEquiv D x) ∈ _
  generalize quotientPlusIntegral R (negativeQuotientEquiv D x) = z at h ⊢
  induction h using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
    simpa [Modified.ePow, Modified.Ed] using Modified.ePow_mem_aPlus (R := R) [(i, n)]
  | algebraMap a =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Modified.laurent_smul_U]
    simpa using Modified.smul_mem_aPlus (R := R) ⟨a, rfl⟩ (Modified.ePow_mem_aPlus (R := R) [])
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add_mem hy hz
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz => exact Modified.mul_mem_aPlus hy hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ePow_mem_span_plusQ
statement:
lemma ePow_mem_span_plusQ (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    Modified.ePow R w ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜
      (Set.range fun b : canonicalBasis D ↦ Modified.plusQ R hvn_ratFunc (b : Um D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  have hw : Modified.ePow R w ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝒜 (⋃ i, Set.range (Modified.Ed R i)) := by
    rw [Modified.ePow]
    refine Subalgebra.list_prod_mem _ fun y hy ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩)
  rw [← map_quotientIntegralForm_plus] at hw
  obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := hw
  have hy' : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y ∈ negIntegral D := by
    change negativeQuotientEquiv D ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y) ∈ quotientIntegralForm D
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hy
  rw [← span_canonicalBasis_laurent] at hy'
  have key : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (canonicalBasis D), Modified.plusQ R hvn_ratFunc x ∈
      Submodule.span 𝒜
        (Set.range fun b : canonicalBasis D ↦ Modified.plusQ R hvn_ratFunc (b : Um D 𝕧)) := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x x' _ _ hx hx' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hx'
    | smul a x _ hx =>
      rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← Modified.laurent_smul_U]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx
  have := key _ hy'
  rw [plusQ_eq_quotientPlus, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
  rw [← e]
  exact this
