name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.toQuotient_qDivPow
statement:
lemma toQuotient_qDivPow (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    toQuotient D 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i)) = quotientIntegralGenerator D i n
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ev_qDivPow_mul
statement:
lemma ev_qDivPow_mul (j : I) (n : ℕ) (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (θ 𝕂 j) * y) =
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j) • ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 (θ 𝕂 j ^ n * y) = F R 𝕧 j ^ n • ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, ev_ι_mul, ih, pow_succ', mul_smul]
  rw [qDivPow, qDivPow, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hpow, smul_assoc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral
statement:
theorem dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral (i : I) (n : ℕ) {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hm : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ) : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) • m ∈ hwIntegral Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i) * y), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_negIntegral] at hx ⊢
    change toQuotient D 𝕧 (_ * y) ∈ _
    rw [map_mul, toQuotient_qDivPow]
    exact mul_mem (quotientIntegralGenerator_mem D i n) hx
  · rw [evq_mk, evq_mk, ev_qDivPow_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.symm_toQuotient
statement:
lemma symm_toQuotient (z : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (toQuotient D 𝕧 z) = NegativePart.mk (D := D) (v := 𝕧) z
proof:
:=
  (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm_apply_eq.2 rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_E_smul_hwv
statement:
lemma qDivPow_E_smul_hwv (i : I) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) N (E R 𝕧 i) • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hN
  rw [qDivPow, smul_assoc, pow_succ, mul_smul, IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, smul_zero,
    smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwv_mem_hwIntegral
statement: lemma hwv_mem_hwIntegral : IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 ∈ hwIntegral Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨NegativePart.mk 1, ?_, by rw [evq_mk, ev_one]⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_negIntegral]
  change toQuotient D 𝕧 1 ∈ _
  rw [map_one]
  exact one_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dE_smul_evq_mem_of_mem_closure
statement:
lemma dE_smul_evq_mem_of_mem_closure {y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hy : y ∈ Submonoid.closure {x | ∃ j n, x = quotientIntegralGenerator D j n}) :
    ∀ (i : I) (N : ℕ), qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) N (E R 𝕧 i) •
      evq hvt Λ ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y) ∈ hwIntegral Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submonoid.closure_induction_left with
  | one =>
    intro i N
    rw [← map_one (toQuotient D 𝕧), symm_toQuotient, evq_mk, ev_one]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hN
    · rw [qDivPow_zero', one_smul]; exact hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ
    · rw [qDivPow_E_smul_hwv Λ i hN]; exact zero_mem _
  | mul_left x hx y hy ih =>
    intro i N
    obtain ⟨j, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨ν, z, hz, rfl, -⟩ := exists_homogeneous_of_mem_closure D hy
    rw [symm_toQuotient, evq_mk] at ih
    rw [← toQuotient_qDivPow, ← map_mul, symm_toQuotient, evq_mk, ev_qDivPow_mul]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      have hm := ev_mem_weightSpace hvn_ratFunc hR Λ.1 hz
      rw [qDivPow_E_smul_qDivPow_F_smul hvn_ratFunc hm]
      refine sum_mem fun t _ ↦ ?_
      rw [efTerm]
      split_ifs
      · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Modified.isLaurent_qBinomZ (D.d i) (D.d_pos i)
          ((Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i) + N - n) t
        rw [← ha, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ i _ (ih i (N - t)))
      · exact zero_mem _
    · have hc : Commute (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) N (E R 𝕧 i)) (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d j) n (F R 𝕧 j)) :=
        ((Commute.pow_pow (E_mul_F_of_ne (R := R) (v := 𝕧) hij) N n).smul_left _).smul_right _
      rw [← mul_smul, hc.eq, mul_smul]
      exact dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ j n (ih i N)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dE_smul_mem_hwIntegral
statement:
theorem dE_smul_mem_hwIntegral (i : I) (N : ℕ) {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hm : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ) : qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) N (E R 𝕧 i) • m ∈ hwIntegral Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  have h : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (quotientIntegralForm D) :=
    (mem_negIntegral D x).1 hx
  rw [quotientIntegralForm, Algebra.adjoin_eq_span] at h
  rw [← (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm_apply_apply x]
  generalize negativeQuotientEquiv D x = y at h
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => exact dE_smul_evq_mem_of_mem_closure hR Λ hy i N
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add, map_add, smul_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    have : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (c • y) = c • (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y := by
      change (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralLaurentEval c • y) =
        integralLaurentEval c • (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y
      exact map_smul _ _ _
    rw [this, laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, smul_algebra_smul_comm, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_qBinomial
statement: lemma isLaurent_qBinomial (d n j : ℕ) : Modified.IsLaurent (qBinomial (𝕧 ^ d) n j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero =>
    cases j with
    | zero => exact Modified.isLaurent_one
    | succ j => exact Modified.isLaurent_zero
  | succ n ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => exact Modified.isLaurent_one
    | succ j =>
      rw [qBinomial_succ_succ]
      exact ((Modified.isLaurent_inv_pow_pow d _).mul (ih _)).add
        ((Modified.isLaurent_pow_pow d _).mul (ih _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_dE_eq
statement:
lemma nodeSl2_dE_eq (i : I) (a : ℕ) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).dE a m =
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) a (E R 𝕧 i) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntegrableSl2.dE_apply, nodeSl2_E, ← map_pow, qDivPow, smul_assoc]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.nodeSl2_dF_eq
statement:
lemma nodeSl2_dF_eq (i : I) (a : ℕ) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).dF a m =
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) a (F R 𝕧 i) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_apply, nodeSl2_F, ← map_pow, qDivPow, smul_assoc]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_hwIntegral_wt_iff
statement:
theorem mem_hwIntegral_wt_iff (i : I) (h : ℕ) (u : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    u ∈ hwIntegral Λ ∧
        u ∈ (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).wt
          (-((h + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ↔
      u ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
        {x | ∃ (j : ℕ) (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1), y ∈ hwIntegral Λ ∧
          y ∈ (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).wt
            ((h + 1 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
          x = (nodeSl2 R 𝕧 _ (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ) i).dF
            (h + 1 + j) y}
proof:
:=
  IntegrableSl2.mem_integral_wt_iff (pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero)
    (fun n hn ↦ by rw [← pow_mul]; exact hvn_ratFunc _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) hn))
    integralLaurentEval (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (hwIntegral Λ)
    (fun a x hx ↦ by rw [nodeSl2_dE_eq hR]; exact dE_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ i a hx)
    (fun a x hx ↦ by rw [nodeSl2_dF_eq hR]; exact dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ i a hx)
    (fun n j ↦ isLaurent_qBinomial (D.d i) n j) h u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_one
statement:
lemma negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_one :
    (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm 1 = fWi (D := D) hvt []
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (toQuotient D 𝕧)]
  exact (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm_apply_eq.2 rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negIntegral_le_span_df
statement:
theorem negIntegral_le_span_df :
    negIntegral D ≤
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (insert (fWi (D := D) hvt []) (negDfSet D))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (quotientIntegralForm D) :=
    (mem_negIntegral D x).1 hx
  rw [quotientIntegralForm, Algebra.adjoin_eq_span] at h
  rw [← (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm_apply_apply x]
  generalize negativeQuotientEquiv D x = y at h
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    induction hy using Submonoid.closure_induction_left with
    | one =>
      rw [negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_one]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    | mul_left g hg y hy ih =>
      obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hg
      have hyI : y ∈ quotientIntegralForm D :=
        (Submonoid.closure_le.2 fun _ hz ↦ Algebra.subset_adjoin hz) hy
      have e : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n * y) =
          (bosv i).df n ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y) := by
        rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, negativeQuotientEquiv_df, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rw [e]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · rw [BosonModule.df_zero]; exact ih
      · refine Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨i, n, _, hn, ?_, rfl⟩)
        rw [mem_negIntegral, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact hyI
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    have : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (c • y) = c • (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y := by
      change (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralLaurentEval c • y) =
        integralLaurentEval c • (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y
      exact map_smul _ _ _
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_proj_one_sup_negFilt
statement:
theorem mem_span_proj_one_sup_negFilt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D)
    (hxw : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
        {NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) (fWi (D := D) hvt [])} ⊔
      ⨆ i, negFilt D i 1 ν
proof:
:= by
  have h := negIntegral_le_span_df D hx
  have e : NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) x = x := by
    rw [proj_of_mem_Uw hxw]; exact ite_eq_left_iff.2 fun h ↦ absurd rfl h
  rw [← e]
  clear e hx hxw
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    rcases hy with rfl | ⟨i, n, z, hn, hz, rfl⟩
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span rfl)
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i
        (proj_df_mem_negFilt D i hn ν hz))
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_iSup_negFilt
statement:
theorem mem_iSup_negFilt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D)
    (hxw : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) : x ∈ ⨆ i, negFilt D i 1 ν
proof:
:= by
  have h := mem_span_proj_one_sup_negFilt D hx hxw
  have h0 : NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) (fWi (D := D) hvt []) = 0 := by
    have hz : LusztigF.toZ (wordWeight ([] : List I)) ≠ LusztigF.toZ ν := fun e ↦
      hν ((LusztigF.toZ_injective e).symm.trans (by simp [wordWeight]))
    rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (fWi_mem_Uw [])]; exact ite_eq_right_iff.2 fun h ↦ absurd h hz
  rwa [h0, Set.singleton_zero, Submodule.span_zero, bot_sup_eq] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFilt_zero
statement: lemma negFilt_zero (i : I) : negFilt D i 1 0 = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_eq_bot.2 fun _ ⟨k, _, hk, hk0, _⟩ ↦ by simp at hk0; omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_one_of_mem_Uw_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := mem_span_proj_one_sup_negFilt D hx hxw
  have h1 : NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ 0) (fWi (D := D) hvt []) = fWi hvt [] := by
    rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (fWi_mem_Uw [])]; exact ite_eq_left_iff.2 fun h ↦ absurd (by simp) h
  simpa only [h1, negFilt_zero, iSup_bot, sup_bot_eq] using h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comp_zero_df
statement:
lemma comp_zero_df (i : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (y : Um D 𝕧) :
    comp hvt i 0 ((bosv i).df n y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
  rw [df_succ, map_smul, comp_zero_f, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comp_zero_of_mem_negFilt
statement:
lemma comp_zero_of_mem_negFilt {i : I} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν) :
    comp hvt i 0 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, y, hk, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact comp_zero_df D i hk y
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_negFilt_iff_comp_zero
statement:
theorem mem_negFilt_iff_comp_zero {i : I} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν ↔ x ∈ negIntegral D ∧ x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν ∧ comp hvt i 0 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ⟨(mem_negFilt_le D hx).1, (mem_negFilt_le D hx).2,
    comp_zero_of_mem_negFilt D hx⟩, fun ⟨hx, hxw, h0⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := df_sub_df_comp_mem_negFilt D i (n := 0) (Nat.zero_le _) hx
    (by rwa [Finsupp.single_zero, tsub_zero])
  rwa [BosonModule.df_zero, BosonModule.df_zero, h0, sub_zero] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fWi_cons_mem_negFilt
statement:
lemma fWi_cons_mem_negFilt (i : I) (w : List I) :
    fWi (D := D) hvt (i :: w) ∈ negFilt D i 1 (wordWeight (i :: w))
proof:
:=
  (mem_negFilt_iff_comp_zero D).2 ⟨fWi_mem_negIntegral D _, fWi_mem_Uw _, comp_zero_kF i _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_rev
statement: lemma bar_rev (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) : LusztigF.bar (rev 𝕂 I x) = rev 𝕂 I (LusztigF.bar x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [rev_algebraMap, LusztigF.bar_algebraMap, rev_algebraMap]
  | grade1 i =>
    change LusztigF.bar (rev 𝕂 I (θ 𝕂 i)) = rev 𝕂 I (LusztigF.bar (θ 𝕂 i))
    rw [rev_θ, LusztigF.bar_θ, rev_θ]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [rev_mul, map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, rev_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_starU
statement: lemma negBar_starU (x : Um D 𝕧) : negBar D (starU D 𝕧 x) = starU D 𝕧 (negBar D x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [starU_mk, negBar_mk, negBar_mk, starU_mk, bar_rev]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rev_θ_pow
statement: lemma rev_θ_pow (i : I) (n : ℕ) : rev 𝕂 I (θ 𝕂 i ^ n) = θ 𝕂 i ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, rev_mul, ih, rev_θ, ← pow_succ', pow_succ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientStar_toQuotient
statement:
lemma quotientStar_toQuotient (a : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    quotientStar D (toQuotient D 𝕧 a) = toQuotient D 𝕧 (rev 𝕂 I a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientStar, negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient, starU_mk]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientStar_mul
statement:
lemma quotientStar_mul (q q' : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientStar D (q * q') = quotientStar D q' * quotientStar D q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 q
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 q'
  rw [← map_mul, quotientStar_toQuotient, quotientStar_toQuotient, quotientStar_toQuotient,
    rev_mul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quotientStar_mem
statement:
lemma quotientStar_mem {q : Quotient D 𝕧} (hq : q ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) :
    quotientStar D q ∈ quotientIntegralForm D
proof:
:= by
  induction hq using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    have e : quotientIntegralGenerator D i n =
        toQuotient D 𝕧 (QuantumGroup.qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i)) := by
      rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, QuantumGroup.qDivPow, QuantumGroup.qDivPow, map_smul,
        map_pow]
    have hr : rev 𝕂 I (QuantumGroup.qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i)) =
        QuantumGroup.qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (θ 𝕂 i) := by
      rw [QuantumGroup.qDivPow, map_smul, rev_θ_pow]
    rw [e, quotientStar_toQuotient, hr, ← e]
    exact quotientIntegralGenerator_mem D i n
  | algebraMap c =>
    have e : (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Quotient D 𝕧) c) =
        toQuotient D 𝕧 (algebraMap 𝕂 (LusztigF 𝕂 I) (integralLaurentEval c)) := by
      rw [AlgHom.commutes]; rfl
    rw [e, quotientStar_toQuotient, rev_algebraMap, ← e]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    rw [quotientStar, map_add, map_add, map_add]
    exact add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [quotientStar_mul]; exact mul_mem hy hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_mem_negIntegral
statement:
lemma starU_mem_negIntegral {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D) :
    starU D 𝕧 x ∈ negIntegral D
proof:
:= by
  have := quotientStar_mem (D := D) hx
  rwa [quotientStar, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_mem_latInfBar
statement: lemma starU_mem_latInfBar {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ latInfBar D) : starU D 𝕧 x ∈ latInfBar D
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  rw [mem_latInfBar_iff, negBar_starU]
  exact starU_mem_latInf (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_mem_smul_latInf'
statement:
lemma starU_mem_smul_latInf' {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    starU D 𝕧 x ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact starU_mem_smul_latInf (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comp_zero_f
statement: lemma comp_zero_f (i : I) (z : Um D 𝕧) : comp hvt i 0 (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (D := D) (NeZero.ne 𝕧) i
  have hq := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (D := D) (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i
  have key : comp (D := D) hvt i 0 ∘ₗ NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i = 0 :=
    BosonModule.ext_df (V := bosv i) hq0 hq fun n x hx ↦ by
      have hne := BosonModule.qInt_ne_zero' hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos n)
      have e : NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ((bosv i).df n x) =
          QuantumGroup.qInt (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ (n + 1) • (bosv i).df (n + 1) x := by
        rw [df_succ, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, e, map_smul,
        BosonModule.component_df hq0 hq hx]
      simp
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_negFilt_of_eq_f
statement:
lemma mem_negFilt_of_eq_f {i : I} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D)
    (hxw : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) {z : Um D 𝕧} (hz : x = NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i z) :
    x ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν
proof:
:= by
  have h := df_sub_df_comp_mem_negFilt D i (n := 0) (Nat.zero_le _) hx
    (by rwa [Finsupp.single_zero, tsub_zero])
  rwa [BosonModule.df_zero, BosonModule.df_zero, hz, comp_zero_f, sub_zero, ← hz] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_starU_eq_f_of_evq_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩ := hx
  set n : I → ℕ := fun i ↦ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat
  have hker : Y ∈ evKernel D n := by
    rw [← ker_ev_eq hR Λ, LinearMap.mem_ker]; exact h0
  set P : Submodule 𝕂 (LusztigF 𝕂 I) :=
    serreSubmodule D 𝕧 ⊔ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (θ 𝕂 k))
  have hle : evKernel D n ≤ P.comap (LusztigF.weightProj ν) := by
    refine sup_le (fun s hs ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
      refine Submodule.mem_sup_left (mem_serreSubmodule.2 ?_)
      exact weightProj_mem_serreIdeal (mem_serreSubmodule.1 hs) ν
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap,
      weightProj_of_mem (wordBasis_mem_weightSpace (rfl : wordWeight (powWord n g) = _))]
    split_ifs with hg
    · have hgi : n g.2 + 1 ≤ ν g.2 := by
        have := congrArg (fun μ : I →₀ ℕ ↦ μ g.2) hg
        simp only [powWord, wordWeight_append, GrandLoop.wordWeight_replicate,
          Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same,
          smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
        omega
      have hg2 : g.2 = k := by
        by_contra hne
        have := hΛ g.2 hne
        simp only [n] at hgi
        omega
      have hnk : n g.2 = 0 := by simp [n, hg2, hk]
      refine Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I g.1, ?_⟩
      rw [LinearMap.mulRight_apply, powWord, hnk, hg2, ← monomial_eq_wordBasis,
        ← monomial_eq_wordBasis]
      simp [monomial]
    · exact zero_mem _
  have hYP : Y ∈ P := by
    have := hle hker
    simpa only [Submodule.mem_comap, weightProj_of_mem hY, ↓reduceIte] using this
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ⟨Z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hYP
  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk (rev 𝕂 I Z), ?_⟩
  have e : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (s + Z * θ 𝕂 k) : Um D 𝕧) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (Z * θ 𝕂 k) := by
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 hs, zero_add]
  change starU D 𝕧 (Submodule.Quotient.mk (s + LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (θ 𝕂 k) Z)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.mulRight_apply, e, starU_mk, rev_mul, rev_θ, NegativePart.f_mk]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fK_hwv_eq_zero
statement:
lemma fK_hwv_eq_zero {Λ : Dom R} {k : I} (hk : Λ.1 (R.coroot k) = 0) :
    fK hvt hR Λ k (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  set V := nodeSl2 R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) k
  have hE : V.E (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 0 := IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv k
  have hp : IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 ∈ V.wt (Λ.1 (R.coroot k)) :=
    mem_nodeWt_of_mem IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace
  have h := IntegrableSl2.fTilde_dF (V := V) (pow_d_ne_zero k) (pow_d_ne_one hv' k) hE hp 0
  rw [IntegrableSl2.dF_zero] at h
  change V.fTilde _ _ _ = 0
  rw [h, IntegrableSl2.dF_apply, pow_one]
  change _ • (F R 𝕧 k • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 0
  rw [F_smul_hwv_eq_zero hR hv' hk, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fW_append_singleton_eq_zero
statement:
lemma fW_append_singleton_eq_zero {Λ : Dom R} {k : I} (hk : Λ.1 (R.coroot k) = 0)
    (w : List I) : fW hvt hR Λ (w ++ [k]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact fK_hwv_eq_zero hR hk
  | cons i w ih => rw [List.cons_append, fW_cons, ih, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_starU_eq_f_of_mem_negFilt
statement:
lemma exists_starU_eq_f_of_mem_negFilt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) {i k : I}
    {w : List I} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν) (hx₁ : x ∈ latInfBar D)
    (hxw : x - fWi (D := D) hvt (w ++ [k]) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    ∃ z, starU D 𝕧 x = NegativePart.f D 𝕧 k z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hk, hΛ⟩ := GrandLoop.exists_dom_wall hfund k ν.degree
  have hdeg : ∀ j, j ≠ k → (ν j : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot j) := fun j hj ↦
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finsupp.le_degree j ν) (hΛ j hj)
  refine exists_starU_eq_f_of_evq_eq_zero hR hk hdeg (mem_negFilt_le D hx).2 ?_
  refine hwFilt_eq_zero_of_mem hR hfund hIH Λ i le_rfl (evq_mem_hwFilt Λ hx) ?_ ?_
  · have e : evq hvt Λ x = evq hvt Λ (x - fWi hvt (w ++ [k])) +
        (evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt (w ++ [k])) - fW hvt hR Λ (w ++ [k])) := by
      rw [fW_append_singleton_eq_zero hR hk, map_sub, sub_zero, sub_add_cancel]
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (evq_mem_smul_lat' (hR := hR) hfund hxw Λ)
      (evq_fWord_sub_fW_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
        InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
        InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund (w ++ [k]) Λ)
  · rw [mem_latBar_iff, hwBar_evq]
    exact evq_mem_lat' (hR := hR) hfund hx₁ Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_of_mem_negFilt
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_negFilt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) {i j : I} {w : List I}
    (hw : w ≠ []) {x y : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν) (hx₁ : x ∈ latInfBar D)
    (hxw : x - fWi (D := D) hvt w ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) (hy : y ∈ negFilt D j 1 ν)
    (hy₁ : y ∈ latInfBar D) (hyw : y - fWi (D := D) hvt w ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  set k := w.getLast hw
  have ew : w = w.dropLast ++ [k] := (List.dropLast_append_getLast hw).symm
  rw [ew] at hxw hyw
  obtain ⟨zx, hzx⟩ := exists_starU_eq_f_of_mem_negFilt hR hfund hIH hx hx₁ hxw
  obtain ⟨zy, hzy⟩ := exists_starU_eq_f_of_mem_negFilt hR hfund hIH hy hy₁ hyw
  set Q := x - y
  have hQs : starU D 𝕧 Q = NegativePart.f D 𝕧 k (zx - zy) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hzx, hzy]
  have hQZ : Q ∈ negIntegral D := sub_mem (mem_negFilt_le D hx).1 (mem_negFilt_le D hy).1
  have hQw : Q ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν := sub_mem (mem_negFilt_le D hx).2 (mem_negFilt_le D hy).2
  have hQϖ : Q ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    have e : Q = (x - fWi hvt (w.dropLast ++ [k])) - (y - fWi hvt (w.dropLast ++ [k])) := by
      simp only [Q]; abel
    rw [e]; exact sub_mem hxw hyw
  have hQ₁ : Q ∈ latInfBar D := sub_mem hx₁ hy₁
  have hF : starU D 𝕧 Q ∈ negFilt D k 1 ν :=
    mem_negFilt_of_eq_f (starU_mem_negIntegral hQZ) (starU_mem_Uw hQw) hQs
  have h0 := negFilt_eq_zero_of_mem hR hfund hIH k le_rfl hF (starU_mem_smul_latInf' hQϖ)
    (starU_mem_latInfBar hQ₁)
  have : Q = 0 := by rw [← starU_starU (D := D) (v := 𝕧) Q, h0, map_zero]
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_localRing_iff
statement:
lemma mem_localRing_iff (g : 𝕂) : g ∈ Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing ↔
    ∃ F : PowerSeries ℚ, HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries ℤ ℚ F = algebraMap 𝕂 (LaurentSeries ℚ) g
proof:
:= by
  change g ∈ IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime 𝕂
    (Polynomial.idealX ℚ) ↔ _
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring,
    Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff, RatFunc.valuation_eq_LaurentSeries_valuation,
    ← LaurentSeries.valuation_def, LaurentSeries.val_le_one_iff_eq_coe]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_algebraMap_eq_iff
statement:
lemma exists_algebraMap_eq_iff (f : 𝕂) : (∃ a : A, algebraMap A 𝕂 a = f) ↔
    ∃ F : PowerSeries ℚ, HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries ℤ ℚ F = expandInf f
proof:
:= by
  rw [expandInf_apply, ← mem_localRing_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar (algebraMap Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing 𝕂 a)) ∈ _
    rw [RatFunc.bar_bar]
    exact a.2
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(⟨RatFunc.bar f, h⟩ : Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing), ?_⟩
    change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar f) = f
    exact RatFunc.bar_bar f

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_algebraMap_eq_of_mem_intSeriesInf
statement:
lemma exists_algebraMap_eq_of_mem_intSeriesInf {f : 𝕂} (hf : f ∈ intSeriesInf) :
    ∃ a : A, algebraMap A 𝕂 a = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := mem_intSeriesInf.1 hf
  exact (exists_algebraMap_eq_iff f).2 ⟨_, hG⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_intSeriesInf_of_mem_intLaurentInf
statement:
lemma mem_intSeriesInf_of_mem_intLaurentInf {f : 𝕂} (hA : ∃ a : A, algebraMap A 𝕂 a = f)
    (hf : f ∈ intLaurentInf) : f ∈ intSeriesInf
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := (exists_algebraMap_eq_iff f).1 hA
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := mem_intSeriesInf.1 hn
  have hX : expandInf 𝕧⁻¹ = HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries ℤ ℚ PowerSeries.X := by
    rw [expandInf_inv_X]; simp [intSeriesHom]
  have hmap : PowerSeries.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) G = PowerSeries.X ^ n * F := by
    apply HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries_injective (Γ := ℤ)
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, ← hX, hF, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, ← hG]
    rfl
  refine mem_intSeriesInf.2 ⟨PowerSeries.mk fun k ↦ PowerSeries.coeff (k + n) G, ?_⟩
  rw [← hF]
  change HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries ℤ ℚ (PowerSeries.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) _) = _
  congr 1
  ext k
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff (k + n)) hmap
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_map, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul'] at this
  simp only [le_add_iff_nonneg_left, zero_le, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_map, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, ← this]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_eq_one_add_of_mem_intLaurentInf
statement:
lemma exists_eq_one_add_of_mem_intLaurentInf {f : 𝕂} (a : A)
    (hfa : f = 1 + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)) (hf : f ∈ intLaurentInf) :
    ∃ g ∈ intSeriesInf, f = 1 + 𝕧⁻¹ * g
proof:
:= by
  have hfa' : f = 1 + 𝕧⁻¹ * algebraMap A 𝕂 a := by
    rw [hfa, map_mul, InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]
  refine ⟨algebraMap A 𝕂 a, mem_intSeriesInf_of_mem_intLaurentInf ⟨a, rfl⟩ ?_, hfa'⟩
  have he : algebraMap A 𝕂 a = 𝕧 ^ (1 : ℤ) * (f - 1) := by
    rw [hfa', zpow_one, add_sub_cancel_left, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero,
      one_mul]
  rw [he]
  exact mul_mem (zpow_X_mem_intLaurentInf 1) (sub_mem hf (one_mem _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobal_mem
statement:
lemma negGlobal_mem (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobal_sub_mem
statement:
lemma negGlobal_sub_mem (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    negGlobal D ν b - fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1 ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A

statement:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formU_eq_quotientForm
statement:

    formU hv' x y = quotientForm D (negativeQuotientEquiv D x) (negativeQuotientEquiv D y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [quotientForm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_formU_negGlobal_self
statement:
lemma exists_formU_negGlobal_self (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    ∃ a : A, formU hv' (negGlobal D ν b) (negGlobal D ν b) = 1 + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set w := (Quotient.out b).1
  set d := negGlobal D ν b - fWi (D := D) hvt w with hd
  have hdP : d ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b
  have hdL : d ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A := Submodule.smul_le_self_of_tower ϖ _ hdP
  have hwL : fWi (D := D) hvt w ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
    NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ w
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := PBWSignedCrystal.word_pairing (D := D) w w
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := PBWSignedCrystal.form_mem_uniformizer (D := D) hwL hdP
  obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂⟩ := PBWSignedCrystal.form_mem_uniformizer (D := D) hdL hdP
  have hG : negGlobal D ν b = fWi (D := D) hvt w + d := by rw [hd, add_sub_cancel]
  refine ⟨a₀ + a₁ + a₁ + a₂, ?_⟩
  rw [hG, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, ha₀,
    formU_comm _ d (fWi hvt w), ha₁, ha₂]
  simp only [sub_self, zero_mem, ↓reduceIte, mul_add, map_add]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formU_negGlobal_self
statement:
theorem formU_negGlobal_self (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    ∃ g ∈ intSeriesInf, formU hv' (negGlobal D ν b) (negGlobal D ν b) = 1 + 𝕧⁻¹ * g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_formU_negGlobal_self D ν b
  have hZ := (negGlobal_mem D ν b).1
  refine exists_eq_one_add_of_mem_intLaurentInf a ha ?_
  rw [formU_eq_quotientForm]
  exact quotientForm_mem_intLaurentInf D hZ hZ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_signedGlobal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_signedGlobal_iff {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    (x ∈ negIntegral D ∧ negBar D x = x ∧
        ∃ g ∈ intSeriesInf, formU hv' x x = 1 + 𝕧⁻¹ * g) ↔
      ∃ b : negCrystal D ν, x = negGlobal D ν b ∨ x = -negGlobal D ν b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxZ, hbar, g, hg, hxx⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_of_mem_intSeriesInf hg
    have hxx' : formU hv' x x = algebraMap A 𝕂 (1 + ϖ * a) := by
      rw [hxx, map_add, map_one, map_mul, InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]
    have hxL : x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
      (mem_latInf_iff_formU_mem (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
        InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
        InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
        D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx).2 ⟨_, hxx'⟩
    obtain ⟨w, e, he, hxw⟩ :=
      PBWSignedCrystal.exists_signed_crystal_residue D hxZ hxL ⟨a, hxx'⟩
    have hee : (e : 𝕂) * e = 1 := by rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    
    have hwν : wordWeight w = ν := by
      by_contra hne
      have hne' : LusztigF.toZ ν ≠ LusztigF.toZ (wordWeight w) :=
        fun h ↦ hne (LusztigF.toZ_injective h).symm
      have hp := proj_mem_smul_latInf (D := D) (LusztigF.toZ (wordWeight w)) hxw
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, proj_of_mem_Uw hx, proj_of_mem_Uw (fWi_mem_Uw w)] at hp
      simp only [hne', ↓reduceIte, zero_sub] at hp
      have hp' := zsmul_mem (neg_mem hp) e
      rw [neg_neg, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul 𝕂, smul_smul, hee, one_smul] at hp'
      exact PBWSignedCrystal.word_not_mem_uniformizer (D := D) w hp'
    set b : negCrystal D ν := Quotient.mk _ ⟨w, hwν⟩
    have hout : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt w ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
      Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq b)
    have hsub : x - (e : 𝕂) • negGlobal D ν b ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
      have e1 : x - (e : 𝕂) • negGlobal D ν b = (x - (e : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w) -
          (e : 𝕂) • ((negGlobal D ν b - fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1) +
            (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt w)) := by
        rw [sub_add_sub_cancel, smul_sub]; abel
      rw [e1]
      refine sub_mem hxw ?_
      rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      exact zsmul_mem (add_mem (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b) hout) e
    have hxE : x ∈ negBalanced D ν :=
      ⟨hxZ, hx, hxL, (mem_latInfBar_iff D x).2 (by rw [hbar]; exact hxL)⟩
    have hGE : (e : 𝕂) • negGlobal D ν b ∈ negBalanced D ν := by
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩ := negGlobal_mem D ν b
      have hs : (e : 𝕂) • negGlobal D ν b = e • negGlobal D ν b := Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul 𝕂 _ _
      rw [hs]
      exact ⟨zsmul_mem h₁ e, zsmul_mem h₂ e, zsmul_mem h₃ e, zsmul_mem h₄ e⟩
    have hxe := eq_of_mem_negBalanced (negGlobalAt D ν) hxE hGE hsub
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · left; simpa using hxe
    · right; simpa using hxe
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgg⟩ := formU_negGlobal_self D ν b
    have hZ := (negGlobal_mem D ν b).1
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨hZ, negBar_negGlobal D ν b, g, hg, hgg⟩
    · refine ⟨neg_mem hZ, by rw [map_neg, negBar_negGlobal], g, hg, ?_⟩
      simp only [map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_neg, hgg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_iSup_Uw
statement: lemma mem_iSup_Uw (x : Um D 𝕧) : x ∈ ⨆ ν, Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  have h : (⨆ ν, Uw D 𝕧 ν) = ⊤ := by
    simp only [Uw, ← Submodule.map_iSup, LusztigF.iSup_weightSpace, Submodule.map_top,
      Submodule.range_mkQ]
  rw [h]; trivial

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_forall_proj
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_forall_proj {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (h : ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ _).1 (mem_iSup_Uw D x)
  have hc : ∀ ν, f ν = 0 := fun ν ↦ by
    have := h ν
    rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum] at this
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ν (fun μ _ hμ ↦ ?_) (fun hν ↦ ?_)] at this
    · rwa [proj_of_mem_Uw (hf ν), ite_eq_left rfl] at this
    · rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (hf μ), ite_eq_right fun e ↦ hμ (LusztigF.toZ_injective e)]
    · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hν, map_zero]
  simp [Finsupp.sum, hc]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_proj
statement:
lemma negBar_proj (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    negBar D (NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 γ x) = NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 γ (negBar D x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction mem_iSup_Uw D x using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν x hx =>
    rw [proj_of_mem_Uw hx, proj_of_mem_Uw (negBar_mem_Uw D hx)]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_pow_smul_mem_latInf'
statement:
lemma exists_pow_smul_mem_latInf' (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ϖ ^ n • x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  induction mem_iSup_Uw D x using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem ν x hx =>
    exact exists_pow_smul_mem_latInf (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
      InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
      InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨n + m, ?_⟩
    rw [smul_add, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_smul, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hn) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_latInf_of_formU_mem
statement:
theorem mem_latInf_of_formU_mem {x : Um D 𝕧} {a₀ : A}
    (ha₀ : formU hv' x x = algebraMap A 𝕂 a₀) : x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  by_contra hnot
  have hex := exists_pow_smul_mem_latInf' D x
  set n := Nat.find hex with hn
  have hxL : ϖ ^ n • x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hnot (by simpa [h] using hxL)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
  have hmL : ϖ ^ m • x ∉ latInf (D := D) hvt A := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 ϖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]; exact inv_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  set y := ϖ ^ n • x with hy
  have hyS : y ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 h
    refine hmL ?_
    have : z = ϖ ^ m • x := by
      have e : (algebraMap A 𝕂 ϖ) • z = (algebraMap A 𝕂 ϖ) • (ϖ ^ m • x) := by
        rw [algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul, hzy, hy, hm, pow_succ', mul_smul]
      exact smul_right_injective _ hϖ0 e
    exact this ▸ hz
  have hyy : formU hv' y y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * (ϖ ^ (2 * n - 1) * a₀)) := by
    simp only [hy, ← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 (ϖ ^ n) x, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha₀,
      smul_eq_mul]
    have e2 : n + n = 2 * n - 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_succ', e2]
  exact hyS (mem_smul_latInf_of_formU_mem (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hxL hyy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_signedBasis_iff
statement:
theorem mem_signedBasis_iff {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ signedBasis D ↔
      ∃ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν), x = negGlobal D ν b ∨ x = -negGlobal D ν b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxZ, hbar, g, hg, hxx⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_of_mem_intSeriesInf hg
    have hxx' : formU hv' x x = algebraMap A 𝕂 (1 + ϖ * a) := by
      rw [hxx, map_add, map_one, map_mul, InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]
    have hxL : x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A := mem_latInf_of_formU_mem D hxx'
    obtain ⟨w, e, he, hxw⟩ :=
      PBWSignedCrystal.exists_signed_crystal_residue D hxZ hxL ⟨a, hxx'⟩
    set ν := wordWeight w
    set b : negCrystal D ν := Quotient.mk _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hout : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt w ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
      Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq b)
    set y := x - (e : 𝕂) • negGlobal D ν b with hy
    have hyS : y ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
      have e1 : y = (x - (e : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w) -
          (e : 𝕂) • ((negGlobal D ν b - fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1) +
            (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt w)) := by
        rw [hy, sub_add_sub_cancel, smul_sub]; abel
      rw [e1]
      refine sub_mem hxw ?_
      rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      exact zsmul_mem (add_mem (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b) hout) e
    obtain ⟨hG₁, -, hG₃, -⟩ := negGlobal_mem D ν b
    have hyZ : y ∈ negIntegral D := by
      rw [hy, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]; exact sub_mem hxZ (zsmul_mem hG₁ e)
    have hyL : y ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
      rw [hy, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]; exact sub_mem hxL (zsmul_mem hG₃ e)
    have hybar : negBar D y = y := by
      rw [hy, map_sub, negBar_smul, hbar, negBar_negGlobal, map_intCast]
    have hy0 : y = 0 := by
      refine eq_zero_of_forall_proj D fun μ ↦ ?_
      refine (negGlobalAt D μ).2 _ ⟨proj_mem_negIntegral D _ hyZ, proj_mem_Uw μ y,
        proj_mem_latInf _ hyL, ?_⟩ (proj_mem_smul_latInf _ hyS)
      rw [mem_latInfBar_iff, negBar_proj, hybar]
      exact proj_mem_latInf _ hyL
    refine ⟨ν, b, ?_⟩
    rw [hy, sub_eq_zero] at hy0
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · left; simpa using hy0
    · right; simpa using hy0
  · rintro ⟨ν, b, hb⟩
    exact (mem_signedGlobal_iff D (x := x) (by
      rcases hb with rfl | rfl
      · exact (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1
      · exact neg_mem (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1)).2 ⟨b, hb⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signedBasis_eq_iUnion
statement: theorem signedBasis_eq_iUnion : signedBasis D = ⋃ ν, signedBasis D ∩ Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun ⟨_, hx, _⟩ ↦ hx⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, b, hb⟩ := (mem_signedBasis_iff D).1 hx
  refine ⟨ν, hx, ?_⟩
  rcases hb with rfl | rfl
  · exact (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1
  · exact neg_mem (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_negGlobal
statement: theorem linearIndependent_negGlobal (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : LinearIndependent 𝕂 (negGlobal D ν)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact (residueIndependent_negGlobalLift D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum (globalBelow D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum ν)).linearIndependent
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap irreducible_localX.ne_zero
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul irreducible_localX

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_negGlobal_laurent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_negGlobal_laurent (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s c hc i hi
  have h := linearIndependent_iff'.1 (linearIndependent_negGlobal D ν) s
    (fun j ↦ integralLaurentEval (c j)) (by simpa only [laurent_smul_eq] using hc) i hi
  exact integralLaurentEval_injective (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_negGlobal
statement:
theorem mem_span_negGlobal {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hxZ : x ∈ negIntegral D)
    (hxw : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (negGlobal D ν))
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact mem_span_negGlobalLift D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum (globalBelow D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum ν) hxZ hxw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_negGlobal_field
statement:
theorem mem_span_negGlobal_field {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hxw : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (negGlobal D ν))
proof:
:= by
  set S := Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (negGlobal D ν))
  have hZ : ∀ y, y ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (negGlobal D ν)) →
      y ∈ S := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy => exact Submodule.subset_span hy
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [laurent_smul_eq]; exact S.smul_mem _ hy
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_inv_pow_smul_mem_latInf hxw
  have hc : ((𝕧⁻¹) ^ N : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero)
  have hW : ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span A (fWi (D := D) hvt '' {w | wordWeight w = ν}), y ∈ S := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact hZ _ (mem_span_negGlobal D (fWi_mem_negIntegral D w) (hw ▸ fWi_mem_Uw w))
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul a y _ hy => rw [← algebraMap_smul 𝕂]; exact S.smul_mem _ hy
  have hcx := S.smul_mem (((𝕧⁻¹) ^ N : 𝕂)⁻¹)
    (hW _ (mem_span_fWi_of_mem hN (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hxw)))
  rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul] at hcx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_laurent_smul
statement:
lemma starU_laurent_smul (c : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    starU D 𝕧 (c • x) = c • starU D 𝕧 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurent_smul_eq, laurent_smul_eq, map_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_mem_span_image
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [starU_laurent_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_image_image
statement: lemma starU_image_image (S : Set (Um D 𝕧)) : starU D 𝕧 '' (starU D 𝕧 '' S) = S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.image_image, starU_starU, Set.image_id']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_signedBasisGeRight_iff
statement:
lemma mem_signedBasisGeRight_iff {i : I} {n : ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ signedBasisGeRight D i n ↔ starU D 𝕧 x ∈ signedBasisGe D i n
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedBasisGeRight_eq_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rwa [starU_starU]
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨_, h, starU_starU x⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff
statement:
lemma mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff {i : I} {n : ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ signedBasisAtRight D i n ↔ starU D 𝕧 x ∈ signedBasisAt D i n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [signedBasisAtRight, signedBasisAt, Set.mem_sdiff, mem_signedBasisGeRight_iff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rightDf_apply
statement:
lemma rightDf_apply (i : I) (n : ℕ) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    rightDf D i n x = starU D 𝕧 ((bosv i).df n (starU D 𝕧 x))
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rightDf_mk
statement:
lemma rightDf_mk (i : I) (n : ℕ) (z : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    rightDf D i n (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (z * ((qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ n)⁻¹ • θ 𝕂 i ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (bosv i).f = NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i := rfl
  rw [rightDf_apply, starU_mk, BosonModule.df_apply, hf, f_pow_mk,
    ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, starU_mk, map_smul, rev_mul, rev_rev, rev_θ_pow,
    mul_smul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.existsUnique_rightDf_sub_mem_span
statement:
theorem existsUnique_rightDf_sub_mem_span {i : I} (n : ℕ) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ signedBasisAtRight D i 0) :
    ∃! y, y ∈ signedBasisAtRight D i n ∧ rightDf D i n x - y ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGeRight D i (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨hy, hxy⟩, huniq⟩ :=
    existsUnique_df_sub_mem_span D n ((mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff D).1 hx)
  refine ⟨starU D 𝕧 y, ⟨(mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff D).2 (by rwa [starU_starU]), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have h := starU_mem_span_image D hxy
    rw [map_sub, ← signedBasisGeRight_eq_image] at h
    exact h
  · rintro y' ⟨hy', hxy'⟩
    have h := starU_mem_span_image D hxy'
    rw [signedBasisGeRight_eq_image, starU_image_image, map_sub, rightDf_apply,
      starU_starU] at h
    rw [← huniq _ ⟨(mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff D).1 hy', h⟩, starU_starU]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rightDf_sub_rightStringMap_mem_span
statement:
lemma rightDf_sub_rightStringMap_mem_span (i : I) (n : ℕ) (x : signedBasisAtRight D i 0) :
    rightDf D i n x - rightStringMap D i n x ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGeRight D i (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := starU_mem_span_image D
    (df_sub_signedStringMap_mem_span D i n ⟨starU D 𝕧 x, (mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff D).1 x.2⟩)
  rw [map_sub, ← signedBasisGeRight_eq_image] at h
  exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rightStringMap_bijective
statement:
theorem rightStringMap_bijective (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (rightStringMap D i n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩ := signedStringMap_bijective D i n
  refine ⟨fun x₁ x₂ h ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h' := congrArg (fun z : signedBasisAtRight D i n ↦ starU D 𝕧 (z : Um D 𝕧)) h
    simp only [rightStringMap, starU_starU] at h'
    have h'' := congrArg (fun z : signedBasisAt D i 0 ↦ starU D 𝕧 (z : Um D 𝕧))
      (hinj (Subtype.ext h'))
    simp only [starU_starU] at h''
    exact Subtype.ext h''
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj ⟨starU D 𝕧 y, (mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff D).1 y.2⟩
    refine ⟨⟨starU D 𝕧 x, (mem_signedBasisAtRight_iff D).2 (by rw [starU_starU]; exact x.2)⟩,
      Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    simp only [rightStringMap, starU_starU, Subtype.coe_eta, hx]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fCounit_θ
statement: @[simp] lemma fCounit_θ (i : I) : fCounit I (θ 𝕂 i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [θ, FreeAlgebra.algebraMapInv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fCounit_serreElement
statement: lemma fCounit_serreElement (i j : I) : fCounit I (serreElement D 𝕧 i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [serreElement, qSerreDiv, map_sum, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fCounit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal
statement:
lemma fCounit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hx : x ∈ serreIdeal D 𝕧) :
    fCounit I x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : serreIdeal D 𝕧 ≤ TwoSidedIdeal.ker (fCounit I) := by
    rw [serreIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, j, -, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker]
    exact fCounit_serreElement i j
  exact (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker _).1 (h hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fCounit_monomial_cons
statement: lemma fCounit_monomial_cons (i : I) (w : List I) : fCounit I (monomial 𝕂 (i :: w)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomial_cons, map_mul, fCounit_θ, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fCounit_rev
statement: lemma fCounit_rev (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) : fCounit I (rev 𝕂 I x) = fCounit I x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [rev_algebraMap]
  | grade1 i => exact congrArg _ (rev_θ i)
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [rev_mul, map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, mul_comm]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evKernel_le_ker_fCounit
statement:
lemma evKernel_le_ker_fCounit (n : I → ℕ) :
    evKernel D n ≤ LinearMap.ker (fCounit I).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine sup_le (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · exact fCounit_eq_zero_of_mem_serreIdeal (mem_serreSubmodule.1 hx)
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨a, i⟩, rfl⟩
    change fCounit I (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I (powWord n (a, i))) = 0
    rw [← monomial_eq_wordBasis, powWord]
    cases a with
    | nil => rw [List.nil_append, List.replicate_succ]; exact fCounit_monomial_cons i _
    | cons j a => rw [List.cons_append]; exact fCounit_monomial_cons j _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.umCounit_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma umCounit_mk (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    umCounit D (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = fCounit I x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.umCounit_starU
statement: lemma umCounit_starU (x : Um D 𝕧) : umCounit D (starU D 𝕧 x) = umCounit D x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [starU_mk, umCounit_mk, umCounit_mk, fCounit_rev]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.umCounit_f
statement: lemma umCounit_f (i : I) (x : Um D 𝕧) : umCounit D (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  change fCounit I (θ 𝕂 i * y) = 0
  rw [map_mul, fCounit_θ, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.umCounit_eq_zero_of_mem_Uw
statement:
lemma umCounit_eq_zero_of_mem_Uw {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) : umCounit D x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, umCounit_mk]
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hz
    cases w with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hν
    | cons i w => exact fCounit_monomial_cons i w
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul, ha, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.one_mem_canonicalBasis
statement: lemma one_mem_canonicalBasis : fWi (D := D) hvt [] ∈ canonicalBasis D
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨0, (mem_canonicalBasisAt_iff D).2 (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.umCounit_fWi_nil
statement: lemma umCounit_fWi_nil : umCounit D (fWi (D := D) hvt []) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change fCounit I 1 = 1
  exact map_one _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.umCounit_of_mem_canonicalBasis
statement:
lemma umCounit_of_mem_canonicalBasis {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    umCounit D x = if x = fWi hvt [] then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, b, rfl⟩ := (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 hx
  by_cases hν : ν = 0
  · subst hν
    simp [negGlobal_zero]
  · have h0 := umCounit_eq_zero_of_mem_Uw hν (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1
    rw [h0]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [h, umCounit_fWi_nil] at h0
      exact (one_ne_zero h0).elim
    · rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.one_mem_canonicalBasisHW
statement: lemma one_mem_canonicalBasisHW (Λ : Dom R) : fWi (D := D) hvt [] ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_canonicalBasisHW_iff D Λ).2 ⟨one_mem_canonicalBasis D, fun i h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (mem_rightRange_iff D).1 h
  have h1 := congrArg (umCounit D) hy
  rw [umCounit_starU, umCounit_fWi_nil, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, umCounit_f] at h1
  exact zero_ne_one h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ker_ev_le_ker_fCounit
statement:
lemma ker_ev_le_ker_fCounit :
    LinearMap.ker (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1) ≤ LinearMap.ker (fCounit I).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_ev_eq hR Λ]
  exact evKernel_le_ker_fCounit _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwCounit_ev
statement: lemma hwCounit_ev (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) : hwCounit hR Λ (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y) = fCounit I y
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ((ev R 𝕧 Λ.1).quotKerEquivOfSurjective (ev_surjective Λ)).symm (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk y :=
    (LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 rfl
  simp only [hwCounit, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, h₁, Submodule.liftQ_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwCounit_evq
statement: lemma hwCounit_evq (x : Um D 𝕧) : hwCounit hR Λ (evq hvt Λ x) = umCounit D x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [evq_mk, hwCounit_ev, umCounit_mk]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwCounit_hwv
statement: lemma hwCounit_hwv : hwCounit hR Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ev_one, hwCounit_ev, map_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwCounit_F_smul
statement:
lemma hwCounit_F_smul (i : I) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwCounit hR Λ (F R 𝕧 i • m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective Λ m
  rw [← ev_ι_mul, hwCounit_ev, map_mul]
  change fCounit I (θ 𝕂 i) * _ = 0
  rw [fCounit_θ, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_canonicalBasisHWBasis_one
statement:
theorem repr_canonicalBasisHWBasis_one (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR).repr m (hwOne Λ) = hwCounit hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  have h : (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR).coord (hwOne Λ) = hwCounit hR Λ :=
    (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR).ext fun b ↦ by
      classical
      rw [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply,
        hwCounit_evq, umCounit_of_mem_canonicalBasis (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ b.2),
        Finsupp.single_apply]
      simp only [hwOne, Subtype.ext_iff]
  rw [← h, Module.Basis.coord_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwCounit_rTensor_tensorEmb_ev
statement:
theorem hwCounit_rTensor_tensorEmb_ev (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    TensorProduct.lid 𝕂 _ (((hwCounit hR Λ₁).rTensor _)
      ((TensorModule.mk _ _).symm (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (ev R 𝕧 (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1 y)))) =
      ev R 𝕧 Λ₂.1 y
proof:
:= by
  let φ : TensorModule 𝕂 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) →ₗ[𝕂]
      IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1 :=
    (TensorProduct.lid 𝕂 _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (hwCounit hR Λ₁).rTensor _ ∘ₗ
      (TensorModule.mk _ _).symm.toLinearMap
  have hφ : ∀ (i : I) z, φ (F R 𝕧 i • z) = F R 𝕧 i • φ z := fun i z ↦ by
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (TensorModule.mk _ _).surjective z
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x y =>
      rw [TensorModule.F_smul_tmul]
      simp only [φ, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
        map_add, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul, hwCounit_F_smul, zero_smul,
        zero_add, smul_comm (hwCounit hR Λ₁ x) (F R 𝕧 i) y]
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, smul_add, ha, hb]
  change φ _ = _
  let P : LusztigF 𝕂 I → Prop := fun y ↦
    φ (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (ev R 𝕧 (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1 y)) = ev R 𝕧 Λ₂.1 y
  have hP1 : P 1 := by
    simp only [P, ev_one]
    erw [tensorEmb_hwv]
    simp only [φ, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
      LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul, hwCounit_hwv, one_smul]
  have key : ∀ a z, P z → P (a * z) := by
    intro a
    induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c =>
      intro z hz
      simp only [P, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower] at hz ⊢
      rw [hz]
    | grade1 j =>
      intro z hz
      simp only [P, ev_ι_mul, map_smul] at hz ⊢
      rw [hφ, hz]
    | mul a b ha hb => intro z hz; rw [mul_assoc]; exact ha _ (hb z hz)
    | add a b ha hb =>
      intro z hz
      simp only [P, add_mul, map_add] at ha hb ⊢
      rw [ha z hz, hb z hz]
  have := key y 1 hP1
  rwa [mul_one] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorEmb_ev_one
statement:
lemma repr_tensorEmb_ev_one (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) (b₂ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    (tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (ev R 𝕧 (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1 y))
      (hwOne Λ₁, b₂) = (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ₂ hR).repr (ev R 𝕧 Λ₂.1 y) b₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hwCounit_rTensor_tensorEmb_ev hR Λ₁ Λ₂ y]
  generalize tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (ev R 𝕧 (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1 y) = z
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (TensorModule.mk _ _).surjective z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [repr_tensorHWBasis_mk, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
      TensorProduct.lid_tmul, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      repr_canonicalBasisHWBasis_one]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ha, hb]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorEmb_evq_one
statement:
theorem repr_tensorEmb_evq_one {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (b₂ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    (tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (evq hvt (Λ₁ + Λ₂) x))
      (hwOne Λ₁, b₂) = if (b₂ : Um D 𝕧) = x then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [evq_mk, repr_tensorEmb_ev_one, ← evq_mk hvt Λ₂ y]
  by_cases hx' : Submodule.Quotient.mk y ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂
  · rw [show evq hvt Λ₂ (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ₂ hR ⟨_, hx'⟩ from
      (canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply Λ₂ hR ⟨_, hx'⟩).symm, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]
  · rw [evq_eq_zero_of_notMem_canonicalBasisHW Λ₂ hR hx hx', map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    exact (ite_eq_right_iff.2 fun h ↦ absurd (h ▸ b₂.2) hx').symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.proj_f_pow
statement:
lemma NegativePart.proj_f_pow (i : I) (m : ℕ) (γ : I →₀ ℤ) (u : Um D 𝕧) :
    NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 γ ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ m) u) =
      (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ m) (NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (γ - Finsupp.single i (m : ℤ)) u)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing γ with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, NegativePart.proj_f, ih, Module.End.mul_apply,
      sub_sub, ← Finsupp.single_add]
    push_cast
    ring_nf

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.NegativePart.proj_eq_zero_of_not_nonneg
statement:
lemma NegativePart.proj_eq_zero_of_not_nonneg {γ : I →₀ ℤ} (hγ : ¬ 0 ≤ γ) (u : Um D 𝕧) :
    NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 γ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  rw [NegativePart.proj_mk]
  simp [zWeightProj, hγ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_degree_le {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hxν : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) (hΛ : ∀ i, (ν.degree : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i)) :
    x ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_canonicalBasisHW_iff]
  refine ⟨hx, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  have hne : x ≠ 0 := (linearIndependent_canonicalBasis D).ne_zero ⟨x, hx⟩
  set n := (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (mem_rightRange_iff D).1 hi
  have h1 := proj_of_mem_Uw (starU_mem_Uw hxν) (toZ ν)
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ← hy, NegativePart.proj_f_pow,
    NegativePart.proj_eq_zero_of_not_nonneg, map_zero] at h1
  · refine hne ?_
    rw [← starU_starU x, ← hy, ← h1, map_zero]
  · intro h
    have h2 := h i
    have h3 := Finsupp.le_degree i ν
    have h4 := hΛ i
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, toZ_apply,
      Finsupp.single_eq_same] at h2
    omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mk_mem_span_canonicalBasisHW
statement:
lemma mk_mem_span_canonicalBasisHW {y : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hy : y ∈ degSpan 𝕂 I N) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk y : Um D 𝕧) ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hmem : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (monomial 𝕂 w) : Um D 𝕧) ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (wordWeight w) :=
      mk_mem_Uw (monomial_mem_weightSpace w)
    rw [← span_canonicalBasisAt] at hmem
    refine Submodule.span_mono (fun b hb ↦ ?_) hmem
    refine mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_degree_le Λ (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨_, hb⟩)
      (span_canonicalBasisAt D (wordWeight w) ▸ Submodule.subset_span hb) fun i ↦ ?_
    have := hN i
    have hw' : w.length < N := hw
    rw [degree_wordWeight]
    omega
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mk_eq_zero_of_evq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_of_evq_eq_zero {y : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hy : y ∈ degSpan 𝕂 I N)
    (h : evq hvt Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk y : Um D 𝕧) = 0) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk y : Um D 𝕧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := (linearIndependent_canonicalBasis D).disjoint_span_image
    (s := Subtype.val ⁻¹' canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
    (t := Subtype.val ⁻¹' (canonicalBasis D \ canonicalBasisHW D Λ))
    (Set.disjoint_left.2 fun _ h₁ h₂ ↦ h₂.2 h₁)
  rw [Subtype.image_preimage_coe, Subtype.image_preimage_coe,
    Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ),
    Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right Set.sdiff_subset] at hdisj
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hdisj _ (mk_mem_span_canonicalBasisHW Λ hN hy)
    (mem_span_of_evq_eq_zero Λ hR h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_mkQ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mkQ_eq_zero {p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hp : p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ.1 N)
    (h : (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ.1).mkQ p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
  have h' : evq hvt Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk y : Um D 𝕧) = 0 := h
  have h0 := mk_eq_zero_of_evq_eq_zero hR Λ hN hy h'
  rw [VermaModule.toVerma_eq_zero_iff hvn_ratFunc, ← mem_serreSubmodule]
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 h0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_toVerma_monomial_mem_vermaDegSpan
statement:
lemma E_smul_toVerma_monomial_mem_vermaDegSpan (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) (w : List I) :
    E R 𝕧 i • VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ (monomial 𝕂 w) ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [monomial_nil, VermaModule.toVerma_one, VermaModule.E_smul_hwv]
    exact zero_mem _
  | cons j w ih =>
    have hb : VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ (monomial 𝕂 w) ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ (w.length + 1) :=
      ⟨_, monomial_mem_degSpan (Nat.lt_succ_self _), rfl⟩
    rw [monomial_cons, ← F_smul_toVerma, ← mul_smul,
      ← sub_add_cancel (E R 𝕧 i * F R 𝕧 j) (F R 𝕧 j * E R 𝕧 i), add_smul, E_mul_F_sub,
      mul_smul, List.length_cons]
    refine add_mem ?_ (F_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ j ih)
    split_ifs
    · rw [smul_assoc, sub_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem (K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ _ hb)
        (K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ _ hb))
    · rw [zero_smul]
      exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan
statement:
lemma E_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (i : I) {d : ℕ} {p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ}
    (hp : p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ d) : E R 𝕧 i • p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact vermaDegSpan_mono Λ (le_of_lt hw) (E_smul_toVerma_monomial_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ i w)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, smul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tmul_mem_tensorDepth
proof:
:=
  Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ hq

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorDepth_mono
statement:
lemma tensorDepth_mono {a a' b b' : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b ≤ b') :
    tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b ≤ tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a' b'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ (Submodule.map_mono (vermaDegSpan_mono Λ ha)) (vermaDegSpan_mono Λ'' hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_smul_twist_mem
statement:
lemma F_smul_twist_mem {a : ℕ} {p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ} (hp : p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ a)
    (i : I) : ∃ p' ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ a, F R 𝕧 i • tw p = tw p'
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, E_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ i hp, by rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_F]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.F_smul_mem_tensorDepth
statement:
lemma F_smul_mem_tensorDepth (i : I) {a b : ℕ} {z : VT} (hz : z ∈ tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b) :
    F R 𝕧 i • z ∈ tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b ≤ (tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a (b + 1)).comap
      (DistribSMul.toLinearMap 𝕂 _ (F R 𝕧 i)) := by
    refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun m hm q hq ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hm
    obtain ⟨p', hp', e⟩ := F_smul_twist_mem hp i
    simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Submodule.mem_comap, DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply]
    rw [TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, map_add, e]
    exact add_mem (tmul_mem_tensorDepth hp' (vermaDegSpan_mono Λ'' (Nat.le_succ b)
      (K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ'' _ hq))) (tmul_mem_tensorDepth hp
        (F_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ'' i hq))
  exact h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_monomial_smul_mem_tensorDepth
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rw [monomial_nil, _root_.map_one, one_smul]; exact hz
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [monomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, minusHom_θ, mul_smul, List.length_cons, ← add_assoc]
    exact F_smul_mem_tensorDepth i ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_smul_mem_tensorDepth
statement:
lemma minusHom_smul_mem_tensorDepth {a b c : ℕ} {y : LusztigF 𝕂 I} (hy : y ∈ degSpan 𝕂 I c)
    {z : VT} (hz : z ∈ tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a (b + 1)) :
    minusHom R 𝕧 y • z ∈ tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a (b + c)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hw' : w.length < c := hw
    exact tensorDepth_mono le_rfl (by omega) (minusHom_monomial_smul_mem_tensorDepth w hz)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add, add_smul]; exact add_mem hy hy'
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, smul_assoc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triDepth_mono
statement:
lemma triDepth_mono {a a' b b' : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b ≤ b') :
    triDepth D a b ≤ triDepth D a' b'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ (Submodule.map_mono (degSpan_mono hb))
    (Submodule.map_mono (degSpan_mono ha))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_mem_triDepth
statement: lemma exists_mem_triDepth (z : fQ ⊗[𝕂] fQ) : ∃ n, z ∈ triDepth D n n
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul p q =>
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _ p
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _ q
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_mem_degSpan y
    obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := exists_mem_degSpan x
    exact ⟨max d d', Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _
      ⟨y, degSpan_mono (le_max_left _ _) hd, rfl⟩ ⟨x, degSpan_mono (le_max_right _ _) hd', rfl⟩⟩
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := hz'
    exact ⟨max d d', add_mem (triDepth_mono (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _) hd)
      (triDepth_mono (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _) hd')⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwv_mem_vermaDegSpan
statement: lemma hwv_mem_vermaDegSpan : VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'' ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ'' 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨monomial 𝕂 [], monomial_mem_degSpan (by simp), by
    rw [monomial_nil, VermaModule.toVerma_one]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_smul_vermaTensorHwv
statement:
lemma plusHom_smul_vermaTensorHwv (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    plusHom R 𝕧 x • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ'' =
      mkT (tw (VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'')
proof:
:= by
  rw [vermaTensorHwv, plusHom_smul_tmul_hwv, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_plusHom,
    VermaModule.toVerma_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triAct_mem_tensorDepth
statement:
lemma triAct_mem_tensorDepth {a b : ℕ} {z : fQ ⊗[𝕂] fQ} (hz : z ∈ triDepth D a b) :
    triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'' z ∈ tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b
proof:
:= by
  have h : triDepth D a b ≤ (tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b).comap (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'') := by
    refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun p hp q hq ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hq
    simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    change (minusHom R 𝕧 y * plusHom R 𝕧 x) • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ'' ∈ _
    rw [mul_smul, plusHom_smul_vermaTensorHwv]
    simpa using minusHom_smul_mem_tensorDepth (b := 0) hy
      (tmul_mem_tensorDepth ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ (hwv_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ''))
  exact h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_monomial_smul_sub_mem_tensorDepth
statement:
lemma minusHom_monomial_smul_sub_mem_tensorDepth (w : List I) {a : ℕ} {p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ}
    (hp : p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ a) :
    minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 w) • mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'') -
      mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ'' (monomial 𝕂 w)) ∈
      tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [monomial_nil, _root_.map_one, one_smul, VermaModule.toVerma_one, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  | cons i w ih =>
    set b := VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ'' (monomial 𝕂 w)
    have hb : b ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ'' (w.length + 1) :=
      ⟨_, monomial_mem_degSpan (Nat.lt_succ_self _), rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨p', hp', e'⟩ := F_smul_twist_mem hp i
    have e : minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 (i :: w)) •
          mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'') -
        mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ'' (monomial 𝕂 (i :: w))) =
        F R 𝕧 i • (minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 w) •
          mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'') - mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b)) +
        mkT ((F R 𝕧 i • tw p) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • b)) := by
      rw [smul_sub, TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, monomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, minusHom_θ,
        mul_smul, F_smul_toVerma, ← monomial_cons, map_add]
      abel
    rw [e, e', List.length_cons]
    exact add_mem (F_smul_mem_tensorDepth i ih)
      (tmul_mem_tensorDepth hp' (K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ'' _ hb))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triEquiv_mk_tmul_mk
statement:
lemma triEquiv_mk_tmul_mk (y x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    triEquiv R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'' (Submodule.Quotient.mk y ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      mkT (tw (VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ'' y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [triEquiv_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_plusHom,
    VermaModule.equivSerreQuotient_mk]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triAct_sub_triEquiv_mem_tensorDepth
proof:
:= by
  have h : triDepth D a (b + 1) ≤ (tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b).comap
      (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'' - (triEquiv R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'').toLinearMap) := by
    refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun p hp q hq ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hq
    simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
      have hw' : w.length < b + 1 := hw
      rw [triEquiv_mk_tmul_mk]
      change (minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 w) * plusHom R 𝕧 x) • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ'' - _ ∈ _
      rw [mul_smul, plusHom_smul_vermaTensorHwv]
      exact tensorDepth_mono le_rfl (by omega)
        (minusHom_monomial_smul_sub_mem_tensorDepth Λ Λ'' w ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' _ _ hy hy' =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, add_tmul, map_add, map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
      exact add_mem hy hy'
    | smul c y _ hy =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← smul_tmul', map_smul, map_smul, ← smul_sub]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  exact h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorDepth_le_map_triEquiv
statement:
lemma tensorDepth_le_map_triEquiv (a b : ℕ) :
    tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b ≤ (triDepth D a b).map (triEquiv R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'').toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun m hm q hq ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk y ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk x,
    Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  exact triEquiv_mk_tmul_mk Λ Λ'' y x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_triAct_eq
statement:
theorem exists_triAct_eq (a b : ℕ) {m : TensorModule 𝕂 (ChevalleyTwist R 𝕧 (VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ))
    (VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ'')} (hm : m ∈ tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b) :
    ∃ z ∈ triDepth D a b, triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'' z = m
proof:
:= by
  induction b generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ'' 0 = ⊥ := by
      rw [vermaDegSpan, degSpan_zero, Submodule.map_bot]
    rw [tensorDepth, h0, Submodule.map₂_bot_right, Submodule.mem_bot] at hm
    exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, by rw [map_zero, hm]⟩
  | succ b ih =>
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ := tensorDepth_le_map_triEquiv Λ Λ'' a (b + 1) hm
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, e⟩ := ih (triAct_sub_triEquiv_mem_tensorDepth Λ Λ'' hz₀)
    refine ⟨z₀ - z₁, sub_mem hz₀ (triDepth_mono le_rfl (Nat.le_succ b) hz₁), ?_⟩
    rw [map_sub, e, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, sub_sub_cancel]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorIrrProj_mk_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorIrrProj_mk_tmul (p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) (q : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ''.1) :
    tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (TensorModule.mk _ _ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] q)) =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (Submodule.Quotient.mk p) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] Submodule.Quotient.mk q
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorIrrProj]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorIrrProj_smul
statement:
lemma tensorIrrProj_smul (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (z : VT) :
    tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (u • z) = TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u (tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (TensorModule.mk _ _).surjective z
  rw [TensorModule.smul_mk]
  simp only [tensorIrrProj, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact (actPair_tensorMap _ _ _ _).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorIrrProj_vermaTensorHwv
statement:
lemma tensorIrrProj_vermaTensorHwv :
    tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 Λ''.1) =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ''.1
proof:
:=
  tensorIrrProj_mk_tmul Λ Λ'' _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorIrrProj_triAct
statement:
lemma tensorIrrProj_triAct (z : (LusztigF 𝕂 I ⧸ serreSubmodule D 𝕧) ⊗[𝕂]
    (LusztigF 𝕂 I ⧸ serreSubmodule D 𝕧)) :
    tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc z)
        (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
          IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ''.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorIrrProj_vermaTensorHwv, ← tensorIrrProj_smul]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_tensorIrrProj_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  set ι₁ := (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 (VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    (vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ.1 n).subtype
  set ι₂ := (vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ''.1 n).subtype
  have hle : tensorDepth R Λ.1 Λ''.1 n n ≤
      LinearMap.range ((TensorModule.mk _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map ι₁ ι₂) := by
    refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun m hm q hq ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hm
    exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨q, hq⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hle hz
  set f₁ := ((ChevalleyTwist.map (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ.1).mkQ).restrictScalars 𝕂) ∘ₗ ι₁
  set f₂ := ((VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ''.1).mkQ.restrictScalars 𝕂) ∘ₗ ι₂
  have hf₁ : Function.Injective f₁ := by
    refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun p hp ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
    have hp' : ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _
        ((VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ.1).mkQ (p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)) = 0 := by
      simpa [f₁, ι₁] using hp
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hp'
    exact eq_zero_of_mkQ_eq_zero hR Λ hΛ p.2 hp'
  have hf₂ : Function.Injective f₂ :=
    (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun q hq ↦
      Subtype.ext (eq_zero_of_mkQ_eq_zero hR Λ'' hΛ'' q.2 hq)
  have e : tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (((TensorModule.mk _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.map ι₁ ι₂) t) = TensorProduct.map f₁ f₂ t := by
    rw [tensorIrrProj, TensorProduct.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [e] at h
  rw [map_injective_of_flat_flat f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂ (h.trans (map_zero _).symm), map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twHwv_tmul_mem_weightSpace
statement:
lemma twHwv_tmul_mem_weightSpace :
    TensorModule.mk (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ''.1)
      (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ''.1) ∈ weightSpace R 𝕧 _ (Λ''.1 - Λ.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hξ : ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ∈
      weightSpace R 𝕧 (TwL Λ) (-Λ.1) := fun μ ↦ by
    rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_K, hw_K_smul_hwv, LinearEquiv.map_smul, map_neg,
      AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]
  have h := TensorModule.tmul_mem_weightSpace hξ
    (show IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ''.1 ∈ weightSpace R 𝕧 _ Λ''.1 from
      fun μ ↦ hw_K_smul_hwv Λ'' μ)
  rwa [neg_add_eq_sub] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_leftActOne
statement:
lemma modTensorAct_leftActOne {ζ : Y →+ ℤ} (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ) (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ u) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ''.1)
proof:
:= by
  subst hζ
  rw [modTensorAct, LinearMap.comp_apply, weightAct_leftActOne, TensorModule.smul_mk]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_leftActOne_triMul
statement:
lemma modTensorAct_leftActOne_triMul {ζ : Y →+ ℤ} (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ)
    (z : (LusztigF 𝕂 I ⧸ serreSubmodule D 𝕧) ⊗[𝕂] (LusztigF 𝕂 I ⧸ serreSubmodule D 𝕧)) :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc z)) =
      tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modTensorAct_leftActOne Λ Λ'' hζ, tensorIrrProj_triAct]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.weightSpace_le_degSpan
statement:
lemma weightSpace_le_degSpan {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {N : ℕ} (hν : ν.degree < N) :
    LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν ≤ degSpan 𝕂 I N
proof:
:= by
  rw [LusztigF.weightSpace_eq_span, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  change FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I w.1 ∈ _
  rw [← monomial_eq_wordBasis]
  refine monomial_mem_degSpan ?_
  rw [← degree_wordWeight, w.2]
  exact hν

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.vermaMinus_mk
statement:
lemma vermaMinus_mk (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    vermaMinus R Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk y : Um D 𝕧) = VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ y
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mkQ_vermaMinus
statement:
lemma mkQ_vermaMinus (Λ : Dom R) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ.1).mkQ (vermaMinus R Λ.1 x) = evq hvt Λ x
proof:
:= by
