name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.vermaMinus_mem_vermaDegSpan
statement:
lemma vermaMinus_mem_vermaDegSpan (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {N : ℕ} (hν : ν.degree < N)
    {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) : vermaMinus R Λ x ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  change vermaMinus R Λ (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) ∈ _
  rw [vermaMinus_mk]
  exact ⟨y, weightSpace_le_degSpan hν hy, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.vermaMinus_mem_vermaLattice
statement:
lemma vermaMinus_mem_vermaLattice (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D) :
    vermaMinus R Λ x ∈ vermaLattice R Λ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ z ∈ quotientIntegralForm D, ∀ m ∈ vermaLattice R Λ,
      quotientMinus R z • m ∈ vermaLattice R Λ := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hz
      intro m hm
      rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, map_qDivPow', quotientMinus_θ]
      exact qDivPow_F_smul_mem_vermaLattice i n hm
    | algebraMap c =>
      intro m hm
      rw [show algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Quotient D 𝕧) c =
        algebraMap 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) (integralLaurentEval c) from rfl, AlgHom.commutes,
        algebraMap_smul]
      exact laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan ⟨c, rfl⟩ hm
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      intro m hm
      rw [map_add, add_smul]
      exact add_mem (ha m hm) (hb m hm)
    | mul a b _ _ ha hb =>
      intro m hm
      rw [_root_.map_mul, mul_smul]
      exact ha _ (hb m hm)
  exact key _ hx _ (mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨[], by rw [fPow_nil, one_smul]⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorBasis_eq_tensorIrrProj
statement:
lemma tensorBasis_eq_tensorIrrProj (Λ Λ'' : Dom R)
    (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'' h = tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (TensorModule.mk _ _
      (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (vermaMinus R Λ.1 h.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] vermaMinus R Λ''.1 h.2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorIrrProj_mk_tmul, tensorBasis_apply, ← mkQ_vermaMinus, ← mkQ_vermaMinus]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_triAct_tensorCanonical
statement:
lemma exists_triAct_tensorCanonical (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) {N : ℕ}
    (h₀ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') (h₁ : (hwbWt Λ h₀.1).degree < N)
    (h₂ : (hwbWt Λ'' h₀.2).degree < N) :
    ∃ z ∈ triDepth D N N,
      triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ.1 Λ''.1 ∧
      tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z) = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀
proof:
:= by
  set c := (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').repr (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀)
  set L : TensorIdx Λ Λ'' → TensorModule 𝕂 (ChevalleyTwist R 𝕧 (VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ.1))
      (VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ''.1) := fun h ↦ TensorModule.mk _ _
    (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (vermaMinus R Λ.1 h.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] vermaMinus R Λ''.1 h.2)
  have hsupp : ∀ h ∈ c.support,
      (hwbWt Λ h.1).degree < N ∧ (hwbWt Λ'' h.2).degree < N := by
    intro h hh
    have hd : (hwbWt Λ h.1).degree ≤ (hwbWt Λ h₀.1).degree ∧
        (hwbWt Λ'' h.2).degree ≤ (hwbWt Λ'' h₀.2).degree := by
      by_cases he : h = h₀
      · subst he
        exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
      · have hl := tensorLt_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero hR Λ Λ'' he
          (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hh)
        exact ⟨hl.2.1.le, hl.2.2.le⟩
    exact ⟨hd.1.trans_lt h₁, hd.2.trans_lt h₂⟩
  have hm : c.sum (fun h a ↦ a • L h) ∈ tensorDepth R Λ.1 Λ''.1 N N :=
    Submodule.sum_mem _ fun h hh ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (tmul_mem_tensorDepth (vermaMinus_mem_vermaDegSpan _ (hsupp h hh).1 (mem_Uw_cbWt _))
        (vermaMinus_mem_vermaDegSpan _ (hsupp h hh).2 (mem_Uw_cbWt _)))
  have hmL : c.sum (fun h a ↦ a • L h) ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ.1 Λ''.1 := by
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun h _ ↦ ?_
    have hc : IsLaurent (c h) := by
      rw [show c h = _ from repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀ h]
      split_ifs
      · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
    exact laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan hc (tmul_mem_vermaTensorLattice
      (vermaMinus_mem_vermaLattice _ (negIntegral_of_mem_canonicalBasis
        (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ h.1.2)))
      (vermaMinus_mem_vermaLattice _ (negIntegral_of_mem_canonicalBasis
        (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ'' h.2.2))))
  have hproj : tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (c.sum fun h a ↦ a • L h) =
      tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀ := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').linearCombination_repr
      (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀)]
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, L]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun h _ ↦ ?_
    exact congrArg (c h • ·) (tensorBasis_eq_tensorIrrProj hR Λ Λ'' h).symm
  obtain ⟨z, hz, ez⟩ := exists_triAct_eq Λ.1 Λ''.1 N N hm
  exact ⟨z, hz, ez ▸ hmL, ez ▸ hproj⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_tensorIrrProj_triAct
statement:
lemma tensorTransition_tensorIrrProj_triAct (Λ Λ' Λ'' : Dom R) (z : fQ ⊗[𝕂] fQ) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (tensorIrrProj (Λ' + Λ) (Λ' + Λ'')
      (triAct R hvn_ratFunc (Λ' + Λ).1 (Λ' + Λ'').1 z)) =
      tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorIrrProj_triAct, tensorIrrProj_triAct, tensorTransition_act, tensorTransition_hwv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.leftActOne_triMul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma leftActOne_triMul_eq_zero (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) {n : ℕ} (hΛ : ∀ i, (n : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i))
    (hΛ'' : ∀ i, (n : ℤ) ≤ Λ''.1 (R.coroot i)) {z : fQ ⊗[𝕂] fQ} (hz : z ∈ triDepth D n n)
    (h : tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z) = 0) :
    leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc (Λ''.1 - Λ.1) (triMul R hvn_ratFunc z) = 0
proof:
:=
  (smul_vermaTensorHwv_eq_zero_iff hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 _).1
    (eq_zero_of_tensorIrrProj_eq_zero hR Λ Λ'' hΛ hΛ'' (triAct_mem_tensorDepth Λ.1 Λ''.1 hz) h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt
statement:
lemma mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt (Λ : Dom R) {b : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hΛ : ∀ i, ((cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i)) : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ
proof:
:=
  mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_degree_le Λ hb (mem_Uw_cbWt ⟨b, hb⟩) hΛ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_dom_pair
statement:
lemma exists_dom_pair (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ Λ Λ'' : Dom R, Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ ∧ (∀ i, (M : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i)) ∧
      ∀ i, (M : ℤ) ≤ Λ''.1 (R.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Finite.exists_le fun i ↦ -ζ (R.coroot i)
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := hY (M + C.toNat)
  have h : ∀ i, (M : ℤ) ≤ (Λ.1 + ζ) (R.coroot i) := fun i ↦ by
    have h1 := hΛ i
    have h2 := hC i
    have h3 := Int.self_le_toNat C
    rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
    push_cast at h1
    omega
  exact ⟨Λ, ⟨Λ.1 + ζ, fun i ↦ (Int.natCast_nonneg M).trans (h i)⟩, add_sub_cancel_left _ _,
    fun i ↦ by have := hΛ i; push_cast at this; omega, h⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_modTensorAct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_modTensorAct_eq_zero {ζ : Y →+ ℤ} {u : Modified R 𝕧}
    (hu : u ∈ LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ)) (M : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ Λ Λ'' : Dom R, Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ → (∀ i, (M : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i)) →
      (∀ i, (M : ℤ) ≤ Λ''.1 (R.coroot i)) → modTensorAct Λ Λ'' u = 0) : u = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_leftActOne_eq_triMul hvn_ratFunc ζ w
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_triDepth z
  obtain ⟨Λ, Λ'', hζ, hΛ, hΛ''⟩ := exists_dom_pair hY ζ (max n M)
  have hle : ∀ m, m ≤ max n M → ∀ x : ℤ, ((max n M : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ x → (m : ℤ) ≤ x :=
    fun m hm x hx ↦ (Int.ofNat_le.2 hm).trans hx
  have h0 := h Λ Λ'' hζ (fun i ↦ hle M (le_max_right _ _) _ (hΛ i))
    (fun i ↦ hle M (le_max_right _ _) _ (hΛ'' i))
  rw [hz, modTensorAct_leftActOne_triMul Λ Λ'' hζ] at h0
  rw [hz, ← hζ]
  exact leftActOne_triMul_eq_zero hR Λ Λ'' (fun i ↦ hle n (le_max_left _ _) _ (hΛ i))
    (fun i ↦ hle n (le_max_left _ _) _ (hΛ'' i)) hn h0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_modifiedCanonical
statement:
theorem exists_modifiedCanonical (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ u ∈ LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ), u ∈ aForm R ∧
      (∀ (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) (_ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ) (h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
        (h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ''),
        modTensorAct Λ Λ'' u = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩)) ∧
      ∀ (Λ Λ'' : Dom R), Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ →
        (b ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ∨ b'' ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') →
          modTensorAct Λ Λ'' u = 0
proof:
:= by
  set N := max (cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree (cbWt D ⟨b'', hb''⟩).degree + 1
  have hN₁ : (cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree < N := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_max_left _ _)
  have hN₂ : (cbWt D ⟨b'', hb''⟩).degree < N := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_max_right _ _)
  have hmem : ∀ Λ : Dom R, (∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i)) →
      b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ∧ b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ := fun Λ hΛ ↦
    ⟨mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt Λ hb fun i ↦ by have := hΛ i; omega,
      mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt Λ hb'' fun i ↦ by have := hΛ i; omega⟩
  have works : ∀ Λ Λ'' : Dom R, ∀ (h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
      (h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ''), ∃ z ∈ triDepth D N N,
        triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z ∈ vermaTensorLattice R Λ.1 Λ''.1 ∧
        tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z) =
          tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩) := fun Λ Λ'' h₁ h₂ ↦
    exists_triAct_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩) hN₁ hN₂
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, Λ₀'', hζ₀, hΛ₀, hΛ₀''⟩ := exists_dom_pair hY ζ N
  have hb₀ := (hmem Λ₀ hΛ₀).1
  have hb₀'' := (hmem Λ₀'' hΛ₀'').2
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hL₀, e₀⟩ := works Λ₀ Λ₀'' hb₀ hb₀''
  refine ⟨leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc z₀), ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hζ₀]
    exact (leftActOne_mem_aForm_iff Λ₀.1 Λ₀''.1 _).2 hL₀
  have key : ∀ Λ Λ'' : Dom R, Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ → ∃ z₁ : fQ ⊗[𝕂] fQ,
      ∃ (h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (Λ₀ + Λ)) (h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (Λ₀ + Λ'')),
        tensorIrrProj (Λ₀ + Λ) (Λ₀ + Λ'') (triAct R hvn_ratFunc (Λ₀ + Λ).1 (Λ₀ + Λ'').1 z₁) =
          tensorCanonical hR (Λ₀ + Λ) (Λ₀ + Λ'') (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩) ∧
        modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc z₀)) =
          tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 z₁) := by
    intro Λ Λ'' hζ
    have hlarge : ∀ Λ' : Dom R, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ (Λ₀ + Λ').1 (R.coroot i) := fun Λ' i ↦ by
      have := hΛ₀ i
      have := Λ'.2 i
      rw [Dom.add_val, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
      omega
    have h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (Λ₀ + Λ) := (hmem _ (hlarge Λ)).1
    have h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (Λ₀ + Λ'') := (hmem _ (hlarge Λ'')).2
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, -, e₁⟩ := works (Λ₀ + Λ) (Λ₀ + Λ'') h₁ h₂
    refine ⟨z₁, h₁, h₂, e₁, ?_⟩
    have eP : Λ₀ + Λ = Λ + Λ₀ := Subtype.ext (by rw [Dom.add_val, Dom.add_val, add_comm])
    have eQ : Λ₀ + Λ'' = Λ + Λ₀'' := Subtype.ext (by
      rw [Dom.add_val, Dom.add_val, ← sub_add_cancel Λ''.1 Λ.1, ← sub_add_cancel Λ₀''.1 Λ₀.1,
        hζ, hζ₀]
      abel)
    have e₁' : tensorIrrProj Λ₀ Λ₀'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ₀.1 Λ₀''.1 z₁) =
        tensorCanonical hR Λ₀ Λ₀'' (⟨b, hb₀⟩, ⟨b'', hb₀''⟩) := by
      have h₁' : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (Λ + Λ₀) := canonicalBasisHW_subset_add D Λ₀ Λ hb₀
      have h₂' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (Λ + Λ₀'') := canonicalBasisHW_subset_add D Λ₀'' Λ hb₀''
      have e : tensorIrrProj (Λ + Λ₀) (Λ + Λ₀'')
          (triAct R hvn_ratFunc (Λ + Λ₀).1 (Λ + Λ₀'').1 z₁) =
            tensorCanonical hR (Λ + Λ₀) (Λ + Λ₀'') (⟨b, h₁'⟩, ⟨b'', h₂'⟩) := by
        clear_value N
        revert h₁ h₂ e₁ h₁' h₂'
        rw [eP, eQ]
        intro h₁ h₂ e₁ _ _
        exact e₁
      rw [← tensorTransition_tensorIrrProj_triAct hR Λ₀ Λ Λ₀'', e]
      exact tensorTransition_tensorCanonical hR Λ₀ Λ Λ₀'' ⟨b, hb₀⟩ ⟨b'', hb₀''⟩
    have hzero : leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc (z₁ - z₀)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hζ₀]
      refine leftActOne_triMul_eq_zero hR Λ₀ Λ₀'' hΛ₀ hΛ₀'' (sub_mem hz₁ hz₀) ?_
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, e₁', e₀, sub_self]
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
    rw [← hzero, modTensorAct_leftActOne_triMul Λ Λ'' hζ]
  refine ⟨fun Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_, fun Λ Λ'' hζ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z₁, h₁', h₂', e₁, e⟩ := key Λ Λ'' hζ
    rw [e, ← tensorTransition_tensorIrrProj_triAct hR Λ Λ₀ Λ'', e₁]
    exact tensorTransition_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₀ Λ'' ⟨b, h₁⟩ ⟨b'', h₂⟩
  · obtain ⟨z₁, h₁', h₂', e₁, e⟩ := key Λ Λ'' hζ
    rw [e, ← tensorTransition_tensorIrrProj_triAct hR Λ Λ₀ Λ'', e₁]
    exact tensorTransition_tensorCanonical_eq_zero hR Λ Λ₀ Λ'' ⟨b, h₁'⟩ ⟨b'', h₂'⟩ h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.existsUnique_modifiedCanonical
statement:
theorem existsUnique_modifiedCanonical (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃! u, u ∈ LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ) ∧
      ∀ (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) (_ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ) (h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
        (h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ''),
        modTensorAct Λ Λ'' u = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, -, ha, -⟩ := exists_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb''
  refine ⟨u, ⟨hu, ha⟩, fun u' ⟨hu', ha'⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_modTensorAct_eq_zero hR hY (sub_mem hu' hu)
    (max (cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree (cbWt D ⟨b'', hb''⟩).degree) fun Λ Λ'' hζ hΛ hΛ'' ↦ ?_
  have h₁ := mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt Λ hb fun i ↦ by
    have := hΛ i
    push_cast at this
    omega
  have h₂ := mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt Λ'' hb'' fun i ↦ by
    have := hΛ'' i
    push_cast at this
    omega
  rw [map_sub, ha Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂, ha' Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂, sub_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modifiedCanonical_mem_range
statement:
theorem modifiedCanonical_mem_range (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'' ∈ LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ)
proof:
:=
  (exists_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'').choose_spec.1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modifiedCanonical_mem_aForm
statement:
theorem modifiedCanonical_mem_aForm (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) : modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'' ∈ aForm R
proof:
:=
  (exists_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'').choose_spec.2.1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical
statement:
theorem modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) (Λ Λ'' : Dom R)
    (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ) (h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ) (h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'') =
      tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩)
proof:
:=
  (exists_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'').choose_spec.2.2.1 Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical_eq_zero
statement:
theorem modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical_eq_zero (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) (Λ Λ'' : Dom R)
    (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ) (h : b ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ∨ b'' ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'') = 0
proof:
:=
  (exists_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'').choose_spec.2.2.2 Λ Λ'' hζ h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_bar
statement:
theorem modTensorAct_bar {ζ : Y →+ ℤ} (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ)
    {u : Modified R 𝕧} (hu : u ∈ LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ)) :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (Modified.bar R u) = tensorPsi hR Λ Λ'' (modTensorAct Λ Λ'' u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hu
  rw [Modified.bar_leftActOne, modTensorAct_leftActOne Λ Λ'' hζ,
    modTensorAct_leftActOne Λ Λ'' hζ, tensorPsi_act_hwv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_modifiedCanonical
statement:
theorem bar_modifiedCanonical (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    Modified.bar R (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'') = modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb''
proof:
:= by
  have hu := modifiedCanonical_mem_range hR hY ζ hb hb''
  refine (existsUnique_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'').unique ⟨?_, fun Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_⟩
    ⟨hu, fun Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂ ↦ modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'' Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hu
    exact ⟨barHom R x, by rw [← hx, Modified.bar_leftActOne]⟩
  · rw [modTensorAct_bar hR Λ Λ'' hζ hu,
      modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'' Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂]
    exact tensorPsi_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnTriangularEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnTriangularEquiv_apply (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (z : fQ ⊗[k] fQ) :
    (columnTriangularEquiv R hv ζ z : Modified R v) = leftActOne R hv ζ (triMul R hv z)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnEquiv_triMul
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnEquiv_triMul (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ) (z : fQ ⊗[k] fQ) :
    (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ
      ⟨leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) (triMul R hv z), _, rfl⟩ : Modified R' v) =
      leftActOne R' hv ζ (triMul R' hv z)
proof:
:= by
  change ((columnTriangularEquiv R' hv ζ)
    ((columnTriangularEquiv R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom)).symm
      (columnTriangularEquiv R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) z)) : Modified R' v) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, columnTriangularEquiv_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mapHom_minus_plus
statement:
lemma mapHom_minus_plus (φ : R.Hom R') (y x : LusztigF k I) :
    QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ (minusHom R v y * plusHom R v x) =
      minusHom R' v y * plusHom R' v x
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ).comp (minusHom R v) = minusHom R' v := by
    apply FreeAlgebra.hom_ext
    funext i
    simp [minusHom]
  have hp : (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ).comp (plusHom R v) = plusHom R' v := by
    apply FreeAlgebra.hom_ext
    funext i
    simp [plusHom]
  rw [_root_.map_mul (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ), ← AlgHom.comp_apply, hm, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, hp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnEquiv_leftActOne
statement:
theorem columnEquiv_leftActOne (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ ⟨leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u, u, rfl⟩ :
      Modified R' v) = leftActOne R' hv ζ (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ u)
proof:
:= by
  let T : QuantumGroup R v →ₗ[k] Modified R' v :=
    (LinearMap.range (leftActOne R' hv ζ)).subtype.comp
      ((columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ).toLinearMap.comp
        (leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom)).rangeRestrict)
  change T u = _
  induction VermaModule.mem_triangularSpan_of u (NeZero.ne v) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem u hu =>
    obtain ⟨w, μ, w', rfl⟩ := hu
    have hroot : R'.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w') (φ.toHom μ) =
        R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w') μ := by
      simp [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum, φ.root_map]
    have hnorm (S : D.RootDatum Y) (ξ : Y →+ ℤ) :
        leftActOne S hv ξ
          (minusHom S v (LusztigF.monomial k w) * K S v μ *
            plusHom S v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) =
        (v ^ S.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w') μ * v ^ ξ μ) •
          leftActOne S hv ξ (minusHom S v (LusztigF.monomial k w) *
            plusHom S v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, K_mul_plusHom_of_mem (LusztigF.monomial_mem_weightSpace w') μ,
        mul_smul_comm, map_smul, ← mul_assoc, leftActOne_mul_K, smul_smul]
    have ht : T (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) *
        plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) =
        leftActOne R' hv ζ (minusHom R' v (LusztigF.monomial k w) *
          plusHom R' v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) :=
      columnEquiv_triMul R R' hv φ ζ
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (LusztigF.monomial k w) ⊗ₜ
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (LusztigF.monomial k w'))
    have hT : T (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) * K R v μ *
        plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) =
        (v ^ R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w') μ * v ^ ζ (φ.toHom μ)) •
          T (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) *
            plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) := by
      have he : (leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom)).rangeRestrict
          (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) * K R v μ *
            plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) =
          (v ^ R.rootSum (LusztigF.wordWeight w') μ * v ^ ζ (φ.toHom μ)) •
          (leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom)).rangeRestrict
            (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w) *
              plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) :=
        Subtype.ext (hnorm R (ζ.comp φ.toHom))
      change (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ _ : Modified R' v) = _
      rw [he, map_smul]
      rfl
    rw [hT, ht]
    have hm : QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ (minusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w)) =
        minusHom R' v (LusztigF.monomial k w) := by
      simpa using mapHom_minus_plus R R' φ (LusztigF.monomial k w) 1
    have hp : QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ (plusHom R v (LusztigF.monomial k w')) =
        plusHom R' v (LusztigF.monomial k w') := by
      simpa using mapHom_minus_plus R R' φ 1 (LusztigF.monomial k w')
    rw [_root_.map_mul (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ), _root_.map_mul (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ), hm, hp,
      mapHom_K, mul_assoc,
      K_mul_plusHom_of_mem (LusztigF.monomial_mem_weightSpace w') (φ.toHom μ),
      mul_smul_comm, map_smul, ← mul_assoc, leftActOne_mul_K, smul_smul, hroot]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul c x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnEquiv_mul
statement:
theorem columnEquiv_mul (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ) (a u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ
      ⟨leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) (a * u), a * u, rfl⟩ : Modified R' v) =
      leftAct R' v hv (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ a)
        (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ
          ⟨leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u, u, rfl⟩ : Modified R' v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [columnEquiv_leftActOne, columnEquiv_leftActOne, _root_.map_mul (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ),
    leftActOne_apply, leftAct_mul, leftActOne_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.leftActOne_mapHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem leftActOne_mapHom_eq_zero_iff (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ)
    (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    leftActOne R' hv ζ (QuantumGroup.mapHom v φ u) = 0 ↔
      leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← columnEquiv_leftActOne R R' hv φ ζ u]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he : columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ
        ⟨leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u, u, rfl⟩ = 0 := Subtype.ext h
    have hz := (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ).injective
      (he.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hz
  · intro h
    have hz : (⟨leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u, u, rfl⟩ :
        LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom))) = 0 := Subtype.ext h
    rw [hz, map_zero, Submodule.coe_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mapHom_fePow
statement:
lemma mapHom_fePow (φ : R.Hom R') (w w' : List (I × ℕ)) :
    QuantumGroup.mapHom 𝕧 φ (fPow R w * ePow R w') = fPow R' w * ePow R' w'
proof:
:= by
  simp [fPow, ePow, qDivPow, map_list_prod, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mapHom_fePowSpan
statement:
lemma mapHom_fePowSpan (φ : R.Hom R') :
    (fePowSpan R).map (QuantumGroup.mapHom 𝕧 φ).toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap =
      fePowSpan R'
proof:
:= by
  rw [fePowSpan, laurentSpan, Submodule.map_span]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨n, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨n, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, by simp [mapHom_fePow]⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(𝕧 ^ n) • (fPow R w * ePow R w'), ⟨n, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [mapHom_fePow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.exists_fePowSpan_leftActOne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hx
  have ht : u • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 0 ζ ∈ vermaTensorLattice R 0 ζ := by
    apply (leftActOne_mem_aForm_iff 0 ζ u).1
    simpa using ha
  obtain ⟨u', hu', he⟩ := mem_fePowImage.1 (vermaTensorLattice_le_fePowImage ht)
  refine ⟨u', hu', ?_⟩
  have hz : (u' - u) • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 0 ζ = 0 := by rw [sub_smul, he, sub_self]
  have := (smul_vermaTensorHwv_eq_zero_iff ratFunc_X_not_root 0 ζ _).1 hz
  simpa only [sub_zero, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] using this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnEquiv_mem_aForm_iff
statement:
theorem columnEquiv_mem_aForm_iff (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ)
    (x : LinearMap.range (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom))) :
    (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ x : Modified R' 𝕧) ∈ aForm R' ↔
      (x : Modified R 𝕧) ∈ aForm R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨u', hu', he⟩ := exists_fePowSpan_leftActOne R' ζ
      (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ x).property hx
    rw [← mapHom_fePowSpan R R' φ] at hu'
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hu'
    have hcol : columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ
        ((leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom)).rangeRestrict u) =
          columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ x := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (columnEquiv_leftActOne R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ u).trans he
    have he' := (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ).injective hcol
    rw [← he']
    exact leftActOne_mem_aForm_of_mem_fePowSpan _ hu
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := exists_fePowSpan_leftActOne R (ζ.comp φ.toHom) x.property hx
    have he' : (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom)).rangeRestrict u = x :=
      Subtype.ext he
    rw [← he']
    change (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ
      ⟨leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u, u, rfl⟩ : Modified R' 𝕧) ∈ _
    rw [columnEquiv_leftActOne]
    apply leftActOne_mem_aForm_of_mem_fePowSpan
    rw [← mapHom_fePowSpan R R' φ]
    exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aColumnEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem aColumnEquiv_apply (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ)
    (x : aColumn R (ζ.comp φ.toHom)) :
    (aColumnEquiv R R' φ ζ x : LinearMap.range (leftActOne R' ratFunc_X_not_root ζ)) =
      columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.mapHom_barHom
statement:
lemma mapHom_barHom (φ : R.Hom R') (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    QuantumGroup.mapHom 𝕧 φ (barHom R u) = barHom R' (QuantumGroup.mapHom 𝕧 φ u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => simp [barHom_algebraMap]
  | E i => simp
  | F i => simp
  | K μ => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy => simp only [_root_.map_mul, hx, hy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_columnEquiv_of_bar_eq
statement:
theorem bar_columnEquiv_of_bar_eq (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ)
    (x : LinearMap.range (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom)))
    (hx : bar R x = x) :
    bar R' (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ x) =
      (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ x : Modified R' 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := x
  rw [bar_leftActOne] at hx
  have he : (⟨leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom) (barHom R u), _, rfl⟩ :
      LinearMap.range (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom))) =
      ⟨leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u, _, rfl⟩ := Subtype.ext hx
  have ht := congrArg (fun y ↦
    (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ y : Modified R' 𝕧)) he
  rw [columnEquiv_leftActOne, columnEquiv_leftActOne, mapHom_barHom] at ht
  rw [columnEquiv_leftActOne, bar_leftActOne]
  exact ht

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_dom_freeCoroot
statement:
lemma exists_dom_freeCoroot (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ Λ : Dom R.freeCoroot, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.freeCoroot.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := R.exists_le_freeCoroot N
  exact ⟨⟨Λ, fun i ↦ le_trans (Int.natCast_nonneg N) (hΛ i)⟩, hΛ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnCanonical_mem_range
statement:
theorem Modified.columnCanonical_mem_range (hR : R.IsXRegular) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ)
    {b b'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'' ∈ LinearMap.range (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root ζ)
proof:
:=
  (columnEquiv R.freeCoroot R ratFunc_X_not_root R.freeCorootHom ζ _).property

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnCanonical_mem_aForm
statement:
theorem Modified.columnCanonical_mem_aForm (hR : R.IsXRegular) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ)
    {b b'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'' ∈ aForm R
proof:
:=
  (columnEquiv_mem_aForm_iff R.freeCoroot R R.freeCorootHom ζ _).2
    (modifiedCanonical_mem_aForm (isXRegular_freeCoroot hR) exists_dom_freeCoroot _ hb hb'')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.bar_columnCanonical
statement:
theorem Modified.bar_columnCanonical (hR : R.IsXRegular) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ)
    {b b'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    bar R (columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'') = columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb''
proof:
:=
  bar_columnEquiv_of_bar_eq R.freeCoroot R R.freeCorootHom ζ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hvn_ratFunc
statement: lemma hvn_ratFunc : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 𝕧 ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun _ hn ↦
  pow_ne_one_of_transcendental transcendental_ratFunc_X hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_monomial
statement: lemma bar_monomial (w : List I) : LusztigF.bar (monomial 𝕂 w) = monomial 𝕂 w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [monomial]
  | cons i w ih =>
    simp only [monomial, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [map_mul, bar_θ, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evKernel_le_comap_bar
statement:
theorem evKernel_le_comap_bar (n : I → ℕ) :
    evKernel D n ≤ (evKernel D n).comap (freeBarSL (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  unfold evKernel
  refine sup_le ((serreSubmodule_le_comap_freeBarSL D).trans
    (Submodule.comap_mono le_sup_left)) ?_
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
  refine Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, ?_⟩)
  change wordBasis 𝕂 I (powWord n g) = LusztigF.bar (wordBasis 𝕂 I (powWord n g))
  rw [← monomial_eq_wordBasis, bar_monomial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ker_ev_eq
statement:
theorem ker_ev_eq :
    LinearMap.ker (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1) = evKernel D (fun i ↦ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ ν, tildeSpan D (fun i ↦ 𝕧 ^ D.d i) (fun i ↦ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) ν ≤
      evKernel D (fun i ↦ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) := fun ν ↦ by
    unfold evKernel
    refine sup_le (fun y hy ↦ Submodule.mem_sup_left ?_) (fun y hy ↦ Submodule.mem_sup_right ?_)
    · rw [mem_serreSubmodule]
      exact serreSpan_le_serreIdeal D (NeZero.ne _) hvn_ratFunc hy
    · refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ hy
      rintro _ ⟨g, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ev_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero,
      VermaModule.toVerma_mem_maxSubmodule_iff hvn_ratFunc hR] at hy
    rw [← sum_weightProj y]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun ν _ ↦ hle ν ?_
    refine (VermaModule.shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff_mem_tildeSpan hvt hR Λ.2
      (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν y)).1 ?_
    rw [shapovalovMap_eq_zero_iff _ (FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν y)]
    intro w
    rw [vermaForm_weightProj, hy w, ite_self]
  · refine sup_le (fun y hy ↦ ?_) ?_
    · exact ev_eq_zero_of_mem (R := R) hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 (mem_serreSubmodule.1 hy)
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, ev_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    refine VermaModule.fPowSubmodule_le_maxSubmodule hR hvn_ratFunc Λ.2
      (VermaModule.toVerma_mem_fPowSubmodule hvn_ratFunc 
        (ν := wordWeight (powWord (fun i ↦ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat) g)) ?_)
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ev_surjective
statement: lemma ev_surjective : Function.Surjective (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1)
proof:
:=

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_ev
statement: theorem hwBar_ev (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) : hwBar hR Λ (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y) = ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 (LusztigF.bar y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((ev R 𝕧 Λ.1).quotKerEquivOfSurjective (ev_surjective Λ)).symm (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk y :=
    (LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 rfl
  simp only [hwBar, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, h, Submodule.mapQ_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_evq
statement: theorem hwBar_evq (x : Um D 𝕧) : hwBar hR Λ (evq hvt Λ x) = evq hvt Λ (negBar D x)
proof:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_hwBar
statement: @[simp] theorem hwBar_hwBar (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) : hwBar hR Λ (hwBar hR Λ m) = m
proof:

  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective Λ m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_smul
statement:
theorem hwBar_smul (c : 𝕂) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_hwv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsNegLaurent.exists_eq_uniformizer_mul
statement:
lemma IsNegLaurent.exists_eq_uniformizer_mul {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsNegLaurent c) :
    ∃ a : A, c = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hc
  have hterm : ∀ n ∈ f.coeff.support,
      integralLaurentEval (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (f.coeff n)) =
        algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * ((f.coeff n : A) * ϖ ^ (-n - 1).toNat)) := by
    intro n hn
    have hn' : n < 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hn (hf n (by omega))
    have hC : integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n)) = (f.coeff n : 𝕂) := by
      simp [integralLaurentEval]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, (-n - 1).toNat = k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hn2 : n = -((k : ℤ) + 1) := by omega
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, _root_.map_mul, hC, integralLaurentEval_T,
      _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_mul, map_pow, InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer,
      map_intCast, hk, hn2, zpow_neg,
      zpow_add_one₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero, zpow_natCast, mul_inv, inv_pow]
    ring
  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, (f.coeff n : A) * ϖ ^ (-n - 1).toNat, ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single f]
  rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.exists_eq_algebraMap
statement: lemma IsIntInv.exists_eq_algebraMap {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) : ∃ a : A, c = algebraMap A 𝕂 a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hc.exists_int_sub
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hn.exists_eq_uniformizer_mul
  exact ⟨n + ϖ * a, by rw [map_add, ← ha, map_intCast, add_sub_cancel]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_ite
statement: lemma isIntInv_ite (p : Prop) [Decidable p] : IsIntInv (if p then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs
  · exact isIntInv_one
  · exact isIntInv_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_mul_mul
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hx, hy⟩ | ⟨hx, hy⟩
  · exact (hx.mul_isIntInv hy).mul_isIntInv hz
  · rw [mul_comm x]
    exact (hy.mul_isIntInv hx).mul_isIntInv hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_finset_sum
statement:
lemma isNegLaurent_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → 𝕂}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, IsNegLaurent (f i)) : IsNegLaurent (∑ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_induction _ IsNegLaurent (fun _ _ ↦ IsNegLaurent.add) isNegLaurent_zero h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_bilinForm
statement:
lemma isNegLaurent_bilinForm {M ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module 𝕂 M]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm 𝕂 M) (e : Module.Basis ι 𝕂 M) (x y : M)
    (h : ∀ g g', IsNegLaurent (e.repr x g * e.repr y g' * B (e g) (e g'))) :
    IsNegLaurent (B x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.BilinForm.sum_repr_mul_repr_mul e x y, Finsupp.sum]
  refine isNegLaurent_finset_sum _ fun g _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  refine isNegLaurent_finset_sum _ fun g' _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  exact h g g'

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx
statement:
lemma tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx (h h' : TensorIdx Λ Λ'') :
    tensorIrrForm hR Λ Λ'' (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h) (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h') =
      formL hvt hR Λ (evq hvt Λ h.1) (evq hvt Λ h'.1) *
        formL hvt hR Λ'' (evq hvt Λ'' h.2) (evq hvt Λ'' h'.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorBasisIdx_apply, tensorBasisIdx_apply]
  erw [tensorBasis_apply, tensorBasis_apply]
  exact TensorModule.form_tmul _ _ _ _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx_sub
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub hR Λ h.1 h'.1
  have h₂ := isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub hR Λ'' h.2 h'.2
  have e : tensorIrrForm hR Λ Λ'' (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h) (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h') -
      (if h = h' then 1 else 0) =
      (formL hvt hR Λ (evq hvt Λ h.1) (evq hvt Λ h'.1) - if h.1 = h'.1 then 1 else 0) *
        formL hvt hR Λ'' (evq hvt Λ'' h.2) (evq hvt Λ'' h'.2) +
      (formL hvt hR Λ'' (evq hvt Λ'' h.2) (evq hvt Λ'' h'.2) - if h.2 = h'.2 then 1 else 0) *
        (if h.1 = h'.1 then 1 else 0) := by
    rw [tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx]
    have : (if h = h' then (1 : 𝕂) else 0) =
        (if h.1 = h'.1 then 1 else 0) * (if h.2 = h'.2 then 1 else 0) := by
      rw [ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, one_mul]
      exact if_congr Prod.ext_iff rfl rfl
    rw [this]
    ring
  rw [e]
  have hq : IsIntInv (formL hvt hR Λ'' (evq hvt Λ'' h.2) (evq hvt Λ'' h'.2)) := by
    have := h₂.isIntInv.add (isIntInv_ite (h.2 = h'.2))
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
  exact (h₁.mul_isIntInv hq).add (h₂.mul_isIntInv (isIntInv_ite _))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx
statement:
lemma isIntInv_tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx (h h' : TensorIdx Λ Λ'') :
    IsIntInv (tensorIrrForm hR Λ Λ'' (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h) (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h'))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := (isNegLaurent_tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx_sub hR Λ Λ'' h h').isIntInv.add
    (isIntInv_ite (h = h'))
  rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical_sub
statement:
lemma isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical_sub (h g : TensorIdx Λ Λ'') :
    IsNegLaurent ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').repr
      (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h - tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h) g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  rcases eq_or_ne g h with rfl | hne
  · rw [repr_tensorCanonical_self, ite_eq_left rfl, sub_self]
    exact isNegLaurent_zero
  · rw [ite_eq_right hne.symm, sub_zero]
    exact isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' hne

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_tensorIrrForm_tensorCanonical_sub
statement:
theorem isNegLaurent_tensorIrrForm_tensorCanonical_sub (h h' : TensorIdx Λ Λ'') :
    IsNegLaurent (tensorIrrForm hR Λ Λ'' (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h)
      (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h') - if h = h' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  set B := tensorIrrForm hR Λ Λ''
  set e := tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ''
  have hsplit : B (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h) (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h') -
      (if h = h' then 1 else 0) = (B (e h) (e h') - if h = h' then 1 else 0) +
        B (e h) (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h' - e h') +
        B (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h - e h) (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h') := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  refine ((isNegLaurent_tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx_sub hR Λ Λ'' h h').add ?_).add ?_
  · refine isNegLaurent_bilinForm B e _ _ fun g g' ↦ isNegLaurent_mul_mul (Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
      (isIntInv_tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' g g')
    · rw [Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
      exact isIntInv_ite _
    · exact isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical_sub hR Λ Λ'' h' g'
  · exact isNegLaurent_bilinForm B e _ _ fun g g' ↦ isNegLaurent_mul_mul
      (Or.inl ⟨isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical_sub hR Λ Λ'' h g,
        isIntInv_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h' g'⟩)
      (isIntInv_tensorIrrForm_tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' g g')

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_leftActOne_leftActOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem Modified.form_leftActOne_leftActOne_of_ne {ζ ζ' : Y →+ ℤ} (hζ : ζ ≠ ζ')
    (u u' : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ u)
      (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ' u') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ u)
      (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ' u') = Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (one ζ)
        (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ' (rho R 𝕧 u * u')) := by
    rw [leftActOne_apply, form_leftAct_left, leftActOne_apply _ ζ' u', ← leftAct_mul]
    rfl
  have hz : one ζ * leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ' (rho R 𝕧 u * u') * one ζ' =
      one ζ * leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ' (rho R 𝕧 u * u') := by
    rw [mul_assoc, leftActOne_mul, one_mul_one_self, ← leftActOne_apply]
  have h2 := form_one_mul_mul_one_eq_zero (R := R) hvn_ratFunc (l₁ := ζ) (l₂ := ζ) (m₁ := ζ)
    (m₂ := ζ') (fun h ↦ hζ (Prod.mk.inj h).2) (one ζ)
    (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ' (rho R 𝕧 u * u'))
  rw [one_mul_one_self, one_mul_one_self, hz, ← form_one_mul, one_mul_one_self] at h2
  rw [h1, h2]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_modifiedCanonical_of_ne
statement:
theorem Modified.form_modifiedCanonical_of_ne {ζ ζ₁ : Y →+ ℤ} (hζ : ζ ≠ ζ₁)
    {b b'' b₁ b₁'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb₁'' : b₁'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'')
      (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ₁ hb₁ hb₁'') = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := modifiedCanonical_mem_range hR hY ζ hb hb''
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ := modifiedCanonical_mem_range hR hY ζ₁ hb₁ hb₁''
  rw [← hu, ← hu₁]
  exact form_leftActOne_leftActOne_of_ne hζ u u₁

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_of_eq
statement:
theorem Modified.form_modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_of_eq (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' b₁ b₁'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb₁'' : b₁'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ a : A, Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'')
        (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb₁ hb₁'') - (if b = b₁ ∧ b'' = b₁'' then 1 else 0) =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := modifiedCanonical_mem_range hR hY ζ hb hb''
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ := modifiedCanonical_mem_range hR hY ζ hb₁ hb₁''
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := IrreducibleModule.tendstoAtInfinity_tensorForm hR hvn_ratFunc
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer ζ u u₁ 1
  set N := max M.toNat (max (max (cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree (cbWt D ⟨b'', hb''⟩).degree)
    (max (cbWt D ⟨b₁, hb₁⟩).degree (cbWt D ⟨b₁'', hb₁''⟩).degree))
  obtain ⟨Λ, Λ'', hζ, hΛ, hΛ''⟩ := exists_dom_pair hY ζ N
  have hΛ₂ : ζ + Λ.1 = Λ''.1 := by rw [← hζ, sub_add_cancel]
  let Λ₂ : Dom R := ⟨ζ + Λ.1, hΛ₂ ▸ Λ''.2⟩
  have hN₂ : ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ₂.1 (R.coroot i) := fun i ↦ by
    change (N : ℤ) ≤ (ζ + Λ.1) (R.coroot i)
    rw [hΛ₂]
    exact hΛ'' i
  have hmem : ∀ {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D) (Λ' : Dom R),
      (cbWt D ⟨x, hx⟩).degree ≤ N → (∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ'.1 (R.coroot i)) →
        x ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ' := fun hx Λ' hxN hΛ' ↦
    mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt Λ' hx fun i ↦ (Int.ofNat_le.2 hxN).trans (hΛ' i)
  have h₁ := hmem hb Λ (by simp [N]) hΛ
  have h₂ := hmem hb'' Λ₂ (by simp [N]) hN₂
  have h₃ := hmem hb₁ Λ (by simp [N]) hΛ
  have h₄ := hmem hb₁'' Λ₂ (by simp [N]) hN₂
  have hζ₂ : Λ₂.1 - Λ.1 = ζ := add_sub_cancel_right _ _
  have key : tensorIrrForm hR Λ Λ₂ (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩))
      (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ (⟨b₁, h₃⟩, ⟨b₁'', h₄⟩)) =
      IrreducibleModule.tensorForm hR hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 (ζ + Λ.1)
        (u • IrreducibleModule.tensorHwv Λ.1 (ζ + Λ.1))
        (u₁ • IrreducibleModule.tensorHwv Λ.1 (ζ + Λ.1)) := by
    rw [← modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'' Λ Λ₂ hζ₂ h₁ h₂,
      ← modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb₁ hb₁'' Λ Λ₂ hζ₂ h₃ h₄, ← hu, ← hu₁,
      modTensorAct_leftActOne Λ Λ₂ hζ₂, modTensorAct_leftActOne Λ Λ₂ hζ₂]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hM Λ.1 fun i ↦ (Int.self_le_toNat M).trans
    ((Int.ofNat_le.2 (le_max_left _ _)).trans (hΛ i))
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (isNegLaurent_tensorIrrForm_tensorCanonical_sub hR Λ Λ₂
    (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩) (⟨b₁, h₃⟩, ⟨b₁'', h₄⟩)).exists_eq_uniformizer_mul
  have hiff : ((⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩) : TensorIdx Λ Λ₂) = (⟨b₁, h₃⟩, ⟨b₁'', h₄⟩) ↔
      b = b₁ ∧ b'' = b₁'' := by
    simp
  rw [pow_one] at ha
  beta_reduce at ha
  refine ⟨c - a, ?_⟩
  rw [← hu, ← hu₁, leftActOne_apply, leftActOne_apply, ← if_congr hiff rfl rfl, mul_sub,
    _root_.map_sub, ← hc, ← ha, ← key, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | contradiction

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_modifiedCanonical_sub_mem
statement:
theorem Modified.form_modifiedCanonical_sub_mem (ζ ζ₁ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' b₁ b₁'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb₁'' : b₁'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ a : A, Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'')
        (modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ₁ hb₁ hb₁'') -
          (if ζ = ζ₁ ∧ b = b₁ ∧ b'' = b₁'' then 1 else 0) = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hζ : ζ = ζ₁
  · subst hζ
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_of_eq hR hY ζ hb hb'' hb₁ hb₁''
    exact ⟨a, by simpa only [true_and] using ha⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hζ, form_modifiedCanonical_of_ne hR hY hζ]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_modifiedCanonicalBasis_sub_mem
statement:
theorem Modified.form_modifiedCanonicalBasis_sub_mem
    (t t' : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ a : A, Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY t)
        (modifiedCanonicalBasis hR hY t') - (if t = t' then 1 else 0) =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ζ, b, b''⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨ζ₁, b₁, b₁''⟩ := t'
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_modifiedCanonical_sub_mem hR hY ζ ζ₁ b.2 b''.2 b₁.2 b₁''.2
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [modifiedCanonicalBasis_apply, modifiedCanonicalBasis_apply, ← ha]
  congr 1
  exact if_congr (by simp [Prod.ext_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]) rfl rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_rho
statement:
lemma mapHom_rho (φ : R.Hom R') (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    mapHom v φ (rho R v u) = rho R' v (mapHom v φ u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => simp
  | E i => simp [rhoE, Kt, Hom.map_ktilde]
  | F i => simp [rhoF, Hom.map_ktilde]
  | K μ => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy => simp only [rho_mul, _root_.map_mul, hx, hy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formFunctional_mapHom
statement:
lemma formFunctional_mapHom (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ) (u : QuantumGroup R v) :
    formFunctional R' v hv ζ (mapHom v φ u) =
      formFunctional R v hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u
proof:
:= by
  have hm (x : LusztigF k I) : mapHom v φ (minusHom R v x) = minusHom R' v x := by
    simpa using mapHom_minus_plus R R' φ x 1
  induction u using induction_rho_minusHom with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | hsmul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]
  | hmon w w' μ =>
    rw [_root_.map_mul (mapHom v φ), _root_.map_mul (mapHom v φ), mapHom_rho, hm, hm, mapHom_K,
      formFunctional_rho_minusHom, formFunctional_rho_minusHom]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_leftActOne_eq_formFunctional
statement:
lemma form_leftActOne_eq_formFunctional (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (u u' : QuantumGroup R v) :
    form R v hv (leftActOne R hv ζ u) (leftActOne R hv ζ u') =
      formFunctional R v hv ζ (rho R v u * u')
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftActOne_apply, leftActOne_apply, form_leftAct_left, ← leftAct_mul]
  exact one_leftAct_one_eq_formFunctional hv (form_leftAct_left hv)
    (form_minusHom_leftAct_one hv) ζ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_columnEquiv
statement:
theorem form_columnEquiv (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ)
    (x y : LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hv (ζ.comp φ.toHom))) :
    form R' v hv (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ x) (columnEquiv R R' hv φ ζ y) =
      form R v hv x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨_, u', rfl⟩ := y
  rw [columnEquiv_leftActOne, columnEquiv_leftActOne,
    form_leftActOne_eq_formFunctional, form_leftActOne_eq_formFunctional,
    ← mapHom_rho, ← _root_.map_mul, formFunctional_mapHom]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_columnCanonical_of_ne
statement:
theorem form_columnCanonical_of_ne {ζ ζ₁ : Y →+ ℤ} (hζ : ζ ≠ ζ₁)
    {b b'' b₁ b₁'' : Um D 𝕧} (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb₁'' : b₁'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'')
      (columnCanonical hR ζ₁ hb₁ hb₁'') = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := columnCanonical_mem_range hR ζ hb hb''
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ := columnCanonical_mem_range hR ζ₁ hb₁ hb₁''
  rw [← hu, ← hu₁]
  exact form_leftActOne_leftActOne_of_ne hζ u u₁

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_columnCanonical_sub_mem
statement:
theorem form_columnCanonical_sub_mem (ζ ζ₁ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' b₁ b₁'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb₁'' : b₁'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ a : A, form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'')
        (columnCanonical hR ζ₁ hb₁ hb₁'') -
          (if ζ = ζ₁ ∧ b = b₁ ∧ b'' = b₁'' then 1 else 0) = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hζ : ζ = ζ₁
  · subst ζ₁
    simp only [columnCanonical, form_columnEquiv, true_and]
    exact form_modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_of_eq (isXRegular_freeCoroot hR)
      exists_dom_freeCoroot (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom) hb hb'' hb₁ hb₁''
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hζ, form_columnCanonical_of_ne hR hζ]⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_columnCanonical_mem
statement:
theorem form_columnCanonical_mem (ζ ζ₁ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' b₁ b₁'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hb₁ : b₁ ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb₁'' : b₁'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ a : A, form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'')
      (columnCanonical hR ζ₁ hb₁ hb₁'') = algebraMap A 𝕂 a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_columnCanonical_sub_mem hR ζ ζ₁ hb hb'' hb₁ hb₁''
  refine ⟨ϖ * a + if ζ = ζ₁ ∧ b = b₁ ∧ b'' = b₁'' then 1 else 0, ?_⟩
  rw [_root_.map_add, ← ha]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.form_columnCanonicalBasis_sub_mem
statement:
theorem form_columnCanonicalBasis_sub_mem
    (t t' : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ a : A, form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc (columnCanonicalBasis hR t)
        (columnCanonicalBasis hR t') - (if t = t' then 1 else 0) =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ζ, b, b''⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨ζ₁, b₁, b₁''⟩ := t'
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_columnCanonical_sub_mem hR ζ ζ₁ b.2 b''.2 b₁.2 b₁''.2
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [columnCanonicalBasis_apply, columnCanonicalBasis_apply, ← ha]
  congr 1
  exact if_congr (by simp [Prod.ext_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]) rfl rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero_of_isXRegular
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero_of_isXRegular (x : Modified R 𝕧)
    (hx : ∀ y, Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set e := columnCanonicalBasis hR
  set c := e.repr x
  set S := c.support
  set F := Modified.form R 𝕧 hvn_ratFunc
  have hirr : Irreducible (ϖ : A) := irreducible_localX
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 ϖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]
    exact inv_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  by_contra hne
  have hS : S.Nonempty :=
    Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.2 fun h ↦ hne (e.repr.map_eq_zero_iff.1 h)
  
  choose m d hd using fun t ↦ InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul (c t)
  set M := S.sup m
  have hd' : ∀ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ M) * c t =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ (M - m t) * d t) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [_root_.map_mul, ← hd, ← mul_assoc, ← _root_.map_mul, ← pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.le_sup ht)]
  have hd0 : ∀ t ∈ S, ϖ ^ (M - m t) * d t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t ht h
    have := hd' t ht
    rw [h, map_zero, mul_eq_zero, map_pow] at this
    rcases this with h1 | h1
    · exact pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0 h1
    · exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 ht h1
  choose! n u hu using fun t (ht : t ∈ S) ↦
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible (hd0 t ht) hirr
  
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image n hS
  set f : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D → A :=
    fun t ↦ (u t : A) * ϖ ^ (n t - n t₀)
  have hc : ∀ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ M) * c t =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ n t₀) * algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hd' t ht, hu t ht, ← _root_.map_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (hmin t ht)]
  set y := ∑ t ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t) • e t
  have hy : algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ n t₀) • y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ M) • x := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← e.linearCombination_repr x, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    rw [Finsupp.sum, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
    rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, hc t ht]
  have hyy : F y y = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z ↦ F z z) hy
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hx, mul_zero] at h
    have h0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ ^ n t₀) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [map_pow]
      exact pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0
    simpa [h0, hϖ0] using h
  
  choose a ha using form_columnCanonicalBasis_sub_mem hR
  have hF : ∀ t t', F (e t) (e t') =
      (if t = t' then 1 else 0) + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a t t') := fun t t' ↦ by
    rw [← ha t t']
    ring
  have hexp : F y y = ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S,
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t) * (algebraMap A 𝕂 (f t') * F (e t') (e t)) := by
    simp only [y, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsum : F y y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (∑ t ∈ S, f t ^ 2 +
      ϖ * ∑ t ∈ S, ∑ t' ∈ S, f t * f t' * a t' t) := by
    rw [hexp, _root_.map_add, map_sum, _root_.map_mul, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum,
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ?_
    simp only [hF, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', ht, ↓reduceIte, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, _root_.map_mul, map_pow]
    congr 1
    · ring
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t' _ ↦ by ring
  
  rw [hyy, eq_comm, ← map_zero (algebraMap A 𝕂)] at hsum
  have hsum' := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(ϖ : A)}))
    (InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap hsum)
  rw [_root_.map_add, _root_.map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2
    (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _), zero_mul, add_zero, map_zero, map_sum] at hsum'
  simp only [map_pow] at hsum'
  have h₀ := eq_zero_of_sum_sq_eq_zero S _ hsum' t₀ ht₀
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h₀
  simp only [f, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one] at h₀
  exact hirr.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_unit h₀ (u t₀).isUnit)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero_of_transcendental_of_isXRegular
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero_of_transcendental_of_isXRegular
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L] {w : L} (hw : Transcendental ℚ w) [NeZero w]

    (eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero_of_isXRegular hR) hw x hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero

theorem eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero (x : Modified R 𝕧)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_form_eq_zero_of_transcendental {L : Type*} [Field L]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_f_pow
statement:
lemma negBar_f_pow (i : I) (k : ℕ) (y : Um D 𝕧) :
    negBar D ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ k) y) = (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ k) (negBar D y)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing y with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ← ih]
    obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ k) y)
    rw [← hY]
    change negBar D (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i (NegativePart.mk Y)) =
      NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i (negBar D (NegativePart.mk Y))
    rw [NegativePart.f_mk]
    erw [negBar_mk, negBar_mk]
    rw [NegativePart.f_mk, map_mul, LusztigF.bar_θ]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_df
statement:
lemma negBar_df (i : I) (k : ℕ) (y : Um D 𝕧) :
    negBar D ((bosv i).df k y) = (bosv i).df k (negBar D y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [BosonModule.df_apply, BosonModule.df_apply, negBar_smul, NegativePart.boson_f,
    negBar_f_pow, qFactorial_inv, map_inv₀, QuantumGroup.bar_qFactorial]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_laurent_smul
statement:
lemma negBar_laurent_smul (c : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    negBar D (c • x) = LaurentPolynomial.invert c • negBar D x
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurent_smul_eq, negBar_smul, bar_integralLaurentEval, laurent_smul_eq]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_mem_negFilt
statement:
lemma negBar_mem_negFilt {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negFilt D i n ν) :
    negBar D x ∈ negFilt D i n ν
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, y, hnk, hk, hy, hyw, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [negBar_df]
    exact df_mem_negFilt D i hnk hk (negBar_mem_negIntegral D hy) (negBar_mem_Uw D hyw)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [negBar_laurent_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_mem_negFilt_succ
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, y, hk1, hk, hy, hyw, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hkν : k ≤ ν i - n := by simpa using hk
    have hw : ν - Finsupp.single i n - Finsupp.single i k = ν - Finsupp.single i (n + k) := by
      ext l
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst hl; simp; omega
      · simp [Ne.symm hl]
    rw [hw] at hyw
    rw [BosonModule.df_df _ (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne 𝕧) i)
      (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) i), qBinomial_inv]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := isLaurent_qBinomial (D.d i) (n + k) n
    rw [← ha, ← laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (df_mem_negFilt D i (by omega) (by omega) hy hyw)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kF_pow_fWi
statement:

proof:
