name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_mem_hwFilt
statement:
lemma hwBar_mem_hwFilt {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hm : m ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν) : hwBar hR Λ m ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  rw [hwBar_evq]
  exact evq_mem_hwFilt Λ (negBar_mem_negFilt D hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwFilt_eq_bot
statement:
lemma hwFilt_eq_bot {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hn : ν i < n) {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hm : m ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν) : m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  have : negFilt D i n ν = ⊥ := by
    rw [negFilt, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
    rintro _ ⟨k, y, hnk, hk, -⟩
    omega
  rw [this, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_bot] at hx
  rw [hx, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fW_replicate_append
statement:
lemma fW_replicate_append (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) (m : ℕ) (w : List I) :
    fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate m i ++ w) = (fK hvt hR Λ i ^ m) (fW hvt hR Λ w)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ← ih]
    rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fW_replicate_append_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa using hw
  | succ m ih => exact kashiwaraF_mem_smul_lat Λ i ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eK_pow_mem_smul_lat
statement:
lemma eK_pow_mem_smul_lat {Λ : Dom R} (i : I) (m : ℕ) {x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}
    (hx : x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ) : (eK hvt hR Λ i ^ m) x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hL : IsCrystalLattice _ (isInt hvt hR Λ) (lat hvt hR A Λ) :=
    isCrystalLattice_lat (hR := hR) InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund Λ
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa using hx
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact LinearMap.map_mem_smul_of_mem ϖ (fun m hm ↦ hL.kashiwaraE_mem i m hm) ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eK_pow_fW_replicate_sub_mem
statement:
lemma eK_pow_fW_replicate_sub_mem (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) (w : List I) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate m i ++ w) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ →
      (eK hvt hR Λ i ^ m) (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate m i ++ w)) - fW hvt hR Λ w ∈
        ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ r, AllProp hvt hR A ϖ r := allProp (hR := hR)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro _; simp
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm
    set w₀ := List.replicate m i ++ w
    have hcons : List.replicate (m + 1) i ++ w = i :: w₀ := rfl
    have hw₀ : fW hvt hR Λ w₀ ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := fun h ↦ hm (by
      rw [hcons, fW_cons]; exact kashiwaraF_mem_smul_lat Λ i h)
    rw [hcons] at hm ⊢
    have hC := (hall (w₀.length + 1)).2.2.1 Λ i w₀ (i :: w₀) rfl rfl hw₀ hm
    have h1 : fW hvt hR Λ w₀ - eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ (i :: w₀)) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
      hC.1 (by rw [fW_cons, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _)
    have h2 := eK_pow_mem_smul_lat hfund i m (neg_mem h1)
    rw [neg_sub, map_sub] at h2
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
    have := add_mem h2 (ih hw₀)
    rwa [sub_add_sub_cancel] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fW_replicate_append_notMem
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ r, AllProp hvt hR A ϖ r := allProp (hR := hR)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 ϖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]; exact inv_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have hA : ∀ d, ∀ s ≤ d, PropA hvt hR A s := fun _ s _ ↦ (hall s).1
  obtain ⟨kk, a, u, hs⟩ := exists_isStr hϖ0 (hA _) (fun s _ ↦ (hall s).2.1)
    (fun s _ ↦ (hall s).2.2.1) Λ i rfl (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ.2 A w)
    (fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w) (w := w) (by rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _) hw
  have hk0 : kk = 0 := by
    by_contra hk
    have h1 := hs.eK_sub (hA _) rfl hϖ0
    simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at h1
    exact hs.dFV_notMem (hA _) rfl hϖ0 (kk - 1) (by omega)
      (by simpa using sub_mem he h1)
  subst hk0
  have hna : n ≤ a := by have := hs.node; omega
  have key : ∀ j ≤ a, IsStr hvt hR ϖ Λ i (wordWeight w + Finsupp.single i j)
      (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate j i ++ w)) j a u := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; simpa using hs
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have := (ih (by omega)).kashiwaraF (by omega)
      rwa [add_assoc, ← Finsupp.single_add] at this
  exact (key n hna).notMem_x (hA _) rfl hϖ0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dvd_of_sum_mem_sup
statement:
lemma dvd_of_sum_mem_sup {Λ : Dom R} (i : I) (n : ℕ) {T ι : Type*} (w : T → List I)
    (u : ι → List I) (f : T → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) (g : ι → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)
    (hw : ∀ c, fW hvt hR Λ (w c) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (he : ∀ c, eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ (w c)) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (hwinj : ∀ c c', fW hvt hR Λ (w c) - fW hvt hR Λ (w c') ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ → c = c')
    (hfn : ∀ c, fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (hf : ∀ c, f c - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (hg : ResidueIndependent A (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ g)
    (hgu : ∀ k, g k - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (t : Finset T) (a : T → A)
    (ht : ∑ c ∈ t, a c • f c ∈
      ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ ⊔ (Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)).restrictScalars A) :
    ∀ c ∈ t, ϖ ∣ a c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hall : ∀ r, AllProp hvt hR A ϖ r := allProp (hR := hR)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund
  have hD : ∀ r, PropD hvt hR A ϖ r := fun r ↦ (hall r).2.2.2.1
  have hϖu : ¬ ϖ ∣ (1 : A) := fun h ↦ irreducible_localX.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_one h)
  have hsl : ∀ {x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}, x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ → x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ :=
    fun hx ↦ Submodule.smul_le_self_of_tower ϖ _ hx
  have hrep : ∀ k, List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k = List.replicate n i ++ i :: u k := fun k ↦ by
    rw [List.replicate_succ', List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
  have hg0 : ∀ k, fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro k hk
    refine hϖu (hg.2 {k} (fun _ ↦ 1) ?_ k (Finset.mem_singleton_self k))
    rw [Finset.sum_singleton, one_smul, ← sub_add_cancel (g k) (fW hvt hR Λ _)]
    exact add_mem (hgu k) hk
  have hgd : ∀ k k', k ≠ k' → fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k) -
      fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k') ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro k k' hne hk
    have h1 := hg.2 {k, k'} (fun j ↦ if j = k then 1 else -1) (by
      simp only [Finset.sum_pair hne, ↓reduceIte, Ne.symm hne, one_smul,
        neg_smul]
      have e : g k + -g k' = (g k - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k)) -
          (g k' - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k')) +
          (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k) -
            fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k')) := by abel
      rw [e]
      exact add_mem (sub_mem (hgu k) (hgu k')) hk) k (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at h1
    exact hϖu h1
  have heK : ∀ m {x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}, x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ →
      (eK hvt hR Λ i ^ m) x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := fun m _ hx ↦ eK_pow_mem_smul_lat hfund i m hx
  
  have H1 : ∀ c c', c ≠ c' → fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c) -
      fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c') ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro c c' hne hc
    refine hne (hwinj c c' ?_)
    have e : fW hvt hR Λ (w c) - fW hvt hR Λ (w c') =
        -((eK hvt hR Λ i ^ n) (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c)) - fW hvt hR Λ (w c)) +
        ((eK hvt hR Λ i ^ n) (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c')) - fW hvt hR Λ (w c')) +
        (eK hvt hR Λ i ^ n) (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c) -
          fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c')) := by rw [map_sub]; abel
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (add_mem (neg_mem (eK_pow_fW_replicate_sub_mem hfund Λ i (w c) n (hfn c)))
      (eK_pow_fW_replicate_sub_mem hfund Λ i (w c') n (hfn c'))) (heK n hc)
  have H3 : ∀ c k, fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c) -
      fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro c k hc
    rw [hrep k] at hc
    have h1 : fW hvt hR Λ (w c) - fW hvt hR Λ (i :: u k) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
      have e : fW hvt hR Λ (w c) - fW hvt hR Λ (i :: u k) =
          -((eK hvt hR Λ i ^ n) (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c)) - fW hvt hR Λ (w c)) +
          ((eK hvt hR Λ i ^ n) (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ i :: u k)) -
            fW hvt hR Λ (i :: u k)) +
          (eK hvt hR Λ i ^ n) (fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c) -
            fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ i :: u k)) := by rw [map_sub]; abel
      rw [e]
      refine add_mem (add_mem (neg_mem (eK_pow_fW_replicate_sub_mem hfund Λ i (w c) n (hfn c)))
        (eK_pow_fW_replicate_sub_mem hfund Λ i (i :: u k) n ?_)) (heK n hc)
      rw [← hrep k]; exact hg0 k
    by_cases hX : fW hvt hR Λ (i :: u k) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
    · refine hw c ?_
      rw [← sub_add_cancel (fW hvt hR Λ (w c)) (fW hvt hR Λ (i :: u k))]
      exact add_mem h1 hX
    · have h2 := eK_pow_fW_replicate_sub_mem hfund Λ i (u k) 1 hX
      rw [pow_one] at h2
      change eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ (i :: u k)) - fW hvt hR Λ (u k) ∈ _ at h2
      have h1' := heK 1 h1
      rw [pow_one, map_sub] at h1'
      have h3 : eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ (i :: u k)) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
        have := sub_mem (he c) h1'
        rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
      have h4 : fW hvt hR Λ (u k) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
        have := sub_mem h3 h2
        rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
      exact hX (kashiwaraF_mem_smul_lat Λ i h4)
  
  intro c₀ hc₀
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 ht
  have hfL : ∀ c, f c ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := fun c ↦ by
    rw [← sub_add_cancel (f c) (fW hvt hR Λ _)]
    exact add_mem (hsl (hf c)) (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ.2 A _)
  have hzL : z ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    have : z = ∑ c ∈ t, a c • f c - y := by rw [← hyz]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact sub_mem (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hfL c)) (hsl hy)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1
    ((Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).1 hz)
  have hd' : ∑ k ∈ d.support, d k • g k ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := by rw [← hd] at hzL; exact hzL
  have hb := hg.exists_eq_of_sum_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    (show ϖ ≠ 0 from irreducible_localX.ne_zero) InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul d.support d hd'
  choose! b hb using hb
  have hzb : z = ∑ k ∈ d.support, b k • g k := by
    rw [← hd]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by simp only [hb k hk, algebraMap_smul]
  let wd : T ⊕ ι → List I :=
    Sum.elim (fun c ↦ List.replicate n i ++ w c) (fun k ↦ List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k)
  have hdist : ∀ x₁ ∈ t.disjSum d.support, ∀ x₂ ∈ t.disjSum d.support, x₁ ≠ x₂ →
      fW hvt hR Λ (wd x₁) - fW hvt hR Λ (wd x₂) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    rintro (c | k) - (c' | k') - hne
    · exact H1 c c' fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
    · exact H3 c k'
    · intro h
      exact H3 c' k (by rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem h)
    · exact hgd k k' fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
  have hsum : ∑ x ∈ t.disjSum d.support, Sum.elim a (fun k ↦ -b k) x • fW hvt hR Λ (wd x) ∈
      ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    rw [Finset.sum_disjSum]
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, wd, neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    have e : ∑ c ∈ t, a c • fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c) -
        ∑ k ∈ d.support, b k • fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k) =
        (∑ c ∈ t, a c • f c - z) - ∑ c ∈ t, a c • (f c - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ w c))
          + ∑ k ∈ d.support, b k • (g k - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k)) := by
      simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hzb]
      abel
    rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, e, ← hyz, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact add_mem (sub_mem hy (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hf c)))
      (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hgu k))
  have := coeff_mem_of_sum_mem hD Λ (t.disjSum d.support) wd
    (fun x₁ h₁ x₂ h₂ he ↦ by
      by_contra hne
      exact hdist x₁ h₁ x₂ h₂ hne (by rw [he, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _))
    (by
      rintro (c | k) -
      · exact hfn c
      · exact hg0 k)
    hdist _ hsum (Sum.inl c₀) (Finset.inl_mem_disjSum.2 hc₀)
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.dvd_of_sum_mem_sup_bar
statement:
lemma dvd_of_sum_mem_sup_bar {Λ : Dom R} {T ι : Type*} (f : T → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)
    (g : ι → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)
    (hfb : ∀ c, hwBar hR Λ (f c) - f c ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g))
    (hgb : ∀ k, hwBar hR Λ (g k) ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g))
    (h₀ : ∀ (t : Finset T) (a : T → A), ∑ c ∈ t, a c • f c ∈
      ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ ⊔ (Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)).restrictScalars A →
      ∀ c ∈ t, ϖ ∣ a c)
    (t : Finset T) (a : T → LocalRing) (ht : ∑ c ∈ t, a c • f c ∈
      localX • latBar hR Λ ⊔ (Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)).restrictScalars LocalRing) :
    ∀ c ∈ t, localX ∣ a c
proof:
:= by
  have hW : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g),
      hwBar hR Λ x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g) := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hgb k
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [hwBar_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 ht
  refine h₀ t (fun c ↦ show A from a c) ?_
  have e : ∑ c ∈ t, (show A from a c) • f c = hwBar hR Λ y + hwBar hR Λ z -
      ∑ c ∈ t, (show A from a c) • (hwBar hR Λ (f c) - f c) := by
    rw [← map_add, hyz, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hwBar_local_smul, smul_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
  rw [e]
  refine sub_mem (add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left ((mem_localX_smul_latBar_iff hR Λ y).1 hy))
    (Submodule.mem_sup_right ((Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2
      (hW z ((Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).1 hz)))))
    (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ ↦ Submodule.mem_sup_right ?_)
  exact (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2 (Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (hfb c))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kE_negLift_mem
statement:
lemma kE_negLift_mem {μ : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D μ) (i : I)
    (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = μ})
    (hw : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w.1) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    kE hvt i (negLift h w) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  rw [← sub_add_cancel (negLift h w) (fWi hvt w.1), map_add]
  exact add_mem (kashiwaraE_mem_smul_latInf (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum i (negLift_sub_mem h w)) hw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwFiltGlobalAt_of_lt
statement:
lemma hwFiltGlobalAt_of_lt (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hn : ν i < n) :
    HwFiltGlobalAt hR Λ i n ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨PEmpty.{u + 1}, PEmpty.elim, PEmpty.elim, fun k ↦ k.elim,
    ⟨fun k ↦ k.elim, fun _ _ _ k ↦ k.elim⟩, ⟨fun k ↦ k.elim, fun _ _ _ k ↦ k.elim⟩,
    fun x hx ↦ ?_, fun k ↦ k.elim, fun k ↦ k.elim⟩
  rw [hwFilt_eq_bot Λ hn hx]
  exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwFiltGlobalAt_of_neg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, hgF, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, hgu, hgw⟩ := h
  have e : ∀ k, List.replicate n i ++ i :: u k = List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k := fun k ↦ by
    rw [List.replicate_succ', List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
  refine ⟨ι, g, fun k ↦ i :: u k, fun k ↦ hwFilt_antitone Λ i (Nat.le_succ n) ν (hgF k), hg₀,
    hg₁, fun x hx ↦ hspan x (hwFilt_le_succ hR Λ i hneg hx), fun k ↦ ?_, fun k ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [e]; exact hgu k
  · rw [e]; exact hgw k

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwFiltGlobalAt_step
statement:
theorem hwFiltGlobalAt_step {Λ : Dom R} {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hn : n ≤ ν i)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i) + n)
    (h : NegGlobalAt D (ν - Finsupp.single i n))
    (hvan : ∀ w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν - Finsupp.single i n},
      fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ → evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) = 0)
    (hG3 : ∀ w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν - Finsupp.single i n},
      kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w.1) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A →
        negLift h w ∈ negFilt D i 1 (ν - Finsupp.single i n))
    (hP : HwFiltGlobalAt hR Λ i (n + 1) ν) : HwFiltGlobalAt hR Λ i n ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set μ := ν - Finsupp.single i n with hμ
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, hgF, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, hgu, hgw⟩ := hP
  set N := Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g) with hN
  have hNF : ∀ x ∈ hwFilt Λ i (n + 1) ν, x ∈ N := hspan
  have hFN : ∀ x ∈ N, x ∈ hwFilt Λ i (n + 1) ν := fun x hx ↦
    (Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hgF)) hx
  have hNK : ∀ x ∈ N, x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g) := fun x hx ↦
    mem_span_field_of_mem_span_laurent (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ) hx
  have hsl : ∀ {x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1}, x ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ → x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ :=
    fun hx ↦ Submodule.smul_le_self_of_tower ϖ _ hx
  
  let T := {c : hwCrystal hR Λ μ //
    kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out c).1) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A}
  let w : T → {w : List I // wordWeight w = μ} := fun c ↦
    ⟨(Quotient.out c.1).1, (Quotient.out c.1).2.1⟩
  let G : T → Um D 𝕧 := fun c ↦ negLift h (w c)
  let fc : T → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1 := fun c ↦ evq hvt Λ ((bosv i).df n (G c))
  let f' : T → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1 := fun c ↦
    evq hvt Λ ((bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 (G c)))
  have hGZ : ∀ c, G c ∈ negIntegral D := fun c ↦ (negLift_mem h (w c)).1
  have hGw : ∀ c, G c ∈ Uw D 𝕧 μ := fun c ↦ (negLift_mem h (w c)).2.1
  have hcZ : ∀ c, comp hvt i 0 (G c) ∈ negIntegral D := fun c ↦
    negative_component_mem_integral D i (hGZ c) 0
  have hcw : ∀ c, comp hvt i 0 (G c) ∈ Uw D 𝕧 μ := fun c ↦ by
    simpa using @component_mem_Uw _ _ _ _ D _ _ _ transcendental_ratFunc_X i _ (G c) (hGw c) 0
  have hf'F : ∀ c, f' c ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν := fun c ↦
    evq_mem_hwFilt Λ (df_mem_negFilt D i le_rfl hn (hcZ c) (hcw c))
  
  have hfcF : ∀ c, fc c - f' c ∈ hwFilt Λ i (n + 1) ν := fun c ↦ by
    rw [← map_sub]
    exact evq_mem_hwFilt Λ (df_sub_df_comp_mem_negFilt D i hn (hGZ c) (hGw c))
  
  have hf'sub : ∀ c, f' c - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1) ∈
      ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro c
    have h1 := df_comp_sub_kF_pow_mem D i n (kE_negLift_mem h i (w c) c.2)
    have h2 := kF_pow_mem_smul_latInf D i n (negLift_sub_mem h (w c))
    rw [map_sub, kF_pow_fWi] at h2
    have h3 : evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1)) -
        fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
      evq_fWord_sub_fW_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
        InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
        InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund _ Λ
    have e : f' c - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1) =
        evq hvt Λ ((bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 (G c)) - (kF hvt i ^ n) (G c)) +
        evq hvt Λ ((kF hvt i ^ n) (G c) - fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1)) +
        (evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1)) -
          fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1)) := by
      simp only [map_sub, f']; abel
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (add_mem (evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund h1 Λ) (evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund h2 Λ)) h3
  have hf'L : ∀ c, f' c ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ := fun c ↦ by
    rw [← sub_add_cancel (f' c) (fW hvt hR Λ _)]
    exact add_mem (hsl (hf'sub c)) (IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR _ Λ.2 A _)
  
  have hfcbar : ∀ c, hwBar hR Λ (fc c) = fc c := fun c ↦ by
    change hwBar hR Λ (evq hvt Λ ((bosv i).df n (negLift h (w c)))) = _
    rw [hwBar_evq, negBar_df, negBar_eq_of_mem h (negLift_mem h (w c))]
  have hf'bar : ∀ c, hwBar hR Λ (f' c) - f' c ∈ hwFilt Λ i (n + 1) ν := fun c ↦ by
    have e : hwBar hR Λ (f' c) - f' c = (fc c - f' c) - hwBar hR Λ (fc c - f' c) := by
      rw [map_sub, hfcbar]; abel
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem (hfcF c) (hwBar_mem_hwFilt hR Λ (hfcF c))
  
  have hwc0 : ∀ c, fW hvt hR Λ (w c).1 ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := fun c ↦ (Quotient.out c.1).2.2
  have hwce : ∀ c, eK hvt hR Λ i (fW hvt hR Λ (w c).1) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := fun c ↦ by
    have h1 := evq_kE_fWi_sub_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund i (hwc0 c)
    have h2 : evq hvt Λ (kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt (w c).1)) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
      evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund c.2 Λ
    have := sub_mem h2 h1
    rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
  have hμν : μ + Finsupp.single i n = ν := sub_single_add_single hn
  have hbound : (n : ℤ) ≤ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum μ) (R.coroot i) := by
    have e : (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i) =
        (Λ.1 - R.rootSum μ) (R.coroot i) - 2 * n := by
      rw [← hμν, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single]
      simp [R.root_coroot, D.cartanMatrix_self]
      ring
    omega
  have hwcn : ∀ c, fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1) ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
    fun c ↦ fW_replicate_append_notMem hfund Λ i (hwc0 c) (hwce c) (by rw [(w c).2]; exact hbound)
  have hwinj : ∀ c c', fW hvt hR Λ (w c).1 - fW hvt hR Λ (w c').1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ →
      c = c' := by
    intro c c' hcc
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [← Quotient.out_eq c.1, ← Quotient.out_eq c'.1]
    exact Quotient.sound hcc
  have hr₀ := dvd_of_sum_mem_sup hfund i n (fun c ↦ (w c).1) u f' g hwc0 hwce hwinj hwcn hf'sub
    hg₀ hgu
  have hr₁ := dvd_of_sum_mem_sup_bar f' g (fun c ↦ hNK _ (hNF _ (hf'bar c)))
    (fun k ↦ hNK _ (hNF _ (hwBar_mem_hwFilt hR Λ (hgF k)))) hr₀
  
  have hf₀ : ∀ c, ∃ l ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ, f' c - l ∈ N := fun c ↦
    ⟨f' c, hf'L c, by rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩
  have hf₁ : ∀ c, ∃ l ∈ latBar hR Λ, f' c - l ∈ N := fun c ↦
    ⟨hwBar hR Λ (f' c), (mem_latBar_iff hR Λ _).2 (by rw [hwBar_hwBar]; exact hf'L c),
      by rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem (hNF _ (hf'bar c))⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hyN, hy₀, hy₁⟩ := exists_residueIndependent_extension (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ) hg₀ hg₁
    f' hf₀ hf₁ hr₀ hr₁
  
  have hz : ∀ c, ∃ z ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g), (y c - f' c) - z ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
    fun c ↦ exists_int_sub_mem_of_mem_span (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ) hg₀ (hyN c)
      (sub_mem (hy₀.1 (Sum.inr c)) (hf'L c))
  choose z hzZ hzsub using hz
  have hZ : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g),
      x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ ∧ x ∈ latBar hR Λ ∧ x ∈ N := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hx; exact ⟨hg₀.1 k, hg₁.1 k, Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩
    | add x x' _ _ hx hx' =>
      exact ⟨add_mem hx.1 hx'.1, add_mem hx.2.1 hx'.2.1, add_mem hx.2.2 hx'.2.2⟩
    | smul m x _ hx => exact ⟨zsmul_mem hx.1 m, zsmul_mem hx.2.1 m, zsmul_mem hx.2.2 m⟩
  let y' : T → IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1 := fun c ↦ y c - z c
  have hy'f : ∀ c, y' c - f' c ∈ N := fun c ↦ by
    have e : y' c - f' c = (y c - f' c) - z c := by simp only [y']; abel
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem (hyN c) (hZ _ (hzZ c)).2.2
  have hr₀' : ResidueIndependent A (lat hvt hR A Λ) ϖ (Sum.elim g y') :=
    hg₀.sumElim ((Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)).restrictScalars A)
      (fun k ↦ (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self k)))
      (fun c ↦ sub_mem (hy₀.1 (Sum.inr c)) (hZ _ (hzZ c)).1)
      (residueIndependent_mod_of_sub_mem _
        (fun c ↦ (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2 (hNK _ (hy'f c))) hr₀)
  have hr₁' : ResidueIndependent LocalRing (latBar hR Λ) localX (Sum.elim g y') :=
    hg₁.sumElim ((Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range g)).restrictScalars LocalRing)
      (fun k ↦ (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self k)))
      (fun c ↦ sub_mem (hy₁.1 (Sum.inr c)) (hZ _ (hzZ c)).2.1)
      (residueIndependent_mod_of_sub_mem _
        (fun c ↦ (Submodule.restrictScalars_mem _ _ _).2 (hNK _ (hy'f c))) hr₁)
  refine ⟨ι ⊕ T, Sum.elim g y', Sum.elim (fun k ↦ i :: u k) (fun c ↦ (w c).1), ?_, hr₀', hr₁',
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro (k | c)
    · exact hwFilt_antitone Λ i (Nat.le_succ n) ν (hgF k)
    · change y' c ∈ _
      rw [← sub_add_cancel (y' c) (f' c)]
      exact add_mem (hwFilt_antitone Λ i (Nat.le_succ n) ν (hFN _ (hy'f c))) (hf'F c)
  · 
    set S' := Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (Sum.elim g y'))
    have hgS : ∀ x ∈ N, x ∈ S' := fun x hx ↦ Submodule.span_mono (by
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨Sum.inl k, rfl⟩) hx
    have hfcS : ∀ c, fc c ∈ S' := fun c ↦ by
      have e : fc c = (fc c - f' c) - (y' c - f' c) + y' c := by abel
      rw [e]
      exact add_mem (sub_mem (hgS _ (hNF _ (hfcF c))) (hgS _ (hy'f c)))
        (Submodule.subset_span ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩)
    have hGS : ∀ w' : {w : List I // wordWeight w = μ},
        evq hvt Λ ((bosv i).df n (negLift h w')) ∈ S' := by
      intro w'
      by_cases hw0 : fW hvt hR Λ w'.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
      · rw [evq_df (hR := hR), hvan w' hw0, map_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
      let b : hwCrystal hR Λ μ := ⟦⟨w'.1, w'.2, hw0⟩⟧
      have hrel : fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out b).1 - fW hvt hR Λ w'.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ :=
        Quotient.mk_out (s := hwCrystalSetoid hR Λ μ) ⟨w'.1, w'.2, hw0⟩
      have hi := fWi_sub_mem_of_fW_sub_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
        InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
        InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund _ w'.1 (Quotient.out b).1 rfl hw0
        (by rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem hrel)
      rw [negLift_eq_of_sub_mem h (w' := ⟨(Quotient.out b).1, (Quotient.out b).2.1⟩) hi]
      by_cases hb : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
      · exact hfcS ⟨b, hb⟩
      · exact hgS _ (hNF _ (evq_mem_hwFilt Λ (df_mem_negFilt_succ D i hn (hG3 _ hb))))
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨k, y₀, hnk, hk, hy₀Z, hy₀w, rfl⟩ := hx
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n k with hlt | hle
      · exact hgS _ (hNF _ (evq_mem_hwFilt Λ (df_mem_negFilt D i hlt hk hy₀Z hy₀w)))
      have hkn : k = n := le_antisymm hle hnk
      rw [hkn] at hy₀w ⊢
      have hsp := mem_span_negLift h hy₀Z hy₀w
      clear hy₀Z hy₀w
      induction hsp using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem z hz => obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hz; exact hGS w'
      | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add a a' _ _ ha ha' => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ha ha'
      | smul c a _ ha =>
        rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, map_smul, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add a a' _ _ ha ha' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha ha'
    | smul c a _ ha =>
      rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha
  · rintro (k | c)
    · change g k - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ i :: u k) ∈ _
      have e : List.replicate n i ++ i :: u k = List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u k := by
        rw [List.replicate_succ', List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
      rw [e]
      exact hgu k
    · change y c - z c - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1) ∈ _
      have e : y c - z c - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1) =
          ((y c - f' c) - z c) + (f' c - fW hvt hR Λ (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1)) := by abel
      rw [e]
      exact add_mem (hzsub c) (hf'sub c)
  · rintro (k | c)
    · change wordWeight (List.replicate n i ++ i :: u k) = ν
      rw [← List.singleton_append, ← List.append_assoc, ← List.replicate_succ']
      exact hgw k
    · change wordWeight (List.replicate n i ++ (w c).1) = ν
      rw [LusztigF.wordWeight_append, GrandLoop.wordWeight_replicate, (w c).2, ← hμν, add_comm]
      simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwFiltGlobalAt
statement:
theorem hwFiltGlobalAt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (Λ : Dom R) (i : I) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) : HwFiltGlobalAt hR Λ i n ν
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ t n, 1 ≤ n → ν i < n + t → HwFiltGlobalAt hR Λ i n ν from
    H (ν i + 1) n hn (by omega)
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro n _ h; exact hwFiltGlobalAt_of_lt hR Λ i (by simpa using h)
  | succ t ih =>
    intro n hn ht
    by_cases hlt : ν i < n
    · exact hwFiltGlobalAt_of_lt hR Λ i hlt
    have hP := ih (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    by_cases hneg : (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (R.coroot i) + n < 0
    · exact hwFiltGlobalAt_of_neg hR hneg hP
    obtain ⟨h, hvan, hG3⟩ := hIH (ν - Finsupp.single i n) tsub_le_self (by
      intro e
      have := congrArg (fun μ : I →₀ ℕ ↦ μ i) e
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this
      omega)
    exact hwFiltGlobalAt_step hR hfund (by omega) (by omega) h (hvan Λ) (hG3 i) hP

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwFilt_eq_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, -, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, -, -⟩ := hwFiltGlobalAt hR hfund hIH Λ i hn
  exact balanced_eq_zero_of_mem_span (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ) hg₀ hg₁ (hspan x hx) hxϖ hx₁

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_hwFilt_sub_mem
statement:
theorem exists_hwFilt_sub_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (Λ : Dom R) (i : I)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hx : x ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν)
    (hx₀ : x ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ) :
    ∃ y ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν, y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ ∧ y ∈ latBar hR Λ ∧
      x - y ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, hgF, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, -, -⟩ := hwFiltGlobalAt hR hfund hIH Λ i hn
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_int_sub_mem_of_mem_span (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ) hg₀
    (hspan x hx) hx₀
  have key : ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g),
      y ∈ hwFilt Λ i n ν ∧ y ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ ∧ y ∈ latBar hR Λ := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy => obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hy; exact ⟨hgF k, hg₀.1 k, hg₁.1 k⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩
    | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => exact ⟨add_mem hy.1 hy'.1, add_mem hy.2.1 hy'.2.1,
        add_mem hy.2.2 hy'.2.2⟩
    | smul m y _ hy => exact ⟨zsmul_mem hy.1 m, zsmul_mem hy.2.1 m, zsmul_mem hy.2.2 m⟩
  exact ⟨y, (key y hy).1, (key y hy).2.1, (key y hy).2.2, hxy⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sub_rootSum_neg_ktilde
statement:
lemma sub_rootSum_neg_ktilde (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) :
    (Λ'.1 - R'.rootSum ν) (-ktilde R' i) = (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) (-ktilde R i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_neg, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, ktilde, map_nsmul, h, rootSum_coroot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.ker_ev_eq_ker_ev
statement: lemma ker_ev_eq_ker_ev : LinearMap.ker (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1) = LinearMap.ker (ev R' 𝕧 Λ'.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_ev_eq hR Λ, ker_ev_eq hR' Λ']
  simp only [h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwTransfer_ev
statement:
lemma hwTransfer_ev (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    hwTransfer hR hR' h (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y) = ev R' 𝕧 Λ'.1 y
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ((ev R 𝕧 Λ.1).quotKerEquivOfSurjective (ev_surjective Λ)).symm (ev R 𝕧 Λ.1 y) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk y :=
    (LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 rfl
  simp only [hwTransfer, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, h₁, Submodule.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwTransfer_evq
statement:
lemma hwTransfer_evq (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    hwTransfer hR hR' h (evq hvt Λ x) = evq hvt Λ' x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [evq_mk, evq_mk, hwTransfer_ev]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwTransfer_hwv
statement:
lemma hwTransfer_hwv :
    hwTransfer hR hR' h (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = IrreducibleModule.hwv R' 𝕧 Λ'.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ev_one, hwTransfer_ev, ev_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwTransfer_F
statement:
lemma hwTransfer_F (i : I) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwTransfer hR hR' h (F R 𝕧 i • m) = F R' 𝕧 i • hwTransfer hR hR' h m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective Λ m
  rw [← ev_ι_mul, hwTransfer_ev, hwTransfer_ev, ev_ι_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwTransfer_K
statement:
lemma hwTransfer_K (i : I) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwTransfer hR hR' h (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • m) =
      K R' 𝕧 (-ktilde R' i) • hwTransfer hR hR' h m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective Λ m
  rw [← sum_weightProj y]
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  have hy := FreeAlgebra.weightProj_mem ν y
  rw [ev_mem_weightSpace hvn_ratFunc hR Λ.1 hy (-ktilde R i), map_smul, hwTransfer_ev,
    ev_mem_weightSpace hvn_ratFunc hR' Λ'.1 hy (-ktilde R' i), sub_rootSum_neg_ktilde h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransfer_mk
statement:
lemma tensorTransfer_mk (x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1) (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) :
    tensorTransfer hR hR' h₁ h₂ (TensorModule.mk _ _ (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y)) =
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (hwTransfer hR hR' h₁ x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] hwTransfer hR hR' h₂ y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransfer_F
statement:
lemma tensorTransfer_F (i : I)
    (z : TensorModule 𝕂 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1)) :
    tensorTransfer hR hR' h₁ h₂ (F R 𝕧 i • z) = F R' 𝕧 i • tensorTransfer hR hR' h₁ h₂ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (TensorModule.mk _ _).surjective z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, tensorTransfer_mk, TensorModule.F_smul_tmul]
    simp only [map_add, tensorTransfer_mk, hwTransfer_F, hwTransfer_K]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, smul_add, ha, hb]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransfer_tensorEmb_ev
statement:
theorem tensorTransfer_tensorEmb_ev (y : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    tensorTransfer hR hR' h₁ h₂ (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (ev R 𝕧 (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1 y)) =
      tensorEmb hvt hR' Λ₁'.2 Λ₂'.2 (ev R' 𝕧 (Λ₁' + Λ₂').1 y)
proof:
:= by
  let P : LusztigF 𝕂 I → Prop := fun y ↦
    tensorTransfer hR hR' h₁ h₂ (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (ev R 𝕧 (Λ₁ + Λ₂).1 y)) =
      tensorEmb hvt hR' Λ₁'.2 Λ₂'.2 (ev R' 𝕧 (Λ₁' + Λ₂').1 y)
  have hP1 : P 1 := by
    simp only [P, ev_one]
    erw [tensorEmb_hwv, tensorEmb_hwv]
    rw [tensorTransfer_mk, hwTransfer_hwv, hwTransfer_hwv]
  have hPadd : ∀ a b, P a → P b → P (a + b) := fun a b ha hb ↦ by
    simp only [P, map_add] at ha hb ⊢
    rw [ha, hb]
  have hPsmul : ∀ (c : 𝕂) a, P a → P (c • a) := fun c a ha ↦ by
    simp only [P, map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower] at ha ⊢
    rw [ha]
  have hPι : ∀ j a, P a → P (FreeAlgebra.ι 𝕂 j * a) := fun j a ha ↦ by
    simp only [P, ev_ι_mul, map_smul] at ha ⊢
    rw [tensorTransfer_F, ha]
  have key : ∀ a z, P z → P (a * z) := by
    intro a
    induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
    | grade0 c =>
      intro z hz
      rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
      exact hPsmul c z hz
    | grade1 j => exact hPι j
    | mul a b ha hb => intro z hz; rw [mul_assoc]; exact ha _ (hb z hz)
    | add a b ha hb => intro z hz; rw [add_mul]; exact hPadd _ _ (ha z hz) (hb z hz)
  have := key y 1 hP1
  rw [mul_one] at this
  exact this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasisHW_eq
proof:
:= by

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorTransfer
statement:
theorem repr_tensorTransfer
    (z : TensorModule 𝕂 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1))
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    (tensorHWBasis hR' Λ₁' Λ₂').repr (tensorTransfer hR hR' h₁ h₂ z) (tensorIdxEquiv h₁ h₂ p) =
      (tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr z p
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ((tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).map (tensorTransfer hR hR' h₁ h₂)).reindex
      (tensorIdxEquiv h₁ h₂) = tensorHWBasis hR' Λ₁' Λ₂' :=
    Module.Basis.eq_of_apply_eq fun q ↦ by
      rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.map_apply, tensorHWBasis_apply,
        tensorHWBasis_apply, tensorTransfer_mk, hwTransfer_evq, hwTransfer_evq]
      rfl
  rw [← hb, Module.Basis.repr_reindex_apply, Module.Basis.map_repr, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isXRegular_freeCoroot
statement: lemma isXRegular_freeCoroot : R.freeCoroot.IsXRegular
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (compFst I (Y := Y)) = ⊥ := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro f hf
    ext y
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf (y, 0)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_fund_freeCoroot
statement:
lemma exists_fund_freeCoroot (j : I) :
    ∃ Λ : Dom R.freeCoroot, ∀ i, Λ.1 (R.freeCoroot.coroot i) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨⟨(Finsupp.applyAddHom j).comp (AddMonoidHom.snd _ _), fun i ↦ ?_⟩, fun i ↦ ?_⟩ <;>
  · simp only [LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.freeCoroot, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp,
      Function.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_snd, Finsupp.applyAddHom_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply] <;> split_ifs <;> simp

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_repr_tensorEmb_evq
statement:
theorem isIntInv_repr_tensorEmb_evq {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    IsIntInv ((tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr
      (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (evq hvt (Λ₁ + Λ₂) x)) p)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := domFreeCoroot_coroot Λ₁
  have h₂ := domFreeCoroot_coroot Λ₂
  have hR₁ := isXRegular_freeCoroot hR
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  have := isIntInv_repr_tensorEmb_evq_of_fund hR₁ exists_fund_freeCoroot
    (domFreeCoroot Λ₁) (domFreeCoroot Λ₂) hx (tensorIdxEquiv h₁ h₂ p)
  rw [evq_mk] at this ⊢
  rwa [← tensorTransfer_tensorEmb_ev hR hR₁ h₁ h₂, repr_tensorTransfer] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.X_smul_mem₁
statement:
lemma X_smul_mem₁ [Module LocalRing V] [IsScalarTower LocalRing 𝕂 V]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.zpow_smul_mem_laurent
statement:
lemma zpow_smul_mem_laurent {M : Submodule (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) V} (z : ℤ) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ M) : (𝕧 ^ z : 𝕂) • x ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  have := M.smul_mem (LaurentPolynomial.T z) hx
  rwa [hsmul, integralLaurentEval_T] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_balanced_approx
statement:
lemma exists_balanced_approx (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ M) (hg₁ : ∀ i, g i ∈ L₁)
    (hsurj : ∀ x ∈ M, x ∈ L₀ →
      ∃ y ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g), x - y ∈ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • L₀)
    (n : ℕ) {x : V} (hxM : x ∈ M) (hx₀ : x ∈ L₀) :
    ∃ y r : V, y ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g) ∧
      (∃ l ∈ L₁, (𝕧 ^ n : 𝕂) • y = (𝕧 : 𝕂) • l) ∧ r ∈ M ∧ r ∈ L₀ ∧
      x = y + (𝕧⁻¹ ^ n : 𝕂) • r
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, x, zero_mem _, ⟨0, zero_mem _, by simp⟩, hxM, hx₀, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, r, hy, ⟨l, hl, hyl⟩, hrM, hr₀, rfl⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e, he, hre⟩ := hsurj r hrM hr₀
    obtain ⟨r', hr', hrr'⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hre
    rw [uniformizer_smul_eq] at hrr'
    have heZ : e ∈ (Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)).restrictScalars ℤ :=
      Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars ℤ (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) _ he
    have heL : e ∈ L₁.restrictScalars ℤ :=
      (Submodule.span_le (p := L₁.restrictScalars ℤ)).2
        (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hg₁ i) he
    have heM : e ∈ M.restrictScalars ℤ :=
      (Submodule.span_le (p := M.restrictScalars ℤ)).2 (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hg i) he
    have hr'eq : r' = (𝕧 : 𝕂) • (r - e) := by
      rw [← hrr', smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero, one_smul]
    refine ⟨y + (𝕧⁻¹ ^ n : 𝕂) • e, r', add_mem hy ?_, ⟨(𝕧 : 𝕂) • l + e, add_mem
      (X_smul_mem₁ hl) heL, ?_⟩, ?_, hr', ?_⟩
    · rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg_one, ← zpow_mul]
      exact zpow_smul_mem_laurent hsmul _ heZ
    · have h1 : (𝕧 ^ (n + 1) : 𝕂) • ((𝕧⁻¹ ^ n : 𝕂) • e) = (𝕧 : 𝕂) • e := by
        rw [smul_smul, pow_succ', mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero,
          one_pow, mul_one]
      have h2 : (𝕧 ^ (n + 1) : 𝕂) • y = (𝕧 : 𝕂) • ((𝕧 : 𝕂) • l) := by
        rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, hyl]
      rw [smul_add, h1, h2, smul_add]
    · rw [hr'eq]
      have := zpow_smul_mem_laurent hsmul 1 (sub_mem hrM heM)
      rwa [zpow_one] at this
    · rw [pow_succ, mul_smul, hrr', smul_sub]
      abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_of_balanced
statement:
theorem span_of_balanced (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ M) (hg₁ : ∀ i, g i ∈ L₁)
    (hsurj : ∀ x ∈ M, x ∈ L₀ →
      ∃ y ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g), x - y ∈ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • L₀)
    (hinj : ∀ x ∈ M, x ∈ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • L₀ → x ∈ L₁ → x = 0)
    (hfull₀ : ∀ x ∈ M, ∃ N : ℕ, (𝕧⁻¹ ^ N : 𝕂) • x ∈ L₀)
    (hfull₁ : ∀ x ∈ M, ∃ N : ℕ, (𝕧 ^ N : 𝕂) • x ∈ L₁) :
    M ≤ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hfull₀ x hx
  set x₀ := (𝕧⁻¹ ^ N : 𝕂) • x with hx₀
  clear_value x₀
  have hx₀M : x₀ ∈ M := by
    have := zpow_smul_mem_laurent hsmul (-(N : ℤ)) hx
    rwa [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← inv_pow, ← hx₀] at this
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hfull₁ x₀ hx₀M
  obtain ⟨y, r, hy, ⟨l, hl, hyl⟩, hrM, hr₀, hxy⟩ :=
    exists_balanced_approx hsmul hg hg₁ hsurj (m + 1) hx₀M hN
  have hne : (𝕧 : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  
  have hr : (𝕧⁻¹ : 𝕂) • r = (𝕧 ^ m : 𝕂) • x₀ - l := by
    have h1 : (𝕧 ^ (m + 1) : 𝕂) • x₀ = (𝕧 : 𝕂) • l + r := by
      rw [hxy, smul_add, hyl, smul_smul, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, one_pow, one_smul]
    have h2 : (𝕧 ^ m : 𝕂) • x₀ = (𝕧⁻¹ : 𝕂) • ((𝕧 : 𝕂) • l + r) := by
      rw [← h1, smul_smul, inv_mul_eq_div, pow_succ, mul_div_assoc, div_self hne, mul_one]
    rw [h2, smul_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
    abel
  have h0 : (𝕧⁻¹ : 𝕂) • r = 0 := by
    refine hinj _ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · have := zpow_smul_mem_laurent hsmul (-1) hrM
      rwa [zpow_neg_one] at this
    · rw [← uniformizer_smul_eq]; exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ hr₀
    · rw [hr]; exact sub_mem hm hl
  have hr0 : r = 0 := by
    rwa [smul_eq_zero, or_iff_right (inv_ne_zero hne)] at h0
  have hxeq : x = (𝕧 ^ (N : ℤ) : 𝕂) • x₀ := by
    rw [hx₀, smul_smul, zpow_natCast, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, one_pow, one_smul]
  rw [hxeq, hxy, hr0, smul_zero, add_zero]
  exact zpow_smul_mem_laurent hsmul _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_int_sub_mem_of_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_int_sub_mem_of_mem_span
    (h₀ : ResidueIndependent InfinityLocalRing L₀ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer g) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range g)) (hx₀ : x ∈ L₀) :
    ∃ y ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range g), x - y ∈ InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer • L₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).1 hx
  have hc : (c.sum fun i a ↦ a • g i) = ∑ i ∈ c.support, integralLaurentEval (c i) • g i :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ hsmul _ _
  rw [hc] at hx₀ ⊢
  have ha := h₀.exists_eq_of_sum_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    (show InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer ≠ 0 from irreducible_localX.ne_zero)
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul c.support _ hx₀
  choose! a ha using ha
  have hz : ∀ i ∈ c.support, ∃ (z : ℤ) (t : InfinityLocalRing),
      integralLaurentEval (c i) = z + algebraMap InfinityLocalRing 𝕂
        (InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer * t) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := InfinityLocalRing.residue_integer_of_laurent (a i) (c i) (ha i hi).symm
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (residue_eq_zero_iff ((show LocalRing from a i) - z)).1
      (by rw [map_sub, hz, map_intCast, sub_self])
    have e : a i = (z : InfinityLocalRing) + InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer *
        (show InfinityLocalRing from t) := (sub_eq_iff_eq_add').1 ht
    exact ⟨z, t, by rw [ha i hi, e, map_add, map_intCast]⟩
  choose! z t hzt using hz
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ c.support, z i • g i,
    Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi ↦ ?_
  rw [hzt i hi, add_smul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, add_sub_cancel_left, algebraMap_smul, mul_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (L₀.smul_mem _ (h₀.1 i))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairingCoef_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma tensorPairingCoef_zero : tensorPairingCoef D 0 = 1
proof: := Finsupp.prod_zero_index

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairingCoef_add
statement:
lemma tensorPairingCoef_add (ν ν' : I →₀ ℕ) :
    tensorPairingCoef D (ν + ν') = tensorPairingCoef D ν * tensorPairingCoef D ν'
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun _ ↦ pow_zero _) fun _ _ _ ↦ pow_add _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairingCoef_single
statement:
lemma tensorPairingCoef_single (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    tensorPairingCoef D (Finsupp.single i n) = (-(𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹) ^ n
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.prod_single_index (pow_zero _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairingCoef_add_single
statement:
lemma tensorPairingCoef_add_single (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (i : I) :
    tensorPairingCoef D (ν + Finsupp.single i 1) = tensorPairingCoef D ν * -(𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPairingCoef_add, tensorPairingCoef_single, pow_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IsIntInv.pow
statement: lemma IsIntInv.pow {c : 𝕂} (hc : IsIntInv c) (n : ℕ) : IsIntInv (c ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact isIntInv_one
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact ih.mul hc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_neg_inv_pow
statement:
lemma isNegLaurent_neg_inv_pow (i : I) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    IsNegLaurent ((-(𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : IsNegLaurent (-(𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹) := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (D.d_pos i).ne'
    rw [hd, ← inv_pow, pow_succ']
    exact (isNegLaurent_inv_X.mul_isIntInv (isNegLaurent_inv_X.isIntInv.pow d)).neg
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero hn
  rw [pow_succ']
  exact hd.mul_isIntInv (hd.isIntInv.pow n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_tensorPairingCoef
statement: lemma isIntInv_tensorPairingCoef (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : IsIntInv (tensorPairingCoef D ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPairingCoef, Finsupp.prod]
  refine Finset.prod_induction _ IsIntInv (fun _ _ ha hb ↦ ha.mul hb) isIntInv_one fun i _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases hn : ν i = 0
  · rw [hn, pow_zero]; exact isIntInv_one
  · exact (isNegLaurent_neg_inv_pow i hn).isIntInv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_tensorPairingCoef
statement:
lemma isNegLaurent_tensorPairingCoef {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) :
    IsNegLaurent (tensorPairingCoef D ν)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.1 hν
  rw [← Finsupp.single_add_erase i ν, tensorPairingCoef_add, tensorPairingCoef_single]
  exact (isNegLaurent_neg_inv_pow i hi).mul_isIntInv (isIntInv_tensorPairingCoef _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairingOp_of_mem
statement:
lemma tensorPairingOp_of_mem {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hy : y ∈ hwWt Λ μ) :
    tensorPairingOp hR Λ y = tensorPairingCoef D μ • y
proof:
:= by
  set B := canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR
  conv_rhs => rw [← B.linearCombination_repr y]
  rw [tensorPairingOp, Module.Basis.constr_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    Finsupp.smul_sum]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun b _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases hb : hwbWt Λ b = μ
  · rw [hb, canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply, smul_comm]
  · rw [repr_eq_zero_of_mem_hwWt hR Λ hy b hb, zero_smul, zero_smul, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorPairing_tmul (m y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    tensorPairing hR Λ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) =
      formL hvt hR Λ m (tensorPairingOp hR Λ y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorPairing]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensor_ext_hwWt
statement:
lemma tensor_ext_hwWt {φ ψ : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1 →ₗ[𝕂] 𝕂}
    (h : ∀ (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1),
      y ∈ hwWt Λ μ → φ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) =
        ψ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun x y ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)).surjective x
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR)) := by
    rw [Module.Basis.span_eq]; trivial
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply]
    exact h m _ _ (evq_mem_hwWt hR Λ b)
  | zero => rw [tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [tmul_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [tmul_smul, map_smul, map_smul, ha]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.act_E_tmul
statement:
lemma TensorModule.act_E_tmul {M₁ M₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module 𝕂 M₁]
    [Module (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₁]
    [IsScalarTower 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module 𝕂 M₂]
    [Module (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₂] [IsScalarTower 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₂] (i : I)
    (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    TensorModule.act R 𝕧 M₁ M₂ (E R 𝕧 i) (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) =
      (E R 𝕧 i • x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y + (Kt R 𝕧 i • x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (E R 𝕧 i • y)
proof:
:=
  TensorModule.E_smul_tmul i x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.act_F_tmul
statement:
lemma TensorModule.act_F_tmul {M₁ M₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module 𝕂 M₁]
    [Module (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₁]
    [IsScalarTower 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module 𝕂 M₂]
    [Module (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₂] [IsScalarTower 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₂] (i : I)
    (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    TensorModule.act R 𝕧 M₁ M₂ (F R 𝕧 i) (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) =
      (F R 𝕧 i • x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • y) + x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (F R 𝕧 i • y)
proof:
:=
  TensorModule.F_smul_tmul i x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.TensorModule.act_K_tmul
statement:
lemma TensorModule.act_K_tmul {M₁ M₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module 𝕂 M₁]
    [Module (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₁]
    [IsScalarTower 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module 𝕂 M₂]
    [Module (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₂] [IsScalarTower 𝕂 (QuantumGroup R 𝕧) M₂] (μ : Y)
    (x : M₁) (y : M₂) :
    TensorModule.act R 𝕧 M₁ M₂ (K R 𝕧 μ) (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) = (K R 𝕧 μ • x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (K R 𝕧 μ • y)
proof:
:=
  TensorModule.K_smul_tmul μ x y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.inv_pow_d_mul
statement: private lemma inv_pow_d_mul (i : I) : (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹ * 𝕧 ^ D.d i = 1
proof:
:=
  inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne 𝕧))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formL_K_smul_left
statement:
lemma formL_K_smul_left (μ : Y) (a w : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    formL hvt hR Λ (K R 𝕧 μ • a) w = formL hvt hR Λ a (K R 𝕧 μ • w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt), rho_K]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formL_F_smul_left
statement:
lemma formL_F_smul_left (i : I) (a w : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    formL hvt hR Λ (F R 𝕧 i • a) w =
      𝕧 ^ D.d i * formL hvt hR Λ a (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • E R 𝕧 i • w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt), rho_F,
    rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_comp_act_E
statement:
lemma tensorPairing_comp_act_E (i : I) :
    tensorPairing hR Λ ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (E R 𝕧 i) =
      counit R 𝕧 (E R 𝕧 i) • tensorPairing hR Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext_hwWt hR Λ fun m μ y hy ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorModule.act_E_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist,
    ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_E, chevalley_K, map_add, tensorPairing_tmul,
    tensorPairing_tmul, counit_E, zero_smul, LinearMap.zero_apply, tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ hy,
    LinearMap.map_smul _ (tensorPairingCoef D μ), formL_F_smul_left, smul_eq_mul]
  have hE : plusHom R 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i) = E R 𝕧 i := by simp
  by_cases hμ : Finsupp.single i 1 ≤ μ
  · have hEy : E R 𝕧 i • y ∈ hwWt Λ (μ - Finsupp.single i 1) := by
      rw [← hE]; exact plusHom_smul_mem_hwWt Λ hμ (θ_mem_weightSpace i) hy
    rw [tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ hEy,
      LinearMap.map_smul _ (tensorPairingCoef D (μ - Finsupp.single i 1)), formL_K_smul_left,
      smul_eq_mul,
      ← tsub_add_cancel_of_le hμ, tensorPairingCoef_add_single, add_tsub_cancel_right]
    linear_combination (-(tensorPairingCoef D (μ - Finsupp.single i 1) *
      (formL hvt hR Λ) m (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • E R 𝕧 i • y))) * inv_pow_d_mul i
  · have hEy : E R 𝕧 i • y = 0 := by
      rw [← hE]; exact plusHom_smul_hwWt_eq_zero hR Λ hμ (θ_mem_weightSpace i) hy
    simp [hEy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_comp_act_F
statement:
lemma tensorPairing_comp_act_F (i : I) :
    tensorPairing hR Λ ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (F R 𝕧 i) =
      counit R 𝕧 (F R 𝕧 i) • tensorPairing hR Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext_hwWt hR Λ fun m μ y hy ↦ ?_
  have hs := IrreducibleModule.form_comm hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (Λ := Λ.1)
  have hFy : F R 𝕧 i • y ∈ hwWt Λ (μ + Finsupp.single i 1) := by
    have h := F_smul_mem_weightSpace hy i
    rw [hwWt, R.rootSum_add, R.rootSum_single, one_smul, ← sub_sub]
    exact h
  have hFm : formL hvt hR Λ m (F R 𝕧 i • y) =
      𝕧 ^ D.d i * formL hvt hR Λ (E R 𝕧 i • m) (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • y) := by
    rw [hs, formL_F_smul_left, ← formL_K_smul_left, hs]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorModule.act_F_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_F,
    map_add, tensorPairing_tmul, tensorPairing_tmul, counit_F, zero_smul, LinearMap.zero_apply,
    tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ (K_smul_mem_weightSpace hy _), tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ hFy,
    tensorPairingCoef_add_single, LinearMap.map_smul _ (tensorPairingCoef D μ),
    LinearMap.map_smul _ (tensorPairingCoef D μ * -(𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹), hFm, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (-(tensorPairingCoef D μ *
    (formL hvt hR Λ) (E R 𝕧 i • m) (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • y))) * inv_pow_d_mul i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_comp_act_K
statement:
lemma tensorPairing_comp_act_K (ν : Y) :
    tensorPairing hR Λ ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (K R 𝕧 ν) =
      counit R 𝕧 (K R 𝕧 ν) • tensorPairing hR Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext_hwWt hR Λ fun m μ y hy ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorModule.act_K_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_K,
    tensorPairing_tmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, tensorPairing_tmul, counit_K, one_smul,
    tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ (K_smul_mem_weightSpace hy _), tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ hy,
    LinearMap.map_smul _ (tensorPairingCoef D μ), LinearMap.map_smul _ (tensorPairingCoef D μ),
    formL_K_smul_left, ← mul_smul, K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_act
statement:
theorem tensorPairing_act (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    tensorPairing hR Λ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u z) = counit R 𝕧 u * tensorPairing hR Λ z
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : tensorPairing hR Λ ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u =
      counit R 𝕧 u • tensorPairing hR Λ from LinearMap.congr_fun h z
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun z ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul,
      AlgHom.commutes, LinearMap.smul_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]
  | E i => exact tensorPairing_comp_act_E hR Λ i
  | F i => exact tensorPairing_comp_act_F hR Λ i
  | K ν => exact tensorPairing_comp_act_K hR Λ ν
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, LinearMap.comp_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_smul]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hx, LinearMap.smul_comp, hy,
      smul_smul, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_hwv
statement:
theorem tensorPairing_hwv :
    tensorPairing hR Λ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 ∈ hwWt Λ 0 := by
    rw [hwWt, R.rootSum_zero, sub_zero]
    exact IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace
  rw [tensorPairing_tmul, tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ h, tensorPairingCoef_zero, one_smul,
    IrreducibleModule.form_hwv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_counit_equivariant
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_counit_equivariant {φ : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1 →ₗ[𝕂] 𝕂}
    (hφ : ∀ u z, φ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u z) = counit R 𝕧 u * φ z)
    (h₁ : φ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 0) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hη : ∀ m, φ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m using hw_induction with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, zero_tmul, map_zero]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, add_tmul, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
    | smul c a ha => rw [map_smul, ← smul_tmul', map_smul, ha, smul_zero]
    | hwv => exact h₁
    | F i a _ =>
      have h := hφ (E R 𝕧 i) (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1)
      rwa [TensorModule.act_E_tmul, IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, tmul_zero, add_zero,
        ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_E,
        counit_E, zero_mul] at h
  have hall : ∀ y (x : TwL Λ), φ (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) = 0 := by
    intro y
    induction y using hw_induction with
    | zero => intro x; rw [tmul_zero, map_zero]
    | add a b ha hb => intro x; rw [tmul_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
    | smul c a ha => intro x; rw [tmul_smul, map_smul, ha, smul_zero]
    | hwv =>
      intro x
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)).surjective x
      exact hη m
    | F i a ha =>
      intro x
      have hF := hφ (F R 𝕧 i) (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] a)
      have hK := hφ (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) ((K R 𝕧 (ktilde R i) • F R 𝕧 i • x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] a)
      rw [TensorModule.act_K_tmul, ← mul_smul, K_add, neg_add_cancel, K_zero, one_smul, ha,
        mul_zero] at hK
      rwa [TensorModule.act_F_tmul, map_add, hK, zero_add, counit_F, zero_mul] at hF
  exact TensorProduct.ext' fun x y ↦ hall y x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_tensorPairing
statement:
theorem eq_tensorPairing {φ : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1 →ₗ[𝕂] 𝕂}
    (hφ : ∀ u z, φ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u z) = counit R 𝕧 u * φ z)
    (h₁ : φ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) = 1) : φ = tensorPairing hR Λ
proof:
:= by
  refine sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_counit_equivariant Λ (fun u z ↦ ?_) ?_)
  · rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, hφ, tensorPairing_act, mul_sub]
  · rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, h₁, tensorPairing_hwv, sub_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_hwOne_of_hwbWt_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_hwOne_of_hwbWt_eq_zero {b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ} (hb : hwbWt Λ b = 0) :
    b = hwOne Λ
proof:
:= by
  have hs := ((mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ b.2)).choose_spec
  have hb' : ((mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ b.2)).choose = 0 := hb
  generalize ((mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ b.2)).choose = ν at hs hb'
  subst hb'
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hs
  exact Subtype.ext (hb'.trans (negGlobal_zero D b'))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_tensorBasis
statement:
lemma tensorPairing_tensorBasis (b b' : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    tensorPairing hR Λ (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ (b, b')) =
      tensorPairingCoef D (hwbWt Λ b') * formL hvt hR Λ (evq hvt Λ b) (evq hvt Λ b')
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorBasis_apply, tensorPairing_tmul, tensorPairingOp_of_mem hR Λ (evq_mem_hwWt hR Λ b'),
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorPairing_tensorBasis_one
statement:
theorem tensorPairing_tensorBasis_one :
    tensorPairing hR Λ (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ (hwOne Λ, hwOne Λ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : evq hvt Λ (hwOne Λ : Um D 𝕧) = IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 := ev_one Λ.1
  rw [tensorBasis_apply]
  dsimp only
  rw [h]
  exact tensorPairing_hwv hR Λ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_tensorPairing_tensorBasis
proof:
:= by
  have hf := isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub hR Λ b b'
  rw [tensorPairing_tensorBasis]
  by_cases hbb : b = b'
  · subst hbb
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at hf
    have hw : hwbWt Λ b ≠ 0 := fun hw ↦ h (by rw [eq_hwOne_of_hwbWt_eq_zero Λ hw])
    have hi : IsIntInv (formL hvt hR Λ (evq hvt Λ b) (evq hvt Λ b)) := by
      simpa using hf.isIntInv.add isIntInv_one
    exact (isNegLaurent_tensorPairingCoef hw).mul_isIntInv hi
  · simp only [hbb, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero] at hf
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact hf.mul_isIntInv (isIntInv_tensorPairingCoef _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_F_smul_mem_hwLaurentLattice
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_laurentSpan (DistribSMul.toLinearMap 𝕂 _ (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i)))
    ?_ hm
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  refine mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨(i, n) :: w, ?_⟩
  rw [DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply, ← mul_smul, Modified.fPow_cons']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_eq_quotientMinus_smul
statement:
lemma evq_eq_quotientMinus_smul (x : Um D 𝕧) :
    evq hvt Λ x = quotientMinus R (negativeQuotientEquiv D x) • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [evq_mk, ev_apply, VermaModule.toVerma_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_mem_hwLaurentLattice
statement:
lemma evq_mem_hwLaurentLattice {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D) :
    evq hvt Λ x ∈ hwLaurentLattice Λ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ z ∈ quotientIntegralForm D, ∀ m ∈ hwLaurentLattice Λ,
      quotientMinus R z • m ∈ hwLaurentLattice Λ := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hz
      intro m hm
      rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, map_qDivPow', quotientMinus_θ]
      exact qDivPow_F_smul_mem_hwLaurentLattice Λ i n hm
    | algebraMap c =>
      intro m hm
      rw [show algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Quotient D 𝕧) c =
        algebraMap 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) (integralLaurentEval c) from rfl, AlgHom.commutes,
        algebraMap_smul]
      exact laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan ⟨c, rfl⟩ hm
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      intro m hm
      rw [map_add, add_smul]
      exact add_mem (ha m hm) (hb m hm)
    | mul a b _ _ ha hb =>
      intro m hm
      rw [map_mul, mul_smul]
      exact ha _ (hb m hm)
  rw [evq_eq_quotientMinus_smul]
  exact key _ hx _ (mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨[], by rw [Modified.fPow_nil, one_smul]⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fPow_smul_hwv_mem_hwIntegral
statement:
lemma fPow_smul_hwv_mem_hwIntegral (w : List (I × ℕ)) :
    Modified.fPow R w • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 ∈ hwIntegral Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rw [Modified.fPow_nil, one_smul]; exact hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ
  | cons p w ih =>
    rw [← Modified.fPow_cons', mul_smul]
    exact dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ p.1 p.2 ih

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_repr_of_mem_hwIntegral
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← span_canonicalBasis_laurent] at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    by_cases hx' : x ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ
    · rw [show evq hvt Λ x = canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR ⟨x, hx'⟩ from
        (canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply Λ hR ⟨x, hx'⟩).symm, Module.Basis.repr_self,
        Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs
      · exact Modified.isLaurent_one
      · exact Modified.isLaurent_zero
    · rw [evq_eq_zero_of_notMem_canonicalBasisHW Λ hR hx hx', map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
      exact Modified.isLaurent_zero
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]; exact Modified.isLaurent_zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply]; exact hx.add hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact (Modified.IsLaurent.mul ⟨c, rfl⟩ hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_repr_of_mem_hwLaurentLattice
proof:
:= by
  change m ∈ Submodule.span ℤ _ at hm
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem m hm =>
    obtain ⟨k, _, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hm
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact (Modified.isLaurent_zpow k).mul
      (isLaurent_repr_of_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ w) b)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]; exact Modified.isLaurent_zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply]; exact hx.add hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [map_zsmul, Finsupp.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul]
    exact (Modified.IsLaurent.mul ⟨c, by simp⟩ hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorBasis_apply
statement:
lemma tensorBasis_apply (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt Λ h.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] evq hvt Λ' h.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorBasis, Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply', Module.Basis.map_apply,
    canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply, canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorBasis_repr_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorBasis_repr_tmul (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) (m' : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1)
    (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] m') h =
      (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ' hR).repr m' h.2 * (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR).repr m h.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorBasis, ← Prod.mk.eta (p := h), Module.Basis.tensorProduct_repr_tmul_apply,
    Module.Basis.map_repr, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_repr_of_mem_quotTensorLattice
statement:
lemma isLaurent_repr_of_mem_quotTensorLattice
    {z : TensorModule 𝕂 (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1)}
    (hz : z ∈ Modified.quotTensorLattice R (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ.1)
      (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ'.1))
    (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    Modified.IsLaurent ((tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr ((TensorModule.mk _ _).symm z) h)
proof:
:= by
  change z ∈ Submodule.span ℤ _ at hz
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨k, _, ⟨w, w', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    refine (Modified.isLaurent_zpow k).mul ?_
    change Modified.IsLaurent ((tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr
      (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (Modified.fPow R w • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        (Modified.fPow R w' • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1)) h)
    rw [tensorBasis_repr_tmul]
    exact (isLaurent_repr_of_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ' (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ' w') _).mul
      (isLaurent_repr_of_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ (fPow_smul_hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ w) _)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]; exact Modified.isLaurent_zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply]; exact hx.add hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [map_zsmul, map_zsmul, Finsupp.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul]
    exact (Modified.IsLaurent.mul ⟨c, by simp⟩ hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_Uw_cbWt

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_mem_hwWt

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_evq_canonicalBasisHW
statement:

proof:
