name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_eq_zero_of_mem_hwWt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set B := canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR
  set P := weightSetProj (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt) (isInt hvt hR Λ)
    {Λ.1 - R.rootSum μ}
  have hiff : ∀ ν : I →₀ ℕ, Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν ∈ ({Λ.1 - R.rootSum μ} : Set (Y →+ ℤ)) ↔
      ν = μ := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR (sub_right_injective h),
      fun h ↦ by rw [h]⟩
  have hφ : B.coord b ∘ₗ P = 0 := B.ext fun b' ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply,
      weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ (evq_mem_hwWt hR Λ b'), LinearMap.zero_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [← canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply Λ hR, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self,
        Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right_iff]
      rintro rfl
      exact absurd ((hiff _).1 h) hb
    · rw [map_zero]
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ m
  rwa [LinearMap.comp_apply, weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ hm,
    ite_eq_left_iff.2 fun h ↦ absurd (Set.mem_singleton _) h, LinearMap.zero_apply,
    Module.Basis.coord_apply] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tmul_mem_quotTensorLattice
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_quotTensorLattice {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ hwLaurentLattice Λ)
    {m' : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} (hm' : m' ∈ hwLaurentLattice Λ') :
    TensorModule.mk (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1)
        (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] m') ∈
      Modified.quotTensorLattice R (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ.1)
        (VermaModule.maxSubmodule R 𝕧 Λ'.1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Modified.quotTensorLattice
  refine map_mem_laurentSpan ((TensorModule.mk _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    (TensorProduct.mk 𝕂 (TwL Λ) _).flip m' ∘ₗ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _).toLinearMap) ?_ hm
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  refine map_mem_laurentSpan ((TensorModule.mk _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk 𝕂 (TwL Λ) _
    (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (Modified.fPow R w • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1))) ?_ hm'
  rintro _ ⟨w', rfl⟩
  exact mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨w, w', rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorBasis_mem_tensorWt
statement:
lemma tensorBasis_mem_tensorWt (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h ∈ tensorWt Λ Λ' (hwbWt Λ h.1) (hwbWt Λ' h.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorBasis_apply]
  exact tmul_mem_tensorWt Λ Λ' (evq_mem_hwWt hR Λ _) (evq_mem_hwWt hR Λ' _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.barPair_tensorBasis
statement:
lemma barPair_tensorBasis (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    barPair (twBar hR Λ) (hwBar hR Λ').toAddMonoidHom (twBar_smul_U hR Λ)
      (hwBar_smul_U' hR Λ') (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h) = tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorBasis_apply, barPair_tmul, twBar_toTwist]
  change ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (hwBar hR Λ (evq hvt Λ h.1)) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
    hwBar hR Λ' (evq hvt Λ' h.2) = _
  rw [hwBar_evq_canonicalBasisHW, hwBar_evq_canonicalBasisHW]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_eq_zero_of_mem_tensorWt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hz
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | tmul m m' =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [tensorBasis_repr_tmul]
    rcases not_and_or.1 hh with hh | hh
    · rw [repr_eq_zero_of_mem_hwWt hR Λ m.2 _ hh, mul_zero]
    · rw [repr_eq_zero_of_mem_hwWt hR Λ' m'.2 _ hh, zero_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorPsi_tensorBasis
statement:
lemma repr_tensorPsi_tensorBasis (h₁ h₂ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h₁)) h₂ =
      ∑ᶠ ν, (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (TensorModule.actPair R 𝕧 (TwL Λ)
        (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) (quasiR R ν) (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h₁)) h₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPsi_apply, barPair_tensorBasis]
  exact ((Finsupp.lapply h₂ ∘ₗ (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr.toLinearMap).toAddMonoidHom).map_finsum
    (support_quasiR_finite (isPlusLocallyNilpotent_hw Λ') _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_actPair_quasiR_eq_zero
statement:
lemma repr_actPair_quasiR_eq_zero {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0)
    (h₁ h₂ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') (hl : ¬ TensorLower Λ Λ' h₂ h₁) :
    (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (TensorModule.actPair R 𝕧 (TwL Λ)
      (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) (quasiR R ν) (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h₁)) h₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hle : ν ≤ hwbWt Λ h₁.1 ∧ ν ≤ hwbWt Λ' h₁.2
  · refine repr_eq_zero_of_mem_tensorWt hR Λ Λ'
      (actPair_quasiR_mem_tensorWt Λ Λ' hle.1 hle.2 (tensorBasis_mem_tensorWt hR Λ Λ' h₁)) h₂ ?_
    rintro ⟨e₁, e₂⟩
    exact hl ⟨ν, hν, by rw [e₁, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle.1],
      by rw [e₂, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle.2]⟩
  · rw [actPair_quasiR_eq_zero hR Λ Λ' hle (tensorBasis_mem_tensorWt hR Λ Λ' h₁), map_zero,
      Finsupp.zero_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorPsi_self
statement:
theorem repr_tensorPsi_self (h : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h)) h = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [repr_tensorPsi_tensorBasis, finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · rw [quasiR_zero, map_one, Module.End.one_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  · intro ν hν
    refine repr_actPair_quasiR_eq_zero hR Λ Λ' hν h h ?_
    rintro ⟨ν', hν', e₁, -⟩
    exact hν' (by simpa using e₁)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorPsi_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [repr_tensorPsi_tensorBasis]
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun ν ↦ ?_
  by_cases hν : ν = 0
  · rw [hν, quasiR_zero, map_one, Module.End.one_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne]
  · exact repr_actPair_quasiR_eq_zero hR Λ Λ' hν h₁ h₂ hl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_repr_tensorPsi
statement:
theorem isLaurent_repr_tensorPsi (h₁ h₂ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    Modified.IsLaurent
      ((tensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ' (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ' h₁)) h₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPsi_apply, barPair_tensorBasis]
  have hmem := tmul_mem_quotTensorLattice Λ Λ'
    (evq_mem_hwLaurentLattice Λ (negIntegral_of_mem_canonicalBasis
      (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ h₁.1.2)))
    (evq_mem_hwLaurentLattice Λ' (negIntegral_of_mem_canonicalBasis
      (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ' h₁.2.2)))
  have := isLaurent_repr_of_mem_quotTensorLattice hR Λ Λ'
    (Modified.quasiRAct_mem_quotTensorLattice _ _ hmem) h₂
  rwa [tensorBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_eq_of_mem_negFilt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxZ, hxw⟩ := mem_negFilt_le D hx
  obtain ⟨y, hyZ, hxy⟩ := exists_sub_negBar_eq_smul D hxZ
  have hne : (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' : (RatFunc.X : 𝕂) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [sq]; nth_rewrite 2 [sub_eq_zero.1 h]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    exact pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X 2 two_pos h'
  have hy' : y = (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂)⁻¹ • (x - negBar D x) := by
    rw [hxy, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
  have hb₀ : negBar D x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A := (mem_latInfBar_iff D x).1 hx₁
  have hb₁ : negBar D x ∈ latInfBar D := negBar_mem_latInfBar D hx₀
  have hyϖ : y ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_inv_X_sub_eq_uniformizer_mul
    rw [hy', ← hu, algebraMap_smul, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hx₀ hb₀))
  have hy₁ : y ∈ latInfBar D := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_inv_X_sub_eq_localX_mul
    rw [hy', ← hu, algebraMap_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hx₁ hb₁)
  have hyF : y ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν := by
    refine (mem_negFilt_iff_comp_zero D).2 ⟨hyZ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hy']
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hxw (negBar_mem_Uw D hxw))
    · rw [hy', map_smul, map_sub, comp_zero_of_mem_negFilt D hx,
        comp_zero_of_mem_negFilt D (negBar_mem_negFilt D hx), sub_zero, smul_zero]
  have hy0 : y = 0 := negFilt_eq_zero_of_mem hR hfund hIH i le_rfl hyF hyϖ hy₁
  rw [hy0, smul_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hxy
  exact hxy.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_fWi_nil
statement: lemma negBar_fWi_nil : negBar D (fWi (D := D) hvt []) = fWi hvt []
proof:
:= by
  change negBar D (Submodule.Quotient.mk 1) = Submodule.Quotient.mk 1
  rw [negBar_mk, map_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_negGlobalLift
statement:
lemma exists_negGlobalLift {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (w : List I)
    (hw : wordWeight w = ν) :
    ∃ y ∈ negBalanced D ν, y - fWi (D := D) hvt w ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A ∧
      negBar D y = y ∧ (w = [] → y = fWi hvt []) ∧
      ∀ i w', w = i :: w' → y ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨fWi hvt [], ⟨fWi_mem_negIntegral D [], hw ▸ fWi_mem_Uw [],
      NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ [], ?_⟩, by simp, negBar_fWi_nil,
      fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ _ h ↦ (by cases h)⟩
    rw [mem_latInfBar_iff, negBar_fWi_nil]
    exact NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ []
  | cons i w' =>
    have hx : fWi (D := D) hvt (i :: w') ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν := hw ▸ fWi_cons_mem_negFilt D i w'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy₀, hy₁, hxy⟩ := exists_negFilt_sub_mem hR hfund hIH i le_rfl hx
      (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ _)
    refine ⟨y, ⟨(mem_negFilt_le D hy).1, (mem_negFilt_le D hy).2, hy₀, hy₁⟩,
      by rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem hxy, negBar_eq_of_mem_negFilt hR hfund hIH hy hy₀ hy₁,
      (fun h ↦ by cases h), fun j w'' h ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := List.cons.inj h
    exact hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobalLift_spec
statement:
lemma negGlobalLift_spec {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b ∈ negBalanced D ν ∧
      negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b - fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1 ∈
        ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A ∧
      negBar D (negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b) = negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b ∧
      ((Quotient.out b).1 = [] → negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b = fWi hvt []) ∧
      ∀ i w', (Quotient.out b).1 = i :: w' → negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν
proof:
:=
  (exists_negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH (Quotient.out b).1 (Quotient.out b).2).choose_spec

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residueIndependent_negGlobalLift
statement:
theorem residueIndependent_negGlobalLift {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) :
    ResidueIndependent A (latInf (D := D) hvt A) ϖ (negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun b ↦ (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH b).1.2.2.1, fun s a hs b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  set o : negCrystal D ν → List I := fun c ↦ (Quotient.out c).1
  have hinj : Set.InjOn o s := fun c₁ _ c₂ _ he ↦ Quotient.out_injective (Subtype.ext he)
  have hsum : ∑ c ∈ s, a c • fWi (D := D) hvt (o c) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    have e : ∑ c ∈ s, a c • fWi (D := D) hvt (o c) = ∑ c ∈ s, a c • negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH c -
        ∑ c ∈ s, a c • (negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH c - fWi hvt (o c)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ ↦ by rw [smul_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem hs (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH c).2.1)
  let a' : List I → A := fun w ↦ if h : wordWeight w = ν then a (Quotient.mk _ ⟨w, h⟩) else 0
  have ha' : ∀ c, a' (o c) = a c := fun c ↦ by
    change (if h : _ then _ else _) = _
    split_ifs with h
    · exact congrArg a (Quotient.out_eq c)
    · exact absurd (Quotient.out c).2 h
  have := coeff_mem_of_sum_fWi_mem (hR := hR) InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund (s.image o)
    (fun w hw ↦ by obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hw; exact (Quotient.out c).2)
    (fun w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂ hne hmem ↦ by
      obtain ⟨c₁, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hw₁
      obtain ⟨c₂, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hw₂
      refine hne (congrArg o ?_)
      rw [← Quotient.out_eq c₁, ← Quotient.out_eq c₂]
      exact Quotient.sound hmem)
    a' (by rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]; simpa only [ha'] using hsum) (o b)
    (Finset.mem_image_of_mem o hb)
  rw [ha'] at this
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.residueIndependent_negGlobalLift_bar
statement:
theorem residueIndependent_negGlobalLift_bar {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) :
    ResidueIndependent LocalRing (latInfBar D) localX (negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH)
proof:
:= by
  have h := residueIndependent_latInfBar D (residueIndependent_negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH)
  have e : (fun b ↦ negBar D (negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b)) = negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH :=
    funext fun b ↦ (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH b).2.2.1
  rwa [e] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_negGlobalLift_mem_negFilt
statement:
lemma exists_negGlobalLift_mem_negFilt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν)
    (b : negCrystal D ν) : ∃ j, negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b ∈ negFilt D j 1 ν
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (Quotient.out b).1 ≠ [] := fun h ↦ hν (by rw [← (Quotient.out b).2, h]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨j, w', hj⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne
  exact ⟨j, (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH b).2.2.2.2 j w' hj⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFilt_le_span_negGlobalLift
statement:
lemma negFilt_le_span_negGlobalLift {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (i : I) :
    negFilt D i 1 ν ≤
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range (negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, hgF, -, hg₁, hspan, hgu, hgw⟩ := negFiltGlobalAt hR hfund hIH i le_rfl
  intro x hx
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun k ↦ ?_) (hspan x hx)
  set b : negCrystal D ν := Quotient.mk _ ⟨i :: u k, hgw k⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_negGlobalLift_mem_negFilt hR hfund hν hIH b
  have hb : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt (i :: u k) ∈
      ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
    Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D ν) ⟨i :: u k, hgw k⟩
  have hGb : negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b - fWi hvt (i :: u k) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel _ (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1)]
    exact add_mem (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH b).2.1 hb
  have e : g k = negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH b :=
    eq_of_mem_negFilt hR hfund hIH (by simp) (hgF k) (hg₁.1 k) (hgu k) hj
      (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH b).1.2.2.2 hGb
  rw [e]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_negGlobalLift
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hν : ν = 0
  · subst hν
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ (mem_span_one_of_mem_Uw_zero D hxZ hxw)
    rintro _ rfl
    set b : negCrystal D 0 := Quotient.mk _ ⟨[], rfl⟩
    have hnil : (Quotient.out b).1 = [] := GrandLoop.eq_nil_of_wordWeight_eq_zero (Quotient.out b).2
    rw [← (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH b).2.2.2.1 hnil]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, rfl⟩
  · exact (iSup_le fun i ↦ negFilt_le_span_negGlobalLift hR hfund hν hIH i)
      (mem_iSup_negFilt D hν hxZ hxw)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobalAt_of_globalBelow
statement: theorem negGlobalAt_of_globalBelow {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) : NegGlobalAt D ν
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ := residueIndependent_negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH
  have h₁ := residueIndependent_negGlobalLift_bar hR hfund hIH
  refine ⟨fun x hxZ hxw hx₀ ↦ ?_, fun x hx hxϖ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_int_sub_mem_of_mem_span (laurent_smul_eq D) h₀
      (mem_span_negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH hxZ hxw) hx₀
    refine ⟨y, ?_, hxy⟩
    clear hxy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy => obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy; exact (negGlobalLift_spec hR hfund hIH b).1
    | zero => exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _, zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩
    | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => exact ⟨add_mem hy.1 hy'.1, add_mem hy.2.1 hy'.2.1,
        add_mem hy.2.2.1 hy'.2.2.1, add_mem hy.2.2.2 hy'.2.2.2⟩
    | smul m y _ hy => exact ⟨zsmul_mem hy.1 m, zsmul_mem hy.2.1 m, zsmul_mem hy.2.2.1 m,
        zsmul_mem hy.2.2.2 m⟩
  · exact balanced_eq_zero_of_mem_span (laurent_smul_eq D) h₀ h₁
      (mem_span_negGlobalLift hR hfund hIH hx.1 hx.2.1) hxϖ hx.2.2.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_of_mem_negBalanced
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_zero.1 (h.2 _ ⟨sub_mem hx.1 hy.1, sub_mem hx.2.1 hy.2.1, sub_mem hx.2.2.1 hy.2.2.1,
    sub_mem hx.2.2.2 hy.2.2.2⟩ hxy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negLift_mem_negFilt
statement:
theorem negLift_mem_negFilt {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) (i : I)
    (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν})
    (hw : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w.1) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    negLift h w ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν
proof:
:= by
  rcases kE_fWi_cases (hR := hR) InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund i w.1 with h0 | ⟨w', hw'⟩
  · exact absurd h0 hw
  have hc := fWi_sub_mem_of_kE (hR := hR) InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund i hw hw'
  have hwt : wordWeight (i :: w') = ν := by
    rw [← w.2]
    exact (wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem_latInf (hR := hR) InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund hc).symm
  have hx : fWi (D := D) hvt (i :: w') ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν := hwt ▸ fWi_cons_mem_negFilt D i w'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy₀, hy₁, hxy⟩ := exists_negFilt_sub_mem hR hfund hIH i le_rfl hx
    (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ _)
  have e : negLift h w = y := by
    refine eq_of_mem_negBalanced h (negLift_mem h w)
      ⟨(mem_negFilt_le D hy).1, (mem_negFilt_le D hy).2, hy₀, hy₁⟩ ?_
    have e' : negLift h w - y = (negLift h w - fWi hvt w.1) +
        (fWi hvt w.1 - fWi hvt (i :: w')) + (fWi hvt (i :: w') - y) := by abel
    rw [e']
    exact add_mem (add_mem (negLift_sub_mem h w) hc) hxy
  rw [e]
  exact hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_negLift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem evq_negLift_eq_zero {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν) (h : NegGlobalAt D ν)
    (Λ : Dom R) (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν})
    (hw : fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ) : evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hwν⟩ := w
  cases w with
  | nil =>
    exact absurd hw (fW_nil_notMem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal Λ)
  | cons i w' =>
    have hkE : kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt (i :: w')) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
      change kE hvt i (kF hvt i (fWi hvt w')) ∉ _
      rw [kE_kF]
      exact fWi_notMem (hR := hR) InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
        InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
        InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund w'
    have hF := negLift_mem_negFilt hR hfund hIH h i ⟨i :: w', hwν⟩ hkE
    refine hwFilt_eq_zero_of_mem hR hfund hIH Λ i le_rfl (evq_mem_hwFilt Λ hF) ?_
      (evq_negLift_mem hfund h ⟨i :: w', hwν⟩ Λ).2.2.2
    have := add_mem (evq_negLift_sub_mem hfund h ⟨i :: w', hwν⟩ Λ) hw
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.globalAt
statement:
theorem globalAt (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    ∃ h : NegGlobalAt D ν,
      (∀ (Λ : Dom R) (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}),
        fW hvt hR Λ w.1 ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ → evq hvt Λ (negLift h w) = 0) ∧
      ∀ (i : I) (w : {w : List I // wordWeight w = ν}),
        kE hvt i (fWi (D := D) hvt w.1) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A →
          negLift h w ∈ negFilt D i 1 ν
proof:
:= by
  induction ν using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | _ ν ih =>
    have hIH : GlobalBelow hR ν := fun μ hle hne ↦ ih μ (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne)
    have h := negGlobalAt_of_globalBelow hR hfund hIH
    exact ⟨h, evq_negLift_eq_zero hR hfund hIH h, negLift_mem_negFilt hR hfund hIH h⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.globalBelow
statement: theorem globalBelow (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : GlobalBelow hR ν
proof:
:=
  fun μ _ _ ↦ globalAt hR hfund μ

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwGlobalAt
statement: theorem hwGlobalAt (Λ : Dom R) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : HwGlobalAt hR Λ ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hvan, -⟩ := globalAt hR hfund ν
  exact hwGlobalAt_of_vanishing hfund h Λ (hvan Λ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobalAt
statement: theorem negGlobalAt (ν : I →₀ ℕ) : NegGlobalAt D ν
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact (globalAt (R := D.extendedRootDatum) D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum ν).1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formL_hwv_left
statement:
lemma formL_hwv_left (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    formL hvt hR Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) m = hwCounit hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using hw_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | smul c a ha => rw [map_smul, map_smul, ha]
  | hwv => rw [IrreducibleModule.form_hwv, hwCounit_hwv]
  | F i a _ =>
    have hE : E R 𝕧 i • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 = 0 := by
      rw [IrreducibleModule.hwv, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, VermaModule.E_smul_hwv,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero]
    rw [hwCounit_F_smul, IrreducibleModule.form_comm,
      IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt), rho_F,
      rhoF, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hE, smul_zero, smul_zero, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_pow
statement: lemma rho_pow (x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (n : ℕ) : rho R 𝕧 (x ^ n) = rho R 𝕧 x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, rho_one]
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, rho_mul, ih, pow_succ']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_pow_smul_mem_weightSpace
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, succ_nsmul, ← add_assoc]
    exact E_smul_mem_weightSpace ih i

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_KE_pow_smul
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨e + (μ + (n + 1) • R.root i) (-ktilde R i), ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, he, smul_comm _ (𝕧 ^ e), mul_smul, ← mul_smul (E R 𝕧 i),
      ← pow_succ', E_pow_smul_mem_weightSpace Λ hm i (n + 1) (-ktilde R i), smul_smul,
      ← zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne _)]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_qDivPow_F_smul_mem_hwIntegral
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← span_canonicalBasis_laurent] at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_KE_pow_smul Λ (evq_mem_wsp hR (mem_Uw_cbWt ⟨x, hx⟩) Λ) i n
    have key : rho R 𝕧 (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i)) • evq hvt Λ x =
        (LaurentPolynomial.T ((D.d i * n : ℕ) + e) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) •
          (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i) • evq hvt Λ x) := by
      rw [hw_laurent_smul_eq, integralLaurentEval_T, qDivPow, qDivPow, map_smul, rho_pow, rho_F,
        rhoF, smul_pow, smul_assoc, smul_assoc, he, smul_assoc, smul_smul, smul_smul,
        smul_smul, zpow_add₀ (NeZero.ne _), zpow_natCast, pow_mul]
      ring_nf
    rw [key]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (dE_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ i n
      ⟨x, negIntegral_of_mem_canonicalBasis hx, rfl⟩)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, smul_algebra_smul_comm, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rho_quotientMinus_smul_mem_hwIntegral
statement:
lemma rho_quotientMinus_smul_mem_hwIntegral {z : Quotient D 𝕧} (hz : z ∈ quotientIntegralForm D)
    {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ) :
    rho R 𝕧 (quotientMinus R z) • m ∈ hwIntegral Λ
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Algebra.adjoin_induction generalizing m with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨i, n, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [quotientIntegralGenerator, map_qDivPow', quotientMinus_θ]
    exact rho_qDivPow_F_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ i n hm
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [show algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Quotient D 𝕧) c =
      algebraMap 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) (integralLaurentEval c) from rfl, AlgHom.commutes,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, rho_one, smul_assoc, one_smul,
      ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hm
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, add_smul]; exact add_mem (ha hm) (hb hm)
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_mul, rho_mul, mul_smul]; exact hb (ha hm)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_formL_hwv
statement:
lemma isLaurent_formL_hwv {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ) :
    Modified.IsLaurent (formL hvt hR Λ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [formL_hwv_left, ← repr_canonicalBasisHWBasis_one]
  exact isLaurent_repr_of_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ hm _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isLaurent_formL
statement:
theorem isLaurent_formL {x y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hx : x ∈ hwIntegral Λ)
    (hy : y ∈ hwIntegral Λ) : Modified.IsLaurent (formL hvt hR Λ x y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [evq_eq_quotientMinus_smul,
    IrreducibleModule.isContravariant_form hR (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt)]
  exact isLaurent_formL_hwv hR Λ (rho_quotientMinus_smul_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ hz hy)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_repr_eq_of_mem_smul_lat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hm
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := repr_mem_of_mem_lat hR hfund Λ hn b
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 ϖ n, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← ha, map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.notMem_smul_lat_of_repr_eq_one
statement:
lemma notMem_smul_lat_of_repr_eq_one {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
    (hb : (𝔅).repr m b = 1) : m ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  intro hm
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_repr_eq_of_mem_smul_lat hR hfund Λ hm b
  rw [hb, ← map_one (algebraMap A 𝕂)] at ha
  have hu : IsUnit ϖ := IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one a (InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap ha).symm
  exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal hu

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.smul_lat_le
statement: lemma smul_lat_le : ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ ≤ lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).1 hm
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_evq_sub_fW_mem
statement:
lemma exists_evq_sub_fW_mem (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    ∃ w : List I, evq hvt Λ (b : Um D 𝕧) - fW hvt hR Λ w ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, c, hc⟩ := (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ b.2)
  refine ⟨(Quotient.out c).1, ?_⟩
  have hc' : (b : Um D 𝕧) = negGlobal D ν c := by exact hc
  rw [hc', show evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν c) - fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out c).1 =
      evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν c - fWi hvt (Quotient.out c).1) +
        (evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt (Quotient.out c).1) - fW hvt hR Λ (Quotient.out c).1) by
    rw [map_sub]; abel]
  exact add_mem (evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν c) Λ)
    (evq_fWord_sub_fW_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
      InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund _ Λ)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_formL_evq_eq
statement:
theorem exists_formL_evq_eq (b b' : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    ∃ a : A, formL hvt hR Λ (evq hvt Λ b) (evq hvt Λ b') =
      (if b = b' then 1 else 0) + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' hvt
  have hL : ∀ w, fW hvt hR Λ w ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ :=
    IrreducibleModule.fWord_mem_lattice hR hv' Λ.2 A
  have hrb : ∀ b₀ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ, (𝔅).repr (evq hvt Λ b₀) b₀ = 1 := fun b₀ ↦ by
    rw [← canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply Λ hR, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_evq_sub_fW_mem hR hfund Λ b
  obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := exists_evq_sub_fW_mem hR hfund Λ b'
  set d := evq hvt Λ (b : Um D 𝕧) - fW hvt hR Λ w
  set d' := evq hvt Λ (b' : Um D 𝕧) - fW hvt hR Λ w'
  have e : evq hvt Λ (b : Um D 𝕧) = fW hvt hR Λ w + d := by simp only [d]; abel
  have e' : evq hvt Λ (b' : Um D 𝕧) = fW hvt hR Λ w' + d' := by simp only [d']; abel
  have hwL : fW hvt hR Λ w ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro h
    exact notMem_smul_lat_of_repr_eq_one hR hfund Λ b (hrb b) (e ▸ add_mem h hw)
  have hwL' : fW hvt hR Λ w' ∉ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
    intro h
    exact notMem_smul_lat_of_repr_eq_one hR hfund Λ b' (hrb b') (e' ▸ add_mem h hw')
  have hiff : (fW hvt hR Λ w - fW hvt hR Λ w' ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ) ↔ b = b' := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hne
      have h₁ : evq hvt Λ (b : Um D 𝕧) - evq hvt Λ (b' : Um D 𝕧) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
        rw [e, e', show fW hvt hR Λ w + d - (fW hvt hR Λ w' + d') =
          (fW hvt hR Λ w - fW hvt hR Λ w') + (d - d') by abel]
        exact add_mem h (sub_mem hw hw')
      refine notMem_smul_lat_of_repr_eq_one hR hfund Λ b ?_ h₁
      rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, hrb, ← canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply Λ hR,
        Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne, sub_zero]
    · rintro rfl
      rw [show fW hvt hR Λ w - fW hvt hR Λ w' = d' - d by simp only [d, d']; abel]
      exact sub_mem hw' hw
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := formL_fW_fW InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund Λ w w' hwL hwL'
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := formL_mem_smul InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund Λ (hL w) hw'
  obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂⟩ := formL_mem_smul InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund Λ (hL w') hw
  obtain ⟨a₃, ha₃⟩ := formL_mem_smul InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
    InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
    InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund Λ (smul_lat_le hR Λ hw) hw'
  refine ⟨a₀ + a₁ + a₂ + a₃, ?_⟩
  rw [e, e']
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [ha₀, ha₁, ha₃, IrreducibleModule.form_comm hR hv' d, ha₂, if_congr hiff rfl rfl]
  simp only [mul_add, map_add]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_of_isLaurent
statement:
lemma isNegLaurent_of_isLaurent {c : 𝕂} (hc : Modified.IsLaurent c) (a : A)
    (h : c = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a)) : IsNegLaurent c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hc
  have ha : algebraMap A 𝕂 a = integralLaurentEval (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * f) := by
    rw [map_mul, InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer] at h
    rw [map_mul, integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_one, h, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne _), one_mul]
  have := isIntInv_of_algebraMap_eq _ a ha
  rwa [IsIntInv, map_mul, integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_one, ← mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne _), one_mul] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub_of_fund
statement:
theorem isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub_of_fund (b b' : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    IsNegLaurent (formL hvt hR Λ (evq hvt Λ b) (evq hvt Λ b') - if b = b' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_formL_evq_eq hR hfund Λ b b'
  have hint : ∀ b₀ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ, evq hvt Λ (b₀ : Um D 𝕧) ∈ hwIntegral Λ :=
    fun b₀ ↦ ⟨b₀, negIntegral_of_mem_canonicalBasis (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ b₀.2), rfl⟩
  refine isNegLaurent_of_isLaurent ?_ a (by rw [ha]; ring)
  refine (isLaurent_formL hR Λ (hint b) (hint b')).sub ?_
  split_ifs
  · exact Modified.isLaurent_one
  · exact Modified.isLaurent_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.formL_hwTransfer
statement:
lemma formL_hwTransfer (x y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    formL hvt hR' Λ' (hwTransfer hR hR' h x) (hwTransfer hR hR' h y) = formL hvt hR Λ x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective Λ x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective Λ y
  rw [hwTransfer_ev, hwTransfer_ev, ev_apply, ev_apply, ev_apply, ev_apply,
    IrreducibleModule.form_mk, IrreducibleModule.form_mk, ← VermaModule.shapF_apply,
    ← VermaModule.shapF_apply, VermaModule.shapF_eq_shapZ, VermaModule.shapF_eq_shapZ]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [VermaModule.zcoef, h]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub
statement:
theorem isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub (b b' : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    IsNegLaurent (formL hvt hR Λ (evq hvt Λ b) (evq hvt Λ b') - if b = b' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := domFreeCoroot_coroot Λ
  have hR₁ := isXRegular_freeCoroot hR
  set e := Set.equivOfEq (canonicalBasisHW_eq h).symm
  have := isNegLaurent_formL_evq_sub_of_fund hR₁ exists_fund_freeCoroot (domFreeCoroot Λ)
    (e b) (e b')
  rw [show ((e b : canonicalBasisHW D (domFreeCoroot Λ)) : Um D 𝕧) = b from
    rfl, show ((e b' : canonicalBasisHW D (domFreeCoroot Λ)) : Um D 𝕧) = b' from rfl,
    ← hwTransfer_evq hR hR₁ h, ← hwTransfer_evq hR hR₁ h, formL_hwTransfer] at this
  convert this using 2
  simp only [e.injective.eq_iff]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_mem_range_of_mem_span
statement:
lemma repr_mem_range_of_mem_span {s : Set M} (hs : ∀ m ∈ s, ∀ i, B.repr m i ∈ f.range) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ Submodule.span S s) (i : ι) : B.repr m i ∈ f.range
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem m hm => exact hs m hm i
  | zero => rw [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    rw [hsmul, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_mem ⟨c, rfl⟩ ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_evq_mem
statement:
lemma repr_evq_mem {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D) (S : Subring 𝕂)
    (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) : (𝔅).repr (evq hvt Λ x) b ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx' : x ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ
  · have he : evq hvt Λ x = 𝔅 ⟨x, hx'⟩ := (canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply Λ hR ⟨x, hx'⟩).symm
    rw [he, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact one_mem S
    · exact zero_mem S
  · rw [evq_eq_zero_of_notMem_canonicalBasisHW Λ hR hx hx', map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    exact zero_mem S

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_mem_of_mem_span_evq
statement:
lemma repr_mem_of_mem_span_evq {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Module S (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)]
    (f : S →+* 𝕂) (hsmul : ∀ (c : S) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1), c • m = f c • m)
    {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ Submodule.span S (evq hvt Λ '' canonicalBasis D))
    (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) : (𝔅).repr m b ∈ f.range
proof:
:=
  repr_mem_range_of_mem_span f hsmul 𝔅 (by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ b
    exact repr_evq_mem hR Λ hx _ b) hm b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_mem_of_mem_hwIntegral
statement:
theorem repr_mem_of_mem_hwIntegral {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ hwIntegral Λ)
    (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    (𝔅).repr m b ∈ (integralLaurentEval : LaurentPolynomial ℤ →+* 𝕂).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hm
  rw [← span_canonicalBasis_laurent] at hx
  refine repr_mem_of_mem_span_evq hR Λ integralLaurentEval (hw_laurent_smul_eq Λ) ?_ b
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a c _ _ ha hc => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hc
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← hw_laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lat_inf_wsp_le_span
statement:
theorem lat_inf_wsp_le_span (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    lat hvt hR A Λ ⊓ (wsp Λ ν).restrictScalars A ≤
      Submodule.span A (Set.range fun b : negCrystal D ν ↦ evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν b))
proof:
:= by
  have hv' := pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X
  set M : Submodule A (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) := lat hvt hR A Λ ⊓ (wsp Λ ν).restrictScalars A
  set N := Submodule.span A (Set.range fun b : negCrystal D ν ↦ evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν b))
  have hMfg : M.FG := by
    have := (wtN_fg Λ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) :
      (wtN hvt hR A Λ (Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν)).FG).map
      (lat hvt hR A Λ).subtype
    convert this using 1
    ext y
    simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, Submodule.mem_map,
      Submodule.subtype_apply, M]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, hyw⟩; exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, (mem_wtN).2 hyw, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y.2, (mem_wtN).1 hy⟩
  have hϖ0 : algebraMap A 𝕂 ϖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer]; exact inv_ne_zero (NeZero.ne 𝕧)
  have hle : M ≤ N ⊔ Ideal.span {ϖ} • M := by
    intro y ⟨hy, hyw⟩
    have key : ∀ z ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ, weightSetProj hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) {Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν} z ∈
        Submodule.span A (fW hvt hR Λ '' {w | wordWeight w = ν}) := by
      intro z hz
      induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
        obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
        rw [weightSetProj_fW]
        · split_ifs with h
          · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, h, rfl⟩
          · exact zero_mem _
        · exact transcendental_ratFunc_X
      | zero => simp
      | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
      | smul c a _ ha =>
        rw [← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 c a, map_smul, algebraMap_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha
    have hP : weightSetProj hv' (isInt hvt hR Λ) {Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν} y = y := by
      rw [weightSetProj_of_mem _ _ _ hyw]; simp
    have hy' := key y hy
    rw [hP] at hy'
    refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) hy'
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    set b : negCrystal D ν := Quotient.mk _ ⟨w, hw⟩
    have hout : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt w ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
      Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D ν) ⟨w, hw⟩
    have hd : fW hvt hR Λ w - evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν b) ∈ ϖ • lat hvt hR A Λ := by
      have e : fW hvt hR Λ w - evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν b) =
          -(evq hvt Λ (fWi hvt w) - fW hvt hR Λ w) -
            evq hvt Λ ((negGlobal D ν b - fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1) +
              (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt w)) := by
        rw [map_add, map_sub, map_sub]; abel
      rw [e]
      refine sub_mem (neg_mem (evq_fWord_sub_fW_mem InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
        InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
        InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund w Λ)) ?_
      exact evq_mem_smul_lat' hfund (add_mem (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b) hout) Λ
    have hdw : fW hvt hR Λ w - evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν b) ∈ wsp Λ ν :=
      sub_mem (hw ▸ fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w) (evq_mem_wsp hR (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1 Λ)
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hz₀w, hz⟩ := TensorModule.exists_smul_weight hϖ0 hd hdw
    have e : fW hvt hR Λ w = evq hvt Λ (negGlobal D ν b) + ϖ • z₀ := by rw [← hz]; abel
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, rfl⟩))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self ϖ)
        ⟨hz₀, hz₀w⟩))
  have hjac : Ideal.span {ϖ} ≤ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal A) := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top, Ideal.span_le,
      Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
  exact Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot hMfg hjac hle

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.lat_le_span
statement: theorem lat_le_span : lat hvt hR A Λ ≤ Submodule.span A (evq hvt Λ '' canonicalBasis D)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have h := lat_inf_wsp_le_span hR hfund Λ (wordWeight w)
    ⟨Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, rfl⟩, fW_mem_wsp hvt hR Λ w⟩
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ h
  rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).2 ⟨_, b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_mem_of_mem_lat
statement:
theorem repr_mem_of_mem_lat {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ lat hvt hR A Λ)
    (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) : (𝔅).repr m b ∈ (algebraMap A 𝕂).range
proof:
:=
  repr_mem_of_mem_span_evq hR Λ (algebraMap A 𝕂) (fun c m ↦ (algebraMap_smul 𝕂 c m).symm)
    (lat_le_span hR hfund Λ hm) b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorHWBasis_apply
statement:
lemma tensorHWBasis_apply (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂ p =
      TensorModule.mk _ _ (evq hvt Λ₁ (p.1 : Um D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] evq hvt Λ₂ (p.2 : Um D 𝕧))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHWBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply',
    canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply, canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorHWBasis_mk
statement:
lemma repr_tensorHWBasis_mk (x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1) (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    (tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr (TensorModule.mk _ _ (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y)) p =
      (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ₁ hR).repr x p.1 * (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ₂ hR).repr y p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHWBasis, Module.Basis.map_repr, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    ← Prod.mk.eta (p := p), Module.Basis.tensorProduct_repr_tmul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorHWBasis_mk_mem
statement:
lemma repr_tensorHWBasis_mk_mem (S : Subring 𝕂) {x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1}
    {y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1} (hx : ∀ b, (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ₁ hR).repr x b ∈ S)
    (hy : ∀ b, (canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ₂ hR).repr y b ∈ S)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    (tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr (TensorModule.mk _ _ (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y)) p ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [repr_tensorHWBasis_mk]
  exact mul_mem (hx _) (hy _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_mem_of_mem_LL
statement:
theorem repr_mem_of_mem_LL {z : TensorModule 𝕂 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1)
    (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1)} (hz : z ∈ LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    (tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr z p ∈ (algebraMap A 𝕂).range
proof:
:= by
  refine repr_mem_range_of_mem_span (algebraMap A 𝕂) (fun c m ↦ (algebraMap_smul 𝕂 c m).symm)
    _ ?_ hz p
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ p
  exact repr_tensorHWBasis_mk_mem hR Λ₁ Λ₂ (algebraMap A 𝕂).range
    (repr_mem_of_mem_lat hR hfund Λ₁ hx) (repr_mem_of_mem_lat hR hfund Λ₂ hy) p

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.laurent_eq_zero_of_invert_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply integralLaurentEval_injective
  rw [map_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_laurent_regular_uniformizer c a ha (ϖ * a : LocalRing) ?_
  have h : integralLaurentEval c = RatFunc.bar (integralLaurentEval c) := by
    rw [bar_integralLaurentEval, hc]
  rw [h, ← ha]
  change _ = RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar _)
  rw [RatFunc.bar_bar]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_eq_of_linearCombination_mem
statement:
lemma exists_eq_of_linearCombination_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (c : negCrystal D ν →₀ LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
    (h : Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D ν) c ∈
      ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    ∃ a : A, algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * a) = integralLaurentEval (c b)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  by_cases hb : b ∈ c.support
  · rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] at h
    simp_rw [laurent_smul_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (residueIndependent_negGlobalLift D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum (globalBelow D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
        D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum ν)).exists_eq_of_sum_mem_smul
      InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap irreducible_localX.ne_zero
      InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul c.support (fun b ↦ integralLaurentEval (c b)) h b hb
    exact ⟨a, ha.symm⟩
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hb]
    exact ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_linearCombination
statement:
lemma negBar_linearCombination {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (c : negCrystal D ν →₀ LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    negBar D (Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D ν) c) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D ν)
        (c.mapRange LaurentPolynomial.invert (map_zero _))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (fun b ↦ zero_smul _ (negGlobal D ν b)), Finsupp.sum,
    Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ ↦ ?_
  rw [negBar_laurent_smul, negBar_negGlobal]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.invert_eq_of_negBar_eq
statement:
lemma invert_eq_of_negBar_eq {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (c : negCrystal D ν →₀ LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
    (h : negBar D (Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D ν) c) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D ν) c) (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    LaurentPolynomial.invert (c b) = c b
proof:
:= by
  rw [negBar_linearCombination] at h
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (linearIndependent_negGlobal_laurent D ν h) b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.wordWeight_replicate_append

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negDepthGe_negCrystalF

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kE_negGlobal_mem
statement:
lemma kE_negGlobal_mem {i : I} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν} (hb : ¬ NegDepthGe D i 1 b) :
    kE hvt i (negGlobal D ν b) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h1 := kE_mem_smul_latInf_ratFunc D i (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b)
  rw [map_sub] at h1
  have h2 : kE (D := D) hvt i (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
    fun h' ↦ h (by rw [← sub_add_cancel (kE hvt i (negGlobal D ν b))
      (kE hvt i (fWi hvt (Quotient.out b).1))]; exact add_mem h1 h')
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_fWi_sub_mem_of_kE_pow D i 1 (by rwa [pow_one])
  exact hb ⟨u, hu⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_negGlobal_sub_mem_span
statement:
theorem df_negGlobal_sub_mem_span {i : I} (n : ℕ) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν}
    (hb : ¬ NegDepthGe D i 1 b) :
    (bosv i).df n (negGlobal D ν b) - negGlobal D (ν + Finsupp.single i n) (negCrystalF D i n b) ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D (ν + Finsupp.single i n) ''
        {b'' | NegDepthGe D i (n + 1) b''})
proof:
:= by
  set μ := ν + Finsupp.single i n
  set g := negGlobal D ν b
  have hg := negGlobal_mem D ν b
  set c := negCrystalF D i n b
  have hw : μ - Finsupp.single i n = ν := add_tsub_cancel_right _ _
  have hn : n ≤ μ i := by simp [μ]
  have hgw : g ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (μ - Finsupp.single i n) := hw ▸ hg.2.1
  have hcw : comp hvt i 0 g ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (μ - Finsupp.single i n) := by
    have := @component_mem_Uw _ _ _ _ D _ _ _ transcendental_ratFunc_X i _ g hg.2.1 0
    rw [Finsupp.single_zero, tsub_zero] at this
    exact hw ▸ this
  have hx : (bosv i).df n g ∈ negFilt D i n μ := df_mem_negFilt D i le_rfl hn hg.1 hgw
  have hxy := df_sub_df_comp_mem_negFilt D i hn hg.1 hgw
  
  have hyc : (bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 g) - negGlobal D μ c ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    have h1 := df_comp_sub_kF_pow_mem D i n (kE_negGlobal_mem D hb)
    have h2 := kF_pow_mem_smul_latInf D i n (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b)
    rw [map_sub, kF_pow_fWi] at h2
    have h3 : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out c).1 -
        fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
      Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D μ) _
    have h4 := negGlobal_sub_mem D μ c
    have e : (bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 g) - negGlobal D μ c =
        ((bosv i).df n (comp hvt i 0 g) - (kF hvt i ^ n) g) +
        ((kF hvt i ^ n) g - fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1)) -
        (fWi hvt (Quotient.out c).1 - fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1)) -
        (negGlobal D μ c - fWi hvt (Quotient.out c).1) := by abel
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem (sub_mem (add_mem h1 h2) h3) h4
  
  have hGc := negGlobal_mem D μ c
  have hd := mem_span_negGlobal D (sub_mem (mem_negFilt_le D hx).1 hGc.1)
    (sub_mem (mem_negFilt_le D hx).2 hGc.2.1)
  rw [← Finsupp.range_linearCombination] at hd
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hd
  obtain ⟨h, hhS, hh⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination _).1
    (negFilt_le_span D i (n + 1) μ hxy)
  have hbar : negBar D ((bosv i).df n g - negGlobal D μ c) = (bosv i).df n g - negGlobal D μ c := by
    rw [map_sub, negBar_df, negBar_negGlobal, negBar_negGlobal]
  rw [← hf] at hbar
  have hinv := invert_eq_of_negBar_eq D f hbar
  have hres := exists_eq_of_linearCombination_mem D (f - h) (by
    rw [map_sub, hf, hh]
    convert hyc using 1
    abel)
  rw [← hf, Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination]
  refine ⟨f, fun b' hb' ↦ ?_, rfl⟩
  by_contra hbS
  have h0 : h b' = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 fun h' ↦ hbS (hhS h')
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hres b'
  rw [Finsupp.sub_apply, h0, sub_zero] at ha
  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hb' (laurent_eq_zero_of_invert_eq (hinv b') ha)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kE_pow_kF_pow_self
statement:
lemma kE_pow_kF_pow_self (i : I) (n : ℕ) (y : Um D 𝕧) :
    (kE hvt i ^ n) ((kF hvt i ^ n) y) = y
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing y with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, kE_kF, ih]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fWi_sub_mem_of_replicate
statement:
lemma fWi_sub_mem_of_replicate (i : I) (n : ℕ) {u u' : List I}
    (h : fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u) - fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u') ∈
      ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    fWi (D := D) hvt u - fWi hvt u' ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  have := kE_pow_mem_smul_latInf_ratFunc D i n h
  rwa [← kF_pow_fWi, ← kF_pow_fWi, ← map_sub, kE_pow_kF_pow_self] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fWi_replicate_sub_mem
statement:
lemma fWi_replicate_sub_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ) {u u' : List I}
    (h : fWi (D := D) hvt u - fWi hvt u' ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u) - fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u') ∈
      ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  have := kF_pow_mem_smul_latInf D i n h
  rwa [map_sub, kF_pow_fWi, kF_pow_fWi] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.fWi_out_negCrystalF_sub_mem
statement:
lemma fWi_out_negCrystalF_sub_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (b : negCrystal D ν) :
    fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out (negCrystalF D i n b)).1 -
      fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:=
  Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D (ν + Finsupp.single i n)) _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negCrystalF_injective
statement:
lemma negCrystalF_injective (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (negCrystalF D i n (ν := ν))
proof:
:= by
  intro b₁ b₂ h
  rw [← Quotient.out_eq b₁, ← Quotient.out_eq b₂]
  refine Quotient.sound (fWi_sub_mem_of_replicate D i n ?_)
  exact Quotient.exact h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.not_negDepthGe_negCrystalF
statement:
lemma not_negDepthGe_negCrystalF {i : I} (n : ℕ) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν}
    (hb : ¬ NegDepthGe D i 1 b) : ¬ NegDepthGe D i (n + 1) (negCrystalF D i n b)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
  refine hb ⟨u, fWi_sub_mem_of_replicate D i n ?_⟩
  have e : fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1) -
      fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (List.replicate 1 i ++ u)) =
      (fWi hvt (Quotient.out (negCrystalF D i n b)).1 -
        fWi hvt (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u)) -
      (fWi hvt (Quotient.out (negCrystalF D i n b)).1 -
        fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1)) := by
    rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.replicate_add]
    abel
  rw [e]
  exact sub_mem hu (fWi_out_negCrystalF_sub_mem D i n b)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_negCrystalF_eq
statement:
lemma exists_negCrystalF_eq {i : I} {n : ℕ} {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {c : negCrystal D μ}
    (hn : NegDepthGe D i n c) (hn' : ¬ NegDepthGe D i (n + 1) c) :
    ∃ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν) (h : ν + Finsupp.single i n = μ),
      ¬ NegDepthGe D i 1 b ∧ h ▸ negCrystalF D i n b = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hn
  set b : negCrystal D (wordWeight u) := Quotient.mk _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
  have hbu : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out b).1 - fWi hvt u ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
    Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D (wordWeight u)) _
  have hμ : wordWeight u + Finsupp.single i n = μ := by
    rw [← wordWeight_replicate_append, ← (Quotient.out c).2]
    exact (wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem_ratFunc D hu).symm
  
  have hcb : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out c).1 -
      fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    have h := fWi_replicate_sub_mem D i n hbu
    rw [← sub_sub_sub_cancel_right _ _ (fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u))]
    exact sub_mem hu h
  refine ⟨wordWeight u, b, hμ, fun ⟨u', hu'⟩ ↦ hn' ⟨u', ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have h := fWi_replicate_sub_mem D i n hu'
    rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.replicate_add] at h
    rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel _ (fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ (Quotient.out b).1))]
    exact add_mem hcb h
  · subst hμ
    exact (eq_mk_of_sub_mem D _ hcb).symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobal_ne_zero
statement: lemma negGlobal_ne_zero {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (b : negCrystal D ν) : negGlobal D ν b ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  negGlobal_notMem D ν b (h ▸ zero_mem _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobal_ne_neg
statement: lemma negGlobal_ne_neg {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (b : negCrystal D ν) : negGlobal D ν b ≠ -negGlobal D ν b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 : (2 : 𝕂) • negGlobal D ν b = 0 := by
    rw [two_smul]
    nth_rw 1 [h]
    exact neg_add_cancel _
  exact negGlobal_ne_zero D b ((smul_eq_zero.1 h2).resolve_left two_ne_zero)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signed_mem_Uw
statement:
lemma signed_mem_Uw {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν} {y : Um D 𝕧}
    (hy : y = negGlobal D ν b ∨ y = -negGlobal D ν b) : y ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy with rfl | rfl
  · exact (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1
  · exact neg_mem (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signed_mem_span
statement:
lemma signed_mem_span {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν} {S : Set (negCrystal D ν)} (hb : b ∈ S)
    {y : Um D 𝕧} (hy : y = negGlobal D ν b ∨ y = -negGlobal D ν b) :
    y ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D ν '' S)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy with rfl | rfl
  · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  · exact neg_mem (Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signed_eq_signed
statement:
lemma signed_eq_signed {μ₁ μ₂ : I →₀ ℕ} {c₁ : negCrystal D μ₁} {c₂ : negCrystal D μ₂}
    {y : Um D 𝕧} (h₁ : y = negGlobal D μ₁ c₁ ∨ y = -negGlobal D μ₁ c₁)
    (h₂ : y = negGlobal D μ₂ c₂ ∨ y = -negGlobal D μ₂ c₂) :
    ∃ h : μ₁ = μ₂, h ▸ c₁ = c₂
proof:
:= by
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rcases h₁ with rfl | rfl
    · exact negGlobal_ne_zero D c₁
    · exact neg_ne_zero.2 (negGlobal_ne_zero D c₁)
  have hμ : μ₁ = μ₂ := by
    by_contra hμ
    have e₁ := proj_of_mem_Uw (signed_mem_Uw D h₁) (toZ μ₁)
    rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (signed_mem_Uw D h₂), ite_eq_left rfl,
      ite_eq_right fun e ↦ hμ (LusztigF.toZ_injective e).symm] at e₁
    exact hy0 e₁.symm
  subst hμ
  have hc : c₁ = c₂ := by
    by_contra hc
    have hd := (linearIndependent_negGlobal_laurent D μ₁).disjoint_span_image
      (s := {c₁}) (t := {c₂}) (Set.disjoint_singleton.2 hc)
    exact hy0 ((Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hd) y (signed_mem_span D (Set.mem_singleton _) h₁)
      (signed_mem_span D (Set.mem_singleton _) h₂))
  exact ⟨rfl, hc⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.proj_mem_span_of_mem_span_signedBasisGe
statement:
lemma proj_mem_span_of_mem_span_signedBasisGe {i : I} {m : ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGe D i m)) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (toZ μ) x ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D μ '' {b | NegDepthGe D i m b})
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨ν, b, hb, hx⟩ := (mem_signedBasisGe_iff D).1 hx
    rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (signed_mem_Uw D hx)]
    split_ifs with h
    · obtain rfl := LusztigF.toZ_injective h
      exact signed_mem_span D hb hx
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    rw [laurent_smul_eq, map_smul, ← laurent_smul_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_of_sub_mem_span_signedBasisGe
statement:
theorem eq_of_sub_mem_span_signedBasisGe {i : I} {n : ℕ} {y₁ y₂ : Um D 𝕧}
    (h₁ : y₁ ∈ signedBasisAt D i n) (h₂ : y₂ ∈ signedBasisAt D i n)
    (h : y₁ - y₂ ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGe D i (n + 1))) :
    y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ₁, c₁, -, hc₁, hy₁⟩ := (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).1 h₁
  obtain ⟨μ₂, c₂, -, hc₂, hy₂⟩ := (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).1 h₂
  have hp := proj_mem_span_of_mem_span_signedBasisGe D h μ₁
  rw [map_sub, proj_of_mem_Uw (signed_mem_Uw D hy₁), proj_of_mem_Uw (signed_mem_Uw D hy₂),
    ite_eq_left rfl] at hp
  have hlin := linearIndependent_negGlobal_laurent D μ₁
  by_cases hμ : toZ μ₂ = toZ μ₁
  · obtain rfl := LusztigF.toZ_injective hμ
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl] at hp
    have hd := hlin.disjoint_span_image (s := {c₁, c₂}) (t := {b | NegDepthGe D i (n + 1) b})
      (by
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        rintro c (rfl | rfl)
        exacts [hc₁, hc₂])
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 ((Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hd) _
      (sub_mem (signed_mem_span D (by simp) hy₁) (signed_mem_span D (by simp) hy₂)) hp)
  · rw [ite_eq_right fun e ↦ hμ e, sub_zero] at hp
    have hd := hlin.disjoint_span_image (s := {c₁}) (t := {b | NegDepthGe D i (n + 1) b})
      (Set.disjoint_singleton_left.2 hc₁)
    have h0 := (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hd) _ (signed_mem_span D (Set.mem_singleton _) hy₁) hp
    rcases hy₁ with rfl | rfl
    · exact absurd h0 (negGlobal_ne_zero D c₁)
    · exact absurd h0 (neg_ne_zero.2 (negGlobal_ne_zero D c₁))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_negGlobal_le_span_signedBasisGe
statement:
lemma span_negGlobal_le_span_signedBasisGe (i : I) (m : ℕ) (μ : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (negGlobal D μ '' {b | NegDepthGe D i m b}) ≤
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGe D i m)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_
  rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  exact (mem_signedBasisGe_iff D).2 ⟨μ, b, hb, Or.inl rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_signed_sub_mem_span
proof:
:= by
  have h := span_negGlobal_le_span_signedBasisGe D i (n + 1) (ν + Finsupp.single i n)
    (df_negGlobal_sub_mem_span D n hb)
  rcases hxy with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact h
  · rw [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub]
    exact neg_mem h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.existsUnique_df_sub_mem_span
statement:
theorem existsUnique_df_sub_mem_span {i : I} (n : ℕ) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ signedBasisAt D i 0) :
    ∃! y, y ∈ signedBasisAt D i n ∧
      (bosv i).df n x - y ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGe D i (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, b, -, hb, hx⟩ := (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).1 hx
  have hy : ∀ y, (y = negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b) ∨
      y = -negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b)) → y ∈ signedBasisAt D i n := fun y hy ↦
    (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).2 ⟨_, negCrystalF D i n b, negDepthGe_negCrystalF D i n b,
      not_negDepthGe_negCrystalF D n hb, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, y ∈ signedBasisAt D i n ∧ (bosv i).df n x - y ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGe D i (n + 1)) := by
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨_, hy _ (Or.inl rfl), df_signed_sub_mem_span D n hb (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩
    · exact ⟨_, hy _ (Or.inr rfl), df_signed_sub_mem_span D n hb (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩
  refine ⟨y, hy, fun y' hy' ↦ eq_of_sub_mem_span_signedBasisGe D hy'.1 hy.1 ?_⟩
  have := sub_mem hy.2 hy'.2
  rwa [sub_sub_sub_cancel_left] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_sub_signedStringMap_mem_span
statement:
lemma df_sub_signedStringMap_mem_span (i : I) (n : ℕ) (x : signedBasisAt D i 0) :
    (bosv i).df n x - signedStringMap D i n x ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGe D i (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  (existsUnique_df_sub_mem_span D n x.2).exists.choose_spec.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signedStringMap_eq
statement:
lemma signedStringMap_eq {i : I} {n : ℕ} (x : signedBasisAt D i 0) {y : Um D 𝕧}
    (hy : y ∈ signedBasisAt D i n)
    (h : (bosv i).df n x - y ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (signedBasisGe D i (n + 1))) :
    (signedStringMap D i n x : Um D 𝕧) = y
proof:
:=
  (existsUnique_df_sub_mem_span D n x.2).unique
    ⟨(signedStringMap D i n x).2, df_sub_signedStringMap_mem_span D i n x⟩ ⟨hy, h⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signedStringMap_signed
proof:
:= by
  refine signedStringMap_eq D x ((mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).2 ⟨_, negCrystalF D i n b,
    negDepthGe_negCrystalF D i n b, not_negDepthGe_negCrystalF D n hb, ?_⟩)
    (df_signed_sub_mem_span D n hb hxy)
  rcases hxy with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
  exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signedStringMap_bijective
statement: theorem signedStringMap_bijective (i : I) (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (signedStringMap D i n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x₁ x₂ h ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨ν₁, b₁, -, hb₁, hx₁⟩ := (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).1 x₁.2
    obtain ⟨ν₂, b₂, -, hb₂, hx₂⟩ := (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).1 x₂.2
    have e₁ : ∀ y, ((x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = negGlobal D ν₁ b₁ ∧ y = negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₁)) ∨
        ((x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = -negGlobal D ν₁ b₁ ∧ y = -negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₁)) →
        (signedStringMap D i n x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = y := fun y ↦ signedStringMap_signed D x₁ hb₁
    have e₂ : ∀ y, ((x₂ : Um D 𝕧) = negGlobal D ν₂ b₂ ∧ y = negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₂)) ∨
        ((x₂ : Um D 𝕧) = -negGlobal D ν₂ b₂ ∧ y = -negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₂)) →
        (signedStringMap D i n x₂ : Um D 𝕧) = y := fun y ↦ signedStringMap_signed D x₂ hb₂
    have h' : (signedStringMap D i n x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = signedStringMap D i n x₂ := by rw [h]
    have hy₁ : (signedStringMap D i n x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₁) ∨
        (signedStringMap D i n x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = -negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₁) := by
      rcases hx₁ with hx₁ | hx₁
      · exact Or.inl (e₁ _ (Or.inl ⟨hx₁, rfl⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (e₁ _ (Or.inr ⟨hx₁, rfl⟩))
    have hy₂ : (signedStringMap D i n x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₂) ∨
        (signedStringMap D i n x₁ : Um D 𝕧) = -negGlobal D _ (negCrystalF D i n b₂) := by
      rw [h']
      rcases hx₂ with hx₂ | hx₂
      · exact Or.inl (e₂ _ (Or.inl ⟨hx₂, rfl⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (e₂ _ (Or.inr ⟨hx₂, rfl⟩))
    obtain ⟨hμ, hc⟩ := signed_eq_signed D hy₁ hy₂
    obtain rfl := add_right_cancel hμ
    obtain rfl := negCrystalF_injective D i n ν₁ hc
    apply Subtype.ext
    rcases hx₁ with hx₁ | hx₁ <;> rcases hx₂ with hx₂ | hx₂
    · rw [hx₁, hx₂]
    · have a₁ := e₁ _ (Or.inl ⟨hx₁, rfl⟩)
      have a₂ := e₂ _ (Or.inr ⟨hx₂, rfl⟩)
      rw [h', a₂] at a₁
      exact (negGlobal_ne_neg D _ a₁.symm).elim
    · have a₁ := e₁ _ (Or.inr ⟨hx₁, rfl⟩)
      have a₂ := e₂ _ (Or.inl ⟨hx₂, rfl⟩)
      rw [h', a₂] at a₁
      exact (negGlobal_ne_neg D _ a₁).elim
    · rw [hx₁, hx₂]
  · obtain ⟨μ, c, hcn, hcn', hy⟩ := (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).1 y.2
    obtain ⟨ν, b, hμ, hb, hc⟩ := exists_negCrystalF_eq D hcn hcn'
    subst hμ
    subst hc
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact ⟨⟨_, (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, negDepthGe_zero D i b, hb, Or.inl rfl⟩⟩,
        Subtype.ext (signedStringMap_signed D _ hb (Or.inl ⟨rfl, hy⟩))⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨_, (mem_signedBasisAt_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, negDepthGe_zero D i b, hb, Or.inr rfl⟩⟩,
        Subtype.ext (signedStringMap_signed D _ hb (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hy⟩))⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.X_pow_dvd_of_mul_localX_pow
statement:
lemma X_pow_dvd_of_mul_localX_pow (a : Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing) (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℤ)
    (h : a * localX ^ n = integerLocalPolynomial p) : Polynomial.X ^ n ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hz : p.coeff 0 = 0 := by
      have hh := congrArg residue h
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, residue_localX, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero n),
        mul_zero, residue_integerLocalPolynomial] at hh
      exact_mod_cast hh.symm
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mpr hz
    rw [pow_succ']
    refine mul_dvd_mul_left _ (ih q ?_)
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ irreducible_localX.ne_zero
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, h, map_mul]
    simp [integerLocalPolynomial, mul_comm]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_of_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem isIntInv_of_algebraMap_eq (f : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (a : A)
    (h : algebraMap A 𝕂 a = integralLaurentEval f) : IsIntInv (integralLaurentEval f)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : algebraMap Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing 𝕂 a = integralLaurentEval (invert f) := by
    have hh := congrArg RatFunc.bar h
    change RatFunc.bar (RatFunc.bar (algebraMap Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing 𝕂 a)) = _ at hh
    simpa only [RatFunc.bar_bar, bar_integralLaurentEval] using hh
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := exists_T_pow (invert f)
  have hloc : (show Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing from a) * localX ^ n = integerLocalPolynomial p := by
    apply injective_algebraMap_localRing
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, algebraMap_localX, map_integerLocalPolynomial, hp, map_mul,
      integralLaurentEval_T, hb]
    simp
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := X_pow_dvd_of_mul_localX_pow a n p hloc
  have hq : invert f = Polynomial.toLaurent q := by
    rw [map_mul, Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow, mul_comm] at hp
    exact ((isUnit_T (n : ℤ)).mul_left_inj).1 hp.symm
  refine ⟨T (-1) * f, fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [coeff_T_mul, show m - -1 = -(-(m + 1)) by ring, ← invert_apply, hq]
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : -(m + 1) ∈ (Polynomial.toLaurent q).coeff.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hne
    rw [support_coeff_toLaurent, Finset.mem_map] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := hmem
    change (k : ℤ) = -(m + 1) at hk
    omega
  · rw [map_mul, integralLaurentEval_T, zpow_neg_one]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_mem_range_of_mem_laurentSpan
statement:
lemma repr_mem_range_of_mem_laurentSpan {S : Set V}
    (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ i, B.repr s i ∈ (integralLaurentEval : LaurentPolynomial ℤ →+* 𝕂).range)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ laurentSpan S) (i : ι) :
    B.repr x i ∈ (integralLaurentEval : LaurentPolynomial ℤ →+* 𝕂).range
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, s, hs, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_mem ⟨LaurentPolynomial.T k, by rw [integralLaurentEval_T]⟩ (hS s hs i)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_zsmul, Finsupp.smul_apply]; exact zsmul_mem ha c

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qDivPow_F_smul_mem_laurentSpan
statement:
lemma qDivPow_F_smul_mem_laurentSpan (i : I) (n : ℕ)
    {z : TensorModule 𝕂 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₁.1) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1)}
    (hz : z ∈ laurentSpan (hwIntegralTensor Λ₁ Λ₂)) :
    qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) • z ∈ laurentSpan (hwIntegralTensor Λ₁ Λ₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_laurentSpan (DistribSMul.toLinearMap 𝕂 _ (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i)))
    ?_ hz
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, μ, y, hy, hyμ, rfl⟩
  rw [DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply, TensorModule.qDivPow_F_smul_tmul ratFunc_X_not_root i _ hyμ]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun p _ ↦
    laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan (Modified.isLaurent_vd_zpow _ _) ?_
  exact mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨_, dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ₁ i p.1 hx, _, _,
    dF_smul_mem_hwIntegral Λ₂ i p.2 hy, qDivPow_F_smul_mem_weightSpace hyμ i p.2, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorEmb_evq_mem_laurentSpan
statement:
theorem tensorEmb_evq_mem_laurentSpan {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D) :
    tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (evq hvt (Λ₁ + Λ₂) x) ∈
      laurentSpan (hwIntegralTensor Λ₁ Λ₂)
proof:
:= by
  have h : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (quotientIntegralForm D) :=
    (mem_negIntegral D x).1 hx
  rw [quotientIntegralForm, Algebra.adjoin_eq_span] at h
  rw [← (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm_apply_apply x]
  generalize negativeQuotientEquiv D x = y at h
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    induction hy using Submonoid.closure_induction_left with
    | one =>
      rw [← map_one (toQuotient D 𝕧), symm_toQuotient, evq_mk, ev_one]
      change tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 (Λ₁.1 + Λ₂.1)) ∈ _
      rw [tensorEmb_hwv]
      exact mem_laurentSpan_of_mem ⟨_, hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ₁, _, _, hwv_mem_hwIntegral Λ₂,
        IrreducibleModule.hwv_mem_weightSpace, rfl⟩
    | mul_left a ha y hy ih =>
      obtain ⟨j, n, rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨ν, z, -, rfl, -⟩ := exists_homogeneous_of_mem_closure D hy
      rw [symm_toQuotient, evq_mk] at ih
      rw [← toQuotient_qDivPow, ← map_mul, symm_toQuotient, evq_mk, ev_qDivPow_mul (Λ₁ + Λ₂),
        map_smul]
      exact qDivPow_F_smul_mem_laurentSpan Λ₁ Λ₂ j n ih
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
  | smul c y _ hy =>
    have : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (c • y) =
        integralLaurentEval c • (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm y :=
      map_smul (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralLaurentEval c) y
    rw [this, map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
    exact laurent_smul_mem_laurentSpan ⟨c, rfl⟩ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorEmb_evq_mem_range
statement:
theorem repr_tensorEmb_evq_mem_range {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negIntegral D)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    (tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (evq hvt (Λ₁ + Λ₂) x)) p ∈
      (integralLaurentEval : LaurentPolynomial ℤ →+* 𝕂).range
proof:
:= by
  refine repr_mem_range_of_mem_laurentSpan _ ?_ (tensorEmb_evq_mem_laurentSpan hR Λ₁ Λ₂ hx) p
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, μ, y, hy, -, rfl⟩ p
  exact repr_tensorHWBasis_mk_mem hR Λ₁ Λ₂ _ (repr_mem_of_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ₁ hx)
    (repr_mem_of_mem_hwIntegral hR Λ₂ hy) p

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_repr_tensorEmb_evq_of_fund
statement:
theorem isIntInv_repr_tensorEmb_evq_of_fund {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ₁ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂) :
    IsIntInv ((tensorHWBasis hR Λ₁ Λ₂).repr
      (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (evq hvt (Λ₁ + Λ₂) x)) p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, b, rfl⟩ := (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 hx
  have hG := negGlobal_mem D ν b
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := repr_tensorEmb_evq_mem_range hR Λ₁ Λ₂ hG.1 p
  have hL : tensorEmb hvt hR Λ₁.2 Λ₂.2 (evq hvt (Λ₁ + Λ₂) (negGlobal D ν b)) ∈
      LL hvt hR A Λ₁ Λ₂ :=
    tensorEmb_mem_LL InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
      InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
      (fun s ↦ (allProp InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap
        InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer
        InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul hfund s).1)
      (evq_mem_lat' hfund hG.2.2.1 (Λ₁ + Λ₂))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := repr_mem_of_mem_LL hR hfund Λ₁ Λ₂ hL p
  rw [← hf] at ha ⊢
  exact isIntInv_of_algebraMap_eq f a ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.chevalley_mapHom
statement:
lemma chevalley_mapHom (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    chevalley R' 𝕧 (mapHom 𝕧 φ u) = mapHom 𝕧 φ (chevalley R 𝕧 u)
proof:
:= by
  have : (chevalley R' 𝕧).comp (mapHom 𝕧 φ) = (mapHom 𝕧 φ).comp (chevalley R 𝕧) :=
    hom_ext (fun i ↦ by simp) (fun i ↦ by simp) (fun μ ↦ by simp)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.comul_mapHom
statement:
lemma comul_mapHom (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    comul R' 𝕧 (mapHom 𝕧 φ u) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (mapHom 𝕧 φ) (mapHom 𝕧 φ) (comul R 𝕧 u)
proof:
:= by
  have : (comul R' 𝕧).comp (mapHom 𝕧 φ) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (mapHom 𝕧 φ) (mapHom 𝕧 φ)).comp (comul R 𝕧) :=
    hom_ext (fun i ↦ by simp [Kt, Hom.map_ktilde]) (fun i ↦ by simp [Hom.map_ktilde])
      (fun μ ↦ by simp)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this u

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_quotientMinus
statement:
lemma mapHom_quotientMinus (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    mapHom 𝕧 φ (quotientMinus R x) = quotientMinus R' x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  rw [quotientMinus_toQuotient, quotientMinus_toQuotient]
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes]
  | grade1 i => simp [minusHom]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [_root_.map_mul, _root_.map_mul, ha, hb, _root_.map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mapHom_quotientPlus
statement:
lemma mapHom_quotientPlus (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    mapHom 𝕧 φ (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R' x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  rw [quotientPlus_toQuotient, quotientPlus_toQuotient]
  induction y using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes]
  | grade1 i => simp [plusHom]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [_root_.map_mul, _root_.map_mul, ha, hb, _root_.map_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_quasiR
statement:
lemma map_quasiR (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (mapHom 𝕧 φ) (mapHom 𝕧 φ) (quasiR R ν) = quasiR R' ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [quasiR, quasiR, map_smul]
  congr 1
  induction quasiRTensor D ν using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]
  | tmul a b =>
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
    simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, mapHom_quotientMinus, mapHom_quotientPlus]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_F_smul_hw
statement:
lemma E_smul_F_smul_hw {Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup Z] {R₀ : D.RootDatum Z} (Λ₀ : Z →+ ℤ)
    (i j : I) (x : IrreducibleModule R₀ 𝕧 Λ₀) :
    E R₀ 𝕧 i • F R₀ 𝕧 j • x = F R₀ 𝕧 j • E R₀ 𝕧 i • x + (if i = j then
      (𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R₀ 𝕧 i • x - K R₀ 𝕧 (-ktilde R₀ i) • x) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← sub_smul, E_mul_F_sub]
  split_ifs
  · rw [smul_assoc, sub_smul]
  · rw [zero_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coroot_eq_of_comp
statement: lemma coroot_eq_of_comp (i : I) : Λ'.1 (R'.coroot i) = Λ.1 (R.coroot i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwMap_F
statement:
lemma hwMap_F (i : I) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwMap hR hR' hΛ (F R 𝕧 i • m) = F R' 𝕧 i • hwMap hR hR' hΛ m
proof:
:=
  hwTransfer_F hR hR' _ i m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwMap_K
statement:
lemma hwMap_K (μ : Y) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwMap hR hR' hΛ (K R 𝕧 μ • m) = K R' 𝕧 (φ.toHom μ) • hwMap hR hR' hΛ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using hw_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [smul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul c a ha => rw [smul_comm, LinearEquiv.map_smul, ha, LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_comm]
  | hwv =>
    rw [hw_K_smul_hwv, LinearEquiv.map_smul, hwMap_hwv, hw_K_smul_hwv, hΛ,
      AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  | F i a ha =>
    rw [← mul_smul, K_mul_F, smul_assoc, mul_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul, hwMap_F, ha, hwMap_F,
      ← mul_smul (K R' 𝕧 _), K_mul_F, smul_assoc, mul_smul, φ.root_map]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwMap_E
statement:
lemma hwMap_E (i : I) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwMap hR hR' hΛ (E R 𝕧 i • m) = E R' 𝕧 i • hwMap hR hR' hΛ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using hw_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [smul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul c a ha => rw [smul_comm, LinearEquiv.map_smul, ha, LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_comm]
  | hwv =>
    rw [IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, map_zero, hwMap_hwv, IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv]
  | F j a ha =>
    rw [E_smul_F_smul_hw, map_add, hwMap_F, ha, hwMap_F, E_smul_F_smul_hw]
    congr 1
    split_ifs
    · rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, map_sub, Kt, hwMap_K, hwMap_K, map_neg, Hom.map_ktilde]
    · rw [map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwMap_smul
statement:
theorem hwMap_smul (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwMap hR hR' hΛ (u • m) = mapHom 𝕧 φ u • hwMap hR hR' hΛ m
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on generalizing m with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [algebraMap_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul, AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_smul]
  | E i => rw [hwMap_E, mapHom_E]
  | F i => rw [hwMap_F, mapHom_F]
  | K μ => rw [hwMap_K, mapHom_K]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_smul, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_smul]
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [mul_smul, hx, hy, _root_.map_mul, mul_smul]

lemma twMap_smul (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (m : TwL Λ) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_actPair
statement:
lemma pairMap_actPair (t : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) :
    pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ (TensorModule.actPair R 𝕧 _ _ t z) =
      TensorModule.actPair R' 𝕧 _ _ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (mapHom 𝕧 φ) (mapHom 𝕧 φ) t)
        (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]
  | tmul a b =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
    | tmul x y =>
      rw [TensorModule.act_tmul, pairMap_tmul, pairMap_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
        TensorModule.act_tmul, twMap_smul, hwMap_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_act
statement:
lemma pairMap_act (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) :
    pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u z) =
      TensorModule.act R' 𝕧 _ _ (mapHom 𝕧 φ u) (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TensorModule.act, AlgHom.comp_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_quasiRAct
statement:
lemma pairMap_quasiRAct (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) :
