      quasiRAct (isPlusLocallyNilpotent_hw Λ₂') (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quasiRAct_apply, quasiRAct_apply,
    map_finsum (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂) (support_quasiR_finite (isPlusLocallyNilpotent_hw Λ₂) z)]
  exact finsum_congr fun ν ↦ by rw [pairMap_actPair, map_quasiR]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_barPair
statement:
lemma pairMap_barPair (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) :
    pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ (barPair (twBar hR Λ) (hwBar hR Λ₂).toAddMonoidHom
      (twBar_smul_U hR Λ) (hwBar_smul_U' hR Λ₂) z) =
      barPair (twBar hR' Λ') (hwBar hR' Λ₂').toAddMonoidHom (twBar_smul_U hR' Λ')
        (hwBar_smul_U' hR' Λ₂') (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [barPair_tmul, pairMap_tmul, pairMap_tmul, barPair_tmul, twMap_twBar]
    exact congrArg _ (hwMap_hwBar hR hR' hΛ₂ y)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_tensorPsi
statement:
theorem pairMap_tensorPsi (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) :
    pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ (tensorPsi hR Λ Λ₂ z) =
      tensorPsi hR' Λ' Λ₂' (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorPsi_apply, tensorPsi_apply, pairMap_quasiRAct, pairMap_barPair]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_tensorBasisIdx
statement:
lemma pairMap_tensorBasisIdx (p : TensorIdx Λ Λ₂) :
    pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ₂ p) =
      tensorBasisIdx hR' Λ' Λ₂' (idxMap hΛ hΛ₂ p)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ q : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ₂,
      pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ₂ q) =
        tensorBasis hR' Λ' Λ₂'
          (tensorIdxEquiv (coroot_eq_of_comp hΛ) (coroot_eq_of_comp hΛ₂) q) := fun q ↦ by
    rw [tensorBasis_apply, tensorBasis_apply, pairMap_tmul, twMap_toTwist, hwMap_evq, hwMap_evq]
    rfl
  exact key p

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_pairMap
statement:
lemma repr_pairMap (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1) (p : TensorIdx Λ Λ₂) :
    (tensorBasisIdx hR' Λ' Λ₂').repr (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ z) (idxMap hΛ hΛ₂ p) =
      (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ₂).repr z p
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ₂).map (pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂)).reindex (idxMap hΛ hΛ₂) =
      tensorBasisIdx hR' Λ' Λ₂' :=
    Module.Basis.eq_of_apply_eq fun q ↦ by
      rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.map_apply, pairMap_tensorBasisIdx,
        Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [← hb, Module.Basis.repr_reindex_apply, Module.Basis.map_repr, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_mem_tensorLat
statement:
lemma pairMap_mem_tensorLat {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ₂.1}
    (hz : z ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ₂) : pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ z ∈ tensorLat hR' Λ' Λ₂'
proof:
:= fun h' ↦ by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (idxMap hΛ hΛ₂).surjective h'
  rw [repr_pairMap]
  exact hz p

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorCanonical_spec
statement:
lemma tensorCanonical_spec (h : TensorIdx Λ Λ₂) :
    tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ h ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ₂ ∧
      tensorPsi hR Λ Λ₂ (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ h) = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ h ∧
      𝕧 • (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ h - tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ₂ h) ∈ tensorLat hR Λ Λ₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨by simpa using smul_tensorCanonical_mem_tensorLat hR Λ Λ₂ isIntInv_one h,
    tensorPsi_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ h, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_mem_tensorLat_iff]
  intro h'
  rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases hh : h = h'
  · subst hh
    simp only [↓reduceIte, repr_tensorCanonical_self, sub_self]
    exact isNegLaurent_zero
  · simp only [hh, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
    exact isNegLaurent_repr_tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ (Ne.symm hh)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pairMap_tensorCanonical
statement:
theorem pairMap_tensorCanonical (p : TensorIdx Λ Λ₂) :
    pairMap hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ₂ p) =
      tensorCanonical hR' Λ' Λ₂' (idxMap hΛ hΛ₂ p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := tensorCanonical_spec hR p
  refine (existsUnique_tensorCanonical hR' Λ' Λ₂' (idxMap hΛ hΛ₂ p)).unique
    ⟨pairMap_mem_tensorLat hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ h₁, ?_, ?_⟩
    (tensorCanonical_spec (R := R') (Λ := Λ') (Λ₂ := Λ₂') hR' _)
  · rw [← pairMap_tensorPsi hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂, h₂]
  · rw [← pairMap_tensorBasisIdx hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂, ← map_sub, ← LinearEquiv.map_smul]
    exact pairMap_mem_tensorLat hR hR' hΛ hΛ₂ h₃

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.columnEquiv_eq_leftActOne
statement:
lemma Modified.columnEquiv_eq_leftActOne (φ : R.Hom R') (ζ : Y' →+ ℤ)
    {x : LinearMap.range (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom))}
    {u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧} (hu : (x : Modified R 𝕧) =
      leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u) :
    (columnEquiv R R' ratFunc_X_not_root φ ζ x : Modified R' 𝕧) =
      leftActOne R' ratFunc_X_not_root ζ (QuantumGroup.mapHom 𝕧 φ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  have : (⟨x, hx⟩ : LinearMap.range (leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom))) =
      ⟨leftActOne R ratFunc_X_not_root (ζ.comp φ.toHom) u, u, rfl⟩ := Subtype.ext hu
  rw [this, columnEquiv_leftActOne]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.domFreeCoroot_eq_comp
statement: lemma domFreeCoroot_eq_comp : (domFreeCoroot Λ).1 = Λ.1.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_columnCanonical_eq_pairMap
statement:
lemma modTensorAct_columnCanonical_eq_pairMap (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ) :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'') =
      pairMap (isXRegular_freeCoroot hR) hR (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ)
        (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ'') (modTensorAct (domFreeCoroot Λ) (domFreeCoroot Λ'')
          (modifiedCanonical (isXRegular_freeCoroot hR) exists_dom_freeCoroot
            (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom) hb hb''))
proof:
:= by
  have hR₁ := isXRegular_freeCoroot hR
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := modifiedCanonical_mem_range hR₁ exists_dom_freeCoroot
    (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom) hb hb''
  have hc : columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'' =
      leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (QuantumGroup.mapHom 𝕧 R.freeCorootHom u) :=
    columnEquiv_eq_leftActOne R.freeCorootHom ζ (u := u) hu.symm
  have hζ₁ : (domFreeCoroot Λ'').1 - (domFreeCoroot Λ).1 = ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom := by
    rw [← hζ]
    rfl
  rw [hc, ← hu, modTensorAct_leftActOne Λ Λ'' hζ, modTensorAct_leftActOne _ _ hζ₁, pairMap_act,
    pairMap_tmul, twMap_toTwist, hwMap_hwv, hwMap_hwv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_columnCanonical
statement:
theorem modTensorAct_columnCanonical (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ)
    (h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ) (h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'') =
      tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hR₁ := isXRegular_freeCoroot hR
  have hζ₁ : (domFreeCoroot Λ'').1 - (domFreeCoroot Λ).1 = ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom := by
    rw [← hζ]
    rfl
  have e₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (domFreeCoroot Λ) := by
    rwa [canonicalBasisHW_eq (coroot_eq_of_comp (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ))] at h₁
  have e₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D (domFreeCoroot Λ'') := by
    rwa [canonicalBasisHW_eq (coroot_eq_of_comp (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ''))] at h₂
  rw [modTensorAct_columnCanonical_eq_pairMap hR Λ Λ'' ζ hb hb'' hζ,
    modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical hR₁ exists_dom_freeCoroot _ hb hb'' _ _ hζ₁ e₁ e₂]
  exact pairMap_tensorCanonical hR₁ hR (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ) (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ'')
    ((⟨b, e₁⟩, ⟨b'', e₂⟩) : TensorIdx _ _)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modTensorAct_columnCanonical_eq_zero
statement:
theorem modTensorAct_columnCanonical_eq_zero (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hζ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ)
    (h : b ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ∨ b'' ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    modTensorAct Λ Λ'' (columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hR₁ := isXRegular_freeCoroot hR
  have hζ₁ : (domFreeCoroot Λ'').1 - (domFreeCoroot Λ).1 = ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom := by
    rw [← hζ]
    rfl
  rw [canonicalBasisHW_eq (coroot_eq_of_comp (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ)),
    canonicalBasisHW_eq (coroot_eq_of_comp (domFreeCoroot_eq_comp Λ''))] at h
  rw [modTensorAct_columnCanonical_eq_pairMap hR Λ Λ'' ζ hb hb'' hζ,
    modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical_eq_zero hR₁ exists_dom_freeCoroot _ hb hb'' _ _ hζ₁ h,
    map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_dom_of_isYRegular
statement:
theorem exists_dom_of_isYRegular [Module.Free ℤ Y] [Module.Finite ℤ Y] (hY : R.IsYRegular)
    (N : ℕ) : ∃ Λ : Dom R, ∀ i, (N : ℤ) ≤ Λ.1 (R.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.exists_le_coroot_of_isYRegular hY N
  exact ⟨⟨Λ, fun i ↦ le_trans (Int.natCast_nonneg N) (hΛ i)⟩, hΛ⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.existsUnique_modifiedCanonical_of_isYRegular
statement:
theorem existsUnique_modifiedCanonical_of_isYRegular [Module.Free ℤ Y] [Module.Finite ℤ Y]
    (hY : R.IsYRegular) (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃! u, u ∈ LinearMap.range (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ) ∧
      ∀ (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) (_ : Λ''.1 - Λ.1 = ζ) (h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
        (h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ''),
        modTensorAct Λ Λ'' u = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩)
proof:
:=
  existsUnique_modifiedCanonical hR (exists_dom_of_isYRegular hY) ζ hb hb''

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rescale_C_eq
statement: lemma rescale_C_eq (a c : k) : rescale a (C c) = C c
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n <;> simp [coeff_rescale, coeff_C]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomialSeries_add
statement:
theorem qBinomialSeries_add (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    qBinomialSeries q (a + b) =
      rescale (q⁻¹ ^ b) (qBinomialSeries q a) * rescale (q ^ a) (qBinomialSeries q b)
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp [rescale_one]
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, qBinomialSeries_succ hq, ih, qBinomialSeries_succ hq b]
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_one, rescale_rescale, rescale_X, rescale_C_eq]
    rw [← pow_succ, mul_comm (q ^ a) q⁻¹, pow_add, map_mul]
    ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_add_eq_sum
statement:
theorem qBinomial_add_eq_sum (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c : ℕ) :
    qBinomial q (a + b) c = ∑ i ∈ range (c + 1),
      q⁻¹ ^ (b * i) * q ^ (a * (c - i)) * qBinomial q a i * qBinomial q b (c - i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_qBinomialSeries, qBinomialSeries_add hq, coeff_mul,
    Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [coeff_rescale, coeff_qBinomialSeries, ← pow_mul]
  ring

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.coeff_qBinomialPhi_self
statement:
lemma coeff_qBinomialPhi_self (hq : q ≠ 0) (h a : ℕ) :
    coeff a (qBinomialPhi q h (a + 1)) = q ^ ((h + 1) * a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp [qBinomialPhi_one hq]
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [qBinomialPhi_succ hq, coeff_succ_one_add_mul, coeff_rescale, coeff_rescale, ih,
      coeff_qBinomialPhi_eq_zero hq h (by omega) le_rfl, mul_zero, zero_add]
    have hinv : q ^ a * q⁻¹ ^ a = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_pow]
    linear_combination q ^ (h + 1) * q ^ ((h + 1) * a) * hinv

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.pow_mul_inv_pow_eq
statement:
lemma pow_mul_inv_pow_eq (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b c d : ℕ) (h : (a : ℤ) - b = c - d) :
    q ^ a * q⁻¹ ^ b = q ^ c * q⁻¹ ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_pow, inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv,
    div_eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ hq) (pow_ne_zero _ hq), ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
  congr 1
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.qBinomial_add_self_mul_qBinomial
statement:
lemma qBinomial_add_self_mul_qBinomial {h i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    qBinomial q (h + j) j * qBinomial q j i =
      qBinomial q (h + i) i * qBinomial q (h + j) (j - i)
proof:
:= by
  have F1 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (show j ≤ h + j by omega)
  have F2 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) hij
  have F3 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (show i ≤ h + i by omega)
  have F4 := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (show j - i ≤ h + j by omega)
  rw [show h + j - j = h by omega] at F1
  rw [show h + i - i = h by omega] at F3
  rw [show h + j - (j - i) = h + i by omega] at F4
  have hX : qFactorial q i * qFactorial q (j - i) * qFactorial q h ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq i)
      (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq (j - i)))
      (qFactorial_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0 hq h)
  refine mul_right_cancel₀ hX ?_
  linear_combination (qBinomial q (h + j) j * qFactorial q h) * F2 + F1 -
    (qBinomial q (h + j) (j - i) * qFactorial q (j - i)) * F3 - F4

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.sum_qBinomial_string
statement:
theorem sum_qBinomial_string (h p : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (p + 1), (-1) ^ j * qBinomial q (h + j) j *
      qBinomial q (h + 1 + p + j) (h + 1 + j) * qBinomial q (h + 1 + p) (h + 1 + j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hqi : q⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hq0
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N, h + 1 + p = N := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have step1 : ∀ j ∈ range (p + 1), (-1) ^ j * qBinomial q (h + j) j *
      qBinomial q (h + 1 + p + j) (h + 1 + j) * qBinomial q (h + 1 + p) (h + 1 + j) =
      ∑ i ∈ range (p + 1), (-1) ^ j * qBinomial q (h + j) j * qBinomial q N (p - j) *
        (q⁻¹ ^ (N * i) * q ^ (j * (p - i)) * qBinomial q j i * qBinomial q N (p - i)) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [mem_range] at hj
    subst hN
    rw [← mul_sum, ← qBinomial_add_eq_sum hq0,
      ← qBinomial_symm q (show h + 1 + j ≤ h + 1 + p + j by omega),
      ← qBinomial_symm q (show h + 1 + j ≤ h + 1 + p by omega),
      show h + 1 + p + j - (h + 1 + j) = p by omega,
      show h + 1 + p - (h + 1 + j) = p - j by omega, add_comm j (h + 1 + p)]
    ring
  rw [sum_congr rfl step1, sum_comm]
  
  have step2 : ∀ i ∈ range (p + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (p + 1), (-1) ^ j * qBinomial q (h + j) j *
      qBinomial q N (p - j) * (q⁻¹ ^ (N * i) * q ^ (j * (p - i)) * qBinomial q j i *
        qBinomial q N (p - i)) =
      q⁻¹ ^ ((h + 1) * p) * ((-1) ^ i * (q * q⁻¹ ^ (p + 1)) ^ i * qBinomial q (h + i) i *
        qBinomial q (h + (p + 1)) (p - i)) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [mem_range] at hi
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, p = i + r := ⟨p - i, by omega⟩
    rw [show i + r + 1 = i + (r + 1) by omega, sum_range_add,
      sum_eq_zero (s := range i) fun j hj ↦ by
        rw [qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q (mem_range.1 hj)]; ring, zero_add]
    have hPhi := coeff_qBinomialPhi_self hqi (h + i) r
    rw [coeff_qBinomialPhi] at hPhi
    simp only [qBinomial_inv, inv_inv] at hPhi
    have hterm : ∀ l ∈ range (r + 1), (-1) ^ (i + l) * qBinomial q (h + (i + l)) (i + l) *
        qBinomial q N (i + r - (i + l)) * (q⁻¹ ^ (N * i) * q ^ ((i + l) * (i + r - i)) *
          qBinomial q (i + l) i * qBinomial q N (i + r - i)) =
        ((-1) ^ i * qBinomial q (h + i) i * qBinomial q N r * q⁻¹ ^ (N * i) * q ^ (i * r)) *
          ((-1) ^ l * (q⁻¹ * q ^ (r + 1)) ^ l * qBinomial q (h + i + l) l *
            qBinomial q (h + i + (r + 1)) (r - l)) := by
      intro l hl
      have e := qBinomial_add_self_mul_qBinomial hq0 hq (h := h) (show i ≤ i + l by omega)
      rw [show i + l - i = l by omega, show h + (i + l) = h + i + l by omega] at e
      rw [show i + r - (i + l) = r - l by omega, show i + r - i = r by omega,
        show h + (i + l) = h + i + l by omega, show h + i + (r + 1) = N by omega,
        show q⁻¹ * q ^ (r + 1) = q ^ r by field_simp; ring]
      linear_combination ((-1) ^ (i + l) * qBinomial q N (r - l) * q⁻¹ ^ (N * i) *
        q ^ ((i + l) * r) * qBinomial q N r) * e
    rw [sum_congr rfl hterm, ← mul_sum, hPhi, show h + (i + (r + 1)) = N by omega]
    have hrN : i + r - i = r := by omega
    rw [hrN]
    subst hN
    have key : q⁻¹ ^ ((h + 1 + (i + r)) * i) * q ^ (i * r) * q⁻¹ ^ ((h + i + 1) * r) =
        q⁻¹ ^ ((h + 1) * (i + r)) * (q * q⁻¹ ^ (i + (r + 1))) ^ i := calc
      _ = q ^ (i * r) * q⁻¹ ^ ((h + 1 + (i + r)) * i + (h + i + 1) * r) := by ring
      _ = q ^ i * q⁻¹ ^ ((h + 1) * (i + r) + (i + (r + 1)) * i) :=
        pow_mul_inv_pow_eq hq0 _ _ _ _ (by push_cast; ring)
      _ = _ := by ring
    linear_combination ((-1) ^ i * qBinomial q (h + i) i * qBinomial q (h + 1 + (i + r)) r) * key
  rw [sum_congr rfl step2, ← mul_sum, ← coeff_qBinomialPhi, coeff_qBinomialPhi_self hq0,
    ← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, one_pow]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.sum_dF_dE_eq
statement:
theorem sum_dF_dE_eq {h : ℕ} {u : M} (hu : u ∈ V.wt (-((h + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) :
    ∃ N, ∀ N' ≥ N, ∑ j ∈ range N', ((-1) ^ j * qBinomial q (h + j) j) •
      V.dF (h + 1 + j) (V.dE (h + 1 + j) u) = u
proof:
:= by
  refine wt_induction hq0 hq (P := fun u ↦ ∃ N, ∀ N' ≥ N, ∑ j ∈ range N',
    ((-1) ^ j * qBinomial q (h + j) j) • V.dF (h + 1 + j) (V.dE (h + 1 + j) u) = u)
    ⟨0, fun _ _ ↦ by simp⟩ ?_ ?_ ?_ hu
  · rintro x y ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ ⟨N₂, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun N' hN' ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [map_add, smul_add, sum_add_distrib]
    rw [h₁ N' (le_of_max_le_left hN'), h₂ N' (le_of_max_le_right hN')]
  · rintro c x ⟨N, hN⟩
    refine ⟨N, fun N' hN' ↦ ?_⟩
    simp_rw [map_smul, smul_comm _ c]
    rw [← smul_sum, hN N' hN']
  · rintro p j η hjp hpj hη hE
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, j = h + 1 + r := ⟨j - (h + 1), by omega⟩
    obtain rfl : p = h + 1 + 2 * r := by omega
    refine ⟨r + 1, fun N' hN' ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ : ∃ s, N' = r + 1 + s := ⟨N' - (r + 1), by omega⟩
    rw [sum_range_add, sum_eq_zero (s := range s) fun l _ ↦ by
      rw [dE_dF_eq_zero_of_lt hq0 hq hη hE (by omega) (by omega), map_zero, smul_zero],
      add_zero]
    have hterm : ∀ l ∈ range (r + 1), ((-1) ^ l * qBinomial q (h + l) l) •
        V.dF (h + 1 + l) (V.dE (h + 1 + l) (V.dF (h + 1 + r) η)) =
        ((-1) ^ l * qBinomial q (h + l) l * qBinomial q (h + 1 + r + l) (h + 1 + l) *
          qBinomial q (h + 1 + r) (h + 1 + l)) • V.dF (h + 1 + r) η := by
      intro l hl
      rw [mem_range] at hl
      rw [dE_dF_of_primitive hq0 hq hη hE (by omega) (by omega), map_smul, dF_dF hq0 hq,
        show h + 1 + l + (h + 1 + r - (h + 1 + l)) = h + 1 + r by omega,
        show h + 1 + 2 * r - (h + 1 + r) + (h + 1 + l) = h + 1 + r + l by omega,
        smul_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [sum_congr rfl hterm, ← sum_smul, sum_qBinomial_string hq0 hq h r, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.IntegrableSl2.mem_integral_wt_iff
statement:
theorem mem_integral_wt_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Module R M] (φ : R →+* k)
    (hφ : ∀ (r : R) (x : M), r • x = φ r • x) (L : Submodule R M)
    (hLE : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ L, V.dE a x ∈ L) (hLF : ∀ a, ∀ x ∈ L, V.dF a x ∈ L)
    (hcoef : ∀ n j, ∃ r, φ r = qBinomial q n j) (h : ℕ) (u : M) :
    u ∈ L ∧ u ∈ V.wt (-((h + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ↔ u ∈ Submodule.span R
      {x | ∃ (j : ℕ) (y : M), y ∈ L ∧ y ∈ V.wt ((h + 1 + 2 * j : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
        x = V.dF (h + 1 + j) y}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨huL, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := sum_dF_dE_eq hq0 hq (V := V) hu
    rw [← hN N le_rfl]
    refine sum_mem fun j _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hcoef (h + j) j
    rw [← hc, show ((-1) ^ j * φ c) = φ ((-1) ^ j * c) by simp, ← hφ]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, _, hLE _ _ huL, ?_, rfl⟩)
    convert dE_mem hu (h + 1 + j) using 2
    push_cast
    ring
  · intro hu
    induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨j, y, hyL, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨hLF _ _ hyL, ?_⟩
      convert dF_mem hy (h + 1 + j) using 2
      push_cast
      ring
    | zero => exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact ⟨add_mem hx.1 hy.1, add_mem hx.2 hy.2⟩
    | smul r x _ hx =>
      refine ⟨L.smul_mem r hx.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hφ]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx.2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.f_df
statement: lemma f_df (n : ℕ) (x : M) : V.f (V.df n x) = qInt q (n + 1) • V.df (n + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := qInt_ne_zero' hq0 hq (Nat.succ_pos n)
  rw [df_apply, df_apply, map_smul, smul_smul, qFactorial_succ, ← Module.End.mul_apply,
    ← pow_succ', mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h, one_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.component_zero_f
statement: lemma component_zero_f (m : M) : V.component hq0 hq 0 (V.f m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : V.component hq0 hq 0 ∘ₗ V.f = 0 :=
    ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun n x hx ↦ by
      simp [f_df hq0 hq, component_df hq0 hq hx]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.component_succ_f
statement:
lemma component_succ_f (n : ℕ) (m : M) :
    V.component hq0 hq (n + 1) (V.f m) = qInt q (n + 1) • V.component hq0 hq n m
proof:
:= by
  have : V.component hq0 hq (n + 1) ∘ₗ V.f = qInt q (n + 1) • V.component hq0 hq n :=
    ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun j x hx ↦ by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, f_df hq0 hq, map_smul,
        component_df hq0 hq hx, add_left_inj]
      split_ifs with h
      · subst h; rfl
      · simp
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.component_eTilde
statement:
lemma component_eTilde (j : ℕ) (m : M) :
    V.component hq0 hq j (V.eTilde hq0 hq m) = V.component hq0 hq (j + 1) m
proof:
:= by
  have : V.component hq0 hq j ∘ₗ V.eTilde hq0 hq = V.component hq0 hq (j + 1) :=
    ext_df (V := V) hq0 hq fun n x hx ↦ by
      rcases n with _ | n
      · have h0 := component_df hq0 hq hx 0 (j + 1)
        simp only [df_zero, Nat.zero_ne_add_one, ↓reduceIte] at h0
        simp [eTilde_of_ker hq0 hq hx, h0]
      · simp [eTilde_df_succ hq0 hq hx, component_df hq0 hq hx]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this m

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.component_eq_zero_of_mem_range
statement:
lemma component_eq_zero_of_mem_range {n : ℕ} {m : M} (h : m ∈ LinearMap.range (V.f ^ n))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) : V.component hq0 hq j m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h
  induction n generalizing j y with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    rcases j with _ | j
    · exact component_zero_f hq0 hq _
    · rw [component_succ_f hq0 hq, ih (by omega) y, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.BosonModule.fTilde_pow_eTilde_pow
statement:
lemma fTilde_pow_eTilde_pow {n : ℕ} {m : M} (h : ∀ j < n, V.component hq0 hq j m = 0) :
    (V.fTilde hq0 hq ^ n) ((V.eTilde hq0 hq ^ n) m) = m
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ (V.eTilde hq0 hq), pow_succ' (V.fTilde hq0 hq), Module.End.mul_apply,
      Module.End.mul_apply, ih fun j hj ↦ by rw [component_eTilde]; exact h (j + 1) (by omega)]
    have := fTilde_eTilde_add_component (V := V) hq0 hq m
    rwa [h 0 (by omega), add_zero] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kF_pow_kE_pow_of_mem_range
proof:
:=
  BosonModule.fTilde_pow_eTilde_pow (V := bosv i) (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (NeZero.ne 𝕧) i)
    (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one hv' i) fun _ hj ↦
      BosonModule.component_eq_zero_of_mem_range (V := bosv i)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.df_mem_range
statement:
lemma df_mem_range (i : I) {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) (y : Um D 𝕧) :
    (bosv i).df k y ∈ LinearMap.range (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(qFactorial ((𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹) k)⁻¹ • (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ (k - n)) y, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hnk,
    BosonModule.df_apply]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFilt_le_range
statement:
lemma negFilt_le_range (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ negFilt D i n ν) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.range (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, y, hk, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact df_mem_range D i hk y
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [laurent_smul_eq]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kE_mem_smul_latInf_ratFunc

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_fWi_sub_mem_of_kE_pow
statement:
lemma exists_fWi_sub_mem_of_kE_pow (i : I) (n : ℕ) {w : List I}
    (h : (kE hvt i ^ n) (fWi (D := D) hvt w) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A) :
    ∃ u, fWi (D := D) hvt w - fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u) ∈
      ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing w with
  | zero => exact ⟨w, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] at h
    have h0 : kE (D := D) hvt i (fWi hvt w) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A :=
      fun h' ↦ h (kE_pow_mem_smul_latInf_ratFunc D i n h')
    rcases kE_fWi_cases_ratFunc D i w with h1 | ⟨w', hw'⟩
    · exact absurd h1 h0
    have hc := fWi_sub_mem_of_kE_ratFunc D i h0 hw'
    have h2 : (kE hvt i ^ n) (fWi (D := D) hvt w') ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
      intro h2
      refine h ?_
      rw [← sub_add_cancel (kE hvt i (fWi hvt w)) (fWi hvt w'), map_add]
      exact add_mem (kE_pow_mem_smul_latInf_ratFunc D i n hw') h2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih h2
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    have e : fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate (n + 1) i ++ u) =
        kF hvt i (fWi hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u)) := by
      rw [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append]; rfl
    have e' : fWi (D := D) hvt (i :: w') = kF hvt i (fWi hvt w') := rfl
    rw [e, ← sub_add_sub_cancel _ (fWi hvt (i :: w')), e', ← map_sub]
    exact add_mem hc (kF_mem_smul_latInf i hu)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobal_eq_of_sub_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_mem_negBalanced (negGlobalAt D ν) hy (negGlobal_mem D ν _) ?_
  have h1 := negGlobal_sub_mem D ν (Quotient.mk _ ⟨w, hw⟩)
  have h2 : fWi (D := D) hvt (Quotient.out (Quotient.mk (negCrystalSetoid D ν) ⟨w, hw⟩)).1 -
      fWi hvt w ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D ν) _
  have e : y - negGlobal D ν (Quotient.mk _ ⟨w, hw⟩) = (y - fWi hvt w) -
      (fWi hvt (Quotient.out (Quotient.mk (negCrystalSetoid D ν) ⟨w, hw⟩)).1 - fWi hvt w) -
      (negGlobal D ν (Quotient.mk _ ⟨w, hw⟩) -
        fWi hvt (Quotient.out (Quotient.mk (negCrystalSetoid D ν) ⟨w, hw⟩)).1) := by abel
  rw [e]
  exact sub_mem (sub_mem hyw h2) h1

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.kF_pow_mem_negFilt
statement:
lemma kF_pow_mem_negFilt (i : I) (n : ℕ) {μ : I →₀ ℕ} {z : Um D 𝕧} (hz : z ∈ negIntegral D)
    (hzw : z ∈ Uw D 𝕧 μ) : (kF hvt i ^ n) z ∈ negFilt D i n (μ + Finsupp.single i n)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (D := D) (NeZero.ne 𝕧) i
  have hq := NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one (D := D) hv' i
  obtain ⟨N, -, hsum⟩ := exists_sum_comp (D := D) i z
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ ↦ ?_
  have hc : (kF hvt i ^ n) ((bosv i).df k (comp hvt i k z)) =
      (bosv i).df (n + k) (comp hvt i k z) := by
    rw [← BosonModule.fTilde_pow_apply (V := bosv i) hq0 hq (e_comp i k z),
      ← BosonModule.fTilde_pow_apply (V := bosv i) hq0 hq (e_comp i k z), ← Module.End.mul_apply]
    change ((bosv i).fTilde hq0 hq ^ n * (bosv i).fTilde hq0 hq ^ k) (comp hvt i k z) = _
    rw [← pow_add]
  rw [hc]
  by_cases hk : k ≤ μ i
  · have hcw : comp hvt i k z ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (μ - Finsupp.single i k) :=
      @component_mem_Uw _ _ _ _ D _ _ _ transcendental_ratFunc_X i _ z hzw k
    have hw : μ - Finsupp.single i k = μ + Finsupp.single i n - Finsupp.single i (n + k) := by
      ext l
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst hl; simp; omega
      · simp [Ne.symm hl]
    rw [hw] at hcw
    exact df_mem_negFilt D i (by omega) (by simp; omega)
      (negative_component_mem_integral D i hz k) hcw
  · rw [comp_eq_zero_of_lt D i hzw (by omega), map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negGlobal_mem_negFilt
statement:
theorem negGlobal_mem_negFilt {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν}
    (hb : NegDepthGe D i n b) : negGlobal D ν b ∈ negFilt D i n ν
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · have hU : negGlobal D ν b ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (ν - Finsupp.single i 0) := by
      simpa using (negGlobal_mem D ν b).2.1
    have h := df_mem_negFilt D i (n := 0) (k := 0) (ν := ν) le_rfl (Nat.zero_le _)
      (negGlobal_mem D ν b).1 hU
    simpa using h
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hb
  have hwt : wordWeight (List.replicate n i ++ u) = ν :=
    (wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem_ratFunc D hu).symm.trans (Quotient.out b).2
  have hx : fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u) ∈ negFilt D i n ν := by
    have h := kF_pow_mem_negFilt D i n (fWi_mem_negIntegral D u) (fWi_mem_Uw u)
    rw [kF_pow_fWi (D := D) i n u] at h
    rwa [← hwt, LusztigF.wordWeight_append, LusztigF.wordWeight_replicate, add_comm,
      Finsupp.smul_single_one]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy₀, hy₁, hxy⟩ := exists_negFilt_sub_mem D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum (globalBelow D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum ν) i hn hx (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ _)
  have hyB : y ∈ negBalanced D ν :=
    ⟨(mem_negFilt_le D hy).1, (mem_negFilt_le D hy).2, hy₀, hy₁⟩
  have hyw : y - fWi (D := D) hvt (List.replicate n i ++ u) ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem hxy
  rw [eq_mk_of_sub_mem D hwt hu, ← negGlobal_eq_of_sub_mem D hyB hwt hyw]
  exact hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negDepthGe_of_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  set w := (Quotient.out b).1
  have hE : (kE hvt i ^ n) (negGlobal D ν b) ∉ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := fun h ↦
    negGlobal_notMem D ν b (by
      rw [← kF_pow_kE_pow_of_mem_range D i hb]
      exact kF_pow_mem_smul_latInf D i n h)
  refine exists_fWi_sub_mem_of_kE_pow D i n fun h ↦ hE ?_
  rw [← sub_add_cancel (negGlobal D ν b) (fWi hvt w), map_add]
  exact add_mem (kE_pow_mem_smul_latInf_ratFunc D i n (negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b)) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFilt_le_span
statement:
theorem negFilt_le_span (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    negFilt D i n ν ≤ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
      (negGlobal D ν '' {b | NegDepthGe D i n b})
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  intro x hx
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ (mem_span_negGlobal D (mem_negFilt_le D hx).1
      (mem_negFilt_le D hx).2)
    rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b, negDepthGe_zero D i b, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ι, g, u, hgF, hg₀, hg₁, hspan, hgu, hgw⟩ := negFiltGlobalAt
    D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum
    (globalBelow D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum ν) i hn
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ (hspan x hx)
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hB : g k ∈ negBalanced D ν :=
    ⟨(mem_negFilt_le D (hgF k)).1, (mem_negFilt_le D (hgF k)).2, hg₀.1 k, hg₁.1 k⟩
  refine ⟨_, ⟨u k, Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D ν) ⟨_, hgw k⟩⟩,
    (negGlobal_eq_of_sub_mem D hB (hgw k) (hgu k)).symm⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_signedBasisGe_iff
statement:
theorem mem_signedBasisGe_iff {i : I} {n : ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ signedBasisGe D i n ↔ ∃ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν),
      NegDepthGe D i n b ∧ (x = negGlobal D ν b ∨ x = -negGlobal D ν b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hr⟩
    obtain ⟨ν, b, hb⟩ := (mem_signedBasis_iff D).1 hx
    have hG : negGlobal D ν b ∈ LinearMap.range (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n) := by
      rcases hb with rfl | rfl
      · exact hr
      · simpa using neg_mem hr
    exact ⟨ν, b, negDepthGe_of_mem_range D hG, hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨ν, b, hd, hb⟩
    refine ⟨(mem_signedBasis_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, hb⟩, ?_⟩
    have hG := negFilt_le_range D i n ν (negGlobal_mem_negFilt D hd)
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact hG
    · exact neg_mem hG

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_signedBasisAt_iff
statement:
theorem mem_signedBasisAt_iff {i : I} {n : ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ signedBasisAt D i n ↔ ∃ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν),
      NegDepthGe D i n b ∧ ¬ NegDepthGe D i (n + 1) b ∧
        (x = negGlobal D ν b ∨ x = -negGlobal D ν b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hge, hnot⟩
    obtain ⟨ν, b, hd, hb⟩ := (mem_signedBasisGe_iff D).1 hge
    exact ⟨ν, b, hd, fun h ↦ hnot ((mem_signedBasisGe_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, h, hb⟩), hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨ν, b, hd, hnd, hb⟩
    refine ⟨(mem_signedBasisGe_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, hd, hb⟩, fun h ↦ hnd ?_⟩
    have hr := h.2
    refine negDepthGe_of_mem_range D ?_
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact hr
    · simpa using neg_mem hr

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negFilt_eq_span
statement:
theorem negFilt_eq_span (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    negFilt D i n ν = Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
      (negGlobal D ν '' {b | NegDepthGe D i n b})
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (negFilt_le_span D i n ν) (Submodule.span_le.2 (by
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact negGlobal_mem_negFilt D hb))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_ratFunc_of_mem_span_laurent
statement:
lemma mem_span_ratFunc_of_mem_span_laurent {S : Set (Um D 𝕧)} {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) S) : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 S
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => exact Submodule.subset_span hy
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [laurent_smul_eq]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_range_iff_mem_span
statement:
theorem mem_range_iff_mem_span {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.range (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n) ↔
      x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (negGlobal D ν '' {b | NegDepthGe D i n b})
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    set S := Submodule.span 𝕂 (negGlobal D ν '' {b | NegDepthGe D i n b})
    have hq := BosonModule.qFactorial_ne_zero' (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_zero (D := D)
      (NeZero.ne 𝕧) i) (NegativePart.pow_d_ne_one hv' i) n
    have hfn : (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n) y =
        qFactorial ((𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹) n • (bosv i).df n y := by
      rw [BosonModule.df_apply, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq, one_smul]; rfl
    have hP : NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν) ((NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n) y) =
        (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n) y := by
      rw [proj_of_mem_Uw hx]; simp
    rw [← hP, hfn, map_smul, proj_df]
    refine S.smul_mem _ ?_
    by_cases hn : n ≤ ν i
    · have e : LusztigF.toZ ν - Finsupp.single i (n : ℤ) =
          LusztigF.toZ (ν - Finsupp.single i n) := by
        ext l
        by_cases hl : l = i
        · subst hl; simp; omega
        · simp [Ne.symm hl]
      rw [e]
      have key : ∀ z ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (negGlobal D (ν - Finsupp.single i n))),
          (bosv i).df n z ∈ S := by
        intro z hz
        induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem z hz =>
          obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hz
          exact mem_span_ratFunc_of_mem_span_laurent D (negFilt_le_span D i n ν
            (df_mem_negFilt D i le_rfl hn (negGlobal_mem D _ b').1 (negGlobal_mem D _ b').2.1))
        | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
        | add z z' _ _ hz hz' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hz hz'
        | smul c z _ hz => rw [map_smul]; exact S.smul_mem _ hz
      exact key _ (mem_span_negGlobal_field D (proj_mem_Uw (ν - Finsupp.single i n) y))
    · have h0 : NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν - Finsupp.single i (n : ℤ)) y = 0 := by
        obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
        have hn' : ¬ (0 ≤ LusztigF.toZ ν - Finsupp.single i (n : ℤ)) := by
          intro h
          have := h i
          simp at this
          omega
        rw [NegativePart.proj_mk]
        simp [zWeightProj, hn']
      rw [h0, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
  · intro h
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ h
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact negFilt_le_range D i n ν (negGlobal_mem_negFilt D hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_negGlobal_depth
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_negGlobal_depth (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent 𝕂 fun b : {b : negCrystal D ν // NegDepthGe D i n b} ↦
      negGlobal D ν b.1
proof:
:=
  (linearIndependent_negGlobal D ν).comp _ Subtype.val_injective

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_rightRange_iff
statement:
lemma mem_rightRange_iff {i : I} {n : ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ rightRange D i n ↔ starU D 𝕧 x ∈ LinearMap.range (NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rwa [starU_starU]
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨_, h, starU_starU x⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mk_mul_mem_rightRange
statement:
lemma mk_mul_mem_rightRange (i : I) (n : ℕ) (z : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (z * θ 𝕂 i ^ n) : Um D 𝕧) ∈ rightRange D i n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rightRange_iff, starU_mk, rev_mul, rev_θ_pow]
  exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk (rev 𝕂 I z), GrandLoop.f_pow_mk i n _⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.rightRange_anti
statement: lemma rightRange_anti (i : I) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) : rightRange D i n ≤ rightRange D i m
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_rightRange_iff] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨(NegativePart.f D 𝕧 i ^ (n - m)) y, ?_⟩
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hmn, hy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_rightRange_zero
statement: lemma mem_rightRange_zero (i : I) (x : Um D 𝕧) : x ∈ rightRange D i 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rightRange_iff, pow_zero]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_mem_signedBasis
statement:
lemma starU_mem_signedBasis {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ signedBasis D) :
    starU D 𝕧 x ∈ signedBasis D
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (b : negCrystal D ν), starU D 𝕧 (negGlobal D ν b) ∈ canonicalBasis D :=
    fun ν b ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨ν, by
      rw [← starU_image_canonicalBasisAt, canonicalBasisAt_eq_range]
      exact ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [signedBasis_eq_union]
  obtain ⟨ν, b, rfl | rfl⟩ := (mem_signedBasis_iff D).1 hx
  · exact Or.inl (key ν b)
  · right
    rw [Set.mem_neg, map_neg, neg_neg]
    exact key ν b

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.signedBasisGeRight_eq_image
statement:
theorem signedBasisGeRight_eq_image (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    signedBasisGeRight D i n = starU D 𝕧 '' signedBasisGe D i n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hr⟩
    exact ⟨starU D 𝕧 x, ⟨starU_mem_signedBasis D hx, (mem_rightRange_iff D).1 hr⟩,
      starU_starU x⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hy, hr⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨starU_mem_signedBasis D hy, (mem_rightRange_iff D).2 (by rwa [starU_starU])⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_rightRange_iff_mem_span
statement:
theorem mem_rightRange_iff_mem_span {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    x ∈ rightRange D i n ↔
      x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (starU D 𝕧 '' (negGlobal D ν '' {b | NegDepthGe D i n b}))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rightRange_iff, mem_range_iff_mem_span D (starU_mem_Uw hx), Submodule.span_image,
    Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨_, h, starU_starU x⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rwa [starU_starU]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_negGlobal_mem_signedBasisGeRight
statement:
lemma starU_negGlobal_mem_signedBasisGeRight {i : I} {n : ℕ} {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {b : negCrystal D ν}
    (hb : NegDepthGe D i n b) : starU D 𝕧 (negGlobal D ν b) ∈ signedBasisGeRight D i n
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedBasisGeRight_eq_image]
  refine ⟨_, ⟨(mem_signedBasis_iff D).2 ⟨ν, b, Or.inl rfl⟩, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  exact negFilt_le_range D i n ν (negGlobal_mem_negFilt D hb)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_rightRange_iff_mem_span_signedBasisGeRight
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ Submodule.span_mono ?_ ((mem_rightRange_iff_mem_span D hx).1 h), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact starU_negGlobal_mem_signedBasisGeRight D hb
  · exact (Submodule.span_le.2 fun y hy ↦ hy.2) h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasis_subset_signedBasis
statement: lemma canonicalBasis_subset_signedBasis : canonicalBasis D ⊆ signedBasis D
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedBasis_eq_union]
  exact Set.subset_union_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_canonicalBasisHW_iff
statement:
theorem mem_canonicalBasisHW_iff {x : Um D 𝕧} :
    x ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ↔
      x ∈ canonicalBasis D ∧ ∀ i, x ∉ rightRange D i ((Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [canonicalBasisHW, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_iUnion]
  refine and_congr_right fun hB ↦ forall_congr' fun i ↦ ?_
  have hS := canonicalBasis_subset_signedBasis D hB
  have hΛ := Λ.2 i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, -, hn1⟩ h
    exact hn1 ⟨hS, rightRange_anti D i (by omega) h⟩
  · intro h
    have hex : ∃ m, x ∉ rightRange D i (m + 1) := ⟨_, h⟩
    refine ⟨Nat.find hex, ?_, ⟨hS, ?_⟩, fun h' ↦ Nat.find_spec hex h'.2⟩
    · have := Nat.find_min' hex h
      omega
    · rcases hm : Nat.find hex with _ | m
      · exact mem_rightRange_zero D i x
      · have := Nat.find_min hex (hm ▸ Nat.lt_succ_self m : m < Nat.find hex)
        exact not_not.1 this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_eq_zero_of_mem_rightRange
statement:
lemma evq_eq_zero_of_mem_rightRange (hR : R.IsXRegular) {i : I} {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ rightRange D i ((Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1)) : evq hvt Λ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rightRange_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  rw [GrandLoop.f_pow_mk] at hy
  have hx : x = Submodule.Quotient.mk (rev 𝕂 I z * θ 𝕂 i ^ ((Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1)) := by
    rw [← starU_starU x, ← hy, starU_mk, rev_mul, rev_θ_pow]
  rw [hx, evq_mk, ← LinearMap.mem_ker, ker_ev_eq hR]
  refine Submodule.mem_sup_right ?_
  set n : I → ℕ := fun i ↦ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat
  have hle : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mulRight 𝕂 (θ 𝕂 i ^ (n i + 1))) ≤
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range fun g ↦ FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I (powWord n g)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I).span_eq, Submodule.map_span,
      Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨(w, i), ?_⟩
    simp only [powWord, LinearMap.mulRight_apply, ← monomial_eq_wordBasis, monomial,
      List.map_append, List.prod_append, List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate]
  exact hle ⟨rev 𝕂 I z, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.starU_negGlobal_notMem_canonicalBasisHW
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  ((mem_canonicalBasisHW_iff D Λ).1 h).2 i (starU_negGlobal_mem_signedBasisGeRight D hb).2

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_of_evq_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mem_span_of_evq_eq_zero (hR : R.IsXRegular) {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : evq hvt Λ x = 0) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (canonicalBasis D \ canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
proof:
:= by
  set n : I → ℕ := fun i ↦ (Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat
  obtain ⟨Z, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  have hZ : Z ∈ evKernel D n := by
    rw [← ker_ev_eq hR Λ, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hZ
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 hs, zero_add]
  change (serreSubmodule D 𝕧).mkQ t ∈ _
  refine (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ?_ : Submodule.map (serreSubmodule D 𝕧).mkQ _ ≤ _)
    ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
  have hw : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I (powWord n g)) : Um D 𝕧) ∈
      Uw D 𝕧 (wordWeight (powWord n g)) := mk_mem_Uw (wordBasis_mem_weightSpace rfl)
  have hr : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I (powWord n g)) : Um D 𝕧) ∈
      rightRange D g.2 (n g.2 + 1) := by
    rw [← monomial_eq_wordBasis]
    simpa only [powWord, monomial, List.map_append, List.prod_append, List.map_replicate,
      List.prod_replicate] using mk_mul_mem_rightRange D g.2 (n g.2 + 1) (monomial 𝕂 g.1)
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ ((mem_rightRange_iff_mem_span D hw).1 hr)
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨wordWeight (powWord n g), ?_⟩,
    starU_negGlobal_notMem_canonicalBasisHW D Λ hb⟩
  rw [← starU_image_canonicalBasisAt, canonicalBasisAt_eq_range]
  exact ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_eq_zero_of_notMem_canonicalBasisHW
statement:
theorem evq_eq_zero_of_notMem_canonicalBasisHW (hR : R.IsXRegular) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hx' : x ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ) : evq hvt Λ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ rightRange D i ((Λ.1 (R.coroot i)).toNat + 1) := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hx' ((mem_canonicalBasisHW_iff D Λ).2 ⟨hx, h⟩)
  exact evq_eq_zero_of_mem_rightRange Λ hR hi

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasisHW_subset
statement: lemma canonicalBasisHW_subset : canonicalBasisHW D Λ ⊆ canonicalBasis D
proof:
:=
  Set.inter_subset_left

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.linearIndependent_evq_canonicalBasisHW
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_evq_canonicalBasisHW (hR : R.IsXRegular) :
    LinearIndependent 𝕂 fun x : canonicalBasisHW D Λ ↦ evq hvt Λ (x : Um D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  have hli : LinearIndependent 𝕂 (Subtype.val : canonicalBasisHW D Λ → Um D 𝕧) :=
    (linearIndependent_canonicalBasis D).comp (Set.inclusion (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ))
      (Set.inclusion_injective _)
  refine hli.map (f := evq hvt Λ) ?_
  have hdisj := (linearIndependent_canonicalBasis D).disjoint_span_image
    (s := Subtype.val ⁻¹' canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
    (t := Subtype.val ⁻¹' (canonicalBasis D \ canonicalBasisHW D Λ))
    (Set.disjoint_left.2 fun _ h₁ h₂ ↦ h₂.2 h₁)
  rw [Subtype.image_preimage_coe, Subtype.image_preimage_coe,
    Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ),
    Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right Set.sdiff_subset] at hdisj
  rw [Subtype.range_coe]
  exact hdisj.mono_right fun x hx ↦ mem_span_of_evq_eq_zero Λ hR hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.evq_surjective
statement: lemma evq_surjective : Function.Surjective (evq (D := D) hvt Λ)
proof:
:= fun m ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective (D := D) Λ m
  exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk y, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.span_evq_canonicalBasisHW
statement:
theorem span_evq_canonicalBasisHW (hR : R.IsXRegular) :
    Submodule.span 𝕂 (evq hvt Λ '' canonicalBasisHW D Λ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun m _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := evq_surjective D Λ m
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (canonicalBasis D) := by
    rw [span_canonicalBasis]
    trivial
  have : Submodule.map (evq hvt Λ) (Submodule.span 𝕂 (canonicalBasis D)) ≤
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (evq hvt Λ '' canonicalBasisHW D Λ) := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span_le]
    intro y hy
    by_cases hy' : y ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ
    · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, hy', rfl⟩
    · rw [evq_eq_zero_of_notMem_canonicalBasisHW Λ hR hy hy']
      exact zero_mem _
  exact this ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.injOn_evq_canonicalBasisHW
statement:
theorem injOn_evq_canonicalBasisHW (hR : R.IsXRegular) :
    Set.InjOn (evq hvt Λ) (canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy h ↦
  congrArg Subtype.val ((linearIndependent_evq_canonicalBasisHW Λ hR).injective
    (a₁ := ⟨x, hx⟩) (a₂ := ⟨y, hy⟩) h)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply
statement:
lemma canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply (hR : R.IsXRegular) (x : canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    canonicalBasisHWBasis Λ hR x = evq hvt Λ (x : Um D 𝕧)
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTwistEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma tensorTwistEquiv_tmul (x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)
    (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) :
    tensorTwistEquiv Λ Λ' (x ⊗ₜ y) =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ y ⊗ₜ ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ x
proof: := rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTwistEquiv_act
statement:
lemma tensorTwistEquiv_act (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (z : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1 ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) :
    tensorTwistEquiv Λ Λ' (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)
      (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) (chevalley R 𝕧 u) z) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 (TwL Λ') (TwL Λ) u (tensorTwistEquiv Λ Λ' z)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on generalizing z with
  | algebraMap c => simp only [AlgHom.commutes, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul]
  | E i =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
    | tmul a b =>
      simp only [chevalley_E, TensorModule.act_F_tmul, TensorModule.act_E_tmul, map_add,
        tensorTwistEquiv_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_K]
      exact add_comm _ _
  | F i =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
    | tmul a b =>
      simp only [chevalley_F, TensorModule.act_F_tmul, TensorModule.act_E_tmul, map_add,
        tensorTwistEquiv_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_K, neg_neg]
      exact add_comm _ _
  | K μ =>
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
    | tmul a b =>
      simp only [chevalley_K, TensorModule.act_K_tmul, tensorTwistEquiv_tmul,
        ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
  | mul x y hx hy => simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hx, hy]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.twTensorBasis_apply
statement:
lemma twTensorBasis_apply (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ' × canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    twTensorBasis hR Λ Λ' p = ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt Λ' p.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt Λ p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twTensorBasis, Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply', Module.Basis.map_apply,
    Module.Basis.map_apply, canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply, canonicalBasisHWBasis_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorTwistEquiv
statement:
lemma repr_tensorTwistEquiv
    (z : TensorModule 𝕂 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1))
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ' × canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    (twTensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorTwistEquiv Λ Λ' ((TensorModule.mk _ _).symm z)) p =
      (tensorHWBasis hR Λ Λ').repr z p.swap
proof:
:= by
  have h : (twTensorBasis hR Λ Λ').coord p ∘ₗ (tensorTwistEquiv Λ Λ').toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      (TensorModule.mk _ _).symm.toLinearMap = (tensorHWBasis hR Λ Λ').coord p.swap :=
    (tensorHWBasis hR Λ Λ').ext fun q ↦ by
      classical
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply,
        Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, tensorHWBasis_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
        LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, tensorTwistEquiv_tmul]
      rw [show ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt Λ' q.2) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
          ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt Λ q.1) = twTensorBasis hR Λ Λ' q.swap from
          (twTensorBasis_apply hR Λ Λ' q.swap).symm, Module.Basis.repr_self,
        Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      exact if_congr ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [← h, Prod.swap_swap], fun h ↦ by rw [h, Prod.swap_swap]⟩
        rfl rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorEmbTw_toTwist
statement:
lemma tensorEmbTw_toTwist (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ + Λ').1) :
    tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m) =
      tensorTwistEquiv Λ Λ' ((TensorModule.mk _ _).symm (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ.2 Λ'.2 m))
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorEmbTw]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorEmbTw_act
statement:
theorem tensorEmbTw_act (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (x : TwL (Λ + Λ')) :
    tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ' (u • x) = TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u (tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ' x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ + Λ').1)).surjective x
  rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, tensorEmbTw_toTwist, tensorEmbTw_toTwist, map_smul,
    ← tensorTwistEquiv_act]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorEmbTw_hwv
statement:
theorem tensorEmbTw_hwv :
    tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 (Λ + Λ').1)) =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEmbTw_toTwist]
  erw [tensorEmb_hwv hvt hR Λ.2 Λ'.2]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_zero_of_twist_equivariant
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_twist_equivariant {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module 𝕂 M] (Λ : Dom R)
    (ψ : TwL Λ →ₗ[𝕂] M) (act : QuantumGroup R 𝕧 → Module.End 𝕂 M)
    (hψ : ∀ u x, ψ (u • x) = act u (ψ x))
    (h₀ : ψ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1)) = 0) : ψ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)).surjective x
  induction m using hw_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply] at ha hb ⊢
    rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | smul c a ha =>
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply] at ha ⊢
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, ha, smul_zero]
  | hwv => exact h₀
  | F i b hb =>
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hb ⊢
    have h := hψ (E R 𝕧 i) (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ b)
    rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_E] at h
    rw [h, hb, map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.eq_tensorEmbTw
statement:
theorem eq_tensorEmbTw (ψ : TwL (Λ + Λ') →ₗ[𝕂] TwL Λ' ⊗[𝕂] TwL Λ)
    (hψ : ∀ u x, ψ (u • x) = TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u (ψ x))
    (h₁ : ψ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 (Λ + Λ').1)) =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1)) :
    ψ = tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ'
proof:
:= by
  refine sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_twist_equivariant (Λ + Λ') _
    (fun u ↦ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u) (fun u x ↦ ?_) ?_)
  · rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, hψ, tensorEmbTw_act, map_sub]
  · rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, h₁, tensorEmbTw_hwv, sub_self]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorEmbTw
statement:
theorem repr_tensorEmbTw (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ + Λ').1)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ' × canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    (twTensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m)) p =
      (tensorHWBasis hR Λ Λ').repr (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ.2 Λ'.2 m) p.swap
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEmbTw_toTwist, repr_tensorTwistEquiv]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isIntInv_repr_tensorEmbTw_evq
statement:
theorem isIntInv_repr_tensorEmbTw_evq {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ' × canonicalBasisHW D Λ) :
    IsIntInv ((twTensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr
      (tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt (Λ + Λ') x))) p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [repr_tensorEmbTw]
  exact isIntInv_repr_tensorEmb_evq hR Λ Λ' hx p.swap

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorEmbTw_evq_one
statement:
theorem repr_tensorEmbTw_evq_one {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (b₂ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ') :
    (twTensorBasis hR Λ Λ').repr
      (tensorEmbTw hR Λ Λ' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt (Λ + Λ') x))) (b₂, hwOne Λ) =
      if (b₂ : Um D 𝕧) = x then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [repr_tensorEmbTw]
  exact repr_tensorEmb_evq_one hR Λ Λ' hx b₂

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_act_tmul_hwv_eq
statement:
theorem exists_act_tmul_hwv_eq (z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) :
    ∃ u, TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u
      (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1) = z
proof:
:= by
  set z₀ := ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
    IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'.1
  set S : Submodule 𝕂 (TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) :=
    LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.applyₗ z₀) ∘ₗ
      (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1)).toLinearMap)
  have hS : ∀ w, w ∈ S ↔ ∃ u, TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u z₀ = w := fun w ↦ by
    simp [S]
  have hact : ∀ u w, w ∈ S → TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u w ∈ S := by
    rintro u w hw
    obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := (hS w).1 hw
    exact (hS _).2 ⟨u * u', by rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]⟩
  have hη : ∀ y, ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y ∈ S := by
    intro y
    induction y using hw_induction with
    | zero => rw [tmul_zero]; exact S.zero_mem
    | add a b ha hb => rw [tmul_add]; exact S.add_mem ha hb
    | smul c a ha => rw [tmul_smul]; exact S.smul_mem c ha
    | hwv => exact (hS _).2 ⟨1, by rw [map_one, Module.End.one_apply]⟩
    | F i b hb =>
      have h := hact (F R 𝕧 i) _ hb
      rwa [TensorModule.act_F_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_F,
        IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, map_zero, zero_tmul, zero_add] at h
  have hm : ∀ m y, ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y ∈ S := by
    intro m
    induction m using hw_induction with
    | zero => intro y; rw [map_zero, zero_tmul]; exact S.zero_mem
    | add a b ha hb => intro y; rw [map_add, add_tmul]; exact S.add_mem (ha y) (hb y)
    | smul c a ha => intro y; rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, ← smul_tmul']; exact S.smul_mem c (ha y)
    | hwv => exact hη
    | F i b hb =>
      intro y
      have h₁ := hact (E R 𝕧 i) _ (hb y)
      have h₂ := hact (Kt R 𝕧 i) _ (hb (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • E R 𝕧 i • y))
      rw [TensorModule.act_E_tmul] at h₁
      rw [TensorModule.act_K_tmul, ← mul_smul, K_add, add_neg_cancel, K_zero,
        one_smul] at h₂
      have h := S.sub_mem h₁ h₂
      rwa [add_sub_cancel_right, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_E] at h
  refine (hS z).1 ?_
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => exact S.add_mem ha hb
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1)).surjective x
    exact hm m y

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorContract_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorContract_tmul (δ : M₂ ⊗[𝕂] M₃ →ₗ[𝕂] 𝕂) (a : M₁) (b : M₂) (c : M₃) (d : M₄) :
    tensorContract M₁ M₄ δ ((a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (c ⊗ₜ[𝕂] d)) = δ (b ⊗ₜ[𝕂] c) • (a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] d)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensorContract, tensorTensorTensorAssoc_tmul, smul_tmul']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorContract_E
statement:
lemma tensorContract_E (i : I) (P : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) (Q : M₃ ⊗[𝕂] M₄) :
    tensorContract M₁ M₄ δ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (E R 𝕧 i) P ⊗ₜ[𝕂] Q +
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (Kt R 𝕧 i) P ⊗ₜ[𝕂] TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (E R 𝕧 i) Q) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (E R 𝕧 i) (tensorContract M₁ M₄ δ (P ⊗ₜ[𝕂] Q))
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add P P' hP hP' =>
    simp only [map_add, add_tmul] at hP hP' ⊢
    rw [← hP, ← hP']
    abel
  | tmul a b =>
    induction Q using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add Q Q' hQ hQ' =>
      simp only [map_add, tmul_add] at hQ hQ' ⊢
      rw [← hQ, ← hQ']
      abel
    | tmul c d =>
      have hE := hδ (E R 𝕧 i) (b ⊗ₜ[𝕂] c)
      have hK := hδ (Kt R 𝕧 i) (b ⊗ₜ[𝕂] c)
      rw [TensorModule.act_E_tmul, map_add, counit_E, zero_mul] at hE
      rw [TensorModule.act_K_tmul, counit_K, one_mul] at hK
      rw [TensorModule.act_E_tmul, TensorModule.act_K_tmul, TensorModule.act_E_tmul, add_tmul,
        tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, tensorContract_tmul, tensorContract_tmul,
        tensorContract_tmul, tensorContract_tmul, tensorContract_tmul, map_smul,
        TensorModule.act_E_tmul, hK, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hE, neg_smul, smul_add]
      abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorContract_F
statement:
lemma tensorContract_F (i : I) (P : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) (Q : M₃ ⊗[𝕂] M₄) :
    tensorContract M₁ M₄ δ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (F R 𝕧 i) P ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) Q +
        P ⊗ₜ[𝕂] TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (F R 𝕧 i) Q) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (F R 𝕧 i) (tensorContract M₁ M₄ δ (P ⊗ₜ[𝕂] Q))
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add P P' hP hP' =>
    simp only [map_add, add_tmul] at hP hP' ⊢
    rw [← hP, ← hP']
    abel
  | tmul a b =>
    induction Q using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add Q Q' hQ hQ' =>
      simp only [map_add, tmul_add] at hQ hQ' ⊢
      rw [← hQ, ← hQ']
      abel
    | tmul c d =>
      have hF := hδ (F R 𝕧 i) (b ⊗ₜ[𝕂] c)
      have hK := hδ (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) (b ⊗ₜ[𝕂] c)
      rw [TensorModule.act_F_tmul, map_add, counit_F, zero_mul] at hF
      rw [TensorModule.act_K_tmul, counit_K, one_mul] at hK
      rw [TensorModule.act_F_tmul, TensorModule.act_K_tmul, TensorModule.act_F_tmul, add_tmul,
        tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, tensorContract_tmul, tensorContract_tmul,
        tensorContract_tmul, tensorContract_tmul, tensorContract_tmul, map_smul,
        TensorModule.act_F_tmul, hK, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hF, neg_smul, smul_add]
      abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorContract_K
statement:
lemma tensorContract_K (μ : Y) (P : M₁ ⊗[𝕂] M₂) (Q : M₃ ⊗[𝕂] M₄) :
    tensorContract M₁ M₄ δ (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (K R 𝕧 μ) P ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (K R 𝕧 μ) Q) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (K R 𝕧 μ) (tensorContract M₁ M₄ δ (P ⊗ₜ[𝕂] Q))
proof:
:= by
  induction P using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add P P' hP hP' => simp only [map_add, add_tmul, hP, hP']
  | tmul a b =>
    induction Q using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add Q Q' hQ hQ' => simp only [map_add, tmul_add, hQ, hQ']
    | tmul c d =>
      have hK := hδ (K R 𝕧 μ) (b ⊗ₜ[𝕂] c)
      rw [TensorModule.act_K_tmul, counit_K, one_mul] at hK
      rw [TensorModule.act_K_tmul, TensorModule.act_K_tmul, tensorContract_tmul,
        tensorContract_tmul, map_smul, TensorModule.act_K_tmul, hK]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorTransition_tmul (x : TwL (Λ' + Λ)) (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ' + Λ'').1) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] y) =
      tensorContract (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ''.1) (tensorPairing hR Λ')
      (tensorEmbTw hR Λ' Λ x ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (TensorModule.mk _ _).symm (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ'.2 Λ''.2 y))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorEmb_act
statement:
lemma tensorEmb_act (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (y : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ' + Λ'').1) :
    (TensorModule.mk _ _).symm (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ'.2 Λ''.2 (u • y)) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u ((TensorModule.mk _ _).symm (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ'.2 Λ''.2 y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul]
  rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_comp_act_E
statement:
lemma tensorTransition_comp_act_E (i : I) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (E R 𝕧 i) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (E R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ''
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun x y ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorModule.act_E_tmul, LinearMap.map_add,
    tensorTransition_tmul, tensorTransition_tmul, tensorTransition_tmul,
    tensorEmbTw_act hR Λ' Λ (E R 𝕧 i) x, tensorEmbTw_act hR Λ' Λ (Kt R 𝕧 i) x,
    tensorEmb_act hR (E R 𝕧 i) y, ← LinearMap.map_add]
  exact tensorContract_E (tensorPairing_act hR Λ') i _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_comp_act_F
statement:
lemma tensorTransition_comp_act_F (i : I) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (F R 𝕧 i) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (F R 𝕧 i) ∘ₗ tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ''
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun x y ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorModule.act_F_tmul, LinearMap.map_add,
    tensorTransition_tmul, tensorTransition_tmul, tensorTransition_tmul,
    tensorEmbTw_act hR Λ' Λ (F R 𝕧 i) x, tensorEmb_act hR (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i)) y,
    tensorEmb_act hR (F R 𝕧 i) y, ← LinearMap.map_add]
  exact tensorContract_F (tensorPairing_act hR Λ') i _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_comp_act_K
statement:
lemma tensorTransition_comp_act_K (μ : Y) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (K R 𝕧 μ) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ (K R 𝕧 μ) ∘ₗ tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ''
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun x y ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorModule.act_K_tmul,
    tensorTransition_tmul, tensorTransition_tmul, tensorEmbTw_act hR Λ' Λ (K R 𝕧 μ) x,
    tensorEmb_act hR (K R 𝕧 μ) y]
  exact tensorContract_K (tensorPairing_act hR Λ') μ _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_act
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_act (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧)
    (z : TwL (Λ' + Λ) ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 (Λ' + Λ'').1) :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u z) =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u (tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' z)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' ∘ₗ TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u =
      TensorModule.act R 𝕧 _ _ u ∘ₗ tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' from LinearMap.congr_fun h z
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c =>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun z ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes,
      Module.algebraMap_end_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul]
  | E i => exact tensorTransition_comp_act_E hR Λ Λ' Λ'' i
  | F i => exact tensorTransition_comp_act_F hR Λ Λ' Λ'' i
  | K μ => exact tensorTransition_comp_act_K hR Λ Λ' Λ'' μ
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, LinearMap.comp_add, hx, hy, map_add, LinearMap.add_comp]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_mul, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hx, LinearMap.comp_assoc, hy,
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, map_mul, Module.End.mul_eq_comp]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_hwv
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_hwv :

      (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 (Λ' + Λ).1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 (Λ' + Λ'').1) =
      ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ''.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorTransition_tmul, tensorEmbTw_hwv]
  erw [tensorEmb_hwv hvt hR Λ'.2 Λ''.2]
  erw [tensorContract_tmul, tensorPairing_hwv, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.isNegLaurent_finsuppSum
statement:
lemma isNegLaurent_finsuppSum {ι : Type*} (f : ι →₀ 𝕂) {g : ι → 𝕂 → 𝕂}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ f.support, IsNegLaurent (g i (f i))) : IsNegLaurent (f.sum g)
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_induction _ IsNegLaurent (fun _ _ ↦ IsNegLaurent.add) isNegLaurent_zero h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.repr_tensorTransition_sub
statement:
theorem repr_tensorTransition_sub {x x'' : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hx'' : x'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) (p : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    IsNegLaurent ((tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'').repr (tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ''
      (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt (Λ' + Λ) x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] evq hvt (Λ' + Λ'') x'')) p -
        if (p.1 : Um D 𝕧) = x ∧ (p.2 : Um D 𝕧) = x'' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  set B₁ := twTensorBasis hR Λ' Λ
  set B₂ := tensorHWBasis hR Λ' Λ''
  set q₀ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ × canonicalBasisHW D Λ' := (p.1, hwOne Λ')
  set r₀ : canonicalBasisHW D Λ' × canonicalBasisHW D Λ'' := (hwOne Λ', p.2)
  set Bf : (TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] TwL Λ') →ₗ[𝕂]
      TensorModule 𝕂 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ''.1) →ₗ[𝕂] 𝕂 :=
    (((TensorProduct.mk 𝕂 _ _).compr₂ ((tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'').coord p ∘ₗ
      tensorContract (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ''.1) (tensorPairing hR Λ'))).compl₂
        (TensorModule.mk _ _).symm.toLinearMap) -
      (LinearMap.mul 𝕂 𝕂).compl₁₂ (B₁.coord q₀) (B₂.coord r₀)
  have hval : ∀ q r, Bf (B₁ q) (B₂ r) =
      tensorPairing hR Λ' (tensorBasis hR Λ' Λ' (q.2, r.1)) * (if (q.1, r.2) = p then 1 else 0) -
        (if q = q₀ then 1 else 0) * (if r = r₀ then 1 else 0) := by
    intro q r
    simp only [Bf, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.compl₂_apply, LinearMap.compr₂_apply,
      LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply', Module.Basis.coord_apply,
      Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, mk_apply,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [twTensorBasis_apply, tensorHWBasis_apply]
    erw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [tensorContract_tmul, map_smul, ← tensorBasis_apply hR Λ Λ'' (q.1, r.2),
      Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ← tensorBasis_apply hR Λ' Λ' (q.2, r.1)]
  have hX := isIntInv_repr_tensorEmbTw_evq hR Λ' Λ hx
  have hY := isIntInv_repr_tensorEmb_evq hR Λ' Λ'' hx''
  have hX₀ := repr_tensorEmbTw_evq_one hR Λ' Λ hx p.1
  have hY₀ := repr_tensorEmb_evq_one hR Λ' Λ'' hx'' p.2
  have key : Bf (tensorEmbTw hR Λ' Λ (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt (Λ' + Λ) x)))
      (tensorEmb hvt hR Λ'.2 Λ''.2 (evq hvt (Λ' + Λ'') x'')) =
      (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'').repr (tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ''
        (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt (Λ' + Λ) x) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] evq hvt (Λ' + Λ'') x'')) p -
        if (p.1 : Um D 𝕧) = x ∧ (p.2 : Um D 𝕧) = x'' then 1 else 0 := by
    simp only [Bf, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.compl₂_apply, LinearMap.compr₂_apply,
      LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply', Module.Basis.coord_apply, mk_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, B₁, B₂, q₀, r₀]
    rw [hX₀, hY₀, tensorTransition_tmul, ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, one_mul]
  rw [← key, ← LinearMap.sum_repr_mul_repr_mul B₁ B₂ (B := Bf)]
  refine isNegLaurent_finsuppSum _ fun q _ ↦ isNegLaurent_finsuppSum _ fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hval, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (_ * _) (_ - _)]
  refine IsNegLaurent.mul_isIntInv ?_ ((hX q).mul (hY r))
  by_cases hqr : q = q₀ ∧ r = r₀
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hqr
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, tensorPairing_tensorBasis_one]
    simp only [mul_one, sub_self, isNegLaurent_zero]
  · rw [show ((if q = q₀ then (1 : 𝕂) else 0) * if r = r₀ then 1 else 0) = 0 by
      rw [ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, ite_eq_right hqr], sub_zero]
    by_cases hp : (q.1, r.2) = p
    · rw [ite_eq_left hp, mul_one]
      refine isNegLaurent_tensorPairing_tensorBasis hR Λ' fun h ↦ hqr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Prod.ext_iff.2 ⟨(Prod.ext_iff.1 hp).1, (Prod.ext_iff.1 h).1⟩
      · exact Prod.ext_iff.2 ⟨(Prod.ext_iff.1 h).2, (Prod.ext_iff.1 hp).2⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right hp, mul_zero]
      exact isNegLaurent_zero

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_sub_mem_tensorLatNeg
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_sub_mem_tensorLatNeg (b : canonicalBasisHW D Λ)
    (b'' : canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt (Λ' + Λ) b) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      evq hvt (Λ' + Λ'') b'') - tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'' (b, b'') ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ''
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h
  have := repr_tensorTransition_sub hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ b.2)
    (canonicalBasisHW_subset D Λ'' b''.2) h
  have e : (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').repr (tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'' (b, b'')) h =
      if (show TensorIdx Λ Λ'' from (b, b'')) = h then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [← tensorBasisIdx_apply hR Λ Λ'' (show TensorIdx Λ Λ'' from (b, b'')),
      Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  change IsNegLaurent ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').repr (_ - tensorBasis hR Λ Λ'' (b, b'')) h)
  rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, e]
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  have hc : (show TensorIdx Λ Λ'' from (b, b'')) = (h₁, h₂) ↔
      (h₁ : Um D 𝕧) = b ∧ (h₂ : Um D 𝕧) = b'' := by
    refine ⟨fun e ↦ ?_, fun e ↦ ?_⟩
    · have e' : (b, b'') = (h₁, h₂) := e
      rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at e'
      exact ⟨congrArg Subtype.val e'.1.symm, congrArg Subtype.val e'.2.symm⟩
    · change (b, b'') = (h₁, h₂)
      rw [Subtype.ext e.1, Subtype.ext e.2]
  convert this using 2
  · rfl
  · exact if_congr hc rfl rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tensorTransition_mem_tensorLatNeg
statement:
theorem tensorTransition_mem_tensorLatNeg (b : canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ))
    (b'' : canonicalBasisHW D (Λ' + Λ''))
    (h : (b : Um D 𝕧) ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ ∨ (b'' : Um D 𝕧) ∉ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'') :
    tensorTransition hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ (evq hvt (Λ' + Λ) b) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
      evq hvt (Λ' + Λ'') b'') ∈ tensorLatNeg hR Λ Λ''
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro p
  have := repr_tensorTransition_sub hR Λ Λ' Λ'' (canonicalBasisHW_subset D _ b.2)
    (canonicalBasisHW_subset D _ b''.2) p
  have hne : ¬((p.1 : Um D 𝕧) = b ∧ (p.2 : Um D 𝕧) = b'') := by
    rintro ⟨e₁, e₂⟩
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact h (e₁ ▸ p.1.2)
    · exact h (e₂ ▸ p.2.2)
  rwa [ite_eq_right hne, sub_zero] at this

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_X_zpow
statement: lemma bar_X_zpow (n : ℤ) : RatFunc.bar (𝕧 ^ n) = 𝕧 ^ (-n)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hw_induction
statement:
lemma hw_induction (Λ : Y →+ ℤ) {P : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ → Prop}
    (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ) (zero : P 0) (add : ∀ a b, P a → P b → P (a + b))
    (smul : ∀ (c : 𝕂) a, P a → P (c • a)) (hwv : P (IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ))
    (F : ∀ i a, P a → P (F R 𝕧 i • a)) : P m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _).comp
    (VermaModule.toVerma_surjective (R := R) (Λ := Λ) hvn_ratFunc) m
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂 (Set.range (FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I)) := by
    rw [(FreeAlgebra.wordBasis 𝕂 I).span_eq]
    trivial
  change P (ev R 𝕧 Λ y)
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [← monomial_eq_wordBasis]
    induction w with
    | nil =>
      change P (ev R 𝕧 Λ 1)
      rw [ev_one]
      exact hwv
    | cons i w ih =>
      rw [ev_monomial_cons]
      exact F i _ ih
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul]; exact smul c _ ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hw_K_smul_hwv

lemma hw_K_smul_hwv (μ : Y) :
    K R 𝕧 μ • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1 = 𝕧 ^ Λ.1 μ • IrreducibleModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ.1
proof:
:= by

    Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_F_smul
statement:
lemma hwBar_F_smul (i : I) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwBar hR Λ (F R 𝕧 i • m) = F R 𝕧 i • hwBar hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ev_surjective Λ m
  rw [← ev_ι_mul, hwBar_ev, hwBar_ev, map_mul, ← θ, bar_θ, θ, ev_ι_mul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_K_smul
statement:
lemma hwBar_K_smul (μ : Y) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwBar hR Λ (K R 𝕧 μ • m) = K R 𝕧 (-μ) • hwBar hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using hw_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [smul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul c a ha => rw [smul_comm, hwBar_smul, ha, hwBar_smul, smul_comm]
  | hwv =>
    rw [hw_K_smul_hwv, hwBar_smul, hwBar_hwv, hw_K_smul_hwv, bar_X_zpow, map_neg]
  | F i a ha =>
    rw [← mul_smul, K_mul_F, smul_assoc, mul_smul, hwBar_smul, hwBar_F_smul, ha,
      hwBar_F_smul, ← mul_smul (K R 𝕧 (-μ)), K_mul_F, smul_assoc, mul_smul, bar_X_zpow,
      map_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.bar_qInv
statement:
lemma bar_qInv (i : I) :
    RatFunc.bar ((𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹) = -(𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_inv₀, map_sub, map_inv₀, map_pow, RatFunc.bar_X, inv_pow, inv_inv, ← neg_sub,
    inv_neg]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_E_smul
statement:
lemma hwBar_E_smul (i : I) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwBar hR Λ (E R 𝕧 i • m) = E R 𝕧 i • hwBar hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using hw_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [smul_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul c a ha => rw [smul_comm, hwBar_smul, ha, hwBar_smul, smul_comm]
  | hwv => rw [IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv, hwBar_hwv, map_zero, IrreducibleModule.E_smul_hwv]
  | F j a ha =>
    have key : ∀ x : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1, E R 𝕧 i • F R 𝕧 j • x =
        F R 𝕧 j • E R 𝕧 i • x + (if i = j then
          (𝕧 ^ D.d i - (𝕧 ^ D.d i)⁻¹)⁻¹ • (Kt R 𝕧 i • x - K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • x) else 0) := by
      intro x
      rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← sub_smul, E_mul_F_sub]
      split_ifs
      · rw [smul_assoc, sub_smul]
      · rw [zero_smul]
    rw [key, map_add, hwBar_F_smul hR Λ j (E R 𝕧 i • a), ha, hwBar_F_smul hR Λ j a, key]
    congr 1
    split_ifs
    · rw [Kt, hwBar_smul, map_sub, hwBar_K_smul, hwBar_K_smul, bar_qInv, neg_neg, neg_smul,
        ← smul_neg, neg_sub]
    · rw [map_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwBar_smul_U
statement:
theorem hwBar_smul_U (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) (m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) :
    hwBar hR Λ (u • m) = barHom R u • hwBar hR Λ m
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on generalizing m with
  | algebraMap c => rw [algebraMap_smul, hwBar_smul, barHom_algebraMap, algebraMap_smul]
  | E i => rw [hwBar_E_smul, barHom_E]
  | F i => rw [hwBar_F_smul, barHom_F]
  | K μ => rw [hwBar_K_smul, barHom_K]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_smul, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_smul]
  | mul x y hx hy => rw [mul_smul, hx, hy, map_mul, mul_smul]
