name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
lemma plusHom_mem_adWeightSpace {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : LusztigF 𝕂 I}
    (hx : x ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν) : plusHom R 𝕧 x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (R.rootSum ν)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [← wordChar_eq_rootSum]
    exact plusHom_monomial_mem_adWeightSpace w
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.hwWt_eq_bot
statement:
lemma hwWt_eq_bot {Λ' : Y →+ ℤ} (h : ∀ ν, Λ' ≠ Λ.1 - R.rootSum ν) :
    weightSpace R 𝕧 (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1) Λ' = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.2 ((weightSpace_quotient_le_map hvn_ratFunc
    VermaModule.iSup_weightSpace_eq_top _ Λ').trans ?_)
  rw [VermaModule.weightSpace_eq_bot hvn_ratFunc h, Submodule.map_bot]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_smul_mem_hwWt
proof:
:= by
  have h := Modified.smul_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace (plusHom_mem_adWeightSpace hx) hm
  have hμ : R.rootSum μ = R.rootSum (μ - ν) + R.rootSum ν := by
    rw [← R.rootSum_add, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hνμ]
  have e : R.rootSum ν + (Λ.1 - R.rootSum μ) = Λ.1 - R.rootSum (μ - ν) := by
    rw [hμ]; abel
  rwa [e] at h

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.plusHom_smul_hwWt_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := Modified.smul_mem_weightSpace_of_mem_adWeightSpace (plusHom_mem_adWeightSpace hx) hm
  rwa [hwWt_eq_bot Λ fun κ hκ ↦ hνμ ?_, Submodule.mem_bot] at h
  have : R.rootSum (κ + ν) = R.rootSum μ := by
    rw [R.rootSum_add, ← sub_eq_zero]
    rw [← sub_eq_zero] at hκ
    rw [← hκ]
    abel
  rw [← LusztigCartanDatum.RootDatum.rootSum_injective hR this]
  exact le_add_self

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.tmul_mem_tensorWt
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_tensorWt {μ μ' : I →₀ ℕ} {m : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ.1} (hm : m ∈ hwWt Λ μ)
    {m' : IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} (hm' : m' ∈ hwWt Λ' μ') :
    ChevalleyTwist.toTwist R 𝕧 _ m ⊗ₜ[𝕂] m' ∈ tensorWt Λ Λ' μ μ'
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨m, hm⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨m', hm'⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.quasiR_mem_span
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := quasiR_mem_range R ν
  rw [← ht]
  clear ht
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | tmul a b =>
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩ := b
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, y, hy, by simp⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.actPair_quasiR_mem_tensorWt
statement:
theorem actPair_quasiR_mem_tensorWt {ν μ μ' : I →₀ ℕ} (hμ : ν ≤ μ) (hμ' : ν ≤ μ')
    {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} (hz : z ∈ tensorWt Λ Λ' μ μ') :
    TensorModule.actPair R 𝕧 (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) (quasiR R ν) z ∈
      tensorWt Λ Λ' (μ - ν) (μ' - ν)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hz
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | tmul m m' =>
    have hq := quasiR_mem_span (R := R) ν
    generalize quasiR R ν = q at hq ⊢
    induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem t ht =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := ht
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
        Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
      rw [TensorModule.act_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_minusHom]
      exact tmul_mem_tensorWt Λ Λ' (plusHom_smul_mem_hwWt Λ hμ hx m.2)
        (plusHom_smul_mem_hwWt Λ' hμ' hy m'.2)
    | zero => rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.actPair_quasiR_eq_zero
statement:
theorem actPair_quasiR_eq_zero {ν μ μ' : I →₀ ℕ} (h : ¬ (ν ≤ μ ∧ ν ≤ μ'))
    {z : TwL Λ ⊗[𝕂] IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1} (hz : z ∈ tensorWt Λ Λ' μ μ') :
    TensorModule.actPair R 𝕧 (TwL Λ) (IrreducibleModule R 𝕧 Λ'.1) (quasiR R ν) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hz
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | tmul m m' =>
    have hq := quasiR_mem_span (R := R) ν
    generalize quasiR R ν = q at hq ⊢
    induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem t ht =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := ht
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
        Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
      rw [TensorModule.act_tmul, ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_minusHom]
      rcases not_and_or.1 h with h | h
      · rw [plusHom_smul_hwWt_eq_zero hR Λ h hx m.2, LinearEquiv.map_zero, zero_tmul]
      · rw [plusHom_smul_hwWt_eq_zero hR Λ' h hy m'.2, tmul_zero]
    | zero => rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb, add_zero]
    | smul c a _ ha => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, ha, smul_zero]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_mem_Uw
statement: lemma negBar_mem_Uw {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) : negBar D x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨LusztigF.bar y, ?_, rfl⟩
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [bar_monomial]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [LusztigF.bar_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_mem_latInfBar
statement:
lemma negBar_mem_latInfBar {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_latInfBar_iff, negBar_negBar]; exact hx

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.negBar_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem negBar_eq_of_mem {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (h : NegGlobalAt D ν) {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ negBalanced D ν) : negBar D x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxZ, hxw, hx₀, hx₁⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y, hyZ, hxy⟩ := exists_sub_negBar_eq_smul D hxZ
  have hne : (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' : (RatFunc.X : 𝕂) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [sq]; nth_rewrite 2 [sub_eq_zero.1 h]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    exact pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X 2 two_pos h'
  have hy' : y = (RatFunc.X - RatFunc.X⁻¹ : 𝕂)⁻¹ • (x - negBar D x) := by
    rw [hxy, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
  have hb₀ : negBar D x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A := (mem_latInfBar_iff D x).1 hx₁
  have hb₁ : negBar D x ∈ latInfBar D := negBar_mem_latInfBar D hx₀
  have hyϖ : y ∈ ϖ • latInf (D := D) hvt A := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_inv_X_sub_eq_uniformizer_mul
    rw [hy', ← hu, algebraMap_smul, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hx₀ hb₀))
  have hy0 : y = 0 := by
    refine h.2 y ⟨hyZ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ hyϖ
    · rw [hy']
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hxw (negBar_mem_Uw D hxw))
    · exact Submodule.smul_le_self_of_tower ϖ _ hyϖ
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_inv_X_sub_eq_localX_mul
      rw [hy', ← hu, algebraMap_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (sub_mem hx₁ hb₁)
  rw [hy0, smul_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hxy
  exact hxy.symm

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_negLift

    (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ w)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_inv_pow_smul_mem_latInf
statement:
lemma exists_inv_pow_smul_mem_latInf {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Um D 𝕧} (hx : x ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ((𝕧⁻¹) ^ N : 𝕂) • x ∈ latInf (D := D) hvt A
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_smul_mem_latInf (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rwa [← algebraMap_smul 𝕂, map_pow, InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer] at hn

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_span_negLift
proof:
:= by
  refine span_of_balanced (L₀ := latInf (D := D) hvt A) (L₁ := latInfBar D)
    (M := negIntegralWeight D ν) (laurent_smul_eq D) (fun w ↦ ⟨(negLift_mem h w).1,
      (negLift_mem h w).2.1⟩) (fun w ↦ (negLift_mem h w).2.2.2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ⟨hxZ, hxw⟩
  · rintro y ⟨hyZ, hyw⟩ hy₀
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_integer_crystal_residue_coordinates D hyZ hy₀
    have hp := proj_mem_smul_latInf (D := D) (LusztigF.toZ ν) ha
    rw [map_sub, proj_of_mem_Uw hyw, Finsupp.sum, map_sum] at hp
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at hp
    classical
    set S := a.support.filter fun w ↦ wordWeight w = ν
    refine ⟨∑ w ∈ S.attach, (a w.1 : ℤ) • negLift h ⟨w.1, (Finset.mem_filter.1 w.2).2⟩,
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
    have hsum : ∑ w ∈ a.support, NegativePart.proj D 𝕧 (LusztigF.toZ ν)
        ((a w : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w) = ∑ w ∈ S.attach, (a w.1 : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w.1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_attach S (fun w ↦ (a w : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w), Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ ↦ ?_
      rw [map_smul, proj_of_mem_Uw (fWi_mem_Uw w)]
      by_cases hw : wordWeight w = ν
      · simp [hw]
      · have hz : LusztigF.toZ (wordWeight w) ≠ LusztigF.toZ ν :=
          fun e ↦ hw (LusztigF.toZ_injective e)
        simp [hw, hz]
    rw [hsum] at hp
    have e : y - ∑ w ∈ S.attach, (a w.1 : ℤ) • negLift h ⟨w.1, (Finset.mem_filter.1 w.2).2⟩ =
        (y - ∑ w ∈ S.attach, (a w.1 : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w.1) -
          ∑ w ∈ S.attach, (a w.1 : 𝕂) • (negLift h ⟨w.1, (Finset.mem_filter.1 w.2).2⟩ -
            fWi (D := D) hvt w.1) := by
      simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      abel
    rw [e]
    refine sub_mem hp (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w _ ↦ ?_)
    rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    exact zsmul_mem (negLift_sub_mem h ⟨w.1, (Finset.mem_filter.1 w.2).2⟩) _
  · rintro y ⟨hyZ, hyw⟩ hyϖ hy₁
    exact h.2 y ⟨hyZ, hyw, Submodule.smul_le_self_of_tower ϖ _ hyϖ, hy₁⟩ hyϖ
  · rintro y ⟨-, hyw⟩
    exact exists_inv_pow_smul_mem_latInf hyw
  · rintro y ⟨-, hyw⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_inv_pow_smul_mem_latInf (negBar_mem_Uw D hyw)
    refine ⟨N, (mem_latInfBar_iff D _).2 ?_⟩
    rwa [negBar_smul, map_pow, RatFunc.bar_X]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.E_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan_succ
statement:
lemma E_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan_succ (i : I) {d : ℕ} {p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ}
    (hp : p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ (d + 1)) : E R 𝕧 i • p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hw' : w.length < d + 1 := hw
    exact vermaDegSpan_mono Λ (by omega) (E_smul_toVerma_monomial_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ i w)
  | zero => rw [map_zero, smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, smul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.minusHom_monomial_smul_sub_mem_tensorDepth_succ
statement:
lemma minusHom_monomial_smul_sub_mem_tensorDepth_succ (w : List I) {a : ℕ}
    {p : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ} (hp : p ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ (a + 1)) :
    minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 w) • mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'') -
      mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ'' (monomial 𝕂 w)) ∈
      tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    rw [monomial_nil, _root_.map_one, one_smul, VermaModule.toVerma_one, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  | cons i w ih =>
    set b := VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ'' (monomial 𝕂 w)
    have hb : b ∈ vermaDegSpan R 𝕧 Λ'' (w.length + 1) :=
      ⟨_, monomial_mem_degSpan (Nat.lt_succ_self _), rfl⟩
    have e' : F R 𝕧 i • tw p = tw (E R 𝕧 i • p) := by
      rw [ChevalleyTwist.smul_toTwist, chevalley_F]
    have e : minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 (i :: w)) •
          mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'') -
        mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.toVerma R 𝕧 Λ'' (monomial 𝕂 (i :: w))) =
        F R 𝕧 i • (minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 w) •
          mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ'') - mkT (tw p ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b)) +
        mkT ((F R 𝕧 i • tw p) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (K R 𝕧 (-ktilde R i) • b)) := by
      rw [smul_sub, TensorModule.F_smul_tmul, monomial_cons, _root_.map_mul, minusHom_θ,
        mul_smul, F_smul_toVerma, ← monomial_cons, map_add]
      abel
    rw [e, e', List.length_cons]
    exact add_mem (F_smul_mem_tensorDepth i ih)
      (tmul_mem_tensorDepth (E_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan_succ Λ i hp)
        (K_smul_mem_vermaDegSpan Λ'' _ hb))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triAct_sub_triEquiv_mem_tensorDepth_succ
proof:
:= by
  have h : triDepth D (a + 1) (b + 1) ≤ (tensorDepth R Λ Λ'' a b).comap
      (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'' - (triEquiv R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'').toLinearMap) := by
    refine Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun p hp q hq ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hq
    simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
      have hw' : w.length < b + 1 := hw
      rw [triEquiv_mk_tmul_mk]
      change (minusHom R 𝕧 (monomial 𝕂 w) * plusHom R 𝕧 x) • vermaTensorHwv R 𝕧 Λ Λ'' - _ ∈ _
      rw [mul_smul, plusHom_smul_vermaTensorHwv]
      exact tensorDepth_mono le_rfl (by omega)
        (minusHom_monomial_smul_sub_mem_tensorDepth_succ Λ Λ'' w ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' _ _ hy hy' =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, add_tmul, map_add, map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
      exact add_mem hy hy'
    | smul c y _ hy =>
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← smul_tmul', map_smul, map_smul, ← smul_sub]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  exact h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.mem_degSpan_map_of_mem_Uw
statement:

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.triEquiv_tmul_eq_vermaTensorMinus
statement:
lemma triEquiv_tmul_eq_vermaTensorMinus (Λ Λ'' : Y →+ ℤ) (x y : Um D 𝕧) :
    triEquiv R hvn_ratFunc Λ Λ'' (y ⊗ₜ[𝕂] x) = vermaTensorMinus R Λ Λ'' x y
proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_tensorIrrProj_lead
statement:
lemma exists_tensorIrrProj_lead (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) (h₀ : TensorIdx Λ Λ'') :
    ∃ m ∈ tensorDepth R Λ.1 Λ''.1 (hwbWt Λ h₀.1).degree (hwbWt Λ'' h₀.2).degree,
      tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (vermaTensorMinus R Λ.1 Λ''.1 h₀.1 h₀.2 + m) =
        tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc₀ := repr_tensorCanonical_self hR Λ Λ'' h₀
  have he : ∀ h : TensorIdx Λ Λ'', tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (vermaTensorMinus R Λ.1 Λ''.1 h.1 h.2) =
      tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'' h := fun h ↦ by
    rw [tensorBasisIdx_apply, tensorBasis_eq_tensorIrrProj hR Λ Λ'' h]
    rfl
  have hmem : h₀ ∈ ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').repr (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀)).support :=
    Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 (by rw [hc₀]; exact one_ne_zero)
  refine ⟨∑ h ∈ ((tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').repr (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀)).support.erase h₀,
    (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').repr (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀) h •
      vermaTensorMinus R Λ.1 Λ''.1 h.1 h.2,
    Submodule.sum_mem _ fun h hh ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hl := tensorLt_of_repr_tensorCanonical_ne_zero hR Λ Λ'' (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hh)
      (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hh))
    exact tmul_mem_tensorDepth (vermaMinus_mem_vermaDegSpan _ hl.2.1 (mem_Uw_cbWt _))
      (vermaMinus_mem_vermaDegSpan _ hl.2.2 (mem_Uw_cbWt _))
  · rw [map_add, map_sum, he]
    simp only [map_smul, he]
    conv_rhs => rw [← (tensorBasisIdx hR Λ Λ'').linearCombination_repr
      (tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀), Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hmem, hc₀, one_smul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_triAct_tensorCanonical_lead
statement:
lemma exists_triAct_tensorCanonical_lead (Λ Λ'' : Dom R) (h₀ : TensorIdx Λ Λ'') :
    ∃ z ∈ triDepth D (hwbWt Λ h₀.1).degree (hwbWt Λ'' h₀.2).degree,
      tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1
        ((h₀.2 : Um D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (h₀.1 : Um D 𝕧) + z)) = tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' h₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, e⟩ := exists_tensorIrrProj_lead hR Λ Λ'' h₀
  have ht₀ : (h₀.2 : Um D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (h₀.1 : Um D 𝕧) ∈
      triDepth D ((hwbWt Λ h₀.1).degree + 1) ((hwbWt Λ'' h₀.2).degree + 1) :=
    Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ (mem_degSpan_map_of_mem_Uw (mem_Uw_cbWt _))
      (mem_degSpan_map_of_mem_Uw (mem_Uw_cbWt _))
  obtain ⟨z, hz, ez⟩ := exists_triAct_eq Λ.1 Λ''.1 _ _
    (sub_mem hm (triAct_sub_triEquiv_mem_tensorDepth_succ Λ.1 Λ''.1 ht₀))
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, ez, triEquiv_tmul_eq_vermaTensorMinus, ← e]
  congr 1
  abel

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.cbWt_eq_of_mem_Uw
statement:
lemma cbWt_eq_of_mem_Uw (b : canonicalBasis D) {ν : I →₀ ℕ} (hb : (b : Um D 𝕧) ∈ Uw D 𝕧 ν) :
    cbWt D b = ν
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (b : Um D 𝕧) ≠ 0 := (linearIndependent_canonicalBasis D).ne_zero b
  have h1 := proj_of_mem_Uw hb (toZ (cbWt D b))
  rw [proj_of_mem_Uw (mem_Uw_cbWt b), ite_eq_left rfl] at h1
  split_ifs at h1 with h
  · ext i
    have := congrArg (· i) h
    simp only [toZ_apply, Nat.cast_inj] at this
    exact this.symm
  · exact absurd h1 hne

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.map_degSpan_le_span_canonicalBasis
statement:
lemma map_degSpan_le_span_canonicalBasis (d : ℕ) :
    (degSpan 𝕂 I d).map (serreSubmodule D 𝕧).mkQ ≤
      Submodule.span 𝕂 ((↑) '' {b : canonicalBasis D | (cbWt D b).degree < d})
proof:
:= by
  rw [degSpan, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hmem : (serreSubmodule D 𝕧).mkQ (monomial 𝕂 w) ∈ Uw D 𝕧 (wordWeight w) :=
    ⟨_, monomial_mem_weightSpace w, rfl⟩
  rw [← span_canonicalBasisAt] at hmem
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ hmem
  intro x hx
  have hxB : x ∈ canonicalBasis D := Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨_, hx⟩
  refine ⟨⟨x, hxB⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
  have hw' := cbWt_eq_of_mem_Uw ⟨x, hxB⟩
    (by rw [← span_canonicalBasisAt]; exact Submodule.subset_span hx)
  change (cbWt D ⟨x, hxB⟩).degree < d
  rw [hw', degree_wordWeight]
  exact hw

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.triangularBasisOne_apply
statement:
lemma Modified.triangularBasisOne_apply (t : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    triangularBasisOne R t = triangularBasisCanonical R (t.2.2, t.1 + cbRootWt D R t.2.1, t.2.1)
proof:
:=
  by rw [triangularBasisOne, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_symm]; rfl

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.leftActOne_triMul_tmul
statement:
lemma leftActOne_triMul_tmul (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (b b'' : canonicalBasis D) :
    leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc ((b'' : Um D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (b : Um D 𝕧))) =
      triangularBasisOne R (ζ, b, b'')
proof:
:= by
  have e : triMul R hvn_ratFunc ((b'' : Um D 𝕧) ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (b : Um D 𝕧)) =
      (canonicalMinusBasis R b'' : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) * canonicalPlusBasis R b := by
    rw [canonicalMinusBasis_apply, canonicalPlusBasis_apply]
    rfl
  rw [e, leftActOne_eq_elt _
      (mul_mem_adWeightSpace (canonicalMinusBasis_mem b'') (canonicalPlusBasis_mem b)),
    triangularBasisOne_apply, triangularBasisCanonical_apply, triFun]
  dsimp only
  exact elt_index (by abel) (by abel) rfl _ _

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.leftActOne_triMul_mem_span
statement:
lemma leftActOne_triMul_mem_span (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {a c : ℕ} {z : fQ ⊗[𝕂] fQ}
    (hz : z ∈ triDepth D a c) :
    leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc z) ∈ Submodule.span 𝕂
      (triangularBasisOne R '' {t | t.1 = ζ ∧ (cbWt D t.2.1).degree < a ∧
        (cbWt D t.2.2).degree < c})
proof:
:= by
  have h : triDepth D a c ≤ (Submodule.span 𝕂 (triangularBasisOne R '' {t | t.1 = ζ ∧
      (cbWt D t.2.1).degree < a ∧ (cbWt D t.2.2).degree < c})).comap
        (leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ ∘ₗ triMul R hvn_ratFunc) := by
    refine (Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ (map_degSpan_le_span_canonicalBasis c)
      (map_degSpan_le_span_canonicalBasis a)).trans ?_
    rw [Submodule.map₂_span_span, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨b₂, hb₂, rfl⟩, _, ⟨b₁, hb₁, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨(ζ, b₁, b₂), ⟨rfl, hb₁, hb₂⟩, (leftActOne_triMul_tmul ζ b₁ b₂).symm⟩
  exact h hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_modifiedCanonical_eq_triMul
statement:
theorem exists_modifiedCanonical_eq_triMul (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ z ∈ triDepth D (cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree (cbWt D ⟨b'', hb''⟩).degree,
      modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'' =
        leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc (b'' ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b + z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := modifiedCanonical_mem_range hR hY ζ hb hb''
  obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ := exists_leftActOne_eq_triMul hvn_ratFunc ζ w
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_triDepth z₁
  set d₁ := (cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree
  set d₂ := (cbWt D ⟨b'', hb''⟩).degree
  set N := max n (max d₁ d₂ + 1)
  have hN : n ≤ N ∧ d₁ + 1 ≤ N ∧ d₂ + 1 ≤ N := by omega
  obtain ⟨Λ, Λ'', hζ, hΛ, hΛ''⟩ := exists_dom_pair hY ζ N
  have h₁ : b ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ :=
    mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt Λ hb fun i ↦ by have := hΛ i; omega
  have h₂ : b'' ∈ canonicalBasisHW D Λ'' :=
    mem_canonicalBasisHW_of_cbWt Λ'' hb'' fun i ↦ by have := hΛ'' i; omega
  obtain ⟨z, hz, ez⟩ := exists_triAct_tensorCanonical_lead hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩)
  have ez' : tensorIrrProj Λ Λ'' (triAct R hvn_ratFunc Λ.1 Λ''.1 (b'' ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b + z)) =
      tensorCanonical hR Λ Λ'' (⟨b, h₁⟩, ⟨b'', h₂⟩) := ez
  have hz' : z ∈ triDepth D d₁ d₂ := hz
  refine ⟨z, hz', ?_⟩
  have ht₀ : b'' ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b ∈ triDepth D (d₁ + 1) (d₂ + 1) :=
    Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ (mem_degSpan_map_of_mem_Uw (mem_Uw_cbWt ⟨b'', hb''⟩))
      (mem_degSpan_map_of_mem_Uw (mem_Uw_cbWt ⟨b, hb⟩))
  have hmem : z₁ - (b'' ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b + z) ∈ triDepth D N N :=
    sub_mem (triDepth_mono hN.1 hN.1 hn) (add_mem (triDepth_mono hN.2.1 hN.2.2 ht₀)
      (triDepth_mono (by omega) (by omega) hz'))
  have h0 := leftActOne_triMul_eq_zero hR Λ Λ'' hΛ hΛ'' hmem (by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, ez', ← modTensorAct_leftActOne_triMul Λ Λ'' hζ, ← hz₁, hw,
      modTensorAct_modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ hb hb'' Λ Λ'' hζ h₁ h₂, sub_self])
  rw [hζ, map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, ← hz₁, hw] at h0
  exact h0

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_span
statement:
theorem modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_span (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (b b'' : canonicalBasis D) :
    modifiedCanonical hR hY ζ b.2 b''.2 - triangularBasisOne R (ζ, b, b'') ∈
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (triangularBasisOne R '' {t | t.1 = ζ ∧
        (cbWt D t.2.1).degree < (cbWt D b).degree ∧
          (cbWt D t.2.2).degree < (cbWt D b'').degree})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, e⟩ := exists_modifiedCanonical_eq_triMul hR hY ζ b.2 b''.2
  rw [e, map_add, map_add, leftActOne_triMul_tmul, add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact leftActOne_triMul_mem_span ζ hz

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt
statement:
lemma modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt (t : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    modifiedCanonical hR hY t.1 t.2.1.2 t.2.2.2 - triangularBasisOne R t ∈
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (triangularBasisOne R ''
        {s | canonicalPairDegree D s < canonicalPairDegree D t})
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun s hs ↦ ?_)
    (modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_span hR hY t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, canonicalPairDegree] at hs ⊢
  omega

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aTriangularBasisOne_apply
statement:
lemma Modified.aTriangularBasisOne_apply (t : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :

:= by

    triangularBasisOne, Module.Basis.reindex_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.repr_triangularBasisOne_coe
statement:
lemma Modified.repr_triangularBasisOne_coe (x : (aForm R).toSubmodule)
    (t : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    (triangularBasisOne R).repr x t =
      LusztigF.integralLaurentEval ((aTriangularBasisOne R).repr x t)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (x : Modified R 𝕧) = Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕂 (triangularBasisOne R)
      (((aTriangularBasisOne R).repr x).mapRange LusztigF.integralLaurentEval (map_zero _)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (aTriangularBasisOne R).linearCombination_repr x]
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
      Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (by simp), Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.sum,
      Submodule.coe_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Submodule.coe_smul, aTriangularBasisOne_apply, Modified.laurent_smul]
  rw [hx, Module.Basis.repr_linearCombination, Finsupp.mapRange_apply]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_aSpan_lt
statement:
lemma modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_aSpan_lt (t : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    (⟨modifiedCanonical hR hY t.1 t.2.1.2 t.2.2.2,
        modifiedCanonical_mem_aForm hR hY t.1 t.2.1.2 t.2.2.2⟩ : (aForm R).toSubmodule) -
      aTriangularBasisOne R t ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (aTriangularBasisOne R ''
        {s | canonicalPairDegree D s < canonicalPairDegree D t})
proof:
:= by
  have h𝕂 := (triangularBasisOne R).mem_span_image.1 (modifiedCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt hR hY t)
  rw [Module.Basis.mem_span_image]
  intro s hs
  by_contra hst
  apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hs)
  apply LusztigF.integralLaurentEval_injective
  rw [map_zero, ← repr_triangularBasisOne_coe, Submodule.coe_sub, aTriangularBasisOne_apply]
  by_contra hne
  exact hst (h𝕂 (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hne)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aModifiedCanonicalBasis_apply
statement:
theorem Modified.aModifiedCanonicalBasis_apply (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (b b'' : canonicalBasis D) :

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.exists_columnCanonical_eq_triMul
statement:
theorem exists_columnCanonical_eq_triMul (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) {b b'' : Um D 𝕧}
    (hb : b ∈ canonicalBasis D) (hb'' : b'' ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ z ∈ triDepth D (cbWt D ⟨b, hb⟩).degree (cbWt D ⟨b'', hb''⟩).degree,
      columnCanonical hR ζ hb hb'' =
        leftActOne R hvn_ratFunc ζ (triMul R hvn_ratFunc (b'' ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b + z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := exists_modifiedCanonical_eq_triMul
    (isXRegular_freeCoroot hR) exists_dom_freeCoroot (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom) hb hb''
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  unfold columnCanonical
  have hs : (⟨modifiedCanonical (isXRegular_freeCoroot hR) exists_dom_freeCoroot
      (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom) hb hb'',
      modifiedCanonical_mem_range (isXRegular_freeCoroot hR) exists_dom_freeCoroot
        (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom) hb hb''⟩ :
      LinearMap.range (leftActOne R.freeCoroot hvn_ratFunc (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom))) =
      ⟨leftActOne R.freeCoroot hvn_ratFunc (ζ.comp R.freeCorootHom.toHom)
        (triMul R.freeCoroot hvn_ratFunc (b'' ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b + z)), _, rfl⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext he
  rw [hs, columnEquiv_triMul]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.columnCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt
statement:
lemma columnCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt
    (t : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    columnCanonical hR t.1 t.2.1.2 t.2.2.2 - triangularBasisOne R t ∈
      Submodule.span 𝕂 (triangularBasisOne R ''
        {s | canonicalPairDegree D s < canonicalPairDegree D t})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := exists_columnCanonical_eq_triMul hR t.1 t.2.1.2 t.2.2.2
  rw [he, map_add, map_add, leftActOne_triMul_tmul, add_sub_cancel_left]
  refine Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun s hs ↦ ?_)
    (leftActOne_triMul_mem_span t.1 hz)
  change s.1 = t.1 ∧ (cbWt D s.2.1).degree < (cbWt D t.2.1).degree ∧
    (cbWt D s.2.2).degree < (cbWt D t.2.2).degree at hs
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, canonicalPairDegree]
  omega

theorem Modified.columnCanonicalBasis_apply (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (b b'' : canonicalBasis D) :

:=

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.columnCanonical_sub_mem_aSpan_lt
statement:
lemma columnCanonical_sub_mem_aSpan_lt
    (t : (Y →+ ℤ) × canonicalBasis D × canonicalBasis D) :
    (⟨columnCanonical hR t.1 t.2.1.2 t.2.2.2,
        columnCanonical_mem_aForm hR t.1 t.2.1.2 t.2.2.2⟩ : (aForm R).toSubmodule) -
      aTriangularBasisOne R t ∈ Submodule.span 𝒜 (aTriangularBasisOne R ''
        {s | canonicalPairDegree D s < canonicalPairDegree D t})
proof:
:= by
  have h𝕂 := (triangularBasisOne R).mem_span_image.1 (columnCanonical_sub_mem_span_lt hR t)
  rw [Module.Basis.mem_span_image]
  intro s hs
  by_contra hst
  apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hs)
  apply LusztigF.integralLaurentEval_injective
  rw [map_zero, ← repr_triangularBasisOne_coe, Submodule.coe_sub, aTriangularBasisOne_apply]
  by_contra hne
  exact hst (h𝕂 (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hne)))

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Modified.aColumnCanonicalBasis_apply
statement:
theorem Modified.aColumnCanonicalBasis_apply (ζ : Y →+ ℤ) (b b'' : canonicalBasis D) :

proof:

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_longest_coverage
statement:
theorem original_PBW_longest_coverage (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement)
    (u : List I) :
    ∃ (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) (e : ℤ), (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
        (e : K) • B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  let f : Quotient D v →ₗ[A] K :=
    ((F (B u)).restrictScalars A).comp
      ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm.toLinearMap.restrictScalars A)
  have hg (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
      ∃ a : A, f (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) = algebraMap A K (π * a) := by
    obtain ⟨t, e, he, ht, -⟩ := original_PBW_unique_signed R hw c
    have hut : B u - B t ∉ P := by
      intro hut
      apply hn
      refine ⟨c, e, he, ?_⟩
      have htu : B t - B u ∈ P := by simpa using neg_mem hut
      have hs : (e : K) • (B t - B u) ∈ P := by
        rcases he with rfl | rfl
        · simpa using htu
        · simpa using neg_mem htu
      convert add_mem ht hs using 1
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := form_mem_uniformizer (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ u) ht
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := word_pairing (D := D) u t
    rw [ite_eq_right hut, zero_add] at hb
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, hb] at ha
    refine ⟨a + (e : A) * b, ?_⟩
    change F (B u) ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm
      (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c)) = _
    simp only [mul_add, map_add, map_mul, map_intCast]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul] at ha
    linear_combination ha
  have hx : negativeQuotientEquiv D (B u) ∈ Submodule.span A
      (Set.range fun c ↦ (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D v)) := by
    rw [← PBWInfinityLattice.intersection_eq_span R hw,
      PBWInfinityLattice.intersection_longest_eq_lattice R hw hw₀]
    change (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (negativeQuotientEquiv D (B u)) ∈ L
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using
      (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ u)
  have hall (x : Quotient D v) (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span A
      (Set.range fun c ↦ (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D v))) :
      ∃ a : A, f x = algebraMap A K (π * a) := by
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact hg c
    | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨a + b, by simp only [map_add, ha, hb, mul_add]⟩
    | smul r x _ hx =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨r * a, ?_⟩
      rw [map_smul, ha]
      simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]
      ring
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hall _ hx
  change F (B u) ((negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (negativeQuotientEquiv D (B u))) = _ at ha
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at ha
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := word_pairing (D := D) u u
  simp only [sub_self, Submodule.zero_mem, ite_true] at hb
  have h1 : (1 : K) = algebraMap A K (π * (a - b)) := by
    simp only [mul_sub, map_sub]
    linear_combination ha - hb
  have hz := int_eq_zero_of_uniformizer 1 (a - b) (by simpa using h1)
  norm_num at hz

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_longest_unique_exponent
statement:
theorem original_PBW_longest_unique_exponent (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement)
    (u : List I) :
    ∃! c : Fin w.length → ℕ, ∃ e : ℤ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
        (e : K) • B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, e, he, hc⟩ := original_PBW_longest_coverage R hw hw₀ u
  refine ⟨c, ⟨e, he, hc⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro d ⟨f, hf, hd⟩
  exact original_PBW_unsigned_injective R hw d c hf he hd hc (by simp)

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_longest_representative_independent
statement:
theorem original_PBW_longest_representative_independent
    (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ) {e f : ℤ} {u t : List I}
    (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) (hf : f = 1 ∨ f = -1)
    (hc : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
      (e : K) • B u ∈ P)
    (hd : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw d) -
      (f : K) • B t ∈ P)
    (hut : B u - B t ∈ P) : c = d ∧ e = f
proof:
:= by
  have hcd := original_PBW_unsigned_injective R hw c d he hf hc hd hut
  subst d
  exact ⟨rfl, (signed_residue_unique he hf hc hd).1⟩

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_longest_unique_signed_exponent
statement:
theorem original_PBW_longest_unique_signed_exponent
    (hw₀ : cs.wordProd w = cs.longestElement) (u : List I) :
    ∃! c : Fin w.length → ℕ, ∃! e : ℤ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
        (e : K) • B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, e, he, hc⟩ := original_PBW_longest_coverage R hw hw₀ u
  refine ⟨c, ⟨e, ⟨he, hc⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro f ⟨hf, hd⟩
    exact (signed_residue_unique hf he hd hc).1
  · rintro d ⟨f, ⟨hf, hd⟩, -⟩
    exact original_PBW_unsigned_injective R hw d c hf he hd hc (by simp)

name: PBWSignedCrystal.integer_sum_squares_one
statement:
lemma integer_sum_squares_one {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (z : α → ℤ)
    (h : ∑ s ∈ S, z s ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∃ u ∈ S, (z u = 1 ∨ z u = -1) ∧ ∀ t ∈ S, t ≠ u → z t = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp at h
  | @insert a S ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha] at h
    have hn : 0 ≤ ∑ s ∈ S, z s ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
    by_cases hz : z a = 0
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, hus, huz⟩ := ih (by simpa [hz] using h)
      refine ⟨u, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hu, hus, ?_⟩
      intro t ht htu
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ht with rfl | ht
      · exact hz
      · exact huz t ht htu
    · have hb : -1 ≤ z a ∧ z a ≤ 1 := by constructor <;> nlinarith
      have hs : z a = 1 ∨ z a = -1 := by omega
      have hsum : ∑ s ∈ S, z s ^ 2 = 0 := by rcases hs with hs | hs <;> simp [hs] at h ⊢ <;> omega
      refine ⟨a, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hs, ?_⟩
      intro t ht hta
      have htS : t ∈ S := (Finset.mem_insert.mp ht).resolve_left hta
      have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun s (_ : s ∈ S) ↦ sq_nonneg (z s)) htS
      rw [hsum] at hle
      nlinarith

name: PBWSignedCrystal.exists_signed_crystal_residue
statement:
theorem exists_signed_crystal_residue {x : Um D v}
    (hxI : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) (hxL : x ∈ L)
    (hnorm : ∃ a : A, F x x = algebraMap A K (1 + π * a)) :
    ∃ (u : List I) (e : ℤ), (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ x - (e : K) • B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, z, -, hx, t, ht⟩ := grouped_integer_norm_coordinates D hxI hxL
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hnorm
  have he : ((∑ s ∈ S, z s ^ 2 - 1 : ℤ) : K) = algebraMap A K (π * (a - t)) := by
    simp only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, mul_sub, map_sub]
    rw [ha] at ht
    simp only [map_add, map_one] at ht
    linear_combination -ht
  have hsum : ∑ s ∈ S, z s ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have := int_eq_zero_of_uniformizer (∑ s ∈ S, z s ^ 2 - 1) (a - t) he
    omega
  obtain ⟨u, hu, he, hz⟩ := integer_sum_squares_one S z hsum
  refine ⟨u, z u, he, ?_⟩
  have hexp : ∑ s ∈ S, (z s : K) • B s = (z u : K) • B u := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single u
    · intro s hs hsu
      simp [hz s hs hsu]
    · exact fun h ↦ False.elim (h hu)
  rwa [hexp] at hx

name: PBWSignedCrystal.unique_signed_crystal_residue
statement:
theorem unique_signed_crystal_residue {x : Um D v}
    (hxI : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D) (hxL : x ∈ L)
    (hnorm : ∃ a : A, F x x = algebraMap A K (1 + π * a)) :
    ∃ (u : List I) (e : ℤ), (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      x - (e : K) • B u ∈ P ∧ B u ∉ P ∧ x ∉ P ∧
      ∀ (t : List I) (f : ℤ), (f = 1 ∨ f = -1) →
        x - (f : K) • B t ∈ P → e = f ∧ B u - B t ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, e, he, hx⟩ := exists_signed_crystal_residue D hxI hxL hnorm
  refine ⟨u, e, he, hx, word_not_mem_uniformizer u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hx0
    have hh := sub_mem hx0 hx
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · exact word_not_mem_uniformizer u (by simpa using hh)
    · exact word_not_mem_uniformizer u (by simpa using neg_mem hh)
  · intro t f hf ht
    exact signed_residue_unique he hf hx ht

name: PBWSignedCrystal.int_eq_zero_of_uniformizer
statement:
lemma int_eq_zero_of_uniformizer (n : ℤ) (a : A)
    (h : (n : K) = algebraMap A K (π * a)) : n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : (n : A) = π * a := InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap (by simpa using h)
  have hr := congrArg Sl2.RankOne.residue he
  change Sl2.RankOne.residue (n : Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing) =
    Sl2.RankOne.residue (Sl2.RankOne.localX * (show Sl2.RankOne.LocalRing from a)) at hr
  rw [map_mul, Sl2.RankOne.residue_localX, zero_mul, map_intCast] at hr
  exact_mod_cast hr

name: PBWSignedCrystal.form_mem_uniformizer
statement:
lemma form_mem_uniformizer {x y : Um D v} (hx : x ∈ L) (hy : y ∈ P) :
    ∃ a : A, F x y = algebraMap A K (π * a)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact formU_mem_smul (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hx hy

name: PBWSignedCrystal.word_not_mem_uniformizer
statement: theorem word_not_mem_uniformizer (u : List I) : B u ∉ P
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact fWi_notMem (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum u

name: PBWSignedCrystal.word_pairing
statement:
lemma word_pairing (u t : List I) :
    ∃ a : A, F (B u) (B t) = (if B u - B t ∈ P then 1 else 0) +
      algebraMap A K (π * a)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact formU_fWi_fWi (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum u t

name: PBWSignedCrystal.word_add_not_mem_uniformizer
statement: theorem word_add_not_mem_uniformizer (u t : List I) : B u + B t ∉ P
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := word_pairing (D := D) u u
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := word_pairing (D := D) u t
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := form_mem_uniformizer
    (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ u) h
  simp only [sub_self, Submodule.zero_mem, ite_true] at ha
  rw [map_add, ha, hb] at hc
  by_cases ht : B u - B t ∈ P
  · rw [ite_eq_left ht] at hc
    have he : (2 : K) = algebraMap A K (π * (c - a - b)) := by
      simp only [mul_sub, map_sub]
      linear_combination hc
    have := int_eq_zero_of_uniformizer 2 (c - a - b) he
    norm_num at this
  · rw [ite_eq_right ht] at hc
    have he : (1 : K) = algebraMap A K (π * (c - a - b)) := by
      simp only [mul_sub, map_sub]
      linear_combination hc
    have := int_eq_zero_of_uniformizer 1 (c - a - b) (by simpa using he)
    norm_num at this

name: PBWSignedCrystal.signed_residue_unique
statement:
theorem signed_residue_unique {x : Um D v} {e f : ℤ} {u t : List I}
    (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) (hf : f = 1 ∨ f = -1)
    (hx : x - (e : K) • B u ∈ P) (hy : x - (f : K) • B t ∈ P) :
    e = f ∧ B u - B t ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hf with rfl | rfl
  · refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa using sub_mem hy hx
  · exfalso
    apply word_add_not_mem_uniformizer u t
    simpa [add_comm] using sub_mem hy hx
  · exfalso
    apply word_add_not_mem_uniformizer u t
    simpa using sub_mem hx hy
  · refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa using sub_mem hx hy

name: PBWSignedCrystal.pbw_sub_smul_not_mem_uniformizer
statement:
theorem pbw_sub_smul_not_mem_uniformizer {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ) (hcd : c ≠ d) (s : K) :
    X hw c - s • X hw d ∉ P
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := PBWProductNorm.norm_residue R hw c
  have ho := PBWProductNorm.orthogonal R hw c d hcd
  change F (X hw c) (X hw c) = _ at ha
  change F (X hw c) (X hw d) = 0 at ho
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := form_mem_uniformizer (PBWProductNorm.mem_lattice_degree R hw c) h
  rw [map_sub, map_smul, ho, smul_zero, sub_zero, ha] at hb
  have he : (1 : K) = algebraMap A K (π * (b - a)) := by
    simp only [mul_sub, map_sub]
    simp only [map_add, _root_.map_one] at hb
    linear_combination hb
  have := int_eq_zero_of_uniformizer 1 (b - a) (by simpa using he)
  norm_num at this

name: PBWSignedCrystal.pbw_unsigned_residue_injective
statement:
theorem pbw_unsigned_residue_injective {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ) {e f : ℤ} {u t : List I}
    (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) (hf : f = 1 ∨ f = -1)
    (hc : X hw c - (e : K) • B u ∈ P)
    (hd : X hw d - (f : K) • B t ∈ P)
    (hut : B u - B t ∈ P) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcd
  rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hf with rfl | rfl
  · apply pbw_sub_smul_not_mem_uniformizer R hw c d hcd 1
    convert add_mem (sub_mem hc hd) hut using 1
    simp
    abel
  · apply pbw_sub_smul_not_mem_uniformizer R hw c d hcd (-1)
    convert add_mem (add_mem hc hd) hut using 1
    simp
    abel
  · apply pbw_sub_smul_not_mem_uniformizer R hw c d hcd (-1)
    convert sub_mem (add_mem hc hd) hut using 1
    simp
    abel
  · apply pbw_sub_smul_not_mem_uniformizer R hw c d hcd 1
    convert sub_mem (sub_mem hc hd) hut using 1
    simp
    abel

name: PBWSignedCrystal.norm_of_distinct_residue_coordinates
statement:
theorem norm_of_distinct_residue_coordinates {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hxL : x ∈ latInf hvt A) (S : Finset (List I)) (a : List I → A)
    (hSd : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ s' ∈ S, s ≠ s' →
      fWi (D := D) hvt s - fWi hvt s' ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A)
    (hxy : x - ∑ s ∈ S, a s • fWi (D := D) hvt s ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A) :
    ∃ t : A, formU hv' x x =
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (∑ s ∈ S, a s ^ 2) + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  set y : Um D 𝕧 := ∑ s ∈ S, a s • fWi (D := D) hvt s with hy
  have hyL : y ∈ latInf hvt A := by
    rw [hy]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun s _ ↦
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (NegativePart.fWord_mem_latticeInf _ _ s)
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := formU_mem_smul (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hxL hxy
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := formU_mem_smul (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
    InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
    InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
    D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum hyL hxy
  have hxy' : formU hv' x x - formU hv' y y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * (t₁ + t₂)) := by
    have : formU hv' x x - formU hv' y y =
        formU hv' x (x - y) + formU hv' y (x - y) := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, formU_comm hv' y x]
      ring
    rw [this, ht₁, ht₂, ← map_add, mul_add]
  choose e he using fun s s' ↦
    formU_fWi_fWi (hR := D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum)
      InfinityLocalRing.injective_algebraMap InfinityLocalRing.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal
      InfinityLocalRing.algebraMap_uniformizer InfinityLocalRing.exists_pow_mul
      D.exists_fundamental_extendedRootDatum s s'
  have hexp : formU hv' y y = ∑ s ∈ S, ∑ s' ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (a s) *
      (algebraMap A 𝕂 (a s') * formU hv' (fWi (D := D) hvt s) (fWi hvt s')) := by
    rw [hy]
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, ← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 (a _), map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ by
      rw [formU_comm hv']
  have key : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ s' ∈ S, algebraMap A 𝕂 (a s) *
      (algebraMap A 𝕂 (a s') * formU hv' (fWi (D := D) hvt s) (fWi hvt s')) =
      (if s = s' then algebraMap A 𝕂 (a s ^ 2) else 0) +
        algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * (a s * a s' * e s s')) := by
    intro s hs s' hs'
    rw [he]
    by_cases h : s = s'
    · subst h
      simp only [sub_self, zero_mem, ↓reduceIte, map_mul, map_pow]
      ring
    · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.2 (fun h' ↦ absurd h' (hSd s hs s' hs' h))]
      simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, map_mul]
      ring
  have hyy : formU hv' y y = algebraMap A 𝕂 (∑ s ∈ S, a s ^ 2) +
      algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * ∑ s ∈ S, ∑ s' ∈ S, a s * a s' * e s s') := by
    rw [hexp, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s' hs' ↦ key s hs s' hs']
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs ↦ by simp [hs]
  refine ⟨t₁ + t₂ + ∑ s ∈ S, ∑ s' ∈ S, a s * a s' * e s s', ?_⟩
  rw [show formU hv' x x = (formU hv' x x - formU hv' y y) + formU hv' y y by ring, hxy', hyy]
  simp only [map_add, map_mul]
  ring

name: PBWSignedCrystal.grouped_integer_norm_coordinates
statement:
theorem grouped_integer_norm_coordinates {x : Um D 𝕧}
    (hxI : negativeQuotientEquiv D x ∈ quotientIntegralForm D)
    (hxL : x ∈ latInf hvt A) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (List I)) (z : List I → ℤ),
      (∀ s ∈ S, ∀ s' ∈ S, s ≠ s' →
        fWi (D := D) hvt s - fWi hvt s' ∉ ϖ • latInf hvt A) ∧
      x - ∑ s ∈ S, (z s : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt s ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A ∧
      ∃ t : A, formU hv' x x =
        ((∑ s ∈ S, z s ^ 2 : ℤ) : 𝕂) + algebraMap A 𝕂 (ϖ * t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_integer_crystal_residue_coordinates D hxI hxL
  set W := a.support
  obtain ⟨S, -, hSd, hcov⟩ := exists_reps_mod (ϖ • latInf hvt A) (fWi (D := D) hvt) W
  choose! r hrS hr using hcov
  let z : List I → ℤ := fun s ↦ ∑ w ∈ W with r w = s, a w
  set y : Um D 𝕧 := ∑ s ∈ S, (z s : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt s with hy
  have hy' : y = ∑ w ∈ W, (a w : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt (r w) := by
    rw [hy, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := r) (t := S) hrS]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [z, Int.cast_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hw).2]
  have hay : a.sum (fun w n ↦ (n : 𝕂) • fWi (D := D) hvt w) - y ∈
      ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    rw [hy', Finsupp.sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [← smul_sub, ← map_intCast (algebraMap A 𝕂), algebraMap_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hr w hw)
  have hxy : x - y ∈ ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    simpa using add_mem ha hay
  refine ⟨S, z, hSd, hxy, ?_⟩
  have hxyA : x - ∑ s ∈ S, (z s : A) • fWi (D := D) hvt s ∈
      ϖ • latInf hvt A := by
    simpa only [hy, ← algebraMap_smul 𝕂 (z _ : A), map_intCast] using hxy
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := norm_of_distinct_residue_coordinates D hxL S
    (fun s ↦ (z s : A)) hSd hxyA
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  simpa only [map_sum, map_pow, map_intCast, Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_pow] using ht

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_unique_signed
statement:
theorem original_PBW_unique_signed {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ (u : List I) (e : ℤ), (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
        (e : K) • B u ∈ P ∧ B u ∉ P ∧
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) ∉ P ∧
      ∀ (t : List I) (f : ℤ), (f = 1 ∨ f = -1) →
        (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
          (f : K) • B t ∈ P → e = f ∧ B u - B t ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  apply unique_signed_crystal_residue D
  · simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
      (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c).property
  · exact PBWProductNorm.mem_lattice_degree R hw c
  · exact PBWProductNorm.norm_residue R hw c

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_residue_injective
statement:
theorem original_PBW_residue_injective {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ)
    (h : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw d) ∈ P) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcd
  exact pbw_sub_smul_not_mem_uniformizer R hw c d hcd 1 (by simpa using h)

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_unsigned_injective
statement:
theorem original_PBW_unsigned_injective {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c d : Fin w.length → ℕ) {e f : ℤ} {u t : List I}
    (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) (hf : f = 1 ∨ f = -1)
    (hc : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
      (e : K) • B u ∈ P)
    (hd : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw d) -
      (f : K) • B t ∈ P)
    (hut : B u - B t ∈ P) : c = d
proof:
:=
  pbw_unsigned_residue_injective R hw c d he hf hc hd hut

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_empty_signed
statement:
theorem original_PBW_empty_signed (hw : cs.IsReduced []) (c : Fin [].length → ℕ) :
    ∃ (u : List I) (e : ℤ), (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw c) -
        (e : K) • B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, e, he, hx, -⟩ := original_PBW_unique_signed R hw c
  exact ⟨u, e, he, hx⟩

name: PBWSignedCrystal.original_PBW_zero_signed
statement:
theorem original_PBW_zero_signed {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) :
    ∃ (u : List I) (e : ℤ), (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (Modified.integralPBWPreimage R hw (fun _ ↦ 0)) -
        (e : K) • B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, e, he, hx, -⟩ := original_PBW_unique_signed R hw (fun _ ↦ 0)
  exact ⟨u, e, he, hx⟩

name: PBWSignedCrystal.wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
lemma wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem {u t : List I} (h : B u - B t ∈ P) :
    wordWeight u = wordWeight t
proof:
:=
  wordWeight_eq_of_mem_Uw (fWi_mem_Uw t) (word_not_mem_uniformizer t)
    (by rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem h)

name: PBWSignedCrystal.negGlobal_mk_sub_mem
statement:
lemma negGlobal_mk_sub_mem (u : List I) :
    negGlobal D (wordWeight u) (Quotient.mk _ ⟨u, rfl⟩) - B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := negGlobal_sub_mem D (wordWeight u) (Quotient.mk _ ⟨u, rfl⟩)
  have h₂ : B (Quotient.out (Quotient.mk (negCrystalSetoid D (wordWeight u)) ⟨u, rfl⟩)).1 -
      B u ∈ P :=
    Quotient.mk_out (s := negCrystalSetoid D (wordWeight u)) ⟨u, rfl⟩
  simpa using add_mem h₁ h₂

name: PBWSignedCrystal.exists_word_of_mem_canonicalBasis
statement:
lemma exists_word_of_mem_canonicalBasis {x : Um D v} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D) :
    ∃ u : List I, x - B u ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, b, rfl⟩ := (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 hx
  exact ⟨(Quotient.out b).1, negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b⟩

name: PBWSignedCrystal.eq_of_mem_canonicalBasis
statement:
lemma eq_of_mem_canonicalBasis {x y : Um D v} (hx : x ∈ canonicalBasis D)
    (hy : y ∈ canonicalBasis D) {u t : List I} (hxu : x - B u ∈ P) (hyt : y - B t ∈ P)
    (hut : B u - B t ∈ P) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, b, rfl⟩ := (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 hx
  obtain ⟨μ, b', rfl⟩ := (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).1 hy
  have hb := negGlobal_sub_mem D ν b
  have hb' := negGlobal_sub_mem D μ b'
  have hbb' : B (Quotient.out b).1 - B (Quotient.out b').1 ∈ P := by
    convert add_mem (add_mem (neg_mem hb) hxu) (add_mem hut (add_mem (neg_mem hyt) hb'))
      using 1
    abel
  have hνμ : ν = μ := by
    rw [← (Quotient.out b).2, ← (Quotient.out b').2]
    exact wordWeight_eq_of_sub_mem hbb'
  subst hνμ
  have : b = b' := by
    rw [← Quotient.out_eq b, ← Quotient.out_eq b']
    exact Quotient.sound hbb'
  rw [this]

name: PBWSignedCrystal.exists_canonical_congruence
statement:
theorem exists_canonical_congruence {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ canonicalBasis D, ∃ e : ℤ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧
      pbwNegative R hw c - (e : K) • x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, e, he, hX, -⟩ := original_PBW_unique_signed R hw c
  refine ⟨negGlobal D (wordWeight u) (Quotient.mk _ ⟨u, rfl⟩),
    (mem_canonicalBasis_iff D).2 ⟨_, _, rfl⟩, e, he, ?_⟩
  have hG := negGlobal_mk_sub_mem (D := D) u
  have : (e : K) • (negGlobal D (wordWeight u) (Quotient.mk _ ⟨u, rfl⟩) - B u) ∈ P := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using zsmul_mem hG e
  convert sub_mem hX this using 1
  rw [smul_sub]
  abel

name: PBWSignedCrystal.existsUnique_canonical_congruence
statement:
theorem existsUnique_canonical_congruence {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃! x, x ∈ canonicalBasis D ∧
      ∃! e : ℤ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ pbwNegative R hw c - (e : K) • x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, e, he, hXx⟩ := exists_canonical_congruence R hw c
  obtain ⟨u, hxu⟩ := exists_word_of_mem_canonicalBasis hx
  have hXu : pbwNegative R hw c - (e : K) • B u ∈ P := by
    have : (e : K) • (x - B u) ∈ P := by
      simpa only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using zsmul_mem hxu e
    convert add_mem hXx this using 1
    rw [smul_sub]
    abel
  refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, e, ⟨he, hXx⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro f ⟨hf, hXf⟩
    have hXfu : pbwNegative R hw c - (f : K) • B u ∈ P := by
      have : (f : K) • (x - B u) ∈ P := by
        simpa only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using zsmul_mem hxu f
      convert add_mem hXf this using 1
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    exact (signed_residue_unique hf he hXfu hXu).1
  · rintro y ⟨hy, f, ⟨hf, hXy⟩, -⟩
    obtain ⟨t, hyt⟩ := exists_word_of_mem_canonicalBasis hy
    have hXt : pbwNegative R hw c - (f : K) • B t ∈ P := by
      have : (f : K) • (y - B t) ∈ P := by
        simpa only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using zsmul_mem hyt f
      convert add_mem hXy this using 1
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    obtain ⟨-, htu⟩ := signed_residue_unique hf he hXt hXu
    exact eq_of_mem_canonicalBasis hy hx hyt hxu htu

name: PBWProductNorm.projectedBraid_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hs := mem_sourceWord_span i hx
  clear hx
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [projectedBraid_word, projectedBraid_word]
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | smul c a _ ha => simp only [map_smul, ha]

name: PBWProductNorm.projectedBraid_injective
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientPlus_injective R
  apply (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).injective
  have he := congrArg (quotientPlus R) h
  simpa only [projectedBraid_spec, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i hx,
    quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i hy] using he

name: PBWProductNorm.projectedBraid_preimage
statement:
theorem projectedBraid_preimage {i : I} {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced (i :: w))
    (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    projectedBraid R i (integralPBWPreimage R hw (Fin.cons 0 c)) =
      integralPBWPreimage R (w := w) (by simpa using hw.drop 1) c
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientPlus_injective R
  rw [projectedBraid_spec, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i
    (quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw c)]
  exact braid_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw c

name: PBWProductNorm.preimage_realization_independent
statement:
theorem preimage_realization_independent {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) = integralPBWPreimage S hw c
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rw [preimage_nil R, preimage_nil S]
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [integralPBWPreimage_cons R hw, integralPBWPreimage_cons S hw]
    congr 1
    apply projectedBraid_injective R i
      (quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero R hw _)
      (quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero S hw _)
    rw [projectedBraid_preimage R]
    rw [projectedBraid_eq R S i ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i _).mpr
      (quotientLDeriv_integralPBWPreimage_cons_zero S hw _)), projectedBraid_preimage S]
    exact ih _ _

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_mem_Uw
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := hx
  have hq : toQuotient D 𝕧 a = x := by
    apply (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm.injective
    rw [negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient]
    exact he
  rw [← hq, quotientBar_toQuotient, negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient]
  exact ⟨bar a, bar_mem_weightSpace ha, rfl⟩

name: LusztigF.quotientBar_mem_Uw_iff
statement:
theorem quotientBar_mem_Uw_iff {ν : I →₀ ℕ} {x : Quotient D 𝕧} :
    (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (quotientBar D x) ∈ GrandLoop.Uw D 𝕧 ν ↔
      (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm x ∈ GrandLoop.Uw D 𝕧 ν
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    simpa only [quotientBar_quotientBar D x] using quotientBar_mem_Uw D hx
  · exact quotientBar_mem_Uw D

name: PBWProductNorm.bar_homogeneous_Uw
statement:
theorem bar_homogeneous_Uw {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm
      (quotientBar D (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)) ∈ GrandLoop.Uw D 𝕧 (degree D w c)
proof:
:=
  quotientBar_mem_Uw D (homogeneous_Uw R hw c)

name: PBWProductNorm.inverse_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem inverse_mem_adWeightSpace (i : I) {χ : Y →+ ℤ} {x : QuantumGroup R 𝕧}
    (hx : x ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 χ) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm x ∈
      adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (χ.comp (reflY R i))
proof:
:= fun μ ↦ by
  have h := congrArg (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
    (hx (reflY R i μ))
  simpa only [map_mul, map_smul, RightStringComparison.inverse_K, reflY_reflY,
    AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] using h

name: PBWProductNorm.pbwDivSymm_mem_adWeightSpace
statement:
theorem pbwDivSymm_mem_adWeightSpace (w : List I) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    pbwDivSymm R w c ∈ adWeightSpace R 𝕧 (pbwWt R w c)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simpa [pbwDivSymm, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial, pbwWt]
      using one_mem_adWeightSpace
  | cons i w ih =>
    rw [pbwDivSymm, CoxeterSystem.pbwDivMonomial_cons, pbwWt, Ta_symm_apply]
    exact mul_mem_adWeightSpace (qDivPow_E_mem _ i _) (inverse_mem_adWeightSpace R i (ih _))

name: PBWProductNorm.exists_homogeneous_of_regular
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneous_of_regular (hR : R.IsXRegular) {w : List I}
    (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ ν : I →₀ ℕ, R.rootSum ν = pbwWt R w c ∧
      ∃ a : LusztigF 𝕂 I, a ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν ∧
        toQuotient D 𝕧 a = (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  have hplus : pbwDivSymm R w c ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕂 (Set.range (E R 𝕧)) := by
    rw [← range_plusHom R 𝕧, ← quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage R hw c]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 (integralPBWPreimage R hw c)
    exact ⟨a, congrArg (quotientPlus R) ha⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_degree_of_mem_adWeightSpace hR ratFunc_X_not_root
    hplus (pbwDivSymm_mem_adWeightSpace R w c) ((linearIndependent_pbwDivSymm hw).ne_zero c)
  refine ⟨ν, hν, a, ha, quotientPlus_injective R ?_⟩
  rw [quotientPlus_toQuotient, quotientPlus_integralPBWPreimage]
  exact he

name: PBWProductNorm.exists_homogeneous
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneous {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ ν : I →₀ ℕ, ∃ a : LusztigF 𝕂 I, a ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν ∧
      toQuotient D 𝕧 a = (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨ν, _, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_homogeneous_of_regular D.extendedRootDatum
    D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum hw c
  exact ⟨ν, a, ha, he.trans (preimage_realization_independent D.extendedRootDatum R hw c)⟩

name: PBWProductNorm.mem_lattice
statement:
theorem mem_lattice {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_homogeneous R hw c
  have hx : (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) ∈
      GrandLoop.Uw D 𝕧 ν := by
    rw [← he, negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient]
    exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  apply (mem_quotientCrystalLattice_iff D hx).mpr
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := norm_residue R hw c
  exact ⟨_, hb⟩

name: PBWProductNorm.signedDegree_character
statement:
theorem signedDegree_character (R : D.RootDatum Y) (w : List I) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ R.root (signedDegree D w c) = pbwWt R w c
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [signedDegree, pbwWt]
  | cons i w ih =>
    simp only [signedDegree, map_sub, map_add, map_nsmul, map_smul,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, pbwWt, comp_reflY_eq,
      ih]
    rw [← ih]
    rw [linearCombination_coroot]
    change c 0 • R.root i + _ - _ = c 0 • R.root i + (_ - _)
    abel

name: PBWProductNorm.exists_homogeneous_signed
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneous_signed {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w)
    (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ ν : I →₀ ℕ, ν.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp) = signedDegree D w c ∧
      ∃ a : LusztigF 𝕂 I, a ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν ∧
        toQuotient D 𝕧 a = (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_homogeneous_of_regular D.extendedRootDatum
    D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum hw c
  have hdeg : ν.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp) = signedDegree D w c := by
    apply D.isXRegular_extendedRootDatum
    rw [linearCombination_natCast, signedDegree_character]
    exact hν
  exact ⟨ν, hdeg, a, ha,
    he.trans (preimage_realization_independent D.extendedRootDatum R hw c)⟩

name: PBWProductNorm.signedDegree_nonneg
statement:
theorem signedDegree_nonneg {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ)
    (i : I) : 0 ≤ signedDegree D w c i
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, _⟩ := exists_homogeneous_signed D.extendedRootDatum hw c
  rw [← hν, Finsupp.mapRange_apply]
  exact Int.natCast_nonneg _

name: PBWProductNorm.homogeneous_degree
statement:
theorem homogeneous_degree {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    ∃ a : LusztigF 𝕂 I, a ∈ LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (degree D w c) ∧
      toQuotient D 𝕧 a = (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_homogeneous_signed R hw c
  have hdeg : degree D w c = ν := by
    ext i
    simp [degree, ← hν]
  exact ⟨a, hdeg.symm ▸ ha, he⟩

name: PBWProductNorm.homogeneous_Uw
statement:
theorem homogeneous_Uw {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (negativeQuotientEquiv D).symm (integralPBWPreimage R hw c) ∈
      GrandLoop.Uw D 𝕧 (degree D w c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := homogeneous_degree R hw c
  rw [← he, negativeQuotientEquiv_symm_toQuotient]
  exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: PBWProductNorm.mem_lattice_degree
statement:
theorem mem_lattice_degree {w : List I} (hw : cs.IsReduced w) (c : Fin w.length → ℕ) :
    (integralPBWPreimage R hw c : Quotient D 𝕧) ∈ quotientCrystalLattice D
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_quotientCrystalLattice_iff D (homogeneous_Uw R hw c)).mpr
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := norm_residue R hw c
  exact ⟨_, ha⟩

name: VermaProjection.decode_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem decode_eval (i : I) (a b : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i (vermaEquiv R Λ₁ a ⊗ₜ vermaEquiv R Λ₂ b) =
      a ⊗ₜ quotientSkewProjection D i b
proof: := by simp [decode]

name: VermaProjection.decode_toral
statement:
theorem decode_toral (i : I) (a b : Quotient D 𝕧) (μ : Y) :
    decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i
      (lowestPair R 𝕧 Λ₁ Λ₂ ((quotientPlus R a * K R 𝕧 μ) ⊗ₜ quotientPlus R b)
        (vacuum R Λ₁ Λ₂)) =
      𝕧 ^ (-Λ₁ μ) • (a ⊗ₜ quotientSkewProjection D i b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vacuum, lowestPair_tmul]
  simp only [map_mul, chevalley_K, mul_smul, VermaModule.K_smul_hwv, map_neg]
  rw [smul_comm, ← vermaEquiv_apply, ← vermaEquiv_apply, ← smul_tmul', map_smul, decode_eval]

name: VermaProjection.decode_factors
statement:
theorem decode_factors (i : I) :
    decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (LinearMap.ker (quotientLDeriv D i)).subtype ∘ₗ
        (tensorCoordinateEquiv R Λ₁ Λ₂ i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (vermaEImage R Λ₂ i).mkQ
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  rfl

name: VermaProjection.projection_Epow
statement:
theorem projection_Epow (i : I) (n : ℕ) (m : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ₂) :
    quotientSkewProjection D i ((vermaEquiv R Λ₂).symm
      (chevalley R 𝕧 (E R 𝕧 i ^ (n + 1)) • m)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : lowestE R Λ₂ i (chevalley R 𝕧 (E R 𝕧 i ^ n) • m) ∈
      LinearMap.ker (vermaCoordinate R Λ₂ i) := by
    rw [ker_vermaCoordinate]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have he := congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp h)
  change quotientSkewProjection D i ((vermaEquiv R Λ₂).symm
    (chevalley R 𝕧 (E R 𝕧 i) • (chevalley R 𝕧 (E R 𝕧 i ^ n) • m))) = 0 at he
  simpa only [pow_succ', map_mul, mul_smul] using he

name: VermaProjection.decode_positive_term
statement:
theorem decode_positive_term (i : I) (n : ℕ)
    (z : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ₁ ⊗[𝕂] VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ₂) :
    decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i
      (lowestPair R 𝕧 Λ₁ Λ₂ ((F R 𝕧 i ^ (n + 1)) ⊗ₜ (E R 𝕧 i ^ (n + 1))) z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [lowestPair_tmul]
    simp only [decode, map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      projection_Epow, tmul_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: VermaProjection.decode_partialSum
statement:
theorem decode_partialSum (i : I) (N : ℕ)
    (z : VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ₁ ⊗[𝕂] VermaModule R 𝕧 Λ₂) :
    decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i (lowestPair R 𝕧 Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R 𝕧 i N) z) =
      decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partialSum, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp [coeff, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  · intro n _ hn
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
    rw [decode_positive_term, smul_zero]
  · simp

name: VermaProjection.partialSum_vacuum
statement:
theorem partialSum_vacuum (i : I) (N : ℕ) :
    lowestPair R 𝕧 Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R 𝕧 i N) (vacuum R Λ₁ Λ₂) =
      vacuum R Λ₁ Λ₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partialSum, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp [coeff, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  · intro n _ hn
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
    simp [vacuum, lowestPair_tmul, pow_succ, mul_smul]
  · simp

name: VermaProjection.decode_braidDelta
statement:
theorem decode_braidDelta (i : I) (u : QuantumGroup R 𝕧) :
    decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i
      (lowestPair R 𝕧 Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i u) (vacuum R Λ₁ Λ₂)) =
    decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i
      (lowestPair R 𝕧 Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R 𝕧 u) (vacuum R Λ₁ Λ₂))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := FullIntertwining.lowestPair_intertwine_all R 𝕧 Λ₁ Λ₂
    ratFunc_X_not_root i u (vacuum R Λ₁ Λ₂)
  have h := congrArg (decode R Λ₁ Λ₂ i) (hN N le_rfl)
  rwa [partialSum_vacuum, decode_partialSum] at h

name: VermaProjection.extract_toral
statement:
@[simp] theorem extract_toral (i : I) (a b : Quotient D 𝕧) (μ : Y) :
    extract R Λ₁ Λ₂ i ((quotientPlus R a * K R 𝕧 μ) ⊗ₜ quotientPlus R b) =
      𝕧 ^ (-Λ₁ μ) • (a ⊗ₜ quotientSkewProjection D i b)
proof:
:=
  decode_toral R Λ₁ Λ₂ i a b μ

name: VermaProjection.extract_positiveComparison
statement:
theorem extract_positiveComparison (i : I) (z : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] Quotient D 𝕧) :
    extract R 0 Λ₂ i (quotientPositiveTensorComparison R z) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (quotientSkewProjection D i) z
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul a b =>
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 b
    rw [← sum_coeff_gradingHom b, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, tmul_sum, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ν _
    have hb : toQuotient D 𝕧 (LusztigF.weightProj ν b) ∈
        (LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 ν).map (toQuotient D 𝕧).toLinearMap :=
      ⟨_, LusztigF.weightProj_mem ν b, rfl⟩
    change extract R 0 Λ₂ i (quotientPositiveTensorComparison R
      (a ⊗ₜ toQuotient D 𝕧 (LusztigF.weightProj ν b))) =
        a ⊗ₜ quotientSkewProjection D i (toQuotient D 𝕧 (LusztigF.weightProj ν b))
    rw [quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem R a hb, extract_toral]
    simp
  | add z w hz hw => simp [hz, hw]

name: VermaProjection.extract_braid_positive
statement:
theorem extract_braid_positive (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    extract R 0 Λ₂ i (braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x)) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientComul D x)
proof:
:= by
  change decode R 0 Λ₂ i (lowestPair R 𝕧 0 Λ₂
    (braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x)) (vacuum R 0 Λ₂)) = _
  rw [decode_braidDelta, comul_quotientPlus]
  exact extract_positiveComparison R Λ₂ i (quotientComul D x)

name: VermaProjection.realizeKernelTensor_eq
statement:
theorem realizeKernelTensor_eq (i : I) :
    realizeKernelTensor R Λ₁ Λ₂ i = (tensorCoordinateEquiv R Λ₁ Λ₂ i).symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro b
  change vermaEquiv R Λ₁ a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] Submodule.Quotient.mk (vermaEquiv R Λ₂ b) =
    vermaEquiv R Λ₁ a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (vermaQuotientEquiv R Λ₂ i).symm b
  rw [vermaQuotientEquiv_symm]

name: VermaProjection.tensor_coefficient_faithful
statement:
theorem tensor_coefficient_faithful (i : I)
    (z w : Quotient D 𝕧 ⊗[𝕂] LinearMap.ker (quotientLDeriv D i)) :
    realizeKernelTensor R Λ₁ Λ₂ i z = realizeKernelTensor R Λ₁ Λ₂ i w ↔ z = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeKernelTensor_eq]
  exact (tensorCoordinateEquiv R Λ₁ Λ₂ i).symm.injective.eq_iff

name: VermaProjection.extract_negative_string
statement:
theorem extract_negative_string (i : I) (a b : Quotient D 𝕧) (μ ν : Y) (n : ℕ) :
    extract R Λ₁ Λ₂ i
      ((quotientPlus R a * K R 𝕧 μ * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i) * K R 𝕧 ν) ⊗ₜ[𝕂]
        quotientPlus R b) =
      if n = 0 then 𝕧 ^ (-Λ₁ (μ + ν)) • (a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] quotientSkewProjection D i b) else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp [qDivPow, qFactorial, mul_assoc, K_add]
  | succ n =>
    simp only [extract, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    rw [vacuum, lowestPair_tmul]
    simp [qDivPow, map_mul, map_smul, map_pow, chevalley_K,
      mul_smul, VermaModule.K_smul_hwv, smul_comm, pow_succ]

name: VermaProjection.extract_negativeSourceTerm
statement:
theorem extract_negativeSourceTerm (i : I) (n : ℕ) (ν : I →₀ ℕ) (a b : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    extract R 0 Λ₂ i (negativeSourceTerm R i n ν a b) =
      if n = 0 then a ⊗ₜ[𝕂] quotientSkewProjection D i b else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeSourceTerm, map_smul, extract_negative_string]
  split_ifs with hn
  · subst n; simp
  · simp

name: VermaProjection.extract_finite_negative
statement:
theorem extract_finite_negative {A : Type*} (s : Finset A) (i : I)
    (d : A → 𝕂) (n : A → ℕ) (ν : A → I →₀ ℕ) (a b : A → Quotient D 𝕧) :
    extract R 0 Λ₂ i (∑ j ∈ s, d j • negativeSourceTerm R i (n j) (ν j) (a j) (b j)) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, if n j = 0 then d j • (a j ⊗ₜ[𝕂] quotientSkewProjection D i (b j)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, extract_negativeSourceTerm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: VermaProjection.finite_braid_coefficient_identity
statement:
theorem finite_braid_coefficient_identity {A : Type*} (s : Finset A) (i : I)
    (x : Quotient D 𝕧) (d : A → 𝕂) (n : A → ℕ) (ν : A → I →₀ ℕ)
    (a b : A → Quotient D 𝕧)
    (h : braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, d j • negativeSourceTerm R i (n j) (ν j) (a j) (b j)) :
    (∑ j ∈ s, if n j = 0 then d j • (a j ⊗ₜ[𝕂] quotientSkewProjection D i (b j)) else 0) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientComul D x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← extract_finite_negative R (0 : Y →+ ℤ), ← h]
  exact extract_braid_positive R 0 i x

name: VermaProjection.finite_two_expansions
statement:
theorem finite_two_expansions {A B : Type*} (s : Finset A) (t : Finset B) (i : I)
    (x : Quotient D 𝕧) (d : A → 𝕂) (n : A → ℕ) (ν : A → I →₀ ℕ)
    (a b : A → Quotient D 𝕧) (c : B → 𝕂) (m : B → ℕ)
    (a' b' : B → Quotient D 𝕧)
    (hb : ∀ j ∈ t, quotientLDeriv D i (b' j) = 0)
    (hd : braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, d j • negativeSourceTerm R i (n j) (ν j) (a j) (b j))
    (hc : quotientComul D x =
      ∑ j ∈ t, c j • (a' j ⊗ₜ[𝕂] (quotientIntegralGenerator D i (m j) * b' j))) :
    (∑ j ∈ s, if n j = 0 then d j • (a j ⊗ₜ[𝕂] quotientSkewProjection D i (b j)) else 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ t, if m j = 0 then c j • (a' j ⊗ₜ[𝕂] b' j) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finite_braid_coefficient_identity R s i x d n ν a b hd, hc, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [map_smul, map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, quotientSkewProjection_divided_mul D i _ (hb j hj)]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: VermaProjection.reversed_projection_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem reversed_projection_eq_zero_iff (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientRev D (quotientSkewProjection D i (quotientRev D x)) = 0 ↔
      ∃ y : Quotient D 𝕧, x = y * toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hp : quotientSkewProjection D i (quotientRev D x) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (quotientRev D) hx
      simpa only [quotientRev_rev, map_zero] using h
    have hm : quotientRev D x ∈ thetaImage D i := by rw [← ker_projection]; exact hp
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hm
    refine ⟨quotientRev D y, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (quotientRev D) hy
    simpa [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, quotientRev_mul] using h.symm
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    simp [quotientRev_mul, projection_theta_mul]

name: VermaProjection.vermaEquiv_toQuotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem vermaEquiv_toQuotient (x : LusztigF 𝕂 I) :
    vermaEquiv R Λ (toQuotient D 𝕧 x) = minusHom R 𝕧 x • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ
proof:
:= by
  simp [vermaEquiv]

name: VermaProjection.vermaEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem vermaEquiv_apply (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    vermaEquiv R Λ x = chevalley R 𝕧 (quotientPlus R x) • VermaModule.hwv R 𝕧 Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  simp only [vermaEquiv_toQuotient, quotientPlus_toQuotient]
  congr 1
  induction x using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 c => simp
  | grade1 j => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]
  | mul a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: VermaProjection.lowestE_vermaEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem lowestE_vermaEquiv (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    lowestE R Λ i (vermaEquiv R Λ x) =
      vermaEquiv R Λ (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i) * x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lowestE, vermaEquiv_apply, mul_smul]

name: VermaProjection.projection_string
statement:
theorem projection_string (i : I) (n : ℕ) {a : LusztigF 𝕂 I}
    (ha : a ∈ skewGenerated D 𝕧 i) :
    quotientSkewProjection D i (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i ^ n * a)) =
      if n = 0 then toQuotient D 𝕧 a else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hk := quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D i (show toQuotient D 𝕧 a ∈
    quotientSkewGenerated D i from ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
  have hf := qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (D := D) RatFunc.X_ne_zero
    (pow_ne_one_of_transcendental' transcendental_ratFunc_X) i n
  have hp : toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i ^ n * a) =
      qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n •
        (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n * toQuotient D 𝕧 a) := by
    simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow, smul_smul, hf]
  rw [hp, map_smul, quotientSkewProjection_divided_mul D i n hk]
  split_ifs with hn
  · subst n; simp [qFactorial]
  · simp

name: VermaProjection.projection_theta_mul
statement:
theorem projection_theta_mul (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientSkewProjection D i (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i) * x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  have hx : x ∈ skewStringSpan D 𝕧 i := by rw [skewStringSpan_eq_top]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [← map_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', projection_string D i (n + 1) ha]
    simp
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp [mul_add, hx, hy]
  | smul c x _ hx => simp [hx]

name: VermaProjection.sub_projection_mem
statement:
theorem sub_projection_mem (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    x - quotientSkewProjection D i x ∈ thetaImage D i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 x
  have hx : x ∈ skewStringSpan D 𝕧 i := by rw [skewStringSpan_eq_top]; trivial
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [projection_string D i n ha]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
      refine ⟨toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i ^ n * a), ?_⟩
      simp [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, ← map_mul, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    simpa only [map_add, add_sub_add_comm] using (thetaImage D i).add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    simpa only [map_smul, smul_sub] using (thetaImage D i).smul_mem c hx

name: VermaProjection.ker_projection
statement:
theorem ker_projection (i : I) :
    LinearMap.ker (quotientSkewProjection D i) = thetaImage D i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have := sub_projection_mem D i x
    simpa only [LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx, sub_zero] using this
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact projection_theta_mul D i y

name: VermaProjection.vermaCoordinate_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem vermaCoordinate_eval (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    (vermaCoordinate R Λ i (vermaEquiv R Λ x) : Quotient D 𝕧) =
      quotientSkewProjection D i x
proof:
:= by
  change quotientSkewProjection D i ((vermaEquiv R Λ).symm (vermaEquiv R Λ x)) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: VermaProjection.ker_vermaCoordinate
statement:
theorem ker_vermaCoordinate (i : I) :
    LinearMap.ker (vermaCoordinate R Λ i) = vermaEImage R Λ i
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (vermaEquiv R Λ).surjective m
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx : quotientSkewProjection D i x = 0 := by
      simpa using congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp h)
    have hx' : x ∈ thetaImage D i := by rw [← ker_projection]; exact hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx'
    exact ⟨vermaEquiv R Λ y, by rw [lowestE_vermaEquiv]; exact congrArg (vermaEquiv R Λ) hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (vermaEquiv R Λ).surjective m
    rw [lowestE_vermaEquiv] at hm
    have hx := (vermaEquiv R Λ).injective hm
    apply Subtype.ext
    change quotientSkewProjection D i ((vermaEquiv R Λ).symm (vermaEquiv R Λ x)) = 0
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, ← hx, projection_theta_mul]

name: VermaProjection.vermaQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem vermaQuotientEquiv_mk (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    (vermaQuotientEquiv R Λ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk (vermaEquiv R Λ x)) : Quotient D 𝕧) =
      quotientSkewProjection D i x
proof: := vermaCoordinate_eval R Λ i x

name: VermaProjection.vermaQuotientEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem vermaQuotientEquiv_symm (i : I) (x : LinearMap.ker (quotientLDeriv D i)) :
    (vermaQuotientEquiv R Λ i).symm x = Submodule.Quotient.mk (vermaEquiv R Λ x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (vermaQuotientEquiv R Λ i).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i x.property]

name: RightStringComparison.inverse_divided_E
statement:
theorem inverse_divided_E (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm (qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (E R 𝕧 i)) =
      ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ n * (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ (-((n * (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))) •
        (K R 𝕧 (-(n • ktilde R i)) * qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n (F R 𝕧 i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_smul, map_mul,
    braidEquivOfNotRoot_qDivPow_F_self ratFunc_X_not_root R]
  have hk : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (K R 𝕧 (-(n • ktilde R i))) =
      K R 𝕧 (n • ktilde R i) := by
    simpa only [braidK_apply, map_neg, map_nsmul, reflY_ktilde, smul_neg, neg_neg,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom] using
