      (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i).map_K (-(n • ktilde R i))
  rw [hk, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, K_add, smul_neg, add_neg_cancel, K_zero, one_mul,
    smul_smul]
  have hcoeff : ((-1 : 𝕂) ^ n * (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ (-((n * (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))) *
      ((-1) ^ n * (𝕧 ^ D.d i) ^ (n * (n - 1))) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_mul,
      zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero))]
  rw [hcoeff, one_smul]

name: RightStringComparison.inversePositive_spec
statement:
lemma inversePositive_spec (i : I) (b : Quotient D 𝕧) (hb : quotientRDeriv D i b = 0) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm (quotientPlus R b) =
      quotientPlus R (inversePositive R i b hb)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_inverse_positive R i hb)

name: RightStringComparison.inversePositive_left
statement:
lemma inversePositive_left (i : I) (b : Quotient D 𝕧) (hb : quotientRDeriv D i b = 0) :
    quotientLDeriv D i (inversePositive R i b hb) = 0
proof:
:=
  inverse_positive_left R i (inversePositive_spec R i b hb)

name: RightStringComparison.braid_inversePositive
statement:
lemma braid_inversePositive (i : I) (b : Quotient D 𝕧) (hb : quotientRDeriv D i b = 0) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R (inversePositive R i b hb)) =
      quotientPlus R b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inversePositive_spec, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: RightStringComparison.inverseComparison_rightTerm
statement:
theorem inverseComparison_rightTerm (i : I) (t : RightTerm (D := D) i) :
    inverseComparison R i t.tensor = t.inverseTensor R
proof:
:= by
  have hc : quotientPositiveTensorComparison R t.tensor =
      (quotientPlus R (t.a * quotientIntegralGenerator D i t.n) *
        K R 𝕧 (positiveToralWeight R t.ν)) ⊗ₜ quotientPlus R t.b := by
    exact quotientPositiveTensorComparison_tmul_of_mem R _ t.hν
  simp only [inverseComparison, LinearMap.comp_apply, hc, map_tmul, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply,
    map_mul, inverse_K]
  rw [inversePositive_spec R i t.a t.ha, inversePositive_spec R i t.b t.hb]
  rw [show quotientPlus R (quotientIntegralGenerator D i t.n) =
      qDivPow (𝕧 ^ D.d i) t.n (E R 𝕧 i) by simp [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow]]
  rw [inverse_divided_E]
  simp only [RightTerm.inverseTensor, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_tmul', mul_assoc]

name: RightStringComparison.extract_inverseTerm
statement:
theorem extract_inverseTerm (i : I) (t : RightTerm (D := D) i) :
    extract R 0 0 i (t.inverseTensor R) =
      if t.n = 0 then inversePositive R i t.a t.ha ⊗ₜ[𝕂] inversePositive R i t.b t.hb else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [RightTerm.inverseTensor, map_smul, extract_negative_string]
  split_ifs with hn
  · simp [hn, quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i (inversePositive_left R i t.b t.hb)]
  · simp

name: RightStringComparison.exists_finite_right_expansion
statement:
theorem exists_finite_right_expansion (i : I) {y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hy : quotientRDeriv D i y = 0) :
    ∃ c : RightTerm (D := D) i →₀ 𝕂,
      (c.sum fun t d ↦ d • t.tensor) = quotientComul D y
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp (comul_mem_rightTermSpan i hy)

name: RightStringComparison.exists_actual_inverse_expansion
statement:
theorem exists_actual_inverse_expansion (i : I) {x y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hy : quotientRDeriv D i y = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y) :
    ∃ c : RightTerm (D := D) i →₀ 𝕂,
      (c.sum fun t d ↦ d • t.tensor) = quotientComul D y ∧
      braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) =
        c.sum (fun t d ↦ d • t.inverseTensor R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_finite_right_expansion i hy
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  have he : braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) =
      inverseComparison R i (quotientComul D y) := by
    simp only [braidDelta, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, hxy,
      comul_quotientPlus, inverseComparison, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [he, ← hc]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, inverseComparison_rightTerm]

name: RightStringComparison.degree_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hb
  exact ⟨a * b, mul_mem_weightSpace ha hb, (toQuotient D 𝕧).map_mul a b⟩

name: RightStringComparison.degree_rev
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := ha
  exact ⟨rev 𝕂 I a, rev_mem_weightSpace ha, (quotientRev_toQuotient D a).symm⟩

name: RightStringComparison.skewGenerator_degree
statement:
lemma skewGenerator_degree (i j : I) (n : ℕ) :
    skewGenerator D 𝕧 i j n ∈
      LusztigF.weightSpace 𝕂 (Finsupp.single j 1 + n • Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using (θ_mem_weightSpace (k := 𝕂) j)
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [skewGenerator_succ, skewAdjoint_apply, twist_skewGenerator, mul_smul_comm]
    have h₁ := mul_mem_weightSpace ih (θ_mem_weightSpace (k := 𝕂) i)
    have h₂ := mul_mem_weightSpace (θ_mem_weightSpace (k := 𝕂) i) ih
    convert Submodule.sub_mem _ h₁ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (by
      simpa only [add_comm] using h₂)) using 1
    · simp only [add_nsmul, one_nsmul, add_assoc]

name: RightStringComparison.rightHomogeneousSpan_mul
statement:
lemma rightHomogeneousSpan_mul (i : I) {a b : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (ha : a ∈ rightHomogeneousSpan (D := D) i)
    (hb : b ∈ rightHomogeneousSpan (D := D) i) :
    a * b ∈ rightHomogeneousSpan (D := D) i
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem b hb =>
      obtain ⟨ha, ν, hν⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨hb, μ, hμ⟩ := hb
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨quotientRDeriv_mul_zero D i ha hb,
        ν + μ, degree_mul hν hμ⟩
    | zero => simp
    | add b c _ _ hb hc => simpa only [mul_add] using add_mem hb hc
    | smul c b _ hb => simpa only [mul_smul_comm] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c hb
  | zero => simp
  | add a c _ _ ha hc => simpa only [add_mul] using add_mem ha hc
  | smul c a _ ha => simpa only [smul_mul_assoc] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c ha

name: RightStringComparison.right_mem_homogeneousSpan
statement:
theorem right_mem_homogeneousSpan (i : I) {b : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hb : quotientRDeriv D i b = 0) : b ∈ rightHomogeneousSpan (D := D) i
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ a ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i,
      quotientRev D a ∈ rightHomogeneousSpan (D := D) i := by
    intro a ha
    induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
      obtain ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩ := ha
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      constructor
      · apply right_rev_zero i
        rw [quotientLDeriv_toQuotient]
        simp [skewDividedGenerator, lDeriv_skewGenerator D 𝕧 i hij]
      · refine ⟨Finsupp.single j 1 + n • Finsupp.single i 1, degree_rev ?_⟩
        refine ⟨skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j n, ?_, rfl⟩
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (skewGenerator_degree i j n)
    | algebraMap c =>
      have he : quotientRev D (algebraMap 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) c) =
          toQuotient D 𝕧 (algebraMap 𝕂 _ c) := by
        rw [← (toQuotient D 𝕧).commutes, quotientRev_toQuotient, rev_algebraMap]
      rw [he]
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      refine ⟨?_, 0, ?_⟩
      · rw [quotientRDeriv_toQuotient]; simp
      · exact ⟨algebraMap 𝕂 _ c, algebraMap_mem_weightSpace c, rfl⟩
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | mul a b _ _ ha hb => rw [quotientRev_mul]; exact rightHomogeneousSpan_mul i hb ha
  simpa only [quotientRev_rev] using h (quotientRev D b)
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i _).mpr (left_rev_zero i hb))

name: RightStringComparison.tmul_mem_rightTermSpan
proof:
:= by
  have hb' := right_mem_homogeneousSpan i hb
  clear hb
  induction hb' using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem b hb =>
    obtain ⟨hb, ν, hν⟩ := hb
    obtain ⟨N, c, hc, he⟩ := exists_right_strings i a
    rw [he, sum_tmul]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro n hn
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨c n, b, n, ν, hc n, hb, hν⟩, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add b c _ _ hb hc => simpa only [tmul_add] using add_mem hb hc
  | smul c b _ hb => simpa only [tmul_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c hb

name: RightStringComparison.comul_mem_rightTermSpan
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := quotientComul_mem_rightKernelTensor D i hy
  rw [← hz]
  clear hz
  induction z with
  | tmul a b => exact tmul_mem_rightTermSpan i a b.property
  | add z w hz hw => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hz hw

name: RightStringComparison.left_rev_zero
statement:
lemma left_rev_zero (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : quotientRDeriv D i x = 0) :
    quotientLDeriv D i (quotientRev D x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (quotientRev D) hx
  simpa [quotientRDeriv] using h

name: RightStringComparison.right_rev_zero
statement:
lemma right_rev_zero (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧} (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0) :
    quotientRDeriv D i (quotientRev D x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [quotientRDeriv, hx]

name: RightStringComparison.rightProjection_mem
statement:
lemma rightProjection_mem (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    quotientRDeriv D i (rightProjection (D := D) i x) = 0
proof:
:=
  right_rev_zero i (quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_of_mem D i (quotientSkewProjection_mem D i _))

name: RightStringComparison.rightProjection_of_ker
statement:
lemma rightProjection_of_ker (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientRDeriv D i x = 0) : rightProjection (D := D) i x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rightProjection, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    quotientSkewProjection_of_ker D i (left_rev_zero i hx), quotientRev_rev]

name: RightStringComparison.rev_integralGenerator
statement:
lemma rev_integralGenerator (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    quotientRev D (quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) = quotientIntegralGenerator D i n
proof:
:= by
  have hp : quotientRev D ((toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i)) ^ n) =
      (toQuotient D 𝕧 (θ 𝕂 i)) ^ n := by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      change quotientRev D (toQuotient D 𝕧 1) = toQuotient D 𝕧 1
      rw [quotientRev_toQuotient, rev_one]
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, quotientRev_mul, ih, quotientRev_toQuotient, rev_θ,
        ← pow_succ', pow_succ]
  simpa only [quotientIntegralGenerator, qDivPow, map_smul, map_pow] using
    congrArg (fun z ↦ (qFactorial (𝕧 ^ D.d i) n)⁻¹ • z) hp

name: RightStringComparison.rightProjection_string
statement:
theorem rightProjection_string (i : I) (n : ℕ) {a : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (ha : quotientRDeriv D i a = 0) :
    rightProjection (D := D) i (a * quotientIntegralGenerator D i n) =
      if n = 0 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rightProjection, LinearMap.comp_apply, quotientRev_mul, rev_integralGenerator,
    quotientSkewProjection_divided_mul D i n (left_rev_zero i ha)]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: RightStringComparison.exists_right_strings
statement:
theorem exists_right_strings (i : I) (x : Quotient D 𝕧) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → Quotient D 𝕧), (∀ n, quotientRDeriv D i (a n) = 0) ∧
      x = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n * quotientIntegralGenerator D i n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, a, ha, he⟩ := exists_quotientSkewGenerators_decomposition D i (quotientRev D x)
  refine ⟨N, fun n ↦ quotientRev D (a n), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact right_rev_zero i ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i _).mp (ha n))
  · have h := congrArg (quotientRev D) he
    simpa only [quotientRev_rev, map_sum, quotientRev_mul, rev_integralGenerator] using h

name: RightStringComparison.exists_inverse_positive
statement:
theorem exists_inverse_positive (i : I) {b : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hb : quotientRDeriv D i b = 0) :
    ∃ a : Quotient D 𝕧, (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm
      (quotientPlus R b) = quotientPlus R a
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : ∀ z ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i, ∃ a : Quotient D 𝕧,
      braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R a) =
        quotientPlus R (quotientRev D z) := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨toQuotient D 𝕧 (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j (negA D i j - n)), ?_⟩
      have h := braid_skewDividedGenerator R hij (negA D i j - n) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
      have hn' : n ≤ negA D i j := hn
      simpa only [Nat.sub_sub_self hn', quotientRev_toQuotient] using h
    | algebraMap c =>
      refine ⟨algebraMap 𝕂 _ c, ?_⟩
      have hr : quotientRev D (algebraMap 𝕂 (Quotient D 𝕧) c) = algebraMap 𝕂 _ c := by
        rw [← (toQuotient D 𝕧).commutes, quotientRev_toQuotient]
        simp
      simp [hr]
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨a + b, by simp only [map_add, ha, hb]⟩
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨b * a, by simp only [map_mul, ha, hb, quotientRev_mul]⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hgen (quotientRev D b)
    ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i _).mpr (left_rev_zero i hb))
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [quotientRev_rev] at ha
  rw [← ha, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: RightStringComparison.inverse_positive_left
proof:
:= by
  apply (quotientLDeriv_eq_zero_iff_braid_positive R i a).mpr
  rw [← hab, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toQuotient_surjective D 𝕧 b
  exact ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: RightStringComparison.inverse_K
statement:
theorem inverse_K (i : I) (μ : Y) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).symm (K R 𝕧 μ) =
      K R 𝕧 (reflY R i μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simpa only [braidK_apply, reflY_reflY, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom] using
    ((braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages ratFunc_X_not_root R i).map_K (reflY R i μ)).symm

name: RightStringComparison.braid_image_right
statement:
theorem braid_image_right (i : I) {x y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y) :
    quotientRDeriv D i y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ a ∈ quotientSkewGenerators D i, ∃ b : Quotient D 𝕧,
      quotientRDeriv D i b = 0 ∧
        braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R a) = quotientPlus R b := by
    intro a ha
    induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
      obtain ⟨j, hij, n, hn, rfl⟩ := ha
      refine ⟨quotientRev D (toQuotient D 𝕧
        (skewDividedGenerator D 𝕧 i j (negA D i j - n))), ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply right_rev_zero i
        rw [quotientLDeriv_toQuotient]
        simp [skewDividedGenerator, lDeriv_skewGenerator D 𝕧 i hij]
      · simpa only [quotientRev_toQuotient] using braid_skewDividedGenerator R hij n hn
    | algebraMap c =>
      refine ⟨toQuotient D 𝕧 (algebraMap 𝕂 _ c), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [quotientRDeriv_toQuotient]; simp
      · simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha', he⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hf⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨a' + b', by simp [ha', hb'], by simp only [map_add, he, hf]⟩
    | mul a b _ _ ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha', he⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hf⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨a' * b', quotientRDeriv_mul_zero D i ha' hb', by simp only [map_mul, he, hf]⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := h x ((mem_quotientSkewGenerators_iff D i x).mpr hx)
  have hby := quotientPlus_injective R (he.symm.trans hxy)
  simpa only [hby] using hb

name: RightStringComparison.left_projector_redundant
statement:
theorem left_projector_redundant (i : I) {x : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0) :
    TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientSkewProjection D i)
        (quotientComul D x) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientComul D x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (quotientSkewProjection D i))
    (quotientSkewProjection_rTensor_comul D i hx)
  simpa only [LinearMap.rTensor, TensorProduct.map_map, LinearMap.id_comp,
    LinearMap.comp_id] using h

name: RightStringComparison.exists_zero_coefficient
statement:
theorem exists_zero_coefficient (i : I) {x y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y) :
    ∃ c : RightTerm (D := D) i →₀ 𝕂,
      (c.sum fun t d ↦ d • t.tensor) = quotientComul D y ∧
      braidDelta R 𝕧 ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) =
        c.sum (fun t d ↦ d • t.inverseTensor R) ∧
      TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientSkewProjection D i)
          (quotientComul D x) =
        c.sum (fun t d ↦ if t.n = 0 then
          d • (inversePositive R i t.a t.ha ⊗ₜ[𝕂] inversePositive R i t.b t.hb) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := exists_actual_inverse_expansion R i (braid_image_right R i hx hxy) hxy
  refine ⟨c, hc, hd, ?_⟩
  rw [left_projector_redundant i hx]
  have he := congrArg (extract R 0 0 i) hd
  rw [extract_braid_positive] at he
  rw [he]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, extract_inverseTerm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: RightStringComparison.projected_braid_compatibility
statement:
theorem projected_braid_compatibility (i : I) {x y : Quotient D 𝕧}
    (hx : quotientLDeriv D i x = 0)
    (hxy : braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i (quotientPlus R x) = quotientPlus R y) :
    TensorProduct.map
      ((braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap)
      ((braidEquivOfNotRoot R ratFunc_X_not_root i).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap)
      (TensorProduct.map (quotientSkewProjection D i) (quotientSkewProjection D i)
        (quotientComul D x)) =
    TensorProduct.map (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap (quotientPlus R).toLinearMap
      (TensorProduct.map (rightProjection (D := D) i) (rightProjection (D := D) i)
        (quotientComul D y))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, _, hz⟩ := exists_zero_coefficient R i hx hxy
  rw [hz, ← hc]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  simp only [RightTerm.tensor, map_tmul, rightProjection_string i t.n t.ha,
    rightProjection_of_ker i t.hb]
  split_ifs with hn
  · simp only [map_smul, map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, braid_inversePositive]
  · simp

name: MixedNormalization.braid_rankTwoXm
statement:
theorem braid_rankTwoXm (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ negA D i j) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (rankTwoXm R v i j a) =
      ((-1) ^ a * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (a * (negA D i j - a + 1)) *
        (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) a / qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j - a))) •
          rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j - a)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hq : v ^ D.d i - (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_inv_ne_zero_of_pow_ne_one hq0
      (fun n hn ↦ by rw [← pow_mul]; exact hv _ (Nat.mul_pos (D.d_pos i) hn))
  have hfac (n : ℕ) := LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root
    (D := D) (NeZero.ne v) hv i n
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  induction a with
  | zero => simpa [rankTwoXm_zero] using map_E_eq_rankTwoXp HT hij
  | succ a ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, negA D i j - a = n + 1 := ⟨negA D i j - a - 1, by omega⟩
    have hn' : negA D i j - (a + 1) = n := by omega
    have hr : negA D i j = n + 1 + a := by omega
    have hs : shift (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j) a =
        shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) := by
      simp only [BraidDiagonal.shift, inv_pow, inv_inv]
      rw [hr]
      field_simp
      ring
    have H := (braidDiagonal_hyp R v (NeZero.ne v) hij hq).stepE (K_neg_mul_Kt i) n
    change braidEi R i * rankTwoXp R v i j (n + 1) -
      shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) •
        (rankTwoXp R v i j (n + 1) * braidEi R i) =
      (-(shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) *
        cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1))) •
          rankTwoXp R v i j n at H
    have hc :
        ((-1) ^ a * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (a * (n + 1 + 1)) *
          (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) a / qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1))) *
          -(shift (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1) *
            cc (v ^ D.d i) ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (n + 1)) =
        (-1) ^ (a + 1) * (v ^ D.d i) ^ ((a + 1) * (n + 1)) *
          (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (a + 1) / qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) n) := by
      rw [cc_pow hq0 hq (by omega), show negA D i j - n = a + 1 by omega]
      have hqn : qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
        exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (show qInt (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1) *
          qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) n ≠ 0 from hfac (n + 1))).1
      simp only [BraidDiagonal.shift, hr, qFactorial_succ, pow_succ (-1 : k)]
      field_simp [hfac, hqn]
      simp only [← pow_add]
      ring_nf
    have he := map_E_self HT
    change braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v i) = _ at he
    rw [rankTwoXm_succ, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, map_mul, ih (by omega), he,
      hn, hs, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_comm _
        ((-1) ^ a * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (a * (n + 1 + 1)) *
          (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) a / qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (n + 1))),
      ← smul_sub, H, smul_smul, hc, hn']

name: MixedNormalization.inverse_braid_rankTwoXp
statement:
theorem inverse_braid_rankTwoXp (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ negA D i j) :
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).symm (rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j - a)) =
      ((-1) ^ a * (v ^ D.d i) ^ (a * (negA D i j - a + 1)) *
        (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) a / qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j - a)))⁻¹ •
          rankTwoXm R v i j a
proof:
:= by
  apply (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_smul, braid_rankTwoXm R v hv hij a ha, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀, one_smul]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))
    (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))))
      (div_ne_zero (LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv i a)
        (LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv i _))

name: MixedNormalization.normalCoeff_zero
statement: lemma normalCoeff_zero (q Q : k) (m : ℕ) : normalCoeff q Q m 0 = Q ^ m
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalCoeff]

name: MixedNormalization.normalCoeff_diag
statement: lemma normalCoeff_diag (q Q : k) (m : ℕ) : normalCoeff q Q m m = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalCoeff]

name: MixedNormalization.normalCoeff_above
statement:
lemma normalCoeff_above (q Q : k) {m a : ℕ} (h : m < a) :
    normalCoeff q Q m a = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalCoeff, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q h]

name: MixedNormalization.normalCoeff_step
statement:
lemma normalCoeff_step {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (Q : k) (m a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ m) :
    normalCoeff q Q (m + 1) (a + 1) = normalCoeff q Q m a +
      (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (a + 1)) * Q) * normalCoeff q Q m (a + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha
  · simp [normalCoeff_diag, normalCoeff_above q Q (Nat.lt_succ_self a)]
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, m = a + 1 + b := ⟨m - (a + 1), by omega⟩
    subst m
    simp only [normalCoeff, qBinomial_succ_succ,
      show a + 1 + b + 1 - (a + 1) = b + 1 by omega,
      show a + 1 + b - a = b + 1 by omega,
      show a + 1 + b - (a + 1) = b by omega, inv_pow]
    field_simp
    ring

name: MixedNormalization.normal_order
statement:
theorem normal_order {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (Q : k) (E x : B) (m : ℕ) :
    E ^ m * x = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), normalCoeff q Q m a •
      (X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x a * E ^ (m - a))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [normalCoeff, X]
  | succ m ih =>
    have hterm (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ m) :
        E * (X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x a * E ^ (m - a)) =
          X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x (a + 1) * E ^ (m - a) +
          (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * a) * Q) • (X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x a * E ^ (m + 1 - a)) := by
      rw [X_succ]
      simp only [BraidDiagonal.shift, inv_inv, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc,
        mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', show m - a + 1 = m + 1 - a by omega]
      abel
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, ih, Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a ha ↦ congrArg (fun z ↦ normalCoeff q Q m a • z)
      (hterm a (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp ha))))]
    simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (m + 1)]
    have hsecond :
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          (normalCoeff q Q m a * (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * a) * Q)) •
            (X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x a * E ^ (m + 1 - a))) =
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          ((q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (a + 1)) * Q) * normalCoeff q Q m (a + 1)) •
            (X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x (a + 1) * E ^ (m - a))) +
          Q ^ (m + 1) • (x * E ^ (m + 1)) := by
      have h := Finset.sum_range_succ'
        (fun a ↦ (normalCoeff q Q m a * (q⁻¹ ^ (2 * a) * Q)) •
          (X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x a * E ^ (m + 1 - a))) (m + 1)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, normalCoeff_above q Q (Nat.lt_succ_self m)] at h
      simp only [zero_mul, zero_smul, add_zero, normalCoeff_zero, mul_zero, pow_zero,
        one_mul, show X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x 0 = x from rfl,
        Nat.sub_zero, ← pow_succ, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at h
      simpa only [mul_comm] using h
    rw [hsecond, ← add_assoc, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [normalCoeff_zero, show X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x 0 = x from rfl,
      Nat.sub_zero, Nat.add_sub_add_right]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    rw [← add_smul, normalCoeff_step hq Q m a
      (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp ha))]

name: MixedNormalization.triangle_add
statement:
lemma triangle_add (a b : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (a + b), t) =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range a, t) + (∑ t ∈ Finset.range b, t) + a * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: MixedNormalization.coeff_normalCoeff
statement:
lemma coeff_normalCoeff {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hf : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0) (Q : k) (m a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ m) :
    coeff q m * normalCoeff q Q m a = coeff q a * coeff q (m - a) * Q ^ (m - a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le ha
  have hb := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q) (n := a + b) (j := a)
    (Nat.le_add_right a b)
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hb ⊢
  have hb' : qBinomial q (a + b) a =
      qFactorial q (a + b) / (qFactorial q a * qFactorial q b) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (hf a) (hf b))).mpr
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hb
  simp only [normalCoeff, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, hb', coeff_closed, triangle_add,
    pow_add, inv_pow]
  field_simp [hf]

name: MixedNormalization.coefficient_convolution
statement:
theorem coefficient_convolution {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hf : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0) (Q : k) (E x : B) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff q m • (E ^ m * x) = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      (coeff q a * coeff q (m - a) * Q ^ (m - a)) •
        (X q⁻¹ Q⁻¹ E x a * E ^ (m - a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [normal_order hq Q E x m, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  rw [smul_smul, coeff_normalCoeff hq hf Q m a
    (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp ha))]

name: MixedNormalization.rankTwoXm_convolution
statement:
theorem rankTwoXm_convolution (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (i j : I) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff (v ^ D.d i) m • (E R v i ^ m * E R v j) =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        (coeff (v ^ D.d i) a * coeff (v ^ D.d i) (m - a) *
          (v ^ D.d i) ^ (negA D i j * (m - a))) •
            (rankTwoXm R v i j a * E R v i ^ (m - a))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rankTwoXm, inv_pow, pow_mul] using
    coefficient_convolution (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))
      (fun n ↦ LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv i n)
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) (E R v i) (E R v j) m

name: MixedNormalization.rankTwoXm_serre
statement:
lemma rankTwoXm_serre {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    rankTwoXm R v i j (negA D i j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))
  rw [rankTwoXm, X_eq_serreAux hq (pow_ne_zero _ hq)]
  rw [pow_succ', mul_inv_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hq (pow_ne_zero _ hq)), serreAux_one]
  simp only [qSerre, qBinomial_inv]
  simpa only [qSerre, one_sub_cartanMatrix_toNat hij] using
    (serre_E (R := R) (v := v) hij)

name: MixedNormalization.rankTwoXm_above
statement:
lemma rankTwoXm_above {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ) (ha : negA D i j < a) :
    rankTwoXm R v i j a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le ha
  induction b with
  | zero => simpa using rankTwoXm_serre R v hij
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc, rankTwoXm_succ, ih (by omega)]
    simp

name: MixedNormalization.rankTwoXm_convolution_truncated
statement:
theorem rankTwoXm_convolution_truncated (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff (v ^ D.d i) m • (E R v i ^ m * E R v j) =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (min (negA D i j) m + 1),
        (coeff (v ^ D.d i) a * coeff (v ^ D.d i) (m - a) *
          (v ^ D.d i) ^ (negA D i j * (m - a))) •
            (rankTwoXm R v i j a * E R v i ^ (m - a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankTwoXm_convolution R v hv i j m]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega))
  intro a ha hnot
  have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
  have hnot' : ¬a < min (negA D i j) m + 1 := by simpa using hnot
  rw [rankTwoXm_above R v hij a (by omega), zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: MixedNormalization.sum_triangle
statement:
lemma sum_triangle {B : Type*} [AddCommMonoid B] (f : ℕ → ℕ → B) (r N : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      if a + n ≤ N then f a n else 0) =
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (min r m + 1), f a (m - a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_product', ← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun p _ ↦ (⟨p.1 + p.2, p.1⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ))
  · intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range]
    omega
  · intro p hp p' hp' heq
    have h1 := congrArg Sigma.fst heq
    have h2 := congrArg Sigma.snd heq
    apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp at * <;> omega
  · intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    refine ⟨(p.2, p.1 - p.2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
      omega
    · have h : p.2 + (p.1 - p.2) = p.1 := by omega
      simp only [h]
  · intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    simp

name: MixedNormalization.Kj_mul_Fi_pow
statement:
lemma Kj_mul_Fi_pow {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    Kt R v j * F R v i ^ n = (v ^ D.d i) ^ (negA D i j * n) •
      (F R v i ^ n * Kt R v j)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Kt R v j * F R v i = (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j •
      (F R v i * Kt R v j) := by
    rw [Kt, K_mul_F, root_ktilde_comm, zpow_neg, zpow_root_ktilde_of_ne hij, inv_inv]
  simpa only [pow_mul] using mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul h n

name: MixedNormalization.left_product
statement:
lemma left_product (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (N : ℕ) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j) * partialSum R v i N =
      (E R v j ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) * partialSum R v i N +
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (negA D i j + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          mixedTerm R v i j a n
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidDelta_E_offdiag R v hv hij, add_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [partialSum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_assoc, Kj_mul_Fi_pow R v hij n,
    mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← smul_tmul', smul_smul, smul_smul]
  simp [mixedTerm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: MixedNormalization.right_product
statement:
lemma right_product (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (N : ℕ) :
    partialSum R v i N * comul R v (E R v j) =
      (E R v j ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) * partialSum R v i N +
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (min (negA D i j) m + 1),
          mixedTerm R v i j a (m - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_E, mul_add]
  congr 1
  · simp only [partialSum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _
    rw [(Commute.pow_right (E_mul_F_of_ne (R := R) (v := v) hij.symm) n).eq]
  · simp only [partialSum, Finset.sum_mul, smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m _
    rw [← tmul_smul, rankTwoXm_convolution_truncated R v hv hij m, tmul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
    simp only [mixedTerm, tmul_smul, show a + (m - a) = m by omega]

name: MixedNormalization.finite_E_offdiag_boundary
statement:
theorem finite_E_offdiag_boundary (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (N : ℕ) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j) * partialSum R v i N -
      partialSum R v i N * comul R v (E R v j) = overflow R v i j N
proof:
:= by
  rw [left_product R v hv hij, right_product R v hv hij, ← sum_triangle]
  simp only [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, overflow]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  by_cases h : a + n ≤ N
  · simp [h, show ¬N < a + n by omega]
  · simp [h, show N < a + n by omega]

name: MixedNormalization.gaussianCoeff_pascal
statement:
lemma gaussianCoeff_pascal {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (m t : ℕ) (ht : t < m) :
    gaussianCoeff q (m + 1) (t + 1) = gaussianCoeff q m (t + 1) +
      q ^ (2 * (m - t)) * gaussianCoeff q m t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, m = t + 1 + b := ⟨m - (t + 1), by omega⟩
  simp only [gaussianCoeff, qBinomial_succ_succ,
    show t + 1 + b + 1 - (t + 1) = b + 1 by omega,
    show t + 1 + b - t = b + 1 by omega,
    show t + 1 + b - (t + 1) = b by omega, inv_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: MixedNormalization.gaussianCoeff_pascal'
statement:
lemma gaussianCoeff_pascal' {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (m t : ℕ) (ht : t < m) :
    gaussianCoeff q (m + 1) (t + 1) = q ^ (2 * (t + 1)) * gaussianCoeff q m (t + 1) +
      gaussianCoeff q m t
proof:
:= by
  have h := qBinomial_succ_succ q⁻¹ m t
  simp only [qBinomial_inv, inv_inv] at h
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, m = t + 1 + b := ⟨m - (t + 1), by omega⟩
  simp only [gaussianCoeff, h,
    show t + 1 + b + 1 - (t + 1) = b + 1 by omega,
    show t + 1 + b - t = b + 1 by omega,
    show t + 1 + b - (t + 1) = b by omega, inv_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: MixedNormalization.coproductCoeff_product
statement:
theorem coproductCoeff_product {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (Q : k) (m t : ℕ) :
    coproductCoeff q Q m t = gaussianCoeff q m t *
      ∏ h ∈ Finset.Ico t m, (1 - q ^ (2 * h) * Q⁻¹ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing t with
  | zero =>
    cases t <;> simp [coproductCoeff, gaussianCoeff]
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy t (m + 1) with ht | rfl | ht
    · cases t with
      | zero =>
        rw [coproductCoeff, ih, Finset.prod_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le m)]
        simp only [gaussianCoeff, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.sub_zero, pow_zero,
          qBinomial_zero_right, mul_one, one_mul]
        ring
      | succ t =>
        have htm : t < m := by omega
        rw [coproductCoeff, ih, ih,
          Finset.prod_Ico_succ_top (by omega : t + 1 ≤ m),
          Finset.prod_eq_prod_Ico_succ_bot htm]
        have h1 := gaussianCoeff_pascal hq m t htm
        have h2 := gaussianCoeff_pascal' hq m t htm
        have hp : q ^ (2 * (m + t + 1)) = q ^ (2 * m) * q ^ (2 * (t + 1)) := by
          rw [← pow_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        have hp2 : q ^ (2 * t) * q ^ (2 * (m - t)) = q ^ (2 * m) := by
          rw [← pow_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        rw [hp]
        linear_combination
          (∏ h ∈ Finset.Ico (t + 1) m, (1 - q ^ (2 * h) * Q⁻¹ ^ 2)) *
            (-h1 + q ^ (2 * m) * Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * h2 - Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * gaussianCoeff q m t * hp2)
    · simp [coproductCoeff_diag, gaussianCoeff]
    · rw [coproductCoeff_above q Q ht]
      simp [gaussianCoeff, qBinomial_eq_zero_of_lt q ht]

name: MixedNormalization.rootProduct
statement:
lemma rootProduct {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0) (a t : ℕ) :
    (∏ h ∈ Finset.Ico t (t + a), (1 - q ^ (2 * h) * (q ^ (t + a))⁻¹ ^ 2)) =
      (q - q⁻¹) ^ a * qFactorial q a * q⁻¹ ^ ((∑ h ∈ Finset.range a, h) + a)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : (∏ h ∈ Finset.Ico t (t + a),
      (1 - q ^ (2 * h) * (q ^ (t + a))⁻¹ ^ 2)) =
      ∏ h ∈ Finset.range a, (1 - q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (h + 1))) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_Ico_eq_prod_range, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
      ← Finset.prod_range_reflect]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro h hh
    have hh' := Finset.mem_range.mp hh
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, a = h + 1 + b := ⟨a - (h + 1), by omega⟩
    rw [hb, show h + 1 + b - 1 - h = b by omega]
    simp only [inv_pow]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hprod]
  clear hprod
  induction a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ, qFactorial_succ, pow_succ]
    have hfactor : 1 - q⁻¹ ^ (2 * (a + 1)) =
        (q - q⁻¹) * qInt q (a + 1) * q⁻¹ ^ (a + 1) := by
      rw [qInt_mul_sub]
      simp only [inv_pow]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hfactor]
    simp only [pow_add]
    ring

name: MixedNormalization.coproductCoeff_top
statement:
theorem coproductCoeff_top {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hf : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0) (a t : ℕ) :
    coproductCoeff q (q ^ (t + a)) (t + a) t =
      (qFactorial q (t + a) / qFactorial q t) * (q - q⁻¹) ^ a *
        q ^ (t * a) * q⁻¹ ^ ((∑ h ∈ Finset.range a, h) + a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coproductCoeff_product hq, rootProduct hq]
  have hb := qBinomial_mul_qFactorial_mul_qFactorial (v := q)
    (n := t + a) (j := t) (Nat.le_add_right t a)
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hb
  have hb' : qBinomial q (t + a) t =
      qFactorial q (t + a) / (qFactorial q t * qFactorial q a) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (hf t) (hf a))).mpr
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hb
  simp only [gaussianCoeff, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, hb']
  field_simp [hf]

name: MixedNormalization.lowestPair_overflow_of_cutoff
statement:
theorem lowestPair_overflow_of_cutoff (i j : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) (N₀ N : ℕ) (hN : N₀ ≤ N)
    (hcut : ∀ m, N₀ ≤ m → ∀ b : QuantumGroup R v,
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ ((F R v i ^ m * Kt R v j) ⊗ₜ[k] b) z = 0) :
    lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (overflow R v i j N) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [overflow, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro n _
  by_cases h : N < a + n
  · simp only [h, ite_true]
    simp only [mixedTerm, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      hcut (a + n) (by omega) _, smul_zero]
  · simp only [h, ite_false, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: MixedNormalization.lowestPair_overflow_eventually
statement:
theorem lowestPair_overflow_eventually (i j : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N → lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (overflow R v i j N) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₀, hcut⟩ := lowestPair_translated_uniform_cutoff R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i z (Kt R v j)
  exact ⟨N₀, fun N hN ↦ lowestPair_overflow_of_cutoff R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i j z N₀ N hN hcut⟩

name: MixedNormalization.lowestPair_intertwine_E_offdiag
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_E_offdiag (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j))
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (E R v j)) z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := lowestPair_overflow_eventually R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i j z
  refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun a ↦ lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ a z)
    (finite_E_offdiag_boundary R v hv hij N)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
    hN₀ N hN, sub_eq_zero] using h

name: MixedNormalization.lowestPair_intertwine_E_any
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_E_any (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i j : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j))
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (E R v j)) z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    exact lowestPair_intertwine_E R v Λ₁ Λ₂ hv i z
  · exact lowestPair_intertwine_E_offdiag R v Λ₁ Λ₂ hv hij z

name: MixedNormalization.braidFi_pow_torus
statement:
lemma braidFi_pow_torus (i : I) (a t : ℕ) :
    braidFi (v := v) R i ^ a * Kt R v i ^ (a + t) =
      ((-1) ^ a * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1))) •
        (E R v i ^ a * Kt R v i ^ t)
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih =>
    have hp := mul_pow_of_mul_eq_smul (K_neg_ktilde_mul_E (R := R) (v := v) i) (a + 1)
    simp only [inv_pow, ← pow_mul] at hp
    rw [pow_succ', show a + 1 + t = a + t + 1 by omega, pow_succ, mul_assoc,
      ← mul_assoc (braidFi R i ^ a), ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
    have ht : braidFi (v := v) R i * (E R v i ^ a * Kt R v i ^ t) * Kt R v i =
        (-((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (2 * (a + 1)))) •
          (E R v i ^ (a + 1) * Kt R v i ^ t) := by
      calc
        _ = -(K R v (-ktilde R i) * E R v i ^ (a + 1) *
            (Kt R v i ^ t * Kt R v i)) := by
          rw [braidFi, pow_succ']
          noncomm_ring
        _ = _ := by
          rw [hp, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, pow_succ' (Kt R v i),
            mul_assoc (E R v i ^ (a + 1)),
            ← mul_assoc (K R v (-ktilde R i)), K_neg_mul_Kt]
          simp [inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
    rw [ht, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring

name: MixedNormalization.braid_firstLeg
statement:
lemma braid_firstLeg (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ negA D i j) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j) =
      ((-1) ^ a * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1))) •
        (E R v i ^ a * (Kt R v i ^ (negA D i j - a) * Kt R v j))
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have hF : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v i) = braidFi R i := by
    simpa using HT.map_F i
  have hK : braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (Kt R v j) =
      Kt R v i ^ negA D i j * Kt R v j := by
    have hh : ∀ μ, braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ) := HT.map_K
    rw [Kt, hh, reflY_ktilde_of_ne hij, Kt, K_pow, K_add, add_comm]
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, hF, hK, ← mul_assoc,
    show negA D i j = a + (negA D i j - a) by omega, braidFi_pow_torus,
    smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

name: MixedNormalization.triangle_square
statement:
lemma triangle_square (a : ℕ) :
    (∑ h ∈ Finset.range a, h) + (∑ h ∈ Finset.range a, h) + a = a * a
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]; nlinarith

name: MixedNormalization.normalized_scalar
statement:
lemma normalized_scalar {q : k} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hf : ∀ n, qFactorial q n ≠ 0) (a t : ℕ) :
    coeff q a * ((-1) ^ a * q⁻¹ ^ (a * (a + 1))) *
      ((-1) ^ a * q ^ (a * (t + 1)) * (qFactorial q a / qFactorial q t)) =
      (qFactorial q (t + a))⁻¹ * coproductCoeff q (q ^ (t + a)) (t + a) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [coproductCoeff_top hq hf, coeff_closed]
  have hn : (-1 : k) ^ a * (-1) ^ a = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]; simp
  have hp : q ^ (∑ h ∈ Finset.range a, h) * q ^ (a * (t + 1)) *
      q ^ ((∑ h ∈ Finset.range a, h) + a) = q ^ (t * a) * q ^ (a * (a + 1)) := by
    simp only [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    have hs := triangle_square a
    nlinarith
  simp only [inv_pow]
  field_simp [hf]
  have hn2 : ((-1 : k) ^ a) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [pow_two, hn]
  rw [hn2]
  linear_combination (((q ^ 2 - 1) / q) ^ a) * hp

name: MixedNormalization.braidDelta_E_offdiag
statement:
theorem braidDelta_E_offdiag (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j) = E R v j ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v) +
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (negA D i j + 1), coeff (v ^ D.d i) a •
        ((F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j) ⊗ₜ[k] rankTwoXm R v i j a)
proof:
:= by
  let T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i
  apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).injective
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T)
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T).symm (comul R v (T (E R v j)))) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, comul_braid_E R v hv hij]
  have hE : T (E R v j) =
      (qFactorial (v ^ D.d i) (negA D i j))⁻¹ •
        rankTwoXp R v i j (negA D i j) :=
    map_E_eq_rankTwoXp (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i) hij
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, map_one,
    hE, smul_tmul', smul_add, Finset.smul_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  have ha' : a ≤ negA D i j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp ha)
  simp only [show negA D i j + 1 - 1 - a = negA D i j - a by omega, rootTerm]
  change _ = coeff (v ^ D.d i) a •
    ((T (F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j)) ⊗ₜ[k] T (rankTwoXm R v i j a))
  rw [braid_firstLeg R v hv hij a ha', braid_rankTwoXm R v hv hij a ha']
  simp only [← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, smul_smul, Nat.sub_sub_self ha']
  have hs := normalized_scalar (q := v ^ D.d i) (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))
    (fun n ↦ LusztigF.qFactorial_ne_zero_of_not_root (NeZero.ne v) hv i n)
    a (negA D i j - a)
  rw [show negA D i j - a + a = negA D i j by omega] at hs
  congr 1
  linear_combination -hs

name: FullIntertwining.flip_overflow
statement:
lemma flip_overflow (i j : I) (N : ℕ) :
    flipChevalley R v (overflow R v i j N) = overflowF R v i j N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [overflow, overflowF, map_sum, apply_ite, map_zero, mixedTerm,
    map_smul, flipChevalley_tmul, map_mul, map_pow, chevalley_E, chevalley_F, Kt,
    chevalley_K]

name: FullIntertwining.finite_F_offdiag_boundary
statement:
theorem finite_F_offdiag_boundary (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (N : ℕ) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (F R v j) * partialSum R v i N -
      partialSum R v i N * comul R v (F R v j) = overflowF R v i j N
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (flipChevalley R v) (finite_E_offdiag_boundary R v hv hij N)
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, flipChevalley_partialSum,
    ← braidDelta_F_chevalley R v hv hij, ← comul_chevalley, chevalley_E,
    flip_overflow] at h
  exact h

name: FullIntertwining.lowestPair_prefix_zero
statement:
lemma lowestPair_prefix_zero (i : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) (n : ℕ)
    (hcut : ∀ b : QuantumGroup R v, lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] b) z = 0)
    (a b : QuantumGroup R v) :
    lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ ((a * F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] b) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (a * F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] b =
      (a ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : QuantumGroup R v)) * ((F R v i ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] b) := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]
  rw [hf, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hcut, map_zero]

name: FullIntertwining.lowestPair_overflowF_eventually
statement:
theorem lowestPair_overflowF_eventually (i j : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N → lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (overflowF R v i j N) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := lowestPair_uniform_second_cutoff R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i z
  refine ⟨M + negA D i j, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [overflowF, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro a ha
  have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro n _
  by_cases h : N < a + n
  · simp only [h, ite_true, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    rw [lowestPair_prefix_zero R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i z n (hM n (by omega)), smul_zero]
  · simp only [h, ite_false, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: FullIntertwining.lowestPair_intertwine_F_offdiag
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_F_offdiag (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i (F R v j))
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (F R v j)) z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := lowestPair_overflowF_eventually R v Λ₁ Λ₂ i j z
  refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun a ↦ lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ a z)
    (finite_F_offdiag_boundary R v hv hij N)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
    hN₀ N hN, sub_eq_zero] using h

name: FullIntertwining.lowestPair_intertwine_F_any
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_F_any (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i j : I)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i (F R v j))
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v (F R v j)) z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    exact lowestPair_intertwine_F R v Λ₁ Λ₂ hv i z
  · exact lowestPair_intertwine_F_offdiag R v Λ₁ Λ₂ hv hij z

name: FullIntertwining.braid_F_chevalley
statement:
lemma braid_F_chevalley (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v j) =
      ((-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) •
        chevalley R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v j))
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have he := HT.map_E j
  have hf := HT.map_F j
  change braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v j) = _ at he
  change braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v j) = _ at hf
  rw [he, hf, ite_eq_right hij.symm, ite_eq_right hij.symm,
    twoNode_chevalley_braidEj (NeZero.ne v), smul_smul]
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hs : ((-1 : k) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) *
      ((-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ negA D i j) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, ← mul_pow]
    have h : (-1 : k) * v ^ D.d i * (-1 * (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹) = 1 := by
      field_simp
    rw [← mul_pow, h, one_pow]
  rw [hs, one_smul]

name: FullIntertwining.braid_F_self_chevalley
statement:
lemma braid_F_self_chevalley (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v i) = (v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2 •
      chevalley R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v i))
proof:
:= by
  have HT := braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i
  have he := HT.map_E i
  have hf := HT.map_F i
  change braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v i) = _ at he
  change braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v i) = _ at hf
  rw [he, hf, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, chevalley_braidEi (NeZero.ne v), smul_smul]
  rw [inv_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))), one_smul]

name: FullIntertwining.braid_E_self_chevalley
statement:
lemma braid_E_self_chevalley (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v i) = (v ^ D.d i) ^ 2 •
      chevalley R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (chevalley R v) (braid_F_self_chevalley R v hv i)
  have hi (x : QuantumGroup R v) : chevalley R v (chevalley R v x) = x :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun (chevalley_comp_chevalley R v) x
  simp only [map_smul, hi] at h
  rw [h, smul_smul]
  rw [inv_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v))), one_smul]

name: FullIntertwining.braid_negative_root
statement:
lemma braid_negative_root (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (chevalley R v (rankTwoXm R v i j a)) =
      (((-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) *
        ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ a) •
        chevalley R v (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (rankTwoXm R v i j a))
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simpa [rankTwoXm_zero] using braid_F_chevalley R v hv hij
  | succ a ih =>
    simp only [rankTwoXm_succ, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, chevalley_E,
      braid_F_self_chevalley R v hv i, ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
      smul_smul, smul_sub, pow_succ]
    congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring

name: FullIntertwining.braid_positive_toral_leg
statement:
lemma braid_positive_toral_leg (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    (i j : I) (a : ℕ) :
    braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (E R v i ^ a * K R v (-ktilde R j)) =
      ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) ^ a • chevalley R v
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j))
proof:
:= by
  have hK : ∀ μ, braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i (K R v μ) = K R v (reflY R i μ) :=
    (braidEquivOfNotRoot_hasImages hv R i).map_K
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, braid_E_self_chevalley R v hv i, smul_pow,
    smul_mul_assoc, Kt, hK, chevalley_K, map_neg]

name: FullIntertwining.braid_flip_root_term
statement:
lemma braid_flip_root_term (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : ℕ) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i)
      (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i))
      (flipChevalley R v ((F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j) ⊗ₜ[k] rankTwoXm R v i j a)) =
    ((-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) • flipChevalley R v
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i)
        (braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i))
        ((F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j) ⊗ₜ[k] rankTwoXm R v i j a))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [flipChevalley_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
  rw [show chevalley R v (F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j) =
      E R v i ^ a * K R v (-ktilde R j) by simp [Kt],
    braid_negative_root R v hv hij a, braid_positive_toral_leg R v hv i j a]
  simp only [← smul_tmul', tmul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have hq : v ^ D.d i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (NeZero.ne v)
  have hp : ((v ^ D.d i)⁻¹ ^ 2) ^ a * ((v ^ D.d i) ^ 2) ^ a = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, ← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_pow, one_pow]
  simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, mul_one, one_mul] using
    congrArg (fun x : k ↦ ((-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j) * x) hp

name: FullIntertwining.braidDelta_F_chevalley
statement:
theorem braidDelta_F_chevalley (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (F R v j) =
      flipChevalley R v (braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j))
proof:
:= by
  let T := braidEquivOfNotRoot R hv i
  let TT := Algebra.TensorProduct.congr T T
  let c : k := (-1) ^ negA D i j * (v ^ D.d i) ^ negA D i j
  have hc : TT (flipChevalley R v (braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j))) =
      c • flipChevalley R v (TT (braidDelta R v hv i (E R v j))) := by
    rw [braidDelta_E_offdiag R v hv hij]
    simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, smul_add, Finset.smul_sum]
    congr 1
    · simp only [flipChevalley_tmul, chevalley_E, map_one, TT,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
        AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, T, braid_F_chevalley R v hv hij, tmul_smul, c]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      rw [show TT (flipChevalley R v
        ((F R v i ^ a * Kt R v j) ⊗ₜ[k] rankTwoXm R v i j a)) = _ from
          braid_flip_root_term R v hv hij a]
      exact smul_comm _ _ _
  apply TT.injective
  change TT (TT.symm (comul R v (T (F R v j)))) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hc]
  change comul R v (T (F R v j)) =
    c • flipChevalley R v (TT (TT.symm (comul R v (T (E R v j)))))
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, braid_F_chevalley R v hv hij,
    map_smul, comul_chevalley]

name: FullIntertwining.braidDelta_F_offdiag
statement:
theorem braidDelta_F_offdiag (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    braidDelta R v hv i (F R v j) = (1 : QuantumGroup R v) ⊗ₜ[k] F R v j +
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (negA D i j + 1), coeff (v ^ D.d i) a •
        (chevalley R v (rankTwoXm R v i j a) ⊗ₜ[k]
          (E R v i ^ a * K R v (-ktilde R j)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidDelta_F_chevalley R v hv hij, braidDelta_E_offdiag R v hv hij]
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, flipChevalley_tmul, map_one, chevalley_E,
    map_mul, map_pow, chevalley_F, Kt, chevalley_K]

name: FullIntertwining.negative_convolution
statement:
theorem negative_convolution (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff (v ^ D.d i) m • (F R v i ^ m * F R v j) =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (min (negA D i j) m + 1),
        (coeff (v ^ D.d i) a * coeff (v ^ D.d i) (m - a) *
          (v ^ D.d i) ^ (negA D i j * (m - a))) •
            (chevalley R v (rankTwoXm R v i j a) * F R v i ^ (m - a))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (chevalley R v) (rankTwoXm_convolution_truncated R v hv hij m)
  simpa only [map_smul, map_mul, map_pow, chevalley_E, map_sum] using h

name: FullIntertwining.lowestPair_intertwine_all
statement:
theorem lowestPair_intertwine_all (hv : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → v ^ n ≠ 1) (i : I)
    (u : QuantumGroup R v)
    (z : VermaModule R v Λ₁ ⊗[k] VermaModule R v Λ₂) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N →
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (braidDelta R v hv i u)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N) z) =
      lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (partialSum R v i N)
        (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v u) z)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on generalizing z with
  | algebraMap c =>
    refine ⟨0, fun N _ ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, map_one,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply]
  | E j => exact lowestPair_intertwine_E_any R v Λ₁ Λ₂ hv i j z
  | F j => exact lowestPair_intertwine_F_any R v Λ₁ Λ₂ hv i j z
  | K μ =>
    refine ⟨0, fun N _ ↦ ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun a ↦ lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ a z) (intertwine_K R v hv i μ N)
    simpa only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply] using h
  | add a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := ha z
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hb z
    refine ⟨max M L, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
    rw [hM N (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hN), hL N (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hN)]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hb z
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := ha (lowestPair R v Λ₁ Λ₂ (comul R v b) z)
    refine ⟨max M L, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    rw [hM N (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hN), hL N (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hN)]

name: Module.End.pow_mul_injective_of_forall_pow_ne_one
statement:
theorem pow_mul_injective_of_forall_pow_ne_one
    {k : Type*} [GroupWithZero k] {q a : k} (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => q ^ n * a)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' : q ^ i = q ^ j := mul_right_cancel₀ ha hij
  wlog hle : i ≤ j generalizing i j
  · exact (this hij.symm hij'.symm (by omega)).symm
  by_contra hne
  have hd : 0 < j - i := by omega
  apply hq (j - i) hd
  have he : q ^ i * q ^ (j - i) = q ^ i * 1 := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hle, mul_one, hij']
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hq0) he

name: Module.End.apply_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute
statement:
theorem apply_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute (hcomm : K * T = q • (T * K))
    (hm : K m = a • m) (n : ℕ) :
    K ((T ^ n) m) = (q ^ n * a) • ((T ^ n) m)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hm
  | succ n ih =>
    have hc := congrArg (fun f : Module.End R M => f ((T ^ n) m)) hcomm
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, ih, map_smul] at hc
    simpa [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, smul_smul, mul_assoc] using hc

name: Module.End.pow_mem_eigenspace_of_q_commute
statement:
theorem pow_mem_eigenspace_of_q_commute (hcomm : K * T = q • (T * K))
    (hm : m ∈ K.eigenspace a) (n : ℕ) :
    (T ^ n) m ∈ K.eigenspace (q ^ n * a)
proof:
:=
  mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr
    (apply_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute hcomm (mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hm) n)

name: Module.End.exists_pow_eq_zero_of_q_commute
statement:
theorem exists_pow_eq_zero_of_q_commute (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hcomm : K * T = q • (T * K)) (hm : K m = a • m) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (T ^ n) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! h
  apply Module.Finite.not_linearIndependent_of_infinite (R := k) (fun n : ℕ => (T ^ n) m)
  exact K.eigenvectors_linearIndependent' _
    (pow_mul_injective_of_forall_pow_ne_one hq0 hq ha) _ fun n =>
      ⟨mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (apply_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute hcomm hm n), h n⟩

name: Module.End.exists_last_nonzero_pow_of_q_commute
statement:
theorem exists_last_nonzero_pow_of_q_commute (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hcomm : K * T = q • (T * K)) (hm : K m = a • m) (hm0 : m ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (∀ i ≤ n, (T ^ i) m ≠ 0) ∧ (T ^ (n + 1)) m = 0 ∧
      K ((T ^ n) m) = (q ^ n * a) • ((T ^ n) m) ∧ T ((T ^ n) m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex := exists_pow_eq_zero_of_q_commute hq0 hq ha hcomm hm
  let N := Nat.find hex
  have hN : (T ^ N) m = 0 := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    by_contra! hn
    have : N = 0 := by omega
    simp [this, hm0] at hN
  have hsucc : N - 1 + 1 = N := Nat.sub_add_cancel hNpos
  refine ⟨N - 1, ?_, ?_, apply_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute hcomm hm _, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact Nat.find_min hex (show i < Nat.find hex by dsimp [N] at *; omega)
  · simpa only [hsucc] using hN
  · rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ', hsucc]
    exact hN

name: Module.End.mul_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute
statement:
theorem mul_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute (hcomm : K * T = q • (T * K)) (n : ℕ) :
    K * T ^ n = q ^ n • (T ^ n * K)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hcomm, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul,
      ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, pow_succ]

name: Module.End.isNilpotent_of_q_commute
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_of_q_commute (hK : Function.Injective K)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (hcomm : K * T = q • (T * K)) : IsNilpotent T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp T.eventually_iInf_range_pow_eq
  set N := LinearMap.range (T ^ n) with hN
  have hsucc : LinearMap.range (T ^ (n + 1)) = N :=
    (hn (n + 1) (by omega)).symm.trans (hn n le_rfl)
  have hTN : ∀ x ∈ N, T x ∈ N := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hsucc ▸ ⟨x, by rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]⟩
  have hKN : ∀ x ∈ N, K x ∈ N := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨q ^ n • K x, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← Module.End.mul_apply,
      mul_pow_eq_smul_of_q_commute hcomm n, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  set T' := T.restrict hTN
  set K' := K.restrict hKN
  have hT' : Function.Surjective T' := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [← hsucc] at hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨⟨(T ^ n) x, x, rfl⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change T ((T ^ n) x) = (T ^ (n + 1)) x
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
  have hdetT : LinearMap.det T' ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, LinearMap.det_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot, not_not]
    exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.2 (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.2 hT')
  have hdetK : LinearMap.det K' ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, LinearMap.det_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot, not_not]
    exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.2 fun x y h ↦ Subtype.ext (hK (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have hc : K' * T' = q • (T' * K') := by
    ext x
    change K (T (x : M)) = q • T (K (x : M))
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, hcomm]
    rfl
  have hd := congrArg LinearMap.det hc
  rw [LinearMap.det_smul, map_mul, map_mul, mul_comm (LinearMap.det T')] at hd
  have hq1 : q ^ Module.finrank k N = 1 := by
    have := mul_right_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hdetK hdetT) (hd.symm.trans (one_mul _).symm)
    exact this
  have hN0 : N = ⊥ := by
    by_contra h
    have := Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.2 h
    exact hq _ Module.finrank_pos hq1
  exact ⟨n, LinearMap.range_eq_bot.1 hN0⟩

name: Module.End.exists_highestWeight_of_q_commute
statement:
theorem exists_highestWeight_of_q_commute [IsAlgClosed k] [Nontrivial M]
    (K T : Module.End k M) (hK : Function.Injective K)
    (q : k) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1)
    (hcomm : K * T = q • (T * K)) :
    ∃ (a₀ : k) (m : M), a₀ ≠ 0 ∧ m ≠ 0 ∧ K m = a₀ • m ∧ T m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := K.exists_eigenvalue
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ha.exists_hasEigenvector
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hm.2
    apply hK
    simpa [h] using hm.apply_eq_smul
  obtain ⟨n, hn, _, heig, hlast⟩ :=
    exists_last_nonzero_pow_of_q_commute hq0 hq ha0 hcomm hm.apply_eq_smul hm.2
  exact ⟨q ^ n * a, (T ^ n) m, mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hq0) ha0,
    hn n le_rfl, heig, hlast⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.eq_smul_highest_of_simpleRep_E_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_smul_highest_of_simpleRep_E_eq_zero
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → k)
    (hx : simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) x = 0) :
    x = x 0 • Pi.single 0 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hσ0 : σ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hσ
  have hq (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) : qInt v r ≠ 0 :=
    qInt_ne_zero hv (hv' _ (by omega))
  ext j
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp
  · have hjpos : 0 < j.val := by
      have : j.val ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hj (Fin.ext h)
      omega
    have hzero := congrArg (fun y ↦ coord n y (j.val - 1)) hx
    rw [simpleRep_E, coord_opE, coord_zero, Nat.sub_add_cancel hjpos] at hzero
    have hc : eCoeff v n σ j.val ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hσ0 (hq _ hjpos)) (hq _ (by omega))
    have hxj : x j = 0 := by
      simpa using (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hc
    simp [hj, hxj]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_parameters_eq
statement:
theorem simpleRep_parameters_eq (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) (hτ : τ ^ 2 = 1)
    (e : (Fin (n + 1) → k) ≃ₗ[k] (Fin (m + 1) → k))
    (he : ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x,
      e (simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x) =
        simpleRep v m τ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hτ u (e x)) : n = m ∧ σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdim : n + 1 = m + 1 := by simpa using e.finrank_eq
  have hnm : n = m := by omega
  subst m
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  let x : Fin (n + 1) → k := e (Pi.single 0 1)
  have hxE : simpleRep v n τ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hτ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) x = 0 := by
    rw [← he]
    simp only [simpleRep_E_single, Fin.val_zero, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceDIte, map_zero]
  have hx := eq_smul_highest_of_simpleRep_E_eq_zero hv hv' hτ x hxE
  have hx0 : x 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hzero : x = 0 := by rw [hx, h0, zero_smul]
    have hh : (Pi.single (0 : Fin (n + 1)) (1 : k)) = 0 :=
      e.injective (hzero.trans e.map_zero.symm)
    have := congrFun hh 0
    simp at this
  have hK := congrFun (he (K sl2RootDatum v 1) (Pi.single (0 : Fin (n + 1)) 1)) 0
  rw [simpleRep_K_single, map_smul] at hK
  simp only [simpleRep_K, opK, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Fin.val_zero,
    Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, one_mul, zpow_one, zpow_natCast,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hK
  change (σ * v ^ n) * x 0 = (τ * v ^ n) * x 0 at hK
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero n hv) (mul_right_cancel₀ hx0 hK)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.simpleRep_equiv_iff
statement:
theorem simpleRep_equiv_iff (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) (hτ : τ ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∃ e : (Fin (n + 1) → k) ≃ₗ[k] (Fin (m + 1) → k),
      ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x,
        e (simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x) =
          simpleRep v m τ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hτ u (e x)) ↔ n = m ∧ σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    exact simpleRep_parameters_eq hv hv' hσ hτ e he
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨LinearEquiv.refl k _, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.K_apply_of_K_apply
proof:
:= by
  induction μ using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [← K_add, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hm, map_smul, ih,
      smul_smul, zpow_add₀ ha, zpow_one, mul_comm a]
  | pred i ih =>
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← K_add, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply,
      K_neg_apply_of_K_apply ρ ha hm, map_smul, ih, smul_smul,
      zpow_add₀ ha, zpow_neg_one, mul_comm a⁻¹]

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.F_string_span_stable
statement:
theorem F_string_span_stable (hv : v ≠ 0) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    {a : k} {m : M} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hm : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m)
    (hE : ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hz : (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (n + 1)) m = 0) :
    ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x,
      x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range
        (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m)) →
      ρ u x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range
        (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m))
proof:
:= by
  let W := Submodule.span k (Set.range
    (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m))
  have hmem (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) : (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ i) m ∈ W :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨i, by omega⟩, rfl⟩
  have hstable (T : Module.End k M)
      (hT : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), T ((ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m) ∈ W) :
      ∀ x, x ∈ W → T x ∈ W := by
    intro x hx
    exact (Submodule.span_le.mpr (by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hT i) : W ≤ W.comap T) hx
  intro u
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c =>
    intro x hx
    simpa using W.smul_mem c hx
  | E i =>
    obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i ()
    apply hstable
    intro i
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i.val with hi | hi
    · simp [hi, hE, W]
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hi)
      rw [hr, E_apply_F_pow_succ hv ρ ha hm hE]
      exact W.smul_mem _ (hmem r (by omega))
  | F i =>
    obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i ()
    apply hstable
    intro i
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']
    by_cases hi : i.val < n
    · exact hmem _ (by omega)
    · have heq : i.val = n := by omega
      rw [heq, hz]
      exact W.zero_mem
  | K μ =>
    apply hstable
    intro i
    rw [K_apply_of_K_apply ρ
      (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hv))) ha)
      (K_apply_F_pow ρ hm i) μ]
    exact W.smul_mem _ (hmem i (by omega))
  | add u u' hu hu' =>
    intro x hx
    simpa using W.add_mem (hu x hx) (hu' x hx)
  | mul u u' hu hu' =>
    intro x hx
    simpa only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply] using hu _ (hu' x hx)

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.F_string_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem F_string_span_eq_top (hv : v ≠ 0) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    (hρ : ∀ W : Submodule k M, (∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, x ∈ W → ρ u x ∈ W) →
      W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤)
    {a : k} {m : M} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hm0 : m ≠ 0)
    (hm : ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = a • m)
    (hE : ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hz : (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (n + 1)) m = 0) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range
      (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rcases hρ _ (F_string_span_stable hv ρ ha hm hE hz) with hbot | htop
  · exfalso
    apply hm0
    have hmem : m ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range
        (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m)) := by
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, by simp⟩
    simpa [hbot] using hmem
  · exact htop

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.exists_highestString_basis
statement:
theorem exists_highestString_basis [FiniteDimensional k M] [Nontrivial M]
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    (hρ : ∀ W : Submodule k M, (∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, x ∈ W → ρ u x ∈ W) →
      W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (σ : k) (m : M), σ ^ 2 = 1 ∧ m ≠ 0 ∧
      ρ (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m = (σ * v ^ n) • m ∧
      ρ (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m = 0 ∧
      (∀ i ≤ n, (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ i) m ≠ 0) ∧
      (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (n + 1)) m = 0 ∧
      ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) k M,
        ∀ i, b i = (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, σ, m, hσ, hm0, hm, hE, hn, hz⟩ := exists_highestString hv hv' ρ
  have hσ0 : σ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at hσ
  have ha := mul_ne_zero hσ0 (pow_ne_zero n hv)
  have hli := F_string_linearIndependent hv hv' ρ ha hm hn
  have hsp := F_string_span_eq_top hv ρ hρ ha hm0 hm hE hz
  exact ⟨n, σ, m, hσ, hm0, hm, hE, hn, hz,
    Module.Basis.mk hli hsp.ge, Module.Basis.mk_apply hli hsp.ge⟩

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.exists_equiv_simpleRep
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_simpleRep [FiniteDimensional k M] [Nontrivial M]
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    (hρ : ∀ W : Submodule k M, (∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, x ∈ W → ρ u x ∈ W) →
      W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (σ : k) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) (e : (Fin (n + 1) → k) ≃ₗ[k] M),
      ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, e (simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x) = ρ u (e x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, σ, m, hσ, _, hm, hE, _, hz, b, hb⟩ :=
    exists_highestString_basis hv hv' ρ hρ
  let S := simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ
  let m₀ : Fin (n + 1) → k := Pi.single 0 1
  let e : (Fin (n + 1) → k) ≃ₗ[k] M := b.equivFun.symm
  have ha : σ * v ^ n ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ hv)
    intro h
    simp [h] at hσ
  have hsK : S (K sl2RootDatum v 1) m₀ = (σ * v ^ n) • m₀ := by
    simpa [S, m₀] using
      simpleRep_K_single (n := n) hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ 1 0
  have hsE : S (E sl2RootDatum v ()) m₀ = 0 := by
    simp only [S, m₀, simpleRep_E_single, Fin.val_zero, lt_self_iff_false,
      ↓reduceDIte]
  have hsF (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      (S (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m₀ = Pi.single i 1 := by
    simp only [S, simpleRep_F, m₀]
    apply ext_coord
    intro l
    have := i.2
    rw [coord_opF_pow, coord_single, coord_single, Fin.val_zero]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)
  have he (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      e (Pi.single i 1) = (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ (i : ℕ)) m := by
    simpa [e, Module.Basis.equivFun_symm_apply, Pi.single_apply] using hb i
  have heF (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) :
      e ((S (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ r) m₀) =
        (ρ (F sl2RootDatum v ()) ^ r) m := by
    rw [hsF ⟨r, by omega⟩]
    exact he ⟨r, by omega⟩
  have he0 : e m₀ = m := by simpa using heF 0 (Nat.zero_le n)
  have extend (u : Sl2 v)
      (h : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        e (S u (Pi.single i 1)) = ρ u (e (Pi.single i 1))) :
      ∀ x, e (S u x) = ρ u (e x) := by
    have hh : e.toLinearMap.comp (S u) = (ρ u).comp e.toLinearMap := by
      apply (Pi.basisFun k (Fin (n + 1))).ext
      intro i
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Pi.basisFun_apply] using h i
    exact fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun hh x
  refine ⟨n, σ, hσ, e, ?_⟩
  intro u
  change ∀ x, e (S u x) = ρ u (e x)
  induction u using QuantumGroup.induction_on with
  | algebraMap c => intro x; simp
  | E i =>
    obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i ()
    apply extend
    intro i
    rw [← hsF i]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i.val with hi | hi
    · simp [hi, hsE, he0, hE]
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hi)
      rw [hr, E_apply_F_pow_succ hv S ha hsK hsE, map_smul,
        heF r (by omega), heF (r + 1) (by omega), E_apply_F_pow_succ hv ρ ha hm hE]
  | F i =>
    obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i ()
    apply extend
    intro i
    rw [he, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ']
    by_cases hi : i.val + 1 < n + 1
    · rw [show S (F sl2RootDatum v ()) (Pi.single i 1) =
        Pi.single ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ 1 by
          simp only [S, simpleRep_F_single, hi, ↓reduceDIte]]
      exact he ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩
    · have hin : i.val = n := by omega
      rw [show S (F sl2RootDatum v ()) (Pi.single i 1) = 0 by
        simp only [S, simpleRep_F_single, hi, ↓reduceDIte]]
      rw [map_zero, hin, hz]
  | K μ =>
    apply extend
    intro i
    rw [← hsF i,
      K_apply_of_K_apply S
        (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hv))) ha)
        (K_apply_F_pow S hsK i) μ,
      map_smul, heF i (by omega),
      K_apply_of_K_apply ρ
        (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hv))) ha)
        (K_apply_F_pow ρ hm i) μ]
  | add u u' hu hu' => intro x; simp [hu, hu']
  | mul u u' hu hu' => intro x; simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hu, hu']

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.irreducible_of_equiv_simpleRep
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_equiv_simpleRep (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1) (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M)
    {n : ℕ} {σ : k} (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) (e : (Fin (n + 1) → k) ≃ₗ[k] M)
    (he : ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x,
      e (simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x) = ρ u (e x))
    (W : Submodule k M) (hW : ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, x ∈ W → ρ u x ∈ W) :
    W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hstable : ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, x ∈ W.comap e.toLinearMap →
      simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x ∈ W.comap e.toLinearMap := by
    intro u x hx
    change e (simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x) ∈ W
    rw [he]
    exact hW u _ hx
  rcases simpleRep_irreducible hv hv' hσ _ hstable with hbot | htop
  · left
    apply bot_unique
    intro x hx
    change x = 0
    have hmem : e.symm x ∈ W.comap e.toLinearMap := by simpa using hx
    rw [hbot] at hmem
    have hz : e.symm x = 0 := hmem
    simpa using congrArg e hz
  · right
    apply top_unique
    intro x _
    have hmem : e.symm x ∈ W.comap e.toLinearMap := by rw [htop]; trivial
    simpa using hmem

name: LieLean.QuantumGroup.Sl2.irreducible_iff_equiv_simpleRep
statement:
theorem irreducible_iff_equiv_simpleRep [FiniteDimensional k M]
    [Nontrivial M] (hv : v ≠ 0) (hv' : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → v ^ r ≠ 1)
    (ρ : Sl2 v →ₐ[k] Module.End k M) :
    (∀ W : Submodule k M, (∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, x ∈ W → ρ u x ∈ W) →
      W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ↔
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (σ : k) (hσ : σ ^ 2 = 1) (e : (Fin (n + 1) → k) ≃ₗ[k] M),
      ∀ (u : Sl2 v) x, e (simpleRep v n σ hv (hv' 2 two_pos) hσ u x) = ρ u (e x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_equiv_simpleRep hv hv' ρ
  · rintro ⟨n, σ, hσ, e, he⟩
    exact irreducible_of_equiv_simpleRep hv hv' ρ hσ e he

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.exists_eq_sum_tmul_basis
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sum_tmul_basis {ι : Type*} (b : Module.Basis ι K L) (x : L ⊗[K] M) :
    ∃ f : ι →₀ M, x = f.sum fun i m ↦ b i ⊗ₜ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : L ⊗[K] M ≃ₗ[K] ι →₀ M :=
    (LinearEquiv.rTensor M b.repr).trans (finsuppScalarLeft K M ι)
  refine ⟨e x, e.injective ?_⟩
  rw [map_finsuppSum]
  conv_lhs => rw [← (e x).sum_single]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun i _ ↦ ?_
  simp [e, finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul]

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.eq_zero_of_baseChange_tmul_one_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis K L
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_sum_tmul_basis b x
  have hf : ∀ i, f i = 0 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ f.support
    · refine hB _ fun y ↦ ?_
      have h := hx y
      rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply] at h
      simp only [baseChange_tmul, mul_one] at h
      exact linearIndependent_iff'.mp b.linearIndependent f.support (fun i ↦ B (f i) y) h i hi
    · simpa using hi
  have hf0 : f = 0 := Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ by simpa using hf i
  simp [hf0]

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.eq_zero_of_baseChange_equiv
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_baseChange_equiv {M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module L M']
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K M) (hB : ∀ x, (∀ y, B x y = 0) → x = 0)
    (B' : LinearMap.BilinForm L M') (e : L ⊗[K] M ≃ₗ[L] M')
    (he : ∀ x y, B' (e x) (e (1 ⊗ₜ y)) = B.baseChange L x (1 ⊗ₜ y)) {x' : M'}
    (hx' : ∀ y', B' x' y' = 0) : x' = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← e.apply_symm_apply x', eq_zero_of_baseChange_tmul_one_eq_zero B hB
    (x := e.symm x') fun y ↦ by rw [← he, e.apply_symm_apply, hx'], map_zero]

name: MvPolynomial.vars_pderiv_subset
statement:
theorem vars_pderiv_subset (p : MvPolynomial I R) (i : I) :
    (pderiv i p).vars ⊆ p.vars
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hjd⟩ := (mem_vars_iff_mem_support j).mp hj
  refine (mem_vars_iff_mem_support j).mpr ⟨d + Finsupp.single i 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply mem_support_iff.mpr
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul (by simpa only [coeff_pderiv] using mem_support_iff.mp hd)
  · apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
    intro hz
