    apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hjd
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_right (by simpa only [Finsupp.add_apply] using hz)

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homotopy_mem_homogeneousTensors
statement:
theorem homotopy_mem_homogeneousTensors (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (n q : ℕ) (z : ExteriorAlgebra R M ⊗[R] MvPolynomial I R)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) :
    homotopy b s z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, p, hlq, hl, hp, hs, rfl⟩ := hz
    simp only [homotopy, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i hi
    rw [homotopyTerm_tmul]
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨i :: l, MvPolynomial.pderiv i p, ?_, ?_, hp.pderiv,
      (MvPolynomial.vars_pderiv_subset p i).trans hs, ?_⟩
    · simp only [List.length_cons, hlq]
    · intro j hj
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
      · exact hi
      · exact hl j hj
    · rfl
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using
      (homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1)).zero_mem
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using
      (homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1)).add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using
      (homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1)).smul_mem a hx

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homotopy_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree_zero
statement:
theorem homotopy_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree_zero (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (q : ℕ) (z : ExteriorAlgebra R M ⊗[R] MvPolynomial I R)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s 0 q) : homotopy b s z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, p, _, _, hp, _, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [← MvPolynomial.totalDegree_zero_iff_isHomogeneous,
      MvPolynomial.totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C] at hp
    rw [hp]
    simp [homotopy, homotopyTerm_tmul]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.normalized_homotopy_primitive
statement:
theorem normalized_homotopy_primitive (b : Module.Basis I K M) (s : Finset I) (n q : ℕ)
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) (hcycle : delta b s z = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < n + q) :
    ((n + q : ℕ) : K)⁻¹ • homotopy b s z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1) ∧
      delta b s (((n + q : ℕ) : K)⁻¹ • homotopy b s z) = z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1)).smul_mem _
    (homotopy_mem_homogeneousTensors b s n q z hz), ?_⟩
  have heq := anticommutator_homogeneous b s n q z hz
  rw [hcycle, map_zero, add_zero] at heq
  rw [map_smul, heq, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hpos)), one_smul]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.eq_zero_of_cycle_polynomial_degree_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_cycle_polynomial_degree_zero (b : Module.Basis I K M) (s : Finset I)
    (q : ℕ) (z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s 0 q) (hcycle : delta b s z = 0)
    (hq : 0 < q) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (normalized_homotopy_primitive b s 0 q z hz hcycle (by simpa using hq)).2
  rw [homotopy_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree_zero b s q z hz, smul_zero, map_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exists_homogeneous_primitive
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneous_primitive (b : Module.Basis I K M) (s : Finset I) (n q : ℕ)
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) (hcycle : delta b s z = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < n + q) :
    ∃ y ∈ homogeneousTensors b s (n - 1) (q + 1), delta b s y = z
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨((n + q : ℕ) : K)⁻¹ • homotopy b s z,
    normalized_homotopy_primitive b s n q z hz hcycle hpos⟩

name: MvPolynomial.sub_homogeneousComponent_mem_restrictTotalDegree
statement:
theorem sub_homogeneousComponent_mem_restrictTotalDegree (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial I R)
    (hp : p ∈ restrictTotalDegree I R (n + 1)) :
    p - homogeneousComponent (n + 1) p ∈
      restrictTotalDegree I R n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_restrictTotalDegree, totalDegree, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro d hd
  have hne := mem_support_iff.mp hd
  change p.coeff d - (homogeneousComponent (n + 1) p).coeff d ≠ 0 at hne
  rw [coeff_homogeneousComponent] at hne
  have hdeg : d.degree ≠ n + 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hne (by simp [h])
  have hcoeff : p.coeff d ≠ 0 := by simpa [hdeg] using hne
  have hbound := (mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mp hp
  rw [totalDegree, Finset.sup_le_iff] at hbound
  have hdle := hbound d (mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff)
  change d.degree ≤ n
  change d.degree ≤ n + 1 at hdle
  omega

name: MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_X_mul
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_X_mul (n : ℕ) (i : I) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    homogeneousComponent (n + 1) (X i * p) =
      X i * homogeneousComponent n p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  by_cases hi : i ∈ d.support
  · have hle : Finsupp.single i 1 ≤ d := by
      simpa only [Finsupp.single_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero,
        ← Finsupp.mem_support_iff] using hi
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hle
    simp only [coeff_homogeneousComponent, coeff_X_mul]
    congr 1
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]
    apply propext
    omega
  · simp [coeff_homogeneousComponent, coeff_X_mul', hi]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.tmul_mem_rectangle
statement:
lemma tmul_mem_rectangle {q n : ℕ} {e : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (he : e ∈ ⋀[R]^q M)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree I R n) :
    e ⊗ₜ[R] p ∈ rectangle (R := R) (M := M) (I := I) q n
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, he, p, hp, rfl⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.polynomialTop_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialTop_tmul (n : ℕ) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : P) :
    polynomialTop n (e ⊗ₜ[R] p) = e ⊗ₜ[R] MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n p
proof: := rfl

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homogeneousTensors_le_rectangle
statement:
theorem homogeneousTensors_le_rectangle (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (n q : ℕ) : homogeneousTensors b s n q ≤ rectangle q n
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro z ⟨l, p, hl, _, hp, _, rfl⟩
  exact tmul_mem_rectangle (hl ▸ basisWord_mem_exteriorPower b l)
    ((MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mpr hp.totalDegree_le)

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.polynomialTop_mem_iSup
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup_homogeneousTensors]
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, p, _, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n p, he,
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous n p, rfl⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.polynomialTop_eq_self
statement:
theorem polynomialTop_eq_self (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I) (n q : ℕ)
    {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) : polynomialTop n z = z
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, p, _, _, hp, _, rfl⟩ := hz
    simp only [polynomialTop_tmul, MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_self hp]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul r x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.polynomialTop_eq_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialTop_eq_zero {q m n : ℕ} (hmn : m < n) {z : EP}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q m) : polynomialTop n z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, _, p, hp, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [polynomialTop_tmul, MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero n p
      (lt_of_le_of_lt ((MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mp hp) hmn), tmul_zero]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul r x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.sub_polynomialTop_mem
statement:
theorem sub_polynomialTop_mem (q n : ℕ) {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ rectangle q (n + 1)) :
    z - polynomialTop (n + 1) z ∈ rectangle q n
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, p, hp, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [polynomialTop_tmul, ← tmul_sub]
    exact tmul_mem_rectangle he
      (MvPolynomial.sub_homogeneousComponent_mem_restrictTotalDegree n p hp)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    simpa only [map_add, add_sub_add_comm] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    simpa only [map_smul, smul_sub] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.polynomialTop_delta
statement:
theorem polynomialTop_delta (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I) (n : ℕ) (z : EP) :
    polynomialTop (n + 1) (delta b s z) =
      delta b s (polynomialTop n z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | tmul e p =>
    simp only [delta, LinearMap.sum_apply, deltaTerm_tmul, map_sum,
      polynomialTop_tmul, MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_X_mul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.delta_polynomialTop_eq_zero
statement:
theorem delta_polynomialTop_eq_zero (b : Module.Basis I R M) {D : Module.End R EP}
    (hD : IsLeadingKoszul b D)
    (s : Finset I) (q n : ℕ) {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ supportedTensors b s q n)
    (hcycle : D z = 0) : delta b s (polynomialTop n z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := hD s q n z hz
  rw [hcycle, zero_add] at he
  rw [← polynomialTop_delta]
  exact polynomialTop_eq_zero (Nat.lt_succ_self n) he

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.sub_polynomialTop_mem_pred
statement:
theorem sub_polynomialTop_mem_pred (q n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {z : EP}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) : z - polynomialTop n z ∈ rectangle q (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using sub_polynomialTop_mem q m hz

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.rectangle_decomposition
statement:
theorem rectangle_decomposition (b : Module.Basis I R M) (q n : ℕ) {z : EP}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q (n + 1)) :
    ∃ (y t : EP) (s : Finset I), y ∈ rectangle q n ∧
      t ∈ homogeneousTensors b s (n + 1) q ∧ z = y + t
proof:
:= by
  have ht := polynomialTop_mem_iSup b q (n + 1) (n + 1) hz
  rw [iSup_homogeneousTensors] at ht
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_support_of_mem_homogeneous_span b (n + 1) q ht
  exact ⟨z - polynomialTop (n + 1) z, polynomialTop (n + 1) z, s,
    sub_polynomialTop_mem q n hz, hs, (sub_add_cancel z _).symm⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.iSup_homogeneousTensors_le_rectangle
statement:
theorem iSup_homogeneousTensors_le_rectangle (b : Module.Basis I R M) (q n : ℕ) :
    (⨆ s : Finset I, homogeneousTensors b s n q) ≤ rectangle q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup_homogeneousTensors]
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro z ⟨e, p, he, hp, rfl⟩
  exact tmul_mem_rectangle he
    (by rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree]; exact hp.totalDegree_le)

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.polynomialTop_zero_eq_self
statement:
theorem polynomialTop_zero_eq_self (q : ℕ) {z : EP}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q 0) : polynomialTop 0 z = z
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨e, _, p, hp, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree] at hp
    have hp0 : p.IsHomogeneous 0 := by
      rw [← MvPolynomial.totalDegree_zero_iff_isHomogeneous]
      exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hp
    rw [polynomialTop_tmul, MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_self hp0]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul r x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.supportedTensors_mono
statement:
theorem supportedTensors_mono (b : Module.Basis I R M) (q n : ℕ)
    {s t : Finset I} (hst : s ⊆ t) : supportedTensors b s q n ≤ supportedTensors b t q n
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro z ⟨l, p, hl, hs, hp, hz⟩
  exact ⟨l, p, hl, fun i hi => hst (hs i hi), hp, hz⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homogeneousTensors_le_supportedTensors
statement:
theorem homogeneousTensors_le_supportedTensors (b : Module.Basis I R M)
    (s : Finset I) (n q : ℕ) :
    homogeneousTensors b s n q ≤ supportedTensors b s q n
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro z ⟨l, p, hl, hs, hp, _, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, p, hl, hs,
    (MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree _ _ _).mpr hp.totalDegree_le, rfl⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exists_support_rectangle
statement:
theorem exists_support_rectangle (b : Module.Basis I R M) (q n : ℕ)
    {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) : ∃ s, z ∈ supportedTensors b s q n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hall : rectangle (R := R) (M := M) (I := I) q n ≤ ⨆ s, supportedTensors b s q n := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro z ⟨e, he, p, hp, rfl⟩
    rw [← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span_fixedDegree_of_span_eq_top R q M b.span_eq] at he
    induction he using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem e he =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := he
      have hv' : ∀ j, ∃ i, b i = v j := fun j => hv ⟨j, rfl⟩
      choose f hf using hv'
      let l := List.ofFn f
      have heq : ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R q v = basisWord b l := by
        simp only [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply, basisWord, l, List.map_ofFn]
        congr 2
        funext j
        exact congrArg (ι R) (hf j).symm
      rw [heq]
      apply Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem l.toFinset
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, p, by simp [l], fun i hi => by simpa using hi, hp, rfl⟩
    | zero => simp
    | add e f _ _ he hf => rw [add_tmul]; exact add_mem he hf
    | smul r e _ he => rw [← smul_tmul']; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r he
  apply (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ ?_).mp (hall hz)
  intro s t
  exact ⟨s ∪ t, supportedTensors_mono b q n Finset.subset_union_left,
    supportedTensors_mono b q n Finset.subset_union_right⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exists_common_support
statement:
theorem exists_common_support (b : Module.Basis I R M) (q n : ℕ)
    {z : EP} (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) :
    ∃ s, z ∈ supportedTensors b s q n ∧
      polynomialTop n z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_support_rectangle b q n hz
  have ht := polynomialTop_mem_iSup b q n n hz
  rw [iSup_homogeneousTensors] at ht
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_support_of_mem_homogeneous_span b n q ht
  exact ⟨s ∪ t, supportedTensors_mono b q n Finset.subset_union_left hs,
    homogeneousTensors_mono b n q Finset.subset_union_right ht⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.rectangle_mono
statement:
theorem rectangle_mono (q : ℕ) {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    rectangle (R := R) (M := M) (I := I) q n ≤ rectangle q m
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro z ⟨e, he, p, hp, rfl⟩
  apply tmul_mem_rectangle he
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree] at hp ⊢
  exact hp.trans hnm

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.cycle_lowering_of_isLeadingKoszul
statement:
theorem cycle_lowering_of_isLeadingKoszul (hD : IsLeadingKoszul b D) (hD2 : ∀ z, D (D z) = 0)
    (q n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) {z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q (n + 1)) (hcycle : D z = 0) :
    ∃ y ∈ rectangle (q + 1) n, z - D y ∈ rectangle q n ∧ D (z - D y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, ht⟩ := exists_common_support b q (n + 1) hz
  have htop := delta_polynomialTop_eq_zero b hD s q (n + 1) hs hcycle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩ := exists_homogeneous_primitive b s (n + 1) q
    (polynomialTop (n + 1) z) ht htop (by omega)
  have hy' : y ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n (q + 1) := by simpa using hy
  have herror := hD s (q + 1) n y (homogeneousTensors_le_supportedTensors b s n (q + 1) hy')
  rw [hdy, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at herror
  refine ⟨-y, neg_mem (homogeneousTensors_le_rectangle b s n (q + 1) hy'), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hlower := add_mem (sub_polynomialTop_mem q n hz) herror
    simpa only [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, sub_add_add_cancel] using hlower
  · simp only [map_sub, hD2, hcycle, sub_zero]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.cycle_eq_zero_of_isLeadingKoszul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, ht⟩ := exists_common_support b q 0 hz
  have htop := delta_polynomialTop_eq_zero b hD s q 0 hs hcycle
  rw [polynomialTop_zero_eq_self q hz] at ht htop
  exact eq_zero_of_cycle_polynomial_degree_zero b s q z ht htop hq

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exists_primitive_of_isLeadingKoszul
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_of_isLeadingKoszul (hD : IsLeadingKoszul b D)
    (hD2 : ∀ z, D (D z) = 0) (q n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    {z : ExteriorAlgebra K M ⊗[K] MvPolynomial I K}
    (hz : z ∈ rectangle q n) (hcycle : D z = 0) :
    ∃ y ∈ rectangle (q + 1) (n - 1), D y = z
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing z with
  | zero =>
    have heq := cycle_eq_zero_of_isLeadingKoszul b hD q hq hz hcycle
    exact ⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _, by simpa only [map_zero] using heq.symm⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hr, hrc⟩ := cycle_lowering_of_isLeadingKoszul b hD hD2 q n hq hz hcycle
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw⟩ := ih hr hrc
    refine ⟨y + w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Nat.succ_sub_one] using add_mem hy
        (rectangle_mono (q + 1) (Nat.sub_le n 1) hw)
    · rw [map_add, hdw]
      abel

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homogeneousTensors_mono
statement:
theorem homogeneousTensors_mono (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n q : ℕ)
    {s t : Finset I} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    homogeneousTensors b s n q ≤ homogeneousTensors b t n q
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro z ⟨l, p, hl, hs, hp, hv, hz⟩
  exact ⟨l, p, hl, fun i hi => hst (hs i hi), hp, hv.trans hst, hz⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.basisWord_mem_exteriorPower
statement:
theorem basisWord_mem_exteriorPower (b : Module.Basis I R M) (l : List I) :
    basisWord b l ∈ ⋀[R]^l.length M
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp [basisWord, exteriorPower]
  | cons i l ih =>
    simpa [basisWord, exteriorPower, pow_succ'] using
      Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self (ι R) (b i)) ih

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.iSup_homogeneousTensors
statement:
theorem iSup_homogeneousTensors (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n q : ℕ) :
    (⨆ s : Finset I, homogeneousTensors b s n q) =
      Submodule.span R {z | ∃ (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R),
        e ∈ ⋀[R]^q M ∧ p.IsHomogeneous n ∧ z = e ⊗ₜ[R] p}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun s => Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro z ⟨l, p, hl, _, hp, _, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨basisWord b l, p,
      hl ▸ basisWord_mem_exteriorPower b l, hp, rfl⟩
  · refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro z ⟨e, p, he, hp, rfl⟩
    rw [← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span_fixedDegree_of_span_eq_top R q M b.span_eq] at he
    induction he using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem e he =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := he
      have hv' : ∀ j, ∃ i, b i = v j := fun j => hv ⟨j, rfl⟩
      choose f hf using hv'
      let l := List.ofFn f
      have heq : ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R q v = basisWord b l := by
        simp only [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_apply, basisWord, l, List.map_ofFn]
        congr 2
        funext j
        exact congrArg (ι R) (hf j).symm
      rw [heq]
      apply Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (l.toFinset ∪ p.vars)
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      exact ⟨l, p, by simp [l], fun i hi => Finset.mem_union_left _ (by simpa),
        hp, Finset.subset_union_right, rfl⟩
    | zero => simp
    | add e f _ _ he hf =>
      rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul]
      exact add_mem he hf
    | smul r e _ he =>
      rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r he

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exists_support_of_mem_homogeneous_span
statement:
theorem exists_support_of_mem_homogeneous_span (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n q : ℕ)
    {z : ExteriorAlgebra R M ⊗[R] MvPolynomial I R}
    (hz : z ∈ Submodule.span R {z | ∃ (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R),
      e ∈ ⋀[R]^q M ∧ p.IsHomogeneous n ∧ z = e ⊗ₜ[R] p}) :
    ∃ s : Finset I, z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← iSup_homogeneousTensors b n q] at hz
  apply (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ ?_).mp hz
  intro s t
  exact ⟨s ∪ t, homogeneousTensors_mono b n q Finset.subset_union_left,
    homogeneousTensors_mono b n q Finset.subset_union_right⟩

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.wedge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wedge_apply (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i : I) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    wedge b i e = ι R (b i) * e
proof: := rfl

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.deltaTerm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deltaTerm_tmul (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    deltaTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p) = contract b i e ⊗ₜ[R] (MvPolynomial.X i * p)
proof: := rfl

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.homotopyTerm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homotopyTerm_tmul (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    homotopyTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p) = wedge b i e ⊗ₜ[R] MvPolynomial.pderiv i p
proof: := rfl

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.contract_wedge
statement:
theorem contract_wedge (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i j : I) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    contract b i (wedge b j e) = (b.coord i (b j)) • e - wedge b j (contract b i e)
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul _ _ _

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.term_anticommutator
statement:
theorem term_anticommutator (b : Module.Basis I R M) [DecidableEq I] (i j : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    deltaTerm b i (homotopyTerm b j (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) +
      homotopyTerm b j (deltaTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) =
    if i = j then e ⊗ₜ[R] (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.pderiv i p) +
      wedge b i (contract b i e) ⊗ₜ[R] p else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deltaTerm_tmul, homotopyTerm_tmul, contract_wedge,
    MvPolynomial.pderiv_mul, TensorProduct.sub_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_eq_same,
      one_smul, MvPolynomial.pderiv_X_self, one_mul, ite_true]
    abel
  · simp [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, h]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator_tmul
statement:
theorem anticommutator_tmul (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (p : MvPolynomial I R) :
    delta b s (homotopy b s (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) +
      homotopy b s (delta b s (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) =
    e ⊗ₜ[R] (∑ i ∈ s, MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.pderiv i p) +
      exteriorNumber b s e ⊗ₜ[R] p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [delta, homotopy, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun j i =>
    deltaTerm b i (homotopyTerm b j (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)))]
  simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, term_anticommutator]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, TensorProduct.tmul_sum, exteriorNumber,
    LinearMap.sum_apply, TensorProduct.sum_tmul]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.wedge_wedge
statement:
theorem wedge_wedge (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i j : I) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    wedge b i (wedge b j e) = -(wedge b j (wedge b i e))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wedge_apply, ← mul_assoc]
  rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (ι_add_mul_swap (b i) (b j)), neg_mul]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.wedge_contract_wedge
statement:
theorem wedge_contract_wedge (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i j : I)
    (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    wedge b i (contract b i (wedge b j e)) =
      b.coord i (b j) • wedge b i e + wedge b j (wedge b i (contract b i e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [contract_wedge, map_sub, map_smul, wedge_wedge, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exteriorNumber_wedge
statement:
theorem exteriorNumber_wedge (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (j : I) (hj : j ∈ s) (e : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    exteriorNumber b s (wedge b j e) =
      wedge b j e + wedge b j (exteriorNumber b s e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [exteriorNumber, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    wedge_contract_wedge, Finset.sum_add_distrib, map_sum]
  congr 1
  simp [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, hj]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.exteriorNumber_basisWord
statement:
theorem exteriorNumber_basisWord (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (l : List I) (hl : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ s) :
    exteriorNumber b s (basisWord b l) = l.length • basisWord b l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [basisWord, exteriorNumber, contract]
  | cons j l ih =>
    change exteriorNumber b s (wedge b j (basisWord b l)) =
      (l.length + 1) • wedge b j (basisWord b l)
    rw [exteriorNumber_wedge b s j (hl j (by simp)),
      ih (fun i hi => hl i (by simp [hi])), map_nsmul, add_smul, one_smul, add_comm]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator_basisWord
statement:
theorem anticommutator_basisWord (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I)
    (l : List I) (hl : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ s) (p : MvPolynomial I R) (n : ℕ)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous n) (hs : p.vars ⊆ s) :
    delta b s (homotopy b s (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p)) +
      homotopy b s (delta b s (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p)) =
    (n + l.length) • (basisWord b l ⊗ₜ[R] p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [anticommutator_tmul, hp.sum_X_mul_pderiv_of_vars_subset s hs,
    exteriorNumber_basisWord b s l hl, TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
    ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', ← add_smul]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator
statement:
theorem anticommutator (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I) :
    (delta b s).comp (homotopy b s) + (homotopy b s).comp (delta b s) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id
        (∑ i ∈ s, (LinearMap.mulLeft R (MvPolynomial.X i)).comp
          (MvPolynomial.pderiv i).toLinearMap) +
      TensorProduct.map (exteriorNumber b s) LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro e p
  simpa only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    Derivation.coeFn_coe] using
    anticommutator_tmul b s e p

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.deltaTerm_sq
statement:
theorem deltaTerm_sq (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i : I) :
    deltaTerm b i * deltaTerm b i = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro e p
  change deltaTerm b i (deltaTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) = 0
  simp [contract, CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_contractLeft]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.deltaTerm_anticomm
statement:
theorem deltaTerm_anticomm (b : Module.Basis I R M) (i j : I) :
    deltaTerm b i * deltaTerm b j = -(deltaTerm b j * deltaTerm b i)
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro e p
  change deltaTerm b i (deltaTerm b j (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)) =
    -(deltaTerm b j (deltaTerm b i (e ⊗ₜ[R] p)))
  simp only [deltaTerm_tmul, contract]
  rw [CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_comm, TensorProduct.neg_tmul, mul_left_comm]

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.delta_sq
statement:
theorem delta_sq (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I) :
    delta b s * delta b s = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [delta]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    have hc : deltaTerm b i * delta b s = -(delta b s * deltaTerm b i) := by
      simp only [delta, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      calc
        _ = ∑ j ∈ s, -(deltaTerm b j * deltaTerm b i) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => deltaTerm_anticomm b i j
        _ = _ := Finset.sum_neg_distrib (fun j => deltaTerm b j * deltaTerm b i)
    simp only [delta, Finset.sum_insert hi]
    change (deltaTerm b i + delta b s) * (deltaTerm b i + delta b s) = 0
    rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, deltaTerm_sq, ih, hc]
    abel

name: ExteriorAlgebra.Koszul.anticommutator_homogeneous
statement:
theorem anticommutator_homogeneous (b : Module.Basis I R M) (s : Finset I) (n q : ℕ)
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra R M ⊗[R] MvPolynomial I R)
    (hz : z ∈ homogeneousTensors b s n q) :
    delta b s (homotopy b s z) + homotopy b s (delta b s z) = (n + q) • z
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨l, p, hlq, hl, hp, hs, rfl⟩ := hz
    simpa only [hlq] using anticommutator_basisWord b s l hl p n hp hs
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    simpa only [map_add, nsmul_add, add_add_add_comm] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    simpa only [map_smul, smul_add, smul_comm a (n + q)] using congrArg (a • ·) hx

name: iSupIndep.mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [iSup_split_single F i, Submodule.mem_sup] at hx'
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx'
  have hb' : b ∈ G i := by
    have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hx (hFG i ha)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
  have hb'' : b ∈ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), G j := (iSup₂_mono fun j _ ↦ hFG j) hb
  have := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (hG i) b hb' hb''
  rwa [this, add_zero]

name: Module.End.mem_weightSpaceOf
statement:
lemma mem_weightSpaceOf {μ : Dual K H} {m : M} :
    m ∈ weightSpaceOf T μ ↔ ∀ a, T a m = μ a • m
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Module.End.mem_of_sum_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_sum_mem (N : Submodule K M) (hN : ∀ a, ∀ m ∈ N, T a m ∈ N)
    (s : Finset (Dual K H)) (x : Dual K H → M) (hx : ∀ μ ∈ s, x μ ∈ weightSpaceOf T μ)
    (hsum : ∑ μ ∈ s, x μ ∈ N) : ∀ μ ∈ s, x μ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing x with
  | empty => simp
  | insert β s hβ ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hβ] at hsum
    have hs : ∀ γ ∈ s, x γ ∈ N := by
      intro γ hγ
      have hne : γ ≠ β := fun h ↦ hβ (h ▸ hγ)
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, γ a ≠ β a := by
        by_contra! h'; exact hne (LinearMap.ext h')
      let y : Dual K H → M := fun μ ↦ (μ a - β a) • x μ
      have hy : ∀ μ ∈ s, y μ ∈ weightSpaceOf T μ := fun μ hμ ↦
        Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hx μ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hμ))
      have hysum : ∑ μ ∈ s, y μ ∈ N := by
        have h1 := N.sub_mem (hN a _ hsum) (N.smul_mem (β a) hsum)
        convert h1 using 1
        simp only [map_add, map_sum, smul_add, Finset.smul_sum, y, sub_smul]
        rw [(hx β (Finset.mem_insert_self β s)) a, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ hμ ↦ (hx μ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hμ)) a]
        abel
      have := ih y hy hysum γ hγ
      have hc : γ a - β a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr ha
      simpa [y, hc] using N.smul_mem (γ a - β a)⁻¹ this
    intro μ hμ
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hμ with rfl | hμ
    · have := N.sub_mem hsum (N.sum_mem hs)
      simpa using this
    · exact hs μ hμ

name: Module.End.inf_iSup_weightSpaceOf_le
statement:
theorem inf_iSup_weightSpaceOf_le (N : Submodule K M) (hN : ∀ a, ∀ m ∈ N, T a m ∈ N) :
    N ⊓ ⨆ μ, weightSpaceOf T μ ≤ ⨆ μ, (N ⊓ weightSpaceOf T μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨hmN, hm⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.mp hm
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset] at hm
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hm
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum] at hs
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hs
  have hmem := mem_of_sum_mem T N hN s (fun μ ↦ x μ) (fun μ _ ↦ (x μ).2) hmN
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun μ hμ ↦ Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem μ ⟨hmem μ hμ, (x μ).2⟩

name: Module.End.iSupIndep_weightSpaceOf
statement: theorem iSupIndep_weightSpaceOf : iSupIndep fun μ : Dual K H ↦ weightSpaceOf T μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro μ
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro m hm hm'
  have hm'' : m ∈ ⨆ ν ∈ {ν | ν ≠ μ}, weightSpaceOf T ν := by simpa using hm'
  rw [← iSup_subtype'', Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset] at hm''
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hm''
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum] at hs
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
  let s' : Finset (Dual K H) := insert μ (s.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _))
  have hμs : μ ∉ s.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _) := by simp
  let x' : Dual K H → M := fun ν ↦
    if h : ν = μ then -m else if h' : ν ≠ μ then (x ⟨ν, h'⟩ : M) else 0
  have hx' : ∀ ν ∈ s', x' ν ∈ weightSpaceOf T ν := by
    intro ν hν
    by_cases h : ν = μ
    · subst h; simpa [x'] using Submodule.neg_mem _ hm
    · simp [x', h]
  have hsum : ∑ ν ∈ s', x' ν = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hμs, Finset.sum_map]
    have h1 : ∀ ν ∈ s, x' ((Function.Embedding.subtype _) ν) = (x ν : M) := by
      intro ν _
      have hν : (ν : Dual K H) ≠ μ := ν.2
      simp [x', hν]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, hx]
    simp [x']
  have := mem_of_sum_mem T ⊥ (by simp) s' x' hx' (hsum ▸ Submodule.zero_mem _)
    μ (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  simpa [x'] using this

name: Module.End.mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le
proof:
:=
  (iSupIndep_weightSpaceOf T).mem_of_mem_iSup_of_le hN hx hx'

name: FilteredLinearMap.exists_preimage_mem_of_graded_exact
statement:
theorem exists_preimage_mem_of_graded_exact
    (F : ℕ → Submodule R A) (G : ℕ → Submodule R B) (H : ℕ → Submodule R C)
    (hF : Monotone F) (hG0 : G 0 = ⊥)
    (f : A →ₗ[R] B) (g : B →ₗ[R] C) (hgf : g.comp f = 0)
    (hf : ∀ p, ∀ x ∈ F p, f x ∈ G p)
    (hg : ∀ p, ∀ x ∈ G p, g x ∈ H p)
    (hex : ∀ p, LinearMap.range (gradedMap F G f hf p) =
      LinearMap.ker (gradedMap G H g hg p))
    (p : ℕ) (x : B) (hx : x ∈ G p) (hcycle : g x = 0) :
    ∃ y ∈ F p, f y = x
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing x with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa [hG0] using hx
    exact ⟨0, (F 0).zero_mem, by simp [hx0]⟩
  | succ p ih =>
    let x' : G (p + 1) := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hsymbol : (Submodule.Quotient.mk x' : grade G p) ∈
        LinearMap.ker (gradedMap G H g hg p) := by
      change Submodule.Quotient.mk (levelMap G H g hg (p + 1) x') = 0
      apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
      change g x ∈ H p
      rw [hcycle]
      exact (H p).zero_mem
    rw [← hex p] at hsymbol
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsymbol
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
      ((F p).comap (F (p + 1)).subtype).mkQ_surjective v
    have hlead : f y - x ∈ G p := by
      rw [← hy] at hv
      change Submodule.Quotient.mk (levelMap F G f hf (p + 1) y) =
        Submodule.Quotient.mk x' at hv
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq ((G p).comap (G (p + 1)).subtype)).mp hv
    have hrem : g (x - f y) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, hcycle]
      have hz : g (f y) = 0 := LinearMap.congr_fun hgf y
      rw [hz, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := ih (x - f y)
      (by simpa only [neg_sub] using (G p).neg_mem hlead) hrem
    refine ⟨(y : A) + z, (F (p + 1)).add_mem y.property
      (hF (Nat.le_succ p) hz), ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, hdz, add_sub_cancel]

name: FilteredLinearMap.range_eq_ker_of_graded_exact
statement:
theorem range_eq_ker_of_graded_exact
    (F : ℕ → Submodule R A) (G : ℕ → Submodule R B) (H : ℕ → Submodule R C)
    (hF : Monotone F) (hG0 : G 0 = ⊥) (hGexhaustive : ∀ x, ∃ p, x ∈ G p)
    (f : A →ₗ[R] B) (g : B →ₗ[R] C) (hgf : g.comp f = 0)
    (hf : ∀ p, ∀ x ∈ F p, f x ∈ G p)
    (hg : ∀ p, ∀ x ∈ G p, g x ∈ H p)
    (hex : ∀ p, LinearMap.range (gradedMap F G f hf p) =
      LinearMap.ker (gradedMap G H g hg p)) :
    LinearMap.range f = LinearMap.ker g
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hgf x
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hGexhaustive x
    obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ :=
      exists_preimage_mem_of_graded_exact F G H hF hG0 f g hgf hf hg hex p x hp hx
    exact ⟨y, hy⟩

name: MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_int_eq_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_int_eq_zero [Finite ι] (P : MvPolynomial ι K)
    (h : ∀ y : ι → ℤ, eval (fun j ↦ (y j : K)) P = 0) : P = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  refine eq_zero_of_eval_zero_at_prod_finset P
    (fun j ↦ (Finset.range (P.degreeOf j + 1)).image (fun k : ℕ ↦ (k : K))) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Nat.cast_injective, Finset.card_range]
    omega
  · choose k hk using fun j ↦ Finset.mem_image.mp (hx j)
    have hxk : x = fun j ↦ ((k j : ℤ) : K) := funext fun j ↦ by simp [(hk j).2]
    rw [hxk]
    exact h _

name: LinearMap.not_injective_add_sum_smul_of_forall_int
statement:
theorem not_injective_add_sum_smul_of_forall_int (A : N →ₗ[K] V) (B : ι → N →ₗ[K] V)
    {D : MvPolynomial ι K} (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ y : ι → ℤ, eval (fun j ↦ (y j : K)) D ≠ 0 →
      ¬Function.Injective (A + ∑ j, (y j : K) • B j))
    (y : ι → K) : ¬Function.Injective (A + ∑ j, y j • B j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hinj
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := (A + ∑ j, y j • B j).exists_leftInverse_of_injective
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hinj)
  set b := Module.finBasis K N
  let M : Matrix _ _ (MvPolynomial ι K) :=
    (LinearMap.toMatrix b b (φ ∘ₗ A)).map C +
      ∑ j, (X j : MvPolynomial ι K) • (LinearMap.toMatrix b b (φ ∘ₗ B j)).map C
  have heval : ∀ z : ι → K,
      eval z M.det = LinearMap.det (φ ∘ₗ (A + ∑ j, z j • B j)) := by
    intro z
    have hc : φ ∘ₗ (A + ∑ j, z j • B j) = φ ∘ₗ A + ∑ j, z j • (φ ∘ₗ B j) := by
      ext m
      simp
    rw [hc, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, RingHom.map_det]
    congr 1
    ext p q
    simp only [M, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_add, map_sum, map_mul, eval_C, eval_X, map_smul]
  have hint : ∀ z : ι → ℤ, eval (fun j ↦ (z j : K)) (M.det * D) = 0 := by
    intro z
    rw [map_mul, heval]
    by_cases hz : eval (fun j ↦ (z j : K)) D = 0
    · rw [hz, mul_zero]
    · refine mul_eq_zero_of_left ?_ _
      by_contra hdet
      have hu : IsUnit (φ ∘ₗ (A + ∑ j, (z j : K) • B j)) :=
        (LinearMap.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (Ne.isUnit hdet)
      exact h z hz (Function.Injective.of_comp
        (f := φ) ((Module.End.isUnit_iff _).mp hu).injective)
  have h0 : M.det * D = 0 := MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_int_eq_zero _ hint
  have hM : M.det = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_right hD
  have := heval y
  rw [hM, map_zero, hφ, LinearMap.det_id] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: Module.Basis.span_eq_top_of_unitriangular
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_of_unitriangular
    (h : ∀ i, c i - e i ∈ Submodule.span R (e '' {j | f j < f i})) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range c) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n i, f i = n → e i ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range c) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ n ih =>
      intro i hi
      have hle : Submodule.span R (e '' {j | f j < f i}) ≤ Submodule.span R (Set.range c) :=
        Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨j, hj, hje⟩ ↦ hje ▸ ih (f j) (hi ▸ hj) j rfl
      rw [← sub_sub_cancel (c i) (e i)]
      exact sub_mem (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩) (hle (h i))
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← e.span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact key _ i rfl

name: Module.Basis.repr_apply_of_unitriangular
statement:
lemma repr_apply_of_unitriangular
    (h : ∀ i, c i - e i ∈ Submodule.span R (e '' {j | f j < f i})) {i j : ι} (hij : f j ≤ f i) :
    e.repr (c j) i = Finsupp.single j 1 i
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : e.repr (c j - e j) i = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have := (e.mem_span_image.1 (h j)) (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hne)
    exact absurd hij (not_le.2 this)
  rwa [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero, e.repr_self] at h1

name: Module.Basis.linearIndependent_of_unitriangular
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_of_unitriangular
    (h : ∀ i, c i - e i ∈ Submodule.span R (e '' {j | f j < f i})) : LinearIndependent R c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg i hi
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmax⟩ := (s.filter fun j ↦ g j ≠ 0).exists_max_image f ⟨i, by simp [hi, hne]⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hm
  have h0 := congrArg (fun x ↦ e.repr x m) hg
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at h0
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m (fun j hj hjm ↦ ?_) (fun h ↦ absurd hm.1 h),
    repr_apply_of_unitriangular e h le_rfl, Finsupp.single_eq_same, mul_one] at h0
  · exact hm.2 h0
  · by_cases hj0 : g j = 0
    · rw [hj0, zero_mul]
    · rw [repr_apply_of_unitriangular e h (hmax j (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, hj0⟩)),
        Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right hjm, mul_zero]

name: Module.Basis.ofUnitriangular_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofUnitriangular_apply
    (h : ∀ i, c i - e i ∈ Submodule.span R (e '' {j | f j < f i})) (i : ι) :
    e.ofUnitriangular h i = c i
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _

name: Rat.eventually_not_exists_int_add_mul
statement:
theorem Rat.eventually_not_exists_int_add_mul {a b : ℚ} (h : (¬∃ z : ℤ, a = z) ∨ b ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℚ), ¬∃ z : ℤ, a + ε * b = z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : ∃ z : ℤ, a = z
  · obtain ⟨z₀, rfl⟩ := ha
    have hb : b ≠ 0 := h.resolve_left (not_not.mpr ⟨z₀, rfl⟩)
    have hb' : 0 < |b| := abs_pos.mpr hb
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (inv_pos.mpr hb')] with ε hε
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    have h1 : ε * b = ((z - z₀ : ℤ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; linarith
    have h2 : |ε * b| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε.1]
      calc ε * |b| < |b|⁻¹ * |b| := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hε.2 hb'
        _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hb'.ne'
    have h3 : ε * b ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hε.1.ne' hb
    rw [h1] at h2 h3
    have h4 : |z - z₀| < 1 := by
      rw [← Int.cast_abs] at h2
      exact_mod_cast h2
    exact h3 (by rw [Int.abs_lt_one_iff.mp h4, Int.cast_zero])
  · have hlt : (⌊a⌋ : ℚ) < a := lt_of_le_of_ne (Int.floor_le a) fun h ↦ ha ⟨_, h.symm⟩
    have hlt' : a < ⌊a⌋ + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one a
    have hcont : Continuous fun ε : ℚ ↦ a + ε * b := by fun_prop
    have hmem : (fun ε : ℚ ↦ a + ε * b) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (⌊a⌋ : ℚ) (⌊a⌋ + 1) ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℚ) :=
      hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
        (show Set.Ioo (⌊a⌋ : ℚ) (⌊a⌋ + 1) ∈ 𝓝 (a + 0 * b) by
          rw [zero_mul, add_zero]; exact Ioo_mem_nhds hlt hlt')
    filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds hmem] with ε hε
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioo, hz] at hε
    have h1 : ⌊a⌋ < z := by exact_mod_cast hε.1
    have h2 : z < ⌊a⌋ + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hε.2
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.isIntegralRoot_iff_corootPairing

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_apply

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing

name: Matrix.Realization.inv_apply_apply

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_inv_apply

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_int_corootPairing_of_mem_rootLattice
