name: Matrix.Realization.reflectionOf_apply'
statement:
lemma reflectionOf_apply' (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) (x : Dual K H) :
    (P.reflectionOf hA v i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x =
      x - P.corootPairing hA x v i • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
proof:
:=
  P.reflectionOf_apply hA v i x

name: Matrix.Realization.reflectionOf_mul_self
statement:
lemma reflectionOf_mul_self (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.reflectionOf hA v i * P.reflectionOf hA v i = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : (⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ : P.weylGroup hA) *
      ⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ = 1 :=
    Subtype.ext (P.reflection_mul_self hA i)
  simp only [reflectionOf]
  calc v * ⟨P.reflection hA i, _⟩ * v⁻¹ * (v * ⟨P.reflection hA i, _⟩ * v⁻¹)
      = v * (⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ *
          ⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩) * v⁻¹ := by group
    _ = 1 := by rw [this, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_mul_simple
statement:
lemma corootPairing_mul_simple (x : Dual K H) (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.corootPairing hA x (v * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) i = -P.corootPairing hA x v i
proof:
:= by
  unfold corootPairing
  rw [Subgroup.coe_inv, Subgroup.coe_mul, _root_.mul_inv_rev, coxeterSystem_simple, reflection_inv,
    LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply, Subgroup.coe_inv]
  simp [P.root_coroot_self hA]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.mul_simple_apply_root
statement:
lemma mul_simple_apply_root (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    ((v * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (P.root i) = -(v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply,
    P.root_coroot_self hA]
  rw [show P.root i - (2 : K) • P.root i = -P.root i by module, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_or
statement:
lemma isPosRoot_or (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.IsPosRoot hA v i ∨ P.IsPosRoot hA (v * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) i
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos hA v.2 i with ⟨k, hk, h⟩ | ⟨k, hk, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hk, h⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨k, hk, by rw [mul_simple_apply_root, h, neg_neg]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.not_isPosRoot_and
statement:
lemma not_isPosRoot_and {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} (h₁ : P.IsPosRoot hA v i)
    (h₂ : P.IsPosRoot hA (v * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) i) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ := h₂
  rw [mul_simple_apply_root] at hl'
  have h0 := P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem
    ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨k, hk, hk'.symm⟩)
    ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨l, hl, hl'.symm⟩)
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at h0
  exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i h0

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent
statement:
lemma isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} :
    P.IsPosRoot hA v i ↔ ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff]
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.length_mul_reflectionOf_lt
statement:
theorem length_mul_reflectionOf_lt {w v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i)
    (hw : ¬P.IsPosRoot hA (w * v) i) :
    (P.coxeterSystem hA).length (w * P.reflectionOf hA v i) <
      (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ω, hωr, rfl⟩ := (P.coxeterSystem hA).exists_isReduced w
  obtain ⟨ν, hνr, rfl⟩ := (P.coxeterSystem hA).exists_isReduced v
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := (isPosRoot_or _ i).resolve_left hw
  rw [mul_simple_apply_root] at hk'
  have hlin : (((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd (ω ++ ν) : P.weylGroup hA) :
      Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) = ((ω ++ ν).map (P.reflection hA)).prod :=
    P.coxeterSystem_wordProd hA _
  have hprod : ((ω ++ ν).map (P.reflection hA)).prod (P.root i) = -P.rootOf k := by
    rw [← hlin, (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd_append, ← hk', neg_neg]
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hse⟩ := P.exists_mul_reflection_eq_eraseIdx hA (ω ++ ν) hk hprod
  rw [← hlin, ← P.coxeterSystem_wordProd hA, (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd_append] at hse
  have hr : P.reflectionOf hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν) i =
      (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i *
        ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [reflectionOf]
    congr 2
  by_cases hsω : s < ω.length
  · rw [List.eraseIdx_append_of_lt_length hsω] at hse
    have h3 : (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω * (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν *
        (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i =
        (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd (ω.eraseIdx s) * (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul _ _ ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i), coxeterSystem_simple, hse,
        (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd_append]
    rw [hr, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, h3, mul_assoc, _root_.mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    calc (P.coxeterSystem hA).length ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd (ω.eraseIdx s))
        ≤ (ω.eraseIdx s).length := (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_wordProd_le _
      _ < ω.length := by rw [List.length_eraseIdx_of_lt hsω]; omega
      _ = (P.coxeterSystem hA).length ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω) := hωr.symm
  · exfalso
    rw [not_lt] at hsω
    rw [List.eraseIdx_append_of_length_le hsω] at hse
    have hs' : s - ω.length < ν.length := by
      simp only [List.length_append] at hs; omega
    have h3 : (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω * ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν *
        (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) =
        (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω *
          (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd (ν.eraseIdx (s - ω.length)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [← mul_assoc, Subgroup.coe_mul _ _ ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i), coxeterSystem_simple,
        hse, (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd_append]
    have heq := mul_left_cancel h3
    have hdesc : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν) i := by
      unfold IsRightDescent
      rw [heq]
      calc (P.coxeterSystem hA).length
            ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd (ν.eraseIdx (s - ω.length)))
          ≤ (ν.eraseIdx (s - ω.length)).length := (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_wordProd_le _
        _ < ν.length := by rw [List.length_eraseIdx_of_lt hs']; omega
        _ = (P.coxeterSystem hA).length ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ν) := hνr.symm
    exact (isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent.mp hv) hdesc

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_zero_of_mem_rootLattice_of_corootPairing
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_rootLattice_of_corootPairing (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : μ ∈ P.rootLattice)
    (h : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i →
      P.corootPairing hA μ v i = 0 ∨ P.corootPairing hA μ v i = 1) :
    μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hall : ∀ v i, P.corootPairing hA μ v i = -1 ∨ P.corootPairing hA μ v i = 0 ∨
      P.corootPairing hA μ v i = 1 := by
    intro v i
    rcases isPosRoot_or v i with hv | hv
    · rcases h v i hv with h0 | h1
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h0)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h1)
    · have hm := corootPairing_mul_simple μ v i
      rcases h _ i hv with h0 | h1
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by linear_combination hm - h0))
      · exact Or.inl (by linear_combination hm - h1)
  
  have horb : ∀ (u : P.weylGroup hA) (k : ι → ℤ), (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k →
      ∀ j, (A *ᵥ k) j = -1 ∨ (A *ᵥ k) j = 0 ∨ (A *ᵥ k) j = 1 := by
    intro u k huk j
    have e := apply_coroot_eq_corootPairing u μ j
    rw [huk, rootOf_apply_coroot] at e
    rcases hall u⁻¹ j with h' | h' | h' <;> rw [← e] at h'
    · exact Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast h')
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast h'))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by exact_mod_cast h'))
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ u : P.weylGroup hA, ∃ k : ι → ℤ,
      (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k ∧ ∑ j, (k j).natAbs = n := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (P.mem_rootLattice).mp hμ
    exact ⟨_, 1, k, by rw [OneMemClass.coe_one, LinearEquiv.coe_one, id, hk], rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, k, huk, hkn⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hkey : ∀ j, (A *ᵥ k) j * k j ≤ 0 := by
    intro j
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    have hj := horb u k huk j
    set k' : ι → ℤ := k - (A *ᵥ k) j • Pi.single j 1 with hk'
    have hu' : (((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j * u : P.weylGroup hA) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k' := by
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, huk, reflection_rootOf]
    have hle := Nat.find_min' hex ⟨_, k', hu', rfl⟩
    have hlt' : ∑ l, (k' l).natAbs < ∑ l, (k l).natAbs := by
      refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun l _ ↦ ?_) ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      · by_cases hl : l = j
        · subst hl
          simp only [hk', Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
          rcases hj with h' | h' | h' <;> rw [h'] at hlt ⊢ <;> omega
        · simp [hk', hl]
      · simp only [hk', Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
        rcases hj with h' | h' | h' <;> rw [h'] at hlt ⊢ <;> omega
    omega
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hq : star k ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k = ∑ j, k j * (d j * (A *ᵥ k) j) := by
    simp [dotProduct, ← mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_diagonal]
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    rw [hq] at h1
    have h2 : ∑ j, k j * (d j * (A *ᵥ k) j) ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun j _ ↦ by
      have := hkey j
      have := hdpos j
      nlinarith
    omega
  rw [hk0, map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at huk
  exact huk

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_sum
statement:
lemma corootPairing_sum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → Dual ℚ H) (v : P.weylGroup hA)
    (i : ι) : P.corootPairing hA (∑ a ∈ s, f a) v i = ∑ a ∈ s, P.corootPairing hA (f a) v i
proof:
:= by
  simp [corootPairing, map_sum]

name: Matrix.Realization.natCast_smul_mem_rootLattice
statement:
lemma natCast_smul_mem_rootLattice {μ : Dual ℚ H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.rootLattice) (N : ℕ) :
    (N : ℚ) • μ ∈ P.rootLattice
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  exact nsmul_mem hμ N

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_sub_smul
statement:
lemma bilinForm_sub_smul {B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ (Dual ℚ H)} {d : ι → ℤ}
    (hBs : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (hBr : ∀ x (v : P.weylGroup hA) i,
      B x ((v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) = d i * P.corootPairing hA x v i)
    (a : Dual ℚ H) (t : ℚ) (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    B (a - t • (v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i))
        (a - t • (v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) =
      B a a + 2 * d i * t * (t - P.corootPairing hA a v i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hBr a v i
  have h2 := hBr ((v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) v i
  have h3 : P.corootPairing hA ((v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) v i = 2 := by
    rw [corootPairing, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, _root_.inv_mul_cancel]
    exact P.root_coroot_self hA i
  rw [h3] at h2
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hBs ((v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) a, h1, h2]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_bilinForm
statement:
lemma exists_bilinForm (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) :
    ∃ (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ (Dual ℚ H)) (d : ι → ℤ), (∀ i, 0 < d i) ∧
      (∀ x y, B x y = B y x) ∧
      (∀ x (v : P.weylGroup hA) i,
        B x ((v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) = d i * P.corootPairing hA x v i) ∧
      (∀ k x, B (P.rootOf k) x = ∑ i, ((k i * d i : ℤ) : ℚ) * x (P.coroot i)) ∧
      (∀ k, ∃ n : ℕ, B (P.rootOf k) (P.rootOf k) = n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  have hroot := P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm
  refine ⟨P.dualBilinForm S, d, hdpos, fun x y ↦ (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq x y, ?_, hroot, ?_⟩
  · intro x v i
    have e : ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H)
        ((v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) = P.root i := by
      rw [← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, _root_.inv_mul_cancel]
      rfl
    rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S (v⁻¹).2 x, e, dualBilinForm_root_right]
    simp only [S, Symmetrization.ofDiagonal, corootPairing, Rat.cast_id]
    have hi : (d i : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hdpos i).ne'
    field_simp
  · intro k
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∑ i, k i * (d i * (A *ᵥ k) i) := by
      have hq : star k ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k = ∑ i, k i * (d i * (A *ᵥ k) i) := by
        simp [dotProduct, ← mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_diagonal]
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp [hk]
      · rw [← hq]; exact (hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hk).le
    refine ⟨(∑ i, k i * (d i * (A *ᵥ k) i)).toNat, ?_⟩
    rw [hroot]
    simp_rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
    have : (((∑ i, k i * (d i * (A *ᵥ k) i)).toNat : ℤ) : ℚ) =
        ((∑ i, k i * (d i * (A *ᵥ k) i) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn]
    rw [Int.cast_natCast] at this
    rw [this]
    push_cast
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by ring

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_pos
statement:
lemma corootPairing_pos (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) {x : Dual ℚ H} (hx : ∀ j, 0 < x (P.coroot j))
    {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) : 0 < P.corootPairing hA x v i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, d, hd, hBs, hBr, hBk, -⟩ := exists_bilinForm (P := P) (hA := hA) hF
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hvk⟩ := hv
  have h := hBr x v i
  rw [hvk, hBs, hBk] at h
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hvk
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hvk
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk0
  have hkj : 0 < k j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hk j) (Ne.symm hj)
  have hsum : 0 < ∑ l, ((k l * d l : ℤ) : ℚ) * x (P.coroot l) := by
    refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun l _ ↦ mul_nonneg ?_ (hx l).le) ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    · exact_mod_cast mul_nonneg (hk l) (hd l).le
    · exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast mul_pos hkj (hd j)) (hx j)
  rw [h] at hsum
  exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (by exact_mod_cast hd i)).mp hsum

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_nsmul_mem_rootLattice
statement:
lemma exists_nsmul_mem_rootLattice (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) (μ : Dual ℚ H) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (N : ℚ) • μ ∈ P.rootLattice
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hμ : μ ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range P.root) := by
    rw [P.span_root_eq_top_of_isFiniteCartan hF]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℚ).mp hμ
  refine ⟨∏ i, (c i).den, Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ (c i).den_pos, ?_⟩
  have hdiv : ∀ i, ∃ m : ℤ, ((∏ j, (c j).den : ℕ) : ℚ) * c i = m := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun j ↦ (c j).den) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    refine ⟨m * (c i).num, ?_⟩
    rw [hm]
    push_cast
    rw [← Rat.mul_den_eq_num]
    ring
  choose m hm using hdiv
  refine (P.mem_rootLattice).mpr ⟨m, ?_⟩
  rw [rootOf_apply, ← hc, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_smul, hm]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_mem_openAlcove
statement:
lemma exists_mem_openAlcove (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) :
    ∃ z₀ : Dual ℚ H, ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i →
      0 < P.corootPairing hA z₀ v i ∧ P.corootPairing hA z₀ v i < 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hA) := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (Set.finite_range fun p : P.weylGroup hA × ι ↦
    P.corootPairing hA P.rho p.1 p.2).bddAbove
  refine ⟨(max M 0 + 1)⁻¹ • P.rho, fun v i hv ↦ ?_⟩
  have hρ := corootPairing_pos hF (x := P.rho) (fun j ↦ by rw [rho_coroot]; exact one_pos) hv
  have hle : P.corootPairing hA P.rho v i ≤ max M 0 :=
    (hM ⟨(v, i), rfl⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  rw [corootPairing_smul]
  have hM1 : 0 < max M 0 + 1 := by have := le_max_right M 0; linarith
  refine ⟨mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hM1) hρ, ?_⟩
  rw [inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hM1]
  linarith

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_mem_closedAlcove
statement:
theorem exists_mem_closedAlcove (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) (x : Dual ℚ H) :
    ∃ u : P.weylGroup hA, ∃ δ ∈ P.rootLattice, ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i →
      0 ≤ P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) v i ∧
        P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) v i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, d, hd, hBs, hBr, -, hBn⟩ := exists_bilinForm (P := P) (hA := hA) hF
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀α⟩ := exists_mem_openAlcove (P := P) (hA := hA) hF
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, hxN⟩ := exists_nsmul_mem_rootLattice (P := P) hF x
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, hzN⟩ := exists_nsmul_mem_rootLattice (P := P) hF z₀
  have hNx : ((N₁ * N₂ : ℕ) : ℚ) • x ∈ P.rootLattice := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact natCast_smul_mem_rootLattice hxN N₂
  have hNz : ((N₁ * N₂ : ℕ) : ℚ) • z₀ ∈ P.rootLattice := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul]
    exact natCast_smul_mem_rootLattice hzN N₁
  have hNpos : 0 < N₁ * N₂ := Nat.mul_pos hN₁ hN₂
  generalize N₁ * N₂ = N at hNx hNz hNpos
  
  let O : Dual ℚ H → Prop := fun y ↦
    ∃ u : P.weylGroup hA, ∃ δ ∈ P.rootLattice, y = (u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ
  have hval : ∀ y, O y → ∃ n : ℕ, B ((N : ℚ) • (y - z₀)) ((N : ℚ) • (y - z₀)) = n := by
    rintro y ⟨u, δ, hδ, rfl⟩
    have hmem : (N : ℚ) • ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ - z₀) ∈ P.rootLattice := by
      rw [smul_sub, smul_add, ← map_smul]
      exact sub_mem (add_mem (P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA u.2 hNx)
        (natCast_smul_mem_rootLattice hδ N)) hNz
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (P.mem_rootLattice).mp hmem
    rw [← hk]
    exact hBn k
  have hxO : O x := ⟨1, 0, zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ y, O y ∧ B ((N : ℚ) • (y - z₀)) ((N : ℚ) • (y - z₀)) = n := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hval x hxO
    exact ⟨n, x, hxO, hn⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hyO, hyn⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hsq : ∀ a : Dual ℚ H, B ((N : ℚ) • a) ((N : ℚ) • a) = (N : ℚ) ^ 2 * B a a := fun a ↦ by
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hmin : ∀ y', O y' → B (y - z₀) (y - z₀) ≤ B (y' - z₀) (y' - z₀) := by
    intro y' hy'
    obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := hval y' hy'
    have hle : (Nat.find hex : ℚ) ≤ n' := by exact_mod_cast Nat.find_min' hex ⟨y', hy', hn'⟩
    rw [hsq] at hn'
    have hN0 : (0 : ℚ) < (N : ℚ) ^ 2 := by
      have : (0 : ℚ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hNpos
      positivity
    refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hN0
    rw [← hsq, hyn, hn']
    exact hle
  obtain ⟨u, δ, hδ, rfl⟩ := hyO
  refine ⟨u, δ, hδ, fun v i hv ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hz0, hz1⟩ := hz₀α v i hv
  
  have hO : ∀ n : ℤ, O ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ -
      (P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) v i - n) •
        (v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i)) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨P.reflectionOf hA v i * u,
      (P.reflectionOf hA v i : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) δ +
        (n : ℚ) • (v : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (P.root i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := hv
      refine add_mem (P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA (P.reflectionOf hA v i).2 hδ) ?_
      rw [hk, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, ← map_zsmul]
      exact P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice _
    · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', reflectionOf_apply',
        corootPairing_add]
      module
  have hstep : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ 2 * d i *
      (P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) v i - n) *
        (P.corootPairing hA z₀ v i - n) := by
    intro n
    have h := hmin _ (hO n)
    rw [sub_right_comm, bilinForm_sub_smul hBs hBr, corootPairing_sub] at h
    linarith
  have hdi : (0 : ℚ) < d i := by exact_mod_cast hd i
  constructor
  · by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    have := hstep 0
    push_cast at this
    nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hdi hz0) (neg_pos.mpr hlt)]
  · by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    have := hstep 1
    push_cast at this
    nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hdi (sub_pos.mpr hlt)) (sub_pos.mpr hz1)]

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_mem_openAlcove
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_mem_openAlcove (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) {x : Dual ℚ H}
    (hx : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i →
      0 < P.corootPairing hA x v i ∧ P.corootPairing hA x v i < 1)
    {w : P.weylGroup hA} (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA x) : w = 1
proof:
:= by
  set γ := (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x - x with hγ
  have hγQ : γ ∈ P.rootLattice := hw
  have hwx : (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x = x + γ := by rw [hγ]; abel
  have hγ01 : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i →
      P.corootPairing hA (-γ) v i = 0 ∨ P.corootPairing hA (-γ) v i = 1 := by
    intro v i hv
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_int_corootPairing_of_mem_rootLattice hγQ v i
    have hb : -1 < P.corootPairing hA ((w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x) v i ∧
        P.corootPairing hA ((w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x) v i < 1 := by
      rw [corootPairing_apply]
      rcases isPosRoot_or (w⁻¹ * v) i with h | h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx _ i h
        constructor <;> linarith
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx _ i h
        rw [corootPairing_mul_simple] at h1 h2
        constructor <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hx v i hv
    rw [hwx, corootPairing_add, hn] at h1 h2
    have hn1 : -2 < n := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (-2 : ℚ) < n)
    have hn2 : n < 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (n : ℚ) < 1)
    rw [corootPairing_neg, hn]
    rcases (by omega : n = 0 ∨ n = -1) with rfl | rfl
    · left; simp
    · right; simp
  have hγ0 := eq_zero_of_mem_rootLattice_of_corootPairing hF (neg_mem hγQ) hγ01
  have hfix : (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x = x := by
    rw [neg_eq_zero, hγ, sub_eq_zero] at hγ0
    exact hγ0
  have hpos : ∀ j, 0 < x (P.coroot j) := fun j ↦ by
    have h1 : P.IsPosRoot hA 1 j :=
      ⟨Pi.single j 1, fun l ↦ by by_cases h : l = j <;> simp [h], by simp⟩
    simpa using (hx 1 j h1).1
  exact Subtype.ext (P.eq_one_of_apply_eq_self_of_forall_pos hA hpos w.2 hfix)

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_forall_not_isIntegralRoot
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, δ, hδ, hy⟩ := exists_mem_closedAlcove (P := P) (hA := hA) hF x
  have hyo : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i →
      0 < P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) v i ∧
        P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) v i < 1 := by
    intro v i hv
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hy v i hv
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_int_corootPairing_of_mem_rootLattice hδ v i
    have hne : ∀ m : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) v i ≠ m := by
      intro m hm
      apply hx (u⁻¹ * v) i
      refine ⟨m - n, ?_⟩
      change P.corootPairing hA x (u⁻¹ * v) i = _
      rw [corootPairing_add, hn, corootPairing_apply] at hm
      push_cast
      linarith
    exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne h0 fun h ↦ hne 0 (by rw [← h]; simp),
      lt_of_le_of_ne h1 fun h ↦ hne 1 (by rw [h]; simp)⟩
  have hw' : u * w * u⁻¹ ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup]
    have e : ((u * w * u⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H)
        ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) - ((u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x + δ) =
        (u : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) ((w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x - x) +
          (((u * w * u⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) δ - δ) := by
      simp only [map_add, map_sub, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, inv_apply_apply]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA u.2 hw)
      (sub_mem (P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA (u * w * u⁻¹).2 hδ) hδ)
  have h1 := eq_one_of_mem_openAlcove hF hyo hw'
  rwa [_root_.mul_inv_eq_one, mul_eq_left] at h1

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) {x : Dual ℚ H}
    {w : P.weylGroup hA} (hw : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA x)
    (hpos : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i →
      P.IsPosRoot hA (w * v) i) : w = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hA) := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hA) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hn : w ^ Fintype.card (P.weylGroup hA) = 1 := pow_card_eq_one
  have hn0 : 0 < Fintype.card (P.weylGroup hA) := Fintype.card_pos
  generalize Fintype.card (P.weylGroup hA) = n at hn hn0
  let g : ℕ → Dual ℚ H := fun m ↦ (((w⁻¹) ^ m : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) P.rho
  set ρ' : Dual ℚ H := ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, g m with hρ'
  have hfix : (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) ρ' = ρ' := by
    have hg : ∀ m, ((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (g m) = g (m + 1) := by
      intro m
      simp only [g, pow_succ', Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    have hgn : g n = g 0 := by simp only [g, inv_pow, hn, inv_one, pow_zero]
    have h1 : ((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) ρ' = ρ' := by
      rw [hρ', map_sum]
      simp_rw [hg]
      have e1 := Finset.sum_range_succ' g n
      have e2 := Finset.sum_range_succ g n
      rw [hgn] at e2
      exact add_right_cancel (e1.symm.trans e2)
    calc (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) ρ' =
        (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) ρ') := by
          rw [h1]
      _ = ρ' := apply_inv_apply w ρ'
  have hiter : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i →
      P.IsPosRoot hA (w ^ m * v) i ∧ P.IsIntegralRoot hA x (w ^ m * v) i := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro v i h1 h2; simpa using ⟨h1, h2⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      intro v i h1 h2
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := ih v i h1 h2
      rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc]
      exact ⟨hpos _ i h3 h4, P.isIntegralRoot_mul hA hw h4⟩
  have hρpos : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i →
      0 < P.corootPairing hA ρ' v i := by
    intro v i h1 h2
    rw [hρ', corootPairing_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun m _ ↦ ?_) (Finset.nonempty_range_iff.mpr hn0.ne')
    simp only [g]
    rw [corootPairing_apply, inv_pow, _root_.inv_inv]
    exact corootPairing_pos hF (fun j ↦ by rw [rho_coroot]; exact one_pos) (hiter m v i h1 h2).1
  have hgen : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℚ), ∀ (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι),
      ¬∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA x v i + ε * P.corootPairing hA ρ' v i = z := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro v
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro i
    apply Rat.eventually_not_exists_int_add_mul
    by_cases hint : ∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA x v i = z
    · right
      rcases isPosRoot_or v i with h | h
      · exact (hρpos v i h hint).ne'
      · have hint' : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x (v * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) i := by
          obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hint
          refine ⟨-z, ?_⟩
          change P.corootPairing hA x _ i = _
          rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, hz]
          push_cast
          ring
        have := hρpos _ i h hint'
        rw [corootPairing_mul_simple] at this
        linarith
    · left
      exact hint
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, -⟩ := (hgen.and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
  have hc : ∀ v i, ¬P.IsIntegralRoot hA (x + ε • ρ') v i := by
    rintro v i ⟨z, hz⟩
    change P.corootPairing hA (x + ε • ρ') v i = z at hz
    rw [corootPairing_add, corootPairing_smul] at hz
    exact hε v i ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hwc : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA (x + ε • ρ') := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup]
    have e : (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) (x + ε • ρ') - (x + ε • ρ') =
        (w : Dual ℚ H ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ H) x - x := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul, hfix]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact hw
  exact eq_one_of_forall_not_isIntegralRoot hF hc hwc

name: Matrix.Realization.integralWeylGroup_le_integralReflectionGroup_of_rat
statement:
theorem integralWeylGroup_le_integralReflectionGroup_of_rat (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    (x : Dual ℚ H) : P.integralWeylGroup hA x ≤ P.integralReflectionGroup hA x
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  induction hlen : (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hex : ∃ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i ∧ P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i ∧
      ¬P.IsPosRoot hA (w * v) i
  · obtain ⟨v, i, hv, hint, hneg⟩ := hex
    have hs : P.reflectionOf hA v i ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA x :=
      (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff hA v i).mpr hint
    have h' := ih _ (hlen ▸ length_mul_reflectionOf_lt hv hneg) (mul_mem hw hs) rfl
    have e : w = w * P.reflectionOf hA v i * P.reflectionOf hA v i := by
      rw [mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self, mul_one]
    rw [e]
    exact mul_mem h' (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨v, i, hint, rfl⟩)
  · push Not at hex
    rw [eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot hF hw hex]
    exact one_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.integralWeylGroup_eq_integralReflectionGroup_of_rat
statement:
theorem integralWeylGroup_eq_integralReflectionGroup_of_rat (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan)
    (x : Dual ℚ H) : P.integralWeylGroup hA x = P.integralReflectionGroup hA x
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (integralWeylGroup_le_integralReflectionGroup_of_rat hF x)
    (P.integralReflectionGroup_le hA x)

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_dominantChamber
statement:
lemma mem_dominantChamber {μ : Dual K H} :
    μ ∈ P.dominantChamber ↔ ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ (P.coroot i)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_zero_of_sum_smul_root_add_sum_smul_root_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_sum_smul_root_add_sum_smul_root_eq_zero {c d : ι → K} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (h : ∑ i, c i • P.root i + ∑ i, d i • P.root i = 0) : c = 0 ∧ d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h
  simp_rw [← add_smul] at h
  have h0 := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_root _ h
  have hc0 : c = 0 := funext fun i ↦ by
    have := hc i; have := hd i; have := h0 i
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at *
    linarith
  refine ⟨hc0, funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have := h0 i
  simp only [hc0, Pi.zero_apply, zero_add] at this
  exact this

name: Matrix.Realization.sub_mul_reflection_apply
statement:
lemma sub_mul_reflection_apply (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    μ - (v * P.reflection hA i) μ = (μ - v μ) + μ (P.coroot i) • v (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
  abel

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_nonneg_sub_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_sub_apply_eq_sum {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) :
    ∃ c : ι → K, 0 ≤ c ∧ μ - w μ = ∑ i, c i • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA, ∃ c : ι → K, 0 ≤ c ∧
      μ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = ∑ i, c i • P.root i from this ⟨w, hw⟩
  refine P.weylGroup_induction_length hA ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp⟩ fun w i hwi ⟨c, hc, hwc⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hwi
  refine ⟨c + μ (P.coroot i) • fun j ↦ (l j : K),
    add_nonneg hc (smul_nonneg (hμ i) fun j ↦ by simpa using hl j), ?_⟩
  rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple, sub_mul_reflection_apply, hwc, hwl, rootOf_apply,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    mul_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_dominantChamber_iff_forall_exists_nonneg
statement:
theorem mem_dominantChamber_iff_forall_exists_nonneg {μ : Dual K H} :
    μ ∈ P.dominantChamber ↔ ∀ w ∈ P.weylGroup hA,
      ∃ c : ι → K, 0 ≤ c ∧ μ - w μ = ∑ i, c i • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun hμ _ hw ↦ P.exists_nonneg_sub_apply_eq_sum hA hμ hw, fun h i ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hci⟩ := h _ (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i)
  rw [reflection_apply, sub_sub_cancel] at hci
  have h0 := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_root
    (fun j ↦ c j - if j = i then μ (P.coroot i) else 0) (by
      simp only [sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
        Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte, ← hci, sub_self]) i
  simp only [↓reduceIte, sub_eq_zero] at h0
  exact h0 ▸ hc i

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_closure_reflection_of_apply_eq_self
statement:
theorem mem_closure_reflection_of_apply_eq_self {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (hwμ : w μ = μ) :
    w ∈ Subgroup.closure (P.reflection hA '' {i | μ (P.coroot i) = 0})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices ∀ w : P.weylGroup hA, (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = μ →
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ∈
        Subgroup.closure (P.reflection hA '' {i | μ (P.coroot i) = 0})
    from this ⟨w, hw⟩ hwμ
  refine P.weylGroup_induction_length hA (fun _ ↦ one_mem _) fun w i hwi ih hwiμ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hwi
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hwc⟩ := P.exists_nonneg_sub_apply_eq_sum hA hμ w.2
  rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple] at hwiμ ⊢
  
  have h0 := P.sub_mul_reflection_apply hA w i μ
  rw [hwiμ, sub_self, hwc, hwl, rootOf_apply, Finset.smul_sum] at h0
  simp_rw [smul_smul] at h0
  obtain ⟨-, hd⟩ := P.eq_zero_of_sum_smul_root_add_sum_smul_root_eq_zero (d := fun j ↦
    μ (P.coroot i) * l j) hc (fun j ↦ mul_nonneg (hμ i) (by simpa using hl j)) h0.symm
  
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hwl
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hwl
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hl0
  have hi : μ (P.coroot i) = 0 := by
    have := congr_fun hd j
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, mul_eq_zero, Int.cast_eq_zero] at this
    exact this.resolve_right hj
  have hri : P.reflection hA i μ = μ := by rw [reflection_apply, hi, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hwμ' : (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = μ := by
    rwa [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hri] at hwiμ
  exact mul_mem (ih hwμ') (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.stabilizer_eq_closure_reflection
statement:
theorem stabilizer_eq_closure_reflection {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber) :
    P.weylGroup hA ⊓ MulAction.stabilizer (Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ =
      Subgroup.closure (P.reflection hA '' {i | μ (P.coroot i) = 0})
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun w ⟨hw, hwμ⟩ ↦
    P.mem_closure_reflection_of_apply_eq_self hA hμ hw hwμ) ?_
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mpr ?_⟩
  rw [LinearEquiv.smul_def, reflection_apply,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq.mp hi, zero_smul, sub_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_apply_eq_self_of_forall_pos
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_apply_eq_self_of_forall_pos {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : ∀ i, 0 < μ (P.coroot i))
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (hwμ : w μ = μ) : w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.mem_closure_reflection_of_apply_eq_self hA (fun i ↦ (hμ i).le) hw hwμ
  have he : {i | μ (P.coroot i) = 0} = ∅ :=
    Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun i hi ↦ (hμ i).ne' hi
  rwa [he, Set.image_empty, Subgroup.closure_empty, Subgroup.mem_bot] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_of_apply_eq_of_mem_dominantChamber
statement:
theorem eq_of_apply_eq_of_mem_dominantChamber {μ ν : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber)
    (hν : ν ∈ P.dominantChamber) {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (hwμ : w μ = ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcw⟩ := P.exists_nonneg_sub_apply_eq_sum hA hμ hw
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ := P.exists_nonneg_sub_apply_eq_sum hA hν (inv_mem hw)
  rw [hwμ] at hcw
  rw [← hwμ, show w⁻¹ (w μ) = μ from w.symm_apply_apply μ, hwμ] at hdw
  obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := P.eq_zero_of_sum_smul_root_add_sum_smul_root_eq_zero hc hd
    (by rw [← hcw, ← hdw]; abel)
  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using hcw

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_self_of_mem_dominantChamber
statement:
theorem apply_eq_self_of_mem_dominantChamber {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (hwμ : w μ ∈ P.dominantChamber) :
    w μ = μ
proof:
:=
  (P.eq_of_apply_eq_of_mem_dominantChamber hA hμ hwμ hw rfl).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.dominantChamber_subset_titsCone
statement: lemma dominantChamber_subset_titsCone : P.dominantChamber ⊆ P.titsCone hA
proof:
:=
  fun μ hμ ↦ ⟨1, one_mem _, μ, hμ, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_mem_titsCone
statement:
lemma apply_mem_titsCone {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.titsCone hA) : w μ ∈ P.titsCone hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, ν, hν, rfl⟩ := hμ
  exact ⟨w * v, mul_mem hw hv, ν, hν, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.existsUnique_mem_dominantChamber
statement:
theorem existsUnique_mem_dominantChamber {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.titsCone hA) :
    ∃! ν, ν ∈ P.dominantChamber ∧ ∃ w ∈ P.weylGroup hA, w μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, ν, hν, rfl⟩ := hμ
  refine ⟨ν, ⟨hν, v⁻¹, inv_mem hv, v.symm_apply_apply ν⟩, fun ν' ⟨hν', w, hw, hwν⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (P.eq_of_apply_eq_of_mem_dominantChamber hA hν hν' (mul_mem hw hv) hwν).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf
statement:
theorem exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, μ (P.coroot i) = n)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ μ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine P.weylGroup_induction_length hA (p := fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦ ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧
    μ - (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = P.rootOf k) ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp⟩
    (fun w i hwi ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ ↦ ?_) w
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hwi
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hμ i
  refine ⟨k + (m : ℤ) • l, add_nonneg hk (smul_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg m) hl), ?_⟩
  rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, coxeterSystem_simple, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply, map_sub,
    map_smul, hm, hwl, map_add, map_zsmul, ← hwk, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
  push_cast
  module

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_self_of_dominant
statement:
theorem apply_eq_self_of_dominant {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, μ (P.coroot i) = n)
    {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (hwμ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, w μ (P.coroot i) = n) : w μ = μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA hμ ⟨w, hw⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := P.exists_sub_apply_eq_rootOf hA hwμ ⟨w, hw⟩⁻¹
  simp only [Inv.inv] at hwl
  rw [show w.symm (w μ) = μ from w.symm_apply_apply μ] at hwl
  have h0 := P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem
    ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨k, hk, hwk.symm⟩)
    ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨l, hl, by rw [← hwl]; change _ = -(μ - w μ); abel⟩)
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h0).symm

name: exists_rat_linearMap_of_finset
statement:
theorem exists_rat_linearMap_of_finset {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (S : Finset K) :
    ∃ Ψ : K →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, Ψ 1 = 1 ∧ ∀ a ∈ S, (∃ z : ℤ, Ψ a = z) → ∃ z : ℤ, a = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ := Projective.exists_dual_eq_one ℚ (one_ne_zero (α := K))
    exact ⟨Ψ, hΨ, by simp⟩
  | insert b S hb ih =>
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ1, hΨ⟩ := ih
    by_cases hgood : (∃ z : ℤ, Ψ b = z) → ∃ z : ℤ, b = z
    · refine ⟨Ψ, hΨ1, fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ha with rfl | ha
      · exact hgood
      · exact hΨ a ha
    push Not at hgood
    obtain ⟨⟨z₀, hz₀⟩, hbz⟩ := hgood
    
    have hne : b - Ψ b • (1 : K) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hbz z₀
      rw [sub_eq_zero, hz₀] at h
      rw [h]
      simp
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Projective.exists_dual_eq_one ℚ hne
    set g : K →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ := φ - φ 1 • Ψ with hg
    have hg1 : g 1 = 0 := by simp [hg, hΨ1]
    have hgb : g b ≠ 0 := by
      have : g b = φ (b - Ψ b • (1 : K)) := by
        simp only [hg, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
          smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [this, hφ]
      exact one_ne_zero
    have hev : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℚ), (¬∃ z : ℤ, Ψ b + ε * g b = z) ∧
        ∀ a ∈ S, (¬∃ z : ℤ, a = z) → ¬∃ z : ℤ, Ψ a + ε * g a = z := by
      refine (Rat.eventually_not_exists_int_add_mul (Or.inr hgb)).and ?_
      rw [eventually_all_finset]
      intro a ha
      by_cases haz : ∃ z : ℤ, a = z
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h ↦ absurd haz h
      · filter_upwards [Rat.eventually_not_exists_int_add_mul
          (Or.inl fun h ↦ haz (hΨ a ha h)) (b := g a)] with ε hε using fun _ ↦ hε
    obtain ⟨ε, ⟨hεb, hεS⟩, -⟩ := (hev.and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
    refine ⟨Ψ + ε • g, by simp [hΨ1, hg1], fun a ha hΨa ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hΨa
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ha with rfl | ha
    · exact absurd hΨa hεb
    · by_contra haz
      exact hεS a ha haz hΨa

name: Matrix.Realization.transport_ext
statement:
lemma transport_ext {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f g : Dual ℚ (ι → ℚ)}
    (h : ∀ j, f (Pi.single j 1) = g (Pi.single j 1)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  (Pi.basisFun ℚ ι).ext fun j ↦ by simpa using h j

name: Matrix.Realization.ratRealization_coroot
statement:
@[simp] lemma ratRealization_coroot (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) (i : ι) :
    (ratRealization hF).coroot i = Pi.single i 1
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.ratRealization_root_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma ratRealization_root_single (hF : A.IsFiniteCartan) (i j : ι) :
    (ratRealization hF).root i (Pi.single j 1) = A j i
proof:
:=
  (ratRealization hF).root_coroot j i

name: Matrix.Realization.weylGroupEquiv_simple
statement:
@[simp] lemma weylGroupEquiv_simple (i : ι) :
    weylGroupEquiv P Q hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i) = (Q.coxeterSystem hA).simple i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weylGroupEquiv, MulEquiv.trans_apply, CoxeterSystem.simple]
  exact congrArg _ (MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: Matrix.Realization.weylGroupEquiv_wordProd
statement:
lemma weylGroupEquiv_wordProd (ω : List ι) :
    weylGroupEquiv P Q hA ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω) = (Q.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih => rw [wordProd_cons, map_mul, ih, weylGroupEquiv_simple, wordProd_cons]

name: Matrix.Realization.weylGroupEquiv_reflectionOf
statement:
lemma weylGroupEquiv_reflectionOf (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    weylGroupEquiv P Q hA (P.reflectionOf hA v i) =
      Q.reflectionOf hA (weylGroupEquiv P Q hA v) i
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ : P.weylGroup hA) =
      (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i := Subtype.ext (coxeterSystem_simple P hA i).symm
  have hQ : (⟨Q.reflection hA i, Q.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ : Q.weylGroup hA) =
      (Q.coxeterSystem hA).simple i := Subtype.ext (coxeterSystem_simple Q hA i).symm
  simp only [reflectionOf, map_mul, map_inv, hP, hQ, weylGroupEquiv_simple]

name: Matrix.Realization.transport_apply_single
statement:
lemma transport_apply_single (μ : Dual K H) (j : ι) :
    transport (P := P) Ψ μ (Pi.single j 1) = Ψ (μ (P.coroot j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [transport, Pi.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.transport_sub
statement:
lemma transport_sub (μ ν : Dual K H) :
    transport (P := P) Ψ (μ - ν) = transport (P := P) Ψ μ - transport (P := P) Ψ ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact transport_ext fun j ↦ by simp [transport_apply_single]

name: Matrix.Realization.map_intCast_mul
statement: lemma map_intCast_mul (n : ℤ) (a : K) : Ψ ((n : K) * a) = n * Ψ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.transport_rootOf
statement:
lemma transport_rootOf (hΨ : Ψ 1 = 1) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    transport (P := P) Ψ (P.rootOf k) = (ratRealization hF).rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  have hint : ∀ n : ℤ, Ψ (n : K) = n := fun n ↦ by
    simpa [hΨ] using map_intCast_mul Ψ n 1
  refine transport_ext fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [transport_apply_single, rootOf_apply_coroot, hint, ← ratRealization_coroot hF,
    rootOf_apply_coroot]

name: Matrix.Realization.transport_reflection
statement:
lemma transport_reflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    transport (P := P) Ψ (P.reflection hA i μ) =
      (ratRealization hF).reflection hA i (transport (P := P) Ψ μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine transport_ext fun j ↦ ?_
  simp only [transport_apply_single, reflection_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, root_coroot, ratRealization_root_single, ratRealization_coroot, map_sub]
  rw [mul_comm, map_intCast_mul, mul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.transport_apply
statement:
lemma transport_apply (w : P.weylGroup hA) (μ : Dual K H) :
    transport (P := P) Ψ ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ) =
      (weylGroupEquiv P (ratRealization hF) hA w : Dual ℚ (ι → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] Dual ℚ (ι → ℚ))
        (transport (P := P) Ψ μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, rfl⟩ := (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd_surjective w
  rw [weylGroupEquiv_wordProd]
  induction ω generalizing μ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [wordProd_cons, wordProd_cons, Subgroup.coe_mul, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply,
      LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coxeterSystem_simple, coxeterSystem_simple, transport_reflection hA hF
      Ψ, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_transport_integral
statement:
lemma exists_transport_integral (μ : Dual K H) : ∃ μ' : Dual ℚ (ι → ℚ),
    (∀ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ,
      weylGroupEquiv P (ratRealization hF) hF.isGeneralizedCartan w ∈
        (ratRealization hF).integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ') ∧
    ∀ v i, (ratRealization hF).IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ'
        (weylGroupEquiv P (ratRealization hF) hF.isGeneralizedCartan v) i →
      P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ1, hΨ⟩ := exists_rat_linearMap_of_finset (Finset.univ.image
    fun p : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan × ι ↦
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ p.1 p.2)
  refine ⟨transport (P := P) Ψ μ, fun w hw ↦ ?_, fun v i ⟨z, hz⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, ← transport_apply _ hF Ψ, ← transport_sub]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (P.mem_rootLattice).mp hw
    rw [← hk, transport_rootOf hF Ψ hΨ1]
    exact (ratRealization hF).rootOf_mem_rootLattice k
  · refine hΨ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(v, i), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩) ⟨z, ?_⟩
    rw [← hz]
    change Ψ ((((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ)
      (P.coroot i)) = _
    rw [← transport_apply_single (P := P) Ψ, transport_apply _ hF Ψ, map_inv]
    rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.integralWeylGroup_eq_integralReflectionGroup
statement:
theorem integralWeylGroup_eq_integralReflectionGroup (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ =
      P.integralReflectionGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ', hW, hint⟩ := exists_transport_integral (P := P) hF μ
  set e := weylGroupEquiv P (ratRealization hF) hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  refine le_antisymm (fun w hw ↦ ?_) (P.integralReflectionGroup_le _ μ)
  have h2 := integralWeylGroup_le_integralReflectionGroup_of_rat hF _ (hW w hw)
  have h3 : ((ratRealization hF).integralReflectionGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ').map
      e.symm.toMonoidHom ≤ P.integralReflectionGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ := by
    rw [integralReflectionGroup, MonoidHom.map_closure, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨v', i, hv', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨e.symm v', i, hint _ i (by rwa [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]), ?_⟩
    change P.reflectionOf _ (e.symm v') i = e.symm ((ratRealization hF).reflectionOf _ v' i)
    rw [eq_comm, MulEquiv.symm_apply_eq, weylGroupEquiv_reflectionOf, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact h3 ⟨e w, h2, e.symm_apply_apply w⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_shorter_factorization
statement:
private lemma exists_shorter_factorization {w v : W} {i j c : B} {k : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hc : c = i ∨ c = j) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hwv : w = v * π (alternatingWord i j k))
    (hlen : ℓ w = ℓ v + k) (hvc : cs.IsRightDescent v c) :
    ∃ v' k', w = v' * π (alternatingWord i j k') ∧ ℓ w = ℓ v' + k' ∧ ℓ v' < ℓ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRightDescent_iff] at hvc
  by_cases hd : (if Even k then j else i) = c
  · refine ⟨v * s c, k + 1, ?_, by omega, by omega⟩
    rw [alternatingWord_succ', hd, wordProd_cons, mul_assoc, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left, hwv]
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have hd' : (if Even k then j else i) = c := by
      rcases hc with rfl | rfl <;> by_cases hk : Even k <;>
        simp_all [Nat.even_add_one, hij.symm]
    have h1 : w = v * s c * π (alternatingWord i j k) := by
      rw [hwv, alternatingWord_succ', hd', wordProd_cons, mul_assoc]
    have h2 := cs.length_mul_le (v * s c) (π (alternatingWord i j k))
    have h3 := cs.length_wordProd_le (alternatingWord i j k)
    rw [length_alternatingWord, ← h1] at *
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.smul_mem_closure_of_not_isRightDescent
statement:
theorem smul_mem_closure_of_not_isRightDescent (hα : cs.IsDihedrallyPositive α) {w : W} {i : B}
    (hw : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i) : w • α i ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  generalize hn : ℓ w = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w i with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hw1 : w = 1
  · rw [hw1, one_smul]
    exact AddSubmonoid.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw1
  have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; exact hw hj
  
  let Q : ℕ → Prop := fun m ↦
    ∃ v k, w = v * π (alternatingWord i j k) ∧ ℓ w = ℓ v + k ∧ ℓ v = m
  have hQ : Q (ℓ (w * s j)) := by
    refine ⟨w * s j, 1, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · simp [alternatingWord]
    · rw [isRightDescent_iff] at hj; omega
  obtain ⟨v, k, hwv, hlen, hv⟩ := Nat.find_spec ⟨_, hQ⟩
  have hmin : ∀ m < Nat.find ⟨_, hQ⟩, ¬Q m := fun m hm ↦ Nat.find_min ⟨_, hQ⟩ hm
  have hle : Nat.find ⟨_, hQ⟩ ≤ ℓ (w * s j) := Nat.find_min' ⟨_, hQ⟩ hQ
  have hjw : ℓ (w * s j) < ℓ w := hj
  rw [← hv] at hmin hle
  
  have hvdesc : ∀ c, c = i ∨ c = j → ¬cs.IsRightDescent v c := by
    intro c hc hvc
    obtain ⟨v', k', h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_shorter_factorization hij hc (by omega) hwv hlen hvc
    exact hmin _ h3 ⟨v', k', h1, h2, rfl⟩
  
  have hk : M i j = 0 ∨ k < M i j := by
    by_contra! h
    obtain ⟨hM, hk⟩ := h
    have hred := cs.not_isReduced_alternatingWord j i (by rwa [M.symmetric])
      (m := k + 1) (by rw [M.symmetric]; omega)
    have h1 : ℓ (π (alternatingWord j i (k + 1))) < k + 1 := by
      have := cs.length_wordProd_le (alternatingWord j i (k + 1))
      rw [length_alternatingWord] at this
      unfold IsReduced at hred
      rw [length_alternatingWord] at hred
      omega
    have h2 : w * s i = v * π (alternatingWord j i (k + 1)) := by
      rw [alternatingWord_succ, wordProd_concat, hwv, mul_assoc]
    have h3 := cs.length_mul_le v (π (alternatingWord j i (k + 1)))
    rw [← h2] at h3
    rw [not_isRightDescent_iff] at hw
    omega
  
  have hvi := ih (ℓ v) (by omega) (hvdesc i (Or.inl rfl)) rfl
  have hvj := ih (ℓ v) (by omega) (hvdesc j (Or.inr rfl)) rfl
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := (AddSubmonoid.mem_closure_pair _ _ _).mp (hα i j hij k hk)
  rw [hwv, mul_smul, ← hab, smul_add, smul_comm, smul_comm v b]
  exact add_mem (AddSubmonoid.nsmul_mem _ hvi a) (AddSubmonoid.nsmul_mem _ hvj b)

name: CoxeterSystem.neg_smul_mem_closure_of_isRightDescent
statement:
theorem neg_smul_mem_closure_of_isRightDescent (hα : cs.IsDihedrallyPositive α)
    (hneg : ∀ i, s i • α i = -α i) {w : W} {i : B} (hw : cs.IsRightDescent w i) :
    -(w • α i) ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul] at hw
  have := cs.smul_mem_closure_of_not_isRightDescent hα hw
  rwa [mul_smul, hneg, smul_neg] at this

name: CoxeterSystem.isRightDescent_iff_neg_smul_mem_closure
statement:
theorem isRightDescent_iff_neg_smul_mem_closure (hα : cs.IsDihedrallyPositive α)
    (hneg : ∀ i, s i • α i = -α i)
    (hpt : ∀ v ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range α), -v ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range α) →
      v = 0)
    (hne : ∀ i, α i ≠ 0) {w : W} {i : B} :
    cs.IsRightDescent w i ↔ -(w • α i) ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range α)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨cs.neg_smul_mem_closure_of_isRightDescent hα hneg, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hw
  have h0 := hpt _ (cs.smul_mem_closure_of_not_isRightDescent hα hw) h
  exact hne i ((smul_eq_zero_iff_eq w).mp (by simpa using h0))

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_one_of_forall_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_forall_smul_eq (hα : cs.IsDihedrallyPositive α)
    (hneg : ∀ i, s i • α i = -α i)
    (hpt : ∀ v ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range α), -v ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range α) →
      v = 0)
    (hne : ∀ i, α i ≠ 0) {w : W} (hw : ∀ i, w • α i = α i) : w = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hw1
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw1
  have h := cs.neg_smul_mem_closure_of_isRightDescent hα hneg hi
  rw [hw] at h
  exact hne i (hpt _ (AddSubmonoid.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩) h)

name: Matrix.IsSimplyLaced.braidOuterCondition
statement:
theorem IsSimplyLaced.braidOuterCondition (hA : A.IsSimplyLaced) : A.BraidOuterCondition where
  simple i j l _ _ hli hlj
proof:
:= by
    rcases hA hli.symm with h1 | h1 <;> rcases hA hlj.symm with h2 | h2 <;> simp [h1, h2]
  double i j l h h' _ _ := by
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; omega
    rcases hA hij with h1 | h1 <;> omega
  triple i j l h h' _ _ := by
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; omega
    rcases hA hij with h1 | h1 <;> omega

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_sub_mem_integralPosRootCone
proof:
:= by
  induction hlen : (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).length w
    using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hex : ∃ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i ∧
        ¬P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i
  · obtain ⟨v, i, hv, ⟨z, hz⟩, hneg⟩ := hex
    have hs : P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∈
        P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b :=
      (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff _ v i).mpr ⟨z, hz⟩
    have hk := ih _ (hlen ▸ length_mul_reflectionOf_lt hv hneg) (mul_mem hw hs) rfl
    have hpos := (isPosRoot_or (w * v) i).resolve_left hneg
    have hint : P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan b
        (w * v * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i := by
      have h1 := P.isIntegralRoot_mul _ hw ⟨z, hz⟩
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := h1
      change P.corootPairing _ b (w * v) i = _ at hz'
      refine ⟨-z', ?_⟩
      change P.corootPairing _ b _ i = _
      rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, hz']
      push_cast
      ring
    have hz0 := hb v i hv z hz
    have hβ : ((w * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i : P.weylGroup _) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
        ((w * v * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i : P.weylGroup _) :
          Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      rw [mul_simple_apply_root, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply',
        corootPairing, inv_apply_apply, P.root_coroot_self hF.isGeneralizedCartan, two_smul,
        sub_add_cancel_left, map_neg]
      rfl
    have hrefl : (P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b =
        b - (z : K) • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      rw [reflectionOf_apply', ← hz]
      rfl
    have e : w = w * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i *
        P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i := by
      rw [mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self, mul_one]
    have hsplit : (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - b =
        (((w * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i : P.weylGroup _) :
          Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - b) + (-z).toNat •
          ((w * v * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i : P.weylGroup _) :
            Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      have hzK : (z : K) = -(((-z).toNat : ℕ) : K) := by
        have h' : (((-z).toNat : ℕ) : K) = ((-z : ℤ) : K) := by
          exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ -z by omega)
        rw [h']
        push_cast
        ring
      conv_lhs => rw [e]
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul _ (w * _), LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hrefl, map_sub, map_smul, hβ,
        ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, hzK]
      module
    rw [hsplit]
    refine add_mem hk (nsmul_mem ?_ _)
    apply AddSubmonoid.subset_closure
    exact ⟨_, i, hpos, hint, rfl⟩
  · push Not at hex
    rw [eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot_integral hF hw hex]
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_integralPosRootCone
statement:
lemma bilinForm_integralPosRootCone (S : A.Symmetrization) {a b : Dual K H}
    (hab : ∀ v i, P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i →
      P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i)
    (ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0)
    {x : Dual K H} (hx : x ∈ P.integralPosRootCone hF.isGeneralizedCartan b) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, q ≤ 0 ∧ P.dualBilinForm S x a = q ∧
      (q = 0 → P.dualBilinForm S x b = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨v, i, hv, hint, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hab v i hint
    change P.corootPairing _ a v i = n at hn
    have hform : ∀ y : Dual K H, P.dualBilinForm S y ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan y v i / S.ε i := by
      intro y
      rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan S (v⁻¹).2, inv_apply_apply,
        dualBilinForm_root_right]
      rfl
    have hsymm := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq
    refine ⟨n / S.ε i, ?_, ?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast ha v i hv n hn) (S.ε_pos i).le
    · rw [hsymm, hform, hn]
      push_cast
      rfl
    · have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        have := S.ε_ne_zero i
        rw [div_eq_zero_iff] at h0
        exact_mod_cast h0.resolve_right this
      rw [hsymm, hform, hfacet v i hv (by rw [hn, hn0, Int.cast_zero]), zero_div]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp, fun _ ↦ by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨q₁ + q₂, add_nonpos hq₁ hq₂, ?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx₁, hy₁]
      push_cast
      rfl
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx₂ (by linarith), hy₂ (by linarith), add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply_integralWeylGroup
statement:
theorem apply_eq_of_add_eq_apply_integralWeylGroup {a b : Dual K H}
    (hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (b - a) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    (hb : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i → ∀ n : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = n → n ≤ 0)
    (hfacet : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = 0 →
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0)
    {z u y : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan}
    (hν : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b - a) (P.coroot i) = n)
    {ν₂ : Dual K H} (hν₂ : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, ν₂ (P.coroot i) = n) {c : ι → ℤ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hνc : (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b - a) - ν₂ = P.rootOf c)
    (hy : y ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b)
    (h : a + (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν₂ = (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b) :
    (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  have hB (k : ι → ℤ) (x : Dual K H) := P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm k x
  have hW (w : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) (x x' : Dual K H) :
      B ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x) ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x') = B x x' :=
    P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan S w.2 x x'
  have hBsymm (x x' : Dual K H) : B x x' = B x' x := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq x x'
  
  have hab' : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (a - b) (P.coroot j) = n := fun j ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hab j
    refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
    rw [← neg_sub, LinearMap.neg_apply, hn, Int.cast_neg]
  have hint : ∀ v i, P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i →
      P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i := fun v i hbi ↦
    (P.isIntegralRoot_congr _ hab' v i).mpr hbi
  
  set x := (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - b with hx
  have hxcone := apply_sub_mem_integralPosRootCone hF hb hy
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (P.mem_rootLattice).mp hy
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hxa, hxb⟩ := bilinForm_integralPosRootCone hF S hint ha hfacet hxcone
  choose n2 hn2 using hν₂
  choose nν hnν using hν
  
  set R₁ : ℤ := ∑ i, c i * d i * ((nν i : ℤ) + n2 i) with hR₁
  have hR₁nonneg : 0 ≤ R₁ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hc i) (hdpos i).le) (by positivity)
  have hR₁eq : B ((z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b - a)) ((z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b - a))
      - B ν₂ ν₂ = R₁ := by
    have hsplit : (z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b - a) = ν₂ + P.rootOf c := by
      rw [← hνc]; abel
    calc _ = B (P.rootOf c) ((z : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (b - a) + ν₂) := by
          rw [hsplit]
          simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
          rw [hBsymm ν₂ (P.rootOf c)]
          ring
      _ = R₁ := by
          rw [hB, hR₁]
          push_cast
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hnν, hn2]
  
  have h1 : B ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b) ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b) = B b b :=
    hW y b b
  have hyb : (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b + x := by rw [hx]; abel
  have hR₂eq : B (b - a) (b - a) - B ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - a)
      ((y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - a) = 2 * q := by
    rw [hyb] at h1 ⊢
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h1 ⊢
    rw [hBsymm b a, hBsymm b x, hBsymm a x, hxa] at *
    linear_combination (-1 : K) * h1
  have hR : (R₁ : K) = 2 * q := by
    have h3 : (y : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - a = (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ν₂ := by
      rw [← h]; abel
    rw [← hR₁eq, ← hR₂eq, hW z, h3, hW u]
  have hq0 : q = 0 := by
    have : ((R₁ : ℚ) : K) = ((2 * q : ℚ) : K) := by push_cast; exact hR
    have h' : (R₁ : ℚ) = 2 * q := by exact_mod_cast this
    have : (0 : ℚ) ≤ R₁ := by exact_mod_cast hR₁nonneg
    linarith
  
  have hxx : B x x = 0 := by
    rw [hyb] at h1
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at h1
    rw [hBsymm b x, hxb hq0] at h1
    linear_combination h1
  have he0 : e = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hqd := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    rw [hx, ← he, hB] at hxx
    have hcast : ((e ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ e : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← hxx, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct]
      simp only [mulVec_diagonal]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
      ring
    simp only [star_trivial] at hqd
    exact hqd.ne' (by exact_mod_cast hcast)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← he, he0, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_mul_eq_isPosRoot_of_orth
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_isPosRoot_of_orth {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (b : Dual K H)
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    ∃ w₁ u₁ : P.weylGroup hA, w = w₁ * u₁ ∧ (u₁ : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b ∧
      ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → P.corootPairing hA b v i = 0 → P.IsPosRoot hA (w₁ * v) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hn : (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hex : ∃ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i ∧ P.corootPairing hA b v i = 0 ∧
      ¬P.IsPosRoot hA (w * v) i
  · obtain ⟨v, i, hv, hb0, hneg⟩ := hex
    obtain ⟨w₁, u₁, hw, hu, hpos⟩ :=
      ih _ (hn ▸ length_mul_reflectionOf_lt hv hneg) (w * P.reflectionOf hA v i) rfl
    refine ⟨w₁, u₁ * P.reflectionOf hA v i, ?_, ?_, hpos⟩
    · rw [← mul_assoc, ← hw, mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self, mul_one]
    · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', hb0, zero_smul,
        sub_zero, hu]
  · push Not at hex
    exact ⟨w, 1, (mul_one w).symm, rfl, hex⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_smul_isIntegralRoot_iff
statement:
theorem exists_smul_isIntegralRoot_iff (μ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ v i, P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (t • μ) v i ↔
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let f : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan × ι → ℕ := fun p ↦
    if h : ∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ p.1 p.2 = z then h.choose.natAbs
    else 0
  set M : ℕ := ∑ p, f p + 1
  have hM : ∀ v i (z : ℤ), P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = z → z.natAbs < M := by
    intro v i z hz
    have h : ∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = z := ⟨z, hz⟩
    have hzc : h.choose = z := by exact_mod_cast h.choose_spec.symm.trans hz
    have : f (v, i) = z.natAbs := by simp only [f, h, ↓reduceDIte, hzc]
    have hle : f (v, i) ≤ ∑ p, f p := Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
      (Finset.mem_univ (v, i))
    omega
  have hM0 : (M : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
  refine ⟨(M : K)⁻¹, inv_ne_zero hM0, fun v i ↦ ⟨fun ⟨z, hz⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h0 ↦ ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · change P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((M : K)⁻¹ • μ) v i = z at hz
    rw [corootPairing_smul] at hz
    have hμ : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = ((M * z : ℤ) : K) := by
      push_cast
      rw [← hz]
      field_simp
    have h1 := hM v i _ hμ
    have hz0 : z = 0 := by
      by_contra hz0
      rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast] at h1
      have : 1 ≤ z.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hz0
      nlinarith
    rw [hμ, hz0, mul_zero, Int.cast_zero]
  · change P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((M : K)⁻¹ • μ) v i = _
    rw [corootPairing_smul, h0, mul_zero, Int.cast_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_apply_eq_of_forall_isPosRoot
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_apply_eq_of_forall_isPosRoot {b : Dual K H}
    {v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan} (hvb : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b)
    (hpos : ∀ u i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b u i = 0 →
        P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (v * u) i) : v = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := exists_smul_isIntegralRoot_iff (P := P) hF b
  refine eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot_integral hF (μ := t • b) ?_
    fun u i hu hint ↦ hpos u i hu ((ht u i).mp hint)
  rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, map_smul, hvb, sub_self]
  exact zero_mem _

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_sub_mem_orthPosRootCone
statement:
theorem apply_sub_mem_orthPosRootCone {a b : Dual K H}
    (ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0 →
        ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧ P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n)
    {v : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan} (hvb : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b) :
    (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a ∈ P.orthPosRootCone hF.isGeneralizedCartan b
proof:
:= by
  induction hlen : (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).length v
    using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hex : ∃ u i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i ∧
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b u i = 0 ∧
        ¬P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (v * u) i
  · obtain ⟨u, i, hu, hb0, hneg⟩ := hex
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz⟩ := ha u i hu hb0
    have hsb : (P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b := by
      rw [reflectionOf_apply', hb0, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    have hv'b : ((v * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i : P.weylGroup _) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b := by
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hsb, hvb]
    have hk := ih _ (hlen ▸ length_mul_reflectionOf_lt hu hneg) hv'b rfl
    have hpos := (isPosRoot_or (v * u) i).resolve_left hneg
    have hvinv : ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup _) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hvb]
      exact inv_apply_apply v b
    have horth : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b
        (v * u * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i) i = 0 := by
      rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, ← _root_.inv_inv v, ← corootPairing_apply, hvinv, hb0,
        neg_zero]
    have hβ : ((v * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i : P.weylGroup _) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
        ((v * u * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i : P.weylGroup _) :
          Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      rw [mul_simple_apply_root, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply',
        corootPairing, inv_apply_apply, P.root_coroot_self hF.isGeneralizedCartan, two_smul,
        sub_add_cancel_left, map_neg]
      rfl
    have e : v = v * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i *
        P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i := by
      rw [mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self, mul_one]
    have hzK : (z : K) = -(((-z).toNat : ℕ) : K) := by
      have h' : (((-z).toNat : ℕ) : K) = ((-z : ℤ) : K) := by
        exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ -z by omega)
      rw [h']
      push_cast
      ring
    have hsplit : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a =
        (((v * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan u i : P.weylGroup _) :
          Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a) + (-z).toNat •
          ((v * u * (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).simple i : P.weylGroup _) :
            Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [e]
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul _ (v * _), LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', hz, map_sub,
        map_smul, hβ, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, hzK]
      module
    rw [hsplit]
    refine add_mem hk (nsmul_mem ?_ _)
    apply AddSubmonoid.subset_closure
    exact ⟨_, i, ⟨hpos, horth⟩, rfl⟩
  · push Not at hex
    rw [eq_one_of_apply_eq_of_forall_isPosRoot hF hvb hex]
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_mem_closure_nonpos
statement:
lemma bilinForm_mem_closure_nonpos {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (S : A.Symmetrization)
    {G : P.weylGroup hA → ι → Prop} {c c' : Dual K H}
    (hG : ∀ v i, G v i → ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧ P.corootPairing hA c v i = n ∧
      (n = 0 → P.corootPairing hA c' v i = 0))
    {x : Dual K H} (hx : x ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure
      {y | ∃ v i, G v i ∧ (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = y}) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, q ≤ 0 ∧ P.dualBilinForm S x c = q ∧ (q = 0 → P.dualBilinForm S x c' = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨v, i, hv, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn, hc'⟩ := hG v i hv
    have hform : ∀ y : Dual K H, P.dualBilinForm S y ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
        P.corootPairing hA y v i / S.ε i := by
      intro y
      rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S (v⁻¹).2, inv_apply_apply, dualBilinForm_root_right]
      rfl
    have hsymm := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq
    refine ⟨n / S.ε i, div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hn0) (S.ε_pos i).le,
      ?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [hsymm, hform, hn]
      push_cast
      rfl
    · have hn' : n = 0 := by
        rw [div_eq_zero_iff] at h0
        exact_mod_cast h0.resolve_right (S.ε_ne_zero i)
      rw [hsymm, hform, hc' hn', zero_div]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp, fun _ ↦ by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨q₁ + q₂, add_nonpos hq₁ hq₂, ?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx₁, hy₁]
      push_cast
      rfl
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx₂ (by linarith), hy₂ (by linarith), add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_of_orth
statement:
theorem apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_of_orth {a b : Dual K H}
    (hab : ∀ j, ∃ n : ℤ, (a - b) (P.coroot j) = n)
    (ha : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0 →
        ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧ P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n)
    {u : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan} (hub : (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b = b)
    (hua : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i →
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0 →
        ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧
          P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) v i = n) :
    (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  have hBsymm (x x' : Dual K H) : B x x' = B x' x := (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq x x'
  have hx := apply_sub_mem_orthPosRootCone hF ha hub
  have hG1 : ∀ v i, (P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0) → ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = n ∧
          (n = 0 → P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan a v i = 0) := fun v i ⟨hv, hb⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := ha v i hv hb
    exact ⟨n, hn, hn', fun h0 ↦ by rw [hn', h0, Int.cast_zero]⟩
  have hG2 : ∀ v i, (P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i = 0) → ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ 0 ∧
        P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) v i = n ∧
          (n = 0 → P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan
            ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) v i = 0) := fun v i ⟨hv, hb⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := hua v i hv hb
    exact ⟨n, hn, hn', fun h0 ↦ by rw [hn', h0, Int.cast_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, h₁, -⟩ := bilinForm_mem_closure_nonpos S hG1 hx
  obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂, h₂, -⟩ := bilinForm_mem_closure_nonpos S hG2 hx
  have hW : B ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a) = B a a :=
    P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan S u.2 a a
  have hsum : ((q₁ + q₂ : ℚ) : K) = 0 := by
    push_cast
    rw [← h₁, ← h₂]
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    rw [hBsymm a ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a)]
    linear_combination hW
  have hq : q₁ + q₂ = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hq₁0 : q₁ = 0 := by linarith
  have hq₂0 : q₂ = 0 := by linarith
  have hxx : B ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a) ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub (B ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a)), h₁, h₂, hq₁0, hq₂0]
    simp
  have hxQ : (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a ∈ P.rootLattice := by
    have e : (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) a - a =
        (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (a - b) - (a - b) := by
      rw [map_sub, hub]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hF.isGeneralizedCartan u.2 hab
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (P.mem_rootLattice).mp hxQ
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hqd := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    rw [← hk, P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm] at hxx
    have hcast : ((k ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k : ℤ) : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← hxx, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct]
      simp only [mulVec_diagonal]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
      ring
    simp only [star_trivial] at hqd
    exact hqd.ne' (by exact_mod_cast hcast)
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hk, hk0, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.root_coroot_self
statement: lemma root_coroot_self (i : ι) : P.root i (P.coroot i) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.root_coroot, hA.diag]
  norm_num

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_apply
statement:
lemma reflection_apply (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.reflection hA i μ = μ - μ (P.coroot i) • P.root i
proof:
:=
  Module.reflection_apply _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_apply
statement:
lemma coreflection_apply (i : ι) (a : H) :
    P.coreflection hA i a = a - P.root i a • P.coroot i
proof:
:=
  Module.reflection_apply _ _

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_apply_apply
statement:
lemma reflection_apply_apply (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) (a : H) :
    P.reflection hA i μ a = μ (P.coreflection hA i a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reflection_apply, coreflection_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_eq_dualMap
statement:
lemma reflection_eq_dualMap (i : ι) :
    P.reflection hA i = (P.coreflection hA i).dualMap
proof:
:= by
  ext μ a
  rw [reflection_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.dualMap_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_reflection
statement:
@[simp] lemma reflection_reflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.reflection hA i (P.reflection hA i μ) = μ
proof:
:=
  Module.involutive_reflection _ μ

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_coreflection
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreflection_coreflection (i : ι) (a : H) :
    P.coreflection hA i (P.coreflection hA i a) = a
proof:
:=
  Module.involutive_reflection _ a

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_mul_self
statement: @[simp] lemma reflection_mul_self (i : ι) : P.reflection hA i * P.reflection hA i = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext μ : 1
  exact P.reflection_reflection hA i μ

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma reflection_inv (i : ι) : (P.reflection hA i)⁻¹ = P.reflection hA i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma reflection_symm (i : ι) : (P.reflection hA i).symm = P.reflection hA i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_root
statement:
lemma reflection_root (i j : ι) :
    P.reflection hA i (P.root j) = P.root j - (A i j : K) • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply, P.root_coroot]

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_root_self
statement: @[simp] lemma reflection_root_self (i : ι) : P.reflection hA i (P.root i) = -P.root i
proof:
:=
  Module.reflection_apply_self _

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_coroot
statement:
lemma coreflection_coroot (i j : ι) :
    P.coreflection hA i (P.coroot j) = P.coroot j - (A j i : K) • P.coroot i
proof:
:= by
  rw [coreflection_apply, P.root_coroot]

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_coroot_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreflection_coroot_self (i : ι) :
    P.coreflection hA i (P.coroot i) = -P.coroot i
proof:
:=
  Module.reflection_apply_self _

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_apply_coroot_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma reflection_apply_coroot_self (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.reflection hA i μ (P.coroot i) = -μ (P.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply_apply, coreflection_coroot_self, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_apply_coreflection
statement:
@[simp] lemma reflection_apply_coreflection (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) (a : H) :
    P.reflection hA i μ (P.coreflection hA i a) = μ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply_apply, coreflection_coreflection]

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_rootOf
statement:
lemma reflection_rootOf [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    P.reflection hA i (P.rootOf k) = P.rootOf (k - (A *ᵥ k) i • Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, rootOf_single]
  congr 1
  rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
  congr 1
  simp [rootOf_apply, P.root_coroot, mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_rootOf_mem_range
statement:
lemma reflection_rootOf_mem_range (i : ι) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    P.reflection hA i (P.rootOf k) ∈ Set.range P.rootOf
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ⟨_, (P.reflection_rootOf hA i k).symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_mem_weylGroup
statement: lemma reflection_mem_weylGroup (i : ι) : P.reflection hA i ∈ P.weylGroup hA
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.weylGroup_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma weylGroup_induction {p : (Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) → Prop} (one : p 1)
    (mul : ∀ i w, p w → p (P.reflection hA i * w)) {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) : p w
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Subgroup.closure_induction_left with
  | one => exact one
  | mul_left x hx w _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact mul i w ih
  | inv_mul_cancel x hx w _ ih =>
