    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [reflection_inv]
    exact mul i w ih

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf
statement:
theorem exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, μ (P.coroot j) = z) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, w μ = μ + P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA (p := fun w ↦ ∃ k : ι → ℤ, w μ = μ + P.rootOf k)
    ⟨0, by simp⟩ (fun i w ih ↦ ?_) hw
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hμ i
    refine ⟨k - (z + (A *ᵥ k) i) • Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hk, reflection_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, rootOf_single,
      LinearMap.add_apply, hz, rootOf_apply_coroot, ← Int.cast_add,
      ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K (z + (A *ᵥ k) i)]
    abel

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf
statement:
theorem exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (k : ι → ℤ) : ∃ k' : ι → ℤ, w (P.rootOf k) = P.rootOf k'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA hw (μ := P.rootOf k)
    fun j ↦ ⟨_, P.rootOf_apply_coroot k j⟩
  exact ⟨k + l, by rw [hl, map_add]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_sub_mem_span
statement:
theorem apply_sub_mem_span {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (μ : Dual K H) : w μ - μ ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range P.root)
proof:
:= by
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA
    (p := fun w ↦ w μ - μ ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range P.root)) (by simp) (fun i w ih ↦ ?_) hw
  · have : (P.reflection hA i * w) μ - μ = (w μ - μ) - (w μ) (P.coroot i) • P.root i := by
      rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ ih (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩))

name: Matrix.Realization.root_mem_realRoots
statement: lemma root_mem_realRoots (i : ι) : P.root i ∈ P.realRoots hA
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, one_mem _, i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_mem_realRoots
statement:
lemma apply_mem_realRoots {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.realRoots hA) : w μ ∈ P.realRoots hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w', hw', i, rfl⟩ := hμ
  exact ⟨w * w', mul_mem hw hw', i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.neg_mem_realRoots
statement: lemma neg_mem_realRoots {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.realRoots hA) : -μ ∈ P.realRoots hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, i, rfl⟩ := hμ
  refine ⟨w * P.reflection hA i, mul_mem hw (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i), i, ?_⟩
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_root_self, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_rootOf_eq_of_mem_realRoots
statement:
theorem exists_rootOf_eq_of_mem_realRoots {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.realRoots hA) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℤ, P.rootOf k = μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w, hw, i, rfl⟩ := hμ
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf hA hw (Pi.single i 1)
  exact ⟨k, by rw [← hk, rootOf_single]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_eq_smul_root_of_eq_zero
statement:
lemma rootOf_eq_smul_root_of_eq_zero {k : ι → ℤ} {i : ι} (hk : ∀ j, j ≠ i → k j = 0) :
    P.rootOf k = (k i : K) • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootOf_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [hk j hj, Int.cast_zero,
    zero_smul]) (by simp)]

name: Matrix.Realization.weylGroupEquiv_symm_wordProd
statement:
lemma weylGroupEquiv_symm_wordProd (ω : List ι) :
    (weylGroupEquiv P Q hA).symm ((Q.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω) =
      (P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_eq, weylGroupEquiv_wordProd]

name: Matrix.Realization.length_weylGroupEquiv
statement:
lemma length_weylGroupEquiv (w : P.weylGroup hA) :
    (Q.coxeterSystem hA).length (weylGroupEquiv P Q hA w) = (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := (P.coxeterSystem hA).exists_isReduced w
    rw [weylGroupEquiv_wordProd, hω.eq]
    exact (Q.coxeterSystem hA).length_wordProd_le ω
  · obtain ⟨ω, hω, hw⟩ := (Q.coxeterSystem hA).exists_isReduced (weylGroupEquiv P Q hA w)
    rw [hw, hω.eq]
    calc (P.coxeterSystem hA).length w
        = (P.coxeterSystem hA).length
            ((weylGroupEquiv P Q hA).symm ((Q.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd ω)) := by
          rw [← hw, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      _ ≤ ω.length := by
          rw [weylGroupEquiv_symm_wordProd]
          exact (P.coxeterSystem hA).length_wordProd_le ω

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_weylGroupEquiv_iff
statement:
lemma isPosRoot_weylGroupEquiv_iff {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} :
    Q.IsPosRoot hA (weylGroupEquiv P Q hA v) i ↔ P.IsPosRoot hA v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent, isPosRoot_iff_not_isRightDescent, IsRightDescent,
    IsRightDescent, ← weylGroupEquiv_simple P Q hA, ← map_mul, length_weylGroupEquiv,
    length_weylGroupEquiv]

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_self_of_mem_closure
statement:
lemma apply_eq_self_of_mem_closure {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} {μ : Dual K H}
    {w : P.weylGroup hA} (hw : w ∈ Subgroup.closure
      {s | ∃ v i, P.corootPairing hA μ v i = 0 ∧ P.reflectionOf hA v i = s}) :
    (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = μ
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem s hs =>
    obtain ⟨v, i, h0, rfl⟩ := hs
    rw [reflectionOf_apply', h0, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  | one => rfl
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb => rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hb, ha]
  | inv a _ ha =>
    conv_lhs => rw [← ha]
    exact inv_apply_apply a μ

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf
statement:
theorem apply_eq_self_iff_mem_closure_reflectionOf (μ : Dual K H)
    (w : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) :
    (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = μ ↔ w ∈ Subgroup.closure
      {s | ∃ v i, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = 0 ∧
        P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i = s}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun hw ↦ ?_, apply_eq_self_of_mem_closure⟩
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  
  let f : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan × ι → ℕ := fun p ↦
    if h : ∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ p.1 p.2 = z then h.choose.natAbs
    else 0
  set M : ℕ := ∑ p, f p + 1
  have hM : ∀ v i (z : ℤ), P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = z → z.natAbs < M := by
    intro v i z hz
    have h : ∃ z : ℤ, P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = z := ⟨z, hz⟩
    have hzc : h.choose = z := by exact_mod_cast h.choose_spec.symm.trans hz
    have : f (v, i) = z.natAbs := by simp only [f, h, ↓reduceDIte, hzc]
    have hle : f (v, i) ≤ ∑ p, f p := Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
      (Finset.mem_univ (v, i))
    omega
  have hM0 : (M : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
  have hwt : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((M : K)⁻¹ • μ) := by
    rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, map_smul, hw, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  rw [integralWeylGroup_eq_integralReflectionGroup hF] at hwt
  refine Subgroup.closure_mono ?_ hwt
  rintro _ ⟨v, i, ⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨v, i, ?_, rfl⟩
  change P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((M : K)⁻¹ • μ) v i = z at hz
  rw [corootPairing_smul] at hz
  have hμ : P.corootPairing hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ v i = ((M * z : ℤ) : K) := by
    push_cast
    rw [← hz]
    field_simp
  have h1 := hM v i _ hμ
  have hz0 : z = 0 := by
    by_contra hz0
    rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast] at h1
    have : 1 ≤ z.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hz0
    nlinarith
  rw [hμ, hz0, mul_zero, Int.cast_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot_integral
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ', hW, hint⟩ := exists_transport_integral (P := P) hF μ
  set e := weylGroupEquiv P (ratRealization hF) hF.isGeneralizedCartan
  have h := eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot hF (hW w hw) fun v' i hv' hint' ↦ by
    rw [show v' = e (e.symm v') by simp] at hv' hint' ⊢
    rw [← map_mul, isPosRoot_weylGroupEquiv_iff] at *
    exact hpos _ i hv' (hint _ i hint')
  simpa using h

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_nonneg_apply_sub_eq_rootOf
proof:
:= by
  induction hlen : (P.coxeterSystem hF.isGeneralizedCartan).length w
    using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hex : ∃ v i, P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∧
      P.IsIntegralRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan b v i ∧
        ¬P.IsPosRoot hF.isGeneralizedCartan (w * v) i
  · obtain ⟨v, i, hv, ⟨z, hz⟩, hneg⟩ := hex
    have hs : P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i ∈
        P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b :=
      (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff _ v i).mpr ⟨z, hz⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := ih _ (hlen ▸ length_mul_reflectionOf_lt hv hneg) (mul_mem hw hs) rfl
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (isPosRoot_or (w * v) i).resolve_left hneg
    rw [mul_simple_apply_root] at hwl
    have hz0 := hb v i hv z hz
    refine ⟨k + (-z) • l, add_nonneg hk (smul_nonneg (by omega) hl), ?_⟩
    have hβ : ((w * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i : P.weylGroup _) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) = P.rootOf l := by
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', corootPairing,
        inv_apply_apply, P.root_coroot_self hF.isGeneralizedCartan, two_smul, sub_add_cancel_left,
        map_neg, ← hwl]
      rfl
    have hrefl : (P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b =
        b - (z : K) • (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) := by
      rw [reflectionOf_apply', ← hz]
      rfl
    have e : w = w * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i *
        P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i := by
      rw [mul_assoc, reflectionOf_mul_self, mul_one]
    calc (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - b
        = ((w * P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i : P.weylGroup _) :
            Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
            ((P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b) - b := by
          conv_lhs => rw [e]
          rfl
      _ = P.rootOf (k + (-z) • l) := by
          rw [hrefl, map_sub, map_smul, hβ, map_add, map_zsmul, ← hwk, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K,
            Int.cast_neg, neg_smul]
          abel
  · push Not at hex
    rw [eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot_integral hF hw hex]
    exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.IsAntidominant.exists_weylDot_sub_eq_rootOf
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_nonneg_apply_sub_eq_rootOf hF hμ ?_
  rwa [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ (μ' := μ) fun j ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩]

name: Matrix.Realization.IsAntidominant.eq_of_weylDot_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := hμ.exists_weylDot_sub_eq_rootOf hF hw
  have hw' : w⁻¹ ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan
      ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) - P.rho) := by
    have e : P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan
        ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) - P.rho) =
        P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ := by
      refine P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ fun j ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice k) j
      refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
      rw [← hz, ← hwk]
      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply]
      ring
    rw [e]
    exact inv_mem hw
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := hwμ.exists_weylDot_sub_eq_rootOf hF hw'
  rw [sub_add_cancel, inv_apply_apply] at hwl
  have h0 := P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem
    ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨k, hk, hwk.symm⟩)
    ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨l, hl, by rw [← hwl, neg_sub]⟩)
  rwa [sub_eq_zero] at h0

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_isAntidominant_weylDot
statement:
theorem exists_isAntidominant_weylDot (μ : Dual K H) :
    ∃ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ,
      P.IsAntidominant hF.isGeneralizedCartan
        ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) - P.rho)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  have : Fintype (P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  set b := μ + P.rho with hb
  have hWb : P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan μ =
      P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b :=
    P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp [hb]⟩
  
  have hQ : ∀ w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b,
      ∃ k, P.rootOf k = (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - b := fun w hw ↦
    (P.mem_rootLattice).mp hw
  let ht : P.weylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan → ℤ := fun w ↦
    if h : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b then ∑ j, (hQ w h).choose j else 0
  have hht : ∀ w (h : w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b) (k : ι → ℤ),
      P.rootOf k = (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - b → ht w = ∑ j, k j := by
    intro w h k hk
    simp only [ht, h, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [P.rootOf_injective ((hQ w h).choose_spec.trans hk.symm)]
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hmin⟩ := (Finset.univ.filter
    (· ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b)).exists_min_image ht
    ⟨1, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, one_mem _⟩⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hw
  refine ⟨w, hWb ▸ hw.2, fun v i hv n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hpos
  push Not at hpos
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at hn
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hQ w hw.2
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hvl⟩ := hv
  have hs : P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i * w ∈
      P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b := by
    refine mul_mem ?_ hw.2
    have e : P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b) =
        P.integralWeylGroup hF.isGeneralizedCartan b :=
      P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral _ (P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice hw.2)
    rw [← e]
    exact (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff _ v i).mpr ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hk' : P.rootOf (k - n • l) =
      ((P.reflectionOf hF.isGeneralizedCartan v i * w : P.weylGroup _) :
        Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) b - b := by
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply', hn, map_sub, map_zsmul, hk,
      ← hvl]
    module
  have h1 := hmin _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hs⟩)
  rw [hht _ hs _ hk', hht _ hw.2 _ hk] at h1
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hvl
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i hvl
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hl0
  have hsum : 0 < ∑ j, l j := Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ ↦ hl j)
    ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_ne (hl j) (Ne.symm hj)⟩
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
  nlinarith

name: Matrix.dotProduct_diagonal_mul_mulVec_reflection
statement:
lemma dotProduct_diagonal_mul_mulVec_reflection {d : ι → ℤ} (hd : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm)
    (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    (k - (A *ᵥ k) i • Pi.single i 1) ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ (k - (A *ᵥ k) i • Pi.single i 1) =
      k ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm : k ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ Pi.single i 1 =
      Pi.single i 1 ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k := by
    rw [dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, hd.eq, dotProduct_comm]
  have hGk : Pi.single i 1 ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k = d i * (A *ᵥ k) i := by
    rw [single_one_dotProduct, ← mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_diagonal]
  have hGi : Pi.single i 1 ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ Pi.single i (1 : ℤ) = 2 * d i := by
    rw [single_one_dotProduct, ← mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_diagonal, mulVec_single_one]
    simp [hA.diag i, mul_comm]
  simp only [mulVec_sub, mulVec_smul, dotProduct_sub, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
    smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, hsymm, hGk, hGi]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.finrank_eq_card_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_card_of_isFiniteCartan [CharZero K] (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) :
    finrank K H = Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.finrank_add_rank
  rw [rank_of_isUnit _ (hA.isUnit_map K)] at h
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.span_root_eq_top_of_isFiniteCartan
statement:
theorem span_root_eq_top_of_isFiniteCartan [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K H]
    (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) : Submodule.span K (Set.range P.root) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  P.linearIndependent_root.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank'
    (by rw [Subspace.dual_finrank_eq, finrank_eq_card_of_isFiniteCartan P hA])

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf_and_quadForm_eq
statement:
theorem exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf_and_quadForm_eq {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H}
    (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    ∃ k' : ι → ℤ, w (P.rootOf k) = P.rootOf k' ∧
      k' ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k' = k ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k
proof:
:= by
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA (p := fun w ↦ ∃ k' : ι → ℤ, w (P.rootOf k) = P.rootOf k' ∧
      k' ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k' = k ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ k) ⟨k, rfl, rfl⟩
    (fun i w ⟨k', hk', hq⟩ ↦ ?_) hw
  refine ⟨k' - (A *ᵥ k') i • Pi.single i 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, hk', reflection_rootOf]
  · rw [dotProduct_diagonal_mul_mulVec_reflection hd hA, hq]

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_realRoots
statement:
theorem finite_realRoots (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) :
    (P.realRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, -, hpos⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have hd : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  refine (Set.finite_iUnion fun i ↦ ((hpos.finite_setOfPred_dotProduct_mulVec_le
    ((Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ) ⬝ᵥ (diagonal d * A) *ᵥ Pi.single i 1)).image P.rootOf)).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hq⟩ :=
    P.exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf_and_quadForm_eq hd hA.isGeneralizedCartan hw (Pi.single i 1)
  rw [rootOf_single] at hk
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, k, hq.le, hk.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_weylGroup
statement:
theorem finite_weylGroup (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) :
    Finite (P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan)
proof:
:= by
  have := (P.finite_realRoots hA).to_subtype
  let F : P.weylGroup hA.isGeneralizedCartan → ι → P.realRoots hA.isGeneralizedCartan :=
    fun w i ↦ ⟨w.1 (P.root i), w.1, w.2, i, rfl⟩
  refine Finite.of_injective F fun w₁ w₂ h ↦ ?_
  have h1 : w₂.1⁻¹ * w₁.1 = 1 := by
    refine P.eq_one_of_forall_apply_root_eq hA.isGeneralizedCartan
      (mul_mem (inv_mem w₂.2) w₁.2) fun i ↦ ?_
    have := congrArg Subtype.val (congr_fun h i)
    simp only [F] at this
    rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, this, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, inv_mul_cancel]
    rfl
  exact Subtype.ext (inv_mul_eq_one.mp h1).symm

name: Matrix.Symmetrization.ε_ne_zero
statement: lemma ε_ne_zero (i : ι) : S.ε i ≠ 0
proof: := (S.ε_pos i).ne'

name: Matrix.Symmetrization.matrix_apply
statement: lemma matrix_apply (i j : ι) : S.matrix i j = A i j / S.ε i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Symmetrization.isSymm_matrix
statement: lemma isSymm_matrix : S.matrix.IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [transpose_apply, matrix_apply]
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (S.ε_ne_zero j) (S.ε_ne_zero i), mul_comm (A j i : ℚ), S.ε_mul_comm,
    mul_comm]

name: Matrix.Symmetrization.map_eq_diagonal_mul
statement:
lemma map_eq_diagonal_mul [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) = diagonal S.ε * S.matrix
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [diagonal_mul, matrix_apply, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (S.ε_ne_zero i)]

name: Matrix.isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization
statement:
theorem isSymmetrizable_iff_nonempty_symmetrization [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} : A.IsSymmetrizable ↔ Nonempty A.Symmetrization
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSymmetrizable_iff_mul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, hdA⟩
    refine ⟨⟨fun i ↦ (d i : ℚ)⁻¹, fun i ↦ by simpa using hd i, fun i j ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    have hi : (d i : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hd i).ne'
    have hj : (d j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hd j).ne'
    have : (d i : ℚ) * A i j = d j * A j i := by exact_mod_cast hdA i j
    field_simp
    linear_combination this
  · rintro ⟨S⟩
    exact isSymmetrizable_iff_mul_eq_mul.mp (isSymmetrizable_iff_exists_eq_diagonal_mul.mpr
      ⟨S.ε, S.matrix, S.ε_pos, S.isSymm_matrix, S.map_eq_diagonal_mul⟩)

name: Matrix.Realization.corootCoord_corootMap
statement: @[simp] lemma corootCoord_corootMap (c : ι → K) : P.corootCoord (P.corootMap c) = c
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.leftInverse_apply_of_inj (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr P.corootMap_injective) c

name: Matrix.Realization.coroot_eq_corootMap
statement: lemma coroot_eq_corootMap [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) : P.coroot i = P.corootMap (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [corootMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.corootCoord_coroot
statement:
@[simp] lemma corootCoord_coroot [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) :
    P.corootCoord (P.coroot i) = Pi.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coroot_eq_corootMap, corootCoord_corootMap]

name: Matrix.Realization.isCompl_corootCompl
statement: theorem isCompl_corootCompl : IsCompl (LinearMap.range P.corootMap) P.corootCompl
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.isCompl_of_proj (p := LinearMap.range P.corootMap)
    (f := P.corootMap.rangeRestrict ∘ₗ P.corootCoord) (by
      rintro ⟨_, c, rfl⟩
      ext
      simp)
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (P.corootMap.rangeRestrict ∘ₗ P.corootCoord) = P.corootCompl := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_comp, LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict,
      LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr P.corootMap_injective, Submodule.comap_bot]
    rfl
  rwa [hker] at h

name: Matrix.Realization.rho_coroot
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_coroot (i : ι) : P.rho (P.coroot i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [rho, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.root_rhoCheck
statement: @[simp] theorem root_rhoCheck [FiniteDimensional K H] (i : ι) : P.root i P.rhoCheck = 1
proof:
:=
  congr_fun (P.rootMap_surjective (fun _ ↦ 1)).choose_spec i

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_rhoCheck
statement:
theorem rootOf_rhoCheck [FiniteDimensional K H] (k : ι → ℤ) :
    P.rootOf k P.rhoCheck = ((height k : ℤ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootOf_apply, height]

name: Matrix.Realization.sum_smul_coroot
statement: lemma sum_smul_coroot {c : ι → K} : ∑ i, c i • P.coroot i = P.corootMap c
proof:
:= by
  simp [corootMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_apply
statement:
lemma bilinForm_apply (x y : H) :
    P.bilinForm S x y = ∑ i, (S.ε i : K) * (P.corootCoord x i * P.root i y +
      P.corootCoord y i * P.root i x) -
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (S.ε j : K) * A i j * P.corootCoord x i * P.corootCoord y j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bilinForm, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.BilinForm.linMulLin_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by ring
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by ring

name: Matrix.Realization.isSymm_bilinForm
statement: theorem isSymm_bilinForm : (P.bilinForm S).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_def.mpr fun x y ↦ ?_
  rw [bilinForm_apply, bilinForm_apply]
  congr 1
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    ring
  · conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    have := congrArg (fun q : ℚ ↦ (q : K)) (S.ε_mul_comm j i)
    rw [Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_intCast, Rat.cast_intCast] at this
    linear_combination -(P.corootCoord x i * P.corootCoord y j) * this

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_coroot_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem bilinForm_coroot_left (i : ι) (x : H) :
    P.bilinForm S (P.coroot i) x = S.ε i * P.root i x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [bilinForm_apply]
  simp only [corootCoord_coroot, Pi.single_apply, P.root_coroot]
  have h2 : ∑ k, ∑ j, ((S.ε j : K) * A k j * if k = i then 1 else 0) * P.corootCoord x j =
      ∑ j, (S.ε j : K) * A i j * P.corootCoord x j := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i (fun k hk ↦ by simp [hk])]
    simp
  rw [h2]
  simp only [mul_add, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  rw [add_sub_assoc, sub_eq_zero.mpr (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ by ring), add_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_coroot_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem bilinForm_coroot_right (i : ι) (x : H) :
    P.bilinForm S x (P.coroot i) = S.ε i * P.root i x
proof:
:= by
  rw [(P.isSymm_bilinForm S).eq, bilinForm_coroot_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_corootMap_left
statement:
lemma bilinForm_corootMap_left (c : ι → K) (x : H) :
    P.bilinForm S (P.corootMap c) x = ∑ i, c i * S.ε i * P.root i x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_smul_coroot, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_corootCompl
statement:
theorem bilinForm_corootCompl {x y : H} (hx : x ∈ P.corootCompl) (hy : y ∈ P.corootCompl) :
    P.bilinForm S x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [corootCompl, LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx hy
  simp [bilinForm_apply, hx, hy]

name: Matrix.Realization.nondegenerate_bilinForm
statement: theorem nondegenerate_bilinForm [FiniteDimensional K H] : (P.bilinForm S).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  refine (LinearMap.IsRefl.nondegenerate_iff_separatingLeft
    (P.isSymm_bilinForm S).isRefl).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
  
  have hker : x ∈ LinearMap.ker P.rootMap := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    ext i
    have := hx (P.coroot i)
    rw [bilinForm_coroot_right] at this
    simpa [(S.ε_ne_zero i)] using this
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := P.ker_rootMap_le hker
  
  have hc : ∑ i, (c i * S.ε i) • P.root i = 0 := by
    ext y
    have := hx y
    rw [bilinForm_corootMap_left] at this
    simpa using this
  have := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_root _ hc
  have hc0 : c = 0 := by
    ext i
    simpa [S.ε_ne_zero i] using this i
  simp [hc0]

name: Matrix.Realization.toDual_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma toDual_apply (x y : H) : P.toDual S x y = P.bilinForm S x y
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_toDual_symm_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma bilinForm_toDual_symm_left (μ : Dual K H) (x : H) :
    P.bilinForm S ((P.toDual S).symm μ) x = μ x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.BilinForm.apply_toDual_symm_apply μ x

name: Matrix.Realization.bilinForm_toDual_symm_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma bilinForm_toDual_symm_right (μ : Dual K H) (x : H) :
    P.bilinForm S x ((P.toDual S).symm μ) = μ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [(P.isSymm_bilinForm S).eq, bilinForm_toDual_symm_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.toDual_coroot
statement: theorem toDual_coroot (i : ι) : P.toDual S (P.coroot i) = (S.ε i : K) • P.root i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.toDual_symm_root
statement:
theorem toDual_symm_root (i : ι) :
    (P.toDual S).symm (P.root i) = (S.ε i : K)⁻¹ • P.coroot i
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, map_smul, toDual_coroot, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i), one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_apply
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_apply (μ μ' : Dual K H) :
    P.dualBilinForm S μ μ' = P.bilinForm S ((P.toDual S).symm μ) ((P.toDual S).symm μ')
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_apply_eq
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_apply_eq (μ μ' : Dual K H) :
    P.dualBilinForm S μ μ' = μ ((P.toDual S).symm μ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_apply, bilinForm_toDual_symm_left]

name: Matrix.Realization.isSymm_dualBilinForm
statement: theorem isSymm_dualBilinForm : (P.dualBilinForm S).IsSymm
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_def.mpr fun μ μ' ↦ by
    rw [dualBilinForm_apply, dualBilinForm_apply, (P.isSymm_bilinForm S).eq]

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_root_right
statement:
lemma dualBilinForm_root_right (μ : Dual K H) (i : ι) :
    P.dualBilinForm S μ (P.root i) = μ (P.coroot i) / S.ε i
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_apply_eq, toDual_symm_root, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_eq_div]

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_root_root
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_root_root (i j : ι) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root j) = (S.matrix i j : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_root_right, P.root_coroot, S.matrix_apply]
  have hi : (S.ε i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i
  have hj : (S.ε j : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero j
  have : (S.ε j : K) * A i j = S.ε i * A j i := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_mul_comm i j
  push_cast
  field_simp
  linear_combination -this

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_root_self
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_root_self (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i) = ((2 / S.ε i : ℚ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_root_right, P.root_coroot, hA.diag]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.two_div_ε_pos
statement: lemma two_div_ε_pos (i : ι) : 0 < 2 / S.ε i
proof: := div_pos two_pos (S.ε_pos i)

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_coroot_eq
statement:
theorem apply_coroot_eq (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (μ : Dual K H) (i : ι) :
    μ (P.coroot i) =
      2 * P.dualBilinForm S μ (P.root i) / P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_root_self S hA, dualBilinForm_root_right]
  have hi : (S.ε i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_rho_root
statement: theorem dualBilinForm_rho_root (i : ι) : P.dualBilinForm S P.rho (P.root i) = (S.ε i : K)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_root_right, rho_coroot, one_div]

name: Matrix.Realization.two_mul_dualBilinForm_rho_root
statement:
theorem two_mul_dualBilinForm_rho_root (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) (i : ι) :
    2 * P.dualBilinForm S P.rho (P.root i) = P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualBilinForm_rho_root, dualBilinForm_root_self S hA]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Matrix.coxeterEntry_ne_one
statement: lemma coxeterEntry_ne_one (n : ℕ) : coxeterEntry n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | _ | _ | _ | n <;> simp [coxeterEntry]

name: Matrix.coxeterEntry_of_four_le
statement: lemma coxeterEntry_of_four_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) : coxeterEntry n = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
  rfl

name: Matrix.IsGeneralizedCartan.mul_nonneg
statement:
lemma IsGeneralizedCartan.mul_nonneg {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan)
    {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) : 0 ≤ A i j * A j i
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (hA.offDiag_nonpos i j h) (hA.offDiag_nonpos j i (Ne.symm h))

name: Matrix.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne
statement:
lemma coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ) {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) :
    A.coxeterMatrix i j = coxeterEntry (A i j * A j i).toNat
proof:
:= by
  simp [coxeterMatrix, h]

name: Polynomial.Chebyshev.S_eval_intCast
statement: lemma S_eval_intCast (n z : ℤ) : (S K n).eval (z : K) = (((S ℤ n).eval z : ℤ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_S (Int.castRingHom K), eval_intCast_map, eq_intCast, Int.cast_id]

name: Polynomial.Chebyshev.S_eval_nonneg_of_two_le
statement:
lemma S_eval_nonneg_of_two_le {t : ℤ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ (S ℤ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval t ∧ (S ℤ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval t ≤ (S ℤ n).eval t
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := S_sub_one ℤ n
    have h' : (S ℤ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval t = t * (S ℤ n).eval t - (S ℤ (n + 1)).eval t := by
      rw [h]; simp
    push_cast
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]
    constructor
    · linarith [ih.1, ih.2]
    · nlinarith [ih.1, ih.2]

name: Matrix.Realization.S_eval_nonneg_of_lt_coxeterEntry
statement:
lemma S_eval_nonneg_of_lt_coxeterEntry (p : ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : Matrix.coxeterEntry p = 0 ∨ k < Matrix.coxeterEntry p) :
    0 ≤ (S ℤ ((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((p : ℤ) - 2) + (S ℤ ((k / 2 : ℕ) - 1)).eval ((p : ℤ) - 2) ∧
      0 ≤ (S ℤ (if Even k then ((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 else ((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))).eval
        ((p : ℤ) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p 4 with hp | hp
  · have hk' : k < Matrix.coxeterEntry p := by
      rcases hk with hk | hk
      · interval_cases p <;> simp [Matrix.coxeterEntry] at hk
      · exact hk
    interval_cases p <;> simp only [Matrix.coxeterEntry] at hk' <;> interval_cases k <;>
      norm_num [S_two, Nat.even_iff]
  · have ht : (2 : ℤ) ≤ (p : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
    have h1 := S_eval_nonneg_of_two_le ht (k / 2)
    have h2 := S_eval_nonneg_of_two_le ht (k / 2 + 1)
    push_cast at h2
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h2
    split_ifs <;> constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]

name: Matrix.Realization.S_eval_ne_zero_of_lt_coxeterEntry
statement:
lemma S_eval_ne_zero_of_lt_coxeterEntry (p n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hnm : Matrix.coxeterEntry p = 0 ∨ n < Matrix.coxeterEntry p)
    (h : (S ℤ n).eval ((p : ℤ) - 2) + (S ℤ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval ((p : ℤ) - 2) = 1) :
    (S ℤ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval ((p : ℤ) - 2) ≠ 0 ∧ p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p 4 with hp | hp
  · have hn' : n < Matrix.coxeterEntry p := by
      rcases hnm with hnm | hnm
      · interval_cases p <;> simp [Matrix.coxeterEntry] at hnm
      · exact hnm
    have e3 : S ℤ 3 = X * S ℤ 2 - S ℤ 1 := by simpa using S_add_two ℤ 1
    have e4 : S ℤ 4 = X * S ℤ 3 - S ℤ 2 := by simpa using S_add_two ℤ 2
    have e5 : S ℤ 5 = X * S ℤ 4 - S ℤ 3 := by simpa using S_add_two ℤ 3
    revert h
    interval_cases p <;> simp only [Matrix.coxeterEntry] at hn' <;> interval_cases n <;>
      norm_num [S_two, e3, e4, e5]
  · have ht : (2 : ℤ) ≤ (p : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
    
    have hmono : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (S ℤ 1).eval ((p : ℤ) - 2) ≤ (S ℤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((p : ℤ) - 2) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        have := (S_eval_nonneg_of_two_le ht (k + 2)).2
        push_cast at this ih ⊢
        simp only [show (k : ℤ) + 2 - 1 = k + 1 by ring] at this
        rw [show (k : ℤ) + 1 + 1 = k + 2 by ring]
        linarith
    have h1 := hmono n
    have h2 := (S_eval_nonneg_of_two_le ht (n + 1)).1
    simp only [S_one, eval_X] at h1
    push_cast at h1 h2 h
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.root_coroot_mul_eq
statement:
lemma root_coroot_mul_eq (i j : ι) (h : i ≠ j) :
    P.root j (P.coroot i) * P.root i (P.coroot j) =
      (((A i j * A j i).toNat : ℤ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.root_coroot, P.root_coroot, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hA.mul_nonneg h)]
  push_cast; ring

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_mul_reflection_pow_coxeterMatrix
statement:
theorem reflection_mul_reflection_pow_coxeterMatrix (i j : ι) :
    (P.reflection hA i * P.reflection hA j) ^ A.coxeterMatrix i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    simp [coxeterMatrix]
  rw [A.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne hij]
  set p := (A i j * A j i).toNat with hp
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p 4 with hp4 | hp4
  swap
  · rw [coxeterEntry_of_four_le hp4, pow_zero]
  have ht : ((p : ℤ) : K) - 2 = Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i) (P.root j) *
      Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j) (P.root i) - 2 := by
    simp only [Dual.eval_apply, P.root_coroot_mul_eq hA i j hij, hp]
  ext μ : 1
  change _ = μ
  refine (reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply (x := P.root i) (f := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i))
    (y := P.root j) (g := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j)) (P.root_coroot_self hA i)
    (P.root_coroot_self hA j) _ μ _ ht).trans ?_
  simp only [Dual.eval_apply]
  interval_cases hpv : p
  · 
    have h0 : A i j * A j i = 0 := by have := hA.mul_nonneg hij; omega
    have hij0 : A i j = 0 ∧ A j i = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
      · exact ⟨h, (hA.zero_comm i j).mp h⟩
      · exact ⟨(hA.zero_comm j i).mp h, h⟩
    simp only [coxeterEntry, P.root_coroot, hij0.1, hij0.2]
    norm_num
    module
  all_goals simp only [coxeterEntry]; norm_num [S_two]

name: Matrix.Realization.intCast_smul_add_mem_closure
proof:
:= by
  lift a to ℕ using ha
  lift b to ℕ using hb
  rw [AddSubmonoid.mem_closure_pair]
  exact ⟨a, b, by simp [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.alternating_apply_root_mem_closure
statement:
theorem alternating_apply_root_mem_closure {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : A.coxeterMatrix i j = 0 ∨ k < A.coxeterMatrix i j) :
    ((if Even k then 1 else P.reflection hA j) * (P.reflection hA i * P.reflection hA j) ^ (k / 2))
      (P.root i) ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure {P.root i, P.root j}
proof:
:= by
  rw [A.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne hij] at hk
  set p := (A i j * A j i).toNat with hp
  have ht : ((p : ℤ) : K) - 2 = Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i) (P.root j) *
      Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j) (P.root i) - 2 := by
    simp only [Dual.eval_apply, P.root_coroot_mul_eq hA i j hij, hp]
  have hS := S_eval_nonneg_of_lt_coxeterEntry p k hk
  have hji : 0 ≤ -A j i := by linarith [hA.offDiag_nonpos j i (Ne.symm hij)]
  have hcast : ((p : ℤ) : K) - 2 = (((p : ℤ) - 2 : ℤ) : K) := by push_cast; ring
  split_ifs with hk2
  · rw [one_mul]
    refine (congrArg (· ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure {P.root i, P.root j})
      (reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply_self (x := P.root i)
      (f := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i)) (y := P.root j) (g := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j))
      (P.root_coroot_self hA i) (P.root_coroot_self hA j) _ _ ht)).mpr ?_
    rw [hcast, S_eval_intCast, S_eval_intCast]
    simp only [hk2, ↓reduceIte] at hS
    simp only [Dual.eval_apply, P.root_coroot]
    have := intCast_smul_add_mem_closure (K := K) hS.1 (mul_nonneg hS.2 hji) (P.root i) (P.root j)
    push_cast at this
    simpa using this
  · refine (congrArg (· ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure {P.root i, P.root j})
      (reflection_mul_reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply_self (x := P.root i)
      (f := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i)) (y := P.root j) (g := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j))
      (P.root_coroot_self hA i) (P.root_coroot_self hA j) _ _ ht)).mpr ?_
    rw [hcast, S_eval_intCast, S_eval_intCast]
    simp only [hk2, ↓reduceIte] at hS
    simp only [Dual.eval_apply, P.root_coroot]
    have := intCast_smul_add_mem_closure (K := K) hS.1 (mul_nonneg hS.2 hji) (P.root i) (P.root j)
    push_cast at this
    simpa using this

name: Matrix.Realization.reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply_root
statement:
lemma reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply_root {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ) :
    ((P.reflection hA i * P.reflection hA j) ^ n) (P.root i) =
      P.rootOf ((((S ℤ n).eval ((A i j * A j i).toNat - 2 : ℤ) +
        (S ℤ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval ((A i j * A j i).toNat - 2 : ℤ))) • Pi.single i 1 +
        ((S ℤ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval ((A i j * A j i).toNat - 2 : ℤ) * -A j i) •
          Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  set p := (A i j * A j i).toNat with hp
  have ht : ((p : ℤ) : K) - 2 = Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i) (P.root j) *
      Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j) (P.root i) - 2 := by
    simp only [Dual.eval_apply, P.root_coroot_mul_eq hA i j hij, hp]
  have hcast : ((p : ℤ) : K) - 2 = (((p : ℤ) - 2 : ℤ) : K) := by push_cast; ring
  refine (reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply_self (x := P.root i)
    (f := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i)) (y := P.root j) (g := Dual.eval K H (P.coroot j))
    (P.root_coroot_self hA i) (P.root_coroot_self hA j) _ _ ht).trans ?_
  rw [hcast, S_eval_intCast, S_eval_intCast, map_add, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, rootOf_single,
    rootOf_single, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
  simp only [Dual.eval_apply, P.root_coroot]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: Matrix.Realization.orderOf_reflection_mul_reflection
statement:
theorem orderOf_reflection_mul_reflection (i j : ι) :
    orderOf (P.reflection hA i * P.reflection hA j) = A.coxeterMatrix i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    simp [coxeterMatrix]
  
  have hne : ∀ n, 0 < n → (A.coxeterMatrix i j = 0 ∨ n < A.coxeterMatrix i j) →
      (P.reflection hA i * P.reflection hA j) ^ n ≠ 1 := by
    intro n hn hnm h1
    rw [A.coxeterMatrix_apply_of_ne hij] at hnm
    have h := P.reflection_mul_reflection_pow_apply_root hA hij n
    rw [h1] at h
    change P.root i = _ at h
    rw [← rootOf_single] at h
    have h' := P.rootOf_injective h
    have hi := congr_fun h' i
    have hj := congr_fun h' j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_apply, hij,
      Ne.symm hij, ↓reduceIte, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add] at hi hj
    obtain ⟨hs, hp⟩ := S_eval_ne_zero_of_lt_coxeterEntry _ n hn hnm hi.symm
    have hji : A j i = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hj.symm with h | h
      · exact absurd h hs
      · omega
    exact hp (by simp [hji])
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (A.coxeterMatrix i j) with h0 | hpos
  · rw [h0, orderOf_eq_zero_iff']
    exact fun n hn ↦ hne n hn (Or.inl h0)
  · rw [orderOf_eq_iff hpos]
    exact ⟨P.reflection_mul_reflection_pow_coxeterMatrix hA i j,
      fun n hn hn0 ↦ hne n hn0 (Or.inr hn)⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_closure_range_root_iff
statement:
lemma mem_closure_range_root_iff {μ : Dual K H} :
    μ ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range P.root) ↔ ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ P.rootOf k = μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨Pi.single i 1, fun j ↦ by by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h], rootOf_single _ _⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, map_zero _⟩
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨k + l, add_nonneg hk hl, map_add _ _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    rw [rootOf_apply]
    refine AddSubmonoid.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (hk i)
    rw [hn, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    exact AddSubmonoid.nsmul_mem _ (AddSubmonoid.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self i)) n

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := (P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mp h
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ := (P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mp h'
  have hkl : k + l = 0 := P.rootOf_injective (by rw [map_add, hl', add_neg_cancel, map_zero])
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    ext i
    have h1 := congr_fun hkl i
    have h2 := hk i
    have h3 := hl i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
    omega
  rw [hk0, map_zero]

name: Matrix.Realization.coxeterGroupHom_simple
statement:
@[simp] lemma coxeterGroupHom_simple (i : ι) :
    P.coxeterGroupHom hA (A.coxeterMatrix.simple i) = P.reflection hA i
proof:
:=
  A.coxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem.lift_apply_simple
    (P.reflection_mul_reflection_pow_coxeterMatrix hA) i

name: Matrix.Realization.range_coxeterGroupHom
statement: theorem range_coxeterGroupHom : (P.coxeterGroupHom hA).range = P.weylGroup hA
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← A.coxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem.subgroup_closure_range_simple,
    MonoidHom.map_closure, ← Set.range_comp, weylGroup]
  congr 2

name: Matrix.Realization.coxeterGroupHom_injective
statement: theorem coxeterGroupHom_injective [CharZero K] : Function.Injective (P.coxeterGroupHom hA)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : DistribMulAction A.coxeterMatrix.Group (Dual K H) :=
    DistribMulAction.compHom _ (P.coxeterGroupHom hA)
  have hsmul : ∀ (g : A.coxeterMatrix.Group) μ, g • μ = P.coxeterGroupHom hA g μ :=
    fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro g hg
  refine A.coxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem.eq_one_of_forall_smul_eq (α := P.root) ?_ ?_
    (fun _ hv hv' ↦ P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem hv hv') P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero
    fun i ↦ by rw [hsmul, hg]; rfl
  · intro i j hij k hk
    rw [hsmul, prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow, map_mul, map_pow, map_mul,
      apply_ite (P.coxeterGroupHom hA), map_one]
    simpa using P.alternating_apply_root_mem_closure hA hij k hk
  · intro i
    rw [hsmul]
    simp

name: Matrix.Realization.coxeterSystem_simple
statement:
@[simp] lemma coxeterSystem_simple [CharZero K] (i : ι) :
    ((P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) = P.reflection hA i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.simple, coxeterSystem, MulEquiv.symm_symm]
  exact P.coxeterGroupHom_simple hA i

name: Matrix.Realization.coxeterSystem_wordProd
statement:
lemma coxeterSystem_wordProd [CharZero K] (l : List ι) :
    ((P.coxeterSystem hA).wordProd l : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) =
      (l.map (P.reflection hA)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i l ih => simp [wordProd_cons, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.isDihedrallyPositive_coxeterSystem
statement:
lemma isDihedrallyPositive_coxeterSystem :
    (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsDihedrallyPositive P.root
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij k hk
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def, prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow, LinearEquiv.smul_def]
  push_cast [apply_ite (Subtype.val : P.weylGroup hA → _)]
  simpa using P.alternating_apply_root_mem_closure hA hij k hk

name: Matrix.Realization.coxeterSystem_simple_smul_root
statement:
lemma coxeterSystem_simple_smul_root (i : ι) :
    (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i • P.root i = -P.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submonoid.smul_def, LinearEquiv.smul_def]
  simp

name: Matrix.Realization.isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff
statement:
theorem isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff {w : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} :
    (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent w i ↔
      ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = -P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  rw [(P.coxeterSystem hA).isRightDescent_iff_neg_smul_mem_closure
    (P.isDihedrallyPositive_coxeterSystem hA) (P.coxeterSystem_simple_smul_root hA)
    (fun _ hv hv' ↦ P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem hv hv') P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero,
    mem_closure_range_root_iff, Submonoid.smul_def, LinearEquiv.smul_def]
  simp only [neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, eq_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff
statement:
theorem not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff {w : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} :
    ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent w i ↔
      ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := fun hw ↦ (P.coxeterSystem hA).smul_mem_closure_of_not_isRightDescent
    (P.isDihedrallyPositive_coxeterSystem hA) (w := w) (i := i) hw
  rw [mem_closure_range_root_iff, Submonoid.smul_def, LinearEquiv.smul_def] at h1
  refine ⟨fun hw ↦ ?_, fun ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ hw ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hwk⟩ := h1 hw
    exact ⟨k, hk, hwk.symm⟩
  · obtain ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ := (P.isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp hw
    have h0 := P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem
      ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩)
      ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨l, hl, by rw [← hwk, hwl, neg_neg]⟩)
    rw [← hwk, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i h0

name: Matrix.Realization.weylGroup_induction_length
statement:
lemma weylGroup_induction_length {p : P.weylGroup hA → Prop}
    (one : p 1)
    (step : ∀ w i, ¬(P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent w i → p w →
      p (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i))
    (w : P.weylGroup hA) : p w
proof:
:= by
  set cs := P.coxeterSystem hA
  generalize hn : cs.length w = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hw1 : w = 1
  · exact hw1 ▸ one
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw1
  have hnd : ¬cs.IsRightDescent (w * cs.simple i) i := by
    rwa [← isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul]
  have := step _ i hnd (ih _ (hn ▸ hi) _ rfl)
  rwa [cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos
statement:
theorem apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (i : ι) : (∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ w (P.root i) = P.rootOf k) ∨
      ∃ k : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ k ∧ w (P.root i) = -P.rootOf k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : (P.coxeterSystem hA).IsRightDescent ⟨w, hw⟩ i
  · exact Or.inr ((P.isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp h)
  · exact Or.inl ((P.not_isRightDescent_coxeterSystem_iff hA).mp h)

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_forall_apply_root_eq
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_forall_apply_root_eq {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (h : ∀ i, w (P.root i) = P.root i) : w = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := (P.coxeterSystem hA).eq_one_of_forall_smul_eq (P.isDihedrallyPositive_coxeterSystem hA)
    (P.coxeterSystem_simple_smul_root hA)
    (fun _ hv hv' ↦ P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem hv hv')
    P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero (w := ⟨w, hw⟩)
    (fun i ↦ by rw [Submonoid.smul_def, LinearEquiv.smul_def]; exact h i)
  simpa using congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_int_apply_root_coroot
statement:
lemma exists_int_apply_root_coroot {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (i j : ι) : ∃ z : ℤ, w (P.root j) (P.coroot i) = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf hA hw (Pi.single j 1)
  rw [rootOf_single] at hk
  exact ⟨_, by rw [hk, rootOf_apply_coroot]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.nonneg_of_apply_root_eq_add
statement:
lemma nonneg_of_apply_root_eq_add {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {i k : ι} (hki : k ≠ i) {z : ℤ} (h : w (P.root k) = P.root k + (z : K) • P.root i) :
    0 ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hQ : P.root k + (z : K) • P.root i = P.rootOf (Pi.single k 1 + z • Pi.single i 1) := by
    rw [map_add, map_zsmul, rootOf_single, rootOf_single, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K]
  rcases P.apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos hA hw k with ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩ | ⟨l, hl, hwl⟩
  · have := P.rootOf_injective (hQ.symm.trans (h.symm.trans hwl))
    have := congr_fun this i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_apply, hki.symm, ↓reduceIte,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add] at this
    rw [this]
    exact hl i
  · have := P.rootOf_injective (show P.rootOf (Pi.single k 1 + z • Pi.single i 1) = P.rootOf (-l)
      by rw [← hQ, ← h, hwl, map_neg])
    have := congr_fun this k
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_apply, hki, ↓reduceIte,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, Pi.neg_apply] at this
    have := hl k
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at this
    omega

name: Matrix.Realization.mul_reflection_mul_inv_eq
statement:
theorem mul_reflection_mul_inv_eq {u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hu : u ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {i j : ι} (h : u (P.root j) = P.root i) :
    u * P.reflection hA j * u⁻¹ = P.reflection hA i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set g := P.reflection hA i * (u * P.reflection hA j * u⁻¹) with hg
  have hgW : g ∈ P.weylGroup hA := mul_mem (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i)
    (mul_mem (mul_mem hu (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA j)) (inv_mem hu))
  
  let ψ : Dual K H → K := fun μ ↦ (u⁻¹ μ) (P.coroot j) - μ (P.coroot i)
  have hui : u⁻¹ (P.root i) = P.root j := by rw [← h]; simp
  have hψi : ψ (P.root i) = 0 := by
    simp only [ψ, hui, P.root_coroot_self hA, sub_self]
  have hgμ : ∀ μ, g μ = μ + ψ μ • P.root i := by
    intro μ
    simp only [hg, ψ, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, h,
      P.root_coroot_self hA]
    rw [show u (u⁻¹ μ) = μ from u.apply_symm_apply μ]
    module
  have hψlin : ∀ μ ν : Dual K H, ∀ c : K, ψ (μ - c • ν) = ψ μ - c * ψ ν := by
    intro μ ν c
    simp only [ψ, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hginv : ∀ μ, g⁻¹ μ = μ - ψ μ • P.root i := by
    intro μ
    have : g (μ - ψ μ • P.root i) = μ := by
      rw [hgμ, hψlin, hψi, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      abel
    conv_lhs => rw [← this]
    exact g.symm_apply_apply _
  
  have hψk : ∀ k, ψ (P.root k) = 0 := by
    intro k
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · rw [hki, hψi]
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ := P.exists_int_apply_root_coroot hA (inv_mem hu) j k
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : ℤ, ψ (P.root k) = z :=
      ⟨z₁ - A i k, by simp only [ψ, hz₁, P.root_coroot]; push_cast; ring⟩
    have h1 := P.nonneg_of_apply_root_eq_add hA hgW hki (z := z) (by rw [hgμ, hz])
    have h2 := P.nonneg_of_apply_root_eq_add hA (inv_mem hgW) hki (z := -z)
      (by rw [hginv, hz]; push_cast; module)
    rw [hz, show z = 0 by omega, Int.cast_zero]
  have hg1 : g = 1 := P.eq_one_of_forall_apply_root_eq hA hgW fun k ↦ by
    rw [hgμ, hψk, zero_smul, add_zero]
  calc u * P.reflection hA j * u⁻¹
      = P.reflection hA i * g := by
        rw [hg, ← mul_assoc, reflection_mul_self, one_mul]
    _ = P.reflection hA i := by rw [hg1, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_root_of_reflection_apply
statement:
lemma eq_root_of_reflection_apply {u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hu : u ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {i j : ι} {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) (huk : u (P.root i) = P.rootOf k)
    {l : ι → ℤ} (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hrl : P.reflection hA j (u (P.root i)) = -P.rootOf l) :
    u (P.root i) = P.root j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rw [huk, reflection_rootOf] at hrl
  have hkl := P.rootOf_injective (hrl.trans (map_neg _ _).symm)
  have hkj : ∀ x, x ≠ j → k x = 0 := fun x hx ↦ by
    have h1 := congr_fun hkl x
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_apply, hx, ↓reduceIte, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_zero, sub_zero, Pi.neg_apply] at h1
    have := hk x; have := hl x
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at *
    omega
  have hγ : u (P.root i) = (k j : K) • P.root j := by
    rw [huk, P.rootOf_eq_smul_root_of_eq_zero hkj]
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := P.exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf hA (inv_mem hu) (Pi.single j 1)
  rw [rootOf_single] at hm
  have h1 : P.root i = (k j : K) • P.rootOf m := by
    rw [← hm, ← map_smul, ← hγ]
    exact (u.symm_apply_apply _).symm
  have h2 : Pi.single i 1 = k j • m := P.rootOf_injective (by
    rw [rootOf_single, map_zsmul, h1, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K])
  have h3 := congr_fun h2 i
  simp only [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h3
  have hkj1 : k j = 1 := by
    have := hk j
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at this
    rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one' h3.symm with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ <;> omega
  rw [hγ, hkj1, Int.cast_one, one_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_mul_reflection_eq_eraseIdx
statement:
theorem exists_mul_reflection_eq_eraseIdx (ω : List ι) {i : ι} {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hw : (ω.map (P.reflection hA)).prod (P.root i) = -P.rootOf k) :
    ∃ s < ω.length, (ω.map (P.reflection hA)).prod * P.reflection hA i =
      ((ω.eraseIdx s).map (P.reflection hA)).prod
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let u : ℕ → Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H := fun m ↦ ((ω.drop m).map (P.reflection hA)).prod
  have huW : ∀ m, u m ∈ P.weylGroup hA := fun m ↦ Subgroup.list_prod_mem _ fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA y
  let pos : ℕ → Prop := fun m ↦ ∃ l : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ l ∧ u m (P.root i) = P.rootOf l
  have hpos_len : pos ω.length := ⟨Pi.single i 1, fun x ↦ by
    by_cases hx : x = i <;> simp [hx], by simp only [u, List.drop_length]; simp⟩
  let m₀ := Nat.find ⟨_, hpos_len⟩
  have hm₀ : pos m₀ := Nat.find_spec ⟨_, hpos_len⟩
  have hm₀le : m₀ ≤ ω.length := Nat.find_min' ⟨_, hpos_len⟩ hpos_len
  have hm₀0 : m₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hul⟩ := hm₀
    rw [h0] at hul
    simp only [u, List.drop_zero] at hul
    have := P.eq_zero_of_mem_closure_of_neg_mem ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩)
      ((P.mem_closure_range_root_iff).mpr ⟨k, hk, by rw [← hul, hw, neg_neg]⟩)
    rw [← hul, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at this
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i this
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, m₀ = s + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm₀0
  have hslt : s < ω.length := by omega
  have hnpos : ¬pos s := Nat.find_min ⟨_, hpos_len⟩ (by omega)
  set j := ω[s] with hj
  have hdrop : ω.drop s = j :: ω.drop (s + 1) := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hslt
  have hus : u s = P.reflection hA j * u (s + 1) := by
    simp only [u, hdrop, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hul⟩ : pos (s + 1) := hs ▸ hm₀
  obtain ⟨l', hl', hul'⟩ : ∃ l' : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ l' ∧
      P.reflection hA j (u (s + 1) (P.root i)) = -P.rootOf l' := by
    rcases P.apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos hA (huW s) i with h | h
    · exact absurd h hnpos
    · simpa only [hus, LinearEquiv.mul_apply] using h
  have hαj := P.eq_root_of_reflection_apply hA (huW (s + 1)) hl hul hl' hul'
  have hconj := P.mul_reflection_mul_inv_eq hA (huW (s + 1)) hαj
  refine ⟨s, hslt, ?_⟩
  have htake : (ω.map (P.reflection hA)).prod =
      ((ω.take s).map (P.reflection hA)).prod * P.reflection hA j * u (s + 1) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← hus]
    simp only [u, ← List.prod_append, ← List.map_append, List.take_append_drop]
  rw [List.eraseIdx_eq_take_drop_succ, List.map_append, List.prod_append, htake]
  change _ = _ * u (s + 1)
  rw [← hconj]
  simp only [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left, reflection_mul_self, mul_one]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_int_corootPairing_of_forall_int
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA (v⁻¹).2 hc
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hc i
  refine ⟨z + (A *ᵥ k) i, ?_⟩
  change ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) c (P.coroot i) = _
  rw [hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hz, P.rootOf_apply_coroot]
  exact (Int.cast_add _ _).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.root_integral
statement: lemma root_integral (j t : ι) : ∃ z : ℤ, P.root j (P.coroot t) = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(A *ᵥ Pi.single j 1) t, ?_⟩
  rw [← P.rootOf_apply_coroot, rootOf_single]

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_integral
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA w.2 hc
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hc t
  refine ⟨z + (A *ᵥ k) t, ?_⟩
  rw [hk, LinearMap.add_apply, hz, P.rootOf_apply_coroot]
  exact (Int.cast_add _ _).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_symmetrizer_corootPairing_mul
statement:
lemma exists_symmetrizer_corootPairing_mul : ∃ d : ι → ℤ, (∀ t, 0 < d t) ∧
    ∀ {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (y : Dual K H) (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) (b : ι → ℤ),
      (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf b →
        P.corootPairing hA y v i * d i = ∑ t, (b t : K) * y (P.coroot t) * d t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  refine ⟨d, hdpos, fun {hA} y v i b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  have hd (t : ι) : (d t : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hdpos t).ne'
  have hroot (z : Dual K H) (t : ι) : B z (P.root t) = z (P.coroot t) * d t := by
    rw [dualBilinForm_root_right]
    simp only [S, Symmetrization.ofDiagonal]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have hform : B y ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) =
      P.corootPairing hA y v i * d i := by
    rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S (v⁻¹).2, inv_apply_apply, hroot]
    rfl
  have hsum : B y (P.rootOf b) = ∑ t, (b t : K) * (y (P.coroot t) * d t) := by
    simp only [rootOf, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      hroot]
  rw [hb, hsum] at hform
  rw [← hform]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ by ring

name: Matrix.Realization.one_le_of_corootPairing_rho_eq
statement:
lemma one_le_of_corootPairing_rho_eq {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι}
    (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) {m : ℤ} (hm : P.corootPairing hA P.rho v i = m) : 1 ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hd⟩ := exists_symmetrizer_corootPairing_mul (P := P) hF
  obtain ⟨b, hb0, hb⟩ := hv
  have h := hd P.rho v i b hb
  simp only [rho_coroot, mul_one, hm] at h
  have hz : m * d i = ∑ t, b t * d t := by exact_mod_cast h
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, b t ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    have : b = 0 := funext fun s ↦ not_not.mp fun h ↦ hall ⟨s, h⟩
    rw [this, map_zero] at hb
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp hb)
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ t, b t * d t :=
    Finset.sum_pos' (fun s _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hb0 s) (hdpos s).le)
      ⟨t, Finset.mem_univ _, mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hb0 t) (Ne.symm ht)) (hdpos t)⟩
  have hdi := hdpos i
  by_contra h1
  have : m * d i ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by omega) hdi.le
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_wall_shift
statement:
theorem exists_wall_shift {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (u : P.weylGroup hA) (j : ι) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 1 ≤ D ∧ ∀ x : Dual K H,
      (∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA x v i = n → n ≤ -D) →
      P.IsPosRoot hA u j → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x u j →
      (∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i →
        (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ≠ (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) →
          P.IsPosRoot hA (P.reflectionOf hA u j * v) i) →
      ∃ c : Dual K H, (∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, c (P.coroot t) = z) ∧
        P.corootPairing hA (x + c) u j = 0 ∧
        ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → ∀ m : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA (x + c) v i = m →
          m < 0 ∨ (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) =
            (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite (P.weylGroup hA) := P.finite_weylGroup hF
  set γ := (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) with hγdef
  set r := (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) P.rho with hrdef
  have hγ : ∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, γ (P.coroot t) = z := apply_integral u (root_integral j)
  have hr : ∀ t, ∃ z : ℤ, r (P.coroot t) = z :=
    apply_integral u fun t ↦ ⟨1, by rw [rho_coroot, Int.cast_one]⟩
  choose fγ hfγ using exists_int_corootPairing_of_forall_int (hA := hA) hγ
  choose fr hfr using exists_int_corootPairing_of_forall_int (hA := hA) hr
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (Set.finite_range fun p : P.weylGroup hA × ι ↦
    2 * fr p.1 p.2 - fγ p.1 p.2).bddAbove
  refine ⟨M.toNat + 1, by omega, fun x hdeep hu hux hsimple ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := hux
  change P.corootPairing hA x u j = a₀ at ha₀
  have ha₀D := hdeep u j hu a₀ ha₀
  set n := (-a₀).toNat with hn
  have hna : (n : ℤ) = -a₀ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
  set q := n / 2
  set ε := n % 2
  have hqε : n = 2 * q + ε := (Nat.div_add_mod n 2).symm
  have hε : ε < 2 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  refine ⟨(q : K) • γ + (ε : K) • r, fun t ↦ ?_, ?_, fun v i hv m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ := hγ t
    obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂⟩ := hr t
    refine ⟨q * z₁ + ε * z₂, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hz₁, hz₂, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  · have hγγ : P.corootPairing hA γ u j = 2 := corootPairing_apply_root_self u j
    have hrr : P.corootPairing hA r u j = 1 := by
      rw [hrdef, corootPairing_apply, inv_mul_cancel, corootPairing_one, rho_coroot]
    rw [corootPairing_add, corootPairing_add, corootPairing_smul, corootPairing_smul, hγγ, hrr,
      ha₀]
    have : (a₀ : K) = -((2 * q + ε : ℕ) : K) := by
      rw [← hqε, ← Int.cast_natCast, hna, Int.cast_neg, neg_neg]
    rw [this]
    push_cast
    ring
  by_cases hvγ : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = γ
  · exact Or.inr hvγ
  left
  have hc : P.corootPairing hA ((q : K) • γ + (ε : K) • r) v i = q * fγ v i + ε * fr v i := by
    rw [corootPairing_add, corootPairing_smul, corootPairing_smul, hfγ, hfr]
  set a := m - (q * fγ v i + ε * fr v i) with ha
  have hxa : P.corootPairing hA x v i = a := by
    rw [corootPairing_add, hc] at hm
    rw [ha]
    push_cast
    linear_combination hm
  have hvx : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i := ⟨a, hxa⟩
  have hsv := hsimple v i hv hvx hvγ
  have hb : P.corootPairing hA x (P.reflectionOf hA u j * v) i =
      ((a + fγ v i * n : ℤ) : K) := by
    have hnK : (n : K) = -(a₀ : K) := by exact_mod_cast hna
    rw [corootPairing_reflectionOf_mul, hxa, hfγ, ha₀]
    push_cast
    rw [hnK]
    ring
  have hbD := hdeep _ i hsv _ hb
  have haD := hdeep v i hv a hxa
  have hMv : 2 * fr v i - fγ v i ≤ M := hM ⟨(v, i), rfl⟩
  have hMt : M ≤ (M.toNat : ℤ) := Int.self_le_toNat M
  have h2m : 2 * m = a + (a + fγ v i * n) + ε * (2 * fr v i - fγ v i) := by
    rw [ha, hqε]
    push_cast
    ring
  interval_cases ε <;> push_cast at h2m ⊢ <;> omega

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_reflection
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_reflection (i : ι) (μ μ' : Dual K H) :
    P.dualBilinForm S (P.reflection hA i μ) (P.reflection hA i μ') =
      P.dualBilinForm S μ μ'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := P.dualBilinForm_root_right S μ i
  have h2 : P.dualBilinForm S (P.root i) μ' = μ' (P.coroot i) / S.ε i := by
    rw [(P.isSymm_dualBilinForm S).eq]
    exact P.dualBilinForm_root_right S μ' i
  have h3 := P.dualBilinForm_root_right S (P.root i) i
  rw [P.root_coroot, hA.diag] at h3
  have hε : (S.ε i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast S.ε_ne_zero i
  simp only [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, h1, h2, h3]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_weylGroup
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_weylGroup {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    (μ μ' : Dual K H) : P.dualBilinForm S (w μ) (w μ') = P.dualBilinForm S μ μ'
proof:
:= by
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA (p := fun w ↦ ∀ μ μ',
    P.dualBilinForm S (w μ) (w μ') = P.dualBilinForm S μ μ') (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun i w ih μ μ' ↦ ?_) hw μ μ'
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, dualBilinForm_reflection, ih]

name: Matrix.Realization.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf
statement:
theorem dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf (d : ι → ℤ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm) (k : ι → ℤ) (x : Dual K H) :
    P.dualBilinForm (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hd hsymm) (P.rootOf k) x =
      ∑ i, ((k i * d i : ℤ) : K) * x (P.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.rootOf_apply, map_sum (P.dualBilinForm (Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hd hsymm)),
    LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, (P.isSymm_dualBilinForm _).eq, dualBilinForm_root_right,
    smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [Symmetrization.ofDiagonal]
  push_cast
  have hi : (d i : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hd i).ne'
  field_simp

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_rootLattice
statement: lemma mem_rootLattice {μ : Dual K H} : μ ∈ P.rootLattice ↔ ∃ k, P.rootOf k = μ
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.mem_range

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_mem_rootLattice
statement: lemma rootOf_mem_rootLattice (k : ι → ℤ) : P.rootOf k ∈ P.rootLattice
proof: := ⟨k, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice
statement:
lemma exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.rootLattice) (j : ι) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, μ (P.coroot j) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hμ
  exact ⟨_, P.rootOf_apply_coroot k j⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_mem_rootLattice
statement:
lemma apply_mem_rootLattice {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA)
    {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.rootLattice) : w μ ∈ P.rootLattice
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hμ
  obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := P.exists_apply_rootOf_eq_rootOf hA hw k
  exact ⟨k', hk'.symm⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_apply_eq_add_rootOf hA hw hμ
  exact ⟨k, by rw [hk, add_sub_cancel_left]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_int_of_smul_root_mem_rootLattice
statement:
lemma exists_int_of_smul_root_mem_rootLattice {c : K} {i : ι}
    (h : c • P.root i ∈ P.rootLattice) : ∃ z : ℤ, c = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  refine ⟨k i, ?_⟩
  have h1 : ∑ j, (if j = i then c else 0) • P.root j = c • P.root i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ by rw [ite_eq_right hj, zero_smul])
      (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h),
      ite_eq_left rfl]
  have h0 : ∑ j, ((k j : K) - if j = i then c else 0) • P.root j = 0 := by
    have e : ∑ j, ((k j : K) - if j = i then c else 0) • P.root j =
        P.rootOf k - c • P.root i := by
      rw [← h1, rootOf_apply, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ by split_ifs <;> simp [sub_mul]
    rw [e, hk, sub_self]
  have := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_root _ h0 i
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl] at this
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp this).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.one_apply'
statement: private lemma one_apply' (μ : Dual K H) : (1 : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ = μ
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_integralWeylGroup
statement:
lemma mem_integralWeylGroup {μ : Dual K H} {w : P.weylGroup hA} :
    w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA μ ↔ (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ - μ ∈ P.rootLattice
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, mem_integralWeylGroup]
  have hd := P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hA w.2 h
  have e : (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ - μ = ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ' - μ') +
      ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ - μ') - (μ - μ')) := by
    rw [map_sub]
    abel
  rw [e]
  exact ⟨fun h' ↦ by simpa using sub_mem h' hd, fun h' ↦ add_mem h' hd⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.integralWeylGroup_eq_top
statement:
theorem integralWeylGroup_eq_top {μ : Dual K H} (h : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, μ (P.coroot j) = z) :
    P.integralWeylGroup hA μ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro w _
  exact P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hA w.2 h

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot
statement:
theorem mem_integralWeylGroup_iff_dot {μ : Dual K H} {w : P.weylGroup hA} :
    w ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA μ ↔
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (μ + P.rho) - P.rho - μ ∈ P.rootLattice
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.integralWeylGroup_eq_of_integral hA (μ' := μ + P.rho) fun j ↦ ⟨-1, by simp⟩,
    mem_integralWeylGroup, sub_sub, add_comm P.rho μ]

name: Matrix.Realization.reflectionOf_apply
statement:
lemma reflectionOf_apply (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (P.reflectionOf hA v i : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ =
      μ - ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ (P.coroot i) •
        (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)
proof:
:= by
  change (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.reflection hA i
    (((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ)) = _
  rw [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul,
    mul_inv_cancel, Subgroup.coe_one, one_apply']

name: Matrix.Realization.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_integralWeylGroup, reflectionOf_apply, sub_sub_cancel_left]
  set c := ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ (P.coroot i)
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA (v⁻¹).2 (neg_mem h)
    rw [neg_neg, map_smul, ← LinearEquiv.mul_apply, ← Subgroup.coe_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
      Subgroup.coe_one, one_apply'] at h'
    exact P.exists_int_of_smul_root_mem_rootLattice h'
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [show c = z from hz, ← map_smul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K z (P.root i), ← rootOf_single,
      ← map_zsmul]
    exact neg_mem (P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA v.2 (P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice _))

name: Matrix.Realization.isIntegralRoot_congr
statement:
theorem isIntegralRoot_congr {μ μ' : Dual K H} (h : ∀ j, ∃ z : ℤ, (μ - μ') (P.coroot j) = z)
    (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.IsIntegralRoot hA μ v i ↔ P.IsIntegralRoot hA μ' v i
proof:
:= by
  have hd := P.apply_sub_mem_rootLattice_of_integral hA (v⁻¹).2 h
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice hd i
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := h i
  have e : ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ (P.coroot i) =
      ((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ' (P.coroot i) + ((z + z' : ℤ) : K) := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply] at hz hz'
    push_cast
    linear_combination hz + hz'
  unfold IsIntegralRoot
  rw [e]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n - (z + z'), by push_cast at hn ⊢; rw [← hn]; ring⟩,
    fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n + (z + z'), by push_cast at hn ⊢; rw [hn]⟩⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.isIntegralRoot_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hv
  have hw' : (((w⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) μ - μ) ∈ P.rootLattice :=
    inv_mem hw
  have hq := P.apply_mem_rootLattice hA (v⁻¹).2 hw'
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := P.exists_int_of_mem_rootLattice hq i
  refine ⟨n + z, ?_⟩
  rw [show (w * v)⁻¹ = v⁻¹ * w⁻¹ by group, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply] at hz
  push_cast
  linear_combination hz + hn

name: Matrix.Realization.mul_reflectionOf_mul_inv
statement:
lemma mul_reflectionOf_mul_inv (w v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    w * P.reflectionOf hA v i * w⁻¹ = P.reflectionOf hA (w * v) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reflectionOf]
  group

name: Matrix.Realization.integralReflectionGroup_le
statement:
theorem integralReflectionGroup_le (μ : Dual K H) :
    P.integralReflectionGroup hA μ ≤ P.integralWeylGroup hA μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralReflectionGroup, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨v, i, hv, rfl⟩
  exact (P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff hA v i).mpr hv

name: Matrix.IsGeneralizedCartan.transpose
statement:
lemma transpose (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) : Aᵀ.IsGeneralizedCartan where
  diag i
proof:
:= by simpa using hA.diag i
  offDiag_nonpos i j hij := by simpa using hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  zero_comm i j := by simpa using hA.zero_comm j i

name: Matrix.IsGeneralizedCartan.toNat_neg_eq
statement:
lemma toNat_neg_eq (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ((-A i j).toNat : ℤ) = -A i j
proof:
:= by
  have := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  omega

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.isGeneralizedCartan
proof:
:= hA.diag
  offDiag_nonpos := hA.offDiag_nonpos
  zero_comm := hA.zero_comm

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.isSymmetrizable
statement:
lemma IsFiniteCartan.isSymmetrizable {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) :
    A.IsSymmetrizable
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdA⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  exact ⟨d, hd, hdA.isHermitian⟩

name: Matrix.IsSymmetrizable.of_isSymm
statement: lemma IsSymmetrizable.of_isSymm {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} (hA : A.IsSymm) : A.IsSymmetrizable
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, fun _ ↦ one_pos, by simpa [← Pi.one_def] using hA⟩

name: Matrix.isSymmetrizable_iff_mul_eq_mul
statement:
lemma isSymmetrizable_iff_mul_eq_mul {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} :
    A.IsSymmetrizable ↔ ∃ d : ι → ℤ, (∀ i, 0 < d i) ∧ ∀ i j, d i * A i j = d j * A j i
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_congr fun d ↦ and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ?_
  rw [IsSymm, ← Matrix.ext_iff]
  simp only [transpose_apply, diagonal_mul]
  exact ⟨fun h i j ↦ (h j i), fun h i j ↦ h j i⟩

name: Matrix.isSymmetrizable_iff_exists_eq_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem isSymmetrizable_iff_exists_eq_diagonal_mul {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} :
    A.IsSymmetrizable ↔ ∃ (ε : ι → ℚ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℚ), (∀ i, 0 < ε i) ∧ B.IsSymm ∧
      A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) = diagonal ε * B
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSymmetrizable_iff_mul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, hdA⟩
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ (d i : ℚ)⁻¹, of fun i j ↦ d i * A i j, fun i ↦ by simpa using hd i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · ext i j; simp only [transpose_apply, of_apply]; exact_mod_cast hdA j i
    · ext i j
      have : (d i : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hd i).ne'
      simp [diagonal_mul, this]
  · rintro ⟨ε, B, hε, hB, hAB⟩
    
    let N : ℕ := ∏ i, (ε i)⁻¹.den
    have hN : ∀ i, ∃ m : ℤ, (N : ℚ) * (ε i)⁻¹ = m := by
      intro i
      refine ⟨((N / (ε i)⁻¹.den : ℕ) : ℤ) * (ε i)⁻¹.num, ?_⟩
      have hdvd : (ε i)⁻¹.den ∣ N := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have h1 : ((N / (ε i)⁻¹.den : ℕ) : ℚ) * (ε i)⁻¹.den = N := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_cancel hdvd
      rw [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, ← Rat.mul_den_eq_num, ← h1]
      ring
    choose d hd using hN
    have hNpos : (0 : ℚ) < N := by
      have : 0 < N := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ Rat.den_pos _
      exact_mod_cast this
    refine ⟨d, fun i ↦ ?_, fun i j ↦ ?_⟩
    · have : (0 : ℚ) < d i := by rw [← hd]; exact mul_pos hNpos (inv_pos.mpr (hε i))
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have hA : ∀ i j, (A i j : ℚ) = ε i * B i j := fun i j ↦ by
        simpa [diagonal_mul] using congr_fun₂ hAB i j
      have : (d i : ℚ) * A i j = d j * A j i := by
        rw [← hd, ← hd, hA, hA, hB.apply j i]
        field_simp [(hε i).ne', (hε j).ne']
      exact_mod_cast this

name: Matrix.Realization.rootMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma rootMap_apply (P : Realization A K H) (h : H) (j : ι) :
    P.rootMap h j = P.root j h
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.rootMap_corootMap
statement:
lemma rootMap_corootMap (P : Realization A K H) (c : ι → K) :
    P.rootMap (P.corootMap c) = c ᵥ* A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → K)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [corootMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, vecMul, dotProduct, root_coroot]

name: Matrix.Realization.corootMap_injective
statement: lemma corootMap_injective (P : Realization A K H) : Function.Injective P.corootMap
proof:
:=
  P.linearIndependent_coroot.fintypeLinearCombination_injective

name: Matrix.Realization.rootMap_surjective
statement:
lemma rootMap_surjective [FiniteDimensional K H] (P : Realization A K H) :
    Function.Surjective P.rootMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← LinearMap.dualMap_injective_iff, ← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro φ hφ
  let c : ι → K := fun i ↦ φ fun j ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0
  have h : ∑ j, c j • P.root j = 0 := by
    ext h
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ h
    simp only [LinearMap.dualMap_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, ← this, LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ φ (P.rootMap h)]
    simp [c, LinearMap.sum_apply, mul_comm]
  have h' := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_root c h
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ φ v]
  simp [show ∀ i, (φ fun j ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0) = 0 from h']

name: Matrix.Realization.finrank_ker_rootMap
statement:
lemma finrank_ker_rootMap [FiniteDimensional K H] (P : Realization A K H) :
    finrank K (LinearMap.ker P.rootMap) + Fintype.card ι = finrank K H
proof:
:= by
  have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker P.rootMap
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr P.rootMap_surjective, finrank_top, finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
    at this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.ker_rootMap_le
statement:
lemma ker_rootMap_le [FiniteDimensional K H] (P : Realization A K H) :
    LinearMap.ker P.rootMap ≤ LinearMap.range P.corootMap
proof:
:= by
  set AK := A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → K)
  set N := LinearMap.ker (P.rootMap ∘ₗ P.corootMap)
  have hN : N = LinearMap.ker AKᵀ.mulVecLin := by
    ext c
    simp only [N, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, rootMap_corootMap, mulVecLin_apply,
      mulVec_transpose, AK]
  have hfinN : finrank K N + AK.rank = Fintype.card ι := by
    have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker AKᵀ.mulVecLin
    rw [finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, ← hN] at this
    rw [← rank_transpose AK, rank]
    omega
  have hle : N.map P.corootMap ≤ LinearMap.ker P.rootMap := by
    rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    simpa [N] using hc
  have heq : N.map P.corootMap = LinearMap.ker P.rootMap := by
    refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle ?_
    rw [← (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ P.corootMap_injective N).finrank_eq]
    have := P.finrank_ker_rootMap
    have : finrank K H + AK.rank = 2 * Fintype.card ι := P.finrank_add_rank
    omega
  rw [← heq]
  exact LinearMap.map_le_range

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_linearEquiv [FiniteDimensional K H] [FiniteDimensional K H']
    (P : Realization A K H) (Q : Realization A K H') :
    ∃ e : H ≃ₗ[K] H', (∀ i, e (P.coroot i) = Q.coroot i) ∧ ∀ i h, Q.root i (e h) = P.root i h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := P.corootMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr P.corootMap_injective)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Q.rootMap.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr Q.rootMap_surjective)
  let φ : H →ₗ[K] H' :=
    Q.corootMap ∘ₗ π + σ ∘ₗ P.rootMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.id - P.corootMap ∘ₗ π)
  have hQP : ∀ c, Q.rootMap (Q.corootMap c) = P.rootMap (P.corootMap c) := by
    intro c; rw [rootMap_corootMap, rootMap_corootMap]
  have hσ' : ∀ v, Q.rootMap (σ v) = v := fun v ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun hσ v
  have hφroot : ∀ h, Q.rootMap (φ h) = P.rootMap h := by
    intro h
    simp only [φ, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.id_apply, map_add, hσ', hQP, map_sub]
    abel
  have hπc : ∀ c, π (P.corootMap c) = c := fun c ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun hπ c
  have hφcoroot : ∀ c, φ (P.corootMap c) = Q.corootMap c := by
    intro c
    simp [φ, hπc]
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro h hh
    have hker : h ∈ LinearMap.ker P.rootMap := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ← hφroot, hh, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := P.ker_rootMap_le hker
    rw [hφcoroot] at hh
    rw [Q.corootMap_injective (hh.trans (map_zero _).symm), map_zero]
  have hdim : finrank K H = finrank K H' := by
    have := P.finrank_add_rank; have := Q.finrank_add_rank; omega
