  refine ⟨LinearMap.linearEquivOfInjective φ hinj hdim, fun i ↦ ?_, fun i h ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := hφcoroot (Pi.single i 1)
    simpa [corootMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Pi.single_apply] using this
  · exact congr_fun (hφroot h) i

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_apply
statement:
lemma rootOf_apply (P : Realization A K H) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    P.rootOf k = ∑ i, (k i : K) • P.root i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma rootOf_single [DecidableEq ι] (P : Realization A K H) (i : ι) :
    P.rootOf (Pi.single i 1) = P.root i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootOf_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_apply_coroot
statement:
lemma rootOf_apply_coroot (P : Realization A K H) (k : ι → ℤ) (j : ι) :
    P.rootOf k (P.coroot j) = ((A *ᵥ k) j : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootOf_apply, P.root_coroot, mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm]

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_injective
statement: lemma rootOf_injective [CharZero K] (P : Realization A K H) : Function.Injective P.rootOf
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro k hk
  have := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_root (fun i ↦ (k i : K)) hk
  ext i
  exact_mod_cast this i

name: Matrix.Realization.rootOf_ne_zero
statement:
lemma rootOf_ne_zero [CharZero K] (P : Realization A K H) {k : ι → ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    P.rootOf k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Ne, ← map_zero P.rootOf, P.rootOf_injective.eq_iff]

name: Matrix.Realization.stdProj_subtype
statement: lemma stdProj_subtype (c : stdKer A K) : stdProj A K c = c
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun
    ((stdKer A K).subtype.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (stdKer A K).ker_subtype).choose_spec c

name: Matrix.Realization.stdRoot_apply
statement:
lemma stdRoot_apply [DecidableEq ι] (j : ι) (v : ι → K) (f : Dual K (stdKer A K)) :
    stdRoot A K j (v, f) = (v ᵥ* A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → K)) j + f (stdProj A K (Pi.single j 1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.linearIndependent_stdRoot
statement: lemma linearIndependent_stdRoot [DecidableEq ι] : LinearIndependent K (stdRoot A K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro c hc
  
  have h1 : A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → K) *ᵥ c = 0 := by
    ext i
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hc (Pi.single i 1, 0)
    simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, stdRoot_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      add_zero, smul_eq_mul, single_vecMul, one_smul] at this
    simpa [mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm] using this
  
  have h2 : ∀ f : Dual K (stdKer A K), f ⟨c, h1⟩ = 0 := by
    intro f
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hc (0, f)
    simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, stdRoot_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      zero_vecMul, Pi.zero_apply, zero_add, smul_eq_mul] at this
    have hc' : c = ∑ j, c j • Pi.single j 1 := by
      ext k; simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    calc f ⟨c, h1⟩ = f (stdProj A K c) := by rw [← stdProj_subtype A K ⟨c, h1⟩]
      _ = ∑ j, c j * f (stdProj A K (Pi.single j 1)) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hc']
        simp [map_sum]
      _ = 0 := this
  have := (forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K (⟨c, h1⟩ : stdKer A K)).mp h2
  intro i
  exact congr_fun (congr_arg Subtype.val this) i

name: Matrix.Realization.nonempty_realization
statement: theorem nonempty_realization : Nonempty (Realization A K (StdSpace A K))
proof:
:= by
  classical exact ⟨std A K⟩

name: Matrix.PosDef.dotProduct_mulVec_sq_le
statement:
lemma PosDef.dotProduct_mulVec_sq_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {M : Matrix ι ι ℤ} (hM : M.PosDef)
    (hs : M.IsSymm) (b c : ι → ℤ) :
    (b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c) ^ 2 ≤ (b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b) * (c ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c) ∧
      ((b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c) ^ 2 = (b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b) * (c ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c) →
        (b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b) • c = (b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c) • b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcb : c ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b = b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c := by
    rw [dotProduct_mulVec, dotProduct_comm, ← mulVec_transpose, hs.eq]
  set p := b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b
  set m := b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c
  set q := c ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c
  set e := p • c - m • b with he
  have hee : e ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ e = p * (p * q - m ^ 2) := by
    simp only [he, mulVec_sub, mulVec_smul, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcb]
    ring
  have hnn : ∀ f : ι → ℤ, 0 ≤ f ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ f := fun f ↦ by
    by_cases hf : f = 0
    · simp [hf]
    · simpa using (hM.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hf).le
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · simp [p, m, hb]
  have hp : 0 < p := by simpa using hM.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hb
  have h1 : 0 ≤ p * q - m ^ 2 := by
    have := hnn e
    rw [hee] at this
    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right (by linarith) hp
  refine ⟨by linarith, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have h0 : e ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ e = 0 := by rw [hee, h, sub_self, mul_zero]
  have he0 : e = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have := hM.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    simp only [star_trivial] at this
    omega
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp he0

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_apply_root_eq_rootOf
statement:
lemma exists_apply_root_eq_rootOf {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    ∃ b : ι → ℤ, (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) = P.rootOf b
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos hA v.2 i with ⟨k, -, h⟩ | ⟨k, -, h⟩
  · exact ⟨k, h⟩
  · exact ⟨-k, by rw [h, map_neg]⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_root_ne_two_smul
statement:
lemma apply_root_ne_two_smul {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (v u : P.weylGroup hA) (i j : ι) :
    (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ≠
      (2 : K) • (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_apply_root_eq_rootOf (v⁻¹ * u) j
  have h' : P.root i = (2 : K) • (((v⁻¹ * u : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)
      (P.root j)) := by
    have := congrArg (((v⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H)) h
    rw [inv_apply_apply, map_smul] at this
    rw [this, Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
  rw [he, two_smul, ← map_add, ← P.rootOf_single] at h'
  have := congrFun (P.rootOf_injective h') i
  simp at this
  omega

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_apply_root_self
statement:
lemma corootPairing_apply_root_self {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
    P.corootPairing hA ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) v i = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [corootPairing, inv_apply_apply, P.root_coroot_self hA]

name: Matrix.Realization.mul_le_three_of_ne
statement:
lemma mul_le_three_of_ne {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} {v u : P.weylGroup hA} {i j : ι}
    (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) (hu : P.IsPosRoot hA u j)
    (hne : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ≠ (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j))
    {k l : ℤ} (hk : P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)) v i = k)
    (hl : P.corootPairing hA ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) u j = l) :
    k * l ≤ 3 ∧ (0 < k → 0 < l)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hdpos, hpos⟩ := hF.exists_posDef
  have hsymm : (diagonal d * A).IsSymm := by
    simpa [IsHermitian, IsSymm] using hpos.isHermitian
  set S := Symmetrization.ofDiagonal d hdpos hsymm
  set B := P.dualBilinForm S
  set M := diagonal d * A
  have hQ (b c : ι → ℤ) : B (P.rootOf b) (P.rootOf c) = ((b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c : ℤ) : K) := by
    rw [P.dualBilinForm_ofDiagonal_rootOf d hdpos hsymm]
    simp_rw [rootOf_apply_coroot]
    push_cast
    simp only [M, dotProduct, ← mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_diagonal]
    push_cast
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ by ring
  have hform (w : P.weylGroup hA) (t : ι) (y : Dual K H) :
      B y ((w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root t)) = P.corootPairing hA y w t * d t := by
    rw [← P.dualBilinForm_weylGroup hA S (w⁻¹).2, inv_apply_apply, dualBilinForm_root_right]
    simp only [S, Symmetrization.ofDiagonal]
    push_cast
    have ht : (d t : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hdpos t).ne'
    rw [corootPairing]
    field_simp
    rfl
  obtain ⟨b, hb0, hb⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc⟩ := hu
  have hbb : b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b = 2 * d i := by
    have h := hform v i ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    rw [corootPairing_apply_root_self, hb, hQ] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hcc : c ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c = 2 * d j := by
    have h := hform u j ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j))
    rw [corootPairing_apply_root_self, hc, hQ] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hcb : c ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b = k * d i := by
    have h := hform v i ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j))
    rw [hk, hb, hc, hQ] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hbc : b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c = l * d j := by
    have h := hform u j ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i))
    rw [hl, hb, hc, hQ] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hsym : c ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ b = b ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ c := by
    rw [dotProduct_mulVec, dotProduct_comm, ← mulVec_transpose, hsymm.eq]
  have hkl : k * d i = l * d j := by rw [← hcb, ← hbc, hsym]
  have hdi := hdpos i
  have hdj := hdpos j
  obtain ⟨hcs, heq⟩ := hpos.dotProduct_mulVec_sq_le hsymm b c
  rw [hbb, hcc, hbc] at hcs heq
  have hle : k * l ≤ 4 := by
    have h4 : (k * l) * (d i * d j) ≤ 4 * (d i * d j) := by
      have : (l * d j) ^ 2 = (k * l) * (d i * d j) := by
        rw [sq]; nth_rewrite 1 [← hkl]; ring
      linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h4 (mul_pos hdi hdj)
  refine ⟨?_, fun hk0 ↦ ?_⟩
  swap
  · by_contra hl0
    have : k * d i ≤ 0 := by rw [hkl]; nlinarith
    nlinarith
  by_contra h3
  have h4 : k * l = 4 := by omega
  have hsq : (l * d j) ^ 2 = 2 * d i * (2 * d j) := by
    have : (l * d j) ^ 2 = (k * l) * (d i * d j) := by
      rw [sq]; nth_rewrite 1 [← hkl]; ring
    rw [this, h4]; ring
  have hvec := heq hsq
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, b t ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    have : b = 0 := funext fun s ↦ not_not.mp fun h ↦ hall ⟨s, h⟩
    rw [this, map_zero] at hb
    exact P.linearIndependent_root.ne_zero i ((LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff _).mp hb)
  have hbt : 0 < b t := lt_of_le_of_ne (hb0 t) (Ne.symm ht)
  have hct := congrFun hvec t
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hct
  have hlpos : 0 < l := by
    by_contra hl0
    have hl0 : l < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hl0) (by rintro rfl; simp at h4)
    have h1 : l * (d j * b t) < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hl0 (mul_pos hdj hbt)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * d i * c t := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hc0 t)
    nlinarith
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hk0
    have hk0 := not_lt.mp hk0
    nlinarith
  have hk4 : k ≤ 4 := by nlinarith
  interval_cases k
  · 
    have hl4 : l = 4 := by omega
    subst hl4
    have hbc2 : b = 2 • c := funext fun s ↦ by
      have := congrFun hvec s
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at this ⊢
      rw [show d i = 4 * d j by linarith] at this
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by positivity : 4 * d j ≠ 0) (by linarith)
    refine apply_root_ne_two_smul (K := K) v u i j ?_
    rw [hb, hc, hbc2, two_smul, map_add, two_smul]
  · 
    have hl2 : l = 2 := by omega
    subst hl2
    have hdd : d i = d j := by linarith
    have hbc2 : c = b := funext fun s ↦ by
      have := congrFun hvec s
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
      rw [hdd] at this
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by positivity) this
    exact hne (by rw [hb, hc, hbc2])
  · omega
  · 
    have hl1 : l = 1 := by omega
    subst hl1
    have hcb2 : c = 2 • b := funext fun s ↦ by
      have := congrFun hvec s
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at this ⊢
      rw [show d j = 4 * d i by linarith] at this
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by positivity : 2 * d i ≠ 0) (by linarith)
    refine apply_root_ne_two_smul (K := K) u v j i ?_
    rw [hb, hc, hcb2, two_smul, map_add, two_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.corootPairing_reflectionOf_mul
statement:
lemma corootPairing_reflectionOf_mul {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (y : Dual K H)
    (u v : P.weylGroup hA) (j i : ι) :
    P.corootPairing hA y (P.reflectionOf hA u j * v) i = P.corootPairing hA y v i -
      P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)) v i *
        P.corootPairing hA y u j
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : (P.reflectionOf hA u j)⁻¹ = P.reflectionOf hA u j :=
    inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (reflectionOf_mul_self u j)
  have h := corootPairing_apply (P.reflectionOf hA u j) v y i
  rw [hinv, reflectionOf_apply', corootPairing_sub, corootPairing_smul] at h
  rw [← h]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.reflectionOf_mul_apply_root
statement:
lemma reflectionOf_mul_apply_root {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} (u v : P.weylGroup hA)
    (j i : ι) :
    ((P.reflectionOf hA u j * v : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) =
      (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) -
        P.corootPairing hA ((v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i)) u j •
          (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflectionOf_apply']

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_iff_of_isIntegralRoot
statement:
lemma isPosRoot_iff_of_isIntegralRoot {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} {x : Dual K H}
    (hx : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA x v i = n → n < 0)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} {n : ℤ} (hn : P.corootPairing hA x v i = n) :
    (P.IsPosRoot hA v i ↔ n < 0) ∧ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hneg : ¬P.IsPosRoot hA v i → 0 < n := fun hv ↦ by
    have h := hx _ i ((isPosRoot_or v i).resolve_left hv) (-n)
      (by rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, hn, Int.cast_neg])
    omega
  refine ⟨⟨fun hv ↦ hx v i hv n hn, fun h ↦ by_contra fun hv ↦ by have := hneg hv; omega⟩, ?_⟩
  by_cases hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i
  · exact (hx v i hv n hn).ne
  · exact (hneg hv).ne'

name: Matrix.Realization.isPosRoot_reflectionOf_mul_of_minimal
statement:
theorem isPosRoot_reflectionOf_mul_of_minimal {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} {x z : Dual K H}
    (hx : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA x v i = n → n < 0)
    (hz : ∀ v i, P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA z v i)
    {u : P.weylGroup hA} {j : ι} (hu : P.IsPosRoot hA u j) (hux : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x u j)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : P.corootPairing hA x u j = -n) {p : ℤ} (hp : P.corootPairing hA z u j = p)
    (hp0 : 0 < p)
    (hmin : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i → ∀ q : ℤ,
      P.corootPairing hA z v i = q → 0 < q → ∀ m : ℕ, P.corootPairing hA x v i = -m → n ≤ m)
    {v : P.weylGroup hA} {i : ι} (hv : P.IsPosRoot hA v i) (hvx : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i)
    (hne : (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ≠ (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)) :
    P.IsPosRoot hA (P.reflectionOf hA u j * v) i
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : ∀ a : ℤ, a ≤ 0 → (a : K) = -(((-a).toNat : ℕ) : K) := fun a ha ↦ by
    rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ -a), Int.cast_neg, neg_neg]
  have hrootQ : ∀ (w : P.weylGroup hA) t, P.IsPosRoot hA w t →
      (w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root t) ∈ P.rootLattice :=
    fun w t ⟨c, _, hc⟩ ↦ hc ▸ P.rootOf_mem_rootLattice c
  have hval : ∀ (w : P.weylGroup hA) (t : ι), P.IsIntegralRoot hA x w t →
      ∃ a : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA x w t = a := fun w t h ↦ h
  have hmulS : ∀ (w : P.weylGroup hA) t, P.IsIntegralRoot hA x w t →
      P.IsIntegralRoot hA x (w * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple t) t := fun w t ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦
    ⟨-a, by
      change P.corootPairing hA x w t = a at ha
      change P.corootPairing hA x _ t = _
      rw [corootPairing_mul_simple, ha, Int.cast_neg]⟩
  have hrefl : ∀ (w : P.weylGroup hA) t, P.IsIntegralRoot hA x w t →
      ∀ (w' : P.weylGroup hA) t', P.IsIntegralRoot hA x w' t' →
        P.IsIntegralRoot hA x (P.reflectionOf hA w t * w') t' := fun w t h w' t' h' ↦
    P.isIntegralRoot_mul hA ((P.reflectionOf_mem_integralWeylGroup_iff hA w t).mpr h) h'
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by
    have := hx u j hu (-n) (by rw [hn]; push_cast; rfl)
    omega
  
  have hdec : ∀ (a : P.weylGroup hA) (ta : ι) (b : P.weylGroup hA) (tb : ι),
      P.IsPosRoot hA a ta → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x a ta →
      P.IsPosRoot hA b tb → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x b tb →
      (∀ y, P.corootPairing hA y a ta + P.corootPairing hA y b tb = P.corootPairing hA y u j) →
        False := by
    intro a ta b tb ha hax hb hbx hsum
    obtain ⟨fa, hfa⟩ := hax
    obtain ⟨fb, hfb⟩ := hbx
    change P.corootPairing hA x a ta = fa at hfa
    change P.corootPairing hA x b tb = fb at hfb
    obtain ⟨ga, hga⟩ := hz a ta ⟨fa, hfa⟩
    obtain ⟨gb, hgb⟩ := hz b tb ⟨fb, hfb⟩
    change P.corootPairing hA z a ta = ga at hga
    change P.corootPairing hA z b tb = gb at hgb
    have hfa0 := hx a ta ha fa hfa
    have hfb0 := hx b tb hb fb hfb
    have hf : fa + fb = -(n : ℤ) := by
      have := hsum x
      rw [hfa, hfb, hn] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hg : ga + gb = p := by
      have := hsum z
      rw [hga, hgb, hp] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    rcases lt_or_ge 0 ga with hga0 | hga0
    · have := hmin a ta ha ⟨fa, hfa⟩ ga hga hga0 (-fa).toNat
        (by rw [hfa]; exact hcast fa (by omega))
      omega
    · have := hmin b tb hb ⟨fb, hfb⟩ gb hgb (by omega) (-fb).toNat
        (by rw [hfb]; exact hcast fb (by omega))
      omega
  
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hvx
  change P.corootPairing hA x v i = m₀ at hm₀
  have hm₀' : P.corootPairing hA x v i = -((-m₀).toNat : ℕ) := by
    have := hx v i hv m₀ hm₀
    rw [hm₀]; exact hcast m₀ (by omega)
  clear hm₀
  generalize (-m₀).toNat = m at hm₀'
  have hvx : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i :=
    ⟨-m, by change P.corootPairing hA x v i = _; rw [hm₀', Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]⟩
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v i with
  | _ m ih =>
  set s := P.reflectionOf hA u j with hs
  by_contra hneg
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.exists_int_corootPairing_of_mem_rootLattice (hA := hA)
    (hrootQ u j hu) v i
  have hsv (y : Dual K H) : P.corootPairing hA y (s * v) i =
      P.corootPairing hA y v i - k * P.corootPairing hA y u j := by
    rw [hs, corootPairing_reflectionOf_mul, hk]
  have hsvx : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x (s * v) i := hrefl u j hux v i hvx
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by
    have := hx v i hv (-m) (by rw [hm₀']; push_cast; rfl)
    omega
  
  have hkm : (m : ℤ) < k * n := by
    have h := isPosRoot_iff_of_isIntegralRoot hx (n := -m + k * n)
      (by rw [hsv, hm₀', hn]; push_cast; ring)
    have := h.2
    have := mt h.1.mpr hneg
    omega
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by
    by_contra hk1
    have : k * n ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by omega) (by positivity)
    omega
  
  set b' := s * v * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple i with hb'
  have hb'pos : P.IsPosRoot hA b' i := (isPosRoot_or (s * v) i).resolve_left hneg
  have hb'x : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x b' i := hmulS _ i hsvx
  have hb'y (y : Dual K H) : P.corootPairing hA y b' i =
      -(P.corootPairing hA y v i - k * P.corootPairing hA y u j) := by
    rw [hb', corootPairing_mul_simple, hsv]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hk1 with hk1 | hk2
  · 
    refine hdec v i b' i hv hvx hb'pos hb'x fun y ↦ ?_
    rw [hb'y, ← hk1]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := P.exists_int_corootPairing_of_mem_rootLattice (hA := hA)
    (hrootQ v i hv) u j
  obtain ⟨hkl, hlpos⟩ := mul_le_three_of_ne hF hv hu hne hk hl
  have hl1 : l = 1 := by
    have := hlpos (by omega)
    nlinarith
  subst hl1
  set t := P.reflectionOf hA v i with ht
  set δ := t * u with hδ
  have hδy (y : Dual K H) : P.corootPairing hA y δ j =
      P.corootPairing hA y u j - P.corootPairing hA y v i := by
    rw [hδ, ht, corootPairing_reflectionOf_mul, hl]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hδx : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x δ j := hrefl v i hvx u j hux
  have hfδ : P.corootPairing hA x δ j = ((m : ℤ) - n : ℤ) := by
    rw [hδy, hn, hm₀']; push_cast; ring
  obtain ⟨hδpos, hδ0⟩ := isPosRoot_iff_of_isIntegralRoot hx hfδ
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (show (m : ℤ) ≠ n by omega) with hmn | hmn
  · 
    refine hdec v i δ j hv hvx (hδpos.mpr (by omega)) hδx fun y ↦ ?_
    rw [hδy]
    ring
  
  set β₁ := δ * (P.coxeterSystem hA).simple j with hβ₁
  have hβ₁pos : P.IsPosRoot hA β₁ j :=
    (isPosRoot_or δ j).resolve_left fun h ↦ by have := hδpos.mp h; omega
  have hβ₁x : P.IsIntegralRoot hA x β₁ j := hmulS _ j hδx
  have hβ₁y (y : Dual K H) : P.corootPairing hA y β₁ j =
      P.corootPairing hA y v i - P.corootPairing hA y u j := by
    rw [hβ₁, corootPairing_mul_simple, hδy]
    ring
  have hβ₁m : P.corootPairing hA x β₁ j = -((m - n : ℕ) : K) := by
    rw [hβ₁y, hm₀', hn, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
    ring
  
  have hβ₁ne : (β₁ : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) ≠
      (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) := by
    intro heq
    have h := congrArg (fun w ↦ P.corootPairing hA w u j) heq
    rw [hβ₁, mul_simple_apply_root, hδ, ht, reflectionOf_mul_apply_root, corootPairing_neg,
      corootPairing_sub, corootPairing_smul, corootPairing_apply_root_self, hk, hl] at h
    have : ((k : ℤ) : K) = 4 := by linear_combination h
    have : k = 4 := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  have hsβ₁ := ih (m - n) (by omega) hβ₁pos hβ₁ne hβ₁m hβ₁x
  
  have hk₁ : P.corootPairing hA ((u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j)) β₁ j = k - 2 := by
    rw [hβ₁y, corootPairing_apply_root_self, hk]
  refine hdec (s * β₁) j b' i hsβ₁ (hrefl u j hux β₁ j hβ₁x) hb'pos hb'x fun y ↦ ?_
  rw [hs, corootPairing_reflectionOf_mul, hk₁, hβ₁y, hb'y]
  ring

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_isPosRoot_reflectionOf_mul
statement:
theorem exists_isPosRoot_reflectionOf_mul {hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan} {x : Dual K H}
    (hx : ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → ∀ n : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA x v i = n → n < 0)
    {y : P.weylGroup hA} (hy : y ∈ P.integralWeylGroup hA x) (hy1 : y ≠ 1) :
    ∃ (u : P.weylGroup hA) (j : ι), P.IsPosRoot hA u j ∧ P.IsIntegralRoot hA x u j ∧
      ¬P.IsPosRoot hA (y * u) j ∧ ∀ v i, P.IsPosRoot hA v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i →
        (v : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root i) ≠ (u : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) (P.root j) →
          P.IsPosRoot hA (P.reflectionOf hA u j * v) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set z := ((y⁻¹ : P.weylGroup hA) : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H) x with hzdef
  have hzy (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι) :
      P.corootPairing hA z v i = P.corootPairing hA x (y * v) i := by
    rw [hzdef, corootPairing_apply, inv_inv]
  have hyint : ∀ v i, P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA x (y * v) i :=
    fun v i h ↦ P.isIntegralRoot_mul hA hy h
  have hz : ∀ v i, P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i → P.IsIntegralRoot hA z v i := fun v i h ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hyint v i h
    exact ⟨a, by change P.corootPairing hA z v i = a; rw [hzy]; exact ha⟩
  
  have hneg_iff : ∀ v i, P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i → ∀ q : ℤ, P.corootPairing hA z v i = q →
      (¬P.IsPosRoot hA (y * v) i ↔ 0 < q) := fun v i h q hq ↦ by
    rw [hzy] at hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := isPosRoot_iff_of_isIntegralRoot hx hq
    rw [h1]
    omega
  have hcast : ∀ a : ℤ, a ≤ 0 → (a : K) = -(((-a).toNat : ℕ) : K) := fun a ha ↦ by
    rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ -a), Int.cast_neg, neg_neg]
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ (v : P.weylGroup hA) (i : ι), P.IsPosRoot hA v i ∧
      P.IsIntegralRoot hA x v i ∧ ¬P.IsPosRoot hA (y * v) i ∧ P.corootPairing hA x v i = -n := by
    by_contra hcon
    refine hy1 (eq_one_of_forall_isPosRoot_integral hF hy fun v i hv hvx ↦ by_contra fun hyv ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hvx
    change P.corootPairing hA x v i = a at ha
    exact hcon ⟨(-a).toNat, v, i, hv, ⟨a, ha⟩, hyv, by
      rw [ha]; exact hcast a (hx v i hv a ha).le⟩
  obtain ⟨u, j, hu, hux, hyu, hn⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hz u j hux
  change P.corootPairing hA z u j = p at hp
  refine ⟨u, j, hu, hux, hyu, fun v i hv hvx hne ↦
    isPosRoot_reflectionOf_mul_of_minimal hF hx hz hu hux hn hp
      ((hneg_iff u j hux p hp).mp hyu) ?_ hv hvx hne⟩
  intro w t hw hwx q hq hq0 m hm
  exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨w, t, hw, hwx, (hneg_iff w t hwx q hq).mpr hq0, hm⟩

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.mul_le_three
statement:
theorem mul_le_three (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    A i j * A j i ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hS⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  set x : ι → ℤ := Pi.single i (-2) + Pi.single j (A j i) with hx
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrFun h i
    simp [hx, hij] at this
  have hpos := hS.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx0
  have key : star x ⬝ᵥ ((diagonal d * A) *ᵥ x) = 2 * d i * (4 - A i j * A j i) := by
    simp only [hx, star_trivial, mulVec_add, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, mulVec_single,
      single_dotProduct]
    simp [diagonal_mul, hA.diag]
    ring
  rw [key] at hpos
  have := hd i
  have : 0 < 4 - A i j * A j i := pos_of_mul_pos_right hpos (by positivity)
  omega

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.det_three_pos
statement:
theorem det_three_pos (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {i j l : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (hil : i ≠ l)
    (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    0 < 8 - 2 * (A i j * A j i) - 2 * (A i l * A l i) - 2 * (A j l * A l j) +
      A i j * A j l * A l i + A i l * A l j * A j i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hS⟩ := hA.exists_posDef
  have he : Function.Injective ![i, j, l] := by
    intro a b h
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all [eq_comm]
  have h := (hS.submatrix he).det_pos
  rw [det_fin_three] at h
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, Fin.isValue, submatrix_apply, cons_val_zero,
    diagonal_mul, hA.diag, cons_val_one, cons_val, Int.sub_pos] at h
  have hdi := hd i
  have hdj := hd j
  have hdl := hd l
  have hpos : 0 < d i * d j * d l := by positivity
  refine pos_of_mul_pos_right (a := d i * d j * d l) ?_ hpos.le
  linear_combination h

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.le_neg_one_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma le_neg_one_of_ne_zero (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (h : A i j ≠ 0) :
    A i j ≤ -1 ∧ A j i ≤ -1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have h2 := hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hij.symm
  have h' : A j i ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h ((hA.zero_comm i j).2 h0)
  omega

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_ne_zero (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {i j l : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hil : i ≠ l) (hjl : j ≠ l) (h : A i j ≠ 0) : A i l = 0 ∨ A j l = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  push Not at hc
  obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hA.le_neg_one_of_ne_zero hij h
  obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hA.le_neg_one_of_ne_zero hil hc.1
  obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := hA.le_neg_one_of_ne_zero hjl hc.2
  have hdet := hA.det_three_pos hij hil hjl
  have p1 : 1 ≤ A i j * A j i := by nlinarith
  have p2 : 1 ≤ A i l * A l i := by nlinarith
  have p3 : 1 ≤ A j l * A l j := by nlinarith
  have q1 : 1 ≤ A i j * A j l := by nlinarith
  have q2 : 1 ≤ A i l * A l j := by nlinarith
  have r1 : A i j * A j l * A l i ≤ -1 := by nlinarith
  have r2 : A i l * A l j * A j i ≤ -1 := by nlinarith
  linarith

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.mul_add_mul_le_three
statement:
theorem mul_add_mul_le_three (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {i j l : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (hil : i ≠ l)
    (hjl : j ≠ l) (h : A j l = 0) : A i j * A j i + A i l * A l i ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have h' : A l j = 0 := (hA.zero_comm j l).1 h
  have hdet := hA.det_three_pos hij hil hjl
  rw [h, h'] at hdet
  linarith

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.eq_zero_or_eq_neg_one
statement:
lemma eq_zero_or_eq_neg_one (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h : A i j * A j i ≤ 1) : A i j = 0 ∨ A i j = -1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : A i j = 0
  · exact Or.inl h0
  obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hA.le_neg_one_of_ne_zero hij h0
  right
  nlinarith

name: Matrix.IsFiniteCartan.braidOuterCondition
statement:
theorem braidOuterCondition (hA : A.IsFiniteCartan) : A.BraidOuterCondition where
  simple i j l h h' hli hlj
proof:
:= by
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; rw [hA.diag] at h; omega
    rcases hA.eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_ne_zero hij (Ne.symm hli) (Ne.symm hlj) (by omega) with
      h0 | h0
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h0)
  double i j l h h' hli hlj := by
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; rw [hA.diag] at h; omega
    rcases hA.eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_ne_zero hij (Ne.symm hli) (Ne.symm hlj) (by omega) with
      h0 | h0
    · have hb := hA.mul_add_mul_le_three hij.symm (Ne.symm hlj) (Ne.symm hli) h0
      rw [h, h'] at hb
      rcases hA.eq_zero_or_eq_neg_one (Ne.symm hlj) (by linarith) with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h0, h1⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h0, h1⟩)
    · have hb := hA.mul_add_mul_le_three hij (Ne.symm hli) hlj.symm h0
      rw [h, h'] at hb
      rcases hA.eq_zero_or_eq_neg_one (Ne.symm hli) (by linarith) with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, h0⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h1, h0⟩)
  triple i j l h h' hli hlj := by
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; rw [hA.diag] at h; omega
    rcases hA.eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_ne_zero hij (Ne.symm hli) (Ne.symm hlj) (by omega) with
      h0 | h0
    · have hb := hA.mul_add_mul_le_three hij.symm (Ne.symm hlj) (Ne.symm hli) h0
      rw [h, h'] at hb
      refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
      by_contra h1
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hA.le_neg_one_of_ne_zero (Ne.symm hlj) h1
      nlinarith
    · have hb := hA.mul_add_mul_le_three hij (Ne.symm hli) hlj.symm h0
      rw [h, h'] at hb
      refine ⟨?_, h0⟩
      by_contra h1
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hA.le_neg_one_of_ne_zero (Ne.symm hli) h1
      nlinarith

name: Matrix.IsGeneralizedCartan.isFiniteCartan_of_mul_le_three
statement:
theorem isFiniteCartan_of_mul_le_three (hA : A.IsGeneralizedCartan) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (huniv : ∀ k, k = i ∨ k = j) (h3 : A i j * A j i ≤ 3) : A.IsFiniteCartan
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hA.diag, hA.offDiag_nonpos, hA.zero_comm, ?_⟩
  have hsum : ∀ f : ι → ℤ, ∑ k, f k = f i + f j := fun f =>
    Fintype.sum_eq_add i j hij fun k hk => (huniv k).elim (fun h => absurd h hk.1)
      (fun h => absurd h hk.2)
  have hji : j ≠ i := Ne.symm hij
  have ha := hA.offDiag_nonpos i j hij
  have hb := hA.offDiag_nonpos j i hji
  have hii := hA.diag i
  have hjj := hA.diag j
  set di : ℤ := if A i j = 0 then 1 else -A j i with hdi
  set dj : ℤ := if A i j = 0 then 1 else -A i j with hdj
  have hsym : di * A i j = dj * A j i := by
    by_cases h0 : A i j = 0
    · simp [hdi, hdj, h0, (hA.zero_comm i j).mp h0]
    · simp only [hdi, hdj, h0, ↓reduceIte]; ring
  have hdi0 : 0 < di := by
    by_cases h0 : A i j = 0
    · simp [hdi, h0]
    · have : A j i ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 ((hA.zero_comm i j).mpr h)
      simp only [hdi, h0, ↓reduceIte]; omega
  have hdj0 : 0 < dj := by
    by_cases h0 : A i j = 0
    · simp [hdj, h0]
    · simp only [hdj, h0, ↓reduceIte]; omega
  refine ⟨fun k => if k = i then di else dj, fun k => by dsimp only; split_ifs <;> assumption, ?_⟩
  rw [posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  refine ⟨?_, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  · ext k l
    rcases huniv k with rfl | rfl <;> rcases huniv l with rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [diagonal_mul, hji, hsym]
  · have hv' : v i ≠ 0 ∨ v j ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      simp only [not_or, not_not] at h
      exact hv (funext fun k => by rcases huniv k with rfl | rfl <;> simp [h.1, h.2])
    simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, hsum, diagonal_mul, star_trivial, ↓reduceIte, hji,
      hii, hjj]
    set x := v i
    set y := v j
    by_cases h0 : A i j = 0
    · have h0' : A j i = 0 := (hA.zero_comm i j).mp h0
      simp only [hdi, hdj, h0, h0', ↓reduceIte]
      rcases hv' with h | h
      · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg y]
      · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg x]
    · have h0' : A j i ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 ((hA.zero_comm i j).mpr h)
      simp only [hdi, hdj, h0, ↓reduceIte]
      set p := -A i j with hp
      set q := -A j i with hq
      have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
      have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by omega
      have hpq : p * q ≤ 3 := by rw [hp, hq]; linarith [h3]
      have key : 2 * q * (x * (q * 2 * x + q * A i j * y) + y * (p * A j i * x + p * 2 * y)) =
          (2 * q * x - p * q * y) ^ 2 + p * q * (4 - p * q) * y ^ 2 := by
        rw [show A i j = -p by omega, show A j i = -q by omega]; ring
      have hq0 : (0 : ℤ) < q := by omega
      by_cases hy : y = 0
      · have hx : x ≠ 0 := hv'.resolve_right (not_not.mpr hy)
        rw [hy]
        simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
        nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx]
      · have hpq1 : 1 ≤ p * q := by nlinarith
        have h1 : 3 ≤ p * q * (4 - p * q) := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpq1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hpq)]
        have h2 : 0 < 2 * q * (x * (q * 2 * x + q * A i j * y) +
            y * (p * A j i * x + p * 2 * y)) := by
          rw [key]; nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hy, sq_nonneg (2 * q * x - p * q * y)]
        nlinarith

name: Matrix.Realization.titsCone_eq_univ_of_finite_weylGroup
statement:
theorem titsCone_eq_univ_of_finite_weylGroup [Finite (P.weylGroup hA)] :
    P.titsCone hA = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite (P.weylGroup hA)
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro μ
  obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
    (fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦ P.transpose.rho (w.1 μ)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hC : w.1 μ ∈ P.dominantChamber := by
    intro i
    have h := hw (⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩ * w)
      (Finset.mem_univ _)
    have hr : P.transpose.rho (P.root i) = 1 := P.transpose.rho_coroot i
    change P.transpose.rho (P.reflection hA i (w.1 μ)) ≤ P.transpose.rho (w.1 μ) at h
    rw [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, hr, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    linarith
  exact ⟨w.1⁻¹, inv_mem w.2, w.1 μ, hC, w.1.symm_apply_apply μ⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.rho_pos_of_mem_posRealCoroots
statement:
lemma rho_pos_of_mem_posRealCoroots {x : H} (hx : x ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA) :
    0 < P.rho x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hx, k, hk, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact P.ne_zero_of_mem_realCoroots hA hx (by simp [h])
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hk0
  have hip : 0 < k i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hk i) (Ne.symm hi)
  rw [apply_corootOf]
  simp only [rho_coroot, mul_one]
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ ↦ by exact_mod_cast hk j)
    ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, by exact_mod_cast hip⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.titsCone_eq_univ_iff_finite_posRealCoroots
statement:
theorem titsCone_eq_univ_iff_finite_posRealCoroots :
    P.titsCone hA = Set.univ ↔ (P.posRealCoroots hA).Finite
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hneg : -P.rho ∈ P.titsCone hA := by rw [h]; trivial
    refine (P.finite_of_mem_titsCone hA hneg).subset fun x hx ↦ ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    simpa using neg_neg_of_pos (P.rho_pos_of_mem_posRealCoroots hA hx)
  · intro h
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro μ
    exact P.mem_titsCone_of_finite hA (h.subset fun _ hx ↦ hx.1)

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_corootOf_nonneg
statement:
lemma apply_corootOf_nonneg {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber) {k : ι → ℤ}
    (hk : 0 ≤ k) : 0 ≤ μ (P.corootOf k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [apply_corootOf]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ mul_nonneg (by simpa using hk i) (hμ i)

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_of_mem_titsCone
statement:
theorem finite_of_mem_titsCone {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.titsCone hA) :
    {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ μ h < 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, ν, hν, rfl⟩ := hμ
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hwu⟩ := P.exists_coweylGroup_apply_apply hA hw
  refine (P.finite_inversionSet_coweylGroup hA hu).subset ?_
  rintro h ⟨hh, hlt⟩
  refine ⟨hh, fun ⟨_, k, hk, hkh⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hwu, ← hkh] at hlt
  exact (P.apply_corootOf_nonneg hν hk).not_gt hlt

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_titsCone_of_finite
statement:
theorem mem_titsCone_of_finite {μ : Dual K H}
    (hμ : {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ μ h < 0}.Finite) : μ ∈ P.titsCone hA
proof:
:= by
  generalize hn : {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ μ h < 0}.ncard = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing μ with
  | _ n ih =>
  by_cases hC : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber
  · exact P.dominantChamber_subset_titsCone hA hC
  simp only [mem_dominantChamber, not_forall, not_le] at hC
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hC
  set S := {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ μ h < 0}
  have hsub : {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ P.reflection hA i μ h < 0} ⊆
      P.coreflection hA i '' (S \ {P.coroot i}) := by
    rintro h ⟨hh, hlt⟩
    rw [reflection_apply_apply] at hlt
    have hne : h ≠ P.coroot i := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [coreflection_coroot_self, map_neg] at hlt
      linarith
    refine ⟨P.coreflection hA i h,
      ⟨⟨P.coreflection_mem_posRealCoroots hA hh hne, hlt⟩, fun heq ↦ ?_⟩, by simp⟩
    refine P.neg_notMem_posRealCoroots hA (P.coroot_mem_posRealCoroots hA i) ?_
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at heq
    rw [← coreflection_coroot_self P hA i, ← heq, coreflection_coreflection]
    exact hh
  have hfin : (P.coreflection hA i '' (S \ {P.coroot i})).Finite := (hμ.sdiff).image _
  have hlt : {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ P.reflection hA i μ h < 0}.ncard < n :=
    hn ▸ (Set.ncard_le_ncard hsub hfin).trans_lt ((Set.ncard_image_le hμ.sdiff).trans_lt
      (Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_lt_of_mem ⟨P.coroot_mem_posRealCoroots hA i, hi⟩ hμ))
  have := P.apply_mem_titsCone hA (P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i)
    (ih _ hlt (hfin.subset hsub) rfl)
  rwa [reflection_reflection] at this

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_titsCone_iff
statement:
theorem mem_titsCone_iff {μ : Dual K H} :
    μ ∈ P.titsCone hA ↔ {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ μ h < 0}.Finite
proof:
:=
  ⟨P.finite_of_mem_titsCone hA, P.mem_titsCone_of_finite hA⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.zero_mem_titsCone
statement: lemma zero_mem_titsCone : 0 ∈ P.titsCone hA
proof:
:=
  P.dominantChamber_subset_titsCone hA fun i ↦ by simp

name: Matrix.Realization.smul_mem_titsCone
statement:
theorem smul_mem_titsCone {c : K} (hc : 0 ≤ c) {μ : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.titsCone hA) :
    c • μ ∈ P.titsCone hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, ν, hν, rfl⟩ := hμ
  exact ⟨w, hw, c • ν, fun i ↦ by simpa using mul_nonneg hc (hν i), map_smul w c ν⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.add_mem_titsCone
statement:
theorem add_mem_titsCone {μ ν : Dual K H} (hμ : μ ∈ P.titsCone hA) (hν : ν ∈ P.titsCone hA) :
    μ + ν ∈ P.titsCone hA
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_titsCone_iff] at hμ hν ⊢
  refine (hμ.union hν).subset ?_
  rintro h ⟨hh, hlt⟩
  by_contra hn
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_or, not_and, not_lt] at hn
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply] at hlt
  linarith [hn.1 hh, hn.2 hh]

name: Matrix.Realization.convex_titsCone
statement: theorem convex_titsCone : Convex K (P.titsCone hA)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hμ _ hν _ _ ha hb _ ↦
    P.add_mem_titsCone hA (P.smul_mem_titsCone hA ha hμ) (P.smul_mem_titsCone hA hb hν)

name: Matrix.Realization.coe_titsPointedCone
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_titsPointedCone : (P.titsPointedCone hA : Set (Dual K H)) = P.titsCone hA
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_interior_titsCone_of_dominant_of_finite_stabilizer
statement:
theorem mem_interior_titsCone_of_dominant_of_finite_stabilizer {μ : Dual ℝ H}
    (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber)
    [Finite (MulAction.stabilizer (P.weylGroup hA) μ)] :
    μ ∈ interior (P.titsCone hA)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := MulAction.stabilizer (P.weylGroup hA) μ
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite S
  let U : Set (Dual ℝ H) := {ν | ∀ w : S, ∀ i : {i // μ (P.coroot i) ≠ 0},
    0 < (w.val : Dual ℝ H ≃ₗ[ℝ] Dual ℝ H) ν (P.coroot i.val)}
  have hU : IsOpen U := by
    change IsOpen {ν | ∀ w : S, ∀ i : {i // μ (P.coroot i) ≠ 0},
      0 < (w.val : Dual ℝ H ≃ₗ[ℝ] Dual ℝ H) ν (P.coroot i.val)}
    simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
    refine isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun w ↦ isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i ↦ ?_
    exact isOpen_lt continuous_const (LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
      ((Dual.eval ℝ H (P.coroot i.val)).comp w.val.val.toLinearMap))
  have hμU : μ ∈ U := by
    intro w i
    have hw : (w.val : Dual ℝ H ≃ₗ[ℝ] Dual ℝ H) μ = μ := w.property
    rw [hw]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ i.val) (Ne.symm i.property)
  have hUX : U ⊆ P.titsCone hA := by
    intro ν hν
    obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
      (fun w : S ↦ (w.val : Dual ℝ H ≃ₗ[ℝ] Dual ℝ H) ν P.rhoCheck)
      Finset.univ_nonempty
    have hC : (w.val : Dual ℝ H ≃ₗ[ℝ] Dual ℝ H) ν ∈ P.dominantChamber := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : μ (P.coroot i) = 0
      · let r : S := ⟨⟨P.reflection hA i, P.reflection_mem_weylGroup hA i⟩, by
          change P.reflection hA i μ = μ
          rw [reflection_apply, hi, zero_smul, sub_zero]⟩
        have h := hw (r * w) (Finset.mem_univ _)
        change (P.reflection hA i ((w.val : Dual ℝ H ≃ₗ[ℝ] Dual ℝ H) ν))
          P.rhoCheck ≤ (w.val : Dual ℝ H ≃ₗ[ℝ] Dual ℝ H) ν P.rhoCheck at h
        rw [reflection_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
          P.root_rhoCheck, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
        linarith
      · exact (hν w ⟨i, hi⟩).le
    exact ⟨w.val.val⁻¹, inv_mem w.val.property, w.val.val ν, hC,
      w.val.val.symm_apply_apply ν⟩
  exact interior_mono hUX (hU.interior_eq.symm ▸ hμU)

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_interior_titsCone_of_finite_stabilizer
statement:
theorem mem_interior_titsCone_of_finite_stabilizer {μ : Dual ℝ H}
    (hμ : μ ∈ P.titsCone hA)
    [Finite (MulAction.stabilizer (P.weylGroup hA) μ)] :
    μ ∈ interior (P.titsCone hA)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, ν, hν, rfl⟩ := hμ
  let w : P.weylGroup hA := ⟨v, hv⟩
  let e := MulAction.stabilizerEquivStabilizer (G := P.weylGroup hA)
    (g := w) (a := ν) (b := v ν) rfl
  let _ : Finite (MulAction.stabilizer (P.weylGroup hA) ν) :=
    Finite.of_injective e e.injective
  have hνint := P.mem_interior_titsCone_of_dominant_of_finite_stabilizer hA hν
  have himage : v '' P.titsCone hA ⊆ P.titsCone hA := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact P.apply_mem_titsCone hA hv hx
  apply interior_mono himage
  change v ν ∈ interior (v.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph '' P.titsCone hA)
  rw [← v.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph.image_interior]
  exact ⟨ν, hνint, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_pos_add_smul_mem
statement:
private lemma exists_pos_add_smul_mem {s : Set (Dual ℝ H)} {μ : Dual ℝ H}
    (hμ : μ ∈ interior s) (ν : Dual ℝ H) : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ μ + t • ν ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ μ + t • ν) :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have he : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), μ + t • ν ∈ s := by
    exact hc.continuousAt (by simpa using mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hμ)
  have he' : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ + t • ν ∈ s :=
    he.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  exact (he'.and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists.imp fun t ht ↦ ⟨ht.2, ht.1⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_posRealCoroots_zero_of_mem_interior
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hν⟩ := exists_pos_add_smul_mem hμ (-P.rho)
  refine (P.finite_of_mem_titsCone hA hν).subset fun x hx ↦ ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
  have hp := P.rho_pos_of_mem_posRealCoroots hA hx.1
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, hx.2,
    zero_add, smul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ht (neg_neg_of_pos hp)

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_realCoroots_zero_of_mem_interior
proof:
:= by
  have hf := P.finite_posRealCoroots_zero_of_mem_interior hA hμ
  refine (hf.union (hf.image fun x ↦ -x)).subset fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rcases P.mem_posRealCoroots_or_neg_mem hA hx.1 with hp | hn
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hp, hx.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨-x, ⟨hn, by simp [hx.2]⟩, neg_neg x⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_one_of_stabilizes_of_pos_on_zero_walls
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U : Set (Dual ℝ H) := {ν | ∀ i : {i // μ (P.coroot i) ≠ 0},
    0 < ν (P.coroot i.val)}
  have hU : IsOpen U := by
    change IsOpen {ν : Dual ℝ H | ∀ i : {i // μ (P.coroot i) ≠ 0},
      0 < ν (P.coroot i.val)}
    simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i ↦ isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional (Dual.eval ℝ H (P.coroot i.val)))
  have hμU : μ ∈ U := fun i ↦ lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ i.val) (Ne.symm i.property)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htU⟩ := exists_pos_add_smul_mem (hU.interior_eq.symm ▸ hμU) (w P.rho)
  have hpos : ∀ i, 0 < (μ + t • P.rho) (P.coroot i) := by
    intro i
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, rho_coroot, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (hμ i) ht
  have hdom : w (μ + t • P.rho) ∈ P.dominantChamber := by
    intro i
    rw [map_add, map_smul, hfix]
    by_cases hi : μ (P.coroot i) = 0
    · simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hi, zero_add, smul_eq_mul]
      exact (mul_pos ht (hzero i hi)).le
    · exact (htU ⟨i, hi⟩).le
  exact P.eq_one_of_apply_eq_self_of_forall_pos hA hpos hw
    (P.apply_eq_self_of_mem_dominantChamber hA (fun i ↦ (hpos i).le) hw hdom)

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_stabilizer_of_dominant_of_finite_zero_realCoroots
statement:
theorem finite_stabilizer_of_dominant_of_finite_zero_realCoroots {μ : Dual ℝ H}
    (hμ : μ ∈ P.dominantChamber)
    (hf : {x | x ∈ P.realCoroots hA ∧ μ x = 0}.Finite) :
    Finite (MulAction.stabilizer (P.weylGroup hA) μ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := MulAction.stabilizer (P.weylGroup hA) μ
  let Z := {x | x ∈ P.realCoroots hA ∧ μ x = 0}
  let _ := hf.fintype
  choose u hu hpair using fun w : S ↦ P.exists_coweylGroup_apply_apply hA w.val.property
  have hfix (w : S) : w.val.val μ = μ := w.property
  let f : S → ({i // μ (P.coroot i) = 0} → Z) := fun w i ↦
    ⟨u w (P.coroot i.val), P.apply_mem_realCoroots hA (hu w)
      (P.coroot_mem_realCoroots hA i.val), by rw [← hpair, hfix]; exact i.property⟩
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro w v heq
  have hcoroot (i : ι) (hi : μ (P.coroot i) = 0) :
      u w (P.coroot i) = u v (P.coroot i) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun heq ⟨i, hi⟩)
  have hqfix : (v.val.val * w.val.val⁻¹) μ = μ := by
    change v.val.val (w.val.val⁻¹ μ) = μ
    rw [show w.val.val⁻¹ μ = μ from (w.val.val.symm_apply_eq.mpr (hfix w).symm), hfix]
  have hone : v.val.val * w.val.val⁻¹ = 1 :=
    P.eq_one_of_stabilizes_of_pos_on_zero_walls hA hμ
      (mul_mem v.val.property (inv_mem w.val.property)) hqfix (by
        intro i hi
        change 0 < v.val.val (w.val.val⁻¹ P.rho) (P.coroot i)
        rw [hpair v, ← hcoroot i hi, ← hpair w]
        simp)
  exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (mul_inv_eq_one.mp hone).symm)

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_stabilizer_of_mem_interior_titsCone
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, ν, hν, rfl⟩ := interior_subset hμ
  have himage : v.symm '' P.titsCone hA ⊆ P.titsCone hA := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact P.apply_mem_titsCone hA (inv_mem hv) hx
  have hνint : ν ∈ interior (P.titsCone hA) := by
    have h : v.symm (v ν) ∈ interior (v.symm '' P.titsCone hA) := by
      change v.symm (v ν) ∈ interior
        (v.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph '' P.titsCone hA)
      rw [← v.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph.image_interior]
      exact ⟨v ν, hμ, rfl⟩
    simpa using interior_mono himage h
  let _ := P.finite_stabilizer_of_dominant_of_finite_zero_realCoroots hA hν
    (P.finite_realCoroots_zero_of_mem_interior hA hνint)
  let w : P.weylGroup hA := ⟨v, hv⟩
  let e := MulAction.stabilizerEquivStabilizer (G := P.weylGroup hA)
    (g := w) (a := ν) (b := v ν) rfl
  exact Finite.of_injective e.symm e.symm.injective

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_interior_titsCone_iff_finite_stabilizer
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact P.finite_stabilizer_of_mem_interior_titsCone hA
  · intro hf
    let _ := hf
    exact P.mem_interior_titsCone_of_finite_stabilizer hA hμ

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_realCoroots_of_finite_posRealCoroots
statement:
lemma finite_realCoroots_of_finite_posRealCoroots
    (h : (P.posRealCoroots hA).Finite) : (P.realCoroots hA).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (h.union (h.image fun x ↦ -x)).subset fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rcases P.mem_posRealCoroots_or_neg_mem hA hx with hp | hn
  · exact Or.inl hp
  · exact Or.inr ⟨-x, hn, neg_neg x⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_weylGroup_of_finite_posRealCoroots
statement:
theorem finite_weylGroup_of_finite_posRealCoroots
    (h : (P.posRealCoroots hA).Finite) : Finite (P.weylGroup hA)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr := P.finite_realCoroots_of_finite_posRealCoroots hA h
  let _ := hr.fintype
  choose u hu hpair using fun w : P.weylGroup hA ↦
    P.exists_coweylGroup_apply_apply hA w.2
  let f : P.weylGroup hA → (ι → P.realCoroots hA) := fun w i ↦
    ⟨u w (P.coroot i), P.apply_mem_realCoroots hA (hu w)
      (P.coroot_mem_realCoroots hA i)⟩
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro w v heq
  have hcoroot (i : ι) : u w (P.coroot i) = u v (P.coroot i) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun heq i)
  have hpos (i : ι) : 0 < P.rho (P.coroot i) := by simp
  have hdom : (v.1 * w.1⁻¹) P.rho ∈ P.dominantChamber := by
    intro i
    change 0 ≤ v.1 (w.1⁻¹ P.rho) (P.coroot i)
    rw [hpair v, ← hcoroot, ← hpair w]
    simp
  have hfix : (v.1 * w.1⁻¹) P.rho = P.rho :=
    P.apply_eq_self_of_mem_dominantChamber hA (fun i ↦ (hpos i).le)
      (mul_mem v.2 (inv_mem w.2)) hdom
  have hone : v.1 * w.1⁻¹ = 1 :=
    P.eq_one_of_apply_eq_self_of_forall_pos hA hpos
      (mul_mem v.2 (inv_mem w.2)) hfix
  exact Subtype.ext (mul_inv_eq_one.mp hone).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_weylGroup_of_titsCone_eq_univ
statement:
theorem finite_weylGroup_of_titsCone_eq_univ (h : P.titsCone hA = Set.univ) :
    Finite (P.weylGroup hA)
proof:
:=
  P.finite_weylGroup_of_finite_posRealCoroots hA
    ((P.titsCone_eq_univ_iff_finite_posRealCoroots hA).mp h)

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_weylGroup_iff_titsCone_eq_univ
statement:
theorem finite_weylGroup_iff_titsCone_eq_univ :
    Finite (P.weylGroup hA) ↔ P.titsCone hA = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let _ := h
    exact P.titsCone_eq_univ_of_finite_weylGroup hA
  · exact P.finite_weylGroup_of_titsCone_eq_univ hA

name: Matrix.Realization.transpose_coroot
statement: @[simp] lemma transpose_coroot (i : ι) : P.transpose.coroot i = P.root i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.transpose_root
statement: @[simp] lemma transpose_root (i : ι) : P.transpose.root i = Dual.eval K H (P.coroot i)
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.corootOf_apply
statement: lemma corootOf_apply (k : ι → ℤ) : P.corootOf k = ∑ i, (k i : K) • P.coroot i
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.corootOf_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma corootOf_single [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) :
    P.corootOf (Pi.single i 1) = P.coroot i
proof:
:= by
  simp [corootOf_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.transpose_rootOf
statement:
lemma transpose_rootOf (k : ι → ℤ) :
    P.transpose.rootOf k = Dual.eval K H (P.corootOf k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootOf_apply, corootOf_apply, map_sum, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_corootOf
statement:
lemma apply_corootOf (μ : Dual K H) (k : ι → ℤ) :
    μ (P.corootOf k) = ∑ i, (k i : K) * μ (P.coroot i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [corootOf_apply, map_sum, map_smul]

name: Matrix.Realization.eval_coreflection
statement:
lemma eval_coreflection (i : ι) (x : H) :
    Dual.eval K H (P.coreflection hA i x) =
      P.transpose.reflection hA.transpose i (Dual.eval K H x)
proof:
:= by
  ext μ
  simp only [coreflection_apply, reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, Dual.eval_apply,
    transpose_coroot, transpose_root, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_mul_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreflection_mul_self (i : ι) :
    P.coreflection hA i * P.coreflection hA i = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x : 1
  exact P.coreflection_coreflection hA i x

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma coreflection_inv (i : ι) : (P.coreflection hA i)⁻¹ = P.coreflection hA i
proof:
:=
  inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (P.coreflection_mul_self hA i)

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_mem_coweylGroup
statement: lemma coreflection_mem_coweylGroup (i : ι) : P.coreflection hA i ∈ P.coweylGroup hA
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.coweylGroup_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma coweylGroup_induction {p : (H ≃ₗ[K] H) → Prop} (one : p 1)
    (mul : ∀ i u, u ∈ P.coweylGroup hA → p u → p (P.coreflection hA i * u)) {u : H ≃ₗ[K] H}
    (hu : u ∈ P.coweylGroup hA) : p u
proof:
:= by
  induction hu using Subgroup.closure_induction_left with
  | one => exact one
  | mul_left x hx u hu ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact mul i u hu ih
  | inv_mul_cancel x hx u hu ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [coreflection_inv]
    exact mul i u hu ih

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_coweylGroup_apply_apply
statement:
theorem exists_coweylGroup_apply_apply {w : Dual K H ≃ₗ[K] Dual K H} (hw : w ∈ P.weylGroup hA) :
    ∃ u ∈ P.coweylGroup hA, ∀ μ x, w μ x = μ (u x)
proof:
:= by
  refine P.weylGroup_induction hA (p := fun w ↦ ∃ u ∈ P.coweylGroup hA, ∀ μ x, w μ x = μ (u x))
    ⟨1, one_mem _, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (fun i w ⟨u, hu, h⟩ ↦ ?_) hw
  refine ⟨u * P.coreflection hA i, mul_mem hu (P.coreflection_mem_coweylGroup hA i),
    fun μ x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, reflection_apply_apply, h, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.exists_transpose_weylGroup
statement:
theorem exists_transpose_weylGroup {u : H ≃ₗ[K] H} (hu : u ∈ P.coweylGroup hA) :
    ∃ u' ∈ P.transpose.weylGroup hA.transpose,
      ∀ x, Dual.eval K H (u x) = u' (Dual.eval K H x)
proof:
:= by
  refine P.coweylGroup_induction hA (p := fun u ↦ ∃ u' ∈ P.transpose.weylGroup hA.transpose,
    ∀ x, Dual.eval K H (u x) = u' (Dual.eval K H x)) ⟨1, one_mem _, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
    (fun i u _ ⟨u', hu', h⟩ ↦ ?_) hu
  refine ⟨P.transpose.reflection hA.transpose i * u',
    mul_mem (P.transpose.reflection_mem_weylGroup _ i) hu', fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, eval_coreflection, h, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]

name: Matrix.Realization.coroot_mem_realCoroots
statement: lemma coroot_mem_realCoroots (i : ι) : P.coroot i ∈ P.realCoroots hA
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, one_mem _, i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.coroot_mem_posRealCoroots
statement: lemma coroot_mem_posRealCoroots (i : ι) : P.coroot i ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ⟨P.coroot_mem_realCoroots hA i, Pi.single i 1,
    fun j ↦ by by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h], P.corootOf_single i⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.apply_mem_realCoroots
statement:
lemma apply_mem_realCoroots {u : H ≃ₗ[K] H} (hu : u ∈ P.coweylGroup hA) {h : H}
    (hh : h ∈ P.realCoroots hA) : u h ∈ P.realCoroots hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, i, rfl⟩ := hh
  exact ⟨u * v, mul_mem hu hv, i, rfl⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.neg_mem_realCoroots
statement: lemma neg_mem_realCoroots {h : H} (hh : h ∈ P.realCoroots hA) : -h ∈ P.realCoroots hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, i, rfl⟩ := hh
  refine ⟨u * P.coreflection hA i, mul_mem hu (P.coreflection_mem_coweylGroup hA i), i, ?_⟩
  rw [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, coreflection_coroot_self, map_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.ne_zero_of_mem_realCoroots
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_mem_realCoroots {h : H} (hh : h ∈ P.realCoroots hA) : h ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, -, i, rfl⟩ := hh
  rw [Ne, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff]
  exact P.linearIndependent_coroot.ne_zero i

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_posRealCoroots_or_neg_mem
statement:
theorem mem_posRealCoroots_or_neg_mem {h : H} (hh : h ∈ P.realCoroots hA) :
    h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∨ -h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, i, rfl⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨u', hu', hu'e⟩ := P.exists_transpose_weylGroup hA hu
  have hr : u' (P.transpose.root i) = Dual.eval K H (u (P.coroot i)) := by
    rw [hu'e, transpose_root]
  rcases P.transpose.apply_root_nonneg_or_nonpos hA.transpose hu' i with ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ | ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩
  · refine Or.inl ⟨⟨u, hu, i, rfl⟩, k, hk, Module.eval_apply_injective K ?_⟩
    rw [← transpose_rootOf, ← hk', hr]
  · refine Or.inr ⟨P.neg_mem_realCoroots hA ⟨u, hu, i, rfl⟩, k, hk,
      Module.eval_apply_injective K ?_⟩
    rw [← transpose_rootOf, map_neg, ← hr, hk', neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.neg_notMem_posRealCoroots
statement:
theorem neg_notMem_posRealCoroots {h : H} (hh : h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA) :
    -h ∉ P.posRealCoroots hA
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨-, l, hl, hlh⟩
  obtain ⟨hr, k, hk, rfl⟩ := hh
  have h0 : ∀ i, ((k + l) i : K) = 0 := by
    refine Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp P.linearIndependent_coroot _ ?_
    have := congrArg (· + P.corootOf k) hlh
    simp only [neg_add_cancel, ← map_add] at this
    simpa [corootOf_apply, add_comm] using this
  have hk0 : k = 0 := funext fun i ↦ by
    have := h0 i
    have := hk i; have := hl i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at *
    have : k i + l i = 0 := by exact_mod_cast ‹((k i + l i : ℤ) : K) = 0›
    omega
  exact P.ne_zero_of_mem_realCoroots hA hr (by rw [hk0, map_zero])

name: Matrix.Realization.eq_coroot_of_coreflection_neg_mem
statement:
theorem eq_coroot_of_coreflection_neg_mem {h : H} (hh : h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA) {j : ι}
    (hj : -P.coreflection hA j h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA) : h = P.coroot j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨u, hu, i, rfl⟩, k, hk, hkh⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨-, l, hl, hlh⟩ := hj
  obtain ⟨u', hu', hu'e⟩ := P.exists_transpose_weylGroup hA hu
  have hr : u' (P.transpose.root i) = Dual.eval K H (u (P.coroot i)) := by
    rw [hu'e, transpose_root]
  refine Module.eval_apply_injective K ?_
  rw [← hr, ← transpose_root]
  refine P.transpose.eq_root_of_reflection_apply hA.transpose hu' hk ?_ hl ?_
  · rw [hr, transpose_rootOf, hkh]
  · rw [hr, ← eval_coreflection, transpose_rootOf, hlh, map_neg, neg_neg]

name: Matrix.Realization.coreflection_mem_posRealCoroots
statement:
theorem coreflection_mem_posRealCoroots {h : H} (hh : h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA) {i : ι}
    (hi : h ≠ P.coroot i) : P.coreflection hA i h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA
proof:
:= by
  refine (P.mem_posRealCoroots_or_neg_mem hA (P.apply_mem_realCoroots hA
    (P.coreflection_mem_coweylGroup hA i) hh.1)).resolve_right fun h' ↦ hi ?_
  exact P.eq_coroot_of_coreflection_neg_mem hA hh h'

name: Matrix.Realization.finite_inversionSet_coweylGroup
statement:
theorem finite_inversionSet_coweylGroup {u : H ≃ₗ[K] H} (hu : u ∈ P.coweylGroup hA) :
    {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ u h ∉ P.posRealCoroots hA}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine P.coweylGroup_induction hA
    (p := fun u ↦ {h | h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA ∧ u h ∉ P.posRealCoroots hA}.Finite)
    (by simp) (fun i u _ ih ↦ ?_) hu
  refine (ih.union (Set.finite_singleton (u.symm (P.coroot i)))).subset ?_
  rintro h ⟨hh, hih⟩
  by_cases huh : u h ∈ P.posRealCoroots hA
  · refine Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr ?_)
    by_contra hne
    refine hih (P.coreflection_mem_posRealCoroots hA huh fun heq ↦ hne ?_)
    rw [← heq, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hh, huh⟩

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.single_le_of_mem_indices
statement: lemma single_le_of_mem_indices (hx : x ∈ indices p) (hxS : x ∉ p.1) : single x 1 ≤ p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, ← mem_support_iff]
  simpa [indices, hxS] using hx

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.indices_toggle
statement: lemma indices_toggle (hx : x ∈ indices p) : indices (toggle x p) = indices p
proof:
:= by
  unfold toggle
  split_ifs with hxS
  · ext y
    simp only [indices, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_erase, mem_support_iff, add_apply,
      single_apply]
    by_cases hy : x = y
    · subst hy; simp [hxS]
    · simp [hy, Ne.symm hy]
  · have hle := single_le_of_mem_indices hx hxS
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ p.2 x := by simpa using hle x
    ext y
    simp only [indices, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert, mem_support_iff, tsub_apply,
      single_apply]
    by_cases hy : x = y
    · subst hy; simp only [true_or, true_iff]; right; omega
    · simp [hy, Ne.symm hy]

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.toggle_toggle
statement: lemma toggle_toggle (hx : x ∈ indices p) : toggle x (toggle x p) = p
proof:
:= by
  unfold toggle
  by_cases hxS : x ∈ p.1
  · rw [ite_eq_left hxS, ite_eq_right (Finset.notMem_erase x p.1), Finset.insert_erase hxS,
      add_tsub_cancel_right]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hxS, ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_insert_self x p.1), Finset.erase_insert hxS,
      tsub_add_cancel_of_le (single_le_of_mem_indices hx hxS)]

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.toggle_ne
statement: lemma toggle_ne (x : σ) (p : Finset σ × (σ →₀ ℕ)) : toggle x p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  unfold toggle
  split_ifs with hxS
  · intro h
    have := congrArg Prod.fst h
    simp only at this
    have h2 : x ∈ p.1.erase x := by rw [this]; exact hxS
    exact Finset.notMem_erase x p.1 h2
  · intro h
    have := congrArg Prod.fst h
    simp only at this
    exact hxS (this ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self x p.1)

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.neg_one_pow_card_toggle
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_card_toggle (x : σ) (p : Finset σ × (σ →₀ ℕ)) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (toggle x p).1.card = -(-1) ^ p.1.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold toggle
  split_ifs with hxS <;> dsimp only
  · rw [← Finset.card_erase_add_one hxS, pow_succ]
    ring
  · rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hxS, pow_succ]
    ring

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.pairWeight_toggle
statement:
lemma pairWeight_toggle (w : σ → M) (hx : x ∈ indices p) :
    pairWeight w (toggle x p) = pairWeight w p
proof:
:= by
  unfold toggle pairWeight
  split_ifs with hxS <;> dsimp only
  · rw [sum_add_index' (h := fun x n ↦ n • w x) (fun _ ↦ zero_nsmul _)
      (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_nsmul _ _ _),
      sum_single_index (h := fun x n ↦ n • w x) (zero_nsmul _), one_nsmul,
      ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hxS]
    abel
  · conv_rhs => rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le (single_le_of_mem_indices hx hxS)]
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hxS, sum_add_index' (h := fun x n ↦ n • w x) (fun _ ↦ zero_nsmul _)
      (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_nsmul _ _ _),
      sum_single_index (h := fun x n ↦ n • w x) (zero_nsmul _), one_nsmul]
    abel

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.min'_indices_involution
statement:
lemma min'_indices_involution (h : (indices p).Nonempty) :
    ∃ h' : (indices (involution p)).Nonempty,
      (indices (involution p)).min' h' = (indices p).min' h
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := (indices p).min'_mem h
  have hI : indices (involution p) = indices p := by
    rw [involution, dite_eq_left h, indices_toggle hmem]
  exact ⟨hI ▸ h, by simp_rw [hI]⟩

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.involution_involution
statement: lemma involution_involution (p : Finset σ × (σ →₀ ℕ)) : involution (involution p) = p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (indices p).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨h', hmin⟩ := min'_indices_involution h
    rw [involution, dite_eq_left h', hmin, involution, dite_eq_left h,
      toggle_toggle ((indices p).min'_mem h)]
  · have hp : involution p = p := dite_eq_right h
    rw [hp, hp]

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.eq_of_not_nonempty_indices
statement: lemma eq_of_not_nonempty_indices (h : ¬ (indices p).Nonempty) : p = (∅, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, indices, Finset.union_eq_empty,
    support_eq_empty] at h
  exact Prod.ext h.1 h.2

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.involution_ne
statement: lemma involution_ne (hp : p ≠ (∅, 0)) : involution p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  have h : (indices p).Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    exact hp (eq_of_not_nonempty_indices h)
  rw [involution, dite_eq_left h]
  exact toggle_ne _ _

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.neg_one_pow_card_involution
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_card_involution (hp : p ≠ (∅, 0)) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (involution p).1.card = -(-1) ^ p.1.card
proof:
:= by
  have h : (indices p).Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    exact hp (eq_of_not_nonempty_indices h)
  rw [involution, dite_eq_left h, neg_one_pow_card_toggle]

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.pairWeight_involution
statement:
lemma pairWeight_involution (w : σ → M) (p : Finset σ × (σ →₀ ℕ)) :
    pairWeight w (involution p) = pairWeight w p
proof:
:= by
  unfold involution
  split_ifs with h
  · exact pairWeight_toggle w ((indices p).min'_mem h)
  · rfl

name: Finsupp.PairInvolution.sum_neg_one_pow_card_eq_ite
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_card_eq_ite [DecidableEq M] (w : σ → M) (β : M)
    {T : Finset (Finset σ × (σ →₀ ℕ))}
    (hT : ∀ p, p ∈ T ↔ pairWeight w p = β) :
    ∑ p ∈ T, (-1 : ℤ) ^ p.1.card = if β = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h0 : ∑ p ∈ T.erase (∅, 0), (-1 : ℤ) ^ p.1.card = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_involution (fun p _ ↦ involution p) (fun p hp ↦ ?_) (fun p hp _ ↦ ?_)
      (fun p hp ↦ ?_) (fun p _ ↦ involution_involution p)
    · rw [neg_one_pow_card_involution (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hp), add_neg_cancel]
    · exact involution_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hp)
    · obtain ⟨hp0, hpT⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hp
      refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h ↦ hp0 ?_, (hT _).mpr ?_⟩
      · rw [← involution_involution p, h]
        rfl
      · rw [pairWeight_involution]
        exact (hT p).mp hpT
  have hwt0 : pairWeight w ((∅ : Finset σ), (0 : σ →₀ ℕ)) = 0 := by simp [pairWeight]
  split_ifs with hβ
  · have hmem : ((∅ : Finset σ), (0 : σ →₀ ℕ)) ∈ T := (hT _).mpr (hwt0.trans hβ.symm)
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hmem, h0]
    simp
  · have hmem : ((∅ : Finset σ), (0 : σ →₀ ℕ)) ∉ T := fun h ↦ hβ (((hT _).mp h).symm.trans hwt0)
    rwa [← Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hmem]

name: MvPolynomial.derivation_eq_sum_pderiv
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_sum_pderiv [Fintype σ]
    (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R)) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    D p = ∑ i, pderiv i p * D (X i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp [derivation_C]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, hp]
    simp only [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, pderiv_X, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_lowWeight
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
  have he : weight w x.1 + weight w x.2 = weight w d := by rw [← map_add, hx]
  by_cases h : weight w x.1 < a
  · rw [hp _ h, zero_mul]
  · rw [hq _ (by omega), mul_zero]

name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem IsWeightedHomogeneous.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (hd : weight w d < n) : p.coeff d = 0
proof:
:=
  hp.coeff_eq_zero d (Nat.ne_of_lt hd)

name: MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_lowWeight
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  split_ifs with h
  · simpa using hp d (h ▸ hn)
  · simp

name: MvPolynomial.coeff_sub_weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : (p - weightedHomogeneousComponent w a p).coeff d =
      p.coeff d - (weightedHomogeneousComponent w a p).coeff d := by simp
  rw [hs, coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact sub_self _
  · rw [hp d (by omega), sub_zero]

name: MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_mul_of_lowWeight
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_mul_of_lowWeight {a b : ℕ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hp : ∀ d, weight w d < a → p.coeff d = 0) (hq : ∀ d, weight w d < b → q.coeff d = 0) :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent w (a + b) (p * q) =
      weightedHomogeneousComponent w a p * weightedHomogeneousComponent w b q
proof:
:= by
  set p₀ := weightedHomogeneousComponent w a p
  set q₀ := weightedHomogeneousComponent w b q
  have hp₀ : p₀.IsWeightedHomogeneous w a := weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous _ _
  have hq₀ : q₀.IsWeightedHomogeneous w b := weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous _ _
  have hp₁ : ∀ d, weight w d < a + 1 → (p - p₀).coeff d = 0 :=
    coeff_sub_weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero w hp
  have hq₁ : ∀ d, weight w d < b + 1 → (q - q₀).coeff d = 0 :=
    coeff_sub_weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero w hq
  have he : p * q = p₀ * q₀ + ((p - p₀) * q₀ + p₀ * (q - q₀) + (p - p₀) * (q - q₀)) := by ring
  have hr : ∀ d, weight w d < a + b + 1 →
      ((p - p₀) * q₀ + p₀ * (q - q₀) + (p - p₀) * (q - q₀)).coeff d = 0 := by
    intro d hd
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply,
      coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w hp₁ (hq₀.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt w) d (by omega),
      coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w (hp₀.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt w) hq₁ d (by omega),
      coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w hp₁ hq₁ d (by omega), add_zero]
  rw [he, map_add, weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w hr (by omega), add_zero]
  exact (hp₀.mul hq₀).weightedHomogeneousComponent_same

name: MvPolynomial.coeff_pderiv_eq_zero_of_lowWeight
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_pderiv, hp, zero_mul]
  simpa [map_add, weight_single] using hd

name: MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_pderiv
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_pderiv (i : σ) (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent w n (pderiv i p) =
      pderiv i (weightedHomogeneousComponent w (n + w i) p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_pderiv, coeff_pderiv,
    coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  have : weight w (d + single i 1) = weight w d + w i := by simp [map_add, weight_single]
  rw [this]
  by_cases h : weight w d = n
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

name: MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_derivation_of_lowWeight
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_derivation_of_lowWeight (hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1)
    (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R)) {k : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hp : ∀ d, weight w d < k + 1 → p.coeff d = 0) :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent w k (D p) =
      ∑ i, w i • (pderiv i (weightedHomogeneousComponent w (k + 1) p) *
        weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 (D (X i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivation_eq_sum_pderiv, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hD : ∀ d, weight w d < 0 → (D (X i)).coeff d = 0 := fun d hd => absurd hd (by omega)
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp (hw i) with h | h
  · rw [h, zero_smul]
    have hi : ∀ d, weight w d < k + 1 → (pderiv i p).coeff d = 0 := fun d hd =>
      coeff_pderiv_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w hp i d (by omega)
    exact weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w
      (coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w hi hD) (by omega)
  · rw [h, one_smul]
    have hi : ∀ d, weight w d < k → (pderiv i p).coeff d = 0 := fun d hd =>
      coeff_pderiv_eq_zero_of_lowWeight w hp i d (by omega)
    have := weightedHomogeneousComponent_mul_of_lowWeight w hi hD
    rw [add_zero] at this
    rw [this, weightedHomogeneousComponent_pderiv, h]

name: MvPolynomial.aeval_weight_zero_eq_weightedHomogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem aeval_weight_zero_eq_weightedHomogeneousComponent [DecidablePred fun i => w i = 0]
    (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    aeval (fun i => if w i = 0 then X i else 0) p = weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial d c =>
    have hm : (monomial d c).IsWeightedHomogeneous w (weight w d) :=
      isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial w d c rfl
    rw [aeval_monomial]
    by_cases h : weight w d = 0
    · have hs := hm.weightedHomogeneousComponent_same
      rw [h] at hs
      rw [hs, monomial_eq]
      congr 1
      apply Finsupp.prod_congr
      intro i hi
      have : w i = 0 := by
        rw [weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff] at h
        have := h i hi
        simpa [Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi] using this
      simp [this]
    · rw [hm.weightedHomogeneousComponent_ne 0 (Ne.symm h)]
      rw [weight_apply, Finsupp.sum] at h
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h
      have hw : w i ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by simp [h0])
      rw [Finsupp.prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero hi (by simp [hw, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi]),
        mul_zero]

name: MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_derivation_lowestWeight
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_derivation_lowestWeight (hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ 1) {p : MvPolynomial σ K}
    (h₀ : weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 p = 0)
    (hD : ∀ i, w i = 1 → ∃ D : Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K) (MvPolynomial σ K),
      D p = 0 ∧ weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 (D (X i)) ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ j, j ≠ i → w j = 1 → weightedHomogeneousComponent w 0 (D (X j)) = 0) :
    p = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype σ
  have key : ∀ k, ∀ d, weight w d < k → p.coeff d = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro d hd; omega
    | succ k ih =>
      have hk : weightedHomogeneousComponent w k p = 0 := by
        cases k with
        | zero => exact h₀
        | succ m =>
          set q := weightedHomogeneousComponent w (m + 1) p
          have hq : ∀ i, w i = 1 → pderiv i q = 0 := by
            intro i hi
            obtain ⟨D, hDp, hne, hother⟩ := hD i hi
            have he := weightedHomogeneousComponent_derivation_of_lowWeight w hw D ih
            rw [hDp, map_zero, Finset.sum_eq_single i] at he
            · rw [hi, one_smul] at he
              exact (mul_eq_zero.mp he.symm).resolve_right hne
            · intro j _ hji
              rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp (hw j) with h | h
              · rw [h, zero_smul]
              · rw [hother j hji h, mul_zero, smul_zero]
            · simp
          have heu := (weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous (w := w) (m + 1)
            p).sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv
          have hz : ∑ i, w i • (X i * pderiv i q) = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro i _
            rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp (hw i) with h | h
            · rw [h, zero_smul]
            · rw [hq i h, mul_zero, smul_zero]
          rw [hz, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero] at heu
          exact heu.resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero m)
      intro d hd
      by_cases h : weight w d < k
      · exact ih d h
      · have := congrArg (fun q => q.coeff d) hk
        simpa [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, show weight w d = k by omega]
          using this
  ext d
  exact key _ d (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

name: MvPolynomial.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_monomial_of_support_subset
statement:
theorem sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_monomial_of_support_subset
    (w : σ → ℕ) (s : Finset σ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (hs : m.support ⊆ s) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i • (X i * pderiv i (monomial m r))) =
      Finsupp.weight w m • monomial m r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [X_mul_pderiv_monomial, smul_smul, ← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_subset hs]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact Nat.mul_comm _ _
  · intro i _ hi
    simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hi]

name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_of_vars_subset
statement:
theorem IsWeightedHomogeneous.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_of_vars_subset
    {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {w : σ → ℕ} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (s : Finset σ) (hs : p.vars ⊆ s) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i • (X i * pderiv i p)) = n • p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, w i •
        (X i * pderiv i (∑ m ∈ p.support, monomial m (p.coeff m))) := by
      rw [support_sum_monomial_coeff]
    _ = ∑ m ∈ p.support, ∑ i ∈ s,
        w i • (X i * pderiv i (monomial m (p.coeff m))) := by
      simp only [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ m ∈ p.support, n • monomial m (p.coeff m) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      rw [sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_monomial_of_support_subset w s m (p.coeff m)
        ((support_subset_vars_of_mem_support hm).trans hs)]
      rw [hp (mem_support_iff.mp hm)]
    _ = n • p := by rw [← Finset.smul_sum, support_sum_monomial_coeff]

name: MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.sum_X_mul_pderiv_of_vars_subset
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneous.sum_X_mul_pderiv_of_vars_subset
    {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous n)
    (s : Finset σ) (hs : p.vars ⊆ s) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, X i * pderiv i p) = n • p
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Pi.one_apply, one_smul] using
    hp.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_of_vars_subset s hs

name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_add_exteriorDegree
statement:
theorem IsWeightedHomogeneous.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_add_exteriorDegree
    {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {w : σ → ℕ} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (s : Finset σ) (hs : p.vars ⊆ s) (q : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i • (X i * pderiv i p)) + q • p = (n + q) • p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_of_vars_subset s hs, add_smul]

name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.inv_degree_smul_euler_add_exteriorDegree
statement:
theorem IsWeightedHomogeneous.inv_degree_smul_euler_add_exteriorDegree
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {w : σ → ℕ} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (s : Finset σ) (hs : p.vars ⊆ s)
    (q : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < n + q) :
    ((n + q : ℕ) : K)⁻¹ • ((∑ i ∈ s, w i • (X i * pderiv i p)) + q • p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.sum_weight_X_mul_pderiv_add_exteriorDegree s hs q,
    ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hpos)), one_smul]

name: Submodule.powSumIdeal_mono
statement: lemma powSumIdeal_mono (I : Submodule R R) (x : R) : Monotone (powSumIdeal I x)
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n ↦ ?_
  rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun k ↦ if k = n then 0 else c k, fun k ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact I.zero_mem
    · exact hc k
  · rw [sum_range_succ]
    simp only [ite_true, zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by simp [(mem_range.mp hk).ne]

name: Submodule.eq_zero_of_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero {I : Submodule R R} {x : R} (hx : IsRightRegular x)
    (hI : I ⊓ span R {x} = ⊥) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → R), (∀ k, c k ∈ I) → ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), c k * x ^ k = 0 →
      ∀ k ≤ n, c k = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro c _ h k hk
    rw [Nat.le_zero.mp hk]
    simpa using h
  | succ n ih =>
    intro c hc h
    set S := ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), c (k + 1) * x ^ k
    have hsplit : ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1 + 1), c k * x ^ k = c 0 + S * x := by
      rw [sum_range_succ', sum_mul, pow_zero, mul_one, add_comm]
      congr 1
      exact sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
    rw [hsplit] at h
    have h0 : c 0 = 0 := by
      have hmem : c 0 ∈ I ⊓ span R {x} := by
        refine ⟨hc 0, ?_⟩
        rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h]
        exact mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨-S, by rw [smul_eq_mul, neg_mul]⟩
      rw [hI] at hmem
      exact (mem_bot R).mp hmem
    rw [h0, zero_add] at h
    have hS : S = 0 := hx (show S * x = 0 * x by rw [h, zero_mul])
    intro k hk
    rcases k with _ | k
    · exact h0
    · exact ih (fun k ↦ c (k + 1)) (fun k ↦ hc (k + 1)) hS k (by omega)

name: Submodule.inf_span_singleton_ne_bot
statement:
theorem inf_span_singleton_ne_bot [IsNoetherian R R] {x : R} (hx : IsRightRegular x)
    {I : Submodule R R} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) : I ⊓ span R {x} ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hinf
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr inferInstance
    ⟨powSumIdeal I x, powSumIdeal_mono I x⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff I).mp hI
  have hmem : a * x ^ N ∈ powSumIdeal I x (N + 1) := by
    refine ⟨fun k ↦ if k = N then a else 0, fun k ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · exact ha
      · exact I.zero_mem
    · rw [sum_range_succ, sum_eq_zero fun k hk ↦ by simp [(mem_range.mp hk).ne]]
      simp
  have hNN : powSumIdeal I x N = powSumIdeal I x (N + 1) := hN (N + 1) (Nat.le_succ N)
  rw [← hNN] at hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hac⟩ := hmem
  have := eq_zero_of_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero hx hinf N (fun k ↦ if k = N then a else -c k)
    (fun k ↦ by
      split_ifs
      · exact ha
      · exact I.neg_mem (hc k))
    (by
      have hs : ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k = N then a else -c k) * x ^ k =
          -∑ k ∈ range N, c k * x ^ k := by
        rw [← sum_neg_distrib]
        exact sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by simp [(mem_range.mp hk).ne]
      rw [sum_range_succ, hs]
      simp only [↓reduceIte]
      rw [hac, neg_add_cancel]) N le_rfl
  exact ha0 (by simpa using this)

name: Submodule.inf_ne_bot_of_noZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem inf_ne_bot_of_noZeroDivisors [IsNoetherian R R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {I J : Submodule R R}
    (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) : I ⊓ J ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff J).mp hJ
  have hreg : IsRightRegular x := fun a b hab ↦ mul_right_cancel₀ hx0 hab
  refine fun h ↦ inf_span_singleton_ne_bot hreg hI (eq_bot_iff.mpr ?_)
  rw [← h]
  exact inf_le_inf_left I ((span_singleton_le_iff_mem x J).mpr hx)

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatStep_iff_left
statement:
theorem bruhatStep_iff_left {u w : W} :
    cs.BruhatStep u w ↔ cs.IsReflection (w * u⁻¹) ∧ ℓ u < ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  have : u⁻¹ * w = u⁻¹ * (w * u⁻¹) * u⁻¹⁻¹ := by group
