  rw [BruhatStep, this, cs.isReflection_conj_iff]

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.length_lt
statement: theorem BruhatStep.length_lt {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatStep u w) : ℓ u < ℓ w

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.bruhatLE
statement: theorem BruhatStep.bruhatLE {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatStep u w) : cs.BruhatLE u w
proof:
:=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.single h

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.inv
statement: theorem BruhatStep.inv {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatStep u w) : cs.BruhatStep u⁻¹ w⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, by simpa using h.2⟩
  simpa using (bruhatStep_iff_left.mp h).1.isReflection_inv

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem bruhatLE_refl (w : W) : cs.BruhatLE w w
proof: := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.trans
statement:
theorem BruhatLE.trans {u v w : W} (h₁ : cs.BruhatLE u v) (h₂ : cs.BruhatLE v w) :
    cs.BruhatLE u w
proof:
:=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h₁ h₂

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.eq_or_length_lt
statement: theorem BruhatLE.eq_or_length_lt {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) : u = w ∨ ℓ u < ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .inl rfl
  | tail _ hs ih =>
    rcases ih with rfl | h
    · exact .inr hs.2
    · exact .inr (h.trans hs.2)

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.length_le
statement: theorem BruhatLE.length_le {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) : ℓ u ≤ ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.eq_or_length_lt with rfl | h
  · rfl
  · exact h.le

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.antisymm
statement: theorem BruhatLE.antisymm {u w : W} (h₁ : cs.BruhatLE u w) (h₂ : cs.BruhatLE w u) : u = w
proof:
:= by
  rcases h₁.eq_or_length_lt with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h₂.length_le (not_le.mpr h)

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.inv
statement: theorem BruhatLE.inv {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) : cs.BruhatLE u⁻¹ w⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hs ih => exact ih.trans hs.inv.bruhatLE

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_inv_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bruhatLE_inv_iff {u w : W} : cs.BruhatLE u⁻¹ w⁻¹ ↔ cs.BruhatLE u w
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h.inv, BruhatLE.inv⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatStep_mul_simple
statement:
theorem bruhatStep_mul_simple {w : W} {i : B} (h : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i) :
    cs.BruhatStep w (w * s i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simpa using cs.isReflection_simple i, by
    rw [(cs.not_isRightDescent_iff).mp h]; omega⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatStep_simple_mul
statement:
theorem bruhatStep_simple_mul {w : W} {i : B} (h : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent w i) :
    cs.BruhatStep w (s i * w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bruhatStep_iff_left]
  exact ⟨by simpa using cs.isReflection_simple i, by
    rw [(cs.not_isLeftDescent_iff).mp h]; omega⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_mul_simple
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_mul_simple {w : W} {i : B} (h : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i) :
    cs.BruhatLE w (w * s i)
proof:
:=
  (bruhatStep_mul_simple h).bruhatLE

name: CoxeterSystem.mul_simple_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem mul_simple_bruhatLE {w : W} {i : B} (h : cs.IsRightDescent w i) :
    cs.BruhatLE (w * s i) w
proof:
:= by
  have := bruhatLE_mul_simple ((cs.isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul).mp h)
  rwa [simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at this

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_simple_mul
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_simple_mul {w : W} {i : B} (h : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent w i) :
    cs.BruhatLE w (s i * w)
proof:
:=
  (bruhatStep_simple_mul h).bruhatLE

name: CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem simple_mul_bruhatLE {w : W} {i : B} (h : cs.IsLeftDescent w i) :
    cs.BruhatLE (s i * w) w
proof:
:= by
  have := bruhatLE_simple_mul ((cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul).mp h)
  rwa [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at this

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.mul_simple
statement:
theorem BruhatStep.mul_simple {y z : W} (h : cs.BruhatStep y z) (i : B) :
    y * s i = z ∨ cs.BruhatStep (y * s i) (z * s i)
proof:
:= by
  set t := y⁻¹ * z with ht_def
  have ht : cs.IsReflection t := h.1
  have hrefl : cs.IsReflection ((y * s i)⁻¹ * (z * s i)) := by
    have e : (y * s i)⁻¹ * (z * s i) = s i * t * (s i)⁻¹ := by
      rw [ht_def, mul_inv_rev]
      simp only [inv_simple]
      group
    rw [e]
    exact ht.conj _
  have hzt : z * t = y := by
    rw [← ht.inv, ht_def]
    group
  have hz : z * s i = y * s i * ((y * s i)⁻¹ * (z * s i)) := by group
  have hne : ℓ (z * s i) ≠ ℓ (y * s i) := by
    rw [hz]; exact hrefl.length_mul_left_ne _
  rcases hne.lt_or_gt with hlt | hlt
  swap
  · exact .inr ⟨hrefl, hlt⟩
  left
  have h1 := cs.length_mul_simple y i
  have h2 := cs.length_mul_simple z i
  have h3 := h.2
  have hzi : cs.IsRightDescent z i := by
    rw [isRightDescent_iff]; omega
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ, hζe⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced (z * s i)
  have hzω : z = π (ζ ++ [i]) := by
    rw [wordProd_append, ← hζe, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
  have hred : ℓ z = ζ.length + 1 := by
    rw [← hζ.eq, ← hζe]; rw [isRightDescent_iff] at hzi; omega
  have hinv : cs.IsRightInversion z t := ⟨ht, by rw [hzt]; exact h.2⟩
  rw [hzω] at hinv
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hje⟩ := hinv.exists_wordProd_mul_eq
  rw [← hzω, hzt] at hje
  simp only [length_append, length_singleton] at hj
  rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hj | rfl
  · exfalso
    rw [eraseIdx_append_of_lt_length hj, wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton] at hje
    have : y * s i = π (ζ.eraseIdx j) := by rw [hje, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
    have h4 := cs.length_wordProd_le (ζ.eraseIdx j)
    have h5 := List.length_eraseIdx_add_one hj
    rw [← this] at h4
    rw [hζe, hζ.eq] at hlt
    omega
  · rw [eraseIdx_append_of_length_le le_rfl, Nat.sub_self] at hje
    simp only [eraseIdx_cons_zero, append_nil] at hje
    rw [hje, ← hζe, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.mul_eq
statement: theorem BruhatStep.mul_eq {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatStep u w) : w * (u⁻¹ * w) = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.1.inv]
  group

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.isRightInversion
statement:
theorem BruhatStep.isRightInversion {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatStep u w) :
    cs.IsRightInversion w (u⁻¹ * w)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1, by rw [h.mul_eq]; exact h.2⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.isReflection_mul_simple_inv_mul
statement:
theorem isReflection_mul_simple_inv_mul {y z : W} (h : cs.IsReflection (y⁻¹ * z)) (i : B) :
    cs.IsReflection ((y * s i)⁻¹ * (z * s i))
proof:
:= by
  have e : (y * s i)⁻¹ * (z * s i) = s i * (y⁻¹ * z) * (s i)⁻¹ := by
    rw [mul_inv_rev]
    simp only [inv_simple]
    group
  rw [e]
  exact h.conj _

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.mul_simple_or
statement:
theorem BruhatLE.mul_simple_or {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) (i : B) :
    cs.BruhatLE (u * s i) w ∨ cs.BruhatLE (u * s i) (w * s i)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .inr (bruhatLE_refl _ _)
  | tail _ hs ih =>
    rcases ih with h | h
    · exact .inl (h.trans hs.bruhatLE)
    · rcases hs.mul_simple i with e | hs'
      · exact .inl (e ▸ h)
      · exact .inr (h.trans hs'.bruhatLE)

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.simple_mul_or
statement:
theorem BruhatLE.simple_mul_or {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) (i : B) :
    cs.BruhatLE (s i * u) w ∨ cs.BruhatLE (s i * u) (s i * w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.inv.mul_simple_or i with h' | h'
  · left
    rw [← bruhatLE_inv_iff]
    simpa [mul_inv_rev] using h'
  · right
    rw [← bruhatLE_inv_iff]
    simpa [mul_inv_rev] using h'

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.not_isRightDescent_of_append_singleton
statement:
theorem IsReduced.not_isRightDescent_of_append_singleton {ω : List B} {i : B}
    (hω : cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i])) : ¬cs.IsRightDescent (π ω) i
proof:
:= by
  have hω' : cs.IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.take ω.length
  rw [not_isRightDescent_iff, ← wordProd_singleton, ← wordProd_append, hω.eq, hω'.eq]
  simp

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.bruhatLE_of_sublist
statement:
theorem IsReduced.bruhatLE_of_sublist {ω σ : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (hσ : σ <+ ω) :
    cs.BruhatLE (π σ) (π ω)
proof:
:= by
  induction ω using List.reverseRecOn generalizing σ with
  | nil => rw [sublist_nil.mp hσ]
  | append_singleton ω i ih =>
    have hω' : cs.IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.take ω.length
    have hstep : cs.BruhatLE (π ω) (π (ω ++ [i])) := by
      rw [wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton]
      exact bruhatLE_mul_simple hω.not_isRightDescent_of_append_singleton
    obtain ⟨σ₁, σ₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := sublist_append_iff.mp hσ
    rcases sublist_singleton.mp h₂ with rfl | rfl
    · simpa using (ih hω' h₁).trans hstep
    · rw [wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton]
      rcases (ih hω' h₁).mul_simple_or i with h | h
      · exact h.trans hstep
      · rwa [wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton]

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.exists_sublist_of_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem IsReduced.exists_sublist_of_bruhatLE {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {u : W}
    (h : cs.BruhatLE u (π ω)) : ∃ σ, σ <+ ω ∧ cs.IsReduced σ ∧ π σ = u
proof:
:= by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl => exact ⟨ω, Sublist.refl _, hω, rfl⟩
  | head hs _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, -, hσe⟩ := ih
    have hinv := hs.isRightInversion
    rw [← hσe] at hinv
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := hinv.exists_wordProd_mul_eq
    rw [hσe, hs.mul_eq] at hj
    obtain ⟨σ', hσ', hσ'r, hσ'e⟩ := cs.exists_sublist_isReduced (σ.eraseIdx j)
    exact ⟨σ', hσ'.trans ((eraseIdx_sublist _ _).trans hσ), hσ'r, hσ'e.trans hj.symm⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.bruhatLE_iff
statement:
theorem IsReduced.bruhatLE_iff {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {u : W} :
    cs.BruhatLE u (π ω) ↔ ∃ σ, σ <+ ω ∧ π σ = u
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ let ⟨σ, h₁, _, h₃⟩ := hω.exists_sublist_of_bruhatLE h; ⟨σ, h₁, h₃⟩,
    fun ⟨_, h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ h₂ ▸ hω.bruhatLE_of_sublist h₁⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.bruhatLE_iff'
statement:
theorem IsReduced.bruhatLE_iff' {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {u : W} :
    cs.BruhatLE u (π ω) ↔ ∃ σ, σ <+ ω ∧ cs.IsReduced σ ∧ π σ = u
proof:
:=
  ⟨hω.exists_sublist_of_bruhatLE, fun ⟨_, h₁, _, h₂⟩ ↦ h₂ ▸ hω.bruhatLE_of_sublist h₁⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.one_bruhatLE
statement: theorem one_bruhatLE (w : W) : cs.BruhatLE 1 w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  exact hω.bruhatLE_iff.mpr ⟨[], nil_sublist _, wordProd_nil _⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.finite_setOf_bruhatLE
statement: theorem finite_setOf_bruhatLE (w : W) : {u | cs.BruhatLE u w}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  refine (ω.sublists.map cs.wordProd).finite_toSet.subset fun u hu ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩ := hω.bruhatLE_iff.mp hu
  exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨σ, List.mem_sublists.mpr hσ, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.finite_setOf_bruhatLE_and_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_bruhatLE_and_bruhatLE (u w : W) :
    {v | cs.BruhatLE u v ∧ cs.BruhatLE v w}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (cs.finite_setOf_bruhatLE w).subset fun _ hv ↦ hv.2

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_isReduced_append_singleton
statement:
theorem exists_isReduced_append_singleton {w : W} {i : B} (hw : cs.IsRightDescent w i) :
    ∃ ω, cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i]) ∧ π ω = w * s i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hωe⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced (w * s i)
  refine ⟨ω, ?_, hωe.symm⟩
  rw [isRightDescent_iff] at hw
  unfold IsReduced
  rw [wordProd_append, ← hωe, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right, length_append,
    ← hω.eq, ← hωe, length_singleton, hw]

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.lifting
statement:
theorem BruhatLE.lifting {u w : W} {i : B} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) (hw : cs.IsRightDescent w i)
    (hu : ¬cs.IsRightDescent u i) : cs.BruhatLE u (w * s i) ∧ cs.BruhatLE (u * s i) w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hωe⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced_append_singleton hw
  have hω' : cs.IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.take ω.length
  have hwω : w = π (ω ++ [i]) := by
    rw [wordProd_append, hωe, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
  have h1 : cs.BruhatLE u (w * s i) := by
    rw [hwω] at h
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσr, rfl⟩ := hω.exists_sublist_of_bruhatLE h
    obtain ⟨σ₁, σ₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := sublist_append_iff.mp hσ
    rcases sublist_singleton.mp h₂ with rfl | rfl
    · rw [← hωe, append_nil]
      exact hω'.bruhatLE_of_sublist h₁
    · exfalso
      apply hu
      rw [isRightDescent_iff, wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right,
        ← wordProd_singleton, ← wordProd_append, hσr.eq, length_append, length_singleton]
      have hσ₁ : cs.IsReduced σ₁ := by simpa using hσr.take σ₁.length
      rw [hσ₁.eq]
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rcases h1.mul_simple_or i with h2 | h2
  · exact h2.trans (mul_simple_bruhatLE hw)
  · rwa [simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at h2

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.lifting_left
statement:
theorem BruhatLE.lifting_left {u w : W} {i : B} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w)
    (hw : cs.IsLeftDescent w i) (hu : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent u i) :
    cs.BruhatLE u (s i * w) ∧ cs.BruhatLE (s i * u) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRightDescent_inv_iff] at hw hu
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h.inv.lifting hw hu
  exact ⟨by simpa using h1.inv, by simpa using h2.inv⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.mul_simple_bruhatLE_mul_simple_iff
statement:
theorem mul_simple_bruhatLE_mul_simple_iff {u w : W} {i : B} (hu : cs.IsRightDescent u i)
    (hw : cs.IsRightDescent w i) : cs.BruhatLE (u * s i) (w * s i) ↔ cs.BruhatLE u w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h.mul_simple_or i with h | h <;> rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at h
    · exact h.trans (mul_simple_bruhatLE hw)
    · rwa [simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at h
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨ω, hω, hωe⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced_append_singleton hw
    have hω' : cs.IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.take ω.length
    have hwω : w = π (ω ++ [i]) := by
      rw [wordProd_append, hωe, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
    rw [hwω] at h
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, -, rfl⟩ := hω.exists_sublist_of_bruhatLE h
    obtain ⟨σ₁, σ₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := sublist_append_iff.mp hσ
    rw [← hωe]
    rcases sublist_singleton.mp h₂ with rfl | rfl
    · rw [append_nil] at hu ⊢
      exact (mul_simple_bruhatLE hu).trans (hω'.bruhatLE_of_sublist h₁)
    · rw [wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
      exact hω'.bruhatLE_of_sublist h₁

name: CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_bruhatLE_simple_mul_iff
statement:
theorem simple_mul_bruhatLE_simple_mul_iff {u w : W} {i : B} (hu : cs.IsLeftDescent u i)
    (hw : cs.IsLeftDescent w i) : cs.BruhatLE (s i * u) (s i * w) ↔ cs.BruhatLE u w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRightDescent_inv_iff] at hu hw
  have := mul_simple_bruhatLE_mul_simple_iff hu hw
  rw [bruhatLE_inv_iff] at this
  rw [← this, ← bruhatLE_inv_iff]
  simp

name: CoxeterSystem.mul_simple_bruhatLE_iff_of_isRightDescent
statement:
theorem mul_simple_bruhatLE_iff_of_isRightDescent {y w : W} {i : B}
    (hw : cs.IsRightDescent w i) : cs.BruhatLE (y * s i) w ↔ cs.BruhatLE y w
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ y, cs.BruhatLE y w → cs.BruhatLE (y * s i) w := by
    intro y h
    by_cases hy : cs.IsRightDescent y i
    · exact (mul_simple_bruhatLE hy).trans h
    · exact (h.lifting hw hy).2
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, key y⟩
  simpa using key _ h

name: CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_bruhatLE_iff_of_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem simple_mul_bruhatLE_iff_of_isLeftDescent {y w : W} {i : B}
    (hw : cs.IsLeftDescent w i) : cs.BruhatLE (s i * y) w ↔ cs.BruhatLE y w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRightDescent_inv_iff] at hw
  rw [← bruhatLE_inv_iff, mul_inv_rev, inv_simple, mul_simple_bruhatLE_iff_of_isRightDescent hw,
    bruhatLE_inv_iff]

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.eq_of_length_le
statement: theorem BruhatLE.eq_of_length_le {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) (hl : ℓ w ≤ ℓ u) : u = w
proof:
:=
  h.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_right (not_lt.mpr hl)

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatLE.exists_bruhatStep_length_eq
statement:
theorem BruhatLE.exists_bruhatStep_length_eq {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE u w) (hne : u ≠ w) :
    ∃ v, cs.BruhatLE u v ∧ cs.BruhatStep v w ∧ ℓ w = ℓ v + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : ℓ w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing u w with
  | _ n ih =>
  subst hn
  have hlt := h.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left hne
  have hw1 : w ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; simp at hlt
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw1
  have hwi := (cs.isRightDescent_iff).mp hi
  have hstep : cs.BruhatStep (w * s i) w := by
    have := bruhatStep_mul_simple ((cs.isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul).mp hi)
    rwa [simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at this
  by_cases hu : cs.IsRightDescent u i
  · have h' := (mul_simple_bruhatLE_mul_simple_iff hu hi).mpr h
    have hne' : u * s i ≠ w * s i := fun e ↦ hne (mul_right_cancel e)
    obtain ⟨v', hv', hv's, hv'l⟩ := ih _ (by omega) h' hne' rfl
    have hor := hv'.mul_simple_or i
    rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at hor
    by_cases hv : cs.IsRightDescent v' i
    · refine ⟨w * s i, ?_, hstep, by omega⟩
      rcases hor with hor | hor
      · exact hor.trans hv's.bruhatLE
      · exact (hor.trans (mul_simple_bruhatLE hv)).trans hv's.bruhatLE
    · refine ⟨v' * s i, ?_, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rcases hor with hor | hor
        · exact hor.trans (bruhatLE_mul_simple hv)
        · exact hor
      · simpa using isReflection_mul_simple_inv_mul hv's.1 i
      · rw [(cs.not_isRightDescent_iff).mp hv]; omega
      · rw [(cs.not_isRightDescent_iff).mp hv]; omega
  · exact ⟨w * s i, (h.lifting hi hu).1, hstep, by omega⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_iff_reflTransGen
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_iff_reflTransGen {u w : W} :
    cs.BruhatLE u w ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y ↦ cs.BruhatStep x y ∧ ℓ y = ℓ x + 1) u w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ h ↦ h.1) _ _ h⟩
  induction hn : ℓ w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  subst hn
  by_cases hne : u = w
  · rw [hne]
  obtain ⟨v, huv, hvw, hl⟩ := h.exists_bruhatStep_length_eq hne
  exact (ih _ (by omega) huv rfl).tail ⟨hvw, hl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReflection.bruhatStep_or
statement:
theorem IsReflection.bruhatStep_or {t : W} (ht : cs.IsReflection t) (w : W) :
    cs.BruhatStep w (w * t) ∨ cs.BruhatStep (w * t) w
proof:
:= by
  rcases (ht.length_mul_left_ne w).lt_or_gt with h | h
  · exact .inr ⟨by simpa [ht.inv] using ht, h⟩
  · exact .inl ⟨by simpa using ht, h⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatOrder.toBruhatOrder_le_toBruhatOrder_iff
statement:
theorem toBruhatOrder_le_toBruhatOrder_iff {u w : W} :
    toBruhatOrder cs u ≤ toBruhatOrder cs w ↔ cs.BruhatLE u w
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatOrder.le_iff
statement:
theorem le_iff {u w : cs.BruhatOrder} :
    u ≤ w ↔ cs.BruhatLE (ofBruhatOrder cs u) (ofBruhatOrder cs w)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatOrder.lt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_iff {u w : cs.BruhatOrder} :
    u < w ↔ cs.BruhatLE (ofBruhatOrder cs u) (ofBruhatOrder cs w) ∧ u ≠ w
proof:
:=
  lt_iff_le_and_ne

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatOrder.covBy_iff
statement:
theorem covBy_iff {u w : cs.BruhatOrder} :
    u ⋖ w ↔ cs.BruhatStep (ofBruhatOrder cs u) (ofBruhatOrder cs w) ∧
      ℓ (ofBruhatOrder cs w) = ℓ (ofBruhatOrder cs u) + 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v, huv, hvw, hl⟩ := h.le.exists_bruhatStep_length_eq h.ne
    have hvw' : toBruhatOrder cs v < w :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hvw.bruhatLE (fun e ↦ by rw [← e] at hl; change ℓ v = ℓ v + 1 at hl; omega)
    have : u = toBruhatOrder cs v := by
      by_contra hne
      exact h.2 (lt_of_le_of_ne huv hne) hvw'
    subst this
    exact ⟨hvw, hl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, hl⟩
    refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hs.bruhatLE (fun e ↦ by rw [e] at hl; simp at hl), fun v h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_⟩
    have := h₁.le.length_le
    have := h₂.le.length_le
    have h₁' := h₁.le.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left h₁.ne
    have h₂' := h₂.le.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left h₂.ne
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatOrder.finite_Iic
statement: theorem finite_Iic (w : cs.BruhatOrder) : (Set.Iic w).Finite
proof:
:=
  cs.finite_setOf_bruhatLE (ofBruhatOrder cs w)

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatOrder.finite_Icc
statement: theorem finite_Icc (u w : cs.BruhatOrder) : (Set.Icc u w).Finite
proof:
:=
  (finite_Iic w).subset Set.Icc_subset_Iic_self

name: CoxeterSystem.isRightInversion_iff_inversionParity_eq_one
statement:
theorem isRightInversion_iff_inversionParity_eq_one [DecidableEq W] {w t : W} :
    cs.IsRightInversion w t ↔ cs.inversionParity w t = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  rw [inversionParity_eq_one_iff cs hω, mem_rightInvSeq_iff cs hω]

name: CoxeterSystem.isRightInversion_wordProd_iff
statement:
theorem isRightInversion_wordProd_iff [DecidableEq W] {ω : List B} {t : W} :
    cs.IsRightInversion (π ω) t ↔ Odd ((ris ω).count t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRightInversion_iff_inversionParity_eq_one, inversionParity_wordProd,
    ZMod.natCast_eq_one_iff_odd]

name: CoxeterSystem.IsRightInversion.mem_rightInvSeq
statement:
theorem IsRightInversion.mem_rightInvSeq {ω : List B} {t : W}
    (h : cs.IsRightInversion (π ω) t) : t ∈ ris ω
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isRightInversion_wordProd_iff] at h
  exact count_pos_iff.mp h.pos

name: CoxeterSystem.IsLeftInversion.mem_leftInvSeq
statement:
theorem IsLeftInversion.mem_leftInvSeq {ω : List B} {t : W}
    (h : cs.IsLeftInversion (π ω) t) : t ∈ lis ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRightInversion_inv_iff, ← wordProd_reverse] at h
  simpa [rightInvSeq_reverse] using h.mem_rightInvSeq

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.isLeftInversion_iff
statement:
theorem IsReduced.isLeftInversion_iff {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {t : W} :
    cs.IsLeftInversion (π ω) t ↔ t ∈ lis ω
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.mem_leftInvSeq, cs.isLeftInversion_of_mem_leftInvSeq hω⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.IsRightInversion.exists_wordProd_mul_eq
statement:
theorem IsRightInversion.exists_wordProd_mul_eq {ω : List B} {t : W}
    (h : cs.IsRightInversion (π ω) t) : ∃ j < ω.length, π ω * t = π (ω.eraseIdx j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp h.mem_rightInvSeq
  rw [length_rightInvSeq] at hj
  refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
  rw [← wordProd_mul_getD_rightInvSeq, List.getD_eq_getElem]

name: CoxeterSystem.IsLeftInversion.exists_mul_wordProd_eq
statement:
theorem IsLeftInversion.exists_mul_wordProd_eq {ω : List B} {t : W}
    (h : cs.IsLeftInversion (π ω) t) : ∃ j < ω.length, t * π ω = π (ω.eraseIdx j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp h.mem_leftInvSeq
  rw [length_leftInvSeq] at hj
  refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
  rw [← getD_leftInvSeq_mul_wordProd, List.getD_eq_getElem]

name: CoxeterSystem.IsRightDescent.exists_wordProd_mul_eq
statement:
theorem IsRightDescent.exists_wordProd_mul_eq {ω : List B} {i : B}
    (h : cs.IsRightDescent (π ω) i) : ∃ j < ω.length, π ω * s i = π (ω.eraseIdx j)
proof:
:=
  IsRightInversion.exists_wordProd_mul_eq cs
    ((cs.isRightInversion_simple_iff_isRightDescent _ _).mpr h)

name: CoxeterSystem.IsLeftDescent.exists_mul_wordProd_eq
statement:
theorem IsLeftDescent.exists_mul_wordProd_eq {ω : List B} {i : B}
    (h : cs.IsLeftDescent (π ω) i) : ∃ j < ω.length, s i * π ω = π (ω.eraseIdx j)
proof:
:=
  IsLeftInversion.exists_mul_wordProd_eq cs
    ((cs.isLeftInversion_simple_iff_isLeftDescent _ _).mpr h)

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_sublist_isReduced
statement:
theorem exists_sublist_isReduced (ω : List B) :
    ∃ ω' : List B, ω' <+ ω ∧ cs.IsReduced ω' ∧ π ω' = π ω
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], Sublist.slnil, by simp [IsReduced], rfl⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    obtain ⟨ω', hsub, hred, hprod⟩ := ih
    by_cases hi : cs.IsLeftDescent (π ω') i
    · obtain ⟨j, hjlt, hj⟩ := IsLeftDescent.exists_mul_wordProd_eq cs hi
      refine ⟨ω'.eraseIdx j, (eraseIdx_sublist _ _).trans (hsub.trans (sublist_cons_self _ _)),
        ?_, by rw [← hj, hprod, wordProd_cons]⟩
      have h1 := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hi
      have h2 := cs.length_wordProd_le (ω'.eraseIdx j)
      have h3 := List.length_eraseIdx_add_one hjlt
      unfold IsReduced
      rw [← hj]
      rw [hred.eq] at h1
      omega
    · refine ⟨i :: ω', hsub.cons_cons i, ?_, by rw [wordProd_cons, wordProd_cons, hprod]⟩
      have := (cs.not_isLeftDescent_iff).mp hi
      unfold IsReduced
      rw [wordProd_cons, this, hred.eq, length_cons]

name: CoxeterSystem.isReduced_iff_nodup_rightInvSeq
statement: theorem isReduced_iff_nodup_rightInvSeq {ω : List B} : cs.IsReduced ω ↔ (ris ω).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨IsReduced.nodup_rightInvSeq cs, fun hnd ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀, he⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced (π ω)
  have hsub : (ris ω).toFinset ⊆ (ris ω₀).toFinset := by
    intro t ht
    rw [List.mem_toFinset] at ht ⊢
    have : cs.IsRightInversion (π ω) t := by
      rw [isRightInversion_wordProd_iff, List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnd ht]
      exact odd_one
    rw [he] at this
    exact this.mem_rightInvSeq
  have h1 := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnd, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hω₀.nodup_rightInvSeq,
    length_rightInvSeq, length_rightInvSeq] at h1
  have h2 := cs.length_wordProd_le ω
  unfold IsReduced
  rw [he, hω₀.eq] at h2 ⊢
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.isReduced_iff_nodup_leftInvSeq
statement: theorem isReduced_iff_nodup_leftInvSeq {ω : List B} : cs.IsReduced ω ↔ (lis ω).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isReduced_reverse_iff, isReduced_iff_nodup_rightInvSeq, rightInvSeq_reverse,
    nodup_reverse]

name: CoxeterSystem.ncard_setOf_isRightInversion
statement: theorem ncard_setOf_isRightInversion (w : W) : {t | cs.IsRightInversion w t}.ncard = ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  have : {t | cs.IsRightInversion (π ω) t} = ↑(ris ω).toFinset := by
    ext t
    simp [(cs.mem_rightInvSeq_iff hω).symm]
  rw [this, Set.ncard_coe_finset, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hω.nodup_rightInvSeq,
    length_rightInvSeq, hω.eq]

name: CoxeterSystem.ncard_setOf_isLeftInversion
statement: theorem ncard_setOf_isLeftInversion (w : W) : {t | cs.IsLeftInversion w t}.ncard = ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← isRightInversion_inv_iff, ncard_setOf_isRightInversion, length_inv]

name: CoxeterSystem.finite_setOf_isRightInversion
statement: theorem finite_setOf_isRightInversion (w : W) : {t | cs.IsRightInversion w t}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  exact (ris ω).finite_toSet.subset fun t ht ↦ IsRightInversion.mem_rightInvSeq cs ht

name: CoxeterSystem.finite_setOf_isLeftInversion
statement: theorem finite_setOf_isLeftInversion (w : W) : {t | cs.IsLeftInversion w t}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← isRightInversion_inv_iff]
  exact cs.finite_setOf_isRightInversion w⁻¹

name: CoxeterSystem.mem_of_simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup
statement:
theorem mem_of_simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup {J : Set B} {l : B}
    (h : s l ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) : l ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hred, hJ, he⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup h
  have hlen : ω.length = 1 := by rw [← hred.eq, he, length_simple]
  obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
  rw [wordProd_singleton] at he
  rw [← cs.simple_injective he]
  exact hJ l' (by simp)

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_eq_wordProd_alternatingWord
proof:
:= by
  have hM1 : M i k ≠ 1 := M.off_diagonal i k hik
  obtain ⟨ω, hred, hJ, rfl⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup hu
  rcases ω.eq_nil_or_concat with rfl | ⟨ω', c, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by omega, rfl⟩
  
  have hc : c = k := by
    rcases hJ c (by simp) with hc | hc
    · subst hc
      exfalso
      apply hui
      have h1 := hred.eq
      rw [IsRightDescent, wordProd_concat, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
      rw [wordProd_concat] at h1
      rw [h1]
      have := cs.length_wordProd_le ω'
      simp only [concat_eq_append, length_append, length_singleton]
      omega
    · exact hc
  subst hc
  
  have hrev : cs.IsReduced (ω'.concat c).reverse := (cs.isReduced_reverse_iff _).mpr hred
  have halt := hrev.eq_reverse_alternatingWord (a := c) (b := i)
    (fun d hd ↦ by
      rcases hJ d (mem_reverse.mp hd) with h | h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl h)
    (by simp)
  rw [length_reverse, reverse_inj] at halt
  set n := (ω'.concat c).length with hn
  rw [halt] at hred hui ⊢
  refine ⟨n, ?_, rfl⟩
  by_cases hM : M i c = 0
  · exact Or.inl hM
  refine Or.inr ?_
  have hle : n ≤ M i c := by
    by_contra hlt
    exact cs.not_isReduced_alternatingWord i c hM (by omega) hred
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun heq ↦ hui ?_
  
  have e := cs.prod_alternatingWord_eq_prod_alternatingWord_sub i c n (by omega)
  rw [show M i c * 2 - n = (M i c - 1) + 1 by omega, alternatingWord_succ,
    wordProd_concat] at e
  rw [e, IsRightDescent, mul_assoc, simple_mul_simple_self, mul_one]
  have := cs.length_wordProd_le (alternatingWord i c (M i c - 1))
  have h2 : ℓ (π (alternatingWord i c (M i c - 1)) * s i) = M i c := by
    rw [← e, hred.eq, length_alternatingWord, heq]
  rw [length_alternatingWord] at this
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.dvd_of_wordProd_alternatingWord_eq
statement:
theorem dvd_of_wordProd_alternatingWord_eq {i k : B} {r : ℕ}
    (h : π (alternatingWord i k r) = π (alternatingWord k i r)) : M i k ∣ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cs.orderOf_simple_mul_simple i k]
  apply orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one
  rw [prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow, prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow] at h
  have hinv : s k * s i = (s i * s k)⁻¹ := by simp [mul_inv_rev]
  rw [hinv, inv_pow] at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht | ht⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' r
  · have he : Even r := ⟨t, by omega⟩
    simp only [he, ↓reduceIte, one_mul] at h
    have : t = r / 2 := by omega
    subst this
    rw [ht, pow_mul', sq]
    nth_rw 1 [h]
    exact inv_mul_cancel _
  · have he : ¬Even r := by rw [Nat.not_even_iff_odd]; exact ⟨t, ht⟩
    simp only [he, ↓reduceIte] at h
    have ht2 : r / 2 = t := by omega
    rw [ht2] at h
    
    have h' : (s i * s k) ^ (t + 1) = ((s i * s k) ^ t)⁻¹ := by
      rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, h, ← mul_assoc, simple_mul_simple_self, one_mul]
    rw [ht, pow_succ, show 2 * t = t + t by ring, pow_add, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, h',
      mul_inv_cancel]

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_of_alternatingWord_mul_simple_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | n
  · left
    simp only [alternatingWord, wordProd_nil, one_mul, mul_one] at h
    exact ⟨rfl, (cs.simple_injective h).symm⟩
  right
  have hMs : M k i = M i k := M.symmetric k i
  
  have hl : l ∈ ({i, k} : Set B) := by
    apply mem_of_simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup (cs := cs)
    have hu : π (alternatingWord i k (n + 1)) ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup {i, k} :=
      wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup fun c hc ↦ by
        rcases eq_or_eq_of_mem_alternatingWord hc with rfl | rfl <;> simp
    have : s l = π (alternatingWord i k (n + 1)) * s i * (π (alternatingWord i k (n + 1)))⁻¹ := by
      rw [h, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    rw [this]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hu (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup (by simp)))
      (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hu)
  
  have hus : π (alternatingWord i k (n + 1)) * s i = π (alternatingWord k i (n + 2)) := by
    rw [alternatingWord_succ k i (n + 1), wordProd_concat]
  have hlen : ℓ (π (alternatingWord k i (n + 2))) = n + 2 :=
    cs.length_wordProd_alternatingWord k i (by rw [hMs]; omega)
  
  have hfirst := alternatingWord_succ' i k n
  have hne : l ≠ if Even n then k else i := by
    intro hl'
    rw [hl', hus, hfirst, wordProd_cons, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at h
    have := cs.length_wordProd_le (alternatingWord i k n)
    rw [length_alternatingWord, ← h, hlen] at this
    omega
  have hl2 : l = if Even (n + 1) then k else i := by
    rcases hl with rfl | hl
    · by_cases he : Even n
      · simp [he, Nat.even_add_one]
      · simp [he] at hne
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hl
      subst hl
      by_cases he : Even n
      · simp [he] at hne
      · simp [he, Nat.even_add_one]
  refine ⟨?_, hl2⟩
  
  have heq : π (alternatingWord i k (n + 2)) = π (alternatingWord k i (n + 2)) := by
    rw [← hus, h, alternatingWord_succ' i k (n + 1), wordProd_cons, hl2]
  have hdvd := dvd_of_wordProd_alternatingWord_eq heq
  rcases hn with h0 | hlt
  · rw [h0, zero_dvd_iff] at hdvd
    omega
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.zmod_two_eq_zero_of_ne_one
statement: private theorem zmod_two_eq_zero_of_ne_one {x : ZMod 2} (h : x ≠ 1) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases x
  · rfl
  · exact absurd rfl h

name: CoxeterSystem.isRightInversion_mul_iff_of_forall
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ht : cs.IsReflection t
  · have h1 := (cs.isRightInversion_iff_inversionParity_eq_one).mp (hw _ (ht.conj u))
    rw [cs.isRightInversion_iff_inversionParity_eq_one,
      cs.isRightInversion_iff_inversionParity_eq_one, inversionParity_mul, h1]
    simp only [ht, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro h h'
      rw [h'] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
    · intro h
      rw [zmod_two_eq_zero_of_ne_one h, zero_add]
  · exact ⟨fun h ↦ absurd h.1 ht, fun h ↦ absurd h.1 ht⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.length_mul_of_forall_isRightInversion
proof:
:= by
  have hT : {t | cs.IsRightInversion w t} = {t | cs.IsReflection t} :=
    Set.ext fun t ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ h.1, hw t⟩
  have hwu : {t | cs.IsRightInversion (w * u) t} =
      {t | cs.IsReflection t} \ {t | cs.IsRightInversion u t} :=
    Set.ext fun t ↦ isRightInversion_mul_iff_of_forall hw u t
  have hsub : {t | cs.IsRightInversion u t} ⊆ {t | cs.IsReflection t} := fun t ht ↦ ht.1
  rw [← ncard_setOf_isRightInversion, hwu, Set.ncard_sdiff hsub
    (cs.finite_setOf_isRightInversion u), ← hT, ncard_setOf_isRightInversion,
    ncard_setOf_isRightInversion]

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_max_length
statement: private theorem exists_max_length : ∃ w₀ : W, ∀ w, ℓ w ≤ ℓ w₀
proof:
:=
  Finite.exists_max cs.length

name: CoxeterSystem.length_le_length_longestElement
statement: theorem length_le_length_longestElement (w : W) : ℓ w ≤ ℓ cs.longestElement
proof:
:=
  (cs.exists_max_length).choose_spec w

name: CoxeterSystem.isRightInversion_longestElement
statement:
theorem isRightInversion_longestElement {t : W} (ht : cs.IsReflection t) :
    cs.IsRightInversion cs.longestElement t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
  have := cs.length_le_length_longestElement (cs.longestElement * t)
  have := ht.length_mul_left_ne cs.longestElement
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.length_longestElement_mul
statement:
theorem length_longestElement_mul (u : W) :
    ℓ (cs.longestElement * u) = ℓ cs.longestElement - ℓ u
proof:
:=
  length_mul_of_forall_isRightInversion (fun _ ht ↦ cs.isRightInversion_longestElement ht) u

name: CoxeterSystem.longestElement_mul_self
statement: theorem longestElement_mul_self : cs.longestElement * cs.longestElement = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← length_eq_zero_iff, length_longestElement_mul, Nat.sub_self]

name: CoxeterSystem.inv_longestElement
statement: theorem inv_longestElement : cs.longestElement⁻¹ = cs.longestElement
proof:
:=
  inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right cs.longestElement_mul_self

name: CoxeterSystem.length_mul_longestElement
statement:
theorem length_mul_longestElement (u : W) :
    ℓ (u * cs.longestElement) = ℓ cs.longestElement - ℓ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← length_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_longestElement, length_longestElement_mul, length_inv]

name: CoxeterSystem.length_longestElement_mul_add
statement:
theorem length_longestElement_mul_add (u : W) :
    ℓ (cs.longestElement * u) + ℓ u = ℓ cs.longestElement
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_longestElement_mul]
  have := cs.length_le_length_longestElement u
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.isRightDescent_longestElement
statement: theorem isRightDescent_longestElement (i : B) : cs.IsRightDescent cs.longestElement i
proof:
:=
  ((cs.isRightInversion_simple_iff_isRightDescent _ _).mp
    (cs.isRightInversion_longestElement (cs.isReflection_simple i)))

name: CoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_longestElement
statement: theorem isLeftDescent_longestElement (i : B) : cs.IsLeftDescent cs.longestElement i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRightDescent_inv_iff, inv_longestElement]
  exact cs.isRightDescent_longestElement i

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_longestElement_iff_forall_isRightDescent
statement:
theorem eq_longestElement_iff_forall_isRightDescent {w : W} :
    w = cs.longestElement ↔ ∀ i, cs.IsRightDescent w i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i ↦ h ▸ cs.isRightDescent_longestElement i, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hne
  set y := w⁻¹ * cs.longestElement
  have hy1 : y ≠ 1 := fun h' ↦ hne (inv_mul_eq_one.mp h')
  have hly : ℓ y = ℓ cs.longestElement - ℓ w := by
    rw [← length_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, inv_longestElement, length_longestElement_mul]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hy1
  have h1 := (cs.isRightDescent_iff).mp (h i)
  have h2 := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hi
  have h3 : cs.longestElement = w * s i * (s i * y) := by
    simp [y, mul_assoc]
  have h4 := cs.length_mul_le (w * s i) (s i * y)
  rw [← h3] at h4
  have := cs.length_le_length_longestElement w
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_longestElement_of_forall_length_le
statement:
theorem eq_longestElement_of_forall_length_le {w : W} (h : ∀ u, ℓ u ≤ ℓ w) :
    w = cs.longestElement
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_longestElement_iff_forall_isRightDescent]
  intro i
  have := h (w * s i)
  rcases cs.length_mul_simple w i with h' | h'
  · omega
  · rw [isRightDescent_iff]; exact h'

name: CoxeterSystem.length_longestElement_eq_ncard
statement:
theorem length_longestElement_eq_ncard :
    ℓ cs.longestElement = {t | cs.IsReflection t}.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_setOf_isRightInversion]
  congr 1
  exact Set.ext fun t ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ h.1, cs.isRightInversion_longestElement⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_longestElement
statement: theorem bruhatLE_longestElement (w : W) : cs.BruhatLE w cs.longestElement
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  obtain ⟨ω', hω', he⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced ((π ω)⁻¹ * cs.longestElement)
  have hl : ℓ ((π ω)⁻¹ * cs.longestElement) = ℓ cs.longestElement - ℓ (π ω) := by
    rw [← length_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, inv_longestElement, length_longestElement_mul]
  have hred : cs.IsReduced (ω ++ ω') := by
    unfold IsReduced
    rw [wordProd_append, ← he, mul_inv_cancel_left, length_append, ← hω.eq, ← hω'.eq, ← he, hl]
    have := cs.length_le_length_longestElement (π ω)
    omega
  have := hred.bruhatLE_of_sublist (sublist_append_left ω ω')
  rwa [wordProd_append, ← he, mul_inv_cancel_left] at this

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_longestElement_mul_simple_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_longestElement_mul_simple_mul_eq (i : B) :
    ∃ j, cs.longestElement * s i * cs.longestElement = s j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← length_eq_one_iff, mul_assoc, length_longestElement_mul]
  have := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp (cs.isLeftDescent_longestElement i)
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatStep.longestElement_mul
statement:
theorem BruhatStep.longestElement_mul {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatStep u w) :
    cs.BruhatStep (cs.longestElement * w) (cs.longestElement * u)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have : (cs.longestElement * w)⁻¹ * (cs.longestElement * u) = (u⁻¹ * w)⁻¹ := by group
    rw [this]
    exact h.1.isReflection_inv
  · rw [length_longestElement_mul, length_longestElement_mul]
    have := h.2
    have := cs.length_le_length_longestElement w
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.longestElement_mul_bruhatLE_longestElement_mul_iff
statement:
theorem longestElement_mul_bruhatLE_longestElement_mul_iff {u w : W} :
    cs.BruhatLE (cs.longestElement * w) (cs.longestElement * u) ↔ cs.BruhatLE u w
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {u w : W}, cs.BruhatLE u w →
      cs.BruhatLE (cs.longestElement * w) (cs.longestElement * u) := by
    intro u w h
    induction h with
    | refl => rfl
    | tail _ hs ih => exact hs.longestElement_mul.bruhatLE.trans ih
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, key⟩
  have := key h
  rwa [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, longestElement_mul_self, one_mul, one_mul] at this

name: CoxeterSystem.mul_longestElement_bruhatLE_mul_longestElement_iff
statement:
theorem mul_longestElement_bruhatLE_mul_longestElement_iff {u w : W} :
    cs.BruhatLE (w * cs.longestElement) (u * cs.longestElement) ↔ cs.BruhatLE u w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bruhatLE_inv_iff, mul_inv_rev, mul_inv_rev, inv_longestElement,
    longestElement_mul_bruhatLE_longestElement_mul_iff, bruhatLE_inv_iff]

name: IsAlgClosed.exists_orderOf_eq
statement:
theorem IsAlgClosed.exists_orderOf_eq (K : Type*) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ ζ : K, orderOf ζ = n
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  classical
  have hsep : (X ^ n - C (1 : K)).Separable :=
    separable_X_pow_sub_C 1 (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne') one_ne_zero
  have hnd : (nthRoots n (1 : K)).Nodup := nodup_roots hsep
  have hcard : Multiset.card (nthRoots n (1 : K)) = n := by
    rw [nthRoots, splits_iff_card_roots.mp (IsAlgClosed.splits _), natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]
  have : Nat.card (rootsOfUnity n K) = n := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr (rootsOfUnityEquivNthRoots K n),
      Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun x ↦
        (Multiset.mem_toFinset (s := nthRoots n (1 : K)) (a := x)).symm),
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe, Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnd, hcard]
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_ofOrder_eq_natCard (α := rootsOfUnity n K)
  exact ⟨((g : Kˣ) : K), by rw [orderOf_units, Subgroup.orderOf_coe, hg, this]⟩

name: Module.End.sub_smul_pow_mul_apply
statement:
theorem Module.End.sub_smul_pow_mul_apply {σ τ : Module.End K V} {α β : V} {x y : K}
    (hxy : x * y = 1) (hσα : σ α = -α) (hσβ : σ β = β + (x + y) • α)
    (hτα : τ α = α + (x + y) • β) (hτβ : τ β = -β) (k : ℕ) :
    (x - y) • ((σ * τ) ^ k) α =
      (x ^ (2 * k + 1) - y ^ (2 * k + 1)) • α + (x ^ (2 * k) - y ^ (2 * k)) • β
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_smul, ih, map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
      Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, hτα, hτβ, map_add, map_smul, map_neg, hσα, hσβ]
    have e1 : (x ^ (2 * k + 1) - y ^ (2 * k + 1)) * ((x + y) ^ 2 - 1) -
        (x ^ (2 * k) - y ^ (2 * k)) * (x + y) = x ^ (2 * (k + 1) + 1) - y ^ (2 * (k + 1) + 1) := by
      linear_combination (2 * x ^ (2 * k) * x + x ^ (2 * k) * y - y ^ (2 * k) * x -
        2 * y ^ (2 * k) * y) * hxy
    have e2 : (x ^ (2 * k + 1) - y ^ (2 * k + 1)) * (x + y) - (x ^ (2 * k) - y ^ (2 * k)) =
        x ^ (2 * (k + 1)) - y ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by
      linear_combination (x ^ (2 * k) - y ^ (2 * k)) * hxy
    rw [← e1, ← e2]
    module

name: Module.End.pow_mul_apply_of_two
statement:
theorem Module.End.pow_mul_apply_of_two {σ τ : Module.End K V} {α β : V}
    (hσα : σ α = -α) (hσβ : σ β = β + (2 : K) • α)
    (hτα : τ α = α + (2 : K) • β) (hτβ : τ β = -β) (k : ℕ) :
    ((σ * τ) ^ k) α = (2 * k + 1 : K) • α + (2 * k : K) • β
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
      Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, hτα, hτβ, map_add, map_smul, map_neg, hσα, hσβ]
    push_cast
    module

name: aux_hyps
statement:
private theorem aux_hyps (hσ : ∀ v, σ v = v - (2 * φ v) • α)
    (hτ : ∀ v, τ v = v - (2 * ψ v) • β) (hφα : φ α = 1) (hφβ : φ β = -c) (hψα : ψ α = -c)
    (hψβ : ψ β = 1) :
    σ α = -α ∧ σ β = β + (2 * c) • α ∧ τ α = α + (2 * c) • β ∧ τ β = -β
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hσ, hφα]; module
  · rw [hσ, hφβ]; module
  · rw [hτ, hψα]; module
  · rw [hτ, hψβ]; module

name: Module.End.mul_pow_eq_one_of_reflections
statement:
theorem Module.End.mul_pow_eq_one_of_reflections (hσ : ∀ v, σ v = v - (2 * φ v) • α)
    (hτ : ∀ v, τ v = v - (2 * ψ v) • β) (hφα : φ α = 1) (hφβ : φ β = -c) (hψα : ψ α = -c)
    (hψβ : ψ β = 1) {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hc : 2 * c = x + x⁻¹) (hx2 : x ^ 2 ≠ 1) {m : ℕ}
    (hxm : x ^ (2 * m) = 1) : (σ * τ) ^ m = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσα, hσβ, hτα, hτβ⟩ := aux_hyps hσ hτ hφα hφβ hψα hψβ
  rw [hc] at hσβ hτα
  have hxy : x * x⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hx
  have hym : x⁻¹ ^ (2 * m) = 1 := by rw [inv_pow, hxm, inv_one]
  have hne : x - x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hx2
    have hxx : x = x⁻¹ := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    calc x ^ 2 = x * x := sq x
      _ = x * x⁻¹ := by rw [← hxx]
      _ = 1 := hxy
  have hgα : ((σ * τ) ^ m) α = α := by
    have := Module.End.sub_smul_pow_mul_apply hxy hσα hσβ hτα hτβ m
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, hxm, hym, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero, one_mul, one_mul] at this
    exact smul_right_injective V hne this
  have hhβ : ((τ * σ) ^ m) β = β := by
    have := Module.End.sub_smul_pow_mul_apply hxy hτβ hτα hσβ hσα m
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, hxm, hym, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero, one_mul, one_mul] at this
    exact smul_right_injective V hne this
  have hσσ : σ * σ = 1 := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
    rw [Module.End.mul_apply, hσ (σ v), hσ v, map_sub, map_smul, hφα, Module.End.one_apply]
    module
  have hττ : τ * τ = 1 := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
    rw [Module.End.mul_apply, hτ (τ v), hτ v, map_sub, map_smul, hψβ, Module.End.one_apply]
    module
  have h1 : σ * τ * (τ * σ) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc τ, hττ, one_mul, hσσ]
  have h2 : τ * σ * (σ * τ) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc σ, hσσ, one_mul, hττ]
  have hgβ : ((σ * τ) ^ m) β = β := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hhβ]
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← (show Commute (σ * τ) (τ * σ) from h1.trans h2.symm).mul_pow,
      h1, one_pow, Module.End.one_apply]
  
  have hd : 1 - c ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : (x - x⁻¹) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      linear_combination (-4) * h - (2 * c + x + x⁻¹) * hc - 4 * hxy
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp this
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  set a := (φ v + c * ψ v) / (1 - c ^ 2)
  set b := (ψ v + c * φ v) / (1 - c ^ 2)
  have hw1 : φ (v - (a • α + b • β)) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_smul, hφα, hφβ, smul_eq_mul, a, b]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hw2 : ψ (v - (a • α + b • β)) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_smul, hψα, hψβ, smul_eq_mul, a, b]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hfix : ∀ n, ((σ * τ) ^ n) (v - (a • α + b • β)) = v - (a • α + b • β) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, hτ, hw2, mul_zero, zero_smul,
        sub_zero, hσ, hw1, mul_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero, ih]
  have hv : v = (v - (a • α + b • β)) + (a • α + b • β) := by abel
  rw [hv, map_add, hfix, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hgα, hgβ, Module.End.one_apply]

name: Module.End.mul_pow_apply_ne_of_reflections
statement:
theorem Module.End.mul_pow_apply_ne_of_reflections (hσ : ∀ v, σ v = v - (2 * φ v) • α)
    (hτ : ∀ v, τ v = v - (2 * ψ v) • β) (hφα : φ α = 1) (hφβ : φ β = -c) (hψα : ψ α = -c)
    (hψβ : ψ β = 1) (hαβ : ∀ a b : K, a • α + b • β = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0) [CharZero K] {x : K}
    (hc : 2 * c = x + x⁻¹) {m : ℕ} (hxm : orderOf x = 2 * m) {k : ℕ} (hk0 : 0 < k)
    (hkm : k < m) : ((σ * τ) ^ k) α ≠ α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσα, hσβ, hτα, hτβ⟩ := aux_hyps hσ hτ hφα hφβ hψα hψβ
  rw [hc] at hσβ hτα
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [orderOf_eq_zero_iff'.mpr (fun n hn ↦ by simp [zero_pow hn.ne'])] at hxm
    omega
  have hxy : x * x⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hx
  intro h
  have := Module.End.sub_smul_pow_mul_apply hxy hσα hσβ hτα hτβ k
  rw [h] at this
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hαβ (x ^ (2 * k + 1) - x⁻¹ ^ (2 * k + 1) - (x - x⁻¹))
    (x ^ (2 * k) - x⁻¹ ^ (2 * k)) (by rw [sub_smul, this]; abel)
  
  have h4 : x ^ (2 * k) * x ^ (2 * k) = 1 :=
    calc x ^ (2 * k) * x ^ (2 * k) = x ^ (2 * k) * x⁻¹ ^ (2 * k) := by
          rw [← sub_eq_zero.mp h2]
      _ = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, one_pow]
  have hdvd : 2 * m ∣ 2 * k + 2 * k := by
    rw [← hxm]
    exact orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one (by rw [pow_add, h4])
  have hkm' : 2 * k = m := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hdvd
    rcases d with _ | _ | d <;> [omega; omega; nlinarith]
  
  have hxm1 : x ^ m ≠ 1 := by
    intro h'
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h')
    omega
  have hxm2 : x ^ m = -1 := by
    have : (x ^ m - 1) * (x ^ m + 1) = 0 := by
      rw [← hkm']
      linear_combination h4
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.mp h) hxm1
    · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
  have hym : x⁻¹ ^ m = -1 := by rw [inv_pow, hxm2, inv_neg, inv_one]
  rw [hkm', pow_succ, pow_succ, hxm2, hym] at h1
  have hxx : x = x⁻¹ := by
    have : (2 : K) * (x - x⁻¹) = 0 := by linear_combination -h1
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left two_ne_zero)
  have : x ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [sq]; nth_rewrite 2 [hxx]; exact hxy
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd two_pos (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one this)
  omega

name: Module.End.mul_pow_apply_ne_of_reflections_of_eq_one
statement:
theorem Module.End.mul_pow_apply_ne_of_reflections_of_eq_one
    (hσ : ∀ v, σ v = v - (2 * φ v) • α) (hτ : ∀ v, τ v = v - (2 * ψ v) • β) (hφα : φ α = 1)
    (hφβ : φ β = -1) (hψα : ψ α = -1) (hψβ : ψ β = 1)
    (hαβ : ∀ a b : K, a • α + b • β = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0) [CharZero K] {k : ℕ} (hk0 : 0 < k) :
    ((σ * τ) ^ k) α ≠ α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσα, hσβ, hτα, hτβ⟩ := aux_hyps hσ hτ hφα hφβ hψα hψβ
  rw [mul_one] at hσβ hτα
  intro h
  rw [Module.End.pow_mul_apply_of_two hσα hσβ hτα hτβ k] at h
  have e : (2 * k : K) • α + (2 * k : K) • β = ((2 * k + 1 : K) • α + (2 * k : K) • β) - α := by
    module
  obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := hαβ (2 * k) (2 * k) (by rw [e, h, sub_self])
  norm_cast at h2
  omega

name: smul_single_add_smul_single_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact ⟨by simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hij.symm] using congrArg (· i) h,
    by simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hij] using congrArg (· j) h⟩

name: CoxeterMatrix.orderOf_geomRoot
statement: theorem orderOf_geomRoot {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : orderOf (geomRoot K m) = 2 * m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [geomRoot, hm, ↓reduceDIte]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (IsAlgClosed.exists_orderOf_eq K (Nat.mul_pos two_pos hm))

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomRoot_pow_two_mul
statement: theorem geomRoot_pow_two_mul (m : ℕ) : geomRoot K m ^ (2 * m) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · simp
  · rw [← orderOf_geomRoot K hm]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one _

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomRoot_ne_zero
statement: theorem geomRoot_ne_zero (m : ℕ) : geomRoot K m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · simp [geomRoot]
  · intro h
    have := geomRoot_pow_two_mul K m
    rw [h, zero_pow (by omega)] at this
    exact zero_ne_one this

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomRoot_sq_ne_one
statement: theorem geomRoot_sq_ne_one {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) : geomRoot K m ^ 2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd two_pos (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h)
  rw [orderOf_geomRoot K (by omega)] at this
  omega

name: CoxeterMatrix.two_mul_geomCoeff
statement:
theorem two_mul_geomCoeff {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    2 * geomCoeff K m = geomRoot K m + (geomRoot K m)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [geomCoeff, hm, ↓reduceIte]
  ring

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomCoeff_zero
statement: theorem geomCoeff_zero : geomCoeff K 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [geomCoeff]

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomCoeff_one
statement: theorem geomCoeff_one : geomCoeff K 1 = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : geomRoot K 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by simpa using geomRoot_pow_two_mul K 1
  have h2 : geomRoot K 1 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := orderOf_geomRoot K one_pos
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at this
    omega
  have h3 : geomRoot K 1 = -1 := by
    have : (geomRoot K 1 - 1) * (geomRoot K 1 + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination h1
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.mp h) h2
    · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
  simp only [geomCoeff, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, h3]
  norm_num

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomForm_single
statement:
theorem geomForm_single (i j : B) (a : K) :
    M.geomForm K i (Finsupp.single j a) = a * -geomCoeff K (M i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [geomForm, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomForm_single_self
statement: theorem geomForm_single_self (i : B) (a : K) : M.geomForm K i (Finsupp.single i a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [geomForm_single, M.diagonal, geomCoeff_one]
  ring

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomReflection_apply
statement:
theorem geomReflection_apply (i : B) (v : B →₀ K) :
    M.geomReflection K i v = v - M.geomForm K i v • Finsupp.single i 2
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomReflection_of_geomForm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem geomReflection_of_geomForm_eq_zero {i : B} {v : B →₀ K} (h : M.geomForm K i v = 0) :
    M.geomReflection K i v = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [geomReflection_apply, h, zero_smul, sub_zero]

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomReflection_single
statement:
theorem geomReflection_single (i j : B) :
    M.geomReflection K i (Finsupp.single j 1) =
      Finsupp.single j 1 + (2 * geomCoeff K (M i j)) • Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [geomReflection_apply, geomForm_single, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one i (2 : K)]
  module

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomReflection_single_self
statement:
theorem geomReflection_single_self (i : B) :
    M.geomReflection K i (Finsupp.single i 1) = -Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [geomReflection_single, M.diagonal, geomCoeff_one]
  module

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomReflection_mul_self
statement: theorem geomReflection_mul_self (i : B) : M.geomReflection K i * M.geomReflection K i = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  have : M.geomForm K i (M.geomReflection K i v) = -M.geomForm K i v := by
    rw [geomReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, geomForm_single_self, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
    M.geomReflection_apply K i (M.geomReflection K i v), this, geomReflection_apply]
  module

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomReflection_apply'
statement:
theorem geomReflection_apply' (i : B) (v : B →₀ K) :
    M.geomReflection K i v = v - (2 * M.geomForm K i v) • Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [geomReflection_apply, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one i (2 : K), smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomForm_single_one_of_symm
statement:
theorem geomForm_single_one_of_symm (i j : B) :
    M.geomForm K j (Finsupp.single i 1) = -geomCoeff K (M i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [geomForm_single, one_mul, M.symmetric j i]

name: CoxeterMatrix.isLiftable_geomReflection
statement: theorem isLiftable_geomReflection : M.IsLiftable (M.geomReflection K)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    rw [M.diagonal, pow_one, geomReflection_mul_self]
  by_cases hm0 : M i j = 0
  · rw [hm0, pow_zero]
  have hm : 1 < M i j := by have := M.off_diagonal i j hij; omega
  exact Module.End.mul_pow_eq_one_of_reflections (M.geomReflection_apply' K i)
    (M.geomReflection_apply' K j) (M.geomForm_single_self K i 1)
    (by rw [geomForm_single, one_mul]) (M.geomForm_single_one_of_symm K i j)
    (M.geomForm_single_self K j 1) (geomRoot_ne_zero K _) (two_mul_geomCoeff K hm0)
    (geomRoot_sq_ne_one K hm) (geomRoot_pow_two_mul K _)

name: CoxeterMatrix.geomReflection_mul_pow_apply_ne
statement:
theorem geomReflection_mul_pow_apply_ne {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) {k : ℕ} (hk0 : 0 < k)
    (hk : M i j = 0 ∨ k < M i j) :
    ((M.geomReflection K i * M.geomReflection K j) ^ k) (Finsupp.single i 1) ≠
      Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk with hm0 | hk
  · have hc : geomCoeff K (M i j) = 1 := by rw [hm0, geomCoeff_zero]
    exact Module.End.mul_pow_apply_ne_of_reflections_of_eq_one (M.geomReflection_apply' K i)
      (M.geomReflection_apply' K j) (M.geomForm_single_self K i 1)
      (by rw [geomForm_single, one_mul, hc]) (by rw [geomForm_single_one_of_symm, hc])
      (M.geomForm_single_self K j 1) (smul_single_add_smul_single_eq_zero hij) hk0
  · exact Module.End.mul_pow_apply_ne_of_reflections (M.geomReflection_apply' K i)
      (M.geomReflection_apply' K j) (M.geomForm_single_self K i 1)
      (by rw [geomForm_single, one_mul]) (M.geomForm_single_one_of_symm K i j)
      (M.geomForm_single_self K j 1) (smul_single_add_smul_single_eq_zero hij)
      (two_mul_geomCoeff K (by omega)) (orderOf_geomRoot K (by omega)) hk0 hk

name: CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_simple
statement:
theorem geometricRepresentation_simple (i : B) :
    cs.geometricRepresentation K (cs.simple i) = M.geomReflection K i
proof:
:=
  cs.lift_apply_simple _ i

name: CoxeterSystem.orderOf_simple_mul_simple
statement: theorem orderOf_simple_mul_simple (i j : B) : orderOf (cs.simple i * cs.simple j) = M i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    simp
  let K := AlgebraicClosure ℚ
  have : CharZero K := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap ℚ K).injective
  have key : ∀ k, 0 < k → (M i j = 0 ∨ k < M i j) → (cs.simple i * cs.simple j) ^ k ≠ 1 := by
    intro k hk0 hk h
    apply M.geomReflection_mul_pow_apply_ne K hij hk0 hk
    have := congrArg (cs.geometricRepresentation K) h
    rw [map_pow, map_mul, geometricRepresentation_simple, geometricRepresentation_simple,
      map_one] at this
    rw [this, Module.End.one_apply]
  by_cases hm0 : M i j = 0
  · rw [hm0, orderOf_eq_zero_iff']
    exact fun k hk ↦ key k hk (.inl hm0)
  · rw [orderOf_eq_iff (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0)]
    exact ⟨cs.simple_mul_simple_pow i j, fun k hk hk0 ↦ key k hk0 (.inr hk)⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.simple_injective
statement: theorem simple_injective : Function.Injective cs.simple
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  by_contra hij
  have := cs.orderOf_simple_mul_simple i j
  rw [h, simple_mul_simple_self, orderOf_one] at this
  exact M.off_diagonal i j hij this.symm

name: CoxeterSystem.nodup_take_leftInvSeq_alternatingWord
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.Nodup, List.pairwise_iff_getElem]
  intro n n' hn hn' hlt
  simp only [List.length_take, length_leftInvSeq, length_alternatingWord] at hn hn'
  rw [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_take,
    getElem_leftInvSeq_alternatingWord cs a b k n (by omega),
    getElem_leftInvSeq_alternatingWord cs a b k n' (by omega), prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow,
    prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow]
  simp only [Nat.not_even_two_mul_add_one, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [show (2 * n + 1) / 2 = n by omega, show (2 * n' + 1) / 2 = n' by omega]
  intro h
  replace h := mul_left_cancel h
  have hord := cs.orderOf_simple_mul_simple b a
  rw [M.symmetric b a] at hord
  rcases hk with h0 | hk
  · rw [h0] at hord
    have := injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder.mpr (orderOf_eq_zero_iff.mp hord) h
    omega
  · have := pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf (x := cs.simple b * cs.simple a)
      (by rw [Set.mem_Iio, hord]; omega) (by rw [Set.mem_Iio, hord]; omega) h
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.isReduced_alternatingWord
statement:
theorem isReduced_alternatingWord (i j : B) {k : ℕ} (hk : M i j = 0 ∨ k ≤ M i j) :
    cs.IsReduced (alternatingWord i j k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk0
  · simp [IsReduced, alternatingWord]
  rw [isReduced_iff_nodup_leftInvSeq]
  by_cases he : Even k
  · have := listTake_alternatingWord i j k k (by omega)
    simp only [he, ↓reduceIte] at this
    rw [← this, leftInvSeq_take]
    exact cs.nodup_take_leftInvSeq_alternatingWord i j hk
  · have := listTake_alternatingWord j i k k (by omega)
    simp only [he, ↓reduceIte] at this
    rw [← this, leftInvSeq_take]
    exact cs.nodup_take_leftInvSeq_alternatingWord j i (by rwa [M.symmetric j i])

name: CoxeterSystem.length_wordProd_alternatingWord
statement:
theorem length_wordProd_alternatingWord (i j : B) {k : ℕ} (hk : M i j = 0 ∨ k ≤ M i j) :
    cs.length (cs.wordProd (alternatingWord i j k)) = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [(cs.isReduced_alternatingWord i j hk).eq, length_alternatingWord]

name: CoxeterSystem.rightInvSeq_cons
statement:
theorem rightInvSeq_cons (i : B) (ω : List B) :
    ris (i :: ω) = (π ω)⁻¹ * s i * π ω :: ris ω
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.map_conj_rightInvSeq
statement: theorem map_conj_rightInvSeq (ω : List B) : (ris ω).map (MulAut.conj (π ω)) = lis ω
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [rightInvSeq, leftInvSeq, ← ih, wordProd_cons, map_cons, map_map]
    congr 1
    · simp only [MulAut.conj_apply]
      group
    · congr 1
      ext x
      simp [MulAut.conj_apply, mul_assoc]

name: CoxeterSystem.rightInvSeq_eq_leftInvSeq_of_wordProd_eq_one
statement:
theorem rightInvSeq_eq_leftInvSeq_of_wordProd_eq_one {ω : List B} (h : π ω = 1) :
    ris ω = lis ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_conj_rightInvSeq, h, map_one]
  simp

name: CoxeterSystem.wordProd_alternatingWord_two_mul
statement:
theorem wordProd_alternatingWord_two_mul (i i' : B) (m : ℕ) :
    π (alternatingWord i i' (2 * m)) = (s i * s i') ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow]
  simp

name: CoxeterSystem.prod_map_alternatingWord_two_mul
statement:
theorem prod_map_alternatingWord_two_mul {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (f : B → G) (i i' : B) (m : ℕ) :
    ((alternatingWord i i' (2 * m)).map f).prod = (f i * f i') ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [alternatingWord]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 1 + 1 by ring, alternatingWord_succ, alternatingWord_succ]
    simp [ih, pow_succ]

name: CoxeterSystem.even_count_rightInvSeq_alternatingWord
statement:
theorem even_count_rightInvSeq_alternatingWord (i i' : B) (t : W) :
    Even ((ris (alternatingWord i i' (2 * M i i'))).count t)
proof:
:= by
  set p := M i i'
  set L := ris (alternatingWord i i' (2 * p))
  have hπ : π (alternatingWord i i' (2 * p)) = 1 := by
    rw [wordProd_alternatingWord_two_mul, cs.simple_mul_simple_pow]
  have hL : L = lis (alternatingWord i i' (2 * p)) :=
    cs.rightInvSeq_eq_leftInvSeq_of_wordProd_eq_one hπ
  have hlen : L.length = 2 * p := by simp [L]
  have hdrop : L.drop p = L.take p := by
    apply List.ext_getElem (by simp [hlen]; lia)
    intro k h₁ h₂
    have hk : k < p := by simp [hlen] at h₂; lia
    simp only [getElem_drop, getElem_take]
    simp only [L, hL]
    rw [cs.getElem_leftInvSeq_alternatingWord i i' p (p + k) (by lia),
      cs.getElem_leftInvSeq_alternatingWord i i' p k (by lia), prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow,
      prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow]
    have e₁ : (2 * (p + k) + 1) / 2 = k + p := by lia
    have e₂ : (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k := by lia
    have hp : (s i' * s i) ^ p = 1 := by
      simp only [p, M.symmetric i i', cs.simple_mul_simple_pow]
    rw [e₁, e₂, pow_add, hp, mul_one]
    have o₁ : ¬ Even (2 * (p + k) + 1) := by simp [parity_simps]
    have o₂ : ¬ Even (2 * k + 1) := by simp [parity_simps]
    simp [o₁, o₂]
  rw [← List.take_append_drop p L, hdrop, List.count_append]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.reflPerm_apply
statement:
theorem reflPerm_apply (i : B) (x : W × ZMod 2) :
    cs.reflPerm i x = (s i * x.1 * s i, x.2 + if x.1 = s i then 1 else 0)
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.prod_map_reflPerm_apply
statement:
theorem prod_map_reflPerm_apply (ω : List B) (t : W) (ε : ZMod 2) :
    (ω.map cs.reflPerm).prod (t, ε) = (π ω * t * (π ω)⁻¹, ε + ((ris ω).count t : ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing t ε with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [map_cons, prod_cons, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ih, reflPerm_apply, wordProd_cons,
      rightInvSeq_cons, count_cons]
    have h : π ω * t * (π ω)⁻¹ = s i ↔ ((π ω)⁻¹ * s i * π ω == t) = true := by
      rw [beq_iff_eq]
      constructor
      · rintro h; rw [← h]; group
      · rintro h; rw [← h]; group
    ext
    · simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_simple]
      group
    · simp only [h]
      split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: CoxeterSystem.isLiftable_reflPerm
statement: theorem isLiftable_reflPerm : M.IsLiftable cs.reflPerm
proof:
:= by
  intro i i'
  ext ⟨t, ε⟩ : 1
  rw [← prod_map_alternatingWord_two_mul, prod_map_reflPerm_apply,
    wordProd_alternatingWord_two_mul, cs.simple_mul_simple_pow]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := cs.even_count_rightInvSeq_alternatingWord i i' t
  rw [hk]
  simp only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one, Nat.cast_add, Equiv.Perm.coe_one, id_eq]
  congr 1
  rw [← two_mul, show (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, zero_mul, add_zero]

name: CoxeterSystem.reflRep_simple
statement: theorem reflRep_simple (i : B) : cs.reflRep (s i) = cs.reflPerm i
proof:
:=
  cs.lift_apply_simple cs.isLiftable_reflPerm i

name: CoxeterSystem.reflRep_wordProd
statement: theorem reflRep_wordProd (ω : List B) : cs.reflRep (π ω) = (ω.map cs.reflPerm).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordProd, map_list_prod, map_map]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun i _ ↦ cs.reflRep_simple i

name: CoxeterSystem.inversionParity_wordProd
statement:
theorem inversionParity_wordProd (ω : List B) (t : W) :
    cs.inversionParity (π ω) t = (ris ω).count t
proof:
:= by
  simp [inversionParity, reflRep_wordProd, prod_map_reflPerm_apply]

name: CoxeterSystem.reflRep_apply
statement:
theorem reflRep_apply (w t : W) (ε : ZMod 2) :
    cs.reflRep w (t, ε) = (w * t * w⁻¹, ε + cs.inversionParity w t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, -, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  rw [inversionParity_wordProd, reflRep_wordProd, prod_map_reflPerm_apply]

name: CoxeterSystem.inversionParity_one
statement: theorem inversionParity_one (t : W) : cs.inversionParity 1 t = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [inversionParity]

name: CoxeterSystem.inversionParity_mul
statement:
theorem inversionParity_mul (u v t : W) :
    cs.inversionParity (u * v) t = cs.inversionParity v t + cs.inversionParity u (v * t * v⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have := cs.reflRep_apply (u * v) t 0
  rw [map_mul, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, reflRep_apply, reflRep_apply] at this
  simpa using (congrArg Prod.snd this).symm

name: CoxeterSystem.inversionParity_simple
statement:
theorem inversionParity_simple (i : B) (t : W) :
    cs.inversionParity (s i) t = if t = s i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [inversionParity, reflRep_simple, reflPerm_apply]

name: CoxeterSystem.inversionParity_self
statement: theorem inversionParity_self {t : W} (ht : cs.IsReflection t) : cs.inversionParity t t = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, i, rfl⟩ := ht
  have h₁ := cs.inversionParity_mul (u * s i) u⁻¹ (u * s i * u⁻¹)
  have h₂ := cs.inversionParity_mul u (s i) (u⁻¹ * (u * s i * u⁻¹) * u⁻¹⁻¹)
  have h₃ := cs.inversionParity_mul u u⁻¹ (u * s i * u⁻¹)
  have e : u⁻¹ * (u * s i * u⁻¹) * u⁻¹⁻¹ = s i := by group
  have e' : s i * s i * (s i)⁻¹ = s i := by group
  rw [e, cs.inversionParity_simple, e'] at h₂
  simp only [↓reduceIte] at h₂
  rw [e] at h₁
  rw [mul_inv_cancel, inversionParity_one, e] at h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  linear_combination -h₃

name: CoxeterSystem.inversionParity_mul_self
statement:
theorem inversionParity_mul_self {t : W} (ht : cs.IsReflection t) (w : W) :
    cs.inversionParity (w * t) t = 1 + cs.inversionParity w t
proof:
:= by
  rw [inversionParity_mul, inversionParity_self cs ht]
  congr 2
  group

name: CoxeterSystem.inversionParity_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem inversionParity_eq_one_iff {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (t : W) :
    cs.inversionParity (π ω) t = 1 ↔ t ∈ ris ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [inversionParity_wordProd, ← List.count_pos_iff]
  have := List.nodup_iff_count_le_one.mp hω.nodup_rightInvSeq t
  interval_cases h : (ris ω).count t <;> simp

name: CoxeterSystem.mem_rightInvSeq_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rightInvSeq_iff {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {t : W} :
    t ∈ ris ω ↔ cs.IsRightInversion (π ω) t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨cs.isRightInversion_of_mem_rightInvSeq hω, fun ⟨ht, hlt⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hmem
  rw [← inversionParity_eq_one_iff cs hω] at hmem
  have h0 : cs.inversionParity (π ω) t = 0 := by
    generalize cs.inversionParity (π ω) t = x at hmem
    revert x; decide
  obtain ⟨ω', hω', he⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced (π ω * t)
  have h1 : cs.inversionParity (π ω') t = 1 := by
    rw [← he, inversionParity_mul_self cs ht, h0, add_zero]
  rw [inversionParity_eq_one_iff cs hω'] at h1
  have := (cs.isRightInversion_of_mem_rightInvSeq hω' h1).2
  rw [← he, mul_assoc, ht.mul_self, mul_one] at this
  lia

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_mul_eq_wordProd_eraseIdx
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_wordProd_eraseIdx {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {t : W}
    (ht : cs.IsRightInversion (π ω) t) :
    ∃ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < ω.length), t = (ris ω)[j]'(by simpa using hj) ∧
      π ω * t = π (ω.eraseIdx j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ((cs.mem_rightInvSeq_iff hω).mpr ht)
  refine ⟨j, by simpa using hj, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [← cs.wordProd_mul_getD_rightInvSeq, List.getD_eq_getElem]

name: CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_eq_mul_simple
statement:
theorem simple_mul_eq_mul_simple {i j : B} {w : W} (h₁ : ℓ (s i * w * s j) = ℓ w)
    (h₂ : ℓ (s i * w) = ℓ (w * s j)) : s i * w = w * s j
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ w : W, ℓ (s i * w * s j) = ℓ w → ℓ (s i * w) = ℓ (w * s j) →
      ℓ w < ℓ (s i * w) → s i * w = w * s j := by
    intro w h₁ h₂ hlt
    obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
    have hω' : cs.IsReduced (i :: ω) := by
      rw [IsReduced, wordProd_cons, length_cons]
      rcases cs.length_simple_mul (π ω) i with h | h
      · rw [h, hω.eq]
      · lia
    have hinv : cs.IsRightInversion (π (i :: ω)) (s j) := by
      refine ⟨cs.isReflection_simple j, ?_⟩
      rw [wordProd_cons, h₁]
      exact hlt
    rw [← mem_rightInvSeq_iff cs hω', rightInvSeq_cons, mem_cons] at hinv
    rcases hinv with h | h
    · rw [h]; group
    · have := (cs.isRightInversion_of_mem_rightInvSeq hω h).2
      lia
  rcases cs.length_simple_mul w i with h | h
  · exact key w h₁ h₂ (by lia)
  · 
    have h' := key (s i * w) (by rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left, h₂])
      (by rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left, h₁])
      (by rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; lia)
    rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at h'
    nth_rewrite 1 [h']
    simp only [← mul_assoc, simple_mul_simple_self, one_mul]

name: CoxeterSystem.induction_mul_simple
statement:
theorem induction_mul_simple {p : W → Prop} (one : p 1)
    (mul_simple : ∀ w i, ℓ w < ℓ (w * s i) → p w → p (w * s i)) (w : W) : p w
proof:
:= by
  induction h : ℓ w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
    rcases eq_or_ne w 1 with rfl | hw
    · exact one
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw
    have e : w * s i * s i = w := cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right i
    rw [← e]
    refine mul_simple _ i (by rw [e]; exact hi) (ih _ ?_ _ rfl)
    rw [← h]
    exact hi

name: CoxeterSystem.induction_simple_mul
statement:
theorem induction_simple_mul {p : W → Prop} (one : p 1)
    (simple_mul : ∀ w i, ℓ w < ℓ (s i * w) → p w → p (s i * w)) (w : W) : p w
proof:
:= by
  induction h : ℓ w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
    rcases eq_or_ne w 1 with rfl | hw
    · exact one
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw
    have e : s i * (s i * w) = w := cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left i
    rw [← e]
    refine simple_mul _ i (by rw [e]; exact hi) (ih _ ?_ _ rfl)
    rw [← h]
    exact hi

name: CoxeterMatrix.BraidMove.symm
statement: theorem BraidMove.symm {ω ω' : List B} (h : M.BraidMove ω ω') : M.BraidMove ω' ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, i, j, hij, hm, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  exact ⟨l, r, j, i, hij.symm, by rwa [M.symmetric], h₂, h₁⟩

name: CoxeterMatrix.BraidMove.cons
statement:
theorem BraidMove.cons {ω ω' : List B} (h : M.BraidMove ω ω') (a : B) :
    M.BraidMove (a :: ω) (a :: ω')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, i, j, hij, hm, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a :: l, r, i, j, hij, hm, rfl, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterMatrix.BraidMove.append_right
statement:
theorem BraidMove.append_right {ω ω' : List B} (h : M.BraidMove ω ω') (γ : List B) :
    M.BraidMove (ω ++ γ) (ω' ++ γ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, i, j, hij, hm, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨l, r ++ γ, i, j, hij, hm, by simp, by simp⟩

name: CoxeterMatrix.braidMove_braidWord
statement:
theorem braidMove_braidWord {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) (hm : M i j ≠ 0) (γ : List B) :
    M.BraidMove (CoxeterSystem.braidWord M i j ++ γ) (CoxeterSystem.braidWord M j i ++ γ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨[], γ, i, j, hij, hm, rfl, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterMatrix.BraidMove.length_eq
statement: theorem BraidMove.length_eq {ω ω' : List B} (h : M.BraidMove ω ω') : ω.length = ω'.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, i, j, hij, hm, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  simp [M.symmetric i j]

name: CoxeterMatrix.reflTransGen_braidMove_symm
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_braidMove_symm {ω ω' : List B}
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen M.BraidMove ω ω') : Relation.ReflTransGen M.BraidMove ω' ω
proof:
:=
  by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ hs ih => exact .head hs.symm ih

name: CoxeterSystem.reverse_alternatingWord
statement:
theorem reverse_alternatingWord (i j : B) (k : ℕ) :
    (alternatingWord i j k).reverse =
      if Even k then alternatingWord j i k else alternatingWord i j k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing i j with
  | zero => simp [alternatingWord]
  | succ k ih =>
    have e : (alternatingWord i j (k + 1)).reverse = j :: (alternatingWord j i k).reverse := by
      rw [alternatingWord_succ, concat_eq_append, reverse_append]
      simp
    rw [e, ih]
    by_cases hk : Even k
    · have hk' : ¬Even (k + 1) := by simp [Nat.even_add_one, hk]
      simp only [hk, hk', ↓reduceIte, alternatingWord_succ' i j k]
    · have hk' : Even (k + 1) := by simp [Nat.even_add_one, hk]
      simp only [hk, hk', ↓reduceIte, alternatingWord_succ' j i k]

name: CoxeterSystem.wordProd_eq_of_braidMove
statement: theorem wordProd_eq_of_braidMove {ω ω' : List B} (h : M.BraidMove ω ω') : π ω = π ω'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, i, j, -, -, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  simp only [wordProd_append, wordProd_braidWord_eq]

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.of_braidMove
statement:
theorem IsReduced.of_braidMove {ω ω' : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (h : M.BraidMove ω ω') :
    cs.IsReduced ω'
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsReduced
  rw [← wordProd_eq_of_braidMove h, hω.eq, h.length_eq]

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.eq_reverse_alternatingWord
statement:
theorem IsReduced.eq_reverse_alternatingWord {a b : B} {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (hab : ∀ c ∈ ω, c = a ∨ c = b) (hhead : ω.head? = some a) :
    ω = (alternatingWord b a ω.length).reverse
proof:
:= by
  induction ω generalizing a b with
  | nil => simp at hhead
  | cons x ω ih =>
    simp only [head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hhead
    subst hhead
    rcases ω with _ | ⟨y, ω⟩
    · simp [alternatingWord]
    have hy : y = b := by
      rcases hab y (by simp) with h | h
      · exfalso
        subst h
        have := hω.take 2
        simp [IsReduced, wordProd] at this
      · exact h
    subst hy
    have hω' : cs.IsReduced (y :: ω) := by simpa using hω.drop 1
    have := ih hω' (fun c hc ↦ (hab c (mem_cons_of_mem _ hc)).symm) rfl
    rw [this, length_cons, length_cons, length_reverse, length_alternatingWord,
      alternatingWord_succ y x (ω.length + 1), concat_eq_append, reverse_append]
    simp

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.isLeftDescent_cons
statement:
theorem IsReduced.isLeftDescent_cons {c : B} {η : List B} (h : cs.IsReduced (c :: η)) :
    cs.IsLeftDescent (π (c :: η)) c
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsLeftDescent
  rw [wordProd_cons, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left, ← wordProd_cons, h.eq]
  have := cs.length_wordProd_le η
  simp only [length_cons]
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_braidMove_of_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem exists_braidMove_of_isLeftDescent {w : W} {a b : B} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : cs.IsLeftDescent w a) (hb : cs.IsLeftDescent w b) :
    ∃ P₀ Q₀ γ : List B, M.BraidMove (a :: (P₀ ++ γ)) (b :: (Q₀ ++ γ)) ∧
      cs.IsReduced (a :: (P₀ ++ γ)) ∧ π (a :: (P₀ ++ γ)) = w ∧ π (b :: (Q₀ ++ γ)) = w
proof:
:= by
  set J : Set B := {a, b} with hJ
  obtain ⟨x, hx, u, hu, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_mul_eq_of_forall_not_isLeftDescent J w
  have hlen := length_mul_of_forall_not_isLeftDescent hu hx
  have hdesc : ∀ c ∈ J, cs.IsLeftDescent (x * u) c → cs.IsLeftDescent x c := by
    intro c hc h
    have h' := length_mul_of_forall_not_isLeftDescent hu
      (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup hc) hx)
    unfold IsLeftDescent at h ⊢
    rw [← mul_assoc, h', hlen] at h
    omega
  have hxa := hdesc a (by simp [hJ]) ha
  have hxb := hdesc b (by simp [hJ]) hb
  
  have hword : ∀ c ∈ J, cs.IsLeftDescent x c →
      ∃ η, cs.IsReduced (c :: η) ∧ (∀ d ∈ c :: η, d ∈ J) ∧ π (c :: η) = x := by
    intro c hc hxc
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηJ, hηe⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup
      (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup hc) hx)
    refine ⟨η, ?_, ?_, by rw [wordProd_cons, hηe, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]⟩
    · unfold IsReduced
      rw [wordProd_cons, hηe, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left, length_cons, ← hη.eq, hηe]
      rw [isLeftDescent_iff] at hxc
      omega
    · intro d hd
      rcases mem_cons.mp hd with rfl | hd
      · exact hc
      · exact hηJ d hd
  obtain ⟨ηa, hηa, hηaJ, hηae⟩ := hword a (by simp [hJ]) hxa
  obtain ⟨ηb, hηb, hηbJ, hηbe⟩ := hword b (by simp [hJ]) hxb
  have hka : (a :: ηa).length = ℓ x := by rw [← hηa.eq, hηae]
  have hkb : (b :: ηb).length = ℓ x := by rw [← hηb.eq, hηbe]
  have hPa := hηa.eq_reverse_alternatingWord (a := a) (b := b)
    (fun c hc ↦ by simpa [hJ] using hηaJ c hc) rfl
  have hPb := hηb.eq_reverse_alternatingWord (a := b) (b := a)
    (fun c hc ↦ by simpa [hJ, or_comm] using hηbJ c hc) rfl
  rw [hka] at hPa
  rw [hkb] at hPb
  
  have hm0 : M a b ≠ 0 ∧ M a b ≤ ℓ x := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hred := cs.isReduced_alternatingWord a b (k := ℓ x + 1) (by omega)
    have e : (alternatingWord a b (ℓ x + 1)).reverse = b :: (a :: ηa) := by
      rw [hPa, alternatingWord_succ, concat_eq_append, reverse_append]
      simp
    have h2 := hred.reverse
    rw [e] at h2
    unfold IsReduced at h2
    rw [wordProd_cons, hηae, length_cons, hka] at h2
    rw [isLeftDescent_iff] at hxb
    omega
  have hkm : ℓ x = M a b := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ hm0.2
    by_contra hlt
    apply cs.not_isReduced_alternatingWord b a (m := ℓ x) (by rw [M.symmetric]; exact hm0.1)
      (by rw [M.symmetric]; omega)
    have := hηa.reverse
    rwa [hPa, reverse_reverse] at this
  
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced u
  refine ⟨ηa, ηb, γ, ?_, ?_, by rw [← cons_append, wordProd_append, hηae],
    by rw [← cons_append, wordProd_append, hηbe]⟩
  · rw [← cons_append, ← cons_append, hPa, hPb, hkm, reverse_alternatingWord,
      reverse_alternatingWord]
    have hm : M b a = M a b := M.symmetric b a
    by_cases he : Even (M a b)
    · simp only [he, ↓reduceIte]
      have := CoxeterMatrix.braidMove_braidWord (M := M) hab hm0.1 γ
      rwa [braidWord, braidWord, hm] at this
    · simp only [he, ↓reduceIte]
      have := CoxeterMatrix.braidMove_braidWord (M := M) hab.symm (by rw [hm]; exact hm0.1) γ
      rwa [braidWord, braidWord, hm] at this
  · unfold IsReduced
    rw [← cons_append, wordProd_append, hηae, hlen, hγ.eq, length_append, hka]

name: CoxeterSystem.reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced {ω ω' : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (hω' : cs.IsReduced ω') (h : π ω = π ω') : Relation.ReflTransGen M.BraidMove ω ω'
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : ω.length generalizing ω ω' with
  | zero =>
    have h1 : ω = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hn
    have h2 : ω' = [] := by
      rw [← List.length_eq_zero_iff, ← hω'.eq, ← h, hω.eq, hn]
    rw [h1, h2]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, α, rfl⟩ := exists_cons_of_length_eq_add_one hn
    have hlen' : ω'.length = n + 1 := by rw [← hω'.eq, ← h, hω.eq, hn]
    obtain ⟨b, β, rfl⟩ := exists_cons_of_length_eq_add_one hlen'
    have hα : cs.IsReduced α := by simpa using hω.drop 1
    have hβ : cs.IsReduced β := by simpa using hω'.drop 1
    have hlα : α.length = n := by simpa using hn
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab
      have : π α = π β := by
        rw [wordProd_cons, wordProd_cons] at h
        exact mul_left_cancel h
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (List.cons a) (fun _ _ hm ↦ hm.cons a) _ _
        (ih hα hβ this hlα)
    · obtain ⟨P₀, Q₀, γ, hmove, hPred, hPe, hQe⟩ :=
        exists_braidMove_of_isLeftDescent hab hω.isLeftDescent_cons
          (h ▸ hω'.isLeftDescent_cons)
      have hQred := hPred.of_braidMove hmove
      have h1 : Relation.ReflTransGen M.BraidMove (a :: α) (a :: (P₀ ++ γ)) := by
        have hP : cs.IsReduced (P₀ ++ γ) := by simpa using hPred.drop 1
        have : π α = π (P₀ ++ γ) := by
          rw [wordProd_cons] at hPe
          rw [wordProd_cons] at hPe
          exact (mul_left_cancel hPe).symm
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (List.cons a) (fun _ _ hm ↦ hm.cons a) _ _
          (ih hα hP this hlα)
      have h2 : Relation.ReflTransGen M.BraidMove (b :: β) (b :: (Q₀ ++ γ)) := by
        have hQ : cs.IsReduced (Q₀ ++ γ) := by simpa using hQred.drop 1
        have : π β = π (Q₀ ++ γ) := by
          rw [h, wordProd_cons] at hQe
          rw [wordProd_cons] at hQe
          exact (mul_left_cancel hQe).symm
        have hlβ : β.length = n := by simpa using hlen'
