        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (List.cons b) (fun _ _ hm ↦ hm.cons b) _ _
          (ih hβ hQ this (by rw [hlβ]))
      exact (h1.tail hmove).trans (CoxeterMatrix.reflTransGen_braidMove_symm h2)

name: CoxeterSystem.IsReduced.of_reflTransGen_braidMove
statement:
theorem IsReduced.of_reflTransGen_braidMove {ω ω' : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω)
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen M.BraidMove ω ω') : cs.IsReduced ω'
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hω
  | tail _ hs ih => exact ih.of_braidMove hs

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail hab hs ih => exact ih.trans (hf _ _ (hω.of_reflTransGen_braidMove hab) hs)

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_eq_of_braidMove
statement:
theorem exists_eq_of_braidMove {α : Sort*} (f : List B → α)
    (hf : ∀ ω ω', cs.IsReduced ω → M.BraidMove ω ω' → f ω = f ω') :
    ∃ F : W → α, ∀ ω, cs.IsReduced ω → F (π ω) = f ω
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun w ↦ f (cs.exists_isReduced w).choose, fun ω hω ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hω₀, he⟩ := (cs.exists_isReduced (π ω)).choose_spec
  exact eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove hf hω₀ (reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hω₀ hω he.symm)

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_wordProd
statement:
theorem braidLift_wordProd (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g) {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) :
    cs.braidLift g (π ω) = (ω.map g).prod
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hω₀, he⟩ := (cs.exists_isReduced (π ω)).choose_spec
  refine eq_of_reflTransGen_braidMove (f := fun ω ↦ (ω.map g).prod) ?_ hω₀
    (reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced hω₀ hω he.symm)
  rintro _ _ - ⟨l, r, i, j, hij, hm, rfl, rfl⟩
  simp only [map_append, prod_append, hg i j hij hm]

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_one
statement: theorem braidLift_one : cs.braidLift g 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hω, he⟩ := (cs.exists_isReduced (1 : W)).choose_spec
  have : (cs.exists_isReduced (1 : W)).choose = [] := by
    rw [← List.length_eq_zero_iff, ← hω.eq, ← he, length_one]
  rw [braidLift, this, map_nil, prod_nil]

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_simple
statement: theorem braidLift_simple (i : B) : cs.braidLift g (s i) = g i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hω, he⟩ := (cs.exists_isReduced (s i)).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, (cs.exists_isReduced (s i)).choose = [j] := by
    apply List.length_eq_one_iff.mp
    rw [← hω.eq, ← he, length_simple]
  rw [hj, wordProd_singleton] at he
  rw [braidLift, hj, cs.simple_injective he]
  simp

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_mul
statement:
theorem braidLift_mul (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g) {u v : W} (h : ℓ (u * v) = ℓ u + ℓ v) :
    cs.braidLift g (u * v) = cs.braidLift g u * cs.braidLift g v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ωu, hu, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced u
  obtain ⟨ωv, hv, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced v
  have huv : cs.IsReduced (ωu ++ ωv) := by
    unfold IsReduced
    rw [wordProd_append, h, hu.eq, hv.eq, length_append]
  rw [← wordProd_append, braidLift_wordProd hg huv, braidLift_wordProd hg hu,
    braidLift_wordProd hg hv, map_append, prod_append]

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_mul_simple
statement:
theorem braidLift_mul_simple (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g) {w : W} {i : B}
    (h : ¬cs.IsRightDescent w i) : cs.braidLift g (w * s i) = cs.braidLift g w * g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidLift_mul hg (by rw [(cs.not_isRightDescent_iff).mp h, length_simple]),
    braidLift_simple]

name: CoxeterSystem.braidLift_simple_mul
statement:
theorem braidLift_simple_mul (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g) {w : W} {i : B}
    (h : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent w i) : cs.braidLift g (s i * w) = g i * cs.braidLift g w
proof:
:= by
  rw [braidLift_mul hg (by rw [(cs.not_isLeftDescent_iff).mp h, length_simple, add_comm]),
    braidLift_simple]

name: CoxeterMatrix.prod_map_artinGenerator
statement:
theorem prod_map_artinGenerator (ω : List B) :
    (ω.map M.artinGenerator).prod =
      PresentedGroup.mk M.artinRelationsSet (ω.map FreeGroup.of).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: CoxeterMatrix.prod_braidWord_artinGenerator
statement:
theorem prod_braidWord_artinGenerator (i i' : B) :
    ((braidWord M i i').map M.artinGenerator).prod =
      ((braidWord M i' i).map M.artinGenerator).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_map_artinGenerator, prod_map_artinGenerator]
  exact PresentedGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem ⟨(i, i'), rfl⟩

name: CoxeterMatrix.lift_artinRelation
statement: theorem lift_artinRelation (i i' : B) : FreeGroup.lift g (M.artinRelation i i') = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [artinRelation, map_mul, map_inv, mul_inv_eq_one, map_list_prod, map_list_prod,
    List.map_map, List.map_map]
  have hc : ⇑(FreeGroup.lift g) ∘ FreeGroup.of = g := funext fun _ ↦ FreeGroup.lift_apply_of
  rw [hc]
  by_cases hii : i = i'
  · subst hii
    rfl
  by_cases hm : M i i' = 0
  · simp [braidWord, hm, M.symmetric i' i ▸ hm, alternatingWord]
  exact hg i i' hii hm

name: CoxeterMatrix.artinLift_artinGenerator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem artinLift_artinGenerator (i : B) : artinLift g hg (M.artinGenerator i) = g i
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup.of _

name: CoxeterMatrix.artinGroup_hom_ext
proof:
:=
  PresentedGroup.ext h

name: CoxeterMatrix.artinLift_unique
statement:
theorem artinLift_unique (φ : M.ArtinGroup →* G) (h : ∀ i, φ (M.artinGenerator i) = g i) :
    φ = artinLift g hg
proof:
:=
  artinGroup_hom_ext fun i ↦ (h i).trans (artinLift_artinGenerator g hg i).symm

name: CoxeterSystem.simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup
statement: theorem simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup {i : B} (hi : i ∈ J) : s i ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup
statement:
theorem wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup {ω : List B} (hω : ∀ i ∈ ω, i ∈ J) :
    π ω ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [wordProd_cons]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup (hω i mem_cons_self))
      (ih fun j hj ↦ hω j (mem_cons_of_mem _ hj))

name: CoxeterSystem.mem_parabolicSubgroup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parabolicSubgroup_iff {w : W} :
    w ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J ↔ ∃ ω : List B, (∀ i ∈ ω, i ∈ J) ∧ π ω = w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨ω, hω, he⟩ ↦ he ▸ wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup hω⟩
  induction h using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨[i], by simpa using hi, wordProd_singleton _ _⟩
  | one => exact ⟨[], by simp, wordProd_nil _⟩
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨ω ++ ω', by simpa using fun i hi ↦ (mem_append.mp hi).elim (hω i) (hω' i),
      wordProd_append _ _ _⟩
  | inv x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨ω.reverse, by simpa using hω, wordProd_reverse _ _⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup
statement:
theorem exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup {w : W} (hw : w ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) :
    ∃ ω : List B, cs.IsReduced ω ∧ (∀ i ∈ ω, i ∈ J) ∧ π ω = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := mem_parabolicSubgroup_iff.mp hw
  obtain ⟨ω', hsub, hred, he⟩ := cs.exists_sublist_isReduced ω
  exact ⟨ω', hred, fun i hi ↦ hω i (hsub.subset hi), he⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_isRightDescent_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup
statement:
theorem exists_isRightDescent_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup {w : W}
    (hw : w ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) (hw1 : w ≠ 1) : ∃ i ∈ J, cs.IsRightDescent w i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hred, hJ, rfl⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup hw
  obtain ⟨ω', i, rfl⟩ : ∃ ω' i, ω = ω' ++ [i] := by
    rcases ω.eq_nil_or_concat with rfl | ⟨ω', i, rfl⟩
    · simp at hw1
    · exact ⟨ω', i, by simp⟩
  refine ⟨i, hJ i (by simp), ?_⟩
  have h := hred.eq
  rw [wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton] at h
  rw [IsRightDescent, wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right, h]
  have := cs.length_wordProd_le ω'
  simp only [length_append, length_singleton]
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_min_length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n, ∃ u, w⁻¹ * u ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J ∧ ℓ u = n :=
    ⟨_, w, by simp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hl⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  exact ⟨u, hu, fun u' hu' ↦ hl ▸ Nat.find_min' hex ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.length_mul_of_min
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hJ, rfl⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup hv
  induction η using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp
  | append_singleton η j ih =>
    have hη' : cs.IsReduced η := by simpa using hη.take η.length
    have hJ' : ∀ i ∈ η, i ∈ J := fun i hi ↦ hJ i (by simp [hi])
    have ih := ih hη' hJ' (wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup hJ')
    rw [hη.eq, wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton, ← mul_assoc]
    rcases cs.length_mul_simple (u * π η) j with h | h
    · rw [h, ih, hη'.eq]; simp; omega
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨ν, hν, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced u
    have hred : cs.IsReduced (ν ++ η) := by
      unfold IsReduced; rw [wordProd_append, ih, hν.eq, hη'.eq, length_append]
    have hdesc : cs.IsRightDescent (π (ν ++ η)) j := by
      rw [IsRightDescent, wordProd_append]; omega
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := hdesc.exists_wordProd_mul_eq
    rw [length_append] at hp
    by_cases hpν : p < ν.length
    · 
      rw [eraseIdx_append_of_lt_length hpν, wordProd_append, wordProd_append] at hpe
      have hmem : π η * s j * (π η)⁻¹ ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J :=
        Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup hJ')
          (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup (hJ j (by simp)))) (Subgroup.inv_mem _
          (wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup hJ'))
      have h1 := hu _ hmem
      have h2 : π ν * (π η * s j * (π η)⁻¹) = π (ν.eraseIdx p) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hpe]; group
      rw [h2, hν.eq] at h1
      have := cs.length_wordProd_le (ν.eraseIdx p)
      have := List.length_eraseIdx_add_one hpν
      omega
    · 
      push Not at hpν
      rw [eraseIdx_append_of_length_le hpν, wordProd_append, wordProd_append, mul_assoc] at hpe
      have h1 := mul_left_cancel hpe
      have := cs.length_wordProd_le (η.eraseIdx (p - ν.length))
      have := List.length_eraseIdx_add_one (show p - ν.length < η.length by omega)
      have h3 : ℓ (π η * s j) = η.length + 1 := by
        rw [← wordProd_singleton, ← wordProd_append, hη.eq, length_append, length_singleton]
      rw [h1] at h3
      omega

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_of_min
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hy1 : u₀⁻¹ * u ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ hne (inv_mul_eq_one.mp h).symm
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hdesc⟩ := exists_isRightDescent_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup hy hy1
  have h1 := length_mul_of_min hu₀ hy
  have h2 := length_mul_of_min hu₀
    (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hy (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup hj))
  rw [mul_inv_cancel_left] at h1
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left] at h2
  apply hu j hj
  rw [IsRightDescent, h2, h1]
  exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hdesc _

name: CoxeterSystem.length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps
statement:
theorem length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps {u v : W} (hu : u ∈ cs.minCosetReps J)
    (hv : v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) : ℓ (u * v) = ℓ u + ℓ v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hmin⟩ := exists_min_length cs J u
  have hu₀' : ∀ x ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J, ℓ u₀ ≤ ℓ (u₀ * x) := fun x hx ↦
    hmin _ (by rw [← mul_assoc]; exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hu₀ hx)
  have := eq_of_min hu₀' hu (by simpa using Subgroup.inv_mem _ hu₀)
  subst this
  exact length_mul_of_min hu₀' hv

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_of_mem_minCosetReps
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_minCosetReps {u u' : W} (hu : u ∈ cs.minCosetReps J)
    (hu' : u' ∈ cs.minCosetReps J) (h : u⁻¹ * u' ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) : u = u'
proof:
:= by
  have hu₀ : ∀ x ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J, ℓ u ≤ ℓ (u * x) := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hu hx]; omega
  exact (eq_of_min hu₀ hu' h).symm

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_mem_minCosetReps_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mem_minCosetReps_mul_eq (J : Set B) (w : W) :
    ∃ u ∈ cs.minCosetReps J, ∃ v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J, u * v = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hmin⟩ := exists_min_length cs J w
  have hu' : ∀ x ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J, ℓ u ≤ ℓ (u * x) := fun x hx ↦
    hmin _ (by rw [← mul_assoc]; exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hu hx)
  refine ⟨u, fun j hj hdesc ↦ ?_, u⁻¹ * w, by simpa using Subgroup.inv_mem _ hu, by group⟩
  have := length_mul_of_min hu' (simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup hj)
  rw [IsRightDescent, this, length_simple] at hdesc
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_and_eq_of_mul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem eq_and_eq_of_mul_eq_mul {u u' v v' : W} (hu : u ∈ cs.minCosetReps J)
    (hu' : u' ∈ cs.minCosetReps J) (hv : v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J)
    (hv' : v' ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) (h : u * v = u' * v') : u = u' ∧ v = v'
proof:
:= by
  have huu : u = u' := by
    refine eq_of_mem_minCosetReps hu hu' ?_
    have : u⁻¹ * u' = v * v'⁻¹ := by
      rw [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, h, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    rw [this]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hv (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hv')
  subst huu
  exact ⟨rfl, mul_left_cancel h⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetRep_mem
statement: theorem minCosetRep_mem (w : W) : cs.minCosetRep J w ∈ cs.minCosetReps J
proof:
:=
  (cs.exists_mem_minCosetReps_mul_eq J w).choose_spec.1

name: CoxeterSystem.parabolicComponent_mem
statement:
theorem parabolicComponent_mem (w : W) :
    cs.parabolicComponent J w ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := (cs.exists_mem_minCosetReps_mul_eq J w).choose_spec.2
  have : cs.parabolicComponent J w = v := by
    rw [parabolicComponent, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul]
    exact he.symm
  rw [this]
  exact hv

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetRep_mul_parabolicComponent
statement:
theorem minCosetRep_mul_parabolicComponent (w : W) :
    cs.minCosetRep J w * cs.parabolicComponent J w = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [parabolicComponent, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: CoxeterSystem.length_eq_length_minCosetRep_add
statement:
theorem length_eq_length_minCosetRep_add (w : W) :
    ℓ w = ℓ (cs.minCosetRep J w) + ℓ (cs.parabolicComponent J w)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← minCosetRep_mul_parabolicComponent (cs := cs) (J := J) w]
  exact length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps (minCosetRep_mem w) (parabolicComponent_mem w)

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetRep_eq_iff
statement:
theorem minCosetRep_eq_iff {w u : W} :
    cs.minCosetRep J w = u ↔ u ∈ cs.minCosetReps J ∧ u⁻¹ * w ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨minCosetRep_mem w, parabolicComponent_mem w⟩
  · rintro ⟨hu, hw⟩
    refine (eq_and_eq_of_mul_eq_mul (minCosetRep_mem w) hu (parabolicComponent_mem w) hw ?_).1
    rw [minCosetRep_mul_parabolicComponent, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: CoxeterSystem.length_mul_of_forall_not_isLeftDescent
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : u⁻¹ ∈ cs.minCosetReps J := fun i hi h ↦ hu i hi (cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff.mp h)
  have := length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hu' (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hv)
  rwa [← mul_inv_rev, length_inv, length_inv, length_inv, add_comm] at this

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_mul_eq_of_forall_not_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_of_forall_not_isLeftDescent (J : Set B) (w : W) :
    ∃ v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J, ∃ u, (∀ i ∈ J, ¬cs.IsLeftDescent u i) ∧ v * u = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, he⟩ := cs.exists_mem_minCosetReps_mul_eq J w⁻¹
  refine ⟨v⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hv, u⁻¹, fun i hi h ↦ hu i hi ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [← isRightDescent_inv_iff, inv_inv] at h
  · rw [← mul_inv_rev, he, inv_inv]

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetRepsProdEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minCosetRepsProdEquiv_apply (p : cs.minCosetReps J × cs.parabolicSubgroup J) :
    cs.minCosetRepsProdEquiv J p = (p.1 : W) * p.2
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatCovBy_iff
statement:
theorem bruhatCovBy_iff {u w : W} :
    cs.BruhatCovBy u w ↔ cs.BruhatStep u w ∧ ℓ w = ℓ u + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h, hl⟩ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨h, hl⟩ ↦ ⟨h.bruhatLE, hl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨v, huv, hvw, hl'⟩ := h.exists_bruhatStep_length_eq (by rintro rfl; omega)
  obtain rfl := huv.eq_of_length_le (by omega)
  exact ⟨hvw, hl⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatOrder.covBy_iff_bruhatCovBy
statement:
theorem BruhatOrder.covBy_iff_bruhatCovBy {u w : cs.BruhatOrder} :
    u ⋖ w ↔ cs.BruhatCovBy (BruhatOrder.ofBruhatOrder cs u) (BruhatOrder.ofBruhatOrder cs w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [BruhatOrder.covBy_iff, bruhatCovBy_iff]

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatCovBy.bruhatLE
statement: theorem BruhatCovBy.bruhatLE {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatCovBy u w) : cs.BruhatLE u w

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatCovBy.length_eq
statement: theorem BruhatCovBy.length_eq {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatCovBy u w) : ℓ w = ℓ u + 1

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatCovBy.ne
statement: theorem BruhatCovBy.ne {u w : W} (h : cs.BruhatCovBy u w) : u ≠ w
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl; have := h.2; omega

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent {w : W} {i : B} (h : cs.IsLeftDescent w i) :
    cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * w) w
proof:
:=
  ⟨simple_mul_bruhatLE h, ((cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp h).symm⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_not_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_not_isLeftDescent {w : W} {i : B}
    (h : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent w i) : cs.BruhatCovBy w (s i * w)
proof:
:=
  ⟨bruhatLE_simple_mul h, (cs.not_isLeftDescent_iff).mp h⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatCovBy.eq_simple_mul
statement:
theorem BruhatCovBy.eq_simple_mul {x y : W} {i : B} (h : cs.BruhatCovBy x y)
    (hy : cs.IsLeftDescent y i) (hx : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent x i) : x = s i * y
proof:
:= by
  refine (h.1.lifting_left hy hx).1.eq_of_length_le ?_
  have := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hy
  have := h.2
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatCovBy.simple_mul
statement:
theorem BruhatCovBy.simple_mul {x y : W} {i : B} (h : cs.BruhatCovBy x y)
    (hx : cs.IsLeftDescent x i) (hy : cs.IsLeftDescent y i) :
    cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * x) (s i * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(simple_mul_bruhatLE_simple_mul_iff hx hy).mpr h.1, ?_⟩
  have := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hx
  have := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hy
  have := h.2
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.BruhatCovBy.isLeftDescent_of_ne
statement:
theorem BruhatCovBy.isLeftDescent_of_ne {b d : W} {i : B} (h : cs.BruhatCovBy b d)
    (hd : cs.IsLeftDescent d i) (hb : b ≠ s i * d) : cs.IsLeftDescent b i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hb'
  exact hb (h.eq_simple_mul hd hb')

name: CoxeterSystem.exists_middle_pair
statement:
theorem exists_middle_pair {a d : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE a d) (hl : ℓ d = ℓ a + 2) :
    ∃ b c, b ≠ c ∧ ∀ x, (cs.BruhatCovBy a x ∧ cs.BruhatCovBy x d) ↔ x = b ∨ x = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hn : ℓ d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing a d with
  | _ n ih =>
  subst hn
  have hd1 : d ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; simp at hl
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hd1
  have hdi := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hi
  have hsd : cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * d) d := bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent hi
  by_cases ha : cs.IsLeftDescent a i
  · have hai := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp ha
    have h' : cs.BruhatLE (s i * a) (s i * d) := (simple_mul_bruhatLE_simple_mul_iff ha hi).mpr h
    obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm, hmid⟩ := ih _ (by omega) h' (by omega) rfl
    have hsa : cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * a) a := bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent ha
    
    have hF1 : ∀ m, cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * a) m → m ≠ a → ¬cs.IsLeftDescent m i := by
      intro m hm hma hmi
      refine hma ?_
      have := hm.eq_simple_mul hmi (by
        rw [cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
        exact not_not.mpr ha)
      rw [← simple_mul_simple_cancel_left (cs := cs) (w := m) i, ← this,
        simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
    let φ : W → W := fun m ↦ if m = a then s i * d else s i * m
    have hφa : φ a = s i * d := ite_eq_left rfl
    have hφ : ∀ m, m ≠ a → φ m = s i * m := fun m hm ↦ ite_eq_right hm
    have hF2 : ∀ m, cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * a) m ∧ cs.BruhatCovBy m (s i * d) →
        cs.BruhatCovBy a (φ m) ∧ cs.BruhatCovBy (φ m) d := by
      rintro m ⟨hm₁, hm₂⟩
      by_cases hma : m = a
      · subst hma
        rw [hφa]
        exact ⟨hm₂, hsd⟩
      · rw [hφ m hma]
        have hmi := hF1 m hm₁ hma
        have hmi' := (cs.not_isLeftDescent_iff).mp hmi
        have hm₁l := hm₁.2
        have hsm : cs.IsLeftDescent (s i * m) i := by
          rw [cs.isLeftDescent_iff_not_isLeftDescent_mul, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
          exact hmi
        refine ⟨⟨(simple_mul_bruhatLE_simple_mul_iff ha hsm).mp ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
        · rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; exact hm₁.1
        · omega
        · exact (simple_mul_bruhatLE_iff_of_isLeftDescent hi).mpr (hm₂.1.trans hsd.1)
        · omega
    have hlen : ∀ m, (m = m₁ ∨ m = m₂) → ℓ m = ℓ a := fun m hm ↦ by
      have := ((hmid m).mpr hm).1.2
      omega
    refine ⟨φ m₁, φ m₂, ?_, fun x ↦ ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have hl₁ := hlen m₁ (.inl rfl)
      have hl₂ := hlen m₂ (.inr rfl)
      by_cases h₁ : m₁ = a
      · have h₂ : m₂ ≠ a := fun h₂ ↦ hm (h₁.trans h₂.symm)
        rw [h₁, hφa, hφ _ h₂]
        intro e
        have := congrArg (s i * ·) e
        simp only [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at this
        subst this; omega
      · rw [hφ _ h₁]
        by_cases h₂ : m₂ = a
        · rw [h₂, hφa]
          intro e
          have := congrArg (s i * ·) e
          simp only [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at this
          subst this; omega
        · rw [hφ _ h₂]
          intro e
          exact hm (by simpa using congrArg (s i * ·) e)
    · obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := hx
      by_cases hxd : x = s i * d
      · subst hxd
        rcases (hmid a).mp ⟨hsa, hx₁⟩ with e | e
        · left; rw [← e, hφa]
        · right; rw [← e, hφa]
      · have hxi := hx₂.isLeftDescent_of_ne hi hxd
        have hsx : cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * a) (s i * x) ∧ cs.BruhatCovBy (s i * x) (s i * d) :=
          ⟨hx₁.simple_mul ha hxi, hx₂.simple_mul hxi hi⟩
        have hsxa : s i * x ≠ a := by
          intro e
          have hx : x = s i * a := by rw [← e, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
          have := hx₁.2
          rw [hx] at this
          omega
        rcases (hmid _).mp hsx with e | e
        · left; rw [← e, hφ _ hsxa, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
        · right; rw [← e, hφ _ hsxa, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact hF2 _ ((hmid m₁).mpr (.inl rfl))
      · exact hF2 _ ((hmid m₂).mpr (.inr rfl))
  · have hl' := (cs.not_isLeftDescent_iff).mp ha
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h.lifting_left hi ha
    refine ⟨s i * a, s i * d, fun e ↦ ?_, fun x ↦ ⟨fun ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have := congrArg (s i * ·) e
      simp only [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at this
      subst this; omega
    · by_cases hxi : cs.IsLeftDescent x i
      · left
        rw [hx₁.eq_simple_mul hxi ha, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
      · right
        exact hx₂.eq_simple_mul hi hxi
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_not_isLeftDescent ha, h₂, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨h₁, by omega⟩, hsd⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.ncard_middle_eq_two
statement:
theorem ncard_middle_eq_two {a d : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE a d) (hl : ℓ d = ℓ a + 2) :
    {x | cs.BruhatCovBy a x ∧ cs.BruhatCovBy x d}.ncard = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hbc, hmid⟩ := exists_middle_pair h hl
  have : {x | cs.BruhatCovBy a x ∧ cs.BruhatCovBy x d} = {b, c} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact hmid x
  rw [this, Set.ncard_pair hbc]

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatSign_spec
statement:
private lemma bruhatSign_spec {d : W} (hd : d ≠ 1) :
    ∃ i, cs.IsLeftDescent d i ∧ cs.bruhatSign (s i * d) d = 0 ∧
      ∀ b, b ≠ s i * d → ℓ b < ℓ d →
        cs.bruhatSign b d = cs.bruhatSign (s i * b) b + cs.bruhatSign (s i * b) (s i * d) + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ∃ i, cs.IsLeftDescent d i := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hd
  refine ⟨h.choose, h.choose_spec, ?_, fun b hb hl ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [bruhatSign.eq_1, dite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · rw [bruhatSign.eq_1, dite_eq_left h, ite_eq_right hb, dite_eq_left hl]

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatSign_square
statement:
theorem bruhatSign_square {a b c d : W} (hab : cs.BruhatCovBy a b) (hbd : cs.BruhatCovBy b d)
    (hac : cs.BruhatCovBy a c) (hcd : cs.BruhatCovBy c d) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    cs.bruhatSign a b + cs.bruhatSign b d + cs.bruhatSign a c + cs.bruhatSign c d = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : ℓ d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing a b c d with
  | _ n ih =>
  subst hn
  have hd1 : d ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    have := hbd.2
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hsd, hrec⟩ := bruhatSign_spec (cs := cs) hd1
  have hdi := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hi
  
  have key : ∀ b c, cs.BruhatCovBy a b → cs.BruhatCovBy b d → cs.BruhatCovBy a c →
      cs.BruhatCovBy c d → b ≠ c → b = s i * d →
      cs.bruhatSign a b + cs.bruhatSign b d + cs.bruhatSign a c + cs.bruhatSign c d = 1 := by
    intro b c hab hbd hac hcd hbc hb
    subst hb
    have hcs : c ≠ s i * d := hbc.symm
    have hci := hcd.isLeftDescent_of_ne hi hcs
    have hcl := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hci
    rw [hsd, hrec c hcs (by have := hcd.2; omega)]
    by_cases has : a = s i * c
    · subst has
      reduce_mod_char
      ring_nf
      reduce_mod_char
    · have hai : cs.IsLeftDescent a i := by
        by_contra hai
        exact has (hac.eq_simple_mul hci hai)
      have hsa := bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent hai
      have hsasc := hac.simple_mul hai hci
      have hscsd := hcd.simple_mul hci hi
      have hne : a ≠ s i * c := has
      have h₁ := ih _ (by omega) hsa hab hsasc hscsd hne rfl
      have h₂ := ih _ (by have := hcd.2; omega) hsa hac hsasc
        (bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent hci) hne rfl
      linear_combination (norm := skip) h₁ + h₂
      ring_nf
      reduce_mod_char
  by_cases hb : b = s i * d
  · exact key b c hab hbd hac hcd hbc hb
  by_cases hc : c = s i * d
  · have := key c b hac hcd hab hbd hbc.symm hc
    linear_combination this
  
  have hbi := hbd.isLeftDescent_of_ne hi hb
  have hci := hcd.isLeftDescent_of_ne hi hc
  have hbl := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hbi
  have hcl := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hci
  have hai : cs.IsLeftDescent a i := by
    by_contra hai
    apply hbc
    rw [← simple_mul_simple_cancel_left (cs := cs) (w := b) i,
      ← simple_mul_simple_cancel_left (cs := cs) (w := c) i,
      ← hab.eq_simple_mul hbi hai, ← hac.eq_simple_mul hci hai]
  have hal := (cs.isLeftDescent_iff).mp hai
  have hasb : a ≠ s i * b := by
    intro e; have := hab.2; rw [e, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at hal; rw [e] at this; omega
  have hasc : a ≠ s i * c := by
    intro e; have := hac.2; rw [e, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at hal; rw [e] at this; omega
  have hsbsc : s i * b ≠ s i * c := fun e ↦ hbc (by simpa using congrArg (s i * ·) e)
  rw [hrec b hb (by have := hbd.2; omega), hrec c hc (by have := hcd.2; omega)]
  have hsa := bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent hai
  have h₁ := ih _ (by omega) (hab.simple_mul hai hbi) (hbd.simple_mul hbi hi)
    (hac.simple_mul hai hci) (hcd.simple_mul hci hi) hsbsc rfl
  have h₂ := ih _ (by have := hbd.2; omega) hsa hab (hab.simple_mul hai hbi)
    (bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent hbi) hasb rfl
  have h₃ := ih _ (by have := hcd.2; omega) hsa hac (hac.simple_mul hai hci)
    (bruhatCovBy_simple_mul_of_isLeftDescent hci) hasc rfl
  linear_combination (norm := skip) h₁ + h₂ + h₃
  ring_nf
  reduce_mod_char

name: CoxeterSystem.neg_one_pow_bruhatSign_square
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_bruhatSign_square {R : Type*} [Ring R] {a b c d : W}
    (hab : cs.BruhatCovBy a b) (hbd : cs.BruhatCovBy b d) (hac : cs.BruhatCovBy a c)
    (hcd : cs.BruhatCovBy c d) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    (-1 : R) ^ (cs.bruhatSign a b).val * (-1) ^ (cs.bruhatSign b d).val +
      (-1) ^ (cs.bruhatSign a c).val * (-1) ^ (cs.bruhatSign c d).val = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := bruhatSign_square hab hbd hac hcd hbc
  have hmul : ∀ x y : ZMod 2, (-1 : R) ^ x.val * (-1) ^ y.val = (-1) ^ (x + y).val := by
    intro x y
    rw [← pow_add, ZMod.val_add, neg_one_pow_eq_pow_mod_two (R := R) (n := x.val + y.val)]
  rw [hmul, hmul]
  have e : cs.bruhatSign a b + cs.bruhatSign b d =
      (cs.bruhatSign a c + cs.bruhatSign c d) + 1 := by
    linear_combination (norm := skip) h
    ring_nf
    reduce_mod_char
  rw [e]
  rw [← hmul, ZMod.val_one, pow_one, mul_neg_one, neg_add_cancel]

name: CoxeterMatrix.restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_apply (J : Set B) (i j : J) : M.restrict J i j = M i j
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.map_alternatingWord
statement:
theorem map_alternatingWord (f : B → B') (i j : B) (m : ℕ) :
    (alternatingWord i j m).map f = alternatingWord (f i) (f j) m
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing i j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => rw [alternatingWord_succ, alternatingWord_succ, map_concat, ih]

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_or_eq_of_mem_alternatingWord
statement:
theorem eq_or_eq_of_mem_alternatingWord {i j c : B} {m : ℕ} (h : c ∈ alternatingWord i j m) :
    c = i ∨ c = j
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing i j with
  | zero => simp [alternatingWord] at h
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [alternatingWord_succ, concat_eq_append, mem_append, mem_singleton] at h
    rcases h with h | rfl
    · exact (ih h).symm
    · exact .inr rfl

name: CoxeterSystem.mem_alternatingWord_of_two_le
statement:
theorem mem_alternatingWord_of_two_le {i j : B} {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    i ∈ alternatingWord i j m ∧ j ∈ alternatingWord i j m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 2 := ⟨m - 2, by omega⟩
  have : alternatingWord i j (m + 2) = alternatingWord i j m ++ [i, j] := by
    simp [alternatingWord_succ]
  simp [this]

name: CoxeterSystem.toRestrict_append
statement:
private theorem toRestrict_append (ω ω' : List B) :
    toRestrict M J (ω ++ ω') = toRestrict M J ω * toRestrict M J ω'
proof:
:= by
  simp [toRestrict]

name: CoxeterSystem.toRestrict_map_val
statement:
private theorem toRestrict_map_val (η : List J) :
    toRestrict M J (η.map Subtype.val) = (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.wordProd η
proof:
:= by
  unfold toRestrict wordProd
  rw [List.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left fun j _ ↦ ?_
  simp [j.2]

name: CoxeterSystem.length_toRestrict_le
statement:
private theorem length_toRestrict_le (ω : List B) :
    (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.length (toRestrict M J ω) ≤ ω.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp [toRestrict]
  | cons i ω ih =>
    have h1 := (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.length_mul_le
      (if h : i ∈ J then (M.restrict J).simple ⟨i, h⟩ else 1) (toRestrict M J ω)
    have h2 : (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.length
        (if h : i ∈ J then (M.restrict J).simple ⟨i, h⟩ else 1) ≤ 1 := by
      split_ifs
      · rw [← CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple, length_simple]
      · simp
    have : toRestrict M J (i :: ω) =
        (if h : i ∈ J then (M.restrict J).simple ⟨i, h⟩ else 1) * toRestrict M J ω := by
      simp [toRestrict]
    rw [this, length_cons]
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.toRestrict_braidMove
statement:
private theorem toRestrict_braidMove {ω ω' : List B} (h : M.BraidMove ω ω')
    (hω : ∀ i ∈ ω, i ∈ J) : toRestrict M J ω = toRestrict M J ω' ∧ ∀ i ∈ ω', i ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, i, j, hij, hm, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  have hm2 : 2 ≤ M i j := by have := M.off_diagonal i j hij; omega
  have hiJ : i ∈ J := hω i (by simp [(mem_alternatingWord_of_two_le hm2).1])
  have hjJ : j ∈ J := hω j (by simp [(mem_alternatingWord_of_two_le hm2).2])
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [toRestrict_append]
    congr 2
    have e1 : braidWord M i j = (alternatingWord (⟨i, hiJ⟩ : J) ⟨j, hjJ⟩
        (M.restrict J ⟨i, hiJ⟩ ⟨j, hjJ⟩)).map Subtype.val := by
      rw [map_alternatingWord]; rfl
    have e2 : braidWord M j i = (alternatingWord (⟨j, hjJ⟩ : J) ⟨i, hiJ⟩
        (M.restrict J ⟨j, hjJ⟩ ⟨i, hiJ⟩)).map Subtype.val := by
      rw [map_alternatingWord]; rfl
    rw [e1, e2, toRestrict_map_val, toRestrict_map_val]
    exact (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.wordProd_braidWord_eq _ _
  · intro c hc
    simp only [mem_append] at hc
    rcases hc with (hc | hc) | hc
    · exact hω c (by simp [hc])
    · rcases eq_or_eq_of_mem_alternatingWord hc with rfl | rfl
      · exact hjJ
      · exact hiJ
    · exact hω c (by simp [hc])

name: CoxeterSystem.toRestrict_reflTransGen
proof:
:= by
  suffices toRestrict M J ω = toRestrict M J ω' ∧ ∀ i ∈ ω', i ∈ J from this.1
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨rfl, hω⟩
  | tail _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := toRestrict_braidMove hs ih.2
    exact ⟨ih.1.trans h1, h2⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.isReduced_map_val
statement:
theorem isReduced_map_val {η : List J} (hη : (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.IsReduced η) :
    cs.IsReduced (η.map Subtype.val)
proof:
:= by
  induction η using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp [IsReduced]
  | append_singleton η j ih =>
    have hη' : (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.IsReduced η := by simpa using hη.take η.length
    have ih := ih hη'
    by_contra hcon
    set ν := η.map Subtype.val
    have hdesc : cs.IsRightDescent (π ν) j := by
      rw [map_append, map_singleton] at hcon
      unfold IsReduced at hcon
      rw [wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton] at hcon
      rcases cs.length_mul_simple (π ν) j with h | h
      · exact absurd (by rw [h, ih.eq, length_append, length_singleton]) hcon
      · rw [isRightDescent_iff]; exact h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := hdesc.exists_wordProd_mul_eq
    have hν'red : cs.IsReduced (ν.eraseIdx p ++ [(j : B)]) := by
      unfold IsReduced
      rw [wordProd_append, ← hpe, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right, ih.eq,
        length_append, length_eraseIdx_of_lt hp, length_singleton]
      have : 0 < ν.length := by omega
      omega
    have hchain := reflTransGen_braidMove_of_isReduced ih hν'red (by
      rw [wordProd_append, ← hpe, wordProd_singleton, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right])
    have hνJ : ∀ i ∈ ν, i ∈ J := by
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.mp hi
      exact k.2
    have heq := toRestrict_reflTransGen hchain hνJ
    rw [toRestrict_map_val, toRestrict_append] at heq
    have hj : toRestrict M J [(j : B)] = (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.simple j := by
      simp [toRestrict]
    rw [hj] at heq
    have h1 : (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.wordProd (η ++ [j]) =
        toRestrict M J (ν.eraseIdx p) := by
      rw [wordProd_append, wordProd_singleton, heq, simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
    have h2 := length_toRestrict_le (M := M) J (ν.eraseIdx p)
    rw [← h1, hη.eq, length_eraseIdx_of_lt hp] at h2
    simp [ν] at h2
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.isLiftable_restrict
statement: theorem isLiftable_restrict : (M.restrict J).IsLiftable (fun j : J ↦ s (j : B))
proof:
:=
  fun i j ↦ cs.simple_mul_simple_pow i j

name: CoxeterSystem.restrictHom_simple
statement: theorem restrictHom_simple (j : J) : cs.restrictHom J ((M.restrict J).simple j) = s j
proof:
:=
  (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.lift_apply_simple (cs.isLiftable_restrict J) j

name: CoxeterSystem.restrictHom_wordProd
statement:
theorem restrictHom_wordProd (η : List J) :
    cs.restrictHom J ((M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.wordProd η) = π (η.map Subtype.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordProd, map_list_prod, wordProd, map_map, map_map]
  congr 1
  refine map_congr_left fun j _ ↦ ?_
  simp [restrictHom_simple]

name: CoxeterSystem.restrictHom_injective
statement: theorem restrictHom_injective : Function.Injective (cs.restrictHom J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨η, hη, rfl⟩ := (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.exists_isReduced g
  rw [restrictHom_wordProd] at hg
  have := (cs.isReduced_map_val J hη).eq
  rw [hg, length_one, length_map] at this
  rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero this.symm, wordProd_nil]

name: CoxeterSystem.range_restrictHom
statement: theorem range_restrictHom : (cs.restrictHom J).range = cs.parabolicSubgroup J
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.subgroup_closure_range_simple,
    MonoidHom.map_closure, parabolicSubgroup]
  congr 1
  ext w
  simp [restrictHom_simple]

name: CoxeterSystem.isReduced_map_val_iff
statement:
theorem isReduced_map_val_iff {η : List J} :
    (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.IsReduced η ↔ cs.IsReduced (η.map Subtype.val)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨cs.isReduced_map_val J, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  unfold IsReduced
  apply le_antisymm ((M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.length_wordProd_le η)
  obtain ⟨η', hη', he⟩ := (M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.exists_isReduced
    ((M.restrict J).toCoxeterSystem.wordProd η)
  have := congrArg (cs.restrictHom J) he
  rw [restrictHom_wordProd, restrictHom_wordProd] at this
  have h1 := cs.length_wordProd_le (η'.map Subtype.val)
  rw [← this, h.eq, length_map] at h1
  rw [he, hη'.eq]
  simpa using h1

name: CoxeterSystem.coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_simple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_simple (j : J) :
    ((cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).simple j : W) = s j
proof:
:=
  cs.restrictHom_simple J j

name: CoxeterSystem.coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_wordProd
statement:
theorem coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_wordProd (η : List J) :
    ((cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).wordProd η : W) = π (η.map Subtype.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordProd, ← (cs.parabolicSubgroup J).subtype_apply, map_list_prod, wordProd, map_map,
    map_map]
  congr 1
  refine map_congr_left fun j _ ↦ ?_
  simp

name: CoxeterSystem.length_parabolicCoxeterSystem
statement:
theorem length_parabolicCoxeterSystem (w : cs.parabolicSubgroup J) :
    (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).length w = ℓ (w : W)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨ω, hω, hωJ, he⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup w.2
    lift ω to List J using hωJ
    have : (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).wordProd ω = w :=
      Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_wordProd, he])
    rw [← this, coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_wordProd, hω.eq, length_map]
    exact (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).length_wordProd_le ω
  · obtain ⟨η, hη, rfl⟩ := (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).exists_isReduced w
    rw [coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_wordProd, hη.eq]
    simpa using cs.length_wordProd_le (η.map Subtype.val)

name: CanonicalGeometric.rootChoice_root
statement:
theorem rootChoice_root (m : ℕ) :
    rootChoice.root m = Complex.exp ((Real.pi / m : ℝ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  change Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / (2 * m)) = _
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: CanonicalGeometric.coeff_complex
statement:
theorem coeff_complex (m : ℕ) :
    GeometricParametric.coeff rootChoice m = (coeff m : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    simp [GeometricParametric.coeff, coeff]
  · rw [GeometricParametric.coeff, ite_eq_right (by exact hm), rootChoice_root,
      ← Complex.exp_neg]
    rw [show -((Real.pi / m : ℝ) * Complex.I) =
      ((-(Real.pi / m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by push_cast; ring]
    rw [Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    simp only [Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg, Complex.ofReal_neg, coeff]
    ring

name: CanonicalGeometric.coeff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_zero : coeff 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [coeff]

name: CanonicalGeometric.coeff_one
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_one : coeff 1 = -1
proof: := by simp [coeff]

name: CanonicalGeometric.form_single
statement:
theorem form_single (i j : B) (a : ℝ) :
    form M i (Finsupp.single j a) = a * -coeff (M i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [form, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: CanonicalGeometric.form_single_self
statement: theorem form_single_self (i : B) (a : ℝ) : form M i (Finsupp.single i a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_single, M.diagonal, coeff_one]
  ring

name: CanonicalGeometric.reflection_apply
statement:
theorem reflection_apply (i : B) (v : B →₀ ℝ) :
    reflection M i v = v - form M i v • Finsupp.single i 2
proof: := rfl

name: CanonicalGeometric.reflection_single
statement:
theorem reflection_single (i j : B) :
    reflection M i (Finsupp.single j 1) =
      Finsupp.single j 1 + (2 * coeff (M i j)) • Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply, form_single, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one i (2 : ℝ)]
  module

name: CanonicalGeometric.reflection_single_self
statement:
theorem reflection_single_self (i : B) :
    reflection M i (Finsupp.single i 1) = -Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_single, M.diagonal, coeff_one]
  module

name: CanonicalGeometric.reflection_mul_self
statement: theorem reflection_mul_self (i : B) : reflection M i * reflection M i = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  have h : form M i (reflection M i v) = -form M i v := by
    rw [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, form_single_self, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, reflection_apply M i (reflection M i v),
    h, reflection_apply]
  module

name: CanonicalGeometric.embed_injective
statement: theorem embed_injective : Function.Injective (embed (B := B))
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.mapRange_injective _ (map_zero _) Complex.ofReal_injective

name: CanonicalGeometric.embed_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem embed_single (i : B) (a : ℝ) :
    embed (Finsupp.single i a) = Finsupp.single i (a : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [embed]

name: CanonicalGeometric.embed_reflection
statement:
theorem embed_reflection (i : B) (v : B →₀ ℝ) :
    embed (reflection M i v) = GeometricParametric.reflection rootChoice M i (embed v)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (embed (B := B)).comp (reflection M i) =
      ((GeometricParametric.reflection rootChoice M i).restrictScalars ℝ).comp embed := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro j a
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
      reflection_apply, GeometricParametric.reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul,
      embed_single, form_single, GeometricParametric.form_single, coeff_complex]
    ext k
    simp [Complex.real_smul, mul_assoc]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: CanonicalGeometric.embed_pair_pow
statement:
theorem embed_pair_pow (i j : B) (n : ℕ) (v : B →₀ ℝ) :
    embed (((reflection M i * reflection M j) ^ n) v) =
      ((GeometricParametric.reflection rootChoice M i *
        GeometricParametric.reflection rootChoice M j) ^ n) (embed v)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, embed_reflection]

name: CanonicalGeometric.reflection_liftable
statement: theorem reflection_liftable : M.IsLiftable (reflection M)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply embed_injective
  rw [embed_pair_pow, GeometricParametric.reflection_liftable rootChoice M i j]
  rfl

name: CanonicalGeometric.representation_simple
statement:
theorem representation_simple (i : B) :
    representation M cs (cs.simple i) = reflection M i
proof: := cs.lift_apply_simple _ i

name: CanonicalGeometric.embed_representation
statement:
theorem embed_representation (w : W) (v : B →₀ ℝ) :
    embed (representation M cs w v) =
      GeometricParametric.representation rootChoice M cs w (embed v)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using cs.induction_mul_simple generalizing v with
  | one => simp
  | mul_simple w i _ ih =>
    simp only [map_mul, representation_simple, GeometricParametric.representation_simple,
      Module.End.mul_apply, ih, embed_reflection]

name: CanonicalGeometric.representationUnits_val
statement:
theorem representationUnits_val (w : W) :
    (representationUnits M cs w : Module.End ℝ (B →₀ ℝ)) = representation M cs w
proof: := rfl

name: CanonicalGeometric.angle_bounds
statement:
theorem angle_bounds {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) :
    0 < Real.pi / m ∧ Real.pi / m < Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have hm' : (1 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  constructor
  · positivity
  · exact (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])

name: CanonicalGeometric.sin_angle_pos
statement: theorem sin_angle_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) : 0 < Real.sin (Real.pi / m)
proof:
:=
  Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (angle_bounds hm).1 (angle_bounds hm).2

name: CanonicalGeometric.dihedralCoeff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem dihedralCoeff_zero (m : ℕ) : dihedralCoeff m 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [dihedralCoeff]

name: CanonicalGeometric.dihedralCoeff_one
statement: theorem dihedralCoeff_one {m : ℕ} (hm : m = 0 ∨ 1 < m) : dihedralCoeff m 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hm with rfl | hm
  · simp [dihedralCoeff]
  · simp [dihedralCoeff, ne_of_gt (sin_angle_pos hm)]

name: CanonicalGeometric.dihedralCoeff_recurrence
statement:
theorem dihedralCoeff_recurrence (m n : ℕ) :
    dihedralCoeff m (n + 2) =
      2 * coeff m * dihedralCoeff m (n + 1) - dihedralCoeff m n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    simp only [dihedralCoeff, ite_true, coeff_zero, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    ring
  · simp only [dihedralCoeff, hm, ite_false, coeff, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hs : Real.sin (((n : ℝ) + 2) * (Real.pi / m)) =
        2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / m) * Real.sin (((n : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.pi / m)) -
          Real.sin ((n : ℝ) * (Real.pi / m)) := by
      have h₁ := Real.sin_add (((n : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.pi / m)) (Real.pi / m)
      have h₂ := Real.sin_sub (((n : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.pi / m)) (Real.pi / m)
      rw [show ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.pi / m) + Real.pi / m =
        ((n : ℝ) + 2) * (Real.pi / m) by ring] at h₁
      rw [show ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.pi / m) - Real.pi / m =
        (n : ℝ) * (Real.pi / m) by ring] at h₂
      linear_combination h₁ + h₂
    rw [hs]
    ring_nf

name: CanonicalGeometric.dihedralCoeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem dihedralCoeff_nonneg {m n : ℕ} (hm : m = 0 ∨ 1 < m)
    (hn : m = 0 ∨ n ≤ m) : 0 ≤ dihedralCoeff m n
proof:
:= by
  rcases hm with rfl | hm
  · simp [dihedralCoeff]
  · have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (hn.resolve_left hm0)
    have hm' : (0 : ℝ) < m := by positivity
    rw [dihedralCoeff, ite_eq_right hm0]
    apply div_nonneg _ (sin_angle_pos hm).le
    apply Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi
    · positivity
    · calc
        (n : ℝ) * (Real.pi / m) ≤ m * (Real.pi / m) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn' (angle_bounds hm).1.le
        _ = Real.pi := by field_simp

name: CanonicalGeometric.pair_pow_single
statement:
theorem pair_pow_single {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ℕ) :
    ((reflection M i * reflection M j) ^ k) (Finsupp.single i 1) =
      dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k + 1) • Finsupp.single i 1 +
        dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k) • Finsupp.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm : M i j = 0 ∨ 1 < M i j := by
    have := M.off_diagonal i j hij
    omega
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [dihedralCoeff_one hm]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
      Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, reflection_single M j i,
      reflection_single_self, map_add, map_smul, map_neg, reflection_single_self,
      reflection_single, M.symmetric j i]
    rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 2 by omega,
      show 2 * k + 2 + 1 = (2 * k + 1) + 2 by omega,
      dihedralCoeff_recurrence, show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * k + 2 by omega,
      dihedralCoeff_recurrence]
    module

name: CanonicalGeometric.reflection_pair_pow_single
statement:
theorem reflection_pair_pow_single {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ℕ) :
    (reflection M j * (reflection M i * reflection M j) ^ k) (Finsupp.single i 1) =
      dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k + 1) • Finsupp.single i 1 +
        dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k + 2) • Finsupp.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, pair_pow_single M hij, map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
    reflection_single M j i, reflection_single_self, M.symmetric j i,
    dihedralCoeff_recurrence]
  module

name: CanonicalGeometric.nonnegative_two_simple
statement:
theorem nonnegative_two_simple {i j : B} {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Nonnegative (a • Finsupp.single i 1 + b • Finsupp.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha (by
    classical
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num))
    (mul_nonneg hb (by
      classical
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num))

name: CanonicalGeometric.pair_pow_nonnegative
proof:
:= by
  have hm : M i j = 0 ∨ 1 < M i j := by
    have := M.off_diagonal i j hij
    omega
  rw [pair_pow_single M hij]
  apply nonnegative_two_simple
  · exact dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega)
  · exact dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega)

name: CanonicalGeometric.reflection_pair_pow_nonnegative
statement:
theorem reflection_pair_pow_nonnegative {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : M i j = 0 ∨ 2 * k + 1 < M i j) :
    Nonnegative ((reflection M j * (reflection M i * reflection M j) ^ k)
      (Finsupp.single i 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : M i j = 0 ∨ 1 < M i j := by
    have := M.off_diagonal i j hij
    omega
  rw [reflection_pair_pow_single M hij]
  apply nonnegative_two_simple
  · exact dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega)
  · exact dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega)

name: CanonicalGeometric.exists_alternating_of_parabolic_ascent
statement:
theorem exists_alternating_of_parabolic_ascent {i j : B} {v : W}
    (hv : v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup {i, j})
    (hi : cs.length v < cs.length (v * cs.simple i)) :
    ∃ n, v = cs.wordProd (CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j n) ∧
      (M i j = 0 ∨ n < M i j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hmem, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup hv
  have hlen : cs.length (cs.wordProd ω * cs.simple i) = ω.length + 1 := by
    have := cs.length_mul_simple (cs.wordProd ω) i
    rw [hω.eq] at this hi
    omega
  have hred : cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i]) := by
    simp [CoxeterSystem.IsReduced, cs.wordProd_append, hlen]
  have halt := hred.reverse.eq_reverse_alternatingWord (a := i) (b := j)
    (fun c hc ↦ by
      have hc' : c ∈ ω ++ [i] := List.mem_reverse.mp hc
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hc' with hc' | hc'
      · simpa using hmem c hc'
      · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hc'
        exact Or.inl hc') (by simp)
  have halt' : ω ++ [i] = CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord j i (ω.length + 1) := by
    simpa using congrArg List.reverse halt
  have heq : ω = CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j ω.length := by
    rw [CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord_succ, List.concat_eq_append] at halt'
    exact List.append_cancel_right halt'
  refine ⟨ω.length, congrArg cs.wordProd heq, ?_⟩
  by_cases hm : M i j = 0
  · exact Or.inl hm
  · apply Or.inr
    by_contra h
    apply cs.not_isReduced_alternatingWord j i (m := ω.length + 1)
      (by rwa [M.symmetric j i])
      (by rw [M.symmetric j i]; omega)
    rwa [← halt']

name: CanonicalGeometric.parabolic_ascent_two_nonnegative
statement:
theorem parabolic_ascent_two_nonnegative {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) {v : W}
    (hv : v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup {i, j})
    (hi : cs.length v < cs.length (v * cs.simple i)) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ representation M cs v (Finsupp.single i 1) =
      a • Finsupp.single i 1 + b • Finsupp.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl, hn⟩ := exists_alternating_of_parabolic_ascent M cs hv hi
  have hm : M i j = 0 ∨ 1 < M i j := by
    have := M.off_diagonal i j hij
    omega
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
  · have hn' : n = 2 * k := by omega
    clear hk
    subst n
    refine ⟨dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k + 1), dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k),
      dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega), dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega), ?_⟩
    simpa [cs.prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow, representation_simple] using
      pair_pow_single M hij k
  · subst n
    refine ⟨dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k + 1), dihedralCoeff (M i j) (2 * k + 2),
      dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega), dihedralCoeff_nonneg hm (by omega), ?_⟩
    simpa [cs.prod_alternatingWord_eq_mul_pow, representation_simple,
      show (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k by omega] using reflection_pair_pow_single M hij k

name: CanonicalGeometric.nonnegative_of_length_lt
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : cs.length w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w i with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hw : w = 1
    · subst w
      intro t
      classical
      simp only [map_one, Module.End.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw
    have hij : i ≠ j := by
      intro heq
      subst j
      exact (not_lt_of_gt hi) hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := cs.exists_mem_minCosetReps_mul_eq {i, j} w
    have hlen : cs.length w = cs.length u + cs.length v := by
      rw [← huv]
      exact cs.length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hu hv
    have hu_ascent : ∀ t ∈ ({i, j} : Set B), cs.length u < cs.length (u * cs.simple t) := by
      intro t ht
      have hnot := hu t ht
      have hne := cs.length_mul_simple_ne u t
      change ¬ cs.length (u * cs.simple t) < cs.length u at hnot
      omega
    have hv_ne : v ≠ 1 := by
      intro heq
      have huw : u = w := by simpa [heq] using huv
      have := hu_ascent j (by simp)
      rw [huw] at this
      exact (not_lt_of_gt this) hj
    have hu_lt : cs.length u < n := by
      have : cs.length v ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hv_ne (cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
      omega
    have hv_i : v * cs.simple i ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup {i, j} :=
      Subgroup.mul_mem _ hv (cs.simple_mem_parabolicSubgroup (by simp))
    have hlen_i : cs.length (w * cs.simple i) =
        cs.length u + cs.length (v * cs.simple i) := by
      rw [← huv, mul_assoc]
      exact cs.length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hu hv_i
    have hvi : cs.length v < cs.length (v * cs.simple i) := by omega
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ := parabolic_ascent_two_nonnegative M cs hij hv hvi
    have hui := ih (cs.length u) hu_lt (hu_ascent i (by simp)) rfl
    have huj := ih (cs.length u) hu_lt (hu_ascent j (by simp)) rfl
    rw [← huv, map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hab, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    intro t
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha (hui t)) (mul_nonneg hb (huj t))

name: CanonicalGeometric.nonpositive_of_length_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := nonnegative_of_length_lt M cs (w := w * cs.simple i) (i := i)
    (by simpa using hi)
  rw [map_mul, representation_simple, Module.End.mul_apply, reflection_single_self,
    map_neg] at hpos
  intro t
  exact neg_nonneg.mp (hpos t)

name: CanonicalGeometric.representation_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem representation_eq_one_iff (w : W) : representation M cs w = 1 ↔ w = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hw
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_rightDescent_of_ne_one hw
    have hneg := nonpositive_of_length_lt M cs hi i
    rw [h, Module.End.one_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hneg
    norm_num at hneg
  · rintro rfl
    exact map_one _

name: CanonicalGeometric.representationUnits_injective
statement: theorem representationUnits_injective : Function.Injective (representationUnits M cs)
proof:
:= by
  intro w v h
  have hker : representationUnits M cs (w⁻¹ * v) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, h, inv_mul_cancel]
  have hker' : representation M cs (w⁻¹ * v) = 1 := by
    exact congrArg Units.val hker
  have := (representation_eq_one_iff M cs _).mp hker'
  exact inv_mul_eq_one.mp this

name: CanonicalGeometric.representation_injective
statement: theorem representation_injective : Function.Injective (representation M cs)
proof:
:= by
  intro w v h
  apply representationUnits_injective M cs
  exact Units.ext h

name: CanonicalGeometric.root_image_ne_zero
statement:
theorem root_image_ne_zero (w : W) (i : B) :
    representation M cs w (Finsupp.single i 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := congrArg (representation M cs w⁻¹) hzero
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one,
    Module.End.one_apply, map_zero] at h
  have hi := congrArg (fun v : B →₀ ℝ ↦ v i) h
  simp at hi

name: CanonicalGeometric.canonicalComplex_injective
statement:
theorem canonicalComplex_injective :
    Function.Injective (GeometricParametric.representation rootChoice M cs)
proof:
:= by
  intro w v h
  apply representation_injective M cs
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply embed_injective
  rw [embed_representation, embed_representation, h]

name: GeometricRootBridge.primitive_root4
statement: theorem primitive_root4 : IsPrimitiveRoot root4 4
proof: := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_I

name: GeometricRootBridge.primitive_root10
statement: theorem primitive_root10 : IsPrimitiveRoot root10 10
proof:
:= by
  convert Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp 10 (by norm_num) using 1
  simp only [root10, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
  congr 1
  ring

name: GeometricRootBridge.primitive_root20
statement: theorem primitive_root20 : IsPrimitiveRoot root20 20
proof:
:= by
  convert Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp_of_coprime 3 20 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) using 1
  simp only [root20, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat,
    Nat.cast_ofNat]
  congr 1
  ring

name: GeometricRootBridge.exp_add_inv
statement:
theorem exp_add_inv (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))⁻¹ =
      ((2 * Real.cos t : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat, Complex.ofReal_cos,
    Complex.cos, ← Complex.exp_neg]
  ring

name: GeometricRootBridge.two_cos_three_pi_div_ten
statement:
theorem two_cos_three_pi_div_ten :
    2 * Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 10) = Real.sqrt (3 - (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 ≤ Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 10) :=
    Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩
  have h5 := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)
  have hdouble := Real.cos_two_mul (3 * Real.pi / 10)
  have hcomp : Real.cos (2 * (3 * Real.pi / 10)) =
      -Real.cos (2 * (Real.pi / 5)) := by
    rw [show 2 * (3 * Real.pi / 10) = Real.pi - 2 * (Real.pi / 5) by ring,
      Real.cos_pi_sub]
  rw [hcomp, Real.cos_two_mul, Real.cos_pi_div_five] at hdouble
  have hs : (2 * Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 10)) ^ 2 =
      3 - (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 := by nlinarith
  have hnonneg := sq_nonneg (2 * Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 10))
  apply Eq.symm
  apply (Real.sqrt_eq_iff_mul_self_eq (by nlinarith) (by positivity)).2
  nlinarith

name: GeometricRootBridge.root4_add_inv
statement: theorem root4_add_inv : root4 + root4⁻¹ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [root4, Complex.inv_I]

name: GeometricRootBridge.root10_add_inv
statement:
theorem root10_add_inv :
    root10 + root10⁻¹ = (((1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [root10, exp_add_inv, Real.cos_pi_div_five]
  congr 1
  ring

name: GeometricRootBridge.root20_add_inv
statement:
theorem root20_add_inv :
    root20 + root20⁻¹ = ((Real.sqrt (3 - (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [root20, exp_add_inv, two_cos_three_pi_div_ten]

name: GeometricRootBridge.exists_primitive_roots_with_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_roots_with_coefficients :
    ∃ z4 z10 z20 : ℂ,
      IsPrimitiveRoot z4 4 ∧ IsPrimitiveRoot z10 10 ∧ IsPrimitiveRoot z20 20 ∧
      z4 + z4⁻¹ = 0 ∧
      z10 + z10⁻¹ = (((1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
      z20 + z20⁻¹ = ((Real.sqrt (3 - (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨root4, root10, root20, primitive_root4, primitive_root10, primitive_root20,
    root4_add_inv, root10_add_inv, root20_add_inv⟩

name: GeometricRootBridge.half_coefficients
statement:
theorem half_coefficients :
    (root4 + root4⁻¹) / 2 = 0 ∧
    (root10 + root10⁻¹) / 2 = (((1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    (root20 + root20⁻¹) / 2 =
      ((Real.sqrt (3 - (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [root4_add_inv, root10_add_inv, root20_add_inv]
  push_cast
  constructor
  · simp
  constructor <;> ring

name: GeometricRootBridge.root_orders
statement:
theorem root_orders : orderOf root4 = 2 * 2 ∧ orderOf root10 = 2 * 5 ∧
    orderOf root20 = 2 * 10
proof:
:=
  ⟨primitive_root4.eq_orderOf.symm, primitive_root10.eq_orderOf.symm,
    primitive_root20.eq_orderOf.symm⟩

name: GeometricFaithfulScope.U_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [U, A, B, C, pow_two, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: GeometricFaithfulScope.V_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [V, U_eq]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [A, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: GeometricFaithfulScope.bad_commute
statement:
theorem bad_commute {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x y : K) (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 4) :
    U x y * V x y = V x y * U x y
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [U_eq, neg_mul, V_eq, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_succ, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, mul_neg,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton, one_smul, Fin.mk_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val]
  all_goals solve
    | ring
    | linear_combination (2 * x ^ 2 * y ^ 2 -x ^ 2 * y ^ 4 -x ^ 4 * y ^ 2) * h
    | linear_combination
        (5 * x * y ^ 2 -5 * x * y ^ 4 + x * y ^ 6 -4 * x ^ 3 * y ^ 2 +
          2 * x ^ 3 * y ^ 4 + x ^ 5 * y ^ 2) * h
    | linear_combination (-2 * x * y + 4 * x * y ^ 3 -x * y ^ 5 -x ^ 3 * y ^ 3) * h
    | linear_combination (4 * x * y ^ 2 -2 * x * y ^ 4 -2 * x ^ 3 * y ^ 2) * h
    | linear_combination (-2 * x ^ 2 * y ^ 2 + x ^ 2 * y ^ 4 + x ^ 4 * y ^ 2) * h
    | linear_combination (2 * x * y -2 * x * y ^ 3) * h
    | linear_combination (-x ^ 2 * y + x ^ 2 * y ^ 3) * h

name: GeometricFaithfulScope.good_difference
statement:
theorem good_difference {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x y : K)
    (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (hy : y ^ 2 = x + 2) :
    (U x y * V x y) 0 0 - (V x y * U x y) 0 0 = -40 * x-25
proof:
:= by
  simp [U_eq, V_eq, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  linear_combination
    (-25 -15 * x -10 * x ^ 2 -9 * x ^ 3 -5 * x ^ 4 -x ^ 5) * hx +
      (4 * x ^ 2 * y ^ 2 -x ^ 2 * y ^ 4 + 2 * x ^ 3 -x ^ 3 * y ^ 2 + x ^ 4 -
        2 * x ^ 4 * y ^ 2 -2 * x ^ 5 -x ^ 6) * hy

name: GeometricFaithfulScope.good_not_commute
statement:
theorem good_not_commute (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (hy : y ^ 2 = x + 2)
    (hpos : 0 < x) : U x y * V x y ≠ V x y * U x y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hd := good_difference x y hx hy
  rw [h, sub_self] at hd
  linarith

name: GeometricFaithfulScope.explicit_coefficients
statement:
theorem explicit_coefficients : ∃ x y z : ℝ,
    0 < x ∧ x ^ 2 = x + 1 ∧ y ^ 2 = 3-x ∧ z ^ 2 = x + 2 ∧
    U x y * V x y = V x y * U x y ∧
    U x z * V x z ≠ V x z * U x z
proof:
:= by
  let x : ℝ := (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 5) ^ 2 = 5 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (5 : ℝ)
  have hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1 := by dsimp [x]; nlinarith
  have hp : 0 < x := by dsimp [x]; positivity
  have hb : x < 3 := by dsimp [x]; nlinarith
  have hy : (Real.sqrt (3-x)) ^ 2 = 3-x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hz : (Real.sqrt (x + 2)) ^ 2 = x + 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  refine ⟨x, Real.sqrt (3-x), Real.sqrt (x + 2), hp, hx, hy, hz, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply bad_commute
    linarith
  · exact good_not_commute x _ hx hz hp

:= by

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.AB_sq_nf
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [A, B, Matrix.cons_mul, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, Matrix.vecMul_cons,
      Matrix.head_cons, neg_smul, one_smul, Matrix.neg_cons, neg_zero, Matrix.neg_empty,
      Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.smul_cons, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg, mul_one, Matrix.smul_empty,
      zero_smul, Matrix.empty_vecMul, add_zero, Matrix.add_cons, zero_add,
      Matrix.empty_add_empty, Matrix.empty_mul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Fin.zero_eta,
      Fin.isValue, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_succ, neg_mul,
      Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, Fin.mk_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, neg_neg, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_singleton, neg_add_cancel, one_mul, zero_mul]
  all_goals solve

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.AB_four_nf

:= by

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.AB_pow_five
statement:
theorem AB_pow_five {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x t : K) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) :
    (A x * B x t) ^ 5 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (5 : ℕ) = 4 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_one, AB_four_nf x t hx]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [A, B, Matrix.cons_mul, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, Matrix.vecMul_cons,
      Matrix.head_cons, neg_smul, one_smul, Matrix.neg_cons, neg_zero, Matrix.neg_empty,
      Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.smul_cons, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg, mul_one, Matrix.smul_empty,
      zero_smul, Matrix.empty_vecMul, add_zero, Matrix.add_cons, zero_add,
      Matrix.empty_add_empty, Matrix.empty_mul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Fin.zero_eta,
      Fin.isValue, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,

      Matrix.cons_val_succ, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_add_cancel_comm, Matrix.one_apply_eq, Fin.mk_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, add_neg_cancel, ne_eq, zero_ne_one, not_false_eq_true,
      Matrix.one_apply_ne, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val, neg_add_cancel, Fin.reduceEq,
      one_ne_zero, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton, zero_mul]
  all_goals solve
    | ring
    | linear_combination (-x) * hx
    | linear_combination (1) * hx
    | linear_combination (-t) * hx

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.BC_sq_nf
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

      Matrix.head_cons, one_smul, Matrix.tail_cons, zero_smul, Matrix.empty_vecMul, add_zero,
      Matrix.smul_cons, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, Matrix.smul_empty, neg_smul,
      Matrix.neg_cons, neg_zero, Matrix.neg_empty, mul_neg, Matrix.add_cons, zero_add,
      Matrix.empty_add_empty, Matrix.empty_mul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Fin.zero_eta,
      Fin.isValue, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_succ, zero_mul,
      Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, Fin.mk_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton, neg_neg, one_mul, add_left_inj, neg_inj]
  all_goals solve
    | ring

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.BC_four_nf
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (B x t * C t) ^ 4 = (B x t * C t) ^ 2 * (B x t * C t) ^ 2 by
    rw [← pow_add], BC_sq_nf]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val',
      Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, mul_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_succ, zero_mul, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero,

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.BC_five_nf
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (5 : ℕ) = 4 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_one, BC_four_nf x t ht]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

      Matrix.head_cons, one_smul, Matrix.tail_cons, zero_smul, Matrix.empty_vecMul, add_zero,
      Matrix.smul_cons, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, Matrix.smul_empty, neg_smul,
      Matrix.neg_cons, neg_zero, Matrix.neg_empty, mul_neg, Matrix.add_cons, zero_add,
      Matrix.empty_add_empty, Matrix.empty_mul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Fin.zero_eta,
      Fin.isValue, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_succ, zero_mul,
      Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, Fin.mk_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val, one_mul, neg_mul,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton, add_neg_cancel_right,
      neg_neg, neg_add_cancel, neg_add_rev, smul_add, smul_neg]

    | ring

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.BC_pow_ten
statement:
theorem BC_pow_ten {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x t : K)
    (ht : t ^ 4 = 5 * t ^ 2 - 5) : (B x t * C t) ^ 10 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (10 : ℕ) = 5 + 5 from rfl, pow_add, BC_five_nf x t ht]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.quartic_bad
statement:
theorem quartic_bad {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x t : K)
    (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (ht : t ^ 2 = 3 - x) : t ^ 4 = 5 * t ^ 2 - 5
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination hx + (t ^ 2 - x - 2) * ht

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.quartic_good
statement:
theorem quartic_good {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x t : K)
    (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (ht : t ^ 2 = x + 2) : t ^ 4 = 5 * t ^ 2 - 5
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination hx + (t ^ 2 + x - 3) * ht

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.BC_pow_ten_bad
statement:
theorem BC_pow_ten_bad {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x t : K)
    (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (ht : t ^ 2 = 3 - x) : (B x t * C t) ^ 10 = 1
proof:
:=
  BC_pow_ten x t (quartic_bad x t hx ht)

name: GeometricCounterexampleRelations.BC_pow_ten_good
statement:
theorem BC_pow_ten_good {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x t : K)
    (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (ht : t ^ 2 = x + 2) : (B x t * C t) ^ 10 = 1
proof:
:=
  BC_pow_ten x t (quartic_good x t hx ht)

name: GeometricCounterexample.reverse_relation
statement:
private theorem reverse_relation {M : Type*} [Monoid M] (a b : M) (n : ℕ)
    (ha : a * a = 1) (hab : (a * b) ^ n = 1) : (b * a) ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : a * (b * a) ^ n = (a * b) ^ n * a :=
    (show SemiconjBy a (b * a) (a * b) from (mul_assoc a b a).symm).pow_right n
  calc
    (b * a) ^ n = a * (a * (b * a) ^ n) := by rw [← mul_assoc, ha, one_mul]
    _ = a * ((a * b) ^ n * a) := congrArg (a * ·) h
    _ = 1 := by rw [hab, one_mul, ha]

name: GeometricCounterexample.generators_liftable
statement:
theorem generators_liftable (x t : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1)
    (ht : t ^ 4 = 5 * t ^ 2 - 5) : triangle.IsLiftable (generators x t)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : A x * A x = 1 := by simpa [pow_two] using A_sq x
  have hb : B x t * B x t = 1 := by simpa [pow_two] using B_sq x t
  have hc : C t * C t = 1 := by simpa [pow_two] using C_sq t
  have hab := AB_pow_five x t hx
  have hbc := BC_pow_ten x t ht
  have hac := AC_sq x t
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [generators, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, triangle,
      CoxeterMatrix.diagonal, pow_one, Fin.mk_one, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.of_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val]
  · exact ha
  · exact hab
  · exact hac
  · exact reverse_relation _ _ _ ha hab
  · exact hb
  · exact hbc
  · exact reverse_relation _ _ _ ha hac
  · exact reverse_relation _ _ _ hb hbc
  · exact hc

name: GeometricCounterexample.representation_simple
statement:
@[simp] theorem representation_simple (x t : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1)
    (ht : t ^ 4 = 5 * t ^ 2 - 5) (i : Fin 3) :
    representation x t hx ht (triangle.simple i) = generators x t i
proof:
:=
  triangle.toCoxeterSystem.lift_apply_simple (generators_liftable x t hx ht) i

name: GeometricCounterexample.representation_u
statement:
@[simp] theorem representation_u (x t : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1)
    (ht : t ^ 4 = 5 * t ^ 2 - 5) : representation x t hx ht u = U x t
proof:
:= by
  simp [u, generators, U]

name: GeometricCounterexample.representation_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem representation_v (x t : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1)
    (ht : t ^ 4 = 5 * t ^ 2 - 5) : representation x t hx ht v = V x t
proof:
:= by
  simp [v, generators, V]

name: GeometricCounterexample.bad_kills_w
statement:
theorem bad_kills_w (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (hy : y ^ 2 = 3 - x) :
    representation x y hx (quartic_bad x y hx hy) w = 1
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := representation x y hx (quartic_bad x y hx hy)
  have heq : ρ (u * v) = ρ (v * u) := by
    simpa [ρ] using bad_commute x y (by linarith : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 4)
  change ρ ((u * v) * (v * u)⁻¹) = 1
  rw [map_mul, heq, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]

name: GeometricCounterexample.words_not_commute
statement:
theorem words_not_commute (x z : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1)
    (hz : z ^ 2 = x + 2) (hp : 0 < x) : u * v ≠ v * u
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hm := congrArg (representation x z hx (quartic_good x z hx hz)) h
  exact good_not_commute x z hx hz hp (by simpa using hm)

name: GeometricCounterexample.w_ne_one
statement: theorem w_ne_one : w ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z, hp, hx, hy, hz, _, _⟩ := explicit_coefficients
  intro h
  have heq : u * v = v * u := mul_inv_eq_one.mp h
  exact words_not_commute x z hx hz hp heq

name: GeometricCounterexample.bad_not_injective
statement:
theorem bad_not_injective (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1)
    (hy : y ^ 2 = 3 - x) :
    ¬ Function.Injective (representation x y hx (quartic_bad x y hx hy))
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  apply w_ne_one
  apply hinj
  rw [bad_kills_w x y hx hy, map_one]

name: GeometricCounterexample.exists_nonfaithful_representation
statement:
theorem exists_nonfaithful_representation :
    ∃ (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 = x + 1) (hy : y ^ 2 = 3 - x),
      w ≠ 1 ∧ representation x y hx (quartic_bad x y hx hy) w = 1 ∧
      ¬ Function.Injective (representation x y hx (quartic_bad x y hx hy))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z, hp, hx, hy, hz, _, _⟩ := explicit_coefficients
  exact ⟨x, y, hx, hy, w_ne_one, bad_kills_w x y hx hy, bad_not_injective x y hx hy⟩

name: GeometricCounterexample.golden_sq
statement: theorem golden_sq : golden ^ 2 = golden + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 5) ^ 2 = 5 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  dsimp [golden]
  nlinarith

name: GeometricCounterexample.badCoefficient_sq
statement: theorem badCoefficient_sq : badCoefficient ^ 2 = 3 - golden
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sq_sqrt
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 5) ^ 2 = 5 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (5 : ℝ)
  dsimp [golden]
  nlinarith

name: GeometricCounterexample.golden_pos
statement: theorem golden_pos : 0 < golden
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [golden]
  positivity

name: GeometricCounterexample.goodCoefficient_sq
statement: theorem goodCoefficient_sq : goodCoefficient ^ 2 = golden + 2
proof:
:=
  Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith [golden_pos])

name: GeometricCounterexample.goodRepresentation_words_not_commute
statement:
theorem goodRepresentation_words_not_commute :
    goodRepresentation (u * v) ≠ goodRepresentation (v * u)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hm := congrArg (fun g : (Mat ℝ)ˣ => (g : Mat ℝ)) h
  change representation golden goodCoefficient golden_sq
    (quartic_good golden goodCoefficient golden_sq goodCoefficient_sq) (u * v) =
    representation golden goodCoefficient golden_sq
    (quartic_good golden goodCoefficient golden_sq goodCoefficient_sq) (v * u) at hm
  exact good_not_commute golden goodCoefficient golden_sq goodCoefficient_sq golden_pos
    (by simpa using hm)

name: GeometricCounterexample.badRepresentation_simple
statement:
theorem badRepresentation_simple (i : Fin 3) :
    (badRepresentation (triangle.simple i) : Mat ℝ) =
      generators golden badCoefficient i
proof:
:= by
  exact representation_simple golden badCoefficient golden_sq
    (quartic_bad golden badCoefficient golden_sq badCoefficient_sq) i

name: GeometricCounterexample.w_mem_badRepresentation_ker
statement: theorem w_mem_badRepresentation_ker : w ∈ badRepresentation.ker
proof:
:= by
  change badRepresentation w = 1
  apply Units.ext
  exact bad_kills_w golden badCoefficient golden_sq badCoefficient_sq

name: GeometricCounterexample.badRepresentation_not_injective
statement: theorem badRepresentation_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective badRepresentation
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  apply w_ne_one
  apply hinj
  rw [map_one]
  exact w_mem_badRepresentation_ker

name: GeometricCounterexample.badRepresentation_ker_ne_bot
statement: theorem badRepresentation_ker_ne_bot : badRepresentation.ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hw := w_mem_badRepresentation_ker
  rw [h, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hw
  exact w_ne_one hw

name: GeometricParametric.badChoice_roots
statement:
theorem badChoice_roots :
    badChoice.root 2 = root4 ∧ badChoice.root 5 = root10 ∧
    badChoice.root 10 = root20
proof: := by norm_num [badChoice]

name: GeometricParametric.badChoice_coefficients
statement:
theorem badChoice_coefficients :
    2 * coeff badChoice 1 = -2 ∧ 2 * coeff badChoice 2 = 0 ∧
    2 * coeff badChoice 5 = (golden : ℂ) ∧
    2 * coeff badChoice 10 = (badCoefficient : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [coeff_one]; ring, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [two_mul_coeff badChoice (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), badChoice_roots.1]
    exact root4_add_inv
  · rw [two_mul_coeff badChoice (by norm_num : 5 ≠ 0), badChoice_roots.2.1]
    exact root10_add_inv
  · rw [two_mul_coeff badChoice (by norm_num : 10 ≠ 0), badChoice_roots.2.2]
    exact root20_add_inv

name: GeometricParametric.reflection_matrix
statement:
theorem reflection_matrix (i : Fin 3) :
    coordinates (reflection badChoice triangle i) =
      Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix (generators golden badCoefficient i)
proof:
:= by
  ext j k
  simp only [coordinates, LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv_apply,
    Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne]
  change (reflection badChoice triangle i (Finsupp.single k 1)) j = _
  rw [reflection_single]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;>
    norm_num [triangle, badChoice_coefficients.1, badChoice_coefficients.2.1,
      badChoice_coefficients.2.2.1, badChoice_coefficients.2.2.2,
      generators, A, B, C]

name: GeometricParametric.representation_matrix
statement:
theorem representation_matrix :
    coordinates.toMonoidHom.comp badGeometric = complexExtension
proof:
:= by
  apply triangle.toCoxeterSystem.ext_simple
  intro i
  change coordinates (badGeometric (triangle.simple i)) = _
  rw [show badGeometric (triangle.simple i) = reflection badChoice triangle i from
    representation_simple badChoice triangle triangle.toCoxeterSystem i]
  rw [reflection_matrix]
  change Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix (generators golden badCoefficient i) =
    Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix (badRepresentation (triangle.simple i) : Mat ℝ)
  rw [badRepresentation_simple]

name: GeometricParametric.badGeometric_kills_w
statement: theorem badGeometric_kills_w : badGeometric w = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply coordinates.injective
  have heq := DFunLike.congr_fun representation_matrix w
  change coordinates (badGeometric w) = complexExtension w at heq
  rw [heq]
  have hw : badRepresentation w = 1 := w_mem_badRepresentation_ker
  simp [complexExtension, hw]

name: GeometricParametric.badGeometric_not_injective
statement: theorem badGeometric_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective badGeometric
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  exact w_ne_one (hinj (by rw [badGeometric_kills_w, map_one]))

name: GeometricParametric.badGeometricUnits_not_injective
statement: theorem badGeometricUnits_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective badGeometricUnits
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  apply w_ne_one
  apply hinj
  apply Units.ext
  exact (badGeometric_kills_w.trans (map_one badGeometric).symm)

name: GeometricParametric.exists_nonfaithful_choice
statement:
theorem exists_nonfaithful_choice :
    ∃ r : RootChoice ℂ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → IsPrimitiveRoot (r.root m) (2 * m)) ∧
      coordinates.toMonoidHom.comp
        (GeometricParametric.representation r triangle triangle.toCoxeterSystem) =
          complexExtension ∧
      w ≠ 1 ∧
      GeometricParametric.representation r triangle triangle.toCoxeterSystem w = 1 ∧
      ¬ Function.Injective
        (GeometricParametric.representation r triangle triangle.toCoxeterSystem)
proof:
:=
  ⟨badChoice, fun _ hm ↦ root_primitive badChoice hm, representation_matrix,
    w_ne_one, badGeometric_kills_w, badGeometric_not_injective⟩

name: GeometricParametric.root_primitive
statement:
theorem root_primitive {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (r.root m) (2 * m)
proof:
:=
  IsPrimitiveRoot.iff_orderOf.mpr (r.order_root hm)

name: GeometricParametric.root_pow
statement: theorem root_pow (m : ℕ) : r.root m ^ (2 * m) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · simp
  · rw [← r.order_root hm]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one _

name: GeometricParametric.root_ne_zero
statement: theorem root_ne_zero (m : ℕ) : r.root m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · rw [r.root_zero]; exact one_ne_zero
  · intro h
    have hp := root_pow r m
    rw [h, zero_pow (by omega)] at hp
    exact zero_ne_one hp
