name: GeometricParametric.root_sq_ne_one
statement: theorem root_sq_ne_one {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) : r.root m ^ 2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hd := Nat.le_of_dvd two_pos (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h)
  rw [r.order_root (by omega)] at hd
  omega

name: GeometricParametric.two_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem two_mul_coeff {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    2 * coeff r m = r.root m + (r.root m)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff, hm, ↓reduceIte]
  ring

name: GeometricParametric.coeff_one
statement: theorem coeff_one : coeff r 1 = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : r.root 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by simpa using root_pow r 1
  have h2 : r.root 1 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have ho := r.order_root one_pos
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at ho
    omega
  have h3 : r.root 1 = -1 := by
    have he : (r.root 1 - 1) * (r.root 1 + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination h1
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp he with h | h
    · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.mp h) h2
    · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
  simp only [coeff, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, h3]
  norm_num

name: GeometricParametric.form_single
statement:
theorem form_single (i j : B) (a : K) :
    form r M i (Finsupp.single j a) = a * -coeff r (M i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [form, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: GeometricParametric.form_single_self
statement:
theorem form_single_self (i : B) (a : K) :
    form r M i (Finsupp.single i a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_single, M.diagonal, coeff_one r]
  ring

name: GeometricParametric.reflection_apply
statement:
theorem reflection_apply (i : B) (v : B →₀ K) :
    reflection r M i v = v - form r M i v • Finsupp.single i 2
proof: := rfl

name: GeometricParametric.reflection_single
statement:
theorem reflection_single (i j : B) :
    reflection r M i (Finsupp.single j 1) =
      Finsupp.single j 1 + (2 * coeff r (M i j)) • Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply, form_single, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one i (2 : K)]
  module

name: GeometricParametric.reflection_mul_self
statement: theorem reflection_mul_self (i : B) : reflection r M i * reflection r M i = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  have h : form r M i (reflection r M i v) = -form r M i v := by
    rw [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, form_single_self, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
    reflection_apply r M i (reflection r M i v), h, reflection_apply]
  module

name: GeometricParametric.reflection_apply'
statement:
theorem reflection_apply' (i : B) (v : B →₀ K) :
    reflection r M i v = v - (2 * form r M i v) • Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflection_apply, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one i (2 : K), smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: GeometricParametric.reflection_liftable
statement: theorem reflection_liftable : M.IsLiftable (reflection r M)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    rw [M.diagonal, pow_one, reflection_mul_self]
  by_cases hm0 : M i j = 0
  · rw [hm0, pow_zero]
  have hm : 1 < M i j := by have := M.off_diagonal i j hij; omega
  exact Module.End.mul_pow_eq_one_of_reflections (reflection_apply' r M i)
    (reflection_apply' r M j) (form_single_self r M i 1)
    (by rw [form_single, one_mul])
    (by rw [form_single, one_mul, M.symmetric j i])
    (form_single_self r M j 1) (root_ne_zero r _) (two_mul_coeff r hm0)
    (root_sq_ne_one r hm) (root_pow r _)

name: GeometricParametric.representation_simple
statement:
theorem representation_simple {W : Type*} [Group W] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (i : B) :
    representation r M cs (cs.simple i) = reflection r M i
proof:
:=
  cs.lift_apply_simple _ i

name: GeometricParametric.opaque_reflection
statement:
theorem opaque_reflection [IsAlgClosed K] (i : B) :
    reflection (opaqueChoice K) M i = M.geomReflection K i
proof: := rfl

name: GeometricParametric.opaque_representation
statement:
theorem opaque_representation [IsAlgClosed K] {W : Type*} [Group W]
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) :
    representation (opaqueChoice K) M cs = cs.geometricRepresentation K
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.val_TUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem val_TUnit (w : W) : (TUnit cs hq w : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) = T cs q w
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_TInv
statement: theorem T_mul_TInv (w : W) : T cs q w * TInv cs hq w = 1
proof: := (TUnit cs hq w).mul_inv

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.TInv_mul_T
statement: theorem TInv_mul_T (w : W) : TInv cs hq w * T cs q w = 1
proof: := (TUnit cs hq w).inv_mul

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.TInv_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem TInv_one : TInv cs hq 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using TInv_mul_T cs hq 1

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.TUnit_mul
statement:
theorem TUnit_mul {x y : W} (h : ℓ (x * y) = ℓ x + ℓ y) :
    TUnit cs hq (x * y) = TUnit cs hq x * TUnit cs hq y
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp [T_mul_T cs q h])

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.TInv_mul
statement:
theorem TInv_mul {x y : W} (h : ℓ (x * y) = ℓ x + ℓ y) :
    TInv cs hq (x * y) = TInv cs hq y * TInv cs hq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [TInv, TUnit_mul cs hq h, mul_inv_rev, Units.val_mul]
  rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.TInv_simple
statement:
theorem TInv_simple (i : B) :
    TInv cs hq (s i) = hq.unit⁻¹.1 • T cs q (s i) - (1 - hq.unit⁻¹.1) • 1
proof:
:=
  Units.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (T_simple_mul_inv cs q hq i)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.TInv_simple_mul_self
statement:
theorem TInv_simple_mul_self (i : B) :
    TInv cs hq (s i) * TInv cs hq (s i) =
      (hq.unit⁻¹.1 - 1) • TInv cs hq (s i) + hq.unit⁻¹.1 • 1
proof:
:= by
  have e : hq.unit⁻¹.1 * q = 1 := hq.val_inv_mul
  have hT := T_simple_mul_self cs q i
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] at hT
  rw [TInv_simple, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc,
    smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, hT, mul_one,
    one_mul, one_mul]
  match_scalars <;> linear_combination (hq.unit⁻¹.1) * e

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isUnit_of_mul_eq_one'
statement: theorem isUnit_of_mul_eq_one' : IsUnit q
proof:
:=
  IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (σ q) (by rw [mul_comm, hσ])

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.val_inv_eq
statement: theorem val_inv_eq : (isUnit_of_mul_eq_one' σ hσ).unit⁻¹.1 = σ q
proof:
:=
  Units.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left hσ

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barT_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem barT_one : barT cs σ hσ 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [barT]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barT_mul
statement:
theorem barT_mul {x y : W} (h : ℓ (x * y) = ℓ x + ℓ y) :
    barT cs σ hσ (x * y) = barT cs σ hσ x * barT cs σ hσ y
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ℓ (y⁻¹ * x⁻¹) = ℓ y⁻¹ + ℓ x⁻¹ := by
    rw [← mul_inv_rev, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv, h, add_comm]
  simp only [barT, mul_inv_rev, TInv_mul cs _ h']

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barT_simple
statement:
theorem barT_simple (i : B) :
    barT cs σ hσ (s i) = σ q • T cs q (s i) - (1 - σ q) • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [barT, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple, TInv_simple, val_inv_eq σ hσ]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barT_simple_mul_self
statement:
theorem barT_simple_mul_self (i : B) :
    barT cs σ hσ (s i) * barT cs σ hσ (s i) = (σ q - 1) • barT cs σ hσ (s i) + σ q • 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [barT, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple]
  rw [TInv_simple_mul_self, val_inv_eq σ hσ]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barAddHom_smul_T
statement:
theorem barAddHom_smul_T (a : R) (w : W) :
    barAddHom cs σ hσ (a • T cs q w) = σ a • barT cs σ hσ w
proof:
:= by
  have : toFinsupp cs q (a • T cs q w) = single w a := by
    rw [map_smul, toFinsupp_T, smul_single_one]
  simp [barAddHom, this]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barAddHom_T
statement: theorem barAddHom_T (w : W) : barAddHom cs σ hσ (T cs q w) = barT cs σ hσ w
proof:
:= by
  simpa using barAddHom_smul_T cs σ hσ 1 w

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barAddHom_smul
statement:
theorem barAddHom_smul (a : R) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    barAddHom cs σ hσ (a • h) = σ a • barAddHom cs σ hσ h
proof:
:= by
  induction h using induction_on cs q generalizing a with
  | T w => rw [barAddHom_smul_T, barAddHom_T]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul b x hx => rw [smul_smul, hx, hx, smul_smul, map_mul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barAddHom_mul_T_simple
statement:
theorem barAddHom_mul_T_simple (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (i : B) :
    barAddHom cs σ hσ (h * T cs q (s i)) =
      barAddHom cs σ hσ h * barAddHom cs σ hσ (T cs q (s i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [barAddHom_T]
  induction h using induction_on cs q with
  | T w =>
    rw [T_mul_T_simple, barAddHom_T]
    split_ifs with hlt
    · rw [barAddHom_T, barT_mul cs σ hσ (x := w) (y := s i) (by
        rw [cs.length_simple]; rcases cs.length_mul_simple w i with h | h <;> omega)]
    · 
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, w = v * s i := ⟨w * s i, by simp⟩
      simp only [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at hlt ⊢
      have hlen : ℓ (v * s i) = ℓ v + ℓ (s i) := by
        rw [cs.length_simple]
        rcases cs.length_mul_simple v i with h | h <;> omega
      rw [map_add, barAddHom_smul, barAddHom_smul, barAddHom_T, barAddHom_T,
        barT_mul cs σ hσ hlen, mul_assoc, barT_simple_mul_self, map_sub, map_one, mul_add,
        mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, mul_one]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_mul]
  | smul a x hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc, barAddHom_smul, hx, barAddHom_smul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bar_T
statement:
theorem bar_T (w : W) :
    bar cs σ hσ (T cs q w) = TInv cs (isUnit_of_mul_eq_one' σ hσ) w⁻¹
proof:
:=
  barAddHom_T cs σ hσ w

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bar_T_simple
statement:
theorem bar_T_simple (i : B) :
    bar cs σ hσ (T cs q (s i)) = σ q • T cs q (s i) - (1 - σ q) • 1
proof:
:=
  (barAddHom_T cs σ hσ _).trans (barT_simple cs σ hσ i)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bar_smul
statement:
theorem bar_smul (a : R) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    bar cs σ hσ (a • h) = σ a • bar cs σ hσ h
proof: := barAddHom_smul cs σ hσ a h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bar_algebraMap
statement:
theorem bar_algebraMap (a : R) :
    bar cs σ hσ (algebraMap R _ a) = algebraMap R _ (σ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, bar_smul, map_one, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bar_T_mul_T_inv
statement: theorem bar_T_mul_T_inv (w : W) : bar cs σ hσ (T cs q w) * T cs q w⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [bar_T, TInv_mul_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bar_bar_T_simple
statement:
theorem bar_bar_T_simple (hσσ : ∀ a, σ (σ a) = a) (i : B) :
    bar cs σ hσ (bar cs σ hσ (T cs q (s i))) = T cs q (s i)
proof:
:= by
  have e : q * σ q = 1 := by rw [mul_comm, hσ]
  rw [bar_T_simple, map_sub, bar_smul, bar_smul, map_one, bar_T_simple, hσσ, map_sub, map_one,
    hσσ, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  match_scalars <;> linear_combination e

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bar_bar
statement:
theorem bar_bar (hσσ : ∀ a, σ (σ a) = a) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    bar cs σ hσ (bar cs σ hσ h) = h
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ w, bar cs σ hσ (bar cs σ hσ (T cs q w)) = T cs q w := by
    intro w
    induction w using cs.induction_simple_mul with
    | one => simp
    | simple_mul w i hlt ih =>
      rw [← T_simple_mul_T_of_lt cs q hlt, map_mul, map_mul, ih, bar_bar_T_simple cs σ hσ hσσ]
  induction h using induction_on cs q with
  | T w => exact hT w
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul a x hx => rw [bar_smul, bar_smul, hσσ, hx]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.invertHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invertHom_apply (a : A[T;T⁻¹]) : invertHom a = invert a
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.invertHom_T_two_mul_T_two
statement:
theorem invertHom_T_two_mul_T_two :
    invertHom (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : A[T;T⁻¹]) * LaurentPolynomial.T 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [invertHom_apply, invert_T, ← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_smul
statement:
theorem barL_smul (a : A[T;T⁻¹]) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : A[T;T⁻¹])) :
    barL cs (a • h) = invert a • barL cs h
proof:
:=
  bar_smul cs _ _ a h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_T_simple
statement:
theorem barL_T_simple (i : B) :
    barL cs (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : A[T;T⁻¹]) (cs.simple i)) =
      (LaurentPolynomial.T (-2) : A[T;T⁻¹]) •
          IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : A[T;T⁻¹]) (cs.simple i) -
        (1 - (LaurentPolynomial.T (-2) : A[T;T⁻¹])) • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [barL, bar_T_simple, invertHom_apply, invert_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_C'_simple
statement:
theorem barL_C'_simple (i : B) :
    barL cs ((LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : A[T;T⁻¹]) •
      (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : A[T;T⁻¹]) (cs.simple i) + 1)) =
      (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : A[T;T⁻¹]) •
        (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : A[T;T⁻¹]) (cs.simple i) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [barL_smul, map_add, map_one, barL_T_simple, invert_T, neg_neg]
  have e1 : (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 : A[T;T⁻¹]) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-2) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by rw [← T_add]; norm_num
  have e2 : (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 : A[T;T⁻¹]) * (1 - LaurentPolynomial.T (-2)) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T 1 - LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, e1]
  rw [smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul, e1, e2, sub_smul, smul_add]
  abel

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_barL
statement:
theorem barL_barL (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : A[T;T⁻¹])) :
    barL cs (barL cs h) = h
proof:
:=
  bar_bar cs _ _ (fun a ↦ involutive_invert a) h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_T_simple_mul
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_T_simple_mul (i : B) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    toFinsupp cs q (T cs q (s i) * h) = leftOp cs q i (toFinsupp cs q h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFinsupp_T_mul, lmul_single_simple]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftOp_apply
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hx']
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] <;> ring
  | single w a =>
    have hne : ℓ (s i * w) ≠ ℓ w := cs.length_simple_mul_ne w i
    rw [← smul_single_one, map_smul, leftOp_single]
    rcases eq_or_ne y w with rfl | hyw
    · have h1 : s i * y ≠ y := fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
      by_cases hy : ℓ y < ℓ (s i * y)
      · simp [hy, h1, not_lt.mpr hy.le]
      · simp [hy, h1, lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hy) hne, mul_comm]
    rcases eq_or_ne y (s i * w) with rfl | hyws
    · have h2 : s i * (s i * w) = w := CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left cs i
      by_cases hw : ℓ w < ℓ (s i * w)
      · simp [hw, h2, hyw.symm]
      · simp [hw, h2, hyw, mul_comm]
    · have h3 : s i * y ≠ w := fun h ↦
        hyws (by rw [← h, CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left])
      split_ifs <;> simp [hyw.symm, hyws.symm, h3.symm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.aeval_T_two_eq
statement:
theorem aeval_T_two_eq (P : Polynomial ℤ) :
    Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) P =
      Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.expand ℤ 2 P)
proof:
:= by
  have : Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) =
      Polynomial.toLaurentAlg.comp (Polynomial.expand ℤ 2) := by
    ext
    simp [Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow]
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.aeval_T_two_injective
statement:
theorem aeval_T_two_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (Polynomial.aeval (R := ℤ) (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  rw [aeval_T_two_eq, aeval_T_two_eq] at h
  exact Polynomial.expand_injective two_pos (Polynomial.toLaurent_injective h)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.coeff_T_mul_aeval_T_two_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_T_mul_aeval_T_two_eq_zero {a n : ℤ} {P : Polynomial ℤ}
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ, n = a + 2 * k → P.coeff k = 0) :
    ((LaurentPolynomial.T a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) *
      Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) P).coeff n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul, aeval_T_two_eq,
    LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
  by_cases hm : ∃ j : ℕ, (j : ℤ) = -a + n
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hm
    have e : -a + n = Nat.castEmbedding j := by simp [hj]
    rw [e, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective Nat.castEmbedding.injective]
    change (Polynomial.expand ℤ 2 P).coeff j = 0
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_expand two_pos]
    split_ifs with h2
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h2
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ two_pos]
      exact h k (by push_cast at hj; omega)
    · rfl
  · refine Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ ?_
    rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact hm ⟨j, by simpa using hj⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_aeval_T_two_injective
statement:
theorem T_mul_aeval_T_two_injective (a : ℤ) : Function.Injective fun P : Polynomial ℤ ↦
    (LaurentPolynomial.T a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) *
      Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) P
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ aeval_T_two_injective ((LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T a).mul_left_cancel h)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.zsmul_T_mul_aeval
statement:
theorem zsmul_T_mul_aeval {a b m : ℕ} {μ : ℤ} (h : μ ≠ 0 → a = b + 2 * m) (P : Polynomial ℤ) :
    μ • (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(b : ℤ)) *
        Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) P) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-(a : ℤ)) * Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2)
        (Polynomial.C μ * Polynomial.X ^ m * P)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne μ 0 with rfl | hμ
  · simp
  have e : (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(a : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T 2 ^ m = LaurentPolynomial.T (-(b : ℤ)) := by
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_pow, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add, h hμ]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.aeval_C, ← e, zsmul_eq_mul,
    eq_intCast (algebraMap ℤ (LaurentPolynomial ℤ))]
  ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.IsKLElement.eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem IsKLElement.eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE {w : W} {C : 𝓗} {P : W → Polynomial ℤ}
    (h : IsKLElement cs w C P) {y : W} (hy : ¬cs.BruhatLE y w) : P y = 0
proof:
:=
  not_not.mp fun h' ↦ hy (h.bruhatLE h')

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.IsKLElement.eq_zero_of_length_lt
statement:
theorem IsKLElement.eq_zero_of_length_lt {w : W} {C : 𝓗} {P : W → Polynomial ℤ}
    (h : IsKLElement cs w C P) {y : W} (hy : ℓ w < ℓ y) : P y = 0
proof:
:=
  h.eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE fun h' ↦ by have := h'.length_le; omega

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.IsKLElement.unique
statement:
theorem IsKLElement.unique {w : W} {C C' : 𝓗} {P P' : W → Polynomial ℤ}
    (h : IsKLElement cs w C P) (h' : IsKLElement cs w C' P') : C = C' ∧ P = P'
proof:
:= by
  have hC : C = C' := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    apply eq_zero_of_barL_eq_self cs (by rw [map_sub, h.barL_eq, h'.barL_eq])
    intro y n hn
    rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, h.toFinsupp_apply, h'.toFinsupp_apply, ← mul_sub, ← map_sub]
    apply coeff_T_mul_aeval_T_two_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub]
    rcases eq_or_ne y w with rfl | hyw
    · rw [h.self, h'.self, sub_self]
    · rw [h.coeff_eq_zero hyw (by omega), h'.coeff_eq_zero hyw (by omega), sub_self]
  refine ⟨hC, funext fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  have := h.toFinsupp_apply y
  rw [hC, h'.toFinsupp_apply] at this
  exact (T_mul_aeval_T_two_injective _ this).symm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isKLElement_one
statement:
theorem isKLElement_one [DecidableEq W] :
    IsKLElement cs 1 (1 : 𝓗) fun y ↦ if y = 1 then 1 else 0 where
  barL_eq
proof:
:= map_one _
  toFinsupp_apply y := by
    rw [toFinsupp_one, cs.length_one]
    rcases eq_or_ne y 1 with rfl | hy
    · simp
    · simp [hy]
  self := by simp
  bruhatLE {y} hy := by
    rcases eq_or_ne y 1 with rfl | h
    · exact cs.bruhatLE_refl 1
    · simp [h] at hy
  coeff_eq_zero {y} hy _ _ := by simp [hy]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_klSimple
statement: theorem barL_klSimple (i : B) : barL cs (klSimple cs i) = klSimple cs i
proof:
:=
  barL_C'_simple cs i

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_klSimple_mul_apply
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_klSimple_mul_apply (i : B) (h : 𝓗) (y : W) :
    toFinsupp cs _ (klSimple cs i * h) y = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) *
      ((if ℓ (s i * y) < ℓ y then
          toFinsupp cs _ h (s i * y) + (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 - 1) * toFinsupp cs _ h y
        else LaurentPolynomial.T 2 * toFinsupp cs _ h (s i * y)) + toFinsupp cs _ h y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [klSimple, smul_mul_assoc, add_mul, one_mul, map_smul, map_add, toFinsupp_T_simple_mul,
    Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, leftOp_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.muCoeff_ne_zero
statement: theorem muCoeff_ne_zero {P : Polynomial ℤ} {d : ℕ} (h : muCoeff P d ≠ 0) : d % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [muCoeff] at h
  split_ifs at h with hd
  · exact Nat.odd_iff.mp hd
  · exact absurd rfl h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.mem_descentsBelow
statement:
theorem mem_descentsBelow {i : B} {v z : W} :
    z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v ↔ cs.BruhatLE z v ∧ ℓ (s i * z) < ℓ z
proof:
:= by
  simp [descentsBelow]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isKLElement_klStep
proof:
:= by
  have hvl : ℓ (s i * v) = ℓ v + 1 := by
    rcases cs.length_simple_mul v i with h | h <;> omega
  have hV := hz v (cs.bruhatLE_refl v)
  have hvw : cs.BruhatLE v (s i * v) := cs.bruhatLE_simple_mul (by
    rw [CoxeterSystem.not_isLeftDescent_iff]; omega)
  have hS : ∀ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v, cs.BruhatLE z v ∧ ℓ (s i * z) < ℓ z := fun z hz' ↦
    mem_descentsBelow.mp hz'
  
  have hμ : ∀ z, muCoeff (Pz v z) (ℓ v - ℓ z) ≠ 0 →
      ℓ (s i * v) = ℓ z + 2 * ((ℓ (s i * v) - ℓ z) / 2) ∧ ℓ z < ℓ v := by
    intro z hz'
    have := muCoeff_ne_zero hz'
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [klStep, map_sub, map_mul, map_sum, barL_klSimple, hV.barL_eq]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z hz' ↦ ?_
    rw [map_zsmul, (hz z (hS z hz').1).barL_eq]
  · 
    intro y
    rw [klStep, map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
      toFinsupp_klSimple_mul_apply, klStepPoly, map_sub, map_sum, mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    · rw [hV.toFinsupp_apply, hV.toFinsupp_apply]
      have e : (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ (s i * v) : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) =
          LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ v : ℤ)) := by
        rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add, hvl]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      split_ifs <;> simp only [map_add, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_X] <;> rw [e] <;> ring
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z hz' ↦ ?_
      rw [map_zsmul, Finsupp.smul_apply, (hz z (hS z hz').1).toFinsupp_apply]
      exact zsmul_T_mul_aeval (fun h ↦ (hμ z h).1) _
  · 
    rw [klStepPoly, CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left, ite_eq_left (by omega), hV.self,
      hV.eq_zero_of_length_lt (by omega), mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, sub_zero]
    intro z hz'
    rw [(hz z (hS z hz').1).eq_zero_of_length_lt (by have := (hS z hz').1.length_le; omega),
      mul_zero]
  · 
    intro y hy
    by_contra hyw
    apply hy
    have h1 : ∀ z, cs.BruhatLE z v → Pz z y = 0 := fun z hz' ↦
      (hz z hz').eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE fun h ↦ hyw ((h.trans hz').trans hvw)
    have h2 : Pz v (s i * y) = 0 := hV.eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE fun h ↦ by
      rcases h.simple_mul_or i with h' | h' <;>
        rw [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at h'
      · exact hyw (h'.trans hvw)
      · exact hyw h'
    rw [klStepPoly, h1 v (cs.bruhatLE_refl v), h2, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · simp
    · intro z hz'
      rw [h1 z (hS z hz').1, mul_zero]
  · 
    intro y hy k hk
    
    have hterm : ∀ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v, z ≠ y →
        (Polynomial.C (muCoeff (Pz v z) (ℓ v - ℓ z)) *
          Polynomial.X ^ ((ℓ (s i * v) - ℓ z) / 2) * Pz z y).coeff k = 0 := by
      intro z hz' hzy
      rw [mul_assoc, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul']
      by_cases hμz : muCoeff (Pz v z) (ℓ v - ℓ z) = 0
      · rw [hμz, zero_mul]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hμ z hμz
      split_ifs with hm
      · rw [(hz z (hS z hz').1).coeff_eq_zero (Ne.symm hzy) (by omega), mul_zero]
      · rw [mul_zero]
    rw [klStepPoly, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    split_ifs with hy'
    · 
      have hyv : y ≠ v := by rintro rfl; omega
      have hsyv : s i * y ≠ v := by
        rintro rfl
        exact hy (by rw [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left])
      have hsyl : ℓ (s i * y) + 1 = ℓ y := by
        rcases cs.length_simple_mul y i with h | h <;> omega
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_add, hV.coeff_eq_zero hsyv (by omega), zero_add]
      by_cases hyS : y ∈ descentsBelow cs i v
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem y hyS fun z hz' hzy ↦ hterm z hz' hzy,
          (hz y (hS y hyS).1).self, mul_one, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
        have hyl := (hS y hyS).1.length_le
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul]
        by_cases hk' : ℓ v ≤ 2 * k + ℓ y
        · rw [hV.coeff_eq_zero hyv hk']
          split_ifs with he
          · by_cases hμy : muCoeff (Pz v y) (ℓ v - ℓ y) = 0
            · rw [hμy, mul_one, sub_zero]
            · have := hμ y hμy
              omega
          · rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
        · have hodd : Odd (ℓ v - ℓ y) := Nat.odd_iff.mpr (by omega)
          rw [ite_eq_left (by omega), mul_one, muCoeff, ite_eq_left hodd,
            show (ℓ v - ℓ y) / 2 = k by omega, sub_self]
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun z hz' ↦ hterm z hz' fun h ↦ hyS (h ▸ hz'), sub_zero]
        have hyv' : ¬cs.BruhatLE y v := fun h ↦ hyS (mem_descentsBelow.mpr ⟨h, hy'⟩)
        rw [hV.eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE hyv', mul_zero, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
    · 
      have hyS : y ∉ descentsBelow cs i v := fun h ↦ hy' (hS y h).2
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun z hz' ↦ hterm z hz' fun h ↦ hyS (h ▸ hz'), sub_zero,
        Polynomial.coeff_add]
      have hsyv : s i * y ≠ v := by
        rintro rfl
        exact hy (by rw [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left])
      have hsyl : ℓ (s i * y) = ℓ y + 1 := by
        rcases cs.length_simple_mul y i with h | h <;> omega
      have e1 : (Pz v y).coeff k = 0 := by
        rcases eq_or_ne y v with rfl | hyv
        · rw [hV.self, Polynomial.coeff_one, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
        · exact hV.coeff_eq_zero hyv (by omega)
      rw [e1, add_zero]
      rcases k with _ | k
      · exact Polynomial.coeff_X_mul_zero _
      · rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul, hV.coeff_eq_zero hsyv (by omega)]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.exists_isKLElement
statement: theorem exists_isKLElement (w : W) : ∃ C P, IsKLElement cs w C P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hn : ℓ w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing w with
  | _ n ih =>
  subst hn
  rcases eq_or_ne w 1 with rfl | hw
  · exact ⟨1, _, isKLElement_one cs⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw
  rw [CoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_iff] at hi
  have hv : ℓ (s i * w) < ℓ (s i * (s i * w)) := by
    rw [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; omega
  have key : ∀ z, ∃ (C : 𝓗) (P : W → Polynomial ℤ),
      cs.BruhatLE z (s i * w) → IsKLElement cs z C P := by
    intro z
    by_cases h : cs.BruhatLE z (s i * w)
    · obtain ⟨C, P, hCP⟩ := ih (ℓ z) (by have := h.length_le; omega) z rfl
      exact ⟨C, P, fun _ ↦ hCP⟩
    · exact ⟨0, 0, fun h' ↦ absurd h' h⟩
  choose Cz Pz hz using key
  have := isKLElement_klStep hv hz
  rw [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at this
  exact ⟨_, _, this⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isKLElement_klBasis
statement: theorem isKLElement_klBasis (w : W) : IsKLElement cs w (klBasis cs w) (klPoly cs · w)
proof:
:=
  (exists_isKLElement cs w).choose_spec.choose_spec

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.IsKLElement.eq_klBasis
statement:
theorem IsKLElement.eq_klBasis {w : W} {C : 𝓗} {P : W → Polynomial ℤ}
    (h : IsKLElement cs w C P) : C = klBasis cs w ∧ P = (klPoly cs · w)
proof:
:=
  h.unique (isKLElement_klBasis cs w)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_klBasis
statement: theorem barL_klBasis (w : W) : barL cs (klBasis cs w) = klBasis cs w
proof:
:=
  (isKLElement_klBasis cs w).barL_eq

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_klBasis_apply
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_klBasis_apply (y w : W) :
    toFinsupp cs _ (klBasis cs w) y = LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ w : ℤ)) *
      Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2) (klPoly cs y w)
proof:
:=
  (isKLElement_klBasis cs w).toFinsupp_apply y

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klPoly_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem klPoly_self (w : W) : klPoly cs w w = 1
proof:
:=
  (isKLElement_klBasis cs w).self

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE
statement: theorem klPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE {y w : W} (h : ¬cs.BruhatLE y w) : klPoly cs y w = 0
proof:
:=
  (isKLElement_klBasis cs w).eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bruhatLE_of_klPoly_ne_zero
statement: theorem bruhatLE_of_klPoly_ne_zero {y w : W} (h : klPoly cs y w ≠ 0) : cs.BruhatLE y w
proof:
:=
  (isKLElement_klBasis cs w).bruhatLE h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.coeff_klPoly_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_klPoly_eq_zero {y w : W} (h : y ≠ w) {k : ℕ} (hk : ℓ w ≤ 2 * k + ℓ y) :
    (klPoly cs y w).coeff k = 0
proof:
:=
  (isKLElement_klBasis cs w).coeff_eq_zero h hk

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.two_mul_natDegree_klPoly_add_length_lt
statement:
theorem two_mul_natDegree_klPoly_add_length_lt {y w : W} (hyw : cs.BruhatLE y w) (h : y ≠ w) :
    2 * (klPoly cs y w).natDegree + ℓ y < ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  have hl := hyw.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left h
  have : (klPoly cs y w).natDegree ≤ (ℓ w - ℓ y - 1) / 2 :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr fun N hN ↦
      coeff_klPoly_eq_zero cs h (by omega)
  omega

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.coeff_toFinsupp_klBasis_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_toFinsupp_klBasis_eq_zero {y w : W} (h : y ≠ w) {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n + ℓ y) :
    (toFinsupp cs _ (klBasis cs w) y).coeff n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFinsupp_klBasis_apply]
  exact coeff_T_mul_aeval_T_two_eq_zero fun k hk ↦ coeff_klPoly_eq_zero cs h (by omega)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klBasis_eq_sum
statement:
theorem klBasis_eq_sum (w : W) :
    klBasis cs w = (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ w : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) •
      ∑ y ∈ (cs.finite_setOf_bruhatLE w).toFinset,
        Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (klPoly cs y w) •
          T cs _ y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (toFinsupp cs _).injective
  ext x
  rw [toFinsupp_klBasis_apply, map_smul, map_sum, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  simp_rw [map_smul, toFinsupp_T, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.single_apply,
    mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  split_ifs with hx
  · rfl
  · rw [klPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE cs hx, map_zero]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.existsUnique_klBasis
statement:
theorem existsUnique_klBasis (w : W) : ∃! C : 𝓗, barL cs C = C ∧
    ∃ P : W → Polynomial ℤ,
      C = (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ w : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) •
        ∑ y ∈ (cs.finite_setOf_bruhatLE w).toFinset,
          Polynomial.aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (P y) • T cs _ y ∧
      P w = 1 ∧ ∀ y, cs.BruhatLE y w → y ≠ w → 2 * (P y).natDegree + ℓ y < ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨klBasis cs w, ⟨barL_klBasis cs w, _, klBasis_eq_sum cs w, klPoly_self cs w,
    fun y hyw h ↦ two_mul_natDegree_klPoly_add_length_lt cs hyw h⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro C ⟨hbar, P, hC, hPw, hdeg⟩
  refine (IsKLElement.eq_klBasis (P := fun y ↦ if cs.BruhatLE y w then P y else 0) ?_).1
  refine ⟨hbar, fun x ↦ ?_, by simp [hPw, cs.bruhatLE_refl w], fun {y} hy ↦ ?_,
    fun {y} hy k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [hC, map_smul, map_sum, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    simp_rw [map_smul, toFinsupp_T, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.single_apply,
      mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · by_contra h
    simp [h] at hy
  · split_ifs with hyw
    · have := hdeg y hyw hy
      exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)
    · simp

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klBasis_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem klBasis_one : klBasis cs 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ((isKLElement_one cs).eq_klBasis).1.symm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klPoly_one_right
statement:
theorem klPoly_one_right [DecidableEq W] (y : W) :
    klPoly cs y 1 = if y = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrFun ((isKLElement_one cs).eq_klBasis).2 y).symm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klSimple_mul_klBasis
statement:
theorem klSimple_mul_klBasis {i : B} {v : W} (hv : ℓ v < ℓ (s i * v)) :
    klSimple cs i * klBasis cs v = klBasis cs (s i * v) +
      ∑ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v, klMu cs z v • klBasis cs z
proof:
:= by
  have := (isKLElement_klStep hv (Cz := klBasis cs) (Pz := fun z y ↦ klPoly cs y z)
    fun z _ ↦ isKLElement_klBasis cs z).eq_klBasis.1
  rw [← this, klStep]
  simp only [klMu]
  exact (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klPoly_simple_mul
statement:
theorem klPoly_simple_mul {i : B} {v : W} (hv : ℓ v < ℓ (s i * v)) (x : W) :
    klPoly cs x (s i * v) =
      (if ℓ (s i * x) < ℓ x then klPoly cs (s i * x) v + Polynomial.X * klPoly cs x v
        else Polynomial.X * klPoly cs (s i * x) v + klPoly cs x v) -
      ∑ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v, Polynomial.C (klMu cs z v) *
        Polynomial.X ^ ((ℓ (s i * v) - ℓ z) / 2) * klPoly cs x z
proof:
:= by
  have := (isKLElement_klStep hv (Cz := klBasis cs) (Pz := fun z y ↦ klPoly cs y z)
    fun z _ ↦ isKLElement_klBasis cs z).eq_klBasis.2
  exact (congrFun this x).symm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klBasis_simple
statement: theorem klBasis_simple (i : B) : klBasis cs (s i) = klSimple cs i
proof:
:= by
  have h := klSimple_mul_klBasis cs (i := i) (v := 1) (by simp)
  rw [klBasis_one, mul_one, mul_one] at h
  rw [h, left_eq_add]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun z hz ↦ ?_
  have ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_descentsBelow.mp hz
  have := h1.length_le
  simp only [cs.length_one, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, cs.length_eq_zero_iff] at this
  subst this
  simp at h2

name: CoxeterMatrix.IsHeckeFamily.mul_self
statement:
theorem IsHeckeFamily.mul_self {t : B → A} (ht : M.IsHeckeFamily q t) (i : B) :
    t i * t i = (q - 1) • t i + algebraMap R A q
proof:
:= by
  have h := ht.quadratic i
  rw [sub_mul, mul_add, mul_add, mul_one, mul_one, ← Algebra.smul_def] at h
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← h, sub_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: CoxeterMatrix.IsHeckeFamily.map
proof:
:= by simpa using congrArg f (ht.quadratic i)
  braid i j hij hm := by
    have := congrArg f (ht.braid i j hij hm)
    rwa [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map] at this

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isHeckeFamily_T
statement:
theorem isHeckeFamily_T : M.IsHeckeFamily q (fun i ↦ T cs q (s i)) where
  quadratic
proof:
:= T_simple_sub_mul_T_simple_add cs q
  braid i j _ _ := by
    rw [← T_wordProd cs q (cs.isReduced_alternatingWord i j (Or.inr le_rfl)),
      ← T_wordProd cs q (cs.isReduced_alternatingWord j i (Or.inr le_rfl))]
    exact congrArg (T cs q) (cs.wordProd_braidWord_eq i j)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.liftLinear_T
statement: theorem liftLinear_T (t : B → A) (w : W) : liftLinear cs q t (T cs q w) = cs.braidLift t w
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftLinear, toFinsupp_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.liftLinear_mul_T_simple
statement:
theorem liftLinear_mul_T_simple {t : B → A} (ht : M.IsHeckeFamily q t)
    (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (i : B) :
    liftLinear cs q t (h * T cs q (s i)) = liftLinear cs q t h * t i
proof:
:= by
  induction h using induction_on cs q with
  | T w =>
    rcases cs.length_mul_simple w i with hlt | hlt
    · rw [T_mul_T_simple_of_lt cs q (by omega), liftLinear_T, liftLinear_T,
        braidLift_mul_simple ht.braid (cs.not_isRightDescent_iff.mpr hlt)]
    · have hw : cs.braidLift t w = cs.braidLift t (w * s i) * t i := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right (w := w) i]
        refine braidLift_mul_simple ht.braid (cs.not_isRightDescent_iff.mpr ?_)
        rw [cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]
        omega
      rw [T_mul_T_simple_of_lt' cs q (by omega), map_add, map_smul, map_smul, liftLinear_T,
        liftLinear_T, hw, mul_assoc, ht.mul_self, mul_add, mul_smul_comm,
        Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, mul_smul_comm, mul_one]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_mul]
  | smul a x hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hx, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.liftAlgHom_apply
statement:
theorem liftAlgHom_apply (t : B → A) (ht : M.IsHeckeFamily q t) (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    liftAlgHom cs q t ht x = liftLinear cs q t x
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lift_apply_T
statement:
theorem lift_apply_T (t : {t : B → A // M.IsHeckeFamily q t}) {ω : List B}
    (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) : lift cs q A t (T cs q (π ω)) = (ω.map t.1).prod
proof:
:= by
  change liftAlgHom cs q t.1 t.2 _ = _
  rw [liftAlgHom_apply, liftLinear_T, braidLift_wordProd t.2.braid hω]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lift_apply_T_simple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply_T_simple (t : {t : B → A // M.IsHeckeFamily q t}) (i : B) :
    lift cs q A t (T cs q (s i)) = t.1 i
proof:
:=
  congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val ((lift cs q A).left_inv t)) i

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lift_symm_apply
statement:
theorem lift_symm_apply (f : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q →ₐ[R] A) (i : B) :
    ((lift cs q A).symm f).1 i = f (T cs q (s i))
proof: := rfl

name: CoxeterMatrix.HeckeAlgebra.isHeckeFamily_gen
statement:
theorem isHeckeFamily_gen : M.IsHeckeFamily q (gen M q) where
  quadratic i
proof:
:= by
    have := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel R (HeckeRel.quadratic (M := M) (q := q) i)
    simpa [gen] using this
  braid i j hij hm := by
    have := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel R (HeckeRel.braid (q := q) i j hij hm)
    rwa [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map] at this

name: CoxeterMatrix.HeckeAlgebra.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {f g : M.HeckeAlgebra q →ₐ[R] A} (h : ∀ i, f (gen M q i) = g (gen M q i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  RingQuot.ringQuot_ext' R f g (FreeAlgebra.hom_ext (funext h))

name: CoxeterMatrix.HeckeAlgebra.freeAlgebraLift_heckeRel
statement:
theorem freeAlgebraLift_heckeRel {t : B → A} (ht : M.IsHeckeFamily q t) ⦃x y : FreeAlgebra R B⦄
    (h : M.HeckeRel q x y) : FreeAlgebra.lift R t x = FreeAlgebra.lift R t y
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | quadratic i => simpa using ht.quadratic i
  | braid i j hij hm =>
    rw [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map]
    simpa using ht.braid i j hij hm

name: CoxeterMatrix.HeckeAlgebra.lift_apply_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply_gen (t : {t : B → A // M.IsHeckeFamily q t}) (i : B) :
    lift M q A t (gen M q i) = t.1 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, gen, RingQuot.liftAlgHom_mkAlgHom_apply]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.equivHeckeAlgebra_T_simple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivHeckeAlgebra_T_simple (i : B) :
    equivHeckeAlgebra cs q (T cs q (s i)) = CoxeterMatrix.HeckeAlgebra.gen M q i
proof:
:= by
  simp [equivHeckeAlgebra]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.equivHeckeAlgebra_symm_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivHeckeAlgebra_symm_gen (i : B) :
    (equivHeckeAlgebra cs q).symm (CoxeterMatrix.HeckeAlgebra.gen M q i) = T cs q (s i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [equivHeckeAlgebra]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.mapAddHom_smul
statement:
theorem mapAddHom_smul (q' : S) (a : R) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    mapAddHom cs q f q' (a • h) = f a • mapAddHom cs q f q' h
proof:
:= by
  apply (toFinsupp cs q').injective
  ext w
  simp [mapAddHom]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.mapAddHom_T
statement: theorem mapAddHom_T (q' : S) (w : W) : mapAddHom cs q f q' (T cs q w) = T cs q' w
proof:
:= by
  apply (toFinsupp cs q').injective
  simp [mapAddHom, toFinsupp_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.mapAddHom_mul_T_simple
statement:
theorem mapAddHom_mul_T_simple (hq : f q = q') (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (i : B) :
    mapAddHom cs q f q' (h * T cs q (s i)) =
      mapAddHom cs q f q' h * mapAddHom cs q f q' (T cs q (s i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAddHom_T]
  induction h using induction_on cs q with
  | T w =>
    rw [T_mul_T_simple, mapAddHom_T, T_mul_T_simple]
    split_ifs <;> simp [mapAddHom_smul, mapAddHom_T, hq]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_mul]
  | smul a x hx => rw [smul_mul_assoc, mapAddHom_smul, hx, mapAddHom_smul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.map_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_T (hq : f q = q') (w : W) : map cs q f hq (T cs q w) = T cs q' w
proof:
:=
  mapAddHom_T cs q f q' w

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.map_apply_smul
statement:
theorem map_apply_smul (hq : f q = q') (a : R) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    map cs q f hq (a • h) = f a • map cs q f hq h
proof: := mapAddHom_smul cs q f q' a h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_T_of_eq_one
statement: theorem T_mul_T_of_eq_one (x y : W) : T cs (1 : R) x * T cs (1 : R) y = T cs (1 : R) (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using cs.induction_mul_simple with
  | one => simp
  | mul_simple y i _ ih =>
    have key : ∀ w : W, T cs (1 : R) w * T cs 1 (s i) = T cs 1 (w * s i) := fun w ↦ by
      rw [T_mul_T_simple]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [← key, ← mul_assoc, ih, key, mul_assoc]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lift_THom_ofCoeff
statement:
theorem lift_THom_ofCoeff (x : W →₀ R) :
    MonoidAlgebra.lift R (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs (1 : R)) W (THom cs) (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff x) =
      (toFinsupp cs 1).symm x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]
  | single w a =>
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_single, MonoidAlgebra.lift_single, ← smul_single_one,
      _root_.map_smul]
    rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebra_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivMonoidAlgebra_T (w : W) :
    equivMonoidAlgebra cs (T cs (1 : R) w) = MonoidAlgebra.of R W w
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, ← AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  simp [equivMonoidAlgebra, THom]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.eval₂_one_T_two
statement: theorem eval₂_one_T_two : eval₂ (RingHom.id R) 1 (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval₂_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.specializeOne_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem specializeOne_T (w : W) :
    specializeOne cs (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : R[T;T⁻¹]) w) =
      MonoidAlgebra.of R W w
proof:
:= by
  simp [specializeOne]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.specializeOne_smul
statement:
theorem specializeOne_smul (a : R[T;T⁻¹])
    (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : R[T;T⁻¹])) :
    specializeOne cs (a • h) = eval₂ (RingHom.id R) 1 a • specializeOne cs h
proof:
:= by
  simp [specializeOne, map_apply_smul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.specializeOne_surjective
statement: theorem specializeOne_surjective : Function.Surjective (specializeOne (R := R) cs)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (equivMonoidAlgebra cs).surjective x
  induction y using induction_on cs (1 : R) with
  | T w => exact ⟨IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T cs _ w, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + b, by rw [map_add, ha, hb, map_add]⟩
  | smul c x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨C c • a, ?_⟩
    rw [specializeOne_smul, ha, map_smul]
    simp

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_mul_T_simple
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_mul_T_simple (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (i : B) :
    toFinsupp cs q (h * T cs q (s i)) = rightOp cs q i (toFinsupp cs q h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFinsupp_mul_T, ← rightOp_single_one cs q, lmul_apply_rightOp, lmul_apply_single_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightOp_apply
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hx']
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] <;> ring
  | single w a =>
    have hne : ℓ (w * s i) ≠ ℓ w := cs.length_mul_simple_ne w i
    rw [← smul_single_one, map_smul, rightOp_single]
    rcases eq_or_ne y w with rfl | hyw
    · have h1 : y * s i ≠ y := fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
      by_cases hy : ℓ y < ℓ (y * s i)
      · simp [hy, h1, not_lt.mpr hy.le]
      · simp [hy, h1, lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hy) hne, mul_comm]
    rcases eq_or_ne y (w * s i) with rfl | hyws
    · have h2 : w * s i * s i = w := CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right cs i
      by_cases hw : ℓ w < ℓ (w * s i)
      · simp [hw, h2, hyw.symm]
      · simp [hw, h2, hyw, mul_comm]
    · have h3 : y * s i ≠ w := fun h ↦
        hyws (by rw [← h, CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right])
      split_ifs <;> simp [hyw.symm, hyws.symm, h3.symm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.invCoeff_eq_rPoly
statement:
theorem invCoeff_eq_rPoly (y w : W) :
    invCoeff cs hq y w = (-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w) * hq.unit⁻¹.1 ^ ℓ w * rPoly cs hq y w
proof:
:= by
  have e : hq.unit⁻¹.1 * q = 1 := hq.val_inv_mul
  have h1 : ((-1 : R) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w)) * (-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w) = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  have h2 : hq.unit⁻¹.1 ^ ℓ w * q ^ ℓ w = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, e, one_pow]
  rw [rPoly]
  linear_combination (-invCoeff cs hq y w * (hq.unit⁻¹.1 ^ ℓ w * q ^ ℓ w)) * h1 +
    (-invCoeff cs hq y w) * h2

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_TInv_inv_apply
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_TInv_inv_apply (y w : W) :
    toFinsupp cs q (TInv cs hq w⁻¹) y =
      (-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w) * hq.unit⁻¹.1 ^ ℓ w * rPoly cs hq y w
proof:
:=
  invCoeff_eq_rPoly cs hq y w

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.invCoeff_one_right
statement:
theorem invCoeff_one_right [DecidableEq W] (y : W) :
    invCoeff cs hq y 1 = if y = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [invCoeff, inv_one, TInv_one, ← T_one cs q, toFinsupp_T]
  rcases eq_or_ne y 1 with rfl | h
  · simp
  · simp [h]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.invCoeff_mul_simple
statement:
theorem invCoeff_mul_simple {w : W} {i : B} (hlt : ℓ w < ℓ (w * s i)) (y : W) :
    invCoeff cs hq y (w * s i) = if ℓ (y * s i) < ℓ y then hq.unit⁻¹.1 * invCoeff cs hq (y * s i) w
      else invCoeff cs hq (y * s i) w - (1 - hq.unit⁻¹.1) * invCoeff cs hq y w
proof:
:= by
  have e : hq.unit⁻¹.1 * q = 1 := hq.val_inv_mul
  have hlen : ℓ (s i * w⁻¹) = ℓ (s i) + ℓ w⁻¹ := by
    have : s i * w⁻¹ = (w * s i)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_inv_rev, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple]
    rw [this, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv, cs.length_simple]
    rcases cs.length_mul_simple w i with h | h <;> omega
  rw [invCoeff, mul_inv_rev, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple, TInv_mul cs hq hlen, TInv_simple]
  simp only [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, map_sub, map_smul, toFinsupp_mul_T_simple,
    Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, rightOp_apply, smul_eq_mul, invCoeff]
  split_ifs
  · linear_combination (toFinsupp cs q (TInv cs hq w⁻¹) y) * e
  · linear_combination (toFinsupp cs q (TInv cs hq w⁻¹) (y * s i)) * e

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rPoly_mul_simple
statement:
theorem rPoly_mul_simple {w : W} {i : B} (hlt : ℓ w < ℓ (w * s i)) (y : W) :
    rPoly cs hq y (w * s i) = if ℓ (y * s i) < ℓ y then rPoly cs hq (y * s i) w
      else (q - 1) * rPoly cs hq y w + q * rPoly cs hq (y * s i) w
proof:
:= by
  have e : hq.unit⁻¹.1 * q = 1 := hq.val_inv_mul
  have hw : ℓ (w * s i) = ℓ w + 1 := by
    rcases cs.length_mul_simple w i with h | h <;> omega
  simp only [rPoly, invCoeff_mul_simple cs hq hlt, hw]
  split_ifs with hy
  · have hy' : ℓ y = ℓ (y * s i) + 1 := by
      rcases cs.length_mul_simple y i with h | h <;> omega
    rw [hy']
    linear_combination ((-1) ^ (ℓ (y * s i) + ℓ w) * q ^ ℓ w * invCoeff cs hq (y * s i) w) * e
  · have hy' : ℓ (y * s i) = ℓ y + 1 := by
      rcases cs.length_mul_simple y i with h | h <;> omega
    rw [hy']
    linear_combination (-(-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w) * q ^ ℓ w * invCoeff cs hq y w) * e

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rPoly_of_length_mul_simple_lt
proof:
:= by
  have := rPoly_mul_simple cs hq (w := w * s i) (i := i)
    (by rwa [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right]) y
  rwa [CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] at this

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rPoly_one_right
statement: theorem rPoly_one_right [DecidableEq W] (y : W) : rPoly cs hq y 1 = if y = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rPoly, invCoeff_one_right]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · simp

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.invCoeff_self
statement: theorem invCoeff_self (w : W) : invCoeff cs hq w w = hq.unit⁻¹.1 ^ ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction w using cs.induction_mul_simple with
  | one => simp [invCoeff_one_right]
  | mul_simple w i hlt ih =>
    have hw : ℓ (w * s i) = ℓ w + 1 := by
      rcases cs.length_mul_simple w i with h | h <;> omega
    rw [invCoeff_mul_simple cs hq hlt, CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_right,
      ite_eq_left (by omega), ih, hw, pow_succ, mul_comm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rPoly_self
statement: theorem rPoly_self (w : W) : rPoly cs hq w w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have e : hq.unit⁻¹.1 * q = 1 := hq.val_inv_mul
  rw [rPoly, invCoeff_self, ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul, ← mul_pow,
    mul_comm, e, one_pow]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.subwordSpan_mono
statement:
theorem subwordSpan_mono {ω ω' : List B} (h : ω'.Sublist ω) :
    subwordSpan cs (q := q) ω' ≤ subwordSpan cs ω
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun _ h' ↦ List.Sublist.trans h' h)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_simple_mul_mem_subwordSpan
statement:
theorem T_simple_mul_mem_subwordSpan (i : B) {ω : List B} {h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q}
    (hh : h ∈ subwordSpan cs ω) : T cs q (s i) * h ∈ subwordSpan cs (i :: ω)
proof:
:= by
  induction hh using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩ := hx
    have h1 : T cs q (cs.wordProd ω') ∈ subwordSpan cs (q := q) (i :: ω) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨ω', List.Sublist.cons i hω', rfl⟩
    have h2 : T cs q (s i * cs.wordProd ω') ∈ subwordSpan cs (q := q) (i :: ω) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨i :: ω', List.Sublist.cons_cons i hω', by simp [cs.wordProd_cons]⟩
    rw [T_simple_mul_T]
    split_ifs
    · exact h2
    · exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h1) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.prod_TInv_mem_subwordSpan
statement:
theorem prod_TInv_mem_subwordSpan (ω : List B) :
    (ω.map fun i ↦ TInv cs hq (s i)).prod ∈ subwordSpan cs ω
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨[], List.Sublist.slnil, by simp⟩
  | cons i ω ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, TInv_simple, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc,
      one_mul]
    exact sub_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (T_simple_mul_mem_subwordSpan cs i ih))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (subwordSpan_mono (List.sublist_cons_self i ω) ih))

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.TInv_wordProd_inv
statement:
theorem TInv_wordProd_inv {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) :
    TInv cs hq (cs.wordProd ω)⁻¹ = (ω.map fun i ↦ TInv cs hq (s i)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih =>
    have hω' : cs.IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.drop 1
    have hlen : ℓ ((cs.wordProd ω)⁻¹ * s i) = ℓ (cs.wordProd ω)⁻¹ + ℓ (s i) := by
      have := hω.eq
      rw [cs.wordProd_cons, List.length_cons] at this
      have e1 : (cs.wordProd ω)⁻¹ * s i = (s i * cs.wordProd ω)⁻¹ := by
        rw [mul_inv_rev, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple]
      rw [e1, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv, this, hω'.eq, cs.length_simple]
    rw [cs.wordProd_cons, mul_inv_rev, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple, ← CoxeterSystem.inv_simple cs i,
      TInv_mul cs hq (by rwa [CoxeterSystem.inv_simple]), CoxeterSystem.inv_simple, ih hω',
      List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.exists_sublist_of_invCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_sublist_of_invCoeff_ne_zero {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {y : W}
    (hy : invCoeff cs hq y (cs.wordProd ω) ≠ 0) : ∃ ω', ω'.Sublist ω ∧ cs.wordProd ω' = y
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := prod_TInv_mem_subwordSpan cs hq ω
  rw [← TInv_wordProd_inv cs hq hω] at hmem
  have key : ∀ h ∈ subwordSpan cs (q := q) ω, toFinsupp cs q h ∈
      Finsupp.supported R R (cs.wordProd '' {ω' | ω'.Sublist ω}) := by
    intro h hh
    induction hh using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [toFinsupp_T]
      exact Finsupp.single_mem_supported R _ ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
  have := (Finsupp.mem_supported R _).mp (key _ hmem) (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hy)
  obtain ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩ := this
  exact ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.exists_sublist_of_rPoly_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_sublist_of_rPoly_ne_zero {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) {y : W}
    (hy : rPoly cs hq y (cs.wordProd ω) ≠ 0) : ∃ ω', ω'.Sublist ω ∧ cs.wordProd ω' = y
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_sublist_of_invCoeff_ne_zero cs hq hω fun h ↦ hy ?_
  rw [rPoly, h, mul_zero]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.length_le_of_rPoly_ne_zero
statement: theorem length_le_of_rPoly_ne_zero {y w : W} (hy : rPoly cs hq y w ≠ 0) : ℓ y ≤ ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  obtain ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩ := exists_sublist_of_rPoly_ne_zero cs hq hω hy
  exact (cs.length_wordProd_le ω').trans (hω'.length_le.trans hω.eq.ge)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.eq_of_rPoly_ne_zero_of_length_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_rPoly_ne_zero_of_length_eq {y w : W} (hy : rPoly cs hq y w ≠ 0)
    (hl : ℓ y = ℓ w) : y = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  obtain ⟨ω', hω', rfl⟩ := exists_sublist_of_rPoly_ne_zero cs hq hω hy
  have h1 := cs.length_wordProd_le ω'
  have h2 := hω'.length_le
  rw [hω'.eq_of_length (by rw [hω.eq] at hl; omega)]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.exists_rPoly_eq_aeval_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem exists_rPoly_eq_aeval_natDegree_le (y w : W) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℤ, rPoly cs hq y w = Polynomial.aeval q p ∧
      p.natDegree ≤ ℓ w - ℓ y ∧ (ℓ w < ℓ y → p = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction w using cs.induction_mul_simple generalizing y with
  | one =>
    refine ⟨if y = 1 then 1 else 0, by rw [rPoly_one_right]; split_ifs <;> simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · intro h
      have hy : y ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; simp at h
      simp [hy]
  | mul_simple w i hlt ih =>
    have hw : ℓ (w * s i) = ℓ w + 1 := by
      rcases cs.length_mul_simple w i with h | h <;> omega
    rw [rPoly_mul_simple cs hq hlt]
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd, hp0⟩ := ih y
    obtain ⟨p', hp', hpd', hp0'⟩ := ih (y * s i)
    split_ifs with hy
    · have hy' : ℓ y = ℓ (y * s i) + 1 := by
        rcases cs.length_mul_simple y i with h | h <;> omega
      exact ⟨p', hp', by omega, fun h ↦ hp0' (by omega)⟩
    · have hy' : ℓ (y * s i) = ℓ y + 1 := by
        rcases cs.length_mul_simple y i with h | h <;> omega
      refine ⟨(Polynomial.X - 1) * p + Polynomial.X * p', by simp [hp, hp'], ?_, ?_⟩
      · by_cases hyw : ℓ w < ℓ y
        · simp [hp0 hyw, hp0' (by omega)]
        have h1 : ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) - 1).natDegree ≤ 1 :=
          (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (by simp)
        have h2 := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le (p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) - 1) (q := p)
        have h3 := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le (p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ)) (q := p')
        have h4 := Polynomial.natDegree_add_le ((Polynomial.X - 1) * p) (Polynomial.X * p')
        have h5 : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ).natDegree ≤ 1 := Polynomial.natDegree_X_le
        omega
      · intro h
        simp [hp0 (by omega), hp0' (by omega)]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.exists_rPoly_eq_aeval
statement:
theorem exists_rPoly_eq_aeval (y w : W) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℤ, rPoly cs hq y w = Polynomial.aeval q p
proof:
:=
  (exists_rPoly_eq_aeval_natDegree_le cs hq y w).imp fun _ h ↦ h.1

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_bar_T_apply
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_bar_T_apply (y w : W) :
    toFinsupp cs q (bar cs σ hσ (T cs q w)) y = (-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w) * σ q ^ ℓ w *
      rPoly cs (isUnit_of_mul_eq_one' σ hσ) y w
proof:
:= by
  rw [bar_T, toFinsupp_TInv_inv_apply, val_inv_eq σ hσ]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftOp_single
statement:
theorem leftOp_single (i : B) (w : W) : leftOp cs q i (single w 1) =
    if ℓ w < ℓ (s i * w) then single (s i * w) 1
    else (q - 1) • single w 1 + q • single (s i * w) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftOp]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightOp_single
statement:
theorem rightOp_single (i : B) (w : W) : rightOp cs q i (single w 1) =
    if ℓ w < ℓ (w * s i) then single (w * s i) 1
    else (q - 1) • single w 1 + q • single (w * s i) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightOp]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftOp_single_one
statement: theorem leftOp_single_one (i : B) : leftOp cs q i (single 1 1) = single (s i) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftOp_single]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightOp_single_one
statement: theorem rightOp_single_one (i : B) : rightOp cs q i (single 1 1) = single (s i) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightOp_single]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftOp_mul_rightOp
statement:
theorem leftOp_mul_rightOp (i j : B) :
    leftOp cs q i * rightOp cs q j = rightOp cs q j * leftOp cs q i
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun w ↦ LinearMap.ext_ring ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, lsingle_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
  have hL := cs.length_simple_mul w i
  have hR := cs.length_mul_simple w j
  have hLR := cs.length_mul_simple (s i * w) j
  have hRL := cs.length_simple_mul (w * s j) i
  rw [← mul_assoc] at hRL
  by_cases c1 : ℓ w < ℓ (w * s j) <;> by_cases c2 : ℓ (w * s j) < ℓ (s i * w * s j) <;>
  by_cases c3 : ℓ w < ℓ (s i * w) <;> by_cases c4 : ℓ (s i * w) < ℓ (s i * w * s j) <;>
  simp only [leftOp_single, rightOp_single, map_add, map_smul, ← mul_assoc, c1, c2, c3, c4,
    ite_true, ite_false] <;>
  first
  | omega
  | module
  | rw [cs.simple_mul_eq_mul_simple (i := i) (j := j) (w := w) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.heckeOps_apply_rightOp
statement:
theorem heckeOps_apply_rightOp {f : Module.End R (W →₀ R)} (hf : f ∈ heckeOps cs q) (i : B)
    (x : W →₀ R) : f (rightOp cs q i x) = rightOp cs q i (f x)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (hf i) x

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftOp_mem_heckeOps
statement: theorem leftOp_mem_heckeOps (i : B) : leftOp cs q i ∈ heckeOps cs q
proof:
:=
  fun j ↦ leftOp_mul_rightOp cs q i j

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.one_mem_heckeOps
statement: theorem one_mem_heckeOps : (1 : Module.End R (W →₀ R)) ∈ heckeOps cs q
proof: := fun i ↦ by simp

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.mul_mem_heckeOps
statement:
theorem mul_mem_heckeOps {f g : Module.End R (W →₀ R)} (hf : f ∈ heckeOps cs q)
    (hg : g ∈ heckeOps cs q) : f * g ∈ heckeOps cs q
proof:
:= fun i ↦ by
  rw [mul_assoc, hg i, ← mul_assoc, hf i, mul_assoc]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.eq_of_mem_heckeOps
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_heckeOps {f g : Module.End R (W →₀ R)} (hf : f ∈ heckeOps cs q)
    (hg : g ∈ heckeOps cs q) (h : f (single 1 1) = g (single 1 1)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ w : W, f (single w 1) = g (single w 1) := by
    intro w
    induction w using cs.induction_mul_simple with
    | one => exact h
    | mul_simple w i hlt ih =>
      have : single (w * s i) (1 : R) = rightOp cs q i (single w 1) := by
        rw [rightOp_single, ite_eq_left hlt]
      rw [this, heckeOps_apply_rightOp hf, heckeOps_apply_rightOp hg, ih]
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun w c ↦ ?_
  rw [← smul_single_one, map_smul, map_smul, key]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.evalOne_bijective
statement: theorem evalOne_bijective : Function.Bijective (evalOne cs q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun f g h ↦ Subtype.ext (eq_of_mem_heckeOps f.2 g.2 h), ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ w : W, single w (1 : R) ∈ LinearMap.range (evalOne cs q) := by
    intro w
    induction w using cs.induction_simple_mul with
    | one => exact ⟨⟨1, one_mem_heckeOps cs q⟩, rfl⟩
    | simple_mul w i hlt ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨⟨leftOp cs q i * f.1, mul_mem_heckeOps (leftOp_mem_heckeOps cs q i) f.2⟩, ?_⟩
      change leftOp cs q i (evalOne cs q f) = _
      rw [hf, leftOp_single, ite_eq_left hlt]
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy
  | single w c =>
    rw [← smul_single_one]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (key w)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lmul_mem
statement: theorem lmul_mem (x : W →₀ R) : lmul cs q x ∈ heckeOps cs q
proof:
:=
  ((LinearEquiv.ofBijective (evalOne cs q) (evalOne_bijective cs q)).symm x).2

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lmul_apply_single_one
statement: theorem lmul_apply_single_one (x : W →₀ R) : lmul cs q x (single 1 1) = x
proof:
:=
  (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (evalOne cs q) (evalOne_bijective cs q)).apply_symm_apply x

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lmul_apply_rightOp
statement:
theorem lmul_apply_rightOp (x : W →₀ R) (i : B) (y : W →₀ R) :
    lmul cs q x (rightOp cs q i y) = rightOp cs q i (lmul cs q x y)
proof:
:=
  heckeOps_apply_rightOp (lmul_mem cs q x) i y

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lmul_eq
statement:
theorem lmul_eq {f : Module.End R (W →₀ R)} (hf : f ∈ heckeOps cs q) :
    lmul cs q (f (single 1 1)) = f
proof:
:=
  eq_of_mem_heckeOps (lmul_mem cs q _) hf (lmul_apply_single_one cs q _)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lmul_single_one
statement: theorem lmul_single_one : lmul cs q (single 1 1) = 1
proof: := lmul_eq (one_mem_heckeOps cs q)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lmul_single_simple
statement: theorem lmul_single_simple (i : B) : lmul cs q (single (s i) 1) = leftOp cs q i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lmul_eq (leftOp_mem_heckeOps cs q i), leftOp_single_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.lmul_lmul
statement: theorem lmul_lmul (x y : W →₀ R) : lmul cs q (lmul cs q x y) = lmul cs q x * lmul cs q y
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← lmul_apply_single_one cs q y]
  exact lmul_eq (mul_mem_heckeOps (lmul_mem cs q x) (lmul_mem cs q y))

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.mul_def
statement:
theorem mul_def (x y : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    x * y = (toFinsupp cs q).symm (lmul cs q (toFinsupp cs q x) (toFinsupp cs q y))
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_mul
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_mul (x y : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    toFinsupp cs q (x * y) = lmul cs q (toFinsupp cs q x) (toFinsupp cs q y)
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_one
statement: theorem toFinsupp_one : toFinsupp cs q 1 = single 1 1
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.basis_apply
statement: theorem basis_apply (w : W) : basis cs q w = T cs q w
proof: := by simp [basis, T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_T
statement: theorem toFinsupp_T (w : W) : toFinsupp cs q (T cs q w) = single w 1
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.basis_repr_apply
statement:
theorem basis_repr_apply (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    (basis cs q).repr h = toFinsupp cs q h
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_one : T cs q 1 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_T_mul
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_T_mul (w : W) (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    toFinsupp cs q (T cs q w * x) = lmul cs q (single w 1) (toFinsupp cs q x)
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_mul_T
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_mul_T (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (w : W) :
    toFinsupp cs q (x * T cs q w) = lmul cs q (toFinsupp cs q x) (single w 1)
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_simple_mul_T
proof:
:= by
  apply (toFinsupp cs q).injective
  rw [toFinsupp_T_mul, lmul_single_simple, toFinsupp_T, leftOp_single]
  split_ifs <;> simp [toFinsupp_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_T_simple
proof:
:= by
  apply (toFinsupp cs q).injective
  rw [toFinsupp_mul_T, toFinsupp_T, ← rightOp_single_one cs q, lmul_apply_rightOp,
    lmul_apply_single_one, rightOp_single]
  split_ifs <;> simp [toFinsupp_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_simple_mul_T_of_lt
statement:
theorem T_simple_mul_T_of_lt {i : B} {w : W} (h : ℓ w < ℓ (s i * w)) :
    T cs q (s i) * T cs q w = T cs q (s i * w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_simple_mul_T, ite_eq_left h]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_T_simple_of_lt
statement:
theorem T_mul_T_simple_of_lt {w : W} {i : B} (h : ℓ w < ℓ (w * s i)) :
    T cs q w * T cs q (s i) = T cs q (w * s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_mul_T_simple, ite_eq_left h]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_simple_mul_T_of_lt'
statement:
theorem T_simple_mul_T_of_lt' {i : B} {w : W} (h : ℓ (s i * w) < ℓ w) :
    T cs q (s i) * T cs q w = (q - 1) • T cs q w + q • T cs q (s i * w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_simple_mul_T, ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_T_simple_of_lt'
statement:
theorem T_mul_T_simple_of_lt' {w : W} {i : B} (h : ℓ (w * s i) < ℓ w) :
    T cs q w * T cs q (s i) = (q - 1) • T cs q w + q • T cs q (w * s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_mul_T_simple, ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_T
statement: theorem T_mul_T {x y : W} (h : ℓ (x * y) = ℓ x + ℓ y) : T cs q x * T cs q y = T cs q (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using cs.induction_mul_simple generalizing x with
  | one => simp
  | mul_simple y i hlt ih =>
    have h1 := cs.length_mul_le (x * y) (s i)
    have h2 := cs.length_mul_le x y
    have h3 := cs.length_mul_simple y i
    rw [cs.length_simple, ← mul_assoc] at *
    have hxy : ℓ (x * y) = ℓ x + ℓ y := by omega
    rw [← T_mul_T_simple_of_lt cs q hlt, ← mul_assoc, ih hxy, T_mul_T_simple_of_lt cs q (by omega)]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_simple_mul_self
statement:
theorem T_simple_mul_self (i : B) :
    T cs q (s i) * T cs q (s i) = (q - 1) • T cs q (s i) + algebraMap R _ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_simple_mul_T_of_lt' cs q (by simp), CoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_self, T_one,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_simple_sub_mul_T_simple_add
statement:
theorem T_simple_sub_mul_T_simple_add (i : B) :
    (T cs q (s i) - algebraMap R _ q) * (T cs q (s i) + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul, mul_add, mul_add, T_simple_mul_self, mul_one, mul_one, ← Algebra.smul_def,
    sub_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_simple_mul_inv
statement:
theorem T_simple_mul_inv (hq : IsUnit q) (i : B) :
    T cs q (s i) * (hq.unit⁻¹.1 • T cs q (s i) - (1 - hq.unit⁻¹.1) • 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have e : hq.unit⁻¹.1 * q = 1 := hq.val_inv_mul
  have e' : hq.unit⁻¹.1 * (q - 1) = 1 - hq.unit⁻¹.1 := by rw [mul_sub, e, mul_one]
  rw [mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, T_simple_mul_self, mul_smul_comm, mul_one,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, e, e', one_smul]
  abel

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inv_mul_T_simple
statement:
theorem inv_mul_T_simple (hq : IsUnit q) (i : B) :
    (hq.unit⁻¹.1 • T cs q (s i) - (1 - hq.unit⁻¹.1) • 1) * T cs q (s i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul]
  rw [← T_simple_mul_inv cs q hq i, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, mul_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isUnit_T_simple
statement: theorem isUnit_T_simple (hq : IsUnit q) (i : B) : IsUnit (T cs q (s i))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨_, _, T_simple_mul_inv cs q hq i, inv_mul_T_simple cs q hq i⟩, rfl⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isUnit_T
statement: theorem isUnit_T (hq : IsUnit q) (w : W) : IsUnit (T cs q w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using cs.induction_simple_mul with
  | one => simp
  | simple_mul w i hlt ih =>
    rw [← T_simple_mul_T_of_lt cs q hlt]
    exact (isUnit_T_simple cs q hq i).mul ih

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_wordProd
statement:
theorem T_wordProd {ω : List B} (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) :
    T cs q (cs.wordProd ω) = (ω.map fun i ↦ T cs q (s i)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction ω with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i ω ih =>
    have hω' : cs.IsReduced ω := by simpa using hω.drop 1
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ← ih hω', cs.wordProd_cons, T_mul_T]
    have := hω.eq
    rw [cs.wordProd_cons] at this
    rw [this, hω'.eq, cs.length_simple, List.length_cons]
    ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {p : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q → Prop} (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q)
    (T : ∀ w, p (T cs q w)) (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y))
    (smul : ∀ (a : R) x, p x → p (a • x)) : p h
proof:
:= by
  have hh : h ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (basis cs q)) := by
    rw [Basis.span_eq]; trivial
  induction hh using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hx; exact T w
  | zero => simpa using smul 0 (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T cs q 1) (T 1)
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact add x y hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => exact smul a x hx

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.adjoin_T_simple
statement:
theorem adjoin_T_simple :
    Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range fun i ↦ T cs q (s i)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro h -
  induction h using induction_on cs q with
  | T w =>
    induction w using cs.induction_simple_mul with
    | one => rw [T_one]; exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
    | simple_mul w i hlt ih =>
      rw [← T_simple_mul_T_of_lt cs q hlt]
      exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩) ih
  | add x y hx hy => exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul a x hx => exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hx a

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.algHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem algHom_ext {A : Type*} [Semiring A] [Algebra R A]
    {f g : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q →ₐ[R] A} (h : ∀ i, f (T cs q (s i)) = g (T cs q (s i))) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (adjoin_T_simple cs q) <| by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact h i

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.map_mul_of_map_mul_T_simple
statement:
theorem map_mul_of_map_mul_T_simple {S A : Type*} [CommRing S] [Ring A] [Algebra S A]
    (σ : R →+* S) (φ : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q →+ A)
    (hsmul : ∀ (a : R) h, φ (a • h) = σ a • φ h) (hone : φ 1 = 1)
    (hT : ∀ h i, φ (h * T cs q (s i)) = φ h * φ (T cs q (s i)))
    (x y : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) : φ (x * y) = φ x * φ y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on cs q generalizing x with
  | T w =>
    induction w using cs.induction_mul_simple generalizing x with
    | one => simp [hone]
    | mul_simple w i hlt ih =>
      rw [← T_mul_T_simple_of_lt cs q hlt, ← mul_assoc, hT, ih, hT, mul_assoc]
  | add y z hy hz => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add, mul_add]
  | smul a y hy => rw [mul_smul_comm, hsmul, hy, hsmul, mul_smul_comm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isHeckeFamily_T_restrict
statement:
theorem isHeckeFamily_T_restrict :
    (M.restrict J).IsHeckeFamily q (fun j : J ↦ T cs q (s j)) where
  quadratic j
proof:
:= T_simple_sub_mul_T_simple_add cs q j
  braid i j hij hm := by
    have e : ∀ a b : J, ((braidWord (M.restrict J) a b).map fun k : J ↦ T cs q (s k)) =
        (braidWord M a b).map fun k ↦ T cs q (s k) := fun a b ↦ by
      rw [braidWord, braidWord, ← map_alternatingWord Subtype.val, List.map_map]
      rfl
    rw [e, e]
    exact (isHeckeFamily_T cs q).braid i j (fun h ↦ hij (Subtype.ext h)) hm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicHom_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parabolicHom_T (w : cs.parabolicSubgroup J) :
    parabolicHom cs q J (T _ q w) = T cs q (w : W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, rfl⟩ := (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).exists_isReduced w
  have hred : cs.IsReduced (η.map Subtype.val) := by
    unfold CoxeterSystem.IsReduced
    rw [← coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_wordProd, ← length_parabolicCoxeterSystem, hη.eq,
      List.length_map]
  rw [parabolicHom, lift_apply_T _ hη, coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_wordProd, T_wordProd cs q hred,
    List.map_map]
  rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_parabolicHom
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_parabolicHom (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q) :
    toFinsupp cs q (parabolicHom cs q J x) = Finsupp.mapDomain Subtype.val (toFinsupp _ q x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on _ q with
  | T w => rw [parabolicHom_T, toFinsupp_T, toFinsupp_T, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_add]
  | smul a x hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hx, map_smul, Finsupp.mapDomain_smul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicHom_injective
statement: theorem parabolicHom_injective : Function.Injective (parabolicHom cs q J)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have := congrArg (toFinsupp cs q) h
  rw [toFinsupp_parabolicHom, toFinsupp_parabolicHom] at this
  exact (toFinsupp _ q).injective (Finsupp.mapDomain_injective Subtype.val_injective this)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.range_parabolicHom
statement:
theorem range_parabolicHom :
    LinearMap.range (parabolicHom cs q J).toLinearMap =
      Submodule.span R (Set.range fun w : cs.parabolicSubgroup J ↦ T cs q (w : W))
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← (basis _ q).span_eq, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 2
  funext w
  simp [basis_apply]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolic_smul_def
statement:
theorem parabolic_smul_def (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q)
    (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) : h • x = parabolicHom cs q J h * x
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolic_op_smul_def
statement:
theorem parabolic_op_smul_def (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q)
    (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) : op h • x = x * parabolicHom cs q J h
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_T_of_mem_minCosetReps
statement:
theorem T_mul_T_of_mem_minCosetReps {d v : W} (hd : d ∈ cs.minCosetReps J)
    (hv : v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) : T cs q d * T cs q v = T cs q (d * v)
proof:
:=
  T_mul_T cs q (length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hd hv)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_mul_T_inv_of_mem_minCosetReps
statement:
theorem T_mul_T_inv_of_mem_minCosetReps {d v : W} (hd : d ∈ cs.minCosetReps J)
    (hv : v ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) : T cs q v * T cs q d⁻¹ = T cs q (v * d⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine T_mul_T cs q ?_
  have h := length_mul_of_mem_minCosetReps hd (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hv)
  rw [← length_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, h, length_inv, length_inv, add_comm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightDecomposition_single
statement:
theorem rightDecomposition_single (d : cs.minCosetReps J)
    (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q) :
    rightDecomposition cs q J (Finsupp.single d (op x)) = T cs q d * parabolicHom cs q J x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on _ q with
  | T v =>
    have h1 : (Finsupp.curryLinearEquiv R).symm (Finsupp.single d (Finsupp.single v (1 : R))) =
        Finsupp.single (d, v) 1 := by
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      exact (Finsupp.curry_single (d, v) 1).symm
    rw [parabolicHom_T, T_mul_T_of_mem_minCosetReps cs q d.2 v.2, rightDecomposition]
    simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Finsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv_apply,
      Finsupp.mapRange_single, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, coe_opLinearEquiv_symm, unop_op,
      toFinsupp_T, h1, Finsupp.domLCongr_single, minCosetRepsProdEquiv_apply]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [op_add, Finsupp.single_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, mul_add]
  | smul a x hx => rw [op_smul, ← Finsupp.smul_single, map_smul, hx, map_smul, mul_smul_comm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightDecomposition_eq_linearCombination
statement:
theorem rightDecomposition_eq_linearCombination
    (f : cs.minCosetReps J →₀ (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    rightDecomposition cs q J f =
      Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun d : cs.minCosetReps J ↦ T cs q d) f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => rw [map_add, map_add, hf, hg]
  | single d x =>
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, ← op_unop x, rightDecomposition_single]
    rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightBasis_apply (d : cs.minCosetReps J) : rightBasis cs q J d = T cs q d
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightBasis, Basis.coe_ofRepr]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightBasis_repr
statement:
theorem rightBasis_repr (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    (rightBasis cs q J).repr x = (rightDecomposition cs q J).symm x
proof:
:= by
  apply (rightDecomposition cs q J).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, rightDecomposition_eq_linearCombination]
  have e : (fun d : cs.minCosetReps J ↦ T cs q d) = ⇑(rightBasis cs q J) :=
    funext fun d ↦ (rightBasis_apply cs q J d).symm
  rw [e]
  exact (rightBasis cs q J).linearCombination_repr x

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rightDecomposition_symm_mul
statement:
theorem rightDecomposition_symm_mul (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q)
    (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q) :
    (rightDecomposition cs q J).symm (x * parabolicHom cs q J h) =
      op h • (rightDecomposition cs q J).symm x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rightBasis_repr, ← rightBasis_repr, ← parabolic_op_smul_def, map_smul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.minCosetRepsProdEquiv'_apply
statement:
theorem minCosetRepsProdEquiv'_apply (p : cs.minCosetReps J × cs.parabolicSubgroup J) :
    minCosetRepsProdEquiv' cs J p = (p.2 : W) * (p.1 : W)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [minCosetRepsProdEquiv', mul_inv_rev]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftDecomposition_single
statement:
theorem leftDecomposition_single (d : cs.minCosetReps J)
    (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q) :
    leftDecomposition cs q J (Finsupp.single d x) = parabolicHom cs q J x * T cs q (d : W)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on _ q with
  | T v =>
    have h1 : (Finsupp.curryLinearEquiv R).symm (Finsupp.single d (Finsupp.single v (1 : R))) =
        Finsupp.single (d, v) 1 := by
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      exact (Finsupp.curry_single (d, v) 1).symm
    rw [parabolicHom_T, T_mul_T_inv_of_mem_minCosetReps cs q d.2 v.2, leftDecomposition]
    simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Finsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv_apply,
      Finsupp.mapRange_single, toFinsupp_T, h1, Finsupp.domLCongr_single,
      minCosetRepsProdEquiv'_apply]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [Finsupp.single_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_mul]
  | smul a x hx => rw [← Finsupp.smul_single, map_smul, hx, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftDecomposition_eq_linearCombination
statement:
theorem leftDecomposition_eq_linearCombination
    (f : cs.minCosetReps J →₀ IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q) :
    leftDecomposition cs q J f =
      Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun d : cs.minCosetReps J ↦ T cs q (d : W)⁻¹) f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => rw [map_add, map_add, hf, hg]
  | single d x =>
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, leftDecomposition_single]
    rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.leftBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftBasis_apply (d : cs.minCosetReps J) : leftBasis cs q J d = T cs q (d : W)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftBasis, Basis.coe_ofRepr]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedCoeff_apply
statement:
theorem inducedCoeff_apply (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    inducedCoeff χ x d = χ (unop ((rightDecomposition cs q J).symm x d))
proof:
:= by
  simp [inducedCoeff]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedCoeff_mul_parabolicHom
statement:
theorem inducedCoeff_mul_parabolicHom (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q)
    (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J) q) :
    inducedCoeff χ (x * parabolicHom cs q J h) = χ h • inducedCoeff χ x
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [inducedCoeff_apply, rightDecomposition_symm_mul, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, unop_mul, unop_op, map_mul, inducedCoeff_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedCoeff_T
statement:
theorem inducedCoeff_T (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    inducedCoeff χ (T cs q d) = Finsupp.single d 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (rightDecomposition cs q J).symm (T cs q d) = Finsupp.single d (op 1) := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, rightDecomposition_single, map_one, mul_one]
  simp [inducedCoeff, h]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedCoeff_surjective
statement: theorem inducedCoeff_surjective : Function.Surjective (inducedCoeff χ)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | add f g hf hg =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨x + y, map_add _ x y⟩
  | single d a =>
    exact ⟨a • T cs q d, by rw [map_smul, inducedCoeff_T, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one]⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.restrictScalars_inducedIdeal
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_inducedIdeal :
    (inducedIdeal χ).restrictScalars R = LinearMap.ker (inducedCoeff χ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
