  rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hx
    rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun h _ ↦ ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, map_sub, inducedCoeff_mul_parabolicHom, ← Algebra.commutes,
      ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, sub_self]
  · intro hx
    rw [← (rightDecomposition cs q J).apply_symm_apply x, rightDecomposition_eq_linearCombination,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun d _ ↦ ?_
    set a := (rightDecomposition cs q J).symm x d
    have h0 : χ (unop a) = 0 := by
      rw [← inducedCoeff_apply, hx, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    have e : a • T cs q d = T cs q d * (parabolicHom cs q J (unop a) - algebraMap R _ (χ (unop a)))
      := by
      rw [h0, map_zero, sub_zero, ← parabolic_op_smul_def, op_unop]
    rw [e]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨unop a, rfl⟩)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedModuleEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem inducedModuleEquiv_mk (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    inducedModuleEquiv χ (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = inducedCoeff χ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [inducedModuleEquiv, Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv_symm_mk,
    LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inducedBasis_apply (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    inducedBasis χ d = Submodule.Quotient.mk (T cs q d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedBasis, Basis.coe_ofRepr, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, inducedModuleEquiv_mk,
    inducedCoeff_T]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.equivOfEq_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivOfEq_T {q' : R} (h : q = q') (w : W) : equivOfEq cs q h (T cs q w) = T cs q' w
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.baseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem baseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul (a : S) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    baseChangeLinearEquiv cs q S (a ⊗ₜ h) = a • map cs q (algebraMap R S) rfl h
proof:
:= by
  induction h using induction_on cs q generalizing a with
  | T w =>
    have : a ⊗ₜ[R] T cs q w = a • Algebra.TensorProduct.basis S (basis cs q) w := by
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.basis_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
        basis_apply]
    rw [this, map_smul, baseChangeLinearEquiv, Basis.equiv_apply, map_T, Equiv.refl_apply,
      basis_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]
  | smul r x hx =>
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, hx, map_apply_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeEquiv_tmul (a : S) (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    baseChangeEquiv cs q S (a ⊗ₜ h) = a • map cs q (algebraMap R S) rfl h
proof:
:=
  baseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul cs q S a h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.baseChangeEquivMonoidAlgebra_tmul
statement:
theorem baseChangeEquivMonoidAlgebra_tmul (hq : algebraMap R S q = 1) (a : S) (w : W) :
    baseChangeEquivMonoidAlgebra cs q S hq (a ⊗ₜ T cs q w) = a • MonoidAlgebra.of S W w
proof:
:= by
  simp [baseChangeEquivMonoidAlgebra]

name: CoxeterMatrix.isBraidLiftable_const
statement:
theorem isBraidLiftable_const {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (c : G) :
    M.IsBraidLiftable (fun _ : B ↦ c)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j _ _
  simp only [List.map_const', length_alternatingWord, M.symmetric i j]

name: CoxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable.reverse
statement:
theorem IsBraidLiftable.reverse {G : Type*} [Monoid G] {g : B → G} (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g)
    {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) (hm : M i j ≠ 0) :
    (((braidWord M i j).reverse).map g).prod = (((braidWord M j i).reverse).map g).prod
proof:
:= by
  have h := hg i j hij hm
  simp only [braidWord, M.symmetric j i] at h ⊢
  rw [reverse_alternatingWord, reverse_alternatingWord]
  split_ifs
  · exact h.symm
  · exact h

name: CoxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable.op
statement:
theorem IsBraidLiftable.op {G : Type*} [Monoid G] {g : B → G} (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g) :
    M.IsBraidLiftable (MulOpposite.op ∘ g)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ ω : List B,
      (ω.map (MulOpposite.op ∘ g)).prod = MulOpposite.op ((ω.reverse.map g).prod) := by
    intro ω
    rw [op_list_prod, List.map_reverse, List.map_reverse, List.reverse_reverse, List.map_map]
  intro i j hij hm
  rw [key, key, hg.reverse hij hm]

name: CoxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable.inv
statement:
theorem IsBraidLiftable.inv {G : Type*} [Group G] {g : B → G} (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g) :
    M.IsBraidLiftable (fun i ↦ (g i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ ω : List B, (ω.map (fun i ↦ (g i)⁻¹)).prod = ((ω.reverse.map g).prod)⁻¹ := by
    intro ω
    rw [List.prod_inv_reverse, List.map_reverse, List.map_reverse, List.reverse_reverse,
      List.map_map]
    rfl
  intro i j hij hm
  rw [key, key, hg.reverse hij hm]

name: CoxeterMatrix.IsBraidLiftable.smul
statement:
theorem IsBraidLiftable.smul {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {g : B → A}
    (hg : M.IsBraidLiftable g) (c : R) : M.IsBraidLiftable (fun i ↦ c • g i)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ ω : List B, (ω.map (fun i ↦ c • g i)).prod = c ^ ω.length • (ω.map g).prod := by
    intro ω
    induction ω with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a ω ih =>
      rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ih, smul_mul_smul_comm, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
        List.length_cons, pow_succ']
  intro i j hij hm
  rw [key, key, hg i j hij hm]
  simp only [braidWord, length_alternatingWord, M.symmetric i j]

name: CoxeterMatrix.IsHeckeFamily.op
proof:
:= by
    have hc : Commute (t i - algebraMap R A q) (t i + 1) :=
      ((Commute.refl (t i)).sub_left (Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left q (t i))).add_right
        (Commute.one_right _)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [MulOpposite.algebraMap_apply, ← op_sub, ← op_one, ← op_add, ← op_mul, ← hc.eq,
      ht.quadratic i, op_zero]
  braid := ht.braid.op

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.ind_T_simple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ind_T_simple (i : B) : ind cs q (T cs q (s i)) = q
proof:
:= by
  simp [ind]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.sgn_T_simple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sgn_T_simple (i : B) : sgn cs q (T cs q (s i)) = -1
proof:
:= by
  simp [sgn]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.ind_T
statement: theorem ind_T (w : W) : ind cs q (T cs q w) = q ^ ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  rw [ind, lift_apply_T _ hω, List.map_const', List.prod_replicate, hω.eq]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.sgn_T
statement: theorem sgn_T (w : W) : sgn cs q (T cs q w) = (-1) ^ ℓ w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  rw [sgn, lift_apply_T _ hω, List.map_const', List.prod_replicate, hω.eq]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionHom_T
statement: theorem antiInvolutionHom_T (w : W) : antiInvolutionHom cs q (T cs q w) = op (T cs q w⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using cs.induction_simple_mul with
  | one => simp
  | simple_mul w i hlt ih =>
    have e : (s i * w)⁻¹ = w⁻¹ * s i := by rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_simple]
    have hlt' : ℓ w⁻¹ < ℓ (w⁻¹ * s i) := by rwa [← e, length_inv, length_inv]
    rw [← T_simple_mul_T_of_lt cs q hlt, map_mul, ih, antiInvolutionHom, lift_apply_T_simple,
      e, ← T_mul_T_simple_of_lt cs q hlt']
    rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionLinearEquiv_apply (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    antiInvolutionLinearEquiv cs q x = antiInvolutionHom cs q x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on cs q with
  | T w =>
    rw [antiInvolutionHom_T, antiInvolutionLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, ← basis_apply,
      Module.Basis.equiv_apply, basis_apply]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul a x hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hx]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolution_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antiInvolution_T (w : W) : antiInvolution cs q (T cs q w) = op (T cs q w⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← antiInvolutionHom_T]
  exact antiInvolutionLinearEquiv_apply cs q _

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.unop_antiInvolution_unop
statement:
theorem unop_antiInvolution_unop (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    (antiInvolution cs q (antiInvolution cs q x).unop).unop = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on cs q with
  | T w => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, unop_add, hx, hy]
  | smul a x hx => simp only [map_smul, unop_smul, hx]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_apply
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_apply (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    antiInvolutionSelf cs q x = (antiInvolution cs q x).unop
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_T (w : W) : antiInvolutionSelf cs q (T cs q w) = T cs q w⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [antiInvolutionSelf_apply]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_antiInvolution_apply
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_antiInvolution_apply (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (y : W) :
    toFinsupp cs q (antiInvolutionSelf cs q h) y = toFinsupp cs q h y⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction h using induction_on cs q with
  | T w =>
    classical
    rw [antiInvolutionSelf_T, toFinsupp_T, toFinsupp_T, Finsupp.single_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    exact if_congr inv_eq_iff_eq_inv rfl rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hy]
  | smul a x hx => simp only [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, hx]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_one
statement: theorem antiInvolutionSelf_one : antiInvolutionSelf cs q 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [antiInvolutionSelf_apply]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_antiInvolution
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_antiInvolution (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    antiInvolutionSelf cs q (antiInvolutionSelf cs q h) = h
proof:
:=
  unop_antiInvolution_unop cs q h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_mul
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_mul (x y : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    antiInvolutionSelf cs q (x * y) = antiInvolutionSelf cs q y * antiInvolutionSelf cs q x
proof:
:= by
  simp [antiInvolutionSelf_apply]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_mul_T_simple
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_mul_T_simple (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (i : B) :
    antiInvolutionSelf cs q (h * T cs q (s i)) = T cs q (s i) * antiInvolutionSelf cs q h
proof:
:= by
  rw [antiInvolutionSelf_mul, antiInvolutionSelf_T, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isBraidLiftable_TInv
statement: theorem isBraidLiftable_TInv : M.IsBraidLiftable (fun i ↦ TInv cs hq (s i))
proof:
:= by
  have hU : M.IsBraidLiftable (fun i ↦ TUnit cs hq (s i)) := by
    intro i j hij hm
    apply Units.ext
    have := (isHeckeFamily_T cs q).braid i j hij hm
    change Units.coeHom _ _ = Units.coeHom _ _
    rw [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map]
    exact this
  intro i j hij hm
  have := congrArg (Units.coeHom _) (hU.inv i j hij hm)
  rw [map_list_prod, map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map] at this
  exact this

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.neg_smul_TInv_simple
statement:
theorem neg_smul_TInv_simple (i : B) :
    (-q) • TInv cs hq (s i) = algebraMap R _ (q - 1) - T cs q (s i)
proof:
:= by
  have e : q * hq.unit⁻¹.1 = 1 := hq.mul_val_inv
  rw [TInv_simple, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  match_scalars <;> linear_combination (-1 : R) * e

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isHeckeFamily_signTwist
statement:
theorem isHeckeFamily_signTwist :
    M.IsHeckeFamily q (fun i ↦ algebraMap R _ (q - 1) - T cs q (s i)) where
  quadratic i
proof:
:= by
    have hc : Commute (T cs q (s i) - algebraMap R _ q) (T cs q (s i) + 1) :=
      ((Commute.refl _).sub_left (Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left q _)).add_right
        (Commute.one_right _)
    have e1 : algebraMap R (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (q - 1) - T cs q (s i) - algebraMap R _ q =
        -(T cs q (s i) + 1) := by
      rw [map_sub, map_one]; abel
    have e2 : algebraMap R (IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) (q - 1) - T cs q (s i) + 1 =
        -(T cs q (s i) - algebraMap R _ q) := by
      rw [map_sub, map_one]; abel
    rw [e1, e2, neg_mul_neg, ← hc.eq, T_simple_sub_mul_T_simple_add]
  braid := by
    have := (isBraidLiftable_TInv cs hq).smul (-q)
    simp_rw [neg_smul_TInv_simple] at this
    exact this

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.signTwistHom_T_simple
statement:
theorem signTwistHom_T_simple (i : B) :
    signTwistHom cs hq (T cs q (s i)) = algebraMap R _ (q - 1) - T cs q (s i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [signTwistHom]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.signTwistHom_signTwistHom
statement:
theorem signTwistHom_signTwistHom :
    (signTwistHom cs hq).comp (signTwistHom cs hq) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:=
  algHom_ext cs q fun i ↦ by simp [signTwistHom_T_simple]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.signTwist_apply
statement:
theorem signTwist_apply (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    signTwist cs hq x = signTwistHom cs hq x
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.signTwist_T_simple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signTwist_T_simple (i : B) :
    signTwist cs hq (T cs q (s i)) = algebraMap R _ (q - 1) - T cs q (s i)
proof:
:=
  signTwistHom_T_simple cs hq i

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.signTwist_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signTwist_symm : (signTwist cs hq).symm = signTwist cs hq
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.signTwist_signTwist
statement:
theorem signTwist_signTwist (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    signTwist cs hq (signTwist cs hq x) = x
proof:
:=
  (signTwist cs hq).apply_symm_apply x

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.signTwist_T
statement:
theorem signTwist_T (w : W) :
    signTwist cs hq (T cs q w) = (-q) ^ ℓ w • TInv cs hq w⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction w using cs.induction_simple_mul with
  | one => simp
  | simple_mul w i hlt ih =>
    have e : (s i * w)⁻¹ = w⁻¹ * s i := by rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_simple]
    have hl : ℓ (s i * w) = ℓ w + 1 := by
      rcases cs.length_simple_mul w i with h | h <;> omega
    have hl' : ℓ (w⁻¹ * s i) = ℓ w⁻¹ + ℓ (s i) := by
      rw [← e, length_inv, length_inv, hl, length_simple]
    rw [← T_simple_mul_T_of_lt cs q hlt, map_mul, ih, signTwist_T_simple,
      ← neg_smul_TInv_simple, smul_mul_smul_comm, e, TInv_mul cs hq hl', hl, pow_succ']

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.sgn_comp_signTwist
statement: theorem sgn_comp_signTwist : (sgn cs q).comp (signTwist cs hq).toAlgHom = ind cs q
proof:
:=
  algHom_ext cs q fun i ↦ by
    change sgn cs q (signTwist cs hq (T cs q (s i))) = ind cs q (T cs q (s i))
    rw [signTwist_T_simple, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, sgn_T_simple, ind_T_simple,
      Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.ind_comp_signTwist
statement: theorem ind_comp_signTwist : (ind cs q).comp (signTwist cs hq).toAlgHom = sgn cs q
proof:
:=
  algHom_ext cs q fun i ↦ by
    change ind cs q (signTwist cs hq (T cs q (s i))) = sgn cs q (T cs q (s i))
    rw [signTwist_T_simple, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, sgn_T_simple, ind_T_simple,
      Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barSignTwist_apply
statement:
theorem barSignTwist_apply (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    barSignTwist cs σ hσ x = signTwist cs (isUnit_of_mul_eq_one' σ hσ) (bar cs σ hσ x)
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barSignTwist_smul
statement:
theorem barSignTwist_smul (a : R) (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    barSignTwist cs σ hσ (a • x) = σ a • barSignTwist cs σ hσ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [barSignTwist_apply, bar_smul, map_smul, barSignTwist_apply]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barSignTwist_T
statement:
theorem barSignTwist_T (w : W) :
    barSignTwist cs σ hσ (T cs q w) = (-σ q) ^ ℓ w • T cs q w
proof:
:= by
  set hq := isUnit_of_mul_eq_one' σ hσ
  set x := barSignTwist cs σ hσ (T cs q w)
  set y := (-q) ^ ℓ w • TInv cs hq w
  set z := (-σ q) ^ ℓ w • T cs q w
  have hx : x * y = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (signTwist cs hq) (TInv_mul_T cs hq w⁻¹)
    rwa [map_mul, map_one, signTwist_T, inv_inv, length_inv, ← bar_T cs σ hσ] at h
  have hyz : y * z = 1 := by
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, TInv_mul_T, ← mul_pow, neg_mul_neg, mul_comm, hσ, one_pow, one_smul]
  calc x = x * (y * z) := by rw [hyz, mul_one]
    _ = z := by rw [← mul_assoc, hx, one_mul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barSignTwist_barSignTwist
statement:
theorem barSignTwist_barSignTwist (hσσ : ∀ a, σ (σ a) = a) (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    barSignTwist cs σ hσ (barSignTwist cs σ hσ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on cs q with
  | T w =>
    rw [barSignTwist_T, barSignTwist_smul, barSignTwist_T, smul_smul, map_pow, map_neg, hσσ,
      ← mul_pow, neg_mul_neg, mul_comm, hσ, one_pow, one_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul a x hx => rw [barSignTwist_smul, barSignTwist_smul, hσσ, hx]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_TInv
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_TInv (w : W) :
    antiInvolutionSelf cs _ (TInv cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) w) =
      TInv cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) w⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : antiInvolutionSelf cs _ (TInv cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) w) *
      T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) w⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [← antiInvolutionSelf_T, ← antiInvolutionSelf_mul, T_mul_TInv, antiInvolutionSelf_one]
  calc antiInvolutionSelf cs _ (TInv cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) w)
      = antiInvolutionSelf cs _ (TInv cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) w) *
          (T cs _ w⁻¹ * TInv cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) w⁻¹) := by rw [T_mul_TInv, mul_one]
    _ = TInv cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) w⁻¹ := by rw [← mul_assoc, h1, one_mul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_barL
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_barL (h : 𝓗) :
    antiInvolutionSelf cs _ (barL cs h) = barL cs (antiInvolutionSelf cs _ h)
proof:
:= by
  induction h using induction_on cs _ with
  | T w =>
    rw [antiInvolutionSelf_T, barL, bar_T, bar_T, inv_inv]
    rw [antiInvolutionSelf_TInv, inv_inv]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | smul a x hx => rw [barL_smul, map_smul, hx, map_smul, barL_smul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isKLElement_antiInvolution_klBasis
statement:
theorem isKLElement_antiInvolution_klBasis (w : W) :
    IsKLElement cs w⁻¹ (antiInvolutionSelf cs _ (klBasis cs w)) fun y ↦ klPoly cs y⁻¹ w where
  barL_eq
proof:
:= by rw [← antiInvolutionSelf_barL, barL_klBasis]
  toFinsupp_apply y := by
    rw [toFinsupp_antiInvolution_apply, toFinsupp_klBasis_apply, cs.length_inv]
  self := by rw [inv_inv, klPoly_self]
  bruhatLE {y} hy := by
    rw [← CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_inv_iff, inv_inv]
    exact bruhatLE_of_klPoly_ne_zero cs hy
  coeff_eq_zero {y} hy k hk := by
    refine coeff_klPoly_eq_zero cs (fun h ↦ hy (by rw [← h, inv_inv])) ?_
    rw [cs.length_inv] at hk
    rwa [cs.length_inv]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.antiInvolutionSelf_klBasis
statement:
theorem antiInvolutionSelf_klBasis (w : W) :
    antiInvolutionSelf cs _ (klBasis cs w) = klBasis cs w⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (isKLElement_antiInvolution_klBasis cs w).eq_klBasis.1

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klPoly_inv_inv
statement: theorem klPoly_inv_inv (y w : W) : klPoly cs y⁻¹ w⁻¹ = klPoly cs y w
proof:
:= by
  have := congrFun (isKLElement_antiInvolution_klBasis cs w).eq_klBasis.2 y⁻¹
  rw [inv_inv] at this
  exact this.symm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klPoly_mul_simple_right
statement:
theorem klPoly_mul_simple_right {i : B} {w : W} (hw : ℓ (w * s i) < ℓ w) (x : W) :
    klPoly cs (x * s i) w = klPoly cs x w
proof:
:= by
  have hw' : ℓ (s i * w⁻¹) < ℓ w⁻¹ := by
    rwa [← CoxeterSystem.inv_simple cs i, ← mul_inv_rev, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv]
  rw [← klPoly_inv_inv, mul_inv_rev, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple,
    klPoly_simple_mul_left cs hw', klPoly_inv_inv]

name: eq_of_ne_of_ne_of_card_le_two
statement:
theorem eq_of_ne_of_ne_of_card_le_two {B : Type*} [Finite B] (hB : Nat.card B ≤ 2) {i j k : B}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) : j = k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hjk
  have := Fintype.ofFinite B
  have h3 : ({i, j, k} : Finset B).card = 3 := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.card_pair hjk]
  have := Finset.card_le_univ ({i, j, k} : Finset B)
  rw [h3, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at this
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_of_length_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem eq_of_length_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent (hB : Nat.card B ≤ 2) {x y : W} {t : B}
    (hl : ℓ x = ℓ y) (hx : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent x t) (hy : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent y t) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : ℓ x generalizing x y t with
  | zero =>
    rw [hn] at hl
    rw [cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hn, cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hl.symm]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hx1 : x ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
    have hy1 : y ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; rw [hn] at hl; simp at hl
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hx1
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hy1
    have hti : t ≠ i := fun h ↦ hx (h ▸ hi)
    have hti' : t ≠ i' := fun h ↦ hy (h ▸ hi')
    obtain rfl := eq_of_ne_of_ne_of_card_le_two hB hti hti'
    have e1 := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hi
    have e2 := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hi'
    have key := ih (x := s i * x) (y := s i * y) (t := i) (by omega)
      (by rw [IsLeftDescent, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; omega)
      (by rw [IsLeftDescent, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; omega) (by omega)
    simpa using congrArg (s i * ·) key

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_of_length_eq_of_isLeftDescent
statement:
theorem eq_of_length_eq_of_isLeftDescent (hB : Nat.card B ≤ 2) {x y : W} {i : B}
    (hl : ℓ x = ℓ y) (hx : cs.IsLeftDescent x i) (hy : cs.IsLeftDescent y i) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hx
  have e2 := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hy
  have key := eq_of_length_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent (cs := cs) hB (x := s i * x) (y := s i * y)
    (t := i)
    (by omega) (by rw [IsLeftDescent, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; omega)
    (by rw [IsLeftDescent, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; omega)
  simpa using congrArg (s i * ·) key

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_of_length_lt
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_of_length_lt (hB : Nat.card B ≤ 2) {y w : W} (h : ℓ y < ℓ w) :
    cs.BruhatLE y w
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : ℓ w using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing y w with
  | _ n ih =>
  have hw1 : w ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; simp at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw1
  have ht' := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp ht
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (ℓ y + 1) (ℓ w) with h1 | h1
  · exact (ih _ (by omega) (y := y) (w := s t * w) (by omega) rfl).trans (cs.simple_mul_bruhatLE ht)
  · by_cases hy : cs.IsLeftDescent y t
    · have hy' := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hy
      exact (cs.simple_mul_bruhatLE_simple_mul_iff hy ht).mp
        (ih _ (by omega) (y := s t * y) (w := s t * w) (by omega) rfl)
    · have hw' : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent (s t * w) t := by
        rw [IsLeftDescent, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]; omega
      rw [eq_of_length_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent hB (by omega) hy hw']
      exact cs.simple_mul_bruhatLE ht

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_iff_of_card_le_two
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_iff_of_card_le_two (hB : Nat.card B ≤ 2) {y w : W} :
    cs.BruhatLE y w ↔ ℓ y < ℓ w ∨ y = w
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.eq_or_length_lt.symm,
    fun h ↦ h.elim (bruhatLE_of_length_lt hB) fun h ↦ h ▸ cs.bruhatLE_refl _⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klPoly_eq_one_of_card_le_two
statement:
theorem klPoly_eq_one_of_card_le_two (hB : Nat.card B ≤ 2) {y w : W} (h : cs.BruhatLE y w) :
    klPoly cs y w = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices key : ∀ n, ∀ w : W, ℓ w = n → ∀ x, cs.BruhatLE x w → klPoly cs x w = 1 from
    key _ w rfl y h
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro w hn x hxw
  have char : ∀ a u : W, cs.BruhatLE a u ↔ ℓ a < ℓ u ∨ a = u := fun _ _ ↦
    bruhatLE_iff_of_card_le_two hB
  have IH : ∀ u a : W, ℓ u < n → klPoly cs a u = if cs.BruhatLE a u then 1 else 0 :=
    fun u a hu ↦ by
      split_ifs with h'
      · exact ih _ hu u rfl a h'
      · exact klPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE cs h'
  rcases eq_or_ne x w with rfl | hxw'
  · exact klPoly_self cs x
  have hlx : ℓ x < ℓ w := hxw.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left hxw'
  have hw1 : w ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; simp at hlx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hw1
  set v := s i * w with hv_def
  have hvl : ℓ v + 1 = ℓ w := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hi
  have hw : w = s i * v := by rw [hv_def, simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
  have hv : ℓ v < ℓ (s i * v) := by rw [← hw]; omega
  have hvi : ¬cs.IsLeftDescent v i := by rw [IsLeftDescent, ← hw]; omega
  rw [hw, klPoly_simple_mul cs hv x, ← hw]
  
  have hterm : ∀ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v,
      C (klMu cs z v) * X ^ ((ℓ w - ℓ z) / 2) * klPoly cs x z =
        if ℓ z + 1 = ℓ v ∧ cs.BruhatLE x z then X else 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hzv := (mem_descentsBelow.mp hz).1
    have hzl := length_lt_of_mem_descentsBelow hv hz
    rw [klMu, muCoeff, IH v z (by omega), ite_eq_left hzv, IH z x (by omega)]
    by_cases hzl' : ℓ z + 1 = ℓ v
    · have hd : ℓ v - ℓ z = 1 := by omega
      have h2 : (ℓ w - ℓ z) / 2 = 1 := by omega
      by_cases hxz : cs.BruhatLE x z <;> simp [hd, h2, hzl', hxz]
    · have hmu : (if Odd (ℓ v - ℓ z) then (1 : ℤ[X]).coeff ((ℓ v - ℓ z) / 2) else 0) = 0 := by
        split_ifs with hodd
        · rw [coeff_one]
          exact ite_eq_right (by have := Nat.odd_iff.mp hodd; omega)
        · rfl
      rw [hmu, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul,
        ite_eq_right (show ¬(ℓ z + 1 = ℓ v ∧ cs.BruhatLE x z) from fun h' ↦ hzl' h'.1)]
  have hsum : (∑ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v,
      C (klMu cs z v) * X ^ ((ℓ w - ℓ z) / 2) * klPoly cs x z) =
        if ∃ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v, ℓ z + 1 = ℓ v ∧ cs.BruhatLE x z then X else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
    split_ifs with hex
    · obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hz₀'⟩ := hex
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem z₀ hz₀, ite_eq_left hz₀']
      intro z hz hne
      refine ite_eq_right fun hc ↦ hne ?_
      exact eq_of_length_eq_of_isLeftDescent hB (by omega) (mem_descentsBelow.mp hz).2
        (mem_descentsBelow.mp hz₀).2
    · exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun z hz ↦ ite_eq_right fun hc ↦ hex ⟨z, hz, hc⟩
  
  have hz₀ : 2 ≤ ℓ v → ∃ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v, ℓ z + 1 = ℓ v := by
    intro h2
    have hv1 : v ≠ 1 := by
      intro h'
      rw [h', cs.length_one] at h2
      omega
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hv1
    have ht' := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp ht
    have hti : t ≠ i := fun h' ↦ hvi (h' ▸ ht)
    refine ⟨s t * v, mem_descentsBelow.mpr ⟨cs.simple_mul_bruhatLE ht, ?_⟩, ht'⟩
    by_contra hzi
    have hz1 : s t * v ≠ 1 := by
      intro h'
      rw [h', cs.length_one] at ht'
      omega
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hz1
    have htr : t ≠ r := by
      rintro rfl
      have := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hr
      rw [simple_mul_simple_cancel_left] at this
      omega
    exact hzi (eq_of_ne_of_ne_of_card_le_two hB htr hti ▸ hr)
  have hDl : ∀ z ∈ descentsBelow cs i v, ℓ z < ℓ v := fun z hz ↦
    length_lt_of_mem_descentsBelow hv hz
  rw [hsum]
  by_cases hsx : ℓ (s i * x) < ℓ x
  · have hsxl : ℓ (s i * x) + 1 = ℓ x := by
      rcases cs.length_simple_mul x i with h' | h' <;> omega
    rw [ite_eq_left hsx, IH v (s i * x) (by omega),
      ite_eq_left ((char _ _).mpr (Or.inl (by omega))), IH v x (by omega)]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (ℓ x) (ℓ v) with hxv | hxv
    · rw [ite_eq_left ((char _ _).mpr (Or.inl hxv)), ite_eq_left, mul_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (ℓ x + 1) (ℓ v) with hxv' | hxv'
      · obtain ⟨z, hz, hzl⟩ := hz₀ (by omega)
        exact ⟨z, hz, hzl, (char _ _).mpr (Or.inl (by omega))⟩
      · exact ⟨x, mem_descentsBelow.mpr ⟨(char _ _).mpr (Or.inl hxv), hsx⟩, by omega,
          cs.bruhatLE_refl x⟩
    · have hxv' : ¬cs.BruhatLE x v := fun h' ↦ by
        rcases (char _ _).mp h' with h'' | rfl
        · omega
        · exact hvi hsx
      rw [ite_eq_right hxv', mul_zero, add_zero,
        ite_eq_right fun ⟨z, hz, _, hxz⟩ ↦ by have := hxz.length_le; have := hDl z hz; omega,
        sub_zero]
  · have hsxl : ℓ (s i * x) = ℓ x + 1 := by
      rcases cs.length_simple_mul x i with h' | h' <;> omega
    rw [ite_eq_right hsx, IH v (s i * x) (by omega), IH v x (by omega)]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (ℓ x + 1) (ℓ v) with hxv | hxv
    · rw [ite_eq_left ((char _ _).mpr (Or.inl (by omega))),
        ite_eq_left ((char _ _).mpr (Or.inl (by omega))), mul_one, ite_eq_left, add_sub_cancel_left]
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzl⟩ := hz₀ (by omega)
      exact ⟨z, hz, hzl, (char _ _).mpr (Or.inl (by omega))⟩
    · have hsxv : ¬cs.BruhatLE (s i * x) v := fun h' ↦ by
        rcases (char _ _).mp h' with h'' | h''
        · omega
        · apply hxw'
          rw [hw, ← h'', simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
      rw [ite_eq_right hsxv, mul_zero, zero_add]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (ℓ x) (ℓ v) with hxv' | hxv'
      · rw [ite_eq_left ((char _ _).mpr (Or.inl hxv')), ite_eq_right, sub_zero]
        rintro ⟨z, hz, hzl, hxz⟩
        have hxz' := hxz.eq_of_length_le (by omega)
        apply hsx
        rw [hxz']
        exact (mem_descentsBelow.mp hz).2
      · have hxv'' : x = v := eq_of_length_eq_of_not_isLeftDescent hB (by omega)
          (by rw [IsLeftDescent]; omega) hvi
        rw [ite_eq_left ((char _ _).mpr (Or.inr hxv'')),
          ite_eq_right fun ⟨z, hz, _, hxz⟩ ↦ by have := hxz.length_le; have := hDl z hz; omega,
          sub_zero]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.klBasis_eq_sum_of_card_le_two
statement:
theorem klBasis_eq_sum_of_card_le_two (hB : Nat.card B ≤ 2) (w : W) :
    klBasis cs w = (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ w : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) •
      ∑ y ∈ (cs.finite_setOf_bruhatLE w).toFinset,
        T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [klBasis_eq_sum]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y hy ↦ ?_
  rw [klPoly_eq_one_of_card_le_two cs hB (by simpa using hy), map_one, one_smul]

name: LaurentPolynomial.coeff_T_mul
statement: theorem coeff_T_mul (k n : ℤ) (f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) : (T k * f).coeff n = f.coeff (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul, sub_eq_neg_add]

name: LaurentPolynomial.isNeg_zero
statement: theorem isNeg_zero : IsNeg 0
proof: := fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsNeg.add
statement: theorem IsNeg.add {f g : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsNeg) (hg : g.IsNeg) : (f + g).IsNeg
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hf n hn, hg n hn, add_zero]

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsNeg.sub
statement: theorem IsNeg.sub {f g : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsNeg) (hg : g.IsNeg) : (f - g).IsNeg
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, hf n hn, hg n hn, sub_zero]

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsNeg.eq_zero_of_invert_eq
statement: theorem IsNeg.eq_zero_of_invert_eq {f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsNeg) (h : invert f = f) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn | hn
  · exact hf n hn
  · rw [← h, invert_apply]
    exact hf _ (by omega)

name: LaurentPolynomial.isBounded_zero
statement: theorem isBounded_zero (N : ℤ) : IsBounded N 0
proof: := fun _ h ↦ absurd rfl h

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsBounded.add
statement:
theorem IsBounded.add {N : ℤ} {f g : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsBounded N) (hg : g.IsBounded N) :
    (f + g).IsBounded N
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply] at hn
  by_cases h : f.coeff n = 0
  · rw [h, zero_add] at hn
    exact hg n hn
  · exact hf n h

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsBounded.neg
statement: theorem IsBounded.neg {N : ℤ} {f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsBounded N) : (-f).IsBounded N
proof:
:=
  fun n hn ↦ hf n (by simpa using hn)

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsBounded.sub
statement:
theorem IsBounded.sub {N : ℤ} {f g : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsBounded N) (hg : g.IsBounded N) :
    (f - g).IsBounded N
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hf.add hg.neg

name: LaurentPolynomial.isBounded_sum
statement:
theorem isBounded_sum {ι : Type*} {N : ℤ} (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → ℤ[T;T⁻¹]}
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).IsBounded N) : (∑ i ∈ s, f i).IsBounded N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact isBounded_zero N
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)).add (ih fun j hj ↦ hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsBounded.mul
statement:
theorem IsBounded.mul {N N' : ℤ} {f g : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsBounded N) (hg : g.IsBounded N') :
    (f * g).IsBounded (N + N')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro n hn
  have hmem : n ∈ (f * g).coeff.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hn
  obtain ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩ :=
    Finset.mem_add.mp (AddMonoidAlgebra.support_coeff_mul_subset f g hmem)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hf a (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp ha)
  obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3'⟩ := hg c (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hc)
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  have := h3.add h3'
  rwa [show a + N + (c + N') = a + c + (N + N') by ring] at this

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsBounded.invert
statement:
theorem IsBounded.invert {N : ℤ} {f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsBounded N) :
    (invert f).IsBounded N
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [invert_apply] at hn
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hf _ hn
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  have : n + N = (-n + N) + 2 * n := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact h3.add (even_two_mul n)

name: LaurentPolynomial.isBounded_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem isBounded_C_mul_T {N n : ℤ} (c : ℤ) (h1 : -N ≤ n) (h2 : n ≤ N) (h3 : Even (n + N)) :
    (C c * T n : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]).IsBounded N
proof:
:= fun m hm ↦ by
  classical
  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply] at hm
  split_ifs at hm with h
  · subst h
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  · exact absurd rfl hm

name: LaurentPolynomial.isBounded_T
statement:
theorem isBounded_T {N n : ℤ} (h1 : -N ≤ n) (h2 : n ≤ N) (h3 : Even (n + N)) :
    (T n : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]).IsBounded N
proof:
:= by
  simpa using isBounded_C_mul_T 1 h1 h2 h3

name: LaurentPolynomial.isBounded_one
statement: theorem isBounded_one : (1 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]).IsBounded 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using isBounded_T (N := 0) (n := 0) le_rfl le_rfl ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsBounded.of_eq
statement:
theorem IsBounded.of_eq {N N' : ℤ} {f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsBounded N) (h : N = N') :
    f.IsBounded N'
proof: := h ▸ hf

name: LaurentPolynomial.isBounded_T_mul_aeval
statement:
theorem isBounded_T_mul_aeval {N a : ℤ} (P : ℤ[X]) (h1 : -N ≤ a)
    (h2 : a + 2 * P.natDegree ≤ N) (h3 : Even (a + N)) :
    (T a * aeval (T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) P).IsBounded N
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine isBounded_sum _ fun i hi ↦ ?_
  have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C, T_pow, eq_intCast (algebraMap ℤ ℤ[T;T⁻¹]),
    ← map_intCast (C : ℤ →+* ℤ[T;T⁻¹]), Int.cast_id, mul_left_comm, ← T_add]
  refine isBounded_C_mul_T _ (by omega) (by omega) ?_
  rw [show a + ↑i * 2 + N = a + N + 2 * i by ring]
  exact h3.add (even_two_mul _)

name: LaurentPolynomial.coeff_negPart_apply
statement:
theorem coeff_negPart_apply (f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) (n : ℤ) :
    (negPart f).coeff n = if n < 0 then f.coeff n else 0
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.filter_apply _ _ _

name: LaurentPolynomial.isNeg_negPart
statement: theorem isNeg_negPart (f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) : (negPart f).IsNeg
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [coeff_negPart_apply, ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsBounded.negPart
statement:
theorem IsBounded.negPart {N : ℤ} {f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f.IsBounded N) :
    (negPart f).IsBounded N
proof:
:= fun n hn ↦ by
  rw [coeff_negPart_apply] at hn
  split_ifs at hn
  · exact hf n hn
  · exact absurd rfl hn

name: LaurentPolynomial.eq_negPart_sub_invert_negPart
statement:
theorem eq_negPart_sub_invert_negPart {f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (h : invert f = -f) :
    f = negPart f - invert (negPart f)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  have hn := congrArg (fun g : ℤ[T;T⁻¹] ↦ g.coeff n) h
  simp only [invert_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_neg, Finsupp.neg_apply] at hn
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, invert_apply, coeff_negPart_apply,
    coeff_negPart_apply]
  rcases lt_trichotomy n 0 with h' | rfl | h'
  · rw [ite_eq_left h', ite_eq_right (by omega), sub_zero]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl 0), neg_zero, ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl 0), sub_zero]
    simp only [neg_zero] at hn
    omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_left (by omega), zero_sub, hn, neg_neg]

name: LaurentPolynomial.exists_eq_T_mul_aeval
statement:
theorem exists_eq_T_mul_aeval {a : ℤ} {f : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]}
    (hf : ∀ n, f.coeff n ≠ 0 → a ≤ n ∧ Even (n - a)) :
    ∃ P : ℤ[X], f = T a * aeval (T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) P ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, P.coeff k = f.coeff (a + 2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, monomial ((n - a) / 2).toNat (f.coeff n), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    conv_lhs => rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single f]
    rw [Finsupp.sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨h1, k, hk⟩ := hf n (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hn)
    have e : ((n - a) / 2).toNat = k.toNat := by omega
    rw [e, aeval_monomial, T_pow, single_eq_C_mul_T,
      eq_intCast (algebraMap ℤ ℤ[T;T⁻¹]), ← map_intCast (C : ℤ →+* ℤ[T;T⁻¹]), Int.cast_id,
      mul_left_comm, ← T_add]
    congr 2
    omega
  · intro k
    rw [finsetSum_coeff]
    by_cases hk : a + 2 * k ∈ f.coeff.support
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem _ hk]
      · rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
      · intro n hn hne
        obtain ⟨h1, m, hm⟩ := hf n (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hn)
        rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hk]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n hn ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨h1, m, hm⟩ := hf n (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hn)
      rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right]
      intro he
      apply hk
      rwa [show a + 2 * k = n by omega]

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.repr_apply
statement:
theorem repr_apply (x : V) (j : ι) :
    b.repr (ψ x) j = (b.repr x).sum fun k a ↦ invert a * b.repr (ψ (b k)) j
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← b.linearCombination_repr x]
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, map_finsuppSum, map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum_apply]
  simp only [h.map_smul, _root_.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.repr_sub_apply
statement:
theorem repr_sub_apply (x : V) (j : ι) :
    b.repr (ψ x - x) j = b.repr (ψ x) j - b.repr x j
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply]

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self {x : V} (hx : ψ x = x) (hneg : ∀ j, (b.repr x j).IsNeg) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  have hsupp : (b.repr x).support.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff]
    exact fun e ↦ hne (b.repr.map_eq_zero_iff.mp e)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (b.repr x).support.exists_maximal hsupp
  have key : b.repr (ψ x) j = invert (b.repr x j) := by
    rw [h.repr_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj.1, h.repr_self, mul_one]
    intro k hk hkj
    by_cases hr : b.repr (ψ (b k)) j = 0
    · rw [hr, mul_zero]
    · exact absurd (le_antisymm (hj.2 hk (h.le_of_repr_ne_zero hr)) (h.le_of_repr_ne_zero hr))
        hkj
  rw [hx] at key
  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hj.1 ((hneg j).eq_zero_of_invert_eq key.symm)

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.exists_step
statement:
private theorem exists_step [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (S : Finset ι) (hSi : ∀ j ∈ S, j < i)
    (hSup : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ k, j < k → k < i → k ∈ S) {j : ι} (hj : Minimal (· ∈ S) j) (c : V)
    (hci : b.repr c i = 1) (hc0 : ∀ k, k ≠ i → k ∉ S.erase j → b.repr c k = 0)
    (hcS : ∀ k ∈ S.erase j, (b.repr c k).IsNeg ∧ (b.repr c k).IsBounded (ℓ i - ℓ k))
    (hψc : ∀ k, b.repr (ψ c - c) k ≠ 0 → k < i ∧ k ∉ S.erase j) :
    ∃ c' : V, b.repr c' i = 1 ∧ (∀ k, k ≠ i → k ∉ S → b.repr c' k = 0) ∧
      (∀ k ∈ S, (b.repr c' k).IsNeg ∧ (b.repr c' k).IsBounded (ℓ i - ℓ k)) ∧
      (∀ k, b.repr (ψ c' - c') k ≠ 0 → k < i ∧ k ∉ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hji : j < i := hSi j hj.1
  have hjS' : j ∉ S.erase j := Finset.notMem_erase j S
  have hcj : b.repr c j = 0 := hc0 j hji.ne hjS'
  
  have hmin : ∀ k ∈ S, k ≤ j → k = j := fun k hk hkj ↦ le_antisymm hkj (hj.2 hk hkj)
  set a := b.repr (ψ c) j with ha
  
  have hanti : invert a = -a := by
    have e : ψ (ψ c - c) = -(ψ c - c) := by rw [map_sub, h.involutive]; abel
    have e' := congrArg (fun y ↦ b.repr y j) e
    rw [h.repr_apply, map_neg, Finsupp.neg_apply] at e'
    rw [Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_eq_single j, h.repr_self, mul_one, repr_sub_apply, hcj,
      sub_zero] at e'
    · exact e'
    · intro k _ hkj
      by_cases hx : b.repr (ψ c - c) k = 0
      · rw [hx, map_zero, zero_mul]
      by_cases hr : b.repr (ψ (b k)) j = 0
      · rw [hr, mul_zero]
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨hki, hkS⟩ := hψc k hx
      have hjk : j < k := lt_of_le_of_ne (h.le_of_repr_ne_zero hr) (Ne.symm hkj)
      exact hkS (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hkj, hSup j hj.1 k hjk hki⟩)
    · intro hj'
      rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hj', map_zero, zero_mul]
  
  have hbd : a.IsBounded (ℓ i - ℓ j) := by
    rw [ha, h.repr_apply, Finsupp.sum]
    refine isBounded_sum _ fun k hk ↦ ?_
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst hki
      rw [hci, map_one, one_mul]
      exact h.isBounded k j
    · have hkS : k ∈ S.erase j := by
        by_contra hkS
        exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hk (hc0 k hki hkS)
      exact ((hcS k hkS).2.invert.mul (h.isBounded k j)).of_eq (by ring)
  set p := negPart a
  have hp : a = p - invert p := eq_negPart_sub_invert_negPart hanti
  have hrepr : ∀ k, b.repr (p • b j) k = if k = j then p else 0 := fun k ↦ by
    rw [_root_.map_smul, b.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases hk : k = j
    · subst hk
      simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hk), ite_eq_right hk, smul_zero]
  refine ⟨c + p • b j, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hci, hrepr, ite_eq_right hji.ne', add_zero]
  · intro k hki hkS
    have hkj : k ≠ j := fun e ↦ hkS (e ▸ hj.1)
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hrepr, ite_eq_right hkj, add_zero]
    exact hc0 k hki fun h' ↦ hkS (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h')
  · intro k hk
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hrepr]
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst hkj
      rw [hcj, ite_eq_left rfl, zero_add]
      exact ⟨isNeg_negPart a, hbd.negPart⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right hkj, add_zero]
      exact hcS k (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hkj, hk⟩)
  · intro k hk
    have e : b.repr (ψ (c + p • b j) - (c + p • b j)) k =
        b.repr (ψ c - c) k + (invert p * b.repr (ψ (b j)) k - if k = j then p else 0) := by
      rw [← hrepr, map_add, h.map_smul, map_sub, map_add, map_add, _root_.map_smul, map_sub]
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [e] at hk
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst hkj
      exfalso
      apply hk
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, h.repr_self, mul_one, repr_sub_apply, hcj, sub_zero, ← ha, hp]
      ring
    · rw [ite_eq_right hkj, sub_zero] at hk
      by_cases hx : b.repr (ψ c - c) k = 0
      · rw [hx, zero_add] at hk
        have hr : b.repr (ψ (b j)) k ≠ 0 := fun hr ↦ hk (by rw [hr, mul_zero])
        have hkj' : k < j := lt_of_le_of_ne (h.le_of_repr_ne_zero hr) hkj
        exact ⟨hkj'.trans hji, fun hkS ↦ hkj (hmin k hkS hkj'.le)⟩
      · obtain ⟨hki, hkS⟩ := hψc k hx
        exact ⟨hki, fun hkS' ↦ hkS (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hkj, hkS'⟩)⟩

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.exists_fixed
statement:
private theorem exists_fixed (i : ι) (S : Finset ι) (hSi : ∀ j ∈ S, j < i)
    (hSup : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ k, j < k → k < i → k ∈ S) :
    ∃ c : V, b.repr c i = 1 ∧ (∀ k, k ≠ i → k ∉ S → b.repr c k = 0) ∧
      (∀ k ∈ S, (b.repr c k).IsNeg ∧ (b.repr c k).IsBounded (ℓ i - ℓ k)) ∧
      (∀ k, b.repr (ψ c - c) k ≠ 0 → k < i ∧ k ∉ S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction with
  | H S ih =>
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS
  · refine ⟨b i, by simp, fun k hki _ ↦ ?_, by simp, fun k hk ↦ ⟨?_, Finset.notMem_empty k⟩⟩
    · rw [b.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hki)]
    · rw [repr_sub_apply, b.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply] at hk
      by_cases hki : k = i
      · subst hki
        simp [h.repr_self] at hk
      · rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hki), sub_zero] at hk
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne (h.le_of_repr_ne_zero hk) hki
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := S.exists_minimal hS
  have hmin : ∀ k ∈ S, k ≤ j → k = j := fun k hk hkj ↦ le_antisymm hkj (hj.2 hk hkj)
  obtain ⟨c, hci, hc0, hcS, hψc⟩ := ih (S.erase j) (Finset.erase_ssubset hj.1)
    (fun k hk ↦ hSi k (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hk)) (fun k hk l hkl hli ↦ by
      have hk' := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hk
      refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun hlj ↦ ?_, hSup k hk' l hkl hli⟩
      subst hlj
      exact (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hk) (hmin k hk' hkl.le))
  exact h.exists_step i S hSi hSup hj c hci hc0 hcS hψc

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.exists_canonical
statement:
theorem exists_canonical (i : ι) : ∃ c : V, ψ c = c ∧ b.repr c i = 1 ∧
    ∀ j, j ≠ i → (b.repr c j).IsNeg ∧ (b.repr c j ≠ 0 → j < i) ∧
      (b.repr c j).IsBounded (ℓ i - ℓ j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S := (h.finite_Iio i).toFinset
  have hS : ∀ j, j ∈ S ↔ j < i := fun j ↦ by simp [S]
  obtain ⟨c, hci, hc0, hcS, hψc⟩ := h.exists_fixed i S (fun j hj ↦ (hS j).mp hj)
    (fun _ _ k _ hk ↦ (hS k).mpr hk)
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hci, fun j hji ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← sub_eq_zero, b.ext_elem_iff]
    intro k
    rw [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    by_contra hk
    obtain ⟨hki, hkS⟩ := hψc k hk
    exact hkS ((hS k).mpr hki)
  · by_cases hj : j < i
    · exact ⟨(hcS j ((hS j).mpr hj)).1, fun _ ↦ hj, (hcS j ((hS j).mpr hj)).2⟩
    · rw [hc0 j hji fun h' ↦ hj ((hS j).mp h')]
      exact ⟨isNeg_zero, fun h' ↦ absurd rfl h', isBounded_zero _⟩

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.existsUnique_canonical
statement:
theorem existsUnique_canonical (i : ι) :
    ∃! c : V, ψ c = c ∧ b.repr c i = 1 ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → (b.repr c j).IsNeg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hci, hcj⟩ := h.exists_canonical i
  refine ⟨c, ⟨hc, hci, fun j hj ↦ (hcj j hj).1⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro c' ⟨hc', hci', hcj'⟩
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine h.eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self (by rw [map_sub, hc, hc']) fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply]
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    rw [hci, hci', sub_self]
    exact isNeg_zero
  · exact (hcj' j hj).sub (hcj j hj).1

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.apply_canonical
statement: theorem apply_canonical (i : ι) : ψ (h.canonical i) = h.canonical i
proof:
:=
  (h.exists_canonical i).choose_spec.1

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.repr_canonical_self
statement: theorem repr_canonical_self (i : ι) : b.repr (h.canonical i) i = 1
proof:
:=
  (h.exists_canonical i).choose_spec.2.1

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.isNeg_repr_canonical
statement: theorem isNeg_repr_canonical {i j : ι} (hj : j ≠ i) : (b.repr (h.canonical i) j).IsNeg
proof:
:=
  ((h.exists_canonical i).choose_spec.2.2 j hj).1

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.lt_of_repr_canonical_ne_zero
statement:
theorem lt_of_repr_canonical_ne_zero {i j : ι} (hj : j ≠ i)
    (hne : b.repr (h.canonical i) j ≠ 0) : j < i
proof:
:=
  ((h.exists_canonical i).choose_spec.2.2 j hj).2.1 hne

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.le_of_repr_canonical_ne_zero
statement: theorem le_of_repr_canonical_ne_zero {i j : ι} (hne : b.repr (h.canonical i) j ≠ 0) : j ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact (h.lt_of_repr_canonical_ne_zero hj hne).le

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.isBounded_repr_canonical
statement:
theorem isBounded_repr_canonical (i j : ι) :
    (b.repr (h.canonical i) j).IsBounded (ℓ i - ℓ j)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
  · rw [h.repr_canonical_self, sub_self]
    exact isBounded_one
  · exact ((h.exists_canonical i).choose_spec.2.2 j hj).2.2

name: Module.Basis.IsBarTriangular.eq_canonical
statement:
theorem eq_canonical {i : ι} {c : V} (hc : ψ c = c) (hci : b.repr c i = 1)
    (hcj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → (b.repr c j).IsNeg) : c = h.canonical i
proof:
:=
  (h.existsUnique_canonical i).unique ⟨hc, hci, hcj⟩
    ⟨h.apply_canonical i, h.repr_canonical_self i, fun _ hj ↦ h.isNeg_repr_canonical hj⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bruhatLE_of_rPoly_ne_zero
statement: theorem bruhatLE_of_rPoly_ne_zero {y w : W} (h : rPoly cs hq y w ≠ 0) : cs.BruhatLE y w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced w
  exact hω.bruhatLE_iff.mpr (exists_sublist_of_rPoly_ne_zero cs hq hω h)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.rPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE
statement: theorem rPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE {y w : W} (h : ¬cs.BruhatLE y w) : rPoly cs hq y w = 0
proof:
:=
  not_not.mp fun h' ↦ h (bruhatLE_of_rPoly_ne_zero cs hq h')

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.eq_sum_toFinsupp
statement:
theorem eq_sum_toFinsupp (h : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra cs q) :
    h = (toFinsupp cs q h).sum fun x a ↦ a • T cs q x
proof:
:= by
  apply (toFinsupp cs q).injective
  rw [map_finsuppSum]
  simp_rw [map_smul, toFinsupp_T, smul_single_one]
  exact (Finsupp.sum_single _).symm

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isUnit_T_two
statement: theorem isUnit_T_two : IsUnit (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial A)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_of_mul_eq_one' invertHom invertHom_T_two_mul_T_two

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_barL_T_apply
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_barL_T_apply (y w : W) :
    toFinsupp cs _ (barL cs (T cs _ w)) y =
      (-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-(2 * ℓ w : ℤ)) *
        rPoly cs (isUnit_T_two (A := A)) y w
proof:
:= by
  rw [barL, toFinsupp_bar_T_apply, invertHom_apply, LaurentPolynomial.invert_T,
    LaurentPolynomial.T_pow]
  congr 3
  ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bruhatLE_of_toFinsupp_barL_T_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine bruhatLE_of_rPoly_ne_zero cs (isUnit_T_two (A := A)) fun h' ↦ h ?_
  rw [toFinsupp_barL_T_apply, h', mul_zero]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_barL_T_self
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_barL_T_self (w : W) :
    toFinsupp cs _ (barL cs (T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial A) w)) w =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-(2 * ℓ w : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFinsupp_barL_T_apply, rPoly_self, ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul,
    mul_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_T_sub_mem_span
statement:
theorem barL_T_sub_mem_span (w : W) :
    barL cs (T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial A) w) -
        (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(2 * ℓ w : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial A) • T cs _ w ∈
      Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial A)
        (T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial A) '' {y | cs.BruhatLE y w ∧ y ≠ w})
proof:
:= by
  set h := barL cs (T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : LaurentPolynomial A) w) -
    (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(2 * ℓ w : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial A) • T cs _ w
  rw [eq_sum_toFinsupp cs h]
  refine Submodule.finsuppSum_mem _ _ _ _ fun y hy ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  · by_contra hyw
    apply hy
    have hne : y ≠ w := fun e ↦ hyw (e ▸ cs.bruhatLE_refl w)
    simp only [h, map_sub, map_smul, toFinsupp_T, Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
      single_eq_of_ne hne, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact not_not.mp fun h' ↦ hyw (bruhatLE_of_toFinsupp_barL_T_ne_zero cs h')
  · rintro rfl
    apply hy
    simp [h, toFinsupp_T, toFinsupp_barL_T_self]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.toFinsupp_barL_apply
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_barL_apply (h : 𝓗) (y : W) :
    toFinsupp cs _ (barL cs h) y = (toFinsupp cs _ h).sum fun x a ↦
      LaurentPolynomial.invert a * toFinsupp cs _ (barL cs (T cs _ x)) y
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_toFinsupp cs h]
  rw [map_finsuppSum, map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [barL_smul, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.eq_zero_of_barL_eq_self
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_barL_eq_self {h : 𝓗} (hbar : barL cs h = h)
    (hneg : ∀ y (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ n + ℓ y → (toFinsupp cs _ h y).coeff n = 0) : h = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hsupp : (toFinsupp cs _ h).support.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff]
    exact fun e ↦ hne ((toFinsupp cs _).map_eq_zero_iff.mp e)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmax⟩ := (toFinsupp cs _ h).support.exists_max_image cs.length hsupp
  
  have key : toFinsupp cs _ (barL cs h) y = LaurentPolynomial.invert (toFinsupp cs _ h y) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-(2 * ℓ y : ℤ)) := by
    rw [toFinsupp_barL_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_eq_single y, toFinsupp_barL_T_self]
    · intro x hx hxy
      have hle := hmax x hx
      rw [toFinsupp_barL_T_apply]
      by_cases hr : rPoly cs (isUnit_T_two (A := A)) y x = 0
      · rw [hr, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      exfalso
      have h1 := length_le_of_rPoly_ne_zero cs _ hr
      exact hxy (eq_of_rPoly_ne_zero_of_length_eq cs _ hr (by omega)).symm
    · intro hy'
      exact absurd hy hy'
  rw [hbar] at key
  set a := toFinsupp cs _ h y
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hy
  apply ha
  ext n
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  by_cases hn : 0 ≤ n + ℓ y
  · exact hneg y n hn
  · have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.coeff n) key
    simp only [LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply,
      LaurentPolynomial.invert_apply, mul_one] at this
    rw [this]
    exact hneg y _ (by omega)

name: LaurentPolynomial.lusztigFamily_of_le
statement:
theorem lusztigFamily_of_le (r : H → H → ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) {h h' : H} (hh : h' ≤ h) :
    lusztigFamily r h h' = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lusztigFamily, ite_eq_left hh]

name: LaurentPolynomial.lusztigFamily_of_not_le
statement:
theorem lusztigFamily_of_not_le (r : H → H → ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) {h h' : H} (hh : ¬h' ≤ h) :
    lusztigFamily r h h' =
      negPart (∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico h h', invert (lusztigFamily r h x) * r x h')
proof:
:= by
  rw [lusztigFamily, ite_eq_right hh, Finset.sum_attach (Finset.Ico h h')
    (fun x ↦ invert (lusztigFamily r h x) * r x h')]

name: LaurentPolynomial.induction_Icc
statement:
private theorem induction_Icc {h : H} {P : H → Prop}
    (ih : ∀ h', (∀ x, h ≤ x → x < h' → P x) → P h') (h' : H) : P h'
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n h', (Finset.Icc h h').card = n → P h' from this _ h' rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n IH =>
    rintro h' rfl
    exact ih h' fun x hx hx' ↦ IH _ (Finset.card_lt_card
      (Finset.Icc_ssubset_Icc_right (hx.trans hx'.le) le_rfl hx')) x rfl

name: LaurentPolynomial.invert_sum_Ico
statement:
theorem invert_sum_Ico {r p : H → H → ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hr : IsLusztigMatrix r) {h h' : H}
    (hp : ∀ x, h ≤ x → x < h' → p h x = ∑ y ∈ Finset.Icc h x, invert (p h y) * r y x) :
    invert (∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico h h', invert (p h x) * r x h') =
      -∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico h h', invert (p h x) * r x h'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul, involutive_invert _]
  
  have h2 : ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico h h', p h x * invert (r x h') =
      ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ico h h', ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico y h', invert (p h y) * r y x * invert (r x h') := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [hp x (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hx).1 (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hx).2, Finset.sum_mul]]
    refine Finset.sum_comm' fun x y ↦ ?_
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hx, hx'⟩, hy, hyx⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hyx, hx'⟩, hy, hyx.trans_lt hx'⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hyx, hx'⟩, hy, -⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hy.trans hyx, hx'⟩, hy, hyx⟩
  rw [h2, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y hy ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨hy, hy'⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 hy
  have hδ := congrArg invert (hr.inv y h' hy'.le)
  rw [ite_eq_right hy'.ne, map_zero, map_sum, ← Finset.Ico_insert_right hy'.le,
    Finset.sum_insert Finset.right_notMem_Ico] at hδ
  simp only [map_mul, involutive_invert _, hr.self, mul_one] at hδ
  simp only [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← mul_add, add_comm, hδ, mul_zero]

name: LaurentPolynomial.isLusztigFamily_lusztigFamily
statement:
theorem isLusztigFamily_lusztigFamily {r : H → H → ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hr : IsLusztigMatrix r) :
    IsLusztigFamily r (lusztigFamily r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlt : ∀ {h h' : H}, h < h' → lusztigFamily r h h' =
      negPart (∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico h h', invert (lusztigFamily r h x) * r x h') :=
    fun hh ↦ lusztigFamily_of_not_le r (not_le_of_gt hh)
  have he : ∀ h h', h ≤ h' → lusztigFamily r h h' =
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc h h', invert (lusztigFamily r h x) * r x h' := by
    intro h
    refine induction_Icc (h := h) (P := fun h' ↦ h ≤ h' → lusztigFamily r h h' =
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc h h', invert (lusztigFamily r h x) * r x h') (fun h' ih hh ↦ ?_)
    rw [← Finset.Ico_insert_right hh, Finset.sum_insert Finset.right_notMem_Ico, hr.self,
      mul_one]
    rcases hh.eq_or_lt with rfl | hh
    · rw [Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero, lusztigFamily_of_le r le_rfl, map_one]
    · have hq := invert_sum_Ico hr fun x hx hx' ↦ ih x hx hx' hx
      have h' := eq_negPart_sub_invert_negPart hq
      rw [hlt hh]
      linear_combination -h'
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ lusztigFamily_of_le r le_rfl,
    fun h h' hh ↦ by rw [hlt hh]; exact isNeg_negPart _, he⟩

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsLusztigFamily.eq
statement:
theorem IsLusztigFamily.eq {r p p' : H → H → ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hr : IsLusztigMatrix r)
    (hp : IsLusztigFamily r p) (hp' : IsLusztigFamily r p') {h h' : H} (hh : h ≤ h') :
    p' h h' = p h h'
proof:
:= by
  revert hh
  refine induction_Icc (h := h) (P := fun h' ↦ h ≤ h' → p' h h' = p h h') (fun h' ih hh ↦ ?_) h'
  rcases hh.eq_or_lt with rfl | hh
  · rw [hp.self, hp'.self]
  · have hsplit : ∀ q : H → H → ℤ[T;T⁻¹], IsLusztigFamily r q →
        q h h' - invert (q h h') = ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico h h', invert (q h x) * r x h' := by
      intro q hq
      classical
      have he := hq.eq_sum h h' hh.le
      rw [← Finset.Ico_insert_right hh.le, Finset.sum_insert Finset.right_notMem_Ico, hr.self,
        mul_one] at he
      linear_combination he
    have hs : p' h h' - invert (p' h h') = p h h' - invert (p h h') := by
      rw [hsplit p' hp', hsplit p hp]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨hx, hx'⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 hx
      rw [ih x hx hx' hx]
    have hd : invert (p' h h' - p h h') = p' h h' - p h h' := by
      rw [map_sub]
      linear_combination -hs
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (((hp'.isNeg h h' hh).sub (hp.isNeg h h' hh)).eq_zero_of_invert_eq hd)

name: LaurentPolynomial.IsLusztigFamily.existsUnique
statement:
theorem IsLusztigFamily.existsUnique {r : H → H → ℤ[T;T⁻¹]} (hr : IsLusztigMatrix r) :
    ∃ p, IsLusztigFamily r p ∧
      ∀ p', IsLusztigFamily r p' → ∀ h h', h ≤ h' → p' h h' = p h h'
proof:
:=
  ⟨lusztigFamily r, isLusztigFamily_lusztigFamily hr,
    fun _ hp' _ _ hh ↦ IsLusztigFamily.eq hr (isLusztigFamily_lusztigFamily hr) hp' hh⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.bruhatLE_mul_of_length_mul
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_mul_of_length_mul {u v : W} (h : ℓ (u * v) = ℓ u + ℓ v) :
    cs.BruhatLE u (u * v)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using cs.induction_mul_simple with
  | one => simpa using cs.bruhatLE_refl u
  | mul_simple v i hlt ih =>
    have h1 := cs.length_mul_le u v
    have h2 := cs.length_mul_le (u * v) (s i)
    have h3 := cs.length_mul_simple v i
    rw [cs.length_simple, ← mul_assoc] at *
    have huv : ℓ (u * v) = ℓ u + ℓ v := by omega
    refine (ih huv).trans (cs.bruhatLE_mul_simple ?_)
    rw [IsRightDescent]
    omega

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetRep_bruhatLE
statement: theorem minCosetRep_bruhatLE (J : Set B) (w : W) : cs.BruhatLE (cs.minCosetRep J w) w
proof:
:= by
  have h := bruhatLE_mul_of_length_mul (cs := cs) (u := cs.minCosetRep J w)
    (v := cs.parabolicComponent J w)
  rw [minCosetRep_mul_parabolicComponent] at h
  exact h (length_eq_length_minCosetRep_add w)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.ringHom_ext_of_map_smul
statement:
theorem ringHom_ext_of_map_smul {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℤ[T;T⁻¹] A] {f g : 𝓗 →+* A}
    (hf : ∀ (a : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) x, f (a • x) = invert a • f x)
    (hg : ∀ (a : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) x, g (a • x) = invert a • g x)
    (hT : ∀ i, f (T cs _ (s i)) = g (T cs _ (s i))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  induction x using induction_on cs _ with
  | T w =>
    induction w using cs.induction_simple_mul with
    | one => rw [T_one, map_one, map_one]
    | simple_mul w i hlt ih => rw [← T_simple_mul_T_of_lt cs _ hlt, map_mul, map_mul, ih, hT]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul a x hx => rw [hf, hg, hx]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barL_algebraMap
statement:
theorem barL_algebraMap (a : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) :
    barL cs (algebraMap ℤ[T;T⁻¹] 𝓗 a) = algebraMap ℤ[T;T⁻¹] 𝓗 (invert a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, barL_smul, map_one, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.map_barL_of_forall_simple
statement:
theorem map_barL_of_forall_simple (χ : 𝓗 →ₐ[ℤ[T;T⁻¹]] ℤ[T;T⁻¹])
    (h : ∀ i, χ (barL cs (T cs _ (s i))) = invert (χ (T cs _ (s i)))) (x : 𝓗) :
    χ (barL cs x) = invert (χ x)
proof:
:= by
  have := ringHom_ext_of_map_smul cs (f := χ.toRingHom.comp (barL cs))
    (g := invertHom.comp χ.toRingHom)
    (fun a x ↦ by simp [barL_smul, smul_eq_mul])
    (fun a x ↦ by simp [smul_eq_mul]) h
  exact congrArg (fun φ : 𝓗 →+* ℤ[T;T⁻¹] ↦ φ x) this

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.T_neg_two_mul_T_two
statement:
theorem T_neg_two_mul_T_two :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T (-2) * LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← T_add]; simp

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.ind_barL
statement: theorem ind_barL (x : 𝓗) : ind cs _ (barL cs x) = invert (ind cs _ x)
proof:
:= by
  refine map_barL_of_forall_simple cs _ (fun i ↦ ?_) x
  rw [barL_T_simple, map_sub, _root_.map_smul, _root_.map_smul, ind_T_simple, map_one, invert_T,
    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, T_neg_two_mul_T_two]
  ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.sgn_barL
statement: theorem sgn_barL (x : 𝓗) : sgn cs _ (barL cs x) = invert (sgn cs _ x)
proof:
:= by
  refine map_barL_of_forall_simple cs _ (fun i ↦ ?_) x
  rw [barL_T_simple, map_sub, _root_.map_smul, _root_.map_smul, sgn_T_simple, map_one, map_neg,
    map_one, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isBarCompatible_ind
statement:
theorem isBarCompatible_ind : IsBarCompatible cs (ind cs _) where
  map_barL
proof:
:= ind_barL cs
  isBounded_T w := by
    rw [ind_T, T_pow, ← T_add]
    exact isBounded_T (by omega) (by omega) ⟨ℓ w, by ring⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isBarCompatible_sgn
statement:
theorem isBarCompatible_sgn : IsBarCompatible cs (sgn cs _) where
  map_barL
proof:
:= sgn_barL cs
  isBounded_T w := by
    rw [sgn_T, show ((-1 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) ^ ℓ w) = LaurentPolynomial.C ((-1) ^ ℓ w) by simp,
      mul_comm]
    exact isBounded_C_mul_T _ (by omega) (by omega) ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicHom_barL
statement:
theorem parabolicHom_barL (x : IwahoriHeckeAlgebra (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J)
      (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹])) :
    parabolicHom cs _ J (barL _ x) = barL cs (parabolicHom cs _ J x)
proof:
:= by
  have := ringHom_ext_of_map_smul (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J)
    (f := (parabolicHom cs _ J).toRingHom.comp (barL _))
    (g := (barL cs).comp (parabolicHom cs _ J).toRingHom)
    (fun a x ↦ by simp [barL_smul]) (fun a x ↦ by simp [barL_smul]) (fun j ↦ by
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
        barL_T_simple, map_sub, _root_.map_smul, map_one, parabolicHom_T,
        coe_parabolicCoxeterSystem_simple])
  exact congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ x) this

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isBounded_toFinsupp_barL_T
statement:
theorem isBounded_toFinsupp_barL_T (y w : W) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T ((ℓ y : ℤ) + ℓ w) *
      toFinsupp cs _ (barL cs (T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) w)) y).IsBounded
      ((ℓ w : ℤ) - ℓ y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd, hp0⟩ := exists_rPoly_eq_aeval_natDegree_le cs (isUnit_T_two (A := ℤ)) y w
  rw [toFinsupp_barL_T_apply, hp]
  by_cases hyw : ℓ w < ℓ y
  · rw [hp0 hyw, map_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    exact isBounded_zero _
  have key := (isBounded_C_mul_T ((-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w)) (N := 0) le_rfl le_rfl ⟨0, by ring⟩).mul
    (isBounded_T_mul_aeval (N := (ℓ w : ℤ) - ℓ y) (a := (ℓ y : ℤ) - ℓ w) p (by omega) (by omega)
      ⟨0, by ring⟩)
  rw [zero_add] at key
  convert key using 1
  rw [show (LaurentPolynomial.C ((-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w)) : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) = (-1) ^ (ℓ y + ℓ w) by simp,
    neg_zero, T_zero, mul_one, show (LaurentPolynomial.T ((ℓ y : ℤ) - ℓ w) : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T ((ℓ y : ℤ) + ℓ w) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-(2 * ℓ w : ℤ)) by
      rw [← T_add]; congr 1; ring]
  ring_nf
  rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.barLSemilinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem barLSemilinear_apply (x : 𝓗) : barLSemilinear cs x = barL cs x
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedIdeal_le_comap_barL
statement:
theorem inducedIdeal_le_comap_barL (hχ : ∀ x, χ (barL _ x) = invert (χ x)) :
    inducedIdeal χ ≤ (inducedIdeal χ).comap (barLSemilinear cs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedIdeal, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, barLSemilinear_apply]
  rw [map_sub, ← parabolicHom_barL, barL_algebraMap, ← hχ]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicBar_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parabolicBar_mk (x : 𝓗) :
    parabolicBar hχ (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (barL cs x)
proof: := rfl

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicBar_smul_hecke
statement:
theorem parabolicBar_smul_hecke (h : 𝓗) (m : InducedModule χ) :
    parabolicBar hχ (h • m) = barL cs h • parabolicBar hχ m
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.map_smulₛₗ _ h m

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicBar_smul
statement:
theorem parabolicBar_smul (a : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) (m : InducedModule χ) :
    parabolicBar hχ (a • m) = invert a • parabolicBar hχ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H x => rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, parabolicBar_mk, parabolicBar_mk, barL_smul,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicBar_parabolicBar
statement:
theorem parabolicBar_parabolicBar (m : InducedModule χ) :
    parabolicBar hχ (parabolicBar hχ m) = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H x => rw [parabolicBar_mk, parabolicBar_mk, barL_barL]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicBar_mk_one
statement:
theorem parabolicBar_mk_one :
    parabolicBar hχ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 : 𝓗) : InducedModule χ) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [parabolicBar_mk, map_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.inducedCoeff_T_apply
statement:
theorem inducedCoeff_T_apply [DecidableEq W] (y : W) (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    inducedCoeff χ (T cs _ y) d = if cs.minCosetRep J y = d then
      χ (T _ _ ⟨cs.parabolicComponent J y, parabolicComponent_mem y⟩) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) y = T cs _ (cs.minCosetRep J y) *
      parabolicHom cs _ J (T _ _ ⟨cs.parabolicComponent J y, parabolicComponent_mem y⟩) := by
    rw [parabolicHom_T, T_mul_T_of_mem_minCosetReps cs _ (minCosetRep_mem y)
      (parabolicComponent_mem y), minCosetRep_mul_parabolicComponent]
  rw [e, inducedCoeff_mul_parabolicHom,
    show T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) (cs.minCosetRep J y) =
      T cs _ ((⟨_, minCosetRep_mem y⟩ : cs.minCosetReps J) : W) from rfl, inducedCoeff_T,
    Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  classical
  by_cases h : cs.minCosetRep J y = d
  · rw [ite_eq_left (Subtype.ext h), ite_eq_left h, mul_one]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h' ↦ h (congrArg Subtype.val h')), ite_eq_right h, mul_zero]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.repr_mk_apply
statement:
theorem repr_mk_apply (x : 𝓗) (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    (inducedBasis χ).repr (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) d =
      (toFinsupp cs _ x).sum fun y a ↦ a * inducedCoeff χ (T cs _ y) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (inducedBasis χ).repr = inducedModuleEquiv χ from rfl, inducedModuleEquiv_mk]
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_toFinsupp cs x]
  rw [map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum_apply]
  simp only [_root_.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.repr_parabolicBar_basis_self
statement:
theorem repr_parabolicBar_basis_self (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicBar hχ (inducedBasis χ d)) d =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-(2 * ℓ d : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd1 : cs.minCosetRep J (d : W) = d := (minCosetRep_eq_iff).mpr ⟨d.2, by simp⟩
  rw [inducedBasis_apply, parabolicBar_mk, repr_mk_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  have hd : (d : W) ∈
      (toFinsupp cs _ (barL cs (T cs (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) (d : W)))).support := by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, toFinsupp_barL_T_self]
    exact (LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T _).ne_zero
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem _ hd, toFinsupp_barL_T_self, inducedCoeff_T_apply,
    ite_eq_left hd1]
  · have : (⟨cs.parabolicComponent J d, parabolicComponent_mem (d : W)⟩ :
        cs.parabolicSubgroup J) = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have h := minCosetRep_mul_parabolicComponent (cs := cs) (J := J) (d : W)
      rw [hd1] at h
      simpa using h
    rw [this, T_one, map_one, mul_one]
  · intro y hy hyd
    rw [inducedCoeff_T_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · exfalso
      have hle := bruhatLE_of_toFinsupp_barL_T_ne_zero cs (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hy)
      have hl := length_eq_length_minCosetRep_add (cs := cs) (J := J) y
      rw [h] at hl
      exact hyd (hle.eq_of_length_le (by omega))
    · rw [mul_zero]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bruhatLE_of_repr_parabolicBar_basis_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [inducedBasis_apply, parabolicBar_mk, repr_mk_apply, Finsupp.sum] at h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h
  rw [inducedCoeff_T_apply] at hne
  split_ifs at hne with hyd
  · rw [← hyd]
    exact (minCosetRep_bruhatLE cs J y).trans
      (bruhatLE_of_toFinsupp_barL_T_ne_zero cs (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hy))
  · exact absurd (mul_zero _) hne

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isBounded_repr_parabolicBar_basis
statement:
theorem isBounded_repr_parabolicBar_basis (d d' : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T ((ℓ d' : ℤ) + ℓ d) *
      (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicBar hχ (inducedBasis χ d)) d').IsBounded
      ((ℓ d : ℤ) - ℓ d')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [inducedBasis_apply, parabolicBar_mk, repr_mk_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine isBounded_sum _ fun y _ ↦ ?_
  rw [inducedCoeff_T_apply]
  split_ifs with hyd
  · set z : cs.parabolicSubgroup J := ⟨cs.parabolicComponent J y, parabolicComponent_mem y⟩
    have hl : ℓ y = ℓ d' + (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).length z := by
      rw [length_parabolicCoxeterSystem, ← hyd]
      exact length_eq_length_minCosetRep_add (J := J) y
    have key := (isBounded_toFinsupp_barL_T cs y d).mul (hχ.isBounded_T z)
    convert key.of_eq (show ((ℓ d : ℤ) - ℓ y) + (cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).length z =
      (ℓ d : ℤ) - ℓ d' by rw [hl]; push_cast; ring) using 1
    rw [show (LaurentPolynomial.T ((ℓ d' : ℤ) + ℓ d) : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T ((ℓ y : ℤ) + ℓ d) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-((cs.parabolicCoxeterSystem J).length z : ℤ)) by
          rw [← T_add, hl]; congr 1; push_cast; ring]
    ring
  · rw [mul_zero, mul_zero]
    exact isBounded_zero _

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.normalizedBasis_apply
statement:
theorem normalizedBasis_apply (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    normalizedBasis cs χ d = (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ d : ℤ)) : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) • inducedBasis χ d
proof:
:=
  Basis.unitsSMul_apply d

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.normalizedBasis_repr_apply
statement:
theorem normalizedBasis_repr_apply (m : InducedModule χ) (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    (normalizedBasis cs χ).repr m d =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (ℓ d : ℤ) * (inducedBasis χ).repr m d
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedBasis, Basis.repr_unitsSMul, Units.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  exact Units.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, ← T_add]; simp)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isBarTriangular
statement:
theorem isBarTriangular :
    (normalizedBasis cs χ).IsBarTriangular (parabolicBar hχ).toAddMonoidHom
      (fun d ↦ (ℓ d : ℤ)) where
  map_smul a x
proof:
:= parabolicBar_smul hχ a x
  involutive x := parabolicBar_parabolicBar hχ x
  repr_self d := by
    rw [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, normalizedBasis_repr_apply, normalizedBasis_apply,
      parabolicBar_smul, _root_.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      repr_parabolicBar_basis_self, invert_T, ← T_add, ← T_add, neg_neg]
    convert T_zero using 2
    ring
  le_of_repr_ne_zero {d d'} h := by
    rw [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, normalizedBasis_repr_apply, normalizedBasis_apply,
      parabolicBar_smul, _root_.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
    exact bruhatLE_of_repr_parabolicBar_basis_ne_zero hχ fun h' ↦ h (by rw [h', mul_zero, mul_zero])
  isBounded d d' := by
    rw [LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, normalizedBasis_repr_apply, normalizedBasis_apply,
      parabolicBar_smul, _root_.map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, invert_T, neg_neg,
      ← mul_assoc, ← T_add]
    exact isBounded_repr_parabolicBar_basis hχ d d'
  finite_Iio d := ((cs.finite_setOf_bruhatLE d).preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn).subset
    fun _ h ↦ (Set.mem_Iio.mp h).le

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicBar_parabolicKLBasis
statement:
theorem parabolicBar_parabolicKLBasis (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    parabolicBar hχ (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) = parabolicKLBasis hχ d
proof:
:=
  (isBarTriangular hχ).apply_canonical d

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.repr_parabolicKLBasis_self
statement:
theorem repr_parabolicKLBasis_self (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d = LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ d : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isBarTriangular hχ).repr_canonical_self d
  rw [normalizedBasis_repr_apply] at h
  rw [parabolicKLBasis, ← one_mul ((inducedBasis χ).repr _ d), ← T_zero,
    show (0 : ℤ) = -(ℓ d : ℤ) + ℓ d by ring, T_add, mul_assoc, h, mul_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isNeg_repr_parabolicKLBasis
statement:
theorem isNeg_repr_parabolicKLBasis {d d' : cs.minCosetReps J} (h : d' ≠ d) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T (ℓ d' : ℤ) * (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d').IsNeg
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalizedBasis_repr_apply]
  exact (isBarTriangular hχ).isNeg_repr_canonical h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bruhatLE_of_repr_parabolicKLBasis_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_of_repr_parabolicKLBasis_ne_zero {d d' : cs.minCosetReps J}
    (h : (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d' ≠ 0) : cs.BruhatLE d' d
proof:
:= by
  refine (isBarTriangular hχ).le_of_repr_canonical_ne_zero (j := d') ?_
  intro h'
  rw [normalizedBasis_repr_apply] at h'
  exact h ((mul_eq_zero.mp h').resolve_left (LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T _).ne_zero)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.isBounded_repr_parabolicKLBasis
statement:
theorem isBounded_repr_parabolicKLBasis (d d' : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T (ℓ d' : ℤ) * (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d').IsBounded
      ((ℓ d : ℤ) - ℓ d')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalizedBasis_repr_apply]
  exact (isBarTriangular hχ).isBounded_repr_canonical d d'

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.eq_parabolicKLBasis
statement:
theorem eq_parabolicKLBasis {d : cs.minCosetReps J} {C : InducedModule χ}
    (hC : parabolicBar hχ C = C)
    (hd : (inducedBasis χ).repr C d = LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ d : ℤ)))
    (hneg : ∀ d', d' ≠ d → (LaurentPolynomial.T (ℓ d' : ℤ) * (inducedBasis χ).repr C d').IsNeg) :
    C = parabolicKLBasis hχ d
proof:
:= by
  refine (isBarTriangular hχ).eq_canonical hC ?_ fun d' h ↦ ?_
  · rw [normalizedBasis_repr_apply, hd, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero]
  · rw [normalizedBasis_repr_apply]
    exact hneg d' h

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.existsUnique_parabolicKLBasis
statement:
theorem existsUnique_parabolicKLBasis (d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    ∃! C : InducedModule χ, parabolicBar hχ C = C ∧
      (inducedBasis χ).repr C d = LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ d : ℤ)) ∧
      ∀ d', d' ≠ d → (LaurentPolynomial.T (ℓ d' : ℤ) * (inducedBasis χ).repr C d').IsNeg
proof:
:=
  ⟨parabolicKLBasis hχ d, ⟨parabolicBar_parabolicKLBasis hχ d, repr_parabolicKLBasis_self hχ d,
    fun _ h ↦ isNeg_repr_parabolicKLBasis hχ h⟩,
    fun _ ⟨hC, hd, hneg⟩ ↦ eq_parabolicKLBasis hχ hC hd hneg⟩

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.exists_parabolicKLPoly
statement:
theorem exists_parabolicKLPoly (d' d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    ∃ P : ℤ[X], (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d' =
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ d : ℤ)) * aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) P ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, P.coeff k =
        ((inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d').coeff (-(ℓ d : ℤ) + 2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_eq_T_mul_aeval fun n hn ↦ ?_
  have hb := isBounded_repr_parabolicKLBasis hχ d d' (n + ℓ d')
    (by rwa [coeff_T_mul, add_sub_cancel_right])
  obtain ⟨h1, -, h3⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
  convert h3 using 1
  ring

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.repr_parabolicKLBasis
statement:
theorem repr_parabolicKLBasis (d' d : cs.minCosetReps J) :
    (inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d' =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-(ℓ d : ℤ)) *
        aeval (LaurentPolynomial.T 2 : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]) (parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d)
proof:
:=
  (exists_parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d).choose_spec.1

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.coeff_parabolicKLPoly
statement:
theorem coeff_parabolicKLPoly (d' d : cs.minCosetReps J) (k : ℕ) :
    (parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d).coeff k =
      ((inducedBasis χ).repr (parabolicKLBasis hχ d) d').coeff (-(ℓ d : ℤ) + 2 * k)
proof:
:=
  (exists_parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d).choose_spec.2 k

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicKLPoly_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parabolicKLPoly_self (d : cs.minCosetReps J) : parabolicKLPoly hχ d d = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine T_mul_aeval_T_two_injective (-(ℓ d : ℤ)) ?_
  simp only
  rw [← repr_parabolicKLBasis, repr_parabolicKLBasis_self, map_one, mul_one]

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.parabolicKLPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem parabolicKLPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE {d' d : cs.minCosetReps J}
    (h : ¬cs.BruhatLE d' d) : parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine T_mul_aeval_T_two_injective (-(ℓ d : ℤ)) ?_
  simp only
  rw [← repr_parabolicKLBasis, map_zero, mul_zero]
  by_contra hne
  exact h (bruhatLE_of_repr_parabolicKLBasis_ne_zero hχ hne)

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.bruhatLE_of_parabolicKLPoly_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bruhatLE_of_parabolicKLPoly_ne_zero {d' d : cs.minCosetReps J}
    (h : parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d ≠ 0) : cs.BruhatLE d' d
proof:
:=
  not_not.mp fun h' ↦ h (parabolicKLPoly_eq_zero_of_not_bruhatLE hχ h')

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.coeff_parabolicKLPoly_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_parabolicKLPoly_eq_zero {d' d : cs.minCosetReps J} (h : d' ≠ d) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : ℓ d ≤ 2 * k + ℓ d') : (parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d).coeff k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_parabolicKLPoly]
  have := isNeg_repr_parabolicKLBasis hχ h (-(ℓ d : ℤ) + 2 * k + ℓ d') (by omega)
  rwa [coeff_T_mul, add_sub_cancel_right] at this

name: IwahoriHeckeAlgebra.two_mul_natDegree_parabolicKLPoly_add_length_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hl := hle.eq_or_length_lt.resolve_left fun h ↦ hne (Subtype.ext h)
  have : (parabolicKLPoly hχ d' d).natDegree ≤ (ℓ d - ℓ d' - 1) / 2 :=
    natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr fun N hN ↦
      coeff_parabolicKLPoly_eq_zero hχ hne (by
        have : (ℓ d - ℓ d' - 1) / 2 < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
        omega)
  omega

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetRep_of_mem
statement: theorem minCosetRep_of_mem {d : W} (hd : d ∈ cs.minCosetReps J) : cs.minCosetRep J d = d
proof:
:=
  minCosetRep_eq_iff.mpr ⟨hd, by simp⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.parabolicComponent_of_mem
statement:
theorem parabolicComponent_of_mem {d : W} (hd : d ∈ cs.minCosetReps J) :
    cs.parabolicComponent J d = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [parabolicComponent, minCosetRep_of_mem hd, inv_mul_cancel]

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetRep_mul
statement:
theorem minCosetRep_mul {d z : W} (hd : d ∈ cs.minCosetReps J) (hz : z ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J) :
    cs.minCosetRep J (d * z) = d
proof:
:=
  minCosetRep_eq_iff.mpr ⟨hd, by simpa using hz⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.mem_parabolicSubgroup_of_bruhatLE
statement:
theorem mem_parabolicSubgroup_of_bruhatLE {y w : W} (hw : w ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J)
    (h : cs.BruhatLE y w) : y ∈ cs.parabolicSubgroup J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hJ, rfl⟩ := exists_isReduced_of_mem_parabolicSubgroup hw
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩ := hω.bruhatLE_iff.mp h
  exact wordProd_mem_parabolicSubgroup fun i hi ↦ hJ i (hσ.subset hi)

name: CoxeterSystem.minCosetReps_empty
