          rw [← hn, ← hn', ← hC.isSome_eIter_iff, ← hC'.isSome_eIter_iff, heIter,
            Option.isSome_map]
        rw [hn, hn']
        have a1 := (h1 n).1 le_rfl
        have a2 := (h1 n').2 le_rfl
        exact_mod_cast le_antisymm (by exact_mod_cast a2) (by exact_mod_cast a1)
      e_map := he
      f_map := fun i b ↦ by
        cases h : C.f i b with
        | none =>
          have h1 : C.fWord (i :: wd b) b₀ = none := by
            rw [fWord_cons, hwd, Option.bind_some, h]
          have h2 := (hnone _).1 h1
          rw [fWord_cons, hΦ _ _ (hwd b), Option.bind_some] at h2
          rw [Option.map_none]
          exact h2
        | some b₁ =>
          have h1 : C.fWord (i :: wd b) b₀ = some b₁ := by
            rw [fWord_cons, hwd, Option.bind_some, h]
          have h2 := hΦ _ _ h1
          rw [fWord_cons, hΦ _ _ (hwd b), Option.bind_some] at h2
          rw [Option.map_some]
          exact h2 }, hΦ⟩

name: Crystal.Equiv.eq_of_fWord
statement:
theorem Equiv.eq_of_fWord {b₀ : B} (hgen : ∀ b, ∃ w, C.fWord w b₀ = some b) {Φ Φ' : Equiv C C'}
    (h : Φ b₀ = Φ' b₀) (b : B) : Φ b = Φ' b
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (ψ : Equiv C C') (w : List ι), C'.fWord w (ψ b₀) = (C.fWord w b₀).map ψ := by
    intro ψ w
    induction w with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons j w ih =>
      rw [fWord_cons, fWord_cons, ih]
      cases C.fWord w b₀ with
      | none => rfl
      | some c => exact ψ.f_apply j c
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hgen b
  have h1 := key Φ w
  have h2 := key Φ' w
  rw [hw, Option.map_some] at h1 h2
  rw [h] at h1
  exact Option.some_injective _ (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: Crystal.Similarity.exists_lift
statement:
theorem Similarity.exists_lift (σ : Similarity C E m) (ψ : StrictHom F E)
    (hψ : Function.Injective ψ) {b₀ : B} {f₀ : BF} (h₀ : ψ f₀ = σ b₀)
    (hgen : ∀ b, ∃ w, C.fWord w b₀ = some b) :
    ∃ T : Similarity C F m, T b₀ = f₀ ∧ ∀ b, ψ (T b) = σ b
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∀ b, ∃ y, ψ y = σ b := fun b ↦ by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hgen b
    have h1 := σ.fWord_stretchWord w b₀
    rw [hw, Option.map_some, ← h₀, ψ.fWord_apply, Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h1
    obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := h1
    exact ⟨y, hy⟩
  choose T hT using hex
  have hmap : ∀ o : Option B, (o.map T).map ψ = o.map σ := fun o ↦ by
    cases o <;> simp [hT]
  refine ⟨
    { toFun := T
      wt_map := fun b ↦ by rw [← ψ.wt_apply, hT, σ.wt_apply]
      ε_map := fun i b ↦ by rw [← ψ.ε_apply, hT, σ.ε_apply]
      e_map := fun i b ↦ by
        apply Option.map_injective hψ
        rw [← ψ.eIter_apply, hT, σ.eIter_apply, hmap]
      f_map := fun i b ↦ by
        apply Option.map_injective hψ
        rw [← ψ.fIter_apply, hT, σ.fIter_apply, hmap] }, hψ ?_, hT⟩
  change ψ (T b₀) = ψ f₀
  rw [hT, h₀]

name: Crystal.Similarity.injective_of_fWord
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (w : List ι) (b : B), C.fWord w b₀ = some b → ∀ b', σ b = σ b' → b = b' := by
    intro w
    induction w with
    | nil =>
      intro b hb b' hbb'
      cases hb
      obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := hgen b'
      cases w' with
      | nil => exact Option.some_injective _ hw'
      | cons j w'' =>
        exfalso
        obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hw'
        have h1 := σ.eIter_apply j b'
        rw [(C.f_eq_some_iff j c b').1 hc, Option.map_some, ← hbb', σ.eIter_apply, hb₀] at h1
        cases h1
    | cons j w ih =>
      intro b hb b' hbb'
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hf⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hb
      have h1 := σ.eIter_apply j b
      rw [(C.f_eq_some_iff j c b).1 hf, Option.map_some, hbb', σ.eIter_apply] at h1
      obtain ⟨c', hc', hcc⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h1
      have h2 := ih c hc c' hcc.symm
      subst h2
      rw [← C.f_eq_some_iff] at hc'
      exact Option.some_injective _ (hf.symm.trans hc')
  intro b b' h
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hgen b
  exact key w b hw b' h

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.wt_u
statement: lemma wt_u {μ : X} (h : D.Orbit Λ μ) : C.wt (S.u μ) = μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [u, h, ↓reduceDIte]
  exact (S.existsUnique_wt μ h).exists.choose_spec

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.eq_u
statement: lemma eq_u {μ : X} (h : D.Orbit Λ μ) {b : B} (hb : C.wt b = μ) : b = S.u μ
proof:
:=
  (S.existsUnique_wt μ h).unique hb (S.wt_u h)

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.u_Λ
statement: lemma u_Λ : S.u Λ = b₀
proof: := (S.eq_u CartanDatum.Orbit.self S.wt_b₀).symm

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.ε_u
statement: lemma ε_u {μ : X} (h : D.Orbit Λ μ) (i : ι) (ha : 0 ≤ D.coroot i μ) : C.ε i (S.u μ) = 0
proof:
:=
  S.ε_eq_zero _ i (by rw [S.wt_u h]; exact h) (by rw [S.wt_u h]; exact ha)

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.φ_u
statement:
lemma φ_u {μ : X} (h : D.Orbit Λ μ) (i : ι) (ha : 0 ≤ D.coroot i μ) :
    C.φ i (S.u μ) = ((D.coroot i μ : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.φ_eq, S.ε_u h i ha, S.wt_u h, zero_add]

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.fIter_u
statement:
lemma fIter_u {μ : X} (h : D.Orbit Λ μ) (i : ι) (ha : 0 ≤ D.coroot i μ) :
    C.fIter i (D.coroot i μ).toNat (S.u μ) = some (S.u (D.reflection i μ))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (C.fIter i (D.coroot i μ).toNat (S.u μ)).isSome := by
    rw [S.isSeminormal.isSome_fIter_iff, S.φ_u h i ha, ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
      WithBot.coe_le_coe, Int.toNat_of_nonneg ha]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 hs
  rw [hy, S.eq_u (h.reflection i) (b := y)]
  rw [C.wt_fIter hy, S.wt_u h, D.reflection_apply, ← natCast_zsmul, Int.toNat_of_nonneg ha]

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.fIter_u_reflection
statement:
lemma fIter_u_reflection {μ : X} (h : D.Orbit Λ μ) (i : ι) (ha : D.coroot i μ < 0) :
    C.fIter i (-D.coroot i μ).toNat (S.u (D.reflection i μ)) = some (S.u μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := S.fIter_u (h.reflection i) i (by rw [D.coroot_reflection]; omega)
  rwa [D.coroot_reflection, D.reflection_reflection] at h'

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.T_u
statement:
theorem T_u {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {μ : X} (h : D.Orbit Λ μ) :
    S.T m hm (S.u μ) = TPow.replicate (S.u μ) m
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | self => rw [S.u_Λ, S.T_b₀]
  | @reflection μ i h ih =>
    by_cases ha : 0 ≤ D.coroot i μ
    · have h1 := (S.T m hm).fIter_mul i (D.coroot i μ).toNat (S.u μ)
      rw [S.fIter_u h i ha, Option.map_some, ih, mul_comm,
        fIter_replicate i (S.ε_u h i ha) (by rw [S.φ_u h i ha, Int.toNat_of_nonneg ha])
          (S.fIter_u h i ha) m m le_rfl, TPow.replicate₂_self] at h1
      exact (Option.some_injective _ h1).symm
    · push Not at ha
      have hν : 0 ≤ D.coroot i (D.reflection i μ) := by rw [D.coroot_reflection]; omega
      have hν' : (D.coroot i (D.reflection i μ)).toNat = (-D.coroot i μ).toNat := by
        rw [D.coroot_reflection]
      have h1 := (S.T m hm).fIter_mul i (-D.coroot i μ).toNat (S.u (D.reflection i μ))
      rw [S.fIter_u_reflection h i ha, Option.map_some, ih] at h1
      have h2 := fIter_replicate (C := C) (a := (-D.coroot i μ).toNat) i
        (S.ε_u (h.reflection i) i hν)
        (by rw [S.φ_u (h.reflection i) i hν, ← hν', Int.toNat_of_nonneg hν])
        (by rw [← hν', S.fIter_u (h.reflection i) i hν, D.reflection_reflection]) m m le_rfl
      rw [TPow.replicate₂_self, ← mul_comm] at h2
      rw [C.tensorPow m |>.fIter_eq_some_iff] at h1 h2
      exact Option.some_injective _ (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.ExtRel.strRel
statement: lemma ExtRel.strRel {x : B} {x' : B'} (h : ExtRel S S' x x') (i : ι) : StrRel S S' i x x'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  by_cases ha : 0 ≤ D.coroot i μ
  · exact ⟨μ, hμ, ha, 0, Nat.zero_le _, rfl, rfl⟩
  · push Not at ha
    refine ⟨D.reflection i μ, hμ.reflection i, by rw [D.coroot_reflection]; omega,
      (-D.coroot i μ).toNat, by rw [D.coroot_reflection], S.fIter_u_reflection hμ i ha,
      S'.fIter_u_reflection hμ i ha⟩

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.ExtRel.eq_iff
statement:
lemma ExtRel.eq_iff {x y : B} {x' y' : B'} (hx : ExtRel S S' x x') (hy : ExtRel S S' y y') :
    x = y ↔ x' = y'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, rfl, rfl⟩ := hy
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg C.wt h
    rw [S.wt_u hμ, S.wt_u hν] at this
    rw [this]
  · intro h
    have := congrArg C'.wt h
    rw [S'.wt_u hμ, S'.wt_u hν] at this
    rw [this]

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.forall₂_extRel_eq_iff
statement:
lemma forall₂_extRel_eq_iff : {n : ℕ} → {x y : TPow B n} → {x' y' : TPow B' n} →
    TPow.Forall₂ (ExtRel S S') x x' → TPow.Forall₂ (ExtRel S S') y y' → (x = y ↔ x' = y')
proof:
| 0, _, _, _, _, _, _ => ⟨fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  | _ + 1, x, y, x', y', hx, hy => by
    have h1 := hx.1.eq_iff S S' hy.1
    have h2 := forall₂_extRel_eq_iff hx.2 hy.2
    obtain ⟨a, x⟩ := x
    obtain ⟨b, y⟩ := y
    obtain ⟨a', x'⟩ := x'
    obtain ⟨b', y'⟩ := y'
    change (a, x) = (b, y) ↔ (a', x') = (b', y')
    rw [Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, h1, h2]

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.isColourRel
statement:
lemma isColourRel (i : ι) : IsColourRel C C' i (StrRel S S' i) where
  ε_eq x x' h
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, ha, c, -, hx, hx'⟩ := h
    rw [C.ε_fIter hx, C'.ε_fIter hx', S.ε_u hμ i ha, S'.ε_u hμ i ha]
  coroot_eq x x' h := by
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, -, c, -, hx, hx'⟩ := h
    rw [C.wt_fIter hx, C'.wt_fIter hx', S.wt_u hμ, S'.wt_u hμ]
  f_rel x x' h := by
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, ha, c, hc, hx, hx'⟩ := h
    have e1 : C.f i x = C.fIter i (c + 1) (S.u μ) := by rw [fIter_succ', hx, Option.bind_some]
    have e2 : C'.f i x' = C'.fIter i (c + 1) (S'.u μ) := by
      rw [fIter_succ', hx', Option.bind_some]
    rw [e1, e2]
    by_cases hc' : c + 1 ≤ (D.coroot i μ).toNat
    · have hs : (C.fIter i (c + 1) (S.u μ)).isSome := by
        rw [S.isSeminormal.isSome_fIter_iff, S.φ_u hμ i ha, ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
          WithBot.coe_le_coe]
        omega
      have hs' : (C'.fIter i (c + 1) (S'.u μ)).isSome := by
        rw [S'.isSeminormal.isSome_fIter_iff, S'.φ_u hμ i ha, ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
          WithBot.coe_le_coe]
        omega
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 hs
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 hs'
      exact Or.inr ⟨y, y', hy, hy', μ, hμ, ha, c + 1, hc', hy, hy'⟩
    · have hs : ¬ (C.fIter i (c + 1) (S.u μ)).isSome := by
        rw [S.isSeminormal.isSome_fIter_iff, S.φ_u hμ i ha, ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
          WithBot.coe_le_coe]
        omega
      have hs' : ¬ (C'.fIter i (c + 1) (S'.u μ)).isSome := by
        rw [S'.isSeminormal.isSome_fIter_iff, S'.φ_u hμ i ha, ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
          WithBot.coe_le_coe]
        omega
      exact Or.inl ⟨Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none.1 hs, Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none.1 hs'⟩

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.strLen_eq
statement:
lemma strLen_eq {i : ι} {μ : X} (hμ : D.Orbit Λ μ) (ha : 0 ≤ D.coroot i μ) {c : ℕ} {x : B}
    (hx : C.fIter i c (S.u μ) = some x) : C.strLen i x = (D.coroot i μ).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := C.φ_fIter hx
  rw [S.φ_u hμ i ha] at h1
  rw [strLen, C.ε_fIter hx, S.ε_u hμ i ha, zero_add, eq_coe_sub_of_coe_eq_add h1,
    ← WithBot.coe_natCast, ← WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.unbotD_coe, add_sub_cancel]

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.forall₂_T_of_strRel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, ha, c, hc, hx, hx'⟩ := h
  rw [strLen_eq S hμ ha hx] at hdvd
  set a := (D.coroot i μ).toNat with ha'
  have h1 := (S.T K hK).fIter_mul i c (S.u μ)
  have h1' := (S'.T K hK).fIter_mul i c (S'.u μ)
  rw [hx, Option.map_some, S.T_u hK hμ] at h1
  rw [hx', Option.map_some, S'.T_u hK hμ] at h1'
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with h0 | hpos
  · have hc0 : c = 0 := by omega
    subst hc0
    cases hx
    cases hx'
    rw [S.T_u hK hμ, S'.T_u hK hμ]
    exact TPow.forall₂_replicate ⟨μ, hμ, rfl, rfl⟩ K
  · rw [max_eq_right (by omega)] at hdvd
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdvd
    have hq : K * c = a * (t * c) := by rw [ht]; ring
    have hqK : t * c ≤ K := by rw [ht]; nlinarith
    have e := fIter_replicate (C := C) i (S.ε_u hμ i ha)
      (by rw [S.φ_u hμ i ha, Int.toNat_of_nonneg ha]) (S.fIter_u hμ i ha) K (t * c) hqK
    have e' := fIter_replicate (C := C') i (S'.ε_u hμ i ha)
      (by rw [S'.φ_u hμ i ha, Int.toNat_of_nonneg ha]) (S'.fIter_u hμ i ha) K (t * c) hqK
    rw [hq, e] at h1
    rw [hq, e'] at h1'
    rw [← Option.some_injective _ h1, ← Option.some_injective _ h1']
    exact TPow.forall₂_replicate₂ ⟨_, hμ.reflection i, rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨μ, hμ, rfl, rfl⟩ _ _

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.forall₂_T_of_extRel
statement:
lemma forall₂_T_of_extRel {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) {x : B} {x' : B'} (h : ExtRel S S' x x') :
    TPow.Forall₂ (ExtRel S S') (S.T K hK x) (S'.T K hK x')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [S.T_u hK hμ, S'.T_u hK hμ]
  exact TPow.forall₂_replicate ⟨μ, hμ, rfl, rfl⟩ K

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.lvl_def
statement:
lemma lvl_def (M : ℕ) (w : List ι) :
    lvl C b₀ M w = (C.tensorPow M).fWord (stretchWord M w) (TPow.replicate b₀ M)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.lvl_eq
statement:
lemma lvl_eq {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (w : List ι) :
    lvl C b₀ M w = (C.fWord w b₀).map (S.T M hM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lvl, ← S.T_b₀ M hM, (S.T M hM).fWord_stretchWord]

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.lvl_mul
statement:
lemma lvl_mul {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ) (w : List ι) :
    lvl C b₀ (K * N) w = (lvl C b₀ N w).map (Similarity.powMap hK (S.T K hK) N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lvl, stretchWord_mul, ← Similarity.powMap_replicate hK (S.T K hK) (S.T_b₀ K hK),
    (Similarity.powMap hK (S.T K hK) N).fWord_stretchWord]
  rfl

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.lvl_cons
statement:
lemma lvl_cons (M : ℕ) (i : ι) (w : List ι) :
    lvl C b₀ M (i :: w) = (lvl C b₀ M w).bind ((C.tensorPow M).fIter i M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lvl, lvl, fWord_stretchWord_cons]

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.forall₂_powMap
statement:
lemma forall₂_powMap {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) {N : ℕ} {l : TPow B N} {l' : TPow B' N}
    (h : TPow.Forall₂ (ExtRel S S') l l') :
    TPow.Forall₂ (ExtRel S S') (Similarity.powMap hK (S.T K hK) N l)
      (Similarity.powMap hK (S'.T K hK) N l')
proof:
:= by
  rw [Similarity.powMap_apply, Similarity.powMap_apply]
  exact TPow.forall₂_flatten (TPow.forall₂_map (fun _ _ hx ↦ forall₂_T_of_extRel S S' hK hx) h)

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.RelAt.mul
statement:
lemma RelAt.mul {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) {N : ℕ} {w : List ι} (h : RelAt S S' N w) :
    RelAt S S' (K * N) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [RelAt, lvl_mul S hK, lvl_mul S' hK]
  rcases h with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨l, l', h1, h1', hl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [h1]; rfl, by rw [h1']; rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨_, _, by rw [h1]; rfl, by rw [h1']; rfl, forall₂_powMap S S' hK hl⟩

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.relAt_nil
statement: lemma relAt_nil : RelAt S S' 1 []
proof:
:= by
  refine Or.inr ⟨TPow.replicate b₀ 1, TPow.replicate b₀' 1, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact TPow.forall₂_replicate ⟨Λ, CartanDatum.Orbit.self, S.u_Λ.symm, S'.u_Λ.symm⟩ 1

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.forall₂_and_mem
statement:
lemma forall₂_and_mem {β β' : Type*} {r : β → β' → Prop} {p : β → Prop} : {n : ℕ} →
    {x : TPow β n} → {x' : TPow β' n} → TPow.Forall₂ r x x' → (∀ a ∈ TPow.toList x, p a) →
    TPow.Forall₂ (fun a a' ↦ r a a' ∧ p a) x x'
proof:
| 0, _, _, _, _ => True.intro
  | _ + 1, _, _, h, hp => ⟨⟨h.1, hp _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩,
      forall₂_and_mem h.2 fun a ha ↦ hp a (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha)⟩

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.RelAt.cons
statement:
lemma RelAt.cons {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {w : List ι} (h : RelAt S S' N w) (i : ι) :
    ∃ M, 0 < M ∧ RelAt S S' M (i :: w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨l, l', h1, h1', hl⟩
  · exact ⟨N, hN, Or.inl ⟨by rw [lvl_cons, h1]; rfl, by rw [lvl_cons, h1']; rfl⟩⟩
  have hf := (isColourRel S S' i).fIter_tensorPow N
    (TPow.forall₂_mono (fun _ _ hx ↦ ExtRel.strRel S S' hx i) hl)
  rcases hf with ⟨h2, h2'⟩ | ⟨m, m', h2, h2', hm⟩
  · exact ⟨N, hN, Or.inl ⟨by rw [lvl_cons, h1, Option.bind_some, h2],
      by rw [lvl_cons, h1', Option.bind_some, h2']⟩⟩
  set K := ((TPow.toList m).map fun x ↦ max 1 (C.strLen i x)).prod with hKdef
  have hK : 0 < K := by
    rw [hKdef, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, List.prod_eq_zero_iff]
    simp
  have hm2 := forall₂_and_mem (p := fun x ↦ max 1 (C.strLen i x) ∣ K) hm
    (fun a ha ↦ List.dvd_prod (List.mem_map_of_mem ha))
  refine ⟨K * N, Nat.mul_pos hK hN, Or.inr ⟨Similarity.powMap hK (S.T K hK) N m,
    Similarity.powMap hK (S'.T K hK) N m', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [lvl_cons, lvl_mul S hK, h1, Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, Similarity.fIter_mul, h2,
      Option.map_some]
  · rw [lvl_cons, lvl_mul S' hK, h1', Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, Similarity.fIter_mul,
      h2', Option.map_some]
  · rw [Similarity.powMap_apply, Similarity.powMap_apply]
    exact TPow.forall₂_flatten
      (TPow.forall₂_map (fun _ _ hx ↦ forall₂_T_of_strRel S S' hK hx.1 hx.2) hm2)

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.exists_relAt
statement: theorem exists_relAt (w : List ι) : ∃ N, 0 < N ∧ RelAt S S' N w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, one_pos, relAt_nil S S'⟩
  | cons i w ih =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN, h⟩ := ih
    exact h.cons S S' hN i

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.optRel_eq_iff
proof:
:= by
  rcases h₁ with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨y₁, y₁', rfl, rfl, hy₁⟩ <;>
    rcases h₂ with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨y₂, y₂', rfl, rfl, hy₂⟩
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
  · rw [Option.some_inj, Option.some_inj]
    exact hr _ _ _ _ hy₁ hy₂

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.fWord_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem fWord_eq_none_iff (w : List ι) : C.fWord w b₀ = none ↔ C'.fWord w b₀' = none
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, h⟩ := exists_relAt S S' w
  rw [RelAt, lvl_eq S hN, lvl_eq S' hN] at h
  rcases h with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨l, l', h1, h1', -⟩
  · rw [Option.map_eq_none_iff] at h1 h1'
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ h1', fun _ ↦ h1⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h1
    obtain ⟨b', hb', -⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h1'
    rw [hb, hb']
    simp

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.fWord_eq_fWord_iff
statement:
theorem fWord_eq_fWord_iff (w w' : List ι) :
    C.fWord w b₀ = C.fWord w' b₀ ↔ C'.fWord w b₀' = C'.fWord w' b₀'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, h₁⟩ := exists_relAt S S' w
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, h₂⟩ := exists_relAt S S' w'
  have e₁ := h₁.mul S S' hN₂
  have e₂ := h₂.mul S S' hN₁
  rw [Nat.mul_comm] at e₂
  have hM : 0 < N₂ * N₁ := Nat.mul_pos hN₂ hN₁
  have key := optRel_eq_iff (fun x x' y y' hx hy ↦ forall₂_extRel_eq_iff S S' hx hy) e₁ e₂
  rw [lvl_eq S hM, lvl_eq S hM, lvl_eq S' hM, lvl_eq S' hM,
    (Option.map_injective (S.T_injective _ hM)).eq_iff,
    (Option.map_injective (S'.T_injective _ hM)).eq_iff] at key
  exact key

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.exists_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_equiv : ∃ Φ : Equiv C C', ∀ w b, C.fWord w b₀ = some b →
    C'.fWord w b₀' = some (Φ b)
proof:
:=
  exists_equiv_of_fWord S.isSeminormal S'.isSeminormal S.exists_fWord S'.exists_fWord
    (by rw [S.wt_b₀, S'.wt_b₀]) (fWord_eq_none_iff S S') (fWord_eq_fWord_iff S S')

name: Crystal.SimilarityData.existsUnique_equiv
statement:
theorem existsUnique_equiv : ∃ Φ : Equiv C C', Φ b₀ = b₀' ∧
    ∀ Φ' : Equiv C C', Φ' b₀ = b₀' → ∀ b, Φ' b = Φ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ := exists_equiv S S'
  have h0 : Φ b₀ = b₀' := (Option.some_injective _ (hΦ [] b₀ rfl)).symm
  exact ⟨Φ, h0, fun Φ' h' b ↦ Equiv.eq_of_fWord S.exists_fWord (h'.trans h0.symm) b⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.mem_integralWeights
statement:
lemma mem_integralWeights {μ : Dual K H} :
    μ ∈ P.integralWeights ↔ ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, μ (P.coroot i) = n
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.root_mem_integralWeights
statement: lemma root_mem_integralWeights (j : ι) : P.root j ∈ P.integralWeights
proof:
:=
  fun i ↦ ⟨A i j, P.root_coroot i j⟩

name: Matrix.Realization.corootInt_spec
statement:
@[simp] lemma corootInt_spec (i : ι) (μ : P.integralWeights) :
    ((P.corootInt i μ : ℤ) : K) = (μ : Dual K H) (P.coroot i)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (μ.2 i)).symm

name: Matrix.Realization.coe_root_cartanDatum
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_root_cartanDatum (j : ι) :
    ((P.cartanDatum hA).root j : Dual K H) = P.root j
proof: := rfl

name: Matrix.Realization.coroot_cartanDatum_cast
statement:
@[simp] lemma coroot_cartanDatum_cast (i : ι) (μ : P.integralWeights) :
    (((P.cartanDatum hA).coroot i μ : ℤ) : K) = (μ : Dual K H) (P.coroot i)
proof:
:=
  P.corootInt_spec i μ

name: Matrix.Realization.cartanMatrix_cartanDatum
statement: theorem cartanMatrix_cartanDatum : (P.cartanDatum hA).cartanMatrix = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  apply Int.cast_injective (α := K)
  rw [CartanDatum.cartanMatrix_apply, coroot_cartanDatum_cast, coe_root_cartanDatum,
    P.root_coroot]

name: Matrix.Realization.coe_reflection_cartanDatum
statement:
theorem coe_reflection_cartanDatum (i : ι) (μ : P.integralWeights) :
    ((P.cartanDatum hA).reflection i μ : Dual K H) = P.reflection hA i μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [CartanDatum.reflection_apply, P.reflection_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_sub,
    AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul, coe_root_cartanDatum, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K,
    coroot_cartanDatum_cast]

name: Crystal.coeffAt_formalCharacter
statement:
theorem coeffAt_formalCharacter [Fintype B] (C : Crystal (P.cartanDatum hA) B) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (formalCharacter C).coeffAt μ = Nat.card {b // (C.wt b : Dual K H) = μ}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ∀ b, (CharacterRing.exp P ℤ (C.wt b : Dual K H)).coeffAt μ =
      if (C.wt b : Dual K H) = μ then 1 else 0 := fun b ↦ by
    rw [CharacterRing.coeff_exp]; simp only [eq_comm]
  rw [formalCharacter, CharacterRing.coeffAt, HahnSeries.coeff_sum]
  refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ ↦ h b).trans ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_boole, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]

name: Crystal.formalCharacter_tensor
statement:
theorem formalCharacter_tensor [Fintype B₁] [Fintype B₂] (C₁ : Crystal (P.cartanDatum hA) B₁)
    (C₂ : Crystal (P.cartanDatum hA) B₂) :
    formalCharacter (C₁.tensor C₂) = formalCharacter C₁ * formalCharacter C₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [formalCharacter, Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← CharacterRing.exp_add, tensor_wt,
    AddSubgroup.coe_add]
  exact Fintype.sum_prod_type _

name: Crystal.coeffAt_formalCharacterOfCones
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.formalCharacterOfCones_eq
statement:
lemma formalCharacterOfCones_eq [Fintype B] (C : Crystal (P.cartanDatum hA) B) (hC) :
    formalCharacterOfCones C hC = formalCharacter C
proof:
:=
  CharacterRing.ext fun μ ↦ by rw [coeffAt_formalCharacterOfCones, coeffAt_formalCharacter]

name: Crystal.IsSeminormal.coeffAt_formalCharacterOfCones_reflection
statement:
theorem IsSeminormal.coeffAt_formalCharacterOfCones_reflection {C : Crystal (P.cartanDatum hA) B}
    (hs : C.IsSeminormal) (hC) (i : ι) (μ : Dual K H) :
    (formalCharacterOfCones C hC).coeffAt (P.reflection hA i μ) =
      (formalCharacterOfCones C hC).coeffAt μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeffAt_formalCharacterOfCones]
  by_cases hμ : μ ∈ P.integralWeights
  · lift μ to P.integralWeights using hμ
    rw [← coe_reflection_cartanDatum, Nat.card_congr (fiberEquiv C _),
      Nat.card_congr (fiberEquiv C _), hs.card_wt_reflection]
  · have h₁ : IsEmpty {b // (C.wt b : Dual K H) = μ} :=
      ⟨fun ⟨b, hb⟩ ↦ hμ (hb ▸ (C.wt b).2)⟩
    have h₂ : IsEmpty {b // (C.wt b : Dual K H) = P.reflection hA i μ} := by
      refine ⟨fun ⟨b, hb⟩ ↦ hμ ?_⟩
      rw [← P.reflection_reflection hA i μ, ← hb, ← coe_reflection_cartanDatum]
      exact ((P.cartanDatum hA).reflection i (C.wt b)).2
    simp [Nat.card_of_isEmpty]

name: Crystal.IsWeakEmbedding.φ_map
statement:
lemma φ_map (h : IsWeakEmbedding C E b₀ j) (i : ι) (b : B) :
    C.φ i b = E.φ i (j b) + (D.coroot i (C.wt b₀) : WithBot ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.φ_eq, E.φ_eq, h.ε_map, h.wt_map, map_sub, add_assoc, ← WithBot.coe_add, sub_add_cancel]

name: Crystal.IsWeakEmbedding.fIter_map
statement:
lemma fIter_map (h : IsWeakEmbedding C E b₀ j) (i : ι) (n : ℕ) {b b₁ : B}
    (hb : C.fIter i n b = some b₁) : E.fIter i n (j b) = some (j b₁)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b₁ with
  | zero => cases hb; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fIter_succ'] at hb ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hf⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hb
    rw [ih hc, Option.bind_some, h.f_map i c b₁ hf]

name: Crystal.Similarity.exists_of_isWeakEmbedding
statement:
theorem Similarity.exists_of_isWeakEmbedding (hm : 0 < m) (hC : C.IsSeminormal)
    (hC' : C'.IsSeminormal) {b₀ : B} {b₀' : B'} (hgen : ∀ b, ∃ w, C.fWord w b₀ = some b)
    (hwt : C'.wt b₀' = m • C.wt b₀) {j : B → BE} {j' : B' → BE}
    (hj : IsWeakEmbedding C E b₀ j) (hj' : IsWeakEmbedding C' E b₀' j')
    (h₀ : j' b₀' = j b₀) (σ : Similarity E E m) (hσ : σ (j b₀) = j b₀) :
    ∃ S : Similarity C C' m, S b₀ = b₀' ∧ ∀ b, j' (S b) = σ (j b)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hφ : ∀ (i : ι) (b : B) (b' : B'), j' b' = σ (j b) → C'.φ i b' = m • C.φ i b := by
    intro i b b' hb'
    rw [hj'.φ_map, hj.φ_map, hb', σ.φ_apply, hwt, map_nsmul, nsmul_add, ← WithBot.coe_nsmul]
  have key : ∀ (w : List ι) (b : B), C.fWord w b₀ = some b →
      ∃ b', C'.fWord (stretchWord m w) b₀' = some b' ∧ j' b' = σ (j b) := by
    intro w
    induction w with
    | nil => intro b hb; cases hb; exact ⟨b₀', rfl, by rw [h₀, hσ]⟩
    | cons i w ih =>
      intro b hb
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hf⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hb
      obtain ⟨c', hc', hjc⟩ := ih c hc
      have h1 : (1 : WithBot ℤ) ≤ C.φ i c := by
        have := (hC.isSome_fIter_iff (i := i) (b := c) 1).1 (by rw [fIter_one, hf]; rfl)
        exact_mod_cast this
      have h2 : (C'.fIter i m c').isSome := by
        rw [hC'.isSome_fIter_iff, hφ i c c' hjc]
        obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hC.exists_φ_eq i c
        rw [hp] at h1 ⊢
        have : 1 ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast h1
        rw [← WithBot.coe_natCast p, nsmul_coe_withBot, ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
          WithBot.coe_le_coe]
        nlinarith
      obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 h2
      refine ⟨b', by rw [fWord_stretchWord_cons, hc', Option.bind_some, hb'], ?_⟩
      have h3 := hj'.fIter_map i m hb'
      rw [hjc, σ.fIter_apply, hj.f_map i c b hf, Option.map_some] at h3
      exact (Option.some_injective _ h3).symm
  choose wd hwd using hgen
  have hS : ∀ b, ∃ b', j' b' = σ (j b) := fun b ↦ by
    obtain ⟨b', -, h⟩ := key (wd b) b (hwd b)
    exact ⟨b', h⟩
  choose S hSj using hS
  have hSw : ∀ w b, C.fWord w b₀ = some b → C'.fWord (stretchWord m w) b₀' = some (S b) := by
    intro w b hb
    obtain ⟨b', hb', h⟩ := key w b hb
    rw [hb', hj'.injective (h.trans (hSj b).symm)]
  have hwtS : ∀ b, C'.wt (S b) = m • C.wt b := fun b ↦ by
    have := hj'.wt_map (S b)
    rw [hSj, σ.wt_apply, hj.wt_map, hwt] at this
    rw [smul_sub] at this
    exact (sub_left_inj.1 this).symm
  have hεS : ∀ i b, C'.ε i (S b) = m • C.ε i b := fun i b ↦ by
    rw [← hj'.ε_map, hSj, σ.ε_apply, hj.ε_map]
  have hφS : ∀ i b, C'.φ i (S b) = m • C.φ i b := fun i b ↦ hφ i b (S b) (hSj b)
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm.ne'
  refine ⟨
    { toFun := S
      wt_map := hwtS
      ε_map := hεS
      e_map := fun i b ↦ ?_
      f_map := fun i b ↦ ?_ }, ?_, hSj⟩
  · cases he : C.e i b with
    | some b₂ =>
      have hf : C.f i b₂ = some b := (C.f_eq_some_iff i b₂ b).2 he
      have h1 : C.fWord (i :: wd b₂) b₀ = some b := by
        rw [fWord_cons, hwd, Option.bind_some, hf]
      have h2 := hSw _ _ h1
      rw [fWord_stretchWord_cons, hSw _ _ (hwd b₂), Option.bind_some] at h2
      rw [Option.map_some, ← C'.fIter_eq_some_iff]
      exact h2
    | none =>
      have h0 : C'.ε i (S b) = 0 := by rw [hεS, hC.ε_eq_zero he, nsmul_zero]
      have h1 : C'.e i (S b) = none := by
        rw [← Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none, ← eIter_one, hC'.isSome_eIter_iff, h0]
        exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : ¬ (1 : ℤ) ≤ 0)
      rw [eIter_succ, h1]
      rfl
  · cases hf : C.f i b with
    | some b₁ =>
      have h1 : C.fWord (i :: wd b) b₀ = some b₁ := by rw [fWord_cons, hwd, Option.bind_some, hf]
      have h2 := hSw _ _ h1
      rw [fWord_stretchWord_cons, hSw _ _ (hwd b), Option.bind_some] at h2
      rw [Option.map_some]
      exact h2
    | none =>
      have h0 : C'.φ i (S b) = 0 := by rw [hφS, hC.φ_eq_zero hf, nsmul_zero]
      have h1 : C'.f i (S b) = none := by
        rw [← Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none, ← fIter_one, hC'.isSome_fIter_iff, h0]
        exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : ¬ (1 : ℤ) ≤ 0)
      rw [fIter_succ, h1]
      rfl
  · change S b₀ = b₀'
    exact hj'.injective ((hSj b₀).trans (by rw [hσ, h₀]))

name: Crystal.fIter_map_of_f_map
statement:
lemma fIter_map_of_f_map {G : B → BE} (hf : ∀ i b, E.f i (G b) = (C.f i b).map G) (i : ι) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : B), E.fIter i n (G b) = (C.fIter i n b).map G
proof:
| 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, b => by
    rw [fIter_succ, fIter_succ, hf]
    cases C.f i b with
    | none => rfl
    | some c => exact fIter_map_of_f_map hf i n c

name: Crystal.StrictHom.ofFMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma StrictHom.ofFMap_apply (hC : C.IsSeminormal) (hE : E.IsSeminormal) (G : B → BE)
    (hwt : ∀ b, E.wt (G b) = C.wt b) (hf : ∀ i b, E.f i (G b) = (C.f i b).map G) (b : B) :
    StrictHom.ofFMap hC hE G hwt hf b = G b
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.StrictHom.eIter_apply
statement:
lemma eIter_apply (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (b : B₁) :
    C₂.eIter i n (ψ b) = (C₁.eIter i n b).map ψ
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [eIter_succ, eIter_succ, ψ.e_apply]
    cases C₁.e i b with
    | none => rfl
    | some c => exact ih c

name: Crystal.StrictHom.fIter_apply
statement:
lemma fIter_apply (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (b : B₁) :
    C₂.fIter i n (ψ b) = (C₁.fIter i n b).map ψ
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fIter_succ, fIter_succ, ψ.f_apply]
    cases C₁.f i b with
    | none => rfl
    | some c => exact ih c

name: Crystal.StrictHom.getD_map
statement: private lemma getD_map (x : Option B₁) (b : B₁) : (x.map ψ).getD (ψ b) = ψ (x.getD b)
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: Crystal.StrictHom.map_reflection
statement: theorem map_reflection (i : ι) (b : B₁) : ψ (C₁.reflection i b) = C₂.reflection i (ψ b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reflection, ψ.wt_apply]
  split_ifs
  · rw [ψ.fIter_apply, getD_map]
  · rw [ψ.eIter_apply, getD_map]

name: Crystal.coe_reflection_restrict
statement:
lemma coe_reflection_restrict (C : Crystal D B) {S : Set B} (hS : C.IsStable S) (i : ι)
    (b : S) : ((restrict hS).reflection i b : B) = C.reflection i b
proof:
:=
  (restrictHom hS).map_reflection i b

name: Crystal.bind_comm_of_iter
statement:
lemma bind_comm_of_iter (F G : B → Option B) (hFG : ∀ b, (F b).bind G = (G b).bind F)
    (T : ℕ → B → Option B) (h0 : ∀ b, T 0 b = some b)
    (hs : ∀ n b, T (n + 1) b = (F b).bind (T n)) (n : ℕ) (b : B) :
    (T n b).bind G = (G b).bind (T n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero =>
    rw [h0, Option.bind_some]
    cases G b with
    | none => rfl
    | some c => exact (h0 c).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    have hT : T (n + 1) = fun c => (F c).bind (T n) := funext (hs n)
    rw [hT, Option.bind_assoc]
    simp only [ih]
    rw [← Option.bind_assoc, hFG, Option.bind_assoc]

name: Crystal.OperatorsCommute.symm
statement:
lemma symm (h : C.OperatorsCommute i j) : C.OperatorsCommute j i where
  e_e b
proof:
:= (h.e_e b).symm
  e_f b := (h.f_e b).symm
  f_e b := (h.e_f b).symm
  f_f b := (h.f_f b).symm

name: Crystal.reflection_eq_getD_stringMap
statement:
lemma _root_.Crystal.reflection_eq_getD_stringMap (C : Crystal D B) (i : ι) (b : B) :
    C.reflection i b = (C.stringMap i (D.coroot i (C.wt b)) b).getD b
proof:
:= by
  unfold reflection stringMap
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Crystal.OperatorsCommute.iter_left
statement:
private lemma iter_left (G : B → Option B)
    (hG : ∀ b, (C.e i b).bind G = (G b).bind (C.e i))
    (hG' : ∀ b, (C.f i b).bind G = (G b).bind (C.f i)) (n : ℤ) (b : B) :
    (C.stringMap i n b).bind G = (G b).bind (C.stringMap i n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stringMap
  split_ifs
  · exact bind_comm_of_iter _ G hG' _ (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) _ b
  · exact bind_comm_of_iter _ G hG _ (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) _ b

name: Crystal.OperatorsCommute.stringMap_comm
statement:
theorem stringMap_comm (h : C.OperatorsCommute i j) (m n : ℤ) (b : B) :
    (C.stringMap i m b).bind (C.stringMap j n) =
      (C.stringMap j n b).bind (C.stringMap i m)
proof:
:= by
  refine iter_left _ (fun b => ?_) (fun b => ?_) m b
  · exact (iter_left _ (fun c => (h.e_e c).symm) (fun c => (h.e_f c).symm) n b).symm
  · exact (iter_left _ (fun c => (h.f_e c).symm) (fun c => (h.f_f c).symm) n b).symm

name: Crystal.IsSeminormal.stringMap_reflection
statement:
lemma stringMap_reflection (hC : C.IsSeminormal) (i : ι) (b : B) :
    C.stringMap i (D.coroot i (C.wt b)) b = some (C.reflection i b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stringMap
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hC.fIter_reflection h
  · exact hC.eIter_reflection (not_le.mp h)

name: Crystal.IsSeminormal.reflection_comm
statement:
theorem reflection_comm (hC : C.IsSeminormal) (h : C.OperatorsCommute i j)
    (hij : D.coroot i (D.root j) = 0) (hji : D.coroot j (D.root i) = 0) (b : B) :
    C.reflection i (C.reflection j b) = C.reflection j (C.reflection i b)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : D.coroot i (C.wt (C.reflection j b)) = D.coroot i (C.wt b) := by
    rw [hC.wt_reflection, D.reflection_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, hij, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hj : D.coroot j (C.wt (C.reflection i b)) = D.coroot j (C.wt b) := by
    rw [hC.wt_reflection, D.reflection_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, hji, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  have key := h.stringMap_comm (D.coroot i (C.wt b)) (D.coroot j (C.wt b)) b
  rw [hC.stringMap_reflection i b, hC.stringMap_reflection j b, Option.bind_some,
    Option.bind_some, ← hi, ← hj, hC.stringMap_reflection, hC.stringMap_reflection] at key
  exact (Option.some_injective _ key).symm

name: Crystal.IsSeminormal.isLiftable_iff
statement:
theorem isLiftable_iff (hC : C.IsSeminormal) :
    M.IsLiftable hC.reflectionPerm ↔ ∀ i j, i ≠ j → M i j ≠ 0 →
      (hC.reflectionPerm i * hC.reflectionPerm j) ^ M i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i j _ _ => h i j, fun h i j => ?_⟩
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    rw [M.diagonal, pow_one]
    ext b
    exact hC.reflection_reflection i b
  · by_cases hM : M i j = 0
    · rw [hM, pow_zero]
    · exact h i j hij hM

name: Crystal.IsSeminormal.reflectionPerm_mul_pow_two
statement:
lemma reflectionPerm_mul_pow_two (hC : C.IsSeminormal)
    (hcomm : ∀ b, C.reflection i (C.reflection j b) = C.reflection j (C.reflection i b)) :
    (hC.reflectionPerm i * hC.reflectionPerm j) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [pow_two, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, reflectionPerm_apply, Equiv.Perm.one_apply]
  rw [hcomm (C.reflection i (C.reflection j b)), hC.reflection_reflection,
    hC.reflection_reflection]

name: Crystal.IsSeminormal.weylAction_simple
statement:
@[simp] lemma weylAction_simple (hC : C.IsSeminormal) (cs : CoxeterSystem M W)
    (h : M.IsLiftable hC.reflectionPerm) (i : ι) :
    hC.weylAction cs h (cs.simple i) = hC.reflectionPerm i
proof:
:=
  cs.lift_apply_simple h i

name: CartanDatum.rootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_zero : D.rootSum 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [rootSum]

name: CartanDatum.rootSum_add
statement: lemma rootSum_add (ν ν' : ι →₀ ℕ) : D.rootSum (ν + ν') = D.rootSum ν + D.rootSum ν'
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul _ _ _)

name: CartanDatum.rootSum_single
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_single (i : ι) (n : ℕ) : D.rootSum (Finsupp.single i n) = n • D.root i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootSum]

name: CartanDatum.rootSum_injective
statement: theorem rootSum_injective (hD : LinearIndependent ℤ D.root) : Function.Injective D.rootSum
proof:
:= by
  intro ν ν' he
  have key : ∀ ν : ι →₀ ℕ, Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ D.root
      (ν.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp)) = D.rootSum ν := fun ν ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (by simp)]
    simp only [rootSum, natCast_zsmul]
  have h2 := linearIndependent_iff.1 hD (ν.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp) -
    ν'.mapRange (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (by simp)) (by rw [map_sub, key, key, he, sub_self])
  ext i
  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using congr($h2 i)

name: Crystal.tensor_elementary_e
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.tensor_elementary_f
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.tensor_elementary_ε
statement:
lemma tensor_elementary_ε (C : Crystal D B) (i j : ι) (b : B) (n : ℤ) :
    (C.tensor (elementary D i)).ε j (b, n) =
      max (C.ε j b) ((elementary D i).ε j n + ((-D.coroot j (C.wt b) : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ))
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.tensor_elementary_wt
statement:
lemma tensor_elementary_wt (C : Crystal D B) (i : ι) (b : B) (n : ℤ) :
    (C.tensor (elementary D i)).wt (b, n) = C.wt b + n • D.root i
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.elementary_ε_self
statement: lemma elementary_ε_self (i : ι) (n : ℤ) : (elementary D i).ε i n = ((-n : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [elementary]

name: Crystal.elementary_ε_of_ne
statement: lemma elementary_ε_of_ne {i j : ι} (h : j ≠ i) (n : ℤ) : (elementary D i).ε j n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [elementary, h]

name: Crystal.elementary_e_self
statement: lemma elementary_e_self (i : ι) (n : ℤ) : (elementary D i).e i n = some (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [elementary]

name: Crystal.elementary_f_self
statement: lemma elementary_f_self (i : ι) (n : ℤ) : (elementary D i).f i n = some (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [elementary]

name: Crystal.KSData.ht_eq
statement: lemma ht_eq {b : B} {ν : ι →₀ ℕ} (h : C.wt b = -D.rootSum ν) : K.ht b = ν.degree
proof:
:= by
  have := (K.wt_mem b).choose_spec
  rw [ht, D.rootSum_injective hD (neg_injective (this.symm.trans h))]

name: Crystal.KSData.ht_b₀
statement: lemma ht_b₀ : K.ht b₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.ht_eq hD (ν := 0) (by rw [K.wt_b₀, D.rootSum_zero, neg_zero])]
  simp

name: Crystal.KSData.eq_b₀_of_ht
statement: lemma eq_b₀_of_ht {b : B} (h : K.ht b = 0) : b = b₀
proof:
:= by
  apply K.eq_b₀
  have hs := (K.wt_mem b).choose_spec
  rw [ht, Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff] at h
  rw [hs, h, D.rootSum_zero, neg_zero]

name: Crystal.KSData.ht_of_wt_sub
statement:
lemma ht_of_wt_sub {b b' : B} {j : ι} (h : C.wt b = C.wt b' - D.root j) :
    K.ht b = K.ht b' + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := K.wt_mem b'
  rw [K.ht_eq hD hν, K.ht_eq hD (ν := ν + Finsupp.single j 1)]
  · simp
  · rw [h, hν, D.rootSum_add, D.rootSum_single, one_smul]; abel

name: Crystal.KSData.ht_Ψ
statement: lemma ht_Ψ (i : ι) (b : B) : K.ht b = K.ht (K.Ψ i b).1 + (-(K.Ψ i b).2).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hwt := (K.Ψ i).wt_apply b
  rcases hp : K.Ψ i b with ⟨c, n⟩
  rw [hp, tensor_elementary_wt] at hwt
  have hn : n ≤ 0 := by have := K.Ψ_snd_nonpos i b; rw [hp] at this; exact this
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, n = -m := ⟨(-n).toNat, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := K.wt_mem c
  rw [K.ht_eq hD hν, K.ht_eq hD (ν := ν + Finsupp.single i m)]
  · simp
  · rw [← hwt, hν, D.rootSum_add, D.rootSum_single, neg_smul, natCast_zsmul]; abel

name: Crystal.KSData.Ψ_b₀
statement: lemma Ψ_b₀ (i : ι) : K.Ψ i b₀ = (b₀, 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := K.ht_Ψ hD i b₀
  rw [K.ht_b₀ hD] at h
  have h2 := K.Ψ_snd_nonpos i b₀
  exact Prod.ext (K.eq_b₀_of_ht (by omega)) (by simp only; omega)

name: Crystal.KSData.φ_b₀
statement: lemma φ_b₀ (i : ι) : C.φ i b₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.φ_eq, K.ε_b₀, K.wt_b₀, map_zero]; rfl

name: Crystal.KSData.φ_ne_bot
statement: lemma φ_ne_bot (i : ι) (b : B) : C.φ i b ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, C.φ_eq_bot_iff]; exact K.ε_ne_bot i b

name: Crystal.KSData.exists_e_ne_none
statement: theorem exists_e_ne_none (b : B) (hb : b ≠ b₀) : ∃ j, C.e j b ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  induction h : K.ht b using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing b with
  | _ L ih =>
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_snd_neg b hb
  have key : ∀ j, (C.tensor (elementary D i)).e j (K.Ψ i b) ≠ none → C.e j b ≠ none := by
    intro j hj he
    rw [(K.Ψ i).e_apply, he] at hj
    exact hj rfl
  have hht := K.ht_Ψ hD i b
  rcases hp : K.Ψ i b with ⟨c, n⟩
  rw [hp] at hi hht key
  simp only at hi hht
  by_cases hc : c = b₀
  · subst hc
    refine ⟨i, key i ?_⟩
    rw [tensor_elementary_e, K.φ_b₀, elementary_ε_self, ite_eq_right]
    · simp [elementary_e_self]
    · rw [← WithBot.coe_zero, WithBot.coe_le_coe]; omega
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ih (K.ht c) (by omega) c hc rfl
    refine ⟨j, key j ?_⟩
    rw [tensor_elementary_e]
    split_ifs with hle
    · simpa using hj
    · by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst hji; simp [elementary_e_self]
      · rw [elementary_ε_of_ne hji] at hle
        exact absurd bot_le hle

name: Crystal.KSData.f_ne_none
statement: theorem f_ne_none (j : ι) (b : B) : C.f j b ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  induction h : K.ht b using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing b with
  | _ L ih =>
  by_cases hb : b = b₀
  · subst hb
    intro hf
    have := (K.Ψ j).f_apply j b
    rw [hf, K.Ψ_b₀ hD, tensor_elementary_f, K.φ_b₀, elementary_ε_self, ite_eq_right (by simp),
      elementary_f_self] at this
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_snd_neg b hb
  have hht := K.ht_Ψ hD i b
  intro hf
  have hfi := (K.Ψ i).f_apply j b
  rw [hf] at hfi
  rcases hp : K.Ψ i b with ⟨c, n⟩
  rw [hp] at hi hht hfi
  simp only at hi hht
  have hc := ih (K.ht c) (by omega) c rfl
  rw [tensor_elementary_f] at hfi
  split_ifs at hfi with hlt
  · simp [Option.map_eq_none_iff, hc] at hfi
  · by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji; simp [elementary_f_self] at hfi
    · rw [elementary_ε_of_ne hji] at hlt
      exact hlt (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.2 (K.φ_ne_bot j c))

name: Crystal.KSData.f_eq_fT
statement: lemma f_eq_fT (j : ι) (b : B) : C.f j b = some (K.fT hD j b)
proof: := (Option.some_get _).symm

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma fw_nil : K.fw hD [] = b₀
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.KSData.f_fw
statement: lemma f_fw (j : ι) (w : List ι) : C.f j (K.fw hD w) = some (K.fw hD (j :: w))
proof:
:=
  K.f_eq_fT hD j _

name: Crystal.KSData.wt_fw
statement: lemma wt_fw (w : List ι) : C.wt (K.fw hD w) = -(w.map D.root).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [K.wt_b₀]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [C.wt_f (K.f_fw hD j w), ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]; abel

name: Crystal.KSData.ht_fw
statement: lemma ht_fw (w : List ι) : K.ht (K.fw hD w) = w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact K.ht_b₀ hD
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [K.ht_of_wt_sub hD (C.wt_f (K.f_fw hD j w)), ih, List.length_cons]

name: Crystal.KSData.exists_fw_eq
statement: theorem exists_fw_eq (b : B) : ∃ w, K.fw hD w = b
proof:
:= by
  induction h : K.ht b using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing b with
  | _ L ih =>
  by_cases hb : b = b₀
  · exact ⟨[], hb.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := K.exists_e_ne_none hD b hb
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 hj
  have hht := K.ht_of_wt_sub hD (b := b) (b' := b') (j := j)
    (by rw [C.wt_e j b b' hb', add_sub_cancel_right])
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := ih (K.ht b') (by omega) b' rfl
  refine ⟨j :: w, ?_⟩
  have := K.f_fw hD j w
  rw [(C.f_eq_some_iff j _ b).2 hb', Option.some_inj] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Crystal.KSData.exists_Ψ_fw
statement:
theorem exists_Ψ_fw (L : ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ w : List ι, w.length ≤ L → ∀ k, C.ε k (K.fw hD w) = C'.ε k (K'.fw hD w))
    (i : ι) (w : List ι) (hw : w.length ≤ L + 1) :
    ∃ (u : List ι) (n : ℤ), K.Ψ i (K.fw hD w) = (K.fw hD u, n) ∧
      K'.Ψ i (K'.fw hD w) = (K'.fw hD u, n)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], 0, K.Ψ_b₀ hD i, K'.Ψ_b₀ hD i⟩
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [List.length_cons] at hw
    obtain ⟨u, n, h1, h1'⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hlen : u.length ≤ L := by
      have := K.ht_Ψ hD i (K.fw hD w)
      rw [h1, K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
      simp only at this
      omega
    have hf := (K.Ψ i).f_apply j (K.fw hD w)
    have hf' := (K'.Ψ i).f_apply j (K'.fw hD w)
    rw [h1, K.f_fw, Option.map_some, tensor_elementary_f] at hf
    rw [h1', K'.f_fw, Option.map_some, tensor_elementary_f] at hf'
    have hφ : C.φ j (K.fw hD u) = C'.φ j (K'.fw hD u) := by
      rw [C.φ_eq, C'.φ_eq, hE u hlen j, K.wt_fw, K'.wt_fw]
    rw [← hφ] at hf'
    split_ifs at hf hf' with hc
    · rw [K.f_fw, Option.map_some, Option.some_inj] at hf
      rw [K'.f_fw, Option.map_some, Option.some_inj] at hf'
      exact ⟨j :: u, n, hf.symm, hf'.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨n', hn', hΨ⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hf
      rw [hn', Option.map_some, Option.some_inj] at hf'
      exact ⟨u, n', hΨ.symm, hf'.symm⟩

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_ne_b₀
statement: lemma fw_ne_b₀ {w : List ι} (hw : w ≠ []) : K.fw hD w ≠ b₀
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := congrArg K.ht h
  rw [K.ht_fw, K.ht_b₀ hD] at this
  exact hw (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero this)

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_eq_fw_step
statement:
theorem fw_eq_fw_step (L : ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ w : List ι, w.length ≤ L → ∀ k, C.ε k (K.fw hD w) = C'.ε k (K'.fw hD w))
    (hS : ∀ w w' : List ι, w.length ≤ L → w'.length ≤ L → K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w' →
      K'.fw hD w = K'.fw hD w')
    (w w' : List ι) (hw : w.length ≤ L + 1) (hw' : w'.length ≤ L + 1)
    (heq : K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w') : K'.fw hD w = K'.fw hD w'
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : w.length = w'.length := by
    have := congrArg K.ht heq
    rwa [K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
  by_cases hL : w.length ≤ L
  · exact hS w w' hL (hlen ▸ hL) heq
  have hne : K.fw hD w ≠ b₀ := K.fw_ne_b₀ hD (fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hL)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_snd_neg _ hne
  obtain ⟨u, n, h1, h1'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw hD K' L hE i w hw
  obtain ⟨u', n', h2, h2'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw hD K' L hE i w' hw'
  have hn : n < 0 := by rw [h1] at hi; exact hi
  have h12 : (K.fw hD u, n) = (K.fw hD u', n') := by rw [← h1, ← h2, heq]
  obtain ⟨hfu, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h12
  have hu : u.length ≤ L := by
    have := K.ht_Ψ hD i (K.fw hD w)
    rw [h1, K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
    simp only at this
    omega
  have hu' : u'.length ≤ L := by
    have := K.ht_Ψ hD i (K.fw hD w')
    rw [h2, K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
    simp only at this
    omega
  have hfu' := hS u u' hu hu' hfu
  apply K'.Ψ_injective i
  rw [h1', h2', hfu']

name: Crystal.KSData.ε_fw_step
statement:
theorem ε_fw_step (L : ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ w : List ι, w.length ≤ L → ∀ k, C.ε k (K.fw hD w) = C'.ε k (K'.fw hD w))
    (w : List ι) (hw : w.length ≤ L + 1) (k : ι) :
    C.ε k (K.fw hD w) = C'.ε k (K'.fw hD w)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hL : w.length ≤ L
  · exact hE w hL k
  have hne : K.fw hD w ≠ b₀ := K.fw_ne_b₀ hD (fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hL)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_snd_neg _ hne
  obtain ⟨u, n, h1, h1'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw hD K' L hE i w hw
  have hu : u.length ≤ L := by
    have := K.ht_Ψ hD i (K.fw hD w)
    rw [h1, K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
    rw [h1] at hi
    simp only at this hi
    omega
  rw [← (K.Ψ i).ε_apply, ← (K'.Ψ i).ε_apply, h1, h1', tensor_elementary_ε, tensor_elementary_ε,
    hE u hu k, K.wt_fw, K'.wt_fw]

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_eq_fw_and_ε
statement:
theorem fw_eq_fw_and_ε (L : ℕ) :
    (∀ w : List ι, w.length ≤ L → ∀ k, C.ε k (K.fw hD w) = C'.ε k (K'.fw hD w)) ∧
    (∀ w w' : List ι, w.length ≤ L → w'.length ≤ L → K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w' →
      K'.fw hD w = K'.fw hD w') ∧
    (∀ w w' : List ι, w.length ≤ L → w'.length ≤ L → K'.fw hD w = K'.fw hD w' →
      K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w')
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun w hw k ↦ ?_, fun w w' hw hw' _ ↦ ?_, fun w w' hw hw' _ ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.1 hw), fw_nil, fw_nil, K.ε_b₀, K'.ε_b₀]
    all_goals rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.1 hw),
      List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.1 hw')]
  | succ L ih =>
    obtain ⟨hE, hS, hS'⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨K.ε_fw_step hD K' L hE, K.fw_eq_fw_step hD K' L hE hS,
      K'.fw_eq_fw_step hD K L (fun w hw k ↦ (hE w hw k).symm) hS'⟩

name: Crystal.KSData.ε_fw_eq
statement: theorem ε_fw_eq (w : List ι) (k : ι) : C.ε k (K.fw hD w) = C'.ε k (K'.fw hD w)
proof:
:=
  (K.fw_eq_fw_and_ε hD K' w.length).1 w le_rfl k

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_eq_fw_of_fw_eq
statement:
theorem fw_eq_fw_of_fw_eq {w w' : List ι} (h : K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w') :
    K'.fw hD w = K'.fw hD w'
proof:
:=
  (K.fw_eq_fw_and_ε hD K' (max w.length w'.length)).2.1 w w' (le_max_left _ _)
    (le_max_right _ _) h

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_word
statement: lemma fw_word (b : B) : K.fw hD (K.word hD b) = b
proof: := (K.exists_fw_eq hD b).choose_spec

name: Crystal.KSData.toFun'_fw
statement: lemma toFun'_fw (w : List ι) : K.toFun' hD K' (K.fw hD w) = K'.fw hD w
proof:
:=
  K.fw_eq_fw_of_fw_eq hD K' (K.fw_word hD _)

name: Crystal.KSData.equiv_b₀
statement: lemma equiv_b₀ : K.equiv hD K' b₀ = b₀'
proof: := K.toFun'_fw hD K' []

name: CartanDatum.cartanMatrix_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma cartanMatrix_apply (i j : ι) : D.cartanMatrix i j = D.coroot i (D.root j)
proof: := rfl

name: CartanDatum.cartanMatrix_self
statement: lemma cartanMatrix_self (i : ι) : D.cartanMatrix i i = 2
proof: := D.coroot_root_self i

name: CartanDatum.reflection_apply
statement:
lemma reflection_apply (i : ι) (μ : X) :
    D.reflection i μ = μ - D.coroot i μ • D.root i
proof: := rfl

name: CartanDatum.reflection_reflection
statement: @[simp] lemma reflection_reflection (i : ι) (μ : X) : D.reflection i (D.reflection i μ) = μ
proof:
:=
  Module.involutive_reflection (D.coroot_root_self i) μ

name: CartanDatum.coroot_reflection
statement:
@[simp] lemma coroot_reflection (i : ι) (μ : X) :
    D.coroot i (D.reflection i μ) = -D.coroot i μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reflection_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, coroot_root_self, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Crystal.φ_eq_bot_iff
statement: lemma φ_eq_bot_iff : C.φ i b = ⊥ ↔ C.ε i b = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.φ_eq]
  induction C.ε i b using WithBot.recBotCoe <;> simp [← WithBot.coe_add]

name: Crystal.e_eq_none_of_ε_eq_bot
statement: lemma e_eq_none_of_ε_eq_bot (h : C.ε i b = ⊥) : C.e i b = none
proof:
:=
  C.e_eq_none_of_φ_eq_bot i b ((C.φ_eq_bot_iff).mpr h)

name: Crystal.ε_ne_bot_of_e_eq_some
statement: lemma ε_ne_bot_of_e_eq_some (h : C.e i b = some b') : C.ε i b ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= fun h' ↦ by
  simp [C.e_eq_none_of_ε_eq_bot h'] at h

name: Crystal.φ_ne_bot_of_e_eq_some
statement: lemma φ_ne_bot_of_e_eq_some (h : C.e i b = some b') : C.φ i b ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, C.φ_eq_bot_iff]; exact C.ε_ne_bot_of_e_eq_some h

name: Crystal.e_eq_some_iff
statement: lemma e_eq_some_iff : C.e i b = some b' ↔ C.f i b' = some b
proof: := (C.f_eq_some_iff i b' b).symm

name: Crystal.wt_f
statement: lemma wt_f (h : C.f i b = some b') : C.wt b' = C.wt b - D.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.wt_e i b' b ((C.f_eq_some_iff i b b').mp h), add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Crystal.ε_f
statement: lemma ε_f (h : C.f i b = some b') : C.ε i b' = C.ε i b + 1
proof:
:=
  C.ε_e i b' b ((C.f_eq_some_iff i b b').mp h)

name: Crystal.φ_e
statement: lemma φ_e (h : C.e i b = some b') : C.φ i b' = C.φ i b + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.φ_eq, C.φ_eq, C.wt_e i b b' h, C.ε_e i b b' h, map_add, D.coroot_root_self]
  push_cast
  rw [← one_add_one_eq_two]
  abel

name: Crystal.φ_f
statement: lemma φ_f (h : C.f i b = some b') : C.φ i b = C.φ i b' + 1
proof:
:=
  C.φ_e ((C.f_eq_some_iff i b b').mp h)

name: Crystal.ε_ne_bot_of_f_eq_some
statement: lemma ε_ne_bot_of_f_eq_some (h : C.f i b = some b') : C.ε i b ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have h' := C.ε_ne_bot_of_e_eq_some ((C.f_eq_some_iff i b b').mp h)
  rw [C.ε_f h] at h'
  rintro h''
  simp [h''] at h'

name: Crystal.φ_ne_bot_of_f_eq_some
statement: lemma φ_ne_bot_of_f_eq_some (h : C.f i b = some b') : C.φ i b ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, C.φ_eq_bot_iff]; exact C.ε_ne_bot_of_f_eq_some h

name: Crystal.f_eq_none_of_φ_eq_bot
statement: lemma f_eq_none_of_φ_eq_bot (h : C.φ i b = ⊥) : C.f i b = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [Option.eq_none_iff_forall_ne_some]
  intro b' h'
  exact C.φ_ne_bot_of_f_eq_some h' h

name: Crystal.f_eq_none_of_ε_eq_bot
statement: lemma f_eq_none_of_ε_eq_bot (h : C.ε i b = ⊥) : C.f i b = none
proof:
:=
  C.f_eq_none_of_φ_eq_bot ((C.φ_eq_bot_iff).mpr h)

name: Crystal.e_injective
statement: lemma e_injective {b₁ b₂ : B} (h₁ : C.e i b₁ = some b) (h₂ : C.e i b₂ = some b) : b₁ = b₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.e_eq_some_iff] at h₁ h₂
  exact Option.some_injective _ (h₁.symm.trans h₂)

name: Crystal.f_injective
statement: lemma f_injective {b₁ b₂ : B} (h₁ : C.f i b₁ = some b) (h₂ : C.f i b₂ = some b) : b₁ = b₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.f_eq_some_iff] at h₁ h₂
  exact Option.some_injective _ (h₁.symm.trans h₂)

name: Crystal.e_bind_f
statement: lemma e_bind_f (b : B) : (C.e i b).bind (C.f i) = (C.e i b).map fun _ ↦ b
proof:
:= by
  cases h : C.e i b with
  | none => rfl
  | some b' => simpa using (C.f_eq_some_iff i b' b).mpr h

name: Crystal.f_bind_e
statement: lemma f_bind_e (b : B) : (C.f i b).bind (C.e i) = (C.f i b).map fun _ ↦ b
proof:
:= by
  cases h : C.f i b with
  | none => rfl
  | some b' => simpa using (C.f_eq_some_iff i b b').mp h

name: Crystal.eIter_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma eIter_zero (b : B) : C.eIter i 0 b = some b
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.fIter_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma fIter_zero (b : B) : C.fIter i 0 b = some b
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.eIter_succ
statement: lemma eIter_succ (n : ℕ) (b : B) : C.eIter i (n + 1) b = (C.e i b).bind (C.eIter i n)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.fIter_succ
statement: lemma fIter_succ (n : ℕ) (b : B) : C.fIter i (n + 1) b = (C.f i b).bind (C.fIter i n)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.eIter_one
statement: @[simp] lemma eIter_one (b : B) : C.eIter i 1 b = C.e i b
proof:
:= by
  rw [eIter_succ]; cases C.e i b <;> rfl

name: Crystal.fIter_one
statement: @[simp] lemma fIter_one (b : B) : C.fIter i 1 b = C.f i b
proof:
:= by
  rw [fIter_succ]; cases C.f i b <;> rfl

name: Crystal.eIter_succ'
statement: lemma eIter_succ' (n : ℕ) (b : B) : C.eIter i (n + 1) b = (C.eIter i n b).bind (C.e i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [eIter_succ, eIter_succ]
    cases C.e i b with
    | none => rfl
    | some b' => exact ih b'

name: Crystal.fIter_succ'
statement: lemma fIter_succ' (n : ℕ) (b : B) : C.fIter i (n + 1) b = (C.fIter i n b).bind (C.f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fIter_succ, fIter_succ]
    cases C.f i b with
    | none => rfl
    | some b' => exact ih b'

name: Crystal.fIter_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem fIter_eq_some_iff (n : ℕ) (b b' : B) :
    C.fIter i n b = some b' ↔ C.eIter i n b' = some b
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b b' with
  | zero => simp [eq_comm]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fIter_succ, eIter_succ', Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.bind_eq_some_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, hcb'⟩
      exact ⟨c, (ih c b').mp hcb', (C.f_eq_some_iff i b c).mp hc⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩
      exact ⟨c, (C.f_eq_some_iff i b c).mpr hcb, (ih c b').mpr hc⟩

name: Crystal.wt_eIter
statement: lemma wt_eIter {n : ℕ} (h : C.eIter i n b = some b') : C.wt b' = C.wt b + n • D.root i
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcb'⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
    rw [ih hcb', C.wt_e i b c hc, succ_nsmul']
    abel

name: Crystal.wt_fIter
statement: lemma wt_fIter {n : ℕ} (h : C.fIter i n b = some b') : C.wt b' = C.wt b - n • D.root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.wt_eIter ((C.fIter_eq_some_iff n b b').mp h), add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Crystal.ε_eIter
statement: lemma ε_eIter {n : ℕ} (h : C.eIter i n b = some b') : C.ε i b = C.ε i b' + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcb'⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
    rw [C.ε_e i b c hc, ih hcb']
    push_cast
    abel

name: Crystal.φ_eIter
statement: lemma φ_eIter {n : ℕ} (h : C.eIter i n b = some b') : C.φ i b' = C.φ i b + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcb'⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
    rw [ih hcb', C.φ_e hc]
    push_cast
    abel

name: Crystal.ε_fIter
statement: lemma ε_fIter {n : ℕ} (h : C.fIter i n b = some b') : C.ε i b' = C.ε i b + n
proof:
:=
  C.ε_eIter ((C.fIter_eq_some_iff n b b').mp h)

name: Crystal.φ_fIter
statement: lemma φ_fIter {n : ℕ} (h : C.fIter i n b = some b') : C.φ i b = C.φ i b' + n
proof:
:=
  C.φ_eIter ((C.fIter_eq_some_iff n b b').mp h)

name: Crystal.fWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma fWord_nil (b : B) : C.fWord [] b = some b
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.fWord_cons
statement:
lemma fWord_cons (j : ι) (l : List ι) (b : B) :
    C.fWord (j :: l) b = (C.fWord l b).bind (C.f j)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.StrictHom.toFun_eq_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma toFun_eq_coe (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) : ψ.toFun = ψ
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.StrictHom.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {ψ ψ' : StrictHom C₁ C₂} (h : ∀ b, ψ b = ψ' b) : ψ = ψ'
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext _ _ h

name: Crystal.StrictHom.wt_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma wt_apply (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (b : B₁) : C₂.wt (ψ b) = C₁.wt b
proof: := ψ.wt_map b

name: Crystal.StrictHom.ε_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma ε_apply (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.ε i (ψ b) = C₁.ε i b
proof:
:=
  ψ.ε_map i b

name: Crystal.StrictHom.e_apply
statement: lemma e_apply (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.e i (ψ b) = (C₁.e i b).map ψ
proof:
:=
  ψ.e_map i b

name: Crystal.StrictHom.f_apply
statement: lemma f_apply (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.f i (ψ b) = (C₁.f i b).map ψ
proof:
:=
  ψ.f_map i b

name: Crystal.StrictHom.fWord_apply
statement:
lemma fWord_apply (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (l : List ι) (b : B₁) :
    C₂.fWord l (ψ b) = (C₁.fWord l b).map ψ
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i l ih =>
    rw [fWord_cons, fWord_cons, ih]
    cases C₁.fWord l b <;> simp [ψ.f_apply]

name: Crystal.StrictHom.φ_map
statement: @[simp] lemma φ_map (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.φ i (ψ b) = C₁.φ i b
proof:
:= by
  rw [C₂.φ_eq, C₁.φ_eq, ψ.ε_apply, ψ.wt_apply]

name: Crystal.StrictHom.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_apply (ψ' : StrictHom C₂ C₃) (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (b : B₁) :
    ψ'.comp ψ b = ψ' (ψ b)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.Equiv.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {ψ ψ' : Equiv C₁ C₂} (h : ∀ b, ψ b = ψ' b) : ψ = ψ'
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext _ _ h

name: Crystal.Equiv.coe_toStrictHom
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_toStrictHom (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) : ⇑ψ.toStrictHom = ψ
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.Equiv.coe_toEquiv
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_toEquiv (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) : ⇑ψ.toEquiv = ψ
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.Equiv.toEquiv_symm_apply_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma toEquiv_symm_apply_apply (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) (b : B₁) : ψ.toEquiv.symm (ψ b) = b
proof:
:=
  ψ.toEquiv.symm_apply_apply b

name: Crystal.Equiv.wt_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma wt_apply (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) (b : B₁) : C₂.wt (ψ b) = C₁.wt b
proof: := ψ.wt_map b

name: Crystal.Equiv.ε_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma ε_apply (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.ε i (ψ b) = C₁.ε i b
proof:
:=
  ψ.ε_map i b

name: Crystal.Equiv.φ_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma φ_apply (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.φ i (ψ b) = C₁.φ i b
proof:
:=
  ψ.toStrictHom.φ_map i b

name: Crystal.Equiv.e_apply
statement: lemma e_apply (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.e i (ψ b) = (C₁.e i b).map ψ
proof:
:=
  ψ.e_map i b

name: Crystal.Equiv.f_apply
statement: lemma f_apply (ψ : Equiv C₁ C₂) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.f i (ψ b) = (C₁.f i b).map ψ
proof:
:=
  ψ.f_map i b

name: Crystal.stretchWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma stretchWord_nil (m : ℕ) : stretchWord m ([] : List ι) = []
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.stretchWord_cons
statement:
lemma stretchWord_cons (m : ℕ) (j : ι) (w : List ι) :
    stretchWord m (j :: w) = List.replicate m j ++ stretchWord m w
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.length_stretchWord
statement: lemma length_stretchWord (m : ℕ) (w : List ι) : (stretchWord m w).length = m * w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih => rw [stretchWord_cons, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, ih,
      List.length_cons, mul_add, mul_one, add_comm]

name: Crystal.stretchWord_append
statement:
lemma stretchWord_append (m : ℕ) (w w' : List ι) :
    stretchWord m (w ++ w') = stretchWord m w ++ stretchWord m w'
proof:
:= by
  simp [stretchWord]

name: Crystal.stretchWord_replicate
statement:
lemma stretchWord_replicate (m n : ℕ) (j : ι) :
    stretchWord m (List.replicate n j) = List.replicate (m * n) j
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, stretchWord_cons, ih, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm, List.replicate_add]

name: Crystal.stretchWord_mul
statement:
lemma stretchWord_mul (m n : ℕ) (w : List ι) :
    stretchWord (m * n) w = stretchWord m (stretchWord n w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [stretchWord_cons, stretchWord_cons, stretchWord_append, ih, stretchWord_replicate]

name: Crystal.fWord_append
statement:
lemma fWord_append (l₁ l₂ : List ι) (b : B) :
    C.fWord (l₁ ++ l₂) b = (C.fWord l₂ b).bind (C.fWord l₁)
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => rw [List.nil_append]; cases C.fWord l₂ b <;> rfl
  | cons i l ih => rw [List.cons_append, fWord_cons, ih, Option.bind_assoc]; rfl

name: Crystal.fWord_replicate
statement: lemma fWord_replicate (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (b : B) : C.fWord (List.replicate n i) b = C.fIter i n b
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [List.replicate_succ, fWord_cons, ih, fIter_succ']

name: Crystal.fWord_stretchWord_cons
statement:
lemma fWord_stretchWord_cons (m : ℕ) (j : ι) (w : List ι) (b : B) :
    C.fWord (stretchWord m (j :: w)) b = (C.fWord (stretchWord m w) b).bind (C.fIter j m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stretchWord_cons, fWord_append]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact C.fWord_replicate j m x

name: Crystal.nsmul_bot_withBot
statement: lemma nsmul_bot_withBot {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : m • (⊥ : WithBot ℤ) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm.ne'
  rw [succ_nsmul, WithBot.add_bot]

name: Crystal.nsmul_coe_withBot
statement: lemma nsmul_coe_withBot (m : ℕ) (z : ℤ) : m • (z : WithBot ℤ) = ((m * z : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: Crystal.nsmul_max_add_withBot
statement:
lemma nsmul_max_add_withBot {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (a b : WithBot ℤ) (z : ℤ) :
    m • max a (b + (z : WithBot ℤ)) = max (m • a) (m • b + ((m * z : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  induction a using WithBot.recBotCoe with
  | bot =>
    induction b using WithBot.recBotCoe with
    | bot => simp [nsmul_bot_withBot hm]
    | coe b =>
      rw [← WithBot.coe_add, max_eq_right bot_le, nsmul_coe_withBot, nsmul_coe_withBot,
        nsmul_bot_withBot hm, ← WithBot.coe_add, max_eq_right bot_le, mul_add]
  | coe a =>
    induction b using WithBot.recBotCoe with
    | bot => simp [nsmul_bot_withBot hm]
    | coe b =>
      rw [← WithBot.coe_add, ← WithBot.coe_max, nsmul_coe_withBot, nsmul_coe_withBot,
        nsmul_coe_withBot, ← WithBot.coe_add, ← WithBot.coe_max,
        mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ (by positivity : (0 : ℤ) ≤ m), mul_add]

name: Crystal.nsmul_lt_of_lt_of_eq_add
statement:
lemma nsmul_lt_of_lt_of_eq_add {m k : ℕ} (hk : k < m) {a b c : WithBot ℤ} (hab : a < b)
    (hc : m • b = c + k) : m • a < c
proof:
:= by
  induction b using WithBot.recBotCoe with
  | bot => exact absurd hab not_lt_bot
  | coe b =>
    induction c using WithBot.recBotCoe with
    | bot => rw [nsmul_coe_withBot, WithBot.bot_add] at hc; exact absurd hc WithBot.coe_ne_bot
    | coe c =>
      rw [nsmul_coe_withBot, ← WithBot.coe_natCast, ← WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_inj] at hc
      induction a using WithBot.recBotCoe with
      | bot => rw [nsmul_bot_withBot (by omega)]; exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe c
      | coe a =>
        rw [nsmul_coe_withBot, WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
        have hab' : a < b := by exact_mod_cast hab
        have : (m : ℤ) * (a + 1) ≤ m * b :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by omega) (by positivity)
        have hk' : (k : ℤ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hk
        linarith

name: Crystal.nsmul_le_nsmul_add_of_le
statement:
lemma nsmul_le_nsmul_add_of_le (m k : ℕ) {a b : WithBot ℤ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    m • a ≤ m • b + k
proof:
:=
  (nsmul_le_nsmul_right hab m).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le k))

name: Crystal.not_lt_nsmul_of_le
statement:
lemma not_lt_nsmul_of_le {m k : ℕ} {a b c : WithBot ℤ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hc : c = m • b + k) :
    ¬ c < m • a
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_lt, hc]; exact nsmul_le_nsmul_add_of_le m k hab

name: Crystal.not_le_nsmul_of_lt
statement:
lemma not_le_nsmul_of_lt {m k : ℕ} (hk : k < m) {a b c : WithBot ℤ} (hab : a < b)
    (hc : m • b = c + k) : ¬ c ≤ m • a
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_le]; exact nsmul_lt_of_lt_of_eq_add hk hab hc

name: Crystal.tensor_fIter_left
statement:
lemma tensor_fIter_left (n : ℕ) (x : B₁) (y : B₂)
    (h : ∀ k < n, ∀ x', C₁.fIter i k x = some x' → C₂.ε i y < C₁.φ i x') :
    (C₁.tensor C₂).fIter i n (x, y) = (C₁.fIter i n x).map (·, y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fIter_succ', ih fun k hk ↦ h k (by omega), fIter_succ']
    cases hx : C₁.fIter i n x with
    | none => rfl
    | some x' =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
      simp only [tensor_f, h n (by omega) x' hx, ↓reduceIte]

name: Crystal.tensor_fIter_right
statement:
lemma tensor_fIter_right (n : ℕ) (x : B₁) (y : B₂)
    (h : ∀ k < n, ∀ y', C₂.fIter i k y = some y' → ¬ C₂.ε i y' < C₁.φ i x) :
    (C₁.tensor C₂).fIter i n (x, y) = (C₂.fIter i n y).map (x, ·)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fIter_succ', ih fun k hk ↦ h k (by omega), fIter_succ']
    cases hy : C₂.fIter i n y with
    | none => rfl
    | some y' =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
      simp only [tensor_f, h n (by omega) y' hy, ↓reduceIte]

name: Crystal.tensor_eIter_left
statement:
lemma tensor_eIter_left (n : ℕ) (x : B₁) (y : B₂)
    (h : ∀ k < n, ∀ x', C₁.eIter i k x = some x' → C₂.ε i y ≤ C₁.φ i x') :
    (C₁.tensor C₂).eIter i n (x, y) = (C₁.eIter i n x).map (·, y)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [eIter_succ', ih fun k hk ↦ h k (by omega), eIter_succ']
    cases hx : C₁.eIter i n x with
    | none => rfl
    | some x' =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
      simp only [tensor_e, h n (by omega) x' hx, ↓reduceIte]

name: Crystal.tensor_eIter_right
statement:
lemma tensor_eIter_right (n : ℕ) (x : B₁) (y : B₂)
    (h : ∀ k < n, ∀ y', C₂.eIter i k y = some y' → ¬ C₂.ε i y' ≤ C₁.φ i x) :
    (C₁.tensor C₂).eIter i n (x, y) = (C₂.eIter i n y).map (x, ·)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [eIter_succ', ih fun k hk ↦ h k (by omega), eIter_succ']
    cases hy : C₂.eIter i n y with
    | none => rfl
    | some y' =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
      simp only [tensor_e, h n (by omega) y' hy, ↓reduceIte]

name: Crystal.Similarity.toFun_eq_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma toFun_eq_coe (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) : σ.toFun = σ
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.Similarity.wt_apply
statement: lemma wt_apply (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) (b : B₁) : C₂.wt (σ b) = m • C₁.wt b
proof: := σ.wt_map b

name: Crystal.Similarity.ε_apply
statement: lemma ε_apply (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.ε i (σ b) = m • C₁.ε i b
proof:
:=
  σ.ε_map i b

name: Crystal.Similarity.eIter_apply
statement:
lemma eIter_apply (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) (i : ι) (b : B₁) :
    C₂.eIter i m (σ b) = (C₁.e i b).map σ
proof: := σ.e_map i b

name: Crystal.Similarity.fIter_apply
statement:
lemma fIter_apply (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) (i : ι) (b : B₁) :
    C₂.fIter i m (σ b) = (C₁.f i b).map σ
proof: := σ.f_map i b

name: Crystal.Similarity.φ_apply
statement: lemma φ_apply (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) (i : ι) (b : B₁) : C₂.φ i (σ b) = m • C₁.φ i b
proof:
:= by
  rw [C₂.φ_eq, C₁.φ_eq, σ.ε_apply, σ.wt_apply, map_nsmul, nsmul_add, ← WithBot.coe_nsmul]

name: Crystal.Similarity.fWord_stretchWord
statement:
theorem fWord_stretchWord (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) (w : List ι) (b : B₁) :
    C₂.fWord (stretchWord m w) (σ b) = (C₁.fWord w b).map σ
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [fWord_stretchWord_cons, ih, fWord_cons]
    cases C₁.fWord w b with
    | none => rfl
    | some x => exact σ.fIter_apply j x

name: Crystal.Similarity.compStrictHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compStrictHom_apply (ψ : StrictHom C₂ C₃) (σ : Similarity C₁ C₂ m) (b : B₁) :
    σ.compStrictHom ψ b = ψ (σ b)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.Similarity.strictHomComp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma strictHomComp_apply (σ : Similarity C₂ C₃ m) (ψ : StrictHom C₁ C₂) (b : B₁) :
    σ.strictHomComp ψ b = σ (ψ b)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.Similarity.tensorMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tensorMap_apply (hm : 0 < m) (σ₁ : Similarity C₁ C₁' m) (σ₂ : Similarity C₂ C₂' m)
    (b : B₁ × B₂) : tensorMap hm σ₁ σ₂ b = (σ₁ b.1, σ₂ b.2)
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.elementary_fIter_self
statement:
lemma elementary_fIter_self (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    (elementary D i).fIter i n a = some (a - n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fIter_succ', ih, Option.bind_some, elementary_f_self]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: Crystal.elementary_ε_nsmul
statement:
lemma elementary_ε_nsmul {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (i k : ι) (n : ℤ) :
    (elementary D i).ε k (m * n) = m • (elementary D i).ε k n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst hki
    rw [elementary_ε_self, elementary_ε_self, nsmul_coe_withBot, mul_neg]
  · rw [elementary_ε_of_ne hki, elementary_ε_of_ne hki, nsmul_bot_withBot hm]

name: Crystal.ε_tensor_elementary_nsmul
statement:
lemma ε_tensor_elementary_nsmul {C : Crystal D B} {C' : Crystal D B'} {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (i k : ι) {b : B} {b' : B'} (n : ℤ) (hε : C'.ε k b' = m • C.ε k b)
    (hwt : C'.wt b' = m • C.wt b) :
    (C'.tensor (elementary D i)).ε k (b', m * n) = m • (C.tensor (elementary D i)).ε k (b, n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensor_elementary_ε, tensor_elementary_ε, hε, hwt, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_neg,
    nsmul_max_add_withBot hm, elementary_ε_nsmul hm]

name: Crystal.KSData.fWord_eq_some_fw
statement: lemma fWord_eq_some_fw (w : List ι) : C.fWord w b₀ = some (K.fw hD w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j w ih => rw [fWord_cons, ih, Option.bind_some, K.f_fw]

name: Crystal.KSData.fIter_fw_stretchWord
statement:
lemma fIter_fw_stretchWord (j : ι) (w : List ι) :
    C.fIter j m (K.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = some (K.fw hD (stretchWord m (j :: w)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := K.fWord_eq_some_fw hD (stretchWord m (j :: w))
  rwa [fWord_stretchWord_cons, K.fWord_eq_some_fw hD, Option.bind_some] at h

name: Crystal.KSData.wt_fw_stretchWord
statement:
lemma wt_fw_stretchWord (w : List ι) :
    C.wt (K.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = m • C.wt (K.fw hD w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.wt_fw, K.wt_fw, smul_neg]
  congr 1
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [stretchWord_cons, List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
      nsmul_add, List.map_replicate, List.sum_replicate]

name: Crystal.KSData.wt_fw_stretchWord_eq
statement:
lemma wt_fw_stretchWord_eq (w : List ι) :
    C'.wt (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = m • C.wt (K.fw hD w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K'.wt_fw_stretchWord hD, K'.wt_fw, K.wt_fw]

name: Crystal.KSData.ht_fw_stretchWord
statement: lemma ht_fw_stretchWord (w : List ι) : K.ht (K.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = m * w.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.ht_fw, length_stretchWord]

name: Crystal.KSData.φ_eq_nsmul_of_ε_eq
statement:
lemma φ_eq_nsmul_of_ε_eq {b : B} {b' : B'} (j : ι)
    (hε : C'.ε j b' = m • C.ε j b) (hwt : C'.wt b' = m • C.wt b) :
    C'.φ j b' = m • C.φ j b
proof:
:= by
  rw [C'.φ_eq, C.φ_eq, hε, hwt, map_nsmul, nsmul_add, ← WithBot.coe_nsmul]

name: Crystal.KSData.exists_Ψ_fw_stretchWord
statement:
theorem exists_Ψ_fw_stretchWord (hm : 0 < m) (L : ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ w : List ι, w.length ≤ L →
      ∀ k, C'.ε k (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = m • C.ε k (K.fw hD w))
    (i : ι) (w : List ι) (hw : w.length ≤ L + 1) :
    ∃ (u : List ι) (n : ℤ), K.Ψ i (K.fw hD w) = (K.fw hD u, n) ∧
      K'.Ψ i (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m u), m * n)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨[], 0, K.Ψ_b₀ hD i, ?_⟩
    change K'.Ψ i b₀' = (b₀', (m : ℤ) * 0)
    rw [K'.Ψ_b₀ hD i, mul_zero]
  | cons j w ih =>
    rw [List.length_cons] at hw
    obtain ⟨u, n, h1, h1'⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hlen : u.length ≤ L := by
      have := K.ht_Ψ hD i (K.fw hD w)
      rw [h1, K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
      simp only at this
      omega
    have hf := (K.Ψ i).f_apply j (K.fw hD w)
    rw [h1, K.f_fw, Option.map_some, tensor_elementary_f] at hf
    have hf' := (K'.Ψ i).fIter_apply j m (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w))
    rw [K'.fIter_fw_stretchWord hD, Option.map_some, h1'] at hf'
    have hφ : C'.φ j (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m u)) = m • C.φ j (K.fw hD u) :=
      φ_eq_nsmul_of_ε_eq j (hE u hlen j) (K.wt_fw_stretchWord_eq hD K' u)
    split_ifs at hf with hc
    · 
      rw [K.f_fw, Option.map_some, Option.some_inj] at hf
      refine ⟨j :: u, n, hf.symm, ?_⟩
      rw [tensor_fIter_left, K'.fIter_fw_stretchWord hD, Option.map_some, Option.some_inj] at hf'
      · exact hf'.symm
      · intro k hk x' hx'
        rw [elementary_ε_nsmul hm]
        refine nsmul_lt_of_lt_of_eq_add hk hc ?_
        rw [← hφ]
        exact C'.φ_fIter hx'
    · 
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst hji
        rw [elementary_f_self, Option.map_some, Option.some_inj] at hf
        refine ⟨u, n - 1, hf.symm, ?_⟩
        rw [tensor_fIter_right, elementary_fIter_self, Option.map_some, Option.some_inj] at hf'
        · rw [← hf', mul_sub, mul_one]
        · intro k _ y' hy'
          rw [hφ]
          rw [elementary_fIter_self, Option.some_inj] at hy'
          subst hy'
          refine not_lt_nsmul_of_le (k := k) (not_lt.mp hc) ?_
          rw [elementary_ε_self, elementary_ε_self, nsmul_coe_withBot, ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
            ← WithBot.coe_add]
          congr 1
          ring
      · rw [elementary_ε_of_ne hji] at hc
        exact absurd (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.2 (K.φ_ne_bot j _)) hc

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_stretchWord_and_ε
statement:
theorem fw_stretchWord_and_ε (hm : 0 < m) (L : ℕ) :
    (∀ w : List ι, w.length ≤ L →
      ∀ k, C'.ε k (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = m • C.ε k (K.fw hD w)) ∧
    (∀ w w' : List ι, w.length ≤ L → w'.length ≤ L → K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w' →
      K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w')) ∧
    (∀ w w' : List ι, w.length ≤ L → w'.length ≤ L →
      K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w') → K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w')
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun w hw k ↦ ?_, fun w w' hw hw' _ ↦ ?_, fun w w' hw hw' _ ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.1 hw), stretchWord_nil, fw_nil, fw_nil,
        K.ε_b₀, K'.ε_b₀, nsmul_zero]
    all_goals rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.1 hw),
      List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.1 hw')]
  | succ L ih =>
    obtain ⟨hE, hS, hS'⟩ := ih
    have hu : ∀ {w u : List ι} {n : ℤ} {i : ι}, w.length ≤ L + 1 →
        K.Ψ i (K.fw hD w) = (K.fw hD u, n) → n < 0 → u.length ≤ L := by
      intro w u n i hw h hn
      have := K.ht_Ψ hD i (K.fw hD w)
      rw [h, K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
      simp only at this
      omega
    refine ⟨fun w hw k ↦ ?_, fun w w' hw hw' heq ↦ ?_, fun w w' hw hw' heq ↦ ?_⟩
    · 
      by_cases hL : w.length ≤ L
      · exact hE w hL k
      have hne : K.fw hD w ≠ b₀ := K.fw_ne_b₀ hD (fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hL)
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_snd_neg _ hne
      obtain ⟨u, n, h1, h1'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw_stretchWord hD K' hm L hE i w hw
      rw [h1] at hi
      have hlu := hu hw h1 hi
      rw [← (K.Ψ i).ε_apply, ← (K'.Ψ i).ε_apply, h1, h1']
      exact ε_tensor_elementary_nsmul hm i k n (hE u hlu k) (K.wt_fw_stretchWord_eq hD K' u)
    · 
      have hlen : w.length = w'.length := by
        have := congrArg K.ht heq
        rwa [K.ht_fw, K.ht_fw] at this
      by_cases hL : w.length ≤ L
      · exact hS w w' hL (hlen ▸ hL) heq
      have hne : K.fw hD w ≠ b₀ := K.fw_ne_b₀ hD (fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hL)
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_snd_neg _ hne
      obtain ⟨u, n, h1, h1'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw_stretchWord hD K' hm L hE i w hw
      obtain ⟨u', n', h2, h2'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw_stretchWord hD K' hm L hE i w' hw'
      have h12 : (K.fw hD u, n) = (K.fw hD u', n') := by rw [← h1, ← h2, heq]
      obtain ⟨hfu, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h12
      rw [h1] at hi
      have hlu := hu hw h1 hi
      have hlu' := hu hw' h2 hi
      apply K'.Ψ_injective i
      rw [h1', h2', hS u u' hlu hlu' hfu]
    · 
      have hlen : w.length = w'.length := by
        have := congrArg K'.ht heq
        rw [K'.ht_fw_stretchWord hD, K'.ht_fw_stretchWord hD] at this
        exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hm this
      by_cases hL : w.length ≤ L
      · exact hS' w w' hL (hlen ▸ hL) heq
      have hne : K.fw hD w ≠ b₀ := K.fw_ne_b₀ hD (fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hL)
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_snd_neg _ hne
      obtain ⟨u, n, h1, h1'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw_stretchWord hD K' hm L hE i w hw
      obtain ⟨u', n', h2, h2'⟩ := K.exists_Ψ_fw_stretchWord hD K' hm L hE i w' hw'
      have h12 : (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m u), (m : ℤ) * n) =
          (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m u'), m * n') := by rw [← h1', ← h2', heq]
      obtain ⟨hfu, hn⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h12
      have hnn : n = n' := mul_left_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hm.ne' : (m : ℤ) ≠ 0) hn
      subst hnn
      rw [h1] at hi
      have hlu := hu hw h1 hi
      have hlu' := hu hw' h2 hi
      apply K.Ψ_injective i
      rw [h1, h2, hS' u u' hlu hlu' hfu]

name: Crystal.KSData.ε_fw_stretchWord
statement:
theorem ε_fw_stretchWord (hm : 0 < m) (w : List ι) (k : ι) :
    C'.ε k (K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w)) = m • C.ε k (K.fw hD w)
proof:
:=
  (K.fw_stretchWord_and_ε hD K' hm w.length).1 w le_rfl k

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_stretchWord_eq_of_fw_eq
statement:
theorem fw_stretchWord_eq_of_fw_eq (hm : 0 < m) {w w' : List ι} (h : K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w') :
    K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w')
proof:
:=
  (K.fw_stretchWord_and_ε hD K' hm (max w.length w'.length)).2.1 w w' (le_max_left _ _)
    (le_max_right _ _) h

name: Crystal.KSData.fw_eq_of_fw_stretchWord_eq
statement:
theorem fw_eq_of_fw_stretchWord_eq (hm : 0 < m) {w w' : List ι}
    (h : K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w')) : K.fw hD w = K.fw hD w'
proof:
:=
  (K.fw_stretchWord_and_ε hD K' hm (max w.length w'.length)).2.2 w w' (le_max_left _ _)
    (le_max_right _ _) h

name: Crystal.KSData.stretchFun_fw
statement:
lemma stretchFun_fw (hm : 0 < m) (w : List ι) :
    K.stretchFun hD K' m (K.fw hD w) = K'.fw hD (stretchWord m w)
proof:
:=
  K.fw_stretchWord_eq_of_fw_eq hD K' hm (K.fw_word hD _)

name: Crystal.KSData.similarity_apply
statement:
lemma similarity_apply (hm : 0 < m) (hC : ∀ i b, C.e i b = none → C.ε i b = 0)
    (hC' : ∀ i b, C'.ε i b = 0 → C'.e i b = none) (b : B) :
    K.similarity hD K' hm hC hC' b = K.stretchFun hD K' m b
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.KSData.similarity_injective
statement:
theorem similarity_injective (hm : 0 < m) (hC : ∀ i b, C.e i b = none → C.ε i b = 0)
    (hC' : ∀ i b, C'.ε i b = 0 → C'.e i b = none) :
    Function.Injective (K.similarity hD K' hm hC hC')
proof:
:= by
  intro b b' h
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := K.exists_fw_eq hD b
  obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := K.exists_fw_eq hD b'
  rw [similarity_apply, similarity_apply, K.stretchFun_fw hD K' hm,
    K.stretchFun_fw hD K' hm] at h
  exact K.fw_eq_of_fw_stretchWord_eq hD K' hm h

name: Crystal.KSData.similarity_b₀
statement:
theorem similarity_b₀ (hm : 0 < m) (hC : ∀ i b, C.e i b = none → C.ε i b = 0)
    (hC' : ∀ i b, C'.ε i b = 0 → C'.e i b = none) :
    K.similarity hD K' hm hC hC' b₀ = b₀'
proof:
:= by
  exact K.stretchFun_fw hD K' hm []

name: Crystal.TPow.toList_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma toList_zero (x : TPow B 0) : toList x = []
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.TPow.toList_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma toList_succ {n : ℕ} (x : TPow B (n + 1)) : toList x = x.1 :: toList x.2
proof: := rfl

name: Crystal.TPow.length_toList
statement: lemma length_toList : {n : ℕ} → (x : TPow B n) → (toList x).length = n
proof:
| 0, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, x => by rw [toList_succ, List.length_cons, length_toList x.2]

name: Crystal.TPow.toList_injective
statement: lemma toList_injective : {n : ℕ} → Function.Injective (toList : TPow B n → List B)
proof:
| 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, x, y, h => by
    rw [toList_succ, toList_succ, List.cons.injEq] at h
    exact Prod.ext h.1 (toList_injective h.2)

name: Crystal.TPow.toList_replicate
statement: @[simp] lemma toList_replicate (b : B) : (n : ℕ) → toList (replicate b n) = List.replicate n b
proof:
| 0 => rfl
